Zhou Guilan looked at her husband's back, shook her head and sighed.
Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong, the two sisters-in-law, winked and winked, each with their own thoughts, envious and jealous of various emotions, wishing to separate immediately.
Xu Shiyan didn't know about these, and even if he knew, he wouldn't care.
After working for a long time, I was tired and hungry, and I ate three bowls of porridge in one go, which made me feel comfortable.
After eating, the couple gathered up the things they bought today.
Su Anying looked at the things her husband bought for her, and was moved to tears. Xu Shiyan was so scared that he thought he had done something wrong, so he coaxed him clumsily for a while.
"By the way, this is the money left over from spending, and there are more than 30 yuan, you take it."
Seeing that his daughter-in-law stopped crying, Xu Shiyan finally breathed a sigh of relief, and hurriedly handed over the rest of the money to her for safekeeping.
"Don't, don't, I don't want it, you should keep it." Su Anying waved her hands in fright.
Before she got married, although Su Anying also went to work in the fields to earn work points, her stepmother managed all the family money.
Marrying into Xu's family, she originally thought she was the mother-in-law's housekeeper, and Su Anying never thought that there would be a time when she managed the money by herself.
Dozens of dollars is already a huge sum of money in her eyes, and she dare not ask for it.
"We are husband and wife, husband and wife are one body, naturally you have to take care of the money." Xu Shiyan smiled, feeling a little distressed.
"This is just the beginning. I will send fish to the Songjiang River every week in the future, and I will make some money."
"If there is a job in the team, I will go to earn work points. If I don't have a job, I will go to the mountains to collect herbs and do a side job. After a few days, when I am in Honghamut City, I will go to the mountains to release the mountain and dig clubs. I can still hunt in winter."
Thinking back now, he had a bad life in his previous life. It wasn't that he was lazy, it was just bad luck.
In 1979, an accident occurred in the Daan Coal Mine, and it took more than half a year to recuperate from his injuries. He was neither a worker nor a farmer, and it was impossible for Xu Shiyan to be supported by the mine.
After giving some symbolic compensation, Xu Shiyan could only go home and work in farming.
In this poor and remote small place along the Dongjiang River, the whole village has only about 700 mu of arable land, and even less ginseng land.
There was no tobacco company to place an order in that year, and it was all pointing to going to the market for retail sales in winter, which could not form an industry and naturally did not make money.
Moved to Donggang in 1987 and missed the team's ginseng site, so I could only go to the mountains to dig soil for others, see ginseng, and do side jobs, and finally developed slowly.
As a result, the price of ginseng plummeted in 1991 and 1992, and the days when it was just a little bit of color fell to the bottom again.
In 1995, the price of ginseng rose anyway, so I took a breath of relief.
Unexpectedly, in the autumn of 1998, the couple went to work in the mountains and got into a car accident again. Su Anying was seriously injured and died on the spot, and Xu Shiyan was seriously injured and was hospitalized for a long time.
This time it was definitely a fatal blow. All the property of the Xu family, including the ginseng and ginseng fields in the field, were tossed in, and there was still a lot of famine outside.
The two daughters were a senior and a freshman at the time, and both dropped out of school to work part-time to support their families.
It's a pity that the two daughters in his family are very good at studying. If there is no accident at home, both children can be admitted to college, how great would it be?
"Daughter-in-law, I dare not say that I can make you rich, but I will treat you well in this life and never let you suffer."
Recalling the hardships and hardships the couple had suffered in the previous life, Xu Shiyan only felt sad, stretched out his arms to hug his daughter-in-law, and made a solemn promise.
Su Anying snuggled into her husband's arms, showing a contented smile. "As long as you treat me well, I'm not afraid of suffering.
I am very capable. I work in the fields to earn work points, which is no worse than a man's work. Together, we will gradually get better. "
Xu Shiyan chuckled, raised his hand to help his daughter-in-law tidy up her sideburns, "The most important thing is to take good care of your body, and leave it to me to make money."
The two have lived together for a lifetime, how can Xu Shiyan not understand the person next to him? This daughter-in-law in his family can't be called capable, she is too capable.
Back when he was working in the coal mine, Su Anying stayed at Xu's house. The two sisters-in-law played tricks and pushed all the work at home to Su Anying.
Even so, Su Anying didn't delay working in the fields to earn work points.
The year when their eldest daughter was born, just as Xu Shiyan was recuperating from an accident at the mine, Su Anying was pregnant with the child and gave birth immediately, so she carried thousands of catties of sweet potatoes home with her big belly.
Later, when she moved to Donggang, Su Anying also went up the mountain to dig the soil and plant ginseng. No matter how hard or tiring she was, she never heard her complain.
If it wasn't for going to work on the mountain with him, how could the daughter-in-law die in a car accident?
In his previous life, he was incompetent, and made his wife suffer too much and suffer a lot of grievances.
In this life, Xu Shiyan hopes that his daughter-in-law will be well, safe and healthy, and grow old with him.
The two of them can see that their daughter is admitted to college, finds a good job, marries a good man, and is happy.
"Well, I will entrust you with making money in the future, and I will entrust everything in the family to me. I don't believe it. The two of us work together, how can we live well?"
Su Anying naturally trusted her husband wholeheartedly.
The newlywed couple cuddled together, chattering as if they had endless things to say. The two imagined the future, as if a better life was right in front of them.
Old Mrs. Li in the east room heard it, but she couldn't make a sound, she just shook her head and laughed.
Young man, how naive, how easy is it to live? It is a good day to be able to have a full meal and not go hungry or cold, so what else do you want?
"San'er, we don't have much firewood at home, help the aunt chop some firewood. It's time to make dinner again later."
The old lady really didn't want to disturb the young couple in the Westinghouse, but when she went out to check, she found that there was not enough firewood.
As soon as Xu Shiyan from Westinghouse heard this, he let go of his wife and came out of the house.
"Mother, let me come. When I come back tomorrow, I will go to the mountains to collect more firewood. Don't worry, keeping it in winter will not let you freeze."

chapters.title: Chapter 11: back door
chapters.content:
Chapter 11 Back Door
In the evening, the young couple rested early, and early the next morning, the young couple packed up their things and prepared to return home.
Su Anying’s family is in Daying Commune. From Dongjiangyan to Daying, you have to walk to Jewelry Hill, then take a train from Jewelry Hill to Xianren Bridge, and then walk from Xianren Bridge to Daying.
If you look at it from the map, walking like this is equivalent to going around half a circle. It is better to walk along the mountain road along the Dongjiang River and go straight to Daying.
But the mountain road is rugged and difficult, and there is a section of the road where you have to climb rocks, which is too dangerous, so Xu Shiyan would rather be safe.
Walk more than eight miles north from Dongjiangyan all the way to Qingling, where Xu Shide taught, and then walk seven or eight miles north, and you will come to the drop-off station of Zhuanggang.
Zhugegang is the pronunciation of Zhugegang. Zhuge means dead in Korean.
During the Japanese puppet period, many people died of Keshan disease in the Zhuanggang area, so this place name was left behind.
The construction of the Hunbai Railway began in 1958, and it was fully opened to traffic in 1974.
There are several express trains and slow trains from Baihe to Tonghua, and from Baihe to Shenyang every day. In addition to the Yanling train, it is quite convenient to go to Xianrenqiao.
At 5:10, there happened to be a bus coming into the station along the zero train. Xu Shiyan helped his wife squeeze into the bus, paid for the fare and sat down.
Along the zero train, that is, the freight train hangs two carriages to carry passengers, most of which are short-distance.
The trains of this year are still old-fashioned steam engines, the kind that burn coal, and someone is responsible for filling coal into the boiler.
When encountering an uphill, add coal in advance, the train is suffocating black smoke, and climbs uphill.
The journey from Zhuzhugang to Xianrenqiao is a total of 24 to 5 miles. There is a stop at Huangjiaweizi in the middle, and the speed along the zero train is slow. After about 20 minutes, we arrive at Xianrenqiao.
Walk five or six miles westward from Xianrenqiao Station, and you will arrive at Daying Village, where Daying Commune is located, also called Daying Brigade.
There are many place names with the word "ying" in Fusong area, most of which are related to ginseng.
In 1910, Xie Taixin, a Dasan household in Yingkou, hired more than 100 workers and set up a relatively large Bangchui Camp here, so it was later called Day Camp.
As soon as the young couple entered the village with their things, they were seen by children playing outside. After a while, many children gathered around and started booing.
"Oh, oh, the second sister of the Su family is leading her son-in-law home." A group of children were yelling there, causing Su Anying's face to turn red.
"Okay, okay, don't make a fuss, each of you will give you a piece of candy, and go play."
Xu Shiyan took out a handful of candies from his pocket and distributed them to the children, so as not to let them mess around.
Now life is hard at this time, and for the children, getting a piece of candy is almost in time for the Chinese New Year, and they are jumping happily.
"Hurry up, go to Su's house and report a letter, saying that the second sister brought her son-in-law home."
The leader of the child had candy in his mouth, and gave instructions vaguely.
When two boys heard this, they rushed out with a whoosh, and Su Anying shouted in fright, telling them to run slowly, and don't choke on sugar in their mouths.
"It's okay, I'm used to it." Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head.
The children of this age are all outside, crazy all day long, they don’t care about anything, they are honest.
The husband and wife walked side by side to the village, followed by a group of children, and met a few old men and old ladies on the road from time to time.
"Hey, isn't this the third kid from the old Xu family? Did you come back home with your wife today?
Good guy, you still have these old things with you. No wonder people say that the old Xu's life is better, it's true. "Someone said with emotion.
Xu Jiazu came to the Northeast through the Guandong, and initially lived in Shijiagou, Yinkuangzi Village, Qingshangou Township, Kuandian.
As the name suggests, Shijiagou is full of rocks, and you can hear movement on this hillside when you shovel the ground.
The land is barren, the grain output is low, and the people are very poor.
It is said that the poorer you are, the lazy you are. This is true. When Xu Chenghou was young, he was not only lazy, but also loved to gamble. I often go out to play money, and I don't see anyone for ten days and a half months.
Playing with money, if you win, you can buy a lot of delicious food, and if you lose, you will beat your wife and scold your children when you come home.
The house was so poor that there was no firewood for the fire. When it was time to cook, Zhou Guilan had to go to the back mountain to collect firewood. When it rained, she would worry about making a fire.
After liberation, people like Xu Chenghou became the target of attack.
If Zhou Guilan's old mother hadn't suggested to let them move out, Xu Chenghou would have been arrested long ago.
In the autumn of 1957, Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan moved to Fusong with their children.
Maybe it was the old lady of the Zhou family's beatings that worked, or it might be Xu Chenghou's repentance.
Xu Chenghou changed it like this, and worked steadily to earn work points, and successfully gained a foothold in Daying.
It's a pity that in 1967 and 1968, Xu Shixian jumped up and down all kinds of slapstick, writing "black material" about the leaders of the commune.
Offended people, was excluded everywhere, and couldn't get along in the big camp.
Exactly in 1970, Xu Shide became a substitute teacher and taught in Dongjiangyan, so his family had to move to Dongjiangyan to live.
It has only been seven years since Xu’s family left Daying, and there are relatives here who often come and go, so most of them know Xu Shiyan.
Seeing Xu Shiyan accompany his wife back home, they had to say hello and chat.
Su's house is right next to the small river in the middle of the village. Before they could cross the bridge, they saw Su Anying's fifth younger sister, Su Anfang, and sixth younger sister, Su Anhua, running towards her.
"Second sister, second brother-in-law, you are back. My parents were still talking about it this morning, saying they wonder if second sister can come back today."
Su Anfang rushed over, pushed Xu Shiyan away, and reached out to hug the second sister's left arm.
"Just now a few boys came to report that it was the second sister who came back.
The parents were very happy, let us come out to greet them. "Su Anhua hugged her sister's right arm.
The sisters of the Su family have a very good relationship, especially the fifth and sixth, who grew up on Su Anying's back since childhood, so seeing her sister back, she was very affectionate.
Xu Shiyan was not annoyed when he was squeezed away by his two sisters-in-law. He just smiled and followed behind with his things.
Cross the bridge and turn north, and walk outside the gate of Su’s house.
The Su family lived by the river, with three adobe houses.
The roof is made of wood thatch that is split into the thickness of a finger and is more than a foot long. The locals call it "thatch house."
Daying has a large population, and Su's family is in the middle of the village, so the yard is not very big, and the stick is clamped with a piece of wood as tall as a person.
The two wooden doors did not have door handles, and the door was open at the moment. Su Anzhen, the third child, and Su Anfen, the fourth child of the Su family, were standing in the yard, looking out eagerly.
As soon as they saw Su Anying and his wife, they immediately became happy and shouted into the room.
"Father, mother, it's really my second sister and second brother-in-law who are back."
As soon as the words fell, Su Weizhong, the father of the Su family, and his wife Han Cai'e came out of the house, just in time to meet Xu Shiyan and his wife.
"Father, mother, I'm back." Seeing her parents, Su Anying couldn't help it, her eyes filled with tears.
"Father-in-law, mother-in-law, I will accompany Yingzi back to visit the two elders." Xu Shiyan stepped forward to salute, which was owed in his previous life.
"Hey, hey, just come back, just come back, come on, come in, come in."
Su Weizhong also looked very excited, and hurriedly called Xu Shiyan and his wife into the house.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Crayfish Tofu
chapters.content:
Chapter 12 Cricket Tofu
Su Anying and his wife returned home early in the morning with a lot of things. Everyone in the Su family was very happy and warmly entertained the young couple.
"Look, I don't know that you came back so early and didn't prepare anything.
Let’s take a bite this morning, and ask your mother to cook something delicious for you at noon. "
It was six o'clock, just in time for breakfast, and Su Weizhong felt a little shabby looking at the porridge, pickles and miso on the table.
When the new uncle enters the door, how can the first meal be so simple?
"Mother, I remember we still have salted duck eggs, right? Hurry up, cook some."
Su’s family lived by the river, so they raised two ducks. They were reluctant to eat their eggs, and sold most of them.
Leave a few pickles for serving.
The new son-in-law came in as a distinguished guest, so he had to treat him well. Without saying a word, Mrs. Han went to find two salted duck eggs from the jar, boiled them in a pot, cut them open and served them.
"Try it, the duck eggs are well marinated this year, and the oil is flowing."
Han put the duck eggs directly in front of Xu Shiyan and Su Anying with a smile on his face, and beckoned them to eat.
Xu Shiyan refused again and again, but he didn't dare to be stubborn, so he finally poked some egg yolks with chopsticks and put them in the porridge to eat.
As for Su Anying, how could she be willing to eat salted duck eggs?
Seeing the two younger sisters lowering their heads and sneaking a glance here, Su Anying directly divided her half duck egg into the bowls of the two younger sisters.
"Yingzi, eat yours and ignore them."
Mrs. Han just wanted to talk about the two young ones when she saw her, but saw that the two young ones ate all the porridge and salted duck eggs in the bowl in a few mouthfuls. Angrily, Mrs. Han stared at the two daughters.
Seeing this, Xu Shiyan didn't say a word, but took advantage of others not paying attention, and dug his share of salted duck eggs into his wife's bowl. "Let's eat."
Su Anying glanced at her parents secretly, split the salted duck egg in half and put it back into Xu Shiyan's bowl.
The young couple looked at each other, smiled and drank the porridge in the bowl.
Su Weizhong had seen the little tricks of his daughter and son-in-law a long time ago, and he didn't point it out. He just finished the meal with a smile.
It is said that the uncle is here, and Su Weizhong should accompany the guests at home.
But Su Weizhong is the captain of the production team, without him assigning errands, today's job probably wouldn't be clear.
Xu Shiyan saw his father-in-law's embarrassment, so he took the initiative to mention that he was going to visit his relatives in the morning.
Let the father-in-law do what he should, without delaying the team's work because of him.
Just like that, Su Weizhong hurried to the production team to arrange today's work after breakfast, while Xu Shiyan led his wife and went out to visit relatives.
Xu Shiyan's grandmother, two uncles, and an aunt are all in Daying.
Come back, if you don’t go elsewhere, you have to visit your grandmother.
It was past ten o'clock when a group of relatives walked down. When the young couple returned to Su's house, they saw many people laughing and laughing, wondering what they were busy with.
It wasn't until I got closer that I realized that it was Su Weizhong's sister-in-law, Mrs. Feng, who came next door with her daughter-in-law and daughter, and was helping Mrs. Han deal with the crickets there.
"Hey, Yingzi and uncle are back? Come in and sit down, it's tiring to go around on a hot day."
Feng's temperament is bright and hospitable, and he treats Su Anying very well.
"Xiaoyu, hurry home and pick some cherries for your brother-in-law.
Check to see if the peaches on the peach tree in the pot are ripe, pick two and give them to your brother-in-law. "
"Anmin, go into the house and talk with your brother-in-law, we will be busy for a while, and I will make cricket tofu for you at noon today."
Feng's is more like a master than Han's, everything is well arranged.
"Coincidentally, yesterday Anmin caught a lot of crickets in the lower reaches of the Tanghe River. I didn't cook them for them because I thought they were too young. It's just right to make cricket tofu."
Su Anmin is the third son of Feng and Su Weicheng. He is fifteen this year. He doesn't like to study. He refuses to go to junior high school after primary school.
Going up and down the mountains and rivers all over the world, they are also very good at catching fish and shrimp.
The cricket tofu that Feng mentioned is a major specialty in Northeast China. Most people who live by the riverside know how to make it, but they rarely do it.
Crayfish, also known as big head shrimp and crayfish, look very similar to crayfish.
The difference is that the body of crayfish is greenish brown, while that of crayfish is dark red. The shell of crayfish is not so thick, while the shell of crayfish is thick and has hard spines.
The first pair of legs of crayfish, that is, the front claws are relatively large. When compared with crayfish and crayfish with the same body size, the claws of crayfish are much larger than those of crayfish.
The living habits of the two are also different. Crayfish grow in clear and transparent streams, have extremely high requirements on water quality, and are sensitive to chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
Crayfish is a kind of Northeast river fresh food. Its taste is delicious and unique. In the eyes of Northeast people, it is definitely the top three food list.
It's a pity that due to environmental pollution and other reasons in later generations, this kind of creature is on the verge of extinction, and only a few breed it, and the price is extremely expensive.
As for cricket tofu, it is definitely not stewed with cricket and tofu.
Peel off the shell of the cricket, remove the sand thread at the tail, then put it in a stone mortar and mash it, and then use gauze to filter out the reddish-brown juice for later use.
Boil the water in the pot, pour the crayfish juice into it, stir gently, and you will see pink flowers floating from the pot.
Add some salt to taste, sprinkle with chopped leeks, this dish is ready, and if possible, you can also make frangipani flowers.
The three colors of red, yellow, and green are very beautiful mixed together, and the taste is soft and tender, just like tofu, so it is called cricket tofu.
This soup combines the umami flavors of crayfish and leeks. It doesn’t need to add any seasoning to remove the fishy smell. Take a sip and it will definitely be delicious enough to swallow your tongue.
However, because the production process is too troublesome, especially in these days when there are no crushing tools, mashing purely by hand is too laborious, so most people seldom do it.
If it wasn't for the new uncle returning home, no matter how many crickets Su Anmin caught, Feng wouldn't bother to cook them. At most, he would cook them with some salt.
"Auntie, this cricket tofu is too troublesome, why bother?
Look at me coming here, it's really troublesome for my aunt, sister-in-law, and third brother. "
Such a high standard of hospitality was something that Xu Shiyan had never experienced in his previous life.
At that time, he went to work in Daan Coal Mine the second day after he got married, and he didn't accompany Su Anying back home at all.
Although the Su family didn't say anything, they must be unhappy in their hearts.
In this life, Xu Shiyan not only accompanied his daughter-in-law back home, but also brought a generous home gift, which can be regarded as an embarrassment to the Su family.
When Su Weizhong was about to leave the house, he specifically told him that no matter what method he tried, he had to prepare a table of delicious dishes to entertain my uncle at noon.
"Hey, what is this? It's the first time for the new uncle to come to the door, and he is a distinguished guest.
The rules of our family are like this, your uncle will also come over at noon, and you and your father will have a good drink at that time. "
Feng's hearty laughter made people feel better after hearing it.

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Hospitality
chapters.content:
Chapter 13 Hospitality
Xu Shiyan and his wife were escorted into the house by Feng Shi to rest. Su Anyu picked cherries and peaches, and Su Anmin poured tea for her brother-in-law and chatted with her.
In the kitchen, Feng Shi, Han Shi and others were frying and frying, and all kinds of aromas wafted out.
No matter who passed by and smelled it, they would all salivate.
At eleven o'clock, Su Weicheng, Su Weizhong brothers who were working in the field, and Su Anying's cousin Su Anbang came back together.
The rules in the Northeast, when guests come to the house, you must find relatives and friends to accompany the guests.
Su Weicheng is Su Anying's uncle, so he must be invited for such a scene.
"Hey brother and sister, what delicious food are you cooking for lunch? You can smell the fragrance from a long way away, so greedy." Su Weicheng asked loudly as soon as he entered the door.
"There are too many, big brother, Anbang, go into the house and wash your hands, and dinner will be served immediately." Han greeted everyone with a smile.
Xu Shiyan also came out of the room, greeted and chatted with Su Weicheng and Su Anbang, the few men got together, and there were countless topics to talk about.
Xu Shiyan changed his image of being a sluggish, honest and silent person in the eyes of others. Although he was not too boastful, he was able to chat about every topic just right.
The man was chatting in the room, and the woman was tidying up in the kitchen. After a while, all the meals were ready.
A kang table was set up on the kang in the east room, and various dishes were served one after another.
The first dish is naturally stewed chicken with mushroom vermicelli. It is said that the uncle entered the door, and the chick lost its soul. This is really true.
Han was also willing to kill the big rooster at home, stewed the hazel mushrooms picked last autumn, and added some vermicelli.
Use a big soup bowl to hold the tip of the bowl and put it in the center of the table, the aroma wafts out with the heat.
Another stewed bacon with beans and potatoes, the meat is naturally left over from the slaughter of pigs last winter.
I didn’t want to eat it all, so I put it in salt and put it away, and I took it out and used it today.
Braised small river fish in sauce, needless to say, this must have been brought back by Su Anmin.
Stewed with homemade miso, topped with some green onion, red chili crushed, the sauce smells fresh and spicy, it is definitely a magic dish.
Fried stuffed tofu, white and tender tofu, put minced luncheon meat into the stuffing, and fry on both sides until golden.
Adjust the soup to thicken the soup, sprinkle with chopped green onion, it looks extra appetizing.
Braised pork stewed with cabbage, green cabbage stewed with canned braised pork, with some tender tofu and thin vermicelli in it.
Scrambled eggs with fungus, cut a lot of scallion white, with black fungus, golden eggs, also exudes a tempting aroma.
The finale is of course cricket tofu soup. There is no soup bowl, and it is served directly in a white enamel basin.
The red, yellow, and green color scheme is delicious and tangy, which attracts people's index fingers.
In June and July in Northeast China, there are not many kinds of vegetables, let alone fresh pork. Even if you have a meat ticket, it is impossible to go all the way to the county to buy meat.
People say "four dishes and one soup, cadres go to the countryside."
The six dishes and one soup in front of me are basically hard dishes, and the golden and fragrant rhubarb rice is definitely a super high standard.
It can also be seen that Han Shi and Feng Shi really put in a lot of effort, even the canned food brought by Xu Shiyan was cooked by them to make up this table.
"Come on, let's all go to the kang, Shiyan, sit next to your father. This table has delicious food, and you should have a good drink at noon today. Yingzi, come and sit down too."
At this time, you can see the role of accompanying guests. Without accompanying guests, the atmosphere will not be active.
After the food was set, Su Weicheng asked Xu Shiyan to take off his shoes and get on the kang, and asked Su Anmin to boil a pot of wine, and filled it up for everyone.
Su Anying hurriedly shook her head, "No, uncle, my mother, my uncle and I are eating in the Westinghouse."
There is no rule in Northeast China that women should not sit at the table, but men and women generally have different tables, and when there are guests at home, men and women are separated.
The Su family is the same, the east room has a table full of men, and the west room also has a table on the kang, where Han and Feng lead their daughters-in-law to eat.
Of course, the West House’s dishes are not as good as the East House’s. There are only four dishes and one soup. There is no fried stuffed tofu and scrambled eggs with fungus, and there is no braised pork in the cabbage.
Even so, it is a delicious dish that is not seen in ordinary times, and it smells delicious.
Feng kept adding vegetables to Su Anying's bowl, and even picked several pieces of chicken for her.
While eating, he asked Su Anying how the Xu family treated her after she married.
Su Anying was honest, so she told about Xu Shiyan and Mr. Xu's falling out on the second day of their marriage and the separation of the family.
Hearing this, both Feng Shi and Han Shi were taken aback.
There are not many sons who take the initiative to separate the family these days. If there is such a disturbance, I am afraid that Su Anying will be accused.
Of course, there are also advantages, that is, Su Anying doesn't need to get along with her mother-in-law and sister-in-law when she gets married, and she doesn't have her parents-in-law to press her head, so she can live comfortably.
"Although you are separated, you can't be too alienated from the Xu family.
My uncle can't hold back his face, you have to be sensible as a new wife. "Han pondered for a while and said.
"Your father-in-law is not easy to get along with, but mother-in-law is nice.
If there is anything going on over there, don’t hide away, go over and help, it looks good to outsiders, and people always talk about it. "
After all, Mrs. Han is at this age and has experienced many things, so she has to give Su Anying a few words.
Whether it is biological or not, she is the daughter of the Su family after all. If Su Anying has a bad reputation outside, it will also affect the girls of the Su family.
"Well, I see, I will go home today and take a look, and we will go back in the afternoon.
Tomorrow, Shi Yan and I will go to the fields to earn work points. If I have time, I will go to my mother-in-law. "
Su Anying is honest, she always listens to whatever her stepmother says, not to mention that the Han family is also thinking of her, so Su Anying naturally appreciates it.
In the west room, Feng Shi and Han Shi gave Su Anying advice, teaching her how to get along with her husband, how to have a good relationship with her in-laws, sister-in-law, sister-in-law and uncle.
It’s not easy for a woman in this life. It’s better to have parents to protect you when you are not married, so you don’t have to think about anything.
Married, become someone else's daughter-in-law, you have to think about everything.
At the moment, the atmosphere in the east room is even more lively.
Men, how many of them can still hold on to alcohol? After a few glasses of wine, his voice became much higher.
Xu Shiyan is the new son-in-law, and this is another return, everyone must toast.
Fortunately, he can drink quite well. He drank several glasses with Su Weizhong and Su Weicheng, but he didn't show anything.
Xu Shiyan has always been steady, even after drinking, he doesn't speak crazy words, and he still looks honest.
When the elders asked him, he said that he would drink if the elders asked him to drink, and he didn't talk about it. This is true and quite likable.
Su Weizhong looked at his son-in-law with various emotions.
When the matchmaker introduced him, Su Weizhong really didn't like Xu Shiyan.
I think this young man is too weak, and I am afraid that my daughter will not have a good life with him and will be bullied.
Unexpectedly, Xu Shiyan looked listless and had no temper, but in fact he was listless, and he was a bit shy.
It’s not bad that you can still earn money if you split up after getting married and bring your daughter-in-law out to live alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Weng son-in-law
chapters.content:
Chapter 14 Weng-in-law
He is honest and steady, he doesn’t go out to cause trouble, and he can make money with a little wit.
Judging from the relationship between the couple since childhood, he loves and protects his wife and knows how to love her. How reliable is such a man.
Su Weizhong looked at Xu Shiyan, and felt that the more he looked, the more pleasing he was, and it was good everywhere.
The happier he was now, the more he drank, and in the end, he simply held onto Xu Shiyan's hand and wouldn't let go.
"Shiyan, good boy, it's really good, father doesn't regret marrying his daughter to you.
In the future, I will not ask for anything else, as long as you treat Yingzi well, dad will be satisfied. "Su Weizhong said, the circles of his eyes turned red.
"It's not easy for Yingzi to be a child. She lost her mother when she was two years old, and even a grown man like me can't take care of her well.
But she has been sensible since she was a child. As a little baby, she can dress, comb her hair and wash her face by herself, so I don’t need to worry about it.
When he grows up, he is even more capable. He can do everything at home and outside, and he needs to use it better than a boy. "The more Su Weizhong said, the more sad he became.
Su Weizhong served as a soldier and participated in the battle on the other side of the Yalu River. After returning to his hometown, he married Su Anying's mother, Sun.
After giving birth to Su Anying, Mrs. Sun contracted tuberculosis, and passed away two years later, leaving behind her husband and daughter.
Su Weizhong is a big man, how can he live with a little boy? So with the help of others, she married Han Cai'e who had fled with her daughter.
Han married and gave birth to four daughters for Su Weizhong.
There are six daughters in this family. No matter how capable Su Weizhong is, he has to work hard to earn money to support him, and he can't take care of the family at all.
Fortunately, Mrs. Han has a good personality, and she treats Su Anying justifiably, never beats, scolds or abuses, and eats and clothes like the others.
Of course, a stepmother is a stepmother after all, and it is impossible to say that she is not partial.
Otherwise, why is it that Su Anying didn't go to school all day for the whole family?
Su Anying has been capable since she was a child, and she has coaxed her children behind her back since she was five or six years old. A little bigger, you can do all the laundry and cooking.
After the age of fifteen or sixteen, they go to the fields to earn work points when they are busy in farming, and go to the mountains to collect firewood when they are not in the field.
It can be said that Su Anying helped support half of the family.
Sometimes, Su Weizhong also feels ashamed of his daughter, no matter what, he should let Su Anying study for a few years, even if he graduated from primary school.
Han’s daughter, Qin Meiling, graduated from elementary school and later became a substitute teacher. She married to Hunjiang last year, and her husband works in Hunjiang Department Store.
After the two got married, Qin Meiling was transferred to Jianshe Elementary School and became a regular.
Su Anying didn't study for a day, so she could only work in the fields to earn work points, and she could only find a partner from the agricultural team.
Compared with the two, can Su Weizhong feel better?
But what can he do? He has been married to the Han family for many years, and he has four daughters, and his relationship is deeper than that of the Sun family.
It is not easy for the Han family to do this for this family. Could he still blame the Han family for this matter?
For the sake of this family, Su Weizhong can only continue to pretend to be deaf and dumb.
Xu Shiyan, who has been a man for two generations, can't understand the meaning of what the father-in-law said? Can't help but sigh.
His little daughter-in-law is really pitiful.
"Father-in-law, don't worry, I will definitely treat Yingzi, my daughter-in-law well. I have to love her when others don't love her."
Xu Shiyan looked serious, and assured the old man in a solemn tone.
"Hey, hey, good, good, Dad can see that you are a good person, I will leave Yingzi to you, I am relieved."
Su Weizhong raised his hand to wipe the corners of his eyes, smiled, and nodded repeatedly.
"Look at you, Weng and son-in-law, why don't you drink and talk about it? Come on, drink quickly."
Su Weicheng on the other end also drank a lot, his tongue was a bit stiff, and he even dragged others to drink with him.
The wine was drank from half past eleven to a little sooner, and it made several men drink up and down.
Now, there is no need to work, and they all fall asleep.
Fortunately, Su Weizhong arranged today's work in the morning, and it's okay if he doesn't go in the afternoon.
Among the few people, Xu Shiyan was the most restrained. The first time the new son-in-law came to the door, he made people get drunk, that would be too embarrassing.
Xu Shiyan can still drink, and because he knows he has nothing to drink, so Su Weizhong and the others are drunk, and Xu Shiyan barely stays awake, just resting on the kangqin at the top of the kang.
"How are you? If you feel uncomfortable, lie down for a while, don't hold on."
After the table was removed, Su Anying sat beside her husband, raised her hand worriedly, touched Xu Shiyan's forehead, and asked softly.
"It's okay, there's nothing to do, I'll just sit here for a while, the alcohol will subside after a while, don't worry." Xu Shiyan held his daughter-in-law's hand and smiled at her.
Su Anying was worried, poured a glass of water for Xu Shiyan, and sat with him for a while.
When Xu Shiyan's alcohol gradually receded and his eyes became clearer, Su Anying felt relieved.
The rule of newlyweds returning home is that they have to go home before the sun goes down.
At four o'clock in the afternoon, there was a slow train from Tonghua to Baihe passing Xianren Bridge. Xu Shiyan and Su Anying happened to be able to take this bus back home.
Just after three o'clock, Han called Su Weizhong up. After the couple discussed it, they went to the warehouse to pack a lot of rice and grain, etc., and brought it back to the young couple.
"You two come back, and there is nothing good for you at home. You two take this little food back, fill in some more, and wait until the autumn harvest."
The Su family has a large population, but they are all daughters, and they don’t eat that much, so there is some food left in the family.
If there is no separation, Su Weizhong will not mention this problem, a big family, this little food is not enough to do.
Now the young couple lives alone, and they don’t eat much. A bag of food can last for a few days, and Su Weizhong doesn’t feel bad about it.
"Oh, dad, it's not necessary, let's keep it at home to eat.
When we separated, we shared some food, enough for us to eat until autumn. "How can Xu Shiyan ask for food from his father-in-law? He quickly refused.
"Look at you kid, are you still seeing me? Yingzi has been working at home all these years, and she earned this ration." Su Weizhong looked unhappy.
"She went out, and she didn't bring anything with her at home. It's just this little food, why don't you tear it up with me?
Take it quickly, or you won't come back later. "
The father-in-law said something harsh, what else could Xu Shiyan say? I can only obey obediently. "Hey, then I'll take it."
It will be a long time in Japan. If there is a chance in the future, just send more things. Human relations, that’s how it is, there will be back and forth.
The same is true for the father-in-law and son-in-law, who have to move around frequently.
Over there, Mrs. Han also found Su Anying's old clothes and made a bundle for her to carry.
"Living at home, save as much as you can. Wear old clothes to work in the field, and don't feel bad when they are dirty. If they are really worn out, you can still wear insoles."
"I will come back often in the future, no matter what time it is, this is also your home."
After all, he is a child raised since he was a child. Even if he is not his own, he still has feelings. Before leaving, Han Shi urged him earnestly.
"My uncle is a good one. You two get along well. If you have a baby early, your father and I will be at ease."

chapters.title: Chapter 15: enemy
chapters.content:
Chapter 15 Dead Enemy
Su Weizhong sent Su Anmin and Su Anfang away, and sent Xu Shiyan and his wife to Xianrenqiao Station together.
Before getting into the car, Su Anfang hugged her second sister, very reluctant to part with her.
It was Su Anying who agreed, and would come back often in the future, so Su Anfang finally let go.
Waiting goodbye to her siblings, Su Anying followed Xu Shiyan back to Dongjiang by car.
After returning home, the lives of the young couple got back on track.
Every morning, Xu Shiyan gets up early to collect fishing nets by the river.
There are a lot of fish in the river, and Xu Shiyan is especially good at picking places to catch them, so he gets something every time.
Expensive fish such as slender scale fish or Aohua are hidden for sale.
Carp or grass carp, take it home and stew it to add another dish, and make the dinner table richer.
When the production team has work, the young couple will work together in the field to earn work points.
When he was not alive, Xu Shiyan went into the mountains, or collected firewood or herbs, anyway, he had something to do.
A week later, Xu Shiyan asked for leave from the production team, and once again sent fish to the Songjiang River with baskets on his back.
This time he brought not only fish, but also a few catties of big crayfish to the guy surnamed Guo.
Sure enough, Fatty Guo was very happy to see the cricket cricket, and he quickly collected the fish. After finishing the accounts, the two divided the money as last time.
Xu Shiyan divided more than 50 yuan, went to the store happily, and bought a bunch of things that didn't require tickets.
With two cooperations, the next thing will be smoother.
Fatty Guo directly explained to the guard, kitchen, and cashier that they must not embarrass Xu Shiyan. The fish that Xu Shiyan sent was directly weighed and counted, and no one was allowed to deduct it.
Of course, Xu Shiyan is also a human being, and he gave these people some things like crickets and small river fish, which made them all very happy.
The ones who come and go are familiar, and the ones who call each other are quite close.
Xu Shiyan separated when he first got married. In fact, many people outside were waiting to see the joke.
In the eyes of outsiders, Xu Shiyan is listless and has no temper, and his work is average, and his work points are more than that of women.
Apart from some medical skills, he has no strengths.
Such a person dared to separate from the family on the second day of marriage. Everyone said that he was coaxed into a daze by his wife.
Little young people don't know that life is difficult, and they separate when their heads get hot. Life will be difficult in the future, and it is too late to regret.
But the big guys waited and waited, and Xu Shiyan and his wife cried before they came.
I just saw that Su Anying was fatter than when she first got married, and her complexion was getting better and better.
Occasionally, when working far away from home, the young couple brought a hearty meal, and Su Anying also dressed well on weekdays.
Looking at this, Xu Shiyan and his wife not only did not suffer from the separation of the family, but it seemed that the better they got over? What's going on?
There was a very trustworthy person, so I asked around, wanting to know how Xu Shiyan and his wife lived so happily?
Things in this world, as long as they have been done, there will always be traces. If others pay attention, they can always see some clues.
Xu Shiyan asked for leave every few days and went to Songjianghe with a big basket on his back.
Someone saw it and said that when they left, they were full of fish, and when they came back, they were filled with miscellaneous supplies.
Needless to say, Xu Shiyan must have caught the fish and sold it at the Songjianghe market.
Now, many people start to get greedy, and some people learn to catch fish and go to the market.
It turned out to be unlucky, and those who were kicked out would run away, not to mention that the fish was not sold, and people were almost arrested.
So, the big guy was even more puzzled, how did Xu Shiyan manage to sell fish every time he went there?
"Yo, third brother Xu, today he asked for leave to sell fish in Songjiang River again? Third brother has the ability, he can sell it when he goes back. It's amazing."
One morning in August, Xu Shiyan had just boarded the boat with his back basket on his back, when another person came behind him.
They all lived in the same village, so Xu Shiyan certainly knew each other. Chen Deyong, the second son of the old Chen family of the Dongjiangyan Brigade.
Xu's family lives in the east of the village, with three rooms and five sons. The Chen family lived in the west of the village, with three rooms and five sons.
Both are in the same team, so it is inevitable to be compared and discussed.
The sons of the Xu family are all tall and strong, while the sons of the Chen family are short and thin, acting like monkeys.
The sons of the Xu family are all very capable, even Xu Shiyan is diligent and diligent, and lives a special life. The days of the Xu family are prosperous, and they are one of the best in the village.
And the Chen family were hiding traitors, playing tricks, and doing nothing. They were allowed to live at home that day, and they wished that they could eat the last meal without the next meal.
The Chen family didn't talk about it, but they had to compare in their hearts. The more they compared, the more jealous they became.
In the previous life, Xu Shiyan's eldest brother and second brother moved to Songjianghe in 1979, the fourth brother Xu Shide also moved to the Hebei brigade, and the fifth child was admitted to university.
Four of the five brothers left, only Xu Shiyan was left alone along the Dongjiang River.
After the land was divided into households, Chen Desheng, the boss of the Chen family, was unwilling to stay in the village to farm the land, and went out to make a living.
Having been around for a few years and getting rich, I went back to the village and trembled. The brothers of the Chen family also took advantage of their elder brother's power to run rampant in the village to retaliate.
Many people in the village were bullied and moved away, and the position of Secretary Zhao Dahai was also squeezed out, and he simply moved away with his family.
Xu Shiyan couldn't stay in the big house anymore, so he had to move out.
"No, I just went to visit relatives."
The Chen family is full of bad things. This kid must not be holding his farts well. Xu Shiyan doesn't want to talk to him, so he just talks casually.
"Third brother, do you see that you are out of touch? Which of us brothers is with whom? Are you still hiding it here?
You guys already knew about the fact that you went to Songjiang River to sell fish. "
"Third brother, there is a business to make money, at least he has a younger brother with him, and they all live in the same village, at least he will help him."
Chen Deyong glanced at Xu Shiyan's back basket. There were quite a lot of fish in it, but he didn't know how much he could sell it for?
Money, that’s a good thing, if only he could earn it.
Xu Shiyan's expression remained unchanged, and he smiled faintly, "I see that Uncle Chen has grown a lot of yellow smoke this year. With so much smoke, can Uncle smoke it all by himself?"
Big houses produce yellow smoke. Although they were not allowed to grow it due to policy reasons a few years ago, ordinary people also grow it in private.
The vegetable gardens and private plots in front of and behind the house, except for a la carte, are mostly planted with yellow smoke.
There are so many yellow smokes, do you really think you keep them at home? In fact, they are all dried and sold in Songjiang River or the county.
The yellow cigarettes in the big house are easy to smoke, and the price is not low. They all point to the yellow cigarettes for some money.
The Chen family is at the west end of the village. There is a large vegetable garden in the area. Who is blind to see the yellow smoke in the vegetable garden?
That is to say, Zhao Dahai is a good person, don't care about the Chen family, and try another brigade cadre? The tail was already cut off.
So, as soon as Xu Shiyan said this, Chen Deyong's face immediately changed, "Well, we have many relatives, and they all know that the cigarettes here are good, so let us ask for it.
Don’t you know about my dad? It's a good face, and he's too embarrassed not to give it to someone who wants it, so it's a little bit more. "
Chen Deyong knows best about his own family affairs, and when Xu Shiyan pointed it out in person, Chen Deyong's face was a bit uneasy.
"Isn't it? My family also has many relatives in Songjianghe and Donggang.
People know that there are a lot of fine scale fish in our Xijiang River. If I want a few, can I not give them? "Xu Shiyan responded directly to the other party's words.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Donggang Commune
chapters.content:
Chapter 16 Donggang Commune
Chen Deyong choked on Xu Shiyan's few words, and looked embarrassed.
He thought to himself, when did the youngest of the Xu family speak so well? Didn't you just stay silent all day before? Why did it suddenly change?
Xu Shiyan was too lazy to talk to Chen Deyong, so he got off the boat and walked away quickly with the basket on his back.
Both of them went to Songjianghe, and Chen Deyong obviously wanted to get close to Xu Shiyan, and he always had nothing to say.
But Xu Shiyan returned to his previous appearance, he just walked around without saying a word, which really depressed Chen Deyong.
After walking for about an hour, I finally arrived at the corner building of Songjiang River.
Xu Shiyan glanced at Chen Deyong behind him, his heart moved, he didn't go straight to the bureau compound, but turned and walked south.
Songjianghe Town is next to Donggang Commune in the south, one is a town and the other is a village.
Compared with Songjianghe, Donggang has a longer history.
At the end of the Qing Dynasty and the beginning of the Republic of China, Orion and Sanhu lived in the Donggang area. Donggang Village was established in 1936, Donggang District in 1946, Donggang Township in 56, and Donggang Commune was established in 58.
Donggang Commune has ten brigades under its jurisdiction. Because it is located in the Changbai Mountains, there are many mountains and little cultivated land.
However, the natural soil environment is more suitable for the growth of ginseng. Ginseng planting has a long history, and it is a well-known hometown of ginseng.
In 1987 in his last life, Xu Shiyan moved to Donggang Town with his family, and lived in Donggang for 30 years until the final development and demolition.
In this life, Xu Shiyan plans to move here earlier, preferably before the joint production contract in 1983, so that he can not only get big fields, but also ginseng land and ginseng.
Life again, Xu Shiyan didn't have much pursuit. He didn't even dare to think about moving to the city or working as a worker in the city.
It is not too difficult to transfer from a farmer to a farmer this year. The Xu family doesn't have that kind of network background, so they can't do such a big thing.
Besides, he has been a farmer all his life, and he doesn't have much education. What can he do if he goes to the city?
It would be better to grow ginseng honestly. The development prospects of Donggang will not be bad in the future.
Originally, he was thinking of coming back to find someone in winter, but when he met Chen Deyong today, Xu Shiyan felt suspicious, so he simply went to Donggang first.
"Second brother, I'm busy."
Xu Shiyan came to the door of a family opposite Donggang Middle School. It happened that there were people in the courtyard. Xu Shiyan hurriedly carried the fish into the courtyard and greeted the owner.
"Yo, aren't these my three brothers? Why are you free to come to Donggang today? Come in and sit down.
Fucking mother, quickly boil water and make tea, the third son of our second aunt's family is here. "
The surname of this family is Zhou, and the male owner, Zhou Changhe, is from the same town as Zhou Guilan, the old lady of the Xu family.
Seriously speaking, Zhou Guilan should be called aunt, so Xu Shiyan calls her second brother.
"Second brother, don't make second sister-in-law busy, I'm here to Songjianghe for business today, and I brought a fish for my second brother along the way.
The fine scales just caught from the river this morning, keep them for a fresh meal. "Xu Shiyan said, passing the fish over.
"Oh, look, why are you so polite?" Zhou Zhanghe narrowed his eyes for joy when he saw the thin-scaled fish.
"Fucking mother, hurry up, my brother brought a large and thin scale, quickly cleaned up and stewed, and left my brother for dinner at noon, I have to drink two cups with my brother."
"Second brother, I really have something to do today, so I won't eat here at noon."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly declined. He didn't come to Zhou's house to have a meal, but mainly to connect with each other and pave the way for the future.
Chang Zhou and his family's eldest son, Zhou Qingguo, served as a soldier outside. This winter, he was demobilized and returned to Donggang Commune to become a militia company commander and security assistant.
When Xu Shiyan moved to Donggang in 1987 in his previous life, Zhou Qingguo happened to be transferred from the deputy mayor of Donggang Town to another place.
This time Xu Shiyan wanted to move out early, so he had to ask Zhou Qingguo for help. The Xu family and the Zhou family don't have much contact with each other on weekdays, so it's not easy to speak directly.
Normally, if you don’t burn incense, it will definitely not work if you hold Buddha’s feet temporarily, so Xu Shiyan has planned it long ago, and will often walk around in the future.
Human relationship is like this, the more you walk, the closer you get, and when it's related, for Zhou Qinguo, Zhou Qinguo can do it with his mouth.
Xu Shiyan still had things to do, so he didn't stay at Zhou's house for a long time, so he only drank his saliva and said a few words before leaving.
Zhou Changhe had no choice but to follow him out the door, just in time to see people from the second brigade driving a carriage passing by, so he hurriedly stopped him and asked the other party to take Xu Shiyan with him.
Zhou Changhe is an old man in the second brigade, so of course he has some face, the driver readily agreed, and Xu Shiyan got into the carriage.
The horse spread its four hooves, kicked and stomped all the way straight to the Songjiang River.
When I arrived at the production material store, the driver went to work, while Xu Shiyan walked through the town from west to east with a basket on his back, and went straight to the bureau compound.
"Yo, Xiao Xu is here. Today is a bit later than usual. Team leader Guo just came out to take a look and said why you haven't come yet."
The old man looking at the gate saw Xu Shiyan and said with a smile on his face.
"Well, I was delayed by something this morning, Mr. Wang, you can take this cricket home and give it to your grandson."
Xu Shiyan smiled and stuffed a pack of crayfish into the old man's hand.
"Oh, what about such a big cricket, look, since I met you, our little grandson has been blessed. Come in, I guess there will be a hurry."
Old Wangtou was so happy, he smiled so hard that he couldn't see his teeth, and hurriedly waved his hand to let Xu Shiyan in.
Xu Shiyan entered the compound and went straight to the back kitchen, and asked someone to weigh and settle the account without mentioning it.
Just talking about the gate of the agency compound, Xu Shiyan had just entered a few minutes ago when someone sneaked over.
Old Wangtou just found a bucket to load the crayfish, when he turned around, he saw a man standing at the gate, stretching his neck and looking into the yard.
"Hey, hey, what are you doing? Idlers are not allowed to enter."
"Master, I'm here to look for someone. I just went in with a basket on my back. I'm looking for him." It was Chen Deyong who came.
He just finished his work and wandered outside the store of the Forestry Bureau, thinking that he could see Xu Shiyan selling fish in the market.
Walking around for a few times, I didn't see anyone. I suddenly turned my head and found Xu Shiyan entering the bureau compound with a basket on his back.
Chen Deyong was curious, so he followed. Just as he was about to follow in, he was discovered by the gatekeeper, Uncle Wang.
"Looking for someone? Someone carrying a basket? We are in the compound of the Forestry Bureau, and there are all cadres in it. Who can carry a basket?"
Uncle Wang glanced at the guy in front of him. He has a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks. He doesn't look like Xiao Xu. Looking at his ghostly appearance, he doesn't look like a good person.
Uncle Wang is an old man, so he immediately paid attention to it, and he didn't care about this problem at all, and waved his hand impatiently.
"Hurry up, don't get in the way here, and the leader will drive back later, so don't bump into you." The old man drove away without saying a word.
"No, I just saw someone go in with a basket on his back, let me look for it."
Chen Deyong is in a hurry, there must be something tricky in it, he has to figure out why Xu Shiyan is here.
"Are you going? If you don't go, I'll call the security team to come. You dare to break into any place if you don't open your eyes?" Old Wang said angrily with a downcast face.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: into the mountains
chapters.content:
Chapter 17 Into the Mountains and Release the Mountains
When Xu Shiyan finished his work and came out of the agency compound, Chen Deyong had already been driven away by Uncle Wang.
"Xiao Xu, there was a man who came after you just now. I saw him sneaking around. He didn't look like a good person, so I asked me to drive him away."
Old Wangtou stopped Xu Shiyan who was going out and reminded him.
Xu Shiyan paused, and immediately thought of Chen Deyong.
Unexpectedly, after wandering around Donggang, he was still followed by Chen Deyong. This guy is so wicked.
"Thank you, sir." Xu Shiyan hurriedly thanked Old Wangtou. "If anyone inquires about me in the future, just drive him away."
The way to earn money that I finally found, although I don’t earn much, and it can’t last for a long time, it can’t be destroyed by others.
"Success, don't worry, your uncle Wang will take care of any trivial matters."
Old Wang took Xu Shiyan's food several times, so of course he had to do his best.
Xu Shiyan thanked the old Wangtou and left the bureau compound.
He knew that Chen Deyong was sure that the cat was watching in some corner, so he decided to wander around the town a few more times and walk the dog.
Forestry Bureau store, Fusong store, non-staple food store, production material store, labor insurance store, medicinal material store, anyway, Xu Shiyan went to each of them for a couple of laps if he had money in his pocket.
Until these places have been wandered around, and there are a lot of things in the back basket, Xu Shiyan checked the time, and it was noon, so he went back.
Xu Shiyan walked in front, followed by Chen Deyong who was dripping with sweat a few hundred meters behind.
This morning, his legs were almost broken from walking.
The point is, Xu Shiyan wandered into the store, and the store was cool and not hot.
But Chen Deyong can't do it outside, basking in the sun, it's really tired and hot.
If it wasn't for figuring out what Xu Shiyan was going to do, how could Chen Deyong suffer this crime?
The more Chen Deyong walked away, the angrier he became, why didn't he think that the third child of the Xu family was hated so much?
Seeing that Xu Shiyan was walking towards the big house this time, Chen Deyong simply stopped following, and sat under the big tree by the side of the road to rest in the cool.
This morning, he was tossed to death by the heat.
Xu Shiyan played tricks on Chen Deyong once, but he didn't take it seriously. When he got home, he began to prepare for the release of the mountain.
In mid-August, the beginning of July in the lunar calendar, at this time, the crops in the field have grown, so there is no need to shovel and weed.
At the same time, the ginseng in the deep mountains and old forests, bearing the bright red ginseng seeds, attracts mallet birds to peck at them, as well as countless people who dream of digging ginseng to make a fortune.
This is what Fangshan people said, "Red Hammer" city.
Ginseng is the king of all herbs, the first of Chinese medicine, and the first among the three treasures of the Kanto.
People in the Changbai Mountain area call ginseng "bangchui", and they call ginseng digging in deep mountains and old forests "Fangshan".
Every year in Red Hammer City, many people, either in gangs or alone, break into the deep mountains and old forests, looking for opportunities to make a fortune.
"You really want to go into the mountains? How dangerous are the deep mountains and old forests? Our family has saved some money now, do you have to take this risk?"
Seeing Xu Shiyan busy packing up the things for going into the mountain, Su Anying asked worriedly.
"Of course I want to go, if you find a big one, you can sell it for a lot of money.
We are living on our own now, spending money everywhere, what can we do with the money from selling fish? "
Xu Shiyan continued to pack his things without even raising his head.
It is not a day or two to go to the mountains to release the mountains. You have to live in the mountains at night, and you have to prepare everything for food and use.
"We can't live in Aunt Li's house all the time, we have to have a nest of our own.
After we have a child, do we still live in someone else's house? "Xu Shiyan said while packing his things.
Hearing her husband talking about the child, Su Anying subconsciously covered her lower abdomen with her hands, and hesitated to speak.
"Then you can find a few people as companions anyway, how can I rest assured that you go into the mountain by yourself?" After a while, Su Anying said.
Xu Shiyan heard the worry and distress in his daughter-in-law's words, looked up at Su Anying, and waved to her. "Come on, daughter-in-law, come and sit."
Su Anying sat down beside Xu Shiyan as promised, Xu Shiyan clasped his hands and hugged his daughter-in-law in his arms.
"I have lived in the big house for seven years, and I am very familiar with the mountains and rivers around here. Don't worry, I will be fine by myself."
In his previous life, he went to the mountains countless times, so he is very experienced in this area, and this area is very familiar, so there is really no need to worry.
"I'll only go out for six or seven days, and I won't go too far. If I don't encounter any big goods, I'll come back quickly.
You are well at home, if you need anything, go to our mother. "Xu Shiyan put his arms around his daughter-in-law and comforted him softly.
It's not that he has to go alone, the main reason is that he has never been on a mountain in his life. Ordinary ginseng leaders are unwilling to bring their first-time leaders into the mountain. They think it is troublesome, so they just shirk and say that there are enough people.
Xu Shiyan can't do anything either, if others don't take him, then he can do it alone.
Su Anying is not an unreasonable person, she is just worried about her husband. Seeing that Xu Shiyan has made up his mind, she can't stop her.
So I went to make a thick stack of pancakes for Xu Shiyan, fried a jar of sauce, and fried some small fish for something.
Everything is done carefully and packed into a big rucksack.
To release the mountain, you have to choose a good day to enter the mountain. You don’t choose the first and fifteenth day of the first day, and you don’t choose the fourth day. Most of them choose the third, sixth, and ninth days.
On the morning of the third day of July, Xu Shiyan packed his bags and set off with sixty to seventy kilograms of things on his back.
The big house is right by the river, and there are stone lazies everywhere on both sides of the river. Less than twenty miles south of Dafang village, there is a naturally formed cave on a stone ladle.
There are stone tables and chairs in the cave, which looks like a natural creation. The locals say that it may be the place where gods lived, so it is also called "Fairy Cave" by the locals.
Xu Shiyan vaguely remembered that in his last life, it seemed that this year, someone in the village dug a big item near the fairy cave.
So, when he left the village, he headed south all the way, in the direction of Xianren Cave.
The big house is located in a remote place, and the traffic conditions are not conducive to logging, so the surrounding forest damage is not so serious.
The further south you go, the villages are gone, and the woods are getting denser.
The thick and big trees have luxuriant branches and leaves, covering the sky and the sun. Even in the hot summer of August, the woods are not hot and hot, and it is cool everywhere.
Living in the emerald green forest, breathing the fresh and moist air in the forest, listening to the crisp chirping of birds.
All this sounds beautiful, but in reality? Mosquitoes are most likely to breed in cool, humid places.
These blood-sucking guys sense the presence of people, and will follow them anytime and anywhere, looking for opportunities to bite.
In addition to mosquitoes, there are also small adzes, blindfolds, etc., which are constantly flying around people. Once they find an opportunity, they will bite hard.
So most of the people who enter the mountain smoke, which can smoke away those annoying little things.
People who do not smoke, there are ways,
A piece of old beef liver is broken off from a tree and set on fire, either held in the hand, or wrapped around the branch and tied on the head.
There is no open flame when the old beef liver burns, only blue and white smoke, which is the nemesis of mosquitoes, so it can be more comfortable.

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Rules of Fangshan
chapters.content:
Chapter 18 Rules of Fangshan
The history of ginseng mining in Changbai Mountain can be traced back to the period of Jurchen or Bohai Kingdom.
At that time, ginseng was a tribute to the Central Plains dynasty by the ethnic minorities in Northeast China, which shows its value.
Hundreds of thousands of years of development, countless ancestors who shuttled in the deep mountains and old forests to find ginseng have left a lot of experience and rules.
In the past, there were special ginseng gangs, and they pointed to the mountains to dig ginseng to live. These people began to enter the mountains in spring and left the mountains before the snow fell.
The season of releasing the mountain, according to the different seasons of ginseng growth, can be divided into Yacao City, Qingcao City, Leek Flower Market, Xiaojiabianer City, Dajiabianer City, Qinghamtou City, Honghamtou City, and Huangluosan.
Among them, it is easiest to count Red Hammer City.
In this season, the ginseng seeds are ripe, a cluster of bright red, swaying in the wind, as if beckoning to people.
A little red in the green bushes is the most conspicuous.
So, most people will rush into the mountain at this time.
I hope to meet a big tree in the vast forest, dig it back and sell it for a good price, and improve my life.
Xu Shiyan carried his bags on his back, traveled through the forest, and came to the vicinity of the Immortal Cave.
He was alone, and he didn't plan to go too far, so he designated this place with a radius of more than ten miles as a mountain farm.
The first thing to do when letting the mountain people into the mountain is to worship the old mountain god.
Use three stones, two vertical and one horizontal, to form the "Lord's Mansion", which is the temple of the old man of the mountain god.
Put three twigs in front of the master's mansion to replace incense, kneel down and pray to the mountain **** to bless you for safety and prosperity.
After worshiping the mountain god, choose a leeward and sunny hillside, and build a stilt, which is the shack where the mountain people live.
First cut three wooden poles with a fast axe, and then pick up some soft bark of poplar and elm to tie the wooden poles to support a tripod.
Pull off the whole piece of birch bark from the birch tree, put thatch on it to prevent rain, and spread hay and animal skins inside to prevent moisture. This is considered a temporary home for the mountain people.
After setting up the ground, we have to go around and chop some dry firewood.
Changbai Mountain is very cool at night, and there are many wild animals. A fire can be used to keep warm, drive away mosquitoes, prevent wild animals, and guide lost people.
The placement of the firewood is also particular, and it must be followed, which means smooth.
After finishing all these tasks, most of the day has passed, so I started a fire to boil water, eat and rest.
After breakfast the next morning, the mountain was officially released, also known as pressing the mountain, opening the mountain, pressing the time, and samucao.
If you enter the mountain in groups and there are many people, everyone should stand together and shout in unison before pressing down on the mountain.
Xu Shiyan was alone, and relying on the fact that this place was not too far from the big house, and there were not many wild animals, he saved the Huangshan Mountain and left the shack to wander around the mountain with a Suobao stick in his hand.
Suobao stick, also known as Suobao stick, is a six-foot-long wooden stick with a red string tied to the top, and copper coins tied to both ends of the red rope.
The vegetation is lush in the mountains and forests, and I don’t know what is hidden in the grass.
The Fangshan people hold Suobao sticks in their hands, and while walking, they use the stick to touch the bushes and tree trunks to scare away the snakes or other small animals hiding in them.
At the same time, weeds can also be pulled to find ginseng.
Every time you walk a certain distance, you have to "beat the kidnapper", that is, break a thin branch at ninety degrees to use it as a mark, indicating that this place has already been passed.
Walking around in the mountains is not easy, you can't talk, and you can't shout when you see anything.
Xu Shiyan went into the mountain alone, which saved some trouble.
I walked around slowly, my eyes kept wandering in the grass, not letting go of every inch of land, every flower and plant.
When you are tired, you can "take a squat", that is, rest, when you are hungry, you can "take a meal", that is, eat, and when you are addicted to smoking, you can "take a fire".
"Na" means auspicious and smooth in Manchu, and it's all for getting big ginseng.
Xu Shiyan wandered around the mountains for a day, but he didn't "open his eyes", so he had to go back to the ground to rest.
It is common for the people who let the mountain go to the mountain without "opening their eyes" for a few days. Xu Shiyan was not discouraged, and proceeded to cook, cook and sleep step by step.
It was only at night, when a wolf howled faintly in the distance, Xu Shiyan didn't sleep well.
It started to rain in the middle of the night. Although the rain stopped in the morning, the temperature was very low. Xu Shiyan changed into a ragged leather jacket and ripped leather pants, and then put on a raincoat.
The leather jacket and leather trousers were all found by Mrs. Li for him. When he was young, Lao Li often went to the mountains to release mountains. Now he is old enough to see ginseng on the mountains. These things are kept at home.
When Xu Shiyan said that he wanted to go into the mountains, Mrs. Li drew out all the old man's belongings and gave them to Xu Shiyan.
It has just rained, and the leaves and grass are covered with crystal raindrops. When the wind blows down, it is another light rain.
Xu Shiyan was wearing a leather jacket and leather trousers and a raincoat, but he was not afraid. He still held a rope stick in his hand and wandered in another direction.
Walking for half an afternoon, suddenly my eyes lit up, and a little red was particularly conspicuous among the green leaves in front of me.
Xu Shiyan walked over quickly and came to the front, carefully looked at it, and it really was a small ginseng seed.
Looking down along the ginseng seeds, there are four palmate compound leaves growing on the purple-black stalk.
Ginseng, according to different growth years and different biological characteristics of different years, can be divided into "three flowers", "slap palm", "two Jiazi", "dengtaizi", "four leaves", "five leaves" from small to large. ", "Six leaves".
If it is garden ginseng, basically it can grow to five or six leaves in the six-year growth period.
However, the growth cycle of wild ginseng is very long. Each stage takes several years or decades, especially the last few stages. It is possible to grow one more leaf after hundreds of years.
That is to say, I counted the leaves of ginseng. The more leaves, the bigger and more valuable the ginseng may be.
Generally, five leaves can produce a lot of goods, and six leaves can keep big ones.
Four leaves, that is, four leaves, the ginseng underneath will not be very big.
Going into the mountains to open your eyes and meeting four leaves is actually unlucky in the eyes of many people.
Xu Shiyan stared at the ginseng tree for a while, and then called out, "The club."
This is called Huoshan. According to legend, ginseng can run when it becomes a spirit.
"How many leaves?" If there are many people coming, other people will ask after hearing it. This is called Jieshan.
"Maul, do you want to take it?" This is to say the size of the ginseng, and then ask whether to dig it.
Si, which sounds the same as death, has a bad meaning, so most people don't say it directly when they meet Sipiye, they just say stick, and the other party understands it.
"Take it." Xu Shiyan hesitated, but decided to dig.
Alone, the procedures that should be followed have to be followed, so I did all the work of calling mountains and mountains.
Decided to dig this ginseng tree, first took out a red rope tied with copper coins, which is the mallet lock, and locked the mallet.
Wrap the red thread of the mallet lock on the ginseng stalks, and put the copper coins at both ends on the Suobao sticks or branches that have been inserted into the ground to prevent the mallet from escaping.
Ginseng is a plant, so it will not run away naturally.
This is mainly due to the high mountains, dense forests and complex terrain, the mixture of ginseng and grass is difficult to distinguish, and it is easy to miss without marking.
The red rope is used for the mallet lock, which is very conspicuous in a piece of green, making it easy for people to lock the target.

chapters.title: Chapter 19: black blind man
chapters.content:
Chapter 19 Black Blind Man
The ginseng is locked with a mallet lock, and then a fire is built upwind, one is to smoke mosquitoes, and the other is to drive away wild animals, so as to avoid being disturbed when digging ginseng.
It had just rained, and the woods were wet. It was obviously not easy to start a fire.
But people who are often in the mountains and forests also have a way to deal with it.
There is a kind of tree called green straw, the trunk is green, the skin is smooth, and there is a thin layer of white wax on it.
It is easy to find this kind of tree, cut it down and chop it into thin strips, and use birch bark to ignite it.
When the fire is hotter, add other firewood, cover it with wormwood, press the fire head to suffocate thick smoke, and float along the wind to the place where the ginseng is. At this time, you can dig ginseng.
Excavating ginseng is called lifting a mallet to show respect.
Lifting a mallet is not an easy job, it requires experienced people, and usually the ginseng will do it by himself.
Xu Shiyan has only one elder brother, so don’t be careless, do it yourself.
Use your hands to remove the grass and leaves around the ginseng, and open the "plate".
Ginseng is often entangled with tree roots and grass roots, and the roots should be sawed off with a "quick saw".
The main reason is that the roots are elastic and cannot be chopped with an ax, as it is easy to damage the ginseng.
Thin tree roots and grass roots should be cut with "quick scissors".
Clean out the plate and expose the soil. At this time, take out the "quick sticks", usually made of deer bones, and push the soil away.
Start digging from the reed head under the ginseng stalk until all the roots of the ginseng are exposed.
Any small roots cannot be cut off, otherwise the price of ginseng will drop when selling.
Every root of ginseng that has been cleaned must be covered with loose soil at any time to keep moisture.
This is a very labor-intensive job. The man who carries the ginseng must be steady, not rush, and take it slowly.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan has a stable temperament and is careful in doing things, so he is the most suitable.
Although it is just a four-leaf tree, and the main root is only as thick as a finger, it will take a long time to dig it out of the soil completely.
Xu Shiyan was alone, and there was no one to replace him when he was tired, so he could only sit on the ground for a while and smoke a cigarette before continuing.
After spending half a day, I finally lifted the ginseng tree out completely.
Although this ginseng tree is not too big, its shape is extremely beautiful.
The reed head is the size of a bean, with a twisted mouth, a slender neck, and two beards on the shoulders that look like arms.
The main body is as thick as an index finger and as long as three fingers, and then there are two legs. The ginseng whiskers are about half a foot long and covered with pearl bumps.
It's pretty good. Although it's not too heavy, it weighs a couple of dollars at most, but it's definitely top grade. Based on the purchase price this year, it's estimated to sell for around two hundred yuan.
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan couldn't help but shake his head. If it was put in forty years, it might sell for tens of thousands.
Yes, it’s useless to think so much.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, went to the side and took off a large piece of fresh moss to lay it out, spread the ginseng on it, covered some original soil, and carefully wrapped the ginseng with the moss.
Moss is soft, moist, breathable, and not easy to dry. It is used to wrap ginseng, which will not damage ginseng, and is also good for freshness. It can keep the parameters of the ginseng unchanged every month.
