Then peel off a large piece of birch bark, wrap the moss in it, use the catalpa bark as a rope, and tie it carefully.
The ginseng package is packed and put away, and the "omen" must be cut.
Find a red pine tree near the place where the ginseng was unearthed, and use a knife or an ax to cut off a foot-square piece of bark in the direction of the ginseng at a height of a rope stick from the ground.
Carve a mark on the smooth trunk, engrave the number of people on the left, how many people there are, and engrave the size of ginseng on the right, and carve how many leaves.
After the engraving is over, the omen needs to be "washed". It is to use fire to burn off the pine oil flowing out from around the omen, so that the omen can still be seen clearly after decades.
The purpose of chopping off the "omen" is to commemorate the ginseng produced here, and to remind people in the future that after decades, someone may still find ginseng near the old omen.
Of course, some people use other methods to record or adjust the direction of omens in order to prevent others from knowing the size of the ginseng they dug.
After finishing all this, Xu Shiyan casually scattered the ginseng seeds that he picked before, and scattered them nearby.
Fangshan people also pay attention to sustainable development, sowing ginseng seeds, maybe after many years, there will be more ginseng here.
Busy and busy, most of the day has passed, but fortunately, I have gained something, no matter how big or small, it is worth comforting.
Xu Shiyan no longer misses it, he packed up his things and returned to Dimenzi.
For the next three days, Xu Shiyan wandered around here, but found nothing. I only saw an Erjiazi tree in the middle, but it was too small, so I let it go.
Xu Shiyan felt a little depressed after three consecutive days with no gains.
In his previous life, when he was working in the Daan Coal Mine, he heard from his family members that a group of people from the village went to the mountains to release the mountain and met a big tree, which was sold for nearly 1,000 yuan.
One thousand yuan in this year is not a small amount, let alone the Dongjiangyan Brigade, even the Daying Commune knows it.
Such a sensational thing, he couldn't remember it wrong, it was found near the fairy cave, and he saw that omen later.
Why has he been wandering around for five days, why didn't he see it? Shouldn't the co-author make this fortune? No luck with this?
Fangshan was originally a matter of luck. It is estimated that he did not have this kind of fortune.
Well, in another two days, if he still can't meet him, he should go home. I think the wife should be anxious to wait at home.
Xu Shiyan relieved himself, and regained his spirits. Holding the Suobao stick in his hand, he kept beating the surrounding vegetation, and his eyes kept looking around.
The mountain forest was silent, except for the sound of sticks pushing away the grass, and the sound of trouser legs rubbing against branches and grass, there were no other sounds.
Suddenly, there was a different sound behind him.
Xu Shiyan's back felt cold. Based on his years of hunting experience in his previous life, he dared to conclude that there must be some beast following behind him.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to make too much movement, and turned his body slightly to look back.
When he saw the situation behind him, he couldn't help but take a deep breath, well, I have to explain here if I have trouble today.
Two or three hundred meters away from behind Xu Shiyan, a huge black animal was wandering towards this side.
That body shape, that walking posture, don't even think about it, it must be a black and blind man.
Hei Xiazi is a local name for the black bear. This thing has poor eyesight and black hair all over, so it is called Hei Xiazi.
Don't look at this thing's poor vision, but its sense of smell is very sensitive, and its strength is so great that it can shatter a cow's shoulder blades with a slap.
This is a guy who can fight a tiger. He moves quickly, has a strong bite, and has rough skin and thick flesh that is resistant to beatings.
Fuck, this luck is far from bad, it's almost memorized.
Xu Shiyan secretly regretted that he shouldn't have dug up the four leaves. It makes sense for the elders to stay.
While he was thinking, the blind man with his head down suddenly sniffled, then raised his head and looked in Xu Shiyan's direction.
Xu Shiyan's heart skipped a beat, he was stunned to control the urge to turn around and run away, and moved back gently and slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Danger
chapters.content:
Chapter 20 Dangerous
I met a black blind man in the mountains, how can I save my life?
Some people said that running in circles confused the blind man.
Hehehe, let alone a black blind man chasing after him, even if there is no one, the woods are overgrown with dead branches and fallen trees, let someone try running in it?
Heixiazi has lived in the woods since he was a child, and that is his home field. Do you want to make him dizzy? Can you?
Some people also say that lying on the ground and pretending to be dead can fool the blind man. The black blind man just has poor eyesight, not stupid.
Don't worry about whether you are really dead or pretend to be dead, just sit on your buttocks, and then do a few more bumps.
The weight of three to four hundred catties is pressed on the person, and if it is turned twice, the internal organs will be crushed, right? Those who pretend to be dead are also dead.
Whether you can live when you meet a black blind man depends mainly on your luck.
If you are lucky, you will meet someone who is full. At most, you can lick it, slap it, and maybe you will die if you get hurt.
If you meet a hungry person, or someone who has been hurt and held grudges, then don’t think about it, you won’t survive even if you run.
Xu Shiyan didn't know if the black blind man in front of him was hungry or not, but he knew very well that he must not provoke this big guy in front of him now.
At this time, don't talk about being cowardly, if he has a semi-automatic in his hand, even if it is a stick, he will dare to take care of this guy today.
No gun, just an axe, let him fight a **** bear weighing more than 300 catties, crazy?
Move carefully, don't provoke this big guy, maybe you can save your life.
Unfortunately, Xu Shiyan's luck really doesn't look good.
Just as he was slowly backing away without a trace, the **** bear suddenly exerted strength and rushed towards Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan pulled something out of his pocket, threw it at the black bear, then turned and ran.
What Xu Shiyan threw out was the pancakes that Su Anying made for him at home, and the rations he brought out.
The pancakes were sweet, the black bear smelled the aroma of the pancakes, and was attracted by the pancakes. Taking advantage of this effort, Xu Shiyan jumped far away.
But the black bear just went over to smell the pancakes, took a bite, probably not satisfied with the taste of the pancakes, and then chased after them.
Just after opening that little distance, which is nothing to the black bear, I saw a black shadow in the woods, jumped up and down a few times, and was not far away from the running people in front.
Xu Shiyan also felt that the black blind man was chasing him, gritted his teeth and ran forward desperately, but no matter how much he ran, he couldn't run away from the **** bear behind him.
The black bear pounced violently, and it was about to throw Xu Shiyan down. If he fell down, Xu Shiyan would have to confess to being in the woods today.
At the critical moment, Xu Shiyan staggered, made a sharp turn, and ran towards a big pine tree next to him.
The pine tree is so thick that two people can hug each other, but there are not many weeds and shrubs around it.
Xu Shiyan started to circle around the pine tree, and the black bear behind him followed suit.
Xu Shiyan knew that turning around in circles was useless. People's physical strength was limited, and if they lost strength after a few laps, they would still be overtaken by black bears.
So taking advantage of the time when the black bear was spinning in circles, Xu Shiyan jumped out again.
The black bear was having a good time circling around, but suddenly the person in front ran away, the **** bear froze for a moment, probably angry, roared, and continued to chase.
This time, the black bear was even faster, and it caught up behind Xu Shiyan in a few strokes.
Xu Shiyan wanted to repeat the old trick, but there were no such suitable trees around.
Hearing the sound of heavy objects falling to the ground getting closer and closer behind him, Xu Shiyan's heart also rose to his throat.
By this time, there is no other way out, but to fight recklessly.
Gritting his teeth, Xu Shiyan cruelly grasped the ax in his hand, stopped his body, turned around, and gave the black bear a blow.
It was also a coincidence that the black bear came right behind Xu Shiyan at this time, with its hind legs upright and its palm raised, and was about to give Xu Shiyan a blow.
Black bears have rough skin and thick flesh, especially their backs. They often rub itchy on pine trees. The pine oil sticks to the fur, and some dirt and gravel hang on them, which cannot be penetrated by ordinary guns.
But the abdomen of a black bear is different, especially the white pattern on the front chest, which is the most fragile.
Hei Xiong stood up, his belly exposed, and Xu Shiyan turned around at this moment. The sharp ax in his hand slashed obliquely downward from the white pattern.
The ax was newly bought by Xu Shiyan. The ax was produced in Dandong. The steel mouth was well tempered, but he sharpened it to be extremely sharp before going out.
This time, Xu Shiyan threw out all his strength.
People are at the critical point of life and have great potential. This ax opened a deep oblique opening from the white pattern of the black bear to the abdomen.
Hei Xiazi was seriously injured, and with a groan, he waved his big bear paw, and the sharp claws patted Xu Shiyan's shoulder.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan had already taken precautions. The moment the ax hit, his body fell short.
Even so, he still couldn't escape completely, and got half a bear's paw. Fortunately, Xu Shiyan was wearing a thick leather jacket, which helped a little.
Even so, Xu Shiyan also felt a sharp pain in his shoulder, and the ax in his hand almost fell to the ground.
Gritting his teeth, he hit another ax with his hand. This time, the black bear had two wounds on its stomach.
The black bear was completely enraged, howled angrily and swung its claws, sending Xu Shiyan flying.
Xu Shiyan hit the tree and felt dizzy for a while, but how can he have time to take a breath at this time?
Don't care about anything, turned over and got up from the ground, before picking up the axe, and ran forward again.
Behind him, the black bear was furiously stimulated by the pain of the wound, and chased after him on all fours.
There are two deep wounds on the black bear's abdomen. It's okay if it doesn't move. With this movement, the intestines come out of the wound and drag on the ground.
The woods were full of fallen trees and branches. The black bear didn't chase very far, and its intestines were caught by the branches, and the black bear howled in pain.
This guy is really a tiger. Seeing that his intestines were caught by the branches, he felt pain when he moved, so he tore his intestines apart, got up and continued to chase Xu Shiyan.
After all, he was injured, such a deep wound, blood kept flowing out. Coupled with the severed intestine, the black bear's physical strength is not as good as before, and the pursuit is not so fast.
But Xu Shiyan couldn't run fast anymore. After running for so long, he was hit by a black bear twice.
In the panic, where do you care about the direction? Xu Shiyan didn't even know where he was running to right now.
Suddenly, the blue sky, white clouds, and green hills in the distance can all be seen at a glance, but the road ahead is cut off, and Shilazi is not far away.
Xu Shiyan panicked and ran towards the direction of the river. In front of him was Shilazi on the bank of the river.
Yes, there is a black bear behind a cliff in front of you. It can be said that there is no way to go to heaven and no way to go to earth. Where can we go now?
Behind him, the angry howl of the black blind man was getting closer and closer.
I lost my ax just now, and I don’t know where my backpack went while running, and I don’t have any sharp weapons in my hand. This is really over.

chapters.title: Chapter 21: A blessing in disguise
chapters.content:
Chapter 21 A blessing in disguise
There is a cliff in front, and there is a crazy black bear behind. Xu Shiyan is really going to despair.
When I looked up, I found a big pine tree growing beside Shilazi.
The trunk is very thick and leans slightly towards the stone lazier. The lower branches are more than two meters high from the ground, thicker than an adult's arm.
Xu Shiyan took a deep breath, used all his strength to jump forward, then leaped forward, grabbed the branches of the pine tree with both hands, and hung himself on the edge of the cliff.
The **** bear behind him didn't know Xu Shiyan's intentions, and was running fast to catch up.
As a result, the **** bear had no time to brake, and rushed directly to the bottom of the cliff.
Xu Shiyan was hanging from the tree when he heard a thud, which was the sound of a heavy object falling.
Looking down, it turns out that about ten meters away from the cliff, there is a protruding platform, which seems to be about the size of two basketball courts.
The black bear was running fast and with great momentum, and it was falling on the edge of the platform at this moment. I don't know if he died or not.
At this time, Xu Shiyan was not in the mood to care about the life and death of the black bear, he had to get down from the tree quickly.
Hanging on this can't last long, and if he falls, he can't compare to the black blind man with rough skin and thick flesh.
Xu Shiyan exchanged his hands and moved to the root of the branch bit by bit. The bark of the pine tree is rough and has tiny thorns.
I couldn't take care of it at the moment, gritted my teeth and struggled a lot, and finally moved to the root of the tree when I was about to lose my hold.
Slipping down from the tree, Xu Shiyan sat directly on the ground and gasped for breath. After the catastrophe, he felt pain all over his body at this moment.
Sitting under the tree for a while, Xu Shiyan didn't hear any movement underneath, so Xu Shiyan stood up staggeringly, and stretched his head to look under the tree.
The black blind man lay on the ground, seemingly motionless. Is this dead? If he really died, would he still be able to earn bear bile?
Xu Shiyan thought about it, but he didn't dare to act rashly. Heixiazi is quite tenacious, so it's better to be careful.
Besides, the platform is about ten meters away from the top. He has nothing now, so it is not easy to go down.
Xu Shiyan thought about it for a while, got up and wobbled back, he had to find all the lost things.
There is a rope in the backpack, it must not be long enough, I have to get some rattan or something to run it down. How can I do without tools?
Xu Shiyan ran all the way, and he didn't know where he came from. Fortunately, the blind man was injured, and there was blood all the way.
Xu Shiyan walked back along the bloodstains and found his backpack, ax and other things, so he followed the bloodstains and returned again.
There are jujube vines and grape vines on the road, and they made a lot of bundles and dragged them.
Go back to the side of the stone lazi, weave the vines together, tie them together with the rope, tie one end to the big pine tree, and run the other end under the lazi.
The black blind man at the bottom still didn't move, and didn't make any movement. Xu Shiyan had an ax pinned to his waist and a backpack on his back, and slowly went down while holding onto the vines.
The tree vine and the rope were still too short to reach the platform. Fortunately, there was not much distance, so Xu Shiyan let go of his hands and jumped down.
Withdrawing the ax from his waist, he approached the black bear carefully step by step, only to find that there was a big pool of blood under the black bear.
The black bear was injured in the first place, and the impact of the fall from above was not small. The injury worsened, and it should be dead.
Xu Shiyan was still worried, so he found another branch and poked it, but it didn't move, so he breathed a sigh of relief and stepped forward with the ax in his hand.
A **** bear weighing more than three hundred catties lay on the ground, and Xu Shiyan turned it over after a lot of effort.
The black bear turned over and found that part of the internal organs flowed out from the wound. Fortunately, the bear bile was protected by the liver, but it was not broken.
Xu Shiyan came to the mountain to release the mountain. According to the rules left by the elders, hunting is not allowed in the mountain.
After thinking about it, he simply cut off a piece of the shirt on his body with a knife, wrapped the bear bile, and put it in his back pocket.
Fresh bear bile cannot be dried directly, it needs to be dipped in boiling water several times and dried. But the household items for boiling water are all in the basement, so it seems that we have to go back to the basement first.
Xu Shiyan glanced at the dead body of the black blind man. This big guy is too heavy, he has to climb up, and he can't carry so much.
Gritting his teeth, he chopped off the bear's paw, and shaved some flesh from the bear's body, and put these on first,
The temperature is lower by the river, and the black bear's body may not be broken if left overnight. If not, go back tomorrow to find someone, and come again.
With great effort, he stuffed the meat and bear's paw into his back pocket.
Xu Shiyan picked up his bag and turned around to walk in the direction of the vines. As a result, he just stood up and was attracted by the red dots not far away.
What's that? Not a mallet? No, it's impossible. There are more than a dozen or twenty flowers in this area, so it must be a mistake.
Xu Shiyan thought in his heart, but couldn't help walking over.
Going closer and taking a closer look, Xu Shiyan almost knelt down on the spot.
On this platform, there are no less than twenty ginseng trees, each with bright red ginseng seeds.
Especially the one in the middle, the ginseng seeds on it are about the size of a small baby's fist, the red skin is shiny, and each one is full.
Looking down the ginseng seeds, the purple-black stalks are almost as thick as chopsticks and about two feet high.
Further down, you can see six palm-shaped compound leaves, green and fluttering in the wind, as if beckoning to someone.
Six leaves, still such a thick stem, such a large ginseng seed, there must be a big one underneath.
Xu Shiyan jumped up happily, and shouted loudly, "Fuck, sticks, a lot of sticks."
If there are many human parameters, the first five leaves are called slices, and the first six leaves are called heaps.
This is a pile in front of me. Looking at it roughly, there are only six leaves and there are two trees, and the others have five leaves and four leaves.
Now, who cares about the black blind man, he threw the backpack on the ground, quickly pulled out the mallet lock from the inside, and locked the biggest one directly.
Locked the ginseng, but Xu Shiyan was not in a hurry to do it, but sat down and thought about things without moving.
He met the black blind man within two hours of entering the forest in the morning, and it was already noon after running all the way.
There are so many large and small ginsengs on this platform, we can't dig them all up, but even if we pick the big ones, we can probably take four or five ginseng away.
It is very likely that a large cargo will have to be lifted for a day or two, that is to say, he will have to be on it for several days.
Come on, don’t think about it, hurry back to the basement and move all the things over here, he’s been eating and living on this platform for the past few days, don’t move his nest, just take everything he can take away.
Xu Shiyan made up his mind, put down his backpack immediately, and climbed up again with only his axe.
Then return to Diguan along the original road, pack up the things inside, and take them all away.

chapters.title: Chapter 22: harvest full
chapters.content:
Chapter 22 is full of harvest
Xu Shiyan stayed on the platform under Lazi for eight days.
When he left home, he only brought seven days' rations with him. If it wasn't for the black bear, Xu Shiyan would have to carry the ginseng hungry.
The black bear weighing more than three hundred catties has been skinned and gutted, and there is still a lot of meat left.
Part of it was salted by Xu Shiyan, dried and preserved, and the other part was either boiled in soup or baked to eat, with pancakes, at least for the past few days.
Fortunately, it was under the stone ladle, even if the beast smelled blood, it would not be able to get down.
Two nights, Xu Shiyan heard wolves howling above Lazi. He probably wandered around for a long time and couldn't get down, so he finally left.
In this way, in eight days, four ginseng plants were finally brought out.
At first he thought that the six-leaf tree was the biggest, but when he lifted it out, he discovered that there was a five-leaf tree that was even bigger.
There is a child with thick arms, a long body, and a beautiful figure. The only shortcoming is that there is a problem with the reed head.
Seeing the reed head, Xu Shiyan probably understood what was going on, it was Zhuantai ginseng.
The growth of wild ginseng depends on the regeneration of buds. Once the buds are damaged, they will not be unearthed in the next year.
Wild ginseng has the ability to hide. Although it will not be unearthed in the next year, the roots will not rot.
After more than ten years or decades, new buds will be bred and unearthed again, which is commonly known as Zhuantai ginseng.
The reborn wild ginseng may produce five leaves or two Jiazi.
The tree that Xu Shiyan dug up has five leaves. It doesn't look big, but in fact the roots underneath are at least five or six taels.
So, this Zhuantai ginseng is very likely to be the ancestor of these ginsengs on the platform.
If it hadn't been dormant underground for decades, it would probably grow even bigger.
There is an old saying, "Seven taels is the treasure of eight taels." This eight taels refers to the eight taels of hexadecimal in the past, which is half a catty when converted into today's scales.
Xu Shiyan remembers that in his previous life, it seemed that in 1981, a wild ginseng seedling was unearthed in Beigang Commune, which weighed five taels of seven coins and was about 150 years old.
The ginseng tree was finally treasured in the Great Hall, which is called a national treasure.
The tree in Xu Shiyan's hand should not be too heavy, that is to say, it is definitely a rare treasure.
Just this one tree, after 40 years, I am afraid that tens of millions will not be able to buy it.
And the other two six-leaf trees are not light in weight, they have to be four or two. Even if you sell it now, you can sell it for at least 2,000 yuan.
The smallest one weighs about two or three. According to the current purchase price, it can be sold for about a thousand or so.
Xu Shiyan is not greedy, even though there are still a lot of ginseng on the platform, he can't take any more.
Keep it, maybe he will come again if he has a chance in the future. It doesn't matter if he doesn't have that opportunity, he has already obtained great benefits, and he must be content in life.
So, I packed up several ginseng bags, and put the three big ones at the bottom of the rucksack.
Then try to put the dried bear meat and boiled bear oil in, and finally put two small ginseng buns on it.
Prepared and dried bear paws, wrapped them in bear skin, tied them with bark, and kept the bear bile in his bosom.
All kinds of things were thrown up three times, and then Xu Shiyan walked back with such big and small bags.
Just halfway through the distance, I heard someone shouting something in the distance. After careful identification, it was actually calling Xu Shiyan's name.
What's going on? Who ran into the mountains to look for him?
Xu Shiyan hurriedly responded here, and then walked quickly to where the sound came from, yelling as he walked.
It is estimated that they heard the movement over there, so they also walked this way.
Walking forward for more than a mile, Xu Shixian, Xu Shian and others walked towards them.
"Third brother, you are getting more courageous, aren't you? Going into the mountains alone, you will die?"
Xu Shi first saw his younger brother, he was relieved at first, and then a fire came up, and he was about to kick him.
Xu Shiyan dodged to avoid, "What are you doing? I'm here to let go of the mountain, and I'm not going out to drink and make money."
"How dare you say that? Do you know that our parents are dying of anxiety at home?
This is a family separation. If you don’t accept the control of the heavens, you dare to run into the woods by yourself. "Xu Shi'an was also impatient, and yelled at his younger brother.
"Third brother, you are too capable. You said that if something happened to you, what would you ask our parents to do? What would you ask Third Sister-in-law to do?
The third sister-in-law is pregnant with a child, do you want the child to be born without a father? "The fifth child, Xu Shixiang, also spoke up.
Xu Shiyan didn't take other people's words to heart, but Lao Wu's words surprised him.
"What? You have your third sister-in-law?" Xu Shiyan exclaimed, and then slapped his forehead.
Days, he actually forgot about this important event.
In the previous life, after Xu Shiyan and Su Anying got married, they went to the Daan Coal Mine. After a while, there came the good news that Su Anying was pregnant.
In April 1978, Su Anying gave birth to a boy.
I don’t know if it’s because of poor life, lack of nutrition, or some other reason, the child was born with deficiencies.
The skin is a thin layer, and the internal organs and skull can be seen directly, so I really dare not even touch it.
Many children are born without opening their eyes. That child was born with wide eyes, looking around, wishing to see every corner of the house.
The child didn’t cry, fuss, or nurse, and only lived for seven days. Everyone who knew said that this child shouldn't have been born in Xu's family, so they came to see if it didn't work, and then left.
Xu Shiyan was always at the Daan Coal Mine, so he seldom went home. Besides, he was still young at that time, so he didn’t have much intention of getting close to his children.
The child was gone, and Xu Shiyan was sad for a while, and then he didn't think about it again.
Later, Su Anying gave birth to two daughters and a son. With three children by her side, she would never think of the child who died young.
After being reborn, Xu Shiyan only thought about the two daughters in his previous life, and completely forgot about this child.
Now that Su Anying was pregnant, Xu Shiyan remembered it.
"Quick, hurry home." He had to go back quickly and take his wife to the hospital to have a look, maybe he could save the baby.
Xu Shiyan raised his legs and ran back. The three brothers saw the whole pile of things he was carrying on his straps, and they couldn't help him.
"What's all this? Look at your big bag? Is this a black blind man's skin? Did you meet a black blind man when you went into the mountains?"
Xu Shian stretched out his hand to pick up the thing in his younger brother's hand, and after a closer look, it turned out to be the fur of a black blind man. He immediately shuddered and asked.
"Well, a black blind man broke into my shack and drank the wine I brought up the mountain. He was so drunk that I went back and looked and killed him."
Xu Shiyan dare not say that he was kicked out by the black blind man and almost died. If he said that, he would probably have to kick him.
So Xu Shiyan made up some nonsense and fooled it, so as not to make a fuss in the family.
The three brothers of the Xu family were speechless when they heard it. Strange things happen every year, especially this year. The third child in their family is so lucky, right? Can this also kill a black blind man?
"Did you encounter a stick in the past few days in the mountains?" Xu Shixian couldn't help asking.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Su Anying is pregnant
chapters.content:
Chapter 23 Su Anying is Pregnant
"Well, I met it. One has four leaves and the other has five leaves. It's okay to meet the five leaves later. It's more than two or three heavy."
Xu Shiyan went to the mountain for more than ten days, far exceeding the expected seven days. Who would believe that he got nothing?
But he couldn’t tell the truth, because Xu Shiyan didn’t plan to sell those big ginseng plants.
It is so rare, I don’t know how much sensation it will cause if it is brought out, not to mention the county, even the province.
Xu Shiyan just wanted to live in peace and stability, but he didn't want to show off this kind of limelight. If there is a big trouble, he might not be able to stop in the future.
What's more, Xu Shiyan has seen through several brothers a long time ago. Don't look at the slick and beautiful words on weekdays. When something happens, each has his own little plan.
If they know that Xu Shiyan has several big clubs in his hand, regardless of whether the family is separated or not, they will definitely be tempted.
Xu Shiyan, he is no longer that careless and honest person, he should take care of his little family first.
Rao Xu Shiyan said implicitly, the brothers were still taken aback.
"What, third child, what did you just say? You went into the mountain and met a big guy?" Xu Shixian staggered and looked at his younger brother in surprise.
How much can you sell for a large product with more than three or two? No one is sure about this.
Because the value of wild ginseng is not only reflected in weight, the five shapes of whiskers, reeds, skin, grain, and body will all have an impact on the quality grading of wild ginseng.
But the weight is also the key. If the weight is not enough, no matter how beautiful the shape is, it will not sell for a high price.
Based on the current purchase price of wild ginseng, it can be sold for more than 400 yuan for about two taels. If the shape is better, it will be about 500 yuan.
Two taels of wild ginseng is a dividing line, and if you go up, you can get much higher if you add one tael, at least double it. If you are in good shape, it is possible to double it.
A mallet sells for more than a thousand, and a black blind man is killed, and a bear bile can be sold for four to five hundred yuan.
By the way, the third child just said that there is still a four-leaf tree, which can be sold for some money.
The brothers were speechless for a while, when did it become so easy to make money?
In previous years, their whole family worked hard in the field from spring to autumn to earn work points. At the end of the year, they had 1,800 yuan left besides rations, which was already the first class in the village.
But what about the third child? Selling fish in the Songjiang River can earn dozens of yuan a time.
This time it’s even more outrageous. After ten days in the mountains, you can spend one or two thousand dollars?
This, is there any reason for this?
"You're quite capable, why didn't you see that you have this ability before the separation?" Xu Shi'an glanced at his younger brother and couldn't help mumbling.
In the past, the third child was always a follower behind Xu Shian, and he was never seen to be capable.
Unexpected, after getting married, the third child has changed a lot. He is capable and lucky, okay.
Xu Shiyan doesn't have the time to talk about that with his brothers right now, he is full of daughter-in-law now.
"Old Fifth, how did you know about your third sister-in-law's pregnancy?"
It's not easy to ask the boss and the second child about this matter, even if they all know, it's not convenient for them to tell.
How can an elder brother talk about the pregnancy of his brother and daughter-in-law? On the other hand, the fifth child, my brother-in-law is not taboo, he can say anything.
When asked by the third brother, Xu Shixiang told him everything he knew.
Dongjiangyan Brigade also has ginseng land, a total of two thousand feet. This season the ginseng seeds are ripe, and the team arranges people to go up the mountain to pick the ginseng seeds.
This job is not heavy, but it requires people to kneel under the shed to do it slowly, so some young daughters-in-law will be selected.
Xu Shiyan is not at home, and Su Anying has a restless temper, so she will go if there is work in the team.
Although Su Anying has not been married for a long time, it is obvious to all that she does a good job, so when the captain arranges work, Su Anying is the first to think of.
Su Anying really didn't say anything about her work, that's called quickness, if others pinched ginseng seeds one foot, she wished she could pinch two feet.
I don’t know if it’s the hot weather or I’m tired from work.
During the break at noon after work, Su Anying just came out of the shed and straightened her waist, but she fell into the driveway and passed out.
At that time, the people who were working together were frightened. They pinched and slapped their chests and backs. At least they woke up.
Now there is no need to work, so hurry back to the village.
Then the other end of the Xu family also got the news, Zhou Guilan hurried over to visit, and only then did he know that Xu Shiyan had entered the mountain alone.
But Zhou Guilan was very angry, and yelled that when the third child came back, he had to cut him.
Zhou Guilan was worried about her daughter-in-law, so she simply took Su Anying back to Xu's family to take care of her.
It turned out that Su Anying woke up in the morning with nausea and vomiting, the kind that even vomited bitter bile.
Zhou Guilan has given birth to eight children in this life, raised six, and has five grandchildren in the family. It can be said that she has rich experience, but can't you tell? The daughter-in-law has it.
The third daughter-in-law was pregnant two months after entering the house. This is a great joy, and Zhou Guilan should be happy.
But Zhou Guilan couldn't be happy when she thought of her incomprehensible third child who dared to run up the mountain to do it by herself.
So he talked about it every day, hoping that his son would come back.
Wait and wait, it has been six or seven days longer than Xu Shiyan expected, Zhou Guilan finally couldn't bear it, and sent her three sons into the mountains early this morning to find Xu Shiyan.
If you can't find it today, Zhou Guilan plans to mobilize the villagers to go into the mountains to find it.
"I've been making nonsense every day, so we didn't go to work and ran out to find you. Let me see how you explain to our mother this time?"
Xu Shixian glared at his younger brother a few times, and said rather dissatisfied.
Xu Shiyan is too lazy to talk to him, as long as he can earn money, he doesn't need to explain anything.
No matter what year you are, money is your confidence.
It is difficult for a man with money, but it is difficult for a man without money. As long as you have money in your pocket, your waist will be strong, and you will not be afraid to speak anywhere.
Xu Shiyan was silent, and the brothers were too embarrassed to complain too much, so they just walked all the way to the village.
By the time the four Xu Shiyan brothers entered the village, it was already ten o'clock in the morning.
The weather was fine in August, and some old men and women in the village were sitting and chatting outside, and there were even a few older girls and daughters-in-law, who were also outside with needlework in their hands.
As soon as the four brothers entered the village, someone noticed them.
"Hey, it's San'er who's back. God, how dare you run into the mountains by yourself? Your mother is in a hurry these days, and her mouth is full of fumes."
The first one to speak with concern was Zhao Dahai's wife.
Zhao and Xu have a good relationship. Aunt Zhao was really happy to see Xu Shiyan come back.
"San'er, how is it going into the mountains? Did you do anything? After so many days of delay, don't do nothing."
The one who is talking later is Chen Deyong's wife. What she said was gloating.
Last time, Chen Deyong followed Xu Shiyan for a day, trying to figure out how Xu Shiyan made money, but in the end he didn't understand anything, and was tired and hot for a whole day.
After returning home, I told my parents that the old couple of the Chen family were very angry. Seeing Xu Shiyan now, the Chen family's mother-in-law had to say something sarcastic.
"Don't worry about it, Auntie, this time I went to the mountain, and I really got something. Look, didn't this kill a black blind man?"

chapters.title: Chapter 24: go home
chapters.content:
Chapter 24 Homecoming
Xu Shiyan raised his finger and pointed to the package in Xu Shian's hand, and everyone followed suit.
They are all old people from the Northeast. Even if you have never seen a live black blind man, you have seen Pi, and you can recognize him right away.
The youngest of the Xu family didn't tell a lie, it was really a black blind person.
This is terrible, everyone's eyes are green.
A black blind man, it’s terrible. Not to mention anything else, just a bear bile is worth a lot of money.
The rest of the bear's paws, bear skin, bear nose, and kneecaps are all useful, even if they can't be sold for money, they are still good things.
The youngest of the Xu family, who had always been silent, went up the mountain and killed a bear? God, this is really unimaginable.
All of a sudden, many people gathered around, asking how Xu Shiyan killed the blind man.
Xu Shiyan repeated what he had said to fool his brother just now, and fooled these people.
The big guys were dumbfounded when they heard it, how could Xiong Xiazi kill like this? This was so unexpected.
"Aunts and aunts, I have to go home quickly. My mother still doesn't know why I'm worried about it these days."
How could Xu Shiyan be in the mood to chat with these people? Hurrying to go home to see the wife is a serious matter, so he nodded to everyone and left quickly.
Everyone looked at the backs of the Xu family brothers and began to talk about it.
"I really didn't expect that the third son of the old Xu family still has such luck.
A black and blind man, bear bile alone can sell for four to five hundred, right? awesome. "It's envious.
"Isn't it? Now Xu Jiasan'er has developed.
At the beginning, when he just got married, he separated from his family. Everyone in our village said that this child has a brain problem, and he will not know when he will have to live. "
"Now look at it again? When a black blind man comes back, a bear gall can catch up with others and work in the team for more than a year." This envy also means being happy for Xu Shiyan.
"At the beginning, old Xu kicked his son out with his head bouncing around. I don't know if he regretted it this time?"
Someone suddenly laughed out loud, this is purely to watch the fun and not think it's a big deal, gloating at other people's misfortunes.
"I don't believe it, the youngest of the Xu family has been sluggish all day long, and Baden's work is better than the girls.
How did he have the ability to kill a blind man? "This, it's a dead duck who has a hard mouth and refuses to see others being good.
"If you want me to tell you, it's because this kid got lucky that he can't guarantee it.
In the woods, he met someone who set a trap, and he picked up the black blind man who was trapped by him. "This is pure conspiracy theory.
Hearing this, Mrs. Chen's heart skipped a beat, she immediately packed up her needles and threads, and hurried home.
Xu Shiyan doesn't care what the villagers talk about. What he cares about most now is his wife.
Su Anying was taken to Xu's house by Zhou Guilan, so they walked all the way to the east of the village.
As soon as he entered the gate of Xu's house, Xu Shiyan called out, "Mom, daughter-in-law, I'm back."
As soon as he finished speaking, he saw a person rushing out of the room. After a few steps, he came to Xu Shiyan and hugged Xu Shiyan.
"You're back. I've been worried at home these few days, because I'm afraid that something will happen to you on the mountain."
Needless to say, this must be Su Anying.
I was so excited, I didn't care if there was anyone nearby, I hugged my husband immediately when I came up, tears streaming down my face.
"It's okay, you see, I told you a long time ago, I know everything here, and it's definitely okay to enter the mountain.
Okay, okay, stop crying, there are so many people watching. "
After being separated for more than ten days, Xu Shiyan also missed his wife, but in the public, he couldn't hold his wife all the time and not let go.
So he raised his hand and patted Su Anying's back, then touched the top of her head, softly comforting her.
"Oh, I said Yingzi, what are you doing so fast?
You are pregnant with a child, and your physique is not good. What if you fall or faint? "
The one who said this was naturally Zhou Guilan. She is not as flexible as Su Anying when she gets older, and she is slow to come out.
Su Anying rushed out and hugged her husband mainly because she was too excited.
Hearing what my mother-in-law said now, I felt embarrassed, and immediately let go of my hand, wiping away my tears.
"It's fine when you come back, as long as you come back safely."
Su Anying raised her head, looked at her husband with unkempt hair and unshaven beard, and smiled with distress and relief.
Su Anying is good-looking, the tears have not been wiped away at this moment, and the eye circles are still red, this smile is even more distressing.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about that anymore, reached out to hold his daughter-in-law's hand, and smiled at her. "Not only did people come back, but they also brought good things back."
"Look, I killed a black blind man and dug up two sticks, daughter-in-law, we are rich this time.
I told you a long time ago that I can support you and your children, did I lie to you? "
What are men working so hard outside? Isn't it to let my daughter-in-law live a good life? At this moment, Xu Shiyan felt that he had a lot of confidence.
In the back, Zhou Guilan looked at her son with a peacock spreading its tail, goosebumps almost fell all over the floor, it was really hard to see.
"Stop yelling at me, kid. You're still a blind man. I'll beat you up."
Zhou Guilan was worried and angry, probably too angry, and kicked her son.
Of course, this kick didn't use much strength, it was purely to scare people.
Xu Shiyan didn't hide, he was kicked by his mother honestly, and turned his head to smile at his mother.
"Mom, I really got something good this time, let's go into the house."
Some things have to go through the clear road, Xu Shiyan didn't hide it, stepped forward and hugged his mother's shoulders, hugged his mother and walked into the house.
Entering the door and coming to the east room, Xu Shiyan put his backpack on the kang and began to dump things outside.
A large bag of dried bacon, two cans of bear oil, a pair of corrugated caps of the black blind man, and a bear nose.
"Second brother, take the one in your hand too. It's a bear skin with four bear paws inside." Xu Shiyan greeted Xu Shian while hesitating.
Xu Shian rolled his eyes, and put a large bag in his hand on the Kang.
Outside is a large bear skin that has been scraped off the fat, which is a bit hard, and inside it is wrapped four bear paws as big as cattail fans.
"Mom, these meats, as well as this canned bottle of oil, two bear paws, bear pollen caps, and bear noses, all should be left at home."
Xu Shiyan scratched and scratched, and gave most of the things to Zhou Guilan.
"My father's leg hurts. I gave him Xiong Bo Ling Gai to drink, and it worked."
No matter what, that is his own father. Even if Xu Chenghou doesn't want to see his son, Xu Shiyan can't forget his identity, and he will still think about the old man when he has something.
"Isn't that daughter of my third uncle's house epistolaryngitis? This blind man's nose is dried and ground into powder, mixed with rice wine, and it can be cured."
This is a proven prescription handed down from the people, and it works.
Xu Shiyan kept two bear paws, and also the bear skin. He planned to get a leather mattress, which would be of great use when going into the mountains in the future.
Zhou Guilan saw her son carrying out these things, but her eyes were sour and tears came down.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: two ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 25 Two ginseng
After all, mother and child are connected. No matter how calm Xu Shiyan said, Zhou Guilan knew that things were not that simple.
Thinking of her son meeting a black blind man on the mountain, and not knowing how many dangers he went through to save his life and get these things back, Zhou Guilan couldn't help crying.
"San'er, don't go into the mountains in the future, it's too dangerous and scary."
As a mother, I only hope that my son is safe and sound.
No matter how much money you earn, if something happens to someone, you will not be able to survive this day.
When Xu Shiyan saw his mother like this, he hurriedly stepped forward to comfort him, "Mom, I will pay attention to it in the future, don't worry."
This time it was indeed enough. If it hadn't been for running to the edge of Lazi, if it hadn't been for that pine tree, Xu Shiyan probably would have confessed.
Of course, without the blind man chasing after him, if the blind man hadn't happened to land on the platform, he wouldn't have been able to meet those wild ginseng trees.
Maybe this is what people say, "Fortune and misfortune depend on each other, and if you survive a catastrophe, you will have good fortune later."
Anyway, not only did he come back with all his beard and tail, but he also gained a lot. Even if he experienced a little danger, it was worth it.
Of course, he has to pay attention in the future, he can’t go into the mountains empty-handed, it’s better to get a gun, even if it’s not semi-automatic, a stick will do.
Zhou Guilan didn't know what her son was thinking. If she knew, it might not be as simple as kicking him.
The son returned safely, and got his son's guarantee again, Zhou Guilan felt more at ease, and now seeing these things on the kang, she felt a little happy.
"By the way, Mom, I also dug up two ginseng trees, look."
Xu Shiyan knew that the brothers behind him were all waiting to see the stick, so he stopped hiding and took out two ginseng bags.
The three big ones were pressed at the bottom of the rucksack, and they were covered tightly with torn clothes, so that they were not exposed at all.
The ginseng bag was opened, revealing two human-shaped mallets inside, and the room suddenly gasped.
These two ginseng trees are very beautiful in shape.
Look at Lu first.
The big one is bamboo reed, the stem scars have not grown flat after a long time, and there are ring-shaped protrusions at certain intervals, shaped like bamboo knots.
The smaller one is horse-toothed reed, with obvious stem scars, alternately arranged sparsely and large, with pockets on the edges, shaped like horse teeth.
Look at the body again, which is the taproot of ginseng.
The body is exquisite and exquisite, the body and legs are well-proportioned, and the two legs are naturally separated. This is an obvious spiritual body.
Then comes the bark, which is the outer skin of the root.
The big tree has firm and delicate skin, yellowish-white and shiny. This is brocade skin. The skin of the small one is delicate, white and shiny, which is tender skin.
There are also stripes, mainly referring to the ring-shaped horizontal stripes at the tip of the main root. The older the ginseng, the tighter the stripes.
The last is the fibrous root, which is the root growing on the branch root, called the fibrous root. The tumor-like protrusions on the fibrous roots are called pearl bumps.
The ginseng whiskers of these two ginseng trees are uniform in thickness, slender, clear and not messy, flexible but not brittle, like leather strips, with obvious pearl bumps on them, which are called pimp whiskers.
In general, the two ginseng trees, one big and one small, are both top-grade in every respect, the difference is only in weight.
"Old man, hurry to Jiagui's place, borrow a ginseng, and weigh these two ginseng trees." Xu Shixian couldn't bear it anymore, and hurriedly sent Xu Shixiang to borrow a ginseng.
戥子 is the kind of small scale used by pharmacies to weigh medicines in the past.
Ginseng is light in weight and cannot be accurately weighed with ordinary scales. There are no electronic scales in this year, so only a scorpion can be used.
Wang Jiagui is a barefoot doctor in the village. He has a son in his family. That's why Xu Shixian sent Xu Shixiang to borrow it.
Xu Shixiang couldn't hold his breath anymore, and ran to Wang's house in a hurry.
It happened that Wang Jiagui didn't go out. When he heard that he was borrowing a stick to weigh the stick, Wang Jiagui was so trustworthy that he followed him.
Wang Jiagui's eyes widened when he saw the two sticks at Xu's house, "Oh my god, why are these two ginseng trees so beautiful?"
Xu Shiyan didn't let others do it, he carefully picked up the ginseng, put it on the scorpion and weighed it.
The small ones cost one or two or three dollars, and the big ones weigh three or two and a half dollars. Xu Shiyan made a rough estimate in his mind.
There is also bear gallbladder, which is a copper gallbladder, and it is not light in weight. If it is calculated, more than two thousand yuan is not lost.
Not only Xu Shiyan knows it well, but other people can roughly figure it out in their hearts, one or two thousand yuan, who wouldn't be envious after seeing it?
"Ahem, mom, why don't you let the third child and younger siblings come back to live?" Xu Shixian coughed twice and said.
"Siblings are pregnant with children, it's not good to be pregnant, they can't live alone outside.
It's better to move back, have a mother and Xiulin and the second sibling to take care of it, it's good for the third sibling and the children. "Xu Shixian found a perfect excuse.
"Yes, yes, Mom, let Yingzi and the third child come back."
Xue Xiulin, who had been watching the excitement in the outer room, couldn't help it anymore, stepped into the east room, and said with a smile on his face.
"You see, I can't work in the field while taking care of Dabin, so it's convenient to take care of Yingzi along the way." Xue Xiulin was talking, but her eyes were fixed on the two ginseng trees.
"Yes, sister-in-law is right, Yingzi is pregnant, so she can't give birth to confinement in someone else's house, so let them move back."
Wei Mingrong reacted a step too late, annoyed, and hastily followed suit.
"At the beginning, it was all just talking and talking. How can the family hold grudges? It's better to move back."
Zhou Guilan is old, but she is not yet confused. She knows what her son and daughter-in-law are thinking.
These few are also worried. When the youngest couple moved out, they all watched the fun with heart.
The youngest couple moved away for such a long time, and they didn’t see the elder brother and sister-in-law who went to see if they needed help.
Now that the third child is well-developed, a few of them rush to help talk, so is it the third child and his wife? That was clearly aimed at two ginseng plants and a bear bile.
"San'er, what do you think?" Zhou Guilan looked at the third son, she couldn't decide this matter.
"Mom, elder brother and second brother, elder sister-in-law and second sister-in-law, thank you for your kindness." Xu Shiyan nodded towards those few and pulled out a smile.
"But the two of us have separated, so there is no reason to come back."
Really think he is stupid? If he nods his head and agrees to come back, then the ginseng and bear bile will become the family's, and everyone will have a share at that time.
Why? He worked his life out in exchange for it. These people didn't do anything, so why should they divide it? dream.
"Mom, I want to take Yingzi to Tonghua Hospital to have a look. This is the first time she has a child, so I'm not at ease."
This is the most important thing. While the month is still young, go to the hospital for a checkup, maybe you can keep the baby.
"Huh? Go to the hospital? You have to go to Tonghua? No need?" Zhou Guilan was stunned. How could this be about seeing a doctor?

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Tibetan ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 26 Tibetan Ginseng
Xu Shiyan's words surprised everyone again.
"What are you doing? Go to the hospital? Go to Tonghua Hospital? Third, do you have money to burn it?"
Xu Shixian was the first to speak again. He looked at his younger brother with an incredulous expression on his face.
"Who has ever heard of a woman who is pregnant and has to go to the hospital for an examination?" People in this day and age don't pay attention to this aspect at all.
"Which woman doesn't have children? My mother gave birth to six of us, your sister-in-law gave birth to three, and your second sister-in-law gave birth to two, and none of them went to any hospital.
The third child is going to go to the sky with a tsundere? Also go to Tonghua Hospital? Do you know how much it costs to go to the hospital? "
Xu Shixian felt that he was the eldest brother, so it was necessary to talk to his younger brother.
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes and snorted, "I'm happy to spend as much as I want, but I didn't spend your money. What are you in a hurry for?"
One sentence choked Xu Shixian enough, he opened his mouth and didn't know what to reply.
"Third brother, what are you talking about? Isn't your eldest brother doing it for your own good?"
Her husband was bullied, Xue Xiulin was naturally not happy, her nose is not like a nose and face is not like a face, she said loudly.
"Don't worry, how old am I? Married and married, I'm going to be a father soon, what's good and what's not, I understand."
Xu Shiyan was not used to it, he didn't even pay attention to those people, he just rewrapped the ginseng and put it in his backpack.
"Daughter-in-law, let's go, let's go home first, I'll clean up, we're going to Tonghua today, and we just sold two ginseng trees."
Xu Shiyan is not in the mood to argue with these people, his wife and children are the most important.
Su Anying was still a little confused, but she was used to listening to her husband, she would do whatever Xu Shiyan asked her to do.
Anyway, she doesn't have anything here. The two clothes are hanging outside after washing, so you can just take them off when you go out.
So, the couple shuffled and shuffled, put their things on their backs, and under the staring eyes of everyone, they left the Xu family.
After Xu Shiyan and his wife left, everyone in the room realized it.
"Mom, look at the virtue of the third child, who else does he see?" Xue Xiulin shouted with an unhappy face.
"Isn't it just two sticks and a black blind man? What can he do? Good guy, I haven't got the money yet, it seems that this family can't accommodate him."
Xue Xiulin's words are almost as sour as a vinegar jar, two thousand yuan, who is not greedy, who is not sour?
Zhou Guilan sat on the kang, looked around at everyone in the room, and sighed.
"Come on, since the third child has already separated and lived in another family, I can't control it. He can do whatever he likes."
I can't help my son, it's disgusting to care so much.
"If you are envious looking at the life of the third child's family, then I will discuss with your father, and when the fourth child gets married this winter, you will also live separately."
Zhou Guilan is not an ordinary old lady, she can see clearly the kindness of her son and daughter-in-law.
Forget it, the tree has big branches, and the children have grown up. It is impossible to stay by my side for the rest of my life. If it is necessary to divide the family, we will divide it, so as to save the endless noise every day.
As soon as Zhou Guilan said this, Xue Xiulin, Wei Mingrong and his sister-in-law became happy, with smiles on their brows and eyes.
"Mom, look at what you said, we didn't say we were going to separate.
Our family is fine like this. We are not Yingzi, and we don’t like living with the elderly. "
Even if you are happy in your heart, you can't show it. You have to say something nice to show your heart, and step on others by the way.
Zhou Guilan snorted and said nothing, just packed up the things left by Xu Shiyan and locked them in the cabinet.
"Mom, what are you doing with the black blind oil? Save it for the stewed beans at noon. I haven't seen oil and water for a long time."
Seeing her mother-in-law lock the cupboard, Wei Mingrong was in a hurry. It’s fine to lock everything else. How good is the oil for stewing?
"You know how to eat, right? I can't? That black blind man made fried cakes with oil. He threw them out for ten days, and the cakes weren't even hard."
Zhou Guilan glared at the second daughter-in-law, she is a foodie.
"The old men go up to the mountains in winter to collect firewood, pull wood, and keep the cakes for them to bring with them. You still stew beans? It's a beautiful idea."
The older generations are all like this. If there is anything delicious, you must first cling to the man.
The two daughters-in-law curled their lips when they heard this. Her mother-in-law is too stingy.
Hurry up and separate the family. After the separation, they will live on their own and eat whatever they like.
Not to mention that everyone in the Xu family was thinking about it, just that Xu Shiyan led his wife all the way back to the Li family.
I didn’t care about anything when I entered the door, I turned out the things in the rucksack first, “Daughter-in-law, please help me look at it, I’m hiding things.”
Five ginseng trees, Xu Shiyan only plans to sell two small ones, and the others will not be sold for the time being.
Now the price of this wild ginseng is still too low, it is not worthwhile to sell it, and I am afraid that the money will be too much to be missed, so it is better to keep it.
The resources of wild ginseng will gradually decrease, and such a precious thing will become more and more difficult to find in the future, and the price will become higher and higher.
Moreover, this thing can save lives at critical times, and it is a good thing that money cannot buy.
Xu Shiyan knows how to process medicinal materials. When he returns from Tonghua, he will process the three ginseng plants and put them away. It will not be a problem to preserve them for thirty or fifty years.
Just where to hide, Xu Shiyan was a little worried. It was just such a room, and it was not his own. He had to think carefully.
This room is a southern kang, with a kangqin on the top of the kang, and a shelf next to the floor of the kangqin, with a pair of boxes of flowers and willows placed on it.
There is a chest of drawers against the wall on the north side. This is the only thing in the whole room. Where can I put the three mallets safely?
Suddenly, Xu Shiyan saw the pile of things under the shelf.
That was when the family was separated, and a sack of potatoes brought from the Xu family was piled up in the corner.
Yes, there is a way.
Xu Shiyan told Su Anying to watch that there were no outsiders coming, while he pulled the potatoes aside, put the three ginseng buns in the corner, and piled the potatoes on top again.
"It's done, I don't believe it, can anyone guess that something is in the potato pile?" Xu Shiyan patted the dirt on his hands and smiled.
"What did you hide just now?" Su Anying looked curious.
"I went into the mountain and dug five ginseng trees, and I can't let others know. Daughter-in-law, remember, no matter who it is, you can't tell." Xu Shiyan whispered.
"Oh, I see." Su Anying's eyes widened, she raised her hand to cover her mouth, and nodded repeatedly.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing, "Quick, help me find some clean clothes. I washed and changed my clothes, and I have to go to Uncle Zhao to open a letter of introduction."
It is not easy to go out these days. There is no certificate or letter of introduction from the village, and there is no place to live.
When Su Anying heard this, she hurried to get Xu Shiyan a basin of water, let him wash his hair and wipe his body, and then found a set of clean clothes from the cabinet.
Xu Shiyan changed his clothes and immediately went out to Zhao's house. When he found Zhao Dahai, he said that he would take his wife to the hospital for an examination.
Zhao Dahai happily issued a certificate and a letter of introduction, and gave Xu Shiyan a few catties of food coupons.

chapters.title: Chapter 27: see a doctor
chapters.content:
Chapter 27 Seeing a doctor
Taking advantage of the time when Xu Shiyan went to issue a certificate, Su Anying quickly turned on the fire to make soup, and then stacked a thick stack of pancakes.
When Xu Shiyan came back, the two of them drank soup and had pancakes. Xilihulu finished eating, packed up the remaining pancakes and pickles, and set off quickly.
On the other side, Xu Chenghou went to work in the field and walked back after work at noon. As a result, he met someone on the road and congratulated him.
Xu Chenghou was confused, not knowing what was going on.
At any rate, I grabbed someone to ask, and after careful inquiring, I found out that it was the third child of his family who had returned from the mountain.
It is said that the third child not only killed a black blind man to get bear bile, but also dug up two ginseng trees.
Xu Chenghou heard it, is it okay? Hurry home.
When I got home, I found that the third son was not here at all. He just came back from the mountain and got a piercing, and then left.
"Father, please take care of the third child. How can he be like this? He started working before the money was in his pocket." Xu Shixian seized the opportunity and hurriedly complained.
"You heard that whose daughter-in-law was pregnant with a child and had to go to the hospital for an examination? Isn't this money burned?"
As soon as Xu Chenghou heard this, he immediately exploded, "This prodigal bastard, I think he just has a little money and doesn't know how high he is."
"Sixth brother, go, hurry to your third brother's place, and call them both." Xu Chenghou was furious, and sent his daughter to call for someone.
"He will instruct me." Xu Shiqin curled his lips, muttered something in a low voice, and then walked out of the room slowly, looking for Xu Shiyan.
"Father, Mom, my third elder brother and third sister-in-law are not at home, Aunt Li said they have gone out." Not long after, Xu Shiqin came back and said.
The news that Xu Shiqin brought back made Xu Chenghou even more angry, but it's useless to be angry again, he has already left, can he catch up and stop him?
"You wait until that **** comes back, I will break his legs." Xu Chenghou was so angry that he couldn't even eat.
"What kind of daughter-in-law did you marry? Is it a funeral? Ever since she came in, the family has never stopped." Even Su Anying blamed this.
"I'm pregnant with a child, those who don't know think she has a golden egg, and have to go to Tonghua Hospital?" Xu Chenghou was so angry that his brow was sweating, he grabbed the cattail fan and slapped it fiercely.
Zhou Guilan sat on the kang and rolled her husband's eyes, "Do you think everyone is like you? You don't take children seriously?"
"If you were careful back then, would our eldest daughter be gone?" Zhou Guilan couldn't help but shed tears as she spoke.
Zhou Guilan married Xu Chenghou at the age of seventeen, and gave birth to a girl at the age of eighteen.
The girl was very beautiful when she was born, and it was Zhou Guilan's first child. She liked it very much.
Unexpectedly, the child was less than two months old. Xu Chenghou came home and yelled because he lost money in a game, which shocked the child.
Afterwards, the child developed a fever and diarrhea, and the medicine did not work well. After a few days, the child passed away.
"Look at you, it's been so many years, how do you still remember this? Why do you dig out old accounts?"
Xu Chenghou lost his temper all of a sudden, and sat on the edge of the kang, muttering in a low voice.
"The third child is a hundred times stronger than you, and knows how to love his wife and children.
Old man, let me tell you, if you dare to hit the third child again, you will get angry with me, and I will divorce you. "
Zhou Guilan never said such harsh words, and for the sake of her son, she went all out.
Xu Chenghou was taken aback by fright, and was dumbfounded at the time.
"Here, how old are we, are we still divorced? Telling it out makes people laugh."
As he got older, Xu Chenghou became more and more afraid of his wife. When he heard that he was going to get a divorce, he immediately lost his temper.
"Hmph, you can figure it out." Zhou Guilan put down her harsh words and turned her head away from her husband.
Xu Chenghou was intimidated by his wife, so he lowered his head and drooped his horns. He didn't dare to lose his temper anymore, and he ate honestly.
At this time, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying had passed Qingling and went straight to Jewelry Hill.
I bought a ticket at Jewelry Hill, and before long, the slow train from Baihe to Tonghua arrived.
The couple hurried into the car, found a seat and sat down. The slow trains stopped regardless of the big or small stations, and they wobbled until eight o'clock in the evening, and finally arrived at Tonghua Station.
Out of the station, it was already dark outside. Under the guidance of others, Xu Shiyan led Su Anying to the Tonghua Hotel opposite the station.
This hotel was established in 1960. It is a four-story building with more than one hundred rooms.
When I arrived at the hotel, I showed the brigade’s certificate and the marriage certificate of the two to the hotel staff.
After the other party registered, they led them to a room on the second floor.
It was past eight o'clock in the evening, and the hotel definitely didn't provide meals. Fortunately, they brought pancakes and pickles, and they could make a pot of hot water, and pancakes and pickles could be fooled with hot water.
Su Anying was already uncomfortable after being pregnant, and after sitting on the train for a long time, she felt that her body was about to fall apart, and she didn't have any energy at all.
After eating, the two quickly rested.
On the morning of September 1st, the two had breakfast in the dining hall of the hotel, then went out and went straight to the First Hospital on Xinhua Street.
When I went to the hospital to register and see a doctor, the doctor gave Su Anying a checklist.
Actually, there are not many checks that can be done these days, especially for pregnant women, there are very few items that can be checked.
After several tests, the doctor took the test sheet and read it before telling Xu Shiyan that Su Anying had symptoms of anemia, so she would feel dizzy or even faint after pregnancy.
People in this age have an unreasonable diet structure, insufficient meat and egg supplements, and anemia is nothing but normal.
Su Anying has no other problems except anemia, so Xu Shiyan can finally rest assured.
It’s just anemia, so take some medicine and take it back, pay attention to it on weekdays, and add more nutrition.
Western medicine is mainly ferrous lactate, and Chinese medicine can also take donkey-hide gelatin and jujube for nourishment.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about traditional Chinese medicine or Western medicine, and asked the doctor to prescribe them. In addition, he also prescribed folic acid and multivitamins.
It cost sixty or seventy yuan even for the examination and taking the medicine. Su Anying was in pain.
"If I knew it earlier, I wouldn't have come here. I didn't find out any illnesses, and I spent a lot of money." After leaving the hospital, Su Anying muttered there.
"It's better if you're not sick, what's wrong? You have to find out something wrong to be happy?" Xu Shiyan was speechless for a while.
"Tell you, these medicines are useful for you and your children, you must take them when you go back, do you hear me?"
Xu Shiyan was worried that Su Anying would feel that these medicines were too expensive, and she was reluctant to take them, so she solemnly warned her.
Not to mention, Su Anying really thought so in her heart, that expensive medicine should not be taken casually, it should be kept.
As a result, Xu Shiyan saw through, so Su Anying could only nod in agreement. "Then where are we going next?" Quickly changed the subject.
"The acquisition department of the medicinal material company, let's go, let's find someone to inquire about." Xu Shiyan looked at his daughter-in-law helplessly, and this little thought was written on his face.
City Medicinal Materials Company has set up purchasing points in various communes and supply and marketing cooperatives in towns, specializing in the purchase of authentic Chinese medicinal materials.
For example, the supply and marketing cooperative of Daying Commune has a counter for separate purchases, but the price offered there is low, which is not cost-effective, so Xu Shiyan thought of selling it in the city.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: A lot of money
chapters.content:
Chapter 28 A lot of money
Xu Shiyan asked a few people, and asked about the address of the purchasing department of the medicinal material company, which is also on Xinhua Avenue, not too far from the hospital, and next to the department store.
Following the guidance of passers-by, the husband and wife found the purchase department.
When I entered the door, there were several counters inside, and two or three staff members were standing there.
Outside the counter, there were six or seven people standing. Judging by the clothes, they must be farmers from nearby villages and towns, and they all came to sell mountain products.
"Everyone line up, come one by one." A male employee at the counter glanced at the person entering the door and said coldly.
Xu Shiyan led his wife and stood at the back of the line. While waiting, he stretched his head to look ahead, wondering what those people in front had brought.
It turns out that there is nothing new, most of them are herbal medicines, and only one person sells deer antlers.
Xu Shiyan looked at the antlers and couldn't help shaking his head.
If this is spring antler, it can still be worth a little money. Antlers are meaningless and worthless.
The staff is quick to do things, check the scale and check the grade to invoice here, and pay the money there. The goods of six or seven people were quickly collected, and it was Xu Shiyan's turn.
Xu Shiyan first took out the bear gall and handed it to the other party.
The other party received it in his hand and took a look, ho, it's a high-quality copper gallbladder.
This thing can’t be used on a platform scale. You have to take out the balance, put the bear bile on one end of the balance, and start to flip the weight on the other side until the two sides are balanced, and the weight is weighed.
"Eight hundred and two, can you sell it?" The other party took the abacus, and after a crackling calculation, he raised his head and asked Xu Shiyan.
"How much? Eight hundred and two?" At this moment, a lot of people came in behind Xu Shiyan and his wife, and the big guys couldn't help but exclaimed when they heard eight hundred and two.
Xu Shiyan was also taken aback. He thought it would be good if he could sell more than 500, but he didn't expect to sell more than 800.
"Sell, sell." More than 800, so why keep it if you don't sell it?
The male employee nodded and issued a ticket. Pass the ticket to Xu Shiyan and ask him to withdraw money from the female employee next to him.
As a result, Xu Shiyan took the ticket but did not move. Instead, he continued to search in his rucksack, and then took out two rolls bound with birch bark.
The male employee had been working for many years, so he naturally had good eyesight. He could tell right away that the birch bark should contain wild ginseng.
"You also dug up wild ginseng?" The male employee looked up at Xu Shiyan in surprise.
The person in front of him didn't look very impressive, but he didn't expect that the things he brought out were all rare things.
"Well, let me see, how much is it worth?" Xu Shiyan smiled, pushed the two birch bark rolls, and sent them to the other party.
The male employee couldn't wait to open the two birch bark rolls, and when he saw the two ginseng, his eyes were straightened.
Not only his eyes were straight, but those who lined up behind were also stunned. They couldn't help but leaned forward and stretched their necks to look at the two ginseng trees on the counter.
"Comrade, wait a moment, I have to find someone." This is no longer something he can just arbitrarily rank.
Ordinary staff members only have the right to set prices for less than two taels, but the big tree is more than three taels, so I have to find the director.
The man hurried out, and not long after, he brought in a man who looked almost fifty.
"This is our director, let him come and see."
The director came over, put on white gloves, carefully picked up the ginseng, looked at it carefully, and then took out the magnifying glass to look at it bit by bit.
After looking at the two ginseng trees for half an hour, I looked up at Xu Shiyan. "Comrade, where is your home?"
Xu Shiyan smiled, "Dongjiangyan Brigade of Daying Commune is from the Fusong side." People's inquiries were normal, and Xu Shiyan was very cooperative.
Director nodded, "Oh, the one from Fusong, that's no wonder."
"Two ginseng trees, the big one is two and a half, the five shapes are beautiful, two thousand four, and the small one is one two three. Although the shape is not bad, but I can only give three hundred yuan. Do you want to sell it?"
"Sell, you can issue an invoice." This price has far exceeded Xu Shiyan's expectations, so what are you waiting for if you don't sell it?
Daying Commune buys wild ginseng. The basic price of two taels is 460 yuan. If the shape is good, it can be floated up, basically around 500 yuan.
The price of three taels is doubled, which is about a thousand yuan, three taels and a half, and the estimated price is only fourteen to five hundred.
If it is purchased in the county, the price will rise a lot, and it is estimated that it can be sold for 1,780 yuan.
After all, it's one level behind, and the unit that handles it also has to keep a part of the profit.
This happened in previous years. Someone dug up ginseng and went to the commune to sell it. They only paid a few hundred yuan, but when they went to Fusong, they doubled it.
Xu Shiyan came to Tonghua to sell ginseng, not knowing that the price here is high.
The main purpose is to accompany Su Anying to see a doctor, and the other one is not to make a scene known to the whole city.
I just didn't expect it to be such a pleasant surprise when I came here.
It's normal to think about it at this time. After all, whether it is Daying Commune or the county, they are all collecting for the pharmaceutical companies in the city.
Can they earn some money after handling it?
He sold it directly to the purchase department here, and the price was high and reasonable.
Today, more than 2,000 yuan per month, if changed to 40 years, it will be more than 100,000 yuan, which is definitely a huge sum of money.
Two ginseng plants, one bear bile, 3,520 yuan, that's the big deal.
Xu Shiyan nodded happily, took the ticket and hurried to get the money from the female employee over there.
On the other side of the female staff, they had prepared early and took out four bundles of brand new Unity directly from the cabinet.
One of the bundles was opened, and forty-eight sheets were counted from it, and all the rest were handed over to Xu Shiyan.
"Comrade, you count the money carefully, leave my place, but don't care about it."
It is estimated that the amount of money is too large, and the attitude of the female employee has become more cautious, and she repeatedly urged Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan counted three times in a row, and it was exactly 3,520 yuan. Then he nodded and put the money into his backpack.
Then, under the envious eyes of everyone, he led his wife out of the purchase department.
As soon as he left the acquisition department, Xu Shiyan grabbed Su Anying's hand and ran away. The two of them ran far away and found a secluded corner.
"Daughter-in-law, look around, I'll put the money away." Xu Shiyan said as he put his arms around his jacket, revealing his belt.
It is said to be a belt, but it is actually a **** pack. Xu Shiyan asked Su Anying to make it for him a while ago.
Sewn a palm-width, two palm-length, and three-finger-thick small bag densely with thick cloth, with a zipper sewn on it and cloth straps sewn on both ends.
Three bundles of money were put into the bag, the cloth belt was tied tightly around the waist, and the coat was put down.
The clothes in this day and age are very loose, covering the waist, and it is impossible to see that money is hidden in the waist.
The remaining five hundred and two, Xu Shiyan handed two hundred to Su Anying, "You keep these, we will go shopping later."
Money cannot be all on one person, nor can it all be placed in one place, it has to be separated.
There are also thieves this year, they bring so much money, you have to be careful.
Su Anying was not stupid, so she immediately understood, so she divided the two hundred yuan into several parts, stuffed both socks, and put some in her trouser pocket.
Xu Shiyan is the same, the remaining three hundred and two, separated a few times, and put them in the rucksack, socks, and trouser pockets.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: buy buy buy
chapters.content:
Chapter 29 Buy Buy Buy
After hiding the money, Xu Shiyan took his wife's hand and came out of the alley.
"Let's go, daughter-in-law, I'll take you shopping." Xu Shiyan was very proud, and with big strides, he led Su Anying straight to the department store.
"What to buy? The things here are too expensive, right? Let's go home quickly."
Su Anying looked at the tall building in front of her, feeling apprehensive for a while.
Before she got married, Su Anying had never been out of Daying Commune, let alone Tonghua.
Stayed in the hotel last night, the four floors surprised her for a long time, the building in front of her was taller than the hotel, she was dizzy looking at it.
"Can that work? We finally came back to the city, and we can't buy something to go back? Not to mention anything else, we have to bring something for the family, right?"
With money in his pocket, Xu Shiyan has a stiff waist and a lot of toughness in his speech. "Come on, let's go in and have a look around, and we'll buy whatever we see."
Su Anying was amused by her husband's arrogance, "I can buy whatever I like, and I have to have a ticket if I want to buy it."
Thinking of this, Su Anying feels relieved, anyway, they don't have tickets in their hands, and they can't buy much, so let's go in and have a look.
