Hearing Su Anying's words, Xu Shiyan shook his head secretly. This is a department store in the city after all. Do you really think it is the same as the supply and marketing cooperative in the commune?
The goods here are more complete and higher-grade, and there are often some things that don’t cost tickets. If you’re lucky, you can find a lot of good things.
The two entered the door just like that, and started shopping mode.
As soon as she entered, Su Anying felt that her eyes were not enough, so she looked left and right, it didn't matter where she looked.
The dazzling array of products on the counter is a hundred times better than that of the supply and marketing cooperatives. There are so many and so beautiful.
When a country bumpkin enters the city, everything he sees is novel. At this moment, Su Anying didn't say that he was going to leave, but went to look at the counters one by one, looking at the goods curiously.
Xu Shiyan looked at his daughter-in-law's surprised expression, and couldn't help being amused and distressed.
"When there is a chance in the future, I will take you to the provincial capital for a stroll, it will be more lively there."
The two spent two or three hours walking around in the department store.
The harvest is also huge. I bought a lot of things. In the end, if Xu Shiyan really couldn't carry it anymore, he would still want to buy it again.
"Okay, I spent all the two hundred yuan on me, and you spent a lot on you, let's go back."
Su Anying finally found out, no wonder her father-in-law called her man a prodigal son, it really makes sense.
Just in the department store at this moment, he spent more than three hundred. If the hospital expenses in the morning are added, it can catch up with a person's salary for a year.
With such a purchase method, no amount of money is enough for him.
Seeing that Xu Shiyan still wanted to buy it, Su Anying quickly grabbed her husband and dragged Xu Shiyan out of the department store.
The two of them were so happy shopping that they even forgot to eat lunch. Xu Shiyan felt hungry when he came out now.
"Let's go, take me to a state-run restaurant for dinner, let's order two delicious dishes." It is rare to come to the city, and I have to let my daughter-in-law taste the dishes in the big restaurant.
Su Anying couldn't hold back her husband, so Xu Shiyan dragged her into a restaurant affiliated with Tonghua Hotel.
In the state-run restaurants of this year, there is no waiter to say anything, and the staff are not like the later generations, who come in and rush forward to entertain a guest.
People just sit behind the counter, you have to go to order, and there is no menu, just a blackboard on the wall, which says what is served today.
It’s time to get to the restaurant, so there must be some hard food.
Considering that Su Anying's appetite is not very good when she is pregnant, Xu Shiyan ordered a plate of meat in a pot. This thing is sweet and sour, and he must like it.
Another serving of stewed tofu with braised pork, meat and vegetables, balanced nutrition. Served with two servings of four taels of rice, it is almost enough to eat.
After ordering the food, paying for the food and food stamps, the two sat there and waited.
After a while, the dishes were ready and served, and they were ready to eat.
"Daughter-in-law, try this meat, it's sweet and sour, you must like it." Xu Shiyan put two pieces of pot-packed meat in Su Anying's bowl and asked her to eat it.
This pot of meat is cut into large pieces with lean meat, wrapped in batter and deep-fried in oil pan. After deep-fried, it is thickened with sweet and sour sauce. Every piece of meat is covered with sweet and sour sauce.
The finished pot-packed meat is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, sweet and sour. One bite, it is absolutely amazing.
When did Su Anying eat this?
When a bite of meat is put into the mouth, the sweet and sour taste fills the mouth, and the secretion of saliva suddenly increases, which makes people appetite.
After shopping for so long, I’m already hungry, why don’t you shake off your cheeks?
The dishes in Northeast China are relatively large. In fact, one dish is usually enough for two people.
However, people in this year have empty stomachs and eat less oil and water, so they eat a lot.
Coupled with the fact that the two of them had been shopping for so long, they were already hungry, and they ate hungrily. They really didn't eat less.
Even so, there were some dishes left in the end.
Su Anying quickly dug out the newly bought aluminum lunch box, rinsed it with water, and then put all the leftovers into the lunch box.
"The two of us don't need to go out to eat at night, just eat leftovers and pancakes." Su Anying glanced at the staff over there and whispered.
This meal cost several dollars, Su Anying felt distressed while eating, but she couldn't go out to eat at night no matter what.
How can my daughter-in-law be able to hide it from Xu Shiyan with her intelligence? He didn't say anything, just nodded with a smile, packed his backpack, and went out with Su Anying.
After leaving the state-run restaurant, Xu Shiyan went to a dim sum shop not far away and bought the most famous dim sum in the city, a fork and fire spoon.
Old soup and noodles, made into a pocket-like fire spoon. The inside is filled with meat, and the outside is sticky with sesame seeds. It is baked on a charcoal fire with a fork, and then put into the oven after it is browned on both sides.
The meat stuffing in the fire spoon is cooked with more than 30 kinds of stomach-strengthening, nourishing and seasoning Chinese herbal medicines until the pork belly is half-cooked, and then grilled.
To sum up, the characteristics of this fire spoon are unique flavor, fragrant but not greasy, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and golden in color. It was rated as a famous Jilin dish by the province in 1964.
Of course, the price is also very expensive, making Su Anying frown in distress.
Xu Shiyan didn't care, why can't he eat something good when he has money?
"Let's go back tomorrow, and we have to take a long car, so save food on the way."
His wife is pregnant with a child, what if she doesn’t eat something good? If you have this condition, you must buy it. What to eat and what to drink, the most important thing is to take care of your body.
Just like that, under Su Anying's distressed expression, the couple returned to the hotel.
It was a tiring day. I didn’t feel much when I went shopping, but when I came back and lay on the bed, my whole body hurt and I didn’t want to wake up at all.
I ate late in the afternoon, and I ate too much, so I didn’t even eat at night, and just slept until morning.
Woke up early in the morning, with leftovers, pancakes, and hot water, and the two of them ate with gusto. After eating, I packed up my things and went straight to the train station.
At 6:30, an express train from Shenyang to Baihe passed through Tonghua.
The two bought tickets and got on the train. They wandered on the road for another six or seven hours, and arrived at Songjianghe Station at around 1:30 in the afternoon.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: save money
chapters.content:
Chapter 30 Saving Money
Jewelry Hill is a small station, and the express train does not stop there, so you can only get off at Xianrenqiao or Songjianghe.
Get off from Xianren Bridge, you have to wait for the slow train, then go from Xianren Bridge to Jewelry Hill, and then walk back. Then, it will be four or five o'clock when we get home.
Get off the bus from Songjianghe at 1:30, and walk back to the big house for about an hour, which is still so trouble-free.
Besides, Xu Shiyan had other things to do, so he bought a ticket to Songjianghe.
The couple got out of the car with big bags and small bags, and there were several donkey jeeps picking up the station near the station to solicit customers.
The so-called donkey jeep is actually a donkey cart.
In the past two years, the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau bought a batch of live donkeys with wood.
Because the quantity was not large, it was distributed to several units. At that time, some of them were killed, and the rest were kept and raised.
I don’t know who it is, so I use this donkey to pull my feet back and forth between the station and the town. The big guys call this donkey jeep.
The couple got on a donkey jeep, walked from the train station to the most prosperous place in the town center, and then paid to get off.
"Where is this? We are here, how do we go home?"
Su Anying had never gone out, let alone been to Songjianghe, standing on the street, she didn't know where to go.
Xu Shiyan pointed to the east side of Cross Street, "Go, go to the savings bank."
They still have more than 3,000 yuan on them, so they can't just take the cash back home, and deposit it in the bank for safety.
The savings banks in this year and month basically serve various units and factories, and there are very few personal deposits.
The two entered the door, the inside was empty, and they didn't need to queue up to get a number, and sat directly in front of the counter.
The staff inside looked at it and found it strange, so they asked casually, "What business do you do?"
"Save money." Xu Shiyan picked up his jacket, took out three bundles of unity from his pocket, and put them on the counter.
The staff at the counter were stunned. It wasn't that they had never seen so much money, but it was mainly because they had never seen someone deposit so much money.
"Comrade, which one do you want to deposit? Fixed term or current deposit?" I feel that the attitude of the staff improved immediately.
"Let's survive first." There are a lot of places to spend money, at least build a house, right? So you can't keep it regularly.
"By the way, can you leave a password for a demand deposit?"
Fixed deposits cannot be withdrawn before maturity, even if the deposit certificate is lost, there is no problem reporting the loss as soon as possible. But the current date is not good, what if it is lost?
"Password? Without this business, you only need to match the person's name and hand stamp to withdraw money."
The staff inside looked puzzled, not knowing what to do with a password to save money.
Xu Shiyan sighed. He could actually guess that the early deposits were all without passwords. He could withdraw them with a passbook and a hand stamp.
"Then, if the passbook is lost and someone finds a place to engrave a hand stamp, can't the money be taken away?" Xu Shiyan couldn't help asking.
"Oh, you said this, you can leave a fingerprint. When withdrawing money, we have to verify the fingerprint before paying."
Over there, a slightly older person explained.
Xu Shiyan nodded when he heard the words. In this business, everyone's fingerprints are different, and impostors cannot be used.
Of course, he will have to come in person to withdraw the money in the future, otherwise no one will be able to take it away.
"Then please save the money for me." Keeping a few hundred dollars in your hand is enough, and the rest should be saved for safety.
The staff quickly counted the money, asked Xu Shiyan to fill out several forms, then stamped their seals and fingerprints, and finally handed Xu Shiyan a passbook.
It is said to be a passbook, but it is actually a small book with a few pages, without a hard shell on the outside.
Xu Shiyan took the passbook and looked through it carefully. When he got home, he found a notebook and wrote down the account. If he really lost it, he could report the loss if he could remember the account.
Xu Shiyan stuffed the passbook into his pocket, led his wife and walked out.
But Su Anying quit, "Where's our money? Let's give her the money, why just give us a small notebook?"
Few people have saved money these days, and Su Anying has never heard of it. Where can I know about this?
Xu Shiyan smiled, and dragged his wife out of the savings office.
"Our money is stored here, and we can withdraw it when we need it in the future. That small book is the proof of withdrawing money."
After coming out, Xu Shiyan patiently told his wife about savings.
"Think about it, we live in someone else's house now, and we usually go to work and are not at home.
We all know that we have money, what if someone has a bad intention to steal it? It exists here, it cannot be taken out without my fingerprint, safe. "
Su Anying seems to understand, but in her eyes, her husband is omnipotent, as long as she obeys him.
"You're still smart, really amazing." Su Anying looked at Xu Shiyan adoringly, causing Xu Shiyan's face to heat up.
If he didn't have experience in his previous life, he would actually be similar to Su Anying.
Saved the money and had nothing else to do, so the two walked all the way, passed by Pine Forest High School, took the Lucky Road, crossed the No. 2 bridge, went west, and went straight to the big house.
Back to the village, it was just after three o'clock in the afternoon.
At the head of the village, there were still a lot of people chatting together. When they saw Xu Shiyan and his wife coming back, these people immediately surrounded them.
"Hey, the three of Xu's family are back, how are you doing? How much did you sell those two ginseng plants? How dare you be so blind?"
"Looking at the couple bringing back the big and small bags, you know that there must be a lot of money exchanged."
"San'er, you see, your younger brother is going to get engaged in a few days, can you take Baiba'er's emergency from your hands?"
Three aunts and six wives, chattering, chattering around Xu Shiyan and his wife, just like a small tofu pot is on fire.
"Aunts and aunts, don't ask, okay? We just came back, and we were hungry and tired along the way.
My daughter-in-law is still pregnant, shall we go home first? "
Xu Shiyan's head hurt from the noise of these people, so he yelled loudly, wrapped his arms around his daughter-in-law's shoulders, and walked out of the crowd with the other.
The crowd was stunned by Xu Shiyan's voice, and they watched Xu Shiyan and his wife walk out of the crowd in a daze, and then they came back to their senses.
I want to catch up again, but I feel quite ashamed after thinking about it, so I can only stand there and discuss.
"Look, why doesn't this kid show any sympathy at all? He is rich, and his tail is up to the sky." Some people were not happy, and deliberately loudly criticized.
"Isn't it? You look at him in such a coquettish manner, he is more arrogant than our secretary, as for?" Someone echoed bitterly.
"Come on, you guys are shameless enough. What does it matter to you if someone has money? Just open your mouth to borrow money, it's yours?"
Some people think that these people are too much, so they have to help Xu Shiyan with a few words.
The wife of Zhao Dahai's family ran a few steps to catch up with Xu Shiyan, "San'er, there is something that my aunt will tell you, you must have a plan in mind."
"What's the matter, auntie?" Xu Shiyan turned around and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Some people are jealous
chapters.content:
Chapter 31 Someone is jealous
"You went into the mountain to dig the mallet yourself, and you didn't bring anyone else with you. Many people in the village had objections, so you found your uncle."
Zhao and Xu have a good relationship, so of course Xu Shiyan has to be told about this and let him be on guard.
This is how the human heart is. If everyone is having a bad time, no one will have anything to say.
But other people are still bitter and hunched over every day to earn work points, but Xu Shiyan has made a lot of money, there must be some people who feel unbalanced.
"Although these people have been pushed back by your Uncle Zhao, I'm afraid they will make other moths." Mrs. Zhao looked worried.
"Also, the Chen family has been saying everywhere in the past two days that the black blind man you killed was strangled to death by their family's Chen Yongfu going up and down the mountain. You pick his family's."
Few people took this seriously at first, but they couldn't stand what the Chen family said, and now many people believe it.
"The Chen family went to your mother's place to make a fuss once. When you come back today, you must be careful."
What should be said, Mrs. Zhao has said everything, she really thinks of Xu Shiyan.
The more Xu Shiyan listened, the more ridiculous he felt. The Chen family really dared to think.
As far as those few birdmen in his family are still playing tricks? Why doesn't he go to heaven?
"Thank you, auntie, I know about this.
The black blind man was not trapped at all. I have a way to prove this. Don't worry, auntie. "
No matter what, Xu Shiyan must appreciate the kind reminder.
"Okay, I'm relieved if you know what's in your mind.
Hurry up and go home, your mother has been worried for the past two days, so go and have a look when you come back. " Granny Zhao waved her hands with a smile, turned and left.
"Let's go, go see our mother first." Xu Shiyan sighed, and led his daughter-in-law straight to Xu's house.
As soon as Xu Shiyan and his wife entered the village, a little boy sent a letter to the Xu family.
Before the couple entered the courtyard, they saw Xu Shiqin, the eldest son of the Xu family, and Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu, the two daughters of Xu Shixian's family, rushed out of the courtyard.
"Third brother, you are back. Our mother has been going crazy for the past two days, talking all day long." Xu Shiqin was very happy to see her brother.
"How is it, is the road safe? Once you leave, our mother is worried, afraid that there will be some mistakes on the road."
Xu Shiqin looked his brother and sister-in-law up and down, and he felt relieved after seeing them doing well.
"It's pretty good, I take the train back and forth, and the road is safe.
The key point is that your brother is so inconspicuous, he looks like a mud leg at first glance, and no one thinks highly of me. "
Xu Shiyan smiled. In fact, it’s okay and safe outside this year. Waiting for a few more years will be called chaos.
"Let's go, go home, I bought a lot of things, and I have a gift from you."
Xu Shiyan raised his hand and rubbed the top of the little girl's head, deliberately messing up her combed hair.
Xu Shiqin was not annoyed either, just smiled and patted his brother's hand away, and asked curiously, "What did you buy for me?"
"There are many, let's go, let's go into the house and have a look."
If Xu Shiyan still has a bit of nostalgia for the Xu family, apart from the old lady Zhou Guilan, this is the younger sister Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiqin, the sixth child of the Xu family, is eighteen this year and was born after the Xu family moved to Daying.
This child has a bad life, and when he was born, life was difficult.
Everyone is starving and malnourished.
Zhou Guilan was pregnant and couldn't eat enough, how could she give birth to a healthy child?
When Xu Shiqin was born, she was thin and small like a kitten, with congenital deficiencies, always sick, I don’t know how much energy was spent, but she managed to keep it.
Xu Shiqin is in poor health, and in winter he spends all day on the kang, surrounded by a quilt, with a brazier in front of him.
One evening in the winter when he was three years old, Xu Shiqin was going to the field to relieve his hand, just in time for Zhou Guilan to cook, and the rest of the family were also busy.
Six-year-old Xu Shixiang carried his younger sister to the ground, and then carried her to the kang after relieved.
A six-year-old baby, holding a three-year-old baby is already strenuous enough, but when it comes to the kang, Xu Shiqin can only be carried up.
Originally, Xu Shiqin's physique was not very good, and he always stayed at home, his bones were brittle, and the two children's spine was damaged due to improper force.
At that time, no one cared about it. In the next few days, Xu Shiqin complained of a stomachache. Zhou Guilan found some medicine for him, and he stopped crying after a few days.
But unexpectedly, a bump slowly grew on Xu Shiqin's back, turning into a hunchback.
Because of this hunchback, Xu Shiqin is only about 1.5 meters tall.
She is a pretty girl with delicate features and ingenuity. Because of this hunchback, her marriage has become a problem.
In their twenties, no one introduces a partner, and the worried old couple of the Xu family sighed all day long.
Until 1984, 25-year-old Xu Shiqin was introduced to marry Liang Shulin, who was six years older than her.
Liang Shulin is the eldest of the Liang family. His family was poor and could not marry a wife. He dragged on until he was in his thirties and married Xu Shiqin.
After the two got married, they gave birth to a son with thick eyebrows and big eyes.
Unexpectedly, he was only 28 years old, and died of acute renal failure and uremia.
Xu Shiqin was not in good health. The death of her son was a big blow to her, and she also passed away due to cardiopulmonary syndrome in the second year.
There are six brothers and sisters in the Xu family. The second child, Xu Shian, died of stomach cancer in 1985. The remaining five are Xu Shiyan and Xu Shiqin.
The two families live close to each other, and they help each other with anything, so Xu Shiyan has the deepest affection for this younger sister.
Resurrection, I don't know if I can change my little sister's fate? That Luo Guo'er might not be able to do anything about it, it's not enough given the current level of medical treatment.
Maybe, save more money, wait for the medical conditions to improve in a few years, and try to go to the capital?
Do your best, as long as you have a little hope, you have to try.
"Third uncle, is there a gift for us?"
As soon as they heard that the little aunt had a gift, the two little girls on the other end also widened their eyes and asked curiously.
"Yes, both." Xu Shiyan reached out and pinched Xu Jinxiu's fleshy face.
The brothers of the Xu family are not very good, but the children of the younger generation are all good, and they treat Xu Shiyan very well, and never say they look down on this poor uncle.
So when he was in Tonghua, Xu Shiyan bought things for the children, no matter how much, it was his uncle's heart.
As soon as they heard that they also had presents, the two little girls clapped their hands happily, turned around and ran into the yard.
"Grandma, my third uncle and third aunt are back and bought something for me." The two little girls shouted excitedly.
Zhou Guilan heard it, came out of the house, and happened to meet Xu Shiyan and his wife.
"It's good to be back, I'm still worried at home. How is it? Is Yingzi okay?" Zhou Guilan hurriedly asked when she saw her son and daughter-in-law.
"Well, it's just a little anemia, I prescribed some medicine, and just go home and take care of it slowly." Xu Shiyan told the truth.
"The child is still young, and I can't see anything now. The doctor said, if you are worried, you should go to the hospital for checkups."
In this day and age, women in cities may still know about prenatal checkups, but rural people don't understand at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 32 Gift
Zhou Guilan doesn’t know much about prenatal checkups. She has given birth to so many children and has never had prenatal checkups.
But she knew that her son had separated, and the young couple could do whatever they wanted, and it didn't cost her money, as long as she didn't care about it.
So Zhou Guilan didn't say anything, and only let her son and daughter-in-law into the house.
Then, they sent their eldest granddaughter, Xu Jinfeng, to the private plot and asked Xu Chenghou to come back.
Just as everyone entered the room and sat down, Xue Xiulin was holding her youngest son Xu Haibin, Wei Mingrong was holding her second son Xu Haitao, and behind her was the crying eldest son Xu Haibo, who also came back.
The two sisters-in-law are educated youths who have been sent to the countryside, and they are not very good at the work in the crop yard. They use the excuse that the child is young, and carry the child to hide outside all day long.
Just now I heard that Xu Shiyan and his wife had returned, so the sister-in-law hurried back with the child in their arms.
Xu Haibo didn't have enough fun yet, he was dragged back in a daze, crying all the way.
When I entered the door, I saw Xu Shiyan and his wife sitting on the top of the kang, with two large rucksacks next to them. It seemed that they had bought a lot of things, and the eyes of the sister-in-law and the wife immediately lit up.
"Oh, is the third child back? How is it? How is Tonghua? Is there anything interesting?"
"The two ginseng plants and the bear bile were sold, right? It looks like they sold for a lot of money. The third child is still capable, much better than your brother."
These two daughters-in-law are also wonderful people, and they are amazing at changing their faces. The previous unhappiness has long been forgotten.
When the two sisters-in-law greeted him, Xu Shiyan didn't bother to ignore him, and just nodded.
"Xiao Bo, what's the matter? Manly man, why are you still crying?"
This eldest nephew is a little cryer, crying no matter what happens.
"Don't cry, third uncle has delicious food here, if you cry again third uncle won't give it to you."
Hey, this trick works so well, when Xu Haibo heard that it was delicious, he immediately stopped crying and stared at Xu Shiyan with wide eyes. "What's delicious?"
Xu Shiyan turned his head and asked Su Anying to take out the fork and fire spoon.
Bought two packs at the time, they each ate two on the train, leaving one pack and two packs.
"Liu Liu, take these three, cut them open with a knife, and share with the five of them."
Even though the fire spoon was already cold, it was still very fragrant. As soon as the outer wrapping paper was opened, everyone could smell it.
Xu Shiqin happily took the fire spoon to cut it open, and then shared a piece with each of his nephews and nieces.
Xu Jinfeng, Xu Jinxiu, and Xu Haibo are all grown up, eating is not a problem at all, just take a bite.
Children of this age have never eaten anything good. If they see delicious snacks suddenly, then who cares about others?
"Mom, there is meat in this, wow, it smells so good, it's so delicious."
Put a large fire spoon into their mouths, and the smell of meat spreads in their mouths. The children have never eaten such delicious food, and their expressions are all interesting.
Xu Haitao is two years old, and he can already eat, but Wei Mingrong has just taken his part.
Xu Haitao looked at his brothers and sisters eating, and was already so hungry, he looked up at the fire spoon in his mother's hand, and burst into tears.
"Mom, eat meat, meat." This baby doesn't speak slickly, but he can also express what he wants. I want to eat meat, why don't you give it to me?
Wei Mingrong was holding a fire spoon in his hand, already salivating from the smell.
She has the heart to take a bite, it's embarrassing to steal her son's food in front of so many people.
"Mom will take it for you. It's almost three o'clock and four o'clock. You have eaten the fire spoon now, and you won't be able to eat later."
Wei Mingrong planned to take it back to the house and taste it himself, but Xu Haitao was too young to eat it anyway.
As a result, Xu Haitao quit, grabbed his mother's hand and went to grab it.
Unable to grab it, I simply hugged my mother's arm and bit down on it.
Even though Xu Haitao is small, it hurts to bite him so hard, Wei Mingrong raised his hand angrily and wanted to hit his son.
"Second daughter-in-law, what do you want?
The fire spoon was given to the children by the third child, so you can give it to Xiaotao. Why do you have to make the children cry? "
With Zhou Guilan around, how could the daughter-in-law beat the grandson? At that time Zhou Guilan was unhappy and gave her second daughter-in-law a hard look.
"Hurry up and give it to him, it makes the child scream all day long, and I don't know how you are a mother?"
The mother-in-law has spoken, what dare Wei Mingrong say? He could only pass the fire spoon to his son.
"Those who want debts will always be troubled all day long. It's so annoying." I was angry and could only scold my son.
"Third brother, do you still have that fire spoon? At least give us some to try."
Wei Mingrong was still greedy, so he stared at the paper bag in Xu Shiyan's hand, there must be some more there.
Xu Shiyan lowered his eyes and ignored Wei Mingrong, "My father and mother haven't had a bite yet, is it your turn?"
As he spoke, he put the remaining fire ladle in front of Zhou Guilan.
"Mom, save these for you and my father to eat. They are quite delicious, and the meat inside is not greasy at all."
Anyway, he gave the fire spoon to his mother. As for how the old lady arranges, he doesn't care.
"Mom, I also bought a lot of things, wait a moment, I will dig them out for you."
Xu Shiyan turned around and pulled the rucksack over, and began to take things out of it.
A piece of deep purple red woolen material for a coat, a piece of dark green fleece fabric for an autumn jacket, and a piece of dark blue polyester cardigan for trousers. These are all for Zhou Guilan.
A piece of dark blue thin woolen material, navy blue polyester card, this is for Xu Chenghou.
"These four quilt covers are all printed flowers, so you don't need to embroider the quilt covers yourself. They look pretty."
The bright red background, the bright peony flowers set off the dragon and phoenix and the Chinese character Xi, are very beautiful. At that time, Su Anying took a fancy to it at a glance.
"Save it as luggage for the fourth and fifth to marry their daughter-in-law, this thing looks good."
Don't say he doesn't think about his brother, look, he even thinks about the quilt for his brother's wedding.
"Little Six, come here, these are for you, and our whole family counts you the most." Xu Shiyan dug out another pile, and these were all for Xu Shiqin.
A piece of rose red satin is a new material, made of chemical fiber, the pattern is very beautiful, and there is nothing wrong with it except that it is expensive.
"Save this for winter to make a western-style padded jacket. It will definitely be beautiful to wear during the Chinese New Year."
A large bag of silk thread for embroidery, bright colors and complete colors. "This is the silk thread you've been talking about, and I just met it."
Xu Shiqin is ingenious and can embroider various patterns.
Usually, when someone in the village wants to get married, they always ask her for help, embroidering pillowcases, curtains, curtains and so on.
For Xu Shiqin, all kinds of beautiful silk threads are the good things she dreams of.
"This pair of leather shoes must look good on you."
"And these, the cream, hair oil, and balm oil, are all yours."
Xu Shiyan really doted on his younger sister, and all these things cost him a lot of money.
In the past, it was fine if you didn’t have money, but now that you have money, you must dress up your sister beautifully.
Xu Shiqin was dumbfounded when he saw the huge pile of things in front of him.
"Third brother, did you buy me so many things? There are too many, so I'll keep the pair of leather shoes and the silk thread. For clothes and creams, give them to my third sister-in-law."

chapters.title: Chapter 33: not telling the truth
chapters.content:
Chapter 33 Not telling the truth
"Your three sister-in-laws have them all. These are bought for you. Keep them. She is an eighteen-year-old girl. She should dress up better."
Xu Shiyan was very satisfied with what his sister said.
How about saying that my sister is still a pain in the ass? At least he has other people in his eyes, and he knows how to give way to his sister-in-law.
"Oh, then I'll take it all, thank you third brother and third sister-in-law."
Xu Shiqin was relieved this time, and hurriedly took all her belongings away, and even put on her leather shoes to try, just right, she couldn't be more beautiful.
"Eldest sister-in-law, second sister-in-law, I bought these for a few children, and saved them for Chinese New Year to make clothes for them."
Xu Shiyan dug out some more pieces of fabric, the girl's is pink printed twill, the boy's is dark blue twill.
Any conflicts among adults have nothing to do with Xiaowa.
Besides, these nephews and nieces are all good when they grow up, and Xu Shiyan doesn't feel bad at all for buying things for them.
Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong happily snatched the fabric, held it in their hands and looked at it.
The fabric is dense and thick, and the color is bright, which is much better than that of the supply and marketing cooperative.
The only shortcoming is that it is too small. I bought it according to the height of the children, and it is just enough to make a top, which is not suitable for adults.
"Third brother, you bought these?"
Wei Mingrong put down the fabric, stretched his head to look at the two bulging backpacks, no, there must be a lot of things inside.
"I brought it for my family, that's all. What's wrong? What else is the second sister-in-law thinking?"
Xu Shiyan snorted softly. Could it be that his little uncle is still allowed to buy things for his sister-in-law? Is that plausible?
Wei Mingrong really wanted to ask, why are these things? Even if they don’t buy them for the two sister-in-laws, at least they have to buy something for the brothers, right?
Before he could speak, footsteps sounded outside, and Xu Chenghou and his three sons came in from outside.
At the beginning of September, not far from the autumn harvest, in order not to delay the team's work, Xu Chenghou led his son to work on the private plot and the small wasteland, and picked up the ones that could be brought back in advance.
These two days, I am going back to cut yellow smoke.
Using a special yellow smoke knife, cut off the leaves from the stem one by one, tie them with ropes at home, and then dry them in the air.
In autumn, the sun is good, the rain is little, and the air is dry. The yellow tobacco leaves can be dried in a few days by hanging on the shelf.
The dried yellow smoke can’t be put away directly, it has to be exposed outside, only the smoke that has been exposed can be smoked, if it is not exposed, the smoke will be spicy and bitter.
Put the dewed yellow smoke in place, dampen it slightly, put it into a special box along the head and tail, tie the end of the petiole with a straw rope, and compact it, it is the finished yellow smoke.
At that time, you can keep it at home to smoke, or go out and sell it.
The Xu family planted half an acre of yellow tobacco. Apart from what Xu Chenghou smoked every year, he could sell it for a lot of money, which was a good income.
"Ahem, I heard that the third child is back?" Xu Chenghou coughed dryly twice as soon as he entered the room, and put on his fatherly airs again.
If according to Xu Chenghou's intention, the third son would have to be scolded first when he comes back, how can he be so bad at life?
But Zhou Guilan's threat was still in his ears that day, Xu Chenghou was really afraid that his wife would divorce him, so he didn't dare to say it.
Xu Chenghou himself has a somewhat fierce face, and he can't pretend to be kind.
This superficial smile, neither embarrassed nor embarrassed, is actually even scarier.
"I'm back, I'm back smoothly." Zhou Guilan was quite happy and said with a smile.
"Come and see, what did my son buy us? This is food, this is fabric for the two of us, and I bought a quilt for the fourth and fifth."
Zhou Guilan wanted to ease the relationship between the father and son, and pointed to the pile of things on the kang.
Xu Chenghou took a look, hey, there are quite a lot of things, "Why do you buy so much cloth? Where did you get the cloth ticket?"
To buy cloth these days, you have to have a cloth ticket. Each household in the agency has a limited amount of cloth tickets every year. If a family puts it together, it’s good enough to buy two sets of clothes.
The pile on the kang may have to be saved for several years.
"We went by coincidence, just in time for a batch of free tickets to arrive at the department store in the city. I thought it looked good, so I brought some for my family."
Chemical fibers don’t need cloth tickets, they are more expensive, but they are more wear-resistant and wear-resistant, so they are more suitable than cotton cloth.
"Oh, it's probably not cheap. After buying so many things, the two sticks are worth a lot, right?"
Xu Chenghou nodded and asked the question that everyone was most concerned about.
"Well, it's okay, two sticks are sold for 1600 yuan, and the black blind man's guts are 500 yuan."
Xu Shiyan didn't tell the truth, which is enough to make people jealous. If he told the truth, his brothers and sisters-in-law would definitely make a fuss.
The amount of money was similar to what everyone had guessed. Xu Chenghou didn't doubt anything, just nodded.
"If you have money, save it well, don't spend it recklessly. You won't spend money like this in the future, it's not the way to live."
As Xu Chenghou said, he glanced at Zhou Guilan.
Seeing Zhou Guilan staring at him unkindly, what he originally wanted to say was swallowed back in his stomach.
In the past two days, the sons have been urging Xu Chenghou, saying that when Xu Shiyan comes back, he will hand over the money to the family.
Xu Chenghou actually has the same intentions. There are two sons who are not married, and a daughter who is not out of the house. There are a lot of places to spend money.
Even if Xu Shiyan is separated, he is still a member of the old Xu family. Now that he has money, he should return the money back to his family. This is what he deserves.
But Zhou Guilan kept warning Xu Chenghou that if he dared to embarrass his third son again, Zhou Guilan would divorce him.
The old couple have been married for half their lives, they have been fighting and fighting all these years and they have not been separated, especially when they are old.
Xu Chenghou was afraid of his wife, so he couldn't ask for money in a straightforward manner, so he spoke to Xu Shiyan, hoping that his third son would take the initiative.
Unfortunately, Xu Shiyan didn't take this issue at all, and just nodded when he heard his father's words.
"Well, I know, I don't have a house to live in yet.
Let's see whether to build one next year or buy a ready-made one. It is estimated that it will cost a lot of money. "
One sentence blocked the possibility of Xu Chenghou speaking again.
Your son doesn’t have a house yet, and he’s still living in someone else’s house.
how? Are you ashamed to ask for the money so that your grandson will be born in someone else's house?
Xu Chenghou was choked up, if this happened before, he would definitely be angry and want to curse.
But now that your son's wings are hardened, if you really want to scold him, he turns around and leaves, what else do you have?
What's more, the old wife is staring at her like a tiger, assuming that if he dares to swear, she will fight him desperately today.
Okay, don’t say anything, hold back.
Therefore, Xu Chenghou ignored the eldest son who kept winking at him, and just lowered his head, loaded a bag of cigarettes, and started smoking.
Xu Chenghou was stunned, and Xu Shixian was still not feeling well. Just as he was about to talk, he heard footsteps outside again.
"Old brother Xu, I heard that your third son is back? Just right, shouldn't we also talk about it?
Your family's third son picked up my family's black blind man, what is the matter? "
Well, the chapter updated yesterday probably made many readers uncomfortable because of the matter of the sixth sister of the Xu family.
The prototype of the sixth younger sister of the Xu family is my real aunt, and our aunt and nephew have a very good relationship. So there is no such thing as deliberate smearing, it's just a pity.
Why write rebirth? What did you do when you were reborn? In my opinion, it should be to make up for the regrets and shortcomings of the previous life.
Think about it, if a person has a prosperous life, a harmonious husband and wife, and filial sons and daughters in this life, he probably will never be reborn.
It is precisely because there were too many regrets in the previous life, so starting over, we must change the ending of the previous life, and everyone sees this kind of change.
The protagonist in the article has also thought about treating Liumei, but with the current strength and vision of the protagonist, it is not enough, so the protagonist has to work harder to earn money. In the future, it will be cured.

chapters.title: Chapter 34: brazen
chapters.content:
Chapter 34 Brazen
The ones who came were of course the Chen family. Chen Yongfu came in aggressively with his wife and four sons.
Behind, followed by a group of spectators.
Everyone is also curious about how much money Xu Shiyan made this time. I even want to see what will happen if the Xu family takes on the Chen family.
"I said Chen Yongfu, are you tired of life, old boy? How dare you come to my house to make trouble?"
Without waiting for others to do anything, Xu Chenghou was the first to rush out of the house, and started cursing while standing in the yard.
He was already suffocated, and he couldn't get angry at his son, so couldn't he be angry at outsiders?
No matter how disobedient his son is, he is his own, a member of his old Xu family, and he can't be trampled by just a cat or a dog.
"As far as you are, you are not as tall as three pieces of tofu.
With your crotch clattering all day long, how can you still go up and down the mountain? Are you not afraid to put yourself in it? "
Xu Chenghou was tall and burly, a head taller than Chen Yongfu. When the two of them stood in the middle of the courtyard, Chen Yongfu lost first in terms of momentum.
I have to say that Xu Chenghou's mouth is really bad enough, and he always uses Chen Yongfu's size to talk about things when they meet.
Chen Yongfu is short, and the children in his family are not tall.
In ordinary days, when someone compares the Chen family with the Xu family, the first thing to do is their height. This is an eternal pain in the heart of the Chen family.
Others talk about it behind their backs. Today, in front of the face, Xu Chenghou belittled him so unceremoniously. How can Chen Yongfu hold on to his face?
"Xu Chenghou, you are tall, what can you do with your height? You stand like a wooden stake, and it takes two feet more cloth than others to wear clothes.
What are you proud of? "Chen Yongfu jumped up in anger.
"Standing tall and big in front of the gate, you don't need to work to look good. I don't lose my strength. I can work alone for you two.
Just like you, I can slap three people with one slap, what's the matter? you have a temper "In terms of verbal battles, Xu Chenghou has never lost.
The critical strike doubled, and Chen Yongfu's face turned purple from anger.
"Well, I didn't come here to argue with you today. It's useless." Anyway, I lost my temper, thinking about the purpose of coming today.
"Your third son stole the black blind man I trapped, we have to talk about it."
Some people are so jealous that they have lost their minds. They have been saying this for the past two days, and now even he himself feels that this is true.
"I have seen shameless people, but I have never seen you so shameless.
Chen Yongfu, do you think you can enter the mountain? You turn around and ask the people behind you, do you believe it or not? "
Xu Chenghou pursed his lips, looked at Chen Yongfu from top to bottom with a contemptuous face, and then snorted twice.
As soon as the words came out, many people inside and outside the courtyard laughed.
Actually, few people in the village believed what the Chen family said.
Don’t forget that most people hate the rich. If I live poorly, you can’t live well either.
Even if everyone knew what was going on, they were willing to join in, but they just wanted to make trouble for Xu Shiyan.
"I don't have the ability, but your son has it? As far as his virtue is concerned, no matter what he does, he takes his time and is not as good as a good old lady.
Can he kill the blind man? Who will believe it? "
Chen Yongfu followed Xu Chenghou to learn, and also began to attack personally.
"Hello, your son. Your son is just like you, like a three-inch nail. Those two short legs."
Don't look at Xu Chenghou scolding his son all day long, but he can't stand if others say something bad about his son.
Not to mention, his son is now well-off and earns so much money.
When he went out these days, many people came to flatter him, saying that San'er must be the leader next year when he releases the mountain.
Xu Chenghou didn't just talk about it, but he was quite proud of it in his heart. Naturally, he couldn't let others bury his son like this.
Seeing that the two old men were over a hundred years old together, and they were arguing like children, Xu Shiyan felt embarrassed standing there.
"Father, you go to the other side, I'll come." Talking and talking can only be scolding, but can't solve the problem.
"Uncle Chen, you said that the black blind man was caught by you. Tell me, what kind of trick did you use? Where did you get it?"
When Xu Shiyan asked this question, Chen Yongfu was immediately stunned.
He doesn't know how to hunt at all, but he was teased by his wife to take advantage of it. How would he know what kind of holster to use?
"Line 8, the cover made of line 8 is near Qianchuan." Chen Yongfu murmured for a long time before choking out this sentence.
The brothers of the Xu family came back from the south of the village that day, and everyone saw this.
Qianchuan is more than ten miles south of the village, where there is a brigade of ginseng, and Lao Litou killed a black blind man near there.
Chen Yongfu took it for granted that he should be the blind man killed near Qianchuan.
As soon as Chen Yongfu said this, the few people in the village who knew how to hunt couldn't help laughing.
"Old Uncle Chen, go home quickly, don't be ashamed of yourself here. Line 8? You can really tell."
Line 8 is a type of iron wire with a diameter of about five millimeters.
The **** blind man weighing more than 300 catties is very strong. Let alone the No. 8 wire as a cover, even an oil silk rope as thick as a finger may not be able to trap it.
Once, when the villagers went to the mountain, they met a black blind man who had been dead for some time, with a piece of oil silk rope tied around his neck.
It was the black blind man who broke the oil silk rope in a daze, but couldn't get rid of the cover, and died of starvation and strangulation.
It is pure layman's words to be able to say that line 8 is used as a cover, so everyone laughed.
Chen Yongfu didn't understand what the people around him were laughing at, but Chen Deyong was more thoughtful, so he leaned over and whispered a few words, and Chen Yongfu blushed.
"No, I misremembered, it should be oil silk rope." Chen Yongfu quickly changed his words.
"Okay, since Uncle Chen said it was an oil silk rope, the blind man must have worn out the fur around his neck in order to break free."
Xu Shiyan knew that the Chen family was messing around, but in order to solve this matter, some things must be made clear in front of the big guys.
"Daughter-in-law, you go home and bring that black blind man's skin, and let everyone see it."
Xu Shiyan turned his head and asked Su Anying to get the bear skin.
Su Anying nodded, and walked out. There were a few trustworthy little daughter-in-laws, and they went to Li's house together.
Not long after, a few people came back, holding the bear skin.
Xu Shiyan unfolded the bear skin. At that time, he peeled the skin completely. There was no trace of friction on the black bear's neck.
"Look, everyone, there are two gashes on the black blind man's stomach, which I cut with an axe.
According to the size of the black blind man and my height, I should also be able to tell that the black blind man stood upright at that time and wanted to pounce. "
Xu Shiyan pointed to the two wounds on the bear skin and said.
"As I said before, this blind man got into my hut, drank the wine I brought, and walked out drunk.
It happened that I went back and had a face-to-face meeting with it. When it stood up and was about to pounce on me, I cut it with two axes. "

chapters.title: Chapter 35: slip away
chapters.content:
Chapter 35 Admit Coward and Slip Away
Xu Shiyan has always used this set of rhetoric to the outside world.
At that time, the main reason was not to worry my mother, and the second one was not to let people know where he dug the ginseng, so I simplified the process of killing the black blind man.
But those two axes do exist, and they can completely match the wound.
Anyone with a discerning eye can see that it is indeed what Xu Shiyan said.
"If the black blind man is caught by the cover, then it can't stand up at all, and it is impossible to cut off the stomach if it is killed, but cut the back of the neck."
"If the blind man broke his cover and ran away, no matter who killed him, it has nothing to do with you."
"Old Uncle Chen, don't mess around here.
What Xu Sange said is reasonable, it doesn’t look like you, it’s full of loopholes, you’re not ashamed, we’re all ashamed for you. "
Yang Chunming and other young men who had a good relationship with Xu Shiyan all spoke up for Xu Shiyan.
Chen Yongfu's family, it was said by everyone that they even had a fever, so they really couldn't hold on.
The only thick-skinned one is Mrs. Chen, and it's not over yet.
"Anyway, I don't believe it, you killed it. With your sluggish virtue, can you kill a black blind man? You must have picked it up."
Mrs. Chen is unreasonable when she messes around.
Xu Shiyan sighed, reached out and rolled up his sleeves, "Okay, you said I don't have that ability, right?
Come on, let the four of your family go up together, I don’t need anyone, if I don’t beat the four of them to the ground, I will share half of the bear’s gall money with you. "
Damn, you really think he's easy to bully, don't you? Alright, then show them your hands today, don't treat him as an easy mess.
Xu Shiyan was always sick when he was a child, but he got better later, and he has great strength.
He works slowly because of his nature, but he is careful and steady, and he can't see others messing around in a hurry.
If you really think that he is easy to bully, you are wrong.
After moving to Donggang in his previous life, he went to see ginseng on the mountain. At that time, the society was very chaotic, and the local hooligans were all thinking about ginseng.
Explicitly blackmailing, secretly sneaking, what kind of person has he never seen?
To put it bluntly, that is the money earned by risking your life to fight those people.
Just a few heads of garlic from the Chen family are simply not enough to look at.
Although Xu Shiyan is only 1.76 meters, he is much taller than the Chen family brothers. It is a bit scary to look down now.
Not to mention, at this moment, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shixian's brothers also have fierce faces and a sense of oppression.
Chen Deyong looked at his brothers, they were all about 1.6 meters tall, dry and thin.
The eldest is working as a temporary worker in the county and is not at home. The fourth is 17 this year, and the fifth is only 14. They are useless at all.
If there is a fight, only he and the third child can handle the matter. They are really not Xu Shiyan's opponents.
"Third brother, look at what happened today, I'm really sorry.
My dad, don’t you know? His mind is a little unclear, he must have remembered wrongly, don't be like him. "
The situation is stronger than the people, the Chen family is at a disadvantage here, the four brothers of the Xu family are staring at each other, and there are a few people who have a good relationship with Xu Shiyan watching.
If there is a fight, and someone secretly trips up or something while the chaos is going on, the Chen brothers will suffer.
A hero doesn't suffer from the immediate loss, Chen Deyong was directly persuaded, and hurried forward to apologize and admit his mistake with a smile.
What else did Mrs. Chen want to say, but was pulled by Chen Deyong's daughter-in-law, and she had no choice but to shut up.
Everyone has given up, what else can Xu Shiyan say? Just smiled.
"The old man is old, and it is possible to remember wrongly.
I met me today. I have a good temper. I don’t have the same knowledge as him. If you meet someone with a bad temper, you will know the result yourself. "
The Chen family counts this kid as the most sinister, he does one thing to the face and another to the other side, with a tigerish smile on his face, he is not a good guy.
Xu Shiyan was secretly vigilant in his heart. The Chen family lost face today, so they must bear grudges. They might take revenge at some point, so they still have to be careful.
"Yes, yes, third brother, today's matter is my brother's fault, and I failed to stop my parents.
You live in our village, there are a lot of adults, this matter is over today, okay? "
Chen Deyong deserved to be able to bend and stretch, no matter what Xu Shiyan said, he responded with a smile, what else could Xu Shiyan do?
"Isn't it? They're all in the same village, so there's no need to make trouble.
Come on, bro, take your parents back, it’s getting late, everyone, don’t watch the show here, let’s all go home and cook. "
Xu Shiyan didn't take it for granted, he just waved his hand and told everyone to leave.
It's really not early, every family should cook and cook, and there is no excitement to watch, everyone's interest is waning, and they leave separately.
The outsiders all left, and the Xu family also went back to the house. Zhou Guilan told her daughter-in-law to cook quickly.
"Third brother, you two will also eat here tonight, and you will go back after eating."
My son has bought so many things, can he still ignore the meal?
My mother spoke, and my father didn't lose his face and lose his temper today. Naturally, Xu Shiyan couldn't refuse, so he could only agree to stay.
Zhou Guilan hurriedly led her daughter-in-law and daughter to Zhang Luo to cook.
Fortunately, there are a lot of vegetables in this season, so cooking is not difficult.
Beans and potatoes, stew in a pot with Xiong Xiazi oil that Xu Shiyan brought back last time.
On weekdays, I can’t wait to boil the dishes with water, but today I used a lot of oil, and the dishes looked oily, so I didn’t need to eat them, I thought they were delicious.
There is a ring of pancakes pasted on the side of the pot. People with good craftsmanship don’t need to be separated by pot curtains.
Pack the pancakes, cover the pot and simmer like this, when the time comes, they will be out of the pot together.
The part of the pancake close to the vegetable soup absorbs the oil and salt in the vegetable soup, giving it a full flavor.
There is a layer of burnt crispy rice under the bottom, which is the favorite of people with good teeth. The more you chew, the more delicious it becomes.
Cucumbers were picked and washed, put them in a pot, and served with miso and minced garlic for a cold dish, which was cool and refreshing.
Put corn in another pot, put a curtain on it, and put eggplant and potatoes.
Wait for it to be cooked and take it out, and serve it with the egg sauce fried by Zhou Guilan herself.
Of course, corn noodle porridge is also indispensable. After all, at night, you can’t just eat dry food, you have to pair it with some gruel.
Today, the variety of corn is different from that of later generations. The yield is not so high, and no chemical fertilizers are used, but the food tastes full, and the corn porridge is delicious.
Farm food does not pay attention to any exquisiteness, as long as the portion is large enough to fill the stomach.
During the meal, Zhou Guilan also asked people to take the remaining five forks and spoons into four portions, and each of the big guys shared a little to taste the taste.
This meal was delicious, and the big guy kept saying that it was a good thing with the young couple.
The children were full of stomachs, and Zhou Guilan drove them out to the yard to go for a stroll to digest food.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan wanted to leave, but before he could speak, the secretary Zhao Dahai came to Xu's house.
"San'er, I have something to discuss with you." Zhao Dahai spoke first.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: into the mountains again
chapters.content:
Chapter 36 Entering the Mountain Again
"Uncle Zhao, if you have something to do, just tell me."
Xu Shiyan still respects Zhao Dahai. If he came to look for him at night, he must have something important.
Zhao Dahai rubbed his hands in embarrassment, "Well, it's such a thing.
Look, you have gone into the mountains to dig up big goods, and all the old and young men in our village are also greedy. "
"They found me just now, and wanted me to ask you, can you take the big guy and go into the mountain again?"
One or two thousand dollars, who wouldn’t be jealous? In the past two days, there has been a lot of trouble in the village, all because of this matter.
Some people felt unbalanced, so they made a fuss in front of Zhao Dahai.
Although Zhao Dahai repulsed them all, he was still upset.
Originally, some people wanted to trouble Xu Shiyan, but the Chen family came to make a fuss in the afternoon, and some people backed off.
After the rest of the people thought about it, it was not easy to find trouble, so let Xu Shiyan lead them into the mountain.
Xu Shiyan was very lucky, Bao Buqi followed him, could we really meet?
So many people found Zhao Dahai, discussed with him, and asked Zhao Dahai to speak to Xu Shiyan.
Taking advantage of the few days before the autumn harvest, wandering into the mountains, what if there is a harvest?
Xu Shiyan was dumbfounded when he heard this, let him take people into the mountain again? Isn't this a joke?
There are rules for releasing the mountain. As long as you meet six leaves, even if you meet them on the first day, you have to go down the mountain immediately after digging this tree.
The **** of the mountain rewards these wealth. People can't be greedy, and accidents will happen if they are not greedy.
Xu Shiyan went into the mountain and dug up two six-leaf trees, and then went into the mountain, isn't he looking for trouble?
"Uncle, isn't that bad? I've already dug up two trees, and that's where the fortune comes from.
If you have the heart, you can go to the mountains with me next year. Not this year, there is no such rule. "
Xu Shiyan frowned. The rules that have been passed down for hundreds of thousands of years cannot be broken here.
"Look at you kid, you didn't meet Liupi leaves when you entered the mountain, so why do you say that your fortune is here?
Maybe if you go into the mountains, you can still meet Liupiye? Didn't it always snow when the mountains were set free? It's okay to go back again. "
Zhao Dahai disapproved, feeling that Xu Shiyan didn't give him face.
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered, yes, no one else knew about his encounter with Liupiye.
"Uncle, I'm young and inexperienced, so it doesn't matter if I go alone.
You let me be the leader and take everyone into the mountain, this is really not good.
In case something happens, I can't take responsibility. "Xu Shiyan was very embarrassed.
"San'er, uncle, there is nothing you can do. They all came to me and said they wanted you to hand over the money to the team, so what do you want me to do?"
Zhao Dahai seems to be a little angry, and his face is not very good.
"Listen to Uncle, and lead them into the mountains for a walk, three to five days will do, don't take too long.
If they can meet, it means they have this fortune. If they don’t meet, these people don’t care about it.
Even if it’s for your uncle and me, make a little effort to run, okay? "
Zhao Dahai is really helpless, he has the heart to protect Xu Shiyan, but it is hard to be angry.
You can't offend a whole village just for Xu Shiyan, right?
"Uncle, you have talked all the way to this point, then I really have nothing to say, so let's go."
What can Xu Shiyan do? Right now they are still living in a big house, so they can't offend everyone, can they?
"But it's agreed, the mountains are dangerous, and you have to listen to me when you enter the mountains, otherwise don't look for me if something happens." The ugly words must be said first.
"Also, whoever is willing to go, let the young people go into the mountains, don't they all say that the first-timers will have good luck? Don't follow the old people."
Those old guys will not listen to Xu Shiyan's fiddling at all. When the time comes to enter the mountain, seven people will be in charge of the family and eight people will be in charge. Who will they listen to?
"Success, success, as long as you nod, I will take care of the rest." Zhao Dahai was very happy when he heard that.
Each family sends a young person into the mountains, and the others don’t delay working in the fields. This arrangement is very good
"Yes, I have to go and inform them, and let everyone get ready to go up the mountain tomorrow. Go early and return early, we have to harvest in autumn."
After Zhao Dahai finished speaking, he didn't stay any longer, bid farewell to Xu Chenghou, and left in a hurry.
After Zhao Dahai left, Xu Shiyan looked back at his family and sighed.
"Father, don't let anyone follow you at home. It will delay your work. It's not that easy to let go of the mountain, don't listen to their nonsense."
Autumn is a busy season, what are you doing all these high-profile things? It's purely full of food, looking for something to do when there is nothing to do.
"I led a few young people into the mountain. It's fine if I don't meet them. If I meet them, I don't want them this time. They are family members, okay?"
Xu Shiyan was afraid that his brothers in the family would also be greedy, so he had to follow, and the family's work would be delayed by then.
It is purely a matter of no shadow, why bother to waste that time? If you have the time, wouldn't it be nice to earn some work points?
The Xu family father and son were really moved just now. They dream of getting rich, and they can do anything.
But now Xu Shiyan said it, Xu Chenghou also calmed down.
Yes, what the third son said is reasonable. Once you go back to the mountain, you can spend less than four or five days talking. What’s wrong with having that time?
"Okay, then you can go with me, what can you do? Who told you to make money, you are jealous." Xu Chenghou nodded, agreeing.
After the discussion, Xu Shiyan led Su Anying back to Li's house to rest.
The couple went out for several days. Fortunately, Mrs. Li burned the kang every day, so they didn't sleep on the cold kang.
Xu Shiyan sent the things for Mrs. Li to the east room again, chatted with the old lady for a while, and then went back to the room.
The couple arranged and locked all the things they brought back in the cabinet, and finally went to the kang to rest.
September 2nd, the 19th day of the seventh lunar month.
Early in the morning, some young people in the village began to get busy preparing. These people had little experience, so they procrastinated until ten o'clock, and finally got together.
After counting the number of people, including Xu Shiyan, there are exactly thirteen.
Seeing this number, Xu Shiyan was somewhat relieved. He was really afraid that if all the eighty or so families in the village had sent people over, there would really be no one in the team to work.
Furthermore, there are rules in Fangshan. If you go single and return to double, the number of people must be single when you go, and count ginseng when you come back, which is an even number.
Take a closer look at the people who came here, most of them don't work hard all day long, and always want to hide and play tricks.
As for Yang Chunming and others, they never came.
Yeah, people are passing by, who is tossing about this?
Right now is not the time at all, delaying farm work to release mountains, ordinary people can't do it.
These people, headed by Chen Deyong, are all close to the Chen family on weekdays.
So, if the Chen family didn't stir things up, Xu Shiyan wouldn't believe it if he was killed.
"I made it clear in advance that you have to listen to me when you enter the mountain. If you don't listen to me, don't blame me if something happens."
It’s still the same sentence, villain first, gentleman second, ugly words first, so as not to cause trouble.
"Brother Xu, don't worry, we will definitely listen to you." Chen Deyong and a few boys shouted loudly.
"Okay, then stop talking nonsense and let's go."
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything else at all, carrying a backpack and leading the people, he just left the village and headed south all the way to Qianchuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 37: make mistakes
chapters.content:
Chapter 37 Make mistakes one after another
Qianchuan is about ten miles southwest of Dafang Village, there is a brigade of ginseng over there, and Lao Litou is there to see ginseng.
Xu Shiyan led a group of beginners, so naturally he didn't dare to go too far for fear of encountering danger.
This group of people also went to work in the mountains on weekdays, but this time it was different from the past. They were going to release the mountain to dig sticks. Everyone was very excited and chatted non-stop along the way.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about them, he didn't talk much on the way, just thinking about his own thoughts.
Arriving near Qianchuan, Xu Shiyan observed the terrain and mountains, and determined the mountain field where the mountains should be released.
The first thing to do when entering the mountain is still to set up the Lord's Mansion and worship the mountain god.
After worshiping the old man of the mountain god, as usual, he chose a hillside facing the wind and facing the sun as a place for everyone to camp.
"Okay, this is it." Xu Shiyan pointed to the position in front of a big tree.
"Start here, build a bridge next to each other, don't be too far away.
The two live in the same building, Goushengzi and Zhang Erdan, you two go to collect firewood. De Yong, you are the cooker, find a place to set up a stove to cook. "
The person who carries the pot is the person who is responsible for cooking.
With so many people joining gangs to enter the mountain, it is not the same as Xu Shiyan's single-stick group. Someone must be responsible for cooking.
The rice, grain, and vegetables brought by everyone from home are all handed over to the pot-handler, who cooks according to the estimated number of days and the number of people.
Xu Shiyan is the leader. He is only responsible for leading the team into the mountains to find the club, and he doesn't care about other things.
Everyone had to obey Xu Shiyan's orders, so they hurried to work.
Goushengzi and Zhang Erdan were looking for firewood nearby, and after a while they came back with a lot of tree heads and branches, and put them on the ground with a thud.
"No, haven't you two heard the old man talk about how to release mountains?" Xu Shiyan became anxious when he saw it.
"The firewood has to be sorted out and carried back, and put it in a smooth manner, so that we can release the mountain smoothly. Look at you two, what are you doing?"
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes angrily, these people really don't understand anything, and they only think about beautiful things to make a fortune all day long.
"Also, what kind of firewood did you two pick up? For the fire at night, you need elm, green straw, and Korean bright seeds, and for the daytime, you need yellow pineapple. Go and find it again."
Elm, green straw, and Koli Mingzi, these kinds of trees will not burst, crack, or cause sparks to burn people who are warming the fire after being burned, so it is best to use them at night.
The temperature in the mountains is very low at this time, and the fire cannot be ceased overnight.
Yellow pineapple tree doesn't like fire, so it can preserve the fire very well.
When they go into the mountains in the morning, they can use yellow pineapple wood to press down the fire, so as to avoid having to rebuild the fire when they return.
These are the experiences that Fangshan must know.
Xu Shiyan is the leader. Since the big guy has found him and asked him to take him into the mountain, he must listen to him.
Gou Shengzi and Zhang Erdan had no choice but to go to the forest to find firewood according to Xu Shiyan's request.
Everyone was busy for a while, and built seven pavilions. Xu Shiyan lived alone, and the other two lived in one.
Wait for everyone to set up the floor, Chen Deyong also cooked a pot of pickled vegetable porridge, and everyone had a meal with pancakes.
In the evening, everyone gathered around the fire to enjoy the fire, and Xu Shiyan told everyone the rules of releasing the mountain.
"Remember it all, if someone breaks the rules and angers the mountain **** when you enter the mountain tomorrow, don't say I'm rude." Xu Shiyan sank down and warned everyone.
"Okay, go to bed early if you have nothing to do, and we will start pressing the mountain after dinner tomorrow morning."
I have talked about everything that needs to be said, do you remember living with them? After Xu Shiyan finished speaking, he went back to the cellar to rest.
The others seemed to be very excited and couldn't sleep, so they got together to chat.
"Hey, did you see that we let him be the boss, but he was ruined.
Oh my god, I really didn't see it, Xu Laosan also has a day when he can give orders. "
Chen Deyong said in a low voice while poking the fire with a wooden stick.
"What's there to be proud of? Our big guys respect him and let him be the leader. He really treats himself as a dish?
We are just borrowing his fortune, waiting for us to see the big stick, and immediately drive him home. Who would use him? At that time, Brother Chen will have to take us with us. "
Most of these people were with Chen Deyong, and they were not right-minded. Before they could do anything, they started to come up with bad ideas.
"Hush, keep your voice down, don't let those two poles hear you." Chen Deyong was very comfortable being praised by these people, and his smiling eyes almost disappeared.
"This kid is quite evil. Since the division of the family, his fortune has been good. Tomorrow, he should be more energetic. Follow him well, and he will definitely gain something."
The group of people discussed together for a while, and then went back to sleep in the cellar.
The next morning, after breakfast was cleaned up, everyone stood together and shouted Huangshan in unison.
Then, you have to look at the mountain scenery from your head. Xu Shiyan looked at the surrounding mountains, and based on the shape of the mountains, the shape of the mountains, and the tops of trees and grass, he judged which part of the mountain would have ginseng, and decided the direction of pressing the mountain.
When pressing down on the mountain, all members must "arrange sticks". The head is the head stick, the middle one is the waist stick, and the outermost one is called the side stick.
Fangshan people hold cable sticks in their hands, and arrange them horizontally according to the order of rowing sticks. Generally, the distance between two people is more than ten feet, so that the cable sticks can touch each other.
All the people walked forward in a horizontal line, not letting go of the distance of a brick, pulling the grass and walking slowly, looking for ginseng. This is called "rather fall a mountain than a brick."
Xu Shiyan walked in the front, pushed the grass away with a rope stick, and stared at the front with all his attention.
No matter what, since you are on the mountain, you have to be serious. This is no joke.
Xu Shiyan has a serious face and is very serious, but others may not be sure, they are just here for luck, how can they have much patience? After a while, he didn't know where to look.
"Hey, mushroom." Someone suddenly said.
The mountain forest was silent, and there was a sudden movement, which shocked everyone.
"Who yelled just now? Didn't I say that you are not allowed to speak when you enter the mountain." Xu Shiyan got angry and turned his head to question.
"I, I saw a bunch of mushrooms just now, so I yelled." Someone on the other end replied weakly.
"Did you go into the mountains to pick up mushrooms? Or did you go to the mountains to find sticks?
Go, pick up all those mushrooms, even if there is one less. "
Xu Shiyan glared at Wang Daqiang who was speaking angrily. What are these things?
Didn't you listen to what he said last night?
You can’t talk indiscriminately in the mountains. The terrain in the mountains is complex and there are many animals. Talking and shouting will lead to distraction and you will not be able to see ginseng.
Xu Shiyan said all these things last night, who knows that this is just the beginning, and some people make mistakes.
If you make a mistake, you have to be punished. No matter what you shout, you have to hold it, even if it is a snake.
Wang Daqiang glanced at Chen Deyong, meaning to let Chen Deyong make up his mind.
What can Chen Deyong say? "You can do whatever you want with your head. Who told you not to listen to what your head has to say?"
They haven't found the club yet, so they can't offend Xu Shiyan.
So, Wang Daqiang stepped forward aggrievedly, and picked up the piece of mushroom in front of him.
Two hands were not enough, so I used my clothes to pocket them, and then followed the crowd to continue walking.
Walking forward for a while, I suddenly heard someone shouting, "Balm."

chapters.title: Chapter 38: bitten by a snake
chapters.content:
Chapter 38 Bitten by a snake
Xu Shiyan was really surprised to hear someone yelling a stick. He opened his eyes after entering the mountain for less than half a day?
So he hurriedly walked towards the man calling Shan, asking questions as he walked. "How many leaves?"
The other side hesitated and couldn't speak.
Xu Shiyan wondered, walked over quickly, and looked in the direction where the stick was pointed, almost twisting his nose in anger.
Where is the mallet, it is a small soursop.
Ginseng and Acanthopanax both belong to the Araliaceae family, and Acanthopanax is also known as a mallet.
Both are also five palmate compound leaves, but Acanthopanax leaves grow on thorny stems.
The seeds of Acanthopanax are purple-black, while the seeds of ginseng are red, which can be easily distinguished by experienced people.
"Grass, are your eyes covered with cow dung? You can't see clearly and you can't help shouting.
This is Zhaishan, do you understand? Deceiving the mountain will offend the mountain god. "Xu Shiyan raised his leg angrily and kicked the man who called Shan.
"Now there are two choices, let's go down the mountain and go home immediately, or you will kneel on the ground and kowtow to the mountain **** to make amends, you choose."
Xu Shiyan was so tired that he brought a bunch of trash into the mountains, so he was speechless.
The one who called Zheshan was called Dong Chengan, who was two years younger than Xu Shiyan, and had never let the mountain go before.
Just now, when I saw something that looked like a mallet, I shouted out of excitement.
It turned out that Xu Shiyan kicked him instead of a mallet, and he felt aggrieved at the moment.
"I kowtow to apologize, I apologize."
They just came to the mountain, if they go straight down the mountain, the big guy will hate him to death? Or kowtow to apologize.
So, Dong Cheng'an knelt in front of a big pine tree, kowtowed three times, and kept chanting, apologizing to the mountain god.
After kowtowing, everyone continued to move forward. This time, no one dared to talk nonsense anymore, and just walked in the woods with their heads depressed.
The further you go, the denser the forest, the taller the grass, the denser the forest and the deeper the grass, you can't see each other a few steps away, and shouting is not allowed.
At this time, the only way to contact is to hit the trunk with a cable stick, which is also called "calling stick."
Once you can’t see others, you tap on the tree trunk, and each of the others responds by tapping one at a time, not only signaling their own position, but also signaling to continue pressing down on the mountain.
It's been a long time since I walked out, and everyone is exhausted.
Xu Shiyan tapped twice on the tree trunk with a rope stick, which meant that everyone should come closer to him, and they could smoke and rest.
"Hold your head, do you want to take a puff." You can talk during the break, Chen Deyong leaned in front of Xu Shiyan, and handed over the cigarette pouch.
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, he has no addiction to cigarettes, just sit down and rest for a while.
Seeing that Xu Shiyan didn't want to smoke, Chen Deyong shook his head, turned around and found a tree stump to sit down on.
Before Chen Deyong could sit down, Xu Shiyan kicked him over when he stood up.
"I think we should break up, this stick can't dig." Xu Shiyan said angrily.
"Did I say that, that tree stump is the dining table of the mountain god? You are disrespecting the mountain **** if you sit on the tree stump."
"You can't remember what I said, either you shouted or cheated, and now you are sitting on a tree stump.
You broke the rules and offended the God of the Mountain, and you still want to dig a stick? "
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, turned his head and walked away. Leading such a group of people, it's good that nothing happens. Don't expect to see the stick.
Chen Deyong was stunned by Xu Shiyan's kick, and fell to the ground without reacting.
"Third brother, don't be angry, you see, Brother De Yong didn't do it on purpose.
He just wanted to find a place to sit down, and accidentally sat there. "Everyone had to help Chen Deyong with a few good words.
"Look, we guys have never let go of the mountains before, and it is really uncomfortable to go into the mountains on the first day.
We finally came to the mountain, we can’t just break up if we say we’re breaking up. ’ Others chimed in.
Xu Shiyan was persuaded by the crowd, somewhat calmed down, and sighed, "I shouldn't have agreed to take you into the mountains, a group of beginners who don't understand anything."
If it wasn't for Zhao Dahai's face, he wouldn't want to go into the mountains at all.
"Let's go back to the ground, that's all for today, if we continue, there may be some trouble."
There is no way to continue today, so I can only try again tomorrow.
Have been out for a long time, but there is nothing to gain. Everyone is a little bit unwilling, but there is nothing they can do. Who told them to make a mistake?
So, one by one, their heads bowed and their horns drooped, they followed behind Xu Shiyan and returned to the station.
Everyone rested for one afternoon and one night, changed direction the next day, and continued pressing the mountain.
It may be the reason for Xu Shiyan's anger yesterday, but this time everyone seems to be more disciplined.
Going into the mountains, I didn’t dare to talk nonsense anymore. I lowered my head and pulled the grass, hoping to find a big one.
After walking for half an afternoon and still not seeing anything, those people were unavoidably discouraged, and gradually some people began to lose their minds.
Chen Deyong drank an extra bowl of porridge in the morning, and he didn't rest after entering the mountain for so long, he held back his urine.
During the process of releasing the mountain, he was not allowed to **** or pee, but Chen Deyong couldn't bear it, so he didn't dare to say anything, for fear of offending Xu Shiyan.
