It happened that he was a side stick, so he took advantage of the time when everyone else was looking down for a stick, and walked away quietly, intending to find a place to relieve himself.
It happened that there was a tall and thick tree stump over there, so Chen Deyong hid behind the stump.
"Going into the mountains is so easy to do. You won't let this or that. You have a lot of things to do. You wait until you go back."
Chen Deyong muttered as he unbuttoned his pants.
"Don't let me sit on the tree stump, why am I peeing on the tree stump, what's the matter? You come to cure me?"
Chen Deyong closed his eyes, hummed a little song, and started to discharge the flood.
Just as Chen Deyong was about to finish urinating, a black shadow jumped up from the root of the tree stump.
Then, a scream was heard, resounding through the woods.
Not to mention Xu Shiyan and others, even the birds in the forest were startled a little better.
"Who? Crying and screaming? Do you want to die?" Xu Shiyan was so angry that he almost regretted bringing these people into the mountains, and no one was relieved.
"Snake, snake." I heard someone shouting loudly over there, the voice was full of pain and panic.
"I've said it several times, you can't call it a snake, it's money."
Xu Shiyan became even angrier when he heard the words, and walked in the direction of the sound, while admonishing others.
"Help, I was bitten by a snake." Chen Deyong was in so much pain that he said intermittently.
Xu Shiyan also heard that something was wrong, and hurriedly ran towards the big tree stump, glared at him and ran over to see that Chen Deyong fell to the ground, his trousers hadn't been pulled up yet.
"Where is the snake? Where did it bite you?" Xu Shiyan didn't look carefully and didn't see the snake, so he asked hurriedly.
"Third Brother, help, a black weed has bitten my place."
Lying on the ground, Chen Deyong felt his hands and feet were cold and he couldn't move. Is he dying?
Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief when he heard that it was a black grass snake.
Black Grass Snake is a name of the local people, also called Wuchong, a relatively large snake.
It is not very toxic. After being bitten by a black grass snake, the swelling will disappear within two days.
Just bite that place, ahem, I don't know if there will be trouble in the future.
Alas, you guys are too impatient. I haven't finished digging this hole yet, and each one of you is getting impatient.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: go down early
chapters.content:
Chapter 39 Going down the mountain ahead of time
"Both of you, go and help him up, pull up his pants, carry him back to the ground, pack up and go down the mountain."
Regardless of whether the black grass snake is poisonous or not, if you are bitten by a snake, you don't dare to be careless, so you should send it home and forget it.
There is a barefoot doctor in the village, at least I can show you.
"Huh? Going down the mountain? Brother Xu, let's stop digging the stick?"
At this moment, other people also came together, and when they heard that they were going home, everyone was very disappointed.
"I haven't opened my eyes yet, how can I go home?
It’s not too far from the site of our brigade. If we can’t send De Yong to Lao Li, let’s stay in the mountains and continue to release the mountain. "
Someone was not happy to just go down the mountain empty-handed to give Xu Shiyan an idea.
"Open your eyes? What are you thinking about?" Xu Shiyan looked around among those people and sneered.
"What are you all thinking about behind your back, you think I don't know?
I’m just looking at Uncle Zhao’s face, so I’m just ashamed to expose it. Do you really think I’m stupid? "
"When you enter the mountain, you have to abide by the rules of the mountain. If you don't follow the rules, you will offend the old mountain god, and some people will have bad intentions.
If something goes wrong, find a solution by yourself, and it has nothing to do with me. "Xu Shiyan shook his hand and rushed away angrily.
During the process of releasing the mountain, if someone is injured by wild animals, it means that someone in the gang has evil intentions. This is the experience and lessons that have been passed down for many years.
These people didn't have good intentions at first, but they didn't expect that something really happened.
At this moment, Xu Shiyan pointed it out in person, and everyone showed embarrassment.
"Let's go, go down the mountain." With their heads gone, what can they do in the mountains?
Dong Chengan beckoned and signaled another person to come forward, and they helped Chen Deyong up.
"Brother Deyong, we will carry you back to the village and find Wang Jiagui to treat your injuries."
As he spoke, he was about to recite Chen Deyong, but he heard Chen Deyong scream.
Although the black grass snake is not poisonous, the wound will swell quickly after being bitten.
Chen Deyong's injured position was too embarrassing. This back not only pulled the wound, but also squeezed it. Naturally, the pain was unbearable.
Dong Cheng'an and the others saw it, well, this is still impossible to memorize.
"Forget it, go chop two pieces of wood, let's take off the leggings, wrap a stretcher, and carry him back."
The woods are overgrown with weeds, and there are many kinds of bugs. In order to prevent bugs from getting in through the trouser legs and biting people, they wear leggings when they go into the mountains.
So, someone took an ax to chop two logs, and others untied their leggings and temporarily tied a stretcher, put Chen Deyong on it, and carried it outside.
On the other side, Xu Shiyan returned to the shack, packed up his belongings, and left with his backpack on his back, ignoring the people behind him.
When Xu Shiyan returned to the village, it happened to be noon, and every family was eating lunch at home. There was no one outside, and no one bothered him.
Xu Shiyan didn't go home directly, but went to the secretary Zhao Dahai's house first.
The Zhao family was eating, and they were all surprised when they saw Xu Shiyan come in.
"San'er, you guys went down the mountain so quickly? Why did you meet a big guy?
Hurry up, sit down quickly, have you eaten yet? Mother of the baby, quickly bring the bowls and chopsticks and let San'er have a bite at our house. "
"Uncle, don't make aunt busy, I just came to talk to you." Xu Shiyan waved his hands hurriedly.
"That group of people didn't go to release the mountain seriously at all. When they got to the mountain, they caused troubles, yelling, cheating on the mountain, sitting at the mountain god's dining table, and urinating on tree stumps."
Xu Shiyan came here to sue, he had to tell Zhao Dahai what happened in the mountains first.
In case those members of the Chen family come to make trouble later, Zhao Dahai doesn't know anything, so it's hard to deal with it.
"What? These bastards, how dare they?"
The rules of releasing the mountains have been passed down for hundreds of years, and people living in the mountains strictly abide by them.
So when Zhao Dahai heard these words, he immediately became angry.
"Where are those bastards? Where are they? I have to beat them." Zhao Dahai was very angry.
Zhao Dahai gave Xu Shiyan the face to beg, and asked Xu Shiyan to take them into the mountain, but those **** didn't do anything good. Isn't this a slap in the face?
"Uncle, Chen Deyong **** on the tree stump and was bitten by the black grass. They are behind. I am angry that I came back first."
Actually, as soon as he saw those people the morning before yesterday, Xu Shiyan knew that the release of the mountain would definitely fail.
Those idlers, hiding traitors and playing tricks, if they can follow Fangshan safely, they will be out of ghosts.
Xu Shiyan waited for them to make a mistake, so he took advantage of the problem to break up and go down the mountain, so as to give Zhao Dahai an explanation.
After all, they are still living in a big house right now, so they have to give Zhao Dahai face.
But he really didn't expect that Chen Deyong would be so unlucky that he would be bitten by a snake when he urinated.
"Where did you bite?" Zhao Dahai's daughter-in-law asked curiously.
Zhao Dahai coughed, his face full of embarrassment, "Where else could it be? Just ask nonsense."
The man was bitten while peeing, so do you still need to ask?
The two sons of the Zhao family next to them couldn't hold back, and all burst into laughter.
The two of them were afraid of being scolded, so they quickly lowered their heads and took two mouthfuls of food, but they couldn't help it, they lowered their heads and sniggered, almost choking on the food.
Zhao Dahai glared at the two sons, "What are you laughing at? Eat your food well."
After speaking, he didn't hold back himself, and coughed again in a hurry, trying to suppress his smile anyway.
"Fortunately, it's black grass. If it's another snake, Chen Deyong will have to explain it to the mountain."
After stabilizing his expression, Zhao Dahai said with emotion.
"Okay, I know about this, San'er, you've been **** off these days, I'm waiting for the autumn harvest, uncle treats you to drink." Zhao Dahai's attitude towards Xu Shiyan was very polite.
I don't blame Xu Shiyan for this matter, it was Chen Deyong who committed suicide. Who has heard of going into the mountains to pee on tree stumps?
"Uncle, I came here just to tell you, and I'll go home if I have nothing to do."
The Zhao family was eating, and Xu Shiyan didn't want to stay for a long time. After explaining things, he got up to leave.
Zhao Dahai stayed for a few words symbolically, and then sent his sons Zhao Jianguo and Zhao Jianshe off to see him off.
Xu Shiyan left Zhao's house and returned all the way to Li's house at the west end of the village.
When I entered the door, I saw Su Anying serving rice out of the pot. "Oh, why did you come back today? Didn't you say that it would take four or five days at least?"
Xu Shiyan left the day before yesterday and came back today. The speed was too fast, Su Anying couldn't help being surprised.
"Have you had your lunch yet? Come on in and sit down, I'll shake some pancakes quickly."
Seeing her husband come back, Su Anying was very happy, and hurriedly called Xu Shiyan into the house to rest.
On her side, she deftly removed a stack of pancakes from the tank, dipped a brush in water and dusted the pancakes. I went to pull out two green onions and scooped up a plate of sauce.
Everything was packed, brought to the west room and placed on the kang table. "I didn't expect you to come back so early, let's eat a few pancakes."
Xu Shiyan looked at the table, and besides pancakes and scallions, there was only a small pot of porridge and a plate of pickles.
"You eat this at home? Didn't we buy some canned food? That's for you to eat.
You are pregnant with a child, you must eat well. "When Xu Shiyan saw the food, he was not happy.
"You are not at home, and I am not in the mood to do it by myself.
The canned food can be stored for a long time. In case of guests at home, it can be used as a dish. "
Su Anying smiled gently, reached out to pick up the scallions, dipped them in the sauce, rolled them into pancakes, and handed them to Xu Shiyan.
There are many rules for releasing mountains, and there is no way to write them all due to space limitations. If the results of this book are not bad, maybe I will write about the Kanto ginseng king in the next book, and write about the ginseng culture of Changbai Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 40: trouble again
chapters.content:
Chapter 40 Trouble Comes Again
Su Anying's thoughts represent most people in this era.
You can’t just eat something delicious, but keep it for guests.
Who will be laughed at if they eat and drink when they are rich.
Su Anying is a living person, and she hid all the canned meat that Xu Shiyan bought.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, and didn't blame anything. Some ideas cannot be changed in a short while.
In the future, he should pay more attention and get more delicious food to replenish Su Anying's body.
After the couple chatted and laughed, Xu Shiyan tidied up, changed his clothes, and then went to the river to hang the net.
It’s been a long time since the last time I released the mountain to catch fish.
Fortunately, I had greeted Team Leader Guo in advance, otherwise, if I didn’t send fish for so long, I’m afraid the business would never be done again.
When Xu Shiyan got down and hung up the net and returned to the village, Chen Deyong and others also returned to the village.
The story of Chen Deyong being bitten by a snake in Fangshan Mountain has been spread all over the village, and the aunts and aunts gathered together to discuss it, laughing while talking.
Seeing Xu Shiyan, many people came here to inquire.
Xu Shiyan didn't have the habit of talking about people behind his back. When others asked him, he just shook his head and didn't say anything. Those people thought it was boring, so they stopped bothering him.
Xu Shiyan walked all the way west, and met many people on the road, all talking about Chen Deyong.
Anyway, there are all kinds of things to say, and some people say that Chen Deyong's daughter-in-law may become a widow in the future.
Xu Shiyan had no sympathy for this.
What does it mean to be self-inflicted and unable to live? It refers to people like Chen Deyong.
Seeing that money is open-eyed and has evil intentions, in the end, it only ends up harming others instead of harming oneself, which deserves to be bad luck.
"Third brother, go home quickly, the old Chen family has brought Chen Deyong to your door, and they are making trouble there."
Walking forward, my sister Xu Shiqin ran past me. The girl came to me panting, and said out of breath.
"What? They dare to come to the house to make trouble?"
Xu Shiyan was on fire at that time, the Chen family was going to die, and they dared to go to his house to make trouble?
"They said that you brought Chen Deyong up the mountain. Now that Chen Deyong is injured, you have to pay them for medical expenses and lost work."
Xu Shiqin finally took a breath, and told Xu Shiyan what happened.
Chen Deyong was carried back to the village by Dong Chengan and others, and went straight to the barefoot doctor Wang Jiagui.
After Wang Jiagui inspected it, he said that the snake was not poisonous, and that Chen Deyong's life should not be in danger.
But the location of the injury is not very good, and it is already swollen very badly, which may delay urination, so the Chen family was sent to the hospital for treatment.
When the Chen family heard this, they thought that Chen Deyong might be doing badly.
This family is also weird, instead of rushing the person to the hospital, they carried the person to Xu Shiyan, trying to extort a sum of money from Xu Shiyan before going to the hospital.
"My father and mother have passed away. My father is arguing with Chen Yongfu. My mother asked me to come find you."
"Okay, you go slowly, I'll go home first." Xu Shiyan nodded, and walked back quickly.
Xu Shiqin's physique is not good, and he can't keep up with his brother, so he can only follow behind slowly.
Before he reached Li's house, he saw a group of people gathered outside the gate from a distance, and there were crying and noisy voices.
Needless to say, this must be the Chen family's trouble.
The spectators saw Xu Shiyan approaching, and hurriedly stepped out of the way to let him pass.
Passing through the crowd, I saw a temporarily tied stretcher outside the gate, and Chen Deyong was lying on the stretcher moaning.
Chen Yongfu and Xu Chenghou were arguing with each other across a stretcher. The Chen family's wife with disheveled hair was sitting on the ground howling while patting her thigh.
"Oh, I can't live anymore. Why is our family Dayong so miserable? Why did he get hurt like this after going up the mountain?"
The mother-in-law of the Chen family draws a long accent, just like singing an opera.
On the other side, Zhou Guilan guarded Su Anying behind her, and stared at the Chen family with a hostile expression, to prevent the Chen family from rushing over and making trouble.
"What are you doing? Howling at our door? Get out, get out of here."
When Xu Shiyan saw this posture, he felt that the Chen family was simply scoundrels.
As soon as Xu Shiyan opened his mouth, all the Chen family members saw it, and surrounded him immediately.
That Mrs. Chen opened her hands and rushed towards Xu Shiyan.
"You conscientious youngest Xu, you killed my son, and I want you to pay for your life."
Xu Shiyan dodged, "Your son didn't obey the rules, he went into the mountains to urinate indiscriminately, and didn't find a good place to urinate on the tree stump.
He killed himself, who is to blame? "
Xu Shiyan knew that it was useless to reason with this kind of people, but he had to speak.
Not to the Chen family, but to the people watching the excitement around.
"Before entering the mountain, I told you to obey the rules and don't offend the mountain god.
But what about Chen Deyong? I sat down on the table of the mountain god, and I said a few words to him, but he was still not happy. The next day he **** on the stump. "
"Aunts, aunts, uncles and uncles, you have lived in the mountains all your life, who has ever heard of someone urinating under a tree stump?
Even if he is a doll, he knows that there are many poisonous snakes and insects in the woods, so he has to find a clean place to pee, right? "
"The snake didn't belong to my family, and I didn't let it bite me. I've already told you what to do. What does it have to do with me?"
Xu Shiyan said while staring at Chen Deyong who was on the stretcher.
"Chen Deyong, tell yourself, what I just said is true? Have I told you everything that should be done?" Xu Shiyan asked sharply.
Chen Deyong didn't dare to answer, so he could only avoid Xu Shiyan's gaze, and lay on the stretcher humming.
"Chen Yongfu, did you hear that? Your son did it all by himself, and it has nothing to do with anyone else.
Hurry up and get the master out, don't be an eyesore at our door, otherwise, I'll give you **** today. "
Xu Chenghou rolled up his sleeves, glared at Chen Yongfu angrily.
Just now I heard someone report that Chen Deyong was bitten by a snake when he went up the mountain, and now the Chen family is making trouble in front of Xu Shiyan's house.
Xu Chenghou didn't know the inside story, he thought it was his son who brought people up the mountain, and he ran into danger because he didn't make arrangements, so he hurried over.
Now, after hearing what his son said, Xu Chenghou understood that the co-author was committed by Chen Deyong himself, and had nothing to do with anyone else.
Now Xu Chenghou has come to his senses, chasing Chen Yongfu's nose and cursing.
"Don't think that other people don't know what your family is thinking? Isn't it just jealous to see my son getting rich?
First blackmailed the blind man, but the black blind man couldn't go away, and then urged him to enter the mountain.
Are you going into the mountains to dig sticks? That is to borrow my son's fortune. "
"Don't look at your little bit of care and think that others don't know, aren't you just trying to blackmail people by taking advantage of your injuries?
I'll tell you Chen Yongfu, you carried him away without any hesitation, and we didn't say anything.
Otherwise, what the **** am I going to do to crush your son's yolk, and let you blackmail him? "

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Zhao Dahai gets angry
chapters.content:
Chapter 41 Zhao Dahai Gets Angry
If you want to talk about the big truth, Xu Chenghou can't say a few.
But if it’s a joke, if Xu Chenghou says he’s second, no one in the village would dare to say he’s number one.
Back then, Xu Chenghou used to drink a lot of wine and make a lot of money. He almost went up the mountain and became a bearded master.
Seeing Xu Chenghou raised his foot to kick Chen Deyong.
If this kick really made him kick hard, I don’t know if the yolk will come out, but if the guy is swollen like that, if he is hit again, he will definitely not be able to use it in the future.
Xu Shiyan was so frightened that he hurried forward to stop his father, "Dad, if you have something to say, don't do anything."
Are you kidding me? With this kick, the old man will have a place to eat for the rest of his life.
Originally it was their business, but don't let the old man get involved in the end.
"It's okay, just let them make trouble, and I'll go to the commune to find a public security assistant.
They made it clear that they were blackmailing. I don't believe it, but I can't find a reason? "
Xu Shiyan turned cold and said in a deep voice. If you want to go to him to blackmail people, there is no way.
"Chen Deyong, just lie there and pretend to be dead, it doesn't matter, we can afford it.
You just wait for the public security assistant to handle it. "Xu Shiyan glanced at Chen Deyong and snorted.
Chen Deyong, who was lying on the stretcher, was already in a cold sweat.
One is that he did not expect the old man of the Xu family to dare to attack, and the other is that he was frightened by Xu Shiyan's words.
Chen Yongfu was also frightened, "The youngest of the Xu family, how dare you?"
"Do you think I dare? Last time, you guys made a fuss about the black blind man. For the sake of my fellow villagers, I don't hesitate to be as knowledgeable as you."
"You guys think I'm a bully, come again today? Okay, then let's find a place where we can reason and talk about it."
There is no need to be polite to those who push forward. Xu Shiyan has a tough attitude and insists on pursuing it to the end.
"Yes, that's what you should do, San'er, I'll watch them for you, you go to the commune."
Xu Chenghou realized at this time that his third son didn't seem so useless.
"Chen Yongfu, can't you blackmail people? Okay, this time I will let you blackmail people inside the fence." Xu Chenghou stared at Chen Yongfu and said viciously.
Chen Yongfu is now in a dilemma. They brought Chen Deyong here to bully Xu Shiyan to be honest, and wanted to blackmail Xu Shiyan a hundred and eighty dollars.
But I didn't expect that Xu Chenghou, an old bastard, would be so ruthless.
And Xu Shiyan, who had been sluggish in Baden on weekdays, was even more ruthless than his father. His father used force, and he sent texts, and he wanted to report the case.
If the public security assistant is really called in, the Chen family and his son are probably going to enter the fence.
I also blame the Xu family for being too kind on weekdays, never arguing with others.
After coming to the big house for these years, no matter what, they always give in, which makes others have the illusion that the Xu family is easy to bully.
In fact, the Xu family was just cautious because they were suppressed too hard in the past few years, and they didn't want to cause trouble again.
But if someone doesn't have eyes and has to find fault, the Xu family is not easy to mess with.
Chen Yongfu was dumbfounded, he didn't know what to do, he was really unwilling to just carry his son away like this.
But if he continues to entangle, he is really afraid that Xu Shiyan will go to the commune.
Just when Chen Yongfu was in a dilemma, Zhao Dahai hurried over with other cadres of the brigade.
In the afternoon, the relevant cadres of the brigade held the autumn harvest deployment work meeting at the team headquarters. Someone just saw that the situation was not good and ran to inform them.
"Chen Yongfu, what are you doing here? Your family, Chen Deyong, did this by himself. What does it have to do with others?"
When Zhao Dahai saw the situation in front of him, he almost turned his nose in anger.
At noon, Xu Shiyan told him about the incident on the mountain, and Zhao Dahai paid attention to it. When Chen Deyong was carried into the village, Zhao Dahai went over to take a look.
The injury is not serious, and the snake is not poisonous, it just needs to be raised for a few days.
Zhao Dahai specifically asked the Chen family to take good care of Chen Deyong before going to the team headquarters for a meeting.
Who would have imagined it, as soon as he left, something happened in the Chen family, and he even carried him to Xu Shiyan's place, blocking the door of his house and crying, making it clear that he was blackmailing him.
"Before I entered the mountain, I told you all that you must obey Xu Jiasan'er in everything, and you are not allowed to cause trouble when you enter the mountain.
Didn’t all of you pat your chests and promise it? As a result, things changed when we got to the mountain, and we couldn't get rid of you all. "
The more Zhao Dahai talked, the more angry he became. He was so entangled by these people that he couldn't do anything, so he put on his old face and begged Xu Shiyan.
The results of it? None of these **** obeyed the rules, and they refused to accept the control of the heaven when they entered the mountain.
Break the rules of ginseng collection, offend the old mountain god, and dare to blackmail people after being bitten by a snake? It's just lawless.
Zhao Dahai's face was slapped, can he not be angry?
"I tell you, if you can stay in the Dongjiangyan Brigade, you can honestly lift them away, otherwise, you can move them away.
A few stinky fish made a pot of soup. The atmosphere of our brigade is for you to mess up. "
Zhao Dahai's face darkened, and he directly issued an ultimatum.
The brigade secretary was so serious that he even said the words of driving out the Dongjiangyan brigade. Chen Yongfu was really dumbfounded and didn't know what to do.
Just at this time, the barefoot doctor from the village also rushed over, seeing the situation, hurried forward to persuade him.
"Old Uncle Chen, didn't you understand what I said?"
"De Yong's injury is nothing serious, but the wound is swollen now, and I'm afraid it will delay his peeing." Wang Jiagui stepped forward to explain with a helpless expression.
"I sent you to the hospital, mainly because the hospital has anti-inflammatory injections. His injury will be healed after two days of anti-inflammatory injections. It doesn't cost much.
What do you think you are going to Xu's house to make trouble for? If you have the time, quickly get in the car and send it to our commune hospital for an injection.
If you delay any more, don't look for me if something goes wrong, I'm not responsible. "
Wang Jiagui is just a barefoot doctor. He can take a look at the usual headaches and fever, and he can do it with some herbs. He really doesn't have anti-inflammatory drugs, so he was sent to the hospital.
Nowadays, it doesn’t cost much to see a doctor. The commune hospital has cooperative medical care, and you can get well soon after a few injections.
So Wang Jiagui couldn't figure out what the Chen family was making a fuss about? Pure blackmail?
"Dr. Xiao Wang, did you hear clearly? Shouldn't you hurry up?" Zhao Dahai spoke again.
"Hurry up, go and inform the barn to set up a car and send Chen Deyong to the commune hospital. Let the brigade pay the money there first."
The secretary had spoken, and a few strong young men came over there immediately, and Chen Deyong was about to leave when he lifted it up.
"Wait a minute, I haven't made it clear about today's matter, why are you going?" Xu Shiyan didn't want to, but stopped him.
"Don't go to the commune hospital, just wait here and wait for the police assistant to come." Isn't it just a joke? Okay, let's see who can beat who today?
Zhao Dahai saw that something was wrong, and he was afraid that today's matter would be difficult, so he hurriedly dragged Xu Shiyan aside.
"San'er, listen to Uncle, don't make a big deal today. Chen Deyong's wife is the niece of the commune secretary."
If it wasn't for this relationship, would Zhao Dahai let the Chen family jump up and down?
Zhao Dahai reminded Xu Shiyan with a word.
Back when Xu Shixian was in Daying, he offended the commune officials from top to bottom.
The Xu family had no choice but to move to a big house. As a result, last year, the deputy secretary of Daying Commune was transferred to Xigang Commune to become the top leader.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: starting ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 42
With Zhao Dahai interceding, Xu Shiyan also feels that it is inappropriate to offend others at the moment.
The Xu family can gain a foothold in the big house, all relying on Zhao Dahai, so they have to give Zhao Dahai face.
"Chen Deyong, you heard clearly, today is for Uncle Zhao's face, I will forgive you this time, hurry up, don't be an eyesore here."
Hearing this, those young men hurriedly carried Chen Deyong into the car, and the Chen family also left in despair.
Chen Deyong was sent to the commune hospital, where he received injections for three consecutive days, the swelling subsided and the wound began to heal.
I don’t know if there are any sequelae, but I dare to walk on the ground anyway.
The Chen family had two fights in a row, and they didn't get any money. Instead, they annoyed everyone, and they became more and more unpopular in the village.
The Chen family and the Xu family also became rivals because of these two incidents.
In the blink of an eye, it's the eighth month of the lunar calendar, and it's time for the crops in the field to be recycled.
The Dongjiangyan Brigade has a total of 700 mu of land, and it is very easy to recycle. The whole village, old and young, worked together, and within a few days they collected all the food.
Taking advantage of the crisp autumn weather, the sun should be dried, and then the beans and corn should be dried.
Spring planting and autumn harvest are always the busiest seasons in the crop yard.
For those who participate in rural areas, there is another more important task in autumn, which is to start making products.
The growth of garden ginseng is regular, from seed to ginseng production, divided into two stages, a total of six years.
In the autumn of the first year, sow the opened ginseng seeds in the ginseng ground.
After three years of growth, it can basically grow into a cigarette to the thickness of a finger, which is called ginseng.
Ginseng seeds are raised from the soil in autumn, and those with good size, good body, and no water rust scars are selected, and they are replanted in good soil, and they will grow for another three years before they can be used as ginseng.
After six years of growth, a ginseng tree can weigh one tael or more, and the largest one can weigh three or four taels.
It is mainly related to the size of the plant, soil fertility, and later management.
Ginseng has very high medicinal value, but there are very few wild ginseng resources. As early as the Ming and Qing Dynasties, garden ginseng had been planted.
The place names of many places in Fusong are related to ginseng, and most of them are large ginseng gardens in the late Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China.
Nowadays, ginseng gardens are owned by the public, and almost all communes and brigades have their own ginseng gardens.
The ginseng land of the Dongjiangyan Brigade is not too much. Even the ginseng seeds are added together, and the ginseng seeds are only more than 2,000 feet in six years.
The so-called zhang is a special term for ginseng. It generally refers to the area of ​​one zhang long and five chi wide. After conversion, it is about five points a few square meters.
Don't underestimate the five square meters of ginseng land. If it is done well, it can produce 16 to 7 catties of water ginseng.
Steamed and sun-dried to make red ginseng, about four catties, based on the current price, it can be sold for three to four hundred yuan.
Three or four hundred in this year, that's a big deal. Otherwise, why are all the communes trying their best to grow ginseng? So worth the money.
Of course, in later generations, with the use of various fertilizers, the output of garden ginseng can reach 20 to 30 catties per foot.
It's just that the price of ginseng is affected by international influences and fluctuates greatly. When the price is low, ginseng farmers will also lose a lot.
As forest resources become more and more scarce, the market for ginseng is rising all the way.
"Starting tomorrow, I will go up the mountain to participate. Next, I will take a roll call. Anyone whose name is called will gather at six o'clock tomorrow morning and go to Qianchuan to participate."
On the afternoon of September 20th, just as everyone was busy harvesting soybeans and putting them in the warehouse, the team leader Yu Shanhai shouted loudly.
Starting ginseng also has solar terms. If it is too early, the pulp of ginseng will not be enough, so the product will not be weighed, and the pulp will not work if it is too late.
Generally speaking, in the days before the autumnal equinox, people go up the mountain to participate.
"Xu Shiyan, Xu Shixiang, Yang Chunming, Zhao Jianguo, Zhao Jianshe..." The captain read a long list.
Picking up ginseng means digging out ginseng from the ground. This job requires not only strength but also patience.
Hands should be steady, frizzy work can easily scratch the ginseng rhizome underneath, destroying its value.
Xu Shiyan is famous for his carefulness and stability. He is the first to be named in the work of planting and planting ginseng every year.
At 6 o'clock in the morning on September 21st, the forty young men who had been named gathered in front of the team department. They took all kinds of starting tools and sacks, drove the carriage, and went straight to Qianchuan Shendi.
Qianchuan Shendi is about ten miles away from the village, and it is near the place where Xu Shiyan led people to release the mountain.
The mountain path was bumpy, and the carriage was not moving fast. After half an hour, I finally arrived at Qianchuan Candi.
At this time, there is no special plastic sheet for ginseng. Most of them are made of broken wood into boards to make ginseng sheds, and then covered with hay or linoleum paper for waterproofing.
So looking from a distance, you can see long black and gray dragons spreading along the mountain.
As soon as everyone arrived outside the garden, they heard the dog barking inside.
Old Li, who guards the garden, walks out of the house in the garden with a gun on his shoulder.
Seeing that it was a member of the team, he stepped forward and opened the door made of branches to let everyone in.
"Uncle Li, this is what my aunt asked me to bring to you. Cotton clothes and trousers, a change of clothes, as well as pancakes, sauce, pickles, and small fried fish."
When Xu Shiyan saw Old Li, he quickly handed over the rucksack on his back, which was the things that Mrs. Li specially packed last night.
"Yo, it's so heavy, my old lady, I don't know how much food she packed for me.
Xiao Xu, thank you, you see that I am on the mountain, and I don’t care about my home. You are the one who takes care of me. "
Old Li took the rucksack and said very politely.
Guan ginseng people go down the mountain only when the land is completely frozen in the twelfth lunar month.
After the new year, not until the fifteenth day of the first lunar month is out, I have to go up the mountain again, and I am away from home all year round.
It is not an easy job to look at ginseng on this mountain. It is necessary to prevent people from stealing it, and also to prevent wild animals from harming it.
Old Litou was a well-known gunner when he was young.
Later, when I got older, my physical strength became weak, so I couldn't go hunting in the mountains.
It happened that the team got ginseng land, so they sent him to see ginseng. He earned a lot of work points, but he couldn't go home and couldn't take care of his family.
Old Litou knew that Xu Shiyan had a good heart and took care of old Mrs. Li, so he was extra polite when meeting Xu Shiyan.
"Look at what the uncle said, I'm living in your house now.
My aunt doesn’t want my rent, and I can eat whatever I want from the vegetable garden. I should be the one thanking you. "Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard this.
"That's right, then we don't need to be polite to each other."
Old Li Tou is a very hearty person, and immediately patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and laughed.
"Would you like to go into the house to drink water? I just boiled a pot of water, and I happen to have the Baomazi picked in spring. Let me make a pot for you."
The Baomazi mentioned by Old Li, the scientific name should be Baodingxiang, which is a kind of plant in the mountains.
There are no tea trees in the Northeast, and poor people can’t afford tea, so in spring, they pick up some leaves and flowers that are fragrant with martin, and dry them for tea.
This stuff nourishes the stomach, and the flowers of the martin are very fragrant, making tea very delicious.
"No, no, I'm starting to participate today. There's a lot of work in the field. Let's get busy first."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, followed the crowd, and walked towards the ginseng land where the goods were shipped this year.

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Production increase coup
chapters.content:
Chapter 43 Coups to increase production
"Divided into two teams, the front ones evacuate the sheds by strings, and the ones in the back cut the ginseng leaves with a sickle, and then started to ginseng."
Xu Shixiang is the captain of the sideline job, so of course he was the leader of the work, and when he arrived at Shendichi Chuaner, he arranged how to do today's work.
Chi Chuaner is also a special term for ginseng, which means a large soil ridge five or six feet wide.
Due to the shape of the mountain, the terrain, and the direction of the pool, the length of the pool is variable. Forty or fifty feet more, twenty or thirty feet less.
The surface of the ridge is called Chimianzi, and the ditch between two ridges is called Madao.
The surface of the pool should be more than one foot higher than the horse track to facilitate drainage.
Ginseng likes light but is afraid of light, loves water but is afraid of water, so every ridge must be covered with a ginseng shed.
Block most of the sun and rain to ensure the growth of ginseng and not rot.
The current ginseng sheds are all single-sided slopes, the length is slightly wider than the pool surface, and the rainwater flows into the horse trail along the ginseng sheds.
Further back, when the special plastic film for ginseng ground comes out, the ginseng shed will evolve into an arched shape, with water flowing on both sides, which is more convenient.
To start ginseng, the ginseng shed must first be removed. The ginseng shed is nailed up with wooden boards, and the boards can be reused, so naturally they cannot be damaged at will.
In the past, if someone was poor and had no living materials after death, a coffin would be nailed with a mallet and board.
The mallet board refers to the wooden board covered with ginseng.
The big guys all came with tools, so a few people came forward with tools such as hammers and pliers.
Remove the grass or linoleum on it first, then lift up the boards and stack them to the side.
In the back, someone took a sickle, cut off the ginseng stems about ten centimeters from the ground, and gathered them together from the beginning to the end.
After cutting the ginseng leaves, replace the sickle with a trident, and start digging the soil according to the remaining stalk traces.
When planting ginseng, trenches are dug and planted according to a certain row spacing, so to grow ginseng, only need to place three teeth according to the distance of each row, so as not to damage the ginseng in the ground.
Three-toothed, unlike a rake, has only three fingers thick teeth, the teeth are about eight inches long, each tooth is two or three inches apart, and the bottom end is pointed.
Three teeth dig into the ground, and then lift up, even the ginseng and soil, a whole lump was dug up.
Then kicked and shook lightly with his feet, most of the soil was shaken off, and then moved back and put it behind him.
Follow the ginseng pickers to pick up the ginseng in the soil, shake off the remaining soil, and put it into a sack.
This job is easy to say, but it is actually very tiring.
Three teeth are not light, swung his head, shoulders are sore and painful.
In addition, the person holding the three-tooth must be precise every time, so as not to hurt the ginseng in the soil, so the energy must be concentrated, and it will be very tired after a long time.
As for those who picked up ginseng, it was not easy. They had to kneel in the ground and sort out the ginseng from the soil bit by bit.
One planed and the other picked up, and the two made a frame.
Ginseng is a delicate job, and it should not be too rough, so it is not fast.
A pair of racks can be up to ten feet a day, and any faster will easily scratch the ginseng, or drop the ginseng and bury it in the soil.
Xu Shiyan has been growing ginseng all his life, so he is very familiar with it.
With the three-toothed tool in his hands, he is absolutely handy. Every time he digs out two or three ginseng trees, it will not hurt the ginseng at all.
It was Zhao Jianshe, the second son of the Zhao family, who was picking up ginseng.
The two cooperated very well, digging out all the ginseng in the soil and picking it up, not a single ginseng was left behind.
"Third brother, this year's mallet is very good, how big do you think it is? I think the one just now can be worth three taels."
Zhao Jianshe looked at the chubby ginseng in his hand and was very happy.
"Well, this year's production should be pretty good.
Actually, the staff in our team is still not good enough to handle the club. If we handle it well, it’s like playing with a stick. "
Xu Shiyan swung his three teeth, chatting with Zhao Jianshe while working.
"Huh? Twenty-five or six pounds? Can't you?
Last year, our team’s production of ginseng land was pretty good, and at the end of the calculation, it was only seventeen catties per foot.
More than 20 catties, so why not all of them go up in twos or threes? "
Zhao Jianshe is young and has never heard that a foot of ginseng can grow more than 20 catties, so his eyes widened.
Xu Shiyan smiled, "Did you know that sticks can actually be used for fat?
Use bean cakes to fertilize in summer, and use it as base fertilizer when planting mallets in autumn. "Xu Shiyan remembered his experience of growing ginseng in his previous life.
"Use base fertilizer when planting sticks. You don't need top-dressing in the year of new planting. In the summer of freezing, you can use bean cake water to top it up again.
In the third year of making goods, one foot can increase production by at least six or seven catties. "
Ginseng is planted in late autumn every year. The next year is called new planting, the second year is called freezing, and the third year is called making goods.
Ginseng does not like common manure. If pig manure and chicken manure or other fertilizers are applied to the ginseng field, it will be directly burned to death.
The only fertilizers that can be applied to ginseng fields are bean cakes and deer dung. It is difficult to get a lot of deer dung, and there may be a way to do it with bean cakes.
Crush the bean cake and ferment it with water. Whether it is fermented bean cake powder or bean cake water, it can be used to fertilize ginseng, which can increase production and income.
Zhao Jianshe was dumbfounded. He had never heard that ginseng could be fertilized before. They were all planted in the ground and let it grow by itself.
"Third brother, is it true or not? Then if our team also top-dresses the sticks, wouldn't the production be higher?"
"You think it's beautiful, right? Where can we get so many bean cakes?" Xu Shiyan shook his head.
Nowadays, most people still can’t get enough to eat. Those soybeans in the team don’t know if they are enough to turn in the task. How can there be bean cakes to top up?
Zhao Jianshe heard the words, his face was full of frustration, "Then isn't this just for nothing?"
I thought there was a way to increase the production of sticks, but it was useless to make trouble for a long time.
"There is also a way, the key is that your dad doesn't know whether to listen or not." Xu Shiyan smiled and dug out a few ginseng plants, and gave them back.
"Have you seen the ginseng land that has been planted this year? It's five hundred feet long, so it's about ten acres, right?
In the spring of next year, all soybeans will be planted. This land does not belong to cultivated land and belongs to our village. At that time, can't bean cakes be used for top dressing? "
As long as you are willing to use your brain to think, there will always be a way, it depends on whether Zhao Dahai dares or not.
Ginseng grows under harsh conditions, so it must be planted in old forest land, and the soil must be turned over after felling trees. It can be said that the forest is very destructive.
However, for economic development, ginseng has to be planted, so the current method is to cut down the forest to plant ginseng, and then return the ginseng to the forest.
The land where ginseng has been planted is running out of soil. In the second year after ginseng is planted, saplings will be planted in the ground. After many years, it will grow into a forest.
The newly planted saplings are very small and do not actually affect the growth of the farmer. You can make a fuss about it.
In Xu Shiyan's last life, he did this in many places.
The ginseng soil after ginseng is contracted out, and a crop of soybeans or potatoes is planted.
The soil where ginseng has been planted has greatly reduced its fertility, and other crops are not good, but soybeans or potatoes grow very well.
Especially potatoes, which are much larger than those in the vegetable garden, and the yield is particularly high.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: harvest joy
chapters.content:
Chapter 44 The Joy of Harvest
Zhao Jianshe was dumbfounded when he heard that, "Third brother, you are all the same person, why do you think you have such a brain? Why is it so easy to use?"
"I'll tell my father later, this method is absolutely feasible."
After the team starts participating every year, the saplings are planted on the exhausted soil, and they are ignored. What a waste.
If this can be used, even if it is only one year, ten acres of land can produce a thousand to eight hundred catties of soybeans, at least it is enough for top dressing.
It doesn’t take much to catch up with the fat. If you increase the production by three or four catties of fresh ginseng, that’s tens of dollars, which is suitable for any calculation.
The more Zhao Jianshe thought about it, the more he felt that it was feasible, but he was so excited that he kept praising Xu Shiyan for being smart.
Xu Shiyan just smiled, but the three-toothed stick in his hand didn't stop, and the two of them planed a ginseng while talking and laughing.
Break at noon, Mr. Li helped to heat everyone's meals, and the big guys ate around the small room of the supervisor, took a rest after eating, and continued to work.
At four o'clock in the afternoon, I packed up the tools, sealed the sack, and then carried it out of the ginseng field, loaded it into a carriage and transported it back to the village.
In the village, Zhao Dahai and his people were waiting at the entrance of the village. When the carriage came back, they immediately went up to meet it.
"How is it? Is this year's mallet long head good?"
What I look forward to most throughout the year is participation, which is related to the income of the entire children's brigade.
No matter how many kinds of corn and soybeans you eat, you can’t exchange them for a few dollars, but ginseng is different, it is simply too valuable.
The annual participation is the top priority in the village.
"It's pretty good, the output is not low, the figure is not bad, it doesn't grow rust, and I don't think it's too bad." Xu Shixiang jumped off the carriage and replied with a smile.
Hearing this, Zhao Dahai and the others cheered up, waved their hands, and signaled the young labor behind him to come over and carry the sack.
"Hurry up, quickly unload the stick and send it to the other side of the warehouse. It's still the old rule, first use the scale, be careful, and keep the accounts."
"Arrange people to patrol the night at the warehouse.
Inform the young daughter-in-law in the village that she will come to work in the house tomorrow. "Zhao Dahai quickly assigned the task.
The so-called goods house is a courtyard next to the village head, which is a small factory for people to participate in.
When ginseng comes back from the ground, it should be cleaned as soon as possible.
Raw sun-dried ginseng is directly dried after scrubbing, or dried in a drying room. Red ginseng should be steamed in a cage, and then dried or dried after steaming.
Ginseng is a precious medicinal material, which is expensive. Except for a small part that remains in major domestic pharmaceutical factories, most of it is exported.
As an important export product, it also implements a unified purchase and sales policy, and the special product bureaus and ginseng companies in counties and cities are responsible for the purchase.
Participants from various communes and brigades will be sent to the county for grading and sale after the ginseng is dried.
After deducting part of the task amount, the rest is owned by the communes and brigades, and has become the most important source of income for the local area.
Due to environmental and population constraints, the Dongjiangyan Brigade has a small ginseng planting area. Even so, it earns more money than many communes and brigades.
That's why Zhao Dahai attaches great importance to the ginseng industry. He didn't follow him to the mountain today, but arranged the next processing at home.
Ginseng is transported to the warehouse, first weighed, then poured out a few sacks, and soaked directly into the big tank.
Things that grow in the soil, no matter how clean they are shaken off, there is still a lot of soil, so they are soaked in advance to make it easier to scrub.
Wait until all the ginseng has been weighed, and the account is recorded. The small courtyard is locked, and the brigade of militiamen are carrying guns and guarding outside the courtyard.
Except for the militiamen patrolling at night, no one is allowed to approach the courtyard.
These have nothing to do with Xu Shiyan. He is only responsible for going up the mountain to participate in the ginseng. When he arrives in the village, someone will take over and go home with the tools.
As soon as she entered the door, she saw Su Anying busy in the kitchen. She was pregnant for two months and still hadn't seen any changes, her figure was still slim and flexible.
Seeing Xu Shiyan enter the door, Su Anying smiled. "The meal will be ready soon, you go wash your hands first, drink some water and rest."
While talking, he picked up the kettle from the stove, poured it into the washbasin, and turned around to scoop up cold water.
Xu Shiyan took two quick steps, and took the ladle from his wife.
"I can do these by myself, I have long hands, and I'm not a baby, how can I let you serve everything?
You are pregnant with a child, try to rest as much as possible. "My daughter-in-law is considerate and capable, and knows how to take care of others, but Xu Shiyan doesn't want her to be too tired.
"Look at what you said, it's just a matter of scooping up a ladle of water, can it still tire me out?" Su Anying smiled and frowned.
"I'm not made of mud and paper, I'm not that delicate.
The old people have said that you need to be more active when you are pregnant, and it is easier to give birth. "
Xu Shiyan poured a ladle of water into the basin, took the water to wash his face, and when he looked up, Su Anying had already handed him a towel.
"That's late pregnancy, move around more, you've just been pregnant, so you still have to be careful."
Xu Shiyan took the towel to dry his face, and told his wife worriedly.
"Usually I'm busy and I'm not at home. Take care of yourself and don't do heavy work. For carrying water and chopping firewood, leave me to come back."
The little daughter-in-law of his family is too capable and strong, Xu Shiyan is really worried.
So every morning he filled the water tank at home with water, chopped a large pile of firewood outside, and reminded him repeatedly before leaving the house.
Su Anying knew that her husband was doing it for her own good, so she didn't argue, she just smiled and opened the lid of the pot.
In the pot is stewed potatoes with beans, and there are pancakes on the side of the pot. Looking at the oily appearance of the beans, you can tell that it is stewed with Heixiazi oil.
The last time I brought back two cans of Heixiazi oil from the mountain, I left one bottle for the Xu family.
Xu Shiyan told his daughter-in-law, don't cherish it, just use it when you need it.
Su Anying promised, but she rarely used it on weekdays. It was probably because she felt sorry for Xu Shiyan who was tired from working in the mountains, so she made some stewed beans.
Stewed potatoes with oily beans, hot pancakes, a few scallions, and a plate of sauce, it is a very good dinner.
The young couple live their lives without so many rules, chatting while eating.
"By the way, Aunt Zhao came over today and asked me to work in the shop tomorrow." Su Anying suddenly remembered this while eating.
"What are the jobs in the house? I should be able to do it?" Daying hasn't grown ginseng much these years, and Su Anying doesn't know much about it.
"It means cleaning the sticks, putting them in a drawer, and steaming them in a pan.
Steamed and cooled thoroughly, picked it up, put it on a fork and let it dry outside. When it is cloudy, send it to the drying room. "
Xu Shiyan is the clearest about this set of procedures, so he must explain it to Su Anying.
"If you really can't stay at home, then go to work. The work in the house is not tiring, and the work points are high."
Xu Shiyan knew that his daughter-in-law was a restless person, and she couldn't stand letting her stay at home all day with nothing to do, so she didn't restrict Su Anying.
Sure enough, Su Anying became happy when she heard that she could go to work, and the work points were still high.
"Then I will go to work tomorrow, don't worry, I won't delay your meal."

chapters.title: Chapter 45: impart experience
chapters.content:
Chapter 45 Teaching Experience
Before dinner was over, Zhao Dahai hurried over.
"San'er, I heard from our family construction that you have a way to increase the production of sticks?" Zhao Dahai yelled as soon as he entered the door.
No need to guess, it must be Zhao Jianshe who went home and taught his father what Xu Shiyan said on the mountain.
Who is Zhao Dahai? Being able to be the secretary of the brigade all these years is not for nothing.
As soon as I heard what Zhao Jianshe said, I knew it was feasible.
But Zhao Jianshe didn't understand what was going on, so Zhao Dahai hurried over without even eating.
"Uncle, have you eaten yet? Sit down and eat something together. Yingzi, bring some bowls and chopsticks for our uncle." Xu Shiyan smiled and beckoned Zhao Dahai to sit down.
How could Zhao Dahai be in the mood to eat? Now he just wants to know about the ginseng fertilization.
"Nephew and daughter-in-law don't be so busy, I came over for dinner at home. San'er, tell me quickly, how is this thing fixed?"
Xu Shiyan dragged Zhao Dahai to sit down, poured him a glass of water, and then talked in detail about ginseng fertilization.
The bean cakes are crushed, mixed with water and trichlorfon, piled together and fermented.
Ferment to a certain extent, take it outside and spread it out to dry.
Before planting ginseng in autumn, mix the fermented bean cake powder with some trichlorfon and other insecticides as base fertilizer.
When planting ginseng, it is necessary to dig a small furrow. You can sprinkle the base fertilizer in the furrow, cover it with a layer of soil, then plant ginseng, and cover it with soil.
The bean cake water for topdressing is even simpler. Pour the bean cake powder into a large tank or pond, add water to ferment and fertilize, and remember to kill insects during the process.
After the frozen ginseng has been weeded twice, pour bean cake water in the small ditch in the middle of each row of ginseng, and then cover with soil.
"Actually, deer dung is also a good fertilizer, and it can be used as a base fertilizer after fermenting. It's a pity that we don't have a deer farm here, so we can't get it."
Xu Shiyan didn't hide it either, and told Zhao Dahai everything he knew.
"Adding top-dressing fertilizer to the base fertilizer, it's like playing with the increase of six or seven catties per foot. If it catches up with the soil, it's normal to add twenty-five or six catties to the soil."
When Xu Shiyan was serving the land in his previous life, it was not impossible for him to weigh thirty-five or sixty-five catties.
As long as the seeds planted are big enough, the soil is good enough to support the seedlings, the fertilizer and water supply is sufficient, and the management keeps up, high yields are still possible.
Of course, at that time, science and technology were advanced, and some diseases could be prevented and controlled.
It's not like now, all pointing to God to enjoy the meal, it's completely incomparable.
"Oh, you said you have such a good trick, why didn't you say it before?" Zhao Dahai heard it and slapped his thigh.
If the Dongjiangyan brigade had used this method a few years earlier, wouldn’t the big guy’s life be better?
"Uncle, I heard this from someone on the train when I went to Tonghua a few days ago." Xu Shiyan made an excuse casually.
"In the seat next to us, there are two technicians who don't know who participated in the scene. They were discussing this matter in the car, and I listened to it."
Xu Shiyan can't say, these are the experiences I summed up in my previous life, right?
Zhao Dahai came to a sudden, "No wonder, I just said that you are not the one who hides and hides your personality. If you have something good, why don't you tell me?"
It turns out that I heard what others said, so that's right.
"I definitely won't be in a rush this year. Next year, let's set up some experimental grounds and try as you said."
Zhao Dahai is cautious in doing things, naturally he refuses to take risks, and plans to set up an experiment site of several tens of feet, if it really works.
"I'll let you be a technician when the time comes, I think you'll do it." Zhao Dahai patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and said full of expectation.
Xu Shiyan smiled, "That's not necessary, I'm also a member of the team, and besides, it's just the way it sounds."
Xu Shiyan didn't care about technicians.
After all, he has already made up his mind to move away. He doesn't know if he can stay in Dongjiangyan next year. He doesn't covet any technicians.
Zhao Dahai sat here for a while, it was getting late, so he said goodbye and left.
When Zhao Dahai left, Su Anying was full of doubts, "When we went to Tonghua, was there someone talking about this? Why don't I remember?"
Xu Shiyan raised his hand and rubbed his wife's face, "Not long after you got in the car, you slept like a pig. What do you know?"
Su Anying fell asleep in the car for a long time because of the pregnancy reaction, which was already lacking energy, and the long train ride was too boring. Unexpectedly, at this time, her husband would make fun of her, she was immediately ashamed and annoyed, and raised her hand to pinch Xu Shiyan.
"Okay, how dare you laugh at me?"
"No, I'm not kidding you. In my eyes, even if you are a little pig, you are the most beautiful one."
Xu Shiyan smiled and held his daughter-in-law's hand, and with a strong effort, he hugged her in his arms, and both of them laughed.
Dongjiangyan Brigade started to participate in the production of more than 500 feet this year, and only got up to 200 feet on the first day, so they will go for a few more days.
It was still the forty young men who went up the mountain to lift the clubs, and another dozen strong young men were selected to work in the warehouse, mainly carrying the steamer, lighting the fire, and watching the fire.
The girls and daughters-in-law who work better in the village are selected to work in the house.
The ginseng trees are washed white and clean, just like little dolls, which is very rare.
The washed ginseng is neatly placed in the large cage, which can be placed in several layers, and then a few strong young men will lift the cage to the cauldron with twelve seals.
The cage drawer is covered, and a large piece of leather made of several pieces of cowhide is found to cover it, and the bottom is tied firmly to prevent air leakage.
The bottom of the pot is on high heat, and the fire is turned off after two hours after the pot is boiled, and then simmered for another hour, untie the rope, remove the cowhide, and open the lid of the cage.
A stream of steamed ginseng's unique aroma floats out along with the heat.
Freshly steamed ginseng is slightly yellow, and when it is dried, it will turn into a yellowish red, so it is called red ginseng.
The cage drawer was opened, and the hot air dissipated, and several young men carried it to the side layer by layer.
When the ginseng was completely cool, a group of young daughters-in-law picked it up gently and placed it on the fork.
This fork is not a fork for eating, but a tool similar to a sieve.
A wooden frame that is 1.45 meters long and less than 1 meter wide, with a layer of Artemisia stalks neatly tied to the bottom.
It is ventilated and breathable, and it will not rust easily like barbed wire. It is best used to dry ginseng.
Steamed ginseng is soft and waxy, and the worker must handle it carefully, otherwise it will be easily broken if the hands are heavy.
Put the ginseng on the fork from head to tail. When the fork is full, someone at the other end will take it away.
There are a lot of shelves in the yard, and the forks full of ginseng are placed on the shelves, and the ginseng is dried in the sun.
Of course, if it is rainy, it will be sent to the drying room.
There is a large kang inside the drying room, and a large pot for steaming ginseng is connected to the outside.
In addition to the kang, there are two stoves in the middle of the ground. When the stove is lit, the heat of the kang can also dry ginseng.
It is only dried ginseng, the color is dark, not as bright as the sun-dried ginseng, so as long as conditions permit, most of them are still dried outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Meet wild ginseng again
chapters.content:
Chapter 46 Encountering wild ginseng again
Ginseng can be said to be the treasure of the whole body, not to mention the root, which has extremely high medicinal value.
The leaves can be used to make tea, make tobacco, and extract saponins, and the ginseng flowers can also be used to make tea, make medicine, and make cosmetics.
Even steaming ginseng, the water left in the pot can be boiled and concentrated to make ginseng paste.
This ginseng ointment is a good thing. If anyone has a sore or boil, get some ginseng ointment and apply it, and it will be fine in a few days.
Catch up with which year there is mumps, which is often called mumps, and ginseng ointment can also be applied.
If it is a little more extravagant, you can also use ginseng paste mixed with hot water to soak your hands and feet, which can make your skin white and tender.
Therefore, every pot of steamed ginseng water will not be wasted. It has been reserved by everyone early and brought home to boil ginseng paste.
Autumn is a season of harvest, a season full of joy. Every busy person has a happy and satisfied smile on his face.
The busier they are, the happier everyone is, because that means they can have a good harvest this year.
Dongjiangyan brigade started to participate in the production of 500 feet this year, and the 40 people can rise more than 200 feet a day, so the work was almost finished on the morning of the third day.
"Shixiang, we don't have many feet left this afternoon, right?" Yang Chunming asked Xu Shixiang during lunch.
"Well, there is only the first string left, which is only about thirty feet long. It won't take long in the afternoon to get up and go home."
Xu Shixiang nodded. He was familiar with how many ginseng lands there were in the team, so he would definitely not remember them wrong.
"Oh, let's not start working too early in the afternoon. It's too early to go back. It's hard to remember the work points."
Yang Chunming has a lot of eyes, so he had to remind Xu Shixiang.
It is definitely different for one day and half a day, but for those who work, there is not much difference.
It's been a day since I left, who doesn't want to earn a few more work points?
Xu Shixiang was stunned for a moment, then smiled, "Okay, let's take a good rest at noon. It's tiring enough to play the club for three days in a row."
Xu Shixiang is quite versatile, otherwise he wouldn't be able to become a sideline captain at a young age. In addition to being educated, he is also capable.
It’s all work in the team, the work points are given by the government, and it’s not taken out of Xu Shixiang’s pocket, so why offend others?
Seeing Xu Shixiang nodded happily, everyone was very happy.
So they ate quickly, some people ran to the house to lie down and rest, some set up a table outside to play chess, or they drank tea and chatted.
"Third brother, take advantage of the lunch break, let's go into the woods to pick up some mushrooms, or pick some mountain grapes, soft dates and so on?
My little boy is hungry all day long, and there is nothing for him to eat at home. "Yang Chunming approached Xu Shiyan and asked in a low voice.
Yang Chunming married early, married a daughter-in-law before his twenties, and now his children are five years old.
Xu Shiyan immediately nodded in agreement when he heard this.
There are a lot of jujubes and grapes in the nearby woods. Go and pick some and bring them home, and give them to Su Anying as snacks.
There are not many fruits that can be eaten these days, unlike in the future, as long as you have money, you can buy everything.
Su Anying is pregnant and sick, but there is really nothing for her to eat at home.
There were still a few foreign persimmons a few days ago, and these days the foreign persimmons have been eaten up, so Su Anying can only eat radishes.
If you can pick some mountain grapes, jujubes, etc., you can eat them for a few days, especially jujubes, which are the best vitamin supplements.
The two reached an agreement, got up quietly, grabbed a sack and walked out.
Zhao Jianshe, Wang Zhijun and other people who get along well on weekdays saw it, and they all came over.
As soon as they heard that they wanted to go to the forest to pick up mushrooms, these few also came out with their shoulder bags.
The mountains in autumn are rich in colors, red maple leaves, yellow birches, poplars, and green pine trees.
There are many delicious foods hidden in the mountains and forests. There are pine cones, walnuts, pears, and hazelnuts on the trees, grapes, schisandra, and soft dates on the vines, and hazel mushrooms on the ground. It can be said to be a huge treasure house.
These days, people in the village are busy with autumn harvesting and growing ginseng, and they haven’t spared time to go to the mountains.
Furthermore, Qianchuan is far away from the village, with tall trees and dense forests, most women dare not come.
So there is everything in the forest, and there are many of them. You don’t have to go too far into the forest to see patches of mushrooms.
Xu Shiyan was not interested in mushrooms, and when others squatted down to pick mushrooms, he continued to move forward.
Finding a mountain grape tree covered with bunches of purple-red grapes, Xu Shiyan reached out to pick two and put them in his mouth, frowning sourly.
This stuff, I guess his little daughter-in-law will love it, the taste of pregnant women is different from that of ordinary people, the more sour the better.
After picking a vine, and walking forward, I met another jujube.
Jujube is a local saying, and the scientific name should be kiwi fruit.
It belongs to the same category as kiwi fruit, but the soft date kiwi fruit in Northeast China is small and hairless, and tastes sweeter and more fragrant.
If it is close to the village, the jujubes will be picked up by the children before they are ripe.
Pick the slightly raw jujubes home, put them in a wooden barrel, cover them with a handful of wormwood, and cover them for a while to soften them.
For children, it is also a kind of fun and enjoyment to rummage through the wooden barrels for ripe soft dates every day.
The mountains are far away from the village, and no one comes to pick them. The jujubes will hang on the trees and lose water slowly.
Especially after the frost falls, the jujubes are sweet and soft, especially delicious.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about those things, he grabbed a jujube tree and picked it all up, leaving none left.
"Third brother, are you here to do the sweeping? Look at the tree you picked, I think the black blind man will cry when he meets him."
After the first few young men saw it, they couldn't help teasing Xu Shiyan.
"I picked it for your sister-in-law, she is sick now, and there is nothing good to eat at home."
Xu Shiyan just smiled when he heard the words, let go of the jujube tree in front of him, and continued to move forward, looking for the next target.
All the people picked wild fruits, mushrooms, and walnuts, and gradually walked into the depths of the forest.
The more Xu Shiyan walked, the more familiar he felt. Looking carefully, he found that the front was the place where he brought Chen Deyong and others to release the mountain last time.
"Not far ahead, there is a tree stump, where Chen Deyong was bitten by a snake." Xu Shiyan pointed to not far away, and told everyone.
As soon as everyone heard this, they immediately regained their spirits, and they had to let Xu Shiyan take them over to have a look.
Just like that, everyone walked towards the tree stump while discussing Chen Deyong's funny scene at that time.
When they got closer, everyone saw the environment around the tree stump and couldn't help shaking their heads.
"Chen Deyong really wanted to die, how dare he urinate on a tree stump in such a place?
There is obviously a hole under the stump, there must be something living in it. "
At that time, Chen Deyong was bitten by a snake, and Xu Shiyan left in anger, not paying attention to the tree stump. Now that I look at it carefully, I always feel that something is not quite right.
A flash of light flashed in his mind, and Xu Shiyan raised his head quickly.
"The club." Xu Shiyan shouted loudly.
I found that some people don't understand wild ginseng and garden ginseng at all.
The wild ginseng in the mountains without artificial cultivation is called wild ginseng. This thing is basically extinct in China. I have never heard of anyone entering the mountains and encountering big goods in these years. A few years ago, one tree was auctioned at the Ginseng Festival, and the price was 8 million. It was actually dug up from Maozi in the north.
Artificially cultivated ginseng is called garden ginseng, which is the type that can be seen in the market, and basically grows for six years. With the current policy changes, the price of garden ginseng has also increased year by year. Last year, fresh ginseng, about ten trees per catty, could be sold for 90 to 100 yuan per catty.
Some people say that ginseng costs two yuan a tree. Hehe, the kind of ginseng that is about the thickness of chopsticks is called ginseng seeds here. It has only grown in the ground for two or three years. , I am not rare to eat, really.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: ginseng growing on the tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 47 Ginseng growing on trees
The tree stump is so thick that it cannot be carried by one person. It is estimated that it was blown down by a strong wind or struck by lightning, and it was broken from a height of one person.
After a long period of time, the stump has rotted and is covered with moss. When you touch it with your hand, it feels as soft as soil.
Some weeds grew on the top of the stump, and among the weeds, there was a green plant.
Six palm-shaped leaves, purple-black stems, and a red ginseng seed on the top that is bigger than a baby's fist, nodding slightly with the wind.
Xu Shiyan has dealt with ginseng for two lifetimes, if he still can't recognize what it is, he is really blind.
The moment Xu Shiyan saw the ginseng, Xu Shiyan exclaimed, "Balm."
The few people who followed him didn't react at all.
"What stick? Go back and pick up the stick? Don't worry.
Didn’t you say everything just now? Go back later in the afternoon, what should we do, don't delay. "
Yang Chunming glanced at the tree stump and thought it was meaningless, so he waved his hand to pick mushrooms.
"I mean, there's a mallet on it, big deal." Xu Shiyan looked helpless, these people didn't understand what he meant at all.
"Huh? There's a mallet on it? Third brother, are you dazzled?"
Everyone looked up in disbelief, looking up at the tree stump.
Then, everyone opened their mouths wide and stared fixedly at the tree stump.
"Damn it, what a stick, it's still six leaves."
"Quick, quick, stick." Everyone came back to their senses and shouted in unison.
"What are you shouting for? We don't even have a home, so shouting is useful?
Hurry up, look back at the small room, borrow ropes, axes, saws, deer bone sticks, etc., I guess Uncle Li can have them. "
Xu Shiyan looked at the stunned look of the crowd, couldn't help laughing, and hurriedly asked them to find something.
This ginseng tree is growing on a rotten tree stump. The tree stump is tall and rotten and cannot bear the weight. You have to think of a way to do it.
At this time, everyone unconsciously led by Xu Shiyan.
So Zhao Jianshe and Wang Zhijun trotted back to the small room, leaving Xu Shiyan and Yang Chunming guarding in front of the tree stump.
Not long after, I saw a large group of people rushing over.
Yeah, who heard that they saw a big product and didn’t want to come and see the fun?
"Brother, where is the mallet?"
Xu Shixiang ran very fast, and was the first to come to Xu Shiyan, but he didn't find the stick.
The crowd came over at the back, and everyone cast their eyes on the ground, but no one saw the shadow of the mallet.
"Jianshe, didn't you say there is a mallet? Where is it?" The big guy thought that Zhao Jianshe was joking, and turned his head to stare at him.
"Then, isn't that right on top of the tree stump?" Zhao Jianshe ran back and forth in a hurry, panting from exhaustion.
He didn’t make it clear just now when he went back, but now he pointed to the top of the tree stump and said out of breath.
"On the stump? Are you kidding me, who ever heard of a mallet growing on a tree?"
Everyone didn't believe it, but their eyes still moved towards the tree stump.
Then, the big guys fell silent.
Because they all petrified collectively, staring at the club on the stump one by one, stupid.
"What's the matter? Why did the mallet grow on it?" After a long time, someone came back to his senses and asked leisurely.
"Then what else can't be figured out? This tree stump is not known for how many years, it's rotten."
Xu Shiyan took the rope slowly and stepped forward to tie up the stump.
"It should be that a bird ate the ginseng seeds and then **** on it. The undigested ginseng seeds fell on it and slowly germinated and grew out."
The odds are extremely low, but not impossible.
The stump was so rotten that it was almost like mud. It was soft and moist, enough to provide what ginseng needed for growth, so the ginseng tree grew like this.
Ordinary people go to the mountains and look for them in the grass with their heads down. How can anyone look up at the sky?
As a result, this ginseng tree slipped through the net. It was so close to the ginseng field that no one noticed it for so many years.
After listening to Xu Shiyan's explanation, everyone couldn't help nodding. It's possible to say so.
At the same time, everyone couldn't help feeling that Xu Shiyan was really lucky. Who would have thought that such a ginseng could make him meet?
"Brother, how did you come up with the idea to look up?" Someone asked curiously.
"You don't know, this is the place where Chen Deyong peed at that time." Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing as he spoke.
"I was very angry at the time, and I didn't bother to look at the tree stump. We happened to wander here just now, and we talked about Chen Deyong."
"I suddenly remembered what the elders said, as long as there are beasts guarding the baby, especially near the big club, there may be snakes."
The elders who released the mountain called the snake Qian Chuanzi, not just for the sake of being nice.
Ginseng will produce ginseng seeds, and ginseng seeds are likely to attract mice. Snakes guarding around ginseng can easily catch mice.
Xu Shiyan also thought of this, so he looked around carefully, but he couldn't find it, and when he looked up, he saw the ginseng on the stump.
Everyone came to a sudden, and then, without knowing who it was, they burst out laughing.
"Third brother, if Chen Deyong knew that there was a ginseng growing on the place where he was bitten by a snake, how would he feel?"
As soon as this remark came out, everyone was taken aback for a moment, and then burst out laughing, some even burst into tears.
"I guess he will regret it to death. Why did you think he was so cheap at the time? Did he have to pee on the tree stump?"
"He simply offended the God of the Mountain, otherwise, he might have seen this stick."
"Impossible, he doesn't have the fortune, even if he doesn't pee, he can't see it, and no one will look up."
For a while, everyone talked about it.
Xu Shiyan didn't have time to chat with them, he was busy.
"Okay, don't just stand there and watch, come here and give me a hand.
I have to bring this tree stump down, please help me, don’t break the tree stump. "
The tree stump is a bit high, and it’s no longer difficult if it’s rotten. If people can’t climb it, they can’t lift the mallet out.
The best way at present is to cut off the stump from the root of the tree, and then take out the ginseng from it bit by bit.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming hurried forward, while the others stood there watching the fun.
Don’t blame them either. They didn’t see the mallet, and it has nothing to do with them. They just came to see the fun.
If they stepped forward to do something, I was afraid that Xu Shiyan and others would misunderstand and think that they should also share a share.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about those people, and ordered Yang Chunming to hold on to the stump. He held a saw and an ax here, and carefully sawed from the root of the stump.
The tree stump was already rotten, and it couldn’t be pulled out after a few saws. So I had no choice but to chop it down with an axe.
The ax was sharp enough, but the tree stump was really thick enough. After a lot of effort, the tree stump was finally brought down.

chapters.title: Chapter 48: bulk
chapters.content:
Chapter 48 Big goods
Xu Shiyan tied the tree stump with a rope in advance, and Yang Chunming and others supported it, so the tree stump fell without too much vibration, and naturally it did not hurt the mallet inside.
The tree stump fell down, and Xu Shiyan began to take a stick and clean up the rotten wood and soil bit by bit.
Gradually, all the reed heads of ginseng are revealed, and a small section of ginseng shoulder is exposed underneath.
