Just looking at that shoulder, you can tell that the ginseng tree underneath is not small.
"It's really a big deal, it's great." Yang Chunming and others were surrounded, and when they saw it, they cheered.
Xu Shiyan saw the ginseng, but they entered the mountain together. It is said that those who see it have a share, and they can also share a part of this ginseng tree.
At this time, the mood of several people is really extremely excited.
As for the others, they don’t have this luck. They came here just to watch the excitement.
Xu Shixiang didn't step forward to help, he looked at his watch, it was getting late.
"Let's go, let's go back to work, there are still thirty feet left before the hammer is raised, so we can't delay." This is said to those watching the excitement.
"Third brother, you don't have to go back in a few afternoons, I think you will be able to go back tonight.
Let me tell my family later, it will save them from worrying at home. "This is said to Xu Shiyan, Yang Chunming and others.
This ginseng tree is not small, and it is inside the stump, so it is a bit difficult to lift it out.
Based on Xu Shixiang's estimate, it would be early if he could carry it out tomorrow.
It is estimated that these people will have to stay in the mountains tonight.
The family members must be worried that they won't see them go back, so they have to go back and send a letter.
"Well, we must be staying here tonight.
There is no need for you to send messages at home, I will let Jianshe and Dajun go back, let him go to each house to talk about it, and then bring some food for use. "
Looking at the situation, I will definitely live in the mountains tonight, and if things go wrong tomorrow, I will have to stay for another night.
The food and drink for the five people had to be resolved, and besides, it was very cold in the mountains at the end of September.
They didn’t bring too thick clothes, so they just stayed like this. If they could get cold at night, they had to send someone back to get their clothes and luggage.
Xu Shixiang was right when he heard it, so he didn't say anything, and led the people away.
Zhao Jianshe and Wang Zhijun also left. They went back to the village to report the news and pick up various things for food along the way.
"Chunming, Erniu, don't just stand here and watch, you two, hurry up and collect firewood, we have to sleep here tonight."
Xu Shiyan knew that these few had no experience in mountain climbing, so he ordered them to work.
Yang Chunming and Li Erniu are both able to work. According to what Xu Shiyan said, they chopped wood very quickly.
Then build two ditches around here, pick up a lot of firewood and come back, and light a fire.
The sun was setting, and the light in the forest was getting darker and darker. On Xu Shiyan's side, the ginseng had just exposed a small section of his shoulder.
At this time, it is no longer possible to continue, otherwise the ginseng skin will be easily damaged, and once damaged, it will not be able to sell at a high price.
"Third brother, it's getting dark, you haven't rested this afternoon, so get up and move around.
Wait for Jianshe and them to come back later, let’s get some food and continue tomorrow. "
Yang Chunming saw that it was getting dark, so he called Xu Shiyan to rest.
Xu Shiyan had been squatting there all afternoon carrying the mallet. He was really tired, so he stopped what he was doing, stood up straight and stretched his arms and legs.
"Look at this, this ginseng tree is not small, I don't think it may be able to carry all of it out tomorrow."
This ginseng tree is not small, and it grows in a special environment. It is difficult to dig and the speed cannot be increased.
"Well, it doesn't look small, third brother, can this ginseng be sold for a lot of money?
Hey, if this can be sold for several thousand yuan, I will have the money to marry a wife. " Li Erniu asked with a simple smile.
"Don't ask nonsense, you boy. The elders have rules. If you get a stick, you can only talk about the size, and you are not allowed to infer the price."
Yang Chunming raised his head and patted Er Niu on the back of the head to warn him.
Li Erniu didn't feel annoyed when he got hit, he just smiled, "Oh, I see, I won't ask after that.
Anyway, this is to follow the third brother to get rich, and the third brother is lucky, so we just follow to pick up the cheap ones. "Don't look at Li Erniu as stupid, but he is not stupid.
Before Chen Deyong and others, didn’t they also look at Xu Shiyan’s fortune with envy?
Those people tried to get rich by taking advantage of Xu Shiyan's luck, but they didn't get anything, and even hurt one person.
They followed up the mountain to pick up mushrooms, but in the end they encountered a stick. Isn’t this the same as picking mushrooms for nothing?
Besides, Xu Shiyan contributed the most. It would be nice for them to take advantage of it. Why are you still thinking about it so much?
Yang Chunming felt comfortable listening to these words, so he nodded.
"That's right, remember one sentence, no matter what to do with this ginseng tree, it is the third brother who decides, understand?"
"Hey, hey, I understand." Li Erniu nodded quickly.
Xu Shiyan over there was about to say something when he saw someone approaching in the distance.
Xu Shiyan and the others rushed over to greet them. It was Zhao Jianshe and Wang Zhijun who came back with their straps and bags, wheezing and panting.
"Third brother, all five families have been notified, and each family has brought dry food and clothes.
My dad said that there might be wild animals in the mountains at night, so he asked me to bring two guns for self-defense. "
When Zhao Jianshe saw Xu Shiyan, he hurriedly said.
Xu Shiyan nodded when he heard the words, sure enough, Jiang is still old and spicy.
Zhao Dahai asked his son to bring a gun. Why is it to prevent wild animals? I'm afraid it's for defense, right?
Now the whole village knows that they met a club in the mountains, who knows if anyone has a bad idea?
What if a group of people come at night, kill them, and take away that ginseng tree? It's not impossible.
Man dies for money, birds die for food, the truth has not changed since ancient times, so the heart of guarding against people is indispensable.
"Succeed, thank you for your hard work, two younger brothers. In the past two days, let's cheer up and wait for the ginseng to be carried out and go down the mountain."
Xu Shiyan took the luggage and carried it on his shoulders, and returned to the gate with everyone.
Zhao Jianshe and the two brought a complete set of things, including dry food and water, so everyone settled down and had dinner first.
Afterwards, they were divided into groups, Zhao Jianshe and Wang Zhijun guarded the first half of the night, and Yang Chunming and Li Erniu guarded the second half of the night to prevent beasts and people from approaching.
As for Xu Shiyan, he has to concentrate on lifting ginseng during the day, which consumes a lot of energy, and he must sleep well at night, so he sleeps at night.
It was safe and sound all night, and Xu Shiyan started to work at dawn the next day. The others boiled water and cooked, and continued after breakfast.
The ginseng tree is really not small, probably because it grows on the stump. In order to absorb more water, the roots are very long.
So the next day they still couldn't dig out all of them, and they had to live on the mountain at night.
Xu Shiyan was tired all day and went to bed early at night. Yang Chunming found opportunities to catch up on sleep during the day, so they still kept vigil at night.
Sleeping until midnight, he suddenly heard a movement. Without saying a word, Yang Chunming raised his gun and pointed towards the direction of the sound.
Then, there seemed to be a messy sound, and then there was no movement.

chapters.title: Chapter 49:
chapters.content:
Chapter 49
The gunshot woke up Xu Shiyan and Zhao Jianshe, and the three jumped out of the cellar directly.
"What's the matter? Is it a man or a beast?"
"I don't know, I can't hear it. I just heard something, so I hugged it and shot it." Yang Chunming shook his head.
"It may be that I have lost everything, anyway, there is nothing wrong with being careful."
Xu Shiyan nodded, indeed, it’s never wrong to be careful.
At this moment, the east side was a little pale, and everyone couldn't sleep because of the gunfire, so they simply sat in front of the fire, warmed up and chatted.
Waiting for the sky to get brighter, Zhao Jianshe started cooking, and Xu Shiyan continued to work with a deer bone stick.
Yang Chunming and the others stood guard nearby with guns on their shoulders, not letting go of any trouble.
At eight o'clock in the morning, this ginseng tree finally showed its whole picture.
The main body of ginseng is probably thicker than an adult's thumb, with a long palm and a beautiful shape.
The two big beard trees at the neck are as thick as cigarettes, and several legs branch out from the main root, and they are also evenly slender and slender.
It is estimated that it is due to the unique growth environment, the ginseng mustache is very long, and it is covered with pearl bumps.
This ginseng tree is estimated to weigh more than three taels, less than four taels. In terms of the five shapes of whiskers, reeds, skin, grain, and body, it is also top-grade.
The main reason is that it grows on rotten stumps, and the nutrition may not be sufficient, so don't look at it as six leaves, but the weight is not as heavy as imagined.
But everyone is already very happy, just this one, why can't it sell for one or two thousand?
They originally went into the mountains to pick up mushrooms, but they picked up a ginseng tree. What else were they thinking?
Xu Shiyan still made ginseng bags with moss and birch bark, and then several people packed up the things and left them in Lao Li’s house.
The five people each brought some dry food, packed lightly and went straight down the mountain without even entering the village, crossing the river and going straight to Songjiang River.
When I arrived at Songjianghe, I found out that there was a bus bound for Fusong at eleven o'clock.
So the five of them bought tickets, ate dry food at the station, took a train at that point, and went straight to Fusong.
The road conditions are not good these days. From Songjianghe to Fusong all the way on the winding mountain road, the bus wobbled for two hours and finally arrived at the county seat.
After inquiring about the place, I found the purchasing station.
This season is busy with the autumn harvest, and there are not many people who come to sell mountain products.
Xu Shiyan came to the counter and put the ginseng bag directly on the counter. "Comrade, please look at this."
Anyone who can work in the purchasing station must have some real skills, at least have good eyesight.
One look at the birch bark roll, and the other party knew it was wild ginseng.
So he reached out to take it, carefully untied the outer bark, and unfolded the birch bark and moss one by one.
When the ginseng inside was displayed in front of my eyes, several staff members at the counter couldn't help but wow.
One of them immediately took out the balance and weighed the ginseng on it.
"This ginseng plant weighs three to two nine dollars and is beautiful in five shapes. Our purchase price here is 2,800 yuan. How about it? Will you sell it?"
This person is quite straightforward, and there is no need to invite someone to come and appraise it. After weighing, he compared the form on the wall and said the price directly.
The ginseng that Xu Shiyan sold in Tonghua before, weighed two and a half, and sold for two thousand and five.
This tree weighs three taels and nine renminbi. It is said that after the wild ginseng exceeds three taels, the price will increase a lot for every penny more.
If you go to Tonghua, this ginseng can be sold for 3,400 to 500 yuan.
But this is not Xu Shiyan's alone. Everyone hurriedly followed because they wanted to get the money quickly.
Only when the money is in your own pocket can you feel at ease, otherwise, if something goes wrong, everyone will be busy for nothing these days.
Furthermore, they didn’t have a letter of introduction and proof in their hands, so it was not realistic to go to Tonghua, so there was no other way but to sell it at this price.
So Xu Shiyan went back to discuss with Yang Chunming, and everyone agreed that it would be sold directly for 2,800 yuan.
Thus, the invoice was issued over there, and the ginseng was taken away, and 2,800 yuan was counted out here, and handed over to Xu Shiyan.
Brand-new Great Unity, two bundles and one stack, exudes the fragrance of ink.
Two thousand and eight, Yang Chunming's eyes are straight, they have never seen so much money.
"Let's use their land to share the money."
There are few people in the buying station, and it is quite clean. Xu Shiyan directly proposed to divide the money, so as not to have no place to go out, and one accidentally be targeted.
"A total of two thousand eight, five of us, five hundred and six each."
Mountain wealth cannot be enjoyed alone, but those who see it have a share. Since five people met ginseng together, of course five people will share it.
"Don't, don't, third brother, we are just getting rich with you, without you, we wouldn't get a penny.
You take the big head, we can divide it in half. "Yang Chunming waved his hands quickly.
Xu Shiyan saw the ginseng, and he also dug it out. Yang Chunming and the others felt that they didn't put in much effort, and the average score was not suitable.
"That won't work, our brother's love is more important than this money, so we should follow the rules, otherwise people will know, and they will poke my spine."
The rules of Fangshan are like this, no matter how much money there is or how many people there are, they all get to share equally.
"If you still treat me as a brother, you will keep the money, otherwise you will have nothing to do as a brother in the future."
Xu Shiyan's face darkened, trying to scare those people.
Okay, now that we’ve talked about it, what should we do? Listen up.
So, a few people happily shared the money, half of the money was put into their arms, and everyone's beautiful mouths couldn't close their mouths.
"Brothers, take care of your money, be careful.
Let's go and find out if there is a car back and what time it will be. Don't delay us going home. "Xu Shiyan reminded everyone.
Most people in this day and age will sew a pocket inside their clothes to keep money.
Some people even sew pockets on top of their underpants or shorts, just to keep money safe when they go out.
Several people went out, found a secluded corner, and carefully hid the money.
Afterwards, the group went to the station and asked about the return bus.
In the afternoon, a bus from Fusong to Donggang happened to pass by the Songjiang River.
There is another bus from Fusong to Hot Spring, passing Xianren Bridge.
The place of the big house is particularly remote and crappy. When returning from Fusong, there are detours in every way.
But in comparison, Songjianghe is more convenient.
"Let's take the Donggang bus. Let's get off at Songjianghe and walk back." Xu Shiyan directly paid for five tickets.
The bus leaves at three o'clock in the afternoon, and there is only one hour left before the departure.
Everyone thinks about it, you have so much money in your pocket, so stop being embarrassing and just stay still.
So, the five of them squatted at the passenger station, talking and chatting together.
They came directly from the mountains, dressed in shabby clothes, still covered in dirt, squatting in a corner, no one even looked at them.
An hour passed quickly, and there was a call from Donggang to check the ticket.
The five people quickly stood up, went over with their tickets, checked them and boarded the train.
Just wandering around like this for two hours, when they arrived at Songjiang River, the five people got off at the corner building and headed west all the way back to the big house.

chapters.title: Chapter 50: sweet pastry
chapters.content:
Chapter 50 Sweet pastry
When Xu Shiyan and his party returned to the village, it was already past six o'clock, it was already dark, and there were not many people outside, which saved a lot of trouble.
When everyone found out that Xu Shiyan and the others had returned, it was already the next morning.
"Oh, isn't this Brother Shi Yan? When did you come back? Why is it so quiet and there is no movement?"
"Isn't it a big deal? I heard that you met a mallet on the mountain? How big is it? Let us see it too, and keep our eyes open."
"Surely it can sell for a lot of money, right? Oh, it's really greedy. Why don't you think I'm so lucky?"
"Isn't it? Let's not talk about anything else. Ever since the three brothers of the Xu family got married, their luck is unstoppable. Good things happen everywhere."
Ordinary agricultural teams are not so busy after the autumn harvest. At most, they collect grain, beat beans, and peel corn.
But the production team for planting ginseng is different. Every autumn is the busiest time for ginseng.
Digging the soil, pouring the soil, raising ginseng seeds, and planting ginseng, I have to be busy until the snow falls.
The ginseng production team of Dongjiangyan Brigade has returned this year, and the ginseng factory is also intensively processing, but there is still a lot of work on the mountain.
In the morning, everyone gathered in front of the team headquarters, waiting for the captain and secretary to assign tasks.
When Xu Shiyan and the others appeared, a lot of people gathered around and asked this and that.
All of a sudden, the vegetable market was in front of the team department, and it was a mess.
"The club was sold in Fusong yesterday, and the family split two hundred yuan." Yang Chunming hurriedly opened his mouth when he saw this situation.
This was on the way back yesterday, the five people discussed it, and when they came back, they said that each of them would share 200, so as not to let others know that they were jealous.
The five of them also told their family members not to go out and talk nonsense.
Two hundred yuan is not enough to make people jealous, and everyone mentions it with envy.
If other people know that each family has divided more than 500 yuan, they don't know what will happen.
This is also the reason why some of them didn't even go back to the village, but went straight down the mountain to sell ginseng.
I just don’t want outsiders to know the size of the ginseng, and I can’t estimate how much they can get, so as not to cause trouble.
Living at home, it is better to be low-key, because it is too high-key to make people jealous.
Other families are still living hard, but your family suddenly has five or six hundred more?
Don't say anything else, come to the door to ask you to borrow one hundred and eighty, will you borrow it?
"What? Only sold for a thousand dollars? Can't you?
I heard our second child come back and say, isn’t it Liupiye? That shouldn't be small, why did you sell it for so much money? "
"Yes, I also heard that the ginseng tree is quite thick, and the exposed shoulders are thicker than a thumb. Why can't it be sold for a thousand dollars?"
Some people seemed unwilling to believe it. After all, dozens of people were working on the mountain at that time, and they all rushed over to join in the fun.
A tree with six leaves costs 1,000 yuan, which is really not much.
"It's not the same. If it grows on the ground, the six leaves may be quite big. Don't forget that it grows on a tree stump.
Besides, the shape of the ginseng tree is not good, it is too short, and the shoulders and head look thick, but in fact it does not have much weight, just three or two. "
Before Xu Shiyan could speak, Zhao Jianshe spoke.
This explanation is reasonable, anyway, no one has ever seen a mallet growing on a tree stump.
"One thousand yuan is not a lot. We worked hard from spring to autumn. How much money can we have left in a year?"
"That's reasonable, two hundred yuan is not a lot. What else do you want?
Going into the mountains to pick up mushrooms and meeting a mallet, it’s all like a dream, money picked for nothing. "
Even if it is two hundred, many people are envious.
"Brother Shiyan, go further into the mountains, no matter what you do, you take your brother with you."
Someone patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder with a flattering expression.
"Brother can see it, you have been married since you were married, and you are very lucky.
Brother, you married a good wife, Wangfu. "
Hearing this, everyone burst into laughter, and Xu Shiyan also laughed.
Since rebirth, luck has improved a lot, Xu Shiyan can't understand this.
Could it be that it was too unlucky in the previous life, bottomed out and rebounded, bringing all the good luck to this life?
While everyone was chatting and laughing, Zhao Dahai and several other cadres came over and assigned everyone today's work.
There are still some things to finish in the field, and there are still some grains in the village that have not been threshed.
Then there is still a lot of soil that has been harvested for this year's new ginseng land. Next, we have to mix loess, pour soil, etc. Anyway, there is a lot of work to do.
Xu Shiyan and other young people were all sent to the mountains to fight the soil.
The land used to grow ginseng is not the same as the field, but forest land.
For the forest land felled in the previous year, in the summer of the second year, the shrubs and weeds on it should be cleared and hung on the strings.
Then use a pickaxe to dig out the soil, take the turf above it, and dig out a clod of more than one foot square, with the soil layer facing up, and the turf buckled inside.
After drying the soil for a summer, the soil moisture becomes less, and some bacteria and insect eggs are also killed.
In autumn, use four teeth to beat the turf to leave the soil, pick out the grass roots and branches and burn them. This process is to beat the soil.
The work of participating in the field is not easy, and the work points are relatively high. The big guys are robbing, and they are all young, strong and good at work.
If it had been in the past, Xu Shiyan would never have been able to go up the mountain to dig the soil, and he would just go to the field to finish up and do some odd jobs.
It's different now, Xu Shiyan is now a celebrity in the Dongjiangyan Brigade.
Zhao Dahai is still thinking about making Xu Shiyan a technician next year, so of course he has to arrange a job that earns a high salary.
So, under the envious eyes of many people, Xu Shiyan went up the mountain to dig the soil to earn high work points with his four-toothed son on his shoulders.
Not only that, Xu Shiyan also felt the enthusiasm of everyone on the mountain.
The one who offered to pass cigarettes, the one who served tea and water during breaks, and the one who helped him carry tools when he got off work, all of them wished to serve Xu Shiyan like an ancestor.
"Third Brother, there's nothing wrong with taking a break at noon, otherwise, let's go wandering in the woods?"
"That's right, third brother, why don't you take us into the mountains."
Every day after work at noon, Xu Shiyan was surrounded by many people, all coaxing Xu Shiyan, wanting Xu Shiyan to take them into the forest.
What if you are lucky and meet a ginseng again?
Xu Shiyan was given a headache by these people. "Brothers, how can it be so easy to meet a stick?"
What is this called? Why are you hanging around him one by one? Xu Shiyan, who is used to being low-key, really can't adapt to the current situation.
After lunch that day, Xu Shiyan thought about going into the forest to pick some grapes for Su Anying.
As a result, he just got up and before he walked out of the arena, a group of people followed behind him.
"Third Brother, why are you going? Take us with you?"
Xu Shiyan stared at the sky speechlessly, it was so annoying, this kind of life was too disturbing, he just wanted to live in peace.
"I just want to pick some grapes for my daughter-in-law. It's nothing else. I'll be back in a while, so I won't delay my work in the afternoon."
"Oh, it turned out to be for my sister-in-law, third brother, why are you so absent-minded? Let's go, we will help you."
A group of dog skin plasters, I can't get rid of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 51: grape cake
chapters.content:
Chapter 51 Grape Cake
The impact of digging up wild ginseng is not limited to this. Su Anying and even Xu's family members have followed suit.
At the other end of the goods room, after the fresh ginseng is washed and steamed, there are only so many tasks left to dry, dry, fork, cut ginseng whiskers, pick grades, and bind ginseng whiskers.
The follow-up work can be regarded as technical. It is effortless, light, and earns a lot of work points.
Many people can't grab it, only some experienced daughters-in-law are left.
A person like Su Anying who bought a house and worked in the house for the first year, normally speaking, would not be able to pick her at all.
As a result, many people were not selected, but Su Anying was selected and stayed in the warehouse to continue working.
Even Su Anying herself was very puzzled, why was she selected?
So when Xu Shiyan came home from work, Su Anying spoke out the problems in her heart.
"Nothing? It's better for you to work.
My daughter-in-law is so capable and ingenious, can you still struggle with the little work in the house? "
Of course Xu Shiyan understood why, most of it was due to the Zhao family.
Xu Shiyan earned more than 500 yuan with Zhao Jianshe. The Zhao family reciprocated, and it is normal to take care of the young couple.
Of course, Su Anying is indeed capable. If she doesn't work well, even if Zhao Dahai wants to take care of her, she will come out of nowhere.
Some things, although everyone knows it well, still need to be convinced, otherwise it is easy to follow the truth.
"Okay, don't worry about those things, just work hard in the warehouse, I guess you can almost reach Luoxue."
"Then, these are the mountain grapes I picked from the mountain."
Xu Shiyan said, and moved in the big basket of grapes outside the door.
Su Anying was dumbfounded at the time, "Why are there so many? You didn't work today?"
A large back basket is full, how many years will it take to eat it?
"Don't mention it, didn't you run out of the mountain grapes I picked for you last time? I was thinking of picking some more at noon this morning.
As a result, the group of people didn’t know why they were going crazy, and they all followed me into the woods, and caught a few vines. This was a disaster, and they were all picked. "
Speaking of this, Xu Shiyan also looked helpless. He just wanted to get something to satisfy his wife's hunger, and he didn't plan to ask for so much.
Su Anying pursed her lips and snickered when she heard the words. In fact, she could probably guess why.
It's all for building a good relationship with Xu Shiyan, and waiting for Xu Shiyan to take them into the mountains next year.
"But there are so many mountain grapes, and there is no place to put them. They will not rot if they are stored in the warehouse for ten days and half a month?"
Su Anying is also worried, even if she is pregnant and loves sour food, she still can't eat so much.
"It's okay, let's eat first. After eating, let's clean up the mountain grapes. I'll make grape cake for you."
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes, and immediately had a solution.
Su Anying doesn't know what grape cake is, but since her husband said it, there must be a way.
So the young couple ate dinner happily, then picked the grapes in the back basket and washed them with clean water.
Pour the cleaned mountain grapes into the pot, add an appropriate amount of water, and boil at the bottom.
While cooking, use tools such as a fence to crush the grape skins.
When the water in the pot turns bright purple, use a strainer to remove the grape skins, fruit stems and seeds, and continue cooking on high heat.
Cook until most of the water in the pot has evaporated, add a little sugar, and then pour in the flour noodles made from potatoes.
Stir well, bring to a boil again, when big bubbles appear, stop the heat and put it in a basin.
"Okay, let it cool overnight, use a shovel or knife tomorrow morning, cut it into small pieces, and put it outside to dry."
After working half the night, I finally finished it, and now I can sleep in peace.
"You are so good, how can you know everything? Can you make grape cake?"
Su Anying's eyes are only shining, what kind of man did she marry? Why do you think your husband knows everything?
Xu Shiyan was a little embarrassed to be stared at by his wife.
"The custom in my hometown, in autumn, is to peel pears, dry red skins in the mountains, and boil grape cakes."
There is indeed such a habit in Shijiagou.
There is no ginseng planted there, and the crops in the fields are not growing well. There are pear trees and mangrove trees in every garden.
In autumn, women in every household make these, and save them for snacks during the Chinese New Year.
Although Xu Shiyan was still very young when the Xu family moved out of Shijiagou, he heard his mother talk about it.
Furthermore, this thing is not too difficult, and it is quite easy to use, just to coax the daughter-in-law, as long as the daughter-in-law is happy.
"It's quite interesting in my hometown. Come on, tell me about it."
Having said that, Su Anying became even more curious, so she had to drag Xu Shiyan into the house and let him talk about things in his hometown.
This talk lasted until midnight, and the next morning, Xu Shiyan almost got up late.
The work of Shendi is still going on, and Xu Shiyan will also take advantage of the rest time to go into the forest to get something delicious.
When the mountain grapes are gone, we will crack pine cones, pick walnuts, and pick hazelnuts.
It is said that if you are pregnant, you should eat more nuts, which is good for the child. Anyway, as long as it is good for Su Anying and the child, he is willing to do it.
Busy and busy, time flies by, and it’s October in the blink of an eye, and the work in Shendi is coming to an end.
After the ginseng soil is well ground, mix some loess in places with too much black soil, and then use a shovel to turn it over from top to bottom to make sharp soil ridges, then you can prepare to plant ginseng.
The ginseng seeds with open openings are sprinkled in the soil and grown for three years, and the soil fertility is not enough. It needs to be taken out and transplanted again. This is called planting ginseng.
The time for planting ginseng is also particular. If it is too early, the moss cells of the reed head will not grow well, and it will be easily damaged, which will affect the emergence rate.
It doesn’t work if it’s too late, it’s all frozen, and the ginseng soil is frozen in lumps, and if the cover is not solid, it is easy to cause frost damage, and the stick will rot in the second year.
Generally speaking, they are all planted before the frost, and the ginseng seeds have to be selected and graded when they come out of the ground, so the ginseng seeds should be planted one week before the frost.
October 16th, the team began to participate in the competition, the same dozens of people from last time, drove the carriage straight to Qianchuan to participate in the field.
You can’t use three-tooth tools for ginseng seeds, you have to use four-tooth tools. The two tools are similar, that is, the four-tooth tool has one more tooth and the spacing is closer.
Ginseng seeds only grow for two or three years, and the seeds are densely scattered. Compared with the ginseng that is produced, they are naturally much smaller.
Picking up ginseng seeds is slower. Most of the time, when one person is planing with four teeth, at least two people have to pick them up.
"Okay, everyone, let's take a break and eat. I haven't been idle this afternoon, and I got up pretty fast."
Xu Shixiang was still the leader, and when the time came, he called to rest there.
Everyone stopped their hands, and the ginseng seed pickers quickly picked up the ginseng seeds on the ground and put them in sacks, and then everyone went back to the ginseng house to eat.
"Hey? What's the matter? Didn't Mr. Li turn on the fire to heat our meals?" When we arrived at the house, we found that there was not even a spark under the pot and the pot was empty. Everyone was a little puzzled, Mr. Why did Li head go?
"Oh, come quickly, Uncle Li has fallen behind the firewood pile." Someone shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: stroke
chapters.content:
Chapter 52 Stroke
When everyone heard the shout, they immediately rushed out of the house and came behind the firewood pile.
I saw Lao Li leaning half of his body on the side of the firewood stack, slanting on the ground, with his eyes closed.
"Don't touch him yet, I'll take a look." Xu Shiyan stepped forward in two steps, pushing away the two people beside Uncle Li.
"I don't know what's going on with Uncle Li now, I can't mess with him, wait a minute."
As Xu Shiyan said, he came forward to check Lao Li's body.
Old Litou had lost consciousness at this time, his body twitched, and saliva flowed from the corner of his mouth.
Open the eyelids and look at the pupils. The pupils are as narrow as a needle point, and the pupils on both sides are of different sizes.
Breathing with obvious snoring, left body reflex disappears, pulse is rapid and disorderly.
"Quick, hurry to the house and find a sewing needle."
Xu Shiyan had a general judgment in his mind, and immediately sent someone to find something.
"Get another towel, soak it in cold water and wring it out for me."
It is reasonable to use an ice pack, but it hasn't been frozen yet, where can I get the ice? Just use a wet towel.
Anyway, the temperature is quite low at this time, and the water in the tank is ice-cold, so it works somewhat.
We all know that Xu Shiyan has some medical skills, better than the barefoot doctor in the village, so no one refuted his words, and people immediately followed suit.
"Third brother, here is the needle you want." Someone dug out a large sewing needle from the room and handed it to Xu Shiyan.
"New needle, I got it from the needle bag."
Xu Shiyan nodded, took the needle, stabbed Lao Li's nose hard, and then squeezed a few times, dark red blood beads came out.
Next, Xu Shiyan pierced Lao Li's earlobe and ten fingertips with a needle, and some dark red or even black blood was squeezed out.
Try the pulse again after bloodletting, and it feels a little more stable, not as fast as before.
At this time, a wet towel was also handed over, and Xu Shiyan hurriedly applied the towel to Lao Li's head.
"Let's set up the car. Uncle Li must have suffered a stroke. He has to be sent to the hospital. There is no cure in our village."
Stroke, also known as cerebrovascular accident, is divided into many types.
Cerebral hemorrhage, cerebral thrombosis, cerebral embolism, cerebral vasospasm, subarachnoid hemorrhage, etc., have different onset priorities and different symptoms at the time of onset.
Based on Lao Li's age and onset, it should be cerebral hemorrhage. So Xu Shiyan took the emergency treatment of bloodletting.
But this is only a helpless solution. It can only alleviate the symptoms, but cannot wake people up. They still need to go to the hospital for treatment.
Xu Shiyan spoke, and someone over there immediately set up a cart, spread bedding on the carriage, and then carefully lifted Old Li's head into the carriage.
"Come on, two people, come with me." Xu Shiyan was the first to jump into the car, and turned around to call for someone.
But I saw someone take a few steps back, obviously not wanting to follow to the hospital.
That’s right, if I go to the hospital this afternoon, my work will be delayed, and they are reluctant to part with their work points.
Naturally, there were also those who didn't care. Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming got into the car without saying a word.
Yang Chunming swung his whip and drove the carriage away with a snap.
The mountain road was rough and bumpy, and the carriage wobbled unhappily. Xu Shiyan was worried that Lao Li's head would also shake, which would increase the bleeding, so he kept supporting him with both hands.
The carriage returned to the village from Qianchuan, Zhao Jianshe rushed to the team headquarters, found his father Zhao Dahai, and took some money from Zhao Dahai.
The main reason was not to disturb Mrs. Li, for fear that the old lady would not be able to bear it alone and would faint.
Bringing the money, the three of them drove to the Xigang Commune.
When they arrived at the commune hospital, the doctors and nurses immediately sent the person for examination and rescue, while Xu Shiyan and others went to go through the formalities and pay the fee.
After a long time, the door of the emergency room opened, and doctors and nurses came out one after another.
"Doctor, how is the patient?" Xu Shiyan and the three stepped forward to ask.
"The patient is old and has high blood pressure, and it may be that he fell again, causing brain hemorrhage.
The situation is a bit serious. Fortunately, you took some first aid measures and sent it to the hospital in time.
Hospitalized for observation and treatment, it may take some time. Are you a family member of a patient? "
The doctor took off his mask and explained the situation to Xu Shiyan and the others.
"Not family members, we are all from the Dongjiangyan brigade. The old man has no children, and only one wife is 60 years old." Xu Shiyan explained.
"No family members? Then this matter is not easy to handle.
How about this, let our brigade give a certificate to explain the situation of the elderly, and the hospital should find a way to take care of it. "
The doctor is nice. When he heard that the old man had no children and only had a wife who was quite old, he immediately said that he could take care of him.
"The old man will have to stay in the hospital for at least ten days and a half months. Our hospital is also busy. Try to let the nurses pay more attention during the day. It is best to have someone in your team take care of it at night."
They all belong to a commune, and the doctor knows that the production team is busy at this time of year.
It is estimated that no one would be happy to delay work and come to bed with someone who is not relatives or reasons, so I came up with this method.
Xu Shiyan and the others have no other choice. If it takes a day or two, anyone can go all out and not earn work points, so come and take care of them.
But if it takes ten days and a half a month, it's really unbearable, after all, everyone eats based on work points.
"Jianjian, Chunming, you two go back to the village, talk to Uncle Zhao and Aunt Li, and see how they arrange it.
I'll take care of it here first. "There's no need for all three of them to stay, Xu Shiyan sent Yang Chunming and Zhao Jianshe away.
Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming drove the carriage back to the village and told Zhao Dahai and Mrs. Li.
Old Mrs. Li was so frightened that her legs went limp when she heard that her husband was unconscious and hospitalized. Anyway, the old lady is in good shape, and she didn't say she was scared out of good or bad.
After recovering a bit, Mrs. Li hurriedly packed her things, she had to serve her husband.
Zhao Dahai is naturally not easy to stop. Besides, a wife is a companion when she is old.
"Sister-in-law, at your age, it's not easy to serve my old brother Li.
Let’s do it this way, you and doctors and nurses will take care of you during the day.
In the evening, I will send the young people in our team over, one person for one day, and I can arrange it anyway.
Let's stick to it for ten days and a half months. When Brother Li is in better health, he will take him home and take care of him slowly. "
This is the best way so far, and Mrs. Li is naturally very grateful.
So Zhao Dahai sent his son, Zhao Jianshe, to drive the car, and took Mrs. Li to the commune hospital with the certificate from the commune.
Old Mrs. Li went to the commune hospital, found a house near the hospital, borrowed their pots and stoves to cook, and served Lao Li.
Old Li has always been the only one at Qianchuan to participate in the field. His illness has blinded the team, so he had to choose another person to go up the mountain to watch the parade.
Originally, I thought that it wasn’t long before the snow fell and I was going to freeze. I would just find someone to go up the mountain to take care of it for a while, and then I could go down the mountain when the snow fell and the person was frozen, and I would arrange someone to rescue them in the spring of next year.
But I never expected that on the night of the third day of Lao Li's illness, the attendant went in to thieves.

chapters.title: Chapter 53: looking for someone to see ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 53 Find someone to read
Seeing ginseng is mainly to prevent people from stealing ginseng, and another is to prevent wild boars, black blinds and other animals from entering the ginseng field.
Dongjiangyan brigade is located in a remote place, except for the workers, few people go there on weekdays, and no one expects that there will be thieves.
Old Litou has been watching ginseng on the mountain for many years, and has never lost ginseng, but he has encountered wild boars and black blinds a few times.
No one expected that just after Lao Li had an accident and was hospitalized, thieves entered the field and lost his club.
Seeing ginseng is not too tiring.
The main thing is to prevent people from stealing ginseng before the ginseng is unearthed in spring and from autumn to ginseng.
I can’t sleep every night, and I have to take a walk in the venue, which is also called walking.
In summer, ginseng grows unearthed, and the underground root pulp is insufficient, so it is generally not thrown away.
After the land is covered by heavy snow in winter, it is so hard to dig everywhere that it is hard to dig. At that time, the ginseng spectators can go down the mountain with peace of mind.
Just because he felt that seeing ginseng was not a difficult job, Zhao Dahai found an old man in his fifties from the village.
Let him go to Qianchuan for a while, and he can come back after it freezes.
As a result, when the old man was sleeping in the house at night, the door was closed from the outside.
The dogs outside didn't know what they ate, and they all lay motionless on the ground.
The mallets for next year’s goods were stolen for nearly twenty feet.
The team was shocked when they found out, and immediately reported to the commune. The commune sent a public security assistant to investigate together with the militia from the brigade.
But after searching and searching, there was no result. This group of people worked neatly, and disappeared after turning around in the woods.
The snow has not yet fallen at this time, and there is no way to follow the footprints.
The Dongjiang River lost twenty feet of clubs for nothing, and the old man who saw ginseng also went home in a fright, and dared not go up the mountain to see ginseng.
Just kidding, he took his life.
In case those people are more cruel, they directly touch into the house and deal with him. In the wild in the mountains, when someone else finds it, the corpse will probably be completely cold.
When it came out, everyone was terrified. Zhao Dahai went to find people to go up the mountain one by one, but no one would agree.
Older people are afraid of accidents, and an old man on the mountain screams that every day should not be done, and the ground is not working.
Don’t say it’s another gang of thieves, just like Old Li, who suddenly fell ill and no one cares about him.
Young people are even more reluctant to go. The work points given by the participants are not high. How can it be compared to working in the team?
Even if there is no more life in the ginseng field in a few days, young people can still go to Jinshan Forest Farm to cut and carry wood. The wages are high, much more than ginseng.
Besides, Kanshen has been living on the mountain and can only go down the mountain after the Gregorian calendar year. It is too boring. How can young people be patient?
Zhao Dahai is so worried, it is still three months away from the freezing of the ground, what can we do on the mountain in these three months?
Can't he go up the mountain? Who will preside over the work in the team?
"San'er, I'm begging you, please help me with this.
Go to the mountain to see it for a while, and you will be counted as full work points every day. If you eat and drink on the mountain, you will be counted as a member of the team. "
Zhao Dahai was really at a loss, so he found Xu Shiyan and discussed with him.
The reason why he was looking for Xu Shiyan was because Xu Shiyan was young and the chance of accidents on the mountain was low.
Even if there is a little ailment, Xu Shiyan can cure it by himself, so that no accident will happen.
The other one is that Xu Shiyan's work is really average, and the steady and meticulous work is not bad.
He has never done such purely labor-intensive tasks as lifting logs and felling.
"Uncle Zhao, it is said that you have said so much, if I don't agree, I really shouldn't." Xu Shiyan was a little embarrassed.
In his previous life, he had been on the mountain to watch for many years, and he knew the tricks in it, but he was not afraid.
"Mainly Yingzi, she is pregnant with a child.
You said that I went up to the mountain to see the ginseng by myself, leaving her at home to do everything, I am not at ease. "
Xu Shiyan was worried about Su Anying. He lived on the mountain for two or three months, leaving Su Anying at home. Who would do the work of carrying water and chopping firewood?
Su Anying wants to be strong and refuses to beg others, but she is pregnant with a child, what if something goes wrong?
"Hey, what else is there? If it doesn't work, let Yingzi go up the mountain with you, and give her half of the work, right?"
When Zhao Dahai heard this, he was happy, and he thought nothing of it.
"When you two go up the mountain, everything you eat and drink is counted as part of our team, and both of you will get work points.
The two of you on your left and right also live in other people’s houses, and there is actually not much difference between the mountain and the village. Look, is this okay? "
Zhao Dahai is really at a loss. The clubs have not been planted yet, and the ginseng seeds have not been sown. There is still a long time before the frost, so the ginseng field cannot be kept guarded by militias.
Compared to the loss of throwing the mallet, Xu Shiyan and his wife's work points are good, and the food they eat is not a big deal.
"This..." Xu Shiyan didn't expect Zhao Dahai to say that, and he was really embarrassed.
The mountain is no better than the village, can Su Anying adapt to the mountain?
"Shiyan, Uncle Zhao has already talked about this, so you should agree.
It’s okay, I’ll go up the mountain with you, I’m not afraid of suffering. "
Su Anying, who was cooking in the outer room, had been keeping an eye on the room, and at this moment she entered the room with a spatula and said.
In Su Anying's mind, the husband and wife live in the same place, and they are not their own home anyway.
The couple went up to the mountain to see ginseng, and the food was managed by the team, and both of them were given work points. This is already very good, why not agree?
"San'er, you married a good wife, Yingzi knows the general idea."
When Zhao Dahai heard this, he became happy and praised Su Anying.
The daughter-in-law has expressed her opinion, what else can Xu Shiyan say? That can only nod in agreement.
"Uncle, it's okay to go up the mountain to see ginseng, but you have to promise me some things."
It was Zhao Dahai who came to beg him on his own initiative, not because he had to go up the mountain to see the ginseng, but he had to talk about the conditions.
"Whatever, you can just say it, as long as there is something in the team, you can just mention it."
It is not easy to find a referee, especially young people, who are not willing to go. Zhao Dahai has an idea now, as long as Xu Shiyan is willing to agree, he will give whatever he wants.
"When Uncle Li was looking at ginseng on the mountain, he used a stick handle. Uncle, you can get me a semi-automatic one with enough bullets."
Xu Shiyan has been thinking about this matter for a long time, and has never had a chance. Now that the opportunity comes to his door, he must get a good gun.
"Another one, please issue me a certificate. I have to go to the blacksmith furnace in the commune to forge a batch of things and keep them for reference."
There used to be six or seven dogs on the mountain. I don’t know what kind of medicine they took this time, but two dogs died of the medicine.
The others were also sick for a while and didn't recover well, so Xu Shiyan had to find another child.
It’s actually very simple to see the parade. Ground guns, crackers, clips, ground nails and other things are arranged around the field, and there are a few good dogs inside to warn, and thieves can’t get in at all.
Xu Shiyan wants to prove that he just wants to go to the blacksmith's furnace and shoot a batch of ground guns, ground nails and other things.

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Up the mountain to see ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 54 Going up the mountain to see reference
At this moment, Zhao Dahai, as long as Xu Shiyan is willing to go up the mountain to see ginseng, he will agree to any conditions, let alone for ginseng.
However, Zhao Dahai was also very curious, so he had to ask what Xu Shiyan wanted to do.
Naturally, there is no need to hide this, Xu Shiyan told Zhao Dahai what he wanted to do.
Ground gun, as the name suggests, is something similar to a gun installed on the ground, very simple.
An iron pipe more than two feet long, with a machine spring welded to the end of the gunpowder. At night, the machine spring is connected to the iron wire and tightened, and the other end of the iron wire is tied to a tree.
Once someone touches the wire, the machine spring springs to ignite the gunpowder, and the gun sand inside will be ejected.
This thing hits iron sand, not a bullet, and its lethality is not too strong.
However, when the gun sand is sprayed out, it is fan-shaped, and the impact area is very large. If someone triggers the machine spring and is bombarded, it will definitely be enough.
Ground guns can be loud enough to call the police, but also have a certain degree of lethality. Installing them in some hidden places around the venue is definitely a sharp weapon for watching.
This thing was equipped in almost all participants in the 1990s, and it was banned two thousand years later.
Let’s talk about the cannon, the principle of this thing is similar to that of a grenade, and its power is naturally not as powerful as a grenade.
At most, it is louder than the kind of crackers played by children in later generations, mainly for warning.
As for nail boards, clips and the like, they are basically the means used by hunters.
Anyway, these are all arranged around the venue, no matter if a thief or a wild beast comes, it is enough to drink a pot.
"Oh, look, I'll tell you that I'll definitely be able to find you for this matter." After hearing this, Zhao Dahai slapped his thigh happily.
"How do you think you have such a long brain? How can you come up with these ideas?
Success, I will issue a certificate for you right away, and all expenses will be recorded on the team. "
This is a matter of course. Kansan’s tool team pays for it, and it will still belong to the team in the future.
Zhao Dahai happily issued a certificate to Xu Shiyan. Xu Shiyan got up early the next morning and went straight to the blacksmith stove in the commune, while Su Anying packed his things at home and prepared to go up the mountain.
October 21st, Xu Shiyan prepared all the things he wanted, and he and Su Anying took the team's carriage to work in the mountains, and went straight to Qianchuan to participate in the field.
When people in the village learned that Xu Shiyan went up to the mountain to see ginseng, many people didn't think so.
"What a good young man, running up the mountain to look at the ginseng like the old man, and bringing his wife with him, is really worthless."
"I've said it a long time ago, with his little ability, he may not be able to catch up with a good old lady to earn more work points.
Winter is coming soon, there is not much work in the team, so I go up to the mountain to watch the scene, at least I can get some work points. "
"That's right, let me tell you, he's lucky enough to get a few ginseng trees this year.
Look at that virtue, I don't believe that a group of people are cheering their feet up, he can still be so lucky? "
In this world, there will never be a shortage of people who flatter and flatter you publicly, but secretly wish to stab you with a knife.
Xu Shiyan is considered to be a big hit this year. Many people in the village are chasing after him and want to take advantage of it.
But there are also some people who, on the surface, speak better than singing, but are secretly jealous and jealous, wishing Xu Shiyan could do something.
This is human nature. If you live well, others may not bless you, but if you live badly, a bunch of people will gloat immediately.
Xu Shiyan naturally didn't know what the villagers said, even if he knew, he didn't care.
Looking at the ginseng, there are many ways to go here. Those who know how to read the ginseng can make a lot of money in a few years.
Don't look at Xu Shiyan's performance in front of Zhao Dahai as if he was reluctant to go up the mountain, but in fact he wished he could live in the mountain.
Ever since Xu Shiyan and his wife came back from Tonghua, people came to the house all day long. Fortunately, many people came to borrow money.
These people don’t know why they are so thick-skinned. They don’t have any contacts on weekdays, and they borrow a hundred and eighty yuan as soon as they open their mouths, as if Xu Shiyan’s family’s money was blown by a strong wind.
Xu Shiyan had discussed with Su Anying a long time ago, no matter who came to borrow money, he would ignore it.
I only said that I will build a house and have a baby in the coming year, and my own money is not enough.
Even if you say that, there are still some people who are not reconciled. Xu Shiyan and his wife both have big heads because of the troubles in the village this autumn.
Zhao Dahai came to find Xu Shiyan, just following Xu Shiyan's heart.
The couple of them moved to the mountains, far away from the village, and lived their little life in peace, how nice?
Don’t say that the top of the mountain is inconvenient, in fact, there is no difference between the big house and the mountain, both are inconvenient.
As for the participation, there are those things that Xu Shiyan got, plus the guns provided by the brigade, and those dogs, don't worry at all.
Just like that, the young couple went up the mountain happily, while others were busy planting ginseng, the couple began to clean up everywhere.
When Lao Litou was here, the house was full of dust, and the putty on the kitchen pot was always thick.
Su Anying wrinkled her nose, splashed water, rolled up her sleeves and started cleaning.
Su Anying was busy cleaning up the house, while Xu Shiyan went around the field to dig traps, bury nail boards, place guns, and tie cannons. The couple were very busy.
Waiting for the ginseng planters on the mountain to get off work all day, Xu Shiyan also arranged all the things that should be arranged, and a sign was hung outside the gate of the ginseng field.
"There are ground guns around, please don't approach them, you will not be responsible for the injury? What is this thing? What is a ground gun?"
When the workers saw it, they were very puzzled, what did Xu Shiyan do?
"Third brother, tell me, what is a ground gun?" If you have such a good faith, ask Xu Shiyan.
"Well, I just want to tell you that in the future, when you come to work on the mountain, don't go near the circle of sticks around the venue."
If these people don’t ask, Xu Shiyan has to tell them, so as not to hurt someone by mistake.
"I not only installed ground guns, but also dug traps and buried nail boards. If anyone walks around, I don't care if they get hurt."
Xu Shiyan told everyone about the power of the ground gun, and then emphatically reminded, don't walk around.
Some people were illiterate and could not understand what was written on the sign at all, so Xu Shiyan explained it clearly to them face to face, and asked them to go back and tell their family members.
As I said in advance, if these people still run around indiscriminately, once they get injured, they will bear the consequences.
"Fuck, third brother, you are too ruthless."
After hearing this, a group of people’s expressions changed. It was so scary. If it was sprayed with a ground gun, they would suffer old crimes if they didn’t die.
"If I'm not ruthless, I can't do it. All the young and old in our village earn money by pointing at the stick. If I'm not ruthless, someone will come and steal it.
Let them steal it, what are the whole village pointing at? "Xu Shiyan smiled and said disapprovingly.
"Yes, yes, that's the reason, you can't be soft-hearted to those thieves.
The thief hasn’t been caught last time until now. If I caught him, I must beat him to death. "
Bringing this matter up, everyone gritted their teeth. If the thief was in front of them, they might be torn to pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 55: resume college entrance examination
chapters.content:
Chapter 55 Resuming the College Entrance Examination
Xu Shiyan took his daughter-in-law to Qianchuan to watch the parade, and happened to miss a big event.
On October 21st, the superiors announced a policy that the college entrance examination will resume this year, and all candidates who meet the requirements can take the exam.
Once the news was announced, it immediately attracted the attention of countless people.
Especially the educated youths who have been sent to the countryside, many of them are preoccupied with thinking about applying for the exam.
Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong on the Xu family's side were educated youths sent to the countryside.
However, both of them graduated from junior high school, and they didn't study well at the beginning, and now they are both married and have children. Even after knowing the news, they didn't think about signing up.
Xu Shixiang, on the other hand, immediately expressed his desire to sign up after hearing the news.
Xu Shixiang has graduated from high school for several years, and has been unwilling to work in the agricultural team to earn work points. He finally had this opportunity, so he naturally couldn't miss it.
If he let go of his previous temper, Xu Chenghou would probably curse again when he heard that the fifth child was going to take the college entrance examination.
This year's college entrance examination is at the beginning of December, and the time is very tight. Xu Shixiang must start reviewing immediately if he wants to take the exam.
You must know that Xu Shixiang is still very popular in the team, and he earns a lot of work points.
Xu Chenghou felt very distressed when he thought that his son would not be able to earn work points while preparing for the exam.
But since the third son was arguing about the separation of the family, and the younger couple went out to live alone, life is getting better and better. Xu Chenghou reflected on himself when he had nothing to do.
The more I think about it, the more I feel that he may be old, and his thoughts and vision cannot keep up.
So this time when the fifth child said he was going to take the college entrance examination, Xu Chenghou just sat there smoking for a long time without saying a word.
Xu Chenghou didn't speak, and the rest of the family couldn't speak rashly, but Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong's sister-in-law didn't like it.
There are a dozen or so members of the Xu family living together, and there are only a few men who can earn work points. If Xu Shixiang signs up for the college entrance examination, he will have one less labor force.
The sister-in-law wanted to talk, but didn't dare, so they reached out and poked their respective men.
Both Xu Shixian and Xu Shian knew what their daughter-in-law wanted to do, but they couldn't say it directly, so they could only wink at their respective daughter-in-laws.
"Okay, you all don't have to frown and fix those things, I'm not too old and dizzy to see clearly."
Zhou Guilan has been in charge of the family for so many years, how can she not guess what her son and daughter-in-law are thinking? Speak immediately.
"The fifth child signed up for the college entrance examination, I agree, this is an opportunity, a rare good opportunity."
Although Zhou Guilan is illiterate, she is very knowledgeable, much better than the average rural old lady.
"If you can really pass the exam and go to university, you will be a person on public food in the future, and you will no longer be a mud leg.
Being able to leave the countryside, without having to work in the fields all day long, and sit in an office to receive wages, is a good thing that others can only dream of. "
"Old five, you go to the commune tomorrow morning to ask for the registration form, and then tell your Uncle Zhao, and then go home and read the book to review.
Work hard, if you can be admitted to university, our old Xu family can be regarded as a glorious ancestor. "
The real master of the Xu family is Zhou Guilan, and the old lady said that this matter is considered a certainty.
"You guys, you don't have to feel that you are at a disadvantage.
I said before that when the fourth child gets married, we will separate and live separately in the spring of next year. "
Without waiting for the daughter-in-laws to make a fuss, Zhou Guilan directly spoke clearly. Now, the two daughters-in-law lost their temper.
Xu Shiyan on the mountain didn't know what happened at home. Even if he knew about the resumption of the college entrance examination, he didn't have the heart to take the exam.
At this moment, he is on the mountain, guarding the stove pit to burn walnut pine cones for Su Anying.
In the afternoon, when Xu Shiyan was digging traps and shooting guns outside the venue, he picked up some walnuts and shot a few pine cones.
This is the best thing about the mountain, it is far away from the village, there are few people coming, and there are many kinds of mountain products.
Su Anying is pregnant, and it is said that pregnant women eating more nuts is good for their children.
So when cooking just now, Xu Shiyan buried two pine cones in the stove pit, pulled out the pine cones after they were cooked, and the charcoal in the stove pit was quite prosperous.
So Xu Shiyan grabbed a large number of hickory nuts, dipped the front tip in cold water, and inserted them vertically into the charcoal fire.
After a while, you can hear a snap, and the front tip of the walnut splits.
When the pine cone is cooked, put it upright, lift your foot and kick hard, the pine nuts inside will burst out, and use your hands to pick the rest to find it.
One big pine cone can produce almost two taels of pine nuts, and two pine cones are enough for Su Anying to kowtow all night.
Fresh pine nuts are sweet and fragrant when they are cooked, and they are more delicious than dry and fried ones.
Su Anying held a pair of pliers in her hand, pinched them open one by one, and pulled out the pine nuts inside and piled them together.
While Xu Shiyan was not paying attention, he stuffed it into his mouth.
"I won't eat it, you can just eat it." Xu Shiyan froze for a moment, then laughed.
"Eating it is good for your health, especially for your children. It is said that eating more nuts will make your children brighter and smarter."
He has no desire for snacks, he eats when he has it, and forgets if he doesn’t.
For him now, nothing is as important as Su Anying and the child in her belly.
"There are so many, and you even burned walnuts. This way of eating, I guess I will be a ball before the baby is born."
Su Anying looked at her slightly protruding belly. It's only been a few months, and she feels like she's gained weight several times.
"It's okay, even if it becomes a ball, it will be the most beautiful one."
Xu Shiyan smiled, picked out a walnut from the stove pit, picked up a knife and chopped it down along the opening, just in time to split the walnut in half.
"Get an awl, pick the walnuts yourself, and I'll go out for a walk."
After all the walnuts were split open, Xu Shiyan got up and went out for a walk with a gun on his back.
The site of the big house is not big, and with the newly planted mallet field in autumn, it is only about two thousand feet long.
In this year, the roads in the ground are wide, so after conversion, it is about fifty or sixty acres of land.
Xu Shiyan carried a gun on his back, and held a flashlight in one hand, strolling around the field, shaking the grass outside with the flashlight from time to time, and then checking whether the sticks clamped around him were damaged.
In the evening, you have to go for a walk, basically you have to go around the venue and some main places inside.
Especially those places that are more convenient for people to come in, or where there are tall trees that can hide people, you have to check carefully.
Avoid someone sneaking into the ginseng field and stealing ginseng in the middle of the night.
Although Xu Shiyan set up various traps around the venue, he didn't dare to be careless. He wandered around wherever he should go.
If he lost the mallet in his hand, it would be a shame.
Xu Shiyan wandered around the venue for half a circle, everything was normal. Xu Shiyan was relieved, and walked back around the other side.
Just as he wandered to the southeast corner of the venue, he suddenly heard a bang, followed by a hog-killing howl.
It was the ground gun that rang out. Hearing the sound, the wild boar should have been wounded.
Xu Shiyan was shocked, and immediately ran towards the place where the gun was fired with a gun in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 56: wild boar
chapters.content:
Chapter 56 Wild boar
The wild boar has rough skin and thick meat.
Especially the adult wild boars, who roll in the mud all day long and rub itchy on the trees.
A mixture of mud, gravel, pine oil and other things will be hung on the shoulder blades and back, which is also called wild boar armor.
Generally speaking, ground guns produce gun sand. Although they cover a wide area, their lethality is insufficient.
Dealing with a wild boar that has already hung armor, I am afraid that the skin cannot be penetrated, and the wild boar cannot be hurt at all.
So Xu Shiyan felt strange, how could there be a wild boar hurt and howling?
And listening to that voice, it seems that the injury is not serious?
The location of the gunshot was very close to Xu Shiyan. You could hear the howling of wild boars in the woods, and you could also hear the sound of wild boars running rampant in the woods.
It can be clearly heard that the wild boar was running around in the woods to escape after being injured.
Xu Shiyan was impatient, but there was nothing he could do. At this moment, the sky was already dark, his vision was affected, and he was in the overgrown forest, so he had no way to chase him.
Just when Xu Shiyan was very annoyed, he suddenly heard a plop, followed by the tragic cry of a wild boar.
Xu Shiyan was overjoyed, knowing that the wild boar had fallen into the trap he dug during the day because of his panic.
There was not enough time in the daytime, so Xu Shiyan dug two traps, one of which was near here.
The pit was as high as a person, and there was a nail board inside. The iron nails on the nail board were more than three inches long, and they were extremely sharp.
Sure enough, the screams of the wild boar continued one after another, always fixed in one position, and that direction was exactly the trap Xu Shiyan dug.
Knowing that the wild boar fell into the trap, Xu Shiyan was not in a hurry, and returned to the small room with a gun on his back.
As soon as she opened the door and entered, she saw Su Anying standing there nervously with a kitchen knife in her hand.
Seeing that it was Xu Shiyan who came in, Su Anying was relieved.
"What's the matter? I heard a bang just now, as if something else was calling?"
"Well, it should be a wild boar, touched the line of the ground gun, and was collapsed by the ground gun.
I listened, I seemed to have fallen into a trap again, it’s all right, I’ll get up early tomorrow morning, I’ll go and have a look, it’s too late at this time, I can’t see anything clearly. "
Xu Shiyan installed a lot of institutions nearby, and it was too dark at night to see clearly, so Xu Shiyan didn't dare to go there rashly, so let's wait until the morning.
Knowing that it was a wild boar, Su Anying was also relieved, and quickly put down the kitchen knife.
"You don't have to come in and be a thief. I'm afraid you're walking outside. What if you meet a thief?"
Xu Shiyan smiled, hugged his wife's shoulders, and the two walked into the back room.
"Don't worry, where are there so many thieves? Let me tell you, the last time I threw the mallet, there must be an insider."
Xu Shiyan had already thought about this matter, and the timing of throwing the club was too coincidental.
Old Li had an accident and was hospitalized. He just found someone who is not very good at reading, and he lost his club?
And those people come in, don't go anywhere else, just rush to the frozen stick?
You must know that the leaves of the mallet are all withered at this time. If you are not a knowledgeable person, how can you steal so accurately?
The mallet is nearly twenty feet long, and no matter how low the output is, it can weigh more than two hundred catties. It takes a lot of time to process and make the goods before selling them.
Now that the police are arresting everywhere, it is not easy for the thief who stole the mallet to hide, and he will never dare to go up the mountain to steal again.
Su Anying is not that interested in these, anyway, as long as Xu Shiyan is safe and sound.
It was getting late, the two of them packed up and had a rest.
In the middle of the night, Xu Shiyan went out for a walk again, and there was nothing unusual everywhere.
Wait until dawn, Xu Shiyan wandered out of the field with a gun on his back and a rope and other things, and came to the location where the gunshot fired last night.
The wire of the ground gun was tripped, and the gunpowder and gun sand in the gun were also emptied, and some blood can still be seen nearby.
Xu Shiyan didn't search hard along the bloodstains, but went straight to the trap.
When I got to the other side of the trap, I saw that some of the branches covering it had already fallen into the pit.
Taking a closer look into the pit, there was indeed a dark thing inside, which was quite big, and it was estimated to weigh at least two hundred and sixty-seven kilograms.
I don’t know if he was injured and bled to death overnight, or he lost his strength because of the tossing, anyway, the pig didn’t move in the trap.
Xu Shiyan didn't go down rashly, but raised his gun and shot the wild boar in the head first.
Sure enough, a shot hit the head of the wild boar, and the wild boar let out a muffled grunt, twitched a few times in the trap, and then stopped moving.
After confirming that the wild boar was really dead, Xu Shiyan was relieved.
Tie the rope to a nearby tree, go down the rope by yourself, avoid the nail plate underneath, and tie the rope to the wild boar.
After the wild boar was tied up, Xu Shiyan climbed up along the rope, cut some wood to make a temporary winch, and dragged the wild boar up from below.
It took a lot of effort, and finally dragged the wild boar back to the yard.
So they called Su Anying to help, and the couple disemboweled and skinned the wild boar.
"Daughter-in-law, you sell those pigs and feed them to the dogs."
Xu Shiyan only took off the pig's heart and put it aside. He didn't want the rest of the goods. He asked Su Anying to feed it to the dog.
Su Anying was obviously taken aback, "Huh? Feed the dog?"
Don't blame Su Anying, people don't eat much meat these days, even if it's off the shelf, they still eat the same after packing it up, how can they be willing to feed the dog?
"Well, hey the dogs, those dogs were drugged before, and they have not been very energetic.
We see that the ginseng is mainly pointing at them, feeding them the off-the-shelf goods, and replenishing them, maybe they will get better soon. "
Dogs play a very important role in the participation. These dogs were carefully fed and trained by Mr. Li. With them, it is much easier to watch the participation.
"Don't worry, we will definitely not be short of meat in the future. After raising those dogs, I will be free in a few days. I will try to take them into the mountains to hunt."
Old Litou himself is an excellent gunner, and the dogs he raises are definitely not bad, and those dogs are all famously powerful.
It's a pity that Lao Li is too old to go up the mountain, wasting those few good dogs.
As soon as Su Anying heard what Xu Shiyan said, she stopped being entangled, so she went straight to the kennel next to her with the goods.
Originally there were seven dogs on the mountain, but the last time people came in, two of them were poisoned to death.
The remaining five dogs were also sick and not very energetic, so Xu Shiyan put them all in a nearby warehouse.
If Su Anying came to feed these dogs when they were still healthy, they would definitely not recognize them.
But at this moment, the dogs are still wilting, and they don't have much temper.
Furthermore, they might have smelled the smell of meat, and they got up from the ground one by one unsteadily, looking at Su Anying with longing eyes.
Su Anying divided the goods in the basin into several portions, put them in the dog food bowls, and sent them to several dogs.
"Eat, eat and get better soon."
Perhaps feeling Su Anying's kindness, the dogs didn't bark, and lowered their heads to eat the pigs in the pot.
In this year, people may not be able to eat enough, let alone dogs?
Because these dogs are watching ginseng on the mountain, the food is controlled by the team. On weekdays, it is corn noodles with some potatoes or something.
I have never been hungry, but it is impossible to eat meat.
Today, I opened meat suddenly, good guy, everyone is not sluggish, I am afraid that I will eat too late, like a storm, I ate all the pigs.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: there is meat to eat
chapters.content:
Chapter 57 There is meat to eat
Su Anying went to feed the dog, while Xu Shiyan took the skin and bone from the pork, chopped it into large pieces and put it away.
A sow weighing 250 to 60 catties has gone to the store, and there are nearly 200 catties left.
Autumn is the time when wild boars are fattening. The walnuts, scallions, hazelnuts, jujubes, etc. in the mountains are full of food, so don’t you just save a belly of fat for the winter?
This is a good time, it all falls to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan cut off all the sacs under the pig's belly and piled them up in a porcelain basin.
Nowadays, what people love most is fat meat, and these are good things.
"Daughter-in-law, in a while you'll be cutting out these saccharine fat meat."
Xu Shiyan just finished dividing the meat here, and Su Anying also came back after feeding the dog, Xu Shiyan pointed to the fat in the basin and said.
"Let's keep a portion of the waist and back on the mountain. When the second brother or the fifth brother go to work on the mountain, let them take some back home."
Xu Shiyan said as he put the meat back together, put it in a basin and put it in a cool place.
There is so much meat, how can the couple eat it all?
At this time, the snow has not yet fallen and frozen. Although the temperature is quite low, the meat cannot be preserved for too long.
There are still several months before the slaughter of pigs during the Chinese New Year. Who doesn't feel uncomfortable?
Wild boar meat is also meat. Now that I have met it, I can’t enjoy it alone. I always give some to my family.
Su Anying doesn't care what Xu Shiyan arranges.
Once you get good things, you should respect the elderly. This is your duty.
No matter how unreasonable Xu Chenghou is, he is still an elder, and they have to do what they should do.
So, Su Anying took the knife, and started to cut the meat quickly, cutting all the fat meat into pieces of the same size.
After cutting, fire at the bottom of the pot, add half a scoop of water to the pot, then pour the fat into the pot, and put a little salt.
As the temperature of the bottom of the pot rises, the fat in the pot is also cooked.
When the water in the pot evaporates almost, no more firewood is added to the bottom of the pot, and the fire is slowly boiled like this.
The original fat gradually turned golden yellow, and there was a layer of clear oil on the bottom of the pot, and a smell of burnt aroma also came out, which made people sniff.
Su Anying pushed the fat all around with a spoon, and then scooped out the oil one by one.
The surrounding fat continued to produce oil, and made a sizzling sound, which sounded very pleasant.
Natives, tube plate oil or the substance left after fat refining is called Youzila, because this thing makes such a sound during the refining process.
With the continuous precipitation of oil, the oil becomes smaller and smaller, and finally becomes crispy and burnt.
Su Anying took a shovel and squeezed the oil hard, making sure that the oil content was almost controlled, and then quickly poured the oil into a small basin.
After all, it is a wild boar, which cannot be compared with domestic pigs. The fat of this wild boar is finally refined into a small jar of oil, and there is a small pot of oil.
The oil was refined in the pot, and the oil was so bright that Su Anying couldn't bear to wash the pot directly.
So I quickly peeled some potatoes, cut a few slices of meat, stewed it in a pot, and pasted pancakes on the side of the pot.
After finishing all these tasks, it was almost seven o'clock.
Before the couple had eaten, they heard a commotion outside. Needless to say, he must have come up the mountain to work.
"Third brother, third brother, what are you doing and haven't left the house yet? Could it be that you are still sleeping with your wife in your arms?"
How can young people have so many taboos? A few young men who got along well with Xu Shiyan came to Xiaofang carrying things, chatting and laughing.
Xu Shiyan pushed the door and came out, "Shut up, don't talk nonsense, your sister-in-law is thin-skinned and annoyed her, be careful not to serve you hot meals at noon."
As soon as the door was opened, the aroma in the kitchen wafted out, and Yang Chunming and Zhao Jianshe and the others sniffed their noses twice.
"Third brother, what delicious food do you two cook? Why does it smell like meat?
Oh, you two are living a good life, and there is still meat to eat on the mountain. "
Zhao Jianshe was younger and had an out-of-the-ordinary temperament and liked to joke, so he asked loudly at this time.
Xu Shiyan glared at Zhao Jianshe, "You have such a loud voice, isn't it uncomfortable not to shout?"
They are all very good brothers, and they don’t need to worry too much about speaking.
