"Last night, a wild boar ran into the ground gun I installed, and by coincidence, it hit the eye."
I found out when I was dragging the wild boar this morning that one eye of the wild boar was beaten blind.
"The one who ran around and bumped into the trap fell into the trap again. I went and dragged it up this morning." Xu Shiyan explained a few words casually.
"When you go home in the afternoon, don't forget to come and pick up a piece of meat, and go back to let the family satisfy their hunger."
Youdao means that mountain wealth cannot be enjoyed exclusively, not to mention brothers who get along so well, there are always some good things to score.
Zhao Jianshe was overjoyed when he heard it, "Third Brother, aren't you too good? You only came to the mountain for a day, and you got a wild boar?"
When I was happy, I couldn't control my voice.
"Yes, you can shout vigorously, and wait to call others over. Your share of meat will be snatched away, I don't care."
Good things are given to everyone, and friends don’t feel bad when they take them away. Xu Shiyan is not so generous if it is replaced by others.
Zhao Jianshe shrank his shoulders when he heard the words, raised his hands and scratched his head, laughing.
"I was wrong, third brother, I was wrong, but don't give the meat to others."
It is not easy to eat meat once a month this year. Even if the family raises pigs, they will have to kill them during the Chinese New Year.
And if you kill it, you have to sell half of it to the supply and marketing cooperative, and the rest can be eaten by yourself.
Even this half pig, it is impossible to open it up and eat it. It has to be kept for Chinese New Year hospitality, and some must be preserved for pickling or air-dried to eat slowly.
Seeing that bit of meat all year round, who wouldn't be greedy? Zhao Jianshe was afraid that Xu Shiyan really gave the meat to others, so he hurriedly begged for mercy.
Xu Shiyan was just trying to frighten Zhao Jianshe. If there are no others, he should send some to the Zhao family.
"Why didn't you see our second and fifth children? What did they do? They didn't come to the mountain today?"
Xu Shiyan took a few glances outside, but he didn't see Xu Shian and Xu Shixiang, so he couldn't help being curious.
"Oh, Second Brother Xu is doing other work today. Your fifth child is going to sign up for the college entrance examination. He said he is studying at home, so he won't come." Yang Chunming spoke over there.
"Aunt Xu asked us to bring these, saying that she was afraid that you would have no food to eat on the mountain."
Yang Chunming pointed to the two bags on the ground, which contained cabbage, radishes, potatoes and pumpkins.
It was precisely because Zhou Guilan asked them to bring these dishes that they didn't go to work directly, but went straight to the small room.
"Third brother, let's go to work first.
They all said that the weather might change recently, and the captain said that he must hurry up and plant a stick, so as not to snow or freeze. "
There is still a lot of work to be done in Shendi, and Yang Chunming and Zhao Jianshe didn't have time to stay for long. After a few words, they hurried to work.
Yang Chunming and Yang Chunming left, Xu Shiyan moved the vegetables brought by the family to the warehouse, then turned and went back to the house, and had breakfast with Su Anying.
Stewed potatoes with oily slices of meat, pancakes with salty and oily water, and a piece of fragrant and crispy oil. There is no one in these days.
As for eating something so oily early in the morning, is it okay? Who cares, as long as there is something to eat, what do you care about?
Oil residue, oil shuttle, oil stains, I don’t know what you call them.

chapters.title: Chapter 58: heartbroken
chapters.content:
Chapter 58
Xu Shiyan's main duty on the mountain is to watch references, and he can ignore the others.
So after breakfast, Xu Shiyan continued to carry the shovel to dig the trap.
Su Anying is a restless person, she has to go to the forest to pick up mushrooms, walnuts and so on.
Xu Shiyan was worried about his wife, so he asked Su Anying to follow him.
Where Xu Shiyan dug a hole, Su Anying just scratched some mushrooms, walnuts, hazelnuts, etc. nearby.
Before the workers had a rest at noon, Su Anying went back to heat everyone's meals and hot water to make everyone eat more comfortably.
When he got off work in the afternoon, Xu Shiyan distributed three or four catties of meat to Yang Chunming, Zhao Jianshe and several other people who got along well with each family.
Also asked Zhao Jianshe to bring a whole son to the Xu family with a waistband.
Now, the news that Xu Shiyan got a wild boar on the first day he entered the mountain, he couldn't hide it.
Even before nightfall, most people in the village knew about it, and what every household was talking about was about Xu Shiyan and the wild boar.
Those behind-the-scenes discussions at the beginning felt that Xu Shiyan, a young man, went up to the mountain to see the parade, and he was not promising. Now he regrets it.
"If I had known that going to the mountain to see ginseng would be beneficial, you brothers should go. This is good, and the old Xu's family took advantage of it."
"Look at the family, the couple went up the mountain to see ginseng, and they both earned work points. The team was in charge of food, and they could even handle wild boars.
I told you to go, but I didn’t listen. Now it’s all right, the old Xu and his wife took advantage of it. "
There are not a few people who think so.
In the past, when Old Li was looking at ginseng on the mountain, the big guys didn't care about the job of looking at ginseng.
They all thought it was the team taking care of Old Li, just finding him an errand to eat and drink.
Later, Lao Li got sick and lost his club in the ginseng field. Then everyone suddenly realized that ginseng watching is also a very dangerous job.
Now, when they learned that Xu Shiyan and his wife not only earned work points on the mountain, but also had other benefits, some people felt unbalanced.
And Kancan, who was not considered a good job in the eyes of everyone, suddenly turned into a sweet pastry in the eyes of everyone.
People are divided into classes, there are always good people and bad people.
Some people, they have no ability, they are so ambitious, their eyes are high and their hands are low.
But once other people get well, he will be jealous and jump up and down.
A person like this can't do anything else, but a little poke in the back is the best.
So, someone found Zhao Dahai and other cadres, and the meaning behind the words was that they wanted to go to see Shen and push Xu Shiyan and his wife down.
"Ms. Dutt's farting, this one is uneasy and good-hearted."
Zhao Dahai was very annoyed. During the team meeting, he started to curse.
"It's a good job to look at the reference now. Everyone is staring and trying to squeeze in. Why did you go so early?"
"When I went door to door asking for help and asked them to go up the mountain to see ginseng, their heads shook like rattles."
"Xu Jiasan'er is honest. As soon as I opened my mouth, he nodded in response. He also helped to figure out a way to come up with so many reference tools."
"Now we all know that there are ground guns, cannons, and traps on the mountain. It's easy to see, and you can catch wild boars for meat. You're all jealous, right?"
"It's useless to be jealous. From today on, if anyone dares to intercede with you again, I will deduct his work points."
Zhao Dahai was so angry that he bombarded the team headquarters, causing everyone to shrink their necks and bow their heads, and no one dared to say anything.
This incident soon spread throughout the village. When those thoughtful people heard about the deduction of work points, they were too frightened to run around to dig connections and go through the back door.
This turmoil quickly spread to the ears of the Xu family, and Xu Chenghou got angry and cursed when he found out.
Of course, this time they are scolding outsiders.
"These shameless things, how can they lick their faces and say that they want to replace us three?
Without the strange things that the third of us made, just relying on their bears, can you see the stick on the mountain? "
Xu Chenghou was very angry. He felt that the people in the village were too careless and uneasy.
"Then when Old Li was around, didn't there be any accidents in the field? Your son is the only one capable?"
Zhou Guilan sat on the kang, muttering while sewing cotton clothes.
"Old Li? He is a well-known gunner in a big house, and he was a great hunter when he was young.
A few years ago, I won the marksmanship competition with others. Can ordinary people compare with Lao Litou?
Not to mention, those dogs he raised are all very powerful. With him in the arena, who would dare to make trouble? "
Xu Chenghou shook his head, thinking that the old woman was at home all day and really didn't understand anything.
"Those dogs are amazing? Why are they drugged?" Zhou Guilan was puzzled.
"That's why you asked, those dogs were raised by Mr. Li himself, and dogs understand human nature.
Old Li fell ill like this, the dogs couldn't see him, so he must not eat and lose energy. The old Hu went up from behind, probably didn't understand.
The thief who stole the mallet deep-fried the steamed buns and stuffed them with medicine. The dog has been hungry for several days, and if he meets the delicious steamed buns, will he not eat them? "
These are not Xu Chenghou's nonsense, they were all found out by people sent by the commune.
The thieves who went to steal the mallet were all experts in dealing with dogs. Even the best dogs could not escape from those people.
"According to what you say, it's really not an easy job to see references? Can the three of us do it?"
Zhou Guilan finished sewing a thread, picked up the thread board, and put on another thread, without looking up, she said casually with a little disdain in her tone.
"Why can't San'er do it? Our San'er is very good. He can even kill wild boars, so what's the point?"
Xu Chenghou was a little unhappy when he heard what his wife said.
Zhou Guilan stopped sewing, raised her head, and looked at her husband with a half-smile.
"Oh, after eating the pork that San'er sent back, you think San'er is capable, right?
Didn’t you just hear that he went to the mountains to see ginseng? Your nose is not a nose and a face is not a face? "
Xu Chenghou's face was flushed red by his wife's words.
"It's been a long time. You dug a big hole and waited for me here." Xu Chenghou raised his hand and wiped his face, and said embarrassingly.
"In the past, I underestimated San'er. I didn't expect our San'er to have such abilities." Xu Chenghou sat on the kang and sighed.
It is impossible to say that you have no regrets.
Xu Chenghou never imagined that his son, who in his eyes was a coward who couldn't be beaten by three sticks, would have such a great ability after the separation.
If only we knew earlier? He couldn't throw his son out anyway.
But it's too late to say anything now, the young couple live a carefree life, what does the family have to do with them?
"Now you know you regret it? Hmph, let me see if you dare to scold me again in the future?
Now he is still thinking about his home anyway, he sold the mallet for the first time, and went back to buy a bunch of things.
The second time I didn’t buy anything, I sneakily gave me a hundred dollars.
If you scold him again and hurt him to the core, he will just ignore you, what else can you do? "What is piercing the heart, this is it.

chapters.title: Chapter 59: take the dog into the mountains
chapters.content:
Chapter 59 Bringing the dog into the mountains
Xu Shiyan, who was living a carefree life with his wife on the mountain, had no idea that the commotion in the village was going upside down.
I don't know what his mother said, which pierced his father's heart.
What Xu Shiyan has to do every day is to dig a hole.
Dig more pits, and put nail boards in places near the venue where thieves are easy to come in.
Not only digging holes, but also setting traps.
Large animal trap with sharp sawtooth, the kind that can break the legs even if a wild boar or a blind man is caught.
Of course, he wrote a sign near each clip to prevent people from touching it by mistake.
The clip is mainly to prevent wild animals, not to hurt people.
In a place farther away, the traps are used, the big ones use oil silk ropes, and the small ones use iron wires. This is purely for hunting.
Anyway, he stays on the mountain every day, just poking around these things, three layers of traps inside and outside surround the participants.
Whether it is a human or a beast, as long as you don't follow the right path and want to get close to the competition, you will bear the consequences.
Of course, at every intersection leading to the venue, there will be a sign with warning words written on it, reminding those who enter the mountain to be careful.
Not only that, the village also cooperated very much. Zhao Haihai specially used the big loudspeaker of the village to shout for several days, warning everyone not to approach the venue.
At the same time, Zhao Dahai also reported to the commune.
This is a new reference method, if it works well, it needs to be promoted throughout the commune.
Besides, I have to let other brigades know, don't run to Qianchuan's side.
The mountain is so big, there are so many good things elsewhere, why bother to come here to make trouble?
Anyway, the duty of reminding has been fulfilled. If someone has to risk his life and rush into this forest, he deserves it if he dies.
Don't say what is unreasonable or unreasonable, domineering or not.
Protecting the property of the whole village is a necessary means. It has been notified.
As for whether hunting is illegal or not? No need to think about this.
Nowadays, there are still many wild animals. In autumn, black and blind wild boars go into the fields to harm crops, and in winter, hungry wolves can enter villages to pick up children.
Now we are talking about animal protection? stop talking.
So Xu Shiyan is at ease and boldly digs the trap, not worried at all.
Paying will definitely pay off. These days, I have caught several hares and pheasants one after another. I also caught a small wild boar and two roe deer.
Life on the mountain has gradually become richer. There is meat in the bowl and oily water in the stomach. Su Anying's complexion is obviously better, and the whole person is plump.
Even those dogs ate well after Zhanguang'er, gradually became energetic, and became closer to Xu Shiyan.
In the blink of an eye, Xu Shiyan and his wife have been up the mountain for more than half a month.
The work in the ginseng field is almost the same. The sticks are planted, the ginseng seeds are sown, and the cold-proof soil is all finished.
Only the newly planted ginseng ground is left, and the pillars are smashed, and the ginseng shed can be made in the next spring.
November 7th was the beginning of winter, and the first snow of the year fell.
If it is placed on the ground, it will be only **** thick, and it will melt slowly when the sun rises, making it unable to stand.
But the mountains are different. The snow falls on the high mountains and the frost hits the depressions. The snow on the mountains is thicker, and the temperature is lower. The snow on the shady slopes does not see the sun, so it just stops.
It's snowing, and the sky and the earth are white, covering the dust and hustle and bustle, but it also makes some things show their traces.
"This snow is good. When the snow stops, you can take your dog into the mountains to hunt." In the evening, Xu Shiyan looked at the snowflakes flying outside and said happily.
"Are you going hunting? Why don't you just leave it? Isn't it good for us now? Hunting is very dangerous, don't hurt you."
When Su Anying heard that her husband was going to hunt, she couldn't help frowning, and said very worriedly.
"That's different. We're just waiting foolishly now, and it's up to God whether we have prey or not.
This mountain is so big, wild animals in the mountain cannot always rush to our side.
It’s winter, and those meats and other things can be put away. I’ll get some wild animals and eat them slowly. "Xu Shiyan knew that his wife was worried about him, so he explained patiently.
Not just for the bite, but more importantly, to find ways to make money.
It is true that there are work points to be earned when watching ginseng on the mountain, but with that little work point, it is nothing more than a year's work, and there is nothing left.
The daughter-in-law is pregnant, and their first child will be born next spring.
Judging from the current situation, this baby should be able to be kept, and Su Anying can't let Su Anying live with the baby on the mountain, right? Gotta have a home of my own.
This is a lot of money. Although there is money to put mountains, it can’t just sit and eat. You still have to find a way to make money.
The beasts in the mountains are not only edible, such as the black blind gall, the musk of the musk deer, and the antler of the sika deer are all good medicinal materials.
As for sable, raccoon dog, squirrel, and otter, they are all high-quality fur, and the purchase price is not low.
Guarding the treasure house of Changbai Mountain, taking advantage of the incessant hunting in these days, he can earn money by hunting openly, how could Xu Shiyan miss the opportunity?
"Don't worry, I'm carrying a gun and leading those dogs.
The dogs raised by Uncle Li are all good seedlings, and they have surrounded Qu Cai in the ginseng garden all day long.
Those dogs should be trained well, they are all good hunters. "
A hunter is happier seeing a good dog than seeing gold, silver and jewelry. How can a good dog be blinded in vain?
Su Anying knew that she couldn't persuade Xu Shiyan, so she simply didn't persuade him, and only told Xu Shiyan to be careful.
The next day when the snow stopped, Xu Shiyan didn’t move, and honestly went to the house to chop firewood and carry water.
Su Anying was still wondering, didn't she mean to go hunting, why is there no movement?
Animals are not humans after all. There was no snow in spring, summer, and autumn. The first snow fell suddenly, and the animals in the mountains were confused.
On the first day after the snow fell, all the animals in the mountains lay down in their nests and did not move. Naturally, if the animals did not come out, there would be no footprints. It would be useless to go hunting in the mountains.
But those animals were hungry, they lay in their nests for a long time, and in the afternoon they were so hungry that they had to come out to wander around for food.
In this way, marks will be left on the ground.
The hunter can identify which kind of animal it is through the footprints and traces in the snow, and hunting is relatively easy.
So Xu Shiyan stayed at home for a day without stopping. On the third day early in the morning, Xu Shiyan got up lightly, made breakfast, and ate dog food.
By the time Su Anying got up, Xu Shiyan had already finished eating, packed up and was ready to go.
"Leaving so early?" Women are sleepy after pregnancy, Su Anying is considered diligent, getting up at 6:30 in the morning.
As a result, as soon as he left the house, he saw Xu Shiyan wearing leggings in the outhouse, and knew that he was going to go up the mountain.
"Well, let's go early, those dogs haven't hunted before, and today I mainly want to walk them."
Xu Shiyan **** his leggings, straddled a bag diagonally, and stuffed the food into the bag.
"After I go out, you can just lock the door directly. No one will come to work on this day, and no matter who calls, you don't have to answer them."
The work in the ginseng field is almost done, and it has just snowed, and the road and the ginseng field are full of mud during the day.
No one will come, so Xu Shiyan set off with three dogs at ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: fight wild boar
chapters.content:
Chapter 60 Fighting Wild Boars
There were five dogs in the camp, but Xu Shiyan couldn't bring them all out. He was afraid that these dogs would not be easy to bring because they had never gone hunting in the mountains before.
Old Li is getting old, although his marksmanship is good, but his physical strength is not good enough.
It is not easy to go hunting in the mountains, the mountains are full of people climbing up and down, and the old people cannot do it at all.
On weekdays, Old Li is just using traps, traps and other prey to get some prey to fight tooth festivals. Occasionally, wild boars run into the venue and kill them. These dogs have no chance to go up the mountain with him.
Xu Shiyan went up the mountain alone with dogs who had no hunting experience. There were too many for him to take care of.
So I can only bring three of them first, and the other two next time, and wait until they are all trained before bringing them out together.
Out of Shenchangzi, Xu Shiyan took the dog all the way to the southwest. About six or seven miles southwest of Shenchangzi, there was a large oak forest.
The oak tree looks very similar to the southern oak tree, and the fruit of the oak tree is also very similar to the acorn, and the locals call it 萫子.
Lisium seed contains a lot of starch, which is a good food for pigs. Many people will go to the forest in autumn to pick up scallion seed and feed it to pigs.
Domestic pigs love to eat, not to mention wild boars. Wild boars often appear there in winter, so that forest is also called wild boar forest.
Xu Shiyan planned to take the three dogs to the wild boar forest to try his luck. After all, these three dogs had never hunted and had no experience, so it would be useless to go elsewhere.
It was around six o'clock when Xu Shiyan came out of the field. He led three dogs all the way across the mountains, and when he arrived outside the wild boar forest, it was past seven thirty.
As soon as I arrived at the outskirts of the wild boar forest, I saw the hoofprints of several animals on the snow. The shape looked like that of a wild boar.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly untied the ropes of the three dogs, and the three dogs immediately shook their hairs, and then sniffed.
One of the big yellow dogs lowered his head and sniffed the footprints, his eyes immediately changed, and he ran into the woods with his legs loose.
When the other two dogs saw this, they also ran into the woods, and Xu Shiyan also followed with a gun on his back.
The three dogs hadn’t run far when they heard a barking sound. You could tell from the sound that the big yellow dog had spotted the target and was calling for its companions.
Sure enough, the barking of the other two dogs also sounded immediately, followed by a burst of barking.
There are sounds of "choo'er", "choo'er", "houer", and "phener" in the middle. Needless to say, it must be the sound of a wild boar.
Xu Shiyan took off the gun from his back, pulled down the safety, held the gun in his hand, and walked forward quickly.
Going around a few trees and a big rock, I saw seven or eight wild boars running up the hillside.
This group of wild boars should have come to the wild boar forest yesterday afternoon or evening to look for food. After eating, they found a nest under a tree to rest.
Pigs are lazy. If no one alarms them, they won’t get up until ten o’clock in the morning.
This is also the reason why Xu Shiyan got up early and took the dogs out, just to stop the pigs before they started their nests.
The pigs were sleeping soundly, and suddenly they were awakened by the barking of a dog, and ran away in a panic.
Animals like wild boars are also very interesting. They don’t have much family values. When danger comes, don’t worry about parents and children, and run for their lives.
And the more pigs gather together, the more cowardly they are and the faster they run.
When tigers hunt pigs, they always follow behind the group of pigs, chasing them relentlessly.
Once the old pigs and piglets are too weak to run and fall behind the pigs, they will be killed by tigers.
Therefore, the tiger also has the nickname of swineherd.
But it would be different if it was a single boar. A mad boar would dare to fight a tiger.
Especially its two sharp fangs are definitely sharp weapons, even the king of beasts may not be an opponent.
Three dogs rushed into the herd of pigs and scattered the pigs in all directions.
The big yellow dog took the lead, and took a bite at the most vulnerable rear of the pig behind.
The pig wailed as it was bitten, and when it turned around, its long mouth was about to pout at the big yellow dog.
At this time, the other two dogs also caught up, and one of them, a big green dog with a green coat, stepped forward and took a bite under the wild boar's front elbow.
Wild boar armor, with a mixture of turpentine and gravel stuck to the back and shoulders, which cannot be penetrated by ordinary knives, let alone dogs, which cannot be bitten at all.
But the place where the front elbow is below is equivalent to a creaking nest of a human being. No matter how much armor is attached to this place, it will not be able to hang it.
The wild boar is in pain, so it doesn't care to turn around and stick to the rhubarb dog.
This is a boar. The locals call it a running basket. Boars are generally larger in size, three to four hundred catties are common, and big running baskets are also five to six hundred catties.
The boar in front of me probably weighed nearly 400 catties. It was big and strong, and was bitten by the green dog, so he threw it out with a strong shake.
Qinggou fell out, but was not injured, and got up again after rolling skillfully.
The boar got angry, and rushed towards the green dog, bowed his head with long fangs in his long mouth, if the fangs were closed, the sharp fangs would be able to open the green dog's stomach.
Fortunately, the rhubarb dog came up at this time and took another bite, still in the same place.
The big bulging bag on the back of the boar was directly held in the mouth by the big yellow dog, and it was all at once.
This time, it was a heart-wrenching pain, and you could hear how tragic the big boar's cry was.
The boar's eyes were red from the pain, and he turned madly and rushed towards the big yellow dog.
At this time, the flower dog, who hadn't stepped forward, rushed over and bit the wild boar's ear.
On the other side, Qinggou also came up and bit the wild boar again under the front elbow.
The wild boar couldn't care less about picking the big yellow dog at this time, so he threw the green dog and the flower dog away with all his might, desperately trying to run away.
The three dogs grew up together since they were young. Although they have never gone hunting in the mountains before, they have a good understanding and cooperate very well.
The three dogs were not willing to let the wild boar run away. They surrounded the wild boar and took turns to bite.
The wild boar was really miserable, it was bitten by the three dogs and it hurt all over.
Of course, the three dogs didn’t get any good. They were injured several times by pigs, but fortunately they were all minor injuries.
These three dogs are fierce enough, even though they are wounded, they still fight with wild boars endlessly.
Three dogs and one pig fought and walked, descended from the hillside to the hill, and went down again.
Xu Shiyan followed closely all the time, but the dog and the pig were always fighting together, and he couldn't find a chance to shoot.
The big yellow dog looked for an opportunity to dig out the back of the wild boar again, and the two packs were torn so that only a little skin remained, and the blood was dripping on the back.
The wild boar finally couldn't bear it anymore, and there happened to be a big tree in front of it, and the pig sat directly under the big tree.
Leaning against the tree behind, blocking the back, panting heavily, with red eyes, staring at the three dogs in front.
The big yellow dog was useless, and the blue dog and the flower dog pounced on them again, one left and one right, one biting their ears and the other their ribs.
The wild boar shook his head from side to side, trying to shake off the two dogs.
At this time, Xu Shiyan put the gun in the face and pulled the trigger, only to hear two shots, and the wild boar's head was pierced.

chapters.title: Chapter 61: reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 61 Harvest
Xu Shiyan has always believed that these dogs are at most wild boars that broke in by mistake in the field, and it is impossible for them to have experience in entering the mountains.
Old Li is in his sixties, and his physical strength is not enough. How could he take his dog all over the mountains to hunt?
But when the yellow dog uttered his voice just now, Xu Shiyan felt that he seemed to have made a mistake in his judgment. The dog didn't seem to be inexperienced.
When the three dogs cooperated tacitly to surround the wild boar, Xu Shiyan knew that he really underestimated Old Li before.
Regardless of his age, he is still an expert in hunting, which is beyond the reach of ordinary people.
These male dogs are big in size, they were trained fiercely and ruthlessly by Mr. Li, and they cooperate with each other very tacitly. They are definitely the best hunting dogs.
This is really a big surprise, Xu Shiyan is very happy.
Two shots killed the wild boar by headshot. The moment the wild boar fell, the three dogs jumped on it and bit it.
Xu Shiyan whistled, and the three dogs stopped, tilting their heads and looking at Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan stood the gun aside, and drew the knife from his leg.
This knife is longer than the butcher's knife, slightly narrower, sharpened extremely sharply, and glows coldly in the sun.
Xu Shiyan walked up to the wild boar, raised a front leg of the wild boar with one hand, pressed the back leg of the wild boar with his right leg, and then raised the knife with his hand and cut open the wild boar cleanly.
The pig intestines were directly hung on the nearby branches to worship the mountain god.
In fact, it is to leave some food for some carnivores such as wolves, tigers, leopards, etc., to prevent them from chasing after the **** smell.
Pick off the pig's heart, cut it open with a knife, and give the biggest piece to the big yellow dog.
This big yellow dog is an excellent head dog, with a good smell and a ruthless mouth.
If there is no big yellow dog today, it would be very difficult to surround the wild boar with just the blue dog and the flower dog.
If you are a dog, you must be treated like a dog, and the pig's heart will be divided by more than half. This is a reward for the dog.
Xu Shiyan held a pig heart in his hand and handed it to the big yellow dog.
Panting heavily, the yellow dog carefully took the pig's heart from Xu Shiyan's hand, and went to the side to eat it.
The remaining pig hearts were divided into two and given to Huagou and Qinggou.
The two dogs did the same. They gently took away the pig's heart and went to the side to eat it.
After eating the pig heart, there are also pig livers and lungs, etc., and the three dogs ate all of them until their bellies bulged.
When you bring a hunting dog into the mountain, you must let the hunting dog open to eat. This is the best reward for the hunting dog.
The hounds fought desperately with the wild beasts, and they must be rewarded for the big ones.
This running basket is not small, nearly four hundred catties, even if the internal organs are removed, there will still be more than three hundred catties left.
For such a big guy, it would take a lot of trouble to transport it back, but Xu Shiyan couldn't be bothered.
While the dog was eating, Xu Shiyan went to the woods to chop some sticks.
Two of the bottoms are flattened, then **** with bark, etc., and tied with ropes to make a simple sledge.
After the sledge was finished, he used a stick to pry the wild boar carcass and got it on the sledge. Then Xu Shiyan pulled the sledge and walked back slowly.
The three dogs did not run around when they were full, but followed Xu Shiyan in front of and behind him.
The big yellow dog looked at Xu Shiyan struggling to drag the sledge, seemed to want to help but had nowhere to go, and barked anxiously.
Xu Shiyan reached out and rubbed Rhubarb's head, "Don't worry, wait until I get back. I'll make a special dog sledge, and then I'll go hunting in the mountains. You guys will help pull the prey."
Today it was just an impromptu idea to take the dog out for a walk. I really didn’t expect that once I entered the mountain, I would gain something. I miscalculated.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan struggled to pull the sledge, stopped and stopped countless times along the way, and finally returned to the venue.
"Daughter-in-law, open the door and see what I got back?"
The gate to the venue was closed tightly, with a lock on the inside, so Xu Shiyan could only shout loudly outside.
Seeing that Shen Xiaofang is not far from the gate, besides, Su Anying has always been worried about Xu Shiyan, so she would come out to have a look from time to time.
So when Xu Shiyan yelled outside, Su Anying heard it immediately, and came out with the key to open the door.
"Ah, did you get a big wild boar?
What a big guy, so much pork, can we finish it? "Su Anying looked at the big guy on the sledge and exclaimed.
"What are you afraid of? When it's cold, the meat can be kept, so let's keep it and eat slowly." Xu Shiyan smiled, and dragged the sledge into the gate.
"When I have time, I will send some back to our mother.
In the future, I will take the dog into the mountains, and I will fight whatever I meet. If I save too much, one day the management team will borrow a horse to sledge, and I will take you back to the camp, and send some to my father-in-law. "
Since returning home, she has been busy, and has no chance to accompany Su Anying back to her mother's house. She didn't even inform Su's family of the news of Su Anying's pregnancy.
Xu Shiyan has been thinking about it in his heart, but there is no way, he is too busy.
Now that the couple lives on the mountain again, they will definitely not be able to go down the mountain until the twelfth lunar month, so they can only wait.
Xu Shiyan knew that the daughter-in-law was thinking about her natal family, but she didn't talk about it, so today he took the opportunity to bring it up first.
Sure enough, hearing what Xu Shiyan said, Su Anying immediately became happy, her eyes brightened.
"No wonder Dad praised you, saying that he found a good son-in-law, which is really good, and he also knows that he misses the old man.
It doesn’t matter if you bring something or not, as long as you have the heart, my dad will be happier if he knows how much we eat. "
Su Anying came forward and helped her husband pull the sledge, and the two dragged the sledge to the front of the house.
"That is, my father married me the daughter I have raised for more than 20 years, so how can I not think about my father-in-law?
It’s just that we can’t get away now, we really have no choice but to wait to go down the mountain, I’ll take you back to live for a few days. "
As Xu Shiyan spoke, he took out a knife, and on the sledge, he peeled and divided the wild boar.
Wild boars have thick skins. Generally, no one eats them. They are all skinned.
The peeled pigskin is nailed upside down on the wall to dry, and it can be used for other purposes.
The rest of the meat was divided, the fat ones were still cut off for Su Anying to refine the oil, and the thin ones were placed on wooden boards and directly poured with water.
Xu Shiyan went hunting in the mountains in the morning. Although he left early, the return journey was too much work, and it was already past two o'clock in the afternoon when he arrived home.
The temperature on the mountain is low. If you pour some cold water on the pork, it will be frozen hard at night. At that time, put it in a wooden barrel and cover it with a layer of snow. It can be stored for a long time.
In winter in Northeast China, there is a large natural refrigerator outside, and everything can be frozen outside.
Freezing some meat is definitely a piece of cake.
It was past three o'clock when Xu Shiyan finished packing up the wild pork.
It gets dark early in winter in the Northeast, and there is no electricity on the mountain, only kerosene lamps or candles are used for lighting, so we have to start making dinner early.
"I haven't eaten the sauerkraut brought by my mother yet. Let's stew sauerkraut with wild boar to eat at night. You've been tired all day. It's delicious." Su Anying suggested.
"It just so happens that I first refine the oil and wipe the sauerkraut."
"Well, okay, you can do it as you see it. The wild boar is a running basket, and the meat is quite tender. It's best to soak it in water first, and add more seasoning."
Wild pork is not as delicious as domestic pig meat, it is too woody and has a smell of mutton.
If the little wild boar or sow is okay, this kind of running basket has a foul smell.
Xu Shiyan was afraid that Su Anying wouldn't understand this, so he specially reminded her.

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Xu Shian
chapters.content:
Chapter 62 Xu Shian
In the evening, I ate wild boar bone soup stewed with sauerkraut, and shredded pork.
Su Anying still has a good way of cooking. There is oil in a big pot here, and a small pot on the stove, and pork bones and pork are stewed in it.
When the oil is refined and ready to serve, stir fry the shredded sauerkraut in the pan, then add bone broth and stew slowly.
Bild pork is cooked with various seasonings, and it is torn apart by hand after a little cooling.
Put some onion shreds, chili shreds, salt and other seasonings on it, cook it with a little hot oil, and the aroma will come out immediately.
This means that now that there is no shortage of oil to eat, Su Anying dares to cook so extravagantly. If it was before, she wouldn't even dare to think about it.
The meal was ready, and it was already dark outside. The couple lit the kerosene lamp and ate dinner happily.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan still went for a walk in the venue, and there was nothing abnormal around him, so he came back to rest with peace of mind.
Wait until midnight before going out for a stroll, and then I felt dawn.
Most of the first snow cannot stand. As the temperature rises, the snow will melt when the sun shines during the day.
The temperature drops in the morning and evening, and a hard layer is frozen again.
The work in the ginseng field was not finished yet, and while it was freezing in the morning, the young people in the team came up the mountain again.
"Third, in a few days the food will be distributed in the team. My father asked me to ask you, where do you put the food for the two of you?"
Xu Shixiang was going to take the college entrance examination, so he stayed at home to review his homework. This time it was Xu Shian who came to work on the mountain.
As soon as Xu Shian saw his younger brother, he asked directly.
Generally speaking, the agricultural team settles a year's work points at the beginning of winter every year, and then everyone uses the work points to convert food and money.
In addition to corn and beans, the big house also grows ginseng.
So every year at the beginning of winter, the food is divided first, and the processed ginseng is all sold, and the money is divided again.
When the family was separated, it was very clear that the work points Xu Shiyan earned before belonged to him.
After Su Anying got married, she also went to work to earn work points, and now that the two of them are still watching references on the mountain, it is estimated that their work points can be exchanged for a lot of food and money.
"Let's put the food at home first, Yingzi and I live on the mountain now, there is no place to put too much food."
Xu Shiyan pondered for a while, and felt that it would be more at ease to leave it at home.
Although my father is not forgiving, he is not greedy for that little food.
Old Mrs. Li was hospitalized and didn’t know what to do. Mrs. Li stayed with her all the time, and there was no one to take care of her at home.
"Okay, that's what my parents said too." Xu Shi'an just passed the message on behalf of his parents, and didn't care about the rest.
"Come on, I'm going to work. I don't have enough pillars and poles for trekking. I have to go into the mountains to pick them up today."
What the locals say is picking up, but not really picking up, but actually going into the forest to cut trees. The so-called gathering firewood means chopping firewood.
The column feet and the large joint poles are the supports of the ginseng shed.
On both sides of the large soil ridge in the ground, a column foot is smashed every ten feet, and a large joint pole is nailed to the top of the column foot, and then the mallet board can be laid.
Most of the mallet boards and Dalian poles can be used for two or three stubbles, but the end of the column foot is buried in the ground, and it will rot within three years, so every time a new mallet is planted, it has to go to the forest to pick up new ones.
In the future, it will be covered with plastic film, and more materials will be used. In addition to column feet and large joint poles, there are also cross arms, branch poles, bow strips, curtains, layering strips, etc.
So ginseng production is an extremely cumbersome and material-intensive task. Regardless of making money from growing ginseng, it is actually really hard work.
"Well, be careful when you enter the mountain. After the snow falls, the beasts will come down the mountain, so be careful." Xu Shiyan had to ask a few words.
At this time, the wild boars are looking for food all over the mountain, and the black blind man is also making the final preparations before squatting in the warehouse, eating wildly, and it is easy to meet wild animals when entering the mountain.
"Don't worry, there are so many people, we all have axes and saws.
I’m not afraid if I meet them, the big guys go up together, and I just eat meat when I kill them. "Xu Shian waved his hand nonchalantly, turned around and left.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help sighing as he watched his brother leave in a hurry.
The second elder brother of his family has always had an impatient temper since he was a child. No matter what he did, he felt that if he didn't finish it soon, it would be too late.
In the previous life, when his mother was still alive, Xu Shiyan often heard the old lady sigh, saying that the second brother might be born with a short life.
Since I was young, I have been faster than others in everything. Other children have just learned how to sit at six months, but Xu Shian can already crawl.
If one didn’t see it, Xu Shi’an could climb onto the loom.
Only eight and a half months, Xu Shian can move a few steps, and after ten months, he can walk very firmly.
The elders say that it is not good for children to leave too early, and the implication is wrong if they leave early.
In 1980, Xu Shi'an always suffered from stomach pains. He went to Quanyang No. 50 Hospital for examination and found that it was stomach cancer.
Gastric cancer, even after several decades, there is no good way to treat it.
Not to mention at the time, the only option was surgery to remove the tumor, and then the doctor came back with a box of medicine called cancer enemy.
Surgery plus drug control prolongs Xu Shian's life by five years.
In 1985, Xu Shian's gastric cancer recurred, and the tumor covered his entire stomach. The treatment failed and he died.
His daughter-in-law Wei Mingrong and two sons Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao are left behind, as well as a dozen houses, a large vegetable garden, and hundreds of feet of ginseng.
Less than two months after Xu Shian passed away, Wei Mingrong took his two sons and family property to remarry a man surnamed Huang.
Under the insistence of the Xu family, Wei Mingrong remarried without leaving home, and Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao did not change their surnames.
The family property left by Xu Shi'an, the Xu family doesn't want it either, it's all for the two children.
It's a pity that the brothers of Wei Mingrong's natal family are all prodigal sons, and they come here all day long to eat and drink.
Not to mention Xu Shian's family property, even the money brought by Lao Huang was ruined by these people.
"What are you thinking? Standing here motionless?
The second brother came over just now, why didn't you tell him about the wild boar meat you brought back home this afternoon?
Also, didn’t you leave a pig’s belly yesterday and said it was for the second brother? Forgot to tell him? "
Su Anying looked at her husband standing there motionless, with dazed eyes, and felt strange, so she poked Xu Shiyan's side and asked him.
"Second brother left so fast, I didn't even have time to say it." Xu Shiyan came back to his senses and shook his head.
"Daughter-in-law, you can do me a favor later, put the wild boar belly on the tiles to dry, and I will give it to my second brother in the afternoon."
The folk remedies are said to nourish the stomach with wild boar belly.
Wild boar eats everything and has a strong digestive ability, so some people think that wild boar belly must be good for the stomach.
Whether it makes sense or not, Xu Shiyan is not clear, he is just doing his best.
The conflict between brothers is nothing more than a dispute over money and interests, and has nothing to do with anything else.
He couldn't just watch his elder brother have an accident, and he couldn't watch his two nephews lose their father at a young age.
So try all the methods you can think of, if it is really useful? After all, it is my brother's life.
Readers have been urging for updates, so let’s talk about the update. There can't be too many new book issues, for fear that some recommendations will not be listed and missed. So every day is two or four thousand words.
This book is estimated to be on the shelves in the middle of the month, and there will be more updates after it goes on the shelves, so you can rest assured.

chapters.title: Chapter 63: black blind man hurting
chapters.content:
Chapter 63 Black Blind Man Hurts People
This year, the newly planted ginseng in the team is nearly 600 feet long, and a lot of it is needed for the pillars alone.
The materials used for ginseng are of course chopped nearby, and it is convenient to transport them back.
Xu Shian and others took axes and saws and went to work in the forest south of the field.
A group of young people went into the mountain talking and laughing, talking nonsense while working. From time to time, someone told a nasty joke, which made others laugh.
Although life is bitter, you have to live it with a smile.
Xu Shiyan doesn't need to follow him to work, and he doesn't plan to go hunting in the mountains today.
Hunting is very tiring, even the people on the mountain can't bear it, and the dogs can't bear it either.
Yesterday has already yielded something, today Xu Shiyan plans to rest at home, and go for a walk outside the jacket clip or something.
Xu Shiyan walked around the periphery of the field, not to mention, he really gained something.
A pheasant and a hare were caught in a trap, and a roe deer fell into a trap in the woods to the west.
At that time, on the branches where the trap was built, there were some frozen greens, which are parasites.
Roe deer and deer love to eat jelly, especially after the snow falls and the ground is white. If you see a pinch of green jelly, it is estimated that the roe deer will eat it happily, but it will fall into the trap.
I wasn’t at home yesterday, and no one was walking the trap. I don’t know how long the roe deer fell into it. Anyway, when Xu Shiyan saw it, he was already dying.
The roe deer is not as heavy as the wild boar, so Xu Shiyan got it up with a little effort, and then returned to the field with the roe deer on his shoulder and the pheasant and hare in his hand.
"Daughter-in-law, look what I got back? I picked up a roe deer in the trap today."
As soon as he entered the arena, Xu Shiyan greeted Su Anying.
Since going up the mountain, there have been constant prey, big and small. Su Anying is no longer the unseen appearance she was at first.
Hearing Xu Shiyan shout, he just smiled and handed over the knife, then turned around and went back to the house to continue sewing.
Xu Shiyan didn't use his wife's help either. Pregnant women should avoid these **** things.
Even if Su Anying is not afraid, the one in her stomach should pay attention to prenatal education, right?
Without anyone's help, Xu Shiyan handled all the prey skillfully by himself. The skins were nailed to the wall to dry in the shade, and the meat was put away for storage.
Just finished working on this side, suddenly there was a rush of footsteps, and there seemed to be some other movements in the middle, like the sound of someone being hurt and whimpering.
Xu Shiyan hurried out. As soon as he arrived at the gate of the venue, he saw Xu Shian and the others hurried over carrying a makeshift stretcher covered in mud and blood.
There are a few people behind, supporting each other, all in a mess.
"What's the matter? Didn't you go to pick up the pillars? Why did you get hurt? Did you hurt the tree?"
Xu Shiyan was stunned, he had only been in the mountain for a few hours, why did he bring one back in such a mess?
"It wasn't that the tree was injured, it was because he met Hei Xiazi, Zhihua let Hei Xiazi slap him, and his leg was broken."
Xu Shian raised his hand to wipe the sweat from his forehead, there was blood on his face and hands, and this wipe was all over his face.
"Second brother, why do you still have blood on your body? Are you also injured?" Xu Shiyan became anxious when he saw it.
"Huh? I wasn't injured. It should be that I chopped Heixiazi with an axe, and my body was bleeding."
Xu Shian froze for a moment, looked down at his hands, and then remembered what was going on.
Hearing that his second brother was not injured, Xu Shiyan was secretly relieved.
At this time, he looked at everyone carefully, except for Li Zhihua who was lying on the stretcher, there were a few grinning people over there, who looked injured.
Don't even have to think about it, this must have hurt the blind man. At any rate, no one was killed, which is considered lucky.
"Hurry up and get him into the car, and send him to the commune hospital."
Xu Shiyan didn't know much about bone grafting, so he didn't dare to do it rashly.
Although Li Zhihua was injured and even broke his leg, it seems that his life is not in danger, so he should be rushed to the hospital for bone grafting.
Fortunately, these people came in a carriage, so they hurriedly carried them into the carriage, and several injured people got into the carriage.
Xu Shian was about to go up to drive the car, but was grabbed by Xu Shiyan.
"Second brother, you can leave later, I have something to ask you." Several people were not injured, and Xu Shian didn't have to drive.
Xu Shian was stunned for a moment, then looked back at his younger brother, and put down his raised leg.
"Da Zhuzi, please send Zhihua to the hospital, I'll take a breather here."
Quite a few people followed, it doesn't matter if there is one more or one less, Xu Shian on the left and right is not injured, and no one is worried about him.
Just like that, Da Zhuzi hurried away in the car and went straight to the commune hospital. And Xu Shi'an was dragged into the house by his younger brother.
Su Anying had already heard the commotion outside the room. Seeing Xu Shian come in at this time, she looked at Xu Shian in a panic, and hurriedly fetched water.
"Second brother, wash your face, it's covered in blood, it looks scary."
Blood on this face, I don't know how many injuries I thought Xu Shi'an had suffered.
Xu Shian washed his face and went back to the back room, and poured two mugs of hot water on the kang table.
Xu Shi'an didn't care about that, he drank half a cup of tea, and felt a little more at ease in his heart.
"Second brother, what's the matter? Where did you meet the black blind man?" Xu Shiyan asked after seeing his brother calm down.
"Oh, don't mention it, just three or four miles south from here, over a small hill, there is a thick big green poplar underneath."
While gesturing, Xu Shian told Xu Shiyan and his wife how they met the black blind man and how everyone was injured.
The base of the columns and the poles used for ginseng do not need to be too thick. The thickness of the mouth of the bowl is enough, but it must be straight, and the poles for the large joints must be one foot long.
The larch is not good, it is full of burrs, and the poplar is too chaffy, and it will rot within a few years.
Most of them are broad-leaved trees such as ash, walnut catalpa, and birch.
There is a second stubble forest in the south of Qianchuan Cangchang, and there are many white birches in it, so Xu Shian and the others went there to cut trees.
When I arrived at the other end, I was working. I don’t know where a nest of rabbits came out.
They are all a group of young men in their twenties and under thirty, why not chase after a rabbit? After this chase, he turned over the mountain.
Then someone saw a big green poplar at the foot of the mountain, which was very thick.
Poplar wood is loose, and the older the poplar tree, the easier it is to be hollow and grow holes.
This big poplar tree is like this. There is a big tree hole at a height of more than two meters.
At that time, some people said, the poplar tree is so big, and there are holes in the tree, will there be black blind people squatting in it?
Heixiazi squatting in the warehouse means that black bears hibernate in tree holes or stone caves in winter. The tree holes are called Tiancangzi, and the stone caves are called Dicangzi.
That big poplar tree is an excellent Tiancangzi.
You must know that black blind people squat in warehouses, they will not just find a place to squat casually, most of them have to find a place long in advance, and they have to clean out the tree hole.
For this season, it’s time for Heixiazi to squat.
A group of young men who are not afraid of anything, even came up with the idea of ​​black and blind.
I don’t know who brought it up, let’s try to see if there are black and blind people in it? If so, if we kill the bear bile and sell it, we can get some meat to eat.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: dare
chapters.content:
Chapter 64 Dare or not
Few of the younger generation in Dafang Village really know how to hunt, and they are just playing around.
A group of inexperienced stunned youths, they don't care about anything as soon as they get excited, and they don't even make preparations before killing Cangzi.
Pick up one person directly, and poke it into the tree hole with a long pole.
What a coincidence, a black blind man got into that tree hole yesterday.
The black blind man is full of food and drink, and is planning to have a good sleep until next year's spring.
As a result, it was woken up by someone poking it just after falling asleep. Can it not be angry? At that time, he roared and crawled out of the tree hole.
A person who knows how to hunt should hold two wooden sticks crossed at the entrance of the cave.
Then another person took an ax and chopped off the blind man's head. If everything went well, the two axes would be about the same.
Just as soon as the blind man died, he fell down and opened the bear bile.
But this group of people was just joking, and it's just a joke. Nothing was prepared, only relying on the large number of people.
So these people just watched the black blind man roaring and crawling out of the tree hole. Immediately, several people were so frightened that their scalps were numb and their legs were weak, and they turned around and ran away.
If it doesn’t run away, it’s probably fine. Maybe it ran away first when the blind man saw the crowds.
As a result, when this person moved, the black blind man was already furious, and when he had a target, he rushed to that person and rushed over.
The crowd was in a mess at this moment, some brave ones swung their axes and wanted to hit the black blind man, and some timid ones yelled and ran away.
Hei Xiazi was furious, and shot the two of them away, and then rushed towards Li Zhihua who was closest to him.
How fast the black blind man moved, he slapped Li Zhihua's shoulder with one paw, and the sharp claws directly scratched the cotton-padded jacket, and with another force, Li Zhihua was shot flying.
It was an inch, but the right leg hit the stone and broke on the spot.
The blind man wanted to hit Li Zhihua harder. At this time, Xu Shian saw that things were not good, so he swung the ax in his hand, and gave the blind man a blow.
As a result, the position of the cut was not very good, it was sideways, and the head was not cut, but the shoulder.
Although Xu Shian was not short, he was very nimble. He struck with an axe, and turned around and ran away regardless of whether he hit or not.
The black blind man was injured by Xu Shian, he was furious at that time, he went straight to Xu Shian and chased him.
Fortunately, Yang Chunming over there saw that he didn't see well, and swung an ax at the blind man. At least Xu Shian was not chased by the blind man.
When Yang Chunming came up, several other people came over with axes.
Seeing that something was wrong, the blind man simply turned around and fled, leaving behind a defeated army.
"How can a person with two legs catch up with four legs? Just watch the blind man run away like this.
Then Li Zhihua complained that his leg hurts, so we carried him back. "Xu Shi'an told the story in detail.
Xu Shiyan shook his head after listening, these people, they can really cause trouble, they want to kill Heixiazicang without preparing anything? How brave are they?
"Second brother, do you still dare to take care of that black blind man?"
Xu Shiyan knew that the second elder brother of his family was very courageous. The black blind man should not be able to scare him.
"How do you measure it? Take an axe? No, that's pure nonsense." Xu Shian shook his head.
He was bragging before, but now he finally understands that blind men can't be killed casually.
"Take a gun, do you think I am like you? Just charge up with an ax?" Xu Shiyan smiled and pointed to the wall.
"I have a semi-automatic specially equipped by Uncle Zhao, and there is a stick by Uncle Li on the wall.
If you dare to go, we will get up early tomorrow morning and take the dog to chase the black blind man. "
It’s no fun to fight wild boars, you can only eat meat. Heixiazi is different, bear bile is very valuable.
Xu Shian immediately widened his eyes when he heard this.
"Third, are you serious? I haven't seen you shoot a gun. How are you shooting?"
Bear bile, what is that? That's money, who wouldn't be jealous when seeing money? The same goes for Xu Shi'an, otherwise would they be able to provoke that blind man?
"That must come true.
I forgot to tell you this morning, yesterday I took my dog ​​and brought back a wild boar, and I was thinking of letting you take it home this afternoon. "
Xu Shiyan was not annoyed by his brother's tone, but still smiled. "How is it? Dare you?"
"Then why dare? If I had a gun today, I would have shot it to death."
Xu Shi'an has participated in militia training and has fired a gun. He is bold and not at all frightened.
"Okay, then you can stay on the mountain tonight, and we will get up early tomorrow to chase."
It was getting late at this moment, the black blind man was alarmed out of the warehouse and was injured, so he must run far away and won't stop until night.
It’s useless for them to hunt them down now. If they catch up, it will be dark. How can they hunt in the dark?
Get up early tomorrow morning and leave. With the big yellow dog leading the way, I will definitely catch up.
It is easy to deal with the blind man during the day, with dogs to help out, and the two brothers each have a gun, how can they kill the blind man.
Just like that, Xu Shian agreed to stay on the mountain, and Su Anying hurried over there to clean up and cook for dinner.
It happened that the rabbit that Xu Shiyan brought back today was skinned, so he chopped up the rabbit meat and stewed it in a big pot with potatoes.
Reheat the stewed sauerkraut with wild pork, cut a plate of wild pork and dipped it in garlic sauce, put a pot of pancakes on it, and Xu Shian was almost full.
"Third brother, I really didn't expect you to have such a good life in the mountains."
After dinner, the two brothers got together to chat, Xu Shian couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"It's okay, anyway, there is no shortage of meat to eat. I put a lot of traps, covers and so on in the circle outside, and I harvested a little every few days, which is enough for the two of us."
Xu Shiyan smiled nonchalantly, if it's not good, can he run up the mountain to live?
"Oh, by the way, the wild boar I shot yesterday is not small, I left the pig belly for your siblings to clean and dry."
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered this, "Second brother, remember to take it home when the time comes.
Put Wang Jiagui's medicine grinder, crush the pork belly, get up early every day on an empty stomach, and drink a teaspoon.
You eat too fast and your mouth is heavy. This is not good. It is easy to have stomach pain. Pork belly nourishes the stomach, so don’t think it is unpalatable. "
Restricted by the conditions, Xu Shiyan has only this way at present.
If it’s summer, you can go to the mountains to pick some Ganoderma lucidum.
It is difficult to collect spore powder from wild Ganoderma lucidum, so it can only be dried and stewed with Ganoderma lucidum or crushed into powder for drinking.
Many people use Ganoderma lucidum to make wine. If it is to nourish the stomach, forget it. Drinking is not very good.
Xu Shiyan tried his best to do all the methods that could be used, but Xu Shiyan didn't know whether it was useful or not.
After all, cancer is still a difficult problem in the medical field. No one knows why Xu Shian got stomach cancer.
"What are you talking about? What kind of wild boar belly did you ask me to drink? You drink a little, and you have a serious stomach problem when you were young.
Your brother and I are in good health, why drink that stuff? "Xu Shi'an's temper is determined to follow Xu Chenghou's, stubborn.
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes angrily, "Yes, you can be stubborn.
Why are you so stubborn with me? I am your younger brother, can I harm you? "

chapters.title: Chapter 65: kill black blind man
chapters.content:
Chapter 65 Killing the Black and Blind
Xu Shiyan felt that he could no longer talk to his second brother, and would be easily **** off.
The second brother of his family is really exactly like the old man. He is stubborn and stubborn. It is very difficult to communicate with them.
Forget it, I'll tell my mother about this matter when I get home, so my mother is capable of treating these two.
"It's getting late, I'm sleepy, let's get up early tomorrow morning to find that blind man."
Xu Shiyan got up and removed the kang table, spread the quilt to sleep, and ignored Xu Shian.
Xu Shian felt a little regretful when he saw his younger brother throwing face at him. The younger brother also had good intentions, so he didn't recognize good people.
But Xu Shian has the same temper as the old man of the Xu family, even if he knows what he did is wrong, he can't be ashamed to say nice things.
In the end, no one can speak, and lie down early to sleep.
On the morning of the 11th, before dawn, Xu Shiyan got up to cook and feed the dog food.
This time, I simply took all five dogs with me and went up the mountain together.
Arrived near the Heixiazi warehouse yesterday, and sure enough, I saw blood on the ground.
Several dogs sniffed the ground, and saw the big yellow dog barking twice, and the black dog and blue dog ran forward with the yellow dog.
The remaining two flower dogs are guarding Xu Shiyan's side, running forward for a while from time to time before coming back.
If the black blind man squats in the warehouse and is disturbed by others, he will step up when he leaves the warehouse. The two brothers Xu Shiyan and their dogs followed the black blind man's blood and smell all the way.
The brothers of the Xu family left the house after six o'clock, and when it was almost ten o'clock, a dog barked in the distance.
The two flower dogs beside Xu Shiyan jumped out in an instant.
"I found it, let's go, it's right in front." Xu Shiyan knew from the voice that the big yellow dog had found the blind man.
The two brothers took off the gun from behind, pulled the safety, and chased all the way forward with the gun in hand. They climbed over a hill and went down, and saw five dogs surrounded a black blind man.
At this time of year, the black blind man just ate a whole body of fat to prepare for the winter. The guy who was originally only about 300 catties now weighs nearly 400 catties.
Such a big man has great strength, and the black blind man can stand up like a human being, waving his sharp claws as big as a palm leaf fan, which is extremely lethal.
The five big dogs were like toys in front of the blind man. When the blind man pulled them casually, the **** dog was swung aside.
Even though the black dog was so smart and quick, the skin on his left front leg was still torn by sharp claws, and he dared not move when he fell to the ground.
At this time, the big yellow dog saw the opportunity and hit the black blind man's back door.
This bite was so hard that the blind black man howled in pain, and turned around to catch the big yellow dog.
The big yellow dog was dexterous, and immediately let go to dodge. The black blind man missed the big yellow dog, but was caught by the flower dog again, and got hit again in the same place.
This black blind man was slashed on the shoulder by Xu Shian with an ax yesterday, and he was already injured. After finally getting out of the crowd, he walked all the way here before lying down to rest.
As a result, before it got up and continued walking this morning, it was chased by a few dogs, surrounded by it and bitten.
The injured black blind man was already violent, but now his eyes were even redder, he turned around and stood up, and slapped the flower dog out with a single slap.
At the moment Huagou was shot flying, there was a bang, and it was Xu Shiyan who fired.
The five dogs were entangled with the blind man just now, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to shoot for fear of hurting the dogs, so he kept aiming with his gun.
Hei Xiazi straightened up and was about the height of a person, much taller than the surrounding dogs. It happened that there were no dogs jumping up at this time, so Xu Shiyan shot at the right time.
This shot was supposed to hit the chest, but the moment the gun went off, the black blind man just turned to the side.
As a result, the bullet passed through the blind man's shoulder obliquely, with small eyes entering and big eyes exiting, leaving a big blood hole on the blind man's shoulder.
As soon as the gun fired, the blind man also found Xu Shiyan.
Generally speaking, when wild boars or black blind men are surrounded by dogs, as long as they see people, they will definitely come towards them.
The black blind man was wounded in several places. Xu Shian cut his left shoulder with an axe, his right shoulder was shot by Xu Shiyan, and he was gouged twice by the big yellow dog and the flower dog in the back, and he was bitten by dogs in other places.
The pain on his body made the blind man's eyes red, and he rushed towards Xu Shiyan like crazy.
Xu Shiyan is holding a pistol in his hand. This kind of gun is single shot. After a shot, the handle of the gun must be pried off to change the bullets. It is not like a semi-automatic rifle that can be fired continuously.
It was troublesome to use the stick. Xu Shiyan was worried that the second brother would not be very good at hunting for the first time, so he gave the semi-automatic to Xu Shian, and kept the stick for himself.
Now that the shot is finished, it is time to reload, but the black blind man has already run towards Xu Shiyan, and Xu Shiyan has no time.
"Second brother, shoot." Xu Shiyan ran to the side, calling Xu Shian while running.
Xu Shi'an stood on the side and fired in response, but the shot also missed and missed the vital point, hitting the black blind man's hind leg.
Hei Xiazi was shot in the hind leg, and his movement of chasing Xu Shiyan paused, and his figure slowed down. At this time, the remaining three dogs rushed over again.
The owner fired the gun to cheer the dog. Once the gun rang, the dog would jump up desperately.
Hei Xiazi had already been shot twice, his shoulder and hind legs were injured, his combat power was greatly reduced at this moment, the back door was once again pulled out by the yellow dog, and his armpit was bitten by the blue dog again.
By this time, the blind man had lost all energy to fight the dog again. There happened to be a tree next to it, and the blind man climbed onto the tree in two or three moves.
The dog can't go up the tree, so it can only surround the tree and bark.
The black blind man thought that it would be able to avoid the dog's bite by climbing a tree, but he didn't know it at all, so he exposed himself to the hunter's gun instead.
Xu Shiyan had finished reloading, aimed at the blind man on the tree, and shot again.
With a bang, the blind man fell directly under the tree. After a few twitches, he didn't move anymore.
Xu Shiyan's shot directly hit Heixiazi's head, killing him with one shot.
The dogs all rushed forward to bite, Xu Shiyan still whistled, and Rhubarb and the others let go of the blind man and returned to Xu Shiyan.
"Second brother, come over and help, we two will open the black blind man."
The black blind man fell on the ground lying on his stomach, a big guy of three or four hundred catties, and it took a lot of trouble for two people to turn it over.
The two spent a lot of effort, and finally turned the black blind man over. After that, Xu Shian opened the black blind man, and Xu Shiyan went to see the dog.
Both the black dog and the flower dog were injured, lying on the ground, looking at Xu Shiyan with wet eyes.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly applied the medicine powder he made himself to the dog, then bandaged the wound with leggings, and hugged it carefully.
At this time, Xu Shian had already picked out the bear bile, and dogs would not eat the internal organs of the blind man, so Xu Shiyan asked him to cut up the blind man's meat and feed it to the dogs.
The other dogs were also wounded, but it didn't affect their eating at all. They all ate until their stomachs bulged, so they went to the side to lie down.
"Second brother, let's build a fire, we have to eat something first, and then drag this big guy back."
Eating too early in the morning, and walking this way just now, if I don’t eat something, I’m afraid I won’t have the energy to drag a black blind man who weighs more than 300 catties back.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: eat meat
chapters.content:
Chapter 66 Eating meat
The two brothers built a fire in the woods.
Xu Shiyan took a knife, cut off a few pieces of meat from Heixiazi's body, threaded them with finger-thick green straw branches, and sprinkled a little salt flour on top.
When the fire burned to its peak, the smoke gradually subsided, and transparent flames danced on the red charcoal, Xu Shiyan brought the branches close to the fire and slowly roasted them.
Heixiazi's meat is already thick, but when it is roasted on the fire, the oil will leak out.
Small bubbles popped up on the surface of the meat, and at the same time gave off a tempting aroma.
Xu Shian at the other end also put the pancakes brought out on top of the green straw sticks, turning them back and forth to bake.
After the meat is baked, the pancakes will be browned and soft. The two brothers exchanged hands, and they happened to be eating pancakes and meat, which was very beautiful.
"It's still a happy life on the mountain, there is meat to eat, everyone says you are honest, I see, you are the worst."
Xu Shian sighed while eating.
I used to think that my younger brother was a simple-minded thief and honest, but now I know that he is the one with the most heart in the whole family.
Divided the family, took the wife out, and now moved to the mountains to see the ginseng.
The team provided food and drinks for the work points, and the couple ate meat on the mountain. They had a very happy life.
"What's wrong? Is the second brother envious?" Xu Shiyan asked with a smile while gnawing on the meat.
"Go back to the village and ask, who is not envious?
Who would have imagined before that the ginseng on the mountain is so good? Old Li was not like that at that time. "
Xu Shian glared at his younger brother, feeling that this guy was showing off.
Xu Shi'an's words are also true. When Old Li was on the mountain, he didn't see any good food and didn't live in a decent place.
Torn clothes every day, not to mention begging for food, it looks really bad.
The big guys thought that it was just like this when looking at ginseng on the mountain, and they looked down on everyone.
But who would have thought that after Xu Shiyan and his wife went up the mountain, their whole appearance would change?
The small room was tidied up by Su Anying inside and out, and it was shiny. Anyone who saw it felt comfortable.
Looking at Xu Shiyan's methods again, guarding the field like an iron bucket, and having all kinds of delicious food, there is really no one who let the couple live these days.
"But having said that, you have to be careful, many people in our village are jealous.
Now it is Uncle Zhao who is determined to protect you, so that you can live your good life safely on the mountain. "
Xu Shian has a stubborn temper, which doesn't mean he is stupid.
The little people in the village googling behind their backs, Xu Shian is Yemenerqing, it is necessary to remind Xu Shiyan at this moment.
"Second brother, don't worry, I didn't expect to see ginseng on the mountain all the time, it was just a stopgap measure.
Uncle Zhao came to me, I can't refuse. If anyone is greedy, just tell them to come, I don't care. "
This is really not bragging, Xu Shiyan has no intention of staying in the Dongjiangyan brigade from the bottom of his heart.
Troubles come out of poor mountains and bad waters. The smaller the place, the more bad people there are.
The main reason is that there are only a few families, and the big guys are all staring at each other. If anyone shows up, they will be targeted, which is definitely not good.
"Cut, to put it bluntly, the two of you are sitting on the mountain to see ginseng. You have work points and food to eat, and you can also hunt and earn money. What a great job, are you willing?"
Xu Shian curled his lips and rolled his eyes, thinking that his younger brother had some skills, so he started bragging.
Xu Shiyan ignored his second brother. After eating, he patted his **** to stand up and went to the woods to chop wood.
As usual, a sledge was tied, and then the two brothers got the open black blind man onto the sledge and dragged it.
The medicine powder has pain-relieving ingredients. The two injured dogs took the medicine, and after resting for a while, they dared to move and walked slowly.
When I came here, I walked for three or four hours, mainly because I was chasing the black blind man, and I took a detour through the hills.
You don’t need to go back. You are familiar with this area. Just go down the mountain and find the nearest road and walk back.
Even so, after all, they still dragged a big guy weighing more than 300 kilograms. When they returned to the venue, it was already past three o'clock in the afternoon.
"It can be counted as coming back, I will be waiting for you to come back with trepidation this day."
As soon as there was movement outside the gate, Su Anying came out immediately. Seeing that the two brothers had returned safe and sound, Su Anying finally let go of her hanging heart.
"What are you afraid of? Our two brothers have five dogs and two guns. Can't we deal with a black and blind man?"
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this, and took out a white cloth bag from his arms.
"Daughter-in-law, go and boil some hot water, dip the black blind man's gallbladder, and hang it up."
This gallbladder is a straw gallbladder, not as valuable as the copper gallbladder obtained by Xu Shiyan before, but it can still sell for three or four hundred.
The two brothers earn three or four hundred a day, and still leave so much meat, which is pretty good.
Su Anying took the blind man's guts and went back to the house to boil water. The brothers here dragged the blind man in, skinned and boned him and separated them in the yard.
"Second brother, put the bear bile here with me first, wait for it to be dried, you can take it to the county and sell it, half the money per person."
"I saw that the team came to work again today, and when you go back in a carriage, you just take some of this meat back.
Remember, give a thigh to Uncle Zhao, let our mother put away the bear paw, and wait for the fourth child to get married and hold a banquet. "
There is a carriage from the team over there, so it must be working again.
I also know that I haven't picked up enough pillars and feet, and those who are not injured must come to work.
Just right, Xu Shian can go back in a carriage, otherwise it would be too much for him to go back with the old meat alone.
The two brothers have just finished their work here, and before they can pack up the meat, the workers over there have also come back from work.
Seeing the meat here and the blind black skin on the ground, the big guys all stared wide-eyed.
"Third brother, is this the black blind man we met yesterday? Did you die?" Yang Chunming looked at it, envious.
"Well, I chased after him early this morning, and was killed by three shots.
After a while, all the brothers will bring some meat back, let’s try something new. "
Hei Xiazi was discovered by the big guys, and Xu Shiyan followed suit.
Heixiazi definitely doesn't have the share of these people, but the meat points are given to them.
Anyway, there is no shortage of meat to eat on the mountain, it’s not good to be too stingy, let some out, how about the big guys having fun?
This year, eating meat is almost in time for Chinese New Year, who would not kiss after seeing meat?
When they heard that there was meat, all of them grinned.
"Thank you third brother, we have had a lot of fun with third brother." Everyone cheered.
Everyone has counted, and no one wants more. One person and one piece of meat weighs three catties, and that is enough.
Xu Shiyan found a sack and asked Xu Shian to take back most of the remaining bear meat, as well as yesterday's wild boar meat.
So, everyone happily drove the carriage, talking and laughing all the way back to the village.
After that, the village became lively. Those who got the meat rejoiced, and those who didn’t got the meat were envious and jealous.
Many parents catch their sons as a stinky training, thinking that their sons are worthless.
Not as capable as Xu Shiyan, who can bring back so much meat for the family to eat, and still earn money.
Invisibly, Xu Shiyan was drawn to a wave of hatred again, and he didn't know anything on the mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Firefox
chapters.content:
Chapter 67 Firefox
