After taking five dogs up the mountain to surround Hei Xiazi, Xu Shiyan further confirmed his guess. Old Li must have brought the dogs into the mountain to hunt.
These five dogs are rare and good hunting dogs, one is better than the other.
It's a pity that two of them were killed by the medicine. If all seven dogs were there, it wouldn't take much effort for ordinary wild boars and black blind men.
Now Xu Shiyan can feel relieved. When the black dog and the flower dog recover from their injuries, he will take the dog out to wander around from time to time.
Not to mention, Xu Shiyan is really lucky, he can always meet something when he goes out, and he will never come back empty-handed.
There are the most wild boars, and occasionally I can meet a group of roe deer. Once in the middle, I happened to meet a black blind man and killed a black blind man.
In addition to those traps and traps near the venue, there will be some gains.
Now, a lot of meat has been accumulated in the barn, and a lot of various skins are also hung on the wall.
In the blink of an eye, the winter solstice has passed, and the temperature is getting lower and lower, with more than 30 degrees below zero outside.
There were several heavy snowfalls in a row, the snow in the venue was almost up to the armpit, not to mention the snow on the mountain, which could almost drown people.
Before and after the Xiaohan solar term, the fur of sables, raccoon dogs, otters and other animals is beautiful in color, durable in texture, and soft in fleece, so it is the best time to hunt.
Xu Shiyan naturally didn’t want to miss this opportunity, so he happened to step on a snowboard made of wild boar skin to go to the mixed coniferous and broad-leaved forest belt on the mountain to catch sables and squirrels.
Come out from Shenchangzi and walk southwest, pass the wild boar forest and go forward, the mountain gradually becomes steeper.
The tree species on the mountain have also changed. The pine trees gradually increase, and the needle and broad-leaved forests are mixed. Further up, it is the area where sables are infested.
The further you go to the top of the mountain, the deeper the snow falls.
The snow in the northeast is deposited as it falls, with a thick layer of snow particles and a hard cover on top.
People step on it directly, and they can get stuck in the snow all at once, and it is difficult to pull their legs out.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan is walking on a snowboard. Although he is not a fast walker, he can walk anyway.
So I paddled my snowboard and walked up the mountain until it was almost the top of the mountain, and there were more and more pine trees.
Xu Shiyan looked at the ground, and after a while, he saw the tiny footprints on the snow, which were left by the sable.
Sable, also known as big leaf by the locals, is one of the three treasures of the New Northeast.
Its coat is light, soft and warm. Light, the finger skin is thin and soft, falling to the ground like a feather.
Soft, the finger hairs are fine and thick, which catches the eyes but not dazzling. Warm, there is a saying that "the face is like fireworks", and it is the most precious fur.
Sables are quick-witted and dexterous, and it is not easy to catch them.
In the past, there was a legend that a hunter followed the sable all the way in the mountains all winter.
Until the beginning of spring, before the sables return to their nests, their vigilance will decrease at that time, and they will be caught by hunters.
There are also legends that sables are kind by nature, and when they see someone freezing in the snow, they will go forward and use its fur to warm them up.
So there are hunters who will lie in the snow with their arms open, waiting for the sables to come and catch them.
Xu Shiyan has never seen these in person, so he doesn't know if they are true or not. Anyway, he came to catch sables with clips.
Find the footprints that sables often walk on, dig a hole 30 to 40 minutes away from the footprints, dig down 40 to 50 centimeters deep, and then dig snow towards the footprints.
Take out a hole that can accommodate the clip, and there is a hole a few centimeters away from the snow cover above.
Open the clip and stuff it into the hole, then cover the clip with the Gregorian card paper, and a clip is set up.
Then, the snow next to it must be carefully covered to avoid being seen by the sables.
There is not much skill in doing this job, the main thing is to be careful and light in movement. Once the movement is too big, the snow on it will collapse.
Xu Shiyan made a mark near the trap, and then wandered elsewhere. He dug a dozen or so holes in this mountain in the morning and set more than a dozen traps.
After placing the trap, Xu Shiyan stepped on the skis and walked back.
When I had just walked halfway up the mountain, I suddenly saw a red thing flying past in front of me, followed by a blue-gray shadow.
The two shadows were extremely fast, before Xu Shiyan could react, they passed by in front of him. Xu Shiyan quickly grabbed the wooden pole and rowed forward, chasing after him.
In the distance, the clear gray shadow caught up with the red animal in front, and it took a bite when it went up.
I don't know where I bit it, but I only heard a scream of "Zhier".
The red shadow seemed to still be struggling to escape, but was bitten again, screaming even more.
Xu Shiyan stopped immediately, took off the gun and pulled the safety, and fired three consecutive shots at the gray shadow.
Xu Shiyan's marksmanship is still good. After three shots, the blue-gray shadow fell directly to the ground.
The red thing escaped the danger by chance, but was seriously injured. It struggled to get up, dragging its legs and crawling forward.
Xu Shiyan held the gun in one hand and swiped across the pole with the other.
It was only when I got to the front that I realized that the blue-gray animal that was shot was a wolf. And the one crawling on the ground is a fire fox.
Fox is an animal that is widely distributed in China, and it can be found everywhere, and there are many varieties.
The most famous one in the Changbai Mountain area is Fire Fox.
Its long fur is thick, bright in color and beautiful in guard hair, and the clothes and hats made of it are very warm, so it is called fire fox.
Foxes have a very keen sense of smell, are withdrawn and quiet, and often go out alone.
With its excellent sense of smell, once it finds the smell of a beast on the road, it will immediately avoid it.
Of course, it’s not foolproof. Look, isn’t this just being chased by a wolf?
Foxes are cunning by nature. When their lives are in crisis, they will fart, which is the smell secreted by the scent glands on their bodies.
People feel dizzy, flustered, or even vomit after sniffing, and hunting dogs sniff, spin around, sneeze, and dare not approach.
So there will be many superstitious legends circulating in the mountains, known as the third grandfather.
As soon as Xu Shiyan approached this way, he could smell a foul smell. It must be the fox farting just now.
It's a pity that I met the natural enemy wolf, and it didn't work. If Xu Shiyan hadn't shot the wolf, I guess the fire fox would have become food for the wolf today.
Xu Shiyan stood there looking at the fox on the ground, and had no intention of killing it.
No matter how good the fur fox is, Xu Shiyan doesn't want it.
There is a saying in the Northeast that when hunting enters the mountains, no matter how big the animals are hit, they will not offend. Don’t worry about wild boars, black blinds, even tigers, it’s okay to hit them.
But small things, especially "Hu Huang Liu Bai Hui", it is best not to provoke them, especially the first two, you must not provoke them.
How should I put it, some rules are passed down for a reason, and Xu Shiyan believes in these.
People, you still have to be a little in awe, otherwise wouldn't you dare to do anything unscrupulously?
Besides, such a mysterious thing as rebirth has happened, how can you not believe anything?
So Xu Shiyan has been on the mountain for so long, and he has never beaten a fox or a yellow-skinned child.
"Forget it, I won't kill you, you go." Seeing the fox lying on the ground, Xu Shiyan turned his head to look at him.
The originally cunning and fierce triangular eyes seem to hide a little pleading.
Xu Shiyan waved his hand at the fox, signaling it to leave quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: save it
chapters.content:
Chapter 68 Save it and keep it
Xu Shiyan didn't intend to kill the fox, so he just bent down and picked up the wolf's body, planning to leave.
As a result, the fox on the ground crawled to Xu Shiyan's feet with great difficulty, and made a cry similar to "咕咚".
Xu Shiyan was a little confused, what does this mean?
"I've already saved your life, so what are you waiting for?"
After Xu Shiyan finished speaking, he slapped himself.
Bah, crazy, and talking to a dumb beast, do you really think this is the third grandfather?
If it had the ability, it wouldn't be caught up by wolves and almost killed.
Unexpectedly, the fox made a continuous buzzing sound, and stayed at Xu Shiyan's feet in a daze, refusing to leave.
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes, "I don't want to provoke you, hey, you are relying on others, right?
Are you not afraid that I will kill you and strip your skin? "
No matter what Xu Shiyan said, the fox would not leave. Xu Shiyan had no choice but to bend down and lower his head to check the fox's injuries.
Well, this guy hurt both hind legs and couldn't walk at all.
"I owe you, right? Langzuo saved you, but he still needs to heal your wounds?"
Xu Shiyan was very helpless, so he could only take out the leggings from the diagonal pocket, and put them on the leggings directly, like carrying a child on his back.
"Let's go, go home and cook your soup."
While threatening, he dragged up the wolf's body. This time, he didn't need a wooden pole to row. Anyway, it was going downhill, just slide down slowly.
All the way back to the venue, he greeted Su Anying to open the door.
"What is this? A wolf? My God, did you meet a wolf today?"
Su Anying was startled when she saw the guy that Xu Shiyan was dragging.
"It's not just a wolf. Look what it is? There's also a fox."
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand to untie the torn sheepskin jacket, revealing the fox hidden in his arms.
It was originally carried on the back, but Xu Shiyan remembered on the way. In such a cold day, the fox was carried on his back without moving, and it was still injured. Could it be frozen?
In desperation, Xu Shiyan had no choice but to tie it up again, and put the fire fox inside the ragged sheepskin jacket.
It was also fortunate that the sheepskin jacket was fat and big, and the fox was small, so it was not awkward to carry it in the front pocket.
"Don't talk about it, this thing is really warm, I put it in my chest, it's warm.
It just smells, it smells so bad, I have to take a shower at night. "
Xu Shiyan lifted the fox out of disgust, put it on the ground, and carefully checked the fox's legs.
One of the fox's legs was bitten off by the wolf, and the other leg was not broken, but the wound was deep.
Xu Shiyan glanced at the fox, then turned around to search for the medicine powder in the cabinet.
First, the unbroken leg was bandaged with medicine, and when the bandage was finished, when the fox was not paying attention, he connected the broken leg.
When the broken leg was connected, the fox might be in pain, and bared his teeth at Xu Shiyan.
Was slapped on the head by Xu Shiyan, "You show your teeth again? I'll throw it out for you."
The fox was slapped, but he was honest, lying obediently on the ground, not daring to move.
Xu Shiyan was very satisfied. After connecting the legs, he found two chopsticks to compare on both sides of the legs, and then wrapped them with rope.
"Okay, let's stay here and raise them. Fortunately, there are no chickens in the farm, otherwise I'm afraid that you will steal the chickens and eat them."
Xu Shiyan found a sack and spread it on the ground, moved the fox on top of the sack, and carried it to the outer room.
This stuff smells stinky, wouldn't it suffocate people to death in the house?
Su Anying watched Xu Shiyan treat the fox with a dazed expression.
After co-authoring and arguing for a long time, the fox brought back by her man was not intended to be skinned, but to be raised? Can this thing be raised?
"Are you planning to keep it? Can it work?" Su Anying was curious.
In the past, I only heard that Huang Pizi lives in someone's house, but I haven't heard of foxes.
"What should I do if I don't keep it? Its two legs are broken. If I don't bring it back, it won't even survive tonight. I don't know what to eat."
Xu Shiyan is also worried, because he provoked a fox back for nothing, how can he raise this thing?
"Forget it, since I shot it to save it from the wolf's mouth, I will save it to the end. After its injury recovers, it will leave by itself."
What can I do, keep it. Fortunately, this guy is an omnivore and eats everything, so the dog eats whatever he eats, and he has the right to raise a dog.
At this point, the fox lived in the venue.
Xu Shiyan talked about feeding the fox like a dog, but he was actually quite attentive.
The pheasant and hare in the kit will be fed to the fox. I usually feed it some of what I do at home.
I have to say that the resilience of wild animals is really strong.
After five or six days, the fox dared to stand up, and after another six or seven days, the broken leg could barely walk.
At this time, the Gregorian calendar year has already passed. Seeing the twelfth lunar month, the ground has long been frozen hard, and no one can steal the ginseng.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying also began to prepare to go down the mountain and go home, packing up for the New Year.
On the eighth day, Xu Shiyan stepped on his skis uphill again, and went to the pine forest to check the clips he had set before.
Not to mention, it was really rewarding, three squirrels were caught, and two sables were caught.
I don't know when it was sandwiched, but it was frozen hard anyway.
Xu Shiyan didn't care either, he didn't plan to eat meat, all he wanted was the skin.
So, put away all the clips, and bring the prey down the mountain contentedly.
On the 9th, Xu Shiyan withdrew all the ground guns and crackers around the venue, and together with Su Anying, packed up all kinds of meat and skins in the warehouse and put them on the sledge.
The five dogs were all put on harnesses, which Xu Shiyan asked Su Anying to help with. The dogs were only used for pulling sledges, and the dogs' necks were not strangled.
Everything is packed, except that fox can't handle it.
Fortunately, the fox's injuries were almost healed, so Xu Shiyan planned to release it.
"We have to go down the mountain and go home for the New Year, you can't rely on me anymore, go play by yourself."
Xu Shiyan was afraid that the dogs would bite the fox again when they saw the fox, so he drove the sledge outside, and then came back and picked up the fox and sent it outside.
I don't know if the fox is really human, so he glanced at Xu Shiyan, turned and ran away.
Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief, this **** is finally gone, and he no longer has to suffer from the stinky smell.
After seeing off the fox, Xu Shiyan and his wife locked the entrance gate and drove the dog back on the plow.
"Daughter-in-law, you walk slowly, pay attention to the bottom of your feet, and be careful of the slippery road. If you don't listen to the sledge, you have to walk by yourself."
Xu Shiyan carefully supported Su Anying to walk, chattering while walking.
"How many things are loaded on our sledge? It's enough for those five dogs to get tired.
My current stature is too heavy to sit on. Don’t you feel sorry for the dog? " Su Anying laughed.
Su Anying has been pregnant for almost six months. She has eaten well on the mountain these days, and she has gained a lot of weight.
My stomach is not very obvious, and I wear thick clothes in winter. If you don't look carefully, you can't really tell that you are pregnant.
Qianchuan Canchang is ten miles away from the village, and Su Anying is pregnant with a child, so the road is naturally not fast. By the time they enter the village, it is almost noon.
"Oh, isn't this the Xu family's three sons and daughters? They went down the mountain and came home to celebrate the New Year?
Yo, what is on this sledge? so much? "

chapters.title: Chapter 69: downhill home
chapters.content:
Chapter 69 Down the mountain and go home
In the Northeast, it is more than 30 degrees below zero in winter, and it is freezing cold. I can't do anything except go up the mountain to collect some firewood.
So most people rest in winter, also called cat winter.
It's cold, and the three aunts and six women in the village can't get together to chat at the entrance of the village, but it doesn't delay them from visiting and chatting.
Dawn is late in winter, and there is nothing to do. Most people eat two meals.
It was two o'clock in the afternoon, and it was time to go home and cook, but as soon as I came out, I met Xu Shiyan and his wife.
Several women's eyes lit up immediately, and they came over to chat and inquire by the way.
"Hey, what are you pulling on this sledge? Something so old?
Otherwise, San’er has to be capable. Going to the mountains to see ginseng and hunting, and bringing so much meat to your parents at every turn, it’s really greedy. "
These people not only talk, but also use their hands, reaching out to turn over the things on the sledge.
Xu Shiyan naturally refused to let them rummage, so he hurriedly stopped them.
"Auntie, these dogs are not very good-tempered, you guys don't get too close, a bite is not worth it." Xu Shiyan could only talk about things through the dogs.
Not to mention, those dogs were really baring their teeth.
They are on the mountain all the year round, and they are trained by old Li to not recognize anyone but the owner and protect things more.
Some dogs don’t care when outsiders enter the door, but if they walk away with something in their hands, they will definitely bite you to death.
A good dog not only protects the owner, but also protects wealth.
These dogs were just like that, when they saw someone approaching the sledge, they would stare viciously and whine.
Frightened, the women quickly withdrew their hands, "What kind of dog does this have? Such a dead temper."
"The dog Kansan has a strong temper, otherwise how can he do it?" Xu Shiyan smiled.
"Auntie, it's getting late, we just came back, we have to go home and have a look, we can talk when we have time."
Living on the mountain for a few months, it was really peaceful. Now that I am back in the village, I have to deal with these people again.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help but sighed, and he didn't know how lively the house would be.
After finishing speaking, Xu Shiyan yelled at the dogs to move on, and went straight to Lao Li's house at the west end of the village.
Although the couple have gone up the mountain, the furniture and everything are still in the Li family, so they have to leave a place to stay so that they can come back for the New Year.
Just arrived at the gate, before entering the door, just in time to see Mrs. Li coming out to hold firewood.
"Oh, it's San'er and his wife who came back? I've been talking about it for the past few days. It's the twelfth lunar month now, and you two should go down the mountain and come back for the New Year.
Look, I really can't help but mutter, isn't this coming back today? "
Old Mrs. Li met Xu Shiyan and his wife, and they were very affectionate.
"Yeah, it's the twelfth lunar month, and I'm going home to celebrate the New Year. Auntie, how is my uncle? Is he better?"
Xu Shiyan drove the sledge into the courtyard, first unhooked the dog, and tied it to the nearby kennel.
These dogs were raised by Lao Li, and they are brought back to be raised in Li's house every year in the twelfth lunar month. The dogs are no strangers here.
"It's okay, half of my body is still not moving, and I can't speak clearly.
Well, at least one life was saved, which is not bad. "
Old Li Tou stayed in the commune hospital for nearly 20 days, and returned home after his condition stabilized.
He is old and has a cerebral hemorrhage, which will definitely leave sequelae. No one can do anything about it, he can only take medicine and acupuncture.
"I've been too busy this fall and haven't seen each other yet, so I haven't thanked you yet.
The doctor said it, but luckily you didn’t move it indiscriminately at that time, and you even bled it, at least this saved the old man’s life.
If it weren't for you on the mountain, our old man would probably hang himself. "Old Mrs. Li said while wiping tears.
It is not to be suspended, but to be certain.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan went to work in the Da’an Coal Mine, but did not work in the field. When he came back during the Chinese New Year, he found out that the old Litou was gone from a sudden illness while watching on the mountain.
After all, it was a memory from many years ago, and it was not a particularly important thing. Xu Shiyan didn't think of it at all before.
After Lao Li had an accident, he thought about it carefully before he remembered it.
But this cannot be said to Mrs. Li. Xu Shiyan can only comfort him, and then quickly unload the things from the sledge and send them to the warehouse for storage.
This autumn and winter, Xu Shiyan has been pulling things a lot.
Pine nuts, walnuts, and hazelnuts filled a sack, and a lot of meat and skins were saved.
Of course, you have to bring everything back when you go down the mountain to celebrate the New Year. Sell what you need to sell, and keep the rest for yourself.
Everything was moved down and packed, and Xu Shiyan carried a pheasant, a hare, a piece of venison and a piece of pork, and entered the east room.
"Uncle, aunt. I just came back from the mountain, and I don't have any good things. They are all made on the mountain. Keep it for eating."
Old Mrs. Li was feeding the old man water, when she saw Xu Shiyan brought something, she waved her hand quickly.
"Oh, San'er, why are you being so polite?
These things, you should take them to your parents, we old couple have nothing to thank you, how can we still accept your things? "
"Mother, if you want to say that, you will be offended.
What is the difference between us and a family? I don't have any other skills, just don't dislike you two elders.
My parents’ side, and what’s more, I’ve been paddling a lot in the mountains this winter.
It’s thanks to my uncle, my uncle is amazing, and those dogs are well trained. "
Without those dogs, Xu Shiyan could still hunt, but certainly not as much as now.
Xu Shiyan admired old Li from the bottom of his heart. When he was young, this old man was absolutely extraordinary.
"San'er, here it is, here it is, keep it, keep it." Old Li didn't slip through his words, and it was a bit difficult.
"Sit, sit." The old man struggled to raise his hand, beckoning Xu Shiyan to sit down.
"No, sir, I just came back and haven't visited my father yet.
I'll go there first, and we'll talk again in the evening. "
I lived on the mountain for several months, and I must go to see my parents when I go down the mountain. This is the rule.
"Hey, hey, night, night, talk."
Old Li is so old, can he not understand this little rule? So he waved his hand at Xu Shiyan, signaling him to go see his parents.
Xu Shiyan came out of the east room, went back to the west room to change clothes, and then dragged the sledge with Su Anying to Xu's house in the east of the village.
"Father, mother, we are going down the mountain." Xu Shiyan shouted as soon as he entered the gate.
"Lao Liu, Jinfeng, Xiaobo, come out and see what delicious food I brought back?"
After all, they are relatives of flesh and blood, and the relationship is still different.
When I first came back from rebirth, I was full of resentment and disliked everyone.
Having lived on the mountain for so long, Xu Shiyan's thoughts have also changed a little.
No matter what, they are also parents and mothers, and those who should be filial should still be filial.
Of course, it is an eternal truth that the smell is far away and near is smelly.
Come back to visit once in a while, just bring something home, but don’t get too close.
Otherwise, Xu Shiyan doesn't think he can bear the old man's bad temper.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Fourth's wedding
chapters.content:
Chapter 70 The marriage of the fourth child
If Xu Shiyan yelled like this outside, Xu Shiqin would have rushed out with his nephew and niece long ago.
But today the house was quiet and there was no movement. Xu Shiyan felt strange and led his wife to the yard.
Until the two of them walked outside the door, just as they were about to reach out to open the door, the door was pushed open from the inside.
"Third brother, you're back?" It was Xu Shiqin, who just looked unhappy.
"What's the matter? Is there something wrong at home?" Xu Shiyan was puzzled and couldn't help asking.
"Don't mention it, isn't the fourth brother engaged on the sixth day of the lunar new year? There is something wrong with the Wu family."
Xu Shiqin sighed, and reached out to help Su Anying enter the door. "Sister-in-law three, be careful, stomp your feet, don't slip."
Brought a foot of snow from the outside, whoever entered the door stomped their feet, the door was wet and slippery.
Xu Shiqin was worried about his sister-in-law, and carefully supported her.
"A moth? What other moths can come out?
At the beginning, they were optimistic about your fourth brother, and they wanted to follow you with shamelessness, but now something is wrong? "
Xu Shiyan was stunned, didn't he remember such a thing in his previous life?
Xu Shide, the fourth eldest of the Xu family, teaches in Qingling, and has been with Wu Qiuyan, the daughter of the Wu family in Qingling, for several years.
The brothers of the Xu family are all good-looking. Xu Shide is a lively person and has a good temper. When he first went to Qingling to teach, he was picked up by the Wu family.
The eldest daughter of the Wu family is named Wu Qiuyan, one year younger than Xu Shide, and looks pretty good. His youngest son happened to be in Xu Shide's class.
The Wu family took a fancy to Xu Shide, no matter what food they cooked, they would ask their youngest son to drag Xu Shide to the house for dinner.
After going back and forth, Xu Shide and Wu Qiuyan saw each other.
The Wu family had long wanted to finalize the marriage, but the Xu family never nodded in agreement.
The main reason is that Xu Shiyan has never had a date. The Xu family is still very strict with rules. The elder brother is not married, and the younger brother cannot marry a wife first.
Finally, in the spring of this year, someone mentioned Su Anying from the big camp to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan's side just got engaged, but the other side of Wu's family urged him to also get engaged, for fear that the marriage would go wrong.
Most people don’t get engaged too early this year, usually one month before they get married, or get engaged at the beginning of the month and get married at the end of the month.
If you know that you have to be a relative when you get engaged, you can’t give gifts during the holidays? The five sons of Xu's family can't afford any money.
So the Xu family has not been in a hurry, and only in autumn did they find a matchmaker to go to the Wu family to discuss the marriage.
At the time, it was also very good. I got engaged on the sixth day of the twelfth lunar month and got married on the twenty-sixth.
It happened that the team divided the money and food, and they had enough money. They killed pigs and held banquets before the year, and celebrated the New Year when they got married.
Unexpectedly, everything for the Xu family's wedding was ready. Xu Shide's school was on winter vacation and was preparing to come back to get engaged. A moth appeared at the Wu family's end.
"The Wu family said that if you want a bride price of 100 yuan, you also need a radio, bicycle, and sewing machine. If you don't have these, you won't get engaged."
Xu Shiqin was very angry. These things add up to five or six hundred yuan.
The key is that bicycles also have radios and sewing machines, which cannot be bought without industrial tickets.
Xu’s family doesn’t have any workers, so where can I get industrial tickets?
Besides, even if there is an industrial ticket, where will the hundreds of dollars come from?
In order for Xu Shide to get married, the family has already made a complete set of furniture and bedding, and bought two catties of wool, a watch, a pair of leather shoes for Wu Qiuyan, and made a pair of cotton clothes. Isn’t this all money?
Xu Shiyan was quite surprised when he heard it. The Wu family has a big appetite, so I dare to ask for it.
Entering the east room, I saw Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan and his wife sitting on the South Kang.
Xu Chenghou was holding a pipe and pot in his mouth, smoking one after another, Zhou Guilan's complexion was not very good.
Seeing Xu Shiyan and his wife enter the door, Xu Chenghou hurriedly knocked the cigarette bag and pot under the edge of the kang, and stopped smoking.
"San'er and his wife are back? Quick, come and sit down. These days, my mother has been nagging, I don't know when you two will go down the mountain?"
Xu Chenghou's attitude was unexpectedly gentle.
This winter, Xu Shiyan brought home a lot of food. No matter if he killed a wild boar, black blind man or roe deer, he would send half of it back.
It can be said that after the winter, the Xu family has not lost their flesh, and life is much better than in previous years.
Who in the village does not envy the Xu family? It is said that Xu Chenghou and his wife raised a capable son, and the whole family followed suit.
Xu Chenghou also felt that his face was radiant, and his attitude towards this third son changed from the past, and his attitude was naturally quite different.
Xu Shiyan's attitude towards his father made him feel uneasy. Did his father take the wrong medicine? I've never seen my father so kind before.
It was Zhou Guilan who pulled his son, so Xu Shiyan sat down, and Su Anying also sat on the edge of the kang.
"Father, Mom, I just heard what happened from the sixth child?" After Xu Shiyan sat down, he had to ask.
"Oh, don't mention it, the family is worrying about the marriage of the fourth child." Zhou Guilan sighed and told Xu Shiyan about the matter.
"You said that it's almost time to get engaged, but there's another thing like that.
One hundred yuan gift, we can still take it out, but where can we find radios and bicycles?
Isn't this embarrassing? "As Zhou Guilan said, her eyes turned red.
Outsiders look at the five sons of Xu's family, and their days are prosperous, but in fact, whoever knows who's life is sad.
Just the fact that these five sons got married and married their daughter-in-law is enough to cause headaches.
The first three are okay, they all went well.
Although the eldest daughter-in-law and the second daughter-in-law are both educated youths, they didn’t want this or that at the beginning, and they all arranged marriages according to the rules of the village.
If the fourth child gets married, it is really done according to the requirements of the Wu family. What do the first three daughter-in-laws think? Can you be happy?
Where is the fifth daughter-in-law in the back? Do you want more when the fifth child gets married?
Zhou Guilan really felt distressed, almost dying of worry.
"Why worry? I didn't like the old Wu's house at first.
How can their family do things like this? Why can't a good girl get married if she can't get married? Dragging the young man home all day long?
What the **** is this? "Xu Cheng generously stared at Xu Shide who was sitting on the North Kang.
"Looking at you, you are very smart, doing stupid things, so you have no place to eat, right? Do you have to go to his house to eat?
You can't find a wife? Do you have to find Lao Wu's family? "Xu Chenghou was full of anger, and all of them were directed at the fourth child.
Xu Shide is also very depressed. This is something that has been agreed, but he changed his mind temporarily. Is he going to get married or not?
"People have long said that they want to get engaged, but you two disagree, and you are reluctant to part with the little money for the holidays.
If you get engaged early, can this happen? "Xu Shide lowered his head and muttered in a low voice.
"You bastard, tell me again? I'll kick you to death today."
Xu Chenghou is not deaf, how could he not hear what his son said?
At that time, I was on fire, and I raised my hand to pick up the broom, and I was about to smoke my son.
Xu Shixian are all in the east room, how can he really let his father beat the fourth child? So hurry up and stop.
"Dad, if you have something to say, don't do anything."

chapters.title: Chapter 71: delicious
chapters.content:
Chapter 71 Delicious
Xu Shiyan didn't know why the Wu family changed their minds. In his previous life, Xu Shide's marriage went smoothly and there were no such troubles.
But he knew that it would be very difficult to deal with this matter now.
Because Xu Shiyan clearly remembered that Wu Qiuyan entered the house on the 26th day of the twelfth lunar month, and gave birth to Xu Haiyang in the sixth lunar month of the following year.
At that time, it was said that the child was born prematurely, but Xu Haiyang gave birth to more than seven catties, which was not premature at all.
If this is the case, at this moment, Wu Qiuyan already has goods in her stomach.
What year is this? In 1977, the folk customs were not so open yet.
The two slept together before they were married, and they were pregnant with a baby. Not only the woman would be ashamed, but the man would be ashamed as well.
Moreover, once the woman retorts that the man is playing hooligans, the result will be even more terrifying.
Xu Shide would be caught and squatted on the fence if he was light, but if he was heavy, he might eat peanuts.
Of course, the Wu family should not be so ruthless, and probably just want to take advantage of the opportunity to get more benefits from the Xu family.
Otherwise, they would just come here directly, and they wouldn’t let the matchmaker send a message asking for so many things.
"Father, don't hit him. What's the use of hitting him when things are at this point? Find a way to solve it."
Xu Shiyan sighed, he really didn't want to come back, as soon as he got home, he would have all kinds of troubles, is it so difficult to calm down and live his life?
"How can I solve it? One hundred yuan dowry, two turns and one sound, smashed my old bones, and our family can't afford these."
Xu Chenghou was stopped by his sons, the broom bump in his hand couldn't reach the fourth child, so he simply threw it over, hitting his son on the head.
"The money was just divided in the Gregorian calendar year. Excluding the two of you, the four strong laborers in the family plus your mother, the total is only about 600 yuan.
Take it to him as a daughter-in-law, our family can't make it through? "
The Xu family has a lot of labor and a lot of food. There are more than a dozen people, old and young, and the rations are several thousand catties a year.
After deducting the food from the work points, it can be converted into six or seven hundred yuan, which is really a good day.
"Fourth, you should go to the Wu family now, have a good talk with them, and ask what the Wu family thinks.
The conditions put forward by their family, let alone our big house village, even if they go to the commune, no, even the county, there are not many families that can meet it. "
"If their family doesn't want to get married, they should make it clear as soon as possible, don't be so embarrassing.
If their family still wants to marry their daughter, they should talk about it carefully, and make a fuss after the wedding date is fixed, and spread it to make outsiders laugh. "
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, and suggested that Xu Shide go to Wu's house to find out.
It is not suitable for others to come forward. Anyway, Xu Shide is getting married. This **** has done everything that should be done and should not be done. He can't hide and not show up when things come to an end, right?
"Huh? Let me go? Can it work?" Xu Shide hesitated.
"Isn't it always the matchmaker who talks about marriage? How can I talk about it myself?"
"Aren't you going? If you don't come forward for your own marriage, who will come forward? What's wrong? You still want our parents to come forward?
Get out, hurry up, and come back after clearing things up. "
Before, Xu Shiyan had a low status in the family, his father didn't like him, and his brothers looked down on him, so he didn't speak harshly.
It’s different now, he’s moved out and lived a different life, and he’s living a pretty good life, his back is tough, and of course he speaks hard.
"Well, I think what the third brother said makes sense. Fourth brother, you should go to Qingling immediately.
Tell the Wu family that they want a bride price of 100 yuan, and I can give it with a gritted teeth, but I can’t get anything else, we can’t get it. "
Xu Chenghou pondered for a while, and felt that this was the only way at present, so he immediately ordered Xu Shide to go to Qingling.
Xu Shide was filled with displeasure, but there was nothing he could do.
I had no choice but to put on my coat, hat and gloves, and went straight to Qingling to talk to the Wu family.
"Oh, yes, I brought back a lot of meat, and it's all in the yard."
Xu Shiyan just remembered that he had half pulled the sledge, and they were all placed in the yard.
"The fourth child is going to get married and have a banquet. I thought about the fact that there is not much meat in the family. I have been doing a lot of work these days, so I wanted to come back and use it for the fourth child's wedding.
Old Five, come and move with me, tidy it up and keep it for use. "Xu Shiyan said, got up and walked out.
The three brothers of the Xu family were all sitting in Beikang, and when they heard this, they hurried out.
The others couldn't sit still any longer, and went out to watch the excitement. Take a look outside, good guy, put two sacks on the sledge.
"What's all this? It's all meat?" The whole family was dumbfounded.
How many things did the third child row and pull on the mountain this winter? I often send it home, and today I got two sacks back?
"Not all, there are some pine nuts, walnuts, hazelnuts, grape cakes, dried jujubes, sugar plum cakes, mountain red skins, and sorbets.
It was all made by Yingzi when she was idle on the mountain, and kept it for Lao Liu and the children to eat.
The rest is wild boar, black blind, deer, roe deer meat.
Anyway, this winter has really been busy, I left some favors, and brought the rest to my family. "
These two couples are restless people, and Su Anying is doing all kinds of things when she goes up the mountain.
She can't hunt, but she can pick walnuts, hazelnuts, mountain grapes, sugar plums and so on.
The mountain grapes were boiled into cakes according to Xu Shiyan's method and then dried in the sun, and the soft dates were directly dried.
Ripe sugar plums are rubbed with a sieve to get powdery pulp, steamed with some starch, kneaded into small cakes and dried, which can also be used as snacks.
Peel off the skin of the sorbet, thread it on a thread and hang it to dry.
Dried until half-dried, put it in a pot to steam, and then take it out to dry after steaming, it is pear tuozi.
Sorbee meat is sour and astringent, it is not delicious to eat directly, but it is dried into pear lumps and steamed with water, but it is sour and sweet and delicious.
In the era when there were no snacks, these things were the children's favorite.
It’s just that most people don’t have the time to do it. Autumn is too busy to take care of the autumn harvest. Who cares?
Su Anying followed Xu Shiyan up the mountain, and she didn't need to do any work, so she did these under Xu Shiyan's guidance.
"Oh, sister-in-law three, you are the best, get us so many delicious food."
Xu Shiqin became happy when he heard that there were so many snacks.
Several younger ones also came to Su Anying's side. The third aunt was the elder and the third aunt was short, which made Su Anying so confused.
Zhou Guilan was also very happy. She walked up to the sledge and carefully looked at the things in the sack.
Then he instructs his son to put all kinds of frozen meat in the warehouse, and take the rest of the snacks in the house.
Things were unloaded from the sledge, and the family happily returned to the east house.
Zhou Guilan grabbed a few handfuls of food from the bag, and asked Xu Shiqin to take the children to Westinghouse to eat, where the adults talked.
"Third brother, the team divided up the money a few days ago, and the money of the two of you is here with me."
Zhou Guilan got up, found a stack of money from the cabinet, and handed it to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan and his wife got a lot of work points. In addition to food, they also shared more than 100 yuan and some tickets.
Xu Shiyan directly took out one hundred and stuffed it to his mother. "Mom, the fourth child is getting married. I don't have much ability. That's all I can do to help."

chapters.title: Chapter 72: brother
chapters.content:
Chapter 72 Brothers
The younger brother is going to get married. As the elder brother who has separated the family, he should express it more or less.
This money is not for Xu Shide, but for the family to help reduce the burden on parents.
"Don't, this winter you took a lot of food from home, and the whole family has enjoyed a lot of glory with you."
Zhou Guilan refused to take it, so she quickly waved her hand.
"You're going to go out and set up a household, and you don't have a house to live in, and your wife is still pregnant, and it's time to have a baby in April next year.
Money is used everywhere, and the money in your hand is not much, so keep it for yourself. "
After Xu Shiyan dug up wild ginseng for the second time, he secretly gave Zhou Guilan one hundred yuan. Zhou Guilan only mentioned it to Xu Chenghou, and no one else in the family knew about it.
This winter, the family kept eating meat, which was sent back by Xu Shiyan, and now he has to give the family money.
Zhou Guilan felt sorry for her son and refused to have it no matter what.
"Mom, Shi Yan gave it to you, so you can keep it.
The two of us lived on the mountain, and we ate food from the team, which didn’t cost much.
There are a lot of people in the family, and the expenses are also high. I don't know what to do with the fourth child's marriage. This little money may not be able to help much.
If you don’t accept it, Shiyan should feel that he gave too little. "
Su Anying sat beside her mother-in-law, and stuffed the money directly into Zhou Guilan's pocket.
The son and daughter-in-law said so, what else can Zhou Guilan do? Only paid.
"Oh, it's getting late, hurry up and cook.
You two can eat here at night, don't go back to work, you probably don't have anything on the other side. "
Suddenly raised his head, just in time to see the clock on the wall, seeing that it was almost four o'clock, he quickly called the two daughters-in-law to cook.
"Linzi, you two should turn on the fire and cook quickly, stew sauerkraut at night, and heat up some fire-sticking spoons."
Sticky fire spoon is a kind of food that people in Northeast China like very much.
Sticky grains, such as rhubarb rice, sticky millet, sticky sorghum, sticky corn, etc., soak in water for about a week, and push the water to grind.
Put it out to stick the dough, put it in a cloth bag to control the excess water, then use the sticky dough to make a skin, wrap it with bean filling and pat it flat.
Heat a dry pan, put a griddle in the pan, and place the wrapped sticky spoon on the griddle until cooked.
The large fields in the team grow corn and beans, and the private plots and small wastelands of each family are generally used to grow broomcorn, millet, sorghum, small beans and other miscellaneous grains.
Xu's family is diligent, picking up a lot of small pieces of wasteland, planting some broomcorn and glutinous millet every year, just keeping the sticky fire spoon.
Soak a hundred catties of rice at a time, and sometimes it takes several days to wrap the sticky fire spoon.
Pick up the cooked sticky fire spoon in a bucket and put it in the warehouse to freeze. When eating, pick up a pot and bring it back, put it in the pot and steam it again.
Northeast people like to eat sticky food. In winter, sticky fire spoon and sticky bean buns are packed, and in summer, sticky mice are packed. Sticky food digests slowly and resists hunger.
Of course, there are also disadvantages, that is, people with a bad stomach eat less, and they are prone to heartburn.
The bean paste in the sticky fire spoon is sweet. There is not so much white sugar in this year, and it is all saccharin.
Fire-sticking spoons do not taste right with other dishes, but only go well with sauerkraut, so in Northeast China, most of the time, sticky-fire spoons are eaten with sauerkraut.
My brother-in-law brought home a lot of food all winter, and today he brought back so much. Although it is famously reserved for banquets, after all, the family can follow suit.
Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong also changed their previous attitudes and were extra diligent. As soon as the mother-in-law said, the two immediately went to cook.
Su Anying felt that it was shameful for her to let her sisters-in-law cook, and she was idle in the house, so she followed to the kitchen, but was pushed back by the two sister-in-laws.
"You are pregnant with a child now, just wait for the meal honestly, and you still need to do this work?"
Just like that, Su Anying was driven back to the east room, and chatted with Zhou Guilan.
On the other end, Xu Shixian and his friends also called Xu Shiyan to Beikang, where the brothers chatted.
"Fifth, what are your plans for the future?"
Xu Shixiang took the college entrance examination before, but the review time was too short, his grades were not good, and he failed the exam.
"I still want to review and take the exam again, but my father is not happy."
Because of failing the college entrance examination, Xu Shixiang fell ill a few days ago, and now he is still listless, with a few blisters at the corners of his mouth, and it looks like he is quite angry.
"Well, review well and take the exam again next year. This year's time is too short, and it's normal if you don't pass the exam."
In the summer of 1978, Xu Shixiang took the college entrance examination again and was admitted to Tonghua Agricultural School, which can be regarded as a technical secondary school.
After graduating two years later, he was assigned to Xinglong Commune as a civil affairs assistant.
Later, I slowly entered the Finance Office, transferred to Yushu Township and became the deputy head of the township, and finally entered the county forestry workstation as the station manager.
It can be said that Xu Shixiang is the best one among the five Xu family brothers.
"Third brother, you have time to help me talk to my father, my father is listening to you now.
You don’t know if you’re not at home, but he always praises you in front of us. "Xu Shixiang forced a smile, with a hint of pleading in his tone.
Xu Shiyan was taken aback for a moment, then shook his head with a smile, "My father praised me? It's fine if he doesn't scold me.
You listen to me, don't talk to my father, you should review and study hard, and work hard to pass the exam and go to college. It will change your whole life. "
With the old man's temper, if he talks about it, he will definitely suffer, and he doesn't want to cause trouble.
In the previous life, without him to persuade him, is it different for the fifth child to take the college entrance examination?
Xu Shixiang was stunned when he heard the words, and then laughed, "Well, I think so too."
Brothers and I haven’t gathered together to talk for a long time, this unexpected gathering, talking and laughing is also very lively.
Of course, there are also quite a few changes.
In the past, Xu Shiyan listened silently to his brothers and said something occasionally, but now, his brothers surrounded him.
Keep asking about watching and hunting on the mountain, especially when it comes to hunting, that brother's eyes are shining.
"Third son, let's go up the mountain another day?
Let me tell you, a few days ago I went to work in a forest farm and saw a Tiancangzi, but I didn’t tell anyone.
I'm just waiting for you to come back, we brothers are going to kill Cangzi. "Xu Shi'an looked excited, eager to try.
The bear bile of the black blind man was sold for 400 yuan last time, and the two brothers shared 200 yuan each.
Xu Shian only gave his mother one hundred, and kept the rest for himself.
Originally, he wanted to go up the mountain to find Xu Shiyan to hunt together, but Wei Mingrong stopped him.
How can there be so many black and blind people in the mountains? Just some wild boars are useless, they can only be eaten and cannot be sold for money, so it is better to go to the forest farm to earn some money.
Xu Shian couldn't handle his wife, so he had no choice but to work in the forest farm.
As a result, Xu Shi'an got into a fight with their trumpeter. He quarreled with him the day before yesterday, and went home in a fit of anger.
Fortunately, he worked in the forest farm for a while, but he discovered a quite hidden black blind warehouse.
If Tian Cangzi could be killed and get another bear gall, he wouldn't have to look for work anymore.
"Second brother, are you reading that right?" Xu Shiyan became energetic when he heard that.
He wished to kill a few more black blind warehouses and earn more money. There are many places to use the money in the future. "Where?"

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Zhou Guilan cursed
chapters.content:
Chapter 73 Zhou Guilan Cursing
“It’s just crossed the Xiaoganba River, but it’s not yet at Dadingzi.
Isn’t there a logging area at the other end this year? Going three miles southwest from the logging area, I turned over a post and saw a big poplar tree.
That day when I was working, I was looking for a place to relieve my hands, and I happened to see a roe deer, so I chased the roe deer, but I didn’t catch it, and found the tree.
The tree hole is surrounded by hoarfrost, there must be a big guy inside. "Xu Shi'an talked about his discovery of Tiancangzi with a proud face.
Xu Shiyan probably knew where it was based on his second brother's description.
It's really remote there, and his second brother is really good at it, and he can go there.
"Second brother, I don't know what's going on with the fourth brother's marriage. I just came back from the mountain and I still have some things to do.
Let’s do this, wait for two or three days, I’ll do something first, and then we’ll bring guns and dogs to kill Cangzi. "
A black-blind gallbladder, even straw gallbladder, can sell for three or four hundred.
Copper guts would be more valuable, so why not use them?
In the future, there will be places where money is used to live. Since I know there is a black blind warehouse, I must go.
The second child and the third child chatted very enthusiastically, and Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang couldn't hold their breath anymore.
"Third brother, bring me and eldest brother with you when the time comes, it's winter, we are idle at home anyway.
It happened that our brothers were together. "Xu Shixiang asked enviously.
"Okay, that's even better. Let's go into the mountains together, and we'll hit whatever we see, just to get something for the New Year."
Xu Shiyan is good at marksmanship, and he is also very powerful with those hunting dogs. If you say that ordinary black and blind people don't need help from others, he can do it by himself.
But hunting is very dangerous, and no one dares to say what will happen in the middle. It is best to have a few people together.
People say that brothers fight in battle, and father and son fight in battle.
It’s the same with hunting, it’s all about the combination of the individual and the horse, and when it’s critical, someone has to come forward and risk their lives to save them.
In the previous life, there were bumps and frictions among the brothers, especially when the house was demolished at the end, which made Xu Shiyan disheartened and full of resentment towards the brothers.
When he was reborn, Xu Shiyan really had a grudge against his brothers and didn't want to talk to them.
But after coming back for such a long time, especially those days on the mountain, Xu Shiyan also thought a lot.
Brothers and flesh and blood, one mother and one compatriot, growing up together since childhood.
There are conflicts because each has a family and takes care of himself. Everyone has a wife and children. Who can be so selfless?
Brothers, even if there is a little conflict, when you encounter a big event, you are still unanimous.
As for the disputes in my previous life, I was actually poor, and only cared about it when I was not doing well.
In this life, Xu Shiyan would not dare to say that he is rich, as long as he avoids the pitfalls in his previous life, he will not live too badly in the future.
People, you still have to look forward, and you can't always be entangled in those things in the past.
Isn't everything going well now?
Xu Shiyan also noticed the change in the attitude of his parents and brothers, and he couldn't always remember the little things in his previous life.
Of course, as the old saying goes, relatives smell better when they are far away.
He comes back to help out when there is an important matter at home. If there is nothing to do, it is better not to get together all the time, so that conflicts will be much less.
Xu Shiyan agreed to hunt together so happily, and the other brothers were also very happy.
Now the talk is getting more and more lively, and there is a tendency to want to stop.
Just at this time, the food was ready, so I hurriedly set the table to eat.
The Xu family has a total of three rooms, the middle one is used for the kitchen, and the east and west rooms are Kangs facing north and south.
The family has a large population, and there is no room for one table, so tables are placed on both the northern and southern kangs.
Xu Chenghou's old couple, Xu Shiyan's husband and wife, and Xu Shixian's brothers ate at the Nankang, while Xue Xiulin's sister-in-law and Xu Shiqin led a few children to eat at the Beikang.
"Don't we have to wait for the fourth child?" Su Anying asked Xu Shiyan in a low voice when the meal was served.
"He went to Wu's house, what else can he lack for food?
Don't worry, if the Wu family doesn't keep him for dinner, then the marriage will probably be ruined.
As long as you keep it, it will be fine, at most it will cost you a little money. "Xu Shiyan dragged his daughter-in-law to sit down nonchalantly.
Xu Shide has wished to grow up in the Wu family these few years. Can the Wu family be short of him for a meal? Don't worry at all.
Su Anying somewhat understood, so she nodded and sat down to eat in peace.
Sauerkraut is stewed with wild boar and tastes good.
There is a soft pancake under the sticky fire spoon, which does not stick to the plate, and it is soft and glutinous when you take a bite. The bean paste inside has a little sweetness, and it tastes good.
In addition to sauerkraut and sticky fire spoon, there are pancakes, corn noodle porridge, and pickles.
Rural people cannot do without porridge for three meals a day. Studies have shown that pasty things are bulky, giving people the illusion of fullness, and can satisfy the stomach quickly.
Such a meal is already very good.
In previous years, let alone meat, I didn’t dare to put oil in the stir-fry. Putting some pumpkin seeds in the cabbage buns made me feel old-fashioned.
Sauerkraut likes oil and water the most. In previous years, without Xu Shiyan hunting, he could only cut potato chips and stew them with sauerkraut.
Now I don’t dare to say that there is meat in Dun Dun, but at least there are oily flowers in it. This is a good day.
The big guys ate to their hearts content. They ate up a bowl of sauerkraut, a few plates of sticky fire spoons, and a basket of pancakes.
After dinner, the woman went to clear the table, and the man got together to continue chatting.
It was getting dark outside, but Xu Shide was not coming back, Zhou Guilan was somewhat worried.
"Old Fifth, why don't you go and have a look. It is supposed to be this time, and your fourth brother should have come back long ago."
From the big house to the eight miles of Qingling, the round trip is only sixteen miles, which is not a problem at all for young people of this age.
Even if the Wu family stayed with Xu Shide for dinner, it stands to reason that he hasn't come back by this time.
Xu Shixiang nodded, put on his thick coat and hat, and was about to go out.
As soon as he stepped out of the gate, he saw a dark figure hurrying over not far away.
"Fourth brother? Why did you come back? Our mother was in a hurry, so she sent me out to look for you." Looking at the figure, it was Xu Shide.
"Oh, don't mention it, let's talk about it in the house." Xu Shide braved the wind and snow to walk this way, and was terribly cold, so he hurried into the house.
"Mom, come out, I have something to tell you."
Xu Shide walked to the door of the east room, stuck his head inside, looked around the room, and said to his mother.
"What are you doing? Come in if you have something to say, what is the attitude of the old Wu family? Do they still want to get married?"
Xu Shide's sneaky appearance made Xu Chenghou very disgusted.
"They are all my family members, what can't I say in front of my face?"
I used to think that the fourth child was pretty good, quick-witted, and easy to do things, why is it that the more I look at it, the more I don’t like it now? Still can't catch up with the third child who is stable and reliable.
Xu Shide shrank his neck, didn't dare to answer his father's words, but still waved at his mother.
Seeing this, Zhou Guilan had no choice but to get off the ground and talk to her son in the outer room.
I don't know what the two girls said in the outhouse, but after a while, I heard Zhou Guilan swearing loudly.
"You bastard, you can do anything, you're trying to **** me off."
The people in the room were all dumbfounded. After all these years, I have never heard my mother swearing. What's wrong?

chapters.title: Chapter 74: beat up
chapters.content:
Chapter 74 A violent beating
Xu Shide was sneaky and dared not enter the house just now, so he had to call his mother to the outhouse.
Xu Shiyan knew at a glance that this **** boy must have known about Wu Qiuyan's pregnancy. He was afraid that his father would beat him up, so he consulted with his mother first.
Xu Shiyan snorted coldly in his heart, even though the mother has a good temper and protects the children, that's nothing to worry about.
As far as Xu Shide's mistakes are concerned, slapping him eight hundred times is enough, counting on his mother to protect him, it's just a dream.
Sure enough, Zhou Guilan's scolding sounded from the outer room.
"Old Xu, come out, beat this little bastard, and expose his skin for me."
As soon as I heard it, I knew that Zhou Guilan was already in a state of rage.
Xu Chenghou has been married to his wife for so many years, and he has never seen a daughter-in-law like this. He immediately put on his shoes and went to the outhouse.
Without further ado, he slapped his son there first.
"Little brat, what the **** did you do to make your mother so angry?"
If it comes to talk, the first three of the Xu family's six children are often beaten and scolded.
The first three have basically never been scolded, let alone beaten.
The boss mainly caused trouble when he was in the camp.
Xu Shixian ignored the influence of the environment at that time as if he had been possessed by a demon.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan refused to listen to what they said and tried to persuade them. Later, Xu Chenghou was hung up and whipped, almost beating him to death.
Thanks to the beating, Xu Shixian was beaten and lay on the kang for more than half a month, missing the opportunity to go out with others.
Xu Shixian ended up making trouble in the commune, and didn't even go to the county, so he wouldn't be liquidated later.
Even so, there is a note left in the file, otherwise, with Xu Shixian's talent, he will be the backbone of literature and art wherever he goes.
The second child was beaten mainly because he was naughty.
Teasing cats and dogs outside, fighting and fighting, and going home to climb houses and do various things.
Xu Chenghou couldn't take it anymore, he beat his head and face, and didn't change after the beating, and continued to work after the injury recovered.
The third child, Xu Shiyan, don't mention it.
When I was a child, I had troubles, and I cried when it was time to eat, and walked out while crying.
Those who didn’t know thought that the family abused him and didn’t give him food.
At that time, everyone was stupid and didn't understand. In fact, Xu Shiyan just had a bad stomach.
His stomach hurts after eating, can he stop crying?
The adult thought he was just looking for trouble, so he brought the child back from the outside and beat him up.
There are three elder brothers who are in the front for comparison, and the latter three are more sophisticated, trying not to provoke their parents.
Xu Shide has been smart and smart since he was a child, and he is the best at winking.
The adult's expression was slightly wrong, and he immediately admitted his mistake. Such a child will basically not be beaten.
Zhou Guilan was so angry that he called out Xu Chenghou to beat his son, and even said that he would peel off his skin. It is conceivable that Xu Shide made a lot of mistakes this time.
That's why Xu Chenghou came out and did it without saying a word.
Don't look at the old man's age, beating people is unambiguous, let's give his son a good meal first.
Where did Xu Shide receive this? There was nowhere to hide from being beaten by the father, so he could only cover his head with his hands to protect his face, and shouted at his mother and brothers.
In the east room, Xu Shixian and others heard it, and they were about to come out to start a fight, but Xu Shiyan stopped him.
"Don't worry about it, my mother has such a good temper that she's offended. This kid made a lot of mistakes. Let my father beat him up first."
The eldest brother and the second child glanced at the third child, feeling that something was wrong, "Third child, do you know something?"
"No, I don't know anything. I know that our mother is angry. The consequences are serious. We'd better not get involved."
Xu Shiyan shrugged his shoulders and asked three questions.
Xu Shiyan stopped him, but the brothers failed to fight, and Xu Shide was beaten up by the old man.
Xu Chenghou was old after all, and he was very tired after beating for a while, so he stopped to catch his breath and asked Zhou Guilan.
"What's the matter? How did this **** mess with you?"
Yes, this is Xu Chenghou, beat him up first without asking about anything, and talk about it after the beating is over.
"Ask him, what did he do?
Why did the old Wu family change their minds when they were about to get engaged, and insisted on three major gifts? Wasn't it caused by this shriveled brat? "
It's okay not to mention it, but when it is mentioned, the anger in Zhou Guilan's heart rises.
Xu Chenghou also faintly sensed that something was wrong at this time, he raised his foot and kicked Xu Shide again.
"Say, what's going on? If you don't make it clear today, I'll really scratch your head."
What can Xu Shide do? If you don't say anything, you will be beaten, so let's say it.
"Father, she has Xiaoyan, and it has been two months.
The Wu family was very angry, saying that they asked our family to give a gift of 100 yuan, plus three other items, or a gift of 500 yuan.
Otherwise, they'll sue me for hooliganism. "
Things turned out to be as Xu Shiyan expected. The Wu family deliberately threatened Xu Shide with the excuse of Wu Qiuyan's pregnancy.
Of course, the Wu family didn't really want to sue, but actually took the opportunity to ask for more money.
When Xu Chenghou heard his son's words, he became furious and kicked Xu Shide over.
"You bastard, you dare to do anything?
You haven’t gotten married yet, so you slept with someone else’s girl, and now you have children?
When did the old Xu family come out with something like you? I must kill you today. "
Xu Chenghou's shout, everyone in the east room understood it, and Xu Shixian and the others suddenly looked very unhappy.
If we talk about it, these things are not unheard of now.
There are a lot of strange things in the countryside, and I have heard of people who steal people to raise men and make broken shoes.
It happened in someone else's house, and everyone was just talking and laughing after dinner.
But if it happened at home, it would be really different. If it spreads out, it won’t make people laugh? Where do you put your face? In the future, you can't let people poke your spine when you go out?
"It's time to beat him up, it's not too much to beat him up, he dares to do anything, the fourth child is too confused." Xu Shixian was also very angry, and said angrily.
"Okay, let's not talk about beating or not, our father should be tired after beating for a long time, hurry up and pull away."
Xu Shiyan could already hear that the old man was panting heavily. After all, he was almost sixty, so what if something happened again?
The three   brothers came out of the room, stepped forward and grabbed Xu Chenghou.
"Father, something has happened, let's find a way to solve it, it's useless to fight."
Xu Chenghou was tired and angry, his face was flushed now, his forehead was covered with sweat, and he stood there panting heavily.
"Solution? How to solve it? He wants a bride price of 500 yuan, or sue him.
Smash my old bones and weigh them on a scale. Is it worth five hundred yuan? "
Xu Chenghou was so angry that he was about to die. How could his son, who has always been shrewd and sensible, make such a mistake?
"He shouldn't have been allowed to teach in Qingling in the first place, and he shouldn't have been allowed to live in a dormitory there. It's a good thing now, how much trouble has it caused?"
Zhou Guilan was flustered over there, even more sad and disappointed.
At present, the fourth son is the most promising among the five sons.
Substitute teachers become regulars, eat public food, and receive wages. How can they do such a thing?
"Five hundred dollars, where can we get them?"
"Yo, five hundred yuan, is the daughter of his old Wu family worth gold?
I can see that we are still worthless. Back then, we didn’t ask for a penny as a gift, it was so stupid. "
In the room, Xue Xiulin said with an unhappy face.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: calculate
chapters.content:
Chapter 75 Calculations
Xue Xiulin started, Wei Mingrong also followed suit, Su Anying was honest, she didn't speak, but her expression was not quite right.
The faces of the old couple of the Xu family were very ugly.
It’s already very difficult to deal with things at this level. If one is not handled well, the whole village will know about it, and the daughters-in-law in the family will also have various grievances.
"Get the **** out of here." Zhou Guilan glared at Xu Shide and called him into the back room.
A group of people returned to the east room.
Zhou Guilan asked Xu Shiqin to lead the children to the Westinghouse and put them to sleep.
Adults can’t let the children hear what they talk about. These little kids don’t understand anything. What if they go out and talk nonsense?
Xu Shiqin also understood that she, a grown girl, could not get involved in these matters, so she obediently led her nephews and nieces back to the Westinghouse to sleep.
At the east room, Zhou Guilan calmed down a little, glanced at everyone, and finally sighed.
"You heard it just now, the fourth brother did something wrong, and now the Wu family has taken advantage of it.
Now that it's the day of engagement, what should I do about it? "
"What can I do? I have caused trouble and figured out what to do.
Old Wu’s family sued if they wanted to, and when the police came to arrest him, they let him go to the fence. "
Xu Chenghou became angry when he saw the fourth child, wishing to beat him up again.
"Anyway, I can't afford three big pieces, and I don't have five hundred yuan to give him as a bride price.
Our family married three daughters-in-law, and we didn’t say which one would ask for a bride price of 500 yuan. "
I have never heard of asking for a bride price these days, and there is no such thing at all.
If the man’s conditions are good, most of them are like the Xu family. They have made furniture and bedding for the woman, and then prepared a watch, two sets of thick and thin clothes, a pair of leather shoes, and two catties of wool for the woman.
This is already the highest standard, Xue Xiulin is an educated youth, the Xu family is afraid that they will be wronged, so they give these.
Later, when Wei Mingrong and Su Anying married in, they also followed the previous example.
If it were an ordinary family, they didn’t even have these, so it would be great if they could make up half of it.
There are still people who have nothing and can't even set up a banquet, so don't they get together to live?
So, if the Wu family wants three big things and a gift of five hundred yuan, this is making trouble for no reason and purely embarrassing others.
Hearing what her husband said, Zhou Guilan shook her head, "Yes, where do we get the five hundred yuan gift? Isn't it embarrassing?"
Xu Shide, who was standing in the middle of the ground with his head down, secretly raised his head, glanced at Xu Shiyan, and muttered something.
"I don't have any at home. Doesn't the third brother have one? The third brother sells sticks and black blind guts. There are more than two thousand."
Xu Shide seemed to be muttering in a low voice, but in fact, everyone in the room could hear him.
When Xu Shiyan heard this, he laughed instead of anger.
At this moment, what else can't you figure out?
From the very beginning, he wondered, Wu Qiuyan got pregnant before she was married, and this happened in her previous life.
Why didn't things go smoothly and get married at that time, but the Wu family is in trouble in this life?
It's three big things and a bride price, if you don't give it, you will sue the officials.
Co-authored to the end, the source is actually here.
The Wu family had heard about Xu Shiyan, and knew that Xu Shiyan would definitely be able to spend the money, so they wanted to make a fortune without fear.
"Fourth brother, tell third brother the truth.
Did the Wu family say what you just said, or do you also think so? "Xu Shiyan lowered his face and asked Xu Shide.
"Third brother..." Xu Shide hesitated and couldn't speak.
Xu Shiyan nodded, "Okay, I understand."
While talking, Xu Shiyan stood up directly, and gave Xu Shide a fist when he went up.
"Outsiders are jealous when they see your third brother earning so little money, and they blackmail people overtly and covertly to make things difficult for them. I'm never angry.
Because those are outsiders, it is normal for them to be envious and jealous.
But what about you? You are my own younger brother, you think of me like an outsider? Fourth brother, you let my brother feel cold. "
This is why Xu Shiyan doesn't like to go home. He would rather lead his wife to live on the mountain than come back and see his brothers scheming about his little money.
Originally, it felt pretty good to chat with my brothers in the afternoon and discuss the matter of hunting in the mountains.
Xu Shiyan also let go of the grudges in his heart, thinking that there is no need to care so much about his brothers.
It was just late at night, and the fourth child gave him this one.
"Daughter-in-law, let's go back to get dressed, it's getting late, you can't stay up late, go back early and rest."
Xu Shiyan punched his younger brother, didn't continue, and led Su Anying outside.
Before going out, Xu Shiyan turned his head to look at the old couple of the Xu family.
"Father, Mom, tomorrow you two will take him directly to the Wu family, and follow how the Wu family handles him.
Anyway, it’s just this group of people, if the Wu family wants to fight or kill, or sue the officials and arrest people, it’s up to them.
The troubles he caused are his own responsibility, and his parents can't control him for the rest of his life. The Wu family likes to do whatever they want, and they don't need to give them any more money. "
Since in the previous life, the Wu family was able to marry their daughter without giving up anything, it is impossible to really send Xu Shide in this life.
This kind of thing can't be slapped with a single slap, but if something happens, the Xu family will be ashamed, and the Wu family will be even more ashamed.
There are several daughters behind the Wu family, don't you believe they dare to make trouble?
After saying this, Xu Shiyan helped his wife, went out of the house, and left the Xu family.
It wasn't until the sound of the outer door closing that everyone in the room came back to their senses.
Xu Cheng generously picked up the broom bump, and gave Xu Shide another blow.
"You bastard, what are you thinking about? What is your third brother doing to the family?
The last time you sold clubs, your third brother secretly gave your mother a hundred dollars behind your back.
Just now your mother gave him the dividends from the team, and he took out another 100 yuan, saying it was reserved for your wedding.
When my elder brother does this, he has exhausted his benevolence and righteousness, and you are still not satisfied. "
After this winter, Xu Chenghou's attitude towards his third son has long since changed. He didn't say anything, but he paid more and more attention to Xu Shiyan in his heart.
With Xu Shiyan here to compare, the more you look at the fourth child, the more ineffective, and the more you want to beat him up.
"Huh? Did the third brother give the family money? I don't know."
Xu Shide was dumbfounded, and no one told him, how could he know?
"The third brother not only gave the family money, but also said that he would take us hunting in a few days. Now you have offended me. I don't know if the hunting can be done?"
On the other end, Xu Shixiang said very distressed.
A black and blind man, at least four or five hundred dollars will fly like this.
It can make the fourth brother **** off. He looks good every day, but he is actually an idiot.
"Well, I don't know, you don't tell me anything."
Xu Shide was in a hurry, "Then what should I do now? Shall I go and chase the third brother back?"
"What time is it? It's dark outside, and your third sister-in-law is pregnant with a child. You can scare her again.
Hey, let’s talk about it in a few days. Go and settle your matter tomorrow. "
Zhou Guilan gouged out her son's eyes a few times, and was really mad at this bear thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 76: determined to move
chapters.content:
Chapter 76 Determined to move away
Xu Shiyan supported Su Anying, came out of Xu's house, and walked all the way to the west of the village.
While walking, Su Anying kept turning her head to look at her husband.
"Shiyan, are you okay?" She was a little worried, feeling that her husband seemed very angry.
Taking advantage of the darkness and no one on the road, Xu Shiyan held his daughter-in-law in his arms and patted her back lightly.
"It's okay, I already knew it in my heart, and I didn't feel much about it."
Come down from the mountain, you can probably guess what will happen.
Although he was on the mountain this winter, rumors of him hunting had already spread throughout the village, and he could be expected to encounter some troubles when he returned.
I just didn't think about it, others are not doing well, but my younger brother made such a mess first.
"Daughter-in-law, would you be happy if I took you away instead of living in the big house?"
Xu Shiyan had thought of moving early in the morning, but these days on the mountain, he thought it was pretty good, so he didn't mention it to his wife.
Now it seems that it is better to move out early.
Whose work will not be guaranteed next year for the ginseng work on the mountain, so plan as soon as possible.
"Move, you can move wherever you want, anyway, I will follow you wherever you go.
Even if you move to the deep mountains and old forests, I will follow you as a savage. "
In Su Anying's place, her husband is right no matter what he does, and she fully supports her.
Xu Shiyan's heart felt hot when he heard the words, and he hugged Su Anying tightly.
This is his little daughter-in-law, who follows him wholeheartedly, regardless of the reason for moving or where she is going.
Where can I find such a good wife?
Although there are all kinds of difficulties in the world, the company of a good wife is bitter and sweet. How can a husband ask for a wife like this?
"Let's move to Donggang, where the place is big, not like a big house in a small valley in the backcountry."
Xu Shiyan coughed twice, controlled his emotions, and explained to his wife softly.
"Our place is too small, the smaller the place, the worse the people.
Because they have never seen the big world, their eyes are only on the three-acre land in the village.
Seeing other people living well makes them feel uncomfortable, jealous and envious, and want to play tricks. "
"We have earned a lot of money this autumn and winter, and we are too showy.
I guess the job of watching the ginseng will be hanging in the year after the year, so I plan to go to Donggang tomorrow, find someone to connect with, and find a way to move out as soon as possible. "
The daughter-in-law doesn't ask, but Xu Shiyan has to explain the reason clearly.
"Oh, oh, you're right, you should plan ahead. Okay, it's better to move to Donggang, as long as you like it, then move."
Su Anying still said that, her husband decides, she has no opinion.
The two walked and chatted all the way like this, and after a while they returned home, washed and tidied up a bit, and got into bed to sleep.
Early in the morning on the second day of the twelfth lunar month, Xu Shiyan started to pack his things.
In the past few months on the mountain, I really got a lot of valuable things.
I saved up two bear bile alone, and a thick pile of all kinds of hides, which had to be sold.
If you stay at home, you are vulnerable to thieves, so it is better to sell the money and save it.
In addition to these, Xu Shiyan also packed a lot of meat, mountain products and the like, and these were reserved for human favors.
Who is empty-handed when asking for help? What's more, it's a major event of relocation and household registration?
Scratching and pulling, I packed a large back basket, at least sixty to seventy catties.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan came out of the house with a basket on his back, all the way to the river.
In winter, the surface of the river has long been frozen, and the thick ice surface is very solid. People can walk on it without any problem.
People who live by the river all the year round don't hesitate to walk on the ice and cross the river quickly.
