"Third brother, when did you go down the mountain? I didn't see you either." Guo Jiang had just walked a short distance when someone behind him greeted him.
Xu Shiyan looked back and saw that it was Zhao Jianshe who was driving the horse sledge up from behind, and there were many people sitting on the sledge.
"Come on, third brother, I just picked you up for a while. It's too heavy to carry such a big basket on your back."
Zhao Jianshe stopped his horse and sledge, and asked Xu Shiyan to go up and sit down.
Xu Shiyan was not polite, and sat directly on the sledge.
"Go to visit relatives, and take a stroll in Songjiang River to see and buy some New Year's goods. What are you doing here?"
"Same, also to buy new year's goods.
Isn’t this a money split in the team? If you have money in hand, why don’t you rush to buy it? At this time, everything is in short supply and you have to grab it. "
The team not only distributed money, but also distributed cloth tickets, cotton tickets and so on.
Looking at the Chinese New Year, I have to tear off a few feet of cloth to add new clothes to the child.
Entering the gate of the twelfth lunar month, who doesn’t buy some New Year’s goods?
The team also understood, so they sent people to drive horses and sledges to carry people to do New Year's goods.
The cold wind is blowing, and the cold wind is poured into the stomach with one mouth, and no one wants to talk too much.
So we chatted for a few words, and everyone shut up.
In winter, there is snow everywhere, and the rough road surface is covered with ice and snow, and it becomes much smoother.
Sledges are more practical than horse-drawn carriages in winter. Horses pull the sledges and run quickly to the Songjiang River.
Passing Pine Forest High School, there is a corner building. Xu Shiyan got off the sledge at the corner building, bid farewell to everyone and walked south.
Others continued to take the sledge to the north and went to the store to buy things.
Xu Shiyan walked for about half an hour with a big back basket on his back, and finally arrived at Zhou's house opposite Donggang Middle School.
The door of Zhuanghuyuan was always open during the day, so Xu Shiyan entered the yard without knocking on the door.
The Zhou family had a big green dog, and when Xu Shiyan came in, he barked.
The people in the room heard it and came out to check, "Are you the third uncle of the Xu family?"
It turned out that this man was twenty-four or five years old, with square features and a good appearance. He was wearing a grass-green military uniform, but his neckline and shoulders were bald.
He looked at Xu Shiyan a few times, and asked with a little doubt.
"It's not bad, you can still recognize me after going out to serve in the army." Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it.
"When did you change jobs and come back?"
This person is Zhou Qingguo, the eldest son of Zhou.
Because of seniority, even though he is only one year younger than Xu Shiyan, he still has to call Xu Shiyan the third uncle.
"I've only been back for about a month, Third Uncle, come in quickly."
Zhou Qingguo was very affectionate when he saw Xu Shiyan, so he hurriedly called Xu Shiyan into the house.
"Dad, Mom, it's the third uncle of the big house Xu family who came." Zhou Qingguo yelled into the house while dragging Xu Shiyan into the house.
In the east room, Zhou Changhe was talking to his wife. When he heard that Xu Shiyan had come, he hurriedly greeted him from the back room.
"Hey, my three brothers are here? I haven't been to Donggang for a while, what are you busy with?"
"Second brother, I'm going to Songjianghe for business today, so I stopped by to see my second brother and sister-in-law."
Xu Shiyan smiled and nodded towards Zhou Changhe, as a greeting.
“I’ve been watching ginseng on the mountain before, so I don’t have time to come here.
Isn’t this some wild boar or something whole on the mountain? I was thinking about sending some to my second brother and second sister-in-law.
It’s not a rare thing, just try something new. "
Xu Shiyan was tossing things out of the basket while talking.
Wild boar meat, roe deer meat, black blind legs, plus a rabbit.
I remember someone said that the back basket can’t hold so many things. Cough cough, I have seen that kind of carrying basket, that is, a person with a height of 1.6 meters is carrying a carrying basket, and when looking from behind, only two feet can be seen. About ten years ago, farmers in Jewelry Hill would carry such large baskets and take the train to Songjianghe to sell things, such as sticky fire spoons and pancakes in winter, and melons and muskmelons in summer. I wondered how the thing with the basket on its back could move.

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Done
chapters.content:
Chapter 77 Done
Zhou Chang and his wife were almost dumbfounded when they saw Xu Shiyan tossing things outside.
Zhou Changhe and Zhou Guilan are just from the same hometown with the same surname, and they don't have much contact on weekdays.
Last time Xu Shiyan brought a large and thin scale, this time he took more, several pieces of meat, isn't that too much?
Serious relatives come to visit, so they don't take so many things.
"Three brothers, what do you think you are doing?
We are very happy that you come to sit at home when you are free. You said that you always bring things when you come back, and you still bring so much, how bad is it? "
Girth and haste to speak. "Don't take it out, keep it for my second aunt and uncle."
"Second brother, I played these when I was watching ginseng on the mountain, and I have played a lot this winter.
I sent half a sledge home yesterday, enough to eat. "Xu Shiyan smiled and put the things on the table.
"Second brother, to tell you the truth, my brother is back, and I really want to ask you for help."
Xu Shiyan knew that if he didn't tell the purpose of coming today, the Zhou family might not be able to accept these things.
So I didn't hide it, and got straight to the point.
"If you have something to say, just say it, why are you being so polite? Look at you heretics."
As soon as he heard that there was something to ask for, Zhou Changhe breathed a sigh of relief.
As the saying goes, you don’t get rewarded for nothing. It’s not okay to accept so many things for no reason. If you want to help, it’s easy to say.
"That's it. After I got married, didn't I live in separate households? There is no development in the big house. I am thinking about moving to Donggang."
Xu Shiyan told the truth, and there was no need to hide it.
"I just want to ask my second brother to help me find out, how to move here, how to move the household registration or something?
One more thing, can my second brother help me find a house?
If there is a house, it is best to sell it away. I will buy one directly. If not, I will borrow someone else’s house for a while, and then I will get a house and build it myself. "
"Hey, what's the big deal for me, that's all." Zhou Changhe slapped his thigh after listening.
"It's not difficult, just a few words from your eldest nephew, he changed jobs and came back to work as a security assistant and militia company commander in the commune.
You just say which team do you like? When you want to move here, Qingguo will handle everything. "
"It's not difficult to borrow two houses to live in, but it's not so easy to buy.
Let your sister-in-law slowly inquire about this matter for you, there must be. "Zhou Changhe was very straightforward and agreed directly.
"Third Uncle, if you want to move to Donggang, is it you and Third Aunt, or the whole family with Second Aunt and Uncle?
You make it clear to me first, and I will tell the secretary here to arrange a good team for you. "
On the other end, Zhou Qingguo also directly stated that this matter is not worth mentioning to him.
"It should be our couple, at most you will bring your sixth aunt." Xu Shiyan thought for a while before speaking.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian's family moved out with Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong back to the city in 1979 in their last life.
Xue Xiulin's work was arranged in the timber factory, Wei Mingrong was arranged in the fiberboard factory, Xu Shixian settled in Donggang Commune, and Xu Shian settled in Dongzhan Vegetable Team.
Xu Shide was transferred to Daying to teach in the summer of 1978.
Because of his outstanding work, he was borrowed by the commune, and after a round of work, he finally became an accountant in the Xigang Township Finance Office.
Xu Shixiang was admitted to university in the summer of 1978. After graduation, he was assigned to Xinglong Commune and left the big house.
So the four brothers don't need to worry about Xu Shiyan, they will all move out in a year or two, and each has its own future.
Xu Shiyan didn't want to interfere in their affairs.
As for the Xu family's old couple, they probably won't be able to move out for a while.
The key is Xu Chenghou's stubborn temper. In his previous life, he refused to move no matter what, and stayed in the big house until his death.
Xu Shiyan didn't think he was capable of persuading that stubborn old man, so let's forget it, wait until the sons have come out to live, and the old man can figure it out himself.
The sixth son, Xu Shiqin, should have moved out earlier.
In the remote place of the big house, there is no development, so you can only wait to get married if you stay there.
Donggang is a big place, maybe you can learn some crafts after moving out, or you can open a shop after a few years when the environment improves.
Zhou Qingguo nodded after listening, "Sure, this matter is on me.
So, third uncle, don’t be in a hurry to move now, after all, the Chinese New Year is coming soon, so spend the New Year with my second aunt and great-uncle.
You moved here before the spring plowing, so you don’t have to delay your work, how about it? "
"Yes, yes, I think so too, just to cause you trouble."
Looking at the Chinese New Year in the twelfth lunar month, and the fourth child is getting married, it is really difficult to mention moving at this time, otherwise it will make the old man angry again.
After the new year, everything on the other side of the big house has been settled, and he moved here with his wife and younger sister, just in time.
"What's the trouble? It's about my family." Zhou Qingguo smiled heartily.
"Don't worry, I'll make arrangements for you here. When the time comes, Third Uncle just needs to bring his household registration."
Speaking of this, the matter of moving is basically a foregone conclusion.
Over there, Zhou Changhe asked his wife to boil water and make tea. The father and son chatted with Xu Shiyan, and they had to inquire about the ginseng on the mountain.
Xu Shiyan didn't talk nonsense, but simply talked about the reasons for seeing ginseng, and the situation of seeing ginseng and hunting on the mountain.
When he heard that Xu Shiyan got some guns, cannons and other things for reference, Zhou Qingguo's eyes lit up, "Third Uncle, you are really good at it, you are a talent."
Able to see ginseng, know how to hunt, and is especially good at planting ginseng. This is the material for a technician. Which team should I put it in to not rush to get it?
"What are talents? It's just living a life. We can do whatever the team asks us to do." Xu Shiyan was a little humble.
The more the three chatted, the more speculative they became, and there was a tendency to want to stop. Zhou Zhanghe also called his wife to let his daughter-in-law prepare, and asked Xu Shiyan to eat at home.
Xu Shiyan looked at his watch, it was past nine o'clock, and he hurriedly got up.
"Second brother, I still have something to do, I have to go to Songjianghe, so I won't have dinner with you today.
When I move here, invite my second brother and Qingguo to drink. "He still has a lot of things to do, so we can't delay.
Zhou's father and son repeatedly tried to persuade him to stay, but Xu Shiyan really had something to do here, so he had no choice but to send it outside the gate.
Xu Shiyan bid farewell to Zhou's father and son, and walked northward with a basket on his back. After walking for about forty minutes, he arrived outside the gate of the Forestry Bureau.
"Hey, isn't this Xiao Xu? I haven't seen you for a long time.
What have you been up to lately and never come? "The old Wang who was watching the gate saw Xu Shiyan for the first time, and dragged Xu Shiyan into the small room very affectionately.
"It's a cold day, hurry up and drink hot water to keep warm."
"Master, I was busy at home a while ago, so I didn't have time to come over.
Isn’t it almost Chinese New Year? Come to buy new year's goods, and bring some mountain goods for the uncle and group leader Guo. "
Xu Shiyan dug out a pack of mushrooms and a hare from his back basket, and gave it to Old Wang.
"Hey, you are so polite, you always bring me something when you come back."
The wrinkles on Uncle Wang's smiling face deepened a lot.
"Let me tell you, you can't be called Team Leader Guo now, he has been promoted, and now he is Director Guo."

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Director Guo
chapters.content:
Chapter 78 Director Guo
"The logistics director of the agency retired a while ago. Team leader Guo has been doing a good job, so the leader promoted him."
Old Wangtou is reminding Xu Shiyan not to say the wrong thing when he meets Director Guo later.
Xu Shiyan was overjoyed when he heard the words, it really was the right time to come today.
It seems that Lao Guo’s line cannot be broken, and it is well maintained, and it may be used in the future.
"Thank you, sir, which office does Director Guo work in now?
I also brought him some wild goods. It’s almost Chinese New Year, just a little thought. "
"Oh, it's next to the original office, you can go find him, he came to work this morning."
Old Wangtou is at this age, and he is guarding the gate of the bureau again. He can't understand what is going on, so he immediately gives Xu Shiyan some advice.
"Success, then I will go to Director Guo first, and then I will talk to the uncle later."
Xu Shiyan put his basket on his back, left the guardhouse hut, and went straight to the bureau building.
Sure enough, I found Guo Shouye in the office, and he seemed to be fatter than before.
"Director Guo, are you busy?" Xu Shiyan smiled as soon as he entered the door.
It so happened that there was no one in Guo Shouye's office at the moment, so when he looked up and saw Xu Shiyan, he was surprised.
"Brother Xu, you haven't been here for a long time, and our leader is still thinking about the slender fish, and told me about it several times."
How many simple people can become directors? Although Xu Shiyan is nothing, he will not ignore him with a cold face.
"In autumn, the fields are busy, so I can't take care of them. In winter, the river is closed, so it's not easy to catch fish.
If the leader is really thinking about it, I will smash a few holes in the ice when I go back to see if I can get some, so that the leader can try it out. "
Xu Shiyan heard the meaning inside and outside the words of Lao Guo, so he had to explain a few sentences.
"Director Guo, I'm here to buy New Year's goods today. I stopped by to see you. I happened to have some wild goods at home. Don't be disgusted."
Come here, just to deliver things. Lao Guo’s line is very useful, and it must not be broken easily, and it must be well maintained.
Giving up some things can bring you greater benefits in the future. This is a necessary investment.
Xu Shiyan took out something while talking.
Naturally, the ones given to Director Guo can’t be pheasants and hares, but some high-end ones.
"I beat a black blind man on the mountain a few days ago. The stewed bear's paw is delicious. This is venison, roe deer meat, and a deer whip."
What kind of bear's paw was taken out in front, venison and roe deer meat, although Guo Shouye is rare, but he can still hold it steady.
When the deer whip was finally taken out, he stood up from the chair directly.
"Oh, this is a good thing."
Men, how many people can not love this stuff?
Although Guo Shouye is only in his thirties, he can’t use it yet, but he can give it as a gift.
Soak this thing in wine, and add some wild ginseng, it will definitely be a great tonic.
The leaders are all old, so whoever you give this stuff to, don’t they all have to happily accept it?
Guo Shouye had just been promoted to an official, and was worrying that he would not have anything good to give as a gift before the Chinese New Year, so Xu Shiyan brought it, which made him very happy.
"Okay, brother Xu is capable, if you have anything to do in the future, feel free to come to see brother, brother will definitely do it for you, and you will never refuse."
Guo Shouye happily put away those things immediately, and his attitude towards Xu Shiyan became more and more enthusiastic.
"In the future, if you still have these good things, don't forget to bring some to my brother.
Brother doesn’t want yours for nothing, I’ll give you money. "I also whispered something later.
"Why is money not money? As long as Guo Ge likes it, if you can meet him in the future, I will keep it for Guo Ge."
Xu Shiyan also changed his address, and smiled at Guo Shouye, saying everything without saying anything.
"Hey, look at my brain."
Suddenly, Guo Shouye slapped his forehead, as if remembering something, he hurriedly opened the drawer.
"Wait a minute, I have something for you." Flipping through it, he took out a stack of colorful bills from inside.
"I have some tickets here, which are left over from the welfare of the workers. You can see which ones you can use, and take them."
Guo Shouye got so many things from Xu Shiyan, probably because he felt sorry.
It happened that he was taking care of these things now, and he had plenty of tickets in hand, so he took out some randomly and gave them to Xu Shiyan.
"Oh, what a shame?" Xu Shiyan was both surprised and delighted.
He came to deliver things to Guo Shouye, purely for future plans, and he didn't think about what he could gain right now.
But I didn't expect that Guo Shouye was quite a particular person, so I gave him a stack of tickets.
In this year and month, all kinds of tickets are useful, and tickets are required for goods that are in short supply, and you can’t buy them without tickets.
"We brothers still say those out-of-the-ordinary things? Take it.
I didn’t even look at what’s available, just take a look for yourself, use what works, and give away what’s useless. "Guo Shouye handed the ticket to Xu Shiyan nonchalantly.
Just at this moment, someone came in and asked Guo Shouye to sign. Xu Shiyan couldn't stay anymore, so he took the ticket and left.
While going out, I heard Guo Shouye tell that person that the person just now was a relative from his forestry farm, who brought New Year's goods for the New Year.
Xu Shiyan smiled, put the ticket in his arms, and came out of the bureau building.
Going out to check the time, it was half past ten, and he planned to go to Fusong, so he hurried to the bus station.
Bought a ticket to Fusong, checked the ticket and got on the bus, only to find that there were so many people going to Fusong that there were no seats on the bus.
In this day and age, it doesn't matter whether it is overloaded or not.
The conductor following the car took out a stack of ponytails from under the seat and directly added a seat.
Mazza can’t be moved, and there are several more seats on the machine cover.
"Those who bring things, put your things on the roof of the car, they are not allowed in the car."
Xu Shiyan was carrying a large back basket, which took up quite a lot of room. The conductor who followed the car was not happy, and told him to put the back basket on the roof of the car.
There is a large net bag on the roof of the passenger car. All the items brought by the passengers are placed on the roof and wrapped in the net bag.
Xu Shiyan saw it, and had no choice but to tie up the things in the back basket firmly to ensure that they would not fall out.
Then he went up the ladder behind the car, put the back basket on the car, and returned to the car to sit on the ponytail.
At 11:00, the bus departed, and after two hours of wobbling along the way, I finally arrived at the county.
Getting out of the car, Xu Shiyan went straight to the purchase station and sold the things he brought.
Two bear galls, one grass and one copper, sold for a little over a thousand dollars.
A pair of antlers, because they are already ossified, can't sell for much money, so I only gave 20 yuan.
If this is deer antler, one tael would be thirty-eight.
At this time, the skins were not too expensive, and a squirrel skin only sold for more than ten yuan.
In 1977, the sable was not yet listed as a protected animal, and the sable fur was not very expensive, more than 100 yuan per piece.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan brought a lot of skins, and the final settlement was no more than 1,400 yuan.
The ticket is issued here, and the ticket is taken to the side to collect the money. The other party counts out a bundle and a half of big unity, and counts it again. One hundred and forty tickets are handed to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan carefully picked up the money and left the purchase point.
As soon as I came out, I felt that something was wrong, and I felt hairy.
I originally wanted to go to the store for a stroll, but now I didn’t dare to go, so I went straight to the station, planning to buy a ticket and return.
While walking, suddenly a man staggered over and bumped into Xu Shiyan.
Well, let me tell you, it will be on the shelves tomorrow, around 12:00 noon, so you don’t have to wait for the update tomorrow morning, just check it out at noon.
It is really the first time to write a book at the starting point, and I don’t understand anything. This book has gone through a lot of thunder and stepped on a lot of pitfalls. I am very grateful to the current readers who can continue to read it. Thank you everyone. With your support, I Have the motivation to write down. There should be nothing poisonous in the back, so you can rest assured.
Thanks to all the readers who have given rewards, thank you for your support, in fact, everyone can support the genuine subscription, and the author is very satisfied.
It will be put on the shelves tomorrow, and there will be five changes at the end of the guarantee. Additional changes will depend on the situation.
Please also support me, the author is not easy to code, please support genuine reading.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: scare off
chapters.content:
Chapter 79 Scared off
The man seemed to be drunk and his body was unstable. He bumped into Xu Shiyan and was about to fall crookedly. He quickly reached out and grabbed Xu Shiyan's clothes to stabilize his figure.
And at this moment, the hand holding Xu Shiyan's clothes suddenly had an extremely sharp blade.
There was a flash of cold light, and the blade cut towards Xu Shiyan's coat.
"Brother, brother, I only have this one piece of clothing that can go out and meet people. If you cut it, your sister-in-law will scold me when you go home."
Just as the blade was about to cut through the fabric, the man's wrist was firmly grasped.
The man was taken aback for a moment, and when he looked up, he saw Xu Shiyan looking at him with a smile.
All of this was slow to say just now, but it actually happened extremely fast, just like a flash.
That man is a habit of stealing, his movements are subtle and extremely quick, but he didn't expect that he was caught and caught when he made a move, and he was shocked.
"Say, what are you talking about? I don't understand." The man refused to admit it, and hurriedly pulled his hand back.
But his wrist was firmly grasped, like being clamped by a vise, and he struggled for a long time to no avail.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand, took the blade from the man's hand, and waved it in front of the man's eyes.
"Your skills are not enough in front of me."
In his previous life, when he was visiting Shen, he fought wits and courage with many gangsters.
Once a person was shot down, Xu Shiyan couldn't bear it, so he was rescued again.
If you don’t fight, you don’t know each other. Later, that group has a good relationship with Xu Shiyan. As for these people's means, Xu Shiyan knows everything.
The person caught by Xu Shiyan's face became very ugly when he saw the blade.
At this moment, a few people suddenly walked over from the side, all of them looked fierce.
You don’t need to guess to know that this is definitely a gang. If you can’t steal it, you have to steal it openly.
"Boy, you are very brave, let him go." One of them stepped forward and said with a very arrogant attitude.
"Little boy, do you know who we are? On our territory, how dare you make a fuss?"
Xu Shiyan's complexion was a bit uneasy, he was careless, he thought it would be a few years before it would be particularly chaotic, but he didn't expect that some people in the county would dare to be so arrogant.
"Brother, I just came to the county to do something. We have no grudges in the past and no enmity in the present. Isn't it good to live in peace?"
Xu Shiyan sighed, let go of the kid holding the blade, and stretched his other hand into the coat without a trace.
"Brother Cao, this kid came out of the buying station just now. I saw that he has a large bundle of money in his pocket, more than a thousand dollars."
The kid finally broke free from Xu Shiyan's hand, hurriedly jumped aside, pointed at Xu Shiyan and said.
"More than a thousand yuan? You are too unscrupulous. You come to the county to do business. If you don't give a few confessions to your brother, how can you do it?
Come on, get the money out. "When the leader on the opposite side heard that there were more than a thousand yuan, his eyes were red.
"I happen to be short of money for the New Year, hurry up."
"Brothers, stay on the front line when doing things, don't push people into a hurry."
Xu Shiyan glanced at the opposite side. There were four people in total, none of them had any belongings in their hands. He should be able to greet them by himself.
"Hey, listen to what he said? It's so funny, don't push people into a hurry? What can you do if you are pushed?" The leader sneered with disdain.
"On the land of Fusong, I have the final say. If you don't pay today, I won't let you leave the county seat. Do you believe it?"
"Really? I'm sorry, but I can't give it to you so easily for the money I earned on the mountain."
Xu Shiyan pulled out his hunting knife directly from the back waist.
I didn’t think so much when I went out, I just wore self-defense habitually, but I didn’t expect it to be really useful.
The knife is slightly longer and narrower than the butcher's knife, and it is very sharp.
The few people on the opposite side were quite knowledgeable, and they recognized it at a glance. This is a knife commonly used by Orion.
When the leader saw the knife, his face immediately changed.
People who can enter the mountains to hunt are not ordinary. They are ruthless and cruel. They can kill wild animals on the mountains, let alone people?
Now, the people on the opposite side are caught in a dilemma.
If you grab it with your hands, the person in front of you will not be a good person at first glance, and if you make trouble, you will be injured. retreat? I feel ashamed and ashamed, what should I do?
Just as the two sides were in a stalemate, a whistle sounded from a distance, and then several people in grass-green uniforms and big caps ran towards us.
When the few people heard it, they all dispersed in a hula.
Xu Shiyan quickly put the knife back on his waist, arranged his coat to cover it, and then left quickly, heading straight to the station.
The car on the return journey was still full of people, Xu Shiyan was more careful, and finally made it to Songjianghe, it was almost five o'clock.
The days are short and the nights are long in winter in the north, and it is already dark outside five o'clock.
No matter how dark it was, he had to go back. Fortunately, it was all the way downhill. Besides, he was very familiar with this road, and there was nothing wrong with it. He returned home around six o'clock.
"Daughter-in-law, I'm back. Is there anything to eat? I'm starving to death."
Going out for a day, I was not willing to eat at noon, and I was already hungry by now, so I shouted hungry when I entered the door.
As a result, when I entered the door and looked inside, my mother was sitting on the kang. "Mom, why are you here?"
"Why did you come back so late? I went to Qingling in the morning, and came to see you two after thinking about it in the afternoon.
As a result, Yingzi said that you went out. What are you doing here? Seeing her son come back, Zhou Guilan finally let go of her worries.
Seeing snow on his son's hat and shoulders, he hurriedly took a broom to help clean it.
"Hurry up and take off your hat and scarf, and put them on the kang to dry."
The scarf and hat were covered with hoarfrost, which was formed by the condensation of exhaled water vapor. It was freezing outside, and even Xu Shiyan's eyebrows and eyelashes were covered with frost.
"The food is still hot in the pot. Take a breather before eating. Don't eat directly when you feel the cool breeze in your stomach. It will easily hurt your stomach."
Su Anying handed over a towel and asked Xu Shiyan to wipe his face, but he was not in a hurry to serve him a meal.
I was afraid that Xu Shiyan would eat when he felt the cold wind in his stomach, and he would suffer from eating.
"Mom, you went to Qingling Wu's house today, what happened to the fourth child?"
Xu Shiyan wiped his face indiscriminately, hung up the towel, turned around and sat beside his mother, and asked.
"What can we do? Your father and I will lead the fourth child over there, just as you said, hand over the fourth child to them to deal with, whatever you like."
"The fourth child was beaten up by your father yesterday, his face was bruised and purple, and the corner of his mouth was torn.
The Wu family saw that we were really angry, so they lost their temper.
At the end of the discussion, it was still as originally agreed, getting engaged on the sixth day and getting married on the 26th. "
Zhou Guilan kept shaking her head as she spoke. The Wu family is just trying to coax the fourth child with different flowers. When they saw that the Xu family was really serious, they were scared.
"This family is close, we shouldn't get married, the Wu family's character is not good, I'm afraid it will be trouble in the future." Zhou Guilan sighed.
With such an in-law, I'm afraid there will be troubles in the future.
"Your dad and I didn't take a fancy to Lao Wu's family from the very beginning, or else we would have agreed on the marriage a long time ago.
It's a pity that the fourth child is so stubborn that he has identified the girl from the Wu family. What do you think? "

chapters.title: Chapter 80: mother and child
chapters.content:
Chapter 80 Mother and Child
Xu Shiyan remembered that in his previous life, after the fourth child married a wife, he was always close to the Wu family.
Xu Shide was transferred to Daying, and the Wu family also moved there.
Later Xu Shide went to work in Xigang, and the second daughter of the Wu family also married to Xigang.
Xu Shide is very concerned about the affairs of his mother-in-law's family, and also takes special care of his sister-in-law and brother-in-law. The whole Wu family is full of praise for Xu Shide.
The only thing is that they are not close to the Xu family, and come back to see the old lady twice a year.
The old lady’s birthday on the sixth day of June, and the second day of the new year, and the rest of the time, she couldn’t see anyone at all.
"Mom, things are already like this, let's think about the good.
The Wu family is just a little cautious and takes advantage of it, but other aspects may not be so bad.
Anyway, the fourth child is married and doesn’t live at home, so out of sight, out of mind. "
I have children, and I am about to get engaged and married. It is too late to say anything now. Simply don't say anything, lest mother feel uncomfortable.
Zhou Guilan sighed, yes, it has reached this point, and regretting is useless.
The son likes Wu Qiuyan wholeheartedly, what can she do as a mother?
The two of them hadn't been separated before, but now that the daughter of the Wu family has a baby in her belly, if she interferes with Huang's marriage again, it will harm the two of them.
What a crime, Zhou Guilan can't do such a thing.
"Don't mention it, what have you been doing when you go out for a day?" Zhou Guilan didn't want to bring up the troubles of the Wu family, so she changed the topic.
"Oh, I went to Songjiang River, and then went to Fusong. I pulled a lot of skins on the mountain before, and sold them to prepare for the New Year."
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything about going to Donggang to find Zhou Zhang and his father and son.
"By the way, I still have some tickets listed. Wait a minute."
He was so busy all day that he didn't even have time to see what ticket Guo Shouye had given him.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly took out the stack of tickets from his pocket and carefully sorted them out.
"Oh, there are quite a few. Cloth tickets, sugar tickets, and national food tickets. This one is an industrial ticket, for a sewing machine."
Xu Shiyan didn't expect that the ticket Guo Shouye gave him included a sewing ticket. This thing is in short supply, and most people can't get it.
"Mom, take these tickets and see what you can use at home, so you can take them back."
Xu Shiyan put all those tickets in front of his mother, and let her choose.
Zhou Guilan shook her head, sorted out the tickets one by one, and handed them to Xu Shiyan.
"I don't need anything at home, so you don't need to buy it. You can keep it. Yingzi is going to have a baby in the next spring. You can use all of these."
Zhou Guilan is not the kind of old lady who puts everything in her hands. In her opinion, it is better for her son and daughter-in-law to live well than anything else.
The Xu family has a large population, and it won't do much for her to take it back. On the contrary, it will arouse the eyes of the daughters-in-law and cause conflicts.
Mom didn't want it, and Xu Shiyan didn't force it. He just nodded and handed the stack of tickets to Su Anying.
"My mother doesn't want it, so you can put it away first, and let's go shopping when you have time."
Sugar tickets can be used to buy brown sugar, confinement for Su Anying, not to mention cloth tickets, anyone can use it.
When a baby is born, you have to make a quilt and two clothes, right?
After sitting down and talking for a while, the chill on Xu Shiyan's body also dissipated, and then Su Anying brought the rice for Xu Shiyan to eat.
Seeing that her son was safe, Zhou Guilan was relieved, "Okay, you eat first, I'll go back.
After you left yesterday, the fourth child regretted it, he was embarrassed to come.
You are an older brother, if your younger brother makes a mistake, you should beat him up, but don’t take it to heart. "Zhou Guilan got up, put on her coat and scarf and went out.
Being a mother is not easy, especially when there are many children in the family. A bowl of water must be leveled, and every child has to be taken care of.
The old lady has given birth to six children in her life, and she loves all of them, and she doesn't want to see her sons gradually estranged.
As the elderly, they all look forward to the filial piety of their children and the harmony and unity of the whole family, so Zhou Guilan can only come here to smooth things over for the fourth child.
"Mom, look at what you said, can I, a brother, care about my brother?"
My mother made peace in person, even if Xu Shiyan felt uncomfortable, he couldn't care less about it.
"The fourth child is married, no matter what work is done at home, let the sixth child always call me.
However, I will not show up when the fourth child is engaged, so as not to embarrass the Wu family. "
Xu Shiyan followed Zhou Guilan to the gate, and helped his mother tidy up the scarf.
"Mom, the road back home is slippery, why don't I see you off?" It was late, and it was dark outside, so Xu Shiyan was a little worried.
"No, you can go back to eat quickly, your mother hasn't reached the age of 70 or 80 and can't walk."
Zhou Guilan was not yet fifty years old, and her body was strong. She waved to her son and walked away quickly.
Xu Shiyan looked at his mother's back and smiled, yes, my mother was over 70 in her previous life, and she can still walk like flying.
The bodies of the older generation are really great, not comparable to those of the young people in the future.
Seeing his mother walking away, Xu Shiyan turned around and went back to the house for dinner.
There is nothing good in the Zhuanghu courtyard. A pot of sauerkraut, a plate of sticky fire spoon, and some porridge would be good.
"Where did you get the sticky fire spoon?" Xu Shiyan likes to eat sticky food, and he was really hungry, so he ate three sticky fire spoons in one go, so he had time to ask.
"My mother brought it, where else could it come from?
Our mother said that you love to eat, and she also knew that we definitely didn’t have bags on the mountain, so I specially sent a pot in the afternoon.
Said that they would go get it when they ran out of food, and they packed two big buckets at home. "
Su Anying watched her husband gobble up food, fearing that he would choke, so she hurriedly poured a glass of water.
"Does our family pack so many sticky fire spoons every year? Two big barrels?"
The barrels mentioned in the farmer's yard are the kind of large wooden barrels, which can hold nearly two hundred catties of beans.
Su Anying can't imagine, how long will it take to eat two big barrels of sticky fire spoons?
"When I was at home, I used to wrap sticky fire spoons. At most, I soaked dozens of catties of rice. In that case, our sisters would also have to pack it for a day."
Two large barrels of sticky fire ladles would take several days to pack, which is scary to think about.
"Can it be the same? Your family is all daughters and eats a small amount. Our family is all young men, so we may eat one by one.
Every winter, our family packs sticky fire spoons and bakes pancakes. You haven’t seen that scene. People say that they are about to catch up with the canteen of the production team. "
Xu Shiyan thought of the situation of wrapping sticky fire spoons and baking pancakes at home in the past, and felt a little nostalgic.
"Before the elder sister-in-law and the second sister-in-law got married, our mother and the sixth son were the only ones who stick to the fire spoon, and a bag lasted for several days.
At the end, the tired little bear, the sixth child, squeezed the little bean stuffing into a big ball with his hands, and then wrapped it up. "
The sticky noodles wrapped with fire spoons are all ground together, but the small bean filling must be cooked every morning, and all wrapped in the same day, otherwise it will be sour.
Xu Shiqin stuffed it hard, so he could finish it earlier.
"My mother found out, and my mother said, if there is not enough small bean paste, put it in the old six bag."
Recalling that time, Xu Shiyan wanted to laugh. His little sister also has moments when she is particularly skinny.

chapters.title: Chapter 81: back home
chapters.content:
Chapter 81 Back to her natal home
Bear bile and hides were sold, and with money in hand, Xu Shiyan wanted to take Su Anying back to Daying.
Taking advantage of the fact that Su Anying is not yet a month old, and there is no delay in going out, go back to her mother's house to have a look.
Waiting for another two months, even if Su Anying wanted to go back, Xu Shiyan would not dare to lead her out.
Since returning home, Su Anying hasn't been back to her natal home, so of course she misses her.
So when Xu Shiyan mentioned it, Su Anying happily went to pack her things.
On the morning of the third day of the twelfth lunar month, the young couple carried a lot of things on their backs and took the train back to Daying.
It’s winter, and it’s impossible for the couple to get up so early. Fortunately, there is a slow train passing through Jewelry Gang at ten o’clock in the morning.
Everyone in the Su family never expected that Su Anying and his wife would come back at this time. When they saw the young couple entering the door, Su Weizhong couldn't close his mouth in surprise.
"God, why didn't you two say something in advance, so that I can send the fifth and the sixth to pick you up at the station.
How tiring it is to walk all the way back. "Su Weizhong looked at the bulky figure of his daughter with distressed eyes.
"Hurry up, the fifth brother hastened to help your sister to sit on the kang, and the sixth brother went to boil water and make tea for your brother-in-law."
Mrs. Han was also very happy to see her daughter and son-in-law coming back, and hurriedly asked the maids to boil water and make tea.
"Come, sit on the kang, the kang is hot, how many months have you been?
I just heard that you have it, alas, I have been busy this autumn, and I didn't spare time to see you. "
Mr. Han held Su Anying's hand, looked up and down, and when she saw Su Anying's swollen belly, she nodded with a smile on her face.
"Well, it's been six months." Su Anying married to Xu's family for exactly half a year, and she got pregnant right after entering the house, so it's only six months.
Actually, the time when a woman becomes pregnant is not calculated according to the natural month.
"I'm busy in autumn, Shi Yan and I have been visiting ginseng on the mountain this autumn and winter, and we don't have time to come back.
It happened to be in the land of heavy snow in the twelfth lunar month, and the two of us went down the mountain, so we hurried back to visit our home. "
Regardless of whether she is her own mother or not, when she returns to her natal home, Su Anying is always happy that her relatives are so warm and friendly.
"Shi Yan, quickly take out the things we brought back.
Father and mother, we came back in a hurry and didn’t go to buy anything. These are all wild pork that Shiyan hunted in the mountains. Let’s keep them at home. "
When I came back this time, Xu Shiyan originally said that he wanted to buy something, but Su Anying refused.
Those canned food and snacks are quite expensive, and they are not real at all.
Parents may not be willing to eat it after buying it and bringing it back, and in the end they kept it for relatives.
It’s better to bring some meat back, the whole family and sisters can satisfy their cravings, how affordable it is.
So the couple came back with a half-basket full of meat, and didn’t buy anything else.
Sure enough, when he heard that it was wild boar, roe deer meat, etc., the eyes of the old five and six suddenly widened.
"Second brother-in-law, you are so good, you can also hunt?"
The little girl came to her in admiration, and stretched her neck to look into the basket, wondering how much meat there was, and whether she could eat it to satisfy her hunger.
As a result, Han Shi slapped him to the side, "Go, go, don't get in the way here, let you boil water to make tea, is it burnt?"
Han felt that her daughter's greedy look was too embarrassing, so she glared at her several times angrily, and ordered her to go to work.
The sixth child pouted, reluctantly went to the outhouse to watch the boiling water.
"I just saw that the second sister and the second brother-in-law have finished half a basket of meat. There must be something for us to eat, don't worry."
The fifth child also came out from the back room and squatted in front of the stove to comfort the younger sister.
"Think about it, the second sister and the second brother-in-law can stay for two days when they come back, my mother must make some delicious treats, right? Don't we just follow along?"
There is no child who is not greedy this year.
People who have boys in other people's homes can still go up a tree to catch a bird, go down a river to catch a fish, and so on to satisfy their hunger.
The Su family are all daughters, at most they just catch a few crickets. Except for their own slaughtering of pigs, they seldom see the smell of meat all year round. Can you not be greedy?
After hearing Fifth Sister's words, the sixth child immediately became happy, and couldn't help but sigh, "It's better for Second Sister to come back."
Don't talk about the little sisters in the outer room whispering, just say that in the east room, Xu Shiyan emptied all kinds of meat from the basket on his back.
A whole loin of wild boar, hind legs of a black blind man, a lump of roe deer meat, two hares and two pheasants, set a table.
Su Weizhong and his wife were dumbfounded, "Shiyan, you fought these on the mountain? My God, how much did you do?"
"It's okay, anyway, I haven't been idle all winter, either hunting wild boars or killing black and blind warehouses.
We couldn’t eat it, so we brought some home. "Xu Shiyan smiled and said very modestly.
"Isn't Uncle Li, the censor in our team, sick? No one was censored. The secretary found me and said that he would let me go up the mountain to take care of it for a while.
There is nothing to do in this winter, except hunting. "Xu Shiyan briefly talked about the cause and effect.
The story of the loss of ginseng in the big house brigade has spread throughout the surrounding communes and production teams, and Su Weizhong has naturally heard of it.
"Oh, so that's what happened. By the way, is the case solved? Have you caught the thief who stole the mallet?"
Everyone has a heart for gossip, and Su Weizhong is no exception.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "No, there has been no news, it seems that the other party is a veteran.
There are no loopholes left, and there is still a way to sell the stolen goods. It is estimated that it will be difficult to catch. "
Garden ginseng is different from wild ginseng. It is a material purchased and sold by the state. It is not easy to sell it outside, and the police will definitely keep an eye on relevant channels.
That's why Xu Shiyan is also very strange. Those thieves have not been caught so far, and their methods of selling stolen goods are too powerful, right?
"If you don't catch the thief, then you have to be careful in the future. If you don't keep it all, they will keep an eye on the participants." Su Weizhong warned worriedly.
"Well, I will be careful." Xu Shiyan nodded directly in response without saying too much.
It was rare for the girl and uncle to come home, and they brought so much food. Su Weizhong was very happy, so he hurriedly sent the girl, and went to the next door to call Su Weicheng's family to talk with Xu Shiyan.
Han checked the time and hurried to the kitchen to prepare.
When my daughter and uncle come back, they have to buy a table of good dishes, don’t they all have to spend time preparing?
It happened that Su Weicheng and his wife also brought their son and daughter over. The two sisters-in-law looked at what they had at home and what Xu Shiyan brought, and after some consideration, they weighed eight dishes correctly.
The two sisters-in-law led a few girls to work in the kitchen. In the room, Su Weizhong, Su Weicheng, Su Anbang, and Su Anmin were all talking and chatting with Xu Shiyan.
The story of Xu Shiyan getting the club from Fangshan had already spread to the surrounding communes and production teams, even Su Weizhong and the others in Daying heard about it.
Su Weizhong knew that his son-in-law was lucky and got a lot of money in the mountains, and he also knew that his son-in-law could still hunt, so he felt so beautiful.
In front of his elder brother and nephew, he boasted that his son-in-law boasted that there is nothing in the sky and nothing on earth, and boasted a flower.
"It's not as powerful as Dad said, it's just luck.
Everyone said that it was Wangfu Yingzi, and once she got married, all kinds of good things happened. "
Xu Shiyan's face became hot when his father-in-law praised him, so he pushed all of them on his daughter-in-law.

chapters.title: Chapter 82: The beast enters the village
chapters.content:
Chapter 82 The Beast Enters the Village
Xu Shiyan's words from his daughter-in-law Wangfu almost made Su Weizhong cry.
Back then, Mrs. Sun suffered from tuberculosis after giving birth to Su Anying. This kind of patient was called "Xie Hua Tuberculosis".
It is said that if you give birth to a daughter, you will get it. If you give birth to a son, you will be fine.
So when Mrs. Sun passed away, many people said behind their backs that Su Anying's fate was not good and that she had forbidden her relatives.
Especially when the Han family had been married for more than ten years, they gave birth to four daughters in succession, without a single boy. Some people said that it was Su Anying's fault.
Although the feudal superstition was broken on the surface in those years, the thoughts in people's bones were still deeply ingrained.
Su Weizhong naturally doesn't believe this, but he can't stand someone thinking so.
In addition, the situation of Su's family is complicated, many people are frightened, so there are few people who propose marriage to Su Anying.
In those few years, because of Su Anying's marriage, Su Weizhong had many gray hairs.
So when someone introduced Xu Shiyan, the Su family simply nodded in agreement.
Seeing that her daughter's life is getting better and better after she gets married, Su Weizhong is very happy.
Now Xu Shiyan said what Su Anyingwangfu said in person again, which completely broke Su Weizhong's knot.
"Second brother, your family Yingzi is blessed, you have found a good son-in-law."
As the elder brother, Su Weicheng was very clear about his younger brother's knot, and immediately patted Su Weizhong on the shoulder to express his comfort.
"Yingzi got married and had a baby, and lived separately, and her life is getting better and better.
You, you don’t have to worry about anything from now on, my uncle will protect you. "
"Yes, our Yingzi is very lucky." Su Weizhong grinned.
The men chatted, laughed and chatted casually. The more they chatted, the more energetic they became, and the more they talked, the more lively they became.
If Han Shi and the others hadn't prepared meals for them to eat, these people might have been able to chat until the evening.
The meals are served, and they are still divided into two tables in the east and west rooms.
Dongwu carried two bottles of wine, and the men started to drink from cup to cup until dark.
In the end, everyone drank and staggered. Fortunately, the two families were close, and they were only a few steps away. Feng carried Su Weicheng back home.
Here, Su Weizhong also drank a lot, fell asleep directly.
Xu Shiyan was drank a lot of alcohol and sat there in a daze.
When Han saw it, she simply arranged for the father and two to sleep in the east room, and she took the five daughters to sleep in the west room, just in time for the mother to have some intimate chats in a few nights.
Xu Shiyan stayed with Su Anying at her mother's house for three days, during which Xu Shiyan led his daughter-in-law to Zhou's house to visit her grandmother.
The old man suffered some blows in the early years, and became unconscious when he was old, sometimes sober and sometimes confused.
I remember meeting Xu Shiyan and Su Anying, and they talked nonsense for a while.
Xu Shiyan's uncle and uncle were both in Daying, and they were quite close when they met Xu Shiyan. When they learned that Xu Shide got married on the 26th of the twelfth lunar month, they also said that they would definitely go to a wedding to join in the fun.
On the afternoon of the sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, the young couple bid farewell to the Su family and returned by car.
It gets dark late in winter, and when we entered the village, it was already dark.
The big house is located in a remote place, without electricity, and kerosene lamps or candles are used at night.
Most people are very frugal these days, how can they be willing to stay up at night and cook oil? Usually go to bed early.
But as soon as I entered the village today, it was obvious that something was wrong. Many houses were illuminated, and there were militiamen patrolling with guns at the entrance of the village.
"Chunming, Jianshe, what's going on? Why are you all out on patrol?" Xu Shiyan saw that it was Yang Chunming and asked hurriedly.
"Yo, third brother, where did you come back from? Why are you leading your sister-in-law around at night? Go home quickly."
Yang Chunming also recognized Xu Shiyan, and rushed Xu Shiyan home.
"No, what happened, why do you all look like you are facing a big enemy?"
Xu Shiyan became more and more strange, why does this look like an enemy?
Is there really something wrong? No, what year is it?
"Third brother, haven't you been home these days? Don't you know that it's spread all over the place?" Zhao Jianshe approached curiously and asked.
"I accompanied your sister-in-law back to Daying. I haven't been in the village these days. What's wrong?"
Xu Shiyan was at a loss, unable to understand what happened.
"No wonder, of course you don't know if you're not in the village.
That Chen family hill, a pack of wolves entered the night before yesterday and took away the livestock raised in the village.
Over the house, a group of wild boars went in the night before yesterday, causing many damages. "Zhao Jianshe quickly told Xu Shiyan what happened in the past few days.
Chenjia Xiaoshan is located on the west side of the Dongjiangyan brigade. There is a natural village with 28 households and 98 people.
Because there is a hill on the north side of the village, in 1910, a man surnamed Chen cultivated ginseng on the hill, so it was named Chen Family Hill.
The housing estate is located eight miles south of the Chen family hill. There are fifty-seven households with more than three hundred people.
In 1910, a householder named Yan lived there, and later moved away, so people call this place Yan’s house, or Fangchang for short.
These two places are not too far away from the Dongjiangyan brigade. Recently, they have been attacked by wild animals one after another and lost a lot of property.
The East River Brigade learned the news, and in order to prevent wild animals from entering the village, they arranged for militiamen to stand guard and patrol.
"What's the point of patrolling? You have to take people to hunt in the mountains." Xu Shiyan shook his head repeatedly when he heard this.
Just guarding is not enough, who knows where those beasts will go? In this cold weather, people are patrolling and standing guard outside, what a pain.
"I haven't beaten pigs for three years, and my baby is so hungry that I cry. There is nothing wrong with what the older generation left behind.
Our commune hasn’t organized hunters to go hunting in the mountains for several years, why isn’t it flooding now? "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, this kind of thing has to be solved from the root cause, it is useless to just guard.
"Third brother, the hunters in our village are all old, how many of the younger generation can really hunt?
In the past few years, no one has been able to lead a team into the mountains. " Yang Chunming sighed.
The militia is different from the Orion. The militia can only shoot guns, but they are not good at how to track and hunt wild animals.
"My father suggested it to the higher authorities, but the commune hasn't come up with a charter yet.
There is no other way but to arrange for people to guard it like this, waiting for a reply from the commune. On the other end, Zhao Jianshe also sighed.
Several powerful gunners in the village are old and can no longer enter the mountains.
The younger generation is now thinking of recruiting workers to the city, or working in forest farms, and few of them have the ability to lead people hunting.
"Hey? By the way, third brother, don't you know how to hunt?"
Zhao Jianshe suddenly remembered, isn't this guy in front of him good at hunting? Everyone has heard that Xu Shiyan spent a lot of time this winter.
"Otherwise, you lead us into the mountains together. If you really kill those wild boars and wolves, we can celebrate the New Year in peace."
Zhao Jianshe widened his eyes, that's right, why did the big guy forget Sange Xu?

chapters.title: Chapter 83: into the mountains together
chapters.content:
Chapter 83 Entering the Mountain Together
Xu Shiyan shook his head hastily when he heard this, "Don't, I don't have that ability.
I made a trap on the mountain and caught prey a few times, purely by luck.
You asked me to take people into the mountains to hunt, isn't that nonsense? I can't take responsibility for what happened. "
Hunting is not the same as hunting.
When the mountain was released, Xu Shiyan knew that if a group of people entered the mountain, as long as they obeyed the rules, there would be no big troubles, so he dared to bring people into the mountain.
Hunting is too dangerous, a bad mess can kill someone, Xu Shiyan doesn't have the guts to take people into the mountains to hunt, if something happens, he can't bear the responsibility.
"You tell Uncle Zhao about this, let the commune ask the forest farm to cooperate.
The forest farm has a security department. They have good marksmanship and advanced equipment. They have machine guns and mountain artillery. Are you afraid that a few wild boars and wolves will fail?
This is not a matter for one of our brigades. The commune has to unite all brigades.
Take out the best guns, the most powerful dogs, and organize to go into the mountains together. "
Dongjiangyan Brigade has a total of ten shots, most of which are sticks, and the best semi-automatic is in the hands of Xu Shiyan.
As for hunting dogs, people can’t get enough to eat these days. How many families have dogs? Those three or five sporadic ones are not enough to do anything.
Guns are not good enough, dogs are not tough, and if you go into the mountains to fight wild boars and wolves, then you are just looking for trouble.
Xu Shiyan was not so stupid as to foolishly agreed to take people hunting.
Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming couldn't help sighing when they heard this, "That's right, what the third brother said makes sense.
Come on, third brother, you should hurry up and lead third sister-in-law home, we will continue to patrol. "The two waved their hands at Xu Shiyan and continued walking forward.
Xu Shiyan originally planned to go home directly, but now he changed his mind and led his wife straight to Xu's house in the east of the village.
"Let's go, go over there, I think the second brother should be jumping around in a hurry."
Xu Shian suggested to kill the Heixiazicang before, but Xu Shiyan is not at home these days, so I don’t know what the impatient person will be in a hurry.
Xu's family members were still awake, and the kerosene lamps stole a little light from the window paper. Xu Shiyan stepped forward and patted on the door. After a while, the fifth brother Xu Shixiang came out to open the door.
"Third brother, why are you here at this time? You just came back from Daying?"
Xu Shian went to Li's house to find Xu Shiyan several times, so he naturally knew about the young couple's return to Daying.
"Well, I just entered the village and came back to see how the family is doing. Your fourth brother is engaged today, is it going well?"
Xu Shiyan helped his daughter-in-law to walk into the yard, asking questions as she walked.
"It went smoothly, and the Wu family didn't say anything." Xu Shixiang smiled.
It has reached this point, if the Wu family makes a fuss, it will make a fool of themselves.
Besides, the Xu family has prepared a lot of things, which is enough to silence the Wu family.
Xu Shiyan nodded, and followed his brother into the house.
In the east room, Xu Chenghou and his wife, Xu Shixian, Xu Shian and others are all there, and it looks like they are talking together.
Seeing Xu Shiyan come in, Xu Shian was the first to speak.
"Hey, third child, you're back. Shall we go to the mountain to kill the black blind warehouse? I'm afraid others will find out in a few days."
Xu Shian is in a hurry, for fear that the blind man will be killed by others.
"It's not peaceful these days. I'm afraid that the commune will really organize people to go hunting in the mountains in two days. If there is a disturbance at that time, even if no one kills the warehouse, it will startle the black blind man."
Xu Shi'an was always impatient, and his younger brother hadn't been seen these few days, which made him almost anxious to death.
"Second brother, look at you in a hurry. Didn't I come back? I didn't return when I entered the village. Come here first. I haven't sat down yet."
Xu Shiyan was dumbfounded by his second brother. His second brother has always had this temper all his life. He was anxious about everything, and finally he lost his anxiety.
"I'm here to ask how the fourth brother's engagement is, and the other is to ask you, who will kill the blind man?"
A black-blind gallbladder, even if it is straw gallbladder, can be sold for three or four hundred yuan. Who would not want it after seeing the money? Xu Shiyan naturally refused to miss it.
"Then what are you talking about, of course everyone is going, it's okay to be free right now."
Xu Shian shouted without asking other brothers' opinions.
"Brother, fourth child, you both will follow into the mountain?" Xu Shiyan ignored the second brother, and turned to ask the eldest and fourth child.
Why did you ask the two of them, because both of them are just playing with pens, and they are not much better than Xu Shiyan in terms of work, let alone hunting in the mountains.
Boss Xu Shixian has a good literary talent, and he was a literary backbone when he was studying.
In the past, there was a cultural performance in the commune, and they all asked him to write host scripts, edit cross talk, etc., and occasionally write an article or poem. He is a proper literary youth.
It is precisely because of this that when he was hot-blooded, he wrote a lot of things that offended people, annoyed the commune cadres, and cut off his own future.
Not to mention the fourth child, who became a substitute teacher within two years of graduating from junior high school.
Teaching all day long, not much work in the fields, let alone hunting, he has never been there at all.
It’s not as good as the fifth one. After graduating from high school, the fifth one joined the team to work, and he can do everything up and down the river.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shide looked at each other and nodded, "Well, the two of us will follow, and we can help no matter what."
Of course, the matter of earning money cannot be left behind. My mother has already said that the family will be separated after the New Year. Who doesn’t want to draw some money at this time?
Hunting pays attention to the combination of people and horses. They must cooperate with each other and help each other when there is danger.
My own brothers are always more reliable than outsiders, and Xu Shiyan didn't object.
"Well, let's do it tomorrow. Tomorrow morning, you all pack up and go to me. Let's go into the mountain with dogs and guns."
Since there is a lot of noise in the mountains now, Xu Shiyan also hopes to have a few more people together.
"Third brother, I was sorry for you that day, your lord, don't be like me."
Xu Shide offended his brother last time, so he thought that the third brother would not take him this time.
As a result, Xu Shiyan didn't even hesitate, and agreed directly. Xu Shide was upset, so he apologized to Xu Shiyan.
"Come on, my brother, are you still fussing over these things? I beat you that day too, didn't I?
After getting married, it is not easy to remember my parents. It is better to take care of my family more than anything else. "
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes at his younger brother, and said a few words, not too heavy.
"Hey, hey, I got it, third brother." It's better for the brother to say him than to ignore him, Xu Shide grinned.
Xu Shiyan Yao Yaotou, this fourth child, I hope he can have a longer memory.
It was not early, and Xu Shiyan and his wife did not delay any longer. After talking to their parents a few more words, they said goodbye and went home to rest.
On the morning of the seventh day of the twelfth lunar month, it was still Xu Shiyan who got up to cook and eat dog food.
The five dogs were half-fed, then packed up everything, checked the guns, loaded the bullets, and made sure everything was ok.
On the other end, the four brothers of the Xu family also changed into ragged leather jackets, cotton Ula, leather hats and leggings, and came to look for Xu Shiyan.
The five brothers gathered together, Xu Shiyan gave the handle to Xu Shian, and gave the dog to the three brothers to lead.
The five brothers went out with guns and dogs on their shoulders.

chapters.title: Chapter 84: wolf scorpion
chapters.content:
Chapter 84 Wolf Wanderer
There was a light snowfall in the middle of the night last night, and the ground was covered with a thin layer.
It is best to go hunting in the mountains at this time. The traces of the prey are all on the snow, and there is no way to hide them.
It is not necessary to enter the mountain too early to kill Heixiazicang, so the five brothers were not in a hurry. They led the dog out of the village after eight o'clock and walked west into the forest.
After walking for a while into the woods, the big yellow dog started sniffing the ground.
Going forward, I found that there were many wild boar footprints on the snow, all over the hillside.
Looking at the situation on the ground, it is estimated that there are hundreds of wild boars, large and small, heading southwest all the way.
"If there is another three-five-shot semi-automatic and a dozen dogs, this group of wild boars will be killed, at least half of them will be able to do it."
Xu Shiyan couldn't help sighing after seeing those footprints.
"Then tell Uncle Zhao and ask him to report it to his superiors. Recently, this wild boar has been quite rampant and has harmed many things."
Xu Shixiang looked at the footprints of wild boars with enthusiasm in his eyes. If a group of wild boars were killed, they would be able to eat meat during the Chinese New Year.
"It's easy to say, waiting for the approval from the superior, the wild boar group has already disbanded."
Winter wild boars live in circles, and then they gather together temporarily to form a herd. When spring begins, the wild boar herd will disperse.
"Let's go, we didn't go into the mountains today for wild boars, so don't worry about it for now. Let's wait and see how the team responds."
Xu Shiyan was not too entangled, the wild boar could only be eaten after being beaten.
His family has no shortage of meat now, so he is not very interested in wild boars. The most important thing at present is the black blind warehouse.
Everyone thought it was right, so they continued to move forward, and walked a little further.
Just after crossing the Xiaoganba River, a wolf scorpion was found ahead.
The paws of wolves are similar to those of dogs, but bigger than dogs, and the two middle toes are longer, so they are easy to identify when they fall on the snow.
"The four wolves are all cooked wolves. It took less than an hour this morning. They should have come out to look for food, and they are all hungry."
Xu Shiyan lowered his head and took a closer look near the wolves, confirming the number of wolves.
Raw wolves and cooked wolves are a distinction made by hunters based on the habits of wolves.
Raw wolves have never confronted hunters before, and have never seen the world, so most of them can be caught by setting traps and traps, and they are easy to fall into the trap of hunters, so they are called raw wolves.
Cooked wolves are different, they all escape from the hunter's guns and traps.
This kind of wolf is suspicious by nature. When walking on the road, it looks around and looks suspicious. If there is a little bit of trouble, it will immediately stand on tiptoe and go back the same way.
Even if you find a branch lying on the road, you will suspect that it is a trap set by the hunter and try to avoid it.
This is what the old Orion said, "A well-cooked wolf can't beat a grass."
The wolf in front of him is walking and stopping, left and right. It looks like there is only a series of footprints, but in fact the wolf behind is completely stepping on the footprints of the leading wolf.
It only divides into a few branches at the sharp corner, and returns to a single branch at the front.
This is obviously the trace left by a cooked wolf. This kind of wolf is not easy to fight.
"Let's go around, don't destroy the wolf's scorpion.
Later, let's kill Heixiazicang first. If it goes well, it won't be too late to fight again when we come back. "
Wolves are very suspicious. If wolf scorpions are destroyed, they will migrate to other places, making it harder to find them in the future.
So, the five brothers took the dog around half a circle, escaped the wolves without damage, and then continued to the destination.
Passing through a cutting area and then going southwest, over a post, on the hillside, there is indeed a big poplar tree.
It is thick enough to be surrounded by two people. There is a tree hole at a height of one person above the ground.
Looking at the hoarfrost hanging around the tree hole, you know that there must be living things living in it, and the most likely one is the black blind man.
When the water vapor breathed out by animals encounters extremely low temperatures, hoarfrost will hang around.
"Big Brother, Fourth Brother, you two will lead the dogs and stay aside for now, we won't need them for the time being."
Ordinary killing black blind warehouse, in fact, do not use a dog. Bring the dog, just in case.
There are many dangers in the mountains. If you bring a dog and encounter any wild beasts, you will need multiple helpers.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shide followed Xu Shiyan's instructions and led the dog aside to wait.
These dogs had been tamed by Xu Shiyan a long time ago. He handed over the ropes to the two of them with his own hands. The dogs were very honest and didn't struggle at all.
Here, Xu Shiyan took Xu Shian and Xu Shixiang to clean up the shrubs and dead branches around the big poplar tree.
Find another big tree opposite the poplar, cleaned up the surrounding area, and lit another fire.
It stands to reason that with so many people coming to kill Cangzi with guns and dogs, it would be fine if these preparations were not done.
But Xu Shiyan has always been cautious and prudent, never willing to take risks, and never fails to do any work that should be done.
After the preparations were completed, Xu Shiyan held a gun in his hand and fired two shots at the opening of the big poplar tree. This is called Cangzi.
It is to wake up the black blind man in the tree hole, and let him crawl out before killing him.
People without guns are called Cangzi, and most of them beat tree trunks with sticks.
The black blind man slept deeply in hibernation, and he had to knock for a long time before he could be awakened. The sound of a gun was loud, and it was easy to wake up the black blind man.
There is also skill in shooting Cangzi, and you can't shoot towards the bottom of the tree hole.
What if by chance, he really hits the blind man and kills him in the tree hole?
Such a big tree, when they saw the tree down, the bile of the black blind man will probably be absorbed almost, so why sell it?
Shot near the entrance of the cave, the sound was loud, waking up the blind man.
Wait for it to crawl out before shooting. If it is killed, it will be disemboweled on the spot to ensure the integrity of the black blind man's guts.
After the two shots, Xu Shiyan took two steps back and waited quietly. After a while, he didn't hear any movement, and fired two more shots.
After the two shots are fired, the remaining bullets are ejected directly, and a series of bullets is reloaded.
After changing the bullet, I fired two more shots, and then I heard movement in the tree hole.
The black-blind man who was awakened slowly crawled out of the tree hole with a sound of "Speak, Speak".
"Brother, fourth, hold down the dogs, don't let them bark."
At this time, you can’t let the dog bark first, you have to wait for the blind man to crawl out completely.
Although the black blind man is bulky, his movements are not slow, and he poked his head out of the tree hole very quickly.
"Second brother, hit it later when it climbs down, pay attention to hitting the head."
Generally speaking, when a blind man goes up a tree, his head is up, and when he gets down a tree, he has to turn his head around and land on his buttocks first.
I don’t know what’s going on with this black blind man? Awakened from a deep sleep, still a little dizzy?
Didn't even turn around, just climbed upside down like this, and fell down in a somersault.
Originally, Xu Shian took aim with his gun, and planned to shoot the blind man while he was crawling down.
As a result, the gun fired, but it missed, and it didn't hit at all.
This time he annoyed the blind man, and rushed towards Xu Shian.
Xu Shian was holding a stick in his hand, and he couldn't shoot continuously, so he turned around and ran away.
At this time, the gun in Xu Shiyan's hand also rang out. The first shot hit Heixiazi's shoulder, and then another shot passed diagonally through the abdomen.
The black blind man was shot twice, screaming in pain, he simply gave up on Xu Shian, turned around and rushed towards Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan stood there firmly, without taking a step back, and shot the blind man directly in the head.
The small eye went in and the big eye came out, and the blood splashed out all at once. The black blind man paused and lay down on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 85: hungry wolf
chapters.content:
Chapter 85 Hungry Wolf
The blind man fell to the ground, and the five dogs also rushed up.
Don't blame them for being slow, it's Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang who reacted a step slower and let the dogs go too late.
Fortunately, no dog stepped forward, so Xu Shiyan shot three times, directly killing the blind man.
Five people, two guns, and five dogs, beat a black blind man. It is really a bit of a bully, and the black blind man was not wronged at all.
Xu Shiyan whistled, and the dogs stopped biting and went back to wait obediently.
Xu Shiyan and Xu Shian held guns on guard, and the three brothers stepped forward and turned the blind man over.
Opened the guts and took off the guts, hung the internal organs of the black blind man on the tree to worship the mountain god, and then cut up the meat and fed it to the dogs.
"Brother, don't feed the dog too much, just half full. Let's go back the same way later and see if we can kill the two wolves."
Xu Shiyan had a thought, and decided to clean up those wolves later.
I saw it when I came here in the morning. There are a total of four wolves, not many in number. If you cooperate well, you should be able to gain something.
Animals like wolves harm many livestock a year, and sometimes enter villages to harm children.
After entering the mountain, everything is under the command of Xu Shiyan. Whatever Xu Shiyan says, the brothers can do as they please.
So the five dogs were only half-fed, and Xu Shiyan and the others did not delay, and dragged the black blind man who had about 300 catties left to go back.
Walking to a place about a mile and a half away from the wolf, Xu Shiyan and others stopped.
"Brother, fourth, fifth, you look at the dog, just stay here and don't move around.
When you hear a wolf barking, hold down the dog and stop barking, and let the dog go when you hear the gunshot. "
There are dogs around, and they must bark when they see wolves. Cooked wolves are already very vigilant, if there is a dog barking, they will definitely turn around and run away.
One and a half miles is seven hundred and fifty meters. To these dogs, it is nothing at all, and they will arrive soon.
The dogs were handed over to the brothers, and Xu Shiyan and Xu Shian dragged the blind man's body to the front.
He wanted to use the corpse of the blind man to lure those hungry wolves into the bait.
When he came to the vicinity of the wolf, Xu Shiyan checked carefully, and he was relieved that there was no sign of the wolf returning.
Wolves are cunning by nature. As long as they are not disturbed, they must go back and forth one way and never go the other way.
So, the two brothers threw the dead body of the blind man not far from the wolf, and each of them found a tree to climb up, and waited on the tree with their guns in hand.
In the bitter north wind, the two sat on the branch of a tree and did not dare to move, for fear of making a noise and scaring away the wolves.
I didn't know how long I had been waiting, but there was a long, miserable cry from the distant hillside.
Experienced hunters can tell as soon as they hear it, those hungry wolves ran for nothing all morning and got nothing, so they could only walk back crying hungry and cold.
Neither of the two brothers spoke, they waited silently, staring at the bottom with all their attention.
Sure enough, I saw a few black spots coming from a distance, and when I got a closer look, it turned out to be four hungry wolves.
A few hungry wolves apparently wandered around and couldn't find anything to eat. On the way back, they sniffed the ground lightly with their noses.
When they came to a position tens of meters away from the corpse of the blind man, the wolf's nose twitched, as if smelling something, he immediately raised his head and looked around.
There is no abnormality around, but there seems to be blood in front.
The wolves immediately cheered up, their ears pricked up, their steps hurried, and they scrambled towards the direction of the smell of blood.
Then, right in front, a black blind man who had been disembowelled to death was found.
A hungry wolf with red eyes, why would he think about why there is a dead black man here?
As long as there is stuttering, who cares about those?
Several wolves swarmed up, bared their teeth and let out whining noises, and began to bite Heixiazi's corpse.
The two Xu Shiyan brothers saw the opportunity and shot almost at the same time.
The marksmanship of the two brothers was not bad, and those wolves were only focused on eating meat, so their vigilance was greatly reduced, so the two wolves fell down in response.
The remaining two wolves ran away when they heard the gunshot. Xu Shiyan's second shot had already fired, and the bullet penetrated Qinglang's shoulder blade and shot out obliquely.
The running wolf suddenly pounced forward, struggled to get up and wanted to run again, but couldn't get up to speed.
At this time, Xu Shiyan fired the third shot again, and the wolf was shot and couldn't get up again.
The gunshot rang out, and five dogs rushed out of the forest quickly.
Coincidentally, the direction in which the only wolf escaped happened to be the direction in which the five dogs were rushing.
The five dogs immediately surrounded the wolf. The yellow dog led the way and gave the wolf a bite.
The wolf wasn’t too big in the first place, but if he was surrounded by five experienced dogs, what would happen?
In no time, the wolf was wounded in several places, screaming in pain, trying to run but unable to get out of the dog's encirclement, and was trapped by five dogs for life.
Xu Shiyan and Xu Shian slipped down from the tree, and followed them with guns on their shoulders. Seeing this, they simply ignored it.
