Just let the dogs vent a bit, because they didn’t have much room for them to beat the black and blind just now, and they didn’t have enough to eat. I guess the dogs are also aggrieved.
Five dogs and a wolf were entangled together. Surrounded by the five dogs, the hungry wolf dodged left and right, but still couldn't avoid the bite of the hunting dogs.
Not long after, Hungry Wolf gradually slowed down due to wound pain and excessive physical exertion.
One inattentive, and the big yellow dog took out the back door again. The painful wolf howled and turned around trying to shake off the big yellow dog, but was accidentally bitten on the neck by the flowery dog ​​again.
Not to be outdone, the wolf turned around and bit the flower dog, but the other side was bitten by the green dog again.
The other two dogs also took the opportunity to come up, each biting one place and tearing hard.
How can a wolf withstand the bite of several dogs? This time, he couldn't break free at all, and could only lie on the ground and howl.
The wolf has been bitten to death by the dog, and there is no possibility of escape.
Xu Shiyan took out the knife he was carrying with him, put a stick on the handle of the knife, stepped forward and pierced the wolf's neck with a knife.
The knife twisted in the wolf's body, pulled it out, and then plunged in hard.
The wolf howled, his body twitched twice, and then stopped moving.
Brothers Xu Shixian also rushed over at this time, seeing the situation in front of them, they were all overjoyed.
Although there is not much benefit in beating wolves, you can’t sell them for a few bucks, but it will save the scourge and prevent the wolves from wreaking havoc.
"Third brother, I'll come, you rest." Xu Shide snatched the knife and disemboweled all four wolves to prevent the stink from covering them.
"Well, fourth child, let's feed the dog this time, let them all be full."
When hunting dogs go into the mountains, they are not afraid of being injured, but they are afraid that they will not be able to bring down their prey.
These dogs have followed Xu Shiyan into the mountains more times, and they will be injured or something, but as long as they are full of meat, they will hunt even harder next time.
So hunters can't be stingy, and must feed the hunting dogs.
Xu Shide responded, and cut up the wolf meat and fed it to the dogs without hesitation.
For dogs, as long as it is meat, they will eat it, and wolf meat is the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: alarmed the whole village
chapters.content:
Chapter 86 Alarmed the whole village
After feeding the dogs, the five brothers walked back with the corpses of a black blind man and four wolves. When they returned to the village, it was almost four o'clock in the afternoon.
It is said that at this time, every household is preparing to cook, and besides, it is very cold, and few people are hanging out outside.
But when Brother Xu Shiyan entered the village, there were really a few people who were free to drop by and wander around.
When the other party saw the Xu family brothers dragging their prey into the village, they hulaed and surrounded them all at once.
"Oh, are you hunting in the mountains? My God, a black and blind man, how many wolves are these?
Good guy, isn't it amazing? "The few people looked at the prey with envy.
"Come on, Brother Xu, we'll help you get it back." A few people were very enthusiastic and came forward to help drag the prey to Xu's house.
Of course, this is all their own little thoughts. They helped, and they can share some meat back later.
As the so-called mountain wealth cannot be enjoyed alone, the folks in the village just don’t help, as long as they open their mouths, they have to give some.
Xu Shiyan is very clear about this, he is not a stingy person, and it is nothing to share some.
Besides, the dog and the gun belonged to the village. If he didn’t give them any, those people would have another excuse to make irresponsible remarks.
Just like that, a group of people dragged their prey to the east of the village.
Before reaching the door of Xu's house, those people shouted into the yard.
"Uncle Xu, come out and take a look, Brother Xu and the others have come back after beating the blind man and the wolf."
In the east room of the Xu family, Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were talking about it, wondering how the sons went to the mountain.
Going into the mountains to hunt is no joke, what if you encounter some danger?
Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong were also worried about their husbands, and they were secretly looking forward to it, hoping that their husbands would gain something when they went to the mountains.
Suddenly heard someone shouting outside, how could the few people sit still, they rushed out of the house and came to the yard.
"Oh, such a **** blind man? And what is this? A wolf?
My God, you guys went into the mountains quite a lot. "
Zhou Guilan exclaimed when she saw the big guys in the yard.
"How are you guys? Didn't you get hurt?"
Mothers are always the first to think about the safety of their sons, and hurriedly look at each of them, for fear that any one will be injured.
"Mom, we're all fine. Today, my brother and I didn't bother with each other, so we just followed the dog.
The third brother is amazing, his marksmanship is accurate, and the second brother is also good at shooting. "
Xu Shide went hunting in the mountains for the first time, and the excitement had not yet passed away. Seeing his parents, he started to talk endlessly, telling the story of their going into the mountains vividly.
Xu Chenghou listened, but let alone his pride.
His back raised his hands and back, his eyes looked back and forth between the prey and the person, and the smile on his face couldn't be hidden.
"Okay, okay, really good, really good." This is definitely not a matter of eating a few bites of meat to sell some money, the key is that the face is too long.
The incident of wolves entering the village has caused a lot of noise in the past few days, and the people in the village are panicked for fear of accidents.
As a result, his son went into the mountains, killed four wolves and came back. Xu Chenghou looked at the wolves and thought they were beautiful.
Xu Shiyan and others skinned the black blind man and the wolf in the yard, deboned and cleaned up the meat.
The few people who helped each other shared some meat and left happily.
Then, before nightfall, everyone in the village knew that the Xu family brothers went hunting in the mountains, and not only killed a black and blind man, but also shot four wolves.
As soon as Zhao Dahai heard the news, he couldn't sit still. He ate half of his dinner, dropped his chopsticks, led his two sons, and hurried to Xu's house.
"Brother Xu, I heard that some of your boys have gone hunting in the mountains?"
The Zhao family has a good relationship with the Xu family, Zhao Dahai came to the Xu family as if he was his own home, he opened the door and entered the room and yelled.
At the Xu family's side, the meal has just been prepared and served, and they are about to eat it.
When Xu Chenghou saw Zhao Dahai coming in, he greeted him for dinner.
Zhao Dahai waved his hand, why is he in the mood to eat now? "Boss, brother, tell me about hunting."
"Uncle Zhao, it wasn't us hunting, it was the youngest who brought us into the mountains." Xu Shi'an explained with a smile.
"Without the third child, how can we do it? The main reason is that the third child is very good.
He is good at marksmanship, and he can also watch wolves, so we hit those wolves. "
Going into the mountain today has gained a lot, and Xu Shiyan's first contribution is naturally, no one can deny this.
Xu Shian has always been a straightforward person, he can say whatever he wants, there is no need to hide this.
"Third brother, didn't you say last night that you don't have the ability to lead people into the mountains? Why did you lead the elder brother and the second brother into the mountain to hunt today?"
Zhao Jianshe was careless, and when he heard Xu Shian's words, he asked in a fuss.
Xu Shiyan knew Zhao Jianshe's temper, but he wasn't annoyed.
"Only four wolves, definitely not that wolf pack.
We happened to kill Heixiazicang first, and when we came back, I said try, if we could kill those wolves. "
"Uncle Zhao, when we entered the mountain, we saw the footprints of a herd of wild boars. There are indeed quite a few, hundreds of them.
The herd of pigs is too big, and the guns are not enough. The guns in our village are old and old, so they won’t work.
It is best to ask the superior for instructions, batch a few more semi-automatics, and then unite with other villages.
Taking advantage of this time, the wild boars are all together in a circle, as long as they are surrounded for a while, the guns rush over. "
In Xu Shiyan's view, this kind of large herd of pigs is the best way to handle it. There are too many people and guns, and if they are surrounded, they will be beaten.
In contrast, wolves are more difficult to deal with. Wolves are too cunning and hunting is very difficult.
Xu Shiyan has said that, what else can Zhao Dahai say?
"Well, the report has been typed up, but who knows when the higher-ups will approve it. If it is later, it will be Chinese New Year."
What can Zhao Dahai do? He is just a brigade secretary. The Dongjiangyan brigade has a small population and poor economic strength, so it has no foundation.
The only guns available in the village are a few guns, nothing else.
Xu Shiyan has nothing to do with this matter.
Sporadic hunting of a few wild boars, killing a black blind man, or chasing a roe deer to shoot a deer, he is not afraid of these.
But if it’s about dealing with such a large group of pigs, he really doesn’t have that ability.
There is not enough manpower, so don't even think about it, wild boars are not so easy to deal with.
"No matter what you say, you killed four wolves today, which can be regarded as eliminating harm for the people. The team commended you.
In the future, if there is a chance, San'er will also take more young people in our village and teach them some skills. "
Zhao Dahai is quite satisfied with Xu Shiyan. The kid is not only capable, but the key is that he is benevolent, kind and rare.
On the other end, Zhao Jianshe also came up to Xu Shiyan, "Third brother, next time you go into the mountains, call me, and I will go hunting with you too."
Zhao Jianshe has such a temper, warm-hearted and loud, and he doesn't have much flirtatiousness.
He helps out whenever there is trouble at home, and joins in wherever there is excitement, but he doesn't bother people.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: hunting party
chapters.content:
Chapter 87 Hunting Team
Zhao Dahai went to the commune in person the next day, and applied again to the commune leaders, asking the higher authorities to distribute guns and ammunition.
The cadres of Xigang Commune expressed their embarrassment, and this matter was not easy to handle.
The main reason is that the Xigang Commune was only established a few years ago.
In the past, Xigang Commune was still a brigade, which was managed by Daying Commune.
A few years ago, the Xigang, Canling, Dongling, Dongfeng, Qingling, Nanling, and Fumin brigades were separated from Daying Commune.
In addition to Liangshan, Jinjiaxiaoshan, Shendingzi, and Nuanshui, Xigang Commune was established.
Xigang Commune has been established for a short time, and has no foundation. It is very poor.
The commune doesn’t have that many guns, so they have to report to their superiors and wait for their reply.
This is reported to the higher level, waiting for the approval of the superior, I don't know what year and month.
But the herd of wild boars can’t wait. Those animals are wandering here and there looking for food. I don’t know which brigade will suffer tomorrow. What should I do?
Recalling Xu Shiyan's proposal, Zhao Dahai suggested calling all the cadres of each brigade to a meeting and gathering the strength of all the brigades to form a hunting team.
Then try to find a way to borrow some equipment from the Jinshan Forest Farm Security Section. No matter what else, let's shoot down the group of wild boars first.
The leaders of the commune made sense when they heard it, so they immediately sent people to various places and called the cadres of several brigades together for a meeting.
The range of activities of wild boars and wolves is in each brigade of Xigang Commune.
This place is remote, with many mountains and forests, a small population, and scattered villages.
Dongling and Nanling brigades are the most populous, with only seven to eight hundred people, and Qingling has about 600 people.
Fumin, Dongjiangyan, and Dongfeng, these brigades have about 400 people, and the rest of them have less than 200 people.
The cadres of several brigades got together and discussed the matter in a hurry. The discussion lasted for a long time.
Finally, it was decided to mobilize young people from various brigades, especially the militiamen, to form a hunting team and go into the mountains to encircle wild boar herds.
"Then it's settled. On January 17th, which is the day after tomorrow, all brigades will send people to the commune to gather.
Let's form a hunting team and go into the mountains to clean up the herd of wild boars. "The leaders of the commune made the final decision.
"All of you, all the brigades, have given away your money, and the commune has also figured out a way to support it as much as possible.
This time, we must destroy the group of wild boars, and we must not let them harm our things again. "
Zhao Dahai rushed back to the brigade after the meeting, and immediately called the young people in the village to the team headquarters for a meeting.
"The commune has decided to mobilize forces from various villages to form hunting teams and go into the mountains to encircle wild boar herds.
Our brigade will pick out twenty young and strong young men to join. "
"Now I'll roll the roll. If I get the roll call, I'll go home and make preparations. In the morning of the day after tomorrow, I'll gather at the commune and discuss specific hunting matters." Zhao Dahai took the list and began to read.
"Xu Shiyan, Yang Chunming, Zhao Jianshe, Zhao Jianguo, Li Erniu, Wang Zhijun, Xu Shian, Xu Shixiang..."
Zhao Dahai read a lot of names, almost all of them are young and strong in the village, and have performed well in militia training. It is estimated that the only exception is Xu Shiyan.
"This time we went hunting in the mountains, the captain of our Dongjiangyan hunting team is Xu Shiyan.
You all remember, everything is arranged by him. "After reading all the names, Zhao Dahai finally said this.
"Huh? Uncle Zhao, how did I become the captain?" Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard that, why did he become the captain?
"No, no, I don't have the ability." Hunting is nothing else, so it's inappropriate for him to be the captain, right?
"Why can't you do it? This winter, those wild boars and blind men in your family have been sent back like running water. Aren't they all beaten by you?
Ask these young people in the village, who has the ability like you?
Among other things, didn’t you come back after beating four wolves a few days ago? I think you are just right. "
Zhao Dahai blew his beard and stared. After looking around, he seemed to scold anyone who dared to disobey.
"Yes, third brother, why are you being modest at this time?
We big guys, wish we could go hunting with you.
Don't worry, we will definitely listen to your arrangements when the time comes, and we can make any adjustments as you say, and we will not give you any trouble for safekeeping. "
Zhao Jianshe spoke next to him, looking excited.
"Yes, third brother, among our group of people, you are the only one who has serious experience in hunting. If you follow you into the mountains, we will accept it.
If anyone dares not to listen to you when he enters the mountain, we will kick him. "Yang Chunming and the others also expressed their views immediately.
Xu Shiyan saw that there were a total of twenty people, and the Xu family brothers accounted for three.
The remaining ones, most of them have a good relationship with Xu Shiyan, especially Yang Chunming, looking for Jianshe and others, they are all close friends.
As for Chen Deyong, he is not on the list this time.
All right, now that we've talked about this, it's a bit unreasonable for him to refuse.
"Okay, since everyone trusts me, I have the cheek to agree."
"That's right, you don't have to babble so much, just don't say anything, just do it." Zhao Dahai became happy when he heard it.
The hunting crews were settled, and Zhao Dahai asked people to take out all the guns and ammunition in the village and distribute them to everyone.
Dongjiangyan brigade has a total of ten guns, but there is no way to have one of them, and only some people can be kept close.
However, Zhao Dahai promised that the commune will support a batch, and it is estimated that it can be used.
On the 16th, everyone rested separately. On the 17th, in the early morning of the 17th, twenty young men from the Dongjiangyan Brigade went straight to the commune to assemble with guns on their shoulders.
In this kind of big siege, the lack of hunting dogs is useless at all, and it will add to the chaos, so Xu Shiyan didn't bring dogs.
At eight o'clock in the morning, people from various brigades also arrived one after another.
Those with a large population will send more people, and those with a small population can only pick out a few, and there will be hundreds of people together, half of whom have no guns.
Fortunately, the commune still had some reserves, and the secretary of the commune went to Daying Commune overnight to second a group, and with some support from the Jinshan Forest Farm Security Section, everyone was given guns.
There are so many people beating, and the beating is a group of pigs, so you have to be a little bit strategic.
It is not enough for seven people to be the head of the family and eight people to be the head of the family. You have to choose a person who everyone trusts to be the captain.
How to choose? Then you have to choose from among the captains.
Someone suggested that, when it comes to marksmanship, whichever team leader is better at marksmanship, the big guy will listen to him.
Only when one person gives orders and the others cooperate fully can this tough battle be fought well.
Those who can come are all young men in their twenties and full of vigor, just compare them, who is afraid of whom?
So a target was set up in the open space at the west end of the commune, and several captains stepped forward to shoot. There were five rounds in total, and the one with the best score was selected.
After five rounds, Xu Shiyan became the captain with the best score, and everyone in the Dongjiangyan Brigade jumped up excitedly.
People from other brigades, some have heard of Xu Shiyan, and some have not.
But no matter what, since the rules are recognized by everyone, the elected people must also accept them.
"Brother Xu, today's hunt is up to you to command, tell me, how shall we fight?"

chapters.title: Chapter 88: herd of wild boars
chapters.content:
Chapter 88 Wild boar herd
Ever since he saw the footprints of the herd of pigs that day, Xu Shiyan had also wondered in his heart what method he should use if he wanted to kill this herd of pigs.
At the moment when someone asked about it, Xu Shiyan didn't feel embarrassed, so he just said what he thought.
"The captains of several hunting teams, each took two people with me, we have to go and circle first."
You must first find out the current location of the wild boar herd and how big the herd is before you can make a hunting plan.
I don’t know anything now, so it’s useless to just talk about it here.
Xu Shiyan is the captain elected by the big guys, and most people know about him.
Moreover, Xu Shiyan's arrangement was reasonable, and no one else could find fault with it.
So the captains of each team led their people and followed Xu Shiyan into the mountain to investigate the situation.
Xu Shiyan judged the general direction based on the habits of wild boars and the footprints he saw in the woods that day.
Everyone set off from Xigang Commune and headed west all the way.
After crossing the Stone River, I saw a large area of ​​wild boar footprints, covering the entire hillside. It seemed that the scale was larger than what Xu Shiyan saw before.
"There are big guys in this group of pigs." Xu Shiyan looked at the hoof prints on the ground, some of which were as big as the mouth of a bowl.
This pig is probably not small, not to mention a thousand catties, seven or eight hundred catties can't run away.
"Captain Xu, where are we going to chase now?"
When they first came out, the other captains were somewhat unconvinced. After seeing the footprints all over the mountain, they had nothing else to say.
"Go, continue to follow, this is the footprint left by yesterday, I guess the group of pigs should be near Bajianfang today."
Experienced hunters can infer the time when the prey passed by from the footprints and excrement left by wild boars on the ground.
Thus roughly judging where the group of pigs can be found next.
Bajianfang is a place name.
Before the Tun was built, there were four peasant households who built eight houses to live here, so after the Tun was built, it was called the Eight Houses.
There are about forty families here, under the jurisdiction of Dongling Brigade.
Just five or six miles south of Bajianfang, there is a large piece of walnut catalpa, also known as hickory forest.
There is nothing to eat at this time of year, and wild boars are probably looking for pecans to eat in the snow in the walnut forest.
Xu Shiyan had a judgment in his heart, so he was not in a hurry to approach the walnut catalpa forest.
Instead, he led people around the forest in a big circle. Sure enough, only wild boars entered the forest, but there was no sign of them leaving the forest.
"Come on, let's go in quietly. No one should shoot rashly. If those pigs are disturbed, it will be difficult to fight if they break up."
Xu Shiyan instructed everyone, and led them into the forest.
In this season, the snow on the mountain has been deposited for a whole winter, with a hard cover on the top, and the bottom is like sand.
When people step on it, it doesn't creak like new snow, but it feels like stepping on the sand, making a swishing sound.
The sound was not loud and could easily be covered by the howling wind in the forest. This was an excellent opportunity. Everyone walked forward cautiously, trying not to make any noise.
This piece of walnut catalpa forest is very large, and there is a big ditch pond at the bottom, and at the moment, the group of wild boars are under the big ditch pond, constantly arching the snow, looking for hickory nuts from the snow.
Everyone looked down from the uphill **** of the ditch pond, and saw a large area underneath, all of which were wild boars.
It’s a little far away, and the wild boars keep arching the snow. The arched snow is blown up by the wind, which is almost like fog, and the sight is blocked, so it’s not so clear.
Looking vaguely, there are hundreds of pigs at least, and there seems to be a big guy among the pigs.
Xu Shiyan gestured towards the crowd, and the group quietly withdrew from the walnut forest without daring to make any noise.
"Let's go, let's go back quickly, early tomorrow morning, bring people over, surround this area and fight directly."
After leaving the forest, Xu Shiyan spoke.
It’s already afternoon, and the west **** of the ditch pond is sunny. The pigs must rest in this forest tonight, and they will continue to move forward tomorrow morning.
As long as they surround the place before the wild boars nest, they won't be afraid of the wild boars running away.
Everyone had already convinced Xu Shiyan at this moment, so they naturally listened to him, so the group hurried back.
When I came here, I followed the trail of wild boars and took a lot of detours, so I don’t need to go back.
Everyone was familiar with this area, so they went straight to the direction of the commune and returned to Xigang.
In the evening, the big guys found a place to live in Xigang Commune.
On the morning of the 18th, before dawn, everyone got up, dealt with a bite of food, and then assembled and set off.
After walking for more than two hours, I came to the walnut catalpa forest.
Arriving here, Xu Shiyan began to arrange manpower and arrange hunting plans.
There are hundreds of people in their line, it is impossible to swarm up and shoot directly, so the wild boar will run away after being frightened, and the two-legged ones can't run faster than the four-legged ones.
Moreover, there are many people and accidents are easy to happen. After all, bullets have no eyes. What if they hurt someone?
So it is necessary to pay attention to tactical cooperation, preparation of steps, and blocking in batches to prevent wild boars from escaping the encirclement.
Xu Shiyan led the people from the Dongjiangyan brigade to enter from the east of the walnut forest, and the people from the Dongling and Nanling brigades surrounded them from the north and south.
The rest of the people were blocked uphill in the ditch and pond on the west side.
"Remember, our side fired first. After the Dongling and Nanling brigades heard the gunshots, they outflanked and drove the wild boars to the west."
"The west is divided into sections, and the firepower is concentrated on the slope. If the wild boars escape, be sure to stop them and try to destroy them all."
I checked the terrain yesterday. The **** on the west side of the ditch pond is steep. Shooting from the east, south, and north sides can kill many pigs.
The rest of the pigs must flee towards the west slope. The west **** is steep, and the wild boars must go uphill slower than downhill. It is easier for the people on the **** to fight down.
Everyone thought it was reasonable, so the captains of each brigade led people to ambush in designated positions around the walnut forest according to the discussed plan.
Here, Xu Shiyan led a group of people from the Dongjiangyan Brigade and changed into the white coats they borrowed from the commune hospital last night.
These people should get as close to the wild boar herd as possible, and then attack suddenly.
Twenty people were distributed in a fan, each with a gun in his hand, walking cautiously into the woods.
The wild boar is lazy. It didn’t lie down to rest until it was full last night. It won’t wake up until ten o’clock this morning.
Sleeping boars are naturally much less vigilant.
In addition, the wind is still blowing in the woods today, and more than twenty people are walking scattered again, and the little movement is covered under the sound of the wind, and it is almost impossible to detect anything.
Everyone dared not walk too fast, and slowly approached the bottom of the ditch and pond.
When I got to the bottom of the ditch pond, I found that there was a large group of wild boars lying on the west **** of the ditch pond.
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, telling everyone not to worry, slow down, slow down, and lean forward as much as possible.
Until they were less than 100 meters away from the herd of wild boars, everyone pulled down the safety guards and took aim with their guns.
Bang bang bang, gunshots rang out, and then there was a howling of wild boars.
Another five chapters have been updated, let me take a breather, and there may be more tonight.

chapters.title: Chapter 89: big win
chapters.content:
Chapter 89 Big Victory
Most of the 20 people in the Dongjiangyan Brigade still use stick handles, and only six or seven people use semi-automatic.
Even so, after this wave of shooting, a dozen wild boars had already fallen on the ground.
The herd of wild boars was frightened and fled in all directions.
Xu Shiyan and the others did not follow forward to chase, but continued to shoot with their guns in hand. They could hit if they could, and it didn’t matter if they couldn’t.
As soon as the gunfire rang out, the men on the north and south sides also took up their guns and prepared intently.
The wild boars fled in all directions, and many of them ran north and south, just hitting the muzzle of the gun.
Only gunshots from the north and the south were heard at the same time, and there was another howling of wild boars.
There were gunshots from the east, north, and south sides, and the wild boar was not stupid, but anyone who could still run turned around and ran up the west slope.
It was difficult to go uphill, and many wild boars were injured, so they couldn't run so fast.
When the wild boar climbed halfway up the hillside, the people lying in ambush on the western hillside also shot in batches.
When you fight pigs, you can’t beat them to death. Then the wild boars will go crazy and fight desperately, and it won’t work if you have a gun. A bad one could kill someone.
Siege on three sides, leave a hole, and the wild boar will not go crazy and desperate if it thinks it can escape.
Occupying favorable terrain in this way, block the attack in sections, and pick the big ones to fight, so as not to cause the wild boars to counterattack.
In the end, there were less than twenty wild boars that escaped, and most of them were injured.
The entire Ergou pond and hillside were stained red with blood, and there were wild boar corpses all over the ground.
Not only were they shot to death, but some were also trampled to death by their fellow fleeing in panic. The air was filled with a thick smell of blood.
"Come on, clean up the battlefield, don't chase those wild boars."
Seeing that someone was about to chase the fleeing wild boar, Xu Shiyan stopped him directly.
"These are enough for us to get back, and the remaining ones will be cleaned up later when we have a chance."
The wild boar carcasses in this place have to be disemboweled quickly, otherwise the meat will stink if the wild boar covers the body, which is useless.
As soon as everyone heard the truth, they stopped chasing after it. Instead, they disemboweled the intact wild boar on the ground, took off the internal organs and hung them on the tree.
This is not to respect the mountain god, but to let the internal organs cool down and freeze quickly, and take them back later.
Pig offal is also a good thing, who is willing to throw it away, take it all back.
In this battle, more than 90 wild boars, large and small, were killed. There were more than 20 wild boars in the basket alone, and the others were sows and piglets.
I took a look around, but I didn't see the big guy among the wild boars.
I think so, to grow so big, I am afraid that I have experienced countless hunters' encirclement and suppression, it is definitely a veteran.
How could such a pig be killed so easily?
With so many prey, even though Xu Shiyan and the others have about a hundred people, it will take a lot of work to transport them back.
Fortunately, it was snow, and everyone dragged and dragged, and after a lot of effort, they finally dragged all the wild boars back to the commune.
Xigang Commune is very lively now, everyone came out to watch.
Seeing the big wild boars, everyone was surprised and happy, and the children jumped up and down clapping their hands.
Since the establishment of Xigang Commune, the first large-scale hunting operation has achieved such a rich result, and the cadres of the commune are also very happy.
The secretary immediately stated that the prey obtained will be distributed by each team according to the number of participants, and the wild boars will be brought back, and each team will handle it by itself.
Everyone cheered, their joy was beyond words.
There are so many wild boars, and a group with a large population can be divided into ten or so heads. At that time, every household can share some meat. Who is not happy?
Dongjiangyan brigade sent 20 people to participate in the hunting, and finally separated three running baskets, five sows, and two little yellow-haired pigs.
Over there, the commune arranged for horse sledges, and loaded the prey obtained by each brigade on the sledges.
The people who participated in the hunt returned the guns and ammunition supported by the commune and the forest farm, and then happily followed the sledge and returned to the brigade.
It was already afternoon when the Dongjiangyan team returned to the village.
Someone came back to report the news beforehand. Zhao Dahai received the news and waited at the entrance of the village with the whole village.
When Xu Shiyan and others came back with a dozen wild boars, everyone in the village cheered.
"Hurry up, go back to the team headquarters. The cauldron at the other end of the cargo room has been set up. Let's open it to eat meat tonight."
Zhao Dahai was so happy that he couldn't close his mouth from ear to ear, he hurriedly called everyone to go to the team headquarters.
The wild boars were hunted down by the hunting team, but the hunting team was also a member of the brigade, and they used the guns of the brigade, so some of these wild boars must be distributed to everyone.
Zhao Dahai discussed with other cadres of the brigade, and the 20 people in the hunting team will share half of the prey they get, and the rest will belong to the whole village.
So, just in front of the team gate, everyone skinned and deboned the pork.
The bones and internal organs were packed up on the spot and brought directly to the goods house.
Over the cargo room, the two large pots had already been cleaned and water was boiled inside.
Clean all kinds of pig offals, throw them into the water and boil them, remove the **** foam and cut them into pieces.
Don't worry about the heart, liver and lungs, they are all mixed together and filled with several large basins.
Cut off some fat over there, serve it with green onion and garlic collected from various houses, and fry it in a pan.
Then pour in the ingredients and stir-fry. After frying the aroma, add soup and simmer for a while, then add potatoes and pumpkin pieces, and just simmer a big pot like this.
The aroma wafted out along the hot air, and everyone salivated when they smelled the aroma.
Water was also added to another large pot, the bones left over from the shaved meat were chopped off, poured into the pot to boil the **** foam, and then water was added to stew again.
A group of women are cutting sauerkraut, waiting for the bones in the pot to cook, and the sauerkraut is also cut.
So pour all the sauerkraut into the pot, add the ingredients and simmer.
This pot of pork bone sauerkraut was bubbling and bubbling in the pot, causing everyone's eyes to stare at it, and they couldn't stop drooling.
The bones and internal organs were all stewed, and half of the remaining meat was reserved for the hunting team, and the rest were divided according to the population.
Everyone was very happy. Those who got the meat rejoiced and hurriedly sent the meat home, and then brought the pots, waiting for the dishes.
After all, wild pork is different from domestic pork. It takes a lot longer to cook before it can be cooked.
Until it was almost dark, the dishes in the pot were finally stewed, and every household was waiting with pots.
Zhao Dahai's daughter-in-law and another mother-in-law used big spoons to serve vegetables for every household.
Pig offload stewed potatoes and pumpkins, stewed pork bones with sauerkraut, each family has a pot.
Everyone took the steaming dishes and ran back in a hurry. When they got home, they had pancakes, and the whole family ate their stomachs round.
The three sons of Xu's family all participated in the hunting, and each divided a lot of meat.
At home, Zhou Guilan led her daughters-in-law to refine oil and cook, and stewed a big pot.
Zhou Guilan is a bit of a clean freak.
She was not very worried about the dishes made by the people in the village. She always felt that the big pot of rice could not guarantee hygiene, so she didn't ask her family to serve the dishes in the village.
Anyway, this winter, the Xu family didn't run out of meat, and no one was greedy for the bones and offal. It was enough for the family alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: double battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 90 Double Hegemony
The United Great Siege Hunting was successful in the first battle, all the brigades in the commune benefited, and the members of the commune were very happy to eat.
In this way, everyone's interest in hunting was aroused.
Especially those who participated in the hunting, their minds began to wander, and they all wanted to go to the mountains to poke something, just to keep it for the New Year.
Since then, the mountains have not been peaceful. It can be said that there is no peace, and people run into the mountains every day.
Some people are lucky and can catch some prey, while some people are unlucky and can't catch anything.
There are still some people who have a little back, and they can't go hunting in the mountains, but they are injured by wild animals.
In five or six days, the commune hospital received more than ten hunting injuries.
Some were kicked by wild boars, some were scratched by black blind men, all kinds of things.
The director of the commune hospital went straight to the secretary of the commune and asked the commune to take care of it.
The commune held an emergency meeting and ordered that no one should enter the mountain indiscriminately.
But everyone's eyes are red, who cares about that? Should we go into the mountains or drill into the mountains?
Dongjiangyan Brigade is in a similar situation, whether they are members of the hunting team or not, they all want to go into the mountains to get some cheap money and come back.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan was leading them, and nothing major went wrong. Every time they went into the mountains, they could gain something, and they would come back after hunting a few wild boars and black blind men.
Xu Shiyan took people up the mountain three times in a row, and each time he gained a lot, but he was also very tired.
Zhao Dahai held an emergency meeting to deliver orders from his superiors, which happened to give Xu Shiyan a chance to rest.
Later, when someone called him again, Xu Shiyan simply refused.
People are not made of iron, so who can bear to go up the mountain?
Those people couldn't call Xu Shiyan, so they wanted to borrow a dog, but Xu Shiyan refused.
Going up the mountain to hunt is all about the dogs, and those dogs have been very tired these days, so they must be given a good rest.
Besides, the dogs recognized their master, and without Xu Shiyan leading them up the mountain, they wouldn't be obedient to work at all.
Borrow it out, in case of any accident, whose fault is it?
Those people couldn't call Xu Shiyan, and they couldn't borrow a dog, so they were not very happy, so they had to leave angrily.
After a few days, the hunting wind somewhat subsided.
Xu Shiyan couldn't take the dog up the mountain anymore, for fear that others would be jealous.
So I led my brothers to trap otters near Nuanquanzi by the river.
Or go to the nearby woods, find a badger hole, smoke the badger, or go to the pine woods to trap squirrels or sables.
On this day, the three brothers worked **** the mountain for an entire afternoon, took a lot of traps, and walked back at noon.
When they had just walked halfway up the mountain, they suddenly heard a roar of "嗤呜" in the distance, and the three of them were so frightened that their legs softened and they almost sat on the snow.
"Third brother, it's the tiger's movement. How can there be a tiger here?" Xu Shixiang's face turned pale with fright, and he said frightened.
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, signaling the fifth child to keep quiet, which would affect his judgment.
Accompanied by the roar of the tiger, there were also some groaning sounds, and Xu Shiyan knew immediately that it was the sound of a bear.
The reason why it is said to be bears instead of Heixiazi is because there is another kind of bear in the Changbai Mountain area, the brown bear, which is the bear that is often mentioned in the ginseng story.
The locals call the black bear a black blind man, and also a dog hunchback. This brown bear is usually called a horse hunchback.
Bears usually hibernate in winter, and black bears usually live in tree holes, called Tiancangzi.
Brown bears are bigger than black bears and cannot live in tree holes, so they hibernate in stone caves, so they are called dicangzi.
This winter, Xu Shiyan killed several Tian Cangzi, but he never met Di Cangzi.
The movement from the other side of the mountain didn't sound like a black bear, but a brown bear.
Which warehouse is this brown bear woke up by someone?
Well, it’s also possible that many people have entered the mountain recently, but some people have disturbed the hibernating brown bears.
The brown bear came out of the cave and met the tiger somehow.
"Second brother, do you dare to go with me to watch the fight between the tiger and the blind bear?"
Xu Shiyan was very courageous, relying on his good marksmanship, he planned to go over to join in the fun.
The number of tigers in the mountains is very small now, and it is difficult to meet them.
Not to mention, the scene of a fight between a tiger and a brown bear is rare, and it would be a pity not to join in the fun.
"Third brother, stop making trouble, that's a tiger, how dangerous, what if something happens?"
Before Xu Shian could speak, Xu Shixiang hurriedly stopped the two of them.
"At the moment the tiger is fighting with the blind bear. They won't finish the game if they don't decide the outcome. Let's take a peek at it from a distance."
Brown bears are one of the few animals that can compete with tigers. When these two meet together, it is definitely not the end if they do not distinguish between life and death.
"Fifth, you follow behind us, it's okay, let's take a look."
Xu Shi'an is also a courageous person. When he heard that the tiger and the blind man were fighting, he felt itchy in his heart. Why don't you go and take a look?
Both brothers have to go, what can Xu Shixiang do? You can only follow behind your brother.
The three brothers followed the direction of the sound and climbed up a mountain.
Crossing the beam and going down, I saw a brown bear and a tiger in a logging field under the hillside. The two big guys were fighting together, and the battle was very fierce.
The tiger should be an adult male with a huge body, weighing almost five hundred catties by the looks of it.
Not to mention the brown bear, it weighs about seven or eight hundred catties, the same as a small mountain.
Despite the huge size of the brown bear, it is not stupid at all. It dodges the attack of the tiger, and even surprises the tiger with a paw.
The tiger is not a fuel-efficient lamp. Relying on its fast speed, explosive power, and dexterous body, it will give the brown bear a hard time from time to time.
The sharp minions left many wounds on the brown bear, and the painful brown bear howled.
The brown bear saw that it was overwhelmed and wanted to run away, but the tiger didn't give it a chance, so it went up and bit the brown bear on the back of the neck.
The brown bear turned around and slapped the bear, but missed it. The tiger nimbly dodged it, and then the tiger clawed and slapped the brown bear on the chest.
These two big guys fight together, each has its own outcome, but generally speaking, the tiger has the upper hand.
Xu Shiyan's cat was watching from the hillside, and the more he watched, the more impatient he became. Just the two of them fighting like this, when will it be over?
Xu Shiyan had a thought, and walked forward leaning against the snowy cat.
Xu Shixiang was about to shout, but Xu Shian grabbed him.
Both brothers didn't dare to make a sound, they stared intently at Xu Shiyan's every move.
Xu Shiyan moved forward little by little while the two big guys were concentrating on fighting and had no time to distract.
After moving to about 300 meters, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to go any further. He picked up the semi-automatic quietly, aimed at the big brown bear, and shot it out with a bang.
Xu Shiyan's marksmanship is really good, and he hit the brown bear's belly with one shot.
The position was wrong, the brown bear didn't die immediately, turned around and came towards the direction of the gunshot.
Xu Shiyan calmly took aim with his gun and fired three more shots in a row.
After three shots, the brown bear fell to the ground.
As for the tiger, when the first shot was fired, it jumped up and fled.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Xu Chenghou Fryer
chapters.content:
Chapter 91 Xu Chenghou Fryer
"Second brother, hurry up, follow me."
Xu Shiyan greeted Xu Shian, ran down the hillside, and came straight to the brown bear.
"Second brother is in charge of vigilance, fifth brother, come here quickly, let us quickly turn this big guy over and cut open his guts."
Xu Shiyan directly threw the gun to Xu Shian, and asked him to be in charge of vigilance to prevent the tiger from leaving and returning.
Here, Xu Shiyan and Xu Shixiang chopped sticks, turned the big brown bear that weighed seven or eight hundred catties over, and then opened it to take out the internal organs and the bear bile.
"My God, such a big bear gall." Xu Shixiang exclaimed after seeing the bear gall.
The bear gall was actually bigger than two adult fists, and it was almost as big as the baby's head.
Brassy color in sunlight, obviously copper gall.
"Go quickly."
Xu Shiyan put the bear bile in a white cloth bag, took the gun from his second brother, and back to back with Xu Shian, they backed up the mountain with Xu Shixiang protected.
The three brothers retreated five or six miles away, and they breathed a sigh of relief when they saw no other abnormalities.
No one knows whether the tiger will turn around and come back. There is always nothing wrong with being careful.
"Third brother, you are too courageous, you dare to take the bear's gall under the jaws of a tiger." Xu Shixiang said with a pale face and lingering fear.
"It's too time-consuming to wait for the two to decide the winner. I'll do a favor and kill Xiong Xiazi. It's not too much to take a bear bile as interest.
Anyway, tigers don’t eat bear bile, so if we don’t take it, it will be wasted. "Xu Shiyan smiled to ease the atmosphere.
"Then why didn't you hit that tiger first?"
Xu Shixiang was puzzled, if he hit the tiger first, and then the blind bear, so that they could be stewed together, how good would that be?
Xu Shiyan looked at his brother beside him with an idiot-like gaze.
"It's broad daylight, why don't you just dream?
The tiger moves so fast, it ran away as soon as I shot it, can I still hit it? "
Hitting a tiger, isn’t that a joke? Xu Shiyan didn't think he had that ability.
In the Northeast, the tiger is also known as the "God of the Mountain", and it is a very spiritual animal.
Usually hidden in the deep mountains and old forests, it is not easy to go down the mountain to disturb the people and harm the livestock.
Although the Siberian tiger is a master of stealth and sneak attacks, it seldom takes the initiative to hurt people. It is often heard that someone was bitten by a black blind man, but it is rarely heard that someone was bitten by a tiger.
The existence of tigers can control the reproduction and growth of wild boar populations to a certain extent, which has a great effect on the balance of the ecological environment.
How many tigers are left in Northeast China? If you can leave one, it counts as one.
Xu Shiyan does not have such a high sentiment, nor does he have a deep understanding of environmental protection.
When he shot, he didn't think about anything, just looking for someone to shoot.
Brown bears are stupid, injured again, slow-moving, and relatively easy to shoot.
Persimmons are picky and soft, this is never wrong.
"Okay, don't think so much, hurry down the mountain and go home.
Tomorrow, let’s go up the mountain to have a look. I don’t know if the dead bear can be eaten by tigers. If you don't eat it, we'll take it back. "
Blind Xiong who weighs seven or eight hundred catties, who would be willing to just throw it on the mountain like that?
No matter what happens, I have to go back and have a look. If it is still there, then drag it back.
The three brothers returned home with bear bile, talking and laughing all the way.
The next day, the eldest and fourth child were dragged up again, dragging a big sledge up the mountain.
Going to the place, I found that Xiong Xiazi's body was still there, but I don't know what animal had eaten it. Looking at the wound, the tiger didn't come back.
So the five brothers took a lot of effort to pry Xiong Xiazi's body onto the sledge, and dragged it home.
As soon as the blind man with a big bear weighing seven to eight hundred kilograms was dragged into the village, the whole village was boiling, and many people came to Xu's house to watch the fun.
Many people wondered, how did the brothers of the Xu family kill this blind man without bringing a dog up the mountain?
Xu Chenghou and his wife also found it strange that the Xiong Xiazi had many injuries. Xu Shiyan and the others didn't lead the dog. What hurt such a big Xiong Xiazi?
After repeated cross-examination, the three brothers met a tiger and robbed the blind man from the tiger's mouth.
"From today onwards, if the three of you dare to go into the mountains again, I will break your legs.
You guys are so courageous, you dare to measure even a tiger, and dare to **** a blind bear under the tiger's mouth? Why don't you go to heaven? "
Xu Chenghou was about to explode with anger, and when the spectators dispersed, he called his three sons to him and scolded him.
"Third brother, you don't need to talk all day long. I don't think you are a good talker. What do you want?"
Since Xu Shiyan came back from the mountain, Xu Chenghou has always been very kind to his third son, but this time the old man was really angry, and pointed at his son's nose and cursed.
"You married a daughter-in-law, and your daughter-in-law still has a child in her belly. You don't think about your parents, you have to think about your wife and children, right?
You think your marksmanship is good and capable, so you dare to try it with a tiger.
Why don't you think about it, in case something unexpected happens, how will you let the family live? "
In the past, he scolded the third child because he thought his son was not up to date and incompetent, but now he scolded him because he felt that this kid was bold and did too much, and he was afraid that his son would have accidents.
"It looks like the Chinese New Year is coming soon, you guys can calm down a bit.
Our family has not been short of meat this winter, and you have also made several black blind people dare.
San'er, listen to Mom's words, don't go up the mountain. "
On the other end, Zhou Guilan also spoke. She didn't curse, but she shed tears, and the three sons couldn't stand it.
"Mom, we were wrong, I really didn't think about this matter, I was just thinking about it at the time, so I didn't think much about it.
Mom, don't worry, we will definitely not go hunting in the mountains recently, and just stay at home. "
Being scolded by his father, Xu Shiyan didn't feel anything. Anyway, he was scolded since he was a child, and he already got angry.
But Xu Shiyan couldn't stand his mother's tears, so he quickly admitted his mistake and promised that he would never take risks again.
"San'er, listen to Mom, it's time to stop.
You have been in the limelight this winter, and now the village has everything to say, go out and listen, who wouldn’t be jealous? this is not good. "
Zhou Guilan was very worried, fearing that her son would be excluded if he went out in the future.
Before Xu Shiyan was on the mountain, although everyone knew that he got a lot of prey, after all, he didn't see it with his own eyes, and his greed was limited.
But recently Xu Shiyan took his brothers up the mountain, wild boar, blind bear, and roe deer, just dragging them home.
Which one in the village doesn't have red eyes? Everything is said behind the scenes.
Especially a few days ago, a few people in the village who had a normal relationship with the Xu family came to Xu Shiyan, wanting Xu Shiyan to take them into the mountains to hunt.
Being rejected by Xu Shiyan, many people in the village spoke even more harshly, with yin and yang.
Some people said that Xu Shiyan took the guns of the brigade and led the dogs of the brigade, but all the prey he brought back belonged to himself.
This is clearly misappropriating public property for personal gain.
I'm scared now thinking about it.
Zhou Guilan was really worried that if her son was so prominent, the rest of his life would be ruined.
Zhou Guilan has never experienced anything in her life, from the Republic of China, Manchukuo to the new society?
In her view, one should be low-key and not show off. Too much show off can lead to accidents.
If this was the old society, Xu Shiyan was so showy, he could easily be kidnapped by Beard.
Now that there is a new society, it is not so chaotic, but it can't stand someone playing tricks behind their backs.

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Xiaonian enters the city
chapters.content:
Chapter 92 Xiaonian enters the city
"In a few days it will be the new year, after the new year, the fourth child will marry a wife, our family has to kill pigs and hold banquets, there are still many things to be busy.
You guys don’t want to go to the mountains for a while, but help out at home and take care of the fourth child’s marriage, okay? "
Zhou Guilan knew that when her son was older, he couldn't force it. Beating and scolding were useless, and he could only push him further away.
So Zhou Guilan adopted a soft policy and softened her tone, showing concern and pleading in every word.
Xu Shiyan's original plan was to hunt as many prey as possible and save more money while he was still in the big house.
The place here is remote and the population is small, and there are many prey on the mountain, and he has a gun and a dog in his hand.
After moving out after a few years, the gun and dog have to be returned to the brigade, so there are no such convenient conditions.
Donggang is densely populated and there are few wild animals, so there is no chance to hunt again.
But what my mother said made sense. The brothers have been tossing a lot these days, and many people in the village are jealous.
In a village, there are not only good people, but also bad people.
Although Xu Shiyan is not afraid of those people making troubles behind their backs, he still has to worry about his parents, and he can't make the old man worry too much.
My mother loves her son so much, how can Xu Shiyan ignore it? I had no choice but to agree.
"Mom, we know, we will all stay at home and help with the wedding."
Fortunately, I have made a lot of things recently, and there are just a few of them.
Plus all kinds of skins and so on, the money brother sold five cents, probably hundreds of cents for each family.
Okay, people are contented, too greedy and prone to accidents, so stop and rest.
Xu Chenghou scolded, Zhou Guilan coaxed.
The couple sang the good face and the bad face, and finally persuaded the sons who were hunting these days.
Brothers Xu Shiyan agreed, except for those clips, I have to go and see it in a few days, and I will definitely not go hunting in the mountains again.
The old couple was relieved, and the family returned to the warmth and harmony of the past.
In this year and month, it is said that it is a wedding, but in fact there is not much to do.
Nowadays, there is no saying that people who get married must buy a house. There are many houses in the family, and one of them is cleaned up to make a new house.
Those with three rooms like Xu’s house, all facing the kangs in the house, cleaned up the east room and the north kang for the young couple.
If the family’s conditions are difficult, and the whole family sleeps on a kang, they also have to get married.
Xu Chenghou knew carpentry, and Xu Shixian and Xu Shian also learned a little bit, so there is no need to find a carpenter to make furniture.
The furniture of this year has only those styles, and there is nothing difficult. The old man has started to work since the beginning of winter, and has already finished the furniture.
Don't worry about the bedding, Zhou Guilan prepared cotton and cloth early on, and the quilt was brought back from Tonghua by Xu Shiyan.
There are not many two bunks and two covers. Zhou Guilan led her daughter and daughter-in-law, and they made them a long time ago and put them on the kangqin.
Finally, there is only the banquet on the wedding day to be busy.
This is also easy. The Xu family raised two fat pigs and killed one on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth lunar month.
Combined with the fact that Xu Shiyan sent back so much meat before, and the meat that he went up the mountain recently, wouldn’t it be easy to hold a few banquets?
What needs to be purchased, that is, candy, tobacco and alcohol at the banquet.
So, on the day of Xiaonian, the Xu family brothers borrowed a horse sledge from the brigade, and took all kinds of skins, bear bile, etc. they had acquired a while ago, and went to the county seat.
Dongjiang along the brigade leans against the first Songhua River, the river flows northward, meets Tanghe River at the mouth of Tanghe River, and then flows northward through the west of the county seat.
So, from the Dongjiang River to the county seat, there was another way in the summer before, to release emissions.
The wood is bundled together to make a wooden raft, which can reach the county seat by flowing down the water.
In the past, some people went to the county town to sell firewood, most of them did this way, and several people could sit on the wooden raft.
This method has a certain degree of danger. With the construction of the road, no one will discharge it gradually.
It will be easier in winter, just use a horse sledge to pull people, and run north along the frozen river.
In winter, the ice on the big river is more than one meter thick, let alone people leaving, driving is no problem.
From the big house to the north along the river, the horse sledge ran fast, and it took two and a half hours to arrive at the place.
This is faster than walking to Songjianghe, and then taking a car from Songjianghe to the county seat, and the time is free.
The horse sledge stopped under the bridge in the west of the county seat. The embankment was too steep for the sledge to climb up, so Xu Shixian was left to watch the sledge.
Others went up along the embankment and went straight to the purchase station.
The New Year is approaching, and many hunters in villages are thinking of selling the mountain goods in their hands to buy new year goods for money, so there are many people in the buying station.
Xu Shiyan and the others lined up for a while before it was their turn, so they quickly took out all the hides they had hunted for a while, as well as three bear gall bladders.
Of the three bear galls, one was snatched from under the tiger's mouth, and the other was killed by a few brothers who killed black and blind people.
There is another one, who met Yang Chunming and others into the mountain.
Everything else is easy to talk about. The one I got together with Yang Chunming and the others has to be recorded separately, and it will be distributed to everyone after returning home.
Three bear gallbladders, two copper and one grass, especially the brown bear one, big copper gall, one can cover two.
Just these three guts were sold for 2,000 yuan, and other squirrel skins, badger skins, otter skins, and sable skins were sold for another 500 yuan.
It sold for 2,600 yuan at once, and the brothers were very happy, while the others in the room were all envious and envious.
Xu Shiyan took the money and gave the three brothers one hundred yuan each.
This is not a dividend, but let them buy things.
"Second brother, you are going to buy candy, cigarettes and wine with fourth brother, and fifth brother, aren't you going to the bookstore to buy review materials? Hurry up.
I took the money and hurried to find my eldest brother. We are waiting for you under the bridge. Come back quickly after finishing the work, we have to go home quickly. "
With so much money, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to walk carelessly.
You must know that at this time, there are huge crowds of people in the county town to buy new year's goods, what if something goes wrong?
Xu Shiyan had a knife on his body, and two guns on the horse sledge.
So after Xu Shiyan gave his brothers the money for the purchase, he hurried out of the purchase station and went straight to meet Xu Shixian under the bridge.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly walked towards the Xijiang River in the county seat, but he didn't notice that as soon as he left the purchase station, someone followed behind him.
Several people followed Xu Shiyan to the riverside, and saw Xu Shiyan meeting and talking with a person on the river.
One of them hid in a hiding place and continued to stare, while the others were sent back to report and call for help.
"Hurry up and report to Brother Sheng Cao and the others, saying that the kid came to the county again last time.
Bring more money this time, they are just the two of them, let Brother Sheng and Brother Cao bring more people, remember to bring some guys. "
Not long after, I saw a group of people running over in a hurry, and the leader was the one Xu Shiyan met last time.
There is another person next to him, not too tall, with a bit of sternness in his brows and eyes, and a bulging waist, as if he is carrying some belongings.
"Where is it? Damn, I let him run away last time, this time I have to kill him." The leader asked.
"It's just under the bridge." Someone pointed to the river.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: old acquaintance
chapters.content:
Chapter 93 Old Acquaintance
The county is surrounded by mountains on three sides in the northeast and south, and adjacent to water in the west.
People in the county call the river to the west the Xijiang River, and the Xijiang Bridge is a cross-county bridge.
After crossing the bridge, it is under the jurisdiction of Jingyu.
In this year and month, the layout of the entire Er County is still mainly developing southward under the Dongshan Mountain.
The vicinity of the Xijiang River has not yet been developed, and there are not many residents, especially near the Xijiang Bridge, where there are not many people.
Under the bridge, the two brothers Xu Shixian and Xu Shiyan didn't know the danger was coming, and they were chatting enthusiastically.
Twenty-six hundred yuan, minus the share of Yang Chunming and others, there is still two thousand left.
The five brothers share together, and each can get several hundred.
The parents at home have already said that they don’t want the money, and it belongs to the individual.
The family will be separated after a year. With this money, there is no need to worry about life in the future.
"Third brother, thanks to you leading us these days, otherwise our brothers wouldn't be able to earn so much money."
What Xu Shixian said was from the bottom of his heart. In previous years, they worked desperately, and it would be good if they could get a hundred yuan in winter.
How long has it been? How many hundreds of dollars have you received? Who can be unhappy?
"It's a pity, our father won't let us go into the mountains, alas."
Xu Shixian sighed, and felt that it was a pity. If he could continue hunting, he would be able to earn more if he didn’t keep everything.
Xu Shiyan was about to say something, when he suddenly raised his head, he saw a group of people rushing down from the embankment.
Those people came in menacingly, and they went straight to the Xu family brothers, and it was clear at a glance that they were coming for them.
"Brother, hold the gun in your arms and don't show it." Xu Shiyan dodged to block Xu Shixian.
Xu Shixian moved very quickly, and immediately bent down from the sledge and grabbed the gun covered under the sack.
Xu Shixian was thoughtful, he didn't show his gun, and hugged him with the sack in his arms.
At this time, more than a dozen people had already arrived in front of the Xu family brothers.
The first person met Xu Shiyan and laughed, "I didn't expect that we will meet again today.
how? I heard that they are selling mountain goods again today? That's a lot of money, right? "
Having said this, the leader's expression changed, and so did his gaze.
"If you are sensible, hand over the money obediently, and I will forgive you for a while, otherwise, I will let you come and go today.
Don’t think that you are the only one who can carry a knife, see? Today, our buddies all brought their belongings. "
The man waved his hand as he spoke, and saw everyone behind him showing their things.
There is a big knife like the one for chopping watermelons, there is also a knife for killing pigs, and there are two people, and the three-section stick is displayed.
A dozen or so people each hold their belongings, but here the Xu family brothers are unarmed.
Xu Shiyan frowned, is the county so chaotic? These people in broad daylight dare to rob with open swords and guns?
In my impression, it seems that the chaos happened after the 1980s. Could it be that he hadn't been to the county at this time in his previous life, so he didn't know?
"Excuse me, why should I give you the money I earned by my own ability?"
Xu Shiyan looked at the people opposite and said without changing his expression.
"The four or five of you were scared away by me last time. This time, do you think you can do it?"
Xu Shiyan stretched his right hand behind while speaking.
It’s okay not to mention the last time, but when the matter of the last time was mentioned, the face of the leader Cao Jiangqi on the opposite side turned blue.
That was simply humiliating. Four or five people gathered around one another, but they were frightened by the knife in his hand.
"Boy, are you crazy? Okay, I'll make you crazy. I'll see you today. Shengzi, do it."
The popular facial features of the leader were distorted, and when he turned around, he called the younger brother behind him to do it.
As a result, he turned around and found that something was wrong, someone was hiding behind him. "Shengzi, what the **** are you doing hiding? Do it."
"Brother Cao, those brothers know me."
The man in the back was not too tall, and his figure was a bit thin. When the man in front turned around, he also moved and dodged, for fear that his face would be seen.
"What? Know you?" Cao Jiang was taken aback for a moment, then gritted his teeth, "If I know you, then I will be them."
These people basically steal whenever they can, grab whenever they can, and run away when they can. It is rare for them to go out with open swords and guns like today.
The main reason is that they didn't take advantage of Xu Shiyan's last time, and they knew that it would be useless if there were fewer people, so they came out in full force.
Some of the ethos left over from previous years, in fact, incidents of fighting, stealing and robbery in society are not uncommon.
The public security in the countryside is good, mainly due to the low mobility of people.
If there is any conflict, the village cadres will solve it, otherwise there will be militias.
Hearing that the leader said to get rid of it, the little man also became ruthless, pulled out the three-section stick from his waist, and walked out from behind Brother Cao.
"Xu Shiyan, I didn't expect to meet you here today. It's really a narrow road to enemies."
"Chen Desheng, I thought you would always be a coward and dare not show your head."
Xu Shiyan was not surprised when he saw the little man.
When these people ran over just now, Xu Shiyan noticed that someone looked familiar.
The brothers of the Chen family are all the same size and body type. After knowing each other for many years, they can be recognized at a glance.
When Chen Desheng heard it, Xu Shiyan had recognized him long ago, and he hated him even more.
"Okay, since you have recognized me, then stop talking nonsense, save your life today, and avenge my second brother."
Ever since I was bitten by a snake when I went into the mountain, I don’t know whether it was because I was scared or the wound was not treated well. Anyway, Chen Deyong’s life is a bit unsatisfactory.
Because of this, the Chen family all hated Xu Shiyan.
It's a pity that Xu Shiyan is now a celebrity in the Dongjiangyan Brigade, and Zhao Dahai strongly supports it. Even if the Chen family wants to play tricks, they have no way to start.
Meeting today, old and new grudges added together, Chen Desheng naturally refused to let Xu Shiyan go.
So he waved the three-section stick in his hand, driving the wind, "Brothers, go."
Chen Desheng is the most capable person under Cao Jiang, and he takes the lead in most of these matters.
When Chen Desheng moved, the ten or so people behind him also waved their belongings and rushed forward.
However, as soon as they took two steps, they all widened their eyes and stopped.
There is only one reason, because the muzzle of the black hole is aimed at them.
At this time, who would dare to rush forward? No matter how fast you charge, are there any other guns that are as fast?
Besides, it's not a gun, is this thing too scary?
"Fuck, you guys are carrying guns?" Cao Jiang was also dumbfounded.
How far does he have to memorize this idea? The last time I met someone with a knife with my bare hands.
Come here today with your belongings. People carry guns, or two guns, and dare not move even if they want to run.
What made this group collapse even more was yet to come.
"Big Brother, Third Brother, what's the matter?" The three Xu Shi'an brothers who went shopping rushed back.
Working hard to update another five chapters, today’s update is over, and the update will start at 7:00 tomorrow morning, so don’t stay up late.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Suspect
chapters.content:
Chapter 94 Doubt
The Chinese New Year is approaching, and the shops and markets are crowded with people.
The three Xu Shi'an brothers didn't dare to wander around. After buying what their mother told them, they immediately rushed under the Xijiang Bridge.
As soon as I arrived on the embankment, I saw a large group of people below, and the situation seemed not right.
The three brothers rushed down and stood beside Xu Shiyan and Xu Shixian.
"Chen Desheng? What the **** are you bastards? What do you want?"
Xu Shian saw Chen Desheng on the opposite side, and thought that this kid was looking for someone to seek revenge.
"Second brother, don't talk nonsense with them.
Old five, go to the police station and call someone, and say that these people robbed. "
Things have come to this point, there is only one result, don't let these people go in, otherwise it will be a disaster in the future.
As soon as they heard that they were going to call the police, the people on the other side panicked.
Someone raised his leg and wanted to run, but as soon as he moved, he heard a bang, and the bullet shot in front of his toes, causing a cloud of crushed ice.
"Whoever dares to move, I can't guarantee where to hit next time." Xu Shiyan held the gun and snorted.
When those people saw it, how dare they move again?
Xu Shiyan let Xu Shian and Xu Shide go over, beat those people down one by one, and then untied their belts and tied them all up.
At this time, most of the waistbands of people's trousers are strips of cloth, which are good for binding people.
The fifth child, Xu Shixiang, rushed to the nearest police station to report the case, and the police from the police station arrived quickly.
Seeing this situation, they brought everyone directly to the institute for questioning and recording confessions.
and other matters were all inquired clearly, Chen Desheng, Cao Jiang and others were directly detained in the police station, and Brother Xu Shiyan could leave.
However, the two guns were debunked.
People say that the leaders of the brigade or the commune must provide a certificate to confirm the legality of the guns before they are allowed to take them away, otherwise they can only be detained.
Xu Shiyan did the same thing, just buckle it.
So the brothers drove their horses and plowed all the way back to Dongjiangyan, and then Xu Shiyan went directly to Zhao's house to find Zhao Dahai, and told them what happened.
"Uncle, I have an idea, do you think you should go to the police station and ask about the throwing of the club by our brigade?"
The gun is still secondary, the key is the mallet.
"Chen Desheng was able to mix with those people, and he couldn't keep the battalion of our brigade. He led people to do it."
Xu Shiyan has suspected this matter for a long time.
He has always thought that there is something tricky in it, and there must be an inside ghost colluding with outsiders to steal the mallet.
As soon as he saw Chen Desheng today, Xu Shiyan concluded that the throwing of the club must have something to do with him.
Chen Desheng is the only one who has this channel in the whole village, and it is unlikely for others.
In the previous life, the Chen family suddenly became rich. Now that I think about it, if I don’t keep it, it’s the money from the sale of the stick.
After hearing this, Zhao Dahai slapped his thigh, "No, why didn't I think of it?
Yes, yes, this matter is guaranteed to be related to the Chen family. The old Chen family said that he was working as a temporary worker in the city, and the co-author was going to be a thief.
No, I will go to the county right away. This matter cannot be delayed, it must be done quickly. "
Zhao Dahai's temper has come up, why is he willing to wait until tomorrow?
Immediately asked Zhao Jianguo to set up the sledge, and Zhao Dahai hurried to the team headquarters to obtain a certificate, etc., and hurried to the county seat.
Xu Shiyan explained the situation to Zhao Dahai, and then returned to Xu's house.
Xiaonian, Zhou Guilan said early in the morning, let Xu Shiyan and his wife go back to have dinner in the afternoon.
Besides, I sold the money during the day, and the dividends have not yet been settled.
When I entered the door, dumplings were being made on the Dongwu Kang.
Xu Shixian waited for others to come back first, and has already told his family what happened today.
So when Xu Shiyan came in, Xu Chenghou hurriedly called him to Beikang to find out what Zhao Dahai's attitude was.
The gun was the property of the brigade, but it was seized in Xu Shiyan's hands. Xu Chenghou was very worried about what punishment the brigade would give Xu Shiyan.
"Father, don't worry, it's okay. Uncle Zhao has already gone to the county, and he will probably bring the gun back tomorrow."
Xu Shiyan didn't mention what he said to Zhao Dahai. Regarding the throwing of the mallet, it's just a suspicion at the moment, and you can't talk nonsense.
There are so many people in Xu's family, if anyone speaks nonsense, the consequences will be a bit serious.
Xu Chenghou frowned when he heard the words, not quite understanding.
Today is a young year, so Zhao Dahai rushed to the county for two guns?
It’s already afternoon, where does he finish his work, and then go back in the evening? As for what?
Xu Chenghou wanted to ask, but at this time the five sons had already started to settle accounts and divide the money, so no one paid any attention to him.
Xu Chenghou shook his head, and didn't bother to care about that anymore.
Zhao Dahai is the secretary of the brigade. He is capable and capable, so don't worry about him.
On the other end, Xu Shiyan took out all the remaining money and deducted 600 yuan from it.
The copper gallbladder was fought with Yang Chunming, Zhao Jianshe and the others, and we will call everyone over tomorrow to share it.
The remaining two thousand, the big copper gallbladder, was shot by Xu Shiyan, Xu Shian, and Xu Shixiang together.
The three brothers discussed it, and no one should worry about it so much. The two thousand yuan will be left to the parents for three hundred, and the remaining five brothers will be divided equally.
Just like that, the accounts were settled, the money was divided, and the three hundred yuan was directly handed over to Zhou Guilan.
"You don't need to give it to me, didn't you agree before? You don't need the hunting money at home, and keep it for you to live in the future."
Zhou Guilan didn't want this money. It was not easy for her sons to work hard to earn this money. After the separation, each of them had to support their families.
The old couple don’t have much to spend, so why do they need so much money?
"Mom, your son gave it to you, so you just keep it.
The fifth and sixth children are not married yet, and the family spends a lot of money, so let’s keep it. "
Xu Shiyan and the others persuaded together, Zhou Guilan thought about it, and accepted the money without any further refusal.
While talking, the dumplings are almost finished.
The pot boiled water, and Zhou Guilan went down to cook the dumplings herself.
One by one, the white, fat and small dumplings fell into the boiling water, stirred gently with a spoon, and the dumplings rolled up and down in the water.
Dry firewood was burning at the bottom of the pot, and the fire was very hot. After the dumplings were put in the pot, the water boiled.
Zhou Guilan turned around and poured some cold water into the pot, and the water stopped boiling.
Boil the water three times, the dumplings are cooked, and beat them directly onto the plate with a strainer. Xue Xiulin's sisters-in-law hurriedly carried them into the room.
There are many people in the family, how can a pot of dumplings be enough? Take out the first pot and then the next pot.
After a while, the second pot came out, and everyone sat around the table, happily eating dumplings.
"Come on, try them all. Today's dumplings have different fillings. Let's see what kind of fillings you can taste?"
Zhou Guilan pushed a plate of dumplings to Su Anying, signaling her to eat more.
When everyone heard this, they picked up the dumplings and took a bite without dipping them in sauce.
"This is sauerkraut, it must be right."
"This is cabbage, but what is the meat without eating, it doesn't look like pork."
Everyone chattered there.
Zhou Guilan didn't say what kind of meat it was, but only asked if it was delicious.
There is a lot of meat in the dumpling, can it be delicious? But what kind of meat it is, I can't tell.
The family has not stopped eating meat this winter. They have all kinds of meat. How do you guess?
"The sauerkraut contains Xiong Xiazi meat, and the cabbage contains roe deer meat." Finally, Zhou Guilan announced the answer.
Sauerkraut likes a lot of oil and water, and bear meat is rich in fat, so it goes well with it.
Roe deer meat is relatively thin, and it goes well with cabbage.
Zhou Guilan's skill in making stuffing is excellent, the dumplings are delicious and delicious, almost filling everyone's throats.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: come to light
chapters.content:
Chapter 95
After the small year, the big year is just around the corner.
Ordinary families are busy preparing things for the New Year, but the Xu family not only has to prepare for the New Year, but also has to make arrangements for Xu Shide's marriage, so naturally they are even more busy.
Xu Shiyan and his wife had to come back to help, so they called Yang Chunming and others over and shared the money for the copper gall.
