Six hundred yuan was divided among ten people, and each person was worth tens of yuan. Even so, everyone was very happy and chatted together.
While talking and joking, suddenly heard a rush of footsteps outside, and then Wang Zhijun's younger brother ran in.
"The police, the police came to our village, driving, driving the car, and Uncle Zhao came back with him."
This kid ran too fast, he was wheezing and wheezing to deliver the letter, and he couldn't speak smoothly.
Everyone was taken aback when they heard the words, "What? The police came? Uncle Zhao also came back with him?
What's the matter? Someone in our village committed a crime? "Yang Chunming and others immediately stood up and walked out.
Xu Shiyan and Zhao Jianshe glanced at each other, but they had some guesses in their hearts.
Looking at this posture, the matter of throwing the stick may really have something to do with the Chen family.
"Go, go and have a look."
A group of people hurried out of Xu's house and went straight to the west of the village. Sure enough, the car stopped outside the gate of Chen's house.
Several people in grass-green uniforms and big hats escorted Chen Deyong out from inside.
Behind, Chen Yongfu and his daughter-in-law, Chen Deyong and Chen Desheng's daughter-in-law, followed behind, crying and howling.
"What the **** is going on? Why was Chen Deyong arrested when he was doing well? What happened?"
After such a short period of time, many people have gathered at the west end of the village. The big guys looked at this posture and were quite puzzled.
What was even more surprising was that not only Chen Deyong was arrested, but also Hu Tou was brought out.
He was in his fifties, and he was so frightened that his body shook like chaff.
"The old beard made a mistake too? No way.
That's Captain Hu's uncle, an old man in his fifties, what can he do? "
Everyone was even more surprised when they saw it. What happened? Two people were arrested in the village at once?
Not only were the spectators around in a daze, but even the vice-captain Hu Liancheng was also in a daze.
"Secretary Zhao, what's going on here? What did my uncle do wrong, why did the police arrest him?"
Hu Liancheng grabbed Zhao Dahai and asked loudly.
Zhao Dahai looked at the people in front of him and coughed, "Okay, since most of the young and old in the village are here, I'll just say it straight."
"Chen Desheng, the eldest son of Chen Yongfu's family in our brigade, said that he was working as a temporary worker in the city, but in fact he was hanging out with a group of people, sneaking around, robbing houses and not doing good things all day long.
Yesterday, a group of them blocked the road and robbed them. They met a hard stubble and were arrested and sent to the police station. "
Zhao Dahai didn't say that he met the brothers of the Xu family, but he was also protecting the Xu family.
"As a result of this trial, it was found out that our brigade lost the baton.
It was Chen Deyong who colluded with his brother Chen Desheng, brought people into the venue at night, and stole our brigade's 20-foot club. "
Speaking of this, Zhao Dahai glanced at Hu Liancheng.
"Speaking of why Old Hu was arrested, it was because he and Brother Chen Deyong cooperated internally and externally.
He puts people into the venue, and he also feeds dogs with medicine.
Then he had someone close the door from the outside, as if he was also a victim, so that we could not suspect him. "
Yesterday evening, Zhao Dahai rushed to the county. Instead of going directly to the police station, he went to the county cadres.
Through the county to put pressure on the police station, let the police station interrogate overnight.
It is about 20 Zhang ginseng from the Dongjiangyan Brigade, and the amount involved is three to four thousand yuan. The county cadres have come forward, and the police station is not fully cooperating?
Under the first trial, someone really couldn't bear it and recruited.
At that time, Chen Deyong learned that Lao Li was sick and no one was watching the field, so he came up with the idea of ​​stealing the club.
Chen Deyong sent a letter to his elder brother Chen Desheng in the county asking him to come back, and then the brothers found Lao Hutou.
Discuss with the old Hutou, and give the old Hutou some money after he succeeds.
Afterwards, Chen Desheng took a few people with him. Taking advantage of the night, with the help of the old Hutou, he overturned the dog with medicine, and successfully stole the club and took it away.
Arrived in the county seat, and through Cao Jiang's contacts, tried to sell the stick.
A total of 3,200 yuan was obtained, the old Hutou divided 200, the person who handled the ginseng company divided 500, and Cao Jiang divided 500.
The remaining 2,000 yuan, the Chen family brothers will share 1,000 yuan, and the other four will share 1,000 yuan.
"Chen Desheng has been in the county for the past two years, and he has done a lot of bad things with others, and the sum of money involved should be quite large.
At present, the relevant departments are still in the process of trial, and how to deal with it in the future is out of our control. "
As Zhao Dahai narrated the incident bit by bit, the eyes of the surrounding audience on the Chen family also began to change.
From doubt at the beginning to contempt, and finally resentment.
"Damn, let me just say that the throwing of the stick was so weird? It was done by the scum of your old Chen family.
You stole the hard work of the big guy, and you get the money to be free?
Damn it, Chen Deyong, I'm **** killing you today. "
There were a few violent ones who rolled up their sleeves and stepped forward, intending to beat Chen Deyong violently.
"Stop, don't mess around, Chen Deyong has done something illegal, so there are laws to deal with it.
How can you beat someone in front of the police? "
Zhao Dahai saw it, and hurried forward to stop him. Beating someone in front of the police, isn't that nonsense?
"Big guy, we have to trust the superiors and the comrades of the police, and we will be able to recover the losses for our brigade.
Okay, now that the Chinese New Year is in sight, don’t hang out here anymore, let’s go home and do whatever we can.
Over there, get out of the way and let the comrades of the public security lead people away. "
Zhao Dahai was afraid that these young people in the village would cause trouble if they got hot-blooded, so he hurriedly waved them away.
At the other end, the people from the police station took Chen Deyong and Lao Hutou into the car and drove away.
Everyone was still angry and looked at the rest of the Chen family with unkind eyes.
When Chen Yongfu and others saw this, they were so frightened that they went into the house in desperation and dared not come out again.
"Everyone listen to me, Chen Desheng and Chen Deyong made mistakes, and their family did not break the law.
Now is a new society, so it’s not a good idea to sit on the same set.
The state has national laws, Chen Desheng and the others broke the law, and they have their own legal sanctions. You are not willing to retaliate against the Chen family, understand? "
As the brigade secretary, Zhao Dahai must say what should be said.
But whether the people below listen or not, it is beyond his control.
The case that had been pending for so long was solved and the thief was caught.
Even though the big guys are angry in their hearts, they can't do anything else with Zhao Dahai's words first.
In desperation, everyone had to go home separately.
Of course, in private, the big guys also scolded the Chen family bloody. Whether they will find opportunities to clean up the Chen family in the future is unknown.
Brothers Chen Desheng and Chen Deyong were the masterminds and stole public property in a huge amount.
Chen Desheng, together with Cao Jiang and others, stole and robbed, and the circumstances were serious and bad.
After the trial, several main members of the gang ate peanuts, and other members also received fixed meal tickets for different years.
The Chen family suddenly lost their two sons, and was squeezed out by the villagers. They couldn't stay in the Dongjiangyan brigade, and then moved away quietly, never to be seen again.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Butcher a pig and prepare a banquet
chapters.content:
Chapter 96 Killing a pig and preparing a banquet
The matter of the Chen brothers caused a huge wave in the village, and every household was talking about it.
The big guys got together and scolded Chen Deyong and his brothers, and even Chen Yongfu and others.
The Xu family also had to discuss a few words in private, but the Xu family was busy and didn't have much time to talk about it.
Xu Shide got married on the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month. On the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth lunar month, the Xu family slaughtered pigs.
How much food is willing to feed pigs these days? They are all fed with hog grass, at most, in autumn, some bean pod skins, bean pods and so on are mixed.
So don't look at it after a year of raising it, in fact it has just reached 200 catties.
The Xu family raised two pigs, sold one to a supply and marketing cooperative, and killed the other for weddings and Chinese New Year.
Woke up early on the 25th, brothers Xu Shian and Xu Shiyan entered the pigsty, **** a fat pig and tied it to a bench.
Several people held down the pig. Xu Shian held the butcher's knife in his hand, and stabbed it from the knife socket under the pig's neck to the heart.
The white knife goes in and the red knife comes out. When the knife is drawn, a stream of blood spurts out.
There is someone holding a basin to collect pig blood.
Wait until all the blood is collected and put it aside.
Zhou Guilan found a sorghum stalk, split it from the middle, folded it into three sections backwards, and kept stirring the sorghum stalk in the pig's blood basin so that it could not solidify.
In the courtyard of Xu’s house, a large pot was set up, filled with boiling water.
After the pig is bled, pour boiling water on it, and then shave. The pig hair was shaved, and the belly was dismantled to take out the internal organs.
The offloaded pigs are all good things. Xue Xiulin's sister-in-law took the offloads away and began to clean them over and over again.
Especially the pig intestines, they have to be turned over, rubbed with plant ash first, and then washed with soda, salt, and vinegar several times until the smell is gone.
Clean the internal organs, put them directly into the pot to blanch, cook the blood foam, then boil on high heat, add seasoning and simmer slowly.
The person in charge of watching the pot opened the pot to take a look from time to time, and inserted the pork liver with chopsticks. Seeing that the heat was almost ready, he immediately scooped it out with a strainer.
Tie one end of the pig’s small intestine tightly with a thin thread, cut some minced fat meat, green onion, salt, pepper noodles and other things into the blended pig blood to season and remove the fishy smell, and then pour it into the small intestine with a funnel.
When the blood is full, tie the other end tightly with a thin thread, and then put it in a pot to boil.
While cooking, **** a needle from time to time to deflate.
When the needle goes in and the blood color is gone when it is pulled out, immediately remove the blood sausage.
The finished blood sausage is kept and stewed with sauerkraut. It is the authentic Northeast pig-killing dish, sauerkraut white meat blood sausage.
This year, when we get married and hold banquets, chefs are rarely invited.
The main family sets the menu according to their own conditions, and the daughters-in-law of the helpers prepare the dishes according to the menu.
Most of the dishes are semi-finished products prepared one day in advance. On the day of the wedding, you only need to heat it up and thicken it with sauce.
The Xu family killed a pig alone for the banquet, and there was so much meat made by Xu Shiyan and others before, so there is no need to worry about hosting a banquet.
Zhou Guilan asked the fifth child to draw up the menu, and decided with the daughters-in-law who came to help.
So although Xu's yard is very busy, it is busy but not chaotic and orderly.
Xu Shi'an and others chopped and deboned the pork according to the requirements of the banquet, and then prepared the pork that should be cooked, chopped, and fried.
"Oh, the fourth daughter-in-law is still lucky, look at how much food is given when people get married and hold banquets?
Our mother-in-law ordered the menu yesterday, and there are even braised meat and Sixi meatballs.
My God, when we got married, we didn't get this kind of treatment.
Yingzi, I remember when you got married was the worst, there was no meat, you got canned mutton, right? "
The Xu family is so busy, of course Su Anying has to come over to help. She has a big belly and can't do anything else, just chopping onions and garlic.
As a result, Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong came over after a short time of leisure, Nian Yanger in front of Su Anying.
Because of the previous quarrel in the Wu family, both Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong were very dissatisfied with Wu Qiuyan who was about to get married.
Seeing her husband's family organize banquets like this again, the sister-in-law and sister-in-law are even more unhappy.
The two of them came to look for Su Anying, just to provoke Su Anying's dissatisfaction, and when the time came, the three sisters-in-law would run on the new daughter-in-law together.
"Sister-in-law, sister-in-law, the time is different, and the wedding banquet is naturally different.
I got married in the summer, and our pigs haven't been raised yet, so how could I be willing to kill them?
Isn't this just in time for the year? Those who even hold a banquet to bring the New Year, of course, have to kill pigs. "
Su Anying has a good temper, and she doesn't have that much thoughtfulness, so she doesn't take what the two sister-in-laws said to her heart.
Whether or not to hold a banquet for the wedding, and what kind of banquet to hold, are all decided by the in-laws.
If the conditions are good, we will do better, and if the conditions are poor, everyone can understand it. There is nothing to choose.
Su Anying was not good when she got married. In summer, she couldn't keep anything, and there was nowhere to buy meat.
Zhou Guilan took a lot of effort, went to Tonghua and Hunjiang several times, and then asked someone to buy the canned food.
Besides, at that time, there were fine scale fish at the banquet, and they were all caught by Xu Shiyan.
Each table has a large and thin scale that weighs three catties. Who would not say that the noodles are hard enough?
So it's not bad, it's just not as lively as it is now.
Su Anying is a big-hearted person, and never cares about these things. As long as Xu Shiyan treats her well, the young couple will live with Meimei, so why compare them?
If life at home is always compared like this, is there still a time to stop?
Su Anying grew up in a different environment, which also cultivated her character of being generous and forbearing, not fighting or grabbing.
So she really doesn't care about these things.
"Besides, the fourth child is a teacher, the only one in our family who has a formal job.
He got married, so it should be easier for him to handle it. Can't make people laugh. "
Su Anying wasn't angry at all, but was always thinking of her husband's family.
When Xue Xiuling and Wei Mingrong heard this, their noses almost turned out of breath.
"Let's go, let's stop talking to her, this is a fool, you are talking to her for nothing.
That's it, when the third child sells her one day, she will have to help count the money. "
Xue Xiulin dragged Wei Mingrong up and left angrily, muttering as she walked.
Su Anying is not deaf, how can she not hear what the two sister-in-laws are saying? Immediately smiled and shook his head, and continued to lower his head to chop the onions.
In the courtyard of Xu's house, it was still bustling with activity, and there were several cauldrons inside and outside the house that were steaming.
The aroma of the stew filled the small courtyard, and all the people in it were smiling.
There is a saying that it is better to marry a daughter-in-law than to be poor and to be rich.
No matter what year, no matter what dynasty or generation, getting married and marrying a daughter-in-law is a big event and something to be happy about.
Xu's family has a happy event, and relatives and friends from far away have to come early.
In the afternoon, Zhou Guilan's natal brother, sister-in-law, and Su Weizhong came over together.
Zhou Guilan hasn't seen her natal family for a long time, so the meeting is naturally very affectionate.
Not to mention Su Anying, she was full of joy when she saw her father coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: house news
chapters.content:
Chapter 97 News of the house
The twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, the exact day when Xu Shide got married.
Wake up early in the morning, the courtyard of Xu's family is extremely lively, there is an endless stream of helpers and congratulators coming in and out.
From Dongjiangyan to Qingling Balidi, the road is not too far.
At eight o'clock in the morning, four horse-mounted sledges were stopped at the gate of Xu's house, which were borrowed after discussing with the brigade in advance.
Groom officer Xu Shide, uncle Zhou Anping, aunt Li Shi, younger brother Xu Shixiang, cousin Zhou Wanxing, younger sister Xu Shiqin, and cousin Zhou Lirong.
Accompanied by matchmakers Jianshe Niang, Chun Mingniang, and a few young men from the village, they drove the horse sledge all the way to Qingling.
When the relatives went out, the Xu family hurriedly set up a banquet for noon, and congratulatory guests also came to the door one after another.
Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong's natal family also arrived at this time, and it was naturally a joy to meet their relatives.
Even Zhou Changhe, who lives in Donggang, came here with his son Zhou Qingguo and generous gifts.
"Second aunt, second uncle, congratulations."
Zhou Changhe met Xu Chenghou and his wife, and came forward to congratulate him with a smile.
"Yo, Changhe, how do you know Xin'er?" The arrival of Zhou Changhe and his father surprised Zhou Guilan.
It is necessary to know that the two families have no real relationship, they are just fellow villagers, and it is not too close to have contacts on weekdays.
When the eldest brother Xu Shixian got married, Zhou Changhe came, and when Zhou Changhe's father passed away, Xu Chenghou went to offer his condolences.
Later, when Xu Shian and Xu Shiyan got married, there was no notice.
The main reason is that the Xu family has too many sons, so it is not good to be notified every time. It is not easy for any family these days, how can they come back to catch up?
"Well, I heard someone say it a few days ago.
Second Aunt, you are too alienated. The younger brothers in the family don’t even send me a letter when they get married. "
Zhou Changhe said with a smile, while beckoning his son to come forward.
"Second Aunt, this is the Qing Kingdom, do you still recognize it?"
Zhou Qingguo came forward and saluted wholeheartedly, "Hello, Second Young Master, Second Auntie, I am Qing Guo."
"Hey, is this the Qing Dynasty who has changed jobs and returned?
Let the second aunt see that she is stronger than before she went to the army. Look at this appearance, she really has the air of a strong man who defends the country, okay, okay. "
Zhou Guilan has met Zhou Qingguo a few times, and she still recognizes him. Zhou Guilan is also happy to see the junior so promising.
"By the way, do you have work arrangements when you come back?"
"Second Auntie, I have a job arrangement. I am in Donggang Commune, the militia company commander and security assistant." Zhou Qingguo answered honestly.
"Okay, okay, very good, let's go, let's go inside and chat."
Xu Chenghou and his wife were very happy. They led Zhou Zhang and his father and son into the house, looking for a place to sit and chat.
The Xu family has handed over many people over the years, and there are many people who come to congratulate him, and they can't always chat with Zhou Zhang and his father and son.
Fortunately, Zhou Zhanghe and Zhou Anping are also familiar with each other, and everyone gathered together to chat and laugh very lively.
Zhou Qingguo is a young man, he has nothing to talk to the older ones, so he goes outside to see where there is help.
It turned out that Xu Shiyan was walking out with a table under his left arm and a few stools in his right hand.
"Third Uncle, what are you doing?" Zhou Qingguo hurried forward, took the stool, and asked casually.
Xu Shiyan turned his head and saw Zhou Qingguo, "Oh, Qingguo is here?
I moved a few tables to the neighbor’s house in the West Courtyard. The house is too small to hold banquets, so I borrowed the space from Jin Hai’s house in the West Courtyard. "
The Xu family has a total of three rooms. Even if the east and west rooms are all composed of north and south kangs, there will not be too many tables.
So I negotiated with the neighbor's house in advance, and borrowed the place of the neighbor's house to hold a banquet.
The person who went out to borrow tables and chairs just now didn’t understand that there were fewer tables at the end of Jin Hai’s house, but more tables at this side. So we have to move tables and benches over there.
"Oh, that's the case, then I'll be with you."
Zhou Qingguo followed Xu Shiyan to the neighbor's house to the west.
"By the way, third uncle, my mother found the house you were looking for for you."
Walking on the road, Zhou Qingguo suddenly remembered this, and hurriedly told Xu Shiyan.
"Just to the east of the martyrs' tomb, next to the woods, there are three adobe houses.
There is quite a large open space next to it, there is a small hill in the back, and there is a large **** to the east. "
"That family, there used to be an old couple with a daughter, but later the old couple disappeared, and the daughter married an educated youth who came to the countryside.
The couple have a very good relationship and have three children.
Isn’t this the resumption of the college entrance examination? The educated youth was admitted to a university in our provincial capital, which happened to be his family.
So they want to sell the house and go back to the provincial capital with their wife and children. "
As the two walked, Zhou Qingguo told Xu Shiyan about the house.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan lived in Donggang for so many years, so he knew which house it was from as soon as he heard it.
When Xu Shiyan moved to Donggang in 1987, he lived in the house in front of the martyrs' tomb, not far away.
I also heard others mention the matter of the house in the back.
It is said that the woman sold the house and happily returned to the provincial capital with the man, but was rejected by her husband's family.
Fortunately, the man is not bad, he is good to his wife and children, and the woman is also capable, so he found a temporary worker in the university cafeteria.
The couple rented a house and lived outside. A few years later, the man graduated and went to work in the hospital, and the woman set up a stall to start a small business.
The house is indeed as Zhou Qinguo said, the surrounding area is quite large, and there are several more houses to be built in the west.
"That's good, how much does his family cost?"
Although the place is big, it is not in the center of the town, it is close to the woods, it is already on the edge, and it is an adobe house, so the price is probably not too high.
"The asking price is four hundred and five. My mother said that if I talk about one piece, I can get it for about four hundred."
The price mentioned by Zhou Qingguo was similar to what Xu Shiyan estimated, Xu Shiyan nodded.
"Okay, you go back and tell my second sister-in-law, let her talk about it for me.
Years later, I will go there, and if it is ok, I will make a decision directly. "
More than 400 yuan, it is very cost-effective to buy three rooms with a large open space around it.
Live in the adobe house for the time being, and then build five large tile-roofed houses on the west side. After a few years, the adobe house will be rebuilt.
At that time, there will be eight big houses in a row, and the living space will be spacious, and a few goods houses can be left, how good?
In his previous life, Xu Shixian followed Xue Xiulin back to the city, settled in Donggang Commune, and then built a house in front of the martyr's tomb.
By the time Xu Shiyan moved in 1987, Donggang had already been converted into a town with a large population, and the homestead was not easy to approve.
It happened that there was an open space to the west of Xu Shixian's house. Xu Shiyan gave his brother some money to buy the land and build four houses.
It is precisely because of this incident that I left a word.
Xue Xiulin later said that Xu Shiyan had taken over his house.
He also said that Xu Shiyan moved out of the big house because he had a good time with their family, and that Xu Shiyan didn't know how to be grateful.
This time Xu Shiyan moved away first, bought a piece of land and built a house by himself, and his household registration is not with his parents. I don’t believe they will talk about it in the future?

chapters.title: Chapter 98: wedding
chapters.content:
Chapter 98 Happy Events
Outside the gate of Xu’s house, a string of firecrackers was picked up with a long wooden pole.
Several teenage boys in the village waited anxiously with matches in their hands. They lit firecrackers only when the sledges that welcomed the bride came back.
Before ten thirty, there was a commotion in the distance, and a child rushed over and shouted.
"Come back, come back, the bride is back."
The boys who were waiting to set off firecrackers at the door cheered up immediately, and stretched their heads to look westward.
Sure enough, I saw the horse sledge coming from not far away, and a person in a red padded jacket sat on the first sledge, no need to guess, it must be the bride.
"Quick, get ready, let me tell you something, and you all light firecrackers."
Someone greeted, and the other waited with a match in his hand.
When the sledge came to the front of Xu's house, and before the newcomer's feet landed, the sound of crackling firecrackers sounded here.
Xu Shide supported his daughter-in-law Wu Qiuyan and got off the sledge. Amidst the flying firecracker debris and the pungent smell of gunpowder, a new couple entered the gate of Xu's house.
Zhou Guilan stepped forward and took the cornucopia from her daughter-in-law.
Here Wu Qiuyan picked up the red flower from the pot, pinned it in her mother-in-law's hair, and called out affectionately, "Mom."
Zhou Guilan was so happy that she couldn't close her mouth from ear to ear, she repeatedly agreed, "Hey, hey."
While agreeing, he took out a red envelope from his pocket and gave it to his new wife.
The wedding ceremony in this year and month is very simple. The newlyweds enter the house and have a blessing. At eleven o'clock, they come out of the house and go to the courtyard.
Zhao Dahai was the officiant, and after speaking a few words, the young couple saluted and thanked the guests, the officiant and the matchmaker, and then saluted to thank their parents for their kindness.
If it was put aside a few years ago, it should have bowed to the portrait of the leader, but now this item can only be omitted.
The warm and simple wedding ceremony ended quickly, and the bride was sent back to the east room to rest, and then the feast began.
Nowadays, the life of each family is not rich, so the whole family does not come to eat at the wedding banquet.
Most of them are the head of the family who comes to have a wedding wine with the ceremony, plus a group of helpers.
There are a total of one hundred families in the big house, and some who have a bad relationship with the Xu family did not come.
So including relatives, friends and natal guests, a total of fourteen tables were set up.
There are six tables on the side of the Xu family, and eight tables on the side of the two neighbors.
Bracken pork, braised venison, braised bear's paw, Sixi meatballs, sauerkraut white meat blood sausage, soft fried meat, fried meat with fungus and carrots, shredded cabbage, mung bean sprouts and shredded carrots.
There is also a pot of rhubarb rice next to each table, and the hot aroma is tangy.
There are eight dishes in total, seven of which have meat, and only one cold dish.
In this scene, who can't say a word hard enough after seeing it?
As far as the moment is concerned, there is really no one who can produce these dishes.
When the dishes went up, everyone was amazed, and they couldn't help but boast that it must be the old Xu's family.
Look at how people live these days, take a look around the whole village, who can compare with it?
The dishes are served and the wine is full, so what else is there to say? Just eat it.
It is rare to see oily water on weekdays. This is all meat and vegetables, why don’t you open your belly to eat?
So one by one, they shook off their cheeks and started to build.
The family members of the Wu family who send off their relatives are all arranged on the kang in the east room, exactly two tables.
For the two tables of guests from my natal family, the food and drink are more abundant. In addition to the eight dishes outside, there are candied sweet potatoes and a platter of sauced meat.
The Xu family arranged for Xu Shiyan's two uncles and Zhao Dahai to accompany the guests, giving the Wu family enough face.
With such a high standard of entertainment, it is too late for the Wu family to bow their heads to eat and drink. Who would care to find fault? Naturally, the host and guest enjoy themselves and the atmosphere is harmonious.
After the banquet, the newcomers had to toast, but the young people in the village made trouble and insisted on letting Xu Shide drink.
The yelling made Xu Shide drunk, and he couldn't climb the kang at night.
The Xu family had already made preparations. Xu Shixiang, Zhou Wanxing, Zhou Wancheng and other young people all came to help hold the wine.
In the end, these few were all drunk with a lot of alcohol, and they found a place to rest red-faced and dizzy.
Of course, the drinkers were not much better. They drank all over, and some of them slipped under the table.
It was less than 12:30, the people who saw off relatives from the Wu family had enough to eat and drink, got up to take their leave and left.
The Xu family found a few young men, drove the horses and sledges, and sent them back.
As for the other guests, they had almost eaten, so they left one after another.
After the guests had left, the helping daughters-in-law hurriedly cleaned up the dishes.
Nowadays, people's stomachs are empty, let alone eight dishes, and there will be nothing left with eight more dishes.
Almost every table was clean, and even the vegetable soup on the plate was eaten with rice, and there was nothing left.
Now, washing the dishes is easy, just put it in the pot and scald it with hot water, rub some baking soda at most, then rinse it with clean water, and it will be clean.
All kinds of utensils such as bowls and plates are borrowed from each house. After washing, they are classified according to the marks, compared according to the list, and they have to be sent back to others.
Of course, there is no one who borrows household items for weddings and sends them back empty-handed. They have to pack some melon seeds and candies.
A group of helpers, Zhou Guilan also wrapped some melon seeds candies, or leftovers, as a token of gratitude.
By the time everything was done and the guests were gone, it was already three or four o'clock in the afternoon.
Because the Chinese New Year was approaching, every family was busy, and the relatives from Daying and Songjianghe did not stay behind. After the banquet, they chatted for a while, and then they all said their goodbyes and left.
The Xu family has been busy all day, and at this time they can finally sit down and rest for a while.
"Finally calmed down for a while, I was so busy this day that my feet hit the back of my head, and my whole body hurts."
Zhou Guilan was so busy that day that she felt dizzy and dizzy. After finally sitting down to rest, she felt as if her whole body was about to fall apart.
"Otherwise people say that marrying a daughter-in-law is not a lie, it's really tiring.
Fortunately, four of the five sons in our family have married daughters-in-law. The fifth is not in a hurry. It will take two years, so we can take it easy. "
Xu Chenghou was too busy to sit down and smoke a pipe.
"Okay, let's all go back to the house and rest for a while. The dinner is simple. Isn't there some leftovers? Just heat it up and eat it."
Zhou Guilan saw that the sons and daughters-in-law all looked tired, and simply waved their hands, telling them to go back to rest.
"Mom, then I'll go back first, and I won't come over for dinner if I don't have anything to do at night. Yingzi and I can just eat at home."
Xu Shiyan is thinking about his daughter-in-law at home, so how can he be in the mood to delay here? Tell your parents and leave.
"Third brother, wait a moment, I'll bring you some food back home, and in the evening, you two can just leave the house and heat it up for yourself."
As soon as Zhou Guilan heard that her son was going to leave, she hurriedly put on her shoes and went to the ground again, and packed a plate of vegetables for Xu Shiyan.
"Yingzi didn't come to eat today, so bring her some delicious food back."
According to the rules in the country, it is not good for pregnant women to attend other people's weddings, and it is easy to get red.
Although I always yelled about breaking the four olds before, some old rules still have to be followed.
After all, there are many people and events on the day of the wedding. If you don’t pay attention to bumping into something, it is too dangerous.
The five chapters are updated today, and there will be no special circumstances in the future, and they will be updated in the morning.

chapters.title: Chapter 99: new year
chapters.content:
Chapter 99 Chinese New Year
Xu Shiyan went home with a pot of vegetables to accompany his daughter-in-law, and didn't go back to Xu's house in the evening.
Most of the noisy young people in the village were drunk at noon, went home to sleep with their heads covered, and didn't get up at night.
Only a few people came over at night, with Zhou Guilan watching, these people were not ashamed to make trouble in the bridal chamber, they just sat for a while and left.
After two days of turmoil, it was finally peaceful and quiet. Everyone breathed a sigh of relief and got a good night's sleep.
This year is the twenty-ninth New Year's Eve of the twelfth lunar month. After the wedding, the Chinese New Year will follow.
Fortunately, the Xu family has nothing to do, just wait for the New Year in peace.
Because it was said in advance that the family will be separated after the year, so Xu Chenghou said that Xu Shiyan and his wife must come back on New Year's Eve this year.
In this way, Xu Shiyan and his wife have nothing to do, they just tidy up the house and prepare some food.
In the twinkling of an eye, it was the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth lunar month. At nine o'clock in the morning, Xu Shiyan brought his daughter-in-law home to help the house.
The brothers erected a lantern pole in the yard, and hung up red lanterns made by Xu Shiqin.
Then the red paper was cut, and Xu Shide wrote couplets, blessing characters, spring strips, etc. with a large brush.
Gate, door, barn, pigsty, chicken coop, all posted.
The barn is full of grain and grain, the pigsty is full of fat pigs, and the chicken coop is full of golden roosters.
After posting this circle, the flavor of the New Year is stronger. With the window grilles with the Chinese character "Happy" posted before, the courtyard is full of red and festive.
Busy posting couplets outside, and cooking inside the house. According to the Xu family's rules, there are three meals on New Year's Eve.
Eat casually in the morning, have a reunion dinner around four in the afternoon, and make dumplings at night to keep the year old.
There are four daughters-in-law in the family, Su Anying is almost seven months pregnant, and Wu Qiuyan is more than three months pregnant.
These two pregnant women can't do too much work, they can only help with washing vegetables and grilling onions and garlic. The main thing is that Zhou Guilan leads Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong to work.
The reunion dinner on New Year's Eve is the only one meal throughout the year, and that is a big deal.
Therefore, Zhou Guilan had to cook the stove herself, and also had to cook some dishes that she couldn't eat on weekdays.
For example, the Xu family's traditional dishes, confused chicken and bergamot cabbage, are must-haves every year.
Stupid chicken, in fact, the chicken is chopped into pieces, marinated with seasoning, then wrapped in batter and deep-fried.
If a chicken does this, it can be fried in a pot, and then stewed with soup to eat.
No one can see which piece of meat is in the batter, so it is called confused chicken.
In fact, this is the solution that I had to come up with during the difficult years.
There is not much to stew a chicken directly, but it can make a big pot and eat it.
Bergamot cabbage is simple, blanched with boiling water and sliced ​​into thin slices.
Draw a few strokes along the veins of the leaves, wrap the inside with meat filling, and steam in a pan.
In this way, the cabbage absorbs the umami taste of the meat filling, and relieves the greasy meat, making it fragrant and sweet in the mouth.
In addition to these two traditional dishes, there are also stewed potatoes with rabbit meat, stewed sauerkraut with big bones, stir-fried roe deer meat, fried meatballs with mushrooms and dried fruits, jelly skin, pig's trotters, stewed fish with thin scales in clear water, sweet and sour pork ribs, exactly ten dishes, Perfect in every way.
The rabbit meat and roe deer meat were naturally brought back by Xu Shiyan before, and he also went to the big river to smash the ice hole to catch the fine scale fish.
There is a piece of fish in the reunion dinner, which means more than every year, which has a good meaning.
"Thankfully, we didn't eat all the meat brought back by the third child, and we just saved it for Chinese New Year.
These ten dishes this year are all hard dishes, let the children openly eat them, and eat whatever they want. "
Zhou Guilan had set the menu early on, and while busy frying chicken, she was chatting with Xue Xiulin and the others.
Xue Xiulin was cutting sauerkraut over there. Hearing her mother-in-law praising her uncle, she stopped cutting vegetables.
In the past, this third uncle was the least present in the family. He was silent and inconspicuous on weekdays.
But now, the three uncles are the ones that the parents-in-law talk about the most.
Before, why didn't I think that the third uncle was so capable?
"Mom, if you don't tell me, I forgot to ask, who did the third child learn to hunt from? No one in our family knows how to do this, no one taught him, how did he know it?"
Xue Xiulin was puzzled, as if her brother-in-law had changed since she got married.
Zhou Guilan also stopped frying chicken, "Yeah, I really forgot to ask, who did the third child learn this skill from?
In the past, I only saw him catching fish and catching shrimps. I wonder if he can also hunt? I really have to ask him when I have time. "
Having said that, Zhou Guilan also became curious, yes, no one in the Xu family knows this, who did the third child learn from?
The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law talked and chatted while cooking, frying and frying in the kitchen.
Until after three o'clock in the afternoon, all kinds of dishes were prepared and served on the table one after another.
There are a lot of people in the family, and there are still two tables in the southern kang and the northern kang. Xu Chenghou and his wife brought their sons, and the two new daughters-in-law who entered the house this year had dinner at the southern kang.
Xue Xiulin, Wei Mingrong, Xu Shiqin and a group of children are in Beikang. Both tables have the same dishes, eat whatever you want.
Xu Shiyan looked at the table and saw that it was all meat and vegetables, so he hurriedly asked his mother.
"Mom, I remember that last time I brought back some sorbet dumplings, grape cakes, and Shanli red skin, right?
Where did you put it? Find it out, soak it in water, put it in a pot and steam it for a while.
This dish is good, but if it is eaten in this way, I am afraid that the children will have indigestion. "
If these dishes are used in normal days, they will be made the same for a meal, mixed with other dishes, and it will be fine.
But all of them are placed on the table at once, for fear that the children will eat too much and easily suffer from indigestion.
In case of diarrhea tomorrow morning, it will be bad.
Shanlihong is wild hawthorn, which has the effect of invigorating the spleen and stomach and promoting digestion. The grape cake is sweet and sour, appetizing and relieving greasy.
Put them in a pot and add water to steam them, just like drinking fruit juice, which is good for children.
"Oh, look at me, I forgot about this stubble.
Just thinking about how rare it is to have so many delicious foods, let the children open up to eat, forgetting that their spleen and stomach are weak. "
Zhou Guilan was reminded by her son and suddenly realized.
Isn't it? Even if the family has not run out of oil and water this winter, the stomach is still empty after all.
Eating like this, adults may just give in, how can children stand it?
So, Zhou Guilan hurriedly went to the ground, and found out from the cabinet what Xu Shiyan had brought back earlier.
Grab some pear tuozi, mountain grape cake, Shanli Hongpier, etc. and put them in a basin, wash them twice with clean water, then add clean water and put them in a pot to steam.
Xu Chenghou watched his wife busy, and suddenly remembered the situation in his hometown in Kuandian.
"Well, when I was young, our family still had silver mines, and my grandma made these in autumn.
It’s the same during Chinese New Year. Steam it in a pot, it’s sweet and sour, and it tastes great. "
"The conditions of our family were good at that time. We had dozens of acres of land and a rather large orchard, which contained all kinds of peaches, sand fruits, and pears.
There are a lot of pear trees in our house, and there are all kinds of pear trees, such as sharp sour, flat-topped pear, flower cover pear, and frozen pear. "
Xu Chenghou seemed to have flipped some switch and talked about things in his hometown.

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Curious baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 100 Curious baby
"What are you talking about about those old sesame seeds and rotten millet?
What are you showing off? It's as if those things didn't fall out of your hands.
You haven't drunk yet, are you drunk? "Zhou Guilan rolled her eyes disapprovingly when she heard her husband's words.
"If you really want to talk about the **** things in your family, you can't finish it for three days and three nights. You, shut up."
Xu's family was in Shijiagou, Yinkuangzi, and it can be counted as a well-known family.
Dozens of acres of land, a large orchard, and a mountain at home. The family also runs a flour mill and raises large animals.
Can’t be considered a big landlord, but a small landlord is definitely enough.
Xu Chenghou has no brothers, only a younger sister, and everything in the family belongs to him.
The atmosphere at the silver mine is not good. When the men are free in winter, they either drink for money or smoke.
When Xu Chenghou was young, he didn't smoke, but he was extremely obsessed with money.
I often go out to play money, and I go there for ten and a half months. I lose all my money before I come back.
Gradually, the family property cost him a lot.
Xu Chenghou's first daughter-in-law was surnamed Jiang. Women in the old society had a hard time living, especially the new daughter-in-law, who suffered from difficulties everywhere in her husband's family.
Xu Chenghou's parents are all old feudal antiques, and the most common sentence they say is "the daughter-in-law who hit him kneads the noodles."
A disobedient daughter-in-law deserves a beating, no matter what the daughter-in-law does right or wrong, it is a beating anyway.
The daughter of the Jiang family married to the Xu family for two years, and was tortured to death in a daze.
The other side of the Jiang family sued the officials, and the Xu family spent a lot of money to settle the lawsuit, and it has completely declined since then.
Later, Xu Chenghou spent a lot of money to marry Zhou Guilan into the family. It may be because of the example of the previous daughter-in-law, but the Xu family did not dare to fight to the death.
Even so, Zhou Guilan suffered a lot during the few years when she first married.
Until Xu Shixian was born, it finally got better.
In 1948, Xu Chenghou's parents died, and Xu's family fell into disrepair. Even so, the middle peasants were settled.
Combined with the fact that Xu Chenghou has always been out of tune, he has become the target of the main attack, and he is very excluded from the silver mine.
At the suggestion of Zhou Guilan's mother, she moved to Fusong to settle down.
Not long after the Xu family moved here, the commune was established.
Driven by the commune and the production team, and separated from the environment of the silver mine, Xu Chenghou slowly improved, and gradually became famous in Daying Commune.
Unfortunately, because Xu Shixian acted as a monster, the Xu family was severely suppressed.
Finally, I had no choice, so I moved to the big house, a remote place in the countryside.
Zhou Guilan doesn't like to bring up things about her hometown the most. Whenever she mentions it, she thinks of how her mother-in-law tortured her back then. Those days are like nightmares now.
"Fortunately, our family has moved out. If we still stay in our hometown, can we live like this?
You have already been ruined, and the children may starve to death.
What are you talking about? Free time for you. In the future, don't mention your mother in front of me, I don't like to hear it. "
Zhou Guilan has been married to Xu's family for more than 30 years. From a submissive little daughter-in-law at the beginning, to now an uncompromising head of the family, it perfectly confirms the saying that a daughter-in-law has become a mother-in-law for many years.
"Okay, today is Chinese New Year, let's not mention those boring things, just sit down and eat with chopsticks."
Zhou Guilan sorted out her mood, not thinking about the bad things in the past, but greeted the children to eat with a smile.
"Come on, Yingzi, eat a piece of fish and ribs."
Zhou Guilan was afraid that Su Anying would be stupid and that she would be too hard to eat, so she picked up some dishes that were far away and put them in Su Anying's bowl.
"Little Yan'er, if you can't reach the other end, let the fourth child pinch it for you.
My family members don’t need to be outsiders, they can eat whatever they want. "
I have been trained by my mother-in-law and know how difficult it is to be a daughter-in-law, so Zhou Guilan never makes things difficult for her daughter-in-law, and treats her daughter-in-law very well.
In her own words, it is the hardship I have suffered, and I cannot let my daughter-in-law suffer again.
A table of good food, it's too late to eat, who cares about talking?
Anyway, those children in Beikang couldn't wait to stuff their mouths with meat, and they were all eager to eat.
At Nankang, Xu Chenghou didn't get angry after being teased by his wife. He just smiled and asked his son to pour wine, and led his five sons to drink happily.
The whole year is busy, and only during the New Year can we relax.
Xu Chenghou no longer put on the airs of being a father, and chatted with his sons while eating and drinking, very amiable.
The children on the other side of the North Kang are still young after all, and their stomach capacity is limited. After eating for a while, they felt that their stomachs were full, and they began to think about it.
I happened to see the table at Nankang, grandpa, dad, uncle, and uncles didn't know what to drink.
Looking at the happy look of grandpa, he took a sip of the contents of the cup, narrowed his eyes, and had an expression of enjoyment on his face.
Xu Haibo rolled his eyes, put down his chopsticks, got off the ground, and ran to Grandpa Nankang.
"Master, what are you drinking? Why does it look delicious? Give me a sip too?"
Children are curious, so they think that there must be something delicious in grandpa's cup, and they must be greedy.
"You bastard, that's wine, it's spicy, you're hungry for anything?"
When Xu Shian heard this, his face immediately darkened, and he scolded his son.
Xu Haibo was a little afraid of his father, but he was still thinking about what was in his grandfather's wine glass, so he hid in his arms.
"Master, what is wine? Is it delicious? Give me a taste?"
The little guy looked up at his grandfather eagerly.
Although Xu Chenghou is very strict with his sons, he likes his grandson very much, and he is very fond of children.
As soon as he heard that the eldest grandson wanted to taste the wine, the old man dipped his chopsticks into the wine glass and brought it to Xu Haibo's mouth.
"Try it, isn't it spicy?"
A child, how can he stand the taste of wine?
Even though there was only one drop, the bitter and spicy taste made Xu Haibo's face wrinkle quickly.
With a "wow", the child cried. "What is this? It's spicy and bitter."
Originally, she was just a little crying bag, and she cried for a while when she had nothing to do, let alone this time.
Xu Shian's face turned black with anger, "I told you it's not good, you have to taste it, and you cried after you tasted it.
Go and find your mother, don't be annoying here. "
Men, few have the patience to coax their children, especially when faced with a crying child, it can definitely break people down.
The child cried, and Wei Mingrong sat there and continued to eat, as if nothing happened.
Anyway, the crying bag in her family cried all day long, the more she coaxed her, the more she cried, and it stopped after a while.
But Zhou Guilan couldn't stand her grandson crying so much, so she hurried down to the ground, filled a bowl of water in the pot and came back.
"Xiao Bo, come here, what's the matter with grandma? Your grandpa's is not good, but the water in grandma's hand is delicious. Come and taste it."
The steamed water of Lituozi should be light red, because it is mixed with grape cake and Shanlihongpier, so the color is much darker.
The purple soup is really a bit of juice.
Children are easily attracted by novelty.
Xu Haibo saw the juice in grandma's hand, and saw that the color was very bright, so he immediately fell in love with it, so he took a sip.
Well, this tastes good, much better than that wine.

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Say goodbye to the old and welcome the new
chapters.content:
Chapter 101 Saying goodbye to the old and welcoming the new
Xu Haibo just went to eat meat, Xu's family eats a lot of food, and he didn't drink water, he was thirsty.
There happens to be this sweet and sour fruit juice, why don’t you hold a bowl and drink enough?
A bowl of soup was swallowed by him just like that.
"Milk, this is delicious, much better than the one in my grandfather's cup, sweet and sour."
Children have a simple mind, whether it is good or not, the taste can be directly judged.
When Xu Haibo shouted, Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu on the other side also cheered up and ran over to surround Zhou Guilan.
"Milk, we want to drink anything good."
It was originally used to coax the children, and now the children want to drink, so why not hurry?
Zhou Guilan simply took out a stack of bowls, filled a bowl for each baby, and also filled some for Su Anying and Wu Qiuyan.
"Try it, both of you, it's delicious." Pregnant women can get special treatment.
"If you want to drink, do it yourself. There is still in the pot. After filling, add some water and continue steaming. You can steam it twice."
Zhou Guilan looked back at Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong. They were all married for several years. Her mother-in-law didn't need to do these things, she could eat whatever she wanted.
Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong were not polite, they went down to the ground to get bowls, and each filled some drinks.
Not to mention, this sweet and sour taste is really suitable for women's taste, and it is quite delicious.
"Third brother, you've been quiet for a whole day, but you're really good at thinking, and you can poke out everything."
Wei Mingrong finished the juice in two gulps, and couldn't help but compliment Xu Shiyan.
It's just that when she said this, she didn't know whether it was a compliment or an insult.
Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard the words, but didn't say anything. He did this to coax his wife, and it was purely for the family.
Of course, this cannot be said, let them think whatever they want.
This is just right, the women and children drink fruit juice, the men drink alcohol, and the reunion dinner is delicious.
Until after five o’clock, I was full and there were a lot of dishes left on the table.
The man drank too much, or slept or chatted together, while the woman was busy cleaning up.
Water was boiled in the big pot in the kitchen, and the two kangs in the West House were very hot. A large basin was placed in the middle of the floor, and hot water was poured.
Sister-in-law Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong put the children in the water one by one and scrubbed them.
After the children finished washing, the door was locked, and the women also took their own baths.
For Chinese New Year, remove the old clothes and clothe them with new ones. Only after washing can you change into new clothes for the New Year.
After finishing all these tasks, it was getting late, so I called the man up, and washed what should be washed, and then began to chop meat and vegetables, and bread dumplings.
In Xu’s family, Chinese New Year dumplings must be stuffed with cabbage and radish.
Cabbage is a homonym for Baicai, and radish is also called Laifu, both of which have excellent meanings.
After everything was ready, panels were placed on the south kang in the east house, and the women either sat on the kang or took a stool and started making dumplings.
It is cold in the Northeast, and there must be a kang at home, so I have developed a habit, and I am happy to do a lot of work on the kang.
The old lady in Northeast China is even more unique, sitting cross-legged.
Of course Zhou Guilan would, too. I saw her sitting cross-legged on one side of the panel, kneading the dough with her hands.
After a while, knead the dough into long strips, and then use your hands to shape them into evenly sized doses, and place the doses neatly in rows.
Speaking of it, grabbing the medicine with your hands is definitely not as fast as cutting it with a knife.
But in this year and month, eating dumplings is not only a meal, but more of a meaning, and there must be a sense of ritual.
Anyway, at Zhou Guilan's place, the dumplings must be pulled by hand. This is a rule and should not be broken.
A piece of noodles is quickly pulled into four neat rows of pills. At this time, grab a handful of thin noodles and sprinkle them on, and flatten the pills with your hands.
The girls and daughters-in-law at the other end can take it, use a rolling pin to roll it into dumpling wrappers, wrap them with stuffing, and place them neatly on the curtain.
It must be unpleasant to make dumplings like this. Fortunately, the family has a lot of staff, otherwise, I am afraid that I will not be able to eat dumplings until midnight.
There are many families in Xu family, and many dumplings are made. The dumplings are made from 8:00 to 11:00.
It happened that Xu Shixiang and the others also fried melon seeds, pine nuts, hazelnuts, etc., so they boiled the dumplings.
After the dumplings were put into the pot, Xu Chenghou led his children and grandchildren to light firecrackers outside.
Among the sound of firecrackers, the children clap their hands, laugh and make noise, amidst the crackling sound, the new year comes amidst the laughter.
Firecrackers sounded outside one after another, and Xu Chenghou also coaxed his grandchildren to light up a few firecrackers and coaxed the children to play.
It didn't stop until the room shouted to eat dumplings.
"Let's go, go back to the house and eat dumplings. After eating the dumplings, kowtow to grandpa. Grandpa has red envelopes for you." Xu Chenghou coaxed his grandchildren into the house who hadn't had enough fun yet.
The little babies have been outside for a long time, and their faces are flushed from the cold.
Even so, they didn't feel cold, they were all very happy.
Well, it’s the children who celebrate the New Year, and the year belongs to them. Only these carefree children are the happiest.
The meal at five o'clock in the afternoon, it's midnight, and I'm hungry, and there are delicious dumplings. Who wouldn't be greedy?
What's more, Zhou Guilan also said that the dumplings are filled with money, sugar, peanuts, and dates.
This time, the children all stared, they must eat money.
Xu Shiyan didn't have that kind of thought, he just picked up a dumpling nearby and put it in his mouth.
As a result, he bit down and gritted his teeth. He looked down, okay, it's a two-cent coin.
"Okay, okay, it seems that the third child can make a fortune this year, okay."
The dumplings are wrapped with candy and money, which is originally for flattery and auspicious meaning.
So as soon as Xu Shiyan paid out the money, Zhou Guilan smiled and said a few good words in succession.
Others followed suit and said auspicious words, and then they all ate, wanting to eat something.
Xu Shixiang took a bite of the dumpling, feeling something was wrong, it creaked, and saw that there was a peanut in it.
"I'm not eating money, I'm eating peanuts." Regardless of what I'm eating, it's all good anyway, Xu Shixiang is very happy.
"Then you will definitely be able to enter the university today. Peanut, you are entering a higher education." Xu Shiyan answered over there.
This peanut, which means step by step, is auspicious in itself.
Xu Shiyan's explanation in this way is not wrong, on the contrary, it is more satisfactory.
Xu Shixiang became happy when he heard it, "Thank you, third brother. With the good words of third brother, I will try again this year."
Last year, he was not reconciled to failing the rankings. Xu Shixiang made up his mind to review and take the exam again, but he didn't dare to say it clearly, so he doesn't care about that now.
Years ago, he also saved some money from hunting and bought some books. This year he has to fight to the death and must be admitted to university.
Xu Chenghou didn't say anything when he heard what the fifth son said.
Now he also understands some things. When his son grows up, he has his own opinions, and it is impossible for others to listen to him.
He's an old guy, his mind can't keep up, so don't worry about it so much, just do whatever you want.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: look at the house
chapters.content:
Chapter 102 Looking at the house
In the hearts of most rural people, eating dumplings on New Year’s Eve is the beginning of a new year.
The significance of New Year's Eve is far greater than that of the Gregorian calendar year. It should be said that the Gregorian calendar year is simply incomparable.
After eating the dumplings, when the twelve o'clock bell rang, Xu Shi took the lead and led the crowd to pay New Year's greetings to the two elders.
Xu Haibo waited for the little baby to get even worse, and knelt down and kowtowed. Xu Haibo was young, but he also followed suit.
Everything that children do is interesting, and it makes everyone laugh.
Xu Chenghou quickly took out a few red envelopes from his pocket and distributed them to the children.
There is not much money in it, two cents per person, for the Chinese New Year, it is a waist for the child.
Zhou Guilan also took out two red envelopes from her pocket and handed them to Su Anying and Wu Qiuyan.
"Our family's rules, the new daughter-in-law is given a red envelope for the first year.
Don’t be too small, you two, this is a little wish from your father and me, and it was also there when your eldest sister-in-law and second sister-in-law came in. "
In the red envelope are two brand-new one-dollar bills. Good things come in pairs, which means auspiciousness.
Originally, neither Su Anying nor Wu Qiuyan wanted to receive red envelopes. How old are they, can they still be like Xiaowa?
But when the mother-in-law said that it was a family rule, and the sisters-in-law had it, the two of them took it as a matter of course.
"Thank you, Mom."
Ordinarily, one should stay awake all night on New Year’s Eve, but most people can’t bear it.
The first few children had slept before, but now they all nodded their heads.
Not to mention Su Anying and Wu Qiuyan, they were already sleepy and yawning, so Zhou Guilan asked the daughters-in-law to coax the children to sleep, so they don't have to watch over them.
It was the men, who were eating melon seeds and chatting together. They were so sleepy that they couldn't stand it, so they found a place to sleep on their side.
The old rule is that you can’t sleep with bedding on New Year’s Eve, otherwise the chickens at home love to cuddle.
So everyone didn't take off their clothes, just fell asleep all night.
What is Chinese New Year? During the Chinese New Year, all the delicious food that has been saved for a year is gathered in those few days to eat.
Chinese New Year is when people who have been busy for a year can finally take a rest, and then eat, drink, visit relatives and friends all day long to chat.
From the first day to the fifteenth day of junior high school, there is almost no work to do, just eating, drinking and having fun.
According to the local rules, on the first and second day of junior high school, visit relatives and friends to pay New Year's greetings, only the daughters who go out can return to their natal home after the evening of the second day or the morning of the third day.
So on the third day of junior high school, the married sons of the Xu family all accompanied their daughter-in-law back to their natal home.
Even Xu Chenghou accompanied Zhou Guilan back to Zhou's house in Daying.
Originally, Xu Shiyan didn't want Su Anying to go out again. After all, Su Anying is now a month old, and there are many people going out during the Chinese New Year. In case of any accidents.
Later it was Zhou Guilan who said that they would also go back to Daying together, and that they would have someone to take care of them when they went together, so Xu Shiyan agreed.
So Xu Shixiang, who was preparing for the exam and reading books, was left to look after the house, and all the family members went out.
Xu Shiyan accompanied his daughter-in-law back to her natal home. Qin Meiling, who happened to be married to Hunjiang, and her husband Sui Hongzhi, and their daughter Sui Xiaoling, who had been in their arms for several months, also came back.
Invite Su Anzhen's date with whom she just dated years ago, and the whole family is quite lively.
Living in Daying until the sixth day, Xu Shiyan was thinking about buying a house, so he couldn't live anymore.
Su Weizhong and his wife repeatedly tried to persuade him to stay, but Xu Shiyan only said that he would come back when he had time, so he led his wife back to the big house.
On the seventh day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan went out with some things on his back. He first went to Songjiang River to send some frozen slender fish to Guo Shouye, and then went to Donggang to find Zhou Changhe.
"Oh, brother, I hope you are here.
Your sister-in-law found a house for you, and the price is almost the same, why don't you go and have a look? "
When Zhou Changhe saw Xu Shiyan, he mentioned the house first without saying anything else.
Xu Shiyan laughed immediately, "Second Brother, Happy Chinese New Year." No matter what, no matter how anxious you are, you have to pay New Year's greetings first.
"Second sister-in-law, happy new year, thank you second sister-in-law, for taking care of my affairs."
"Happy New Year to the three brothers.
How polite are my brothers? Brother, if you come today, you can't just sit for a while and leave. You must have a meal at home. "
Zhou Changhe's daughter-in-law, Li Shi, is a hearty and generous person, who is considerate and generous in her dealings with others.
Xu Shiyan brought things with him several times when he came here, and she felt very sorry that she had to leave Xu Shiyan to eat at home today.
"Okay, then please trouble sister-in-law, I will eat here today.
By the way, sister-in-law, there are two fine scale fish in the back basket. I made a hole in the ice a few years ago. It was frozen very hard, so I kept it at home to eat. "
Zhou's family sincerely helped, but Xu Shiyan was embarrassed to come to the door empty-handed.
Exactly years ago, he smashed a hole in the ice to get out the fish he had hidden before, and left two for the Zhou family.
When Zhou Chang and his wife heard this, they had to say a few words about Xu Shiyan, thinking that he was too out of touch.
Xu Shiyan only responded with a smile, causing Zhou Zhang and his wife to have no choice but to accept the fish.
"Changhe, you can accompany the three brothers to look at the house, there is a lot of urging.
If you are optimistic about it, quickly settle down. I am looking at that place. "
Ms. Li urged Zhou Changhe to take Xu Shiyan to see the house, while she was busy cooking and entertaining guests at home.
Zhou's family lives opposite the middle school, which is considered to be close to the center of Donggang Commune.
The tomb of the martyrs is on the north side, close to the woods.
Going from Songjiang River to Donggang, there is a crossroad just after entering the area of ​​Donggang, and the tomb of the martyrs is in the northeast of the crossroad.
Donggang used to belong to the fifth district, and the tomb of the martyrs commemorates the district chief at that time.
So most people also call the tomb of the martyrs the tomb of the district chief.
In 1946, the traitor Jiang Yongqing colluded with the Fu gang and killed the district chief.
After the founding of the People's Republic of China, a martyr's tomb was built in the local area to commemorate.
Many people say that, in fact, there is no corpse in the tomb of the martyrs, it is just an empty tomb.
Anyway, the big guys are not afraid, and there are many children playing around there.
The house that Zhou Changhe mentioned is the second building to the east of the martyr's tomb, and it should actually be regarded as a small flat hill.
Behind it is the woods, and to the east is a hillside, with a ditch and pond at the bottom.
The open space in the west is quite large, and then there is a small hillside, and there is a small ditch and pond between the house in the west.
There are three adobe houses with thatched roofs, but the houses are fairly upright, and the yard is neatly tidied up.
The vegetable garden is very large, and some fruit trees are planted on the hillsides on both sides. It seems that there is also a garden behind the house.
In such a spacious place, if a few more large tile-roofed houses are built, it will be absolutely comfortable to live in.
Xu Shiyan was quite satisfied with the house, and he also heard from Zhou Changhe on the way that the other party was eager to move away, and finally talked about 400 yuan.
And also brought a warehouse, and a big stack of firewood behind the house.
"Brother, what do you think of this place? If you think it's okay, let's go in and discuss it with him.
If you are not optimistic, then wait and let your sister-in-law help you find out.
Look for the place in the middle, it's still a bit off. "
From Zhou Changhe's point of view, the price of the house is okay, but the location is a bit out of the way.
"Second brother, it's very good here, let's go in and ask." Xu Shiyan was very satisfied with this.
Because he knew that this place was later demolished.
In such a big place, he will build more houses and set up a processing factory. Not to mention, he can pay some money just for demolition.

chapters.title: Chapter 103: buy a house
chapters.content:
Chapter 103 Buying a house
The owner of the house is Qi Yunsheng, who is one year older than Xu Shiyan. He went to Donggang in 1968 and lived in Donggang for ten years.
I took the college entrance examination last year and was admitted to the Bethune University of Medicine and Science. After the year, I have to report to the school.
Qi Yunsheng wanted to take his wife and children back to the provincial capital, so the house here had to be disposed of.
As the check-in time drew closer, he became more and more anxious.
"Brother Xu, four hundred yuan is really the lowest.
Don’t think my house is made of adobe, but it’s neatly tidied up. Even if you live in it for another ten or twenty years, you’ll be fine.
Besides, how big is the surrounding area? Living is also spacious. "
It could be seen that Qiao Yunsheng was really in a hurry to sell the house, and he asked for 400 yuan, and he didn't ask for more.
"I just want to take Xiujuan's mother and son with me, otherwise, to be honest, I really don't want to come here.
Brother Xu, take a look around the front and back of your house, this place is worth buying. "
Xu Shiyan had heard about Qiao Yunsheng, and although he had never met him, he admired him.
In this era, many educated youths abandoned their wives and children in order to return to the city.
Qiao Yunsheng is worthy of respect for being able to take his daughter-in-law along without disliking her daughter-in-law in the countryside when she is admitted to university.
"Brother Qi, don't say anything, this house is only 400, I bought it."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, not intending to embarrass Qi Yunsheng.
Since the house is promising and he has money in his hand, don't miss the thirty or twenty, it's time to make friends.
Qi Yunsheng didn't expect Xu Shiyan to be so happy at all, he thought he would have to negotiate the price again, so he was stunned.
"Buy it directly for 400 yuan?" Qi Yunsheng asked in disbelief.
"Well, just buy it directly, Brother Qi, you are a happy person, and I don't care about it.
In this way, you have found the neighbors and the cadres of the brigade to be witnesses. Let's write the contract on the spot, okay? "
Xu Shiyan is also afraid of long nights and dreams, what if someone is also optimistic about the house and wants to buy it?
Buy it quickly, he will move his household registration when he goes back, and move quickly while the river is still frozen.
Otherwise, after a while, the river will start to thaw, and people will not dare to leave on the river, which will delay things too much.
"Hey, hey, okay, then I'll find someone to go."
When Qi Yunsheng heard this, he was overjoyed, and immediately rushed out to look for his neighbors.
But Zhou Zhanghe helped the people to the end, told Xu Shiyan, went directly to the commune to find Zhou Qingguo, and brought several cadres from the Second Brigade over.
In these days, homesteads are collectively owned, and they are not easily bought or sold. They must be approved by the brigade and the commune.
Zhou Changhe meant that he just took the opportunity of buying a house to introduce Xu Shiyan to the people in the brigade, and it would be easy to change his household registration in the future.
The four neighbors live very close, and they will come soon.
It is said that it is the neighbors, but in fact it is the neighbors on the left and right, and there are two families across the road.
The Qi family has been clamoring to sell the house for a while, everyone knows about it, so just now when Qi Yunsheng went to find them, these families didn't hesitate, and came directly to be a witness.
Besides, you have to get to know your neighbors in the future.
It is said that distant relatives are not as good as close neighbors, and sometimes neighbors get along better than relatives.
Living at home, I’m actually afraid of having a domineering and unreasonable neighbor in the stall. Living next to each other, such a neighbor is really not disturbing enough.
Xu Shiyan has an honest and honest look on his face, the kind that doesn't bother anyone who sees him.
So when everyone saw it, they all felt that this person seemed easy to get along with. First of all, the first impression was very good.
Everyone sat and chatted together, and they had to inquire about Xu Shiyan's family affairs. Xu Shiyan had nothing to hide, and simply talked about his own situation.
After talking for a while, Zhou Chang and his father and son accompanied several cadres of the brigade to arrive, and also invited a primary school teacher over.
Zhou Qingguo had already mentioned to the secretary and captain of the Second Brigade that a relative was moving here.
With this foreshadowing, those in the brigade were very polite to Xu Shiyan, and immediately agreed to Xu Shiyan's purchase of a house and the transfer of his household registration to the Second Brigade of Donggang Commune.
With these guarantors and neighbors as witnesses, the house sale will be recognized.
At that moment, Qi Yunsheng found paper and a brush, and asked the elementary school teacher to write the contract for the sale of the house.
Then both the buyer and the seller, the guarantor, and the witnesses all sign and press their fingerprints.
Generally speaking, when buying a house, you pay a part of the deposit first, and wait for the other party to hand over the house before giving the rest.
Xu Shiyan knew that Qi Yunsheng was in a hurry, and besides, he was far away, so he simply gave Qi Yunsheng the four hundred yuan.
"Brother Qi, although this is the first time we've met, I've seen your temper, so don't bother.
In this way, when you clean up the house here, give the key to my second brother.
I don’t know how long it will take when I go back to change my household registration, so don’t delay your return to the provincial capital. "
"Second brother, don't bother the second master, I will entrust this matter to you, brother, and keep the key for me when the time comes."
Anyway, Zhou Changhe has been troubled so much, and this matter is not bad, so I just entrust it all to Zhou Zhanghe.
Zhou Changhe didn't refuse, and directly agreed.
At this point, the Qi family's house will belong to Xu Shiyan, just wait for Xu Shiyan to move his household registration and move here with his wife.
The house was successfully bought, Xu Shiyan couldn't help but thank these people who came today.
"Thank you secretary and captain, and neighbors, I have nothing prepared today.
In this way, when I move over, I will definitely set up a banquet to invite everyone to drink. "
"Do you still need to wait for you to move in? Come on, come to my house to drink today."
Zhou Zhang and the other end laughed, and said immediately.
"This is my aunt's younger brother, just like my own younger brother, everyone, let's go to my place for a drink."
Zhou Changhe had made up his mind a long time ago, and today he must support Xu Shiyan.
These are all members of the Second Brigade. Having a meal together will always be a matter of personal preference in the future, and Xu Shiyan will be easy to get along with when he moves here.
"Look, I was supposed to ask for this, why did Uncle Zhou spend money on it?"
At this end, Qi Yunsheng looked embarrassed, and also expressed that he would treat him to dinner.
In the end, Zhou Changhe won, so the group went to Zhou Changhe's house.
It happened that Mrs. Li was cooking at home. Seeing so many people coming, she hurriedly thought about a few more dishes, and even instructed the second boy to go to the supply and marketing cooperative to buy more bottles of wine.
Mrs. Li works quickly, and it didn't take long to make six dishes and one soup.
"It's too hasty, a few dishes to deal with casually, the secretary, the team leader, Mr. Chen, everyone will eat as they please.
The food is not good, but the wine is not enough. " Mrs. Li said very politely while serving the dishes.
"Sister-in-law, what do you mean, six dishes and one soup will still be eaten?
When our county cadres come to the countryside, it would be nice to have four dishes and one soup. Our specifications are higher than theirs, so what else do you want? "Secretary of the Second Brigade Yu Shou Guangdang even laughed.
"Hey, there is another big fish here. What kind of fish is this? It doesn't look like a carp."
Not everyone is familiar with fine scales, and the appearance of the fish is destroyed after stewing, so it’s normal to not be able to see it.
"Oh, those are the thin scales my brother brought this morning.
Secretary, don't underestimate my brother, he can fish and hunt.
Last year, I was a member of the Dongjiangyan brigade, and I got a lot of wild boars and black blinds all winter. "

chapters.title: Chapter 104: talents
chapters.content:
Chapter 104 Talent
Zhou Changhe intends to make Xu Shiyan famous and let others know Xu Shiyan's ability.
After all, Xu Shiyan was going to move to Donggang, so he was new to Donggang and was unfamiliar with the place.
The cadres of the brigade are not familiar with him, and they don't know what skills he has.
If you have no ability, you can only follow others and do some vigorous work.
But if you have some skills that others don't know, it will be different.
When encountering a problem, the leader must be the first to think of who can do it. This is the difference.
Don't underestimate this ginseng hunting, it is also a skill that others don't know, don't care about the size of the skill, as long as it can come in handy, that's fine.
As soon as Zhou Changhe said that, brigade secretary Yu Shouguang's eyes lit up.
"Xiao Xu, are you a member of the Dongjiang Yan brigade? When did it happen? I heard that your brigade lost the club before?"
Everyone in the communes in the entire county knows about the throwing of sticks by the brigade along the Dongjiang River.
What's more, the Xijiang Brigade, Xinhua Brigade, and Yanjiang Brigade under the Donggang Commune are just across the river from the Dongjiang Yanbrigade. They are very close, and everyone knows everything.
"Well, after I lost the club last fall, I couldn't find anyone in the team to help me, so I stepped in temporarily."
Xu Shiyan didn't mean to show off, but nodded very modestly and low-key.
Yu Shouguang patted the table when he heard it, "Oh, look, you almost missed someone, didn't you?
Old Zhou, you have done a great job. "
Yu Shouguang was so happy, but Zhou Changhe was taken aback, what's wrong? "Old Yu, are you okay?"
"Cut, what can I do?
You don’t know, after Dongjiangyan lost the stick last year, he invented a kind of reference thing called a ground gun.
When we went to a meeting, we heard people say that it was made by a young man, and it is very useful to see the reference.
Xiao Xu, you made that ground gun, right? "This is all nonsense, if you don't go to see the ginseng by yourself, who would bother to fix those?
