Xu Shiyan didn't expect that even Donggang knew about the stuff he poked out.
"Well, it's just a little gadget. The previous Orion's method has been slightly improved. It's okay to use it for viewing."
He can't say that he came up with it all by himself, so he can only find such an excuse.
"Come on, I'll wait for you to move here, and help our brigade get ready.
Let me tell you, as long as you set up that gun, many participants are looking for it.
Our place is different from that along the Dongjiang River. Our place is closer to the Songjiang River.
You also know that Songjianghe is both a town and a forestry bureau, as well as Linjian, Forest Railway and other places, where there are too many people, chaos will arise.
Several brigades in Donggang have participated in the field, as well as the commune and state-owned fields. Where can they not be used? Needless to say, Yu Shouguang was so happy.
It was Zhou Qingguo who mentioned it to him before, saying that a distant relative was in the Dongjiangyan Brigade and wanted to move here.
With Zhou Qingguo's face, Yu Shouguang naturally couldn't say anything else.
Anyway, it’s just a few more people. There are 350 households in the second brigade, and there are more than 1,700 people. What’s the difference?
Who would have imagined it? He just picked up a treasure. If the other brigades know it, they can **** people from him if they don't have it all.
"Xiao Xu, I'll give you a letter of introduction later, you take my letter of introduction and go back to change your household registration, and move here while the river is still freezing.
If you don’t have enough people to move, the brigade will help you send people and sledges. "
Those who are capable will like everywhere, regardless of their ability, as long as they are useful.
Don't say anything else, he just needs to let the wind out, saying that the guy who made the ground gun is in his second brigade, and everyone else has to come to him?
Once you ask, you will owe the favor. It is all benefits, and fools push the benefits out.
Actually, the transfer of agricultural household registration in the same province in this year is not troublesome. As long as you find a receiving place, you can settle down without a letter of introduction.
Transferring from farmers to non-farmers or moving from Shandong to this end, it will be troublesome and require various procedures.
Yu Shouguang just wanted to show how much he valued Xu Shiyan when he said this.
He was worried that on the other side of the Dongjiang River, he might not let people go easily.
With the letter of introduction, and Yu Shouguang's face, Dongjiang will definitely not be stuck.
Xu Shiyan really didn't think about it so much. In his opinion, it was just a change of household registration. Zhao Dahai had such a good relationship with the Xu family that he wouldn't stop him.
Of course, having a letter of introduction is absolutely different, at least it proves that the Second Brigade attaches great importance to him.
No matter when, no matter who, being valued by others is always a very pleasant thing.
"Success, then I'll go back and do it as soon as possible. Secretary, don't worry, I definitely don't hide anything. I can teach ground guns, cracking cannons and so on."
The Second Brigade has been growing ginseng for so many years, and there are only fixed candidates to see the ginseng. Xu Shiyan didn't expect to let him go to the ginseng.
As long as you can get a foothold here smoothly, it’s just a ground gun, so you can teach me, there is no need to hide it.
They are all happy people, so it doesn't take much effort to talk and do things.
Yu Shouguang felt that Xu Shiyan was a young man who could handle him well.
Xu Shiyan also felt that the cadres of this brigade are quite straightforward and nice.
People and people are like this, talking and chatting, and drinking a little wine, the chatting will become closer.
After the meal was over, Xu Shiyan really followed the brigade cadres to the team headquarters and issued a letter of introduction.
Then Yu Shouguang specially arranged for someone to drive Xu Shiyan to Dajiang with the sledge.
Xu Shiyan drank a little swayingly at first, but was blown by the cold wind all the way, and when the alcohol passed, he became more energetic.
Arrived by the river, thanked the person who brought him back, Xu Shiyan crossed the river back to the village, and went straight to Zhao Dahai's home.
"Uncle, are you at home?" The two families knew each other so well that they didn't need to look out of the way.
"Third brother? Why are you here? Did someone tell you? What the hell, these people really owe me."
I didn't want to see Zhao Jianshe walking out angrily as soon as I entered the door, and the two happened to walk towards each other.
Xu Shiyan was taken aback, why didn't he feel right? "Jiangshe, what's wrong with you? Who messed with you?"
"My third brother, how can you still hold your breath at this time?
Your errand of looking at references has been overwhelmed by others, why don't you ask me in a hurry? "
Zhao Jianshe is straight-hearted and has a loud voice. He thought Xu Shiyan already knew, so he didn't care, and just yelled out.
"Huh? Kancan's job was rejected?" Xu Shiyan understood why Zhao Jianshe was so angry when he heard this.
"Look at you, is it worth getting angry about this little thing?"
Xu Shiyan had guessed a long time ago that there must be a fork in the work of watching the ginseng after the year, so he didn't take it to heart at all.
He is ready to move to Donggang, and even bought the house, does he care about whether to see the reference or not?
"It's not just your errand, my dad was also raped." As a result, Zhao Jianshe's next sentence directly confused Xu Shiyan.
"What? Jian Jian, please explain to me clearly, what's wrong with my Uncle Zhao? Why can't I still get a job?"
Zhao Dahai is a few years younger than Xu Chenghou. He is only fifty-three this year. He is doing a great job. How could he be slapped?
"Zhao Jianshe, you bastard, you don't know what to say all day long, why are you telling your third brother these things?"
In the east room, Zhao Dahai's voice came out.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: job lost
chapters.content:
Chapter 105 Lost job
Seeing Shen's job being replaced, Xu Shiyan had expected it a long time ago, and he was not surprised, nor angry.
But Zhao Dahai was raped, which was beyond Xu Shiyan's expectation. What's going on?
"Uncle, tell me, what's going on? You did a good job, why did you get kicked out?"
Xu Shiyan walked into the room quickly, and asked Zhao Dahai eagerly.
"It's okay, it's just that I made a mistake at work, so if you lose your job, just lose it, it's not a big deal.
San’er, uncle, I’m sorry, but I couldn’t keep the errand of Kansan, alas. "
Zhao Dahai sat on the kang, looking downcast, as if he was several years old.
"No, uncle, you have to tell me the truth, what is it for?
Is it related to my reference? If it's for me, it's not worth it. "
Xu Shiyan is not stupid. These two things happened at the same time, so they must be related.
But just an errand of seeing a reference, how can Zhao Dahai's work be involved?
"Oh, let's not mention the past, anyway, I have done enough in the past few years, I am too worried.
It's better to come down and do some work to earn work points lightly and economically, without having to worry about it all day long. "
Zhao Dahai said it as if he was relaxed, but his expression was not the same.
When Dong Jiangyan was still in the squad, Zhao Dahai was the captain, and when he was promoted to the brigade, he was the brigade secretary.
After working for these years, everyone has a psychological gap and finds it hard to accept that he was suddenly kicked out.
"San'er, if you don't look at references in the future, let's work hard.
As long as you work hard, you can earn a lot of work points for a year.
But in the future, when it comes to hunting, selling fish, etc., try to poke as little as possible, and others will look jealous. "
Zhao Dahai looked at Xu Shiyan, and didn't know what to say, so he could only tell him a few words, which could be regarded as a reminder.
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan somewhat understood.
"Uncle, after all, it's because of my business that I let you die, right? Who made the decision? No, I'll go find him."
You can come to him if you have something to do, why do you have trouble with Zhao Dahai?
Zhao Dahai is the village secretary, so he can't stare at the team members all day long. What do the members do, and what does it have to do with Zhao Dahai?
"No, San'er, don't go.
You don’t have to worry about this matter. Uncle is just getting old and lacks energy, so he wants to go home and rest.
Uncle told you, just want you to be careful in the future, don't you know those people in our brigade? All pink eye. "
In the past, Zhao Dahai was under pressure, and there was a limit to the jealousy of these people in the team.
Now that Zhao Dahai is no longer in the position, he is worried that Xu Shiyan will still be as flamboyant as before, and that he will be jealous and cause other things.
At this point in the teaser, Xu Shiyan knew that he would not be able to ask any more questions.
"Uncle, who is in charge of our team now? I have something to ask the team to handle."
He came back mainly to change his household registration, so it is important to get down to business first.
As for why Zhao Dahai was taken down, I will find a chance to ask later.
"I'm coming down, now Hu Liancheng is acting brigade secretary, you can find him if you have anything to do.
But when you meet him, speak politely and don't bring any emotions. You know that Hu Liancheng is not easy to handle. "
Zhao Dahai did not say anything to Xu Shiyan, he reminded everything that should be reminded.
When Zhao Dahai said this, Xu Shiyan understood more or less that Hu Liancheng was probably behind this incident.
You must know that Hu Liancheng is only the vice-captain, even if Zhao Dahai came down, it should be the captain Yu Shanhai who went up, how could it be Hu Liancheng's turn?
"Uncle, I'll do something first, and I'll talk to you when I'm free."
Xu Shiyan got up to say goodbye, walked out, and winked at Zhao Jianshe before going out.
From Zhao Jianshe's mouth, he can definitely ask the reason.
Zhao Jianshe's nerves are usually rough and not very sensitive, but today he doesn't know what's wrong. Suddenly, the strings in his mind were hooked, and he immediately understood what Xu Shiyan meant.
"Dad, then I'll go out to see off my third brother." After finishing speaking, before Zhao Dahai could say anything, the kid jumped out in a whoosh.
Zhao Dahai sighed heavily when he saw his son jumping out.
"Construction is such an ugly thing, it really makes him worry to death. Once he goes out, why don't he say everything?"
Zhao Dahai's daughter-in-law didn't say a word just now, but now she spoke, "Let's just say it, and let San'er know the reason.
He knows what he knows, and he will be able to guard against it in the future. Besides, you helped him carry things, you should let him know. "
Zhao Dahai was silent for a long time after hearing what his wife said.
"It shouldn't be said that way, it's not that I helped him carry things, but San'er helped me carry a lot of things.
At the beginning, no one went up to the mountain to see ginseng, even the two boys in our family were not happy. Once I told San'er, he agreed.
San’er’s daughter-in-law was still pregnant with a child. At that time, my eyes were red-eyed, and I didn’t think about anything, so I asked San’er to take his wife up the mountain.
Now that I think about it, what a shame, if Yingzi made a mistake on the mountain, how could we be worthy of him? "
"Oh, you're right, San'er means a lot to our family." Zhao Dahai's daughter-in-law sighed.
Actually, in today’s age, it’s normal for men to be animals and women to be men.
Whose daughter-in-law is pregnant, and she still works outside the home?
Catching up with the busy farming season, you have to work even if you are about to give birth. There are also some daughters-in-law who are working in the field and are about to give birth. It is common for them to work in the morning and give birth in the afternoon.
No one really takes a woman's pregnancy seriously. Zhao Dahai didn't think much about it at the time, so it's not a big problem.
"Let's talk about the throwing of the stick, it wasn't that San'er met the boss of the Chen family, so how can we find out who stole the stick?
Although our brigade failed to recover too many losses in the end, it can be regarded as an explanation to the big guys.
If the case can’t be solved, others won’t tell me publicly or scold me behind my back? "
Zhao Dahai has no one to talk to, so he can only chatter with his wife.
At this moment outside the gate of the Zhao family, Xu Shiyan was also questioning Zhao Jianshe.
"Xiangshe, we are the best buddies, you can't hide from the third brother if you have something to do."
Zhao Jianshe was stunned and didn't have so many twists and turns, so he nodded immediately when he heard it.
"That's right, the third brother is closer than my own brother, I'm sure I won't hide it from you."
"Then tell me, why was Uncle Zhao taken down?" Xu Shiyan asked seriously.
Zhao Jianshe let out an "ah" and scratched his head, "My father won't let me say that."
Xu Shiyan raised his foot and was about to kick him, "Still hiding with me? If you don't tell me, how can I find a way to help Uncle Zhao?"
There must be something tricky behind this matter. If Xu Shiyan doesn't figure it out, he won't be able to sleep when he gets home tonight. He must figure it out.
“It means that someone reported to the commune that you embezzled public property and used the brigade’s guns and dogs for your own personal gain.
Said that you went hunting on the mountain in the name of a ginseng, and you also received the work points and rations of the brigade for nothing. What is it called personal utilitarianism or something.
also said that you caught fish and sold them in the market before, which was speculation and the tail of capitalism, and the impact was very bad. "
Zhao Jianshe is such a straightforward person, how can he hide it, Xu Shiyan bluffed him, poured beans into the bamboo tube, and said everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Change of residence
chapters.content:
Chapter 106 Change of household registration
On the seventh day of the first lunar month, Xigang Commune organized a meeting with the secretaries and captains of each brigade to discuss and deploy the next spring plowing work.
I don’t want to be in the meeting, but someone brings up various issues of Xu Shiyan, a member of the Dongjiangyan brigade.
Just like what Zhao Jianshe said, any one of them is enough for Xu Shiyan to drink a pot.
Where is Zhao Dahai willing? At that time, I quarreled with the commune officials.
Then someone attacked Zhao Dahai, saying that Zhao Dahai was conniving and covering up, and that he made serious mistakes in his work.
At that time, Zhao Dahai quarreled with those people directly.
Isn’t he just a brigade secretary? The big deal is that Zhu Bajie will throw a rake and stop serving monkeys. What’s the big deal?
But they want to label them casually, that is absolutely impossible.
Just like that, Zhao Dahai lost his job as brigade secretary, and Xu Shiyan lost his job as a spectator.
Anyway, this quarrel was still useful, and the commune didn't say to continue to pursue Xu Shiyan's other matters.
"My father came back and said that someone must have been jealous of you, third brother, so they stabbed you in the back.
There are really not many good people in our village, all of them have red eyes. "Finally, Zhao Jianshe couldn't help cursing.
After Xu Shiyan listened to it, he had a rough idea in his heart. There may be a lot of tricks behind this matter.
Who is Hu Liancheng? Old Hutou's nephew, commune secretary Cao Mingchuan, is the uncle of Chen Deyong's wife.
Unfortunately, Lao Hutou and Chen Deyong are the main personnel in the case of throwing the stick.
If there is no retaliation, Xu Shiyan would not believe it.
"Okay, I know about this. Jianshe, I will go to Hu Liancheng to do something first, and I will come to you when I have time."
Xu Shiyan already had concerns in his heart, so he left Zhao's house and went straight to Hu Liancheng's.
At this point, Hu Liancheng must not be at the team headquarters, so Xu Shiyan went straight to Hu's house.
As soon as I entered the courtyard, I could vaguely hear a lot of people chatting in the house. Even though the doors and windows were closed in winter, I could hear the excitement of the people talking inside.
Xu Shiyan frowned, came to the door of the house, did not push the door directly to enter the house, but knocked on the door outside.
"Uncle Hu, are you at home?"
There was a sound of footsteps in the room, and then someone came to open the door. It was Hu Liancheng's son Hu Changming.
Hu Changming didn't know who was outside, he thought it was someone who had a good relationship with the Hu family, and opened the door with a smile on his face.
As soon as he saw it was Xu Shiyan, the smile on his face froze. "Brother Xu, are you coming?"
Hu Changming looked puzzled, what is Xu Shiyan doing here at this time? Knowing that Kansan's errand has been slapped, are you here to plead for mercy or to cause trouble?
"Oh, I have something to do with Uncle Hu." Xu Shiyan responded casually and stepped into the room.
As soon as I entered the east room, I found that there were many people sitting in the room, including relatives of the Hu family, and some people who had a good relationship with the Hu family on weekdays.
Is this the one who came to congratulate Hu Liancheng after knowing about Hu Liancheng's interim secretary?
The laughter and laughter that filled the room stopped abruptly the moment they saw Xu Shiyan.
Everyone in the room stared at Xu Shiyan in a daze, wondering what Xu Shiyan was here for at this time.
Finding faults? Or beg for help?
Well, I guess he came to beg for help because he was scared. With Xu Shiyan's character, he couldn't do anything like deliberately visit the door to find fault.
"Yo, nephew Shi Yan, come here at this time, what's the matter?"
Hu Liancheng greeted Xu Shiyan with a smile, looking very friendly.
"Oh, Uncle, that's what happened, I want to move out of my household registration."
Xu Shiyan was careful not to take out the letter of introduction.
If he didn’t take the letter of introduction, Hu Liancheng might think that Xu Shiyan knew that he couldn’t get along in Dongjiangyan, so he quickly found a place to move out.
If you show the letter of introduction and know that you are moving to the Second Brigade of Donggang, maybe Hu Liancheng will still want to make sure.
"Huh? Hukou moved? Where are you going to move?"
Xu Shiyan's words caught Hu Liancheng by surprise. This kid is going to move away without saying a word?
"Xinancha, a small village, my wife has a relative there, I want to move there." Xu Shiyan didn't say it was the Second Brigade of Donggang Commune.
Xinxicha is also affiliated to Donggang Commune, but it is extremely remote and the village is very small, with only thirty or fifty households, poorer than Dongjiangyan.
When everyone in the room heard it, they all showed tacit expressions.
Look, this must be because he knew that Zhao Dahai had stepped down and no one would protect him anymore, so he hurried to find a place to slip.
"Oh, nephew Shiyan, what do you think you are doing? Isn't our Dongjiangyan doing well? The wages are not low.
The job of looking at the ginseng was originally said that you went up for a while a few years ago.
There are some strong young men in our village, so we should give them a chance, right? "
Hu Liancheng also thought that Xu Shiyan would move out in a fit of anger when he found out that he was rejected for his job.
"If you move to that good place, uncle will definitely not say anything, people go to higher places.
You moved to the place in Southwest Cha, what kind of development can you have? Well, let's stay along the Dongjiang River. "
Hu Liancheng said that he seemed to be thinking of Xu Shiyan, but his tone and expression didn't seem quite right.
Xu Shiyan knew what was going on in his heart, so he didn't point it out.
"Uncle, no need, I've already decided to move, please, uncle, please move out the household registration relationship for me."
In these years, the household registration management is in the village or the street. If you want to move out of the household registration, Hu Liancheng has to nod.
Hu Liancheng saw that Xu Shiyan was determined to go, so he couldn't persuade him any more.
"Okay, let's go, go to the village department, I will move you and your wife's household registration out."
Before, Xu Shiyan planned to remove the household registration of the sixth son Xu Shiqin, but now he changed his mind.
In the morning, he went to Songjiang River to meet Guo Shouye. He brought Guo Shouye several fine scale fish and asked Guo Shouye to help him with something.
People in this day and age mostly buy fabrics for their clothes, and women can almost make ordinary casual clothes by themselves.
But for some uniforms, Chinese tunic suits, and various coats, you must find a special tailor shop to make them.
The employees of the Forestry Bureau are rich and pay special attention to food and clothing, so they have a tailor shop.
The master craftsmen in the store have good craftsmanship, and all kinds of clothing are especially beautiful.
Xu Shiyan asked Guo Shouye for help and asked Xu Shiqin to work as an apprentice in a tailor shop.
Xu Shiqin knows a little bit of tailoring, embroidery and so on. In the past, he could become an apprentice after a year or so of learning.
After becoming an apprentice, you can stay in the tailor shop as a helper with a salary.
In two years, I will be able to run my own business. Xu Shiqin can open his own shop if he wants to. No matter what, he will have the ability to settle down.
What is Guo Shouye's identity? The logistics director of the agency, the person who hangs around with the leader all day, who can't give him some face?
For him, this matter was not worth mentioning at all, so he agreed at the time, and asked Xu Shiyan to bring his sister there in a few days, and he was responsible for the settlement.
Xu Shiqin is going to be an apprentice, and she doesn't work in the agricultural team, so there is no need to change her household registration. Let's wait and see how she will be arranged after she becomes an apprentice.
Right now, it is only necessary to remove the Hukou of Xu Shiyan and his wife.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: angry again
chapters.content:
Chapter 107 Getting angry again
Hu Liancheng didn't embarrass Xu Shiyan too much. When he went to the team headquarters, he moved Xu Shiyan's household registration and other things out, and stamped the team headquarters stamp.
Xu Shiyan carefully picked up the few pieces of paper, thanked Hu Liancheng, left from the team headquarters, and went home to see his wife.
Then, before nightfall, the whole village knew about it.
Xu Shiyan was masturbated because he was on an errand, and he took his wife to move to the small place in Southwest Chak.
"Third brother, my father asked you to go there, and I need you."
Just after dinner in the evening, Xu Shixiang came over with an uneasy face.
Xu Shiyan didn't even ask, he got up, put on his clothes, and went out.
"Daughter-in-law, if you're sleepy, go to bed first, and I'll go tell my parents."
Don't even need to think about it, the old man must have known about Xu Shiyan's move to Southwest Cha, and he got angry again, and asked Xu Shiyan to go over and question him.
Don’t let your wife watch the excitement about this matter. It’s better to rest and sleep at home honestly.
Xu Shiyan followed Xu Shixiang out, and as soon as he got outside, Xu Shixiang couldn't hold back.
"Third brother, why don't you discuss with our parents about moving?
We also moved to the poor place in Xixicha, our father knew that he was very angry. "
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard the words, "Old Wu, there are some things that may not be true.
Let's go, go home, let me explain together, so as not to say it twice. "
After finishing speaking, he left his confused brother and walked straight to the east of the village.
As soon as he entered the gate, he heard Xu Chenghou's loud voice.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help but shook his head, his father, at such an old age, his temper just doesn't change, he's like a powder keg, it explodes when touched.
Really talk about him when you are free, and control your temper.
How old are you? And then be so furious all day without moving, can the blood pressure bear it?
The old man passed away quite suddenly in his previous life.
At that time, it was just in time to collect beans, but a big hailstorm came down, and all the soybeans were smashed into the ground.
The old man became impatient, and scolded Xu Shiyan, thinking that he was working too slowly, so he should take the beans home earlier so that they wouldn't be all blind in the field.
The old man was jumping high and swearing at people, when suddenly his face changed and he fell to the ground.
Xu Shiyan knew it was a cerebral hemorrhage at a glance, and he also did emergency treatment.
Keep Xu Chenghou is old, the bleeding may be heavy, and the location is not good. He was sent to the hospital but he was not rescued, so he just disappeared.
Xu Chenghou is not yet sixty now, and he is in excellent health. As long as he controls his temper a little on weekdays and pays attention to his diet in the future, he may not be able to develop into the kind he was in his previous life.
Of course, that stubborn old man is not easy to play with. This matter has to be done slowly. Fortunately, there are still a few years left, so let's take it easy.
Xu Shiyan thought to himself, and pushed open the door, "Father, who are you angry with? I heard you from a long way away."
As soon as he saw his third son enter the door, Xu Chenghou's heart burst into flames.
"Who are you angry with? Who else can you be with, you bastard?
I thought you were promising, but it turned out to be a coward. It's just that the errand of Kansan was slapped, so you were so scared that you wanted to move?
It’s okay to move, you can find a good place anyway, go to Southwest Fork, that’s farther than Dongjiangyan, a place where rabbits don’t **** and birds don’t lay eggs, what are you going to do? "
The more Xu Chenghou thought about it, the more angry he became, and he started looking for broom bumps when he turned around.
"Dad, come and see what this is?"
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, and he didn't care that the old man was looking for broom bumps, so he took out the letter of introduction from Yu Shouguang from his arms.
"What? I can't read, why don't you show me?"
Xu Chenghou was illiterate and couldn't read the letter of introduction. He only looked at the red stamp underneath. So he quickly handed the letter of introduction to Xu Shide next to him.
On the seventh day of the first lunar month, Qingling Primary School has not started yet, and Xu Shide can stay at home for a few days.
He took a look at the letter of introduction and was stunned.
"Third brother, this is the letter of introduction from the second brigade of Donggang Commune, asking you to settle in the second brigade. Then why do you say you want to move to Xixiancha?"
"What? Donggang No. 2 Brigade?" Xu Chenghou was dumbfounded when he heard it. Why is this different from the rumors outside?
"What's going on? Third child, hurry up and say, it makes you mad every day."
"It's nothing, I wanted to move to Donggang a long time ago, and I went to buy a house today.
I happened to be having a drink with the secretary of the Second Brigade, and he was very happy to let me move there, so he gave me a letter of introduction. "
Xu Shiyan knew that if he didn't explain this matter clearly to his parents today, his father could really beat him up, so he explained the matter in detail.
"As soon as I came back, I heard that Uncle Zhao was masturbated, and my errand as a ginseng was also admirable.
So when I went to find Hu Liancheng, I didn't show this letter of introduction, and didn't mention anything, only that I would move to Xi'ancha.
No, Hu Liancheng didn't make it difficult for me, and moved out the household registration procedures for me quite smoothly. "
Xu Shiyan laughed as he spoke. Fortunately, he was a little clever, otherwise, why would it be difficult for Hu Liancheng to keep him, and he would not be moved to his hukou.
Everyone in the room was dumbfounded after hearing this, "Damn it, third child, they all say you are honest, you are the one with the most heart in the whole family.
Donggang Commune, return to the second brigade, you really know how to choose, the best place. "
Xu Shian stared at his younger brother with wide-eyed eyes, and he would be in a hurry with anyone who said that the third child was stupid again.
If the third child is stupid, he is not so smart.
Look at them, they are quiet, everything is done, and they directly find the best brigade in the best commune.
It is also possible for the brigade secretary to personally issue a letter of introduction. Can ordinary people do it?
Xu Shi'an, it can be said that he has spoken out the thoughts of the whole family.
Donggang Commune is well-known among these communes in the county, mainly because it has a long history of planting ginseng, and its work points are higher than elsewhere.
Among the ten brigades under Donggang Commune, the second brigade is the best.
The Second Brigade has more than 2,600 mu of arable land and more than 10,000 feet of land.
You know, the first group of Donggang has only 2,300 mu of arable land, with a total area of ​​4,000 zhang, and the third brigade has 1,800 mu of arable land, with a total area of ​​7,000 zhang.
There is a saying in Donggang Commune, "The first team digs Gastrodia elata, the second team climbs the mountains, and the third team sells bean sprouts."
What do you mean? That is, a large team is in the east of the commune, with little ginseng land but close to the mountains, pointing to the sideline business of digging Gastrodia elata.
The second team has a high score for ginseng and multi-work, and they all planted ginseng on the mountain and climbed all over the ground.
The third brigade has less land, and not too much land for ginseng. In winter, they can only produce bean sprouts as a side job and sell them in Songjianghe.
Xu Shiyan directly picked the best brigade of the best commune, he is more villainous than anyone else.
Those people outside still spread rumors, thinking that Xu Shiyan couldn't stay along the Dongjiang River any longer, and moved away with his wife in desperation.
Actually, they picked up Gao Zhier and developed it.
If the people outside who have fallen into trouble know this, they will probably turn green with anger.
When everyone thought of this possibility, they couldn't hold back and laughed.
"You little brat, you keep everything from the family, and you didn't tell me such a good thing in advance?"
Xu Chenghou couldn't help laughing either, scolding his son while laughing.

chapters.title: Chapter 108: animism
chapters.content:
Chapter 108 Animism
"Father, I dare not say this in advance, wouldn't it make people more jealous?
In case someone messes up with it, can I still change my account and move away? "Xu Shiyan also laughed.
"Father, that's what I think, I'll move out first to explore the way.
When I get a firm foothold in Donggang, you and my mother will also move out. The big house is still too far away, not as good as Donggang. "
Xu Shiyan never thought of leaving his parents in the big house.
He deliberately moved out first, mainly because he wanted to separate the household registration, buy a house by himself, and not mix with the family, so as to avoid brothers looking for trouble in the future.
In the previous life, the brother moved away early, leaving him to stay with his parents.
Those people said very well, the third child gave his parents a pension, and the house will be left to the third child in the future, and they don't want it.
Waiting for the house to be demolished when the mother is gone, these people don’t care about what they say, and they say that the old house was left by the mother, and all the sons have a share.
In his previous life, he suffered a loss once and was cheated once, so in this life he will not step on the trap.
The five sons are responsible for the elderly care, so don't try to push all of them on his head.
Family property, when the old couple dies, they will be divided equally.
What he earns is his own, so don’t mess with the old man this time, so as not to be unclear in the future.
"By the way, I bought a house in Donggang, three rooms with a big yard, bigger than our house.
What I mean is, let the sixth child follow me to live in Donggang.
I found her an apprentice job in the tailor shop of the Forestry Bureau, and learned the craft from a master master. After learning, she might be able to stay in the shop to work. "
Now that the words have been spoken, there is no need to hide the rest, Xu Shiyan directly proposed to take Xu Shiqin away.
"Third brother, you helped me find a master to learn tailoring? Oh, it's great, I wanted to learn it a long time ago, but no one taught me."
On the other side, Xu Shiqin almost jumped up with joy when he heard it.
She is not in good health, and she can't earn a few work points by working in the fields. It is really difficult in this agricultural team.
If you can learn a craft and help others make clothes in the future, you will have the ability to settle down.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were also very happy. The old girl was the heart disease of their husband and wife.
Unexpectedly, the third child still has this ability, so he arranged for the sixth child to learn tailoring.
For now, this is a very good craft. Even if you can't stay in the shop to work after learning it, you can make clothes for others at home, at least you can eat and drink.
"Sixth brother, you have to study hard, don't disappoint third brother Ni's heart."
Zhou Guilan tugged at her daughter's hand, exhorting her with great emotion.
"Understood, Mom, don't worry, I will study hard." Xu Shiqin was so happy that he didn't know what to do.
"Third brother, when are we moving to Donggang? I have to pack up quickly."
"As soon as possible, your third sister-in-law and I will also pack our things tomorrow, and then find a few sledges. Let's move quickly while the river is still freezing."
If you want to move, you have to pack it up, and besides, Qi Yunsheng has to give him some time to move out.
Here, Xu Shiqin was full of joy and longed to move to Donggang and learn crafts from the master.
On the other end, Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong were very upset.
Both of them are educated youths sent to the countryside by the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau. They haven't been able to return to the city yet. Why are the third and sixth children moving away?
"Third son, who did you follow, can you send sixth son an apprentice?
I haven’t heard from your second sister-in-law and I have returned to the city this time, so why don’t you get someone to inquire about it? "Xue Xiulin couldn't hold back anymore and asked.
"Sister-in-law, going back to the city is too important, I can't help you.
If you are free, you will often go back to Songjianghe, let your family members organize activities, and you can always find a way to return to the city. "
It's been more than a year since he returned to the city in 1979, and Xu Shiyan didn't want to make the effort.
After finally getting on the line with Guo Shouye, this kind of favor is getting less and less, you can't open it casually, you have to use it wisely.
When Xue Xiulin heard this, she was discouraged. When she returned to her natal family in the third year of junior high school, they also went back to inquire.
If they are not married, they can return to the city right now, but they are all married and have children, so they are not eligible.
No one has eyes for this kind of thing.
At that time, going to the countryside was hard, so I thought that if I got married, I would have someone to rely on. How could I ever think that there would be a day when I would return to the city?
It's useless to regret now, you can't leave your husband and children and go back to the city, right? They can't do such a heartless thing.
What can I do, wait, maybe one day the policy changes and they can go back?
Xu Shiyan sat here for a while, the misunderstanding was cleared up, and then he left Xu's house to go back to accompany his wife.
The next day, on the eighth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan and his wife were packing things at home.
Don’t look at when the two of them moved out, they only had a set of furniture and luggage. In the past six months, they have bought a lot of things one after another.
Pots, bowls and pans, pots and pans, all kinds of household items for daily life are available. Not only these, but also the food they share.
The rations distributed in the brigade were produced in the Xu family's private land and a small piece of uncultivated land. Xu Chenghou distributed the rations to Xu Shiyan according to the population.
Originally thinking that the couple didn’t have much to eat, and there was no place to store it at Lao Li’s house, so they kept it at Xu’s house, and occasionally went to bring some back.
I'm going to move this time, so I have to take everything with me.
The news that Xu Shiyan was going to move to Southwest Chak had already spread, and many people who had a good relationship with him also came to help when they saw Xu Shiyan's brothers back and forth.
When there is no use, everything that needs to be cleaned up is also cleaned up.
On the ninth day of the lunar new year, Xu Shiyan went to Hu Liancheng again and asked him to find the person who watched the reference and make a handover.
There are firewood, bright seeds, wood and other things that Xu Shiyan picked up this autumn and winter on the mountain.
Since he is no longer on the mountain to see the ginseng, these are also taken away.
The new ginseng spectator in the village is Hu Liancheng's brother-in-law Li Qiang.
Xu Shiyan took several of his brothers up the mountain, intending to hand over the matter and bring back the things on the mountain along the way.
As soon as a group of people arrived at the ginseng place, they found that there were a lot of pheasants and hares piled up in front of the door of the kanshen xiaofang.
Everyone was taken aback, "Third brother, why didn't you take all these down when you went down the mountain? Are you still missing so much?"
Xu Shide glanced at it, and there were at least a dozen pheasants and hares in that pile.
The third brother of his family is really big-hearted, so he won't take away so many things?
Xu Shiyan froze there, "No, I didn't do it. I packed it up when I left, so I won't be left behind."
Xu Shiyan said, and went to check, but after a quick look, he found that those pheasants and hares were all killed by some animals.
Comparing the tooth marks, Xu Shiyan looks like a fox or a wolf.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly got up and looked around, and sure enough, he found some traces on the snow near the house.
"It's a fox. I rescued a fire fox from a wolf's mouth on the mountain before, and brought it home to raise it for nearly half a month, feeding it meat all day long.
Before going home, I released it. It is probably the pheasant and hare that this guy got, as a gift. "
Everything has animism, let alone a fox? This little guy is quite interesting, and he knows how to repay his kindness.
My own habit of reading is to find a time to read together every day when I update, so I also concentrate on updating in the morning. If you think it is more reasonable to develop separately, then I can publish two chapters in the morning and the rest in the evening.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: move place
chapters.content:
Chapter 109 Moving
Xu Shiyan walked around the venue, but he didn't see the fire fox. He thought he didn't know where he went.
Xu Shiyan was mainly worried that he was going to move away and was not on the mountain. If the fox still came to participate, he might be injured.
Originally wanted to tell Li Qiang, but after thinking about it, forget it.
If you don’t say it, Li Qiang may not be thinking about it. If you say it, he will have to find a way to catch the fox.
After all, how can a good fox fur be worth twenty or thirty yuan? Who wouldn’t want it?
Forget it, let it be fate, that rascal is very smart, in a few days Li Qiang will take the dog up the mountain, and the rascal will not be able to get close to the venue, maybe he will not come in the future.
Go back to the small room of the venue, and hand over to Li Qiang and others.
In fact, it’s nothing, mainly those ground guns and other things, just count the quantity.
It was designed by Xu Shiyan at the beginning, and the brigade paid for it to go to the blacksmith furnace to make it, so it must belong to the brigade.
After the handover, everyone came out to load the firewood, bright seeds, and a few pieces of good wood on the sledge, and drove the sledge back to the village.
Everything was packed, and it happened that Zhou Zhanghe from Donggang sent a message saying that the Qi family had already handed over the house and moved out, and Xu Shiyan could move there at any time.
Xu Shiyan went to find Hu Liancheng, and asked the team to send a few horse sledges to help move.
As a result, Hu Liancheng said that the Southwest Fork is not far away, so let's find a way to move slowly.
The horses in the brigade have been busy recently and have no time.
It is said that people leave the tea to cool down, but this person has not left yet, the tea is already cold.
Xu Shiyan could only shake his head helplessly. He really felt that he was useless, so it would be good to move away? Don't even have the last bit of face?
I hope that when Hu Liancheng didn't come to him for help.
Anyway, Li Qiang never asked how the ground gun was wired, and Xu Shiyan would not ask it himself.
That stuff, if Xu Shiyan hadn't taught him by hand, he wouldn't have learned it at all. It might kill the wiring people, let them play.
In the early morning of the tenth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan went across the river to Songjianghe, and went directly to Guo Shouye, asking him to find a car for him.
Xu Shiyan gave all the money for gas, labor, etc., and helped him move.
Why did you find Guo Shouye and not Yu Shouguang?
One is the convenience of a car. The few things at his house can’t even be filled in a car, so they can be transported in one trip, saving you the trouble of going back and forth.
Secondly, before Xu Shiyan officially settled in the Second Brigade, he used the horses of the Second Brigade to sledge.
Guo Shouye agreed without saying a word, and directly called the large transport truck at Banshihe Forest Farm, and told the driver to help him get out of the car and move.
There is heavy snow in winter, and the rough roads are covered by heavy snow, which is much easier to walk than in summer.
Besides, the big truck can’t run on any road. This is the old foundation of the firewood road, so there is no problem in running.
Usually walking for nearly an hour, the big truck didn't even take half an hour, and drove directly to the river.
Xu Shiyan didn't let the car cross the river, so he stopped by the river and waited for him.
"Master, please take your troubles, just wait here for a while, I will ask someone to help move everything here."
Xu Shiyan directly stuffed two packs of cigarettes to the driver, making the driver nod happily.
"Success, it doesn't matter if you move slowly, anyway, I have nothing else to do today, so I'll just wait here."
Xu Shiyan returned to the village, and immediately found his brother, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming and other people who got along well.
As soon as everyone heard about the move, there was a truck waiting across the river. Now they regained their energy and didn't care about anything. They went to Li's house and moved all the things they had packed in the yard.
"Daughter-in-law, you don't have to worry about anything today, just hold this burden tightly to me, just don't throw it away."
Xu Shiyan handed a bundle to Su Anying, and inside it was a box he nailed with thin boards, and what was inside the box was naturally the three ginseng plants.
Xu Shiyan had prepared the three ginseng trees a long time ago, put them in a box and stored them carefully, and brought them to the mountain when he went up to see ginseng, and brought them back when he came back down the mountain.
This time moving, needless to say, it must be taken away, and it can't be put in any box or cabinet, so I just give it to Su Anying and let her hold it.
Su Anying naturally knew what was in the box, so of course she was cautious, "Well, don't worry, I will definitely hold on to it and not let go."
"Third brother, and me, I look at the third sister-in-law, I must take good care of her."
Xu Shiqin was also there, carefully supporting Su Anying to the riverside, and under the driver's arrangement, he got into the cab of the truck.
Xu Shiyan moved things from the west of the village to the east of the village in a noisy manner. The whole village knew about it, and many people came out to watch the excitement.
Everyone is quite puzzled, I didn’t find a sledge for this move, so why should I ship it out?
Those who have such a good letter can't help but ask. "Jianjian, are you guys helping Xu Laosan move? It can't be true that you just moved to Xi'ancha manually?"
"Fart, can my third brother be such a shameless person? He brought a big truck here. Have you never been in a truck?"
Zhao Jianshe glanced at the man, and shouted triumphantly.
"Also, who said that my third brother moved to Southwest Cha? They are going to move to the Second Brigade of Donggang Commune."
When Xu Shiyan was looking for someone to help move, he told everyone that he was moving to Donggang Commune.
But this group of friends were so envious, they all shouted, let Xu Shiyan go to the front station first, and if they get along well, they will all move out by then.
No one is willing to stay in this broken place along the Dongjiang River.
Some people didn’t believe Zhao Jianshe’s words, so they went to the riverside together, and they saw the big truck. Now, they finally believed it.
Before everyone thought that Xu Shiyan was pushed out and had to move away. Many people laughed at Xu Shiyan behind his back.
As a result, when I heard it now, I was completely dumbfounded.
Good guy, how can I be kicked out in such a desperate way, how can I get promoted step by step.
Go to Donggang Commune, Second Brigade? Also found a big truck to move? When did Xu Laosan have such a great ability?
There are a few people who have a good relationship with Hu Liancheng. Seeing the situation, they hurried to talk to Hu Liancheng.
When Hu Liancheng heard this, his face turned blue with anger.
"Grass, Xu Laosan's grandson, what a ghost, he told me that he moved to Xi'ancha.
After a long time of trouble, he moved to Donggang No. 2 Brigade. If I knew, I would not change his hukou. "
The people next to me shook their heads when they heard this. What's the use of saying this now?
"By the way, secretary, did Mr. Xu teach Li Qiang how to use the ground gun that Kansan used?"
Suddenly, someone remembered this matter and asked a casual question.
"I don't know, they went to the mountain to handover that day, and I didn't ask when they came back."
Hu Liancheng was stunned for a moment, and suddenly realized that he seemed to have missed something.
"Hurry up, call Li Qiang here and ask me."
Someone hurried to find Li Qiang, and when he asked, Li Qiang didn't learn how to make a ground gun from Xu Shiyan at all.
"How difficult is that thing? When the time comes, I will go up the mountain to have a look, and I will figure it out after thinking about it.
How is Xu Laosan's ability better than mine? "Li Qiang said indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: new home
chapters.content:
Chapter 110 New home
Xu Shiyan has no time to care what Hu Liancheng and his group think.
At this moment, the big guy has already loaded all the things into the car, and then everyone jumped on the car and sat down.
The truck started and went straight to Donggang.
Passing through the checkpoint on the way, the person at the checkpoint saw that it was a transport vehicle from the Banshihe Forest Farm, and they didn't even stop it, and let it go.
Walking uphill all the way to Donggang, you can go a little slower, which doesn't affect the truck much.
Half an hour later, the truck stopped outside the gate of Xu's new house.
The road is short, and everyone in the car is wearing a lot of clothes, so we arrived at the place before it was frozen through.
So they jumped out of the car one by one and hurried down to move things down.
A large truck stopped in front of Qi's house, and the neighbors saw it, so they had to come over to have a look.
After looking at it, I realized that the co-author was the Xu family who moved today.
The last time we ate and drank together, so we must help today, so the neighbors also reached out to help.
Regardless of the fact that there are a lot of things on the car, with so many people busy, they were quickly unloaded from the car and started moving to the yard.
My son moved, Xu Chenghou must come and see.
Getting out of the car, I saw such a large yard in front of me, and three neat rooms.
Oops, the old man is in his heart, that's really, very proud.
It has to be his son, who bought a house quietly, moved out of the big house, and settled in the best brigade in the best commune.
OK, that's great.
According to the old rules, when moving into a new house, the first one to enter the door should be the rice vat.
Xu Shiyan's family didn't have any rice tanks, so they moved a wooden bucket for small ballast.
Xu Shiyan moved in himself, followed by everyone who put furniture, luggage, pots and pans in the house, and put other things in their own places.
The Qi family’s house was newly pasted years ago, with snow-white wallpaper on the top, and a circle of colorful paper walls underneath.
Everywhere in the house is quite clean, there is no need to clean it at all, just install the furniture.
The layout of the new house is not the same as Xu's, it is Beikang.
Under the south window is a wall of fire, which warms the house in winter and puts things on it in summer.
The kangqin is still placed on the top of the kang, along the foot of the east wall, two boxes are placed on the shelf, and a chest of drawers is placed in the corner of the south wall.
Put a thermos pot, tea tray, and tea cups on top of the chest of drawers.
The East House is lived by Xu Shiyan and his wife, while the West House is left to Xu Shiqin. There are two boxes on the Westing Kang and a table on the ground, which looks a little empty.
"I'll buy Lao Liu another set of furniture later, at least a kangqin and a cabinet. Otherwise, there's nowhere to put her things."
Xu Chenghou turned around and said to Xu Shiyan.
"Father, don't worry about that, just make do with it for the time being.
This year, take a break. Next year, I plan to build five houses in Xitou. Then I will find someone to build the furniture together. The complete set will look good. "
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, and hurriedly told his father about his plan.
"Huh? You want to build five more houses? Why build so many houses?
Just these few people, building so many houses will be empty by then, which is useless. "
Xu Chenghou didn't understand, what was his son thinking about? A total of three people in the family, and build five more houses?
They live in three rooms along the Dongjiang River, and they live in more than a dozen people. Why do they need such a big house? How much firewood do you need to burn in winter?
"Father, if you don't understand, you will understand later. Now, cover it quickly, it belongs to us."
In these years, the land is collectively owned by the brigade, and there is no such thing as a use certificate, whoever occupies it is whoever owns it.
You have to take advantage of the opportunity to occupy more space. It is rare to find such a spacious place in the future.
Xu Shiyan has already thought about it. If there is an opportunity in the future, he would like to buy a few more houses.
He didn't pursue too much, usually renting out someone to show the house is enough, and when it is demolished, why can't he pay a sum of money?
Money will only get worse in the future, so it’s better to save a house.
Xu Chenghou was still old-fashioned and didn't understand what his son was thinking, "Whatever, anyway, the money is yours, you can figure it out.
Just don’t waste all the money in your hand. Don’t forget that you will become a father soon, and you will have to save money to be your son’s wife in the future. "
This old man, before his grandson was born, he is already thinking about his granddaughter-in-law.
"I know, don't worry."
Xu Shiyan smiled, didn't talk to his father anymore, but went outside the gate, took out money from his pocket, and handed it to the driver.
"Brother, I'm too busy moving today, and I don't have time to entertain you. You can use this money to buy two bottles of wine. Thank you, brother."
The driver saw that the money Xu Shiyan gave him, after deducting the gas money, still had a lot of money left over, which was several times higher than a day's wages.
In addition, he got two packs of cigarettes before, the driver was very happy now, and said with a pat on the chest, if Xu Shiyan still used the car in the future, he would go to the Banshihe Forest Farm Transport Team to find him.
Xu Shiyan naturally agreed, and just like that, the driver happily drove away.
"Old Wu, hurry to the supply and marketing cooperative and buy some tobacco, alcohol, sugar and tea.
If you have any canned food, buy a few more, and save the big guys for a meal at noon. "
They are all good friends, and there is also this neighbor in the neighborhood, who came to help move in the cold weather, so he had to cook a meal.
"By the way, when you come back, stop by the Zhou family's second brother's and ask the second brother and Qing Guo to have dinner."
Xu Shixiang studied in Donggang high school, of course he is familiar with this place, took the money, and ran to the supply and marketing cooperative in no time.
Xu Shiyan turned around and greeted everyone to come in and sit down.
In the kitchen, Su Anying and Xu Shiqin were already busy, lighting a fire to boil water, finding out the meat they brought over and serving them up, preparing to cook for the guests.
The advantage here over Dongjiangyan is that there is a well in the yard, so you don’t have to carry water all day long like in Dongjiangyan. This is much more convenient.
Su Anying worked swiftly, despite her big belly, she didn't delay her work at all, and with Xu Shiqin's help, she got six dishes right in a short time.
For a while, I heard all kinds of noises in the kitchen, and after a while, I didn't know what was going on, but the fragrance came out anyway.
"Third brother, what is my sister-in-law doing in the outhouse?
Oh, my sister-in-law is heavy, so don't bother her, we won't eat here, we'll go back when we talk. "
Yang Chunming noticed something was wrong, so he hurriedly asked Xu Shiyan.
"Is that okay? I'm moving today, you've been busy with this for a long time, and you can't even eat?
Don't worry, your sister-in-law is working quickly, and there is still the sixth child. "
Xu Shiyan is not worried about his wife, but in front of so many people, he, the head of the family, can't leave the guests alone and go cook, right?
Fortunately, there is still the sixth child, sister-in-law and sister-in-law, so it is no problem to cook a few dishes.
At this time, Xu Shixiang, Zhou Changhe, Zhou Qingguo, and several cadres of the brigade entered the yard together.
Needless to say, the cadres of the brigade must have been called by Zhou Qingguo, who was helping Xu Shiyan to contact people.
Qi’s house has an advantage, the windows are not pasted with window paper, but inlaid with glass.
When someone comes in from outside, the person inside the room can see it at a glance.
Xu Shiyan saw the situation outside from the window, and hurried out of the house to meet him.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Technology is what it is
chapters.content:
Chapter 111 Technology is skill
"Xiao Xu, how often do you see yourself? You should tell me about the move. Our brigade is full of people. Let's arrange some people to help you move."
When Yu Shouguang saw Xu Shiyan, he complained half-truthfully. Of course, this was just polite talk.
Of course Xu Shiyan understood, but he didn't really take it to heart, he just smiled.
"Aren't I afraid that Secretary Yu is too busy to bother me?
A friend of mine works in the logistics of the Forestry Bureau, so I asked him to help find a truck.
All moved here in one car, no worry. "
The truck stopped in front of my house just now, and many people saw it. There is nothing to hide from this.
"Hey, you even have acquaintances in the Forestry Bureau, that's great. You can't be an ordinary person at first sight."
Yu Shouguang's praise is sincere.
The Forestry Bureau is the best unit in the area. It must be unusual to be able to contact the logistics staff of the agency and ask them to help find a car.
Xu Shiyan couldn't continue with these words, so he could only call Yu Shouguang and his party into the room, and then introduced each other to everyone.
Yu Shouguang didn't have much airs, and he was very kind when he met Xu Chenghou. After seeing Xu Shixian's brothers, he praised him even more.
Indeed, the five brothers of the Xu family are outstanding regardless of their physical appearance.
There were Xu Chenghou, Xu Shixian and others talking in the room, Xu Shiyan hurried to the kitchen to have a look.
"Daughter-in-law, how many dishes are you going to cook? What are you going to have?"
With so many people coming, we must cook some decent dishes, not too cheap.
"Rabbit meat stewed with potatoes, chicken stewed with mushrooms, mixed wild boar, stewed fine scales, stir-fried roe deer meat, braised venison.
Lao Wu bought a few more cans just now, I was thinking about adding another luncheon meat, braised pork vermicelli and cabbage, do you think it will work? "
Since Xu Shiyan bought the house and decided to move, Su Anying began to prepare.
The rabbit meat, pheasant, wild pork, etc., are all stewed in advance by her, put in a basin and frozen outside.
At this time, the temperature is still very low, and it just freezes into a lump. When using it, take it in the house and wait. If it doesn’t work, just pour it into the pot and add some soup to stew it.
Su Anying is a woman who knows how to live a good life. The meat at home is not too willing to eat. Isn't this coming in handy?
Xu Shiyan gave his daughter-in-law a thumbs up when he heard it, "Okay, it has to be my daughter-in-law, she's really capable."
Eight dishes, all of which are meat, this size, no one else. "Daughter-in-law has worked hard."
With these eight dishes, Xu Shiyan is completely at ease.
There are still guests in the house, and it is not easy for him to stay in the kitchen, so he hurried into the house.
In the east room, everyone gathered together to chat casually, talking nonsense from all over the world.
Anyway, men are like this, three points can also blow out seven points, as long as the atmosphere is lively enough.
Of course, Xu Shiyan was the one who talked the most.
Yang Chunming and others were afraid that Xu Shiyan would be squeezed out when he first arrived, so they had to talk about Xu Shiyan's work in the big house.
For example, watching ginseng, hunting, Zhao Jianshe, who is straight, also mentioned the method of increasing production with a stick that Xu Shiyan said before.
"When I heard that my third brother was going to move out that day, my dad couldn't bear it. He said before that he wanted my third brother to be a technician."
Don’t think that Zhao Jianshe is stupid, as stupid people also have stupid eyes.
These words seemed to be said casually, but they caught the attention of Yu Shouguang and others.
"Yo, Xiao Xu, I didn't expect you to know a lot about this kind of ginseng.
Come on, talk to me carefully, we will discuss it, if it is feasible, we will try it this year. "
The second brigade is not Dongjiangyan, the family has a big business, and it is not easy to get some bean cakes?
Don’t adjust too much in the first year, just a few tens of feet to see the effect. If the effect is good, it will be terrible in the future.
When he was in the big house, Xu Shiyan didn’t hide anything. Now that he’s moved to the Second Brigade, he wants to take root here in the future.
Therefore, Xu Shiyan talked to Yu Shouguang and others about how to use bean cakes to ferment and top-dress ginseng to increase production and income.
After listening, Yu Shouguang and the others patted their thighs happily.
They are all old farmers, and they know it is reliable when they hear it.
"Come on, Xiao Xu, you will be responsible for this in spring.
Waiting for the mallet next fall, it will really work, I will mention you as a technician. " Yu Shouguang said immediately.
The main reason is that Xu Shiyan has just arrived, so he can't mention it directly, and he has to make some achievements. If he speaks this way again, others will be convinced.
"Don't worry, Secretary Yu, as long as I know what I know, I will definitely not hide it.
As for the technician or something, I don’t ask for it, as long as I can live a stable life. "
Xu Shiyan was as humble as ever, and at first glance he was a very honest and honest person.
Just talking lively, the meal is ready. But with so many people, one table is not enough.
Fortunately, the neighbor spoke up, so he hurried to borrow a table.
So there was one table on the kang, one table on the ground, eight dishes were served, the wine was full, good wine and food were good to entertain, who would not be happy to see it?
"Well, nephew, daughter-in-law, eldest niece, you two should come over and have some food too. We'll list a bunch of places, and you two will come and sit."
Seeing Su Anying turning around to go out, Yu Shouguang hurriedly greeted her.
"Uncle, there's no need. We don't drink alcohol, so we don't eat in the house. We still have food and everything. The sixth child and I can just eat in the Westinghouse.
There is still rhubarb rice in the pot, so I looked at the pot.
Uncle, if you need anything, just call me, and I will get it. "Su Anying smiled and came out of the east room.
"Little sister, we won't go to the east room to eat. After the rhubarb rice is cooked, we will eat in the west room.
They were drinking and smoking, so the house couldn't stay. "Su Anying whispered to Xu Shiqin.
"Well, I know, just now when I brought food inside the house, I almost choked on the smell of smoke." Xu Shiqin laughed when he heard that.
Smoking, drinking, and bragging are indispensable for men to get together. The old Northeast tobacco smells so strong that everyone in the family smokes, not to mention this house. Most people can't stand it.
"Anyway, we cook a lot of dishes, and it would be better for the two of us to stop and eat at Westinghouse."
Most of the locals are like this. When guests come to the house, they are all accompanied by men, and the women find another place to eat.
There are very few families where the women are too busy to serve the table, and have to wait for the guests to finish eating before sitting down to pick up the leftovers.
Just like that, the men ate, drank, talked and laughed in the east room.
Su Anying and Xu Shiqin were in the Westinghouse, serving a small pot of stewed chicken with mushrooms, and some other dishes, such as rhubarb rice, which were also delicious.
At three o'clock in the afternoon, the meal was finished.
After dinner, the big guys chatted for a while, but it was getting late.
Xu Chenghou and the others had to go back to Dongjiangyan, so they had to leave quickly.
When Yu Shouguang heard this, he immediately arranged for people to put on two sledges and send Xu Chenghou and others back to the big house.
As soon as these people entered the village, someone noticed them, and those who owed them became curious and insisted on asking.
Yang Chunming and the others deliberately talked about moving.
Especially how the cadres of the Second Brigade valued Xu Shiyan and wanted Xu Shiyan to be a technician.
Then it didn't take long before everyone in the village knew about it.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: write a letter
chapters.content:
Chapter 112 Letter writing
How Hu Liancheng and others regretted being angry after hearing the news, I will not mention it for the time being.
Just talking about Xu Shiyan, seeing off his father, brother and others, hurriedly opened the door of the east room and the door of the outer room, and let the smell of smoke outside, so that Su Anying would not be able to sleep at night.
The weather is quite cold at this time, and the door cannot be left open all the time, even if the heat escapes.
So when the smell of smoke dissipated, the door of the outer room was closed.
"Liu Liu, I remember you brought a stack of letter paper? Do you have a pen? Find one for me."
Xu Shiyan remembered one thing, and asked Xu Shiqin for letter paper and a pen.
Xu Shiqin came as an apprentice. She was afraid that she might not remember what the master taught, so she brought a pen and paper.
I plan to learn what I learned during the day, and write it down when I get home at night.
At this moment, the third brother wanted a pen and paper, so Xu Shiqin obediently found letter paper and a pen for the third brother to use.
"Brother, what are you doing? Are you planning to write a letter?" Xu Shiqin asked casually.
"Well, the family we bought the house was surnamed Qi, he was admitted to the University of Medicine, and left an address for me when he left.
I wrote a letter to him, one is to thank him for moving away without cleaning up the things made at home, and left us a lot of things.
There is one more thing, I want him to help inquire about Mr. Chu's news.
After waiting for two years, our side is stable, save some money, I will take you to the provincial capital to see and treat your illness. "
The younger sister's problem is also Xu Shiyan's heart disease. He has been thinking about it all the time, but he suffers from having no way out.
When Elder Chu was in Daying, he didn't mention his address in the provincial capital. Xu Shiyan only knew that he was a professor of the University of Medical Sciences or something, but there was nowhere to look for him right now.
It happened that Qi Yunsheng was admitted to the University of Medical Sciences, and asked him to help him find it. If he had any news, he would be able to contact Mr. Chu.
Xu Shiqin's problem is not likely to be cured. After all, Mr. Chu has status, so maybe he can find a good doctor.
As soon as Xu Shiqin heard what his brother said, tears fell, "Third brother, I can't cure this problem.
My mother took me to Hunjiang and Tonghua before, and the doctor said, I can’t rule by law. "
When Xu Shiqin was six or seven years old, Zhou Guilan took her out to see a doctor.
At that time, the doctor said directly, just eat whatever is delicious when you take it home, and don’t think too much about it.
It's not easy for Xu Shiqin to grow up to such a big age. She didn't dare to think that she could cure her disease.
"Why do you think you are crying? What year are you talking about? More than ten years have passed, why is there no progress in medicine?
Don't worry, no matter how intractable it is, as long as there is a way, I will treat it for you. If it doesn't work, let's go to the capital. "
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan watched with his own eyes how his younger sister suffered when she got older.
There is not enough space in the chest cavity, the internal organs are squeezed, and there is no room for the heart and lungs to relax.
That's why Xu Shiqin was always out of breath, panicked, suffered from cardiopulmonary syndrome, and his face turned blue when he died.
In this life, Xu Shiyan does not ask for anything else, but hopes that there is some way to correct Xu Shiqin's spine.
Let Xu Shiqin not suffer when he gets older.
It is estimated that this is not easy, it will cost a lot of money, but no matter how much money is spent, it is not as important as my sister.
"That would cost a lot of money, brother, how can we have that kind of money?"
Xu Shiqin was still crying, sobbing and saying something in despair.
No matter what year it is, poor people can’t look down on medical care, let alone a problem like Xu Shiqin’s, which cannot be solved by a few hundred thousand.
No matter how much more, Xu Shiqin couldn't figure out when their family would get so much money.
Even if there is so much money, who would be willing to spend it on her medical treatment?
After all, from the current point of view, Xu Shiqin just has a hunchback on her back, which is neither painful nor itchy, and does not affect her life.
Spending a lot of money for such a problem, others will definitely think that Xu Shiyan is a psychopath and his brain is not normal.
"Earn money slowly, brother think of a way, you also learn to cut well, save some by yourself.
No matter how long it takes, as long as there is hope, we have to work hard. "
There will be money, there will definitely be, and when a person is alive, there must be something to think about and something to look forward to.
In order to treat his younger sister, he will definitely work hard to earn money.
"Okay, you go to pack your luggage with your third sister-in-law first, and write a letter."
Xu Shiyan still has things to do, so he can't always coax his sister here.
Xu Shiqin wiped away his tears when he heard this, and ran to help Su Anying pack her clothes and luggage, and found out all kinds of curtains, and hung them up tomorrow morning.
Xu Shiyan said here that he wrote a letter to Qi Yunsheng, but in fact he wrote more than one letter.
One was sent to Qi Yunsheng in the provincial capital, and the other was sent to Daying to Su Weizhong. If he moved, he had to tell his father-in-law the address.
There is another letter, which Xu Shiyan intends to send to the county.
Hu Liancheng and Cao Mingchuan from Xigang Commune, they made random accusations, framed others, and wantonly suppressed and retaliated against them by taking advantage of their work.
Xu Shiyan is just a commoner, and he really can't fight them openly, but it's not that he has no tricks at all.
At present, the province is sending people to the county to inspect the work, rectify the discipline, and correct the mistakes of the past few years.
Xu Shiyan has lived in Daying for so many years, and also lived in Dongjiangyan for seven or eight years. He knows some things very well.
Especially Cao Mingchuan, it seems that he was investigated in the spring of 1979 in his last life. In the end, many things were found out, and he was directly finished.
Xu Shiyan directly wrote down everything he knew and sent it to the county working group. If someone really saw it, it would be enough for those guys to drink a pot.
In case of bad luck and no movement, then wait until next year. Anyway, Skynet will be restored, so it’s not that the time has not come yet.
Xu Shiyan finished writing the letter and carefully hid it. It was getting late, so he hurriedly washed and rested.
The next morning, Xu Shiyan took the letter and led Xu Shiqin to Songjianghe.
First go to the bureau building to find Guo Shouye, and express my gratitude to Guo Shouye for helping to find a car.
When Guo Shouye saw Xu Shiyan leading a girl, they looked similar, so he guessed that this was Xu Shiyan's younger sister.
Guo Shouye immediately stated that he had already made an agreement with the tailor shop, and Xu Shiyan would just lead the people there.
"You just say that I let you pass, and you have already greeted me over there, don't worry."
It took no effort for Guo Shouye to say a word.
Just like that, the brother and sister left the office building and went straight to the tailor shop next to the Songlin store.
The master over there was very enthusiastic when he heard that Director Guo had introduced him. He grabbed Xu Shiqin's hand and asked this and that.
When I learned that Xu Shiqin had some tailoring skills, I was even happier.
Directly arranged some simple tasks for Xu Shiqin, such as locking buttonholes and cutting trousers, and asked her to practice her hands first.
Accepting apprentices is actually finding people to do the work. Whether the master teaches or not is entirely up to conscience.
If it was in the old society, the apprentices would be provided with food and housing for three years, but the master would have to do all the work at home, washing clothes, cooking and taking care of the children.
Moreover, the master doesn’t teach anything, he learns all by himself secretly, all relying on understanding.
It is much better now, Xu Shiqin is an apprentice here, and takes care of lunch at noon.
After finishing their studies, they can stay in the store to work, or they can take the work back home and do it on a piece-rate basis.
Anyway, as long as the craftsmanship is good, you can make a living anywhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: settle down
chapters.content:
Chapter 113 Settlement
With director Guo's face, the masters of the tailor shop will take care of Xu Shiqin to some extent.
Apprentices don’t produce results in a few days, they have to learn slowly.
Xu Shiyan told her younger sister to learn skills from her master, don't be afraid of hardship and tiredness, have good eyesight, and don't be lazy.
After Xu Shiqin settled down, Xu Shiyan left, went directly to the post office, bought envelopes, stamped them, wrote down the address, and mailed the letters separately.
He has done everything he can do, and then he can only wait patiently for the result.
Xu Shiyan returned to Donggang and went directly to the team headquarters.
Donggang Commune is located in the Changbai Mountains. The area under its jurisdiction is 51.5 kilometers long from east to west and 31 kilometers wide from north to south. It has ten brigades under its jurisdiction.
The commune has three brigades directly under the resident, as well as a forest farm, an industrial general factory, a building materials general factory, a health center, a middle school, and a central primary school.
At the same time, the local state-owned Fusong No. 1 Farm is also within the jurisdiction of Donggang.
The three brigades are basically arranged from east to west, and the first brigade is at the easternmost side of the commune, connecting with the state-owned first camp.
The second brigade is in the middle, and the third brigade is in the west.
South of the commune is a series of mountains, the most famous of which is Paotai Mountain. There is a cave under the mountain, which is said to be an air-raid shelter.
It is said that there is a coal seam under the Paotai Mountain, and it is a rare white coal, but the reserves are too low and the mining cost is too high, so it has not been mined.
There is a river at the foot of Paotai Mountain, known as the Huangni River.
The headquarters of the three brigades are not too far from the bank of the Huangni River from east to west.
The team headquarters of the Second Brigade is a small two-story building, newly built not long ago, with green and white painted stones as walls on the outside, and snow-white white gray walls on the inside.
Compared to the team headquarters of the first and third teams, which are all small bungalows, the team headquarters of the second team is much more grand.
It can also be proved from the side that the conditions of the second team are indeed much better than other teams.
Xu Shiyan entered the team headquarters, found Yu Shouguang on the second floor, and handed over their husband and wife's household registration documents to Yu Shouguang.
"Secretary Yu, this is the household registration of my wife and I. My sixth sister's will not be moved here for the time being."
Yu Shouguang took over the household registration and arranged for someone to settle down. The Second Brigade had five production teams, and Xu Shiyan was assigned to the first team.
"Wait until the spring begins, let the captain of your team take you to the mountain to draw a private plot.
You can grow some grains and beans at home. "
In the past, private plots were not allowed to grow food, only vegetables, but now the control is not so strict, you can grow whatever you want, as long as it is not illegal.
"In addition, starting tomorrow, you will help the brigade with some work.
I will arrange a few people for you, and you will take them to the industry, and make all kinds of guns, crackers, etc. quickly.
I'll leave this matter to you, it must be done. "
After the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, the ginseng land will start to work, and those who see ginseng will also go up the mountain.
Yu Shouguang meant that since ground guns are so useful, they must be equipped as soon as possible.
"Success, don't worry the secretary, I will definitely handle this matter carefully, and it will be safe to keep."
Xu Shiyan arranged an errand for him as soon as he arrived in the second brigade, so he was naturally happy.
Only when he has something to do can he have a chance to perform. If he is not used for anything, when will he be able to make his mark?
He just hangs around behind others all day long, and never gets his turn, so why did he move to Donggang?
On the twelfth day of the first lunar month, the team really sent five young men to help Xu Shiyan to make ground guns and other reference tools.
Donggang Commune has an industrial general factory, which is separated from the headquarters of the Second Brigade by a north-south road. The team headquarters is in the east of the road, and the industry is in the west of the road.
In the industrial factory, there are all kinds of machine tools, which can process various parts, which are much better than the blacksmith furnace in Xigang Commune.
Yu Shouguang had already greeted the people in the industry. Xu Shiyan went there, drew the design drawing of the ground gun, made a request, and began to process the parts there.
and all other parts are all processed, and Xu Shiyan leads people to assemble and test.
The parts produced by industrial machine tools are much more precise than those made by blacksmith furnaces.
Load the gunpowder and gun sand, and lay the iron wire.
Arrange a piece of plywood in front of the muzzle of the ground gun, and pull the iron wire with a rope.
With a bang, the gun sand was sprayed out, and the plywood with a thickness of five millimeters was penetrated by the gun sand and made into a sieve.
"Fuck, this thing is too powerful, right?"
All the cadres of the brigade went to see the test. When they saw the plywood with a sieve bottom, everyone was dumbfounded.
With this power, if you put 30 to 50 people around the venue, and cooperate with some crackers, who dares to run to the venue?
"Xiao Xu, okay, this thing you made is too powerful.
