Is that so, next, you will be in charge of this, first get thirty or fifty for our brigade.
Our brigade is more than 10,000 feet tall, and there are six people in the team on the mountain. If we have this kind of gun, it will be easier to see the reference. "
The second brigade's venue is near the No. 2 bridge on the west side, which is the road going along the Dongjiang River, halfway to the south branch.
The second brigade has a total of about 12,000 feet of land, and the surrounding environment is very complicated. There are many idle people in Songjianghe, and the pressure to see the participants is relatively high.
Especially after the Dongjiangyan brigade lost ginseng last year, this side also attaches great importance to it, increasing from the original three to six ginseng.
In this way, the cost of work points and so on will increase. Although the second team's family is not bad, it is always a heart problem.
If ground guns and crackers are used around the field, the pressure on the spectators can be relieved, and three or four people can be removed to come back to work.
The ground gun is dead, and it can be used for many years after it is made, and it does not eat grass and does not give work points, which is great.
"Hey, don't worry, the secretary, I will definitely make this batch of ground guns as soon as possible, so as not to delay the use of spring ginseng."
The leader assigns tasks because he values ​​himself, and it's too late for Xu Shiyan to be happy.
He gets high work points for all his work. Now that everyone else is idle at home, he can earn work points. Isn’t that great?
In this way, Xu Shiyan led the people to stay in the industry for three or four days.
According to Yu Shouguang's request, he made 30 ground guns, more than 100 pull cannons, and made some traps for trapping animals.
The people who work in the industry are mostly members of the third brigade. Many people are curious about the ground gun that Xu Shiyan got, and they have to mention it when they go home.
As a result, within a few days, the other two brigades and the commune participated in the field, and they all knew that the second brigade had assembled a baby for reference.
Yu Shouguang was called to the commune, and the leaders of the first brigade, the second brigade, and the commune participated in besieging him together.
"You old boy, you don't pay attention to it. If you have a good thing, you hide it and don't want others to know it. It's too dishonest."
"That's right, that's right, thanks to the fact that we all belong to the same commune, you can be picky like that.
The news is hidden so deep, and none of it is leaked to us, it's so embarrassing. "
"Old Yu, come on, tell me, how did you get the gun?
I heard people say that it was drawn by a young man? Where did such a young man come from?
Your life is really good, you can meet any good things.
No, if you don’t hand over the person today, we won’t let you go back. "

chapters.title: Chapter 114: sought after
chapters.content:
Chapter 114 Wanted
Donggang is well-known as the hometown of ginseng. The annual income of ginseng planting can reach two to three million yuan, accounting for about half of the total income.
It can be said that the ginseng industry is the mainstay of Donggang Commune's income. Who doesn't pay attention to the entire commune from top to bottom?
No one wants to have the ginseng that has been planted after several years of hard work be stolen by thieves. If you have this kind of ginseng tool, why don’t you want it?
Under the siege of the crowd, Yu Shouguang couldn't hold on and had to surrender.
"Yes, yes, I say it's not enough?
Our team recently moved a family from Dongjiangyan, two young couples.
The young man was a member of the Dongjiangyan brigade before, and he stabbed the ground gun. "
When Yu Shouguang said this, his expression was not to mention how complacent, who would not be happy if he picked up a treasure for nothing?
"Grass, you old boy is really lucky, all the talents have gone to your team."
When everyone heard this, they sighed, this is really incomparable.
The Second Brigade has a great reputation, and people came here for the Second Brigade, so it's useless for them to envy them.
"Hurry up, get the young man here, let us meet.
We don't have your fate, and if they take the initiative to defect, then let them do us a favor, and give us several teams all guns. "
Envy is useless, let's be more realistic, their ultimate goal is to shoot the ground.
What can Yu Shouguang say? Can you still let me see you? This is not something their second brigade can hide.
It's pretty good now, at least come here to discuss it, if it's left before, it's an unconditional adjustment.
"It's okay to find someone to come, and it's okay to help them get the guns.
But there is one thing that was agreed in advance. It is just a gun made for you, and it is responsible for the use of the church. You have to give work points, and you can't use it for nothing.
Also, if you borrow it, you have to pay it back, don’t be like before, you never get back from a meat bun, that’s not okay. "
This kind of thing has happened before. The second brigade is rich, and when other brigades borrowed things in previous years, most of them were borrowed and disappeared.
Yu Shouguang was really worried that if this person borrowed money, he would borrow it and never return it.
That can’t be done, he is still counting on Xu Shiyan to get the bean cake fermented and top-dressed after a while, this person must not let go.
When Yu Shouguang said this, several other people showed embarrassment.
"Oh, don't worry, can we do something like that?
Besides, this is a human being, and the registered permanent residence is already in your team. What else can we do? "
Now that we’ve talked about this, what else can Yu Shouguang do? I had to ask someone to find Xu Shiyan.
Then, Xu Shiyan became a favorite, and was seconded to other brigades and communes in turn to participate in the field, leading people to make ground guns and other paraphernalia.
Not only do they give work points, but they also take care of two meals a day, serving delicious food and drinks until they learn how to make and install ground guns.
At the end of February and the first half of March, Xu Shiyan basically did nothing else, either in the industry or in the various brigades.
Take your apprentices to make ground guns and pull cannons, and teach them how to load gun powder, gun sand, how to wire, and what precautions to take.
Everything is explained carefully, for fear that these people will not be able to understand if they have only a half-knowledge.
Mainly because ground guns are too dangerous.
In the previous life, there was a person who watched the ginseng. He installed a ground gun by himself, but one day he drank too much and accidentally tripped on it, collapsed himself, and was seriously injured in the hospital.
Therefore, Xu Shiyan reminded thousands of people to be careful when using it.
Fortunately, those who can be selected as apprentices are all bright and clever young people, who can learn things quickly and solidly.
Xu Shiyan personally checked and accepted the results after teaching, and he was relieved that everyone did well.
Xu Shiyan is serious and careful in his work, has skills but is not arrogant, and never looks up to the sky just because of his ability.
No matter who he is, he is very kind to everyone, and he speaks very steadily, without talking crazy words at all.
During the days when he was seconded to work in other brigades, he was very popular.
The boys who followed him as apprentices all admired him, and when they left after teaching, the big guy was quite reluctant.
They all said that if there was anything in Xu Shiyan's family in the future, they would ask them to keep it.
In the blink of an eye, it was late March, and the weather was getting warmer. The snow on the sunny **** had melted a lot, but the shady **** was still covered with thick ice and snow.
At this time, the work of ginseng can no longer be waited, and we must hurry up to build a shed.
The bases of the pillars were smashed last winter. At this time, it is necessary to arrange for people to go up, nail the poles of the Dalian to the feet of the pillars, and then nail the mallet boards to the poles of the Dalian.
Before the sticks are unearthed, cover all the ginseng sheds to prevent the ginseng from being exposed to rain.
Ginseng is too delicate, and it will rot if it is exposed to rain, which will reduce the production.
The jobs in the ginseng area are all young and strong guys. In the past, along the Dongjiang River, most of them didn't have Xu Shiyan's share.
Moving to Donggang was different. The captain of the small team directly arranged for Xu Shiyan to work on the mountain.
Participating in land work with high work points, who wouldn’t like it?
So, Xu Shiyan, who had just finished shooting, cheerfully followed others up the mountain to work.
It is not difficult to build a shed on the ground. First, use a saw to saw a V-shaped notch on the top of the column foot, and then saw off half of each end of the large connecting pole.
Two large connecting poles are built together, just to support the notches at the base of the columns, and then directly nailed in with six-inch big nails.
Lay the mallet board on the top, and nail it with nails.
The ginseng shed doesn’t need to be left untouched for three years after it’s finished. In winter, the wooden boards should be taken down to let the snow fall on the surface of the ginseng pool.
New planting is to make a full set of sheds, freezing and making goods is to only re-nail batten boards, thatch grass or linoleum paper.
So every spring, work is very busy.
The second brigade is not Dongjiangyan. Last year, a total of 3,000 feet of sticks were planted here, which is more than Dongjiangyan in total.
It takes a long time to build a shed just for these new plants.
"Captain, did we lose our big league pole? I clearly remembered to pick up enough last year, why is it not enough?"
I worked for a few days, and when I saw it was about to end, I found that there were not enough poles in Dalian, and it was still a hundred feet away, which was useless.
Wang Jiaren, the captain of the small team, came over to take a look.
There are only about 20 poles left on the ground, and there are many useless ones left on the ground.
"I can't tell, we are too close to the Songjiang River.
In winter, no one is watching, if you don’t keep everything, you will be owed. If you don’t go to the woods to collect firewood, come and steal from us. "
Wang Jiaren sighed. "It's okay, you guys take axes and saws, go to the woods to pick up some more, what can you do?"
So a small group of young men, armed with axes and saws, went into the woods to find suitable wood.
As a result, not long after entering the forest, I saw a group of brown-gray beasts running towards us on the hillside in the distance.
"Roe deer, it's roe deer, hurry up, drive them to the shady slope."
They are all people living in the forest area, how can they not know the roe deer? Now, everyone was happy, and someone shouted loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 115: beat the roe deer
chapters.content:
Chapter 115 Beating Roe Deer with Sticks
Roe deer looks like a deer, but is much smaller than a deer.
It is covered with thick, gray-brown bright hair, but there are no spots on the belly like sika deer. ,
Some roe deer have short three-pronged horns on their heads, while others don't.
This thing has slender legs and is extremely good at running and jumping. It runs very fast, and usually the hunting dogs can't catch it.
Roe deer are docile by nature and have no ability to attack, so they all live in groups.
It likes to inhabit places with a lot of grass and sparse forests, and often moves in secluded bushes.
The group of roe deer in front of me looked like there were more than a dozen of them. They were running extremely fast, and they were about to run in front of everyone.
It was Xu Shiyan who reacted quickly and immediately called out to everyone to drive the group of roe deer north.
So everyone immediately raided from the south, swung axes, saws and other tools in their hands, and drove the roe deer to the north.
The roe deer was running, and when it saw a person, it panicked immediately, and saw someone holding something to chase them from the south, so it turned around and ran north.
Bypassing the mountain bag, there is a large shady **** to the north.
At this time, the temperature is high during the day, and the snow melts and becomes soft and loose. At night, the temperature is low, and a smooth hard cover is frozen on top of the snow.
Those roe deer had slender legs and small hooves. They rushed to the snow on the shady **** and got stuck in the snow.
The snow under the ground is too hard, and the roe deer is stuck in the snow and cannot move.
There is an old saying in the mountains, "Falling snow chases out rabbits, melts snow to hunt roe deer". It's the situation right now.
Seeing that a dozen or so roe deer were all stuck in the snow, everyone was overjoyed.
Go forward with the tool in your hand, hit the roe deer on the head, and knock the roe deer down.
Beating roe deer with a stick, that's how it came about.
Seeing that none of the dozen or so roe deer escaped, everyone was very happy, so they dragged the roe deer out of the snow.
Now, I don’t care about picking up the big couplets anymore, I’ll deal with the roe deer first.
"Wait a minute, I'll go over there and take a look."
Xu Shiyan felt that something was wrong, so he dropped the roe deer in his hand and looked for it in the direction where the roe deer ran over just now.
Walking out for two or three miles, I found a dead roe deer on the snow in the woods.
A male roe deer, quite big, surrounded by blood.
I don’t know what was bitten to death, my heart, liver and lungs were ripped out, and some of the flesh on my body was gnawed.
Xu Shiyan looked around, and there were still a few footprints of plum blossoms with five petals on the remaining snow. Just look at the footprints and you will know that it is a wolf.
Just now, it should be that the roe deer group was targeted by wild wolves and killed a big male roe deer.
The rest of the roe deer ran away in panic, but met them head-on, and finally, the whole army was wiped out.
The wolf must have heard someone and scared away, leaving behind the roe deer's body.
Xu Shiyan dragged the dead roe deer all the way back to join the crowd.
"Hey, Brother Xu, you are still amazing, and picked up another one. What killed it?"
The boys were very curious when they saw it, so they came to look at the wound.
"It's a wolf, let's work around here, be careful." The sooner the spring begins, the more careful it is.
Everyone’s expressions were serious, and they nodded solemnly, “Well, you have to be careful.
In the future, when we go into the woods, don't be alone, let's go together. "
Now, I don’t care about picking up the roe deer, let’s get the roe deer back to the venue first.
A dozen or so young men each dragged a roe deer back to the arena. This time, they made the other teams envious.
"Didn't you go into the forest to pick up the big couplet poles? Why did you drag the roe deer back? Where did you meet?"
The boys talked about the incident in a hurry, and the others felt emotional after hearing it.
Isn't this luck too good? Just go into the mountains to pick up a big joint pole, and you can also meet a group of roe deer chased by wolves?
Alas, there is no comparison between people.
Wang Jiaren also came over, looking at the roe deer that these people under his hands made, he also followed suit.
"Come on, hurry up and cut open the skin. If you cover it for a long time, it will stink."
A group of boys, why are you being polite? He hurriedly searched for his belongings, and disemboweled and skinned a dozen or so roe deer.
No need to work in the afternoon, Wang Jiaren left work for these people in his team in advance, the big guys divided the roe deer meat, and drove the carriage all the way home happily.
"Daughter-in-law, do you see what I brought back?"
Xu Shiyan returned home with half a roe deer on his shoulders, and said loudly before entering the house.
Since I came to Donggang, I have been busy, and I have no guns in my hands, so I have no chance to go hunting in the mountains.
The meat that was originally brought from the Dongjiang River could not hold back as the weather got warmer, and Su Anying had marinated it into bacon. The family hadn't eaten fresh meat for some days.
Xu Shiyan opened the door and entered the room while talking, but there was no sign of Su Anying in the kitchen.
Stretching his head into the east room, he saw his mother Zhou Guilan sitting on the kang, "Mom, why are you here?"
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, why is mom here at this time?
"What's wrong? I can't come?" Zhou Guilan gave her son a white look.
"We're looking at April, and I estimate that your wife is only half a month and twenty days away from having a baby.
Then I have to come and take care of it? Or count on you? "Zhou Guilan laughed as she spoke.
"My mother brought two old hens, a basket of eggs, and made small quilts, small clothes, and urinals for the children."
Su Anying got off the ground with her big belly, and asked Xu Shiyan to put the meat down.
"This is roe deer meat? Didn't you go up the mountain to work? Why are you still hunting roe deer?"
Today's Su Anying is no longer the little daughter-in-law who knew nothing before.
I followed Xu Shiyan on the mountain last winter, and I saw all kinds of prey, and I recognized it at a glance. It was roe deer meat.
"Well, it's roe deer meat.
There are not enough poles on the mountain, so we went into the mountain to pick them up, but we met a group of roe deer, and we drove them back into the snowy nest on the shady slope. "
Xu Shiyan didn't mention the wolf biting the roe deer, for fear that his mother and daughter-in-law would worry.
"Mom, how is your house? I've been busy since I moved here, and I couldn't even go back for the Lantern Festival. Is there anything going on at home?"
Xu Shiyan put the roe deer meat in a big basin, took it to the kitchen, and went back to the house to talk with his mother.
"There is nothing wrong with the family. After fifteen, I decided to divide the family.
The fourth child brought his wife back to Qingling. He works there, and the Wu family is also there. Years ago, I made some money with you. It is enough to go out and find a house. "
Bringing the separation, Zhou Guilan looked a little lonely.
As an elderly person, who doesn’t want their children and grandchildren to be around?
"Your second brother and his wife have moved out, and they happened to borrow the house of Old Litou's house.
Just wait for a homestead to be approved from the team, and then build another house.
When Xiaobo and Xiaotao grow up, they also have a house for them to get married and a wife. "
Zhou Guilan thinks so far, even thinking about her grandson marrying a wife.
"Your elder brother is with us, and your father and I will be gone in the future, and the house will be theirs.
You brothers don’t have to worry about it. It’s been like this since ancient times. Whoever takes care of the elderly will get the family property. "
According to the logic, it should be divided in this way. The eldest son and the eldest son should provide for the parents, and everything in the family belongs to the eldest son.

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Li Qiang
chapters.content:
Chapter 116 Ground Spear Li Qiang
Xu Shiyan was silent for a long time after hearing what his mother said.
It's not that he is thinking about the family property, but he is thinking about how to arrange for his parents in the future.
Don't look at the boss couple talking well now, when Xue Xiulin can return to the city, the couple must find a way to leave their parents behind and move out.
"Mom, don't let the second brother build a house along the Dongjiang River.
The elder sister-in-law and the second sister-in-law have to go back to Songjianghe sooner or later, in that dilapidated place along the Dongjiang River, building a house is just a waste of money.
Waiting to move out, you can't get a penny back. "
Who wants the house in that dilapidated place? Those who have money to burn build houses there.
"Ah? Didn't you say that married educated youths are not allowed to return to the city? Your second brother can't always live in someone else's house."
Zhou Guilan has not been reborn, so naturally she doesn't know what will happen a year later. What the third son said made him a little puzzled.
"The policy will change, shouldn't we start to turn over the previous account now?
So many people go to the countryside, and only those who are not married are allowed to return to the city. Can other people have no idea?
Many people are sneaking back to the city now, and there will be more in the future. "Xu Shiyan said very firmly.
"Mom, when you go back and tell my second brother, don't build a house, you just say I said it, and you will definitely suffer if you build it."
Today's Xu Shiyan is not what he used to be. He has a lot of power at home, and even Xu Chenghou listens to his third son's opinion.
Zhou Guilan nodded, "What you said makes sense.
You don’t need to wait for me to go back, just find someone to send a message to go back someday. I will at least stay here until your wife’s full moon. "
Zhou Guilan is here to serve Yuezi, and she won't be going back anytime soon.
Zhou Guilan hasn't seen her son for some days, so she has to ask her about her son's situation after moving here.
As soon as I heard that Xu Shiyan had a good time here because of the ground gun, Zhou Guilan was also very happy.
"Oh, I don't remember the ground gun.
The spectator that our team was looking for, Li Qiang, was on the mountain two days ago, and his ground gun collapsed. "
Zhou Guilan suddenly remembered this matter, and hurriedly told her son.
"I heard that you didn't teach him how to do it? He went up the mountain to poke Goo himself.
As a result, one of them was not done properly, and the gunpowder touched him, and the gun sand burst out, hitting him all over. "
Originally, Hu Lancheng wanted to get Xu Shiyan back and asked Xu Shiyan to teach Li Qiang how to use the ground gun.
But Li Qiang looked down on Xu Shiyan, thinking he could do it, so he kept thinking about the gun when he went up the mountain.
He poked and mumbled to load the gun ammunition, gun sand, and wiring, but he didn’t know what he did. The gun ammunition got messed up, and the gun sand sprayed out, half of which hit Li Qiang.
Thanks to the thick clothes he was wearing at this time, and Li Qiang didn't know how to use them, so he put less gun ammunition.
But even so, Li Qiang was seriously injured.
The gun sand hit the flesh, and all had to be taken out by surgery. The injury itself was not serious, and it was a pain to have the surgery.
"Mom, didn't they shout to come to me for money?"
Xu Shiyan was not surprised at all when he heard the news. The ground gun thing really thinks it's just an individual?
Not to mention that Li Qiang has never poked Gu before, even Xu Shiyan's apprentice taught it himself, and it took a lot of effort to learn it.
Li Qiang, he asked for trouble.
"They dare? Where's the face?
Those are all made by you for reference. They are jealous when they see you living well on the mountain, and push you down in anger, so they can pick up ready-made ones.
Serve it right, how dare he ask you to lose money? Your father can beat him to death. "Zhou Guilan's eyes widened, and she looked a little difficult to mess with.
Xu Shiyan laughed out loud, "Mom, you look like my father now."
If people say that they are husband and wife, it is true. Zhou Guilan's domineering appearance just now has really imitated Xu Chenghou's appearance by 80%.
"It's been a lifetime, isn't it different?" Zhou Guilan also laughed when she heard it.
"Mom, Hu Liancheng is still the secretary of our brigade? I, Uncle Zhao, haven't resumed my duties?"
What Xu Shiyan actually wanted to ask was how Hu Liancheng and Cao Mingchuan were doing, and whether his report letter was useful.
But you can't ask directly about this, for fear of revealing your secrets.
Zhou Guilan was frightened by the eldest son at the beginning, but Xu Shiyan also imitated his elder brother's tricks, and could be so angry.
"It's still the same, Hu Liancheng's acting secretary, you, Uncle Zhao, are now ordinary people."
Zhou Guilan shook her head, not understanding why her son mentioned this.
"Mom, go back and persuade my father to move out of the big house earlier."
Since Hu Liancheng is still acting secretary, it means that Xu Shiyan's letter has no effect.
In this case, it is estimated that Hu Liancheng will have to wait until Cao Mingchuan falls next year before he can follow.
Now that what happened to Li Qiang, maybe the Xu family will have a hard time after they are in Dongjiangyan.
Xu Shiyan meant, it’s better to move out, what is there to miss in that crappy place?
"Move out? Where will you move? Also move to Donggang?
You said that your father and I moved here with the fifth child, where is your eldest brother and second brother? Our family has too many people to settle down.
No way, you just settled down in Donggang, it’s not good for us to follow you. "
Zhou Guilan actually didn't want to stay in the big house, but she loved her son even more.
With such a large family moving out, how can it be so easy to settle down? Where do you live? Where to settle down?
Xu Shiyan had to give Zhang Luo all these, but Xu Shiyan had just settled down in Donggang just now, how could he cause him such a big trouble?
When Zhou Guilan said so, Xu Shiyan didn't persuade him any more.
Anyway, he knows that the fifth child will be admitted to university this summer, and the eldest child will return to the city with his wife next year.
Forget it, just for this year, he can get by anyway, and after those few are settled, he can just persuade his parents to move out.
The mother and son hadn't seen each other for some time, so they forgot the time after talking. Zhou Guilan suddenly raised her head and realized that it was getting late.
Listen carefully, there seems to be a clanging sound in the outer room.
"Oops, I was too busy chatting with you, Yingzi is busy in the kitchen by herself."
Zhou Guilan hurriedly went to the field and went to the kitchen to help Su Anying cook.
"Yingzi, what are you chopping meat for? How about making so much meat? How about keeping it for a while before you have a baby?"
It turned out that Su Anying took a piece of roe deer meat and was chopping stuffing there. Zhou Guilan hurried over and took the kitchen knife.
"Mom, let's make dumplings and eat some cabbage at home. It just so happened that Shi Yan brought the meat back?"
It’s a rare time for my mother-in-law to come here. It just so happens that there is still some flour at home, and there is fresh roe deer meat, so I have to make dumplings.
"It will be a while before I have a baby. I can't keep this meat until then, so I can eat it when I need it."
The meat is all chopped up, so what are you talking about? bag chant.
Zhou Guilan chopped the meat with clangs, and Su Anying scooped out the noodles, added a little salt to the noodles, and woke up with cold water and noodles.
Called Xu Shiyan again, and asked him to go to the cellar behind the house and bring back two cabbages.
The house of the Qi family is well-organized. There is a pressurized well in front of the house and a cellar behind the house.
When Qi Yunsheng's family moved away, they left a lot of cabbage and radishes in the cellar, and Xu Shiyan brought some more when he moved here.
The population of the family is small, and there are still a lot of cabbage left by this time.
The temperature in the cellar is quite good, the cabbage is well preserved, the outer skin is somewhat dry, just peel it off.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: going to give birth
chapters.content:
Chapter 117 is about to give birth
Zhou Guilan gave birth to eight children in this life, raised six, and took care of five grandchildren.
Absolutely rich experience in raising children.
With Zhou Guilan coming to accompany Su Anying, Xu Shiyan can rest assured, otherwise he would have to stop working in this busy season and just stay at home with Su Anying.
Zhou Guilan came over and led Su Anying. The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law made a lot of baby clothes, quilts, quilts and other things at home.
Prepared everything needed for the birth of the child, and just waited for Su Anying to give birth.
The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law couldn't stay idle, and even baked pancakes, saving Kaichun to bring Xu Shiyan a meal.
It was Qingming in a blink of an eye, and the weather was getting warmer. People also took off their big cotton jackets and cotton trousers, and changed into sweaters and wool trousers.
The willow tree is twitching crazily, and the fluffy willow dog grows bigger and bigger.
There is that naughty child who made a whistle out of wicker, and then gathered together in groups and squeaked and blew.
It's a bit noisy, but adults don't mind it, because it's the sound of spring.
At four o'clock in the morning on April 18th, Su Anying's stomach felt tight and painful, so she reached out and pushed Xu Shiyan beside her.
"Shiyan, wake up, my stomach hurts, maybe I'm about to give birth."
Xu Shiyan got up from the kang all at once, "What's the matter? Are you sure it's about to give birth?"
It seems that he was born on April 20th in his last life. Could it be that when he is reborn, the date of birth of the child will also change?
"How are you feeling now? Does your stomach hurt badly?"
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to be careless, and while asking about his wife's situation, he put on his clothes and went to the ground.
"Well, it hurts one after another, and it hurts a little bit at the moment."
Su Anying is a very tolerant person, her stomach started hurting in the middle of the night, she kept silent.
At this moment, I really couldn't take it anymore, so I woke up Xu Shiyan.
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan knew that his wife was about to give birth, so he quickly helped Su Anying get dressed, then pushed open the door and yelled towards Westinghouse.
"Mom, Yingzi said she had a stomachache. The pain was severe. She might be about to give birth."
When Zhou Guilan from the West Room heard this, she immediately got up and dressed and came to the East Room.
"Yingzi, how are you feeling? Your stomach hurts a lot?"
At this moment, Su Anying's stomach hurts, her face is pale, and her brows are tightly frowned.
"Well, it hurts a lot, it looks like it's about to give birth."
Although it is the first child, Su Anying has heard a lot from her mother-in-law and people who have given birth around her. Knowing her situation, she should be about to give birth.
"Let's go, hurry to the hospital. Third child, help your daughter-in-law, I'll get things, let's hurry."
On the first day Zhou Guilan came to take care of her daughter-in-law, she asked Xu Shiyan, where will the baby be born?
Should I find a midwife at home, or go to the hospital.
In fact, most of the children born in rural areas these days are born at home, and very few people go to the hospital.
In her previous life, Su Anying gave birth to her first child at home.
Xu Shiyan was worried about his wife and children and refused to stay at home.
What's more, the hospital is only five or six minutes away from Xu's family. It's very close, so it's natural to go to the hospital to give birth.
Don't care how much it costs to go to the hospital, as long as Su Anying and the child are safe.
Zhou Guilan never interfered with the affairs of her son's family, and they had the right to decide about the affairs of the young couple.
So at this moment, Xu Shiyan supported Su Anying with one hand and the luggage roll with the other, while Zhou Guilan carried a bag with each hand, and the three of them walked out like this.
"Third brother, you help the third sister-in-law to walk slowly, and I will come right away."
Xu Shiqin just woke up from a deep nap at his age.
At the moment, I don't care about anything else, I put on my clothes and locked the door, followed me out in a hurry, and went straight to the hospital.
Donggang Commune Hospital is just behind the middle school.
Actually, the courtyard of the middle school was the address of the old hospital. Later, when the commune wanted to build a school, the hospital moved to the north, giving most of the land to the middle school.
The boy's dormitory is the mortuary of the former hospital, so it is often rumored that there are some strange movements on the other side of the boy's dormitory.
Su Anying had a stomach ache and walked away quickly, and arrived at the hospital ten minutes later.
Xu Shiyan went to the doctor and nurse on duty as soon as he entered the door, "Doctor, my wife has a stomachache and is about to give birth."
The doctors and nurses on duty came out immediately after hearing this.
The doctor stepped forward to check Su Anying's body, and arranged for nurses to prepare the ward.
"Doctor Yang is at home, so I quickly sent someone to look for it. The pregnant woman has frequent contractions at the moment, and she should give birth soon."
The doctor listened to the fetal heart rate, then pinched the watch to measure the contraction time, and deduced that Su Anying's situation should give birth soon.
"I know Doctor Yang's house, I'll look for it." Xu Shiyan ran out immediately after hearing this.
There is a very powerful obstetrician and gynecologist named Yang in Donggang Commune, who is very skilled in delivery.
Xu Shiyan had heard of this person's name in his previous life. When he came to Donggang in this life, he asked someone about Dr. Yang and knew where Dr. Yang lived.
Dr. Yang's house is not far to the east of the headquarters of the Second Brigade. Xu Shiyan flew all the way and soon arrived at Dr. Yang's house.
At this time, I didn't care about anything else, so I hurried to knock on the door. "Is Doctor Yang at home? Someone is going to have a baby."
Xu Shiyan just yelled twice, the door was pushed open, and someone came out from inside.
"Wait a minute, here we come."
As an excellent obstetrician and gynecologist, I have long been used to someone knocking on the door at any time.
Don't say it's early in the morning, it's normal for people to come in late at night. Who knows when pregnant women will give birth?
Xu Shiyan waited outside the gate. Within two minutes, a woman who looked less than forty years old opened the gate with a medicine box on her back.
"Where do pregnant women live?" Most pregnant women ask doctors to deliver their babies at home, so people ask this question.
"At the hospital, a doctor checked and said that the baby will be delivered soon. Doctor Yang, please excuse me." Xu Shiyan hurriedly replied.
Doctor Yang was stunned for a moment, probably thinking that the pregnant woman was in danger, so he immediately became anxious, "Go quickly."
Xu Shiyan followed Dr. Yang, and the two rushed all the way to the hospital soon.
The doctor on duty at the hospital saw Dr. Yang and stepped forward to explain the situation.
"Sister Yang, all the signs of the pregnant woman are normal. The amniotic fluid has broken just now, the fetal heart rate is stable, and there are no other symptoms. She has been sent to the delivery room."
When Dr. Yang heard this, he was relieved.
The main reason is that very few people come to the hospital to give birth these days, unless it is dystocia or hemorrhage, so she thought a little too much just now.
"Okay, come here and help me." Then, he went to the doctor's office to change into the surgical gown and prepare for the delivery.
Both doctors changed into surgical gowns, put on sterile gloves and entered the delivery room.
Xu Shiyan and the others stood guard outside the delivery room, listening to Su Anying's cries of pain one after another inside.
When Xu Shiyan gave birth to his first child in his previous life, Xu Shiyan was still in Daan Coal Mine. When he received the news and returned home, the child had already been born.
This time, Xu Shiyan stood guard outside the delivery room, listening to his wife's painful cries inside, Xu Shiyan's heart was pulled together.
"Please God, bless their mother and child safe."
After rebirth, many things have changed. This child was born two days earlier.
Xu Shiyan can no longer predict whether the production process will be smooth.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: eldest son
chapters.content:
Chapter 118 The eldest son
After Su Anying became pregnant, no matter whether it was her mother-in-law, her natal mother, or even the aunts and aunts in the neighborhood, they all told her not to shout loudly when giving birth, and to bear the pain no matter how painful it was.
As the old saying goes, the first child shouts, and every child after that has to shout to be born.
Scientifically speaking, shouting when giving birth is likely to cause high blood pressure and hemorrhage.
Su Anying has a tenacious temperament and keeps everyone's advice in mind, so there is not much movement from the delivery room.
But the more this happened, the more distressed Xu Shiyan became.
The daughter-in-law is giving birth inside, and he can't help at all, so he can only walk back and forth in the corridor outside.
"Daughter-in-law, hold on, you must be well and safe." While walking, she was still muttering.
Zhou Guilan was dizzy from Xu Shiyan walking back and forth.
"Third brother, stand there leaning against the wall, don't go away indiscriminately, I feel dizzy when I look at you like this."
Who is not in a hurry? Her daughter-in-law is inside, and she is also anxious, but no matter how anxious she is, she can't help, what else can she do but wait?
"Mom, I can't calm down."
Xu Shiyan can handle other things calmly, except for the matter of his wife giving birth, he is really unsteady.
"If you can't calm down, you have to stay still." Zhou Guilan glared at her son and said in a deep voice.
Xu Shiyan is not afraid of his father, but his mother.
Seeing that my mother was angry, I could only stand obediently in the corner, facing the wall and muttering in my heart.
Suddenly, a cry of a baby came from the delivery room, and the three people waiting outside all showed joy.
"It was born, it was born, as soon as I heard this sound, I was a big fat boy."
Zhou Guilan happily stood up from the bench and clasped her hands together.
"Thank God for blessing, our third son has a child." Zhou Guilan almost cried when she said this.
Recalling that when the third son was born, he was like a kitten, crying in a low voice.
At that time, who would have imagined that the third son would marry a wife and have children?
At that time, I thought that it would be good to support him, how could I dare to think about anything else?
The door of the delivery room was opened, and the nurse came out holding a candle package wrapped in a flower quilt.
"Su Anying's family members, the mother gave birth successfully, and he is a younger brother."
While talking, the nurse handed the baby in her arms to Zhou Guilan.
"The child is very healthy, a big fat boy who weighs six pounds and six taels, I haven't seen a few such chubby children.
Auntie, you have become a grandma, congratulations. "
The birth of a new life brings hope and joy to people. The nurse congratulated Zhou Guilan with a smile on her face.
"Thank you, thank you." Zhou Guilan stretched out her hand, took the child over, held the baby in one hand, and pushed aside the quilt with the other.
"He's really a little fat man, much better-looking than when you were born."
Xu Shiyan wanted to see his son, but he missed his wife in the delivery room even more.
"Excuse me, is my wife okay? Can I take her to the ward now?"
The nurse looked at Xu Shiyan with a look of surprise.
Although not many people come to the hospital to give birth, they have seen some.
Most fathers are so happy to jump up when they hear about their newborn son. Many people just focus on holding the baby and don’t think of asking their daughter-in-law at all.
This young man is different. He didn't even look at the son when he was born, but asked his wife first.
It’s okay, this young man is not bad, and the little daughter-in-law in it didn’t marry the wrong person.
"Well, you can go in, just help the mother to the ward at the end of the corridor.
There is no one else in the ward for the time being, so please be careful not to dirty the other beds. "
The nurses are good, and there are not many people in the hospital this year, so a separate ward was arranged for the family to take care of the mother and baby.
Xu Shiyan followed the nurse into the delivery room, just at this moment Su Anying had already put on her pants with the help of the doctor.
Xu Shiyan stepped forward, took off his coat and covered his daughter-in-law's head.
It was still very cold in the spring morning. The conditions in this hospital were mediocre, and there was wind in the corridor. Xu Shiyan didn't dare to let his daughter-in-law blow the wind, for fear that something might happen to her.
Xu Shiyan covered his daughter-in-law with his clothes, then picked her up, walked out of the delivery room, and sent her to the ward to carefully put her down.
"You just gave birth, we have to stay in the hospital for a day or two to observe and observe, and then go home for confinement."
Accidents may occur at any time within 48 hours after delivery, so it is more reassuring to observe in the hospital for a while.
Money or not, the safety of the daughter-in-law and son is the most important thing.
"I'll stay here to watch Yingzi and the child, you two hurry home and find that roe deer skin mattress.
Boil some hot water and fill two hot water bottles.
This room is not warm. Yingzi just gave birth and is weak. It is too cold to do. "
The weather is warmer in mid-April, but there is no sun in the ward at the moment, and it is overcast and cold.
Zhou Guilan was thoughtful enough, but she still forgot that the environment in the hospital was different from that at home, so she hurriedly dismissed her son and daughter, and went home to get things.
The hospital was close to home, and the brother and sister quickly boiled hot water. Not only did they pack two warm water bags, but they also came back with a thermos pot and a roe deer skin mattress.
Su Anying is young and in good health after all. Although she has just given birth, she still has some physical strength.
So he moved to the side, spread the roe deer skin mattress, and put the two warm water bags under the bed, which made it much warmer.
Zhou Guilan made brown sugar water again and gave it to Su Anying, "Drink some brown sugar water to warm up your body and nourish your blood."
At this time, most of the people in confinement drink brown sugar. In their eyes, brown sugar is a good thing, and it is the most blood-enriching.
This was bought with a sugar ticket from Guo Shouye. Most people would have to spend a lot of effort to find it.
"Just drink a little, and you don't need to drink too much. Go home and make delicious food for you to replenish your body."
Xu Shiyan was over there, whispering to his wife in a low voice.
Brown sugar nourishes the blood and breaks the blood. If the mother drinks less, it can nourish the blood. Drinking too much is not good.
After all, Su Anying had just given birth, and she was so tired and flustered. In addition, she was tortured by the stomachache at night and didn't sleep well, so she felt a little drowsy right now.
"Shiyan, bring the child here, let me have a look, I haven't seen what our son looks like yet."
Xu Shiyan didn't realize it until now, it seemed that after his son was born, he hadn't been able to take a look at it yet, and was patronizing his wife.
"Mom, give me the child, I haven't seen what my son looks like until now."
Xu Shiyan took the child over and put it beside Su Anying.
"Look, daughter-in-law, our son looks really good-looking, white and fat, with eyebrows and eyes like you."
Xu Shiyan looked at the child, he seemed to look a bit like the child in his previous life, but he was much fatter than that child.
Flesh, with a white and tender face, no longer that skinny look.
Rebirth, I finally changed the trajectory of some things.
This baby will no longer die young like in his previous life. He will grow up healthy and healthy, and become the eldest son of the Xu family and the support of his younger sisters.

chapters.title: Chapter 119: newbie dad
chapters.content:
Chapter 119 Novice Dad
Su Anying gave birth to her son smoothly, and Xu Shiyan and others were also relieved.
The baby only cried once when he was born, and then he slept with his eyes closed.
Seeing this, Zhou Guilan asked Xu Shiyan to stay in the hospital to watch over his wife and children. She took Xu Shiqin home to cook for her daughter-in-law.
At home, there is a pig's trotter that Xu Shiyan specially asked someone to buy two days ago.
Zhou Guilan soaked the pig's trotters in warm water, washed them several times, and blanched them to remove the blood foam.
Afterwards, put the trotters in a casserole, add warm water, put the peanuts that Xu Shiyan found hard to find, and add two Passepartout.
Passepartout stewed pig's trotters are best with milk.
The pig's trotters won't be stewed for a while, and Su Anying is still in the hospital, so she can't be hungry, so she has to make something to eat.
It happened that there were two bundles of dried noodles bought from the store of the Forestry Bureau a few days ago at home.
Zhou Guilan took out the small half stick, first fried the pan with large oil and chopped green onion, then added water to boil the poached eggs, and finally put in the noodles, seasoned them appropriately, and put them in a big lunch box.
"Sixth, hurry up, take this to your third sister-in-law first, let her eat a little to fill her stomach.
Don't go to the tailor shop today, and help me cook at home. Your third sister-in-law is in the hospital, and you can't leave her. "
After the noodles were cooked, Xu Shiqin was sent away to the hospital. Zhou Guilan had to make breakfast for the rest of the family.
Xu Shiqin had already washed and groomed at this moment, so she hurried to the hospital with her lunch box.
"Third brother, my mother made noodles and poached eggs for my third sister-in-law. How is third sister-in-law? Get up and eat something?"
Xu Shiqin entered the ward and found his sister-in-law lying on the bed as if asleep. Xu Shiqin dared not speak loudly and asked in a low voice.
"I haven't slept yet, the third brother Ni told me to close my eyes and keep them healthy."
No, Su Anying, who had her eyes closed, spoke.
Su Anying became a mother for the first time. Although she was physically weak after giving birth, she was very energetic and always wanted to look after the child.
Xu Shiyan felt that his daughter-in-law was always staring at the child without taking a break, so he tricked her into closing her eyes and resting her eyes.
I thought Su Anying could fall asleep, but she didn't sleep at all.
Xu Shiyan didn't know whether to laugh or cry, so he could only help his wife up, put the lunch box on Su Anying's lap with a towel.
"It takes a lot of effort to give birth to a baby, so let's eat something. Eat something light first, and then kill the chicken and make chicken soup for you when you get home."
To be honest, Xu Shiyan had never served his wife during confinement in his previous life, and he didn't understand anything at that time.
It was later that the girl gave birth to a baby, and the girl's mother-in-law didn't understand anything when she was serving the confinement, so she gave the mother chicken soup from the beginning.
As a result, the milk was blocked, and I went to the hospital with a high fever.
The doctor said, in fact, the mother is weak after giving birth, so she should eat light food, and then drink chicken soup after the body recovers a little.
In the past few days, Xu Shiyan has infiltrated his mother's ideas without any trace.
Fortunately, Zhou Guilan was never that kind of old-fashioned old-fashioned feudalism. She would listen to what Xu Shiyan said, and took it to heart.
So I made dried noodles for the first meal, and didn't use much oil.
Nowadays, vermicelli is a rare thing, not to mention the oil inside, poached eggs, and green onion floating on top.
Not to mention Su Anying, who has spent a lot of energy and has an empty stomach, anyone who sees it wants to eat it.
Su Anying's appetite is really good. She ate all of a serving of noodles and three poached eggs. Now she feels much more comfortable in her stomach.
"Shiyan, I'm fine, you don't have to look at me like that, go home and eat."
Su Anying sat for a while after eating, feeling tired and sleepy, so she lay down to rest.
How dare Xu Shiyan leave his wife and children behind, he ran home to eat? They just sent Xu Shiqin home and replaced him after dinner.
Su Anying was tormented by a stomachache last night and didn't sleep well, but now she really fell asleep.
Xu Shiyan was lying on the side of the bed, looking at the big and small sleeping on the bed, he couldn't help laughing.
Is this the happiest moment in the world?
Unfortunately, before Xu Shiyan was happy for a few minutes, the little guy wrapped in the quilt suddenly pursed his mouth and burst into tears.
Scared so much that Xu Shiyan hurriedly picked up the child to coax him, but no matter how he coaxed him, the little thing refused to stop. In the end, Su Anying was woken up.
"Did you pee?"
Su Anying took the child, unwrapped the bag and took a look, right? After a big splash of urine, the diaper pad was soaked.
"There are urinals in the bag over there, bring me a few, and I'll change them for her."
Although Su Anying gave birth to a child for the first time, she is better than anyone else in taking care of children.
She brought up the five and six children in the Su family. Isn't it a piece of cake to change the baby's diaper?
Su Anying quickly changed the diaper for the baby. Sure enough, the baby stopped crying when the **** was dry.
Baji, babble, mouth, eyes do not open, just humming there.
"Is this kid hungry?" Xu Shiyan looked at his son like that, probably hungry.
How can Su Anying have milk just after giving birth? There is no way to buy milk powder these days.
"Okay, little ancestor, you have to hold on a little bit, daddy will make sugar water for you."
I vaguely remember someone who said that newborns can be fed some glucose water, saying that it is to prevent hypoglycemia in newborns?
"Daughter-in-law, do you still have that glucose powder? Did you bring it to the hospital?"
Xu Shiyan bought a pack of glucose powder for Su Anying and Xu Shiqin to drink, so he probably didn't finish it.
"Take a look through those two bags, I don't know if our mother brought them." Su Anying pointed to the bags and said.
Xu Shiyan looked through the past, and found half a pack of glucose powder, so he poured some in a tea mug, and fed it drop by drop along the corner of Xiaowa's mouth with a spoon.
Not to mention, the little thing felt the taste of sugar water, so he really drank it.
Xu Shiyan looked at his son drinking sugar water and liked it very much.
"This little guy is so funny, you can listen to him drink some sugar water and make movements."
This little thing thought his family was poor in his previous life, so he came for a few days and then left.
In this life, I hope that he can grow up safely, and it can be regarded as a continuation of the father-son relationship that was interrupted in the previous life.
Xu Shiyan carefully fed his son sugar water, about two tablespoons, and stopped feeding him.
As a result, the little thing was still not happy, and pursed his mouth.
"I don't want to cry anymore. For children with bigger farts, it's not good to drink too much sugar water."
Xu Shiyan didn't care about that, he put down the spoon, picked up the little guy, and strolled on the ground to coax him.
"What are you doing wandering around with him in your arms? You're talking all day long."
Zhou Guilan came back just at this time, and when she saw Xu Shiyan dangling on the ground with the child in her arms, her face turned dark immediately.
"Put the baby down for me, the baby can't get used to it, the more you hold it, the harder it is to sleep well in the future, and it will cry if you don't hold it.
You can do it, go up the mountain all day, and coax the children when you come back at night.
What about Eiko? If she just hugs the baby all day, you will exhaust her to death? "
Zhou Guilan stepped forward, took the baby, and gently placed it on the bed, humming and patting it with her hands.
Not long after, the baby stopped moaning and slept soundly.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: weird baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 120 Weird Baby
His son was born and he was very healthy, Xu Shiyan was very happy.
Go home and have dinner, go to the commune immediately, borrow the commune's phone number, call Daying Commune, and ask someone to send a letter to Su Weizhong.
After that, Xu Shiyan found Wang Jiaren and asked for leave. He also borrowed a bicycle and rode back to the big house to announce the good news.
Xu Chenghou was also very happy to learn that he had added a grandson, so he gave Xu Shiyan the eggs that the family had bought recently.
"Let your mother take good care of confinement there, and you don't have to worry about her at home, and you can work hard.
You are also a father now, and you have a heavy burden on your shoulders. You must work hard, and you have to support your wife and children. "The old father urged earnestly.
Xu Shiyan missed his family and didn't stay in the big house. After chatting with his father for a while, he returned to Donggang by bicycle.
Su Anying stayed in the hospital for one night, and the doctor checked her body the next morning.
After confirming that there was nothing wrong, Xu Shiyan was asked to go through the discharge procedures and take Su Anying home for confinement.
Going home is naturally much more convenient. With Zhou Guilan taking good care of her, Su Anying soon had milk.
The little baby has something to eat, so she doesn’t cry or fuss, sleeps when she’s full, urinates when she wakes up, and eats after urinating.
This little guy has a big appetite, and he urinates a lot when he eats a lot. The urinals prepared at home are almost not enough.
The clothesline outside is full of children's clothes, which look like colorful flags.
After the little boy was born, his eyes were kept closed, and he didn't open them until five or six days later.
Xu Shiyan went to work on the mountain and came home in the evening, and when he learned that his son had opened his eyes, he hurried over to hug him to cherish.
In the end, I don’t know what happened. The little baby who was originally fine, suddenly burst into tears when he saw Xu Shiyan.
Okay, since he was born, he has never cried like this.
Those who didn't know about the crying sound thought that Xu Shiyan secretly strangled the child while no one was paying attention.
"Look at you, if you don't know how to hold a child, don't hold it. If you hold it, the child will cry like this."
When Zhou Guilan heard that her grandson was crying, she was so angry that she quickly snatched her grandson over to coax her.
It was strange, the child was crying loudly in Xu Shiyan's arms, but when it was in Zhou Guilan's arms, it only shook slightly, and the little thing stopped crying.
"Little bastard, do you dislike your father?" Xu Shiyan was so angry at his son.
Is this **** looking down on him? In her previous life, she despised him for being poor and refused to be his son.
I finally had a better life in this life. I took care of this little brat. What the hell, I still hate it, right?
"Go aside for me, I just came back from the mountain, smelling of sweat all over my body.
Besides, I don’t know if you brought Cao Climber back from the mountain, so hurry up and change your clothes and wash your face. "
Zhou Guilan hugged her grandson, rolled her son's eyes, and looked disgusted.
Crawler, scientific name tick, grows in the woods, feeds on the blood of humans and animals.
This thing bites people and doesn't let go, it keeps sticking into the flesh.
If it is pulled out forcefully, even if the body is broken, the mouthparts will not let go, and will remain in the flesh forever, and some may grow into sarcoma.
The most important thing is that this thing is carrying forest encephalitis virus. If it gets infected, it is very dangerous and it is easy to die.
People who live in mountainous areas come back from the mountains. The first thing they do is to check their bodies, especially the hidden places like armpits, behind ears, and thighs.
As the weather gets warmer, the grass crawlers really come out to move around.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to argue with his mother, so he hurried to fetch water, washed his hair, scrubbed his body indiscriminately, and changed into a suit of clothes.
I thought that if this was the case, the child would stop crying, right?
As a result, Xu Shiyan just leaned in front of his son, and before he could pick him up, the little thing started to grin and cry again.
"You said this is also evil, you are not at home, we will not hear him cry for a day.
People’s children ate and slept, slept and ate, but they were well-behaved. I have never met such a coaxable child.
Hey, as soon as you came home to visit him, the child cried. If I hadn't been watching right in front of my eyes, I would definitely think that you secretly pinched him. "
Zhou Guilan was also left speechless by the father and son. Why is there a natural hatred between the father and son? Cry when we meet?
Xu Shiyan raised his hands in surrender, "Well, can I stay away from him? This bear must have had a grudge against me in the previous life."
Stinky boy, wait until you grow up and see how I deal with you.
Xu Shiyan muttered silently in his heart, and left his son's side, but as soon as he left, the little baby stopped crying immediately.
It's for Zhou Guilan and Su Anying, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, it's really dumbfounding.
"Hey, the two of you didn't deal with each other when you were young, what can you do when you grow up? Isn't this like your father and the third child again?"
Zhou Guilan sat on the edge of the Kang, looking down at the little guy under the quilt who was less than seven days old.
"Why do you think you are such a bear? Why do you have trouble with your father? Sigh."
How could the little baby understand anything, lying on the kang, spitting milk bubbles, and smiling at Zhou Guilan.
This smile made Zhou Guilan laugh from ear to ear, and quickly hugged her grandson to coax her.
"How fun, a little thing less than seven days old, he can laugh."
When Xiaowa just laughed, Su Anying also saw it, and now she was even more surprised.
"Yeah, he can actually laugh. At that time, my fifth and sixth younger sisters would only laugh when the moon was full."
Su Anying looked at her son, always feeling that this little guy seemed a little different.
"This guy, he will definitely be a smart and mischievous kid in the future.
You two take good care of your child, with a little care, and in the future you will be counting on him to support you in the old age. "
In most people's minds, it is a rule that has been passed down for many years for the eldest son to provide for the elderly, and Zhou Guilan is no exception.
Xu Shiyan, who was sitting on the stool over there, couldn't help but hum when he heard this.
Counting on your son for retirement? I guess I thought too much.
When this baby grows up, it will be different then.
The child is promising. He is admitted to university and works outside. It is good to come back two or three times a year.
In a big city, if you want to buy a house, buy a car, and marry a wife, you probably have to pay some money from your family.
Life in the city is not easy and the pressure is high. How can parents cause trouble for their children?
If the child is worthless and cannot enter college, what can he do if he stays at home?
Planting the ground and planting sticks? Doing business?
It is not easy for me to live by myself, and my parents may have to pay for the marriage.
I will have a child later. At that time, the cost of raising a child is high, and there are various cram schools, and the pressure of life is high enough. Can the old couple be willing to let their son worry about it?
Everyone talks about raising children to look after their old age, but that’s actually the case, it’s just a hope in my heart.
After a new life, Xu Shiyan also figured it out, no matter whether it is a daughter or a son, raising them has never been for the purpose of preventing old age, and there is no need to always talk about old age.
As long as the children live well and are capable, it is impossible to see their parents helpless.
Therefore, it is the duty of parents to do their best to cultivate their children into talents.
It is good for parents to fulfill their responsibilities. Since they have given their children life, at least for the first twenty years, they should be responsible for their children. After that, it all depends on the individual.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: catching toads in the rain
chapters.content:
Chapter 121 Catching Toads in the Rain
When Xu Shiyan came home, the sky was a bit cloudy, and when the meal was ready for dinner, it started to rain patter outside.
Zhou Guilan looked at the weather outside the window and breathed a sigh of relief.
"Finally, I am looking forward to the rain. There is really little rain in this spring, and there will be two games in total.
After the rain, the ground should be a little wet. It’s just a few days to plant the land, which is good. "
"Well, the field has been dry for a while and is almost smoking, and this rain is very timely.
Tomorrow and the day after tomorrow, I will go to our private land to tidy up, and in a few days I will take time to plant some broomcorns, millet and so on. "
Old peasants depend on the weather for their food, and what the people in the village house want most is good weather.
Xu Shiyan moved here, and the team allocated half an acre of private land, which is not much, and it is enough to grow some grains and beans.
After all, the family has a small population, so something is enough to eat.
One spring and one autumn are the busiest seasons for the agricultural team, and the participating households are even busier.
Fortunately, these days, the work in Shendi is almost busy.
The ginseng ground for freezing and making goods has already passed the pond, and it will take a few days for the new planting to come out, which happens to be the time for planting.
"It's not the right time for me to be in confinement, otherwise I can go farming with you."
Su Anying, who had already had dinner over there, who was holding the baby and breastfeeding, couldn't help sighing when she heard it.
When Chun Geng was so busy, she just caught up with her confinement. There were so many jobs outside the house, leaving it all to her husband alone, which was enough for him to get tired.
"You, take a good confinement, and taking care of your body is more important than anything else.
Don't always think about working, women do everything, why do men need them?
Marrying a Han, marrying a Han, dressing and eating, farming and working are what they should do.
You can take care of the children at home with peace of mind, figure out the mess at home, and don't let the third child worry about it outside. "
Zhou Guilan couldn't help sighing when she heard this.
Among the daughters-in-law in her family, the third daughter-in-law is the most capable.
"My mother is right, don't worry about anything, and leave the whole family to me, so you can sit in confinement with peace of mind.
You have done a great job by taking good care of yourself. "Xu Shiyan also persuaded.
No one knows better than Xu Shiyan what kind of temper his daughter-in-law has.
Su Anying is just too capable. She is always busy on weekdays. Even in the late pregnancy, she didn't delay her work.
The sudden cold made her lie on the kang all day long, except for eating and sleeping, she was uncomfortable with leisure.
But no matter how uncomfortable it is, the confinement must be settled, and there is no need to discuss it.
While talking, he suddenly saw someone walking in hurriedly from outside. Xu Shiyan hurriedly opened the door and saw that it was the neighbor in the East Courtyard.
"Xiaofeng, why are you here when it's raining, what's the matter at home?" Xu Shiyan stepped aside and called the other party into the room.
"Brother Xu, there is nothing wrong at home, I just came to see you and asked if you are going to catch toads at night?
It didn’t rain much this spring, and the toad couldn’t even go ashore. I guess it’s raining tonight, and the toad will come up with all his brains.
Let's catch toads with flashlights, and we can catch old noses overnight. "
Sun Xiaofeng, Xu's neighbor to the east, is one year younger than Xu Shiyan.
The Sun family also belongs to the Second Brigade and the First Brigade. They work together all day long, and they are also neighbors. They get along very well with Xu Shiyan.
The toad Sun Xiaofeng mentioned is not a frog or a toad, but the Northeast Rana, which is a kind of Rana.
The dried fallopian tube product of the female Northeast Rana, also called Rana oil, is an extremely valuable tonic, known as "Snow Hammer Oil" in the south.
So, the Northeast Rana is also called snow clam.
Toads live in the woods in summer, and come down from the mountains in late autumn to spend the winter in the river.
Wait until the beginning of spring, then go ashore from the river, and lay eggs in ponds, ditches, or stable river bends.
After the spawning is over, they enter the forest to live again, and the cycle repeats.
Toad is the best river fresh food, especially the spring toad. After a winter in the river, there is no dirt in the stomach. The meat is delicious and nutritious. It is the favorite delicacy of the local people.
According to their habits, when it rains every spring, people go to the river with a flashlight to catch them.
"Hey, if you don't mention it, I really forgot. Okay, then I'll go after dinner, let's go together."
Xu Shiyan has been preoccupied with his wife's childbirth these days, and can't think of anything else.
When Sun Xiaofeng said this, he also realized that it rained late this year, so this crop of toads is probably the only one.
If you don’t catch it, you won’t be able to eat it this year.
"Success, then I'll go home and prepare first, don't worry, Brother Xu, eat slowly."
When Sun Xiaofeng heard that Xu Shiyan agreed, he was so happy that he didn't enter the room, turned around and left again.
Xu Shiyan returned to the east room and explained to his mother and daughter-in-law.
"Mom, taking advantage of the rain, Xiaofeng and I went to catch some toads and came back. We just stewed them for Yingzi's nourishment."
When I was in the big house, every spring, Xu Shiyan went to catch toads twice to satisfy everyone.
Now in Donggang, this habit cannot be changed.
"Okay, since Xiaofeng is looking for you, let's go, don't go too far, and don't come back too late." Zhou Guilan didn't stop her, but only ordered a few words.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan quickly ate a few mouthfuls of food, and then went to find a raincoat, a flashlight, and a woven bag.
After everything was ready, they went out to find Sun Xiaofeng, and the two of them left the door like this, heading straight for the direction of Caozihe.
Caozi River belongs to a branch of the upper reaches of Songjiang River, twenty miles away from Donggang.
For Xu Shiyan and Sun Xiaofeng, twenty miles is like playing.
The two walked forward with flashlights, staring at both sides of the road. It has been raining for a while, and it is very likely that there are toads on the roadside.
Sure enough, not far in front, a few black dots were bouncing up and down the aisle.
As soon as the light of the flashlight shone on them, they immediately lay down on the ground and did not move.
Xu Shiyan and Sun Xiaofeng ran over immediately and grabbed the toad on the ground.
The skin of amphibians is slippery and cold. People who have never caught toads are likely to be shocked.
For Xu Shiyan, there was no disturbance in his heart at all, but he felt that this toad was so fleshy when he grabbed it.
Starting with a big mother and baby, I feel that it can sink two or two.
Xu Shiyan sighed in his heart, speaking of it, it’s still a good time, unlike later generations, toads were caught in large numbers, and there were not many wild toads.
The point is that later, in order to make money, those people contracted the river section, and then used plastic sheets on the river bank to block the toads from traversing.
The plastic sheet is high and slippery, and the toad cannot jump over it, so they are all blocked under the plastic sheet, just grab it directly.
The toad trip is really a desperate plan. The wild toads were caught within a few years, and after that, they can only be artificially bred.
The toad that can be cultivated artificially, how can it taste better than the wild one?
"Brother Xu, go forward, there must be more ahead, go."
Catching toads is addictive, and the more you catch them, the more you want to keep catching them.
Sun Xiaofeng had already caught several of them. Seeing Xu Shiyan standing there not knowing what to think, he yelled at him to move forward quickly.
Xu Shiyan put the toad into the woven bag hanging on his waist, and walked forward quickly.
I didn’t go very far, and there were several toads in front of me. At this time, I didn’t have time to think about it, so I caught it.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: human society
chapters.content:
Chapter 122 Human Relationship Society
This rain is neither too heavy nor too small, which is suitable for catching toads.
Xu Shiyan and Sun Xiaofeng arrived near the Caozi River before 7:30, and they didn't have to go far. They just found a river bank to stroll back and forth, and caught any toads that jumped up.
It wasn’t just the two of them who came out to catch toads. They didn’t talk when they met each other. They caught their own toads without disturbing each other.
This catch lasted in the middle of the night, until after two o'clock in the middle of the night, when the rain was getting lighter and the toad was almost gone, Xu Shiyan and Sun Xiaofeng walked back.
Xu Shiyan arrived home at almost four o'clock, and it happened that the child was peeing and groaning, so Zhou Guilan got up to change the child's diaper.
Hearing movement in the outer room, Zhou Guilan hurriedly came out to check.
"Why did you come back at this time? Is this a toad that has been caught all night? Take off the raincoat quickly, take a breather and go back to the house to sleep."
Xu Shiyan first threw the bag in his hand to the corner, and the toad in the bag made a croaking sound.
"This crop of toads is so thick, you didn't see it, jumping all over the floor.
We lost track of the time while we were catching on, and found out when the little rain toad was gone. It was already midnight, so we hurried back.
Our place is not a big house, the river and the river are far away. "
"I caught a lot today, and there were quite a lot of mothers and children.
It just so happened that I dug a bunch of Gastrodia elata two days ago? Get some toad stewed Gastrodia elata for Yingzi to eat.
Let’s keep some mother’s hugs. During the day, I will go to Director Guo of the Forestry Bureau. Don’t care if they are rare or not, just give them something.
Also, take some away for the sixth child and give it to her master. The sixth child is an apprentice there, and he teaches with great care. It is our heart to give you something. "
Human relationship society, this is the necessary communication, especially in the Northeast, without human relationship, nothing can be done.
Xu Shiyan is well aware of this truth, so no matter where he is, he pays special attention to maintaining human relations. It is really useful in critical times.
"Well, okay, you can do whatever you want, anyway, let's eat at home, and it doesn't matter if a **** holds a male dog."
How can Zhou Guilan not understand these things at such an old age? She can understand that her son has worked hard all night, and what he does is serious.
For my own family, just eat what you have, and the gift must be good.
The locals refer to the female wood frog as a mother, and the male as a male dog.
Actually, it should be called a female leopard, because the belly of the female wood frog is yellow and flowery, like a leopard.
However, it is difficult to write the leopard of this leopard. Many people write it as a hug, and when it comes and goes, it becomes a mother hug.
There is toad oil in the belly of mother's spores in autumn, and seeds in spring, and they are relatively large, so most people like to eat mother's spores.
The male dog has nothing in his stomach and is small in size.
Gifts, it must be a good gift, and you can eat it at home, since they all taste the same anyway.
Xu Shiyan had been busy all night and didn't sleep, and now he was unbearably sleepy.
After chatting with Zhou Guilan for a few words, the cold air on his body dissipated, and he opened the door and entered the east room.
Su Anying had already fed her son to burp, and when Xu Shiyan came back, she hurriedly pointed to the quilt on the kang, signaling Xu Shiyan to go to bed quickly.
Xu Shiyan was not in the mood to look after the child at the moment, for fear of making the boy cry, he took off his shoes, got into bed, and quickly fell asleep.
It rained all night, the ground was soaked, and the ground was wet and sticky, so it was impossible to work.
Xu Shiyan didn't wake up until after eight o'clock. He ate casually, picked 30 big mothers to hug, packed them in fine mesh bags, and gave them to Guo Shouye.
As Guo Shouye, there must be a lot of gift-givers. He received three copies of Toad early this morning.
Even so, Guo Shouye was still very happy to see Xu Shiyan.
Sometimes this is how people get along with each other. They don’t care how expensive things are, but what they care about is their heart. If you have good things, you can think about each other, which is enough.
"Oh, it must have been caught in the rain last night, right?
Look at you, grab it and keep it for yourself to eat, isn’t the sister-in-law born? Stew some to make up for my sister-in-law, this is still thinking about me, how bad is it? "
Guo Shouye had a friendly smile on his chubby face, and happily accepted the toad.
"Well, I didn't go to see my nephew when my sister-in-law was confinement. Here are a few tickets. I think you can use them."
Guo Shouye had nothing else to do here except that there were too many tickets, so he took a stack and handed it to Xu Shiyan.
"Brother, I didn't come here for that purpose, I just came to see Brother Guo.
I've been too busy these days, and I really don't have time to come here. Finally, it rained and I stopped work. Come and see Brother Guo. "
Xu Shiyan quickly waved his hand, and he sent some toads. How dare you ask for a ticket?
Instead of being that careless, why don't you think he's just trying to get this cheap?
"Look at you, why are you being polite with your brother? I don't have anything else here. Is this thing missing?
Hold it, there seems to be a meat ticket or something in it, go buy some meat, and make up for your sister-in-law. "
Guo Shouye was upset when he saw that Xu Shiyan refused to accept it. His face sank, and he put the ticket in front of Xu Shiyan.
Yes, it’s not enough if you don’t accept it.
"Then I would like to thank Brother Guo. I have taken advantage of following Brother Guo this year." Xu Shiyan put the ticket away with a smile.
Guo Shouye saw that Xu Shiyan had accepted the meat ticket, and his face looked better.
"That's right, what are we brothers doing with those out-of-the-ordinary words? In the future, if you need anything, come to me.
I don’t have anything else, tickets can still be obtained. "
All the benefits issued by the unit have to go through the hands of Guo Shouye. He said as much as he said, but he just drew a few tickets, so what?
There are so many ticket dealers these days, where did those tickets come from?
Guo Shouye is already very good if he doesn’t go out and sell it. A few gifts are not considered farts.
Xu Shiyan chatted with Guo Shouye for a while, then left the bureau and went straight to the non-staple food store.
I have a meat ticket in hand, why don't you hurry to buy meat? After queuing for a while, it was finally his turn, and there happened to be a small piece of pork belly left.
"Comrade, give me all the pork belly, and those pig's trotters and big bones, I bought them all."
Meat needs a ticket, but pig's trotters and big bones do not.
At this time, the shaved meat is very clean, and there is not much meat on the big bones, so most people don't like to buy it.
With money, who doesn’t want to buy some meat, why buy bones?
The same goes for pig’s trotters. Except for Chinese New Year, or when a woman in the family gives birth to a baby, not many people buy it at other times.
The master who buys meat doesn’t care about those, as long as you give him tickets and money, it’s the same for anyone who buys.
So he sold the pork belly, two trotters, and a pile of big bones to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan returned home happily with his net bag in his hand.
Before entering the house, I heard a lot of people talking in the house.
Opening the door and entering the east room, it turned out to be the father-in-law, mother-in-law, and sister-in-law.
"Father, mother, when did you arrive? Look, I knew I would pick you up at the station."
"Isn't it seven days since Yingzi gave birth? As grandparents, we have to come and see the baby.
You don’t need to pick it up. Today, the commune has something to go to Fusong. We came here by bus from Fusong. "
Since Su Weizhong received the news that Su Anying had given birth to a son, he has been thinking about coming to see Huanxi.
Finally waited for seven days, and quickly brought his wife and daughter here.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: look happy
chapters.content:
Chapter 123 Looking Happy
Local custom, the maiden’s family can only come to see the joy in three days, seven days, or twelve days, not too early.
Su Weizhong was late when he received the news, and the team happened to be busy, so he had to make arrangements for the production team and come over in seven days.
Come here to see, my uncle's new home is quite decent.
Three very well-organized houses, with a large courtyard in front and back, and clean windows inside and out, making it comfortable to look at.
Looking at Su Anying, who is in confinement, she is in good spirits, and her little grandson is so cute and chubby.
Su Weizhong has a hanging heart, and he has completely let go of it at this moment.
Which father doesn't love his daughter? Su Weizhong is a big man who just doesn't like to talk about it, but he is relieved to see that his daughter is doing well.
Seeing my uncle come back now, Su Weizhong was even happier, and dragged Xu Shiyan to chat, asking how they were doing after they moved to Donggang.
The father-in-law is here, so Xu Shiyan must be with him.
