Give the meat in my hand to my mother, and then sit down and chat with my father-in-law.
Hearing that my uncle moved to Donggang, Su Weizhong is even more beautiful in his heart.
The conversation between Weng and son-in-law became hotter and hotter, and the voice of the conversation gradually rose a little bit uncontrollably.
"Master, please speak in a low voice, the child is asleep and will be woken up again."
Han walked over, reached out and poked Su Weizhong.
Su Weizhong then remembered his little grandson, "Look, I was so happy that I went there, and I accidentally raised my voice.
Shiyan, let's go, let's chat in the yard, just show me the front and back yards of your house. "
As Su Weizhong said, he dragged Xu Shiyan out. Weng and his son-in-law turned from the front yard to the backyard. When they saw a small hill behind them, Su Weizhong was even happier.
"You have a few acres of land here and there, right? That's great, the place is big, and it's comfortable to live in."
The nature of farmers is that they feel close to the land when they see the land. Even if they don’t do anything in such a large yard, they feel that their hearts are open when they look at it.
"Well, the place is not small, and most of them are idle.
I'm thinking about building a few more houses in a few years, and planting fruit trees on the hillsides on both sides.
There are only these few people in the family, and they can’t eat even if they grow vegetables. It’s better to get some fruit trees, so that the children can eat in the future. "
Xu Shiyan had planned it long ago. Such a large space cannot be left empty. It is only serious to use it rationally.
But not right now, the policy hasn't come down yet, so he can't be the first bird.
When the documents are issued in 1979, he can throw off his arms and do it without too many scruples.
"Planting fruit trees? Then you have to be careful, you can't have too many, or you will have your tail cut off."
Sure enough, when Su Weizhong heard this, he persuaded Xu Shiyan with a little worry.
The troubles of the past few years were like this. It was not allowed to raise too many poultry and livestock, and the fruit trees could only be planted less, or too many.
"Dad, don't worry, I know enough, so I won't plant too many." Xu Shiyan smiled.
He couldn't be more clear in his heart, didn't he make a fuss this spring without seeing him? For newcomers, it's better to keep a low profile.
The Weng and his son-in-law were walking around and chatting. In the house, Zhou Guilan asked Su Anying to chat with her natal mother, and she hurried to the kitchen to cook.
The in-laws came to see Huanxi, and they had to be treated well. It happened that Xu Shiyan bought the meat and bones, so Zhou Guilan hurriedly picked it up for lunch.
At the beginning of spring, every household actually has nothing to eat.
The cabbage stored in the winter has long since been eaten, and even if there is any leftover, it should be rotten.
Not to mention the radish, it has long been too brany to eat.
There are still some potatoes, and they have begun to sprout. Peel and remove the bud nests, just like a pot of toad.
Find out the dried beans from the cabinet last autumn, soak some, and stew it with big bones, it is also a dish.
The germinated green onions in the vegetable garden are growing quite well. Pick up a few and bring them home and fry them with eggs.
No matter how you count, there are only three dishes, which is outrageous.
Fortunately, I found some fungus, soaked some and fried it with bacon, and finally made up four dishes.
Zhou Guilan worked quickly, and the Han family sent the third and fourth children to help out, and a meal was quickly prepared and served on the table.
"Yingzi, this is a toad made separately for you, with Gastrodia elata in it, this is good, you should eat more."
Zhou Guilan brought her daughter-in-law's meals first, and sent them to Su Anying.
Gastrodia elata can dispel wind and dampness. It is said that women who are in confinement are good to eat some gastrodia elata, so as to avoid sitting down due to accidental wind.
Ordinarily, Gastrodia elata was still unearthed in the field at this time, so it was not easy to meet.
This was just a few days ago, when Xu Shiyan was working on the mountain, he saw the old stalks of Gastrodia elata, and dug out a lot from the bottom.
Gastrodia elata before emergence is of the best quality, but after emergence, it is empty.
Xu Shiyan dug Gastrodia elata and didn't plan to sell it. He got it home and buried it in the soil, thinking about putting it in the chicken soup in a few days for Su Anying to eat.
It happened that there were toads today, so Zhou Guilan took a few out of the soil.
Cleaned and cut into pieces, put a dozen or so spores, stewed in a small casserole, let Su Anying eat soup and meat together.
There are actually no good things to eat during confinement these days. Most of them are millet porridge and boiled eggs. There are no dishes, let alone oily water.
Families with good conditions can stew some chicken soup and trotter soup. For those with poor conditions, it is good to eat millet porridge, and there are not many eggs.
Zhou Guilan takes care of her daughter-in-law attentively, and can cook for her daughter-in-law in different ways.
In addition, when I was in the hospital, the doctor also said that the mother can eat a little food, as long as it is not too salty.
So Su Anying's food is not bad, and the dishes are somewhat salty.
Compared with the puerpera's confinement meals, the big guys eat much more normal.
The toad stewed potatoes were put in soy sauce, and the vegetable soup was bright red and oily.
Potatoes absorb the umami taste of toad, so they are soft and waxy, and the taste is better than that of toad.
Dried bean hi oil, just stewed with big bone soup, much more delicious than usual stewed.
Although there are only four dishes, everyone in the Su family is also very satisfied.
In the afternoon, Xu Shiyan couldn't go to the private plot either, so he just searched the vegetable garden at home.
Su Weizhong was restless, carrying a shovel and together with my uncle, turned over the vegetable field.
On the east and west slopes of the garden, many shepherd's purses and mother-in-laws grew.
There was no rain or drought a few days ago, and the wild vegetables were all stuck to the ground.
After the rain last night, the wild vegetables and grass in the field absorbed the water, and immediately became refreshed.
After lunch, Zhou Guilan left Mrs. Han to accompany Su Anying, and she dug shepherd's purse in the garden with a small shovel in her hand.
Not to mention, the hillsides on both sides were dug up, and a whole basket was filled, so I went back to pick it up, cleaned it, scalded it with boiling water, chopped stuffing, and made dumplings.
Women make dumplings for seven days after giving birth. There is also a saying that it is called pinching the bones.
If the Su family doesn't come, Zhou Guilan plans to make a bowl of dumplings for Su Anying to eat.
Since people from the Su family are here, let’s wrap some more, just as Xu Shiyan bought the pork belly, chopped it up and put it in.
The most tender shepherd's purse in spring, and the meat, it is oily when you bite into it. This dumpling is so fresh that you can't wait to swallow it with your tongue.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: Xu Haiyuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 124 Xu Haiyuan
Su Weizhong's family of four stayed at Xu's house for one night, and left after dinner the next morning.
Xu Shiyan and his wife tried to persuade him to stay but failed.
Seeing that the spring plowing is about to start, I'm busy, so I can spare two days to come and have a look. How can I stay for a long time?
Xu Shiyan borrowed a carriage from the team and sent his father-in-law and his family to the station.
I bought another ticket for them, sent them on the train, and then went back to work in the team.
Seeing that it is almost May 1st, spring plowing will start soon, and the fields should be tidied up.
Last year, we had to dig fences in the field where corn was planted.
The corn stalks are cut down and taken away to feed the livestock, but the roots of the corn are still left in the field.
Every year before spring plowing, the roots of corn have to be dug out with a pickaxe, so everyone calls it a fence or a stubble.
There is no need to worry about the bean field, just a plow stick will do.
The weather is good, the corn roots that have been dug out are piled up together, dried in the sun for two days, and then burned. After that, it was plowing and sowing.
Most of the land of the Second Brigade is just in front of Paotai Mountain, and the whole large area is there.
Before the spring plowing, the team held a meeting to comprehensively plan what kind of food to plant this year based on what was planted in each field last year and the indicators issued by the superior this year.
Most of the large fields are corn and soybeans, especially soybeans. Most of them are used for export to earn foreign exchange, and a lot of them are planted every year.
The Northeast is cold, and the crops have a long growing season, and only one crop of grain can be grown a year.
Farming time waits for no one. If you plant it late until autumn, the corn and beans will still be green and frost will fall.
So at this time, we must seize the time to plant the land. No matter who it is, we cannot ask for leave, and we must go to work every day.
All the cattle and horses in the team put on plow sticks to plow the ground, and someone behind them took a pickaxe to plan the row, someone carried a dung basket, poked some dung into each row with a small shovel, and then used their feet to pull some soil to cover it. .
No way, there are few chemical fertilizers these days, and even if they are available, they are reluctant to use them.
Farm manure is too little, after fermenting and decomposing and drying, use less as base fertilizer, which can promote crop growth.
Fertilization was applied in the front, and someone was carrying a basket behind him, and three or four seeds leaked from his hand, and fell into the pit accurately, and then used his feet to pull some soil to cover it, and stepped on it firmly.
Farming the land is hard work, and those who wield pickaxes in front of them will suffer from tired shoulders all morning.
At the back, there is a kind of stepper, with one foot in a ditch and one foot in a ridge, and a long ridge comes down. The leg of the stepper is sore, and the aisle begins to stand on tiptoe.
The sunshine in early May was already abundant. After working under the sun for a whole morning, when we got off work at noon, everyone was tired and sweaty.
The land of the Second Brigade is neither far nor close to the village, and there is not enough time for the lunch break to go home, so they can only bring food to eat in the field.
From the willow trees on the ground, I took off the bags with rice from all over the place.
Then he threw the pickaxe on the ground, and the person sat on the handle of the pickaxe, opened his pocket, took out dry food, and gnawed.
The meals brought by the people are also varied, mostly pancakes, and then there are corn flour pancakes and pickled cabbage heads.
"Brother Xu, what are you rolling in this pancake? Why does it smell delicious?"
The meals that Xu Shiyan brought were pancakes that Zhou Guilan had rolled for him in advance.
Before Su Anying gave birth to a child, Zhou Guilan led her daughter-in-law and daughter to bake pancakes for two days, just for the convenience of Xu Shiyan to bring meals at this time.
Inside the pancake, there are green onions and bacon.
Bacon is the meat made in winter, which is salted and preserved.
Wash it with water when you eat it, put it in a pan and fry it, and roll it into the pancake. Wouldn’t that be delicious?
Zhou Guilan felt sorry for her son's hard work, and was afraid that his son would lose his strength after eating too much, so she specially rolled two pancakes with meat, and the rest was green onions.
The person next to him smelled the fragrance as soon as he sniffed, and couldn't help asking.
Xu Shiyan didn't know that his mother brought him meat, and it was hard to tell, so he could only fool around.
"Is it fragrant or not? You have been exposed to the sun this morning, have you fainted?"
While talking, he quickly ate the pancakes, then picked up the kettle, and drank a few sips.
Fried biscuits, I always feel not full when I eat them. After drinking some water, I suddenly feel full of stomach.
After eating, everyone smoked a cigarette, rested for a while, and started farming again. They were busy until after five o'clock in the afternoon, and then they packed up their tools and went back.
It’s six o’clock when I get home, wash my face and change clothes for dinner, and then tease my son after dinner.
"Xu Haiyuan, I warn you, if you cry again, I will beat you up."
Xu Shiyan picked up his son and put him on his lap, letting the little guy lie on his back. The father and son stared wide-eyed.
The boys of the younger generation of the Xu family all use the character Hai in the middle, and three dots of water in the latter character.
Xu Shiyan hasn't read many books, and his nephews have used the names that are easy to say. This baby has never been named in his previous life, so he doesn't know what to name the child.
Later, I found a teacher in the elementary school and named the child Xu Haiyuan.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan thought it sounded good, so he just used it.
Xu Haiyuan was saving face today and didn't cry.
The weather was warm in early May, and the baby was wearing a jacket and trousers, with a diaper on top and no quilt.
The little guy was lying on Xu Shiyan's lap, his two little arms were waving wildly, and his calves were kicking wildly.
Xu Shiyan looked amused, so he kissed his son's fleshy little fist.
As a result, one of them was accidentally punched in the face by his son.
Xiaowa didn't hit her hard, but Xu Shiyan couldn't laugh or cry.
"Okay, I just threatened you that I was going to beat you up, so give me a shot first, right?"
The little thing on the leg couldn't understand what Xu Shiyan said at all, it was still waving its small fists, and grinning at Xu Shiyan.
When his son smiled, Xu Shiyan was instantly elated. This kid always cried when he saw him. How could he ever laugh? It is simply rare.
"Mom, Haiyuan smiled at me too." Xu Shiyan happily showed off to his mother.
As a result, before he was happy for two minutes, he suddenly felt a heat flow on his legs.
Look again, okay, son Xiong urinated, this splash of urine not only wet the urine, but also wet most of Xu Shiyan's trouser legs.
"Hey you little bastard, dare to pee on your dad?"
Xu Shiyan suddenly felt like crying. The pants he just changed this afternoon need to be washed again.
Xu Shiyan spoke a little louder. When the little boy heard his father yelling at him, he suddenly became unhappy. He pursed his mouth and cried out loudly.
"No, you **** all over me, you have a reason, right?"
Xu Shiyan is speechless, he just wants to get close to his son, why is it so difficult, either crying or peeing all over him?
"What are you calling? The child is peeing on you to see if you know each other (pouring), know what a fart.
Boy urine, good stuff, beautiful you. "
Zhou Guilan smiled and came over to take away her grandson, and gave her son a supercilious glance. Su Anying didn't say anything, just sat there smiling.
Well, don't say anything, anyway, since his son was born, his position in the family has fallen to the bottom.
Xu Shiyan got up helplessly, found another pair of trousers to change into, fetched water by himself, rubbed his son's peeed trousers twice, and hung them outside to dry.

chapters.title: Chapter 125: celery
chapters.content:
Chapter 125 Dayeqin
The second brigade has a total of 2,600 mu of land, but fortunately there are many people working.
During the spring plowing season, regardless of gender, even the school will take advantage of the busy farming holiday on May Day, so regardless of the large amount of land, planting is not slow.
In a few days, the large tracts of land were planted, and there were some leftovers, just a few people left to finish the work.
After the land in the team has been planted, it is the turn of each family to reserve land.
Compared to this, private land is more laborious, because there is no plow stick to plow the ground, so you have to plan it yourself with a pickaxe.
It took Xu Shiyan more than three days to plant half an acre of land in Xu's family, but it was planted anyway.
No way, one person is digging the ground to dig furrows, and digging and planting, it's too grindy to go back and forth.
Millet, millet, and two rows of red beans were planted.
The place is small, so I can only grow a little of everything, so that I don’t have to worry about eating at home, otherwise I won’t have a place to buy.
Xu’s private plot is in Xiaonangou, also south of Paotai Mountain, farther than Datian of the Second Brigade, and close to the root of the mountain.
After finishing his work, Xu Shiyan saw that it was still early, so he went into the woods to pick big leaf celery.
In the spring season, every household is short of vegetables to eat, and has no choice but to go to the mountains to collect wild vegetables.
In the first ten days of May, all kinds of wild vegetables in the mountains are in good season, such as big leaf celery, Yaneryi, Huazijian, mountain millet, mountain spinach, etc., can be eaten.
Among them, Dayeqin is the most popular.
Else celery, also called mountain celery, is a perennial herb, clustered, with turquoise or lavender stems.
The leaves are three obovate compound leaves, the back of the leaf is bright, and there are small white flowers, which are very similar to the flowers of celery, and the celery has a very special aroma.
Celery can be fried, mixed, or dipped in sauce. The best thing is to make dumplings.
Before Xu Shiyan was reborn, all kinds of wild vegetables had become pure natural and pollution-free green food.
Every spring, there are piles of wild vegetables in the market, and the big leaf celery costs more than ten yuan a catty.
Even so, many people bought it.
Moreover, some people regard wild vegetables as good gifts for relatives and friends.
At this time of the year, you can either buy or go up to the mountains to get some wild vegetables such as celery and send them to relatives and friends far away.
At that time, the express delivery industry was developed, fresh food arrived within two days, and people from far away could taste the delicacy of Northeast China.
But right now, eating wild vegetables is just a choice of desperation.
Who let there be nothing but green onions and leeks in the vegetable garden? What else can you eat without wild vegetables?
The dried vegetables in the autumn have been eaten up, and the potatoes are sprouting and growing, who dares to eat them?
No one can stand pickled vegetables and scallions dipped in miso all day long. Who doesn’t get red-eyed when they see wild vegetables?
In this season, the weeds in the forest are growing wildly, and the little purple, white, and yellow flowers in the forest are swaying in the wind.
The young leaves on the branches have just spit out new green, and they have not yet fully unfolded. There are still some yellow-backed shoots, and the breath of spring is everywhere.
I don’t know what kind of bird it is in the forest. It is singing on the branches, and the chirping is quite pleasant.
On the hillside in the distance, the pink azaleas are just in bloom, bright and moving, as bright as clouds.
Xu Shiyan was not in the mood to appreciate the beautiful scenery, he just lowered his head and searched among the trees.
Sure enough, not too far into the forest, there are several mounds of big leaf celery in front.
In this day and age, everyone has no choice but to go to the mountains to collect a few vegetables and eat them at home. No one makes money by selling celery.
So the wild vegetables have not been crushed yet, they are all very thick.
Waiting for another 30 years, there are more people collecting vegetables on the mountain than vegetables, and the vegetables are as thin as thread, and they are all single.
Pull the grass around the celery to the side with your hands, then grab the root, shake it from side to side and pull it down vigorously, and you will get a handful of celery.
After two or three pierces were squeezed over, I couldn't hold it in my hand.
Pick up a piece of bark at random, or find a rasp grass from the ground, also called elderberry or pencil grass, tie up the celeriac, throw it in the bag with rice, and move on.
Xu Shiyan was walking forward with his head down, when suddenly a big bird flew up from the grass in front of him.
Xu Shiyan saw the feather and knew it was a hen.
Most pheasants build nests in bushes or grass. This is the time when pheasants lay eggs and hatch chicks.
It is estimated that Xu Shiyan came over to pick up the vegetables and surprised the hen pheasant in the nest, so he flew away with a flutter.
Xu Shiyan walked quickly to the grass where the pheasant flew up, searched carefully nearby, and found a nest.
Inside lay six or seven wild eggs with light green shells that were a circle smaller than domestic eggs.
The pheasant has already flown away and can’t be caught. It’s not winter and it’s not easy to catch the pheasant, so let’s just take the eggs away, anyway, the pheasant will lay eggs again.
Xu Shiyan was not polite, he just picked up the eggs and put them in his pocket.
Picked up seven wild eggs, and walked forward to pick up a few handfuls of celery, the slanted pocket couldn't hold anything.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to walk back, but after walking a few steps, he saw a tuft of grass in front of him.
The grass is very similar to clover, but much shorter, with tender reddish stems, slightly transparent in the sun.
Three small triangular leaves, a bit like a **** for shoveling the ground.
This kind of grass is called sour **** board by the locals. The whole plant is edible. It tastes sour and sweet, and children like it very much.
Xu Shiyan squatted down, picked off the bunch of sour **** boards, and brought them back to Lao Liu to eat.
That girl loved eating these things since she was a child, and she hasn't changed since she grew up.
Walking a few steps forward, I saw a few more clusters. Xu Shiyan didn't care about those, and took them off, carefully putting them in his pocket.
Going into the mountain was quite rewarding, so Xu Shiyan went down the mountain with his bag on his back and went home contentedly.
When Xu Shiyan came home, he found that Xu Shiqin was also at home, and he couldn't help being a little surprised, "Why do you leave work so early today?"
Xu Shiyan remembered that it was almost six o'clock when the sixth child returned home, but it was only five o'clock, why did he go home?
"Third brother, I have been back at this time for several days. The shop is not busy, so the master asked me to go home early.
You've been busy all day long and didn't come home until late, so I don't know. "
Xu Shiqin held a small dress in his hand, and was sewing it stitch by stitch. You don't need to look to know that it was made for that little fellow Xu Haiyuan.
Su Anying's milk is good, that kid Xu Haiyuan was born fat, and he has grown a lot these days, and the clothes he originally made are all too small.
When Zhou Guilan and Su Anying were making clothes, they had leftover hair.
But no one thought that the child would be so fat when he was born, grow so fast, and the clothes would not be big enough, so he would have nothing to wear right now.
Xu Shiqin took a torn dress from Su Anying, and cut it to make a small set of clothes for her little nephew.
It happened that the weather was hot, and the jacket and trousers couldn't be worn, so I simply made it single.
"I forgot this morning. I knew I would take it to the store. There are sewing machines in the store. This stuff will make you bald after a few strokes."
As Xu Shiqin said, he sewed the last few stitches, and then bit off the end of the thread.
Xu Shiqin's words immediately reminded Xu Shiyan.
"I remember I had a sewing ticket at home, and I bought a sewing machine when I had time, and it was convenient to use."
When Xu Shiyan went to give Guo Shouye a gift a year ago, he got a stack of tickets, including a sewing ticket.
At that time, I thought about moving. It was too troublesome to buy, and I was busy moving here, and Su Anying didn't know how to use it, so I forgot.

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Sour **** board
chapters.content:
Chapter 126 Sour Hoe Board
Xu Shiyan rummaged through the cabinet and found the sewing ticket, "Fortunately, I didn't lose it. I'll go to the store of the Forestry Bureau another day and just buy one."
Lao Liu has been learning cutting for so long, so he dare not say anything else, but it is definitely no problem to step on the sewing machine.
If you buy it back, you won’t be idle and no one will use it, so buy it.
"Huh? Third brother, you want to buy a sewing machine? Farewell, that thing is too expensive."
A sewing machine costs one hundred and fifty yuan, why spend that money?
"The account cannot be calculated in this way. If a sewing machine is used well, it will be fine for decades.
If we have a sewing machine in our family, you will be able to cut it, and then the whole family will make their own clothes. Wouldn’t it save money in a few years?
Besides, how many people in Donggang know how to cut and sew?
When you finish your studies, you can buy all the tools. If nothing else, you can set up a small tailor shop in our house to make clothes for others. Isn’t it good? "
Xu Shiyan shook his head with a smile, one hundred and fifty yuan was still easy for him to take out.
Sewing machine, one of the three major items in this year, has to be bought sooner or later.
Xu Shiqin was a little moved by what his brother said, "Third brother, are you really planning to buy it?"
"Buy, I will go when I find time these few days, and plant all our vegetable gardens first."
The vegetable garden of Xu’s family is quite big. It’s not enough to just grow vegetables. How can there be so many vegetables for such a few people?
Xu Shiyan plans to grow some yellow smoke, sweet potatoes, and corn in the vegetable garden. The yellow smoke can be sold, and the sweet potato and corn can be eaten as a meal.
A while ago, Xu Shiyan got up early every day to dig the ground. The vegetable garden was almost done, and all kinds of vegetables that should be planted were also planted.
At present, the yellow tobacco seeds and sweet potato seedlings are not available at home, so I have to go back to the big house to find them.
Just a few days later Su Anying confinement, Zhou Guilan has lived here for more than a month, she must go back to the big house.
Xu Shiyan planned to drop by to find some yellow tobacco seeds and sweet potato seedlings when he was sending his mother home.
"Okay, you brothers and sisters, stop chattering there, pack up and eat quickly."
Zhou Guilan had already prepared dinner and greeted the brother and sister with a smile.
"I was so busy talking to Lao Liu that I forgot about the business.
Mom, let’s have dinner later. Today I picked up a few handfuls of celery and a few wild eggs. Let’s prepare two more dishes.
I’ve only eaten small tofu for the past two days, and I’m getting sick from eating it. "
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered that there was still something in his backpack, so he went to the outhouse to find the backpack, and took out the celery and wild eggs inside.
"Oh, this big leaf celery is not too tall.
The Donggang side has a later solar term than the big house side, and it’s almost too late to eat at our place at this time. "
Zhou Guilan looked at the half-foot-tall Da Yeqin and muttered.
"Well, Donggang has a late solar term, I think it can be ten days later than the big house."
The altitude of Donggang is high, it is close to Changbai Mountain, and the temperature is low. It is true that the solar terms are a few days later.
"Hey, old six, I also picked a pickle board, here you are."
Xu Shiyan took out a pickle board from his pocket and handed it to Xu Shiqin.
"Now you are no longer in the big house, and there is nowhere to pick a big neck for you."
The big neck is also a kind of sour plant.
A single stem with a large leaf growing on it, most of which grow under the stone ladles by the river.
The stem is one and a half feet high, it can be eaten when tender, sour and slightly astringent.
In the era when snacks are scarce, it is also very happy to be able to eat a big neck.
In addition to sour **** boards and big necks, there are tiger polygonum seeds that can be eaten in spring.
Tiger Polygonum is actually the seedling of raspberry, the kind of tender seedling that emerges directly from the ground, half a foot high and thick with chopsticks.
Pick off the leaves, peel off the skin and thorns outside the stems, and eat the tender stems inside.
The good taste is the fragrance with a little sweetness, while others are bitter with astringency, all depends on luck.
Anyway, the children in the mountains have already developed the ability to dare to eat anything.
In spring, sour **** board, big neck, tiger Polygonum, in summer, mountain sesame flower, oxbolinggaer, tray, and Dianzao.
In autumn, people eat wild grapes, schisandra, jujubes, and even stinky plums.
Especially stinky plums, which are sour and astringent, can't move the tongue after eating, and the tongue will be stained purple-black.
Eating too much can't poop, but there are still a lot of children who love to eat.
In the era of scarcity of supplies, children could not eat shrimp chips and popcorn, nor could they drink Coke Sprite Mirinda.
But they will try their best to find everything that can be imported to obtain simple happiness and satisfaction.
"My third brother is better, he thinks about me in everything." Xu Shiqin quickly took the sour hoe, pinched one and chewed it in his mouth.
The sour taste diffused in the mouth, and the saliva immediately became richer.
"This thing is really appetizing." While talking, Xu Shiqin walked into the house with the pickle board.
"Don't give it to your third sister-in-law, she is in confinement, she can't eat these."
Sour **** board is cold in nature, and the whole plant can cure burns. Su Anying is still in confinement, so she can't eat that thing.
Xu Shiqin promised, put the sour **** board in the Westinghouse, then took the sickle into the vegetable garden, cut two handfuls of leeks, washed them and cut them into sections, and kept the fried wild eggs.
Zhou Guilan took a handful of celery and shook it, then picked off the leaves and grass, washed it with water, and threw it in a pot to scald it.
Then take it out, put it in cold water, squeeze it dry, cut it into sections and add some chopped green onion, some salt and soy sauce and mix it.
Wild vegetables like to be fried in oil. It doesn’t taste good when fried without oil. It’s better to mix them with cold dishes.
"There seems to be a piece of bacon at home, I will chop it up tomorrow, let's make buns to eat.
Dayeqin is best eaten with cabbage buns or dumplings. "Zhou Guilan kept her hands on and said while mixing vegetables.
Xu Shiyan wanted to say, what kind of buns should I make? Dumplings are delicious, and Dayeqin dumplings are a must.
But think about it again, how to make dumplings?
Meat is okay, the meat ticket that Guo Shouye gave last time is still there, but you can buy it, what about white noodles?
There is a little white flour left at home. The last time the father-in-law and mother-in-law came, they made dumplings. How can there be dumplings without white bread?
Forget it, buns are just buns, and vegetable buns with corn noodles are also pretty good, so don’t think so much about them this year.
Waiting for the spring of next year, I will catch two piglets high and low to raise them, not for anything else, just eat some meat at home.
I didn't dare to raise this year, mainly because Su Anying gave birth to a baby, and she was afraid that she would be tired. Moreover, the family's foundation is weak, and there is not much food, so what to feed?
There were two extra dishes for dinner, cold celery and fried wild eggs with leeks. Unfortunately, Su Anying didn't take a bite of these two.
Chives return to milk, and cold vegetables cannot be eaten by confinement women, for fear of her diarrhea.
Su Anying just watched helplessly, with a pitiful look on her face.
"Daughter-in-law, you can eat cabbage buns tomorrow, so you can bear with it tonight.
You will be confinement in a few days, it will be fine when you are confinement, you can eat whatever you want. "
Xu Shiyan, who was eating vegetables with his head down, suddenly looked up and saw his daughter-in-law's resentful eyes, and hurried to comfort her.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: night cream
chapters.content:
Chapter 127 Night Cream
On May 18th, Xu Haiyuan had a full moon.
On this day, Xu Chenghou brought his son, daughter-in-law, grandson and granddaughter to Donggang to celebrate Xu Haiyuan's full moon.
By the way, I also brought some yellow smoke seedlings and sweet potato seedlings to Xu Shiyan, so there is no need for Xu Shiyan to go back to the big house now.
Everyone had lunch at Xu Shiyan's place, and left for the big house in the afternoon, Zhou Guilan naturally followed.
Before leaving, Xu Shiyan gave his mother another thirty yuan and a few cloth tickets.
"Mom, I should make you a suit of clothes, but I'm also busy, let alone Yingzi.
You take the money and the cloth ticket, and go back to the county to buy a piece of beautiful cloth and make a suit of clothes. "
My mother has been here for a month and a half, and the daughter-in-law and children are very well taken care of.
Su Anying didn't lose weight after confinement, on the contrary, she gained weight.
Not to mention Xu Haiyuan, the flesh of his body, the joints of his arms that look like lotus roots, are all thanks to Zhou Guilan.
Xu Shiyan is grateful to his mother from the bottom of his heart, and has nothing to show, he can only give some money and cloth tickets.
Zhou Guilan refused, but Xu Shiyan stuffed it in his pocket.
"Mom, my sister-in-law and second sister-in-law are watching over there. It's so ugly for us two to tear it back and forth. I'll keep it for you."
Zhou Guilan saw it, and couldn't argue with her son anymore, so she had to accept it, and then left Donggang and returned to the big house with Xu Chenghou and others.
As soon as Zhou Guilan left, the house suddenly seemed much empty.
Fortunately, there is a little guy like Xu Haiyuan, the little thing is getting more and more fun after the full moon, and he has less time to sleep during the day, lying on the kang and kicking his calves.
Sometimes she can babble and chatter, she looks fat and white, which is very rare.
Xu Shiyan kept his word. After searching for a day, he actually went to the store of Songjianghe Forestry Bureau and brought a sewing machine back.
By the way, I also bought a complete set of cutting rulers, scissors and other tools for Xu Shiqin.
But Xu Shiqin was so happy that he cut a half-sleeve top for Su Anying that day, and made it in the middle of the night.
The next morning, I ironed it with an iron and brought it to Su Anying. Su Anying tried it on and it was just right.
"Liu Liu, you are good at this craft, and the clothes you make are really beautiful."
Su Anying stood in front of the big mirror and looked left and right. She was very satisfied and even praised Xu Shiqin for her good craftsmanship.
Xu Shiyan was also very happy to see it. The sixth child is really good at this skill, so he must praise him a few words.
"Third brother, I have been learning from the master for several months, and I can make most clothes.
My master secretly told me a few days ago that he would let me study for another two months, and then find a way to help me get rid of the relationship and see if I can stay in the tailor shop to work. "
Xu Shiqin is ingenious, no matter what he looks at, he knows it.
Plus she will come to work, and she will bring something to the master from time to time.
Nothing else, fresh cabbage, radish, and lettuce from the vegetable garden are brought to the master in different styles every day.
The master is a worker. There is no vegetable garden at home, so you have to buy vegetables to eat, and someone will give them to you. Wouldn’t you be happy?
After coming and going, she took more care of Xu Shiqin. No matter what clothes she made, she would call Xu Shiqin to look at them, and then tell them after reading.
Xu Shiqin is not stupid in the first place, and even if the master teaches so hard, what else can't he learn?
"Yo, your master is good at it, you can deal with it.
It would be the best if you can stay in the store, receive salary, get red card, not bad. "
The tailor shop is a subordinate unit of the Forestry Bureau, collectively owned, and the masters in the tailor shop are all paid regular workers.
If Xu Shiqin can stay, even the initial apprentices will have a salary of more than 20 yuan a month, and they can still eat food supplies, which is a good thing.
"If you need money or things to leave favors, tell me, and I will help you find a way. As long as the work can be implemented, everything will be easy to handle."
The Forestry Bureau is a good unit that everyone wants to work on, with high wages and good benefits.
If Xu Shiqin can really become a worker, he really doesn't have to worry about it in the future.
Even if she is laid off in a few years, she is not afraid. Xu Shiqin knows how to work, can open her own shop, and retire when she gets old. What a great thing?
Even if you spend a little money on favors, it's worth it.
In late May, the club has grown quite tall, and it's time to start weeding the ginseng field.
And Xu Shiyan also began to prepare for the top dressing of fermented bean cakes.
Yu Shouguang allocated three young men to Xu Shiyan, and drew out a 50-foot-frozen stick as an experimental field.
also promised to keep another 100 feet of new planting this autumn, all of which will be used to test the effect of bean cake fertilizer.
Xu Shiyan took the task and led his men to crush the bean cakes.
The bean cakes of this year are all machine-pressed into a big disc, and it is not easy to smash them.
Steam the bean cakes in a pot for a period of time, wait until the bean cakes are softened by the water vapor, and then chop them with a guillotine.
Those who make the base fertilizer soak the bean cakes, add pesticides, and pile them up in a spare room to ferment.
After fermenting to a certain extent, take it out to dry, and put it away after drying, and use it when planting ginseng in autumn.
The bean cake water for topdressing can be fermented in a large tank or pond, but the easiest way is to dig a deep pit in the horseway, and then add water and bean cake powder to fertilize.
The advantage of this is that it is close to the ginseng field and it is convenient to fertilize.
The disadvantage is that there is no agricultural plastic film these days, so there must be yellow mud in the temporary pits, and the bean cake water is mixed with yellow mud water.
But it’s okay, it’s all going to be poured into the ground anyway, yellow muddy water is yellow muddy water.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan led his people, first crushed the bean cakes, and then went to the ground, dug a few pits in the fifty-foot pond and horse trail, and began to fertilize.
"Hey? Why do I feel that the temperature has been a little low these two days?"
On the evening of May 24th, after finishing work, Xu Shiyan and three other young men walked outside the venue together. Xu Shiyan suddenly felt that something was wrong.
It’s almost June, and summer is coming soon. Why is the temperature so low in the evening?
"Really, if you don't tell me, I haven't noticed yet, it's chilly.
This year's bad weather is terrible enough. It didn't rain in the spring, and it rained again a few days ago. The ground temperature can't rise. I don't know what the crops will grow. "
The people together raised their hands and rubbed their arms, and quickly put on their coats.
"I feel cold, it's not a good thing, I'm afraid of late frost."
Xu Shiyan vaguely remembers that it seems that in the past seven or eight years, in late May and early June, there were continuous late frosts in Daying, Songjiang, Xinglong, Donggang, Quanyang, Beigang and other areas, and the affected area was more than 40,000 mu.
At that time, Xu Shiyan was working in the Da’an Coal Mine. He listened to the radio broadcast from you. He couldn’t remember the exact time.
But Xu Shiyan knows one thing, the No. 2 bridge is the frost road, and as long as there is frost, he must go here.
Now all the sticks have sprouted quite tall. If there is a late frost and the sticks are frozen to death, the consequences will be very serious.
"Let's go, take the car home." Xu Shiyan was a little anxious when he thought of this.
Hurriedly left the venue, found the carriage of the brigade, boarded the carriage with everyone and returned to Donggang.
Getting off the carriage, Xu Shiyan didn't even go home, and went straight to Yu Shouguang's house. "Secretary Yu, I have something to tell you."

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Method
chapters.content:
Chapter 128 Method
"Xiao Xu, you just came back from the mountain? Why, something went wrong with the fermenting of bean cakes?"
Yu Shouguang saw that Xu Shiyan was covered in dirt, so he knew that he had just come down from work and came here without even returning home, so he couldn't help feeling a little strange.
"Uncle, it's not about bean cakes.
It’s because the temperature is low these days, why do I think that there should be night cream?
The No. 2 bridge is frost road. If there is late frost here, what will happen to the sticks on the mountain? "
Xu Shiyan was straightforward and expressed his worries.
When Yu Shouguang heard this, his expression turned serious. He could feel the low temperature these two days.
But he really didn't think about the late frost, because it rained a while ago, but it has just cleared up these few days, and the temperature is a little lower, which is normal.
"Xiao Xu, this is not a joke, are you sure?"
The second brigade has more than 10,000 feet of bamboo, all of which are at the end of the No. 2 bridge. If there is a late frost, all the bamboo seedlings will be frozen to death, and the loss will be too serious.
"Uncle, I said this myself, you definitely don't believe it.
If it doesn’t work, Uncle ask some old people on our team. "
Xu Shiyan knew that since he was young, it was normal for people to ignore what he said.
But he has to say that this matter is related to the income of a brigade or even a commune this autumn.
"Yes, yes, let's go, let's go to the team headquarters."
Yu Shouguang nodded heavily when he heard this, followed Xu Shiyan and went straight to the team headquarters.
Arriving at the team headquarters, Yu Shouguang directly turned on the loudspeaker and started shouting.
Call the other cadres of the Second Brigade, several veteran households, and technicians to discuss things together.
When everyone arrived at the team headquarters, they heard Xu Shiyan's deduction, and before anyone else could speak, the technician jumped up first.
"Impossible, when is it still frosty?
This was affected by the rain before. We are too close to Changbai Mountain, and the temperature is already low. "
The technician is a college student of workers, peasants and soldiers. He studied at the Agricultural University and was assigned to do an internship a while ago.
Yu Shouguang handed over the matter of fertilizing the bean cakes to Xu Shiyan, and also assigned him the matter of the experimental field, the technician was a little unhappy.
Feeling that Xu Shiyan robbed him of his job, he was a little emotional towards Xu Shiyan, so before anyone else could speak, he jumped out to object.
It was the old farmers who murmured for a long time, but no one expressed their opinions hastily.
Yu Shouguang saw the expressions of those old people, and knew that something was wrong, "Uncle Zhang, look at it, what should we do about this?"
The man called Uncle Zhang by Yu Shouguang is seventy years old this year, with gray hair all over his head, but he is in good spirits.
The old man stroked his beard, pondered for a moment, "I remember when I was young, maybe in my twenties.
One year around this time, the club seedlings came out of the ground and grew quite tall. When a frost came, they all froze to death.
Well, at that time, they were all owned by their own family, and there were several large households. Because of this frost, they lost everything. "
The mallet seedlings will rot if they are frozen to death, and the germs will infect downwards, and even the mallet underneath will rot.
In order to reduce the loss, once the mallet seedlings are frozen, they have to get ginseng and make goods quickly.
But at this time, the mallets are not starched, the scales are not weighed at all, and the goods are not produced, which is useless.
When Yu Shouguang heard this, his expression turned ugly, "Uncle, what do you do when you say this? Can it be prevented?"
Yu Shouguang is in his forties this year. He has never experienced such a thing, and he has no idea, so he hurriedly asked.
Master Zhang sighed and shook his head.
"It's not easy to fix, if it's a big field, you can try it with smoke.
Ours is ginseng ground. There are sticks, boards and thatch on the top of the pool skewers. If there is a fire, even the sticks will be burned. "
Experienced farmers will look at Shuangtou.
Before the frost comes, pile some branches and dry grass around the whole field, and when the first frost arrives, set fires around.
Using pyrotechnic gas to increase the temperature can prevent crops from being killed by frost.
But that is a big field, relatively open and easy to operate. What's the deal with this ginseng?
The pool strings are covered with thatch and covered with wooden planks and thatch. If one is not done well, the fire will jump up to the pool strings. Don’t resist frost, let’s burn the whole camp.
When Yu Shouguang heard this, his heart turned cold. How can this be done? "Xiao Xu, do you have any tricks?"
Yu Shouguang turned his head and looked at Xu Shiyan with hopeful eyes.
Xu Shiyan also shook his head, "Secretary, this matter is not easy to deal with. The key is that we can't find anything suitable."
"What is it?" Yu Shouguang and the old men asked together.
"Cao Xiang, use this thing to stick it on the side of the pool, and arrange for people to wait.
Seeing that the head of frost has arrived, light it up immediately, and the frost will not fall down once the smoke is smoked. "
Xu Shiyan sighed while talking, they all did this in their previous life, but what is going on now?
A few years ago, feudal superstition was broken, and burning incense and paper was not allowed. Where can I find grass incense?
Sure enough, when Yu Shouguang and the others heard this, they all shook their heads and sighed.
It’s really hard to find these things nowadays, the factories that produce burnt paper and grass incense are all yellow, where can I buy them?
"What's the matter? Are we really just watching?"
Yu Shouguang was in a hurry, more than 10,000 feet of stick, not to mention being hit by Shuang, even if the damage was one or two hundred feet, it would be a loss of tens of thousands, who can bear it?
"Hmph, I'm just talking nonsense, I don't believe there can be frost. What kind of grass fragrance is used? I have never heard of such a method."
On the other end, the technician rolled his eyes and hummed.
Xu Shiyan pondered for a moment, "Secretary Yu, if it doesn't work, we can only take a risk.
At this time, the vegetation on the mountain is lush and thick, and when a fire is lit, it only emits smoke.
Let's arrange more people to watch it, as long as it doesn't get out of hand. "
What should I do then? You can't really sit here, can you?
Wait for the frost to come and freeze the club to death, and the whole brigade will cry at home?
"Secretary, I think what Xiao Xu said is reasonable, we can't just wait, if there is frost, there is no place to cry.
Hurry up and arrange people to go up the mountain, and prepare as much as possible while it’s still not too dark. "
The captains of several teams also agreed with Xu Shiyan's words.
This thing is related to the livelihood of more than 300 households for three years. It is not a joke. Even if the inference is wrong, it is better than not preparing for anything.
"Yu Yu, hurry up and call someone on the radio, and some of us old guys will follow along, helping to see when Shuangtou will come."
Those old men couldn't hold back any longer, the matter was too big, who could stay at home with peace of mind?
Yu Shouguang gritted his teeth, made up his mind, and immediately turned on the loudspeaker to call out.
"Every household, please pay attention. Each household should contribute a strong laborer, bring a sickle, ax and matches, and report to the team headquarters immediately."
After shouting four or five times in a row, he stopped.
Time is tight and tasks are heavy, so there must be a large number of people. More than 300 households, one person from each household should be enough.
The loudspeaker yelled, and those who heard it hurriedly informed each other. It didn't take long for more than three hundred strong laborers to gather in the open space in the backyard of the team headquarters.
Yu Shouguang personally explained to everyone that he would rather make a mistake than let it go.
Even if it is a waste of time, you must immediately go up the mountain, cut fresh branches and wormwood, and pile them in the open spaces of the ginseng. Once the frost falls, light the fire immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 129: anti frost
chapters.content:
Chapter 129 Anti-Frost
The second team has a big business, this is really true.
All the people gathered, the barn over there was put on the cart, and everyone sat in the carriage and went straight to the No. 2 bridge.
Arrived at the place, Xu Shiyan called to stop the crowd first, and mowed grass and trees outside.
Xu Shiyan led a few young people, and together with the spectators, dismantled all the ground guns.
The sky has darkened at this moment, and the line of sight is not good. What if someone accidentally trips over the ground gun and gets injured?
The ground gun is dismantled here, and the people at the other end go into the forest and don't care about those. Whatever wormwood and shrubs, they can cut whatever they have.
The sky was getting dark and it was inconvenient to work. Someone asked Mingzi to light it, made a torch and held it up, and others continued to mow the grass.
Everyone has been busy until late at night, and finally placed a lot of firewood piles around the venue and in some open spaces inside.
Every pile of firewood was guarded by several people. Those old men and Xu Shiyan were scattered around the venue.
They are all experienced people who can feel the frost coming from the changes in the soil and air.
The temperature gradually drops at night. In early summer, people who can freeze are shivering. Many people feel that the weather is abnormal and they are more vigilant.
Even the technician who had been yelling that he couldn't put frost on his face gradually became serious.
He is also a student of the Agricultural University, so it is impossible that he does not even have this bit of common sense.
More than 300 people stayed outside in this freezing night until the middle of the night, but the frost still did not come.
Some people breathed a sigh of relief, while others muttered, thinking that the night might have been wasted.
There are also some people who are really sleepy and panic, just find a place to lean on and stare.
Just as the east was turning pale, suddenly, Xu Shiyan from the west shouted, "Shuangtou has arrived."
Then, a torch was lit, and the fire was lit, and the blue-white smoke rose immediately, fluttering and scattered around.
The fire started from the west to the east and was gradually lit.
Everyone tensed up, staring at the fires with full concentration.
I was afraid that a gust of wind would suddenly blow somewhere, and the sparks would fall on the mallet shed, which would be a bad thing.
Fires were lit everywhere in the venue, and the whole venue was shrouded in smoke. People coughed from the smoke and had to lower their bodies slightly.
The fire burned for almost half an hour before it gradually extinguished.
When the smoke cleared, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, they listened to Xu Shiyan's suggestion. Otherwise, how much would this frost have cost?
"Finally escaped a catastrophe, thanks to Xiao Xu this time, I have to give you a big credit."
Yu Shouguang also followed up the mountain. He had held back his energy and didn't speak before, but now that his spirit was relaxed, he felt tired and exhausted.
"It's nothing, so let's all go back?"
The smoky anti-frost has been successful, why stay on the mountain? Everyone has stayed up all night, so hurry down the mountain to rest.
"Uncle Yu, there is no rush to go down the mountain. I suggest that everyone spend more time and go into the forest to cut some grass and trees.
This frost, I'm afraid it will come continuously. "As a result, Xu Shiyan on the other end said this.
He remembered that in his previous life, it was from the end of May to the beginning of June, and there was a continuous frost, and the loss was very serious.
So, they just won the first battle, and they don't know how many more battles will follow.
"What? Can it still be connected? Are you kidding me?"
Originally, the technician had changed a lot towards Xu Shiyan, but after hearing this, he got on the fence again.
"Why haven't I heard that frost can be applied continuously? How can there be such a saying?"
"Before you said that it's almost summer and there can't be frost. Did it come just now?"
Xu Shiyan doesn't like to argue with others, but this kid is too annoying, so I'm sorry if I don't hate him.
The technician choked on Xu Shiyan's words, his face flushed but he couldn't say anything to refute, and coughed angrily.
Yu Shouguang, on the other hand, was more calm than the technician, "Xiao Xu, are you sure? Is this frost still coming?"
"Uncle, look at the weather, I dare not say, I mean, be prepared.
Let’s go into the woods later and get some to pile up again. Let’s see how the temperature will be tomorrow night.
If the temperature is still low, needless to say, we have to continue to resist frost. If the temperature is not so low, then it will be fine.
Anyway, it’s just a few piles of grass, so it’s okay to put them there. In case of frost, we won’t be blind, right? "
What can Xu Shiyan say? Can't I tell them that I listened to the radio in my previous life, saying that several communes were affected by disasters, and tens of thousands of acres of fields were completely destroyed?
Yu Shouguang thought about it for a while, and it made sense, anyway, it’s already reached this time, let’s work.
What else can I do if I go down the mountain and go back to sleep after the work is done?
"Come on, the big guy is troubled, then follow what Xiao Xu said and continue to make haystacks."
The secretary spoke, and everyone agreed with Xu Shiyan's words.
This is related to the vital interests of the big guys. No one is stupid, so let’s be tired if you are tired, as long as it is useful.
So, everyone picked up the sickle and ax again, and continued to work in the forest.
The sky is getting brighter now, and the work will not be delayed, and the big guys can't care about being sleepy, so they can work with their arms free.
We were busy until six o'clock in the morning, and everyone was tired and sleepy, walking swayingly, and piled up a lot of firewood piles in the venue.
This time it was finally over, so I went down the mountain in a carriage.
On the way down the mountain, I saw a layer of shiny frost hanging on the grass and leaves by the roadside.
The temperature is low in the morning, and the frost has not yet melted. In the daytime, the leaves of the trees will all wilt when exposed to the sun.
"Okay, let's all go home and catch up on sleep. You don't need to worry about other things. It depends on the situation at night and listens to the loudspeaker announcement."
Back to the village, Yu Shouguang told everyone to disperse and go home to catch up on sleep.
When Xu Shiyan entered the house, Xu Shiqin packed up and went to Songjianghe.
Seeing the third brother wandering home, Xu Shiqin hurriedly asked, "Third brother, why did you go last night? Why did you come back at this time?
My third sister-in-law didn't sleep much all night, just waiting for you. "
Xu Shiyan didn't eat last night, and stayed up all night. He was tired, sleepy and hungry, and his whole body was listless.
"The anti-frost is gone, can't we feel it in our village? How low was the temperature last night."
Xu Shiqin nodded, and couldn't help asking curiously, "Well, it's quite cold, how is it on the mountain? Is it really frosty?"
Although the temperature is low on this side of the house, after all, the crowds are dense and there are fireworks, so there is no frost.
"The No. 2 bridge is the frost road, and the frost is very heavy. On the way back, I saw a layer of grass leaves on the side of the road."
Xu Shiyan staggered into the room, and didn't bother to change his clothes. He tied his head on the kang, didn't care about anything, and fell asleep.
Seeing this, Su Anying didn't dare to disturb her, so she quickly pulled the quilt over to cover Xu Shiyan, and put the rice in the pot to heat it up.
When do you wake up and eat again, what can you do?

chapters.title: Chapter 130: meritorious service
chapters.content:
Chapter 130 Merit
Xu Shiyan didn't sleep long this time, and woke up hungry at ten o'clock.
As soon as I woke up, I heard a loudspeaker shouting, saying that people from all households were sent out to the big fields to prepare for the frost.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard the news, he knew that the frost last night probably had something to do with Datiandi.
"Daughter-in-law, is there anything to eat? I'm starving to death. I have to eat quickly. I'm not sure what to do in the afternoon."
There are a lot of people in the village, and it is estimated that they will not be needed to fight the frost in the field, but I am afraid that they will have to go up the mountain at night.
He didn't eat last night or this morning, and now he is so hungry that he can't bear it.
Su Anying was waiting for Xu Shiyan to wake up, and quickly served food.
"You didn't eat when you came back in the morning, so I heated all the food in the pot, eat it."
Small ballast porridge, big pancakes, fried cabbage with bacon, water radish, green onions, miso, that’s all.
Where does Xu Shiyan care? Now it’s good to eat whatever you want.
So Xilihulu ate two bowls of porridge, killed three pancakes, and finished a plate of dishes, and only then did he feel that his stomach was full.
"Daughter-in-law, you are watching the child at home, I have to go to the team headquarters.
I don’t know what happened to Shuang last night, I have to go to the team headquarters to find Secretary Yu. "
Frost resistance was proposed by Xu Shiyan. He still doesn't know the specific situation. He has to find out the situation before he can decide whether to continue to resist frost tonight.
Xu Shiyan reckoned that even if he didn't go to the team headquarters, Yu Shouguang would have to get someone to call him later, so he might as well go there by himself.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan didn't even change his clothes, so he went to the team headquarters in a dirty suit.
After inquiring at the team headquarters, I learned that Yu Shouguang had been called to the commune for a meeting.
Before he left, he left a special message, saying that he wanted to call Xu Shiyan to discuss matters, so the people in the team headquarters asked Xu Shiyan to wait.
Xu Shiyan was waiting at the team headquarters, and at this time, the commune was having a meeting.
The area affected by the frost last night was not small. The ginseng fields of the first and second brigades were covered by hundreds of feet of damage, and the large fields of each brigade were also affected to varying degrees.
"Just received a call from the superior, Daying, Songjiang, Xinglong, Manjiang, Quanyang, Beigang, all have different degrees of frost.
Tell me, how much did your teams lose? "
The secretary of the commune took the lead and asked the teams to report the area affected by the disaster. This is to report the statistical data to the county.
When the secretary asked, the captains of several brigades all lowered their heads and sighed.
A large group lost more than 300 feet of ginseng land, all of which were produced this year, and large fields were also affected to varying degrees. It is estimated that hundreds of acres of seedlings were killed by the frost.
Large fields, if it’s really not possible, you can grow sweet potatoes and vegetables, but ginseng is not good. If it’s not good enough, you’ll have to buy ginseng as soon as possible. It’s better than rotten in the field.
The third team suffered more damage than the first team.
The ginseng land of the third brigade was at Nantianmen, where the frost was heavy, and the ginseng land was affected by five hundred feet.
Fortunately, they are all newly planted. At this time, I will start to make goods, and then sprinkle some perilla seeds. After a while, I will cut down the perilla seeds and turn over the soil, and replant them in autumn, so that the ginseng will not be blind.
No way, who called the stall? The Datian area of ​​the third brigade was also affected by hundreds of acres, which made the secretary of the third brigade feel distressed.
It was the second brigade's turn. Yu Shouguang looked at the people on both sides, but he didn't dare to speak.
I'll go, the other teams have lost so much, and their second brigade didn't suffer any damage. If I say this, can they be beaten to death?
"Yu Shouguang, where is your team? I remember that your team's base is on the No. 2 bridge, right?
It is said that the frost is quite heavy on the other side, how about you? "The more the secretary of the commune listened, the heavier his heart became.
God doesn’t take care of people. How much food was lost and how many clubs were damaged by a frost? Will members be hungry this year?
"Secretary Li, the ginseng of our team did not suffer any disaster.
Last night I took people up the mountain to resist the frost. I didn’t sleep all night, so I managed to keep the stick.
There are hundreds of acres of Datian fields affected by disasters, there is no way, they cannot be separated, and the strong laborers are all working on the land, so they don’t care about Datian. "
Yu Shouguang looked at the people on both sides, and said cautiously.
"What? Old Yu, you really took people up the mountain to resist the frost? Damn, how can you be sure there is frost?"
The secretaries of the First Brigade and the Second Brigade all looked at Yu Shouguang like a monster.
The three brigades are all in the same commune, and they are all next to each other. The second brigade kept shouting through the loudspeaker yesterday evening, and the other brigades heard it too.
When Yu Shouguang led his people up the mountain last night, he also specially sent someone to notify the other two brigades to make preparations.
The two brigades didn't take it seriously, but in the end, there was really a frost, and they were all dumbfounded.
So at this moment, they are all very curious, what makes Yu Shouguang firmly believe that there will be frost?
"There is a young man in our team, the one who helped get the ground gun before. He came to me yesterday afternoon and said that it is very likely that there will be frost.
That young man, he is a very solid and stable person. I know that he cannot say that if he is not sure.
I consulted with some old people in the team, and then we went up the mountain to fight the frost.
Don’t worry about whether there will be frost or not, at least we have worked hard to prepare, even if it is useless, we have done our best. Right? "
At this time, gloating at other people's misfortunes seemed wrong, but Yu Shouguang couldn't help laughing.
This Xu Shiyan is really a lucky star.
Look, thanks to listening to him, right? Otherwise, it would be Yu Shouguang who cried today.
If he hadn't listened to Xu Shiyan's words, it is estimated that the No. 2 bridge can be completely wiped out without leaving a single bit. Thinking of the result, Yu Shouguang has the desire to die.
"Grass, you old boy is so lucky, you can meet any good things, why don't you think our team doesn't have such a capable person?"
The secretaries of the two brigades were all annoyed. They all received the news, but they didn't believe it.
Who would have thought that it would still be frost in June? This is a good time, and the loss is heavy.
A few brigades bought ground guns before, Secretary Li knew about it, and even reported it to the higher authorities.
But he didn't pay much attention to the man who made the ground gun.
When I heard that Kangshuang was mentioned by that young man this time, Secretary Li became curious.
"Old Yu, tell me about this young man in your team."
Yu Shouguang talked about Xu Shiyan's role in the frost resistance yesterday.
This time, Xu Shiyan has made great contributions and must be praised.
"By the way, Xiao Xu told me that I have to go to resist the frost tonight, and the frost will continue to fall."
Yu Shouguang suddenly remembered what Xu Shiyan said, and hurriedly told everyone.
Everyone heard this, so why are you still holding a meeting here? Hurry up and arrange for someone to go to Anti-Frost.
If there are several frosts in a row, everyone will not have to live this year.
"Secretary Li, we're going back first, and we have to arrange people to fight against frost."
How can the cadres of several brigades sit still? One by one, they hurriedly left the commune compound like burning their buttocks, and gathered people to go up the mountain to fight the frost.
"Old Yu, I have to report to the county as soon as possible. This is a big deal. If the county can arrange it in time, maybe the loss can be reduced."
Secretary Li didn't have the mood to chat right now, so he immediately picked up the phone and planned to report to the county.
"That young man in your team has made great contributions. This year's model worker and advanced individual are all given to him."

chapters.title: Chapter 131: award
chapters.content:
Chapter 131 rewards
From May 24th to June 2nd, 1978, many areas in Fusong had continuous late frosts.
Because leaders at all levels actively led all members to resist the frost, only thousands of acres of land were affected by the disaster.
Compared with what Xu Shiyan heard on the radio in his previous life, more than 40,000 mu of land was affected by the disaster, which is already a blessing.
When the statistical results came out, the county leaders also breathed a sigh of relief.
Thanks to Donggang Commune's advice and continuous frost resistance, a large area of ​​farmland was preserved.
Otherwise, this autumn, everyone will be hungry.
The county leaders sent people to Donggang Commune to investigate, and learned that it was Xu Shiyan, a member of the Second Brigade, who suggested continuous frost resistance, and immediately rewarded and commended Xu Shiyan.
Elected Xu Shiyan as this year's model worker and advanced individual, and at the same time gave certain rewards.
Not only the county, Donggang Commune, and the Second Brigade also gave corresponding rewards.
Moreover, Yu Shouguang also directly promoted Xu Shiyan as a technician, and from now on he will receive high work points and do technical work.
In addition to the certificate, serving the people, a large mug, and towels, what is more surprising is that the county even rewarded a bicycle ticket.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about the others, he couldn't be more happy when he got the bicycle ticket.
Without further ado, I took it to the Songjianghe store, bought a big Jinlu bicycle and came back.
Bicycles, sewing machines, two of the three major items have already been purchased. Now, the big guys are very envious, and they all praise Shiyan for his ability.
Donggang is good at this point, the place is big, there are many talented people, and there are also rich families.
So the envy of the big guys is envy, but no one is jealous.
Frost resistance for nine consecutive days has exhausted everyone, but no matter how tired they are, the work in the field cannot be delayed.
Daejeon should shovel heads all over the ground, and ginseng fields should pinch ginseng flowers, and nothing can be delayed.
Xu Shiyan is already a technician of the second brigade, and he is definitely not needed for the work of shoveling the ground. He took people to pick ginseng flowers in the ginseng field.
Ginseng flower is the flower of ginseng, a raceme, a small broken green flower.
Ginseng does not bloom during the planting period, and ginseng blooms every year from the new plant.
Ginseng blossoms and bears fruit, which will definitely affect the yield. In order to balance the yield and reserve seeds, the seeds are generally frozen for this year, and the newly planted and manufactured goods are not retained.
Since there are no seeds left, it must be pinched off before the ginseng flowers bloom to avoid wasting nutrients.
When pinching ginseng flowers, find a sunny day, so that after the ginseng flowers are pinched off, the broken marks on the stems left will quickly dry up and will not be infected.
Moreover, the pinched ginseng flowers have to be dried in the sun, and they will not be dried on cloudy days.
"Be careful, turn over the leaves, don't drop the ginseng flowers.
This is a stick for making goods. If the ginseng seeds are left, the stick will easily leak if it is not pressed against the scale. "
Xu Shiyan is now a technician, so he doesn't need to work as hard as before, he just watches others work now.
So while walking and yelling, I was afraid that someone would work bald and fight back. It seemed that the work was fast, but in fact it was not of quality.
Those sticks that were unearthed late and grew short, forgot to pinch the ginseng flowers.
This kind of thing is too common. When Xu Shiyan was looking at the place on the mountain, every time the ginseng seeds matured, he would make a pool of goods to stop the ginseng seeds.
The so-called block is to pick up the leak.
The blocking stick means that after someone started ginseng, someone took the four-toothed ginseng and went to the ground to plan the ground again, picking up the missing ginseng and ginseng whiskers from the ground.
Stopping the seeds is also the same reason. As for blocking ginseng seeds, it is to pick up the ginseng seeds that have been picked up by other people's pinched ginseng flowers.
There may only be three or five sticks in a ten-foot stick, which cannot support a lot of goods in one place, but it may be tens of thousands of feet. If you accumulate a little, you can pick up a lot.
And the seeds of the sticks that are made are big and of good quality. If they are washed and dried, they will be sprinkled on the ground, and they will grow good ginseng seeds.
If you don’t say it, it seems that there are many ways to learn. Those who know how to learn can earn a lot of money in three years, but those who don’t know how to learn can earn nothing.
As for what it means to make goods out of the way, that is a term in the ginseng industry.
It means that the ginseng pulp is insufficient, and the inside is empty. After steaming and drying, it is not round, but shrunken instead. This is called ditching.
Ditched goods, if they can’t be graded or weighed, naturally they can’t be sold at a high price.
Xu Shiyan is the type who works carefully. With him watching, these people really have no chance to be fooled. They all carefully rummaged under the leaves, trying not to miss a single one.
Don't look at it as if pinching ginseng is easy, but it is actually quite troublesome.
The pool is about five feet wide, with a canopy on top, and the two of them have to face each other, kneel on the side of the pool, stretch out their hands to pinch ginseng flowers, and kneel down all day, which is really tiring.
It should be said that a lot of work in the ginseng field has to be performed on knees, such as pinching ginseng flowers, weeding, loosening the soil, and pinching ginseng seeds.
How about saying that this ginseng is valuable, kowtow and kneel for three years, and then sell it cheap, I would be sorry for the effort.
It is not fast to pinch ginseng flowers, and the two of them will only be thirty or forty feet a day.
The No. 2 Brigade made more than 3,000 feet of ginseng this year, plus the newly planted end. It took almost three days to finish all the ginseng flowers.
The pinched ginseng flowers were spread out on broken mats and spread out to dry in the open space behind the team headquarters.
Women can do this job, as long as it doesn't rain, turn it around properly so that it doesn't get too sunburned.
After pinching the ginseng flowers in the ginseng field and shoveling the weeds in the field, there is no important work in the field at this time. It belongs to the period of hanging hoe, and the members of the commune will go to the mountains to do side jobs.
"Daughter-in-law, they came to me and said that they would go to the mountains tomorrow to gather cattle and hair.
Do you still have pancakes at home? You help me stack more pancakes tomorrow morning. "On the afternoon of the 6th, as soon as Xu Shiyan entered the door, he told Su Anying.
Su Anying was cooking, and when she heard what Xu Shiyan said, she asked curiously, "What is Niu Maoguang?"
I was in Daying before, so I have never heard of this thing.
"Well, it's something like bracken, covered in fine hair, similar to ox hair, so it's called ox hair.
Wait until I come back and you will find out. There are ditches and ponds in the woods behind us, but the quantity is small. "
Xu Shiyan scratched his head, not knowing how to describe it to his wife.
Niu Mao Guang, also known as Weicai, scientific name Cinnamon Osmanthus, belongs to Vilaceae, perennial herb.
Niu Mao Guang's dried products are very popular in countries that live a good life and are known as mountain delicacy.
Since 1972, the annual domestic export volume has been 2 to 3 million tons.
It can export to earn foreign exchange, so many buying stations accept it. Every year in this season, big guys will go to the mountains together to collect cattle and hair.
Niu Maoguang generally grows in ditch ponds or laodianzi. There are not many near Donggang Commune, and there are very few in the back woods.
So most of them go to places like Bakilometer, Baihuiyao, and Baixi Dadianzi, all of which are quite far away.
Riding bicycles now, and riding motorcycles in the future, or taking other people’s agricultural tricycles and paying the fare.
There are those who are powerful, driving halfway or in a big car to pull people into the protected area to collect cattle.
There are few people in the protected area, and the cow hair is widely distributed and thick, and most of them produce bad food, which is of good quality and high price.
Of course, don’t think about it this year. It’s more than 100 kilometers away from the reserve, and most people can’t go there, except for people from the forest farms in Qianchuan and Shengli.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: plentiful
chapters.content:
Chapter 132 Squeeze the cow hair wide
At four o'clock in the morning on June 7th, Xu Shiyan had already finished his meal, and with his dry food on his back, he rode his bicycle to Baixi Dadianzi with a few young people in the team.
Baixi Dadianzi, five or six kilometers east of the Baixi Fork Road, is very close to Baixi Forest Farm.
This place, thirty years later, will be developed into Changbaishan Airport.
Right now, this place is still a very desolate place.
Dianzi referred to by the locals mostly refers to closed depressions in the mountains, that is, swamps.
Most are located near river valleys and streams in broad-leaved forest belts and coniferous-broad-leaved mixed forest belts.
Xu Shiyan and others put their bicycles outside Dadianzi, found a thicker tree, tied them to the tree with iron chains, and locked them with locks.
A bicycle costs more than 100 a month these days, and if you lose it, you will be heartbroken to death.
In a few years, in places like Baixi Dadianzi, there will be people who specialize in car inspection, and they will pay twenty cents.
After locking the car, everyone carried their pockets and walked into the dianzi.
The pockets they carry are woven bags. The straps of the carrying baskets are removed, the two corners of the woven bags are tied at the bottom, and the mouth of the bag is fastened at the top. This is lighter and more convenient than carrying the baskets.
The forests in Dadianzi are sparse, mainly small shrubs and grasses, especially the pachyrhiza, which are widely distributed.
Everyone is wearing water boots, try to step on the grass or tree roots when walking, otherwise they will fall into the water if they are not careful.
The cow hair is wide, and it is distributed in such a dianzi.
There are clusters of pier, the buds are about 20 cm long, and the leaves have not yet unfolded, and they are all shrunk into a ball, like a baby's head, fluffy.
Entering Dianzi, the crowd scattered in all directions, each bowing their heads to pick up the cattle.
Xu Shiyan held a small knife in his hand, cut the root of the ox hair about two centimeters from the ground, and got a pile of ox hair in his hand.
Put it in the handbag first, and then put it in the back pocket when it is full.
Baixi Dadianzi has not been patronized by Wanshuang this year, and the hair growth is quite good, and everyone can't care about talking and chatting, and they all seize the time to gather the hair growth.
There are more mosquitoes in the swamp, and there are small planer adzes, which fly towards people in groups, and if you are not careful, you will be bitten and get a big bag.
In order to prevent mosquito bites, most people can only hold cigarettes in their mouths, trying to smoke away mosquitoes.
Some people brought their daughter-in-law's gauze scarf and wrapped their heads directly.
The gauze scarf is very thin and transparent. Wrapping it around the head does not block the view, but it will feel uncomfortable after a long time.
No way, in order not to be bitten, this is the only way.
Xu Shiyan still used the old method, breaking off a piece of old beef liver, burning it and tying it to the top of his head.
The morning passes quickly, find a dry place to sit and rest at noon, have a meal, and continue in the afternoon.
Waiting until three o'clock in the afternoon, Xu Shiyan yelled at everyone, started to wander back, found a bicycle out of Dianzi, and then walked outside.
After pushing the car for a few steps, I saw a group of things flashing past in front of me.
"Fuck, it's a deer, a herd of deer." Someone shouted.
"Why are you so excited? We don't have guns either."
Xu Shiyan also saw the group of deer, probably came to eat moss and lichen around Dianzi.
