The deer run extremely fast, they don't even have guns, so they don't have to think about that, they are just excited.
Hearing what Xu Shiyan said, the two boys next to him looked unwilling, "If I knew I would meet a deer, I should have taken a gun into the mountain."
Xu Shiyan glanced at the speaker. This young man is called Huang Shengli, and he is just across the road from Xu Shiyan's house, in Daonan.
"Do you have a gun at home?" Xu Shiyan asked casually.
"Yes, my grandfather is a veteran hunter in Donggang, my father can also hunt, and my family has a stick."
Huang Shengli said casually. "By the way, Brother Xu, I heard that you can also hunt, right? Let's go together in winter."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "I can't fight without a gun."
Now you are not in a big house, you can use the guns and dogs in the team, how can you hunt without guns and dogs?
"What's the problem? Tell Secretary Yu to borrow it from the team." Huang Shengli shook his head with a smile.
"Our secretary admires you so much, what's the big deal about borrowing a gun? If not, you can still borrow it from Zhou Qingguo.
He is a security assistant and militia company commander, and he also manages guns and ammunition. The two of you have a good relationship, and it is not difficult to borrow a gun. "
Actually, in Donggang, there are not many young people who can hunt. Many of them work in industry and forest farms.
Influenced by his grandfather, Huang Shengli likes hunting quite a lot. Unfortunately, few people can join him. Huang Shengli's father doesn't allow him to go into the mountains alone.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "No, it's not good to borrow the gun from the team and use it yourself."
Efforts have been made to gain wisdom. Xu Shiyan doesn't want to cause trouble now. Now that he has managed to gain a firm foothold in Donggang, it's good to just grow ginseng and land honestly.
Even if he wants to hunt, he still has to find a chance to buy a gun and raise a few dogs, and never give others a chance to criticize him.
"If you don't want to borrow it, you can buy it, but it's too expensive, hundreds of dollars." Huang Shengli was not reconciled, and continued to mutter.
Xu Shiyan's heart moved, and he turned to look at Huang Shengli, "What's wrong? Do you have a way to buy a gun?"
"Yes, what's the problem? We used to have many gunners in Donggang.
Right now, many people go to work and don’t like to go hunting in the mountains.
I know several companies, all of which have guns, wait for me to go back and ask for you. "
Huang Shengli patted his chest and assured Xu Shiyan that the matter was left to him.
It is good to get a gun, Xu Shiyan immediately became happy, chatted with Huang Shengli a few more words, and asked him for help.
When the other young men next to them heard this, they also shouted to follow them up the mountain together.
They are all young people, and most of them are neighbors who get along well. The big guys are talking and laughing, riding a bicycle all the way home.
"Daughter-in-law, I'm back, how is the house? Is there nothing wrong?"
Back home after five o'clock, Xu Shiyan pushed the car in and saw Su Anying cooking in the kitchen, so he asked casually.
"Where's Yuanyuan?" Yuanyuan, his son's nickname.
"In the rocking car, the weather is hot and the kang is hot. I was afraid that he would have a heat rash, so I threw him in the rocking car and dangled it.
It's just in time for you to come back, take a look for me, has he peed? "
Su Anying was busy putting pancakes in the pot, and couldn't spare her hands, so she asked Xu Shiyan to come in to watch the children.
The cradle that Su Anying mentioned is the cradle. This cradle was made by Xu Chenghou when Xu Jinfeng was born, and the children in the family used it when they were young.
On the day of Xu Haiyuan's full moon, Xu Chenghou specially brought it here for Su Anying to coax the child.
Tie a rope to the beam of the house, and hang the rocking car on it. The baby lies in the rocking car, dangling and easy to sleep.
This is also a big monster in the Northeast, raising a child to hang up.
The main reason is that in the past there were many wild animals in the Northeast, and some wolves really broke in and took the children away, and put them in the rocking car, which was safer.
"Wait a minute, I'll change clothes first, I've been walking in the woods all day, and there are weeds crawling on my body."
Xu Shiyan is particularly concerned now, and hurriedly went to the house to find a coat to change, washed his face and hair, and then went into the house to coax his son.
"Baby son, come, let daddy hug you."
Although Xu Haiyuan would pee all over Xu Shiyan or cry every time he saw him, Xu Shiyan still liked to play with his son.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Implementation work
chapters.content:
Chapter 133 Implementation
The weather is gradually getting hotter in June, and the bungalows are even hotter. Su Anying is afraid that the child will get prickly heat, so she wears half sleeves and shorts for her son.
The nearly two-month-old baby is chubby, and the joints of his arms and legs are like lotus roots.
The little guy was lying in the rocking car, he was bored, when he saw someone reaching out to him, he was probably overjoyed, and started dancing.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand, took his son out of the rocking car, touched his butt, and found that the pee was dry.
So he comfortably hugged his son on his lap, lowered his head and looked at his son, and deliberately flicked his tongue to make a sound, making Xiaowa laugh straight away.
After getting along with each other for this period of time, Xu Haiyuan didn't cry when he saw Xu Shiyan, on the contrary, he was able to chat with Xu Shiyan chicken and duck, chatting very happily.
Xu Shiyan just coaxed his son like this, oh, ah, agreed casually, and shook the rattle from time to time to attract his son's attention. The father and son got along fairly well.
It's a pity that this harmony was quickly broken, and after a while, Xu Shiyan felt a heat flow on his legs.
Yes, his family is so big, and he peed on him again.
"You are catching someone and causing trouble, right? Every time I hug you, you urinate on me.
Thanks to your dad being careful, he didn't change his pants when he came back. "
Xu Shiyan didn't know whether to laugh or cry, he quickly picked up his son, took out the soaked diaper, and then pulled out another piece from the bed, folded it and stuffed it into Xiaowa's pants.
"Daughter-in-law, my son **** on me again." After changing the diaper, he turned to complain to his wife.
"Who told you not to urinate? He can urinate now. If you pick him up, he urinates first. Otherwise, what if he doesn't urinate on you?"
Su Anying heard it in the outer room, and was speechless for a while.
"My mother and I are at home during the day, and I urinate all the time. You don't need a few urinals now."
Everyone in this year is like this, the baby starts to urinate as soon as he is one month old.
Xu Shiyan remembers that in his previous life, he heard people say that children can't pee well.
But it’s like this all around, what can he say? There are no diapers now, and if you don’t urinate for your child, the diapers that a baby of this age replaces in a day can hold a large basin.
The daughter-in-law is tired enough to coax the children to cook all day long, and then wash so many clothes?
He works all day long and can't help with anything at home, so don't give orders.
Anyway, they all came here from childhood, aren’t they all doing well?
"I changed the lace for him and put it in the car. Where is the lace that I replaced today? I washed it together."
The trousers were wet and had to be washed out. The daughter-in-law was busy, so Xu Shiyan simply washed himself with water, and rubbed out a few pieces of the pants.
While washing clothes, Xu Shiqin came back.
"Hey, third brother, put it there quickly, I'll do it." Xu Shiqin saw his brother rubbing his clothes clumsily, and hurriedly took over.
"Okay, you, let's go into the house and coax the children." Xu Shiqin drove his brother away with a look of disgust.
"Oh, by the way, when you go up the mountain, third brother, you have time to break some oak leaves and come back.
It’s almost the Dragon Boat Festival, and the Forestry Bureau distributes welfare, and each person has two catties of glutinous rice. I thought I still have rhubarb rice at home, so let’s make a few zongzi with it. "
Xu Shiqin remembered something and hurriedly asked Xu Shiyan.
"You are an apprentice, so you also have Jiangmi points?" Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard this, isn't this benefit too good? Even apprentices?
"Well, didn't my master say that before? Find someone to handle the work for me.
I have been notified today, and asked me to go back and change my account as soon as possible. So the holiday benefits are also my share. "
Xu Shiqin rubbed his clothes quickly, and explained something casually.
"So fast? Your master is amazing. OK, then I'll take some time to break some oak leaves and come back."
Eating zongzi is not easy these days. It’s okay to say that big yellow rice is grown in every household, but zongzi leaves are hard to buy.
Most people use eucalyptus leaves to wrap them. The leaves of eucalyptus trees are big, and they are used as zongzi wrapped in leaves. It has a special fragrance and is delicious.
Xu Shiyan went up the mountain all day long, breaking some leaves is not difficult.
"Little sister, you don't need to go up the mountain to break it. There is a forest behind our house, and the leaves are still big."
As soon as Xu Shiyan agreed, Su Anying, who was serving food outside, said something.
"There are many oak trees in the back mountain, but they haven't grown up. They are short and have big leaves."
Su Anying is not idle at home. While her son is sleeping, she wanders around the house. She knows best what is in the woods behind.
"Today is the second day of junior high school, and the day after tomorrow morning, we can go to the back woods to break it. It happens to be the fifth day of the new year. Let's go back to the big house to see our parents, and then move out the little sister's household registration."
Dragon Boat Festival is a big festival, even if the family is separated, I have to go back to see the elderly during the festival.
Not to mention, there is also the matter of Xu Shiqin's household registration change, which happened to be done together.
Xu Shiyan proposed this, and everyone didn't have any opinions, so they quickly packed up and ate.
After eating, Xu Shiyan hurriedly boiled a pot of boiling water again, poured Niu Maoguang into the pot and scalded it.
Pick out a piece of ox hair from the pot, split it from the root, and if it can be split in half, it is hot.
This thing can’t be scalded too much, it won’t weigh if it’s too hot, and it won’t work if it’s lightly scalded, the color is not good.
When the fire is just right, quickly use a fork to pick out the ox hair, spread it on the broken mat in the yard.
Xu Shiyan spent a lot of time on this day, and he lost almost 70 to 80 catties. One pot was not boiled, so it was divided into two pots.
"By the way, those are monkey legs. They will be scalded separately later, and they can be saved for stir-frying, or they can be dried in the sun and eaten in winter."
Monkey legs are also a kind of fern. Compared with Niu Maoguang, there is a groove on the stem.
Monkeys also have hairs on their legs, which are black flat hairs, which are different from the fine yellow hairs of cows.
Niu Mao Guang is actually not tasty and bitter in the eyes of Chinese people.
But the monkey legs are delicious, fragrant and smooth, and they are good when fried fresh. If they are soaked in winter, they are good for cold dishes.
Xu Shiyan saw the monkey's legs in the mountains and also squeezed some of them, so if he didn't sell them, he would keep them for his own food.
Whether it's cow hair or monkey legs, you have to pluck the hair after ironing.
In the evening, I built a fire in the yard, threw some mugwort on it to smoke the mosquitoes, and then the three of them worked together to **** the cattle until it was almost ten o'clock.
"Daughter-in-law, you have to dry the cows at home tomorrow, and I have to go up the mountain, so take advantage of this time to gather more.
If you don’t know how to do it, you can ask your neighbors. I went up the mountain with Huang Shengli and Sun Xiaofeng.
Aunt Huang and Aunt Sun will also share the news tomorrow, so you can learn from them. "
Twelve catties of cow hair can make one catty, and the purchase price at the purchasing station is two yuan and fifty cents.
Xu Shiyan got these back today, and they are worth about five or six catties. It takes nearly half a month for a season of cattle and hair, and he can get back a hundred and ten yuan.
That’s a lot. After all, it can’t be compared with mountain hunting or hunting. In daily life, big money needs to be earned, and small money can’t be let go, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Dragon Boat Festival
chapters.content:
Chapter 134 Dragon Boat Festival
The next morning, Xu Shiyan rode away early again.
Waiting for seven or eight o'clock, Su Anying followed what Xu Shiyan said, and hung the cow hair on the open space in the yard.
Anyway, the Xu family has a big place, so there is room for everything.
Before going to bed at night, Xu Shiyan told Su Anying how to bask in the buffalo.
During the day, I specially carried my son to the neighbors to see how they rub and dry, and then I followed suit.
Drying cattle hair is not directly drying, so that there will be a line of drying, which is not necessary for the purchase station.
Sun-dried cows have a lot of hair, so they have to be kneaded constantly, and they have to be kneaded hard, but they can't be kneaded.
Knead it with a sack under it. When it is half dry, step on it with a sack, and then knead it into a ball before drying it.
The kneaded and sun-dried ox hair is broad, purple-red in color, twisted and curled up, which makes the vegetables look thick and good-looking.
Xu Shiyan went to the mountain to collect vegetables, while Su Anying coaxed the children to dry the cow hair at home.
The young couple are thinking about one thing and exerting their energy in one place. Are they still afraid that they will have a bad life?
On June 9th, the fourth day of the fifth month of the lunar calendar, Su Anying took advantage of the time to dry the cattle hair, went to the back woods and came back with a basket of oak leaves.
Jiangmi and rhubarb rice were soaked in water separately. Xu Shiqin came back early in the afternoon, and the sister-in-law coaxed the children to cook while making zongzi.
Eat zongzi these days, not so much, and there are no candied dates to put, big dates are rare things.
Fortunately, Su Anying has a way. Soak the big white beans in advance and boil them with some sugar.
When making zongzi, put some beans in it, it tastes sweet and soft, and the taste is also very good.
The rice dumplings were wrapped, and the rice was cooked. Just when Xu Shiyan came back, he ate the rice quickly, and he had to blanch the beef.
"Before this time next year, I will set up a pot in the yard, and let's put it outside to scald the beef.
Otherwise, in this hot day, the kang would be so hot that it would be impossible to sleep at night. "
Xu Shiyan complained while working.
He actually didn’t think about getting a lot of money this year. He didn’t have a bicycle at home. How could he go so far without a bicycle?
After buying a car, I hurried into the mountains to collect vegetables. I didn't have time to set up a stove, so I could only make do with it.
"Let's go back early tomorrow, I'll buy some gauze and nail the windows.
When it’s too hot at night, the windows are left open, and the screens are nailed on to prevent mosquitoes from entering. "
The weather is hot, and the kang is also hot, so it’s really hard to sleep at night.
Open the window, lest mosquitoes come in and bite people, don’t open it, the room is like a steamer, it’s so hot at night that I can’t sleep.
If a stove is set up outside, all the things that consume firewood are made outside, and the kang in the house is burned once a day to ventilate, at least it is not so hot.
Xu Shiyan's words, everyone has a deep understanding.
Especially recently, two pots of cow hair are scalded every night, and the kang is hot to the touch.
Fortunately, the kang is big, so they try to sleep on the top of the kang, at least better, if they sleep on the top of the kang, they will be cooked.
The three of them were stroking cattle outside, and rice dumplings were still cooking in the pot.
After the fire is over, no more firewood is added, and the pot is tightly covered so that it is so stuffy.
Boring all night, get up early and eat directly, neither cold nor hot.
On the morning of the fifth day of the lunar new year, Su Anying boiled six eggs, and there was no need to cook other meals in the morning, just eat the dumplings and eggs directly.
After dinner, the three of them packed up their things. Xu Shiyan took off the rocking cart and tied it firmly behind the Dajinlu bicycle.
Then put the son inside and push him away, so that he doesn't need to be hugged by anyone, and he is comfortable.
On the front handlebar, there are still two Dulu rice dumplings, both of which belong to Jiangmi.
This stuff is usually rare, take it back to give parents and children a taste.
Xu Shiyan pushed the cart, Su Anying and Xu Shiqin walked, taking advantage of the fact that the morning was not too hot and the road was not too difficult, so they went back to the big house.
When going to the riverside to take a boat, Su Anying held the child in her arms, and Xu Shiyan moved the bicycle onto the boat.
Uncle Liu saw Xu Shiyan and the others, and he was quite enthusiastic, "Since you moved out, you haven't come back for some days.
Yo, did you buy this bike yourself? Or else San'er has to be capable, and the bicycles are all bought, all right. "
The group crossed the river with their bicycles. This time, they didn't need to put the child in the stroller anymore. Su Anying held her and soon arrived at Xu's house at the east end of the village.
"Father, mother, we are back." Xu Shiqin shouted first after entering the door.
"I just said, I don't know if you will come back for the holidays? Hurry up, let me see Xiao Yuanyuan."
As soon as Zhou Guilan heard the movement, she hurried out of the house and took her grandson over without saying a word.
"Hey, this fat boy, take a look, he's white and fat, he's just like Yingzi."
Su Anying was born fair, no matter how much the sun tans, she won't get dark, but her skin turns red.
People call this kind of skin color the angry sun, but it is actually cold fair skin.
Xu Haiyuan fell asleep all the way, and woke up when crossing the river just now, feeling very refreshed now.
Hold in grandma's arms, she didn't cry or fuss, and looked around with **** eyes.
As a result, as soon as he entered the room and saw the situation in the room, the child burst into tears.
Everyone was taken aback, "What's wrong? I remember Yuanyuan didn't like to cry. I never cried when I hugged him."
Zhou Guilan was also dumbfounded, she was always serving her during the confinement, the little grandson was so easy to coax, what's wrong?
"Maybe he's hungry? He fell asleep all the way and just woke up."
Su Anying took the baby and went to the side to nurse, the baby stopped crying after all.
Here, Xu Shiyan handed the zongzi to his mother.
"Mom, this is the welfare of the old six. Two catties of glutinous rice, wrapped in rice dumplings, bring some back for you to taste."
Woke up too early, the store was not open yet, and I didn't bring anything else.
Zhou Guilan smiled and took the zongzi, and hurriedly called her granddaughter.
"Feng'er, go to your second uncle's house, call Xiaobo Xiaotao, and say that third uncle brought them rice dumplings, Jiangmi's, come and taste."
In this day and age, glutinous rice is a rarity, and glutinous rice dumplings are even rarer.
It doesn't matter if adults eat this bite or not, let the children have a taste.
As soon as Xu Jinfeng heard about the glutinous rice dumplings, he immediately put on his shoes and went to the Li family in the west of the village to find his two cousins.
Here, Xu Shiyan sat down and talked to his mother about Xu Shiqin's work.
"Mom, I have another good thing to tell you. The sixth child has a job and was left in the tailor shop by her master.
Apprentice workers, the salary is not high, and it will rise slowly later. "
In the beginning, they were called apprentices, and those who did not pay wages are now called apprentices, which is equivalent to apprentices with wages, and have the same benefits as workers, but that is absolutely different.
Zhou Guilan was very happy when she heard that, "Really? Oh my god, that's great. My daughter is going to be a worker."
Originally, among the six children, Zhou Guilan was most worried about the third and sixth children.
Now that the third child has moved to Donggang, life is getting better and better, and he has also arranged the work of the sixth child.
For the workers of the Forestry Bureau, this is a good thing that many people dream of leaving the crop yard and eating rice and iron rice bowls in the future.
"Old girl, you have to thank your third brother, how can you be a worker without your third brother taking you out of our broken valley?"

chapters.title: Chapter 135: want to move out
chapters.content:
Chapter 135 Want to move away
Xu Jinfeng has quick legs, and soon called his two cousins, followed by Wei Mingrong.
"Oh, whose bicycle is this? Dajinlu, it's new.
This car is more than a hundred, third child, do you care if someone borrowed it? "
As soon as Wei Mingrong entered the yard, he saw Xu Shiyan's big golden deer bicycle, and asked in a loud voice.
"Second sister-in-law, my third brother bought it. The county rewarded my third brother with a bicycle ticket, so he bought the bike."
Xu Shiqin spoke quickly, rushing to speak without waiting for his brother and sister-in-law to speak.
"The county rewards the third bike ticket? What's going on?"
In the room, Zhou Guilan was a little confused when she heard it. Why did her son do something important, and the county rewarded him?
"Mom, there was frost a while ago, how is our team doing? Is there any loss?"
Xu Shiyan didn't answer his mother's question directly, but asked about Xiashuang.
Dongjiangyan and the No. 2 Bridge are both on the Shuang Road.
"Oh, don't mention it, the county ordered to find a way to resist the frost.
Hu Liancheng didn't take it seriously at all. There was frost for three days in a row. The crops in the field killed many people, and the sticks seemed to be damaged by the frost.
Hu Liancheng saw that the situation was not good, so he led people to resist the frost. It was too late and the loss was quite big.
In the past few days, Hu Liancheng has been making a fuss, playing with a stick. "Bringing this matter, Zhou Guilan was full of resentment.
"Why do you think he is the leader? The county has issued an order, but he just doesn't listen. It's all right. I don't know what will happen this autumn."
Because of this incident, the village is full of complaints, but what can be done?
There were people guarding the commune, so Hu Liancheng was not punished at all for such a big loss.
The big guys said behind their backs that if Dongjiangyan continues to develop like this, no one wants to stay.
"Thanks to you moving out, I think, if this continues, everyone's heart will be lost, and they probably want to move out in the future."
Zhou Guilan sighed, moved to the big house in the spring of 1970, and lived in it for a few years, do you want to move out again?
"The commune doesn't care at all? Hu Liancheng made such a mistake, why didn't he get fucked?" Xu Shiyan found it incredible.
"Oh, what do you know? The daughter of Hu Liancheng's family was engaged to the son of Cao Mingchuan's family a while ago.
Then Cao Mingchuan has a backer in the county, and Hu Liancheng is backed by a big tree. What is he afraid of? " Zhou Guilan sighed.
Chen Deyong was so embarrassing at the beginning, wasn't it because he was next to Cao Mingchuan?
This is good, Chen Deyong is gone, and Hu Liancheng appears again.
"By the way, you haven't said yet, what's the matter with the bicycle ticket?"
Zhou Guilan suddenly remembered that her son hadn't told her about the county reward yet.
"Oh, well, I was the first to give an early warning about the frost. Our team's Shendi was not beaten by the frost.
Later, I also said that there may be continuous late frosts, and then the commune reported it, and the county ordered all places to resist the frost.
The county rewarded me with some things, including a bicycle ticket. "
Xu Shiyan was very tenacious, and told his mother and sister-in-law what happened.
"Mom, not only did my third brother win the award, but the team also made him a technician." Xu Shiqin on the side said quite proudly.
Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong's eyes widened when they heard this.
This little brother-in-law has been lucky since he got married last year.
You have only moved to Donggang for a few months, and you have become a technician?
"Third brother, see if you can help me out. We might as well move our family to Donggang. It's really frustrating to stay in this ghostly place."
Xue Xiulin couldn't hold back, and said something.
"Sister-in-law, if I tell you not to move, you will definitely not be happy."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, and continued without waiting for the two sisters-in-law to change their faces.
"I heard that the policy is likely to be changed next year. In this situation, you can return to the city.
You are thinking about whether it is better to move to Donggang, or find someone to do activities and return to Songjianghe as a worker? "
Needless to say? Of course it's good for workers.
"Third brother, is what you said true?" Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong's expressions changed, and they asked eagerly.
"I've heard people talk about it, but I don't know when it is. Our team also has educated youths, and they are all talking about it." Xu Shiyan can only find such an argument.
Knowing that the two sister-in-laws will be able to return to the city after the Chinese New Year, why did he bother to come? There is no need to toss in vain.
"Then when we are not busy, we two will go back and ask. It would be better if we can go back to the city."
Both of them were happy, no matter what, Xu Shiyan's words gave them hope.
This big house, they have lived enough, and they wish to return to the city immediately.
Xu Shiyan discussed going back to the city with his two sister-in-laws, and Xu Shiqin on the other end helped his nephew and niece to peel off the skin of the zongzi. The children took a bite and thought it was delicious.
"This year the field is like this, and I didn't dare to make zongzi."
Zhou Guilan couldn't help sighing when she saw the satisfied faces of her grandchildren.
There was a disaster in the field, and I don’t know how much food will be left. I have to save the food at home, so I’m willing to squander it?
"Thanks to the work arrangement of the old girl, I will eat the food supply in the future, otherwise, I will be in a panic."
Wei Mingrong came over late and didn't know that Xu Shiqin had a job. Hearing this, he was even more envious.
"The sixth brother is still blessed, and he is blessed with the third brother." Wei Mingrong sighed.
"Mom, I will lead the sixth child to move out the household registration. This is a big deal."
The coming back this time is not just for the festival, the most important thing is to change the household registration. This is the most important and cannot be delayed.
"Third son, let your father accompany sixth son to change his household registration later." Zhou Guilan thought for a while and stopped her son.
"Last time you offended Hu Liancheng when you moved your household registration. I'm afraid he will be even more angry when he sees you."
Hu Liancheng was tricked by Xu Shiyan once, and this time he went to change his household registration again, which might be difficult.
"Let your father go, if Hu Liancheng dares not to do it, let your father dance with him, your father is old."
Zhou Guilan didn't say anything later, but in fact she wanted to say that in terms of playing tricks, eight Xu Shiyan tied together can't keep up with Xu Chenghou alone.
If Hu Liancheng refuses to change his household registration, then quarrel with him.
Xu Shiyan still can't understand the meaning of his mother's words? Immediately couldn't help it, burst out laughing.
"Okay, it's true that my father is better than me in this matter."
As long as the father shows the energy to dance high with his sons, I believe Hu Liancheng will also have a big head. "Where's my dad?"
"Your father is in our private land. While there is not much work in the team, let's clean up our own land first."
As the saying goes, people are diligent and not lazy, Xu Chenghou can be regarded as an old farmer's style. The little land in his family is very carefully tended, and he stays in the field all day long.
"Liu Liu, then you go to your private plot to find our father, and let our father accompany you to change your household registration. If there is any trouble, you can come back to me."
Xu Shiyan asked his sister to go find someone in the field.
Here, Xu Shiyan told his mother to find out the hanging nets and fish docks at home, find some pancakes, carry a bucket, and go to the river to catch fish and crickets.
It’s rare to come here, so I can’t go back empty-handed. Crayfish are big here, and there are a lot of fish. Don’t worry about the fish, it’s good to get a few back to eat.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Crayfish fishing
chapters.content:
Chapter 136 Fishing Crayfish
Xu Shiyan went up along the river, and came to a place where he thought there would be fish, and lowered the hanging net into the river.
Then put the broken pancakes in the fish dock made of canned bottles, fasten them again, and go down to the place where the small fish in the stable water gather.
Five or six fish docks were planted, but Xu Shiyan didn't go home, so he turned over stones to find crayfish in a shallow place by the river.
There are a lot of crickets in the big river here, if you just turn over a stone, there will be crickets underneath.
This cricket cricket also has a name called Changbai Mountain Inverted Reptile.
The moment the stone was lifted, I saw that the cricket did not run forward, but walked backwards.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand and directly grabbed the tail of the cricket. The cricket waved its big pincers, but it couldn't catch Xu Shiyan, so it had to be thrown into the bucket.
Xu Shiyan caught the crayfish very quickly, and caught half of the crayfish in a short while.
However, most of the ones caught in this way are not too big.
Xu Shiyan wanted to get some crickets back to give to Xu Shiqin's master, as well as Guo Shouye, so he had to find a way to catch the big ones.
This is not difficult, just bring up a fish dock, and there are a few fish in it.
Fill out two larger ones, smash them on the stone, then find a long wicker, and tie the smashed fish to the front end of the wicker.
Stepping on the big rock to the deep water, stretch the wicker into the water near the big rock.
Crayfish eat all kinds of animal carcasses, including dead fish.
Not long after, Xu Shiyan felt the willow branch sink, and immediately pulled it out. Sure enough, a palm-length cricket was caught.
Xu Shiyan quickly grabbed it and threw it into the bucket, then continued fishing.
This method is very good, but it is a bit expensive for fish. Fortunately, Xu Shiyan has downloaded several docks, and some fish can be used.
Not long after, a lot of crayfish were filled in the bucket, and Xu Shiyan reckoned that it was almost enough, so he walked back with the bucket.
Don’t worry about hanging the net, just wait for them to put it away before they leave.
Xu Shiyan returned home with a large bucket of crayfish. Just as he entered the gate, he heard bursts of laughter coming from the room.
It seems that Xu Shiqin's household registration should be transferred, and the big guys are joking.
In summer, the windows were all open. When Xu Shiyan walked into the courtyard with a bucket, the people in the house saw it, and several people came out of the house.
"Third Brother, when did you come back? Instead of looking for us, I went to the river to catch fish and shrimp first."
The first one to run out was Zhao Jianshe, followed by the Xu family brothers.
Zhao Jianshe complained, but stepped forward directly, reaching out to hug Xu Shiyan.
"I heard that the third brother is now very powerful. Not only has he won an award for his meritorious service, he has also become a technician?"
Xu Shiyan took two steps back to avoid Zhao Jianshe's hug.
"Hey, hey, I haven't seen you in a few months, don't make a fuss about it, those who don't know think what's going on with us."
Xu Shiyan put down the barrel, raised his hand and hit Zhao Jianshe on the shoulder.
"Big man, why are you so gross, goosebumps all over the floor."
When Xu Shiyan said this, everyone behind him laughed.
Zhao Jianshe was also embarrassed, raised his hand and scratched his head, and laughed, "I haven't seen my third brother for a long time, haven't I? Excited."
"Why are you so excited? Let's go into the room and talk." Xu Shiyan smiled, and entered the room with Zhao Jianshe and his brothers.
Upon entering the room, I found that Zhao Dahai and his wife were also in the room, "Uncle Zhao, Aunt Zhao, how are you two?"
When Zhao Dahai saw Xu Shiyan, he nodded happily, "Okay, everything is fine.
San'er is really promising this time, your father always praises you in front of me. "
Zhao Dahai has been here for a while, and he also knows about Xu Shiyan, so he is both happy and emotional at the moment.
If those things hadn't been figured out before, would Xu Shiyan have stayed in the big house?
If a big house produces model workers and advanced individuals, what an honor it would be?
"Uncle Zhao, look at what you said, what is there to do? It's all about living."
Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head. He didn't think he was capable, but he just took advantage of his rebirth.
He has forty years more experience and experience than others. If he hasn't improved at all, what is he doing when he is reborn?
"Father, has Lao Liu's household registration been moved out?" Xu Shiyan is most concerned about this.
Of course, judging from the lively atmosphere of the Xu family just now, it should be that they have moved out.
"Moved, at the beginning Hu Liancheng didn't give up, this won't work, that won't work.
I directly asked the sixth child to take out all the formalities. When he saw that all the formalities were in place, he deflated the eggplant and moved his household registration smoothly. "Xu Chenghou replied with a smile.
Xu Shiqin's change of residence is different from that of Xu Shiyan at that time.
Xu Shiqin is transferring from a rural household to a city, from a farmer to a non-citizen, or to the Forestry Bureau. He must have a relocation permit, a certificate of non-agricultural transfer, and a work certificate.
Fortunately, Xu Shiqin was all ready to bring back, and took pictures directly on the table.
Hu Liancheng saw that there were all kinds of procedures, and there was nothing to do, so he could only change his household registration.
He didn't dare to make trouble in this matter, if Xu Chenghou was annoyed, with Xu Chenghou's temper, he could really fight Hu Liancheng desperately.
In the past, Xu Chenghou was worried that they were foreigners, and because Xu Shixian got into trouble in the camp, Zhao Dahai took in Xu's family under pressure.
That's why Xu Chenghou always thinks about this kind of affection no matter what, and he can't make Zhao Dahai mess up.
But since Zhao Dahai came down, Hu Liancheng was replaced, and Xu Shiyan was replaced by Kancan, Xu Chenghou was full of resentment towards Hu Liancheng.
It's not bad that Xu Chenghou's temper didn't go directly to Hu Liancheng to settle accounts, and he was expected to have a good face towards Hu Liancheng? Go dreaming.
Besides, the Xu family is different now. The third child is doing well in Donggang, the sixth child is a worker, and the fourth child is a teacher.
The fifth child will take the college entrance examination in a few days. If he passes the exam, he will be a college student.
Xu Chenghou is stiff now, if Hu Liancheng doesn't move his household registration, Xu Chenghou can slap him there.
Xu Shiyan could imagine that his father and Hu Liancheng were blowing their beards and staring, and couldn't help laughing.
"Okay, just move out.
Father, don't confront Mr. Hu Liancheng on weekdays, after all you still have to live here, right? "
Xu Shiyan couldn't say it in front of Zhao Dahai.
Why don't you have to hang out until winter, count the work points, and let's talk about it after getting the food and money.
This year, when the boss and the second child move out next year, they will simply move out together.
Who is still messing with them in this crappy place like the big house?
"Cut, as far as he does those things, you ask how many people are there in our village?
These people in our village, they usually mess around and make trouble, but when it comes to serious things, they are all cowards.
Everyone is not in the same heart. If they are in the same heart, they will go directly to the county to make trouble.
Just shake out Hu Liancheng's nonsense, I don't think he will step down? He still dares to be like me? Shouting him. "
Xu Chenghou glanced at Zhao Dahai and said so on purpose.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Elm yellow mushroom
chapters.content:
Chapter 137 Elm Yellow Mushroom
What Xu Chenghou said was actually for Zhao Dahai.
But Zhao Dahai didn't seem to understand, and didn't answer, Xu Chenghou sighed, and didn't continue talking.
Xu Shiyan and his wife came back for the holiday with their child in their arms, and Xu Shiqin got a job, which was a happy event.
Zhou Guilan said that she had to celebrate anyway, because the leeks in the yard were growing just right, and there were some elm yellow mushrooms growing on the elm stump in the backyard.
Zhou Guilan asked Xu Shiqin to pick the yellow elm mushrooms, cut leeks in the yard by herself, and made dumplings stuffed with yellow mushrooms and leeks at noon.
Elmus chrysanthemum, the scientific name is Jinding Pleurotus, the color is golden, and it has a special mushroom aroma.
Wild elm yellow mushrooms have a strong aroma and can be used for stir-frying and soup. You can also stir-fry salt mushrooms, which taste fresher than shrimp.
Of course, for Northeast people who love to eat dumplings, making dumplings with elm yellow mushrooms and leeks is definitely an unforgettable delicacy.
There used to be an old elm tree in the backyard of Xu’s family, but it was cut down, leaving a stump that gradually rotted, and some yellow elm mushrooms grew every year.
This is the first crop this year, not too many, just seven or eight, and the bright yellow ones are very beautiful.
Zhou Guilan felt that the yellow elm mushrooms were missing, so she scrambled five more eggs and mixed them in the stuffing.
Here was busy making dumplings, and Zhao Dahai's family couldn't stay any longer, so he got up and said goodbye.
Xu Chenghou went out to see him off, but in the house, he put up the panels and started working.
There are many people in the family, and seeing that it is noon again, I have to pack it out for dinner quickly.
Xu Shiyan and the others had to go back early in the afternoon. The ox hair plucked out last night was piled up in the warehouse, so they had to go back to dry it to see the sun, otherwise it would be easy to stick.
This time, Zhou Guilan was no longer obsessed with picking up the jelly, but picked up a knife and cut them all into normal sized jiao.
This is much faster. The daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law work together, and soon two curtain dumplings are made.
South Kang made dumplings, and North Kang Xu Chenghou led his sons to chat there.
Xu Chenghou now sees that his third son is getting more and more pleasing to the eye, so he has to ask in detail about Xu Shiyan's situation in Donggang.
Knowing that Xu Shiyan was enjoying himself in the second brigade, Xu Chenghou felt indescribably proud.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian were very envious of their younger brother, and they also wanted to move out of the big house.
There were no outsiders in the family at the moment, so Xu Shiyan told his father and brothers directly to let them persist for another six months.
No matter what happens, we have to go to the brigade to settle the accounts. After the food and money are distributed, we can discuss the matter of moving.
After thinking about it, Xu Chenghou and his son made sense, and it was indeed inappropriate to move away at this time.
As far as Hu Liancheng's virtue is concerned, not to mention keeping his household registration to prevent relocation, he can certainly deduct his work points to deliberately embarrass others, so let's bear with it.
When everyone talked about the production cut this year, Xu Chenghou had to scold Hu Liancheng again.
"Okay, stop playing your prestige here, and quickly boil the water.
There is still a piece of noodles left here, cook the dumplings quickly after wrapping.
In the afternoon, the sixth child has to go back to complete the formalities and settle down. Didn’t the third child say that? What else is there in the house to be exposed to the sun? "
The big house does not produce cow hair, and no one picks it up. Zhou Guilan doesn't know what it is.
Just listen to what my son said, you can sell it for money.
As long as it can be sold for money, it is a good thing, and it should not delay the business.
Just like that, Xu Chenghou was sent by Zhou Guilan to boil water.
Not long after, the water in the pot boiled, and the three-gailian dumplings in the house were also wrapped. So they all took it out, and put the Xilihulu dumplings into the pot.
Dumplings with vegetarian fillings don’t need to be cooked for so long, just boil them twice and take them out.
"This taste is really fragrant."
The dumplings are being fished out of the pot, Xu Jinfeng and Xu Haibo, the little guys, can't sit still in the house.
Looking greedily at the door frame and looking into the outer room, Ha LaZi, who was greedy by the aroma, almost fell to the ground.
"A group of greedy cats, get out of the way, and be careful not to burn you."
Zhou Guilan went out to fish dumplings with a strainer, and when she turned her head and saw the spooky appearance of her grandchildren, she couldn't help laughing, and hurriedly told them to stay away.
Over there, Su Anying and the others hurried over and brought the dumplings to the house.
The two pots of dumplings were cooked, and everyone went to the kang and sat down to eat.
Pick up a dumpling and bite it open. The green leeks, golden eggs and yellow elm mushrooms make people happy just looking at them.
Take a sip of the soup, and then taste the dumplings carefully, "It's delicious, really fresh, this leek, elm and yellow mushroom dumplings are fresh."
Xu Chenghou spoke his mind for everyone.
"Yingzi, you eat this. This one is made of cabbage and meat, and there is no leek in it."
Zhou Guilan brought over a bowl of dumplings and put them in front of Su Anying alone.
Using cabbage and bacon as stuffing without chives, the main reason is that Su Anying will return milk after eating leeks.
"Mom, no need, I can eat anything, this is for the children."
There are quite a few people who say that leeks return milk or something, but Su Anying didn't feel it.
In the spring vegetable garden, there are green onions besides leeks. What else can you eat if you don’t eat leeks?
After confinement, she ate the same food as her family, and she didn't feel anything wrong.
But her mother-in-law was able to think about her, and even specially made dumplings without leeks. Su Anying was quite moved.
Finally, the bowl of dumplings was shared among the children, and Su Anying ate the same as everyone else.
After lunch, Xu Shiyan chatted with his brothers for a while, and at one o'clock, he went to the river to set up the hanging net.
Not to mention, Xu Shiyan was very lucky. This net caught several fish, two of which were thin scales.
Xu Shiyan originally thought of taking away only the thin scales and letting Xu Shiqin take away the favor, but Zhou Guilan said that he would not keep the rest of the fish, and let Xu Shiyan take them all away.
Not only that, Zhou Guilan also caught two chickens. The chicks hatched in the spring are half grown by this time.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan pushed the car, and Xu Haiyuan was asleep in the back seat, with several fish hanging from the handlebars.
Su Anying carried a small basket on her back. Inside the basket were two chicks and two crayfish in nets. The group crossed the river and went straight to Songjiang River.
Arrived at the Forestry Bureau, Su Anying was waiting under the shade of a tree with her child in her arms. Xu Shiyan and Xu Shiqin carried their things and went to work separately, and after a while, they went home together.
It was past three o'clock when I got home, and as soon as I entered the door, I quickly took out the cow hair and spread it out on the broken mat to dry.
Thanks to the fact that it hasn't rained these days, the weather is fine, and the skin is dry until the evening, so it won't rot.
Xu Shiqin's job was completed in this way, and since then he has become an apprentice in a tailor shop under the Forestry Bureau.
The monthly salary is about 20 yuan, and other benefits are the same as those of forestry bureau workers. After waiting for a year and a half, the salary will increase.
Niu Maoguang is still growing, Xu Shiyan also took the opportunity to squeeze as much as possible.
The best ones are the ones with wide hairs, which are weighed on the scale, and then become thinner and thinner at the end, so they don’t weigh the scale anymore.
Xu Shiyan worked hard for more than ten days, and finally saved about 60 catties of dry goods. This year, the price of cow hair has increased, and it costs three yuan per catty.
One season of Niumaoguang sold for less than two hundred yuan, and there was still some money left for the bicycle, and the whole family was very happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 138: hail
chapters.content:
Chapter 138 Hail
One season's worth of cows' hair is abundant, and for ten days, there is still some money left over to earn a bicycle.
If this is a big house, I am afraid it will attract the envy and envy of many people. But in the second team, no one really thought it was a problem.
Some fathers and sons or husband and wife go to the mountains together to collect cattle and hair, and they can earn more than 300 yuan this season.
This thing mainly needs to have a means of transportation. It is useless to point to walking into the mountains, so it is really important to have a bicycle.
Niu Maoguang has just passed the season, and the work in the ginseng field has started to be busy again.
Weed the grass twice, and then Xu Shiyan's fifty-foot test field should be fertilized.
It is easy to weed the grass twice, as long as weed the big grass in the field, unlike the first weed, you have to loosen the soil along the way.
However, the second brigade had to weed the 10,000-foot ginseng land twice, and it was really busy for a while.
Xu Shiyan still led people to work in the ginseng field. Not only did he have to lead the workers to pull weeds, but he also had to lead people to fertilize the fifty-foot test field.
In the middle of the two rows of ginseng, use a small pick to create a small ditch.
Then use a long-handled spoon to scoop up the bean cake water one by one and pour it into the ditch, then cover it with soil.
This job is said to be light, but it is actually dirty and tiring.
The bean cake has been fermented in the puddle for such a long time, it stinks.
No way, everyone covered their noses with cloth strips and worked hard.
Fortunately, it is only fifty feet long, so I finished it in two days.
On June 19th, everyone was working in the field, when suddenly the sky became cloudy, the wind was blowing, and there was lightning and thunder in an instant.
Bean-sized raindrops fell, and along with the raindrops, there were even pigeon egg-sized hailstones, crackling down.
Fortunately, the ginseng sheds were all thatched in the ginseng fields, and the bewildered people hid directly under the ginseng sheds, but the hail didn't hit them.
Just listening to the hailstones falling on the ginseng shed, and thinking about the clanging of the boards, everyone's heart sank.
Such a large hailstorm does not know how wide the coverage is.
It’s okay if it’s just the ginseng land, after all, it’s covered by a ginseng shed, so it won’t cause any loss.
If this hits you on a big field, you are afraid that the crops in the field will be ruined again.
"Brother Xu, what do you think is wrong with the weather this year? There was a late frost a few days ago, and here comes another hailstorm.
Well, I don’t know if the land in our brigade has been hit by hailstones.
If this happens, we may not even have enough rations this year. "
Several people sat on the surface of the pool to hide from the rain, while watching the hailstones falling outside and sighing.
"Who knows what's going on this year? Alas, we old farmers depend on the sky to eat. Whether we are full or hungry, it all depends on whether God rewards us. It's difficult."
Xu Shiyan sighed, he had the impression that many places in the county were affected by the hailstorm.
Songjiang Commune lost thousands of acres due to the hailstorm. This year's life is probably not going to be easy.
Thunderstorms and hailstorms came together. Within half an hour, the rain gradually subsided, and the hailstones stopped falling.
After the rain, the sky cleared up, and everyone came out from under the pavilion.
I saw a layer of hailstones in the road, shining brightly, the big ones were like pigeon eggs, and the small ones were about the size of fingers.
Everyone sighed for a while, it's over, this year's harvest will be blind again.
"God, you are bringing us disaster. This year, it's late frost and hail. How are you going?"
"Hey, Technician Xu, can't you predict the weather? Then why didn't you predict the hailstorm today?"
Suddenly, there was a chuckle from over there, and someone looked at Xu Shiyan with contempt and taunted him.
Xu Shiyan saw that it was none other than Qiao Hui, the former technician in the team.
Because of Wanshuang, Xu Shiyan was promoted to be a technician, while Qiao Hui had no choice but to stay in the team to work because the internship period hadn't passed yet.
Probably because he was robbed of his job, he was a little dissatisfied with Xu Shiyan, so he made a sarcastic statement at this moment.
"Student, do you think there is a way to prevent hailstorms? Even if I predict it in advance, can you still put sheds on all the big fields?"
Xu Shiyan shook his head. Young people just can't hold their breath, and when they encounter something, they rush to stand up.
What is the meaning of saying this? It can only make people laugh.
Even if there are greenhouses in later generations, it may not be able to prevent that big hailstone in such a situation.
Besides, there is no one who keeps all the fields in greenhouses.
Sure enough, when Xu Shiyan said this, everyone laughed.
"That's right, college student, or you can invent something that can block all our fields, so you won't be afraid of hailstones."
Originally, Qiao Hui just wanted to ridicule Xu Shiyan, but when Xu Shiyan satirized him back, he couldn't help but snorted, turned around and left.
"What is there to coax? Do you really think you are a college student?
He is just an ordinary farmer, and he was recommended to study for two years because of his connections.
One bottle is not full and half of the bottle is dangling, there is not much ink in the stomach, but it is bigger than anyone else. Cut, what the hell? "
As soon as Qiao Hui left, the young men couldn't help complaining.
"If brother Xu has the opportunity to study, he must be better than him."
Xu Shiyan shook his head quickly when he heard it, "What's the point? I haven't finished junior high school yet, so I still can't compare with others.
Come on, let's all work, he is just doing an internship here, and he will leave after a while, why bother making trouble? "
Everyone thought about it, it was just an intern, and he had to leave in a few days.
"Yes, yes, work, don't be as knowledgeable as him."
When everyone returned to the village from Candi, they heard that the hailstorm was not small. Not only the team, but also some places in the commune were hit by hailstones.
Fortunately, the affected area of ​​Donggang Commune is not too large, which is a blessing in misfortune.
Even so, everyone is depressed.
I worked so hard all year round just for that little food. If things go on like this, will I still be able to eat the rations this autumn?
When the farmer has no free time, weeds should be plucked twice in the ginseng field, and the field should be shoveled twice.
No matter how bad the mood is, you still have to work. If you don’t work, won’t the remaining crops be barren?
The summer solstice passed after busy work, and at this time, Gastrodia elata was unearthed in the forest, and it was time to pick the ganoderma lucidum.
Many people in the team began to form gangs and go to the mountains to do side jobs.
Several young men who got along well with each other from the neighbors all ran to find Xu Shiyan, and the big guys went into the mountains together to dig Gastrodia elata.
Digging Gastrodia elata is not like pulling Niu Maoguang, you have to go to Dadianzi, Gastrodia elata can be found in many places.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan lived here for many years, and he knew very well where there were many Gastrodia elata around.
So he took Sun Xiaofeng and others, either to Kaifeng Fork Road, or to Daniugou, or to Xiaoshahe and Dashahe.
Although it is a bit further away, they have bicycles, so there is no delay in starting early.
It is precisely because of the distance and few people go there, they can encounter a lot of Gastrodia elata in a day.
Gastrodia elata, Orchidaceae, Gastrodia elata are saprophytic herbaceous plants. They have no roots and no leaves, and cannot perform photosynthesis. They can only rely on the accompanying Armillaria armillaria to provide nutrition for growth and reproduction.
Armillaria are mostly distributed in broad-leaved forests, especially eucalyptus and linden forests, so when you dig Gastrodia elata, you should also look for such forests.

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Gastrodia elata is taller than a human
chapters.content:
Chapter 139 Gastrodia elata is taller than humans
Gastrodia elata grows in a spindle shape, a bit like a potato seed. It grows underground and may be distributed in multiple layers.
There are two ways to dig Gastrodia elata.
One is spring, before the Gastrodia elata is unearthed, take a shovel and go up the mountain.
In the place where Gastrodia elata may be found, dig the ground with a shovel, and dig a shovel to see the soil.
Maybe if you are lucky, you will meet a trick, and maybe you will dig out a pot from this trick.
The Gastrodia elata dug out at this time, because no seedlings have emerged, have high nutritional content, and the tubers are not empty, so the quality is higher and the price is higher.
The other is to wait until after the summer solstice, when the Gastrodia elata seedlings are unearthed.
Gastrodia elata seedlings are generally yellow-green or purple-red, with yellow-green flower spikes on them, which are easy to see in the forest.
Most of the time, under a Gastrodia elata seedling, there will be many large and small Gastrodia elata cubs.
It would be even better if there are three or four seedlings growing in one place. The soil between the seedlings is all turned over, and half a bag can be dug out if it is not neat.
If you meet Gastrodia elata, you can see a dozen or twenty Gastrodia elata seedlings looking like a dragon at once, so needless to say, start digging.
"It's over, we are late, look here, it has been dug up after such a long trip, this must be Tian Malong."
On this day, everyone went to the north side of the Kaifeng fork to dig Gastrodia elata.
Just coming down from the firewood road, before I walked a few steps into the woods, I saw someone dug a long way ahead.
Looking at the appearance of the soil turning, you can tell that there must be at least twenty or thirty Gastrodia elata trees in this place.
When several people saw that Ma Long was poached away that day, they were immediately discouraged.
This means that someone has been here before them, and even if they meet again, most of them are single trees, which is meaningless.
"It's all here, let's look in the forest, then we can't just go back like this, let's go." Xu Shiyan was not discouraged.
As the saying goes, fish pass through a thousand-layer net, and there are fish in every net.
The same is true for going up the mountain to start a side business. No one can go through it without missing a single bit, there will always be something that is missed.
Maybe that person dug up a gastrodia elata and left contentedly? In the mountains, anything can happen.
Everyone thinks so, they are all here, how can they go elsewhere?
Let's go, walk inside, go a little farther, maybe you can gain something?
Just like that, everyone followed Xu Shiyan to the forest.
I don’t know if this side has been dug up, or if I came to the wrong place today. After walking for more than half an hour, I really didn’t see a single tree, and everyone couldn’t help but feel discouraged.
Huang Shengli lost confidence as he walked, so he stopped to rest on the hillside, holding a grass tree with one hand, and playing mushrooms there.
"What's going on today, several of us didn't open our eyes.
Gastrodia elata, Gastrodia elata, where have they all gone? Could it be that they were poached away? "
Xu Shiyan had already walked up the hillside at this moment, and when he heard Huang Shengli reading rice seedlings there, he couldn't help but look back at him.
Then, Xu Shiyan realized something was wrong. "Victory, look at what you are holding in your hand?"
"Huh? What else can I hold in my hand? Grass, green straw?"
Huang Shengli glanced at the tree in his hand indifferently, a tree as thick as a little finger, what's so strange?
"You look up." Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head, pointing Huang Shengli to look up.
"Look up? What can I do if I look up? Tianma is not in the sky, so I can see it when I look up?"
Huang Shengli chanted while looking up, and then he was dumbfounded.
"Grass, Gastrodia, why is this Gastrodia taller than me?"
Huang Shengli is not tall, a little over 1.6 meters, but a Gastrodia elata grows taller than him, which is too much.
"Too bullying, I'm not as tall as Tianma."
Huang Shengli's words made several people laugh out loud.
"Okay, don't put it there and read the rice seedlings, dig up Gastrodia elata quickly, and see how many are there?"
Huang Shengli snapped off the Gastrodia elata pole, leaving only the bottom one foot high.
Then use your hands to move the turf and soil under the stalks, and dig down bit by bit until the potato-like gastrodia tubers are exposed.
However, he did not take out the tuber directly, but scraped the soil back along the tail of the tuber.
Sure enough, not far away, four or five big cubs were pulled out, and further down, there were some slightly smaller ones.
Finally, within a radius of two feet, Huang Shengli dug out two large handfuls of Gastrodia elata.
It is very good to have so many under one seedling.
Huang Shengli opened his eyes, and the big guys had confidence, so they dispersed and walked forward to find Tianma.
Xu Shiyan walked towards a post in front of him, turned over the post, and suddenly saw a pink flower on a tree in front of him.
Xu Shiyan walked over quickly and found that it was a tree mushroom.
This tree mushroom, pink in color, is one of the few brightly colored mushrooms that are not poisonous.
Coprinus coprinus, scientifically known as sulfur bacteria, is a fungus that is edible and medicinal.
This kind of fungus has a characteristic, that is, it grows very fast.
Maybe it was not as big as an egg the day before, but after two days, it has grown to the size of a cattail fan, and it is lignified and cannot be eaten.
So it is not easy to go to the mountains and meet the fresh and edible tree coprinus.
Today coincidentally, this tree mushroom grows just right, tender.
I went home and cut it into blanched water, and it was very delicious when fried with leeks.
If you are willing to eat something, you can also wrap it in noodles and fry it, and then eat it with some salt and pepper. It is very delicious. It really feels like eating chicken. Why is it called tree chicken mushroom?
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand, and carefully broke off the large tree mushrooms that were stacked one after another.
He took out another bag from the bag he was carrying behind him, wrapped it up separately, and put it in the bag to carry it on his back.
The things in the mountains are not domesticated, so it is impossible for everything to go well, and you can do whatever you want.
Whatever you encounter is fine, as long as you have something to gain and don't go back empty-handed, Xu Shiyan can accept it.
Carrying the bag on his back, Xu Shiyan continued to walk forward. He planned to go down from this post and take a look ahead.
Just two steps forward, I found two Gastrodia elata seedlings in front of me.
After entering the mountain for a long time, finally opened his eyes, Xu Shiyan was very happy, and walked towards the two Gastrodia elata.
As a result, I just arrived and looked around a few times, hey? There are three more trees not far ahead?
Xu Shiyan became happy, five trees, so close together, there might be a large nest in the middle.
"I met Gastrodia elata here, where are the five seedlings." Xu Shiyan shouted.
"You all look carefully, maybe there are some around here."
Gastrodia elata is not a mountain ginseng, and it is not worth much, so whoever sees it belongs to whoever enters the mountain.
Wild ginseng is too precious, if it cannot be divided equally, some people may feel unbalanced, especially if they encounter big goods, it is very likely that people will die.
The people over there heard that Xu Shiyan had opened his eyes, and they were all happy and more confident, so they wandered around the neighborhood.
Not to mention, there are really nearby, not long after, Sun Xiaofeng and the others also shouted, opening their eyes.
When you enter the mountains, you are afraid that you will not open your eyes, as long as you open your eyes, it is easy to say.
Xu Shiyan cleaned up all the grass around the five Gastrodia elata, and then began to rummage around the area surrounded by the five Gastrodia elata from the outside to the inside.
Sure enough, I met a nest, and finally this nest dug out large and small Gastrodia elata, which was a washbasin.

chapters.title: Chapter 140: earn a small fortune
chapters.content:
Chapter 140 Making a small fortune
There are uncertainties in running a sideline business in the mountains. No one knows what and how many people will encounter when entering the mountains.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan dug Gastrodia elata when he saw it, picked up mushrooms when he saw it, and one day he came across Ganoderma lucidum.
On a wind-fallen tree, a ring of Ganoderma lucidum grew, the big ones were like a plate, and the small ones were as big as a palm, with a dozen or so flowers.
The few who followed Xu Shiyan into the mountain at that time were all stunned. They had never seen so many Ganoderma lucidum before.
Changbai Mountain Ganoderma lucidum belongs to the red Ganoderma lucidum, the color is dark red.
The front and stipe of Ganoderma lucidum are covered with a layer of hard and shiny waxy substance, while the back is fine and porous.
Changbai Mountain Ganoderma lucidum has high medicinal value, but at present, its value has not been excavated by people.
The local people call Ganoderma lucidum wood Ganoderma lucidum, and they don’t regard it as a good thing, and sometimes the purchasing stations don’t accept it.
Xu Shiyan didn't plan to sell it either, he picked up the Ganoderma lucidum for his family to use.
Ganoderma lucidum has the effects of lowering blood sugar, lowering blood lipids, enhancing immunity, and anti-tumor. It can be reserved for Xu Shian and the old man.
Under Zhou Guilan's persuasion and supervision, Xu Shi'an ate all the wild boar stomachs he made in winter.
This time, I will eat Ganoderma lucidum next time. As long as it is the method Xu Shiyan can think of, I will use it. I hope it will be effective.
At Xu Chenghou's age, he should start to take care of his body. As long as he pays more attention, he won't get sick so suddenly and go away.
It takes a short time to dig Gastrodia elata, and within ten days, Gastrodia elata seedlings grow taller and bloom.
After a while, the seedlings of Gastrodia elata began to turn black and rot into a net shape, giving birth to many small Gastrodia elata cubs.
And those big gastrodia elata will become empty.
When Gastrodia elata is gone, the properties of the medicine will be poor, and the price will not be sold, so no one will dig it anymore.
Clean the Gastrodia elata that has been dug home, and cook in a pot.
In the past, digging was less, and it was cooked with millet porridge, so that the cooked Gastrodia elata was dried and weighed, and the color was good.
But there are a lot of Gastrodia elata dug now, and there is not so much millet to cook with, so we can only boil it in clean water.
The cooked gastrodia elata are put outside to dry, the big ones are directly placed on the mat, and the small ones can be strung together with threads.
Emerged Gastrodia elata is just a piece of skin after drying, which is not worth weighing.
The most valuable is the big one, which turns slightly yellow when dried, translucent, and of the best quality. Generally, four or five catties of the big one can be dried for one catty.
The price of dried Gastrodia elata is not high. The county medicine company buys it.
Xu Shiyan digs at least 20 to 30 catties a day, and at most one day meets Gastrodia elata, and digs more than 70 catties of fresh Gastrodia.
In less than ten days, I saved sixty to seventy catties of dry goods, and got another sum of money.
"Why do I think it is easier to make money here in Donggang than in a big house?"
Xu Shiyan took time to go to the county medicinal materials company and sold Gastrodia elata. When he came back to report the bill to his wife, Su Anying was there feeling emotional.
"It must be much easier, there are many people here, and there are many opportunities.
Of course, the most important thing is that our family has an extra bicycle, so I can go running in distant places, and of course earn more than others. "
In the past, in the big house, every time Gastrodia elata was unearthed, everyone went to the mountain to dig.
Walking on two legs is naturally no better than walking around with two wheels. Everyone walks close, and no one can dig too much.
It’s like a large team over there, why do you say that a large team digs Gastrodia elata?
The main reason is that they are on the east side, close to the back mountain of Gaolibaozi, where there are many gastrodia elata.
There are still a few people who have bicycles these days, Xu Shiyan and the others can ride to farther places.
Forty or fifty miles away, if you walk back and forth every day on two legs, and you have to run all over the mountain to find gastrodia elata, you may not be exhausted.
But riding a bicycle is different. It takes less than two hours to get there for forty or fifty miles.
Walk far, naturally have more opportunities and earn more money than others.
"You haven't seen places like Qianchuan Forest Farm and Shengli Forest Farm.
It is close to the Changbai Mountain Reserve, and everyone enters the reserve to do side jobs and earn more money. "Xu Shiyan smiled and explained to his wife.
Su Anying is too lazy to analyze these things, she only knows that she can make money.
"Just give me half of the money, and you can keep the rest.
You go to buy everything in our house, you can't go back and ask me for money for everything, right?
It’s a joke for a big man who doesn’t have any money in his pocket. "
Su Anying counted the money, just like selling Niu Maoguang before, keeping half for herself and saving the other half for Xu Shiyan.
Anyway, she usually coaxes the children and doesn't go out very often. Xu Shiyan does the shopping, and if she doesn't pay, where can Xu Shiyan change things back?
The couple sat on the kang and talked, but no one paid attention to Xu Haiyuan lying on the kang.
When they turned around by chance, they found that the little guy turned sideways at some point.
"Daughter-in-law, did you sideways for the child?"
Xu Shiyan felt strange, he didn't see his daughter-in-law moving the child just now, why did the child turn sideways?
"No, I didn't touch him. I changed the diaper just now after feeding, and I put down the flat bed for him."
Su Anying was also stunned when she saw her sleeping son lying on the side of the kang.
"It is estimated that this kid turned over by himself. He has seen it for almost three months, and it is normal to learn to turn over."
Su Anying has served several younger sisters, so she knows a lot about this.
Turning over three times, sitting six times and crawling eight times is the law of a baby's growth. Most healthy children follow this rhythm.
"Our son was born on April 18th, and it's already July 12th, almost 100 days ago.
I reckon, after a hundred days, he will be able to turn everything over. "
"It's July 12th today? Oh, the fifth child should have finished the exam, and I don't know how he did?
I only went up the mountain this day, so I forgot about the serious business, so I had time to find someone to send a message back and ask. "
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered that at the beginning of July, Xu Shixiang took the college entrance examination.
When did the exam results come out in the previous life? It seems that the results will come out at the end of July, and the admission results will come out in mid-August.
"I hope that the fifth child will be admitted to the university smoothly, and he will have a good job in the future, so that he doesn't have to climb up at midnight and work in the fields in the middle of the night to be a fool."
Xu Shiyan said, looking down at his sleeping son on the kang.
"Little guy, you have to remember, you have to study hard when you grow up.
In the future, you will also get into a good university, go to work in the city, and be a daughter-in-law in the city. Don’t be like your father, an old farmer. "
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand and touched his son's tender and chubby face, revealing the old father's satisfied smile.
Xu Haiyuan in his sleep didn't know what his father expected for his future.
I don't know what the little guy dreamed about in his dream, so he giggled suddenly, which startled Xu Shiyan.
"Yo, what are you dreaming about? Did you dream of marrying a wife?" Xu Shiyan thought it was fun, and touched his son's face again.
As a result, this time, she was slapped aside by Su Anying.
"When you wake him up, you can coax him yourself. What time is this? If he wakes up at this time, he can play until midnight. Who can afford it?"
Su Anying rolled Xu Shiyan's eyes and said angrily.
Xu Shiyan pulled his daughter-in-law into his arms, and said with a light smile, "Then let's do something else while the brat is asleep?"

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Firewood
chapters.content:
Chapter 141 Firewood
July is a hot day with little rain, so it is a good time to prepare the ground for bed digging.
The second brigade has a long history of planting ginseng. Most of the ginseng land near the No. 2 bridge has been used. There is no cutting area this year.
The newly approved ginseng land is near Xiaohei River in the southwest of Funan Forest Farm.
After selecting the site, the first thing to do is to clean up the site.
This area was newly cut last year. The large logs have already been transported away, and the remaining shrubs, small trees, and weeds have to be cleaned up. This is the firewood.
Generally speaking, bottoming firewood is most suitable for carrying out in dog days.
Leave the useful wood, and put the rest of the dead branches and weeds together. After drying for a few days, light it up and burn it off.
In order to increase the ground temperature, accelerate the decomposition of organic matter, promote the maturation of the soil, and reduce pests and diseases.
Xu Shiyan is a participating technician in the second brigade, so he must bring people to do all these tasks.
Funan Forest Farm is far away from Donggang, and it is inconvenient to run back and forth all day, so Xu Shiyan took his people and built a ground next to the ginseng field.
Taking advantage of the good weather, grab the jobs quickly.
After a few days in the sun, the dead branches and weeds on the ground were half dry, so I found a windless morning and planned to light the firewood pile.
"Everyone, be more energetic, you must watch it, and don't run away.
There are forests all around here, if something happens, we have to go in. "
Xu Shiyan told everyone worriedly, for fear that one careless person would run away, and that would be a big deal.
"Brother Xu, don't worry, these haystacks are quite far away from the edge of the forest, and you can't run away from the fire, so you can rest on the side with peace of mind."
Although Xu Shiyan is a technician, but he has no airs, lives and works with the big guys, and never looks down on anyone, so everyone is very close to Xu Shiyan.
"The haystack we are trimming this time is too big. I'm afraid it won't be trimmed when the fire starts, so I'd better be careful."
How dare Xu Shiyan leave the place? He just went home the day before yesterday, and these **** piled up firewood so high.
Just kidding, if the fire comes together and there is a gust of wind, I really dare not say what's going on, so let's just watch here honestly.
"Don't be in a hurry to start a fire, everyone is holding a shovel and digging a firebreak around those haystacks. This thing is really not a joke."
Xu Shiyan was still worried, and arranged for someone to dig a circle around the firewood pile with a shovel.
Working together for such a long time, everyone knows Xu Shiyan's temper, and they are cautious and considerate.
Since Xu Shiyan is the leader, he can do whatever he says.
So this group of young men were not too tired, they all took shovels, picks, etc., and dug a firebreak around those big firewood piles.
Now, Xu Shiyan felt relieved, and called for someone to light the fire.
Those weeds had been exposed to the sun for several days, and they had already dried out. Once a fire was lit, the flames would burst up immediately, burning with the half-dried branches.
In summer, it is already hot, but when the fire is lit, it becomes even more scorching.
Everyone hastily withdrew far away, sitting in the shade by the edge of the forest, chatting and laughing.
Others were laughing and joking, but Xu Shiyan didn't dare to be distracted at all. He kept staring at the fire, fearing that something might happen.
Everything was fine originally. Although the fire was big, most of the branches were not too dry after all, so the fire was not big.
Suddenly, a gust of wind blew over, and the fire started up in a flash.
Xu Shiyan stood up suddenly in fright, "Quick, look around, don't run away."
With the little fire escape they dug, if there is a big fire, it can't be stopped at all. This is really no joke.
"Stop sitting still, hurry up and take a look."
While talking, Xu Shiyan walked around the forest to check the situation around the fire.
As a result, an abnormality was discovered just beside a fire in the west.
The fire escape over there was not dug properly, and the grass around the fire was dried up. The wind just now should have blown out the sparks, and the fire spread to the side.
"Hurry up and come here with your belongings, this side is deserted." Xu Shiyan hurriedly shouted, and rushed over with a shovel in his hand.
When everyone over there heard this, they were terrified, and hurried to the west.
Looking over here, the fire has spread quite a lot on the ground.
Without saying a word, everyone began to beat the branches with their shovels, and some people picked up soil from the ground and pressed it up.
Fortunately, when laying firewood, it was cleaned up fairly cleanly, and the grass on the ground was not thick.
Coupled with the wind, it blew for a while, and soon stopped. The fire was brought under control under the beatings of the crowd.
"It's so good, it's really a mother, why is there such a demonic wind?"
Seeing that the fire was extinguished, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Now, no one dared to run to play, and they all stayed around the forest, staring at the fires, for fear of any accidents.
A few fires were too big, and there were some big tree roots inside, and they burned until the afternoon, so it was over.
Xu Shiyan was worried, so he took people to check the fire one by one, and turned the fire from top to bottom with a stick.
After confirming that they were all extinguished and there were no sparks left, he breathed a sigh of relief and led the people down the mountain.
Shendi is more than 30 miles away from Donggang. Fortunately, Xu Shiyan was riding a bicycle and arrived home after five o'clock.
Before entering the door, he heard laughter and laughter in the house, which seemed to be a lot of people talking, Xu Shiyan was a little puzzled, who is here?
In summer, the windows were all open, so Xu Shiyan went to the window and took a look in. Okay, there are quite a few people in the room.
The father-in-law, mother-in-law, father and mother are all here. What day is it today, why is it so complete?
"Dad, Mom, Dad, Mom, why are you here?" The two dads must be distinguished, so they can only call Xu Chenghou Dad and Su Weizhong Dad.
"Why are you here? You are a father, you have even forgotten your son for a hundred days, right?
Haiyuan celebrates a hundred days today, and my mother, your father-in-law, and mother-in-law all come to see the child and celebrate the hundred days for the child. "
Xu Cheng gave his son a thick look. How can such a big event be forgotten?
Xu Shiyan slapped his forehead, "Oh my god, I really forgot, the mountain is too busy these days, I live on the mountain, and I don't know which day it is."
Isn't it? His family's son was born on the twelfth day of the third month in the lunar calendar. The baby is counted as a hundred days, not by day, but by month, and it takes ninety-nine days.
Today is the 25th day of the seventh lunar month in the Gregorian calendar. Isn’t it the 21st day of the sixth month in the lunar calendar?
"What are you busy with? Look at your disheveled face, why is your face still black and gray?"
Zhou Guilan saw that her son was tanned and thin this summer, and she immediately felt distressed.
