"Sandi, laying firewood, burning those branches and weeds today, isn't this leading the people to watch the fire burn out, leaving a body of ashes."
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to say that he almost ran away, for fear that his parents would worry.
"Okay, you can go wash it quickly and change clothes, Yingzi, quickly find him a set of clean clothes."
Zhou Guilan loves to be clean, how can she see her son's dirty appearance? Hurry up and rush Xu Shiyan to wash and tidy up.
Xu Shiyan has been on the mountain for the past few days, and he is really not looking good.
It happens that the water in the big basin in the yard is still warm, so hurry up and wash it.
"Mom, have the results of the fifth college entrance examination come out?" Xu Shiyan took the towel handed by his mother, wiped his head and face, and asked casually.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: baby hundred days
chapters.content:
Chapter 142 Baby Hundred Days
"It came out, I went to the county yesterday to see the score, 196 points.
It’s better than last year, but I don’t know if I can pass the exam. "Zhou Guilan replied with a little worry.
Xu Shiyan heard it and found that he had the same score as in his previous life, so it is estimated that Tonghua Agricultural School did not run away.
It’s not easy to think about it. When the fifth child was studying in a rural middle school, the content they learned was simple, and most of it was related to agricultural practice.
I have reviewed for nine months in total, and the test scores are not bad. There are still many people who have not passed the exam, right?
"Then it is estimated that there will be an admission result in August. Mom, don't worry, the fifth child will definitely be admitted." Xu Shiyan comforted his mother very firmly.
"Well, I hope it's like what you said.
If the fifth child can be admitted to a university, he won’t have to work in the Zhuanghuyuan, bowing his back and pouting all day long. "
Zhou Guilan nodded and smiled.
"Okay, don't talk about that, let's go in and eat quickly. Today, Lao Liu bought meat and came back. The dumplings happened to be made of celery meat."
When Xu Shiyan came back, the dumplings had already been made.
He was washing up outside just now, and the dumplings were just cooking in the house, and they were already served on the table.
Xu Shiyan is on the mountain these days, living in shacks, eating pancakes and pickled cabbage heads, which really makes him hard to rely on.
At this moment, the aroma of the dumplings hit his nose, and Xu Shiyan felt his stomach growling. He was really hungry and greedy.
The family is not polite, and greeted their parents, father-in-law and mother-in-law to sit on the kang, and then Xu Shiyan rummaged through the cabinets and found a bottle of wine and three wine cups.
"Dad, Daddy, there are dumplings tonight, let's have some." While talking, he filled up the dumplings for his father and his father-in-law.
"Then you must drink some, dumpling wine, the more you drink, the more delicious you will be."
Xu Chenghou watched his son pour the wine with a smile, not to mention how beautiful he was.
Not to mention Su Weizhong on the other end, my uncle is so capable, and his life is prosperous, and he, the father-in-law, is also beautiful in his heart.
A dear father and a father-in-law, the two old men got together, drank this little wine, and once the chatterbox opened, they praised each other.
After the compliment was over, the other party praised Xu Shiyan and Su Anying. Oops, this bragging exchange made Zhou Guilan and Han Shi on the other end dumbfounded.
"Come here, eat dumplings. If you don't eat such delicious dumplings, how can you just drink?"
Zhou Guilan gave Xu Chenghou several dumplings and gave him a glare.
Xu Chenghou hadn't drunk much yet, so he couldn't see what it meant, so he hurriedly greeted Su Weizhong to eat dumplings.
The Han family on the other end was also caught by Su Weizhong, and he touched Su Weizhong's arm. Su Weizhong also came back and ate it quickly.
"Well, this dumpling is delicious and fresh.
Why don't you say that you still have to be a worker, you see that there are meat tickets every month, it's not like us, waiting for our own pigs to be slaughtered all year round. "
Su Weizhong said with emotion while eating dumplings.
"Well, it's true. Ever since the sixth child became a worker, we've been wiped out, and we can eat meat every now and then."
Although Xu Shiqin is only an apprentice, the benefits he should have are not bad.
Xu Shiqin lived here, and Xu Shiyan and his wife never mentioned food expenses.
She felt sorry for herself, so she went back to buy some meat from time to time, and took back whatever the unit sent.
"In-laws, the sixth child of your family is nineteen this year, right? Do you have a date?"
Han's side glanced at Xu Shiqin who was eating silently, and asked Zhou Guilan in a low voice.
Zhou Guilan shook her head, "No, alas, I was in a big house before, but someone introduced it. I didn't like it, so I pushed it."
Last year, someone introduced Xu Shiqin to someone. The young man was twenty-four years old, and his family was poor, with no parents. He had six or seven younger siblings, the youngest was only eight years old.
If you marry in the past, and become a sister-in-law and a mother, it would be a shame to suffer hardships.
With Xu Shiqin's physique, how could he stand it?
Zhou Guilan didn't think it was right, so she didn't tell Xu Shiqin, but directly refused, which made the matchmaker quite unhappy.
"Well, it's thanks to you that you didn't agree. You see, now that the sixth child has such a good job, why won't he find a worker in the future?
If the couple were both workers, would life be better?
My in-laws, let me tell you, this matter cannot be sloppy.
With a beautiful girl, a formal job, and good craftsmanship, why can't we find someone with good conditions? "
Mr. Han leaned close to Zhou Guilan's ear and muttered softly.
Not to mention, Han's words really touched Zhou Guilan's heart.
Which girl is not rare? They all looked at their daughter well, and they all hoped that their daughter would find a good husband's family in the future.
"Well, I think so too, don't worry, I'm only nineteen, let's talk when I meet someone good.
When a girl becomes an official for a day, and when she gets married, she becomes a daughter-in-law for someone else.
The heart is endlessly tired and tired, let her enjoy a few years of happiness. "
Zhou Guilan said while looking at her daughter, her eyes were full of love and pity.
The women don't drink, eat fast, and finish eating in a short while, so they sit next to them and chat, waiting for the three of them to be full before cleaning up.
At this moment, Xu Haiyuan was full and finished urinating, so Xu Shiyan hurriedly hugged him to play with his son.
As a result, I saw that there was a white thread hanging around my son's neck, and ten yuan was tied under the white thread.
Needless to say, it must have been hung up by the father-in-law and mother-in-law.
In the past, it was a long life lock for the baby of a hundred days, how can there be such a thing now?
I changed the style, made a white thread, tied money underneath, and hung it around the child's neck, implying a long time.
It is estimated that there is something on the neck, Xu Haiyuan feels that it is not very strong, and always wants to wave his hand to grab it.
Xu Shiyan looked back and asked Zhou Guilan, "Mom, can this thread be taken off? I looked at Xiao Yuanyuan and wanted to catch it."
"Oh, by the way, we were all busy and forgot to take off the thread.
Grandpa, pick the thread from head to toe, hey, yes, that’s it.
All right, let Yingzi put it away, save the thread for future use. "
Mr. Han hurried up to him, pointed to Xu Shiyan, and took off the hanging white thread.
"This child is really good-looking, white and fat, look at these little arms and legs, how fun it is to see each joint."
It's rare to see a fat baby these days, and it's rare for anyone to see it.
"Come on, give me a hug, grandma." Han didn't care about that, and took the child away.
Going to Zhou Guilan, the two of them teased the children together, making Xiao Haiyuan grin with joy.
Xu Shiyan was dumbfounded. It wasn't long before he picked up his son, and he didn't care about it, so he was snatched away?
Oh, no way, one is the mother and the other is the mother-in-law, if you can’t afford to offend them, then you can only wait until they are rare enough.
As a result, Xu Shiyan waited and waited all night, but he didn't wait for a chance.
The whole family loves the little baby, hugging and kissing each other, how can Xu Shiyan have a role?
Finally kissed enough, Xu Shiyan wanted to hug him, but Su Anying took his son away again.
The little guy wanted to eat when he was hungry, and he ate again after eating. After cleaning up, he was too sleepy to keep his eyes open and went to sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 143: new pickaxe
chapters.content:
Chapter 143 New Pickaxe
Xu Chenghou and others stayed at Xu Shiyan's house for one night, and went home the next morning.
Xu Shiyan was very busy. He was called away early in the morning, and he couldn't send his father-in-law and mother-in-law to the station.
Fortunately, Su Weizhong and his wife both understood, so they naturally ignored it and left happily.
Xu Shiyan led his people and continued to toss in the new venue.
After laying firewood on the ground, it is time to orient and hang strings.
Orientation is to determine the direction facing the front eaves of the ginseng bed according to the requirements of ginseng for light and the terrain.
The overall requirement is to use morning and evening yang, avoid noon yang, and not use frontal yang.
Generally, at ten o'clock or half past ten in the morning, the sun exits from the pool surface as the standard.
The flat land mostly takes the dew sun, that is, the pool string is oriented north-south or south-east.
Mountain land is mostly in the direction of south and north, and the north and south slopes of mountainous land are mostly along the mountain.
If the east and west slopes are not steep and the water can be discharged smoothly, they can be horizontal or inclined. If the **** is large, follow the mountain or **** it.
Orientation is very important. Yu Shouguang found a few old farmers, and together with Xu Shiyan, took a compass to measure around the site for half a day, and discussed for a long time before confirming Yangkou.
Fix the Yangkou, and then hang the skewers.
According to the determined direction of the pool string and the specifications of the ginseng bed, the stakes are marked, which is called hanging string.
Still use the compass to set the direction, find out the positions of the stakes at both ends, and connect the two stakes with a rope.
Along the rope, insert a stake every five meters. This is the baseline.
From the end point of the baseline, measure the width of the furrow string along the direction of the end line, that is, the width of the pool surface and the horse path together.
Then insert the stakes, and each stake is numbered with an ink pen. Connecting stakes of the same number is equivalent to drawing countless parallel lines on the entire land.
The area between two adjacent parallel lines is a furrow string. When digging the soil, the stakes cannot be pulled out or moved.
It sounds simple, but the actual operation is very troublesome. The second brigade plans to make 5,000 feet of ginseng soil this year, and it took two days just to hang the strings.
After hanging the strings, the next step is to dig the soil.
Workers wielded pickaxes and dug up the turf and the underlying soil layer together to form a large adobe about one and a half feet square, which was buckled upside down in the middle of the furrow strings.
At the same time, gather the subsoil on both sides to the middle of the string, and place the adobe on top of the subsoil in the shape of fish scales.
After the adobe has been exposed to the sun and fully matured, the columbine soil is then drilled.
Digging the soil is purely a laborious task.
The picks used for digging the soil these days are larger than those used in large fields.
But in Xu Shiyan's eyes, this thing is still not good, it's too narrow, and it can't be counted.
So, Xu Shiyan began to take advantage of his rebirth again, and drew a blueprint.
After asking for instructions too broadly, I asked someone from the industry to build a few new pickaxes according to the drawings.
The new pickaxe is twice as wide as the original pickaxe. In order to reduce the weight, only half of the bottom is solid, and the top is hollowed out.
The new pickaxe is so sharp that it can cut off the roots of small trees with two strokes, let alone turf.
It only takes two or three strokes to plan a piece of adobe, which is more than half the effort of the original pickaxe.
"My God, this thing is so easy to use, Xiao Xu, how did you think of it?"
Xu Shiyan brought four or five picks up the mountain to test them out for everyone. After trying them out, they all said that the new picks are easy to use, work fast and save effort.
Yu Shouguang and other brigade cadres who followed up the mountain were all dumbfounded, this new pickaxe is also very easy to use.
"I'm thinking about it, the pickaxe we use is too slow, time-consuming and laborious, and the work is too slow." Xu Shiyan smiled.
In the previous life, when this pickaxe first came out, many people rushed to buy it. The blacksmith who made the pickaxe made a lot of money.
This thing is really easy to use. Until he was reborn, unless he was digging the ground with a machine, if it was done manually, he always used this kind of digging tool.
Xu Shiyan hit a total of five pickaxes in the industry, all of which were taken away.
Others didn't, so they could only watch others work quickly and easily.
"Uncle Yu, don't just stand here, go back quickly and make a pickaxe with the industrial side."
Beside there was that clever man, who hurried up to Yu Shouguang and gave Yu Shouguang some advice.
"Order one hundred and eighty, the big guys will have one hand, and the work will be quick."
"Uncle, I guess it won't take a few days before other brigades will come to you again.
This time, don’t play up your style like the ground gun.
Simply, just order thousands of them from the industry, and then sell them, even if you earn two yuan for one, can't you make a lot of money?
It’s okay, uncle, think about it, at least earn money for the pickaxes we use in our team. "
Xu Shiyan was even more ruthless, and he did something absolutely amazing.
Anyway, this is what he did, and he can't always give it away for nothing. Even if he doesn't benefit himself, he has to let the brigade make a fortune.
After being reminded by Xu Shiyan, several cadres in the team immediately widened their eyes.
"Oh, what's the matter? What are we all pretending to be in our heads? I can't figure out this thing.
Go, go, hurry up, go back quickly, find the people in the industry, and ask them to keep the secret.
This pickaxe, if our brigade doesn’t make a fortune, it’s really a waste of Xiao Xu’s thoughts. "
How many brigades are there in Donggang Commune? ten.
Ten brigades all planted ginseng, and they all had to dig the soil. I don’t believe they were not tempted by such a useful pickaxe?
Even if a commune orders a hundred pickaxes, the quantity is still very large.
You don’t need to earn much for a pickaxe, just one yuan is enough, which is better than letting other teams take advantage every time.
So, the cadres of the brigade didn't care about anything, and slipped down the mountain.
As soon as he went back, Yu Shouguang immediately found the director of the industrial factory, and directly finalized with the other party that he would only make pickaxes for the second brigade, and the first batch would be 1,000.
Fixed the industrial side, Yu Shouguang first went to the commune to participate in the field, found the director of the commune to participate in the field, talked to him in vernacular, and successfully sold a hundred of them.
It is one yuan higher than the industrial quotation, and half of the deposit is paid in advance.
The first step is successfully taken, and the next step will be easy. Yu Shouguang and the others continue to fool around.
In a few days, all the brigades under Donggang Commune were fooled into ordering goods by them.
The second brigade is so noisy, how can it not disturb the commune?
The leaders of the commune were very curious when they knew about it. They went to the mountain to check it out and found that the pickaxe was really easy to use.
"Old Yu, you are not authentic, you can earn money in groups, this is not acceptable.
Well, about the pickaxe, the commune has taken over. "Several leaders of the commune took over the follow-up work without saying a word.
"Hey, Lao Zhang, how much ginseng soil did your commune make this year? Have you finished digging?
I have a very useful tool for digging the soil. It is fast and light. It is used by several brigades in our commune. Would you like to take a look? "
The secretary of the commune directly shook the phone to find someone, which was a hundred times better than Yu Shouguang and the others riding a bicycle.
Being fooled by Donggang Commune, the nearby Xinglong, Songjiang, Manjiang and other communes all sent people to learn from them.
Then, they discovered that this pickaxe is really good.
Donggang said, we have a part of the stock here, and if there are not enough, you can make an order. Do you want it?

chapters.title: Chapter 144: past life master
chapters.content:
Chapter 144 Past Life Master
In fact, both Yu Shouguang and the leaders of the commune understand one truth.
The matter of the pickaxe cannot be hidden. Even if they don't take the initiative to find someone, it is estimated that after a while, someone will be able to imitate it.
The main reason is that this thing does not have much technical content, as long as it has a look, it can be made by a blacksmith furnace.
So, their idea is to seize the opportunity before others react.
Earn as much as you can, so as not to be taken advantage of by others in the end.
As for the people in other communes, they really wanted to go back and imitate.
I thought about buying ten as a sample, and went back to find a blacksmith stove to make it myself.
As a result, Donggang Commune is also ruthless. Each commune must order more than 500 pieces, and pay 70% of the deposit in advance.
If you want three melons and two dates, just fool the good things away, there is no way.
Donggang Commune dared to be so tough, and naturally they had their support.
Not every commune has an industrial factory that can use machine tools to make pickaxes. In addition to Donggang Industry in the entire county, there is the county hardware factory.
The leaders of Donggang Commune have already gone to the county to negotiate, and they only accept large orders, and they will not accept orders less than a thousand.
Industrial mass production is like this, and the cost can be reduced when the quantity increases.
So don’t look at the price increase by Donggang Commune, it’s actually lower than the cost of hand-made blacksmith furnaces.
Both parties understand what is going on in their hearts, but when doing business, you have to bargain, otherwise you will feel uncomfortable.
After some discussion between the two parties, in the end, people from other communes were overwhelmed, and had no choice but to order 500.
There are fourteen communes and four towns in the whole county. There are town offices in the towns.
For this round alone, Donggang Commune ordered thousands of pickaxes and quite a few ground guns.
Donggang Industrial Factory and County Hardware Factory started work together, worked overtime, and took the time to complete the order.
Then, Xu Shiyan was transferred down to be responsible for the production of picks and ground guns, especially the quality supervision.
"Xiao Xu, add another 500 pickaxes, 100 ground guns, and 300 crackers for the industrial side.
This is an item ordered by a state-run factory. After it is finished, you have to be responsible for it, helping to install and teach the technology. "
On this day, Xu Shiyan was still working in the industry, and the cadres of the commune came to inform him.
The Fusong local state-run No. 1 venue is located in Donggang.
In 1946, it was called "Yongmao Ginseng Garden".
There are more than a thousand employees in a factory, and the operating area is 50,000 to 60,000 square meters. The annual income is 5 to 6 million, and the profit turned over is tens of millions.
A participant has its own primary and secondary schools, staff clubs, clinics, and nurseries.
There are production vehicles, cars, tractors, and various types of agricultural machinery, and there is also a mechanized processing plant.
It is said that the second team is powerful, compared with the first team, it is nothing.
Let's not talk about the second team, even the commune's participation, in front of the first participation, not even the younger brother.
"Xiao Xu, you must put your heart into this job as a participant. Our commune is now negotiating with a participant to jointly run a middle school and a high school."
The cadres of the commune patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and told him to complete the task with quality and quantity.
Xu Shiyan had heard about the joint school in his previous life.
Donggang High School used the same site as others.
Yi Zhanchang moved the original primary school to the east. The original primary school teaching building was converted into a dormitory building. On the west side of the dormitory building, a four-story teaching building was built.
Then Donggang Middle School separated the junior high school from the high school, the high school moved to the new school, and the junior high school was still at the original location.
The condition of the joint school is that students with registered permanent residence, regardless of their grades in the junior high school exam, can go to junior high school.
Moreover, there are discounts for students of participating middle schools who study in high school.
"Don't worry, the leader, I will definitely take care of this matter."
For Xu Shiyan, no matter what he does, it is his duty. He is a member of the Second Brigade and a member of Donggang Commune. He will do whatever the leader arranges.
To put it bluntly, to teach technology is just talking, counting work points, and taking care of food. Isn't it a hundred times better than him digging the big soil with a pickaxe on the mountain?
So, next, the industry will try its best to complete the order of the first participant, and after it is completed, the first participant will send people to check and accept it.
After passing the acceptance check, just use the car to pull the things away.
By the way, I made an appointment with Xu Shiyan, and sent a car to pick him up the next day, and went up the mountain to teach the ginseng to install the ground gun.
The ginseng sites in the first factory are all near the Caozi River, quite far from Donggang, and most of the workers work by car.
On the morning of August 12th, the attendant sent a car to pick up Xu Shiyan, and he went up the mountain with the workers.
The road to Caozihe Sanchang is not easy, with bumps and sharp turns all the way.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan was riding in a jeep, which was better at least, and those who worked were all riding in big cars, which was even more bumpy.
Bumped all the way across the Caozihe Bridge, and walked another 30 miles, and finally arrived at a breakout.
"Uncle Han, this is a technician from the Second Brigade of Donggang Commune. Didn't the director mention that gun before? It was made by this young man.
Our field manager ordered a hundred ground guns, and asked the young man to teach you a few, so that it will be easier to see references in the future. "
Everyone got out of the car and entered the venue, and saw a tall and burly man who was less than fifty years old.
The person who led Xu Shiyan here, quickly introduce him.
"Xiao Xu, this is Uncle Han who we watched in the first split.
Don't underestimate Uncle Han, he is a well-known gunner in our field, and he is very good at hunting.
Besides, his ancestors opened an **** agency, and Uncle Han is a good kung fu, otherwise, can he watch the parade on the mountain? "
Xu Shiyan looked at the person in front of him, tears almost fell out.
He is too familiar with the person in front of him. In his previous life, he was the person in front of him. He taught him to hunt and fight. This is his master, Han Wenzhong.
"Uncle Han, I have admired your name for a long time. The junior Xu Shiyan is a little smart, and he dare not show off in front of Uncle Han."
Xu Shiyan stepped forward and saluted respectfully.
I really didn't expect that Xu Shiyan was happy and excited to meet Master here.
In his last life, in 1987, Xu Shiyan moved from a big house to Donggang. He wanted to develop ginseng because his family background was too weak. Later, after someone introduced him, he went up the mountain to show ginseng to a ginseng market.
At that time, all the participating venues were also contracted, and the participating venues of the first sub-field were contracted by the Han family. However, the Han family did not have enough staff, so they hired a few outside.
Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong had a very bad temper. When they were watching ginseng on the mountain, the old man taught Xu Shiyan a little boxing. He took Xu Shiyan to the mountains in summer and took him hunting in winter.
The old man has practiced martial arts since he was a child, and he has a very good physique. Even though he was almost sixty years old at that time, he couldn't let go of leading Xu Shiyan over the mountains.
Xu Shiyan followed Han Wenzhong to watch ginseng on the mountain for three years. While releasing the mountain and hunting to save money, he bought ginseng soil and ginseng seeds to throw in the field.
As a result, when I went down the mountain three years later, I caught up with the sharp drop in the ginseng market in 1991 and 1992, and lost the money again.
Later, Xu Shiyan had no choice but to continue looking for places to watch references to make money.
I kindly recommend a book, "The Monk in the Red Mansion" Lu Zhishen transmigrated as Jia Baoyu, friends who like it can read it.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Kindness
chapters.content:
Chapter 145 Kindness
It can be said that Han Wenzhong is Xu Shiyan's master and benefactor.
Since he moved to Donggang, Xu Shiyan has always wanted to visit Han Wenzhong.
But in this life, the two of them have never met in the slightest, so if he went looking for it rashly, people might think him crazy.
Xu Shiyan was still thinking about how he could find a chance to meet the Han family. Unexpectedly, he met them when he came up the mountain today.
Han Wenzhong looked at the excited look of the young man in front of him, a little puzzled.
Have you seen this guy before? It doesn't seem to be, so why do you look like you saw your relatives?
"Technician Xu, right? Have we met before?" Han Wenzhong asked tentatively.
"No, I haven't seen it, I just heard about your name, you are a well-known hunter, and you once hunted tigers.
Juniors also like hunting, and I admire sharpshooters like you the most. "Xu Shiyan restrained his expression and said with admiration.
Hearing this, Han Wenzhong grinned, "It happened so many years ago, I didn't expect anyone to think about it.
Xu technician also likes hunting? That's a good thing, wait for the winter, come to me on the mountain, I will take you hunting.
Nowadays young people, not many like hunting. They all want to be workers to earn wages and keep their income. They don’t look down on this craft. "
Han Wenzhong's father was a bodyguard teacher and used to run a bodyguard agency in the county.
The people who walk the darts are so forthright and righteous, and they make friends all over the world. The Han family has inherited this character.
Han Wenzhong is the same, he likes to make friends and take care of juniors.
As soon as he heard that Xu Shiyan liked hunting, Han Wenzhong became happy.
"Don't call me a technician, just call me Xiao Xu. I am so happy to go hunting in the mountains with you."
Xu Shiyan dreamed of hunting with his master again, regardless of whether Han Yuanzhong invited him sincerely, he took it as real.
Han Wenzhong was even happier when he heard this, "Okay, then I'll call you Xiao Xu, let's go into the room and rest for a while, uncle will make you tea."
Xu Shiyan has a simple, honest and easy-to-approach face, which can easily make people feel good.
Han Wenzhong was no exception. After meeting Xu Shiyan and saying a few words, he felt that this young man was very nice.
"Uncle, I came up the mountain mainly to install that ground gun.
I still have to trouble you, call all the ginsengers on the mountain, and I will teach you how to use this thing.
Waiting for the ground guns to be finished, the two of us will sit down and chat. "
Although Xu Shiyan was very excited to see the master, Xu Shiyan did not forget his purpose of coming up the mountain.
"That's fine, wait a minute, I'll call someone over."
Han Wenzhong still liked Xu Shiyan's down-to-earth attitude, so he immediately went to the observation deck over there, took a loudspeaker and yelled loudly twice.
Not long after, I heard responses from several other places, and after a while, I saw three people coming from different directions.
"This is the eldest of my family, Han Limin, from the public security team, and came to help in autumn. The second child is from the local police station, and the third child has gone to the army."
Han Wenzhong pointed to the young man who was very similar in shape and appearance to him, and introduced him to Xu Shiyan.
"He is twenty-six, how old are you, Xiao Xu?"
"Uncle, I'm also twenty-six, my birthday is in October. Brother Limin should be older than me."
Xu Shiyan is too familiar with Han Limin. In the previous life, the two of them planted clubs together, and their relationship is quite strong.
At that time, Xu Shiyan and his wife had a car accident. Su Anying was seriously injured and died on the spot. Xu Shiyan was unconscious and sent to the hospital for emergency treatment.
Zhou Guilan led three children, all of whom had numb claws.
I took out all the money at home and borrowed it from relatives and friends, but it was still not enough.
Han Limin helped out 20,000 yuan, and later helped to find a way to sell Xu's ginseng land and sticks. This was enough money for Su Anying's funeral and Xu Shiyan's follow-up treatment.
The 20,000 yuan in 1998 was really a lot of money.
Xu Shiyan has always remembered this friendship.
I didn’t live a good life in my previous life, and I didn’t have much chance to repay others. I can only go to Han’s house to see Mr. Han during the holidays.
If there is a chance in this life, I must repay the favor of the previous life.
"Well, Limin's birthday is March, so you should call Brother Sheng." Han Wenzhong nodded.
"These two are Xiao Wang and Xiao Li, both of us are participating in the field, and they will follow along to see the participants on the mountain."
There are a total of 30,000 zhang in a sub-field, and there are four people watching the participation. Han Wenzhong is the general manager, and the others are under his arrangement.
"This is a technician sent by Donggang Commune, Xiao Xu, the ground gun we heard about before was made by Xiao Xu.
Come here today to teach us how to use it, so listen carefully and don’t slip away. "
Han Wenzhong restrained his expression, and said with a serious face.
Looking at the ginseng on the mountain, everything has to be arranged by Han Wenzhong.
Besides, two of the four are surnamed Han, what else can the other two do besides being obedient?
"I know, I know, don't worry, Uncle Han, we promise to study hard." The two quickly nodded in response.
Xu Shiyan led the men and moved the guns and cannons out of the car. Fifty ground guns and one hundred and fifty **** cannons were given here in the first breakout, and it took two days to set up these alone.
It’s better to pull the cannon, as long as you tell how to pull the thread and place it around the venue.
Ground guns are troublesome. You need to learn how to load gun powder and gun sand, how to hide in the woods and how to be the most sensitive wiring.
These have to be demonstrated by Xu Shiyan himself, explaining them tirelessly over and over again.
I'm afraid that they won't remember something, and if they make a fuss, they will destroy themselves. That's not a joke.
"Why do I look at this thing, it looks like the Dibengzi used for hunting?"
However Han Wenzhong looked at it, this thing is quite similar to the things used for hunting in the early years.
At that time, there were similar things, which were set in places where prey often appeared. If the prey accidentally tripped, it would be hit by gun sand.
However, this thing can only be fixed in one position, and the gun sand is not very powerful, even large animals cannot be killed, and it is easy to be accidentally touched by people, so it is not very useful later.
"Uncle, you read that right, it was improved from that one, and the one used now is more powerful."
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard the words, no matter what, he improved little by little.
The ground gun was indeed used for hunting at first, and it was only used for reference later.
"Well, I can see that yours is more subtle and sensitive, and your lethality is also greater.
Not to mention, you have some ideas, you can use the means of hunting to look at references, okay. "
Han Wenzhong nodded after hearing the words, admiring Xu Shiyan more and more.
The young man has enough brains, he can turn the old household items eliminated by the Orion into sharp weapons, okay, this young man has a bright future.
"Let's install this ground gun, we must remember the location, I am really afraid that I will not remember it, so I will make a mark nearby.
This thing is quite powerful. If it is shot down by the ground, it will not die, and it will not be able to bear the crime of living. "
While teaching them how to install, Xu Shiyan also reminded them that no matter what they do, safety is the most important thing.
Don’t install a ground gun, the thief didn’t collapse, but killed his own people.

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Ask for leave
chapters.content:
Chapter 146 Leave
Related to the safety of life, it is very important, who dares to be careless?
Xu Shiyan taught seriously, and Han Wenzhong listened carefully.
Know what to do by heart, and then follow what Xu Shiyan taught until you are proficient.
One morning, Guang taught how to use the ground gun, but failed to install a few.
At noon, Han Wenzhong and his son cooked a lot of delicious food, and prepared wine for Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to drink too much, he only drank two cups, and he still has to work in the afternoon, how can he work in a daze after drinking too much?
That's a ground gun, if something goes wrong, it's too late to regret it.
Xu Shiyan didn't go down the mountain that night, but lived directly on the mountain, but had a good time drinking with Han Wenzhong and his son.
It took two days to install everything on the side of the first branch, and put up the warning signs.
Xu Shiyan went down the mountain after completing the task. Before leaving, Han Wenzhong and his son made an agreement with Xu Shiyan that they would go to drink with Xu Shiyan when they went down the mountain in winter.
Next, Xu Shiyan went to the second breakout and taught the people there how to install the ground gun.
By the time he finishes his work, it will already be August 16th.
"Daughter-in-law, let's go back to the big house tomorrow, I asked for leave from the team.
The fifth son should go to Tonghua to study in a few days, and the fourth daughter-in-law has already given birth to a child.
I've been busy all this time, so I didn't have time to go back. Let's take advantage of the lack of things in the team these days and go back. "
At this time, the corn and beans in the field are almost grown, just waiting for the autumn harvest.
The ginseng seedlings grow quite tall in the ginseng field, and there is no need to weed and loosen the soil. The frozen ginseng seeds have been pinched two days ago.
When Xu Shiyan went to ask for leave, he heard from Yu Shouguang that the ginseng seeds of the fifty feet topdressed with bean cake water were particularly good, and the seeds were large and plump.
The ginseng soil has also been planed and left to dry in the sun. It will be enough to dig the soil in a few days.
Xu Shiyan planned to take advantage of this gap and hurry back to the big house to have a look.
Xu Shixiang's admission notice arrived a while ago, and it was indeed Tonghua Agricultural School.
Xu Haiyang, the eldest son of Xu Shide's family, was born on the 23rd day of the sixth month of the lunar calendar, that is, the third day after Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan returned home after spending 100 days with Xu Haiyuan.
The other side of the big house had already sent someone to send a message, but Xu Shiyan was staring at the industry at that time, and couldn't get away, so how could he have time to go back?
This time it’s over, so why don’t Xu Shiyan ask for leave to go back and have a look?
"Oh, by the way, this is a reward from the commune and the team, you can keep it."
As Xu Shiyan said, he dug out some things from his pocket.
This time, both the team and the commune made a small fortune with the pickaxe for digging the soil. Later, it was known to the county, and the county immediately wanted to leave the design.
It is said that the county hardware factory produced another batch, and it is not known where it was sold.
Anyway, the commune and the team felt that this was Xu Shiyan's idea, and it didn't mean that it was not good, so they gave some prizes.
In this year, the so-called rewards are just that.
Big tea mugs, towels, soap boxes, and mirrors are all practical things.
The county is even more picky, and there are no real objects, so some tickets are given.
Xu Shiyan looked through it, and there are watch tickets and radio tickets, all of which are in short supply.
It’s okay, it’s all useful, even if you don’t use it, it’s still a favor to give it away.
"Okay, let's go back if you say so." Su Anying put the things together and put them away with a smile.
"The fifth child is admitted to university, you, as an older brother, shouldn't you mean it?
And the fourth child, shall we buy something or give money? "
There is a happy event at the relatives and friends' home, so we have to join in the fun. One of my own brothers is going to college, and the other has children. How can the elder brother not lose money?
Back when Su Anying gave birth to Xu Haiyuan, although Xu Shide and his wife didn't come, they asked Xu Chenghou to bring things and money, and Xu Shixiang also bought things for Xiaowa.
Human relations are called exchanges when there are back and forth.
Between brothers, even if they are separated, they are not enemies. They should move around, otherwise, wouldn’t they be more and more divided?
"Well, let the fifth one give the money, and go out and buy what he lacks. The Tonghua side has everything, and what we buy may not necessarily be what we want.
On the fourth side, according to what they gave us at that time, let’s add some more as you see.
I'm an elder brother anyway, don't be so stingy and make people laugh. " Xu Shiyan thought for a while and said.
The couple reached a consensus, then Xu Shiyan went to clean up and wash up, came back to coax his son to play, and Su Anying went to cook.
After a hundred days, Xu Haiyuan is more interesting than before.
The little guy was quite solid, and when he was happy, he turned over and lay on the kang with his little head raised, looking at Xu Shiyan with a smile, while his two little hands were still patting the kang mat excitedly.
Xu Shiyan didn't hug his son, instead he squatted in front of the kang, met his son's eyes, then ducked down and hid.
The little boy didn’t understand. When he saw that his father was gone, he stretched his neck to look for him. He was still young and couldn’t crawl, so he screamed anxiously.
"Cat." Xu Shiyan straightened up suddenly, and appeared in front of Xu Haiyuan again, deliberately teasing him.
Now, Xu Haiyuan became happy, grinning happily, giggling.
"Isn't it fun? Do you want another one?"
When Xu Shiyan saw his son smiling, all the exhaustion from his body disappeared. This little guy is so much fun.
I don’t know if Xu Haiyuan understood, anyway, right now he started yelling, as if urging Xu Shiyan to play again.
This time, Xu Shiyan didn't squat down anymore, he pulled the pillow towel casually, covered his face, and then put it down again. "Cat."
Sure enough, the little guy laughed again.
Xu Shiyan tried every means to coax his son to play in the house. The father and son made fun of each other and had a great time playing.
As a result, Xu Shiyan forgot to urinate again, but this time he didn't urinate on him. Xu Haiyuan's clothes, trousers, and quilt on the kang were all wet.
"Daughter-in-law, I was wrong, I really didn't mean it."
Xu Shiyan hugged his son, stood in front of the kang and watched his daughter-in-law remove the quilt, apologizing and admitting his mistake sincerely.
"Come on, I already knew that it's useless to count on you.
It has been said hundreds of times, to coax children to remember to pee, but you just don’t listen and always forget. "
Su Anying didn't believe this a long time ago, Xu Shiyan did this every time, and promised to be good, but when he became crazy with his son, he forgot everything.
Xu Shiyan lowered his head and stared at the son in his arms, "Son, your mother is angry with us, what should we do?"
How does Xu Haiyuan know that? He thought his father was playing with him, so he giggled again, and kept waving his little hands, dancing happily.
Xu Shiyan lowered his head and lightly touched his son's forehead, "You idiot, you don't understand anything.
Hey, this is the best time in your life, when you are carefree and don’t have to worry about anything.
Eat and sleep when you are full, eat when you are full, cry when you are unhappy, and laugh when you are happy, no one is as comfortable as you. "
Xu Haiyuan didn't understand those things, he just thought it was interesting to hit the forehead, and he was shaking his head and wanted to do another one with Xu Shiyan.
How dare Xu Shiyan? It's good to think about it, if the son is touched and cried again, can the wife forgive him?
"Well, just play for a while, don't be dissatisfied, or your mother will be very angry."
Xu Shiyan said while winking at Su Anying, then laughed and carried his son outside to play.

chapters.title: Chapter 147: the dog died
chapters.content:
Chapter 147 The dog is dead
Thursday, August 17th, Xu Shiqin does not rest, but there are few clothes to be made in summer, so it does not matter to ask for a day off.
So after having dinner in the morning, the three of them pushed Xu Haiyuan as before, went to Songjianghe store to buy some things, and then went back to the big house.
Xu Shide originally taught in the Qingling Brigade, but before the summer vacation, Daying Commune notified him to transfer him to Daying Central Primary School.
So taking advantage of the summer vacation and Wu Qiuyan's confinement again, Xu Shide retired the house in Qingling and temporarily moved back to the big house.
Waiting for school to start, he first went to Daying Commune to settle down, and Wu Qiuyan also moved there after confinement.
Wu Qiuyan was confinement in the east room and north kang, Zhou Guilan took care of her attentively, and both mother and child were well-raised.
The three of Xu Shiyan went back and brought thirty eggs, one catty of brown sugar, two catties of dried noodles, and two pieces of cloth to Wu Qiuyan and Xiaowa.
It was a bit more than what the fourth and fourth couple gave, but not too much.
"Old Five, this is a watch ticket, and this is twenty yuan.
When you go out to study, I won’t buy anything for you. Go to school to see what is missing, and go buy it yourself. "
Xu Shiyan took out money and tickets, and gave them to the fifth child.
Giving money to the fifth child this time is different from the money that Xu Shiyan gave to the family when the fourth child married a wife last time.
The last time it was for the family, mainly to help parents.
Besides, at that time, he was the only one who passed the branch, so he gave more and gave less, and Xu Shixian and others did not compare.
After all, the money earned by Xu Shixian and his brothers is also with their parents, and it does not belong to them.
It's different now, the brothers are separated.
The fifth child goes to college, if Xu Shiyan gives more, will the other brothers give it or not? How much?
Others are not as well-founded as Xu Shiyan, and they will be unhappy by then.
Twenty yuan, no more, no less, those brothers can afford it, and no one will be careless.
"Oh, third brother, where did you find the watch ticket? I've been searching everywhere for a while, but I can't find it."
Watches are considered big items these days, so they are not easy to search for.
In the past, Xu Chenghou used to ask someone to find a relationship several years in advance for the engagement and marriage of his sons, and it took a lot of effort to get it.
"The county rewarded it a while ago. I have a watch. This ticket is just right for you."
When Xu Shiyan got married, the Xu family also gave Su Anying a watch.
Most of the watches at this time were of the same type, and there were very few pure women’s watches, and even ordinary people would not buy them.
After getting married, Su Anying didn't wear it very much, so she gave it to Xu Shiyan.
"Third, what are you doing again? The county rewarded you?"
When Xu Shiyan said this, the brothers became curious and came over to ask.
Xu Shiyan told his family about the pickaxe.
Everyone suddenly realized that the twenty big pickaxes that the team got back a while ago were actually poked out by Xu Shiyan.
"We've all heard about this. It seems that Donggang Commune has made a fortune this time. It's been a long time since the commotion was due to my third brother."
Xu Shian patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and laughed.
"If Hu Liancheng finds out about this, his nose might turn crooked. He kicked out the third brother, but in the end he didn't lose any of the benefits, but instead lost a lot of money."
Xu Shixiang suddenly thought of this, thought it was quite funny, and laughed too.
Reminded by Xu Shixiang, everyone also thought about it and laughed along.
"It deserves it, who told him not to be kind?
Run on the third child, squeeze the third child away, thinking that his relatives can take advantage of going to see Shen, but what happened?
A few days after Li Qiang went up the mountain, his ground gun collapsed. Li Ming and Li Gang went up to look at the ginseng again, and went into the mountain to hunt.
Brought a few dogs into the mountain and met Hei Xiazi, who scratched him and killed three dogs. "
On the other end, Xu Chenghou snorted with disdain. "Do you really think it's so easy to see ginseng hunting? Cut, let's have a sweet dream."
"Father, you said that Li Ming and Li Gang were scratched by a black blind man when he entered the mountain. When did it happen? Why didn't I hear about it?" Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard it.
Brother Li Ming's death has nothing to do with him, but those dogs are all good, it's a pity to die.
"Just two days ago. Isn't this Red Hammer City? A group of people in the village remembered that you released the mountain last year.
I just wanted to go into the mountains and wander around. If I'm lucky, I might meet a stick.
As a result, when I went into the mountain, I didn't meet the stick, but met a black blind man.
Then Li Ming hurried into the mountains with dogs and guns, saying that he was going to fight black and blind people. "
Xu Chenghou sighed and told his son what happened recently.
"Li Ming and Li Gang took the five dogs in the field and entered the mountain with two guns.
I don’t know what they did. They were scratched by the black blind man and almost died. Of the five dogs, only two flower dogs were left.
The head dog Rhubarb, the **** Dahei, and the blue dog are all gone.
Alas, these bastards, they can really do harm to them. The three good dogs are blind for nothing. "
Xu Chenghou couldn't help but start cursing at the end of his speech.
"You haven't seen Uncle Li and Aunt Li. They knew the dog was dead, and Uncle Li cried to tears." On the other end, Xu Shi'an continued.
The five dogs were all raised by Mr. Li, and Mrs. Mrs. Li also helped to feed them every winter, and they had a deep relationship.
When they learned that the dog had died, the old couple felt distressed and didn't eat for two days.
Xu Shiyan felt a pain in his heart when he heard the words, it's a pity that those good dogs were blind for nothing.
"Dad, I remember you told me last time, it seems that the black dog has a cub? Did it have a cub?"
When Xu Haiyuan was a hundred days old, Xu Chenghou mentioned that the black dog on the mountain had brought a cub, and Xu Shiyan was still thinking about asking his father to help him with a puppy.
"Down, Dahei had just let Li Ming bring his cub into the mountain less than 20 days after he gave birth.
Alas, it’s a pity for those puppies, their mothers are gone, and there is no milk to feed them. I don’t know if they can feed them. "
Xu Shian knows this matter best.
"Brother Li is injured and is still living in the commune hospital.
Those **** are left unattended. Uncle Li asked us to bring them back. They are all raised by Uncle Li now. "
In this day and age, most families don't have much food left over and can't afford a dog.
Furthermore, that son of a **** is not yet full moon, so he is too young to be taken care of, and he will die if he fails, so no one in the village cares about him.
Old Li couldn't bear it, so he had to ask someone to help him, bring him back the pup, and he kept it.
Old Litou has been watching on the mountain for many years, and the first few dogs were brought up by Lao Litou's own hunting dogs.
In these years, dogs gave birth to dogs, and with the addition of people from other places, the later Dog Gang came into existence.
It's a pity that two of them were killed by the beard medicine last year, and three of them were destroyed by Brother Li Ming.
Old Li asked for the remaining two big dogs, but the team refused to give them. They only gave Lao Li the few puppies that were left unattended.
"Hey, so is Old Li, stubborn, you said he is so virtuous now, why does he still have a dog? Can he afford it?" Xu Chenghou sighed.
"Father, Mom, let's talk first, I'll go see Uncle Li." Xu Shiyan's heart moved, and he immediately got up and went out.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: brat
chapters.content:
Chapter 148 Puppy
Xu Shiyan trotted all the way to Li's house in the west of the village. As soon as he entered the door, he heard the sound of the little puppy barking in the house. Xu Shiyan knew immediately that the puppy was hungry.
"Uncle Li, Auntie, are you all at home?" Xu Shiyan asked as he walked into the house.
Old Mrs. Li came out of the east room, and she was both surprised and happy when she saw Xu Shiyan.
"Oh, when did San'er come back?"
"Ma'am, I just got home not long ago, so I came over to see how Uncle Li is doing."
Xu Shiyan smiled at old Mrs. Li, and followed them into the east room.
Old Litou can sit up now, and sits on the kang with a pillow behind him.
A sack was spread on the ground, and four puppies were lying on it, two with yellow fur and two with black fur. You could tell at a glance that they were Rhubarb's children.
"Hey, my uncle's body is obviously getting stronger, and he can sit up? That's great."
Xu Shiyan looked at it, and found that Old Li's complexion was not bad, or else, the old man's body is really good.
Cerebral hemorrhage is such a serious illness, with the current medical conditions, Lao Li can still get better little by little, all thanks to his good physique.
"Yo, Saner, hurry up, sit down, sit down and talk."
Old Li's speech was obviously stronger than before. When he saw Xu Shiyan, he greeted him very kindly to sit down.
Xu Shiyan sat on the edge of the kang next to Lao Li's head, and looked at the dogs on the ground.
"Master, what's going on here? Why are you raising dogs again? These puppies don't look like they're full moon, how are you raising them?"
"Oh, San'er, don't mention it. I will make you, Uncle Li, sad to death.
You said how can our family afford a dog with this condition? Even if the full moon is over, we can't afford it, let alone this one without the full moon.
I'm really worried, feeding rice soup doesn't work, the pup is so hungry that he babbles. "Not waiting for Old Li to speak, Aunt Li spoke first.
"Rhubarb, Dahei, and Daqing were brought up the mountain by Li Ming and Li Gang brothers, and it was a disaster for the blind man.
No one in the team is willing to support the remaining litter of puppies, so Uncle Ni insists on coming.
What do you think our family can do? I'm busy enough to take care of you, Uncle Li, all day long, and I can't take care of you at all. "
Old Mrs. Li probably had nowhere to confide in. When she saw Xu Shiyan, she complained to him.
As a result, as soon as he said this, Old Li, who was sitting on the kang, burst into tears.
"My rhubarb and **** were raised from childhood, and they just disappeared.
I, I have to feed their cubs anyway. "
The old man has no children and lives with his wife. Those dogs are just like his sons.
Now that the dog is gone, he has no choice but to have these bastards.
Xu Shiyan looked at Old Li, then at the puppies on the ground, and sighed.
"Uncle Li, if you trust me, can you sell these puppies to me?
There are cows and sheep in our team. I can find a way to get milk and goat milk, so I can feed these dogs. "
The second brigade has a strong family background, which is much stronger than Dongjiangyan. It not only raises large animals, but also a flock of sheep.
Xu Shiyan got along very well with the people in the second brigade. If the person in charge of the barn asked for some milk and goat milk, or simply borrowed a sheep to go home, it shouldn't be difficult for him.
These puppies have been around for twenty days, and they only need to be fed for another ten days, and they can eat in the future, and they can feed without breastfeeding.
Rhubarb and Dahei are both good dogs, and their cubs are not bad either.
Xu Shiyan originally wanted to raise two dogs, but he couldn't find a good one.
Seeing these four little guys now reminds me of the time I took the dog into the mountains last winter.
Da Huang and Da Hei's children, no matter what happens, he has to raise them.
"Master and aunt, I didn't bring much money back today, only fifty yuan, don't think it's too little, both of you."
As Xu Shiyan said, he took out five cards of Great Unity and was about to stuff them into Old Li.
How can Old Li want Xu Shiyan's money? Quickly wave your hands. "Don't, don't, we men can't talk about money.
San’er, if you like them, then take them all away. I believe you, you are a dog lover, and you will definitely be able to raise them well. "
Old Li said, tears came down again, he was really afraid that he would not be able to take care of the dogs, and these **** would die.
Xu Shiyan knows how to hunt, but all good hunters are rare dogs, and treat dogs like their lives.
The pup can only be taken care of carefully in the hands of such a person.
"Master, don't worry, I will take good care of these dogs." Xu Shiyan solemnly assured the old couple.
"Yes, I believe you. Old woman, find something, put this puppy on it, and let San'er take it away. We can't afford them, but San'er can do it."
Old Li was very reluctant to give up, but he had no choice but to ask the old woman to find someone to pretend to be a dog.
Xu Shiyan stuffed the money behind the pillow while Lao Li was not paying attention.
Old Mrs. Li went outside, found an old carrying basket, spread a piece of broken sack in the basket, and then put the four puppies into the basket one by one.
The puppy woke up as soon as it moved its place, and started whining again.
Old Mrs. Li seemed a little bit reluctant, and raised her hand to pat the heads of the puppies one by one, "Go, find a good place for you, don't starve to death here."
"Ma'am, don't worry, I will take good care of them." Xu Shiyan looked at the four puppies with thick heads and brains, and liked them very much. When they grow up, they will be good hunting dogs in the future.
Old Mrs. Li sighed and waved her hand, "Take it away, your uncle and I can trust you, this dog is in your hands, and it will definitely grow into a big yellow and **** dog."
Xu Shiyan took the basket, chatted with the old couple of the Li family, and left the Li family with the dog, heading straight to the east of the village.
As for Mrs. Li and Mrs. Li, they didn't find out the fifty yuan at night, but Xu Shiyan left early, so they could only keep the money.
"Ah, puppies, there are several puppies, they look so pretty."
As soon as Xu Shiyan entered the yard with the basket, Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu all surrounded them, looking curiously at the puppies in the basket.
"Puppy is too young, you can only look at it now, not touch it."
The elders say that kittens and dogs are not easy to touch, and they are easy to get angry and get sick.
Especially these puppies are not yet full moon. If they are in the hands of children, they will rub them to death in a short while, so Xu Shiyan specifically warned them.
The children were well-behaved, no one touched them, they just looked at the sleeping pup in the basket with surprise and excitement, and followed Xu Shiyan into the house happily.
"Grandpa, grandma, my third uncle picked up several dogs."
Xu Jinxiu rushed into the room and said, in the child's heart, such a small dog must have been picked up.
"Third son, you went out in a hurry just because of these puppies? They are so small, how do you take them home to support them?"
Xu Chenghou stretched out his head to take a look, all right, the four puppies are brought back, who can afford them?
"Dad, don't be afraid, I have a way to feed them, don't worry."
When I was young, I went to ask for some milk and goat milk to feed. When I was older, the corn noodles were cooked, and some potatoes and pumpkins were added to it, so I could always feed myself.
The harvest of the Second Brigade is not bad this year, and his family has a small population, so there must be enough food to feed the dogs.
Readers have been asking, how can the author add updates, alas, let alone add updates, now five updates every day, the author spends a lot of time saving the manuscript and bites the bullet to update it.
The author has neurasthenia, sleep disorders, heart problems, and high blood lipids. Anyway, he is not very old, and the problems are not old or young.
I can't sleep well at night, and I feel dizzy and flustered during the day, so I can only take some tranquilizing medicine to help me sleep. But after taking these medicines, I feel dizzy and want to sleep during the day, because something is wrong anyway.
When the state is good, you can write five chapters a day, but when the state is not good, you can only write two chapters and three chapters. I have saved a few manuscripts for free, and they are almost squandered by me.
It’s not that I don’t want a monthly pass, there’s no way to add a new one, and I’m embarrassed to ask for it if I’m unreasonable. For the time being, let’s just watch it at the fifth shift of the day. One day I will destroy all the manuscripts saved, so I can only write as much as I want, just follow the fate, hehe.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: red hammer city
chapters.content:
Chapter 149 Red Hammer City
Xu Shiyan said that he could support him, so it was difficult for others to say anything else.
Zhou’s house had a north-south kang, and the house was hot, so Xu Shiyan put the four puppies into the barn.
The children are all staring at the freshness, how can they be willing to leave? So one by one they gathered in the barn and wandered around the puppies.
The children were watching the dogs outside, and the adults were sitting and chatting in the shade of the yard.
The brothers haven’t seen each other for some time, but we have a lot to talk about together.
Xu Shiyan rarely asked about Xu Shixiang's going to school and Xu Shide's job transfer, but Xu Shixian and the others were more concerned about how Xu Shiyan was doing in Donggang.
Now that the Dongjiang River is full of smog, the hearts of the big guys have long been lost, and they all want to move out.
Xu Shiyan still has the same attitude. Brothers can move out if they want to, each depends on his ability, and he has no choice.
He has just gained a foothold in the second brigade, and he is not that capable of taking away all the members of this big family, so he can't settle down.
Father, son and brothers were chatting outside, and in the kitchen, Zhou Guilan led his daughter-in-law and daughter to cook.
Xu Shiqin bought all her meat tickets for this month and brought back the meat. There are also a lot of vegetables in the vegetable garden at this time, and she can get several vegetables by just scratching, without worrying at all.
Zhou Guilan specially cooked some rice soup for Xu Shiyan to feed the puppy.
Those puppies were probably hungry, and they didn’t like rice soup, and drank a lot.
At noon, the big guys got together and had a meal happily.
Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming and others knew that Xu Shiyan was back, so they all ran over and sat down for a while, chatting with Xu Shiyan.
"Third brother, can you stay at home for a few days? Let's go to the mountains together?"
Others were hesitant to speak, but Zhao Jianshe was blunt, didn't think too much, and asked directly.
When Zhao Jianshe asked this question, let alone Yang Chunming, even Xu Shixian and the others looked at Xu Shiyan expectantly.
Last year, Xu Shiyan met several clubs, and Yang Chunming and the others shared a lot of money.
Who thinks there is too much money? In fact, they are all thinking about releasing mountains, but it is difficult to open their mouths.
"No, I just took a day off, so I can't go into the mountains with you." Xu Shiyan shook his head.
"I'm not from Dongjiangyan anymore. If I bring people into the mountains and let the people in the village know about it, I'll have to cause some trouble again. It's not good."
Actually, Xu Shiyan was also thinking about the sticks under the lazier, but now is really not the time.
He came back with his wife and children. If he went into the mountain, his family would definitely not be able to hide it.
Don’t take the brothers with you, they are not happy, and the parents are also upset.
Lead the brothers, the wild ginseng under the lazi is equivalent to the root.
Even if the brothers listen to him now and won’t poach all of them, what about in the future?
Who is not jealous when seeing money? It is estimated that when Xu Shiyan walks on the front foot, these few on the back foot will be able to dig out all the sticks.
How to say, Xu Shiyan also has selfish intentions, the price of wild ginseng is low now, it is really not worthwhile to dig out the real ones.
He intends to use that platform as a secret ginseng base, and he will go there when it is really useful in the future.
So, let’s continue to hide the secret. If he doesn’t mention it, others will never know.
When Xu Shiyan said this, everyone was a little frustrated, but there was nothing they could do.
"Hey, you said it would be great if the third brother didn't move away? We brothers can make some money together with the mountains and hunting." Zhao Jianshe sighed with great regret.
It's useless to be emotional, Xu Shiyan should go or have to go.
At two o'clock in the afternoon, the weather was not so hot. Xu Shiyan, his wife, sister, son and dog, set off to return to Donggang.
I carried some things when I came, but when I left, a basket collapsed, and there were four puppies in the basket.
The four little guys drank a lot of rice soup at noon, and there was something in their stomachs, but they didn't make much noise, so they just slept all the way back to Donggang.
As soon as he returned home, Xu Shiyan settled his wife and son, and immediately went to the brigade's barn to find Lao Feng, who raised the cattle.
"Uncle Feng, I have something to ask for your help."
Xu Shiyan has moved here for more than half a year, and he gets along well with everyone in the team. Lao Feng, who raises livestock, and his son have a good relationship with Xu Shiyan.
Old Feng also took good care of Xu Shiyan. Whenever Xu Shiyan needed to borrow animals for something, Lao Feng was very happy.
"Just tell me what's going on, why are you being polite to Uncle Feng?"
Old Feng laughed when he saw Xu Shiyan. He didn't know what Xu Shiyan was asking for, so he agreed directly.
"Uncle, that's what happened, and I have four puppies.
The **** went into the mountain the day before yesterday and was killed by Xiong Xiazi, and the pup was not yet full moon.
I am thinking about whether I want some milk or goat milk from you, and I will go back to feed the dog. "
Old Feng didn't see him, Xu Shiyan didn't hesitate, and directly explained his purpose.
"Hey, I still think it's something important, isn't it just feeding the puppies?
In this way, I will bring you a ewe. Isn’t there a small hill behind your house? You tied it up on the back mountain and raised it. Aren't you afraid you won't be able to feed the four puppies? "
The second brigade has more than one hundred sheep, half of which are ewes, and there are quite a few cubs that produce milk, so just take one away.
"Just wait, I'll take it for you." Old Feng was quick to do things, and went to fetch the sheep without saying a word.
Not long after, a big ewe was brought in. I don't know where he got the lamb, so he handed the ewe to Xu Shiyan anyway.
Xu Shiyan thanked Lao Feng, took the sheep home, tied the sheep to the barn, and taught the puppy how to drink goat milk.
The puppies haven’t had milk for several days, and they are very happy to eat now. Fortunately, the sheep has a big body and produces a lot of milk, which is enough to feed four puppies.
"Daughter-in-law, during the day tomorrow, you tie the sheep to the hillside to let them graze, and come back every few hours to feed the dogs.
These dogs will be weaned after feeding them for more than ten days. "
Xu Shiyan saw that the pups were eating well, so he was relieved, and turned around to give Su Anying a few words.
Xu Shiyan has to go up the mountain to work during the day, how can he have time to watch the sheep and dogs at home.
The couple finished watching the puppies, and were about to go back to the house to cook, when they heard footsteps outside, and turned their heads to see that it was Sun Xiaofeng, Huang Shengli, and Feng Chao.
"Why are you here at this time? Have you eaten? It just so happens that your sister-in-law is going to cook, why don't you stay and eat together?"
Xu Shiyan is very familiar with these people, and they often go to the mountains to work together and engage in side jobs together, so they don't see each other, so they turn around and ask Su Anying to cook a few more dishes.
"Brother Xu, don't make sister-in-law work hard, let's go home and eat later." Huang Shengli waved his hand.
"The few of us came to you, mainly to ask Brother Xu, do you want to go into the mountains with us to release the mountains?"
Red Hammer City is the best season to release mountains.
Everyone has a dream of getting rich, but everyone in the mountains, who doesn’t dream of going into the mountains to dig a big stick and sell it for thousands of dollars to live a good life?
At this time, there is not much work in the field and the ginseng land, and the ginseng soil cannot be harvested for the time being. It is a good time to release the mountains.
Huang Shengli and the others couldn't sit still for a long time, and they came to find Xu Shiyan several times today.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, what's wrong? Come to him today to release the mountain?
"Can it work? Our captain can let me go?"
It would be a lie to say that Xu Shiyan is not moved. He also wants to earn more money.
Next year, I plan to build a house, and I also need to treat my younger sister. Which one does not cost money?

chapters.title: Chapter 150: fox dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 150 Jackal
"Then what is there not to allow? The people in our commune, every year around this time, gang up and go up the mountain.
We have a temper with Brother Xu, so we want to find you together. "
Fangshan, most of them are looking for a partner who gets along with each other on weekdays. Like Xu Shiyan last year, he was simply forced to help.
Although Xu Shiyan has not been in Donggang for a long time, he has made a lot of friends.
Before, they gathered Niu Maoguang together and planed Gastrodia elata together, and they both felt that they were very compatible, so this time they came to Xu Shiyan again.
"You all said that, then go ahead and find the candidate. Everyone knows the rules of letting go of the mountains. You want to be single or not double.
It’s best to know how to ride a bicycle. If we want to go, we can go a little farther. I don’t think we have a share in the nearby places. "
It would be nonsense to say that Xu Shiyan is not tempted. Since everyone wants to go, let's go into the mountains together, and we will meet if we don't get together.
When everyone heard that Xu Shiyan agreed, they were all very happy, so they negotiated and decided to go up the mountain the day after tomorrow, which is the 16th day of the seventh lunar month.
After the discussion, those few hurried home to prepare things.
Xu Shiyan also hurriedly cooked and ate, and then rummaged through the boxes to find all kinds of tools and clothes for Fangshan.
The next day is July 15th, the Hungry Ghost Festival. At this time, it is not allowed to go to the grave to burn paper. Besides, the Xu family has no ancestors here, so there is no need to pay homage.
So Xu Shiyan was resting at home to coax the children this day, and Su Anying happened to have the opportunity to cut a lot of beans, eggplants, and cucumbers to dry.
This is the case in Zhuanghuyuan. The summer sun-dried vegetables are good for winter and spring.
After the beginning of autumn, the weather is dry, and the dried vegetables are not easy to mold and grow hairs.
Usually, Su Anying wants to coax the children, so she can only take the opportunity to cut less. This time, with Xu Shiyan's help, Su Anying cut a lot, and the west yard is all over the floor.
The sun is very good. After one day, those vegetables will be half dry.
In the evening, Xu Shiyan helped to pack everything up, and after drying it the next day, it was almost ready to be put away.
In the early morning of July 16th, Xu Shiyan, Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng, Feng Chao, and Zhou Qingguo.
Five people, each carrying sixty to seventy kilograms of luggage, set off from Donggang on a bicycle and walked eight kilometers to Baixi Forest Farm to the protected area.
Changbai Mountain Nature Reserve was established in 1960 and is divided into general protection area and absolute protection area.
The management of protected areas is not so strict these days, and outsiders are generally allowed to enter protected areas.
It was not until after 1982 that the general protected area and the absolute protected area were abolished and set up for unified management. After the management regulations were promulgated in 1988, strict management was implemented.
From Donggang to the protected area, Xu Shiyan chose the shortest road, which is still 70 to 80 kilometers away.
In this year and month, there are all firewood roads, which are incomparable with the cement roads and asphalt roads of later generations. It lasted until after two o'clock in the afternoon, and finally arrived at the scheduled location.
Xu Shiyan visited Maanshan Forest Farm for several years in his previous life, and went to the mountain every year, so he is very familiar with the vicinity of the reserve.
The familiar road led everyone to enter from a forest path, and found a sunny hillside.
When you arrive at the place, you still first set up the master's mansion, then build a shack and collect firewood.
Xu Shiyan was chopping wood with an ax when he suddenly saw something and ran over not far away.
That thing has brown-red fur, looks like a wolf, but is smaller than a wolf, with a few tufts of black hairs on the tip of its tail, has a thin waist and short legs, and is quick to move.
"What just ran over?"
Among them, Zhou Qingguo was the only one who had never been in the mountains before. He left as a soldier when he was eighteen. He came back last winter. How could he have a chance to go into the mountains?
So when he saw something running past, Zhou Qingguo wanted to chase it.
"Qinguo, you don't want to die, dare to chase it?" Xu Shiyan hurriedly called Zhou Qingguo to stop.
"Do you know what it is? Do you dare to chase after it rashly?"
As soon as Zhou Qingguo heard Xu Shiyan's words, he knew something was wrong.
"Was that a wolf or a fox just now?" Zhou Qingguo asked uncertainly.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "It's not a wolf or a fox.
That thing, don’t look at its small size, even the ancestors of wild beasts in the mountains, tigers, leopards, bears, and pigs are afraid of it.
If a hunter brings a dog into the mountains and dares to provoke it, even the dog and man will be finished. "
"Huh? What is so powerful?"
Over there, Feng Chao and Sun Xiaofeng were also dumbfounded when they heard this. They had never heard of this kind of animal before.
It is Huang Shengli, the grandfather and father of the family can hunt, and the old man in the family has said it, so he knows what it is.
"Brother Xu, are you talking about jackals?"
"Yes, that's the thing." Xu Shiyan nodded.
Jackal, the name of the local people, is actually a jackal, and people in the mountains also call it a red wolf.
Jackals are smaller than wolves, but their sense of smell, hearing, and vision are sharper than wolves. They are quick in action and good at running. They are the enemies of many animals in the mountains.
This thing is very cunning, relying on its own quickness, it jumps onto the opponent's back like a gust of wind, grabs the opponent's neck like a pincer, and bites the throat fiercely.
No matter how strong the beast is, it will not be able to break free until its throat is bitten off.
Everyone in the mountains knows the temper of jackals, so no one dares to provoke it, so it is rare to hear of jackals hurting people.
After listening to Xu Shiyan's explanation, Zhou Qingguo heaved a sigh of relief, "Fortunately, I didn't catch up just now, otherwise it would be quite dangerous."
Zhou Qingguo went up the mountain with a gun, not for hunting, but for self-defense.
Just now he was just curious for a while, but when he thought about it now, it was fortunate that he didn't follow up impulsively after hearing Xu Shiyan's words, otherwise it would be really awkward.
"When you enter the mountain, you have to abide by the rules of the mountain, even if you are carrying a gun, that is not acceptable.
We are here to free the mountains, not to hunt, not to be in danger, and not to provoke animals. "
There are many rules in the mountains, and the emphasis is on the harmonious coexistence between man and nature. Most people do not go hunting when they enter the mountains.
Unless you have been in the mountains for too long and have nothing to eat, there is no way, most of them are setting traps to catch roe deer or something.
"Hey, I see, Uncle Third, I will follow your orders." Zhou Qingguo nodded repeatedly.
For a person like him who has never let go of mountains, it would be nice to be able to take him with him. He doesn't dare to talk about it, it's better to be obedient.
Several people speeded up their actions, quickly set up the floor, and built a fire outside at night.
Several people sat around the fire, eating and chatting while warming the fire.
Chatting until after eight o'clock in the evening, Xu Shiyan asked everyone to go back to rest.
"Have a good dream tonight, tell me about your dream tomorrow morning."
According to the rules handed down by the elders, Fangshanren’s dream is not for nothing, there are all kinds of sayings.
Many people followed the guidance of dreams to find the club, so Xu Shiyan would tell everyone that.
The shack was covered with grass and roe deer skin mattresses. Xu Shiyan fell asleep not long after lying down.
In the deep mountains and old forests, from time to time, some wild beasts could be heard, especially wolves, whose breath was soft and loud, and the movement was really scary.
Sleeping until midnight, Xu Shiyan felt a smell of urine.
He felt strange and got up to check, only to see a shadow running away at high speed.
The shadow looked like it was the jackal I saw in the afternoon. Cooperate with the guy to pee nearby.

chapters.title: Chapter 151: Omen Suzhou Code
chapters.content:
Chapter 151 Omen Suzhou Code
According to the legend of the mountain people, this jackal is the patron saint of the mountain people.
Once upon a time, there was a young man who came from the east of the Guanguan. He went into the mountains to find a club by himself. He didn’t understand anything.
In the middle of the night, he saw a wolf-like thing guarding him.
The young man was so frightened that he drove the thing away, but the thing turned around and came back, not far from the young man, just sitting and looking at him.
Later, when the young man went down the mountain and talked about it with others, he realized that that thing was a jackal.
With it guarding, other animals dare not come forward, so the young man can go down the mountain safely.
Xu Shiyan didn't know whether the legend was true or not. Anyway, he would not provoke jackals. Seeing that there was nothing abnormal around him, he went back to sleep in the shack.
I don’t know if it’s a psychological effect, or if the jackals urinated. Anyway, in the middle of the night, I didn’t hear the wolves howling again, and everyone slept soundly.
Woke up early and had dinner, five people stood in a row and shouted Huangshan in unison.
Next, Xu Shiyan is the head stick, Huang Shengli is the side stick, and the other three are waist sticks.
Five people held rope sticks in their hands, lined up horizontally, and pressed the mountain in the direction pointed by Xu Shiyan.
Mountain pressing is a boring job, you can’t talk and chat, and you have to keep your eyes on the grass on the ground.
All orders are conveyed through the rope stick in the hand of the head stick.
Everyone came out in the morning until after ten o'clock, but there was nothing to gain.
Xu Shiyan tapped the tree twice with a rope stick, and everyone stopped to smoke and rest.
Zhou Qingguo came from a soldier background, so it was nothing to walk this far, so he found a dry place to sit down, took out cigarettes and distributed them to everyone.
"Third Uncle, would you like one?"
