Zhou Qingguo knew that Xu Shiyan didn't smoke on weekdays, but when he went into the mountains, there were many mosquitoes, so he smoked a cigarette to relieve his fatigue, and drove away the mosquitoes along the way.
Xu Shiyan took the cigarette, Zhou Qingguo took out a match and lit it for Xu Shiyan.
"Third Uncle, the mountain is so big, there are only five of us, how can we find the stick?"
Zhou Qingguo was a beginner, and it was his first time entering the mountains, so he didn't understand anything, so he just asked casually.
Xu Shiyan took a puff of his cigarette and was about to say something to Zhou Qingguo when he suddenly saw the place where Zhou Qingguo was sitting just now.
Suddenly dumbfounded, he hurriedly grabbed Zhou Qingguo who was about to sit down.
"The club." Xu Shiyan looked at the piece of grass that Zhou Qingguo had crushed, and shouted.
Everyone was taken aback for a moment, but they didn't realize it. They thought Xu Shiyan was scolding Zhou Qinguo.
Still, Huang Shengli had a quick mind, followed Xu Shiyan's gaze, and then hurriedly picked up the mountain.
"What product?" This is the same as asking how many leaves.
"The key to opening the mountain." It is Erjiazi.
Because Erjiazi has only two branches, like a key.
Let the mountain people enter the mountain. If you meet Erjiazi first, you are likely to meet big goods next. Therefore, Erjiazi is called the key to the mountain.
"Brother Xu, where is it? Why didn't we see it?"
Sun Xiaofeng and Feng Chao all leaned over and looked around, but they didn't see it at all.
Xu Shiyan inserted the cable stick into the ground, straightened the overwhelmed mallet seedling with his hands, found two more small sticks, and wrapped the mallet lock around the mallet seedling.
Now, everyone can see that this ginseng plant is not too big, with only two or three ginseng seeds on it, which is not conspicuous at all.
Zhou Qingguo didn't pay attention just now, and just sat down on his buttocks. If he hadn't brought out cigarettes to Xu Shiyan, Xu Shiyan would not have noticed.
Everyone came to their senses at this moment, and they didn't know who started it, so they laughed.
"Qingguo, Qingguo, you are really there. People say that the first child will have good luck. You are really good. You have a stick out of your ass.
Fortunately, you are still asking, where can you meet a mallet, and you are sitting on a tree under your buttocks. "
How did Zhou Qingguo expect such a thing to happen? Stretching out his hand and scratching his head, he laughed awkwardly there.
He really didn't see it, so he just found a place to sit down. How could he think that he would be so accurate when he sat down?
"Fortunately, you have good eyesight, otherwise we would have missed it." That's all Zhou Qingguo could say.
"Come on, don't blabber there.
Victory, you carry this ginseng. Xiaofeng, you go to the whole fire and help fumigate the mosquitoes while I wander around. "
Xu Shiyan felt that there should be Shen nearby, so he had to look around again.
Just like that, Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng, and Feng Chao stayed behind to carry the ginseng, while Xu Shiyan and Zhou Qingguo walked around the neighborhood together.
Walking and walking, Zhou Qingguo suddenly saw something. He didn't dare to speak nonsense, so he knocked on the trunk with a rope stick.
Xu Shiyan heard this, and leaned towards Zhou Qingguo, "What's wrong?"
"Third Uncle, do you think that is the old omen you mentioned?" Zhou Qinguo pointed to an old pine tree not far ahead.
I saw that it was one person high from the ground, a piece of bark was cut off, and something was carved on the exposed wood.
Xu Shiyan took a look, isn't it just an old sign? He hurriedly led Zhou Qingguo to the front.
Taking a closer look, the engraving on it is garbled characters, which is not an ordinary sign.
After all, Zhou Qingguo grew up in the forest area, so he knew a little about these things, but he couldn't understand the sign in front of him.
"Third Uncle, what is this? Why can't I understand it?"
General omens, the number of people is engraved on the left, several horizontal bars are engraved for several people, the growth years of ginseng are engraved on the right, and several horizontal bars are engraved for several leaves.
These things were told by the elders in the village since they were young, and most of them understood, but Zhou Qingguo couldn't understand this one in front of him.
"This engraved is the Suzhou code, also known as the flower code.
The people who got the big goods here didn’t want people to know the details, so they changed the sign and used the Suzhou code to engrave it. "
Xu Shiyan took a careful look at the marks on it, and it really was the Suzhou code.
Suzhou code, also called grass code and flower code, is an early folk commercial number.
A counting method separated from counting chips in the Southern Song Dynasty, mostly used for commercial bookkeeping.
This kind of code rarely appears in the Northeast. Xu Shiyan also heard about it when he was with Mr. Han in his previous life.
The Han family went through the darts back then and had contact with many merchants from the north and the south, so they understand this.
"The boss said that there were a total of nine of them, and they carried six leaves for one seedling, and five leaves for three seedlings.
Let me check the year, the second year of Xuantong, when did the second year of Xuantong come? The last emperor of the Qing Dynasty, right?
Oops, if you do the math, isn’t it sixty or seventy years old? "
Xu Shiyan's history is not very good, that is, he heard from storytelling that it seems that the last emperor's year name was Xuantong, that is to say, this omen is quite a long time.
"Come, Qingguo, come here, come with me, and kowtow to the old man of the mountain **** and the old seniors, let the old man bless us, and we can find a big stick near here."
In the early years, Fangshan people adhered to the rules of the mountain **** who left his head behind.
When you encounter a large shipment of ginseng, you should pick the ginseng seeds and scatter them around.
Try to leave a source of wealth for future generations, but cannot cut off the roots of children and grandchildren.
People in the past believed in these things and obeyed them piously, unlike later generations who wished they could have everything for themselves at once. Who cares about future generations?

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Liupinye
chapters.content:
Chapter 152 Liupinye
The old wild ginseng will produce ginseng seeds every year.
Even if no one sows it, the ginseng seeds are mature and blown off by the wind, or are eaten by birds and then excreted, they may take root and grow ginseng.
There were one seedling with six leaves and three seedlings with five leaves.
According to the rules of the ginseng collectors, it is estimated that there will be a lot of four leaves, lampstands or Erjiazi left at that time.
After so many years, maybe someone dug it away, or maybe no one found it, but there will definitely be ginseng around here.
The Miao Erjiazi I saw just now, it is very likely that the ginseng seeds of the big goods here have reproduced again.
Zhou Qingguo was very obedient, obediently followed Xu Shiyan, and kowtowed in front of the old omen.
Muttering words in his mouth to let the old man bless you, get rich when you meet a big guy, and bless you for safety.
This is not a feudal superstition, but an admiration for nature and a yearning for a better life.
The two stood up, Zhou Qingguo was at a loss, he didn't know where to look, so he could only ask Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan waved his hand to signal Zhou Qingguo not to speak. He looked around in a circle, and kept replaying the situation of those people pressing mountains to find ginseng in his mind.
"Let's go, follow me." Xu Shiyan signaled Zhou Qingguo to follow him, and the two walked eastward along the old sign, pushing aside the grass with a rope stick as they walked.
After walking less than fifty steps, Xu Shiyan saw a bright red ginseng seed in front of him, which was so big.
Looking down along the ginseng seeds, under the purple stalks, there are six palm-shaped compound leaves, swaying in the wind, as if waving at people.
"The club." Xu Shiyan shouted hastily.
"What product?" This time, Zhou Qingguo was smart and hurried to pick up the mountain.
"Liupinye." On the first day of entering the mountain, I met Liupinye, which is very rare.
Xu Shiyan was very happy, and turned to look at Zhou Qingguo.
It is said by the elders that wild ginseng is spiritual.
Aren’t there ginseng dolls and ginseng girls in the ginseng story? Legend has it that ginseng has spirits, can run, and can choose the age when it leaves the mountain.
Thus, the people who enter the mountain are not destined to be blessed, and most of them will not meet.
In his previous life, Zhou Qingguo was promoted from the security assistant of Donggang Commune to the deputy mayor of Donggang and the mayor of Songjianghe, and then took the cadre examination and was promoted to work in the city.
So, the first time this kid entered the mountain, he sat on a ginseng tree under his buttocks, and he also discovered the old sign.
Xu Shiyan has been here in his previous life, but he has never met the old sign, nor has he met ginseng here.
It can be said that someone came and poached it. It can also be said that it was not Xu Shiyan's chance, so he didn't meet him.
No matter whose chance it is, after all, this time, the few of them are considered to be fishing.
"Quickly, quickly." Zhou Qingguo continued to learn quickly.
Kuaidang means auspiciousness and auspiciousness, and it means celebration here.
"Qingguo, you stay here and watch, I will look for it further."
Xu Shiyan took the mallet lock from Zhou Qingguo's hand, marked the tree, and asked Zhou Qingguo to guard it here, and he continued to look for it.
Sure enough, at a distance of fifty or sixty steps to the east and south of this place, Xu Shiyan saw another five-pin leaf.
Search again, and find two Sipinye.
At this point, it is considered to be an end, even if there are still around, Xu Shiyan did not look for it.
It’s still the same sentence, to be a man is to be content, and how much food the mountain **** rewards is a certainty. Greed will cause accidents.
Xu Shiyan marked all the ginseng he found, and it happened that Huang Shengli over there also carried out the Erjiazi tree.
Everyone gathered together, looking at the Liupinye, the others were dumbfounded.
"Third brother, no wonder people say that if you follow you into the mountains, you can meet big goods. It seems true." Huang Shengli and others said with emotion.
Last year, the big house came out with big goods, and it has already spread all over the country.
Even if they didn't know it was Xu Shiyan before, everyone had heard about it when Xu Shiyan moved to Donggang.
Some people believe it, while others scoff at it.
Huang Shengli and others have spent a long time with Xu Shiyan, and they all feel that the rumors are reliable. Isn't this confirmed today?
"Don't, this time it has nothing to do with me, it's all about the Qing Dynasty, and we are all with the Qing Dynasty."
Xu Shiyan pointed at Zhou Qingguo with a smile, and when everyone heard this, they all laughed too.
"In this way, Shengli leads Xiaofeng and Chaozi, and you go back and bring the things from our shack.
The promotion of ginseng here cannot be completed in a day and a half. We have to sleep nearby. "
They came out from six o'clock in the morning to ten o'clock, even if they walked slowly over the mountains, they were still more than ten miles away from the shack.
It's so far away, I can't run back and forth, I have to stay near here, waiting for the few seedlings to be lifted out, and they go straight down the mountain.
"Hey, got it, Brother Xu, don't worry, we'll go back right away."
Now, Xu Shiyan does whatever he says, and everyone listens to him.
So, according to Xu Shiyan's instructions, Huang Shengli and Sun Xiaofeng went to move the things in the closet, and set up another closet here.
Zhou Qingguo was at the upper air outlet of Liupinye, holding a fire to drive away mosquitoes, while Xu Shiyan held a deer bone stick, pushed aside the soil bit by bit, and began to lift the ginseng.
This sixth-grade leaf tree looks not small, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to be careless, and carefully pulled the soil out.
I'm afraid that if a hand shakes, the skin of the mallet will be scratched, and the breath will be lost, then it will be worthless.
Huang Shengli and the others quickly moved everyone's things over, first set up the pots and stoves to cook, and then re-selected a place to build a house in the afternoon.
Others were busy, Xu Shiyan was responsible for carrying the ginseng, Zhou Qingguo stood nearby with a gun, and was in charge of vigilance, lest any wild beast came over and hurt people.
The six-pin leaves of the seedlings are not small, and they cannot be lifted out for a day, so everyone rests nearby at night.
I don't know if it was an illusion, but Xu Shiyan slept until midnight, feeling like he smelled urine again.
Fortunately, there are no wild animals at night, so everyone can feel more at ease, have a good rest at night, and get up to lift the ginseng at dawn.
Three days later, the four seedlings of ginseng were carried out. Among them, the seedling with six-pin leaves weighed about four taels and had a very beautiful shape.
The fifth-rank leaves of the seedlings are also growing well, there must be three or two halves.
Two seedlings and four leaves are smaller, two or two are heavy, and one tree is in poor shape. It is estimated that it will not sell for much money.
As for the Erjiazi tree, it’s a small tree, estimated to be about half a tael, and it has already been carried out, so you can’t dislike it, just pack it up and take it away.
The five of them packed up their things, took advantage of the dawn to find the place where the bicycles were locked, and then rode on the bicycles and walked all the way back.
"Brother Xu, why do I feel like I'm dreaming.
It takes a lot of effort for others to set the mountain, and it is not sure whether they will be able to catch up.
Why do we enter the mountain, just like that ginseng is raised by ourselves, and when we enter the mountain, we will meet big goods, and we will go down the mountain after taking it? "
They all rode down the mountain on their bikes. Feng Chao and the others hadn't recovered from their strength yet, and they couldn't believe that they got the big goods so easily.
"Didn't I say it all? This time we've had a good time with Qing Guo.
Qingguo is lucky and blessed, so this time we went very smoothly. "
Xu Shiyan insisted on this statement, this time it must be the credit of Zhou Qingguo.

chapters.title: Chapter 153: money
chapters.content:
Chapter 153 Money
Don't care who is responsible for it, anyway, this time, the few of them are doing it for nothing.
Several people rode their bicycles back happily, and when they returned to Donggang, it was already midnight.
"Brothers, if you want me to tell you, don't go home tonight.
They all stay at my house for one night, and tomorrow morning, we will go to the county by car. "Zhou Qingguo proposed.
Si Miao's big stick, you can't rest assured if you put it in someone's house, it's best to sell it quickly.
Zhou Qingguo didn't marry a wife, and his family was the quietest.
Feng Chao is not married either, but the brothers above him are all married and have no family separation. The whole family lives together, making a lot of noise.
The remaining Xu Shiyan, Sun Xiaofeng, and Huang Shengli are all married and have children.
Going back in the middle of the night, I woke up the child again, crying and screaming.
Everyone was right after thinking about it, Liupin Ye is really too eye-catching.
Many people know that they went to release the mountain. They came back in the middle of the night and made a big commotion. Others must understand that this is a meeting with a big guy. What if someone misses it?
It's better to stay at Zhou Qingguo's place for a night, and leave directly tomorrow morning, it's safer.
Everyone knew that Zhou Qingguo had returned from the army and was a security assistant, so no one dared to think about him.
"Okay, let's stay here in Qingguo tonight, and get a certificate tomorrow morning, don't go to the county, let's go directly to Tonghua.
There is a purchase point directly set up by the pharmaceutical factory in Tonghua, and the price is higher, which is much more cost-effective than the county. "
Xu Shiyan directly agreed with Zhou Qingguo's proposal, and he proposed to go to Tonghua.
Last year when Xu Shiyan led Yang Chunming and others, the main reason was that he didn’t dare to let the villagers know the size of the stick. He was afraid that people would be jealous, so he couldn’t open a letter of introduction to Tonghua.
That seedling club was sold for hundreds of dollars, Xu Shiyan sometimes felt it was a pity when he thought about it.
They encountered a lot of clubs this time. It would be a shame if they went to the county.
Everyone understood as soon as they heard it, Xu Shiyan had experience.
"Success, just listen to Brother Xu, let's go to Tonghua tomorrow."
Just like that, the five of them went directly to Zhou Qing's country and knocked on the door at night.
Zhou Changhe saw that his son had led the man back, and immediately understood what was going on, so he led the man directly to Zhou Qingguo's house without asking anything.
The five of them fell asleep without taking off their clothes.
Woke up at six o'clock in the morning to grab a casual meal, and then Zhou Qingguo hurried to the commune to find someone to open a letter of introduction.
The other four didn't even return home. They followed Zhou Qingguo to Songjianghe and boarded the train, heading straight for Tonghua.
Fortunately, before leaving, Zhou Qingguo's mother made a pack of pancakes and brought some pickles, and Zhou Changhe brought some money.
Several people hurried to Songjiang River, took the express train at 8 o'clock in the morning, and went straight to Tonghua.
When the train arrived in Tonghua, it was already past two o'clock in the afternoon. Five people got off the train and rushed to the purchase point, where they sold all the ginseng.
The price this year is slightly higher than last year.
The leaves of the sixth-grade seedling weighed four taels and one yuan, and the shape was very beautiful. The wild ginseng was more than four taels, and the price went up a lot. This one alone sold for five thousand three.
The fifth-grade leaves weigh three, two or six coins, two thousand and six hundred.
One seedling with good shape and fourth-grade leaves, two or two more heavy, nine hundred yuan, and five hundred yuan for the poorer shape.
As for the Erjiazi tree, it only sold for 60 yuan.
Five seedlings joined together, nine thousand three hundred and sixty, a short of six hundred yuan to ten thousand.
Ten thousand in seven or eight years, what is that concept?
Zhou Qingguo and the others were all dumbfounded. No one thought that they could earn so much money by going into the mountains.
In comparison, Xu Shiyan is considered the most normal one.
He took the money counted by the staff, put it directly into his back pocket, and dragged the four people out of the purchase point in a hurry.
Fortunately, it is not far from get off work, and there are not many people in the purchase point. Besides, they are all wearing rags that went up the mountain, and they are all in tatters. No one cares about them.
The five people left the purchase point and went straight to the train station. Only then did they know that the slow train going back in the afternoon had already left.
I had no choice but to find a hotel. Fortunately, Zhou Qingguo brought a letter of introduction and checked in smoothly.
The five of them happened to want a room. As soon as they entered the room, Xu Shiyan asked Zhou Qingguo to listen to the movement outside the door, and then he took out the money and began to calculate and divide the money.
Nine thousand three hundred and sixty yuan, 60 yuan is reserved for meals and bus tickets, and I have to return the money to Zhou Zhang and the advance, and the rest will be discussed.
The nine thousand three is still the average score, one thousand eight hundred and six per person.
Going into the mountains to dig sticks, everyone contributed a lot.
Although the ginseng was carried out by Xu Shiyan, Zhou Qingguo and others were not in charge of vigilance, cooking and other chores. Xu Shiyan was alone in the mountains, and he didn't know what danger he encountered.
Fangshan pays attention to working together.
Why is veteran Sun Liang admired? It's not that he is so good at freeing mountains, but that he is benevolent and righteous, and lost his life just to find a friend.
Without a heart of benevolence and righteousness, you can’t eat the rice of running mountains. Even if someone gets ginseng with bad intentions, they will eventually be punished.
Huang Shengli and others held more than 1,800 yuan and their hands were shaking.
I never dreamed in my life that I could earn less than 2,000 yuan after a few days in the mountains.
"Xiaofeng, let me pinch it to see if it hurts? Why do I think this is a dream?"
Feng Chao blinked, and reached out to pinch Sun Xiaofeng.
Sun Xiaofeng dodged to dodge, and then twisted Feng Chao severely, Feng Chao let out a pained groan, and then grinned.
"It hurts, it's real, it's not a dream. Oh my God, more than a thousand dollars, this time I can marry a wife."
Feng’s family has six or seven children, and life is not going well. Feng Chao’s four older brothers are all married.
With this amount of money, let alone Feng Chao marrying a wife alone, it is enough for the two younger brothers to count later.
"Look at your stupid look, but you must find a smarter daughter-in-law.
Otherwise, I am worried about your son, what will you do if you follow suit? "Sun Xiaofeng deliberately made fun of Feng Chao.
An angry Feng Chao was going to arrest Feng Xiaofeng, and the two chased each other madly in this room.
"Okay, both of you calm down a little bit, someone from the hotel will knock on the door later."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly pulled the two of them away, not allowing them to sneer, they are so grown up, and they are still jumping up and down like a baby.
"Going back, let's say that we met a five-pin leaf seedling and bought it for 2,500 yuan, and each person shared 500 yuan. Do you understand?"
Xu Shiyan has the most experience in this matter. He called the others to him and gave them advice.
"I don't care how much you tell your family.
But outsiders, remember, just say that it was divided into 500 yuan, and no one should say anything wrong, understand? "
Five hundred yuan is not a lot in this day and age. If you build a big house, you will attract the envy and jealousy of a group of people, and those who borrow money may have to step through the threshold.
But in Donggang, others will envy them when they know about it, but that’s all.
After all, there are a lot of side jobs here, and they earn a lot of money. Many people's families are quite rich, so they don't have to be jealous of other people's money.
Although those ages are similar to Xu Shiyan, but in these respects, he is still stunned.
Upon hearing Xu Shiyan's words, they all widened their eyes, "Brother Xu, it's because you have too many thoughts, we didn't even think of it."
Most people in this day and age are honest, and there are not many people who play tricks like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 154: savings
chapters.content:
Chapter 154 Savings
The five of them brought so much money, they really didn't dare to go out and even ate dinner in the hotel.
Anyway, the people in the hotel allowed them to take the plates back to the house to eat, and then send them back after eating.
At night, everyone didn’t dare to sleep. They stuffed their money into their bags and slept under their pillows.
Early the next morning, I got up and ate something casually, and then took the express train back at 6:30.
On the train, the five of them also got together, and Zhou Qingguo was always on guard.
Fortunately, nothing happened on the way, so I returned to Songjianghe smoothly.
Getting off the train, Xu Shiyan still went to the savings bank, saved 1,500 yuan, and took the rest home.
Those four people didn't know until this time that they could save the money and still have interest.
The few discussed it, and each of them saved 1300 yuan, which happened to be 500 yuan each to go home.
Just like that, the savings office did a business worth several thousand yuan at once, and the staff at the counters were all dumbfounded.
These five people are dressed in rags and covered in dirt. Where did they get so much money?
Could it be that he did something bad?
Of course, this has nothing to do with savings banks, they are only responsible for handling business, and they don’t care about the rest.
The five of them had saved their money and were relaxed. Zhou Qingguo said, why not go shopping and drink at his house in the afternoon.
Xu Shiyan did the math, and there is still a lot of sixty left, so no one needs to take the money, and just pay from the remaining money.
Buy whatever you can buy, cook delicious food when you go home, call your own wives, and have a lively time together.
Just like that, a few people went straight to the store, bought some canned food, and at the non-staple food store, bought some spare ribs, pork offal, etc.
He went back to Donggang and went straight to Zhou's house.
Since a few people left yesterday, Zhou Changhe has been thinking about it.
I don’t know if these people went out smoothly or not, and I don’t know how much the mallet can sell for.
Finally looking forward to the return of everyone, Zhou Changhe was relieved.
"Oh my God, I finally came back safely, hurry up, let's all go into the house, sit down and drink some water to rest."
"Second brother, we won't go into the house anymore, let's go home first, and come to your house for a drink later.
Please trouble my sister-in-law to put in some effort to make those things. In the evening, we big guys will be lively at the second brother's house. "
Xu Shiyan waved his hands with a smile, pushed his bicycle and walked out.
After greeting Zhou Changhe, the others also pushed their bicycles away and went home to announce the good news.
"Daughter-in-law, I'm back." Xu Shiyan pushed his bicycle and yelled loudly as soon as he entered the gate.
Xu Shiyan entered the mountain on the 16th day of the seventh month of the lunar calendar and returned on the 22nd day of the seventh month. This trip took six days.
Su Anying was thinking about it all day long at home, wondering how her husband was doing outside, whether he would be in danger, and whether he would be able to come back smoothly.
She has to take care of her son, and she has to serve these open-mouthed beasts at home, worrying about being burdened and worried.
As soon as she heard her husband calling her outside, Su Anying couldn't care about anything else, picked up her son and ran outside, just in time to see Xu Shiyan pushing the car in.
"Are you back? How is it? Is everything going well?"
The moment Su Anying saw her husband was well, Su Anying's hanging heart finally let go.
Regardless of whether there is any gain from entering the mountain, as long as people come back safely, it is better than anything else.
"Well, it went well, let's talk in the room."
Although the neighbors are quite far away, Xu Shiyan is still very careful.
Pick up the car, take off all the things that are used for mountain storage on the back seat of the car, and enter the house with the wife.
Arriving at the East Room, Xu Shiyan took out a passbook and three hundred dollars from his back pocket, and handed them to Su Anying.
"Save this carefully. There are 1,500 yuan in it. Keep the money at home as well. There is usually something urgent."
As soon as Su Anying heard Xu Shiyan's words, she knew that this time she went to the mountain and met a big guy again.
So he took the passbook, took out the key to open the box, took out a small locked box inside, and opened the small box with the key. Not only the passbook was placed in it, but also money.
When I came back from Tonghua last year, I saved 3,000 yuan, and then divided 560 yuan with Yang Chunming and others the second time.
Winter sold bear bile skins for 1400 yuan for the first time, and divided it for 400 yuan for the second time.
This summer, Niu Mao Guang sold less than two hundred, and Tianma sold more than one hundred.
After deducting the 400 yuan for buying a house, buying a sewing machine, a bicycle, and daily living expenses, there are 5,500 yuan in two passbooks, and almost 1,000 yuan in cash.
The couple counted the money with smiles on their faces, then locked the small box again, put it at the bottom of the box, and locked the box again.
"Daughter-in-law, next year I plan to build five houses in the west, all of which are made of bricks and tiles, which are solid. It saves me from having to go to the house to tidy up the roof in summer."
While teasing his son, Xu Shiyan talked to his wife about his plans for next year.
"Wait for another two years to take a break, and renovate the three rooms in the east end, and build a row of warehouses and barns. We will have a good life in the future."
Xu Shiyan has long thought about it. When the policy comes down next fall, each family will be allowed to raise large livestock, pigs, and poultry.
He tried to find a way to raise two cows or two mules for work, and put them down the west slope, build a pigsty, and raise five or six pigs.
The small hill in the back does nothing else, plant fruit trees, raise a dozen big geese, and raise a few chickens, this family has the appearance of living.
Xu Shiyan said that Su Anying just listened with a smile and didn't express any opinions. When Xu Shiyan finished speaking, she nodded.
"Okay, as long as you like, you can arrange it however you want.
However, now you have to wash and tidy up your face, look at you like this, like a mud monkey, with a disheveled face.
I don’t know that you haven’t washed your face for a few days, so it’s like this. "
Su Anying raised her hand and wiped Xu Shiyan's face, okay, it's all mud.
"Can you still look good when you go up the mountain?
Bringing so much money back, I specifically told Qingguo and the others not to wash their faces. Just because of this virtue, no one happened to come to us. "
This is how many years of experience.
When you go out in the car, the more clean and straight you are, the more people will sit next to you, and it will be easier for people to stare at you.
The more tattered your clothes are, and the more muddy your clothes are, the more people will feel uncomfortable when they look at you, and they will definitely not come to your side, but it is safe.
"False reasoning, if you are lazy, you can say you are lazy. There are so many nonsense to fool me."
Su Anying didn't know whether to laugh or cry, and slapped her husband, urging him to wash and change clothes quickly.
"Hurry up and wash it up, or you won't be allowed to go to the kang at night."
After being married for a long time, the originally shy little daughter-in-law has also become more aggressive, threatening people at every turn.
"I'm really not allowed to go to the kang? I've been out for several days, and you don't miss me? Then what do I think you should do?"
Xu Shiyan played tricks on purpose, got close to his wife, kissed her on the cheek, and then ran away.
Xiao Haiyuan, who was leaning on his mother's arms, didn't know what was going on, and suddenly giggled.
Su Anying wiped her face, looked down at her son, and smiled too.
"What do you know, you know how to laugh?"
While talking, he rummaged through the cabinet, found clean clothes for Xu Shiyan, and put them on the kang.

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Pork mouth mushroom
chapters.content:
Chapter 155 Pork mouth mushroom
Xu Shiyan washed, tidied up and changed his clothes, then wrote a note for Xu Shiqin, took his son in his arms and led his daughter-in-law, and locked the door to go to Zhou's house.
As soon as I arrived at Zhou's house, I found that other people had already arrived.
Huang Shengli led his wife and a son and a daughter, and Sun Xiaofeng also led his wife and son.
Among the few people who went up the mountain together, only Feng Chao and Zhou Qingguo are still single.
At this time, everyone had smiles on their faces, and hurriedly said hello when they met.
The women are not very familiar with each other, but they all have children, and they get to know each other when they get together and chat.
Zhou Qingguo's mother, Mrs. Li, was busy cooking in the kitchen.
When the other daughters-in-law saw it, they hurriedly gave their children to their men, and then went to help in the kitchen.
These daughters-in-law are very capable, and with their help, the meals were prepared and served quickly.
Pork ribs stewed beans, fried peppers, cucumber mixed with pig mouth mushrooms, sugar mixed tomatoes, three fried and one fried, pork liver and tongue platter, shredded pork heart mixed with shredded green onions, fried elm mushrooms with leeks.
Mrs. Li is very capable, picking out eight dishes.
"The third child in the family went to Lengchang to pick that pig's mouth mushroom, and I washed it seven or eight times.
First soak it with small ash, then wash it with soda and salt, and eat it with confidence. "
When Mrs. Li served pig's mouth mushroom mixed with cucumber, he specially explained it, lest everyone might be suspicious.
This pig's mouth mushroom, the scientific name is glue top, is a fungus that grows on oak wood.
It is dark brown, like a top and a pig's mouth, so it is named pig's mouth mushroom.
Porcini mushrooms are something that people love to hate.
I love it because the taste is particularly good. It tastes more meaty than fungus, soft and elastic, comparable to a pig's mouth.
Especially mixed with cucumber and garlic, it is fragrant, smooth and elastic, and the more you eat, the more you want to eat it.
People hate it because this thing contains a poisonous substance.
If you don’t wash it or don’t wash it clean, your mouth will be swollen and numb after eating, it’s really the same as a pig’s mouth.
Besides, my whole body feels uncomfortable like being pricked by needles, I can't see the light, and even my fingers are swollen seriously.
Symptoms are similar to solar allergic dermatitis, and it will take six or seven days to subside, which is especially painful.
If you want to remove the toxicity of pig's mouth mushroom, you must use small ash, that is, plant ash water, soak it for about ten hours, and then scrub it over and over again.
It is best to scrub twice with alkali and salt. After soaking and scrubbing, the pig's mouth mushrooms become soft and slippery, and the taste is very good.
"Oh, I made my sister-in-law bother. It's tiring to prepare so many dishes. Thank you, sister-in-law."
Xu Shiyan saw that eight dishes were placed on the table one after another, and all the vegetables of the season were served. He knew that Mrs. Li had put his heart into it, so he naturally wanted to thank him.
Except for Xu Shiyan who called sister-in-law, the others all called aunt.
Neighbors in the neighborhood, regardless of their seniority, they call each other anyway, and it doesn't matter what is messed up or not.
"Cough, why are you being polite? Eat quickly, there are no good dishes to entertain you, so you can eat whatever you want."
Mrs. Li was very straightforward. The dishes were set out and the wine was placed on the table. He greeted Zhou Zhanghe and Zhou Qingguo and his son accompanied him.
I left the East Room and ate with Su Anying and others in the West Room.
Together, there is Zhou Qingan, the third child of the Zhou family, sixteen years old.
Zhou Changhe was born in the army, and several of his children were influenced by him, and they all yearned to join the army.
The second child of the Zhou family, Zhou Qingjun, also served as a soldier the year before last. The third child is studying now, and his grades are not very good. Anyway, he keeps shouting all day long that he will join the army just like his elder brother and second brother.
Women have to take care of the children in this house, and eating is troublesome.
It’s okay to be younger like Xu Haiyuan, just put it on the kang and let him stretch his arms and kick his legs to play. Su Anying looked back while eating.
Huang Shengli's son is older, he is three years old, and it is time for him to run all over the ground, and the younger one is less than one year old, so he can't crawl.
Huang Shengli's daughter-in-law had no choice but to hug her daughter and coax her son to eat.
Nowadays, most of the society is like this. Men work in the team every day, and go home after a tiring day, and few people coax their children.
Women always do housework while watching their children, and have to coax their children while eating. Everyone is used to it, so they don’t feel that much.
When several women get together, apart from talking about their husbands and children, men are different, and they can talk about everything in the world.
In the east room, Zhou Changhe talked about some things that happened in the commune these days.
"A group of people dug up a lot of goods when they went into the mountains. I heard that they went to the county to sell more than 2,000 yuan, and they all shared 400 to 500 yuan.
The third brigade also heard that a group of people went into the mountain with clubs. It seemed that they were not as good as the first brigade. The family shared about two hundred yuan. "
Catch up with Red Hammer City, who in the mountains doesn't want to go into the mountains to try their luck?
I don’t know how many groups of people go to the mountains these days, but there are not many who can meet big goods.
In such a big commune, I have only heard of these two groups. If Xu Shiyan and the others are added, there will be three groups.
Xu Shiyan was happy when he heard this.
The more people in a commune dig up wild ginseng, the more inconspicuous they are, and no one cares about them.
Xu Shiyan stabbed Zhou Qingguo and Huang Shengli, and they looked at each other, understanding.
No matter who you are talking to, just say what you said in the Tonghua discussion, so as not to make people jealous.
"It seems that this year is a good year, and there are many sticks going down the mountain.
Very good, probably the old man of the mountain god, knowing that our life is difficult, deliberately sent ginseng essence down the mountain to help us. "
Xu Shiyan poured wine for Zhou Changhe and said something with a smile.
This was an interesting remark, which made everyone laugh out loud.
Others don’t know if it’s difficult or not, but the few of them, with this money, can do a lot of great things.
"Isn't it? I haven't mentioned the daughter-in-law yet.
Just right, my mother told me when I got home today, someone introduced me to a girl, and I went to see her another day.
If it can be done, then hurry up and get married in winter. "Feng Chao grinned and said with a silly smile.
"Well, the boss is not young, it is time to marry a wife.
Not only Chaozi, but also Qingguo, Uncle Zhou, hurry up and make arrangements for Qingguo.
Don't let him pick and choose all day long, what are you doing with such high vision? Just find someone who is more virtuous and able to live a life. "
On the other end, Huang Shengli couldn't help teasing Feng Chao and Zhou Qingguo.
Zhou Qingguo is twenty-five this year, let alone, the young man is twenty-five and hasn't mentioned his wife yet, so it's really late.
No way, Zhou Qingguo was in the army for several years before he came back from the army.
His eyesight is high, and other people don't like to propose marriage. In the past half a year since he came home, he has met several times, but nothing happened.
Bringing this matter up, Zhou Changhe had a headache, "Don't mention our family's Qing Dynasty, this brat doesn't have the heart to get married.
If someone introduces one, it won’t work, and if I introduce him again, it won’t work. I make him worry to death, and I don’t know what kind of person he is looking for. "
"Second brother, what are you worried about?
We, Qingguo, have a size and a job like this. Why do we have to find a good-looking wife who has a job? What's the rush? "
Others don't know, but Xu Shiyan knows very well that Zhou Qingguo got married in the winter of 1978.
I married a doctor from Donggang Hospital, who is beautiful and works well.
"It's not safe, Qingguo's daughter-in-law is waiting there, and I will meet you another day."

chapters.title: Chapter 156: autumn harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 156 Autumn Harvest
The five people spoke in unison, saying to the outside world that they met a five-pin leaf seedling, and the family shared five hundred yuan.
There is a comparison between the first team and the third team, and the big guys don't think much of it.
There will be envy to some extent, but it is not as jealous and jealous as the big house, so that it will stumbling secretly.
In this way, the lives of Xu Shiyan and others were not disturbed much, and they still did what they should do.
The crops in the big fields have entered the mature stage. At this time, there is no need to weed and loosen the soil, just wait for the harvest in the middle and late September.
There is not much work in the ginseng fields. After autumn, the ginseng sheds that were making goods in those years had to be opened, and there was a rain, so that the ginseng could absorb enough water, and the products were weighed in autumn.
But it has been sunny recently, so we have to watch the weather and wait for the rain.
But Cantu from the Xiaoheihe River, it is time to hurry up and fight the columbine, otherwise, if it rains, he will not be able to work for several days.
After drying the ginseng soil for these days, the grass roots are dead and the soil is much looser. At this time, we have to work quickly while the weather is fine.
Xu Shiyan has always been in charge of the ginseng soil on the Xiaoheihe side, and it is also necessary for him to bring people over to fight the columbine soil.
To beat the soil, you need to hook up the planed adobe with three teeth and throw it to about one meter in front of your chest.
At the same time, kick with your feet, smash with three teeth, and repeat several times until the adobe is shattered and all the grass roots are shaken out.
To make good soil, clean up the site immediately, collect tree roots, grass roots and other sundries on both sides of the border, let it dry for a few days and then burn it.
The soil must be loosened without clods.
In some places where there is a lot of black soil, loess has to be taken from the hillside and mixed in a certain proportion.
Then use a shovel to turn the soil evenly, which is called pouring the soil.
The soil should be poured finely and evenly, and folded into sharp soil ridges with a shovel.
The soil ridge should be straight, the soil should be sufficient, and the thickness should be uniform.
Pour all the ginseng soil into a big soil ridge, and this is the end, just wait for the ginseng seeds to be planted in late autumn.
It can be said that there is no such thing as easy and easy work in the field, which is made of mud all day long.
In order to compete for the weather, the big guy has to live and work on the mountain, so as not to waste time running back and forth.
So when Xu Shiyan and the others finished packing up the ginseng soil and went down the mountain, they made one after another, which was almost like a mud monkey.
In September, Xu Shixiang went to Tonghua to study with his luggage on his back.
The family is busy with the autumn harvest, and no one has time to see him off.
Anyway, it’s close to home, and it’s just there by train. For a young man in his twenties, do you still need someone to send you this distance?
Nowadays, going to college doesn’t cost money, and there is a subsidy of more than ten yuan per month. Anyway, food and drink are enough for one person, and if you save a little, you can still have surplus.
Zhou Guilan brought some money to her son, and the elder brothers also felt a little bit more concerned. Xu Shixiang has money in his hand, so he doesn't have to worry about life.
No one else went to deliver it, but Xu Shixiang's partner followed him to Tonghua.
Lived in Tonghua for a few days, seeing Xu Shixiang settle down, and then went home.
Autumn is a very busy season. Men work in the team during the day, harvesting corn and beans, and they have to work on their own private land in the morning and evening.
Women are not idle, and all kinds of vegetables in the vegetable garden have to be cleaned up.
Otherwise, when the frost hits one day, everyone will be beaten by the frost, so what else do you eat?
So we have to hurry up and clean up. The old ones are taken off and placed in a cool warehouse, where they can be stored for a while and eaten slowly.
If it is tender, you have to find a way to marinate it and save it for winter.
The Northeast region has not had vegetables for a long time. After frost, there are no other vegetables to eat except cabbage, radish and potatoes.
So most women have to hurry up to dry and pickle vegetables.
All kinds of vegetables in the vegetable garden can be marinated and eaten slowly.
Steam the tender eggplants in the pan for a while, then remove them in the middle after cooling down, and put in enough salted garlic and coriander powder.
Put it in a jar and seal it up. After a few days of marinating, the garlic eggplant is ready to eat.
Tender beans, young peppers, and even pepper leaves are all scalded in boiling water, sprinkled with salt and marinated.
If you have the conditions, you can also cut some green onion leaves, garlic slices, etc., the taste is better.
Celery root and coriander root are dug out from the ground, cleaned and scalded with boiling water, then sprinkled with salt, rubbed thoroughly, and put into jars.
When eating, take out and slice the celery root, eat it when drinking porridge in the morning, the more you chew, the more fragrant it will be.
Anyway, hard-working women will turn everything they can eat into pickles or dried vegetables, save them, and eat them when there is no food.
This is also a helpless move, as is the case in the Northeast, where winter is too long.
Unlike the south, there are fresh vegetables all year round.
Autumn harvest is the busiest season of the year, but also the happiest.
I was so tired from working every day that I couldn't straighten my back. When I got home, I saw sorghum ears, grain ears, and millet bundled together on the garden sticks.
In the garden, there are sticks of yellow smoke on the wooden frame, red pepper strings and garlic braids on the wall, and a lot of pumpkins, sweet potatoes, yams, and potatoes in the warehouse.
Seeing the joyful wife and the chubby and lovely son again, no matter how hard and tiring it is, it is worth it.
"Come on, eldest son, come to Dad."
Xu Shiyan came home after a busy day, and regardless of his tiredness, he reached out and picked up his son, putting him on his neck.
The six-month-old baby is quite firm and can sit up.
Since Xu Shiyan put his son on his neck for fun that day, this kid has been addicted.
Every time I see Xu Shiyan, I just yell and stretch out my hand, but I’m still not happy to hug him, I have to ride on my neck to be happy.
Xu Shiyan carried his son for a walk all over the place. The little guy didn't know how to be afraid, so he waved his hands happily and shouted.
Father and son are so crazy, Su Anying is terrified.
"Be careful, don't fall on the child, it's so high, what if you fall?"
Su Anying reached out to pick it up, but Xiao Haiyuan ignored her mother at all, playing with his father was a joy.
"Daughter-in-law, it's okay, don't worry. I'll coax the children, you can cook with peace of mind."
Xu Shiyan grabbed his son's waist, how could he let his son fall?
Just carrying his son like this, he ran from the house to the yard, and then wandered around the yard.
"Come, see our dog."
Wandering to the kennel, Xu Shiyan put his son down and let him reach out to pet the puppy.
The four puppies are almost two months old. They were weaned a while ago, and they are eating well now.
With Su Anying taking good care of them, the four puppies are all growing up very well and are very energetic. They fight with all kinds of skin all day long.
Xu Haiyuan came out every day to see the puppies, and he liked them very much. He stretched out his little hand, petted this one, and then petted that one.
Xiaowa, without counting in his hand, grabbed the back of the little black dog's neck with force.
Fortunately, he didn't have that much strength, he only squeezed it, but couldn't lift the dog up.
The little black dog barked, and Xu Shiyan quickly picked up his son and put him on his lap.
The little guy couldn't reach the puppy anymore, so he lifted his calf and feet, looking at his posture, he looked like he was about to kick.
"You brat, I think you'll be a flirt with cats and dogs when you grow up, naughty bastard."
Xu Shiyan reached out and held his son's fleshy little feet, not allowing him to move around.
"Father told you, these are our dogs, don't bully them." Xu Shiyan warned his son seriously.
How could Xiao Haiyuan understand those things? He turned his head in doubt and glanced at Xu Shiyan, "Eight, eight?"

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Old Chu's news
chapters.content:
Chapter 157 News from Elder Chu
A six-month-old baby can already utter some syllables unconsciously.
Recently, in order to train his son, Xu Shiyan deliberately asked his son to call him father.
Now hearing his son utter similar syllables, Xu Shiyan is very happy.
"Daughter-in-law, daughter-in-law, the son will call him daddy now." Xu Shiyan carried his son into the house, showing off to Su Anying.
Su Anying looked helpless. Some people are already fathers, but they are more stable and more like children.
I don't know what's going on.
"Such a little kid, what does he know? He just said it casually.
Two days ago he was still calling you mom, why don't you ask him to call you mom again? Is it worth your yelling at Xiaowa to talk too much? "
Su Anying has served her sisters before, so she knows this all too well.
For a baby to really call someone, no matter what, it must be ten months later, or one year old to be able to call clearly.
Some babies have slurred speech, and it will be later. Do you expect a six-month-old baby to be called dad? That's really overthinking.
Xu Shiyan didn't believe it, and carried his son back to the house, teasing him over and over again, trying to make the little guy call him dad again.
But Xu Haiyuan didn't play enough just now, he still wanted to go out, he just turned his head to look outside and shouted, how could he listen to his father and call him dad?
Father and son talked about each other for a long time, but finally Xu Shiyan was defeated, so he could only carry his son on his back and continue to go crazy.
I don't know if the little guy is in a better mood, or because he had an idea, and made the eight-eight sound again, which made Xu Shiyan very happy.
"You little rascal, you have to be your daddy as a horse for you to ride, so you are willing to call him daddy."
Xu Shiyan patted his son's **** symbolically to show his anger.
The little guy didn't care, and started giggling. Hearing the voice, he knew he was very happy.
"Okay, you guys don't go crazy there, put him down quickly, and piss, so you don't pee all over your neck."
Su Anying finished the meal, came out of the kitchen with a spatula in her hand, and yelled at Xu Shiyan to urinate on her son.
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered that he had been playing with his son for quite a long time.
If this big boy spills urine, I'm afraid he will have to take a hot bath.
So he quickly put his son down and hugged him to pee.
The little guy hasn't played enough, how can he? So I started to play donkey and fight.
Su Anying still couldn't see it anymore, she took her son to the garden to coax her, and after a while, she really urinated.
At this time, Xu Shiqin also came back from get off work, so he hurriedly washed his hands and ate.
The whole family was having dinner when they suddenly heard shouts from the loudspeaker that they would go to the No. 2 bridge tomorrow to participate in the parade, so that those whose names were called would gather at the team headquarters tomorrow with their tools.
Xu Shiyan's name is impressively in the first place, needless to say, he must be the team leader.
"Third brother, since you moved to Donggang, you have been ahead of everything, it's really different."
Xu Shiqin was very emotional when he heard the shout from the loudspeaker.
When I was in the big house, Xu Shiyan couldn't get many jobs with high work points.
Looking at the present, Xu Shiyan works less and earns more work points.
This year, Su Anying gave birth to confinement and coaxed her child, so she couldn't go to work to earn work points, but this year there will be more problems with the family's work points. This is change.
"What's the difference? Isn't it all about living?"
Xu Shiyan smiled, took some egg custard with a spoon, and fed it to his son.
"No matter where you are, just work hard and get by.
Your third brother is very satisfied now that he has a wife and a son. "
It is good to have a wife and children, own house and savings.
In the future, they will have a bigger house, more money, two more daughters, and a room full of children's laughter. This life is enough.
"By the way, Qi Yunsheng sent a letter saying that he found Elder Chu.
Mr. Chu is currently at Bethune Medical University, serving as the vice president and a professor. I have written back and entrusted Qi Yunsheng to ask for Mr. Chu's contact information.
When I get in touch with Mr. Chu, I will ask him if there is any good way to treat your illness. "
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered this matter, and hurriedly told the younger sister.
Xu Shiyan only knew Mr. Chu's name, but he didn't know anything about Mr. Chu's current affairs.
Qi Yunsheng also spent a lot of time inquiring, and finally got news a while ago, so he hurriedly wrote to tell Xu Shiyan the good news.
Qi Yunsheng also said in the letter that he would slowly inquire about Elder Chu, and then write to Xu Shiyan again.
Xu Shiqin was stunned when he heard this, "Brother, can it really be useful?"
Xu Shiqin has never dared to have too much hope, for fear that the greater the hope, the greater the disappointment.
"Whether it's useful or not, we have to try it, and we won't regret it even if it doesn't work.
You are still young now, so as long as there is a way, I will help you cure it.
Even if you can't fully recover, even if you can improve a little, it's worth it. "
Xu Shiyan's attitude is very firm, no matter how much effort and money it takes, he has to treat it.
Brother thinks of her wholeheartedly, what else can Xu Shiqin say?
"Well, I believe in the third brother, and the third brother said to treat it, so I will definitely treat it."
In fact, in Xu Shiqin's heart, why doesn't he hope that he can straighten up and be like a normal person?
Now there is finally hope, and she is also looking forward to having good news sooner.
"By the way, third brother, when you go to the mountain again, dig some flower soil for me and come back.
My master has raised a few Clivia trees, which are growing very well, and I like them very much.
She promised to give me a few seedlings so that I could raise them myself when I come back.
The soil in our vegetable garden is not good, it is best to use black soil from the mountains. "
Xu Shiqin suddenly remembered something. She wanted to grow some potted flowers, but there was no place for flower soil.
The black soil layer in the back forest is too thin, and the soil fertility is not enough. It should be the most suitable soil for ginseng.
When Xu Shiyan heard this, something seemed to flash through his mind, but he couldn't catch it.
He thought carefully for a long time, but he couldn't come up with a clue, so he simply gave up.
"Okay, that's easy. I'm going to start ginseng these few days. When I take a break at noon, I'll go into the forest and dig some ginseng soil for you."
The soil where ginseng has been planted is not good, and the fertility in the soil has been absorbed by ginseng.
You have to fetch soil from the forest and let it dry in the sun before you can grow flowers.
After dinner, the sky is getting dark.
At this time, there is no TV and no other entertainment. Although Donggang is connected to electricity, everyone is reluctant to pay the electricity bill, and they all go to bed early.
Xu Haiyuan may have slept a lot during the day, but at night he regained his energy and refused to sleep no matter what.
Lying on the kang was not enough, so he looked at Xu Shiyan murmuring, meaning that he wanted Xu Shiyan to carry him to play.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to pick up his son, throw it into the air vigorously, and then catch it again.
Xu Haiyuan is a bold one, not afraid at all, on the contrary, he is happy and laughs happily.
Xu Shiqin and Su Anying on the other side looked terrified, wishing they could go forward and grab the child.
The sister-in-law and the sister-in-law were always staring at Xu Shiyan's hand, afraid that he might accidentally miss it.
Xu Haiyuan was born fat, and Su Anying's milk is probably good. The meat fed to this kid is chubby, and the six-month-old baby is almost twenty catties.
Xu Shiyan threw it a dozen times in a row and felt a little tired, so he handed the child to Su Anying.
"By the way, do you still have a radio ticket at home?
Wait until the time is over, go to Songjianghe or the county, buy a radio and come back. "
There is no TV, a radio is fine. There is no movement at night, it is really too boring.

chapters.title: Chapter 158: compost
chapters.content:
Chapter 158 Mixed Fertilizers
On September 20th, the Second Brigade of Donggang Commune began to participate.
Early in the morning, Xu Shiyan led a hundred strong young men, each carrying tools and sacks, and drove the carriage straight to the No. 2 bridge.
Here, those who withdraw the shed, those who cut the ginseng leaves, and those who hold the three-toothed ginseng.
Everything is arranged in an orderly manner, and everyone is busy with their own affairs without delaying anything.
The club was unearthed, Xu Shiyan came over to have a look, um, it’s okay.
He has a good figure, no rust, and his size is considered not too small in the eyes of others, but for Xu Shiyan, he feels that he is still not good enough.
This is the reason why there is no top dressing. If the fertilizer is enough, it will definitely grow bigger.
Xu Shiyan, the leader, does not need to do the work himself. He just needs to walk around and be responsible for dispatching and supervising the work.
Watch the big guys work, don't plan the sticks, don't pick them up too slowly and drop them in the soil to bury them.
Harvest is always pleasant.
Seeing piles of doll-like mallets being packed into sacks, no matter who it is, they will feel that no matter how hard it is, it is worth it.
The ginseng of the second brigade is growing well, and the output is not low.
Those who work, although tired, are all smiling. This is the happiness of a good harvest.
More than a hundred people are all strong men, so the work is naturally fast. In three or four days, all the three-thousand-foot goods are finished.
The Second Brigade is on the south bank of the Huangni River. There is a processing factory run by the brigade in front of Paotai Mountain, and there is a small river in front of the processing factory.
Just diverted the river water, built a large pond, soaked ginseng and washed it.
The processing plant has a large area, and the various areas inside are clearly divided.
Soaking ginseng pond, brushing ginseng pond, steaming ginseng room, drying room, rows of shelves in the yard, with forks for drying ginseng on them, all kinds of facilities are available.
The girls and daughters-in-law in the team are all vying to come to the processing factory to earn work points at this time. A group of people gather together, chatting and laughing very lively.
Others are busy earning work points, but Su Anying can only coax the child at home, making her jump in a hurry.
But what can be done? Xu Haiyuan is too young, no one helps to look after the child, so she can't carry her son to work, right?
Even if Xu Shiyan is willing, the processing factory will not let him.
"Daughter-in-law, don't worry, our family doesn't need you to earn work points now, as long as you manage the whole family well, it will be better than anything else."
Xu Shiyan couldn't laugh or cry when he saw his daughter-in-law anxious, so he could only comfort him.
"Daughter-in-law, don't underestimate being at home. If no one does these miscellaneous tasks, how can I work outside to earn work points?"
In his previous life, when Su Anying was alive, Xu Shiyan thought the same as other men.
Do you think women are just housekeepers, cookers, and children at home? What are you tired of? Still nagging every day?
But after Su Anying left, Xu Shiyan realized that a family without a woman would not look good at all.
Rice won’t cook by itself, clothes won’t clean by itself, and the inside and outside of the house won’t become spotless by itself.
A woman's life is trapped in these trivial things that others don't care about, but she supports a family.
So after being reborn, Xu Shiyan changed his mind.
Men and women have different social divisions of labor, no matter what they do, it is very important.
Su Anying lived in a different environment since she was a child. There are six sisters in her family, and there is no boy. She is used to going out to work just like a boy.
Usually, it's okay, but every time it comes to the season of spring planting and autumn harvest, she feels that staying at home is not right, mainly because her status has not been changed.
After being persuaded by Xu Shiyan several times, Su Anying also gradually understood that she now has a husband and someone to rely on, and there is no need to fight as hard as before.
So he stayed at home to take care of the children with peace of mind. The house and the outside were cleaned up neatly, so Xu Shiyan didn't have to worry about anything.
In a blink of an eye, September passed, and most of October passed, and ginseng seeds grew in the ginseng field. After picking, they were ready to plant ginseng.
At the beginning of spring, Yu Shouguang said that he would give Xu Shiyan a hundred feet of ginseng soil and let him do a bean cake base fertilizer test.
At that time, Xu Shiyan fermented the bean cake powder according to a hundred feet. As a result, the effect of top dressing with bean cake water was obvious in summer.
Yu Shouguang regretted this, so he discussed with Xu Shiyan, can he find a way to get more fat, and try to get as much ginseng as possible this year for experimentation.
This matter is not difficult for Xu Shiyan.
He can not only ferment bean cakes as base fertilizer, but also make mixed fertilizer.
Fried and crushed perilla seeds, overstone, decomposed bean cake powder, and kang cave soil are fully mixed in a ratio of two, two, two, and four, and piled up and fermented again.
When planting ginseng, apply about four catties per foot as base fertilizer, and after three years, the yield can be increased by 20 to 30%.
If combined with bean cake water topdressing, the yield can increase by 50%.
Of course, Xu Shiyan will not teach this recipe to others.
The compound fertilizer was prepared entirely by Xu Shiyan himself, and it was useless to anyone.
And he asked for a lot of things, making it impossible to guess the specific formula.
Not all skills can be taught free of charge. This skill is the experience Xu Shiyan has accumulated over the years in his previous life.
Even if there is chemical fertilizer later, it is not as good as this method.
Ginseng grows vigorously and is not easy to get disease. Just kidding, who would spread the word easily.
Xu Shiyan didn’t pass on the methods, and the team couldn’t do anything about it. Anyway, as long as the harvest is good, the rest should not be too greedy.
There are 5,000 feet of ginseng land on Xiaohei River, 4,300 feet of ginseng is planted, and 1,000 feet of ginseng is left to sow seeds.
Planting ginseng is not an easy task. The two of them work together to put the pond in the field in the morning.
It is to spread out a part of the large soil ridge with tools. According to the requirements of the site reference, the soil layer must be of a certain thickness.
After that, use a shovel to dig trenches on the surface of the pool according to a certain row spacing, and the depth should be five or six centimeters.
If you don’t fertilize, you can directly place the ginseng seeds in small furrows, and the spacing between plants is determined according to the size of the ginseng seeds.
The larger the ginseng seeds, the farther the distance between plants, and the smaller the ginseng seeds, the closer the distance between plants should be, leaving enough room for growth.
Put the ginseng seeds in place, and then cover with a layer of six to eight centimeters of soil, and that's it.
This is the normal procedure for planting ginseng, but for those experimental fields that need to be fertilized, there is an additional process of spreading fertilizer and covering the soil before placing the ginseng seeds.
In this way, the speed of planting ginseng will be slower.
Of course, the second brigade has a lot of manual work, so let’s go slower, no one cares.
As long as the output of ginseng increases, this labor cost can be ignored.
The work of planting ginseng is done upside down, and a special square plate is placed in front of the worker, with a wooden section protruding from each end of the square plate.
The length of the wooden square is the same as the width of the surface of the pool. Two short wooden squares are nailed to the top of the wooden square. The length of these two short wooden squares is generally six inches, which is the row spacing.
This thing, in the industry jargon, is called a system, which is specially used to measure the line spacing.
Every time you press **** the surface of the pool, it leaves a mark, and when you drag it according to the mark, you can accurately grasp the line spacing, so that the two people will not be wider on one side and narrower on the other.
The main function of the square plate on the system is to place ginseng seeds.
Just like that, the two of them planted ginseng while dragging the frame backwards, and they could probably plant fifteen to twenty feet a day.
Of course, there are also those who work fast. In Xu Shiyan's previous life, there were a couple who could grow fifty feet a day.
At present, it is impossible. The production team is full of gangs, who is willing to do that.

chapters.title: Chapter 159: see reference
chapters.content:
Chapter 159 Negotiation see reference
As soon as the ginseng is planted with a mallet, someone must watch it.
"Xiao Xu, uncle wants to discuss something with you."
After planting ginseng for two days, Yu Shouguang stopped Xu Shiyan when he came back from the mountain.
"Look, at the Xiaoheihe side, can you go up and see the ginseng?
The main thing is, this year our team’s participation area is divided into two. It will take two years for the No. 2 bridge to break camp, and someone must take care of the Xiaohei River.
I was wondering if you have experience, how about you go up? "
Yu Shouguang came to Xu Shiyan not because he was useless.
Today’s reference is not the same as before, everyone is rushing to do it.
There are ground guns and cannons on the mountain. It’s not difficult to see the participants, and you can earn high work points. Who wouldn’t like it?
But there is one thing, others can't do it, no dog.
There are more than 8,000 feet left on the No. 2 bridge. There are five or six dogs on the mountain, and they cannot be separated at all.
The dogs of each household are useless if they haven’t seen them before. Besides, there are few dogs nowadays, and at most one family can raise one.
The dogs were not familiar with each other. They stopped working after going up the mountain and just bit each other, which was useless.
Xu Shiyan's family has four dogs, and everyone in the team knows that although they haven't grown up yet, they are still working.
Yu Shouguang felt that Xu Shiyan had a stable and thoughtful personality, and he also had experience in watching ginseng. It would be no problem for him to bring four dogs up the mountain, so he came to him.
"Uncle, when you let me go up the mountain, do you only care about Dongpizi, or use me from now on?"
Xu Shiyan didn't directly agree, he had to ask clearly first.
I just planted the mallet and saw ginseng in winter this year, called frozen skin, mainly from the end of October to the end of December for two months.
In fact, the frozen skin is the best-looking, because the ginseng seeds are too small, and it is too troublesome to steal them in the field.
After pawing all night, you may not be able to get a sack. Which thief is stupid? Take a lot of effort to get some worthless ginseng seeds?
Looking at Dongpizi is just a formality, but earns a lot of work points, which is really a good deal.
But Xu Shiyan wanted to keep watching Shen.
Dividing fields to households and the household contract responsibility system were implemented in Donggang in the spring of 1983, and there are still several years left.
During this period, you can’t do it alone. It’s better to see references on the mountain and accumulate some foundation.
After the land is divided into households, if he is willing, he can also contract the reference land in the team.
At that time, hire two blind people to work on the mountain, and do something else by yourself, earning a lot of money is easy.
Two lives have been dealing with ginseng, he only knows this, nothing else.
Let him go into business and do business, but he can only do things related to ginseng.
But now the policy does not allow it, don't even think about it, so what is he doing?
Although I have some money now, it’s not enough. Lao Liu needs a lot of money to treat his illness, so I still have to work hard to make money.
So Xu Shiyan is willing to go to participate, mainly to see the attitude of the team.
If it’s just like the other end of the big house, it’s just a stopgap measure, let him come down after two months, and find someone else after a year, then he simply won’t go, saving trouble.
If he is allowed to keep reading, then he has to prepare well.
"Look at what you said. You can see that you have experience, and you made all the ground guns and cannons, so you must be using you all the time."
Yu Shouguang laughed as soon as he heard it. How could Shen change people randomly?
Which one you use is always used, and it is easy to cause accidents if you change it casually.
"That's it for this winter, you can do it yourself.
Next year, we will continue to expand from side to side, and it will take five or six thousand feet. At that time, I will find you a helper.
Wait until the year after next, the camp at the other end of the No. 2 bridge will be completely dismantled, and there will be another person here, who will be under your jurisdiction. "
Since Xu Shiyan came to the second team, he has been outstanding everywhere, and he has also brought a lot of glory to the second team.
So there is a good thing, the first thing Yu Shouguang thinks of is Xu Shiyan.
"You take the dog up the mountain, eat and drink, and the team will take care of it. After completing the work for you, the team will equip you with a semi-automatic gun.
Looking at Shen’s house, I’ll send someone to help you build it in the past two days. It must be cleared up. What do you think? Ok? "
"Uncle, you have already said so, it must be done. I have to thank Uncle, and think of me first when something good happens."
Now that we’ve talked about this, if Xu Shiyan says no to Joe, then he simply doesn’t want to stay in the Second Brigade.
"Uncle, I have one more thing to ask, the brigade's gun, I can use it for hunting, okay?
If it doesn’t work, I might as well just buy a gun myself. "
Learning lessons from the past, we must be careful. It is best to ask first, and it is a big deal to pay for a gun yourself. Why let people talk about it.
"You can really joke, kid, isn't the gun given to you just for you to command?
What if wild boars and black blind men enter the ginseng field and cause harm? Why don't you fight?
You can do it with confidence. The team will give you a certain amount of bullets every month. If it exceeds, then you can find a way to buy it yourself, okay? "
Yu Shouguang couldn't help laughing after hearing Xu Shiyan's words.
The second team has a big family, and the son can't play?
They arranged for people to go up the mountain to see the ginseng, and the guns are not allowed to be used, so what is that for? When a fire stick is used?
"Come on, with what you said, I feel relieved, then I will go home and tell my wife, pack it up for me, and I will go up the mountain to see the ginseng."
Xu Shiyan also laughed, no wonder he was too careful, didn't he suffer this loss before?
"Okay, then it's settled. Tomorrow I will send people up the mountain to build a house for you."
Yu Shouguang was relieved now, smiled and waved his hands, letting Xu Shiyan go home.
When Xu Shiyan got home, he told Su Anying about Kansan.
After listening, Su Anying didn't say anything, only sighed.
"Okay, now that you've made an agreement with Uncle Yu, what else can I say? You're doing something right, I can't stop you.
You can rest assured at home, with me and the sixth child, it will be fine.
You don’t need to worry about the child. When you come back from the mountain, he will definitely call you Dad. "
The husband is here to earn money and work hard for the family. How can a daughter-in-law hold back? Must support.
"It means that the child is young. If the child is older, I would like to go up the mountain with you. For nothing else, there are many things in the mountain."
While talking, Su Anying laughed by herself.
She actually kind of misses the situation on the mountain last year. How nice is it to draw all kinds of things back and forth?
"Well, don't even think about it, suffering on the mountain, I don't want you to suffer with your children.
We are not the same now as before. What a wonderful place Donggang is, let’s stay at home. "
Xu Shiyan reached out and rubbed his daughter-in-law's face.
Not to mention, this year Su Anying was raised at home, and her skin is better than before.
Although I didn’t get tanned before, it was still a bit rough after being exposed to the wind and sun. Now my skin is thin and smooth, and it feels really comfortable to the touch.
"Okay, take this opportunity, hurry up and hug your son more, otherwise it will take you a long time to come back."
Su Anying patted Xu Shiyan's hand away, stuffed her son into her husband's arms, and turned around to pack Xu Shiyan's clothes and luggage.
Xu Shiyan hugged his son, first opened the door to the little guy, and then picked up the little guy and threw it twice.
Xu Haiyuan is not afraid at all, he likes this kind of game very much, he giggled happily, and still muttered that he must let Xu Shiyan continue.

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Is it a rascal?
chapters.content:
Chapter 160 is a rascal?
Yu Shouguang did what he said, and he took people up the mountain the next day to cut wood and dig soil to build a house.
The small houses that can be seen on the mountain are generally not too big, with two rooms and wooden carvings.
The inside and outside are pasted with yellow mud and smoothed. The roof does not use a thatch, but is directly paved with wooden boards and nailed with linoleum paper.
The south kang in the east house is quite large, connected to the pot and stove in the outside kitchen, with a stove on the north side and a wall of fire.
After it gets cold in winter, the stove is turned on, and the stove is connected to the fire wall, which happens to heat up the house.
Anyway, most of the time, I live on the mountain until the ice and snow cover in the Gregorian calendar year, and I will go down the mountain when it gets colder. This is enough.
There were many people, the house was built quickly, and then the fire was started to ventilate.
A few days later, the kang was dry, and the wall was almost dry.
Xu Shiyan borrowed the brigade's carriage, pulled four and a half dogs, and a lot of luggage and other things up the mountain.
At the end of October, it was already a bit cold on the mountain. Xu Shiyan went up to the mountain to see ginseng, and he didn't have to worry about other things.
The jelly skin looks good, and almost no one thinks about it, that is, to take a walk around at night.
During the day, there were people working in the venue, so Xu Shiyan wandered around casually, as before, digging holes, wiring, safety guns, and tie-down guns.
If you have extra time, go to the woods and grab some walnuts, pine nuts, scallion seeds, jelly mushrooms and the like.
Pine nuts can be kept for eating or sold, and the purchase station charges 50 cents per catty for pine nuts.
Funan Forest Farm happens to have a Korean pine forest. There is no contract for the red pine forest this year, and anyone can dig the pine cones.
The people from Funan Forest Farm came here. This year happened to catch up with the big harvest of pine cones, and there were a lot of them on every tree.
Xu Shiyan tied the foot ties on his feet, tied a rope around his waist, and held a pole in his hand. He climbed up the tree like this and stabbed down the pine cone with the pole.
After poking everything on a tree, come down and pick it up. After picking up everything around the tree, climb another tree and continue poking.
Pine cones of almost two trees can hold a sack.
I went back and piled them up and slept for a few days. When I had nothing to do at night, I would knock them with wooden sticks, smash the pine cones and pick out the pine nuts.
In addition to pine nuts, Xu Shiyan's favorite pick is scallion seeds.
Next year, he plans to raise two pigs at home. If he only feeds pig grass, the pigs will not grow big or get fat.
Grass is a good thing to feed pigs. Pick up more and take them down when you go down the mountain. It’s good to keep them for feeding pigs.
It snowed late this year, and the first snow didn’t come until mid-November.
Before the snow fell, Xu Shiyan pulled a lot of seeds, and piled up several sacks in the warehouse.
It was snowing, and Xu Shiyan was not in a hurry to fight Dawei.
The main reason is that the four dogs are half-grown and have no hunting experience. You can only train slowly, not in a hurry.
Fortunately, there are a lot of traps around the field, and some gains can be made.
All pheasants and hares are often caught, and deer and roe deer are also occasionally harvested.
Once he caught a wild boar, and Xu Shiyan happened to pass by, and the shot failed. He dragged it back, packed it up and frozen it, and kept it down the mountain to take it home.
