On this day, Xu Shiyan got up early to walk the condom, only to find that there was rabbit hair on the wire loop of a rabbit harness.
And there's blood around, and some blurry footprints.
Xu Shiyan felt strange, so he walked along the trail for a while, and then found a rabbit head with a piece of rabbit skin attached.
Cooperating with the rabbit in his suit, it was stolen and eaten by some wild beast.
"Yo, there are still people who dare to steal my things? That's okay."
Xu Shiyan looked at the trace and felt strange. It is said that in the snow, the paw prints of wild beasts should be very clear. What kind of things are left behind, but they can't see clearly?
Don't worry about anything, since you dare to steal his prey, then wait to be dealt with.
So, Xu Shiyan set up a chain trap in the area where the rabbit was lost, and waited for the thing to steal the rabbit again, so that he could catch it in one fell swoop.
After waiting for a few days, several rabbits were lost, but the guy was still missing.
Xu Shiyan was a little angry, and made the cover again.
In the early morning of this day, Xu Shiyan went for a walk again, but as soon as he got near the serial condo, he heard whining noises.
Xu Shiyan immediately ran to the location of the trap, but when he got there, he saw a fox with fiery red fur was caught in the trap.
"Why is this thing again, oh my god, I'm so worried."
The last thing Xu Shiyan wants to provoke in the mountains is Hu Huang. It is said that these two types have a small face and love to hold grudges. If they are offended, they will take revenge sooner or later.
But what should I do if I have already been caught? Fortunately, he is not dead yet, so he hurried forward, untied the cover and let it go.
As a result, just as Xu Shiyan came to the front, the fire fox that was whining and whining suddenly changed its movements and began to chirp.
This voice is too familiar. The rascal who saved last year acted like a baby with him all day long, and made this noise.
Xu Shiyan paused as he undid the cover, and took a closer look at the one in front of him. The more he looked at it, the more he felt that it looked so much like the one last year.
Xu Shiyan hurried to check the guy's hind legs, and sure enough, he found an old scar on one leg.
"Rapid ghost, is that you?"
Xu Shiyan was very surprised, and he couldn't believe it.
How far is Qianchuan Sanchang along the Dongjiang River from Funan Xiaoheihe? How did the rascal wander so far?
But the injury on the leg is indeed very similar.
Lai Pigui was bitten by a wolf, and Xu Shiyan healed the wound. After the wound healed, the fur was not the same as before.
Don't worry about it, let's untie it first.
The chain cover is very troublesome, Xu Shiyan spent a lot of effort, and finally untied the cover.
Then, I saw that guy starting to circle around Xu Shiyan, making buzzing noises as he turned.
Okay, just focus on this rascal, needless to say, it must be the one from last year.
"Come on, since we met, you can come with me.
If you don’t learn well day by day, and steal the prey in other people’s traps, you will meet me. If you meet others, you will die. "
Xu Shiyan patted Huohuhu on the head angrily, reached out and picked up the back of the fox's neck, and carried it away.
It's strange to say that the fox is also a wild animal in the mountains. It's usually quite fierce, but it's biased towards Xu Shiyan, and it's very obedient.
Xu Shiyan carried it, and it wasn't fierce, so Xu Shiyan carried it obediently.
The place where the cover is placed is not too far from the Kansan Xiaofang. Xu Shiyan walked quickly and arrived in a short while.
As soon as he entered the venue, Xu Shiyan put the rascal down.
As a result, the four dogs tied over there smelled a different smell, and immediately barked.
The four dogs are the children of Dahuang and Dahei.
Rhubarb is a very good leading dog. Among the four dogs is a yellow one called Xiao Huang, who inherited his father's genes.
It also has a good fragrance and is very sensitive to the smell of prey.
This is great. Seeing the fox, Xiao Huang jumped straight up, as if he wanted to bite it.
Lai Pigui was not afraid at all, just swayed beside Xu Shiyan, and deliberately flicked its big furry tail.
A high-spirited look perfectly explained what it means to be a fox pretending to be a tiger.
"Okay, don't hang around here, go into the house quickly."
Xu Shiyan didn't know whether to laugh or cry, what the **** is he trying to become a master?

chapters.title: Chapter 161: badger hole
chapters.content:
Chapter 161 Badger Cave
The arrival of Lai Pigui made the venue lively.
The four dogs would bark in all kinds of ways whenever they saw the rascal, but the rascal had to go in front of the dog to scream.
Not only was it blowing, it also farted, and a stench came out, which made the four dogs sneeze and spin around in place.
The four dogs were still young and inexperienced after all, after being picked up by the rascals three or four times, they stopped barking when they saw the rascals again.
Turn your head and don't even pay attention to it, let the rascals walk around in front of their eyes, they don't even lift their eyelids, lest they get stinky farts.
Now, Lai Pigui is dominating the field, and he is very proud every day.
Originally, winter is the most difficult season for foxes when the land is blocked by heavy snow, the north wind howls, the weather is cold, and prey is scarce.
Most foxes curl up in soil or stone holes all day long, hugging their big fluffy tail tightly to sleep, and don't go out to look for food until they can't stand the hunger.
It's good to be here now, the rascal ghost lives in a warm hut, and with Xu Shiyan, he doesn't have to worry about eating and drinking.
That thick fire-colored fur is smooth and smooth, not to mention how beautiful it is.
Xu Shiyan didn't bother to care about it, and let the rascal wander around in the venue.
Anyway, when cooking, prepare some for the rascal at home.
Meat and vegetables should be fed together. The raw ones do not need to be cooked, and no salt is added.
Feed it once a day, and don’t feed it too fat, or when he goes down the mountain, this guy will be so fat that he can’t run, and it will hurt him instead.
Lai Pigui is very shrewd. Now that he has a house to live in and someone to take care of food and drink, he is very comfortable, and he no longer goes around the field to steal prey from the trap, and hangs around Xu Shiyan every day.
There are no springs and no wells near Canchang, and most of the draft water is snow water, or go to the nearby small river to break ice holes to carry water.
Nowadays, the environment is good, there are no cars running, and no boilers are burned.
Especially on the mountains, the snow falls and piles up so thickly that there will be no layer of dust on it.
So when Xu Shiyan is willing to move, he goes to the river to fetch water, and when he is not willing to move, he picks up some snow nearby and can cook.
This morning, Xu Shiyan had nothing to do, so he carried two buckets and wanted to go to the river to fetch some water.
When the skinny ghost saw Xu Shiyan going out, he jumped out and followed Xu Shiyan, jumping left and right.
This time, it didn't need to sweep the snow with its big tail to remove its footprints, and just had fun on the ground.
Xu Shiyan glanced at the rascals jumping all over the floor, and shook his head helplessly.
This guy really wants to become a master, and everything else is just a dog's power, which is a fox's power.
Looking at Xu Shiyan's side, it can really jump up and down, not enough for it to squat.
Xu Shiyan was slandering himself, when he suddenly saw the rascal, who didn't know what was going on, and ran forward in a hurry.
Xu Shiyan was afraid that something would happen to this guy, so he hurried after him.
I saw the fiery shadow running fast on the snowy ground, all the way south, and came to a sunny hillside.
Xu Shiyan is an old hunter anyway. Looking at the terrain, he thinks there should be badgers here.
Sure enough, I saw Lai Pigui stopped in front of a stone not far away.
There is a hole under the rock, and hoarfrost hangs on the hole. Obviously, there is something living in the hole. It is not sure if it is a badger.
Xu Shiyan put down the bucket and pole, and wandered around here.
Under the root of a big tree, another hole was found, which was also covered with hoarfrost. There should be badgers living under it.
Badgers are semi-hibernating animals. They eat a lot of fat in autumn and squat in caves to sleep in winter.
But occasionally I wake up, or come out to defecate, or find something to eat.
Badger’s cave is very delicate. There are several intricate passages inside. Each road has an exit, and each exit has a different function.
Some exits are covered with grass, moss, and soil, which can be opened at any time.
When you find a badger hole, you can dig it out directly with tools.
Badgers in winter are plump and hibernating. They move slowly and are easy to catch by opening holes.
Another way is to find all the exits and block the excess ones, leaving only two.
Then light firewood outside a hole and smoke it. The badgers inside can’t stand the smoke, so they will find an exit and run out.
The exit at the other end can be captured by keeping people or dogs guarding it.
Xu Shiyan came to fetch water today, and he didn’t bring a pickaxe. Although the soil layer wasn’t completely frozen at this time, he couldn’t dig it with his hands.
He planned to go back later, take the dogs out, smoke them, and train the dogs at home.
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan got up and picked up the bucket again, intending to carry water. No
Thinking about the rambunctious ghost, he stopped doing it, moved towards a dirt bag, made whining noises, and kept digging up the dirt with his claws.
Xu Shiyan felt strange, so he had to put down the bucket again and went to check near the soil bag.
At a glance, I understood that this should be another hole.
When I was looking for the two cave entrances just now, the rascals didn't make any movement, but they kept digging up the soil and making noises when they got here.
Xu Shiyan's heart suddenly moved. Is there a badger under this exit?
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan stopped carrying water at all, put down his pole and bucket, drew a knife from his waist, and picked up the soil with it.
It turned out that the soil was very loose, and it was easy to dig out a big hole.
Looking into the cave by the light, not far from the entrance of the cave, there are three gray, fat guys squatting, not even moving.
Xu Shiyan stretched his arms, and directly pulled out three fat badgers from the hole.
Taking a closer look, it turned out that the eyes of the three badgers were covered with gum, no matter how much they blinked, they were all blindfolded.
No matter what kind of animals, they eat crazily in autumn and accumulate a thick body of fat.
Badger’s body has a lot of heat, and badger’s nest is warm in the ground, so it’s so hot that it produces eye mucus, which sticks its eyelids.
It is estimated that the three badgers thought it was too hot, so they ran to an exit to blow a cool breeze to dissipate the heat, but they were discovered by the rascals.
It was a good time, Xu Shiyan caught the three big fat badgers alive.
Even if Badger was captured alive, it would be impossible to bring him back alive.
These things are very fierce. Although they don’t seem to like to move at the moment, it’s because they are sleepy and their eyes are blurred.
If they are brought back like this, they will have to resist within a few steps.
This thing has rough skin and thick flesh, and sharp claws. Even if it bites and scratches it, it will hurt quite badly.
I have no choice but to kill the badger and bring it back.
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, and took advantage of Badger's reaction, he directly cleaned it up with a knife.
Then he disemboweled the belly and threw the internal organs to the rascal. When the rascal was full, Xu Shiyan threw the three dead badgers into the bucket and walked back with them.
Before he walked back to the venue, he heard a dog barking. Hearing the movement, it seemed that someone was coming.
Xu Shiyan hurried back, and when he returned to the venue, he saw that it was Sun Xiaofeng who was leading Xu Shian.
"Second brother, why are you here? What's going on at home?"

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Go back to town early
chapters.content:
Chapter 162 Early return to the city
In December, the river was not completely frozen and could not be walked.
Xu Shi'an came here at this time, could it be because there is something important at home?
Xu Shiyan was startled and asked quickly.
"It's okay, everything at home is fine, I moved down, and found a house in Songjianghe to settle down with your second sister-in-law and children.
I thought about going to Donggang to find you, but my younger siblings told me that you went up the mountain to see ginseng, so I will come to the mountain to see you. "
Xu Shian was very happy to see his younger brother, and explained with a smile.
Xu Shiyan was taken aback again, feeling something was wrong.
In the previous life, both the elder brother and the second elder brother moved out of the big house before the spring of 1979.
It’s only December 1978, why did the second brother move down?
"Let's go, second brother, go into the house and say, what's going on at home? You moved down, where's the big brother?"
If the second child can move down, it means that the second sister-in-law can return to the city, the second sister-in-law can return to the city, and the eldest sister-in-law can too.
The eldest brother’s family will definitely move down too, where are the parents? Where are parents?
Xu Shiyan was full of doubts, and led Sun Xiaofeng and Xu Shian into the small room.
When the rascal ghost saw an outsider, he hid for a long time and didn't show up at all.
The three of them entered the room and sat down. Xu Shiyan poured two glasses of water for them, and then asked in detail.
’ “Second brother, please tell me in detail, is there something going on at the other end of the big house?”
"Brother Xu, you don't know about it on the mountain, it has been spread everywhere else.
Hu Liancheng of the big house concealed the reduction in grain production and did not report it. In order to pay the quota in full, he deducted the rations of the members.
The commune members didn't have enough food, so they made a fuss in the county.
Not only Dongjiangyan, but also the Xigang Commune has mobilized a group of people. "
Before Xu Shian could speak, Sun Xiaofeng spoke first.
Donggang Commune and Xigang Commune are next to each other, and the Xijiang, Xinhua, and Yanjiang brigades are just across from Dongjiangyan. If something happened on the other side of Dongjiangyan, this side will know soon.
It's just that no one has been working on the mountain recently, so no one has sent a letter to Xu Shiyan, he just doesn't know.
Logically, it should be in November every year, and the work on the mountain is about the same, so the annual work points should be settled, and the food should be distributed to each household.
Wait until the end of December, when the dried sticks are sold, and the money will be divided.
But the Dongjiangyan Brigade has been dragging its feet and not giving settlement work points, nor giving food.
After inquiring, Hu Liancheng did not dare to report the loss due to a 30% reduction in production this year due to the frost, and his superiors did not give a quota reduction task.
Hu Lian became the quota payer and deducted the big guys' rations.
Now, the people from Dongjiangyan made a fuss, and made a fuss in the county, revealing the matter.
It was a coincidence that the higher-ups just sent a working group down for the second time to check some things.
Now it’s all right, Hu Liancheng, together with Cao Mingchuan, and several people from the Xigang Commune and the county have been dug out.
"It seems that someone wrote a material to report Cao Mingchuan.
When the working group came down for the first time, it was suppressed, and this was the second time.
Afterwards, many things were dug out. This time, Cao Mingchuan was completely finished. "Xu Shi'an gloated.
"Third brother, you don't know yet, do you? The gangster caught last year was the one surnamed Cao, who is still related to Cao Mingchuan.
It seems that he has something to do with everyone in the county, otherwise can he be so arrogant? "
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan roughly understood what was going on.
The letter he wrote didn't work the first time it was suppressed, but somehow it still left a clue.
It happened that this time the Dongjiangyan brigade was making a fuss, and someone dug out a string along the line.
"That's not right, second brother, what does this have to do with your moving? There are policies from above? Second sister-in-law can go back to the city?"
Xu Shiyan suddenly recalled that something was wrong.
He remembers very clearly that the policy will only come out next year, Wei Mingrong and Xue Xiulin are not eligible to return to the city now, how did they move out?
Hearing his younger brother's question, Xu Shi'an could only sigh, and explained the matter clearly.
It turned out that since Xu Shiyan moved away, the Xu family had been squeezed out along the Dongjiang River. When Xu Shixiang also moved out of his household registration, Hu Liancheng became even worse.
Found an excuse to dismiss Xu Shixian's errands, and Xu Shian was always assigned the most tiring and low-paying jobs.
Xu Chenghou quarreled with Hu Liancheng several times and almost got into a fight, but they still couldn't solve the problem, and they could only get more and more tense.
Because of these things, both Xu Shixian and Xu Shian had the idea of ​​moving.
It happened that they also had money in their hands, so they asked the daughter-in-law to go back to her natal family to make connections.
Finally got the quota to go back to the city, but Hu Liancheng was stuck, saying that he did not comply with the regulations, so Xu Cheng generously took his son and beat Hu Liancheng and his son.
Hu Liancheng framed Xu Chenghou and his son because of this, saying that the three thousand catties of dung dried by the brigade disappeared, and Xu Chenghou must have stolen it and scattered it on Xu's private plot.
No one believed this story, everyone took it as a joke.
Just in time for the ration matter, Xu Chenghou took the lead, joined forces with Zhao Dahai and Yu Shanhai, and mobilized everyone along the Dongjiang River to bring down Hu Liancheng.
After that, Xu Shian and Xu Shixian took the opportunity to move out of Dongjiangyan, and moved to Songjianghe with their wife.
"My eldest brother's registered permanent residence is in the Evergreen Vegetable Team, and I'm in the Dongzhan Vegetable Team.
Both of us have just moved out for a few days, looking for someone else’s house to live in temporarily, and then buying or looking for a place to build a house. " Xu Shi'an finally finished.
After hearing what the second brother said, Xu Shiyan changed his face immediately.
"The two of you moved out with your wife and children, and left our father and mother in that crappy place in the big house, right?"
Damn, these two brothers really know how to do things, leave their parents alone, and they just moved away?
Xu Shian scratched his head when he heard this, "What's the matter? My eldest brother and I both settled down with our wife, and it took a lot of effort to land in the food team.
Our father and mother did not comply with the regulations, they moved out, where is the registered permanent residence? "
The vegetable team is an agricultural team directly under the Forestry Bureau. It mainly grows vegetables for the employees of the Forestry Bureau in the town to eat.
Although it may seem that they are doing agricultural work, they belong to urban household registration, and they also eat food supplies.
This household registration is not easy to obtain. The Xue family and the Wei family have spent a lot of work and relied on favors to get the uncle's household registration.
To tell the truth, they really couldn't afford to register for Xu Chenghou and his wife again.
"You never thought that the relatives of Hu Liancheng's family are all along the Dongjiang River.
This time, it was my father who took the lead and brought Hu Liancheng down. You all moved away. Our father and mother are there, will they be bullied in the future? "
Xu Shiyan stared at Xu Shian, gritted his teeth angrily.
"Even if you can't arrange parents, at least you can send me a letter."
Others can't arrange it, but Xu Shiyan can.
Just send him a letter, and he will find a way to let the old couple move out together.
Even if they settle in Donggang, there is always a place to go, why can't they just leave the old couple behind?
The son and daughter are not around, let the old couple stay in that crappy place along the Dongjiang River, what can I do if something happens?

chapters.title: Chapter 163: pick up
chapters.content:
Chapter 163 Receiving people
"Can't you? Uncle Zhao has resumed work, with him here, who would dare to bully our parents?
The old couple are also in good health, what can happen? "Xu Shi'an was inexplicably trained by his younger brother.
"Didn't you leave our family behind and move out, so why are you allowed to move and others are not allowed?"
Xu Shiyan laughed angrily at what the second brother said, "Second brother, what do you want me to say?
When I moved, our brothers were all in the big house.
Even if I move out, you and I will still be there, not leaving a lonely old couple. "
In the previous life, the brothers moved away one after another, leaving the old couple and Xu Shiyan in the big house.
In this life, Xu Shiyan deliberately moved away first, not because he didn't want to provide for his parents, but because he wanted to seize an opportunity to save these people from throwing his parents to him.
As a result, there was no chance to throw it to him this time, so the old couple was thrown in the big house.
"Why didn't you think about it, Uncle Zhao can still stare at our parents with good eyes?
If those **** want to harm people, will they do it openly?
As long as they do something bad secretly, our parents are old, can we still prevent them? "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, these two brothers have never experienced it, how do they know how bad those people in the big house can be?
"Besides, our father and mother have been living with their sons and grandchildren, and they are used to being lively.
This sudden move away, you are not afraid of their panic? What's wrong with flashing again?
The two of them were in that crappy place, and they really had a headache. There was no errand around them, and it was hard to send us a letter. "
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes at his second brother and sighed.
"Xiaofeng, how did you get here?" Xu Shiyan didn't want to talk to his second brother anymore, so he turned to ask Sun Xiaofeng.
"Cycling, I borrowed a bicycle from my second brother, and we came here by bicycle."
Sun Xiaofeng didn't understand what Xu Shiyan asked, so he just answered truthfully.
"Do my brother a favor, live on the mountain for two days, mainly to take care of the dog.
I have to go back to do some errands, at most three days, I promise to come back. "
Xu Shiyan had to hurry down the mountain to arrange for his parents.
In the previous life, the old man refused to move down, because there were not so many disturbing things, and there was Xu Shiyan by his side.
This life is different, if the old couple are still left there, if something happens, the brothers will regret it to death.
"Brother Xu, don't worry about going down the mountain to do errands. I'll help you look at this end. You can just tell my wife later."
The two families are next to each other, and they have a good relationship. They just helped to watch on the mountain for two days. At this time, the land was covered by heavy snow. In fact, it doesn’t matter if no one is watching.
"Okay, this is the badger I just caught this morning, you can deal with it, if you really don't know how to clean it, just throw it outside and freeze it.
The dogs fed them corn noodles.
The main reason is that there is a fox, who has gone to nowhere at the moment, just don’t hit it when you see it.
It was rescued by me before, and it has been living on the mountain shamelessly, and I didn't drive it away. "
Xu Shiyan had to explain the matter clearly, especially Lapigui, if he didn't explain clearly, he was afraid that Sun Xiaofeng would beat him if he saw it.
Most people who run in the mountains don't provoke Hu Huang, but some people don't believe in evil, and they only point to catching yellow skins and foxes to make money.
A piece of yellow skin can be sold for twelve yuan, and a piece of fox skin can be sold for more than twenty or nearly thirty.
"Oh, I see, Brother Xu, don't worry, I won't provoke it."
Sun Xiaofeng hurriedly nodded in response. His family members have said since he was a child that those things should not be provoked, and he remembered it.
"Second brother, go, come down the mountain with me."
Xu Shiyan got dressed, called Xu Shian, and the two of them rode down the mountain.
When Xu Shiyan went up the mountain to see the ginseng, he also brought his bicycle up, just for the convenience of going down the mountain.
Riding a bike in the winter is actually a pain, but I don’t care about that right now.
Xu Shiyan pedaled the car and ran all the way, returned to Donggang Commune, and went straight to the Second Brigade to find Yu Shouguang.
When Yu Shouguang met Xu Shiyan, he thought something happened on the mountain.
After hearing it, it turned out that Xu Shiyan wanted to take over his parents, so he agreed without saying a word.
"It's just such a small matter, why do you need to say it in advance? You just take your parents over, and I will settle down."
Slowly say that Xu Shiyan's father is not too old to work, even if he can't work, if he wants to move here, he has to be settled.
With Yu Shouguang's words, Xu Shiyan was relieved, so he returned the car that Xu Shian borrowed.
Then he went home, talked to Su Anying, then went to the next door to talk to Sun Xiaofeng's wife and parents, and then went to Songjianghe.
At this time, the river hadn’t completely frozen, so Xu Shiyan didn’t dare to leave, so he had to take a car to Jewel Hill, and then walk from Jewel Hill to the big house.
"Okay, put the bike at your place first, and I'll go find you when I come back."
Xu Shian took Xu Shiyan to the train station by bicycle, just as a slow train was about to leave.
So he bought a ticket and entered the station, turned around and told Xu Shian, then got on the bus and left.
The slow train wobbled to Zhugegang, Xu Shiyan got off, went straight to Qingling, and then to the big house.
When he entered the village, someone greeted him, and he answered a few words casually, then hurried home.
Walking into the gate, before he even got to the door of the house, he heard the movement of his father.
"Everyone has no conscience, if they say move away, they will all move away, leaving us here.
I read it, raising sons is all for nothing, and they are all raised by others.
The fourth child moved to the camp, and the old Wu's family moved there.
Now the eldest and the second are also defecting to the father-in-law's family, and the sons I have raised for so many years are all grown-ups. "
No need to guess, this must be the old man complaining at home.
"Who do you blame? The third child has mentioned to you several times, saying that you are not happy to let you move to Donggang.
It’s all right now, they’ve all moved away, and we’re the only ones left here, hanging on trees, right? "
Another voice was naturally Zhou Guilan.
Through the door, Xu Shiyan heard it from outside, and felt that his heart was not very strong.
Everyone talks about raising children for old age, but in the end, how many can you really count on?
In his previous life, he was with his parents in the big house.
At that time, he was scolded by his father all day long, and he was blamed for being useless. He was indeed panicked, and he always wanted to compete with his father.
But really waiting for the old man to pass away, it seems that he is the one who cries the most.
With parents, there is still a place to come from, but without parents, where is the way back in life?
Those who have never experienced it will never understand.
A father and a mother are the only family. No matter how old he is, he still hopes that someone can call him Saner.
"Dad, Mom, I'm back." Xu Shiyan calmed down, opened the door and entered the room, and shouted into the room.
In the east room, Xu Chenghou, who was complaining, immediately put on his shoes and went out of the room when he heard the sound of his third son.
"San'er? Why are you back at this time? Didn't I hear people say that you are watching the scene on the mountain?"
Xu Chenghou's face was full of surprise, "What's wrong? What happened on the mountain?" The old man couldn't help but worried, and hurriedly asked.
"Father, it's fine on the mountain. I'll pick you up and live in Donggang." Xu Shiyan smiled at his father and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: make sense
chapters.content:
Chapter 164 Talking through
As soon as he heard that his third son was going to take them to Donggang, Xu Chenghou's eyes lit up, and then he shook his head again.
"No, the big house is pretty good. Your mother and I will live here for the elderly, and we won't go anywhere."
Xu Shiyan couldn't help but rolled his eyes, this is his family's stubborn old man, his stubborn father.
Mingming couldn't be more happy in his heart, but he had to keep his mouth shut, and he wanted to save face and suffer.
"If you don't go, I'll take my mother away." Xu Shiyan deliberately angered his father.
"Do you dare?" Xu Chenghou immediately stared at him, what's the matter?
He can't even cook a meal, and without his old wife by his side, he can't starve to death, can he?
Xu Shiyan ignored the stubborn old man, went into the east room and sat beside his mother.
"Mom, I'm here to discuss something with you. Do you think you and my father will move to Donggang?"
Zhou Guilan was in the room, and had already heard the conversation between the two men.
Knowing that the third son was going to pick them up, Zhou Guilan was very happy from the bottom of her heart, but she still had a lot of scruples, so she didn't nod directly, but looked at Xu Chenghou.
"San'er, why are you running back so well, are you going to pick us up to Donggang?"
Zhou Guilan can't be like her husband, who just opens her mouth to smack people. Xu Chenghou can't speak, so she has to speak well.
"It's nothing, didn't you hear from my second brother that they all moved away? I'm a little worried that you two stay in the big house.
It's too far away from us, and this end is crappy, you said it would be troublesome for us to come back. "
Xu Shiyan knew that if he wanted his parents to move out, he had to talk to his mother first.
"What are you worried about? Your mother and I are not too old to move, so don't worry about it.
We are having a good time, without you bothering me, it is quiet. "
Before Zhou Guilan could speak, Xu Chenghou on the other end sat on the edge of the kang, picked up a cigarette pouch, knocked it, and hummed.
"We two old guys are living a good life, and we won't be down to the point of going to you.
Don't think about anything, just watch your ginseng on the mountain, don't lose your errand, it's better than anything else. "
The old man used the strongest tone and said caring words, just such an awkward person.
Xu Shiyan took a deep breath, resisting the urge to quarrel with the old man, who told him to have such a father?
No matter what, even if Dad can’t, Mom still has to.
He didn't hesitate to argue with that stubborn old man, he had already gotten used to his virtues in two lifetimes.
"Mom, do you think this is okay? You move in first and live with me.
Didn’t I go up the mountain to see ginseng? There are only Lao Liu and Yingzi at home. To be honest, I am not at ease. If you go with them as companions, at least I can feel at ease on the mountain. "
Xu Shiyan didn't even look at his father, so he told his mother. Of course, this was actually for his father.
"Hukou, I will give it to you alone, not with me.
After the new year, I will go to the team to approve a homestead for you two, and build a few houses in the spring.
The fifth child hasn’t talked about his daughter-in-law yet, and the sixth child hasn’t left the house yet, why can’t they have a happy event with me, right? "
Xu Shiyan can actually understand the old man's thoughts. The old man must be worried that if they move there, it will be tantamount to defecting to the third son.
In the future, with the third son, how will the fifth son and the old daughter be arranged in the future?
No matter how bad the big house is, this is Xu Chenghou's home, and he is the master of the house.
The old son and the old daughter are not married yet, for them, the old man must also stay.
How can a younger brother or sister hold a wedding at the elder brother's house? There is no such rule.
"If your two elders are willing, you can find a place a little closer to my house, so that my mother can help take care of Yuanyuan when she is free.
Either this spring or autumn, and I'm not at home, Yingzi would be too busy with other things at home. "
Finally, Xu Shiyan resorted to his trump card and moved his son out.
Kissing each other from generation to generation is absolutely true. In his previous life, the old man didn't like to see Xu Shiyan so much, but he was very rare for the three children in the family.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan looked at each other. In fact, the two had already been tempted, but they had too many worries and couldn't just say yes.
But the son has already talked about this. If they take Joe again, it will be a bit too much.
"Didn't you tell me to coax the children earlier? Talking a bunch of nonsense, this sentence is the most useful."
Xu Chenghou went down the donkey along the slope, and nodded in agreement.
"Old woman, shall we move around and coax our grandson?"
Older people, who doesn't care about excitement?
Especially the Xu family, who have always been with their children and grandchildren, and moved away so suddenly, the old couple felt very uncomfortable in their hearts, otherwise Xu Chenghou wouldn't be angry at home.
Zhou Guilan wanted to agree a long time ago, but because of her husband's face, he had to nod first.
Seeing her husband's attitude change now, Zhou Guilan also laughed.
"Why not? I've had enough of this place, and besides, I'm also thinking about Yuanyuan.
Is that little guy able to crawl all over the kang now? It must have been fun. "
Xu Shiyan scratched his head, "I've been on the mountain for a while, I really don't know if he can climb it, it should be almost the same.
Going down the mountain today, I went home and got a haircut. I told Yingzi that I didn't even hug the child, so I came by car. "
To be honest, Xu Shiyan also misses his son, but there is no other way. Earning money is the most important thing. If you don’t earn money, how can you support your wife and children?
Not to mention that the child is fine, but when it comes to talking about it, the old couple are a little impatient, they are all thinking about the baby.
The three of them discussed it. At this time, the river was not really frozen, and it was not easy to move.
It’s better for the old couple to go to Donggang first, help coax the children and take care of the house. After a while, the river is frozen, and then come back to move.
At that time, it was time for the team to divide the money. After dividing the money, I opened a household registration, moved directly, and stopped playing here.
Xu Shiyan thinks it's good to deal with it this way, at least give the two elders a time to adapt.
If the two of them really don't get used to going to Donggang, that's fine, so send them back.
It shouldn't be so. Su Anying got along well with her in-laws in her previous life, and it's impossible for her to get along too badly in this life.
Anyway, it’s only one winter, and when spring begins, we will definitely find another house for the old couple.
Other Xu Shiyan can do it, but on this point, he must insist.
After all, his parents raised him once, and taking care of him is a matter of course, but the division must be clearly distinguished and cannot be confused.
It's already this time, there is probably no train back, so Xu Shiyan can only stay at home for one night.
Zhou Guilan hurried to arrange food, and after eating, the three of them started to pack things.
The old couple went there, and at least they had to bring luggage and a change of clothes, and there were a lot of things.
The next morning, Xu Chenghou went to his neighbor and asked him to come over every day to help burn the kang.
At the beginning of spring, the family caught two pigs, but later it was frosty and the crops in the field did not grow well. Xu Chenghou was worried that there would not be enough food, so he sold them to others.
There are only two chickens left in the house, so they put them in their pockets and took them away.
Then, the three of them set off with luggage, clothes and other things on their shoulders. They still went from Qingling to Jewelry Gang, and then took the slow train from Jewelry Hill to Songjianghe.

chapters.title: Chapter 165: settle down
chapters.content:
Chapter 165 Settlement
The family of three got off the train and went directly to the north of the station.
Xu Shian's husband's family is just north of the station. After Xu Shian returned to the city with his wife, he also found a house nearby to live in.
It was very close, so Xu Shiyan had to push the bicycle back first.
Xu Shi'an and his wife saw that the third child really brought his parents here, and they felt a little flustered.
There is really no place to settle down here, and there is nothing they can do.
Although Xu Shi'an has settled in the vegetable team, he can't make money without work in winter.
Although Wei Mingrong has arranged a job, he has only been at work for a few days, so he really cannot afford to support so many people.
Xu Shiyan saw what his brother and sister-in-law were thinking, and didn't say anything else. He just told them that his parents lived in Donggang for the time being, and he would go to Donggang to look for things in the future.
After that, Xu Shiyan led his parents back to the station, found a donkey jeep, and chartered a car to take them back to Donggang.
The donkey cart dangled to the east of Donggang Martyrs' Tomb, stopped in front of Xu's house, and then the three of them carried all their things into the courtyard.
As soon as she entered the yard, Su Anying saw it from the window, and hurried out to help carry things.
"Father, Mom, I finally hoped for you to come. Shiyan went up to the mountain to see ginseng, and my sixth son and I were at home. To be honest, I was a little scared at night."
Su Anying said this on purpose. In fact, the law and order in Donggang is not bad.
Zhou Qingguo is the security assistant of Donggang Commune and the company commander of the militia.
Yu Shouguang also secretly asked the neighbors and the neighbors in front to take more care of the Xu family.
So Xu Shiyan left home these days, everything at home is quite stable.
But for Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan, hearing what their daughter-in-law said, the old couple felt needed.
It seems that they are quite useful and not trash, so I am very happy in my heart.
"Oh, what are you doing out here? Where's Yuanyuan? He can crawl now, right? Don't fall to the ground."
Xu Chenghou suddenly thought of this matter, and he didn't care about it anymore, and rushed into the room in a few steps.
As a result, as soon as I entered the house and saw my grandson, I was immediately happy.
Su Anying piled up the quilt to block the outside, and blocked Xu Haiyuan in the kang. At this moment, Xu Haiyuan is trying to crawl out.
The little guy who is less than eight months old has just learned how to climb, and he is not yet that capable of climbing over mountains and mountains.
Xu Haiyuan's face was flushed with exhaustion, and he still refused to give up, wanting to conquer the quilt mountain in front of him.
"Hey, my good grandson, what are you doing?"
The moment he saw his grandson, Xu Chenghou burst into a smile on his old face.
Throwing it casually, throwing the luggage roll on the ground casually, taking off the cotton hat, leaning in front of Xiaowa, and making eye contact with Xiaowa.
Xu Haiyuan hasn't seen his grandfather for a long time, how can he recognize him?
But this baby didn't recognize his life, stared at the old man in front of him with big eyes, and blinked several times.
Maybe it's the nature of the blood, or maybe it's because the baby loves to laugh naturally, looking at the strange old man, he didn't cry, but grinned instead.
Baby's smile made Xu Chenghou feel his heart melt, and he hurried forward and reached out to hug his grandson.
"Yuanyuan, I am Grandpa Ni, let Grandpa hold you for a while."
The old man didn't even take off his coat, just hugged Xu Haiyuan like this, put Xu Haiyuan on his lap, looked left and right, the more he looked at it, the more he liked it.
"It's still Yingzi who will take care of the children, look at how chubby Yuanyuan is raised?
My God, this little face is grunting, why is it so rare? "Xu Chenghou rarely praised his third daughter-in-law.
Su Anying didn't speak at the side, just pursed her lips and smiled.
After being married for such a long time, Su Anying has also figured out her father-in-law's temper.
This old man just has an unforgiving mouth, no matter how good the words come out of his mouth, it won't sound so good.
It would be nice to be able to boast like this.
"Mom, put everything down quickly, I've packed everything here, you and my father live in the east room.
If Shiyan doesn’t come back, I will live in the West House with my sixth son. When Shiyan comes back, my sixth son will move to the East House. "
Su Anying took the two bags from Zhou Guilan's hand and put them on the kang.
"No, no, I'll just live in the Westinghouse with your father. How hard is it to move around?"
Zhou Guilan quickly waved her hands when she heard that, they just came to live for a while, so it doesn't matter which room they sleep in? What is East House West House, not those particular about.
"That's not allowed, the old man lives in the east room, this is the rule.
If I let your elders live in the Westinghouse, let alone others, my parents will scold me if they find out later. "
Su Anying smiled, and helped Zhou Guilan to sit on the edge of the kang. This has been the rule since ancient times, the elders of the family live in the upper house.
It has always been like this when people get along with each other, fighting for what is lacking and giving way for what is more than enough.
The daughter-in-law and mother-in-law are fighting each other, and if they have to compete, the family will have to fly around all day long and have no stable life.
If the daughter-in-law and mother-in-law give way to each other and are polite, the family will be harmonious.
A mother-in-law is not a mother, and a daughter-in-law is not a girl. It is impossible to get along really close.
Especially for the new daughter-in-law, it is even more necessary to give in to each other and adapt slowly.
Su Anying separated from Xu's family on the first day she married. Except for the confinement period, she didn't live with her in-laws much.
But Su Anying has a good temper, she can get along well with her stepmother in her natal family, so naturally she won't treat her in-laws badly.
If the rules that should be observed are well followed, and no one else can find faults, that's fine.
"Mom, just do what Yingzi said, you and my dad live in the east room.
I can only stay at home during the period from the twelfth lunar month to the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, and I have to go up the mountain for the rest of the time. It is more convenient for us to live in the Westinghouse. "
Xu Shiyan is naturally standing with his wife. As long as the family is harmonious, isn't it all the same?
Waiting for next year, houses will also be built here, and five rooms will be built directly. At that time, there will be plenty of space, and you can live in any house you like.
Son and daughter-in-law said so, and Xu Chenghou and his wife were also very happy, so they agreed with the flow.
It's not too early now, and it's not far from dark, so Xu Shiyan can't go up the mountain again at this time, so he can simply stay at home for one night.
It happened that Xu Shiqin also came back from get off work, and when he saw his parents came, Xu Shiqin was also very happy, holding Zhou Guilan tightly and insisting on sleeping with his mother at night.
Zhou Guilan had to make fun of her daughter, but Xu Shiqin refused to follow her, and acted like a baby with her mother in her arms.
Xu Haiyuan is very familiar with the little aunt. Seeing the little aunt hugging an old lady, the little guy didn't know what to think, so he pushed hard towards Xu Shiqin.
Stretched out his small hand and called out to Xu Shiqin, insisting that Xu Shiqin hug him.
"You little brat, that's your grandma, and you're still arguing with your grandma."
Xu Shiqin hurried over, picked up the little nephew, smacked the little nephew on the face, and then sat next to the mother with the little nephew in his arms.
Xu Haiyuan raised his head, looked at Zhou Guilan for a while, and then reached out to Zhou Guilan for a hug.
But Zhou Guilan was so happy that she hugged her grandson in her arms, "Do you still recognize grandma? You were just born, and grandma is holding you."
Zhou Guilan opened the door with her grandson, and the funny little guy laughed and laughed. For a while, the room was full of laughter, not to mention how lively it was.

chapters.title: Chapter 166: live sable
chapters.content:
Chapter 166 The Living Sable
Xu Shiyan stayed at home for one night. On the morning of December 11th, he rode his bicycle and brought some food and hurried up the mountain to replace Sun Xiaofeng.
Sun Xiaofeng lives quite comfortably on the mountain.
The three badgers were skinned by him, the fat meat was boiled in oil, and the lean meat was stewed with carrots.
Seeing Xu Shiyan's return, Sun Xiaofeng still sighed that he could no longer live on the mountain.
Xu Shiyan brought Sun Xiaofeng two hares, a piece of wild pork, and a small jar of badger seed oil for him.
This badger seed oil is a good thing. It is very effective in treating burns and scalds without leaving scars.
Moreover, it can also cure chilblain. Apply badger seed oil to the frostbite and bake it on the fire. The badger seed oil will be absorbed by the skin, and the chilblain will heal slowly.
"Brother, don't say anything polite, take these back and feed them to your family."
Sun Xiaofeng refused, but Xu Shiyan forced it to him.
Finally, Sun Xiaofeng could only accept it, and pushed the car away.
"By the way, Brother Xu, I haven't seen the fox you mentioned, and I don't know where it went."
Before leaving, Sun Xiaofeng suddenly remembered this, and hurriedly told Xu Shiyan.
"Oh, it doesn't matter, I probably ran out to play."
Xu Shiyan wasn't worried at all, that skinny ghost was so smart and smart, he must have known there were outsiders in the venue and refused to come back.
As expected, in the evening, the rascal came back with a pheasant in his mouth.
Xu Shiyan returned to the mountain, and everything returned to normal. Get up early every day and take a walk around the covers, traps, and traps.
Eat breakfast or lead a few dogs into the mountains, and shoot whatever prey they meet.
Or go to the pine forest on the high mountain to trap sables and squirrels, or go to the river to find otter nests to hunt otters.
If Xu Shiyan leads the dog out, the rascal will not follow, and will stay at home honestly.
If Xu Shiyan went out by himself, Lai Pigui would not leave him at all, and had to cling to Xu Shiyan.
Not to mention, it is really useful to bring this guy, the fox's sense of smell and hearing are very good, better than dogs.
You can evade in time when you encounter danger, and you can also help Xu Shiyan find the nests of otters, raccoons, and badgers.
With such a right-hand assistant, Xu Shiyan's harvest is also exceptionally rich, and he has accumulated a lot of skins.
On this day, Xu Shiyan stepped on his skis to go for a walk in the pine forest on the mountain again, and the rascal followed him.
When he came to the pine forest on the top of the mountain, Xu Shiyan searched for the location where he was trapped.
Two places were empty after walking, but before reaching the third one, Rapier suddenly jumped out.
Xu Shiyan didn't know what happened, so he quickly followed.
As a result, when I came to the third clip, I saw a little guy the size of a house cat, covered in tan.
The little guy has a slender body, short and thin limbs, and fluffy tail hair. The brown hair is mixed with sparse white guard hairs. Under the chin, there is a row of yellow-orange throat spots.
This little guy is none other than the sable, one of the three treasures of Northeast China.
The sable is not dead yet, it is screaming.
The clip that Xu Shiyan put down caught one of the sable's hind legs.
Lai Pigui was about to bite it, so frightened Xu Shiyan hurriedly shouted, "Wait a minute, don't bite it."
It is rare to meet a live sable, how could Xu Shiyan be willing to kill him?
Hurriedly stepped forward, snatched the sable from the rascal's mouth, broke off the clip, and hugged the little guy in his arms.
The little guy was injured on his hind leg, and was frightened again. After being picked up by Xu Shiyan, his whole body trembled with fright.
When Xu Shiyan saw this, he put the sable on his chest with leggings. The little guy's leg was injured, and besides, there was a rascal staring at him, so he couldn't run away.
After catching a live sable, Xu Shiyan suddenly had an idea, perhaps, he could take this little guy back to raise it.
This is a female mink. If it can be domesticated successfully, and then catch a male again, can it be artificially bred?
The idea is quite good, and it may be difficult to implement it, but you can try it.
Aren’t the raw materials of the mink coats of later generations all farmed? Others can raise it, why can't he?
Xu Shiyan was thinking in his heart, but he didn't stop on his feet. He continued to step on the skis and looked at all the clips he had set before.
Two of them were triggered but they didn’t gain anything. They had to get up and find a place to resettle.
The rest are not triggered, stay there, no one knows when they will come in handy.
Walking around, Xu Shiyan got a live sable, Xu Shiyan was very happy, and led Lai Pigui back to the Kansan Xiaofang.
As soon as he entered the house, Xu Shiyan quickly released the sable from his arms to treat its injuries.
The sable's hind leg was pinched off and needs to be boned.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help it, he was easily connected, and he found a wooden bar to compare with, and wrapped it with a rope.
"You watch it for me, don't let it run away, but don't bite it, do you hear me?"
As soon as Xu Shiyan looked up, he saw Lai Pigui staring straight at the sable.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly patted the rascal on the head, and then went to find food for it, not allowing it to play tricks on the sable.
Sure enough, the rascal had something to eat, so he stopped staring at the sable.
The sable was probably frightened, laying on the ground, not daring to move, just staring around with big round eyes.
Xu Shiyan hurried out, went to the warehouse to find No. 8 wire and thin wire, used pliers and other tools to weave a cage, and then put the sable into the cage.
In this way, the sable can't run away, and the rascal can't bite.
Since he caught a live sable, Xu Shiyan became more attentive. He went for a walk in the pine forest on the mountain every two days, hoping to catch another male.
There are not many sables on the mountain, how can there be so many coincidences? Can you still meet a live sable?
Only one time was caught, but Xu Shiyan was late, and the sable was dying and could not be saved.
Regarding this, Xu Shiyan is not discouraged, no matter whether he is dead or alive, as long as there is something to gain, anyway, he will only be fed, and he will slowly find a way in the future.
In the blink of an eye, there were still a few days left in December of 1978, and the lunar calendar was at the end of the winter month.
The north wind is howling, the sky is freezing, and the ginseng land on the mountain is already frozen hard.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about his family, especially about his parents moving, so he didn't wait until the twelfth lunar month, so he packed up his things and prepared to go down the mountain.
"I have to go down the mountain, what should I do on the mountain?
I don’t dare to take you home, if you go to steal other people’s chickens, wouldn’t it be a disaster? "
Looking at the rascal, Xu Shiyan was in trouble. Should he bring the rascal down the mountain together?
Take it with you, for fear that this guy will go back and cause trouble. There are chickens in the village. If he steals it, he will die if he is caught.
Even if you don’t steal chickens, once someone finds out, you will be doomed.
But if you don’t take it down the mountain, leave it on the mountain without anyone taking care of it.
Lai Pigui seemed to understand Xu Shiyan's words, looked at Xu Shiyan, walked around him twice, then turned and ran away.
Xu Shiyan was relieved to see Lai Pigui running away.
This guy is a ghost, he has his own way of living, so don't worry too much.

chapters.title: Chapter 167: owed baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 167 The Owned Baby
Xu Shiyan was in a hurry to move his parents, so he temporarily locked pine nuts, walnuts, scallion seeds and other mountain products in the warehouse.
There are not many opportunities to play Dawei this winter, after all, Gouzi is too young and inexperienced.
He also killed two wild boars, once killed Heixiazicang, and also killed a deer and two roe deer.
It was because of the rambunctious ghost that he saved a lot of skins and put them in a big bag.
Xu Shiyan planned to go up again after moving house, looking for sledges to pull things, so this time the meat in the downhill belt was not particularly large.
Xu Shiyan rode a bicycle and walked slowly in front, with a leather sack on the back seat.
There is a cage hanging on the handlebar, and in the cage is the sable.
He went down the mountain and no one fed the sables, so he wouldn’t starve to death? So just take it home.
Four dogs followed behind pulling the sledge. The sledge was loaded with some food, and it was not heavy. The dogs could easily pull the sledge and run.
It was about thirty miles from Xiaoheihe Sanchang to Donggang. Xu Shiyan stopped several times on the way to let the dogs rest.
By the time they got home, it was already noon.
"Daughter-in-law, I'm back." Xu Shiyan yelled as soon as he entered the door, and then saw Su Anying coming out of the room.
"How is the family? How are our parents? How about our son?"
Xu Shiyan was also very happy to see his daughter-in-law. He really wanted to hug her and kiss her, but in this yard, there are still parents at home, so bear with it.
"Our father went back to the big house a few days ago, and the money should be settled there. He said to go back and pack up, and after the money was divided, he opened a household registration so that he could move."
Su Anying was also very happy to see her husband come back, and came forward to help Xu Shiyan untie the sledge, and took the dog to the kennel outside the barn to tie it up.
Then the two of them moved all the things down. They should put them in the warehouse, and take the rest into the house.
"Hey, is this a live sable? Did you catch a live sable? Are you planning to raise it again?"
Su Anying followed Xu Shiyan on the mountain for a winter, gained knowledge and learned a lot.
So I recognized at a glance that the little thing in the cage, about the size of a domestic cat, was a sable.
"Well, I caught it while walking the trap that day, and my leg was broken.
I am not willing to kill it, I plan to raise it, this is a female, and when I have a chance in the future, I will catch a male again, and they will be able to give birth to cubs. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and took off the wire cage, and handed it to his wife to carry. He carried a big bag of skins, and the two entered the house together.
In the east room, Zhou Guilan was playing with Xu Haiyuan in her arms.
Xu Haiyuan can grow up now, he can climb the whole kang, and he can fall to the ground if he is not careful, so now he dare not leave people.
Su Anying and Zhou Guilan changed shifts and looked at the little guy, afraid that he would fall to the ground and something bad would happen.
"Mom, I'm back."
Xu Shiyan entered the east room, took off his hat and coat, sat in front of his mother, and talked to his mother while reaching out to tease his son.
"How is living here? Are you still used to it?"
"Then what are you not used to? Everything here in Donggang is convenient, not to mention Yingzi, it's good for us."
Zhou Guilan laughed as soon as she heard it. Her son and daughter-in-law are filial, and she has such a cute and fun little grandson. Are the old couple still living together?
"Your father is here, don't mention how happy he is, he will go to visit Chang and your second brother's house every now and then.
Neighbors, neighborhood neighbors, they are very polite when they see your father, and they go to your father to drink tea, chat and play chess. You haven’t seen him beautiful every day. "
If living here is not comfortable, can the stubborn old man go back early to pack his things and plan to move?
"Well, as long as my parents are used to living here, I will go back to the big house tomorrow.
If my father's end is done, I will hurry back to find a car and move. "
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan nodded, feeling relieved. He was really worried that the old man would not be able to stay in Donggang because of his stubborn temper.
"Okay, hurry up and move here to save worry, or you will have to worry about the other end."
Zhou Guilan thought the same way. Now that she has made up her mind to move, she should come here as soon as possible to clean up, just in time for the Chinese New Year.
While the two girls were chatting, Xu Haiyuan on the other end crawled onto Xu Shiyan's lap, raised his head, opened his mouth, and looked at Xu Shiyan with a smile.
Xu Shiyan took a look, and the little guy had six white teeth, which looked like a bunny, very cute.
"Come on, let Dad give you a hug."
Having not seen his son for almost 20 days, Xu Shiyan also panicked, and hurriedly picked up his son, let him sit on his lap, and wrapped his arms around his waist.
"Dad, come on, call one after me, Dad."
But the little boy didn't listen to him at all, instead he stretched out his little hand to touch the beard on Xu Shiyan's chin.
Xu Shiyan lives on the mountain. He is a big man. Few of them pay special attention to appearance. It is normal not to shave for a few days.
I didn’t even think about it before going down the mountain. The stubble was already growing. The baby saw it as a novelty, so he reached out to touch it.
"Son, how many beards are left of your grandfather?"
Xu Shiyan touched his son's little hands so proficiently, and he knew that this little guy must have practiced a lot on weekdays.
I don’t know, how many of my father’s beards are left?
At the other end of the big house, most men like to grow beards after fifty to prove that they are old enough, and very few old men shave their beards clean.
Anyway, the big guys stay, no one thinks it's strange.
Hearing Xu Shiyan's words, Zhou Guilan and Su Anying couldn't help laughing.
"He also said that our father's beard has been cut long ago.
Our son's hand is too short, as long as our father hugs him, he will grab our father's beard. Our father had nothing to do, so he cut off his beard. "
Su Anying stared at her son while talking.
This mischievous guy is so simple, there is no one who is skinnier than him, and his little hands are also ruthless, and he will not let go of grandpa's beard.
Grinning Xu Chenghou's teeth in pain, he couldn't bear to hit his grandson, so he had no choice but to cut his beard.
When Xu Shiyan thought about the situation, he also found it funny, but he couldn't laugh, so he had to scold his son with a straight face.
"Asshole, how can you squeeze grandpa's beard?
Your grandfather has had that beard for several years, and your big brother Dabin has never plucked it, so you are forced to cut it, you naughty boy. "
Don't think Xu Haiyuan is young, but he knows how to look at his face. Seeing his father scolding others with a straight face, Xiaowa immediately quit and started crying.
Okay, this guy is crying, as if Xu Shiyan hit him.
Frightened, Zhou Guilan hurriedly took her grandson back, "You said you, you have lived in the mountains for so many days, and the child sees you so close, you are still capable.
What are you training him for? Does your father look good with that beard? I told him to cut it a long time ago, but he didn't listen.
Go out and have a look, who in Donggang has a beard like your father?
For a man in his sixties, his beard looks like he is in his seventies or eighties. I looked well cut, young. "
In Zhou Guilan's place, no matter what the grandson does, he is right, isn't it just a beard, if you cut it off, cut it off, what's the big deal?
"Go, go, talk to your wife, don't scare us here.
You can’t hear a single sound on normal days, but you made us cry as soon as you came back, really. "Zhou Guilan pushed her son back to the Westinghouse with a face full of disgust.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: decline
chapters.content:
Chapter 168 Decline
Xu Shiyan wanted to sit down and talk to his wife for a while, how could he have time? There are still many things to be busy.
Moving parents is different from his time. The old couple lived in a big house for these years and saved a lot of things.
Want to move, but can't find a car to find someone? Can't you say hello to Guo Shouye in advance to find a car?
If so many things are pointed at the sledge, it will take several days. It is better to find two cars and get out at once.
So, after sitting at home for a while, Xu Shiyan brought a lot of things to the Forestry Bureau to find Guo Shouye.
Guo Shouye hasn't seen Xu Shiyan for a long time, but the meeting was very warm.
As soon as he heard that Xu Shiyan was moving for his parents and wanted to find two cars, Guo Shouye agreed without saying a word.
He only said that whenever Xu Shiyan used it, he would call and call for a taxi.
After the car matter was settled, Xu Shiyan went to find Xu Shixian and Xu Shian again, and made an appointment with them to go back to the big house tomorrow and help his father pack his things.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian had known for a long time that the third child intended to take his parents to Donggang, and they were very happy.
Anyway, they have nothing to do now, so go back and help move.
In this way, the next morning, the three brothers met and went straight to the big house.
The ice layer on the surface of the river is already very thick, and it is no problem for people and vehicles to leave.
Crossed the river and went straight to Xu's house. As soon as he entered, he saw Xu Chenghou dismantling the warehouse, and there were many things piled up in the yard.
Needless to say, the old man has already started packing his things, and he is about to move.
"Father, we are back, are you ready?" Xu Shiyan spoke first.
"Well, pack it when you have time. I thought you had to go down the mountain in a few days, but I didn't think so early."
Xu Chenghou met his three sons, and only spoke to Xu Shiyan, but he didn't even talk to them.
I don't blame Xu Chenghou either. These two moved when they said they would move, and neither of them mentioned that they would take their parents with them. Can the old man feel at ease?
Especially the boss, whose family is not the eldest son to take care of the elderly?
It was also well said when the family separated, the old couple lived with the boss.
The results of it? As soon as the boss's daughter-in-law said to go back to the city, this little **** followed her away without saying a word, as if his **** was on fire, and he didn't even think about what his parents would do in the future.
In the end, he was still the third child, thinking about his parents in his heart, thinking that the old couple would not be able to stay in this crappy place, so he took them away.
Xu Chenghou was angry, so he naturally didn't like to talk to those two sons.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian knew at a glance that they had offended their father.
Each of them was too ashamed to say anything, so they hurriedly helped clean up.
It was Xu Shiyan, who chatted with Xu Chenghou while working.
"Father, have your household registrations been issued yet? I, Uncle Zhao, didn't say anything?"
"What can you say? The son and daughter of the family have all moved away. We can't keep the two old guys here. Isn't it normal to move away?
But Uncle Zhao is quite envious of me. He even praised you when he asked me to go drink that day.
Praise you for your ability and heart, knowing how to take our old couple to Donggang to enjoy the blessings. "Xu Chenghou said this on purpose to the two sons.
The five sons all came out of the same mother's womb. I really didn't expect the gap to be so big.
In the past, I always looked at the third child as incompetent, felt that the third child was worthless, and felt that those few were capable.
Only then did I realize that the third child is the most reliable, and the others, hmph, can't be counted on.
Xu Shiyan couldn't answer these words, so he could only shake his head and smile, and hurried over to work.
Father and son tore down the warehouse, pigsty, chicken coop, everything that should be demolished, and took away everything that could be taken away. Even if it was not used, it could still be used for fire.
The master here is busy with some work, and the neighbors around saw it, and they all came to help.
Not long after, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming and others also knew about it, and they all came over.
The big guys worked together and packed the two big stacks of firewood from the Xu family to the other side of the river.
No matter how thick the ice on the surface of the river was, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to let the car come over.
It’s easy to say that nothing happens, but if something happens, no one can bear the responsibility.
Everything is tossed to the opposite side, just waiting for loading directly on the car tomorrow.
Everyone helped out for a whole day and tidied up everything. In the evening, Zhao Dahai arranged meals, and called Xu Chenghou, his son and the helpers over for a meal.
During this meal, Zhao Dahai and Xu Chenghou did not drink less. At the end of the meal, both of them were a little sad and almost shed tears.
Zhao Dahai took advantage of the alcohol and scolded Hu Liancheng for not being a thing.
If it wasn't for his messing around, the people in the Dongjiangyan brigade would not be so distracted, and now everyone wants to go out.
Xu Chenghou also drank a lot, so he told Zhao Dahai not to be a brigade secretary when he was two years old, but to leave when he had to. There was no development in this remote place.
Xu Shiyan sat by and watched, really not knowing what to say.
In the previous life, the old Chen family was involved. There were less than 100 families in the Dongjiang Yan brigade, and there were only about 30 families left in the end. In this life, he became Hu Liancheng again.
Actually, we don’t necessarily have to blame anyone for this matter. There is really no development along the Dongjiang River, and it’s normal for people to go to high places.
Where is this going? It's just that the Xu family moved away, waiting for the introduction of the household contract responsibility system. With the disbandment of the commune and the production team, more people will go out.
Especially after the 1990s, the Songjiang River cascade power station was built, and a dam was built upstream.
In the past, I used to rely on water to eat water, but later I couldn’t eat anything, so why keep it?
The loneliness along the Dongjiang River is the doomed ending.
"Third brother, can Donggang No. 2 Brigade still ask for someone?"
Xu Shiyan was thinking about something, Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming came over and asked in a low voice.
"What's wrong? You two want to move out too?" Xu Shiyan recovered and looked at these two people.
"Well, the end of the Dongjiang River is really boring. You don't know, this year there is not much food, and there is not much money.
Besides, there are not many ginseng fields left in Qianchuan. My father said that there will be no place to grow ginseng in two or three years. "
Zhao Jianshe glanced at his father and whispered.
Dongjiangyan is a small place after all, and there is not much woodland available.
Ginseng has been planted in the Qianchuan area for many years, and there is really no place to expand it around.
Originally, there were not many places. If there is no more ginseng, how can this place develop? No wonder Zhao Jianshe was thinking about moving out.
"Okay, I will ask our secretary later, and I will write to you when the time comes."
They are all good friends, Xu Shiyan naturally can't refute his face.
In the future, the population of Donggang Commune will increase, and there will be no shortage of Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming.
He just talks about it, so he can help as much as he can.
"Hey, thank you third brother, then we will go to the third brother in the future."
Zhao Jianshe became happy when he heard it, and grinned.
"Brother, why don't you defect? ​​Let's earn money together in the future."
After all these years together, Xu Shiyan would think of friends like the big house when he was on the mountain.
It is good for Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming to go to Donggang. It is even better if they have the opportunity to develop together and make money together in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: radio
chapters.content:
Chapter 169 Radio
December 29th, 1978, the 30th day of the winter month of the lunar calendar.
Early in the morning, Xu Shiyan went to Songjianghe, found Guo Shouye, and asked him to help find two large trucks.
Then Xu Shiyan led the car back to the big house, where Xu Shixian and others began to toss into the car.
Furniture and luggage, pots and pans, all kinds of household items, rations, as well as firewood, wood, dismantled warehouses, etc., were filled with two large trucks and pulled directly to Donggang.
Donggang side, Yu Shouguang, Zhou Changhe got the news and brought many people over to help.
Except for the furniture and luggage moved into the house, everything else was gathered and stacked in the yard.
These are not needed for the time being, and they will have to be removed when the house is built in the next year.
After working for a long time, they finally settled down. The Xu family cooked a lot of dishes, and the helpers were invited to drink.
At the wine table, Xu Shiyan mentioned that Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming wanted to move to Donggang.
Yu Shouguang nodded without saying a word, and told Zhao Jianshe and Yang Mingchun that they can move here anytime, as long as they move their hukou, they will be settled here.
To the delight of Yang Chunming and his wife, they toasted several glasses of wine to Yu Shouguang, saying that they would go back and prepare for the preparations, and they would move here before the beginning of spring.
The Xu family's old couple officially settled in the Second Brigade of Donggang Commune.
However, they did not have the same account with Xu Shiyan, but a separate account.
The old couple took a fancy to the house of Xu Shixian in their previous life. It was a large open space in front of the martyr's tomb, not far from the side of the road.
There is a road away from Xu Shiyan's family, so it will be convenient for each other to take care of each other in the future.
Xu Shiyan had already guessed that his parents would be able to look at the land, so he went to the team to go through the formalities and paid for the property.
After the beginning of spring, start to prepare materials and build a house.
"Xiao Xu, there is such a big open space at the west end of your house, why don't you build a house for your parents there?
Being close, there is no need to spend extra money on building a house. "The cadres of the brigade couldn't understand what Xu Shiyan was thinking, so they couldn't hold back and asked.
Of course, this is also the doubt in the hearts of many people.
In these days, one house is all you need to live in, and there are many families who live in three rooms. Why do you need so many houses? No fire?
"My parents are still young, and there is a younger brother and a younger sister in the family who are not married. It would be shameful to live with me.
It’s better to live in a single family. I’m close and take care of me. "
Xu Shiyan didn't take it seriously, and explained with a smile.
"Yes, yes, I think Xiao Xu handled this matter quite openly.
伱 said that he was neither the eldest son nor the youngest son, and the third child in the middle. Where to count, the old man should not live with him.
Now that he has taken the old man over to take care of him nearby, he is already fine.
Anyway, Lao Xutou is not very old, and he can still work for a few years. After a few years, he can no longer work, and his five sons will take care of him.
Why can't Xiao Xu be alone, right? "Yu Shouguang stood up to Xu Shiyan, helping Xu Shiyan speak everywhere.
Just like that, the household registration of the old couple of the Xu family was settled, and the team was also allocated a private plot, which is next to the private plot of Xu Shiyan's family, which is convenient for management.
The procedures for the homestead have also been completed, and we just need to wait for the spring to prepare to build a house.
For the time being, they can only live in Xu Shiyan's house, and they just spend a new year together.
Finally the house was settled properly, Xu Shiyan borrowed the brigade's horse sledge, and went up the mountain to pull down the meat and all kinds of mountain products stored on the mountain.
Throw the prickly pear into the barn, wait for the spring to catch two pigs, and feed them together with pigweed, so that in winter, at least one pig can be killed for the New Year.
Xu Shiyan did a lot of pulling in autumn, and the pine nuts alone weighed three to four hundred catties.
Reserved food from home and distribution to relatives and friends, and sent the rest to the purchase station to sell. Even pine nuts and walnuts were sold for a total of 120 yuan.
After that, Xu Shiyan went to Fusong again and sold the hides, bear bile, etc.
The number of furs this year has increased a lot compared to last year, especially the mink skins, which have almost doubled. Two mink skins sold for more than 400 yuan.
Add a copper gut, as well as raccoon dogs, otters, badgers, squirrels, etc., and they were sold for more than 2,000 yuan.
Xu Shiyan left the buying station, went straight to the store, and bought a radio.
Now, three turns and one sound, it is considered complete.
"Father, Mom, what did I buy?" Xu Shiyan entered the door with the box in his arms, happily letting his family guess.
As a result, when I entered the door, I found that dumplings were being made at home.
"Why are you making dumplings? Little girl, you didn't go to work today? Or did you get off work early?"
"Third brother, are you being confused, today is the Gregorian calendar year."
Xu Shiqin laughed as soon as she heard it, and she could see that her third brother was so busy these days that he was dizzy and forgot about the Gregorian calendar year.
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard it, and turned to look at the Gregorian calendar board on the wall. No, there are new ones on them, so the big "1" is on it.
"Oh, I was really busy and fooled, and I even forgot the important event of the Gregorian calendar year.
Well, I bought a radio, let’s put it in the east room, and I’ll adjust the frequency later, so I can listen to the news at night. "
Xu Shiyan quickly put the box on the top of the kang, took the radio out of it, and put it on top of the box.
The box in his house was half-opened, and the radio was placed on it just right, so there was no delay in opening the box.
"Radio? Oh my god, how dare you buy it, and that brings the radio back?"
Xu Chenghou, who was coaxing his grandson to play at the other end, took a look, and hurriedly hugged his grandson and moved closer to him, looking over him happily.
"This one is different from the one I saw in Daying Commune before."
The big house has no electricity, let alone a radio, not even a big speaker.
The population is small, if there is something wrong, the team department can yell out, and most people can hear it.
When I was in Daying, the Daying Commune built an earthen power station in the upper reaches of the Tang River, which could generate electricity to meet the needs of the commune.
There is a radio in the commune, through the loudspeaker, it broadcasts news to the commune members all day long.
"Dad, what you said was ten years ago, when was that?
Nowadays there are many brands of radios, and it is normal to have different shells. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, pulled the wire out from the back of the radio, and plugged it into the socket.
Then twist the switch, adjust the frequency band, after a burst of buzzing, finally heard the sound, it is news from the local station.
There aren’t many good programs on the radio these days, except for the news, it’s just model plays and storytelling, and it won’t be until a few more years.
By that time, it was called a deserted place. Every day when the storytelling was broadcast, there was no one outside, and everyone was listening to storytelling at home.
"Wait a few more years, we should have a TV here, and then I will find a way to get a TV ticket. Let's move a TV back and let you watch it."
In his previous life, the old man didn't watch TV until he left.
I hope that in this life, the old man will be in better health, live a long and healthy life, and be able to see and enjoy everything.
"TV? What TV? Anyone else?"
Xu Chenghou was a little confused. He didn't understand what his son was talking about.
"No, it would be nice to have a radio like this."

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Han's
chapters.content:
Chapter 170 The Han Family
The Second Brigade, like Dongjiangyan, also settles the work points in winter, first divides the food, and waits until all the sticks are sold, then divides the money.
It happened to be the second day of the Gregorian calendar year, and the team informed that every household went to a meeting at the team headquarters to collect money.
There are three members of Xu Shiyan's family, and only Xu Shiyan works alone, but he has a high salary and many days.
