From the beginning of the first month to lead people to make ground guns, until the end of the winter month, it is counted as work.
In addition, the state-run No. 1 participating, the commune participating, and several brigades also settled the work points or wages that should be given to Xu Shiyan.
So despite the fact that there was only one person, he shared more than three hundred dollars.
Xu Chenghou was also very happy when he learned that his son had shared so much money.
Zhou Guilan didn't even say anything, and directly searched for sticky corn, rhubarb rice, etc. from the grain that was brought in, and found a vat to soak the upper half of the vat. She was planning to pack a sticky fire spoon.
Now the old couple lives with the third child, and all their food comes from the third child's house.
Even if the second brigade is rich, and there is a lot of food and money in the team, it can't help several people to eat like this.
Since they have been together for a while, they can't afford any rations.
At other times, Su Anying would not let Zhou Guilan use the old couple's rations, so Zhou Guilan could only eat rice wrapped in sticky fire spoons for the whole family to eat.
Once the money is in hand, give it to Su Anying, and Xu Shiyan picks up the rest, "Daughter-in-law, I have something to go out for."
Xu Shiyan plans to go to the venue and visit Han Wenzhong.
In the previous life, the two were masters and apprentices. Mr. Han taught Xu Shiyan a lot of things. I am afraid that there will be no fate of masters and apprentices in this life, but Xu Shiyan still wants to make friends with the Han family.
Once the relationship is good, you will have the opportunity to repay the kindness of your previous life in the future.
Xu Shiyan couldn't tell Su Anying about these things in detail.
I can only tell her that I met an old man who was very angry at a venue before, and he wanted to ask him to help get some more dogs.
Su Anying never cared about these things. Xu Shiyan is a person with serious business, and he is not going to eat, drink, have fun, play money to find girls, so there is no need to worry too much.
Just let Xu Shiyan go shopping for something, the first time you come to someone's house, you can't go empty-handed.
Xu Shiyan wandered to the store first, bought two bottles of wine, two cans, and a pack of snacks.
Han’s family is a hunter, and they also look at the scene on the mountain. The Changbai Mountain is closer to the Chaozi River, so there must be a lot of prey, and they have no shortage of wild game.
Besides, the first time you come to the door, you have to pick up some decent things. It’s better to buy something from the store.
The state-run field is on the east side of Donggang Commune, connected to a large team, and the area is not small.
Han's house is located at the east end of Yishenchang, with six large tile-roofed houses and a large and spacious yard.
Xu Shiyan has been here countless times in his previous life, and he is very familiar with it, so he found the place easily.
As soon as I entered the gate, I heard the dog barking in the yard.
Mr. Han is a well-known gunner in the field, and the dogs he raises are also very powerful. When seeing a stranger enter the door, he can't wait to pounce on him and bite him.
"Is Uncle Han at home?" Xu Shiyan didn't go in rashly, but stood at the gate and shouted.
The people in the house heard the movement, came out to check, and found that the person did not recognize, "Who are you looking for?"
"Is it the sister-in-law of the Han family? I'm here to find Han Wenzhong, Uncle Han. Is he at home?"
At this time, basically all the people watching the parade went down the mountain. Xu Shiyan guessed that Mr. Han should be at home.
"I'm at home, I'm at home, come in quickly." The person who came out was Han Limin's daughter-in-law Liu Chunhua.
As soon as he heard that the person was looking for his old man, he quickly stopped the dogs and stopped them from barking. He politely led Xu Shiyan to the easternmost room.
"Dad, someone is looking for you."
Xu Shiyan followed into the house, and saw Han Wenzhong sitting on the kang, smoking a cigarette, and Han Wenzhong's wife, Sun Shi, sitting next to him.
Han Limin was sitting on the edge of the Kang over there. "Uncle Han, Aunt Han, Brother Limin." Xu Shiyan entered the door and greeted everyone in the Han family.
"Oh, isn't this Technician Xu? Why are you here?"
Just now I heard from my daughter-in-law that someone was looking for him, but Han Wenzhong didn't care, thinking that it might be someone who attended the event, knowing that he had come down the mountain to sit down.
Unexpectedly, when he looked up, he found that it was Xu Shiyan, and Han Wenzhong moved to the edge of the kang and was about to get off the ground.
"Uncle, sit down, don't get off the ground." Xu Shiyan quickly put the things in his hand on the kang, and then supported Han Wenzhong.
"Uncle, I also went up to the mountain to see ginseng this winter, and I just came down. I was busy with some things, so I happened to come to see my uncle and aunt."
Xu Shiyan said while helping Han Wenzhong to sit down.
"Look, come as soon as you come, why are you still holding something?
Ordinarily, Limin and I brought things to see you. Thanks to you this year, you taught us the Anna ground gun, and a group of people really went to the venue in autumn.
Someone tripped over the cannon, and another tripped over the ground gun, and one person collapsed, and then the gang caught them all. "
Han Wenzhong met Xu Shiyan and was very kind.
It was windy that night, and the dog was useless at all. If there were no ground guns and cannons to warn, the club would have been thrown.
Han Wenzhong has been watching ginseng in the field for many years. If he loses his stick, it will be a face-slap. How can he still be in the mountains to see ginseng?
"Technician Xu, thank you very much."
"Uncle, didn't we agree, you call me Xiao Xu, and I call you uncle? Why are you called a technician again?"
My little ability is not enough to look good in front of my uncle. "
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to take it seriously in front of Han Wenzhong. Without the old man teaching him those skills, it would be useless even if he was reborn.
Master Han is the one Xu Shiyan is grateful for from the bottom of his heart.
"Father, Xiao Xu, I don't think you two need to thank you, we are all family members, why are you polite?"
Han Limin has a straightforward temperament. Seeing his father and Xu Shiyan being polite to each other, he felt awkward, so he said with a smile.
"No, we are all on our own, why are you being polite?" Han Wenzhong immediately laughed, and dragged Xu Shiyan to sit on the kang.
"Xiao Xu, tell Uncle, why did you go up the mountain to see ginseng? No one else in your team went?"
Han Wenzhong asked curiously. He hadn't heard of any team that sent technicians to the mountains to watch.
"No, many people in the team want to go up the mountain, and they don't have a dog at home.
I managed to get four puppies before, and they happened to be half-grown. Besides, didn’t I make all the ground guns and so on?
The secretary of our brigade also took care of me. Seeing that the work score was high, he let me go up the mountain. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, now it seems that Shendu has become a sought-after job. If Yu Shouguang didn't value him, he might not be able to grab it.
"Oh, oh, that's the way it is, that's good, that's good.
As long as you earn more work points, you can do whatever you want, and you can feel free to watch ginseng on the mountain, right? "Han Wenzhong was relieved when he heard the words.
Participating is different from the agricultural team. Han Wenzhong receives a fixed salary, and there are subsidies for participating.
He didn't know much about how the agricultural team counted, and he was afraid that Xu Shiyan would suffer.
"You also have a dog at home, how about it? Can you go into the mountains to hunt? If you can hunt, why don't we take the dogs into the mountains some other day?"
Mr. Han is used to being on the mountain, and he can't stay idle when he comes home, so he wants to find someone to go into the mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: two pigs
chapters.content:
Chapter 171 Two Pigs
"Uncle, the four dogs in my family were all from back then, they are still young and inexperienced.
If you don’t think I’m stupid and the dog isn’t too tough, then I’ll accompany you into the mountains to try. "
Xu Shiyan didn't mean to hunt Han Wenzhong when he came here, he just came to visit the old man.
But he also knew that Mr. Han never played those empty-headed things, and since he spoke, it was a sincere invitation.
Xu Shiyan is naturally willing to follow Han Wenzhong up the mountain, but there are some things that need to be explained first.
"Hey, look at what you said, your uncle knows nothing but taming dogs.
In this way, tomorrow we men will go into the mountain together, and I will help you drag the dog out. "
Han Wenzhong is really okay, Xu Shiyan is an outsider, so he immediately agreed to help Xu Shiyan tame the dog.
"The five dogs in my family are the most powerful. The first dog has a good smell and a tough mouth, and the few help dogs are also tough.
伱Don't worry, with my dog ​​with me, I can practice it after a few times. "
It is rare for Han Wenzhong to meet a young man with a similar temperament who loves hunting, so he especially wants to take Xu Shiyan along.
The old man has already said so much, what else can Xu Shiyan say? Then I can only agree.
Han Wenzhong was very happy when he heard that Xu Shiyan agreed, so he hurriedly told his wife, Mrs. Sun, to ask Mrs. Sun to prepare some dishes, and to keep Xu Shiyan at home for dinner.
Xu Shiyan wanted to refuse, but with the enthusiasm of the Han family father and son, how could he let him go?
In this way, Xu Shiyan was left in the Han family.
At noon, the second son of the Han family, Han Lixin, also got off work from the Canchang police station, and accompanied Xu Shiyan to drink together.
Han Wenzhong and his wife have only three sons, probably inherited from the Han family, all of them are very capable.
Han Limin has good fists and kicks, and he is a member of the security team.
When I am busy in autumn, I go up the mountain to assist in the inspection of ginseng. After the goods are shipped in autumn, I go down the mountain to take care of the security of the processing plant.
The second child, Han Lixin, works at the Canchang Police Station, and the third child has joined the army, and has been in the army for four years.
Han Limin and Han Lixin are both married and have not separated. They still live with the old man, and they live in the three rooms to the west.
The Han family are straightforward, informal, and drink well.
Several people get together to drink and chat, the more they chat, the more speculative they are, and the more they drink.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan knew it well and didn't get himself drunk, but he was a little shaky in the end.
This meal lasted quite a while, and when Xu Shiyan left the Han's house and walked all the way back to Xu's house, it was almost four o'clock.
Xu Shiyan returned home, fell asleep on the kang, slept until night, and didn't even get up for dinner.
Woke up in a daze on the morning of the 3rd, remembering the agreement with the Han family father and son to go hunting together in the mountains.
So he quickly packed up his things, told his parents and his wife, took dry food and other things, led the four dogs out, and walked eastward to the Han family to find Han Wenzhong and his son.
Donggang Commune is densely populated, and there are no wild animals nearby. If you want to hunt, you have to go deep into the mountains.
Han Wenzhong and his son are very familiar with this area, so they said that it is better to walk in from the Caozi River and go straight to the reserve.
Xu Shiyan naturally said nothing, anyway, wherever Han Wenzhong said to go, he just followed.
Thus, the three of them led the dog and first went to Han Wenzhong's Kansan's branch, stayed here for a night, and set off from here the next day to walk eastward along the Caozi River.
Within less than twenty miles away, Xiao Huang from Xu Shiyan's family and the dog "Er Chuanzi" from the Han family sniffed and barked.
Han Wenzhong glanced at Xiao Huang, and nodded approvingly.
"Your dog is not bad, it smells good. A dog that is less than a year old can compare with my Er Chuanzi, that's fine."
The head dog of the Han family, Er Chuanzi, is a cross between a local stupid dog and a Chifeng hound.
"Well, Xiao Huang's father is Da Huang, and he is also a very good head dog. I brought him for hunting last year.
It's a pity that the guardian of the master died under the paws of the blind man in summer, which is a pity. "
Xu Shiyan said with emotion, together with Han Wenzhong, let go of the dog.
The dogs of the two families got together all day yesterday, and they are already familiar with each other, and they will not bite each other after they are separated.
The head dog let out a sound and ran forward leading the other dogs. Xu Shiyan, Han Wenzhong, and Han Limin followed leisurely behind.
Walking forward for a while, there were footprints of a large row of wild boars on the ground. Looking at it, there were about six or seven wild boars in size.
Xiao Huang and Er Chuanzi probably discovered this group of wild boars and led other dogs to chase them.
Entering the mountain, what you meet is all luck, and no one can pick and choose.
"Okay, let's hunt some wild boars home today, just as there is no need to kill pigs during the Chinese New Year, let's go, let's go and have a look."
Han Wenzhong smiled, led Xu Shiyan and Han Limin, and walked forward quickly.
Don't look at Han Wenzhong, who is fifty, he has a great physique, and his legs and feet are nimble, and he can walk faster than Xu Shiyan and the others.
Walking forward, I heard a dog barking in the distance. Hearing the movement, he knew that he had already fought with the prey.
The three of them quickened their pace and chased forward. They turned over a beam and saw nine dogs fighting with two wild boars at the foot of the hillside.
The four dogs of the Xu family surrounded a yellow-haired son, and the five dogs of the Han family surrounded a boar and ran into a basket.
Although the four dogs of the Xu family were all puppies back then, none of them were good-natured, they were all fierce.
Xiao Huang followed his father, opened the back door, Hu Zi and Er Hei hung up the pliers, and Xiao Hei would bite wherever it was convenient and easy to bite.
These four dogs are only about half a year old, but they are not small in size, and they are entangled with a yellow-haired dog that weighs about one hundred catties.
The yellow-haired boy was so desperate that he could only run around, but he couldn't get rid of the siege of the four dogs.
On the other side, not to mention the five dogs of the Han family, they are all dogs of three or four years old, when their physical strength is at their best.
Er Chuanzi is big, but also a head-on dog, daring to fight hard with wild boars.
The other gang dogs were also stubblers, and when the lead dog got on, they all jumped up, each finding their own place to bite.
These five dogs were not small in size, they were extremely ruthless, and they were smart and flexible. When they saw the situation was not going well, they let go of their mouths and ran away, and the others immediately made up to prevent the wild boars from injuring their companions.
Nine dogs and two pigs fought into two groups, fighting and walking on this half hillside, biting and fighting non-stop.
The pig wanted to run away, but the dog refused to let it go. For a while, the sound of the dog barking and the pig screaming was endless.
After all, the little Huang Maozi was easy to deal with. Regardless of the four old dogs, they quickly drove Huang Maozi under a big poplar tree.
The yellow-haired boy was half-sitting with his back against the poplar tree, blocking his back.
As a result, Huzi and Erhei jumped forward, one left and one right, and bit Huang Maozi's ear tightly.
Xiao Hei also stepped forward, and bit the pig's nose. The three dogs bit Huang Maozi tightly, and tried their best to lower their bodies.
Huang Maozi's head was pressed against the snow, this pig was condemned to death.
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to chop wood, put it on the handle of the knife, passed by, and stabbed the back of the wild boar with a knife.
The yellow-haired boy twitched and screamed.
Xu Shiyan drew out the knife, and came again, the pig whined twice, and there was no more movement.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: black blind man sneak attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 172 Black blind man sneak attack
Xu Shiyan dealt with Huang Maozi cleanly, while Han Wenzhong and his son also took the opportunity to shoot and killed the running basket.
Going into the mountains, there will be a harvest, so I am naturally happy, so I hurriedly opened the wild boar, so as not to stink the meat after covering the chest.
Just as Xu Shiyan was holding a knife in one hand and tearing open the pig's leg with the other, all four dogs were waiting around.
Suddenly, a black shadow circled out from behind the big poplar tree, and rushed towards Xu Shiyan.
Xiao Huang sensed something was wrong, screaming and pounced on the shadow.
And Xu Shiyan also felt the danger at this time, so he couldn't care less about other things, so he just rolled on the spot and walked a few steps away.
Then stood up and looked back, it was a black blind man.
It turned out that the tree that the wild boar was leaning against was a big green poplar with two people hugging each other.
Poplar trees are old and most of them are hollow with tree holes, and it happens that a black blind man lives in the tree hole.
The entrance of the cave is at the back, and Xu Shiyan just paid attention to the dogs and wild boars, and didn't have time to look at the tree carefully.
It is estimated that the movement of the dogs and wild boars downstairs was too loud, which disturbed the black blind man living in the tree hole.
The blind man crawled out of the tree hole, not knowing what was going on, and rushed towards Xu Shiyan.
Thanks to Xu Shiyan's vigilance and Xiao Huang's cleverness, he escaped the pounce at least.
As soon as Xiao Huang went up, the other three dogs also jumped up.
But these four dogs were not big in the first place. They had just fought with wild boars and were very tired. When they met a black blind man again, they were obviously not opponents.
One inattentive, Er Hei was slapped and flew out by Hei Xiazi, and fell to the ground screaming.
Hei Xiazi appeared too suddenly, and the Han family father and son were quite far away from Xu Shiyan.
The dogs of the Han family were also staring at the dead wild boar.
When Xiao Huang yelled, Han Wenzhong heard that something was wrong, and immediately turned his head to look this way, and he was quite frightened.
"Er Chuanzi." Han Wenzhong immediately greeted his dog, raised his gun, and fired at the blind man who was about to pounce on Xu Shiyan again.
Mr. Han’s marksmanship is really good. He shot in a hurry and had to dodge the three dogs of the Xu family. This shot hit the back of the black blind man.
The blind man is different from the wild boar. The wild boar runs away when it hears the gunshot, but the blind man rushes up to face the shooter.
Han Wenzhong's shot made the black blind man angry, leaving Xu Shiyan and the three dogs behind, he was about to rush to this side.
At this time, Xiao Huang took a mouthful from behind, and the blind man howled in pain, and turned his head to give Xiao Huang a blow.
Thanks to Xiao Huang's cleverness, he took a bite and ran away immediately. The black blind man's paw scraped against Xiao Huang's fur without injury.
Hei Xiazi didn't hurt Xiao Huang, turned his head and rushed towards Han Wenzhong, and at this time, all the dogs of the Han family also came up.
Er Chuanzi was staring at Han Limin just now, seeing Han Limin cut open the pig's heart to give it to eat, when Han Wenzhong called it, Er Chuanzi felt a little reconciled.
But then the gunshot rang out. As a well-trained head dog, he immediately entered a fighting state when he heard the gunshot, and rushed towards the blind man.
Er Chuanzi barked while pounced, and the other four dogs of the Han family heard the barking of the leading dog, and gave up the idea of ​​eating meat first.
They all rushed towards the blind man, each looking for a place to speak.
This black blind man looks to weigh more than 300 catties, and he is about the height of a person standing up. Er Chuanzi's body size is nothing in front of it.
With a wave of the bear's paw, Er Chuanzi flew out with a groan, and when he turned around again, a dog was also shot out.
The main reason is that the dogs are tired and their movements are not as agile as before.
The black blind man can stand up, wave his sharp claws, and be slapped by it, which is really not light.
Following Er Chuanzi and Hua Dianer's screams, there was another gunshot, which was fired by Xu Shiyan.
Just now he leaned his gun upright beside a tree, and took a knife to kill a pig.
Taking advantage of the opportunity of Han Wenzhong to shoot the black man away, Xu Shiyan quickly grabbed the gun and shot directly when he saw the opportunity.
This shot just hit Hei Xiazi's head, Hei Xiazi swayed twice and fell forward.
Xu Shiyan brought the gun to him and fired two more shots to confirm that the blind man was really dead.
The remaining dogs all rushed forward at this time, biting the dead body of the blind man.
Han Wenzhong and his son also rushed over at this time, and the old man gave Xu Shiyan a thumbs up.
"Good marksmanship, among the younger generation, there are very few marksmanship like yours, okay, the young man really has the ability."
Han Wenzhong has long seen that Xu Shiyan is by no means as stupid as he said, so he has to praise him at this moment.
"The blind cat touched a dead mouse, and I was also worried, afraid that it would hurt our dog again."
Xu Shiyan said politely, turned around and hurriedly checked the dog's injuries.
Er Chuanzi was scratched by the black blind man's sharp claws on his right front shoulder, his skin was opened, and blood gushed out.
Xu Shiyan quickly took out the medicine bottle from his pocket, poured the medicine powder on the wound, covered the wound with his leggings and slowly wrapped it around a few times.
Hua'er was not seriously injured, she was scratched on the top of her hind leg, Xu Shiyan also quickly applied medicine to bandage her, then turned around and went to find her Erhei again.
Erhei hurt his stomach, almost cut his belly.
Xu Shiyan also used the same method to stop bleeding and relieve pain, but now he found that leggings were not enough.
Fortunately, Han Wenzhong followed and handed over a pair of leggings. Xu Shiyan didn't care about that, and quickly bandaged Erhei's wound.
The three dogs were all bandaged up, Xu Shiyan raised his gun to warn, Han Limin stepped forward, opened the black blind man, and took out the bear bile.
"Let me tell you, this blind mother is carrying a cub, and the cub ran away just now when we were distracted by it."
Han Wenzhong saw that something was wrong, walked around the big poplar tree a few times, poked a wooden pole into the tree hole a few times, and then said.
Xu Shiyan went over to look, and sure enough there was a line of footprints behind the poplar tree, which were left by the black blind man, and it seemed that it was only about a year old.
"Let's run away if the small one runs away, this big one is enough." Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong came back again.
At this time, Han Limin had already picked off the guts of the black blind man, and hung his internal organs on a tree.
Then, Han Limin went to disembowel the yellow-haired boy, and then fed it to the dogs.
Several dogs worked hard, not only did they kill two pigs, but also a black blind man, why don't they open up and feed them?
Er Chuanzi and Hua Dian were okay, they dared to move, and it didn't delay their eating at all.
Er Hei was a bit serious and didn't dare to move, so Xu Shiyan had no choice but to bring the meat to Er Hei's mouth to feed. Er Hei was tired and hungry, and he ate a lot.
"Brother Limin, you can save both pig bellies for me, I will be useful."
Xu Shiyan was afraid that Han Limin would feed the pig belly to the dog, so he hurriedly said.
I don't know what's wrong with Xu Shian's stomach. I can't stop eating pork belly, so I have to continue eating.
Han Limin nodded, left the pork belly alone, and cut some black blind meat to feed the dogs. He didn't stop until all the nine dogs ate their bellies round.
While Han Limin was feeding the dogs, Han Wenzhong was gathering firewood to build the fire.
Cut some meat from Huangmaozi's body, put it on a branch and roasted it, and roasted it together with the dry food he brought.
The three of them had enough to eat, so they had the strength to make two temporary sledges. Put wild boars and black blinds on the sledge.
Er Chuanzi and Huadianer were injured, but they could barely walk.
Erhei hurt his stomach, Xu Shiyan couldn't bear it, so he could only put Erhei on the sledge, and pulled him back together.
After tossing around for a long time, it's getting late, and I can't go down the mountain today, so I have to go back to see the small room and stay overnight.
Fortunately, Han Wenzhong left a lot of rice in Kansan Xiaofang, so the three of them first skinned and unloaded the wild boar and Heixiazi.
Then stew rice with meat, and some wine, let alone, these days are quite comfortable.
"It's still comfortable on the mountain. Now when I go home, I feel weak."
After eating, Han Wenzhong lit a bag of cigarettes and sighed while smoking.
No, I really can’t stand it anymore, I feel that my brain is not enough. For the time being, the fourth watch first, let me take it easy.

chapters.title: Chapter 173: musk deer
chapters.content:
Chapter 173 Fragrant deer
It was rare to come to the mountain once, and Han Wenzhong wanted to take Xu Shiyan with him, so he naturally refused to go down the mountain easily.
Xu Shiyan also felt that there was nothing to do at home, so he might as well wander around the mountains for a few more days, so that he could meet other prey if he didn't make it all.
In this way, the three of them lived on the mountain. One day they hunted two wild boars, the next day they met a black blind warehouse, and the day after tomorrow they met a herd of deer.
With Han Wenzhong, an experienced old hunter, he almost never misses.
Sometimes he went too far and couldn’t go back to see the small house. Han Wenzhong could also find the house left by the hunter in the mountains and forests for a night of shelter from the wind and snow.
When leaving the next day, leave firewood and some rice for the convenience of those who come later.
"Come and see, this is the mountain donkey road, there should be mountain donkeys around here."
On this day, the three of them didn't bring their dogs out for a stroll. Han Wenzhong looked at a line of footprints on the snow and greeted Xu Shiyan and Han Limin.
The mountain donkey mentioned by Han Wenzhong is actually a local name for musk deer, also called musk deer.
Sweet deer looks a bit like a deer, but smaller in size, neither male nor female has horns.
There is a sachet behind the belly button of the male deer musk deer, which contains musk. It is a kind of precious medicinal material and spice, and the purchase price is very high.
Sweet deer is small in size, light and sensitive, and good at jumping.
Not only can you move freely on the cliffs, but you can also climb inclined trees with ease.
Sweet deer deer's vision and hearing are extremely sensitive, and if there is a little trouble, it will run away immediately.
Moreover, musk deer often stands on the cliff and looks out. Once it finds traces of natural enemies, or hunters and hunting dogs, it immediately flees without a trace.
Sweet deer likes to eat lichen and moss, and likes to eat twigs and leaves of pine trees and fir trees in winter.
So most musk deer have a fixed living place, and they will not migrate to other places until they eat up the food around them.
Mountain donkey road, that is, the footprints left by the musk deer.
At a rough glance, it looks a bit like a cow's hoof print of a few sizes, but it is different when you carefully distinguish it.
The hind legs of musk deer are longer than the front legs. When running and jumping, the hind hooves are in front and the front hooves are behind.
Xu Shiyan lowered his head to search nearby, and sure enough, he found some musk deer dung.
If the surface of the donkey's dung is smooth and shiny, it means that it has just been excreted, at most two or three days.
If the epidermis has become dark and rough, it was discharged half a month ago.
If some are dilapidated, it must have been at least one or two months ago.
Experienced hunters can judge the elapsed time of prey through footprints, feces, etc., so as to find out the hunting rules.
Looking at the dung, Xu Shiyan knew that this group of donkeys had just passed by here for at most two days.
Han Wenzhong also found out, so he led Xu Shiyan and Han Limin along the mountain donkey road for a while.
Far away, there seemed to be some voices, "Yo... Yo..." The voice came along the wind, loud and small intermittently.
Han Wenzhong waved his hand, signaling Xu Shiyan and Han Limin to hide in the bushes, with their guns ready at all times.
On the other side, Han Wenzhong pinched his nose with his hands, his cheeks puffed up, and he learned to make a sound like "Yo... Yo... Yo".
Xu Shiyan knew that this was Han Wenzhong's special skill.
Imitate the call of the female musk deer to attract the male musk deer, also called the musk deer.
This is not easy to learn. At first Xu Shiyan learned it from Han Wenzhong for several months before he barely learned it.
Han Wenzhong can not only call musk deer, but also make horns out of birch bark, and blow the sound to call deer.
Xu Shiyan has learned these methods in his previous life, but his knowledge is average, sometimes it works and sometimes it doesn’t work, so he doesn’t use it most of the time.
Just as Xu Shiyan was thinking wildly, the voice of "Yo... Yo..." in the distance became more and more clear.
Obviously, musk deer really came here.
Most of the musk deer are male and female, and every winter is the season for them to find a mate.
When the male musk deer hears the female's call, he will yell and run towards the direction of the call.
Han Wenzhong continued to call, and male musk deer responded from time to time in the distant woods. It sounds like there are a lot of them.
Han Wenzhong also hid in the bushes at this time, ready with a gun, and kept calling.
Xu Shiyan and Han Limin hid behind the bushes and did not dare to move. They looked out from the gaps in the bushes and kept an eye on the situation outside.
Then, I saw a group of guys with short brown hair all over their bodies.
Looks like a deer, with no forked horns on the forehead, a row of white hairs on both sides of the neck, slender limbs, short tail, two big and round ears, and a pair of big eyes.
Sweet deer is alert by nature, pricking up its ears and tilting its neck, looking around cautiously, obviously looking for a female musk deer.
At this time, Xu Shiyan, Han Wenzhong, and Han Limin fired at the same time.
A gunshot rang out, several musk deer fell to the ground, others were frightened and ran away.
This thing ran very fast, and disappeared in an instant.
The three of Han Wenzhong got out of the bushes and looked at the four or five musk deer that had fallen on the ground.
"Today's harvest is not small. This thing can sell for hundreds of dollars, which is no less than a black blind man."
Sweet deer is usually rarely encountered, and even if it does, it would be useless without Han Wenzhong's means.
Before anyone approached, the musk deer ran away.
The three of them stepped forward, quickly removed the sachet, then disemboweled and took out the internal organs.
"Uncle, do you think there is a way to capture them alive?" Xu Shiyan asked Han Wenzhong while working.
Xu Shiyan never thought about it so much if he put it aside.
Hunting is a way of making money. As long as he can make money and improve his life, Xu Shiyan will not soften his heart when he sees his prey.
But since Xu Shiyan met the rascal again and captured a live sable, his thinking has changed a little.
Extensive and savage hunting methods like the present one are very destructive to the sustainable development of organisms.
Wild boars, badgers, etc. harm the farmland, and black blind people can easily hurt people, but it is understandable.
But some wild animals that are of great economic value and do not cause much harm to people, such as sable, musk deer, and deer.
These animals, can you find a way to capture them alive and raise them artificially?
Han Wenzhong listened to Xu Shiyan's words, smiled and shook his head.
"It's difficult, the musk deer is cautious by nature, and it's not easy to set a trap to catch it.
Besides, even if caught, how to raise it? Don't you have to kill and take the sachet if you keep it? "
People in this day and age don't know that musk can be obtained in another way, and it doesn't hurt the life of musk deer.
So hunters directly kill the male musk deer, and then cut the sachet.
Others don't know, but Xu Shiyan knows.
In later generations, musk musk deer, civets, muskrats and other animals were cultivated artificially, and musk can be extracted without killing them.
Xu Shiyan felt that this might be a way. If the research made it clear, there would be no need to hurt the lives of so many musk deer.
It is not likely that these animals will become extinct in a few decades.
"The solution is something that people think of, so think about it."

chapters.title: Chapter 174: sticky fire spoon
chapters.content:
Chapter 174 Pack sticky fire spoon
Xu Shiyan, Han Wenzhong, and Han Limin stayed on the mountain for seven or eight days and saved a lot of prey.
Getting up early on the 11th, Han Limin went down the mountain first, went back to the venue to find a driver, and drove up.
Dragged Han Wenzhong, Xu Shiyan, nine dogs and a lot of meat down the mountain together.
Thanks to the fact that Han's family lives far away, it is at the east end of the venue.
When the car stopped in front of Han's house and unloaded the meat, only a few family members saw it.
Someone came to help, Han Wenzhong didn't refuse, and everyone moved down together.
The three of them have been rowing a lot these days, hunting during the day, returning in the afternoon, peeling off the skin and bones to remove the meat and freeze it outside.
Right now, they were all piled up in the courtyard of the Han family, and all kinds of meat piled up into a hill.
"How else can I say it? Old Uncle Han is really good. Look, how much meat is this?"
Helpingly looked at the meat in the yard, envious.
Han Wenzhong is a generous person, he hurriedly asked Han Limin to share some meat with the families who helped him. Everyone happily thanked Han Wenzhong before leaving.
After the outsiders were sent away, it was the turn of the two families to divide.
Knowing that the Xu family has a large population, Han Wenzhong divided the meat equally.
Other bear bile, musk, etc., waited for a few days to dry out, Xu Shiyan and Han Limin went to Tonghua to sell and then split the money.
Han Limin found the sledge at home, and helped Xu Shiyan put all kinds of meat into sacks and put them on the sledge.
Then Xu Shiyan dragged the sledge and led the four dogs back to his home.
As soon as Xu Shiyan dragged the sledge into his yard, the door opened.
"Third brother, you are back. If you don't come back, our mother will call someone to go to the mountain to find you."
The one who came out was Xu Shixiang, the fifth child. He was on winter vacation at school and came home for the New Year.
Fortunately, Xu Chenghou asked his daughter to write a letter to Tonghua, telling Xu Shixiang about the move.
Otherwise, when Xu Shixiang went back to the big house, he would probably be in a daze. After studying in the first half of the year, why did his home disappear?
"The fifth child is back? It's just right, help brother move all these to the warehouse. This year's Chinese New Year, we have something to eat."
Xu Shiyan was also very happy to see the fifth younger brother coming back. He didn't care about greetings at the moment, so he **** the dog first and moved everything down.
The two brothers carried the sack together and sent it to the warehouse.
Xu Shiyan found a wooden barrel, filled it with some snow, and then buried the meat in the snow with a layer of meat and a layer of snow.
The meat jelly was sprinkled with water before, and there was a layer of ice shell on the outside, so as to keep the meat fresh to the greatest extent.
If this is not the case, even if it is buried in the snow, the meat will easily dry out and become unpalatable.
"Brother, who did you go up the mountain with? It's too powerful. After going out for seven or eight days, you came back with so much meat?"
Xu Shixiang and his brother moved two or three times, and the heavy sack was full of meat. He was very curious when he was happy, which capable person did the third brother find?
"An old man who participated in the field, his marksmanship is like a god, and he is very skilled.
They can fight in both large and small circles, and they can also call musk deer, deer, and roe deer.
Three people, three guns and nine dogs, tell me, can we cut back? "Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard that.
Last year, he led a group of people who didn’t know anything by himself, and he was able to hunt a lot of prey in the mountains.
Not to mention that this year, he followed Mr. Han to the Changbai Mountain Reserve. It is normal to fight these things.
The two put away all the meat, Xu Shiyan carried a bag and carried a gun, and entered the house with Lao Wu.
As soon as I entered the door, I felt that the kitchen was steaming. After a closer look, it turned out that Su Anying was standing in front of the pot, turning over the sticky ladle in the pot with a shovel.
"Yo, this is a sticky fire spoon, how much rice did you pack?"
In a wooden trough next to the pot table, half of the trough has already been filled. Looking at the posture, why do you feel that there are still many unpacked?
Mom won’t pack a lot of sticky fire spoons like before, right?
"I wrapped it for a whole day yesterday. My mother soaked half a tank of rice and added small bean paste. How much can you say?"
Su Anying was very happy to see her husband come back safely, and smiled while turning over the sticky ladle in the pot with a shovel.
"Our mother said, you like to eat sticky fire spoons, besides, isn't the fifth child coming back too?
Pack more, send some to Director Guo when you have time, don’t worry about it, this is our heart.
There is also my little sister’s master, who is very kind to my little sister, we have nothing else to offer, let’s send some food. "
When Xu Shiyan heard it, it made sense.
Life at home cannot be sealed and no one walks around. Human relations are essential.
There is nothing else in the crop yard. It is better to give away some of the things produced by oneself than nothing.
"Well, okay, it just so happened that I came back with a lot of meat this time, and I will ask Lao Liu to bring some to her master another day."
"Daughter-in-law, you are busy first, I will go into the house to talk to my parents, and I will watch the pot later."
When you go out these days, you must say hello to your parents when you get home. This is the rule.
Xu Shiyan pushed open the door of the east room, and saw Zhou Guilan sitting cross-legged on the kang.
There is a large basin on the left, with sticky noodles in it, and a medium-sized basin on the right, with small bean paste in it.
Xu Haiyuan next to him is holding a piece of sticky face mask, his face is also white, and he is still working there.
Behind Xu Haiyuan, Xu Cheng's thick padded jacket, face, and trousers were all covered with white sticky face, but with a doting and helpless expression on his face, he watched his grandson make trouble.
"My God, Xu Haiyuan, what are you doing? Are you making trouble?"
Xu Shiyan raised his forehead, there is a child in the family, can he still wrap the sticky fire spoon safely?
Xu Haiyuan was struggling with the sticky face in his hand, and he couldn't shake it off.
As soon as he heard his father's movement, the little guy was very happy, and stretched out his hand towards Xu Shiyan, still shouting eight syllables.
This little guy can already speak a lot of syllables, what mother, father, grandpa, grandma, what he said is not so clear, but he consciously called people.
"Don't mess around, you did it yourself and figured out your own way, I don't bother with you."
Xu Shiyan saw his son's appearance, deliberately pretended to be disgusted, and stayed away from his son.
It is estimated that the little guy understood his father's face, froze for a while, and then started crying with his mouth curled up.
As soon as Xu Haiyuan cried, Xu Chenghou immediately lost his temper and looked up at his son.
"I want you to hug you, why so much nonsense? You must make us cry."
As Xu Chenghou said, he picked up his grandson and put him on his lap to coax him, and then bit by bit he peeled off the sticky face on his grandson's hands.
Just now I ignored him, mainly because I picked this piece, and Xu Haiyuan went to grab it in the basin after a while.
If his hand is sticky, he has to work hard to get it off, so as not to cause too much sticky face.
"Father, he is my son, why don't I take care of children when I am a father?
That's food, how can he still let him do harm? "Xu Shiyan suddenly had a black line.
This is the disadvantage of living with the elderly, unable to take care of the children.
It doesn’t matter whether the child is right or wrong, as long as he says something, the old man will stop him, let alone hit him, dare to move his finger?
Xu Shiyan was very helpless. In his previous life, the youngest son of his family was so used to it. With his grandparents as his backers, he was not afraid of anything.
In this life, he doesn't want his eldest son to become that virtuous.

chapters.title: Chapter 175: newspaper
chapters.content:
Chapter 175 Newspaper
"How old is Yuanyuan? What does he know about a nine-month-old child?"
It's just to save face together, let him play with it. "
Xu Chenghou, who has been a veteran farmer all his life, doesn't he understand that it is food?
It is now, at least I can fill my stomach. If I can’t eat a few years ago, who would dare to harm a little food?
If Xu Shiyan and his brothers dared to do this when they were young, Xu Chenghou would have slapped his son away, and even Zhou Guilan would have been scolded.
But when it comes to the little grandson, the old man's heart is off, and all kinds of excuses come out.
"Such a small child, do you care about him?" The old man hugged his grandson and gave his son a supercilious look.
This is the reason why you can't live with the elderly. You are too protective of your children.
Xu Shiyan took a deep breath, forget it, he didn't hesitate to argue with his father, anyway, the house will be built in the spring of the next year, and his parents will move to a new house in autumn at most.
Be patient for a while, there will be more opportunities to clean up my son in the future.
"Mom, go change your clothes and let Yingzi come in to help you pack."
Xu Shiyan can also wrap sticky fire spoons, but he is a big man with hot hands.
The sticky dough became thin after several back and forth in the hand, and the sticky fire spoon that came out of the bag was not in shape.
When he was in the big house, Xu Shiyan often baked pots and glued fire spoons, and he knew how to do this job.
"Okay, then you go to see the pot, Yingzi comes back to make a package, we should hurry up.
Daddy looked at the child, but he couldn't help. "
Zhou Guilan didn't have the nerve to complain that her husband didn't know anything, so she could only say that Xu Chenghou looked after children.
Xu Shiyan went to Xixiwu to take off his coat, then went to wash his hands, and took the shovel from Su Anying.
Fire the pot with a sticky fire spoon, and put a griddle in the pot.
When the griddle is hot, wipe it with an oil bag, then place the wrapped sticky spoons on the griddle one by one, cover the pot and wait for a while.
When the bottom of the sticky fire spoon turns yellow and hard, turn it over with a shovel, and then bake this side until the color is golden.
The sticky fire spoon baked in this way, let it cool and take it outside to freeze. When you eat, pick some up and put it in the pot to steam it.
If you want to eat the hard surface just out of the pan, you must bake it for a while to avoid unfamiliarity.
It is not difficult to look at the pot, you just need to turn the sticky spoon in the pot frequently, and pay attention to the fire in the pot and stove so that it does not burn too hot.
Xu Shiyan did this with ease, faster than Su Anying.
Just in time, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law are in the house, and Xu Shiyan is watching the pot outside, and they have just paid for it.
It was packed until three o'clock in the afternoon, and the bean paste and sticky noodles were all gone.
Zhou Guilan and Su Anying cleaned up the kang in the east room, and put the pots, curtains and other things back together.
Then Su Anying took Xu Haiyuan to the Westinghouse to nurse, Zhou Guilan went to the field, went to the sauerkraut jar to fish some sauerkraut, washed it and cut it into shreds, and then took two mustard greens from the pickle jar and shredded it.
Xu Shiyan beat several wild boars and black blind men on the mountain. The conditions in the mountain are poor and there is no way to refine oil.
Just now, Xu Shiyan took advantage of the gap while watching the pot, and went to bring all the fat meat into the house to slow down. At this moment, most of the meat was slowly opened, and it was just right when it was half frozen and not frozen.
Zhou Guilan cut all the fat meat into pieces of normal size, then added some water to the pot, and began to rely on oil.
As the water evaporates, the oil gradually precipitates, and the kitchen is filled with the aroma of refining oil.
The grease in the pan was bubbling one by one, making a sizzling sound, nothing could be more pleasant than this sound.
Zhou Guilan took a spoon and scooped out the oil little by little. At the end, she baked the oil again and put it into a basin with a strainer.
Then put the onion and garlic in the oil refining pot, fry the pot, pour the shredded sauerkraut into it and stir fry until it is thoroughly fried, add soup and stew.
In another pot, all the sticky fire spoons have been baked.
For the last ones, Xu Shiyan specially baked them a little longer, so that both sides were browned.
"Mom, let's eat sticky spoon and sauerkraut at night, no need to bother."
Even after two days of busy work, I am quite tired, so I just need to have something to eat, and there is no need to prepare too many dishes.
"Well, I just need to fry another pickle. The fifth child said that he wants to eat the shredded pickle at home.
You say this kid is really strange, greedy for this thing. "
Zhou Guilan didn't plan to make too many dishes. If Xu Shixiang didn't say that he wanted to eat shredded pickles, he would have planned to stew pickled cabbage.
There are two stoves in the kitchen, one stews sauerkraut, the other washes it up quickly, and fry mustard shreds in large oil.
In the evening, there is a hot and delicious sticky spoon that is freshly baked, with sauerkraut and shredded mustard greens.
There is also a delicious, crispy and crispy oil, which directly feeds everyone.
While eating, they listened to the news on the radio. After the meal, the three of them chatted together.
Xu Shiyan had to ask Lao Wu how he was studying in Tonghua, so Xu Shixiang told some interesting things about what happened in the university.
Xu Chenghou was fascinated by what he heard, and couldn't help but sigh with emotion. Fortunately, the fifth child has been admitted to university, otherwise how would there be such an opportunity?
The three of them chatted until after eight o'clock, and Zhou Guilan urged everyone to go to bed quickly, and then went to wash up and go back to the room to rest.
Xu Shixiang and Xu Shiqin lived with their parents in the east room, and Xu Shiyan and his wife took Xu Haiyuan to live in the west room.
Xu Haiyuan was tired of all kinds of mischief during the day, so he went to bed early after eating milk.
Xu Shiyan put his arms around his daughter-in-law, and the two chatted about things on the mountain in bed.
This chat lasted until midnight, and when I woke up the next morning, I yawned profusely.
January 12th, the fourteenth day of the twelfth lunar month, it's time to prepare for the New Year.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan packed five or six catties of sticky fire spoons, a piece of venison, a musk deer leg, and a deer whip.
This is intended to be given to Guo Shouye. He has helped a lot, and it is almost Chinese New Year, so it is a good idea to give something away.
Guo Shouye was still very enthusiastic when he met Xu Shiyan. Seeing that Xu Shiyan sent so many things, he had to be polite to show his gratitude.
"Hey? By the way, Brother Shiyan, do you want a newspaper?
I happen to have some newspapers here that I plan to deal with, so take them if you find them useful. "
Guo Shouye suddenly remembered something, the newspapers in each office had accumulated a lot.
This thing is useless after seeing it, it can only sell waste paper, so I asked Xu Shiyan casually.
Xu Shiyan became happy when he heard that, "Yes, of course, I'm planning to go to the store to buy paper for the wall. It's better to have newspapers."
These years are mud walls, and clods will fall down over time.
So when the Chinese New Year is approaching, most people will paste the walls with paper.
You can go to the store to buy white paper for the wall, but it is too expensive. If you catch up with the opportunity, it would be nice to buy some paper for the wall with newspapers.
Newspaper is thicker than white paper, and it is stronger to paste the wall.
So when Guo Shouye said there was a newspaper, Xu Shiyan nodded immediately, why not give it for free?
It’s good to order some newspapers without dropping the price, and save money on buying paper.
This is because Director Guo didn't regard Xu Shiyan as an outsider, so he took the initiative to mention the newspaper. If it were someone else, he might not necessarily give it to him.
Guo Shouye liked Xu Shiyan's honesty, so he immediately asked Xu Shiyan to go to the warehouse.
Hua pulled two large bundles of newspapers, weighing more than ten catties, and Xu Shiyan took them away.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: new year
chapters.content:
Chapter 176 New Year
After the fifteenth day of the twelfth lunar month, the year is getting closer and closer.
People who have worked hard for a year began to prepare all kinds of delicious and fun things.
Make new clothes for the children in the family, buy some New Year pictures, and buy some firecrackers.
Every time I go out and come back, the children surround me enthusiastically, chirping and asking what they bought.
Every household is also busy preparing for the New Year, killing pigs, making tofu, cleaning, unpacking and washing bedding, pasting walls, and steaming steamed buns.
The Xu family has almost the same process, but this year the family does not raise pigs, so it saves the link of killing pigs.
It was the second brigade, which killed twenty big fat pigs, and distributed some meat to each household.
The second brigade distributed the meat, and the Forestry Bureau distributed only flowers. In addition to rice, noodles, oil, peanuts, and sugar, each employee even distributed five catties of hairtail.
I don’t know which brother unit the Forestry Bureau bought with wood.
How about saying that many people have sharpened their heads and want to work as workers in the Forestry Bureau? It is true that the salary is very good.
With these, the Xu family doesn't have to buy anything.
Xu Shiyan took the time to go to Tonghua with Han Limin and the others to sell the bear bile and musk that he had hunted on the mountain before.
The musk is more expensive than bear bile, but it is light in weight, so it sold for more than three thousand.
Xu Shiyan said that he only needed one-third, but Han Limin disagreed, and finally gave Xu Shiyan two-fifths.
Having received 1,300 yuan, Xu Shiyan had to go to the Tonghua Department Store to buy something for his family to take home.
Clothes, shoes, fabrics, and some daily necessities, anyway, buy what looks right.
Some people need tickets, but it doesn’t matter, there are people selling tickets outside department stores.
As long as you are willing to pay, you can get any ticket.
Finally, I took a big bag of things home.
Xu Chenghou met, so he had to say something again, thinking that Xu Shiyan couldn't live a life, and spent money recklessly if he had money.
What did the old man say?
Just throw the fabric to Xu Shiqin and Su Anying, let them hurry up and make clothes.
It's not difficult, Xu Shiqin is in charge of cutting, and Su Anying is in charge of doing it.
Su Anying has learned a lot from her sister-in-law in the past six months. The sewing machine is very slippery, and it is easy to sew clothes.
The aunt and sister-in-law worked together, and they quickly made the whole family's new clothes.
It is said that those who have money but not have the money marry a daughter-in-law for the New Year, and when the New Year is approaching, many people get married here.
Not to mention other places, there are several in the second brigade. Xu Shiyan is called to help and drink wedding wine every day, and Su Anying is also called away to help cook at every turn.
Fortunately, Zhou Guilan is still at home, Xu Haiyuan can now eat chicken cakes and millet porridge.
Mom wasn't at home, and he didn't look for her, so Su Anying could help out with peace of mind.
On the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, Zhou Qingguo got married.
Speaking of which, it was a coincidence that Zhou Qingguo found his wife.
During the beginning of winter, Zhou Qingguo's mother, Mrs. Li, fell and broke her arm.
Zhou Qingguo accompanied his mother to the hospital, and for some reason, he met the doctor on duty in the hospital.
After Li's arm recovered and he was discharged from the hospital, Zhou Qingguo established a relationship with him.
Before, Zhou Changhe was worried that his son would talk about his daughter-in-law all day long, because he was afraid that his son would look down on this one and hit him as a bachelor.
Unexpectedly, Zhou Qingguo found a good partner, who has a job to earn wages, and looks good.
Zhou Changhe was afraid of having long nights and dreams, so he quickly found a matchmaker and went to the woman's house to propose marriage.
When the woman heard that Zhou Qingguo was demobilized from the army, he was working as a security assistant in the commune, and he liked it very much.
So the two families found an opportunity to meet, got engaged directly, and then got married before the end of the year.
When Zhou Qingguo got married, Xu's family members came over to attend the ceremony, help, drink wedding wine, and the excitement lasted until evening before returning home.
This year is the twenty-ninth New Year's Eve of the twelfth lunar month, and the days can't help but pass by. Before you know it, the year has come to an end.
After separation, the sons don’t have to come back to celebrate the New Year together.
So this year, only the old couple, Xu Shiyan, Xu Shixiang and Xu Shiqin will spend New Year's Eve together.
Although there are few people, the New Year’s program must not be left behind.
It is still hanging lanterns and posting couplets in the morning, having reunion dinner in the afternoon, making dumplings and keeping the year old in the evening.
After eating dumplings on New Year’s Eve, the bell of the new year is also ringing.
As the bell rang, Xu Shiyan and his wife held the child, Xu Shixiang and Xu Shiqin brothers and sisters, and everyone wished their parents New Year greetings together.
"Father, Mom, Happy Chinese New Year, I wish you both a long and healthy life and good luck."
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan's old couple looked carefully and nodded repeatedly.
"Okay, okay, everything is fine, you are all fine too. Be healthy and safe, as long as you are healthy, your parents will be fine."
The old couple can't say any gorgeous words, only a heart that loves their children.
"Come, come, bring my good grandson here, grandpa has a red envelope."
Xu Chenghou took out a red paper bag from his arms and waved to Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan, who is more than nine and a half months old, gets along very well with his grandfather these days.
Seeing grandpa beckoning, he twisted his body, trying to break free from his mother's arms and go to find grandpa.
Su Anying couldn't hold her son, so she could only put him on the kang and let the child crawl.
Xu Haiyuan changed into a red satin double-breasted padded jacket and black trousers today, and Xu Shiqin also specially made a melon cap made of the same material as the padded jacket.
Xu Haiyuan was originally white and chubby. Wearing this suit, he looked more festive and beautiful than the dolls in the New Year pictures.
Xu Chenghou was so rare that he hugged his grandson and kissed him several times.
"Come on, this is a red envelope from grandpa. It's a pocket money. Take it and don't lose it."
Xu Chenghou stuffed the red envelope into his grandson's hand, and kissed his grandson's fleshy little hand.
Xu Haiyuan is so young, so naturally he doesn't know what a red envelope is, but he just saw that the red color looks good, so he grabbed it in his hand and refused to let go, and no one would give it to him.
Zhou Guilan quickly took out a red envelope and handed it to her grandson.
The little witty ghost climbed up to grandma, raised his head, and kissed grandma. Zhou Guilan was so happy that the wrinkles on his face deepened a lot.
In previous years, the old couple gave lucky money to their grandchildren, not much, 20 cents each.
So Xu Shiyan didn't care, and let his son hold the red envelope in his hand, crawling all over the kang.
Before, all the mats in the house were made of kang mats.
The kang mat is made of reeds, with patterns on it, and it wears down clothes, and even if you are not careful, your hands will be pricked.
A few days ago, Xu Shiyan approached Guo Shouye and asked for a lot of fiberboard.
Paint the front side with paint, spread it on the kang, and paste the seam in the middle with cloth strips.
The kang made of this thing is slippery and slippery, much better than the mats on the kang. It is not afraid of damaging Xu Haiyuan's pants, and is not afraid of pricking his tender little hands.
Xu Haiyuan, on the other hand, is still a little uncomfortable, the kang is too slippery, it doesn't take much effort for him to get up, and he always slips, which is very interesting.
On New Year's Eve, the family has nothing to do, they can only eat melon seeds and drink tea and chat.
In the end, they were all sleepy, so Xu Shiyan and his wife simply carried their son back to Westinghouse to sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Change
chapters.content:
Chapter 177 Changes
Xu Haiyuan took a nap in the evening, and now he is sleepy,
Even so, he still held the two red envelopes tightly and refused to let go.
Su Anying undressed her son, put a diaper on it, and pulled out the red envelope while her son was sound asleep.
As a result, I opened it and saw that there were ten yuan in each of the two red envelopes. "Shiyan, look, our father and mother gave it to the child."
Xu Shiyan was shocked when he saw it, and hurried to the east room with the red envelope.
"Father, Mom, did you make a mistake, why did you give Yuanyuan so much money?"
A kid with ten dollars in a red envelope? Are you crazy?
Su Anying was a new wife last year, and she only got two yuan. How could she be so spoiled with children?
Xu Chenghou seemed to expect his son to come back to find him, so he was not surprised at all, and just rolled his eyes at his son.
"Grandpa gave to grandson, how much money do you still care about?
What the hell, when will I have to get your consent to do something? "
This is what the old couple had discussed a long time ago. They felt that they would live with the third child this winter, and that they would eat and drink for the third child, and that the third child would also buy clothes for the new year.
The old couple felt uncomfortable, so they wanted to use the name of giving the child lucky money to make fun of it.
Xu Shiyan somewhat understood what his parents were thinking, but this was too much.
Xu Shiqin's monthly salary is only a little over 20 yuan, and giving 20 yuan to a nine-and-a-half-month-old baby is also a loss to these two old ladies?
"Father, mother, we are a family, so you don't need to be so alien to me.
This money, you two should keep it, because we have to build a house after the next year. "Xu Shiyan reached out and handed the money to Zhou Guilan.
"Third brother, do you look down on your father?
Even if your father is incompetent, it’s not like he can’t even come up with twenty yuan, right? "
Xu Chenghou got angry and raised his voice.
"I tell you, it is for children, you save it, and you are not allowed to move it.
Do you think I gave you flowers? You are so beautiful. "
Xu Shiyan was so choked by his own father that he didn't dare to confront his father after Chinese New Year, what could he do?
"San'er, this is given to our grandson by our grandparents. It is more or less our intention, so don't worry about it.
Your father is right, you are responsible for helping to keep it, and when the child grows up, you can spend it as you like. "
On the other end, Zhou Guilan was rarely on the same side as her husband, helping her husband persuade her son.
In the end, Xu Shiyan still failed to convince his parents, so he had to accept the red envelope and go back to the Westinghouse, asking his wife to save the money for his son.
After New Year's Eve, when you open your eyes again, it will be the New Year's Day.
I made a lot of dumplings last night, so I specially left a curtain uncooked and put them outside to freeze.
In the morning, boil the water and cook the frozen dumplings. After the family finished eating the dumplings, before they finished cleaning up, the New Year's greetings came to the door.
Donggang is not like a big house with just a few households. There are more than 300 households in the second brigade alone, and there are also a large brigade and a third brigade.
Although Xu Shiyan has only been in Donggang Commune for a year, he gets along well with many people.
On this day, many people came in and out of the house, and they all came to pay New Year's greetings to Xu Chenghou and his wife.
Xu Shiyan also found an opportunity to visit the homes of Yu Shouguang and other brigade cadres, as well as Guo Shouye, Han Wenzhong and others, to pay New Year's greetings.
Anyway, this family sits for a while, and the other family chats, and the day passes like this.
The second day of the first lunar month is the day when the Xu family brothers reunite.
Xu Chenghou had already said that after the separation, no matter where he was, he had to come back on the second day of the first lunar month.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian are both in Songjianghe, so they are close to each other, and they arrived early with their wives and children.
Xu Shide lived a little far away from Daying, so at least he caught up with a Yanling bus. The couple rushed over in the morning with their son in their arms.
A big family gathered here at Xu Shiyan.
It's Chinese New Year, Xu Chenghou naturally won't care about his sons anymore, so his attitude is okay.
Especially when he saw his grandchildren, the old man was immediately overjoyed, and quickly took out a stack of red envelopes, giving each child 20 cents.
Seeing that the old man didn't mean to be angry, Xu Shixian and the others also breathed a sigh of relief, and sat down to chat with their parents and brothers.
"Hey, third child, your house even has a radio?
Sewing machine, radio, bicycle, plus the watch on your wrist, three turns and one sound let you get it all together, it's really doable. "
Xu Shian looked at the radio on the box, his eyes were wide open, how could he not be envious?
"Third son, if you want to make money in the future, remember to call your brother. You think my two sons should make more money, right?"
Xu Shian leaned over to his younger brother and said with a smile.
Xu Shian and Xu Shixian both moved to Songjianghe and settled in the food team.
This vegetable team is actually the family team of Forestry Bureau employees, who grow vegetables and sell them to Forestry Bureau employees.
Start working every spring, and work for one day, and the team will lend you one yuan as wages. After all the harvest in autumn is sold, the team will settle the wages.
In winter, there is basically nothing to do, so I can only idle.
Xu Shian and Xu Shixian had already entered winter when they moved here. They didn't work in the vegetable team in summer, so naturally they didn't have their salary.
These days, they are all living on the wages of Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong.
But there are four or five people in both families, so what do you do with that little salary?
It was thanks to the rations and money that were distributed when I moved out of the big house, not much, and with the savings I had saved before, I could hold on for a while at least.
Xu Shiyan looked at the two elder brothers beside him, feeling a little complicated, with a little worry hidden in his joy.
Because of his rebirth, the fate trajectory of the two brothers is also different from the previous life.
Originally, the eldest brother Xu Shixian should have settled in Donggang Commune in the spring of 1979.
Xu Shixian moved from a big house to Donggang. He has no foundation, and he just does some hard work.
In winter, the commune participates in logging, and Xu Shixian goes up the mountain to carry logs.
Anyone who has ever lifted a log knows that four people must lift a large log in unison, shouting and shouting.
One day when lifting the wood, Xu Shixian was on the front bar, and the big guy was chanting to lift it up, but the back bar staggered.
It doesn't matter this time, Xu Shixian's spine was injured, and after he recovered from the injury, he couldn't straighten up after bending over.
Fortunately, his injury was new, and he had been wearing a steel vest for two years, and it was corrected in a daze.
But because of this, Xu Shixian couldn't do any more vigorous work.
Fortunately, after the winter of 1979, the policy was changed, and it was allowed to withdraw from the company to work alone, and it was allowed to open photo studios, restaurants, barber shops and other individual businesses.
Xu Shixian knew how to fiddle with cameras, so he opened a photo studio, and he could make a fool of himself anyway.
Xu Shixian and his wife both had their own brains. They moved from Donggang to Songjianghe, bought a vacant lot and built a house by themselves, and then sold it after two years of construction, and made some money by dumping the house.
Later, the couple partnered with others again to run the ginseng business. They bought red goods from here and sold them in the south.
When it was the most prosperous, it was shipped to the south in wagons, and the money was carried back in suitcases.
It's a pity that in 1991 and 1992, the market for ginseng plummeted, Hong Kong companies stopped accepting the goods, and the sale of ginseng had to be suspended.
After that, Xu Shixian could only do some small business.
With the family wealth saved before, and after I got old, I applied for family worker retirement, and my life is quite comfortable, much better than Xu Shiyan.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Intend
chapters.content:
Chapter 178 Intended
In this life, affected by Xu Shiyan's relocation and Hu Liancheng's excessive disturbance, Xu Shixian moved out of the big house ahead of schedule, and then settled in the Evergreen Vegetable Team.
Thinking about it, I probably won't be carrying logs up the mountain like in my previous life.
Xu Shiyan reminded himself in his heart, remember to pay more attention to the boss this winter.
But don’t lift the wood, how can you avoid the disaster in your previous life.
Regardless of how the brothers get along, Xu Shiyan doesn't want his elder brother to suffer again. It is best to avoid getting hurt.
"Second brother, how do you feel about your stomach now? Do you have any stomach pain or discomfort?"
Compared to the injury of the elder brother, Xu Shiyan is more concerned about the stomach of the second brother. After all, it is enough to avoid accidents, but there are too many unknowns about diseases.
"Stomach? I don't feel much. Anyway, I ate those pork stomachs you prepared, and they were Ganoderma lucidum. I think the food tastes better than before, and my appetite is better."
Xu Shian shook his head, he didn't feel anything before.
It's just because of the kindness of the third brother, my mother earnestly urged me to eat pork belly and Ganoderma lucidum.
His stomach really doesn't feel much.
It is best not to feel. Xu Shiyan doesn't want his second brother to get sick. It would be great if he could take care of him like this.
"Well, I found a few more pork bellies, remember to take them back and eat them.
Also, you have to eat slowly when eating, because your eating habits are not good. "
Xu Shiyan was worried, so he had to give a few words of advice.
"Okay, what you say is what you say, isn't it okay to listen to you?"
Xu Shian was helpless, his younger brother also had good intentions, he couldn't refuse, otherwise he would annoy the third child, and he would not be able to earn money with him in the future.
"Fourth brother, how are you doing at Daying?" Xu Shiyan couldn't just talk to the second brother, so he turned to ask the fourth brother.
"It's okay, it's also a central elementary school, and the conditions are good.
I bought a house in the Hebei brigade, three rooms, not as big as the third brother’s yard, and it’s also cheap. I bought it for two hundred yuan.
I have to have my own house to live in, otherwise the child will cry and make noise all day long, and it will be too inconvenient to live in another house. "
Daying and Hebei are just across the Tanghe River. Xu Shide bought a house in Hebei. It is not far from Daying Central Primary School. It is very convenient to go back and forth. The key is that the house is cheap.
"Well, that's good, don't care about the size, I have a nest." Xu Shiyan nodded.
In his previous life, Xu Shide lived in Hebei for eight years, and was transferred to Xigang Township, where he has been living ever since.
These two are capable, Xu Shide went to work, and he still planted a hammer. If his son Xu Haiyang was not very successful, he made a lot of money, and the fourth couple could save a lot.
Xu Shide has a pension of three or four thousand a month, so he can live well when he is old.
How to put it, Xu Shiyan's family has always been poor in his previous life.
Old farmers have no retirement insurance and no pension when they get old.
At the beginning of the car accident, he suffered serious head injuries, but he managed to save his life.
After being discharged from the hospital, for two or three years, I was affected by the injury, and I was confused and confused. At first, I didn't even recognize my family members.
I gradually recovered later, but my physical strength couldn't keep up, and I couldn't do heavy work.
Fortunately, my daughter is capable, not only supporting the family, but also sending that brat out to study and find a job.
It's a pity that the **** didn't go home since he went out. He married a daughter-in-law outside, and the family had to pay for a house and a car, and gave the bride price to get married.
For that stinky boy, Xu Shiyan emptied his family fortune. What happened afterward?
Xu Shiyan said that he wanted to stay there for a few days, but he only listened to his wife's orders and refused to let him.
As soon as they heard that the house was going to be demolished, the couple jumped back, jumping up and down to fight for the family property.
In this life, the eldest son has been saved, and the eldest daughter and second daughter will be born next.
Xu Shiyan had made up his mind a long time ago that he wanted these three children. As for the **** son in his previous life, he could go to any family he wanted to be reincarnated in, anyway, he didn't care much about it.
The brothers haven’t seen each other for some time, and they had a good chat together.
At noon, Zhou Guilan led her daughter and daughter-in-law, and cooked two tables of dishes. The big guys ate and drank together, talking and laughing, which was pretty good.
After dinner, Xu Shixian and Xu Shian's family sat down for a while and then left. Xu Shide's family of three stayed for one night.
In the morning of the third day of junior high school, the new year is sent off, and the daughter and daughter can go back to their natal home after going out.
Xu Shiyan had to accompany Su Anying back to Daying, and happened to be with Xu Shide and the others.
Zhou Guilan went back to Daying to visit her mother a few years ago, so she doesn’t plan to make troubles after the next year. Older people don’t like to go out, so they try to stay at home as much as possible.
When I go back during the Chinese New Year, there are many relatives there, so it’s not good not to visit any of them.
It is not good to visit relatives empty-handed during Chinese New Year, and you have to spend a lot of money to buy things, and it also wastes time. Just thinking about it gives you a headache.
Donggang has a Chinese New Year movie show, and the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau has a Yangko team performing Yangko all day long. It is said that there are ice lanterns in front of the bureau building, which is quite lively.
Zhou Guilan plans to take her daughter and son to the movies together, and then go to the Bing Lantern when they are free.
Xu Shiyan accompanied his daughter-in-law back to Daying and only lived until the fifth day of the lunar new year, so he hurried back.
He is not thinking about movies or ice lanterns, but he really has a lot of things to prepare.
Xu Shiyan planned to go up the mountain after the fifteenth day, and do some serious business before the snow melts.
So after returning from Daying, others came to him to watch movies and Yangko dances, but he didn't go, and only devoted himself to weaving cages at home.
Xu Shiyan thought it over, and he went back to find a way to catch a few sables, otters, raccoon dogs, etc., and raise them on the mountain by himself.
At the beginning, keep a few less animals, take your time, wait for the policy to come down in October, and encourage members to raise livestock.
He developed economic animal breeding in advance, laid the groundwork early, and waited for the contract in 1983 to form a certain scale.
In the future, planting ginseng and cultivating it at the same time, walking on two legs is better than just pointing at ginseng.
Xu Shiyan's plan was not mentioned to his family.
However, he made cages all day long, and made some medicinal materials, rice bran, wheat bran, bean cakes and other things. The whole family felt strange.
asked, Xu Shiyan just fooled around, anyway, no matter who asked, he just didn't say what he wanted to do.
Xu Chenghou inquired several times, but Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, and he was so angry that he stopped asking.
Anyway, the son has separated into another family. He is the head of the family, and he can do whatever he likes, and he, as an old man, can't control it.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan made more than a dozen large and small cages before going up the mountain, and fried them with salt, rice bran, wheat bran, bean cakes, etc., steamed and pressed them into brick-sized bait.
There are also some other things that have been adjusted. Anyway, there are so many things that can almost hold a sledge.
During the Lantern Festival on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiqin's work unit gave out Lantern Festivals.
Zhou Guilan had a rare extravagance and fried two large plates with oil.
Golden and fragrant Lantern Festival, the big guys are so happy to eat, while eating, while sighing, the welfare of the Forestry Bureau workers is better.
After eating Lantern Festival, the family went to Songjiang River to watch the ice lanterns in the evening.
The ice lanterns of this year are absolutely genuine, and they are completely carved out of super large ice cubes.
Put a light bulb inside, and the light bulb lights up at night, just like a crystal palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 179: otter
chapters.content:
Chapter 179 Otter
After eating Lantern Festival and seeing ice lanterns, even if this Lantern Festival is over, the New Year is over.
On the sixteenth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan borrowed a horse sled from the commune.
Packed a sledge for food and various cages, took the dog and the sable, and went up the mountain.
As soon as I arrived on the mountain, I found that there were many fox footprints around the house, which must have been left by rascals who came back from time to time.
Opened the barn, and found several dead hares and pheasants.
Needless to say, this must be the ration that the rascal got back and stored.
This guy probably used the barn as a den, and even slept with a broken sack on the floor.
Knowing that Laipi Gui is safe, Xu Shiyan is also relieved, so he quickly lit the fire.
The kang has not been lit for a long time, and the chimney and the kang hole are full of cool breeze.
Okay, light a fire, all the smoke poured out from the stove, and Xu Shiyan coughed so hard that tears came out.
No choice but to keep the door open and continue to burn the fire. Xu Shiyan sat at the door, holding a cardboard box, and kept fanning.
It burned for about an hour, and the cold air was smoked out, and the smoke was slowly flowing. The chimney outside started to smoke, and the smoke in the house stopped.
The kang is ready, and there is still a stove. Fortunately, the stove is easier than the kang, and it will be fine if it smokes for a while.
After all the smoke in the room cleared, Xu Shiyan quickly closed the door, and the heat in the room slowly rose, and he felt warmer.
The house was warmed up, Xu Shiyan started to pack up and clean up, and then cook.
Going back this time, I brought a lot of sticky spoons, pancakes, pickles, miso, etc. from home. Su Anying also specially stewed a pot of sauerkraut for Xu Shiyan to bring.
It is much more convenient to cook in this way, just stick the hot spoon to the fire, then put the sauerkraut in the pot and stew it again.
At night, I suddenly heard the movement of a dog, not barking, but another kind of choking sound.
Xu Shiyan went out to check, and it turned out that the rascal was back, so let him enter the house quickly.
