Lai Pigui seemed very happy to see Xu Shiyan, walked around Xu Shiyan several times, and made a buzzing sound again.
Xu Shiyan couldn't laugh or cry, so he could only pat it on the head, and spread a sack on the ground again, so that the rascal could sleep in the house.
Back to the mountain on the second day, Xu Shiyan led Lai Pigui up the mountain, and set traps in the pine forest. Xu Shiyan was still thinking about catching another sable for his family companion.
In addition to trapping under the pine forest, Xu Shiyan and Lai Pigui went to the edge of the Xiaohei River to look for otters.
With the skinny ghosts around, it is not difficult to find otters, but how to catch them alive is difficult.
In the past, when Xu Shiyan found the otter, he just shot him and killed it.
But if you want to catch a job now, you have to use your brains to find a way.
In the upper reaches of the Xiaohei River, there is a warm spring where otters can be found.
Xu Shiyan built a ground fence near Nuanquanzi during the day. The ground fence was covered with pine bark and birch bark to keep out the wind and snow.
A thick layer of dried burdock grass and ulagrass are used to spread the floor inside, and a roe deer skin mattress is spread on top of it.
Why do you use roe deer skin when you go into the mountains? The main reason is that the roe deer skin has no smell, even if it is damp, it will not emit a special smell.
Going into the mountains in summer to catch the rain will not attract snakes. If you use other skins, it will smell when it rains and get wet, and it will easily attract snakes.
Of course, there are no snakes in winter, but otters have a very keen sense of smell. The skins of other animals have a smell, so the otters might not go ashore if they smell it.
Otters are very interesting. They play in the water during the day, pull in the water, and play games in the water. They are very courageous.
No matter what wild beasts on the shore stare at it, or even scare it, it doesn't care. If it plunges into the water, no one can do anything to it.
But at night, the otter becomes a coward.
There is only one way to go ashore and go into the water, stepping on your own footprints exactly, stop every step, listen for any movement, and then check if there are any traces of other animals around your footprints.
Once the situation is found to be wrong, immediately turn around and jump into the water and never come out again.
Xu Shiyan took advantage of the daytime to open an ice hole in the distance and caught a lot of fish.
Waiting for it to get dark, Xu Shiyan got into the box that had been set up in advance.
There was a special hole left in the box facing Nuanquanzi, and Xu Shiyan just stared at it with good eyes.
Suddenly, there was a crash, and two otters emerged from the water, rolled their small eyes, looked around, and then climbed out of the water to the shore.
The otter is a strange animal. Even though it just came out of the water, its fur seems to have a special layer of material, which does not stick to water after it comes out of the water.
Two otters went ashore carefully, walking and stopping, listening around for any unusual movements.
It wasn't until they confirmed that the surrounding area was safe that they took short legs, walked and sniffed, and went to rest in the bushes on the bank.
Xu Shiyan waited until there was no sound in the bushes, then crept out of the box, and set a few traps with fish on the road where the two otters had just passed.
This kind of clip is similar to a mouse trap, without serrations, so it won't hurt the otter.
But this kind of clip is very heavy, and the otter can't drag it, it can only spin around in place, so it is also called a mushroom clip.
Placing the clips, Xu Shiyan walked backwards, covering his footprints with a layer of snow.
In case the clever otter finds something unusual, or smells something and runs away.
Xu Shiyan retreated back to the box, just squatting inside and staring.
Fortunately, he was wearing thick clothes, and the zipper was still a wind block, so he wouldn't be damaged by the cold.
When the eastern sky was slightly white, the two landed otters felt hungry, so they came out of the grass.
After looking around for a while, he felt that there was no danger, so he walked to Nuanquanzi with peace of mind following the footprints left last night.
As a result, not long after walking, I smelled the smell of fish. Following the smell of fish, I saw delicious fish on the clip.
Otter, who was already hungry, immediately became happy when he saw the fish.
But these two guys were very vigilant, and they didn't rush over immediately. Instead, they squeaked and returned to the grass again.
Then poked his head out and looked around until he confirmed that there was no danger around him, then he came out boldly and went straight to the fish.
Xu Shiyan put several traps, and the two otters went to each other.
As a result, they just bit the fish, and before they could run away with their mouths, they touched the clips and caught them all at once.
Xu Shiyan has been staring at the two otters, seeing this situation, come out of the closet immediately.
Walked closer, caught the two otters, and put them into the cages prepared in advance.
These two otters happen to be a male and a female, and they are about three years old, which is a good time.
"Let's go, go back with me, I will take care of eating and drinking in the future."
Xu Shiyan looked at the two round, cylindrical bodies, short legs, brown and black shiny fur little guys in the cage, and was overjoyed.
With these two live otters, if they are kept well, after a few years, they will be much better.

chapters.title: Chapter 180: farming
chapters.content:
Chapter 180 Breeding
Successfully caught a pair of otters, which gave Xu Shiyan a little more confidence in the future of breeding.
Of course, it also added a lot of things to his career as a reference. Every day he had to go to the river to catch fish and shrimps, and come back to feed the two otters.
Xu Shiyan only caught this pair of otters, and didn't catch any more after that.
The main reason is that he doesn't have much confidence in the breeding of otters. Everything is in the process of exploring the rules, so he can only try to raise two first.
If there are too many at once, he can't take care of them, and it would be a pity to raise them to death.
A few days later, Xu Shiyan went for a walk on the mountain, and accidentally caught another sable.
It happens to be a male, and there can only be a couple with the one at home.
But this thing is timid, and it takes a long time to recover after being frightened.
Besides, sables usually live alone, so Xu Shiyan didn't dare to put two sables in one cage rashly, so he had to lock them up separately and put the two cages next to each other.
Suddenly there are several small animals, and it seems that the ginseng house is not suitable for breeding.
No way, Xu Shiyan cleaned up the warehouse and reserved it as a place for breeding.
For the time being, he can only do this, and after a while the weather gets warmer, and he will find another way to resettle the animals.
Since the addition of these animals, Xu Shiyan's daily workload has also increased.
Not only to catch fish and shrimps, but also to set traps and traps to get some meat for the two sables to eat.
Sables are omnivores, and their food is mainly small birds and animals, as well as some pine nuts, berries, and insects.
In order to raise them, Xu Shiyan also spent a lot of brainpower, and specially made a batch of mouse traps to catch mice to feed the sables.
In addition to these, Xu Shiyan also went to the south of the Xiaohei River in a forest that had just been felled for a few years, shoveling snow and laying bait.
The bait is specially prepared for deer, it contains a lot of salt, and there are also some bran and bean cakes, all of which are prepared according to the deer's favorite taste.
Deer like to eat bark, branches and leaves.
In the forest after felling, some branches will re-emerge from the roots of the tree, which is the favorite of deer.
Xu Shiyan had hunted deer here before, but now, he came up with another way.
Put the bait in the snow, then blow the horn made of birch bark, and gradually, the deer will be attracted.
The herd of deer will hang around here from time to time when they find salty and delicious bait.
From now on, every time Xu Shiyan puts bait, he will blow the horn to call the deer, come and go, those deer are used to it, and run this way when they hear the sound.
Nowadays, the most valuable thing about deer is antler.
Others such as deer heart, deer blood, deer tendon, deer fetus, etc., are not accepted by the buying station, and can only be kept for home use or given away.
The velvet antler should wait until after the beginning of spring to grow to two short branches, before the bone becomes ossified, the quality is the best.
So Xu Shiyan didn't intend to kill the deer any more. He had to find a way to attract the deer, and at that time, he would use medicine to stun the deer and cut the antler.
The resources in the mountains are gifts from nature, but they are by no means inexhaustible.
If it cannot be used rationally and blindly kills, it will only be exhausted and the resources will be exhausted in the end.
Hunting is not just to eat the meat, but more importantly, to create economic value.
Deer antlers are valuable, but killing a deer for two antlers, after cutting off the antlers, the meat can only be eaten, which is obviously a bit wasteful.
It may be a better way to cut the antlers and sell them for money without harming the lives of the deer.
Of course, these are all Xu Shiyan’s wishful thinking, and it is much more difficult to implement them in practice, but he is willing to try, what if it succeeds?
Busy and busy, the first month will pass soon, and the weather will gradually warm up. The young people of the second brigade have all gone up to the mountain to work.
Sun Xiaofeng, Huang Shengli, and the others brought Xu Shiyan some food every now and then, and Su Anying entrusted them to bring them here, for fear that Xu Shiyan would not be able to eat well and suffer on the mountain.
On this day, Xu Shiyan went to the second crop forest early in the morning to throw bait to attract deer.
As soon as I came back, I saw the carriage of the team approaching, and a group of people jumped out of the carriage.
"Brother Xu, my uncle Xu has come up the mountain." Feng Chao was the first to jump out of the car and shouted at the top of his voice.
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard it, and hurried over. At this time, Sun Xiaofeng and Huang Shengli helped Xu Chenghou out of the carriage.
"Father, why did you come up the mountain?" The field work is done by strong guys, why is this old man still up here?
Xu Chenghou glanced at the third son, didn't say anything, just handed him the bag in his hand.
"Come on, let's go into the house and talk about it." At first glance, there is something wrong.
Xu Shiyan's heart skipped a beat, what happened at home? Surprised his father to come up the mountain?
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to ask, and followed behind his father, and the two of them went into the small room.
As soon as he entered the room, the old man turned his head and glared at his son.
"Clean up and go home for two days. I'll watch over the club for you on the mountain." Xu Chenghou suddenly said these two words.
"Huh? I'll go back, you watch for me? What?"
Xu Shiyan was immediately stunned, what happened at home, the father is not fair, and he needs to go down the mountain?
"What? What are you talking about? You don't know what you did when you went home during the Chinese New Year?
Yuanyuan is only eleven months old, and before weaning, your wife is pregnant again.
What kind of **** are you, can't you hide a little bit? "
Xu Chenghou saw his son's masked expression, and became even more angry. He raised his leg and kicked Xu Shiyan.
This **** bastard left his grandson without milk, so he deserves a beating.
"Huh? Yingzi is pregnant again?" Xu Shiyan was dumbfounded, no way? When did it happen?
My God, my daughter-in-law's place is really good, it's really good food.
But this is too frequent, right? The eldest is only eleven months old, no, he went up the mountain on the sixteenth day of the first lunar month, and the eldest was only ten months old at that time.
Pregnant with the second child so early, can the daughter-in-law's body bear it?
"Father, help me watch on the mountain for a day, I'll go home and have a look."
How can Xu Shiyan hold his breath right now? He had to go home quickly to see his wife and take her to the hospital for a physical examination.
Women are not good. Pregnant too often, it hurts the body.
"Nonsense, what am I doing here? Isn't it just to read the reference for you? You bastard, you can make you mad every day."
Xu Chenghou rolled his eyes, feeling that his son was stupid as hell.
It’s not to help his son to see the reference, he is so old, what is he doing all over the mountain?
"By the way, Dad, come here, I have to tell you something."
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan was not so dazed that he couldn't remember anything, so he quickly dragged Xu Chenghou to the warehouse, and showed Xu Chenghou the otters and sables.
"Father, I caught this, and I plan to raise it myself, and these open-mouthed beasts have to be fed.
Did you see it? The fish in this bucket are fed to otters, and the pheasants, chickadees, and rats here are fed to sables.
There’s nothing I can do now, I’ll think about it after a while, and feed them the whole thing. "

chapters.title: Chapter 181: girl is here
chapters.content:
Chapter 181 The daughter is here
Xu Shiyan explained everything on the mountain clearly, grabbed his bicycle, and hurried down the mountain.
Not to mention taking a break on the road, those pedals wish they could be hot wheels, they almost made him kick out sparks.
It usually takes more than an hour to get home, but today I arrived at my gate in about 40 minutes.
Xu Shiyan got out of the car and pushed it to the yard. He had just taken two steps when he heard the sound of his son crying loudly from the room.
Xu Shiyan was so anxious that he couldn't care less about his bicycle, so he leaned on the garden stick and walked quickly into the house.
"Yuanyuan, what's wrong?" Xu Shiyan entered the room and asked.
Zhou Guilan was coaxing her grandson in her arms, and when she saw her son come back, she was even more angry.
"What's the matter? What's the matter? He has no milk, weaned, can he stop crying? He's only eleven months old and has no milk to eat."
Old people are like this, feeling sorry for their grandson, seeing his grandson crying like that, Zhou Guilan is anxious and angry, can he not be angry?
"When he had milk before, he would just take a few bites and would not eat, and he was only in love with eating.
Hey, it’s gone this time, he’s come to his senses again, and when he sees his mother, he’ll look for milk to feed, and cry if he doesn’t give it.
The same goes for the two of you. Whose child doesn’t eat milk for eighteen months and twenty months?
You guys are good, the child is only so old, and he has no milk to eat. "
Zhou Guilan feels sorry for her grandson, and she is also exhausted physically and mentally by her grandson. How can she have a good face? Arresting his son is a stinky training.
Xu Shiyan's head was full of black lines, "It's my fault, I didn't pay attention. So what should I do now?"
He has been on the mountain for a few months, isn't he happy to get close to his wife when he comes home? Who would have thought it would be so easy to get pregnant?
"How can I fix it? How can I fix it? If I know how to fix it, tell you to come back?"
Zhou Guilan's anger did not dissipate, and she continued to bombard her son.
Xu Shiyan was scolded by his father on the mountain, and was disgraced by his mother when he returned home.
But the daughter-in-law is already broken, so what else can I do?
"Or, I'll go to Uncle Feng and borrow a milk sheep?"
The son needs milk, but the daughter-in-law is gone. Can the store sell milk powder these days? It is estimated that it is choking enough.
It seems that I can only try goat milk, and I can find a way to get this.
Zhou Guilan sighed, "He's used to breastfeeding. If you let him drink goat's milk, he can do it? That's goat's milk."
"Try it, I'll go find Uncle Feng, if it's okay, bring the sheep back first.
If it doesn’t work, I’ll send it back, that’s okay. "My eldest son has no rations, so he has to think of a way.
"Hey, don't lead the sheep, just milk some goat milk, I'll boil it and see if he drinks it.
If it doesn’t work, you can go shopping for more eggs, dried noodles and so on. There are fine grains provided by the sixth child at home, so make them for him to eat in different ways.
He had already eaten, and he was just looking for awkwardness these days. "
Zhou Guilan lost her temper, but now her anger subsided, and her tone softened a lot.
Actually, most people in this day and age are not shy about it, let alone contraception.
Many women are pregnant again before the birthday of their last child, which is normal.
What should the child do if he has no milk? In good condition, steam some chicken cakes with rice soup.
If the conditions are not good, it is good if you can drink rice soup. Whatever the adults eat, just chew and feed the children, and they can also be raised.
Xu Chenghou's old couple mainly like Xu Haiyuan too much, that baby is chubby and cute.
In the past few days, the baby has been making a fuss, has no milk and doesn’t like to eat, and has lost a lot of weight. Grandparents feel distressed, so they get so angry.
But things are already like this, it's useless to get angry, you have to find a way to solve it.
Xu Shiyan nodded, turned around and went to the west room to see his wife, but as soon as he entered the room, he saw Su Anying sitting on the kang crying.
The son in that room kept crying, and the mother and son were connected. Can Su Anying not feel distressed?
But the child cried even harder when he saw her, so Su Anying didn't dare to go over, so she could only hide in the west room and cry secretly.
Xu Shiyan looked at it, and he was really big, "Daughter-in-law, don't cry, it's not a big deal.
Won't that bear thing have to be weaned sooner or later? It's just right to break it at this time, it will save him a little older, more thoughtful, and he is only in love with breastfeeding and refuses to eat properly. "
In fact, all babies have such a stage. When they first come into contact with foods other than breast milk, they are obsessed with the taste of various foods and do not eat much milk.
I drink milk like water, and I just take two bites when I think about it.
When he is about to turn one year old, he starts to have a long-term mind. He refuses to eat well and wants to eat milk all day long.
Xu Haiyuan is stuck at this juncture right now, that's why he can make such a fuss.
It’s okay to wean off milk, eat well.
Based on the Xu family now, it is still possible to provide a baby like Xu Haiyuan with some good food.
"Let's go, change some clothes, I'll accompany you to the hospital for an examination.
Alas, it was also my fault that you got pregnant with your second child so early. Let's go check it out. If there is any nutritional deficiency, make up for it quickly. "
Compared to his son, Xu Shiyan is more worried about his daughter-in-law. He has only given birth to his eldest son for eleven months, and now he is pregnant again. I am afraid that his health has not recovered yet.
Su Anying felt better after being comforted by her husband.
So he went to change clothes, and Xu Shiyan and Xu Shiyan quietly left the house, and quickly slipped away before Xu Haiyuan found out.
The hospital is near, and it will be there in five minutes. Xu Shiyan accompanied his wife to find Dr. Yang.
Dr. Yang checked Su Anying, drew blood for a test, and told Xu Shiyan that Su Anying was in good health.
Although the child was conceived a little earlier, Su Anying is young, so she just needs to take care of her after giving birth.
"Go back and rest more, if you vomit badly, come to the hospital and I will prescribe some medicine.
As long as you can hold back, then don’t take medicine, it’s three-point poisonous, and it’s not very good for children. "Doctor Yang has to give some instructions.
"Well, doctor, I want to ask, when was this child born?"
Before being scolded by his parents, Xu Shiyan didn't think about it at all.
At this moment he finally calmed down, and he suddenly realized that the time when his wife was pregnant seemed to be about the same as the time when he was pregnant with his eldest daughter in his previous life.
In their previous life, their first child left within a few days after birth, and then Xu Shiyan also returned to work in the mine, while Su Anying was at home.
When it was Chinese New Year, the mine was on vacation for a while, Xu Shiyan stayed at home for a while, and later Su Anying became pregnant with their eldest daughter.
"Well, according to normal calculations, it should be born in early November."
Dr. Yang counted the days and gave a time.
Xu Shiyan did some calculations in his mind. In his previous life, his eldest daughter was born on September 19th of the lunar calendar in 1979. Does it seem to be November 7th or 8th in the Gregorian calendar?
Based on this calculation, they should be able to match.
It turns out that this is the eldest daughter who has come to report. No wonder she is in such a hurry. Are you afraid that you will be too late to catch up?
"Thank you doctor, then we'll go first if there's nothing else to do."
Knowing that the child in his wife's belly was likely to be a eldest daughter, Xu Shiyan let alone his joy, thanked Dr. Yang quickly, and then helped his daughter-in-law out of the hospital.
"Daughter-in-law, did you hear what the doctor said just now?
Go home and rest as much as possible, don't do too much work, you are double now, you have to pay attention. "

chapters.title: Chapter 182: solve
chapters.content:
Chapter 182 Solved
The couple left the hospital, went straight to the barn of the brigade, found Uncle Feng, and explained to him why they came.
Old Feng laughed as soon as he heard it, and hurriedly found Jiashi to squeeze a pot of goat milk.
"Go back and boil it to cool down, put it in a feeding bottle and give it to the children to try.
If the child can drink, you come over again, and I will lead you a ewe that has just given birth to go back. "
The couple were very grateful. After thanking Lao Feng, they took the goat milk and went home.
As soon as she got home, Su Anying hurried to light the fire, found a small aluminum pot, washed it clean, and boiled goat milk for her son.
After cooking, let it hang out for a while. There is no bottle at home, so I put it in a bowl and feed it little by little with a spoon.
Not to mention, Xu Haiyuan has a strong mouth.
I guess I haven't drank milk for several days, and I drank goat milk with relish, and I just fed half of the bowl of milk with a spoon.
Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief when he saw this.
So he took the money and went out. First, he found Yu Shouguang, told Yu Shouguang, and bought a milk sheep directly from the team.
This is different from before. At that time, if you borrow it for ten days and half a month, you can send it back. Who knows how long Xu Haiyuan will have to eat milk?
In addition, Su Anying is also pregnant, so it is a good idea to drink goat milk to supplement nutrition properly.
Simply buy one and bring it home, let the two of you drink it together.
The sheep in the team are also raised for sale, so who is it different to sell to?
Yu Shouguang agreed without saying a word, and asked Xu Shiyan to pick the best one.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan took a sheep home, and searched around for some bean pod skins, corn stalks, etc. to feed the sheep.
Persist for a while, after a while, the snow will melt, and the grass and trees will sprout in the woods behind, so the sheep will have something to eat.
Xu Haiyuan had goat milk to drink, so he didn't cry as much as before.
Anyway, seeing Su Anying, she was still sticky and wanted to be hugged by her mother, and she hugged her mother's neck with a look of grievance.
Zhou Guilan was worried about Su Anying's body, and she was afraid that Xu Haiyuan was too young, and it would be bad if the two of them bumped into each other.
So after a while, I took my grandson away to coax her, and let Su Anying rest as much as possible.
Xu Shiyan saw that his home was still safe, so he was relieved. He ate something at home at noon, and then rode back to the mountain in the afternoon.
He didn't dare to let the old man stay on the mountain at night, so take advantage of the opportunity of getting off work in the afternoon and let the old man go home quickly.
Ever since he knew his wife was pregnant again, Xu Shiyan was a little uneasy on the mountain.
Every five or six days, during the day when everyone went to work in the mountains, I hurried home by bicycle to take a look and pick up some meat and fish along the way.
After Qingming, the ice and snow melted and exposed the ground, so Xu Shiyan took the time to build another warehouse.
It’s not right either, it can’t be called a barn, it should be called a barn, which is specially built for sables and otters.
The two sables have not yet reached the breeding season, that is, they live in a single room, but they have been replaced with a larger iron cage.
Inside, there are sleeping and resting nests made of hay and fur, and there are feeding and watering troughs.
The cage is one and a half feet above the ground, and the feces pulled by the sables fall directly on the ground, which is basically the same as a rabbit cage.
It’s just bigger, and it’s a little more clean and luxurious.
The otter's nest is more troublesome. The place where this thing lives must have water.
No way, Xu Shiyan found a broken big tank, only half of the bottom of the tank was needed, and a pool was built.
Some fish are put into the pool every day, and a very clean and warm nest is also built next to it.
Otters play in the pool during the day, catch fish to eat, and return to their nests to rest at night.
The otter probably has a big heart and is happy with the situation. The female otter was pregnant a while ago, and she will give birth after a while.
The people who came to work in the team said that Xu Shiyan was so whimsical that he could raise sables and otters.
Xu Shiyan didn't argue with them either, since he didn't raise many animals anyway, and raising those that couldn't live was purely an experiment, just try his luck.
In the blink of an eye, it is May, and azaleas are blooming all over the mountains and plains, and it is time to plant the land again.
Xu Shiyan was watching ginseng on the mountain, and he didn’t have time to go back to farm. Datian didn’t matter, they were all in the team, and farming earned work points. He also earned work points while watching ginseng on the mountain.
But the family's private land and vegetable garden can't be cultivated, so Xu Shiyan is also a little anxious.
So I sent a message to ask Xu Chenghou to come up. Xu Chenghou was on the mountain during the day, and Xu Shiyan rode home early, and then rode up the mountain after finishing his work.
The good thing is that Shouguang also knows the situation of the Xu family, and when he went to the land, he asked people to visit the Xu family's private land of less than one mu.
In this way, you don’t have to work hard to dig all the picks on the ground.
In addition, Su Anying also followed up the mountain, and the couple planed and planted one by one, and they quickly planted their private land.
"Otherwise, shall I go up the mountain with you?"
After planting the private plot, when Xu Shiyan was going to ride back to the mountain in the evening, Su Anying said.
"Huh? You go up the mountain with me? No, you are pregnant with a child, what are you doing up the mountain? Stay at home.
There is still Yuanyuan at home, we can't take Yuanyuan up the mountain, it's too dangerous. "
If there is no Xu Haiyuan, or if the wife is not pregnant, just follow up the mountain and go up the mountain.
Anyway, the participants there are all newly planted, and there is not much work, so it is quite safe.
Su Anying went up the mountain, and she can help take care of those open-mouthed beasts, and Xu Shiyan can also let go of his hands and feet to make money.
But there is still Xu Haiyuan, the little ancestor, now he is not clamoring for breastfeeding, this baby can already walk a few steps staggeringly, and is very good at shopping.
If this is thrown directly to Zhou Guilan, Zhou Guilan, who is naughty and can do it, won't have time to cook.
If you take it up the mountain, let alone, I don’t know how he will do it.
Su Anying was still pregnant with the child, and she took care of the place and the child by herself, and had to cook and so on, which was impossible.
So, it’s better for Xu Shiyan to suffer a little bit, as long as the daughter-in-law and son suffer less.
"Let's stay at home, you and our mother take turns looking after the children, and you can still have time to cook a meal or something.
Our mother is not young anymore, it is too tiring to throw the child to her. "
Xu Shiyan can only persuade his daughter-in-law in this way, there is no other way, there is no time when everything goes well when living at home.
If you want to make money, you have to suffer. How can you make a lot of money without suffering? Pie in the sky? impossible.
Su Anying wanted to go up the mountain to help out, how can I say, after all, the family has already separated.
Always let Xu Chenghou go up the mountain to see the ginseng, and Xu Shiyan goes down the mountain to work. Others know it, and they will inevitably say that Xu Shiyan is taking advantage of his parents.
He said that the family was separated, but in fact he still asked his parents for help if he needed help.
If Su Anying went to live in the mountains, on the one hand, she would take care of Xu Shiyan, and on the other hand, she would take care of the place during the day, Xu Shiyan could come back to work without any delay.
But what Xu Shiyan said is also reasonable, the current situation is special, Xu Haiyuan's mischievous ghost is really beyond the reach of ordinary people.
"Okay, then I'll stay at home, and I don't need you to come back for nothing important.
I can plant the vegetable garden at home, and I can also shovel and thin the seedlings in the private plot. You can rest assured on the mountain, and you will lose weight after tossing back and forth. "
Su Anying looked at her husband distressedly. He has been busy for a while, and Xu Shiyan is dark and thin, just like Dong Dong.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Antler cutting
chapters.content:
Chapter 183 Cutting antlers
In mid-May, the large fields and private plots are all planted.
The newly planted mallet seedlings have just been unearthed, and we have to wait a few more days for weeding, so there is no work for the time being.
In the woods, all kinds of wild vegetables grow just right, but at this time no one is picking them up to sell, and even if they sell them, no one will buy them.
At most, you can get something to eat, and you don’t have to go far. You can find it anywhere in the forest, just grab a few pieces.
Xu Shiyan began to miss the antler.
In this season, the antler on the stag's head just emerges from the second branch, more than 20 centimeters long, which is the best time to cut the antler.
So, early this morning, Xu Shiyan took his newly made bait with ingredients in it, and went to the second stubble forest.
After several months of observation, Xu Shiyan has figured out the situation of the deer herd.
There is a large herd of deer near here, with a total of thirty or forty deer, a dozen male deer, and the rest are female deer and young deer.
Xu Shiyan scattered about a dozen bait blocks on an open space. Special materials were added to the bait blocks, and the deer would fall asleep after eating the bait blocks.
After placing the bait, Xu Shiyan immediately retreated to the upper air outlet and blew the birch bark horn in his hand.
The herd of deer were in love with the bait that was fed from time to time, and refused to go too far.
After this period of guidance and training, the deer will know that there is something good to eat when they hear the sound, so the head deer will immediately run towards this side with the deer.
Sika deer are good at running in the mountains and forests, and they are extremely fast. Usually they can't catch up with dogs.
So not long after Xu Shiyan blew the horn, he saw a large herd of deer running wildly in the distance.
At this time, Xu Shiyan lit a tin can he brought.
Inside the tin can is a drug that Xu Shiyan concocted from medicinal materials such as Ziheche and Yangjinhua.
If people smell it after lighting it, they will quickly fall into a coma.
But this is in an open space, and the aroma will be diluted if you are far away, and the deer is big, so I can't guarantee the effect.
However, with the scent and the contents of the bait, it should be able to bring down this group of deer.
Xu Shiyan mainly didn't want the lives of these deer, he only wanted antlers, so he spent a lot of trouble.
Otherwise, just put medicine in the bait block, and the poison will kill it, it’s that simple.
Otherwise, you can throw bait and shoot the deer directly when it comes, without too much effort.
But if you kill a deer, you can only get antler once, and then it will be gone.
Using this method, one crop in spring can be harvested, and another crop can be harvested in autumn. As long as the deer herd is still there, he can continue to harvest next year and the next year.
After two years of waiting for the conditions to improve, he simply caught the deer and raised them in captivity, wouldn't it be better?
After lighting the incense, Xu Shiyan immediately retreated to a small hillside in the distance, and the cat watched from behind the bushes.
Then I saw a group of deer rushing to the Erchao forest. The stags didn’t care about their wives and children at this time, and rushed to eat the bait.
The bait pieces are fried and steamed thoroughly with bran, bean cakes, etc., mixed with salt and special materials, and then compacted and dried.
Although the grass has grown on the ground this season, how can the grass be delicious?
Especially the salt in it is the favorite of deer.
The female deer can't grab it, so they can only wander around, waiting for the male deer to eat almost, before picking up some leftovers.
A dozen or so stags each occupy a piece, bowing their heads and gnawing.
At this time, there was a faint scent of flowers in the air. The deer were in love with the bait, and ignored the scent at all, still lowering their heads to eat.
By the time they gnaw halfway through, the medicine in the bait has already exerted its effect.
Combined with the continuous fragrance, the stags began to shake, their legs became weak, and they couldn't get up when lying on the ground.
The doe and fawn didn't know what happened, and they also smelled the aroma, so they were a little confused at the moment.
Looking at the bait on the ground, they are reluctant to leave and want to eat some.
Xu Shiyan took advantage of this opportunity, extinguished the incense in the tin can, and quickly came to the herd of deer.
The doe and fawn were frightened, and fled away staggeringly.
But the bucks ate too much bait, and the medicine took effect. They were weak and their limbs were weak, and they couldn't get up after struggling a few times.
I saw Xu Shiyan stepping forward with a hacksaw, creaking it, and sawing off a piece of deer antler with a few strokes.
At this time, the deer antler has honeycomb holes inside and is loose in texture, so it is very easy to saw the velvet.
The antler was sawed off, and some blood came out from the cut.
Deer antler blood is a good thing, Xu Shiyan naturally refused to let it go.
He took out new cotton from his pocket, dipped the blood from the cut, and threw it into a small bottle he brought.
Wild animals are not human beings. They have particularly good resilience and strong resistance to drugs.
So Xu Shiyan had to hurry up and saw off all the antlers as soon as possible, and then collected the antler blood.
Apply some anti-inflammatory and hemostatic powder on the fracture of the velvet antler, and stick it with adhesive tape.
Xu Shiyan's movements were already very fast, even so, as soon as he finished treating the antlers and wounds of the dozen or so stags, that deer stood up danglingly, and the other stags also began to struggle to stand up.
Xu Shiyan saw it, and knew that the strength of the medicine would soon pass, so he ran away without saying a word, carrying his bag on his back.
If you are surrounded by those deer, I dare not say what will happen, so run away.
When Xu Shiyan ran to the top of the hill, he looked back and saw that the dozen or so stags could already stand up, but their legs were not very good, and they were shaking and trembling.
It is estimated that after a while, nothing will happen. The resilience of wild animals is really unacceptable.
No matter what, the velvet antlers are all in hand. The velvet antlers of a dozen or so stags filled a big bag.
These are all processed and sent to the purchase station, they can be sold for a lot of money.
Xu Shiyan no longer looked back at the herd of deer. He knew that the deer would be fine, so he hurried back.
After returning to the ginseng hut, quickly squeeze out the blood from the antler and clean the dirt and dust on the outside.
Use a glass shovel to scrape off the fluff outside the antler.
Traditional Chinese medicine is made with no copper and iron, so you can't use a knife, you have to use glass **** or bamboo sticks.
After that, tighten the saw edge with thread, sew it into a net shape, nail small nails on the top of the antler, and hang it on the shelf with a hemp rope.
Put it in boiling water and scald it three or four times until white foam appears at the fracture and stop when it smells like egg yolk, and dry the velvet antler.
The next day, it has to be ironed again, and then air-dried or oven-dried.
A piece of fresh velvet antler is about a catty. After processing and drying, there are only a few taels left, which is light and fluffy.
If you cut it into slices, you can see that the velvet antler has a red core, all of which are honeycomb eyes.
If you wait until another branch is grown, the quality will not be as good as it is now.
As for the cotton dipped in deer antler blood, Xu Shiyan had already thrown it into a barrel of high-grade liquor.
He bought it in advance and prepared to make deer blood wine.
Deer antler blood infused wine, that's a good thing, a gas station for men, I don't know how many people want it.
Waiting for the time to go down the mountain, I gave Lao Guo two bottles, and kept him happy to accept it.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: ready to build a house
chapters.content:
Chapter 184 Prepare to build a house
The fifty-foot stick was topdressed with bean cake water last year, and it is still growing well this year.
The two hundred feet newly planted with the compound fertilizer prepared by Xu Shiyan as the base fertilizer last year, after being unearthed this year, the club seedlings grew taller and stronger than the club seedlings that did not use the base fertilizer.
It can be clearly seen that the sticks with base fertilizer are growing well.
After Yu Shouguang came up to see it in person, he immediately decided that all the frozen ones this year will be topdressed.
Then prepare some base fertilizer. When planting sticks in autumn, try to use all the base fertilizer.
Base fertilizer plus top dressing can increase yield by 50%.
It's been three years of service, who doesn't want to produce more, it's all money.
How much is the bean cake? The team didn't go elsewhere to search and climb, so they had to prepare.
Xu Shiyan is a technician in the second brigade, and he has to lead people to work on these things, but the stick on the side of Xiaoheihe can't be left alone.
On the second day after Xu Shiyan came back from cutting the velvet antlers, Yu Shouguang went up the mountain to look for Xu Shiyan.
"Xiao Xu, that's my plan, and on your side, I'll arrange someone to come up.
Recently, you went back to take charge of the fattening business first, what do you think? "
"Uncle Yu, you can arrange whatever you want, I will listen to you."
Yu Shouguang is the secretary, and Xu Shiyan is a member, so of course they have to listen to the leaders.
"Then look, who is more appropriate to arrange?"
It was agreed at the beginning, who will be arranged by Xiaoheihe, and Xu Shiyan will choose the person.
Yu Shouguang is not the kind of person who doesn't count what he says. Once he has said something, he must fulfill it. Therefore, Xu Shiyan has to decide the choice.
"Uncle, do you think it's okay to let my dad come up?"
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, this matter can't ask outsiders.
There are otters and sables on this mountain, and rascals come back from time to time, and they are replaced by others. What if greed for money harms these little things?
In terms of reliability, who can compare to your own father? Don't look at Xu Chenghou's bad temper, but he does a good job.
Now the ginseng field is surrounded by ground guns, cannons, and traps, and it is newly planted. No one can come here. The old man looked on the mountain and saw that nothing happened.
Besides, when Xu Shiyan is not busy, he can come up to live at night, and the father and son are just right for company.
Besides, when Xu Chenghou came up, the team also gave full work points. The old man is still earning full work points in his sixties. Where can he find such a good job?
"Okay, you two are more reliable than others on the mountain.
Success, then I will go back and tell your father to ask him to come up the mountain tomorrow, and you will go down to take care of the fattening. "
As soon as Yu Shouguang heard this, he immediately agreed.
For him, it doesn't matter who comes to see the participants, what is important is the fertilization technology that Xu Shiyan has mastered.
Compared to the increase in production with a stick, a person's work points are nothing.
Don't talk about the work points of one person, it is ten people, how much money is it all year round?
If you can increase the production by 50% for this tens of thousands of sticks, how much will it be?
Any fool knows which one is the best deal, and Yu Shouguang is not stupid.
"Xiao Xu, as long as you understand the matter of fattening, when the time comes, our team will have a hammer and the production will increase. I will credit you a great contribution."
Yu Shouguang's words are sincere and sincere, not making a big deal.
The ginseng output of the second brigade has increased, if he doesn't give Xu Shiyan some benefits, he won't be able to keep people at all.
Other brigades, communes, or even the county, as long as they know that Xu Shiyan has this ability, why don't they go all out to grab it?
In order to retain talents, you have to come up with something real, otherwise who will help you?
"Uncle Yu, don't worry, I will definitely figure this out."
Xu Shiyan smiled, it doesn’t matter whether he remembers the merits or not, it’s fine now, he won’t be squeezed out or suppressed, and speaking in the team has a bit of weight, Xu Shiyan doesn’t have any big ambitions, so that’s fine.
Earn work points, earn some extra money by rowing, live a small life slowly, and be content.
Yu Shouguang went down the mountain and hurried to discuss with Xu Chenghou.
Xu Chenghou heard this, asked him to go up the mountain to see the ginseng, and gave him full work points. Oh, he was very happy.
You know, the work points of the second brigade are much higher than that of the big house, and the full work points are almost two yuan a day. It would be foolish not to go.
In this way, on the morning of May 17th, Xu Chenghou brought a lot of luggage, and the team specially sent a carriage to take him up the mountain.
When the father and son met, Xu Shiyan had to lead his father around the venue, talking about those ground guns, crackers and so on.
"Father, you just remember, but anyone with a mark like this on the side must have a ground gun.
Clips, traps, etc., all have cards next to them. "Xu Shiyan pointed to a big tree, the mark he made, and told his father.
Xu Chenghou was not stupid, he understood the sign, "Okay, I understand, don't worry, I don't usually go this way.
You just go back to work, don’t worry too much about those open-mouthed beasts on the mountain, I’ll keep them for you, I understand. "
Xu Chenghou is a very capable person, none of these troubles him, the only difficulty is eating, which he is not very good at
Fortunately, before coming up, Zhou Guilan made a thick stack of pancakes for him, and also brought a few jars of pickles, miso and so on.
Even if Xu Shiyan doesn't come back at night, Xu Chenghou can still manage to eat.
After all the instructions that should be ordered, Xu Shiyan rode his bicycle down the mountain and led the people to prepare for the fermentation of bean cakes.
Xu Shiyan was always worried that his father was on the mountain, so he tried to come back at night as much as possible, and then rode down the mountain after getting up in the morning.
Anyway, it takes a little effort to go back and forth, it's better than leaving the old man alone on the mountain.
The good thing is that Shouguang arranged a few more helpers for Xu Shiyan this year, and Xu Shiyan picked the candidates himself.
Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Feng Chao, Sun Xiaofeng, and Huang Shengli, who moved from the big house, all worked with Xu Shiyan and got high work points.
After ten days of hard work, the bean cake was finally crushed and fermented, and Xu Shiyan's errands came to an end for the time being.
Xu Shiyan told Yu Shouguang that his family wanted to build a house, and he had to work for a few days to buy the materials for building the house first.
Most houses are built these days with adobe, and bricks are also used.
Adobe houses are easier. Loess is mixed with pagoda grass and mud, and filled into wooden frames to make adobes of uniform size, which can be used after drying.
Building a house with adobe is simple, and most of them use yellow mud, that is, prepare some stones to lay the foundation, and then get some wood to make beams, purlins, doors and windows.
If you build a brick house, it will be troublesome.
Bricks, stones, cement, lime, sand, all of these have to be used.
To the north of Donggang Elementary School, there is a large kiln factory with red bricks, tiles, and porcelain pipes.
Stone, the third brigade has a special quarry, which is used for construction and construction in the commune and Songjiang River.
Sand, cement, lime, there is a building material factory in Donggang, and they all have it.
However, all the above things are supplied to various units.
If you want to use it, you can’t buy it with money, you need to approve it.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan and the commune officials also knew each other, and most of them could still talk, so they found someone to ask for a relationship, and finally approved the note.
Then, take the note approved by the commune leader, bring money, and cigarettes and alcohol.
Go to the kiln, quarry, and building materials, and buy all the things needed to build a house, and find a car to take them home.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: roof beams
chapters.content:
Chapter 185 Building a house with beams
The house that Xu Chenghou and his wife had their eyes on was not small.
I also know that Xu Shixian built three rooms there in his previous life, and later Xu Shiyan built three rooms next to each other. Can the space be small?
That's why Xu Shiyan meant that the left and right sides were busy for a while, and there was no difference between the one and a half rooms, so he simply built five rooms and occupied the space.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were hesitant at first. If they built five brick and tile houses, all of them would cost seven to eight hundred yuan, which was not enough for the family.
Xu Shiyan said, if it doesn’t work, he will help the mat first, and when the four brothers come back, let them pay a share.
Xu Chenghou thought about it, and felt that since he was busy, he might as well build a bigger one.
The parents want to build five houses over there, and Xu Shiyan also plans to build five brick houses on the west side of the house.
Calculated in this way, the two ends add up to ten houses, and a lot of materials are required, and the labor is also quite worrying.
Now it’s not like in the big house before, the five brothers are all together, and they can do a lot of work by themselves, and find helpers for the rest.
If these ten houses are all directed to helpers, it will be overwhelmed.
So Xu Shiyan was so cruel that he found Guo Shouye and asked him to help find the construction team of the Forestry Bureau, that is, Lin Jian.
Directly contracted the ten houses of the Xu family to Lin Jian Construction. They are professionals, and their work is much better than that of helpers who are found casually.
Anyway, the labor is a bit more expensive, but there is a reason why it is expensive. The quality of the house built by a professional construction team is also guaranteed.
It would be impossible for someone else to do this.
Lin Jian is a public unit, and he only does business for the public, so how can he build a house for an individual?
But if it was Guo Shouye, there would be no problem. A few cigarettes and a few bottles of deer antler blood wine.
Lin Jian took over the private work of the Xu family by taking the opportunity of building a public house for a certain forest farm.
Anyway, Lin Jian has plenty of workers, so it is right to treat him as a big guy to earn extra money.
The leaders at the top turn a blind eye and turn a blind eye, and the workers at the bottom get benefits, so what else is there not to like?
Bricklayers and carpenters are all included, as well as the kang, stove, and inner and outer walls. It’s just that the wages are a bit more expensive, but it’s worry-free.
After the materials are ready, Xu Shiyan doesn't have to worry about it. Only on the day of the beam-raising, he has to find some helpers to take care of the meal, and Xu Shiyan doesn't need to take care of the rest.
Xu Shiyan really had no other choice, his father was watching ginseng on the mountain, and the two brothers were too busy to spare time.
Not to mention the two younger brothers, one teaches and the other goes to school, who can come to work?
Let's not talk about work, there are not even people who follow Zhang Luo, all have to point to Xu Shiyan alone.
He doesn't have eight hands, how can he do it?
It's the best way to contract everything out. As long as the work is handed over before autumn, the old couple can move in this year. I really can't care about the rest.
In this way, on June 6th, the 12th day of the fifth lunar month, two houses broke ground and began to dig the foundation.
At the same time, carpenters also began to make beams, doors and windows, etc.
Part of the carpentry materials were brought in from the big house.
After all, the Xu family has been in the Northeast for so many years. They have saved nothing but wood.
The other part is the wood that Xu Shiyan put on the mountain last autumn and winter.
The wood was skinned at that time, and after a winter and a spring, it was almost dry.
A few days ago, I found a car and pulled it down, and it was suitable for making beams, purlins, shed poles and so on.
After working for many days, I finally settled the matter of the house. All the materials were ready, and the carpenters and bricklayers arranged it by themselves.
At home, Zhou Guilan and Su Anying are responsible for boiling water and hot meals for the workers, trying to take care of them as much as possible.
Just like that, the Xu family’s house was built up slowly and orderly.
Xu Shiyan is busy with fertilizing in the team and building a house at home. Whether it is Niu Mao Guang or Gastrodia elata this year, there is no time for it.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan took the time to go to the county and sold all the twenty or so dried velvet antlers.
The best velvet antler costs 38 yuan a tael, and each piece of dried velvet antler is about two and a half to three taels, and you can buy about a hundred.
In the end, I got more than 2,400 yuan, which was more than enough to build a house.
It was late July, when Xu Shixiang came back from Tonghua.
With the addition of the fifth helper, Xu Shiyan was immediately relieved, at least someone was watching over the house, so he could free up his hands and work on the ground.
On July 26th, the third day of the sixth lunar month, Xu’s house was erected.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian both asked for leave, and Xu Shide came here after the summer vacation, and has been helping here.
Not only the Xu family brothers, but also Zhou Guilan's natal nephews, nephews, and relatives living in Daying, such as Su Weizhong and Su Weicheng, also came to help.
Xu Shiyan's job in Donggang Commune is not bad, and he has a lot of people. The apprentices he brought, when they learned that Xu's house was going to be erected, they all came to help.
Even Han Limin, I don't know how I heard about it, so he came here specially.
Thanks to the large number of people, there are a total of ten houses on both sides, all of which have to be erected, and the lack of manpower is really not enough.
Therefore, the manpower was divided into two groups, each led by carpenters and bricklayers, and began to work.
Liang Tuan had already made it, and the main beam in the middle was tied with red cloth strips and copper coins.
Xu Shide wrote two couplets of Shangliang Daji in advance and pasted them on the brick wall.
Someone was standing on top of a shelf with a bunch of firecrackers in his hand, and another person was holding a small basket with candies in it.
The carpenter directed the people to hoist the main beam in the middle to the roof, and then used various tools to correct the direction and fix the position.
At the same time, someone lit firecrackers.
There was a crackling sound, accompanied by red confetti flying all over the sky, and the air was full of the smell of burning sulfur.
The person carrying the basket sprinkled sugar down in handfuls, and a group of children below came to grab it.
Building a house and erecting beams is also a major event. The picture is a festive and lively one. No one would think that the children are making trouble, and they all laugh and watch them grab candy.
Some people will go to the basket to grab another handful and distribute it to the children who didn't grab it.
The main girder is fixed, and then the other girders are also lifted up to find the correct direction and position, and then nailed obliquely with wooden poles or boards, also called dalazi.
The beams and towers are all fixed, and then the purlins, eight boards, shed poles, and shed boards are nailed.
The Xu family built a brick-and-tiled house with a new structure, with tiles on the top and white ash sheds on the bottom.
In order to keep warm, a mixture of yellow mud and sawdust was pasted on the shed board, and then covered with a thick layer of sawdust.
In this way, the workload will be much larger, and fortunately there are so many people to help.
Everyone divided labor and cooperated according to the requirements of the foreman, each doing their own work, in an orderly manner, without any chaos, and the progress was very fast.
By one o'clock at noon, all the tiles were hung, and the shed mud and sawdust were all pressed.
According to the rules, on the day of raising the beam, the host will prepare a sumptuous feast for the helpers.
For today's meal, Xu Shiyan also spent a lot of thought.
Xu Shiqin had saved up the meat tickets for several months, plus the tickets given by Guo Shouye, and gave them to Xu Shixiang.
I searched for meat in Songjianghe and various non-staple food stores in the county one day in advance, and I bought a lot of people who didn't need a ticket.
In addition, there is everything in the vegetable garden this season, so this meal is very rich.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: news
chapters.content:
Chapter 186 News
The meal at noon was of course arranged at Xu Shiyan's house.
Xue Xiulin, Wei Mingrong, Wu Qiuyan, these sisters-in-law all came, and even Xu Shixiang's object Chen Chunling came to help with work.
Su Anying has been pregnant for five months, with a swollen belly, a bit clumsy figure, unable to do much, Zhou Guilan is making trouble inside and out.
In the courtyard of Xu's family, a pot and stove were built, and most of the dishes that cost firewood were cooked outside.
The two pots in the house are not idle, all kinds of frying and cooking, and the aroma is wafting.
Summer is already hot, and cooking in the house will make it even more sweltering.
Besides, there are so many people who come to help, that the east and west rooms cannot be opened.
Su Anying discussed with Zhou Guilan and decided to just set up a table in the yard.
Originally there were a few vines in this garden, but Xu Shiyan bought a few more last year, and the poles of the vine trellis happened to be placed on the roof.
The vines were growing vigorously, and they all climbed onto the roof, covering the yard, making it quite shady.
So, in the yard, tables and chairs were set up and dishes were served.
Pork ribs stewed with beans, pork head meat, cucumber mixed with pig ears, shredded pork heart mixed with shredded green onions, scrambled eggs with leeks, fried peppers with meat, eggplant with minced meat, tomatoes mixed with sugar.
In the eight dishes, except for the tomatoes mixed with sugar, the rest have meat, which is considered hard enough.
The dishes are all served well, and the wine is also served, two bottles per table, and there is still snow-white rice stewing in the big pot over there.
The rice is naturally the fine grain that Xu Shiqin supplies every month, and he has saved it for several months.
Except for Xu Haiyuan, no one was willing to eat a little bit, and they all saved it for today's hospitality.
As soon as the pot is opened, the aroma of rice hits the nose, who would not be greedy after seeing it?
Eight dishes, rice, this is already a very high standard, whether it is a helper or a worker of Lin Jian, everyone is happy to see this meal.
"Third brother, it's all right, it's all rice, ouch, it's really delicious."
Zhao Jianshe took a deep breath, closed his eyes and thought about it, praised,
"It's good to have workers at home, and you can still eat rice.
Otherwise, it would have to be the third brother. The ten big houses at these two ends are all bricks and tiles, which look rare. "
Yang Chunming and others also followed suit, and everyone burst into laughter.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly greeted the big guys to sit down and eat, and everyone ignored them. They found familiar people to join together, chatting, laughing, eating and drinking.
Above the head, the grape trellis covers the scorching sun, leaving a piece of coolness.
From time to time, a gust of breeze blows, bringing a burst of refreshment. In front of you, there are delicious food and wine.
Surrounded by laughter, who would be unhappy in such an atmosphere?
Building a house and putting up beams is a big event, and it is even more a happy event. Regardless of relatives and friends, everyone is smiling and congratulates Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan together.
"In-laws, you must be blessed. Look, the big house with five bricks and tiles is now on the beam.
Waiting for the inside and outside to be tidied up and move in in autumn, how comfortable it is. "
Old people gathered at the table, and Su Weizhong had to congratulate Xu Chenghou.
Building a house at home, of course Xu Chenghou has to come back. There are people digging and working on the mountain, so they help to watch.
New planting is good, no one cares about it, it's not worth it.
In the evening, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan can go back and watch.
"Isn't that your uncle's ability? If there is no third child, where would I dare to build such a big house, and it is all bricks and tiles? I dare not think about it."
The beauty in Xu Chenghou's heart, after living to sixty years old, he can finally live in a spacious and bright tile-roofed house, and this life is not a loss.
"Before, I really didn't like San'er.
I think he is too bored, three sticks can't beat a fart, and he can't do anything all day.
But who would have thought that among the five sons, the third son would be promising.
伱Look at his current life, five big tile-roofed houses are built, there are three houses on this side, and two pigs are raised on the other side.
He can look at ginseng on the mountain, and he can also hunt and release mountains. Really, among these few, no one can compare to him. "
Xu Chenghou drank some wine, and used his strength to praise his third son.
"Yeah, now you and San'er are lucky enough to move out of the big house and switch to Donggang No. 2 Brigade, earn more work points, and build five more tile-roofed houses.
It’s not San’er, you are still living in your adobe house in a big house. "
Besides, Zhao Dahai, who also rushed over to help, couldn't help complaining while holding a wine glass.
"At the beginning, I looked down on San'er, how are you doing now? Didn't San'er and his wife treat you well?"
They are old buddies for many years, and they don't care much about what they say. Zhao Dahai deliberately pokes Xu Chenghou's sore spot.
Xu Chenghou didn't care, just laughed there, "Yeah, that's why people can't just watch for a while.
Who would have thought that the sick Saner in our family would be as successful as he is today? "
Xu Chenghou smiled very proudly, his life so far has been worth it.
Eat, drink, play, have been rich and have been poor, messed around when young, and have daughters and daughters when they are old, and sons and daughters-in-law are still filial.
One has everything one should have in one's life, contentment.
"Get all your beautiful snot bubbles out. Hurry up, drink and stop showing off."
Zhao Dahai looked at Xu Chenghou's complacent look, envious, so he could only find Xu Chenghou for a drink.
"Old Yu, come on, let's have a drink together, I envy you too, you have a talent."
Speaking of envy, Zhao Dahai is not only envious of Xu Chenghou, but also Yu Shouguang.
Originally, Xu Shiyan should be the pride of Dongjiangyan, but now it is a good thing that Yu Shouguang picked up a ready-made one.
This is fate, it is really enviable and jealous.
Yu Shouguang was chatting and drinking with people with a smile. He was stunned for a moment when he heard this, and then he understood, and quickly clinked glasses with Zhao Dahai.
"That is, Xiao Xu can come to our second team, that is my treasure.
Xiao Xu is a talent, talent should not be buried, but should be treated well, right? "
Yu Shouguang did this on purpose.
Yu Shouguang also found out about Xu Shiyan's experience in the Dongjiangyan Brigade, and he felt sorry for Xu Shiyan from the bottom of his heart.
Such a talent, Dongjiangyan's group of fools didn't know how to cherish it, so they ran him away, regretting it now, isn't it too late?
Zhao Dahai couldn't understand the meaning of Yu Shouguang's words, but what could he say?
Dongjiangyan was ruined by Hu Liancheng and his gang, and now many people are thinking about moving out, even Zhao Dahai’s own son has moved out, what are you talking about?
"Come, drink, drink." Drinking a bar, there is everything in the wine, it is useless to talk so much.
Good wine and good food are in front of you, why talk so much? It's time to eat and drink, let's talk about the rest later.
Everyone pushed cups to change cups, drank and punched, and for a while, the courtyard of Xu's family was full of laughter and laughter, which was extremely lively.
The men are eating outside, and the women are setting a table on the floor of the east room.
The radio is on, and the local station is playing Chinese opera. It feels pretty good to listen to the opera while eating.
"Now, a piece of news will be broadcast. At about 1:30 noon today, a gas explosion occurred in the Fusong Da'an Coal Mine. Seven people were killed on the spot and two were seriously injured."
While eating, such a news came out from the radio suddenly, everyone in the room who was eating was dumbfounded.
"It's a good thing that the third child refused to go to the Da'an Coal Mine, otherwise, there would be trouble."
Zhou Guilan dropped her chopsticks to the ground in fright, and muttered in her mouth.
This the one that was posted by mistake before. The author is currently away from home, so there is no way to modify the content, so he can only replace the previous one. I'm so sorry. I was about to cry because of my stupidity, alas, it was terrible.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: rejoice
chapters.content:
Chapter 187 Fortunately
A temporary news broadcast on the radio made Zhou Guilan and Su Anying, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, turn pale.
"Yes, thanks to Shi Yan's insistence on refusing to go to Da'an Coal Mine.
Otherwise, what is our family doing now? "Su Anying also muttered.
What will it be like? Zhou Guilan thought about it.
If my son didn’t oppose it desperately, but obediently went to the Da’an Coal Mine and earned fifty or seventy yuan a month, many people would be envious.
In that case, maybe the old couple would not move to Donggang.
The family may not be separated, and they will still live together, and they may live well.
But everything will be suspended on July 26th, let alone someone is gone, even if he is seriously injured, he will not be able to live this day.
Looking at the present, the son moved out of Dongjiangyan, and the old couple also moved out.
Now five big tile-roofed houses are about to be built, and the days are booming, and everything is going for the best.
Therefore, there are countless roads in life, and what looks good may not always be good.
Seeing that there is nowhere to go, if you insist on going, you will have a bright future and a bright future.
"Eat and eat, don't think about that, anyway, no one in our family works in the mine, so we don't have to worry about it."
Zhou Guilan is now extremely thankful that she didn't force her son to go to the Daan Coal Mine.
Of course, based on Xu Shiyan's resolute attitude at that time, even if she tried to persecute her, it would probably be useless.
It's strange, how dare the third child say that there will be accidents in the coal mine?
Su Anying thinks so too, what do you care about? Anyway, her man is not in the mine.
"Um, uh, eat.
Chunling, eat more, it’s like your own home when you come here, don’t be shy about eating. "
Su Anying smiled, and picked up several pieces of ribs for Chen Chunling, for fear that this girl would not be able to let go when she came to eat at home for the first time.
Chen Chunling, her family belongs to Donggang First Team, and her elder brother teaches in Donggang Middle School.
Chen Chunling is two years older than Xu Shixiang, and she met Xu Shixiang when he was studying in Donggang.
Later, the two were still working together, and they had a good impression of each other when they got along, so they established a romantic relationship.
Chen Chunling is good-looking, with a junior high school education, a nice person, and she works quickly.
Originally, everyone thought that Xu Shixiang was admitted to university and was likely to break up with Chen Chunling.
As a result, not only did the two not separate, but their relationship became better and better.
Xu Shixiang also told his family that he will marry Chen Chunling when he comes back from graduation.
Zhou Guilan never interfered with her son's marriage, as long as her son liked it.
Zhou Guilan didn't have any dissatisfaction with Chen Chunling, anyway, it's okay to be older when she's older.
The daughter is two years older than Huang Jinli, and the daughter-in-law is two years older. She knows how to take care of others, and she is very good.
During the Chinese New Year, Chen Chunling came to Xu's house to pay New Year's greetings, and left after sitting for a while. This was the first time she came to Xu's house for dinner.
Zhou Guilan also had to take care of her a little bit more, and made a lot of dishes for Chen Chunling.
Chen Chunling is a very forthright person, and there is nothing to be ashamed of, and she responds generously.
In the future, when her mother-in-law and sister-in-law give food, she will eat it, and return Zhou Guilan's food.
For a while, the atmosphere on the table was also quite good.
Building the upper beams of a house usually finishes the work in the morning, drinks at noon, waits until the afternoon is over, and each goes home, and the rest of the work will be done later.
Drunk to the point of drowsiness, who can still go up to work? Who will be responsible if something goes wrong?
This meal lasted from one o'clock to almost three o'clock, and everyone was full of wine and food. Some people drank a lot of wine and walked a little wobbly.
Everyone left, Xu Shiyan sent them to the gate one by one, chatted with them a few more words, and watched the guests leave.
"Third brother, my dad drank a lot of wine at noon, I saw him staring and falling asleep.
So, in the afternoon, I will go up the mountain with you to see the ginseng, and let my father rest at home for two days. "
The fifth child, Xu Shixiang, saw off his partner and turned around to talk to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Chenghou was happy at noon, drank a lot, and now he has fallen asleep with his eyes wide open, and it is really impossible to let him go up the mountain again.
Xu Shiyan glanced at Lao Wu and nodded.
"That's fine, let's go to the mountains to stay for one night, and let my father stay at home for two days."
Actually, it is not necessary to go up the mountain without the fifth child, as long as Xu Shiyan is enough, the main reason is that there is a sudden emergency in the team and no one will take care of him on the mountain.
So, the two brothers told their family members that Xu Shixiang rode a bicycle and took Xu Shiyan up the mountain.
Going to the mountain to see that there was nothing wrong, Xu Shiyan was relieved, and got something to feed the otters and sables.
Xu Shixiang looked at the sables and otters, feeling quite strange, never thought before that these wild animals could be domesticated.
"Brother, have you thought about how to develop in the future? If you raise these things, you won't be afraid of being cut off your tail?"
Although the meeting above has determined the next development policy and route, the specific documents and policies have not yet come down.
No one knew exactly what was going on, and they were all in a daze at this moment.
Combined with the influence of the previous years, everyone was terrified, and no one dared to be the first bird, for fear of being hit.
"I'm keeping these few now, not too many, just for fun, and it doesn't violate the policy.
Wait for a while, and see what the above means. If it really makes us let go, then let’s talk. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, he has rebirth experience, of course he knows.
In October of this year, the county will convey the spirit of the document from the superior, and there will be no more tail-cutting in the future.
When the policy comes down, he can also let go of his hands and feet to do something. At least, he has to start a breeding farm first.
Not to mention anything else, raising some otters, sables, raccoon dogs, deer, musk deer, etc., will definitely make money.
As long as he is willing to work hard, he will definitely develop in the future.
Plant some more sticks and develop your own ginseng garden. It is best to have the opportunity to directly contract a mountain in the future to develop some forest ginseng.
That thing is too young to be good. It will be difficult to buy ginseng land in the future, and ginseng under the forest should also develop.
It’s good to grow ginseng and raise livestock like this.
"Well, third brother, you are doing things well, that's good.
Don't worry, everything still has to wait for the policy to come down, so don't be the first bird.
We don't want to be rich and powerful, we just want to be safe and sound. "
Xu Shixiang also felt that these years of tossing was enough, he just hoped that his family would be safe and sound, and that nothing would go wrong again.
The two brothers wandered around in and out of the ginseng field, went for a walk on the trap cover and so on, and caught a few mice and birds for the sable.
Go to the river to set up a dock, and come back with some fish to feed the otters.
Eat casually at night and go to bed early.
Sleeping until midnight, the dogs started to choke and choke again. Needless to say, the rascal must have come back, let him in quickly.
Xu Shixiang heard from his father that there was a firefox on the mountain, who would stay in the field all day long and would come back to eat.
Now that he saw that beautiful Firefox, Xu Shixiang also found it interesting.
"Third Brother, people say that Hu Huang is a Baojiaxian. You are protected by Hu San, no wonder life is getting better and better."
Xu Shixiang said half-jokingly.
"Do you still believe this? I didn't think too much about it. I just couldn't bear it at the time and saved it from the wolf's mouth." Xu Shiyan laughed loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: new house
chapters.content:
Chapter 188 New house
After the beams are put on the house, it is necessary to build the walls, pan the kang, set up the stove, build the shed, plaster the interior and exterior walls, and dig the ground.
The house design drawings were drawn by Lin Jian's people, and the construction team worked according to the drawings.
The five houses of the Xu family have a large span, eight meters wide and fifteen meters long, with enough space.
The east and west houses are all suites, and the second room on the east side is larger, with a large kang, directly connected to the kitchen stove.
The room on the east side is a normal room. There is a stove in front of the kang, and the stove is connected with the kang.
The two rooms at the west end separate the north side, and the north side of the west room is temporarily used as a storage room. When there is heating in the future, a boiler will be installed as a boiler room.
There is also a pot and stove on the north side of the Xici Room, and it happens that the kang is used for cooking and cooking.
The kitchen is on the north side, occupying half of the west room and half of the outhouse, with two pots and stoves.
In addition, there are cupboards, sinks for washing vegetables, operating tables, rice grain shelves, etc., and sewer pipes have also been dug.
There are pipes connected to the bottom of the vegetable washing pool, leading directly to the outside.
Anyway, the ditch pond is to the west of Xu Shiyan's house, and the water flows directly into the back woods without affecting other people's homes.
The two rooms on the west side are also Kangs, but the rooms are smaller, and they will be reserved for the children to live in when they grow up, or for guests to live in.
The east room is large, and Xu Shiyan plans to buy a set of sofas and tea tables in the future and put them under the south window.
When guests come to the house, there must be a place to sit and talk.
But the house is too big, and it is not warm in winter, so the partition wall between the kitchen and the east side was built as a fire wall.
There is a stove outside. In winter, if the stove is turned on, the wall with a fire will be warmed up, and with the addition of a kang, the house will also be warm.
Anyway, the house is big, so it will definitely waste firewood in winter.
But there is no way, the children will grow up in the future, so they can't all sleep together, can they?
The partition walls were built, the kang and pots and stoves were also set up, and the pots, sinks, and operating tables were all smoothed with cement.
It is easy to take care of and clean, and it is a hundred times better than the previous mud stove.
Then there is the shed.
In the previous houses, the two gable walls were all bricked up, and there were no shed poles or boards on the beams.
Just build a few boards, you can put things on the roof, and you can see the beams and tiles on it when you look up.
After that, the shed poles and boards are nailed, and then the shed is pasted with paper, and there is a gap between the paper and the shed.
There was a rat attack at night, and the rat ran back and forth on the paper shed, and the people below could hear a lot of noise.
Sometimes there is a hole in the paper shed, and the mouse can fall out of the hole, or else it will also fall out of the hole.
Xu’s family built a new house, so naturally they couldn’t continue with this kind of house. Xu Shiyan had agreed with others to close the shed.
Saw the soft wood into three fingers wide and less than one centimeter thick wooden planks. The planks are covered with hairs, which are the fibers of the wood. These are called gray strips.
Put the gray strips at intervals of about one centimeter, and nail them to the shed board, with the four sides flush with the wall.
Then use white ash and a hemp knife to make it into a paste, and smooth the entire roof of the shed. This kind of shed is durable, warm and beautiful.
The doors and windows are inlaid when the bricks are laid, so after the shed is plastered, the inner walls are directly plastered with the same material.
The white and gray walls are clean and tidy, so there is no need to put newspapers on the walls every year in the future.
The interior walls are plastered and the floor is covered. For a brick and tile building, it must be equipped with a cement floor.
Lay stones and sand on the bottom and tamp it flat, then sand and cement in proportion, smooth the ground, and press it several times to make the ground smooth and flat.
The house is all finished, only the outer walls are left. Songjianghe began to popularize the water-washed stone walls, which look good, but it takes a lot of work and materials.
Xu Shiyan thought about it for a while, and let it go, that thing looks good and is not suitable for use, and it will be troublesome if you want to make an external wall insulation in the future.
It’s not as good as plain cement noodles, and it looks pleasing to the eye.
In this way, the two houses are finished with plain cement surface, which saves time and effort, and the outer walls are finished soon.
At this point, the bricklayers are all done, and the rest is to install windows and doors, and carpentry.
The two houses, the construction team took turns to work on both sides, and it took a long time to finish it.
What about Xu Shiyan, he can come back every now and then during the day to take a look.
Usually, he has to be busy with planting and fertilizing in the team, and he has to go back to the mountain to take care of him at night, which is really too busy for him.
At the beginning of August, Xu Shiyan used the same method as last time to attract a group of deer and cut off two crops of antler.
Otherwise, this beast just has no memory.
