After the deer antlers were cut for the first time, Xu Shiyan threw bait and blew the horn a few times before, but the deer did not appear at that time.
Go to see it on the second or third day, and the bait has been gnawed away.
Xu Shiyan didn't care, and continued to blow the horn as before, and gradually, the herd of deer would come when the horn sounded.
That's why Xu Shiyan repeated his old trick and cut off another crop of velvet.
Maybe the deer also thinks that there is no danger to their lives, anyway, they trade antlers for food.
The quality of the second crop of antler is not as good as that of the first crop, and the price is not so high. The antlers of a dozen or so stags are sold for less than two thousand yuan.
Anyway, it's pretty good, it's all for nothing, at most, some food and salt.
How much is that stuff worth? The cost is not much.
Now, Xu Chenghou also knew how his son made his money, and he couldn't help admiring him.
How can these three sons think so well? Others have to kill the deer and cut the antler, but he feeds the deer and saws the antler.
The deer is almost catching up with the one raised by the family, which is really good.
Being so busy, Honghamut City couldn't enter the mountain, but Xu Shiyan didn't think it was a pity.
Even if you go to the mountains, you may not be able to meet wild ginseng, and if you do, you have to share it together.
Well, if you get one thousand or eight hundred, if not, it’s only one or two hundred yuan. How can you catch up with these two crops of deer antler and earn as much?
And he made money without saying a word, no one else knows, how good?
At the end of August, when the construction team handed over the work, Xu Shiyan paid all the wages to others, and stuffed the foreman with some cigarettes and alcohol.
Coaxed the foreman very happily, and said that if there is any work in the future, you can just find him in private, and he will lead people to do it, and you don't need to find a leader.
It stands to reason that people from the construction team come to work, and the Xu family pays wages, and no one owes anyone else.
But Zhou Guilan boiled water to make tea every day, and there were enough persimmons, cucumbers, plums, and sand fruits in the vegetable garden to eat.
Most people in this day and age are still very simple. The Xu family is so enthusiastic that those workers feel embarrassed.
So I work very carefully and carefully, and never waste what can be saved.
You know, these people can waste a lot of material if they shake their hands.
While installing the door and window glass, he tilted his hand and smashed a few pieces of glass, what else could the Xu family say?
But these people are stunned that not a single piece of glass is broken, and the boards are being installed, these are all good things.
In comparison, those vegetables and fruits are nothing.
Human feelings are actually accumulated bit by bit through things.
The house is handed over, ventilated and dried for a while, and then you can move in.
But Zhou Guilan was not in a hurry to move.
Now Xu Chenghou is watching ginseng on the mountain, and here Su Anying has not been away from having a baby for a long time, and she cannot do without people.
Zhou Guilan is an old woman, why move to a new house by herself?
It's better to live here, with daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law, it will be lively when there are many people.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Increase production
chapters.content:
Chapter 189 Production increase
In a blink of an eye, it is another year of autumn harvest.
The weather this year is quite good, and there are no disasters. The crops are growing well.
Farmers have been busy for a year, and they are looking forward to a good harvest.
The ears of corn are long, and the corn grains on the top are full and firm. On one corn stalk, two or three ears of corn can grow. Who would be unhappy to see it?
The bean stalks more than one and a half feet long are full of bean pods, all of which are full of seeds, and the golden beans inside are exposed with a grin. Who would not be happy to see it?
Purple sorghum, golden ears of grain, bowed heavily and bowed their heads.
When a gust of wind blows, the ears of sorghum and corn nod and sway with the wind, as if they are dancing to celebrate the harvest. Who doesn’t like it?
Autumn harvest, no matter how tired you are, is still a joy.
The Second Brigade not only planted fields this year.
Yu Shouguang really followed what Xu Shiyan said, and planted all the ginseng land he made last year with soybeans.
The soybeans grew unexpectedly well, which made everyone very happy.
Needless to say, these soybeans are not within the quota of the superiors, so there is no need to hand them in.
At that time, it will be sent to the oil mill for oil extraction. The soybean oil family can share some, and the bean cake can be saved for next year's ginseng ground for top dressing.
Then participate in the land to increase production, and the income of the big guys will increase.
Ouch, when I think about it this way, I feel that life is very hopeful.
During the autumn harvest season, even the students are off for farming, and everyone in the team, old and young, who can work, has to go to the fields to work.
After finishing their work, those in the team have to collect their own private land.
Both Xu's family and father are on the mountain, they are not needed in the team for the autumn harvest, but they can't keep their own land.
So Xu Chenghou stayed in Shendi, Xu Shiyan went out early and returned late, and went back to collect the private land.
Su Anying was more than eight months pregnant, with a big belly, and wanted to help out, so scared that Xu Shiyan hurriedly coaxed his wife home.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan was seriously injured due to an accident at the mine and could not move.
At that time, the brothers all moved away, and Xu Chenghou was too busy with the work in the team.
Xu's family has private land and a small piece of wasteland, so they are really busy, so Su Anying went back to pick sweet potatoes with the child in her arms.
Now the Xu family doesn't have so much private land, and there is no small wasteland. Besides, Xu Shiyan is doing well, how can he let his pregnant wife work?
The private land of the two families is not much, less than one mu, and Xu Shiyan will finish it soon.
Just at this time, the team informed that starting on September 18th, the No. 2 Bridge will be open.
As a technician, Xu Shiyan naturally had to join him.
On the 18th, Xu Shiyan led a group of young men straight to the No. 2 bridge. When they got there, they arranged for people to work.
Xu Shiyan took Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Feng Chao and others straight to the fifty-foot test ginseng field that was topdressed last year.
"We don't care about anything else, let's get the fifty feet out today.
Soak the scale on the spot, and then compare it with the ginseng next to it to see how the effect of topdressing with bean cake water is. "
Xu Shiyan pointed to the fifty-foot club and said confidently.
In fact, there is no need to pull out the mallet, just looking at the mallet seedlings on it, there is an obvious difference.
The top-dressed ones here are fifty feet long, and the stick seedlings can grow half a foot taller than those without top-dressing, and the stems are also thick, and some of them can catch up with little fingers.
Just this seedling, how bad is the mallet underneath?
Without further ado, the big guys began to remove the ginseng from the ginseng shed and pick up the ginseng.
Yang Chunming swung his three teeth and brought up three trees at once.
"Hey, this mallet is really good. Look, it's pretty good."
When the three-toothed body shook its arms, the three clubs were exposed. It was really plump and juicy, and it looked good.
When the others heard this, they were also anxious, and hurriedly swung the three teeth to plan.
Then, I heard Feng Chao also say that the mallet looks good,
The fifty-foot-long club used as a test field happens to be a string.
There are also people joining in the party. When the big guys heard that the club is big here, they all came to join in the fun.
Some people brought more than a dozen sticks from over there for comparison.
Compared with each other, it is really different, the one with top dressing is a circle bigger than the one without top dressing.
"Okay, put these mallets in separate bags, go back and mark them, and process them separately."
Not only to test the output of water ginseng, but also to test the shipment rate of the products, so as to determine the real effect of topdressing.
Xu Shiyan must be able to speak well. According to what Xu Shiyan said, Zhao Jianshe and the others put the fifty-foot clubs in separate bags, and wrote marks on the sacks with a pen.
By the end of the work in the afternoon, the fifty-foot-long club was filled with eleven sacks.
When I went up the mountain in the morning, I brought a large steelyard.
So some good guys came over and found wooden poles to pass through the rings of the steelyard, and the hooks of the scale hooked the sacks.
The boys on both sides raised the wooden poles, and the sacks were lifted off the ground. Someone at the other end fiddled with the big weights until the weights lifted slightly, and then reported the count.
"Ninety-eight catties."
The sacks in this day and age are small, and the weight of beans and other things is heavy. Most of the sticks are about 100 catties.
All the eleven sacks were weighed, and then the weight of the sacks was removed, and finally calculated, fifty feet, a total of more than one thousand catties and one hundred catties of water ginseng.
One sack will deduct two catties of soil, that is to say, an average of one zhang yields just over twenty catties.
The side without top dressing, the best one is a 16-jin mallet.
Based on such a comparison, after topdressing, the average yield per ten feet of stick increased by about 4 jin, reaching 25%.
This data is already very powerful. If the three thousand feet are all fertilized this year, how much will the output be?
Everyone was very happy. The experiment proved that Xu Shiyan's method of fermenting bean cakes for top dressing is feasible and can effectively increase production.
This is definitely good news and cause for celebration.
Everyone happily loaded the sticks into the carriage, and drove the carriage down the mountain to go back.
As soon as he arrived at the processing plant, Yu Shouguang hurried over to ask about the situation of the stick before the truck was unloaded.
Autumn is too busy, Yu Shouguang is sitting in the team, arranging various affairs, and has no time to go up the mountain.
Before Xu Shiyan could speak, the people who followed talked about the production of sticks in a hurry.
Especially the fifty feet of fertilizer topdressing, the output has reached a new height.
When Yu Shouguang and the others heard this, they were so happy that they almost jumped up. The 25% increase in production was beyond imagination.
"Xiao Xu, you have made a great contribution. Planting sticks this fall, remember to apply all the base fertilizers."
Yu Shouguang was so excited that he was incoherent. As the secretary of the second brigade, he knew best what the increase in production represented.
"Uncle Yu, the processing factory also has to make goods separately, and we have to test the delivery of the sticks after topdressing."
Xu Shiyan looked at Yu Shouguang's cheerfulness and didn't want to disturb him, but there are some things that must be explained.
"Okay, okay, leave this matter to me, don't worry."
Yu Shouguang immediately called the person in charge of the processing factory and told them to process separately.
The processing factory got orders from Yu Shouguang and knew the importance of the matter.
So a separate manpower was arranged to be responsible for the processing of these sticks, and a separate area was set aside to dry the dry goods, and even the forks where the goods were placed were marked.
"Secretary, don't worry, these goods will definitely not be mixed up. I promise you, if something goes wrong, you will take me down."

chapters.title: Chapter 190: implement
chapters.content:
Chapter 190 implementation
It takes about ten days for fresh ginseng to be soaked and scrubbed to steamed and dried.
After this group of people came out of work, they found that the top-dressed ginseng did not produce white skin, no grooves, and the color was yellow and red, and the color was bright and lustrous.
Ordinary fresh ginseng can produce more than four catties of dry goods for one catty of dry goods, and top-dressed ginseng can produce one catty of dry goods for less than four catties, which is obviously weighing on the scale.
With such a calculation, the comparison is simply too obvious.
After topdressing, not only the yield of fresh ginseng is high, but the quality of red ginseng produced is also good, and it is also under pressure.
As long as you are not stupid, you will know what to do in the future.
"Xiao Xu, this year's advanced individual is still you."
Yu Shouguang was so happy that he directly made a decision. The advanced individual reported by the second team this year is still Xu Shiyan.
"Xiao Xu, we must give full play to the advantages of young people, make persistent efforts, guard against arrogance and impetuosity, continue to innovate, and contribute to our team."
Yu Shouguang patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder, expressing great expectations for him.
"Thank you Uncle Yu, I will definitely continue to work hard."
The leader praised him, which was an affirmation of him. Of course Xu Shiyan was happy, and he had to express his opinion or something.
Back and come back for processing, and the ginseng field on the other side of the Xiaohei River also continues to dig the soil and pour the soil, ready to plant ginseng.
On October 5th, the policy finally came down.
Allow members to plant small pieces of land, and encourage members to raise large livestock, pigs, and poultry.
Individuals are allowed to open restaurants, photo studios, and engage in processing and selling surplus grain.
Allow members to quit the company to work alone, contract land, and continue to implement the labor management form of contracting labor to the group, five fixed rewards, and production-based pay.
Collectively retain mountains and allocate abandoned farmland to individuals for tree planting. Trees are planted in front of and behind houses, and whoever plants them will have.
As soon as the new policy came out, Xu Shiyan's heart was in his stomach.
From now on, he can do something without worrying about it.
Of course, he can't do anything right now, it's not the time, it will always be next spring.
Among other things, on the small hillside in my backyard, plant some fruit trees and raise some chickens, ducks, geese, etc., it will definitely be no problem.
Right now, what Xu Shiyan has to do is to prepare fertilizer.
This autumn, the Second Brigade planted 4,000 feet of ginseng. Yu Shouguang said that all 4,000 feet of ginseng will be used as base fertilizer.
In summer, Xu Shiyan led people to crush five thousand catties of bean cakes.
Except for a part of fermented top dressing, the rest are piled up and fermented, then dried and stored away, waiting to be used in autumn.
The four thousand feet of ginseng land are all using base fertilizer. This is a big deal and requires a lot of fertilizer. Bean cakes alone are not enough, and other things have to be mixed.
Suzi and Guoshi are okay to say, they can be washed and climbed to some extent, but the soil in this kang cave is not good.
How many households are there in the Second Brigade? Even if everyone removed the kang and rebuilt it, the soil in the kang hole would not be enough.
So we had to find another way to replace the kang soil with peat soil.
Now that such a large amount of fertilizer needs to be proportioned, it is impossible to point at Xu Shiyan alone.
So Xu Shiyan found Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Huang Shengli and other people who got along well, and led them to work.
"We have tight schedules and heavy tasks, and the work is a bit tiring. The brothers overcome it and gritted their teeth to get out of the work.
I have taught you all the recipes. If you learn that hands are work, it will definitely be beneficial in the future. Try not to talk about it when you go out. "
It's not that Xu Shiyan is stingy, and he is holding on to something and refuses to hand it over. This has to be tested and verified to be convincing.
Although the recipe is quite simple, it may not be possible to understand it without him personally teaching it.
In case other people learn with a half-knowledge, they will burn out the stick if they make trouble.
At that time, people will not say that they did not learn well, but only that there is a problem with Xu Shiyan's prescription.
"Third brother, don't worry, we all know the seriousness, if you don't let me say it, we will definitely not say it."
Zhao Jianshe was the first to express his opinion when he heard it.
Don't look at his straightforward temper, but he knows right from wrong and good from bad.
Xu Shiyan didn't treat them as outsiders, so he asked them to get up and work together, and passed on the recipe to them, so he couldn't live up to the third brother's trust.
"Yes, Brother Xu, don't worry, we promise to keep this matter secret. If anyone speaks out, I will be the first to slap him." Feng Chao was more direct.
Yang Chunming, Huang Shengli, and Sun Xiaofeng all expressed that they would never share this formula without Xu Shiyan's consent.
These people are not stupid, of course they know that Xu Shiyan is doing this for their own good.
The formula is kept secret. Skills are what you learn. No matter what age you are, you can rely on skills. That's not a joke.
Needless to say, just look at Xu Shiyan's popularity in the second team.
These will be the key training targets in the future, and if they don’t keep them well, they will be able to join Shouguang’s class in the future, so why don’t they follow suit?
If they hadn't had a good relationship with Xu Shiyan, if Xu Shiyan hadn't regarded them as his own brothers, could he teach them Fang Zi?
This is all affection, they all appreciate it, and remember Xu Shiyan's kindness.
"Well, work hard and save some money in the past few years.
Looking at the current situation, if the guarantee is not complete, it can be contracted in a year.
In the future, we can contract. I am familiar with the people from the Forestry Bureau. We will rent a piece of land by ourselves, and the family will grow a few hundred feet of sticks. What kind of day will that be? "
Xu Shiyan had planned a long time ago. After the land was distributed to the households, he had money in hand, so he directly contracted a piece of ginseng land.
If I can’t grow so many at home, I will sell them.
Those who sold ginseng in the past life made a lot of money. He knows how to do this job. As long as he has the capital, it is no problem to keep it.
"Hey, we all follow the third brother, and we will do whatever the third brother says."
Yang Chunming and the others were all happy when they heard it. Facts have proved that it is definitely beneficial to follow the third brother.
Enough talking, let's get to work.
Crushed perilla seeds, Guoshi, fermented bean cake powder, and peat soil are mixed according to a certain ratio.
The peat soil is different from the soil in the kang cave. It is raw soil, and there may be insect eggs in it.
So during the secondary accumulation and fermentation, a certain amount of pesticides should be added to the fertilizer.
After the fertilizer has been piled up and fermented, it is spread out to dry again, then bagged and sent to the mountain.
The area of ​​base fertilizer application this time is too large. If all of them are spread in the furrows when planting ginseng, it will be too time-consuming.
So Xu Shiyan requested that the fertilizer be spread on the big ridge, and the soil should be re-poured and mixed evenly.
This can be faster, but the amount of fertilizer is slightly more, which is within the acceptable range.
Now the people in the second brigade are particularly convinced by Xu Shiyan, he will do whatever he says.
Isn’t it just pouring the soil again? No problem, as long as the output of the hammer can increase, not to mention pouring it once, ten times will do.
In this way, all the fertilizers were transported to the mountain and mixed with the ginseng soil.
Then, ginseng seeds were set up at the end of the No. 2 bridge, and the women of the whole team tried their best to choose.
Classify the good ginseng seeds, split them into strips with corn nests, and tie the ginseng seeds one by one.
Why use corn nests? The main reason is that these things are easy to rot.
Even if you forget to roll it off when planting ginseng, it will rot when buried in the ground, and it will not affect the growth of the club.
If you use nylon rope or plastic rope, if you forget to pull it off, the ginseng seeds may be tied up, and the ginseng seeds will not rot even after the ginseng seeds are stretched out.
I’ve been away from home for the past few days, poking some manuscripts with my mobile phone, but I don’t know what’s wrong, I keep sending them wrong. I read your comments yesterday, and I really didn’t mean to deliberately cheat the book currency. I don’t know how to make it up for everyone now. Well, let me think about how to do this thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Possibly a daughter?
chapters.content:
Chapter 191 Maybe a daughter?
Four thousand feet above the ground, more than a hundred young men went up to work on the mountain. After seven or eight days of busy work, they finally planted all of them.
The next step is to sow ginseng seeds. Xu Shiyan doesn't care about it. He has to go home quickly, because his wife is about to give birth.
During the examination at the hospital, the doctor said that she should be born in early November.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan's eldest daughter was born on November 8th.
But after rebirth, many things have changed, and Xu Shiyan dare not say whether the child can be brought forward or delayed.
So he told Xu Chenghou that he planned to go home with his wife.
I'm too busy this year, and I don't have time to spend time with my wife. It's been a few days, I have to go back and be with my wife.
On the morning of November 3rd, Xu Shiyan rode a bike with a lot of things, went down the mountain and returned home.
"Daughter-in-law, I'm back." Xu Shiyan shouted as soon as he entered the gate.
As a result, Su Anying didn't come out, and his eldest son Xu Haiyuan ran out of the house.
"Daddy, hug."
One-and-a-half-year-old Xu Haiyuan can already clearly call him Dad, Mom, Grandpa, Grandma, and Aunt, and he can also say some simple words.
Although Xu Shiyan spends only a short time at home this year, he always runs back and forth, and every time he comes back, he will make something delicious and fun for his son.
So the relationship between father and son has not faded, Xu Haiyuan is talking about his father all day long at home.
Xu Shiyan leaned his bicycle on the garden stick casually, bent down to pick up his son, and kissed his son's tender little face.
"My dear son, do you miss Dad at home?"
Xu Haiyuan nodded obediently, "Yes, I thought about it."
This baby is very smart, and before Xu Shiyan could ask again, he pointed directly to his heart, "Here, I thought about it."
The son's actions melted Xu Shiyan's heart.
Xu Shiyan lifted Xu Haiyuan, let his son ride on his neck, and ran in the yard with his son on his shoulders.
Zhou Guilan came out behind Xu Haiyuan, seeing her son and grandson making trouble in the yard, Zhou Guilan couldn't help laughing.
"How old are you, and you can still make trouble like a child." Zhou Guilan couldn't help shaking her head and laughing.
"How is it on the mountain? Have you finished your work? Is your father okay on the mountain?"
Zhou Guilan was also thinking about her husband, Xu Shiyan was busy this autumn, and Xu Chenghou didn't have time to come down.
The old couple haven't seen each other for a long time, don't wait to see each other when they are together, and miss each other when they are separated.
"The ginseng seeds are all planted, only the seeds are left, I don't bother to care about them.
Thinking that Yingzi might be born someday, she hurried back.
My dad is okay, very good, and he has learned how to cook. He can cook simple meals.
I will come back to stay for a few days, wait for Yingzi to give birth, I will help wait for a few days, and then go up to replace my father. "
Xu Shiyan carried his son on his shoulders and walked up to his mother.
"Mom, how is Yingzi? Is there still no movement?" What Xu Shiyan misses most is his wife.
"Your daughter-in-law is okay, she has always been solid, with a big belly, and she hasn't missed any work outside the house.
The new house was cleaned by her inside and out. I just looked at Xu Haiyuan, a skinny boy, and I couldn't spare my hands.
A few days ago, we moved into a new house. It was cold and we couldn’t do without a fire in the new house. "
Zhou Guilan said, and together with Xu Shiyan, they walked to the door of the five rooms in the west.
At this time, Su Anying also opened the door and came out.
Xu Shiyan saw that his daughter-in-law's chubby belly was like a pot.
"Daughter-in-law, I'm back, how do you feel? Is there anything unusual?"
"It's okay, everything is fine, my stomach doesn't hurt, the baby is wandering around in my stomach all day, very lively, everything is fine."
Su Anying was very happy to see her husband come back. She rubbed her stomach with one hand, supported her waist with the other, and talked to Xu Shiyan with a smile.
Xu Shiyan came forward and touched his wife's belly.
It was also a coincidence, but at this time, Su Anying's stomach moved.
"Huh? Why do I feel that this guy moves differently from my son at that time?"
Xu Shiyan felt that the one in Su Anying's stomach this time seemed to be turning around.
When I was pregnant with Xu Haiyuan before, that brat was punching inside, and I could feel it through my belly, punching and kicking.
"My daughter-in-law is pregnant this time, it should be a girl.
My daughter is lazy, and she moves differently in her stomach, just like swimming. Kid Pi, punches and kicks when he moves. "
Beside Zhou Guilan smiled and explained.
Zhou Guilan is so old, she has given birth to so many children, what has she not experienced? Of course I know more.
Xu Shiyan was even happier when he heard that it might be a daughter. His eldest daughter is finally coming, isn't it?
"Mom, you go into the house, Yingzi, walk slowly."
Xu Shiyan let his mother, supported his daughter-in-law, and carried his son on his back, and the four entered the door.
The new house is well cleaned up, the cement floor is smooth and flat, and the white walls look extraordinarily neat and clean.
There are several potted flowers on the window sill, rose, September chrysanthemum, Clivia, and hanging golden lanterns, all of which Xu Shiqin came back from the Songjiang River.
Especially the Clivia, which Xu Shiqin likes very much. He found a dozen of them from various places, and they were all placed on the windowsills of the east and west houses.
The emerald green leaves seem to have a layer of wax on them, which looks very shiny and beautiful.
At this time, it is not the flowering period of Clivia, but September chrysanthemum, and there are still a few flowers in bloom. The bright yellow color looks delicate and lovely, and it is also quite beautiful.
There is a large kang in the east room, and there is a kangqin on the top of the kang. The two boxes are not in this room, so they probably got it in the east room.
A shelf was built against the east partition, on which there were radios, thermos pots, tea mugs, creams and other things.
A large mirror is hung on the wall, with smaller photo frames on both sides of the mirror.
In the photo frame are some old photos of the Xu family, as well as photos taken when Su Anying and Xu Shiyan registered their marriage.
In addition, there are photos of Xu Haiyuan when he was six months old and when he was one year old. There were no color photos in those years, and they were all in black and white.
Under the south window, I originally wanted to keep a set of sofas, but the sofas are not easy to sell these days, and I guess I have to wait for a few years.
I don’t know whose idea it was, so I put the sewing machine there, and there is a shelf next to it, which is Xu Shiqin’s cutting and ironing console.
It’s okay, the light under the south window is good, so this arrangement is reasonable.
Xu Shiyan carried his son on his shoulders, wandered around the house, and felt that the layout of the house was fine, and it was well cleaned up, except that the furniture was a little lacking.
Looks like I have to find someone to order a set of furniture, otherwise it won't match the new house.
"After waiting for a while, find a carpenter to make a set of furniture. I heard that veneer furniture is popular now, so let's get a set at that time."
In the past two years, thirty-six legs have gradually emerged in the city, which are more beautiful than this old-fashioned furniture.
Xu Shiyan felt that he could find someone to talk about how to make this furniture in detail, and it would be good to get a set of modular furniture.
After all, this house will be lived in for many years. As for the furniture, just be a little more novel, and don’t be too advanced.
People's appreciation vision changes with the times, it is too advanced, others may not think it looks good.
"By the way, Mom, I plan to ask my elder brother to go up the mountain to help watch for a while, do you think it's okay?"

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Elder Chu's reply
chapters.content:
Chapter 192 Elder Chu’s Reply Letter
Xu Shiyan has been thinking about his eldest brother.
In his previous life, Xu Shixian happened to carry logs up the mountain with the commune participants in the winter of 1979.
In this life, Xu Shixian has settled down in the food team, logically speaking, there should be no more accidents.
But who can guarantee this? What if Xu Shixian had nothing to do in winter and went to work in the forest farm with others? This is not good either.
What Xu Shiyan meant, anyway, the eldest brother is idle in winter, why not go up the mountain, be with him as a companion, and replace Xu Chenghou.
The two brothers are watching ginseng on the mountain, occasionally hunting or something, not to mention how much money they earn, just eating and drinking.
It can also avoid accidents in the previous life, isn't it good?
"Let your elder brother go up the mountain? It's fine, just let your father come down the mountain to rest for a while.
Anyway, the vegetable team has nothing to do at this time, and he is also idle at home, going up the mountain to take care of your father. "
Zhou Guilan didn't know what the third son was thinking, so she thought it was just trying to make up for her elder brother.
The palms and backs of the hands are full of flesh. Now that the third child is better off, he is willing to go back and pull his elder brother. How can a mother be unhappy? I can't wait.
Zhou Guilan had never mentioned it before, mainly because she was afraid of Xu Shiyan's embarrassment. Today Xu Shiyan took the initiative to mention it, and Zhou Guilan quickly agreed.
Xu Shiyan didn't explain too much, some things couldn't be explained.
Anyway, let the boss follow him up the mountain, they don't cut logs, safety is more important than anything else.
"Okay, I will tell my elder brother if I have time, if he is willing to go, he can pack his things and go up the mountain."
At this time, I don’t have a phone at home, so I have to go and talk directly about anything.
Xu Shixian currently lives in an alley in front of Qiliangdian. Xu Shiyan can just drop by while he is on business in Songjianghe.
While the mother and son were talking, Su Anying took out two letters from Kang Qin's drawer and handed them to Xu Shiyan.
"This is a letter from you. It should have been mailed from the provincial capital. It just arrived a few days ago. My mother and I are illiterate, so we didn't open it."
Xu Shiyan took the letter and looked at it. The addresses for sending the letter were all provincial capitals, but not one place.
Looking at the handwriting, one is from Qi Yunsheng, and the other should be from Mr. Chu.
Through Qi Yunsheng's efforts, Xu Shiyan and Mr. Chu regained contact this spring.
Xu Shiyan sent two letters to Elder Chu, and Elder Chu also replied two letters.
When he wrote a letter last time, Xu Shiyan mentioned Xu Shiqin's situation and asked Mr. Chu if there was any way to treat it.
It is estimated that Mr. Chu's reply is for this matter.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly opened the letter and saw that it was indeed true.
Mr. Chu said in the letter that with the current domestic medical level, it is still a bit difficult to do this kind of spinal deformity correction.
When Mr. Chu went to the meeting, he discussed it with several authorities and believed that this is a topic that should be studied in depth.
Old Chu told Xu Shiyan not to worry, just wait.
Xu Shiyan read the letter and sighed. The development of domestic medicine also suffered a big blow in those few years.
This is not so easy to restore, it seems that we have to wait.
Qi Yunsheng's letters are nothing more than trivial matters, asking about people in his hometown.
"Mom, Mr. Chu wrote me back, saying that there is no good solution for the little sister's spine at present, let's wait and see.
Mr. Chu said that this is a subject, and he will bring students and some people from the hospital to conduct research.
If there is news, I will write to us. "Xu Shiyan read the letter and told his mother.
Zhou Guilan could only sigh after hearing this, "Oh, what can I do? Wait."
Zhou Guilan is also worried, her daughter is already twenty, and because of her problem, she has no partner yet.
There are also people who come to propose media, but most of the conditions are not good.
Those people saw that Xu Shiqin had a job and skills, but he had a hunchback problem, and he was old again.
Just thinking that the Xu family must be anxious, no matter what the family's conditions are, and the family is poor, they dare to come to propose a matchmaker.
"Mom, don't worry, this matter may be solved soon."
Seeing his mother sighing, Xu Shiyan thought it was because of his younger sister's problems, so he hurriedly comforted her.
"Shiyan, our mother is not only worried about my younger sister, but mainly because of the popularity of those media promoters."
Besides, Su Anying tugged at Xu Shiyan's sleeve and said in a low voice.
"Two days ago, the two of them proposed matchmaking, and introduced a young man from Songjianghe, who is also a member of the vegetable team.
Polio sequelae, lame in one leg.
Our mother disagreed, the matchmaker was unhappy when he left, and it was a bit harsh. "Bringing this matter up, Su Anying was also very angry.
The guy introduced was from an average family and had a lame leg. Zhou Guilan immediately rejected it.
No matter how bad her daughter is, she can't marry a lame man.
In the end, the matchmaker was not happy, saying that if Xu Shiqin had a job and wanted to marry in the town, he wouldn't want her.
What did Xu Shiqin Luoguoer say, why did he marry a lame man? It's just right for the two of them to live together.
Zhou Guilan was so angry that she said at the time that her daughter would not be able to marry, she would be smashed to death on the wall, and she would not be able to marry a cripple.
Just like that, the matchmaker was unhappy, and left in a jerk, Zhou Guilan was also very angry, and has been frowning for the past few days.
Actually, during this year, many people came to the Xu family to propose marriage.
After all, everyone can see what the Xu family's conditions are now, and there are really people who want to marry the Xu family.
But, most of the people who come to propose marriage come because the Xu family is rich, Xu Shiqin has a job, and the urban household registration.
The words in and out of the words more or less carried the meaning of disliking Xu Shiqin's poor physique.
Zhou Guilan loves her daughter the most. She always says that she doesn't require the man's family to be an urban registered permanent residence, nor does she require a job.
As long as people are motivated and diligent, treat Xu Shiqin well, and truly love Xu Shiqin.
But those who came to the media, many of them used Xu Shiqin's hunchback as a handle.
It seems that they are willing to marry, and the Xu family has to agree with Le Diandianer. What are these things?
So Zhou Guilan uttered harsh words, even if his daughter never married, she would not find these people.
"Mom, don't be in a hurry, and don't get angry, the younger sister is only twenty, it's not good to get married early."
Xu Shiyan understood after hearing what his daughter-in-law said, and quickly persuaded his mother.
"What's wrong with our sixth son? He looks good, has a job and a craft, and has an urban hukou. He will definitely find a good one in the future.
Isn't that the problem? Find a way to cure it. If it doesn't work for a year, it will be two years. There is always a time when it can be cured. "
Medicine is constantly developing, and domestic medical technology will also advance by leaps and bounds in the future.
Xu Shiqin is only 20, even if he is 25 in five years, as long as he can be cured, it is never too late.
As for getting married, why worry?
Xu Shiqin can support herself, why did she get married so early and make troubles on her own?
For those women in later generations, it is considered early to get married in the 27th or 80th year, even in their thirties.
He doesn't care about other people's families, but as an older brother, Xu Shiyan feels that few people are worthy of his younger sister.
It doesn’t matter if you don’t get married, maybe the younger sister’s life is better.
As for the one in the previous life, forget it, I really don’t like it.
Simple and foolish people know how to make great efforts, and they don't have much success in their lives. The whole family points to Xu Shiqin.
Of course, that brother-in-law also looked down on Xu Shiyan in his previous life.
Uncle and brother-in-law have been natural enemies since ancient times.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Expectant
chapters.content:
Chapter 193 Waiting for Labor
Xu Shiyan has been very busy this autumn, so he finally came home.
Zhou Guilan looked at Hei Shou's son so distressed that she couldn't care less about worrying, so she hurriedly searched for something delicious.
Xu Shiyan brought a lot of things from the mountains, such as mushrooms, fungus, hazelnuts, pine nuts, walnuts, etc.
So I grabbed some pine nuts, pinched them open with pliers, and fed them to my son.
Xu Shiyan asked Su Anying to find a few bags and put them in everything. He planned to go to the post office in the afternoon and send them to Mr. Chu and Qi Yunsheng.
After all, Xu Shiyan and Chu Lao have a relationship between master and apprentice. Back then, Chu Lao taught Xu Shiyan a lot.
Now that I know the address of Mr. Chu, I have to send some wild goods to others, which is a little kindness.
Qi Yunsheng has been in contact with him for the past two years.
Xu Shiyan also plans to ask Qi Yunsheng to help him find more medical books and so on. How can there be any reason to ask for help?
In this day and age, there is no time limit for mailing things, and no one can guarantee when they will arrive.
I dare not send those fresh things, for fear that they will be broken halfway, so I can only send dry goods.
are all local products, not worth much, it is a little thought.
Send some to Elder Chu and Qi Yunsheng, and some to Guo Shouye.
Things are not high or low, or that sentence, human feelings need to move around.
Just happened to go to Songjianghe to do business, so Xu Shiyan went directly to his elder brother's house and told Xu Shixian to go up the mountain to take care of some things for a few days.
At this time, the food team has nothing to do, Xu Shixian is idle at home.
As soon as he heard that he was asked to go up the mountain, Xu Shixian nodded and agreed.
On the 4th, Xu Shixian went up the mountain to find Xu Chenghou, and lived with Xu Chenghou on the mountain.
With someone as a companion, at least he is not alone, otherwise, Xu Chenghou can only talk to the rascal every day.
The pair of otters on the mountain have now been upgraded to become parents, with three cubs.
With Xu Chenghou taking good care of them, the cubs are growing up pretty well, and they are all very happy.
But this thing is not well-fed, no matter how you feed it, as long as you are hungry, you will turn your face.
The pair of sables can't see what's going on yet.
I put them together in summer, but the gestation period of the female mink is very long, and the fertilized eggs have a diapause period, so far there is no abnormality.
Anyway, Xu Chenghou followed Xu Shiyan's instructions and fed these guys every day.
So far, they are all well-raised, and the water is smooth and smooth, especially rare people.
Xu Shixian looked at the animals on the mountain and was very envious, "Father, if I also follow the example of the third child, can I raise some of these animals?"
This cage is full of money, who wouldn’t be tempted to see it?
Xu Chenghou shook his head, "Boss, it's not dad who hit you, this job, you are really capable.
伱If you don’t have the condition of being a third child, where do you live? Is there such a convenient place to grab food for them?
These open-mouthed beasts eat fish or meat every day, you can't get them. "
It is not easy to engage in special breeding. You have to take advantage of the right time, place and people. Xu Shixian currently does not have that condition.
"Don't worry about this matter, when the third child is free, you can listen to his opinion.
I heard from the third child before that he intends to study the animal feed or something. If the research is successful, he will expand the breeding.
I don’t understand these things, I have to wait for him to come back. He's busy now, let's talk about it when he really understands. "
Now Xu Chenghou has regarded his third son as his backbone, and he has to discuss everything with his third son.
Xu Shixian thought about it for a while, it was useless to discuss with his father, he had to find his third brother.
So I lived on the mountain with peace of mind, got up every morning, followed my father to walk the traps and traps, and then went to the other side of the Xiaohei River to catch fish.
The weather is getting colder, but the river is still not frozen, so we have to take advantage of this time to prepare more fish and shrimp, otherwise the few otters will have nothing to eat in winter.
Xu Shixian knows how to shoot a gun, and always carries a gun with him every time he goes out.
That set occasionally catches wild boars, roe deer, etc., and just killed them to get them back.
As for the pheasant and hare, there is no shortage of them on the mountain. The whole rabbit stewed with potatoes, or the pheasant stewed with mushrooms are very fragrant.
Anyway, Xu Shixian knows how to cook, and the two of you have a good life on the mountain, and you don't have to listen to Xue Xiulin's nagging all day long, so you feel more at ease.
On the other side, after Xu Shiyan went down the mountain, he happened to be in time for the brigade to calculate and distribute food.
Xu Shiyan did not earn less work points this year, and he has a lot of food points. It is estimated that he can still get a lot of money in the Gregorian calendar year.
The brigade distributed the food, and each household shipped it back.
Xu Shiyan, together with Sun Xiaofeng, Huang Shengli and others, borrowed the brigade's carriage, brought back all the food, and stored it in the warehouse.
Xu Chenghou was not at home, and Xu Shiyan also brought back the food for the old couple and sent it to the granary of the new house for storage.
If you have food in your warehouse and money in your pocket, you will have confidence in your heart, and you will not panic when encountering anything.
Originally, Xu Shiyan planned to find a carpenter to order a set of furniture, but Zhou Guilan stopped him.
Zhou Guilan felt that when their family built such a big brick house in summer, and then made a complete set of new furniture, they were afraid that outsiders would be jealous.
Xu Shiyan is now a celebrity in the second brigade, but he is popular, and he is afraid that there will be many right and wrong.
Still have to be more steady and keep a low profile.
Xu Shiyan can do it if he thinks about it. There is nothing very attractive about making furniture now. After two years, those furniture styles in the city will become popular, and then find someone to make new ones.
Otherwise, I have to change it in the future, which is troublesome.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan stayed at home with his wife and son, coaxing Xu Haiyuan to play all day long.
On the morning of November 8th, Su Anying came together and found that something was wrong, and she became popular.
She didn't have a stomachache, but she didn't dare to neglect, so she greeted Xu Shiyan to get up.
When Xu Shiyan heard that his daughter-in-law was popular, he knew that it was about to give birth.
So he got up quickly, packed up his things and had a casual meal, then led Su Anying to the hospital.
I went to the hospital for an examination, and the doctor said that the cervix was opened three fingers, and there was a possibility of giving birth. If I was worried, I would be hospitalized for observation.
Then what else to say? Xu Shiyan immediately went through the hospitalization procedures and asked Su Anying to observe in the hospital.
As a result, just after nine o'clock in the morning, Su Anying began to have a stomachache.
It happened that Zhou Guilan rushed over after cleaning up the house. Xu Shiqin didn't go to work and took care of Xu Haiyuan at home.
My stomach started to hurt at nine o'clock, and the pain became unbearable after ten o'clock, so I was rushed to the delivery room.
This time, the doctor said that someone could go in to accompany her. Zhou Guilan refused to let Xu Shiyan enter the delivery room, so she followed her in.
Xu Shiyan just strolled back and forth in the corridor, while walking, all he could think about was his daughter in his previous life.
The eldest daughter of his family, Xu Jinping, was born on November 8, 1979, September 19 in the lunar calendar.
People say that males account for 258 and females account for 369. Xu Jinping was born on September 19th, which accounts for 9 out of 1 year. What a happy birthday.
But in fact, the eldest daughter has been dragged down by this family in her life, and she has suffered so much and suffered so much.
Xu Jinping is very good at studying. She ranked first in the school in the elementary school, first in the school in the senior high school entrance examination, and third in the county.
At that time, it was popular to take the entrance examination for a technical secondary school. Everyone persuaded them to let their children take the entrance examination for a technical secondary school.
Xu Shiyan felt that it was a pity that her daughter was so good at studying, and it was a pity that she had to go to high school to enter university.
My daughter is also up to the task, and she has been doing very well in high school.
But who would have imagined, in the autumn of 1998, when the eldest daughter was just in her third year of high school, Xu Shiyan and his wife were involved in a car accident.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Tangled
chapters.content:
Chapter 194 Tangled
In the autumn of 1998 in the previous life, Xu Shiyan and his wife hitchhiked and took the tricycle of the same ginseng planter to work in the Xilinhe ginseng field.
On the way back, a tricycle collided with a speeding heavy truck at a fork in the road not far from Kaifeng Forest Farm.
There were seven people on the tricycle, four dead and three seriously injured.
Su Anying died on the spot, and Xu Shiyan was seriously injured and fell into a coma.
The tricycle owner and his father died instantly.
After the truck driver collided with the three wheels, he hit a large gravel pile on the side of the road and rolled over into a ditch.
The truck driver was seriously injured and died after being sent to the hospital.
The point is that the truck driver is self-employed, and he pulls a lot of cars bought by the famine.
As soon as his wife heard that the man had an accident and many people died, she took the child and ran away that night.
The Xu family suffered great changes, and Zhou Guilan led the three children in despair.
With the help of relatives and friends, I raised some money, but it was far from enough for Xu Shiyan's emergency treatment.
Later, Xu Jinping had no choice but to make a decisive decision. With the help of the Han family, she sold all the sticks of the Xu family, regardless of whether they were manufactured or newly planted and frozen.
Only then did Xu Shiyan be saved, and a funeral was held for Su Anying.
The family has encountered such a big event, where can Xu Jinping study again?
Together with Xu Jinmei, who just graduated from high school, dropped out of school to work part-time to earn money to support their family and suffer from hunger.
Take care of Xu Shiyan, who suffered a head injury in a car accident and is in a daze. He also has to take care of his mischievous younger brother who has been doing nothing all day long to go to school.
After more than two years at least, Xu Shiyan gradually returned to normal, and fell again.
Xu Jinping followed her to work in Candi in spring and summer, learned to do business in Candi in autumn, and went to work in a local flooring factory in winter.
The family situation gradually improved, so Xu Jinping sent her younger sister to an apprenticeship to let her learn a craft so that she would not be able to work part-time for the rest of her life.
Xu Jinping was devoted to helping the family and wanted to send her younger brother to study, so she delayed finding a partner.
People around are urging her to get married quickly, Xu Shiyan also feels that he can't delay his daughter any longer, so he keeps nagging in front of her all day long.
In the first winter of 2006, Xu Jinping went to work in a flooring factory and met a young man.
My family is from Xinglong Township, and I also grow sticks, and I go to work in a flooring factory in winter.
The two got along pretty well, and with the help of others, they got engaged and married soon.
In the new year, Xu Jinping became pregnant and gave birth to a girl.
Marriage is too hasty, and I don't know much in advance.
I didn't know until after the child was born that the man's family was a bit patriarchal, and he was not good to Xu Jinping's daughter, and kept urging him to have a second child.
Xu Jinping's parents-in-law blindly favored their youngest son and daughter-in-law, only cared about their grandson, and ignored their granddaughter.
If it’s just like this, that’s all. Who can always live in a happy life? If the in-laws are not good, the big deal is not to live together and live by themselves.
But no one expected that Xu Jinping's husband would change after he got married.
He likes to gamble, playing mahjong with others all winter, and losing tens of thousands.
I can tolerate other things, but I can't stand this gambling. How can a gambler quit?
Today I swear that I will never go to the poker table again, and tomorrow I will play again in a sneaky way.
If he didn't give him money, he tried to borrow from others, and owed a lot of gambling debts outside.
The sticks are not well taken care of, it was Xu Shiyan who took people up the mountain to work, helping his daughter get married and take care of the sticks.
How do you go on living like this? Xu Jinping's temper was absolutely intolerable, so she divorced and took the child back to her parents' home.
Married in 2006, divorced in 2010, with a three-year-old daughter.
At that time, Xu Shiyan was also old, and his family no longer planted mallets.
No way, Xu Jinping got the tour guide certificate, took a tour group to Changbai Mountain as a tour guide in summer, went to the market in autumn to catch goods for sale, and took her children to sell goods in Anguo in winter.
An Guo sells clubs, not renting a stall and watching the stall all day long as others think.
Instead, rent a room similar to a garage to store goods, and put a bed next to it to sleep.
When the customers in the south come, they sell the goods and open, and if they don’t come, they just idle every day.
So Xu Jinping used her mobile phone to read books when she was bored. After a long time, she always waited for updates, so she came up with the idea of ​​writing by herself.
Not to mention, this writing was out of control, and I gradually made some money.
Now that she has money, Xu Jinping simply doesn't go to Anguo to sell goods, and opens a mountain store in the local area.
Cooperated with local tour guides, sold to foreign tourists, also sold goods online, and later learned to sell goods live, and made a lot of money.
Among the three children, Xu Shiyan is the most ashamed of his eldest daughter.
When the family had an accident, under such difficult circumstances, Xu Jinping insisted on not letting the third child, Xu Haichao, drop out of school.
Later, Xu Haichao went to a self-financed high school and repeated it for another three years. In 2005, he finally got into a junior college to study.
In 2005, when there was a policy of one college student per village, Xu Jinping asked her younger sister to take the exam without saying a word.
Xu Jinmei also struggled, and was admitted to Jilin Agricultural University, majoring in animal husbandry and veterinary medicine.
It is conceivable how tiring it is to provide for two college students at once at home. Without the support of the eldest daughter, it is impossible to rely on Xu Shiyan alone.
Later, Xu Shiyan heard the eldest daughter talk about it, saying that if she had another life, she would never want to be the eldest daughter and elder sister again, it was too tiring.
So when he was reborn, Xu Shiyan tried his best to keep his eldest son Xu Haiyuan and earn money.
It is to make the daughter enjoy more blessings in the future, which can be regarded as compensation for the suffering of the eldest daughter in her previous life.
But at this moment, Xu Shiyan suddenly became a little uncertain.
He has been reborn, and everything has changed. Now, what is in his wife's stomach, is it still the daughter of the previous life?
Although the parents are still those two people, the food and housing are different.
To put it a little harshly, the kang where I slept was not the original one.
His eldest daughter, can it still be the original one?
Originally, Xu Shiyan was only worried about the daughter-in-law in the delivery room, but after this thought surfaced, it couldn't be shaken off in Xu Shiyan's mind.
What if she is not the daughter of the previous life? Then how will he compensate his daughter?
"God, please, it must be a girl, it must be our Pingzi."
Xu Shiyan clasped his hands together and muttered as he walked.
In the morning, there are people coming and going in the hospital. Although there are few people in the delivery room, some people will still look here.
The people next to him saw a man, muttering something while walking, clasping his hands together as if worshiping God.
I thought this person had mental problems.
How could Xu Shiyan care about what other people think? He is only thinking now that the daughter-in-law must be the daughter of the previous life.
"Pingzi, come on, come and be a daughter to Daddy.
In this life, Dad works hard to earn money, so you can do whatever you want.
You want to study, your father pays for you to go to college, and you love writing, so let's take the Chinese department of some university.
You said that you don’t want to be the eldest daughter in your next life, and your father can fulfill your wish. Now that you have an older brother, someone will love and protect you in the future.
Come on, dad misses you, shall we be father and daughter for the rest of our lives? " Xu Shiyan muttered as he walked, tears were about to fall.
At this moment, a baby's cry suddenly came from the delivery room.
Xu Shiyan froze there for a moment, the child was born, is it his eldest daughter?

chapters.title: Chapter 195: named
chapters.content:
Chapter 195 named
Before the delivery room door opened, Xu Shiyan stood there in a daze, staring at the delivery room door.
It seems to be able to see the situation inside through the door.
After what seemed like a few minutes, and what seemed like a long time, the door of the delivery room finally opened.
Xu Shiyan hurried forward.
"Nurse, hello, has my wife given birth? Is it a girl?" Xu Shiyan asked eagerly.
The nurse was taken aback by Xu Shiyan's words, and there are people who are looking forward to having a daughter? Isn't everyone looking forward to having a son?
"Congratulations, the mother gave birth to a younger sister. She is seven pounds and two taels, very healthy, and the mother and daughter are safe."
When the nurse said it was a younger sister, Xu Shiyan couldn't help it, tears fell.
It's a daughter, really a daughter, born at this time, it should be the eldest daughter of his family.
"Thank you, thank you, I have a daughter, I have a daughter."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly raised his hand to wipe away his tears, and thanked the nurse with tears and smiles.
Nurses were stunned by Xu Shiyan's appearance. They had seen happy birth of a boy, but they had never seen one so happy to cry at the birth of a daughter.
"You're welcome, the baby will be brought out immediately, and the mother will be sent to the ward to rest in a while." The nurse turned around and went in again.
A few minutes later, the door of the delivery room opened again, and Zhou Guilan came out with a candle bag in her arms.
Xu Shiyan hurried forward, "Mom, let me see the child."
When his son was born, he was never in such a hurry.
Zhou Guilan frowned slightly, "When this child was born, he didn't know what was on his head. It was like wearing a filial piety hat. It's not good."
Old people are superstitious, and Zhou Guilan is no exception.
When the baby was born, the fetal membranes just covered her head.
In Zhou Guilan's eyes, it's like a filial piety hat, which is unlucky, so Zhou Guilan is a little unhappy.
Xu Shiyan, on the other hand, almost jumped up when he heard this. That's right, it's really his eldest daughter.
In the previous life, when the daughter-in-law gave birth to the eldest daughter, it was the same. Zhou Guilan also said the same thing.
Zhou Guilan said that the child was born wearing a filial hat, so he is not considered expensive, and he is afraid that there will be disasters in the future.
The name for the child is called Da Da, so let’s do it yourself.
As a result, the child was born without a serious name for several years, and the family called the child Lao Da Da.
Later, I was about to go to elementary school, so I could no longer call him by nickname.
Xu Shiyan said, the above two sisters are both gold characters in the middle, so let’s call them accordingly.
Since it is said that there is a disaster, it is better to call it Ping, and it will be safe in the future, so it was named Xu Jinping at first.
Later, when I moved to Donggang and registered permanent residence, I didn’t know what happened, so I became Jin Ping.
Xu Shiyan thought it sounded good, so he changed into Xu Jinping without changing it.
"Quick, let me see, my eldest daughter, let daddy hug you."
By this time, Xu Shiyan was completely sure that this was the eldest daughter of his family in his previous life.
God really took pity on him and fulfilled his wish. In this life, they will still be father and daughter, giving him a chance to make up for his daughter.
Xu Shiyan hugged his daughter so tenderly that he almost forgot that his daughter-in-law was still lying inside.
Fortunately, the nurse came out to remind Xu Shiyan, and then he remembered, and hurriedly handed over the child to his mother, went in and carried his wife to the ward.
The hospital wards in this year did not have heating, but there was a firewall, so the room was still warm.
Xu Shiyan prepared hot water and warm water bags early on, and the bed was not too cold.
Zhou Guilan made some hot water and mixed it well, dipped a soft cloth in warm water, and wiped some dirt on her granddaughter's face and head.
"You little thing, come here as soon as you come, and bring your things.
Then you will call it blocking from now on, and block yourself. "Sure enough, Zhou Guilan still said what she said in her previous life.
"Mom, that can't be done. If you call it that, what will happen if outsiders know it? Do you call it that?
The child will go to school in the future, so he must not be laughed at? "
Xu Shiyan heard it, is it okay?
No way, in this life, I can't let my daughter bear such a name for several years, it's too ugly.
In my previous life, I moved to Donggang before my daughter went to school, and others didn't know that nickname.
If you still call it that in this life, the neighbors in the neighborhood will know it, and then the classmates will know it too? That would be a joke for a lifetime.
No, absolutely not, Xu Shiyan will not allow such a thing to happen, his daughter must have a nice name.
"Xu Jinping, this is the girl's name. Jin, next to the word Wang, means Meiyu."
Xu Shiyan had already thought of the name. He searched through the dictionary on the mountain and found it.
In her previous life, she was Jin Ping. The word Jin is not good, especially when the names of the two daughters are put together, they are often teased by classmates.
Why not change it to Jin, a rare and unique jade.
The daughter of his family must be as painful as pearls and jade, a baby, this word is better.
Zhou Guilan has never been educated and doesn't know anything about Jin and Jin. Since her son is determined, there is nothing she can do about it.
"It's up to you, call it whatever you like." While speaking, she gently wiped her granddaughter's face.
"Did you hear that? The name your father gave you, Jinping, oh, it sounds so nice."
Zhou Guilan likes children, especially this little granddaughter is chubby and cute when she comes out, how can Zhou Guilan not care about them?
It's just because of that little thing, I have a grudge in my heart.
Since Xu Shiyan and his wife didn't mind, Zhou Guilan didn't want to mention it again.
Old Dabang was a nickname, so no one mentioned it again.
Su Anying gave birth to a daughter smoothly. This is a happy event, and she has to report the good news.
Besides, it's almost noon, and I have to cook something for Su Anying.
So Zhou Guilan asked Xu Shiyan to stay with her in the hospital for a while, and she went home to cook for Su Anying.
Mother left, Xu Shiyan was lying on the bedside, looking at his daughter with a smile on his face.
"Daughter-in-law, do you see how handsome our daughter is? Look at her eyebrows and mouth, they are so pretty. Her hair is also good, dark and dense, beautiful."
In Xu Shiyan's eyes, his daughter is the prettiest, no other child can compare.
Su Anying looked at the man next to him who was staring at his daughter dotingly, and was very puzzled.
Didn’t you say that children are not allowed to stare? Why don't you care about it?
A newborn baby, red and wrinkled, where can you tell it looks good?
Su Anying glanced at her daughter and closed her eyes.
Hey, compared with her brother, why is this girl so far behind?
Her brother was born white and fat, with good skin, but this girl is only fat, and her wrinkled skin is like that of a little old man. I really don't see how she looks good.
"Shiyan, I'm thirsty, please pour me a glass of water."
Su Anying didn't want her husband to stare at the child all the time, so she simply found something for Xu Shiyan to do and asked him to pour water.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard that his daughter-in-law was thirsty, he hurried to pour water. After testing the temperature of the water, he helped his daughter-in-law up and fed her water.
"Daughter-in-law, take a good rest and take care of your body. If you have any work, just ask me.
It’s winter, so there’s nothing to do. If you can confine yourself to confinement, try to confine yourself to confinement. "
The two children are too close together, which is equivalent to having one child a year, which has a great impact on the woman's body, so she must take a good rest.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: save lives
chapters.content:
Chapter 196 Saving People
Su Anying successfully gave birth to her daughter, and the whole family was very happy. At noon, Xu Shiqin came to deliver meals and led Xu Haiyuan.
Don't look at Xu Haiyuan who is naughty on weekdays, but after seeing his sister, he is very obedient.
Come forward and kiss my sister's little cheek, then lie on the bed and look at it, I really like it.
"Yuanyuan, this is your sister.
When you grow up, you have to take good care of your younger sister, love your younger sister, and protect your younger sister, you know? "
Bad dad, now start to indoctrinate his son.
Xu Haiyuan didn't know what his father was thinking, tilted his head to ponder, then looked at his sister sleeping on the bed, and suddenly smiled.
"Well, my sister is good, I love my sister."
One-and-a-half-year-old Xu Haiyuan has only met the younger brother of the fourth uncle's family, who is more mischievous than him and loves to cry.
So when I suddenly saw such an obedient younger sister who only knew how to sleep and not cry or make trouble, I fell in love with her right away, and my younger sister is better.
Serving Su Anying for lunch, Xu Shiyan hurried to the commune while Xu Shiqin and Xu Haiyuan were here.
Borrowed the commune's phone number, called Daying Commune, and still asked someone to send a letter to Su Weizhong.
This time, Xu Chenghou is on the mountain, so he doesn't have to go to announce the good news. It's important to come back quickly to take care of his wife.
As soon as I got back to the hospital, I heard from Xu Shiqin that another woman was sent in just now. It is said that she was born prematurely and her fetus was in an abnormal position, which was very dangerous.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his head and glanced at the other side of the delivery room. There were two people standing outside the delivery room. The male was in his twenties and fourteen years old, walking back and forth anxiously.
It doesn’t matter what year it is, this woman’s childbirth is tantamount to turning around before the gate of **** is closed, which is very scary.
Xu Shiyan secretly rejoiced, thanks to Su Anying's smooth birth, otherwise, he might be more worried than that man.
After tossing around in the delivery room for a long time, a nurse suddenly ran out.
"The mother is in hemorrhagic shock and urgently needs a blood transfusion. Is there any type O blood? Hurry up and find someone."
There is no such thing as a blood bank these days. If a blood transfusion is needed, the blood is drawn and transfused directly on the spot.
The two people outside the delivery room were stunned, and the man's hands were trembling.
"I, I have type A blood, and my mother has type AB blood." Both blood types don't match.
The nurse glanced at the man, "Even if you are type O, you can't use it. You have to find someone else."
Blood transfusions are not allowed between relatives or husbands and wives. There is a very small chance of accidents. Blood transfusions must be made by people who are not related.
"Ah? Then where can I find it? I, I'll go back to the village and use the loudspeaker to shout."
The man was stunned, and his reaction was half a beat slower than usual.
"When you use a loudspeaker to call someone, your wife will die."
The nurse sighed, knowing that these two people could not be counted on right now, and they were all confused.
The nurse walked towards the ward as she spoke, and asked loudly, "Is there anyone with type O blood? There is a maternal hemorrhage here, and a blood transfusion is urgently needed."
There are many escorts on this side of the ward, and it is fastest to find them from these people.
In this day and age, most people's awareness is extremely high, as long as the blood type matches, many people are willing to help.
Xu Shiyan came out of the ward, nodded towards the nurse, "I am, take me there."
Saving someone's life is a merit and virtue, and the right is to accumulate blessings for the newborn daughter.
A man also came out from another ward, saying that he also had type O blood.
Upon hearing this, the nurse hurriedly took the two of them to have their blood type tested, do a blood cross, and then give the mother a blood transfusion.
Both Xu Shiyan and the man received 400ml of blood transfusion. The doctors and nurses tried their best to rescue the mother, and finally rescued the pregnant woman.
The mother gave birth to a boy, who was as thin as a cat, and was carried back to the ward by the grandmother.
The husband of the parturient woman sent the daughter-in-law back to the ward to settle down, and came here in a hurry to find Xu Shiyan.
After stuffing money and bowing, he thanked Xu Shiyan with tears in his eyes for the blood transfusion and saved his wife.
"Brother, thank you very much. Without your help, the lives of my wife and children would be on the line."
How could Xu Shiyan ask for other people's money?
"Brother, we are both husbands and fathers, I understand how you feel.
Don't give me the money, I can't take it, and you don't have to thank me, go back and take care of your wife. "
After transfusing 400ml of blood, he was somewhat dizzy and weak. How could Xu Shiyan have the energy to fight with the other party?
So they tried to persuade the man to go back and let him take good care of his wife.
The man was really worried about his wife and son. Xu Shiyan didn't charge money here, so he had no choice but to go back.
After I went back, I asked someone about which brigade the two people who gave the blood transfusion today belonged to, and what their name was.
Xu Shiyan had a blood transfusion, so he had to take a rest.
It happened that Zhou Guilan came over. As soon as she heard about this, she asked her son to go home and rest, and she took care of her here.
Xu Shiyan walked home, originally wanted to lie down for a while, but fell asleep in a daze, and when he opened his eyes, it was almost dark outside.
So he got up quickly to cook and cook, and sent them to the hospital, where Zhou Guilan, Xu Shiqin and the others were brought back to eat and rest.
In the evening, Xu Shiyan was with him in the hospital.
Here, the eldest daughter of his family slept soundly, neither crying nor fussing. Next door, the premature boy cried all night.
Su Anying is in good shape, and milk came in the next morning.
The little girl ate with her eyes closed, and fell asleep when she was full. She was very coaxable.
But the boy next door just kept crying, and his voice was hoarse from crying.
"Shiyan, go over and ask, what happened to his child?
Oh, why am I so uncomfortable just listening to it?
The child has been crying since last night and was born prematurely. Can this be supported? "
As a mother, Su Anying couldn't hear her child crying, even if it was someone else's child, she felt worried.
"I inquired last night, the first child, the days are not yet.
The woman suddenly fell down and had a stomachache and was about to give birth, but she bleeds again.
After finally giving birth to the child, the baby weighs less than five catties, and is as big as a kitten.
The woman seemed to be in a coma last night. There is no milk to feed the child, and the child must be fussy. "
The news in the hospital is still well-informed. When Xu Shiyan went out for a walk last night, he heard people in other wards talking about it, so he knew something.
There is no milk powder these days, and even if there is, it is in the big cities, and Donggang is definitely not available in the countryside.
The baby was born prematurely and was not well developed, and he had nothing to eat, so he would definitely make trouble.
"Then you go ask the family, there is really nothing to feed, bring the child here, I will feed a few mouthfuls.
Don't let the baby cry like that, even a good baby can cry, let alone a premature baby. "
Su Anying's heart is soft, even if she becomes a mother, she can't hear this news.
"Anyway, my milk is enough. You see, my daughter eats too little to sleep, and I'm dripping. I can help others a little bit."
"You, you just have a good heart." Xu Shiyan sighed.
Her daughter-in-law is kind-hearted, gentle and kind, and he doesn't know the blessings he has cultivated in several lifetimes to marry such a good wife.
"Okay, I'll go over and ask, we don't know if people like it or not."
Ask me, it’s considered their dedication. After all, giving birth in the same hospital on the same day is also considered fate.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: help
chapters.content:
Chapter 197 Help
In the ward next door, the man was exhausted physically and mentally from the torment of the crying child.
While the daughter-in-law was lying on the hospital bed just waking up, extremely weak, while the son was crying non-stop.
The man is really a big head, and he doesn't know what to do.
"Brother, my wife asked me to ask, is your child crying all the time without milk?" Xu Shiyan knocked on the door and asked softly.
The man held the child and opened the door. Seeing that it was the person who gave blood transfusion yesterday, he quickly let people in.
"Oh, why don't you cry from hunger?
My daughter-in-law is bleeding profusely, and she just woke up this morning, lying there in a daze, how can there be milk to feed the baby?
The child was crying from hunger. The grandma of the child returned to the team and wanted to find someone to help feed him, but she hasn’t returned yet. "
There is no milk powder this year.
Usually, if a wife has no milk to feed the child, she has to find someone who has given birth to the child in the same village and is breastfeeding the child.
At least after three or four months of mixing, they can be fed rice soup, and they can be raised slowly.
The man's daughter-in-law was in a coma due to bleeding, and she must have no milk to feed the child, so his mother went back to the brigade to find someone to help.
"Brother, my wife said, if you don't worry, take the baby there, and she will feed the baby a few sips of milk."
Xu Shiyan glanced at the man's arms, the thin and small child who was out of breath from crying, and whose face was covered in bruises, couldn't bear to look at it.
"Really? Oh, thank you sister-in-law.
I let the child worry to death. You said he was so angry that he cried like this. "
The man was overjoyed when he heard this, and quickly thanked Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan smiled, and reached out to take the child.
"Then just wait, I'll take it back and let my wife feed it, and I'll send it back to you when I'm full."
My own daughter-in-law must not let others watch when she feeds the baby. Besides, the situation of this pregnant woman cannot be separated from people.
Xu Shiyan doesn't care about other people's sons, he just feeds them with kindness, so there is nothing to worry about.
The man thanked him a thousand times and watched Xu Shiyan carry the child to the next ward.
The child who was still crying at first became silent after a while.
The man breathed a sigh of relief, his son was finally not hungry, otherwise he would be in a panic, how can he support him?
In the ward on the other side, Su Anying shook her head as she looked at the thin and small baby in her arms.
"Look at it, this poor guy, why is he crying? Fortunately, he can still breastfeed, but his mouth is tight enough.
Eat, eat, sleep well when you are full, don't disturb your mother to rest. "
The little boy hadn’t had a mouthful of milk for almost a day after he was born, and he was so hungry that he didn’t stop eating for a long time, until he was full, and then let go.
Xu Shiyan took it, patted the baby, and laughed when he saw that the baby stopped crying.
"Let's not talk about it, although this child is thin and small, he is quite good-looking, with a small nose and a small mouth.
Yes, you have a good rest, I will send the child back to others. "
After all, it’s not my own. Send it away as soon as you’re full, so as not to worry about other people’s father.
Xu Shiyan carried the baby back to the next ward. The baby was full, and this time he slept with his eyes closed without crying or fussing.
The man put the child on the hospital bed, comforted his wife, then came out of the ward, and stood in the corridor chatting with Xu Shiyan.
"Brother Xu, I really appreciate you two.
Look, yesterday you gave my daughter-in-law a blood transfusion, and today my sister-in-law is breastfeeding my son.
Your husband and wife are great benefactors of our family, I don’t even know how to thank you. "
Last night, the man had already found out who Xu Shiyan was, so he called Brother Xu right now.
"My surname is Yang, Yang Junxian, and I'm in the first team.
I’ve heard Brother Xu’s name before, but I’ve never met anyone, so I didn’t expect to meet him here. "The other party held out his hand.
"Oh, I know, the captain of the third team of the first team, right?
I've heard it mentioned before, but I haven't seen it before, how can I expect to meet here? "
Xu Shiyan once led a few apprentices of the first team, and heard people say that the captain of the third team of the first team was young and capable, and his surname was Yang.
Xu Shiyan quickly reached out his hand and shook hands with the other party.
"Xu Shiyan, just moved here from the big house last year, from the second brigade."
Xu Shiyan also reported his family name, even if the other party already knows him, this is still a courtesy.
"Don't look at Brother Xu, who has only moved here for more than a year, but he has a great reputation. He has been an advanced individual and a model worker for two consecutive years, which is admirable.
I have always wanted to know Brother Xu, and I have always had a chance, so I never expected to meet him here.
Brother Xu and his wife are warm-hearted people, good people get rewarded. "
Yang Junxian held Xu Shiyan's hand with both hands, and his gratitude was beyond words.
The two are about the same age, and both of them are hospitalized after their daughter-in-law gave birth.
Yang Junxian knew that Xu Shiyan already had a son, so he had to ask some questions about raising children.
Chatting and chatting, and talking about other things, the more we chat, the more speculative we become.
If Yang Junxian's mother hadn't rushed back, the two would probably still be chatting.
"Junxian, hurry up and give me the baby. I'll carry him back and ask Li Bin's wife to feed him some milk. The baby is so hungry, he just cries."
Aunt Yang was anxious and didn't notice the silence in the ward, so she came up and said.
"Mom, no need, technician Xu's wife helped feed the baby just now.
Right now, the little thing is full and sleeping. "Yang Junxian explained to his mother with a smile.
