"Mom, this is the technician of the second brigade, the one I often talk about.
Brother Xu and his wife are kind-hearted, they couldn’t bear to hear our child crying all the time, so they fed the child for us. "Yang Junxian introduced Xu Shiyan to his mother.
"Hello, Aunt Yang.
That, my daughter-in-law will be discharged from the hospital almost tomorrow, and my daughter doesn’t eat much.
Auntie, don’t be too busy today, it’s cold outside, so I took the baby out to let the wind blow, and asked my wife to feed it a few more times.
It doesn’t matter if we leave the hospital tomorrow, let Jun Xian carry the baby to my house, my house is close. "
Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian got along quite well, and besides, he is poor for that baby. Anyway, it’s only a few days, so let’s feed him if he can.
"Auntie, let me give you a recipe, pig's trotters are stewed with Passepartout, and you can put some soybeans or peanuts in it.
Give this to pregnant women, and they will have milk soon. "
Pig’s trotter stewed in Passepartout, it is milk-through, suitable for mothers who have just given birth.
Pig trotters stewed with pangolin and **** buliuxing are for the treatment of scarce milk, and have different effects.
"Really? Oops, thank you so much.
Jun Xian, you have to thank him well in the future, this is blood transfusion and feeding our children, how can you repay him? "
Aunt Yang is also a very reasonable person. When she heard Xu Shiyan's words, she was both happy and grateful, and she didn't know what to say.
"You are welcome, auntie. We are all from the same commune. We didn't know each other before, but now we do?"
Xu Shiyan smiled, if others are in trouble, they can help if they can.
In this world, there are fewer ungrateful white-eyed wolves, but more good people.
Just because there are a few scum, you can't be **** and dare not do anything.
"Aunt Yang, Brother Yang, we've been chatting for a long time now, I have to go back and see my wife, let's chat when I have time."

chapters.title: Chapter 198: make a trap
chapters.content:
Chapter 198 Make a trap
Su Anying is in good health, she stayed in the hospital for two days, and went home after the examination was fine.
It was Yang Junxian's daughter-in-law, who was so dangerous and finally rescued, and had to continue to be hospitalized in the hospital.
Although Aunt Yang took good care of her daughter-in-law, she was exhausted after all, and she couldn't recover for a while.
Even if he drank pig's trotter soup according to Xu Shiyan's method, there was not much milk.
There was no other way, Yang Junxian could only brazenly carry his son to Xu's house, and asked Su Anying to help him breastfeed him.
Su Anying has enough milk, and her daughter eats very little, so she feels bloated all day long, and she can feed more than one child.
Just like that, Su Anying helped to feed the baby for another seven or eight days. It wasn't until Yang Junxian's daughter-in-law was discharged from the hospital and went home to confine her that she stopped holding the baby.
However, Yang Junxian brought a lot of things to thank.
One of Xu Shiyan and his wife gave blood transfusion and the other fed the child. This kindness is too great to repay.
No matter how many things there are, I can’t express my gratitude, but it’s okay. I can’t buy more things these days, so I can only do this.
Xu Shiyan refused to accept it, how could Yang Junxian let him? After talking and persuading him, he left everything behind.
"Brother Xu, we will treat you as brothers in the future. No matter what happens on your side, just say something, I will keep it."
Yang Junxian has no brothers, only three younger sisters.
He felt that he and Xu Shiyan were right in temper. If it weren't for the fact that sworn brothers are not popular these days, he might be able to drag Xu Shiyan into worship.
Xu Shiyan saw that Yang Junxian was so honest, what else did he say?
"Okay, I will definitely find you if I need anything in the future.
Waiting for the younger siblings to get better, and when the weather is warm, come to play with the children. "
Yang Junxian is a good person, and Xu Shiyan is also willing to associate with him.
Besides, someone’s good intentions can’t be refuted, right?
When the child was twelve days old, Su Weizhong and his wife brought their daughter to see Huanxi.
The little girl who was born more than ten days ago is getting better and better. The jaundice has faded on her small face, and it is gradually turning white.
A pair of big watery eyes, the jet-black eyeballs are like fine black pearls, the small mouth is pink and tender, and the nose is small and exquisite.
Anyway, it looks good everywhere, and Su Weizhong and his wife are so rare that they don't want to let go of it.
Being idle in winter, Su Weizhong's family lived in Donggang for three days, and then left happily.
After seeing off the old man, it was time for Xu Shiyan to pack up and go up the mountain.
There are still many things to do on the mountain, and Xu Chenghou can't be allowed to live on the mountain forever.
The old man went down the mountain, it's time to pack up and move to a new house.
On November 25th, Xu Shiyan rode a bicycle and brought a lot of food, and returned to the mountain.
"Second brother, when did you come up?" When I arrived on the mountain, I found that not only Xu Shixian was there, but Xu Shian was also there.
"It's been a few days since I came up, and it's boring to stay at home. The second sister-in-law is always nagging all day long.
I just heard that my eldest brother is on the mountain, so I will come to stay with my father for a few days. "Xu Shi'an was very happy to see his younger brother back, and smiled.
Xu Shiyan actually knew in his heart that his second brother must have thought that he called the boss up because he wanted to take the boss alone to earn some money.
Actually, Xu Shiyan just wanted his eldest brother to avoid the disasters of his previous life and avoid suffering.
Forget it, I can’t talk about it, let the second child think about it as he pleases.
"Father, that my mother said, let you go down the mountain as soon as possible, you have to pack up and move to a new house."
The new house has been built for such a long time, and there is no one to live in it. This is not acceptable.
Because the new house is not dry enough, it is too cold in winter, it is easy to suffer from frost damage, and the house has no life.
These days, Xu Shiyan went to burn the kang every day.
But this house is weird. Even though it’s all on fire, there’s a big difference between people who live in it and people who don’t.
Even if the fire is lit every day, people who cannot live will feel cold.
"Well, okay, I will go down the mountain with the workers in the afternoon." Xu Chenghou nodded.
It's time to go back and tidy up. No matter how good my son's house is, I can't live there forever. I have a nest, so I have to go back to my own house.
It snows late this year, and it’s still rare. A while ago, the team sent people to cover grass curtains and put on cold-proof soil, for fear that the sticks would be damaged by freezing.
In recent days, I have only started to pick up the pillar feet and big joint poles for sticks.
The Second Brigade planted 5,000 feet of ginseng this year, and sowed 1,300 feet of seeds. It takes a lot of materials just to make a shed on the ground, and it may take two or three days to finish.
There is a carriage in the team, Xu Chenghou can go down the mountain in a carriage, it is very convenient, so there is no need for Xu Shiyan to send it.
Only dragged some of the meat and dry goods on the mountain, and asked Xu Chenghou to take it down.
Xu Chenghou left, and the three brothers stayed on the mountain. There was nothing to do at this time, so Xu Shian said he wanted to go hunting in the mountain.
He came up to the mountain for this purpose, and brought up a gun and a lot of bullets from the old man's house.
Xu Shiyan can think about it for a while, anyway, he is idle anyway, leading his brothers into the mountains to do something.
Even if you don’t make money, you can still have meat to eat and improve your life.
Just like that, the three brothers packed up and prepared for a few days, and the next day when it was snowing, they led four dogs into the mountain.
Not to mention, the three brothers were lucky. When they entered the mountain, they met a group of wild boars. Four dogs surrounded a sow and took it down easily.
In the next few days, I also gained some rewards when I went to the mountains. One day, I met a black blind man and killed a black blind man.
The most important thing is that Xu Shiyan discovered Shanluzidao, and it was in the last few days.
When it comes to shooting a wild boar or something, Xu Shiyan just went out with his brothers to hang out and play, just to eat meat, and he didn't care much.
But this mountain donkey road is different, especially the new mountain donkey road, which proves that there are musk deer nearby.
Xu Shiyan is more interested in these now.
"Big Brother, Second Brother, let's go, go home, we won't be hunting today, go back and get some stuff, I'm useful."
Xu Shiyan didn't say any reason, turned around with his brothers and returned to the venue.
Back to the venue, Xu Shiyan began to tidy up the boards, not knowing what to nail.
The two brothers felt strange, but they couldn't ask anything, so they could only help with the work.
Brothers have all learned carpentry skills from Xu Chenghou, and the tools on this mountain are also complete.
The three brothers worked together, and it took a day and a half to make four things like doors.
Xu Shiyan rode his bicycle down the mountain again, and got some springs from somewhere.
Something like a door frame, with two doors inlaid, and the outside of the door is tied with a spring.
The two doors can only be opened inwards but not outwards. Once the door is pushed open, it will be pulled back by the spring and closed immediately.
"No, third child, what is this thing you made up? Why does it get more and more strange the more you look at it, can you use this thing for hunting?"
The two brothers felt strange and didn't know what Xu Shiyan was going to do.
"You can rest assured to follow me, let you learn a lot tomorrow."
Xu Shiyan just didn't say what he was going to do, but just looked at the four doors back and forth, constantly calculating in his mind, and ignored the two brothers at all.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian have nothing to do, everything on the mountain has to listen to the third child, and the third child can do whatever the third child says, so what can we do?

chapters.title: Chapter 199: capture alive
chapters.content:
Chapter 199 Live Capture
On the afternoon of December 3rd, Xu Shiyan led his two brothers, carrying four things that looked like doors, as well as tools such as shovels and picks.
Start from the venue and go straight to the place where you found the mountain donkey road.
When he got there, Xu Shiyan wandered around a few more times to confirm that the musk deer had been here in the last day or two.
Finding the right location, Xu Shiyan asked his two brothers to help, cleared all the snow, and then built a fire.
After the fire was burnt out, the permafrost underneath would soften a little.
Fortunately, at the beginning of December, the ground has not been completely frozen, and the permafrost layer on the top will be baked, and the bottom will be easier.
Brothers spent a long time, and finally dug out four traps, and then installed the door on them.
Then sprinkle a thin layer of soil on the door, a layer of fresh snow, and finally, put some frozen greens, cabbage leaves and other things on it.
After finishing all this work, it was already dark, and the three brothers built a corner near here.
The three of them huddled in the basement to deal with it all night. When the east just lit up, the three of them got up quickly.
Xu Shiyan asked the two elder brothers to go a little farther away, and he was here, hiding in a small bush, "Yo... yo..." and began to call the musk deer.
After blowing for a long time, there was no movement.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian in the distance shook their heads, not knowing what the third child was doing.
Xu Shiyan was not discouraged at all, and continued to blow. After a while, there was a rustling sound in the distant jungle.
Then, I saw more than a dozen deer-like animals running out of the woods to the east.
Xu Shixian and his brothers hid behind the bushes, not daring to move, for fear of disturbing the animals.
But Xu Shiyan continued to make noises non-stop, luring those musk deer toward the position of the trap.
Needless to say, this group of musk deer must be male.
Hearing the movement from Xu Shiyan, I thought there was a "female companion" here, so they hurried over.
As a result, I arrived here and looked around, but I couldn't find the person I liked.
Suddenly, the leading musk deer found emerald green cabbage leaves and frozen greens on the ground.
In the winter, when the wilderness is in the wild and the vegetation is withered, it is difficult for musk deer to eat enough.
Suddenly found something delicious, the musk deer stared straight at the rare delicacy in front of them with their small eyes widened.
seems to be hesitant, should I eat or find a partner?
Food is in the front, it is obvious that being hungry is more important than finding a female partner, the leader hesitated for a moment, and then quickly rushed towards the food.
The ones behind couldn't wait to keep up, even jumping faster than the leading one.
As a result, just as they jumped on it, the trap's trap was knocked over, and a few musk deer fell into the trap.
Some of them fell in and were locked in by the door, and some had their heads clamped, buttocks pouted, and they wanted to retract their heads.
Some fell in with only one leg and were pinched by the door, struggling to break free.
Only four traps were set, and about three or four fell into the trap. The others turned around and ran away when they found something wrong.
At this time, the Xu Shiyan brothers jumped up, holding the rope in their hands, and tied the struggling musk deer directly to its four hooves.
Afterwards, Xu Shiyan took out a strip of black cloth from his pocket, and blindfolded the musk deer.
Turn out the high-grade liquor again, take a sip in your mouth, and spray it towards the musk deer's nostrils.
The musk deer was suffocated by the strong smell of alcohol, and suddenly became dizzy, like a drunk, his whole body was weak, groggy, unable to struggle.
Four gates, finally caught three musk deer, one of the legs was caught, and took the opportunity to break free and run away.
The three brothers didn’t care about the musk deer that had run away, they walked out the door with one hand, picked up the musk deer with the other, and walked back like that.
Go back to the venue, and lock the musk deer into the pen that Xu Shiyan had surrounded before.
"Third brother, you can do everything. What do you plan to do with these three musk deer? Just kill them and get musk?"
Xu Shixian didn't have time to ask until the fragrant deer was locked up.
"Brother, I need your help with something." Xu Shiyan looked at his elder brother.
"Borrow your pen and write an article. I will find a way to find someone to pass it on. It would be best to post it in a newspaper."
Xu Shiyan has been thinking about this matter for a long time. He is low-educated and can't write well, so he has to ask his brother for help.
Xu Shixian was stunned when he heard it, "What? Write an article and publish it in the newspaper? Don't make trouble, I dare not."
When he was young, he dared to write anything when he was hot-blooded. Now that he has a family and a business, Xu Shixian dare not fool around anymore.
"Brother, not those articles, I asked you to write an article about animal protection.
Especially animals with medicinal value like deer and musk deer, which do not do much harm to people and crops and need to be protected. "
Well, if Xu Shiyan hadn't planned to engage in breeding, he certainly wouldn't have thought of these things.
But Xu Shiyan has been thinking about it since he came up with this idea last year.
In the entire Changbai Mountain area, how many hunters like him are there?
As forests are gradually cut down, the living environment of wild animals is gradually shrinking, and then they encounter indiscriminate hunting by hunters.
The populations of these animals will gradually decrease or even die out.
Don't mention anything else, just talk about the musk deer and deer.
In order to hunt for musk, hunters always kill the musk deer and cut off the sachet.
In order to hunt deer antlers, most deer are killed and the antlers are cut off.
Is there any other way?
Actually, there are other ways to extract musk without harming the musk deer.
Since this is the case, why don't you think of a way to let the people above know?
Perhaps, when everyone knows this method, is it possible to save the lives of a few musk deer?
Xu Shiyan didn't know if it would be useful for him to do so, but he was willing to do his little bit.
Whether it works or not, he did it, and it was better than nothing.
Xu Shixian listened to his younger brother's words, pondered for a long time, and then sighed.
"I can help you write this article, but I dare not say whether it is useful or not.
I think it’s quite embarrassing, how many people understand this? Just like me and my second child, if we hadn't been with you these days and listened to your nagging, we wouldn't understand.
In our hearts, as long as we can make money, I don’t care whether the musk deer or the deer live or die? "
Xu Shixian's words represent the thoughts of ordinary people, the majority of people.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't been reborn, he must have thought the same way. Life hasn't gone well yet, who cares so much?
As long as you can earn money, is there anything wrong with killing a few musk deer and a few deer?
"Brother, it depends on man's effort. I don't know if it will work, but I want to spread the method of picking musk."
This is Xu Shiyan's selfishness.
Because at present, the musk purchased by the pharmaceutical factory purchase point is the whole sachet.
The method Xu Shiyan mentioned to collect musk is all powder. This kind of musk is afraid that people will not buy it at all.
Only when it attracts the attention of the upper echelons, especially the medical industry, and this method is recognized, can the musk that Xu Shiyan picks be accepted and valuable.
Otherwise, even if he raised these musk deer, it would be useless, and he would have to kill them sooner or later, so that would be meaningless.
"Anyway, you are reasonable, come on, if you talk to me again at night, I will try to write it for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Raising sweet roe deer
chapters.content:
Chapter 200 Raising Fragrant Roe Deer
The arrival of the three fragrant deer gave Xu Shiyan some more errands, and he had to find food for them.
Sweet deer like to eat moss, lichen, pine and fir young leaves.
In winter, moss and lichen are hard to find, but there are pine trees. Cut some from the surrounding woods and throw them in the pen to feed them.
Pair it with some cabbage leaves or something, and you can feed it.
Looking at it, the scale of Xu Shiyan's breeding is getting bigger and bigger, Xu Shixian and Xu Shian are also worried.
"Third son, if you raise these things, what can you do when you go down the mountain during the Chinese New Year?"
No one is watching from the mountain. These sables, otters, etc., must not be harmed by some beast?
If you go home, can there be so many things to feed? This thing is not very easy to arrange.
"Well, it's really not easy to handle, let's see when the time comes.
I don’t keep enough of them now, if not, I will get them down when I go down the mountain. "
Xu Shiyan also thought of this problem, but right now there is really no good way to solve it.
Anyway, it's just a small fight now, and it can be arranged anywhere.
He took some time to raise it first, let's talk about it after watching this round of scenes, and it should be contracted to the household by then.
If the team still uses him as a reference, then he will set up a breeding farm near here and hire two blind people to work there.
If he doesn’t need to continue to look at the ginseng, then he will go down the mountain. It happens that the mountain behind his house is very good, and a small breeding farm is enough.
Brother Xu Shixian didn't have any good ideas, this farm is too small, it's not worth working together as three brothers.
Of course, I don’t dare to make it big now, Xu Shiyan, who is playing small, is playing tricks.
If a large breeding farm is set up right now, hehe, it doesn’t necessarily belong to anyone.
"Well, brother, I have to remind you, don't make too much noise, otherwise it will make people jealous.
We must not forget the lessons we learned before, and we still have to be careful.
I'm looking at this policy, maybe it will change, take your time, if there is any chance, the three of us will work together and do something very well. "
On the other side, Xu Shian had to remind his younger brother.
Brothers are all good intentions, Xu Shiyan understands, and he knows it well, so he will keep it like this for now, and he is not in a hurry to expand.
Brothers Xu Shixian and Xu Shian are on the mountain, and they follow Xu Shiyan every day, either hunting pine nuts, hunting wild boars, hunting black blind men, picking badgers, etc., and they can always gain something.
It's a bit reluctant to leave, and doesn't want to go home.
Don’t blame them, the key is that the daughter-in-law goes to work to earn money, and they stay at home all day.
The daughter-in-law always complains that they don’t make money, but the vegetable team is not working this winter, so what are they doing?
It’s better to be on the mountain, even if you can’t earn money, you can still get something to eat.
The three brothers lived on the mountain until the end of December, and they really saved a lot of things.
On December 30th, Xu Shiyan went down the mountain, borrowed two horse sledges from the team, and pulled all these things down the mountain.
The musk deer, sable, and otter were all put into cages and placed on the first sledge.
The sledge in the middle pulls all kinds of food, mainly pine nuts, walnuts, mustard seeds, and wild boar and black blind meat.
Finally, four dogs pull a sledge, which is loaded with food for sables and otters.
Xu Chenghou and his wife have moved to a new house, but during the day they are still with Xu Shiyan.
Xu Chenghou was building furniture for his son in the east room, and Zhou Guilan helped watch Xu Haiyuan.
This kid is too naughty, Su Anying can't take care of him if she wants to take care of her daughter.
If Zhou Guilan didn't come to help, Su Anying and the two children might not even be able to eat.
As soon as the three brothers came back, Xu Chenghou and his wife were also very happy.
But just seeing the animals that Xu Shiyan brought back, I have a headache, how can I raise them?
"It's okay, just put them in the three rooms on the east. After the New Year, I will go up the mountain, and I have to take them up."
Xu Shiyan had already thought about this matter on the mountain. The three houses in the east are empty, and it is useless to keep them. They just happened to be used to house these animals first.
Let’s just bury it, anyway, there are no people living there, and it will be overturned in a few years.
The houses that live in people should be lived in by animals. Xu Chenghou and his wife couldn't understand it.
But there is no trick. Who told Xu Shiyan to get so many open-mouth beasts?
"Hey, I don't know what to say about you. Isn't it good to watch a ginseng and go hunting? Why do you have to keep these things?
People say that those who have a lot of money and hair are not counted. Can you make money by adjusting these things? Don't waste your time. "
Zhou Guilan was worried, because she was afraid that her son's busy work would be for nothing, and he would not be able to earn money if he was tired.
"Mom, if I say that I can definitely make money, you won't believe me.
Anyway, it takes a little effort, and nothing else is spent, so let’s keep it.
If it can really develop, it will definitely make money in the future, but it doesn't see much effect right now. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and didn't argue with his mother. Don't blame the old man, their cognition is different.
Developing farming is not easy in itself. If it cannot be scaled up, it is indeed not very profitable.
It is necessary to expand the scale and replace it from generation to generation in order to see profits.
Take your time, he is not in a hurry, the main thing is that now is not the time, just make a small fuss first, seize the opportunity, and talk about it later.
In this way, the otters and sables were put in cages, and a shelf was built and placed in the adobe landlord's house. The three musk deer were released from the cages and locked in the West Room.
At any rate, this is also a house, sheltered from wind and snow, much better than the shed outside.
After settling the animals and moving all the things down, Xu Shiyan and Xu Shian drove the horses and sledges back to the team.
Then back home, the whole family chatted together lively.
Xu Shiyan came back from the mountain for more than a month, and he was very happy to see his wife and children. First, he hugged Xu Haiyuan and threw him twice, making the little guy giggle.
"Son, you're sinking again, your father can't hold you anymore."
Xu Haiyuan eats well after weaning, and Zhou Guilan, Su Anying's mother-in-law and daughter-in-law are also careful in feeding him.
Xu Shiyan hugged his son and threw it a few times, but his arms felt sore. Afraid of accidents, he quickly put down his son.
Where is Xu Haiyuan willing?
No one at home can coax him like this on normal days, Pi Xiaozi, who likes to play some exciting games, so he kept humming and asked Xu Shiyan to throw it again.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to find another way to let his son step on his instep.
Xu Shiyan sat on the edge of the kang, grabbed his son, and let him swing on his feet.
Xu Haiyuan had never played like this before, so he immediately became happy. After playing for a while, Xu Haiyuan finally came down happily.
After coaxing the son, the girl just woke up, Su Anying fed the baby and changed the diaper.
Only then did Xu Shiyan stuff her daughter, and let him coax Su Anying to cook.
Looking at the little girl who is almost two months old, she looks much better than when she was just born.
The small face is rosy and fleshy, and a pair of **** eyes are shining brightly.
Such a small baby has grown eyelashes, which are quite long, which is really rare.
Xu Shiyan hugged his daughter, no matter how he looked at it, he liked it.
"Girl, grow up quickly. When you grow up, Dad will buy you a lot of beautiful dresses. He will definitely dress you up as the most beautiful little girl."

chapters.title: Chapter 201: buy a house for pennies
chapters.content:
Chapter 201 Buying a house with money
Xu Shixian and his brothers ate at Xu Shiyan's place, and in the afternoon the three brothers shared the things they brought back.
Bear bile, hides and other things are placed here with Xu Shiyan first, and after two days, the three of them went to the county to sell them for a penny
There were also a lot of other meat, and it happened that each person had a sledge and dragged them back to Songjiang River.
The two brothers lived on the mountain for a month and didn't go home. The daughter-in-law was very upset at first and kept nagging all day long.
As a result, seeing her husband brought so many things back, and knowing that there will be money, he didn't say anything, and hurriedly cooked with a smile on his face.
So, man, you have to be able to make money no matter what time you are.
Xu Shiyan chatted with his parents for a while. After four o'clock, Xu Chenghou and his wife packed up their things and went home.
Now that the old couple has moved to a new house, Xu Shiqin can't still live in his brother's house, so he also went to live there.
Xu Shiyan sent his parents home, and walked around there to have a look.
When the house was first built, the layout of the two places was the same.
Compared with Xu Shiyan's house, the garden here is relatively smaller. There is a large area on the west side of the house, and a warehouse is built.
The room is pretty much the same, with more furniture than Xu Shiyan's side, including cabinets, writing desks, chests of drawers, etc. It looks better than Xu Shiyan's side.
"I'm working on the furniture on your side, but other foreign gangs have to go out and spend money to build furniture, and living at home is almost enough.
After Yuanyuan gets married, I don't care what kind of furniture you like. "
Yangbang is a local dialect, which means almost the same as a twenty-five-stringed cymbal, and when it comes out of Xu Chenghou's mouth, it is no different from money to burn.
"Father, am I afraid that you will be tired?"
What can Xu Shiyan say? Can he say that he dislikes the furniture made by the old man?
In fact, from the bottom of my heart, the old man's craftsmanship is nothing to say, but he is a bit outdated and can't keep up with the situation.
Such a nice house, with old-fashioned furniture, seems somewhat inappropriate.
But even his own father has spoken, what dare Xu Shiyan say? How dare he say that he doesn't need his father to do it, but go out and buy it by himself? Make the old man angry again?
Come on, it’s just furniture, as long as it’s useful.
Parents are all good intentions, afraid that he can spend too much money and can't save it. Dad is still making furniture for him at this age, so be content.
After chatting with his parents for a few more words, Xu Shiyan went home.
They ate two meals, and they didn't have to do anything else in the evening. Xu Shiyan went crazy with his son, which didn't make Xu Haiyuan tired, but made Xu Shiyan sweat profusely.
"Come on, go to sleep with your mother, I have something else to do." Xu Shiyan handed his son to his wife, took out a pen and paper and began to write a letter.
The letter is naturally written to Mr. Chu, and the content is some views on the sustainable development of traditional Chinese medicine.
Before Xu Shiyan asked Xu Shixian to help him write an article, revised it several times, and finally finished it before going down the mountain.
Xu Shiyan briefly wrote some of his own opinions in the letter, and asked Mr. Chu to help read the article written by Xu Shixian.
If you think it is useful, please submit it to relevant departments, or submit it to some newspapers and magazines.
Xu Shiyan has confidence in his eldest brother's writing style, and also knows the influence of Mr. Chu in the medical field.
Moreover, in March 1980, that is, March next year, the Changbai Mountain Nature Reserve will be listed as an international biosphere reserve.
Xu Shiyan felt that at this time, sending a proposal on the protection of rare animals in the Changbai Mountain area and the sustainable development of animals with medicinal value would attract some attention.
Xu Haiyuan hasn't had enough fun yet, how can he sleep well? I have to find my father to coax me.
Under Xu Haiyuan's constant interference, Xu Shiyan managed to finish writing the letter.
So, together with the manuscript and the letter, they were packed into a large envelope and placed on top of the kangqin.
If it is too short, if Xu Haiyuan gets it and tears it up, then the manuscript that Xu Shixian wrote by lighting a lamp these days will be in vain.
When Xu Shiyan finished writing the letter, Xu Haiyuan also yawned sleepily, and Xu Jinping on the other end was hungry and needed milk.
So the couple coaxed a baby each, and Xu Shiyan washed his son's feet and put him to sleep.
The little guy hadn't seen his father for a long time, and he had to sleep with him at night, so Xu Shiyan held his son in his arms and coaxed him to sleep.
Over there, Su Anying fed her daughter and changed her diaper. The little girl was very obedient, and fell asleep after taking a few casual pats.
Although they haven't been back for more than a month, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to make a mistake, so the couple just hugged a baby each to sleep.
Woke up early on the 31st, Xu Shiyan ate some food casually, and then came out of the house with a large basket on his back.
Go to Xu Shixian first, and the two brothers went to the post office together to mail the letter.
Then wait for Xu Shian at the passenger station of the Forestry Bureau.
As soon as Xu Shian arrived, the three brothers drove straight to Fusong, where they sold bear bile and all kinds of skins.
The prices of bear bile and hides have risen again, and they were sold for around 1,500 yuan.
The three brothers shared five hundred yuan each, and happily took the money home.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shian's family still live in other people's houses.
Now that they got the money, Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong both moved their minds and began to **** around looking for a house or real estate approval.
Finally, Xue Xiulin took a fancy to a family room on the other side of Baishan Street.
It was a house built by the employees of the Forestry Bureau privately. In 1975, the restrictions on the construction of private houses by employees were taken into public ownership.
At the beginning of 1979, when the new policy came down, all of them were refunded, and a property right license was applied for.
But the original family had already moved out, so the house was sold by someone, and it happened that Xue Xiulin found out and bought it.
The place is not too big, with three rooms, not a big yard, and no vegetable garden.
Most houses in the town are like this, unless it is in a remote place, Baishan Street is very close to the bureau building, and there are many residents, so it would be nice to have three rooms.
The key is that it is close to the lumber factory where Xue Xiulin works, so it is convenient to go to work.
The asking price of the house is not high, three hundred yuan.
Xue Xiulin saved some money, so she happily bought the house.
Let Xu Shixian go over there to clean up for a while, reorganize the kang and everything, and then the family moved to a new house.
Xu Shixian was busy tidying up the house and building a few pieces of furniture, so he had no chance to work, let alone carry wood.
Xu Shi'an didn't have a ready-made house on his side, but he approved a homestead on Sentie's side.
The area over there belongs to the fringe area, where not many people live, and there are forests in the back, occupying land casually.
Xu Shian has a lot of ambitions, and plans to enclose more places, regardless of farming or raising livestock in the future, it will be good.
At the beginning of January, several brigades in Donggang Commune began to settle the settlement.
Xu Shiyan has been busy this year, watching ginseng and leading people to work. He has a lot of work points. After deducting points for food, there are more than 400 left.
Xu Chenghou earns less, nearly three hundred.
This is the second brigade, with a lot of land and high work points. If you change to a big house, you won’t be able to earn so much.
There is a leap in June this year, so the Chinese New Year is late, and the 15th of February is only the 30th of the Chinese New Year.
It was a long time ago, and Xu Shiyan also went down the mountain, so Zhou Guilan discussed with Su Anying to wrap a sticky fire spoon and bake pancakes.
Try to save as much food as possible before the year, so that you will have no time when you are busy after the year.
So soaking rice, grinding, mother-in-law and daughter-in-law pack a sticky fire spoon and bake pancakes.
Xu Shiyan was doing carpentry work with his father, and the whole family was very busy.

chapters.title: Chapter 202: butcher pig treat
chapters.content:
Chapter 202 Killing a pig for a treat
Xu Chenghou knew that his son's house was building a new house, and it would not look good to add some old-fashioned furniture.
So I went to Songjianghe specially, and chatted with him for a long time under the pretext that I needed to make furniture at home.
After returning, they made furniture for Xu Shiyan according to the most popular styles at present.
Large wardrobe, vertical cabinet, chest of drawers, coffee table, cupboard, writing desk, kang table, side stand, chair, stool.
When Xu Shiyan came back from the mountain, the old man had already made a few big pieces, and the rest were just busy with his father.
In mid-January, Xu Shixiang came back from winter vacation.
He also brought back a set of fine porcelain tea sets from JDZ to Xu Shiyan. It was so beautiful that it was considered a congratulatory gift for Xu Shiyan.
When the fifth child came back, the three of them made furniture together, or helped Xu Shixian clean up the house.
I have to prepare feed for the open-mouth beasts at home, and I am busy every day anyway.
Just being so busy, it will soon be the end of the year.
The team kills pigs and divides the meat, and everyone starts to kill pigs and make tofu, busy preparing for the New Year.
The Xu family caught two pigs at the beginning of the spring, and after raising them for a year, they only weighed 200 catties, and they were fed with scallions.
Xu Shiyan discussed with his wife, one of the two pigs was killed a year ago, and the other was killed after the beginning of spring.
Being busy in the Spring Festival, I am tired, and the food is not good and there is no oily water. It is better to kill it at that time and keep more meat for myself.
Xu Shiyan has been taken care of by the brigade leaders and neighbors since he moved to Donggang. No matter what happened at home, they would come to help.
So when slaughtering pigs years ago, Xu Shiyan planned to invite people from Yu Shouguang and other brigades, as well as neighbors and friends who got along well.
Killing pigs and entertaining guests is a traditional custom. Su Anying doesn't care about these, and Xu Shiyan can do whatever he wants.
Therefore, Xu Shiyan notified Yu Shouguang and others in advance to let them come to eat at home on the 25th day of the twelfth lunar month.
He also made a special trip to the Han family to invite the old man of the Han family and the brothers Han Limin.
It happened that Han Liwei, the youngest of the Han family, was going home to visit relatives, so Xu Shiyan said, let's go there together to join in the fun.
On the morning of the 25th day of the twelfth lunar month, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Huang Shengli and others all came to Xu's house.
The crowd entered the pigsty, grabbed a pig that had been hungry for a day and hadn’t fed it, tied it to a bench and killed it.
Everyone cleaned up together, and the house was also busy cooking.
Xu Shiqin, who works in a tailor shop, has to ask for leave to help at home.
The tailor shop, in fact, will not accept work after the 15th day of the twelfth lunar month. As the year approaches, who doesn't have anything to do?
So Xu Shiqin asked for leave, and the master readily agreed.
Men are busy killing pigs and shaving them, dismantling pigs for internal organs, dismantling pork and chopping bones.
Women cut sauerkraut, pick up pig blood, wash pigs and load them, and prepare blood sausages, head and hooves to load.
Originally, Su Anying was going to clean the pigs and unload the goods, but Xu Jinping, who was lying on the kang, woke up and cried. She had no choice but to comfort the child first.
Xu Shiqin saw it, and went to the well in the yard with a pot of pig intestines, intending to press the water up to clean it.
Beside the pressurized well, a man in a grass-green uniform was carrying a bucket of water to leave, and the two met after walking.
"Do you want to fetch water? Let me help you."
When the other party saw Xu Shiqin, he hurriedly put down the bucket, and stepped forward to help Xu Shiqin carry the pigs to the pressurized well.
Then press the handle hard, and the clear well water will come up with a splash.
Xu Shiqin didn't know each other, but he also knew that this should be his brother's friend.
People helped, she must thank her. So he smiled at the other party, "Thank you."
The young man on the opposite side glanced at Xu Shiqin, froze for a moment, then nodded.
"You wash first, if you still fetch water after a while, call me."
Xu Shiqin and Xu Shiyan look a bit like Xu Shiyan, and they are brother and sister at a glance.
The other party didn't say anything else, and without waiting for Xu Shiqin's answer, he turned around and left with the bucket in his hand.
Xu Shiqin was a little unresponsive. Looking at the tall and straight back of the other party, he was stunned for a few seconds, then smiled, moved the basin to the side, and began to clean the pig's intestines.
By the time Su Anying came out after feeding her daughter, Xu Shiqin had already rubbed the pig intestines with plant ashes twice, and was about to rub the pig intestines with soda again.
The two aunts and sisters-in-law worked together, washed it with vinegar again, and rinsed it with clean water twice before taking it back for blood sausage filling.
If you kill a pig for a treat, you must eat authentic pig-killing dishes.
Sauer cabbage meat blood sausage, and then a platter of pig offal, pig head meat and so on.
The dishes don’t need to be exquisite, as long as they are generous in quantity, open to the eye, and accompanied by two bottles of good wine, it will be very good.
There was a table on the kang in the east room and a table on the ground. Everyone gathered together to exchange cups, drink and punch each other. It was extremely lively.
Han Wenzhong is very famous in the field, not to mention that his three sons are all outstanding, and Yu Shouguang and others are familiar with them.
Several older people get together and chat more and more speculatively.
When Xu Chenghou and Han Wenzhong met for the first time, they felt that they were in the right temper, chatting while drinking.
Han Wenzhong praised Xu Shiyan for being filial, capable, and kind-hearted, while Xu Chenghou praised the three sons of the Han family for their promise.
Anyway, men drank wine and praised each other.
The table of young people on the ground is also very lively. Although Han Limin, Yang Chunming and others have never met before, a friend of a friend is a friend.
Northeast people never know each other at the wine table, as long as they drink together today, they will be friends from now on, and it’s fine to talk about things.
"Limin, where is your brother in the army?
The young man looks really good, do you have a date? If there is no match, I will introduce my sister-in-law to him. "
Yang Chunming drank a lot of wine and got a little heady, so he hooked up with Han Limin and asked about Han Lizhi's situation with a smile.
Han Limin didn't drink less, and laughed immediately when he heard about his brother.
"You mean the third child in my family? He is only twenty-two, and he is going to be a soldier at eighteen, and he is in Shenyang.
I don’t have a partner yet, I’m still young, so don’t worry. "
Generally speaking, those who are still young and not in a hurry are mostly excuses to shirk.
Yang Chunming understood as soon as he heard it. His sister-in-law was a rural girl, and the Han family participated in the field and belonged to the workers.
The shoulders of the two families are not the same, he is reckless.
"Yes, yes, brother is young and has a bright future, so it's not good to think about it too early."
Yang Chunming said something along the way, then poured wine for Han Limin, and the two continued to drink.
As the protagonist being talked about, Han Liwei didn't drink much alcohol.
He has good hearing. Even though the room is so lively and everyone is talking loudly, he can still hear the conversations between the elder brother and others.
Han Liwei lowered his eyes and looked at the blood sausage in the sauerkraut bowl in front of him.
"Brother Xu, come, let me toast you.
In the past few days since I’ve been back, I often hear my father mention Brother Xu, saying that Brother Xu is a good person, very smart, sincere, and worthy of friendship. "
Han Liwei picked up the wine glass, approached Xu Shiyan, and toasted Xu Shiyan with a smile.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, then laughed, and quickly picked up his wine glass.
"Where is it, he is just an old farmer, a little clever and not much.
In comparison, no one is as capable as the three of you brothers. I, Uncle Han, are so lucky.
Come on, let's not respect each other, let's go together. "
After finishing speaking, the two touched their wine glasses, and each drank the wine in the glass.
"Brother Xu, how many brothers do you have? I don't even know each other." Han Liwei asked seemingly casually.

chapters.title: Chapter 203: settle old scores
chapters.content:
Chapter 203 Settling Old Accounts
"We have five brothers and a younger sister. No one else came, but the fifth and sixth younger sisters are here.
Then, that is the fifth and sixth sister, right now in the Westinghouse?
It’s the one who served the dishes up just now, with two big braids.
Worked as an apprentice in a tailor shop of the Forestry Bureau, and his skills were excellent. "
Xu Shiyan was happy today, and he didn't drink less. Now that Han Liwei has been caught, some vernacular words are indispensable.
"Let me tell you, my sixth younger sister is smart, and she learns things quickly.
After a few months of apprenticeship with the master, she has almost learned it. Her master likes her, so why not find a way to stay in the tailor shop?
Don't look at the apprentices now, they are also workers, eating the food supply, unlike me, an old farmer with muddy legs. "
Mentioning his sixth younger sister, Xu Shiyan was proud and praised his younger sister.
"Well, Brother Xu's family is very nice and smart." Han Liwei raised the corners of his lips slightly when he heard this, and nodded.
What else did Xu Shiyan want to say, but now that Zhao Jianshe was toasting him again, he couldn't care about Han Liwei.
Han Liwei wasn't annoyed either, he just sat there with a smile, didn't drink, just looked at him with his glass, as if he was thinking about something.
After eating a meal until evening, these people drank so much that they walked and swayed.
Seeing that it was getting dark, everyone took their leave and left one after another. The Xu family tidied up and it was finally quiet.
The 25th day of the twelfth lunar month is over, and there are only a few days before the New Year's Eve.
Xu’s house is newly built, with double-glazed windows and whitewashed walls, so there is no need to sweep the walls or paste the window paper, which saves a lot of trouble.
With the sound of firecrackers, we bid farewell to the old year, and in the blink of an eye it is a new year.
The streets and alleys are full of the taste of the New Year. People put on new clothes one after another, and visit relatives and friends to send blessings to each other.
In the first day of junior high school, most of the neighbors walked around each other.
Xu Chenghou and his wife have moved to a new house, so most people came to wish the old couple a new year.
On Xu Shiyan's side, fewer people went there.
On the second day of the first lunar month, the Xu family brothers all came back with their wives and children, and even Xu Shixiang brought his partner, Chen Chunling.
The family gathered together, chatting and laughing, it was very lively.
"Ahem, that, old lady, you take your daughter-in-law and children to Westinghouse to talk.
I have something to explain to them. "
While talking lively, Xu Chenghou suddenly knocked on his cigarette bag, glanced at the five Xu family brothers with a serious face, and asked Zhou Guilan to take his daughter-in-law and grandchildren to the Westinghouse.
Everyone was stunned for a moment, not understanding what the old man was going to do.
Zhou Guilan, on the other hand, seemed to guess what the old man wanted to say, so she waved her hand, indicating that the daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law should come out and talk together in the Westinghouse.
In the east room, only Xu Chenghou and his five sons were left. Xu Chenghou knocked on the pipe and pot again and coughed.
"After the New Year's Eve the year before last, your mother and I separated our families in front of our brothers and neighbors in the big house."
As soon as the old man mentioned this topic, Xu Shixian immediately understood that the old man wanted to settle accounts with him.
"Father..." Xu Shixian wanted to defend himself.
"Don't talk, wait until I finish talking." Xu Chenghou glared at his eldest son.
"It was agreed at the beginning that our old couple will live with the boss.
The boss will give us the old age, the house at home, etc., will be given to the boss in the future. "
Xu Chenghou sighed and continued.
"Yes, the houses along the Dongjiang River are worthless.
Your mother and I haven't saved any money for most of our lives, and we don't take advantage of how much money we have.
So you all jumped faster than anyone else, and just threw us two old gans on the edge of the Dongjiang River. "
Don't think that after a year, Xu Chenghou forgot about it, he remembered it, and he must make it clear today.
"You all say that you have difficulties, okay, I don't blame you, but today, we have to spread the matter out and explain it clearly.
Now your mother and I live in five large tile-roofed houses. As far as the moment is concerned, these five brick-and-tile houses are worth at least 800 yuan for such a large space inside and out.
How much it will be worth in the future, I don’t know, I think it can only be more but not less. "
Xu Chenghou thought about this matter for a long time, and he felt that it must be implemented as soon as possible.
Now it’s different from before. The three broken adobe houses in the big house are worthless and no one will hesitate to take them.
But now, five large tile-roofed houses with bright tiles are here, inside and outside, who doesn't care?
The old couple is alive, everything is fine, but if the day they leave, can these bears fight over the house?
Xu Chenghou felt that he was not old yet, he was in good health and delicious, and it would be no problem to live another ten or twenty years.
However, there are some things that must be planned in advance. It cannot be said that he just closes his eyes and ignores everything, leaving some troubles for the children.
In the end, it was his fault that brothers did not look like brothers, but relatives looked like enemies.
"I'm over sixty-one now, and I can't do much work anymore.
Now the four of you are married and have children, and the fifth child has also been brought back. You will be assigned a job after graduating from university in summer, so I don’t have to worry about it in the future.
Today I’m just asking you, what about the old-age care? "
Xu Chenghou looked around and saw the expressions of his sons.
"When building this house, the third child paid 400 yuan for me, and the money will be shared equally among you.
Then, the five of you go back to get money and food for the elderly.
No matter what's wrong with your mother or me, the five of you will share equally.
If your mother and I are sick or have a disaster, the five of you will take turns to take care of them, and no one will be left behind.
When your mother and I are gone, no matter what is left, even the house is sold together, and the five of you will share it equally. No one has more and the other has less. "
This method is absolutely fair, and no one takes advantage of anyone.
Xu Shixian and the others were a little dumbfounded, they hadn't thought about this at all.
"Father, you are only sixty-one, isn't it too early to think about this?" Xu Shixian muttered in a low voice.
Xu Shian and Xu Shide glanced at the boss, and nodded in agreement.
That's right, Dad is only so old, so he plans to go so long?
Xu Chenghou has raised his son all these years, and he knows exactly what these **** are thinking.
This is when I heard that they were asked to take money, and everyone was reluctant to part with it.
"What's the matter? Do you think that your mother and I worked so hard to raise you up, and told you one by one that you have a daughter-in-law and a home. Don't we deserve to enjoy happiness now?"
The old man pulled his face down and asked in a deep voice.
"No, Dad, we didn't mean that." Who dares to nod and admit it?
"Since it doesn't mean that, it means that our old couple should enjoy a happy life, right?
That line, just do as I said, the four of you pay 80 yuan each, and pay back the money from the third child first.
Then we will discuss how much money you should take home and how much food you should give. "
Just these bastards, you still want to play tricks on him?
Cut, let them all tie together, it is not enough to see.
"The discussion is over, I will go to the secretary of the brigade, and then call the chief and your second brother, and let them all be witnesses.
We wrote a contract and implemented it, and then asked the principal of the fourth child and the street director of the eldest and second child to sign it. "
Jiang is still old and spicy, if Xu Chenghou really wants to clean up his sons, none of them can escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 204: pension agreement
chapters.content:
Chapter 204 Pension Agreement
Xu Shixian and the others turned pale when they heard what their father said.
This is the captain, the principal, and the street director. Isn’t it too scary?
How worried the old man was about them that he thought of this trick?
It was Xu Shiyan, who wanted to be happy after hearing it.
The father of his family is a real gangster when he is a gangster, and a gangster when he is a gangster.
No wonder people say that people are old and cunning, it is true, this hand is beautiful.
Xu Shiyan really didn't expect that his father could raise the issue of pension at this time.
In fact, Xu Shiyan wanted to mention it a long time ago, but he never found a chance. Unexpectedly, his father would speak first.
Also, there are five brothers in the Xu family, and they can only get together during the Chinese New Year. Why don’t you tell them now, when will you say it?
The old man has already been thrown down by several sons, and he has learned a lot from a fall, so he must implement the matter this time.
Very good, the old man's arrangement is reasonable, Xu Shiyan raised his hands and feet in favor.
Pension should never be a matter for a son.
It was so difficult at the beginning, the old couple was able to support five sons.
how? Now five sons can't afford to support two old people?
Although Xu Shiyan agreed in his heart, he couldn't make a statement first, otherwise the brothers would think it was his instigation.
So Xu Shiyan sat there, not saying a word, watching how the two brothers responded.
"Father, you know what happened to me. I just moved out of the big house last year, and I have no foundation.
At any rate, I was on the mountain with my third child a while ago, bought some things, sold some money, and then bought a house.
I really don’t have that much money in my hand, eighty, I can’t get it out now. "
Xu Shixian's face was as wrinkled as a bitter melon. How could he have any money?
I went to Fusong to sell mountain products, and when I got home, the money was taken by my wife. I only kept a few yuan, and the rest was confiscated.
Now all the money is with the wife, eighty yuan, how can he have it?
This matter, even if I discuss it with my daughter-in-law, I'm afraid I can't discuss it. It's impossible for the daughter-in-law to give money.
Xu Shi'an is similar. Since the two brothers got married, they have been taken over by their daughter-in-law to death. As long as the family uses money, they can't control it.
"Father, I bought a house and set up a family when I married Yanzi, and my salary is not much.
Swallow is now serving the children and can’t work to earn work points, and we are also short on money. "
As for Xu Shide, let alone.
The little money at home is probably used to subsidize the old man’s family. How can I give 80 yuan to Xu Shiyan?
The three brothers don’t have any money, how much can the fifth brother have as a college student?
Even if he has it, the three elder brothers above don’t pay, so he takes it out? That's not the case.
"Father, can this matter be changed?
My third brother’s four hundred yuan is considered his shareholding.
In the future, no matter how much the house is worth, my third brother will share half of it, and the rest will be divided among the four of us. Do you think this will work? "
The old fifth has a quick brain, his eyes rolled, and he came up with an idea.
"Old Five, let's do as our father said, I won't take advantage of my brother.
Otherwise, I don’t need you to pay back the money. We have discussed how much we will give our parents every year, and mine will be deducted from the four hundred.
It’s not enough, I’ll use the money to provide for the elderly in the future, how about it? "
Xu Shiyan can't be trusted with these few people. What they are talking about right now is full of hype, but when that day comes, they will all backtrack.
These five brick and tile houses are now worth 800 yuan, and when they are demolished, let alone 600,000 yuan.
By that time, can Xu Shiyan take half of it? Don't dream, those brothers can't agree.
Xu Shiyan is not greedy for the other half, but wants the brothers to share equally.
When Xu Shiyan said that, the eyes of the brothers brightened, yes, this is a good idea.
"Yes, yes, the third child is right.
Father, then I think it’s better to follow what the third child said, he is equivalent to paying the pension in advance. "
The three brothers nodded repeatedly, thinking it was reasonable.
Xu Chenghou glanced at the third child and sighed.
This idiot son is still too soft-hearted, so he let those **** go easily.
"Okay, then do as the third child said, from now on, you will give me and your mother five yuan and five catties of grain every month.
Your mother and I can still move, so we can earn a little bit. If you bring these back to subsidize, it will be enough. "
When the brothers heard that five yuan plus five catties of grain per month, they immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
I thought it would take a lot for the old man to be able to open his mouth like a lion. Five yuan plus five catties of grain, they can still afford it, okay, this is fine.
"Don't be beautiful, this is this year. From now on, every second day of the new year, I will set a year's pension money and food."
Xu Chenghou didn't want to speak again. It turns out that this is only the standard for this year, and we will discuss it next year.
Xu Chenghou is not stupid, who knows what will happen in the future? This can't be a death sentence, otherwise he will lose money.
"You can send money and food back every three months or half a year. If anyone doesn't get money and food back for a year, he will have no share in the family.
If your mother and I have any problems in the future, the cost of seeing a doctor will not be counted, and you will pay for it separately. "
Xu Chenghou is in his sixties, what has he not experienced? So there will be no loopholes for the sons to take advantage of.
The old man has made all the arrangements, what else can Xu Shixian say? can only agree.
So, Xu Chenghou found paper and pen, and Xu Shide wrote the pension agreement.
In duplicate, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shixian all signed their fingerprints.
There is no notary office in this year, but we need to find several notaries.
Exactly two days later, Xu Chenghou will accompany Zhou Guilan back to her mother's house. The agreement can be brought there, and Zhou Guilan's brother can be a witness.
Of course, if you are still afraid of being insecure, you can do what Xu Chenghou said.
Find the principal of Daying Primary School, the director of the street, and the secretary of the brigade, and all sign their names to testify.
After the agreement was written and signed, Xu Chenghou nodded in satisfaction and put away the agreement.
"There is one more thing, so I won't write about it."
The old man intends to talk about everything today, so as to avoid trouble in the future.
"You guys are all far away, but the youngest is closer.
If your mother and I have a little problem with headaches and brain fever, I guess you can't help, and you have to count on the third child.
Don’t think that you have made a great contribution by taking the money and food back home. The third child takes money and food just like you, and Yu Wai has to take care of the old couple.
In the future, if you see me and your mother helping the third child with something, you don’t have to climb.
Who told you to jump so far one by one? You don't take care of me, and don't care what I usually do. "
Xu Chenghou has been thinking about it for a year, and he can't think of it in every way?
Among the sons, only the third is reliable, and there are many places to count on the third in the future, so he has to be partial.
But there are many sons in the family, and there is always comparison. If the old man puts his ugly words first, the next few will be ashamed to trouble the third child.
What the old man said is obviously partial to the third child.
The brothers all understood, but they had nothing to say. What else could they do besides nodding in agreement?

chapters.title: Chapter 205: two years later
chapters.content:
Chapter 205 Two years later
On the second day of the Lunar New Year, taking advantage of the return of his sons, Xu Chenghou made a final decision on the future care of the elderly.
On the third day of the first lunar month, Xu Chenghou accompanied Zhou Guilan back to Daying, and he really found the two uncles of the Zhou family, Zhou Anping and Zhou Anfu, to put their fingerprints on the pension agreement.
Mother and uncle, with these two guarantees, I am not afraid that Xu Shixian and the others will not admit it.
At any rate, under the persuasion of his relatives, Xu Chenghou didn't really go to the principal of the primary school, nor did he go to the street director of the eldest and second child.
Not long after the new year, Xu Shiyan went back to the mountain to visit the festival again, while Su Anying stayed at home to take care of the two children.
Before going up the mountain, Xu Shiyan went to find Yu Shouguang and the relevant personnel of the commune, and talked about some ideas about breeding economic animals.
Yu Shouguang and Secretary Li of the commune are quite supportive, thinking that this can be tried.
If the experiment is successful, this may be another sustainable development path for Donggang Commune besides ginseng planting.
With the support of Yu Shouguang and Secretary Li, Xu Shiyan felt relieved.
After returning to the mountain, I found a way to catch a lot of live otters, sables, etc., and the scale of breeding expanded little by little.
On March 27, 1980, Changbai Mountain Reserve was listed as an international biosphere reserve.
In early April, the article written by Xu Shixian was published in many newspapers and magazines in the province, which aroused the attention and discussion of many people.
On April 17th, the province sent people to Tonghua to join forces with Tonghua to Fusong.
On-the-spot investigation of the relevant planning of the production and construction policy of "mainly forest" mountainous areas in Fusong area.
I believe that the proposal of giving priority to forestry and combining forestry, ginseng, animal husbandry and deputy to comprehensively develop mountainous areas is in line with reality and should be implemented as soon as possible.
At the same time, some people went to Xiaohehe to conduct field inspections.
I learned about Xu Shiyan's breeding techniques for rare wild animals, especially medicinal economic animals, and the extraction method of musk.
The people above affirmed this method of not harming the life of male musk deer and producing musk many times, and reported it to relevant departments for discussion and study.
Xu Shiyan became a well-known figure in Donggang Commune and even Fusong for a while, and many places wanted to invite him to give lectures.
Xu Shiyan only said that he had no education, and he couldn't explain any major principles, so he pushed everything away and focused on watching ginseng farming on the mountain.
Spring goes to winter, the seasons change, and it is June 1, 1982 in the blink of an eye.
Xu Shiyan stayed outside the delivery room of Donggang Commune Hospital again. His wife was about to give birth again.
Three months after Su Anying gave birth to her eldest daughter, Xu Jinping, the husband and wife decided through discussion and responded to the call of their superiors that they could not have any more children for the time being.
Combined with Xu Shiyan being on the mountain all year round, it was rare for the husband and wife to be together, but they stopped for two years.
Last autumn, Xiaoheihe ginseng field started to produce ginseng for the first time, and the mountain was too busy.
Xu Shiyan, Xu Chenghou, and Yang Chunming were too busy to eat, so Yang Chunming's wife and Su Anying left their children and went up the mountain to help.
As a result, after the busy autumn, Su Anying found out that she was pregnant again.
Xu Shiyan already has a son and a daughter in his family, which does not meet the regulations.
Donggang is more strictly managed, unlike big houses that are remote and unmanned.
Yu Shouguang privately gave an idea to let Su Anying live on the mountain with Xu Shiyan to avoid many troubles.
According to the logic, Su Anying's due date should be July, but since yesterday, she has become popular and her stomach hurts.
Xu Shiyan was so frightened that he hurriedly led Su Anying down the mountain and sent him to the hospital.
As a result, the doctor in the hospital checked and said that Su Anying might be pregnant with two.
"Daughter-in-law, you must be safe and sound, and there must be nothing wrong.
I shouldn't worry about having another child. How good are we two children? "
When he was on the mountain, Xu Shiyan felt that his daughter-in-law's belly was not right, it was bigger than the average pregnant woman.
But the Xu family had never had twins, so Xu Shiyan didn't think about it. He just thought that his daughter-in-law ate too much on the mountain, and she became fat and had a big belly.
When the doctor told him that Su Anying was probably pregnant with two, Xu Shiyan was dumbfounded. How is this possible?
Xu Shiyan was really regretting it to death. He shouldn't still be thinking about wanting a daughter. He fancifully thought that the second daughter might also come.
If he had known that there would be twins, why would he not be able to lead his wife to hide on the mountain for so long? At least he would find a way to lead his wife to check.
This, why is it different from the previous life?
In his previous life, his second daughter was born in the autumn of 1981, but there is no such thing as twins.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly walked back and forth outside the delivery room, like a headless chicken, muttering while walking around.
Let’s not talk about the previous life. After several years of rebirth, many things have changed. How can we all develop according to the previous life?
At this time in the previous life, the second brother Xu Shian had developed stomach cancer and underwent an operation.
But in this life, his second brother is like a live donkey, nothing happens.
In his previous life, Xu Shixian, the eldest brother, quit Donggang Commune due to injury at this time and opened a photo studio.
What about this life? Because of that article, Xu Shixian was taken by the leaders of the bureau.
Directly recruit workers into the trade union, work as a secretary in the publicity department, write some speeches, organize an event and so on.
Xu Shixian also took this opportunity to publish many articles praising his hometown and reflecting the changes of the times in newspapers in the city and the province.
Last year, what Xu Shixian wrote was picked up by the county leaders, so he was seconded across the unit, and now he works in the county.
I just sit in the office and read the newspaper every day. I have nothing to do to write manuscripts for the leader, and I just post a few articles in the newspaper. I live a comfortable life.
Everything has been changed and disrupted, Xu Shiyan still thinks about his previous life at this time, and Xu Shiyan feels that his mind is also squeezed by the door.
Now, Xu Shiyan can no longer guess how the future will develop, let alone whether his wife can give birth safely inside.
All he can do is stand outside the delivery room, praying for God's blessing, and don't let his daughter-in-law have any accidents.
Su Anying had been in the delivery room for a while, and there were cries of pain, tugging at Xu Shiyan's heart.
While anxious, Xu Shiqin hugged his niece Xu Jinping and led his nephew Xu Haiyuan to the hospital.
"Dad, where's Mom?"
Xu Jinping struggled and jumped out of her aunt's arms, rushed to her father, and asked with a worried face.
A little girl who is only four years old, but actually only two and a half years old, has a braid tied with a red string on the top of her head. She has a small red face, big watery eyes, and delicate and beautiful eyebrows.
This baby combines the advantages of her parents and looks very good-looking.
The little girl was wearing a pink round-neck shirt and duck-egg blue overalls, all of which were made by Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiqin's tailoring skills are extraordinary nowadays, no matter the people in magazines or pictorials, she can imitate the same clothes with a glance.
"My God, you are not at home, what are you doing in the hospital?"
Xu Shiyan bent down and picked up his daughter, and kissed her on the cheek.
"Mom is inside, and the younger brother or younger sister is coming out to meet you.
Pingping, let's stay outside and wait for mom, okay? "
No matter how anxious you are in your heart, you can’t show it to your children. Children are very sensitive and can feel the emotions of adults, so they will be afraid.
"I said I shouldn't come, right? You have to find your parents."
Over there, Xu Haiyuan, who is more than four years old, hummed with a stern face.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Twins
chapters.content:
Chapter 206 Dragon and Phoenix Twins
The two children of the Xu family both speak early.
Especially Xu Haiyuan, his pronunciation was very standard from the beginning.
The four-year-old baby can already speak a long series of sentences, and express very clearly.
Xu Shiyan remembered that his mother said that he was almost five years old when he was a child, and he still couldn't speak clearly.
This kid is much better than his father.
"It's already here, just sit over there and wait, don't make any noise, okay?"
It's been a long time since I saw the children, and Xu Shiyan panicked, but now is not the time to get close to the children, and his wife is still suffering in the delivery room.
Xu Shiyan put his daughter on the long bench over there, and asked Xu Shiqin and Xu Haiyuan to sit down and wait quietly.
Xu Jinping was very obedient, she sat down as soon as her father told her to, and the two babies leaned together, waiting quietly with their father.
After a while, I suddenly heard a baby crying from the delivery room.
Xu Shiyan stood up from the stool and walked to the door of the delivery room.
But he waited for a long time, but he didn't see any nurse coming out, but he waited for the second cry.
This sound is much louder than the one just now, obviously not a baby.
"Really two?"
Xu Shiyan was stunned. There are still twins in his family? It's just unbelievable.
After a while, Zhou Guilan and a nurse came out of the room with a candle bag in their arms.
The nurse immediately laughed when she saw Xu Shiyan, "Congratulations, you are a pair of twins, now you have younger brothers and sisters."
Xu Shiyan was not in the mood to see the child this time, but only asked if he could go in to pick up the mother.
After getting an affirmative answer from the nurse, I went in directly.
The nurse was still the same nurse from last time, but this time she was stunned again.
Last time, a daughter was born and she almost cried with joy. This time, why don’t you even look at the twins?
Xu Shiqin hurried forward and took the baby from the nurse's arms, "Which of these two children came out first?"
The newborn babies are all similar, wrinkled and red, and they are from the same mother. I really can't tell them apart.
"This is my sister. Look, she has a birthmark on her wrist. That is my younger brother. There is a bruise on her buttocks, as if she was kicked by someone."
Zhou Guilan nodded towards the one in her arms, indicating that this was the one who came out earlier, and the one in Xu Shiqin's arms was the kid who came out later.
"I didn't expect that my third brother and third sister-in-law could give birth to a pair.
Mom, did the elders of our family give birth to a pair of twins? "Xu Shiqin felt amazing when he saw the two very similar babies.
Zhou Guilan shook her head, "We don't have it here, but if there is one, it's also at your sister-in-law's home.
But I haven't heard of it, who knows what kind of luck the third brother is getting? Actually gave birth to two at once? "
Zhou Guilan held the child in her arms, and chanted while walking to the ward.
"Alright, now I won't ask for more. Your third brother has two sons and two daughters. Four children are enough."
As the elderly, they all hope that their children and grandchildren will prosper, and the more grandchildren they have, the better. Zhou Guilan is no exception.
Now the eldest son, Xu Shixian, has two daughters and one son, and the second son, Xu Shian, has two sons.
The third son, Xu Shiyan, has two sons and two daughters, and the fourth son, Xu Shide, has one son and one daughter. They are all doing well.
Only the fifth child, Xu Shixiang, has only one daughter in his family.
Xu Shixiang graduated in the summer of 1980 and was assigned to Xinglong Commune. In the autumn, he married Chen Chunling. In the summer of 1981, he gave birth to a daughter.
When Chen Chunling gave birth, she went into dystocia and hemorrhagic shock, and almost died.
Xu Shixiang was frightened and said, as long as this child is needed, there will be no more.
From the bottom of her heart, Zhou Guilan still hopes that the fifth and fifth couple can have another child, regardless of the daughter and boy, and have two children as companions.
Only one, I always feel lonely and flustered.
But both Xu Shixiang and his wife said no, and Zhou Guilan couldn't say much.
Xu Shixiang is different after all. People with formal jobs are really hard to find in the current situation.
The mother and daughter carried the child to the ward, and just after putting the child down, Xu Shiyan came back with his wife in his arms.
This time I gave birth to two children, and the fetal position of the two children was not right, and they happened to be stuck in each other.
If it wasn't for Dr. Yang's good skills, he was transferred here, and it's not sure what would happen.
Su Anying was exhausted. This time, she really didn't have the energy to go to see the child again. When she returned to the ward, she closed her eyes and rested.
Xu Shiyan felt distressed when he saw his daughter-in-law like that, "We will never have another child in the future, just these four children are enough."
Being able to have four children was already beyond Xu Shiyan's expectations. Originally, he only planned to have three.
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan suddenly felt something was wrong. Could it be that **** Xu Haichao who reincarnated early?
With this thought, Xu Shiyan couldn't hold his breath anymore, and quickly turned to look at the two children.
Two newborn babies, with wrinkled faces, can't see anything.
"Mom, which one is the girl and which one is the kid?"
The two children look the same, without removing the quilt, it is impossible to tell which is the girl and which is the boy.
Zhou Guilan hurriedly told her son how to tell the difference.
Xu Shiyan frowned upon hearing this. In his previous life, did the second daughter have a birthmark on her wrist? Why can't he remember?
No, this should not be the girl in the previous life. In the previous life, the second girl of his family was born in 1981. It has been 82 years now, it is impossible.
Then, the other one will not be that **** Xu Haichao.
Xu Haichao was born in 1983. Both of them were born at the wrong time. How could it be the one in the previous life?
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan didn't know whether he was happy or regretful, and felt a little indescribable.
Before, he was also looking forward to the birth of his second daughter.
Xu Jinmei, the second daughter in her previous life, also dropped out of school because of a car accident between her husband and wife.
The second child can’t study as well as the eldest, but it’s not bad.
That girl likes to sing and dance the most, but unfortunately the family conditions were not good at that time, and she couldn't afford it at all.
The second child dropped out of school to work for two or three years, and then the family gradually got better. With Xu Jinping's support, Xu Jinmei went to study beauty and hairdressing, and opened her own shop.
In 2005, just as the policy of one college student in one village was being implemented, Xu Jinmei took the exam with the encouragement of her sister, and was admitted to the animal husbandry and veterinary major of Jilin Agricultural University.
After graduating two years later, the kid didn't go back to the village, but went to the south to make a living and joined a veterinary drug company for sales.
Later, I met a young man in the company who was also from Northeast China. The two hit it off quite well and got married after a while.
How to put it, it is really not easy for two people to leave their hometowns and work hard outside.
But Xu Jinmei is smart, capable and enterprising. The couple thought about one thing and worked hard together, and slowly saved some money.
Coupled with some financial support from the two families, they bought a house in the south and settled down, and had a son.
Life is not about being rich and powerful, it is always passable.
The old house in my previous life was actually rebuilt by Xu Jinping later, and it was demolished only a few years after it was built.
Originally Xu Shiyan meant that the second daughter and son had settled down outside and could not come back again. The old house at home was demolished and replaced by another house.
He lives with the eldest daughter and granddaughter, and will give it to the eldest daughter when he is gone.
The rest of the money is reserved for his retirement, and if he is gone, if there is any money left, it will be given to the boss. After all, the boss owed the most in those years.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Annunciation
chapters.content:
Chapter 207 Annunciation
In fact, no matter what era, it is always the one who suffers in front of the elderly.
Other people come back every year and a half, usually when they are in a good mood and send a few money, and when they are in a bad mood, they don’t even make a phone call.
