Being close and convenient, the family has to worry about big and small things, from sickness to hospital to firewood, rice, oil and salt, everything is on my mind.
Xu Shiyan felt that he had treated his eldest daughter badly, so he wanted to make up for it more.
Unexpectedly, the demolition of the old house had not yet been negotiated, but he was **** off by his brother and son.
That's all, it's useless to think so much.
He has been reborn, and everything has changed accordingly. You can't force it, you can only let nature take its course.
Xu Shiyan relieved himself in his heart, and no longer entangled in the things of his previous life.
Treasure what is in front of you, love your wife, and raise a few children, that's enough.
"Third brother, have you named the two little guys?" At this time, Xu Shiqin suddenly asked.
Xu Shiyan looked down at the two babies who were still sleeping soundly, "The girl's name is Xu Jinhui, and the kid's name is Xu Haiqing."
Before, Xu Shiyan was looking forward to being a daughter, and only thought of her name.
In the previous life, the second daughter was named Xu Jinmei, and when combined with the eldest daughter's name, it always reminded me of a famous book, and those who knew them always laughed at them.
In this life, the child is no longer the same, and the name has also been changed to Wisdom Hui.
As for the son, let alone, it must be changed. The name Xu Haiqing sounds good too, so let’s just leave it at that.
Zhou Guilan and Xu Shiqin didn't say anything after hearing this.
When a father loves to name his child whatever he likes, no one else cares about it. Anyway, what Xu Shiyan gave is not bad, it sounds good, so don’t pick it, let’s do it this way.
"Okay, since the name has been chosen, you can go to the team another day and register the child's household registration."
"My sixth son and I are here to take care of you, so hurry up and call your father-in-law to announce the good news.
And your elder brother, the fourth and the fifth, you should notify if there is a need. Our family has never had a pair before, happy event. "
Zhou Guilan looked at the two children, feeling happy, and urged Xu Shiyan to report the good news.
Xu Shiyan nodded as he said, and hurriedly found a place to call to announce the good news.
After that, I went home and boiled a basket of eggs, dyed them red with red paper, and rode up the mountain to announce the good news.
When Mr. Xu heard that the third daughter-in-law had given birth to a pair, he was so happy that he couldn't close his mouth.
"Come on, you, hurry down to take care of your wife's confinement, you don't need to worry about anything on the mountain for a while.
At the other end of the farm, you should hurry up and arrange to understand.
Yingzi has lived with you on the mountain for such a long time, and now she has given birth to two more babies. This time, she has to be confinement to take care of her. "
In the past two years, life has gone smoothly, and Xu Chenghou's temper has also changed. He is very kind to his third son and third daughter-in-law.
It is no longer like before, always talking with a gloomy face and stinging.
"Well, I see, Dad, then I will go back first, and I will come up to pick you up another day to take you home to see the child."
In the past few years, the relationship between father and son has improved a lot, but it is rare to quarrel and start a fire like before.
Xu Shiyan talked to his father a few words, then went around to two other places to look at Shenxiaofang, and found Yang Chunming and Zhao Jianshe.
Give them some red eggs, and tell them about the family affairs, and tell them to pay more attention and take good care of the participants so that nothing goes wrong.
"Congratulations to the third brother, happy to have twins, really awesome, good luck, have two sons."
Zhao Jianshe's daughter-in-law gave birth to two daughters in succession, and he wanted to have another son.
But in the current situation, I am not too daring, and I am afraid that another girl will come out.
So when I heard that Xu Shiyan had a son and a daughter in his family, I was so envious.
"Third brother, the two children in front of your house didn't have a full moon wine.
This time, I will add two at once. Shouldn’t we have a full moon wine, and invite everyone to have a meal to celebrate? "
Yang Chunming's family has sons and daughters, but he doesn't envy him much. He is just happy for Xu Shiyan.
At this time, it is nice to have four children.
"Don't even think about placing the full moon wine. I'm fine if I don't get punished. I don't dare to be too embarrassing."
Xu Shiyan shook his head and smiled wryly. Thanks to Yu Shou Guangming's covert protection, he didn't cause any trouble.
The child landed safely now, so don’t make too much noise, the team and the commune just turn a blind eye and it’s over.
If he was slamming wine and entertaining guests, he would definitely be in trouble if someone stabbed him out.
The household registration of the two children has not yet been registered, so I dare not make any announcements.
"Yes, yes, third brother is still thoughtful, don't fool around."
In these years, Zhao Jianshe left the big house and grew up a lot without the protection of his own father.
Speaking and doing things are not as straightforward as before, I know I have thought more.
"After a while, I will invite the brothers to drink. These days, I will ask the brothers. I must keep the place."
It’s definitely not okay to hold a full moon banquet, but no one can control my brothers getting together to drink.
Xu Shiyan had thought about it a long time ago, waiting for a while to find an opportunity to call these people who have a good relationship together.
It's good wine and good food all the time, and it's not about celebrating, it's just a gathering of brothers, and no one has anything to say.
"Third brother, don't worry, we are on the mountain, and we will take good care of them."
It is related to work points, no one will be careless.
In the past two years, the outside has gradually become chaotic. Zhao Jianshe and the others are all cautious, for fear that people who enter the venue will lose their clubs.
Xu Shiyan didn't stay on the mountain for long, so after giving instructions, he hurried away on his bicycle and went straight to the farm.
The original article attracted the attention of the leaders above.
Xu Shiyan's small farm has also been established as a model for the development of new rural economic law and animal husbandry.
With the support of leaders at all levels, a site was specially approved for Xu Shiyan to develop his breeding business.
The farm was not selected in the village, but in the mountains of Dadongtou, Donggang Commune, not far from the upper reaches of the Huangni River.
There used to be a big paozi over there. After Xu Shiyan contracted it, he cleaned up the paozi again, and brought water from the Yellow Ni River to make the paozi have running water.
Then put in a lot of fish fry and keep them as feed for otters and other animals.
The area of ​​the farm is not small, dozens of acres, apart from the animal breeding area, there is also a large area of ​​feed planting.
Mainly plant pasture, dandelion, bitter herbs, carrots, etc., and reserve them as feed supplements in winter.
In the animal breeding area, the outermost circle is made of wooden sticks, and the inside is barbed wire.
Both the deer park and the musk park were blocked by barbed wire fences more than three meters high. These two types of animals are very good at jumping. If the barbed wire fence is short, it is easy to jump out and run away.
The otter garden is closer to the pond, which is convenient for feeding fresh miscellaneous fish and ensures the healthy growth of otters.
Each group of otters has a dedicated activity area, and each enclosure has a small pool for otters to play.
Xu Shiyan is researching marmot breeding technology. If successful, there will be no need to build ponds and reduce breeding costs.
Other sable gardens and raccoon dog gardens are all in individual iron cages, leaving a certain space for the animals inside to move around, and there are also special rest areas and feeding areas.
Apart from these, Xu Shiyan also raised a lot of sheep, chickens, geese and other poultry.
Sheep are mainly milked to make milk tofu to feed sables, and chickens and geese are naturally reserved as feed for carnivores such as sables.

chapters.title: Chapter 208: farm
chapters.content:
Chapter 208 Farm
At present, there are about 60 otters in the farm.
This thing breeds fast, and it can give birth to many in one litter. It is also sturdy, and it is easy to feed.
The number of sables is less, about twenty.
The main reason is that the gestation period of the female mink is too long, she only has one litter a year, and her fecundity is weak.
There are fifteen adult male musk deer, six female musk deer and more than ten juvenile musk deer in the musk park.
The adult musk deer are all captured by Xu Shiyan in winter with people, and the juvenile musk deer are bred after the female musk deer arrives at the farm.
There are more than 30 deer, more than 10 male deer, and the rest are female deer and young deer.
Needless to say, these deer were naturally captured by Xu Shiyan using the old method, drugged and stunned, and then transported to the farm.
There were fewer raccoon dogs, and it was not easy to catch them alive. Xu Shiyan spent a lot of effort, and only managed to catch seven or eight of them.
I'm not in a hurry, I'm raising and breeding slowly, and the scale will expand in the future.
After two years of exploration and research, Xu Shiyan has become very proficient in breeding these economic animals.
From feed ratio, to disease prevention, to breeding and breeding, we have accumulated a lot of experience, and the scale of breeding is gradually expanding.
At the farm, Huang Shengli, Feng Chao, and Sun Xiaofeng took turns on duty, and hired a few blind men to work.
The so-called blind drifters are not hooligans. It is the Northeast region, from the 1960s and 1970s to the mid-1990s, a certain type of special group of people.
The three northeastern provinces are located outside the Shanhaiguan Pass, and have always been called Guanwai or Guandong, while Shandong, Hebei and other places are called Guanli or Guannei.
Guanli is densely populated and has little land, while outside the Guanli is sparsely populated, fertile and rich in products.
Since the end of the Qing Dynasty, in every disaster year, many people in the pass left their homes and came to live outside the pass. This is the reason for entering the pass.
In the old society, people who came to the east of the Guandong came to work for the landlords at first.
Gradually save money and start a family business, most of them settled in the Northeast.
After the new society, especially after the establishment of the commune, due to the restrictions on household registration, many people from Guanli were unable to settle in the Northeast.
Can't earn work points, can't get rations, have no house and land, so they are called blind wanderers by the locals.
This situation will continue until the mid-1990s.
The Northeast gradually declined, while the Guanli was developed, the economic situation improved, and a large number of wanderers returned to their hometowns. These were also the last batch of people who entered the Guandong.
A few years ago, there was still an operation to catch blind people here. Once caught, they would be sent back.
In the past two years, with the change of policy, more people came to Guanli, and the arrest here is not so strict.
But these homeless people have no house, no land, and can't find a job. Their lives are pretty bad.
Xu Shiyan asked for help, and hired five or six strong young men to work on the farm.
There is no need to pay much salary, just take care of the food.
The farm was established by Xu Shiyan, Feng Chao, Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng and others.
Xu Shiyan provides technology and initial population, accounting for more shares.
Feng Chao and others assisted in the management, took turns to be on duty, and accounted for less shares.
At present, the farm is still in the period of accumulation and development, with large input and low output.
Sables, otters, and raccoon dogs are all expanding their populations, and they are temporarily unprofitable, only antler and musk are produced.
Thanks to the strong support from above, coupled with the low labor cost, there can be some profits.
After two years, the population will be fully developed, and it will be better.
"Brother Xu, why are you here?"
It was Huang Shengli who was on duty at the farm today. Huang Shengli was quite surprised to see Xu Shiyan coming over.
"Victory, I'm coming to see the farm.
Your sister-in-law gave birth to a pair of twins today. I have to take care of your sister-in-law at home recently, and I can’t take care of the farm. "
Xu Shiyan saw Huang Shengli, and quickly gave him some red eggs.
"Oh, my sister-in-law is too good, isn't she? She gave birth to a pair of twins.
Brother Xu, you are really blessed, congratulations. Oh, what a happy event.
Brother Xu, don’t worry, there are me, Chaozi, and Xiaofeng at the farm, we will take good care of it, so you can go home and take care of your sister-in-law. "
Huang Shengli was also happy when he heard it, and hurriedly patted his chest to ensure that the farm must be well managed and nothing will go wrong.
"Well, we have been brothers for several years, and I can trust you.
Well, I’ll go around first, and distribute the eggs to those workers along the way. Everyone is very happy. "
Xu Shiyan patted Huang Shengli on the shoulder.
After getting along for several years, Xu Shiyan is very clear about the character of these people.
If it weren't for the fact that they knew each other well and got along well, Xu Shiyan wouldn't have allowed them to invest in the farm.
Xu Shiyan walked around the farm and distributed the red eggs to the blind workers who were working.
Actually, the conditions have gotten better in recent years. Members all raise chickens at home, and occasionally they can eat an egg or something.
The farm also raised some chickens and geese, which produced a lot of eggs, but most of them were sold.
Eating scrambled eggs for these workers is regarded as improving their lives. Boiled eggs are Qingming and Dragon Boat Festival, and each person can give two.
Xu Shiyan distributed three red eggs to each of them, and everyone was very happy, carefully put them in their pockets, and kept them to eat slowly.
"Work hard, and at the end of the year, I will give you some rewards or something.
Our farm is making less profit now. After two years, when it becomes more profitable, I will raise your wages.
It’s not easy for you who have left your hometown to come outside the customs. Work hard, and you can’t lose. "Xu Shiyan had to say something encouraging.
Xu Shiyan's words are not a big deal.
He had already discussed with Huang Shengli and the others, and at the end of the year, they should be given a proper salary increase.
It’s not easy for these people. Those who leave their hometowns come out to earn a living, and the money they earn from a year’s hard work has to be sent back to their hometowns, and they are left with nothing to eat and drink.
These people are very hardworking and willing to contribute. It would be best if they can stay in the farm for a long time.
No matter what year it is, if you want to keep someone, you have to raise the salary. Once the money is paid, they will naturally not be willing to leave.
Those few people were very grateful when they heard the words, and expressed in strong Guanli dialect that they must work harder and promise to work hard.
Xu Shiyan walked around the farm and saw that the animals in each pen were doing well, so he was relieved.
So, he led a ewe that had just given birth to a calf, and walked back.
Su Anying gave birth to two babies at once, and she didn't know if she could drink milk.
Furthermore, Su Anying's body is badly short, so she should make up for it.
Get a ewe and come back to milk the goat. In case the mother's milk is not enough, there is still goat milk.
If there is enough breast milk, then save it for Su Anying to replenish her body, it will be useful anyway.
Xu Shiyan **** the sheep when he got home, and then went to the hospital.
As a result, I just entered the inpatient department, and before I reached the door of the ward, I heard the cry of a child coming from the ward.
Opening the door and entering the room, Xu Shiqin and Zhou Guilan were holding a baby and coaxing them there.
"Mom, what's wrong? The two children are crying so hard?"
Xu Shiyan opened the door and entered the ward, and looked at the bed, Su Anying seemed to be sleeping.
Su Anying had a lot of trouble giving birth this time, exhausted, and fell asleep after lunch.
The two children cried so loudly that they didn't wake her up.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: Difficult to coax
chapters.content:
Chapter 209 Difficult to Coax
"It should be hungry, Yingzi is weak, and I don't know when she will have milk.
I just fed them some glucose water, it didn’t matter, didn’t they cry again? "
Zhou Guilan hugged her grandson to coax her, while whispering to her son.
"These two children are not as good as Yuanyuan and Pingping when they were young. Whenever one of them cries, the other immediately follows."
Two babies are much more difficult to coax than one. They cry when they urinate, cry when they are hungry, and cry whenever they feel a little uncomfortable, and one cries and the other promises to cry too.
Zhou Guilan and Xu Shiqin have not been idle this afternoon, and they were utterly battered and flustered by the two children.
"Mom, don't worry, I brought a ewe back, and it's been a few days since it gave birth.
In this way, I went back to milking and cooking, and put it in a bottle to feed the child.
For the time being, deal with them so that they don’t cry, and see when Yingzi can have milk. "
At this time, Xu Shiyan was particularly thankful that he had thought a little more.
Otherwise, it will be dark soon, and he has to go to the farm again, so that people are not tired and things will be delayed.
"Then you are not in a hurry? The two children were born in the morning, and they haven't had milk yet."
When Zhou Guilan heard this, she hurriedly urged her son to go back to milk the goat.
There is no way, there is Su Anying, a pregnant woman living in the maternity ward of the hospital, and she wants to find someone else to excuse her because she doesn't have milk.
There is a woman in the village who just gave birth not long ago, but Zhou Guilan and her daughter are inseparable.
Su Anying fell asleep, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping were also here. If their mother and daughter went out with their children, no one would take care of them.
"Mom, little sister, you two will take care of you here first, and I will take the two little ones back.
Pingping, Yuanyuan, go home with Dad, let’s milk our younger siblings. "
As Xu Shiyan said, he picked up his daughter, and Xu Haiyuan directly stretched out his little hand for his father to lead, and the three of them left the hospital and walked home.
Fortunately, the hospital was close to home, and when he got home soon, Xu Shiyan quickly found two pieces of candy and gave them to the two children.
You have to coax these two first, and don't make trouble, so that Xu Shiyan can work with peace of mind.
No matter what age, children are not immune to candy, and the two children were very happy when they got candy.
"Thank you, Dad." Xu Jinping didn't forget to hug Xu Shiyan and kiss her to express her gratitude.
"Eat sweets obediently, dad goes to work. Candy wrappers can't be peeled off, so ask brother for help."
Oops, the old father's heart just melted into a mess.
However, Xu Shiyan did not take the initiative to pick up candy paper for the child, but entrusted the important task to his son.
The purpose, of course, is to increase the difficulty.
No matter how smart Xu Haiyuan is, after all, he is small and his hands are not flexible enough.
It takes a bit of work just to pick out the candy wrappers of the two pieces of candy. The two children have something to do, so they won't make trouble.
The bad-hearted father threw the pot to his son like this, took the household items to milk the milk, and waited for him to milk the goat milk, just in time for Xu Haiyuan to peel off the candy wrapper of his own piece of candy and put it in his mouth.
As for Xu Jinping, my brother took out the candy wrappers for her first, and now the little girl has candy in her mouth, so it tastes delicious.
Xu Shiyan set up two horizontal bricks in front of the stove pit and lit the firewood.
Put the small aluminum pot on two bricks, boil the goat milk, let it cool, and pour it into the bottle.
Then, Xu Shiyan picked up his daughter, led his son, and sent the two children to the Sun's house next door, asking Sun Xiaofeng's daughter-in-law to take care of them for a while.
After the two children were settled, Xu Shiyan went to the hospital.
Going to the hospital, Su Anying was woken up by the crying of the child, and was holding the child to feed her.
But she was weak and hadn't had any milk yet, so the two babies had no milk after gnawing. After a few mouthfuls, they became unhappy and continued to cry.
"Hey, my little ancestor, don't cry, you can hear your movements in the whole pediatric hospital. Come, your dad has milk here."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly handed a baby bottle to Zhou Guilan, hugged a baby himself, and nursed it carefully.
Hungry baby, who cares if it's goat's milk or something? It's nice to have something to drink.
Gudu Gudu drank a lot, and now I finally stopped crying.
The two babies ate and drank enough, patted and hiccupped, and fell asleep not long after, Zhou Guilan and others were relieved.
"Yingzi, sleep a little longer, I'll go back and cook for you."
Zhou Guilan saw that it was not early, so she carefully placed the child beside Su Anying, and then hurried home to cook with Xu Shiqin.
The arrival of the dragon and phoenix caught everyone in the Xu family by surprise.
The two babies are particularly fussy. They cry together when they want to cry, eat together when they want to eat, and urinate at about the same time, but whoever takes a step behind will definitely cry with his throat open.
The four adults of the Xu family, who were tossed about by the two children, were in a hurry.
At least I persisted for two days. On the third morning, I went through the discharge procedures and went home.
In addition, Su Anying also had milk, and the two babies were breastfed, but they were not as noisy as before.
Fortunately, last autumn, Xu Shiyan caught some hens on the mountain and picked up a lot of snow clam oil.
This stuff is a great tonic, and it has a good effect on postpartum weakness, and it can also promote breast milk. Even if two babies are breastfed, they can supply it.
Su Anying's mother and son had just arrived home and settled down, but Su Weizhong and his wife brought their five and six children here.
"I heard that Yingzi gave birth to a pair of twins, how can I calm down? I discussed with your mother-in-law, come over early to see, and try to help the leader.
These two children are not easy to serve, and there are not enough people. "
Su Weizhong couldn't go into the back room to see his daughter, so he sat between Dongci and talked to Xu Shiyan.
"This time, let the sixth child stay and help Yingzi take care of the children for a while.
Otherwise, with your four children, the two younger ones must be difficult to take care of. Yingzi and her in-laws alone are too busy. "
Su’s six daughters, the third married the winter of the year before last to Lao Nan’s family in Daying Village, and the fourth married Shuanglong last winter.
The fifth child is nineteen this year, and the sixth child is seventeen this year. Both of them have finished junior high school, failed to pass any exams, and can only work in the team.
The eldest son, Su Anhua, is young and has been favored since childhood. The work in the field is mediocre, and he earns few work points.
What Su Weizhong meant was that he wanted Su Anhua to come over and help his sister take care of the children, so it could be regarded as sharing some of the burden for Su Anying.
"Oh, that's a good thing."
Xu Shiyan was overjoyed when he heard this. Now he wished for more help from the family.
Su Anying is in confinement, Xu Shiqin still has to go to work, and there is still a lot of work here.
Xu Shiyan couldn't stay at home for confinement and not work for a month.
If he goes up the mountain, Zhou Guilan will be pointed at by his family to work alone.
When the family was short of staff, the father-in-law offered to ask his sister-in-law to come and help, which was just in time.
Weng son-in-law for so many years, Xu Shiyan knew his father-in-law's temper, and never said those foolish things, so he was not polite.
"Then thank you, dad, and my sixth sister, oh, to tell you the truth, I'm still worried.
Yingzi is in confinement, and she has two children at once. My side is both a farmer and a farmer, so I can't take care of it. "
My father-in-law helped solve the big problem, so Xu Shiyan naturally wanted to express his gratitude.
"My family, why are you being polite?
Hua'er was brought up by Yingzi, and now she is here to help her second sister look after the child, isn't that what it should be? "
Su Weizhong waved his hand and smiled.
Dear readers, it will be updated at 7:00 tomorrow morning. Please support the author a lot and support genuine reading. Welcome to Qidian Chinese website to read the latest chapters.

chapters.title: Chapter 210: lecture
chapters.content:
Chapter 210 Lectures
The father-in-law and mother-in-law brought their sister-in-law to see Huanxi, and Xu Shiyan must entertain them well.
Fortunately, the living conditions are much better now than before. Songjianghe can buy everything. Tickets are not required for many things, but they are more expensive.
For Xu Shiyan, it was not a problem at all. He pulled all kinds of food back and made a big table of delicious dishes.
The joy of coaxing her father-in-law and mother-in-law, she praised Su Anying for her good fortune.
Su Weizhong is the production team leader. The team is busy at this time, so we can't delay too long, so we go home the next day.
Mr. Han stayed at Xu's house for a week, helping to take care of Su Anying and the child.
With the help of Han's mother and daughter, Zhou Guilan was finally able to relax a lot, and Xu Shiqin hurried back to work.
Han lived for a week, thinking about her family, and left too.
Only the sixth son, Su Anhua, was left behind to help take care of Su Anying and the children.
Before leaving, Mrs. Han also urged Su Anhua to have sharp eyesight and help with work more.
Su Anhua agreed, and Han finally left in peace.
In June, the ginseng field has to be busy with a lot of work, and there is also the task of preparing fertilizer for the ginseng field.
Xu Shiyan is now not only a participatory technician of the Second Brigade, but also a participatory technical consultant of Donggang Commune. He really can't stop serving confinement at home.
Last year, Xiaoheihe ginseng field started to produce ginseng for the first time.
The two-hundred-foot-long mallet that was tested at the beginning, was applied with base fertilizer and top-dressing fertilizer, and the post-management was added to keep up.
Yizhang produces 25 catties of water ginseng, which is more than 50% higher than the original output.
The ginseng fertilization test of the second group was successful, and the output broke through the record high.
This is a great thing, how can Yu Shouguang hide it? Even if he wanted to hide it, he couldn't hide it.
Besides, this is a great achievement, and Yu Shouguang was a fool to hide it.
I immediately reported it to the higher authorities, and then the whole Erdonggang Commune and even the county knew about it.
The county specially sent people to investigate and verify, and they went up the mountain together.
I saw with my own eyes that a big mallet was lifted out of the ground, and it was weighed on the spot. It weighed 24 to 5 catties, and in some areas it could even weigh 26 to 7 catties.
This is a big deal, and the people sent by the county immediately reported it.
Then the Agricultural Bureau, Ginseng Antler Company, Specialty Products Bureau and other departments all sent people over to ask about the specific formula of ginseng fertilizer and other related matters.
Xu Shiyan, as the ginseng technician of the second team and the specific person in charge of ginseng fertilizer, is of course responsible for explaining to the superiors.
At this time, the fertilizer formula must no longer be hidden.
At the beginning, Xu Shiyan told Zhao Dahai that he heard someone mention it on the train, so it is naturally difficult to change his words at this time.
He only said that topdressing with bean cake water was inspired by listening to the conversations of others. As for the preparation of mixed fertilizers with bean cakes, perilla seeds and Guoshi, he researched it himself.
In this way, it is easier to win people's trust, and it also prevents inconsistencies in the rhetoric from leading to suspicion.
When the formula was made public, people from relevant departments immediately took some samples of the fertilizer prepared by Xu Shiyan and sent them to the Provincial Agricultural College, where experts and professors were invited to come for laboratory analysis.
After a while, news came back, confirming that the formula is indeed effective.
In addition to the fact that the output of the second team is there, no one doubts it.
So, an article about Donggang Commune No. 2 Brigade participating in agriculture, Comrade Xu Shiyan, dedicated to the public, dare to think and do, and have the courage to practice. Arm your mind with scientific knowledge, research and develop compound fertilizers for ginseng, and increase production and income.
After Xu Shixian's pen, it finally appeared in major newspapers in the county, city, and province.
Originally, Xu Shiyan was well-known among the county leaders because of his wildlife breeding, and he was a key object of care.
This time, the special fertilizer for ginseng came out again, and the good news that the production increased by 50% was developed by Xu Shiyan again.
When the county leaders found out about it, they greatly affirmed Xu Shiyan's contribution.
Be aware that wildlife farming is still in its infancy.
It may take more than ten years to develop to a certain scale and be able to drive the county economy.
But this special fertilizer for ginseng is different. The whole Fusong, no, it should be said that together with Fusong’s surroundings, how many places are pointing to planting ginseng to develop the economy?
If all fertilizers are used, the production will increase by 50% in three years. If all the ginseng fields in a county are added up, how much will the production be increased? Who is not moved?
County leaders unanimously approved the selection of the second brigade of Donggang Commune as the advanced collective in August 1981.
Xu Shiyan was selected as an advanced producer, a model worker, and a production model in the industry.
At the beginning of spring this year in March, Xu Shiyan also went to the county to attend the commendation meeting.
The county leaders personally presented awards, wore big red flowers, and asked Xu Shiyan to speak on stage to share the preparation technology of ginseng fertilizer.
Since Xu Shiyan has disclosed the formula, he will naturally not be stingy in teaching the technique.
But the commendation conference has a time limit, and some things cannot be understood by words, but must be practiced.
So Xu Shiyan briefly talked about it, and then said, in June and July, the fertilizers of the second brigade will be fermented, welcome to visit and learn.
After getting off the podium, Xu Shiyan was surrounded by the leaders of the communes, local communes participating in the venue, and several state-owned participating venues belonging to the county.
All asked Xu Shiyan politely about the specific technology of fertilizer preparation, and wanted to hire Xu Shiyan to give technical guidance in the past.
Xu Shiyan still has the same attitude, no matter where he is, he can send people to learn.
If it is really inconvenient, he has brought many apprentices here, and he can also send people to give technical guidance at that time.
After all, Xu Shiyan is alone, without eight legs, so he can't walk in so many places.
So, in June, everyone called to inquire.
Donggang gave the specific time, on June 10th, work will start here, and you can come to study.
On the 10th, Donggang Commune borrowed the large classroom on the fourth floor of the newly built Donggang High School and arranged for Xu Shiyan to give lectures to students from all over the world.
Specifically introduce the specific operation process of ginseng fertilizer, as well as some related production increasing techniques and so on.
“Ginseng soil fertilizer can be divided into two types: base fertilizer and top dressing.
Basic fertilizer is the base fertilizer, there are several methods.
The first type uses bean cakes to be crushed and fermented, and is applied separately as a base fertilizer, and about one catty of fermented bean cake powder is used per foot.
After three years, the production of water ginseng can be increased by about 10 to 20%. "
Xu Shiyan had already prepared the relevant materials, so he didn’t panic at all when he gave a lecture on stage. He listed them one by one and explained them one by one.
"The second type is perilla base fertilizer.
Fry the perilla seeds and crush them, mix with five to six catties of fine soil per catty, and spread the perilla seed base fertilizer evenly on the roots when planting ginseng.
Using about half a catty of perilla per zhang will increase production by 20% after three years. "
“The third type is deer manure base fertilizer, fully decomposed deer manure, finely poured, and mixed into the ginseng soil when pouring the soil.
Applying about ten catties of deer dung per foot of ginseng soil can increase production by 35% after three years. "
"The fourth type is mixed fertilizer, fried perilla seeds are crushed, stone crushed and fermented, bean cake powder is decomposed and dried in the sun, kang cave soil.
Mix evenly in the ratio of two, two, two, and four, and pile up for secondary fermentation.
Use about four catties per zhang, and increase production by 25 to 30 percent after three years. "
"If there is no kang soil, peat soil can be used, but attention should be paid to killing insects and the secondary fermentation time will be longer.
The insect eggs and germs in the peat soil are fully killed to ensure that ginseng is free from pests and diseases. "
The above recipes and data are from county annals. My family used to mainly use bean cakes, and Suzi used less.

chapters.title: Chapter 211: recipe open
chapters.content:
Chapter 211 Recipe disclosure
Since Xu Shiyan decided to disclose the formula, he naturally wouldn't hide it.
In view of the different conditions of each commune and participation in the field, it is impossible to use one kind of fertilizer for all, so Xu Shiyan told everyone the methods he knew.
Anyway, after listening to it, they can choose the appropriate method by themselves.
This still has to be tailored to local conditions and choose according to your own conditions.
"There are also several methods of top dressing.
The first kind of bean cake powder is fermented with water, and the basic ratio is one catty of bean cake powder to five catties of water.
Using 30 to 40 jin of bean cake water per foot, combined with base fertilizer, can basically increase production by 50%. "
"The second type is topdressing with decomposed deer manure on the root side.
When loosening the soil for the first time, apply fully decomposed and finely poured deer manure into the furrows, about 20 catties per foot. "
"The third type, superphosphate root topdressing.
Mix calcium superphosphate in humus soil to fully ferment, and spread evenly between the ginseng rows when loosening the soil for the first time. "
“There is another method, root topdressing, which can also be understood as foliar fertilizer.
Two catties of calcium superphosphate mixed with twenty catties of water, soaked overnight and filtered, sprayed on ginseng stems and leaves around four o'clock in the afternoon.
It can be sprayed three times during the growth period of a year. The first time is after the ginseng leaves are fully unfolded, the second time is at the green fruit stage, and the third time is after the fruit is harvested.
The ginseng leaves that have been applied with foliar fertilizer grow well, and the leaves are dark green, which can promote photosynthesis.
Make ginseng rhizomes more nourished, and make up for the lack of pulp caused by leaving ginseng seeds. "
These are all the experience Xu Shiyan accumulated in his previous life. He has tried it in the second brigade in the past few years, and it is obviously effective.
It took a whole morning to explain these few articles in detail, and those who came to study also wrote down several pages in their notebooks.
At noon, these people were arranged to eat in the high school cafeteria.
No one said a treat, they all took food stamps and money and went to the cafeteria window to get food.
Xu Shiyan didn't eat with these people, his home is in Donggang, why bother to eat in the cafeteria?
"Third brother, you really taught them the technology for nothing? Isn't this too cheap for them?
We took several years of work and slowly tested it out. "
On the way back, Zhao Jianshe asked rather puzzled.
At the beginning, Xu Shiyan led Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming and others to teach them to experiment with various fertilizers.
It can be said that after several years of training, Zhao Jianshe and others have mastered relevant technologies proficiently.
So in this lecture, Xu Shiyan specifically told Yu Shouguang to arrange for people to go up to the mountain to see the ginseng, and replace Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming.
At the other end of the farm, Feng Chao and others were also asked to find family members to replace them for a few days, and all of them came to attend the class.
The most important thing is that they will be sent to various places as technicians next.
No matter how good the theory is, no matter how carefully you listen to the lectures, if you don’t have practical experience, you can’t master the key steps of fermentation, and you need someone to guide you personally.
"What else is there? Our family is not rich, it's good that everyone is rich and strong.
An industry can only occupy a pivotal position in related fields and have the right to speak only if it develops as a whole and its scale becomes larger and larger. "
Xu Shiyan smiled. He couldn't tell much about the truth, but he knew that the ginseng industry was related to the economic development of the entire county.
He is an old farmer, not very capable, and has accumulated this little experience in his previous life.
If he can have some effect on the society, it can be considered that he has not been reborn in vain.
"Third brother is still very enlightened, we have to study hard from third brother in the future."
Zhao Jianshe seems to understand, but he understands a truth, following Xu Shiyan, will never suffer.
So no matter what Xu Shiyan does, they will fully support it.
"Starting tomorrow, these people will have to see how we lose weight.
I guess they may not understand it from this point of view. At that time, I guess you will have to go to various communes as technical guides.
So you have to listen carefully in the afternoon, just as a review, and don’t let our team lose the chain when you go out. "
Xu Shiyan still has confidence in the brothers. After all, he has been leading them for several years, so it's time to become apprentices.
When several people heard this, they all stared, "Really? Really let us do technical guidance? Oh, that would be great."
Go out to give technical guidance to other places, get high work points, pay well, and don't have to do much work, how great.
"Third brother, why don't you go?"
"I won't go too far. Your sister-in-law at home is not yet confinement. I will guide you to the nearest one, the commune, and the brigades."
Xu Shiyan can't take all the limelight by himself. Since they are brothers, there is no need to worry about it so much.
As if staying at home, Xu Shiyan doesn't care about these.
Several people talked and laughed, and they arrived near Xu's house, so they separated and went home.
As soon as Xu Shiyan entered the gate, the daughter who was playing in the yard rushed over, "Father."
The little girl loves to be hugged by her father, and she opens her little arms as soon as they meet. Her big watery eyes are full of expectation, waiting for her father to hug her.
How could Xu Shiyan refuse his daughter's request, he immediately bent down and reached out, picked up his daughter and hugged her in his arms.
Girls are different from boys. What Xu Haiyuan liked most at that time was riding on his father's neck.
When it comes to Xu Jinping's place, girls are timid and afraid of heights, and most of them will be satisfied after hugging them.
"Is Pingping good this morning?" Xu Shiyan hugged his daughter and asked as he walked into the house.
"Be good, be good, Bao is the best."
Xu Jinping patted her chest with her chubby hands and assured her father that she was a good baby.
"Well, just be good, our Pingping is the most obedient baby, right?
Mom has to take care of her younger siblings now, Pingping can't be naughty, she has to be good. "
Xu Shiyan kissed his daughter on the cheek and praised her a few words.
At this time, Xu Haiyuan who was playing in the yard also came over, "Dad, my brother and sister are not good, they always cry."
This kid can speak well, and he even knows how to file a complaint.
Xu Shiyan bent down and picked up his son, one in each hand.
"Well, my brother and sister are too young, so they are definitely not as good as you two.
You two are grown up, as older brothers and sisters, you should take care of them more. "
I don’t know if it’s because Su Anying spends most of her time on the mountain after she became pregnant, lacking enough nutrition, anyway, these two little ones are not as easy to coax as the first two.
Crying when they are hungry, crying when they pee, crying when they are stretched, or any big movement at home can make them cry.
Zhou Guilan said that it may be that the two youngsters were having confinement, and there are such children.
Xu Shiyan has no good solution, he can only take a look at it first, if he is still making trouble after confinement, he has to go to the hospital to have a look, if there is something missing, make up for it quickly.
While talking, Xu Shiyan carried one of them into the room with one hand. Just at this time, Su Anhua was cooking in the kitchen, and he heard the movement and looked out.
"Second brother-in-law is back, oh my god, it's really okay to hold them back one by one.
Hurry up and take a break in the house, just wait for the meal. "
Su Anhua and Zhou Guilan switch, one cooks and the other takes care of the children, otherwise, the two children will be tossed so hard that they won't even be able to eat.

chapters.title: Chapter 212: looking for help
chapters.content:
Chapter 212 Looking for a helper
After one day of lectures, the practical operation started on the second day.
Bean cake powder and other raw materials are all crushed early in the morning. This is not a technology, and now every commune has mills or something, so crushing is not a problem.
The most important thing is the ratio of raw materials, and accurate grasp of the degree of fermentation.
If the fermentation is light, it will not work, and the fertilizer will easily burn the beards of the mallet, resulting in a reduction in production.
Fermentation is not enough, nutrition is lost, and the expected goal cannot be achieved.
But this fermentation process takes a long time, and these people who come to study cannot stay here forever.
There is no other way, but according to Xu Shiyan's wishes, the second brigade sent out a few technical instructors to follow up and guide the teaching.
Now, several communes almost fought for the technicians.
No way, Xu Shiyan has only brought out five of Zhao Jianshe and the others in the past few years. There are so many communes and participants in the county, and they cannot be separated.
Finally, everyone discussed and decided that each of Zhao Jianshe and the others would lead two communes.
So, the two neighboring communes negotiated to pick up a technician. From June to September, he will follow up and guide the whole process, manage food and housing, and give double work points.
Just like that, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming and others went home happily, packed their luggage, and went out to work as technical directors.
As for Xu Shiyan, he stayed in Donggang Commune to guide the first team, the commune team, the first team, and the third team.
In this way, Xiao Heihe had no choice but to find someone else.
Yu Shouguang picked four old men in their fifties from the Second Brigade to go up, and they all obeyed Xu Chenghou's command.
Fortunately, the other end of the Xiaohei River is far away from the Songjiang River. In addition, ground guns and cannons are very useful, and few people dare to go there.
Several old men were on the mountain as companions, walking the field twice at night and catching fish during the day.
Occasionally a pheasant and a rabbit can improve life. Although it is not as good as when Xu Shiyan was on the mountain, it is not bad.
But the farm is a bit troublesome. Huang Shengli and the others have gone out, and there is no one to look after them.
Those blind wanderers can do their jobs, but there must be a reliable person in charge.
After thinking about it, Xu Shiyan went to find his second brother Xu Shian.
Compared to the smooth sailing and rapid rise of the boss in the past few years, the second child Xu Shi'an can only be said to be mediocre.
The vegetable team has not developed more and more in the past few years, and the Forestry Bureau directly dumped several subordinate vegetable teams to the town.
With the opening of the market in the past two years, small businesses and hawkers are allowed to trade freely, and the small villages around the Songjiang River also come to sell vegetables, which has a great impact on the vegetable team.
Xu Shian can't earn much money working in the vegetable team, so he simply grows food and vegetables in front of and behind his house.
When choosing a homestead, Xu Shian was optimistic about the large and spacious place here.
After the house is built, there is a large vegetable garden around it, which can cover three or four acres.
Eat the grain at home, and sell the vegetables in the market. After all, it is not less than earning in the vegetable team, and it is free and not controlled by others.
"Second brother, you can help me take care of it for a while.
You don’t need to put in much effort, the main thing is to watch those blind people work.
I’ll go there when I’m free, and we’ll replace each other.
This autumn, I will help you find ginseng seeds and ginseng seeds.
I think the place behind you is quite big, isn’t it? The soil quality here is good, you can earn more if you plan a ten-foot-twenty-foot planting stick than you can grow vegetables. "
Xu Shiyan consulted with his elder brother, and promised to help his second son grow ginseng along the way.
"Third brother, aren't you joking with your brother?" Xu Shian's eyes widened upon hearing this.
He regretted it a long time ago. He should have settled in Donggang in the first place. Planting ginseng can make more money than growing vegetables.
"Can individuals grow ginseng now? This thing is purchased and sold in a unified manner, and the ginseng company does not accept personal sticks."
Growing ginseng is no better than growing vegetables. After all, the vegetables can be sold in the market after all, but not sticks, they are all purchased together.
People only connect with various communes and participating venues, and sell it personally, and do not accept it.
"Second brother, if you believe me, you will be right as I say.
How fast has the situation changed in the past two years? Look at our agricultural team, haven't we started to sub-contract land bit by bit?
If the guarantee is not complete next year, contracting will be completely allowed. At that time, how could there be any difference between public and private? It's okay to keep. "
Last year, the superiors issued instructions that some difficult communes, remote plots, and "chicken mouth" plots around the village can be contracted to households.
No matter what the policy is, it must be implemented step by step, and it is impossible to change it all at once. We must leave room for members to change their ideas.
From autumn of this year to spring of next year, the distribution of land to households will be implemented successively, and in the spring of next year, ginseng land will also be distributed to individuals.
In the future, there will be no talk about communes and individuals. As long as individuals hand in the tasks according to the quota, the rest of the ginseng can be sold freely without restriction.
If it weren't for this, how could Xu Shiyan encourage the second brother to plant the club himself?
"Don't waste your land after planting sticks. I will teach you another trick at that time. The old ginseng planted Gastrodia elata, which has high yield and good quality. Basically, it is no different from wild ones.
Now you know how much Gastrodia is, how troublesome it is to go up the mountain to dig, let’s grow it ourselves. "
If you talk about other things, Xu Shiyan doesn't understand, but if you talk about the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land, he understands.
Last year, Fusong old ginseng field cultivation Gastrodia elata test passed the prefecture-level scientific and technological appraisal.
But this technology has not been able to be promoted, mainly because there are still some defects.
What Xu Shiyan knows is more mature than today's technology, but lacks an experimental base.
In the past few years, Xu Shiyan has been breeding wild animals and preparing fertilizers for ginseng.
If there are benefits, I'd better stick to my brother first, and wait for the real results to come out later.
"That's great. I'll listen to you. Don't forget to take your brother with you when you have something good to do in the future." Xu Shi'an became happy when he heard that.
In the past few years, he has figured out a truth, he must be right to listen to the third child, since the third child said it can be done, then he doesn't need to worry about anything.
"Don't worry, my brother, no matter what happens."
Not for anything else, but for the sake of the two nephews, help the second brother.
In the previous life, the two nephews helped Xu Shiyan a lot.
At that time, Xu Haibo came down to work before graduating from middle school, and drove the shopping station in his backyard.
Xu Shiyan's ginseng planted and planted ginseng here, and Xu Haibo drove the boss's tractor to help with the work.
Xu Shiyan was in a car accident and was hospitalized. The two nephews stayed in the hospital in shifts until Xu Shiyan was discharged.
It would be fine if Xu Shiyan was incompetent, but now he is somewhat useful, reaching out to help the second brother, so that the life of the second brother's family can also be improved.
As long as the second brother is still there, the two nephews will not stop studying early. No matter how good they are at school, they can still go to high school regardless of their registered permanent residence in the Forestry Bureau.
Xu Haibo is ten years old this year. By the time he graduates from high school, the Forestry Bureau will not be in decline.
Even if the child is poor in school and cannot pass the college entrance examination, he can find a way to recruit workers to work in the Forestry Bureau, which is better than in his previous life.
If the child is promising and can pass the exam, that's not to mention.
They can still catch up with the good times, assign work, and get a solid job no matter what, how good is it?
Just like that, Xu Shian happily followed Xu Shiyan to the farm to be on duty, leading the people to work.
The farm is far away from Donggang, but in fact it is close to Sentie. During the day, Xu Shian watches over it, and at night the two brothers take shifts. Everything is normal and nothing goes wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Comprehensive utilization of ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 213 Comprehensive utilization of ginseng land
Xu Shiyan will guide the fertilizer fermentation matters of the first field, the commune field, the first team, and the third team.
It’s okay to talk about other places, after all, the area of ​​ginseng is small, and the amount of fertilizer is not so much.
One ginseng field is not enough, the ginseng area is too large, and there must be a lot of fertilizer.
So Xu Shiyan was the first to go to the first field to guide, and the commune field and the other two brigades sent people to follow them to learn.
Dozens of young men were arranged for the first participation, led by Han Limin, who studied with Xu Shiyan.
These people are at least junior high school graduates, and some of them are high school graduates, all educated, and they can remember each one carefully.
Xu Shiyan gave lectures to these people, but he didn't feel any pressure. There is a specialization in the art field, and a high degree of education does not mean a high level of technology.
"Brother Limin, what is the name of that young man? I look quite young, and he is also a worker in the field?"
During the lunch break, Xu Shiyan looked at a young man who looked less than twenty, and asked Han Limin.
"That's the youngest son of a sub-field leader's family, Li Chengrong.
Graduated from high school last year, did not go to university, so I recruited workers and entered the field. I am nineteen this year. "
Han Limin heard the words, glanced over there, and explained with a smile.
"Oh, oh, what did I say, it looks very gentle, it doesn't look like it's making great efforts." Xu Shiyan nodded.
It turned out to be the head of the first breakout field, so it's no wonder.
"This kid is not bad. Don't look at his gentle and delicate appearance, he is willing to work hard, and he is not squeamish at all. He is also a quick learner.
Our two families live next to each other. We have watched this child grow up since he was a child. He is a good boy.
It's a pity that I failed to perform well in the college entrance examination and failed to enter the university.
Everyone persuaded him to repeat the study, but he refused desperately, so he just came to work. "
Han Limin obviously knew Li Chengrong very well, and there was a little regret in his words.
While talking, Li Chengrong walked over from there and sat beside Han Limin.
"Brother Limin, I heard that you have a very good relationship with Technician Xu, right?
I would like to ask Technician Xu some questions, is it okay? "The young man asked in a low voice with an expression that couldn't be wiped away.
"Then what else? Ask if you want.
Let me tell you, Technician Xu is a very nice person. He praised you just now, saying that you are smart and serious. "
The two families are close neighbors, and Han Limin grew up watching Li Chengrong, just like his own brother, and he had to take care of him a little bit more.
"Shiyan, come, let me introduce you two. This is Xiaoli, my neighbor.
Xiao Li wants to ask you something, if it is convenient for you, you can talk to him. "
Han Limin got up and sat on the side, so that Li Chengrong and Xu Shiyan wouldn't have to communicate through him.
"Hi, Technician Xu, I'm brother Limin's neighbor. Brother Limin watched me grow up."
Li Chengrong was a little shy, raised his hand and scratched his head, and greeted Xu Shiyan with a look of embarrassment.
"Don't call me a technician. I'm a few years older than you. If you don't mind, just call me Brother Xu."
Xu Shiyan is 30 years old this year, ten years older than Li Chengrong, so it's okay to be called brother.
"Well, um, brother Xu, um, I've read the reports about you, that is, the ones about wild animal breeding and special fertilizer for ginseng.
Actually, I want to ask Brother Xu about the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land.
Our current 33-year forestry and ginseng rotation plan, it is quite wasteful if the saplings do not grow for a few years in the middle, is there any way? "
Li Chengrong was encouraged and boldly spoke out about his problems.
Li Chengrong's father is a sub-field leader, and the things he comes into contact with and experience are different from ordinary workers participating in the field.
Besides, his cultural level is higher than others, so the depth of thinking about the problem is naturally different. It is not surprising that he can ask this question.
Xu Shiyan pondered for a moment before speaking.
"Xiao Li, you know, in fact, your brother Xu didn't even finish junior high school, so he doesn't have much education."
Modesty is a virtue, and most people are similar. No matter what you do, first show that your level is limited.
"However, after all, I have been in contact with Shendi for many years.
Besides, I studied medicine from others for a few years, and I don’t know anything else. In terms of medicinal materials, I know a little bit. "
Of course, if you have something in your stomach, you can talk about it.
"Actually, there are indeed some methods for the comprehensive utilization of ginseng.
For example, I mentioned before that in the second year of ginseng, soybeans can be planted, soybeans can be squeezed to eat oil, and bean cakes can be used to feed livestock and be used as ginseng fertilizer.
Then ginseng is fertilized, and the yield increases. This virtuous circle increases the utilization rate of ginseng land. "
Everyone knows this, Xu Shiyan said it, just as a foreshadowing.
"For another example, the technology of growing Gastrodia elata in old ginseng land announced last year can also effectively use waste ginseng land to create economic value.
Besides, the ginseng land is used up, and the forestry department needs to plant trees, so can we work on tree species?
For example, interplanting medicinal materials such as Schisandra seedlings, Polygonatum Polygonatum, and Dilonga?
Also, can we develop small berry shrubs like Dianzao and Dianguo? "
Donggang Yishang was brilliant when it issued shares, and many cadres in the county subscribed for Yishang’s shares.
But after two thousand years, it gradually declined.
The main reason is that after the end of the 33-year plan, there is no place to participate in the venue, so individuals can only find other ways to disintegrate the venue.
But in Xu Shiyan's view, it is also related to the single industrial structure, and there is no other way to go except planting ginseng.
Once the ginseng land is gone, most people can only lose their jobs.
If you can rely on your own advantages to make comprehensive use of ginseng land, try the deep processing of ginseng industry, as well as the deep processing of other medicinal materials and economic crops.
Perhaps, there are different ways out.
Xu Shiyan came back from rebirth. Even though he was in his sixties when he died in his previous life, he had experienced the era of rapid economic development and information explosion after all.
Moreover, the eldest daughter of his family worked as a tour guide, and later opened a mountain shop, selling local specialties of Changbai Mountain.
Xu Shiyan is very clear that those things that are insignificant in the eyes of local people are treasures in the eyes of outsiders.
And these, if used well, any one of them can become a very profitable industry.
Of course, these are Xu Shiyan's whims.
How to develop a field is a matter for the field and county leaders at all levels to consider, and it has nothing to do with him.
"Oh, it's getting late, we have to work quickly.
That, Xiaoli, we can chat slowly when we have time. Not in a hurry. "
While talking, when I raised my wrist, I saw that it was getting late, and there was still a lot of work on the other side.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about chatting with Li Chengrong, so he got up quickly, urging everyone to work quickly.
Han Limin also stood up, and turned to look at Li Chengrong who was still in a daze.
"You boy, are you fascinated by listening to it?
Let me tell you, your brother Xu is not a simple person, if you have a chance in the future, you should slowly ask him for advice. "
Actually, Li Chengrong was not the only one who was fascinated by listening, and Han Limin also wished Xu Shiyan could talk more.
Now Han Limin has been transferred to the technical department, he is the person in charge of the technical department, and in autumn he is also in charge of the processing plant.
From what Xu Shiyan said just now, Han Limin was very keenly aware that this might be an opportunity.
Well, I really need to have a good chat with Xu Shiyan when I have time, this guy has a lot of good things in his mind.
Dear friends, update on time at 7:00 tomorrow. Please support the author, support genuine reading, more wonderful books, all in Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Han Xu got married
chapters.content:
Chapter 214 Han Xu gets married
Xu Shiyan led his apprentice for four days in Yichang.
During these four days, Li Chengrong has been following Xu Shiyan, asking questions about this and that.
Xu Shiyan wasn't bothered at all. It's normal for a young boy who just left school to become more bookish.
Waiting for a few years to become an old fritters, and I will never ask questions like a student again.
Four days later, Xu Shiyan switched to the commune to participate, and then went to the first team and the third team for brief guidance.
The people from the two brigades have been following Xu Shiyan for several days, and they have already learned about the same. It is useless for Xu Shiyan to spend too much time.
Xu Shiyan wandered around during the day, doing technical guidance, and had to go to the farm on duty the next night, which was enough for him.
At any rate, I have been busy for more than 20 days, and the matter of fertilizer fermentation has come to an end for the time being. Just wait for a while to check the degree of fermentation.
On July 1st, the twins of the Xu family will have a full moon.
Due to some special reasons, Xu Shiyan didn't manage the full moon wine, and he was busy at that time, so he really couldn't take care of it.
Until mid-July, Xu Shiyan calmed down a bit, and Zhao Jianshe and others also returned from other places.
Xu Shiyan then said, find a time to invite everyone to dinner.
Coincidentally, July 18th, the 28th day of the fifth lunar month, is Xu Chenghou's birthday.
According to the rules established by the separation of the family, after Xu Chenghou turned sixty, the brothers had to come back every year to celebrate the old man's birthday.
Xu Shiyan simply took the opportunity to call some good friends over to have fun.
He is celebrating his father's birthday, not holding a full moon wine. Even if others know about it, they can't find anything wrong with it.
Xu Shiyan arranged for someone to go up the mountain to replace Xu Chenghou in advance, and then brought the old man back, took a bath, shaved his head, shaved his face, and tidied up neatly.
Xu Shiqin also made a new set of clothes for the old man, dressing up the old man very energetically.
Xu Shixian in the county, Xu Shixiang in Xinglong Commune, and Xu Shide seconded to Daying Commune as an accountant all took leave of absence.
Come back a day early with your wife and children, and bring back the pension and food that should be given to the elderly in the first half of the year.
Regardless of whether it’s the old house or Xu Shiyan’s, there are so many houses that even if the whole family comes back, they can still live there.
Although it was under the banner of Xu Chenghou's birthday, all the people invited were Xu Shiyan's friends, so naturally it had to be done on Xu Shiyan's side.
On the 18th, many people came to the Xu family.
Yang Chunming, Feng Chao and others needless to say, Zhao Jianshe and his father Zhao Dahai came together.
Zhao Dahai is getting older, and many people have moved out from the brigade along the Dongjiang River, making it worse and worse.
Zhao Dahai lost his temper. He moved out this spring and followed Zhao Jianshe. It happened that he hadn't seen Xu Chenghou for a long time, so he came to join in the fun.
Han Wenzhong, Han Limin, Han Lixin and his son came together.
Why? Of course it is because Xu and Han are about to get married.
That year Xu Shiyan slaughtered a pig for a treat, and Han Liwei met Xu Shiqin, and for some reason, he got it right.
The next day, he went to the tailor shop of the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, found Xu Shiqin, and said that he wanted to make a suit of clothes as a gift.
It was the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, so tailor shops would not accept jobs.
But Xu Shiqin didn't have the nerve to refuse, so he rushed to make it for Han Liwei.
As a result, when Han Liwei came to pick up the clothes, he said that they were for Xu Shiqin, which scared Xu Shiqin enough.
Although Xu Shiqin was twenty, there were many people who had introduced him to her, but most of them were rejected by Zhou Guilan before they came to her.
I only met two or three, and at most I said a few words in front of the introducer, but it didn't work out afterwards.
It was the first time to be pursued by a young man, and the other party was so outstanding.
Xu Shiqin felt that he was not worthy of this condition and dared not even think about it, so he rejected Han Liwei's gift and ran home.
Years later, Han Liwei returned to the team, but when he was outside, he would write letters to Xu Shiqin from time to time.
Do not write any excessive content in the letter, just talk about ideals and the customs outside.
will also encourage Xu Shiqin, let Xu Shiqin study more, work hard and so on.
Xu Shiqin didn't reply to the letters at first, but Han Liwei couldn't hold back and sent them here one by one. After a long time, Xu Shiqin felt that it was not good not to reply to the letters.
In this way, the two have been exchanging letters for more than a year.
Later, Han Liwei expressed his intentions again in the letter. Xu Shiqin lost his mind for a while, so he asked his mother for advice.
It wasn't until this time that Xu Shiyan realized that the kid who co-authored Han Liwei had been thinking about his sister for a long time.
Ordinarily speaking, Xu Shiyan should be happy that such an outstanding young man like Han Liwei likes his sister.
However, in July 1984 in his last life, Han Liwei died at the border at the age of 27.
Xu Shiyan knew Han Wenzhong in 1987, and three years have passed since Han Liwei died.
But whenever Han Wenzhong mentioned his youngest son, Han Wenzhong would cry with grief.
That was the most outstanding child of the Han family, who died at a young age without even marrying a wife.
So Xu Shiyan struggled for a long time, and also analyzed the interests with his mother and Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiyan can't make the decision for his younger sister, he can only leave the decision to the younger sister and let her choose.
Xu Shiqin thought over and over again, and finally decided to agree to Han Liwei's pursuit.
At the same time, the Han family also received a letter from Han Liwei.
Han Wenzhong hesitated when he learned that his youngest son had taken a fancy to Xu Shiyan's sixth younger sister.
After all, Xu Shiqin's physical condition is there, and it is impossible for the Han family to have no opinion at all.
But the son liked it wholeheartedly, and Han Wenzhong and his wife had no choice but to invite a matchmaker to Xu's family to propose marriage.
The two parties have already made a verbal agreement on the marriage, and they will only wait for this winter, when Han Liwei goes home to visit relatives, to get engaged to the two.
Han and Xu are about to become in-laws, Xu Chenghou celebrates his birthday, can Han Wenzhong not come?
"Brother Xu, I haven't seen you for a while, but my brother is getting more and more energetic."
Han Wenzhong was very affectionate when he saw Xu Chenghou, looked him up and down, and smiled.
"Sure enough, people are in high spirits on happy occasions. Are you very happy to have a pair of children and grandchildren?"
Han Wenzhong and Xu Chenghou flirted with each other, and they were about to get married soon, so naturally they didn't see each other, and deliberately teased Xu Chenghou.
"Of course I'm happy to have a grandson, and even more happy is that our old girl has a good uncle.
Do you think I can not be energetic? I'm still waiting to hold my grandson. "Xu Chenghou laughed loudly.
For him, it was a happy event for his third son to have a pair of twins, but that was all.
After all, there are a lot of grandchildren, so there is nothing new.
But Xu Shiqin's marriage has always been a heartache for their husband and wife.
Now that Xu Shiqin has found such a good partner, Xu Chenghou has also gone to have a heart attack. This is the most gratifying thing.
Han Wenzhong laughed when he heard it, "Yes, yes, this is a big deal.
I heard a letter from the third child, saying that a report has been sent up, and when the application is approved, I will come back this winter to hold a wedding. "
Han Liwei is twenty-five years old this year and has served in the army for seven years. He is in compliance with the regulations and is only waiting for the approval of his superiors.
Xu Shiqin is twenty-three this year, and it is also the best time.
The two families discussed, why not take the opportunity to get engaged and get married together.
After a while after marriage, if conditions permit, let Xu Shiqin move to Han Liwei's side. The husband and wife can't always live in two places.

chapters.title: Chapter 215: godmother
chapters.content:
Chapter 215 Godfather Godmother
In the name of his father's birthday, Xu Shiyan invited some friends who got along with him to come and have fun, and of course Zhou Zhang, his father and son, and Yu Shouguang couldn't be left behind.
The weather was very hot in July, and everyone didn't bother to go inside, so they sat outside under the grape arbor to enjoy the cool.
Xu Chenghou, Han Wenzhong, Yu Shouguang, Zhao Dahai, Zhou Chang and these older people got together.
Xu Shiyan and his brothers, as well as Han Limin, Han Lixin, Yang Chunming and others, gathered for two other tables.
Everyone chatted while drinking tea, all kinds of topics, and they could talk about anything for a long time.
The Xu family's sisters-in-law, as well as Xu Shiqin and Su Anhua, were cooking in the house.
Xue Xiulin has changed a lot in the past two years.
She knew in her heart that her husband's current situation was all because of his third uncle.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't entrusted Xu Shixian to write the article, and also specifically marked that Xu Shixian wrote it, Xu Shixian wouldn't have been recruited by the bureau as an exception.
So now Xue Xiulin is very nice to Xu Shiyan and his wife. When she saw Su Anying going to help in the kitchen, she hurried out.
"Yingzi, it's hot in the room, and there's still oily fumes choking on you, you and our mother carry the baby to sit in the yard, it's cool outside.
The child is almost 50 days old, and he is not afraid of the wind. It is good to go out for activities this summer. "
"Yes, yes, what the sister-in-law said is, there are so many of us, why do you need to do it?
Hurry up and take the baby outside to cool off. "Wei Mingrong also followed suit.
She already knew the plan of the third uncle from her husband, and Xu Shian was working on the farm, and Xu Shiyan also paid wages, which was much better than Xu Shian growing and selling vegetables.
Wei Mingrong is in his thirties, how can he not know what is good or bad? No matter how stupid he is, he still knows that Xu Shiyan needs to be treated better now.
Su Anying saw that the kitchen really couldn't get her hands in, and the room was too hot.
So I sat outside with my mother-in-law and the baby in my arms.
Coincidentally, these people outside were also very curious when they saw the twins of the Xu family, and they all gathered around to see the little baby.
"Hey, these two babies look quite alike, so you can't tell them apart.
It was due to a man and a woman, otherwise the parents would probably have to admit their mistakes. "When everyone saw the appearance of the two babies, they all joked.
"It's not bad, but at first glance they look alike, but if you look carefully, you can tell they're different."
Su Anying also laughed, laughing enough to explain a few words.
While talking and laughing, I saw a couple leading a little boy in.
As soon as the little boy entered the door, he ran towards Su Anying, "Godmother, godmother, come and see, brother and sister."
Before she ran to Su Anying, she tripped and fell.
"Idiot, you have been telling me not to run around, you have to run, did you fall?"
Before the little boy could cry, Xu Haiyuan, who was playing with his cousins ​​in the yard, helped the little boy up with a look of disgust.
"Brother, don't scold Xiaoyu."
Xu Jinping, who was braided upside down, hurried over to help the little boy dust off his pants.
held the little boy's hand again, and blew on the little boy's slightly torn delicate palm. "Hey sister, it doesn't hurt."
The little boy who was about to cry with his mouth pursed, burst into tears when he saw Xu Jinping.
"Well, it doesn't hurt anymore, Brother Yuanyuan, Sister Pingping."
The little boy is very good-looking, with big white eyes, and the tears are still hanging on the long eyelashes at the moment, not to mention how painful it is.
"Xiaoyu, come to godmother, let godmother take a look."
Su Anying waved at the little boy, called the little boy to her side, checked carefully, and found that the little boy had no other injuries, so she was relieved.
"Run less in the future, your body is weak, and you can easily get hurt if you can't run."
Su Anying raised her hand and touched the little boy's forehead, then raised her head and smiled at the couple behind.
"Junxian, Yufeng, you two are here too, sit down quickly." The people who came were Yang Junxian and his wife.
At the other end, Xu Shiyan also saw the person coming, and hurried over to say hello.
"Hey, I didn't expect you two to bring Xiaoyu here, hurry up and sit down.
Jun Xian, sit here, brother and sister, sit next to your sister-in-law. "
Yang Haoyu, the son of Yang Junxian's family, was also the baby Su Anying fed in the hospital.
Su Anying and Ji Yufeng gave birth in the hospital on the same day. Ji Yufeng almost died because of premature delivery and dystocia. The blood was transfused by Xu Shiyan and another person.
Later, Yang Haoyu had no milk to eat, and Su Anying fed him for nearly ten days. It can be said that Xu Shiyan and his wife are kind to the Yang family.
After that, the two families communicated frequently, Yang Junxian and Xu Shiyan got along very well, and Ji Yufeng often came to Xu's house with Yang Haoyu in his arms.
When Yang Haoyu was one year old, he recognized Xu Shiyan and his wife as godfather and godmother, and the two families moved around as relatives.
The children of the two families always play together and get along very well.
Yang Haoyu was born prematurely. He has been weak since he was a child.
Standing with Xu Jinping, it seems that she is one year younger than Xu Jinping.
But this baby is very smart and speaks early, a little witty ghost.
Although Xu Haiyuan said he disliked Yang Haoyu, he actually took care of this thin brother.
Needless to say, Xu Jinping took care of Yang Haoyu everywhere, and really loved him as his own younger brother.
The three children will panic if they don't see each other for a few days, especially Yang Haoyu, who is crying and fussing to find his brothers and sisters.
When Ji Yufeng gave birth to Yang Haoyu, he almost died of dystocia and hemorrhage. The couple were so scared that they didn't dare to have a second child.
In addition, Yang Junxian is now the deputy secretary of a large team, and it is not easy to take the lead in violating the policy. The couple only plan to take this one and forget it.
Yang Haoyu has two cousins, but he doesn't like to play with his cousins, so he likes to find brothers and sisters from the Xu family.
At this moment, Yang Haoyu couldn't care about the fall just now, so he took out a few pieces of candy from his pocket and distributed them to the Xu family brothers and sisters.
Then the three little heads got together, murmuring without knowing what they were talking about.
Su Anying couldn't help laughing when she saw the mysterious appearance of the three children.
"Look at the three of them, they are almost like a family of brothers."
"Yeah, fortunately there are sister-in-law's and Xiaoyu playing with our family. Xiaoyu, this child, can't wait to grow up in your house."
Ji Yufeng looked enviously at the baby in Su Anying's arms.
"Hey, I really envy my sister-in-law. It would be nice to have two children at once. In the future, I will have four children as companions, so I won't be alone."
People in this day and age still have the concept of having more children and grandchildren and more blessings.
Although the higher-ups are advocating it vigorously, it is not so easy to change the deep-rooted concepts.
Su Anying couldn't continue with these words, so she could only smile.
Ji Yufeng also came to his senses, stopped talking about the children, and focused on teasing the little baby.
The twins of the Xu family were always crying during confinement, but after confinement, they got better. They only ate and slept every day.
At this moment, the two babies woke up and fed the milk, lying in the arms of grandma and mother, looking around with small eyes, very energetic.
When Ji Yufeng liked it, she quickly picked it up and coaxed it, but after holding it for a while, she felt something was wrong and the baby peed.

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Xu Haiyuan was trained
chapters.content:
Chapter 216 Xu Haiyuan Being Disciplined
Fortunately, Su Anying cushioned the child with a quilt, and there was a quilt underneath, so Ji Yufeng's trousers were only slightly wet.
"Look, I was so busy talking, I forgot to pee the child.
Brothers and sisters, why don't you go into the house and change my pants for a while? "
Su Anying was extremely embarrassed when she saw that her son had been urinated on her body. She hurriedly got up and was about to drag Ji Yufeng into the house.
"Sister-in-law, no need, just a little, the heat will dry up quickly.
Where is the boy peeing, okay. "
Ji Yufeng was not at all unhappy, and looked down at her pants.
Anyway, a small piece is wet, like splashing some water, it doesn’t matter in summer, just change it when you go home.
People in this day and age are not very particular. How many of them are clean?
