At most, he was going out as a guest, just changing into clean clothes.
Ji Yufeng said so, Su Anying didn't insist any more, and quickly carried her son into the house, and went to change the diaper.
I just changed the diaper at this end, and before I came out again, I heard a child outside crying.
Today, all the children of the Xu family's younger generation came back.
Xu Jinfeng, Xu Jinxiu, Xu Haibo, Xu Haitao, and Xu Haibin are slightly older, and they went to the small hill in the backyard to play.
Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, Xu Haiyang and Xu Jingyi from Xu Shide's family, plus Yang Haoyu, these are the little ones.
Adults don’t allow them to go to the back mountain, so they don’t know what to dig in the shade of the front yard.
Xu Shixiang's daughter, Xu Jingwen, was born in 1981. She is only one year old and has just passed away, so she also joins this group.
Just now they were having a good time, but in the blink of an eye, a child was crying.
Su Anying, Wu Qiuyan, and Chen Chunling were taken aback and hurried out to check.
"Ocean, what's wrong with you?"
Wu Qiuyan saw that her son was crying there, so she hurried over to pick her up and asked softly.
"Brother Yuanyuan, hit me." Xu Haiyang cried very sadly, and raised the back of his hand to show Wu Qiuyan.
Xu Haiyang was born on the 23rd day of the sixth lunar month in 1978, more than three months younger than Xu Haiyuan.
"Then why don't you say, you push Xiaoyu?"
Before anyone else could speak, Xu Haiyuan stood up and glared at Xu Haiyang angrily, with a gloomy face and pursed lips, looking unhappy.
"Xiaoyu gave us sugar, if you don't have your share, you should push him and beat you what you deserve."
Although Xu Haiyuan is small, he is not bad in momentum.
Besides, he is a few months older than Xu Haiyang, he speaks slickly, has a small mouth, and speaks words very clearly.
Xu Shide lived in Daying, and he brought his children back twice a year to celebrate New Year's with Xu Chenghou's birthday.
Although Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiyang are cousins, they rarely meet each other. If they don’t play together, how can they have any relationship?
For Xu Haiyuan, cousins ​​are not as good as godbrothers, they are closer to Yang Haoyu.
"Yuanyuan, don't talk nonsense, why don't you beat your brother."
At this time, Su Anying also came out of the house, and quickly dragged her son over to teach him a lesson.
" Haiyang is your cousin, and he is a guest at our house, so how can you beat the guest?
We have candy at home, tell mom, wouldn’t it be good if mom gave me a few more pieces? "
Children's lawsuits are the most difficult to resolve, but no matter what, what can Su Anying do? You can only train your own son first.
"Godmother, don't scold brother, I, I was wrong."
As a result, Su Anying only said a few words, and Yang Haoyu came over directly, hugged Su Anying's thigh, looked up at Su Anying with tears in his eyes, and said directly that he was wrong.
"There's less sugar, I'll give it to my sister."
It turned out that Yang Haoyu only carried four pieces of candy in his small pocket.
Just now, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping were given a piece, and Yang Haoyu wanted to eat a piece by himself.
As a result, Xu Jingyi and Xu Jingwen approached, and he gave the remaining two yuan to the two girls.
Xu Haiyang felt that Yang Haoyu would not give him any sugar, so he gave Yang Haoyu a push.
Xu Haiyuan on the other end was unhappy, and slapped Xu Haiyang's hand.
Xu Haiyang didn't get the candy, and even hit his brother for a while, so he burst into tears and went to his mother to complain.
Now, it's hard for Su Anying to die.
This is the godson, the other is the nephew, and in the middle there is a pouting, disobedient son.
Who can tell the right and wrong of a group of four- and five-year-old children?
"Okay, Yingzi, what do you care about with the child?" At this time, Zhou Guilan spoke.
"Quick, go back to the house and find something delicious for the children.
It’s because the two of us were busy with our work and forgot to give them something to eat. "
Zhou Guilan is stepping down for Su Anying, what else can she do? You can't drag Xu Haiyuan over and beat him up, can you?
If you make a mistake, Xu Haiyang makes a mistake first, so he will be beaten up?
It's outrageous, I can only pass with the mud.
What else can Su Anying say? He quickly picked up Yang Haoyu, and went into the house to find something delicious for the children.
On the other end, Wu Qiuyan also dragged her son aside and gave him a few words of reprimand in a low voice.
As for Ji Yufeng, he hugged Xu Haiyuan in his arms to comfort him.
"Grandma, see what we picked back?"
At this time, Xu Jinfeng and the others came back from the backyard. Xu Jinfeng and Xu Haibo each held a big tea mug filled with some small red fruits.
Several older children showed off with excitement, "There are a lot of trays in the back mountain, and we picked two tea mugs."
The tray is actually a raspberry, also called a raspberry.
The fruit is red, and the small ball made of coral beads in Lu Xun's works is this thing.
The mature tray tastes sweet and sour, and is very popular among children.
But the branches of this thing are full of thorns, you have to be very careful when picking them, otherwise it will **** your hands.
Xu Shiyan cleans up the hills in the backyard every spring, and tries to cut down or root out some weeds, especially thorny shrubs.
But near the garden, he deliberately left some thorn roses, trays of seedlings, etc., just to prevent thieves.
At this time, the trays had just matured, and no one went to pick them after the young children in the family. It happened that Xu Jinfeng and the others found out, and picked a lot of trays and came back.
"Hey, are you really capable and not afraid of pricking your hands?
The plums and sand fruits in our garden can be eaten, you just pick them casually, how painful it is to run to pick them? "
Although Zhou Guilan is a bit older, her eyesight is okay.
The back of the granddaughter's hand was scratched several times, it was red, and the old lady felt distressed when she saw it.
"Grandma, it's all right, I just scraped it a few times, and it doesn't hurt. Grandma, try it quickly, it's sweet."
Xu Jinfeng grabbed a tray from the tea mug and brought it to grandma, as if she was offering a treasure, she insisted on letting grandma taste it.
The granddaughter is so filial, how could Zhou Guilan refuse? So I pinched a few and put them in my mouth to taste.
"Oh, the trays here are small, not as good as those in our hometown.
The tray at the other end is huge, and it’s delicious. "
Maybe because she is getting older, Zhou Guilan has also begun to miss her hometown in the past two years, and she always thinks of the past.
"When I was young, I was just as old as you, and I always went up the mountain to pick pallets and so on.
The one over there is bigger and has fewer seeds, which is much tastier than this one. "
When Xu Jinfeng and the others heard this, their eyes widened.
"Grandma, when shall we go back to our hometown and have a look?" They mainly want to taste the tray grandma said.

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Grow up to Tsinghua University
chapters.content:
Chapter 217 Growing up to Tsinghua University
The grandchildren spoke childishly and clamored to go back to their hometown, but Zhou Guilan could only shake her head and sigh.
"It's too far away, the other end is too far away, we have to back up from Tonghua and take a bus when we go back.
It's too troublesome, and it costs a lot of money to go back. "
Why doesn't Zhou Guilan want to go back and have a look? But in these days and years, it would cost too much to go back, who would be willing?
The children don't understand that life is difficult, and they want to pester grandma, so that grandma promises to take them back to their hometown.
At this time, Su Anying brought out a basket, which contained some candies, biscuits and the like.
As soon as the children saw delicious food, they forgot about going back to their hometown, and they all surrounded Su Anying, asking for delicious food.
Su Anying distributed some candy and biscuits to the children, and specially gave Xu Haiyang a few pieces of candy, and finally coaxed Xu Haiyang to stop crying.
A turmoil between the children was subsided, and after a while, the children got together to play together again.
At noon, a few tables were set up in the yard.
Now the conditions are much better than before, and the meals are more abundant.
The big guys are not polite, they should eat and drink, talking and laughing is especially lively.
"Hey, sister-in-law, turn on the radio, let's see if there is any news.
It's a pity that there is no storytelling at noon. It would be great if there were storytelling. "Zhao Jianshe suddenly uttered a voice.
Usually at home, I listen to the radio for dinner, but now I feel that something is missing, so I call Su Anying to turn on the radio.
As soon as Su Anying heard it, she went into the room with a smile and turned on the radio, adjusted the channel, and amplified the sound so that everyone outside could hear it.
July 18th, just a few days after the college entrance examination, the radio was talking about some university affairs.
Now we are talking about Tsinghua University, a first-class university in China.
Xu Shixian and others heard it, and then followed suit.
It is said that if someone's child can be admitted to Tsinghua University, he can go to the capital to study in the future, and he can be assigned a good job after graduation.
Maybe he can stay in the capital to work, that would really be regarded as honoring his ancestors.
"Dad." Xu Jinping ran to Xu Shiyan's side and tugged at Xu Shiyan's sleeve.
"What's the matter, girl?" Xu Shiyan thought that his girl had something to do with him, so he hurriedly picked her up and put her on his lap.
"Father, I have grown up and am going to be admitted to Tsinghua University."
The little girl raised her head, her big eyes were shining brightly, her red face had a serious expression, and she told her father about her great ambitions solemnly.
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered that when the eldest daughter in the previous life was a child, she also talked about the Tsinghua University exam.
With the daughter's attitude and enthusiasm for studying, if there is no accident between the husband and wife, the daughter will be admitted to Tsinghua University if they are not in order.
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan felt sore, "Yes, let's take the Tsinghua University exam, and my daughter will definitely pass the exam."
The dialogue between the father and daughter made everyone in the yard laugh.
"Oh, if someone is admitted to Tsinghua University, it will be the glory of Donggang." Yu Shouguang couldn't help sighing.
"Xiao Pingping, you have to keep your word and don't brag."
The latter words are naturally teasing the children.
Such a little girl, how can she know what is going on at Tsinghua University? Is that something ordinary people can pass the exam?
"Blowing? How do you brag?"
A girl who is only four years old, how can she know what bragging is?
So he stared at Yu Shouguang with a pair of big eyes full of doubts.
"Hahaha, braggarts are promising.
Xiao Pingping, you study hard in the future, and when you are admitted to university, grandpa will come to have a wedding, okay? "
The little girl's ignorant expression made everyone laugh out loud. Yu Shouguang smiled and encouraged Xu Jinping.
How did Xu Jinping know so much? Anyway, she only remembers one thing, study hard and get into Tsinghua University.
"Well, well, I want to go to school, Tsinghua University."
Everyone laughed again, and many praised Xu Jinping for her ambition.
Xu Jinping is still young, so she can't tell what these people mean, but her wish to be admitted to Tsinghua University has taken root in her heart at this moment.
"Then, I will also take the Tsinghua University exam, with Sister Pingping."
On the other side, Yang Haoyu, who was still in Ji Yufeng's arms, broke free from his mother's arms and ran over to find Xu Jinping.
"Let's go to college together."
Xu Jinping jumped off her father's lap, tilted her head to look at Yang Haoyu, and then nodded heavily.
"Okay, let's go together. You must keep what you say, and you are not allowed to go back on your word." As he spoke, he stretched out his right hand and raised his little finger.
Yang Haoyu also stretched out his right hand, hooking Xu Jinping's little finger with his little finger, the two of them were still talking.
"Hanging on the hook, not allowed to change for a hundred years, whoever becomes a puppy."
The two babies made everyone laugh out loud. Zhou Guilan even burst into tears, and quickly wiped them away with her hands.
"Okay, you two come here quickly, don't delay uncle and uncle drinking."
These two little kids are so interesting, how can they think of going to university, and they have to go to Tsinghua University?
Xu Jinping pulled Yang Haoyu, and the two babies just held hands, returned to their mother's side, and sat down to eat obediently.
Everyone laughed enough, rubbed their sore cheeks, and continued drinking and eating.
During the chat, Zhao Jianshe and others had to talk about some things about going out as a technical guide, and then asked Xu Shiyan if he had anything interesting to do here.
"Yes, there is a young man in our field who graduated from high school last year and recruited workers.
As soon as Shi Yan passed by, the young man wandered around Shi Yan, asking this and that, wishing not to leave even an inch.
This means that Shi Yan has a good temper, and he would have been annoyed by someone else. "
Before Xu Shiyan could speak, Han Limin spoke first.
"Why don't you say that my brother is capable, with all kinds of theories, the young man can't wait to learn from his teacher directly.
A few days ago, he came to inquire with me, asking where my brother’s home is. He still didn’t understand some things, so he wanted to come and ask for advice. "
As soon as he mentioned Li Chengrong's bookworm, Han Limin wanted to laugh.
I didn’t think that kid was so fun before, and if that energy of study is used in the university entrance exam, maybe he can really pass the exam.
Xu Shiyan also laughed when he heard this.
"Xiao Li is a pretty good young man, but he just left school, so he isn't that tactful in his dealings.
is also pretty good, this kind of person has tenacity in doing things. It's okay, if he wants to come, I don't think he's annoying.
However, it’s fine to be a teacher. I haven’t even finished junior high school. I’m a high school student anyway, so I don’t dare to be a teacher for him. "
Everyone laughed when they heard this.
"Third brother, this is not right, education does not mean everything, there are too many capable people without education.
I think the third brother is quite capable, how good is the lecture? The group of people below were all dumbfounded. "
Everyone talked and chatted while eating and drinking. Anyway, there was nothing to do in the afternoon, so it was rare to get together and chat more.
While talking and joking, suddenly a person ran in from outside.
It was very hot in summer, the man must have been running all the way here, and his face was covered in sweat.
"Brother Xu, that camp called, saying that your grandma passed away.
Let you and Uncle Xu, Aunt Xu, hurry over. "
The man may have been running in a hurry, out of breath, and managed to speak smoothly.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 218: mourning
chapters.content:
Chapter 218 Funeral
With a clang, the bowl in Zhou Guilan's hand fell to the ground and broke into pieces.
Zhou Guilan didn't realize it, she just stared at the young man delivering the letter with a pale face, "What's going on? Please speak slowly."
It was only after I spoke that I realized that my voice was trembling.
"Aunt Xu, the other side of Daying called our commune, saying that your old mother passed away, and asked you and Uncle Xu to go quickly."
When the young man saw Zhou Guilan's appearance, he knew that the old man couldn't bear the blow and was too sad, so he repeated it word by word.
Zhou Guilan swayed twice, but fortunately she was supported by Xue Xiulin and Chen Chunling beside her.
"Mom, be careful, grandma is gone, you have to hold on."
The daughters-in-law looked at their mother-in-law worriedly, and began to persuade her.
On the other end, Xu Chenghou was also shocked, and came over to support Zhou Guilan.
"Don't cry, our mother has suffered a lot in these years, she is suffering in her heart, and it is a relief to leave now."
Zhou Guilan didn't cry, but she looked a little numb, "Well, is there still a car in the afternoon? We have to leave quickly, we can't delay."
Mother died, Zhou Guilan had to go to see her off for the last time.
Xu Chenghou didn't know if there was a car, so he turned to look at Xu Shide.
"Yes, there is another train in the afternoon, from Quanyang to Songshu Town, at three o'clock."
Xu Shide is in Daying, he has to take the train every time he comes to Donggang, he knows best.
"It's only one o'clock, and I still have time to catch up, Saner, go to the car.
Jianshe, you drive the car, and take you Uncle Xu, Aunt Xu, and your third brother to the station. "
On the other side, Zhao Dahai raised his wrist to see that it was just after one o'clock, so he hurriedly ordered his son to drive the car to the station.
Grandmother's death is a major event, there is no delay, everyone can understand, so they got up one after another.
Yang Chunming and Zhao Jianshe hurried to the barn to pull out the Xu family's horses and put them into the carriage.
On the other end, Xu Chenghou discussed with his sons who should go.
"Father, all six of us have to go, the daughter-in-law and children should be at home.
The children are young, it is not good to go to this occasion. "Xu Shixian is the eldest son, so he has to say that.
Xu Chenghou thought about it, the children in each family were not very old, and it was two generations apart, so there was no need for the children to come to this kind of occasion.
"Okay, then it's settled, old woman, go, go back and pack up, bring two changes of clothes, let's go quickly."
Zhou Guilan's mind is in a mess right now, she can't think at all, she will do whatever Xu Chenghou says to do.
So he followed Xu Chenghou back to his home, dug out some plain clothes from the closet, and put them in a pocket.
He dug out some money from the cabinet and put it in his pocket.
At the other end, Yang Chunming, Han Limin and others also got up to leave after seeing this.
"Shi Yan, it happened so suddenly, we won't stay here for long.
You hurry up and go to the camp, take care of your parents, they are old and can't stand the trouble. "
Han Wenzhong came to Xu Shiyan and told him.
"Uncle Han, I'm really sorry, I wanted to invite everyone to have a good time."
Xu Shiyan let out a long sigh. To be honest, he really forgot about it.
"Hey, do we guys still need to talk about this? No one here today is an outsider, and no one will care.
Birth, old age, sickness and death, it is human nature to mourn. In the past, we made good arrangements for funerals for the elderly.
Let the old man be buried in a grand manner, which is also your wish as a junior. "
Han Wenzhong patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder as a comfort.
Just like that, Zhao Jianshe got into the carriage, pulled Xu Chenghou and his wife, Xu Shixian's six brothers and sisters, and Wu Qiuyan's mother and son, and went straight to Songjianghe Railway Station.
Zhao Jianshe sent the people there, returned directly, and sent the car back to Xu Shiyan's house.
Xu Shiyan and others went to the station to buy tickets, and entered the station along the zero train at 3:00 pm.
A group of people boarded the car, swayed along the zero car for more than an hour, and finally arrived at Xianren Bridge.
Get off at Xianrenqiao and walk towards Daying. On the way, Wu Qiuyan led her daughter and daughter back to the Hebei brigade.
Zhou Anping's house is in the middle of Daying Village.
After crossing the small bridge and walking west a few steps, I saw a long string of "dump papers" raised in front of Zhou's house from a distance.
Tots can be made from paper strips, or directly from burnt paper. The age of the deceased can be seen from the length of the toss paper, and whether it is a man or a woman can be seen from the placement of the tots.
Outside the gate of Zhou Anping’s house, there is an inverted paper on the right side, a white obituary on the left side, and a long row of red cloth with a banner written on it with white paint.
The name of the person who passed away, the year of death, etc. are written on it.
Although Zhou Guilan felt uncomfortable, she gritted her teeth and endured it all the way, but seeing such scenes at this time, she couldn't bear it anymore.
Tears fell in a rush, and the crying became a tearful person.
Xu Chenghou helped Zhou Guilan to walk into the yard, and the younger members of the Zhou family came out to greet her, "Second Aunt, Second Uncle, Cousin."
When relatives meet in such a situation, it is inevitable that they will be sad and cry.
Entering the courtyard, before arriving at the coffin, Da Zhang Luo, who was in charge of the funeral, called Zhou Guilan and the others over, and tore off the filial cloth. Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan both wore sackcloth and filial piety.
Xu Shixian and others are grandsons and granddaughters, so they only need to wear filial piety belts around their waists.
Zhou Guilan knelt before the coffin and wept bitterly, and Xu Shiyan and his brothers also shed tears.
Although their grandma has been crazy for many years, she is not bad for her grandson.
Every time she came to see her, the old lady would smile and give them delicious food.
Now that the old man passed away, everyone thought of what happened to their grandmother in this life, and they couldn't help but feel sad and grieved, and tears fell down uncontrollably.
The origin of the Zhou family is also in Qingshangou, Kuandian, belonging to Jiangjiabaozi, not too far from the silver mine.
When Zhou Guilan's father, Zhou Huaimin, was still there, the Zhou family was very prosperous.
The family has a lot of land, cooking pots, weaving workshops, livestock and carts, and many long-term laborers are hired to do the work.
Zhou Huaimin has a good personality, he donates money and makes many friends.
Regardless of whether it is an official person or a bandit beard, they all have friendship.
In the past three years, the Kuandian area was occupied by devils, and the local Huzi actively responded to the call for an uprising against Japan.
Among them, there is a team that has a deep friendship with Zhou Huaimin. Zhou Huaimin often sends food and information to this team.
As a result, he was discovered by the devils and took Zhou Huaimin away. He has never seen him again since, neither alive nor dead.
In those years, there were rumors from time to time that someone saw Zhou Huaimin's body in front of a certain mountain temple.
Or say that Zhou Huaimin's head was chopped off and hung on the wall of the county town.
Zhou Huaimin's wife, Jiang Shi, is an illiterate woman with small feet. Her husband had an accident, and the youngest daughter in the family is only three years old. What can she do?
He just washed his face with tears all day long, and didn't even protect his own little property, which was embezzled by others.
The only thing Jiang can do is to quickly arrange a marriage for the eldest daughter and send the eldest daughter away.
The eldest daughter of the Zhou family, Zhou Guizhi, was married off at the age of fifteen, and later moved to Fusong.

chapters.title: Chapter 219: funeral
chapters.content:
Chapter 219 Funeral
When Zhou Huaimin was taken away, Zhou Guilan was only eight years old, and her younger sister was only three years old.
Nine years later, the Zhou family was in complete decline.
In order to marry Zhou Guilan's third elder brother, Zhou Ansheng, Jiang married her second daughter to Xu's family, a silver mine, and pawned a house for Xu Chenghou.
After changing a lot of gift money, he turned around and married his third son a wife.
Later, the devils withdrew and there was another war in Kuandian, so Jiang took her three sons and the youngest daughter to Fusong to join the eldest daughter.
A few years later, Xu Chenghou and his wife couldn't get along in the silver mine, so they received a letter from Mrs. Jiang asking them to go to Fusong too.
At this point, a whole family of brothers and sisters came here.
The team funded by Zhou Huaimin then became the Anti-Japanese League, and it is said that some people became big cadres.
So in the five or so years, the superiors sent down a working group to live in Zhou's house for half a year, to make contributions to Zhou Huaimin.
But at that time, the Jiang family and Zhou Anping had been terrified after experiencing the troubled times. How could they dare to believe it?
No matter how much people persuaded, they just refused to nod.
The working group stayed here for half a year without any results, and then left.
In the sixties or so, Zhou Anping did not know where he got a newspaper with the names of a group of cadres in the capital on it, and there was a man named Zhou Huaimin.
Now, Jiang is in a state of confusion, and must say that it is her husband.
It is said that Zhou Huaimin has developed, married another daughter-in-law in the capital and started a family, and abandoned his wife and children and did not want her anymore.
In this way, Jiang gradually became delirious, with good times and bad days.
When it’s good, it’s almost like a normal person. When it’s bad, don’t mention it.
What put chili peppers in the kang hole to burn, yell to smoke some yellow leather, or run around the street with disheveled hair, scolding her husband for being heartless while running, and leaving her to enjoy the blessings.
Anyway, in those years, Jiang’s work was very good. Zhou Anping and Zhou Anfu stayed by their mother’s side and suffered a lot.
Only Zhou Ansheng, he moved out of town, quieter.
Jiang has been working for these years, and he has done a lot of things to hang himself, but no one thought that he really died this time.
It sounds very mysterious, the house where Mrs. Jiang lives has a window, and two nails are driven into the two corners of the window frame.
Ms. Jiang took a sack string and tied it to two nails. When he put his head up, he lost his breath.
When Zhou Anping found out, he was so cold, how could he save him? I can only inform my younger siblings, let's do the funeral.
Zhou Guilan and the others cried for a while, and were persuaded to get up by the helper, and sat down beside them.
Hearing my brother and sister-in-law talk about the death of my mother, in the end, I can only sigh.
"Hey, this is fate. Who would have thought that a sack line could kill someone?"
Indeed, Jiang lived to be eighty-three, and it’s okay to hang himself all day long. How could he want to die on a sack line in the end?
Ms. Jiang passed away in the morning. In Northeast China, this is three days.
The weather is hot at this time, and the funeral for three days is really enough.
Fortunately, the birthday materials were prepared long ago, not to mention the shrouds. The Jiang family has been preparing for more than ten years.
Every New Year's Eve, she still wears it once.
Zhou Anping hired a carpenter to make long-lived wood, paint it, draw patterns, and make a big show. According to local customs, before every meal, he took the Zhou family's children and grandchildren to deliver soup.
Xu Shiyan and others kept watch at night, and had to help with funeral arrangements during the day. Just like that, two days passed.
On the morning of the third day, the body was buried, the coffin was sealed, and the children and grandchildren wept to see each other off.
Eight strong young men lifted the coffin, and carried the coffin to the mountain for burial according to the pre-selected location.
The Zhou family prepared a banquet here, thanking relatives and friends for their help.
After dinner, the friends who helped each other dispersed, leaving only the bookkeeper, Da Zhangluo, and the Zhou family to settle the accounts.
Brothers settle accounts clearly, my mother is gone, and things must be cleared up afterward.
These years, red and white weddings and weddings are held every month, and there are few people who give money, but they are all given things.
To do white affairs, the normal friendship is just a few knives of paper, and the better friendship, most of them have a tent besides the paper, which is black cloth and white cloth.
The bookkeeper collected all the gifts received in the past few days and all kinds of expenses, and reported to the three brothers Zhou Anping.
The money for the funeral was all taken from Zhou Anping. Now that the accounts are out, the three brothers must share them equally.
According to local customs, daughters are not divided into family property, and the daughters are not required to pay for the funeral of the elderly.
The only thing is that the money for the coffin digging has to be paid by the daughter.
Of course, this is not much money. Zhou Guilan, sister Zhou Guizhi, and younger sister Zhou Guiyun can pay ten yuan each.
The three brothers of the Zhou family were okay, and settled the accounts in a friendly manner.
The second child, Zhou Anfu, and the third child, Zhou Ansheng, both gave money to the boss.
At this point, the funeral of the old man has come to an end. Then there will be three days to round the grave and burn Wuqi.
"You brothers and sisters go back, you don't need to stay here with us, your mother and I are fine, we are all fine."
Everything was dealt with clearly here, Xu Chenghou called his five sons to him and told them to go home separately.
Boss, fourth, fifth, and sixth all go to work, so it’s not good to take too long leave.
The second and third children have to keep an eye on the farm, and the third child still has a lot of things to do, so it is not good to delay any longer.
"We will wait until the grave is completed before going back. Just now your uncle and the others also said that the first seven will not be burned, only the fifth and seventh.
Let’s come again when we wait for the five-seventh and hundred-day burns. "
According to local rules, when someone passes away, it is generally the funeral, round grave, May 7, 100 days, anniversary, and third anniversary. These are more important.
In some places, more emphasis is placed on the first seven, but most of them do not burn the first seven.
As the old saying goes, the first seven have to be done, and the next seven have to be done. No one can afford it, so most of them burn five sevens.
If there are five sons in the family, you can’t burn Wuqi, you have to burn Sanqi.
At this time, every household is busy, and no one can stay here for seven or eight days, and leave whenever they need to.
Xu Shiyan and the others are grandchildren, so it's good for this sake, no one cares about it.
"Father, mother, let's go back first, you two will stay here for a few more days, and it happens that my third uncle and aunt also rarely come back together.
Father, look at my mother, don't let her cry all the time, it's not good to cry too much. "
The six brothers and sisters of the Xu family saw that it was getting late, and there was no car to go back any later.
Everyone didn't hesitate, and they left together after exhorting their parents a few words.
The six siblings broke up at the bridge, Xu Shide crossed the river and headed north, and the remaining five siblings walked to Xianren Bridge.
At Xianrenqiao Railway Station, Xu Shiyan, Xu Shian, and Xu Shiqin went to buy train tickets, and the three of them took the train back to Songjianghe.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang took the bus on Xianren Bridge to Fusong, and they arrived at the county first.
If there is a car to go to Xinglong, Xu Shixiang will go back directly, if not, Xu Shixiang will stay in the county for one night, and return to Xinglong tomorrow.
"Brother, Fifth, you two should pay attention on the road, it is not peaceful at this time, please be careful."
The past few years have not been the same. There is chaos outside, especially passenger cars. There are really road robbers.
Fortunately, the two brothers didn't bring much money with them, so there should be no problem.
The four brothers left, Xu Shiyan, his second brother and his sixth sister took the express train, and wandered back to Songjiang River together.
Xu Shian sent iron, Xu Shiqin went to the store, and Xu Shiyan went home.
"Second brother-in-law, you are back. Someone will always come to your house to look for you these days."
As soon as Xu Shiyan entered, Su Anhua hurriedly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: dolls fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 220 Babies fight
No need to think about it, Xu Shiyan knew who was looking for him, this Li Chengrong is really a nerd.
"It's okay, I'll go to the venue in two days." Xu Shiyan smiled and walked into the east room.
Entering the room, Su Anying was coaxing the two little ones on the kang.
There is no shadow of Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping in the room, it is estimated that these two children went crazy to someone.
"How's it going? I haven't been at home for a few days, have the two kids been arguing?"
Xu Shiyan came closer, stretched his head to look, the two children were not asleep, they were lying on the quilt and kicking their legs.
"It's not bad, it's much easier to coax than in confinement.
Take a nap in the morning and a nap in the afternoon, and stop crying at other times.
If it’s okay, I’ll play with them. When they fall asleep, I can also sleep for a while.
Shiqin also came to live after get off work. With her and Huaer's help, I was fine and not too tired. "
Su Anying turned her head to look at Xu Shiyan, and found that her husband's eye sockets were sunken and his face was full of stubble. He knew that he must have not had a good rest these days.
"Do you want to go to sleep for a while, I look at your eye sockets are blue." Su Anying felt sorry for her husband and asked him softly.
"It's okay, I just stayed up for two nights." Xu Shiyan didn't care, and reached out to touch the little feet of his daughter and son.
"After a good night's sleep, I will recover, and now I won't be able to sleep at night."
The couple teased the child while chatting in low voices. Xu Shiyan had to tell Su Anying what happened at the other end of the camp.
"I saw my father and mother, and they all went to help. After a while, I chatted with my parents for a while."
They are all in the same brigade, and they are not far away. If the Zhou family has something to do, Su Weizhong must go to help.
"I heard from my father and mother that they want me to find a partner for my sixth sister in Donggang.
I didn't express my position at the time, so I passed it vaguely. Daughter-in-law, do you think this can work? "
It is a matter of life for my sister-in-law, so I must ask my wife for her opinion.
In 1987 in his last life, Su Weizhong passed away due to kidney disease.
Su Anying's elder sister Qin Meiling, through her husband's relationship, took her mother Han and her two younger sisters, Su Anfang and Su Anhua, to Hunjiang.
Then I figured out a way to arrange jobs for both younger sisters.
Su Anfang is at the piano factory, and Su Anhua is at the paper mill.
Unfortunately, within a few years, the piano factory was ruined, and the paper mill was shut down due to pollution problems, and the two sisters lost their jobs.
Later, Su Anfang married a grocery vendor who had a daughter.
Su Anhua is married to a chef and has a son.
The life in the city is just like that. It looks good on the outside, and the people in the city are glamorous.
In fact, people with little ability have to live frugally and spend money, which is no better than life in the country.
So when Xu Shiyan learned of his father-in-law and mother-in-law's intentions, he hesitated a little. Wouldn't it be good for him to intervene in the marriage of the two sister-in-laws?
The point is that the two brothers-in-law are very good people, it seems wrong to destroy other people's marriage indiscriminately.
Su Anying was stunned when she heard this.
"How big are the flowers? Seventeen, what do you want to do so early? I don't know what my parents think?"
As the person who single-handedly takes care of the eldest sister, Su Anying doesn't think it's a good thing to marry her younger sister so early.
Being a girl for a day and being an official for a day is not bad. Besides, Su Anhua is young, so there is really no need to be too anxious.
Xu Shiyan understood as soon as he heard it, and nodded quickly, "Well, I thought so too, it's too early."
There is only one belief in Xu Shiyan, what the wife says is the truth, no matter what the daughter-in-law says, he will listen to it, and if the daughter-in-law says no, then it will not work.
Su Anying was amused by Xu Shiyan, and glared at him.
"Come on, go to the barber shop and shave your head and face. Look at what you made. When the two children come back, they shouldn't look for you."
Generally speaking, if an elder in the family passes away, the children and grandchildren should not cut their hair or shave within five or seven days. Many people rush to shave their heads or something after the funeral.
Xu Shiyan is a grandson, so he is not included in this list, besides, he has to go around busy, how can he be made like a savage?
Xu Shiyan looked in the mirror, and it turned out that his hair had grown and his beard was unshaven.
"Come on, you are coaxing the kids at home, I'll go to the barber shop. Is there anything you want to eat? I'll buy something along the way."
"No, there is nothing missing at home, you can shave your head quickly, take a bath in hot water at night, and change your clothes."
Knowing Xu Shiyan's temper, Su Anying hurriedly said that she didn't need to buy anything, and just like that, kicked Xu Shiyan out of the house.
The commune has a shaving shed. At this time, the head is shaved forty-five cents, and the face is also shaved.
The shaving master was very skilled, and the manual clippers were very smooth, and he gave Xu Shiyan a flat head.
Then dipped in soap foam with a brush, brushed it on the upper and lower lips and cheeks, held a razor in hand, and shaved off the beard with a few brushes.
Not only that, but even the nose, ears and eyes were shaved.
After tidying up everything, and coming out of the shaving shed cleanly and comfortably, I feel refreshed.
It happened that the shaving shed was not far from the store, so Xu Shiyan went in and walked around, bought some candy and biscuits for his daughter and daughter, and walked back with a paper bag.
As soon as I walked near the tomb of the martyrs, I found a group of children who didn't know what they were doing in the open space in front of the tomb of the martyrs.
There was a lot of noise, and it seemed that someone else started to fight.
This group of children looks like the older ones are only six or seven years old, and the younger ones may be three or four years old.
Children in these years are free-range, and they can go home to eat when it is time to eat. The rest of the time, they can go wild wherever they like.
The adults in the family are very busy, who has time to take care of them?
The children run wildly outside all day, and they are all made like mud monkeys, and they have to be scolded when they go home.
But tomorrow morning, I still run out, and I don’t have any memory.
Everyone's childhood was like this, Xu Shiyan didn't think much of it, so he didn't intend to meddle in other people's business, smiled and shook his head before heading home.
Before he could walk over, he suddenly felt something was wrong.
Among the group of children, there seems to be someone in a pink skirt who is wrestling together?
Powder skirt? Does his daughter have a pink skirt?
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan couldn't calm down anymore. He walked up to him a few steps and shouted loudly.
"What are you doing? Are you going against the sky? Do you still dare to fight?"
They were all children. As soon as they heard that an adult was coming, all the spectators around ran away, leaving only the few who scuffled together in the middle.
Xu Shiyan saw it, okay, his eldest son got entangled with a six or seven-year-old boy.
The boy grabbed Xu Haiyuan's shoulders and pressed his head against Xu Haiyuan's chest. Xu Haiyuan grabbed the other person's hair tightly and pulled it back.
On the other side, the daughter of his family was not idle, and was torn together with a four or five-year-old boy.
The boy pulled Xu Jinping's braid, and Xu Jinping lowered her head and bit the boy's arm hard, making the boy cry in pain.
Beside, Huang Shuqing, the son of Huang Shengli's family, and Sun Yu, the son of Feng Chao's family, also fought with others, and it was a mess anyway.
"Stop it all, what are you doing?"
Xu Shiyan has black lines all over his head, so such a young child started fighting? All of them, why are they so wild?

chapters.title: Chapter 221: lesson
chapters.content:
Chapter 221 Lesson
Seeing that it was Xu Shiyan, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping immediately let go of their hands, and approached Xu Shiyan with a guilty conscience.
"dad."
When Xu Jinping called out her father, the tears came out immediately, and she didn't know whether she was scared or wronged.
"Yuanyuan, what's going on? We're all friends playing together, why are we still fighting?"
Xu Shiyan lowered his face and asked his son.
"He deliberately threw mud spots on my sister's skirt, and he plucked my sister's braids."
Xu Haiyuan pointed to the two boys opposite with an angry look on his face.
Xu Shiyan glanced at the two boys, somewhat impressed.
These children should be the children of the staff of the grain depot. They live in the family room of the grain depot near the primary school, on the west side of the road to the martyrs' cemetery.
It is definitely a good job to work in the grain depot these days.
The staff of the grain depot looked down on the old farmers, and most of their children played together, rarely with the children at the east end of the martyrs' tomb.
I don’t know what’s going on today, but we all came to the Martyrs’ Tomb to play, and we ended up fighting.
"Uncle Xu, Yuanyuan is welcome, they deliberately bury Pingping's skirt.
Yuanyuan asked them to apologize, and they threw clods, so we did it. "
On the other end, Huang Shuqing, the son of Huang Shengli's family, was afraid that Xu Shiyan would get angry and hit Xu Haiyuan, so he hurried over to explain.
"Yes, don't blame Yuanyuan, they are the first to find something."
Sun Yu, the eldest of Sun Xiaofeng's family, also hurriedly opened his mouth to tell Xu Shiyan what happened.
The Sun family is next door to the Xu family, and the Huang family is also next to the Xu family in Daonan. The adults of the two families get along well, so the children play together all day long.
Huang Shuqing is older, he is seven years old this year, and Sun Yu is six years old.
These two are very like brothers. Every time they play together, they take special care of Xu Haiyuan and his sister.
Especially Xu Jinping, who is good-looking and well-dressed, and the little boys around her are very protective of her.
So today those kids came over to cause trouble, stained Xu Jinping's skirt and pulled her braids.
Huang Shuqing and the others were very angry, so they asked others to reason.
As a result, instead of apologizing, the other party threw stones and soil clods at them.
Regardless of Xu Haiyuan's young age, he has a strong temper, so he just went over to the other party.
Huang Shuqing and Sun Ning saw that it couldn't be left behind, so they also rushed up.
Even the little girl Xu Jinping was not far behind, grabbing the brat who was throwing mud on her skirt, and scratching it with her hand.
Xu Shiyan really didn't know what to say after listening.
Who did the two children of his family follow? Both of them have good tempers, how did they raise such two fiery tempers?
Girl, he knew that she was a powerful person in her previous life, otherwise she wouldn't be able to support such a big family.
Who is this son with? Cough cough, this stuff can't be passed down from generation to generation, right? Xuan, it seems really possible.
Xu Shiyan glanced at the boys across from him, "Are you all hurt?"
Those ones looked bigger than this one, but they were all in a mess, with their heads covered in dirt.
The boy who pinched Xu Jinping's braid just now had a few red marks on his face. Needless to say, he must have been scratched.
Except for the youngest one, the others all shook their heads.
Originally, this matter was unreasonable, and they were still young, so not only did they not win, but they also suffered losses.
They all felt ashamed, even if they were hurt, they couldn't admit it.
"Why are you crying? You have the face to cry after being bitten by a girl doll?"
The older one kicked the youngest angrily when he saw that the youngest was crying.
"It's all about you, I'm just idle every day, let's go, go home." As he said, he held that little neck by the collar, and just left.
Seeing the group of children leaving, Xu Shiyan looked down at his son and daughter.
"Both of you, come home with me, and let your mother see you two doing this later. It will be strange if she doesn't beat you up."
Xu Shiyan is not willing to beat up his daughter, what can he do? I can only move my wife out to scare people.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan walked in front, and Xu Haiyuan followed behind, holding hands.
Huang Shuqing and Sun Yu saw it, and obediently followed behind.
Arrived outside the gate of Xu's house, Huang Shuqing and Sun Yu hurriedly said, "Uncle Xu, we are home."
"Well, pat the soil on your body carefully before entering the house."
Xu Shiyan didn't look back, he just snorted, as a reminder to those two.
Nowadays, it is common for children to fight outside.
Whether you win or lose outside, you don’t tell when you go home.
If you say it, you will definitely be beaten. If you don’t say it, you will be fooled if you don’t keep it clean.
Of course, if the body is damaged, you won't be able to run away and you will be beaten.
Who is not busy? How can there be time to wash clothes for children all day long?
Besides, isn’t that soap money? The clothes are made of cotton, and the more they are washed, the thinner they become, won't they be torn? Is it that easy to make a new dress?
Most adults don’t care about children, they care about clothes. It doesn’t matter if you lose in a fight, but if your clothes are dirty or torn, that’s not okay.
When Huang Shuqing and Sun Yu heard this, they quickly patted the dirt on their bodies with their hands.
The two of them checked each other to make sure they were all slapped off before going home.
As for whether the two children will be beaten when they go back, I don't know.
"Daughter-in-law, come out and take care of it. These two children go out to fight with others. You can see how to deal with it."
A father can’t easily beat a child. One is that a man doesn’t know how to deal with it, so it’s easy to beat him hard and cause accidents.
One more thing, men should be used as the last weapon, and they cannot be used until something really big happens.
Otherwise, if you beat the child, it will be even more difficult to manage in the future.
Mothers love their children dearly, even if they beat them, they are reluctant to be cruel. For trivial matters, only the daughter-in-law can come forward to teach them a lesson.
Another point is that this child is the flesh that fell from his mother, and he is partial by nature.
Many women are like this. I gave birth to the child, and I can hit it. You, a father, can't hit it. If you hit me, I will be anxious with you.
Xu Shiyan knew this well, so he yelled at his wife when he entered the door.
Su Anying was peeing on the child in the house. When she heard the movement outside, she quickly wrapped the child and put it on the kang, and came out of the house.
"Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, what did you two do? Are you courageous? How dare you fight?
Look at what you two made, what happened to rolling in the mud?
Xu Jinping, your aunt just made that dress for you, and you just washed it. See what you did to it, can it still come out after washing? "
As expected, Su Anying's first concern is clothes.
"Mom, I don't dare anymore, never again."
The little girl was terribly frightened by her father just now, but now seeing her mother's angry face, she was so frightened that she burst into tears.
When the girl cried, Xu Shiyan couldn't stand it anymore, so he quickly winked at his daughter-in-law.
"Ahem, that, that." Xu Shiyan signaled his daughter-in-law to teach his son not his daughter.
Su Anying gave Xu Shiyan an angry look.
The worst thing is the man in her family, who pretends to be a good person in front of the children all day long, and she is the one who does the bad.
"Xu Haiyuan, what's the matter with you? Why are you leading your sister out to fight?
I see you as a brat, you deserve a beating, I must beat you today. "
Su Anying was half-truthful, picked up the sweeping broom behind the door, held her big head, and pointed the broom handle at Xu Haiyuan.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 222: cheating
chapters.content:
Chapter 222 cheating father
As the third generation of the Xu family, is Xu Haiyuan someone who can be easily subdued?
Even if his mother pointed at him with a broom handle, this kid would never bow his head and admit his mistake.
"Who told them to bully my sister? Whoever bullies my sister, I will beat him."
In Xu Haiyuan's world, there is no right or wrong, he only remembers one sentence.
"My dad said before that I want to protect and love my sister, and no one can bully my sister."
Su Anying was choked and glared at Xu Shiyan angrily.
"Everything I say is for nothing, your dad is good at talking, right?
Okay, let your dad tell you, I don’t understand today, don’t come in the house and don’t eat. "
After Su Anying finished speaking, she threw the broom on the ground and went into the house.
Xu Shiyan didn't expect it, he was tricked by his five-year-old son, and now he can't laugh or cry.
"Come on, son, let's chat." Xu Shiyan took his son's hand, and the two sat on the wooden pier.
Xu Jinping stretched her head to look into the room, thought for a while, and sat on the wooden pier with her father and brother.
"Is it fun to fight today?"
Xu Shiyan didn't discipline his son, but instead talked to his son in a pleasant manner, and reached out to help his son wipe off the ashes on his face.
"It's not fun." Xu Haiyuan pursed his lips and shook his head.
"It's hard for him to hit me." Xu Haiyuan pointed to his chest.
Xu Haiyuan is only four years old and three months old, but he has been taller than children of the same age since he was a child.
In addition, the living conditions of the Xu family are not bad, and Xu Haiyuan is quite strong, so he looks like he is over six years old.
For such a small thing, if he fights with older children, can he still suffer a little bit?
This kid is just stubborn, he takes soft things but not tough ones.
Su Anying called him just now, but he refused to give in. At this moment Xu Shiyan asked Yan Yuese, he couldn't help telling his father about his grievances.
"Come on, Dad, take a look."
Xu Shiyan lifted his son's clothes and took a look, but there was nothing unusual.
Even if the child is older, his strength is still limited, so he won't be really hurt.
However, Xu Shiyan still pretended to rub his son.
"Look, fighting isn't that fun, is it?
Actually, even if you win the battle, aren’t you also injured yourself? What a pain. "
Xu Shiyan raised his hand and rubbed the top of his son's head.
"Dad did say that you should protect and love my sister.
Your sister was bullied and you beat her back, which is not wrong.
However, fighting is not the only way, and, before fighting, you have to judge whether you will suffer a disadvantage.
If you feel that the possibility of suffering is relatively high, can you find other ways? "
Xu Shiyan feels that educating children is really a tangled matter.
For example, children fighting today, is it right or wrong? You were bullied when you were away from home, do you want to fight back?
It is enjoyable to fight violence with an eye for an eye, but it is very likely to put yourself in a greater crisis.
If there were not Huang Shuqing and Sun Yu today, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping would have been beaten up if they dared to fight with others.
Then should we persuade the children to endure? It's also very confusing.
In case the child listens to the words, he always endures and does not resist when encountering things in the future. In that case, it will only make the other party more and more arrogant and worse.
So the speed in the middle is too difficult to grasp.
Xu Haiyuan tilted his head, thinking about his father's proposal, "Then should I come back to find my mother? Let my mother find their adults?"
After finishing speaking, the little guy curled his lips and frowned.
"It's too troublesome. I don't need my mother to come forward for this matter. It can be done with one fist."
In the little guy’s mind, those detours are too troublesome and ineffective, so it’s better to be more direct.
Yes, after talking for a long time, it is tantamount to talking for nothing.
Xu Shiyan looked at the sky speechlessly, how did he raise such a thing?
Are you influenced by grandpa? That's not right, the child's grandfather lives on the mountain as an adult, how many days does he come back all year round?
Besides, the old man's temper is much better now, he doesn't get angry very much, he laughs all day long, and he doesn't speak loudly to Xu Shiyan, so it is impossible to affect the child.
Is that genetic inheritance? It's over, if it's hereditary, I'll just wait for the bear to clean up the mess in the future.
"Such a violent brat, I don't know who you are with?" Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand angrily, and poked his finger on his son's forehead.
"Well, I understand it, I can't let you go crazy at home.
The school starts in autumn, you go to study, I will tell Teacher Qi to let you go to the school's Yuhong class. "
Yuhong Class is a saying in this era, but it is actually the preschool class that later generations say.
Nowadays, there is no such thing as a kindergarten. The place where babies are coaxed is called nursery school, and the place where preschool children are taught is called Yuhong Class.
After many years of propaganda that reading is useless, even though the college entrance examination has been resumed for several years, in fact, there are still many people who don't value studying very much.
Especially the rural people, there are quite a few people who think that their children can go to elementary school, as long as they can write a little and do some calculations.
As for sending the child to the Yuhong Class, that's even more nonsense. Spending money to send the child out to be coaxed is money-burning.
Whose children are not outside all day long? Just wait until you are old enough to go to the first grade. What kind of Yuhong class do you go to?
In the Yuhong class of Donggang Primary School, most of them are children of workers.
Especially when both parents are at work, no one is taking care of the children, so they are simply sent to Yuhong Class, at least someone will watch them.
Donggang Primary School requires children to be seven years old before they can go to the first grade.
Yuhong class is to prepare children for the first grade. The teacher will teach the children some pinyin and numbers, so the requirement is that children over six years old can go.
Ordinarily Xu Haiyuan is not old enough, but this child is precocious, much smarter than children of the same age, and should be able to adapt to the Yuhong class.
Anyway, it's not difficult for Xu Shiyan to find someone to send.
For children, parents may not necessarily listen to what they say, but they must obey what the teacher says.
Educating children should not be completely dependent on schools and teachers, but there is nothing wrong with children being educated by teachers at school.
Xu Haiyuan's child is different from other children. It is obviously not a good way to let him be so crazy at home all day long.
It is not a bad thing to study early.
"Study? It's okay. Then I'm not at home, what should my sister do?"
Xu Haiyuan has no aversion to studying, he only misses his sister. He went to study, so there is no one to accompany his sister at home?
"Dad, I'm going to study too."
Sure enough, Xu Jinping pouted on the other end, looking unhappy. She also wants to study, and she still has to go to university.
"Pingping, you are still young, wait for another two years, Dad will send you to Yuhong Class, okay?"
Xu Shiyan was tossed about by the two children, one of them grew up, and the two children were more difficult than the other.
Son, he has a cold face and a vicious mouth. He looks like everyone else is an idiot all day long. With his powerful appearance, he actually knows how to take care of others.
From his treatment of Yang Haoyu, it can be seen that as long as he likes it, he will definitely protect it.
Girl, she looks obedient and obedient, but in fact she is weird and pungent, definitely a little pepper.
Look at her today, she scratched that boy and even took a bite. I don't know what the boy's parents will do when they see it.

chapters.title: Chapter 223: read
chapters.content:
Chapter 223 Reading
At this time when Xu Shiyan was talking with Xu Haiyuan, one of the family rooms of the Xitou Grain Depot.
The hostess was very angry when she saw several red marks on her youngest son's face and neat teeth marks on his arms.
"Whose brat is this? Look at the face scratched by our second child, and there are teeth marks on the arms.
No, I have to find him. Boss, tell me, whose child did you fight with today? "
The eldest son was whipped several times by his mother with a feather duster because of the fight, and it still hurts now.
Hearing my mother ask, I stared at my younger brother fiercely. ,
"As for the old Xu's family at the east end of the martyr's tomb, he was scratched by that little girl.
He chattered and flirted, dumped the little girl with muddy spots, and the second child of the Wu family next door pulled her braids. "
"The little girl's elder brother asked them to apologize, and they both threw clods of dirt. If you don't beat him, who will you beat?"
The elder brother looked at his younger brother, wishing he could kick his feet again.
At that time, when they saw someone beating him, they did it without thinking about anything, and they didn't realize until the beating was over that the co-authorship was caused by these two things.
That's good, I didn't win the war outside, and I had to be beaten when I got home, so I was so angry.
"You **** bastard, you can really be idle.
You deserve it, you still have the face to cry if you let a girl bite you. "When the master heard this, he wished he could kick his son twice.
"I'm telling you, don't lose that person as soon as possible, you are used to this bear thing, and you will be domineering and causing trouble everywhere every day.
Yes, let him suffer a little bit to improve his memory. "The host turned his head and scolded his daughter-in-law, and this matter is over.
On the other side, after Xu Shiyan had some "effective communication" with his son and daughter, he finally persuaded his daughter to go back to school in two years.
Then the three masters tentatively entered the door, Xu Haiyuan carefully looked into the room, and found that his mother was coaxing his younger siblings on the kang.
"Dad, you go in first." Xu Haiyuan retracted his head, pulled Xu Shiyan's clothes, and let his father go in first.
What a big kid, it's really great.
Xu Shiyan raised his hand, rubbed his son's little head vigorously, and then walked into the house.
"Daughter-in-law, when will you eat?" Xu Shiyan came to the kang with a smile, stretched out his hand to grab the feet of the younger son, and teased him.
"What's wrong? Did you guys explain it clearly?" Su Anying glanced at her husband and son, and looked at Xu Shiyan with a half-smile.
This person is becoming more and more out of shape, leading the children to fool around all day long.
"Well, it's clear, school starts in autumn, and Yuanyuan is sent to Yuhong Class, it's time for him to study.
Yuanyuan said, come back from school to teach Pingping, don't they both have something to do? "
This idea was conceived by the two of them to coax Xu Jinping.
As soon as the little girl heard that her brother was going to school and came back to teach her, she decided to go without arguing.
Su Anying nodded, "Well, send it, children study is the right way."
Su Anying couldn't study by herself, what she envied most was that others went to school.
Don't say that the family conditions are good now, even if the family conditions are not good, the children have to study when they should.
"Yuanyuan come here." Su Anying waved to Xu Haiyuan and asked her son to come forward.
Xu Haiyuan obediently walked to the kang, lowered his head, "Mom, I was wrong, I shouldn't fight today."
This is an agreement with my father, and I have to apologize to my mother when I enter the house.
"Mom, I was wrong too." Xu Jinping looked at her mother with a pitiful look on the other end.
Even if Su Anying was angry again, seeing her son and daughter like this, her anger disappeared.
What's more, she wasn't that angry.
In Su Anying's view, it's not a problem for children to be wild at all. If others bully them to the top and don't resist, what can they do?
As long as the child doesn't go out to make trouble, steal things, bully others on purpose, or get into fights occasionally, it's not a big problem, and it's okay to turn a blind eye and close one eye.
Of course, parents have to show their attitude.
Fighting is an incorrect behavior, and it is enough for children to have this cognition.
"Well, it's good to know that you're wrong. That's it, change your clothes quickly, wash your hands and prepare to eat."
There is a limit to teaching children. If you talk about the truth, children don't like to hear it, and adults don't like it.
It’s enough that it’s almost the same, and talking too much will annoy everyone.
Just like that, Su Anying found clean clothes for the two children and put them on.
At this time, Xu Shiqin also came back, and hurriedly served the meal, and the family ate affectionately.
Turn on the radio again, and listen to a storytelling. These days are quite enjoyable.
The second day after returning home, Xu Shiyan went to another field to check on the fertilizer fermentation.
When Na Licheng met Xu Shiyan, it was like meeting a relative. He followed Xu Shiyan, and various problems emerged one after another.
There are some problems that Xu Shiyan can talk about, and some problems that cannot be solved now at all, or problems that cannot be solved at Xu Shiyan's level, he can only avoid answering.
One ginseng field, commune ginseng field, several brigades, you have to go to see each place, and you have to lead people to turn the fertilizer to make the fertilizer ferment as completely as possible.
It's been several days since I finished this round.
Xu Chenghou and his wife also came back from Daying, and then Xu Chenghou went back to the mountain to continue watching ginseng. Xu Shiyan was busy running around ginseng fields and farms.
In the blink of an eye, it entered August, and after the beginning of autumn, I began to feel cool in the morning and evening, and the daytime was still very hot.
At this time, it is a good time to dry vegetables in the crop yard.
Together with Su Anying and Su Anhua, Zhou Guilan picked a lot of eggplants, beans, and cucumbers while the children were sleeping, cut them up and put them outside to dry, then dried them and stored them for winter or spring.
On August 20th, elementary school starts.
Xu Shiyan found Teacher Qi from elementary school and sent Xu Haiyuan to study in Yuhong Class.
The teacher of Yuhong class didn't want to accept Xu Haiyuan because he was young.
Teacher Qi spoke up, but he was too embarrassed to refuse, so he could only agree to let Xu Haiyuan stay and try.
Thus, Xu Haiyuan was arranged in the first row to study with a group of seven-year-old children.
After a day, the teacher found that despite Xu Haiyuan's young age, his mind was quite good.
What the teacher taught, other children couldn't remember, but he remembered it clearly.
No matter what time it is, the teacher also likes smart children. This time, he doesn't dislike Xu Haiyuan for being too young. Instead, he assigns Xu Haiyuan some small tasks every day.
Xu Haiyuan thinks going to school is very interesting. He can play with a group of children and learn things, so he looks forward to going to school every day.
In the first few days, Su Anhua was worried and went to deliver it, but later Xu Haiyuan refused, feeling too shameful.
The little guy carries the small schoolbag made by his aunt on his back every day, with two notebooks and a pencil case inside, and happily goes to school by himself.
Go home to eat at noon, go to school by myself in the afternoon, and go home by myself without being picked up after school.
Xu Haiyuan keeps his word. Every day when he goes home, he tells his sister what he learned in class, such as pinyin, numbers, ancient poems, etc. He comes back every day to teach his sister.
This child has a good memory, and the teacher taught him word for word, and he was especially good-looking when he taught his younger sister.
Xu Jinping doesn't think she is small, but she is not sloppy in her studies. It is much more worry-free than before for the two children to teach the other.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: rainstorm
chapters.content:
Chapter 224 Heavy Rain
Woke up early in the morning on August 26th, it was raining heavily outside.
Xu Shiyan looked at the rain and the gloomy weather outside, and his heart became heavier.
"Daughter-in-law, you stay at home. I'll go to Uncle Yu's house. I have something to do."
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan lost his composure, put on his raincoat and went out.
"Yuanyuan, don't go to school today, it's raining too much." Before leaving, Xu Shiyan told his son.
Xu Haiyuan really wanted you to go to school with an umbrella just now, but Dad said so, and he didn't hold back.
"Oh, Dad, please ask me for a leave." The little guy is very particular and knows how to ask for leave.
"Yes, I see." Xu Shiyan responded and left the house.
Go to school and talk to the teacher first, and then go to Yu Shouguang's house.
"Uncle, there is something wrong with the rain, hurry up and call people to Xiaoheihe.
Also, the residents along the Hetao should move quickly, first to the homes of relatives and friends. "Xu Shiyan said loudly as soon as he entered the door.
Yu Shouguang looked at the rain outside at home, and was also worried. It rained so heavily that it kept falling, so how did he do the work in the field?
"Xiao Xu, it's you. What's wrong? Do you think the rain can continue?" Yu Shouguang asked Xu Shiyan in surprise.
"Uncle, I'm not afraid of 10,000, just in case. I see that the weather is not right, and the rain may not stop for a while.
Hurry up and call someone, we would rather waste our efforts than let the members suffer losses. "
That is not a feeling, but a certainty.
In the previous life, from August 26th to 28th, 1982, there was heavy rain in the Fusong area, and the water levels of the Toudao Songhua River and Songjiang River rose sharply.
Xu Shiyan was still in the big house at that time. Although Xu's house was by the river, it was built on a high place and was not flooded.
But when the water level was the highest, it was not far from his home.
Xu Shiyan watched the torrenting flood rush down with poultry, livestock, furniture and clothing, and a large number of trees.
After the flood, many people went to Jiangwan to pick up things.
Not to mention anything else, just firewood can be picked up much longer.
At that time, you don’t have to drag the firewood back when you pick it up. You just need to tie a willow root, and others will know that it belongs to the owner, and they won’t move.
After that rain, Xu Shiyan picked up a large stack of firewood, which shows how serious the upstream flood was, and a large number of trees were washed down.
The city of Fusong was even worse. I heard that the entire Erxian County was surrounded by floods, and many areas were flooded. Some places in the town and suburban communes were severely affected.
The experience of the past few years told Yu Shouguang that he was right to listen to Xu Shiyan.
Originally, he was worried that there would be problems with the rain, but when he heard what Xu Shiyan said, how could he sit still?
So they quickly put on their raincoats, and the two hurried to the team headquarters, and then shouted with loudspeakers.
First, the families were notified to send young and strong laborers to gather to prepare to go up the mountain, and then the residents along the Huangni River were notified to immediately pack up their things and evacuate to higher places.
As soon as the second brigade shouted, the first and third brigades also noticed something was wrong, and the secretaries of the two brigades hurried over to inquire.
As soon as they heard that it was Xu Shiyan's suggestion, the secretaries of the two brigades immediately went back to mobilize their members to prepare for flood fighting in advance.
"Xiao Xu, don't go to Xiaoheihe, hurry up, go to the commune and tell Secretary Chen what you think.
It depends on what Secretary Chen means, and whether he needs to report to the county. "
Yu Shouguang saw that Xu Shiyan was also going to Xiaoheihe with everyone, dragged him back, and let him go to the commune.
"Oh, okay, I see."
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, thinking that Secretary Chen could listen to him? The secretary of the commune is not Yu Shouguang, and Xu Shiyan may not be trusted by others.
But think about it again, don't care whether you listen or not, he gave advice.
Once Secretary Chen adopts it? At least it can reduce the loss a little, right?
Just like that, Xu Shiyan ran all the way from the headquarters of the Second Brigade to the commune.
It happened to be at work right now, and many people came in and out with umbrellas and raincoats.
Xu Shiyan went directly to Secretary Chen's office, knocked on the door and entered.
"Secretary Chen, well, I have something to report to you." Xu Shiyan said as soon as he entered the door.
Chen Jianzhang, Secretary of Donggang Commune, is arranging today's work. Seeing Xu Shiyan coming in, Chen Jianzhang was quite surprised.
"Xiao Xu, why are you here? What's going on in your team?"
"Secretary Chen, this rain is unusual, and I am worried that there will be floods. Look, should I ask the weather station or the county?"
Xu Shiyan didn’t say that he was certain that there was a storm and flood. He didn’t have that weight in the commune, so he suggested that Chen Jianzhang ask the weather station.
Less than 500 meters to the east from the tomb of the martyrs, there is a national benchmark weather station, which was newly built a few years ago.
There are various settings and instruments inside, which are used to detect the weather and record meteorological data.
At the end of August, autumn has already entered, and it is not a dog day. According to the local climate, there should not be too much rain.
But Chen Jianzhang looked at the rain outside the window, frowned, simply picked up the phone on the desk, and shook the handle next to it, "Hey, connect me to the Donggang Weather Station."
Not long after, the operator connected the Donggang Weather Station.
Chen Jianzhang asked people, will this rain continue? How long is it expected to last?
As a result, the person in charge of the weather station hesitated and couldn't say anything, and couldn't give any advice.
Annoyed, Chen Jianzhang dropped the phone and hung up, "It's nothing, I don't know what is the use of building a weather station there."
"Xiao Xu, well, what is your team Yu Shouguang doing?"
Chen Jianzhang suddenly remembered the matter of Anti-Shuang that year. At that time, the person in front of him made a suggestion, Yu Shouguang responded quickly, and the second brigade did not suffer any losses.
This time, that old boy Yu Shouguang won't do things in a muffled manner again, will he?
"Oh, our team secretary led people to organize the evacuation of residents along the Huangni River, and sent people to Xiaohei River to visit the land.
The first group and the third group should also arrange for people to evacuate along the bank of the Hetao. "There's nothing to hide about this, Xu Shiyan told the truth.
"Our secretary arranged for me to come here and report to Secretary Chen to see what the commune has planned."
What else does Chen Jianzhang not understand? After the first team and the third team suffered losses, they are now watching the second team do things.
Whatever the second brigade does, the other two brigades will follow suit, for fear of being left behind.
As for Yu Shouguang of the Second Brigade, he especially listened to Xu Shiyan's words.
So, these three brigades went directly to work without passing through the commune.
"Okay, I will immediately arrange for someone to notify the Xijiang, Yanjiang, and Xinhua brigades about this matter."
These three brigades are located along the Songhua River in Toudao. In the event of an accident, these three brigades will be the most vulnerable.
While talking, Chen Jianzhang picked up the phone again and called the county.
"Hey, Secretary Guan, what's going on, does the county meteorological bureau have any early warning for today's rain?"
Chen Jianzhang couldn't directly give advice to his superiors, so he turned a corner and asked his superiors for their opinions.
"Hmm, um, nothing else, I just feel that the rain is not normal.
Several brigades in our commune have already started to make preparations in advance. I am not sure, so I ask the leader for instructions. "
The rain started at 5:30 in the morning, and it's only 8:00 now.
Most people didn't realize it, and just thought it was an autumn rain. After all, not everyone is like Xu Shiyan, who has previous life experience.

chapters.title: Chapter 225: flood
chapters.content:
Chapter 225 Flood
When the rain first started to fall, no one cared about it, at most they just complained.
It’s raining so much, I can’t go out again today. Not only can't I go out today, I'm afraid it will be difficult to go outside for the next few days.
After all, there are yellow mud roads everywhere in Donggang. When it rains, there are yellow mud soup everywhere. It is really inconvenient to go out.
Otherwise, there would be no such thing as "Come to Donggang Township, Huangni slipped your crotch."
But when the heavy rain continued until evening, many people realized that something seemed wrong.
Those who lived along the Huangni River and were persuaded to evacuate by the brigade sent people originally complained that they thought the brigade was looking for trouble when there was nothing to do, and they were just messing around.
Now I don’t say much anymore, I huddle in the house of relatives and friends, looking at the rain outside, I start to feel happy secretly.
Thanks to the early move, the river water is probably high now, and they don’t know if their house is flooded?
Donggang Commune organized militiamen and young and strong laborers to patrol along the river with flashlights.
Looking at the river water like yellow mud soup mixed with dead trees and branches roaring past like ten thousand horses galloping, everyone's hearts jumped.
This scene is really a bit scary.
Just as I was thinking about it, I heard a click in front of me, as if there was something breaking.
Everyone hurriedly looked forward with flashlights, only to find that a wooden bridge in front was broken.
It may be that the wooden piles have rotted for too long, and they were suddenly broken by the flood, and then the whole bridge broke like this, and the bridge deck rushed down along the water.
"Grass, thanks to the withdrawal of people from the other side of the river, otherwise the bridge will be broken and the water will still be heavy, so there is no way to come over."
A group of militiamen on patrol saw them, and sighed with great gratitude.
"Yeah, thanks to the quick response of our brigade, we evacuated in time, otherwise, it would have been quite dangerous.
I don’t know, what’s going on at the other end of Xiaoheihe? "These patrolling people are all members of the second brigade, walking forward and talking.
"It shouldn't be a problem, the Xiaohei River is quite high, and it's quite far away from the river.
I was afraid that there would be heavy rain on the mountain and the water in the road would be too deep.
Didn’t our secretary take people to the mountain? They must have dug a ditch, as long as the water can get out without flooding the mallets. "
Everyone thought about the topography of Xiaoheihe Candi, and thought it should be nothing serious.
On Xiaoheihe Mountain, Yu Shouguang and his men dug a ditch in the rain for a whole day.
By night, at least all the horse trails were cleaned up, and deep drainage ditches were dug around the ginseng ground.
Ginseng land is not a flat river, but a hillside. As long as the drainage ditches are dug, the rainwater will flow out along the horse path and the drainage ditch, and will not be accumulated in the horse path, then it will be fine.
"Don't sleep tonight, patrol around with a flashlight, if you find a ditch that is not working, call someone to clean it up.
Grit your teeth and hold on, but you must keep our mallet. "
It was getting dark, and Yu Shouguang didn't dare to go down the mountain, so he led his people to stand guard on the mountain.
The hopes of more than 1,700 people from all over the team are all participating in this area. If they are flooded, how will they live in the next three years?
"I don't know, how is the farm of our third child?
There is a big bubble at his end. If the water floods up, all the animals raised there will drown except otters. "
Xu Chenghou looked at the heavy rain outside and was worried. If it went on like this, he was afraid that the farm would be ruined.
"Hey, God, it's really not perfect, let people live?"
"Brother Xu, don't worry, your family is a successful man, he must know it well.
I didn’t let him come up today, probably at the farm right now. Seeing Xu Chenghou's worried face, Yu Shouguang could only comfort him.
Yu Shouguang guessed correctly, Xu Shiyan is really at the farm.
With such a heavy rain, he must go to the farm to sit in charge.
When selecting the site for the farm, Xu Shiyan had thought about flooding.
So the forage planting area was placed on a flat and open land, and the animal pens were placed on a sunny hillside.
