The big paozi where the fish were raised had a few drainage ditches reserved when it was being repaired, but they were not used normally, and they were all blocked.
At noon, Xu Shiyan dug a drainage ditch with a few blind people. After seeing things bad in the afternoon, he dug the other one.
At night, Xu Shian didn't think it was going to work, so he discussed with Xu Shiyan, and then dug up the last one.
"Well, let's dig it up. Don't be afraid to lose a few fish. We can raise them again if the fish are gone. If this farm is flooded, years of hard work will be wasted."
Xu Shiyan looked at the rain that was still falling outside and nodded, so a group of people came to the last drain, waved the shovel, and dug the drain.
The last drainage ditch has the lowest terrain, and the ditch is also wide, so when this ditch is dug, the water level of Paozi will no longer rise.
Everyone finally breathed a sigh of relief, and stared here for a while, making sure there was no danger, and then went back to rest.
This night, I don’t know how many people were sleepless all night, all staring at the dark night sky outside, praying in their hearts that God would open their eyes and stop going down.
However, the facts disappointed everyone. It was still raining, and it rained from the 26th to the 28th.
In this rain, the average rainfall was more than 210 millimeters, and the average rainfall in Manjiang, Donggang, and Quanyang exceeded 223 millimeters.
The water levels of both the Songhua River and the Songjiang River in Toudao rose sharply. During the flood peak period, the water level rose by more than 30 centimeters per hour, and the peak flow rate was 4,800 cubic meters per second.
The houses and crops in the low-lying areas were all soaked in the water, causing heavy losses.
Fortunately, the county took timely measures to organize the evacuation of the masses in advance, and it was lucky that there were no casualties.
The rain stopped, the flood slowly receded, and there was a mess everywhere.
The commune and the brigade quickly called on everyone to clean up the flooded land and raise the crops that were washed down by the water.
Bridges and roads will need to be rebuilt, and houses that cross the water will also need to be rebuilt.
This busy, ten days and a half months passed in a blink of an eye. After all this work is over, it's time for the autumn harvest.
Crops are divided into plots, those that have been flooded will not be harvested temporarily, and those that have not been flooded will be harvested in batches according to maturity.
On September 16th, the Xiaoheihe ginseng field began to produce ginseng.
This year there are a total of more than 4,500 feet of sticks, and all of them are made of base fertilizer. Last year, the fertilizer was added. When the sticks came out of the ground, everyone was shocked.
Those with the first and second roads planted in the ground, there are many sticks in twos and fours.
The heaviest one weighed more than half a catty, and it was directly taken away by Yu Shouguang, scrubbed, soaked in wine, and sent to Li Jianzhang's office.
This is a milestone in the development of the second brigade's participation in the industry. It must be kept as a specimen, and it cannot be sold as a commodity.
and other ginseng are all grown out, and the total output is counted. After applying fertilizer, the output can be increased by more than 50% per foot of ginseng.
The production of 4,500 feet of ginseng in the second brigade can catch up with the previous 7,000 feet. This is definitely a huge leap.
The news was reported to the county, and the county leaders discussed and decided that this year's advanced collectives would be returned to the Second Brigade of Donggang Commune.
Of course, compared with honors, the members of the Second Brigade care more about work points.
With such a high output of sticks this year, each family can earn a lot of money.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: to worry about
chapters.content:
Chapter 226 Worry
"Xiao Xu, I have discussed with the captains of our team. When this year's clubs are sold for money, I will give you a bonus separately.
Without you taking the lead in this ginseng fertilizer, how could our team have the current output? You deserve a lot of credit.
We don't care about other places, anyway, the team must express it. "
During the meeting of the second brigade, Yu Shouguang publicly stated in front of several captains, small captains, accountants and others that he would reward Xu Shiyan.
You know, in the past, a ten-foot ginseng real estate was considered high-yielding.
What about now? A good piece of land can lift twenty-six to seven kilograms, and a poor one can also lift twenty-two to three kilograms.
The second brigade makes goods at 4,500 feet, how much will the increase be?
And this is not a simple increase of tens of percent. You must know that the larger the ginseng, the higher the grade of the product.
The higher the grade, the higher the price, and the income is definitely much higher than the increase in production.
"Uncle Yu, it's easy to say whether there is a bonus or not.
I just went to the processing factory and wandered around. The processing method of that big product is wrong. "
Xu Shiyan really didn't take bonuses or anything to heart.
How many rewards can be given to individuals this year? At most a hundred dollars, does he care about that?
"Huh? What's wrong?"
Yu Shouguang and the others were stunned when they heard this. Isn’t that the case with all the manufacturers? Steam it out and dry it, what else can I do?
"Uncle, those big ones are different. The three or four two sticks are too big, and they are easy to crack when steamed.
Once the mallet is cracked, it will not be able to make good products, and it will not be able to sell at a high price. "
The mallet is big, full of pulp, and high in starch and other substances. Once steamed, it is easy to split longitudinally, which is what Xu Shiyan said.
If the mallet is cracked, it will leave marks even if it is dried in the sun. When the grade is checked, it will not be tested, and good products will not be sold at a high price.
"Oh, what should I do?" Hitting the petals, everyone knows what's going on.
In the past, the output of ginseng land was low, and occasionally a few large trees came out and were steamed, so I made this mistake.
But it was rare in the past, and it was just like that when they got together, and no one cared.
Nowadays, the output is so high, and there are so many big ones, it would be a pity if all of them were steamed.
"Use a cloth strip, one finger wide, to wrap the main body of the mallet tightly, and then steam it in a pan.
After steaming and cooling thoroughly, untie the cloth strips to dry, so that it is not easy to beat the petals. "
This trick was thought up by the eldest daughter of his family in the previous life.
At that time, the output of sticks was high. In order to prevent the sticks from cracking petals, Xu Jinping tried to wrap cloth strips around the sticks and tied them tightly.
It’s troublesome, too much effort, but there’s no way, in order to sell more money, it takes effort.
"Wrapped with cloth strips? How many cloth strips and how many people are there? Can you get busy?" asked the person next to him.
"Then what can I do? Look for it from door to door, old clothes and sheets, anything, as long as it doesn't fade.
Mobilize the whole team of men, women and children to work, and this work must be done. "
Xu Shiyan spread his hands. If he wants to make money, he has to spend time and energy.
I want to make more money, but I don’t want to bother. There is no such good thing in the world.
Yu Shouguang heard that it made sense, so why worry about making money? So I immediately yelled in the loudspeaker.
Call on all households to donate old clothes and sheets, work hard, and go to the processing factory to work.
Regardless of men, women, or children, as long as you do a good job, you will definitely get a lot of work points.
Now, a lot of people really called out.
The big guys took their old clothes, or the sheets that were torn in the middle, and tore them into finger-wide strips according to Xu Shiyan's request.
Then use cloth strips to tie up the sticks that are heavy in threes and fours as much as possible, and then put them in a cage and steam them.
Take out a pot of steamed ginseng, put it aside to cool thoroughly, and then put it on the fork while untying the cloth strip.
Not to mention, this trick is really effective, there is really no need to hit the flap.
"Xiao Xu, you can really do it, thanks to you in our brigade, you said that since you moved here, how much time have we big guys followed?
Young man, do a good job, uncle is optimistic about you.
It’s a pity that there are no workers, peasants and soldiers college students anymore, otherwise my uncle would have to recommend you to study at the Agricultural University for two years, what a waste of talent. "
Yu Shouguang encouraged Xu Shiyan while expressing emotion.
"Uncle, I really want to go to school, but it's a pity that I didn't catch up with the good time, right?
Now that the college entrance examination has resumed, my little ink has already been eaten up, and I can't pass the exam. "Xu Shiyan felt sorry.
Actually, he really wants to study, mainly animal husbandry and veterinary medicine.
In the future, the scale of the farm will become larger and larger, and the disease prevention and control will be more stringent.
He is still a layman in these things. If there is a chance, it is best to find a place to learn.
In fact, there are quite a lot of things to learn, not only animal husbandry and veterinary medicine, but also agricultural product processing, extraction of active ingredients of medicinal materials, etc. Xu Shiyan really wants to learn.
Although the Fusong area is rich in ginseng, it has always been a raw material export state.
To be honest, this is really equivalent to being stuck by an outsider, and the price is completely set by the foreign purchaser.
In the past few years, it is still unified purchase and sales, and the output is not high, and nothing can be seen.
Waiting for a few years, the ginseng of each family has developed after the contract is contracted to the household, and the ginseng of various enterprises has also emerged one after another.
The ginseng planting industry has entered a brutal growth period, and the market regulation is not timely, causing ginseng farmers to suppress each other's prices.
In the end, foreign customers can only make a profit, and participate in agriculture and pay for death.
In the past, Xu Shiyan didn't have much ambition, he just wanted to develop his own ginseng land, planting hundreds of thousands of sticks.
Use the experience of your previous life to avoid some pitfalls and just live your happy life.
But what happened in the past few years, especially the promotion of ginseng fertilizer, reminded Xu Shiyan.
Without corresponding measures, the price of ginseng may plummet, which will be earlier than in the previous life.
If it is only the second brigade, or Donggang Commune has mastered the technology of ginseng and fertilizer, even if the production is increased, it will not have a great impact on the overall situation.
But now the entire Erxian County is starting to promote it. How much will the production increase in three years?
In the future, not only the county, but also several nearby counties that also produce ginseng, will definitely learn to promote the use of ginseng fertilizers.
By that time, the output of ginseng will increase significantly, but the purchase volume and purchase price will not rise but fall instead.
Participating in agriculture and not having a good harvest? Will this happen?
Before 1986, the country did not relax restrictions, so it should not have happened, but after 1986, this situation is very likely to happen.
If that's the case, Xu Shiyan's good intentions may turn out to be a bad thing.
As long as Xu Shiyan thought of such a situation, he would feel chills down his back.
He is just an ordinary old farmer with no education or background.
A person who is driven by the times and moves forward passively, how capable is he to resist the torrent of the times?
"Xiao Xu, what are you thinking? Why are you still motionless? Why are you in a daze?"
Yu Shouguang was surprised to see Xu Shiyan standing there in a daze, so he stretched out his hand and pushed Xu Shiyan's shoulder.
"Uncle, please help me pay attention to that, if there are some training courses in our county.
You sign up for me, I have to study. "It may not be easy to go to college, so I can only think of other ways.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: good news
chapters.content:
Chapter 227 Good news
"What do you think, kid? Training class? If there is a training class, you go to give lectures to others.
As far as Shendi is concerned, who else is better than you? What are you going to learn? "Yu Shouguang laughed as soon as he heard it.
"Uncle, it's not just about ginseng technology, but also other things such as animal husbandry, veterinary medicine, agricultural product processing, and deep processing of medicinal materials.
As long as there is relevant training, I want to listen to it. "Xu Shiyan shook his head.
What he wants to learn is not ginseng planting technology, but what he wants to learn is industrial deep processing, how to use the advantages of raw materials to create greater value.
Yu Shouguang was taken aback when he heard the words, "Oh, I have never heard of what you said.
When did our county hold these training courses? It's the first time you've given a lecture, and this stuff sucks. "
Xu Shiyan sighed helplessly. It seems that it is impossible to rely on the brigade for this matter, and he has to find a way by himself.
Xu Shiyan wandered around the processing factory a few more times to confirm that all the workers had mastered the method of wrapping cloth strips around sticks, and then left with Yu Shouguang and others.
After returning home, Xu Shiyan immediately took out a pen and paper, and wrote a letter to Elder Chu.
He told Mr. Chu his confusion and worries about the future prospects of the ginseng industry.
In the past few years, Xu Shiyan and Mr. Chu have been keeping in touch with each other by letter.
Especially after Mr. Chu was asked to submit the article that year, the content of the two chats was also very broad, and they could talk about everything.
Anyway, Elder Chu doesn't find Xu Shiyan annoying, and he is very concerned about Xu Shiyan's confusion. The master and apprentice back then have now become pen pals.
After finishing writing the letter, Xu Shiyan found an opportunity to send it out.
After two days of busy work at the processing plant, I finally wrapped up those big sticks and steamed them.
Slightly smaller ones are unnecessary, just scrub, steam and dry them normally.
Not to mention, after the rain at the end of August, the weather has been good. It hasn’t rained much, and the sun is pretty good, which is just right for drying the sticks.
This red ginseng is dried and can be dried in the sun or dried.
However, the color of the dried mallet is dark and not bright.
Pure sun-dried sticks, bright and translucent in color, high in quality.
Therefore, most of the drying rooms are only used as a last resort in rainy days, but when the weather is good, the sun is enough.
This year, the production of ginseng in the second brigade is high, and the pressure on the processing plant is relatively high, attracting a large number of girls and daughters-in-law to work overtime.
Su Anhua was also placed in the processing factory by Xu Shiyan.
After the dragon and phoenix twins gradually grew up, they were not as noisy as they were when they were young. Su Anying's body recovered, and Zhou Guilan and Zhou Guilan were able to take care of them.
Originally, Su Anhua was going back to Daying, Su Anying consulted with her husband, it is better to arrange Su Anhua to work in a processing factory for a while.
Su Anhua’s return to Daying is the autumn harvest. The work in the field is tiring, and women earn less work points. How can it compare to a processing factory?
Xu Shiyan found someone from the processing factory and asked Su Anhua to work in the name of Su Anying. The work here is high and not tiring, which is just right.
There are too many jobs at this end of the processing plant, and there are not enough manpower in the first place, so I wish more people would come.
As for whether it is Su Anying or Su Anhua, the processing factory doesn't care at all, as long as someone works.
The processing factory is busy drying the goods, cutting beards, and grading. These tasks have nothing to do with Xu Shiyan. His main energy is still on the mountain and the farm.
Especially on the farm side, the forage silage for deer and musk deer starts in summer and is the last wave in autumn.
Due to the impact of the autumn rain, the quality of the forage was not as good as before. Xu Shiyan and his people took some time to put the last batch of silage into the warehouse.
The carrots, cabbage, etc. in the field are also harvested and buried in the field or collected in the cellar to ensure that the deer and musk deer have enough forage for the winter.
The feed for sables, raccoons, and otters has made considerable progress after two years of research.
According to the different developmental stages of animals, the feed configured with meat meal, bone meal, dairy products, fish meal, soybean meal, etc. is also filled in the warehouse to ensure that the animals can be supplied normally in winter.
Before, Xu Shiyan promised his second brother that he would help him develop ginseng. Xu Shian took the time to dig 15 feet of ginseng soil in his backyard.
Originally, Xu Shiyan planned to pick some from Zazilouer and spend money to buy them for Xu Shian to use.
Unexpectedly, this year the second brigade approved less ginseng land, and there were quite a lot of ginseng seeds left.
The remaining ginseng seeds can only be used as goods, which is a pity.
So Xu Shiyan mentioned something to Yu Shouguang, and helped Xu Shian buy dozens of catties of ginseng seeds and ginseng seeds, and helped Xu Shian plant the mallet, which made Xu Shian and his wife very happy.
This ten-foot stick is well taken care of, why can't it be sold for less than two thousand yuan after three years? This is comparable to making money in the vegetable team, who is not happy?
After a busy day, it was the beginning of November, and the first snow fell like this.
And Xu Shiyan also received a letter from Elder Chu.
"Little sister, little sister, Elder Chu wrote a letter saying that there should be a cure for your problem.
You hurry up and ask your master for leave, let's take some time to go to the provincial capital to see a doctor for you. "
Xu Shiyan went down the mountain on business, so he went to the team headquarters first, but when he got there, he found his letter.
Opening it, it was Mr. Chu who said that the correction of the spinal deformity had made progress, and asked Xu Shiyan to take Xu Shiqin to the provincial capital as soon as possible.
There will be a physical examination for Xu Shiqin. If the physical condition permits, he will be hospitalized immediately for surgical correction.
Xu Shiyan was very happy when he saw the content of the letter, and ran home with the letter, and shouted when he entered the door.
Xu Chenghou was still watching ginseng on the mountain, and Zhou Guilan was here all day long to help look after the children before going down the mountain.
Xu Shiqin also came over to help cook and serve the children after get off work. After dinner, the mother and daughter went back to live in the other house.
"Third brother, is it true? Elder Chu really said that my problem can be cured?"
Xu Shiqin came back from get off work and was cooking in the kitchen. Hearing this, he came out of the kitchen with a shovel.
"Look, can I still lie to you? Isn't that what it says? It tells you to go to the provincial capital for a physical examination."
Xu Shiyan handed the letter to his sister and asked her to read it by herself.
Xu Shiqin's hands trembled with excitement, and the two thin sheets of letter paper seemed to weigh more than a thousand catties. As he looked at it, tears couldn't help falling down.
"Brother, my disease can really be cured. Mr. Chu said that they cured a few similar ones. This, isn't it a dream?"
Looking forward day and night, looking forward to these years, finally waiting for good news, how can Xu Shiqin not be excited?
At this moment, her eyes were blurred with tears, but she was smiling. They were tears of joy.
"Yes, Mr. Chu led a research team to cooperate with hospitals in Jinling and the capital to tackle key problems, and finally found a way to correct spinal deformities.
That's why they said, let you go to the provincial capital. Ask for leave tomorrow, let's hurry up and go out. "
Xu Shiyan looked at his younger sister's excited appearance, and laughed himself. It's not easy. After all these years, it's finally here.
"Hey? What does it smell like? What's mushy?"
Xu Shiyan was smiling, when he sniffed his nose suddenly and smelled a sticky smell.
The brothers and sisters hurried to the kitchen, only to find that the cabbage in the pot was not turned over, and it was all mushy.

chapters.title: Chapter 228: hide money
chapters.content:
Chapter 228 Hiding money
The letter from Elder Chu gave everyone in the Xu family hope.
After dinner, Zhou Guilan immediately led Xu Shiqin home, packed up his things and prepared to go out.
"You go out this time, I don't know how long you have to live in the provincial capital, bring a few more clothes."
Zhou Guilan chanted while helping her daughter pack her clothes.
"Wear that purple woolen coat when you leave, let's go out, we can't wear too shabby to make people look down upon."
The coat Zhou Guilan mentioned was a piece of material that Xu Shiyan bought for Zhou Guilan when he went to Tonghua for the first time.
Zhou Guilan felt that the color was too bright and not suitable for an old lady like her, so she never used it.
Isn't this planning to get engaged to Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei this winter?
A while ago, Zhou Guilan dug out the piece of purple-red woolen fabric and asked her daughter to make a coat, so as not to have decent clothes when she got engaged, which would be unsightly.
I didn't expect that before Han Liwei came back to get engaged, news came from the provincial capital, so let's wear it and go to the provincial capital to see a doctor.
Such a big girl can't be too ugly when she is out of the house.
"By the way, send a telegram to Liwei as soon as possible tomorrow, and it is best to ask your third brother to go to Han's house to talk.
伱I don’t know how many months it will take to get medical treatment. If the engagement of the two of you doesn’t work, just postpone it for a while? "
Zhou Guilan suddenly remembered this and reminded Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiqin stopped packing his clothes, "Well, I'll send a telegram to Liwei first, and then write a letter to discuss it with him.
I hope he can agree to postpone the engagement, medical treatment is the most important thing.
As long as there is some hope that I can return to normal, I still want to marry him in a healthy and healthy way.
In order not to be laughed at by others, with such a good young man, don’t find a healthy daughter-in-law. "
This is Xu Shiqin's heart knot. She refused to agree to Han Liwei before, mainly because she was afraid that people would laugh at him.
Now, there is finally hope. No matter how painful it is, Xu Shiqin is willing to try if there is a possibility of recovery.
She only hoped that on the wedding day, she could straighten her back, stand beside Han Liwei, and accept everyone's blessings.
Instead of being laughed at by others, being pointed at by others.
After hearing what her daughter said, Zhou Guilan's eye sockets became hot, and her nose was sore, tears were about to fall.
"Hey, if I had put in more effort back then, how could I have made you suffer this?"
Because of her daughter's hunchback, Zhou Guilan regretted it all her life.
"Mom, what are you talking about? What conditions did our family have at that time?
Six children, my father goes out to work all day long and can’t take care of the family. You wash clothes, cook and chop firewood by yourself, and you have to watch the six of us.
It would be great if we could support all six of us. Who would have thought that there would be accidents? "
When I was young, I did complain about my parents, my brother, and the unfairness of God.
As Xu Shiqin grows older, after Xu Shiqin becomes sensible, he no longer resents and can accept the reality.
Zhou Guilan raised her hand to wipe away her tears, got up and went to the inner room of the east room, and moved a cabinet on the ground to reveal the wall behind.
At the base of the wall, there is a brick whose color is different from the surrounding ones.
Zhou Guilan took down the brick, reached out and took out a cloth bag from inside. In the cloth bag, of course, was the money she had saved over the past few years.
The sons pay pensions every month, from five yuan in the first year, now it has risen to eight yuan a month.
Xu Chenghou went to the mountains to see the ginseng, eating and drinking were all managed by the team, and he also earned high work points.
How much can Zhou Guilan eat at home alone? In the past two years, the family has saved some money.
My daughter is going to see a doctor. This is a major operation. Who knows how much it will cost?
Zhou Guilan counted, and there was a total of 1,200 yuan left at home.
Zhou Guilan gritted her teeth and kept two hundred, and gave all the one thousand yuan to her daughter.
Poor family and rich road, besides, this is for medical treatment, so bring as much as you can.
The third son said that he would give the big head, but how could Zhou Guilan be willing?
Is it so easy for my son to earn some money? In the past two years, what kind of virtue has he been tired of? He was dark and thin, and looked pitiful.
As long as the family can contribute a little bit, they can't make their son pay more.
Zhou Guilan pocketed 1,000 yuan, and wrapped the rest in cloth and stuffed it into the hole in the wall, then plugged it with bricks, and moved the cabinet back.
"Then, this is a thousand dollars, you put it away carefully.
Going out and seeing a doctor, there are a lot of places to spend money, and I don’t know if this little money is enough.
Try to spend the money first. It’s not easy for your third brother to earn money. If you can’t spend it, don’t spend it. "
Zhou Guilan came out from the back room and put the money into the hands of her daughter.
"Mom, you gave me so much money, is it still useful at home?
I have saved some money in the past few years, don't give me so much, five hundred is fine. "
Xu Shiqin started working in the autumn of 1978, and it has been four full years now, and he has already changed from an apprentice to a regular worker.
The salary of the Forestry Bureau is the same as other places, but the subsidy is high. Xu Shiqin now has a salary of 50 yuan a month.
She spends lightly as a girl, eats at home in the morning and evening, and takes care of meals in the store at noon.
Usually just buy some daily necessities, and then go back to buy some fine grains, meat and the like.
Xu Shiqin has always been looking forward to getting medical treatment, so he doesn't spend much on weekdays, and just wants to save more money.
She has almost a thousand yuan in her hand, and she doesn't want to have so much money at home.
"Don't, take it all, you don't know how much you have to spend on this problem, bring more money, and feel at ease."
Zhou Guilan shook her head, bewilderedly giving the money to her daughter.
Xu Shiqin had no choice but to take it, and then the couple began to think about where to put the money.
Such a lot of money can't be carried in a pocket, and even if a pocket is sewn on the underpants, it won't fit.
Finally, Zhou Guilan decided to take apart Xu Shiqin's thin padded jacket.
Divide the money into three parts, and sew the most in the interlayer of the cotton-padded jacket. When waiting for the money to be used, the cotton-padded jacket is unthreaded and taken out.
The other part is put into the pocket of the underpants, and it is also sewn with thread.
The rest are stuffed separately in the socks and under the insoles.
Zhou Guilan's mother and daughter were thinking about hiding money, and Xu Shiyan was doing the same thing on the other side.
Xu Shiyan was not willing to dig a hole in the wall of the new house, he was making a fuss under the ground of the new house.
The floor of the storage room was planed by him and a basement was dug.
It’s not too big, only six to seven square meters, and it’s surrounded by bricks and cement, so it’s quite dry.
Ginseng, money, and several sets of stamps he entrusted to Tao Deng the year before last were all locked in a box in the basement by Xu Shiyan.
In the past two years, the family has spent a lot of money. Besides, isn’t there a basement? Simply did not deposit money in the bank.
There are five thousand yuan in cash at home, so I simply bring all of them. Who knows how much it will cost? Be prepared.
After thinking about it, Xu Shiyan picked another ginseng, and then took it with the ginseng and money.
After taking the money out, Xu Shiyan was in trouble again. How can he get so much money?
There are no hundred-yuan bills in this year and month, they are all ten yuan, and five thousand is five whole bundles.
These five bundles are quite a lot of money, how can they not be conspicuous when they go out with them?
The **** pack can hold almost 3,000, and the remaining 2,000 are stuffed in the back pocket for 5,000 are sewn into the underpants pocket, and 8,000 are sewn in a pocket on the lining of the padded jacket, and the remaining 2,000 are put outside for minor use.
Finally, Xu Shiyan put his hunting knife into his back pocket again.
I don’t know what to encounter when I go out, so I bring a knife and feel at ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Set off
chapters.content:
Chapter 229 Departure
On November 8, 1982, Xu Shiyan went to see Yu Shouguang early in the morning.
Told Yu Shouguang about going out with Xu Shiqin for medical treatment, and wanted Yu Shouguang to write him a letter of introduction.
Nowadays when I go out of town, food stamps are not required in many places for meals, but for accommodation, I need a letter of introduction. Without a letter of introduction, there is no place to live.
Although Qi Yunsheng and Mr. Chu are both in the provincial capital, they can't live with others.
I don’t know how long it will take to go to get medical treatment this time, so I can’t always trouble others.
Yu Shouguang nodded immediately when he heard this, and led Xu Shiyan to the team headquarters, where he gave him a letter of introduction and a stack of food coupons.
“Although food stamps are no longer required in many places, the price is quite expensive.
I still have some food stamps here, you take them all. It’s not easy to go out for a trip. "
Yu Shouguang is a person who lives a life, and he is thoughtful.
Xu Shiyan didn't refuse, Xie Taishouguang took the letter of introduction and food stamps, and hurried home.
After arriving home, they took their bags with Xu Shiqin, and Feng Chao drove the carriage to send them to Songjianghe to find Xu Shiqin's master to ask for leave.
When Xu Shiqin's master heard that he was going to the provincial capital for medical treatment, he nodded in agreement without saying a word, and happily gave the vacation.
"When you get there, you can treat your illness with peace of mind, and you don't have to worry about anything.
When you go out, the master doesn’t give you anything. You take the twenty yuan and food stamps with you. "
"Master, no need, I brought money, and food stamps." How could Xu Shiqin ask for money from the master? busy rejecting.
"What's the matter? You think the master is poor, so you don't give much? Just take it if you let me. Why are we mothers still seeing each other?"
Master Qin's face was gloomy, and he gave Xu Shiqin the money and food coupons in a daze.
"Okay, don't break it with me, go to the car quickly, and you won't be able to catch the car if you are delayed."
Master Qin didn't give Xu Shiqin a chance to refuse, and pushed the siblings out.
"Be careful on the road, there is chaos outside at this time, don't sleep in the car."
Master Qin was worried, and gave a few more instructions. He saw the siblings getting into the carriage with his own eyes, and then turned back to the shop.
Feng Chao shook off his whip, and drove the carriage towards the train station.
I was in a hurry to leave in the morning, and I didn't have time to go to Han's house.
The brothers and sisters were in agreement, and they just waited until they arrived at the provincial capital, checked their bodies to make sure they were ready for surgery, and then sent a telegram to Han Liwei.
No one dares to say that they will be able to cure this time when they go to the provincial capital.
What if it cannot be cured? Then you must go back quickly, and naturally there is no need to inform the Han family.
If it can be cured, I will send a telegram again, so as not to be happy for nothing.
The carriage ran very fast, and arrived at the train station in a short time.
Feng Chao tied the carriage outside the station, and helped Xu Shiyan and his brother and sister send their bags in before driving back.
Xu Shiyan went to buy a ticket to Hunjiang.
Songjianghe does not have a direct train to the provincial capital yet, so it has to reverse from Hunjiang or Tonghua.
It took some time to ask for leave in the morning and issue a letter of introduction, so it didn’t take long after buying the ticket, and the ticket was checked at the other end.
At 8:40, the train pulled into the station, and Xu Shiyan carried Xu Shiqin's big and small bags on his shoulders, protecting Xu Shiqin and getting on the train.
In this year and month, there is no need to be seated, as long as you have a ticket, you can sit anywhere.
Fortunately, there were not too many people going out at this time, so the brother and sister found an empty seat and sat down, and put their luggage on the shelf.
Originally, Zhou Guilan wanted Xu Shiqin to go out in that fuchsia woolen coat, but was stopped by Xu Shiyan.
They brought a lot of money when they went out this time, so they have to be more careful, and wear a woolen coat, what's the matter? Show off your money?
When you go out, the better you dress, the more you will attract thieves. Now the outside is not the same as it was a few years ago, it is very chaotic.
There is no robbery on the train, but there are so many thieves, so don't let the thieves stare at them.
So Xu Shiyan wore the ragged padded jacket he used to work in the mountains, patched layer upon layer, and Xu Shiqin also found a piece of clothing that he wore at home, with patches on it.
The two brothers and sisters are dressed in rags, and people can tell at a glance that they are old farmers with little money, and thieves don't pay much attention to them.
Even so, Xu Shiyan did not dare to be careless, and remained vigilant anytime and anywhere.
No matter who approached here, Xu Shiyan was very careful to avoid contact as much as possible, and kept Xu Shiqin inside.
There are more people on the bus and fewer people get off on this road. There are more and more passengers on the bus. At the next few stops, there are no seats.
This kind of time is also a good time for the thief to start. Sure enough, after a while, someone shouted that his money was lost.
The man’s clothes were cut, and the money inside was stolen.
The person who was stolen burst into tears, and the people around showed sympathy, but they were helpless.
In this year and month, who doesn't go out with fear?
"Brother, why are you so scary? The clothes that are good have been cut.
So many people didn’t notice when it was stolen? "Where did Xu Shiqin experience this, he was terrified.
"That's why I said, you can't wear it too well when you go out, the more it is worn out, the more no one cares.
It would be even better if there is a smell of sweat and feet, so that no one will lean towards you. "Xu Shiqin instructed his sister in a low voice.
Xu Shiqin, who was so frightened that his face turned pale, couldn't help but burst out laughing when he heard this.
"Brother, you can really bury people."
Who doesn't tidy up when they go out? How can the smell of sweat and feet come out? That's too embarrassing, right?
"It's true, don't believe it.
Look at the one who lost money just now, it looks like he was on a business trip, such a person must have a lot of money on him, and he is the most attractive to thieves. "
Xu Shiyan explained to his sister in a low voice, which can be regarded as giving her some insight.
"Those thieves are the best at looking at people. They can recognize who is rich and who is not.
So, don't think about other things, be natural, just a poor old man who has never gone out. "
Xu Shiqin is not in good health. He really has never been out of the house. The farthest is from Songjiang River to Xianren Bridge.
The old-fashioned steam train ran slowly, and after running for nearly five hours, it finally arrived at Hunjiang Railway Station.
The radio shouted that passengers should pack their luggage and prepare to get off the bus, and many people rushed to the door.
The more this happens, the more accidents there will be, so Xu Shiyan is not in a hurry, he just took off his luggage and waited.
It was not until the train stopped that Xu Shiqin got off with the crowd.
Just got off the train, before he got out of the platform, he heard someone shouting that his things were gone.
Needless to say, it must have been taken by someone when they got out of the car just now.
When Xu Shiqin heard Dongxing over there, he was so frightened that he wanted to touch the money in his clothes, but was stopped by Xu Shiyan.
"Stay still, watch out for someone staring at you."
Who knows if the lost thing is real or fake? What if someone yelled this on purpose and secretly observed the reactions of these passengers?
No matter who it is, when they hear that someone else has been stolen, they will subconsciously check whether their money is lost.
Some people will take advantage of this natural reaction, observe in secret, and then strike while others are not paying attention.
So at this time, it is absolutely impossible to check, just go outside.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: too messy
chapters.content:
Chapter 230 Too messy
Reminded by Xu Shiyan, Xu Shiqin stopped making any moves, and just followed his brother carefully.
The two brothers and sisters left the station, turned around and went to the ticket office to buy tickets to the provincial capital.
The train to the provincial capital was in the evening, and it was still early, and the siblings couldn't stay at the train station all the time, so they simply asked for a room in an outside hotel to pass the station.
The two of them didn't go out for a stroll, they just stayed in the hotel obediently.
Guan asked for some hot water, and dealt with the meal with pancakes and pickles brought from home.
At 5:30, the two checked out of the room, carried their luggage to the station, and boarded the train at that time.
This train departs at 6 o'clock and arrives at the provincial capital at 7 o'clock in the morning, so I just stay on the bus overnight.
In these years, sleeping berth tickets are not available to ordinary people, they have to be issued by a government official with a work certificate.
Brother and sister Xu Shiyan are old farmers, so they must not be treated like this.
Besides, it’s just for one night, and it’s not a long trip, so there’s no need for that.
Hunjiang is the departure station. There are many empty seats on the train, and the two carriages reserved for Tonghua are all empty.
Xu Shiyan led Xu Shiqin, and directly found a long seat opposite, and sat on one side.
If no one comes at night, they can still lie down for a while.
There were not too many people getting on the bus in Tonghua, and there were many empty seats on the bus, so after passing Tonghua, Xu Shiyan let Xu Shiqin rest, and he watched.
When it was nine o'clock in the evening, Xu Shiyan was also squinting with his luggage on his pillow.
At twelve o'clock, there seemed to be very light footsteps approaching him.
Xu Shiyan didn't say a word, he closed his eyes and pretended to be asleep.
Sure enough, someone stopped in front of Xu Shiyan and reached out to feel around Xu Shiyan's waist, only to find something hard.
The man sensed something was wrong, and immediately withdrew his hand, but Xu Shiyan grabbed his wrist.
"Brother, did you find anything rare?" Xu Shiyan sat up and looked at him with a smile.
The man covered his head with a hat, and also wore a hood around his neck to cover half of his face, only showing his nose and eyes.
"Let go, or my brother will not spare you when he comes over."
The man warned Xu Shiyan viciously, but there was a little guilt in his voice.
Xu Shiyan exerted force on his hand, and with a clever click, he removed the guy's right wrist and arm.
"Your brothers? How many?"
Xu Shiyan looked around just now. Most people in this carriage are asleep, and there are no people around who are in charge of vigilance.
That is to say, this guy may be putting on a show, or his accomplices are committing crimes in other compartments, and they haven't come here yet.
The guy touched Xu Shiyan's hunting knife just now, and he knew that something was wrong at that time.
Being restrained at this moment, he didn't dare to move his right arm at all, and that guy also understood that he had provoked someone who shouldn't be provoked.
"Brother, it's not easy to come out to eat a meal, brother hold your hand high."
Seeing that something was wrong, the man immediately softened his tone and begged for mercy.
"Brother, where can I get a bite to eat? Do I have to go this way?"
From the beginning, Xu Shiyan didn't yell loudly, and always talked to the other party in a low voice. He was also afraid of attracting the other party's accomplices.
Xu Shiyan took his younger sister with him when he went out this time, and tried to avoid side effects as much as possible.
In case the other party has more than a dozen accomplices, he is alone, and he must suffer.
"It's all a last resort." The man gritted his teeth and whispered.
Xu Shiyan sighed and waved his hands, "You go, I don't care about you.
It is best to get off at the next stop and find a hospital. I can only unload, not bone-setting. "
Yes, but I can't give him a positive, who knows what kind of person this guy is?
What if he gets a bone-setting connection, and he turns his face again?
That's the best way, the right hand dare not move, only the left hand is left, not afraid that he will turn out any troubles.
The other party also noticed that Xu Shiyan was not easy to provoke, so without saying a word, the moment Xu Shiyan let go of his hand, he turned and ran away.
When the man ran away, Xu Shiqin sat up and said, "Third brother, did you just let him go?"
Xu Shiqin didn't dare to sleep too hard, and seemed to be listening in a daze. She didn't dare to move, and just closed her eyes to listen.
Xu Shiqin didn't dare to speak out until the man left.
"What else can he do if he doesn't let go? Call the police if the trouble becomes serious?
Do you know how many people are in their gang? If more than a dozen of them gather around, will we both suffer?
There are only these people in the carriage, do you dare to say that they can all get up and help us? "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, going out, one more thing is worse than one less thing.
People's hearts are unpredictable. There is no shortage of brave people in this world, but there are more people who are greedy for life and afraid of death.
No one wants to take the initiative to cause trouble.
There are even some people who would rather lose some money than get ahead.
Xu Shiyan never dared to think too well of human nature, and he would not be disappointed if he planned for the worst.
Xu Shiqin thought for a while, then nodded, "Well, what the third brother said makes sense, I'm too naive."
"Don't think about it, go on sleeping, don't dare to say anything else, our carriage should be safe in the second half of the night."
He caught someone without making a fuss, and let him go. There are rules for each line. Logically speaking, that person will never come back to make trouble.
Of course, if you meet that kind of unruly person, maybe you will come back for revenge based on the number of people.
If it really comes, then there is no way, just go all out.
Xu Shiqin was still sleepy. Since her brother said it was safe, she had nothing to worry about and continued to lie down and sleep.
Xu Shiyan didn't go to sleep directly, but sat there, holding the knife handle at his waist with his right hand, and kept vigilant at all times.
Until the next stop, no one came to seek revenge, so Xu Shiyan was relieved, let go of his hands, lay down and stared.
Before five o'clock, the passengers on the train woke up one after another, and then heard someone shouting that his things were lost.
When one person shouted, the others were also awakened, checking their luggage and belongings, and several shouted and lost money and things.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard this, he immediately pretended to look through his luggage.
"Oh, it's amazing, what kind of vile and smoky person is this, why would he even steal from someone like me.
I can't live anymore at home, so I want to go to the provincial capital to join relatives, and I only have a few dollars left for travel expenses, and I'm gone, how can I live? "
Everyone else lost their things, but their brother and sister didn't lose their things, and their clothes are so shabby, it's easy to be suspicious.
So Xu Shiyan came up with such a trick, sitting on the ground, patting his thigh and crying loudly.
"Oh, I can't live anymore, my sister is still disabled.
Bullying the handicapped, losing conscience, hitting five thunders and bangs. "
Xu Shiyan deliberately brought out the trick of the old rural lady and shrew cursing the street, pointing at the scolding and howling there.
The whole car does not need to listen to others, but all look at him like a fool.
Xu Shiqin watched her brother perform with embarrassment, and didn't dare to laugh, so she could only cover her hands and shake her shoulders.
Others saw it and thought Xu Shiqin was crying too.
The brothers and sisters were already dressed in shabby clothes, and when they cried like this, they looked even more pitiful, and others could only shake their heads when they saw it.
"Sigh, today's society is really getting more and more chaotic. Honest people have a hard time, and they are bullied wherever they go."

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Old Chu
chapters.content:
Chapter 231 Chu Lao
Under Xu Shiyan's exaggerated and artificial howls, everyone looked at the siblings from suspicion to sympathy and pity.
These people can live on without some money and things. These two brothers and sisters are so poor, what will they do in the future?
Everyone shook their heads and sighed, and returned to their seats.
Xu Shiyan howled twice again, and then, under the persuasion of others, returned to his seat with a mournful face.
Just at this time, the train arrived at another station, a few people got off the train, and then a large group of people came up.
Xu Shiyan saw it, and quickly asked Xu Shiqin to sit in his side to make room for the people who came up later.
The siblings stood next to each other, talking in a low voice.
"Brother, you are really good, you can pretend anything?
You were exactly the same as his mother Chen Deyong just now. "
Xu Shiqin lowered his head and did not dare to raise it, muttering softly.
"Well, I learned from her.
No way, didn’t you see that several people in the carriage lost money and things? That man must have done it last night.
If I don't come here, they will have to suspect us. "
No way, in order not to arouse suspicion, you have to play tricks and roll around.
Although it was a bit exaggerated and looked like a fool, the effect was quite good, and Xu Shiyan was very satisfied.
As for those who lost their money and things, they don't deserve sympathy.
Nowadays, it’s so chaotic outside, and I don’t even have this kind of cognition when I go out, and I can sleep soundly on the train, and I deserve it if I lose something.
Xu Shiyan is not someone's parents, so he has no obligation to help them catch thieves.
What's the matter? If he was injured last night because of catching a thief, how many of these people could help him?
There must be kindness, but what is the point of scoring, if you can’t distinguish the situation and send out kindness indiscriminately, if you make trouble, you will lose your life.
It can be said that he is selfish, but first of all, he must be responsible for himself and his loved ones.
This is the responsibility of being a son, a husband, and a father. He will never be reckless and desperate for irrelevant people.
There were many people in the car, the two of them didn't continue talking, they just closed their eyes and squinted.
There were a lot of people coming up at the first two stops, and there were no seats on the bus, and many people were standing.
At 7:30 in the morning, the train entered the terminal station Changchun Station.
Brother and sister Xu Shiyan carried their luggage on their backs, followed the crowd calmly, and left the station.
Going outside, I found an older person to inquire about the way to Bethune Medical University.
Old Chu said in a letter before that he lives in the family area of ​​the faculty and staff of the Medical University.
It's also very close to the affiliated hospital. Qi Yunsheng is also doing an internship in the affiliated hospital now.
The two brothers and sisters took the bus according to their instructions, and went straight to the Medical University Station on Xinmin Street.
When they arrived here, the two of them didn't go directly to find someone, but first found a hotel nearby, and opened a double room with the letter of introduction from the brigade.
The brothers and sisters brought too much money and couldn’t live with others. Even if it cost more money, they had to ask for a separate room.
Most of the tourists who live near here are accompanying their families to see a doctor, so the hotel will take care of this.
The staff didn't make it difficult for Xu Shiyan and his sister, and arranged a room for them simply.
The two of them put away their luggage, changed their clothes, and locked the door with money.
Get out of the hotel, go straight to the family area according to the address written by Mr. Chu in the letter.
Mr. Chu is already seventy-six years old, and he no longer holds a real job in the past two years, but is an honorary principal and honorary dean.
Now that the research group has overcome the difficulties, Mr. Chu doesn’t even bring students with him, but just sorts out medical records at home, reads books and so on.
Xu Shiyan took the letter and looked for it one by one according to the address on the letter. He really couldn't understand it, so he asked someone on the road.
The provincial capital in early November was warmer than Donggang. The siblings still dressed according to the temperature at home, and they were sweating after wandering around for a while.
Fortunately, he finally found Mr. Chu's home, so Xu Shiyan hurriedly knocked on the door.
"Who are you looking for?"
A woman in her forties came out to open the door, and when she saw Xu Shiyan's brother and sister, she asked suspiciously.
"Hello, may I ask if this is Mr. Chu Xuanhuai's home?
We came from Fusong, specially to visit the old man. "Xu Shiyan knew that this person was Elder Chu's nanny.
Elder Chu’s wife died of illness when the accident happened that year. In order to avoid suspicion, the two sons drew a clear line with Elder Chu and sent them to other places.
Later, Mr. Chu was taken back to the provincial capital to resume work. The two sons had already taken root elsewhere and never returned to the Northeast.
So Mr. Chu has been living alone these years, and the nanny is arranged by the school to take care of Mr. Chu's daily life.
As soon as she heard that it was from Fusong, the nanny immediately laughed.
"I know, I know, the surname is Xu, right? Mr. Chu always talked about it, and he said it yesterday, and you may come soon. Please come in."
It should be that Mr. Chu has given instructions in advance, so the nanny has a very good attitude and politely let Xu Shiyan and his sister into the small courtyard.
The houses in the family area are not large.
Although Mr. Chu has a high rank, he is alone and doesn't care much about external conditions, so it's just a small yard and two and a half small rooms.
The yard is well cleaned up. It can be seen that the yard should be full of flowers in summer.
In early winter, the wind was bleak, and there were only a few dead branches and leaves left in the yard.
The nanny led Xu Shiyan brothers and sisters in, "Mr. Chu, the person you have been thinking about is here."
While speaking, he led the two of them into the living room.
The size of the house is not large, the two-and-a-half-room small room is also the kitchen and the nanny's quarters, so the house is a bit crowded.
It is said to be a living room, but it should also be considered a study room. The walls are full of bookshelves, and there are various medical books on them, as well as anatomical diagrams, acupuncture dolls, and the like.
Chu Xuanhuai was born in the family of Xinglin, some of his ancestors were imperial doctors.
He was taught by the elders of his family since he was a child, and he has a profound knowledge in medicine.
However, at that time, the Qing Dynasty perished, warlords fought in chaos, and the country was in a precarious time of national peril, internal and external troubles.
Affected by the atmosphere at that time, Chu Xuanhuai became suspicious of the ancestral medical skills.
resolutely left home, went out to study, and then traveled across the ocean to study western medicine abroad.
Chu Xuanhuai came back from his studies and was entrusted by his superiors to work in Jinling Drum Tower Hospital, secretly serving as our liaison station.
Later, due to work needs, he was transferred to the north and joined North China Medical University to teach.
Finally transferred to Northeast China and became a professor at Jilin Medical University.
It is also because of past experiences, especially studying abroad and working in enemy-occupied areas.
During those days, he became a key target and was sent to Daying Village for reform.
After those years of tossing, the old man's health is not very good.
Although he returned to the provincial capital in the past few years, someone took good care of him, but after all, he was old and his mental and physical strength were not as good as before, so he could only retire.
At this moment, the old man is sitting at the desk, flipping through medical books.
Hearing what the nanny said, he raised his head and glanced at the door.
Through the lens, I saw two familiar faces.
"Yo, it's your brothers and sisters here. I haven't seen you for many years, and your appearance has changed." Elder Chu recognized Xu Shiyan's brothers and sisters, and said with a smile.
"Master, it's me. I'm here to see you." Xu Shiyan came to Elder Chu and saluted respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: an examination
chapters.content:
Chapter 232 Inspection
"Get up, get up, oops, this is a new society, it's not like this.
Come on, come to me and let me have a look, I haven't seen you for several years. "
Old Chu was very kind when he saw Xu Shiyan, so he hurriedly got Xu Shiyan up and beckoned Xu Shiyan to come to him.
Xu Shiyan walked up to Elder Chu as he said, squatted down, and looked up at the old man.
"Master, you are getting old." Xu Shiyan choked up and couldn't speak.
If he could stick to his own ideas and take care of Master more, maybe Master would not grow old so quickly.
"No, Master thinks he is quite young.
I can still eat four steamed buns and a bowl of porridge, or two bowls of rice for a meal now.
Old rice grains, old rice grains, master can still eat, and he is in good health, it’s alright. "
Mr. Chu was extremely optimistic. Seeing Xu Shiyan was sad, he smiled and comforted him.
"Xiao Zhao, quickly get a stool for the two of them, sit down and talk."
Mr. Chu greeted the nanny, and the nanny hurriedly brought over two stools, and the siblings sat down.
Xu Shiyan just remembered that he also brought a lot of things to Mr. Chu, and hurriedly handed them over to the nanny.
"Master, I came in a hurry, and I couldn't bring you anything good.
It’s just some mushrooms, fungus, ginseng, and a little bit of toad oil and Gastrodia elata. "
That ginseng is naturally old mountain ginseng.
Last summer, Xu Shiyan was dragged into the mountain by a rascal ghost, but he came across several ginseng trees.
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, he dug up the ginseng, processed it and stored it, and no one knew about it.
This time when he came to the provincial capital, Xu Shiyan was worried about what gift to bring to Mr. Chu, and when he was getting the money, he saw those ginseng, so he chose one of them.
Mr. Chu is getting old, so he gave him a tree of old wild ginseng. In case of any situation, it might save his life.
Toad oil is obtained by catching mothers in autumn.
The elderly are physically weak. In winter in the Northeast, the air pressure is high and the temperature is low. Especially in provincial cities, the wind is strong and the air is dry, making it difficult to endure.
Stew some toad oil with rock sugar, which can nourish the body and enhance resistance.
"Look at you, it's such a long way, why bring me something? What a waste of time." Elder Chu laughed as soon as he heard it.
"Don't say it, I really miss our Changbai Mountain mushrooms and fungus.
I asked Xiao Zhao to store the ones you sent before, and make them for me to eat every now and then. The things from Changbai Mountain are better, and I can eat them. "
"Okay, I won't be polite to you anymore.
Xiao Zhao, put away the things for me first, you can buy a chicken in a while, and we will have chicken stewed with mushrooms for lunch. "
Mr. Chu didn't think about anything else, he just thought that Xu Shiyan got a ginseng from the team, and he just saved it for the next day to drink stewed chicken soup, which is quite good.
The nanny nodded, carrying her things into the back room.
"In a blink of an eye, your Xiaoliu has grown into a big girl, look at this appearance, it is quite similar to your mother.
Good boy, I have heard your brother say that you are promising. "Old Chu looked at Xu Shiqin and nodded in praise.
"Originally, I should recommend you to go to Jinling Drum Tower Hospital, where the research is earlier than ours, and the technology has also taken shape.
But, it’s too far away. If you want to cure this problem, you need at least two or three operations. It’s so far away, we can’t afford it.
It’s better to be in the provincial capital. This is also the research group I lead, and the technology is fine. Elder Chu looked at Xu Shiqin and explained to her.
Spine deformity correction is not that simple, especially for Xu Shiqin's nearly 20-year-old injury, it is even more difficult.
The spine cannot be corrected and stereotyped all at once. In that case, the risk factor is too high, and the pressure on the spinal nerves and internal organs is too great.
Therefore, the operation is divided into several times, and the correction is done bit by bit.
Jinling is too far away, and it takes several days to go there once, and I really can’t afford to go there several times a year.
"Thank you, Mr. Chu, it doesn't matter if it's Jinling or the provincial capital, as long as it can be cured." Xu Shiqin nodded with a smile.
Where is Jinling? This is the first time even to the provincial capital, let alone Jinling, she doesn't even know where to go.
Old Chu glanced at the watch on the wall, it was more than eight o'clock and less than nine o'clock.
"Xiao Zhao, you lead them to Chi Hao, just say it's the person I mentioned before, and let him arrange it."
Just as the nanny had put away her things and came out, Elder Chu asked her to follow her.
"The two of you followed Xiao Zhao to the Medical University Hospital, and went there to find the chief of surgery, Chi Hao, who was my former student.
At present, he is the authority of our hospital in terms of spinal deformity correction. "Elder Chu explained to the Xu Shiyan brothers and sisters.
"Go to check first, come back after the check, and eat at my place at noon.
Waiting for the test results to come out, I will hold a meeting with Xiao Chi and the others to discuss the details. "
Business matters. Brother and sister Xu Shiyan came to the provincial capital to treat illnesses. They hurried to check in the morning, and when the film came out in the afternoon, they could hold a meeting to study the plan.
It is important to seize the time to treat the disease, and to reminisce about the past at any time.
"Well, let's go to the hospital for an examination first, and come over to have dinner with Master at noon."
Xu Shiyan was not polite to Mr. Chu either, he got up immediately, went out with the nanny, and went straight to the hospital.
The Affiliated Hospital of the University of Medical Sciences is naturally not far from the hospital, and the three of them arrived within a short walk.
The nanny is a family member of the hospital staff and is very familiar with the hospital. She led Xu Shiyan and his sister to Chi Hao, the director of orthopedic surgery.
As soon as Chi Hao saw the nanny leading people over, and then looked at Xu Shiqin's situation, he probably guessed what was going on.
"Xiao Chen, I'll hand over this patient to you, give her a checklist, and do a full body checkup first.
Especially visceral ultrasound, spinal anterior and lateral X-rays, all have to be done, and the X-rays will be sent to me. "
After Chi Hao inquired about Xu Shiqin's situation, he handed Xu Shiqin over to a young doctor.
Let the doctor accompany you throughout the whole process, first write the bill, pay the money, and then go to take X-rays and checks one by one.
Fortunately, Dr. Chen was with him, otherwise the hospital is so big, and Xu Shiyan tossing back and forth would have completely confused him.
After all the inspections are completed, the whole morning is almost over.
Dr. Chen took the film and various examination results, and led Xu Shiyan and his brother back to Chi Hao's office.
Director Chi hung up the film and checked it carefully, looked through the relevant examination results, and asked about Xu Shiqin's injury at the time.
Xu Shiqin was young at that time, how can I remember please? At least Xu Shiyan could remember something, so he helped to answer.
Having read all the inspection results and the film, Chi Hao let out a long breath.
"Since Teacher Chu asked you to come, then I have to explain clearly to you.
As for the first one, this **** has been injured for too long, and it is very difficult and time-consuming to completely correct it.
It is conservatively estimated that you will be hospitalized here for almost three months this time, during which time you will have two surgeries.
Another one is that the risk of this operation is very high.
Look, the bone quality in these places has changed, and some excess bone hyperplasia needs to be removed in order to correct it.
Once there is an accident, such as touching a nerve or blood vessel, it is likely to cause more serious disabilities. "
"The third one, it must be about money.
Currently, our spine correction is a new method, and all the instruments used are imported, which are very expensive.
I wonder if you can bear such economic pressure? "

chapters.title: Chapter 233: cost
chapters.content:
Chapter 233 Fees
"Director Chi, I would like to ask you, how much is the first stage operation, that is, the three months you mentioned?"
Before coming here, Xu Shiyan had discussed with Xu Shiqin about the operation, and they were aware of the risks and so on.
After all, it is the spine. If it is not done properly, it will hurt the nerves, and it may be paralyzed.
Xu Shiqin has a firm will, that is, no matter how painful or dangerous, she still wants to have this operation.
After receiving so many strange looks for twenty years, she felt very inferior.
Now Xu Shiqin is about to get engaged to Han Liwei, she hopes that she can marry the person she likes in the most perfect state.
So, the brothers and sisters are most concerned about money.
The two of them had six or seven thousand dollars with them, and I don't know if the first-stage surgery will be possible.
If it is not enough, Xu Shiyan has to find another way.
"In fact, the main reason is that the materials are expensive. This set of imported alloy materials costs about 2,000 yuan, and the operation fee is a few hundred yuan.
In addition to various medical expenses, hospitalization expenses, etc., it is conservatively estimated to be more than 3,000. "
Chi Hao made a rough estimate and gave the Xu Shiyan brothers and sisters a number.
The monthly hospitalization fee for this year is 1.2 yuan per bed per day, which is more than 100 yuan for three months.
Most surgeries are not expensive. Type A surgery costs 45 to 60 yuan, type B surgery costs 30 to 45 yuan, type C surgery costs 15 to 30 yuan, outpatient minor surgery costs 5 to 15 yuan dollars.
Spine correction is a new project, and if it is not included in these four categories, the operation fee will be higher.
But in general, the bulk is the material.
No way, the domestic production of medical equipment and materials is not enough.
This new type of medical project requires materials that cannot be produced domestically and can only be imported.
All together, the minimum guarantee is 3,000 yuan.
And this is not counting three months of food expenses, nutrition expenses, and the room and board that Xu Shiyan accompanied here.
If you count them all together, it may cost more than four thousand.
Four thousand, what is the concept?
For example, Xu Shiqin is now a second-level worker, and her monthly salary is less than 30 yuan. In addition, she has a forest subsidy in her early twenties, which is about 50 yuan a month.
Four thousand yuan is equal to her eighty months' wages, that is, nearly seven years' wages.
Xu Shiqin had to save all his wages for seven years without food or drink in order to have surgery, and this is not all.
Just thinking about it is enough to make many people retreat.
That's why Director Chi explained all this clearly to Xu Shiyan and his siblings in advance, so that they would know that this operation is really not something ordinary people can do.
Xu Shiqin's injury is not considered a work-related injury, and there is no place for reimbursement, all of which are at his own expense, which is simply unaffordable for ordinary families.
Xu Shiyan brothers and sisters were relieved after hearing this. Fortunately, it was within the range they could bear.
"Director Chi, we will perform this operation." The siblings said in unison.
Chi Hao looked at the siblings in surprise. Although they were dressed neatly, they were just ordinary people.
I heard from Mr. Chu before that it was the first ordinary peasant family in Fusong, how could they afford so much money?
When will farmers earn so much money?
"Okay, since you agree to the operation, I'll let someone arrange the hospitalization.
Tomorrow morning, you will come to go through the hospitalization procedures. The specific operation plan needs to be discussed carefully in a meeting. "
At Director Chi's position, self-cultivation is naturally extraordinary. Even if you have doubts in your heart, you will never question it face to face.
Director Chi is very busy here, so it's not good for the brothers and sisters of the Xu family to disturb him.
So the two of them bid farewell and left, and returned to Chu's old home according to the way they came.
The nanny opened the door to see Xu Shiyan brother and sister, and greeted them warmly.
The two siblings entered the living room again, only to see Elder Chu with a serious face.
"Shiyan, why didn't you tell me that what you gave me was an old mountain ginseng?"
It turned out that after the nanny sent Xu Shiyan and the two to the hospital, she returned to Chu's house and bought a chicken according to Elder Chu's wishes.
Mr. Chu said that he wanted to eat chicken stewed mushrooms at noon, but last year’s ones were gone, so the nanny went to look for the ones that Xu Shiyan had just sent.
As a result, after looking through it, I found that there was a wooden box inside the package, and there was a ginseng tree in the box.
The nanny is also a family member of a doctor, and she has some knowledge, so she feels wrong at first glance.
This does not seem to be an ordinary ginseng, so quickly show it to Mr. Chu.
Chu’s family has a long history of learning. Although he has been practicing Western medicine all these years, the foundation laid down since childhood is still there, and he can recognize it at a glance. This is a very old mountain ginseng.
At this moment, just this ginseng will cost about 1,500 yuan.
Fifteen thousand, how much is that?
Usually send some fungus mushrooms, walnuts and pine nuts, which is considered normal.
Sending ginseng worth more than 1,000 yuan all at once, is it still worth it? Of course, Mr. Chu couldn't ask for it.
"You have to spend a lot of money to treat Xiao Liu's illness, why give me such a valuable thing back?
No, you can take it back quickly, I will find you a place to sell it, just keep it for Xiao Liu’s medical treatment. "
Old Chu pushed the wooden box on the table towards Xu Shiyan, motioning Xu Shiyan to take it away.
"Master, this thing may be worth a little money with you, but with me, no amount of money is worth as much as our teacher-student relationship.
At the beginning, you didn't think I was stupid for accepting me as an apprentice, but unfortunately I didn't insist on learning from you all the time. I have always regretted it all these years.
I haven't been able to take care of you by your side these years. My apprentice is not qualified enough.
This ginseng is a little bit of my filial piety. "
How can you take back what you give away? A wild ginseng may be precious to others, but it is nothing to him.
Now Xu Shiyan has several trees in his hand.
The big house is under the cliff, last year he took a chance to visit it, and the dozen or so ginseng trees were all healthy, but no one found it.
If it’s used in the future, he’ll just have to dig it out. Isn’t Elder Chu still missing?
"Don't worry, I have prepared all the money for my little sister's medical treatment.
As you know, I have been tossing a lot in the past few years, and I have a little money in my hand. "Xu Shiyan smiled and pushed the wooden box over again.
"Master, do you think I am at this age, can I learn something more?
I have a breeding farm now. I heard that the fields may be divided into ginseng land after the next year, and I will contract and do it alone in the future. I also want to learn about deep processing and fine processing of ginseng.
Now there is no recommendation system in universities, so is there any other way, I want to go to school. "
Xu Shiyan was well aware of Elder Chu's temper, so he quickly changed the subject.
Sure enough, when Mr. Chu heard that Xu Shiyan wanted to go to school, he immediately regained his energy, but after thinking about it carefully, he frowned again.
"Oh, you, you really didn't catch up with the good times.
If you had followed me to study for a few more years, at least you could take the barefoot doctor exam, and it would be useful to pass the exam.
Now, workers, peasants, and soldiers are not allowed to be recommended to go to college. They have to take the college entrance examination. You don’t meet the requirements. Why do you take the exam? "
Old Chu shook his head as he spoke.
"A while ago, I heard that the Agriculture Committee commissioned the Agricultural University to recruit a group of correspondence colleges, with majors in animal husbandry and agricultural product processing.
But the requirement is to be an agricultural cadre or a backup cadre at the deputy county level, and you don't meet this requirement. "
Nowadays, when ordinary people miss college, the only way is the college entrance examination.
The rest of the correspondence courses and night schools have thresholds and are not open to ordinary people.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 234: difficult to read
chapters.content:
Chapter 234 Difficult to read
Xu Shiyan was a little disappointed when he heard it. In this day and age, it is really difficult for ordinary people to study.
Otherwise, how could the college entrance examination be called an opportunity to change fate?
Ordinary people want to step into a higher class, and the college entrance examination is the most direct and safest way.
Unfortunately, Xu Shiyan is not even qualified to take the college entrance examination.
Then is there any other way to let him learn some professional knowledge?
"Master, what if I go to college at my own expense? Is it possible?"
This is the last hope. Who told him that he has no education and no qualifications?
Old Chu shook his head, "What are you thinking about today? How much does it cost the country to train a college student?
In these years, if individuals pay for it, ordinary families cannot afford it. "
At this time, there is no tuition fee for going to college, and the state also provides subsidies.
I’ve never heard of anyone who goes to college at their own expense, that’s pure nonsense.
“Even if you can afford it, that’s not enough.
University is to cultivate talents for the country, so what is it called to study at your own expense?
Where will I arrange it after finishing my studies? How many talents can come out of such a person? "
Old Chu shook his head, feeling that Xu Shiyan was just wishful thinking.
Xu Shiyan sighed, sure enough, it’s too early to think about this, the dual-track system hasn’t even started yet, so it’s a bit nonsense to talk about going to college at your own expense.
"Then there is no other way? Master, I really want to learn something, something that is actually useful, it doesn't matter if you have a diploma or not."
The correspondence course is for the diploma, and for the promotion of the post evaluation.
Xu Shiyan doesn't have that much ambition, he just wants to learn something that is really useful.
Old Chu was silent for a moment, "Well, how about you, you probably have been living in the provincial capital for a long time, and you are fine on weekdays, so come and follow me, and I will teach you some medical skills.
In the past few years, there should be related exams. You should study hard and try to get a certificate, which will be useful in the future. "
Barefoot doctors’ qualification certificate is not too difficult these days. Mr. Chu thinks that if Xu Shiyan works hard, it shouldn’t be a problem.
"As for the animal husbandry and veterinary medicine and agricultural product processing you mentioned, I will find someone to help you get some books from the Agricultural University. You have to learn by yourself when you have time.
If there is any opportunity in two years, or the policy changes, I will find a way to get you a correspondence education qualification. "
People of Mr. Chu's age like people who love to learn and are willing to study.
In the past two years of master-student correspondence, Mr. Chu agrees with some of Xu Shiyan's ideas, and he also hopes that Xu Shiyan can go further and improve.
"As long as you are willing to study, it is never too late."
Xu Shiyan was very happy when he heard it.
"Master is willing to teach me again, then of course I am happy. But will I not disturb you when I come to study?"
Chu Laobai gave Xu Shiyan a look, "What are you bothering me? I am an old man, and I have nothing to do on weekdays. What else can I do besides reading?
If you want me to say, you can live with me directly, and you will often take care of Xiaoliu when you are away from the hospital, and learn from me when you come back when you are free. "Old Chu thinks that Xu Shiyan is too out of touch.
Xu Shiqin will have an operation, and after the operation, he will need some rehabilitation treatment, so it will take a long time.
For such a long time, it is impossible for Xu Shiyan to stay in the ward all the time, he must have another place to live.
What Elder Chu meant, it’s better to move here, to accompany Xu Shiqin when he’s busy, and to learn some medical skills from Elder Chu when he’s free.
Xu Shiyan has his own foundation, as long as Mr. Chu gives some pointers, he can make considerable progress.
It will be no problem to take the barefoot doctor qualification certificate.
"Master, let's discuss this matter after Xiao Liu's operation is settled.
I guess I had to be with her all day when she had just finished the operation. "
How could Xu Shiyan agree to live with Mr. Chu directly?
The place here is not big, Mr. Chu lives in the inner room of the east room, and the nanny lives in the hut connected to the kitchen at the west end, so it is not easy for Xu Shiyan to come and disturb him.
He thought about it, and rented a house nearby here when he had time, instead of staying in a hotel all the time, the money was too expensive, and he couldn't cook.
Rent a hut by yourself, with a kitchen or something, where you can buy vegetables and make some delicious food for Xu Shiqin's health.
It is not good to say this directly in front of Mr. Chu, lest Mr. Chu will be unhappy.
So Xu Shiyan said, wait and see how Xu Shiqin's surgery progresses, and then make a decision.
Speaking of Xu Shiqin's surgery, Chu, young and old, had to tell the brothers and sisters about the practice of spinal correction surgery.
After speaking in this way, the topic became farther and farther away. In the end, Elder Chu also forgot about the ginseng tree.
It wasn't until the nanny finished the lunch and brought it in that Elder Chu remembered it again, but he couldn't return it to Xu Shiyan, so he could only sigh and let the nanny put the ginseng away.
"Keep it, this is a good thing, it will become less and less in the future, and it can save lives at critical times."
It would be a lie to say that Mr. Chu doesn't like it, he just thinks it's too expensive.
"I don't want to give away such expensive things in the future, Master, I have this one enough for my use."
"Hey, I see, I will bring mushrooms, fungus and dried vegetables to Master in the future, right?"
Xu Shiyan nodded obediently and smiled.
"Okay, this is okay, I like these.
