Especially those dried eggplants and dried beans, not to mention, I really miss that bite.
I remember that at that time, it was dried with radish stalks and mustard stalks in autumn, and the small tofu was made in spring, and I thought it was delicious at that time. "
The old man remembered the days when he was sent to the camp.
Lao Cong, who is in charge of the cowshed, has nothing to eat every spring, so he soaks the bean cakes fed to the livestock and grinds them, and then makes small tofu.
"Well, yes, that's how it is done.
Don’t just use dried vegetables, spring mother-in-law Ding, Laoniu file, etc., and small tofu are delicious.
If Master is thinking about this, wait for me to go back and send Master some dried vegetables.
But eating at this time, it must not be as fragrant as before. "
In the past, I was hungry, and everything I ate was delicious. Now that my life is better, if I eat small tofu, I won’t be able to taste the same taste as before.
"Don't, those dried vegetables are not as expensive as the postage, so don't bother."
Old Chu waved his hands quickly when he heard that, how many mouthfuls can he eat, it's not worth the effort.
"Come, let's eat. Xiao Zhao's cooking skills are very good. Come and try her stewed chicken with mushrooms."
Old Chu smiled and called everyone to sit down and eat together.
In addition to stewed chicken and mushrooms, there is also one meat and two vegetables on the table, and there is also a pot of rice.
Four dishes with rice, this is a very good meal, Xu Shiyan brothers and sisters thanked the nanny, and then sat down.
The nanny served meals for the three of them. Mr. Chu was old and very particular about manners, so no one spoke at the dinner table, and everyone ate quietly.
The nanny's craftsmanship is really good. The stewed chicken with mushrooms is very soft and rotten, which is suitable for Mr. Chu's teeth.
Old Chu really did as he said, he ate two bowls of rice in one meal, and then he hesitated looking at the stewed chicken with mushrooms, wanting to eat more.
Being stopped by the nanny, Elder Chu could only put down the bowls and chopsticks with unsatisfactory expressions.
"It's delicious, it's really fragrant. Let's stew some rice at night, and the soup will be so delicious when soaked in rice."

chapters.title: Chapter 235: rent a house
chapters.content:
Chapter 235 Rent
After lunch, brother and sister Xu Shiyan chatted with Mr. Chu for a while.
Chu is getting old and has to take a nap at noon, so the brother and sister bid farewell and left.
In the afternoon, Chi Hao arranged for someone to take Mr. Chu to the hospital. Together with a group of orthopedic surgeons, they discussed and made several surgical plans based on Xu Shiqin's examination results.
On the morning of the 10th, Xu Shiyan brought his younger sister to the hospital to go through the hospitalization procedures.
With Chi Hao taking care of him, he arranged a double room for Xu Shiqin to live in.
After Xu Shiqin was hospitalized, he had to undergo a series of more detailed examinations to prepare for the operation.
The operation was scheduled for the morning of the 12th. Taking advantage of the fact that the hospital was fine, Xu Shiyan hurried to the post office to send a telegram.
Xu Shiqin had to tell Han Liwei about Xu Shiqin's operation.
After sending the telegram, Xu Shiyan didn't go back to the hospital directly, but wandered around, trying to find a house to live in.
Staying in a hotel all day is not enough, it is too expensive, and eating is also a problem.
The hotel they are currently staying in is considered a good mid-range hotel. It costs 2.5 yuan a day for a room for two. Breakfast is just porridge, Lianghe noodles, steamed buns, and pickles.
It doesn’t matter whether it’s noon or evening, you have to find another place to buy food.
White flour steamed buns cost four cents for two taels, and Xu Shiyan can eat two of them.
Cornmeal hair cakes are cheaper, seventy cents a catty, half a catty is just right for Xu Shiqin.
But you have to have side dishes, one meal is considered a dish, let’s say four or five cents less, some seven or eight cents or even more.
Xu Shiyan can still make do with it, but if he can't, he can solve it with a bowl of throwing sleeve soup.
Xu Shiqin can't do it, he must eat some good supplements, and the food cost is nearly two yuan a day.
Four or five yuan a day for food and lodging, one hundred and forty fifty yuan a month, three months? This calculation is actually quite scary.
If you rent a house, the rent is only ten yuan or eight yuan. Xu Shiyan lives alone, so it doesn’t need to be too big, as long as there is a place to cook.
To inquire about a house, you have to find an older person.
There happened to be a park nearby, so Xu Shiyan went for a stroll.
The provincial capital is also cold in November, but it is much warmer than the Changbai Mountain area.
There are some old men near the park, find a sunny place to set up a chessboard, and play chess while basking in the sun.
Xu Shiyan also leaned over, commenting and pointing fingers with the group of old men watching the fun.
After a little longer, the group of old men noticed Xu Shiyan.
"You young man, if you don't go to work, what are you doing here among us old men?"
Someone looked at Xu Shiyan curiously, and asked a casual question.
"Master, I don't go to work, I come to the province to do errands.
I want to ask some of you, is there any house nearby that rents out?
It doesn’t need to be big, just a room and a place to cook. "Xu Shiyan smiled and explained to others.
There are quite a few old men in this group, and some of them were moved when they heard it.
"Young man, how long do you want to live? If it's for three days and two mornings, then you might as well stay in a hotel, no one will rent it to you."
Xu Shiyan heard that there is a family, and quickly replied, "Master, I guess I can live for three months.
To tell you the truth, my sister is sick and hospitalized in the Medical University Hospital, and it will take three months.
You said that if I stayed in the hotel for three months, I wouldn't be able to afford the money.
So I thought about renting a house, and I can cook some food myself. Wouldn’t this save money? "
Xu Shiyan was honest, so he told others why he wanted to rent a house.
Don’t say it’s not okay, people from other places come to the provincial capital to rent a house, they are afraid that you are a bad person who will do bad things.
"Hey, what's wrong? You have to be hospitalized for three months? Poor.
That’s right, you can earn a lot of money even if you eat and live for three months. It’s not as cost-effective as renting a house. "
When everyone heard this, they sympathized with Xu Shiyan.
Regardless of the year and month, it’s always the same sentence, don’t get sick if you have anything, don’t have money if you don’t have anything.
If a person is sick and hospitalized, the money will be spent like running water.
"Young man, there is an empty room in my house, not far from the hospital. If you want to live in it, come with me to have a look."
Over there, an old man spoke first.
"That's kind, sir, can I trouble you once and lead me to have a look?"
Xu Shiyan became happy when he heard it, and it turned out that this move was right.
The old man stopped watching the excitement, and led Xu Shiyan back.
Sure enough, in the alley opposite the hospital, after walking around for a while, I came to a small courtyard.
"The children in my family are not around, and there are only me and my wife at home.
The Westinghouse is vacant and no one lives there, and the children will come back after Chinese New Year. If you live for three months, it's just right, and there will be no delay. "
The old man opened the door and yelled into the yard, and saw an old lady in her sixties coming out of the house.
"Old woman, this young man's younger sister is hospitalized in the Medical University Hospital and wants to find a house to live in.
I wondered if our Westinghouse was idle, why not let the young man live for three months? "The old man discussed with his wife.
When the old lady heard it, it was fine, three months is less than the Chinese New Year, so it won't delay the children's coming back to live.
Anyway, the house is idle if it is idle, and it has to be burned in vain. If it is rented out for a month, there will still be some money.
"Okay, the young man is an honest man at first glance, come, let's talk in the room, let's have a good discussion."
Don't worry about the city and the countryside, who isn't living a tight life these days?
Rent out a room, earn ten yuan and eight yuan, and buy a few more catties of meat to eat, which is very good.
The old couple warmly greeted Xu Shiyan to enter the room, but Xu Shiyan was not polite, and followed into the east room.
This house should also be a public house, not too big, it looks like a small three.
The old couple live in the east room. There is a kang on the north side. There are kang pianos, cabinets and so on. There is also a radio on the box.
A few chairs were placed under the south window, and three or four flower pots were placed on the windowsill, all of which were Clivia.
The old couple greeted Xu Shiyan to sit down, the old lady poured Xu Shiyan a glass of water, and then began to discuss the house.
“The West House is not as big as the East House, anyway, two or three people can live there.
You want to rent a house and cook for yourself, right? Then you must have no luggage or household items.
Then, luggage, firewood, pots and pans, I will use it for you here, even the house, you can give me 30 yuan a month, how about it? "
The old lady is a very shrewd person. After chatting with Xu Shiyan for a while, she probably figured out what's going on, so it costs 30 yuan a month to open her mouth.
The old man next to him was almost startled when he heard it.
Who has heard of a house that costs 30 yuan a month? Is the price too high? "Old woman, what are you doing?"
The old man tugged on his wife's skirt and asked in a low voice.
"Leave it alone." The old lady glared at her husband.
Stupid, I finally met someone renting a house, so I have to earn some money.
Besides, if she asks for a price, they have to counter-offer. What's the rush?
Xu Shiyan frowned slightly when he heard that it was thirty. This price was a bit different from what he expected.
But think about it carefully, and I can accept it. People have said that, and they still use bedding, pots and pans.
He can't buy a set of all these household items, can he? What do you do when you're waiting to go home? It's too long-winded to take it home, isn't it a prodigal if you throw it away?
It’s fine if he can use the ones from this store, and it’s enough for him to buy some bowls and chopsticks.
"Auntie, my sister spends a lot of money in the hospital for medical treatment, can you lower the rent?
Twenty yuan, I really can’t afford more. "

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Clivia
chapters.content:
Chapter 236 Clivia
No matter how small a sale is, you have to bargain, not to mention that it costs twenty or thirty yuan a month.
Even if Xu Shiyan has money, he can't spend it recklessly, the province must save it.
The two sides talked for a while, one yuan and one yuan for grinding, and finally the landlord, Mrs. Zhang, gave in to twenty-three yuan a month.
Bedding, firewood, and kitchen utensils are all for Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan felt that this was okay, so he settled on it, and paid the first month's rent and a deposit of ten yuan on the spot.
Then they went back to the hotel, moved all the luggage and items they brought to the residence here, and checked out.
After that, under the guidance of Uncle Zhang, I went to the nearby market and bought some rice noodles, oil, seasonings, meat, vegetables, lunch boxes, bowls and chopsticks, etc.
Now that the city has opened up, you don’t have to ask for a ticket. Anyway, if you don’t have a ticket, the price will be higher.
As high as it is, the money saved by a hotel is basically enough.
Borrowing the landlord’s housewares to cook, naturally you have to stagger the cooking time with others.
The old couple had nothing to do, they had two meals a day, and Mrs. Zhang started cooking at three o'clock in the afternoon.
Xu Shiyan had nothing to do when he was free, so he went to the east room to chat with Uncle Zhang.
"Master, my aunt likes Clivia very much, and has several pots at home."
Xu Shiyan looked at the Clivia trees on the window sill, only one of the four pots was big, with a dozen leaves, and it would bloom after a while.
The remaining three pots only have seven or eight leaves, which should be two-year-old seedlings, probably separated from the bigger one.
There are only these four pots of Clivia on the window sill, nothing else, so Xu Shiyan said that Aunt Zhang probably likes Clivia very much.
"My younger sister also likes it. I have several pots and varieties at home. The flowers are beautiful."
Xu Shiyan didn't think of anything else, just chatting casually.
The speaker has no intention but the listener has the intention. Uncle Zhang immediately widened his eyes when he heard it.
"Hey, do you have Clivia at home? Are those varieties?
It's a pity, it's far away, if it's close, I have to go to your house to see if there are good varieties and buy a few back.
This stuff is worth a lot now. The big tree in my house is now being offered for hundreds of dollars. "
"Before, this tree was only sold for two hundred at most, and the document above said that the maximum price was not allowed to exceed two hundred.
But this matter, the more the price is not allowed to be high, the more the price will rise.
Isn't it the beginning of spring this year, our provincial capital held a Clivia charity exhibition? Oops, this time, the price has risen even faster.
Just these few seedlings are worth tens of dollars now, and after one or two years of flowering, they can be sold for hundreds of dollars. "
Uncle Zhang introduced it excitedly, but at the same time felt that it was a pity that Xu Shiyan's family was too far away, and he couldn't find good varieties.
Uncle Zhang's words were like a thunderbolt on a sunny day, splitting Xu Shiyan's chaotic memory.
That's right, that's right, how could he completely forget such an important thing?
In the early 1980s, the speculation of Clivia in the provincial capital became very popular.
It is said that a Hong Kong businessman once came to buy a pot of top-quality Clivia Clivia in person, and offered to exchange it for a Crown sedan, but he was not sold to him.
There is also a person in Harbin who spent 50,000 yuan to buy a pot of Clivia back home.
I heard that at that time, Clivia was called "green gold bars".
At this time in the previous life, Xu Shiyan was still in the big house, and there was no news there. It was several years before they heard about it.
At that time, the speculation of Clivia in the provincial capital had already blown. I don’t know how many people speculated on this and ended up bankrupt. The person who led the exhibition back then was sentenced to prison.
A frenzied hype, leaving only chicken feathers and discarded Clivia seedlings in the trash.
Xu Shiyan's heart was beating wildly.
When paying the hospitalization fee in the morning, Xu Shiqin also said that he didn't know where the next surgery fee would come from.
The pot on the window sill of Uncle Zhang’s house is a common variety, and each pot can sell for hundreds of dollars. The ones cultivated by Xu Shiqin must be more expensive.
I don’t know what the sixth sister of his family is thinking, anyway, she really likes Clivia.
In the past few years, Xu Shiqin has searched for flower seedlings everywhere, and also pollinated the seeds by himself to cultivate young seedlings.
There are nearly a hundred pots of Clivia seedlings, large and small, at home. There are about ten rooms in the two houses, and the window sills are full of Clivia.
Zhou Guilan said it, but Xu Shiqin didn't listen to it, and he was very meticulous in serving him every day.
If this is sold at a good time, how much can it be exchanged for?
When Xu Shiyan thought of this, his heart almost jumped into his throat.
"Master, Clivia is so valuable? You can't be fooling around, right? It's just a potted flower, anyone buy it?"
Xu Shiyan said this on purpose to provoke the old man.
Sure enough, Uncle Zhang became unhappy when he heard it, "Then how can it be worthless?
what is this? Clivia. At the beginning, it was raised in the palace of Emperor Xuantong, where did the common people see it?
Emperor Xuantong fell, and the gardener in the palace got the seeds and spread them, and then they spread among the people. "
"People say Clivia is elegant and handsome, with the style of a gentleman.
Its flowers are like orchids, and the leaves, flowers, and fruits are all beautiful. You can enjoy flowers in one season, fruits in three seasons, and leaves in four seasons. Are ordinary flowers comparable? "
Uncle Zhang had a sullen face and gave Xu Shiyan a lesson.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly made an expression of enlightenment, and nodded repeatedly, "Yes, yes, the uncle is still very powerful and educated.
I’m from a small valley, so I really don’t understand these things.
Then according to what the uncle said, Clivia is quite valuable, a few hundred yuan per tree, which is more than a year's salary. "
Now, if I follow Uncle Zhang's words, I will directly coax the old man who is fried.
Xu Shiyan said that he came from the valley and didn’t understand anything, which made Uncle Zhang feel beautiful immediately, and a sense of superiority arose spontaneously.
"Yes, you said if you hadn't come to the provincial capital, would you have seen so many tall buildings?
Come out to gain knowledge. If you don’t understand, just read and ask more, don’t talk nonsense. "
"Yes, yes, what the uncle said is true." Xu Shiyan was not annoyed either.
"Master, if you want to buy Clivia, where do you go?
As soon as I heard what my uncle said, I wanted to find some good seedlings and go home. "Xu Shiyan asked intentionally.
"Oh, it's winter, it's not the time, I can't buy any more.
In summer, there is a road market on the other side of Hongqi Street, where many people sell and buy flowers. "
Uncle Zhang didn't know what Xu Shiyan was thinking, so he shook his head regretfully, and casually gave an address.
Xu Shiyan kept the address of Hongqi Street firmly in his heart at that time. It is true that he will not make a trip this year, but he can do it next year or the year after.
Just at this time, Aunt Zhang prepared the meal and brought it in.
Xu Shiyan saw it, and hurried out, picking vegetables, washing vegetables, cutting meat, and cooking.
In winter, there are not many fresh vegetables in the provincial capital, radishes, cabbage and potatoes.
Potato slices fried with meat, cabbage slices fried with meat, served with the steamed buns bought before, and a meal is complete.
So they put them in newly bought lunch boxes that were cleaned and cleaned, and then cleaned up the kitchen. Xu Shiyan went straight to the hospital with the meals.
"Little sister, you don't have to worry about the cost of the operation this time, brother knows a way to make money."

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Operation
chapters.content:
Chapter 237 Surgery
Xu Shiqin's operation was scheduled on the 12th. After the physical examination in the morning, the doctor asked her to rest in the ward.
He also prescribed some medicine for Xu Shiqin to take on time, try to adjust his state as much as possible, and prepare for the operation the day after tomorrow.
I haven't seen my third brother all afternoon, and now I just shouted that I have money for surgery.
Xu Shiqin was a little confused, not knowing what her third brother meant by this.
"Brother, what happened to you again? It makes you happy."
"Sister, you are a rich man now, brother will have to rely on you to take care of me in the future."
Xu Shiyan smiled, opened the lunch box, and handed Xu Shiqin a pair of chopsticks.
"Come, eat, let's have a meal today, and tomorrow I will buy ribs for you to stew."
Xu Shiqin was even more confused, what happened to her brother? Nervous?
"Brother, aren't you obsessed with something? Are you talking nonsense? Why can't I understand a word?"
Xu Shiyan laughed loudly when he heard the words, "I rented a house near here, guess what I saw in the landlord's house? There are four pots of Clivia on the windowsill of his house.
I heard from the old man Zhang that now a pot of Clivia can be bought for hundreds, and seedlings can be bought for dozens.
Think about it, how many pots are there in total in our family? You are not a rich man who is? "
It's boring to play tricks, so Xu Shiyan announced it directly.
"You girl is really blessed, I don't know what you think, why do you have to raise so many pots? Do you know that this stuff can be valuable?"
If it wasn't for Xu Shiqin's normal behavior on weekdays, Xu Shiyan would really wonder if his sister had also been reborn.
Xu Shiqin was dumbfounded when he heard the words, "Hundreds of dollars a pot? Is it true or not? Then our family has a lot of them."
Clivia can be propagated by seeds or by dividing roots.
Xu Shiqin likes Clivia, so he searched for flower seedlings everywhere and raised them. After the Clivia he raised bloomed, he was reluctant to cut off the flower arrows, and kept the seeds for reproduction.
Over the past few years, I have saved a lot, big and small.
If there are hundreds of pots in a large pot and dozens of small pots, those at home can be worth ten to twenty thousand.
"It's true. I heard people say that the relevant leaders want to designate Clivia as a city flower. If that's true, the price of Clivia will probably increase.
Let's not be in a hurry, take good care of those flowers when you go back, and wait for us to come early next year and bring some potted flowers to try. "
It seems that in 1984, Clivia was designated as a city flower, and then the price soared.
Until June 1985, this farce finally came to an end after the official action, leaving a mess.
On the way to the hospital, Xu Shiyan had already thought about it. He could think of a way to operate this matter and take the opportunity to make a fortune.
Fusong is far away from the provincial capital, and the trend of hype Clivia has not spread. He can take the opportunity to buy some seedlings and seeds at a low price and cultivate them by himself.
In the fall of the next year, I will come to the provincial capital to rent a place to sell. As long as I sell them all before June 1985, I can make some money.
Of course, this is not something he can do alone.
After I had to go back, I discussed with Zhou Qingguo, Han Limin, Feng Chao and others, and the big guys worked together and made money together.
"Then when I go back this time, I will plant all the seeds left this year.
Fortunately, I didn’t listen to our mother’s yelling, so I threw the seeds away, and later sold them for money. See if our mother still mumbles? "
Xu Shiqin was very happy. How could he have imagined that because of a momentary liking, he would actually save a lot of money.
Now, I really don't have to worry about the operation fee.
"Those are all things to say later, eat first, take a good rest after eating, and adjust your state to prepare for the operation.
Cure your problem first, and then let’s talk about other things. Don’t worry, with my brother here, I can still earn the cost of your surgery. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, urged Xu Shiqin to eat quickly, and picked all the meat for her. "Eat more."
After the brothers and sisters finished eating, Xu Shiyan went to the water room to clean the lunch box and chopsticks.
Only Xu Shiqin lived in the ward, and there was another bed over there. Xu Shiyan worried that it would be unsafe for his sister to live alone at night, so he covered himself with a coat and lived on another bed.
The next morning, Xu Shiyan went to buy paper and pens, and wrote to Zhou Qingguo.
The letter talked about Clivia, and asked Zhou Qingguo to join forces with Feng Chao, Zhao Jianshe and others to search for small flower seedlings and seeds of Clivia in surrounding villages and towns.
The specific matters will be discussed after Xu Shiyan returns home.
One more thing is to ask Zhou Qingguo to go to Xu's house and tell Zhou Guilan that the family's Clivia must not be harmed.
What's more, it must be kept secret, and no one else should know.
Xu Shiqin also wrote a letter to Han Liwei, telling him in detail about the operation in the provincial capital, and hoped that Han Liwei could understand that the wedding date was postponed.
After writing the letter, Xu Shiyan went to the post office to send the registered letter. The staff assured that it would arrive within a week, so Xu Shiyan was relieved.
At 8:30 in the morning on the 12th, Xu Shiqin, who had fasted all night, was pushed into the operating room.
Xu Shiyan stood guard outside the operating room, walking back and forth nervously.
"God bless my little sister to go well, and the operation must be done safely."
Xu Shiyan clasped his hands together and muttered as he walked.
The operation lasted for more than three hours, until it was almost twelve o'clock, and the door of the operating room finally opened.
A group of doctors didn't even change their surgical gowns, and all of them walked out of it with tired faces.
"Doctor, how is my sister? Did the operation go well?" Xu Shiyan hurried forward and asked.
Chi Hao raised his hand and took off his mask, nodded towards Xu Shiyan, "The operation was very successful.
We remove excess hyperplastic tissue around the spine and restore the misaligned spine to its original position.
For the first surgery, it cannot be directly restored to the normal curvature, so that the internal organs and bones of the patient cannot adapt to the sudden change.
After one and a half months of recuperation after the operation, the second correction will be done, and the second correction will be easier, and the curvature can be corrected to normal by then. "
Chi Hao knew what Xu Shiyan was worried about, so he patiently explained to Xu Shiyan.
"The patient will be sent back to the ward in a while, and it is estimated that he will wake up tonight.
After the anesthetic fails, it will be very painful. I will try to use some medicines to relieve the pain, and the patient will have to try to overcome the rest.
The patient cannot eat for 24 hours, and cannot walk on the ground within a week.
Moreover, try not to adopt the supine position, but must lie on the side, and be careful when turning over. "
Chi Hao patiently explained the precautions to Xu Shiyan.
At this time, the nurse pushed Xu Shiqin, who was covered with tubes and hung with several hanging needles, out of the operating room.
Xu Shiyan couldn't care about anything else, so he hurried forward to help, pushed Xu Shiqin back to the ward, and carried him to the hospital bed.
"There are still a few bottles of medicine. When you see that the bottle is empty, go to the nursing station to find someone to change the medicine." The nurse instructed a few words, turned and left.
Xu Shiyan squatted in front of the hospital bed, looking at Xu Shiqin who was lying motionless on the bed with a pale face.
"Sigh, I don't know if I insisted on you undergoing surgical correction, whether it was right or wrong, and caused you to suffer so much."
There are always countless sufferings at the moment. If you don’t do corrections, you will suffer punishments when you get old.
"Oh, I hope everything goes well for you in the future.
I don’t want to be rich and powerful, but only to be safe and healthy, that means I didn’t waste my thoughts in vain. "
Xu Shiyan looked at the sleeping Xu Shiqin and muttered.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 238: recover
chapters.content:
Chapter 238 Restoration
Xu Shiqin woke up at night, and couldn't even drink water because the anesthetic hadn't worn off yet.
Xu Shiyan could only dip a cotton swab in water and wipe his sister's lips for relief.
After the anesthetic wears off, Xu Shiqin, who was tortured by severe pain, was dying. Even if the doctor gave him an analgesic, it could only alleviate part of it.
Xu Shiqin was sweating in pain, gritted his teeth and refused to cry or shout.
None of the doctors and nurses expected that the seemingly weak Xu Shiqin would be so strong.
You know, how many strong men can't survive the pain after the operation, and some people even cried and howled for the doctor to prescribe strong analgesics.
A girl as young as Xu Shiqin can't even cry out. This kind of perseverance is admirable.
After twenty-four hours, Xu Shiqin can eat.
At first it was only liquid food, but gradually I could eat some soft noodles, small wontons and the like.
Before the operation, Xu Shiyan asked Qi Yunsheng's daughter-in-law for help, and found a woman in her forties to accompany her in the hospital.
Aunt Wang took care of Xu Shiqin in the hospital, while Xu Shiyan concentrated on cooking, running between the hospital and Uncle Zhang's house.
Xu Shiyan changed ways to cook food for his younger sister, and from time to time went to the market to buy some spare ribs or big bones to make soup for Xu Shiqin.
Fortunately, I rented a house and cook by myself, so I can do whatever I want.
If this is staying at a restaurant, where can I buy bone soup? Can the stuff made by the restaurant compare with the stewed ones at home?
With Xu Shiyan's meticulous care, Xu Shiqin recovered quite quickly.
A week later, Xu Shiqin dared to move slowly to the ground.
When Xu Shiqin stood up for the first time with the support of his brother, he felt as if he was taller.
"Brother, have I become taller? Why do I feel that I am different from before?" Xu Shiqin asked in doubt and surprise.
Xu Shiyan looked down at the little girl beside him.
Because of spinal deformity, Xu Shiqin was only about 1.5 meters tall.
Now that most of the spine has been corrected, the whole body is stretched out, and naturally it is much taller than before.
"Well, it is taller. You are about 1.6 meters now. You are waiting for another operation. The curvature of the spine will completely return to normal. It should be a little higher."
Xu Shiyan was also very excited. He just said that there is no inheritance of short stature in the family. If his little sister grows up normally, she will definitely not be short.
Now it’s not bad, at least the spine has recovered, and the internal organs will not be squeezed in the future.
When Xu Shiqin gets old, the chest space will not be so crowded that the heart and lungs will not be able to relax.
"Brother, thank you, if you hadn't found a way to find someone and paid for my treatment, I'm afraid I would have to live like a hunchback for the rest of my life.
How dare I think that there will be a day when I can straighten up? "
Xu Shiqin, who suffered from postoperative pain in those days, didn't cry, but at this moment, she really couldn't help crying.
For so many years, she dreamed that she could stand straight in front of people.
Now, this dream can finally come true, and she is no longer a hunchback in the eyes of others.
She is a brand new Xu Shiqin, and she no longer has to bear strange looks from others.
Xu Shiqin cried bitterly while hugging her brother, and Xu Shiyan couldn't help crying too.
"Okay, okay, we just finished the operation a few days ago, so we can't cry.
Come on, you'd better go back to bed and lie down, the doctor said, you can't walk around for too long every day.
Take it step by step and give the spine and internal organs time to adapt. "
Spine deformity correction is actually tantamount to removing the proliferated bone on the spine through surgery and other means, and then forcing the spine to return to normal with the help of external force.
The spine has been bent for so many years, and the internal organs have also adapted to the original space.
This sudden recovery from correction requires time for the spine and internal organs to adapt. To put it simply, don’t stretch it out.
So the doctor told me to do it step by step, and not to move for too long at once, otherwise the internal organs will not be able to bear it.
Xu Shiqin wiped away his tears, went to the bathroom with Aunt Wang's support, and then came back and continued to lie down.
From then on, Xu Shiqin added a little more time for activities every day, and gradually felt that it was not so uncomfortable to get up and walk around.
November 24th, that is, the twelfth day of Xu Shiqin's operation, she was able to walk on the ground for half an hour.
Accompanied by Xu Shiyan, Xu Shiqin specially found a place with a big mirror, and went to look in the mirror.
Looking at the slightly hunched figure in the mirror, Xu Shiqin couldn't help crying again.
The scene that I dreamed of before has finally become a reality.
"Okay, let's go back, if the doctor doesn't see you during the ward round, he will have to reprimand me again."
Xu Shiyan looked at his sister like that, his eyes filled with relief.
How wonderful, this is what a girl in her twenties should look like.
"Wait for you to recover, I will take you to a department store to buy clothes.
Your old clothes probably won’t be worn anymore, so let’s change them all and buy new ones. "
How wonderful, my sister can dress up beautifully in the future, wearing beautiful long skirts.
His sister is good-looking, she must be prettier than the models in the pictorial.
Xu Shiyan helped Xu Shiqin, who was reluctant to part with him and looked back at the mirror, to leave and return to the ward.
As a result, as soon as I entered the ward, I saw a figure that shouldn't be here.
"Liwei, why are you here?" The siblings exclaimed at the same time.
The person waiting in the ward is Han Liwei who should be far away in Shenyang.
At this moment, he was wearing a grass-green uniform, standing upright in the ward, when he heard a familiar voice turning his head.
Then, I saw Xu Shiqin who had changed drastically as if he had been reborn from the ashes.
"Shiqin, how are you? I received a telegram that day saying that you were undergoing surgery in Changchun. I was so anxious that I died."
Han Liwei stepped forward and hugged Xu Shiqin in his arms.
Seeing this, Xu Shiyan might as well retreat to the door to give the lovers some space.
The two haven't seen each other for several years, and they meet again in this situation, so there must be a lot to talk about.
It’s better to avoid his light bulb for a while.
Xu Shiyan stood at the door, half-closed the door of the ward, and listened to the two people in the room whispering their parting and longing for each other.
After a while, Xu Shiyan coughed twice, pushed the door open again and entered.
At this moment, both Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin had calmed down. When Han Liwei saw Xu Shiyan enter the door, he immediately stood up.
"Third brother, thank you, I, I really didn't expect Shiqin to recover so well."
In Han Liwei's opinion, Xu Shiqin's current performance is already very good.
"Thank you? This is my own sister, and I should do everything for her."
Originally, Xu Shiyan still had some opinions on Han Liwei.
This guy came to chase his sister without making a sound, and really hooked her, it is really hateful.
But it seemed that Han Liwei had rushed over from such a long distance, and he immediately left after receiving the news.
Don't say anything else, just for this kind of affection, Xu Shiyan can't say anything else.
The two families have already agreed on a marriage, so what else can he say? admit it.
"Are you here on vacation? How long is the vacation? Will it not delay your business?" Xu Shiyan asked worriedly.
"Well, I originally asked for leave before the Chinese New Year to go back to get engaged and get married.
Didn’t you receive a letter from Shiqin? When I learned of her surgery, I really couldn't wait, so I took a vacation in advance to take care of her. "

chapters.title: Chapter 239: ready to get engaged
chapters.content:
Chapter 239 Preparing for Engagement
When Han Liwei received a telegram and learned that Xu Shiqin was preparing for an operation in Changchun Hospital, he was in a hurry.
But the telegram was only a few words, and the words were not clear. He didn't even know which hospital Xu Shiqin was in, and it was useless for Han Liwei to worry.
There was no way, Han Liwei called a member of the field to find Han Limin, and asked Han Limin to go to Xu's house to inquire about the situation, and told him when he understood.
Han Limin answered the phone without daring to neglect, and immediately went to Xu's house to inquire.
Only then did I know that Xu Shiyan accompanied Xu Shiqin, and the two of them left on the 8th to go to the Provincial Medical University Hospital for surgery.
Han Limin hurried back and called Han Liwei to explain the situation clearly.
Han Liwei hurriedly asked the leader to ask for leave, and wanted to go to Changchun to find Xu Shiqin.
Han Liwei has one month of family leave every year. Last year, he gave the vacation to others. This time he simply took extra vacation.
Just when he was about to leave after asking for leave, the registered letter from Xu Shiyan arrived.
Han Liwei knew the specific address, so he rushed all the way to the provincial capital to find the two brothers and sisters.
"Third brother, I have two months of vacation, let me stay with Shiqin for a while, if you are busy at home, go back."
Xu Shiqin wrote in the letter that she will need at least three months for this operation.
Han Liwei had already sent a telegram to his family before leaving, saying that he would go to Changchun to accompany Xu Shiqin, and that he might not be able to go home this year.
"No, there is nothing to do at home in winter, and I have made arrangements before I leave.
In a month, Shiqin will have another operation, I don't worry about her. "
The object is the object, and they are not married yet, so how could they all be taken care of by Han Liwei?
"You still have to go back to Donggang when you have time, and go back to see the old man.
I haven’t been back for two years, Uncle Han and Auntie miss you very much. "
Han Liwei seldom has a vacation, but he came here directly to accompany Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiyan didn't want these things to affect the Han family's opinion of Xu Shiqin, so he suggested that Han Liwei take time to go home.
Han Liwei is not a fool, how could he not understand what Xu Shiyan meant?
"Third brother, I will stay here with Shiqin for a few days, and then go home."
Han Liwei had other concerns. He had to go back and discuss some matters with his parents.
Xu Shiyan nodded, it's okay, not a fool who is dazzled by love.
Daughter-in-law is important, but parents should not be forgotten.
"Well, you stay here with Shiqin for a few days, and then go home to see your parents.
Waiting for Shiqin to have the second operation, you come back, and we will stay with her together. "
Recently, Xu Shiqin's state has stabilized, as long as there is one person watching.
I don’t know what the second operation will be like. It would be great if there are more people to accompany me at that time.
Just like that, Han Liwei stayed in the hospital to take care of Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiyan can spare more time to study with Mr. Chu.
Xu Shiyan already has a foundation, and he hasn't abandoned his medical books these years.
He asked Qi Yunsheng to read a lot of books for Tao, and he would read them when he was free. Compared with when he was studying with Mr. Chu, he has made great progress.
"Why didn't you participate in the barefoot doctor examination last year? Your level is absolutely fine."
After Xu Shiyan tested some of Xu Shiyan's medical foundations, Elder Chu asked very puzzled.
"I'm too busy to take care of it, and besides, I don't have confidence.
I thought the barefoot doctor exam was quite demanding. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head. It was September, the busiest season in Shendi, so how could there be time to take any exams?
"You, you can't tell the difference between serious things every day, don't you understand which one is important?"
Old Chu was annoyed by Xu Shiyan, thinking that he didn't take priority.
"Go back and inquire. There will be an exam next time. You must sign up to take it. After passing the exam, it will definitely be useful."
Mr. Chu repeatedly urged Xu Shiyan to get his certificate.
"Don't think I'm fooling you, there is a big gap in the medical team now, especially the shortage of rural doctors, so the higher-ups have relaxed the requirements.
Wait a few more years, and all the medical students will graduate, so what about the barefoot doctor? "
"Well, don't worry, master, I will definitely study hard when I go back, and try to pass the certificate exam."
This point, needless to be said by Mr. Chu, Xu Shiyan is of course clear.
With the reform of the college entrance examination system and the expansion of university enrollment, it is not easy for students who graduate from health schools to find jobs.
At that time, how could there be any talk about barefoot doctors and country doctors? It was canceled long ago.
Those who got the certificate before also have their own places to go. They can open their own clinics, and some are recruited by the hospital and become doctors with formal jobs.
Xu Shiyan is not interested in the job of a doctor, but the certificate is really useful in his hands.
On this point, Mr. Chu is right, he should have passed the exam earlier.
Barefoot doctors are different from orthodox Chinese medicine and Western medicine. They don't pay attention to the system, but focus on practicality and healing.
Never mind black cats and white cats, the cat that can catch mice is a good cat.
The same goes for barefoot doctors, no matter what kind of traditional Chinese medicine or Western medicine, as long as it can cure diseases.
As for Mr. Chu, he studied Chinese medicine when he was young, and Western medicine when he grew up.
Who cares about Chinese and Western medicine in those years? As long as he can save people and cure diseases, he is a good doctor.
So Mr. Chu himself never struggled with these things. He proceeded from reality and passed on the most practical things to Xu Shiyan.
There are two masters and apprentices, one teaches with heart, and the other learns wholeheartedly. Can such one-on-one teaching be effective?
Xu Shiyan came to study every morning and afternoon, and went back to cook for Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei in the middle.
In the evening, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin will change shifts to accompany Xu Shiqin, and they will spend all their time reading and reviewing.
Han Liwei stayed with Xu Shiqin in the hospital for a week, and then left for Donggang.
Xu Shiyan thought, why did Han Liwei leave for only ten days and half a month? Come back before Xu Shiqin's second surgery?
Unexpectedly, Han Liwei came back after only leaving for a week, and two old people, Han Wenzhong and Xu Chenghou, came back with him.
"Father, Uncle Han, why are you here?"
Xu Shiyan was taken aback. What are the two old men doing so far away?
"Third brother, what about Liwei, the holidays are not enough, I guess he has no time to go home for the New Year.
You, Uncle Han, came to discuss with me, and said that it is better to get engaged to the two in the provincial capital, and it is best to get the certificate as well.
Waiting for our sixth son to recover from his injury, Liwei will have a holiday next time, and they will hold the wedding in a serious manner. "
Originally, the two parties discussed that this winter, taking advantage of Han Liwei's vacation, they directly arranged the marriage.
But Xu Shiqin's surgery disrupted the original plan, and the Han family wants to settle it sooner.
So I went to Xu Chenghou and his wife, and discussed getting engaged first.
Han Liwei has already filed a marriage report, it would be best if he can get the certificate here.
If you can’t get a certificate, you have a marriage report, and you’re engaged, the marriage is considered complete, and you can just make up for the wedding later.
There is no other way, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin are not young, but the situation is special, so we can only find a compromise.
When Xu Shiyan heard this, he gave Han Liwei a blank look. This kid was afraid that something might go wrong in the marriage, so he wanted to settle down early.
Also, with the appearance and character of his sister, and now she has undergone surgery, I don’t know how many people are thinking about it when she goes back.
That kid Han Liwei didn't strike sooner, if he didn't keep it all together, he could really kill Cheng Yaojin halfway.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Get a certificate
chapters.content:
Chapter 240 Licensing
The Xu family naturally couldn't do anything that broke their promises, and it wasn't that Han Liwei didn't trust Xu Shiqin.
"Well, I have no objection to the engagement. As for getting the certificate, you may have to ask if it is okay if you are not in the place of household registration.
But there is one thing I have to tell Liwei in advance, the sixth sister’s operation is not a one-time operation.
Maybe I have to come again next year, and after that it is estimated that I will have to take care of it for half a year before my body fully recovers.
The doctor said that within two years, it is not recommended that the sixth sister become pregnant and have children.
So in my opinion, engagement is fine, and the certificate can be temporarily withheld. "
Xu Shiyan didn't mean to beat the mandarin ducks, some things must be explained clearly in advance, so as to avoid mutual resentment in the future.
"Don't worry, third brother, I know about this, and I have told my parents.
Shiqin and I are both young, we can afford to wait a year or two. "
With Han Liwei's shrewdness, he has already consulted the attending doctor. What he likes is Xu Shiqin, no matter in the past or now.
Well, Han Liwei has already talked about this matter, what position does Xu Shiyan have to object?
"Come on, then choose a good day, before the second operation.
Let's find a better restaurant and invite Mr. Chu, Qi Yunsheng's family, and the doctors and nurses from the hospital.
It's so lively together, that's what it is. "
It is impossible for Han Wenzhong and Xu Chenghou to stay in the provincial capital for a long time, so they can only do it as soon as possible.
"Well, your mother and your aunt Han have already checked the date, and it is the tenth day of this month, which is the day after tomorrow.
It happens to be the 26th day of October in the lunar calendar, which is a good day, so that day. On the other end, Xu Chenghou and Han Wenzhong looked at each other and said with a smile.
Okay, this is the two families who have already negotiated everything that should be discussed. Come on, what are you talking about, let's deal with it quickly.
"Success, I'll talk to Director Chi later.
Tomorrow let Liwei accompany Shiqin to the department store to pick out two nice clothes, and then go to take a photo.
Here, I am looking for someone to inquire about the registration and collection of certificates. If it is possible, I will go to get the certificate the day after tomorrow. "
Both parents agreed, and Xu Shiyan had nothing to object to.
My younger sister is getting older, so she should get married. Anyway, now it’s just a matter of proof, and the wedding has to be done after going back. Just go through the process here.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan first sent Han Wenzhong and Xu Chenghou to the hotel for accommodation.
The house he rented was too small to accommodate too many people.
Besides, when I was renting a house, I arranged for one person, and I took Han Liwei to live there a few days ago, and brought two more out of the blue, because the landlord was afraid that he would not like it.
The two old men on the left and right will not stay in the provincial capital for a long time, so it is better to stay in a hotel for peace of mind.
After the two old men settled down, Xu Shiyan went to find Qi Yunsheng again.
Qi Yunsheng was intern in this hospital, and Xu Shiyan had found an opportunity to visit Qi's family before.
Qi Yunsheng and his wife were also very enthusiastic when they met Xu Shiyan, and even invited Xu Shiyan to eat at home.
As soon as Qi Yunsheng heard that Xu Shiqin was going to obtain a certificate from Han Liwei, he took Xu Shiyan to the relevant department to find out the situation.
When the staff first heard that neither of the two people who wanted to obtain the certificates had local registered permanent residence, they said that they did not comply with the regulations and refused to apply.
Later, I learned that the situation was special, and Han Liwei had a marriage certificate issued by the organization.
The other party let go, saying that they can go to get the certificate, wait for the certificate to be collected, and then go back to the civil affairs department where the household registration is located to report.
Just like that, on the morning of December 8th, after Xu Shiqin had his injection, accompanied by Han Liwei, he went shopping to buy clothes.
Han Liwei took all the allowances he had saved in the past two years, and wanted to buy a few more sets for Xu Shiqin from head to toe.
Where is Xu Shiqin willing? In the end, the two discussed and bought a jacket, sweater, trousers, overcoat, and leather shoes, a complete set, which cost a lot of money.
Then, Xu Shiqin changed into that set of clothes and went to the photo studio with Han Liwei.
"Yes, yes, come closer, come closer, hey, yes, smile."
The master who took the photo had a good attitude. He smiled and instructed the two of them how to pose and how to laugh, and then snapped and snapped several photos in succession.
"What a good couple, look how energetic the young man is, this girl is also handsome."
The cameraman praised Han Liwei and the two for their good meal, and Xu Shiqin blushed in embarrassment when he praised them.
"Come to pick up the photo in about a week, by the way, do you want to add some color?"
This year and month are all black and white photos. This is a wedding photo of Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei, and the black and white ones are not good-looking.
One of the popular ones nowadays is to dye a little color on the developed photos.
A master with high craftsmanship can make photos almost like color photos.
Of course, the price must be higher.
Han Liwei was not short of money, and when he heard that he could paint, he immediately nodded in agreement.
"Then please trouble master, it must be done more delicately, this is our wedding photo, it's too plain to look good."
The master photographer patted his chest and assured that he would definitely make it look better.
Then according to the price of the coloring, they charged another fee, left Han Liwei's name, and told them to come and pick up the photos in a few days.
After all, Xu Shiqin's body hasn't fully recovered yet, so he couldn't stay out for too long. After the photo was taken, the two hurried back to the hospital.
On December 9th, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin, accompanied by Xu Shiyan and Qi Yunsheng, went to the marriage registration department to fill out a form to receive a marriage certificate.
The marriage certificate of this year and month is a piece of pink paper with a red flag printed on it, and ears of grain, flowers, and ribbons printed around it.
According to the household registration booklet and relevant certificates, the staff fills in the names, gender, and age of the two people respectively, writes the year, month, and day at the bottom, and stamps the official seal. This is considered to be a certificate.
"Congratulations to the two of you, you two are newly married and happy, and have a good marriage for a hundred years."
If it is someone else, the staff will probably just give the certificate and the job will be over.
But for Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei, the special couple, the staff had a very good attitude. When they handed over the marriage certificate, they even sent their best wishes.
"Thank you, thank you." Han Liwei was well prepared, and hurriedly took out a bag of candy and distributed it to several staff members on site.
"Come, eat wedding candy and be happy." This kid, his mouth is almost grinning to the ear, and he can't find his way in happiness.
The staff were not polite, they all came over to grab a few pieces of candy to congratulate the new couple.
Amidst the blessings of everyone, the newlyweds happily picked up their marriage certificates, accompanied by Xu Shiyan and Qi Yunsheng, and returned to the hospital.
Han Liwei prepared a lot of candies. This time, as soon as he entered the hospital, he grabbed candies and gave them to everyone, whether it was doctors, nurses or family members of patients.
People in this year are mostly simple and honest. When others heard that the couple had obtained the certificate, they also sent their sincere blessings.
"Several comrades have worked hard. My wife has been in the hospital for so long and has been taken care of by everyone.
Tomorrow is the engagement banquet for my lover and I, and I invite a few comrades to take part in it. "
Han Liwei sent Xu Shiqin back to the ward, and immediately took the candy to the nursing station.
After distributing the candies to the nurses, they were invited to the engagement banquet.
"Comrade, we will keep the wedding candy, but we really can't attend the engagement banquet.
The hospital is busy with work, thank you for your kindness.
I wish Comrade Han and Comrade Xu a harmonious husband and wife, a happy marriage for a hundred years, an early birth of a baby, and happiness. "
The head nurse led all the nurses in the nursing station to send blessings to Han Liwei in unison.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: remind
chapters.content:
Chapter 241 Reminder
At noon on December 10th, Xu Shiyan reserved a table at the Changbaishan Hotel near the hospital.
Invited Mr. Chu, Qi Yunsheng and his wife, Chi Hao and others to attend Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei's engagement banquet.
At the banquet, the Han family brought out the engagement ceremony that had been prepared a long time ago.
A plum blossom watch, a jade bracelet, a pair of gold earrings, and another three hundred dollars.
The bracelet and earrings look old.
The ancestors of the Han family opened an **** agency, which was saved in the early years.
Buried them during the tumultuous years, but now no one cares, they dug them up again, and picked two good ones for the young daughter-in-law.
"The remaining two turns and one ring, and thirty-six legs, will be prepared when you get married."
Han Wenzhong was afraid that the Xu family would misunderstand, thinking that they only gave this, so he had to explain a few sentences.
"Anyway, it's up to you to choose when the time comes. You can ask for something. If you don't want something, you will be paid. You can buy it yourself."
Han Liwei is still there in Shenyang now, and he is not sure where he will be in the future. It is useless to buy furniture in advance, and it will not be able to transport it so far.
So Han Wenzhong didn't make any preparations, and waited until the wedding was held.
"Oh, my in-laws, that's a lot.
Their young people have wages, and they can buy the rest by themselves. How can they have to give everything to their parents? "
Engaged in this year, there is no dowry money, the Han family will give 300 yuan, which is quite a lot.
Xu Chenghou was very satisfied, how could he let the Han family pay for something that had two turns and one sound and thirty-six legs?
How much does it cost to marry a wife?
They are all ordinary people, and no one will take advantage of it to enter the mountains and silver mountains, so they dare not make such a fuss.
The Han family produced so many things, what do the Xu family want to dowry?
"We do new things and do new things, so we don't pay so much attention to rules.
As long as the two of them get along well and are harmonious and beautiful, those thirty-six legs, two turns and one sound, are all external objects. "
All the certificates have been obtained, as long as there is no big difference, the Xu family does not choose, as long as Han Liwei treats Xu Shiqin well, he can accept any conditions.
"Okay, let them arrange it themselves, and we old people will not get involved."
The Xu family was reasonable, and Han Wenzhong was also very happy, so he waved his hand and asked Xu Shiqin to put away the money and things.
Over there, Xu Shiyan and Han Limin helped to serve all the dishes. When the food and wine were ready, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin toasted their fathers together.
Both Han Wenzhong and Xu Chenghou prepared red envelopes to give change money.
Of course, there is not much money for changing the name this year, just a few dollars, just for auspiciousness.
Changed her mouth, the engagement process is almost over, and the next step is to eat and drink.
Xu Chenghou had to offer a few glasses of wine to Mr. Chu and apologize for the past.
Mr. Chu is the one who cares about those? He just smiled and waved his hands, no one will mention the past, just let it go with a smile.
Elder Chu, Chi Hao, and Qi Yunsheng were not allowed to drink alcohol, which did not affect the atmosphere of the engagement banquet.
The big guys were chatting and laughing, and it was very lively. At the banquet, Xu Shiyan deliberately brought the topic to the monkey forest in the south.
Nowadays, the Chinese people are most concerned about the safety of the Southwest Monkey Forest. Han Liwei also has to do drills in the army.
This topic, it can be said that men are very concerned about it, and once it is brought up, they can't stop it.
Xu Shiyan deliberately pretended to be a little drunk.
"Liwei, I heard that those monkeys are very good at special operations, especially ambushes in the mountains and forests, and have a very high endurance. Is there such a thing?"
"Yes, I also heard people mention that they can lie in ambush in the wet and dark forest swamps full of snakes and poisonous insects, and they have great endurance."
Han Liwei certainly knows more than Xu Shiyan, "They often lie in ambush like this, attacking us by surprise."
"Then you said, is there such a possibility.
It means that the two sides are going to fight. We use some equipment to observe the other side in advance, and we also use some radish and big flowers to wash the ground in advance.
But monkeys can bear it. No matter how many people are injured, they just keep silent and motionless, which leads to our misjudgment? "
In the previous life, Han Liwei and his comrades were negligent due to misjudgment. Everyone thought that there would be no war and went to sleep.
As a result, the monkey attacked, and Han Liwei and his comrades all died in that battle, which made Han Wenzhong sad for the rest of his life.
Right now, Han Liwei has not been transferred to the southwest, and Xu Shiyan doesn't know whether Han Liwei will be transferred in this life.
Xu Shiyan has already made plans for the past two days. If he can remind him, he will remind him and get vaccinated in advance so that Han Liwei will be aware of this.
It was impossible, so at the beginning of spring in 1984, Xu Shiqin was asked to write a letter to call Han Liwei back for the wedding.
Although doing that may make Han Liwei miss the most important moment in his military career, and he may regret it, but it is better than losing his life.
Of course, Xu Shiyan hopes that through Han Liwei, he can also remind his comrades in arms. Maybe this way, more family tragedies can be avoided.
Xu Shiyan is a soft-spoken person, and there is really too little he can do. He can only do this little bit of effort, hoping it will be useful.
Han Liwei's expression suddenly became serious when he heard this.
After all these years in the army, he naturally knows more than Xu Shiyan.
If the battle takes place at night, if our electronic equipment fails to detect the abnormality of the opponent, it is really possible to misjudge.
"Third Brother, I have never been to the Monkey Forest, and I have only heard about it.
But the situation you mentioned may really happen. Looking back, I will try to write a report. "
They also have some virtual training courses in the army. The situation Xu Shiyan mentioned is a good simulation condition, and you can really try it.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard it, he knew that Han Liwei valued his words, and immediately became happy.
As long as someone pays attention to it, maybe when they encounter this situation in the future, they will be alerted and will not repeat the tragic scene of the previous life.
"I don't understand anything, it's just nonsense, you can figure it out for yourself." Xu Shiyan waved his hand, pretending to be stupid.
"Shiyan, if you don't understand anything, everyone else will be a fool.
Is there something you don't know yet? As for that kid from the Li family, he sorted out all the questions he asked you for advice, wrote a document and handed it to Secretary Lin, the leader in attendance.
Secretary Lin read the material and became interested in the contents, so he called Li to ask.
Finally, kid Li said, I learned all this from you.
Secretary Lin wanted to discuss with you in detail, but after inquiring, you came to the provincial capital. "
On the other end, Han Wenzhong remembered something and told Xu Shiyan quickly.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, what did he tell Li Chengrong? Oh, it seems to be comprehensive utilization of ginseng and deep processing of ginseng products, right?
At the beginning, it was Li Chengrong who had no choice but to say it. Why do you still have to find him? Why are you looking for him?
"Looking for me? I belong to the commune, they are state-run workers, and they are two units. What's the use of looking for me? I'm not just a worker.
I told Li Chengrong everything I could say, but there was only a little stuff in my stomach, and I couldn’t tell you anything useful. "
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: can be discharged
chapters.content:
Chapter 242 can be discharged
Xu Shiyan didn't mean to pretend to be a wolf with a big tail when he said that, he really didn't care about those things.
If you don’t think about Clivia, you can ask him to give lectures or help when you come to the venue, as long as he is free, it’s nothing.
But it’s not working now. In the next two years, Xu Shiyan will focus on the development of Clivia, and also take care of the farm and his own ginseng land.
He is too busy, how can he have the time to give guidance to the participants?
"Well, that's right, I've heard from Limin that you gave technical guidance to a participant before.
The idea of ​​each of these is really beautiful. For some salary, I just want to get other people's good ideas to them.
If you want me to say, don't talk to them unless they give enough benefits. "
People's hearts are biased towards their own family.
Not to mention that the Han and Xu families got married, even before, in Han Wenzhong's place, Xu Shiyan was closer.
"Uncle, it's not a good thing, I really don't have time and can't take care of it.
That Zhou Qingguo went to see Brother Limin, right? Next, I have to do some big things with Brother Limin. "
Han Wenzhong was so protective, Xu Shiyan was naturally happy.
Before, Xu Shiyan wrote to Zhou Qingguo, asking him to find brothers Han Limin, as well as Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Huang Shengli, and others to find ways to search for Clivia florets and seeds.
A few days ago, I received a letter from Zhou Qingguo, saying that they had found a lot of seeds, and asked Xu Shiyan when he would go back and what to do next.
From Zhou Qingguo's reply letter, Xu Shiyan knew that Brother Han Limin must have participated.
In his previous life, he owed such a big favor to the Han family, but in this life, he took Han Limin with him and earned some money, so it was considered repayment.
"I don't know about it. I'm still on the mountain, and it's not time to go down."
Han Wenzhong shook his head. He has been taking people to see ginseng on the mountain, and every year he goes down the mountain in time for New Year's Day.
"What's wrong? You still want to do big things, what big things are you doing?"
Xu Shiyan slapped his forehead, this stinky memory is really gone, he can't remember anything.
"It's nothing, just thinking about some business and earning some money." Xu Shiyan chuckled, trying to get away with it.
Han Wenzhong saw Xu Shiyan's expression, and he knew there was a ghost. He wanted to ask, but the occasion was wrong.
Forget it, let’s talk about it when we find a chance.
Chi Hao and Qi Yunsheng have to go to work in the afternoon, and Xu Shiqin can't be out for too long.
After a while, she will have an operation, so she must recuperate.
The others didn't let go of their drinking either, they all wanted to let it go, so the engagement banquet didn't drag on for too long, everyone ate and drank enough and left together.
Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei are engaged, so the old fathers of the two families are relieved.
Stayed in the provincial capital for another day, the two felt that the cost here was too high, so they hurriedly bought a ticket and walked back.
On this long road, the car had to be reversed halfway. Xu Shiyan was worried and wanted to send the two old men back.
I don’t want Xu Chenghou and Han Wenzhong to disagree. They think that Xu Shiyan is looking down on them.
The two of them haven't reached the point where they can't move, how can they not go home?
The two stubborn old men insisted, but Xu Shiyan had no choice but to tell them to be careful on the way back.
"Okay, we are both over a hundred years old together, how can we not be as good as you?
Do you know the name of the thing under the nose? It's too bad, we can't open our mouths to ask?
Okay, hurry back and accompany Lao Liu, don't waste your time here. "
Xu Chenghou was really impatient with his son talking about it, so he happened to be shouting for ticket inspection, so he quickly picked up his bags, took the ticket and entered the station.
Xu Shiyan looked helplessly at the two old men entering the station until they disappeared, then sighed, turned and left the train station.
Xu Chenghou and Han Wenzhong got on the train and walked back, backing up at the Hun River halfway.
The two old men went out, but no one paid attention to them, but they went back after a smooth trip.
Here, Xu Shiyan and Han Liwei accompanied Xu Shiqin, making different kinds of food every day to replenish her body.
Xu Shiqin is recovering very well, Chi Hao consulted with a group of experts outside the bone, and confirmed that Xu Shiqin's condition is OK.
It was decided to perform a second operation on Xu Shiqin on December 20th.
On the morning of the 20th, it was still 8:30, and Xu Shiqin was pushed into the operating room again.
Xu Shiyan and Han Liwei stood outside the operating room, waiting anxiously.
Compared with the first time, the second operation is much simpler and easier. The main thing is to adjust the curvature of the spine to be the same as that of a normal person.
Alloy screws and nail rods are installed for the first time, and you only need to make some adjustments for the second time.
In this way, the time was naturally not as long as last time. Two hours later, the door of the operating room opened.
“The patient’s spine has been fully adjusted to the normal curvature, and the operation was a success.
The next step is to rest with peace of mind, and when her spine and internal organs can fully adapt, she can be discharged from the hospital. "
Chi Hao knew that the family members were in a hurry, so this time without waiting for Xu Shiyan and the others to ask, he took off his mask and explained to them.
"Nursing is still the same as last time, so I won't say more about it.
After the patient can eat, I will give the patient more nourishing food, and then I will prescribe some medicine to promote bone recovery.
If the recovery is good, it may take less than a month to be discharged from the hospital and go home. "
Xu Shiqin's condition is better than expected, and he should be able to leave the hospital and go home earlier.
Xu Shiyan and Han Liwei were very happy when they heard the news. After thanking them, they helped push the car back to the ward.
The pain after the operation this time seems to be lighter than the last time, and Xu Shiqin didn't suffer as much after waking up.
Under the careful care of everyone, after seven or eight days, Xu Shiqin dared to walk slowly.
This time, there was another big change, Xu Shiqin could completely straighten his back.
It looks like a normal person, and it seems to be a little taller than before.
"That's great, this is what my sister should look like."
Xu Shiyan looked at Xu Shiqin, who stood shoulder to shoulder with Han Liwei, tall and straight, and found it particularly pleasing to the eye.
Look, what a good couple, God, he still loves others, and finally made his sister get better.
The curvature of the spine is completely restored, and the internal organs need a process of adaptation, which cannot be rushed.
Xu Shiqin appropriately increased the frequency and duration of activities every day according to the doctor's request. After gradually getting used to it, she felt less uncomfortable.
In the blink of an eye, 1982 ended, and New Year's Day in 1983 arrived.
On New Year's Day, Xu Shiyan and Han Liwei made dumplings and sent them to the hospital ward in lunch boxes and small pots.
The three of them ate dumplings in the ward, happily celebrating New Year's Day.
After New Year's Day, Xu Shiqin's health improved day by day, and he was able to walk on the ground for a long time every day.
After the rounds on the morning of January 18th, Chi Hao also brought good news.
After consultation with the orthopedic surgery expert group, Xu Shiqin's physical condition is very good, and she can go through the discharge procedures and go home to recuperate.
"Go back and take a good rest. Within three months, you can't do heavy work, you can't sit for a long time, and you should rest as much as possible.
Winter next year, I have to go again to take out the screws and nail rods in the body. "Young Master Chi Hao must not tell you the precautions after discharge from the hospital.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: come back
chapters.content:
Chapter 243 Return
Xu Shiqin is young, has good physical recovery, and Xu Shiyan is meticulous in serving him, so it is much earlier than the expected three months.
This is of course good news, and the three of them are very happy.
After thanking Chi Hao, Xu Shiyan hurriedly went to the inpatient department to settle all expenses and went through the discharge procedures.
Then the three of them packed their luggage and moved to the other side of the small rented house in several trips.
When I first rented a house, I told people that I would rent it for three months.
There are still some days left before three months, and they still have to stay in the provincial capital for a day or two, so of course they have to live here.
This is the first time that the old landlord couple saw Xu Shiqin, and they learned that she was Xu Shiyan's younger sister who was hospitalized.
Seeing that Xu Shiqin looks so good-looking, I couldn't help but praise him.
Xu Shiyan told the landlord, Aunt Zhang, that they were leaving early.
After getting along with each other for the past two months, the landlord and the old couple are also somewhat reluctant to part with Xu Shiyan.
"Xiao Xu, this is your remaining rent and deposit.
Although it was said to be three months at the beginning, since you have returned the house early, it is not easy for me to charge you more money.
Take the money and buy some food for your sister on the way back. Aunt Zhang handed Xu Shiyan twenty-five yuan.
The monthly rent is twenty-three, and the stay this month is less than ten days.
Aunt Zhang counted on the basis of ten days, and left eight yuan, and the remaining fifteen together with the deposit were refunded to Xu Shiyan.
"Oh, ma'am, just give me the deposit, I don't want the rent.
Look, I've lived here for more than two months, and I've troubled you guys a lot. I can't even ask for the rent. "
That is to say, people in this year really can refund the money if they can't live.
If you put it aside later, who cares if you don’t arrive at the date, the rent will not be refunded after the rent is paid.
Xu Shiyan refused to ask for the fifteen yuan, so he had to give it to Aunt Zhang again.
"Auntie, it's like this. When winter comes next year, my sister and I have to come.
When the time comes, I will go directly to the two of you, how about it? "
These old couple are nice, and Xu Shiyan gets along well with them, so we can decide on the residence for next year in advance.
"That won't work, next year is next year, this year must be refunded to you.
It’s not easy, you took your sister out for treatment and spent a lot of money, my aunt can’t cheat you. "
How to bargain at the beginning was one thing, but now that the rent is left, it is another matter. Mrs. Zhang can't be greedy for such a cheap price.
The two gave way for a long time, but in the end Uncle Zhang couldn't see it and opened his mouth.
"That's it, we will accept the money, let your aunt cook a few dishes tonight, and keep you for a meal.
Even if I give it to the three of you to practice, it can be regarded as a celebration of the little girl’s healthy discharge from the hospital. You have to give this face to the uncle. "
As long as the money is accepted, Xu Shiyan really didn't want to waste time back and forth with Aunt Zhang, so he readily agreed.
Just like that, Xu Shiqin went back to the house to rest, and Xu Shiyan and Han Liwei went to the station to buy tickets.
Before being discharged from the hospital, Chi Hao issued a certificate to Xu Shiyan, and wrote another note, asking Xu Shiyan to go to the station to find someone to buy a few sleeper tickets.
The distance from Changchun to Hunjiang is quite long. In Xu Shiqin's condition, he cannot sit all the time and needs to lie down to rest.
Not to mention, because of Chi Hao's relationship, the person in charge at the station over there was very polite and arranged for it.
Xu Shiyan successfully bought three sleeper tickets for the afternoon of the 19th.
Buying the tickets, Xu Shiyan felt relieved. In the afternoon, he and Han Liwei went shopping again and bought a lot of things.
In the evening, Mrs. Zhang really cooked a table of good dishes, and everyone got together for a meal.
The next morning, Xu Shiyan went to Elder Chu to bid farewell. Elder Chu was also very happy to learn that Xu Shiqin was discharged from the hospital early, and told Xu Shiyan to be careful on the return trip.
At the same time, Elder Chu also drew a lot of books for Xu Shiyan, and asked Xu Shiyan to take them back and read them whenever he had time.
Moving a box of books back made both Xu Shiyan and Han Liwei feel worried.
Originally, they had a lot of things to bring back, plus these books, how could they take them back?
Xu Shiqin still had an idea, and said that it is better to mail back the things that are not needed. Although it costs a little more money, it will save worry on the road.
Xu Shiyan thought about it, so he hurriedly packed up with Han Liwei.
Take the box of books and some unused luggage to the post office and send them back.
Han Liwei just remembered, and stopped by Donggang No. 1 venue to make a phone call, please tell the Han family, they will go back by car in the afternoon.
In this way, the three of them traveled lightly and only carried two large backpacks, which was much easier.
Old Chu had been there, and when Qi Yunsheng was discharged from the hospital, he happened to say something, and he didn't have much thought about the provincial capital.
At noon on the 19th, the three said goodbye to Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang, and went out to the train station by car.
At around three o'clock in the afternoon, the train started, and the three of Xu Shiyan set off on their way home.
There weren't many people on the sleeper side, and Han Liwei's uniform could scare off a lot of unruly people, so the return journey was very peaceful, and no accidents happened.
Arriving at Hunjiang at four o'clock in the morning, the three of them didn't find a place to cross the station, so they rested at the station for a while.
I went out to have breakfast after six o'clock, and went back by car at half past seven.
In mid-to-late January, when the railway capacity is tight, there are quite a lot of people on the train.
The five-hour journey is not worth buying a sleeper, so Xu Shiqin can only sit.
Fortunately, the three of them found a long seat. At the back, Xu Shiyan and Han Liwei simply stood up and let Xu Shiqin lie down for a while to rest.
Someone next to him was unhappy when he saw it, so Xu Shiyan slapped the hospital certificate in front of that person.
Besides, they didn't occupy other people's seats, and others didn't care.
In this way, I persisted until I reached Songjiang River.
As soon as I got off the bus, I felt the temperature in the Changbai Mountain area, which was several degrees lower than that of the provincial capital.
Fortunately, the three of them covered themselves tightly, so they hurried out with their bags on their backs.
As soon as they got out of the station, they heard someone calling them. After a closer look, they were actually Han Limin and Han Lixin.
Needless to say, this must be because I knew they were coming back and came here to pick them up.
"Hurry up, hurry up, get in the car, don't freeze your siblings in this cold weather."
When Han Limin saw the three of Han Liwei, he quickly greeted them and walked to the side. A jeep was parked at the other end.
"I borrowed this from Secretary Lin. It's been too cold at home these days. If you take a donkey jeep home, your family will be frozen into popsicles before your family members arrive." Han Limin pointed at the jeep and laughed.
"Shiyan, it's because of your face that Secretary Lin is willing to borrow it.
Secretary Lin said, when you come back to find a time, I want to treat you to dinner. "
Xu Shiyan understood as soon as he heard it, and he really missed it when he co-authored and participated in the show.
"Brother Li Min has to worry, let's go, let's go back first."
There are serious jeeps to sit in, who still rides in donkey jeeps? So the three of them hurried into the car.
"This car is better, it's really comfortable." Xu Shiyan smiled.
"That's right, this car can only be used by a few leaders at ordinary times, sit firmly, and we will get home as soon as we get fuel."
Han Lixin laughed and started the car.
Han Lixin's driving skills are nothing to say, the jeep is speeding all the way, pedestrians and houses outside the window flash past.
Twenty minutes later, the jeep stopped outside the gate of Xu's house in front of the martyr's tomb.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: surprise
chapters.content:
Chapter 244 Surprise
Everyone in the room at the Xu family's side is waiting for Xu Shiyan and the others to come back.
It was last night, and the Han family was notified by the other side of the venue.
