Han Limin came over early this morning to inform the Xu family, and Xu Chenghou asked for help, wanting to call the elder son and the others.
As a result, Xu Shixian and the others were too busy to come back from work, but the neighbors all knew about it.
Xu Shian's family, Zhou Qingguo, Yang Chunming, Zhao Jianshe, Feng Chao, Huang Shengli, these people are all there.
Yu Shouguang, Zhao Dahai, Zhou Changhe, Han Wenzhong and his wife also came and waited.
Everyone wanted to see what Xu Shiqin looked like after the operation, and even wanted to chat with Xu Shiyan.
So, when the car stopped at the gate, the dogs in the yard barked, and the people in the house guessed that Xu Shiyan and the others had come back, and came out to greet them in a hurry.
"Third Brother and Sixth Sister, it's true that you are back.
Oops, my sixth younger sister is a lot taller now. Hey, she looks really handsome in this long woolen coat. "
Zhao Jianshe ran faster than anyone else, and was the first to rush out.
When he saw Xu Shiqin, who was wearing a long dark red plaid coat, with a tall and slim figure, Zhao Jianshe couldn't help but praise him.
Xu Shiqin laughed when he heard this, "Brother Jianshe, you are too exaggerated.
The person is still the same person, and the face is still the same face, how can he be handsome? "
As long as it is a woman, there is no one who does not like others to praise her for her beauty, and Xu Shiqin is no exception. She is beautiful in her heart, but she has to be modest in her mouth.
"Can it be the same? Sixth Sister is tall and slender now, and looks good in her clothes.
You don’t need to look at the face, just look at the back, you can tell that he must be handsome. "
It is indeed different, the posture is tall and straight, and the person is confident, and the temperament has improved all of a sudden.
Even with that face, it looks absolutely different.
"Why don't you say it, or Liwei's eyes are thieves, and he has fallen in love with the sixth younger sister a long time ago.
Would you like to try now? It's not certain if you get your turn or not. "
Zhao Jianshe was outspoken, and did not treat Han Liwei as an outsider, so he deliberately teased.
"That's right, if you meet a good girl, don't rush after her, or it will be too late if someone snatches her away."
Han Liwei didn't take it seriously, he laughed and walked into the yard while protecting Xu Shiqin.
In the yard are the dogs that watch the scene on the mountain. Xu Chenghou went down the mountain on New Year's Day, and the dogs were brought back.
Gouzi recognized Xu Shiyan, he heard Xu Shiyan's movement just now, and was choking.
Now when they saw Xu Shiyan enter the door, the four dogs wanted to break the rope and jump on Xu Shiyan, their tails even swayed to the sky.
Xu Shiyan has nothing to do, so he can only go to appease Gouzi first.
Every dog ​​touched its head, scratched its chin, and hugged again.
While Xu Shiyan was soothing the dog, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin were surrounded by everyone and entered the room.
There were a lot of people sitting in the east room of Xu's family. Xu Chenghou, Yu Shouguang, Zhao Dahai, Zhou Changhe, Han Wenzhong and other older people were all sitting on the kang, stretching their necks and looking out.
"Father, Mom, I'm back." Xu Shiqin hurried to the front of the kang, and hugged his mother who was about to put on her shoes and go to the ground.
"Just come back, just come back, come on, let mom see, what has my daughter become?"
Zhou Guilan couldn't hold back, and her eye cracked again.
The shoes were not put on, so she just pulled them on like this, raised her hand to touch the girl's cheek, and then looked up and down, back and forth.
"It's really healed, old man, look quickly, our daughter is really healed, look, my daughter is actually taller than me."
Zhou Guilan still had tears in the corners of her eyes, but the corners of her mouth couldn't help but rise, she was really happy from the bottom of her heart.
His daughter has finally returned to normal, and is no longer the hunchback that others say.
Look at this tall and straight figure, how beautiful it is. It turns out that the girl is taller than her when she straightens her waist.
So good, so good.
Xu Chenghou was also happy, but he was a big man, and he didn't cry like Zhou Guilan.
Besides, he had been to the provincial capital before and saw his daughter's appearance after the first operation, so he wouldn't be as surprised as Zhou Guilan.
"Sixth, why don't you come and meet your in-laws?"
Xu Chenghou smiled and reminded his daughter that Han Liwei's parents were also here, so he couldn't lose his courtesy.
Reminded by Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan also remembered, quickly wiped her face, and pushed her daughter towards Han Wenzhong and his wife.
Xu Shiqin stepped forward, smiled and called, "Dad, Mom."
Han Wenzhong's daughter-in-law, Li Yuexiu, was surprised and happy when she saw her daughter-in-law's radical change after the operation.
Back when his son insisted that he liked this old girl from the Xu family, Li Yuexiu was actually a little unhappy.
With a good guy like her son, what kind of daughter-in-law can't be found, so why just find a hunchback?
But Han Liwei recognized Xu Shiqin, and the old couple of the Han family couldn't argue with each other, so they had to admit it, and felt a little uncomfortable.
Now that the two have received their marriage certificate, and the daughter-in-law has successfully returned to normal after another operation, Li Yuexiu is also full of joy when she looks at the dignified and beautiful daughter-in-law in front of her.
"Hey, hey." Li Yuexiu quickly agreed.
"Are you tired from the car ride all the way? Quick, come and sit."
Li Yuexiu reached out and grabbed Xu Shiqin's hand, and asked Xu Shiqin to sit next to her.
"It's okay, not too tired." Seeing her mother-in-law, Xu Shiqin was a little at a loss, so she had to sit down next to Li Yuexiu.
At the other end, Han Liwei took off his coat, hung it on the wall, and asked Xu Shiqin to take off his coat to help hang it up, and then sat down next to Li Yuexiu.
"I just called my second brother to report the news, but I didn't expect everyone to come."
Han Liwei was almost taken aback when he entered the room just now, good guy, there are so many people.
"Your third brother and Shiqin have been out for more than two months, who doesn't want to see what Shiqin has become now?
Your elder brother and the others are also in a hurry, saying that they arranged work today and asked for leave, and they will come back tomorrow for a gathering. "
Zhou Guilan smiled, but the Xu family didn't dare to say anything else, because there were so many people.
The five sons all marry wives and have children. If all five families come back, it will be lively.
"By the way, Liwei, how long is your vacation? Can you stay at home for a few more days? These relatives at home haven't seen you yet."
Zhou Guilan suddenly remembered that the eldest and fourth child had never met Han Liwei.
"Mom, I might have to leave tomorrow." Han Liwei only had two months of leave, and it was due soon.
If Xu Shiqin wasn't worried about his health, he should have returned to Shenyang directly from Changchun by car.
If there is a delay in sending Xu Shiqin home like this, he will have to leave for the team tomorrow morning, and it won't work if he goes back late.
When Zhou Guilan and Li Yuexiu heard this, they both sighed. It's a pity that they came back so rarely, but they couldn't have a family reunion.
"It's okay, we will meet again when we have a chance.
Liwei is wearing this uniform. He is a member of the public family. It is his mission to protect the family and the country. We can't help, just don't hold back. "
Xu Chenghou also sighed, wanting to pick up the pipe and take a puff, seeing so many people in the room.
My daughter has just returned from surgery, so she may not be able to smell the smoke.
Forget it, bear with it.
"Yes, my in-laws are right, since the child has been sent to the army, it is not just our child.
He has his mission and responsibility, and we can only fully support him. "Han Wenzhong and Xu Chenghou had opposite tempers, and they hit it off right away.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: celebrate
chapters.content:
Chapter 245 Congratulations
Waiting for Xu Shiyan to coax the dogs outside, and when he entered the room again, everyone in the room was already chatting very enthusiastically.
In the east room, there is a table on the kang and a table on the floor, all of which are filled with hot meals, Su Anying and Wei Mingrong are still on top.
The brothers and sisters of the Xu family have been away for so long, and Xu Shiqin has also cured his illness and came back. It must be something delicious to cleanse them up.
After hearing the news in the morning, Su Anying hurriedly went shopping and started to work.
At noon, the family gathered more and more, Su Anying saw that even Xu Shiqin's parents-in-law had come, fearing that the dishes were not hard enough, she added several more dishes.
As soon as Xu Shiqin and the others entered the door, Su Anying and Wei Mingrong began to put the table up. When Xu Shiyan came in, the dishes were almost ready.
Seeing Xu Shiyan enter the house, Yu Shouguang hurriedly called him to his side. "Xiao Xu, come here, uncle will chat with you for a while."
Xu Shiyan saw that the table on the ground was already full.
Well, don't pay attention to those rules, sit on the edge of the kang.
So he took off his coat and hat, and sat down next to Yu Shouguang.
"Uncle, what is the income of our brigade this fall?" Xu Shiyan is most concerned about this issue.
When Xu Chenghou went to the provincial capital, the team only distributed the food, not the money, so Xu Chenghou didn't know how much he could distribute.
It is said that this year's production is so high, everyone can share a lot of money.
"I just want to tell you about this." Yu Shouguang laughed as soon as he heard it.
"This year, the grain production in our team has somewhat decreased.
But the stick has a bumper harvest, with a 50% increase in production and a 70% increase in income.
Deducting the amount of tasks that should be handed in, the money distributed to each household is much more than last year. "
Mentioning this year's income, Yu Shouguang couldn't close his mouth with joy.
In previous years, those who were able to share 200 yuan could get more than 300 yuan this year. For example, Xu Chenghou, who got more than 400 yuan last year, almost got 700 yuan this year.
"I remember that your family should have distributed nearly 800 yuan this year.
Here is the wages and work points converted by the participants and other brigades, and the money that your sister-in-law worked in the processing factory. There are details. You can go to the team to find it another day. "
Xu Shiyan went to give technical guidance to the other team and one of the participants, and the work points for that end were not as high as those of the second team, so Xu Shiyan's points were only a little more than Xu Cheng's.
If it is calculated according to the work points of the second brigade, Xu Shiyan can get more than 900 yuan this year.
"In addition to these, our team unanimously agreed to give you a reward of 500 yuan.
Well, the money is all given to your wife.
In addition, our team was rated as an advanced group again this year, and you are also an advanced individual. In March next year, we will go to a meeting in the county to receive the award. "
The production of ginseng in the second brigade is so high this year, it must be set as a model, and the advanced collective has not run away.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't told him in advance, and he wasn't at home, I don't know how many places would have come to visit and study.
As soon as the superior called to ask, Yu Shouguang reasoned that Xu Shiyan was not at home.
Besides, it’s winter, and there’s nothing to visit and study. I’ll make a summary report when the conference is held next year.
"Uncle Yu, you are only talking about good things and not bad things.
Why don't you say that our county holds a commendation meeting for fighting against floods, and my third brother has nothing to do with it.
My third brother was advocating early evacuation as a precaution. Our commune sent out so much water that no one was injured, and not a single chicken was lost.
But what about other places? The loss was so great, but in the end, they were judged as heroes, models, and pacesetters. My third brother didn't get anything, so why? "
Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others at the table on the ground felt that something was wrong, and they felt wronged for Xu Shiyan.
Yu Shouguang rolled his eyes at the young people at the table, "Just Xiao Xu didn't get anything?
Our brigade, our commune, didn’t we get anything? What's the use of saying that?
Secretary Chen of our commune got into a fight with the leader during the county meeting because of this matter. What can he do? Shouldn't it be ours or not? "
Bringing this matter up, Yu Shouguang was also very disturbed.
Here led people to evacuate ahead of time, and arranged people to patrol to ensure that there were no casualties and no loss of property. What happened? Bai worked hard and didn't get anything.
In other places, they don’t take any precautions, and wait until they are flooded before thinking about saving people and emergency.
The results of it? He is considered a hero, so where is the reasoning for this thing?
Xu Shiyan understood what was going on when he heard it.
"Uncle, don't worry about it, we don't care about that, as long as our commune doesn't suffer much loss.
The other heroes, models and pacesetters are all false names. We only want the affordable ones, and don't care about those vain ones. "
"Let's do what we should do in a down-to-earth manner, as long as we are worthy of the members and conscience, right?"
Xu Shiyan didn't feel uncomfortable or lost. He had seen this kind of thing a lot in his previous life, so it's not unusual.
Besides, he didn't warn in advance because of rewards, but mainly for the sake of the folks in the village.
After moving to Donggang these years, everyone gets along very well.
Xu Shiyan couldn't just watch the villagers suffer losses, so he risked being questioned to warn the police.
It's best not to mention this matter, lest he can't explain clearly.
At that time, people will treat him as a magic stick, but it will be bad.
Some limelight can be shown, and some limelight can be avoided if possible. Xu Shiyan thinks that the current situation is very good.
"Let's not talk about those bad things, come on, it's rare that everyone is here today, let's all pour the wine and have a drink together.
It is to celebrate the recovery of our sixth sister, and also to celebrate that my sixth sister has found a good man.
This is my brother-in-law, Han Liwei. The two of them have received their certificates in the provincial capital.
Waiting for Liwei to visit relatives next time, he will hold a wedding for them. "
Xu Shiyan didn't want to talk about that, so he changed the subject.
At this time, Su Anying came in with a few bottles of wine, Xu Shiyan quickly opened the wine, and poured all the wine for the elders at the table on the kang.
"Yes, yes, it makes sense, it's all in the past, so don't mention it.
Come on, let's make one together, welcome Shi Yan and Shi Qin, and wish Shi Qin and Li Wei a happy marriage for a hundred years. "Everyone echoed in unison.
A group of big men in the east room, drinking and chatting, punching and so on when they are in the mood.
Westinghouse, Zhou Guilan, Li Yuexiu led Xu Shiqin, Su Anying, Wei Mingrong, and a few other children to eat happily.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping's two children are no one to care about, and they can eat well by themselves.
On the other hand, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing, who are almost eight months old, have already started eating.
Now seeing so many delicious food on the table, exuding a tempting aroma, the two babies salivated and called out ahh.
Su Anying and Zhou Guilan took a look, so they had to hold the two children in their arms, and spooned some chicken cakes to feed them.
As a result, the two babies were eating something wrong, so they reached out to grab the adults on the table.
Not to mention, Xu Haiqing's little hands are really good. Taking advantage of Zhou Guilan's inattention, he really grabbed a rib, and Xiaowa was so happy that he quickly took a bite.
"Hey, look at what you can do, and you're still eating ribs. This vegetable soup is all over your body, and your hands are full of oil."
Zhou Guilan is no longer obsessed with cleanliness, so don't think about being clean when coaxing children.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: to divide the land
chapters.content:
Chapter 246 is about to divide the land
Xu Shiyan has been away for more than two months, and many things have indeed happened at home.
The most important thing is that the superiors have clearly issued a document. In the spring of 1983, the local household contract responsibility system began to be implemented.
The land that originally belonged to the commune and the brigade was distributed to each household according to the population.
In the future, farmers can decide what to plant and how much to plant. As long as the task is paid enough, the rest will not interfere.
"The commune and the team are discussing this matter.
Our team’s opinion is that Datiandi will draw lots to determine the plots of land according to the population and land level, and each team will be assigned to each household. "
They are all big fields, but some are fertile and some are barren. To make the division of fields fair and just, all of them must be considered.
"As for the mallets, next year there will be no distinction between those who make goods and those who freeze them. Then we will still work in teams. In autumn, we will get paid for making goods.
Ginseng seeds, ginseng seeds, and new plants are also distributed according to the population of each household.
The new ginseng land for next year is still at the Guhua land on the other side of the Nantianmen.
The area is not big, and each person is divided into two feet, and they are divided together for three years. "
These were all determined by the team in a meeting, and it was originally planned to call a meeting of members in the near future to make an announcement.
Most people in the team have heard about it, and Yu Shouguang told Xu Shiyan specially.
Guanghuadi is a word that has only come out in the past two years.
In 1980, through several consultations, relevant departments in the county allocated about 20,000 hectares of secondary forests and primary forests from five provincial forestry bureaus as land for participation in several communes.
These lands are collectively called the linked land.
The new land of the Second Brigade this autumn is the Guhua land, in a place called Nantianmen, which should actually be under the jurisdiction of the Xinglong Commune.
"Xiao Xu, there is something that your father said is waiting for you to come back to discuss.
It’s the ginseng site in our team, who is contracted to watch the ginseng, do you two still plan to continue to watch the ginseng?
If you continue to watch the competition, you will have to sign a contract with the team after the next year and pay a part of the deposit. "
This is what Yu Shouguang really wants to say.
After the land is distributed to the households, everyone does their own work, and no one earns work points, but the sticks on the mountain must be watched by someone, so someone has to contract them.
Determine how much it will be ten zhang. If you make goods and freeze next year, you can wait for the winter to divide the money.
But for new planting and next year’s new ginseng land, each household has to pay for the ginseng fee.
Nowadays, looking at ginseng is a sought-after job, and many people are staring at it.
The ginseng of the Second Brigade is now divided into two places, Xiaoheihe and Nantianmen.
These days, several people have already gone to discuss with Yu Shouguang, and they want to contract the reference.
Yu Shouguang kept his promise. On Xiaoheihe's side, Xu Shiyan's opinion still prevails. If Xu Shiyan wants to contract, he won't give it to others.
"Uncle Yu, I just came back, let me discuss this matter with my father, can I give you an answer in two days?"
Xu Shiyan glanced at Xu Chenghou, and seeing his father's eagerness to try, he knew that his father wanted to contract.
Xu Shiyan didn’t want to contract to see ginseng anymore. He didn’t have a good job before, and he made a lot of money from ginseng, so he agreed to go up the mountain to see ginseng.
Now the farm is gradually developing, and the family has divided the field and the ginseng land, and both have to be busy.
Plus Xu Shiyan still wants to make a fortune from Clivia, how can he have time to go to the mountains to see ginseng?
This matter, you have to discuss it with Xu Chenghou, break the pros and cons of the matter and tell the stubborn old man.
If Xu Shiyan directly said that he would not contract in front of so many people, he was afraid that Xu Chenghou would not be willing to directly fry the pot.
Although Xu Chenghou's temper has improved a lot in the past two years, no one can guarantee whether the old man will get angry in front of so many people.
The relatives and friends in this room today, especially the new uncle Han Liwei, can't provoke Xu Chenghou, let's wait until the outsiders leave.
"Okay, any time is fine, you two discuss it slowly, after all, it is not a trivial matter.
If you contract, the deposit is quite a lot, so you must be careful. "
Yu Shouguang nodded, this is a big deal, Xu Shiyan must think about it.
The east room was chatting and drinking while chatting, and they didn't finish drinking until after two o'clock.
Yu Shouguang and Zhao Dahai are older, they can't drink enough, and they can drink some wine, but the younger ones are fine.
Xu Shiyan winked at Zhou Qingguo and Zhao Jianshe, and called them to discuss in a low voice.
"Send them back to rest first, go to my place at night, we still have important matters to discuss."
Just like that, everyone dispersed, and Han Wenzhong and his son also left.
Han Liwei is leaving tomorrow, and he is very reluctant to part with Xu Shiqin, but he also knows that Xu Shiqin is very tired this day and needs to rest early.
So the two of them were sticky for a while, and then reluctantly left.
Xu Shiyan went out to see off the guests, saw that everyone had left, and then went back to the house.
Xu Shiqin was really tired this day, so he simply went back to the Westinghouse to rest.
Xu Shiyan, holding his youngest son in his arms, sat on the kang in the east room, chatting with his parents.
Talk about some things about going to the provincial capital this time, and tell your parents about the accounts.
"Father, Mom, this time I went back to the provincial capital to treat my younger sister. The surgery, hospitalization, and medical expenses cost a total of more than 2,900."
I was discharged from the hospital early, and the hospitalization and medical expenses were a little less than expected, but most of them were material costs and surgery costs, which could not be saved.
"It's the money, because the younger sister's master didn't mention whether it can be reimbursed because she asked for leave at the time, and we didn't feel embarrassed to ask.
So I left at my own expense. If it was public expense, we wouldn’t spend much after the reimbursement.
My younger sister is not a full-time migrant worker. She belongs to a large group. I think it is too much to report.
Anyway, let's not count on it, it all depends on what her master says. "
Xu Shiqin's problem was that he couldn't rely on work-related injuries before he recruited workers.
If it is a work-related injury, the unit will reimburse 100% of the compensation, and the family does not need to pay a penny.
It is not considered a work-related injury, but a medical treatment, but this problem, in the eyes of others, should be treated only if you have money to burn.
After all, Xu Shiqin's hunchback is neither painful nor itchy, and it doesn't delay work, it's just a little ugly.
Most people don’t pay attention to whether it looks good or not, and many people still can’t eat enough. Who cares whether it looks good or not?
Xu Shiyan was not sure whether the medical unit could reimburse him, so when he was in the hospital, he paid for it by himself.
Even if the unit gives a limited report, he has to spend a lot more than his own expenses first, which is really not worthwhile.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan didn't understand this either, so they could only listen.
Wei Mingrong somewhat understood, "Little sister, you should be able to get medical subsidies.
Waiting for her to ask her master, anyway, the unit can give some subsidies, not much.
Large collectives are not good like this, they cannot keep up with all migrant workers. "
Wei Mingrong also belongs to the big group.
At that time, she was in a hurry to return to the city, and she didn’t meet the conditions for all migrant workers. There happened to be a group of large collective quotas, and she and Xue Xiulin both went back to the city with the large collective quota.
At that time, I felt that it didn’t matter whether it was a collective or the whole people, as long as I could go back to the city.
After I came back, I found out that the welfare benefits for the whole people and the large collective are quite different.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: discuss
chapters.content:
Chapter 247 Consultation
"Well, anyway, after our operation is done, it would be better if the unit can provide subsidies. If we don't, we don't expect it."
Xu Shiyan nodded. He didn't count on the unit in the first place. It is estimated that even if there is a subsidy, there is not much money.
"Next year, in winter, I have to go to the provincial capital, and the doctor said that I will take out those screws and nail rods by then.
After raising her for another year or so, the little girl will be like a normal person. "
"Need another surgery? Oh my god, that's going to be a pain.
I have heard the old girl say that it hurts after the operation. "
When Zhou Guilan heard that she had to undergo surgery again, she felt sorry for her daughter.
"This is half of the treatment, why should we continue to treat it.
Look, my daughter has changed a lot after the operation, how nice it is. "Xu Chenghou saw it and quickly persuaded him.
Men should be more rational, although they feel distressed, but they always look at things in the long run.
"Third brother, you only talked about the money spent in the hospital, isn't that also the cost of your food and accommodation there?
How much are those? Count them all and give me the total. "Xu Chenghou persuaded his old wife a few words, then asked Xu Shiyan again.
"I heard from your mother that when you left, she brought a thousand dollars to the sixth child, and the sixth child saved a thousand dollars himself.
This is definitely not enough to spend, the rest, I will let you borrow it, and I will return it to you slowly.
You cannot pay this money.
You are an elder brother. It is not easy enough to accompany you out for such a long time and delay your own earning.
We are parents, and it is only natural to treat our daughter. Why did we fail to take good care of her back then? "
To put it bluntly, Xu Chenghou was really muddled when he was messed up, no one can compare to him.
But if he is reasonable, he is also a pretty good person.
In the past few years, Xu Chenghou has also seen the dedication of the third son to the family.
The third son has not been easy this year. He is busy with work outside the house, and he is desperately trying to drag the family business.
After finally saving some money, how can it be said that one person will cause harm?
The third son can no longer afford the money for the daughter's medical treatment.
Xu Shiyan was really surprised when he heard what his father said.
He just wanted to say that he had already discussed this matter with Xu Shiqin, but before he spoke, he felt wrong. Looking down, okay, the younger son is peeing on him again.
Yes, there is no way to continue chatting, let's clean up first, because I was wearing a thick coat, I peed a little wet.
"Daughter-in-law, my son is peeing on me again, so hurry up and change his pantyhose."
Xu Shiyan, dumbfounded, handed his youngest son to Su Anying, and asked Su Anying to change the child's pants and pants.
Xu Shiyan doesn't matter, it's not much wet, take off the outer pants and throw them on the fire wall to dry for a while, and then wash them at night when you go home.
Su Anying hugged her son, and pretended to pat her younger son's buttocks.
"Little bastard, you usually know how to urinate when you want to pee, what's the matter today?
Your father has been away for such a long time, and you peed on him as soon as he came back? "
While speaking, she carried her son to the Westinghouse, where Xiaowa's pants and clothes were all there.
While Su Anying and Xu Shiyan were talking, Wei Mingrong tugged at Xu Shian and winked at Xu Shian.
"Father, mother, third child, it's getting late, let's go home first.
I came out early today, the kang didn’t turn on the fire at noon, and the stove must have been turned off, and the room was cold when I went back late, no way. "
We have been married for more than ten years, and Xu Shian understands what the daughter-in-law looks at. He stood up quickly and said he was going home.
Xu Chenghou glanced at his second son and daughter-in-law, and drooped his eyelids.
"Okay, it's getting late, it's time to go back. It's cold at this time, don't freeze my grandson."
Hmph, these two are so narrow-minded, do you really think he can't see it?
This is when I heard that the cost was so high, I was afraid that they would also pay for it, so I ran away in fright.
The second child is a coward, the daughter-in-law can control her to death, and she gets angry when she sees it.
Xu Shi'an also noticed that the father's expression was not right, but what could he say?
"Well, father and mother, you should rest earlier.
Third child, you are quite tired just after you come back, so go home early to rest and spend time with the children, Yuanyuan and Pingping miss you. "
Xu Shian was a little embarrassed, hurriedly put on his overcoat, then dressed his sons, and led the two sons and his wife away.
When the second child's family left, Xu Cheng generously knocked on the pipe and pot.
"I look at the virtue of the boss and the second every day, and I get angry.
Dignified man, why did he let his wife manage him like this? "
If he hadn't been concerned about the little granddaughter in Zhou Guilan's arms, Xu Chenghou would definitely have filled a bag of cigarettes and smoked twice, which would have **** him off.
"Father, don't argue with the second brother, it's not easy for the second brother.
I don’t have a job, so I just plant some vegetable gardens, and I can earn some money on the farm this year. "
A man earns less money and his waist is not strong, so he has to be controlled by his wife?
However, it was also Wei Mingrong who went too far, the one just now was too obvious.
Anyway, stay outside, save some face for your man, how can there be such a thing?
"Speaking of which, I shouldn't have used the name of the educated youth to sound good.
If you find a dutiful rural girl, you won't have such a thing. "
Xu Chenghou was still angry, and complained again.
"How good do you think Yingzi is? Hardworking and capable, she can do everything at home and outside, and I don't care about you so much."
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this.
His old man is really right in saying this, but his wife is really right in saying that.
Don't talk about anything else, let's just talk about the medical treatment for the younger sister this time, Xu Shiyan took away five thousand yuan, and Su Anying didn't say a bad word.
Before he left, he said, don’t be careless when you go out, as long as Xu Shiqin’s illness can be cured, you can spend as much money as you want, even if it’s not enough for us to borrow money.
"That's right, Yingzi has a good personality." Xu Shiyan laughed like a fool, his eyes almost disappeared from the smile.
When the old couple saw the virtue of the third son, they couldn't help but join in the fun.
"You, it's a fool's blessing to be a fool. Look at your foolish appearance." Xu Cheng gave his son a thick look, and was no longer angry.
That's all, the daughter-in-law here has been married for more than ten years, so what's the use of talking about it?
The family is separated anyway, don't worry about not being here.
"Father, there is something that I want to discuss with you. Let's see if we don't book the venue next year, okay?"
Xu Shiyan stayed mainly to discuss this matter with the old man.
Xu Shian was here just now, and there was something hard to say. They just left, so Xu Shiyan hurriedly told his father about it. Zhou Qingguo and the others should come to him later.
Seeing what Xu Chenghou wanted to say, Xu Shiyan spoke first.
"Father, listen to me first. The first one, as I said today to the secretary, is that you have to pay a deposit for the contractor.
This deposit must be quite a lot. We have to pay out first, which is boring.
What's more, it's not a few years ago now, and now everywhere is in chaos. Didn't the Xiaohei River ginseng land almost enter this year?
You said that we have divided the fields and ginseng land, isn’t it good to manage our own crops and sticks? Why bother to run up the mountain without family and business? "
In the past few years, the family on the mountain has been tossing back and forth, and Xu Shiyan is enough.
Besides, there are only two years left on the other side of Xiaoheihe, and they can’t earn much money. Whoever wants to go to see the ginseng can go. Xu Shiyan doesn’t want to see the ginseng anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Decide
chapters.content:
Chapter 248 decision
"Second, there is a big stall at the farm on my side.
The farm is now being looked after by the second brother with the help of Feng Chao and Shengli.
Second brother planted a mallet on the other end, and his house still has such a big garden, so he has to go back to work.
Father, let’s not go to see the ginseng, how about you take care of the farm for me? "
It is impossible for Xu Shiyan to stop looking at the ginseng, but let Xu Chenghou stay on the mountain instead? The old man is not young anymore, that's not okay.
"There is one more, I think Qingguo may have told my mother, that is Clivia.
You don't know, this thing is very popular in the provincial capital now.
A pot costs a few hundred yuan. I heard people say that this Clivia may be selected as a city flower. If that is the case, the price may rise to something. "
The last one is the key point.
Xu Shiyan wanted to develop Clivia, but he couldn't hide it from his family, so he simply talked about it with his parents, so as to prevent them from looking at those Clivia.
"Our family has this condition. Do you see how many pots my little sister has accumulated in the past few years? The windowsill is full of flowers she made.
It seems that you have saved a lot of seeds, right? If it is planted, it will be all money.
What I mean is, we can't miss such a profitable business.
Let’s search for more flower seedlings and flower seeds to grow. When the next spring comes, I will find a way to rent a store in the provincial capital, and we will transport the flowers there and sell them.
Otherwise, you can go to the provincial capital to find a merchant and come to us to buy the flowers.
Don’t say too much for a pot, just a few hundred yuan is enough. How much is that? "
Xu Shiyan has also made up his mind about this matter. Right now, he can use the three vacant old houses on the east side of his house to grow flowers.
Clivia likes shade and can be cultivated without too much sunlight.
Fire a good fire at the other end of the old house, use it as a greenhouse, put up more flower shelves, and you can grow a lot of potted flowers.
When spring comes next year, Xu Shiyan will be at the other end of the farm, and the entire flower shed will be placed there, so as not to be too conspicuous at home.
Just in time, Xu Chenghou stopped looking at the reference, and he can go to take care of the flower shed, mainly to watch the blind Liuzi work.
This, at present, is safer than Kansan. After all, it is far away from the provincial capital, and no matter how chaotic it is, it cannot be messed up here.
Besides, there are dogs and guns at the farm, and there are so many people. If it’s really not possible, you can still find helpers from the village. What are you afraid of?
"San'er, you said, is this Clivia really worth that much money?
Why does it sound like a dream to me? Does it feel like a dream? How much do you think our mallet is worth?
The wild ginseng you dug in the mountains has grown for decades, and the things that can save lives only sell for 1,800 yuan.
Can Clivia be eaten or drunk? Why is it so valuable? "Zhou Guilan hugged her little granddaughter and said with a puzzled look on her face.
In Zhou Guilan's opinion, it's just a potted flower. It looks good, but it's not food or food. Is this stuff worth money?
If you want her to say, it’s really useless to plant some crops for food and fill your stomach.
"Mom, the people in the city are different from us. They are all workers and cadres, and they earn wages and have money.
People don’t have to worry about eating and drinking, so they think differently from our old farmers. They call it spiritual pursuit.
I am happy when I look at the flowers, and my heart is hard to buy with money. "
In fact, Xu Shiyan admires people like Mom and Dad, their thoughts are always so simple and true.
It is also true that the material base determines the superstructure, and the older generation came from suffering and starvation, so they simply cannot understand those exaggerated so-called spiritual pursuits.
"We don't care about that, we just take advantage of the opportunity to earn some money, anyway, in my opinion, there is no money to be rare.
With money in hand, corn and beans are as beautiful as flowers to me. "
Apart from making money, Xu Shiyan has no other pursuits. He can't appreciate Clivia or peony, it's just so stupid.
"Father, what do you think? Help me look at the farm after the next year?
I will also give you money like the second brother did, okay? "
Xu Shiyan looked at the old man's face, he was okay, he didn't look down, so it should make sense.
It's not that I'm afraid of my father, it's mainly because I've gotten used to being kind and friendly in the past few years, and I really don't bother arguing with him.
Besides, there are still children, and arguing with the father in front of the children will not have a good effect.
"Okay, you can do whatever you say. I'm old and I'll listen to you."
Xu Chenghou pondered for a while, then nodded in agreement.
"You don't need to pay money, so why do you have to ask for money when you are helping your son? You haven't given money to your family these years?
When the field is busy in spring and autumn, I tend the field, and when I am not busy, I will go to the farm to help you look after it. "
Xu Chenghou unexpectedly readily agreed.
Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief when he heard that, he was really worried that the stubborn old man couldn't make the turn and had to go up the mountain.
It’s so good, they understand the whole situation of their own family, and make money by watching references.
"Oops, I forgot to take out the things to share with everyone." Xu Shiyan happened to see the backpack in the corner, and quickly took it over.
"Before we came back, Liwei and I went shopping in a department store.
Let’s not talk about it, the things in the provincial capital are better than ours. Liwei and I both dragged some things for our family, but forgot to take them out just now. "
Xu Shiyan said while taking things out of his pocket.
"Yuanyuan, this is your pencil case, as well as a box of pencils and erasers. Study hard in the future."
Xu Shiyan took out a blue iron pencil case. The pencil case of this year is very simple, and the inside is empty.
Waiting for a few more years, the kind of plastic pencil case with magnets will come out.
There are also layers inside, and there are special places for pencil erasers, and some even have pencil sharpeners.
In fact, Xu Shiyan wanted to buy that kind when he was shopping, but he couldn't find it in several places.
Xu Haiyuan was playing with his eldest sister on the top of the kang, when he heard that there was a gift from him, he hurried over.
"Wow, what a beautiful pencil case, thank you Dad."
Children of this age study, very few have a pencil case, not even stationery.
Some children just use a pencil and an eraser, and use a knife to carve a circle on the back end of the pencil, and then tie it with a string.
The eraser has a hole drilled in it, and a rope is also worn, and then the pencil and eraser are hung around the neck, saving you from losing it.
There are also people who put the kind of cardboard box, such as the kind used by hospitals or clinics to hold injections, and put a pencil and eraser on it, which is also very beautiful to use.
When Xu Haiyuan was in Yuhong Class, it was a small schoolbag made by Xu Shiqin. The schoolbag has a sandwich, and the pencil and eraser are placed in the sandwich.
Xu Haiyuan has never seen such an exquisite pencil case, and he likes it very much.
The pencil is also pretty, with colorful paint on the outside and a small eraser on the back.
As for the eraser, there is nothing unusual, just an ordinary white eraser.
The scented eraser in the shape of various fruits or animals has not yet appeared.
"As long as you study hard, Dad will buy you better-looking pencil cases and books in the future." Xu Shiyan patted his son's head and smiled.
"Dad, where's mine? I want a pencil case too."
Over there, Xu Jinping also came over, and the little girl looked at her father expectantly, asking for a gift.
"Girl, you are still young, I will buy you a pencil case after you go to Yuhong Class. Look, what did Dad buy for you?"
Xu Shiyan took out a red plastic hairpin from his pocket, with white polka dots on it and a bow.

chapters.title: Chapter 249: semiconductor
chapters.content:
Chapter 249 Semiconductors
When Xu Shiyan bought this hairpin, many girls were scrambling for it. I heard that it is a style that has just come from the south.
Just one dollar for such a small thing is expensive enough.
But Xu Shiyan felt that his daughter would look good wearing it, so he didn't care how much it cost, so he tried his best to grab a small one for his daughter.
"Wow! So beautiful."
Xu Jinping imitated what her brother said just now, and stared at the hairpin in her father's hand with a pair of big eyes.
"Dad, what is this?"
The little girl liked it very much, but she didn't take it, but sat obediently in front of her father.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand and put the hairpin on top of his daughter's head.
"That's how it's used. When it's summer, you don't have to braid your hair like this anymore. You can just wear a hairpin and a skirt. It looks pretty."
His daughter is handsome and dressed like that, she is definitely the most beautiful little princess.
Well, yes, I'm waiting for Xia Tian to think about buying a pair of small leather shoes for my daughter, so that they look good together.
"Wait a minute, and Dad bought you a lot of presents."
Xu Shiyan continued to take out of his pocket, and took out a rag doll.
The doll’s face should be made of plastic or hard plastic. It has a small round face with a pink face and big eyes that can move. They open their eyes when they are hugged, and close them when they lie down.
There is also a hat with a fly edge sewn on the head, hair made of woolen yarn, and a floral skirt.
"Dad, is this a doll for me?"
The little girl couldn't bear it anymore, and quickly picked up the doll and jumped on the kang.
"Dad, do you know? That Jiang Chunhong, she has a doll.
I want to hug, but she won't let me hug. "
Jiang Chunhong that Xu Jinping mentioned was her new friend.
Since Xu Haiyuan joined the Yuhong class, Xu Jinping stopped running around with her brother, and just played with a group of little girls.
Among them are Su Lijuan and Jiang Chunhong, both children of grain depot workers.
Xu Jinping was the same age as them, and played well.
Jiang Chunhong's father is the director of the grain depot, and her mother also works. The family is rich and lives a good life.
Jiang Chunhong's father went out to bring back a doll for his daughter. Jiang Chunhong liked it very much and always showed off in front of his friends.
Children of this age, how can there be any toys? Not to mention dolls.
Just take a pillow cover or towel, tie a doll and play with it, it will be quite satisfying.
So Jiang Chunhong's doll is envied by many children, and Xu Jinping is no exception.
Sometimes I want to be touched and hugged, but people don’t give me it, and I feel very disappointed.
"Grandpa, grandma, look, I have a beautiful doll.
Bigger than Jiang Chunhong, and more beautiful, you see, her hair is golden yellow, her eyes are blue, so pretty. "
Xu Jinping was so beautiful, she jumped up and down with the doll in her arms, and even ran to show off to Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan.
Seeing the happy appearance of their granddaughter, the old couple laughed too.
"Then you have to take good care of it, don't get it dirty or lose it.
This thing is not cheap, if you lose it, there is nowhere to buy it. " Zhou Guilan told her granddaughter with a smile.
"Don't worry, our Pingping plays with everything carefully. This is her doll, so she must look at it like a baby."
Xu Chenghou smiled and watched his granddaughter jumping around there, and he didn't think the doll was expensive.
Anyway, this thing can be played by itself for many years, and my granddaughter can still play it in the future, no matter how expensive it is, as long as the child is happy.
Here with grandparents, there are no principles, as long as the grandchildren are happy, everything will be fine.
"Dad, I bought you something, you must like it."
Xu Shiyan smiled and handed a box to Xu Chenghou.
Xu Chenghou was stunned, "Why do you still buy me something? Look at you, just buy something new for the child.
I'm an old man, I don't want anything. "Xu Chenghou said while waving his hands and pushing away.
"Father, don't regret it if you don't want it."
Xu Shiyan opened the box with a smile, revealing a square object about the size of a palm, whether it was metal or plastic.
Turn the switch on the side, and you can hear a sound coming out of the square thing.
"Oh, is this a semiconductor radio?" Xu Chenghou's eyes lit up, and he grabbed it.
"I thought it was something, you said it was a semiconductor, how can I say no?"
"This is a sika deer brand pocket semiconductor radio, produced by Changchun Radio Factory."
Xu Shiyan smiled and knew that the old man must like this thing.
Xu Chenghou held the semiconductor in his hand, rubbing his fingers against the carved plexiglass on the surface, listening to the voice coming from inside, he couldn't put it down.
"Isn't this stuff expensive? I remember hearing people say that it's more than two months' salary."
Xu Chenghou is very rare, but he also loves money. He always feels that it is a waste for his son to spend so much money on such a gadget.
"Father, what year is your old almanac?
Now this thing is worthless, this one is the best, only fourteen and a half dollars. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head and laughed when he heard it. Semiconductors were worth two months’ salary, and that was more than ten years ago.
In 1963, the two-tube semiconductor was 46 yuan, in 1964, the three-tube semiconductor was 57 yuan, and in 1965, the six-tube semiconductor was 67 yuan.
Waiting until the 1970s, the price of semiconductors was lowered, falling year after year.
Up to now, the backlog of radios is not easy to sell. The six tubes only cost more than ten yuan, and there is no ticket.
Before going to the provincial capital, Xu Shiyan didn't know that this thing was so cheap.
When I saw it that day, I just asked casually. When people said it, Xu Shiyan was also taken aback.
After asking clearly, I quickly bought one for the old man.
It’s good to keep this thing to listen to something. The battery is safe, and two AA batteries can last for a while.
"Now, the radio factories have switched to producing tape recorders. No one in the city wants this stuff, so it's cheap."
Electronic products are like this. Now that tape recorders are popular, these factories make tape recorders.
Wait for a few years to become popular, and in the end, many factories can't keep up with the market rhythm, and they will become yellow.
"Oh, oh, it's so cheap, that's okay, just buy it if you buy it."
Xu Chenghou felt relieved when he heard that it cost more than ten yuan.
The price is acceptable, very good, this gift from my son is quite satisfactory.
"Mom, I didn't pick anything good for you, I just bought a hat and two pieces of fabric."
Buying things for my mother was the most difficult thing. Xu Shiyan went shopping for a long time but couldn't find anything he wanted. The hat was not bad.
Later, I had nothing to do, so I bought two pieces of fabric, one is dark blue corduroy and the other is dark brown dark satin.
“What did the salesperson say this hat was?
Oops, I can’t remember, anyway, I think it’s quite soft and warm when I wear it, so I bought it, mom, try it. "
Xu Shiyan didn't know much about these things. Anyway, he just looked good at the time and didn't care so much, so he paid for it.
Zhou Guilan took the hat, and as soon as she started to hold it, she felt that the hair was soft and soft, and it felt warm in her hand.
Look carefully, it seems to be made of woolen yarn, but the fur is very warm.
"Hey, this is good, it's soft and warm, okay, it's good."
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 250: despised by son
chapters.content:
Chapter 250 Despised by his son
Going out for a trip and coming back, I brought something for everyone in the family, coaxing my parents and children to be very happy.
Seeing the smiling faces of his parents and children, Xu Shiyan felt very satisfied.
"Daughter-in-law, I bought it for you too, and I'll give it to you when I get home."
Just as Su Anying finished packing for his son, Xu Shiyan whispered to his wife.
Su Anying smiled, "Should we go back? You are quite tired after going out these days, go home and rest.
The two little ones didn't sleep this afternoon, and I guess they can go to bed early tonight.
After a while, the two of them will feel uncomfortable, so they should go home early, because they have to burn the kang and stove at the other end. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at the clock on the wall, it was almost five o'clock, it was indeed not early, and Zhou Qingguo and the others would come to him in the evening.
"Dad, Mom, let's go home first.
The younger sister has to be raised at home for a while, I will take some time tomorrow to talk to her master. "
Xu Shiqin had just had the operation for twenty days, and the doctor said that he should not be tired and not sit for a long time. There was no other way but to ask for leave.
"Yes, yes, chat again when I have time.
Old lady, quickly help Yingzi wrap up the baby, and the two of them go back with the little one in their arms. "
Xu Chenghou actually had a lot to say to Xu Shiyan, but it was really getting late.
The son’s house is also such a big house, the house is not warm after the fire is late, and the child suffers.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan put on the pants that he had just peed on, and then put on clothes and shoes for the two older ones.
Su Anying and Zhou Guilan dressed the two little ones and covered them with quilts. Xu Shiyan carried a backpack and hugged his youngest son.
Su Anying hugged her little girl, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping followed behind her parents.
The family of six left here and went back to their own home.
When leaving in the morning, Su Anying threw a few big scorpions into the stove, and threw a few lumps into the stove.
When I got home in the afternoon, the room wasn’t too cold, and the kang felt slightly warm.
The couple entered the door and hurriedly put the child down, unwrapped the quilt, and let Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, the older ones, watch over them.
The stove is faster than the kang, and after a while, the heat from the stove came up, and the room gradually became warmer.
Xu Shiyan boiled a pot of water and threw some large pieces of firewood into the stove before entering the house with Su Anying.
Xu Shiyan dumped things out of his backpack, and made a pile of clothes, shoes, wool, scarves, etc. bought for his wife.
"Look at you, going out for a trip already cost a lot of money, why are you buying me so many things?"
Su Anying was quite happy to see those things, but when she thought about money, her heart ached.
"It's not easy for you to earn money, and we still have four children to raise.
I stay at home all day and don’t go out very often. If you buy me these clothes and shoes, I don’t have a chance to wear them.
Don't spend this money in the future. "
"Look at what you said, what do I earn money for? Isn't it just for you and the children to have enough food and clothing?
Who said you can’t wear it at home, just wear whatever you like. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping who were coaxing their younger siblings to play.
While the daughter and son were not paying attention, she secretly kissed the daughter-in-law on the face.
Su Anying was a little embarrassed by her husband's behavior, and glanced at him.
"The children are here, what are you doing?"
"Oh, wait until the children fall asleep at night." Xu Shiyan leaned close to his wife's ear and whispered.
Provoking Su Anying to stare at him, "You have to show some face."
Xu Shiyan laughed nonchalantly.
Now, Xu Haiyuan heard it, and went to his father's side.
"Dad, what are you laughing at? So happy?"
Xu Shiyan took his son over and put him on his lap, "Dad is home, of course I am happy to see you and Mom.
Dad has been away for so long, do you miss him? "
I haven't been idle since I came back, and I haven't been able to get close to the children.
Finally free now, Xu Shiyan hugged his eldest son and chatted, teasing him.
"Dad, it's alright if you ask Pingping about this. How old am I, and you still tease me like this?"
Xu Haiyuan is a big kid, especially after studying in autumn, he is more sensible and always feels that he is an adult.
Hearing his father ask such a naive question at this moment, the little boy was speechless.
That expression is like saying, Dad, do you think it’s fun? How childish.
Now, it was Su Anying's turn to laugh.
She was just opening the door of the kangqin cabinet, packing things and putting them in. When she heard her son's words, she held on to the cabinet door and kept laughing.
Xu Shiyan was despised by his son, he was taken aback for a moment, and then realized that he grabbed his son and wanted to slap his ass.
"Okay you little brat, you hate your father, right?"
Xu Shiyan didn't really want to beat his son, but just to frighten him.
Xu Haiyuan panicked a little now, and quickly covered it with his hand.
"Don't, Dad, I was wrong, I miss you, I really miss you."
A hero doesn’t suffer from immediate losses. Now he is too young to beat his father, so he admits defeat.
"Little kid, I don't believe you can't be cured."
Xu Shiyan still refused to give up, grabbed his son, and kissed his tender little face.
He didn't shave on the way back, and he happened to have beard stubble. This kiss made Xu Haiyuan's face itchy, and the little guy begged for mercy.
"Dad, Dad, I don't dare anymore, I won't dare again in the future, please forgive me. Mom, help me."
At the other end, Xu Jinping, who was playing with the doll, saw that her brother was being bullied by her father, so she hurried over.
"Dad, please forgive my brother. My brother is wrong." The two children have a good relationship, and the little girl pleads with her brother.
"Okay, for Xiao Pingping's sake, I will spare the little **** Yuanyuan."
Xu Shiyan let go of his son and brought his daughter over. "Then do you think about Dad?"
Adults, most of them love to play this game with children.
Ask if you think about it, where did you think? The children's answers were varied and interesting.
Xu Jinping secretly glanced at her brother, then laughed.
"Thinking about it, thinking about it in my heart, thinking about it in my head, but I miss my father, and my father will not come back sooner."
The little girl has a sweet mouth and can coax people. That cute appearance makes people rare.
"Well, this is Dad's good daughter, unlike your stinky brother who doesn't even miss Dad."
It's better to be a girl, more caring than a kid, that brat, don't mind.
Su Anying on the other side couldn't stand it any longer, and found a pair of thick cotton trousers from the cabinet.
"A person in his thirties is like a child.
Come on, you should change your pants quickly, don’t you feel uncomfortable when your son peed in those pants?
I still hug my son and daughter, so I'm not afraid to make them look bad. "
It was only November when Xu Shiyan went out, and he was wearing thin cotton trousers.
Now that life is better, Su Anying made two thick cotton trousers for Xu Shiyan.
"Oh, if you don't tell me, I really forgot."
Isn’t it so? The trousers outside are almost toasty, and the cotton trousers are still damp in one piece.
Xu Shiyan quickly took off his trousers and put on the one Su Anying found out.
"Third Brother, Third Brother, what are you doing at home?"

chapters.title: Chapter 251: partnership
chapters.content:
Chapter 251 Partnership
Xu Shiyan had just changed into his trousers, and before he could even put on his belt, he heard someone yelling outside.
Don't even think about it, it must be Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming.
Xu Shiyan quickly put on his belt, went out from the house, and when he opened the door, it turned out to be Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe, and Zhou Qingguo.
"I just came back from my father's place, isn't this a fire.
I guessed that it was time for you to come over, just in time, I boiled a pot of hot water and made tea for you. "
"The few of us were playing poker at Shengli's house just now, and we are waiting for the third brother to come back.
Just now the kid from the Shengli family said that your chimney is smoking. We guessed that the third brother and the third sister-in-law are back, so hurry up. "
Zhao Jianshe and the others entered the door with a smile, stomped their feet, and walked to the east room.
These guys were all thinking about Clivia, so they made an appointment when they got out of Xu's house and waited at Huang Shengli's house.
After Zhou Qingguo and Zhao Jianshe escorted their fathers home, they all ran to Huang Shengli's house to play.
As soon as the Huang family boy said that there was smoke coming out of the chimney at the Xu family's side, how could a few of them care about playing poker? Drop the poker and come over.
"Third brother, please tell us about the Clivia.
What was written in your letter was too simple, we couldn't understand it at all. "
As soon as he entered the room and greeted Su Anying, Zhao Jianshe couldn't wait to ask.
"Sit first, sit down and talk."
How many years have been friends, how can Xu Shiyan not understand Zhao Jianshe's quick temper? So he smiled and greeted everyone to sit down.
Su Anying packed up the two little ones, carried them to the east room, and told the two older ones to watch over their younger siblings.
Then he went to the kitchen to wash the teapot, made a pot of tea and brought it over, so that Xu Shiyan and the others could chat while drinking water.
Xu Shiyan told everyone about his experience in the provincial capital.
Everyone heard that a pot of Clivia can sell for hundreds of dollars, and the price is likely to increase, and everyone's eyes widened.
"My God, can a pot of flowers sell so much? Is it made of gold?"
Zhao Jianshe exclaimed, he couldn't understand a bit, a pot of flowers, can't eat or drink, how can it be worth hundreds of dollars?
Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard this, where did he go? Waiting for the autumn and winter of 1984 would be crazy.
A potted flower can sell tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands.
Gold? How much is the gold at this time? A hundred thousand can buy thirty or forty taels of gold, right?
One tael of gold can be used to make gold sheets of more than ten square meters, which can be used to make flowers, and I am afraid that dozens of pots of "golden flowers" can be made.
Otherwise, how can Clivia be called a green gold bar?
"Let's not worry about why it is so valuable, the world of the rich is different from ours.
Let's just think about it now, how can we make some money. Right, third uncle? "
Zhou Qingguo, on the other hand, has a bit of knowledge, and knows that it is meaningless to discuss those things, so let's think about how to make money.
"After receiving the third uncle's letter, I, together with Feng Chao and Chunming, searched everywhere for seedlings and seeds, not to mention, really scratched.
The seedlings cost 50 cents to 80 cents each, and the seeds cost 1 cent. When people hear that we buy this thing, they think we are fools. "
A few years ago, growing flowers was a big poisonous weed, and they had to be grown in secret.
The past few years have gotten better. Many people have started to grow flowers, but no one pays attention to them.
If you want any flowers, just tell them directly, and they will press a seedling or something. I have never heard of anyone spending money to buy flower seedlings and seeds.
Of course, when someone buys it, someone sells it, but there are very few Clivias in Donggang, and after a lot of effort, Bala can only find about a dozen orchids.
In Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, some people raise Clivia.
Zhou Qingguo and the others are also quite capable, asking around, as long as anyone has it, they will ask.
When people heard that the seedlings and seeds were paid, they were willing to sell them.
Just scratching and pulling around like this, there have been dozens of seedlings and hundreds of seeds recently.
"Third brother, we don't know how to grow this kind of thing, the seedlings are okay, come back to raise them, what are the seeds?"
The seedlings were taken back and raised in various families, but they didn't know how to plant that kind of seed, so they could only wait for Xu Shiyan to come back.
"Our sixth sister will, and so will your third sister-in-law.
It’s okay, you can bring the seeds over here, I have a big place here, just let your third sister-in-law have time to plant them. "
Xu Shiqin likes Clivia and is very experienced in cultivating Clivia.
Zhou Guilan thinks that her daughter always plays with these things, and the whole house is full of window sills, so she is not allowed to keep so many.
Xu Shiqin moved to her brother's side, and Su Anying helped Clivia in daily life. After a long time, she also gained a lot of experience. She knows what to do.
When everyone heard about Su Anying's meeting, they felt relieved. As long as someone knows how to grow it, and if it can be sold, then they will not be afraid.
Xu Shiyan told them again, asking each family to inquire more, and relatives and friends far away also helped to search and collect as much as possible.
Money, come from Xu Shiyan, collect as much as possible, and it will be easier to handle if there is a lot.
"I contribute the money, and the big guys contribute. When we make money, we will share dividends according to the shares."
Xu Shiyan was afraid that everyone still had concerns, so he simply said that he would pay for it.
"No, third brother, it would be great if you can lead us to earn money.
If we don't pay any more, doesn't that mean we are picking up money after the third brother? That won't work.
We should pay for the money, and we can’t let the third brother carry it alone. "Yang Chunming shook his head quickly when he heard this.
"Yes, yes, the third brother can't contribute the money alone, the big guys all contribute part of it.
We have made a lot of money with the third brother these years, can we still not trust the third brother? "Zhao Jianshe was the first to agree.
They have been with Xu Shiyan for a long time, and they have indeed enjoyed a lot of glory.
It's only a few dollars to buy Clivia seedlings. They haven't lost money in the past few years, so it's not impossible that they can't afford it.
Feng Chao, Huang Shengli and others expressed their opinions after hearing this, "Yes, Jianshe and Chunming are right.
It would be great if Brother Xu could take us with us, we can’t let Brother Xu pay for everything.
Our brothers earn money together, even if we lose money, we have to share it with the big guys. "
"Okay, then I would like to thank everyone for your trust."
It is definitely the most proud thing in a person's life to have a few trustworthy brothers and friends who work side by side.
Xu Shiyan was very happy, pulled everyone along, and began to talk about his plan.
This winter will be like this, using the window sills of various houses, and the old house on Xu Shiyan's side, as much as can be cultivated.
In the spring of the coming year, we will set up a flower shed on the side of the farm, cultivate Clivia seedlings in large quantities, and also purchase finished Clivia seedlings.
By the end of the summer of 1984, Xu Shiyan went to Hongqi Street or somewhere in the provincial capital to rent a place, the entire Clivia Flower Company or something.
At that time, the finished orchids will be sold in the store, and the seedlings can be wholesaled.
How to operate it will be discussed later. It is useless to discuss too much now.
The most important thing is to take advantage of the wind blowing in the provincial capital, and buy more goods. When you know the value in the future, you will spend more money.
It is said that Zhuge Liang is the best of the three cobblers. So many people gather together to discuss things, and they can think of everything.
Now, the chatter became more and more joyful, and the conversation lasted until after eight o'clock.
"Oh, it's getting late, let's go home quickly.
Third brother has been away for so long, and when he comes back today, why can't he get close to his sister-in-law?
Let’s not lose our eyesight, go, go, go home. "

chapters.title: Chapter 252: make trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 252 Trouble
Xu Shiyan sent away the group of winking bad friends, locked the door, wandered around to make sure everything was fine, and then went back to the house.
At this moment, Su Anying spread out the bedding, and took the sleeping children out of the east room and put them on the kang.
The two younger ones fell asleep after six o'clock, and the two older ones were sleepy before eight o'clock, and fell asleep without taking off their clothes.
The sleeping sons and daughters on the kang, the gentle and virtuous wife, at this moment, is undoubtedly the most beautiful and happiest picture in the world.
Xu Shiyan was surrounded by happiness, and the corners of his mouth could not help but rise. He walked to the edge of the kang and put his arms around his wife's waist.
"Daughter-in-law, you've worked hard. I'm not at home. It's not easy for you to take care of these four."
One person has to take care of four children, even with Zhou Guilan's help, it is enough for Su Anying.
Su Anying leaned back, leaning on Xu Shiyan's arms, looking at the four sleeping babies beside her, she also smiled.
"It's okay, with our mother's help, the two older ones are sensible, and can help me look after the younger one.
Tired but not tired, just thinking about you, I don’t know how you are doing outside. "
Su Anying has such a temperament, no matter how hard or tired she is, she will never lose her temper with her husband.
It is not easy for her to take care of the children at home, and her husband may not be easier than her outside.
At any rate, she still has her mother-in-law to help her. Her husband is outside and unfamiliar with the place. It should be even more difficult to take care of her sister-in-law who is hospitalized, and to run around, buy vegetables and cook.
Isn’t that what life is like? Everyone has their own hardships.
Husbands and wives should be considerate of each other, think more about each other's difficulties, instead of complaining and complaining blindly.
"I'm fine outside, I just miss you and my children.
I really hope that my sixth sister will get better soon so that she can go home early. "
Xu Shiyan put his arms around his daughter-in-law, whispering how he misses his family.
"Finally back, I can hold my wife in my arms. Really, as soon as I hold you, I feel that my empty heart is filled at once."
Having a wife and son, this is his home, it feels so good to be home.
At the beginning, the two of them were talking close together, but as they talked, something changed.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand and pulled the light cord, and the room suddenly became dark.
On the seventh day of the twelfth lunar month, there was no moonlight outside, only the biting cold wind, blowing the treetops and making whining sounds.
After an unknown amount of time, the couple were falling asleep.
Suddenly there was a wow from Su Anying, who was crying, and then the other was crying too.
Xu Shiyan woke up instantly with a jolt, quickly turned on the light, put on a cotton jacket, picked up one, and coaxed.
Su Anying also got up in a padded jacket, picked up the other one, reached out to touch it, and the urine was wet.
The two young ones went to bed too early tonight, and Su Anying also forgot to pee just now, and now even the mattress is wet.
"Have you checked if your daughter has urinated? If she hasn't urinated, take her to pee, and if she urinates, change her panties."
Su Anying glanced at Xu Shiyan, and taught him how to do it. Here, she quickly changed the trousers for the youngest son.
Take out the wet quilt again, throw it aside, and find another small quilt to put on it.
Fortunately, Zhou Guilan took apart some old cotton clothes and made several peeing mats for the two babies, and Xu Haiyuan and the others' small peeing mats were also there.
Lay it on top of the big mattress, even if you urinate at night, it will at most be because the upper mattress is wet, and it won’t wet the bigger mattress underneath.
Otherwise, you don’t have to do anything else every day, just remove the mattress.
Xu Shiyan touched it, but the girl didn't pee, so she quickly hugged her to pee. Sure enough, it was a big splash.
"You two little bastards, it's a good thing you didn't cry just now."
Xu Shiyan came back with his daughter in his arms, put her back in the bed, watched the little girl close her eyes and hummed a few times before falling asleep again, and heaved a sigh of relief.
The little girl was easy to coax, and she fell asleep in a while, but the little boy couldn't do it. After changing the diaper, the little guy closed his eyes and groaned and refused to sleep.
Su Anying took a look and knew that her son was going to eat, so she picked her up and nursed her son.
As a result, after eating a few mouthfuls, the kid fell asleep.
"Usually I feed them at 8 o'clock in the evening and coax them to sleep.
They can sleep through the night when they are old enough to wake up around four o'clock in the morning.
Today, there are too many people in the afternoon, so I didn't sleep. I went to bed too early at night, so I woke up in the middle of the night. "
Su Anying put down her sleeping son and patted her son again to make sure her son was fast asleep before lying down.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his arms and put his arms around his daughter-in-law. The couple leaned against each other and fell asleep after a while.
Xu Shiyan has been away for more than two months, and his family can't take care of him at all. There must be a backlog of things.
When I came back, I couldn’t get any rest, and I had to work again the next morning.
First went to Han's house, Han Liwei was leaving, Xu Shiqin was not in good health and could not be sent, Xu Shiyan, the uncle, could only go there once.
Send Han Liwei into the car, Xu Shiyan and Han Limin didn't take the donkey jeep, just strolled back.
When he reached the center of the town, Xu Shiyan turned towards the Forestry Bureau and stopped by a tailor shop.
Xu Shiqin is like this now, it is estimated that he will not be able to come to work a few years ago, so he must tell Xu Shiqin's master.
Master Qin is very good. When he heard that Xu Shiqin's operation was successful, he was also happy.
Straightforwardly let Xu Shiqin take care of her at home, and don’t need to rush back to work.
"Xiao Xu, how much did Shiqin spend this time? Did you bring the receipt back?
Give me all the receipts, and I will go to the bureau to find someone to see if I can ask for more subsidies or something.
At that time, you were in a hurry to go out, and I forgot to mention that Shiqin can reimburse part of the surgery and medical expenses. "
Master Qin thought of this suddenly, and hurriedly asked Xu Shiyan for the hospital receipt or something.
Xu Shiyan really brought those materials and gave them all to Master Qin.
"Master Qin, don't be too embarrassing, report as much as you can."
The money has been spent, so it’s a surprise if you can repay it, but it’s okay if you can’t.
It's not that Xu Shiyan is so generous, the key is that he doesn't want Master Qin to be too embarrassing.
After all, this tailor shop is only a small unit under the Forestry Bureau, so it can't even be ranked.
Master Qin doesn't have much power, and everything has to be done according to the rules of the bureau.
"Okay, don't worry, I will try my best to fight for it, and if you don't get too much, don't be disappointed."
Master Qin didn't dare to guarantee it, he just said he was doing his best.
After leaving the tailor shop, Xu Shiyan went to the bureau building again to find Guo Shouye.
He brought back a good pack of cigarettes from the provincial capital, bought it through Mr. Chu's relationship, and just kept it for Guo Shouye.
Guo Shouye already knew about Xu Shiyan accompanying his younger sister to the operation, so when he saw Xu Shiyan, he first asked Xu Shiqin about the operation.
Knowing that everything went well, Guo Shouye was also very happy.
Xu Shiyan gave him the cigarette. Guo Shouye had seen the world, and he knew it was a good thing at a glance, so he was very happy.
I have to give the money to Xu Shiyan, as Xu Shiyan brought it back for him.
How could Xu Shiyan ask for money? The two pushed back for a while, and finally Guo Shouye could only accept it.
"Brother, don't spend money like this in the future, it's not easy for you, and you have four children to support.
Our brothers have been friends for these years, if there is anything you can just say, if you can do it, you can do it directly, if you can't, you can find a way to help you. "
"Brother, I have nothing else to do, I just want Brother Guo to help me find out who has Clivia in the bureau.
Or other forestry bureaus, who has Clivia.
I spend money to buy, big or small, seeds are fine. "

chapters.title: Chapter 253: old house to flower shed
chapters.content:
Chapter 253 Old house turned into a flower shed
Xu Shiyan came to Guo Shouye because he wanted to borrow Guo Shouye's connections.
Yang Chunming and others are all farmers, and most of their relatives are old farmers. They don’t have enough connections, so it is difficult to find more Clivia seedlings.
But Guo Shouye is different. He is in the forestry system and has acquaintances in forestry bureaus in various places.
If Guo Shouye can help, the acquisition of Clivia seedlings will be easier.
"Clivia? What do you want that thing for?"
Guo Shouye doesn't quite understand Xu Shiyan's meaning, it's okay to be idle, and accept Clivia seedlings? What's the use of that thing?
"Brother, I plan to start a Clivia flower company, and I can find a way to sell it, but now I am short of flower seedlings.
I entrusted many people to help me find out. I wonder how many people I know, so I can ask for help when I have time.
Especially our county belongs to several other bureaus, or elsewhere.
If you want to inquire, you just need to tell me the address, and I will figure out the rest. "
Please ask others for help, then you have to speak clearly, it is useless to hide it.
As for Guo Shouye helping harvest flower seedlings, will he spread the news? Others will learn from it.
Xu Shiyan is not worried about this.
What does he do with this? It is incomparable with those big households who raise Clivia, and it is not a drop in the bucket.
Clivia was designated as the city flower in 1984, and there were dozens of flower companies in the provincial capital all of a sudden, looking for flower seedlings from all over the country.
Xu Shiyan doesn't know if he can make waves with this little capital, so what are you afraid of?
He just took advantage of his rebirth to earn a little money to spend.
"Flower company? You can really think, this thing is not easy to play with, you should be careful.
Yes, it's easy. My sister-in-law's natal family belongs to the Lushuihe Forestry Bureau, and her relatives also live in Quanyang, Linjiang, and Sanchazi.
It’s just about Chinese New Year, when the time comes to visit relatives, I’ll help you find out. "
When Guo Shouye heard it, it was not difficult for him to deal with such a trivial matter.
"Hey, thank you brother, you have helped me a lot.
Well, brother, I just came back yesterday, and there are a lot of things at home, so I will come to talk to my brother another day. "
Xu Shiyan saw that it was not too long before he came out, and he hadn't gone to see the farm yet, so he hurriedly told Guo Shouye, left the bureau building and went home first.
There is indeed a lot of work at home, and the three houses in the east end have to be cleaned up.
The kang was removed, the north and south were surrounded by fire walls, and a stove was needed in the middle of the ground.
Winter is cold, Clivia needs a certain temperature to grow, if it is too cold, it will not grow at all.
In addition to this, we have to build a flower stand.
If you want to grow more flowers, you must use the space effectively. Just placing one layer on the ground is too wasteful of space.
I made an agreement with Huang Shengli and the others yesterday, and we will do these tasks together.
In the morning, Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng and others came over, first removed the kang, and piled the adobe and the soil on the kang in the middle of the ground.
After the cleaning is completed, smash the adobe and mud to use it for the wall of fire.
When Xu Shiyan arrived home, Huang Shengli and the others were all disgraced, and they were dumping soil from the Kang cave.
"Third brother, alas, you are back, your kang has been plagued by rats, and the rats are nesting in the kang hole.
