This is due to the removal of the kang. If it was directly set on the fire, there would be smoke everywhere and choke to death. "
Zhao Jianshe's face was covered with black ash, and his body was also covered with black and gray.
The three old houses in Dongtou have been vacant for a long time. Xu Shiyan planned to renovate when he had the opportunity, so he didn't care.
Once the house is idle, it will definitely break down quickly. If there is no fire on the kang, it is normal for there to be rats inside.
Xu Shiyan walked into the house and took a look. The kangs in the east and west rooms were removed, and the stove in the outer room was also removed.
In this way, the room looks very empty, leaving enough space for flowers.
"Well, okay, it's good like this, brothers, you have worked hard. I will go back to the house and change clothes later, and come to work."
Xu Shiyan can still be idle about his own affairs?
So I went back to the house and changed into a piece of rags for work, and together with Zhao Jianshe and others, cleaned up the old house inside and out.
All the unnecessary things were cleaned up, and the excess adobe was piled up outside.
After the house is cleaned up, start smashing adobes, kneading mud, setting up fire walls, and setting up stoves.
Xu Shiyan led the people to work on this side, while Xu Chenghou rummaged for wood to help make flower shelves.
After all the houses were tidied up, the fire walls were fired and dried, and the flower shelves were installed, the three old houses were transformed into flower sheds.
After five or six days of work, the flower shed was finally finished.
When everything is ready here, each family will hand over the collected seeds to Su Anying and Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiqin has nothing to do to recuperate at home. She is an expert in raising Clivia, so she happened to come to help.
Xu Shiyan handed over the flower shed to his wife and sister. He has to work on the farm. This year's musk hasn't been picked yet.
Generally speaking, non-species musk musk can be harvested from October to March of the following year.
For musk deer breeding, the mating period should be staggered, and the musks should be harvested in September to October, or after December.
Autumn is too busy to take care of it. As soon as winter comes, Xu Shiyan goes out to the provincial capital again. After such a delay, it will be delayed until the end of January and the beginning of February.
Don't pick too much incense in the sachet, it is easy to form big lumps, and musk deer will suffer when picking incense.
Male musk deer will only secrete musk after two years. Three to ten years is the peak period of fragrance production, and basically no fragrance will be produced after fifteen years.
There are 15 adult male musk deer in the breeding farm, and each musk deer can take 15 to 20 grams of incense.
Take the musk and send it to Tonghua Medicinal Materials Purchase Station. Xu Shiyan signed a purchase agreement with them, and the musk and velvet produced every year will be sold to the other party at the market price.
This crop of musk alone can earn a small 10,000 yuan.
After a few years, those young musk deer will grow up, the scale of the farm will expand, and the profit will be more.
As wild musk deer becomes less and less, musk will become more and more expensive.
When Xu Shiyan came back from Tonghua, it was only a few days before the Chinese New Year.
And the things he mailed from the provincial capital finally arrived at the local post office.
Xu Shiyan pushed a cart to the post office and picked up several packages.
Fortunately, everything was well preserved, especially the box of books, which was sealed up very firmly, without falling apart or being lost.
I moved the things home, and Xu Shiyan didn't bother to dismantle them, so let's pile them up in the West Room first.
It was the box of books that I couldn't wait to open.
When I was in the provincial capital, I was in a hurry, and I didn’t even look at the books. I only heard from Mr. Chu that some of them belonged to his family, and the other were textbooks from the Agricultural University.
Xu Shiyan took the books out of the box one by one, sorted them, and put them on the bookshelf in the east room.
As a result, halfway through the arrangement, I found that there were several manuscripts inside, all written by Mr. Chu himself.
There are medical records of Mr. Chu who practiced medicine over the years, and there is another book, which is actually a secret recipe handed down by the Chu family.
The Chu family has practiced medicine for generations, and their ancestors even had imperial doctors. The secret recipe can be said to be a treasure, and its value is immeasurable.
Xu Shiyan was so frightened that his hands trembled, the manuscript almost fell out of his hands, and a letter inside fell out.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Fascinated
chapters.content:
Chapter 254 Fascinated
Xu Shiyan opened the letter, and he knew it was written by Mr. Chu himself.
In the letter, Mr. Chu explained why he sent the medical records and secret recipes to Xu Shiyan.
Mr. Chu had a special experience back then, and he never got married. It was not until after liberation that he married a wife and had children with the help of others.
So the two sons of his family are not very old. At the time of the accident, one was seventeen and the other was sixteen.
When the two teenagers were rebelling, they saw their father was arrested, and their mother was seriously ill and had no way to ask for help, and finally died of illness.
Later, the two were squeezed out and suppressed, suffered all kinds of bullying, and were finally arranged to go to the mountains and countryside in the northwest.
This experience caused great psychological harm to the brothers.
So the two swore that they would never study medicine and forbid their children to study medicine.
And Elder Chu is the only son in the family, that is to say, the inheritance of several generations of the Chu family will end here, and there will be no successors.
Elder Chu felt that he was getting old, maybe one day he left, and the medical skills of the Chu family would also be lost.
With the tempers of the two brothers, they might burn all the manuscripts of medical books left by Mr. Chu.
Elder Chu felt ashamed of his ancestors. No matter what, the secret recipe of the Chu family couldn’t just disappear. He had to find a successor.
Thinking about it, only Xu Shiyan is suitable, so Mr. Chu put these manuscripts in a pile of books.
I didn't tell Xu Shiyan beforehand, just because I was afraid that Xu Shiyan would disagree.
Xu Shiyan took the letter and read it over and over again. After reading it several times, he could only sigh in the end.
"Master, you can really give me a problem, leave this thing to me, can I keep it well?
How can I have the ability to pass on the medical skills of the Chu family? "
Xu Shiyan really doesn't have much confidence in himself, he's just half-assed.
In the field of medicine, some people dare not say that they have achieved something after studying for decades. Why should he help Mr. Chu keep such an important secret recipe for someone who doesn't even have half a bottle of water?
Xu Shiyan sent it back to Mr. Chu if he wanted to, and he was worried that if something went wrong during the mailing process, it would be lost.
After much deliberation, I had to pack the manuscript and the secret recipe carefully and put them in a box in the basement.
Wait for him to write a letter to ask Mr. Chu before dealing with it.
A box of books, most of which are agricultural university textbooks that Mr. Chu helped to bring, and a small part of them are medical books.
Xu Shiyan looked at the row of books on the bookshelf, very happy, and quickly took one down to read carefully.
However, his culture is still a little low, and it is very difficult to read. He pondered while reading, and after a long time, he only read three or four pages.
A book is quite thick, and it may not be easy to finish it.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan is a resilient person. If he finds his way, no matter what method he thinks of, he has to understand it.
This is down, Xu Shiyan doesn't care about anything else except eating and sleeping and reading.
Su Anying endured it for three days, and couldn't bear it anymore.
"Didn't you say before that when the New Year is coming, you have to buy New Year's goods for the few people in the farm, and then give them some bonuses?
Why don’t you do anything every day, just hold a book? When you can't read those books, do the serious business first. "
"Don't you even look at what time it is?
Today's New Year's Eve, you don't prepare anything for others, how can you let them spend the New Year's Eve? "
Reminded by Su Anying, Xu Shiyan remembered that he had forgotten something important.
"Isn't it? I promised them before that I wouldn't lose them at the end of the year. I just read books these two days and forgot about it.
Daughter-in-law, I'll go out first, don't move the book for me.
Especially that **** Xu Haiyuan, don't let him come in and read my book. "
Xu Shiyan quickly marked the book, put it back on the bookshelf, and asked Su Anying to do it before going out.
"Oh, hurry up, who cares about your books? Your son is too lazy to read them, and he can't read them."
Su Anying said so, but when she got out of the east room, she found a lock and locked the door.
No one knows better than Su Anying the virtues of her own children.
Xu Haiyuan is mischievous, I can't guarantee what he can do, so it's better to lock it for peace of mind.
Xu Shiyan went out, first went to the Songjiang River, pulled a pile of food, loaded it into the car and took it to the farm.
In winter, there is less work on the farm, and the feed is stored in advance, just feed according to the regulations.
A few homeless people are not busy, so they play poker at their residence.
"Brother Xu, you are here. We just rest for a while and go to work later."
Several people were a little nervous when they saw Xu Shiyan coming, for fear that their boss would think they were lazy if they didn't work.
"It's okay, there are few jobs in winter, as long as you understand how to feed these animals, it doesn't matter if you usually play a little bit.
But there is one thing, you can play, but you are not allowed to move money.
If you let me know that you are playing with money, don't blame me for being rude, I will drive away whoever is playing with money. "
Xu Shiyan is not such a strict person, and he is not a rich landlord, how can he not let people rest?
But there are certain rules that must be followed, and the farm will definitely not accept those who play with money.
Playing with money is not a good thing if you get involved.
As for gamblers, few can quit. In the end, wives and children are scattered and their families are ruined.
The gambler is impatient to lose, but he can do anything. If someone has a bad idea, it will be bad if he sends his idea to the farm.
"It's not easy for all of you to leave your hometown and travel all the way to the Northeast.
Earn some money and save it, and save it to marry a wife later, but don't do harm indiscriminately. you know? "
Xu Shiyan is quite satisfied with these young men, so he naturally doesn't want them to go astray. If he can remind them, he should remind them as much as possible.
"Ah, ah, we all understand, Brother Xu, we don't use money, look, isn't this a sticker?"
These people are quite honest, as soon as Xu Shiyan said, they nodded quickly.
"Okay, just remember this.
Today’s Xiaonian, I brought you some food over here, and you guys will make some dumplings yourself for a few nights.
If you can’t go home after such a long distance, let this be your home. "
Xu Shiyan put all the vegetables and meat he bought, as well as some white noodles, on the shelf on the ground.
"I originally promised you, you work hard, and you won't lose at the end of the year.
It's the end of the year, and I'll give each of you a red envelope for the New Year. "
What you said, you have to do. Xu Shiyan took out six red envelopes, each containing 60 yuan.
This is not a salary, it should be regarded as a bonus for them.
How could these people have imagined that not only would there be so much food today, but there would also be red envelope collars.
Hurriedly came forward, received the red envelope and thanked Xu Shiyan.
"Thank you Brother Xu, we work here with Brother Xu, we get paid, we also take care of food and drink, and there are red envelopes at the end of the year, which is much better than our fellow villagers."
These people work in the farms, and they are in charge of food and housing. They are paid 15 yuan a month. During the holidays, Xu Shiyan will express it to some extent.
If you count it seriously, it's not too bad to compare with the locals, let alone the blind drifters.
Several people were very grateful, holding red envelopes with excitement.
How many blind people have been busy for a year and have nothing left in the end? They can still save money to send home this year, which is really good.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: eat canned food
chapters.content:
Chapter 255 Eating canned food
After Xu Shiyan delivered the things, he went around the farm again, and after confirming that there was nothing wrong here, he rode his bike home.
As a result, as soon as he arrived at his door, he saw General Tie guarding the door.
Needless to say, Su Anying must have taken the child to the parents' place.
During the new year, Zhou Guilan was worried that her third son and her husband would be too busy to take care of the children and make dumplings.
So I went there in person, together with Su Anying, holding the two younger ones and leading the two older ones, and brought them here together.
When Xu Shiyan entered, there were bursts of laughter in the room.
Entering the east room, Su Anying, her mother-in-law and sister-in-law are rolling out dumplings together.
Xu Chenghou was sitting on the top of the kang, holding a spoon in his hand, feeding Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping canned food spoon by spoon.
I don't know who came to visit and brought the canned food. The old man opened it for his grandchildren without saying a word.
How can there be anything delicious in this year?
Summer is coming to an end, Xu Shiyan has planted many fruit trees in the garden, and there are fruits to eat.
What do you have in winter? The one that can be chewed is probably a big turnip.
Occasionally, I saw a seller selling apples, and they were robbed of them before they could do anything. Most people couldn't buy them at all.
Canned fruit is delicious no matter in the eyes of adults or children.
If someone’s child has a cold and a fever, it’s good to keep it in a can, which is more effective than taking medicine and injections, and it can be called a magic weapon.
Even if the life of the Xu family is better than the average family, it is impossible for Xu Haiyuan and the others to eat canned food.
The two children sat obediently in front of their grandpa, waiting for their grandpa to scoop out the soft pulp for them to eat.
While eating, I laughed, not to mention how happy I was.
"Father, why do you give them canned food? It's very expensive, how good it is to keep you and my mother?"
Xu Shiyan entered the door, hung his coat on the wall, came to the top of the kang, and stretched out his hand to pinch his son's face.
"Greedy cat, you know how to coax your grandpa, but you don't know how to save good things for grandparents to eat.
You two, eat less, be careful that if you eat too much, you won’t be able to eat dumplings at night. "
"Look at you, I managed to coax the two of them not to make a fuss, and let your wife and the others make dumplings well.
These two children have to learn how to make dumplings, and the noodles they kneaded are useless. "
Xu Chenghou glanced at his son, and his tone was full of love for the two children.
"Then you don't want to beat them? Beat them hard. Once you beat them, they will have a long memory, and you will not dare to keep them next time."
Xu Shiyan saw that his father was in a good mood today, so he said this on purpose to scare the two children.
Xu Chenghou glared at his son, "You can take him home later and beat him up, as long as you don't stand in front of my eyes, you can do whatever you want.
It doesn’t work here, I can’t see it. "
Of course Xu Chenghou knew that this was to scare the two little kids, but he just couldn't help it. Being a grandfather who loves his grandson is really no nonsense.
"The canned food was the day before yesterday. The supply and marketing agency came to a batch of reduced prices. It was cheaper than usual. I bought it back after seeing it was good.
Specially save those who coax them, and save them from always making trouble.
How nice do you think this is? I'll feed them, they eat, it's delicious. "
"They can eat whatever they like, but they can't eat anything.
Hurry up and wash your hands, and go to help with the bag, while the two of them are honest at the moment, hurry up and pack it out. "
No matter how smart a child is, he is still young after all, and there are always times when he is mischievous.
In order to coax the children into not making trouble, Xu Chenghou really used all methods.
Xu Shiyan saw that the half curtain had just been wrapped at the other end, and most of the dumplings at home were wrapped with two curtains, which was quite a difference.
So I hurriedly washed my hands, took the rolling pin and rolled the skin.
Xu Shiyan is good at rolling dumplings, which are fast and round, and one person can make them for three people.
There was an extra helper, so naturally it was fast, and after a while, another curtain and a half was wrapped.
Su Anying went to boil the water, and when the water boiled for the dumplings, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan went to the yard together and lit a 200-ring firecracker.
When the firecrackers sounded, Zhou Guilan and Xu Shiqin quickly hugged the two little ones and covered their ears, for fear of scaring the two little ones.
It was Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, who were not afraid at all, and followed behind grandpa and father, clapping their hands happily.
The dumplings stuffed with cabbage and pork are very fresh, and everyone eats them a lot.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping probably ate too much canned food. After eating three or four dumplings each, they both shouted that they were full and refused to eat any more.
The adults didn’t care about them, so don’t eat if you don’t want to eat, let them play as they please.
As a result, the two children said that they were full and didn't want to eat dumplings, but after a while they hugged the cans on the window sill.
The two dug out the canned food with spoons and ate them happily. When the adults noticed something was wrong, the two children even drank up the canned soup.
"Oh my god, you two ate two cans this afternoon, and now you even drink soup, so you can't pee on the kang at night?"
Zhou Guilan couldn't laugh or cry when she saw it, and quickly took away the empty can.
I was afraid that one of the two children would accidentally smash the bottle and hurt them both.
"Yingzi, pay attention at night and tell them to get up and relieve themselves.
What a big belly, eating so much canned food and drinking soup, it would be strange not to pee on the kang. "Zhou Guilan told her daughter-in-law worriedly.
"You too, just eat it for the children, you can open it one by one, open two at once.
Let the two of them catch it, so it's not exciting? "Zhou Guilan gave her husband a blank look, and began to complain about Xu Chenghou.
It’s not that I feel bad about eating, the key is that I’m afraid that the child will be hurt by eating.
One of them is five years old and the other is four years old. As a result, the two of them ate two cans. What if they get sick and have diarrhea?
"That one is an apple and the other is an orange. They both want to eat it, so what can I do? Just open it and give it to them.
Why do we still feel distressed when the child eats something? "Xu Chenghou glanced at his wife and muttered in a low voice.
The two babies were very happy when they were eating, but now they felt overwhelmed, so one hugged the grandfather's neck, and the other ran to find the grandma to hug, neither wanting to move lazily.
Seeing this, the old couple stopped arguing, each holding their children to coax them, and letting them go for a walk to digest food.
The two children had to eat canned food to support themselves, so Xu Shiyan couldn't help but go home right away.
Even if he said it, Xu Chenghou would never let them go at this time. He was afraid that the couple would go home and beat the child, so he coaxed the two children to play on the ground.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to sit on the edge of the Kang and look at the blooming Clivia on the south window sill.
Yellow, red, orange, red with yellow, yellow with red, really are all kinds of colors and shapes, competing for beauty.
Xu Shiqin's ability to raise Clivia is really not bragging, this flower makes her raise it so beautifully.
"Unfortunately, I remembered it too late. If I remembered this earlier, all of them would grow up and bloom, and I could sell them for a lot of money."
Xu Shiyan looked at those flowers and muttered with regret.
Nowadays, all the seedlings on the market are small seedlings, which are cheap, but unfortunately they won't grow very big, and they won't be able to bloom after two years.
Not to mention those seeds, when the time comes, the seedlings with only a few leaves can be sold for tens of dollars.

chapters.title: Chapter 256: busy year
chapters.content:
Chapter 256 Busy Years
Xu Shiyan's family stayed here until 7:30, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping's brother and sister were both sleepy, so Xu Chenghou let them go.
Before leaving the house, Xu Chenghou whispered to his son and daughter-in-law not to hit the children.
Children, it’s normal to be greedy. The two children also suffered today.
Made Xu Shiyan speechless, led the children home, and scolded the two children with a straight face.
The girl is timid, and she shed tears after being scolded by her father. Xu Haiyuan is probably also afraid, so she stood there obediently and did not dare to speak up.
After Xu Shiyan trained the children, he asked the two children to relieve themselves quickly, lest they really pee on the bed at night.
After the two babies came back after peeing, they took off their clothes and got into the bed, and fell asleep after a while.
At eleven o'clock, Su Anying even specially asked the two children to get up and pee, but both said they didn't pee.
It turned out that just after twelve o'clock, Xu Haiyuan crawled out of his bed and stabbed Xu Shiyan. "Dad, I peed on the kang."
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard this, he quickly turned on the light, and then saw that his son's quilt was all wet. It's a big splash of urine.
Before Xu Shiyan could say anything, the girl over there also got up, "Dad, I want to pee."
Xu Shiyan didn't say a word, picked up his daughter and ran to the outside room. The son's bed can only be handed over to his daughter-in-law.
When Xu Shiyan came back with his daughter in his arms, Su Anying had already pulled out the quilt that her son had peed on and threw it aside, and put another quilt on it.
"I wonder if you two will dare to eat so much canned food in the future? There are not many things to eat.
Xu Haiyuan, you are only six years old, and you still pee on the kang, is it embarrassing? "
While cleaning up her son, Su Anying deliberately buried her son.
Xu Haiyuan is a very shameless child. When his mother said so, his little face couldn't hold back anymore, and he was about to cry with his mouth puckered.
"Do you dare to cry tonight? Believe it or not?"
Su Anying stared, frightened Xu Haiyuan to hold back tears.
"Okay, okay, don't make them cry in the middle of the night.
The key is that there are still two younger ones. If you wake them up, you won't have to sleep tonight. "
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to be a peacemaker, holding his daughter and son in his arms, coaxing them to sleep.
"Dad, I won't eat so much again." Xu Haiyuan murmured while lying in his father's arms with his eyes closed.
This child has a very strong self-esteem. He can really remember such a shameful thing for many years when he wets the bed at such an age and is scolded by his mother.
"Well, well, go to sleep, go to sleep, there are still things at home to be busy tomorrow, you have to help Dad with work."
Xu Shiyan patted his son on the back, coaxing him to sleep.
After the new year, every household started to get busy.
Sweeping the house on the 24th, Xu Shiyan took his son, tied the new broom to a stick, and lifted it up to sweep the dust on the wall.
Xu Haiyuan is so young, his arms are sore when he lifts it up for a while.
But this baby is stubborn, his arms are sore and he doesn't stop, he grits his teeth and continues, until he is so tired that he can't even lift his arms.
Twenty-five pasted windows.
The windows of Xu's house are double-layered. At the beginning of winter, Su Anying cut strips of newspaper and pasted the window seams. At this time, there is no need to paste it again.
So today, I made tofu at home.
Su Anying soaked some soybeans in advance, and asked Xu Shiyan to go to the mill to push the water mill early in the morning on the 25th day.
When Xu Shiyan came back from pushing the mill, the old couple and Xu Shiqin also came over. They quickly poured the bean foam into the pot and brought it to a boil.
Xu Chenghou is the best at making tofu. Don't look at him before, he knows a lot of crafts.
The boiled bean foam is wrapped, and the soy milk is filtered out to save some tofu. The bean dregs can be fed to pigs.
Xu Chenghou scooped out a spoonful of soy milk, and asked Su Anying to find something to pack, put some sugar, and give it to Xu Haiyuan and his sister.
This time, the two brothers and sisters learned their lesson, no matter how good the drink was, they didn’t drink too much. Each of them drank a small bowl, and Xu Shiqin picked up the bottom.
Scoop out some more, put some plaster on it and let it stand, and it will become tofu brain.
Cook a marinade for a while, then get some pickles, pancakes, etc., and breakfast will be ready.
The tofu here is made with brine.
It is said that tofu is ordered in brine, and one thing is one thing. Sure enough, as soon as the brine was stirred in, the soy milk turned into flocs.
In a wooden square plate with eyes that can leak water, a coarse cloth is laid, and then the flocs that have been bitten with brine are scooped in.
Fill it and cover it with a cloth, then cover it with a wooden plank, and put a stone on it.
Wait until the moisture inside is almost controlled, the tofu is formed, and then just pull it out.
Over there, Su Anying baked green onion pancakes in another pan, and used a horse ladle to marinate them on the stove.
Put the ordered tofu nao into a bowl, put some chopped green onion, pickles and so on.
Scoop a spoonful of marinade, and serve the burnt scallion pancakes. This morning meal is not to mention how delicious it is.
After breakfast, it happened that the tofu was almost ready, so Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan worked together to put the tofu on another square plate.
Bai Shengsheng's trembling tofu looks particularly appetizing.
Xu Chenghou took a knife and divided the tofu into large pieces.
"Let's keep half of it for ourselves. You can send some to the Han family, and then give some to the master of the sixth child. It's the Chinese New Year, that's what it means."
Make tofu during the Chinese New Year, and relatives and friends will get some points at home.
Donggang is a rural area, and many people would make a pack of tofu for Chinese New Year.
Sanchang and Songjianghe are no good. They are both workers. They don’t farm their own land, so they can’t make tofu without beans.
That's why Xu Chenghou said, send some from house to house.
I keep these at home, some of them are pulled out with cold water, put in a cool place, and can be eaten slowly for a few days.
The other part, simply cut into small pieces, and put it outside to freeze into lumps of frozen tofu.
After the tofu is frozen, it is full of small eyes, and the stewed Chinese cabbage is left. The frozen tofu absorbs the taste of the soup and is extra delicious.
Xu Shiyan put a few pieces of tofu in a basin, first gave it to the Han family, and then gave some to Master Qin and Guo Shouye.
Master Qin was very happy to see Xu Shiyan, and told Xu Shiyan to let Xu Shiqin go for a while.
The money for the medical subsidy came down, and Xu Shiqin had to come over and sign to receive it.
Xu Shiyan thanked Master Qin before riding home.
Twenty-five to make tofu, twenty-six to kill pigs.
This year, Xu Shiyan didn't raise pigs. Su Anying lived on the mountain for half a year, and then came back to have a baby. How can she have the time to raise pigs?
Zhou Guilan, on the other hand, caught two piglets at the beginning of spring, which was pretty good.
After raising it for a year, it weighs less than 200 catties. It happened to kill one for the New Year, and save the other for spring.
When everyone comes to help butcher pigs at home, it must be a treat, and authentic pig-killing dishes must be available.
The people who helped these people ate deliciously, but in the end they drank all of them staggeringly.
On the twenty-seventh day, Xu Shiyan caught two sheep from the farm and came back to kill them.
The ewes in the breeding farm keep the milk they produce to make milk tofu to feed the sables, and the rams can only eat meat when they grow up.
Now that life is better, two sheep are killed during the Chinese New Year and eaten in different ways.
When it was twenty-eight, steamed buns began.
Zhou Guilan showed off her unique skills, steaming several pots of various jujube steamed buns.
He stared straight at Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, brothers and sisters. He had never seen so many jujube steamed buns before, they were so beautiful.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: Lunar New Year's eve
chapters.content:
Chapter 257 New Year's Eve
Busy and busy, it's New Year's Eve.
Xu Shiyan and his wife are very busy with their four children.
That's why Xu Chenghou said that this year the two families will celebrate the New Year together, which is lively and convenient.
Thirty This morning, Xu Shiyan cleaned up his yard, erected lantern poles, and hung red lanterns.
Pasted the couplets and blessings outside, and after tidying up, I went back to my parents to celebrate the new year with Su Anying and the four children.
Now that the days are better, Zhou Guilan must prepare more delicious food.
From about ten o'clock in the morning, Zhou Guilan led her daughter and daughter-in-law to work in the kitchen, frying the same delicious food.
The aroma wafted into the room, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, who were greedy, drooled and looked into the kitchen.
"Two little greedy cats, then, let's eat it, don't eat too much, there are still a lot of dishes."
Zhou Guilan brought a bowl of freshly fried meatballs, dried fruits, and crispy twists, and asked Xu Haiyuan to take them to the house to eat, saving them from being greedy here.
The two children happily went back to the house to eat with their bowls in hand.
The two of them ate, and the two young ones became greedy when they saw it, and screamed.
Thanks to Xu Shiqin watching, Xu Haiyuan almost handed the ball to his younger brother.
"No, they are too young to chew these fried things, you two eat it, I will steam egg cakes for them.
Remember, you must not feed them anything else. "
Xu Shiqin watched his nephew and niece eat all the delicious things in the bowl, and then he was relieved, and went to the kitchen to make steamed chicken cakes for the two little ones.
After three o’clock in the afternoon, the meals are ready, and the Kang table is placed on the Kang table in the east room, and the whole family sits around the table and have a reunion dinner.
At night, Xu Chenghou coaxed the children, and the others made dumplings. At 11:30 in the evening, there were firecrackers going off outside one after another.
Xu Chenghou called his sleeping grandchildren to go out and set off firecrackers.
As soon as Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping heard that the firecrackers were going to be set off, Jilu got up immediately, dressed and went out with grandpa and father.
In the past two years, no matter what, some old rules have risen again.
Before setting off the dumplings and setting off firecrackers, Zhou Guilan will set up a heaven and earth table in the yard, and on the table are some offerings such as steamed buns, chicken, fish, meat, and wine.
Wait for the water in the pot to boil, and before the dumplings were cooked, Xu Chenghou led his children and grandchildren out, lit three incense sticks and put them in the bowl filled with corn noodles.
At this time, it is not easy to find an incense burner bowl. Most of them use two bowls to fill a bowl of corn noodles, which is really successful.
Waiting for it to be used up, the corn noodles can still be fed to pigs and chickens without delay.
Xu Chenghou lighted incense and handed out papers, and Xu Shiyan lit a 500-gun firecracker over there.
After the firecrackers were set off, Xu Chenghou led his children and grandchildren to kneel and kowtow in front of the Tiandi table, sincerely praying for a safe and smooth new year and all the best.
After distributing the paper, they kowtowed, and then, the father and son turned on the coaxing mode.
There are more kinds of firecrackers on the market this year, besides ordinary firecrackers and Ertijiao, there are other tricks.
What are flashing thunder, colorful pearls, diamond monkeys, and some small firecrackers that children like, such as small planes, small bees, everything.
In order to coax the children, Xu Shiyan bought tens of dollars worth of fireworks and came back with a basket, and now he took them all out and lit them one by one.
The flash thunder is a bit like the colorful pearl. They fly out one by one and explode in the sky.
Flash Thunder will explode and make a loud noise, but Color Pearl doesn’t make much noise, and it looks better when it explodes.
The two little babies looked up at the beautiful fireworks of various colors blooming in the dark night sky, jumping up and down happily and clapping their hands.
Xu Shiyan and Xu Chenghou saw that the children were so happy, and they became more and more energetic.
If Zhou Guilan hadn't cooked the dumplings and told them to go back to eat dumplings, the couple would probably still be able to continue.
"Let's go home and eat dumplings first, and let's come out to release them after dinner."
Xu Chenghou looked at the ones left in the basket, they might not be able to put them all in a while, so let's eat first.
The two babies spent a lot of time outside. It was quite cold outside at night, and their little faces were flushed from the cold, but they didn't care.
The two children were addicted to watching fireworks. When they heard that they were going to eat in the house, they all turned their heads reluctantly.
"Dad, how about some more?" Xu Jinping tugged at the corner of Xu Shiyan's clothes to discuss.
"Hey, let's go into the house to warm up. After a while, when we are full, Dad will take you out to let us go.
Look, there are still these in the basket, we will put them away later. "Xu Shiyan picked up his daughter and coaxed the little girl back to the house.
Xu Jinping was delighted when she heard that the fireworks would come out later. She hugged her father's neck and happily followed her father and grandpa into the house.
The kang table is still outside, so I can only stand aside.
The side stand is actually a table, and the legs at the bottom can be folded, folded up when not in use, and placed against the wall, so the locals call it the side stand.
There are six or seven plates of dumplings on the table, a bowl of garlic sauce in the middle, a bottle of vinegar and a bottle of sesame oil next to it.
In front of everyone, there are small plates and chopsticks.
Seeing that Xu Chenghou and his son came back with their children, Zhou Guilan invited them to eat dumplings together.
"Come on, sit down, let's eat dumplings."
The table was placed next to the edge of the Kang, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping were arranged on the edge of the Kang. The two children were small, so it was just right for them to sit on the edge of the Kang.
Zhou Guilan put four or five dumplings into small bowls for each of them, and poured soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil into their small dishes.
The two children went to bed tonight and didn't eat much. They are a little hungry now.
The delicious hot dumplings were right in front of them. Both children were hungry, so they didn't care about them, so they quickly grabbed them and ate them.
Xu Jinping was still young, and it was a bit difficult to hold the dumplings with the chopsticks, so she simply did it directly.
Adults don’t care if they see it, let them do it, as long as the children are willing to eat it.
"Yes, it's delicious. Grandma packed the dumplings with money, peanuts, red dates, and sugar. Let's see what you can eat."
Zhou Guilan sat beside the two children, coaxing them to eat.
The two little ones fell asleep, and they didn’t wake up when the firecrackers were set off outside. Just in time, everyone can have a meal with peace of mind.
The dumplings on New Year’s Eve are filled with things for the sake of flattery, most of which are filled with money and sugar.
Of course, some people are uneasy and kind.
There used to be a mother-in-law who wrapped a small piece of charcoal in the dumplings on New Year’s Eve, and said as she wrapped them, to see who is unscrupulous in the family, and whoever is unscrupulous can eat them.
When she said this, the mother-in-law stared at the eldest daughter-in-law, implying that the daughter-in-law had a dark heart.
As a result, when the dumplings were boiled and eaten, the charcoal-wrapped dumplings were eaten by the youngest son of the family.
The youngest son who was angry turned black at the time, and lost his temper with his mother.
Zhou Guilan doesn't have those bad intentions. If you want to celebrate the New Year, no one will find that uncomfortable.
No matter who eats what, the big guys will say all kinds of good words and wish them well. For Chinese New Year, the picture is this celebration.
Not to mention, most of the money was eaten by Xu Shiyan and Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiqin also ate jujubes, peanuts, etc. Everyone said that Xu Shiqin will have good luck in the coming year.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Ruixue
chapters.content:
Chapter 258 Ruixue
The family happily finished eating the dumplings for New Year's Eve, and before they could clean up, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping pestered Xu Shiyan and had to go out to put flowers.
"Go, take the kids out to play.
It’s Chinese New Year, isn’t it just like a child? There are still so many in the basket, let's go. "
Xu Chenghou was happy, put on his hat and coat, and went out with a basket in his hand.
The two little ones were also dressed neatly, and followed happily.
Xu Shiyan was worried, so he had to follow him out.
As soon as I went out of the house, I found that it was snowing outside.
Flying snowflakes, flying all over the sky with the wind, falling lightly and skillfully, a thin layer of snow on the ground.
"Yo, it's snowing. Good, good, the auspicious snow is a good sign for a good year." Seeing Xu Chenghou, he said a few good words.
The kids didn’t know Ruixue, but the grandpa said yes, and the two children just clapped their hands and jumped there, shouting yes.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing when he saw this scene.
How good is it? The new year is snowy, the world is peaceful, the old and the young are happy, and the whole country celebrates.
Just in time, Su Anying and Xu Shiqin also came out.
Xu Shiqin was very playful for a while, and played with his nephews and nieces with the ground muscles, that is, fireworks sticks.
Su Anying stood beside Xu Shiyan, watching with a smile on the faces of three generations of people, old and young, playing in the snow.
"How wonderful, it feels like this year is particularly lively." Su Anying couldn't help muttering.
"The two children can play now, the younger sister's body has also recovered, and our father is not as gloomy as before.
That's great, it would be great if it was like this every year in the future. "
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand and put his arms around his wife's shoulders, "I hope to see this scene every year, and live up to my youth and youth."
Xu Shiyan couldn't remember where he saw it, and he didn't care what happened or what happened, so he just said something casually.
"Huh? What are you talking about?" Su Anying didn't understand, and turned to look at her husband.
"It's nothing, I mean, it will be more lively in the future.
After two years of waiting, the two little ones in the house also grew up. When the four children ran all over the yard, they would probably be flying like cats and dogs, and there would be no peace. "
When Xu Shiyan thought of that scene, he found it very interesting.
How wonderful, the four children in this life, if there is a little trouble, this is what life looks like.
"Dad, come on, help us put this away."
Xu Jinping lost the tendons in her hands, just in time to see her parents talking, so she hurried over and dragged her father to set off the fireworks.
Finally, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan set off all the fireworks in the basket, and the two little guys followed the adults into the house with a lot of desire.
It was getting late, it was time to rest, and everyone didn't lay down bedding, so they just slept with their clothes on.
On the first day of the Lunar New Year, everyone is full of joy. Every family goes out to pay New Year’s greetings. When they meet acquaintances on the road, they all want to say Happy New Year.
Neighbors and neighbors also visit each other and pay New Year's greetings to each other.
Xu and Han are in-laws, so they must go to visit. Xu Shiyan accompanied his sister to Han's house to pay New Year's greetings to Han Wenzhong and his wife.
When Han Wenzhong and his wife met Xu Shiqin, they were naturally very happy. Mrs. Li also specially prepared a red envelope for Xu Shiqin, and stuffed it into Xu Shiqin's hands.
"If Liwei was at home, you should be celebrating the New Year here this year.
It is customary for a mother-in-law to give a red envelope to a new daughter-in-law. Ask your elder sister-in-law and second sister-in-law, do they all have them? "
Xu Shiqin had no choice but to accept the red envelope, and the Han family warmly persuaded them to stay, and the siblings also had a meal at the Han family.
On the other side, Yang Junxian and his wife took their son Yang Haoyu to Xu's house to pay New Year greetings to Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan.
The old couple are naturally very enthusiastic about the dry relationship of the third son's family.
Not only took out delicious dried fruit snacks to entertain Yang Haoyu, but also prepared meals, so they had to stay for dinner.
Su Anying and the children didn't go back to their home, and it happened that the children got together to play together.
Winter is cold, Yang Haoyu is weaker and doesn't go out very much, so he hasn't seen the Xu family children for some days.
Especially the two young ones, they have changed a lot, which amazed Yang Haoyu even more.
"The two of them can sit by themselves, wow, that's great."
I don’t know who I learned from, and all the children would say wow, how so.
"Qingqing, Huihui, this is your third brother, do you remember? In the future, if something happens, if you can't find your eldest brother, you will find your third brother."
Zhou Guilan hugged Xu Haiqing with one hand, and Yang Haoyu with the other, and said to the two young ones.
The children of the Xu family no longer have nicknames, but follow their first names.
As for the third brother, he was naturally talking about Yang Haoyu.
Yang Haoyu was born prematurely and was weak. When he was a child, he was always sick and sick, and his family said he couldn't support him.
Someone came up with an idea, saying that they wanted to find a god-in-law, especially a person who was blessed with both children, and maybe they were brought along.
So, when Yang Haoyu was one year old, he recognized Xu Shiyan and his wife as godfather and godmother.
Not to mention, since he recognized his god-in-law, Yang Haoyu has gotten better day by day, and he is no longer suffering from illnesses all day long, suffering from colds and fevers at every turn.
Although the body is still weak, it is much stronger than before.
This is a god-in-law recognized by the son, and Yang Haoyu is a child of the Xu family, so he must follow the Xu family's ranking.
That's why Zhou Guilan said that Yang Haoyu is the third brother of Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui.
"Yes, yes, when you grow up, if there is something you can't solve, ask your third brother for help."
Ji Yufeng held Xu Jinhui in her arms, and laughed when she heard that.
"That's great, our family, Xiaoyu, now we have four brothers and sisters. If there is anything going on in the future, these five will go together."
Ji Yufeng used to regret not being able to have a baby to keep her son company, and now she doesn't want that anymore.
Brothers don't get along well, maybe they can't catch up with friends.
The Yang family has a close relationship with the Xu family. The children grew up together, and they have a deep relationship. They are also companions, no worse than brothers.
"Xiaoyu, remember, these are your younger siblings. If anyone bullies them in the future, that's not acceptable."
On the other end, Yang Junxian did not forget to tell his son.
Although Yang Haoyu is young, he is very sensible and obedient, and he keeps his parents' words firmly in his heart.
"Well, I see, I have older brothers and sisters, and younger brothers and sisters, no one can try to bully us."
The little boy was proud when he talked about his older brothers and sisters.
"Xiaoyu, let's go, let's go out and find Brother Shuqing and Brother Sun Yu to put the sledge down together."
Children these days are skinny and wild-hearted, and they rarely want to stay at home.
Xu Haiyuan didn't go out to play these few days, and was tired of staying at home. Just when Yang Haoyu came, he dragged Yang Haoyu out together.
Yang Haoyu glanced at his parents, "Mom, can I go play with Brother Yuanyuan?"
"Go, it's fine, just get dressed." Seeing his son's longing eyes, how could Ji Yufeng have the heart to refuse?
So he asked his son to put on his coat and hat, and then covered the scarf tightly, and followed Xu Haiyuan and the others to go out with the sledge.
As soon as Xu Haiyuan went out, he started beckoning friends just like Sun Houzi untied the seal.
Not long after, Huang Shengli's eldest son Huang Shuqing, daughter Huang Shuyun, youngest son Huang Shuping, Sun Xiaofeng's son Sun Yu, daughter Sun Ning, and Feng Chao's son Feng Bin.
A group of children were dragging the sledge, shouting and laughing, running wildly on the street.
Just find a sloping road, sit on the sledge and slide down, don't mention how happy you are.

chapters.title: Chapter 259: wrong
chapters.content:
Chapter 259 is wrong
The second day of the Lunar New Year is the day when the Xu family brothers reunite.
Before nine o'clock in the morning, Xu Shi'an and his wife came back first with their son. After a while, Xu Shixian, Xu Shide, and Xu Shixiang's family came in together.
It turned out that Xu Shide brought his wife and children to the county last night, and they lived at Xu Shixian's house. This morning, they drove back from the county together.
The bus they took happened to pass by the Xinglong Commune. When they arrived in Xinglong, Xu Shixiang and his wife got on the bus with their daughter in their arms. The three families took the bus to Songjiang River and then went to Donggang.
"Dad, Mom, we are back.
Oh, I was really busy years ago, and the leaders of the unit held meetings all day long, so they had to find me for many manuscripts.
I received a phone call from home that day, and I wanted to ask for leave to come back, but the leader just refused to give me the leave. There was really no way. "Xu Shi entered the door and explained quickly.
"Isn't it? The New Year is approaching, the county has a joint security operation, and our commune is also extremely busy, with meetings every day."
Xu Shixiang was seconded as a public security assistant from the civil affairs assistant, and now he is wearing a uniform, which is quite energetic.
"Well, our commune is also busy with year-end summarization and accounting.
If you don't say that serving people's bowls is under the control of others, it is not false at all.
Going to the shift, I'm dead body, I have to work hard to do anything, and the leader may not approve or not to ask for leave. "
On the other side, Xu Shide also looked helpless. He is now seconded to Daying Commune as an accountant and no longer teaches.
When the three brothers entered the door, they didn't say anything, and explained why they didn't come back before.
Hearing this, Xu Chenghou just snorted and didn't answer.
Zhou Guilan saw it and knew that her husband was feeling uncomfortable, so she could only cough softly, and stretched out her hand to tug at Xu Chenghou's skirt.
No matter what happens, the children are back on the second day of the Lunar New Year. They just walked in, so don’t be too stiff.
"I know you are all busy. If you have a job, you are like this. You are not free. It's okay, come and sit down."
Xu Chenghou remained silent, Zhou Guilan had no choice but to smile and beckon his son and daughter-in-law to come in and sit down.
"Hey, where are the third couple and the sixth? What are you doing? They're not here?"
Everyone sat down, only to find that Xu Shiyan, Xu Shiyan, and Xu Shiqin were not there.
When they came back at this time in previous years, the third daughter-in-law was busy in the kitchen, why didn't they see anyone today?
"Oh, Lao Liu has gone to her master.
Didn’t you go to Han’s house to pay New Year’s greetings yesterday, did you stay for dinner? There is no time to see her master.
Go to Master Qin’s place to pay New Year’s greetings early today, and I’ll be back later. "
"The youngest couple will be here soon. They are busy taking care of the four children. They are probably cleaning up right now."
Seeing that her husband didn't speak, Zhou Guilan could only speak.
At this moment, the Xu Shixian brothers all sensed that something was wrong.
When they came back during the Chinese New Year, the father didn't even have a smiling face, the mother didn't arrange food in the kitchen, and the younger sister and the third family were not there.
This doesn’t look right.
"Father, mother, um, is there something wrong?"
Xu Shixian hesitated for a moment, and asked tentatively.
Xu Chenghou raised his eyelids to look at his son, took out the cigarette bag and pot, and knocked on the edge of the kang twice.
"Well, I have something to tell you."
Nonsense, he deliberately sent the old girl away today, and asked Zhao Jianshe to go to the third son's house, blocking the third son and his wife from going out for a while, just to settle accounts with these bastards.
"Well, the sixth child went to the provincial capital for medical treatment. Even the materials, surgery, and medical expenses were all included, and the total cost was 3,500 to 600 yuan.
A few days ago, the unit gave some medical subsidies, which can be seven or eight hundred yuan.
Let’s see how to calculate the rest of the money. "
Xu Chenghou didn't care about that anymore, he loaded a bag of cigarettes and lit it, took two puffs, and looked up at his four sons.
Originally, the old couple had discussed that they would pay for the daughter’s medical treatment, instead of the son.
The sons all started their own families and started their own businesses. They have their own homes and lives to live, and it is not easy to give money and food to their parents every month.
Their old couple doesn't have much expenses now, Xu Chenghou can still earn money, and the old couple are both in good shape, so they don't want to cause too much trouble to their sons.
The old couple thought of their son wholeheartedly, what happened?
Xu Shiqin came back from the provincial capital for more than 20 days, except for Xu Shian and his wife who were here on the day of returning home, the rest of them didn't face each other.
Their own sister went out to have an operation for treatment, and when she came back, she called them specifically to tell them, but no one came back to take a look.
Xu Chenghou had been angry a long time ago, but he kept holding back his anger.
Looking at the Chinese New Year, it's not good to make a fuss.
Especially in front of the young couple, Xu Chenghou couldn't get angry.
The youngest couple really have nothing to say to the family, no matter how stupid Xu Chenghou is, he can tell the difference between good and bad.
The old Chinese New Year didn't want the third son to worry too much, so he kept holding back.
Right now, the old man really couldn't hold back anymore.
None of these **** are good, they are all white-eyed wolves.
"For the more than three thousand yuan, the sixth child saved one thousand, and my mother and I borrowed the rest.
The money returned from medical subsidies paid off part of the famine.
There is still the rest, you guys have a look, how to pay this money, I have to pay back the money. "
Xu Chenghou is an old man, so he wouldn't say that he and Xu Shiyan paid the money.
If you say that, these sons will have an excuse.
He only said that it was borrowed from outside, and the famine was caused, so it depends on what his sons say.
"As for the third child, he accompanied the sixth child to the provincial capital and was busy taking care of him. If he was delayed, he would not make any money for two or three months.
It’s not easy for him, he doesn’t have a job, he has to work hard all day long to earn that little money, and it’s enough for him not to earn money for two or three months.
So, he will not be allowed to pay the money.
I don’t want too much for the four of you, just scrape together 1,600 yuan and I’ll pay back the famine outside. "
It’s not possible to let the son pay for all of them, but the old couple also have to get some.
Xu Chenghou spoke so impeccably that his four sons were dumbfounded.
Especially Xu Shixian, Xu Shide, and Xu Shixiang. The three of them discussed on the phone in advance.
I thought it was the New Year's Eve, and the house was so lively that my parents definitely couldn't mention these things.
Didn't realize it, this is the scene when I came back today.
"Father, my younger sister is going out to get medical treatment, we as elder brothers really should do our part."
As soon as Xu Shixian opened his mouth, he felt a pain in the side of his waist. Needless to say, his wife secretly pinched his lower back while no one was paying attention.
"Ahem, well, I was too busy at the time, so I didn't make time for it.
This matter has to be the third child. He does not go to work and is freer than us.
No matter what you say, I really have to thank the third child, he took it all by himself. "
Xu Shixian coughed twice, changed the subject directly, and didn't dare to talk about sharing.
"Fifth, say something." Xu Shixian really didn't know what to say, and turned to look at his younger brother.
"Father, mother, that little sister's medical treatment is serious business.
But I just bought a house, and I don’t have a lot of money. "
Xu Shixiang saw that the elder brother kicked the ball to him, and he couldn't express his opinion. After thinking about it, he could only say this.

chapters.title: Chapter 260: cry poor
chapters.content:
Chapter 260 Crying Poor
Xu Shixiang can also see that today, if the old man puts on this posture, if the brothers don't pull out a penny, it will definitely not work.
Four families pooled 1,600 yuan, and one family had to get 400 yuan.
Four hundred yuan is not a small amount to them, and everyone feels distressed when they take it out all at once.
So Xu Shixiang thought, cry poorly first, and see what the old man means, and if it doesn't work, just spend less.
"Yes, yes, Dad, you see we didn't bring so much money with us when we came back.
Well, this is half a year’s pension money, you should collect it first. "
On the other side of Xu Shide, he quickly took out the fifty yuan that he had prepared in advance, and put it in front of Xu Chenghou.
The old-age pension is eight yuan a month, and forty-eight yuan for six months, so let’s just pay fifty yuan.
The fourth child gave pension money, and the others hurriedly paid for it.
Xu Chenghou collected the money without further ado, "This is money for the elderly.
Don’t even try to fool me, tell me, can you help pay the sixth child’s medical treatment? "
"Father, we want to help, but you also have to understand our difficulties.
The few wages I earn at work are not enough to do anything. Qiuyan is giving the child to my mother-in-law to watch, and she will work in the fields to earn work points.
We don’t have much money for a month, and we have to give the family eight yuan plus food. We don’t have much money, so we can’t afford it. "
Xu Shide looked at it, and among the brothers, he and the second brother had a worse life.
Elder brother and sister-in-law both have jobs, and they have dual careers. Their lives are definitely not bad.
The fifth daughter-in-law also joined the Xinglong Commune as a broadcaster a while ago, and the couple both earn wages.
Ever since the brothers entered the door, the second child didn't say a word or anything, Xu Shide had no choice but to speak first.
"Father, it's not that we don't want to give this matter, it's true that we don't have it."
Xu Shide spoke, and Xu Shixian continued.
"Yes, Dad, don't look at Linzi and I both work in the county, in fact Linzi's salary is not as good as in Songjianghe, and there is no forest subsidy.
My three children are all studying, and they really can't open a little bit. "
Who is easy in this year? Don't we all live a tight life?
Double employment sounds good, but living in the city costs money everywhere, and you have to buy everything.
This is relying on the few articles he can write every month, a little manuscript fee or something, and life is better.
But he also felt distressed if he was asked to take out several hundred at once.
Four brothers, except for the second who didn't say a word, those few were crying poor.
Hearing what the brothers said, Wei Mingrong couldn't help it, and opened his mouth to cry poorly.
No one else wants to pay, so why should she take it out?
Before Wei Mingrong could speak, Xu Shian quickly tugged on Wei Mingrong's sleeve, and shook his head towards Wei Mingrong.
Wei Mingrong didn't understand what her husband meant, so he glared at him, while Xu Shian kept winking at Wei Mingrong.
The couple didn't speak, and their eyes have already fought several lawsuits.
Xu Chenghou sat on the kang, and he could clearly see the small movements of his sons and daughters-in-law.
The old man snorted in his heart, look, everyone, as long as money is mentioned, they all change their appearance, right?
"Then what do you mean, that you don't want to pay?"
The old man smoked a bag of cigarettes, knocked the pot of the cigarette bag on the edge of the kang, and knocked out the soot inside.
Then he threw the cigarette bag into the basket on the kang, and looked up at his sons.
"Father, it's not that we don't want to come out, it's because we really don't have money in our hands, and we don't have the strength to do it." The three brothers said in unison.
Xu Chenghou nodded, "Okay, if you can't take it out, I can't force you to take it out.
Come on, let’s do it like this, don’t blame you, blame your father for not being able to save gold or silver or something. "
The old man's words sounded unpleasant, and his heart was sad, and only he knew it.
"Old woman, have you prepared all the meals? No matter what happens when the children come back, we have to take care of the reunion dinner."
Xu Chenghou didn't lose his temper, so he turned to ask Zhou Guilan.
"The meat and vegetables are prepared, but I haven't cooked them yet. Look, I haven't been idle all morning."
Zhou Guilan replied.
"Such a large family is counting on me as an old woman for dinner? I am old with old arms and legs, but I don't have that ability."
Zhou Guilan was also angry, and what she said was tingly.
Xu Shixian listened to it a few times, but still don’t understand? Quickly stabbed his wife.
"Come on, let's cook."
The daughters-in-law also understood now that this is the old couple deliberately cleaning them up today.
Okay, so what else, let’s cook.
When these people come back, they can’t just talk about it. Just do the work when it’s time to work, and don’t make your parents-in-law unhappy.
Just like that, the daughters-in-law quickly changed their clothes, washed their hands and went to the kitchen to cook.
Fortunately, Zhou Guilan prepared quite a lot of food, including everything. Several people discussed the menu and got busy.
On the other side, Xu Shiyan was in a hurry.
Today is a big day for the Xu family to reunite. It's almost twelve o'clock, and they haven't passed yet.
At this moment, it is estimated that those few houses should arrive, but Zhao Jianshe and the others on his side are chatting around.
Xu Shiyan couldn't open his mouth to drive people away, so he could only chat patiently with Zhao Jianshe and the others.
Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli got Xu Chenghou's instruction, and they sat at Xu Shiyan's place until after twelve o'clock, and then they said that they had something to do, and they left.
Xu Shiyan sent his brothers away, hurried back to the house, picked up Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui with his wife, led the two older ones out, locked the door and went straight to his parents.
As soon as the family of six entered the yard, they saw Xu Haibo and Xu Jinfeng playing in the yard.
When the children saw Xu Shiyan and his wife, they hurried over to pay New Year's greetings, "Happy New Year, Third Uncle, and Happy New Year, Third Aunt." The children
"Hey, good, good, all good."
Xu Shiyan nodded, as a greeting to his nephews, and then carried the child into the house.
As soon as I entered the east room, I saw the brothers sitting in the room, not knowing what to talk about, it was very lively.
Xu Shiyan and his wife greeted the brothers one by one, put the child on the kang, and unwrapped the quilt.
"Father, we came late, they went to play in Jianshe and Shengli just now, and they chatted a little longer."
Xu Shiyan was worried that his father would be unhappy, so he had to explain a few sentences.
"Well, it's okay, the two of you have four children, and you are busy enough. It doesn't matter, your eldest brother and the others just arrived not long ago."
The old man is clear in his heart, so naturally he won't blame his son.
Su Anying put the child on the kang, took off the hat for the child, and took off the big cotton jacket outside.
"Shi Yan, you look at the child, I'm going to the kitchen."
Su Anying felt that she came late, and the sisters-in-law were all busy in the kitchen, so she felt a little sorry.
"Yingzi, you sit here. Where are the two children? Who can coax the two children when they start arguing? The clumsy third child can coax the children?
You just leave it here, why, without you, this meal can’t be finished? "
Just as Su Anying turned to go out, Xu Chenghou spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 261: caution
chapters.content:
Chapter 261 Admonishment
Su Anying has a sincere heart, and feels that it is rare for her elder brother, sister-in-law, and younger siblings to come back.
My sisters-in-law are all busy in the kitchen, and it’s shameless for her to do nothing, so she rushes to work in the kitchen.
As soon as Xu Chenghou said this, Su Anying froze there. The father-in-law's words today seemed to be in a bad taste, what's wrong?
Su Anying turned her head to look at Xu Shiyan, who was also in a daze.
"My father told you to coax the child, so you can stay here to coax the child.
These two have been making a fuss this morning. I really don't understand if you're not in this room. "
Don't worry about what's going on, since Dad has spoken, he has to listen.
Xu Shiyan didn't want his wife to be too tired, so he simply followed the old man's words and stayed.
Su Anying saw that her mother-in-law was also sitting on the kang, and her heart began to worry, something seemed wrong today.
Yes, be obedient and stay in the room honestly.
Just like that, Su Anying stayed in the east room to coax the children, while the four sisters-in-law were busy in the kitchen.
It was busy until about two o'clock, and all the meals were out of the pot, so the east room set up the table and called the children to come back for dinner.
Coincidentally, Xu Shiqin, who had been out all morning, also came back now.
Xu Shixian waited for others to see that the sixth younger sister had changed a lot. She was tall and confident, and she was so much taller than before, so she couldn't help but be amazed.
"Hey, old six, you have changed so much after this operation?
My God, if you don't look at the face, who would dare to recognize it? "
Except for Xu Shian and his wife, the others were all surprised, their jaws almost dropped.
Originally, everyone had some opinions about Xu Shiqin going to the provincial capital for surgery.
Isn’t it just a hunchback? No pain, no itching, no delay in work, why bother to have to suffer those crimes for surgery?
It is also understandable to say that it is easier to find a partner in the future when there is no date.
But Xu Shiqin already has a partner, why do he have to go for surgery?
It's so dangerous, you still suffer, and you have to spend a lot of money. Isn't it just looking for trouble?
But at this time, seeing the change of her sister as if she had been completely reborn, everyone changed their minds at once.
This has changed too much, where is the sixth younger sister from before?
Sure enough, money is not spent in vain, depending on the current appearance of the sixth child, it is worth how much money is spent.
Xu Shiqin greeted his brothers and sisters-in-law one by one.
"I went to the master's place this morning, who would have thought that all my master's apprentices would have passed by today.
A dozen or so people got together and chatted all over the place, until this point. "
Xu Shiqin has changed a lot now. Those who know her want to inquire about the operation. How can they let her go easily?
Those who ask this question and that question, aren’t they coming back late?
"It's okay, it's okay, come on, Sixth Sister, your body hasn't recovered yet, you should go to the kang to rest."
No matter what you say, they are also brothers and sisters. Xu Shixian still loves his sister, so let Xu Shiqin go to the kang to rest.
Xu Shiqin stayed at the master's house for a long time, and came back from walking, and was indeed tired, so he was not polite, and went directly to the kang to rest.
The meals are all set here, and the table starts just waiting for the parents to serve.
Xu Chenghou glanced at Xu Shiyan, "Third brother, help me, I have to go out and relieve myself."
The old man had something to say to his third son. It was inconvenient for everyone, so he made an excuse.
When the others heard this, they all came to help, but the old man waved his hand and didn't use it.
"It's okay, you guys are sitting, usually the third child supports me, I'm used to it."
When Xu Shiyan heard this, he felt that something was wrong.
Dad has a great physique, when did he help you?
"Dad, you slow down, put on your hat, and walk slowly."
Performing a full set of plays, Xu Shiyan carefully supported his father and went out of the house. The two of them came to the toilet in the garden.
"Third brother, remember a sentence, in front of those few people today, you are not allowed to mention the word Clivia, do you understand?"
Xu Chenghou let go of his son's hand, looked back at his son, and said solemnly and seriously.
"Huh?" Xu Shiyan was stunned, not understanding what his father meant.
"Ah what? Listen to what I say, and do whatever I tell you to do.
Remember, don't mention it, don't drink some wine and get lost, and talk to them about anything. "
The old man glared at the third son, this bear thing is also worrying every day, he is so stupid to death.
"Oh, oh. Got it, got it. Don't worry, dad, I won't mention it." Xu Shiyan recovered and nodded quickly.
To be honest, Xu Shiyan didn't plan to take the boss, the fourth child, and the fifth child with him.
Xu Shiyan thinks that all three of them have jobs, either in the commune or in the county.
It is not good for people in the public sector to participate in these matters. If someone stabs and sues them, they will lose their jobs or something.
It is really not worth it to lose the iron job in order to earn that few money.
As for the second child, Xu Shian, he works in a farm. Xu Shiyan probably couldn't hide it from him if he wanted to build a flower shed on the farm.
At that time, the second brother must be busy with the work. If he earns money, he will give it to the second brother. Outsiders can partner, and his brother can leave it behind?
But when the old man said this at this time, Xu Shiyan understood a little bit, and he probably provoked the old man again for some reason.
Come on, it wasn’t a big deal in the first place, so if you don’t mention it, don’t mention it, just right.
Received his son's assurance, Xu Chenghou was relieved, so he went in to relieve his hand, then Xu Shiyan supported his father, and went back to the house to wash his hands.
Everyone in the room was seated, and the reunion dinner officially began when Xu Chenghou and his son sat down.
Although Zhou Guilan didn't do anything, she prepared enough materials, so the lunch meal was still very rich, with several meat dishes.
Especially a dish of braised mutton, which is something that is not commonly seen, and everyone likes it.
Other confused chicken and bergamot cabbage are must-have traditional dishes of Dongwu every year.
Chicken stewed with mushrooms, braised pork ribs, sauerkraut vermicelli, etc., are also delicious.
It is rare for the children and grandchildren to come back, and everyone gathered together, but the atmosphere is very happy and harmonious.
Xu Chenghou and his sons poured wine and drank some.
"Come here, let's have a sip, and it's rare to see you all. It's Chinese New Year, and we men are very lively."
Xu Chenghou seemed to have completely forgotten the unpleasantness of the morning, and was very happy drinking with his sons with a smile.
It was nearly four o'clock in the meal. After the meal, Xue Xiuling's sisters-in-law went to clean up the table and the kitchen, and Xu Shixian and others got together to laugh and chat.
After a while, Xu Shian led his wife and children and left first.
They have been out for such a long time, and the house can't do without a fire.
Anyway, it was close, so I went back after walking, which was quite convenient.
At this time, there is no car back to the county, so the three families stayed and stayed for one night before taking the car back tomorrow morning.
No one lives in the west room, and there is no fire on weekdays. The people who can live are the east room and the second room, plus the west room.
Xu Chenghou discussed with Zhou Guilan, and they took Xu Shiqin to live at Xu Shiyan's side, just to help coax the children, and there happened to be three families living in three rooms here.
It also saves the discomfort of being crowded together. Anyway, there are many houses in the family, so I can live in them.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 262: don't take them
chapters.content:
Chapter 262 Don't take them
"Father, what do you mean by what you said today?"
Backing to his home, he hurriedly lit the fire first. After he was done with work, Xu Shiyan came up to his father and asked in puzzlement.
For the sake of his father's words, Xu Shiyan didn't drink a few sips of wine this afternoon, for fear that he would drink too much and say everything without knowing what to say.
Now that he is finally free, of course he has to ask.
"What do you mean? Heh heh, I'm afraid you, an idiot, are not talking about the door, so tell them about Clivia.
What does it mean? " Xu Chenghou snorted.
He had already seen through the virtues of those sons, but he still felt uncomfortable and panicked.
"Ah?" After that, Xu Shiyan felt that his brain was not enough, and he didn't understand what his father meant by this.
Over there, Zhou Guilan sighed, and told the behavior of the sons who came back in the morning, after Xu Chenghou said that they would share the medical expenses equally.
"You and Shiqin came back from the provincial capital, and we both found someone to call them.
My father and I originally thought, even if they don’t come back that day, why don’t they come back in a day or two?
That's their own sister. The operation is such a big deal. They didn't say they went to the provincial capital to help take care of her. Even after the operation, they didn't know how to bring something back to take a look?
Even if they don’t take anything, come back and take a look, your father and I have supported them for nothing. "
Speaking of this matter, Zhou Guilan was also full of resentment.
My sister is in trouble, and none of them are close to the front. Waiting for my parents to be in trouble, can I still count on them?
Zhou Guilan was really disappointed this time, so she especially supported Xu Chenghou's approach.
The mention of medical expenses today is actually a temptation.
If the four brothers agreed to pay without saying a word, Xu Chenghou must find some excuse not to want so much money from his son.
The total cost was 3,500 to 600 yuan, the old couple paid 1,000 yuan, Xu Shiqin paid 1,000 yuan, and the medical subsidy returned nearly 800 yuan.
There are still seven or eight hundred left, and the four brothers share it, and this matter will be resolved satisfactorily.
As a result, the brothers pushed back and forth, and they all left there crying poorly, and no one wanted to pay for it.
The more the old couple heard it, the more disappointed they became. This son was raised for nothing.
The matter of hundreds of dollars is so embarrassing and refuses to take it out. When the old couple is seriously ill in the future, can they count on these people?
That's why Xu Chenghou spoke and told Xu Shiyan not to mention Clivia in front of his brothers.
These **** are not willing to pay if they are asked to pay, and they will not be taken to make money in the future.
Although Xu Chenghou still had doubts about Clivia's ability to make money, he believed in his third son.
The old three made money from poking things, so even if Clivia can't make a lot of money, he can still make several times the money of Xu Shiqin's surgery.
To be honest, it’s a lot, thousands of dollars, how many people have seen it in this year?
This time, I won’t bring those bums with me. When they find out, I’ll regret it.
Let them play tricks one by one to make them appear smart, right? Okay, go smart, play with yourself if you have the ability.
After listening to what his parents said, Xu Shiyan finally understood what was going on. The co-authorship was because of his younger sister's surgery.
That’s right, what those brothers did was really not very authentic.
Xu Shiyan's operation was advocated by Xu Shiyan, so Xu Shiyan was always in charge.
The other brothers didn't understand and didn't help, and Xu Shiyan didn't blame them.
After all, the other few were not reborn. They didn't know how much the little sister would suffer when she got old, and they didn't see the little girl finally gasping for breath and suffocating to death with their own eyes.
However, after the operation, these few didn't even show their faces, which is indeed a bit too much.
This is my own sister, how can I not care at all?
Don't blame the old man for being angry, it's, it's time to clean them up.
Originally, Xu Shiyan and his younger sister had agreed that Xu Shiqin's treatment money would be paid from Xu Shiyan for the time being, and he would pay for it.
The original Clivia in the family, when the time comes, Xu Shiyan will find a way to sell them, no matter how much they sell, they will all belong to Xu Shiqin.
After deducting the money for medical treatment, all the rest will be left to Xu Shiqin as a dowry.
Han Liwei is in Shenyang now, and he doesn't know where he will be in the future. They are married, and Xu Shiqin will definitely follow him.
No matter where you are, you must have a home, and you can get a lot of money to build a home outside.
Xu Shiqin has money in his hands, and his waist is strong in his in-laws' family, so he can live without embarrassment.
As for the seedlings that started this year, they will not be given to Xu Shiqin if they sell for money in the future.
Those are all owned by the flower company, which is shared by Xu Shiyan, Zhao Jianshe and others.
For this part, Xu Shiyan will explain the matter clearly with a few brothers when he finds an opportunity after the Chinese New Year.
Responsibilities and rights are all clearly demarcated, and who owns how many shares must be clearly understood, which is the minimum.
Brotherhood is divided into love, and money is returned to money, which cannot be confused.
If the money is not clear, it will definitely be a trouble in the future, and even the brothers will not be able to do it if the trouble is not good.
From the very beginning, Xu Shiyan didn't plan to involve his brothers. He was still worried and didn't know how to explain it to his parents.
Unexpectedly, Mom and Dad found a good reason for him.
Come on, now that his parents have spoken, he will do everything according to his parents' orders, so don't blame him for those brothers in the future.
"Okay, I will follow my parents' orders on this matter, and I will do whatever you say."
Xu Shiyan nodded obediently, his parents had already spoken, and he happened to have no worries at all, so he just did what he should do, okay, that's really good.
Xu Chenghou chatted with his son for a while, it was getting late, everyone should rest.
So Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiqin lived in the inner room of the east room, and Xu Shiyan and his wife lived in the second room of the east room with their children.
The four children are having fun during the day.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping followed their brothers and sisters so crazy, they fell asleep when they lay down tired at night.
The two little ones slept for a while during the day when a group of people teased them.
So Su Anying fed them enough and put on clean pants, and the two fell asleep.
In the middle of the night, Su Anying coaxed her to urinate, and then continued to sleep until morning.
