New Year’s Eve in the morning on the third day of junior high school. At five o’clock, the old couple got up, packed up and went home, chopping vegetables and making bread and dumplings.
With the sound of jingling in the kitchen, can the people sleeping in the house be safe? Get up and work quickly one by one.
The big guys worked together, the dumplings were made quickly, and when the dumplings were cooked, a whip was placed outside, which was regarded as a New Year's greeting.
After eating the dumplings for the new year, it's time for everyone to go back.
At 7:30, there was a bus from Donggang to Fusong. Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang took this bus.
At 8:40, the train from Baihe to Tonghua passed Songjianghe, and Xu Shide's family took this train.
Xu Shiyan and his wife also had to take their children back to Daying Su’s house, so they happened to go together.
Still trouble Zhao Jianshe to drive the carriage, send Xu Shiyan and others to the station, then buy a ticket, check the ticket and get on the train.
After more than an hour, the train arrived at Xianrenqiao Station. Xu Shiyan and his wife each held a small one and led a big one, and got off the train carefully.
As soon as they got out of the station, they heard someone calling them, and then they saw that it was the Su family who came to pick them up.

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Su family reunion
chapters.content:
Chapter 263 Su family reunion
Xu Shiyan and his wife returned to Daying with their child in their arms, and everyone in the Su family greeted them with joy.
On the third day of the Lunar New Year, all the daughters who went out came back.
Qin Meiling and her husband Sui Hongzhi led their son and daughter, Sui Xiaoling and Sui Xiaojun.
Su Anzhen married nearby, in Daying, and Nan Zhendong lives in the west of the village, not too far from the Su family.
The eldest son of Su Anzhen's family, Nan Xiaoming, is one year younger than Xu Jinping, and the second child, Nan Xiaoliang, is less than one year old.
Su Anfen married to Shuanglong, her husband Ji Tongzhong, and their son Ji Hongliang was born in November.
It happened that Xu Shiyan was in the provincial capital at that time, and Su Anying took care of the two children and didn't have time to visit her sister.
Now, the Su family is bustling with six daughters, four uncles, and nine grandchildren.
Su Weizhong and his wife looked at the people in the room, and they couldn't close their mouths with joy.
Seeing the tiger-headed and tiger-headed appearance of grandchildren and granddaughters is also extremely rare. Hug this one and kiss that one, whichever one is good.
"Father, here is some mutton. The family killed two sheep a few years ago and brought half of them to the family.
These are the things I randomly scratched when I went out to the provincial capital.
We have four children, and we really can’t take too many things. "
The two younger ones put them on the kang, untied the quilt, took off the outer cotton jacket, took off their hats, and let them climb on the kang.
Xu Shiyan then freed up time to talk to his father-in-law.
Su Anying can only come back once a year or so, so she has to bring something home.
It is really not easy to go out now, holding the small one and leading the big one.
Fortunately, with Xu Shide and the others, Zhao Jianshe helped to hand it up when getting on the bus, and Xu Shide helped to carry some when getting off the bus, and the Su family came to pick it up at the station.
Otherwise, just pointing at Xu Shiyan and his wife, four children are enough for them, how can they have the ability to bring more things?
Xu Shiyan pointed to the woven bag, which contained mutton.
Then he took out a semiconductor radio from his back pocket, which was for Su Weizhong.
Nowadays, this thing is not so expensive, and there are relatives, fathers-in-law, and fathers-in-law, so there is no preference.
There are two other pieces of fabric, which are similar to Zhou Guilan's.
The mother-in-law is also a mother, and the Han family is very good to Xu Shiyan.
"By the way, Sixth Sister, this is your money for working in the processing factory in autumn."
Xu Shiyan took out one hundred yuan and handed it to Su Anhua.
Su Anhua worked in the processing factory for a month and a half, but actually earned less than 70 yuan. After discussing with his wife, Xu Shiyan added some.
"Also, this is the dress your sister Qin made for you. I don't know if it fits. Try it on."
Su Anhua helped take care of the children at Xu's family for nearly half a year, and it was really a great help.
When she returned home, Xu Shiyan was in the provincial capital, and Su Anying gave her sister sixty yuan.
When Xu Shiyan came back and brought up this matter, he felt that he had given less.
When Su Anhua was in Xu's family, she was busy working outside the house, and she put in a lot of effort, but sixty yuan was too little.
So the couple discussed to add some money and make a set of clothes.
It happened that Xu Shiyan brought back a lot of fabric from the provincial capital, and Xu Shiqin had nothing to do when he was idle at home, so he just cut it out and finished it.
"Brother-in-law, I only worked in a processing factory for a month and a half, so I definitely can't earn so much.
Don't fool me, this must be you and my sister deliberately adding money. "
Su Anhua is not stupid. After working in a processing factory for so long, how can she not know how much other people earned in previous years?
This is more than twice as much as what she inquired about. Don't even think about it. It must be that my sister and brother-in-law gave her money in the name of wages.
"Originally, for the sake of the second brother-in-law, they asked me to work, and left me until the end, earning more money than others.
Second brother-in-law, you give me more money, you don’t want me to come to your house in the future, do you? "
"How can it be? This year the second team has made money, and the work points are high, making more money than in previous years."
Xu Shiyan coughed lightly, the little girl nowadays is not easy to fool. "If you don't believe me, ask your sister, really."
Su Anying on the other end nodded cooperatively, "Well, this year, the second brigade has a bumper harvest and earns a lot of money.
Hold it with peace of mind. If you like it this fall, you can still go to work. We are still together to make goods this year. "
Su Anying spoke, Su Anhua didn't say anything, just accepted the money, and then happily took the clothes and ran to Westinghouse.
"Both of you, just let her get used to her. How much does it cost to pay and make clothes?"
Han complained, but couldn't hide the smile on his face.
Although these two daughters are not their own, but they grew up beside them, and they are just like their own.
Not to mention my uncle, he respects the couple very much, and he never comes empty-handed every time, and brings a lot of food and use.
Even if it is a son, it is not necessarily better than this to marry and live in another family.
Su Anying and Xu Shiyan didn't answer, they just laughed.
When Mrs. Han saw this, she stopped talking, carried the two babies over, and sat face to face, teasing the children while chatting with Sister Su Anying.
On the other end, Xu Shiyan was dragged by Su Weizhong and his brothers-in-law to talk.
This year, the work points of the Second Brigade of Donggang Commune hit a record high. The whole county knows that Nan Zhendong, Ji Tongzhong and others are particularly envious, and dragged Xu Shiyan to inquire about it.
Su Weizhong is more concerned about contracting households. He doesn't know how to arrange it at Donggang, so he has to ask Xu Shiyan.
Su Anhua went to Westinghouse to change into new clothes, and ran back happily.
"Father, mother, look at the clothes that Sister Qin made for me, how well they fit, Sister Qin's craftsmanship is beyond words, this clothes are so beautiful."
Su Anhua is the youngest girl in the Su family, loved by her parents and doted on by her sisters, besides, she is younger and has a lively personality.
Now that you have a beautiful dress, you must come out and show it off.
Xu Shiqin made a set of clothes for Su Anhua, a sorghum beige top with slanted pockets, small lapels, and a narrow waist.
The waist is specially made with a fake belt. After wearing it, the waist looks slender, the figure is tall and straight, and it is particularly energetic.
Navy blue pants are also designed to close the legs, not as fat as most people's pants these days.
But it is not like the legs are tied like the later generations, it is very suitable for fat and thin, and the legs look long.
Su Anhua is average in stature, only about 1.58 meters, but dressed in this way, she looks extraordinarily tall and good-looking.
Han looked at it, and nodded again and again, "Don't talk about it, your sister-in-law's craftsmanship is really nothing to say.
I haven't seen anyone wear this outfit, it's so pretty. "
Nowadays people make clothes to be worn in winter and summer, most of them are fat and big, girls really don’t look good when they wear them.
Xu Shiqin's clothes are made according to Su Anhua's autumn size, so they must be thinner, and of course they look good.
"Yingzi, turn around and ask, does your sister-in-law's master still accept apprentices?
I don’t think your sixth younger sister is able to work in the fields. If she still accepts apprentices, let her go and learn from her.
We don’t ask for anything to recruit workers, as long as we can learn a craft, we will pick up jobs in our village later, can’t we also support ourselves? "
Han has been thinking about this for a long time, but has never had a chance to speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Brother-in-law
chapters.content:
Chapter 264 Brother-in-law
"Mother, does Hua'er want to learn by herself? The craft is no better than others, as long as she likes it herself.
When you have time, mother, ask Hua'er carefully. If she wants to learn, I will ask our family Shiqin later.
If Hua'er doesn't have that kind of heart, then forget it. She doesn't like it, so she definitely can't learn it with her heart. "
Su Anying still doesn't know what her own sister looks like?
Su Anhua's needlework is mediocre, and she doesn't like it very much. It would be too much to ask her to learn tailoring.
Han Shi heard the words, and sighed, "Aren't I worried about her?
You said that the contract will be contracted to each household soon, and each household will divide the land.
There are only five and six children left in our family, but how can these two work compared to you and the third.
Expect the two of them to make money in the agricultural team? Whether you can support yourself or not is up to you.
I thought to myself, isn’t it better to learn some skills than to make great efforts? "
The Han family also came up with such an idea because they were desperate.
The old five and the six are young, and they used to be protected by their sisters, so they didn't make much effort, and Su Weizhong was capable at that time.
Now, Su Weizhong is old, and his health has not been very good in the past two years, and the two girls can't work, how will they live in the future?
Su Weizhong is also worried. At this moment, he is discussing with Xu Shiyan.
"Shi Yan, is there any young man of the right age in your team?
It doesn’t matter how good-looking you are, and you don’t need how rich your family is, as long as the young man works hard and can live a solid life.
The five and six are not young anymore, if there is a suitable one, let me introduce one, I think your second team is very good, much better than the camp. "
Su Weizhong's idea is simple, the girl will get married sooner or later when she grows up.
It's better to find a good man for my daughter to marry, and it can be counted as a support.
Donggang No. 2 Brigade, the well-known Fuyu Brigade, if the girl can marry there, she will definitely not have to worry about the future.
Besides, being close to the second daughter, the sisters take care of each other, how nice?
The last time the Zhou family held a funeral, when Xu Shiyan met his father-in-law, Su Weizhong vaguely had this idea.
At that time, Xu Shiyan deliberately pretended not to understand and mumbled.
After returning home, she asked her daughter-in-law for her opinion. Su Anying thought that the two younger sisters were too young, so she refused to let Xu Shiyan interfere in their marriage.
Unexpectedly, this time, Su Weizhong directly pointed it out, and Xu Shiyan felt a little stressed.
"Father, the fifth younger sister is twenty this year, and the sixth younger sister is only eighteen, isn't she too young?
I see, the two younger sisters might as well stay with the second elder and take care of you for a few more years. "
Xu Shiyan also felt that the two sister-in-laws were not too old, so there was no need to rush to get married.
What are the benefits of getting married so early? Becoming a mother early is a lifetime of endless worries.
"Both of us are fine, so we don't need to take care of them.
My daughter is old enough to stay at home and get married too late, making people laugh.
Yingzi was too late at that time, I always felt sorry for her, thanks to meeting you, now that your life is getting better and better, I don’t think I have any worries.
Don't be too late for these two, I will be less concerned when I meet the right one to marry. "
Su Weizhong still had the old idea that a girl would have to marry sooner or later, and it was better to marry early than late, so she felt at ease.
My father-in-law said so, how could Xu Shiyan refuse? I can only nod.
"Okay, I'll go back and ask. If there is a suitable one, I will send a message to Dad later."
One end is the father-in-law, and the other end is the daughter-in-law. Xu Shiyan is also in a dilemma in the middle.
If you want to talk about good guys, Donggang No. 2 Brigade really has them.
The two sister-in-laws in his family can look good, and they can't find fault in their work. If he wants to match, it's really not difficult.
"Second brother-in-law, do you still need people in your second brigade? Otherwise, Anfen and I will move there.
Ssangyong couldn’t do it, so they just pointed to farming. The wages were too low, and they were busy all year round and didn’t earn much money. "
Su Anfen's man, Ji Tongzhong, finally found a chance to ask.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help sighing when he heard this.
This fourth brother-in-law, according to the words of the older generation, is a seedling, an embroidered pillow, which looks good, but in fact there is nothing wrong with it.
Ji Tongzhong looks good, handsome with bushy eyebrows and big eyes, but he is poor at work, and he is afraid of exerting himself and refuses to endure hardship.
In 1987, Su Weizhong passed away, and the Han family moved to Hunjiang with their two daughters.
As a result, Ji Tongzhong and his wife also left their house and land, and followed them to the Hunjiang River.
The two of them have registered permanent residence in the countryside, so they can't recruit workers. They just mess around in the city, and their life is not good, but they just refuse to go back to the village to farm the land to make a living.
The two lived in Hunjiang for more than ten years, but they really couldn't get along, and had no choice but to return to Shuanglong to farm.
I don’t want to live in peace while farming, I just think of some tricks, planting sesame seeds, but no one recycles them, and I lose money again.
Anyway, I know how to work when I am old. I farm at home in spring and autumn, and work on construction sites in summer.
Finally saved some money, bought a bungalow in Dongshangen, the county seat, and married his son a wife.
"Xiao Ji, making money planting mallets is making money, but it's also tiring.
It is not easy to work hard for three years before getting out to make goods.
Besides, the land will be divided immediately, and the brigade has actually demarcated the land.
If you move at this time, there will definitely be no land for you on the other side of Ssangyong, and no land on the other side of Donggang.
You can't fall at both ends, why are you here? "
I wanted to move earlier, but I only remembered it at this time. I can't get any benefits. What's the point of moving?
When Ji Tongzhong heard it, his face fell down, "Oh, I just heard that, how is the Donggang side?
Second brother-in-law, what can I do? I heard you don't have some kind of farm? Otherwise, I'll go to work for my second brother-in-law? "
This kid became whimsical again.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, this fourth brother-in-law is just so out of tune.
Who has ever heard of someone who has land at home that cannot be planted properly and runs to work for others?
"Xiao Ji, what do you want me to say? My farm has a lot of work, and I'm always busy all day long.
On the other side, I’m always looking for a job with a blind person, the wages are low, and anyone who stutters will do.
Besides, the breeding farm is a joint venture of several people, and there is also a share in the brigade. I don’t have the final say. "
This is purely an excuse.
The large area of ​​the breeding farm is taken care of by the brigade and the commune, and approved. Therefore, 10% of the annual profit must be given to the brigade, which is counted as the cost of land use.
Although Huang Shengli and others hold shares, but the proportion is small, the decision-making power is still in Xu Shiyan's hands.
Xu Shiyan really couldn't arrange for this brother-in-law. His farm is not big enough to support idlers, so he can only use this excuse.
When Ji Tongzhong heard it, the farm was tired of work and the wages were low, so he was wilted at that time.
He just wants to find a job that is not tiring and earns a lot of money. Why is it so difficult?
Su Weizhong couldn't help shaking his head when he heard the conversation between the two brothers-in-law. The marriage of the fourth daughter did not go well.
At that time, I heard from the matchmaker that the young man is handsome, and there is only one older sister and one younger sister in the family, and there are few brothers, so don’t worry.
When we met, Su Weizhong felt something was wrong and didn't want to agree.
But Su Anfen couldn't help herself, she wanted to marry anyway.
Now it seems that the fourth uncle is really not good, not to mention compared with the second uncle, even the third uncle.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: two sisters
chapters.content:
Chapter 265 The two sisters-in-law
Su Weizhong looked at the four sons-in-law, and if he said the job was good, it must be the eldest son-in-law.
People work in Hunjiang Department Store, which is the best job nowadays.
But if you want to say it well, it is still the second uncle. Although he is a farmer, the average person in the family can't compare with it.
Five big tile-roofed houses, and also opened a breeding farm, and the second brigade also made money by planting sticks. Those days were prosperous.
The third son-in-law is in the local area of ​​Daying, and grew up watching him.
Honest, good physique, able to work.
Crop yard, it has to be this good, as long as you work hard, life will definitely not be bad.
Only this fourth uncle, alas, people who don't know look at it, thick eyebrows and big eyes are very good-looking, whoever sees it at the first sight is rare.
But what's the use of looking good? Can't work, can't earn money, and still think about the pie in the sky all day long, this is really embarrassing.
But the four girls are all married and have children, what else can they do? Deal with it.
Now Su Weizhong has no idea, just looking for a partner, he must know the basics and understand clearly.
Otherwise, how could he remember to ask Xu Shiyan to help introduce him.
Not only is Tudonggang a good place and earns a lot of money, but also because of Xu Shiyan's popularity in Donggang, he must know a lot and find a suitable one.
"Shiyan, remember what Dad said, you must be careful and help the elders find a partner."
Su Weizhong didn't want Fourth Young Master to say anything useless, so he changed the subject.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to nod his head in agreement. If his father-in-law ordered him, then he could only obey obediently.
The daughter brought her son-in-law and children back, and the family must prepare some good food.
Han made preparations in advance, and seeing that the time was almost up, he asked the fifth and sixth to cook quickly.
The daughters in this house naturally didn't need Mrs. Han to do anything. After a while, the meals were all prepared and served, and the whole family was reunited, which was very lively.
The brothers-in-law got together, and they had to drink. Xu Shiyan's alcohol capacity was not bad, but he drank too much in the end.
But Xu Shiyan's wine taste is okay, and he won't talk nonsense if he drinks too much, or cry and make noise, at most he just sits there in a daze, or falls asleep somewhere.
Xu Shiyan and his wife lived in Daying for four days.
Finding time in the middle, I went to sit at Xu Shiyan's uncle, second uncle, and aunt's house, and went to Su Anying's uncle Su Weicheng's house next door for dinner.
Anyway, the Su family is very kind to Xu Shiyan, and they are very enthusiastic. They must stay with Xu Shiyan's family for a few more days.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about the Clivia at home, and felt like growing grass in his heart. After living for four days, he couldn't bear it anymore.
On the morning of the seventh day of the first lunar month, the couple returned to Songjianghe by car with their four children.
Followed by Su Anfang and Su Anhua.
Su Weizhong wanted to marry both of his daughters to Donggang, so he discussed with Su Anying that he wanted the old five and the sixth to send Su Anying's family back and live there for a while.
Either learn some crafts from Xu Shiqin, or help Su Anying work and look after the children.
The old man had a good plan. He thought that if the two daughters were to live in Xu's house, the neighbors would see that there would always be a kind-hearted person to help the mediator. Maybe this marriage would meet.
Su Anying is no more stubborn than her own father, so she can only discuss with her husband.
The two younger sisters don’t have much to do in Daying, and it’s impossible to expect them to work in the fields. Why don’t you come over and find something for them to do.
Among other things, it is okay to take care of the Clivia seedlings with Su Anying for the time being.
There are more and more Clivia seedlings at home, Xu Shiyan has so many things to do, he can't take care of them.
Xu Shiqin will have to go back to work after the next year and has no time to take care of her.
Su Anying has to take care of four children, and she may not even be able to eat when she is busy. How can she have time to take care of Clivia seedlings? You can't just leave all the work to Zhou Guilan, can you?
Let the old five and the sixth go over to help take care of it, and pay some wages a month, which is better than finding outsiders.
Xu Shiyan made sense when he heard it. Now that the stall at home is getting bigger and bigger, he really needs a few good helpers.
Su Anfang and Su Anhua are not married, so there is no burden, and it is convenient to do everything with light hands and feet.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan agreed to let the two sister-in-laws go with him, but he didn't say that he was going back to take care of Clivia.
In the past few days at Su's house, Xu Shiyan didn't even mention Clivia's problems.
In this matter, whoever is asked to help in the search for flower seedlings and seeds has to benefit others, otherwise, in the future, others will definitely not be happy when they find out that he has made money raising Clivia.
They are all relatives, so ask someone to help, how much will they give? Xu Shiyan hasn't made any money yet, and he doesn't know how much he will make in the future.
If you give too much, he is reluctant to take it out, and if you give too little, it will be troublesome in the future.
Simply, let’s not mention this problem. When others find out, they will say that it’s a partnership business with a friend. He can’t make the decision himself, so it’s more worry-free.
Anyway, there are quite a few of them now. If you can meet them in the future, you can get some, and if you don’t, you will lose them.
This year’s New Year’s Eve is late, the seventh day of the first month is already February 19th, and the temperature outside is thawing at noon, and the temperature is also higher.
Everyone got out of the car and sat in a donkey jeep. They didn't feel too cold and returned to Donggang all the way.
The first thing to do when you get home is to visit your parents.
As soon as Zhou Guilan heard that Su Anying's two younger sisters had come to live for a while, she immediately said that it would be better for Su Anfang and Su Anhua to live here, just to be with Xu Shiqin.
During the day, the two went to Xu Shiyan's house to help take care of Clivia, and came back to live at night.
If they are willing, they can also learn how to make clothes from Xu Shiqin.
Zhou Guilan's arrangement actually suits Xu Shiyan's wishes.
You need to know that he is living with a single household and is not with the elderly.
This guy suddenly came to live with two sisters-in-law, both of whom are unmarried girls. Will others gossip if it spreads out?
When Su Anhua lived there last year, mainly Zhou Guilan and her daughter lived there most of the time, everyone in the neighborhood knew about it, and no one wentssip.
Now that Xu Chenghou can't go up the mountain to see ginseng, and Zhou Guilan can't live with his son, it's not good if Su Anfang and sisters stay there.
Another advantage is that Zhou Guilan often has some old ladies who come to visit.
These older people, they all like to stretch the mediators, isn't that just right? Xu Shiyan, who was also spared, took the trouble to touch it.
He only needs to tell his mother about the request from the other end of the Su family, and half of the matter will be completed.
When someone comes to propose a matchmaker, Xu Shiyan spends a little effort to find out clearly, if yes, just see each other, if no, just pull down, how simple.
"Well, I think it's okay, it happens that the fifth and sixth younger sisters are about the same age as Shiqin, and they have something to say when they get together.
It’s okay to be idle, and I can learn some crafts from Shiqin, at least learn how to step on a sewing machine.
From now on, this thing will be a must-have in every household. "Xu Shiyan nodded again and again, expressing his agreement with his mother's proposal.
On the other end, Su Anying also thought her mother-in-law's suggestion was good.
She didn't think so much, mainly because she thought that with Xu Shiqin by her side, maybe the two younger sisters could really learn something along the way.
Even if she doesn't point to handicrafts to eat, this woman should learn some sewing, otherwise, what if she gets married and has children?
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 7 o'clock. Thank you for your support. More genuine books are available on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 266: stake
chapters.content:
Chapter 266 Shareholding
When Xu Shiqin heard that Sister Su Anfang was staying, she was even more delighted.
She was the only girl in the family since she was a child, and she had no one to accompany her. Sometimes she was really lonely and flustered.
Especially when I see other people have sisters, I really envy them.
I didn’t feel anything about going to work before, and now I don’t do much at home. It’s really boring after a long time.
When Su Anhua was here last year, he got along very well with Xu Shiqin.
After Xu Shiqin got off work, the two of them would get together, chat and do some work, which was great.
Now that there is Su Anfang again, Xu Shiqin is even happier, so he hurried to tidy up the Westinghouse, and brought two more quilts out to dry them, which will be useful at night.
"The two of you will live with me from now on. It just so happens that I have company too."
Xu Shiqin cleared out the bedding, and tidied up the cabinet again, freeing up two compartments for Sister Su Anfang to put clothes and so on.
In the west room, the three girls were chatting and laughing to pack their things, and in the east room, Xu Chenghou and his wife were chatting with Xu Shiyan.
"In the past few days you have been away, the house is quite lively, and many people have come to look for you.
Limin led a young man who was quite young and wore glasses. He came to see you several times, saying that the secretary who attended the meeting had something to do with you.
You have time to go to the venue and ask Limin what's going on. "
"Also, the director of the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, surnamed Guo, also came to see you yesterday.
What did you ask him to inquire about? There is news, let you take time to go there. "
Xu Chenghou didn't understand why his son was looking for someone else, anyway, someone in my middle sent a message.
"It's not our team anymore, there will be a meeting to divide the territory in those few days.
Secretary Yu asked someone to ask you, the ginseng land is still contracted.
Seeing that the weather is getting warmer and warmer, if we want to go to the parade, we have to find someone from outside the team.
You told me that this year we are contracted to see ginseng, whoever wants to go to see it. "
That was what the father and father had discussed a long time ago. Guo Shouye agreed to his son, so naturally he can change his mind.
"Okay, you get it, Dad.
Tomorrow you go to Shi Sheng first, please ask Brother Guo for help, and then give Taodeng some Clivia seedlings.
You probably don’t believe me, just taking advantage of some small things outside the first month, you and Jianshe, we will find some flower seedlings, seeds and so on in seven places, and it’s almost gone. "
My own father, what can I hide from Xu Cheng, tell the truth.
"Are they a few of them now? Are there too many of them? With so little, can they be sold in the future?"
Guo Shouye wasn't worried at all, no matter how cheap those things were, they still cost money, so what if they were sold?
"Father, what's the matter, in my eyes, it's not much.
It’s easy to handle if there is less, and it’s easy to adjust if there are too many. "
It is easy to manage any industry without a scale.
Less, I can’t find a way to find a car to transport to the provincial capital, and I can’t find merchants from the provincial capital to buy it. I have to make money before deducting the freight, right?
What if it’s just the dozens of pots outside the house? Is it worth the trip?
I can always carry a basket on my back, hold eight taels of potted flowers, and go to the provincial capital by train, right? Is this a joke?
Shi Shengbo understands that, but I know that my son is doing things fairly safely, and it must be that he dared to do that because he was out of his mind.
"That's fine, let him.
By the way, he asked Director Guo for help. Did he have to give others benefits in the past? He was in the business of making money. "
Guo Shouye knows business, but understands the world.
If it is put on hold later, the middleman has to be right for that kind of thing, and it is not to earn introduction fees.
Now I know that I don’t have that kind of business, but if I ask someone to help, I will give the benefits if I have to.
"Well, you discussed that with us at Jianshe, and you have to bring Brother Guo with you.
Brother Guo is a native of Li. We have troubled others in those years, and we owe it to me. "
Xu Shiqin must have given enough benefits.
It was just that one time, I had nothing to do before and I had to find someone else, so what kind of benefit would I do?
Guo Shouye listened and nodded, it's okay, the eighth son is quite considerate in dealing with things.
"Well, you should remind him of that matter, if he makes a big fuss, be careful.
If he wants to make a fuss, it’s best to say hello to Secretary Yu of our team and Secretary Chen of the commune.
It’s okay, and people outside the team can help him take care of it. "
Guo Shouye is young and has little experience, so he probably needs to remind Xu Chenghou.
"Success, you know, Dad, you didn't think about that."
Xu Chenghou smiled, and I can see that my father is thinking about me now, and he is more considerate than me.
"Oh, by the way, nothing happened. On the seventh day of the lunar new year, Lao Qi came back with 200 yuan.
Said that I can make up those for the time being, and the rest will be given to you after I draw the money.
The seven hundred yuan, if you give him, it will be considered that the seventh child has also bought a share.
He also kept quiet, he didn’t have any hard work before, so he called me, and in the future he will care about how much money he earns, so remember to share some with me. "
Guo Shouye handed over 700 yuan to Xu Chenghou, which was regarded as an investment for his seventh son.
"Alas, you have raised seven sons.
From now on, I feel that these few are smart and smart, and they haven’t worked yet. Without us, even if you are old, someone will take care of you.
Looking at it now, the more stupid the more treacherous, I still catch up with them. "
There is an old saying that "eccentric pain is beneficial", which is absolutely wrong.
The youngest is the eldest son, and has been valued by his parents since he was a child. Even if Xu Shixian caused such a small trouble, Guo Shouye still has high hopes for his son.
Lao Qi is clever and Lao Qi is stupid, both of them are like parents, but the more they are like that, the more selfish they are, they only care about themselves as Gu parents.
On the contrary, it was the seventh child who got into trouble and was beaten all day long, and the eighth child who was most valued by Baden.
In the future, I feel promising, but it happens that promising children are more filial.
When Xu Chenghou heard that Seventh Brother got the money back, he was surprised but also very unhappy.
"Your seventh brother borrowed the two hundred yuan, do you know where he borrowed it from, and he must have kept it from your seventh sister-in-law.
Okay, you listen to your father and take Brother Seven with you. "
Xu Shian works in the farm, and there is also a flower shed here, and the matter of raising Clivia itself has been hidden from me.
That was just right, and it couldn't be carried along logically. In the past, Xu Chenghou had nothing to say about this brother's arguing.
The whole family ate there and didn't go home until seven o'clock in the morning.
Fortunately, there is no old couple to take care of the house. Whether it is the residence or the flower shed, there is a fire, and the outside of the house is quite warm.
The seeds planted outside the flower shed also stopped germination and popped out a little bit. The germination rate is not high, which is considered high
Xu Chenghou lost confidence in the cultivation of Clivia.
On the afternoon of the fourth day of the first lunar month, Xu Chenghou first went to Songjianghe to find Xu Shiqin.
As soon as Xu Shiqin saw Xu Chenghou, he told me that during the Chinese New Year, I helped find out how many places it was.
For Quanyang Forestry Bureau, Lushuihe Forestry Bureau, Baihe Forestry Bureau, Bachazi Forestry Bureau and other places, I have asked people to ask relatives and friends who are away from home, not to mention, there are really not many.
"Those are the addresses. When he went to find someone, he said that you told him, and they would know."
Shi Shengbo handed Xu Chenghou a large book, which contained some addresses and names.
"Hey, you have to thank Brother Guo, he did you a little favor.
Brother, he is worried about that matter, the younger brother earns money, if it falls to the elder brother. "

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Participation secretary
chapters.content:
Chapter 267 Attending Secretary
With the list and address given by Guo Shouye, Xu Shiyan called Zhao Jianshe and others together for discussion when he returned home.
It happened that last year everyone went to some communes and participated in the field to give technical guidance.
Seeing the place names on it, each of them looked for familiar ones, then split up, took money and set off to work.
Taking advantage of the fact that there is nothing to do in the first month, I quickly swipe back and wait for a while to be busy. Who has the time to toss about this?
Others are busy, but Xu Shiyan can't, he has to go to the venue.
Don't worry about Secretary Lin's business with him, Han Limin has said several times that he has to go to the Han family.
Therefore, Xu Shiyan went out with Zhao Jianshe and others, and rode a bicycle straight to Han's house in the field.
When Han Wenzhong and Han Limin saw Xu Shiyan coming, they were very happy, and hurried to the next door to find Li Bingzhuo, the director of the branch, and his son Li Chengrong.
As soon as Li Bingzhuo heard that the capable person his son was talking about was coming, he immediately told his wife to prepare some food and treat them to dinner.
Then, Li Bingzhuo sent his son, Li Chengrong, to invite someone to Secretary Lin's house.
Li Bingzhuo himself went to the Han family to meet Xu Shiyan.
"Hey, this is Technician Xu, right?
I have often heard from our family, Cheng Rong, that the child admires you, saying that Technician Xu is a capable person.
I have never had the chance to meet him before, but I finally met him today. "
When Li Bingzhuo saw Xu Shiyan, he was very polite and extended his right hand towards Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan stood up when Li Bingzhuo left the room, and at that time he also reached out his left hand to shake him.
"He is good as the manager of the field, and he has long admired his nickname.
Brother Chengrong is exaggerating, you are just an ordinary old farmer. "It's unnecessary to be polite.
"Yes, yes, Technician Xu is a person without real talent and learning. You have heard about his deeds.
This whole ground gun is now used for viewing in various venues, which is very useful.
I don’t have this pickaxe yet, all of you participating in the field have changed to that kind now, and the work is slow.
Not to mention the ginseng fertilizer he researched, the output of their seven teams this year is simply enviable, it's amazing. "
Last year, the ginseng production of the Seventh Team of Donggang Commune reached a new level, with an average of 77 catties of water ginseng produced per foot.
That is a milestone in the development of Fusong's ginseng industry. Not to mention Fusong, even distant counties, but where ginseng is planted, there is no one who knows.
Then, Lin Qiyue is easy to accept.
"It's just a little stupid to be overrated, and it's too low to be praised by the Xiao family."
"Well, Brother Han, you have many questions and you want to ask Technician Xu for advice.
Your family is sincerely willing to invite Secretary Lin. If so, please invite Xu technicians. There is no brother Han and Limin. Let's go to your house together? "
Han Limin is seventy years behind this year, a few years older than Li Chengrong.
The two families are neighbors and get along very well. Han Limin invited them and said that Secretary Lin would also be there. Naturally, he responded quickly.
"Success, what's the matter on the right and left, go to his house and sit down."
Li Cheng smiled and nodded, dressed properly, and everyone went out of Han's house to the next door.
A group of people retreated to the east room of Li's house and just sat down, when Xu Shiyan and a secretary of the field, Li Bingzhuo, also arrived.
Qiang Shiliang had to be introduced. Lin Qiyue and Secretary Lin shook hands and greeted each other.
That Secretary Lin was young, in his eighties, wearing glasses, gentle and elegant, and very easy-going.
"After that, Dali handed you an article, which you thought was very good before reading it.
Some outside ideas are exactly the difficulties that participants will face at present and in the future.
You heard from Dali that those were all told to me by Technician Xu, and I sorted them out.
So you have always wanted to meet Technician Xu, but unfortunately, Technician Xu is too busy, so there is always a chance.
Just now when Dali went over to tell you, you should hurry over here, and you must meet that little capable man in person. "
When Li Bingzhuo saw Lin Qiyue, he first praised him.
"Secretary Lin, if he said that, he would embarrass you.
You who have graduated from junior high school, how can you have no skills?
This is working with Dali, and I boasted a few words to me when I was free, but I dare say that I am a capable person. "
The one behind the eyes is a secretary attending the scene.
Lin Qiyue understands the division of titles in the system too well, but he feels that he should be far behind Secretary Chen of Donggang Commune?
He is the attending secretary, and Lin Qiyue is at least a commune technician.
I was afraid, mainly because I knew what Secretary Lin wanted to do. Lin Qiyue felt that he had better speak more carefully to avoid offending others.
"Hey, what he said is too modest, he is the first among those participating technicians outside our county.
Even the few technicians in your field admire him. If we are incapable, we are incapable, so you admire incapable people. "
Li Bingzhuo laughed when he heard the words. Based on my experience, I can tell at a glance that Lin Qiyue has no scruples in his heart.
"Today is outside the old calendar, and the young Chinese New Year, let's not be a secretary or a technician.
How old are you younger than him, you call him brother, he calls you brother Lin.
It's about something else, for the sake of Limin's relationship, we also use it to see Li. "
Li Bingzhuo said that on purpose, but in fact, it doesn’t matter that the Han family is very Li Bingzhuo.
Of course, the popularity of the Han family was wrong, and Qiang Shiliang and Han Wenzhong got along well.
Li Bingzhuo has no intention of making friends, and there is no Han Wenzhong and Han Limin to help him, and Qiang Shiliang is too good at it, as if he has no ability, so he will be less.
So the little guy sat up, drinking tea and nibbling melon seeds, chatting cautiously.
After talking and getting acquainted, Li Bingzhuo had to talk about some things about the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land, mainly to seek Lin Qiyue's opinion.
If you want to talk about other things, Lin Qiyue knows a lot. If it has nothing to do with ginseng, there are really few who can compare with me. After all, I don't have the memory and experience of future generations.
The ginseng farms, regardless of whether they are state-run or local, are mainly planted with ginseng, so don’t think that all the ginseng farms are workers, and they do the work of old farmers.
But only planting ginseng in the field is farming, and workers receive wages, earning work points, and the benefits are also good.
At the end of 1948, several participating farms in the county have implemented the family farm production responsibility system.
The main farm divides each annual ginseng into large parts, and contracts it to the family for field farming management, and the products are handed over to the general farm for accounting.
In 1941, a ginseng factory was restructured and Fusong Dongfang Ginseng Co., Ltd. was established.
At that time, 21 million funds were raised, making the participating industry reach its most glorious period.
It should be said that from 1948 to 2000, it was the best golden period for the development of an industry.
At this time, all the employees in the field had no money and lived a good life.
Among the girls participating in the competition, most of them are married. If the girl from Donggang Town can marry in the competition, relatives and friends will be very happy.
Every year, there is a celebration, all kinds of agricultural eight-wheelers, cars, motorcycles, half a circle around Donggang, it is really booming at this time.
Two thousand years ago, Yichang went uphill and gradually prospered.
Workers can only develop inwardly and find their own way out.
In a few years, it became so yellow once it entered the market, and even the processing factories that participated in the market were sold at a low price.
Come to catch up with other provinces and directly set up Chixi District, specializing in tourism development.
As soon as they joined the factory, none of these employees had any salary, and the houses were demolished and relocated.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Technical Adviser
chapters.content:
Chapter 268 Technical Advisor
What I told Li Chengrong before about comprehensive development and utilization was indeed an idea of ​​Xu Shiyan.
At the time, I just said it casually. In fact, when it is actually implemented, there are many problems to be encountered in all aspects.
Xu Shiyan didn't expect that Li Chengrong took this child seriously, and he didn't know what he was thinking, and even wrote materials and handed them to Secretary Lin.
Now that Secretary Lin asked, Xu Shiyan could no longer pretend not to understand, so he could only talk about his opinion.
In addition to what Li Chengrong said before, Xu Shiyan also raised a few points.
One is the deep processing and finishing of ginseng products, and the other is the brand effect of ginseng products.
"Brother Lin, just say, is the red ginseng from Changbai Mountain inferior to Korean ginseng?
Not bad, right? Then why, our ginseng cannot sell other Korean ginseng?
Why is this? Because people have made famous names, everyone knows Korean ginseng.
At present, most of them are rough processing, without finishing processing, we cannot make flagship products.
There is no product that can stand up and scream loudly. Do you think our mallet can compare with others? "
"Our current processing method, regardless of whether it is red goods or white goods, is the most extensive and low-end processing.
The clubs we planted were taken away by foreign merchants, especially merchants from Nanbang and Dongyi.
What about others? People take it over, extract ginsenosides, make health care products, and make cosmetics.
They took the raw materials from us at a low price, and then sold them to various places after finishing. The price has doubled.
Why can’t we process it ourselves? Why should we just let the money go to make money and let others take the money away? "
Lin Qiyue kept those words in his mind for two lifetimes, and finally said them today.
Even at the time of my rebirth, in the Donggang area, yes, it should be said in the Fusong area, a small part of ginseng is still sold directly on the market before extensive processing.
Bought by local merchants, then sold to the country, or directly sold to several small domestic pharmaceutical companies.
There are too many local companies that can do deep processing and finishing, and the money is earned by others.
Shen Nong worked desperately outside the field, and all he earned was hard money.
"Oh, he looked at it, and you said, you should talk to your brother.
Those words should only be listened to by us, and these leaders outside the county should listen to them even more. "
Su Anying heard that, and excitedly slapped on the table, and the teacups under the table were flipped up, and some of the tea outside the cups splashed out.
"Brother Xu, you look at me as a talent, a rare talent.
He thinks he wants to participate? If he wants to come, you can make a decision now and hire him as a technical consultant. How does he look? "
Su Anying is generally interested in what Tan Meiheng said, the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land, the deep processing and fine processing of ginseng products.
For example, comprehensive utilization, the outside knowledge is small.
How to make comprehensive use, how to obtain the minimum income under the unlimited land area.
Returning the front to the forest and using the land with the ginseng, how can it be possible to achieve conflicts and minimize benefits.
Those must be studied in depth and on the spot, and fantasy is useful.
Tan Meiheng is an unambitious person. I hope that I can develop smaller and better under my hands.
I think Lin Qiyue is a talented person, and he is really not outstanding in the aspect of participating in the industry.
Cherishing talents and knowing how to tap talents are the qualities and expertise of a leader.
So Su Anying directly invited Tan Meiheng to hire Lin Qiyue as a technical consultant to participate in the event.
"Huh?" Tan Mei Heng was dumbfounded on the spot.
Let me come to participate? As a technical consultant? Is it a joke?
But that’s right, I’m from the agricultural port, and I was transferred to participate in the field as a technical consultant. I didn’t get off work before?
That, is the way right?
"Brother Lin, well, you don't have a breeding farm yourself, and you plan to start another flower company in the future.
It is to tell him that you have been waiting for the land to be divided into households, so that you can work independently. "
Lin Qiyue didn't speak coherently, he knew what he wanted to express.
To say that I am tempted by Su Anying's proposal is pure nonsense.
A participating technical consultant, who used to be a worker, received wages, and will not be able to take leave in the future. After that, I dreamed that I would never have such an opportunity.
But now that I have made the stall so small, I plan to do a small job before dividing the fields into households.
At that time, let me come to the field as a worker? So how should we choose? It's not difficult at all.
"That is still complicated? He is himself again, and he doesn't have a wife yet.
He put the farm and flower company in his wife's name.
He is at the helm at the front, and his wife is at the back, what's wrong? What else can others do with his wife? "
Here, Han Limin's brain turned slowly, and he thought of a solution as soon as he got up.
Lin Qiyue is currently recruiting workers to participate in the field. For the time being, he can bring his family members with his household registration. Li Chengrong and his children are still in the seventh team.
Anyway, the land will be distributed this year. In the past, as long as you paid enough tasks, you can do whatever you like.
Farms and flower companies also hire people to work, in the name of Li Cheng, and Tan Mei Hang gives advice to the helm, which is a bit of a delay in earning money.
Or, Li Chengrong, we simply want the land, and it is feasible to wait two years and find a way to get the household registration to Yishenchang.
Family workers, as long as they violate the policy, others don’t care what they like to do.
"Brother Xu, he will go back and discuss it with outsiders, and he will think about it himself.
If he comes, you will pay him the minimum salary of a technician.
Let’s first refine the old ginseng cultivated in Gastrodia elata and Changbai Mountain red ginseng, and tackle those two technical problems.
You enroll him in the study class of our provincial rural primary school, and the unit pays to send him to study, what does he think? "
Su Anying also spent a lot of money in order to poach people.
At that time, Tan Meiheng didn't feel numb at all, and the reaction was over.
It was like a pie in the world, it hit me on the head with a snap.
"Secretary Lin, he really has to let you think about it sloppily. Later, you discuss it with someone outside your family and give him a letter."
That matter was only discussed with people outside the family, and the most important thing was to discuss with the commune outside the team.
Han Limin's idea sounds very good, but it is too realistic in reality. How can there be no good things in the world?
Squad and commune allowed?
So Lin Qiyue agreed to come up as soon as his head got cold, I had to figure it out sloppily, discuss it with Yu Shouguang and Secretary Chen, and agree to let him go here.
"Well, you get it, get it.
Anyway, you are waiting for him, and as long as he wants to, you will give me the other procedures.
Whether they are communes or teams, you can do the work. "Tan Meiheng should have seen Lin Qiyue's concerns, and gave me another reassurance.
Now that we've reached the end of the story, Mei Hang really has something else to say.
At that time, Li Bingzhuo's daughter-in-law cooked the meal and brought down two bottles of good wine.
"Don't chatter there, slow down, you have prepared good wine and food at the other end, and it's rare for young people to get together during the Chinese New Year, so you still need to drink?"
"Yes, yes, he forgot about it when he saw you so preoccupied with listening to Da Xu.
Come on, Secretary Lin, Da Xu, Brother Han, shall we have something to eat and drink together? "Li Bingzhuo hurriedly dragged everyone over.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Heartbeat
chapters.content:
Chapter 269 Heartbeat
Xu Shiyan drank too much, and was finally sent home by Li Chengrong.
"Sister-in-law, Brother Xu drank too much at noon today. I'm really sorry. My dad and the others are happy today and drank a lot."
Li Chengrong was young and didn't drink a few sips. The others, including Han Wenzhong, all drank totteringly.
Li Chengrong sent Lin Qiyue home first, and then sent Xu Shiyan back.
Su Anying and her two younger sisters were looking after Clivia in the old house in Dongtou, when they heard some movement outside, they came out to look.
In the end, she saw her man staggering after drinking, and was helped in by Li Chengrong.
"My God, how much alcohol have you been drinking?"
Su Anying knew a little about her man's drinking capacity, Xu Shiyan would not drink so much easily.
What happened today? Can you still drink to this point?
"Daughter-in-law, there is a happy event today, I will tell you later."
Although Xu Shiyan drank a lot, he was still sane. When he saw his daughter-in-law, he said with a smile.
When Su Anying saw her husband's virtue, she was very angry, but she couldn't say anything in front of Li Chengrong.
He could only come forward to support Xu Shiyan, "Let's go, let's go into the house.
Xiao Li, thank you, I even sent Brother Xu home after such a long journey. "
No matter how angry she is, she can't get angry in front of outsiders. Su Anying smiled and thanked Li Chengrong.
"Sister-in-law, don't thank me, I'm so embarrassed."
Li Chengrong was young, so he felt that in his own home, he was very sorry for drinking others like this.
But I have nothing to do? My father took the lead in drinking, and drank less than anyone else. At that time, the family probably vomited several times.
Anyway, Su Anying vomited and made trouble, which is fine.
"Sister-in-law, you are leaving the house now, and he will take good care of you, Brother Xu."
Xu Shiyan scratched his head sheepishly, bid farewell to Su Anhua, and left the Xu family.
"Hey, Dali, hurry up, the road is slippery, and it's getting early, go back and be careful."
At that time, the frost thawed at noon and the temperature dropped in the evening. The road was like a mirror, slippery when walking.
"Understood, sister-in-law, let him go back to the house slowly." Xu Shiyan waved his hand and walked slowly.
I just left, Li Chengrong and Su Anfang came out from the old house.
"Seventh sister, was this a nerd just now? You looked at the image behind you."
Li Chengrong glanced at the small door, only looking at the back, he didn't look like the nerd who always came to Su Anying later.
"Well, yes, you and me.
His brother-in-law went to the side of the field today, probably drinking with the people in the field, how did he drink? The calendar was sent back. "
There was someone behind her eyes, Su An angrily gouged out her husband's eyes.
Li Chengrong and the sisters covered their mouths and snickered, and quickly helped Su Anhua **** Su Anying back out of the house.
As soon as Su Anying came back to her home, she didn't care about these things, and fell asleep.
That sleep, I slept until four o'clock in the evening, and I woke up.
"Daughter-in-law, what time is it?"
Su Anying just woke up, and she seemed to understand in a daze, so she asked Wu Changzhu.
"What time does he care? Go to sleep, sleep for eight days or two at least?"
Why do you drink so little alcohol? Does he know what his own physique is? "
Su An gave her husband a blank look. Since the Chinese New Year, that guy has been drinking a lot, and he drinks less when he moves.
How can a good person drink like that? What if something goes wrong with drinking someday?
Su Anhua said, but she went to the ground very quickly, poured some warm water, and handed it to Su Anying.
Drunk people are thirsty, and drinking saliva can make them feel better.
Su Anying took the tea mug and drank all the water in one go, only then did she feel refreshed.
"Don't mention it, today I had a drink with Uncle Han, Brother Limin, Secretary Lin who hadn't yet joined the scene, and the manager of the first branch, and it wasn't my father Wu Changzhu.
Whoops, those few are really drinkable, and at the very end, they all got on the ground. "
Su Anying shook her head and smiled wryly, I also want to drink so little wine, so I just keep trying to persuade you, what's the matter?
"Daughter-in-law, there is really nothing to discuss with him."
Su Anying remembered that Secretary Lin wanted me to participate as a technical consultant, so she hurriedly told Su Anhua.
"Brother Limin gave the idea to put the farm and flower company in his name.
In the past, he started a company to do business, and when you got off work, what did he think of it? "Actually, Su Anying thinks that proposal is wrong and quite reasonable.
"He wait a moment, let you stroke.
One participant wanted him to work here as a technical consultant. He was no longer a worker before. He earned wages, received subsidies, and ate food supplies, right? "
Su Anhua wasn't a bit confused, did you mean it was difficult to recruit workers?
In the future, I heard people say that only a few of the recruits are married. Su Anying is married and has no children. Can she still recruit workers as workers?
And what kind of technical consultant, paid according to the minimum wage of technicians? Then why doesn't it sound a bit suspenseful?
"However, he wanted you to take over from him and take care of the farm and Clivia? Is that what he meant?
You have even taught yourself, he thinks you can take care of it? "
Su Anhua has no confidence in herself. You learn a lot every day, so when you came to Xiaoying Commune to hold a literacy class, you learned a little bit.
In those years, I just had enough to eat, and now I want you to take care of so few things? can you do it
"Why don't you care about it? He is so stupid, so he can learn it if he knows it.
Daughter-in-law, you want to tell him later that he has to learn.
We are looking for less education, as long as we can read special books and be able to settle accounts.
If so, he will understand what we are doing when the seven cubs are young.
When the time comes, just wait for us to fool him. "
Su Anying is full of confidence in her daughter-in-law. My daughter-in-law is stupid and slow to learn.
As long as you are willing to endure hardship with your heart, it is too late to study now.
When Su Anying said something else, Wu Changzhu still didn't care. When he mentioned the seven big ones, Su Anhua immediately widened her eyes.
"Hey, but is it? When we were young, and mischievously fooled you, you can see it. This is okay."
Both of them were able to study hard, and they only hoped that the children would be good-for-nothing and pass the primary school entrance examination in the future.
But it’s definitely okay to be able to fool those brats.
"From what he said, do you really want to participate?"
To be honest, Su Anhua was also very moved. In those days, who was looking forward to being a worker?
Good workers, no wages due to wind and rain, and no subsidies.
Although the workers who participated in the field also contributed a little effort, their treatment was low, and they hadn't had a break before, so what good things?
"Well, I didn't have that idea, so did I ask his opinion first?
Ask him first, ask parents tomorrow morning, and then have to go to Secretary Yu and Secretary Chen to ask our opinions. "
Speaking from the bottom of her heart, Su Anying is also willing to participate.
It's for other reasons, just because of Lin Qiyue's sentence, Su Anying can't be allowed to go to the rural primary school to study.
Before she was reborn and came back, Su Anying discovered that being educated is really okay.
Rebirth is definitely a sharp weapon to kill everything in seconds, and it is even possible to make up for the lack of knowledge.
I guess you have a little less experience than others, but the experience will run out sooner or later.
The combination of knowledge and experience can create more value.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at one o'clock. Thank you for your support. There are fewer genuine books, all on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 270: agree with
chapters.content:
Chapter 270 Approval
"At the wine table, Secretary Lin told me that in a year or two, the attendees will find a way to send me to the Agricultural University to study.
This is different from the college entrance examination and the former college students of workers, peasants and soldiers. This belongs to adult education, but the academic qualifications are recognized by the state. "
These days, a college degree is still very valuable, no matter what kind it is, even if it is a correspondence course or a night university, the unit will recognize it.
Unlike in the future, it must be admitted after graduating from a full-time university.
This is what attracted Xu Shiyan the most.
Because in these years, it is impossible for ordinary people to go to college except for the college entrance examination.
In fact, he doesn't want to pay for that little salary and benefits, but this study is too attractive, and he really can't refuse it.
When he was reborn and came back, Xu Shiyan really thought that in the future, his wife and children would be hot on the bed, and he would just live a normal life without being rich.
Grow some ginseng, educate the children well, and then quietly buy a few houses in the future.
Waiting for the demolition, and some money in my hand when I am old, I live a good life.
But it's been a long time since I came back, and I found that some things are really as simple as I thought.
In the torrent of the times, there will be an invisible force pushing you forward, so you have to work hard to move forward.
From ground guns and pickaxes at the beginning, to ginseng fertilizer later, as Xu Shiyan's name became bigger and bigger, correspondingly, the responsibility will also be heavier.
Maybe Xu Shiyan thought too much? Taking yourself too seriously?
Anyway, he felt that it was not enough to dawdle around, and he had to plan for the future.
I dare to say that I have made no small changes to history, and I dare say that I have made no small contributions to my hometown, but there are a lot of small things, and I guess they still have no impact.
For example, in the future, the output of the seventh team participating in the field has hit a record low, what next? What should I do?
Is that influence good or bad for the future direction?
Lack of knowledge limits Su Anying's vision and makes me unable to predict the future without mistakes.
The experience of rebirth is not yet representative of everything, so I want to study.
Use knowledge to enrich yourself and lower your vision and pattern, maybe it will be useless in the future?
So on that matter, I really need to discuss it with Liang Yuanjun and Secretary Chen and listen to our opinions.
"Anyway, you think, if our father and mother know that he can go to a factory as a worker, we will be very happy.
To be honest, you also refused, so there are few good things.
He went to work as a technical consultant, but he was tired and earned little money, which was great. "
Liang Yuanjun gave some advice, but you have the conditions to support your husband's decision.
Whether Su Anying goes to participate in the game or stays in the agricultural team, for Liang Yuanjun, it's all good.
Su Anying laughed as soon as she heard it. That's my wife.
Who was that tigress just now? It seems to be acquainted.
"Come on, daughter-in-law, let's take the child to bed. You slept all morning, and you were sleepy at the time. Go read a book."
Just woke up, how can I fall asleep? Just read a book.
Liang Yuanjun also said something else, coaxing the children to sleep.
In the early morning of the fourth day of the first lunar month, Su Anying ran to her parents and told them what happened yesterday.
"Dad, Mom, do they think that will work?"
"Success, how is this a success? Oh my god, I dreamed that your son is going to be a worker?
Or technical advisor? According to the minimum wage for technicians?
Your God, is that a hundred times weaker than Xiaoan Coal Mine, which is also a worker and a farmer?
Old Ba, he told his father, if that’s the case, what level of work should he be? When Xu Chenghou heard it, he slapped his calf happily.
It is also a worker and a farmer. If you have an agricultural household registration and do industrial work, you are considered a regular worker, just like a temporary worker.
Xu Chenghou thought it was good, because his son was willing to go, and scolded him bloody.
Nowadays, they are full-fledged workers of the whole people. They are paid wages, receive red cards, and do not have various allowances and benefits.
If Xu Chenghou's head was squeezed by the door, how could he refuse? At that time, I was so happy that I had to jump low.
The eighth son is promising, and he was able to break the rules and recruit workers to participate in the competition. Who would be envious if he said it?
"Father, to be honest, you also understand. Oh, don't care about the level of workers, the salary is high anyway."
Liang Yuanjun scratched his head, I really understand those.
"You heard from Brother Limin that the salaries of the technicians participating in the field are quite low, and there are no various allowances, and the treatment is quite good."
Join the field, talk to the Forestry Bureau, this is definitely a good unit.
Let’s not talk about agricultural workers, even family members, it is so difficult to recruit workers.
Now it’s all a carrot and a hole, and the son has to take the place of the father to go to get off work. How many people are easy to recruit like Li Chengrong.
"That's it, you tell him, hurry up and come and go to get off work.
That opportunity is only once in a lifetime, let him regret it if he misses it.
At the end of Team Seven, he went to discuss with Secretary Yu to see what he said.
If you want to talk, just follow Limin's recruiting, his wife and children's household registration is on the other side, and the land should be divided.
His father, you can still do it. There are no mallets in these fields outside the house, so you can plant them, and he will worry about everything. "
Xu Chenghou patted his chest and assured that Liang Yuanjun will take care of those things, and Su Anying only needs to get off work properly, and I will take care of everything outside the house.
Just like that, Su Anying was chased away by her father, and hurried to find Liang Yuanjun.
When Xu Shiyan saw that Su Anying was looking for me, he thought it was a matter of Kansan, and the Xu family changed their minds again.
As a result, when he heard it, well, Liang Yuanjun's jaw almost dropped in shock.
"Da Xu, it is said that you are the secretary of the seventh team, he is so talented, if you have to desperately keep him, you will let him go.
But our man is such a person. He has contributed a lot to our team in the years since he came to the seventh team. Now that he has no future, his uncle can stop him anyway. "
"You will say in the future that his child will be successful in the future.
Originally, you wanted to train him as your successor, and you gave him that position before.
But our seventh team is still too big after all, he stays with us, Qu Cai.
A field trip, this is a state-run field directly under the county, if he hadn't developed better than that in the past.
Uncle supports him, such a good opportunity, we can miss it. "
Xu Shiyan is a fastidious person with no style, so he is definitely a special person.
When he heard that Su Anying was favored by a participating secretary and wanted to be transferred to be a technical consultant, Liang Yuanjun was even more unhappy than Xu Chenghou.
"In that case, you can give him a trick. He will be at your place at noon this afternoon and ask his aunt to cook some delicious dishes. You invite Secretary Chen over.
Let’s discuss that matter outside the house first, and let a member of the party, Secretary Lin, go through the process.
In that way, it doesn’t matter who it is, it’s all faults. We’re recruiting formally, right? "
If it is said, it must be Xu Shiyan, after all, he has been working for all those years, and he is not thoughtful.
Without the support of Secretary Chen and me, no matter how jealous others are, it would be useless to name important people in the field.
Xu Shiyan's character was straightforward, he did what he said, and immediately told his wife, and then went to Secretary Chen's house.
The commune was too busy for the young Chinese New Year, so Chen Jianzhang felt uncomfortable and agreed, and followed Xu Shiyan to Yu's house.
I met Su Anying over there, and before I knew everything about it, I also agreed with Su Anying's participation.

chapters.title: Chapter 271: team leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 271 Leader
"Xiao Xu, you are a good comrade and a talent.
Our commune and your brigade have enjoyed a lot of glory with you. No one dares to deny your credit for this.
To be honest, if you develop in the agricultural team, you will be out of talent and you will not be able to develop.
Our commune is incomparable to Yishenchang, which is a county-owned unit, and now it is under the jurisdiction of Fusong Ginseng Company.
I heard that our county ginseng antler company is going to cooperate with Jilin Agricultural University and the Provincial Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine to establish a county ginseng antler research institute.
Xiao Xu, if you work hard in the field and try hard to get into the research institute, then you will be amazing. "
Chen Jianzhang has great expectations for Xu Shiyan.
It should be said that both Chen Jianzhang and Yu Shouguang have a mind and vision, and they are not the kind of people who only care about self-interest.
So the two of them are very supportive of Xu Shiyan going to work in a field.
In their view, this is definitely a good thing. Xu Shiyan went to Yichang as a technical consultant and concentrated on researching the technology of participating in the industry. In the future, not only Yichang will benefit.
Waiting for the technology to mature, it must be promoted throughout the county, and Donggang Commune will definitely follow suit.
Donggang Commune is an agricultural commune. Without such a large amount of funds and strength for technology research and development, naturally it cannot support Xu Shiyan.
What Xu Shiyan did was beneficial to Donggang Commune and the development of Fusong's ginseng industry.
If his ideas can be realized, then the ginseng industry and economic level of the entire Erxian County will have a big leap.
Good thing, must support.
"Just do as Lao Yu said, the farm and the flower company are all in the name of his wife, and the commune and the team will help him.
As for him, he was at the front to make suggestions, his wife came forward, and these young people outside their team were assistants.
Let’s make performance first. If it can drive the local economy and make fewer people rich, who has nothing to say? "
Lin Qiyue made a final decision, and the matter was settled.
Without the endorsement of the secretary of the commune and the secretary of the team, what else is Chen Jianzhang worried about?
Immediately, I did all the things that should be done, found Secretary Lin, and made it clear that I wanted to go to Yishen after get off work.
When Qu Guiying heard this, she was very depressed, and immediately sent a report.
Relevant leaders outside the county received the report, and first scolded Xu Shiyan as a real thief.
Qu Guiying's name is known to everyone outside the county, and the ginseng production of the seventh team last year was jealous.
This half-jin club, soaked in wine, was moved from Lin Qiyue's desk to the desk of the chief secretary in charge of the county, and at the top, it was sent out of the province.
"Well, it's good to go to the competition, after all, he is the oldest participant outside our county.
The conditions here are better than others, and there is no development.
Look, without the participation of Da Xu, once you participate in the game, you can really make some ordinary things. "
Several leaders had no expectations for this, so the report was approved very quickly as soon as they participated.
Chen Jianzhang was transferred from the No. 7 Team of Donggang Commune to the No. 1 Participating Field as a technical consultant, and his salary was calculated as that of a first-class worker.
It can be rated as a fourth grade in one go, and many veteran skilled workers will be rated as a lower grade for a lifetime.
Chen Jianzhang came to participate in the field, but he didn't make any contribution, so he directly gave it to the fourth-level worker, and others were convinced.
Of course, that level is also very good. There are seven participants in the entire county, and there is only one first-level technician.
There is a way, but Chen Jianzhang doesn't have that ability.
If others are convinced, then find a way to increase the production of ginseng on the basis of the current situation created by Chen Jianzhang, and that will do.
Yes, that kind of opportunity is too rare. The current output of ginseng per foot is seventy-seven catties, which is not very low, and it is difficult to make a breakthrough.
The report was approved, and the indicators for the transformation from rural areas to non-agricultural areas were directly issued by outside the county.
Qu Guiying brought a certificate of participation, the indicator of rural conversion to non-government, and a letter of introduction for the transfer of household registration, and moved out of her household registration to the team, and then went to the first participation venue to go through the entry procedures.
"Okay, welcome to Team Leader Xu. From now on, he will lead the backbone of the technical team to grasp the production technology of our field.
The formulation of technical specifications and standards is mainly to tackle the technical problems of comprehensive utilization of ginseng land, and strive to generate income for our ginseng as soon as possible. "
All the leaders attending the venue held a large-scale welcome party for Chen Jianzhang. Xu Shiyan, on behalf of all the staff present, welcomed Chen Jianzhang's arrival.
A participant does not have his own field department, and has a very small yard.
Chen Jianzhang is a technical consultant and the leader of the technical team. The front office of the field department specially cleaned up an office for Qu Guiying to use.
Next door, a small office, is where the technical team and other people are.
Han Limin and Li Chengrong are also in the technical group, which is now led by Chen Jianzhang.
On the first day at the unit, Qu Guiying met and chatted with colleagues in the technical group.
The people in the technical group were not the ones who learned to prepare ginseng fertilizers from Chen Jianzhang at the beginning. They basically knew each other, and it was wrong to get along with each other afterwards.
So when Xiaojia knew that the leader of the technical team was Chen Jianzhang, there was some resistance.
At the beginning we learned from him, but now he is transferred to be the team leader, which is reasonable.
Newly arrived at a place, Qu Guiying also has a slow schedule to arrange work plans, just chatting with Xiaojia to learn more about the situation after each visit.
After all, Chen Jianzhang is an employee who participated in the field, and I only heard about some things. Some specific matters need to be understood in detail.
After chatting with Xiaojia for a while, Chen Jianzhang asked for some materials that had been planted in the field in recent years. He hadn't processed the production report of the factory in those years, so he took it back to his office and looked at it sloppily.
I understood something, so I asked Han Limin.
Chen Jianzhang has never been aggressive in his work, but focused on safety. He must not make plans for the new year until he has a deep understanding.
Besides, when was that? There is also the first month of the month, and the mountain is white, and I have done enough work. Even if I make the best plan, it is useless?
So Chen Jianzhang is slow at all, just read the materials quickly.
The day's shift just passed, and she went to work at seven o'clock, and Qu Guiying went home by bicycle.
As soon as I got home and sat down, and the water was still drunk, Zhao Jianshe and his team rushed back.
"Brother, he is too brotherly.
After sending you guys out to collect flower seedlings, he went to the field to get off work. "
That small voice, you can guess it is Zhao Jianshe.
"But is it? Mynah, he went to a field to get off work, what do you guys do?
The backbone is here, how many of you are dumbfounded? "Yang Chunming and others followed closely behind.
In those few years, Chen Jianzhang was the leader of Xiaojia, followed Qu Guiying to earn money and learn skills, and they all regarded Chen Jianzhang as the leader and backbone.
Now that Chen Jianzhang is looking for a place to go to get off work, we all know what to do next.
"Come on, let's all sit back and sit down, let's sit up and talk.
Originally, you also thought about it, when we were looking for them a few days ago, let’s sit down and talk about the next thing.
Just right, let me take this opportunity to talk about it.
Daughter-in-law, don’t go to the kitchen for him to work. He needs to participate in those things going forward. Come, he will sit too. "
Qu Guiying called Su Anying over, and the Xiao family sat down and discussed together.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Share confirmation
chapters.content:
Chapter 272 Share Confirmation
"I went to work in a ginseng field, not because of the one hundred and eighty salary, but mainly because I wanted to study something."
Xu Shiyan called the brothers to sit down, poured everyone a glass of water, and then spoke.
"In our brigade, let alone the brigade, the commune doesn't have that condition.
One participation is different from our agricultural team. They really have that strength, so it’s not leaving you behind, it’s a serious matter. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, he knew that the brothers didn't really blame him, they were just joking around.
"I go to work, and the farm and flower company are all under your sister-in-law's name.
In the future, you will have to rely on the help of your brothers. After all, your sister-in-law is young and inexperienced. "
Xu Shiyan bowed his hands to everyone, thanking them in advance.
