"Don't worry, I just won't participate in these things on the surface, I will give you ideas behind the scenes."
After all, he has a job, holds a solid job, and develops a side job outside, so it's not good for people to know.
"Oh, I see, the third brother moved behind the scenes and pushed the third sister-in-law to the front.
Oops, then my third sister-in-law is doing really well. In the future, I won’t be able to comment on heroines, March 8 red-banner bearers, etc.? "
Everyone understood what Xu Shiyan meant, and now they were relieved, and they were in the mood to laugh.
"That's necessary, our third sister-in-law is so capable, she will definitely be able to be evaluated in a few years.
It’s still because you two are amazing, why don’t you fill the wall with certificates in the future? "Everyone was joking.
Su Anying was embarrassed to be disturbed by these people, but she tried her best to stay flustered.
"It's just you, waiting for the spring, the flower shed is built on the farm, and the daughters-in-law of their family will also come to work.
Going forward, their women are going to farm and plant sticks, and the farms and flower companies are under your control. "
Xu Shiyan discussed with Su Anying about that, and you think that is more reasonable.
The children in these families are all younger. Some of them should go to college, some should go to education class, and no one can take care of them no matter how old they are.
The daughters-in-law of each family should also be liberated and do something.
Who said that men can only circle around the pot? In the future, men will go to the land to earn work points, and now they can also do some careers.
Zhao Jianshe and the others were not surprised when they heard this, and then laughed. "Yes, yes, sister-in-law has no idea."
It’s okay, the daughter-in-law doesn’t have serious business to do, so she can save herself from being pleasing to the eyes at home all day, and even the women suffer.
Explained the matter of going to get off work, and then came to Siguo to report, and went to Taodenghua to plant flower seedlings everywhere in those few days.
Not to mention, there are many kinds of flowers, especially flower seeds, which are the best things to find. A Clivia can bear more than a dozen seeds when it blooms.
Flowers who have grown up may not be willing to sell, but there is a problem with the flower seeds.
A flower grows from 10 to 20 cents. If you don’t have it, it’s a lot to save. It’s good to sell it for some money, and save it to buy a few pieces of candy for your children.
"Not many households have told you to wait for this year's seeds to come up, and keep them all for us. If there are big seedlings, they will also keep them."
Zhao Jianshe and the others kept the big seedlings at home. The seeds were packed outside the cloth pockets, and they were all handed to Su Anying.
"Okay, that's good. We are accepting small ones, so we need big seedlings and flower seeds, and the cost is high."
A seed costs at least 20 cents, and when it grows into two-year seedlings, it can be sold for tens of dollars. What can compare with that profit?
Su Anying asked Xu Shiyan to collect all the seeds, and then keep an account, how much each family collected, and how much they spent.
"We made an agreement at the beginning. If we don't have money to earn together, of course we have to keep our word, but we don't have a charter for who gets more or less.
Brothers, let’s talk about it. In our flower company, each person owns a specific shareholding, and how is the dividend calculated? "
I have had time to talk about it since then. Now that so few seeds and big seedlings have been recovered, the flower company has no certain scale, and there should be no rules and regulations.
"Brother, he has the final say on that matter. You all followed him to fight wolves, and everything was arranged by him."
The little guy is used to following Su Penggu. Of course, Su Anying has the final say on that kind of thing.
To tell the truth, don’t look at how little flowers and seedlings have been collected recently, in fact, there is really a lot of money spent.
As for the matter, it is about earning more or less, and it is less than Bai Jian. We trust Su Anying, so we also care about earning more or less.
"Well, tell me what you think.
The entire flower company, you own half of the shares, and the few of them still have the other half. "
The idea came from Su Anying, and I was also responsible for the field and technology. I was also the main force in the previous sales, so I took it for granted.
"Where you are outside, some will be distributed to Director Guo of the Forestry Bureau, not your seventh brother, our team and the commune.
At that time, you can see how to arrange it. Anyway, it is going out from you, so they will manage it. "
Guo Shouye's share is more than that of Zhao Jianshe and us. As for outside the team and the commune, Su Anying still has to figure out how to give it.
We have to wait until Clivia has all been sold to see how much we can earn. There is no way to make less, and there is no idea to make more.
"Brother, if that's the case, he's still taking the lead.
If so, Director Guo’s role should also come from you. "
Yang Chunming thinks that those of us are not taking advantage of it, as if we still have a lot of shares. Is that too good?
"Yes, let's do as you said. We are thinking very well now, but we still have to decide how much money we will earn in the future.
If you earn more in the future, just don’t blame you, brothers. "
According to Su Penggu’s thinking, if I can make money, but how much I earn, I have a bottom line in my heart, and I will save ugly words later, so as to avoid mutual resentment in the past.
"This is definitely possible, Brother Xu is worried, that matter is to control compensation, and it will affect the relationship between our buddies.
Even if there is money to be made in the future, whoever turns his face will be unhappy, and you will be the first to kick me. "Huang failed to express his position quickly.
"Yes, yes, yes, if anyone turns his face because of that little thing, you little guys will fall in love with me." Everyone echoed.
Just like that, the affairs of the flower company were settled, so Su Penggu took out a pen and paper, and wrote an agreement according to the content of the conversation just now.
It was made in duplicate, and everyone signed and signed below, even Xu Shiyan pressed their fingerprints.
However, the first copy was given to Xu Shiyan for safekeeping, and the other copy was given to Zhou Qingguo for safekeeping.
That thing is not an adult before a gentleman. Without such a piece of paper, there were really no disputes before, at least there was no basis.
After the matter was discussed and the agreement was signed, Xu Shiyan saw that it was early, so he hurried to cook.
"Failure, Qingguo, they are sitting and talking first, you hurry up and cook, if you wait for a while, Xu Haiyuan will cry out hungry."
Children are mischievous all day long, do all kinds of work, consume less energy, and get hungry slowly.
Then cooking, this bear thing should be hungry.
Xu Shiyan hadn't finished his sentence yet, but Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, who knew who they had been crazy with for another day, retreated from the inside.
"Mom, is the meal ready? You're hungry."
"Hungry, hungry, hungry, I know I'm hungry all day long. He looked at the two of them, so where did he go to do it? These pants are full of mud."
No matter how gentle a mother is, she can instantly transform into a violent old mother when she sees a mud monkey made by her son and daughter-in-law.
Outside the house, a group of women looked at each other in dismay, smiling wryly, brat, what can we do? Start school now.

chapters.title: Chapter 273: february two
chapters.content:
Chapter 273 February 2
On March 1st, the seventeenth day of the first lunar month, the school starts.
Huang Shuqing, Huang Shuyun, Sun Yu, Xu Haiyuan were all sent to school by their parents.
Huang Shuqing is the oldest, and he attends Yuhong class for half a year, just in time for elementary school.
Sun Yu and Huang Shuyun will be next year. As for Xu Haiyuan, he will only be six years old after the new year, and he will not be able to go to elementary school until the next year.
These older ones have gone to Yuhong class, and the house is much quieter.
Xu Haiyuan was not at home, so no one took Xu Jinping to do it. The little girl could only go to Su Lijuan and others to play.
Girls are quieter, so they don’t go to the house to climb the house to cause trouble, most of them are playing house.
Get a doll, find a scarf or pillow towel to wrap it in, pretend to feed and water, and coax her to sleep.
Or, get some broken bowls, broken tiles, etc., and then get some dead branches and leaves, and some vegetable leaves and wild fruits in summer.
Add some sand or something, stir it, and cook like an adult.
Otherwise, put the scarf or quilt at home around the body, as a big skirt or cloak.
Anyway, boys play with knives and guns, and girls play tricks by pretending to be mothers.
"Daughter-in-law, who is crying in our bathroom? Why do I hear someone crying?"
This day, Xu Shiyan had nothing to do and went home early, but when he entered the yard, he heard someone crying in the toilet.
Xu Shiyan felt strange, so he asked Su Anying.
"It's Pingping's friend, that is, Lijuan, the eldest son of the Su family in the grain depot at the west end of the martyr's tomb.
The child is constipated and dry, unable to poop, and crying in the toilet.
Oops, your persuasion just now was helpful. "Zhou Guilan sighed upon hearing this.
"Next time, too, squatting outside the toilet for a long time to pull out, not to cry.
It was the sister-in-law of the Su family who came here, scolded the child well, and scolded him away. "
The women of the Su family get off work in the grain depot, the daughter-in-law has a job, and there are seven young men outside the family. It seems that there is no mother to support.
So the burden is quite heavy, and the life away from home is also special. Although there is enough food, daily oil and water are too much.
As for that person, if there is oil and water outside the stomach, he will be very constipated.
Su Lijuan may have had a trumpet for several days. Today, she was playing at Xu's house and said she wanted to go to the toilet, but she couldn't pull it out no matter how squatting here.
This child loves to cry at first, but when it was over, he squatted outside the toilet and cried.
Hong Bozhe smiled and shook his head after listening, "Daughter-in-law, is there no honey and sesame oil in our house?
He finds out, you can boil some honey and sesame oil for the child and drink it. "
Su Lijuan is a big girl, whom Xu Jinping has met a few times. She is pretty, and she speaks rudely. She plays well with Hong Bozhe.
The villain has the heart to suffer the child, but if there is no other way, he can make the child cry in the toilet all the time.
When Hong Bozhe heard this, he quickly took out honey and sesame oil from the cabinet.
Xu Jinping took it to the kitchen, set up bricks behind the stove to make a fire, then found a spoon for rice, and poured wild honey and a little water outside.
Before boiling, turn back to remove the sesame oil, stir well and let cool.
Here, Zhou Guilan coaxed Su Lijuan out of the toilet, led the eldest girl back out of the house, and then gave the eldest girl the honey sesame oil to drink.
"How is it? Is it delicious?" Xu Jinping asked the big boy with a smile.
Honey is sweet, and sesame oil is added on the outside, can this be delicious? The big girl hated it so much that she even licked the spoon clean.
"It's delicious, thank you uncle."
The big girl knows what that is for, so she thinks that someone gave you something delicious, so thank you quickly.
"It's thanks, I can pull it off when I get home later.
Further forward, the stomach is comfortable, it can be pulled out, and it can cry. You have to find a villain to find a way. Do you understand? "
For such a big child, it is very difficult to poop. No wonder you cry.
"Well, I see, uncle, aunt, you go home first, and come to play with Pingping tomorrow."
The eldest girl was very rude. Before saying goodbye to Xu Jinping and Zhou Guilan obediently, she chatted with Su Anying for a few more words before leaving and returning home.
Su Lijuan went home, and it was late at night, so she pulled it smoothly.
Su Lijuan's mother found it strange, so she asked her boyfriend why he was crying today.
Although Su Lijuan is big, she has a pretty good memory. She said that today at Xu’s house, uncle and aunt gave you fragrant and sweet water, so it would be very difficult for you to poop.
When Hong Bojuan's mother heard this, she kept it out of her mind. When she met Hong Bozhe by chance a few days ago, she probably had to ask Zhou Guilan what she was drinking.
Hong Bozhe told you the recipe, and asked Su Anying to bring Su Lijuan a bottle of wild honey.
At the end of the Su family, the children were sometimes asked to bring something to the other side, and they came and went, and the two families lost contact.
In a blink of an eye, the first month passed, and it was the day when the seven dragons raised their heads in July.
On July 7th, the local custom is to eat pork head meat and fried jelly beans.
As for the Xu family, there is not one thing to do yet, so this is an introduction to stir-fry sauce.
People from the Northeast are so open-mouthed, are there no jokes? Give a Northeast person a can of sauce, and the whole Ershan can be eaten up.
That is an exaggeration, but the life of Northeast people is indeed free from sauce, everything can be dipped in sauce, and life can be lived without sauce.
There are so few ways to make small sauce, and no one makes sauce cubes.
Before natural fermentation, remove the hyphae on the inside and outside, cut into pieces, boil water with pepper, small ingredients, ginger, and salt, pour it under the cleaned crushed sauce cubes, and put it in a tank to continue fermentation.
When the weather is fine, you have to put the sauce tank inside to dry, and while drying, skim off the fermented white cattail below, and it will be delicious when it is fermented.
Xu's family uses that method to make sauce, but fry the sauce primer first.
Turn the corn noodles back out of the pot, and stir-fry over low heat until it turns brown and gives off a burnt aroma.
Then step back to remove an appropriate amount of water, stir and stir evenly while it is cold, and form small **** with small bowl mouths.
In particular, a layer of white flour will be rolled in the ball, so that the ball is difficult to dry out.
Wait until the **** are completely cool and the skin is slightly dry, put them outside the basket covered with bean straw, and find a cool place to ferment.
Xu Shiyan hates putting it under the door frame of the kitchen door.
Nail a shelf under the door frame of the kitchen, put the basket under the shelf, the kitchen is cool and not air-conditioned, it is the best place for fermented sauce introduction.
After two months of fermentation, a layer of green hair grows on the inside and outside of the sauce primer, and the fermentation is complete if there is no red mycelium on the outside before breaking.
The two families eat sauce, and it is enough to stir-fry more sauce primers.
Fortunately, without the help of Su Anfang and Su Anhua, Xu Shiyan fried two pots of corn noodles, rolled them into a dozen balls, and put them up to ferment.
"Yingzi, let's make dumplings tonight.
There was no sauerkraut outside the tank, so he took it out and threw it several times, but there was no meat left, so let's make some sauerkraut and pork dumplings.
Eat there in the evening and celebrate the festival together. "
July 7th, Xiaoda is also a festival, and now the days are better, and Sister Su Anfang is not there yet, there must be something delicious, and the dumplings are arranged.
In the evening, when Hong Bozhe went to work, he saw that his house was locked, and he knew that he was with his parents.
As soon as I exited the door, I could smell the aroma of dumplings. When I exited the house, there were 81 plates of dumplings under the Kang table. There were only a few dishes in the middle, and one of them was pork head meat.
"Hey, what day is it today, so little delicious food?"
"July 7th, the people in his class even know what day it is today?
I also went to cut my hair. See if your hair has grown less? "
Xu Shiyan heard this, and glanced at his son. The one who got off work should be the one who is at home, even thinking about July 7th?
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at 1 o'clock. Thank you for your support. There are fewer genuine books, all on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: black blind man hurting
chapters.content:
Chapter 274 Black Blind Man Hurts People
Xu Shiyan slapped his forehead, "Oh, I'm so busy and confused, I can't even think about today, February 2."
Don’t blame him, this person who goes to work, he only remembers what day of the week it is, and who cares about the time of the lunar calendar?
Besides, Xu Shiyan has been busy in the field recently, and Xu Shiyan can't take care of other things.
"Go and wash your hands and come over to eat, do you want to drink? If you want to drink, let your mother heat the pot of wine, so we can have a drink?"
Xu Chenghou sat on the kang and asked his son with a smile.
Yo, Dad is in a good mood, do you want a drink? That must accompany you.
"Drink, I'm so tired these days, take two sips to relieve fatigue."
It’s the holidays, just drink as much as you want, but not too much.
So Xu Shiyan went to wash his hands.
Zhou Guilan found out her own jug, which is the kind of glass pot belly jug, which can hold four taels of wine when it is filled.
Zhou Guilan took a look, filled more than half of the pot, and then put it into the tea mug filled with hot water.
Xu Shiyan happened to take two wine cups from the kitchen, half a pair of small glasses, and each of them put one in front of them.
Xu Shiyan poured a glass for his father first, and then poured a glass for himself.
"What have you been up to lately? I heard from Fang'er and Hua'er that sometimes you come back very late?"
While the father and father were eating and drinking, Xu Chenghou asked his son.
"Oh, the whole Gastrodia elata strain is fermenting.
There are so many old ginseng fields in the field, and it is impossible to grow beans all of them, so I thought about planting some Gastrodia elata.
In the past few days, I have taken people to ferment the strains, waiting for the spring to harvest some Gastrodia elata, and plant them in the ground.
Start once a year before, and develop rapidly. "
Zeng Zhengyi went to a ginseng site, not to study the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land.
Before understanding the actual situation, Han Limin decided to develop Gastrodia elata and Asarum first, and then cultivate Schisandra chinensis and Earthworm.
I have encountered suitable land before, and then develop blueberries, indigo fruits, etc.
Fusong area later studied the technology of planting Gastrodia elata in old ginseng land, and passed the prefecture-level scientific and technological appraisal.
But it has been able to be promoted, mainly because the method is not a problem.
In those days, Han Limin intended to lead people to tackle the missing link.
In fact, it is also complicated. It is not that the cultivated Armillaria armillaria are piled up and fermented with oak wood segments.
Wait until the bottom of the oak wood section is covered with mycelia, and then bury the wood section and Armillaria fungus outside the ginseng field where the mallet was just raised last year, and put Gastrodia elata under it.
Gastrodia elata cubs will not be able to harvest next year after one year of growth.
Speaking of which, the growth period is shorter than that of ginseng. If the intention is correct, the benefits are also wrong.
Of course, that thing is complicated to say, but it is not difficult to do. It is not easy to work.
While the father and father were drinking, Zeng Zhengyi explained to his father. Xu Chenghou seemed to understand, but felt that my son is now very powerful, and he can even grow Gastrodia elata.
"What did he say about the asarum? Can you grow asarum in the ginseng ground?" The old man asked if he understood.
"Well, this one is actually complicated, it's not about planting an asarum tree seven feet away under the newly planted pond gang.
Just right, the mallet grows for eight years, and even the asarum is harvested. It kills two birds with one stone, uses the land rationally, and loses a share of income. "
In fact, just like that, asarum can’t repel insects, and planting asarum in Shendichi is also intended to prevent some insect damage, so it’s a win-win situation.
Of course, that is not too troublesome. If there is no separate Asarum nursery, it will be transplanted before the big seedlings are cultivated.
I later said that everything can only be done step by step, and slow is the way to go.
"In those few days, you didn't go down the mountain to pick up oak wood and saw it into pieces when you came back, so you have been going down the mountain with the car of the shop every day."
A small number of ginseng fields in the field are outside the Caozi River, and there is no cutting area every year.
At that time, the utilization rate of the cutting area was still low, and the forestry department transported away the small logs that became useful outside the cutting area.
There are some tree heads and branches left, or they are left to rot in place, or they are burned with fire.
Waiting for a few more years, the tree heads and branches are also good things, and they are all sold in piles and used as firewood for others.
Participants will discuss with the logging department that the remaining tree heads and branches will be harvested, and the workers will be left to go down, and the selected ones will be used for column feet, small joint poles, crossarms, and branches.
Because oak wood is relatively hard and is easy to nail, so a few times, the workers in the field are picking oak wood, and they are watching the ginseng pick it up and set it on fire.
Han Limin didn't bring people to go down the mountain to pick oak wood from the tops and branches of these trees, transport them up the mountain and saw them into sections for cultivating fungus sticks.
"Oh, you guys, be careful, there may be no wild beasts down the mountain.
At that time, did the blind man sleep so deeply in winter? If he woke up, he would hurt others. "
Xu Chenghou listened, and probably had to give some advice.
"It should be that, this side is next to the field, Uncle Han, we always go back to the mountains to hunt in winter, so there are probably no wild animals in the distance.
Something is going on, please pay less attention. "
Going down the mountain, everyone knows that nothing will happen. They are afraid of 10,000, just in case, so they should be more careful.
The father and father were chatting while eating dumplings and drinking wine, knowing it or not, Han Limin ate a plate of less dumplings, and ate more dishes.
"Oh, I'm full, today's dumplings are really delicious." Satisfied, Han Limin put down his chopsticks contentedly.
Others were already full, so they cleared the table, and Zeng Zhengyi and his wife took their children home to rest.
After picking oak wood for several days in a row, there was a lot of wood piled up in the front yard of the processing factory, and the bags of Armillaria fungus brought back from outside the county also arrived.
So on the seventh day, Han Limin followed him down the mountain, but took a few people to cut wood with a chainsaw in the front yard of the processing factory, and prepared to pile up the materials for fermentation.
Xu Shiyan brought a group of people down the mountain to continue picking oak trees.
"Shiyan, let's go down the mountain with a dog and a gun tomorrow."
In the morning, Xu Shiyan and others came back with the car, and when they saw Han Limin, Xu Shiyan said that.
"Huh? Take the dog down the mountain? What's wrong, there are no wild animals down the mountain?"
Han Limin heard that it was a dog and a gun, so there was nothing under the mountain?
"Well, I met a white blind man when I went down the mountain today." Xu Shiyan explained what happened in a complicated way.
It was seventeen years ago, and the few people who participated in the first branch of the field went down the mountain one after another.
There were no two of them, and a Tiancangzi was found outside the mountain two days later.
Those two people had selfish intentions, just thinking not to alarm others, we two secretly went to kill the bear outside the warehouse here, how much can we sell for a bear bile.
Those two people took their guns to kill Di Cangzi during the day, but they fell into the empty city plan of the blind man.
The blind man came out of the tree hole after a while, and hid in front of the two of them. While they were paying attention, he jumped down.
One of them fired in a panic, wounding Bai Xiazi and angering Bai Xiazi.
Blind man is like a wild boar, a wild boar will run away when it sees a gun, but blind man will go down with the gun.
This man only had time to fire two shots, both of which hit vital points in the panic, but was knocked down by the white blind man almost every time.
One of them was sat down by the blind man and almost died, and the other was bitten twice by the blind man, both of which were seriously injured.
If Xu Shiyan and others were working in the distance, and when they heard the cry for help, a group of people rushed over with axes and saws and rescued them, these two people would have died.
"Your father said, let him take the dog down the mountain tomorrow, and our two families will be together, and we will follow the trail and kill this white blind man."

chapters.title: Chapter 275: take the dog up the mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 275 Take the dog up the mountain
"Hasn't Uncle Han walked all over the neighborhood long ago? Why is there still Tiancangzi?"
Xu Shiyan felt strange, with Han Wenzhong's ability, he could still leave black blind people near the venue?
"My father said, it should be a hunchback, probably the black blind man who went to hibernate when he went down the mountain during the Chinese New Year, and he couldn't sleep well.
I was startled when those two people checked, and I came out of the tree hole early, which hurt people instead. "
Han Limin shook his head, according to the old man's explanation, it should be like this.
Xu Shiyan nodded, he can meet any situation when he goes hunting in the mountains, so he recited this when he caught up.
"The four dogs in my family didn't hunt last winter. I guess they all gave birth. I'm afraid it won't do much to bring them up the mountain."
Hound dogs become more powerful the more they work. If they don’t hunt for a long time, their skills will become rusty.
Last winter, Xu Shiyan was in the provincial capital, and Xu Chenghou didn't know how to hunt, so those dogs could only be tied in the yard, fearing that they would forget their skills.
"It's okay, there are still a few dogs in my house, and they will come out after a while." Han Limin waved his hand.
Xu Shiyan thinks about it, the dogs of the Han family are very powerful, and his own dogs are led by good dogs, so they can get acquainted quickly.
"Come on, let's go up the mountain tomorrow."
Actually, this hunter is also addicted to hunting. Xu Shiyan is not addicted to hunting. He is too busy with family affairs to take care of him.
But when he brought up the topic, he also missed it.
The next morning, instead of riding a bicycle, Xu Shiyan led four dogs and carried a gun.
This gun was bought before the farm was built. I bought two guns together, semi-automatic, mainly for the purpose of guarding the farm.
Going to work yesterday, Bu Qilun went over to pick up the ones that were easy to take back home, and carried them away this morning.
When we came to the oil depot in Canchang, all the workers were waiting for their cars at the oil depot.
Now, a small number of people in the venue recognize Han Limin, and most of them have to come over to say hello to Bu Qilun.
"Hey, Team Leader Xu, why are you still holding a dog and carrying a gun today, and you want to go down the mountain to hunt?"
"Well, did the two people we saw at the venue yesterday let the white blind man make trouble?
Your uncle Han said that he asked you to take down the dog and gun, and go back to the mountain with me today, and find and kill this white blind man, so it is safe for us to go down the mountain to work and so on. "
Bu Qilun’s work is actually so rigid, with a low degree of freedom.
I take people down the mountain, arrange things up, and do it if I like, and I can do it by hand.
So today I plan to go down and make arrangements to leave the mountain with Xu Shiyan.
As soon as that matter was brought up, everyone would have nothing to talk about.
"Oh, but is it? Yesterday you looked at the appearance of these two people, it was miserable.
One made the white blind man gnaw half of his face, and the other made the white blind man sit and all the feces and urine came out.
Carrying it to our Sanchang Health Center is absolutely fine, so is it sent out of the county as soon as possible? "
Speaking of the tragic situation of these two people, everyone looked horrified and pitiful. Even if they can be cured, they must also become disabled. What can they do before?
"Did you think that Team Leader Xu would still hunt? It's true. He is both civil and military, and he has no skills." No one praised Han Limin.
Now, Han Limin is a famous person participating in the competition, and everyone knows that Han Limin is leading the team to tackle key problems, trying to find ways to increase the income of participating in the competition.
If it comes true, the benefits for workers will be less in the past, which is very good.
While talking, the participating shuttle bus arrived, just two cars.
Caozihe Ginseng is quite far away, and there are not many commuting cars outside the site, which are dedicated to pulling workers down the mountain to work.
The car stopped, and a group of workers got out of the car slowly. With the help of Han Wenzhong, Han Limin got all seven dogs out of the car.
Hunting dogs have no rules, and it is annoying to go out, so before getting out of the car, they just lie here obediently and bark.
The car wobbled back to the outside of the channel, and came all the way to the field where the club was newly planted last year.
The workers were all making sheds at that time, and they got into the car and went straight out of the field.
The site that Xu Shiyan was looking at was inside, and the area that was planted the next year, I calculated the time, and Chi Yan waited there with the dog.
Han Limin and Han Wenzhong got into the car, got the dogs into the car, and met Xu Shiyan.
"Uncle, those dogs of your family went hunting last winter, and they didn't have any births. Let's serve as help dogs for his dogs today."
As soon as they met, Han Limin said.
"Okay, our family and four dogs go down together, how can we get this white blind man up."
Xu Shiyan nodded, I have no confidence in my dog.
In the following years, Bu Qilun and Xu Shiyan partnered to retreat to the mountains every winter to hunt. The dogs of the two families were also strangers to each other, and they would bite each other, so it was difficult to work together.
Eight people led four dogs and walked all the way to the place where the accident happened yesterday.
Not far away, Rhubarb, the head dog of the Xu family, and Qi Chuanzi, the head dog of the Han family, seemed to sense something and barked a few times towards the rear.
Needless to say, that is the scent of the blind man.
"He also said that the rhubarb was born from work. Is that good? Come on, let's go and have a look."
When Bu Qilun saw the situation, he laughed. He is a good dog, even if he works for a long time, his nose is as sensitive.
Rhubarb and Qichuanzi are both good dogs, and they are small in size. Once they find the trace of their prey, they get excited and try to move back.
As soon as the lead dog makes a noise, the other dogs will follow the lead dog, and the person who leads the dog will grab the rope.
"It's something, let go, let me go after it first, let's follow." Seeing that, Xu Shiyan could only untie the dog.
Han Limin also untied the ropes under the necks of his seven dogs, and saw Da Huang and Qi Chuanzi jump out as soon as they got up, barking as they ran.
The other dog followed closely, spread his legs and ran back.
Han Limin and Bu Qilun were old, with slow legs and feet, and walked slowly with their guns on their backs. Bu Qilun was also a little younger, so I walked ahead quickly.
"Just behind, he looked at a small poplar tree.
Your father said, after I went up the mountain last winter, I wandered around there, and I have seen it.
So I said, it must be before the Gregorian calendar year, the tree hole receded and the hunchbacked bear disappeared. "
Han Wenzhong pointed to a small thick poplar tree on the **** behind and said.
"Well, it's possible. Let's go and have a look."
Han Limin nodded, and the seven of them walked slowly to Xiao Yangshu.
At that time, the seven dogs of the Han family had already run far away, but the seven dogs of the Xu family wandered behind the little tree and continued to run back.
"It can be seen that the seven dogs of your family have given birth, and they stopped after running for a while."
Bu Qilun knew that at a glance, it was because he had been hunting in the mountains for a long time.
After Bu Qilun got off, he patted Rhubarb on the head, "Go, I'm waiting for you."
Rhubarb glanced at Han Limin, barked again in the direction of the small poplar tree, then turned around, and rushed out again with his dogs.
Han Limin was a little puzzled, feeling as if Rhubarb was a little too right, as if he was trying to tell me something.
What's going on?
"Let's go, let's hurry up, this white blind man is big, don't look injured, you probably have a hard fight."
Han Wenzhong saw Han Limin in a daze, so he hurriedly grabbed me.
"Well, let's go."
Han Limin also thought what was going on, so he followed Han Wenzhong and walked back at a slower pace.

chapters.title: Chapter 276: female bear
chapters.content:
Chapter 276 Female Bear
Generally speaking, if the black blind man in hibernation is disturbed, he will step up and go far.
Xu Shiyan and Han Limin are ready to go far today.
As a result, the two of them followed the dog, and after walking three or four miles away, they heard the dog barking wildly in front of them. As soon as they heard the sound, they had encountered prey.
"So fast?" Han Wenzhong and Xu Shiyan were surprised. Did they meet another beast on the way?
At this moment, they didn't care about anything else, each with their guns in hand, and trotted forward all the way to chase.
When I got closer, I saw nine dogs surrounded a black blind man. The black blind man must have been injured and it was not convenient for him to move around.
"That's it. Two people were injured yesterday. We rushed to it and drove it away."
Han Limin took a look and recognized that it was the one that hurt people yesterday.
"Strange, the injury doesn't look serious, why did you come here?"
No one can explain Han Limin's confusion. At this moment, Xu Shiyan and Han Limin are both armed with guns to keep an eye on the situation ahead, and whenever they find an opportunity, they will shoot and kill the blind man.
The dogs of the Han family are all fierce, and Er Chuanzi is the only dog ​​who dares to fight hard with a black blind man.
Although Xiao Huang hadn't hunted for a long time, he was not afraid, and took out the black blind man's back door when he saw the right opportunity.
The black blind man took a bite from Xiao Huang, the pain was unbearable, he turned around, raised his paw to slap Xiao Huang, Xiao Huang was smart, turned around and ran away.
After all, it’s been too long since he hasn’t hunted, so he moved a little slower, and got hit on the butt, and the black blind man’s sharp claws cut through the fur, leaving a bloodstain.
At any rate, he was seriously injured, so Rhubarb dodged away with a howl.
When my dog ​​saw that, he rushed down with red eyes.
The one who bit the blind man's buttocks, the one who pulled out his belly, and the one that bit his back elbow, the four dogs swarmed down, biting wherever they caught.
One injured and came in, and I continued with the other.
No matter how powerful the white blind man is, he can only be bitten by four dogs.
Especially Rhubarb and Hua Dianer, they are both dogs digging out the front door, and the two of them took a bite when they got the chance.
The blind man fought and left, but was finally forced down a tree by a group of dogs.
Once the white blind man got off the tree, the dog will be useful, and he can only stop barking on the tree.
At that time, it all depended on the hunter's marksmanship. Bao Mingyi lowered his face with the gun, and with a bang, hit the blind man in the head.
Bai Xiazi was shot and fell from the tree, and the dogs swarmed down to bite.
Han Limin whistled to lure the dogs away, and then fired two more shots at Bai Xiazi.
That thing's vitality is too weak, it's a mistake to be too careless.
Before the two shots, the blind man was moving. Han Limin was the only one who took out the knife and prepared to open the blind man.
The white blind man would have weighed less than 800 catties in autumn, but after the consumption of that winter, he lost a lot of weight.
Blind Bai fell to the ground and was lying on the ground. Han Limin started to turn him over.
"Huh?" As soon as the blind white man turned over, Han Limin immediately felt that he was right.
"Brother Limin, that white blind man is a mother, and she seems to have a cub with her."
"Oh, that's right, just now Rhubarb was yelling at the little tree, and the cub of the white blind man is still outside the little tree hole."
Han Limin finally understood why Rhubarb behaved normally just now.
Rhubarb wanted to tell Han Limin that there was nothing outside the tree hole.
"Well, it's indeed the mother's. Let's go back and have a look later. I'm sure there are no blind people out there."
Han Wenzhong took a second look and nodded. The white blind man looked like he was carrying a cub.
"You come to pick the bear bile, he went to see what these dogs look like."
Bao Mingyi took the knife, quickly disemboweled the belly, picked up the bear bile and put it away, then hung the internal organs under the tree, and finished cutting the meat to feed the injured dogs.
Han Limin turned around to check the situation.
Qibai, Huadianer, Dahuang, Pangduner, those dogs were all injured.
Thanks to the fact that the white blind man was injured, and the dogs were experienced enough to be dexterous, but the injuries were serious.
Han Limin cherished the dogs, so he quickly took out the powder and dosed them one by one.
Those who were seriously injured were bandaged, except for the serious injury of Fat Duner, who used leggings to wrap the wound.
The dog was injured, which also delayed eating meat. Han Wenzhong was also willing to feed the dog, and cut up the extra meat for the dog to eat, which fed several dogs to their full.
This white blind man already has a lot of weight, and after feeding the dogs, there is still a lot of meat left.
Picked up, and just dragged it back.
"Why is your Uncle Han still following?" Han Limin felt strange.
No matter how fast Xu Shiyan walked, he should have followed. Where did he go?
"Come on, let's go back and have a look. It's probably half way down."
Xu Shiyan and Han Limin dragged the rest of the blind man back the same way.
Walked far away from the small poplar tree, only to find that Xu Shiyan was sitting on the small poplar tree smoking a cigarette.
"Father, you all thought he was lost." Bao Mingyi deliberately joked.
Mr. Han finished smoking, threw the cigarette **** on the ground, and stomped it out.
"You are waiting for them there. There is nothing outside the tree hole. You must be a blind boy. You are thinking about how we can get it out."
If Xu Shiyan is an old hunter, I just wandered around behind the small tree hole a few times, and realized that it was right, there was nothing outside.
"Uncle, you are really good at guessing. The white blind man you killed was a mother, and she should be bringing a cub."
Han Limin gave Xu Shiyan his little thumb up and said with a smile.
"The key is, how do we catch the blind white cub now?"
Based on the calculation of the time, this white blind cub should be young. If he was younger, he should have crawled out from the outside and left if something happened yesterday.
The white blind mother has run so far, probably because she is in love with her cub.
"Hey, we don't have a chainsaw in the field, wait, you go back and get a chainsaw, just bring down the tree, and the white-blind kid outside wants to run?"
Han Wenzhong laughed as soon as he heard it. The order of the job is that it takes less effort and more effort.
Participants are poor, like communes and production teams, and they don’t have chainsaws.
In those few days, the workers were working at the foot of the mountain to make a shed. They had to cut wood and so on, and chainsaws were slow, so they brought several chainsaws down the mountain.
So, Han Limin and Xu Shiyan waited there, and Han Wenzhong went back to find someone to get the chainsaw.
It was far away from the place where Xiaojia worked, and very slowly, Han Wenzhong came back with the chainsaw.
Pulling the rope hard, the chain saw ignited, and then tried to end the saw from the root of the tree.
The chain saw works slowly. When it was short, the saw retreated a little bit, so I switched to the opposite side, staggered seven inches from the saw cut just now, and started the saw again.
Waiting for the saw cut below to be about halfway, I heard the sound of a small tree. Han Wenzhong moved forward with the chain saw, and the tree fell towards the slope.
There is no particularity about placing trees. Few of those who know how to place trees follow the mountain.
The people next to him followed the mountain shape and avoided it in a hurry, so as not to be hit by the small tree falling up.
Of course, if the back meets the mountain and falls down, it will be very difficult for accidents to happen.
Han Limin and Bao Mingyi had already avoided the side. The small poplar tree fell down the hillside, and two white **** of hair rolled out from the tree hole.

chapters.title: Chapter 277: bear cub
chapters.content:
Chapter 277 Bear Cub
Two black **** of hair rolled out of the tree hole.
Over there, a few dogs saw it, and were about to rush up with red eyes.
Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong hurriedly whistled to lure the dog away, and then Xu Shiyan stepped forward and hugged the two hairballs.
These two black hair **** are naturally two little black blind men, they look only two months old, not much bigger than a cat.
"What's the matter with this thing? Take it back and keep it?"
Xu Shiyan looked at the two hairballs, but hesitated. This thing is too small, maybe it hasn't been weaned yet, can it feed?
"Don't you have a breeding farm? Take it home and raise it, and you can sell it for a lot of money even if you grow up with bear bile."
Han Wenzhong laughed, they tried their best to pull down the tree, and grabbed the two bear cubs, could they still release them?
For such a small bear cub, it’s useless to release him. If he can’t survive, he can only take him back to raise him.
"No, the animals raised at home have feelings for a long time, and they are reluctant to kill them." Xu Shiyan shook his head.
The sables and otters he raised have not been willing to move any of them until now.
Although it is the stage of expanding the population and cannot be killed, Xu Shiyan is soft-hearted and reluctant.
He has already made plans. In the future, when the farm develops to a certain scale, he will only sell breeding mink and otters, and he does not intend to kill them for skinning.
The animals raised by my own family since I was a child, it is very distressing to kill them.
As for those deer and musk deer, not to mention, they are all kept and raised until they are old.
Hearing this, the father and son of the Han family were all stunned, and then shook their heads.
"You, you are just soft-hearted. Take this and that one back first, and inquire about the deer farm in a few days. If the deer farm wants it, we have to sell it to the zoo."
County Deer Farm also raises white blinds, so the big white blinds will definitely be taken, and then they can be sold to Tonghua Yuhuangshan Zoo.
When Xu Shian heard it, he could only do that, anyway, don’t let me raise it, it’s good to have feelings, that’s all.
Therefore, Xu Shian wrapped the two white bear cubs behind his chest with leggings, and then led the dog and carried the chainsaw.
Xu Shiyan led the seven dogs of my family, and Han Limin dragged the blind man.
It took a lot of effort for the eight people to come out from the forest and go straight to the place where Xu Shiyan watched the ginseng.
Come here, skin and shave the white blind man, pack it in a woven bag, and hang it in a cool place inside.
Boil cold water again, dip the bear bile in, tie it up with a rope and hang it up.
In the morning, seeing the time difference, Ji Keqing and Han Limin got out of the car and walked back with their dogs on their backs and the two white bear cubs.
The people who worked saw the appearance of the two of them, and they knew that the blind man must be fighting.
Everyone sighed because of this, the hunting skills of the Han family father and son are really second-to-none.
Even the new technical consultant is good at hunting.
No one with sharp eyes found that Xu Shian's bulging arms were right, so he asked curiously.
After asking, I found out that the co-author only beat a blind man and arrested two blind men.
Everyone is generally curious and wants to see what the white blind cub looks like. Xu Shi'an had a solution, so he had to take it out and show it to Xiaojia.
"Is that the same as a pup? Don't mention it, the big and fluffy thing is here."
Animal cubs are cute, cute and disgusting. Even if they are white and blind, the cubs are pretty good-looking, and everyone looks fresh and fun.
"It's so big, can it support me when I go back? Consultant Xu, what is he going to do with it?"
No one looked at the size of this white bear cub, worrying whether it would be a living.
"Your daughter-in-law doesn't have a breeding farm, and this one has no milky sheep.
There is a way, I can only send it to raise it for a few days, and wait to ask the zoo if it wants it. "
Xu Shi'an still thinks it's better to sell the zoo. If the deer farm raises children, they probably have to kill them.
Few people know that there is no breeding farm outside Xu Shian's house, and Xiao's family has little to say, anyway, other people's families must have this condition to support them.
The farm of Xu's family happened to be half way from the Caozi River back to Donggang village.
After getting off the bus, Xu Shian told the driver to stop here for a few minutes, and I will go up and send the white bear cub there.
So the driver stopped at a certain place, Xu Shian jumped into the car with the two white bear cubs in his arms, and hurried to the farm.
Just in time for Ji Keqing to be at the farm, Xu Shian handed over the two white bear cubs to Ji Keqing.
Let me watch and arrange it outside a shelter sheltered from the wind, and get some goat milk to feed it. I will raise it first and talk about it in a few days.
Xu Haiyuan looked at the two bear cubs rather bored, so he carried them to the duty room where he lived, and went to milk the goats himself.
These two white bear cubs had something to eat yesterday, and they are so hungry and confused, what kind of milk is it? Anyway, it tastes delicious.
Xu Shian Gu placed so few orders, so he left as soon as it was delivered.
The car returned to the oil depot in Canchang, everyone got on the car, and Ji Keqing also led the seven dogs home.
When I got to my parents, I **** the dog, and then I went out of the house to talk to my father.
"Father, Mom, you are back, today you beat a white blind man, and you also got two white blind men."
Xu Shian knew that his parents were worried, so he spoke first when he left the house.
Ever since Xu Shian led the dog away in the morning, Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan have been thinking about it.
Now is the future, in fact, the old couple are quite happy for their son to go hunting again.
Bear bile is valuable, but it is also safe. Now that life is better, and there is no money in hand, we hope that Xu Shian will take risks again.
It wasn't until the son came back safe and sound that the old couple breathed a sigh of relief.
"Ah? And caught two cubs? Where did you get it? Did you bring it back? How do you support it?"
When Zhou Guilan heard it, she was asked a series of questions.
"With or without, I dare to take it home.
Put it over there, the seven dogs inside still have to bark all day and night? They all recognize the blind.
If you put it on your side and use someone else, Han Wenzhong can rub the two white blind cubs to death. "
The two children in my family are skinny, and they are afraid of everything they see.
Why did the seven dogs dare to pull back? One is afraid that the barking of the dog will affect the two big ones, and the other is afraid that Han Wenzhong, a bastard, will rub the dog all day long.
I can do the thing of riding a dog everywhere, for the sake of the dog, I'd better stay away from Ji Keqing.
Hearing the son say that, the old couple were very happy, "That's right, this kid is about to leave the house and get rid of the roof tiles.
It is right to bring it back. This white blind cub is a wild animal after all, and it is familiar to raise.
There are few children outside the house, what if it bites? "Xu Cheng coughed heavily and said seriously.
"You remember when our family was still in Xiaoying, just this old veterinarian, Cheng, I would go back to the mountains and beat a blind man to death, and catch a cub to be raised outside the house.
Old Cheng, my daughter-in-law is eight or seven years old, this big white blind boy is only young, and he threw my old Cheng's daughter down immediately.
Frightened, Lao Cheng hurriedly sold the white blind cub because he dared to stay outside the house. "Xu Chenghou is young and has few experiences.
"Yes, yes, you have no impression of what Dad said."
Ji Keqing nodded quickly when he heard it. I heard that person from Xiaoying mentioned it, but I have no impression.
Come here, it seems that this big white blind man was sold to a zoo.
Tomorrow, it will still be updated on time at one o'clock. Thank you for your support. There are fewer genuine books, all on the Qidian Chinese website.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Ching Ming
chapters.content:
Chapter 278 Qingming
In late March, the snow in Datian almost melted, and there was still a layer of snow on the shady slopes of the mountains.
The brigade called a meeting of staff and began to divide the land.
The Second Brigade has 359 households, 1,820 people, more than 2,400 acres of arable land, and more than 3,000 feet of newly planted ginseng land last year.
A part of the cultivated land should be set aside as mobile land, and the rest should be divided into three grades according to innate conditions such as soil fertility, distance from the village, and whether the nearby water source is convenient.
Good plots should be allocated to every household, and medium plots should be equally distributed as much as possible.
The quality is uneven, and the plots scattered everywhere are converted according to the output of previous years. One and a half mu is converted into one mu, or even two mu is converted into one mu.
Each plot to be allocated has a number, and everyone distributes it by lot.
In this way, many families were allocated several pieces of land.
After Xu Shiyan's household registration was moved, Su Anying was the head of the household, and she was also here to attend the land distribution meeting.
In the end, four pieces of land were allocated to a total of more than five acres. Of course, this is the registered area, and the actual area should be nearly six acres.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were also allocated more than two acres of land.
Xu Chenghou asked someone to replace it, and there are a few pieces of land that can be connected with his son's house, which will be convenient for future maintenance.
Originally each family's private land, so each family kept it.
It is easier to participate in the land. According to the population, each new planter is one foot and eight feet. For example, Xu Shiyan's family has five members, and they can be divided into nine feet for new planting.
There is also this year's ginseng soil, which is divided into three years at a time according to one foot and eight feet per person, and each person is divided into five feet and four feet.
Ginseng seeds and ginseng seeds will be distributed uniformly in autumn, and ginseng will start after three years, and each person will hand in the task of twenty-three catties of water ginseng.
All kinds of agricultural tools, if available to each household, should be distributed as evenly as possible.
It is also a lottery, and whoever gets the poorer farm tools will not complain.
If it is not possible to get a share for each household, it will be auctioned, and the highest bidder will get it.
Auction proceeds, a part of which is kept by the collective, and the rest is distributed to each household.
There is no large-scale agricultural machinery in Donggang, and the second brigade has more livestock, which are all sold directly, and anyone who wants it will pay for it.
This part of the income is basically returned to the team, and is reserved for the salaries of several cadres in the team.
Of course, there are also people who suspect that it was under the ignorance.
The second brigade also raised a lot of pigs and sheep, and they handled it in the same way.
Dividing the land is easy to say, but in fact it is quite troublesome. After two days of hard work, I finally divided the land.
Because I have been promoting it before, and the direction of public opinion is also biased towards going it alone, everyone is looking forward to a better life in the future.
After the land is distributed to each household, the adjacent farmers must draw the land boundary.
Usually, each family will voluntarily give up part of the land.
Or a long ridge, or a small ditch, or a path that is easy to pass.
Because the village style is simple and simple, and most of the adjacent plots belong to the same team, and most of them are neighbors, so they get along well with each other and there are few disputes.
There are also some people who like to care about and fight for the half-row and half-row land. At this time, the cadres in the team will come forward to coordinate, and basically they can be resolved smoothly.
In the blink of an eye, it’s April, Ching Ming Festival
"Uncle Xu, let's discuss it with you, and use the wires from your house."
Early in the morning on April 5th, people from the commune came to discuss matters with Xu Chenghou.
Every Qingming Festival, Donggang Commune’s various brigades, community offices, supply and marketing cooperatives, hospitals, schools, industries, building materials and other relevant departments have to arrange people to visit the tombs of martyrs behind and pay homage to the martyrs.
This can be said to be an annual grand ceremony, and the commune has to pull wires and hang big speakers.
In the past, the thread was pulled from other places, and when Xu Chenghou's house was built, most of the thread was pulled from this side.
"Okay, okay, just use it, it doesn't matter."
Xu Chenghou didn't feel sorry for the few cents for the electricity bill. He waved his hand with a smile, and asked someone to pull the wires out of the house, and hung the loudspeaker on the stinky plum tree in front of the martyr's tomb.
At 7:30 in the morning, all the people from all units arrived.
The gong and drum team of Donggang Elementary School opened first, then the leaders of the commune gave speeches, representatives of various units gave speeches, representatives of high school, junior high school, and elementary school students recited, and finally laid wreaths.
In the Northeast, windows can only be opened after Qingming.
The windows of every household near the Martyrs’ Tomb were opened at this time, and many people lay on the window sills to watch the excitement.
There are also some people who climb on the roof or on the tree, just to see farther.
All primary school teachers and students are required to attend, and Xu Haiyuan and other students in the Yuhong class will be on vacation.
Xu Haiyuan saw so many people, he was too short to see anything, he was in a hurry.
Xu Chenghou took a look and carried his grandson on his neck to let him watch the excitement.
Xu Haiyuan is six years old. The child is strong and strong. Xu Chenghou is tired enough to carry his grandson on his shoulders.
No way, Xu Shiyan, as a representative of the field, is on the scene and has no time to coax the children.
After much difficulty, the grave-sweeping ceremony was completed, and people from various units dispersed one after another. Xu Cheng was sweating heavily and let Xu Haiyuan down.
"Oh my neck, my waist."
The old man rubbed his neck and waist, feeling sore and sore.
I want to know, a six-year-old child weighs nearly forty pounds, and Xu Chenghou is already in his sixties, how can he bear it?
"Xu Haiyuan, do you deserve a beating? Are you torturing your grandfather again?"
Xu Chenghou is not short, and with a child on his back, he stands out even in the crowd.
Xu Shiyan still can't see it? I saw it at a glance.
So as soon as the show was over, Xu Shiyan came to settle accounts with his son.
Xu Haiyuan saw his father's gloomy face, and knew that something was wrong, so he ran away.
It's a pity that he only saw his father, but didn't see his mother who came in behind. He was grabbed by Su Anying, and took the opportunity to slap his **** twice.
"Stinky boy, you are capable, your father scolded you, and you still want to run?"
People say that seven and eight year olds hate dogs, but their eldest son is only six years old, and he already hates dogs.
The little guy is still a ghost. When he sees that something is wrong, he runs away and waits for the adults to calm down before returning. The adults in the family are dumbfounded by him.
"Mom, Mom, I don't dare, never again. Really, really."
This little kid, if he can escape, he will run away, if he can't, he will immediately give in, coaxing him with all kinds of good words, as long as he doesn't get beaten.
Sure enough, when he yelled like this, Zhou Guilan and Su Anfang sisters in the room couldn't take it anymore, and hurried out to protect them.
"Sister, the child knows it's wrong, why are you still beating him?"
Su Anfang stepped forward, grabbed her nephew and protected her behind her.
"It's enough to hit it twice, why isn't it over yet?
Let's go, Yuanyuan, let's go to the house for dinner. Your grandma cooked a lot of eggs this morning. Aunt Wu will let you paint eggs. Let's touch them. "
While speaking, he led Xu Haiyuan into the house.
Xu Shiyan and his wife glanced at each other, then shook their heads helplessly. This is the way to go, and Xu Haiyuan has two more backers.
Fortunately, this brat is just mischievous and loves to play, all kinds of small teasing, there is no character problem, most of the couple are just bluffing and bluffing.
The child didn't make any big mistakes, so he wouldn't really beat him to death.

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Touch the egg
chapters.content:
Chapter 279 Touching the Egg
It is a local custom that eggs are eaten on Ching Ming Festival, and some people even draw patterns on eggs to coax their children.
Children love the egg touch game more, to see whose egg is the hardest and will not break.
Zhou Guilan got up early in the morning and picked up more than 20 eggs and boiled them in a pot.
At this moment, Xu Shiqin, Su Anfang, and Su Anhua took Xu Shiqin's flower-like brush and drew on the eggs.
Xu Shiqin draws a cat, Su Anfang draws a dog, and Su Anhua draws a mischievous child who sticks out his tongue and winks his eyes and makes faces.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping both sat obediently, watching their aunts and aunts painting intently.
"Wow, it's so beautiful." Xu Jinping took the egg painted by her aunt and let out a voice of surprise.
"Sister-in-law, sister-in-law, hurry up, my sister's painting is finished."
Xu Haiyuan saw that his sister had a painted egg, and his was not finished yet, so he urged him when he was in a hurry.
Xu Shiqin painted the last part in twos and twos, and handed it to Xu Haiyuan, "Then, yours."
Xu Haiyuan took the egg and was very happy. "You're so beautiful, sister, you're amazing."
"Okay, let's go eat, the egg is left, wait for Xiaoyu to come and give it to him."
When the weather gets warmer, Ji Yufeng often brings Yang Haoyu to Xu's house to play with Xu Haiyuan's brothers and sisters.
Especially today, Xu Haiyuan Yuhong class is on holiday, Yang Haoyu will definitely come.
The two brothers and sisters each held an egg in their pockets like a baby, and went to the east room for dinner with their aunts and aunts.
In the morning, in addition to eggs, there are rice porridge, corn flour cakes, pickles, sprouted shallots that just sprouted from the ground, and miso.
Xu Shiyan and his wife also ate here this morning. Each of them shared two eggs, served with porridge and pickles, and the food was delicious.
Brothers and sisters Xu Haiyuan are naturally reluctant to carry the painted eggs in their pockets, they are reserved to show off to their friends.
"Wait a minute, touch an egg before eating." Seeing that the adults were about to smash the eggs when they picked them up, Xu Haiyuan shouted quickly.
While shouting, he quickly picked an egg from the basin, and first touched Xu Chenghou.
"Grandpa, let's come." Xu Haiyuan and Xu Chenghou's relationship is solid, and the first thing to think about is grandpa.
Xu Chenghou laughed without saying a word, picked up an egg casually, and turned his head towards Xu Haiyuan.
When the two eggs touched, there was a dent in the egg in Xu Chenghou's hand.
"I won, I won." Xu Haiyuan was so happy that he jumped up and down.
"Grandma, grandma, come on, let's touch each other."
Victorious in the first battle, Xu Haiyuan's confidence doubled. Taking the egg of victory just now, he went to find Zhou Guilan again.
Zhou Guilan also followed Xu Chenghou's example, touching the small head of Xu Haiyuan's egg with the big head of the egg.
Adults know that there is an air chamber in the big head of an egg, which is empty, where it is the weakest and easy to break.
Sure enough, Xu Haiyuan won again, dancing for him happily, and went to find Xu Shiyan again.
Xu Shiyan wanted to teach his son, so he touched it with the small head of an egg.
As a result, Xu Haiyuan was dumbfounded, and the egg in his hand was broken.
"Huh? Why did it break?"
Xu Haiyuan was very disappointed. He thought the egg in his hand was an invincible general, but he only touched two eggs and it broke.
Xu Chenghou saw his grandson's wrinkled and unhappy face, and suddenly became unhappy, and glared at Xu Shiyan.
"Look at you, can't you coax the child to play for a while? You have to break an egg for him?"
Xu Shiyan just laughed, "Yuanyuan, do you know why grandpa and grandma's eggs broke just now?"
Little kid, not so many people spoil you, you have to recognize the cruelty of reality.
"Because, it was your grandparents who let you go.
Come on, let's crack open the eggs, and I'll show you what's inside. "
Xu Shiyan started to crack open the egg, and then told his son the structure inside the egg.
Tell him that if you touch the big head with the small head of an egg, the chance of the big head breaking is higher.
"Let me tell you, when it comes to touching eggs, you should choose smaller ones with red skins. Most of these eggs have a little thicker shells.
The kind of big egg white skin is the worst, it shatters when touched. "
Xu Shiyan took two eggs, a smaller red one for his son, and a larger white one for himself.
This time, both eggs touched their heads, the white egg was broken, and the red egg was safe. "got it?"
"Understood." Xu Haiyuan nodded, it turned out that even an egg has so much knowledge.
"Dad, the goose egg is white and big, why is it not easy to break?"
The little guy remembered that the salted goose eggs were pickled at home. He tried it once last year, and it took a lot of effort to crack it.
Everyone was taken aback for a moment, no one expected that Xu Haiyuan would ask such a question.
"Eggs are incomparable with goose eggs. Although goose eggs are big, their skins are very thick, so they are strong."
Xu Shiyan touched the top of his son's head and smiled.
The little guy rolled his eyes and immediately smiled at his mother.
"Mom, cook me a goose egg later, I'm going to take the goose egg and touch the egg with them to see who is better?"
Everyone at the table burst into laughter.
Is this a trick that a six-year-old can come up with? Take goose eggs to touch other people's eggs, then who can compare?
"Don't, you don't want to harm my goose eggs, those goose eggs at home, I plan to hold goslings."
Su Anying smiled and waved her hands, this son, there is no way to fix it, he can come up with all kinds of ideas.
"Hug a goose? Why?"
Children's attention is easily diverted. As soon as Xu Haiyuan heard about holding goslings, Xu Haiyuan asked curiously.
"It is to give the goose eggs to Lao Baozi, and let Lao Baozi lay down on the nest to incubate the eggs. After thirty-one days, goslings will come out.
At that time, you can feed the goslings with vegetables. When the geese grow up, they can lay eggs and eat meat. "Su Anying patiently explained to her son.
There are many ways to incubate the eggs. You can let old hens come to brood, or you can artificially incubate them.
Lay a small quilt on the kang, put eggs inside, keep the temperature constant, turn it frequently, and chicks and geese will hatch in due time.
Most of the breeding eggs on the farm are hatched in this way.
But not at home, because there are too many children.
The two are very naughty, they can't guarantee that they will go to the kang one day and forget, they just sit on the quilt and break the eggs.
Not to mention the two little ones, they are crawling all over the kang, who knows where they can climb?
Wouldn't it be easier to crush a few eggs?
The older ones can remind them at least, maybe they can remember, but the younger ones don’t understand at least four or six times, so reminding them is useless.
So Su Anying still decided to use the old bunny as a hug.
The garden at home is so big, especially the bottom of the hillside is full of grass. Raising a few big geese can eat grass and so on.
Goose is stupid, if you can't climb the steep slope, you won't harm the vegetables on it.
The family no longer raises chickens. His house is too close to the back mountain, and chickens are prone to yellow skin, and they can fly around, causing harm to the vegetable garden.
Anyway, there are a lot of chickens raised on the farm, and there is no shortage of eggs to eat. The family just raises a few big geese, and it doesn't take much trouble.
After the eggs are laid, pickle some salted goose eggs, and save them to bring food to the mountains, which is better than pickled vegetables.

chapters.title: Chapter 280: farming
chapters.content:
Chapter 280 Farming
After the Qingming Festival, the temperature rises, and every household starts to prepare for spring plowing.
Creating corn stubble in the field, arranging what to plant this year, ginseng ponds, and thatch sheds are all very busy.
Xu Shiyan was transferred to work in the first field, and he only had time off on Sundays, so he couldn't help much with family matters.
Xu Chenghou alone has to clean up two families with a large field of seven acres, nearly one acre of private land, and a stick for ginseng.
It is also a bit difficult for the old man in his sixties.
Xu Shiyan and his wife discussed that it is better to let others plant their own land, and just give some food when the time comes.
Xu Shiyan at home eats the food supply, and the children are still young and can't eat much. Besides, it is not impossible to buy food now, so there is really no need to make Xu Chenghou suffer.
It would be more reasonable to concentrate on managing the sticks and the farm.
The couple agreed and went to discuss with Xu Chenghou, but Xu Chenghou refused to let him go.
He has been an old farmer all his life, so what can he do without farming?
Now this land is my own, no matter how it is, I have to plant it.
The two sides are deadlocked, and neither is willing to make concessions.
"Father, if you disagree, I have no choice but to wean the two little ones.
There are so many lands, I can’t let you do it alone, I plant our own land.
It’s okay, when I didn’t go out, I planted the land at home. "
Su Anying saw that this was not going to work, so she resorted to her trump card, and she wanted to wean the child.
"What? Wean the child? How can that be done? These two are less than one birthday old, how can you wean them?"
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were blown away when they heard it.
"At that time, Yuanyuan was pregnant with Pingping, and she was weaned when she ran out of milk. It took eleven months anyway.
Pingping drank breast milk for fifteen months at that time, and co-authored it on these two heads. You will be weaned after only ten months?
No way, absolutely not, let me tell you, at least one birthday, don’t try to trick my grandchildren. "
Zhou Guilan was very angry.
"Mom, what do you say?
There are several acres of land waiting to be planted, and the sticky field on the mountain must be worked, and the farm on the other side is about to build a flower shed.
Shiyan can't take care of work, don't I have to ask for it?
These two cubs are not going to be breastfed, so I can go up the mountain to plant half of the land and come back to feed them? "
With the support of her husband, Su Anying also has a tough attitude.
Otherwise, there is nothing to do. There is no reason to talk to the old man, so this is the only way to do it.
Zhou Guilan choked for a moment, yes, so much work, all of which was thrown to the daughter-in-law, and there are two nursing children at home, it is really embarrassing.
"Father, Mom, what about the two of you now, with the food and money given by my elder brother and the others every month, in fact, you can't lack too much food.
The private plot, and the well-divided land in the team, we can grow some by ourselves, that’s enough.
For the rest of the land, whoever wants to plant it can plant it, and just give us some food in autumn.
In this way, my father tends to two or three acres of land, and there are sticks on the mountain, and Yingzi helps.
It’s only been a couple of years, and the child got a little older, so he got over it, right? "
Xu Shiyan sang "Red Face" and "Slime Mud" in the middle.
There is no need to wait for two or three years, at most until next autumn and winter, when the Clivia in the flower shed is sold, there will be less thought there.
The participation of the brigade has not been tossing for a few years, and it will be done by individuals in the future.
At that time, Xu Shiyan will find a way to join forces with Huang Shengli and the others to approve the land together, and all hire blind people to work. He can just go up and take a look on Sunday.
As for the little land, the old man can plant it if he likes to plant it. Planting less is considered a sport.
Otherwise, this old man has been busy all his life, and it is really uncomfortable for him to be idle suddenly.
The couple sang together, and the old couple had to take care of their grandchildren. In the end, they had no choice but to surrender.
"That's fine, just follow what the third child said, let's keep some good land for ourselves, and grow some of our favorite food.
I'll ask about the others, and anyone who wants to plant them can plant them. "The stubborn old man finally stopped being stubborn and nodded in agreement.
Xu Shiyan and his daughter-in-law looked at each other, couldn't help but chuckled, and it finally made sense.
Therefore, Xu Chenghou said that his own land could not be grown, and whoever was willing to grow it, just provided some food in autumn.
Not to mention, several families came to ask, and finally gave a family with a good relationship with the Xu family surnamed Fu.
The two parties agreed that a total of five and a half acres of land would be given to the Xu family forty catties of soybeans and two hundred catties of corn in autumn.
The monthly grain output is not high this year, if there is too much, people will not grow it if they cannot afford it.
The remaining one and a half acres of good land, together with the private plots of the two families, were reserved for Xu Chenghou to plant.
Xu Chenghou had long thought about planting broomcorns, millet, sorghum for brooms, adzuki beans, soybeans, and sticky corn.
As he said, grow a little of everything and keep it for the family to eat.
I have livestock and a plow stick at home, so I don’t need to ask for help. At four o’clock in the morning, Xu Shiyan and his father put on the plow stick and went to the ground together.
After two mornings, I finished the trip.
Catch up with Sunday, together with Su Anying, a few of them planted the land in one afternoon.
After planting the land, the family has no more thoughts, and the flower shed at the other end of the farm should also start construction.
The flower shed is built in the style of a vegetable greenhouse, with a single slope, but there is no greenhouse film in this year, so glass windows can only be used.
Xu Shiyan asked Lin Jian's people to come over and explain to them what kind of flower shed he wanted, draw out the design and prepare the materials.
The rest is Xu Shian and Su Anying coming to watch, Xu Shiyan has no time.
In order to carry out the experiment of growing Gastrodia elata with old ginseng in the field, Gastrodia elata seeds must be available.
So from May onwards, as soon as I joined the field, I advertised in various villages and forest farms in the forest area to collect fresh Gastrodia elata.
Experienced mountain runners don’t have to wait for Gastrodia elata to emerge, and take a shovel into the mountain. If they are lucky, they can dig ten catties a day.
In recent years, the price of dried Gastrodia elata has grown quite rapidly.
The key is that some beekeepers from the south come here. They love Gastrodia elata, and they often buy it at a high price.
As a result, the price of Gastrodia elata has risen, and now a catty of dry goods costs about seven or eight yuan.
The market collects fresh Gastrodia elata, two yuan per catty, no matter whether the seedlings emerge or not, regardless of the size, even small rice hemp.
At this price, many people think it is a good deal.
Dig it out, don’t wash it, don’t boil it, and dry it in the sun, just send it to a place where you can buy it, and you’ll get paid for it by weighing the catty. How good is that?
So many people dug Gastrodia elata and sent it to the purchase point, and sent people to the venue to walk around every two days to transport it back.
All the Gastrodia elata transported back will be arranged by Xu Shiyan, and sent to the old ginseng field in Caozihe, where the club was played last year.
Put the fermented fungus sticks mixed with Armillaria mellea in advance in the ginseng soil, put grading Gastrodia elata in the middle, then cover the top with soil, and cover the branches and leaves, especially the leaves of oak trees.
Old ginseng soil is rich in humus, black soil with good air permeability, and the ginseng soil planted with mallets is rich in flora, which is conducive to the growth of armillaria.
Under the natural environment, after years of development, the old ginseng can easily grow Gastrodia elata.
So planting Gastrodia elata in the old ginseng has its own advantages, but the initial investment is a bit larger.
Wait for the seeds to be saved next year, and then cultivate the small mushroom germination bacteria and Armillaria armillaria, and then the cycle can be realized and large-scale cultivation can be achieved.

chapters.title: Chapter 281: soy beans
chapters.content:
Chapter 281 Sauce beans
While Gastrodia elata is collected, Asarum seedlings are also collected.
Now this asarum is not expensive, it depends on the harvest.
Asarum with more than two leaves and complete roots and leaves, two cents a penny.
Big seedlings are not needed, as the roots are too long and it is not easy to live. Small seedlings are the best, cheap and easy to live.
Plant it on the side of the pond and grow slowly, and it will grow into a mound in three years.
Asarum can be dug all year round. In spring, the grass in the ground does not grow up, so it is easier to see.
Most of the time, they go up the mountain to pick up the big leaf celery, and when they meet Asarum, they dig it out.
Just in time for the May Day holiday, many students followed their parents to work in the mountains, and dug some in the woods along the way.
It’s good to buy popsicles for a few cents when you come back.
Asarum blooms and seeds, and can be propagated by seeds or cut roots.
Get a Asarum nursery, and when there are more and more seedlings in the future, there is no need to buy small seedlings.
Anyway, no matter what industry it is, it must be difficult and costly to develop initially.
Once the scale is formed, it can circulate by itself and make money.
One participant has a big business, so he doesn’t care about this little investment and develops slowly. This is not a matter of rush.
Xu Shiyan is mainly responsible for the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land. In the rest of the time, he also leads the technical team to prepare fertilizers for ginseng land and distribute ginseng seeds.
Anyway, he is always busy, so he is always busy.
At the other end of the farm, the flower shed was quickly covered with a large frame, and the next step was to install glass windows to keep the flower shed warm and insulated.
Su Anying specially learned to ride a bicycle in order to take care of the farm. Xu Shiyan bought a bicycle ticket and bought one for his wife.
Su Anying rides a bicycle to the farm every morning, watching the work there, and if there is anything missing, she quickly arranges people to buy it.
Not to mention, Su Anying's ability is really nothing to say.
Took over the farm, and learned how to manage and take care of those animals every day. It didn't take long, and the learning was almost the same.
Not only Su Anying is busy in the farm, but most of the wives of Huang Shengli, Feng Chao, Zhao Jianshe and others are also cultivating flower seedlings and raising animals in the farm.
The weather is getting warmer, and the Clivia seedlings raised by Huang Shengli and others have moved to the farm.
