The flower shed was temporarily unavailable, so a wooden shed was built to keep out the wind and rain. Centralized management is easier than separate care for each household.
Women, most of them like flowers and plants. The green Clivia flower seedlings are rare, and they can make money. Who doesn't care about them?
Not to mention those furry and cute animals, they are all money, and for the sake of money, they have to be taken care of.
In order to run back and forth to the farm, most of the women have learned to ride a bicycle.
Now the conditions of all the companies are okay, and it is not difficult to buy a bicycle.
So the women cooked meals in the morning, and after the children went to school, they rode bicycles to work on the farm.
At eleven o'clock at noon, I will ride home for dinner.
Su Anying fed the two children in the morning and went out, and went home at noon to feed them twice, and returned in the evening, and the children were under her care.
It may be because of the large number of people in the family, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing are not very in love with their mother.
Play with two aunts and grandma during the day, eat something when hungry, or drink some goat milk or something.
Mom came back, she just took a sip of milk, and she didn't feel greedy if she didn't give it, but she couldn't do without her at night, she had to coax her to sleep.
Su Anying was discussing with her mother-in-law. Judging from this situation, weaning at the age of one year is fine. Anyway, breast milk is optional, so hurry up and stop worrying.
Zhou Guilan originally disapproved of weaning too early, but seeing the attitude of the two babies, she had no choice but to nod in agreement.
It's the end of May.
"Yingzi, don't go to the farm tomorrow, we will fry the soy beans in a while.
It is cooked in the pot tonight, and it will be sent to the mill to be rolled out tomorrow morning. We will make the sauce tomorrow. "
On the night of May 29th, Zhou Guilan came to Su Anying and told her about making sauce.
Doubanjiang doesn't matter, as long as the weather is warm and sunny, you can make it anytime.
When the Xu family makes sauce, they will choose the eighth day, the eighteenth day, and the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month of the lunar calendar. During these days, they go to the mill to push the soy beans and the sauce into a paste.
The sauce primer placed in the bean straw first evaporates and becomes lighter, and then slowly ferments.
After two months of fermentation, the surface has been covered with turquoise hairs, and some are slightly cracked.
Break apart the sauce primer. If the fermentation is successful, you will see not only green hairs, but also red mycelia inside, with a slightly sour aroma.
The sauce made by such a sauce primer will not be bad in taste.
If the fermentation is not good, there are only green hairs and a strong musty smell, then it will not work.
The sauce made is not tasty, with a musty smell.
Zhou Guilan is very good at making sauce primers. A few days ago, she broke apart the sauce primers, cleaned them, and piled them up again to ferment again.
The sauce made from the second-fermented sauce primer has a stronger fragrance.
The two families eat soy sauce, so they must not make too little, so Su Anying and Zhou Guilan fried 40 catties of soybeans together in the evening.
Soybeans are screened with a curtain in advance to pick out broken watercress, stones, grass stalks, etc., and then rinsed with water to dry, very clean.
Slowly stir-fry over low heat until the beans are slightly burnt and red, giving off a special aroma, but they cannot be fried, then put them in a pot and put them aside.
The fried beans have to be cooked, and they must be fully cooked.
Zhou Guilan has her own secret recipe for making sauce. Soybeans are mixed with some peas to make the sauce more sweet.
When cooking beans, put a piece of schisandra vine and a bundle of catwort wormwood inside.
Beans in sauce will have a natural aroma, and the sauce made is very delicious without other seasonings.
"No wonder when I eat the sauce made by my aunt, I feel that it is different from my mother's. So there are still these sayings."
Sister Su Anfang also helped stir-fry beans and soy sauce beans. After seeing what Zhou Guilan put into the sauce bean pot, the two suddenly realized.
It's no wonder Xu's sauce tastes extraordinarily delicious, and the co-authors have secret recipes.
"This is the method passed down from my mother-in-law.
In the past, the place where my family lived was very crappy, and there were stone cannons everywhere when I went out, so it was difficult to get out.
To buy something, I have to go to Niu Mao Wu, which is quite far and inconvenient.
At that time, our family had a piece of hill, and there were Schisandra chinensis on the hill, and Artemisia argyi was more common, and they were all around the garden.
So use these two when cooking beans, and the beans in sauce are very fragrant.
In fact, schisandra vine has many uses, and it can also be used for stew.
Cat put Artemisia, not to mention, stewed fish into it, it can remove the fishy smell, and the taste is still fresh. "
Seeing that Su Anfang and the others were curious, Zhou Guilan had to talk about it.
“When we lived in Daying and the big house, when it was time to eat, someone would come to the house and ask for miso.
Some people borrowed the bowl from home without taking the bowl, and forgot to return it.
Throughout the year, I don’t know how many bowls I throw away. "
Northeast people are like this, every meal is inseparable from miso, whoever has a good miso, others will ask for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: elementary school games
chapters.content:
After the sauced beans are boiled, there is no need to add more firewood to the bottom of the pot, just simmer slowly.
The next morning, put the reddish beans and the soaked sauce primers into several tin buckets together.
Su Anying borrowed a wheelbarrow and pushed it to the mill in the backyard of the second brigade.
This method of making sauce must be ground with a grinder, otherwise the sauce primer cannot be finely ground, and it will not taste good to anyone who eats a bite.
By the time Su Anying and the two younger sisters pushed their wheelbarrows to the mill, there were already quite a few people lined up here.
The mill usually does not push soybeans. Only on the eighth day of April, the eighteenth day of April, and the twenty-eighth day of April are days when the soybean paste is made.
In this way, there is no need to brush the grinding chamber back and forth.
In the process of grinding, some water needs to be added, so four buckets of beans are added with sauce introduction, and finally five buckets are pushed back.
Xu Chenghou left two barrels on his side and three barrels on his side.
According to the ratio of three catties of beans to one catty of salt, pour the sauce and salt into the porcelain jar.
Beans with soy sauce are actually more grain, and the ratio of grain to salt is less than three to one.
Use a rolling pin to keep stirring in one direction until the salt and sauce are evenly mixed, and then sprinkle a layer of salt on top to seal the cylinder.
Finally, the cylinder mouth is covered with white cloth, and the cylinder mouth is tied tightly with red cloth strips.
If it is sauced cubes, it must be put outside to dry for a full month before it can be eaten.
But the sauce made by Xu’s family can be eaten in three days.
Of course, it is best to ferment for a month, so that the aroma of the sauce will be stronger.
Xu's family still has the sauce they made last year, so they are not in a hurry to eat new sauce.
It is said that the freshly made sauce cannot be moved by a double-bodied person. If it is moved, the sauce will not ferment and will go bad.
As for whether it is true, no one knows, and no one has tested it.
The soy beans are food, tens of catties of beans, plus a lot of salt, are all money, who is willing to take risks?
Making sauce, pickling pickles, and pickling sauerkraut are three important things in the daily life of Northeast people, and they must be treated with caution.
Maybe I won’t have food for the next year, it’s not a joke.
Waiting for the sauce tank to be sealed, it was not too early. Su Anying saw that there was no need to go to the farm this morning, so hurry up and pack up and cook.
As soon as the meal was ready, I heard Xu Haiyuan running in from outside.
"Mom, Mom, we have a sports meeting tomorrow."
The tradition of Donggang Central Primary School is to hold the sports meeting on June 1 every year, and participate in the township Little Braun concert on October 1.
The sports meeting is not only attended by children from Donggang Central Primary School, but also from other brigade primary schools under Donggang Commune, which also sends athletes to participate. It is also a rare event in Donggang Commune.
"The elementary school has a sports meeting, why are you so excited? Do you still have your project?"
Su Anying laughed as soon as she heard it, and raised her hand to rub the top of her son's head. Is there still a project for the baby in the Yuhong class to participate in?
"Yes, yes, the teacher said, we also have projects, and whoever wins will be rewarded with sugar."
Xu Haiyuan pursed his lips, feeling that his mother looked down on him.
He is too young to participate in the sports meeting? Who stipulated it?
"Oh, so you can also participate, so do you need your mother to accompany you to school tomorrow?"
Seeing her son like that, Su Anying knew that what she said casually hurt her son's self-esteem, and immediately regretted it.
"Your teacher didn't say what kind of clothes to wear? Mom quickly find it for you."
Su Anying remembers watching the elementary school sports meeting, many children were wearing white tops and black pants.
For this suit of clothes, many people have to borrow them.
Xu Haiyuan didn't need to borrow it. Xu Shiqin had just made him a white shirt a few days ago, and he also had black pants at home.
"No, the teacher didn't say, we don't need to review, we should be able to wear whatever clothes.
If mom has time tomorrow, she can take her sister to school and let her watch the fun too. "
Children are very sensitive, and Xu Haiyuan doesn't mind when he senses his mother's remorse.
Su Anying thought about it, on the side of the farm, only the glass windows are left in the flower shed, and it may take a few days.
Then there are nail flower stands and so on. Xu Shi'an looked over there and saw that there was no problem.
"Okay, then I will accompany you to school tomorrow, just to take your sister there to watch the fun."
There are too many people on this kind of occasion, Xu Jinping can't go by herself, but an adult should follow to avoid any accidents.
On May 31st, Su Anying led Xu Jinping, Su Anfang and Su Anhua hugged Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui, and went to school to watch the sports meeting together.
Zhou Guilan was bored at home, so she also followed the past to join in the fun.
It happened that Ji Yufeng also brought Yang Haoyu here, and everyone met at the school gate.
The annual elementary school sports meeting is also a rare recreational activity. People around are leading the children to watch the fun.
At the gate of the primary school, many people even made some food and put it for sale.
Soda water, popsicles, candies, and the most surprising thing is that they sell big necks.
Yang Haoyu had never seen a big neck before, so he was very curious and asked Ji Yufeng what it was.
Zhou Guilan shook her head when she saw the big neck.
"If this is still in a big house, you can take the time to wash clothes and go home. It's much thicker than this."
Most of these things grow in the roots of Shilazi by the river, especially at the big house in Xijiang.
There is no river or Shilazi on this side of Donggang, no wonder the children don’t know each other.
Although she disliked it, the old lady took out the money and bought three sticks, giving the three big ones a taste.
"This thing has to be peeled off, the outer skin is peeled off and the inner flesh is eaten, it's sour."
With a big neck, it eats poles, and the part that grows in the ground underneath is whitish.
The most tender is here, sour with a little sweetness, the more you eat, the more sour, and at the end, it will be sour and astringent.
The three children didn't dislike it, they ate it with great enthusiasm, and said it was delicious while eating.
Zhou Guilan frowned all the time, only children can eat this stuff, but adults find it sour.
After eating the big neck, the inspection just started.
All the teachers and students are queuing up outside the gate of the primary school, ready to enter.
There are more than 20 classes in Donggang Central Primary School, plus other elementary schools in the brigade, the lineup is almost at the tomb of the martyrs.
At the front of the team was an art teacher from an elementary school, not tall, wearing a red cloak, and holding a pointed baton in his hand.
Followed by the national flag team, then the elementary school drum team, waist drum team, dance team, and garland performance team, followed by tall boys carrying school badges, knife flag team, and square teams of various classes.
When the inspection time is up, the leading teacher holds the baton and leads the students into the arena.
"Grandma, those sisters are so beautifully dressed. I will come to study in the future and dress like them."
The girls in the dance team are all wearing short skirts, white dance pants, with makeup on their faces, and their hair is all **** and coiled on top of their heads, with red flowers on them.
Xu Jinping saw those girls and felt that those girls were very beautiful. She was so envious that she told her grandma that she would also join the dance team in the future.
"Come on, what's so good about it? All the faces are painted red, it's so ugly."
Unexpectedly, Xu Haiyuan pouted beside him.
The blush on the faces of those girls is a lump of red. In Xu Haiyuan's eyes, they are ugly as hell. I don't know how his sister thinks they look good?
"Well, brother is right, it doesn't look good.
Second sister, don’t dress like them, it’s too ugly. "Yang Haoyu echoed from the side.

chapters.title: Chapter 283: early admission
chapters.content:
In this age when entertainment activities are lacking, the sports meeting is already a very important thing. There are people inside and outside the school gate, all to watch the fun.
Su Anying and the others followed Xu Haiyuan to gain a fortune, and went to Yuhong Class, where there were still chairs to sit on.
Yuhong Class also has a sports meeting today, and the fun is all kinds of games.
Xu Haiyuan is a child who is one or two years younger than others, but he has not fallen behind in anything. He has participated in several sports and is the first.
Especially a sport of running while doing calculations. Children run from the starting point to the middle, pick up the small blackboard on the ground, write the calculation results on it, and then run to the finish line.
As long as the calculation result is correct, there will be rewards, and the first place will also reward notebooks and candies.
Although Xu Haiyuan was younger than those children, he ran quite fast, and reached the middle with a whoosh.
Pick up the small blackboard and chalk and run, writing numbers while running.
Seeing his brother running, Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu shouted for him to cheer up and encourage Xu Haiyuan.
The other children were calculating on the spot, writing down the numbers and holding them before running.
Xu Haiyuan ran while writing, of course it was fast, but he was the first again, and came back with a notebook and candies.
He participated in four sports, and he happened to take four first prizes, four pieces of candy, one piece for each of his younger brothers and sisters.
Over there, the teacher of Yuhong Class was chatting with Su Anying.
"Mother Haiyuan, your son is very good, smart, good at concentrating in class, and knows how to be humble."
Ms. Yang from Yuhong Class praised Xu Haiyuan.
"It's just that he is too young, I'm afraid he won't be accepted in the first grade.
Let me tell you, it’s best to find someone and let him go to the first grade.
The things that Yuhong Class has learned can't help him at all. It is a waste for such a child to stay in Yuhong Class for two years. "
In the following few sentences, Teacher Yang whispered very close to Su Anying.
"I'm supposed to be a teacher, so I shouldn't say these things.
If this is an ordinary child, it is true that he cannot go to school early at a young age, but your son is different.
I think it would not be worth it if he wasted two years in Yuhong Class. "
According to the policy of the local education department, children should enter school at the age of seven. Xu Haiyuan is only a little over five years old now, which is not old enough.
Teacher Yang made the decision sincerely for the good of Xu Haiyuan, and after evaluating Xu Haiyuan's intelligence and other factors.
As for whether Xu Haiyuan's parents can listen to the teacher's advice, Teacher Yang can't interfere too much.
Su Anying was stunned when she heard this, how can her child be so outstanding?
I didn’t notice it, I just thought this baby was so skinny, I wished I could go to the house to expose the tiles, but I didn’t expect that she did very well in school.
A sense of pride welled up, and Su Anying couldn't help laughing.
"Thank you teacher, we will discuss this matter after his father gets off work in the evening."
It would be great if he could study in the morning, but I'm afraid the school won't agree, so Xu Shiyan has to figure out a way.
Ms. Yang smiled and nodded towards Su Anying, turned around and went elsewhere. She couldn't be seen whispering to a parent, which would have a bad influence.
The children were not idle during the morning sports meeting.
Sisters Zhou Guilan, Ji Yufeng, and Su Anfang all bought food and drink for the children, and even the two little ones also took a couple of sips of soda.
Before noon, everyone was tired. It happened that the fun activity in Yuhong Class was over. Su Anying told the teacher and took the child home.
In the evening, when Xu Shiyan got off work, Su Anying told Xu Shiyan what the teacher said during the day.
"Do you think we should find someone to send our son to the first grade in autumn?"
Xu Shiyan pondered for a while, then nodded, "Okay, I'll find someone."
I don’t know whether it’s because Donggang is across the road, or it’s the policy of this year. Anyway, when the eldest daughter was in elementary school in her previous life, she was also required to be seven years old.
The eldest girl in his family had a young birthday, and she was eight years old and only six years old. She had no choice but to find a school teacher to help her hide her age.
It was not until my daughter was in the second grade that the homeroom teacher saw that the child was doing well in his studies and could keep up, so he no longer required a household registration booklet.
Unexpectedly, my son is even better, and he has to enter school two years in advance.
It's probably not easy to do this, so what else can I do if I ask someone to help me?
"No rush, it's not June yet, it's a long time before school starts in autumn, I'll find a way.
I guess it will take a little effort to go to the first grade this fall, and I will go to school next year, and I can do it after finding all the teachers. "
In the previous life, it was Mr. Qi who helped her daughter go to school. It was okay to say one year in advance, but two years in advance, it took a little thought.
"Well, you can figure it out, I don't understand this matter." Su Anying really didn't understand these things, so she didn't dare to give an idea.
Elementary school sports meeting is held for two days, and the second day is meaningless.
Just in time for Children's Day, the Yuhong class was on holiday, so Xu Haiyuan didn't go to school the next day and stayed at home to play.
The flower shed over the farm was finally finished, and all the flower stands were set up.
Su Anying led the daughter-in-law of Huang Shengli and others to work over there, and put all the Clivia seedlings on the flower stand and arranged them.
A flower shed is 15 meters long and 7 meters wide. It is filled with trapezoidal flower stands. Each flower stand has five or six floors. A flower shed can hold about 3,000 to 4,000 pots of small flower seedlings.
The floor of the flower shed is paved with cement blocks and has a kang structure. In winter, fire is fired for heating. The heat starts from the ground, and the temperature of the whole flower shed can be kept balanced.
There is a row of glass windows in front of the flower shed, and half of the upper **** is glass windows, which ensures the light transmittance.
When it is cold in winter, it is covered with a layer of plastic film, and then covered with straw curtains to keep warm and windproof.
Xu Shiyan has made all the plans, and the flower shed is built and kept.
etc. Clivia are all sold, and vegetables and fruits that are on the market in winter can also be grown here, which is also an income.
You can’t spend money to build a flower shed. It only needs to be used for two years and you don’t need it. You can use it reasonably.
It can be said that Huang Shengli and others have really made a lot of progress this winter and spring.
The two flower sheds are more than half set up, plus there are many more at the end of Xu's old house. In total, there are seven or eight thousand pots of seedlings.
"I don't know how much these flower seedlings will be sold in the future, but it's a lot of money to spend."
In the evening, when Su Anying and Xu Shiyan were chatting about the cost of the flower shed, they couldn't help nagging.
"Can you guarantee that this thing will make money? Don't lose it when the time comes, we have invested a lot of money in it."
Flower seeds and flower seedlings cost about 1,000 yuan. The materials and labor for two flower sheds are more expensive than building a house.
Adding labor, flower pots, etc., it really costs a lot, Su Anying really has no idea.
"Don't worry, you will definitely be able to make money. If you don't believe me, this winter, you will accompany my little sister to the provincial capital for medical treatment. When the time comes, you will know."
Xu Shiyan had planned a long time ago. This time, let his wife accompany his younger sister to the provincial capital to see a doctor, and also let his wife go out to learn more.
"Huh? You want me to go to the provincial capital this winter? Can I do it?"
Su Anying was dumbfounded when she heard that, the farthest she went was to Tonghua, now let her go to the provincial capital?
"Don't worry, I'll take you there when the time comes, and make arrangements in the provincial capital, and I'll come back."
Xu Shiyan is a technical consultant for the field, and the field was busy with processing at that time, so it is impossible for him to stay with Xu Shiqin for too long.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Summary meeting
chapters.content:
Gastrodia elata is generally unearthed around the summer solstice, and then blooms and bears fruit.
In this season, digging Gastrodia elata is much easier, so at this time, mountain runners enter the mountain in groups with pockets on their backs and pickaxes.
For Xu Shiyan, he has no time to dig gastrodia elata in the mountains now.
He has a more important task, harvesting Gastrodia elata seeds to prepare for the next Gastrodia elata breeding.
The cost of using Gastrodia elata tubers to reproduce is still a bit high, not as good as seed propagation, and the cost is low.
Of course, the technical requirements are also more difficult, and you can overcome the experience slowly.
Some of the Gastrodia elata planted in spring in the old ginseng field have unearthed and bloomed. Pick five to ten flower buds from the top of the inflorescence to reduce nutrient consumption.
Gastrodia Gastrodia in the wild, there will be insect pollination, supplemented by artificial pollination.
After more than 20 days, the fruit is ripe and should be harvested and stored early.
Put the harvested Gastrodia elata seeds into the seeding tube, sprinkle them on the leaves mixed with the germination bacteria of small mushrooms, and mix them well.
Afterwards, the fungus leaves are buried in the fungal bed with fungal materials according to certain specifications.
Gastrodia elata seeds germinate and will grow into rice hemp. When the rice hemp grows to a certain extent, it can be transplanted, and after another year or two, it can be picked up and made into goods.
Although this method of reproduction is cumbersome, the cost is relatively low, and there is no need to buy gastrodia cubs every year.
"During this period of time, our work has been done well.
Next, I have to be busy. "
The development of Gastrodia elata and Asarum is just a sideline business, and the main business is ginseng cultivation and processing.
So we should distinguish between primary and secondary, and we can’t mess it up.
"We bought tractors and rotary cultivators this year. The soil planing does not require manual labor and can be mechanized, but the requirements are higher.
In our group, some people who scored points went up the mountain and were responsible for instructing the machines to plow, rake and ridge.
One thing must be remembered, the tractor wheels must run strictly along the stringing line and within the scope of the work path, and are not allowed to cross the surface of the pool. "
One participant has a lot of money and wealth. This spring, he bought four Dongfanghong tractors, as well as rotary tillers and brush cutters.
It is expected that the ginseng soil this autumn can complete mechanized operations, and manual labor is only used as an auxiliary. This can greatly save manpower, but it also has some drawbacks.
One is that mechanical plowing is not as meticulous as manual plowing, and the other is that when the tractor is working, ginseng will rot where it is crushed by the wheels.
No one can explain this problem clearly, but as long as it is a tractor road, it will be rotten.
In order to prevent this problem, Xu Shiyan specifically discussed with Secretary Lin to reduce the number of access roads, that is, the horse trails, to ensure that the tractor roads are just on the work roads.
Reducing the width of the working road is not only to cooperate with mechanical plowing, but more importantly, it is to make rational use of the land.
The current ginseng operation roads are relatively wide, and some horse roads are even wider than the pool surface. This is actually unreasonable and cannot achieve the effective utilization of the land.
The bridle path is just called a bridle path, but it doesn’t mean that horses can run away. In fact, the width of the bridle path can be as long as one person can pass smoothly with a watering can on his back.
Waiting for another 20 years, when the ginseng soil costs tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of dollars per hectare, even those who want to narrow the road will have trouble getting through it.
Now one hectare of land can produce 700 feet of ginseng, and in the future, one hectare can produce 1,200 feet, all of which is money.
The land that can be used to grow ginseng will only become less and less. If we don’t pay attention to rational use now, when there is no land to use in the future, the ginseng industry will also die.
For this purpose, Xu Shiyan also specially wrote an article, "Shrinking Operation Roads and Improving Land Utilization Efficiency".
This article was published in the journal of Fusong Ginseng Society some time ago, which aroused many discussions.
The leaders of the county also attach great importance to it, and specially convened a meeting with the leaders of participating venues and communes to discuss it, and it may be implemented in the whole county in the future.
"Understood, team leader, we must strictly follow the operation requirements, watch the tractors work, and never make mistakes." Han Limin and the others nodded in response.
"Well, participating in the land is one aspect, and the other is this year's participation in labor."
"It's almost time to pick up the goods again. On the processing plant side, the equipment needs to be overhauled in advance, and new processes need to be developed. We have more important things to do."
"At the other end of the comprehensive factory, the ginseng flower drink dew was successfully developed, and at the Guangzhou Flower City, the soda water factory that cooperated with us has also begun to put into production.
We can't relax, we have to continue to work hard, Ginseng Coke, there are still technical problems to be solved.
cheer up and not relax. "
Ginseng flower dew is a project that Xu Shiyan had already started researching before he came to participate.
The ginseng flower dew cola was proposed by Xu Shiyan on the basis of ginseng flower dew.
He discussed with Secretary Lin that it would be better to build the factory locally instead of just providing raw materials.
Fusong has beautiful mountains and rivers, and so many mineral water brands in later generations have built factories here.
If you don’t take advantage of such a good resource, what’s the point of just providing raw materials for others?
“Our research on human participation this year mainly starts from two aspects.
One is to develop ginseng instant honey slices. If this is done, it is almost like a snack. You can take it out and eat a slice anytime, anywhere.
For people in our country, it is still too extravagant.
But for foreign countries, especially South Korea and Dongyi, they prefer to eat ginseng products, and this method is more acceptable. "
Based on the current equipment and processing level of the processing plant, deeper processing is still not possible.
The craft of this instant honey slice is not particularly complicated, slice it and marinate it with good honey.
It can be made into cans, preferably individually packaged in single-piece plastic packaging. For small snacks, one piece is packaged, and you can open and eat at any time.
Ginseng, medicinal and edible.
Needless to say, medicinal uses, such as Ginseng Reconstituted Pills, Ginseng Dabu Pills, Ginseng Jianpi Pills, etc., can all be used.
People abroad can also extract ginsenosides, ginsenosides and other components for use.
Ordinary eating methods, most of which are stewing chicken soup, making tea, cooking porridge, etc. It should be said that it is quite troublesome.
This kind of instant honey chips is eaten as a snack, and you can eat it anytime, anywhere, just open a pack.
Made with high-quality honey, it removes the anger of ginseng, nourishes yin and moistens dryness, and replenishes vitality.
Relatively speaking, it is more popular with some young people, especially those white-collar workers who are busy with work.
Xu Shiyan made such an introduction, and the technical team were all dumbfounded. No one thought that there could be such a method.
"Team leader, your method is good, but the ginseng we produce is directly taken away by the provincial medicinal materials company.
In this case, the medicinal material company has no procurement plan. "Someone next to him raised an objection.
Xu Shiyan smiled, "Do you think that with the current momentum of ginseng development in our county, if the output doubles in two or three years, the provincial medicinal materials company will still have the ability to buy them all?
If they can't buy them all, where will the ginseng we cultivated so hard be sold? "
A few words made the faces of the people below turn pale with fright.
"Impossible? Ginseng has always been purchased and sold in a unified manner. Can the province not buy it?
Then if the province can’t collect so much, what can we do? "
In the era of planned economy, ginseng management implements the policy of unified planning, unified production, unified purchase and unified sales.
The ginseng produced in Fusong is purchased by the provincial medicinal materials company and the provincial medicine and health products import and export company.
But with the implementation of the household contract responsibility system, the ginseng industry in various places is booming.
By 1989, the higher authorities issued a document, except for the acquisition of the above two companies in accordance with the previously signed five-year purchase and sale contract, the rest of the acquisitions were organized by the county itself.
At that time, the production of ginseng increased rapidly, and the county was simply unable to fully purchase it, which led to a large backlog of ginseng.
Despite many positive measures taken by governments at all levels, the situation has not been saved.
Starting from 1990, the price of ginseng plummeted, and fell to the bottom in 1992. Since then, the ginseng market has been in a slump.
But now, the situation has changed.
Because of the ginseng field fertilizer, the era of large-scale increase in ginseng production is coming.
Then, does the provincial medicinal material company and health care product company still have the ability to buy them in full? It may be able to persist for a few years, but the future prospects are still not optimistic.
Chinese people have a bad habit of following the trend. As long as they see other people making money by doing something, it will cause a lot of people to flock in.
The same is true for the ginseng industry. In recent years, ginseng production has increased, and the income of ginseng farmers has increased, followed by large-scale expansion of ginseng households in various places.
Not to mention the original participation of each commune and team, each enterprise or institution either approves its own participation, or organizes participation with the forest farms under the Forestry Bureau.
Even elementary schools, supply and marketing cooperatives and other units, as long as they have some money to invest, they will invest in it.
The blind expansion of ginseng planting area resulted in a sharp drop in the price of ginseng.
No one buys the ginseng grown, and the ginseng farmers lower the prices of each other in order to reduce losses.
So in the spring of this year, when the county held a commendation meeting, Xu Shiyan proposed that the relevant departments should strictly control the area of ​​ginseng planting and not blindly expand it.
However, his remarks were opposed by many people.
Many people think that Xu Shiyan has a formal job now, and he has forgotten his roots after leaving the agricultural team.
Regardless of the overall situation, they want to restrict the development of others and hinder the county's economic take-off.
This is speaking for the state-run participants, wanting to monopolize the market, anyway, they have everything.
Some people who opposed it almost canceled Xu Shiyan's personal awards.
Thanks to the support of Secretary Guan, Xu Shiyan was not punished.
After Xu Shiyan came back, he discussed this issue with Secretary Lin, and Secretary Lin agreed with Xu Shiyan.
In any field, blind expansion will only lead to greater crises.
Therefore, one participant must be at the forefront, and cannot wait until the crisis comes to find a way to break the situation, then it will be too late.
"The state-run first participating venue, the oldest among the four participating venues in the county, can be regarded as the big brother.
Therefore, a participant must play a leading role. As a technical research department of a participant, we must take the lead and produce high-quality products, and must not be looked down upon by outsiders.
The product is out. As for the sales, we don’t need to worry about it. Secretary Lin and the county management secretary will consider it.
What we have to do is to tackle key technical problems and make products with the highest value, the highest profit, and the products that customers most want to buy. This is our task. "

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Li Chengrong's thoughts
chapters.content:
"Ginseng honey slices can only be said to be a small gadget, and we have a more important product this year.
It is based on Korean ginseng, and strives to create our own characteristics, Fusong Changbaishan red ginseng.
It seems that the ginseng company in the county is also researching it. Let's compare with them to see who will research it first. "
No matter what you do, you will be motivated if you have competition.
Xu Shiyan said this on purpose to cheer up the people under his command.
Of course, it is true that the county is researching this Changbai Mountain red ginseng, but there has been no progress.
Xu Shiyan is also holding back his energy, and must lead people to overcome technical problems.
“Next, we will develop various ginseng products.
For example, ginseng extract, ginseng oral liquid, sambal wine, ginseng sugar, ginseng coffee, canned ginseng white fungus, ginseng smoke, ginseng tea, all of which are worthy of our in-depth research. "
After these things are researched, taking advantage of the trend of health care products in the 1990s, they can not only be exported to foreign countries, but also can be sold domestically.
“In the future, our technology will be able to make ginseng beauty cream, ginseng skin care lotion, ginseng shampoo, and ginseng essence soap.
Only when we refine and brand the industry ourselves can we bring more added value.
Instead of simply planting in the field for three years, get it out, process it and sell it.
One thing to keep in mind is that primitive and extensive production and processing methods can only earn a minimum amount of money forever, and our money is all earned by other people. "
It should be said that Xu Shiyan's books in the past six months are really not in vain. All kinds of ideas and theories have improved a lot compared to before.
What he said opened a door, allowing everyone to see the world outside the door.
"Okay, what the team leader said is good." Li Chengrong was the first to applaud, and the others came to their senses and followed suit.
Everyone has longing and hope on their faces.
"Leader, can I record what you said just now?" Li Chengrong asked immediately.
“I think this is something that not only our technical team should learn, but most of the participants should learn.
He even said that all relevant personnel in the county should take a look. "
"It's okay to sort it out. Let's show it to Secretary Lin first. As for the county, we have to ask Secretary Lin for instructions."
Xu Shiyan is now an employee in the field. If there is something to do, he should first ask the leader for instructions, and the leader allows him to do it.
After all, what he said just now may be a big picture in the eyes of others, which is unrealistic.
If it got out, people would have to laugh at him for his whimsical ideas.
That's why Xu Shiyan felt that Secretary Lin was better than him in determining the specifics, so it was not good for him to make decisions on his own.
Li Chengrong nodded, "Okay, I remember. When the manuscript comes out, I will show it to the team leader first. If you say yes, I will give it to Secretary Lin."
"Okay, today's meeting will be like this, it's late, let's go home from get off work."
A stage work summary meeting and a work outlook meeting for the next stage ended in this way.
It happened to be almost time, so Xu Shiyan asked everyone to go home from get off work.
"Brother Xu, wait for me." Xu Shiyan just pushed the car to the outside of the field department when Li Chengrong's voice came from behind him.
"What's wrong? Is there something wrong?"
Xu Shiyan turned his head and looked at Li Chengrong, only to find that this kid's face seemed a little red.
The weather in July is hot, but it’s past four o’clock, so it’s not hot enough to make your head swell, right? This kid is sick?
"Ahem, that, Brother Xu, please, give this to Comrade Su Anhua."
Li Chengrong coughed twice, and handed a paper bag to Xu Shiyan with an awkward expression.
"This is a scarf I bought when I went to the county a while ago. It looks pretty good to me. Brother Xu, please help me give it to her."
After saying this, what else does Xu Shiyan not understand?
Co-author Li Chengrong, this kid, misses his sister-in-law Su Anhua.
Recalling a while ago, Li Chengrong always forgot to run away from Xu's family, saying he was asking some questions.
After arguing for a long time, this kid has no good intentions.
Xu Shiyan looked Li Chengrong up and down, and snorted.
"So you kid, you didn't go to ask questions, you went to chase girls.
All right, my eyes are quite thieves, and I have taken a fancy to my sixth sister. "
In all fairness, it's okay to be honest and long-suffering, not as good-looking as Ji Tongzhong, but he can still be regarded as good-looking and dignified.
It is myopia, wearing glasses, Xu Shiyan has inquired about it, myopia is not severe, about 300 degrees, it should not be inherited.
People are good-looking and good at work. The workers in the state-run field, the backbone of the technical team, will definitely develop when they are young.
The ages are also matched, Li Chengrong is 21, Su Anhua is 18, the two have settled down for two years, Su Anhua just happens to be 20 and can get married.
In this day and age, most girls get married early, and it is true that there are not many girls like Su Anying who marry in their twenties.
Not to mention family background, Li Chengrong's father is the head of a subfield, and his brothers and sisters also have jobs, and they are all married.
Li Chengrong is the youngest one. I heard from Li Bingzhuo before that he will live with his old son in the future.
Li Chengrong's mother, Xu Shiyan has met several times, she is okay, reasonable, not like a wicked mother-in-law.
Thinking of the tasks assigned by my father-in-law during the Chinese New Year, at least half of this year is over, and it seems that half of the tasks can be completed.
One thing is not right, the marriage of the fifth child has not happened, why did the sixth child come first?
It was the same in the previous life, the sixth child got married first, and the fifth child got married when he was quite old.
Could it be that this is still the case in this life?
Yes, let’s go home and discuss this matter with my wife. If I have time, I really have to hurry up and introduce one to the fifth child.
The old six is ​​still young, so don't really rush ahead.
The father-in-law and mother-in-law are old-fashioned. If the order is out of order, the old couple will probably feel uncomfortable.
Xu Shiyan took another look at Li Chengrong. From the bottom of his heart, Li Chengrong is a good guy, and he can't fault him in any aspect.
But there is one thing, are you a little timid? You don't dare to chase after a girl you like, but you actually entrust Xu Shiyan to help deliver things?
"That, brother Xu, listen to me, me, me, that."
Li Chengrong was overwhelmed, so nervous that he couldn't even speak clearly.
He blushed so anxiously that his forehead was covered with sweat, but he didn't know what to say.
Xu Shiyan was amused by this silly boy, and couldn't help shaking his head.
"I like to chase after myself, so what's the matter if I pass things from the middle?
I am a brother-in-law, and I help outsiders chase my sister-in-law, is it reasonable? "Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes at Li Chengrong.
"If you really want to, just tell your family members and send someone to my house or my mother's place to propose marriage.
It doesn't matter if you like girls, we are upright, don't sneak around like it's shameful. "
Xu Shiyan didn't pick up anything, just patted Li Chengrong on the shoulder, and then pushed the car away.
Leaving Li Chengrong stunned in place, his mind was full of Xu Shiyan's words just now.
I was really interested, so I told my family and sent someone to propose marriage.
"Brother Xu, I really mean it, I'm going to find my mother right now."
Li Chengrong yelled at Xu Shiyan's back, raised his legs and ran home.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Cream Popsicles
chapters.content:
Xu Shiyan rode his bicycle home, and as soon as he entered the door, he saw his two young children playing in the yard.
These two children are going to leave at the age of one year old, and now they have gone very smoothly.
After successfully evolving from a four-legged beast to a two-legged beast, the two babies can't be locked up at all. They run around the yard all day long, and they can't let them out.
"Qingqing, Huihui, come, come and find Dad, and see what Dad bought for you?"
Xu Shiyan parked his bicycle, waved to the children, and then took out something wrapped in a towel from his diagonal pocket.
"Popsicles, creamy ones, come quickly, one for each person."
Cream popsicles, five cents a piece, new arrivals from participating stores.
Xu Shiyan passed by and saw it just now, and bought a few for the children.
He also deliberately borrowed a tea mug to store it, and wrapped it in a towel, for fear that it would melt too quickly.
"dad."
Xu Shiyan brought food back from get off work every day. The two little ones were very happy to see their father, and they ran towards their father with short legs, giggling.
These two have just learned to walk for less than two months, so they lift their legs and run.
Seeing the two babies stumbling towards him, Xu Shiyan was so worried that he hurried up to meet them and hugged the two little ones in his arms.
"Come on, one root per person."
Xu Shiyan untied the towel, took out popsicles from the tea mug with a lid, and gave one to each of the two children.
"Yuanyuan, Pingping, what are you two doing? You don't come to eat any popsicles?"
The two young ones were very happy holding the popsicles, but the two big ones were poking around in the corner, not knowing what to do, even ignoring their father when he came home.
Xu Shiyan walked over and found that the two were looking at the ants on the ground.
"Look, Dad, my brother ate the cake and dropped the scum on the ground, and then a lot of ants came over.
I used the toilet ball my mother put in the closet and drew a circle here.
Then the ants were all stupid, they couldn't find their way home, and they all wandered around in this circle, which was fun. "
Xu Haiyuan pointed to the ants on the ground and explained to Xu Shiyan.
"Our teacher said that ants find their way by smell. It's true." Xu Haiyuan showed off to his father with a proud face.
Xu Shiyan was speechless, and rolled his eyes. This brat can do anything. He has nothing to do this day, and he is a disaster for ants.
"Are you free on vacation?"
Bear stuff, since the Yuhong class is on summer vacation, this guy has been herding sheep, and he can do nothing every day.
It caused Su Anying to be on fire every day, and sometimes Xu Shiyan had to eat when he went home.
"I've already found someone to tell you that I will be in the first grade in autumn, and I happen to be with Shuqing.
You only have a few days left to enjoy yourself, waiting to go to elementary school, if you don't study hard, see how I beat you. "
Xu Shiyan raised his hand, squeezed his son's face, and then handed the popsicles to the two older ones.
"Come on, let's eat first, don't harm those ants, look at your dirt, will your mother beat you when she sees it?"
This kid doesn't know where to put it, the pants are covered with dirt.
"Is your mother back yet? Have you cooked at home?" Xu Shiyan asked while helping his son pat his pants.
Actually, there is no need to ask, if Su Anying comes back, how dare Xu Haiyuan cause such a situation?
"Eat slowly, watch your siblings, I'll cook." Xu Shiyan got up and was about to go into the house to cook.
As soon as he entered the door, he saw Su Anfang and Su Anhua walking towards the east room with food.
"Yo, you two cooked the meal? I was thinking about cooking.
Your second sister hasn't got off work yet? The farm is so busy? "
The two sisters stayed at home to take care of Clivia, and there were four mischievous children, and they had to wash clothes and cook, which was enough for them.
Xu Shiyan is busy with the work of participating in the field, while Su Anying is busy with the farm and the field of participation in the brigade.
The couple couldn't take care of the family anymore. Fortunately, there were Zhou Guilan and the Su family sisters, otherwise, their family would definitely be ruined, and they wouldn't even be able to eat.
"Well, the second sister said that the sables in the farm are mating these days, and she will come back later these days."
Sables do not live in groups. Males and females are separated, and special management is required during the breeding season.
Su Anying didn't dare to be careless, and tried her best to take care of it over there, for fear of accidents.
The scale of the farm is bigger this year, and there are more than a hundred otters, big and small.
The number of sables is small, and about 20 young minks were born in the beginning of spring. At present, it seems that they have to be raised slowly, not in a hurry.
Deer and musk deer have also added many new members, and the population is constantly expanding. This spring, a batch of deer antlers sold for a lot of money.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying calculated that it is more profitable to raise deer and musk deer. This is a sustainable resource. There is no need to kill deer or musk deer, and there is income every year.
Of course, sables and otters also sell a lot of money. Not long ago, some otters were sold, which made more money than selling otter skins.
Some people came to inquire about breeding sables. Su Anying felt that the breeding rate of sables was low and the population had not yet reached a prosperous level, so she didn't want to sell them for the time being, and waited for two years to discuss.
Since Su Anying took charge of the farm, she has been very attentive to these animals.
Isn't it the time for the sable to breed? She is worried, so she goes to take care of it every day and take good care of it.
Anyway, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui were also weaned, Su Anying simply didn't come back at noon, ate there, and returned home in the evening.
Just as he was talking, he heard the movement of a bicycle outside, and then Su Anying's voice sounded.
"Who bought the popsicles for you? It's almost night, and you'll eat cold ones, how will you eat later?"
Well, needless to say, Su Anying must be upset seeing the children eating popsicles.
"Daughter-in-law, I bought it. There are new cream popsicles in the store today. I bought four for the children.
It's hot, so it doesn't matter if you let them eat something, and don't delay eating. "
Xu Shiyan hurried out of the house and explained to his wife.
These kids in his family are solid, a popsicle is fine.
Generally speaking, children with weak spleen and stomach should not eat more cold food, as they are prone to indigestion.
Like Yang Haoyu, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to feed them. These little donkeys in his family are not afraid, and it's okay to eat them once in a while.
This year is not the future. Every household has a refrigerator, and children eat cold food all day long.
"You got off work early today, coming back earlier than me."
Su Anying saw that her husband was at home, smiled, and put the bicycle on the side of the garden stick.
After taking over the farm, Su Anying has changed a lot compared to before.
The original braid was cut and cut into a number five head.
It may be that these days are a little longer and there is no time to clean up, and the weather is hot, so she uses a floral handkerchief to gather her hair up and tie it into a short ponytail.
Blue floral top with white background, blue-gray pants, fat and thin fit, refreshing and neat.
If Su Anying used to be gentle and gentle at home, now she is a little more capable and sharp, with more confidence and calmness in her brows and eyes, and her temperament is different from before.
Regarding the change in his wife, Xu Shiyan was delighted in seeing it.
No one has to contribute to the family, and a woman should also have her own career.
Men should not use the name of the family to trap their daughter-in-law at home and give women a suitable space. They will definitely not be worse than men.
Of course, it’s also fortunate that their family has a helper, otherwise, they would definitely be in trouble.
As long as the husband and wife work together to survive this difficult period, they will get better in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: mischievous
chapters.content:
"Well, nothing has happened recently, and Gastrodia elata breeding has basically come to an end."
From July 20th, Gastrodia elata begins to rot after blooming, and new Gastrodia elata cubs are released.
The gastrodia elata is empty and there are no scales, so instead of digging gastrodia elata, the mountain runners look for ganoderma lucidum, which can be released in a few days.
Xu Shiyan couldn't keep Gastrodia elata cubs, so the cultivation of Gastrodia elata could only be suspended.
"It's time to start preparing for the processing of sticks, there are more sticks in the field, and the goods start earlier than our team.
In a few days, I have to bring someone to overhaul the equipment and prepare to start work. "
Xu Shiyan focuses on the deep processing of ginseng, so of course he is in charge of the processing factory.
"Oh, if you are not too busy recently, please contact me and sell those two little black blind men.
Those two things are so delicious, they are still mischievous every day, follow their feet, and love to hug people's thighs. "
Su Anying picked up her youngest son and walked into the house, discussing with Xu Shiyan.
At the beginning of spring, I caught two little black blind men from the mountains and came back. They were too young to feed them at that time, so they were thrown in the farm and fed with goat milk first.
Xu Shiyan meant that the two little black blind men can be locked up in any pen, and they can be raised casually and sold when they are weaned.
Who would have thought that Xu Shi'an had fun watching the two black and blind cubs, so he didn't lock them up and stayed in his duty room, teasing them all day long.
The little black blind man lost his mother and was kept by Xu Shian as a pet. He probably took Xu Shian as his mother.
That's good, I follow Xu Shi'an all day long, and roll around to show off his cuteness every now and then.
Otherwise, they will hold their legs and not let go, and if one fails, they will trip someone up.
The most terrible thing is that the bigger these two things are, the more edible they are.
They can eat any kind of feed at the farm, and their stomachs feel like a bottomless pit every day.
Su Anying is also worried that these two little black blind men will grow bigger and bigger, and it will be harder to make a move in the future.
The one raised by the family is also reluctant to kill, isn't that just smashing it in the hand?
"Oh, yes, and those two black and blind men, I forgot about this time.
That’s fine. Sometime, I’ll call Tonghua and ask someone to ask the zoo if they want it. "
Xu Shiyan has a cooperative relationship with Tonghua's medicinal materials purchasing station. The velvet and musk produced here are directly purchased there, so it is no problem to find someone to help.
The couple were talking, Su Anfang and Su Anhua over there had already served all the food on the table, so they called Xu Haiyuan and his brother and sister to wash their hands and eat.
Then, Xu Haiyuan's dirty body was discovered by Su Anying.
Furious, Su Anying jumped into a rage, dragged her son to the kitchen, fetched water for a good scrubbing.
"You can work hard. I will take you to the farm tomorrow. I will let you clean up the deer dung. Let's see how you can do it?"
"Okay, I'm going to see the deer."
Xu Haiyuan didn't want to hear it, but his eyes widened with excitement.
He has been thinking about the animals on the farm for a long time, and he is eager to see them.
"Well, daughter-in-law, don't be fooled, you let him go to the farm, it would be strange if he didn't play tricks on you.
Those animals are timid, they will get sick if they are frightened, and they may die.
Don't let this **** go to the farm, we can't bear the loss. "
Xu Shiyan was frightened when he heard this, so he hurriedly stopped him.
Are you kidding, the animals on the other end are all money, with Xu Haiyuan's combat power, it might be a toss in the past, but I can't stand it.
Su Anying heard the same thing, if Xu Haiyuan really tortured and killed a few of them, wouldn't it be a waste of money?
"Tell me about you, Cheng Tianpi, you can poke and poke everything, I make you so worried.
When does school start? Hurry up and go to school. "Just a few days after the holiday, Su Anying was thinking about the start of school.
It's also strange, Xu Haiyuan is a child who goes to school very well, obediently attends classes and does homework.
It is easy to go home, there is nothing he can't do.
He also had to look through the mouse hole twice, and he was curious about everything. The clothes, if they didn't get a set in a day, they were so dirty that they couldn't be seen.
"Who did you say you followed, why did you go shopping like this?" Su Anying sighed helplessly.
"Mom, I'm not being naughty, I just dug some earthworms today.
People say, can an earthworm live if its body is broken? I just want to try it.
In the afternoon I tried the ants and drew a circle for them, and then they wandered around in the circle, unable to find their way home. "
Xu Haiyuan blinked his big eyes with an innocent and ignorant expression on his face.
He is clearly experimenting, can you prove what the teacher said? How did you become naughty?
Seeing that Su Anying's anger was about to rise again, Xu Shiyan hurriedly stopped her.
"Daughter-in-law, eat, eat.
You let him do it. Anyway, there are only twenty days before the start of school, and he will be in elementary school when the school starts.
There is homework after school in elementary school, and if he dares not to finish his homework, he will be embarrassed. You don't need to tell me, I will definitely cut him off. "
Xu Shiyan glared at his son vigorously as he spoke.
This son of his family doesn't know what's in his head, and the things he plays are different from other children.
Other children are so old, they all play yo, shoot a slingshot, or throw a clay doll or something.
He doesn't, he only plays things that others can't think of.
In winter, I filled the glass with water and put it outside to freeze. The glass was frozen and exploded.
In summer, I used the magnifying glass at home to bake paper, and the paper almost burned the firewood stack.
Tie a small red flag on the tail of the old Baozi, so scared that the old Baozi kept running and almost died of exhaustion.
Throwing Zhou Guilan's little chicken into the water, the chicken almost drowned.
In order to study why someone was talking on the radio, Xu Haiyuan almost disassembled the radio to see where the person was hiding.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't discovered it early, his radio might have become a spare part.
Later, it was Xu Shiyan who explained the principle of the radio to his son, and the brat believed that there was no one in the radio, and it was transmitted through radio waves.
Just such a child, if you say he’s going to buy it, he’ll return a bag of excuses.
What am I going to do, what is going on with what our teacher said.
Let’s say he doesn’t scouring, he will cause some trouble every time, and it’s not over if nothing happens.
If there is such a condition, give him some Lego or something, or those small handicrafts, I guess this kid can make a name for himself, but right now?
Hey, let’s do it. Next time he goes out, he will go to the bookstore more often to see if there are any books suitable for such an older child.
There is a book to read, maybe it will not be so expensive.
"Eat, eat, eat, I have something to discuss with you."
After Xu Shiyan stared at his son, he had to turn around to coax his wife.
No way, for the sake of family stability, don't be full of gunpowder all day long, only he can make mud in the middle.
As soon as Su Anying heard that there was something to discuss, she stopped being angry with her son, and hugged her youngest son and daughter by her side, and hurriedly fed the child.
"When you two grow up, don't be so naughty like your brother. If anyone is naughty, mom will beat him up."
Su Anying's words were obviously referring to the two younger ones, but in fact they were beating the eldest son.
It's a pity that the big-hearted son of his family doesn't listen to his mother's nagging at all.
At this moment, the storytelling started to play on the radio, and the little guy stopped making noise. He listened attentively to the storytelling, and was fascinated by it.

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Rats at night
chapters.content:
After dinner, Sister Su Anfang helped clean up the kitchen before leaving.
Su Anying bathed and changed the clothes for the four children, and then washed the changed clothes by hand.
Xu Shiyan led the children who had taken a bath to play until they were all sleepy, and the quilts were laid on the bed, and the four children were lined up from small to large, just half of the kang.
"In two years, Xu Haiyuan, you take your younger brother to sleep in the west room, and Ping Ping takes your younger sister to sleep in the west room."
Looking at the children all over the bed, Xu Shiyan felt very satisfied.
How wonderful, when these few grow up and start their own families, and then bring back a few grandchildren and grandchildren, how good is the whole room full of people?
"Dad, I can go to the west room to sleep now, there are rats in the east room, and there will always be noise at night.
But I searched for it during the day, but I couldn't find the mouse hole.
No way, let’s raise a cat. This mouse is too bad. What if it eats our furniture and steals our food? "
Xu Haiyuan was lying on the bed, blinking his big eyes, with a puzzled and worried expression on his face.
"There are mice in our house? Why didn't I know? I didn't hear."
Xu Jinping lay beside her brother with a look of surprise, why didn't she know?
"You sleep like a pig at night, what do you know?"
Xu Haiyuan glanced at his sister, his eyes were full of contempt.
"Dad, it really doesn't work, let's get some rat poison.
I heard people say that zinc phosphide works best. Grab some crickets to remove the shell, pour the medicine into the shell and cover it. They say that the poisonous rat is the best. "
Xu Shiyan almost choked on his own saliva, which made him cough for a long time.
"If you don't sleep at night, it's useless to think about it.
Who told you that zinc phosphide is good for rats? That stuff is poisonous.
The four of you in our family are terribly scavenging, and you can rummage every corner. What if your brother sees and eats it? "
Xu Shiyan finally stopped coughing, and warned Xu Haiyuan seriously.
"When you hear what other people say outside, you are not allowed to poke around, do you understand?
Some things are beyond the capabilities of children as old as you, it is too dangerous. "
Xu Haiyuan has nothing to say about his hands-on ability, and his ideas are right. Xu Shiyan is really worried about this kid, what if he pokes something dangerous?
"Remember in the future, don't play with fire, don't touch electrical appliances, don't touch the sockets, light bulbs, etc. at home.
Those pointed things are not good either, they are easy to pierce.
Then there is the medicine, no matter what kind of medicine, you are not allowed to tamper with it, it is not a joke, if you take the wrong medicine, it will be fatal. "
Xu Shiyan knew that the eldest son could understand what he said, so he warned his son very seriously.
This is really no joke, it's too dangerous.
"My father and mother are too busy to take care of you. You are an older brother. You must protect your younger siblings. Do you understand?"
The eldest son must be responsible for the eldest son. This is the idea Xu Shiyan instilled in his son since he was a child.
Xu Haiyuan can be naughty, he can be as naughty as he likes, but he must remember one thing, protect his younger siblings and not let them get hurt.
"Oh, I see, Dad. I will definitely pay attention to my brothers and sisters in the future."
Xu Haiyuan knew the seriousness of the matter, immediately put on a small face, and nodded solemnly.
"Dad, don't worry, I'm a man and a good helper for Dad. I will definitely be able to complete the task."
Xu Shiyan smiled, and reached out to rub his son's little head.
"Okay, go to bed quickly, you are still young, rest early and grow up quickly, and only when you grow up can you help your parents share more.
The younger brothers and sisters will also grow up, and when they are older, Dad will also tell them. "
Everyone should be responsible for their own safety.
When the child is young, parents are obliged to protect the child, but the concept must be established from an early age, and they cannot wait for something to happen and then regret it.
The two younger ones have already fallen asleep, Xu Jinping is too sleepy to open her eyes, Xu Haiyuan is still a little bit energetic, but obediently closes her eyes and rests.
Xu Shiyan reached out and pulled down the light cord, and the room became dark.
After a while, several children fell asleep, and Xu Shiyan got up and came out of the east room.
"Is there anything left to finish? Let me do it."
Seeing that his daughter-in-law was scrubbing and washing clothes at the door, Xu Shiyan hurried forward to help throw the clothes out and wring out the water.
"Otherwise, let's just buy a washing machine and save trouble." Xu Shiyan said while the two were twisting the clothes.
"It's not very useful to buy that thing. I've seen the washing machine in Jiang's house, and it consumes water, electricity and washing powder.
In fact, I don’t have to worry about going anywhere. I have to add water in and put water out, and I can’t keep up with rubbing it with my hands. "
Su Anying shook her head, thinking that the washing machine is a waste of money and not very useful.
The Jiang family that Su Anying mentioned was the family of the director of the grain depot in Xitou. Both of them had jobs, and they bought a washing machine a while ago.
The neighbors in the neighborhood knew about it, and they all went to his house to watch the excitement, and wanted to see how the washing machine washed clothes.
Su Anying happened to be fine that day, and was dragged by Huang Shengli's wife to take a look, and thought it was actually quite troublesome.
At most, you don’t need to rub it with your hands. Others may not be worry-free, it takes water and electricity.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment before he remembered that the washing machine at this time was semi-automatic, not fully automatic.
"Our house is better. You put the washing machine in the kitchen, and connect the pipe to the water pipe here. The drain pipe just goes into the sewer. It's okay, it's not too troublesome.
Wait for me to ask, is there a double-tub washing machine that can dry clothes, which is good for winter. "
In a previous life, my family bought a Clivia brand single-tub washing machine, but I really didn’t use it much.
Su Anying thinks that the washing machine is troublesome to use, the clothes can't be washed cleanly, and the sheets can be shredded.
Later, the washing machine was left unused and broke, and it seemed that it was sold for dozens of dollars in the end.
"The key is that these four skin children are made like mud monkeys all day long.
We are both busy, you are too tired to go home and wash their clothes after a busy day.
Get a washing machine to save some effort, so I just watch and wash it. "
Xu Shiyan still felt that it was necessary to buy a washing machine.
"Fine, then you can do whatever you want." Xu Shiyan was kind, and Su Anying didn't want to argue with her husband.
Buy it if you want, it’s not like the family can’t afford it.
"By the way, didn't you say that you have something to discuss with me? What's the matter?" Su Anying did not forget what Xu Shiyan said at the dinner table.
"Oh, yes, how about that young man you look at Li Chengrong?"
Xu Shiyan thought of Su Anhua's marriage, so he hurriedly told his wife and asked her opinion.
"Xiao Li, it's pretty good. Every time I come to our house, I'm very polite and gentle. What's the matter?"
Su Anying didn't understand why her husband suddenly asked Li Chengrong what she was doing.
"He took a scarf today and asked me to help deliver flowers." Xu Shiyan stared at his wife to see how she reacted.
"Huh? Xiaoli and Hua'er?" Su Anying looked surprised.
"When did it happen, why didn't I see it at all?"

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Su Anhua's Marriage
chapters.content:
"The two of you should have nothing to do, it's just that Xiao Li has taken a fancy to our family's flower.
I was wondering what you mean, what do you think of Xiao Li?
I told him today that if you want to, you can find a matchmaker to propose marriage. Gou Qiuqiu is as shameless as you are. "
This year it is said that free love is advocated, but in fact most men and women are still introduced by matchmakers.
It is better than before. Both men and women can meet a few times, and they can get along well if they can talk, and it’s okay if they don’t.
"Xiao Li's family is a worker, and his father is a field manager. Our Hua'er has an agricultural registered permanent residence, and my father is also in the agricultural team.
The shoulders of the two families are not generally even, can this work? The Li family may not agree, right? "
What Su Anying was worried about was the disparity between the two families.
Su Weizhong asked the two daughters to live in Donggang mainly for the marriage of sister Su Anfang.
Li Chengrong is good no matter what the conditions are, let alone Su Anying, even if Su Weizhong comes, he can't find fault.
Su Anying's main concern is the Li family. They are workers' families, so can they marry old farmers?
"Anyway, I told Xiao Li that if he wants to, he can tell his family members to propose marriage in a dignified way.
At that time, let’s ask Hua’er for her opinion. If she agrees, the two of them will get along. If they don’t agree, it’s okay, right? "
Actually, Xu Shiyan also worried about this, so he asked Li Chengrong to explain it to his family.
Don't let the two young people get along secretly, and only let the family know when the relationship is deep.
What if the Li family disagrees? Didn't that hurt Su Anhua?
Now Su Anhua doesn't know anything, even if Li's family disagrees, Su Anhua won't suffer any harm, just find a suitable one slowly in the future.
As for Li Chengrong, if the girl he likes doesn't have the courage to fight for it, such a man should forget it, it's not good.
"Well, yes, it's all up to Xiaoli and his family, let's not mention it to Hua'er, wait and see."
Su Anying also felt that her husband was right to handle it this way.
Marriage is not a matter of two people, it is a relationship between two families, so it is better to be cautious.
"I just want to tell you in advance, if the Li family really finds someone to bring it up, you are prepared."
Xu Shiyan didn't intend to say anything. He didn't even mention it when the two sisters-in-law were around.
At this moment, the children are all asleep before speaking, lest Xu Haiyuan's ear-reporting **** listens to it, and may slip up at some point.
"Actually, I'm quite optimistic about Xiaoli, and it happens that we are both participating in the venue. If we become relatives, we will take care of each other.
Hua'er doesn't need to marry elsewhere, she is close to you, and we can take care of everything in the future. "
From the bottom of his heart, Xu Shiyan really thinks this marriage is pretty good.
Li Chengrong is a worker who participates in the field. Regardless of whether it will be yellow or not when he participates in the field in the future, he will have all the benefits he deserves, and he can retire normally in the future.
It seems to be 2010. There was a policy that all family workers can retire after paying a sum of money.
Compared with officially retired workers, there is only one seniority salary short.
Family workers in forestry bureaus and field workers can do it.
Pay according to your age, and you can get a part of it back later, which is quite appropriate.
The family members of the workers are also retired. The husband and wife earn three to four thousand yuan a month. In a small place like Donggang, they can live a decent life.
If Su Anhua gets married with Li Cheng, think of a way to move Su Anhua's household registration to Yishenchang in two years.
A participating family member may have the opportunity to recruit workers. Even if they cannot be recruited, they will be able to work as family workers and retire in the future, which is not bad.
"Now it depends on the Li family's attitude. If Li Bingzhuo and his wife agree, they may come to propose marriage soon.
If they don’t agree, then there’s nothing to do. I’ll still look in the brigade to see if there is any suitable introduction for the elders. "
As Xu Shiyan spoke, he picked up a large basin and poured out the water in the basin.
"Yeah, let's not talk about this matter, let's see Li Family."
Su Anying brought the wrung clothes into the house, planning to dry them tomorrow morning.
Children's clothes cannot be left outside overnight. The old man said that it is not good to be exposed to the moon and stars.
At the Xu family's side, the couple cleaned up their clothes and went back to sleep.
On the other side of the venue, Li’s house was still brightly lit. Li Bingzhuo and his wife felt a headache when they saw their stubborn son.
"You said we didn't have a good girl in the show?
Among your classmates, there is no one you can fancy? Why do you have to find a country girl? "
Li Bingzhuo's daughter-in-law, Sun Limei, looked at her son in great perplexity.
His son's elm head, otherwise he wouldn't be enlightened, but he suddenly became enlightened, and fell in love with a rural girl.
"What's wrong with the rural girl? What's wrong with the rural girl? I just think Su Anhua is fine.
Diligent and capable, nice to people, not arrogant at all.
It's not like the girls we participated in, all of them looked up to the sky, wishing to look at people with their nostrils. "Li Chengrong snorted.
The first market is a state-run market. The workers are treated well, earn a lot of money, and the girls in the market don’t have to worry about getting married.
Moreover, the first field is next to a large team from Donggang Commune, one is an agricultural cooperative, and the other is a state-owned field. The comparison between the two is also obvious. The people who participated in the first field do have a sense of superiority.
Li Chengrong is such a stupid boy, he just finds the girls in the field disliked, but he likes the gentle and virtuous girl like Su Anhua.
"The rural girl has a different household registration.
After having children, the household registration will be with the mother. Do you want your child to have a rural household registration? "
There is a rule in this year that the child's household registration follows the mother's.
Why are girls with urban hukou sought after? This is also a reason. Who doesn't want a child to have an urban hukou upon birth?
"What's so great about the hukou? It's enough to move here. My dad can't get a hukou anymore?"
Li Chengrong doesn't think so, in his opinion, it's just a household registration, how easy it is.
The family members are not recruiting, so they moved here after thinking of a way, so what's the problem?
"Son, tell Dad the truth, how long have you been with that girl?"
Li Bingzhuo didn't speak until now, and asked directly.
Li Chengrong scratched his head, "Where is it? I haven't had time to tell others yet.
Today, I finally mustered up the courage to find Team Leader Xu, but Team Leader Xu pushed me back with just one word.
He said, if I have the heart, let my family members come forward to propose marriage, don't be sneaky. "
After leaving the teacher without success, and being teased back, Li Chengrong let alone worry about it.
When Li Bingzhuo heard this, he nodded and heaved a sigh of relief.
"It's still group leader Xu who is more stable than you.
If you don’t discuss it with your parents first, I think you’ve read this book to your stomach. "
Before, Li Bingzhuo was worried, whether the girl from the Su family knew about the situation of the Li family and deliberately showed favor to Li Chengrong or something.
If that's the case, even if this girl is a fairy, she definitely can't have it.
"Then I am afraid that you will not agree?" Li Chengrong lowered his head and muttered there.
"If you don't discuss it, how do you know we disagree?" Li Bingzhuo's voice raised a lot.
“Since ancient times, the major matters of marriage have been decided by parents.
Now is a new society, which advocates free love, but you can't be too free.
In major matters, parents have to check it out. "

chapters.title: Chapter 290: visit the door
chapters.content:
"Well, tomorrow you can find Mrs. Han next door and ask her to take you to Xu's house.
Don't talk about what's going on, just go to see Team Leader Xu's house for a while.
Let's take a look at the girl's character first. If you think it's okay, then find a chance to come to propose marriage.
The important event in the son's life cannot be sloppy. "Li Bingzhuo thought for a while, then turned his head and said to his wife.
"Huh? Do you really want to marry him a rural wife?"
Sun Limei was stunned, and looked at her husband puzzled.
"You, you have long hair but short knowledge, what's wrong with the rural girl?
Didn't you listen to what your son said? They also graduated from junior high school and are educated.
Besides, don't you look at others, don't you look at Xiao Xu's face?
Do you think that Secretary Lin just invited someone to be a consultant? People have real skills. "
Li Bingzhuo shook his head and sighed, his daughter-in-law sometimes really has bad vision.
"Let me tell you, Xiao Xu will definitely have better development in the future, he is the main technology, the technical backbone of our participation.
If our family Xiao Rong can become brother-in-law with him, it will be our help in the future.
I don’t care about my age, what about Xiaorong? Do you really want him to be a worker for the rest of his life? Can't you go up?
If you don’t make some merit, how can you go up there? Li Bingzhuo took a puff of cigarette, then let it out again, letting out a long breath.
"A household registration is nothing, I'm still in this position, so I'll do it if I say so.
The key is our son, if he doesn't have a few helpers, it won't work. "
Raising a child who is a hundred years old often worries about a thousand years old. Parents have to think more about their children.
Especially with Li Chengrong's temperament, it's okay to be a worker. If you want to go up, you can't do it without a few reliable helpers.
Sun Limei could only sigh when she heard this, and gave her son a blank look.
"Day by day, it's as if I owe you in my previous life, and I have endless troubles with you."
The meaning in these words is to promise her husband to find opportunities to meet people.
