"Okay, your mother has already agreed to go to Xu's house, what are you still doing here? Why don't you go back to sleep?
If you have that time, quickly record what your team leader said, polish it well, and hand it to Secretary Lin.
Don't be stupid every day, don't understand anything, it makes you worry to death. "
Li Bingzhuo looked at his son who was still standing in the middle of the ground, and was speechless for a while, his stupid son, what do you say?
"Oh, I see." Li Chengrong happily turned and went back to his room to rest.
Li Bingzhuo and his wife looked at the back of their son leaving happily, and couldn't help shaking their heads.
"Silly son, when will he learn to be more tactful?" The couple sighed at the same time.
The next day, Sun Limei really went to the Han family next door to find Han Wenzhong's wife Li Yuexiu.
The two of them muttered for a while, then Li Yuexiu changed her clothes, and the two of them left Han's house without taking anything, heading west to Xu Chenghou's house at the martyr's tomb.
Han and Xu are in-laws, so for this kind of thing, you must ask the elders. Li Yuexiu wanted to talk to Zhou Guilan first, and bring Su Anhua over to have a look.
It was also a coincidence that Xu Chenghou was not at home when he was working on the mountain, and Zhou Guilan was at Xu Shiyan's side.
Li Yuexiu saw that the gate was locked, so she guessed that it was Xu Shiyan's side, so she led Sun Limei there.
"In-law, in-law? Are you there?" Li Yuexiu asked loudly as soon as she entered the gate.
Su Anfang and Su Anhua were both working in the flower shed. When they heard the movement outside, they hurried out to check.
"Are you Aunt Han?" Su Anhua lived here for a long time, met Li Yuexiu once, and recognized her when they met.
"Auntie, wait a minute, my aunt is in the backyard, I'll call for someone to go.
Fifth sister, hurry up, this is the mother-in-law of our sister Qin, you lead the aunt into the room first, I will find the aunt. "
When Su Anfang heard this, she didn't dare to be negligent, and hurriedly led Li Yuexiu and them into the room to sit down, and poured water for them again.
Su Anhua, on the other hand, went to the backyard and found Zhou Guilan who was leading the twins to watch the big goose.
"Ma'am, Sister Qin's mother-in-law is here, and she brought another person." Su Anhua walked up to Zhou Guilan and said.
As soon as Zhou Guilan heard it, she knew what was going on. Her son mentioned it to her in the morning, but she didn't expect the Li family to come very quickly.
"Oh, oh, got it. Qingqing, Huihui, let's go, let's go back and find something delicious."
These two little guys come to the backyard to watch the geese every day, and they can't be coaxed away without something delicious.
As soon as they heard that there was something delicious, the siblings Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing became happy.
With his short legs upside down, holding grandma's hand from left to right, Huanhuanxi went to the front yard with grandma to find something delicious.
"Hey, my in-laws are here, look at me coaxing the kids in the backyard."
Zhou Guilan led the child in and greeted Li Yuexiu with a smile.
"Who is this?" Knowing that she was the daughter-in-law of the Li family, she had to ask, as if she had someone in her eyes.
"Oh, this is our old neighbor, it's just the west courtyard of my house, the elder's family.
We both want to go shopping in Songjianghe, and we are tired after walking to you, so we come in to find some water to drink. "
Li Yuexiu couldn't directly say that she came to see someone, so she could only find an excuse.
Zhou Guilan understood as soon as she heard it, and nodded with a smile.
"Hua'er, go to the garden quickly, pick a few melons for Aunt Han and Aunt Li, or pick a watermelon, what can I do with just drinking water?" Zhou Guilan deliberately sent Su Anhua to work.
"Hey, I got it." Su Anhua agreed, turned around and went out to pick fruits in the garden.
Xu Shiyan's family has a big vegetable garden, and they can't eat so many vegetables.
When spring began, Xu Shiyan specially scoured the seeds of cantaloupe and watermelon, raised seedlings in advance, and planted a large area.
These days, muskmelons and watermelons are ripening one after another, and Sister Su Anhua picks some every day and saves them for the children to eat.
Su Anhua has a long-term mind, and specially carried a basket into the garden, picked the ripe watermelons, picked two, and picked more muskmelons.
The person who came was Xu Shiqin's mother-in-law, and they were going to leave later, so they couldn't let them go empty-handed.
Packing a few melons back home is the same thing.
Su Anhua moved very quickly, picked the melon out quickly, went into the house to wash the melon, cut the watermelon and put it on a plate, and brought it into the house.
"Aunt Han, Aunt Li, let's eat melons. The melon seeds my second brother-in-law picked up from Jewelry Gang are delicious."
Su Anhua put the plate in front of Li Yuexiu and Sun Xiuyun, and said with a smile.
The home-grown watermelon is not too big, but when you cut the red flesh inside, it looks delicious.
Li Yuexiu was not polite, she reached out and took a piece of watermelon, and took a bite.
"Well, it's delicious, in-laws, if you have time, you can ask Shi Yan, can this melon be kept as a seed?
Save some for me, and I will plant it next year. tasty. Brother and sister, you should try it too, this sandy watermelon is really good, very sweet. "
Li Yuexiu looked at Su Anhua while talking, "Dear family, who are these two girls?"
This is what I asked on purpose, pretending to be confused.
"Oh, these two girls are the natal sisters of my third daughter-in-law.
Isn't this the third daughter-in-law who is in charge of the farm? The family was too busy, so they left the two younger sisters to help take care of the house.
Oh, these two girls might be doing it. Look at the house and the outside are all cleaned up by them. There are three flower sheds at the east end, which are also taken care of by them. "

chapters.title: Chapter 291: satisfy
chapters.content:
Zhou Guilan seized the opportunity and praised Su Anfang and sisters so much that she was ashamed to praise them.
"Ma'am, there is still work over there in the flower shed, that, let's go to work first.
Aunt Han, Aunt Li, sit down for a while longer. "
They don't know Li Yuexiu well, so it's awkward to sit here, so they might as well just go to work.
The two girls wanted to go out, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui were unwilling to stay in the house, so they took a piece of cantaloupe and went out with the two aunts.
In the room, there were only three people left: Li Yuexiu, Sun Limei, and Zhou Guilan.
Li Yuexiu reached out, poked Sun Limei, and winked at her.
That means asking Sun Limei what is her impression of Su Anhua.
Sun Limei nodded towards Li Yuexiu. That means, I think it's okay.
The daughters of the Su family are all good-looking. Although Su Anhua is not as tall as Su Anying, she is not bad.
It can be seen from the first contact that the girl is very polite, and she can't find fault with people and things.
It seems that he has a bright eye and is not lazy.
Live at home, don’t ask your wife to be smart and capable, just live in a down-to-earth manner and do your duty.
How about the participating girls? Naturally, they are much better, but there are some who are really proud.
Sun Limei felt that her son was stubborn, and if she found a daughter-in-law who was arrogant, she might not be able to get along with her, and would fight every day.
Find someone with a good personality, who my son also likes, and the young couple can live a happy life with Hemeimei.
What can a mother think? Aren't you hoping for a good life for your son?
The couple is always at odds and fights every now and then, so what's the point of living that day?
Sun Limei nodded, and Li Yuexiu understood, so she asked.
"My in-laws, how old are those two girls? Are you dating?"
You can't ask Su Anhua directly, that would be too obvious, so you both have to ask.
"No, they are not very old, the fifth and 20th, and the sixth is eighteen this year. There is no rush, we will talk about it when we meet good ones."
Zhou Guilan's words are sincere.
In fact, Su Anfang and Su Anhua have lived in Xu's house for such a long time, it is impossible that no one will see them.
Country women, especially older women, love to do the work of mediators when they have nothing to do.
Xu's family has come to the two young girls, who can't see it? A lot of people came to inquire about it, and some people suggested mediation.
Zhou Guilan treated the two girls as if they were her own daughters.
Those people who came to propose marriage were not able to reach the two girls at all, and they were directly rejected by Zhou Guilan.
how? The two girls both graduated from junior high school. They want to look good, have a good personality and work well, and they are still worried about getting married?
Looking for a partner is not going up the mountain to dig wild vegetables, just gouging out the basket? That's not okay.
You have to keep your eyes open and look for it, and you can't be sloppy.
"Sister-in-law, someone fell in love with that young man, let me tell you about the young man's qualifications, can you listen?" Li Yuexiu asked tentatively.
Before she came, she had discussed with Sun Limei. If Sun Limei had a good impression of Su Anhua, Li Yuexiu would mention it to the Xu family.
If Sun Limei thinks it's not good, then they sit for a while and leave without saying anything, just to save embarrassment.
Since Sun Limei nodded, Li Yuexiu had to continue talking.
"The young man is our worker in the field, and now he is in the technical group, working under the hands of Shi Yan's nephew.
He is not a bad person, he graduated from high school and is educated, not to mention his family, the conditions are quite good. "
As for the matchmaker, it's all good to say, Li Yuexiu is not exaggerating, she is telling the truth.
"Hey, the participating workers? Our Hua'er has a rural household registration, can the young man's family agree?"
When Zhou Guilan said this, she naturally looked at Sun Limei, wanting to see how Sun Limei would react.
"Sister-in-law, you see that what you said is wrong. What's the matter? The people who participated were not farmers before?
There is no need to go up three generations, our family used to be from the countryside. "On the other end, Sun Limei smiled and said.
"The workers in the field, it sounds good to be a worker, but in fact, don't they do the same work as the old farmers? They are all mud legs, who hates each other?"
This statement is not false. It has only been about 20 years since the establishment of the venue. Aren’t those at the beginning all old farmers?
Later, some people from the Anqiu branch were resettled, and some were transferred from Donggang and other places. Most of the families were farmers.
In fact, most of the participating workers are quite good, only a few of them have the mentality of the poor getting rich, and after becoming a worker, they look down on the old farmers.
"In-laws, siblings, if you say so, I think the young man is okay.
Regarding this matter, I will discuss it with San'er, my wife and Hua'er, and listen to their opinions.
If you like it, let’s find another day and invite my in-laws from Daying to see each other, okay? "
They are all straightforward people, and Zhou Guilan doesn't have to beat around the bush.
She is not someone who belongs to Su Anhua, and she can't decide this lifelong event, so she can only call Su Weizhong and his wife to come and see her.
"Success, success, let's finish this first, I'll be waiting for your letter here."
Speaking of this, there is no need to fret.
So, Li Yuexiu and Sun Limei got up and said goodbye.
"Oh, why are my in-laws leaving so soon? Sit down for a while.
Look, I didn’t sit for a while when I came here, there are still so many melons. "Zhou Guilan had to get up and see her off.
"Hua'er, Hua'er? Come on, find a basket and pick some melons for Aunt Han and Aunt Li to eat at home."
Zhou Guilan deliberately let Su Anhua show her face again, otherwise, she would have found a basket by herself.
In summer, the windows are all open, and Zhou Guilan speaks loudly, Su Anhua can hear her.
"Ma'am, I picked them just now, and they're in the outhouse."
The three of them just came out of the east room, and they saw a basket filled with watermelons and cantaloupes.
"Look, how thoughtful the girl is, I prepared it without saying anything.
In-laws, younger siblings, and our own things, don’t be too polite, take them home and eat them. "
Zhou Guilan picked up the basket and stuffed it into Li Yuexiu's hands.
The two tore it for a while, then Li Yuexiu shyly carried the basket and walked out with Sun Limei.
Su Anfang, who was working in the flower shed over there, saw Su Anhua, so she had to follow her out of the gate. "Auntie, come and sit down when you have time."
Li Yuexiu told Sun Limei that they were going to Songjianghe, and it was not easy to turn around and go to the venue. They had to walk west for a while, and then went east by detour.
"Sister and sister, how do you look at the girl? I think it's okay anyway, it's just that the account is missing.
It is not difficult, and it is not a big deal to catch up with the opportunity to move to our venue. "
"Well, the girl is pretty good, she doesn't have to choose her appearance or character, and she only needs this account.
We don't need to talk about seeing each other, the household registration is easy to talk about, isn't Lao Li still in this position anyway? Why can't I open an account? "
Sun Limei is also satisfied with Su Anhua, "Our silly boy, this time his eyes are quite good, and the girl in the picture is not bad."

chapters.title: Chapter 292: agree
chapters.content:
Sun Limei went back and told her husband everything about her going to Xu's house. He also talked about his impression of Su Anhua.
When Li Bingzhuo heard that Su Anhua was not bad, he was also very happy.
The husband and wife have loved their youngest son since they were born. Since the youngest son is optimistic, as long as the girl is not bad, he should try his best to make it perfect.
It's time to mention it, and the next thing is to wait for the reply from the Xu family.
On the other side, when Xu Shiyan and Su Anying came home from get off work, they were called by Zhou Guilan, and in front of Su Anhua, they told about their visit to the Li family.
"Hua'er, this is a major event in your marriage, you decide for yourself.
What about Xiaoli, who often comes to our house, and you have seen him before. What do you think of this person? Ok?
If it works, ask your brother-in-law to call Daying, find a time for your parents to come and see for yourself. "
Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan, these are all in-laws, not parents, they have no control over marriage matters, and they have to invite Su Weizhong and his wife to come.
Su Anhua was dumbfounded right now, how could she have thought that Li Chengrong would fall in love with her?
"Ma'am, can you let me think about it? This is too sudden."
Su Anhua was confused and didn't know what to say.
Li Chengrong has seen her many times, and she still calls him a nerd in private. She has a good impression of this young man, but she never thinks about anything else.
Actually, Su Anhua knew what her father meant by sending their sisters to Donggang, and he wanted them to find a partner here.
Su Anhua didn't have any objection to this. Don't women have to marry sooner or later? No one can stay at home forever without going out.
Second sister is in Donggang, and they have a good relationship as sisters. It would be great if they could be closer to second sister in the future.
Li Chengrong is a participating employee, receiving wages and receiving red cards, which she didn't dare to think about before.
But if it can be done, wouldn't it be great? When I went back, I said that the faces of my parents were also radiant.
However, Li's family is a worker's family, and Li Chengrong's father is still the director of the factory. Isn't this threshold too high?
Is she considered high-ranking? Will the Li family underestimate her? Will marrying into such a family be looked down upon in the future?
An eighteen-year-old girl had expectations for the future for the first time, but she was also full of confusion. She couldn't figure it out.
"Yes, yes, we must think about it carefully, it's okay, the Li family said, wait for our news.
You think about it carefully, and just tell your sister when you think it over. "
Zhou Guilan can understand Su Anhua's mood. It's normal for a girl to feel uneasy when encountering a major event in her life.
Su Anhua didn't sleep all night, tossed and turned the pancakes, and woke up with dark circles under her eyes the next day.
Before Xu Shiyan and his wife went to work, I told them and asked Xu Shiyan to call Daying.
Life is full of unknowns. Marrying anyone is a gamble. At least find someone who likes you, and the chances of winning are better.
Knowing what Su Anhua wanted, Xu Shiyan called Daying when he was at work.
Still please ask someone to find Su Weizhong, tell him the phone number here, and let Su Weizhong call back at a convenient time.
Coincidentally, Su Weizhong happened to be having a meeting at the commune, and the person who answered the phone found him directly.
Su Weizhong dialed back directly and learned about the little girl.
As expected by Xu Shiyan, Su Weizhong couldn't help sighing when he heard that the fifth child had no news, but the sixth child was in love with him. What's the matter?
Forget it, don’t worry about that, if Lao Liu can meet such a good family, he has to hurry up, don’t delay.
So, Su Weizhong made an agreement with Xu Shiyan that they would go to Donggang on July 23, which is the day after tomorrow.
On Sunday, July 24th, I thought Lai and his father and son would have time, so they happened to see each other.
Received the reply from the father-in-law, Xu Shiyan also hurriedly informed the Li family, and Li Chengrong was very happy when he heard the news.
"Okay, don't be pretty, you kid, go get a haircut and tidy up, your hair is long, so you're going to meet your partner like this?"
There are a lot of things going on recently, and the technical team is very busy. It is estimated that Li Chengrong hasn't had a haircut for a while, so he is indeed a bit sloppy.
Xu Shiyan saw this, so he had to remind him.
"Hey, got it, I'll go right away." Li Chengrong agreed, turned around and ran away.
Go to the staff bath to take a bath, and then get a haircut. The whole person is more energetic.
That's all Xu Shiyan can do, the follow-up has nothing to do with him, he still has a lot of things to do.
The ginseng land on the mountain has started to work. The workers have brought the brush cutter up two days ago to cut down the shrubs and weeds.
Mechanization is faster than manual labor. If the land is 20,000 feet long, if it is all cut by people with a sickle, how many years will it take to finish it?
It is different with a brush cutter, and the work is too fast.
Shrubs and weeds are easy to clear, but those big tree stumps left by felling are very laborious.
Unless the tree roots are pulled out, neither the tractor nor the rotary cultivator can operate.
The ginseng land of the first ginseng field is already deep in the Caozi River, not too far from the reserve. The trees here are very thick, and the stumps left after felling are also very thick.
For smaller tree stumps, use a big ax to cut off the surrounding tree roots, and several people work together to pry them with crowbars.
Larger tree roots will not work, and the manpower is not so strong, so explosives must be used to blow them up.
In the 1970s, ammonium nitrate and sawdust were mostly used to make soil explosives.
By the 1980s, finished explosives could be obtained. For personal use of explosives, you need to go to the police station to pay for a certificate, and go to the explosives depot to get the explosives.
Donggang Commune, in Nanshan, which is south of Paotai Mountain, has a depot for explosives.
As soon as you join the field, there is also an explosives depot at a distance of four kilometers from Jindongtou.
You don’t need to go to the police station to use the explosives in the field. You can go directly to the explosives warehouse with the letter of introduction and other documents.
All the tree stumps in the ground that could be pried up by hand were all pried up, and the remaining ones that couldn't be pried up had to dig holes under the tree stumps.
Find a day with good weather, uniformly load explosives, connect detonators, fuses, etc., then clear out the idlers around the ginseng ground, and arrange for people to ignite the fuse.
This job is not easy to do. The amount of explosives is less, and the tree stump cannot be blown up.
The amount of explosives is too much, and the explosive force is too strong to cause accidents.
When loading explosives, the detonator and fuse must be connected properly. If the detonator is not inserted, it will become a squib.
The explosives, the detonator, and the fuse are connected, covered with oiled paper, and the soil has to be compacted on top.
If the soil is not compacted, the cannon will be fired, and the tree stump will not be blown.
So, this is a very dangerous job, and it must be done by experienced veterans.
The technical team is not in charge of this, but on July 23rd, Xu Shiyan still came up the mountain.
"Consultant Xu, why did you come to the mountain? Today, we need explosives to lift the roots of the trees on the mountain. It is very dangerous.
You young man doesn't understand anything, what are you doing here? Isn't this adding to the chaos? "
A few older workers saw Xu Shiyan and said with pouted lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 293: blast
chapters.content:
"Consultant Xu, it's not that uncle looks down on you. You know other things, but you can't do this.
Don't hang around here, what if you are injured later if you light up the explosives later? "
There was an elderly worker who raised his hand and was about to push Xu Shiyan out.
"Uncle, I just heard that tree stumps were blasted today, so I came here to take a look.
This thing is too dangerous, are you sure the explosives are installed? Do you need to check again? "
As Xu Shiyan said, he wanted to go into the arena.
"Hey, hey, Consultant Xu, what are you doing? Don't make trouble, okay?
We are all veterans of firing cannons for many years, can’t we do this?
The explosives are all installed, and the place will be cleared immediately. Don’t go in. It’s too dangerous to go in. What can I do if I hurt you? "
Several people stretched out their hands and stopped Xu Shiyan.
"No, Uncle, I'm really worried, are you sure you have installed everything?
This is not a joke, no matter how experienced you are, you can't be careless. "Xu Shiyan was stopped and couldn't go in, and was a little anxious.
"Oh, don't worry, why are you so grumpy at such a young age? When I was working in the field, you were still wearing crotch pants."
"Consultant Xu, it's not that uncle is blowing here.
If you want to talk about other things, you are a little bit capable, but when it comes to shooting guns, in the first place, my big brother Li said that he was second, and no one dared to say first. "
The old worker patted his chest and promised with great pride.
"Little young man, you still have a lot to learn, no matter what kind of seventh-level technician you are, your ability is not enough to participate in the field.
That's all right, you don't need to take care of the matter here, leave the venue quickly, our side is going to be set on fire soon. "
The old man Li waved his hand, signaling to the others to get Xu Shiyan out quickly.
Xu Shiyan remembers that in his previous life, Han Wenzhong said that in 1983, something happened when he fired cannons and collapsed tree stumps.
There was a place where the explosive did not go off after being ignited. The workers thought it was the detonator or the fuse was not connected properly, so they went to dig the soil.
Actually, it was because the fuse was pinned by the roots of the tree, and it burned a little slower there.
It doesn’t matter if the workers pick it up, the soil is loose and breathable, the fuse burns fast, and the explosives go off.
The person who picked up the explosives was killed on the spot. It is said that his intestines were blown up, and the people next to him were also injured in varying severity. It is considered a serious accident.
Xu Shiyan had no other intentions. He just wanted to come up and take a look. If something really went wrong, it might save someone's life.
Otherwise, if something really happened, it would be a major accident. Whoever gets involved in such a thing will not have to live.
But what these people were trying to do was to prevent Xu Shiyan from going over to check.
And the attitude of these people is not troublesome, but a little contemptuous, feeling like they look down on Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan knew that since he came here as a technical consultant, many workers were not convinced.
Those people looked at Xu Shiyan's young age, but received the salary of a seventh-level technician, and thought that he was just a blind cat who ran into a dead mouse, good luck.
I don’t know how to make a ginseng ground fertilizer. This is a treasure, and I even came to the field as a technical consultant.
How capable can one be at such a young age? Serve as consultants for those who have worked for more than ten or twenty years?
Regarding these, Xu Shiyan was not angry, and it was normal for others to question him.
After all, he is a newcomer and is still receiving a high salary. People can understand that he is not pleasing to the eye.
Faced with doubts, the best way is to make achievements and prove it with strength.
So from the first day of work, Xu Shiyan held back his energy and had to make some achievements.
But no matter what, it is not three or five days to see the results, he needs time.
But today he came to remind him with good intentions, but these people looked at him with prejudice.
Xu Shiyan was also a little angry, so he simply stopped talking and followed the crowd to retreat beyond the safety line.
Here, everyone evacuated to 50 meters away, and someone waved the red flag in his hand to signal to the opposite side.
On the other side, someone started lighting the fuse.
Let’s blast the roots of the tree. Sometimes it’s a single one, and sometimes it’s several together, mainly depending on the density of the tree stumps.
If you are close, you can go together; if you are too far away, you can only come alone.
Whether it is a single or several together, you must reserve enough fuses. If they are together, first ignite and keep longer, and then ignite a little shorter.
The length of the wire is such that after being ignited, people have to run at least ten meters away.
There are a lot of big tree stumps in this piece of land, and the big old Li directs people to release them in groups, so quickly.
A group of more than ten wires were all ignited, and the man ran away. After running less than 20 meters, the first one ignited exploded.
There were bang bang bang bangs over there, while Da Lao Li and the others here were counting silently in their hearts, judging from the number of bangs, whether there were squibs.
"Well, these ten are ringing, the next group."
After the explosion passed and everyone confirmed that it had sounded, they were relieved and continued to wave the red flag to signal to the other side.
After receiving the signal, continue to click on the next group.
The first few groups were fine, and they all rang. The elder Li glanced at Xu Shiyan and snorted.
That meaning is self-evident, this is because Xu Shiyan is too nosy and questioned the ability of the elder Li.
Xu Shiyan didn't speak, just stared at the distance, it's best if nothing happens, why, you thought he was expecting something to happen? Those are human lives, not a joke.
Here, continue to shake the red flag, and on the other side, light the fuse again.
However, this time, six only rang five times. "Is there a noise?"
Big Lao Li didn't wait for the sixth ring, his face turned ugly immediately, and he asked hastily.
"Well, I just counted, five times, it should be a dumb person who didn't make a sound." The person next to him said.
"It is estimated that the fuse or detonator was not plugged in firmly and fell out."
"I'll go over and have a look." Da Lao Li's face was livid, and he was about to go forward to check.
"Uncle, don't go there, just wait."
Xu Shiyan stopped the person, turned his head and shouted to the person who lit the fuse over there, "Come back first, don't go, don't go."
The two slaps were quite far away, and Xu Shiyan couldn't hear what Xu Shiyan was shouting.
But there was no flag waved here to give a signal, and the people at the other end didn't dare to move, just waiting there.
Big Lao Li was stopped by Xu Shiyan, anxious.
"Hey, what's the matter with you little comrade? Did you deliberately go up the mountain to make trouble today?
There are only a few left, and you can go home after get off work. There must be a squib on the other end that didn’t go off.
What do you think you are doing here? "As Da Lao Li said, he pushed Xu Shiyan away vigorously, and was about to check.
"Uncle, really don't go, the explosive didn't go off, maybe it's because the fuse ignited slowly."
Xu Shiyan stopped Da Lao Li again, not letting him go that way.
"Impossible, I've been working for so many years, and I haven't encountered a fuse yet, can it be slow?
They are all the same, how can they be slower than others? Get out of the way, I'll go over and have a look. "
Big Old Li had a face full of disbelief, he had to go there.
Xu Shiyan refused to let him go no matter what, the two of them just tore it up here, and the people next to him saw it and could only come over to persuade them.
The person waiting for the signal over there looked wrong, so he simply ran over here, thinking to come over and ask what was going on.
Just as he ran forward for about ten meters, there was a bang behind him, and it exploded.

chapters.title: Chapter 294: too hanging
chapters.content:
The sound of an explosion suddenly sounded, everyone was frightened and froze on the spot.
After a while, everyone came back to their senses.
Big old Li turned pale with fright, let go of Xu Shiyan with trembling hands, sat down on the ground, his eyes were straight, and his lips were white.
It was too scary, he took his life.
In the situation just now, most people thought it was a squib, and they must go there and reinstall the fuse and detonator.
This chop, the explosives went off, is there still life?
"Consultant Xu, I owe you my life today. If you hadn't stopped me, I would have died right now."
Big Old Li put his hands on the ground, squatting halfway down to salute Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan was so frightened that he stepped forward in two steps, and helped Da Lao Li up.
"Hey, Uncle Li, you are going to cut my life. You are the elder and I am the junior, what can I do?"
Xu Shiyan only remembered that it happened, but he didn't know exactly who had the accident.
But no matter who it is, they are all colleagues in the field, and they bow their heads and don't see each other when they look up.
If he can’t remember it, that’s fine. Now that he remembers it, he has to come up and take a look anyway. It’s a good thing to save him.
"I'm sorry for you, just now I didn't have a nose and a face with you, and I almost beat you.
I am not a thing, Consultant Xu, I...
Hey, don’t say anything else, from now on, what you ask the consultant to say, I, Lao Li, will listen to. "
Big Lao Li was in tears now, and he was ashamed of being frightened.
People stopped him with good intentions, but he didn't appreciate it and almost fought with them. Thinking about it now, he is really ashamed.
"Oh, today is really good, thanks to Consultant Xu coming, otherwise, our old lives would really be on the line."
The old workers next to them also regained their strength at this moment, and said with lingering fear.
At the other end, the young man in charge of lighting the fire ran over in shock.
"What happened just now? Why did it take so long to ring? I remember that the fuse wasn't too long?"
Thanks to the fact that he had been waiting for the signal from here and didn't go over to check the situation without authorization, otherwise, his life would be on the line today.
"That's right, Consultant Xu, how do you know that's not dumb?"
This question reminded everyone.
It seems that Xu Shiyan is very sure that he is not a dumb cannon, and keeps blocking him from passing, because of what?
"Because I believe that several of them are masters, and they won't make such low-level mistakes.
How many years have you guys been doing these jobs, it’s impossible that you don’t even understand a fuse and a detonator.
But if the explosives didn't go off, it must be a problem elsewhere.
I guess, when the soil was filled in and compacted, the fuse made the root of the tree pinned, so it was slow. "
What can Xu Shiyan say? Said he had heard it mentioned in his previous life?
He can only make reasonable inferences. As for whether these people believe it or not, it doesn’t matter. Anyway, it’s good that nothing happened today.
Otherwise, it is estimated that the participants will have to stop production for inspection, and several leaders will have to follow suit.
"Well, what Consultant Xu said is quite reasonable, that's what it is like to be incomplete." Everyone nodded after hearing this.
The key is that there has never been such a thing before, and no one has experienced it, so I can only trust Xu Shiyan.
No matter what the reason was, at least no one died.
But regarding today’s matter, these people have to write a self-criticism when they go back.
Just write it, writing a review is better than losing your life, everyone has calmed down, and hurried over to check it out.
Check to see if all the tree roots are blown out, pack them up and put them in a pile to dry, and then just set them on fire.
After everything was packed, everyone was relieved, and they came out of the venue together and went straight to the place where the car was taken.
While walking, everyone is still talking about today's affairs.
This is also considered a safety production accident. It must be reported when you go back, and the relevant personnel must conduct a review. It is not something that can be hidden.
"No matter what you say, it's fortunate that consultant Xu came up today.
In the past, we always looked down on Consultant Xu and thought you were young and inexperienced.
Relying on a little bit of ability, he got on the leader and came to teach us how to be a seventh-level technician.
Unexpectedly, Consultant Xu really knows everything, we are lame, sorry. "
Several older workers are very polite to Xu Shiyan at the moment.
"Huh? No, Consultant Xu, what are you doing here today?
Just to watch the shooting? How did you know something might happen today? "
Someone suddenly realized that the shooting of cannons and tree roots is not under the control of the technical team.
Xu Shiyan is the consultant of the technical team. He is not there to stare at the research and development. What are you doing here?
"Oh, I went up the mountain today to find something to do with Uncle Han.
I had to wait for the car to go down the mountain together. I came over to take a look at it. I didn’t know until I came. "
In fact, Xu Shiyan mainly came to watch the cannon shooting, and looking for Han Wenzhong was just an excuse.
Tonghua sent a message to Xiner, saying that they wanted the two little black blind men, but Xu Shiyan and the others had to figure out a way to get there.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about the cannon shooting on the mountain, so he used this as an excuse to come to Han Wenzhong to discuss how to send the two little black blind men away.
Actually, there is no need to discuss this matter with Han Wenzhong, just ask Han Limin.
"Oh, it's a coincidence that the co-authorship is a coincidence. What a coincidence, if you don't come up today, I dare not say what will happen."
Everyone sighed after hearing this. It seems that something should not have happened to co-authoring today. How could it be such a coincidence?
Talking and chatting, I came to the waiting place.
At this moment, the car has not yet arrived, and everyone is still chatting together.
"Consultant Xu, come, sit here, it's too cool here."
The attitude of those old workers towards Xu Shiyan has taken a big turn. Now, looking at Xu Shiyan, everyone else is kind.
Xu Shiyan was not polite, so he sat down next to those people.
In fact, he is quite happy to chat with older people, and he can learn a lot from it.
While speaking, there was a sound of car horns, and then several large trucks drove over from a distance.
The car turned around and came back to a stop. Everyone climbed onto the car one after another. Someone glanced into the driving building and recognized the driver.
"Liangzi, is it your class this afternoon? Hey, go and see your father, he was really scared today."
Someone pointed to the back, and over there, Big Old Li was standing listlessly at the back of the crowd.
The driver who drove the car was called Li Zongliang, the son of the elder Li.
Hearing this, Li Zongliang hurriedly drove the door down and walked towards Big Old Li.
"Dad, what's the matter with you? You don't look very good, what's wrong with you? Then you get in my car? There are two people in the driving building."
Li Zongliang didn't know what happened. He just saw his father's expression was wrong and he was not energetic. He thought he was sick, so he quickly helped the elder Li and walked to his car.
"Liangzi, please invite Consultant Xu over.
It's not Consultant Xu today, your father's life will be lost on the mountain. "
At this moment, Big Old Li, his heartbeat has not returned to normal, and he feels uncomfortable in his chest.
A person who is almost fifty years old, how can he stand such a big shock?

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Can't understand
chapters.content:
"Huh? What's going on?"
Li Zongliang felt that his father was not in the right state just now, and he was shocked when he heard this.
"Dad, what's wrong with you? What scares you like this?" He remembered what the man said just now, and asked quickly.
"Oh, forget it.
Your dad has been working in the field for more than 20 years. Among other things, he has been setting explosives for more than ten years, right?
From the use of ammonium nitrate sawdust in the past to the finished explosives, I have never missed it.
It was the first time today, if it wasn't for Consultant Xu, your father and I would have lost my life on the mountain today. "
Big Lao Li sighed, and told his son what happened.
Li Zongliang was terrified when he heard this. If his father had an accident on the mountain, how would his family live?
"Consultant Xu, come on, you can sit in the driver's building, there is still room here."
Without saying a word, Li Zongliang quickly came to Xu Shiyan, dragged Xu Shiyan to his car, and let Xu Shiyan sit in the driving building.
In summer, it’s actually still comfortable outside. When the car is driven, it is windy and vigorous.
How could Xu Shiyan refuse another kindness? So he sat side by side with Big Old Li in the co-pilot.
The workers at the back all got into the car and yelled at the front. The driver started the car and pulled a few workers who were working in the field down the mountain together.
The big cart pulled the crowd all the way bumpy, wobbling, somehow returned to the venue.
Everyone got off the car, some went home, and some went to the field department to report to the leader.
Xu Shiyan had nothing to do, so he went to the store to have a look first, bought two cans, and then took a piece of meat, and just strolled home.
As soon as I entered the gate, I heard a burst of laughter in the yard. Needless to say, this must be the father-in-law and mother-in-law.
Xu Shiyan carried his things and walked quickly into the yard.
Sure enough, in the yard, Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan, Su Weizhong, and Han Shi were all there, and the four old people were coaxing the two babies, talking and laughing.
"Father, mother, when did you arrive? I have been working on the mountain all day, but I haven't been able to pick you up."
Xu Shiyan stepped forward and talked to his father-in-law and mother-in-law.
"No need to pick up, now Songjianghe Railway Station can pull the donkey cart.
The two of us can bring you to Donggang for fifty cents, so what else? You are busy with work, so you can't delay. "
When Su Weizhong saw the second uncle, he smiled like a flower.
I used to think that my uncle had a good job, working in a department store, and he was from the city.
Looking at it now, no one can compare to the second uncle. The family lives well, and with his skills, he even recruited workers to enter the state-owned field as technical consultants.
I heard that it is the salary of a seventh-level technician, plus subsidies and so on, more than 100 yuan a month, which is really incredible.
The key is that the second son-in-law has a good personality and is not arrogant. No matter what time it is, he is unhurried, especially steady and reliable.
The tasks entrusted to him were done quietly, and the work was done very beautifully.
Just like the marriage of the sixth child this time, Su Weizhong originally thought that it would be good to find a young man from the Second Brigade of Donggang, but what happened? Find the participating workers.
The eldest of the six daughters of the Su family married in the city, and the second married in the countryside. As a result, the son-in-law became a worker.
If the sixth son finds another worker, who will look down on him in the future? Su Weizhong has no son?
What about those who have sons? Is their son a worker?
Alas, she is only the fifth child. I don't know where this girl's marriage is?
Forget it, don’t think about those things, let’s settle the matter of the sixth child first.
"What have you been up to lately? I heard from your dad that you go to work all day without rest? Are you so busy at the other end?"
Su Weizhong pulled over a small bench and called Xu Shiyan to sit down.
"Father, chat with you later, I'll send the things in first."
Xu Shiyan didn't sit down, but went into the kitchen and gave Su Anying what he was holding.
"There is nothing good, you can eat those two cans.
Tomorrow morning, go to Songjianghe to have a look. There are some cooked food and buy some. Our parents and mothers come here every once in a while. It’s delicious all the time. Don’t worry about money. "
"Is it up to you to order these? I prepared them a long time ago, and I bought them this morning. I just pack them up and eat later.
Look at the disheveled face you made, what did you do up the mountain today? "
Su Anying saw that Xu Shiyan's head and face were covered in dust and dirt, as was his body, so she couldn't help but wonder, what did he do?
"Don't mention it, today the cannons were fired on the mountain and the roots of the trees fell. Even if you are far away, you can still fall into the ground."
When he came back, Xu Shiyan slapped him again, but it was useless.
The explosives were so powerful that clods, wood, and gravel were blown all over the sky, creating a miasma of smoke.
Although Xu Shiyan said that he could not be hurt from Li Yuan, he did not escape from the dust all over his head.
As Xu Shiyan said, he scooped some water from the tank, washed his head and face, and then went out of the kitchen to chat with his parents and mother-in-law in the yard.
Su Weizhong couldn't help but ask, what kind of work does my uncle do after he arrives at the venue.
Xu Shiyan briefly talked about cultivating Gastrodia elata and Asarum, researching ginseng products, etc.
At the beginning, Su Weizhong understood Gastrodia elata and Asarum. Later, when he talked about Armillaria mellea, Osmanthus chinensis, and ginseng flower drink, ginseng flower cola, etc., Su Weizhong was almost like listening to heaven, and didn't understand at all.
"My in-laws, can you understand what Shi Yan said? Why don't I understand anything?"
Su Weizhong glanced at Xu Chenghou. Seeing Xu Chenghou's calm face, he thought Xu Chenghou could understand.
As a result, Xu Chenghou shook his head, "What do you know? I haven't even heard of the stuff he's doing now.
You haven’t seen it, there is nothing in the east room of his house, there is a big bookshelf against the wall.
The higher-ups don’t know where to find the books. Anyway, as long as he doesn’t go to work, he will definitely read those books.
I am like this, the words in the book know me, I don’t know them, what can I understand? "
The two old men looked at each other, and both had an indescribable feeling that they couldn't keep up with the situation.
"Oh, I really admire Shi Yan's enthusiasm.
It's a pity, you said it would be nice if he went to take the college entrance examination? Can I get into a university or something? "
Su Weizhong didn't know about the Xu family's past, so he just said it casually.
But this casual remark pierced Xu Chenghou's heart.
Yes, but at that time, let Xu Shiyan finish junior high school, the year when the college entrance examination was just resumed, the requirements were low, and he could apply for the exam with a junior high school education.
Relying on Xu Shiyan's enthusiasm for studying, he might not be able to pass the exam.
If Xu Shiyan is also admitted to a university, and there are two college students from one family, what will it be like?
"Father, I don't have the skills to go to university, I just read books blindly.
If you let me read the review materials for the college entrance examination, I can see myself falling asleep. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at the old father's face, and knew that his father was feeling sad and regretful, so he quickly explained.
"Everyone has his own life, isn't it good now? Look at my salary, it's higher than that of college graduates."
Xu Shiyan is a seventh-level skilled worker, and one level away is the highest salary among workers.
Those college graduates who just joined the workforce only paid forty or fifty yuan a month, which is far behind Xu Shiyan.
Being a human being is enough. You can’t always think about the things that have passed. Looking forward, the future will be even better.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: look at each other
chapters.content:
Xu Shiyan chatted with his own father and father-in-law for a while, but Su Anying shouted that it was time to eat, so he went into the house to eat.
Songjianghe Market has become much more prosperous in recent years than before, and there are also shops selling cooked food.
Su Anying bought a roast chicken and a elbow, plus fried peppers with meat, stuffed eggplant, ribs stewed with beans, and cucumbers.
The canned food that Xu Shiyan bought was unused, and there were already six dishes.
My family, there is no need to talk about any rules, just stand aside and let the big guys sit around a table, eating happily.
Zhou Guilan and Han Shi each held a small child to feed, while Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping sat there obediently and ate by themselves.
Xu Chenghou, Su Weizhong, and Xu Shiyan each poured a glass of wine and chatted while drinking.
It took a little longer to eat dinner, and it was already dark outside after dinner.
Xu Chenghou and his wife sat for a while before returning home.
Su Weizhong and his wife led their two daughters to stay in Westinghouse.
During the day, in front of Xu's family, some things are hard to say, but at night, the Han family has to ask the two daughters how they are doing here.
What's going on with the Li family, what Su Anhua thinks about the young man from the Li family, etc.
The four members of the Westinghouse family chatted until midnight, while Xu Shiyan and Su Anying from the Easthouse chatted for a while before resting.
The next day was on the 24th, which happened to be Sunday. The technical team had nothing to do in the past two days, so Xu Shiyan didn't go to the field department.
In the morning, Xu Shiyan cleaned up the yard, and went into the garden to pick some melons and fruits for the guests.
At nine o'clock, there was movement outside. Xu Shiyan went out to see that it was Li Yuexiu and Han Limin, mother and son, who came with Li Bingzhuo's family of three.
Last time Li Yuexiu came with Sun Limei, and she must not be left behind this time.
Han and Xu are in-laws, and they can have a chat with the Han family.
By comparison, most of the time the woman goes to the man's house, and a few go to the woman's house. There are also men and women who meet together at the matchmaker's house.
Choose Xu Shiyan's home, mainly because he is familiar with both parties, so everyone can feel more comfortable coming here.
"Uncle Li, Aunt Li, Aunt Han, Brother Li Min, come in quickly."
When the guests came to the door, Xu Shiyan greeted them with a smile and let everyone go to the east room.
By the looks of it, there is no rule of bringing gifts, so the three members of the Li family came here empty-handed.
Everyone entered the room, introduced by Xu Shiyan, met each other, greeted each other and sat down.
Su Anhua and Li Chengrong, who are the protagonists today, are standing behind their parents, neither of them speak, but Li Chengrong secretly glanced at Su Anhua several times.
Su Anhua is wearing a light pink shirt with light green florals today, beige gray pants, very elegant and neat.
It's not as coquettish as some of the girls in the show, but it's not shabby either, just right.
The glossy black hair is braided and hangs down to the waist. There is no extra decoration on the head, only the tail of the hair is tied with a red headband.
No makeup or powder is applied on the face, a clear face is naturally pretty.
It is said that there are eighteen ugly girls, and that is really the case. There is no need to dress up at all, it is natural and comfortable to look at.
Li Chengrong always looks towards Su Anhua, Su Anhua is not wood, can she not feel it?
Su Anhua was embarrassed by the look, she raised her head and glanced at Li Chengrong, her face blushed a lot, then she lowered her head and stopped looking at Li Chengrong.
On one side, a pair of children interacted silently, while on the other end, Li Bingzhuo, Su Weizhong, and Xu Chenghou had a good chat.
Xu Shiyan had mentioned the situation on both sides in advance, so he had a general understanding.
Come here today, it’s just a formality, it can be regarded as a clear road, and the two young people can communicate normally in the future, and they can get married seriously.
Waiting for a period of time, the two families feel that it is okay, and then through a matchmaker, just find a date to get engaged.
We all know each other, and with Han Limin and Xu Shiyan in the middle, we don't have nothing to say, so the atmosphere in the room is quite harmonious, and there is no silence.
Su Anying made tea for everyone, and brought melons and fruits to the guests for the guests to eat.
"This is the watermelon grown in my own garden this year. It's sandy and delicious. Try it.
I thought it was good, and when I left for a while, I took both of them back. "
In the past few days, the watermelons in the garden are quite ripe, and no one in the Xu family can sell them in the market.
At this time, every household is still working hard for food, and there are not many families who are willing to grow melons and fruits.
After all, not everyone is like Xu Shiyan, who loves children, for fear that the children will have nothing to eat.
So planting a lot of fruit trees in the garden does not count, but also a large piece of cantaloupe and watermelon.
They are all acquaintances, so you don't have to be polite, each picks up a melon and takes a bite.
The entrance of the watermelon with sandy flesh is very moist, and it has a rustling taste, which tastes quite sweet.
"Hey, this melon is delicious and sweet. Get me two later and give it to my sons when I go back."
Han Limin was not polite to Xu Shiyan, he said while eating watermelon.
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, these people who became parents are almost the same, if they have delicious food, they miss the children at home.
Xu Shiyan just wanted to say that there are plenty in the garden, so pick them at will.
Suddenly heard movement outside, looked up and looked out the window, there were several people coming in from outside.
"Uncle Li, can you sit down first, I'll go out and see who's here."
Xu Shiyan got up and was about to go outside, but at this time, half of the people outside had walked in.
"Is Consultant Xu at home? I, Lao Li."
It was the elder Li, his wife, and Li Zongliang who came. The family of three were carrying things in their hands.
"Hey, Uncle Li, why are you here? Come in and talk."
Xu Shiyan just walked to the door of the house, walked face to face with the three members of the Li family, and hurriedly let the Li family into the house.
Big Lao Li's family of three entered the east room. When they saw the room full of people, they were stunned.
"Master Li, are you here?" When did the head of Li's family have such a good relationship with Consultant Xu? A family of three?
Look to the side again, "Xiao Han, sister-in-law Han, you are all here too, what day is today?"
Big Lao Li was even more confused, what's going on?
"Oh, this is not sister-in-law Han introducing someone to our family Xiaorong. It happens to be the wife and sister of Team Leader Xu. Today, Team Leader Xu looks at her."
Li Bingzhuo did not hide it, and explained the situation generously.
"Old Li, what are you doing? The three of you are carrying these old things around, what can you ask Team Leader Xu for?"
Li Bingzhuo glanced at the things in the hands of the three members of the Li family, and asked very curiously.
Big Lao Li just remembered and was still holding things, "Consultant Xu, these are for the elderly and children. Don't think too little of our family's kindness."
Saying that, the three of them put everything on the table. Canned food, snacks, milk powder, malted milk, a lot of things piled on the table.
"Oh, Uncle Li, what do you think you are doing?
We are all colleagues in the same place, I am very happy when you come to sit at home, what are you doing with these things? "
Xu Shiyan didn't notice it just now, but now he saw it and was shocked.
These things on the table are scratched and scratched. If there is no one hundred, it will cost sixty or seventy yuan. Big Lao Li's monthly salary may not be enough.

chapters.title: Chapter 297: gratitude
chapters.content:
"Consultant Xu, if you hadn't stopped me yesterday, my father's life would have been lost.
You said if something happened to my dad, how would our family live? You saved my dad, and you saved our family.
My eldest brother is not here, and the two younger sisters are still young. I will take the place of my brothers and sisters. Thank you, Consultant Xu, for your kindness. "
As Li Zongliang said, he was going to give a big gift to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan was so frightened that he supported Li Zongliang, "Oh, brother, I don't want to do this.
We are all in the same place. Although we don’t have much contact on weekdays, we are familiar with each other, so who can watch what happens? "
Xu Shiyan was not sure at the time, but there was such a thing in his memory. It happened that the artillery was fired on the mountain, so he thought about going over to have a look.
No way, he's just such a person, it's fine if he doesn't know, but since he knows, why can't he just watch something happen.
"Our family is grateful for the great kindness of Consultant Xu. From now on, I will treat you as my brother.
Consultant Xu, no matter what you have to do, just ask, and I will do it. " Li Zongliang was so grateful that he didn't know what to say.
Over there, Li Bingzhuo and the others were a little dazed, not knowing which song this was singing.
"Old Li, what's the matter?" Li Bingzhuo asked anxiously.
Big Lao Li gave a detailed account of what happened yesterday.
"Thanks to Consultant Xu trying to stop me, otherwise, my life would be gone.
At that time, I was fighting with Consultant Xu and almost hit him. Now that I think about it, it’s not a thing at all. "
After hearing this, everyone was stunned.
Especially Li Bingzhuo, he is the head of the first subfield, and the side where he worked yesterday was the participator of the first subfield.
If something happened, he, the director of the factory, would also be put on the job. Not to mention anything else, self-criticism and introspection would be indispensable.
"No wonder, I heard people say before that Xiao Xu is blessed, and wherever he goes, there are people who follow him. This is true."
Li Bingzhuo let out a long breath and sighed.
"Brother Xu, you are blessed, your son is capable. Brother Su, you are not bad, you have a good son-in-law."
Li Bingzhuo calmed down, and turned around to praise Xu Chenghou and Su Weizhong, the in-laws.
Xu Chenghou and Su Weizhong didn't look too good just now, they were worried for Xu Shiyan.
Explosives collapse tree roots, that's not a joke, one can really cause accidents.
"Yeah, my uncle, I can't find fault anywhere.
Especially kind-hearted, no matter who you are, you are very popular, no matter where you go, you can meet a few friends. "
Su Weizhong's words are true, Xu Shiyan is born with that temper, simple and honest.
When getting along with friends, he doesn't hide his mind. If anyone has a big or small affair, he will help.
So no matter where he goes, he can get along well with people, and others are willing to associate with him.
Like those people who hide traitors, play tricks, and play tricks, they may think it’s okay when people don’t know it at first.
Waiting to suffer once and be fooled once, so I know what to do in the future, so I will stop dating.
Now that we have caught up, and we are all acquaintances, the big old Li's family also sat down to talk.
That Li Zongliang is two or three years older than Li Chengrong, and he used to play with him.
The two had to get together to whisper a few words, Li Zongliang asked Li Chengrong, which one was his partner.
There are two big girls in this room, Li Zongliang thought it was the slightly older one.
As a result, Li Chengrong said that it was the younger one who wore the pink shirt.
Li Zongliang froze for a moment, then glanced at the girl next to her in a light blue shirt.
Here, the eldest daughter-in-law, Zhao Meijuan, is also very close to Li Yuexiu and Sun Limei, and happened to be chatting with Zhou Guilan and Han Shi.
As soon as she heard that Li Yuexiu was the matchmaker for the two families, the elder Li's wife joked about it.
"Sister-in-law Han, look at you, then our family's Zongliang doesn't have a partner, so you should help Zhang Luo Zhang Luo."
"Hey, it's because your family's Zongliang has high vision, and none of the girls participating in the show looked down on me.
Just say it, with your good guy Zongliang, who can drive and is skilled, what kind of girl can’t be found, and I’m still needed? "
Li Yuexiu knew that the other party was joking, so she answered the conversation with a smile.
It is not a matter of time-consuming to see each other, it is just that the two families sit together to meet each other, and each other is considered to have admitted that the two children are in love.
So it is not good for Li Bingzhuo and others to stay in Xu's house for a long time. After chatting for a while, they got up to leave.
Li Bingzhuo and the others wanted to leave, and the eldest brother Li's family of three couldn't survive here, so they all wanted to leave together.
The Xu family had to go out to give them away. As for the things on the table, Xu Shiyan didn't say anything like asking Big Brother Li to take them back.
It's not that he really covets other people's things, but that he doesn't have the rules.
People from the Northeast don’t take back what they send out.
Don't care about the amount of things, the price or the lowliness, what you give is a heartfelt gift.
If the owner doesn't accept it and asks someone to take the things back, it will be a slap in the face, and it will be difficult for the two families to communicate again in the future.
After accepting a gift from someone else, if there is any relationship between them in the future, you have to go to help other people's family with any big or small things. With a gift or something, this is human favor.
Northeast people, most of them came from the Guandong. There are many independent small families, and there is no sense of clan.
In order to live a better life, we should pay more attention to human relations and friends.
Therefore, Northeast people have many friends, strong social skills, and they know everyone well.
Of course, there are many possibilities that they are friends with wine and meat, which may not be effective when something really happens, so you can't offend them.
"By the way, Brother Limin, those two little black blind men have a letter, and they asked us to send it to Tonghua.
I’m in a panic, I’m not allowed to take these two things with me on the train, how can we integrate them? "
While walking out, Xu Shiyan and Han Limin chatted casually, and they happened to talk about sending the little black blind man to Tonghua.
Transfer to Tonghua is a problem, the train cannot be used, and it is too expensive to find a car alone.
The two black blind men don’t know how much they can sell, and the fare alone is a lot, which is really not worth it.
"Consultant Xu, Brother Limin, what are you talking about? Who has something to go to Tonghua? Then just come with me?
Our convoy has two days to go to Tonghua to pull some things back, there is space in the car. "
Coincidentally, Li Zongliang happened to be next to the two of them. Hearing Xu Shiyan and Han Limin muttering, Li Zongliang asked a question.
"Really? Whoops, that would be great. Is our car going empty?"
Xu Shiyan and Han Limin became happy when they heard this. It would be nice if they could get a ride, and save trouble.
"Well, it seems that I can get some goods, not many, there must be a place.
Consultant Xu, if you are going to Tonghua, come with us. We will leave at 8:00 in the morning and arrive in the afternoon. It is not slower than the train, and it is more convenient and less crowded. "
Xu Shiyan wants to take a car, even if there is no room, Li Zongliang can find a way to find a place for him, this is a must.
"That's great, Zong Liang, thank you, we are worried.
It doesn’t need too much space, just enough to fit an iron cage.
Your sister-in-law's farm has two black and blind boys, and I plan to send them to Tonghua Zoo. "

chapters.title: Chapter 298: send away little black bear
chapters.content:
Su Weizhong and his wife are quite satisfied with Li Chengrong and the Li family, so the marriage is considered a deal.
However, Li Chengrong and Su Anhua are still young, and they have only formally established a relationship. As for engagement and marriage, there is no rush.
The two families are discussing to let the children stay together for a year and a half, and then they will be engaged and discuss about marriage.
There is a lot of arable land at Daying, and the four members of Su Weizhong's family divided more than eight acres of land.
The two daughters are both in Donggang, and the eight mu of land is directed to the couple to clean up at home. It is true and quite busy.
Although the land is divided into households now, Su Weizhong, the captain, is still on the job.
Don't look at the need to lead the members to work, those miscellaneous things are more troublesome.
So Su Weizhong and his wife couldn't stay in Xu's house for a long time. They took advantage of the car in the afternoon and went back in a hurry.
It happened that Xu Shiyan had nothing to do. After lunch, he sent his father-in-law and mother-in-law away.
"Daughter-in-law, pick up half of the things that Uncle Li and the others brought this morning, and give them to our parents to take away."
Big Lao Li sent a lot of food, and the family couldn't eat it, so it happened to be divided into two. Both parents are old, so they should eat something good.
"Oh, no need, don't give it to us.
The things sent by others are very expensive, and they will be kept for favors in the future. "
Most of the elders think like this. Gifts from others should not be eaten and used easily, but should be kept for later gifts.
"Don't, these are edible, there is a time limit, after time they should be broken.
It doesn't hurt to eat something, but it hurts to be blind.
My parents are not too young anymore, they should eat and drink something good to nourish their bodies. "
Xu Shiyan ignored his father-in-law's obstruction, found a bag, and filled half of the things.
Su Weizhong saw that the uncle was sincere, and it was useless for him to stop him, so he had to give up.
Su Anfang and Su Anhua were naturally reluctant to let their parents leave, so they talked while holding Han's hand. I have to tell my parents to pay attention to something.
It's not early, and it's still a long way from Donggang to the train station, so we can't delay any longer.
Then everyone came out and got into the carriage that Xu Shiyan had harnessed. Xu Shiyan waved his whip, and the horse ran happily, heading north all the way to the train station.
Arrived outside the station, Xu Shiyan didn't follow him in, but only took out one hundred yuan and handed it to Su Weizhong.
"Father, Yingzi and I are busy, and it's rare to go back. You can keep this little money, and buy something if you need it."
Xu Shiyan's salary is more than 100 yuan a month now, and Su Anying is in charge of the farm, not to mention, there is no shortage of money.
The father-in-law and the mother-in-law come here once, so they can't go back empty-handed.
Where was Su Weizhong willing to ask for my uncle's money, he hurriedly waved his hands and refused to accept it, but Xu Shiyan stuffed it into his pocket.
"Father, there are many people in this place, let's not tear each other up so that people will look shameful.
The second elder has raised Yingzi for more than twenty years, so we should be filial to the second elder. "
"I still have something to ask Dad for help. If Dad refuses to accept money, how can I ask Dad in the future?"
Seeing that Su Weizhong refused to accept him, Xu Shiyan could only say so.
"Ah? Why do you need my help? Just say it, no matter how difficult it is, I have to find a way to help you."
Su Weizhong was taken aback by what my uncle said. What else can he do to help an old man?
"Father, at the end of October this year, my sixth younger sister has to go to the provincial capital for surgery.
I'm too busy at work, so I can't stay with you for a month. I want Yingzi to go.
But the provincial capital is such a big place, and the outside is chaotic. I don’t feel at ease when the two women are away from home.
I was thinking, why not bother Dad and follow Yingzi to the provincial capital? "Xu Shiyan has been thinking about this matter for a long time.
Autumn is the busiest season for participation, and the processing plant can be busy until winter.
Especially this year, Changbai Mountain red ginseng will be trial-produced. Xu Shiyan must be too busy to go to the provincial capital.
Xu Shiyan doesn't have time, so don't count on the other brothers, and it's not convenient for the man to take care of him, so it's better to let Su Anying go with him.
As for Su Weizhong, it was Xu Shiyan's excuse. Xu Shiyan's real purpose was to let Su Weizhong go to the provincial capital for a physical examination.
In his previous life, Su Weizhong passed away due to kidney disease. Even though he was still a few years away, he should not be careless.
It is best to go to the provincial capital hospital for a checkup, and those who need injections and medicines should be given as soon as possible.
"Oh, ok, I can do this.
After waiting for the autumn harvest, when you say you will leave, I will pack up my things and go to the provincial capital with Yingzi. "
As soon as he heard that he was going to the provincial capital with his daughter, Su Weizhong agreed without saying a word.
Weng and his son-in-law made an agreement, Su Weizhong led the Han family and walked to the station with things, Su Anfang and Su Anhua followed and sent them to the station.
The two sisters lived in Xu's house for half a year, and they didn't have to worry about eating and drinking. Su Anying also gave them some pocket money for a month.
The two girls were not willing to spend, so they gave all the money to their mother last night.
Xu Shiyan waited outside the station for a while, until the train came in, Su Weizhong and his wife got on the train and left, and sister Su Anfang came out, and then drove the car back.
Su Anhua's marriage is settled, Xu Shiyan and his wife finally lost half of their worries.
As for Su Anfang, it depends on fate, maybe one day the marriage will change, and the marriage will be resolved smoothly.
Another advantage of the marriage agreement is that Li Chengrong finally had a fair reason to get in touch with Su Anhua.
Look on the 24th, and on the 25th, this kid sent a lot of things to Su Anhua.
Shawl, cream, soap, two pieces of cloth.
This kid is not doing well yet, but he knows who to pet, and he doesn't know how much money he has left from this month's salary.
No matter what, the young man has a heart, and Sister Su Anhua is very happy to see this.
I didn't expect Li Chengrong to look a little stunned, but he still knows how to hurt others, which is very good.
On July 28th, Li Zongliang drove with another driver to Tonghua to deliver things to the participants.
When I went there, there was not much cargo on the car, leaving a lot of space.
Xu Shiyan and Han Limin asked for leave from the leader, just in time to pick up and transport the two little black blind men.
The two little black blind men are familiar with people, and they are not afraid of people. If they are given something delicious, they will go into the cage by themselves.
Xu Shian, on the other hand, was extremely reluctant to see the two little things being transported away.
That's okay, these two guys are too good to eat, so they can't be kept like this.
Everyone lifted the cage to the car and put enough food inside.
The two little black blind men seemed to sense something was wrong, but they had no choice but to stay obediently in the cage.
At eight o'clock in the morning, a group of people set off from Donggang.
The speed of cars in these years is not so fast, and the road conditions are not good, the road is bumpy and swaying, and we have a rest for dinner in the middle, and it is already afternoon in Tonghua.
"Brother Xu, Brother Han, take care of your two affairs first, and then we will go to load the goods."
Just like that, Xu Shiyan first went to the person from the medicinal material procurement department, and he led him to the other side of the zoo.
There are a few peacocks and old monkeys in Yuhuangshan Zoo, just missing black and blind people.
These two black blind men were artificially raised since they were young, and they are not so wild, so it is appropriate to stay in the park.

chapters.title: Chapter 299: have to go to school
chapters.content:
Xu Shiyan hitchhiked and sent the two little black blind men to the zoo. In the end, the two little black blind men were sold for 1,200 yuan.
After getting the money, Xu Shiyan and Han Limin invited Li Zongliang and another driver to have a good meal in the evening, and bought cigarettes, alcohol and other things for each of them when they came back.
Li Zongliang was embarrassed to accept it, but another driver, Le Hehe, accepted it, so he could only accept it.
The rest of the money, after deducting the expenses of the two little black blind men on the farm during this period, was divided with the Han family.
Don't worry about how much it is, at least you get a fortune, and you don't have to feed those two guys anymore. It is too edible to feed.
In the blink of an eye, most of August has passed.
On August 20th, the elementary school started. Xu Shiyan took Xu Haiyuan to the office of the first-year group on the 18th, according to the request of the principal of the elementary school.
Several first-grade teachers gave Xu Haiyuan a paper, and if he answered correctly, he was allowed to go to elementary school.
There is no way, Xu Haiyuan is too old, the school is worried that he will not be able to keep up.
Even if there is a guarantee from the teacher of Yuhong Class, it will not work. Finally, after discussing and deciding to take the exam to see the situation.
The first grade questions are not too difficult, but for a six-year-old child, it is already not easy.
Xu Haiyuan finished answering the paper in a calm manner, handed it to the teacher, and then quietly stood beside his father, waiting for the result.
The first few teachers reviewed the papers carefully, and were surprised to find that Xu Haiyuan got full marks.
That is to say, this kid has almost learned the content of the first semester of the first grade.
Yes, what else to say, I must have it.
There are four classes in the first grade of Donggang Central Primary School, and the teachers of these four classes look at Xu Haiyuan.
The little baby, standing there behaved quietly and well-behaved, this baby looked like a sweet baby at first glance, and was so smart, several teachers wanted this student.
Finally, the grade leader decided to draw lots, and Xu Haiyuan was assigned to class one a year.
In this way, the six-year-old Xiaodouding Xu Haiyuan has become a primary school student, and he can go to the first class every year when the school starts on August 20.
"Dad, I have to go to school too, and I have to go with my brother.
And Xiaoyu, Xiaoyu also has to go to school, we all go to school. "
Xu Shiyan took his son home and just told his family the news. On the other end, his daughter Xu Jinping was unhappy, hugged Xu Shiyan's thigh, and cried to go to school.
Yang Haoyu, who was playing at Xu's house, also ran over and hugged Xu Shiyan's other leg.
"Godfather, I'm going to school too, and I'm going to study with my second sister."
Finished, poking a hornet's nest, this is, who would have thought that these two little ones would join in the fun.
"No, you two are only five years old, not yet four years old. What school do you go to? Yuhong class doesn't necessarily want you."
Xu Shiyan is speechless. The other children cry in fright when they hear that they are going to school, and they wish they could play at home.
There are still crying and shouting to go to school? Why did he meet so strangely?
"No, we're going to school, Dad, let's go to school, please."
Xu Jinping hugged Xu Shiyan's leg, raised her small face, with tears in her big eyes, and looked at him pitifully, with a pleading look on her face.
In this situation, who can bear to refuse?
Yes, left and right are begging for favors, and they have to beat favors.
One sheep is also driven, and two sheep are also herded. What can I do? It's a good thing that children want to study, so find someone to send them to Yuhong Class.
In the afternoon, when Yang Junxian came to pick up his son, Xu Shiyan discussed with him.
Both of them have nothing to do with their children, so they can only send them to school.
Fortunately, the Yuhong class is not so strict, so I asked someone to talk about it, and because of Xu Haiyuan's face, the teacher really agreed to accept Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu.
So, Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu went to Yuhong Class to study as they wished.
There is only one class in Yuhong Primary School, so these two are in the same class as Huang Shuyun from Huang Shengli's family, Sun Yu from Sun Xiaofeng's family, Zhao Lili from Zhao Jianshe's family, and Yang Jianjun from Yang Chunming's family.
Now it works. You can’t see it when you go to school, but you can’t see it when you leave school.
Huang Shuqing and Xu Haiyuan, who were already in the first grade, went to Yuhong class to pick up those few, and then this large group of children came out of school and walked home.
That posture, those who didn't know it thought they were looking for someone to fight.
It's also good, that is, the children of the grain depot workers' families don't dare to provoke them anymore.
Yang Haoyu's family is a large group, too far away from the school, and he is young, so he is worried about going home by himself.
So at noon, Yang Haoyu ate at Xu's house, and played at Xu's house after school in the afternoon.
Wait until Ji Yufeng or Yang Junxian finish their work, and then come to Xu's house to pick him up.
Even though Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu are young, these two study hard, and they can remember everything the teacher teaches.
Xu Shiyan saw this, and could only let the children do it.
But in private, she told Su Anying that no matter what Xu Jinping is doing this time, she must be eight years old before she can go to elementary school.
She herself has a young birthday, and her eight-year-old primary school does not meet the regulations. It can't be earlier, it is not good for the child.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping didn't know what their parents were talking about in private. For them, going to school was a very happy thing.
Especially Xu Haiyuan, a first-year student, has learned more than Yuhong class.
He likes everything, especially the science class. He listens to it like a fascination. He likes to listen to whatever the teacher says, and he will talk to his two aunts when he gets home.
Xu Jinping is also very happy, because there are so many students in Yuhong class, everyone can play together.
Xu Jinping is young, most of the children in the class are older than her, and most of them will let her.
Plus she is good-looking, two aunts and one aunt put her heart into dressing her up, wearing pigtails and small skirts, neatly dressed, really like a doll, very attractive.
Besides, this baby has a sweet mouth, he can talk to anyone when he meets him, and he is also very polite. Who wouldn't be surprised to see such a kid?
Both older ones have gone to school, so the family can actually relax a bit.
Sisters Zhou Guilan and Su Anfang took care of the two young ones, while Xu Shiyan and Su Anying worked outside the home.
It's almost autumn harvest, Xu's family has planted some land, and there are sticks on the mountain, so why not be busy?
"I went to see it today, and it looked like it was digging in the soil.
That’s the only way to go, digging out the dirt, it’s not as good as cleaning up at home. "In the evening, Xu Shiyan chatted with Su Anying.
At the other end of the Nantian Gate, when the vernal equinox opened, the seven members of the two families shared a total of thirty feet of ginseng.
Xu Shiyan has to go to work, how can he have time to dig the soil? Xu Chenghou is getting old, and Su Anying, a woman, can't even dig the soil.
So Xu Shiyan bagged out the thirty feet of ginseng soil and found someone to do the work for one foot and two yuan.
After all, not all families are like the Xu family. More often, there are several laborers in the family. There is not much land and ginseng to divide, so they have to find ways to make money.
