However, if this job is outsourced to others, it will not be as good as doing it yourself.
Xu Shiyan is also a very careful person. When he saw the work done by others, he really looked down upon it, thinking it was too rough.
"Okay, let's make do with it, what can we do? It really doesn't work, I'll go up and watch when the soil is poured, and pour it again.
You can't expect everyone to work as well as you do. "Su Anying can only persuade.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Participate in a good harvest
chapters.content:
One ginseng farm has an annual shipment of 10,000 to 20,000 feet, and an annual output of nearly 300,000 jin of water ginseng.
The ones shipped this year happened to be fertilized with bean cake water last year, and the output is expected to be higher.
With such a large output, it would be impossible if they were all squeezed into production around the autumnal equinox.
So just entered September, as soon as the venue started to distribute the participants, the processing factory also started to work.
Yichangchang processing factory is just to the north of the factory, covering a large area.
This place is much stronger than the processing factory in the second brigade. There are steaming ginseng tanks, dryers, ginseng brushing machines and other large-scale mechanical equipment, worth more than 400,000 yuan.
Other supporting facilities are also very complete, and the venue is larger.
Every autumn, all the employees of a ginseng site, together with their family members, are mobilized to start making ginseng products.
Even so, the manpower is not enough, and some temporary workers need to be found from outside.
Even Donggang junior high school and high school students will go to the processing factory to work for a few days at this time to earn class fees.
For students of this age, going to school is not only about studying, but also participating in labor. The school has a special labor class.
Chop firewood and burn the stove in winter, clear snow, plant and shovel the ground in spring, weed and clean up the playground in summer, harvest the ground in autumn, chop corn and beat beans.
The students don't fall behind in any of these tasks, they have to do them all.
Waiting for another two years, the school-run ginseng field will appear, and students will have to go to the ginseng field to pick ginseng seeds and weeds.
From the first day of participation, not only Xu Shiyan and others went up the mountain, but also Li Bingzhuo and Lin Qiyue, just to prove the effect of top dressing with bean cake water.
In the past two years, the way of covering ginseng has changed again.
From the previous bat board felt paper, to yellow transparent plastic film, curtains, bow strips, etc., from a single-sided shed to a small arched shed.
The yellow polyvinyl chloride ginseng film has a width of nearly two meters, is relatively soft, has strong light transmission, and has a short anti-aging time.
Currently, relevant departments are studying blue polyethylene film, which has better anti-aging performance than yellow one.
The ginseng shed has been updated in the first ginseng field, which is currently covered with yellow polyvinyl chloride. As for the agricultural team, it has not been used yet, mainly because the ginseng film is too expensive.
This kind of shed can save you a lot of worry when you evacuate the shed. You only need to untie the upper layer and bow strip, and roll up the plastic sheet and the lower curtain, so the work is very fast.
The two people in front withdraw the shed, and the person behind cuts the ginseng leaves with a sickle, and then they can start ginseng.
"Secretary Lin, look quickly, this year's clubs are really good, and they are generally bigger than previous years.
After a while, we will produce a string and weigh it as a whole, so we can try to find out how much the production increase has been. I feel that a 20% increase in production is no problem. "
As soon as it started to grow there, everyone noticed that the growth of ginseng this year was unusual, and it was obviously bigger than previous years.
"Hurry up, tell everyone, hurry up and work, and quickly measure the output later."
Lin Qiyue looked at the stick sticking out from the ground, and said excitedly.
It costs at least a dozen yuan to increase the production of one catty of water ginseng by one zhang. At present, it is absolutely impossible to increase the production of one catty by one zhang.
One participant has shipped nearly 20,000 feet this year. If this is calculated as a whole, how much will the increase in production and income be?
It would be exciting to change to anyone, let alone Lin Qiyue as the secretary of the field.
His eyes are full of mallets now, and his mind is full of how much income can be increased this year.
With this money, the site has to buy something more, and the workers will pay more benefits.
Secretary Lin has spoken, why don’t the workers below hurry up? So everyone speeded up to participate.
It didn't take long, a string of about forty feet came out, the sticks were shaken to clean the soil, and they were packed into sacks.
Someone brought a large steelyard over there, and a few strong young men carried the scale and began to weigh the sacks one by one. There was another person beside him, who was holding a notebook to record.
Not long after, the statistics showed that a string of forty-two-foot sticks yielded a total of 850 catties of water ginseng, and an average of one meter can yield a little more than 20 catties of water ginseng.
As soon as the data was reported to Secretary Lin, the cadres present were all overjoyed.
"Secretary, if all follow this ratio, our participation will increase production by 70,000 to 80,000 catties this year.
My goodness, we could make millions more just from this. "
It’s not like I don’t know, but I’m surprised that just top dressing has such a good effect.
How about waiting until the year after next? Even base fertilizer plus top dressing, how much will the yield increase?
"Consultant Xu, you are amazing, this trick is really easy to use."
Lin Qiyue excitedly held Xu Shiyan's hand, not knowing what to say.
In the past, I just heard about it, even Donggang Commune, the Second Brigade, and even the county newspapers, but after all, I never saw it with my own eyes, and I couldn’t feel that feeling at all.
At this moment, piles of clubs are in front of you, and groups of numbers prove the effect of bean cake top dressing.
Through the numbers, you can see the huge benefits. Who is not excited? That joy cannot be expressed in words.
Comparatively speaking, Xu Shiyan is very calm, after all, he has experienced this several times.
Last year when the production of the second team was high, Yu Shouguang and others were so excited that they almost knelt down and cried.
"As long as we continue to improve the technology, the output will increase. Take your time and don't rush."
There are still ways, but at present, it is not suitable to use it anymore, otherwise there will be a phenomenon that the harvest will hurt farmers in a good year.
Lin Qiyue is also such a big secretary who participated in the event. He has seen too many big scenes, and the excitement was only temporary, and soon subsided.
So he directed the people to continue working, while he, Xu Shiyan and several other cadres present went to a side meeting to study the next ginseng processing plan.
Originally, Xu Shiyan proposed to trial-produce ginseng honey slices and Changbaishan red ginseng.
Lin Qiyue always felt that these two kinds of products were likely to be produced and faced the problem of no market, so he didn't dare to promise too much, and only talked about a small amount of trial production.
However, at the moment when he saw the production data just now, Lin Qiyue made up his mind to support Xu Shiyan's proposal and must research new products.
Even if it is impossible to generate income in the short term, new products must be produced.
"Xiao Xu, the few of us held a meeting to discuss and decided to allocate 30,000 catties of fresh ginseng for your experiment this year.
I hope you will not disappoint our expectations of you, and make sure to make a blockbuster product that belongs to us. "
Judging from the current situation, it is not a problem to increase the production of ginseng land by 70,000 to 80,000 jin, and allocate a part of it for experimentation. Even if it is unsuccessful, it will not have much impact on the overall situation.
Xu Shiyan became happy when he heard this.
"Leaders, rest assured that our technical team will definitely not disappoint the expectations of the leaders. We will definitely be able to overcome difficulties and make the products we want."
No matter who you are, you all hope to gain the trust of others, and you all hope to have the opportunity to show your strengths.
Before in the second team, without such conditions, Xu Shiyan would not have such great ambitions.
But it's different now, he has to make some achievements to prove that Lin Qiyue made an exception to poach him to participate in the competition, and it was the right choice.
"Okay, young people must have this energy, work hard, we are very optimistic about you and the technical team.
Work hard, overcome difficulties, and make achievements, and your rewards are indispensable. "
Lin Qiyue patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and encouraged him.

chapters.title: Chapter 301: Developed successfully
chapters.content:
Ginseng comes out of the field, and after being weighed and recorded, it is sent directly to the processing factory.
A ginseng processing plant is equipped with ginseng brushing machines, steaming ginseng tanks, dryers and other machines, which can mechanize most of the processes.
The way of processing ginseng in the First Participation Field is different from that in the Second Brigade and other places.
The ginseng brushing machine does not need manual brushing of ginseng. After the fresh ginseng is brushed by the machine, part of the ginseng needs to be broken off manually.
Therefore, a large number of people will be recruited to participate in the field, breaking off ginseng whiskers, straightening out ginseng whiskers, putting forks out of the pot, weighing, etc.
Temporary workers recruited from outside generally do tasks such as breaking and trimming ginseng beards.
Individual piece counting, each person will be given a few big bamboo baskets, and the sticks he broke out will be placed in the baskets, and when they are full, they will go to the scale to keep accounts.
Other things like swinging forks, weighing, drying, beard trimming, beard smoothing, packing, etc. Most of them are young people selected from the workers' families, who work quickly and are paid by the hour.
The technology group wants to develop a new product, ginseng instant honey slices. Fresh ginseng needs to be washed and sliced, and then marinated in honey.
Not to mention Changbai Mountain red ginseng, which requires more than a dozen processes, all of which require a lot of labor.
The technology group is not only responsible for the development of new products, but also supervises the quality and maintenance of related equipment.
So, from the first day of processing, the technical team has more than half of the staff in the processing factory.
At the Xu family's side, the Clivia seedlings have been finalized, and this year's new seeds have not yet been confiscated, so the daily management does not need to take too much thought.
Besides, both Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping have gone to school, and there are only two young ones left at home, so Zhou Guilan can take care of them by herself.
Sister Su Anfang discussed with Xu Shiyan that they wanted to find something else to do, so they couldn't stay idle all the time.
Xu Shiyan thought about it, the two sister-in-laws are quite capable, and there is a shortage of people at the other end of the processing factory.
The processing plant is very busy from the beginning of September to the beginning of November. In two months, it can earn seventy or eighty yuan, which is not bad.
Thus, Xu Shiyan arranged for the two sister-in-laws to go to the processing factory. With him around, he must have arranged jobs that were not too tiring but also paid a lot of money.
Sister Su Anfang was good at her job, and her hands and feet were quick, and no one else could find anything wrong with her, so she just stayed in the processing factory.
Xu's family didn't grow much land, and their own ginseng land was not much, so Xu Chenghou took care of it.
In the past few years, Xu Shiyan has been taking care of him. Every winter, Xu Chenghou is given some ointment or some herbal tea for conditioning.
Now Xu Chenghou has also noticed that he can't count on anyone but the third child, so while he can still move, try to help the third child as much as possible.
Su Anying can't run to the farm every day, she has to clean up her own land, especially the ginseng land.
At the breeding farm, choose one of the few blind people who has done a good job as the leader, and cooperate with Xu Shian to lead the others to work.
The daughters-in-law of Su Anying, Huang Shengli and others, go there every now and then to take care of Clivia, and the rest of the time, they are busy with team affairs.
The Second Brigade still has the sticks to make goods this year. When the land was allocated, it was not distributed to each household, but each family still had to work. After the goods were produced in autumn, the money could be distributed.
Su Anying had to come forward for all these odds and ends.
September 17th, the second brigade began to participate.
The ginseng output of the second brigade is still very good this year, making Yu Shouguang and other cadres laugh from ear to ear.
After busy work, it entered October, and all the food in the Xu family's field was taken back.
Under the supervision of Su Anying, the new ginseng land carefully poured the soil again, just waiting for the team to divide the seeds and ginseng seeds and plant them.
At this time, Xu Shiyan led the backbone of a participating technical team, and was working on the production of Changbai Mountain red ginseng.
Changbaishan red ginseng is a product that selects high-quality ginseng on the basis of ordinary red ginseng and carries out deep processing.
In addition to the six processes of the first processing, there are twelve processes in the second processing.
Selection, trimming, drying, weighing, softening, molding, compression molding, drying, boxing, sealing, pumping air and nitrogen filling, boxing.
Among them, the most tedious and difficult part is softening, molding, and pressing.
If the softening is not enough, it cannot reach a state of sufficient elasticity and plasticity. If it is too softened, it is easy to crush the ginseng when molding.
When loading the mold, the speed must be fast, while shrinking and reshaping.
The red ginseng cannot be flattened and crushed when pressing the mold, and the red ginseng can be combined together. The technical requirements for this are very precise.
Xu Shiyan has spent more than a month in the processing workshop, overcoming the relevant technical difficulties one by one. After these days of exploration, it is almost the same.
"Leader, we have measured the water content and weight of this batch of products, and confirmed that each ginseng weighs 601 grams, and the water content also meets the standard."
On the morning of October 19th, Xu Shiyan led people to test a batch of red ginseng blocks that had been dried for six or seven days.
After the inspection of the staff, the water content is up to the standard, and each ginseng block accurately reaches the standard of 601 grams.
Xu Shiyan took the data handed over by the team members and carefully checked the moisture content, quality and other data.
Changbaishan red ginseng can be divided into six levels: 16 slices-20 sticks, 20 slices-28 sticks, 30 slices-28 sticks, 40 slices-48 sticks, 50 slices-58 sticks, 60 slices-68 sticks, six grades.
No matter what grade, no matter how many branches of ginseng, the requirement is that one piece of finished ginseng must be 601 grams, and the water content should not exceed 12%.
The prepared Changbai Mountain red ginseng has excellent texture, pure color, transparent cutin, no grooves, yellow skin, and scars, and is hard and brittle. Has a special fragrance, taste slightly bitter, sweet.
Put it in a tinplate box, seal it and store it with nitrogen, which can prevent moths and last for a long time.
"Everyone, after more than a month of hard work, this batch of red ginseng fully meets the standards.
That is to say, our Changbai Mountain red ginseng has been successfully trial-produced. "
Xu Shiyan read all the data, took the prepared ginseng block and checked it repeatedly, and finally confirmed that the red ginseng in his hand was exactly the same as the Changbai Mountain red ginseng he had seen in his previous life.
In the previous life, Fusong Ginseng Company spent a long time researching and finally successfully developed Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng in the autumn of 1984.
Xu Shiyan took advantage of Rebirth and finally succeeded in developing it before Ginseng Company.
There was a burst of cheers in the room, and everyone was very happy.
Some people jumped up and down happily, and some people hugged the people around them excitedly, and there was a round of applause at the scene.
The emergence of new technology represents a new level of ginseng processing in Yishenchang.
"Okay, don't be so happy, hurry up and send the samples and data to Secretary Lin and the others, so that all the leaders will be happy too.
Next, it has to be sent to the county ginseng research institute, and it can only be produced after passing the identification. "
Successful trial production is only the first step, and the next step is certification.
It is necessary to prove that the quality and craftsmanship of Changbai Mountain red ginseng are superior to Zhengguanzhuang Korean ginseng, and to register patents and trademarks.
Only in this way, otherwise, what is the use of their research and development?

chapters.title: Chapter 302: On business trip
chapters.content:
Changbai Mountain red ginseng was successfully trial-produced, and Lin Qiyue and other participating leaders were very happy.
Lin Qiyue immediately asked people to collect all the data and materials, and sent them to the county ginseng company together with the samples.
At the same time, he made a report to the county to apply for a trademark for the newly developed Changbaishan red ginseng.
"Xiao Xu, pack up and go to the provincial capital for a business trip in the last few days.
The county ginseng company replied, let us send some samples to the laboratory of Bethune University of Medical Sciences, and the county commissioned a professional inspection for our Changbai Mountain red ginseng. "
A few days after the report was delivered, Lin Qiyue called Xu Shiyan over and asked Xu Shiyan to prepare for a business trip.
Xu Shiyan is preparing to ask for leave in a few days to accompany Xu Shiqin and Su Anying to the provincial capital to perform surgery on Xu Shiqin.
Before he could speak, he was asked to go on a business trip to the provincial capital, which was just right and more convenient.
So, I received the letter of introduction, travel allowance, etc., and completed the procedures.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly called Daying and told Su Weizhong that they were going to the provincial capital on October 18th.
"Daughter-in-law, pack up quickly, we will go to the provincial capital together the day after tomorrow.
We have something to attend, so we sent me to the provincial capital on a business trip, just in time, I will send you, Shiqin, and my father to the provincial capital together. "
After get off work in the evening, Xu Shiyan said to Su Anying as soon as he entered the door.
"Huh? Go to the provincial capital the day after tomorrow? What about our ginseng land? It's time to plant ginseng in a few days."
Su Anying was washing the pots and cooking. When she heard that she was going to go out the day after tomorrow, she was stunned.
"It's okay, I'll take you there, settle you down, and I'll come back first when I'm done.
Our family has a total of more than 20 feet. I told Shengli and Jianshe to plant ginseng together.
When it’s Sunday or if I take a day off, it’s easy to plant ginseng. "
In the countryside, this is called an au pair, which means that if you help me for a day, I will also help you for a day, helping each other with work.
Xu Shiyan gets along so well with Zhao Jianshe and others, even if Xu Shiyan is not at home, those few people can help plant the hammer on this matter.
"Well, that's fine, I'll pack up after dinner.
Hurry up to our mother's side and tell my little sister to ask her to ask for leave and prepare to go out for surgery. "
Xu Shiqin has been undergoing surgery for almost a year. It is time to take out the screws and nail rods in the body. It has been too long, and the flesh and blood will wrap those materials, making it even more difficult to do.
While the weather is still warm, I don’t suffer from being hospitalized, which is pretty good.
"Okay, then you cook first, and I'll talk to my parents and my little sister."
After Xu Shiyan finished speaking, he hurried out of the house and went straight to his parents.
It happened that Xu Shiqin had just returned from get off work. In the summer, Xu Shiqin saved up money and bought a Phoenix light bicycle.
Now I ride a bicycle to and from get off work, which is much more convenient than before.
After a year of adjustment and rehabilitation, Xu Shiqin is now much stronger than when he just returned from the operation, and his whole body is in good spirits.
As soon as he heard that he was going to the provincial capital the day after tomorrow, Xu Chenghou, his wife and Xu Shiqin were all taken aback.
No one thought it would be so early, they thought it would be November anyway, and we would talk about it after we were all busy at home.
"Then you can ask your master for leave tomorrow, it's rare to catch up with your third brother on a business trip, so I can go out with you.
Otherwise, I'm still worried. It's not safe for you and your third sister-in-law to go out on the road. "
Zhou Guilan was the quickest to respond. Now that the business trip of the third son has been decided, what else to say, just ask for leave and go together.
With Xu Shiyan going out with him, everyone can rest assured.
"Isn't it costing so much money for the operation this time? Old woman, take a look at how much money is left at home in a while, and give it to the child.
It's not easy for a poor family to get rich, so don't take less. "
On the other end, Xu Chenghou also came to his senses, took a puff of cigarette, and asked Zhou Guilan to prepare the money.
"Father, Mom, you don't need to take the money, as long as the money comes from me." Xu Shiyan said hurriedly.
Xu Shiqin's surgery last year has already emptied the house.
Xu Chenghou didn’t visit this year, and he didn’t have any other income except for the pension allowances from his brothers. How much money does he have? Let's keep the old couple.
"Then how can you pay for everything? It's not easy for the two of you to earn money. Seeing how busy this autumn is, you can't take care of your family.
Your mother and I don’t have any big expenses, and we don’t spend much on food, so we can’t let you spend all of it. "Xu Chenghou insisted.
It’s not easy for a son and daughter-in-law. This year, the couple has been so busy, how can they bear to let their son spend money everywhere?
"Father, you don't have to be stubborn with me.
In this way, I will bring some money and let the younger sister choose some good Clivia trees, just to go to the provincial capital to test the water. "
It’s just starting to get cold this season, so don’t bring too much, just two pots of Clivia will do, let’s try it in the past.
If it is successfully sold, then there is nothing to worry about. Even if it can’t be sold, Xu Shiyan has money, so he won’t have money for surgery.
When Xu Chenghou and his wife heard this, this seemed to be a solution.
My son and daughter-in-law have been raising Clivia for almost a year, so it's time to give it a try and see if it makes money or not.
"That's fine, old girl, bring all the wages you saved yourself.
It costs a lot to go out, don't let your third brother and third sister-in-law pay for it. "Xu Chenghou instructed Xu Shiqin.
"Understood, Dad." Xu Shiqin responded.
Xu Shiyan notified his parents and sister, but he didn't stay here, so he hurried back home.
It happened that sisters Su Anfang and Su Anfen came back from get off work in the processing factory, and the family had dinner. Su Anying told her two younger sisters that she was going out.
"Second Sister, you can rest assured that you can stay with Sister Qin in the provincial capital. In a few more days between the two of us, the work in the processing factory will be almost finished.
When the time comes, the two of us will come back to take care of the house and cook, so you don’t have to worry about anything at home. "
Sister Su Anfang started working in the processing factory in early September, and it has been nearly two months now. Recently, the processing factory has not had so much work, and many temporary workers have quit.
The two of them have a good time with Xu Shiyan, and they are still staying inside for the time being. It is estimated that nothing will happen in a few days, and they just come back to take care of the family.
"Mom, I will help take care of my younger siblings, don't worry."
Even Xu Haiyuan patted his chest and assured his mother that he would take good care of his younger siblings.
"Okay, my mother believes in our family, she is a good brother who is responsible and conscientious."
Son's childish words warmed Su Anying's heart, she reached out and rubbed the top of her son's head, and smiled.
After dinner, Sister Su Anfang packed up her things and went to live with Zhou Guilan.
Here, Su Anying hurriedly packed her clothes and luggage.
Xu Shiqin's operation this time, it is conservatively estimated that it will take about a month to come back, and the weather will be cold at that time, so he has to bring thick clothes.
In addition, I have to prepare some gifts for Mr. Chu and Qi Yunsheng and his wife. There are quite a lot of things in one stroke.
"This is three thousand yuan, you put it away and hide it.
I told my little sister, and asked her to pick two pots of Clivia to take with her, and try to sell them over there.
If Clivia can be sold, we don’t have to pay for the little sister’s surgery fee. If the sale is not good, I guess the money is enough. "
Xu Shiyan took out three bundles of money from the cellar of the storage room and handed them to Su Anying.

chapters.title: Chapter 303: to the provincial capital
chapters.content:
On October 18th, 1983, the 13th day of the ninth month in the lunar calendar, Xu Shiyan took his wife and younger sister and boarded the train to Hunjiang.
When passing Xianrenqiao Station, Su Weizhong also boarded this train and found Xu Shiyan and his party.
The four of them gathered in one place, and they happened to occupy the two long seats on the opposite side. They talked and laughed along the way, and arrived at the Hunjiang River in the afternoon.
Xu Shiyan specially brought two flower baskets made of wicker, each containing a pot of Clivia, and brought them together with his luggage, but no one paid attention to them anyway.
When I arrived at Hunjiang Station, I bought a ticket to the provincial capital in the evening, and then I found a place to store my luggage.
Xu Shiyan took his father-in-law, daughter-in-law, and younger sister to find a restaurant for dinner.
Although it has only been a year, the city has changed a lot. There are many restaurants opened by individuals near the station.
Xu Shiyan picked a restaurant that looked good, led people in, and ordered four dishes.
It is not easy to drink when you are away from home, so I asked for rice directly.
The attitude of individual restaurants is naturally different. In the restaurant, the apprentice helper brought the food with a smile and brought a pot of hot water.
The four of them didn't eat anything on the way, they were all hungry. The four dishes were quite large, and they ate them all in the end.
In the final calculation, it was a bit more expensive than the state-run hotel, but it was still acceptable.
"The cooking of the food just now is average, and the price is not low.
But I see that his business is doing well, how many people do you see coming in and out? "
After eating and drinking enough to leave the restaurant, Su Weizhong chatted with Xu Shiyan while walking back.
"Well, it's convenient for him to be near the train station. Hunjiang is a big station. There are many people coming and going, so there must be a lot of people eating."
Xu Shiyan smiled, the restaurants near the station are just like that, they are all passing passengers, how many repeat customers can there be?
The amount of food is sufficient, and the taste is acceptable, so that's all. You can't ask for too much.
"I'm just too busy, otherwise, I really plan to set up a restaurant at Songjianghe Station.
Look at my farm, there are a lot of sheep.
Ewes keep their milk to make milk tofu to feed sables, rams are useless, open a mutton restaurant.
I don’t sell anything else, just mutton soup, big mutton buns, etc., and it doesn’t take much craftsmanship.
Going out in winter, how comfortable is it to have a bowl of hot mutton soup? " Xu Shiyan said with a smile as he walked.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't been recruited to participate in the field at the beginning, Xu Shiyan really planned to set up such a small shop with Su Anying at Songjianghe Railway Station.
At this time, it’s pretty good to be able to eat a meal of meat. The whole mutton restaurant must have good business.
Su Weizhong laughed as soon as he heard it, "You, what a thoughtful idea.
Isn't it so bad? There are quite a few people going back and forth at Songjianghe Railway Station, so it would be fine to open a small restaurant.
But, you two, don’t even think about it, you can’t lose your job, and Yingzi also made a big booth on the other side.
You two, just calm down, don't bother. "
No matter how much money a small restaurant makes, it can’t compare to what a farm makes. The stalls are too big to take care of, so it’s useless.
"Well, isn't that what it is? Both of us are too busy now, and we don't have time to care about those."
Xu Shiyan also laughed, he was just thinking about it all day long, the family was already busy enough, and there was no one around.
While talking, he has already returned to the station.
The train departs at six o'clock, and there are still two hours left, and it is not easy to go elsewhere, so just sit and wait at the station.
The law and order situation is relatively severe this year, and a lot of local hooligans have entered, so the train station is much quieter than before, and it is not as chaotic as before.
Although there were occasional noises, it was not a big problem. Xu Shiyan and his party were four people, and others would not dare to provoke them easily.
The train departed from Hunjiang at six o'clock. Xu Shiyan used his business trip and the letter of introduction for Xu Shiqin's treatment to find a way to buy four sleeper tickets.
The four of them rested after boarding the car, and they woke up until 7:00 the next morning, and the terminal station was Changchun.
Donggang is close to Changbai Mountain and belongs to high-altitude mountainous area. The provincial capital is a plain area with low altitude and high temperature.
So regardless of whether it was morning when I got off the car, I still felt warmer than at home.
A group of people left the train station, took the bus and got off near the University of Medical Sciences.
Still find a hotel to arrange accommodation first, then go straight to the Orthopedics Department of the Medical University Hospital, and find Chi Hao, the director of the Orthopedics Department.
"I thought you had to come in November, but I didn't expect it to be earlier." Chi Hao laughed when he saw Xu Shiyan and his sister.
Ever since Xu Shiyan met Chi Hao in the provincial capital, every time he sent something to Elder Chu, he would also send a copy to Chi Hao.
After all, they are all students of Mr. Chu. Although Xu Shiyan is not from a major, nor is he engaged in the pharmaceutical industry, he still has a little fellowship.
"Well, I came to your hospital on a business trip, so I brought my sister along along the way.
Director Chi, my sister will be handed over to you. You can see when to arrange her surgery.
I still have something to do. I have to go to your medical university and find the director of the teaching and research section to help with the test. "
Xu Shiyan's most important task when he came to the provincial capital was to test Changbai Mountain red ginseng to see whether the composition of Changbai Mountain red ginseng could be better than Korean ginseng and ordinary red ginseng.
"Oh, yes, yes, you are now the technical consultant for Fusong Yi, right?
When I met my teacher a while ago, he told me about you and praised me.
Said that you just didn't catch up with the good time, otherwise, you should not be less successful than the teacher and other students. "
When Chi Hao heard this, he suddenly remembered that Mr. Chu once said that Xu Shiyan has a job now, and he is a seventh-level technician.
"Mr. Chu is flattering me. How can I have that ability? It's just a little trick."
Xu Shiyan smiled, and didn't take Chi Hao's compliment seriously.
Since Xu Shiqin is here, he must arrange hospitalization as soon as possible and prepare for surgery.
Before the operation, a lot of examinations had to be done, so Chi Hao immediately issued an order to take Xu Shiqin to go through the hospitalization procedures.
"Daughter-in-law, I will send the things to the teaching and research office of the University of Medical Sciences first, and you will take care of this end first.
When I come back, I will find someone to arrange for my father to also have a physical examination. "
Xu Shiyan asked Su Weizhong to come to the provincial capital for this main purpose. He hadn't mentioned it to his wife before, but now he has to say it.
"Oh, okay, you can go to work without worry, I'm here."
Su Anying wasn't surprised either, she still knew her man very well, Xu Shiyan had a purpose in everything he did, and he wouldn't come up with random ideas.
There must be other reasons for Su Weizhong to come to the provincial capital because there are people in his family.
Su Weizhong fought in the army in his early years, and suffered from many problems. It is good to have a physical examination, and if something is wrong, he can be treated as soon as possible.
Xu Shiyan is quite at ease with his daughter-in-law. After more than half a year of training, his youngest daughter-in-law has grown very fast, and this little thing can't help her.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan threw those three people to the hospital, while he returned to the hotel.
The Changbai Mountain red ginseng, common red ginseng, and the Zhengguanzhuang Korean ginseng that Lin Qiyue had found from somewhere he had brought, packed them all on his back, and went straight to Bethune Medical University.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: Ginseng detection
chapters.content:
The Medical University Hospital where Xu Shiqin treats patients is the First Clinical College of Bethune Medical University, which is very close to the main campus.
Xu Shiyan, carrying a big backpack, left the hotel and went straight to the Medical University. When he reached the door, he was stopped by the guard.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly took out the letter of introduction given by his unit and showed it to the old man.
The guard saw it clearly, so he was relieved, and kindly pointed Xu Shiyan in the direction of the teaching and research office.
Xu Shiyan wandered around the medical university according to the instructions of the guard.
I have to say that this university is different. The campus covers an area of ​​more than 500,000 square meters.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't been instructed by the doorman to find it by himself, he would have been confused.
Came to the school building and found the teaching and research office. Xu Shiyan handed the letter of introduction to a staff member in charge of reception.
"Oh, this one, you have to go to our Director Song, it's in that office."
The other party read the introduction letter and pointed to an office not far away.
Xu Shiyan came to the director's office, knocked on the door, there was a voice from inside, and he opened the door and went in.
"Hello Director Song, I am an employee of Fusong No. 1 Ginseng Factory. I have been entrusted by the factory to send ginseng samples and data. I would like to ask the Medical University to help me with testing."
Xu Shiyan said while handing over the letter of introduction.
"Oh, I know, I know, the leaders of your county have already called.
It is said that Changbaishan red ginseng was successfully trial-produced, let us help to test the content of ingredients, right? "
Director Song was very polite, and took over the letter of introduction, as well as the stack of documents.
Xu Shiyan quickly opened the backpack and took out various samples from it, each with a label on it.
"Then trouble Director Song, the test fee will be transferred to the account of the teaching and research section."
This kind of test is definitely not free, but Xu Shiyan will not be allowed to bring money, all of which are paid directly to the public account.
Xu Shiyan's role is to carry things on his back, wait for the test results to come out, and then bring the documents back.
This was something that had been arranged in advance, and Director Song didn't say anything else.
Put all the samples and data in a small cabinet, and then tell Xu Shiyan that it will take about four or five days for the results to come out, and ask Xu Shiyan to wait patiently.
The family was very busy, and Xu Shiyan didn't want to disturb him, so he left and went back to the hospital.
At this time, under the guidance of the doctor, Su Anying had already gone through the hospitalization procedures for Xu Shiqin, and accompanied Xu Shiqin for examinations everywhere.
Xu Shiyan saw that he was not needed here, so he simply led Su Weizhong, called the internal medicine department, and asked a doctor to check Su Weizhong's body.
At first, Su Weizhong thought he was doing some formalities for Xu Shiqin.
As a result, when he went to the internal medicine department, Su Weizhong was stunned when Xu Shiyan told him to see a doctor, and hurriedly dragged Xu Shiyan to go out.
"Shi Yan, what's the matter? Didn't we accompany your sister to the hospital for surgery? Why are you still giving me a physical examination?"
"Father, you are old and not in good health. Isn't this just a chance? Let the doctor check you up.
If something is wrong, let's fix it quickly. "Xu Shiyan smiled and pushed his father-in-law down on the chair, and turned to talk to the doctor.
"Doctor, please, give my father a full-body examination. We will do everything we can do today. If we can't, we will do it again tomorrow morning on an empty stomach."
For things like liver function and kidney function, you have to draw blood on an empty stomach, so you can’t do it today.
But you can open an order to pay the fee first, and come directly to the blood test tomorrow morning on an empty stomach.
"No, no, Shiyan, you heard from daddy that nothing happened to daddy, it's fine.
You don't waste that money. It will cost a lot of money for us to come out. I'm fine, what are you going to check for me? "
When Su Weizhong heard that he had done all the projects he could do, he was so frightened that he had to stand up and go out again.
"Father, just listen to me, it doesn't cost much to have a physical examination.
At your age, it is best to check every year.
In our small place over there, there are quite a lot of inspections that cannot be done. It is a rare visit, and everything that needs to be checked will be checked. Yingzi and I are also at ease. "
Xu Shiyan pressed Su Weizhong back on the chair with force.
"Uncle, look at how filial your son is, and he brought you here for a physical examination.
Oh, let’s check it, it won’t cost you much, if you’re fine after the check, don’t you feel relieved? "
A few more patients came in later. Seeing this, they all smiled and persuaded Su Weizhong.
When Su Weizhong heard that Xu Shiyan was his son, he felt so beautiful in his heart, and forgot about leaving.
"Hey, this is not a son, this is my uncle."
"Grandpa, ah, brother, you are so lucky to have such a filial son-in-law who even brought you here for a physical examination.
Then why don't you readily agree? Such a filial son-in-law is hard to find. "
The people next to him heard it, and they all praised Shiyan for his filial piety.
Xu Shiyan didn't feel much about it yet, but Su Weizhong was praised by others, and he couldn't close his mouth.
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to ask the doctor to prescribe all the items that could be checked, and then went downstairs to pay the fee and stamp it, and took Su Weizhong to check everywhere.
Hematology and urine routine, heart, lung, liver, kidney, bladder, all undergo ultrasound examination, and then do an electrocardiogram or something.
Anyway, everything that can be checked by the internal medicine department has been checked, mainly the kidneys and urinary system.
"Father, it's tomorrow morning, don't eat, let's come early to draw blood and test liver and kidney function."
After all these inspections, Xu Shiyan supported Su Wei to rest on the bench outside, and he went to wait for the inspection results.
Take the test results and go back to Su Anying, where Xu Shiqin's tests are almost done.
Xu Shiyan approached Chi Hao, "Director Chi, how is my sister's physical condition? When can I have surgery?
I can stay in the provincial capital for four or five days, can I arrange surgery earlier? "
Chi Hao was watching Xu Shiqin's inspection film, and when he saw Xu Shiyan coming in, he laughed.
"Very good, the recovery is quite good.
In this way, let your sister rest and adjust today and tomorrow, and have surgery in the morning of the day after tomorrow, how about it? "
This operation is to remove the screws and nail rods placed in the body. This does not require any expert consultation, Chi Hao can arrange the operation directly.
"That's great, thank you Director Chi.
If there is nothing to do today, can I take her to Chu's hometown? Take her back to the hospital tonight. "
It would be best if the operation could be performed as soon as possible, and Xu Shiyan can also take care of him here for two days.
Otherwise, the operation will be performed after he is gone. I am afraid that Su Anying has never seen that scene, and she is so flustered that she loses the charter.
"Yes, there is no needle today, you can go out and come back at night."
Chi Hao nodded, Xu Shiqin is in good condition now, and doesn't need any more injections.
Hospitalization is for the convenience of examination and arranging surgery, nothing else, no special care is required before surgery, and there is no delay in going out and wandering around.
"Okay, then thank you Director Chi."
With Chi Hao's permission, Xu Shiyan was relieved, so he went back to the ward and found Xu Shiqin and others.
"Before it's still early, let's go to Mr. Chu's place first. Director Chi said that he will arrange your operation the day after tomorrow. It happens that I still have a few days to accompany you."

chapters.title: Chapter 305: Sell ​​Clivia
chapters.content:
Xu Shiyan led his father-in-law, daughter-in-law, and younger sister, and brought a lot of mushrooms, fungus, dried vegetables, etc.
Went to the store to buy some milk powder, canned food, etc., and went to Mr. Chu’s place together.
Old Chu had been sent to Daying for more than eight years, and he knew Su Weizhong very well, so he was naturally very happy to see his old friend.
Everyone sat with Mr. Chu for a while. Originally, Mr. Chu wanted to keep Xu Shiyan and the others here for lunch, but Xu Shiyan refused.
They came suddenly, and the nanny couldn't prepare in advance, so they left a temporary meal, which caused trouble for others.
Xu Shiyan said that he would stay in the provincial capital for a few days and come back when he has time.
At noon, the four of them ate outside.
In the afternoon, Su Weizhong went back to the hotel to rest. Xu Shiyan took Su Anying and Xu Shiqin to the store to buy some things needed for hospitalization.
Xu Shiyan asked Chi Hao about it, and said that after the operation this time, he will be discharged from the hospital for about 20 days and go home to recuperate.
In this case, it is not worth renting a house, and it is better to live in a hotel, which saves trouble.
In the evening, Xu Shiyan accompanied Xu Shiqin in the hospital, while Su Anying and Su Weizhong lived in the hotel.
Early the next morning, Su Anying led Su Weizhong to the hospital. Xu Shiyan found the doctor on duty, drew Su Weizhong's blood, and sent it to the laboratory.
The results won't be available until ten o'clock in the morning, so there's no need to wait here.
The four of them went out for breakfast together, and then Xu Shian arranged for Su Weizhong to go back to rest, while he bought some things and went to see Uncle Zhang.
Coincidentally, Uncle Zhang has not gone to the park to play chess yet, and is preparing to leave at home.
Seeing Xu Shiyan coming in carrying things, Uncle Zhang and Aunt Zhang were quite surprised.
"Hey, it's Xiao Xu, when did you come to the provincial capital? Come on, come in, come in." Uncle Zhang warmly greeted Xu Shiyan to come in and sit down.
"I arrived yesterday morning, it's not that my younger sister has just settled down for hospitalization, and I came to visit my uncle and aunt this morning.
This is something I just bought casually, don't dislike it, both of you. "Xu Shiyan followed into the room and put the things on the table.
"Oh, look at you, just come here, what else do you bring?
How long can you live in the provincial capital this time? Westinghouse still can't live? If you want to live, I will ask your aunt to clean up quickly. "
When Uncle Zhang saw those things, he couldn't help being polite.
"Master, I can't stay long this time, I have to go back in three to five days.
My daughter-in-law and husband-in-law came together, and my sister doesn’t have to stay in the hospital for a long time for this surgery, so I won’t live in your house. "
Xu Shiyan explained with a smile while looking at Uncle Zhang's house.
For a year, Uncle Zhang’s house basically remained the same. The only thing that changed was the addition of a pot of Clivia on the windowsill.
"Yo, sir, you found another pot of Clivia? What kind of species is this? Is it expensive?"
Xu Shiyan glanced at the appearance of the Clivia, and it seemed that it was not a special species.
"Expensive, so why not expensive? This pot, let me tell you, costs more than 700 yuan.
I bought this at the beginning of spring, and now you look at it, it is more expensive.
The price of Clivia this year has increased a lot compared to last year. Looking at the situation, I guess it will still increase. "
When Clivia was mentioned, Uncle Zhang couldn't help grinning.
Bought it at the beginning of spring, and now someone bids a pot of 1,000 yuan, but he is not willing to sell it.
Looking at this situation, it still has to go up. How can you make money if you sell it?
"Master, that's what happened. I came back with two pots of Clivia.
You also know that my sister’s operation cost a lot of money, so I was thinking of finding a place to sell it. Is there a way for you, sir? Do me a favor? "
This is the real purpose of Xu Shiyan's coming here.
If the weather was warm, there would be no need to find anyone. As soon as Xu Shiyan took Clivia to the Hongqi Road, many people offered to buy it.
But what time is it now? At the end of October, the weather turned cold, and there were not many people in those road markets.
Even if there is someone, he can go for a walk with the bare Clivia in his arms when the weather is cold? Why don't you freeze the flowers?
Xu Shiyan is not very familiar with the provincial capital, so he can only ask the locals for help.
As soon as he heard that Xu Shiyan had brought two pots of Clivia, Uncle Zhang stared.
"Two pots of Clivia? Oops, those are precious now.
Unfortunately, all the money in my hand is spent or I will buy it. "
Uncle Zhang couldn't help but sigh, the money in his hand is still too little, if he had more money, he would have accepted the flowers brought by Xu Shiyan.
"You want to sell flowers, right? I know the place, and it happens that there is nothing to do today, so I'll take you around?
I know several places, let's go. "
Uncle Zhang is a warm-hearted person, besides, he helps introduce business, and there are benefits to be gained, of course he is happy.
Just like that, Uncle Zhang followed Xu Shiyan out of the house and went to the hotel to get flowers first.
Seeing that the Clivia was packed in a flower basket with cotton wrapped around it to keep warm, Uncle Zhang nodded.
I can see that he is a careful person. Although the provincial capital is not too cold at this time, he can't be careless. If the leaves are damaged by freezing, it will be a waste of money.
At this time, there are not many stores selling Clivia in the provincial capital.
Uncle Zhang led Xu Shiyan through the streets and alleys of the city, and walked around for a long time to a courtyard.
In the yard of that house, a flower shed was set up.
Xu Shiyan looked at the flower shed and knew that it must have raised a lot of Clivia.
"Old man, are you at home? I'm here to introduce you to business." Uncle Zhang shouted as soon as he entered the door.
Then, a man came out from the flower shed. He looked to be in his fifties, wearing reading glasses and holding a small shovel for loosening soil. Needless to say, he was tending tweed.
"Old Zhang, what are you doing? Want to buy my flowers again? Let me tell you, they won't sell them.
I sold you the potted flowers in Kaichun, and I had to pay a lot of money. This time, I won’t sell it no matter what you say. "
The old man saw the person coming, his face was not very good-looking, and he waved his hand to push him out.
"Don't, I tell you, if you drive me away today, you will regret it."
Uncle Zhang was not annoyed at all, he was still smiling.
"I'm here to introduce you to business, see? This guy has two pots of flowers that he wants to sell.
do you want? Don't let me go to someone else. "As Uncle Zhang said, he made a gesture to go out.
"Wait a minute." The old man regained his energy when he heard this, and quickly called him to stop.
"What are you talking about? Someone is selling Clivia?"
The old man quickly wiped his reading glasses and looked at Xu Shiyan carefully. When he saw the flower basket Xu Shiyan was holding, his eyes lit up immediately.
"Young man, come in, let's come in and talk about it in detail." This attitude changed immediately.
Xu Shiyan hugged the flowers and followed them into the flower shed.
The flower shed in this house is not too big, and there are several flower stands inside, all of which are Clivia, and there are about sixty or seventy trees, large and small.
But it seems that they are all common varieties.
The man asked Xu Shiyan to take out all the things in the flower basket, and then he looked at the two potted flowers carefully, and couldn't help but exclaimed.
"Hey, you are a monk and a technician Huang, young man, where are you from?"
The old man knew the goods, and he recognized them at a glance. The two potted flowers that Xu Shiyan brought were not easy.

chapters.title: Chapter 306: make a deal
chapters.content:
There are many varieties of Clivia, among which Oiler, Great Victory, Monk, Technician, Painted Face, and Round Head are all rare varieties.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan doesn't know where his younger sister got it from. Among the Clivias she raises, there are several rare varieties.
It was the seeds that Xu Shiyan found from outside later, most of them were ordinary goods.
So, there is definitely a difference between genuinely liking and making money.
When going out this time, Xu Shiqin specially picked two pots of finished Clivia flowers that are not too old and are expected to bloom this winter.
I also want to test the water and see how much I can sell it for.
Monk Clivia is said to have been bred by an old monk.
The pedicel is thin, the flowers are purple-red, and the leaves are dark green. It is of great ornamental value and has a particularly strong heredity. The flowering period is 30 to 50 days. It is said that it has a great reputation among Clivia.
Technician was trained by a technician surnamed Huang, so it is also called Huang Technician.
The top of the leaf is sword-shaped, the veins are raised, and the leaf color is light. It is the parent of various flower-faced Clivia, and it is also a good product among Clivia.
Xu Shiqin also bred a few Dashengli plants, which are said to be very precious varieties.
In the past, Xu Shiyan didn't understand these things, and he didn't care too much. Isn't this for the cultivation of Clivia? I asked a lot of people.
Once after hearing the names of Da Shengli and Huang Technician, Xu Shiyan even joked with Huang Shengli, saying that Huang Shengli, the co-author, named it to raise Clivia, and there are two Clivia varieties in one name.
The old man revealed the species of Clivia in one mouthful, and at first glance, he was someone who really liked Clivia and understood Clivia.
Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard the words, "My home is quite far away, this time I came to the provincial capital to do business, and I brought two Clivia trees along the way.
Master, do you accept it? If you don't accept it, I'll find another buyer. "
"Take it, take it, of course I take it, come on, let's go into the room and talk about it."
The old man cheered up, called Xu Shiyan and Uncle Zhang into the house again, and asked his wife to boil water and make tea.
It was only now that Uncle Zhang introduced the two to each other. It turned out that the old man's surname was Hu.
"Comrade Xiao Xu, tell me, how much do you want to sell these two potted flowers?"
Uncle Hu stared at the two pots of Clivia, his eyes glistened, but he was so greedy.
"Master, you and Uncle Zhang are both familiar. You can give me a price after looking at it. If I think it's suitable, I'll sell it."
Xu Shiyan has just arrived, how do you know the current market of Clivia in the provincial capital?
Then if you open your mouth indiscriminately, what if you sell it cheap? It's better to let others bid, and he will listen to how it goes.
The more Xu Shiyan said that, the less he dared to fool the other party. After pondering for a long time, Uncle Hu finally spoke.
"Two potted flowers, I'll give you two thousand yuan, how about it?"
Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard this, "Uncle Zhang, I have to trouble you, and then lead me to wander around elsewhere."
The pot of ordinary Clivia in Uncle Zhang’s house now costs almost 1,000 yuan.
He is a breed that can be called famous, and give him a thousand? too little.
After Xu Shiyan finished speaking, he raised his leg and was about to leave. When the old man heard this, he quickly got up to stop him.
"Don't, don't, we can discuss it, we can discuss it."
Old Hutou was making a tentative bid just now, but he didn't expect that the person on the other side was also an expert. The price of 2,000 yuan didn't make him tempted.
Old Hu Tou thought about his wallet and was cruel.
"Two thousand and five, the most, this is all I have in my hand, I really can't afford any more."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "Master, don't make things difficult for you, I'll look elsewhere."
This is the first one, why worry? It has been given to two thousand and five now, maybe the next family can give even more.
Turn around first, if you can’t give such a high score elsewhere, then come back again.
Anyway, the two Clivia trees in his hands are in good condition, so I'm not afraid that no one will want them.
"Old Zhang, Lao Zhang, can you say something for me, you came here just to watch?"
Old Hu was in a hurry, so he hurried to find a helper.
"Old man, don't be in a hurry, it's okay, I will lead him first and then go for a walk elsewhere.
If someone else’s bid is higher than yours, then we won’t be able to sell it elsewhere. If someone else’s bid is not as high as yours, then it’s not too late for us to come back. "
Uncle Zhang said that on purpose.
Xu Shiyan said that this was not appropriate, but Uncle Zhang said that there was nothing wrong with it.
Before he came, Xu Shiyan told Uncle Zhang that if the price was high, he would be indispensable for the money for the seam, and Uncle Zhang would definitely help Xu Shiyan.
"Two thousand eight, two thousand eight head office, right?" The old Hutou became even more impatient when he heard it.
Others don't know, but he doesn't know? As long as these two potted flowers leave his door, it is impossible to come back.
But there are not many poor people who play with Clivia. For thousands of dollars, people are afraid that they will buy it without blinking an eye.
"Three thousand, I'll sell it for three thousand yuan, and I won't do anything less."
Xu Shiyan estimated that the price was about the same. After all, it was not yet 1984. At this time, a pot of flowers sold for 1,500 yuan, which was enough.
He didn't ask much, just enough money for Xu Shiqin's hospitalization and surgery.
It’s just two pots of flowers. I still have some at home. I’ve already brought them, so I’ll just sell them.
The old Hutou seemed a little bit embarrassed when he heard the three thousand yuan, he thought about it, and finally gritted his teeth and nodded.
"Success, three thousand is three thousand, just wait, I'll get you the money."
These two potted flowers have more than a dozen leaves, and they will bloom soon after they are obtained, and they are also rare varieties. He collected 3,000 yuan and sold them out to make money.
Of course, it is impossible to sell, and it has to be kept and cultivated.
As he spoke, the old Hutou turned and went out, probably asking his wife for money.
I just listened to the two people in the other room muttering for a long time, and then someone opened the door and went out, not many came back, and then the old beard came into the room with money.
"Three thousand yuan, you order, we pay the money and deliver the goods, and count them face to face, and you will not accept the account afterwards."
Xu Shiyan took the money, and the three bundles were all ten yuan. He counted them just right, so he put the money away.
"Deal, these two potted flowers belong to Uncle Hu.
Then let's not bother, Mr. Hu, I still have quite a few at home. When I have the opportunity to come to the provincial capital in the future, we can continue to cooperate. "
Xu Shiyan actually saw it, this person should be a second-hand dealer, whoever he is, as long as he can make money.
Old Hutou got two pots of Clivia, he was so happy that he didn't care about anything else, he quickly carried the flowers to the flower shed, and didn't go out to send Xu Shiyan and Lao Zhangtou off.
Xu Shiyan doesn't care either, as long as the money is in hand, it doesn't matter what extra etiquette is.
Coming out of the old Hutou's house, Xu Shiyan looked around and saw that there was no one in the alley, so he took out a wad of money from his pocket and stuffed it into the old Hutou.
"Master, you keep this money. If I come to the provincial capital next time, I will ask you for help."
Old Zhangtou Lehehe took the money, but put it in his pocket without counting it.
For them, they can probably know how much it is by touching the thickness.
"Success, as long as you come to the provincial capital, no matter how many potted flowers you bring, the uncle will sell them for you, and you will definitely not suffer."
In such a short period of time, I earned a hundred yuan, who would be unhappy?

chapters.title: Chapter 307: the early days
chapters.content:
The two potted flowers were sold successfully, Xu Shiyan and Uncle Zhang separated in the park, and then returned to the hospital ward.
"Little sister, daughter-in-law, I sold those two potted flowers. Guess how much they sold for?"
There were only Xu Shiqin and Su Anying in the ward, no outsiders, Xu Shiyan asked his sister-in-law to guess with a mysterious face.
Su Anying and Xu Shiqin were surprised when they heard that the two potted flowers had been sold.
"How long has it been before it's sold?"
Clivia is really so popular? no?
"How much money? A few hundred yuan?" The two of them didn't dare to guess too much.
From the two of them's minds, a few hundred is not bad, but how much is it worth even if it is a potted flower?
"No, guess more." Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head.
"One thousand? Can't it be so expensive? There are so many in our family, so it's not worth much?"
Su Anying feels that her brain is not strong enough, can two potted flowers be worth a thousand? It's kind of scary.
"Not right, less." Xu Shiyan continued to shake his head.
"Huh? One thousand is less? It can't be two thousand, right? It's too scary. How can this thing be worth so much money?"
Xu Shiqin was also a little surprised. One thousand yuan for two pots was a sky-high price in her opinion, how little? Is it a thousand per pot?
"Two potted flowers, sold for 3,000 yuan, gave the middleman 100 yuan to match, and left 2,900 yuan. Then, it's all here."
Xu Shiyan stopped playing tricks with his wife and younger sister, and directly took out the money and handed it to Xu Shiqin.
"This time, don't worry about the money for hospitalization, right?
These are more than enough for surgery and inspection, so you can wait for the surgery with peace of mind. "
Xu Shiqin was dumbfounded looking at the three thick bundles of money, two pots of flowers can sell for three thousand?
How many pots did she raise? According to this calculation, how much can it sell for?
Also, the family of the third brother and the third sister-in-law raises more. Although it is a seedling, it can be worth a lot of money.
God, why is this thing so valuable?
"Brother, you didn't pay for it out of your own pocket to comfort me, did you?" Xu Shiqin couldn't believe it, feeling that it was too much.
"Tch, your brother is only so promising, why would he lie to you for three thousand dollars?
This is really money for selling flowers, so take it with confidence, eat what you want, drink what you want, the most important thing is to nourish your body.
You are now a rich man. Next fall, let’s find an excuse to ask for leave and sell all the flowers at home.
At that time, you will have money. "Xu Shiyan pouted, has he gotten to this point? Being questioned by his own sister?
Xu Shiqin was a little embarrassed by what his brother said, "Brother, I don't doubt you, I really can't believe it."
While talking, Xu Shiqin handed the money to Su Anying.
"Sister-in-law three, you keep the money. You have to run around even when I'm in the hospital, so I put it in your place for peace of mind.
You can spend whatever you like, now that we have money, don’t be afraid. "
Sure enough, he was rich and powerful. Now, Xu Shiqin felt that his back was much straighter.
Hey, it feels so good to be rich.
Both the couple were amused by Xu Shiqin's appearance, Su Anying didn't refuse, and quickly collected the money.
Xu Shiyan saw that it was getting late, and it was almost time for the test results to come out.
So I told my wife, turned around and left the ward, ran to the laboratory in the outpatient building, and got the test results.
Then I went to the internal medicine department to find a doctor, and showed them all the checklists from yesterday and today.
After reading the checklist, the doctor frowned slightly, "Where's the patient? Why didn't he come?"
The information about Su Weizhong was written on the list, which didn't match Xu Shiyan, so the doctor asked.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard this, he knew that something might not be right.
"I'm resting at the hotel, I'll go find him right away."
Originally, Xu Shiyan thought to come over to ask about the situation first. If there is nothing wrong with the inspection, there is no need to alarm Su Weizhong.
But seeing a doctor like this, it is estimated that the situation is not right.
The doctor nodded, and handed the stack of inspection documents to Xu Shiyan, Xu Shiyan took it, and hurried back to the hotel to find Su Weizhong.
Then, the two returned to the outpatient clinic again to find the doctor.
Facing the checklist, the doctor asked Su Weizhong some physical conditions, and checked Su Weizhong's blood pressure.
"According to the results of the examination, the urine routine test is abnormal, hematuria.
Kidney function tests showed that creatinine and blood urea nitrogen were within the normal range, and no obvious abnormalities were seen in renal ultrasound. "
The doctor took the receipt and explained it to Su Weizhong and Xu Shiyan.
Hearing the doctor's words, Su Weizhong was obviously relieved.
He didn't understand, so he felt that several items were normal, so it was nothing wrong.
At this moment, Su Weizhong began to feel sorry for money.
I told you a long time ago that there is nothing wrong with him, which is great. Blood was drawn and checked, which cost a lot of money.
Contrary to Su Weizhong, Xu Shiyan feels that the situation may not be optimistic.
In his previous life, Su Weizhong died of kidney disease. Before he left, he was hospitalized in Fusong, and Xu Shiyan went to bed with him to take care of him for a long time.
The doctor said at that time that Su Weizhong's disease should be the gradual development of chronic glomerulonephritis, and finally renal failure. This will never be wrong.
It is now 1983, and there are only four years left in 1987.
If it is chronic glomerulonephritis, there are no symptoms at the initial stage, only abnormal urine routine.
There are no obvious abnormalities in renal function and renal ultrasound. Waiting for abnormalities to be found, it will be in the middle and late stage.
"However, I checked my blood pressure just now, and through the consultation, I occasionally have swollen eyelids in the morning.
Reasonable suspicion, it may be the early stage of chronic glomerulonephritis. "The doctor continued, and it was exactly as Xu Shiyan inferred.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help sighing when he heard this.
"Doctor, please ask, if it is chronic glomerulonephritis, it should be in the early stage, right? Is there any effective way to treat it?"
This disease is actually very difficult to cure and can only be controlled with drugs. The ideal situation is to maintain a stable state and not continue to develop.
Thanks to the early detection, the effect will be better with active treatment.
Just as the doctor was about to speak, Su Weizhong over there spoke first, "What treatment?
Am I not doing well? There is nothing wrong with it, so don't spend more money than necessary. "
Su Weizhong is still old-fashioned. He is not in pain or itching now. There is nothing wrong with him. It is a waste to check the body, so why should he treat it?
Xu Shiyan sighed, "Father, don't worry, just listen to what the doctor has to say.
Since we have come to the hospital, we have to trust others. It doesn’t matter if you are sick. Early detection and early treatment will cost less and you will suffer less.
If the condition is really serious, it will be too late to regret.
You said that the five and six in our family are not married yet, so you have to watch them go out? "
In his previous life, Su Weizhong couldn't wait for the two daughters to get married. Before he left, he regretted that too many things were delayed because of his illness.
Su Weizhong choked on his son-in-law's words, and didn't know what to say.
It was the doctor, who was quite satisfied with Xu Shiyan's attitude, and continued to explain.
"You are right. With early detection and early treatment, the disease can still be controlled.
If you don't hurry up and treat, once the disease gets worse after a long delay, it will be difficult to treat.
It may eventually lead to serious consequences such as renal failure and uremia, so it should not be taken lightly. "

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Test results
chapters.content:
Su Weizhong always felt that it cost too much to see a doctor.
It was agreed that he would come to accompany his daughter, but instead he came for a checkup and treatment, and he had to ask my uncle to pay for it, and he felt very sorry.
But what the doctor said, he was also a little scared.
It’s not that I’m afraid of death, but mainly because I’m afraid that if I get seriously ill, I’ll spend a lot of money and drag others down, which is not good.
"Then, how can I cure my problem?"
Finally, Su Weizhong was persuaded and asked hesitantly.
"It's the initial stage, and the condition is not serious. After a period of injection, I will prescribe some medicine for you to go back to take.
Then I usually pay more attention to my diet and so on, so I can control it. "The doctor patiently explained to Su Weizhong.
"Ah, that's injections and medicine, so you don't need to be hospitalized?"
Su Weizhong heaved a sigh of relief when he heard this.
He wasn't afraid of injections or anything else, but he was mainly worried about hospitalization, spending too much money and delaying things.
If he also has to be hospitalized, who will my daughter take care of? Running on both sides, must his daughter be exhausted?
The doctor understood Su Weizhong's meaning and couldn't help smiling.
"Well, you don't need to be hospitalized, I will prescribe you injections for seven days, and you can go to the outpatient injection room for injections every morning and afternoon.
Wait for the seven-day injection, do an examination to see how the situation is, and then decide on the next step of treatment. "
"Okay, the doctor will trouble you and prescribe medicine."
Su Weizhong and Su Anying had to stay with Xu Shiqin in the hospital for at least 20 days, and it happened that nothing was delayed.
This is why Xu Shiyan tried every means to trick his father-in-law into the provincial capital, just to take the opportunity to treat his father-in-law.
Waiting for Clivia to be sold next year, and then the second child will also be inspected.
Although looking at it now, the second child is nothing like a live donkey, and the time of illness in the previous life has long passed, so it is also safe to check.
Xu Shiyan secretly made a decision in his heart. Parents should also find time for them to come for a checkup. Prevention in advance is easier than treatment after a real illness.
Just like that, the doctor gave Su Weizhong an injection for seven days, and Xu Shiyan went down to pay for the medicine.
Then accompanied Su Weizhong to the outpatient injection room for injections, and gave all the remaining medicine to the nurse.
The nurse made a record in the notebook, labeled the medicine, put it in the cabinet in the treatment room, and injected Su Weizhong according to the list every day.
Unless it is a major operation these days, the use of hanging bottles is very rare, and most of them are small injections.
Su Weizhong is no exception, just take a shot after mixing the medicine.
Muscle acupuncture is actually quite a pain, it hurts, but fortunately, Mr. Su Weizhong, the pain is not a big deal.
Su Weizhong checked his body and prescribed medicine. Xu Shiyan was relieved of his heart disease.
Another day, at 8:30 am on the 21st, Xu Shiqin under general anesthesia was pushed into the operating room.
Xu Shiyan, his wife, and Su Weizhong were waiting anxiously outside the operating room.
Three hours later, the lights in the operating room were turned off, the door was opened, and Chi Hao and several doctors came out.
"The operation was very successful. All the screws and nail rods in the body have been removed. After a good rest, I can be discharged from the hospital and go home in about 20 days."
Hearing that the operation was successful, Xu Shiyan and others were relieved. When Xu Shiqin was pushed out of the operating room, the three hurried forward and helped push him back to the ward.
With Su Anying here this time, there is no need to ask someone to take care of her.
Su Anying takes care of her sister-in-law very attentively. She doesn't dislike changing clothes, wiping her body, pooping and urinating at all.
On the 24th, Xu Shiyan went to the teaching and research office of Bethune Medical University again.
When Director Song saw him, he immediately took out a stack of documents from the cabinet.
"After our test and analysis, Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng contains total ginsenosides, diol type saponins Rb, Rd, total amino acids, essential amino acids that cannot be synthesized by the human body, ginseng polysaccharides, volatile oils, anti-aging maltol, and anti-cancer substances. The content of Rh2 is significantly higher than that of Korean ginseng.
The content of toxic substances arsenic and organic chlorine is lower than the limit stipulated by Korean ginseng and national pharmacopoeia. "
Director Song pointed to the data on the appraisal report and explained it to Xu Shiyan.
Changbai Mountain red ginseng is researched according to the transformation of chemical components in plants at different temperatures and the principle of different properties of dry matter.
Ordinary red ginseng undergoes secondary processing, which can transform the chemical components inside the ginseng again.
Moreover, Changbai Mountain red ginseng is made with excellent craftsmanship, which is better than Korean ginseng, and its active ingredients are also better than Korean ginseng.
Through scientific testing and identification, Changbai Mountain red ginseng is superior to Korean ginseng in terms of composition and technology.
That is to say, Xu Shiyan and the others succeeded, and they really developed Changbaishan red ginseng.
"congratulations.
I know that you have spent time and effort for this research, and now you have finally succeeded, which is gratifying. "
Director Song repacked the documents into the bag, sealed it, and handed the file bag to Xu Shiyan.
"Keep it safe, take it back quickly, I will also send a report to the province, your city and county."
Seeing that Xu Shiyan was still in a daze, Director Song thought Xu Shiyan was too excited, so he smiled and patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder as encouragement.
Xu Shiyan took the document bag and put it in his bag, thanked Director Song, and left with the bag on his back.
Go out to find the post office, make a phone call to the venue first, tell Secretary Lin the test result, and make Secretary Lin happy.
"Really? That's great. This time we succeeded in developing it first, faster than the county. That's great.
Xiao Xu, hurry up and buy a ticket and come back. When you come back, we will participate in the celebration meeting for your technical team. You are the first. "
Secretary Lin was overjoyed to learn that Changbaishan red ginseng was successfully developed, and the appraisal results were superior to Korean ginseng in all aspects.
Let Xu Shiyan take the time to go back and come back to hold a celebration party.
Xu Shiyan came to the provincial capital for ginseng testing. Now that the identification results came out, he had to go back quickly regardless of whether there was a celebration party or not.
So I went to the train station and bought a ticket for the afternoon of the 25th.
Then, taking advantage of the time, Xu Shiyan went to see Elder Chu again, and also met with Qi Yunsheng, and gave Qi Yunsheng the things.
On the evening of the 24th, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying accompanied Xu Shiqin in the ward.
Xu Shiyan wanted to go home early, so he had to ask his wife.
"I see that Shiqin's condition is okay, so you just take care of it.
Our father’s injection will be finished in two days. Remember to urge our father to do a test, which is blood and urine routine. It’s not a laborious test, and it doesn’t cost much.
After checking the results, if it doesn’t work, you can get another seven days of injections.
Ask the doctor to prescribe oral medicine for a period of time, and it happens that our father is here, so you watch him take it every day.
Before Shiqin is discharged from the hospital, I will go for another test, and then listen to the doctor's arrangement, it is best to get some medicine or something. "
What Xu Shiyan is most worried about is his sister and father-in-law. Before leaving, he must talk about it more.
"Thank you for your hard work, but there is really nothing you can do. There is a whole lot of waiting at home. I will make delicious food for you when I go back, and I will serve you."
Xu Shiyan held his daughter-in-law's hand, speaking with distress and guilt.
"Okay, this is what you said, I will wait for you to serve me."
Su Anying pursed her lips happily, deliberately joking with Xu Shiyan.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: buy books
chapters.content:
On the morning of the 25th, Xu Shiyan went to the Xinhua Bookstore and bought some books for himself and for his son.
There are not too many books suitable for children to read these days, that is, some comic books, commonly known as comic books.
The more classic ones are of course "Journey to the West" and "Romance of the Three Kingdoms".
"Hello comrade, I would like to ask, besides these, are there any other books suitable for children?
For example, "Story King" or something, do we have it here? "
Xu Shiyan doesn't know much about these things, he just heard about them by accident in his previous life.
He didn't know when this book started to exist, so he could only ask others.
""The King of Stories"? I haven't heard of it. I have only heard of "Youth Literature and Art". I have a few copies here. Do you want to read it?"
The salesperson of the bookstore dug out some magazines from the side shelf, found a few of them, and handed them to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan took it and flipped through it. The content inside was pretty good, but unfortunately it was all a long time ago.
"Is there any more? If so, I can buy a few more."
The content here is quite suitable for children, and Xu Shiyan thinks his son will like it. But there are only a few books, too few.
"No, this only sold a few issues in our generation.
You can go to the post office to inquire, or you can write to this address to order the magazine. "
The salesperson's attitude was good, and he even gave Xu Shiyan instructions on how to buy.
"Oh, thank you, thank you, thank you so much, then I will buy all these books.
By the way, is there a book called "One Hundred Thousand Whys"? Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered, as if this was also for children.
The salesperson nodded, found a set of "One Hundred Thousand Whys" and handed it to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan also looked through them all, and after confirming that they were all right, he asked the salesperson to issue an invoice, and he bought all the books he had just picked out.
Xu Shiyan bought a lot of books, and the salesperson was okay. While Xu Shiyan went to pay the money, he found a piece of old kraft paper.
