When Xu Shiyan came back, the two of them wrapped all the books tightly in kraft paper and tied them with nylon rope.
Xu Shiyan just carried a big paper bag, left the bookstore and returned to the hotel.
At noon, Xu Shiyan bought a meal for his wife and younger sister.
I went out to dinner with Su Weizhong again, so I had to tell Su Weizhong to insist on treatment.
Su Weizhong saw that his son-in-law was so attentive, how could he have the nerve to say anything else?
I just agreed, and I will definitely cooperate with the doctor and treat with peace of mind.
After lunch, Xu Shiyan took the bus to the train station with his things.
At around three o'clock in the afternoon, the train entered the station, Xu Shiyan checked his ticket and boarded the train, and set off to return to Songjianghe.
When I got home on the afternoon of the 26th, I didn’t care about what to say to my parents. I threw all my miscellaneous things at home, and rode my bike to the venue.
"Secretary Lin, this is the appraisal certificate personally issued by Director Song of the Teaching and Research Office of the University of Medical Sciences. These are the inspection reports."
Xu Shiyan went directly to Secretary Lin's office and handed over the document bag in his backpack to Secretary Lin.
"Okay, okay, great, oh, Xiao Xu, you've done a great job this time."
Secretary Lin took out the certificate of appraisal and looked at the bright red seals on it, which made Secretary Lin very happy.
He carefully packed all the materials, got up and locked them in the cabinet behind.
With this appraisal report, the Changbaishan red ginseng of Donglin brand can be officially put into production.
In the future, Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng of Donglin brand will become a business card of a ginseng market or even Fusong, and its value is immeasurable.
"You are tired enough to go out, I approve you a day off, you don't have to go to work tomorrow, go home and have a good rest.
Go to work the day after tomorrow, and we still have a lot of work to do. After the site is over, there will be a celebration party for you. "
Secretary Lin was overjoyed, and granted Xu Shiyan a vacation, and asked Xu Shiyan to go home and rest.
"Thank you Secretary Lin, then I will go home first."
Going out these days, I don’t know what’s going on at home, so I have to go back and have a look.
As for the holiday, he will go to Huang Shengli and the others later to see who has time tomorrow and help him plant the ginseng.
Holiday? There is still so much work to be done, how can there be any holidays?
Just like that, Xu Shiyan hurriedly rode to his parents' side of the bike again, and told his parents about Xu Shiqin's situation.
"Father, Mom, don't worry, the younger sister is fine, the operation was quite successful.
When I left, I couldn’t get off the ground, but I was in good shape.
Yingzi also served attentively, and the little girl came back after a while. "
Hearing what their son said, the old couple finally breathed a sigh of relief, "That's good, that's good, thank you for your hard work.
It’s really interesting to be a brother-in-law and sister-in-law. If Shiqin dares to forget the kindness of brother-in-law in the future, I don’t need you to tell me, I will clean her up first. "Xu Chenghou said harshly.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard the words, "No need, Dad, Yingzi and I did this not to repay anyone.
The sixth child is my own sister, no matter what happens, I can't watch her be like that for the rest of my life.
How good is it now? The hunchback was cured and a nice man was found.
After the operation this time, she will be able to get married after recuperating for about half a year. At that time, she will discuss with the Han family and marry her off in a good manner.
Live well with Liwei and the two of them in the future, and having another child, wouldn't this life be complete? "
From the bottom of his heart, Xu Shiyan is very satisfied with this result.
It should be said that through his efforts, the fate of the little sister has been completely changed.
Xu Shiqin is in good health, and will not be tortured by illness for the rest of his life. Marrying Han Liwei, as long as Han Liwei is fine, the two of them will definitely have a good life in the future.
In the future, the two will have a child and have a happy life, which is very good.
Xu Shiyan reminded himself again in his heart that Han Liwei must come back to get married around April next year.
At that time, Han Liwei should not have been rotated to the southwest. No matter what, Han Liwei had to be stopped, and he must not be allowed to go there.
"By the way, father and mother, guess how much the two potted flowers I brought sold for?"
Xu Shiyan didn't want to talk about kindness or not, so he changed the subject and started talking about Clivia.
Even Xu Shiqin and Su Anying couldn't guess the price, let alone the old couple.
The two of them guessed in Dali, and at most they guessed a thousand dollars.
Then both of them think it’s unbelievable enough, two pots of flowers sell for a thousand dollars?
Their house is only worth 2,000 yuan now, and two pots of flowers can catch up with two and a half houses? Are you kidding me?
"You two guessed too little. Two pots of flowers sold for 3,000 yuan." Xu Shiyan made a three-point comparison with his fingers.
"Huh? Three thousand?" Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan shouted in unison.
In the world of the old couple, three thousand yuan is a lot of money for the boss. Anyway, they have never had three thousand yuan in their hands.
Before it was good enough to save more than a thousand, it was saved for several years.
Three thousand yuan? My God, the two potted flowers have caught up with the five big tile-roofed houses in his house, isn't this just a joke?
The old couple looked at the flowers on the window sill, and were dumbfounded. If they were all sold, how much would they cost?
"Third brother, when will you sell these at home too.
Oh my God, I was terrified when I saw these flowers.
You said that if it is not well maintained, or someone steals it, I should feel sorry for it? "

chapters.title: Chapter 310: tin toys
chapters.content:
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard his mother's words, "Mom, don't worry, as long as you and my father don't go out and talk about it, no one here should know how much Clivia sells for."
Donggang is remote, and many people spend their whole lives wandering around Songjiang River in Donggang. They probably have never been to the county seat, let alone the provincial capital.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't accompanied Xu Shiqin to the provincial capital for medical treatment, if he hadn't had the memory of rebirth, he wouldn't have known the value of Clivia at all, so don't worry about it.
"Next autumn, I will find a chance to go to the provincial capital again and sell all the Clivia at home."
Next summer, I will go to the provincial capital to rent a shop, preferably with a small courtyard.
Xia Tian packed it up, tried to transport the Clivia before October, took advantage of the best time to sell, made a fortune, and came back to do other things.
When the old couple heard this, they knew that their son had something in mind, so they were relieved.
Looking up while speaking, he realized that it was almost four o'clock, "Oh, it's getting late, Yuanyuan, Xiaoyu, and Pingping should be back soon.
These children shouted hungry as soon as they entered the door, so I had to clean up and cook. "
This is the case for those who are studying at home, and they have to watch the school time to prepare meals.
Otherwise, they would be like hungry wolves when they came back from school, shouting for food as soon as they entered the door.
Sister Su Anfang is still working in the processing factory, and they have to get off work at nearly five o'clock.
So Zhou Guilan handed the two little ones to Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan to watch, and she hurried to clean up and cook.
In this season, there are not many dishes that can be eaten.
Eggplants and beans are picked before the frost. The tender ones are pickled and eaten slowly, and the old ones are kept in the shade of the warehouse.
What can be eaten now is radish, cabbage, potato, sauerkraut pickled in a vat, and it has not been fermented, so it cannot be eaten.
Fortunately, I changed to a piece of tofu during the day, and there is still meat at home.
Slice the cabbage, cut the tofu into cubes, soak a handful of vermicelli, and cut some meat slices.
Saute in the pot until fragrant, add sliced ​​meat and fry, then add sliced ​​cabbage and fry until soft, add soup.
The soup is boiled, add tofu, season, simmer for a while, and put the soaked vermicelli in.
Cook the pot again, and a pot of cabbage tofu vermicelli is ready.
Wash a big radish, cut into four pieces, and then cut into slices.
Boil the water in the pot, put it in and scald it, and use a strainer to remove it and put it in cold water.
Scoop a bowl of sauce from the sauce jar, beat two eggs, put chopped green onion, and scramble an egg sauce.
Then fish out a stalk of pickled spicy cabbage in autumn from the tank, cut it into pieces and put it on the plate. These are the dishes for the evening.
The rice is also simple. There are still some steamed Lianghe noodles before, and some sorghum rice. This meal at night is enough.
Zhou Guilan was busy in the kitchen alone, while Xu Shiyan and Xu Chenghou were coaxing the children and chatting in the room.
While talking, he heard footsteps outside, needless to say, it must be that Xu Haiyuan and the others have returned.
Sure enough, shouts have already started outside, "Grandpa, grandma, we are after school, what are we going to have for dinner? We are all hungry."
Children are hungry very fast. Today's Yuhong class only focuses on educating children, but they don't care about what to eat, let alone extra meals, snacks, etc. Don't even think about it, there is no such thing.
The children stayed at school all afternoon, and they must be hungry after school, so they yelled as soon as they entered the door.
"Are you hungry? Ask your grandpa to make some milk powder or malted milk. Take a sip to fill your stomach, and the meal will be ready later." Zhou Guilan answered in the kitchen.
Milk powder and malted milk, needless to say, they must have been sent by others before.
For example, Xu Shiyan and his wife didn’t keep the things that Da Lao Li gave to Xu Shiyan before, and they divided them into two to honor their parents at both ends.
Not only the big old Li, but also the ones sent by Han Liwei, and others who came to see the old couple.
But Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were not willing to take a bite of any delicious food, nor did they give it away, and kept it all for the children to satisfy their cravings.
Xu Haiyuan slipped into the house three times, but as soon as he came in, he found that there was someone else in the house.
"Father, godfather." Seeing that it was Xu Shiyan, the three children immediately surrounded him, and they were all overjoyed when they called each other daddy.
Xu Shiyan was very happy looking at the three children, and hurriedly asked the children to put away their schoolbags, and then rummaged for them from their back pockets.
"Then, this is the toy I bought for you."
Tin clockwork frog, mouse, rooster, tank, rabbit, there are five children in the family, one for each of them, and they play with each other.
What can children of this age have to play with? Summer and mud wrestle mud dolls.
It is to squeeze the mud into the shape of a bowl, and then throw it **** the ground.
The air inside is suddenly impacted, and the bottom will burst directly, which is called falling.
The children competed in who could fall louder, the louder the harder.
In winter, it is to smoke ice, put sledges, and skates.
Binggaer is a spinning top. It is made of wood with a ball embedded in the bottom. It is pulled on the ice with a rope to see whose spinning time is longer.
It is easy to place the sledge. Every household in the Northeast has a sledge. Find a **** and lower it from the top of the **** to the bottom of the slope.
The feeling of getting up to speed fascinates the children.
Skate shoes are not the kind of professional skating shoes, but a wooden board with two No. 8 wires inlaid, and a few noses nailed, tied to the shoes with ropes, and you can slide on the ice.
In addition, the girls are also happy to play hopscotch, rubber band, and Galaha.
Boys can play hoops, slingshots, and if they have the conditions at home, they can use bicycle chains to make gunpowder guns.
Anyway, most of them don’t spend money, and they find ways to poke and play by themselves.
It is absolutely impossible for the family to spend money on toys, let alone this kind of tin clockwork toy.
Whoever takes out one of them will definitely attract the envious eyes of countless friends.
So at this moment, the children were all shocked when they saw the tin toy.
The three pairs of big eyes stared straight at the toy, and they exclaimed, "Wow, this looks good."
Anyway, I don’t know who I learned from. As long as these children see strange things, they will all wow.
"The three of you choose first, and after picking the rest, let them play.
You guys can exchange and play with each other, but it’s best not to take it out, it’s easy to lose. "Xu Shiyan has to tell the children.
Nowadays, tin clockwork toys are definitely rare.
Take it out and let other children see it. If you can’t keep it, which child is greedy and steals it, don’t even think about it, that’s for sure.
"Also, Xu Haiyuan, let me give you a formal warning.
There is a clockwork inside. It was coiled when it left the factory. If you disassemble it, the clockwork will break down, and your father and I can’t fix it.
You can figure it out. Anyway, if you dismantle it, I don’t care if it doesn’t fit.
Moreover, it is not allowed to play with younger sister and younger brother. "Xu Shiyan looked at his eldest son and warned with a sneer.
Based on Xu Shiyan's understanding of his family's eldest son, this baby's hands are too short, and he can't guarantee that one day he will be curious and really take apart the frog.
Just in case, you have to get a vaccination in advance, otherwise, Xu Shiyan will have a headache again.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: good homework
chapters.content:
Xu Haiyuan looked at the frog that could jump up and down after being winded up, and was curious about what was in it.
As a result, my father saw through his thoughts, and immediately squeezed his eyes mischievously, stuck out his tongue, and laughed.
"Dad, I won't take it apart, don't worry."
"Tch, I don't know about your two moves? Anyway, you take it easy and play, if you break it, it will be fine."
Xu Shiyan curled his lips. Considering the fighting power of his eldest son, I can't guarantee when the tin frog will be divided into five horses.
"By the way, I also bought a lot of books for you, from now on, stop being naughty and lead your sister to read more."
Xu Shiyan pointed to the kraft paper bag in the corner over there, which was full of books and hadn't been opened yet.
"Really? Thanks Dad."
Xu Haiyuan was pleasantly surprised when he heard that he had bought a book for him, and hurriedly said thank you to his father.
I'm afraid that my father will be unhappy in a while and won't give him the book.
"Okay, hurry up and do your homework.
Pingping Xiaoyu, you two have no homework, right? Then you two coax your younger siblings to play. "
Primary school students in the first grade also have homework, but less.
Parents these days are busy, working from dawn to dusk, no one is watching their children doing their homework, everything depends on self-consciousness.
The children go to play after finishing their homework, and the family members don’t check. At most, they ask, have you finished your homework?
If the child wants to say that he has finished writing, then that's fine, don't worry about it.
Xu Haiyuan is okay, she does her homework every day when she gets home, and after finishing her homework, she will tell the adults at home, and then go to coax her younger siblings to play.
Of course, if Xu Haiyuan coaxes the children, that’s not coaxing.
Xu Chenghou is dexterous and a carpenter.
In order for the grandson to have a place to do his homework when he came home, he specially nailed two sets of tables and chairs, one here and one at Xu Shiyan's house.
The desks and chairs are the same as those in the school, and Xu Haiyuan sits just right.
While speaking, Xu Chenghou had already poured a teacup of milk powder into a large teacup, pouring each child a cup.
"Hurry up, drink something quickly, pad your stomach, and your milk will prepare the meal in a while."
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui don’t need feeding bottles anymore, they can hold their cups and drink slowly.
Xu Chenghou was afraid that the two of them drank too much and would affect their meals, so he poured half a glass for them. The three of them were too big, and they all had a glass.
Xu Haiyuan drank it three times, and finished it in a few sips.
Then wiped his mouth, Xu Haiyuan went to do his homework, Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu went to the kang and led the two little ones, poking the tin toy.
Seeing the rabbit and the rooster bouncing around, the two little guys clapped their hands happily.
Xu Shiyan took advantage of his son's homework time, secretly stood behind his son, and glanced at his son's homework.
Well, it’s okay, the writing is quite straight, and the book is clean, there is no scribbles, every page is very smooth, there are no corners or creases.
It’s not like some children who are studying a book. It’s only halfway through a semester.
Not to mention the homework, it can be kneaded like a rotten vegetable leaf.
Xu Shiyan remembers hearing people say that one can tell whether a child is studying well or not by looking at his eraser.
If the eraser is poked with holes all over it, or broken into small pieces, the child will definitely not listen well in class and will just play there.
Xu Haiyuan's eraser, except for the frayed corners, is in good condition, without a single eye.
Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head, his son really has nothing wrong with him except being naughty.
It’s okay, it’s just a naughty age, how can you be as old-fashioned as an adult?
People say that boys are smart, girls are clever, and naughty children are promising.
Xu Shiyan stood behind Xu Haiyuan for a long time, but Xu Haiyuan didn't notice, he just focused on doing his homework.
It’s been more than two months since I started school, and I’m pretty good at Pinyin, I’m starting to write Chinese characters, and I’m starting to write calculations in mathematics.
Xu Shiyan looked at it, Pinyin, Pinyin matts, matts, each one has an article.
It took Xu Haiyuan about half an hour to write from the beginning to the end, and the words were quite straight.
Xu Haiyuan wrote mathematics at the end, and he finished all the questions.
The books and homework were closed, and they were about to put them in their schoolbags when they turned around and saw Xu Shiyan.
"Dad? Why are you standing here?" Xu Haiyuan was taken aback.
"It's okay, let's see how your homework is written? It's pretty good, and I'll keep it up in the future."
It's really good for a six-year-old child to be able to write homework to this extent. Xu Shiyan was very happy, and raised his hand to rub the top of his son's head.
Xu Haiyuan was very happy to be praised by his father, but he still tried his best to keep his face tight and nodded seriously. "Got it, Dad."
Seeing the child pretending to be steady, Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing, this baby is so fun every day.
"Okay, go wash your hands, I guess it's time to eat later."
As soon as he finished speaking, he heard movement outside, and then Su Anfang and Su Anhua came in. They were working in the processing factory before they got off work.
"Second brother-in-law, are you back? How is sister Qin? Did the operation go well?"
The two of them saw Xu Shiyan as soon as they entered the room, and hurriedly asked.
"Very good, the operation was successful, and I guess I will be back in half a month." Xu Shiyan nodded.
When they heard that the operation was a success, the two sisters were also very happy.
I don't have time to say anything else right now, so I hurried to wash my hands and help Zhou Guilan with work.
Not long after, the food was prepared and brought into the house, and the children were called to come over for dinner.
Cabbage tofu vermicelli, children each serve a bowl, and half a pancake.
Eating pancakes and vegetables, even soup and water is very comfortable.
The rest is served in a small straw hat basin, and the adults don’t need a bowl, they can eat whatever they want.
After the radish is scalded with boiling water, the spicy air is removed, it is a bit sweet, and it is delicious when dipped in egg sauce.
Spicy cabbage is to choose Chinese cabbage with a relatively full heart, cut into four petals, first sprinkle with salt to remove excess water, and then smear the special spicy sauce on the inside of the leaves.
The hot sauce is also homemade, red pepper, onion, garlic in autumn, and some apples, pears, and hawthorn can be added if possible.
Add salt and sugar, chop them together, carefully spread on each leaf of cabbage, and put it in a jar to seal and ferment.
Fermented spicy cabbage, salty and spicy, slightly sour, and a little fruity, it is most appetizing and delicious.
This spicy cabbage was learned from others when I was in Daying.
It's just that the past few years have been bad, and I'm not in the mood to toss about it.
Now that the family is doing better, sugar and other things can be bought, Zhou Guilan picked up this craft again, making a jar of spicy cabbage in autumn, and saving it to eat slowly.
Most of the dining tables of Northeast people are like this, stews, sauces, pickles, pickles, these are enough, and there is no need to make too many bells and whistles.
Put a bowl of sorghum rice, cover it with a spoonful of cabbage and tofu vermicelli, and then add some pickled vegetables and miso. This meal will make your stomach round.
"The food at home is still delicious, and those made outside can't keep up with my mother's craftsmanship."
Xu Shiyan was almost full, put down his chopsticks contentedly, and smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Ginseng
chapters.content:
After dinner, Xu Shiyan went to find Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Huang Shengli and others, and discussed asking them to help him plant ginseng.
Zhao Jianshe and the others estimated that Xu Shiyan would be back soon, and they had already finished their work at home, and they were just waiting for Xu Shiyan to come back.
"Third brother, if you don't come back again, the rest of us will think about planting the stick for you directly." Zhao Jianshe said so.
"Tomorrow we are all free, let's go up the mountain together.
Your thirty feet of ginseng soil, serial sticks and sowing seeds can be finished in one day. "Huang Shengli also said.
"Okay, then thank you brothers, I'm too busy."
Xu Shiyan smiled and thanked his brothers, so sometimes friends get along better than brothers.
After discussing the matter of planting ginseng, Xu Shiyan hurried back to his parents and took the child home.
The two younger ones are used to living with their grandparents these days, and Zhou Guilan was also worried that Xu Shiyan would not be able to take care of the four children alone, so she only asked Xu Shiyan to take the two older ones home.
As for Yang Haoyu, when Xu Shiyan went to Zhao Jianshe and the others, Yang Junxian came to pick up the child.
Ginseng seeds and ginseng seeds were distributed by the team a few days ago.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan coaxed the children while picking ginseng seeds, tied them with corn nests, and packed them in cardboard boxes.
Before, in the team, the top three ginseng seeds were planted in the ground, and the rest were used as seeds to make goods.
This year, the contract is contracted to the households, and each family has divided the ginseng soil for three years at once. The ginseng seeds cannot be as in previous years.
As long as the reed heads and beards are complete, regardless of their size, they all have to be left and planted in the ground.
As for how big the goods will be in three years, I don’t care about it. Let’s develop slowly, and it will be fine in the future.
The three of you took a lot of things home, but fortunately, the kang lit a little fire during the day, so just make another stove quickly.
Xu Shiyan unwrapped the kraft paper bag and picked out the books inside.
Put the ones for myself in the inner study, and let Xu Haiyuan keep the ones for the children.
Xu Haiyuan got a lot of new books and was very happy.
He can't read much now, so he can't read them all, but he can flip through the pictures inside.
The two brothers and sisters were holding a comic book, and they were fascinated by reading it.
Xu Shiyan took advantage of the children's reading time to quickly burn the kang and the stove to heat up the house before putting on the kang and making quilts.
Coaxed the two children to wash their feet and change their clothes, and then the father told the two stories from the book in the bed, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping went to bed contentedly.
Su Anying was not at home, and Xu Shiyan had to be busy with going up the mountain in the morning, so he must have the meal with his parents when he got up early.
Woke up the son and daughter in the morning, washed the faces of the two children and changed their clothes.
Xu Shiyan is a clumsy man, and he doesn't know how to braid his daughter's hair, so Xu Jinping can only wear her hair and go to her grandma's house to find her two aunts.
The family had just had breakfast, and before the table was cleared, Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others came over with their belongings, followed by Zhou Changhe and Zhou Qingguo.
Xu Shiyan hurried back to set up the car, and when they were ready to set off, Yang Junxian rode over with his son.
Yang Junxian carried Yang Haoyu out of the car, told his son to go to school with Xu Haiyuan, and then smiled at Xu Shiyan.
"Xiaoyu came home last night and said that the third brother is going to plant sticks on the mountain today. It just so happens that our family's work is over, so I can help you plant ginseng."
Yang Junxian is now the deputy secretary of the first team. Although the production team is yellow, there are actually many things to do.
But no matter how busy the team is, he has to come to Xu's house to help.
The two families are relatives. Xu Shiyan and his wife have helped the Yang family so much. If the Xu family has a job, they must come. This is a relationship.
Xu Shiyan saw that Yang Junxian was dressed for work, and there were square plates, shovels and so on on the bicycle shelf.
Knowing that Yang Junxian had prepared it long ago, he didn't refuse.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan drove the carriage, pulling Zhou Changhe, Xu Chenghou, ginseng seeds and ginseng seeds, and household items for work.
The other people rode their bicycles one step ahead and went directly to the Nantianmen Shendi.
Nantianmen is a place name, because the two walls of the mountain are towering, and the distance in the middle is about 50 meters, which is a platform that drops down suddenly.
Looking from a distance, it seems that a huge sky gate is opening in the sky.
On the west side of Tianmen Gate, there is a huge boulder shaped like a human being, as if the gatekeeper is standing still. On the east side, the rolling mountains are like a tiger, entrenched on the top of the mountain.
So the locals named it Nantianmen.
The third brigade's Guahua land is in a forest south of Nantianmen, not too close to Donggang.
Xu Shiyan drove the car away from home at 6:30, and it was almost 8:00 when he arrived.
Zhou Qingguo and the others rode their bikes fast, and they arrived early. They had just leveled the surface of the pond with tools, and they started planting ginseng as soon as Xu Shiyan and the others arrived.
A total of 30 feet of ginseng soil, and nine people working on it, isn't that fast?
Zhou Changhe was responsible for saving face, Xu Chenghou handed over the ginseng seeds, and Xu Shiyan went to sow the seeds.
The rest of the people stood in pairs, digging the soil with shovels and began to plant ginseng.
The family of Xu Shiyan and Xu Chenghou has seven members, with a total of thirty-seven feet and a half.
In order to distinguish the half zhang from others, I had to pick a ditch in the middle, and it was useless, leaving thirty-seven zhang.
Among them, ten feet of ginseng seeds are sprinkled, and the remaining twenty-seven feet are planted with ginseng.
The main reason is that there are not enough ginseng seeds, so we can only sow more ginseng seeds. After a few years of development, we can plant more ginseng.
Zhao Jianshe and the others are all strong young men who can work quickly. For them, twenty-seven feet of ginseng soil is a piece of cake.
Everyone started working together, and at one o'clock in the afternoon, the work was done, so they packed up everything that should be packed in the ground, took all their belongings, and drove the carriage back.
It was less than three o'clock when I arrived home, and Zhou Guilan led Su Anfang and Su Anhua, who had taken leave, to work in the kitchen.
No matter who the family is, if someone else comes to work for the helper, it must be a delicious treat.
Zhou Guilan sent Su Anfang to Songjianghe early in the morning, bought meat and cooked food, and came back.
"Hey, you're back so soon? Hurry up and wash your hands and sit in the house, the food will be ready soon."
Zhou Guilan saw everyone coming back, and hurriedly called everyone to enter the room to sit down and rest.
Here the water was boiled, took out the teapot and poured out the tea leaves, and took them to the east room. Find another cigarette and distribute it to everyone to smoke casually.
Those who can come to help with work are not outsiders, and they are not polite. They smoke when they want, and drink tea when they want.
The big guys sat in the room and chatted for a while. After a while, the food and drink were all set up, and they were all hungry. No one was polite, so they quickly sat down to eat.
"Come on, pour them all out, no matter what you can drink or not, it doesn't matter how much you want, it doesn't matter if you drink less, it relieves fatigue."
Xu Shiyan took the wine bottle and poured wine for everyone.
"Changhe, let's drink this, it's hot, we're at this age, so don't compare yourself to the young ones.
They dare to drink something cold, let’s drink something warm. "
Xu Chenghou took the scalded jug and poured it for Zhou Changhe.
Old people are still old-fashioned. Drinking liquor must be scalded, no matter whether it is cold or hot.
But the young man doesn't care about that, he can't wait to pick up the bottle and drink directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 313: chicken thief
chapters.content:
Take a day off to plant ginseng, and then go to work normally.
Changbai Mountain red ginseng has been tested and identified, and the quality is indeed higher than that of ordinary red ginseng. The University of Medical Sciences directly sent the relevant certificate to the relevant department.
Therefore, the province issued an order to require a ginseng farm to trial-produce 2,000 boxes of Changbai Mountain red ginseng this autumn for foreign orders.
Received orders from superiors, as soon as I participated in the field, I hurriedly got to work and found a place to customize wooden boxes, tinplate boxes and other packaging and accessories.
Xu Shiyan started to lead the technical team to produce Changbaishan red ginseng with all his strength.
Changbaishan red ginseng is packaged in two layers inside and outside, with a wooden box inside and a tin box outside.
First dry the packaging wooden box, wipe off the dust, and pad the paper.
After checking that the specifications of the parameters are correct, put them into the box, seal the cover, and indicate the specification weight. This is the inner layer of packaging.
Wrap the wooden box containing the ginseng block with a layer of moisture-proof paper, attach an instruction manual, put it into a tinplate box, seal the cover, and stamp the specification and weight with steel stamps.
Afterwards, use an evacuator to evacuate the air in the iron box, and after the vacuum is reached, nitrogen is flushed into the box, and the air filling hole is welded at the same time.
The can opener key is welded to the other end of the lid, and the tin box is wrapped with wrapping paper. Indicate the specifications and weight on the paper.
The last step is packing, 20 boxes per box, **** and put into storage, just wait for delivery.
Changbaishan red ginseng belongs to secondary processing, which is very time-consuming in itself, and in addition to the fact that it has just started production, the process is not very proficient.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to recruit another manpower, so he could only lead the technical team with a few young people to work slowly, and the production time would naturally be longer.
Fortunately, the time given by the province was sufficient, and after everyone got used to it for a while, the speed also increased, and it got better slowly.
Xu Shiyan was busy leading people to process Changbaishan red ginseng, so naturally he couldn't take care of family affairs.
It was Su Anfang and sisters. After the work in the processing factory was over, they went back to clean up the house and took care of the four children and Clivia, so Xu Shiyan could save a little worry.
The sticks and ginseng on the mountain were all helped by Zhao Jianshe and the others to clean up and evacuate the shed, cover the cold soil, smash the foot of the pillar, etc.
Donggang is close to Changbai Mountain, the weather is colder earlier, and the snow falls earlier.
Just entering November, there have been several snowfalls in a row. Depending on the situation, the snow can stop.
If it were the past years, it would be time to go hunting in the mountains by this time, but now, you don’t have to think about anything, just go to work and finish the job.
"Third brother, I don't think it's right, we seem to have lost a few chickens in our farm.
Come and take a look with me, there seems to be footprints of something over here, but I can't make out what it is. "
It was Sunday, so Xu Shiyan had a rest and went to the farm to have a look. As soon as he got there, Xu Shian told him that the chickens in the farm were lost.
Xu Shiyan followed his second brother around the outside of the farm, and sure enough, he found some suspicious traces outside the fence behind the chicken farm.
Xu Shian couldn't understand it, but Xu Shiyan knew it was left by the fox.
There are chickens in the farm. It is a little far away from the village, surrounded by woods, and it is normal to have foxes.
"It's okay, I'll make something some time, just put a few more near the chicken coop.
But remember, don’t kill the fox if you catch it. Find a cage to keep it. "
Xu Shiyan was very helpless, why did he encounter these things everywhere he went?
This thing is not easy to offend, let alone kill it.
But you can’t ignore it, or all the chickens in the chicken farm will be stolen. Really worried panic.
Xu Shiyan went back and made a few things for catching foxes, also called hen music.
This is a canvas pocket with a valve. The wooden frame valve is stuck on the door inside the chicken coop. As long as the fox gets in, the valve will automatically close.
The canvas bag was thin and long, and the fox couldn't turn around in it, and the trap door couldn't be pushed outward, so he could only be trapped in it.
Xu Shiyan made five or six hens and sent them to the farm, but in the past few days, he lost several chickens.
Xu Shian gritted his teeth angrily, according to what Xu Shiyan said, put the hen Ledu in the chicken coop, and waited for the fox to be fooled.
Xu Shiyan didn't go home at all, and stayed at the farm at night.
There was no movement in the first few days, and the hen music didn't come in handy.
On the morning of the fourth day, when Xu Shiyan and others went to the chicken farm for a stroll, they suddenly found a canvas bag moving.
You can tell at a glance that something must have been tricked.
"Catch it, catch it, there must be a chicken thief here." Xu Shian saw it, shouted loudly and rushed up.
Xu Shian took Hen Le out, carried his bag to another place, found an empty iron cage, opened the trap door, and poured out the contents.
Sure enough, it was a fire fox with extremely beautiful coat color.
"It's a fire fox. Its coat color is quite beautiful. Now a complete fox fur can sell for hundreds of dollars."
Xu Shian looked at the fire fox, and said with gritted teeth.
I don't know if the fox understood Xu Shian's words, or got angry when it was caught, and made a "woo-woo" sound at Xu Shian, and bared its teeth at him.
Then he turned around and farted towards Xu Shian and the others.
The fox's farts are so bad, they stink badly, Xu Shi'an and the others were so smoked that tears came out, and they quickly stepped back while covering their noses.
The door of the iron cage hadn't been closed yet. Taking advantage of the time when everyone retreated, the fire fox leaped forward and came out of the cage, turned around and was about to run.
"It's you again, you don't learn well every day, and you go to the chicken farm to steal chickens, right?"
As a result, before the fox could take two steps, someone grabbed the back of the neck and couldn't move.
It was Xu Shiyan who caught Firefox.
He is not as impatient as Xu Shian, and he followed Xu Shian just now.
Unexpectedly, Firefox made a fart, which made several people dizzy, and then Firefox wanted to run away.
Xu Shiyan has been with Laipi Gui for several years, and he knows the temperament of the fox, so he stepped forward in two steps and grabbed the fire fox by the back of the neck.
A scene that surprised everyone appeared.
The fox caught by Xu Shiyan, instead of farting or struggling, made a whining sound.
Everyone was dumbfounded, what the **** is this?
Xu Shiyan let go of his hand helplessly, and threw the fire fox on the ground. Then, the fox started to wander around Xu Shiyan, rubbing Xu Shiyan's trouser legs with its big tail.
If Xu Shiyan was a little skeptical just now, he can be sure now that this is a rascal.
"Oh, third child, isn't this the fox you raised on the mountain? How did it find it here?"
Xu Shian also came to his senses, the whining fox in front of him looked very much like the one he had seen in Xiaoheihe before.
"Well, that's it. Who knows why it came here from Xiaoheihe again? This little thing is about to become a spirit."
Xu Shiyan squatted down, looked at the fire fox, and patted it on the head.
"You can search hard, and if you dare to run around the village, you won't be afraid of being caught and stripped of your skin?"
Lai Pigui was not annoyed, he tilted his head to look at Xu Shiyan.
If Xu Shiyan didn't know that foxes can't laugh, he would really think that this thing was laughing.
"I figured it out, you're going to rely on me, right?" What can you do? Let it depend on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 314: bring home
chapters.content:
From the Qianchuan farm in the big house, to the Xiaohehe farm in Funan, and then to the breeding farm, for five or six years, the fate between Xu Shiyan and the rascal has never been broken.
Now that this guy is here again, what else can Xu Shiyan do? Only the rascals can be left behind.
But how to raise it made Xu Shiyan embarrassed again.
Let’s stay in the farm, Xu Shiyan is not willing to put it in a cage. But if you don't put it in a cage, you are afraid that the rascal will cause trouble.
There are too many animals here in the farm, so it's not a big deal for the rascal to steal a few chickens, but what if he bites the sable on a whim?
A baby sable can be sold for hundreds of dollars now, let alone an adult, killing one would cost a lot of money.
This mischievous thing, no one can guarantee what it can do.
Furthermore, Xu Shiyan was also worried that there were so many people at the farm, and he was afraid that someone would have bad intentions and secretly kill the rascal.
As Xu Shian said, a good fox fur is nearly 100 yuan now, how much is the monthly salary of those blind people?
Seeing a hundred dollars running in front of my eyes all day long, what if someone is tempted?
This is different from the little black blinds. Those two black blinds are too small, and their courage is worthless and there is no place to ask for it.
Furthermore, the two little black blind men lived with Xu Shian all day long, under Xu Shian's nose, no one dared to move their minds.
After thinking about it, Xu Shiyan decided to take the rascal home to raise him.
There are no dogs or chickens at home, so those big geese can be sent to their parents to raise them. Pigs and horses are as big as pigs, so the rascals will not dare to mess with them.
The three houses on the east side have been used as flower sheds, which are just right for rascals to live in. There is enough space and it is warm over there, raspers should like it.
There is a forest behind Xu's house. The rascals have had enough of staying at home, so they can go for a run in the forest, and catch birds and mice.
After making a decision, Xu Shiyan found a wicker basket and pointed to the basket to let the rascal go in.
Then, under the surprised expressions of everyone, Lai Pigui really jumped into the basket, with his big tail curled up, and he lay obediently in the basket.
Xu Shiyan hung the basket on the handlebar of the bicycle, and just rode back like this.
Along the way, the rascal didn't move, just lying on his stomach, completely trusting Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan lived in the farm, and Su Anfang and Su Anhua accompanied Xu Haiyuan's brothers and sisters at night.
It was not yet time for class, and the two children had just finished eating and were packing up their things and preparing to leave.
Su Anfang was carrying a pig food bucket to feed the pigs when she saw Xu Shiyan come back.
"Second brother-in-law, why are you back at this time?" Su Anfang asked casually.
"Oh, it's okay, the fox on the other side of the farm caught it, and I brought it back to raise it."
Xu Shiyan explained a sentence, and then walked to the three houses to the east with a basket.
Going into the house and putting down the basket, Lai Pigui jumped out of the basket, shaking his fur, and looked around curiously.
Xu Shiyan found a few broken sacks from the warehouse and spread them on the floor of the east room.
"Then, this is where you live. I warn you, don't go out and steal chickens. I don't care if they catch you and beat you to death."
Xu Shiyan pointed at the rascal's forehead and warned it.
Xu Shiyan didn't care whether the rascal could understand or not.
That is, he suffered a loss in Xu Shiyan's hands. It is not easy for others to catch him.
After placing Laipigui in the flower shed, Xu Shiyan got up and was about to go out, but before he could get to the door, he saw Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping running over with surprise on their faces.
"Father, Fifth Aunt said, you want to raise a fox? Where is it? We want to see the fox."
Both children are very curious. They only heard about the cunning fox in the story, but they haven't seen it yet.
"Be careful it bites you."
Bringing the fox home, Xu Shiyan knew that the children would definitely find out, so he didn't object and said no, he just turned around and led the two children into the house.
"Did you see it? Just lying on the stomach over there." Xu Shiyan pointed to the rascal who was lying on the sack in the east room.
The two children stretched their heads and glanced at the east room, "Is this a fox? Wow, it's so beautiful."
I have to say that Laipigui's fur is really rare, no matter who sees it, he likes it, and the two little babies are no exception.
"Dad, can we pet it?"
Xu Haiyuan opened his eyes wide, staring at Laipigui longingly, asking for Xu Shiyan's opinion.
"It stinks, so don't touch it, get your hands on it, and when you go to school later, your classmates will dislike you."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, not letting go.
Lai Pigui is a wild animal, no matter how cute it is, the wildness is still there.
The two children are not light or heavy in their hands. If they accidentally squeeze them, they are afraid that the rascal will bite.
The two children were a little disappointed, but they didn't insist any more. They were going to school, and they really smelled bad.
"Then let's come back to play with it after school, let's go, go to school, if we don't go, we will be late."
Xu Haiyuan held his younger sister's hand, and the two children walked out of the house in two steps and turned around, then joined the children of Huang's family and Sun's family, and went to school together.
There is an extra rascal in the family, but it doesn't have much impact.
Xu Shiyan only told Su Anfang and the others some precautions, especially feeding, not to add salt, otherwise the fox will shed its hair.
Other things don’t matter, don’t feed too much in a day, and don’t need to be full of meat, just feed it what you have at home, and the rascal will go out to find food by himself.
After Xu Haiyuan and the others got to know each other for a few days, they really dared to touch the rascal.
As for the rascal ghost, it is very psychic, and it doesn't get angry when children touch it, and sometimes they can play with children.
It is right to have a dog as a companion for the children.
On the morning of November 12th, Xu Shiyan received a call back from Su Anying.
It was said that Xu Shiqin was recovering well and could be discharged from the hospital on the 13th. They planned to take the car on the 14th to go back, and estimated that they would arrive home on the 15th.
Xu Shiyan was naturally very happy when he found out, and went to his parents' place after get off work to tell everyone the good news.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were too happy to sit still when they heard that the old girl would be back in a few days.
"Third brother, please take a leave of absence on the 15th and go to the station to pick them up."
In winter, it may be hard to find a donkey cart. It’s better to go there with your own carriage. Prepare bedding in advance, and it won’t be too cold to come back by carriage.
"No, I will tell the venue and find a car to pick it up."
Xu Shiyan is not like before. It is still very easy to borrow a car from Secretary Lin.
"Yes, yes, I forgot that you have a car. Anyway, it would be better if you can borrow a car. It is faster and more comfortable than a horse-drawn carriage."
The old couple nodded repeatedly after hearing this.
Yeah, they all forgot about it, don't look at it is only a year away, the third son of their family, but today is not what it used to be.
"When I earn money in the future, I will also buy a car, so it will be more convenient to go out and do everything."
Xu Shiyan did have this idea. It is no problem for him to learn to drive at his age. It is convenient for him to get a small broken car to drive.
"You can think about it, what kind of family are we? Buying a car yourself?"

chapters.title: Chapter 315: pick up
chapters.content:
Xu Shiyan went to work to find Secretary Lin, talked to Secretary Lin, and he agreed.
At noon on the 15th, Han Lixin drove, and together with Xu Shiyan, went to the train station to pick up someone.
In mid-November, the temperature had not yet reached the lowest point, and it was quite cold. The two parked their car outside the train station and waited in the car without getting out of the car.
"It's about time, why is there no movement?"
Xu Shiyan looked at his watch, it was clearly time for the train to arrive at the station, why there was no movement at all.
"Is it late? Wait a little longer, if not, let's go to the station and ask."
Han Lixin was also in a hurry. There was no other way. If the train didn't come, what else could they do?
After waiting for more than ten minutes, they finally heard the train whistle. The two of them got out of the car in a hurry and walked towards the exit.
They walked to the exit, and the train also entered the station. Through the iron railings, they saw many people getting off the train with big bags and small bags, and walked towards the exit.
The two of them stared wide-eyed, and finally saw a familiar figure.
"Little sister, daughter-in-law, this way, this way." Xu Shiyan waved towards the inside and shouted loudly.
Su Anying supported Xu Shiqin with one hand, and a big bag in the other hand, and a bag on her back.
Not to mention Su Weizhong, he has a large back pocket on his back and is carrying things in both hands.
The three of them looked outside while walking, looking for the person who picked up the station.
Sure enough, they saw someone waving at them outside the exit, and after a closer look, it was Xu Shiyan and Han Lixin.
"Little sister, your third brother is here to pick us up."
Su Anying waved to her husband, then supported Xu Shiqin and walked quickly out of the train station.
As soon as they came out, Xu Shiyan and Han Lixin stepped forward and took the bags from Su Anying and Su Weizhong.
Su Anying supported Xu Shiqin, and they walked forward to the jeep.
"This is it?" Su Weizhong thought that his son-in-law would come to pick him up in a carriage, but he saw a jeep and couldn't react.
"Oh, I borrowed it from the store. Our carriage is slow and not warm yet. This carriage is fast."
Xu Shiyan smiled, explained something, and helped his sister into the car.
"Did you borrow it from your leader? Can you also borrow a car?" Su Weizhong was amazed.
His uncle is doing so well now? Can you borrow the car at the venue?
Su Weizhong looked at the car in front of him. This should be called a jeep, right? This is not something that ordinary cadres can sit on.
How about an old saying?
"Regional cadres stop at both ends, county cadres have canvas tents, commune cadres one three zero, brigade cadres two zero zero."
The canvas tent refers to the jeep, which used to be only available to county cadres.
"Father, what are you thinking? Hurry up and get in the car."
Xu Shiyan just helped his sister into the car, when he turned around, he saw Su Weizhong staring at the car in a daze, and couldn't help but wonder, what's wrong with the old man?
"I just took a look at this car. Didn't everyone say before that you have to be a county cadre to ride it?
Unexpectedly, I am an old mud leg, and I still have the opportunity to ride in such a car? "
Su Weizhong felt dizzy, as if in a dream.
"Father, you should go up and sit up in the cold weather, let's go home quickly, the family is waiting."
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this, this old man is really interesting.
"After your uncle earns money, let's buy a car and drive it."
While speaking, he helped the old man into the car, and then packed the luggage, which was also jammed into the car.
The jeep is big and spacious, and it is not too crowded for three people in the back and luggage.
"Daughter-in-law, please support the little sister."
Xu Shiyan sat in the co-pilot, turned around and gave instructions, and then Han Lixin started the car, leaving the station and heading south all the way.
Go south from the train station, pass the watchtower in front of Songjianghe Market, then turn east, and then south, you can go directly to Donggang.
The road in Songjianghe Street is not bad, but the road from the corner building to the south to Donggang is not so good, with potholes and bumps.
Su Anying put her arms around Xu Shiqin, trying to keep her body balanced and avoid touching the wound on her back.
The jeep was much faster than the horse-drawn carriage, and soon arrived at Donggang, and stopped directly outside the gate of Xu's house in front of the martyr's tomb.
As soon as the car stopped, before Xu Shiyan got out of the car, he saw many people screaming out of Xu's yard.
Xu Shi'an couple, Su Anfang sisters, Li Chengrong, Han Limin, Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others.
The big guys rushed forward, Sister Su Anfang supported Xu Shiqin, Zhao Jianshe and others carried their luggage and packages, and entered the east room happily.
There are more people in the east room, Han Wenzhong and his wife, Li Bingzhuo and his wife, Yu Shouguang, Zhao Dahai, Zhou Changhe, these older people are all there.
The Han family is Xu Shiqin's in-laws. Xu Shiqin went to the surgery without telling the Han family and left. Li Yuexiu was not able to go to the provincial capital to take care of her, so she felt very sorry.
So when they learned that Xu Shiqin was back, the old couple specially bought a lot of things and sent them over to make up for Xu Shiqin's health.
The Li family and the Han family are neighbors, and Li Chengrong is still dating Su Anhua, how can he not know about Xu Shiqin's return from surgery?
Speaking of it, the Li family and the Xu family will soon be in-laws visiting each other. If the Xu family has something to do, the Li family will definitely come. This is a normal human relationship.
So Li Bingzhuo and his wife have discussed with Han Wenzhong and his wife, and they came here this morning with their things.
Not to mention the other people, they all have a good relationship with the Xu family, and they all came to have a look with their things.
This time, Xu Chenghou and his wife did not call those sons.
One time is enough, and the old couple have no memory, so they won't commit that bitch.
It will be like this in the future, there is no need to inform them of family affairs, love will come or not.
With so many people caring, Xu Shiqin is naturally happy.
However, she has just finished the operation for more than 20 days, and her body is still quite weak, especially when walking back from the Hunjiang River, she mostly sits and does not have a good rest.
At this moment, he was forced to say hello to everyone, and then he was helped back to the Westinghouse to rest.
"I just saw that Shiqin's figure hasn't changed much after returning from surgery this time.
Oh, I'm at home, so I'm worried, if you take out those screws, nail sticks, etc., will she hunch back again?
Looking at it this time, it seems to be okay, nothing wrong. "Zhou Guilan looked at Xu Shiqin's back and said to Li Yuexiu.
These words were actually meant for the in-laws, and Zhou Guilan purposely said them because she was afraid that the Han family might have some concerns.
After all, I have never seen a hunchback that can be corrected by surgery.
Don’t look at it before, it was fine, but there were things holding it inside, and no one dared to say what a person would be like after taking out those things.
For the biological parents, no matter what the daughter looks like, they can accept it and will never dislike it.
But for others, especially the in-laws, this is not necessarily the case, so Zhou Guilan said this on purpose.
Li Yuexiu nodded, "Don't worry about it, as long as you are a good person.
Oh, I was thinking about it at home. You said that the child had undergone several surgeries, how much trouble would it take?
It hurts for several days even if we got a **** on our body. You said that the child has suffered so many backs, how can he bear it? "

chapters.title: Chapter 316: Introduction object
chapters.content:
Han Wenzhong and Li Yuexiu have only three sons and no daughters.
Li Yuexiu has been greedy for other people's daughters all her life, so she treats her daughter-in-law very well.
Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei have been engaged for almost a year, and they are very close to the Han family. On Sundays, Xu Shiqin goes to the Han family to visit his in-laws.
I also make clothes and buy things for my in-laws, and get along well with Li Yuexiu.
Originally, Li Yuexiu was still talking about waiting for her daughter-in-law to undergo surgery, and she would go to bed and serve her.
Unexpectedly, Xu Shiyan and others left in a hurry and did not inform the Han family. When Li Yuexiu found out, Xu Shiyan and his party had been gone for several days.
Li Yuexiu was thinking about it at home, wondering how her daughter-in-law's operation will be and whether it will go well.
Finally looking forward to returning, she was relieved to see her daughter-in-law safe and sound.
It's just that when she thinks of the sufferings her daughter-in-law has suffered, she feels uncomfortable.
If you want to say that you love your child, who can love you more than your own mother?
It's just that Zhou Guilan can't shed tears in front of so many people.
But now Li Yuexiu said that Zhou Guilan couldn't bear it anymore, and raised her hand to wipe the tears from the corners of her eyes.
"Yeah, I don't even dare to think about it, and I can't help but cry when I think about it. You said that back then, if I put a little effort into it, the child would not die."
The two old ladies sat face to face and shed tears. The people next to them saw it and quickly persuaded them.
In front of so many people, Zhou Guilan and Li Yuexiu couldn't keep crying, so they had to wipe away their tears and change the topic.
"Huh? By the way, I just miss our Shiqin and forget about serious things."
Li Yuexiu slapped her thigh and said suddenly.
"Well, Brother Su, is your fifth child still dating?" Li Yuexiu turned her head and asked Su Weizhong loudly.
At the other end, Su Weizhong, who was talking to Xu Chenghou, Zhao Dahai and others, turned his head to look this way.
"Huh? Ah, yes, my fifth child is still dating. What's wrong? My in-laws are going to help introduce one?"
The Su family and the Xu family are related by marriage, and the Xu family and the Han family are also related by marriage. These are all in-laws who visit the door, so Su Weizhong calls them that.
"Isn't it? Let me tell you, someone fell in love with your fifth son, and asked me to kiss you.
I was patronizing my daughter-in-law, and I almost forgot the big things. "Li Yuexiu said while clapping her chin.
When Li Yuexiu said this, everyone in the room was stunned, even Xu Shiyan was a little stunned.
ah? The fifth younger sister has been spotted by someone, which family's kid has such good eyesight? He is dexterous enough, and he knows how to find someone to propose a matchmaker.
"It's not someone else, you've seen it before, that's the big old Li when your sixth son and Xiao Li saw each other last time.
The second son of his family has taken a fancy to your fifth son. "Li Yuexiu didn't hold back, and said directly.
It turned out that when Li Chengrong met Su Anhua that time, Li Zongliang had taken a fancy to Su Anfang, but he didn't have the nerve to mention it directly.
Later, Su Anfang worked in a processing factory, and happened to be with the wife of the elder Li.
The daughter-in-law of the eldest brother Li heard her son talking about it once, and secretly began to pay attention.
After observing and observing, I really think this girl is pretty good.
Humble and polite to people, not to mention working, very diligent, with a bright eye, hard-working.
So the daughter-in-law of the eldest brother Li deliberately got close to Su Anfang, asked Su Anfang about the Su family's affairs, and asked Su Anfang if she had a date or something.
After learning that Su Anfang had no match, the eldest daughter-in-law Li was moved and planned to find someone to propose a matchmaker.
Who should I look for? After much deliberation, she had to find Li Yuexiu.
After all, the Han family has relatives with the Xu family, and Li Chengrong was also Li Yuexiu's matchmaker last time. Simply, good things come in pairs, so let's go to her this time.
Just like that, the eldest brother Li and his wife found an opportunity to go to the Han family and asked Li Yuexiu to provide a matchmaker for their son.
When Li Yuexiu heard this, she had to ask a little more. After learning that the Li family really wanted to get married, Li Yuexiu agreed.
Coincidentally, when Xu Shiqin came back today, Han Wenzhong and his wife came to visit their daughter-in-law, Li Yuexiu planned to mention something to the Xu family first, to hear what the Xu family meant, and then talk about it later.
Unexpectedly, Su Weizhong went to the provincial capital with him. It is more convenient now, and he asked directly in person.
Su Weizhong heard it, and thought about it carefully, oh, yes, a family of three came that day, and the young man looked young and not bad-looking.
Su Weizhong was surprised. He didn't expect his two daughters to marry the workers who participated in the field? This is really unbelievable.
Su Weizhong turned his head and went to look at Xu Shiyan, which meant, of course, to ask Xu Shiyan, how is the Li family, and how is the young man from the Li family.
Xu Shiyan also understood now, the last time they met together, they not only met Li Chengrong and Su Anhua.
Even Su Anfang was married, but no one knew it at the time.
"Father, that Li Zongliang is the driver, driving the bus for the unit.
He picks us up to and from get off work all day long, and if the unit has any transportation tasks, he also drives out. "
Xu Shiyan understood what the father-in-law meant at a glance, so let me introduce him quickly.
Su Weizhong nodded when he heard it, driver, that’s a good job, not bad.
"In-laws, wait a moment, I'll ask my fifth brother."
No matter how good the job is, no matter how good the person is, the girl has to be happy.
Su Weizhong saw that there was no one in the east room, so he knew that his daughter was busy cooking in the kitchen.
It was not easy to ask the daughter in front of the big guys, so he put on his shoes and went to the kitchen to find Su Anfang.
Called Su Anfang to the yard, and the two chatted for a while.
When Su Anfang heard that the Li family came to propose a matchmaker, she was still a little puzzled.
After Su Weizhong explained, saying that the cannonball almost caused an accident, Su Anfang suddenly remembered the last time he brought a lot of things to thank Xu Shiyan's house.
When Su Anfang was working in the processing factory, she met the young man named Li Zongliang several times, and it was he who went to the processing factory to find his mother Zhao Meijuan.
Because Su Anfang and Zhao Meijuan are very familiar, they call her Auntie, and they still work together as partners to lift and lower the fork.
So every time Li Zongliang came to find someone, he could chat with Su Anfang.
Su Anfang didn't think about other things before, but now she finally understands that the Li family has long been interested in her, and they deliberately found an opportunity to get in touch with her.
"How is it? Girl, do you think that young man suits you?
If you think it's okay, I'll go back to your aunt of the Han family and find a time to have a look at the two families.
You are not young anymore, it would be good to get married early. "
Su Anfang is 20, and will be 21 after the new year. It's time to get married. It's rare to meet a good one, so don't hurry up?
Su Anfang looked embarrassed, "Father, you can make the decision, I have no objection."
This means agreeing, but I am just embarrassed to say it.
Can Su Weizhong not understand what a girl means? Immediately laughed.
"Come on, I'll go back to your aunt of the Han family. While I'm here these few days, let's find a day to see each other."
Before I kept saying that the sixth child was ahead of the fifth child, but this time, the fifth child also has a place.
If two people get along well, we will hold a wedding for them next year, and it is not easy to mess up the order.

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Good daughter-in-law
chapters.content:
Ask to understand the girl's heart, Su Weizhong happily entered the house.
Tell Li Yuexiu to ask her to reply to the Li family, and find some time in the next few days to come and see her.
When everyone heard this, they knew that this was another marriage, and they all came to congratulate.
Just at this time, the food was ready, packed up, everyone ate and drank together, talked and laughed, not to mention how lively it was.
It wasn't until four o'clock, when it was getting dark outside, that everyone said goodbye and left.
Su Weizhong led the two daughters back to Xu Shiyan's side to light the fire, while Xu Shiyan, his wife and children stayed temporarily.
Su Anying had to talk to her in-laws about the expenses of going out this time.
The experience and growth of this year has made Su Anying change a lot. Not only did she follow Xu Shiyan to read some words, but she is no longer troubled by ordinary accounting.
Su Anying recorded every expense when going out in a small notebook.
Take out a piece of straw paper and check the accounts and the amount of money with Xu Shiyan and the other two. They are basically the same, and there is no big discrepancy.
"Father, Mom, the total cost of going out this time was less than 900 yuan, and my little sister's operation cost is relatively light.
This is the money for the two pots of Clivia. Shiyan sold it for 3,000 and gave it to the middleman for 100. Now there are 2,000 points left.
Mom, put it away for the younger sister, and give it to her when she wakes up. "
Su Anying pushed the money and hospital bills to her mother-in-law.
Back home, her mission is over, and the money is naturally out of her hands.
Xu Shiqin had just finished the operation and was weak. He just ate something and went back to the house to rest and fell asleep.
Because it's not worth bothering her, Su Anying handed over the money to her mother-in-law.
Zhou Guilan put away the bills, and then took out half of the two bundles of money.
"You accompanied Shiqin to the operation, delayed the work at home, and had to wait on her with feces and urine, which probably cost a lot of money.
You take these, it is the wish of your parents and your sixth younger sister. "
Zhou Guilan is illiterate, but she is not stupid.
When Saner and his wife reconciled accounts just now, she heard clearly that there were many accounts that Su Anying did not include.
These two couples can’t pay money openly, so instead of spending money secretly, what can they do?
Su Anying was able to accompany Xu Shiqin to the operation and waited on her for so many days. This sister-in-law has done impeccable work, so how can they let them pay for it?
"Mom, you don't need to give me money, that's what my little sister spent in hospital.
What I just told Shi Yan, there are some accounts that are not included, because I bought things for the children. "
Su Anying saw that her mother-in-law took four or five hundred yuan and wanted to give it to her, how could she ask for it? Quickly explain.
"Look, there are several bags on the ground, all of which are for family members.
I didn’t spare time this afternoon. I’ll send you your portion after I go back to clean up. "
When a woman goes out, can she not buy anything?
After confirming that Xu Shiqin could be discharged from the hospital, Su Anying, accompanied by her father, visited several department stores and brought things for the family.
"Then you take it too, it's been a hard trip, I've lost weight looking at your face.
Go back and eat some delicious food, make up for it, and wait for the 9th, kill a few chickens and stew chicken soup. "
Zhou Guilan still insisted on giving the money to her daughter-in-law.
"Mom, I'm busy, how can I have time to cook some chicken soup?
Otherwise, put the money with Mom, and wait for Mom to cook delicious food, so I’ll sneak over and eat. "
Su Anying couldn't ask for anything, just returned the money and said with a smile.
In fact, on normal days, no matter which side made delicious food, they would call over to eat together.
It's just that what Su Anying said is nice, and it makes the parents-in-law feel at ease.
Su Anying said so, and Zhou Guilan did the same thing, so she had to collect the money.
"Okay, let's make dumplings tomorrow, and kill the chicken and stew the chicken the day after tomorrow."
As she said that, Zhou Guilan laughed. For such a good daughter-in-law, she doesn't feel bad about eating anything.
"Well, this is okay. I really haven't eaten anything good after I went out for a while. I have long been greedy for the dumplings at home." Su Anying also laughed.
Xu Shiyan and his wife chatted with their parents for a while, and it was getting late.
The two younger ones at the other end probably had too many people in the afternoon and didn’t sleep well, so now Lai Haw is going to sleep.
Seeing this, Xu Shiyan quickly packed up his things, what he could carry on his back, and then led the four children, big and small, to go home together.
As soon as he entered the gate, before he reached the middle of the yard, he suddenly saw a shadow rushing towards him.
Before Xu Shiyan could react, Xu Haiyuan stepped forward and hugged the shadow.
"Laipi ghost, you can't stay in the house anymore, run around, and be careful not to be caught."
Don't think about it, the one who was caught was naturally a rascal.
Laipigui was placed in three houses on the east side by Xu Shiyan. In order to allow it to come and go freely, Xu Shiyan specially dug a small door on the door and made a hinge to install it.
Lai Pigui can open the door and come in and out no matter from the inside or the outside.
This little thing is very smart. It definitely doesn't **** or pee in the house. It also goes out for a walk at a fixed time every day. It is much more convenient to have such a small door.
After getting acquainted with Xu Haiyuan and the others these days, every time Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping come back from grandma's house, Laipigui will be the first to notice.
Then he came out of the house and welcomed Xu Haiyuan and the others back home.
"This is the one on the mountain? When did you go up the mountain and bring it back?"
At this moment, Su Anying finally understood that what her son was hugging was actually the firefox that was raised on the mountain before.
Xu Chenghou went down the mountain last winter, and he didn't go up again after the year, and he didn't have time to find the fox.
Su Anying thought it was Xu Shiyan who went to work in the factory, but he met Lai Pigui and brought him back.
"Where? This guy doesn't know what's going on. He went to our farm to steal chickens, and I caught him again."
Xu Shiyan patted Lai Pigui on the head with a smile, and led his wife and children into the house.
“I was worried that if I stayed in the farm, it would cause trouble again, so I raised it at home.
We have a relationship with it, so we have the right to raise a dog, and we can’t eat much anyway. "
Su Anying thinks about it too. It has been several years. They have moved places several times, and they can always meet rascals. This fate is indeed very deep.
Let’s raise it, it’s not difficult to raise a fox in their family’s conditions.
While speaking, a group of people entered the house, and the rascal also swayed his big tail, and followed everyone into the house.
Su Weizhong was originally staying in the Westinghouse, but when he heard the movement, he came out to look around, only to see Raipi Ghost.
"Hey, this is the fox you mentioned earlier? It looks pretty, and it's not afraid of people. It's quite interesting."
Su Weizhong had heard my uncle mention a fire fox before, and I saw it today.
I don't know if the rascal ghost can understand the words, but it didn't whine at Su Weizhong.
Instead, he swung his big tail and circled Su Weizhong twice before going to the East Room to play with Xu Haiyuan and the others.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui, who were originally sleepy and sloppy, stopped being slutty after seeing the slutty ghost, and happily played with the slutty ghost.
"If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I really wouldn't believe that the wild animals in this mountain could be so docile."
Su Weizhong found it very novel. Who has ever seen a fox that can coax children?

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Technical appraisal
chapters.content:
Su Weizhong originally planned to send Su Anying and Xu Shiqin back, so he returned to Daying by car.
As a result, upon arriving here, I learned that Li Zongliang had taken a fancy to Su Anfang, and that the Li family was coming to see her in the next few days, so Su Weizhong naturally couldn't leave.
So, the next day, Xu Shiyan was asked to call Daying and inform the family that he would go back in a few days.
On the other side, Li Yuexiu went back from Xu's house, went to the elder Li's house, and talked to her there.
As soon as Da Lao Li and his wife heard that Su Weizhong happened to be in Donggang, the couple lost their composure and quickly turned over the solar calendar cards.
It is decided that the day after tomorrow is the 17th, and I will go to see Xu's family.
The Han family hurriedly notified Xu Shiyan again, and rushed to meet Xu Shiyan at Xu Shiyan's house on the 17th.
Su Anfang and Li Zongliang knew each other before, so the so-called seeing each other was just a formality.
It's just a meeting between the parents of the two parties, talking and chatting, even if they admit that the two young people get along.
Su Anfang met each other in the morning, and Su Weizhong returned to Daying by car in the afternoon.
When I go back, I have to tell Mrs. Han about the daughter's marriage.
Han heard that the fifth child also has a partner, and he is also an employee who can drive, so he is very happy.
"The two younger ones in our family are all married to her second sister.
It's a pity that the third and fourth married early, and if it was two years later, they might be able to find a worker. "
While happy, I also feel a little regretful. Of the six daughters, only these two are married to the countryside.
"Cough, be content, you, who can have front and back eyes?
That's great, the six maids are settled, and the rest of us, the old couple, can live in any situation. "
Su Weizhong persuaded his daughter-in-law not to let Mrs. Han think so much.
Su Anying came back from the provincial capital, and everything at home returned to normal.
Sister Su Anhua took care of the flowers at home, while Su Anying and Huang Shengli's wife went to the farm every day to take care of the Clivia in the flower shed and the animals.
Finding a Sunday, Xu Shiyan took advantage of his rest to go to the farm to lead people and pick musk.
There are several more male musk deer that can pick musk this year, the production of musk has increased, and the price of musk has also increased.
Xu Shiyan accompanied Su Anying to send this batch of musk to Tonghua and sold it for more than 10,000 yuan.
At the medicinal materials purchasing station, there were people who wanted to buy musk musk deer from Xu Shiyan, but Xu Shiyan refused.
For the time being, he does not intend to sell the species of musk deer.
Artificially raised musk deer can live up to 17 or 18 years. Except for juvenile and old age, which do not produce musk, they can harvest musk for almost ten years.
The musk that has been harvested in the past ten years can be sold for seven to eight thousand based on the current price, not to mention that the price of musk has increased every year, and it will be more expensive than gold in the future.
Besides, musk deer eat grass and don’t eat meat, so the cost of raising them is not that high. Xu Shiyan was so stupid that he sold them out.
The farm has formal procedures and has a corporate account, so there is no need for Xu Shiyan to go back with the money, and the financial department there can just transfer the money to the farm's account.
So the couple don’t have to worry about anything, they went to Tonghua for a long time and came back by car.
Xu Shiyan just arrived home, thinking about resting for an afternoon before going to work the next day.
As a result, just as he sat down, Li Chengrong came to him in a chilly condition before his **** was warmed up.
"Brother Xu, hurry up, Secretary Lin has something to do with you."
"Ah? Why are you in such a hurry?"
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard that, he asked for leave to go out, Secretary Lin knew, what is so important, he came to look for him knowing he was out?
Thanks to him coming back, otherwise Li Chengrong didn't rush for nothing?
"I don't know, anyway, Secretary Lin is very anxious and asked me to come to you.
If you are not at home, just tell the uncle and aunt that when you come back, no matter how late it is, go to the venue to find Secretary Lin. "Li Chengrong shook his head and said.
"Okay, then let's go, go to the venue and have a look."
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan thought it was a big deal, so he didn't dare to neglect, so he quickly put on his coat and hat, and pushed the car out.
"Xiao Li, please ride slowly, don't worry, I'll go to the field department to find Secretary Lin first."
Xu Shiyan instructed Li Chengrong to leave quickly on his bicycle.
The venue where one attends the venue is not too far away from Xu’s house, only two or three miles away. Xu Shiyan rode his bicycle all the way and arrived soon.
The car was thrown directly outside the gate of the field department building. Xu Shiyan walked in a few steps to the second floor, and went straight to Secretary Lin's office.
"Secretary Lin, it's me." Xu Shiyan knocked on the door outside.
The people in the room heard it and said come in, Xu Shiyan opened the door and went in.
"Secretary Lin, I heard from Xiao Li that you are looking for me?"
Xu Shiyan was thinking all the way, what went wrong that made Secretary Lin so eager to find him?
Is there something wrong with Changbaishan red ginseng? Or was there something wrong with his job?
No, he is careful enough to avoid problems.
Secretary Lin raised his head, and seeing Xu Shiyan's forehead full of lawsuits, he couldn't help laughing immediately.
"Don't worry, it's not that you made a mistake at work, it's a good thing."
Xu Shiyan was relieved when he heard that it was a good thing. He was really worried just now.
He has just joined the field for less than a year. If there is a mistake in his work, he will be sorry for Secretary Lin's cultivation and attention.
"Oh, that's good, that's good." Xu Shiyan smiled innocently.
"Come on, come over and look at this."
Secretary Lin took out a file bag from the cabinet, beckoned Xu Shiyan to come forward, and then pulled out a stack of files from the file bag.
The top thing looks very special, with a red cover, it looks a bit like a certificate of honor.
Xu Shiyan stepped forward, took the document handed over by Secretary Lin and looked through it carefully. It turned out to be the result of the technical appraisal of the cake fertilizer used for ginseng.
Organized by the Changbai Mountain Ginseng Technology Development Board, jointly identified by experts from Jilin Agricultural University, Tonghua Economic Cooperation Office, Special Products Institute of Academy of Agricultural Sciences, Agricultural Economics Management Cadre School, and Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine of medicinal materials companies.
Ginseng cake fertilizer has high output and large branches, the rate of large branches increased by 21%, and the economic benefit increased by 22.6%.
The internal components of ginseng are the same as those of non-fertilized ginseng, even higher than those of non-fertilized ginseng.
This measure is conducive to the development of the industry, and a certificate of scientific and technological achievements will be issued.
At the same time, Xu Shiyan, the inventor of cake fertilizer, was also awarded a certificate of honor.
