"Secretary Lin, this is?" Xu Shiyan was a little excited holding the certificate, which was the affirmation of his superiors.
But it's very strange, who declared this fat cake technology for him?
"You, it seems that you have little experience. This technology has already been taught, why don't you know how to apply for technical appraisal?
I found out that I didn't declare it after I asked someone, so why don't I declare it for you immediately? "
Otherwise, the status is different, and the vision is also different.
In the past, Xu Shiyan was in the second brigade, and Yu Shouguang and Chen Jianzhang were also considered smart and capable people, but they didn't expect this.
Lin Qiyue is different. He knows that science and technology are the primary productive forces, which are extremely valuable.
The technology of applying cake fertilizer and compound fertilizer to ginseng is very mature. Even if there is no reward for the inventor of this technology, it should be affirmed.
Technical appraisal certificate and honorary certificate are the greatest affirmation of Xu Shiyan's ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: glory
chapters.content:
"Secretary Lin, how can I thank you for this?" Xu Shiyan held the two certificates and felt that they were as heavy as a thousand catties.
In the past, they were all advanced individuals, model workers, etc. Most of them were praises for a person's quality.
Although the effect of the ginseng fertilization test is remarkable, apart from being happy and worried for the big guy, Xu Shiyan really didn't expect such a little trick to get a technical appraisal.
From the bottom of his heart, what Xu Shiyan values ​​more is technical approval.
Regardless of whether it is a model worker or an advanced individual, it is a very subjective determination.
As long as they are hardworking and willing to work, it is not uncommon for many people to receive these honors.
Advanced science and technology are irreplaceable. As a technical consultant, Xu Shiyan is the capital of his life, and no one can replace it.
"Thank you? With you taking the lead in our participating technical team, we will definitely be able to develop more products.
I still count on you to come up with more good ideas, take us to participate, and make the ginseng industry bigger and stronger. Secretary Lin patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder with a smile.
"By the way, the two articles you wrote are about narrowing the homework path, and the two articles about transparent film ginseng.
Wasn’t it published in our county’s publications before? I have reported to our Fusong Ginseng Society.
These two papers are well written and are expected to be awarded. I hope you will continue to work hard. "
Lin Qiyue is not only the secretary of the State-owned No. 1 Ginseng Association, but also a permanent director of the Fusong Ginseng Society.
The two articles written by Xu Shiyan were sent to newspapers and magazines after Lin Qiyue read them and confirmed that they could be published.
A while ago, the Ginseng Society called for papers related to ginseng production this year, and Lin Qiyue submitted all of Xu Shiyan's two articles.
Two papers, even if one can be judged for an award, it is very impressive.
For Xu Shiyan, it is tantamount to laying the foundation for his future road, and the future will be smooth.
Xu Shiyan doesn't know what to say right now.
Since I moved out of the big house, I really meet noble people everywhere.
Whether it is Yu Shouguang, Chen Jianzhang, or Lin Qiyue, everyone has helped him a lot.
Especially Lin Qiyue, who can really be said to be Xu Shiyan's bole.
It was he who defied all opinions and dug Xu Shiyan into the arena, giving Xu Shiyan a space to flex his fists.
When a person reaches food and clothing, food and clothing are already secondary, and what is more important is the recognition of him by society.
The same is true for Xu Shiyan now.
The life of the Xu family should be said to have surpassed too many people. Although it is not yet well-off, it is far beyond the line of food and clothing.
Xu Shiyan no longer needs to worry too much about what to eat and what to wear. What he values ​​more is the contribution of personal strength to the unit and society, and the sense of accomplishment that his ideals are realized in his own hands.
"Secretary Lin, I... I don't even know what to say.
Secretary Lin, you can rest assured that I will continue to work hard and lead the technical team to overcome difficulties, work hard to tackle key problems, and make greater achievements.
We will never disappoint the expectations of Secretary Lin and the leaders in the field. "Xu Shiyan was indeed a little excited, and his speech was a little messy.
Xu Shiyan was an old farmer in his previous life, and his experience is there. Even if he keeps learning and growing in this life, he is not good enough after all.
It is already very rare to be able to get to where we are today. If we want to move forward, we need to put in more effort and work hard.
"Okay, as long as you have the drive, as long as you have the ambition, there is nothing you can't do.
You are now the benchmark for our participation, you must take the lead and set an example for young people. "
Lin Qiyue smiled and encouraged Xu Shiyan.
"It's okay, take all the certificates back, put them away, this thing is useful.
Originally, we said that we would hold a celebration party when you came back, but it has been busy for a while, and the venue discussed, let's hold a party on New Year's Day, and celebrate your achievements by the way. "
"Hey, thank you Secretary Lin, then I'll go back first."
Xu Shiyan hugged the file bag, happily left the secretary's office, and walked all the way downstairs.
At the stairs on the first floor, Li Chengrong was waiting. Seeing Xu Shiyan coming down with a smile on his face, Li Chengrong also heaved a sigh of relief.
"Brother Xu, how are you? Are you okay?" In fact, Li Chengrong was also worried, for fear that Xu Shiyan had a problem with his work.
"It's okay, our technical team is fine." Seeing Li Chengrong, Xu Shiyan hurriedly showed him the appraisal certificate.
"That's it. Secretary Lin applied for a technical appraisal to the newspaper. That's why he called me just now."
Everyone in the audience will know about the technical appraisal soon, and there is nothing to hide.
Besides, Li Chengrong and Su Anhua are dating, they will get married in two years, and they will be brother-in-law with Xu Shiyan.
This is a serious relative, what can I hide?
"Great, brother Xu, congratulations, you can treat me when you have time.
For such a big happy event, it would be meaningless not to invite a drink. "
Li Chengrong looked at the certificate of appraisal, envious and happy to replace Xu Shiyan.
"Okay, let your sister-in-law cook some delicious dishes another day. Let's call Shang Zongliang, Brother Limin, and those from the technical team, and let's have a lively time together."
Xu Shiyan agreed without saying a word.
He gets along well with those in the technical team. Others don't know this yet. If they knew, they would definitely clamor for him to treat them.
The two talked while leaving the field department. Xu Shiyan held the document in his arms, and this time he stopped riding the bike, and just pushed the bike back with one hand.
When he got home, he saw his daughter-in-law wandering around like a fly without a head.
Just now Li Chengrong hurried over and said that Secretary Lin was looking for Xu Shiyan, and Xu Shiyan grabbed the car and left. Anyone who saw that situation was afraid.
Su Anying was worried about her husband, because she was afraid that something might go wrong with Xu Shiyan. She was thinking wildly at home, and the more she thought about it, the more afraid she became, so she turned around in a hurry?
"Come back? What's going on? I'm so anxious."
Seeing Xu Shiyan pushing the cart into the yard, Su Anying immediately went out of the house and asked eagerly.
"Look at what you are in a hurry, it's not a bad thing, it's a good thing. Let's go, let's go into the room and tell you."
Xu Shiyan leaned the car on the garden stick casually, then dragged his wife into the house, put the document bag in his arms on the kang, and took out the honorary certificate and technical appraisal certificate from it.
"Daughter-in-law, come and take a look, this is the appraisal certificate of ginseng cake fertilizer technology, and the honorary certificate issued by the superior.
Secretary Lin asked me to go to the venue for this reason. "Xu Shiyan showed the certificate to Su Anying like offering a treasure.
Su Anying didn't understand these things. Although she learned to recognize a lot of characters, she still couldn't understand what was written on it.
But looking at the exquisite cover and the big bright red seal on the certificate, Su Anying knew that this thing must be very remarkable.
"It's amazing, this one should be kept well, I think you should make two more photo frames, put them in the photo frames, and hang them on the wall.
The wall of our house, it would be beautiful if someday your certificates and certificates could be hung all over. "

chapters.title: Chapter 320: end of term
chapters.content:
Chapter 320 End of term
The news that Xu Shiyan had obtained the technical appraisal from the province quickly spread throughout the audience, and those colleagues who got along well with Xu Shiyan all called for Xu Shiyan to treat him.
So they found a day for everyone to rest, Xu Shiyan called all his colleagues home, and Su Anying led the two younger sisters to make two tables of banquets to entertain the guests.
The weather is getting colder and colder, and the winter solstice has passed in a blink of an eye. Xiaodouding Xu Haiyuan, a first-year student, ushered in the final exam.
Two subjects of Chinese and mathematics were easily passed.
Then, with the help of the older brothers, the stove in the classroom was taken down.
This year, primary schools use stoves for heating in winter. In autumn, each student gives two feet of firewood, which can be burned until the end of the day.
When school starts on March 1 next year, there is no need to burn the stove.
So every winter vacation, the stove will be dismantled, and all the stove lids and stove tubes will be kept in the students' homes for safekeeping, so as not to be stolen at school.
Most of the furnace tubes and furnace covers are kept in the homes of the students closest to the school.
In Xu Haiyuan's class, his home is the closest to the school.
So, after the exam, the teacher explained the time to listen to the grades, and assigned the holiday homework.
Then a few strong students lifted or hugged the furnace tube and the furnace cover to Xu Chenghou's end.
"Grandpa, this is something from our school. You put it in the barn and store it properly." Xu Haiyuan told Xu Chenghou.
"Oh, okay, okay, don't worry, I'll put them all in the warehouse, so I can't lose them."
Xu Chenghou hurriedly nodded and put away his things.
These are made of iron and cannot be placed close to the ground, as they are prone to rust, so they must be placed on a shelf.
"Xu Haiyuan, we're leaving, I come to play with you when I have time."
The students put away their things and waved goodbye to Xu Haiyuan one by one. It was just a holiday, and the hearts of the children were all wild.
Xu Haiyuan waved his hands and watched the students leave, turned around and went back to the room, immediately took out his homework book, and started to write homework for the holiday.
Xu Chenghou put the stove lid and stove tube back to the house, and saw his grandson sitting at the small desk, writing carefully.
"Isn't it a holiday? Why are you still doing your homework?" The old man felt strange and asked.
"Our teacher left homework, one matts a day, I'll finish writing these two days first."
Xu Haiyuan wrote seriously, and answered his grandfather's questions without raising his head.
"Back to school in three days, the teacher will announce the test results, and there will be homework by then.
I finish writing earlier, so I can play for a few more days during the Chinese New Year. "
"Oh, that's fine, you can write it if you want." Xu Chenghou nodded and didn't say any more.
Xu Haiyuan has never been a worry about his studies. He has his own plans, so let's take care of them and don't disturb the children.
Xu Haiyuan wrote three homework in one go, and then stopped, and also on the second day of the holiday. He didn't do anything, so he did homework at home.
After writing for three days in a row, it's time to go back to school to listen to the grades.
December 27th at eight o'clock in the morning, Xu Haiyuan carried a small schoolbag and went back to school with Huang Shuqing.
As for Xu Jinping, Huang Shuyun, Sun Yu and others, the Yuhong class had already been on vacation.
Xu Haiyuan and Huang Shuqing are not in the same class, and the two went back to their respective classes at school.
The stove has been removed, and the class is dead cold.
The teacher didn't say much, just handed out the papers and read them on the class list.
Then according to the test scores, homework was assigned to the children, and it was over when they returned to school. There are few homework with good grades, and a lot of homework for those with poor grades.
The children with good grades walked back happily, while those with poor grades looked bitter, not knowing how to explain to their families.
Xu Haiyuan returned to his grandparents with his schoolbag on his back. As soon as he entered the door, Zhou Guilan asked with a smile, "Hey, my grandson is back? How is it? How many points did you get?"
The old lady just asked casually, no matter how much the child scored in the test, in the hearts of grandparents, as long as the child is healthy and healthy.
Xu Haiyuan went to elementary school at the age of six. It is enough to keep up and not to fall behind. There are not so many requirements.
"Double hundred, the paper is so simple that you still lose points?"
Xu Haiyuan looked calm, took the paper out of his schoolbag, and handed it to his grandparents.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan are both illiterate, but they still know the hundred.
Besides, the whole article is full of red checkmarks, without a single cross, and I know it is a perfect score.
"Hey, my eldest grandson is really good, he passed the double hundred exam.
Come on, let's make dumplings this afternoon. My grandson has worked hard in his studies, so let's eat something good. "
Zhou Guilan was very happy, and immediately decided to make dumplings in the afternoon.
"Yes, yes, make dumplings. My eldest grandson is so good in the exam, I must eat dumplings to celebrate." Xu Chenghou also echoed.
Xu Haiyuan was embarrassed all the time, how difficult can the first grade exam be?
He just got a perfect score in the exam. Are grandparents so happy?
"No need? It seems that I just ate it a few days ago."
That's right, the night Xu Shiyan got his certificate back, he also made dumplings to celebrate. It's only been a week, and it's time to make dumplings again.
"Can it be the same? When your brothers were in the first grade, they didn't hear that they came back from the double hundred exam.
My eldest grandson is so promising that he must make dumplings. "Xu Chenghou didn't care about that, he went to buy meat after putting on his shoes.
Zhou Guilan began to think about what kind of dumplings to make in the afternoon.
The sauerkraut stuffing last time, let’s make cabbage stuffing this time, the cabbage is in the cellar, Zhou Guilan hurried to the cellar to get the cabbage.
Only Xu Haiyuan was left, looking at the paper with a dazed expression, this, really don't need to celebrate, okay?
Xu Haiyuan's objection was invalid. In the afternoon, Zhou Guilan led sister Su Anfang and Xu Shiqin, who was recuperating at home, to make dumplings together.
Waiting for Su Anying and Xu Shiyan to come back, the couple were also a little confused. It's not a new year, and it's still a few days before New Year's Day. Why are you making dumplings again?
When he learned that his parents were celebrating Xu Haiyuan's double hundred exams, Xu Shiyan also looked helpless.
This old couple are too good at spoiling children, right? A double-hundred in the first-year exam is worth celebrating by making dumplings with such fanfare?
"Son, in your class, how many double hundred students passed the exam?"
Xu Haiyuan got a full score in the exam, even if they were tied, it would be considered first, so Xu Shiyan didn't ask about the ranking, but only asked how many double-hundred students in the class.
Xu Haiyuan tilted his head and thought for a while, then shrugged and shook his head.
"No, some have a hundred in mathematics, and others have a hundred in Chinese, and I am the only one who has a double hundred."
"Oh, then you did pretty well in the exam, okay, keep it up, I hope you can always have this grade."
Xu Shiyan nodded, it seems that his son is really good at learning.
"By the way, how many points did your elder brother Shuqing get in the test?" Xu Shiyan just asked casually.
"I don't know, I asked him, but he refused to tell." Xu Haiyuan shook his head.
"I guess it's not very good, otherwise he must have shown off to me."
Well, what else is there that I don’t understand? That kid Huang Shuqing must have failed the exam.
I don't know if Huang Shengli will be angry and beat his son when he looks at his son's exam paper.

chapters.title: Chapter 321: celebrate
chapters.content:
Chapter 321 Celebration
When Huang Shuqing came to play with Xu Haiyuan the next day, he didn't seem to be able to walk very smoothly, limping around.
Needless to say, he must have been beaten.
But children are skinny, no matter how painful they are, it won’t delay their mischief. It’s finally a holiday, so why not play hard?
Xu Shiyan secretly asked Xu Haiyuan to drag Huang Shuqing to do some homework every day, and then go out to play after finishing.
Not to mention, Huang Shuqing really listened to what Xu Haiyuan said.
Huang Shuqing came to do his homework every morning, and Xu Haiyuan could explain the questions he didn't know.
Huang Shuqing wrote the questions for the first semester of the first grade, while Xu Haiyuan previewed the next semester's courses.
Both of them finished their homework, and then went out to play with other children.
After coming and going, Huang Shuqing didn't feel so disgusted with homework anymore, and came to write with Xu Haiyuan every day.
In a blink of an eye, the New Year's Day in 1984 arrived, and a party was organized to welcome the New Year's Day.
All the participating departments have arranged manpower, and together with the comrades of the participating art troupe, they will perform together.
This is the New Year's Day party, and it is also a celebration party for the comrades in the technical team.
At the opening of the celebration, Secretary Lin personally read out the appraisal report of Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng, and at the same time announced a piece of good news.
The 2,000 boxes of Changbai Mountain red ginseng produced by the ginseng farm were brought to the order meeting by the provincial medicinal material company, and the response was good. Many foreign businessmen signed an order contract for Changbai Mountain red ginseng with the province.
Starting next year, the first ginseng farm will increase the production of Changbai Mountain red ginseng.
"Our Changbai Mountain red ginseng, 16 pieces in a box, the order price is 388.
Comrades, how much is the purchase price of ordinary red ginseng unitary six? Two hundred and sixteen.
Remove the price difference in weight, remove our packaging material fees, processing fees and other expenses, and you can earn an extra 100 yuan per catty.
One hundred yuan a catty, comrades, this is not a small amount, just for this item, if we do well next year, we can earn millions of yuan more.
So I say, the comrades in the technical group have made great contributions. "
When Lin Qiyue supported Xu Shiyan and others in the development of Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng, he never expected that the upgraded technology would bring such a huge profit.
This is only one item of Changbai Mountain red ginseng. If the deep processing of the ginseng industry is done according to Xu Shiyan's vision, how much will the output value increase in the future?
With this money, how much can you do?
Among other things, you can add a lot of cars and tractors to the venue, which can fully realize mechanized production.
It can give more bonuses to employees, and can also improve housing and living conditions for employees. How good is it?
Lin Qiyue spoke with great passion on the stage, and all the employees listened to it with enthusiasm.
Everyone was overjoyed and applauded desperately.
Then, several leaders present presented awards, bonuses, and big red flowers to the comrades in the technical group. For a while, the scene was extremely lively.
Xu Shiyan showed his colleagues in the technical group, and was booed by everyone, and sang a song together.
Afterwards, the party officially began, and the programs selected by each department were very exciting.
The show ran from 8:00 am to 11:30 am. After the gala ended, everyone left one after another, and the afternoon was off.
Xu Shiyan was surrounded by everyone, wearing big red flowers, went out of the field, and rode his bicycle back home.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were very happy when they saw their son wearing a big red flower on his chest and a certificate in his pocket.
Since he came to Donggang, the son of his family has been getting better and better every day, receiving various certificates and awards non-stop.
As a parent, who doesn’t look forward to the success of their children?
At the beginning, I felt that the third child was not going to be very promising in this life, and it would be nice to be able to farm and grow ginseng in a big house honestly.
Who would have thought that the third child would have such a good time?
Xu Chenghou was happy, and while eating dumplings at night, he dragged Xu Shiyan to drink a few glasses of wine.
While drinking, Xu Chenghou also said that he shouldn't scold his son all day long.
"I didn't realize until now that the production team is full of help, and the work that only asks for quantity but not quality is not suitable for you at all.
You, you should do this kind of work that can endure loneliness and do research in a down-to-earth manner.
You went to participate in the field, this step is really right. "
At this time, the old man finally understood that it wasn't that his son was useless, but that his son had never found a suitable position.
Look at the present, isn't this in the right position, shining brightly?
"Father, let's not mention those things in the past, it's for my own good.
Aren’t the production teams like that at that time? Working for the team to earn work points, everyone wants to earn more, just fool the big noodles. "
Times have changed, and it has been six or seven years since he was reborn, and he has long since lost his original resentment.
Now Xu Shiyan has a peaceful mind and can face the past squarely.
Born in this age, in that kind of environment, his father only hated him.
This night, both of them drank a lot of wine and talked a lot drunk.
Father and son have completely untied their knots, no one is entangled with those things in the past, life will continue, and everything should look forward.
In September 1983, Donggang Commune was renamed Donggang Township, and all the brigades under its jurisdiction were also renamed Villages.
The first brigade was renamed Dongshen Village, the second brigade was renamed Donggang Village, and the third brigade was renamed Xishen Village.
After New Year’s Day, Donggang Village convened a meeting of villagers to distribute this year’s ginseng land dividends to each household.
But compared to last year, this year's points are obviously less. It's not just the Xu family who are young, but everyone.
Obviously this year's ginseng harvest has increased, and the price of sticks is also higher than in previous years, but the income of each family is not more, but less.
Everyone is not very happy, but there is nothing they can do.
The leader said that it is the part that is less issued, and the deductions are based on items such as participation fees, withdrawals, and overall fundraising. What can I do? I can only admit it.
Out of the village, everyone was talking about it, saying that the village was too harsh.
But they can only discuss it in private, there is no other way.
"Third brother, it's still good for you, you have become a worker, and you don't have to deduct this or that when you receive your salary every month.
Look at you, cotton coats, overalls, water boots, raincoats, and gloves are all distributed in the field.
There is a monthly salary, and there are benefits during the holidays. I am really envious. "
Xu Shiyan and his wife were busy and didn't go to the meeting. Huang Shengli and others helped Xu Shiyan get the money and sent it to Xu Shiyan.
Speaking of money, the big guy couldn't help complaining.
"Why do you envy me? I still envy you for being free. Look at me, I go to work every day, and I'm so dead that I can't do anything."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, regardless of workers and peasants, there are advantages and disadvantages, and everything has two sides.
"Forget it, there are still left for next year's mallet, so give as much as you want.
In the future, we will develop the club by ourselves. Except for handing in tasks to the village every year, the rest will be our own.
As long as you work hard, are you afraid that your life will be bad? "Xu Shiyan can only comfort the big guys like this.
"By the way, I greeted my friends from the Forestry Bureau.
Next year, the few of us will form a partnership together to cover a piece of land. How good it is for us to develop and participate in the field ourselves. "
This is the direction they are going to develop next, rather than worrying about how much the village has deducted.

chapters.title: Chapter 322: cat winter
chapters.content:
Chapter 322 Cat Winter
Participate in the field, doing the work of old farmers in the name of workers.
After the winter, the crop farm has nothing to do and stays at home. In fact, most of the workers participating in the field are the same. In winter, they basically stay at home.
Better than the crop yard, the workers participating in the field are paid even if they are idle, and the benefits are not delayed.
The work at the processing plant is all over.
The ginseng processed this year, except for the honey slices that are still marinating in the container, the others have already been packed and shipped to the provincial medicinal materials and health care products company.
This year, the yield of ginseng in the first ginseng field is high, and there are many large branches, so the benefits are naturally higher than in previous years.
Secretary Lin laughed all day long, saying that he was waiting for the medicinal material company to settle the payment before giving benefits to everyone.
The technical team is not as busy as before. Two people are arranged to take turns on duty every day, so what should the others do.
Xu Shiyan is the team leader, so he goes to the field department every now and then to make a call, and it's just like going to the technical team for a walk.
The rest of the time, most of the time went to the farm to watch and replace Su Anying.
At the other end of the farm, all kinds of feed are stored.
The Xu family has a good relationship with the Su family of the grain depot. Xu Shiyan also bought a lot of old grain from the grain depot, which is matched with green storage feed, which is enough to ensure that the animals in the farm survive the winter.
The flower shed is normally heated, and the Clivia inside is growing well. This autumn and winter, another batch of seeds have been harvested, and some of them have already sprouted green leaves.
Xu Shiyan counted, two flower sheds, plus the flowers grown in the three houses at home, there are more than 10,000 pots of Clivia in total.
Waiting to sell all these Clivias, they will have the capital to develop and can use their fists.
Xu Shiyan went to the farm to keep an eye on it, while Su Anying was free and went home to take care of the children.
and Zhou Guilan soaked a lot of rice again, and began to wrap the sticky fire spoon.
Fortunately, sisters Su Anfang are also here, Xu Shiqin asked for leave to recuperate and hasn't returned to work yet.
The big guys worked together, worked hard for two days, and finally wrapped up all the sticky fire spoons.
Filled with a large wooden tank, plus a large wooden barrel.
"Second sister, I discussed it with my younger sister. We want to go home tomorrow."
After wrapping the sticky fire spoon, I don't have much thought here. Sister Su Anfang discussed with Su Anying.
The two sisters have been in Donggang since the first lunar month, and it seems that it has been almost a year, and they only go back twice in the middle.
Exactly two days ago, the wages of the processing factory were also settled, and the two sisters earned about 100 yuan each.
The two sisters thought about it, taking advantage of the fact that the second sister's house is not busy recently, they went back to Daying to accompany their parents, and they will come again when they are busy here in the next year.
"Oh, okay, it's time to go back, my mother doesn't know how to miss you two.
Then tomorrow morning, ask your brother-in-law to drive the bus and take you two to the station. "
This year, thanks to the help of her two younger sisters, otherwise Su Anying would have been too busy with eight hands.
Since the younger sister wants to go back, they must not be left empty-handed.
"Wait a minute, both of you, I'll find something, and you two will take it back to your parents."
Su Anying got up, went to the back room to search, scratched a lot of things.
Then he took out some money from the cabinet and handed it to the two younger sisters.
"These three hundred, you two help me bring them to my parents. I am busy on this side, and I am afraid that I will not have time to go back a year ago, so that my parents can buy some things for the New Year.
This one hundred, you two take it, go to Songjianghe later, buy whatever you like. "
"Second sister, we don't want money, and you usually give us a lot."
Sister Su Anfang hurriedly waved her hands. They have food and housing here. Usually, the elder sister also gives pocket money, which is much better than farming at home. How can they ask for more money?
"Look, this isn't for you guys, it's money for parents during the Chinese New Year.
Be obedient, take it back for my sister, wait for the new year, my sister will take the child back to live for a few days. "
Su Anying put the money into Su Anfang's coat pocket without saying a word.
"By the way, you guys are going home, have you told Xiao Li and Xiao Li?"
One of the two brothers-in-law’s surname is Li and the other’s surname is Li.
"Well, yes, they both said they were going to take us home."
Li Chengrong and Li Zongliang are not busy recently, and they wish they could go to Xu's house every day, so why don't they know that Su Anfang and the others are leaving?
"Oh, that's fine, I'm relieved to have them deliver it." Su Anying nodded upon hearing this.
It's okay, these two boys are quite good at things, and the date is going home, so they follow to see off, just in time to meet the future father-in-law and mother-in-law, very good.
Xu Shiyan learned that the two sisters-in-law were going back, so Li Chengrong and Li Zongliang went to see them off, and hurried to the farm, where they killed a sheep and a few chickens, and left them outside overnight, until they were frozen hard.
The next morning, Xu Shiyan got into the carriage and sent his two sisters-in-law, Li Chengrong, and Li Zongliang to the station.
The two boys bought a lot of things, plus the clothes and luggage of Sister Su Anhua, and the things Xu Shiyan and Su Anying prepared for the family, the four of them finally got into the car with their straps on their shoulders.
Xu Shiyan watched them all get into the carriage, and then drove the carriage home.
Li Chengrong and Li Zongliang escorted the Su family sisters back to Daying Village, and were warmly received by the Su family.
Su Weicheng's family, as well as Su Anzhen and Nan Zhendong's husband and wife, all came.
Even some friends who have a good relationship with the Su family also came to see the new uncle.
We all know that the two daughters of the Su family have gone to Donggang, and I also heard Su Weizhong mention that the two daughters found a partner there, and they were both workers in the field.
Many people were envious and curious, not knowing what kind of workers participated in this field.
Looking at it, hey, the two young men are both good-looking, and they are neatly dressed. At first glance, they look different from the mud legs of the crop yard.
Everyone congratulated Su Weizhong and his wife one after another, and at the same time they were too greedy.
I used to think that the six daughters of the Su family had no sons, and they all joked behind their backs, but now?
Among the six sons-in-law, four are workers.
One son-in-law is half a child, and these six sons-in-law are quite promising. No matter what happens in the future, Su Weizhong and his wife can be taken care of, and they won't fall to the ground.
There are also those who are not right-minded and love to sow discord, so they go to Zhou's house and give Zhou Anping and Zhou Anfu brothers eye drops.
"Old Brother Zhou, Second Brother, I didn't say anything, you two are his own uncles, he is living a better life now, why don't you want to drag your relatives?"
"Why don't you say, your brother-in-law and younger sister are too, why don't you take care of their three children?
If you have money, you can’t make such a mess. The two sister-in-laws will live here for nearly a year. How much does it cost to eat and live?
With that money, why don’t you come back to see the two uncles?
I can see it, since your old lady is not here, your relatives are separated. "
"You didn't see it just now. When the two girls from the old Su family entered the village, they brought back a lot of things including bags and straps.
You said that he only knows how to help his father-in-law, but why doesn't he know how to help his mother-in-law's family? "
There are people like this who don’t look good at others, and specialize in doing things that pick and choose.
"Uncle Tao, how much money does your family earn this year?
I heard that your eldest son is also doing well, isn't he? Then why didn't you see him pulling his old uncle?
Talking about those useless, why? Life in our family is worse than yours? What are you worrying about here? "
Zhou Wanxiang, the son of Zhou Anfu's family, pushed him back unceremoniously.

chapters.title: Chapter 323: got engaged
chapters.content:
Chapter 323 Engagement
This year’s New Year’s Eve falls on February 1st, as usual, Xu Shiyan took his wife and children back to celebrate the New Year with his parents.
On the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, Xu Shiyan asked someone for help and killed a pig and a few sheep.
In addition, I also killed a doe who didn't know what was wrong, maybe it was too frightened and always miscarried.
Mutton and venison were distributed to many relatives and friends, and half of the pork did not need to be sold to the supply and marketing cooperatives, all of which were kept for the New Year.
In addition, Xu Shiyan went up the mountain with Han Limin and others in the twelfth lunar month to hunt some wild game, so this year has been very prosperous.
Seeing that the days are getting better every year, Xu Chenghou and his wife are also very happy.
All four grandchildren were given big red envelopes, which made the four children so beautiful.
For Xu Shiyan, the only regret is that he does not have TV and cannot watch the Spring Festival Gala.
There is no other way if it is true, TV tickets are too difficult to find.
A few years ago, there were a few quotas for participating in the field, the secretary, deputy secretary, field leader, and branch field leader. These cadres are not enough, and Xu Shiyan has no turn at all.
If you don’t have it, you don’t have it, wait slowly, you can always wait for the opportunity.
On the first day of the Lunar New Year, Xu Shiyan went to the houses of Lin Qiyue, Li Bingzhuo, and Guo Shouye to pay New Year's greetings.
On the second day of the Lunar New Year, Xu Shixian's brothers came back with their wife and children, and they were very happy when they learned that Xu Shiqin had finished the operation and was in good health.
At the same time, they also apologized. They were too busy to follow Xu Shiqin to the provincial capital.
Several daughters-in-law also said to Zhou Guilan that the sister-in-law came back from the operation, and the family didn't give a letter, so they came back to take a look.
Regarding this, Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan had a very tacit understanding, they just listened silently, and neither of them said anything.
It’s just that Xu Chenghou mentioned to his sons that starting this year, the pension will be ten yuan a month.
Prices have risen, wages have also risen, and pensions have to go up too. Otherwise, how can there be enough money?
Ten yuan will be ten yuan, and an increase of two yuan is still acceptable, so it is settled.
The family still prepared all kinds of materials, and several daughters-in-law worked together to make two tables of delicious food.
The big guys got together lively, talking and laughing very happy.
On the third day of the Lunar New Year, Xu Shiyan led his wife and children back to Daying, and the whole family was reunited.
Su Weizhong and his wife were very happy to see their grandchildren, and gave red envelopes to the children one by one.
But these children were so happy that they held red envelopes and refused to let go, and their mother would not give them.
"Okay, let the children be happy for a while after the Chinese New Year. It doesn't have much money, let them keep it."
Su Weizhong saw that Qin Meiling was angry with his daughter, so he hurriedly persuaded her.
"Hold the money by yourself, keep it in your pocket, but don't lose it.
All right, let's go play, Xiaoli, you are the biggest, take care of your brothers and sisters. "Su Weizhong patted his granddaughter's head and warned in a gentle voice.
"Understood, grandpa, I will lead them to play in front of our house, not to go too far."
Sui Xiaoli was born in 1977, and she was eight years later. The little girl was pretty and well-behaved, so she nodded her head in agreement.
After that, I led my younger brothers and sisters to the gate to play.
Xu Haiyuan is seven years old, Sui Xiaojun and Xu Jinping are six years old, and Nan Xiaoming is five years old.
These few are still a little older, and they can play together, so they will make a snowman outside and have a snowball fight.
Xu Haiqing, Xu Jinhui, and Ji Hongliang are only three years old, but they are not left behind, and they have to go out to play with them.
Nothing to do, Su Weizhong sent his old daughter, Su Anhua, to go out to accompany the children, mainly to keep an eye on them, and not to run to the river to make a fuss.
There is a river between Daying Village and Hebei Village, called Tanghe. The Tanghe River passes through the Hot Spring Village, so there is hot spring water coming down.
The surface of the river was freezing in some places, so I was afraid that the child would accidentally fall down and cause an accident.
Qin Meiling, Su Anying, and Su Anfen are all married to other places. Throughout the year, the sisters finally meet each other. Of course, they have to get together for two days of fun.
Moreover, there is another big event to be done this year, Su Anfang is going to get engaged, and the date is set on the sixth day of the first lunar month.
Su Anfang is 21 this year, and Li Zongliang is 24. They are not young, and they both feel that they get along well after being together for a while.
So Li Zongliang took advantage of the time when he came back to the Su family to mention the engagement to Su Weizhong.
The Su family readily agreed, and then chose a date, which was set on the sixth day of the first lunar month.
When Li Zongliang came last time, Su Anzhen met him, but Qin Meiling and Su Anfen didn't have time to meet him.
The fifth younger sister is going to get engaged. Of course, these sisters and brothers-in-law have to stay to help out and meet their future brothers-in-law.
On the morning of the sixth day of the first lunar month, Li Zongliang, accompanied by his parents and Li Yuexiu, took the train to Daying. Take the train to Xianrenqiao Station.
When the four of them got out of the car, they saw Xu Shiyan and several people waving at them. Needless to say, the Su family must have arranged for someone to pick them up.
"Hey, it's so cold, and I asked you to come to the station to pick me up.
Actually, there is no need. Zong Liang has been here once and knows the way to go, so we just walk over. "As soon as Da Lao Li saw Xu Shiyan, he said hurriedly.
"How can I do that? Uncle Li, Aunt Li, and Aunt Han have come all the way, so they have to come here to pick them up.
Our conditions are not good. There is no jeep, only a carriage. Come on, anyway, we will arrive in a while. "
Xu Shiyan said half-jokingly, and then led everyone to go outside the station. When he went outside, he saw that a carriage had already parked there, and the driver was the youngest of Su Weicheng's family.
It would be nice to have a car to pick them up. How could the Li family pick these?
Everyone got into the carriage, Su Anmin flicked his whip, drove the carriage out of Xianren Bridge, and walked towards Daying Village.
In the first month of the lunar year, it was a time to visit relatives and friends. The news that the five daughters of the Su family were getting engaged had spread throughout the village.
Taking advantage of the good weather, many people were waiting outside, wanting to see what the fifth uncle of the Su family brought for their engagement.
No way, people in small villages usually don’t have much entertainment, and they only care about their parents.
Who's old sow gave birth, whose man was making broken shoes outside, which little widow's house was gone.
These things are just the stuff of other people's conversation, so gossip about other people's family after dinner, this day will pass by day by day.
When Li Chengrong and Li Zongliang came to Daying last time, many people saw it, and I don’t know how many people secretly envied it.
Everyone also wanted to see what the participating workers brought to the woman when they got engaged.
So when the carriage entered the village, needless to say, there were many people standing on both sides of the road, all pointing at the people on the carriage.
"Hey, did you see it? I took a lot of things in big and small bags.
Oops, this worker is different from the old farmer, look at his clothes. "
"Isn't it? Look how energetic that young man is? He's quite innocent.
Unlike those in our village, they all look like black charcoal. It's good to have a serious job. "There was a lot of discussion among the people, all kinds of emotion.
The three members of the Li family came to the door of the Su family under the attention of everyone, got out of the car and entered the yard with their things.
There are only four changes today, let me take it easy, I really can’t write it, alas.

chapters.title: Chapter 324: bride price
chapters.content:
Chapter 324 bride price
When the Li family arrived, everyone in the Su family welcomed them warmly. The in-laws met and greeted each other, and then sat down.
As a matchmaker, Li Yuexiu had to speak first.
"Brother-in-law, sister-in-law, and me, entrusted by Lao Li and his wife, to be a matchmaker for the two children."
"These two children are engaged today, so let's not talk about those foolish things.
Here is the engagement wedding prepared by the Li family. Let's take a look. If you think there is something missing, feel free to mention it. We can talk about it. "
Li Yuexiu is an open-minded person, straight to the point, and put all the things prepared by the Li family on the table.
Four bottles of wine, loin meat with four ribs, four handfuls of vermicelli tied with red strings, and four boxes of snacks.
This is an engagement wedding that has become popular in Songjianghe recently. These four ceremonies alone cost a lot of money.
Waiting for the engagement to be completed, the woman keeps half of the four gifts, and the man has to bring the other half back.
There are also some people who are reluctant to spend so much money, so they simply prepare half of it, so that they don't have to bring it back when the time comes.
The Li family is not short of money, and it’s also for the sake of looking good.
In addition to the four necessary gifts for engagement, the Li family also prepared a set of clothes, a pair of leather shoes, a watch, and two catties of wool for Su Anfang, and also gave Su Anfang a bride price of 160 yuan.
In this year and month, it is definitely a high standard. For ordinary people, it is very good if they can make a set of clothes for them and buy them a pair of shoes.
If the conditions are better, adding a watch will be enough.
Where have I heard that there are betrothal gifts? Anyway, there has never been one in Daying Village.
When Su Anying and Su Anzhen got engaged, there was no mention of bride price.
These things plus the dowry were placed on the table, inside and outside of Su's house, even those people lying outside the windows and looking in at the door, were all stunned and dumbfounded.
God, so many things, and money, how much do you get in total? Not three or four hundred?
"No wonder people say that it is good to be a worker, and that the workers who participate in the factory are rich, which is really amazing.
You just say, there is a family in our village, which young man is engaged and can come up with these things?
No wonder the old Su family wants to send their daughter to Donggang, instead of looking for it in our village, look, let others scoop it up, right? "
Some people were envious, so they whispered at the door of Su's house.
"That's right, who is as smart as the old Su family couple?
At that time, the second girl married pretty well, but now, you see, they are all followed, right?
Oops, why don't we have such a good son-in-law in our house? "
This speech is even more sour, there is no way, it is too greedy, who would not be jealous after seeing it?
What is said outside, can actually be heard inside the house.
Su Weizhong was happy in his heart, and he didn't want to argue with those people outside, so he could say whatever he liked.
In the past, these people secretly laughed at him for not having a son, and no one will take care of him in the future, but now everyone is envious?
Su Weizhong doesn't care, Su Weicheng is not happy, what is this for? All these outs one by one are not shameful enough.
Let the Li family see it, and they can't say that the people in the small village are just ignorant? No fuss about anything. It's so embarrassing.
"Well, our family has a happy event today, so we won't keep the big guys.
Another day, when the fifth child goes out, he must prepare a banquet, and invite everyone to come and drink the wedding wine.
Don’t suffer from freezing outside in this cold weather, everyone, go home, go home. "Su Weicheng turned cold and went out to chase those people away.
They are all neighbors in the neighborhood, and they can't be too shameless no matter how they look down.
The Su family all came out, and they couldn't stay here any longer, so they all smiled and said a few words to Su Weicheng, then turned and left.
Su Weicheng watched those people leave, then snorted, and told his third child to watch outside and not let those irrelevant people come over.
Su Weicheng chased away those onlookers, turned and went back to the house.
The room is very lively at the moment, Su Weizhong and Li Zheng, who is the eldest brother Li, are chatting very warmly.
Han's and Feng's chat with Zhao Meijuan and Li Yuexiu, and they got closer and closer.
Engagement is always at the woman's home, and the woman should prepare a sumptuous feast to entertain the man's family.
It happened to be in the first lunar month, and every household had delicious food. Su Weizhong knew that he was going to be engaged to his daughter after the year, so he specially saved a lot of meat.
At the moment, Qin Meiling and the others are busy in the kitchen, frying and frying for a meal, making several delicious dishes.
So a table was set up in the east room and the west room, and Su Anhua and Su Anyu led the children in the family to dinner at Su Weicheng's house next door.
At the beginning of the banquet, Li Zongliang and Su Anfang had to toast the matchmaker first, and then toast to the parents of both parties and change their words.
Su Weizhong and his wife, and Li Zheng and his wife, also took out the red envelopes prepared in advance, and gave them the change money.
By this time, the engagement ceremony is over, and then there is nothing else to do, it is time to eat and drink.
The Su family entertained them warmly and kept urging the Li family to drink and eat food. Su Weizhong and Su Weicheng accompanied Li Zheng to drink.
Xu Shiyan and other brothers-in-law and Su Anbang and Su Anmin accompanied Li Zongliang.
Everyone exchanged cups, drank and chatted, and the atmosphere was very harmonious.
There are several trains going to Songjiang River passing through Xianren Bridge, and there is still a slow train in the afternoon, so the Li family is not in a hurry to leave.
This meal started at twelve o'clock and lasted until two o'clock. It was mainly men who drank, and women actually ate fast.
The men didn't drink less, and they were all a little confused in the end.
Li Zongliang looked at his watch, it was getting late, and they had to go to the station quickly.
"Eldest brother-in-law, second brother-in-law, I really can't drink anymore, we asked when we came, there is still a slow train at three o'clock in the afternoon.
It's getting late, we have to go back quickly, or we won't be able to catch the train. "
"Hey, if you can't make it, then you won't make it. If you can't make it, you'll stay and live here. What are you afraid of?" Sui Hongzhi's tongue was a little hard when he drank.
"No, no, no, the two younger sisters are the only housekeepers at home. If they don't go back at night, the two of them will cry in fright?"
Li Zongliang hurriedly waved his hands, there is no such rule as living in the husband's house on the day of engagement.
Over there, Da Lao Li also told Su Weizhong and Su Weicheng about the family situation, and they had to catch the train back.
Su Weizhong had to keep it for a while, but in the end he had no choice but to ask the Han family to separate the four gifts and take half of them back to the Li family.
Su Anmin was young and hadn't had a few sips of wine, so he sent him to drive.
Sui Hongzhi and Xu Shiyan followed, and took the Li family to Xianrenqiao Station in a carriage.
Xu Shiyan had a better drinker and was quite sober. He went directly to the ticket window and bought four tickets for Da Lao Li.
"Uncle Li, I have to stay here for a few more days, so I can't go back with you, so be careful on the way back.
When I go back, find time to invite Uncle Li to drink at home. "
"Oh, look at you, how can you buy a ticket for this? No, no." Big Lao Li hurriedly refused.
"Look, I've bought all the tickets, so you still let me refund it? There's not much money in total, so Uncle Li is still being polite to me?"
Xu Shiyan smiled, gave the ticket to Da Lao Li, and stayed with them for a while, until there was a call to check the ticket, and then he watched the four people check the ticket and enter the station.

chapters.title: Chapter 325: look at ice lanterns
chapters.content:
Chapter 325 Looking at the ice lamp
Xu Shiyan stayed in Daying for another two days, during which time he visited his uncle Zhou Anping, his second uncle Zhou Anfu, and his aunt Zhou Guizhi.
On the eighth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan returned to Donggang with his wife and children, and sister Su Anfang.
The wedding date of Su Anfang and Li Zongliang was set on June 17th, 1984, May 16th in the lunar calendar.
At that time, the spring plowing had already ended, and the participation was not too busy, and the weather was not too hot, so it happened to be a banquet.
The wedding date has been set, so it is said that Su Anfang has to stay at home and prepare for marriage with peace of mind.
But Su Anfang said that she didn't know anything, and wanted to go back to Donggang and ask Xu Shiqin to teach her how to embroider curtains and curtains.
Su Weizhong and his wife are clear in their hearts, the daughter is in love with someone, and she doesn't want to stay in Daying.
What can I do? We are engaged, we will get married in a few months, oops, I just turned a blind eye and closed my eyes, so I nodded and agreed.
Just like that, Sister Su Anfang went back to the Xu family.
The fifteenth day of the first lunar month is the year, and there is no work to participate in the field, and they are all on holiday and do not go to work.
So, on the ninth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan invited colleagues to participate, and on the tenth day, Huang Shengli and others were invited.
In the blink of an eye, the fifteenth day of the first lunar month came, and the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau set up ice lanterns again. This year, it was reported that fireworks were also set off.
Li Zongliang and Li Chengrong made appointments with Sister Su Anfang early on to watch the ice lanterns and fireworks together on the fifteenth night.
"You two should go too, Yingzi has been taking care of the children for the past few years, and she didn't go out for a walk.
Now that the children are grown up, let them stay at home, and you, husband and wife, and Shiqin, go out for a walk. "
Fifteenth afternoon had dinner early, before Li Chengrong and the others came, Xu Chenghou said to Xu Shiyan.
"Father, why don't you and my mother go to see the ice lantern?"
Leaving the children with the elderly, the couple go shopping, watch fireworks and ice lanterns, isn’t it good?
"My mother and I went for a walk a few days ago and read it." Xu Chenghou made excuses at will.
They did go to see it, it was during the daytime, they went to watch Yangko twisting, and they took a look at the ice lanterns along the way.
What’s the point of looking at the ice lantern during the day? It’s only good when the light is on at night.
"You guys go, there must be a lot of people going to Songjiang River tonight, it's very crowded.
Your mother and I are old-timers, so we don’t want to join in the fun.
You youngsters go out to play, and take care of them. Although we caught a batch last year, there are a lot of hooligans in Songjianghe.
Hua'er and Fang'er are both young girls, and Xiao Li and Xiao Li have nothing to do, so there are a few more people to go tonight, and there is also a care. "
Xu Chenghou is so old, what things can't be imagined?
He asked his son and daughter-in-law to go, relaxing his mind was one thing, and protecting Su Anfang and Su Anhua was another.
Xu Shiyan was right when he thought about it, so he didn't argue with his parents anymore, he just told Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping not to be naughty at their grandparents' house, and to go to bed early at night.
The main reason is that the children go to bed early, and when they go out at night, these children will be so sleepy that they will sleep no matter how long they go shopping.
When a large group of people go out, they can't disturb everyone's interest because of their own children.
Besides, there are too many people at this time, what if the child is lost and lost?
Forget it, wait until the child grows up in a few years.
Xu Haiyuan was obedient, and didn't make a fuss about going to see the ice lantern, "Well, don't worry, Dad, I'll take care of my younger siblings."
The longer the baby grows, the more he looks like a big brother.
Xu Shiyan thought for a moment, since he was going to see the ice lanterns, it wouldn't be as lively as there were many people. So I asked Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng and others.
It's rare to have an entertainment project these days, who wouldn't want to go? So these people all brought their own wives, some even brought their younger sisters and so on.
Now, a large group of people.
At 6:30 in the evening, Li Chengrong, Li Zongliang, Han Limin and his wife, Han Lixin and his wife came together.
The Han Limin brothers heard from Li Chengrong that they were going to take Su Anhua to see the ice lantern.
After thinking about it, they might as well bring their wives together and go out for a walk, and they happened to be looking for Xu Shiyan.
As a result, when I arrived here, I found that Xu Shiyan had already gathered a lot of people.
So the big guys went to Songjiang River together without driving a car or riding a bicycle, just talking and laughing.
The ice lantern is in the open space of the square to the west of the bureau building, which is the place where Xu Shiyan sold fish.
The Forestry Bureau has money, and they brought back a lot of huge ice cubes from the lower reaches of the Songhua River in the north, and asked someone to carve them into ice lanterns of various shapes.
The inside of the ice lantern is hollowed out, and light bulbs are put in. After the electricity is turned on at night, the whole ice lantern presents a colorful, crystal-clear and dreamy scene, which is very attractive.
When Xu Shiyan and others arrived at the square, it was less than seven o'clock, and all the ice lanterns were powered on, colorful and dreamlike, just like a crystal palace.
The square is crowded with people, many people have already gathered, strolling around, stopping in front of each ice lantern, and carefully admiring it.
At exactly seven o'clock, on the bureau building, someone lit the fireworks that had been prepared long ago.
Clusters of colorful and different fireworks scattered in the sky.
Cooperating with the ice lanterns on the ground, it illuminates the night like day, even more dazzling than day.
Among the crowd, bursts of exclamation burst out.
I don’t blame everyone. This is the first time in many years that the Forestry Bureau has set off fireworks in addition to ice lanterns during the Lantern Festival.
The big guys all looked up at the sky, and every time a firework exploded, everyone was amazed.
Fireworks are not cheap these days, and the Forestry Bureau is not willing to set off too many. After about ten minutes, the fireworks stopped, and everyone's upturned heads were finally able to lower their heads.
"It's so beautiful, I've never seen such a beautiful firework." Su Anying said excitedly as she leaned against Xu Shiyan.
"Well, if you want to watch it in the future, I will bring you here every year."
The Forestry Bureau makes ice lanterns every year during the Lantern Festival, and this custom lasted until 1995 and 1996.
Later, the Forestry Bureau was in a recession, so there was not so much money to make ice lanterns.
In the next few years, there were still fireworks, and gradually even the fireworks disappeared.
Ice lanterns and fireworks have become beautiful scenes in the memory of Songjianghe people.
The couple on this side chatted in low voices, while Li Chengrong and Li Zongliang on the other side saw a seller of candied haws, so they hurriedly bought one for their partner.
Xu Shiyan looked up occasionally, just in time to see them handing candied haws to Su Anfang and the sisters.
Xu Shiyan curled his lips, these two boys are really good at pleasing their partners.
"Wait a minute, you two, I'll go buy candied haws for you two."
Xu Shiyan turned his head, greeted Su Anying and Xu Shiqin, waited for him beside him, then quickly went to find the candied haws seller, and bought a candied haws for his wife and younger sister.
Xu Shiyan just paid the money and took the candied haws in his hand. When he turned around, he found that there were several people around where his wife and younger sister were standing.
Xu Shiyan froze for a moment, then walked back quickly.
When I came closer, I found that there were a few boys in their twenties talking to Xu Shiqin with a playful smile on their faces.
Xu Shiqin ignored them with a cold face, but those people just chattered with j8 flirtatiously, and one of them even touched Xu Shiqin.
Xu Shiyan saw that this was not bad, stepped forward and raised his leg, kicked the kid who made the move, and kicked the guy flying out.

chapters.title: Chapter 326: fight
chapters.content:
Chapter 326 Fighting
The annual Lantern Festival ice lanterns can be said to be a major event in the Songjiang River area.
The family members of the forestry farms under the Forestry Bureau will take a small train down to watch the ice lanterns, so the square can be said to be crowded with people.
There are many people, and there are all kinds of teachings and nine streams, so accidents are easy to happen.
Especially those idle and unemployed people in the society, wandering around in groups of three or four.
Seeing the young and beautiful young girl and daughter-in-law, she whistled lightly, and stepped forward to move her hands and feet, all kinds of things.
This is also the reason why Xu Chenghou asked his son to come with him. There are so many people, and if something happens, at least he won't suffer.
I didn't expect that sister Su Anfang was fine, but Su Anying and Xu Shiqin met a few gangsters.
Xu Shiqin is handsome, but she had physical problems before, so no one paid attention to her.
Now that the spine has been healed, she is slender and slender at about 1.6 meters.
She learned tailoring by herself, and she also knows how to dress up. She is particularly eye-catching in a long woolen coat.
When they wandered around just now, many young men looked at them.
Although Su Anying is thirty, her complexion is fair and doesn't look old, and her dress is quite fashionable. Compared with a little girl, she has a more mature charm.
Xu Shiyan went to buy candied haws. The two sisters-in-law saw that there was a photo next to them, and they said that it is rare to see such a beautiful scene, so why not take a photo.
The two of them had just stood down and posed in front of a dragon-shaped ice lantern. Before the photographer could press the shutter, a few young men came from the other end, whistling towards the sister-in-law.
One of them, who was still smiling, approached Xu Shiqin. He didn't have anything good to say, and raised his hand to grab Xu Shiqin.
Su Anying dragged Xu Shiqin behind her, and raised her hand to slap the kid.
Before she could make a move, she saw that kid was kicked and flew away.
Looking again, it was Xu Shiyan who kicked someone.
"Here, take the younger sister to the side." Xu Shiyan handed the candied haws in his hand to his daughter-in-law, then turned to look at the boys.
"You're very courageous. You dare to do it at this time. Why didn't you get arrested last year?"
Xu Shiyan rolled up his sleeves while speaking.
There were a total of five or six people on the opposite side, all in their twenties, with seven dissatisfied and eight dissatisfied faces all over their faces. It was obvious at a glance that these were gangsters who were not doing business.
"Oh shit, you kid dare to hit our big brother, are you so tired of working?"
Several people saw that the leader was kicked, and immediately became angry, and the one who rolled up his arms and sleeves came towards Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan dodged to avoid the oncoming fist, raised his hand to hold the opponent's arm, and twisted it back, only to hear the boy groaning and screaming in pain.
Xu Shiyan pushed this one out with force, then twisted his body, raised his leg and kicked the other one away.
There were six people in total, and Xu Shiyan cleaned up three of them as soon as he raised his hand.
The first kicked person was still squatting on the ground, clutching his stomach and unable to straighten up.
The one whose arm was twisted, the arm fell off the ring, and one arm could not be lifted.
Only the one kicked in the back can be lightened, and grinned in pain.
The remaining three saw that something was wrong, so they simply pulled out their belongings from their waists, three very sharp hand axes.
"Cut him, I will let him run rampant, today he must be hacked to death."
The kid who was squatting on the ground and couldn't straighten up pointed at Xu Shiyan and shouted.
The three of them swung their hatchets and slashed towards Xu Shiyan.
The spectators around were terrified when they saw it. Someone screamed and hurried to hide.
This square is not very big in all, and there is a lot of commotion at this end. How could Huang Shengli, Han Limin and others who were wandering around not far away not notice it?
At first, I didn't see who was fighting, but the men were a little curious, so they leaned forward to see clearly.
"Oh, no, it's the third brother, and the third brother got into a fight. Fuck, they're swinging axes, these bastards."
Zhao Jianshe had good eyesight, and he recognized Xu Shiyan and a few people with axes in the fight over there.
"Daughter-in-law, you guys find a place to stay. Shengli, Xiaofeng, those are our third brother, go, **** them, **** it."
Zhao Jianshe yelled, and rushed over. Huang Shengli, Han Limin, Sun Xiaofeng, and Yang Chunming rushed over without saying a word.
Li Chengrong and Li Zongliang were happily chatting with their partner, when they suddenly heard Zhao Jianshe shouting in a loud voice, they turned their heads quickly, and saw something not far away.
"Is that the second sister over there? Let's go find the second sister and sister Qin, let's go and have a look."
The two gave instructions to their partner and rushed over.
Xu Shiyan has no belongings in his hand, and the other party has three axes, so he is at a disadvantage.
One careless, the coat was cut a hole.
Thanks to the thick winter clothes, people are fine.
Just at this time, Zhao Jianshe and others rushed over, and seven or eight people directly surrounded the three people, and Ding Dong beat them up violently.
Regardless of the fact that the three men had axes in their hands, when the number of people was superior, no axes would work, and they were still beaten to the ground.
"Let's go, don't fight, it won't be good if you bring in the security guards later."
Xu Shiyan saw that the opponents were all bruised and swollen, so he told everyone to stop.
Just at this time, there was a whistle in the distance.
Needless to say, it must be someone from the security team of the Forestry Bureau who rushed over after hearing the news.
"Damn it, I've got you guys off today, little B bastard, I'll beat you so hard in the future."
Zhao Jianshe was not reconciled, and kicked one of them again, then turned around and walked with the big guy.
The people from the public security team are just around the corner, so why do those little **** dare to stay for a long time?
Not to mention saying harsh words to save face, just **** off and crawl.
When the security team arrived here, no one was seen, and they all ran away.
It was a good time to watch ice lanterns during the Lantern Festival, but was disturbed by some unsightly gangsters, and everyone felt a little uncomfortable.
"Madan, the security team came too fast just now, otherwise I would have beaten those **** to death."
While walking, Zhao Jianshe was still muttering.
"Hey, you said that the punishment was so strict last year, didn't many people eat peanuts?
Why are there so many people who don't know what to do? Isn't he afraid of being caught too? "
Huang Shengli and the others were a little puzzled. Ordinarily, shouldn't those local ruffians be cats at home quietly? How dare you come out and brag?
"Last year, all the bosses were arrested, and it was impossible to arrest all the young people below.
They are now, there are no tigers in the mountains, monkeys are called kings, and a group of punks feel that they are great. "
The territory of Songjianghe is actually quite chaotic, where is it now?
Looking back, the early and mid-1990s were even more chaotic.
After the new century, things gradually got better. It wasn’t until later that the higher authorities strictly enforced the law, and social security was really improved.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: Hit the curtain
chapters.content:
Chapter 327 Hitting the Curtain
A small accident, no one took it to heart, and did not mention it to the family when they got home.
After the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, the year is over, and every household has begun to prepare materials for ginseng.
The polyvinyl chloride plastic film for ginseng has much better light transmittance than the wooden shed, which is beneficial to the increase of ginseng production.
So many people are thinking about using plastic film for the newly planted mallets.
Using plastic film for ginseng is completely different from the previous wooden shed.
Under the plastic film, a curtain made of branches should be laid. The process of weaving the curtain is called making a curtain locally.
Two or three people usually make a wooden frame according to the width of the pool surface, and nail four or five nails at equal intervals on both ends of the wooden frame.
Bundles of wire are wrapped around wooden sticks in advance to form tassels.
Then wrap the wire around the nail, and then pull it to the nail at the other end of the wooden frame to fix it. A total of four or five wires were pulled.
Go up the mountain and cut all kinds of branches that are as tall as a person, put them together in groups of two, and carry them horizontally on the wire.
Holding the tassel of wire in his hand, he wrapped the branch around it, and then wrapped it around the wire underneath.
The distance is about **** wide, and then two branches are put on, and the branches are braided with iron wire bit by bit.
At the end, it is knotted and fixed, and it is removed from the iron nails. A curtain is one foot long and rolled up neatly, waiting to be transported to the mountain for spring thatch ginseng.
So fifteen years later, the workers who participated in the field began to go up the mountain to cut slivers and open curtains.
Xu Shiyan plans to use plastic sheds for the new plants at his home and his parents' side, and in the beginning of spring, so the curtains must be opened.
So I asked the leader for a few days off, and Su Anying and I went up the mountain to cut the branches for two days, and brought them back in a carriage.
Then made a wooden frame, wrapped the wire, and the couple opened the curtain at home.
“I heard that they are now researching polyethylene blue translucent film, which seems to be a little harder than the yellow plastic film currently used.
Waiting for that kind of plastic film to come out, we don’t have to open the curtains, just use the bow strips directly underneath, just a little denser, and save the need to open the curtains every year. "
While working, Xu Shiyan chatted with his wife.
PVC plastic film is soft and light-transmitting, which is not the best choice for ginseng.
The blue polyethylene plastic film currently being researched is better, not only because of its thick and firm texture, anti-aging, but also because it is beneficial to the growth of ginseng.
It is said that after sunlight passes through the blue shed, it can promote photosynthesis.
Xu Shiyan doesn't know much about this, anyway, he only knows that since the appearance of blue plastic film, Shendi has been using this kind of film all the time.
“You can use anything, and I think this is better than using a wooden shed.
You said that now they are divided into different households. Who has so many boards, and the whole mountain has ginseng?
Now the forest is not harvested casually, and it is too wasteful to use wooden boards.
This plastic shed can be used for three years. I calculated that day, and the price is not bad, and the waste plastic film can still be sold as waste after three years. "
Su Anying answered while working.
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan turned his head and glanced at his wife. Not to mention, his daughter-in-law has grown up really fast in the past year or so, and she is no longer the housewife who only knew how to hang around the pot.
The weather is not warm in the first month of the month, and a few words will fill your stomach with a cool breeze, and the couple can't care about chatting anymore.
Many people in Donggang Township have switched to plastic sheds, so during the end of the first month and the beginning of February, when you go outside, you can see many people hanging the curtains outside.
The curtain is one foot long, and thirty feet of ginseng soil is enough to make more than thirty curtains.
Xu Shiyan and his wife were not too slow to work, and they finished it in two days.
The husband and wife agreed on this job, and they didn't want Sister Su Anfang to intervene.
Especially Su Anfang, who is going to get married in a few months, it's better to stay indoors to take care of her skin. If the cold wind blows outside, her face should be chapped.
After the curtains are drawn, rolled up and piled up in the yard, they will be transported to the mountains after a while.
For other tasks, Xu Shiyan had to take some time off on Sunday to do some work. There was no way, he had a job, and the field had to be busy fermenting Armillaria militarum and other things.
In the blink of an eye, March 1st is coming, and the children who have played wildly for a winter vacation are about to start school.
On February 29th, elementary school returned to school, and Xu Haiyuan went to school with his schoolbag on his back in the morning.
When I arrived at school, I first handed in my vacation homework, then cleaned up, and then the teacher called a few strong boys to the office to hold and distribute books.
Primary students in the first grade, in addition to mathematics and Chinese, also have science, politics, art, music, etc.
The teacher handed out all the books and told the children that they must find some thick paper to wrap the book covers when they get home, as the saved new books will soon wear out.
New books have been issued, and the return to school is over. The teacher told the children to go home quickly and not to run around outside.
Xu Haiyuan returned to his grandparents' house with a small schoolbag on his back, "Grandpa, do we still have kraft paper at home? I have a new book, and the teacher said to wrap it in thick paper."
There are no ready-made plastic book covers in this year, and even calendar paper is rare. The only thing that can be used to wrap books, except for newspapers, is kraft paper.
I dare not say anything else, but I still have kraft paper at home. Xu Shiyan bought a lot from his work unit and kept it for paste.
Whether you used to lay kang mats or lay fiberboards now, the surface of the kang must be covered with a layer of paper first, or it will be full of dust.
Generally speaking, after the kang is ready for at least two years, it has to be removed once to clean the hole, and once removed, the surface of the kang has to be re-pasted.
Last autumn, when Xu Chenghou picked up the kang, Xu Shiyan ordered a lot of kraft paper, but he didn't use that much, and Zhou Guilan put the rest away.
As soon as she heard that the eldest grandson wanted to wrap the books in kraft paper, Zhou Guilan hurried to find a large one.
Xu Chenghou took his grandson's textbook and compared it, cut it to a suitable size, and then patiently wrapped the book cover for his grandson.
Don't look at Xu Chenghou's five big and three rough old men, it's quite a coincidence to do these jobs, and the book cover is neat.
Xu Haiyuan was lying on the kang, watching his grandfather wrapping the book cover intently, and when he finished wrapping it, he took a pen and wrote his name on the book cover.
After wrapping the book cover, it doesn’t count, and the book has to be stapled.
Primary students in lower grades are required by teachers to use this folder.
There are two kinds of clips for the book, one is with a spring, you can just clip the book in directly, and the other is for threading a string after drilling a hole.
Worry-free with a spring, you can just clip it, but it is not strong, and the book will fall if you apply a lot of force.
Especially after the homework was handed in, the teacher accidentally dropped the homework book when he was approving the homework.
Xu Haiyuan’s book clips are all the kind with holes for strings, black book clips, and the bottom two corners are red cloth painted with a layer of paint.
Xu Chenghou pierced the two books with a big awl, and then shook the awl to pull it out.
Find a shoelace, or ask Zhou Guilan for some wool, pass it through the newly drilled hole, fix the clip and the book together, and tie the shoelace or wool firmly.
Still the same, Xu Chenghou nailed a book, and Xu Haiyuan took it and wrote his name on it.
Wait for everything to be done, even the books and books, all put in the schoolbag. "Thank you grandpa."

chapters.title: Chapter 328: award
chapters.content:
Chapter 328 Awarded
School started on March 1st, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping both went back to school for class, leaving Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui at home.
Brothers and sisters are not at home, no one leads them to play.
The weather is not so warm yet, the two children can't go out for a run, so they can only be naughty at home.
Fortunately, there are rascals, these two little guys are not too lonely.
Su Anfang was about to get married, so Su Anying asked her to do more sewing at home, at least to make two sets of new clothes for herself, and two sets for Li Zongliang.
In addition, there are door curtains, curtains, curtains, pillowcases and other things, which must also be prepared.
The work of making sheds in the ginseng field is all contracted out. Su Anying still takes turns with Huang Shengli's wife and others to take care of the farm and the Clivia at home.
On March 13th, Fusong held the 1983 Congress of Advanced Collectives and Advanced Producers.
Thirteen advanced collectives, twenty-four model workers, and more than one thousand advanced workers were selected.
Yi Shenchang has been rated as an advanced collective for many years in a row, and Xu Shiyan has also been selected as an advanced worker and a technological pacesetter in the industry.
In view of the fact that Xu Shiyan made some remarks at the meeting last year and caused many people to object, this time, the county leaders did not allow Xu Shiyan to speak again.
"Xiao Xu, don't be discouraged, this is a kind of protection from the leader.
You are now the vanguard of our Fusong ginseng industry, and your contribution is huge.
But there is a saying that you have to understand, the big tree attracts the wind, and now I don’t know how many people are staring at you, trying to find something wrong.
So, after several discussions, we decided not to let you speak on stage today.
You must understand our painstaking efforts and don't have any ideas. "
