Last year, Xu Shiyan said at the conference that the excessive development of the Fusong ginseng industry should be controlled, especially to control some enterprises and institutions from blindly investing in the ginseng industry.
This remark offended many people. Several leaders in the county made this decision because they wanted to protect Xu Shiyan.
"Secretary Guan, don't worry, I won't have any thoughts.
However, I still say the same thing, if the county does not introduce measures in time, those enterprises and institutions will be allowed to join the ginseng industry indiscriminately.
I can only say that the ginseng economy in our county will soon be in crisis. "
Xu Shiyan has no obsession with those who speak or not. He just wants to remind these people not to be confused by the prosperity in front of them.
How crazy these units are throwing in now, how ruthless the situation will collapse in the future.
Controlling the excessive growth of ginseng planting area has never been on the body of ordinary ginseng farmers.
How capable are ordinary people? Every household can plant thirty or forty feet of ginseng a year, which is already very impressive.
After three years, the ginseng can be sold for a lot of money, and life is pretty good.
These people don't have much ambition, even if they develop ginseng, they do what they can and develop slowly.
From tens of feet a year to at most a hundred feet, I think it is very beautiful.
The most serious are those units.
They took the public money, invested a lot of money in the ginseng industry, and cooperated with the forestry department to get thousands or tens of thousands of feet of ginseng soil at once.
When the price of ginseng fell, it was these people who desperately sold it out in order to stop the loss in time.
Xu Shiyan experienced it in his previous life.
In 1994, Funan Forest Farm sold ginseng seeds outside, and a foot of ginseng seeds cost only ten yuan, which was really only a few dollars more expensive than ginseng soil.
The workers at the Funan Forestry Farm scolded them as prodigals. The forestry farm invested a lot of money at the beginning, but in the end they lost everything.
Those units that fail to invest will be borne by the public, and the losses will not fall on individuals.
The only ones who suffer in the end are ginseng farmers who grow ginseng honestly and sell ginseng for money to make a living.
"Hey, Xiao Xu, I understand what you said, but in the current situation, you and I can't stop the trend with a few words." Secretary Guan sighed.
Since Xu Shiyan made this suggestion last year, Secretary Guan has been thinking about it from time to time, and has discussed it with some people, thinking that there is indeed such a possibility.
But there are some things that cannot be done once you know it. After all, what Xu Shiyan predicted has not happened yet.
If only because of what Xu Shiyan said, the county will order that all enterprises and institutions are strictly prohibited from developing the tertiary industry, and they are not allowed to grow ginseng.
It will cause public outrage, and the county cannot afford such consequences.
Regarding this, Xu Shiyan couldn't continue to say anything, anyway, he did everything he could, and he couldn't stop those people who had to die.
The conference lasted for three days and ended on March 16th.
The meeting here just ended, and Lin Qiyue led Xu Shiyan to attend another meeting.
On March 17th, the second annual meeting of Fusong Ginseng Society was held in Fusong.
The annual meeting elected a new chairman, vice chairman, secretary-general, directors, and members.
One participating secretary, Lin Qiyue, was elected as the vice chairman of the Ginseng Society, and one participating technical consultant, Xu Shiyan, was elected as the director of the society.
At the same time, the annual meeting reviewed a batch of papers submitted last year, and selected two papers for the first prize, five papers for the second prize, and two papers for the third prize.
During the award process, a small accident occurred.
Lin Qiyue submitted the two papers for Xu Shiyan. The scientific and technological content and literary talent far surpassed other papers. It is reasonable to select the first prize without any problem.
Xu Shiyan is alone, and the two first prizes are his articles, which many people think is unreasonable.
You have to give others a chance. It cannot be said that all the benefits are taken by one person.
Lin Qiyue has a different view on this.
"I think this is normal. Our Ginseng Society is a place for research and learning, not for seniority.
Why, there are genuine articles, but just because someone wrote two articles, can’t both be awarded? What's the point?
Afraid that others will feel uncomfortable? If that's the case, all these articles will be awarded the first prize.
Sit in a row and divide the fruit, everyone has a share, and no one has any objections, so what do we need the ginseng society to do? Is the decoration nice? "
When Lin Qiyue said this, those who opposed him were speechless.
In the end, Xu Shiyan's article won the support of the majority, and both articles were awarded the first prize.
Under the envious eyes of everyone, Xu Shiyan took the stage to accept the award and delivered his acceptance speech at the same time.
The meeting was held for several days in a row. Although there were some small episodes in the middle, the result was still very good.
Xu Shiyan returned home with honors and grades. Xu Chenghou looked at the awards and certificates brought back by his son, his mouth could not close his mouth with joy, and his eyes narrowed.
"It must be that our third child is promising. Look, all the certificates and certificates hanging on the wall are your certificates. That's great. It's joyful to look at.
My son is promising, so what kind of director can he be? What does this director do? What's the matter? "
Xu Chenghou was happy, but also a little curious. What kind of things does this director deal with?
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this, "Father, a director is just a title, anyway, he is a little higher than ordinary society members.
No matter what it is, it is mainly to make some suggestions for the ginseng society and the development of the local ginseng industry.
Just like this award, when the annual meeting is held next year, I can be a reviewer and score other people's articles. "
The Ginseng Society is not a functional department. Those who work in the society have other jobs.
Like the chairman of this year, he is the deputy county in charge of participating in special products, like Lin Qiyue, he is the director and secretary of the first participating factory, the top leader.
The society is just a name and has no real power, but it can offer advice and make reasonable suggestions for the development of Fusong ginseng industry.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: enqueue
chapters.content:
Chapter 329 Joining the team
After several days of meetings, I feel dizzy. That kind of tiredness is not physically tired, but mentally tired.
So Lin Qiyue specially gave Xu Shiyan two days off to rest at home.
How can Xu Shiyan have time to rest? He still has important things to do.
On March 19th, Xu Shiyan took the shuttle bus of the participating workers to work, and went to the participating field in Caozihe to find Han Wenzhong.
Fifteen years later, Han Wenzhong took people up the mountain to see ginseng.
The old man is in good health and has enough experience. He couldn't find anyone more suitable than Han Wenzhong, so he kept leading a few workers to watch.
Xu Shiyan went up the mountain to find Han Wenzhong, of course to discuss the marriage between Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei.
"Uncle, you see, our little sister has also undergone surgery for more than five months, and I seem to be doing well.
I mean, should we send a telegram or write a letter to Liwei, asking him to come back and get married?
You said that these two people have already received their certificates, and it is outrageous that the wedding has never been held.
Hurry up and organize the wedding, and find a way to transfer our little sister's job. These two people can't live in two places forever, right? "
Xu Shiyan has been thinking about this matter all the time. He vaguely remembers what Han Wenzhong said in his previous life. It seems that Han Liwei was ordered to be transferred to the southwest border in April.
Xu Shiyan's intention was to ask Han Liwei to ask for leave and come back to get married before the rotation order was issued.
Han Liwei hasn't visited his relatives for another year and a half, and since he's getting married, he can definitely take some more time off, so that he can avoid the catastrophe of his previous life.
No way, for the happiness of my sister, I can only use this trick.
Han Wenzhong thought it made sense when he heard it. Yes, the third son and third daughter-in-law have both received certificates for more than a year, and the wedding has never been held.
Before, it was because the third daughter-in-law needed surgery and was not suitable for marriage and childbirth, so she kept procrastinating.
It’s time to make arrangements for the children, so hurry back and get married, and the old couple has lost their minds.
"Well, what you said is reasonable, it's time for those two to get married.
That's it. I'll tell Limin later that I'll send a telegram to Liwei to urge him to come back and get married.
Actually, everything that needs to be prepared at home has been prepared. We are just waiting for Shiqin to recover from surgery and hold a wedding for them. "
Han Wenzhong nodded, agreeing to Xu Shiyan's proposal.
Just like that, when Han Limin finished his work at noon and came to visit Shen Xiaofang for dinner, Han Wenzhong told him.
Han Limin was right when he heard it. It was time for the third brother to get married, and it was not good to delay it.
Xu Shiqin will be twenty-five this year, any later would be bad.
So, Han Limin took a leave of absence the next day, went to the post office and sent a telegram to Han Liwei.
Ask Han Liwei to ask for leave as soon as possible to go home for the wedding.
It stands to reason that when the telegram is sent, Han Liwei will receive it soon. If he receives it, he can call home or send a telegram.
As a result, the telegram has been sent out for seven or eight days, and there is no reply. Everyone feels strange.
Ten days later, Han Lixin received a call from Han Liwei at his work unit. It turned out that he had gone on a mission a few days ago before returning to the camp.
Han Lixin told his family's opinion to his younger brother, and asked Han Liwei to take leave as soon as possible to come back and get married.
Han Liwei said on the phone that he had already submitted the application, and he wished he could come back and get married soon.
Hung up the phone, Han Lixin hurried to the technical team and spoke to Xu Shiyan, which was like sending a letter to the Xu family to reassure them.
Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief when he learned that Han Liwei had asked for leave and would come back only after the leader's approval.
Fortunately, Han Liwei asked for leave before April.
Now I am looking forward to Han Liwei's smooth return from leave, just missing the rotation.
Xu Shiyan went home, told his parents and sister the good news, and asked Xu Shiqin to prepare for the wedding quickly.
In fact, what should be prepared has already been prepared, and we just waited for Han Liwei to come back.
However, after hearing the news, the Xu family's old couple were still happy and nervous. They couldn't sleep at night, and they reorganized the dowry for their daughter.
In the blink of an eye, it was another Qingming Festival, and the grave-sweeping ceremony for martyrs in Donggang Township started again.
The same as last year, the township staff came to Xu’s house to discuss and pull wires from Xu’s house.
The difference is that last year, Xu Haiyuan, who had to be carried by his grandfather to watch the excitement outside the crowd, was at the front of the Donggang Elementary School team this year.
Although Xu Haiyuan is only a first-grade elementary school student, as a student representative, he stepped forward to give a speech, remembering the martyrs, not forgetting the legacy of the martyrs, and being a good boy in the new era.
That testimonial was five or six hundred words at least, and the little guy finished the whole process without even reading it, so he memorized it completely.
The adults still have to read from the script, the contrast is too obvious.
All the people who participated in the grave sweeping were curious about that little boy. Whose child is this? Little Douding is actually stronger than adults.
Xu Shiyan, who also participated in the grave-sweeping ceremony, was full of pride and pride.
This son of his family, don’t think he’s particularly scouring on weekdays, but when it comes to the real chapter, he’s not at all afraid.
How good it is to listen to the children recite, the voice is full of emotion, and it is much more emotional than those who hold the manuscript and read it.
Xu Chenghou, who was watching the excitement outside the crowd, and Zhou Guilan, Su Anying, who was listening by the window at home, also looked proud.
Really, this kid has such a long face.
"That's my grandson, my family's."
Xu Chenghou heard someone talking about it and asked who the little boy was reciting, so he hurriedly told them that it was his grandson.
"Hey, congratulations, uncle, the eldest grandson of your family is amazing, and he is not stage fright at such a young age.
How well you listened to what he said, it was a hundred times better than those who just read it from a manuscript.
It’s true, this child will definitely be promising in the future, uncle, let’s raise the child well, if it’s not perfect, he will be admitted to a university in the future, and his ancestors will be honored. "
People around are very polite to Xu Chenghou, and they can't hide their envy in words. Who doesn't care about such an outstanding child?
Xu Chenghou heard others praise his grandson, it really makes people happier than praise him, grinning, seeing his teeth but not his eyes.
"That is, it must be cultivated well."
Representatives from various units came forward to lay wreaths. Even if the grave-sweeping ceremony was over, everyone else withdrew one after another. Only Donggang Primary School remained where it was.
It turned out that this year's Young Pioneers' entry ceremony was held in front of the martyrs' tomb.
The counselor of the brigade gave a speech and announced the list of new members of the Young Pioneers. Basically, these children who were newly enrolled last year were all included in the team.
Then, some senior students put bright red scarves on the first-year students.
The counselors of the brigade explained the origin of the red scarf to the new students, telling them that the red scarf was the corner of the red flag, which was dyed with the blood of the martyrs.
Admonish the children to inherit the behest of the martyrs and contribute to the construction of the motherland.
All the members of the first grade raised their right hands and followed the teacher to **** by word.
At this moment, every child straightened their backs with firm eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Preparations for the Spring Fair
chapters.content:
Chapter 330 Preparations for the Spring Fair
Wake up early to sweep the tomb. After the ceremony, they go home for dinner. After breakfast, those who should go to work go to school, and those who should go to school go to school.
During the festival, Xu Shiyan's family ate at the old man's side.
Xu Shiyan was in a hurry to go to the venue, and took a few bites of food casually. He didn't have time to listen to his father showing off his grandson there, so he went to the venue by bike.
As soon as I arrived at the office, before I sat down, someone knocked on the door and came in.
"Section Chief Xu, Secretary Lin is looking for you and asked you to go to his office immediately. There is something urgent."
Years later, many technicians were transferred in, and the technical group was upgraded to a technical department. Xu Shiyan was also promoted and became the chief of the technical department.
"Oh, I see." Xu Shiyan immediately put down the documents in his hand, got up and went straight to the secretary's office on the second floor.
"Xiao Xu, come here, come and sit down quickly, I have something important to discuss with you."
When Lin Qiyue saw Xu Shiyan, he waved with a smile and let Xu Shiyan sit over.
"That's right, the Spring Fair will be here soon. If we leave it in previous years, we won't have the chance to participate.
Isn't this the successful development of our Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng, and a lot of goods were ordered at the autumn and winter order fair last year?
The province specially allocated a quota to our county this time, and the designation is for us to participate in the fair, and let us take our products to participate in the Spring Fair. "
Lin Qiyue didn't make a fool of himself, he cut straight to the point and said it directly.
The Spring Fair and the Autumn Fair are both large-scale import and export trade fairs held in the southern city of Yangcheng.
In this day and age, the companies that can participate in the trade fair are basically provincial-level key enterprises and competitive products.
Although ginseng is a product that can be exported for currency exchange, most of it is still raw material for export.
The ginseng antler tiger bone wine, ginseng invigorating spleen pills, ginseng essence, ginseng reconstituted pills and other products produced by Fusong Pharmaceutical Factory are only sold domestically and have not been able to go abroad.
So over the years, regardless of the Spring Fair or the Autumn Fair, nothing happened to Fusong.
Because of the successful trial production of Changbaishan red ginseng, I participated in an order meeting last year and the results were good.
The meaning of the province, then give it a chance to see the effect, so there is this participation quota.
This is a big deal, not to mention participating in the event, even the county is paying special attention.
Early this morning, the county called, asking Lin Qiyue to prepare well, produce excellent products, and try to show his face at the Spring Fair.
"Xiao Xu, I called you here for this reason.
You think about it, what products should we bring to the exhibition? Can't miss the opportunity. "
Lin Qiyue was very excited. This is a rare opportunity. If he can gain something from going out this time, his chances of participating in the competition will be widened.
Lin Qiyue was excited, spoke a little fast, and finished speaking in a snap.
Xu Shiyan listened, pondered for a moment, and then spoke.
"Secretary Lin, there are still too few products in our market. What we can sell are the newly developed Changbaishan red ginseng and the ginseng honey slice."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, only taking these two products out for a trip, too little, not worth it.
The key is that the ginseng flower dew is not produced locally, it is a joint venture between Yichangchang and Huacheng, so there is no way to participate in the exhibition.
"We still have some Changbai Mountain red ginseng in stock, so it's no problem to bring a few boxes as samples.
Ginseng honey slices have also been processed successfully, just need to get a suitable packaging, I think this thing is done well, and the profit will be higher than that of Changbai Mountain red ginseng. "
If he participated in the Spring Fair two or three years later, Xu Shiyan could lead people to make several products.
Among other things, ginseng gastrodia honey, ginseng tea, ginseng angelica tea, ginsenosides, fresh ginseng royal jelly, these can all be sent to the conference.
But now, the product is too single, and I am afraid that it will not produce any effect.
"Oh, isn't it?
In the past, we used to process whatever goods the provincial medicinal materials company ordered. We didn’t have our own products. This gave us an opportunity, but we couldn’t grasp it. "
Lin Qiyue was not as excited as before, and gradually became rational.
"You said if I met you earlier, wouldn't our scene have developed long ago?"
"Secretary Lin, don't worry about this, let's prepare the products for the exhibition first.
Although we only have these two main products, if they are done well, there will be surprises if they are not complete. "
Xu Shiyan is the kind of hard-working person. Since the superior has rarely given a quota, there is no need to say anything. Hurry up and prepare.
Don't look at the single product, maybe the more single the more conspicuous it is, right?
"Yes, yes, then let's prepare quickly.
What do you need to do? We have never participated in the venue, and I have no idea.
Otherwise, I will go to the county to discuss with the leaders, can’t I go to the province to learn from it? "
Ginseng belongs to the scope of medicines and health care products, and the Spring Fair belongs to the third phase of exhibition, from May 1st to May 5th.
Now it is April 4th, there should be enough time, if it is really not possible, he will go to the provincial capital.
"Has our county participated in the Spring Fair before? If you haven't, it's useless for you to ask the leader.
Simply, let’s prepare it ourselves. I’ll discuss it with the people in our department when I go back, come up with a specific plan, and then you can decide. "
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, the county has never been to an exhibition, what the **** do they know? Maybe not as good as Xu Shiyan.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan still has more than 30 years of experience. In his previous life, the mountain shop opened by his daughter, in order to sell things to tourists, the packaging was very beautiful, and there were product introductions inside, which were all very good.
Xu Shiyan felt that this could be used as a reference, so he quickly took out the plan, and had to find a place to make it.
"Okay, then this matter will be handed over to your technical department, and it must be done well.
We can't live up to the great trust of the leader, and we can't lose face as a participant, right? "
Lin Qiyue called Xu Shiyan here to ask for his opinion.
Currently speaking, in terms of ginseng production technology, there are too few people who can surpass Xu Shiyan, anyway, there are none.
Lin Qiyue has already regarded Xu Shiyan as the backbone, and whenever it involves technical issues, he always consults with Xu Shiyan.
"Come on, secretary, don't worry, I will definitely bring my colleagues in our department to handle this matter beautifully."
Xu Shiyan came out of the secretary's office and didn't go back to his small office. Instead, he went directly to the big office next door and gathered everyone in the technical department for a meeting.
"This is a rare opportunity for us to show our faces in the first place, and everyone must put up 120,000 points of energy and do their best to do this well.
Next, I will assign tasks, and everyone will do their own things according to my requirements. "
"Li Chengrong, with a few people, you have carefully compiled the test report of our Changbai Mountain red ginseng, as well as the efficacy and application of ginseng instant honey slices.
Hurry up to find relevant foreign language talents, or go to the province to find someone to translate into several languages.
Then, find someone to print the brochure, color printing.
Don’t we have photos of ginseng sheds, ginseng seeding and blooming in our field? Bring them all, it is best to have a little introduction.
This job is for you, it should be no problem. "
Li Chengrong's writing is good, and the few people in his group are all high school educated, so it must be no problem to do these jobs.

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Rotation Southwest
chapters.content:
Chapter 331 Rotation Southwest
"Brother Limin, you bring a few people to be responsible for the packaging of ginseng honey slices, we need two kinds.
One is a glass bottle, similar to a canned bottle, but it should be small and exquisite, the more exquisite the better, the capacity should not exceed 300 ml, preferably 200 to 250 ml.
Another kind is a transparent plastic jar, and the capacity should not be too large. Ten to fifteen plastic-sealed ginseng honey slices can be contained in a bottle. "
Xu Shiyan turned his head and assigned tasks to Han Limin.
There are two types of packaging, glass bottles are made into cans, this kind can be taken two slices of ginseng honey and soaked in water to drink every day.
The other is to plastic seal first, make individual small packages, and then put them into plastic bottles.
This can be carried with you, and you can eat it anytime, anywhere, just unpack it and eat a piece.
"Xu Ke, why do you need such a small package? Don't we have to waste a lot of money on the packaging?
The canned bottle needs to be five or six hundred milliliters, otherwise it won’t hold many honey chips. "
Before Han Limin nodded, someone next to him questioned that this kind of packaging was too wasteful of materials and labor.
"Do you think that buying ginseng is like buying Chinese cabbage in your family? Buy the big ones?" Xu Shiyan sighed speechlessly.
"Anyone who can afford ginseng, cares about the cost of packaging? What people want is convenience, the packaging is small and easy to carry, understand?
Our ginseng honey tablets are mainly targeted at white-collar workers who work in high-end office buildings.
These people, you want them to take a big canning jar? What are you kidding? "
This is the difference in concept. When most people in the country are still struggling on the line of food and clothing, they can't think of what those rich people are pursuing.
"It's best to order a few flannelette or satin boxes, which are high-end gifts.
There are two glass bottles and two plastic bottles in one box, which are specially used as gifts. "
This thing is a high-end thing to play, just to distinguish it from other people's products.
It is also ginseng, packed in a cardboard box, and beautifully packaged, how can it be the same?
"Remember, the only requirement is the packaging. It should be exquisite and beautiful, as well as the labels on the outside. It must look good." Xu Shiyan solemnly reminded Han Limin and others.
"Don't worry, we will definitely follow the section chief's request." Han Limin responded in unison with several people in his team.
"Okay, starting tomorrow, I will bring people from other groups to seal the honey chip."
Ginseng honey slices are still stored in large containers, and they have to be pressed into small vacuum packaging with food-specific plastic film.
The machines and materials arrived a while ago, mainly because I am busy with other things these days, and there are no orders for the time being, so I am not in a hurry.
I didn't expect good news to come out of nowhere, so what are you talking about? Hurry up and work, at least make a few boxes of samples for the exhibition.
As the tasks were assigned, everyone in the technical department got busy, doing their own jobs.
Xu Shiyan took charge of the overall situation, supervised the progress, and reported the progress to Secretary Lin from time to time, which was enough for him.
"Mr. Xu, your call is said to be from Shenyang."
On the 6th day, Xu Shiyan was leading people to make honey chip plastic packaging in the workshop of the comprehensive factory. Suddenly someone ran over and said that he had a call.
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard it, from Shenyang? Who?
So he hurried out of the workshop, ran to the office of the comprehensive factory, and answered the phone. "Hello? Which one?"
"Third brother, it's me, Liwei." It was Han Liwei's voice on the other end of the phone.
"Ah? Liwei? Didn't you ask for leave and go back to get married? Why are you still in Shenyang?"
The day before yesterday, the family received a telegram from Han Liwei, saying that the leader had approved the vacation and allowed Han Liwei to come back and get married.
Based on the time, Han Liwei should be almost home by now, why is he still in Shenyang?
Xu Shiyan suddenly had a bad feeling in his heart, could this kid not be able to come back and get married?
"Third brother, please help me explain to Shiqin that I can't go back and get married for the time being.
Our regiment was ordered to rotate to the southwest border, and the leader canceled my vacation. "
Sure enough, what Han Liwei said on the phone confirmed Xu Shiyan's guess.
Holding the phone in his hand, Xu Shiyan let out a long sigh. He had calculated thousands of times, but he didn't make it. The telegram was sent just in time for Han Liwei to go on a mission and come back late.
If you want Han Liwei to ask for leave and come back to get married, the time must be right.
It was too early, Han Liwei asked for leave and came back to get married. Once there is an order from the organization, he has to return to the team immediately.
It was too late, before Han Liwei asked for leave and the order came down, the marriage would not be consummated.
So Xu Shiyan calculated everything and took the time to send a telegram to Han Liwei.
Xu Shiyan's calculation was that Han Liwei immediately asked the leader for leave after receiving the telegram, and set off before the order was issued, which happened to perfectly miss the rotation.
Although it will be a pity that I lost the opportunity to defend the frontier and fight for the motherland, but I can save my life.
But I didn't expect that Han Liwei was on a mission, and he was ten days late. By accident, the order came down before Han Liwei stepped on the train home.
"Liwei, you are the pride of the Han family and Shiqin. It is the responsibility of a man to defend his family and the country. We cannot hold you back.
I'll go back and explain this to Shiqin, but you must remember what the third brother told you that time.
When dealing with those monkeys, you must not be careless, their endurance is very good.
Sometimes, a slight negligence can cause an irreparable tragedy, understand? "
What can Xu Shiyan do? The wheel of fortune may deviate because of his rebirth, but more often than not, it will return to the right track.
What Xu Shiyan can do is to remind Han Liwei as much as possible to avoid the tragedy of the previous life.
"Third brother, I have always remembered what you said. I have done several sand table deduction with people, and I will definitely remain vigilant."
On the phone, Han Liwei sensed the seriousness of Xu Shiyan's tone, and knew that his uncle was worried about him, so he repeated his assurances.
"Okay, let's do this, we're over there, if the policy allows, tell me the address, and I'll find a way to mail you some medicine."
It is definitely impossible to stop it, so I can only find a way in other aspects.
Doing deduction in advance will definitely raise your vigilance, and then send some medicines with special effects, perhaps, it will be useful.
"Thank you third brother, trouble third brother, please explain to Shiqin for me."
Han Liwei's tone was also a little heavy. On the one hand, he was looking forward to the reunion of his relatives and wife, and on the other was the order of the organization, the mission of defending the family and the country.
As a soldier, he has responsibilities, so he can only give up his family to take care of everyone.
It's just in my heart, I can't help but feel ashamed, I really feel sorry for my wife.
Han Liwei hung up the phone after Xu Shiyan repeatedly promised to help explain.
As soon as the phone was hung up, Xu Shiyan also seemed to be stupid, standing there for a long time without recovering.
"Mr. Xu, what's wrong with you?"
Someone came in to look for Xu Shiyan, but found that Xu Shiyan was standing there motionless, with his hands still holding the phone, and he didn't know where to look.
The visitor felt strange, so he asked a question.
"It's okay, I'm just obsessed with thinking about things." Xu Shiyan came back to his senses and walked out of the office quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 332: retreat
chapters.content:
Chapter 332 Retreat
Xu Shiyan found Han Limin and told him that Han Liwei could not come back to get married.
Han Limin was also a little worried when he learned that his younger brother would be transferred to the southwest border by rotation.
"Didn't you hear that there was a commotion all the time? Liwei passed, would it be dangerous?"
"Whether it is dangerous or not, we cannot stop it.
From the day Liwei went to serve in the army, he was not only a child of the Han family.
He is a member of the country and a cadre carefully trained by the organization. It is his responsibility to defend the country. We can only support him as much as possible, and we cannot hold him back. "
This was also Xu Shiyan's biggest concern when Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei were talking about a partner.
Han Liwei's status is different. He shoulders heavy responsibilities and is not an ordinary person.
Since Xu Shiqin has accepted Han Liwei, he must have the determination to face danger.
"Okay, let me talk to Shiqin when I go back, and you can also tell Uncle Han and Aunt Han to persuade me."
It's useless to say anything, since Han Liwei was agreed to join the army, he had to prepare for the worst.
Everything is expected to the worst, and then make the best preparations, this is Xu Shiyan's consistent way of doing things.
"Brother Limin, help me watch the workshop, I have to do something, I may not come to work tomorrow."
He has to search for something and prepare some medicine, which can save his life.
"Oh, okay, I'll be watching over the workshop, don't worry."
Han Limin thought that Xu Shiyan was in a hurry to go back and explain to his sister, so he nodded in response.
There is nothing wrong with the workshop. The plastic packaging of honey chips is actually very simple, and it is easy to operate after getting used to it.
Xu Shiyan trusted Han Limin, so he didn't go to the workshop again, and rode his bike home directly.
Take the money, go to Songjianghe Pharmacy, and grab some medicine.
After returning home, I picked out one of the wild ginseng trees I had hidden, and added it with other treasured medicinal materials.
Then he hid in the east room, and started tinkering with things according to the secret recipe given by Mr. Chu.
Sister Su Anhua looked at it strangely, but she didn't dare to disturb her.
Waiting for Su Anying to come back in the afternoon, the two of them told their sister about Xu Shiyan staying in the east room for a day.
"It's okay, brother-in-law Ni is probably researching something.
He has this problem, once he wants to poke something, he will not give up until he makes it.
Leave it alone, wait for him to finish, and then he will come out. "
After all, they are a couple who have lived together for seven years. Su Anying still understands her husband's temper very well.
Xu Shiyan locked himself in the east room for two days, only came out when eating, and even slept in the inner room.
In the end, a bottle of pills and two bottles of powder were prepared.
Xu Shiyan breathed a sigh of relief, put the medicine bottle on the top of the bookshelf, then came out from the east room, and locked the door.
"What's wrong? Your retreat is over? What else have you come up with?"
Just in time for dinner, Su Anying asked with a smile while putting the food on the table.
Retreat is a word that Su Anying learned from Xu Shiyan.
Before, Xu Shiyan also locked himself in the house for several days and could not come out. He told his wife that he was in retreat, so Su Anying asked this question.
"Well, poke out something, it may be of great use to keep it."
Xu Shiyan didn't care about his wife's teasing, just smiled and went to wash his hands, and came back to eat.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan went to his parents' place to tell his parents and sister about Han Liwei not coming back to get married.
After hearing what Xu Shiyan said, the three members of the Xu family were silent for a long time.
"Oh, your third brother told you back then that finding a soldier is not that easy.
Look, isn’t this what it is? Liwei is a member of the country, he must observe discipline, and he cannot do whatever he wants.
You have to think about it yourself, if nothing else, then we can only wait until he comes back to get married. "
Zhou Guilan felt sorry for her daughter and was also worried that she would not think about it, so she was the first to speak out to persuade her.
"Yes, what your mother said is correct, Liwei is a person who does great things, and it is his responsibility to defend the frontier and keep the land safe for the people.
Even if you have any grievances or thoughts, you have to hold them back now, you can't quarrel with Liwei, and you can't go to the Han family.
You choose the person yourself. When you two got together, you knew that Liwei was a soldier, so you have to be considerate of him, right? "
Xu Chenghou knocked on the pipe and pot and said.
Xu Shiqin sighed, "Father, Mom, I know, and I don't blame him.
I am proud of my man, Liwei is an upright man, as a hot-blooded man should be.
If he ignores discipline and has to ask for leave to come back and evade responsibility, I will look down on him.
It's okay, I'll wait for him, and when he comes back safely, I haven't held a wedding with him yet. "
Xu Shiqin had tears in his eyes, not because he was angry and wronged, but because he was worried.
She bit her lower lip, blinked hard, and forced back the tears.
“I just don’t know if he can communicate with his family when he gets there.
If I could, I would at least write him a letter and tell him that I was at home waiting for his return. Xu Shiqin sighed after calming down for a while.
The reaction of his parents and sister made Xu Shiyan feel a little uncomfortable, and even more regretful.
Back when he knew that Han Liwei liked Xu Shiqin, he should have directly opposed it with a firm attitude, and there would be no such bad things.
He knew the ending of his previous life, but at the beginning Han Liwei was very interested in Xu Shiqin, and he didn't try his best to destroy it. He just let Xu Shiqin choose by himself.
At that time, he thought that he could somehow change Han Liwei's fate, but he didn't expect that the road to changing fate against the sky was full of accidents.
Now, he is not sure what will be the result of Han Liwei's visit. What will Xu Shiqin do if there is an accident?
Alas, it’s no use regretting things now, what can I do?
I can only pray to God to open his eyes, and don't let Han Liwei, no, it should be said that Han Liwei's comrades-in-arms, don't let anything happen.
I hope they can all return safely, and don’t make their parents and relatives in their hometown sad and desperate.
The Xu family calmly accepted the fact that Han Liwei could not come back to get married.
At the Han family's side, Han Wenzhong sighed for a long time when he heard the news, and Li Yuexiu even secretly cried a few times.
What can be done? From the first day Han Liwei joined the army, the Han family has accepted this reality, no matter what age, someone has to sacrifice.
It cannot be said that others should sacrifice, but it is their own child's turn to be reluctant.
Because of Han Liwei's matter, the two families were depressed for a long time.
But no matter how worried and uncomfortable, life has to go on.
Spring is so busy, there is a lot of work waiting in the field, no one can sigh all day long, they have to eat and work, right?
Refer to the thatch curtains and plastic film in the field, and then the face of the pool, and the corn slats in Datiandi.
At the exhibition hall, the exhibited products have been prepared. Changbai Mountain red ginseng, canned ginseng honey slices, and plastic-packaged honey slices are all prepared according to Xu Shiyan's requirements.
The brochure is beautifully made. There are not only text introductions in multiple languages, but also photos of ginseng growth environment, ginseng flowers, ginseng seeds, and ginseng harvesting.
The most amazing thing is that there are wonderful ginseng stories at the back of the brochure, as well as the development history of Changbai Mountain ginseng, especially emphasizing that it was a tribute to the imperial dynasty in the past.
Xu Shiyan highly praised and affirmed the works of Li Chengrong and others. Sure enough, the wisdom and strength of the masses are infinite.
The kind of gift box packaging that Xu Shiyan wanted was also made by Han Limin's efforts by finding a few veteran craftsmen.
The bright red satin gift box, with gilt letters on it, is extraordinarily beautiful.
Sorry, sorry, I misremembered the time of the rotation. Shenyang participated in the rotation, but not at that time. I checked the information before, but I don't know how to remember it, and I remembered the wrong time. Alas, these days, my brain is for nothing. It has already been written, so let it be, and it is not easy to change it. Sorry, sorry.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: accompanying
chapters.content:
Chapter 333 Accompanying
The Spring Fair, medicine, health care products and local products are all in the third phase, and the exhibition time is from May 1st to May 5th.
From Fusong to Guangzhou, you need to go to Changchun to join the large troops in the province, and then take the train from Changchun to the south.
It will take five or six days for this journey alone, and you have to make arrangements in advance when you get there, at least one day reserved.
That is to say, they have to leave on April 21st at the latest.
On April 19th, the products exhibited at the first exhibition site have been shipped out by railway, and Lin Qiyue has also arranged for his entourage.
Suddenly, I received a call from the county, saying that Lin Qiyue only needs to go alone for the first time, and the county will arrange several people to go there.
"Ju Li, what do you mean?
The number of participants designated above, we have prepared all the products, so many things, how can I go alone? Am I busy? "
As soon as Lin Qiyue heard what was on the phone, his complexion suddenly became ugly.
Originally, Lin Qiyue planned to take Li Bingzhuo and Xu Shiyan to Guangzhou together.
With so many products, it is necessary to have enough manpower to arrange booths and be responsible for publicity and introduction.
Xu Shiyan is in charge of exhibiting products. He is the most familiar and has many ideas, so he has to go.
Li Bingzhuo is stable, he is just right as a support, Lin Qiyue is at the helm, the three of them are a perfect combination.
Arrange three people to participate in the venue, plus the secretary of the county, and Director Li of the Commercial Bureau, five people are exactly right.
But the county suddenly said that they needed to arrange another person, and Lin Qiyue would be furious.
The province appointed them to participate in the exhibition, but as soon as they participated in the exhibition, only one person went? what? Watch other people play monkeys?
"Old Lin, you also have to consider our difficulties. No factory in our county has ever participated in the Spring Fair.
This time is a rare opportunity, anyway, we have to go out and study.
Besides, there are many products in our county. There are so many good medicines in the county pharmaceutical factory, don't we have to take the opportunity to sell them outside?
Old Lin, even if you carry forward your style and let brother companies follow suit, okay?
No matter how many products you have, can’t we help you with the work? "On the other end of the phone, earnestly persuaded.
"No, the quota cannot be given up.
The county can arrange as many people as it likes, and it has nothing to do with our participation. "
Lin Qiyue became unhappy, and refused with a very strong attitude.
This is not something else that can be used to promote the style. The province calls for one exhibitor to participate in the exhibition, and it is not the place won by the county. Why should others follow suit?
Want to follow Zhanguang, why did you go ahead of time?
Everything has been prepared here, tickets have been arranged in advance, and now they say they won’t let so many people go.
Why? With the big heads of the gang in the pharmaceutical factory?
"Look at you, why are you so impatient? Isn't this all for the sake of our county?
In this way, add another person on your side, and I will find a way to get rid of another person on my side, will this work? "
The other end of the phone had no choice but to back down and decide to take one less person.
The leader voluntarily backed down, and Lin Qiyue couldn't be justified. In the end, he had no choice but to agree.
Hung up the phone, Lin Qiyue called Xu Shiyan and Li Bingzhuo to a meeting to discuss who would go and who would not.
"Secretary, let the field manager go, and I will be in charge of research and development.
I don’t know a foreign language, and when I went to communicate with foreign businessmen, I was a duck to Ting Lei, and I didn’t understand anything, so it was useless.
There is no need to introduce the products in our market, you two know Yemen in your heart.
Besides, we all have printed brochures, and merchants can understand them after taking them, and it doesn’t take much effort.
It’s useless for me to go, and I have to pay for the travel expenses in the flower field. "
Among the three, Xu Shiyan was the least qualified. At this time, of course he had to take the initiative to back down.
It's just a chance to go out, it's nothing, the boss is not happy.
"No, I should be at home. There is a lot of work in the field at this time, and I will stay at home and lead others to work.
Xiao Xu, follow Secretary Lin, you are young, strong and energetic, let me go all the way, this bone will fall apart. "Li Bingzhuo waved his hands quickly.
"You are the most familiar with those products, even if you don't know a foreign language, you can still talk to the translator.
It's useless for you to ask me to go, I don't understand. "
This is modesty. Li Bingzhuo is also the head of the factory after all. With so many years of experience, can he still not understand the efficacy of ginseng at all?
Li Bingzhuo had the intention to praise Xu Shiyan and let Xu Shiyan stand out, so he voluntarily backed down.
Xu Shiyan knew in his heart that the more he couldn't grab this spot, the two pushed each other, which made Lin Qiyue in a dilemma.
"Xiao Xu, don't be polite to Lao Li, you are a young man, please work harder, this time you will be with me.
Lao Li is steady, there really needs to be someone watching over the mess in our place, Lao Li has enough weight to hold things under control. "
Years later, the original deputy head retired, and Li Bingzhuo was transferred to the deputy head of the main field, which was regarded as a promotion.
Lin Qiyue leads the team out, so there must be a leader on the side of the venue.
"Yes, yes, Xiao Xu has to follow in this matter.
Young people are hard-working, go there and learn from other provinces when you get there, steal a teacher or something, you can definitely do this. "
Li Bingzhuo patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and said with a smile.
Both leaders have spoken, and it is useless for Xu Shiyan to object, so he can only agree.
It’s already decided to go out, and the things that should be packed are almost packed, so what’s the point? Hurry up and get ready, let's go.
On April 20th, Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan carried a lot of things on their backs, took the train to Hunjiang first, and then reversed to the provincial capital.
There is no train in the county, so the leaders tried to find a way to take a car from the county to the provincial capital, meet up in the provincial capital, and then report to the Provincial Commercial Hall Exhibition Organizing Committee.
Everyone arrived, and then led by the leaders of the province, the group boarded the train heading south from the provincial capital.
The old-fashioned green leather train is as slow as ever, and the wheels are in contact with the rails, making a rattling sound.
Xu Shiyan and the others were sitting in this carriage, most of which were representatives of enterprises in the province and counties and cities.
Although they may not have known each other before, the Northeast people have their own hospitable attributes, and all of them are good at socializing. If you get in the car and chat for a while, you will almost know each other.
The requirement for participating in the Spring Fair is that every participant must wear a suit.
In this day and age, most people's clothes don't fit well, they are bulky and loose.
This season, it’s still a bit cold in the north, so people wear sweaters and shirts inside their suits, and some people even wear a sweater under their shirts for fear of going out in the cold.
The train went all the way south, and the big guys undressed all the way down, and finally they were suit shirts.
Xu Shiyan was different from them, the suit was made by Xu Shiqin himself.
According to Xu Shiyan's requirements, it must be fit, that is, fat and thin people who can only wear a white shirt inside, don't be too fat and not energetic.
So Xu Shiyan was wearing a suit and a coat over his head. When he felt hot on the road, he took off his coat.
"Yo? You are wearing a suit, how can you feel more energetic than us?"
We were about to arrive at the place. When everyone was packing up and getting out of the car, someone suddenly noticed that Xu Shiyan's suit was different from everyone's.
"Oh, my sister sewed this one by hand. It didn't have to be too fat at the time, and I could wear a shirt inside."
Xu Shiyan lowered his head to look at himself, then looked up at the others, and noticed something different.
Originally, those people had a lot of clothes in their suits, but now they took off their sweaters and everything else, making the suits look empty and not very energetic.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Exhibit
chapters.content:
Chapter 334 Exhibitors
A group of people wandered on the train for five days, finally arrived at the station, and came to the city at the forefront of reform and opening up.
The moment they got off the train, everyone's legs felt weak, as if they were stepping on cotton.
Some people feel like they are still on the train, dangling around.
Young people can feel better, but those who are older feel like they are going to fall apart.
Just like this, I left the station and went straight to the hotel I booked in advance to stay.
All of them lay motionless on the bed and slept for a whole day, only to wake up the next morning and feel much better.
You can’t be idle even here. In the morning, all the representatives from the province will have a training meeting together, emphasizing discipline.
This kind of large-scale event must act in a unified manner. It is not allowed to go out privately, let alone contact anyone in private.
In this day and age, discipline is still very important. If anyone who does not observe discipline causes trouble, then the quota will be canceled directly, and there will be no chance.
Have a training meeting in the morning, go to the train station in the afternoon to pick up the exhibitor samples shipped in advance, and set up the booth the next day.
Here we are hurrying to finish the matter, and the third phase of the Spring Fair has also started.
Fusong is a place specially approved by the province, and the booth is arranged in a slightly remote location, so that merchants will not be able to wander here for a while.
So Lin Qiyue and Secretary Guan chatted there.
"Oh, I have been here for two days, and I finally realized what is called the real southern speed, what is called time is life, and efficiency is everything. It is really different.
We are still developing slowly over there. If you look at the south, they are all trotting all the way. "Lin Qiyue couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"Yes, compared with others, we are several steps behind. They are running, and we are walking. It is too difficult to catch up."
Secretary Guan also felt the same way. What he saw and heard in the past two days was really an eye-opener.
The difference between the north and the south and the speed of economic development all make people yearn for the south.
This, Xu Shiyan can't get in, the difference between the North and the South is already obvious at this time.
When the south has already started to run desperately, the north is still swaying like a big brother, so how to catch up? The gap will only grow wider.
While chatting, a staff member suddenly came to remind them that a foreign businessman had arrived, which cheered everyone up.
Xu Shiyan and the others hurriedly arranged their clothes, corrected the work badges on their chests, raised their chests and looked up, energetic and ready to go into battle.
A group of merchants came in front of them, accompanied by staff specially arranged by the exhibition.
However, there are few explainers and many merchants. Many people can't wait to listen to the explanations, so they scatter around to have a look and choose the products they like.
Some people walked around and came to a booth and stopped to watch.
One booth was only about one meter in size. Lin Qiyue, Guan Enxue, and Li Jingming, standing behind the booth, were crowded and unable to move away.
Xu Shiyan and one person from the pharmaceutical factory can only be behind the leader.
Seeing someone coming, Lin Qiyue hurriedly handed over the brochure they brought.
The merchant received it and found that there were Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and other words on it, and described the product in detail.
Especially the testing and identification of Changbai Mountain red ginseng, the brochure has a photo of the identification certificate.
At the end of the brochure, there are very vivid and wonderful stories.
This made many people feel quite novel, and many people reached out for the brochure to read carefully.
Some people came to ask Secretary Guan and Lin Qiyue behind the booth about the products.
Both Guan Enxue and Lin Qiyue don't understand foreign languages, and the staff of the exhibition arrangements are too busy at the moment, so they can't take care of this side at all.
Lin Qiyue was so anxious that he was sweating profusely, and even gestured and said, he couldn't understand what he was talking about.
"What's wrong with this? We don't understand the language of others."
But Lin Qiyue was anxious to death. Finally, so many people came over, but they couldn't understand. Isn't this a delay?
No, you must train a few specialized translators when you go back, and you can’t wait for no one to use the real chapter.
Lin Qiyue and the others were in a hurry to get angry, but the provincial leaders also noticed that the situation was different.
Originally, the province allocated a quota to Fusong with the attitude of giving it a try, but I really didn't expect that in such a short period of time, there would be a lot of merchants here.
The provincial leaders saw it, and quickly arranged for two accompanying translators to help answer the questions of foreign businessmen.
After the two translators came over, Lin Qiyue's pressure suddenly eased a lot.
At this moment, he simply pushed Xu Shiyan to the front and asked Xu Shiyan to introduce and the two staff members to translate.
No one knows the product better than Xu Shiyan. Through his vivid introduction, those merchants also understand the function of the product in front of them.
Ginseng products are mainly used in Asia, especially some people in East Asia, who are more cognizant of this.
Especially the ginseng instant honey slices, many people are particularly interested.
Xu Shiyan was flexible, took the opportunity to open a few bottles, and gave each merchant a small individual package, indicating that they could open it and taste it.
Some people have the courage to open it immediately and take out the honey piece and put it in their mouth.
Ginseng is impregnated with high-quality honey. The sweetness of honey neutralizes the bitterness, so the sweetness of honey is the first thing you feel in the mouth, and then the aroma of ginseng.
"This kind of honey slice was passed down from the secret recipe of the ancient court. You know, the ginseng from Changbai Mountain was a tribute to the royal family, and ordinary people could not enjoy it."
"Those imperial concubines are able to look young and stay young forever because they eat ginseng every day."
"This honey slice is especially made of the best Changbai Mountain ginseng, the top linden tree snow honey, and other precious medicinal materials. It took dozens of processes to refine it."
The above paragraph is all made up, just to increase the story and persuasion.
"We mainly use the secret recipe of the palace and cooperate with modern technology to produce the new type of instant honey slices. The honey slices are rich in nutrition, high in medicinal value, and they are very convenient to eat."
"This kind of instant honey chips is aimed at those high-class people who are busy with work on weekdays and have no time to make soup for nourishment.
Then you can carry a little honey chip with you, and when you think of it, you can take it out anytime and anywhere and eat a piece.
For example, when waiting for the bus or elevator, it can be used as a snack without delaying work, but the effect is much better than snacks.
Especially for those mental workers and office white-collar workers, it is a very suitable nourishing product.
It can resist fatigue, enhance resistance, and relieve sub-health status. "Xu Shiyan explained to these people while distributing honey chips.
"What about this small glass bottle, which can be eaten in the office or at home.
Take one or two tablets and brew them with hot water, as tea, the effect is also very good. "
Xu Shiyan opened another small canning jar and let people see the inside. Compared with the plastic one, there is more honey in it, and it is better to soak it in water.
Brochures and on-site tastings have already moved the hearts of many merchants.
In addition to Xu Shiyan's introduction, it is especially said that it comes from the secret recipe of the palace and was used by the royal family in the past.
How can those merchants bear it? Immediately came forward and asked Xu Shiyan about the price of the honey chips.
This, before coming here, Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue discussed the accounting.
A small can of ginseng honey slices, with two and a half pieces of fresh ginseng as the standard, just one piece, the cost price of ginseng alone is about ten yuan.
Including honey, packaging, and labor, the total cost does not exceed fifteen yuan.
Xu Shiyan suggested an offer of eighteen dollars.
Based on the current exchange rate, it can be converted to thirty-six yuan, which is a corner if you earn twice as much.
The plastic package has a small amount, but the ginseng used is large and the requirements are high.
The cross-section of the slices should not be smaller than a five-cent coin, and each slice should be finished in appearance, and the amber color is slightly transparent.
So don't look at the light weight, but the quality is higher and the packaging process is more complicated, so the price is 11 US dollars.
As for the gift box, each box contains two glass bottles and two plastic bottles, and the price is $64.
When arranging the booth, Guan En learned about the quotation. At that time, Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue had a tacit understanding and deliberately lowered the price.
The main reason is that the price is too high and the county will interfere.
The other one also wants to see the reaction on the spot. If the intention of the merchants on the spot to order is high, the price will definitely go up. Who comes out here not to make money?
So, when Guan Enxue heard Xu Shiyan's offer, his frightened hands trembled.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: Earn foreign exchange successfully
chapters.content:
Chapter 335 Success in Earning Foreign Exchange
Two halves of fresh ginseng, if processed into light red ginseng, it should be about twenty sticks per catty.
The purchase price of the place of origin, that is, the purchase price of the county ginseng antler company, is about 170 yuan.
The wholesale price of the county ginseng antler company to domestic sales, that is, to the provincial medicinal material company and health care product company, is two hundred and ten yuan.
The wholesale price of the medicinal material company to foreign countries is 260 yuan, which is about 130 U.S. dollars, and the fluctuation will not be too large.
If fresh ginseng is made into honey slices, then 20 cans can be produced, and each can sells for 18 dollars, a total of 360 dollars.
Deducting related costs, the profit is much higher than the price of ordinary red ginseng.
Xu Shiyan not only uses two-and-a-half fresh ginseng, but also two-and-a-half fresh ginseng, which has lower cost and higher profit.
This is the added value brought by industrial finishing. The finer the processing, the higher the added value and the greater the profit.
Guan Enxue is that an ordinary person? As far as this little account is concerned, you can understand it once you think about it.
At the moment, I was amazed that the two people participating in the competition had the courage to call such a high price, and at the same time I was very excited.
If this price is really achieved, the profit is simply too considerable.
Some merchants hesitated a little after hearing the price, but some merchants thought the price was acceptable.
So immediately stepped forward, discussed in detail, and signed a letter of intent.
Those who are still hesitating, seeing that other people have signed the letter of intent, some of them are also moved, so they all come here.
"Everyone, we are currently in stock, and we should be able to have 25,000 bottles of glass jars and 40,000 bottles of plastic jars.
If this amount is exceeded, you will have to wait for about eight months. You can't make it until fresh ginseng is unearthed in autumn.
The entire production process will take a few months, so the supply will be available after New Year's Day in 1985 at the earliest. "
Xu Shiyan yelled this on purpose, not only for those merchants, but also for the management secretary, Secretary Lin.
Let them be aware of this, don’t get too excited and overorder all of a sudden, this is really not available anywhere else, and they can’t get it.
In autumn, Lin Qiyue promised Xu Shiyan to allocate 30,000 catties of fresh ginseng to Xu Shiyan for experiments.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to spend too much at the time, and only selected more than 10,000 catties of fresh ginseng to make honey chips.
After all, no one knew at the time whether the honey chip would be successful, so they didn’t dare to do too much.
The honey slices made of more than 10,000 catties of fresh ginseng are probably the output that Xu Shiyan reported before. If there is more, if you want it, you can only wait after New Year's Day.
Of course, the actual time required is not that long, Xu Shiyan said so on purpose. As he said before, there are dozens of processes, so what if the time is short?
The longer it takes, the more it proves that the production of things is cumbersome and rare, so others will pay attention to it.
And explain the matter clearly first, so as not to be unable to supply the goods when the time comes, then you will have to pay the merchants money.
Guan Enxue and Lin Qiyue were shocked when they heard this, and hurriedly checked the quantity of the current order.
As for those merchants, as soon as they heard that there was only such a small amount, many of them who were hesitant at first stepped forward to order.
In just a short while, tens of thousands of bottles of honey chip products were all ordered.
Even Changbai Mountain red ginseng, some people place orders, but the quantity is not large, just as the stock in the market is sufficient.
The five-day exhibition, the first day has not yet finished, and there are no products to sell at the first exhibition.
But Guan Enxue and Lin Qiyue are very happy, this is the beginning of Fusongling.
I never dared to think before that they could also come to the Canton Fair and earn foreign exchange successfully.
Guan Enxue was so happy that he didn't know what to do. He couldn't care less about what to say at the moment, and directly turned into a humanoid stamping machine, Kaka just kept stamping the letter of intent for purchase.
After the two parties sign the letter of intent, there will be special staff responsible for negotiating subsequent payment and delivery procedures.
"Old Lin, have you counted? How many thousands of foreign exchange can these orders earn in total?"
I don't know how many chapters have been written. Guan Enxue felt that his arms were a little numb. Taking advantage of the small number of people, he turned around and asked Lin Qiyue.
"Secretary Guan, I made a rough calculation just now. It should be more than 800,000 dollars, less than 900,000 dollars."
Lin Qiyue barely restrained the joy in his heart, tried to stay calm, and spoke very calmly.
In fact, his heart was as excited as a drum, and his hands were shaking non-stop. Right now, he wished he could jump a few highs on the spot and call him out.
Foreign exchange earning of nearly 900,000 US dollars, what kind of concept is this?
Not to mention the participation of a small state-owned exhibition, including the participation of enterprises from the Tonghua area, it is impossible to say whether it can earn 900,000 US dollars.
This is a US dollar, but foreign exchange has a different meaning.
How many factories wish they had to make money in order to earn foreign exchange. They not only earn foreign exchange, but also make money, and they make a lot of money. Lin Shule couldn't keep his mouth shut.
When Guan Enxue heard that it was nearly 900,000 yuan, he suddenly regained his spirits, his waist no longer hurt, his arms were no longer sore, and his eyes glowed green.
This time, Fusong has achieved results, and when he goes back, he must celebrate the participants by wearing red ribbons. This is definitely a historic breakthrough.
You must know that although ginseng can be exported to earn foreign exchange, it is exported from the provincial medicinal material company, which has nothing to do with Fusong. The place of origin can only earn hard money.
But starting today, everything is different.
The success of ginseng honey slices made Guan Enxue see the potential of deep processing and fine processing of products.
Just right, it's time for the museum to close for a break at noon.
The few people who were already exhausted and paralyzed, but their spirits were extremely excited, supported each other like this, and walked out of the huge Liuhua Pavilion with strange smiles on their faces.
Xu Shiyan and the others don’t have the treatment of foreign guests, and they don’t have high-end cars to pick them up.
Several people went directly to a nearby restaurant and ordered casually. Two bowls of rice were not enough for each person, so they ordered another bowl.
At this moment, I finally came back to my senses and couldn't help laughing.
"I didn't expect, I really didn't expect that this time you can create a miracle by participating.
Tell me, what was your thinking at the time? How did you come up with the idea of ​​making this kind of honey?
This thing obviously doesn't have much technical content, so how dare you do so much at once? What if you can't sell it? "Guan Enxue couldn't hold back, and asked out anyway.
"This is Xiao Xu's idea. Didn't we submit several reports before we participated in the event? It was an article about industrial upgrading, ginseng refining and deep processing? Those were all Xiao Xu's ideas.
Last year we had a bumper harvest of ginseng, and the output hit a record high, so I went all out and specially approved 30,000 catties of water ginseng for Xiao Xu to use in experiments.
Who would have thought that the value created by these 30,000 catties would be so high. "
At this moment, Lin Qiyue is also very grateful for the correct choice he made at that time, and he unconditionally supported Xu Shiyan's research experiment. Really, so true.
"Young people are full of brains. Not bad, really good. Secretary Guan, you will be rewarded when you go back. This is to bring honor to our county."
Director Li next to him also looked excited.
"Old Lin, can you share this technology with your brother units?" Li Jingming asked seemingly casually.
Lin Qiyue was stunned for a moment, then looked up at Xu Shiyan.
Now, Xu Shiyan has become the backbone of Lin Qiyue, no matter what happens, he has to ask Xu Shiyan what he means.

chapters.title: Chapter 336: apply for patent
chapters.content:
Chapter 336 patent application
"Secretary Guan, I want to report this matter to you.
I discussed with Secretary Lin that we plan to apply for a patent for the technology of ginseng honey slices and Changbai Mountain red ginseng. "
Nowadays, China does not pay much attention to these, and there is no patent application, but it is recognized abroad.
Fusong's ginseng products must have patent certification if they want to go international directly.
With patent certification, no matter how simple the technology is, the one next to you who has a good life and the one who always likes to steal other people's culture, don't even think about using it.
Before I was reborn and came back, I heard my daughter talk about it.
It is said that it is a domestic traditional Chinese medicine, but the formula was taken away by Xiaori, and it was changed to Hanfang, which has a high sales volume abroad.
There is also the special application for world heritage, which also changes the various cultures in our country and becomes his family.
People in China don’t pay much attention to it, and the result is that they get it away and apply for a patent.
Looking back, we can no longer sell food from our country. What's the name of this bitch?
Xu Shiyan doesn't know anything else, and he can't care about it, but anything that comes out of his hand must apply for a patent.
You can apply for as many as you can, and other countries will not want to use it in the future.
"Huh? Patent certification? What is that? Why don't I understand?"
Guan Enxue and Li Jingming were both dumbfounded. Why does this feel like they are listening to a bible?
What is patent certification? Never heard of it.
Don’t blame them. At present, we don’t even understand trademark registration in China, let alone patents.
"I don't know much about patent certification.
Anyway, it is the technology in my hands. As long as it has not appeared before, I apply for a patent, so others will not be able to use it in the future.
If others want to use it, they have to pay me the patent fee. If they don’t, I can file a lawsuit against him. "
Xu Shiyan's culture is not enough, that is, he has a general understanding, so he wants to take this opportunity to inquire about it.
"Ah? Aren't you too picky?
Co-authored a ginseng slice soaked in honey, oh, if you use it, others won’t let you use it? This is not very authentic, is it? "
On the other end, Director Xue of the pharmaceutical factory, who had been silent all this time, was blown away.
This morning, none of the products brought by the pharmaceutical factory were touched, and they all watched a performance.
The director Xue of the pharmaceutical factory was really anxious to get angry, and envious and jealous.
The medicine that their pharmaceutical factory has worked so hard to make, but no one is optimistic about it. Why is it that so many foreigners have taken a fancy to an unremarkable ginseng honey tablet?
Earning more than 800,000 US dollars in foreign exchange at once? God, pharmaceutical companies never dared to think about it.
The director of the pharmaceutical factory just now thought in his heart that this fall, their factory will also find a way to cooperate with some participants.
Isn’t it just soaking in honey? Who doesn't know this stuff? When the time is ready, they will come to sell it, and it will cost more than ten dollars a bottle.
How much does this thing cost? Isn't it just playing tricks? What's the big deal?
When Li Jingming spoke, it was actually from the pharmaceutical factory to signal that they had been muttering for a while just because of this matter.
Who would have imagined that this little technician would be so picky when he participated in the field. Instead of agreeing, what kind of patent should he apply for?
What is this for? He used it, but others can't use it in the future? Are you crazy about making money?
"Tunnel? What is authentic?
Director Xue, please tell me, what should I do to be authentic?
We participate in the field, which is time-consuming, labor-intensive and cost-intensive. Why do others take away the technology for nothing without paying anything for the products we develop?
Co-author and share the technology with me is called authentic, or generous? If I disagree, am I cheap? "
Xu Shiyan took a look at Director Xue, and immediately turned down, what's wrong? Picking up the bargain and picking it up on him? Dreaming.
"Also, do you think our honey chips are soaked in honey? Hehe, then you really look down on us technology developers.
Although it is a small slice of ginseng honey, the technical content inside may not be lower than your ginseng tiger bone wine.
If someone reproduces it casually, will we technicians have any face? "
This, Xu Shiyan is confident, even if someone who does not know the production process is given honey chips, he will not be able to figure it out.
The processing of honey chips is not simple, and some processes require strict control of temperature and pressure.
Just kidding, without two brushes, how dare he send products to the Spring Fair?
"Secretary Guan, do you still remember the topic of controlling the rapid growth of ginseng that I mentioned before? This is the same.
This year, we have earned foreign exchange by participating in the market. If we don’t take some measures, next year, let alone other places, there will be several factories in our county that will also produce honey chips.
Of course, let’s not mention whether the quality of other factories is up to standard.
The amount of foreign purchases is there, and each company can only lower the price of each other in order to sell.
In the end, who is cheaper? The cheap ones are foreign businessmen, they took advantage of it, and we lost money. "
Xu Shiyan simply ignored the director of the pharmaceutical factory and turned to talk to Guan Enxue.
"Maybe Secretary Guan hasn't figured it out yet, what kind of honey chips can earn foreign exchange, and they are so popular?
Actually, it’s just one thing, what sells is creativity, which is in line with foreign consumption levels and caters to consumer groups, so it can be successful.
Is creativity worth money? It may be worthless in the eyes of many people, but in my heart, creativity is priceless.
This has nothing to do with technical difficulty. No matter how technical it is, even if you make flowers out of ginseng, foreign businessmen will not recognize it, and you will still not be able to sell it. "
“What is protected by applying for a patent, and what is protected is creativity.
I applied for a patent, and similar products will not be allowed to appear in foreign countries in the future. This ensures the uniqueness of ginseng honey tablets and also protects our interests. "
When Xu Shiyan said this, he stopped and turned to look at Director Xue.
"As for the country, even with patent certification, some people still don't believe in evil, and will definitely operate secretly, wanting to get a share of the pie.
No problem, just produce it, I'll see if it can be sold if it is produced.
The patent is in my hands, as long as you want to export it, don't try to bypass me.
At that time, I see that those people have invested a large amount of money, and a dollar in foreign exchange cannot be exchanged. What should I do? "
This means that the director of the pharmaceutical factory heard it, and if you have the ability, try it and see if you can sell it?
Actually, this is to guard against gentlemen and not against villains. There will always be people who take advantage of loopholes, but there are rules, which can always guard against most people.
"Secretary Guan, it doesn't mean that we don't care about our brother units or the general public as soon as we make money in the field.
The point is that the current product is too single, just such a kind of money-making, we can't put all the bets on a small honey chip.
When we develop more products in the future, we will definitely bring our brothers and farmers to make money together.
How many employees do we have in total? Even if each employee has eight hands, we can't keep busy all day long.
What's the matter? By that time, can we forget about other participants in our county? Then you have to take care of it, everyone will get rich together. "
This is not to coax anyone, Xu Shiyan really thinks so. Of course, how to achieve common prosperity is still a question that needs to be discussed and studied.
"But it can't do it now, it really can't. The ginseng refined processing industry is just at the beginning, and it's too weak to withstand some people messing around."
"If someone sees our ginseng honey slices earning money now, they will be jealous and start the project, within three years, the ginseng honey slices in our county will be rotten on the street.
Rare things are more expensive, this sentence is the absolute truth, so I said, you must apply for a patent and control the patent right. Even if others want to imitate, in a short time, it will not affect our county's export earnings. "
When Xu Shiyan said this, he looked at Director Xue of the pharmaceutical factory, and the meaning behind his words was obvious.
Guan Enxue and Lin Qiyue were stunned and dumbfounded by Xu Shiyan's words. They had never been exposed to these things before, and they had never even heard of them.
"Xiao Xu, come on, we have to go through the formalities quickly and apply for patents for all our related technologies, no matter how much it costs, we have to go through it quickly.
Grandma’s, I don’t believe it anymore. With the patent certification, who will argue with me? "
Lin Qiyue jumped up excitedly, and his voice couldn't help but grow louder.
Originally, a few people were sitting here chatting, the voices were not loud, but Lin Qiyue slapped the table, which alarmed the people next to him, and many people looked this way.
Lin Qiyue was full of emotion and blood, and when he saw that many people around him looked at him with condemnation.
Lin Qiyue was so angry that he really wanted to ask, "What are you looking at?"

chapters.title: Chapter 337: Export rights
chapters.content:
Chapter 337 Export Rights
Before the words could come out, Xu Shiyan grabbed him.
"Secretary Lin, calm down, calm down, we still have important things to do. You have to go to the provincial leaders with Secretary Guan, we don't have the right to export yet."
These words are to divert Lin Qiyue's attention. People from the Northeast have such a temper. If they don't agree with each other, they can really fight with them. How can it be done?
