As for the right to export, they come to the Spring Fair, and as long as the export trade is concluded, there are relevant departments to operate it.
It doesn’t matter whether the company has the right to export, there is always a way.
Xu Shiyan just wanted to take this opportunity to fight for a participant. If he can win the export right, it will be convenient in the future.
Lin Qiyue was stunned when he heard it, "Damn it, I forgot about the important thing. What's the matter? Will it delay our work?" It's over, won't the joy be in vain?
"It's okay, 800,000 dollars, the province will help find a way."
Xu Shiyan just laughed, this is definitely no problem, the province will give the green light all the way, and handle it quickly, and it will never let more than 800,000 dollars fly away.
Speaking of which, participating in the Spring Fair this time has really gained a lot. If you can get the right to export independently after participating in the fair, it will be great in the future.
In my previous life, I participated in the competition for the first time in 1996. After being approved by the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, I got the right to import and export.
It is estimated that it is impossible to achieve it in one step now, but there must be a way to relax the policy appropriately so that a participant can have the corresponding export right.
It’s only 1984, don’t rush, take your time, wait for more and more products to participate in the fair, and the greater the amount of export earnings, the greater the authority you can get.
At present, as long as these deeply processed products are not subject to the control of the county ginseng company and the provincial medicinal material company, it will be fine if they don't get stuck.
"Secretary Lin, complain to the leaders more about how difficult it is for us.
How difficult is R&D? Workers work in three shifts and don’t rest during holidays.
Don’t make people think that we are rich, remember that we are poor and have no money.
Our products must be held in our own hands, and we must not go through two layers of procedures in the county and the province. "
Xu Shiyan reminded Lin Qiyue in a low voice, don't get excited, feel that your waist is stiff, and pretend to be a fork in front of the leader.
Asking is poor, but it is not easy, and you can live on the money of exporting.
Lin Qiyue didn't give it for nothing, it was not for nothing when he heard it, he didn't tense up immediately, and almost laughed out.
"You kid is getting worse and worse. We all know that we are the richest in the field, but you still make me cry poor. Come on, I understand, look at it."
The meal was full, the talk was over, and it was time for the museum to open in the afternoon, so everyone got up and left the restaurant and returned to the exhibition hall.
In the afternoon, Xu Shiyan, Li Jingming, and Xue Kun were behind the booth, and Guan Enxue and Lin Qiyue went to find the provincial leaders.
Earning nearly 900,000 foreign exchange in the morning, this performance is also ranked first in the province.
The leader of the team met them very politely and asked if there was any difficulty and if they needed help.
Lin Qiyue began to perform, crying about the difficulty of research and development, how much research funds were spent, and how much ginseng was harmed.
How hard it is for the R&D personnel, who burn the lamps and burn oil continuously, do not rest on holidays, and regard the field as their home, wishing they could lay the floor in the field.
Anyway, it’s pitiful, the purpose is one, and it’s not easy for us to develop.
In the future, this self-developed product will not go through the county and provincial procedures. We need an export right.
The medicine company was not happy at first.
This morning, not many of the products they brought were ordered, but they made a big splash.
Leaving aside the medicinal material company, which directly exports from a local market, then their medicinal material company must not reduce their profits by a lot every year?
The money falls into one participant’s pocket, what about the others? Others don't make money anymore?
The people at the medicinal material company will object.
As a result, at this time, Lin Qiyue made another big move, saying that he could pay 20% more than before for the profits and taxes of self-developed products.
That is to say, the part that the medicinal material company earned was directly handed over.
As long as you can get the right to export, you can give up the middleman's part of the profit, and they will earn the export part.
Moreover, export earnings are subsidized, and no matter how you calculate it, you earn more than before.
The people from the medicine company were dumbfounded, what the hell, can they still play like this?
"Leader, this does not comply with the regulations. The rules set by the above are that our medicinal material company is responsible for purchasing ginseng.
If we omit our link and directly connect with foreign businessmen, it will have a great impact, and foreign businessmen will deal with us separately to suppress prices. "
The people from the medicinal material company were not easy-going, so they immediately fought back.
"I think the leader may not have figured out what I meant just now.
I mean, we export our self-developed products, and we still cooperate with county ginseng companies and medicinal materials companies for other conventional products. "
This is purely a trap. Self-developed products are of high value, and we will definitely produce as many self-developed products as possible in the future.
Conventional products, hehe, there will be fewer and fewer in the future, and one day sooner or later, I will stop playing with you.
"Leader, there is one more thing. I wonder if the leaders have thought about it?
Currently, Fusong's ginseng fertilization technology is very mature, and the current ginseng production is rising steadily, and it is estimated that it will reach three to five times the previous production in the next three years.
With such a large output, I don't know whether the medicinal material company has the ability to buy them all?
If, by that time, we can’t buy all of them, then what should we participants do? Can't we find our own way out? "
Lin Qiyue remembered Xu Shiyan's article, and directly used the arguments in it to convince the provincial leaders.
As soon as these words came out, not only the medicinal material company and the provincial leaders, but even Guan Enxue was startled.
If the output is so high, if the sales volume fails to increase and there is a backlog, it will definitely lead to lower prices and seriously damage the economy.
"Is this true? Why do you say that?" The provincial leader lost his composure and hurriedly asked.
Lin Qiyue has read Xu Shiyan's article several times.
Moreover, he is not only the head of a ginseng field, but also the vice-chairman of the Humanistic Society, with all the data on Fusong ginseng planting in his mind.
Now list the data one by one, and do detailed explanation and reasoning.
The more they talked, the more chilled these leaders felt. If this is not going well, something will really go wrong.
"This is the original intention of our participation, overreaching our own capabilities, and insisting on independent research and development of new products, upgrading the ginseng industry, and deep processing and finishing.
We cannot passively wait for the market to fall before looking for a way out. We must take the initiative and strive to increase the added value of products. This is the way out in the future. "
This set of theories came entirely from Xu Shiyan, but it made Lin Qiyue understand it quite well.
It's all said here, what else can the medicinal material company say?
It is certain that the production of ginseng will increase. With a planting area as large as Quanfusong, if the production increases by 30 to 50%, then their medicinal material company really does not have the ability to buy it.
This thing is not very easy to adjust. If you have too much appetite, you will have too much greed. If you can't digest it, something will go wrong.
The people from the medicine company stopped talking.
The provincial leaders saw it, well, don’t say anything, just do what you need to do, and don’t delay earning foreign exchange.
It doesn't matter who owns the right to export, as long as it can export to create value, it doesn't matter who owns it.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: Booking
chapters.content:
Chapter 338 Reservations
So, the provincial leader immediately called back and reported the situation here in detail.
Then ask the relevant departments to complete the relevant procedures for the export right of a participating market as quickly as possible, so as not to delay the receipt of more than 800,000 foreign exchange.
If there is an endorsement from the province, it will definitely not be wrong.
Lin Qiyue was very happy, and happily returned to the booth, but when he got there, he found that there were many people around the booth.
Lin Qiyue was thrilled. They had sold out all the goods in stock all morning, and they ordered again, but there was nothing to sell. This is no joke.
"Xiao Xu, what's the situation? We have no goods to sell, why don't you put away the samples on the booth?"
Lin Qiyue came behind Xu Shiyan, gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice.
"Don't worry, Secretary Lin, I've already told them that they can't ship at the moment, and it won't be until after New Year's Day in 1985 at the earliest.
People are pre-ordering our products for this year's new season. You see, the shipping date is scheduled until March and April next year. "
Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard the words, he thought he was stupid, and still ordered takeaway when he was out of stock? He is now booked out for next year.
It’s just right, this fall, the ginseng will be shipped from the ground, you can make it with the honey slices first, and the rest will be later.
"Secretary Lin, hurry up and call back, let our people find a way to collect honey now."
This is the most important thing. Honey slices cannot be made without honey.
A catty of ginseng needs at least half a catty of honey. I just ordered 10,000 glass bottles and 20,000 plastic bottles. Honey alone requires a lot.
There is a bee farm in Yishenchang, which is near Shenchang on the mountain, but the bee production is not too high, and it can produce more than 1,000 catties of honey a year.
For such a large demand, it is completely a drop in the bucket.
The honey used in ginseng honey slices is mainly linden tree honey, which cannot be found elsewhere but around Changbai Mountain.
Fortunately, there are beekeepers around. Every summer, those beekeepers in the south will also come to Changbai Mountain to catch linden tree honey.
Prepare in advance and buy as much as possible, so as not to be short of honey when the time comes, and you will be caught blind.
Lin Qiyue was already dumbfounded. How could he still do this to pre-order next year's products?
Not to mention, this is also beneficial. They can produce according to the order and avoid the backlog caused by blind production.
"Success, I'll call right away and ask Lao Li to immediately mobilize manpower to collect honey everywhere."
Lin Qiyue saw that he was not needed here, well, why should he go, don't make trouble here.
For an afternoon exhibition, Xu Shiyan ordered 12,000 glass bottles, 30,000 plastic bottles, 1,000 gift boxes, and a small amount of Changbaishan red ginseng.
In the next four days, there will be a certain amount of orders every day. Most of the merchants are from South Korea and Dongyi, and there are also orders from European and Southeast Asian merchants. The farthest places are the beautiful country and the maple leaf country.
At the end of the five-day exhibition, in addition to the first batch of those that can be delivered directly, reservation orders have reached 60,000 bottles of glass jars, 100,000 bottles of plastic jars, and 8,000 gift boxes. There is also a small amount of Changbaishan red ginseng, which is expected to earn two 1.7 million dollars.
Including the previous 800,000 yuan, just participating in this exhibition created nearly 3.6 million dollars in foreign exchange income.
Now, other counties, cities and enterprises participating in the exhibition are envious, and many people come to learn from Guan En.
I just want to ask if there are any corners and corners here that need help from other counties and cities.
That means, you eat meat in Fusong, can you let other places also drink soup.
Guan Enxue was frightened by these people and ran away.
Are you kidding me? These enterprises in their county are still waiting to drink soup, can they give it to others?
Guan Enxue had already negotiated with Lin Qiyue before, and the packaging of glass jars and plastic jars was handed over to the county to arrange, and the task was completed with quality and quantity.
Honey, if you can’t buy so much honey, the county will do its best to help you buy it.
For the rest of the matter, no matter where the difficulty is, feel free to mention it as soon as you participate. No matter how big the problem is, there is also the support of the county.
Even the leaders of the city also said that if they have difficulties, they can report to the higher authorities at any time, and the higher authorities will definitely do their best to help.
"Little Guan, there are capable people in your county, General Fu, you have made great achievements this time.
Go back, the recognition is commended, the reward is rewarded. You can't let people work for nothing and get nothing.
The ability to export and earn foreign exchange is the greatest contribution. Such talents must be cultivated and retained. "
The leader of the Tonghua area called Guan Enxue to give him some advice.
"Yes, yes, don't worry the leader, we all count on this."
For Fusong, participating in the game is a cash cow, and Xu Shiyan is even more precious.
So it's more than just keeping it? Guan Enxue wished he could transfer Xu Shiyan to the county right now, and confess him like an ancestor.
However, it is estimated that this idea is difficult to realize, and people will definitely not be released once they participate in the game.
Yes, take your time, the rewards and benefits that should be given are enough, and if you have the opportunity in the future, you have to recruit people.
"By the way, leader, there is one more thing to report to you and the provincial leaders. I wonder if the leader has time?"
Guan Enxue remembered the matter of applying for a patent, and he had to say hello to his superiors about this matter.
Otherwise, other counties and cities will really imitate next year, and if my family fights, it will be a joke for others.
"Is there something to report? If you have time, our exhibition is over, so there must be time."
This year's Spring Fair, Fusong earned more than US$3 million in one fell swoop, nearly half of the province's total earnings.
This weight, in front of any leader, has face, so there must be time, and if you don’t have time, you have to make time.
"Let's go, let's go, I'll accompany you to find the leaders of the province and talk about your ideas."
Just like that, the regional leaders led Guan Enxue and Lin Qiyue to find the provincial leaders.
Although Xu Shiyan is a hero, his level is too low and too high for him to get in touch with.
Lin Qiyue and Guan Enxue sang together and reported the patent application to the higher authorities.
How should I put it, if the people in the county don’t understand it, those in the province must understand it. When the provincial leaders heard it, they knew that it was an expert’s advice, and it was indeed necessary.
The province immediately stated that it would send two professionals tomorrow to accompany Lin Qiyue and Guan Enxue to Hong Kong City to consult and handle matters related to patent applications.
This is a big deal and cannot be ignored.
After Lin Qiyue and Guan Enxue left, the provincial leaders immediately called back.
Let the family organize a meeting to discuss which projects in the province are worth applying for patents in recent years, and hurry up.
This is really not a joke. When it is registered by a foreign country in the future, there is no place to cry.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan, a little butterfly, flapped its wings. As for how much impact it would have on the future, he didn't know.
Anyway, on the second day, Xu Shiyan brought all relevant technical materials such as ginseng field fertilizer, light-transmitting film ginseng technology, narrowing operation path, Changbai Mountain red ginseng technology, and ginseng instant honey chip technology.
Follow the leader, apply for a temporary pass, and then go to the port city.
Find a relevant firm and apply for all items that can be patented.

chapters.title: Chapter 339: warm welcome
chapters.content:
Chapter 339 Warm welcome
The procedure for applying for a patent was a bit cumbersome, and Xu Shiyan and his party were delayed for a few days.
After they finished their work on the patent application, the others had already returned. After all, they all had jobs and no one could afford to delay.
Since it is already late, there is no need to worry, just take a look around.
It's rare to come to a big southern city, why can't I go back empty-handed.
Xu Shiyan went shopping. Color TVs, refrigerators, washing machines, etc. are still limited to tickets.
No tickets are required for other daily necessities, clothing, shoes and hats.
Yes, I can’t get back the big ones, so I bought a few clothes for my family, and it was not a waste of time.
Xu Shiyan bought a few good-looking jeans for his wife, younger sister, and sister-in-law. This kind of jeans is rare among them, and it is definitely synonymous with fashion.
Buy a set of beautiful children's clothing for each of the five children.
These children haven't worn ready-made clothes yet. It's rare to have such beautiful clothes, and they must be set for each of them.
Mom and Dad are the same, picking two nice clothes, and scratching a lot of other odds and ends.
Anyway, I have enough money with me, so I can spend what I need, and why not keep it?
After a crazy purchase, everyone boarded the return train and headed north all the way back to their hometown.
It was another five-day train journey, and I finally looked forward to the arrival of the train at Changchun Railway Station, which made several people very excited.
Traveling on the train these days is really a pain.
Originally, Lin Qiyue, Guan Enxue and others planned to find a random place in the provincial capital to rest for a day, and then go back the day after tomorrow.
I really can't take the train continuously, I can't stand it.
As a result, as soon as they got out of the train station, several people were dumbfounded.
What's the situation outside the station? With the sound of gongs and drums and the fluttering of red flags, what is this for?
A group of primary school students’ drum and trumpet team dressed in neat attire, blowing and playing, and someone on the other side held a sign with what was written on it?
"Welcome the Fusong delegation triumphantly, and warmly celebrate the record breaking of the Spring Fair."
Co-authored, this is specially to welcome Guan Enxue and his party? This is too grand, right?
Several people were a little dumbfounded, but the two staff members next to them who accompanied them to Hong Kong City for business were all smiling.
"This is what the provincial leaders mean. Our province has broken historical records in foreign exchange earnings this year, and your county alone has earned more than three million dollars in foreign exchange.
The provincial leaders have said that they want to give everyone a red coat. "
While speaking, several elementary school students wearing red scarves came forward and put big red flowers and ribbons on Xu Shiyan and others.
That is to say, there are no flowers in this year. If there are flowers, then there must be a bouquet of flowers.
Then, surrounded by the crowd, Xu Shiyan and others got into the car waiting outside and went all the way to the Provincial Hotel.
Then I found out that the front of the provincial hotel was even more grand.
Xu Shiyan and the others were dumbfounded, and got out of the car with a face covered in circles. Amid the applause and cheers of the crowd, they walked to the ceremonial stage.
At this time, the leaders of the province began to speak.
The content is nothing more than to praise Fusong for participating in the competition, for daring to innovate and practice, to add glory to the province's foreign exchange earnings, and so on.
The above are all official articles. As for those things, Xu Shiyan just listened casually and applauded along with the big guys.
But later, when talking about rewards, Xu Shiyan pulled himself together and listened attentively.
"Special rewards include Lin Qiyue, director and secretary of the field, Xu Shiyan, technical consultant, and two Sanyo 14-inch color TV sets."
Xu Shiyan heard this sentence most clearly.
Changchun No. 1 Radio Factory imported Sanyo parts from Dongyi to assemble 14-inch Sanyo color TV sets.
In January of this year, approved by the Provincial Price Bureau, the Provincial Department of Commerce, and the Provincial Department of Machinery and Electronics Industry, the ex-factory price of each unit is 945 yuan, and the market retail price is 1,050 yuan.
This one is considered the best TV in the province, although it is only 14 inches, it is in color.
The previous Corolla 17-inch black and white TV only sold for 619.
"Xiao Xu, what did the leader say just now? I don't seem to understand."
Lin Qiyue was in a daze the whole time. He had been the field manager and secretary for many years, and he had never encountered such a scene.
Before five days in the car, I was dizzy and didn't know the south, east, north, south, and north. Now, I'm even more confused.
"Secretary Lin, the leader said that we will be rewarded with a 14-inch color TV for each of us."
Xu Shiyan is still sober, but now he is laughing out of shape.
A color TV costs around 1,000 yuan. He can get the money, but he can't get the tickets.
This thing is so popular, not to mention Donggang's participation, even Fusong may not be able to supply a few.
Those who can watch color TV these days are all amazing people, and they are definitely a status symbol.
"Xiao Xu, pinch me, why does it feel like a dream to me, did we get confused in the car?"
Lin Qiyue couldn't believe it, so he had to let Xu Shiyan pinch him twice to see if it hurt.
Xu Shiyan was amused, "Secretary Lin, this is real, not a dream.
Let’s participate, this time it’s really amazing, earning more than 3 million US dollars in foreign exchange, accounting for less than half of the province’s foreign exchange earnings this year.
Therefore, the leader rewards us. "How can he really pinch Lin Qiyue, he can only explain to others with a smile.
Lin Qiyue pinched himself and felt the pain, and now he is at ease, and it seems to be true.
Just in time, at this moment, the provincial and regional leaders had finished speaking, and they were calling Lin Qiyue up to speak, so Xu Shiyan smiled and pushed Lin Qiyue onto the stage.
Lin Qiyue is also a leader, his quality is there.
Don't look at the bewildered state off stage just now, after getting on stage, the whole person quickly calmed down.
First of all, I would like to thank all the leaders and all the comrades who came to the welcome ceremony, and then I made a statement that I will continue to work hard to create a more brilliant tomorrow.
Anyway, it’s that set of jier, which can be used anywhere.
Regardless of what Lin Qiyue said was good or bad, anyway, there was a round of applause, and everyone clapped vigorously with smiles on their faces.
After Lin Qiyue finished speaking, a leader suggested that a technical consultant who was present also come up to speak and talk about why ginseng honey tablets were developed in the first place.
Xu Shiyan quickly waved his hands when he heard this. On such a big occasion, what is he, a small technician, going up to show off?
But no matter how much he waved his hands, it was useless. He was dragged and dragged onto the stage.
"Uh, that, to be honest, I'm still a little confused now, it feels like a dream."
Xu Shiyan cleared his throat, and just said this.
Everyone burst into laughter, not because they were laughing at Xu Shiyan's stupidity, but because they thought he was interesting.
Xu Shiyan's face looks like an honest and honest person who is not good at words. It is precisely this kind of person who can do things in a down-to-earth manner and make achievements.
Those who are particularly shrewd at first glance, and who can talk endlessly with their mouths, simply can't stop doing research.
So the more honest Xu Shiyan is, the easier it is to win the favor of others.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: return with honor
chapters.content:
Chapter 340 Returns with honor
This kind of occasion is simply not suitable to really talk about experience, and people don't really come to listen to what they say.
So Xu Shiyan said a few words very simply, and then thanked everyone present.
And said that he would continue to work hard and work non-stop in order to repay the love of the elders in his hometown.
Everyone can see that this technician is too honest, and he belongs to the kind of person who has something in his stomach and can't tell.
So no one laughed at him, and only sent Xu Shiyan off the stage with the warmest applause.
The welcome ceremony was over, and the leader arranged for Xu Shiyan and his party to stay at the provincial hotel, allowing Xu Shiyan and others to rest first, and there will be a celebration banquet in the afternoon.
Everyone was really exhausted. As soon as they entered the hotel room, they wished they could lie down and sleep right away.
But there is a celebration banquet in the afternoon, and it won't be long, so I can't sleep.
So I hurried to take a shower and relax, put on a set of clean clothes, and then lay down on the bed to rest for a while.
The celebration banquet in the afternoon was very lively. Many leaders from the province and region were present, and many people made a special toast.
In the end, Guan Enxue, Lin Qiyue, and Xu Shiyan all drank too much and were sent back to the hotel drunk.
Originally, the few of them wanted to take the train back to Hunjiang, and the county car went to Hunjiang to pick them up.
As a result, the regional leaders firmly refused to let them take the train, and the province also arranged a car, so they took the color TV and Xu Shiyan all the way to Tonghua.
Arriving in Tonghua, it was another welcome and celebration, and the itinerary was delayed for another two days.
When Xu Shiyan left Tonghua, he was no longer an ordinary technician.
Specially approved by the leaders, Xu Shiyan was awarded the title of assistant engineer of Tonghua Foreign Trade Bureau, that is, the title of junior engineer.
If it weren't for Lin Qiyue's insistence, Xu Shiyan would have been poached by Tonghua.
Xu Shiyan himself doesn't want to leave Donggang either, he thinks it's better for him to develop in his hometown.
No matter how good Tonghua is, there is no room for him to go there. It is better to participate in one field and show off his strengths.
At least I left Tonghua and returned to Fusong, but the welcome ceremony here was even more grand.
The county leaders announced that Xu Shiyan would be the deputy director and honorary consultant of the county's ginseng research institute. Instead of working in the county, he would regularly guide the county's ginseng production work every year.
Because on the way, Xu Shiyan mentioned to Guan Enxue that he really wanted to go to university to learn knowledge and enrich himself.
Therefore, several leaders discussed and decided to arrange for Xu Shiyan to go to the Provincial Agricultural University in autumn to study agricultural product processing and other related knowledge.
Of all the rewards, only this one moved Xu Shiyan's heart the most.
He originally thought that it would take a few more years, and the participants could find a way to arrange for him to study.
Unexpectedly, after working for more than a year, the dream came true.
"Thank you for your kindness, I am ashamed.
I will definitely study hard, strive to learn more knowledge, and transform the knowledge I have learned into productivity to benefit my hometown. "
Xu Shiyan was so excited that he didn't know what to say.
By the time Xu Shiyan and the others returned to Donggang, it was already May 22, and they had been away for a month and a day.
"Dad, Mom, I'm back, look, what I brought back."
The jeep in the county took Xu Shiyan directly outside the gate of Xu Chenghou's house.
Getting off the car, Xu Shiyan didn't care about anything, and shouted loudly into the yard.
It was late May, the weather was starting to heat up, and the windows were all open. Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan heard their son's movement in the house, so they hurried out.
Looking outside, it was terrible. A jeep and a large car were parked in front of my house.
At this moment, someone was moving things down from the big car behind. There were two big cardboard boxes, and the things inside were quite heavy.
"San'er, what is this? What did you buy and you brought it back with a car?"
The old couple were dumbfounded when they saw it. What did his third son buy back?
Good guy, how many things do you have to hold in two such big cardboard boxes?
At this time, Lin Qiyue also got out of the car, "Uncle Xu, Aunt Xu, those are the rewards given to Xiao Xu by the province and county, a color TV and a washing machine."
That's right, the county rewarded washing machines.
You must know that a participant earned more than three million U.S. dollars in foreign exchange this time, and gave Fusong a bad face. Which county or city will look down on them in the future?
Moreover, from now on, Fusong can go to trade fairs every year. As long as there is a participant there, there is no need to look around without foreign exchange to earn.
What a wonderful thing, can the county not have any blood?
People in the province have rewarded color TVs, and the county can't be stingy, so they decided to reward washing machines.
That is to say, Xu Shiyan doesn't need to buy anything, and two of the new three major items have already been collected.
Lin Qiyue is in his forties, so it's not easy to call him the same age.
In order to get closer to the Xu family, Lin Qiyue took the initiative to lower his status, calling Xu Chenghou and his wife Uncle and Aunt.
The old couple had never met Lin Qiyue before, so they were a little confused at the time, so Xu Shiyan hurriedly introduced him.
"Father, Mom, this is our secretary Lin."
On the way back, Lin Qiyue yelled at Brother Xu one after another. Xu Shiyan's objection was invalid, so what can I do?
Anyway, there is no relative relationship, and the name is the same, so you can call it whatever you like.
"Hey, Secretary Lin, I heard from our family San'er. He said that you are a good leader and you are very supportive of his work."
Xu Chenghou was very excited when he heard that he was his son's leader, and hurriedly invited Lin Qiyue to sit in the room.
"Oh, I didn't know that Secretary Lin was coming. Come on, please come in, old woman, and hurry up to boil water and make tea."
"Uncle, aunt, don't be busy, I won't come in, don't you think there are people waiting here?
I have been away for a month or so, and I have to go home quickly. Another day, another day I will come to drink with my uncle. "
In the car, there is a reward for Lin Qiyue.
The county arranged a car to take Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan back. Xu's house is close, so they stopped here first.
Originally, Lin Qiyue also wanted to participate in the whole welcome ceremony, but Xu Shiyan abruptly stopped him.
Don't make a fuss, Xu Shiyan felt that his head was too big for the welcoming ceremony along the way.
Besides, this season, the participants are busy, everyone is working on the mountain, what kind of welcome ceremony are you doing? Delay production.
It's better to just come back quietly and reunite with the family.
Don’t do those things that are formal and empty-headed. It’s a waste of time and money. It’s not good.
Lin Qiyue thought about it, and it made sense. He was also very tired all the way back, and he was drinking at celebration banquets everywhere. He really couldn't stand it.
He simply listened to Xu Shiyan, and the bird went home quietly, and he could rest honestly.
"Huh? Don't come in and sit in the house? How can it be done? Look, the leader didn't even enter the house when he came, and didn't take a sip of water. It seems that we don't understand the rules when it spreads."
Xu Chenghou said while winking at his son, why can't the leader just leave like this.
"Uncle, we men don't care about this, and we don't need to talk about those rules. It's really too tiring. I want to go home and lie down to rest.
When the venue is not busy, I will definitely come to the house to find my uncle for a drink. "
How could Lin Qiyue stay? There were still jeep and car drivers waiting at the other end, so I had to reject Xu Chenghou's kindness, got in the car again, and led them away.

chapters.title: Chapter 341: father jiko filial piety
chapters.content:
Chapter 341 Father is kind and son is filial
The weather is warm in late May, and many older people are sitting outside and chatting.
A jeep and a big car parked at the gate of the Xu family just now, many people saw it, and many people looked at it curiously.
Later, I saw someone moving things down from the big car, two big cardboard boxes, I couldn't see what they were from a distance.
Many people were curious, so they simply came here.
Waiting for the jeep and the big car to drive away, a group of people gathered outside the gate of Xu's house.
"Brother Xu, what's going on in your house? What's in these two big boxes?" Someone couldn't help but ask.
"This is a TV set, a washing machine, from the province and the county, to reward our three sons."
Xu Chenghou touched the cardboard box and was so happy that he kept grinning.
It was the third son of his family who had the ability to get back a color TV set and a washing machine without spending a penny.
"Color TV? Washing machine?
Oh my God, how much credit is this for, the province and the county have given such a good reward? "
When the people around heard it, they exclaimed.
Donggang doesn’t even have color TVs, there are few black and white TVs.
As for the washing machine, no one else has heard of it, and it seems that I bought it from the director of the grain depot.
The key is that they didn't buy them themselves, they were rewarded by the province and county.
These two add up, not more than one thousand or nearly two thousand? Oh my goodness, this is amazing.
"Uncles, aunts, um, please help me carry the things into the house. Let's go in and talk about it later."
Xu Shiyan had just put the big backpacks he had brought back into the house, when he came out, he saw this large group of people fumbling around the color TV and washing machine, looking around. It was extremely rare.
Xu Shiyan immediately laughed, these days, whoever owns a color TV can really attract people from a whole village.
Don't look at the people here who join in the fun here are all old men and women in their fifties and sixties, but the country people are in good health, and it is no problem at all to carry the lifting work.
As soon as they heard Xu Shiyan's words, several old men began to roll up their arms and sleeves, planning to carry things into the house.
"Huh? Wait a minute, wait a minute.
San'er, this is your reward, shouldn't you let it go to your house? Why are you still putting it here? Not suitable not suitable. "
Xu Chenghou didn't hear it right, what does my son mean, to put the color TV and washing machine here?
Then how? It's not that he won an award, he can't take things from his son.
The people who were about to carry the suitcases into the house also froze for a moment, and all looked up at Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan laughed, "Father, this color TV and washing machine are my filial piety to the elders.
It happens that the two elders usually have nothing to do at home. Wouldn’t it be nice to have a TV to relieve boredom?
My mother is getting old, so she rubs the small clothes with her hands, and throws the big clothes in the washing machine to save effort. "
On the way back, Xu Shiyan decided to give the color TV and washing machine to his parents.
The old couple have suffered and suffered all their lives. When they are old, they should enjoy some blessings.
In the previous life, I was not capable, and I didn’t want to honor my parents. Now that I have made such progress, I have to let my parents enjoy it.
"Ah? No, no, no. This is something that the superior leader rewarded you. What do you think is going on with us?
Let’s take you there. If your mother and I want to watch TV, we can go to your house to watch it. Anyway, don’t we usually go to your place all day long? "
His son is filial, Xu Chenghou is of course happy, but he thought, this color TV and washing machine are not allowed.
Five sons, why can't you count on one for everything, why are those few gone?
If the TV is turned off today, when those few come back in the future, they will have to let go of their old couple.
No, no, you can’t have this stuff.
The son worked hard and was rewarded only when he was recognized by the leader.
He is an old man who doesn't do anything, how can he have the face to ask for a color TV?
"Father, that's not what you said. My parents don't have TV to watch. Do you think I can watch TV at home with peace of mind?
What's more, how busy Yingzi and I are every day? How much time do you have to watch TV?
There is also Xu Haiyuan and the others. If there is an extra TV at home, they can watch it without eating or sleeping.
This thing is not good for children to watch for a long time, it is not good for the eyes, and it will delay the rest. "
Xu Shiyan knew that if he didn't move the child out, he couldn't convince his parents, so he had to use his trump card.
As soon as grandchildren were mentioned, Xu Chenghou fell silent. What his son said seemed to make sense.
There are multiple radios in the house, and Xu Haiyuan’s child can listen to storytelling on them without eating. If there is a TV at home, will the child be free from magic?
The eldest grandson studies so well, and I still count on him to go to university in the future.
It would be bad if you watch TV all day long and damage your eyes.
Xu Chenghou hesitated, but those watching the fun couldn't help it.
"Oh, I said Old Brother Xu, what are you doing with ink?
My son is filial, and I gave you the award-winning TV. Don’t you want it? If it were me, I would happily move the TV.
How wonderful, why do you think I am not such a promising and filial son?
Hey, if I have such a son, I can wake up laughing from my dreams. "
"That's right, the son's kindness, what a filial child.
Hurry up, move into the house, install it quickly, and let us all see what kind of color TV it is. "
A group of people next to him persuaded, who is not curious when they see the color TV? I want to see what it looks like.
I don’t know who yelled, but the big guy picked up the box and walked into the house without saying a word.
Xu Chenghou saw that he didn't want to stop or not, so he could only follow behind, calling for people to be careful while walking.
"Well, let's put the washing machine in the Westinghouse first, put the TV on the Kang, put it on the Kang.
After a while, I will tidy up and move out of a place. "
Zhou Guilan followed into the house, hurriedly talked to others, and put the washing machine in the Westinghouse. No one disassembled it, and kept it as it was.
The TV was carried to the Kang in the east room, and someone quickly found the scissors and unwrapped the plastic strips tied outside the package.
Then I opened the cardboard box, took out the foam inside, and moved the TV out.
"Oh, this TV is bigger, much bigger than the Jiang family's." When the TV was exposed, everyone exclaimed.
Jiang’s house, of course, is the house of the director of the grain depot. His house has a 12-inch black and white TV.
This one is fourteen inches, which is indeed a circle bigger than that one.
In the corner of Xu’s east room, there was a chest of drawers, on which there were originally thermos pots, tea trays, tea cups and so on.
Zhou Guilan packed away the things on the chest of drawers, and placed the TV on top, just right.
The TV is put on, but the power supply is not working, and it is out of reach. The outdoor antenna is still all parts, and you have to assemble it yourself, and there is no cord.
Xu Shiyan hurried to Songjianghe by bicycle, bought sockets, wires, special antenna cords, etc., and after returning home, he was busy for a long time before he finally installed the TV.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: there is a TV
chapters.content:
Chapter 342 There is a TV
Xu Shiyan and the others set off from the county at eight o'clock in the morning, and the winding mountain road went uphill again, and they arrived home around ten o'clock.
It was past eleven o'clock when Xu Shiyan went to buy sockets, wires and so on.
At this time, every household was busy cooking, and there were not so many people on Xu Chenghou's side.
Zhou Guilan and Su Anfang Su Anhua, who heard the news, were busy cooking in the kitchen. Xu Chenghou helped his son, and the two of them erected a pole in the yard to install the antenna.
Before the installation was over, Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, and Yang Haoyu came back from school.
"Grandma, is the meal ready? I'm starving to death." Almost all children will say this when they enter the door.
Xu Haiyuan started shouting before entering the gate, but as soon as he entered, he happened to see Xu Shiyan busy in the yard.
"Dad? Dad is back."
"Godfather is back."
The three children were so happy that they stepped forward and hugged Xu Shiyan.
"Dad, why did you come back? You have been away for more than a month."
The child is grown up and knows how to miss his loved ones, so now he is holding Xu Shiyan and refuses to let go.
But the two younger ones in the family didn't seem to feel much, and they didn't feel too much after seeing Xu Shiyan. At most, they let Xu Shiyan kiss a couple of times, and ran to find the dog to play with.
The three babies are all grown up, Xu Shiyan can't hug and kiss them now, he can only touch the top of the children's heads.
"Well, I just got home, aren't I busy installing a TV antenna? Our house has a TV.
Well, let’s wash our hands first and get ready for dinner. I’ll turn the TV on later, so we can watch TV. "
As soon as the three children heard about Ann TV, they immediately jumped up happily. They have long been greedy for other people's TV, and they went to Jiang's house to watch it once before.
There are too many Jiang family members, most of them are family members of grain depot employees. Those people are very proud, so they look down on the agricultural team, and they don't give Xu Jinping and the others good looks.
Although Xu Jinping is small, she has a lot of self-esteem. She will never look at others treating her like that.
The three children rushed into the room quickly, and then saw the brand new TV on the chest of drawers.
"Wow, this TV is so big, it's bigger than Jiang Chunhong's. It's so beautiful. Our family will have a TV in the future. It's great."
The three children were so happy that they jumped on the ground. They will have TV to watch in the future, and they don’t have to go to other people’s houses to watch TV.
“In the future, when I come home from school, I will do my homework first, and then I can watch TV after finishing my homework.
If anyone can't finish their homework, I won't allow him to read it. "
Just in time, Xu Shiyan installed the antenna outside and erected the pole at this time, and was about to enter the house to adjust the TV.
Seeing the children jumping and jumping, I deliberately put on a straight face to scare them.
"Dad, we don't have homework yet, so we don't need to do it."
Xu Jinping stretched out her little hand, grabbed Xu Shiyan's skirt, and looked up at her father. She has no homework, what to write?
"Oh, yes, Dad remembered wrongly, you and Xiaoyu are still young and don't have homework.
That line, the two of you go home to coax your younger siblings first, and then watch TV. "
Xu Shiyan slapped his forehead, only thinking about fooling the children, but forgot that both of them are young, how can there be homework in Yuhong Class?
"Xu Haiyuan, they don't have homework, but you do.
Remember, watch TV after finishing your homework, otherwise, you will see how I will deal with you. "
Xu Shiyan looked at his elder son with a malicious look on his face, he did it on purpose.
This brat is so obsessed with listening to the radio, why can't he get into it when he has a TV? Get vaccinated in advance.
Xu Haiyuan curled his lips, "Dad, when did you see that I have been doing my homework for more than half an hour? Someday I will do my homework first when I get home from school."
They leave school after four o'clock in the afternoon, and they go home in half an hour at most before finishing their homework.
The TV can only be watched after six o’clock in the evening, cut, do you really think he doesn’t understand anything?
Xu Shiyan originally wanted to embarrass his son, but in the end he was despised by his son, and it was neither laughing nor crying for him.
"You, you don't need to be beautiful here, there are few homework in the first grade, and there will be more and more in the future.
I don't believe it, you can finish it in half an hour by the sixth grade? Wait until you fail to finish your homework, I will blame your father for not beating you up. "
Xu Shiyan had nothing to do with his son, so he could only rub his son's face as a relief.
China Central Station has a signal at noon, so we have to take the opportunity to adjust the TV and fix the antenna outside.
"Well, I'll go outside to hang around the antenna, and the three of you will watch from inside. If someone comes out, call me."
Xu Shiyan turned on the TV and taught Xu Haiyuan how to find a station, while he went out to rotate the antenna to find a direction with the best signal.
When the TV was turned on, there was no signal, and it was full of snowflakes. After that, I slowly tuned the channel, turned the antenna, and after a while, there was indeed a person coming out of the station.
China Central Television, the noon news is coming soon, there is a program right now.
So the children hurriedly shouted, "Okay, okay."
"What are you doing? It's a noisy day?"
At noon, Su Anying came back from the farm by bicycle. Seeing that the gate of her house was locked, she knew they were all here, so she hurried over.
Before entering the door, she heard the children shouting there. She thought the children were being naughty and didn't know what to do, so she hurriedly dropped the car and entered the yard.
"Oh, you're back? What are you doing?" As soon as he entered the yard, he saw Xu Shiyan, who was poking something there.
Su Anying felt strange, she had been away for more than a month, and when she came back home, she didn't take a rest quickly, what was she talking about?
"Daughter-in-law, come, help me, hold the bottom, I tied the pole, it's the antenna pole of the TV.
I gained a lot from going out this time. The province rewarded a 14-inch color TV. I thought about showing it to my parents. Isn’t this the Zheng’an antenna? "
It's not easy to show off in front of others, but in front of your own wife, you have to show off.
"Color TV? Oh, that's really good, okay, put it on our parents' side, the old couple can't sleep at night, so it's nice to have a TV to watch."
Su Anying did not object to her husband's decision. In her opinion, apart from not living together, the two families are no different from having a separate family.
Several children in my family eat at the in-laws' side, and the couple also come over for a meal every now and then.
Originally, it was said that food and money would be given, but the parents-in-law did not want it. It would be nice to be able to give some compensation from other aspects.
"By the way, there is also a washing machine, and I also gave it to our mother.
Daughter-in-law, I'll find a way to wait until autumn, let's buy one at home. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at Su Anying, and told her that the washing machine was also given to her parents.
"You give the washing machine to our mother, why not keep it for my younger sister, who doesn't know when she will get married, how about keeping it as a dowry for her?
Our mother has the same temper as me, and she doesn’t even like the clothes washed by the washing machine. After all, the younger sister’s physique is not good. If she is married with a washing machine, she will not be troubled in the future. "
Su Anying shook her head when she heard this. This stupid man in his family is still a little bit close to thinking about things.
"Hey, if you don't say it, I really don't remember it. It has to be my daughter-in-law. What I think is thoughtful."
Xu Shiyan's eyes lit up, and he laughed, look, his wife is getting more and more capable now.
In the autumn of 1987, my family bought a Longjiang 17-inch black and white TV. I remember that it was weekends and winter and summer vacations at that time. CCTV had programs all day long, and usually there were TV programs at noon and evening. If anyone still remembers the situation at that time, you can tell me, thank you.

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Enviable
chapters.content:
Chapter 343 Enviable
Xu Shiyan attached the wooden pole with the antenna to the foot of the garden pole, and screwed it firmly with the No. 8 wire, so that the pole would not be afraid of falling down.
After setting up the antenna, I went into the house with my wife, and saw the three children staring at the TV intently.
You can receive two stations locally, Central Station and Jilin Station.
Jilin TV has no program at noon, so it starts at night, and CCTV has news at noon.
"Oh, this is TV? It's the first time I've seen it.
Hey? How do you think these people got into the TV?
Look, this is just like a real person, it can talk and move, how did it do it? "
It was also the first time for Su Anying to see TV, and she was very curious. Looking at the people on TV, she couldn't help asking.
"Mom, I know this.
These people on TV are all recorded in advance, and then transmitted with wireless signals, and we receive them and they come out. "
Without waiting for Xu Shiyan to speak, Xu Haiyuan hurriedly explained to his mother.
He heard from the school teacher before, because their principal has a TV at home.
It is said that this is similar to a radio, but much more complicated than a radio.
"Oh, so that's what happened.
Well, it's time to eat, so let's turn off the TV first, I don't want to watch TV while eating.
Especially Xu Haiyuan, I can't get used to your bad habits. When I come back from school in the afternoon, I will read it after finishing my homework. "
Or is it just a couple? The idea is the same, it is so tacit.
The three children reluctantly turned off the TV, just at this time the food was ready, Su Anying urged the children to wash their hands and eat.
Although Xu Shiyan came back as a bird, there was no welcome ceremony.
But when he came back from a business trip, the province rewarded him with a color TV and a washing machine, and the county arranged for a jeep and a big car to send them back.
The news quickly spread throughout the two villages of Donggang and Xican.
Before we finished our meal here, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Feng Chao and others all came to Xu's house.
"Third brother, I heard that your family has a color TV? Oh, but really, such a big TV?
My third brother is amazing. It’s really good to reward the TV for coming back after going out. "The one with the loud voice is none other than Zhao Jianshe.
While speaking, everyone came in from the outside, watching the TV on the chest of drawers, everyone was amazed.
"Third Uncle, how are you doing this trip? Tell us, what's going on?
What the **** did you do to reward you with a color TV? "
Zhou Qingguo, who is already the Minister of Armed Forces and Security Director of Donggang Township, asked Xu Shiyan with a smile on his face.
Xu Shiyan had almost eaten now, so he put down his chopsticks and chatted with Zhou Qingguo and others.
Tell everyone about his experience of going to Yangcheng in the south.
This noon, I was busy with TV, and Xu Chenghou and his wife didn't have a chance to ask about their son's going out, so they listened attentively at the moment.
When they heard that ginseng honey slices had created more than three million dollars in foreign exchange, everyone in the room was stunned.
Then when they heard about Xu Shiyan's calculation and learned about the profit of the honey chip, these people were so shocked that their jaws almost dropped.
"God, this is too much money. We have been struggling for three years, how much money do we only earn from the field? Compared with the third brother, it is nothing.
Look, this is what the third brother said about the power of deep processing.
You think we people, when will we be able to sell clubs so expensively? "Zhao Jianshe looked yearning.
"Dream, how many catties of sticks can be picked out of the twenty or thirty feet of ginseng land in your house to make honey chips? Do you have those machines in your house?
Only people who participate in the field have this strength and can earn money. Let's dream. "
Yang Chunming is more sensible, and he gave Zhao Jianshe a blank look, thinking that this kid is dreaming of marrying a wife all day long, thinking of something good.
Zhao Jianshe was not annoyed when he was bullied, he just scratched his head with his hands and laughed, "Then why don't people have a dream? I'll just think about it."
“Construction is not a waste of time, and sooner or later there will be such an opportunity.
Let’s not be discouraged, take your time, plant our mallets first, and the output will increase. When there is a chance in the future, we will set up a processing plant.
Isn’t it just a machine? Buy it, and I will help you find a way when the time comes. "
It is impossible for a participant to do all the projects that make money. It must radiate the surrounding areas and drive the regional economy.
After two years of waiting for the policy to be loosened, Xu Shiyan planned to get someone to join the factory in the name of Su Anying.
At that time, let’s not talk about anything else, if you help a party process some sticks or something, you can earn a lot of money.
Regarding this aspect, Xu Shiyan is still thinking about how to get farmers who have been divided into households to work independently, and then screw them together again.
To make Fusong ginseng bigger and stronger, all ginseng households must unite.
The strength of an individual is too small to attract attention. Only by making it bigger and occupying a place can it have the right to speak.
So, in fact, dividing land to households may not be all good. The success of many places proves one thing, the collective economy has a better future.
However, Xu Shiyan has no clear idea of ​​how to do this and to what extent.
When he is free, he has to find someone who understands it and study it carefully.
Hearing what Xu Shiyan said, everyone laughed.
"That's right, I said that the third brother is capable, and he will definitely not leave the brothers behind.
Yes, we don’t have to think about anything, just plant the mallet first and then.
Thinking so much, we don’t have a mallet in our hands, everything is useless. " Zhao Jianshe slapped his thigh and laughed.
There was still work in the field, and the big guys didn't have time to stay for long, so they sat for a while, got up and went home, ready to go to work in the field.
Before they left, they all told Xu Shiyan to come to Xu's house to watch TV in the evening.
Come as soon as you come, don’t talk about the countryside at this time, it’s the same even in the city, whoever has a TV, and the neighbors are all crowded to that house.
At night, not to mention how lively it is, the room is full of people.
It's getting late, and it's time for the three of Xu Haiyuan to go back to school.
The three kids had enough to eat and drink, and turned back to watch TV before reluctantly going to school.
After the children left, Xu Shiyan dug out the things he had brought and shared them with his family.
Now, Xu Chenghou and his wife are also used to their son and daughter-in-law bringing back things every time they go out, and Xu Chenghou doesn't mind his son spending money.
Only those who can earn can spend it, and those who don’t earn pennies don’t even want to spend it.
Su Anhua and Su Anfang looked at the jeans, they were extremely rare, and even Su Anying looked left and right with them.
"This thing is really strong. I feel it is quite old and thick. It is good for working and wearing, and it won't be worn out."
The jeans of this era are not as thin as those of later generations. This one is harder, and even harder after being put in the water, which is especially difficult to wash.
"Well, I heard that these jeans are what the cowboy from the beautiful country wears to work.
I don’t know how it spread to our country, and it has become a rare thing, so why are you talking about fashion?
Anyway, it’s just that thing I look at, at most it’s a little stronger than our fabric.
These pants are waiting to be worn out, and they are just right for working in the mountains. Ordinary trees and such will definitely not be able to pierce through them. "
Xu Shiyan nodded again and again, and he also felt that this thing is good for work.
The couple sang together and made a good pair of jeans, which became work clothes in their mouths.
Keep making these people in the family amused.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: happy event
chapters.content:
Chapter 344 A lot of happy events
After distributing things, Xu Shiyan showed the title certificate of the assistant engineer of the Tonghua Foreign Trade Bureau, and the appointment letter of the deputy director and consultant of the County Ginseng Research Institute to his parents and wife.
"My god, are you promoted?"
Xu Chenghou didn't know a single big character, but he took the two documents and turned them over and over carefully.
The old man kept smiling happily, and the wrinkles on his face became much deeper.
"Then where will you go to work in the future? Tonghua or the county?"
How does Xu Chenghou understand this? I thought my son had been promoted and wanted to change places to work.
"Father, that's not what I meant. Assistant Engineer of Tonghua Foreign Trade Bureau is a professional title.
Am I not a technician before? Logically, I have to work for at least four years, have excellent skills, and have to pass the exam before I can be rated as an assistant engineer.
The leader felt that I had real talents and knowledge, and made outstanding contributions, so he directly gave me a title. Then my salary can be raised a bit. "
Xu Shiyan only realized after inquiring with others that co-authoring him is a professional title, and he must have a professional title to get a salary increase and promotion in the future.
"As for the County Ginseng Research Institute, it's actually just a well-known institution, just an honorary consultant, who gives lectures on the development of ginseng technology every year.
Maybe some benefits can be given, right? I wasn't too embarrassed to ask at the time, anyway, I wasn't going anywhere, and I was still working at a venue. "
For now, Xu Shiyan doesn't want to go anywhere.
He just wanted to participate in the field in a down-to-earth manner, lead people, and understand the fine processing of the ginseng industry.
Think of a way to earn the money, and he doesn't care about whether he gets promoted or not.
"Father, mother, daughter-in-law, there is another good news. This fall, I will go to the Provincial Agricultural University to attend college."
The last one is the blockbuster.
"What? Go to college? Or the Provincial Agricultural University?"
Xu Chenghou felt that he was a little out of his mind at the moment, and today's surprises came one after another, and he was a little dazed.
"You can go to college without the college entrance examination? Is this true?"
At the beginning, the fifth child was admitted to the Tonghua Agricultural School, and he passed the exam twice. How can the third son go to university without even taking the exam? Is it reliable?
"It's true, this is an adult university specially established by our province to improve the quality of cadres.
Basically, those who can be selected to study must be deputy county-level cadres or candidate cadres, with a two-year schooling system, a college degree, and a nationally recognized degree. "
If Xu Shiyan hadn't made great contributions this time, it would take at least three or four years before he would have the opportunity to study.
"Oh, you got so many benefits by going out this time?
It's a color TV and a washing machine, what title is it given, and what is the deputy director, so can I still go to school?
My God, the grave of the old Xu family ancestors is smoking, this is the real glory of the ancestors. "
As Zhou Guilan said, she couldn't help but shed tears.
Who would have thought that the third son, who almost died of illness at the beginning, and who seemed to be unable to support him all day long, would be so promising now?
"Old woman, look at you, your son will be rewarded for his meritorious deeds. This is a happy event. Why are you crying?"
Xu Chenghou tried to persuade his wife, but actually there were tears in his eyes.
Their old couple never dreamed that the third son would be able to achieve what he is today.
They haven't seen the grand welcome ceremony in the provinces, cities, and counties. If they saw it, Bao Buqi would be so excited.
Seeing his parents so excited, Xu Shiyan felt very excited.
There seems to be such a saying before, how did you say it?
A man's three major goals are to make his parents think he is a good son when he is twenty-five years old.
At the age of thirty-five, let the wife feel that he is a good husband.
At the age of forty-five, let the children feel that he is a good father.
Xu Shiyan is thirty-two this year, and he dare not say anything else, but now, he can be said to be a good son in the eyes of his parents and a good husband in the eyes of his wife.
As for what the children think, we have to wait until they grow up to judge.
It is okay to complete two of the three major goals, and keep working hard for the remaining one.
Xu Shiyan came back after going out for more than a month, and there wasn’t much work on the mountain in the afternoon, so Su Anying simply didn’t go, and the family just sat and chatted together.
It was too late at noon to buy meat dumplings, so Zhou Guilan said, hurry up and buy some meat, and make dumplings stuffed with leeks and meat in the afternoon.
Xu Shiyan was really tired after tossing around these days, so he simply didn't go home, and just lay down on the kang of his parents' house for a while.
"Oh, these days when I go out, I feel my body is stiff when I just sleep on the bed. Our own kang is more comfortable, and my whole body feels strong when I lie on it."
Cooking at noon, the kang was very hot. Xu Shiyan lay on the kang, feeling sore and sore waist, and immediately felt much more comfortable.
"Don't lie down like this, your neck hurts, here's a pillow." Zhou Guilan hurriedly brought a pillow for her son, so that he could lie down comfortably.
To be honest, Xu Shiyan was really tired, lying on the hot kang made him feel comfortable all over.
At the beginning, I was able to chat with Xu Chenghou casually, but fell asleep after a while.
Seeing that her son had fallen asleep, Zhou Guilan quickly closed the north window, found a thin quilt, and put it on Xu Shiyan's body.
"Hey, outsiders only talk about how many awards he has won, how beautiful he is, who knows how tired and miserable he is outside?
Look at this, when you come back, you are much thinner than when you left. "
The old lady was so distressed that she looked at her sleeping son and muttered in a low voice.
"Well, you cook more delicious food these days, and ask them to come back to eat more, and it will be fine after a while."
Xu Chenghou is a big man with a thick heart, but he didn't know that he was fat or thin, but his wife said that he must have lost weight and must make up.
"Tomorrow I will kill our big rooster and cook it in a pot for my son to eat."
Zhou Guilan was amused by her husband's words, rolled her eyes at Xu Chenghou, put on her shoes and went to the garden to cut leeks.
At the beginning of spring, Xu Chenghou set up a small plastic shed in the leek field, and put the leeks inside, which grew earlier than other people's leeks and were still tender.
The leeks with the head knife have been cut a long time ago. This is a two-knife leek more than half a foot high. Because there is no wind, the light green color is rare.
The leeks were harvested, picked and cleaned, and it happened that Su Anying also bought the meat, so she kneaded the noodles, chopped the meat, cut the vegetables, and adjusted the stuffing.
At 3:30 in the afternoon, Zhou Guilan led her daughter-in-law and sister Su Anhua to start making dumplings.
By the time Xu Haiyuan and the others came home from school and shouted hungry when they entered the door, the dumplings were already more than half wrapped.
So I went to make a fire to boil the water. After making the dumplings here, the water in the pot boiled, so I quickly boiled the dumplings.
Before Xu Haiyuan finished his homework, the first pot of dumplings was already cooked.
The unique fragrance of leek stuffed dumplings permeates the whole house, and even the yard can smell the fragrance.
"Come on, let's eat dumplings. It's stuffed with chives and meat. Today's dumplings will make your tongue go hungry."
This was said to Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping and other children.
Children who are already hungry, how can they bear the aroma of dumplings now?
One by one, they hurried to wash their hands, sat obediently at the table, and waited to eat.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: watch TV
chapters.content:
Chapter 345 Watching TV
Su Anying bought three catties of meat, all of which were chopped up by Zhou Guilan.
Pair it with fresh and tender leeks, and it will be oily after a bite. Can it be fresh?
The little mouths of the children were greasy, and they all yelled that it was delicious.
Zhi Le, who had a good look at Xu Cheng, hurriedly pushed the plate towards the children. "If it's delicious, you can eat it vigorously. I made a lot of bags today."
That is to say, the days are better now, and you can eat dumplings if you want.
If this is put in the past, who can eat dumplings on ordinary days? Chinese New Year dumplings may not have so much meat.
The whole family sits around the table and eats dumplings happily. As soon as the dumplings are finished, before the table is picked up, people start to come to the house one after another.
These are all waiting to watch TV. Who is not curious about the big color TV? They all ate early and went to Xu's house to watch the excitement.
Xu Shiyan saw this and hurriedly turned on the TV.
Now this year is not the future, as long as you turn on the TV, there will be programs anytime.
At this time, except for weekends and winter and summer vacations, the rest of the time will be broadcast at a fixed time, starting at 6 pm.
Before six o'clock, turn on the TV and there will be a colorful vertical road. It will take a few years for the disc to appear.
Although there are no images, there is music. Xu Jinping, who was already full, danced to the music.
Not to mention, the little girl twisted very vigorously, following the rhythm perfectly.
When the big guys met, they all said that this child is smart and good at dancing, so he should be trained well.
Xu Shiyan smiled, but didn't answer. This girl in his family has a lot of interests and can do anything.
In this life, he worked hard to make the conditions of the family better. At that time, no matter what his daughter likes, she can learn what she wants to learn, and she can learn what she likes to learn.
There are more and more people coming to the house, Su Anying saw that, she quickly cleared the table, and then found chairs, benches and so on for them to sit on.
There are still people who are not welcome, just sit on the kang, and finally there is nothing to sit on, so some people simply find a piece of firewood to sit on.
At six o'clock, the TV signal is coming. Please enjoy a section first, and then the official program.
When the characters appeared on the TV, all the people in the room exclaimed, "This is better, people are colorful."
Then, no one spoke, and they all stared at the TV intently.
Even if it was a news broadcast, everyone watched it intently, and didn't want to miss a single scene.
When Yang Junxian came to pick up his son, he saw such a scene.
"Yo, the third brother is back? Is this a TV bought from the south?" Yang Junxian didn't dare to speak loudly, and only asked Xu Shiyan in a low voice.
Xu Shiyan finally got out of the house and talked to Yang Junxian in the outer room.
"I didn't buy it, it was a reward from the province. Isn't this something new for everyone? So they all watched TV."
At this time in his previous life, Xu Shiyan was still in the big house, and there was no TV in every household there.
His family bought a TV several years after moving to Donggang. At that time, most households in Donggang had TVs.
So Xu Shiyan saw such a lively scene for the first time. There were people all over the room, even the door of the outer room, and there were even people lying on their stomachs outside the rear window.
Xu Shiyan, this is Donggang's first color TV set, they all feel fresh, and they all come to join in the fun and watch TV.
"It's all like this, my eldest sister's house is black and white twelve inches, and many neighbors go to see it at night.
What can I do? Just watch it. Anyway, after nine o’clock, there will be no programs. "
Yang Junxian's younger sister is in the county. His brother-in-law is quite capable and has a TV at home.
During the Chinese New Year, I came home and told Yang Junxian that a bunch of people were watching TV at his house every night.
"Xiaoyu, let's go, let's go home." Yang Junxian entered the room and discussed with his son softly.
There is something at home today, he came late, if he is not busy, he can come to pick him up before six o'clock.
"Dad, can you wait a while before leaving? I still want to watch TV."
Yang Haoyu looked at his father pleadingly, he really wanted to watch TV for a while.
Yang Junxian shook his head, "It's too late, you have to go to school tomorrow, go home early. If it's later, your mother should worry about us."
The child was weak since he was a child. Yang Junxian felt sorry for the child and rarely spoke loudly to him.
Yang Haoyu looked outside, and it was dark, "Okay then, let's go home.
Dad, when will you win a prize and bring home a color TV? "
Children don’t understand those things. When they saw their godfather’s house with a TV, they were naturally very envious. They thought that if their father could win an award anytime, he would just bring back a TV.
"Son, I'm not as good as your godfather."
Yang Junxian laughed when he heard the words, this stupid son of his family, does he really think that everyone has the ability of Xu Shiyan?
"When the money is divided this winter, can Dad find a way to buy one for our family?" The Yang family's conditions are good, and there is money to buy a TV, but there is no ticket.
Children don't understand, but when they heard that they can buy it at home in winter, they immediately became happy.
"Okay, Dad, you have to keep your word." Yang Haoyu jumped up happily.
"Hush, keep your voice down, don't disturb people watching TV. Let's go, let's go home first, goodbye to your godfather."
Yang Junxian gestured to his son to keep his voice down, and then the father and father said goodbye to Xu Shiyan, and Yang Junxian took his son home by bicycle.
Watching TV for the first time, everyone was very excited.
Even the two little children Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui, who were always sleepy on weekdays, sat obediently in the arms of their grandparents, very energetic.
In fact, there are not many TV shows in this year and month. There are very few domestic TV series, and most of them are imported from Hong Kong and abroad.
And only one episode is broadcast every night, and the TV has no signal before ten o'clock.
"Hey, this is too little, why can't we put more?"
When everyone saw that there was no show, they all sighed, they haven't watched it enough yet, why is it gone?
"Well, it's getting late, let's go home quickly, we have to go to work in the fields tomorrow, why don't we sleep too late and won't wake up tomorrow morning?"
Over there, Yang Chunming looked at the watch on the wall, and it was indeed getting late, so he told the Xu family and left first.
The others still have more to say, but there is no signal on the TV, so it is useless to stay, and they can only leave reluctantly.
"Uncle Xu, let's watch TV tomorrow."
"Hey, good." Xu Chenghou smiled and nodded.
Come if you come, anyway, if other people don’t come, they have to watch TV, neighbors, if they just watch TV, can you not let them?
The outsiders all left, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying hurriedly coaxed the children to go home too.
The two younger ones were quite energetic just now, but when the TV was turned off, they immediately nodded sleepily.
There was no way, the husband and wife each held one, but the older one was fine, and followed their parents home after bouncing all the way.
"Hurry up and go to bed, starting tomorrow, you can only watch the news broadcast, you are not allowed to watch it so late.
The little boy is growing up, so he can't go to bed too late. "
It's such a short journey, the two little ones have already fallen asleep.
Xu Shiyan and his wife hurriedly packed the quilts, settled the two younger ones down, and urged the two older ones to wash up and go to bed.
Xu Shiyan felt that watching TV like this was not an option, so he made a rule for the children to go home after watching the news broadcast, and they were not allowed to stay so late like today.

chapters.title: Chapter 346: bonus
chapters.content:
Chapter 346 Bonus
Xu Shiyan didn't want to say anything, but the news that he won awards from the province and the county, as well as a color TV and a washing machine, quickly spread throughout Donggang.
Many people are talking about this matter, and many people also know about the event that earned more than 3 million foreign exchange this year.
Many people said that Xu Shiyan’s participation in the field was really the right step. No matter how good the agricultural team is, it is incomparable with the state-run participation.
The participating workers also heard about it, and many people asked around.
Lin Qiyue saw this, so he simply took some time to hold a staff meeting in the compound of the field department, and briefly talked about going to the Spring Fair.
"We gained a lot from participating this time, ginseng honey slices, earning more than three million dollars in foreign exchange.
The technical department has made great contributions, so the venue decided to reward each person in the technical department with 1,000 yuan, and the section chief Xu Shiyan rewarded 2,000 yuan. "
Earning more than three million dollars in foreign exchange, even after deducting costs and profits and taxes, this time you can get more than six million dollars in one participation.
How much was the total income of one participant last year? 6.5 million.
That is to say, the turnover of going to the Spring Fair this time alone is the total income of the whole year of last year's participation.
Just kidding, is it reasonable not to reward such a great contribution?
There are currently about 30 people in the technical department, how much is 1,000 yuan per person? It's just a drop in the bucket.
"Don't be jealous, everyone, this is what the technical department deserves.
Without the research conducted by Section Chief Xu who led people day and night and forgot to sleep and eat, we would not be able to earn this kind of money at all.
Besides, the benefits we get from participating in the fair are more than these. We have obtained the export right, and in the future, our products can be exported directly.
Comrades, think about it. In the future, we can directly export the ginseng products we grow and exchange for foreign exchange.
What does this mean? This means that we have taken another step up as soon as we participated in the field, a step of leaping significance.
This step forward is of great significance for our ginseng products to enter the international market, and it can also be regarded as our contribution to the construction of the country.
Everyone of you here is a hero. "
Lin Qiyue is a person who can be a secretary after all, and he is not a simple person. He speaks beautifully and lifts his spirits.
The workers in these years are very conscious, and they really treat the factory as their own home.
So after Lin Qiyue finished speaking, there was thunderous applause, and everyone's face was filled with the kind of proud smile that I contributed to the country's construction.
"Of course, every worker will not be left behind. We will pay more benefits and bonuses at the end of the year, so that everyone's sweat will not be wasted.
Everyone can rest assured that as long as we all twist together, think in one direction, and work hard in one direction, we will definitely become more and more brilliant once we participate, and everyone's life will also get better and better. "
Of course, it’s not enough to just sing high-profile, but also something affordable.
If the factory makes money, the workers must also benefit. This is a win-win situation, everyone is happy.
After the staff meeting, everyone in the technical department received a bonus.
One thousand dollars per month this year is a huge amount. The people in the technical department are all crazy with joy. They all say that working with the chief of the department has a bright future.
"Well, just be happy, we still have tasks." After the staff meeting, Xu Shiyan called everyone in the technical department together for a small meeting.
"The bonus is just the beginning. In the future, the more we research our products, the more we will earn foreign exchange through export. At that time, everyone's bonus will not be less."
"This year's ginseng flower will come down soon, and we will do our best to focus on the project of ginseng flower cola this year.
I have already mentioned to the leader that we not only make ginseng flower cola, but also ginseng cola.
If these two projects are won, it is expected to earn more foreign exchange next year. "
This is basically the way of functional drinks, try it first, if the effect is good, then upgrade the technology.
