If it is done well in the future, it will definitely be no worse than that.
Xu Shiyan has already checked with Lin Qiyue and other cadres of the venue. The two projects of ginseng flower cola and ginseng cola will not be joint ventures with outsiders, but will be done by themselves.
They have money now, but it is just a beverage production line, which doesn't cost much, so there is no need to form a joint venture with others.
"Tomorrow, Team Leader Han will bring a few people and ask for a car from the venue. Let's go find the water source together."
Their drinks want to open up the market, make people’s eyes shine, and become a unique product. The advantages of ginseng flowers and ginseng alone are not enough, and the water source must also be found.
"Li Chengrong, you take people up the mountain to watch the ginseng flowers being picked, and when you come back to dry them, you must ensure the quality."
"Group Leader Zhao, you take people to various towns in our county and discuss with them the purchase of ginseng flowers."
One ginseng field cooperates with the Huacheng soda factory in Yangcheng to provide ginseng flowers there and make ginseng flower drink dew.
But now I want to make ginseng flower cola by myself, but there are not enough raw materials.
Ginseng flowers can be used to make tea, and can also be used to make ginseng crystals, so in recent years, merchants have also purchased them.
Once you need raw materials for participation, you can only grab them from other merchants, there is no way.
Lin Qiyue has already coordinated with several other participants. The ginseng flowers of other participants this year will be collected directly by one participant, and the price will be 5% higher than that charged by foreign merchants.
Xu Shiyan meant that in addition to other participations, the townships must not miss out, and the supply of raw materials must be sufficient.
"Received, I promise to complete the task." The leaders of several groups responded in unison, and the others were also full of confidence and high morale.
With the section chief leading them, their technology department will surely make great achievements again.
Early the next morning, Xu Shiyan and Han Limin took a few people and set off in the participating car to find the water source.
There is a road heading north at Dadongtou in Yishenchang. It is a big downhill road, which just crosses the road from Songjiang River to Baixi Forest Farm and Funan Forest Farm.
Not far from the fork to the east, there is a four-kilometer timber checkpoint.
Follow the firewood road behind the checkpoint, make seven turns and eight detours all the way downhill, until there is a big bend not far from the river, and everyone gets off the car.
"Go here, there is a spring in front of it, it will bubble, let's go, let's find it."
Xu Shiyan pointed to the forest. They wanted to go through the forest ahead to find a spring.
The spring water is very special, a natural aerated mineral spring, which is rich in natural carbonic acid.
Xu Shiyan remembers that in a few years there will be a soda factory in Donggang, which will use that spring water.
Later, that place was developed by Lin Haixueyuan Company, and it became a water source and was protected.
It is said that the mineral water is exported, and a bottle is quite expensive.
Mineral water plants and so on will definitely be developed in a few years if conditions permit, but at present it is still dominated by ginseng-related industries.
The most important thing is to occupy the place first. Such a good place and such good water should not be wasted, and the greatest value must be created.
A group of people followed Xu Shiyan's instructions and walked through the forest, looking for water sources.
Walking and walking, they heard the sound of gurgling water. Everyone cheered up and followed the sound of water to look forward, and then found a small river.
Going forward, you can see a spring water gushing out next to a big rock on the hillside, flowing into a small river.
"I found it, I found it." Everyone shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: Ginseng Blossom Cola
chapters.content:
Chapter 347 Ginseng Flower Cola
"Oh, why is this water still spicy? Kill me."
Someone was curious, so he went up to pick up the water with his hands and took a sip.
Different from the sweetness and moistness of other mountain spring water, this water feels crispy and numb at the entrance, killing your mouth.
The soda that I usually drink has some saccharin at least, and the taste is acceptable. This one has no sweet taste but is particularly killer, and most people can't stand it.
Xu Shiyan also came forward, picked up some water and took a sip, "Well, this is it."
That's right, it is this spring, which was later named Shixiquan, which means rare spring water in the world.
This kind of natural mineral water with gas is very rare, and the carbon dioxide contained in the water is very delicate, which can stay in the water for a long time.
Compared with this artificial sparkling water and soda water, it is too rough.
This water is said to be good for the human body, but Xu Shiyan couldn't tell what it was.
He knows one thing now, and if he finds it, he should go through the formalities quickly and occupy the place first. Don't let any capital take away such a good place.
Therefore, Xu Shiyan took the people and searched around again to determine the location and scope of the water source, and then took the people away.
Back to the venue, Xu Shiyan immediately reported to Lin Qiyue, and then Lin Qiyue arranged for someone to write a feasibility report and quickly sent it to the county.
In the county, I saw that a beverage factory was going to be built in Yishenchang to make ginseng flower cola and ginseng cola. The factory site was selected in a small river upstream of the Caozi River.
What else is there? Without further ado, the county approved it directly, and expanded a lot beyond the scope mentioned by the first participant, so that the first participant had enough space to build a factory.
After selecting the factory site, one side hurriedly builds the factory building and enters the production line, and the other side rushes to prepare raw materials.
The development of ginseng flower cola has basically taken shape, and with the newly found water source, it will get twice the result with half the effort, and the samples will come out soon.
Of course, most people are not used to drinking this stuff, and feel that it is similar to drinking medicinal soup.
"What the **** is this? Why does it taste bitter? It also tastes a bit mushy, like medicine soup, and it kills your mouth."
Xu Shiyan specially took two bottles home to give his family a taste.
Not surprisingly, Xu Chenghou and his wife, Su Anying, sister Su Anfang, Xu Shiqin, all of them almost vomited out after taking a sip each, saying that it was too bad to drink.
But Xu Haiyuan, Yang Haoyu, and Xu Jinping, the three little ones, said they were delicious after drinking them, staring at what was left in the bottle, feeling hungry.
"Dad, can we drink the rest?"
"What's so good about that thing? It makes you so greedy?"
Xu Chenghou looked puzzled, but seeing the children staring at him eagerly, he still couldn't bear it, and poured some more for them.
As a result, the three children held the cups and drank them again.
Everyone finds it strange, why don't these children find it unpleasant to drink?
"Dad, this is the difference in daily eating habits.
Adults have already formed a habit, and they must think this stuff is not good, but children are different.
Their eating habits have not yet formed, and they have a high degree of acceptance of new things, so they think it tastes good. "
Actually, Xu Shiyan didn’t think there was anything delicious about Coke, but foreigners love it, so what is it called? Happy fat house water?
All right, don't care if it's good or not, as long as it can be sold to make money.
Ginseng flower cola was successfully developed, so hurry up to report it and apply for testing and identification by an authoritative organization.
It is necessary to get the test results and confirm that all standards are met before registering trademarks, ordering packaging, and mass production after the factory is completed.
The samples are shipped to the provincial capital together with the ginseng honey slices, and then there are special people there to receive them and help send them to relevant institutions for testing and identification.
This time, it was useless for Xu Shiyan to follow, mainly because Xu Shiyan was busy and had no time.
June 17th was the day Su Anfang and Li Zongliang got married.
Daying is not too close to Donggang. If you want to pick up the bride that day, you have to drive from Fusong, which takes more than six hours to go back and forth, and go all the way to Fusong on a winding mountain road. The road condition is not good and it is dangerous.
So the two families of Su and Li were discussing that on June 16th, Li Zongliang went to Daying to welcome his relatives, and the Su family happened to hold a banquet to entertain relatives and friends.
Then I picked up the Su family in the afternoon and stayed at the Canchang guest house. On the 17th, I picked up my daughter-in-law from the guest house to get married.
Su Anfang's parents are both present, and there is absolutely no reason to marry from her sister or brother-in-law's family. This is the final decision after everyone discusses it together.
Regarding this, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying didn't have any opinion, anyway, they can do whatever they want.
As long as the young couple is doing well and the wedding goes smoothly, don't care about anything else.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan and his wife went to Daying on June 15th to help the Su family live.
Then on the morning of the 16th, the Su family held a banquet to entertain guests.
In the afternoon, Su Weicheng and his wife, Su Anfang's cousin Su Anguo and his wife, Su Anbang and his wife, Su Anmin, and Su Anhua, as natal guests, accompanied Su Anfang and Li Zongliang back to Donggang and lived in the guest house.
If you don’t have your own parents to send off your relatives, your sister can’t go either.
There is an old saying that if the elder sister does not send the younger sister, the younger sister will be poor for a lifetime.
Su Anfang doesn't have a brother, so she can only ask her uncles, aunts, and cousins ​​to see her off. Anyway, Su Anhua is young, so as a younger sister, she can go.
Su Anfang and his party went to Donggang and arranged them directly at the participating guest house. With the face of the Li family and Xu Shiyan, the guest house must not be negligent, and everything was properly arranged.
Lin Qiyue also arranged for the family members of the employees to go over to act as the mother's family and help with the inside and outside.
On the morning of June 17th, Li Zongliang took a group of young men to the guest house to welcome his relatives. Then go back to Li's house for the wedding ceremony, and serve wine in the canteen at noon to entertain guests.
The conditions are much better now than in the past few years. The Li family has ordered two pigs from the first team long ago, so the banquet is very sumptuous. Regardless of the mother-in-law's family, they are very satisfied.
On June 18th, the Li family set up a banquet and invited the three families of Su, Xu, and Han.
Without everyone's help, Li Zongliang and Su Anfang would not be able to get married smoothly.
Su Anfang got married smoothly, and everyone was less concerned.
It's just that Xu Shiqin felt uncomfortable watching Su Anfang get married in a splendid manner, and he didn't know when Han Liwei would come back, and when the two of them would be able to hold their wedding.
"Little sister, what's the matter? Are you thinking about Liwei?"
On the way back after the banquet, Su Anying saw that her sister-in-law was gloomy, and knew that she was thinking about Han Liwei, so she grabbed her sister-in-law's hand and tried to persuade her.
"It's okay, didn't Liwei call a while ago to say that everything is fine over there?
It seems that I haven’t heard of any movement recently. I guess there is nothing wrong, and I will be back after a while. "
After Han Liwei arrived there and settled down, he asked for permission and wrote a letter to his family to report his safety.
At that time, Xu Shiyan happened to be going out. According to Xu Shiyan's instructions, Su Anying packed the medicine powder and pills that Xu Shiyan had prepared and divided into small bottles.
Give it to Xu Shiqin to send the express mail to Han Liwei.
A few days ago, Han Liwei sent a telegram, saying that he had received the item and he would keep it safe.
"Sister-in-law, even if there is any movement at the border, it will not be reported on TV. We don't even know about it." Xu Shiqin sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Ginseng soil
chapters.content:
Chapter 348 Approval of Ginseng Soil
The test results of Ginseng Blossom Cola came back quickly.
After testing and identification by an authoritative organization, the ginseng flower cola developed by Yishenchang not only contains the essential ingredients of cola, but also contains ginseng polysaccharides and other main active ingredients.
It reaches the physical and chemical indicators stipulated in the food and is allowed to be put into production.
After receiving the test results, all participants were very happy, and worked overtime on the new factory building, striving to complete and put it into production as soon as possible.
On the other side, Xu Shiyan led someone to design the outer packaging and apply for trademark registration.
The preparations are done first, and we just wait for the completion of the factory building to start.
On June 27th, Xu Chenghou celebrated his birthday. The brothers of the Xu family took leave of absence and came back with their wives and children to celebrate the old man's birthday.
Seeing a big TV set up next to my parents, it was still in color. The brothers were very envious and watched it for a long time.
When Xu Shiyan returned to the county, the county also held a grand welcome ceremony, and Xu Shixian was also present at that time.
Now that the brothers have gathered together, Xu Shixian has to tell the big guys about the situation at that time.
Aroused all kinds of envy from the brothers, they all said that Xu Shiyan really had a long face this time.
Xu Chenghou also mentioned at this time that Xu Shiyan was going to study at the Agricultural University in autumn.
Specially emphasized that this university can only be attended by cadres above the deputy county level or candidate cadres.
This time, everyone is envious.
Xue Xiulin and Chen Chunling, sisters-in-law, looked at Su Anying, and couldn't help feeling emotional.
Originally, the third daughter-in-law looked uneducated and stupid, but she was the luckiest one.
The family happily celebrated the old man's birthday, and hurried back in the afternoon.
The brothers started their own families and did not live together. After a long time, the relationship naturally faded.
Xu Shiyan didn't have time to lament, he was too busy.
Not only was there a bunch of things to do at the venue, he also partnered with Zhou Qingguo, Yang Junxian, Yang Chunming and others to pay for it a while ago, and found Guo Shouye, who was already the director of the resource department of the Forestry Bureau, and approved a piece of participation in the Kaifeng Fork Road. land.
Starting from this year, individuals can purchase ginseng land from the forest tenure department as long as they pay the corresponding resource fee.
The Forestry Bureau's right to approve ginseng soil is under the management of the Resource Department.
Generally speaking, sparse forest land and over-mature forest land are the most expensive, with a land of three to four thousand yuan.
Bare mountains, wasteland, and bushes are slightly cheaper, and the cheapest are swamps, ditches, and ponds, which cost less than two thousand yuan per field.
The piece of land that Xu Shiyan is optimistic about is almost six ridges, which is a ditch and pond near Kaifeng Forest Farm.
No way, now the money is not so abundant in the hands of each family, and it is too good to afford it.
Xu Shiyan has money, and he can't take it all by himself. Since it is a partnership, everyone contributes together, and it is best to share the money equally.
Although this is a ditch pond, the soil quality is very good.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan bought ginseng soil here, planted it for three years, and the yield was very high.
That's why Xu Shiyan chose this place. Several partners collected 10,000 yuan to pay the resource fee, and then found someone to clean up the trees and bushes, and began to hang strings.
The hanging strings in the ditch pond are not too many feet long, and they can reach six hundred feet in one field. There are six fields in total, and finally three thousand seven hundred feet.
Xu Shiyan, Yang Junxian and other eight people each kept fifty feet, and the rest were sold.
The ginseng soil distributed by each village last year was distributed for three years at one time, so this year there is no ginseng soil in each family.
Grow a stick, the most feared thing is the interruption in the middle, the jargon in the industry is called running empty.
This thing is planted every year. The first three years are invested in it, and after three years of rotation, it starts to make money.
If there are empty cars in any year, and there are no goods to be produced at that time, this year will be very difficult.
When the ginseng soil was divided, the village said that it was divided once every three years, and those who were unable to bear it could only wait for the next time to divide.
The family has some spare money, so they have to find a way to buy some ginseng soil and plant sticks, otherwise life will be difficult.
Therefore, there is no need to say anything about the ginseng soil approved by Xu Shiyan and others.
The relatives and friends of each family know, your family is 20 feet long, and my family is 30 feet long.
Six yuan a foot, 3,300 feet of ginseng, all were bought in less than two days.
If they hadn't acted early and set aside the ones from the family in advance, it is estimated that even those would have to be robbed.
Thirty-seven hundred zhang, apart from the reserved four hundred zhang, it was also sold for 19,800 yuan.
The cost of approving ginseng soil and finding someone to work and hang strings, each family earned more than 1,000 yuan, and there are fifty feet of ginseng soil, which is not bad.
"Third brother, let's batch more ginseng soil next year. I think selling ginseng soil will bring in money faster than planting sticks."
When distributing the money, Zhao Jianshe said this.
Indeed, from the approval of the ginseng soil to the sale, it took a total of one month or so. The family earned more than 1,000 yuan, and there were still fifty feet of ginseng soil left.
This guy, just kidding, got the money.
I have worked hard for three years with a mallet, and I don’t know how much I can earn.
"What are you doing with so many approvals? I just asked someone to approve the ginseng soil for the convenience of our own use of ginseng soil. Do you think I still live by selling ginseng soil?"
Leave fifty feet for our own family, and it will be pretty good if we develop slowly, let's be content. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and ignored Zhao Jianshe.
The family is fifty feet long, trying to find a way to find some seeds, sprinkle some ginseng seeds, and develop slowly.
Three years later, the market just caught up with the good market, and it can be sold for five or six hundred yuan, which is a lot. How much is too much?
Xu Shiyan has always said that to control the blind expansion of human parameters, too fast growth is not a good thing.
He made many batches of ginseng soil, and his family can't use that much, so he had to sell them.
At that time, everyone will buy more and plant more. In the end, the overcapacity of ginseng will reduce the price, and everyone will lose money.
This person has a problem, he is not satisfied, and he has to look forward to Shu.
Plant 30 feet this year, plan to plant 50 feet next year, and plan to plant 100 feet the year after.
It increases every year. How much money you have in your hand, you can’t wait to invest in it double.
Catch up with a good year, the market is good, and you will make money in three years.
If you catch up with the bad market and the price is low, you will lose money after three years.
Some people are busy working for thousands of feet, but they can't do it by themselves, so they all point to hiring someone.
Busy all year round, making a fuss, and at the end of the day, I can't catch up with others who earn hundreds of feet a year.
Why? The cost is too heavy, the investment is too high, there is only quantity but no quality, what's the use if you can't sell the price?
Few people grow, all are high-quality products, and there is no need to hire people to do the work, the couple can finish the work.
Saving money everywhere, isn’t it just making money in the end?
So, it’s still the same sentence, do what you can, less but better is the correct development route, don’t try to eat a fat man with one bite, you will easily choke to death.
Now Xu Shiyan wants to take the road of less and better, don't fix too much, and develop slowly.
"Well, what the third brother said makes sense, hehe, I just think it's too easy to make money."
Seeing that the eyes of money are open to human nature, no one can avoid it. Zhao Jianshe is a stickler at first, how could he think so much?

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Xu Haiyuan was beaten
chapters.content:
Chapter 349 Xu Haiyuan Gets Beaten
After entering July, Xu Shiyan's nerves tensed up.
Especially after the 10th, he was restless all day long. Even when he went to work, he took Xu Chenghou's semiconductor with him, hoping to hear some news about the border from it.
Unfortunately, Xu Shiyan was disappointed. It has been many days since the 12th, and he has not heard any news.
This is also normal, the war is still going on, in order not to leak secrets, it is not allowed to report casually.
But Xu Shiyan's hanging heart has nowhere to go, and he is worried, fearing that something will happen to Han Liwei at the border.
Wanted to send a telegram to Han Liwei, but didn't know where to send it.
The last time I sent something, it was just a temporary address. It is said that I have to transfer several times to get to the place.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to say anything to his sister, for fear that Xu Shiqin would get angry and get sick again, so he could only keep the matter in his heart.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about Han Liwei who was at the border and didn't know the specific situation, and at the same time he had to be busy with various things to participate in.
Su Anying has to work on the farm at one end, and has to find someone to dig the soil and clean up her ginseng land at the other end.
Anyway, the couple are too busy to care about other things.
July 10th, the final exam for elementary school, three days after the exam, the results came out, Xu Haiyuan was not surprised that it was double hundred.
The homeroom teacher was very happy, so he didn't leave too much homework for Xu Haiyuan. As a result, the kid finished all the homework in a few days, and then started to let himself go.
The children of several families got together, not to go to the Huangni River at the foot of Paotai Mountain in the south to catch fish and shrimp.
It is to go to the water bubble behind the east weather station to catch tadpoles.
Otherwise, go to the woods behind, climb trees and dig out bird nests.
Anyway, as long as they can do it, this group of children are not left behind, and they will go home soaked in mud all day long.
But the mothers of these families were so angry that they gathered together and beat the children up.
Even Xu Haiyuan couldn't escape the beating, and was beaten by Su Anying with a feather duster.
After the fight is over, reason with them again.
How old are a group of brats to do this? Going up the tree and down the river is too dangerous, what if there is an accident?
Xu Haiyuan grew up so big, it was the first time he was beaten so badly.
The buttocks were swollen and high, and I could only sleep on my stomach at night. After two days, the swelling subsided, but it became bruised again.
It happened that Zhou Guilan accidentally saw it, but Zhou Guilan was so distressed that she gave Xu Shiyan and Su Anying a bad reprimand behind their backs.
"I didn't say that you shouldn't take care of the children, but you should take care of them with some measure, right? How could you beat a child to death?
This is because your father didn't see the wound on Yuanyuan's buttocks. If he saw it, he wouldn't be blamed if he didn't fight with you guys.
How can you be parents like this? How can you beat a child like that? "
Zhou Guilan also beat children when she was young, and Xu Shiyan was often beaten when she was young, but she has never been beaten so hard.
"Mom, I really don't blame Yingzi for this matter, Xu Haiyuan is too capable, too much.
How old do you think he is? He dared to go down to the river to catch fish, and he went to catch tadpoles in the bubble. What if he fell into the water and had some accidents, what would he do?
In the kiln factory, a child drowned a few days ago. He just went to the big bubble in front of the kiln factory to take a bath, but he didn’t come up when he went down.
The children who were with him rushed to call for someone, and when the adults heard it and came to save them, the children were dead.
The woman in that family passed out when she heard the news. Whose child had an accident, the parents must be so distressed to death? "
Of course Xu Shiyan had to speak for his wife, he felt that Su Anying did the right thing.
Xu Haiyuan has done too much in the past few days, he should be cleaned up, and he can't be allowed to be so embarrassing.
If something happens, how will the family live? Didn't that gouge out their hearts?
After what Xu Shiyan said, Zhou Guilan was speechless.
That's right, such a small child can't do anything wrong, what if something happens?
"Then you said these brats are on vacation, and they don't watch much TV during the day, and they don't have much homework, what can they do?"
Zhou Guilan was also panicked. These children are like wild horses that have run wild when they are on holiday. Adults can't follow behind them and watch them all day long.
"Mom, let me find someone to borrow Xu Haiyuan's second grade books, let him preview the new lesson at home, and then read the books and so on.
Huang Shuqing probably hasn't finished his homework yet. Sun Yu, Shuyun, and Tingting will be in first grade this fall.
I made a small blackboard for them, so that Xu Haiyuan could tell them about the first grade class.
Got to find something for them to do, otherwise it will be really bad, too terrible. "
Xu Shiyan also had no choice but to bear his own son.
Let Xu Haiyuan watch Huang Shuqing do his homework, and then take charge of teaching those who will go to school this fall, previewing the first-grade courses.
"I'll ask someone again, if Songjianghe sells footballs, buy a football.
The open space next to the martyrs' tomb is good, let them play football there, it's better than going down the river. "
There is no way, if this group of children behaves badly, they are as skinny as they are, and sooner or later something will happen.
What can Zhou Guilan say? The son is also for the good of everyone, so let's do it.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan made a small blackboard for the children, and asked for some chalk from the trade union publicity room.
Clean up the westernmost room, hang a small blackboard on the wall, and use the whole board as a desk.
Every morning, Xu Haiyuan taught the younger ones some mathematics and Chinese, then watched Huang Shuqing do his homework, and read books by himself, and the morning passed.
Xu Shiyan asked someone to buy a football from the county. Every afternoon, the children played football in the open space next to the martyrs' tomb.
This stuff, in hindsight, is definitely a rarity.
When Xu Haiyuan and the others play football, they attract many children from nearby to join in the fun. Anyway, the children don't know how to play football, so they just play randomly.
There will also be unhappiness in the middle. The agricultural team and the family members of the grain depot are not pleasing to each other, and if the troubles are not good, they will fight.
Just fight, don't care which side loses, and you are not allowed to complain when you go home. Anyway, the next day, we got together to play again.
Adults can only turn one eye and close one eye. If they can’t control so much, they can only ignore it.
At most, tell the children not to kill them when they are joking around, and they are not allowed to take belongings.
There was the Olympic Games in the summer of 1984. From July 28th to August 12th, CCTV broadcasted the Olympic Games at various times.
Now the Xu family is very lively. The old men and women in the neighbors, except for eating and sleeping, spend the rest of their time at the Xu family watching the Olympics.
At the beginning, the children still felt that it was quite fresh, and they ran to watch TV every day after finishing their homework.
Later, I found it boring. They didn’t understand anything about the games on TV.
That's it, the children don't watch TV at home, they should play or play.
But for most Chinese people, the Olympic Games has touched the hearts of hundreds of millions of people.
On July 29th, Huaxia athletes won two gold medals in one fell swoop, breaking the Olympic record of zero gold medals.
This is a historic moment, and countless people shouted with excitement.
In this year's Olympic Games, our athletes won a total of fifteen gold medals, ranking fourth on the medal table.
This is the proudest moment for the Chinese people. Everyone watching the TV broadcast has tears in their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 350: Pine Mushroom Tray
chapters.content:
Chapter 350 Pine Mushroom Tray
With the Olympic Games coming to an end, there are not many days left for the children's vacation.
The bear children have performed well during this period. After the adults discussed, they lifted the ban on the children and allowed them to go out to play.
But you are not allowed to go to the water, you can go to the forest to pick up mushrooms, pick trays and so on, everything is based on safety.
Now, the children cheered up and got up early carrying small baskets and went to the woods behind to pick mushrooms.
Behind Xu Shiyan's house, there is a large forest and a large ditch and pond. Walking in, you can go to the side of Sentie.
In the past, this was the old ginseng land in Donggang, but later it was planted with larch, and now the larch is as thick as the mouth of a bowl.
In the larch forest, there will be a kind of mushroom called matsutake mushroom.
The cap of this mushroom is covered with a layer of mucus, especially when there is dew in the morning, the top of the mushroom is sticky and slippery.
So, some people call this mushroom sticky dumpling.
Pick off the fallen leaves and pine needles from the fresh pine mushrooms, wash them and stir-fry them.
Put some homemade miso, and cut some green peppers into it, it tastes very fresh.
It is slippery and smooth in the mouth, and the taste is very good.
If you pick up too many mushrooms, spread them on a fork or thread them on a wire to dry, and save them for stewed chicken in winter.
Dried matsutake mushrooms are soaked and stewed in chicken broth. After stewing, it tastes delicious and bites the head, which is better than meat.
In addition to pine mushrooms, there is also a small yellow mushroom, which also grows on the ground. The mushroom caps are bright yellow, small in size, and most of them grow in flakes.
The small yellow mushrooms are also very tasty, but they are too small to count. In most cases, they are eaten with pine mushrooms.
These are the two most delicious mushrooms in the pine forest, and there are other broom mushrooms.
It’s okay to eat it fried with pine mushrooms, but if eaten alone, it’s not very tasty.
Middle and late August is the season when the mushrooms in the forest are the most prosperous.
The children go to the forest to pick mushrooms every morning, and when they come back, they clean up the dead branches and leaves.
It’s a good choice to stir-fry and add another dish at noon, or dry it and save it for winter.
The children are very interested in this, and the adults in the family don't think too much about it. One day they pick up more, the adults are happy, and maybe they can buy a few popsicles for them.
Now the children were even happier, and happily entered the forest.
In addition to mushrooms, there are also trays in the woods, which are also children's favorites.
Pallets are small thorny shrubs that don’t grow very high, and it’s best to be in the second stubble forest.
The seedlings that just came out of the ground last year will bloom and bear fruit this year. The trays that grow out are very large, and you can pick a bunch of small branches.
The small red fruit has a sweet and sour taste, and is a favorite snack for many children.
There are actually two kinds of trays that the locals refer to. One is bright red, with no hair on the outside of the pulp, and it is shiny.
This kind of sour is sweet, and this kind of fruit grows upwards, and you can see it at a glance when you enter the forest, a red branch of fruit.
There is another kind, pink, with a layer of hair on the outside of the pulp.
The stalk of this kind of fruit is long and grows downward, and you can only see it when you push the leaves.
This kind of fruit has a very special taste and a very strong fruity aroma, so some people call it Maotray or Korean Tray.
Anyway, no matter what kind, it is the favorite of children.
After some children entered the mountain, they took off the tray and ate it.
Some children ate a little, but most of them picked it up and put it in the tea mug.
After returning home, Mr. Guan asked for some sugar or some honey, crushed the selected tray with a spoon, stirred it with sugar or honey, and the bright red jam was made.
Scoop a spoonful into your mouth, sweet and sour, delicious.
On the morning of the 17th, Xu Shiyan returned to his parents with the notice from the Agricultural University.
When I first entered the door, I saw my two daughters sitting in the shade of the yard.
Each of them held a small bowl, and took a spoon to scoop up something to eat.
"Yo, you two will enjoy it, what do you want to eat?"
Xu Shiyan saw that the girls were all sitting on the stools. The little girl was short and her legs were still flirting, not to mention how leisurely she was.
couldn't help laughing, deliberately stepped forward to tease the girl.
"Girl, give Dad a taste, Dad is hungry seeing you two eating."
Xu Jinhui, who is more than two years old, has a round and fleshy face.
A pair of big eyes are really like what is said in storytelling, the white mercury is inlaid with black mercury, sparkling and pure.
Now when she heard that her father wanted to eat it, the little girl hurriedly took a spoonful from the bowl, and didn't care if the jam was falling down, she lifted it up and wanted to give it to her father.
"Dad, eat, sweet."
This baby’s speech is not as good as the first two, but compared with ordinary children, it is considered very good.
Pronunciation is quite standard, just jumping single words, and seldom able to speak sentences.
Xu Shiyan ate his mouth pretendingly, and nodded, "Well, it's really sweet and delicious. Our family Huihui is the best. If there is something delicious, I will tell my father."
Xu Shiyan deliberately praised his daughter, and even touched the top of the little girl's head.
Beside   , Xu Jinping twitched her lips, "I'm fooling the kids again, Dad didn't eat at all."
This girl is just like his brother, she is a ghost, and Xu Shiyan's little tricks can't fool her at all.
As soon as Xu Shiyan spoke, Xu Jinping knew that her father was deliberately teasing the child.
So they didn't even move, just watched the father and daughter perform, and after watching it, they had to complain.
When Xu Shiyan heard what the eldest daughter said, he coughed several times due to choking.
"Yes, you are just like Brother Ni, you know how to tear down your dad all day long."
It's over, the daughter is getting better and better as she grows up, it's not easy to be fooled, it's not fun at all.
"Little girl, why are you so thoughtful all day long? Be careful, but you don't grow tall."
Xu Shiyan didn't know whether to laugh or cry, he deliberately grabbed the eldest daughter's hand, and put a spoonful of jam into his mouth.
Then he reached out and rubbed his daughter's face. Seeing her helpless face, Xu Shiyan felt a little better.
"Dad, being tall has something to do with your parents' genetics, it has something to do with the nutrition of what you eat, and it has nothing to do with whether you are smart or not.
I am called wisdom, with a brain. "
Xu Jinping put down the bowl in her hand, rubbed her face, and looked at her father helplessly.
Why do you feel that Dad is more like a child than her? How childish.
It's over, I'm dead chatting today, I can't continue.
Xu Shiyan felt that if he continued to chat with his daughter, he would feel like an idiot.
Really, since Xu Jinping joined the Yuhong class last year, especially after Xu Shiyan bought those books back.
The two older ones in the family grow up at a rapid rate, and their ability to absorb knowledge exceeds the vast majority of children.
It's so strange, neither he nor his wife are smart people, so how did they give birth to these two monsters, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping?
These two children are so simple, I don’t know who they are with their IQ, anyway, there are more than a dozen children in the old Xu family’s life, and they have never seen one as smart as them.
Children are smart, and they don't know whether it is good or bad.
Xu Shiyan only hopes that the children can grow up healthy and carefree. Children should look like children.
But no matter how you look at it, the two of his family are not like ordinary children.
Is this good or bad?

chapters.title: Chapter 351: Lesson Xu Haiqing
chapters.content:
Chapter 351 Lesson to Xu Haiqing
"Sir, what time did you come back? Is the place not busy?"
Xu Chenghou had seen his son come back a long time ago. He didn't make a sound, just lying on the window, watching his son and granddaughter chatting in the yard.
Seeing his son being rejected by his granddaughter, the old man is also very happy.
After thinking about it after enjoying the music, it is better to open the mouth to give my son a step down, and then I asked.
"Father, well, my notification letter has arrived. It just so happens that the venue is not busy this morning, so I will ask for leave and come back."
Xu Shiyan smiled, took out the notice and walked into the house.
"I didn't see Xu Haiyuan and his brothers, what did they do?"
At this moment, I suddenly remembered that the two sons are not here, why did they go?
"Yuanyuan went to find Teacher Qi. Didn't you borrow the second-grade books for him? If you have any questions, you can ask Teacher Qi."
Xu Haiyuan is absolutely crazy when he plays, but he is absolutely unambiguous when it comes to learning.
Prepare the second-grade courses by yourself, and if you don’t know it, go to the neighbor teacher Qi.
"Xiaoqing went out with your mother, that follower thing, no matter who in the family goes out, he will follow.
Your mother was going to go shopping, but he cried and shouted to follow him. There was no way, so your mother led him away. "
The four children in the family have different tempers.
The two elders love to study, but Xu Haiyuan has strong hands-on ability, can cause trouble and is restless.
Xu Jinping is a girl, she is a bit more obedient in comparison, but she is also eccentric and not easy to mess with.
The younger one, Xu Jinhui looks quieter, well-behaved, soft and good-tempered, and she can do whatever she is asked to do.
Xu Haiqing, in Zhou Guilan's words, was reincarnated as a star.
If you don’t like to stay at home, you’d like to wander around from east to west, even if you don’t go to anyone’s house, you can just hang around on the street. If you don’t like to go home.
"That **** Xu Haiqing stays away all day, I think he deserves a beating."
As the child got older, Xu Shiyan always felt that the temperament of the fourth child was quite similar to that of the youngest son Xu Haichao in his previous life.
Zhen Te Niang is a wicked girl, born at different times, why are her personalities still so similar?
"How old is the child, do you care about him? Follow along, and your mother doesn't buy too many things."
Xu Cheng gave his son a thick look, this one doesn't want to do anything good, and spends all day thinking about how to beat the child, what's wrong?
"Here's the notice? Didn't it tell you when to go to school?"
Xu Chenghou didn't like to hear that, so he simply changed the subject and asked him what he cared most about.
"Oh, the superior said, report from September 20th to 25th."
Most of them are cadres who are going to study. When this autumn is busy, they have to give some time to arrange their work before they can go to school.
"Oh, it's still a while, let your mother and your wife prepare luggage for you later.
You didn’t come back until the Gregorian calendar year when you went out, right? You have to bring enough clothes and bedding.
I remember that when the fifth child was studying, he had an eiderdown mattress, right? Let your mother look for it and bring it for you, that thing will be kept cold. "
Xu Chenghou felt sorry for his son, and began to talk about things to prepare for going out.
"Well, that's fine. It's best to have a duck down mattress. If you don't have me, you can bring a roe deer skin mattress. It's all good."
Others don’t have these things, and his family doesn’t lack them, and they don’t know what the accommodation at the school is like. It’s okay to bring extra luggage.
"Father, I plan to leave on September 20th, settle down there, and take care of the Clivia at home.
Sell it when it’s time to sell, and you can’t keep it at home forever. "Xu Shiyan said, looking at the Clivia on the window sill.
In recent days, the Clivia in Fusong and Songjianghe has also become a bit lively.
According to Huang Shengli and the others, Clivia seeds now cost a few cents or even a dollar a grain.
Wait until October, Clivia will be designated as a city flower, and the entire provincial capital will be frantically buying it. It is estimated that the seeds can also cost several dollars a piece.
Xu Shiyan intends to take advantage of this opportunity to quickly sell the flowers at home. It is best to sell all the flowers before the year, and it can't be delayed for too long.
"Oh, okay, it's time to sell it. At home, your mother thinks about it every day, for fear that someone will steal it.
Let’s sell it, I can’t eat or drink so much.
If the sixth child really likes it, just keep a few pots of good ones to raise, but don’t make so many. "
To tell the truth, ever since Xu Shiyan came back from the provincial capital last year, the old couple knew that Clivia was so valuable, they often couldn't sleep at night, for fear that their Clivia would be missed by others.
So when he heard from his son that he wanted to sell Clivia, Xu Chenghou had an idea, sell it quickly, but don’t hold it down, he is so worried all day long that he can’t bear it.
Father and son were chatting, Zhou Guilan carried something in one hand, and led Xu Haiqing in from the outside with the other.
Xu Haiqing was still holding a popsicle in his hand.
Probably walked back a bit slowly, the popsicle was licked by him, and there was still a little bit left, the cream and sugar had melted, and the paste was all over his hands.
Xu Shiyan glanced at his youngest son, his face darkened, "Walking around with your grandma all day long, just thinking about the delicious food, right?
Xu Haiqing, you don’t need to be so loud all the time, you see, one day you will be annoyed by me, and I’ll blame you if I don’t beat you up. "
The youngest child is used to it at home, not to mention grandparents, even older brothers and sisters are tolerant to younger brothers.
So Xu Haiqing's temper is a bit muddy and unreasonable. Whatever he wants to do, if others don't let him, he will cry.
I don't know how long it took him to buy this popsicle. Anyway, this brat is not far away from being beaten.
If Xu Shiyan scolded his children in front of his parents in the past, Xu Chenghou and his wife would definitely not be happy.
But Xu Haiqing is really hard to manage this brat, and now Xu Shiyan's right to speak at home has also increased a lot.
So the old couple had a tacit understanding and turned their heads to do other things. They were out of sight and out of mind.
There is no other way. Among the four children, this one is the most muddled, so I can't do it alone.
Xu Haiqing was actually quite afraid of Xu Shiyan. When he saw Xu Shiyan staring at him with a cold face, subconsciously, the little guy wanted to hide with his grandparents.
Xu Shiyan can still make such a little thing dodge? He dragged his younger son to him and stared at him with a cold face.
"Is the popsicle delicious? After rolling a few times, your milk bought it for you?
Come on, let me learn from you, let me see how you play tricks? "
Xu Haiqing pouted and was about to cry, but Xu Shiyan didn't buy it at all.
"Hold back your tears, dare to cry? What's wrong? I hit you, and you still cry?"
Bear child, roll around in front of others, crying and howling, try playing in front of him?
Xu Haiqing glanced at Xu Shiyan secretly, but he really didn't dare to cry, tears were in his eyes, and he blinked and held back.
Xu Shiyan snorted, "Go and wash your hands and face. After washing, find a corner and stand there for an hour.
No matter who goes out in the future, if you dare to cry and make noise, you must follow, and I will punish you to stand when you come back. "
Bear boy, can't he cure you?
Xu Jinping, who was coaxing her younger sister in the yard, sighed when she heard the movement in the room.
Hurriedly entered the house to scoop up water, asked Xu Hai to wash his hands and face, and then pointed to the corner of the storage room.
"Go there and stand still.
Serve it right, who told you to be embarrassing? Hit it? Our father is not used to you. "

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Han Liwei was seriously injured
chapters.content:
Chapter 352 Han Liwei is Seriously Injured
Xu Haiqing didn't dare to say anything in a daze, and obediently went to the storage room, and found a corner to stand.
This kid really has that twist, and he really stood still for an hour.
Xu Shiyan was also angry and funny when he was treated by his youngest son. The four children are amazing, and they are really convinced.
Just after an hour, Zhou Guilan hurried to call the little grandson out.
When this kid saw grandma, he hugged grandma's thigh, and began to sniff his nose aggrieved and wanted to cry.
"Xu Haiqing, I'll beat you if you cry." Xu Shiyan said.
The little guy was so scared that he quickly let go of his grandma, ran to the yard, and went to play with his two sisters.
"Such a young child, don't be too strict."
Xu Chenghou saw his grandson running to the yard and having a good time with his two sisters, so he whispered to his son in the room.
"Yuanyuan was even better than him when he was young, and you didn't say you were so ruthless."
"Father, the little ones are unwilling to take care of them, so I can only be the bad guy.
There is a lot of scouring, but he is famous for his scouring, he is not just playing around.
I am not afraid of children being naughty, naughty children will have a bright future, but I am afraid that the big guys will get used to this brat Xu Haiqing and make bad habits.
If you can take care of it when you are young, you can take care of it as soon as possible. When you grow up, you can take care of it even if you want to. "
The youngest son in the previous life was like this. The two daughters above finally got an old son, and they are both used to it.
Xu Shiyan himself was not willing to take care of it, that's why he got used to those stinky problems.
It’s definitely not going to work this time, and I have to take good care of it since I was a child.
Xu Haiqing may not be very promising, even if he will work at home and grow sticks in the future, he must not develop those lazy habits.
"Forget it, your own son, you can take care of it as you want." Xu Chenghou sighed and didn't say anything else.
One generation doesn't care about the affairs of the second generation, but he doesn't even care about his son in this life, so let's not care about his grandson's affairs.
The father and two were chatting in the house, the three children were playing in the yard, and Zhou Guilan went to the vegetable garden to pick vegetables for lunch.
Just entered the garden and picked two handfuls of beans, when I heard the sound of a bicycle stopping outside the gate, and then someone walked quickly into the yard.
The four dogs in the yard suddenly cheered up and barked at the person who came.
"Stop barking, and go back." Xu Jinping was in the yard, and hurriedly drove the dogs back to their dens.
Then he smiled at Han Limin at the door, "Uncle Han, my dad is inside."
Xu Jinping knew the visitor, knew that Han Limin was looking for her father, so she hurriedly led Han Limin into the house.
"Grandpa, Dad, I, Uncle Han, are here."
"Limin is here? Come and sit down."
Xu Chenghou's heart skipped a beat, he felt strange, why did Han Limin come here while he was eating lunch at this hour?
"Have you had lunch? Let your aunt cook a few more dishes, and let's eat here at noon."
"Uncle Xu, stop busy, I have something to do.
Well, Shi Yan, let’s go, let’s hurry to find our siblings, Liwei had an accident over there, and he’s recuperating in the capital. "
Han Limin's face was full of eagerness, how could he have the leisure to chat with Xu Chenghou? Pulling Xu Shiyan was about to go out.
The sibling he was talking about was of course Xu Shiqin.
"Huh? What's wrong with Liwei?" Xu Chenghou from the east room, and Zhou Guilan who walked to the door with a basket, asked in unison.
Zhou Guilan dropped the basket in her hand, walked into the room in two steps, and asked again, "Limin, tell the aunt, what's the matter with Liwei?"
"Master, Madam, don't worry.
That’s how it happened. Liwei was seriously injured and couldn’t be cured at the border, so he was sent to the capital.
Just now I received a call at work, saying that Liwei had woken up and wanted to see his siblings. "
Han Limin quickly explained, for fear that the old couple would get angry and something would happen again.
"Lixin went up the mountain to find my father. My mother said that she wanted my siblings to take a leave of absence and go to the capital with her, so I hurried over here."
If something happened to Han Liwei, of course the Xu family had to be notified. Han Limin was too anxious just now and didn't explain the matter clearly.
"San'er, hurry up, hurry up and find Lao Liu, let her pack her things and go to the capital."
Zhou Guilan became anxious when she heard that, and urged Xu Shiyan to go out quickly.
"I don't know how injured Li Wei is. Oh, this kid, don't you have to suffer old crimes?"
Mother-in-law loves her son-in-law very much. Although Zhou Guilan doesn't get along with Han Liwei much, she likes this son-in-law very much.
When I heard that my uncle was injured and sent to the capital for treatment, I immediately felt distressed.
"Let's go, let's go find the younger sister." Xu Shiyan only sighed, and didn't have time to persuade his mother.
Han Liwei was able to come back with his life, which is already a blessing in misfortune. He sacrificed directly in his previous life.
Be content, no matter what, people are still there.
Just like that, the two of them hurriedly rode their bicycles to Songjiang River, arrived at the tailor shop, and told Xu Shiqin about Han Liwei.
When Xu Shiqin heard that Han Liwei had been seriously injured, he almost fell down. Fortunately, Xu Shiyan gave him a hand and he was able to stand still.
"Don't worry, Liwei's situation should be fairly stable, you should ask for leave quickly, go home to pack your things, and find a way to go to the capital as soon as possible." Xu Shiyan comforted his sister.
At this time, it is useless to get angry in a hurry. No matter how worried you are, you have to calm down and get down to business.
"Shiqin, come on, hurry up and go home. I'll make up a leave note for you from your work unit. It's fine."
Xu Shiqin's master was nearby, and he heard everything, so he persuaded Xu Shiqin to leave quickly.
At this time, they couldn't care about anything else, and the three of them hurried back to Donggang by bicycle.
Zhou Guilan helped Xu Shiqin pack his clothes and luggage, and Xu Shiyan accompanied Han Limin to the venue to ask for leave and borrow a car.
When Lin Qiyue heard that Han Liwei was injured and hospitalized in the capital, he immediately arranged for a driver to take the Han family to Tonghua.
So the driver drove, picked up Li Yuexiu and Han Limin who were already prepared, picked up Xu Shiqin on the way, and drove straight to Tonghua all the way.
The main reason is that it was past eleven o'clock, the express train in the morning had already left, and the slow train was too late until midnight in Tonghua, so I couldn't catch the train to Shenyang.
So the driver drove directly to Tonghua, and it was estimated that he could catch the train to Shenyang at 6 o'clock in the evening.
This way, the driver didn't care about that, and ran desperately.
Thanks to the fact that the driver always goes out, he is experienced and familiar with the road, and arrived at Tonghua Railway Station before six o'clock.
Han Limin hurriedly bought a ticket, took Li Yuexiu and Xu Shiqin to check the tickets and got on the bus.
"Xiao Zhou, thank you so much today, brother came back to buy you a drink."
Before entering the station, Han Limin gave the driver 200 yuan. Anyway, if it's enough or not, that's the thing, let's talk about it if it's not enough.
Just like that, Han Limin took the train from Tonghua to Shenyang with his mother and sister-in-law.
Arrived in Shenyang in the middle of the night, I didn't care about rest at all, so I hurriedly bought another ticket to the capital, reversed the train and walked to the capital, and finally arrived in the capital on the afternoon of the 18th.
At the capital station, a special car came to pick up the station, picked up the Han family, and went straight to the capital 301 hospital.
In the intensive care unit, Xu Shiqin saw Han Liwei who was covered in gauze and was holding several hanging bottles.
"Liwei, I'm here." Xu Shiqin resisted crying, walked forward gently, and carefully held Han Liwei's hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Old ginseng help
chapters.content:
Chapter 353 Laoshan Ginseng Help
After Xu Shiqin and the Han family left, Xu Chenghou and his wife kept thinking about it, not knowing what happened to Han Liwei, and whether Xu Shiqin and the others arrived in the capital safely.
Finally, on the morning of the 19th, Han Limin called back.
Informed them that everything was fine in the capital, and that Han Liwei's condition was also stable, so Xu Shiyan felt relieved.
As for why Han Liwei was injured, it may be related to confidentiality, and Han Limin and the others don't know.
All I know is that Han Liwei was seriously injured at the time, and was hanging on his breath when he was found.
"Shiyan, Liwei said, thanks to the medicine you gave him, he keeps it with him all the time.
He took the pill twice after the injury, and once more before he passed out, and finally saved his life. "Han Limin said on the phone.
"The doctor also said that Liwei's injuries are very serious, and he would not survive under normal circumstances."
"Well, I extracted it from century-old mountain ginseng and other medicines."
Xu Shiyan didn't say that he used the largest ginseng tree he dug in the big house to save Han Liwei's life.
As long as the person is still alive, no matter how precious the ginseng is, it is not as important as the happiness of the younger sister in the rest of her life.
Han Limin has lived in the forest area for these years, and he immediately understood, "Shiyan, you are our family's benefactor."
The ginseng that can have such a miraculous effect is not only a hundred years old, its value is immeasurable.
Xu Shiyan actually used it to dispense medicine to Han Liwei, and the Han family owed Xu Shiyan his life.
"It's useless to say that, who is Li Wei? My brother-in-law.
Come on, let’s not talk nonsense with you, the long distance is quite expensive, you will take good care of Liwei over there for a while, and let them come back first to get married after he recovers from his injuries. "
Xu Shiyan is not willing to listen to words of kindness or non-kindness. It is too far-fetched for him to talk about kindness with the Han family.
Hung up the phone, Xu Shiyan quickly talked to the people in Corey, rode home by bike, and told his parents about Xu Shiqin.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were relieved to learn that their daughter had arrived in the capital safely and that Han Liwei's injury was improving.
"As long as Liwei is fine, let's take it easy.
It is better than anything else to recover from the injury, change jobs and come back, find a job and live a stable life. "
Xu Chenghou doesn't know anything else, as long as people are safe anyway.
Xu Shiyan didn't express any opinion on this, and he couldn't guess Han Liwei's future.
Whether it is changing jobs or staying in the army, it is not up to them to decide, it depends on the meaning of the superiors.
In short, Han Liwei is fine, everyone can feel at ease, no matter how serious the injury is, there will be a day when he recovers, as long as he is there, everything can be said.
On August 20th, Xu Haiyuan started school and became a second-year student.
Sun Yu, Huang Shuyun, and Zhao Tingting became first-grade pupils.
Xu Jinping saw that those people were all in elementary school, so she had to make a fuss about going to elementary school again.
This time, no matter how much trouble she made, Xu Shiyan and his wife were determined to ignore her.
Are you kidding me? A child who is only six years old, and his birthday is still so young, going to elementary school?
Even if Xu Shiyan can find a relationship, it won't work, he should just stay in Yuhong Class honestly.
Xu Jinping begged to no avail, so she could only stay in Yuhong Class with Yang Haoyu.
Children start school, and adults can also breathe a sigh of relief. The autumn harvest is about to start, and the ginseng and goods are about to start, and everyone is also busy.
It was even busier when he participated in the exhibition, so Lin Qiyue called people to hold a meeting every day to discuss the plan of participating in the production of goods this fall.
Every year, a ginseng factory must produce corresponding products according to the requirements of the provincial medicinal materials company, such as ordinary red ginseng, raw sun-dried ginseng, sugar ginseng, etc.
This year, there are two more Changbaishan red ginseng and honey chips, and there are also raw materials reserved for ginseng cola at the beverage factory.
There must be a charter for these, and the production quantity of each category must be set, and blind production cannot be done.
In the middle of a meeting, suddenly the secretary came in and said it was a call from the province.
Lin Qiyue said, just go directly to the meeting room, and he will pick it up here.
The phone was transferred, and Lin Qiyue picked up the phone and found out that it turned out to be a honey chip that was shipped a while ago. The response from the customer was good, and some customers wanted to place additional orders.
"Xiaolin, once you participate, can you increase the production of honey chips this autumn?" asked the other end of the phone.
"If there is any difficulty, just mention it, the province will definitely support it.
If your factory lacks raw materials, other brother units can also provide support.
At present, the prospect of earning foreign exchange from ginseng honey slices is good, we have to seize the opportunity. "
After hearing this, who doesn't understand? This is watching foreign merchants place additional orders, and some people are jealous again.
"Leader, you can rest assured that we are doing a deployment meeting for this fall production.
It is estimated that this year’s honey chip production, in addition to the existing orders, we can still produce…”
Speaking of this, Lin Qiyue glanced at Xu Shiyan, which means, ask Xu Shiyan to give him a number.
Xu Shiyan quickly wrote down 20,000 yuan on the paper, and whispered, "20,000 catties of fresh ginseng."
This is a conservative estimate made by Xu Shiyan based on the current raw materials in the venue and the ginseng output last year.
In fact, if you want to produce, you can add another 20,000 catties.
However, scarcity is the most expensive thing, and if too many honey chips are produced, they will be worthless, so we cannot blindly expand production.
Lin Qiyue understood what Xu Shiyan meant in an instant, so he started to fool the person on the other end of the phone.
"20,000 catties of honeydew ginseng, let's grit our teeth and we should be able to finish it.
Leader, it’s not that we are stingy, this honey chip has strict quality control and high technical requirements.
The workers of the brother unit have not been trained, nor do they have suitable factory equipment, so this matter will not cause trouble to the brother unit.
No matter how hard or tiring we are, we can overcome it and guarantee that we will complete the task without delaying the province. "
Lin Qiyue's words choked the person on the other end of the phone, so there's no way to continue talking.
"Okay, since you have prepared for the market, the province can rest assured, work hard, and strive to develop better products to earn foreign exchange."
The leader babbled a few more words on the phone, then hung up.
As soon as the phone was hung up, Lin Qiyue started to sneer.
"See? We all look at our fast fat meat and want to come up and take a bite.
Hmph, thanks to what Xiao Xu said, we directly applied for a patent in Hong Kong City.
A while ago, the results of the patent application have come down. Without our authorization, there is no possibility of production in other places. "
"Comrades, the next task is very difficult.
In autumn, we are already busy at the ginseng field. The workers have to set up ginseng, dig the soil, plant ginseng, and the processing factory has to process it. Now that the production volume of the honey chip workshop is so large, it is necessary to arrange more manpower.
The beverage factory may start production at the end of October, and there is still a shortage of workers there. Let's talk about it, what should we do? "
It's really a headache. Now that there are orders and factories, there are not enough workers. What can no one do?
"Secretary Lin, I have a suggestion. It is better to recruit a group of people, especially women, from among the family members of our employees to become regular workers.
The technical department arranges for this group of people to do pre-job training. After the training, they will go to work. After they are proficient in their work, they can bring in temporary workers. "
There are quite a few unemployed young people among the family members of the participating workers. Recruiting these people can solve part of the problem to some extent.

chapters.title: Chapter 354: Recruitment as a worker
chapters.content:
Chapter 354 Recruitment as a worker
There are more than 1,000 employees in the first factory, except for the subordinate schools, shops, service departments, etc., most of the rest are male workers.
No way, digging up the mountain, planting ginseng, and picking up ginseng are all heavy physical labor, and women can't do it.
So among the regular workers, most of them are men.
Both the processing plant and the comprehensive plant have seasonality. Every autumn, the family members of the workers are mobilized to work, which can be considered as an increase in family income.
Nowadays, the honey chip workshop needs a large number of workers. The beverage factory is expected to be completed and put into operation in October. They all need skilled workers. Temporary workers cannot be hired here.
So Xu Shiyan proposed to recruit a group of workers between the ages of 20 and 30 from the family members of the workers, regardless of gender.
Lin Qiyue and other leaders heard that this suggestion is very reasonable.
If the factory wants to develop well and expand its scale, it must recruit more workers. If there are not enough workers, nothing can be done.
Just like that, the venue immediately posted an announcement, and the loudspeakers began to shout.
Eligible unemployed young people from each household, regardless of gender, can all come to the personnel department of the field department to register. After passing the review, they can be recruited as regular workers.
Upon hearing the news, the whole venue became lively, and many people came to sign up.
Especially in the past few years, a group of young people who have graduated from junior high school and high school, failed to enter university, and their fathers are not old enough to retire, so they have no way to take over. This can be regarded as a way out.
Many people came to sign up. After reviewing the materials, the Human Resources Department found that those who met the requirements were approved.
In two days, the Human Resources Department examined and recruited 120 young workers, and more than 90 of them were female workers.
This is also normal. When boys grow up, they can be recruited to work or sent to serve in the army. They can think of ways, but girls are really difficult to arrange.
Then there are some married daughters-in-law, who are also the main force of this recruitment. Anyway, the honey chip workshop is not labor-intensive, and the female workers are careful, which is just right.
Su Anfang married Li Zongliang, and now she is also a member of the participating family.
Su Anhua and Li Chengrong also get along very well, and they will be engaged in winter, so they can be regarded as future family members.
Neither of these two people needed Xu Shiyan's action. The Li family and the Li family greeted the field, and the two sisters were all recruited to participate in the field and became regular workers.
After Su Anfang married Li Zongliang, her household registration was moved, but Su Anhua's did not.
So Su Anfang accompanied her sister to take the early-rising Yanling bus back to Daying, and moved her household registration and food relations.
"What, both of you have recruited workers to enter the venue as workers?"
The two daughters came back early in the morning, Su Weizhong was quite puzzled.
As a result, when they heard that the two daughters were recruited as workers, Su Weizhong was overjoyed.
"Well, didn't the second brother-in-law lead someone to do research and processing? This year, he earned more than three million yuan in foreign exchange, so the venue needs to add a honey chip workshop and a beverage factory.
When there are not enough workers to participate in the field, workers are recruited from family members.
Hua'er is the force given by Li's family. I am recruiting workers outside the rules. I followed the formal procedures.
Anyway, both of us have passed the recruitment. Isn’t this the household registration for returning to Hua’er? "Su Anfang quickly explained it, so that the old man didn't understand.
"Hey, if you talk about it, you two are still getting rich with your second brother-in-law."
Su Weizhong slapped his thigh. The second son-in-law of his family has become very capable, and the family has also enjoyed a lot of glory.
"Oh, let's not talk about being in the light or not.
Is it a little bit of a little bit for our family to follow the second son-in-law? Those will be discussed later.
Hurry up, take the children to the village, and quickly move out the household registration and food relations, so that the children can quickly implement the work. "
Seeing that her husband was happy, Han Caie urged Su Weizhong to get her daughter to do business quickly.
"Yes, yes, hurry up and change your household registration first."
Su Weizhong slapped his head, quickly put on his shoes and went to the ground, led the two daughters out of the house, and walked to the countryside.
Since the commune was abolished and changed to Daying Township, the township government moved to Xianrenqiao.
When it comes to Xianren Bridge, there is also an allusion.
Around 1910, at the west end of the village, there was a wind-fallen tree covered with moss, which fell across the Tanghe River.
At that time, there was no bridge for people to cross the river, so they could only walk on the fallen logs, which was difficult.
Someone said at that time, "This single-plank bridge is not dared to be walked by ordinary people, only immortals can pass it smoothly." Hence the name Immortal Bridge.
When the village was built in 1936, this place name was used.
When the Hunbai Railway was being built in 1958, a station was set up at Xianrenqiao, and people from the Railway Bureau worked on it.
Later, county-owned deer farms, grain depots, oil depots, etc. were also located here one after another, so the township government was also here.
It takes about half an hour to walk from Daying Village to Xianrenqiao Township.
Su Weizhong led the two daughters all the way to the east, and those who saw it felt strange. Aren't Su Anfang and Su Anhua both in Donggang? Why are you back at this time?
Anyone with good faith should inquire about it. It doesn't matter if you inquire, it's in Su Weizhong's arms.
"Oh, my two daughters both recruited workers to enter the state-run factory and became workers. Isn't this coming back to change their household registration?" Su Weizhong said loudly on purpose.
In the past, he used to joke that he had no son, no family, look now? What happened to the six daughters?
The eldest daughter is a teacher, the second daughter has a farm at home, and the fifth and sixth children recruited workers this time.
Those who laughed at him for not having a son, did their son become a worker?
When the people around heard this, some were genuinely happy for Su Weizhong, while others were envious and jealous, with various reactions.
Su Weizhong doesn't care what these people think, anyway, he feels very happy now.
Shu Tan, so he smiled and led his daughter to the village to change her household registration and food relations.
Su Anfang and Su Anhua were in a hurry to return to Donggang to confirm their household registration and work, and they had no time to stay with their parents.
After the change of household registration, the express train in the morning was about to arrive, and the two gave their father some money, and hurried to Xianrenqiao Station.
I bought a train ticket, took the train back to Donggang, and went directly to the Human Resources Section of the field department to go through the recruitment and settlement procedures.
At this point, the sisters became a formal worker participating in the field.
The recruited new workers undergo pre-job training at the staff club.
Xu Shiyan brought people from the technical department to give lectures to these people, mainly about relevant rules and regulations, safety production and other matters.
As for the production of honey slices, that is actually not too difficult. Xu Shiyan and his team have already researched a ginseng slicer.
As long as someone puts ginseng on top, the blade will automatically cut the ginseng into thin slices. The thickness of each slice is exactly the same, which can ensure the quality of honey slices.
Of course, this kind of operation must be strictly in accordance with the regulations. If it is not done well, it is easy to hurt people, so it is necessary to do safety production-related knowledge training and assessment.
Those who pass can be hired, and those who fail will be given a chance to re-learn. If they still can’t learn, then they can only be arranged to do odd jobs in the processing factory, or they don’t want it at all.
"Don't think, I'm joking with you, safe production is the top priority, this concerns everyone.
I want to emphasize again that all female workers have their hair cut short and have a size five. When entering the workshop, they must wear white overalls, hats, and masks.
Men, all have a crew cut, and the same is true, wearing masks and hats.
Anyone caught by the safety and sanitation patrol who is out of compliance, then you can go home. "
Xu Shiyan doesn't have the time to talk nonsense with these people. The rules and regulations are set, and everyone has to abide by them. Those who don't abide by them can leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 355: Top university
chapters.content:
Chapter 355 Going to University
The newly recruited workers will study and train intensively for ten days. At the beginning of September, the participants will start to participate in the field, and the workers will officially start to go to work and produce.
The yield of the new sticks that participated in the field this year is still good, and these are only treated with bean cake water once, and foliar fertilizer is added twice.
From next year, those who will be added will be the base fertilizer plus top dressing. It is estimated that the output will be higher next year.
Ginseng is taken out and shipped directly to the processing factory. After the machine brushes the ginseng to remove the sediment, there are special personnel to select the ginseng suitable for making honey slices.
The requirement is that a single tree weighs one or two halves to two halves, and the main body is round without redundant forks.
The selected ginseng is sent to the honey chip workshop. First, the ginseng reed head is cut off, and then cut into thin slices of a certain thickness by a machine.
The reed heads and ginseng must be returned to the processing factory, the ginseng will be steamed and processed for sale, and the reed heads can be used to extract saponins.
The cut ginseng slices should be soaked in the best linden tree honey for a certain period of time.
Then remove it from the honey, put it in a steamed ginseng tank, and steam it under a certain pressure at 45 degrees.
The steamed ginseng slices are then immersed in the medicinal liquid prepared by several traditional Chinese medicines for a certain period of time.
Take it out and mix it with honey again, store it in a container, and wait for a certain period of time before it can be packaged and shipped.
So don't look at it as a small piece of ginseng, the process required is quite a lot.
Although it is not as exaggerated as the dozens of processes that Xu Shiyan said, there are still more than a dozen.
The honey chip workshop is required to be clean and dust-free. All workshop staff wear white work clothes, white hats, masks, and special rubber gloves on their hands.
Female workers cut their hair short, one is to prevent accidental damage caused by long hair getting caught in the machine, and the other is to prevent hair from falling and affecting product quality.
After the workers who have passed the training and passed the examination are familiar with the operating procedures, they can get started very quickly.
The honey chip workshop was soon on the right track, and Xu Shiyan also had to pack his luggage quickly, because he had to go to the provincial capital to go to school.
There were two other people who went to study in the provincial capital with Xu Shiyan, Li Chengrong and secretary Xiao Peng.
These two people went to the provincial normal university to study foreign languages.
When I went to participate in the Spring Fair, Lin Qiyue found that he didn't know a foreign language, and it was inconvenient to not have a trusted translator by his side.
Since a participant wants to develop in exporting and earning foreign exchange, he must have his own foreign language professionals, otherwise it will be easy to fall into the pit.
So Lin Qiyue specially applied to his superiors, and arranged for the two of them to study foreign languages ​​at a normal university.
No way, there is no special foreign language university in the province, so I can only go to normal university.
On the morning of the 19th, Zhou Guilan rolled out noodles with her own hands and asked Xu Shiyan's family to eat them.
"Welcome dumplings to send off with noodles, eat noodles before going out, everything goes smoothly. San'er, eat more."
Zhou Guilan chanted while filling noodles for her son.
"Oh, I see, Mom." Xu Shiyan took a large bowl of noodles from his mother.
"Mom, you should sit down and eat too. I'm so tired after getting up early in the morning."
Su Anying saw that her mother-in-law had finished serving her husband noodles and was about to serve others, so she hurriedly took them.
"Shiyan is going out, you can give him a feast, and I will come for the others."
My mother-in-law has been busy all morning, how can I let my mother-in-law come to serve a meal.
The noodles rolled by Zhou Guilan are unique. Eggs, alkali, and salt are used to knead the noodles. The noodles are rolled thinly and cut finely.
Xu Shiyan went out to study, so he cooked noodles in clear soup.
Zhou Guilan said that after eating like this, you will have a clear mind and be able to study hard.
The noodles in clear soup are sticky, and it makes you feel confused after eating, so it must be noodles in clear soup.
Although it looks like clear soup noodles, it is not simple at all.
Boil the water, put it in a bowl, pour a spoonful of bone soup made from big bones, and then add some bone-removed meat, fried peanuts, chopped pickles, chopped green onion, and coriander.
The clear and bright soup is covered with oil flowers and smells fragrant. This noodle can make three big bowls if it is eaten open.
Xu Haiyuan and the others were all salivating, and started to make the bowl after receiving it, "Grandma, the noodles you made are really delicious, it's great."
Mouth full of noodles, don't forget to praise grandma and give grandma a thumbs up.
The two little ones followed suit, "It's great, it's great, it's delicious." He said while sticking out his thumb.
Zhou Guilan's eyes were so happy that she narrowed her eyes, "I like it, grandma will make it when I have time.
Eat slowly, and what’s more, after eating, the two of you hurried to school and studied hard. Look, Dad is going to college. "
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping nodded heavily, "Dad, you have to study hard and don't be lazy. When we grow up, we have to go to college."
"Okay, Dad will definitely study hard and set a good example for you."
Xu Shiyan smiled, and stretched out his hand to pinch the little cheeks of his son and daughter.
"You must be good at home, listen to grandma, and don't make trouble for grandma."
