Several children responded in unison, promising to be obedient and not make trouble.
After breakfast, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping went to school with their schoolbags on their backs. Xu Shiyan also packed and checked the luggage to make sure it was all right.
Just at this time, there was a sound of a car honking outside the door. Needless to say, it must be the car sent by the attendant to take Xu Shiyan to the train station.
Xu Shiyan hurried out to get his luggage, Su Anying helped carry two bags, and sent them out of the gate.
Sure enough, he saw two jeeps parked outside the gate, Li Chengrong jumped out of the car, helped Xu Shiyan put his luggage on the car, and did not forget to turn his head and say a few words to Su Anhua.
After loading the luggage into the car, Xu Shiyan looked back at his family, "Father, Mom, I'm leaving, don't worry about me.
Yingzi, I will leave the house to you for the time being. Pay more attention to the farm, and I will call there if I need anything. "
At the farm, I applied for a phone a while ago, and it was installed just a few days ago, mainly for the convenience of future contact.
Xu Shiyan got into the jeep, waved to his family, the car started, and took several people out of Donggang, all the way north.
Xu Chenghou and his wife stood outside the gate, watching the jeep disappear in an instant, both happy and sad.
"Brother Xu, what are you doing early in the morning?"
Someone passed by and saw the Xu family standing outside the gate looking north, and asked if it was strange.
"My son has gone to the provincial capital to go to university, and he came to pick him up just now." Xu Chenghou turned his head, half showing off and half sighing.
"No matter how old I am, as soon as my son goes out, I will miss him. Children, they are still children at any age."
"That's that, that's that. Hey, brother Xu is still blessed. Among the five sons, two of them went to college. It's really good."
Originally, he was trustworthy and inquired about it, but Xu Chenghou showed it off.
The man smacked his lips, shook his head, and hurried away. Why don't you go? Listen to Xu Chenghou showing off here?
Seeing the man leave in a hurry, Zhou Guilan couldn't hold back, and gave her husband a supercilious look.
"Showing off all day long, but your son is promising, I'll give you to the beauty.
Isn’t it the time when you despised your son for being worthless and scolded him all day long? "
The old lady had disliked Xu Chenghou for a long time, and hit him deliberately today.
Xu Chenghou blushed a lot, "Look at you, it's been many years since which pot was left unopened and which pot was lifted.
Forget about Chen Zhima rotten millet, right? "

chapters.title: Chapter 356: Professional class
chapters.content:
Chapter 356 special course
Xu Shiyan has been to the provincial capital several times, and he led Li Chengrong and Xiao Peng to Changchun with familiarity.
Provincial Agricultural University and Normal University are both in the southeastern suburbs, far away from the train station.
Fortunately, the notice stated how to take the bus. The three of them left the train station, went to the bus stop outside, and took the corresponding bus.
The three of them were all going to study, and they brought a lot of luggage, which took up a lot of space. The conductor saw that they had asked for an extra ticket.
Xu Shiyan and the others didn't care, they took the bus all the way to the southeastern suburbs, and changed buses halfway, so they finally arrived at the place.
Li Chengrong and Xiao Peng first got off at the stop near the Normal University, and Xu Shiyan took the car and walked a long way, and finally arrived near the Agricultural University.
Just like this, I carried it on my straps, walked to the gate of the Agricultural University with great effort, and handed the notice to the comrades at the reception.
The people at the reception saw that this was a student of this year's cadre training class, so they immediately called someone over to help Xu Shiyan with his luggage, and went to go through the admission procedures.
Cadre special training class, two-year full-time face-to-face junior college.
Universities do not charge tuition fees these days, and the school also pays living expenses.
For the special training class for cadres, in addition to the usual wages paid by the unit, the unit has subsidies, and the school also pays living expenses.
Otherwise, ordinary people can’t get it at all?
Xu Shiyan and his group have majors in agronomy, specialty products, veterinary medicine, animal husbandry, agricultural machinery, agricultural economics, medicinal plant cultivation, and vegetables.
Those who come to study are all local cadres above the deputy county level or candidate cadres, so the school stipulates that you can choose one major and two minors.
In fact, it means that it is not necessary to specialize in one subject, it is better to know a little bit, who knows which department will be arranged to work after graduation?
Xu Shiyan pondered for a while, and chose to major in specialty products and minor in animal husbandry and agricultural economics.
No way, a person's energy is limited, it is impossible to learn everything, and I can't take care of it.
Just these things, Xu Shiyan looked at the schedule, and it was already full.
After completing the admission procedures, someone will help to send the luggage to the dormitory.
These people have a separate dormitory building, four-person room, the conditions in the dormitory are okay, quite spacious.
The four iron frame beds are divided into left and right, and there is no need for upper and lower beds.
There are two desks near the window, and there are two desks near the bed near the door, exactly one for each person.
Xu Shiyan came early, the first one, probably because no one came, so the room seemed quite empty.
Wait for everyone to arrive, and soon the house will be ruined.
Xu Shiyan chose a seat by the window and was not in a hurry to unpack his luggage.
Instead, he took out the washbasin first, went to the public bathroom at the end of the corridor to fetch water, cleaned the inside and outside of the dormitory, wiped everything that needed to be wiped clean, and then opened his luggage.
A simple iron frame bed, the bed board is just a few wooden boards, and the wooden boards are covered with straw mats made of cattail grass.
Xu Shiyan wrapped a piece of polyvinyl chloride plastic film he brought from home on the straw mat.
Then spread the duck down mattress, then the cotton mattress and sheets, and finally put the pillows and quilts on the head of the bed in an orderly manner.
The quilts are all newly made by Su Anying. The quilt cover, white sheets, and soft cotton are brand new inside and out. Sitting on it is soft and comfortable.
The first day at school, that's how it went.
Registration time is from the 20th to the 25th. The opening ceremony will be held on the 26th, and classes will start after that.
Xu Shiyan deliberately came a few days early, and no one else came yet.
So the next day, Xu Shiyan talked to the instructor and the dormitory administrator, and he went out to visit his friends.
Since I came to the provincial capital to study, I must go to see Mr. Chu, so the first stop is naturally the Medical Family Hospital.
"Master, I came to the provincial capital to study. I took a junior college course in agriculture. I came here yesterday, and I came to see you today."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly explained the situation when he saw Mr. Chu.
"Oh? Agricultural college course, good, good. I didn't expect you to come to college so soon, it's good, it's good.
I always say that knowledge is wealth, and science and technology are the primary productive forces.
Being able to go to school, no matter which school, no matter what major, is fine. Learning is better than not studying, which is very good. "
Old Chu was also very happy to learn that Xu Shiyan came to study at Agricultural University.
"It's just that I was ashamed of my master's teachings, and failed to devote myself to studying medicine and inherit the mantle of my master."
Speaking of which, Xu Shiyan also felt a little regretful, he still learned too late and wasted too much time in the middle.
Medicine is an extremely time-consuming subject, and he is busy with various things now, so he doesn't have the time to devote himself to research.
Medicine, for Xu Shiyan, is difficult to achieve anything, it can only be used as a hobby, and he can't point to this line of work for dinner.
"It's just blind thinking every day. Whether you study medicine or not has little to do with your future achievements."
Old Chu laughed as soon as he heard it, and looked at Xu Shiyan with kind and kind eyes.
"You are already very good now, be content.
Master has heard about it, you are doing very well in your field, and you have researched something, earning a lot of foreign exchange.
A while ago, many newspapers in the province reported on your participation, with your name on it, and Master saw it.
How wonderful, no matter in which aspect, as long as you can achieve something, you will not live in vain in this life.
Who said you have to study medicine? I look fine. "At Mr. Chu's age, he can take everything seriously.
"What kind of mantle do you inherit? My own son and grandson didn't inherit it.
If there is no one, there will be no one, so what can be done? You just help me keep those medical handbooks and secret recipes.
In the future, whoever is destined to go is the best. No one will pass it on. It can only be the sorrow of an era and has nothing to do with you. "
When Mr. Chu said this, there was a little loneliness in his eyes.
The centuries-old inheritance of the Chu family has been cut off in his hands. He must feel uncomfortable in his heart.
"Stop talking about this, come, come and tell me about your trip to the Spring Fair.
Also, what kind of product is your ginseng honey tablet? I'm interested in these right now. "
Mr. Chu didn't like to talk about that, so he dragged Xu Shiyan to sit at the desk and asked about the deep processing of the ginseng industry.
Especially when Xu Shiyan mentioned that he applied for a patent abroad, Mr. Chu's eyes lit up.
"Okay, this is good, have vision.
How many good things did our ancestors leave behind? Over the years, I have followed the West, thinking that those in the West are treasures, but they treat the things left by our ancestors as garbage.
Don’t even think about it, our culture has been passed down for thousands of years, can’t it compare to the development of the West for hundreds of years?
Yes, we are backward in modern times, and we are not as good as the rapid development of the West, so we can't completely negate the things left by our ancestors. "
Speaking of these, Elder Chu couldn't help feeling sad.
As a person who has experienced the old society and the new society, and who has struggled in the difficulties and confusion, Mr. Chu has a deep feeling for these things.
The older you get, the deeper your understanding and attachment to the cultural heritage of the motherland.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: choose a place
chapters.content:
Chapter 357 Choosing a place
Although Xu Shiyan's education level is not high, he was reborn after all, and experienced the era of information explosion.
Not to mention anything else, such as a certain sound, a certain hand, etc., I have more or less brushed it, so I understand it a little bit.
In fact, in this year and month, not only Mr. Chu is confused, everyone is full of confusion and doubt about the future, and they don't know where the future lies.
So, they blindly worship the West and deny traditional culture.
In the future, when the country's economy develops and more people regain their national self-confidence, naturally, they will no longer be superstitious about the West.
So, again, the economic base determines the superstructure, and only when people are rich can they have the leisure to inherit and develop culture.
A person who can't even eat enough to eat will not take these things into consideration at all.
Xu Shiyan and Mr. Chu resonate on many topics, so despite their age, they can chat together.
This conversation lasted for a long time, and the two of them came back to their senses only after the nanny prepared a meal and greeted them.
"Let's go, eat first, and talk later.
Anyway, you are studying at the Agricultural University now, and you have nothing to do on Sunday, so you come to my place, improve the food, and chat with me along the way.
I'm free, so I can help you figure out the formula of the functional drink you mentioned.
And the health care products you mentioned, these are all ways, you can try it. "
Mr. Chu is now retired and has nothing to do at home. He was very interested in hearing Xu Shiyan mention this just now, so he proposed to help Xu Shiyan.
"That's good, I don't have to worry about you if you always take action." Xu Shiyan was overjoyed when he heard that.
Although he has an idea, it is very difficult to implement it. If nothing else, this formula is a headache.
If Mr. Chu can help, then the big problem will be solved.
Xu Shiyan had lunch at Mr. Chu's place. In the afternoon, Mr. Chu wanted to take a nap, so after lunch, Xu Shiyan said goodbye and left.
There was nothing wrong anyway, so Xu Shiyan planned to go to Uncle Zhang, and wanted to ask him where the Clivia market in the provincial capital is now.
There are so many Clivias at home, I have to find a way to sell them.
The best way is to find a similar location, get a yard facing the street with a gate, and open a flower company.
However, it is estimated that the price is not low. If it is not possible, you can find a similar yard.
Uncle Zhang was taken aback when he saw Xu Shiyan, and when he learned of Xu Shiyan's intentions, he patted his thigh.
"It's not difficult, I know that many houses are rented out.
Go, I'll show you one by one, you don't have to go far, it's just around here.
Let me tell you, our park is now an open-air market for Clivia. If there are only ten pots or eight pots, just squat in the park. "
Uncle Zhang thought that Xu Shiyan didn't have many potted flowers at home, so he casually pointed to the park not far away.
The weather is quite warm in this season, and there are many people in the park.
"Grandpa, I have a lot of Clivia in my family, besides, it's not good at this time, and the family members don't have time to come over.
I have to rent a place first, and wait for a month or so before I can ship all the flowers at home and sell them. "
In October, Clivia was designated as the city flower, and the price has been rising all the way since then.
Xu Shiyan also plans to start selling it after October, and now he is just preparing in advance.
Uncle Zhang nodded, "I see, you are not an ordinary person. Let's go, uncle will take you around."
Uncle Zhang stopped talking nonsense, and led Xu Shiyan to stroll around here.
The old man retired and had nothing to do. He just wandered around all day long and was very familiar with his surroundings.
So he led Xu Shiyan to walk through the streets and alleys, and walked to several places where he rented houses.
Xu Shiyan went around several places and chose one.
Sitting in a courtyard structure facing north and south, the third room facing the street is a pavement, and the door opens at the east end.
There is a rather large courtyard inside, with five main rooms and three east and west wing rooms. It seems that there is a back room behind.
It stands to reason that the house in front should be an upside-down house. It is estimated that it has been built as a pavement for the convenience of doing business.
"Uncle Zhang, what kind of place is this? It's a nice yard, why isn't there anyone living there?"
Xu Shiyan liked the house very much, but felt strange, why is the house so good that he is idle?
"Cough, don't mention it. In the early years, this was a paper craftsman's shop. Later, in the new society, it was not allowed to open.
A few years ago, when there was a lot of turmoil, the old couple of the host family died, the daughters and sons died and scattered, and the house was returned to the public.
This is not the year before last when his youngest son came back and fought a lawsuit for a while. At least he got the house back, and after a lot of effort, he drove out all the residents.
The meaning of the youngest son is that he wants to sell, but his house is too much and too expensive, and most people can't afford it.
So I put it on the other side of the housing management office, sell what you buy, and rent what you rent, but he asks for the whole rent.
Such a big yard, who can afford it? "
Uncle Zhang is indeed a local expert. He knows everything, so he told Xu Shiyan the origin of this house in detail.
Xu Shiyan's heart moved when he heard it. It would be a good deal to buy this house, but I don't know how much he wants?
Forget it, I don’t have enough money now, so let’s rent it first.
"Master, should I go to the housing management office to rent this house, or rent it from myself? It looks good to me, and I want to rent this house."
There are too many Clivias at home, and the place is too small to fit them. This place is very good, with many empty rooms, which can be opened up and accommodate many people.
Clivia is so valuable, there must be many people making up their minds, and it is not impossible to rob it openly and secretly.
There must be enough manpower here, and even the dogs at home have to be brought here, otherwise, if a thief comes in, it will be troublesome.
The place is big enough, and the yard is well-organized and suitable.
"The owner seems to be in the provincial capital, let me ask you.
However, let me tell you, this house is quite expensive for him. He doesn’t have five hundred yuan a month, so I’m afraid he won’t be able to afford it. "Uncle Zhang pouted.
Before, he rented the house to Xu Shiyan. It cost twenty-three yuan for a room with bedding, various household items, and a fire.
Let other people know about it, and they all say that he has been taken advantage of, and dares to rent such an expensive house.
In the yard in front of me, no matter how many houses there are, there are more than a dozen rooms in the front and back, it can't be said that it costs 500 yuan a month?
Whoever rents this house will be taken advantage of.
Uncle Zhang glanced at him, oh no, Comrade Xiao Xu.
"How about looking at something else? This house is really too expensive."
Five hundred yuan a month is indeed more than Xu Shiyan expected, but it is still acceptable. After all, he has seen two stores with rents of several thousand or even tens of thousands.
Of course, the two eras are incomparable.
But he only rents it for a while, at most until Chinese New Year, which is just over four months, and the more expensive it is, the more expensive it is.
After all, the location is good and the yard is big enough, which is just right for opening a flower company and selling all the Clivia.
"Uncle Zhang, please trouble me and help find the owner? Let me talk to her."
Xu Shiyan looked around again, and felt that this place is the most suitable, so let's do it.

chapters.title: Chapter 358: Students from neighboring counties
chapters.content:
Chapter 358 Students from neighboring counties
With the help of Uncle Zhang, Xu Shiyan met the owner of that yard.
Haggled with the other party for a long time, and finally negotiated, four hundred and fifty a month.
Xu Shiyan rents for four months first, and then sees whether to renew the lease when it expires.
The other party didn't intend to rent long-term at first, but mainly wanted to sell, so Xu Shiyan's short-term rent was exactly what he wanted.
Just like that, the two parties went to the housing management office to make records, and then signed the contract. Xu Shiyan paid the rent for four months directly.
As for the deposit, there is no need. The house is empty and there is nothing, and Xu Shiyan can't break off a piece of wall and take it away.
After renting a house, you have to go to the street and the police station to register. This is a necessary procedure.
This time I want to open a shop to start a business, which is different from the last time I rented a house from Uncle Zhang’s house.
Both the street and the police station had to ask in detail what kind of business they were going to do, where the people who rented the house came from, anyway, they asked a lot.
People are also afraid that someone rented a house to do something illegal and disciplined. Register it. If something happens in the future, this is the key investigation object.
Xu Shiyan said that he rented it for his relatives, who wanted to open a flower company in the provincial capital. The house was rented here, and people would come in a few days.
The other side of the street said, wait for the person to arrive, and go to register with the certificate issued by the village.
After the formalities were completed, Xu Shiyan got the key to the house, went back to the yard, and turned back and forth.
Not to mention, this house is really nice, the place is big and spacious enough.
In another twenty years, it is impossible to find such a spacious house with a good location in the provincial capital.
Of course, the house is quite old. Some parts of the backyard wall are loose, and some of the roof tiles are broken.
It seems that after taking over, there is still a little tidying up, especially the courtyard wall, which must be done.
Fortunately, when renting the house, Xu Shiyan told the owner of the house that he might tidy up the broken place when he came over.
The landlord himself had no money, and he wanted the tenant to help him repair the house, so he readily agreed.
After wandering around, Xu Shiyan probably knew where to repair.
Only then did he lock the courtyard door, go to the nearby post office, and make a call to Donggang.
A while ago, Xu Shiyan specially installed a phone on the farm, just for the convenience of contact.
"Daughter-in-law, tell Shengli, Feng Chao, and Jianshe.
Let Qingguo stay at home, take care of the Clivia at the other end of the farm, and do ginseng.
The other people arranged the family affairs as soon as possible. Even you, my father, and my second brother brought our four dogs and brought over at least a thousand pots of flowers.
I mentioned this to Brother Guo, and he arranged a car there.
By the way, please remember to let Victory bring all those who can carry guns.
There are also materials for nail flower stands, which are also shipped together. "It happened that Su Anying was at the farm, so Xu Shiyan explained everything to his wife.
The couple discussed these matters when they were at home, so when Xu Shiyan said it, Su Anying immediately understood.
"Okay, I will discuss with Shengli and the others, and go to the provincial capital as soon as possible."
It was getting late, and this end was quite far from the Agricultural University. If it was too late, there would be no cars.
Xu Shiyan put down the phone and hurried back to the Agricultural University by car. When I got back to the dormitory, I found that there were two more people.
"Hello classmate, I'm from Antu, Park Zhengzhe."
"Hello, classmate, I'm on Jingyu's side, Shao Yong."
Both of them are around forty years old, older than Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly stepped forward and shook hands with the two respectively.
"Hi, students. I'm from Fusong, Xu Shiyan. I didn't expect that we are destined. It happens that the three counties are neighbors."
Indeed, Fusong is in the middle, Antu is in the east, Jingyu is in the west, and the three counties are next to each other.
It was originally from the same province, and it was also a neighboring county, so the intimacy immediately came up.
The three introduced each other, and Xu Shiyan knew that one of these two was the director of the government office, and the other was the head of the township secretary.
This is the so-called candidate cadre. It is estimated that after two years of study here, he will be able to be promoted to a deputy county-level cadre when he returns.
In contrast, Xu Shiyan is the chief of the technical department participating in the field, and his qualifications are indeed quite different.
But those two people didn't mean to look down on Xu Shiyan's name, not to mention that the whole province knows it now.
Not to mention the neighboring counties are all engaged in ginseng-related industries, so why not know?
Shao Yong and Park Zhengzhe both intend to build a good relationship with Xu Shiyan, and they may cooperate in the future, so they are very enthusiastic.
Most of the people in Northeast China are social experts. Whether they know each other or not, they get familiar with each other just by chatting.
The three of them cheered up and went out to drink together at night.
As soon as I drank the wine, the chat box opened up, and the various chats between the South China Sea and the North that day made the relationship closer.
Fortunately, all three of them counted and knew that they were here to study, so they didn't drink too much, and the meaning was just that.
Nothing happened in the next few days, so Xu Shiyan went to the yard he rented to clean it up.
I also spent money on firewood and coal to burn the kang and clean up.
Waiting until the 24th, the last person in their dormitory also came.
Not to mention, what a coincidence, that one is Changbai, in the south of Fusong, four places put together, just to surround Changbai Mountain.
Now, there are four people in the dormitory, so we have to go out to have fun at night.
It wasn't until the opening ceremony on the 26th that everyone knew that this group of cadre training colleges had enrolled less than a hundred people in total.
Most of them are not at the deputy county level.
Most of these people are in their forties, and Xu Shiyan is the youngest among them. He is a special case, different from others.
If he hadn't done meritorious service, this good deed would not have happened to him at all.
At the opening ceremony, the dean gave a speech to the students and put forward some requirements for the students. At the same time, he also encouraged the students to communicate with each other, learn from each other, and make progress together.
As soon as the opening ceremony was over, everyone gathered together to exchange information with each other.
Most people hold a notebook in their hands and start to write down the names and contact information of their classmates.
These will be social resources in the future, belonging to their network and useful.
Xu Shiyan was also unavoidable, and also prepared a notebook, and the big guys just kept contact information with each other, and made an appointment to go drinking together.
People of this age have an urgent desire to read.
So don't look at the big guys who are very noisy. After the class really started, one by one became more serious, and everyone signed up for a lot of classes.
No one played when returning to the dormitory after class. They all held their books and buried themselves in their studies, for fear of being left behind by others.
Xu Shiyan was no exception. He listened carefully and took notes in class, and went back to the dormitory to review and preview quickly.
I usually go to the school library when I have some free time, wishing I could read books while eating.
The food in the school is mediocre, but everyone is here to study, and no one is here to eat.
They all survived the hard times. They used to eat pickles all day long, but now the conditions are good, so no one picks on them.
Just order two dishes and two steamed buns, as long as you can eat enough.
Many people, even when eating, are discussing study.

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Clivia started
chapters.content:
Chapter 359 Clivia begins
On September 30th, Su Anying, Xu Chenghou, Xu Shian, together with Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli, Yang Chunming, Feng Chao, and Sun Xiaofeng.
Brought dogs and guns, escorted two carts of Clivia and various materials for flower stands, as well as everyone's clothes and luggage, to the provincial capital.
Just in time for Sunday plus the National Day holiday, Xu Shiyan had a rest and made an appointment with his family in advance, and he was waiting on the only way into the city.
It was almost four o'clock in the afternoon on the 30th, and everyone came to the agreed place to meet Xu Shiyan.
Then Xu Shiyan led the car and came all the way to the yard he had packed up in advance.
"Slow down, don't worry, come down and stretch your arms and legs.
Those dogs should be tied directly to the yard, separated, but never tied together. "
Xu Shiyan helped Xu Chenghou out of the car, and hurriedly called everyone to pack things in the yard.
There are two big trucks loaded with flowers and things, and it’s time, so I have to unload the truck quickly.
Huang Shengli and others took the dogs down first, not only the four from the Xu family, but also two from Huang Shengli's family, two from Yang Chunming's family, and one from Feng Chao's family.
There are nine dogs in total, all of them are good dogs that used to go hunting in the mountains, and they are all fierce.
Huang Shengli is also a good hunter. In the past two years, Xu Shiyan has been busy with work and rarely has time to go up the mountain.
In winter, Huang Shengli took Yang Chunming, Zhao Jianshe and others together, and borrowed Xu's dogs every time, so the dogs of the several families were familiar with each other and did not fight.
Even so, in order to prevent accidents, they are still tied separately.
Exactly four corners of the yard, and the backyard, all tied dogs.
"All the flowers are placed in the five rooms of the main house on the north side. I cleaned up the house, if not, put them on the ground first, and build a flower shed tomorrow.
People live separately, Chunming, Jianshe, Shengli, Feng Chao, the four of you live in a house facing the street.
Father, Yingzi, you live in the East Wing, Xiaofeng and Second Brother, you two live in the West Wing.
I cleaned up the kang, lit the fire ahead of time, and just light it up later. "
In addition to the wall, there is also a back room at the back. The thief would have to make a little effort to get in. Just tie two dogs between the main room and the back room.
Mainly the houses facing the street, without walls to block them, are the easiest to enter, so Yang Chunming and the others are arranged to live here.
There are walls on both sides of the east and west. Tomorrow, we will start tidying them up. Barbed wire and caltrops are blocked on the top of the wall, or some glass shards are put on it, which can somewhat help.
No one knows what the provincial capital will look like after the price of Clivia soars all the way.
What if someone is really jealous and wants to steal or rob? So you have to do some preparation in advance.
This is also the reason why Xu Shiyan asked his family to bring dogs and guns, not afraid of ten thousand but just in case.
At this time, I don’t care about who lives where. It’s important to move the flowers down and send them to the north house first.
The flower shelves are all disassembled, and I don’t care about it right now. Anyway, I can put as many as I can on the ground.
Fortunately, there were so many people, and even the two drivers helped unload the car. The big guys worked for almost two hours, and at least they put everything together.
"Come on, come on, everyone has a break for dinner, it's six o'clock.
That, we have too many things, we can’t do without people, I ordered the dishes from the restaurant, we will just eat one meal, and we can start our own business tomorrow. "
Xu Shiyan took the time to go to a nearby restaurant, ordered eight dishes, and brought them here quickly, calling everyone to eat.
I just came here, and there is no table or anything, so I simply put it on the kang.
Everyone doesn’t care about that anymore, they go directly to the kang or squat or sit, and it’s important to eat quickly.
I left home at four o’clock in the morning, took a break on the road at noon, ate pancakes and drank some water, and dealt with it until this time.
They are all so hungry, who cares about that? Just eat it quickly.
The food in the restaurant was big enough, Xu Shiyan specially bought two pots of big steamed buns, and at the end of the meal, there was only half of the steamed buns left.
"Oh, I'm finally full. I'm so hungry that my eyes are green this day." Everyone said.
After dinner, he couldn't be idle, so Xu Shiyan took the two drivers to the guest house and arranged for them to stay.
The driver was found from the Forestry Bureau, Guo Shouye's face, so it must be arranged properly.
Xu Shiyan bought cigarettes, fruit, and snacks for the driver, and sent the driver away cheerfully.
Su Anying had settled the fare before the arrival, so there was no need to pay any more, the driver could just drive away tomorrow morning.
Xu Shiyan told the instructor and the dormitory administrator in advance that there were relatives at home, so he didn't go back to school at night and stayed in the courtyard.
The next day happened to be a holiday on the 11th. Xu Shiyan led the people to tidy up the yard and strengthen the fence first.
Bought sand cement, repaired all the loose wall tiles, and put a layer of cement on the top of the wall.
Then the waste collector bought some wine bottles and dropped them, and stuck the glass shards in the cement, and the walls were densely covered with glass shards.
If anyone comes to climb the wall in the middle of the night, it will be enough for him.
In addition to the glass shards, wooden poles were also fixed on the top of the fence, and the No. 8 line was wrapped with barbed wire, and several lines were wound around the top of the fence.
Now don't be afraid of trouble, once something really happens, it will really work.
The yard here is big, and the house is enough. There are five main rooms in the north, which are enough for placing flowers, and some can be placed in the other rooms.
Therefore, there is no need to build a flower shed outside. You only need to nail and install the flower shelf, arrange the flowers, and set up a few stoves to ensure heating in winter.
All the materials for the flower shelves have been pulled over, and it is enough for the big guys to clean up the nail flower shelves after finishing the wall.
These tasks cannot be done in a day or two. Xu Shiyan still has to go to class, and he doesn't have time to be here all the time.
Anyway, the general idea has been told to everyone, these people don’t have to worry about working, just follow the steps step by step.
Don't worry, it won't start selling flowers until November.
The small courtyard is being cleaned up intensively.
Xu Chenghou led people to tidy up the walls and make flower shelves, while Su Anying was in charge of purchasing, cooking, and taking care of the nine dogs.
After a few days, things gradually went smoothly, and everything was on the right track.
On October 11, 1984, the city passed the "Decision on Naming Clivia as the City Flower of the City".
Now, the price limit order of 200 yuan is completely useless, and the price of Clivia begins to soar.
On the 15th, it was proposed to develop the windowsill economy and try to grow three to five pots of Clivia per household.
The price of Clivia rose steadily, just like blowing bubbles, inflating dozens or even hundreds of times at once.
In several major Clivia markets, such as Changchun Station, Chaoyang Park, Laoquanlou, Guangfu Road, Yongchun Road, Hongqi Street, Wanbao Street, Qinghua Road, etc., if you walk from one end to the other with a pot of Clivia, The price can be doubled.
In less than a month, more than a dozen flower companies specializing in Clivia have appeared in the provincial capital, and there are also some flower and tree shops that also specialize in selling Clivia.
Suddenly, the entire provincial capital was in a state of turmoil. People frantically asked where there was Clivia, and some even went to collect Clivia and sell it.

chapters.title: Chapter 360: Crazy Clivia
chapters.content:
Chapter 360 Crazy Clivia
Fengying Flower Company, named after Su Anying, also opened for business at this time.
There is no need for any publicity, just set off firecrackers here, and immediately someone found out that there is another flower company here.
Then, those who searched and climbed Clivia everywhere poured in in an endless stream.
In the main room on the north side, there are rows of flower stands, on which are all kinds of Clivia, large and small.
There is a label under each pot, indicating the variety and price of Clivia.
The first batch of more than a thousand pots was shipped to the provincial capital. Except for the finished Clivia raised by Xu Shiqin, most of the rest were those raised by Xu Shiyan's family, and a small part were from the farm.
It is always necessary to prepare some large and small ones, and they can be chosen by others.
At this time, it will be the Clivia flower season soon.
The finished Clivia with more than a dozen leaves have already worn the stiles and flower buds, and they will bloom after a while.
The price of Clivia is not set blindly.
Before the opening, Xu Shiyan specially asked Huang Shengli and others to go to those Clivia markets with flowers in their arms.
Look at the price given by others, and double the price when you come back.
The expensive ones are tens of thousands, the cheap ones are thousands, and even flower seedlings with only three or four small leaves are priced at four to five hundred.
Anyway, this price frightened Huang Shengli and others. They never dreamed that a pot of flowers could be sold so expensive.
At the beginning, everyone was quite nervous, thinking that the price was too high and it might not be easy to sell.
Unexpectedly, on the first day of opening, dozens of pots were sold in the store, and the most expensive pot sold for 30,000.
A person from a neighboring province came over and picked three pots of finished Clivia, which cost more than 70,000 yuan.
For those small flower seedlings, the customer didn't even talk about the price, just ordered the money to pay, and left with them.
On the first day of opening, it sold more than 200,000 yuan.
Where have these people seen so much money? It was so frightening that Xu Chenghou and the others' hands were trembling when the shop was closed at night.
"Quick, quick, quickly secure and lock the window panels, and lock the door after inserting it.
Eat quickly, and take turns on duty in the first half of the night and the second half of the night.
My God, this is too scary, how can it be so expensive. "
When the price was first set, Xu Chenghou felt that Xu Shiyan was fooling around and set it so high.
Looking at it now, my good guy, this is too scary, can a pot of flowers sell for tens of thousands of dollars?
Su Anying hurriedly cooked on the other side, the big guys ate and rested, and they were on duty at night, no one dared to be careless.
After opening, many people come in to buy in the store every day, no matter how expensive it is, there will always be something that catches their eye.
Small flower seedlings are the best sellers. When the time is good, they sell hundreds of pots a day, while big flower seedlings sell a bit slower and go out every day.
"Waiter, can this potted flower be cheaper?"
This is the most common phrase in the store, and I don’t know how many people yell it every day.
"Sir, you have a good eye, this plant is an oiler.
Don’t look at just a few leaves, if you buy them back and grow them for two years, they can sell for tens of thousands of dollars.
Our family mainly has too many flower seedlings, and there is really no place to put them, so we sell them out when we have no choice.
Five hundred yuan is not expensive anymore. If you don’t believe me, go out and inquire about other houses. The price of Clivia has risen a lot these days. "
After these days of experience, Su Anying has become much calmer, and chatted with the other party calmly.
Su Anying's words are not fooling anyone. Huang Shengli and Zhao Jianshe go to various markets and Huamu companies every morning, and the prices really vary every day.
Su Anying got Xu Shiyan's instruction, and the price hasn't been raised yet.
The point is, there are still so many at home, so we have to get rid of them as soon as possible.
The house has only been rented for four months, and it is necessary to take advantage of the four months to sell it quickly without delaying for too long.
Opposite him was a man in a suit and tie, who looked like a small leader of some unit.
When the other party heard that Fengying Flower Company had a lot of Clivia seedlings, his eyes lit up.
"You mean, there are still many Clivia seedlings in your family? How many can there be?"
Su Anying was stunned for a moment, and immediately realized, "There are seven or eight thousand pots at home, some with three or five leaves, and some with seven or eight leaves."
Clivia can be propagated by seeds or asexually. Basically, it can grow three to five leaves a year.
Of course, this is also related to light, fertilizer and water.
Xu Shiyan led people to harvest seeds and cultivate Clivia from the end of 1982 to the beginning of 1983.
Until the spring of this year, the flower sheds and windowsills of the houses were full, and the price of Clivia seeds also rose, so they stopped buying and planting.
So the flower seedlings at home have three or five leaves, and there are also seven or eight leaves.
Clivia, who was served by Su Anying, knew the flowers at home very well. Of course, she remembered exactly how many there were, and immediately reported the number.
"So many? Where is it? Take me to see it." As soon as the other party became happy, he wanted Su Anying to take him to see it.
"Sir, I'm sorry, my house is far away from here."
Su Anying smiled, she was so far away, why did she lead her to see it?
"How far is very far? Judging by your accent, you haven't left our province, so you can't just be in the south.
It doesn’t matter how far away it is now, as long as there are enough flower seedlings, you can tell where it is. "
When the other party heard this, he smiled nonchalantly, and would never leave the country no matter how far away.
Nowadays, many people take planes to invert flower seedlings, what are they afraid of?
"Over there in Fusong, that is the county where ginseng is produced."
Su Anying thought about it, and finally decided to tell the other party.
This matter cannot be concealed. When they came, they had registered at the street. If someone asked, they would know where they came from.
"Well, can you arrange someone to lead the way? I'm going to have a look.
If there are many flower seedlings, I will purchase at least a thousand pots. "
When the other party heard that it was Fusong, he was relieved. This little road is nothing. It will take a day to drive at most, so it's not a big deal.
Su Anying thought for a while before returning to the other party, "Sir, do you think this is okay?
Let's sign a letter of intent for an order. You pay a deposit of 50,000 yuan in advance, and I will immediately arrange for someone to deliver flowers here.
In this way, you don’t have to travel to and fro to delay things. Besides, with so much cash, the road is quite dangerous. "
In other words, Su Anying can be regarded as having practiced now.
She was worried that this person didn't know where he came from, so Su Anying came up with this method in order to avoid someone setting them a trap.
Pay a deposit of 50,000 yuan before you can see the goods.
Come to think of it, ordinary liars don’t have the strength to come up with 50,000 yuan.
Anyway, a lot of flowers have been sold in the store recently, and another batch should have been shipped over. It is best not to let others know the exact location of the flower shed at home.
The other party laughed as soon as he heard it, "Yo, it's not simple, it's quite clever.
All right, anyway, you have a lot of flowers here, I am not afraid that you will lie to me.
Fifty thousand, right? Wait a minute, I'll let someone pick it up. "
As he spoke, the man turned his head and said a few words to the person behind him, who immediately turned around and left.
After a while, two people came back with a suitcase. When the suitcase was opened, there was a brand new 50,000 yuan in it.

chapters.title: Chapter 361: Large Orders
chapters.content:
Chapter 361 Big Order
Su Anying called Huang Shengli over, and asked Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe, and the other two to go to the savings office together to count the money.
After confirming that the money was all right, Zhao Jianshe came back to report the letter, Su Anying signed the order letter of intent just written with him, and quickly deposited the money in the bank.
"Shengli, go to the post office, call Qing Guo, and ask him to arrange for someone to deliver another two thousand potted flowers here.
Remember, you must take good heat preservation measures, arrange more militiamen to **** the car, and be careful on the road. "
Just at this moment, Huang Shengli and the others came back after depositing money, and Su Anying asked them to call again.
It's not that I'm catching someone specifically to instigate, but the store is busy right now, so many people are choosing Clivia, and Yang Chunming and the others can't get away.
Huang Shengli naturally didn't care about these things, so he hurried to the post office to make a call.
Zhou Qingguo received a call and immediately arranged for a car.
It's not difficult. There are people in the Forestry Bureau and the First Participation Field who have cars. The relationship Xu Shiyan established in advance can be used now.
In early November, the weather was not too cold, and the big car was covered with a canvas awning.
Before the flower seedlings were moved up, they were baked in a charcoal basin for a while in the car.
When the flower seedlings are loaded into the car, remove the charcoal basin, stack the flower seedlings next to each other, cover the middle with torn cotton, old clothes, etc., put a shelf on top, and cover with a quilt.
Five or six militiamen were arranged in the car, escorting the car with guns in hand. This was specially approved by Secretary Chen.
Xu Shiyan greeted Chen Jianzhang and Yu Shouguang before going to school, and the town gave full support and must ensure the safety of Clivia.
On November 3rd, Zhou Qingguo received a call, and on the afternoon of the 4th, two thousand pots of flower seedlings were shipped to the flower company.
Su Anying hurriedly found someone to unload the truck, and then notified the person who paid the money, the office director of an unknown factory.
The other party came to see the flowers the next day, and sure enough, he picked out a thousand pots of flower seedlings, some with three or five leaves, and some with seven or eight leaves.
The price of seven or eight leaves must be much higher. After some bargaining between the two parties, these flower seedlings were finally sold for 520,000 yuan.
Pay a deposit of 50,000 yuan before deduction, and pay cash for the remaining 470,000 yuan.
You know, this year has not yet issued large-denomination banknotes of fifty or one hundred, and the largest is ten yuan.
The 400,000 yuan, if packed in sacks, would take almost two sacks.
Of course the other party would not do such a cheap thing. They packed them in cardboard boxes and pulled them over with a jeep.
"Hurry up, hurry up, get off the board and close the shop, it's closed today."
Su Anying looked at the boxes of money, and without saying a word, directly called for the closure of the business.
Such a big business, so much money, can’t be kept in the store, it must be deposited in the savings bank as soon as possible, even if there are fewer people.
"Chunming, Shengli, Jianshe, Second Brother, just like last time, you guys go directly to the savings bank to deposit the money."
Su Anying hurriedly arranged for someone to go to the savings bank to save money.
"We are waiting here. When it is ready, we will load it here immediately."
It is necessary to confirm that all the money is in order before shipping out, otherwise they will lose a lot.
The heart of defense is indispensable, who knows the identity of the other party?
Anyway, Xu Shiyan told him that all incoming money must be handled in this way.
Fortunately, it was morning and there were not many people in the store. Huang Shengli and others explained to them in a friendly voice, and most of them understood, and turned their heads and left.
After persuading everyone to leave, they hurriedly got off the board and closed the store, leaving Feng Chao, Sun Xiaofeng, Su Anying, and Xu Chenghou in the store to accompany the director.
The rest carried their boxes and went straight to the nearest savings bank.
The other end of the savings bank was also dumbfounded when he saw so much cash, so he hurried to find the director.
The director saw it, well, don’t say anything, closed the business, called all the staff, and transferred people from other savings banks to help, and count them together.
Ten yuan denomination, one bundle is only one thousand yuan, four hundred and seventy thousand, more than four hundred bundles.
In this era when money counting machines were not yet widely used, more than a dozen staff members were busy all afternoon with manual work alone, and the counting was finally completed.
According to Su Anying's intention, the money was saved in four passbooks.
After repeatedly confirming that the money in the account was correct, Zhao Jianshe and others expressed their gratitude to the staff of the savings office before returning to the store.
"Sister-in-law, this is the money just now, 470,000 has been saved."
Zhao Jianshe and others handed over the passbook to Su Anying. After reading it, Su Anying confirmed that there was no problem, and quickly arranged for someone to help load the car.
"Leader, I'm really sorry for keeping you waiting for so long.
No way, I’m a woman, it’s not easy to start a business, I have to be careful, I’m sorry. "
Waiting for all the flowers to be loaded into the car, Su Anying hurriedly apologized to the other party.
After all, it was a waste of time, no matter whether people are angry or not, she must have an attitude there.
Originally, the other party was indeed a little unhappy, but with Su Anying's attitude, it was difficult for him to say anything.
"It's okay, I can understand, after all, this is a business worth hundreds of thousands.
Awesome, seeing that you can do such a big business at such a young age, yes, you are capable. "The other party nodded, got in the car and left.
Sending these people away, everyone heaved a sigh of relief.
"Okay, don't cook at noon today, go to the restaurant to order a few dishes, eat well, and talk about it in the afternoon."
After experiencing these days, Xu Chenghou has also calmed down a lot, and now he speaks directly.
This morning, I was very nervous, and that kind of tiredness made me feel extremely tired from the inside out. I really didn't have the energy to cook again.
So, I ordered food from the restaurant at noon, everyone was full, and they were not willing to rest in the afternoon, and continued to open for business.
The news of a new batch of flower seedlings from Fengying Flower Company spread quickly, and then several people from other factories and mines, as well as Erdao dealers, came to buy them.
Nowadays, the entire provincial capital is going crazy. Many factories, mines and individuals have invested money in the Clivia industry.
Not to mention, those second-hand traffickers, they kept wandering around, unwilling to let go of any opportunity to make a fortune.
The second batch of Clivia was sold out without being used for a week.
In the previous batch, except for those finished big orchids that sold slowly, three or four pots a day, the others also sold a lot.
And, several more customers, placed large orders.
Seeing this, Su Anying wanted to call back and ask Zhou Qingguo to arrange for another two thousand pots to be shipped over.
"Yingzi, how many potted flower seedlings are there left at home?" Xu Chenghou stopped Su Anying and asked her.
"There are still about 7,000 pots left in the house, there are all sizes, what's the matter?" Su Anying asked puzzled.
"You went to tell the orderer that it's hard to find a car at home recently.
If they can go there to see the flowers and find a way to transport them away, we can lower the price. "
Xu Chenghou coughed twice, looked around the store a few times, and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 362: There is an old family
chapters.content:
Chapter 362 There is an old man in the family
"Father, can this be done? Shiyan didn't say it could be done like this."
Su Anying was stunned for a moment, she didn't understand what father-in-law meant, let people know where the flower shed is, okay?
"You don't have to ask anything, just do as I tell you, and I'll tell you what's going on later."
Xu Chenghou waved his hand, signaling Su Anying to do as he said. "By the way, ask them to reserve a deposit of 50,000 yuan."
Xu Shiyan couldn't come forward about the sale of Clivia.
One is that he is studying at school and has no time.
Another, his current name is not small, once this speculative thing is recognized, it will have a bad impact.
So Xu Shiyan explained that Su Anying and Xu Chenghou are in charge of the matter here.
If there is a major event, Su Anying can't make a decision, and all will be arranged by Xu Chenghou.
Her husband had something to say in advance, and Su Anying couldn't question her father-in-law's words, so she went over there and talked with a few customers who ordered.
It was the same as last time, everyone reserved a deposit of 50,000 yuan, and then Su Anying issued them a receipt.
Arrange people to lead the way and lead them to Donggang to choose by themselves. The price is 20 yuan per pot, which is the same as here.
Don’t underestimate the twenty yuan, if it’s one thousand pots, it’s twenty thousand yuan.
It is more than enough to hire any kind of car, and it is definitely worth a trip.
There were five groups of people in total, and three groups of people listened to Su Anying's request, immediately nodded in agreement, and paid the money directly.
One person was still hesitating, while the other left cursing.
The hesitant person finally nodded in agreement.
After all, Fengying Flower Company is as powerful as Fengying Flower Company, and there are not many flower seedlings in large quantities. It would be a pity to miss it.
Just like that, Su Anying collected 50,000 yuan from each person, wrote the receipt by hand, stamped the official seal, and pressed the fingerprint, and then handed over the receipt to the other party.
"Several, discuss how to get there yourself, and I will arrange someone to lead the way."
But whoever does such a big business, how can there be a few idlers? Or a small leader of a factory or mine, or a big boss in business.
Everyone has a solution, so they each bring their cars, money, and people, and prepare to set off.
According to Xu Chenghou's intention, Su Anying arranged for Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli to lead the way back.
It's not dangerous to go back, and they don't bring any money. Even if something happens on the way, those people have to protect them, otherwise where can I buy Clivia?
Besides, the four families have brought a lot of people, even if they do meet a few small thieves, they are not afraid.
Just like that, Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli led the four groups out of the provincial capital and went straight to Fusong.
On the other end, Su Anying called back and asked Zhou Qingguo to take care of these people at home.
No matter how many potted flowers these people buy, the 50,000 yuan on the receipt will be deducted, and the rest will be paid in cash.
As for the price, Su Anying also set a range, which can be sold out.
Zhou Qingguo is a smart person, he immediately understood what was going on, and immediately promised to follow Su Anying's words.
"Father, why do you have to let them go to our house to choose flowers? Let them know our address, okay? Will there be any trouble?"
Until after dinner in the evening, Su Anying couldn't hold back and finally asked.
"Yingzi, tell Dad, among those who came to order today, did some people leave as soon as they heard that a deposit would be charged?"
Xu Chenghou filled a bag of cigarettes and took two puffs before he asked.
"Yes, there is such a person, what's the matter, dad?"
Su Anying was stunned for a moment, recalling that during the day, there was indeed such a person.
"That person, since our store opened, he has come every day. He doesn't buy anything, he just looks around and walks around."
Xu Chenghou put down his cigarette and pot, and looked up at everyone in the room.
Everyone was dumbfounded. There are too many customers coming and going in the store these days, and no one noticed such a person.
"Uncle, what do you mean? We are being targeted?" Everyone was startled, feeling a cool breeze blowing from their backs.
Isn’t it, it’s only been open for a few days, and you’re being targeted?
"Then do we have to call the police or something? Or should we make some preparations?"
Xu Chenghou shook his head, "There's nothing wrong now, and it's useless to call the police, so let's be careful.
I don't think there's anything serious about it recently. The surrounding area of ​​our yard is quite solid, and there are dogs in it. Those people probably don't think it's easy to do it. "
That group of people must have been staring at this place for a long time, and they didn't make a move, probably because they found it difficult to handle.
It's also because there aren't too many stocks in the store these days, so it's not worth doing it.
"I'm afraid that someone has figured out the delivery rules in our store.
Among other things, if someone really figured it out, they would sneak in at night when our shipment arrives, or would they just lead someone in if they encountered a ruthless person?
Otherwise, they hijacked our car transporting Clivia on the way, what can we do? "
Xu Chenghou's age, what things have not been experienced?
To put it bluntly, he almost went up the mountain to become a beard back then. Can you hide the little tricks played by these little thieves from him?
"So, you just said, let those merchants go to Donggang to see the goods? But what if those people also follow the vines?"
Yang Chunming's faces turned pale, isn't this too scary?
"The other end? Huh, that's our territory.
We are in the provincial capital, we must keep a low profile and not be too arrogant, we just try to make money safely.
But if those people come to our territory, they will be coiled up if they are dragons, and they will be lying down if they are tigers. "
Xu Chenghou just finished smoking a bag of cigarettes, knocked the pot of the cigarette bag, and sneered.
"What does Zhou Qingguo do? The Minister of Armed Forces, the Director of Security, and those militiamen are idle to eat?
Cut, if the township and the village want to benefit, then they should work hard. Is the money taken for nothing?
Besides, there is Limin Lixin, Lixin is the director of the Shenchang police station. Now, the Han family also gets a share. They don't work? "
Han Limin returned to Donggang from the capital a few days ago.
After all, he still has a job. He is so busy attending the field in autumn, Xu Shiyan and Li Chengrong come to study, and Han Limin is the leader of the technical department. He has to come back.
Leave Li Yuexiu and Xu Shiqin to take care of Han Liwei, that's all.
With Zhou Qingguo and the Han brothers, the farm employs more than a dozen bums, guns, militiamen and people from the police station, don’t you believe that a few petty thieves dare to attack?
In contrast, Xu Chenghou is more worried about being caught in the right pattern and hijacking the car halfway, that is the most dangerous.
Therefore, Xu Chenghou gave advice, let the merchants choose by themselves, and ship back by themselves.
Before Zhao Jianshe and the others left, Xu Chenghou also told the customers to go back when the time came, and asked them to follow them back to transport some.
Along the way, we also have to take care of each other, and there are more people in the car.
"These few people can buy almost two or three thousand pots.
For the rest, if there are still people who want a lot, let’s do this again, in this store.
In the future, we will mainly sell large flower seedlings, and retail them outside, so don’t store too much. "

chapters.title: Chapter 363: burglar
chapters.content:
Chapter 363 A thief
Su Anying and the others were frightened by Xu Chenghou's words, and they all felt like they were chilling from the bottom of their hearts.
It seems that this money is really not easy to earn. If there is a trouble, something will happen.
"Cut, are you afraid of a ball?
We have many people, guns and dogs. If anyone dares to come in, I will kill him with one shot. "
Xu Shian came up again in a daze, and slapped the table, which shocked everyone, but also regained everyone's courage.
"That's right, what the second brother said is right, afraid of him getting a ball?
We are not scared too much, we have killed wild animals in the mountains, how many people are we afraid of?
There really were those little thieves who dared to come in, so I shot them one by one. "Yang Chunming followed up.
"Yes, yes, what are we afraid of if we go all out? Whoever dares to move our minds must let him know how powerful we are."
After all, he is a man from the Northeast, how can he not be bloody? Such a sum of money, even if you work hard, you have to protect it.
"At night, I'm still on duty in shifts. Be alert and sleep with a gun in your arms. If there is any movement and it really doesn't work, give him a shot first."
Just like that, the big guys went to rest separately, and they didn’t even take off their clothes at night, and they really slept with their guns in their arms.
The same goes for the dogs outside, they were all scattered, letting them run around the yard.
These are dogs that have hunted in the mountains, and they are ruthless.
Someone really came in, as long as the leading dog made a sound, the others could be torn up by the prey?
Big wild boar and black blind man have been bitten, are you still afraid of people?
Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli took people back to Donggang to see and buy flowers, which would definitely take longer than sending them directly from home, and it would take three or four days to go back and forth.
Here in the provincial capital, the store is open as usual, and there are still many people coming in and out to buy flowers every day.
But there are no more seedlings in the store, and the big flowers are not selling fast, only a dozen pots a day.
After all, it is too expensive, few people can afford it.
Su Anying is not in a hurry, anyway, the house has been rented for four months, so let’s sell it slowly.
Until the afternoon of the fourth day, Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli returned to the provincial capital with their people.
This time, a thousand pots of medium-sized seedlings with six or seven leaves were brought over.
"Sister-in-law, those four groups bought a total of 3,500 pots of flowers, and the Qing Kingdom has accurate accounts for the exact amount they sold.
There are not many seedlings with three or five leaves left in our house, so the ones we brought this time are slightly larger ones. "
As soon as he entered the door, Zhao Jianshe hurriedly reported to Su Anying.
Su Anying made a quick calculation in her mind.
In the past few years, including the flower shed at the farm, plus the three houses of Xu Shiyan’s family, and the window sills of each household, they have only cultivated ten thousand or hundreds of trees.
About 1,200 trees were transported the first time, 2,000 trees the second time, and 3,500 trees were brought over this time.
Zhao Jianshe and the others brought over a thousand trees, and it is estimated that there are less than two thousand and less than three thousand trees left in the family.
According to this speed, almost all the small and medium seedlings can be sold before New Year's Day.
Only those big ones are left, and the shipment is slow. But the big ones also make money, and a pot can be tens of thousands or thousands, so take it slow.
"Okay, let's unload the Huadu and move it in first. Be careful not to freeze."
The store has really run out of stock these days, so I quickly unloaded the thousand pots and put them on.
Following the militiamen who came to **** the car, this time they arranged a dozen or so, all carrying semi-automatic vehicles.
At this moment, everyone started working together, and quickly moved Clivia into a warm room.
Xu Chenghou called Huang Shengli over, gave him a few instructions, and then Huang Shengli led the driver and the militiamen to dinner.
After eating, arrange people to rest in the guest house.
Another thousand pots of flower seedlings were sent, everyone's heart was tense, their hearts were not at ease, and they dared not sleep well at night.
The first half of the night was Xu Shian and Feng Chaoxuan, and the second half of the night was Yang Chunming and Sun Xiaofeng.
At half past one in the middle of the night, Yang Chunming felt anxious and went out to use the bathroom.
He was just about to open the door and enter the house with a gun in his hand, when he suddenly heard a slap behind him, as if something fell to the ground.
At the end of October, there was only one tick left of the moon in the sky, and it was so dark that I couldn't see anything clearly.
Yang Chunming followed the sound, touched it silently, and picked up two steamed buns from the ground.
Deep-fried steamed buns are very fragrant, and there seems to be meat in them. For dogs, they are definitely delicious.
If you want to talk about other things, Yang Chunming may not know it, but Yang Chunming is very familiar with this stuff.
He has been hunting with Xu Shiyan for many years, how can he not understand this trick?
It can be seen that there is an expert outside. Deep-fried steamed buns are filled with medicinal beans. If a dog eats these steamed buns, he will be poisoned and die soon.
The dog is dead, and if there is no warning, people outside can sneak in and steal Clivia.
Yang Chunming sneered inwardly. This trick is okay against ordinary dogs, but against well-trained hunting dogs? What are you kidding?
The dogs of these families have long developed the habit of not being fed meat by anyone except the people they recognize.
Not to mention the things on the ground, they don’t even touch them. Didn’t you see that those dogs were all lying in the nest, not moving at all?
Relying on Xujiatou dog Xiaohuang's scented head, it smelled the thing as soon as it hit the ground.
But up to now, Xiao Huang didn't even move, just didn't like it at all.
Yang Chunming picked up the steamed buns, went back to the door lightly, opened the door gently and entered the house, and woke up all the people living in the house.
Everyone got up quietly and hid in the dark of the courtyard.
Outside, a few black shadows were waiting under the wall.
They had to wait until the dogs in the yard ate the steamed buns and the toxicity took hold before they could go down.
If it is normal, you can climb up the wall and take a look inside.
But this house is too dilapidated, the walls are full of glass shards and barbed wire, there is no way to go up to see, so they can only wait outside.
After about ten or twenty minutes, the leader reckoned that it was almost the same.
With a wave of their hands, several people quickly formed a human ladder, climbed to the top of the gate, and entered from here.
There is no other way, no one can get in, and no one dares to go up the wall. The roof was afraid of making noise that would wake up the people in the house, so it could only go through the gate.
The gatehouse of this gate is connected to the roof of the house, with no gap in between.
This group of people should be used to stealing, their movements were light and quick, and they climbed to the roof in a few strokes.
Then go down a few ropes, the person grabs the ropes and slides down, finally jumps lightly, and lands.
Up to this point, everything went smoothly, and there was no movement at all.
Several people gestured to each other, and they were about to approach the house to the north.
As a result, just as they moved, several shadows suddenly appeared from the darkness.
With a sip, he bit the leader's **** directly, and the painful man groaned.
It was Xiao Huang who came out to attack silently.
This dog is not only good-looking and ruthless, but also very clever. He is good at hunting and watching ginseng.
This dog is very smart. When hunting, it knows how to invite its partners to go with it. It doesn’t matter if it bites people. It likes to sneak up and kill people.
When Xu Chenghou was looking at ginseng on the mountain, once a thief went in, and Xiao Huang went up without saying a word and took a bite.

chapters.title: Chapter 364: are crazy
chapters.content:
Chapter 364 is crazy
Xiao Huang is a dog that digs the back door. No matter what kind of prey it faces, it will definitely bite the back at the first bite, and it will be ruthless.
This means wearing thick clothes in winter, with cotton trousers, otherwise, what effect would it have if the mouth is not even?
Humans are different from wild boars, so they are not so accurate.
Even so, the bitten person was still yelling and sweating in the cold weather.
After Xiao Huang bit the man hard, he began to scream.
Then, the other dogs jumped at me too.
Hunting dogs are no joke. Nine dogs went up and surrounded those people and started biting them.
Now, there was a lot of screaming in the yard, and without waiting for Yang Chunming and the others to make a move, the little thieves were almost eaten by dogs.
Yang Chunming whistled, and the dogs backed away.
Those little thieves were bitten badly. They struggled to get up and looked up, and immediately felt that their pants were wet.
Holy shit, this family not only has a dog, but also a gun.
A dozen or so guns, with their black muzzles pointed at them, frightened a few little thieves to pee.
"The good man spares his life, the good man spares his life." Several people knelt on the ground in fright, begging for mercy.
"Cut, with just this little courage, you dare to come here and steal things?"
On the other end, Huang Shengli glanced at these people and shook his head with contempt.
I can see that now all the cats and dogs in this city are starting to be dishonest, and these few dare to come and steal Clivia.
"It's not that they are timid, they are scared.
Xiao Huang's dogs are too ruthless. These city people, have they ever seen such ruthless dogs? "
Yang Chunming smiled, stepped forward and kicked those people twice.
"Grandma, you dare to break into anything, right?
Don’t even think about it, we dare to open a shop in the provincial capital to sell Clivia, do we have no skills?
See it? These dozens of guns didn't shoot directly just now, they beat you into sieves, so you can pick them up. "
Xu Chenghou had guessed a long time ago that this side was already being watched.
So after unloading the car in the afternoon, Huang Shengli took the militiamen to eat and stay in the hotel on the surface. In fact, they just shot a feint, and they all lived in while no one was paying attention.
There are so many people guarding, let alone these four or five little thieves, a few more can be easily beaten to the ground.
The five thieves were all pinned down and none of them managed to escape. They were **** with ropes and stuffed into the unused room at the north end of the West Wing.
Don’t alert the police at the police station at night. The security situation in the city is not very good recently, and they are busy enough. Let’s talk about it during the day.
Although they caught five of them, they didn't dare to be careless, and they still kept people on duty in the second half of the night.
Until seven o'clock in the morning, Yang Chunming took the men and sent the thieves to the police station.
Recently, the police stations in the provincial capital are very busy.
Because of Clivia, theft and robbery happened from time to time.
A younger brother was in charge of borrowing money from his elder brother. He happened to see Clivia. In order to **** Clivia, he hacked his sister-in-law to death with an axe.
There was another man in the neighboring province who learned that Clivia was valuable, and led his younger brother with a gun, and drove over to **** it.
Anyway, there are all kinds of things, and there are troubles everywhere.
So Yang Chunming and the others sent the thief there, and they didn't have time to worry about that end. They just put on the bracelet and squatted in the corner to wait for it to be dealt with.
Yang Chunming simply makes a record here, and then he can go back.
Although a few thieves were caught, the shop did not affect it at all.
As soon as the door opened in the morning, many people poured in, and the store suddenly became busy.
There is an endless stream of people who choose Clivia. Most of them buy small trees. The ones with three or five leaves are sold out as soon as they come out, and many people choose the ones with seven or eight leaves.
Many people pay directly without even talking about the price.
Su Anying and others collected money to settle the accounts, and at the same time put a plastic bag on the Clivia flower pot to keep out the cold.
The plastic bags were made by the daughter-in-law of Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli, cut out of polyvinyl chloride plastic film made of ginseng and put on an iron.
The ginseng film is relatively thick, and it can be placed on the flower pot to prevent the Clivia from being damaged by freezing.
Although Xu Shiyan has been attending classes at school, news of disturbances outside can also reach the school.
Hearing about the chaos outside, Xu Shiyan was also worried about the flower company, so he hurried over to have a look at the weekend.
Xu Shiyan was also a little scared when he learned that thieves had broken in at night.
Fortunately, he chose this yard at the beginning. Anyway, it is in the city center, and the security is not bad.
Moreover, the yard is neat enough, and they took stricter precautions so that no major accidents would happen.
If this was in a small village in the suburbs, I'm afraid it wasn't a thief who came in to steal it. If there was trouble, someone would come and rob it directly.
"If there are still a large number of wholesales, don't be too aggressive about the price, sell them early to save worry.
I feel that the entire provincial capital is going crazy now, let’s sell it as soon as possible, and it’s important to go home for the New Year. "
Xu Shiyan told Su Anying secretly, let her accept it as soon as she sees a deal, don't be too greedy, it is serious to sell it out early and go home.
They are indeed crazy. Today's Clivia has become a hard currency comparable to gold.
It is said that someone held a pot of Clivia and went directly to the store to change a TV. People call Clivia a green gold bar.
But Xu Shiyan knew that all of this was just a bubble, and when the bubble burst next summer, there would only be a chicken feather left.
They must withdraw as soon as possible, and they must not get involved and sink deeper and deeper.
"Don't worry, I know what's going on. In the current situation, I can't wait to sell out and leave.
We are worried all day long, and we dare not sleep at night. "
Su Anying understands better than Xu Shiyan, she guards the shop here all day long, and often arranges people to visit other flower shops to check the market.
She knows more about the current situation than Xu Shiyan.
"Everyone has worked hard, keep going, we will go home and share the money after selling."
No matter how hard you work, when you think of the money, you don't feel much better.
Money is not easy to earn. These days, they earn money that others can't earn in their entire lives. Isn't it normal to be worried?
What are you afraid of? Go all out and fight hard, and you can always stick to it by gritting your teeth.
The militiamen who came to **** the car were all acquaintances, and Su Anying decided to stay behind.
There were enough people in the store, so Su Anying sent Huang Shengli and others to go to various flower companies and flower and tree shops to inquire about news and keep abreast of the market.
If they meet big customers, they will also let them contact in private and tell them that Fengying Flower Company can wholesale Clivia seedlings in large quantities.
This operation really worked, and a few days later, another group of people gathered together.
Still follow the previous path, pay the reservation payment here, and then arrange for someone to lead the car back to load the goods.
This time, those at home were all covered by a few people.
It is said that those few people almost fought in order to grab the goods.
In the end, it was Zhou Qingguo and Han Lixin who mobilized the militia to suppress it.
A few days later, I heard that a car loaded with Clivia was robbed on the road leading to the provincial capital somewhere.
There was a fierce fight between the two sides, and it is said that both sides fired guns.
Anyway, what the people in the rumors said had a nose and eyes, Su Anying and others were thrilled to hear it, but fortunately they were not the ones who were robbed.
Don’t worry about it, anyway, the Clivia at home is sold out, and now there are only these left in the store, which are decreasing every day.
The big guy looked at the increasingly empty room, and heaved a sigh of relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 365: Why go back?
chapters.content:
Chapter 365 Why go back?
Clivia seedlings are easy to handle, but it takes a lot of effort. After all, not everyone has the strength to spend thousands of dollars on flowers.
Erdao dealers also think that big flowers are too expensive, and there are few buyers, so they tend to be backlogged in their hands, which is not as convenient as small seedlings.
Those who can afford big flowers are mostly big businessmen who have heard the news.
For example, a Hong Kong businessman who exchanged a crown for a phoenix crown failed to buy the treasure of the store from the Phoenix Crown Flower Company, but was fooled by Huang Shengli.
Picked away two pots of big victories and one pot of yellow technicians, and got 80,000 yuan.
There was also a wealthy businessman from Harbin who picked up 140,000 Clivias in one go, all of which were rare varieties.
Anyway, these days, everyone has seen what it means to be rich and powerful.
I used to think that the deer antlers that can earn 10,000 a season in a farm would be so beautiful, but now I see that the deer that can be fed for a year can’t keep up with the price of a pot of Clivia.
Fortunately, with Xu Shiyan talking in front of everyone from time to time, everyone can remain calm and rational.
We all know that the prosperity in front of us is just artificially inflated, which is not normal.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan and Xu Chenghou are at the helm, and everyone agrees, that is, sell Clivia as soon as possible, so that everyone can go home and share the money for the New Year.
