In a blink of an eye, December seemed to be over, and there were only three or five pots of ordinary large flower seedlings left in the store. Su Anying gritted her teeth and sold them cheaply.
All Clivias are sold short, everyone can finally breathe a sigh of relief.
But next, there is another problem, how do they go back?
Miscellaneous things can be thrown away, but these seven or eight people, nine dogs, and so many clothes and luggage, why go back?
Not only these, but also money, which is not easy to handle.
Although most of the flower seedlings are sold at home, the big flowers here are worth a lot.
Su Anying did the math, Xu Shiqin's big flowers alone sold for more than 1.7 million.
Combining the money from the sale of the seedlings, tax deductions, and seven or eight hundred thousand in cash in the store, there are nearly three million in the savings bank.
What is the concept of three million? It is packed in sacks, which can hold ten sacks.
So much money is stored in the savings bank, let’s take it all out, let’s not talk about it, how can they go back with more than a dozen big bags of money?
You can’t take cash with you, and now you can’t deposit and withdraw money in other places. Passbooks can only be used here, and it’s not easy to go back.
I have no choice but to remit money through the bank, but this is also limited, there is a limit per day, and the transfer to the account is very slow, and the handling fee is quite high.
Everyone is worried, and they don't know what to do, so they can only wait for Xu Shiyan to come over and discuss together.
"We still have to remit money, and we can't take cash back. No matter how slow the remittance is, it is safer than taking it back with us.
So, I called Qingguo and asked him, Limin, Lixin, and Zongliang to come to the provincial capital. I have something to discuss with them. "
Xu Shiyan pondered for a while, and found a solution, but Zhou Qingguo and the others had to come over.
Zhao Jianshe and others have always followed Xu Shiyan's lead. They will listen to what Xu Shiyan says, so no matter what Xu Shiyan arranges, they will agree.
So he immediately called Zhou Qingguo, Han Limin and the others, asking them, Han Lixin and Li Zongliang to come to the provincial capital as soon as possible.
Zhou Qingguo came here with his family's account book, and happened to be here. Everyone check the accounts, calculate dividends and so on.
Xu Shiqin’s sale of more than 90 Clivia trees is not included.
Just talking about the 10,000 Clivia seedlings, including retail and wholesale, sold a total of more than 5.5 million.
Various costs, taxes, remittance fees, etc. will be deducted in the middle, and it is estimated that there will be 5.12 million left in the end.
It was agreed at the beginning, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Zhou Qingguo, Feng Chao, Sun Xiaofeng, Huang Shengli, Han Limin, they will hold half of the shares.
That is to say, almost each of these seven people can share more than 300,000 yuan.
"That's it, transfer 200,000 yuan to each of your seven accounts first.
Shiqin’s account was remitted 500,000 yuan, and my account was 500,000 yuan. "
In this way, 2.4 million is remitted, and the rest of the savings can be withdrawn.
"Qingguo, I remember when you were in the army, you knew how to drive, right?" Xu Shiyan turned his head and asked Zhou Qingguo.
"Huh?" Zhou Qingguo was stunned for a moment, "Oh, yes, I have driven a car before, and I know how to drive." Zhou Qingguo was a little confused, not knowing what Xu Shiyan meant.
"Okay, that's it, I'll find someone tomorrow, let's find a way to buy two cars and go back.
You can drive, and Lixin and Zongliang can also drive. Get two cars to drive back, just to load all our things here. "
Xu Shiyan had already thought about it. If he had the money, he would buy two cars first, not for showing off, but for the convenience of work.
Whether it’s a farm or a farmer’s own farm, you can’t always find someone else’s car to transport something or something. You can buy a car yourself, which is convenient to use.
"Shall we buy a car? How much will it cost?" Everyone was dumbfounded when they heard this.
Buying a car? Never dared to think about it before. But now, let alone, it seems that there is really no problem.
"I have inquired about it. Dongfeng Automobile Factory in the province has released a new double-cab passenger and cargo light vehicle.
Imported engines for a whole vehicle cost 28,000, and domestic engines cost 18,500.
Imported engines for three types of chassis, 19,500, and domestic engines for three types of chassis, 12,600. "
Double-cab seats are used for both passenger and cargo, which is more convenient than a big car. Anyway, he thinks this is very good. It is convenient to transport some materials to Shendi, and there is still room for people to sit.
Yang Chunming's eyes lit up when they heard it, "Third brother, are there two cars missing?
Since Qingguo, Lixin, and Zongliang all know how to drive, let’s have three cars, and the money counts for us.
We are rich now, not to mention anything else, it is convenient for two families to use one. A few of us will learn how to drive when we go back, so there is no problem in keeping them. "
Men, few can resist the temptation to get a car.
The ginseng land they acquired this year is in the Kaifeng Fork Road, nearly 30 miles away from home.
If there is a car here, why is it a hundred times better than the carriages of other companies? How good is it to transport curtains and plastic sheets to the mountains in spring?
Get it up in one trip, if it takes a carriage to go back and forth several times.
It will be convenient when you start to participate in the future. A stick of thirty or fifty feet, and a thousand catties, can be pulled back in one cart. It takes several trips to put the carriage.
They also have money now, the money is so easy to come by, everyone has no idea, why not spend it to buy something, how good is it?
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, sure enough, money is a man's guts.
When you have money, your waist is hard, and you can buy a car worth 10,000 to 20,000 yuan.
"Okay, leave this matter to me, and I will find someone to handle it when I go back.
Let’s just make a deal like this. Tomorrow, I’ll send money first. I’ll find someone here to find a way to buy a car.
Guys, if you have nothing to do, you can also go for a stroll.
Having been in the provincial capital for so long, I guess I haven't been able to take a good look around.
It’s been a long time since I’ve been out, and it will be Chinese New Year in another month, so I have to bring something home for my family. "
It's over, there is something wrong with the background, I made a mistake.

chapters.title: Chapter 366: love to buy what to buy
chapters.content:
Chapter 366 Buy whatever you like
As Xu Shiyan said, he winked at Su Anying. Su Anying understood, and immediately dragged a large bag over and put it on the table.
"In this way, the family will get 10,000 yuan first, and they can buy whatever they like.
Don’t cherish money, we have money now, we can spend it when we need it.
As long as you don’t go out to play money, don’t look for women, I don’t care how you spend it. "
That pocket was full of money, bundles of great unity, all new.
There are ten bundles in one stack, exactly eight stacks, and Xu Shiyan distributes them to the big guys one by one.
"Second brother, the ten thousand is yours. I will calculate with you when I get back, how much should I give you."
The second brother has been busy with him for so long, so he also gets a share.
But the exact amount, I have to go home, and Xu Shiyan will talk about it after he has calculated the accounts.
"Huh? And mine? Oh, no, no, I'm still paid. Why do you give me so much money?"
Xu Shian glanced at the stack of money, startled, ten thousand yuan? Oh my god, isn't that too much?
He didn’t invest any money in it, he just kept busy and gave him 10,000 yuan, which was too much.
"Third brother, you don't have to do this. You see, they all invested money in Jianjian, and they should share the shares.
We are two brothers, I just help you with a little work, you give me so much? don't. "
Xu Shian didn't dare to reach out to take it, despite making so much money these days, Xu Shian is also greedy, but not jealous.
How much money was invested in the flower shed at the beginning, and how Zhao Jianshe and others contributed, Xu Shi'an watched with his own eyes.
He didn't invest any money in it, he just helped out these days, but he didn't have the face to take so much.
"Second brother, you have a part here, but it's better to build them." Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this.
"This is what my father said, take it for you."
In front of so many people, Xu Shiyan didn't mention the fact that his younger sister asked his brother to pay for the operation, but only said that Xu Chenghou had spoken.
On the other end, Xu Chenghou also followed suit, "The third child gives it to you, you take it, don't care how much it is, it's the bond between you brothers.
You have been tired of following the busy schedule these days, so take it and buy something for the two children at home. "
The old man actually wanted to say, don’t give all the money to the daughter-in-law, lest the second daughter-in-law always go to her mother’s house.
But he glanced at Zhao Jianshe and the others next to him, and remained silent.
No matter what you say, in front of so many people, you have to save some face for your son.
Waiting for no one to come, but you have to teach your second child a lesson, don’t be so stupid as to hand over all the money you earn to the family.
People say that men are rakes for money, and women are boxes for money.
Xu Shian's rake can hug, but it can't support Wei Mingrong's box, which has no bottom to leak. It's not okay to live at home.
If it were Xu Shiyan and Su Anying, Xu Chenghou wouldn't say a word.
Xu Shian looked at the money on the table, and it would be pure nonsense to say that he was not moved.
Who doesn't care about seeing money? Those who don't care about money are fools.
"Father, you let me take this." Xu Shi'an smiled and hugged the money.
"Okay, everyone has collected all the money, so what should we do tomorrow.
Tonight, just eat some food and stop drinking. With so much money, drinking is a waste of time. "
After distributing the money, Su Anying re-locked the half-deflated bag in the cabinet, and then went to cook for everyone.
Here, when Xu Shiyan was chatting with Han Limin and Zhou Qingguo, he couldn't help but ask about Han Liwei's situation and whether there was any major family affairs.
"Liwei is okay, I can already go for a walk when I come back, I guess I will be discharged from the hospital a year ago.
He seems to have reported to his superiors that he wants to go home to recuperate, mainly to get married.
Anyway, we don’t know what’s going on at the border. I listened to it occasionally. Anyway, his leader said that he should go home and heal his injuries first, and he doesn’t need to return to the team for the time being. "Han Limin talked about Han Liwei's situation.
"Uncle Xu, don't worry, Liwei is not missing an arm or a leg, he is still whole.
He was seriously injured. It is said that a lot of bullets and shrapnel were taken out of his body, and he underwent two operations later, also to remove the shrapnel.
I'm much better now, don't worry, I won't delay getting married. "Han Limin was afraid that Xu Chenghou might misunderstand, so he quickly explained.
Knowing that Han Liwei's body has recovered and he is fine, not to mention Xu Chenghou, even Xu Shiyan was relieved.
"If you survive a catastrophe, you will have blessings, well, as long as you live well.
Hurry up and get married. The marriage of these two people is also full of disasters. If it weren't for these things, their children would have run all over the place. "
Xu Chenghou was very happy, took a puff of cigarette, and sighed.
"Our place is okay, and the honey chip production is going smoothly.
It is estimated that before New Year's Day, all orders will be produced and ready to be shipped.
The other end of the beverage factory officially started production at the end of October.
Don’t tell me, we found that Quanyang, and it doesn’t freeze in winter, and the water keeps flowing out, so it doesn’t delay our production in winter.
The current output is not too high, mainly because the market has not yet been opened, and the production line of the beverage factory has not dared to produce at full capacity. "
Han Limin is now the leader of the technical department, and he knows these things best.
"By the way, our ginseng flower cola, ginseng cola, and ginseng honey slices all passed the provincial technical appraisal a while ago.
Our Changbai Mountain red ginseng, red straight beard, and ginseng honey slices were also rated as high-quality products by the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation and were awarded a certificate of honor.
Changbai Mountain red ginseng won the special prize of provincial scientific and technological progress. "
Speaking of this, Han Limin was full of pride. This is the glory of everyone in the technical department and the best affirmation for them.
"There is still a certificate for you. It is with Secretary Lin. I will give it to you after you go back."
Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard the words, "It's pretty good, we're proud to participate this time."
These awards represent that the ginseng industry deep processing plan participated in the field has been affirmed by the superior leaders, which proves that the way of deep processing and fine processing proposed by Xu Shiyan has a prospect.
This is what Xu Shiyan wants to see the most.
"Qingguo, is there nothing going on at home? The provincial capital was very noisy a while ago, what about at home? How is our house?"
After asking about the field, of course, I also have to care about the farm and the flower shed.
Although the flowers have been sold out, it is necessary to know what happened so that Xu Shiyan can go back and discuss with Secretary Chen what to do next.
"There is no stopping at our house. After October, some people started harvesting Clivia.
Do you know how much we sold a Clivia flower in the later stage? For a few bucks, I thought those people were crazy. "
Zhou Qingguo didn't see the scene of people in the provincial capital buying Clivia madly. He thought that the noise in Songjiang River was quite serious.
"After the flower seedlings were sold for the first time in our flower shed, people have been following them.
Songjianghe's group of gangsters were all taking aim. One night, more than a dozen people were about to charge into the farm with axes and machetes.
Lixin and I made preparations in advance. We took the militiamen and made arrangements in advance. We held down all the gangsters and sent them to the police station.
Since then, things have subsided quite a bit. "
Zhou Qingguo said it lightly, but in fact, the situation at that time was also quite tense.
Fortunately, more than a dozen militiamen were arranged to guard the flower shed. When Chen Jianzhang spoke, even the mountain cannons went to the farm. Otherwise, how could those people be restrained?

chapters.title: Chapter 367: big purchase
chapters.content:
Chapter 367 Big Purchase
Even if Zhou Qingguo didn't say anything, Xu Shiyan could still guess.
"This time, Secretary Chen has given us great support.
After I go back, I will talk to Secretary Chen. All the militiamen who have contributed can not lose money to others. "
Without the support and help from the township and the village, Baobuqi Xu Shiyan was busy working in the provincial capital, and his hometown in Donggang was copied.
So gratitude is a must, but how to get the most reasonable and useful money needs to be considered.
While talking, Su Anying prepared a meal and brought it up. Everyone had dinner together, and no one drank.
There is still a lot of money in the store now, so don't be careless.
After dinner, everyone got together and chatted for a while before going to rest.
Fortunately, Clivia has been sold out, and the thieves were caught last time, and the police force has recently been increased in the provincial capital.
So the night was fairly peaceful, and there were no little thieves making plans.
Xu Shiyan stayed here for one night, and went back to school the next day. He asked his classmates to help him contact Dongfeng Motor Factory.
In the name of the farm, they intend to purchase three new passenger and cargo light vehicles from Dongfeng Motor Factory.
Xu Shiyan originally wanted to buy a type of imported engine for a complete vehicle, but was told that it was out of stock and only the domestic engine was available.
In desperation, Xu Shiyan could only agree.
Just like that, two days later, Xu Shiyan took Zhou Qingguo, Han Lixin, and Li Zongliang to Dongfeng Automobile Factory and brought out three brand new light vehicles.
In order to facilitate the return of goods, Xu Shiyan also asked others to buckle the canvas awning on the car.
In this way, on the way back, those dogs will not be frozen.
This kind of light vehicle is very popular, and many places rush to buy it. The farm is an individual unit, and the car factory originally had no unplanned quota.
At least because of Xu Shiyan's classmate's face, he not only sold the car to Xu Shiyan, but also equipped him with a canvas awning and other things according to Xu Shiyan's request.
The other party confiscated too much money, and in the end they even bought a car and took away favors. The three cars cost a little more than 56,000 yuan, and finally got them.
Xu Shiyan's purchase of a car went smoothly, but Su Anying's transfer of money was very troublesome.
Nowadays, most people still use the post office to send remittances, sending tens of dollars at a time, and hundreds of dollars at most.
Su Anying wants to remit millions of dollars, the post office definitely can't do it, and the savings bank doesn't have the ability to do it, so she has to go to the provincial bank to handle it.
The money deposited in the savings bank will be transferred to the provincial bank through relevant procedures, and then apply for a money order from the provincial bank.
After passing the review, fill in the draft power of attorney, and after the review is correct, handle the transfer or receive some cash.
Issuing and cashing banks make settlement through the accounts of "Combined Bank Transaction" and "Outward Remittance".
Subsidiary transactions are generally mailed, and banks have special co-bank envelopes.
But this method is very slow, and in order to prevent loss, the bank name and bank number of the cashing bank are usually filled in on the money order.
The limit for issuing money orders is 200,000 yuan. If the limit is exceeded, the procedures will be even more troublesome.
Not only must the bank name and bank number of the designated cashing bank in the place of cashing be filled out on the bill of exchange, but at the same time, the issuing bank must send a verification telegram to the cashing bank in the prescribed format on the same day.
Su Anying had to transfer more than two million yuan in total. She went back and forth several times to the savings bank and the provincial bank alone, and then had to review various procedures at the provincial bank.
It ran for three or four days and didn't finish it. Later, Xu Shiyan asked someone to find a way, and the provincial bank successfully remitted the money.
Moreover, it can only be remitted to the county bank, not to the savings bank in Songjianghe.
After working so hard for five or six days, Su Anying finally let out a sigh of relief after remitting the money.
So taking advantage of Xu Shiyan's holiday, Su Anying led Xu Chenghou and Xu Shian to the hospital for a physical examination.
Don't look at Xu Chenghou bragging and staring at his son, but he values ​​Su Anying, his daughter-in-law, very much.
The daughter-in-law is full of filial piety, and she persuades her in every possible way. Besides, now that she has money in her hands, she should go for a check-up.
Just like that, the father and son went to the Medical University Hospital for an examination. After a complete set of examinations, Xu Chenghou had a little high blood pressure, but it was not too serious.
The doctor prescribed some medicine, and instructed Xu Chenghou to pay more attention to his diet and less anger.
Xu Shian's body was fine, especially his stomach, and nothing abnormal was found.
Knowing the test results, Xu Shiyan was naturally the happiest.
As long as there is nothing wrong with it, be more careful in the future, his second brother should be fine this time.
Bought the car and remitted the money, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shian checked their bodies and found nothing serious.
By this time, Su Anying finally got in the mood and started to make big purchases.
After all, it is a provincial capital and has everything. Apart from buying books, toys for the children, clothes and shoes for the New Year, what Su Anying wants to buy the most are home appliances.
Xu Shiyan's award-winning TV is at his parents' side, and the washing machine is reserved for Xu Shiqin's dowry. The couple have nothing.
Su Anying thought about buying a set for herself.
Nowadays, these home appliances still require a ticket, and they are supplied by ticket.
If you are in Songjianghe or Fusong, you really can’t do anything, but this is in the provincial capital. As long as the money is in place, it is not difficult to buy anything.
At the entrance of those department stores, there are special ticket counters, as long as you pay, you can get any ticket.
So, Su Anying bought the color TV, washing machine, and refrigerator.
Zhao Jianshe and the others looked at it, and it was still my sister-in-law who knew how to buy things.
After thinking about it, these people think that anyway, they have money in their hands, so what to buy during the Chinese New Year will not be able to keep up with adding a few big things to the family for comfort.
How beautiful is it to watch TV at home during the Chinese New Year?
Every Chinese New Year, the daughter-in-law is very tired from washing the sheets and so on. Get a washing machine to go home and throw it in the washing machine to stir it up. It's so worry-free.
Just like that, several of them followed Su Anying's example and searched for tickets at the entrances of various stores, and then went to buy appliances.
Xu Shiyan gave everyone 10,000 yuan, which is enough to open up the flowers.
So, every family bought a color TV and a washing machine. As for the refrigerator, they didn't buy it.
It’s winter in Northeast China, it’s colder than a refrigerator outside, what can’t be frozen, why do you need a refrigerator?
I bought the car at a loss, but the big guy bought it freely now, and all kinds of things were pulled back as if they didn’t need money.
When people go back to buy things like this, the neighbors nearby must be able to see it, and many people are discussing behind their backs.
"Look, how can I say they are country bumpkins. They all have money and don't know how to burn buns. They go back and buy them all day long."
"Isn't that right? They have made money, and a pot of Clivia can be sold for tens of thousands. If you have money, why don't you spend it?
Oh, nouveau riche is nouveau riche, petty, rich, I don’t know how to make a fuss. "
Zhao Jianshe and others didn't know what the neighbors were talking about behind their backs, and even if they knew, they didn't care.
how? They can spend the money they earn on their own merits as they like, without disturbing others.
As Xu Shiyan said, as long as they don’t play with money, don’t court women, and don’t do things that violate the law and discipline, who can control how they spend their money?
What do you do if you have money and don’t spend it? Baby?
I clearly set the schedule last night, but somehow it was all messed up. Alas, the order of the two chapters in the middle is wrong, so I’ll ask the editor to call it back during the day.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: go home
chapters.content:
Chapter 368 Go home
January 10th, the special training class finished the final exam and had a holiday. Li Chengrong and Xiao Peng also finished the exam on the 11th.
The big guys have almost bought everything they should buy. After discussing, they decided to leave together on the 12th and drive back.
Xu Shiyan also found the owner of the originally rented yard, and moved out of the house ahead of schedule.
At the beginning, Xu Shiyan was really tempted to buy the yard.
He found the owner and wanted to discuss with him about buying and releasing the house. As a result, the owner opened his mouth and asked for 50,000 yuan.
Fifty thousand dollars? Right now, even 50,000 yuan can buy two courtyard houses in the capital.
This is just a provincial capital, not a first-tier big city. For 50,000 yuan, you can buy three yards like this now.
Xu Shiyan was curious about the orderliness of the yard, and it was in the city center. He thought about buying it for about 20,000 yuan, and regarded it as an investment. After it was demolished in the future, he could change a few houses.
The homeowner probably took Xu Shiyan for a fool, and knew that they made a lot of money selling Clivia, so he wanted to slaughter it.
Xu Shiyan is not really a fool with a lot of money, just casually tricking people.
I couldn’t make it through after two lectures, so I simply didn’t buy it. If I have the opportunity in the future, I can buy it elsewhere. I can sell this house to whoever I like.
All the Clivias have been sold, and those flowery shelves are useless. These days, they are used to light the fire one after another, and there are not many left when they leave.
At two o'clock in the morning on the 12th, except for the three drivers, others began to load things into the car.
There were two cars when we came, and all three cars were full when we went back.
At least enough space is reserved for the dogs, and other valuables and cash are all placed in the pilot building.
A two-cab car is quite spacious inside.
In a driving building, five people can sit even the driver, and if it is crowded, six people can be no problem.
Three cars, fifteen people, fully seated, not crowded at all.
So Zhou Qingguo, Han Lixin, and Li Zongliang drove the car.
Li Zongliang had been to the provincial capital before, and he led the way. The three brand new cars left the provincial capital all the way and flew towards Fusong.
At noon, I found a town to rest for a while.
There was a lot of cash in the car, and the big guy didn't dare to get out of the car to find a place to eat. He just bought some steamed buns, took a bite, and continued walking back.
Fortunately, the road was safe and sound, and there was no robbery. At around four o'clock in the afternoon, I finally arrived at Donggang.
Now, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. They were tense along the way, and no one dared to be complacent.
"Well, it's getting late, we guys are tired after going out these days, let's all go home today.
Tomorrow morning, let’s go to Fusong, and after clearing up the remittance matters, we will get together and figure out all the accounts, how much should be divided, and divide the money.
Let me put the money here first. "
The car stopped at the gate of Xu Chenghou's house, Xu Shiyan helped Xu Chenghou get out of the car, turned around and said to everyone.
Indeed, Zhao Jianshe and others left at the end of September. It has been more than three months since January 13th. Who doesn’t want to go home?
Besides, I made a lot of money this trip and bought so many things, I wanted to go home quickly and share the joy with my family.
"Success, Uncle Third, let's move your things down for you first, and then we'll bring back all the things from each house.
The car I drove will be put in my place tonight, and we will finish the work tomorrow before sending it to the farm. "
In winter, there are not many places to use cars, and each family does not have any garages, and the cars cannot even enter the gate.
It can only be placed on the avenue for one night, and it will be used as a breeding farm tomorrow. The other end is spacious.
In the future, if anyone wants to use a car, they can go to the farm to drive it.
"Yes, we will send all the things to each family, and then drive back to my place first, and we will talk about it tomorrow." On the other end, Han Limin also said something.
"Second son, it's getting late today, you just stay here for one night, and you can go home tomorrow." Xu Chenghou glanced at his second son and said.
"Oh, oh, okay, then I'll stay with dad for one night."
Xu Shian thought about it, his home was the furthest away. At this time, it is not easy for Han Lixin and others to take him back by detour. Tomorrow will be tomorrow.
Tomorrow, he will drive the carriage of the third family, and he can also set the TV home.
That's right, Xu Shian was not willing to spend so much money, he only bought a TV.
Everyone discussed it properly, and then they first took down the four dogs of the Xu family and sent them to the yard, and then carried down all the household appliances, luggage, and cash.
With such a loud commotion outside, can you still hear it in the house? Zhou Guilan hurried out to check, just in time to meet the big guy.
Huang Shengli and others were carrying things into the house, and when they saw this, they hurriedly shouted, "Aunt Xu, get out of the way first, let's carry the things into the house."
Seeing this, Zhou Guilan hurriedly turned sideways to dodge, and then everyone roared and carried things into the house.
The old lady was stunned for a moment, not knowing what was going on.
"Old man, what is this for? What did you all buy? Why are there so many things? How much money did you earn, and you just spent it like this?"
Zhou Guilan knew that Clivia had earned money, but she didn't know how much she earned at home.
Now seeing the big guys moving things into the house, the old lady was a little dumbfounded.
What did you buy? Why does it look similar to the TV where my son won the award before?
"Old woman, don't ask, I'll tell you tonight.
Is there any food? Enough to eat? If it doesn't work, hurry up and cook some more dishes or something. We haven't eaten much this day, and we are all hungry. "
Xu Chenghou grabbed his wife to prevent Zhou Guilan from asking.
Zhou Guilan understood instantly, and hurried to the kitchen to get some food.
The people here moved all their things into the house, and they didn't have time to sit down and talk, so they all left after talking to Xu Chenghou.
Xu Shiyan was going to help other people unload their cars, but the big guys didn’t use him, so let him rest at home.
Feng Chao, Zhao Jianshe, Zhou Qingguo, and Yang Chunming are on the same road. Everyone first unloaded their things and sent them home.
Then they sent Huang Shengli and Sun Xiaofeng back together.
As for the Han brothers, there is no need for others. Li Zongliang, Xiao Peng, and Li Chengrong can help.
After seeing so many things, especially big things like color TVs and washing machines, all the families were very happy.
Hearing again that everyone made a lot of money outside, they were so happy that they wanted to jump up into the sky.
The Xu family was even more happy, because not only Xu Chenghou and his sons came back, Xu Shiqin also arrived home two days ago.
The family is reunited, and naturally it is extremely joyful.
"Hurry up, let's eat first. Don't go home tonight, you all sleep here. There is plenty of time to talk all night."
Zhou Guilan cleared the table and greeted everyone to eat. Seeing that Xu Chenghou was chatting enthusiastically with his three children, she said with a smile.
Two meals in winter, dinner is just around four o'clock, and everyone sits down together.
Xu Chenghou and the others were hungry all the way, but now their stomachs are empty, and no one is polite when they see the food, and they just open it up, and they eat it all up.
"You said you are too, come back today, why don't you mention going back to make a call?
I will lead Huaer and Shiqin, and I will make dumplings for you. "
Zhou Guilan looked at Xu Chenghou and the others wolfing down their meals, and complained distressedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: scary money
chapters.content:
Chapter 369 The amount of money is scary
"I didn't let it go. You don't know what's going on with us in the provincial capital. How dare you call home and say when you're coming back?"
Xu Chenghou muttered while eating.
I really dare not. With so much money in their hands, no one dares to say whether someone is still watching them secretly.
What if they did, they ran to make a phone call, and they were overheard?
Knowing that they are coming back today, who would do something early on the way?
This is not impossible. For the sake of money, there are always people who are desperate and can do anything.
They packed their things and walked back early in the morning, because they were also afraid of this.
Anyway, I came back smoothly all the way, which is better than anything else. As for those who say that dumplings are not dumplings, it doesn't matter if you don't eat a bite.
Grandpas were in a storm, they ate up all the food, and they were finally full.
One of them didn’t care about that, and sat there lazily, leaning against the wall or the kangqin.
Zhou Guilan, Xu Shiqin, and Su Anhua quickly cleared the table.
The two little ones, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui, finally had a chance, and they clung to their mother's arms and refused to move.
Although Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping also miss their mother, they are too old to compete with their younger siblings, so they can only stay next to their father.
"Dad, it's been a long time since you've been away. My brother and I miss you so much."
Xu Shiyan stretched out his arms around his daughter and son, touching their little faces.
"Mom and Dad miss you too, but there is no way, Dad went to study, and Mom went to earn money.
See, my mother earned money and bought another color TV.
Tomorrow, when Dad finishes his work, he will install the color TV for you. You can watch TV at our house in the future. "
Speaking of this, Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered something.
"Mom, hurry up, hurry up and lock the door, no one can watch TV at home tonight."
Ever since there was a TV, many people here come to watch TV at night.
But not today. There are so many things in the house, and so much money, and they haven’t been put away. How can outsiders come again? What if something goes wrong?
"Isn't it? Wait, I'll go through the gate right now."
Zhou Guilan glanced at the boxes on the ground, it was really not good for outsiders to see them, lest some people feel uncomfortable and cause trouble if they are not in order.
Without waiting for Zhou Guilan to move, Su Anhua went out quickly, closed the door, inserted the bolt from the inside and locked it.
"Grandpa and aunt, I've locked the door, or else, let's turn off the lights too.
When people see that the lights in our house are not on, they think that there is something wrong with the switch of our house, so they stop watching TV. "Su Anhua gave an idea.
"No, we are aboveboard, we don't steal, no need.
Someone knocked on the door, saying that there is something at home tonight and I can't watch TV. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head with a smile when he heard the words, why turn off the lights properly?
It is love to let the neighbors watch TV, and it is duty not to let them watch TV.
Before, the neighbors in the neighborhood came to watch TV every day. The Xu family didn’t say anything, just watched it casually, and had to prepare tea for them at night, which was enough.
how? Why don't you allow other people's family to have trouble? How can you be so overbearing and unreasonable?
After dinner, the outside door is also closed, this time I can sit down safely and have a good chat.
"Mom, little sister, guess how much money we made for Clivia this time?"
Su Anying smiled all over her face and asked her mother-in-law and sister-in-law pretending to be mysterious.
"Tens of thousands? Or hundreds of thousands?"
Xu Shiqin looked at the things on the ground, combined with the price Xu Shiyan sold the two potted flowers last year, tried hard to guess more, and guessed a hundred thousand.
"Can't you? Clivia can earn that much?" Zhou Guilan shook her head when she heard the number reported by her daughter.
She thinks it's impossible, but still more than a hundred thousand? How is it possible, there are not even 10,000 yuan households this year.
Hundreds of thousands? What are the flowers, so valuable?
"Too little, guess more." Su Anying refused to say directly, and had to let Xu Shiqin guess.
"Huh? A hundred thousand is too little?" Xu Shiqin couldn't believe it.
"How much is that, hundreds of thousands? Millions?" Xu Shiqin's eyes widened with disbelief.
"Sister-in-law three, are there really millions?"
"Just the finished Clivia that you cultivated by yourself sold 1.7 million."
Su Anying smiled, and dropped a big thunder, which directly bombarded Zhou Guilan's mother and daughter's heads.
"The small flower seedlings planted by several of our partners have sold for more than five million."
Su Anying refused to finish the calculation, and threw a bigger thunderbolt, which directly knocked the mother and daughter dizzy.
"What? 1.7 million? More than 5 million? My God, how much does this add up to?
What kind of flowers are you, you can’t sell them for so much money, right? What's wrong? How old is a pot of flowers? "
Zhou Guilan came to her senses after a long time, sat on the kang and muttered to herself.
Xu Shiqin's reaction was no better than Zhou Guilan's, so I don't blame them.
As Zhou Guilan said, there are not many million-dollar households. If they pull back a few million at once, isn’t that the same as listening to the scriptures? How dare you believe it?
"Little sister, your third sister-in-law didn't lie to you, it is true that your share bought about 1.7 million yuan.
Part of the money has gone to the county bank, we will get it tomorrow, and the other part should have been deposited in our savings bank by Qing Guo.
Wait for me to finish the county first, and then I will figure out everything here later, and then I will see what you mean.
Check whether it is a regular deposit or a demand deposit. There is too much money, so just keep a little less for daily use, and you can’t keep it all at home. "
"No, third brother, I don't want that much money, you can just give me tens of thousands of dollars, and the rest will be given to you and our parents.
I am just a flower that I have nothing to do, but I don’t mean to make money.
The third brother and the third sister-in-law are not as busy as they are, helping me sell them. Those flowers are just flowers, and they cannot be exchanged for so much money.
It's useless for me to ask for so much money, I have nowhere to spend it. "Xu Shiqin was terrified.
She has never seen 10,000 yuan. Now it is more than a million? Give her all the money, it is estimated that she will not sleep well at night in the future, it is scary.
"We agreed at the beginning, as much as you want, if you think you don't need it normally, you can save it for a fixed period.
Have you discussed with Li Wei? When are you getting married? What will be the arrangement after Liwei, should he return to the team or change jobs?
If he returns to the team, will you two still be able to live apart? Where is he going, you have to follow him too? At that time, it will cost money to settle down.
Besides, you are working with a large group, so it’s hard to say whether you can be transferred at that time. How can you do without some money?
If Liwei changes jobs, I don’t know where his work arrangements are, okay?
If it really doesn’t work, don’t you two have to have capital to do any business? "
Xu Shiyan doesn't care about his sister's money, no matter whether it is 1.7 million or more, it is agreed that it is Xu Shiqin's, so he has to give it to her.
"Don't worry, your third sister-in-law and I made a lot of money.
The two of us hold half of the shares, even if all the expenses are deducted, I have more left than you. "

chapters.title: Chapter 370: money and affection
chapters.content:
Chapter 370 Money and family affection
"That won't cost that much money, you can just give me one hundred thousand and two hundred thousand, and I don't want the rest.
You and the third sister-in-law have been in the city for such a long time, and the expenses are definitely not small, so you can't let them all pay.
Besides, our father and second brother have been busy for so long. "
Xu Shiqin felt that she was ashamed to take more than one million yuan.
She didn’t do anything, just provided some seeds and seedlings, and did nothing else. As a result, her brother and sister-in-law gave her so much money, and the money was hot.
"The accounts haven't been settled yet, but the cost is actually not much.
For my father and second brother's share, I can just come and pay, and then you can get married with the money at ease.
Live a good life with Liwei in the future, don't let your parents worry about it, it's better than anything else. "
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, with his brother here, my sister doesn't need to worry about these things.
"No, third brother, this is really not good, I can't ask for so much.
You saved Liwei's life, and you helped to cure my illness. Even if you took all the money from selling Clivia, we didn't say a word.
If you give it all to me, I really can't take it with peace of mind, it's absolutely impossible. "
Xu Shiqin insisted that no matter how important money is, it is not as important as the relationship between siblings.
"Okay, you two stop arguing, that's it, 1.7 million, Shiqin 1 million, and the rest will be given to the youngest couple.
Without your third brother and third sister-in-law, it is true that they would not be able to earn this money, and it is right to share some with them. "
On the other end, Xu Chenghou was very happy to hear that the brother and sister were giving in to each other.
It's impossible for the two of them to keep pushing back like this, so the old man simply stepped forward to help settle the lawsuit.
"Well, it's what dad says, or else just give me 700,000, and give me 1 million to my third brother."
Hearing this, Xu Shiqin felt that such a distribution was reasonable, since she couldn't have all of them anyway.
"Oh, I've never seen anything like this in our family, and the money is still pushed out." Xu Shiyan sighed.
"Well, save the money and put it here or with my mother.
If you want to do something in the future, and the capital is not enough, you can take it away. "
It’s also good to keep a part of the family. Although the character of the Han family is fine, but with so much money, I dare not say whether there will be any trouble in the future.
Keep a part of the family, even if something happens in the future, Xu Shiqin still has room to take a step back.
Everyone should plan for the bad in advance, just in case.
Xu Chenghou has already spoken, so there is a conclusion on this matter.
Next, we need to discuss the share for Xu Shian.
Regarding this matter, before Xu Shiyan could speak, Xu Chenghou spoke first.
"Second brother, when Shiqin returned home from the first operation, I mentioned that I asked your brothers to help pay for some medical expenses."
“At that time, those few said they had no money, so I never mentioned it again.
Later, you gave me two hundred yuan, and I gave the money to the third child, and asked him to invest in Clivia, which was counted as a small share of you.
Now that Clivia has made money, the third child gave you 10,000 that day, and today I am in charge. After the accounts are settled, let him give you another 30,000. "
Although Xu Chenghou is illiterate, he has his account in mind.
Xu Shiyan partnered with others to plant Clivia, and even bought seeds, seedlings, plus flower sheds, flower pots and other things, and invested more than 10,000 in succession.
Now that Clivia has made money, Zhao Jianshe and the others can share about 300,000 yuan each.
Xu Shi'an didn't invest that much money, so he definitely won't get that much. Giving him a total of 40,000 yuan is very reasonable.
The amount Xu Chenghou said was similar to Xu Shiyan's own calculation. Originally, Xu Shiyan also planned to give Xu Shian 40,000 to 50,000 yuan at that time.
After all, the second brother has been busy for so long, and he still holds shares to some extent, so it is not good to give less.
"Huh? No, no, dad, I don't want this money, right?
The third child usually pays me a salary, and this gave me another 10,000, which is very good. "
Xu Shian didn't understand until this time.
After arguing for a long time, the reason why the third child took him was because of the two hundred yuan he took out earlier.
Let’s just say, in such a money-making business, the third brother didn’t call his own brothers, but partnered with outsiders.
This old man has too many thoughts every day, right?
"Second brother, what my father said is what Yingzi and I meant.
How to put it, 40,000 yuan is really not comparable to the construction of them, but it is still a lot.
The second brother took the money, and he can do whatever he wants.
Anyway, I dare not talk about other businesses. If you want to grow ginseng or something, just ask me, and I will help you come up with ideas and regulations, so you can make some money.
You still have two sons, you can’t just sit and eat, and you have to find a way to make money. "
On the other end, Xu Shiyan spoke, he wanted to take the opportunity to persuade his brother, don't get too close to the Wei family, it won't do any good.
Before Xu Shiyan could continue, he heard someone knocking on the door outside, and the dogs in the yard barked wildly.
Needless to say, it must be to watch TV.
Su Anhua was about to go out, but was stopped by Xu Shiyan, "I'll go and talk to them."
Xu Shiyan put on his shoes and got off the ground while talking, put on his coat and went out.
"Who is it?" Xu Shiyan asked through the door.
"Oh, what's going on today? The door was locked so early? We are watching TV. What does it mean that the door is not allowed?"
Outside the gate, a few old women in their fifties asked very puzzled.
"Oh, Aunt Qin, um, I have something to do at home tonight, so it's not convenient to watch TV.
Tomorrow, come back tomorrow, it’s okay to delay for one night. "As soon as Xu Shiyan heard it, he knew who it was.
In front of Xitou Primary School, a family moved from another place the year before last, surnamed Qin.
This family has nothing to do with the Xu family. Since the Xu family has a TV, they always watch TV.
"Oh, Shi Yan's nephew is back?
Look, the neighbors, you have been away from school for so long and you come back, the aunt and aunt came to see you, is this the head office? "
The people outside seemed unwilling, and still wanted to enter the door. This time, they not only wanted to watch TV, but also wanted to inquire more about the news.
Now there are rumors that the Xu family has made a big money-making business in the provincial capital.
These people are like cats scratching in their hearts, wondering how big this business is and how much money they made?
"Several aunts and aunts, I am really tired after coming back from such a long distance, so I plan to rest early tonight.
Thank you, auntie, for your concern. Let’s come another day. I really don’t have time tonight. "
Xu Shiyan still can't hear the thoughts of these people? It's nothing more than curiosity.
It’s fine at other times, but not today.
After Xu Shiyan finished speaking, he turned around and went back to the house.
These people outside heard the closing of the door, and knew that they would not be able to watch TV tonight, so they had to go home.
"Cut, what's the big deal? Isn't it just that I made some money and have a TV?"
Come to your house to watch TV, that is worthy of you, I really fell in love with you. "
The mother-in-law of the Qin family turned and walked away with a displeased face, still muttering.
The other people shook their heads when they heard what the mother-in-law of the Qin family said.
This old woman is not a thing at all. It is said that his daughter-in-law was tortured to death by her, and she couldn't stay in the original place, so she moved to Donggang.
"Stop being with her in the future, who is it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 371: caution
chapters.content:
Chapter 371 Admonishment
Xu Shiyan didn't respond to what the women outside said.
Wonderful flowers can be found everywhere, and Donggang is also a town after all. How can all the good people be good in such a big place?
It is impossible for everyone to have such a strong relationship with the Xu family. If you have a good relationship, you should get along well, and if you have a bad relationship, just ignore it.
As for what they say, don't even listen.
It’s not a new year to hear the cricket call? What should I do, just live a good life at home.
Xu Shiyan entered the room, just in time to hear Xu Chenghou scolding Xu Shian.
"When I was in the provincial capital, in front of the construction and victory, I didn't have the nerve to say you, to save face for you.
Second, remember it for me, save the money by yourself, don’t let your prodigal daughter-in-law know when you go home, and don’t tell her too much about us in the provincial capital.
Masters, don’t tell your wife those useless things. Your daughter-in-law is stupid and virtuous, you don't know it in your own mind?
And her natal brothers, as far away as you can.
It’s fine to go to your place for a meal occasionally on weekdays. For other things, don’t care what they say, don’t get involved, understand? "
Xu Chenghou has long been displeased with that guy from the Wei family, so he is not a family to live.
Old Wei's family also belongs to the Forestry Bureau, and he is famous in the Forestry Bureau for not being able to live well.
Funding for seven days is fun, that is to say, in the first seven days of each month's capital opening, there are big fish and meat all day long, eating and drinking.
In the middle of the month, I run out of money, so I start with corn, porridge, big pancakes and pickles.
Wait until the end of the month and the wages are gone, and then I can start to spend a lot of money, and I can borrow as much money as I can.
Wait until the capital is raised next month, pay back the money first, and then repeat the process of last month.
Just living like this month after month and year after year, even though there are several people in the family who go to work to earn wages, they can still be poor in those days. It is really a wonderful family.
When the two families got married, the Xu family was in the big house, so they didn't inquire carefully.
Thinking that the Wei family is a worker's family after all, and the Forestry Bureau is rich.
Xu Shian, an old farmer with clay legs, is already very remarkable to be able to marry an educated youth from a worker's family.
After getting married, I slowly learned the details of the Wei family.
It's a pity that it's too late, two children are born, so how can it be messed up?
If the Wei family knew that Xu Shian had money, they might not know how to surround him to **** blood.
So Xu Chenghou wanted to find an opportunity to have a talk with his second child these few days, so that he could be careful not to go home stupidly and give all the money to his wife.
If that's the case, within two years of safekeeping, all the 40,000 yuan can be ruined by Lao Wei's family, and there will be no money left.
"Yes, second brother, I wanted to say that just now.
It’s not that my father and I deliberately provoked the relationship between you and the second sister-in-law. The main reason is that the second sister-in-law doesn’t know what to do.
If it comes and goes lightly, we won’t say anything.
After all, the old Wei family has raised the second sister-in-law for so many years, and then she didn’t want anything, so she just married our family.
But his family is really not the kind of people who live a life of duty. It is no good for such people to get too close to them.
You can persuade the second sister-in-law when you have time, no matter what you say, you have to take care of your own home first.
Xiaobo Xiaotao is in his teens, and he is about to enter junior high school, and in a few years he will be admitted to university.
If it’s okay to be admitted to university, there is a way out, but what if you don’t pass the exam? Do you still have to give them a daughter-in-law? "
Xu Shiyan listened to his father's words and took it very seriously.
If his second brother didn't stay far away from the Wei family, he would have a hard time living with how much money he has.
If you want to say that Xu Shian is stupid, that would not be the case. He is just stunned, but he is not stupid.
The old man and his younger brother expressed kindness and sincerely thought of him, how could Xu Shian not understand?
"Mom, if the third child really gives me the money, I won't save it, you can put it aside for me.
If I am of any use, I will take it from you. "
What kind of daughter-in-law is Xu Shian still not clear? In fact, he knew in his heart that he just loved his wife and was reluctant to turn against her.
But such a large sum of money really cannot be kept with the wife. It is safest to let the mother help to keep it.
"Okay, as long as you trust me, put it here.
If you want me to say, don't think about what you are doing, just follow the old couple.
They planted sticks, and you also planted some ginseng.
Don't adjust too much, thirty or fifty feet a year, as long as they are connected, and you will make goods every year in the future, why can't you miss this day. "
The sons and daughters are all the flesh that fell from their bodies, and Zhou Guilan loves each of them.
The second child is a straight-hearted fool, he doesn't have any twists and turns, and don't even think about making a lot of money, just plant some sticks, and it will be fine for a year.
Xu Shian was very obedient this time, he agreed to whatever his parents said, and Xu Chenghou and his wife felt a lot more at ease when they saw it.
Xu Chenghou and others went out for three months, and finally came back. The whole family got together and chatted, and it was too late before they knew it.
Zhou Guilan hurriedly cleaned up the house, she lived in the east room with Xu Chenghou and Xu Shian.
Xu Shiyan and his wife lived outside the east room with their children. Xu Shiqin and Su Anhua still live in Westinghouse.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui haven't seen their mother for a long time, and they just dragged their hands and refused to let go.
No way, Su Anying could only sleep with her arms around the two younger ones. Seeing that the two older ones couldn't catch up, she simply hugged her father to sleep on one left and one right.
"Thankfully, we only have four children. If there are two more, we won't be able to coax them together."
Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing when he saw this. There are not enough parents.
"Xu Haiyuan, how is your final exam? It's the second grade, can you keep up?"
The three of them got into bed, Xu Shiyan put his arms around his son, and asked a casual question.
"Dad, I know.
My brother still passed the double hundred exam, and their teacher came to our house, praising my brother for studying well, being sensible, and being polite.
My brother is a three-good student in his grade, and grandma put away the certificate. "
Xu Jinping's small mouth, she said everything before Xu Haiyuan opened her mouth.
"Yo, my eldest son is so good? How about a three-good student, really good."
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard the words. The eldest son of his family is really good at studying, so he doesn't need to worry about his parents at all.
Of course, even if the husband and wife wanted to worry about it, it would be of no use.
In the past, Xu Shiyan could still read a story to his son from a book. Since Xu Haiyuan learned to use a dictionary, Xu Shiyan didn't even need to read a story. He found a way to solve it himself.
This kid is so worry-free in his studies.
"Dad, don't listen to my sister booing there, she's just a three-good student, still in the same grade, nothing special.
Our teacher said, let me strive for the three good students in the school. "Xu Haiyuan was a little embarrassed by his father's praise.
In his opinion, this is nothing at all. If he can judge some rewards in the whole county like his father, that is his ability.
"Well, Dad believes in you, you can do it.
Pingping also cheers, and strives for you to be as good as your brother after you go to school. "
His daughter will definitely not be bad in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 372: let the dogs go
chapters.content:
Chapter 372 Release the dog
Xu Chenghou and others stayed in the provincial capital for three months, and they were afraid to sleep every night.
After finally going home, I finally relaxed this night and slept soundly.
I slept until after six o'clock the next morning, when Zhou Guilan woke me up to eat.
The main reason is that there are still a lot of things to do today, so I can’t get up too late. When people come to the house later, they will still be sleeping soundly, which is outrageous.
Just after breakfast, there was the sound of a dog barking outside.
Su Anhua went out to take a look. It turned out that it was the fifth sister Su Anfang and her brother-in-law Li Zongliang. They came in one after the other.
"Oh, Fifth Sister, please slow down.
It's early in the morning, it's cold and slippery outside, what are you doing out here? Watch out for your tummy. "
"What are you careful about? It's only been a little over two months, and you're so far away from being pregnant, what are you afraid of?" Su Anfang looked indifferent.
The country woman, who is pregnant and about to give birth, still works as usual. She is only two months pregnant, and it's just a bean sprout. Why are you so nervous?
"You don't even look at my brother-in-law's face, he's still talking hard."
Su Anhua rolled her eyes, and hurried forward to support her sister.
The brother-in-law of her family looked nervous like an old Baozi guarding chicken cubs.
"Leave him alone, since the doctor in the clinic said, I should be pregnant, and your brother-in-law is just like that.
I was not allowed to go to work every day, and I was not allowed to do anything. I was pregnant and almost became useless. "
Su Anfang turned her head and glanced at Li Zongliang, what about it?
"Why don't you go to the provincial capital for a few days, no one cares about me." Su Anfang muttered.
The main problem is that the participating teams don’t have so much work in winter. Li Zongliang often rests at home, and Su Anfang won’t let him do anything.
Su Anfang has seen so many women who are pregnant with children, all of them should do what they should do, just be more realistic.
I've never met anyone's daughter-in-law, and she doesn't do anything when she's pregnant. There's no need for that.
Li Zongliang was disgusted by his wife, but he was not annoyed. He just smiled and scratched his head, and followed his wife into the house.
"Second Sister, you are finally back, oops, you miss me so much."
Su Anfang entered the east room, saw the second sister, and was so happy that she wanted to go up and hug her.
"Daughter-in-law, daughter-in-law, slow down, slow down."
Li Zongliang hurriedly stepped forward to stop her, and carefully helped Su Anfang walk over.
Su Anying had already heard from the sixth sister that the fifth child was pregnant, and seeing Li Zongliang taking care of her carefully now, she felt it was funny.
Don't look at Li Zongliang's tall and burly man, he is really good to his wife.
Look, his daughter-in-law is only a little over two months pregnant, and she is far away from giving birth. Look, he is nervous, so what if she waits for her to give birth soon?
However, Su Anying just looked at and smiled, and didn't say anything. She doesn't need her sister-in-law to point fingers at how the young couple get along.
Too many couples are not harmonious because the relatives around them are involved, which actually affects the relationship between the young couples.
"Hey, Fang'er is here? Hurry up, get on the kang, it's warm on the kang.
Take a look, what are you doing in such a hurry in this cold weather? Your second sister can't run away either. "
When Zhou Guilan saw Su Anfang and his wife coming, she quickly asked them to sit down.
Su Anfang's pregnancy has long been known to Li Zongliang's relatives and friends, and Zhou Guilan heard it from Su Anhua.
"I just miss my second sister." Su Anfang laughed when she heard that.
I don't know what's going on, anyway, she has something to do now, so she has to slip up, otherwise she will always feel uncomfortable in her heart.
Here, just as Li Zongliang and his wife sat down, there was another barking of dogs outside.
Zhou Guilan went out to have a look, she was the mother-in-law of the Qin family who always came to watch TV at home. There is no TV this early in the morning, what is she doing here?
"Oh, I heard that your family has come back? Yesterday evening, several cars pulled things back?
I thought about it and came to see, what good things did you get back from the provincial capital? " Qin Pozi said with a flattering smile.
She heard her son mention it when she came home last night, saying that in the evening, she saw several cars parked outside the gate of Xu's house, and many people were carrying things down.
After hearing this, Mrs. Qin felt like a cat scratching her heart.
After eating this morning, I didn't even clear the table, so I came to Xu's house to inquire about news.
"Oh, who owns the car outside? It's a new car."
Zhou Guilan's complexion is a bit uneasy, the family is very busy today, how can I have time to talk nonsense with this person?
"Who did you listen to? How can there be anything? It's just my four dogs and some luggage."
Thanks to last night, I moved the color TV and refrigerator I bought back to the inner room of the east room, and even locked the money in the inner cabinet.
Otherwise, if this woman sees it, she will be surprised and annoying again.
"No, someone saw it and said that a lot of things were moved down, such as big boxes."
Mrs. Qin looked puzzled, and she said that she was about to go inside. She didn't believe Zhou Guilan's words and wanted to go in and have a look.
Since the Xu family moved to Donggang, they have gotten along well with the neighbors in the neighborhood, and they were originally quite harmonious.
No one expected that such a wonderful family moved here from Xitou.
This Mrs. Qin obviously has no friendship with the Xu family, but she has a thick skin. She goes to watch TV all day long, and she loves to point out other people's affairs.
Zhou Guilan usually doesn't like to argue with Mrs. Qin, so she just pretends she doesn't see such a person, but not today.
"Hey, what are you doing? Breaking into other people's houses early in the morning?" Zhou Guilan reached out and grabbed the old lady Qin.
"Look, the neighbors in this neighborhood, why don't you come to your house to sit and sit?
See you like this? how? What shady things are hidden in the house? "
Mrs. Qin was stopped, feeling unhappy in her heart, and immediately flung her face and said something ugly.
The more Zhou Guilan didn't want her to enter the house, the more curious she became. What happened to the Xu family?
There is a kind of person who is just like this. She is curious about other people's affairs and has nothing to do with her, and she must find out.
Mrs. Qin is such a particularly unpopular person, she walked in while talking.
Zhou Guilan angrily reached out to stop her again.
And at this moment, a shadow suddenly swooped over, and when it came to Mrs. Qin, it gritted its teeth and made a whining sound.
"Oh my god, why isn't your dog tied up? What if it bites someone?"
Mrs. Qin was so frightened that she jumped out quite far away.
It was Xiao Huang who jumped out, but it didn't bite people today, but bared its teeth at Mrs. Qin and kept calling.
With a cry, he took a step forward, forcing Mrs. Qin out of the gate, and Xiao Huang stopped moving, and stood guard at the gate, barking.
Xiao Huang appeared so suddenly, Zhou Guilan was also stunned, the dog was **** last night, when did Xiao Huang break the chain?
"Grandma, if such a person comes again in the future, you will let the dog go. I think she dares to come in?"
The two children, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, appeared from behind Zhou Guilan with playful smiles, and looked at the panicked expression of Mrs. Qin outside the gate, which made the two children very happy.
Needless to say? Xiao Huang must have been let go by the two of them.
"You two naughty **** dare to do anything, what if Xiao Huang bit someone just now?"
Zhou Guilan was dumbfounded by her grandchildren, these two children, why are there so many tricks?
"No, Xiao Huang is very obedient. I told it just now, just scare it, don't really bite it."

chapters.title: Chapter 373: Bank savings
chapters.content:
Chapter 373 Bank Deposits
Escaping Mrs. Qin, Zhou Guilan quickly tied Xiao Huang up.
At this time, Zhou Qingguo, Han Limin and others all arrived.
Everyone didn't have time to chat, so they drove to Fusong quickly, and settled the money matter first.
Han Lixin had already gone to work on vacation, and Li Zongliang happened to be here, so Zhou Qingguo and Li Zongliang drove away in two cars, and the big guy just sat down.
Xu Shiyan took all the procedures and went straight to Fusong.
Arriving at Fusong Sub-branch just at work, Xu Shiyan took out their wire transfer voucher.
When remitting money from the provincial bank, a telegram has been sent to the Fusong sub-branch. Two days ago, I also received letters from the provincial bank.
So as long as you confirm the wire transfer voucher in Xu Shiyan's hand, you can handle it.
However, with such a large remittance, the ordinary staff of the bank can no longer make decisions, so they hurriedly recruited the president, vice president, and director.
Several leaders of the bank approached Xu Shiyan and the others for various discussions.
The main meaning is whether it is possible to open an account directly here and leave the money in the branch.
Otherwise, such a large amount of remittance would not be able to be withdrawn by the bank in full.
The bank promised a lot of preferential policies, and even the president said that it can give special arrangements, and the current account opened here can also be withdrawn at Songjianghe Savings Bank.
You must know that in this year and month, individuals seldom deposit money in the bank, and ordinary people still like to hide money at home.
In order to attract deposits, banks and savings offices resorted to various tricks.
How could the bank let go of such a large sum of money? Then you must stay in this line.
Xu Shiyan and others thought about it, anyway, they are not in a hurry to use the money, they can store it in a branch or a savings bank.
Although the county is a bit far away, they have a car now, and if they really need money for something, it is not too difficult to drive over to get it.
Besides, the bank promises that the current account can be withdrawn in Songjianghe, so it can be stored anywhere, and there is no need to transfer it to Songjianghe savings bank.
Finally, Xu Shiyan and others negotiated with the bank. Zhao Jianshe and the others each opened a current account of 50,000 yuan in the bank, and the remaining 150,000 yuan was deposited on a regular basis.
Xu Shiyan and Xu Shiqin each have 50,000 demand deposits and 450,000 fixed deposits.
The bank leaders were overjoyed when they heard this, and hurriedly arranged for someone to handle it.
At this time, savings with rewards has not yet become popular, but in order to attract people's deposits, banks also give some gifts, and the most common ones are all kinds of industrial tickets.
What watch tickets, sewing tickets, bicycle tickets, and even TV, washing machine, refrigerator tickets.
The president of the sub-branch asked for a lot of votes and gave them to Xu Shiyan and the others.
"It's Chinese New Year, and there is nothing else in the store. Take these tickets back, everyone, and see if you can buy some New Year's goods, just in time."
Zhao Jianshe and others regretted it to death when they saw those votes.
If they knew that deposits could get industrial tickets, why would they bother to buy color TVs and washing machines in the provincial capital?
Come back and buy it, and you don’t have to bother to search for tickets from Bala.
"Okay, take your deposit receipts and passbooks, put them away when you get home, and don't lose them.
These tickets, let’s distribute them to you when you get home. We don’t need them, and you can give them to relatives and friends. "
Those tickets are in high demand, and whoever they give them to will have a lot of fun. Otherwise, take it out and sell it, and I don't know how many people are rushing to ask for it.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan and his party left the branch under the watchful eyes of all the staff of the branch.
They didn't dare to delay in the county seat, so they drove back quickly.
Driving by yourself is faster and more convenient than passenger cars.
Back and forth plus running errands, it took four hours. I came out at seven o’clock in the morning, and got home after eleven o’clock at noon.
If you take a bus, you can only come back in the afternoon for this little thing.
And it’s inconvenient, the car is messy, what can I do if I lose something?
"Don't leave at noon, after dinner here, we have to go to Songjianghe Savings Bank in the afternoon to arrange the rest of the money."
The car stopped outside the gate of Xu Chenghou’s house. Xu Shiyan asked the brothers to get off the car and enter the house together.
The proceeds from the sale of more than 6,000 Clivia seedlings are all deposited in the account of the farm.
They have to quickly collect all the accounts, remove expenses and so on, and distribute the rest of the money to everyone, just to feel at ease during the New Year.
Everyone did not refuse, and followed Xu Shiyan into the hospital.
"Uncle Xu, we came to your place for a meal at noon today. Do you have any good wine and food? Shouldn't we have a couple of dinners?"
Just saw Xu Chenghou in the yard, Yang Chunming and the others joked.
"That's necessary, don't leave at noon today, your aunt killed a chicken just now, and went to the market to buy a lot of meat and so on.
After a few dishes at noon, let's drink a pot of good wine together. "
Earn money, why don’t you celebrate with a good meal?
As soon as Xu Shiyan and the others left in the morning, Zhou Guilan led her daughter-in-law, killed a chicken, bought meat and ribs, and said that she had to cook something delicious to reward the big guy at noon.
When everyone heard this, they all laughed and walked into the house while laughing.
As soon as the door of the house was opened, the aroma from the kitchen wafted out. When everyone sniffled, it was the aroma of chicken stewed with mushrooms.
"Oh, auntie, have you stewed chicken and mushrooms? It smells so good." Zhao Jianshe asked loudly.
"Yeah, I killed a big **** today.
In autumn, didn’t the children pick up a lot of pine mushrooms? Just soak it up and stew it, and then some vermicelli.
Let me tell you, keep this dish for lunch today to support you. "
Zhou Guilan came out of the kitchen with a shovel in her hand and said to everyone with a smile.
"Mom, where's my second brother? Are you home?"
Xu Shiyan glanced into the east room, only to see Su Anfang coaxing Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui to play. He didn't see Xu Shian in the yard just now, so he asked a casual question.
Xu Shian has been away for so many days, he must be homesick, besides, he has nothing to do here, why don't you go home?
"Well, not long after you left, he became anxious and had to go home.
Hair your carriage, and leave with the TV and luggage, saying that you will bring the carriage back tomorrow. "
Zhou Guilan responded, and went back to work in the kitchen.
Xu Shiyan and others entered the east room, set up a table, and Zhou Qingguo handed over all the accounts here to Xu Shiyan.
The big guys sat around the table, before eating, they sorted out the accounts first, and the dividends were all clear.
"I just looked at the accounts, and the money we hired for the car was settled on a trip basis. Now there are militiamen helping to look after the farm, and the money for pressing the car to the provincial capital has not been settled.
Let me tell you a number, do you think it will work? "After Xu Shiyan read the account book, he discussed with everyone.
"We have earned money, so don't search too much. The militia's money is calculated on a daily basis. You will be given 30 yuan a day. What do you think?"
People’s militia came to patrol and maintain law and order. It was also very hard work, and they couldn’t rest in the middle of the night.
Not to mention those who go to **** the car, that is risking their lives, they are all from the villagers, and they cannot be used for nothing.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: ginseng market
chapters.content:
Chapter 374 Ginseng Market
"Okay, third brother, you have the final say, we have no objection."
The militiamen helped to patrol and protect the farms, and it took at most a month.
Even if one person gives one thousand, it won’t cost 20,000 yuan, just give as you need, and you can’t search on it.
Huang Shengli turned his head to look at the others, and when he saw everyone nodding, he asked.
"By the way, third brother, what are you going to do in the village? And the other side of Guo Department of the Forestry Bureau."
Actually, on November 15, 1984, the superior issued a document, and Donggang Township was changed to Donggang Town.
But the big guys are used to being called Donggang Township, and they can't change it for a while.
"Let's make it clear first, you can't pay for the money yourself, everyone will pay together."
The few of them discussed this matter behind Xu Shiyan's back in the provincial capital, and they cannot follow the previous agreement.
At that time, no one knew how much they could earn, so Xu Shiyan said he would give it to Xiangli and Guo Shouye, but he paid for it himself.
The big guys didn't know what to do, so they didn't argue with Xu Shiyan about this.
But it’s different now, a few million.
They follow behind Xu Shiyan, and each of them can get hundreds of thousands, which is almost like picking up for nothing.
If Xu Shiyan paid for the bulk of the expenses as before, they would be too careless.
Xu Shiyan treats them as buddies and leads them to make money, and they can't do things that are not human.
So several people have discussed it long ago. After all the expenses are deducted, then the money will be divided. Xu Shiyan can't let Xu Shiyan take out so much by himself.
"Huh? No need, I'll take the lead, whether it's in the town or Guo Ge's side, I can just come and go.
How much do you share, you don’t need to pay. "Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard the words, and hurriedly waved his hands with a smile.
"No need, Brother Guo, I think it's almost enough to give him a hundred thousand."
Guo Shouye just helped to inquire about the news, and he was not involved in other matters. Normally, 30,000 to 50,000 yuan would be enough.
But Guo Shouye has a relationship with them here. In the future, he will have to approve ginseng from the resource department. This relationship is very good, so give more.
"As for the town, I just want to discuss with you, I don't think it's right to give money directly."
Everything else is easy to talk about, only the one in the town is the most difficult to get, give me money? How much is appropriate? There is no use without it. many? How much is too much?
Moreover, even if it is given, can it be used in the right place?
Don’t let Xu Shiyan give the money, and the town directly gave benefits to the cadres for the Chinese New Year. This matter is not guaranteed.
Huang Shengli and the others sighed when they heard this.
It's not that the town is not good, but judging from the dividends of the sticks in the past two years, the things they do are too ordinary.
"Third brother, what do you think we should do? You talk about it first, let us help you as a consultant."
"What I mean is, why don't we do something meaningful.
I want to invest 200,000 yuan to build a ginseng market in our Donggang.
Think about it, starting next year, each of us will have a stick, right? Except for the submitted tasks, the rest can be sold freely.
Then can we organize such a ginseng trading market? In the first few years, there may be few people coming, but as more and more people come from various households, I dare say that this market will definitely become prosperous. "
Before 86 years, there was no serious ginseng professional market in Fusong.
The relatively large-scale souvenir market in the county is Wanliang, and it only goes to the market every tenth day.
In the late 1980s, merchants from some coastal areas came to purchase ginseng, but they could only go to Wanliang.
When ginseng farmers from all over the county heard the news, they also went to Wanliang to trade, gradually attracting ginseng households from several surrounding counties to sell ginseng.
By 1991, Wan Liang seized the opportunity and invested 230,000 yuan to build a ginseng market with an area of ​​2,600 square meters.
It was put into use in 1992, and the transaction volume reached 40 million yuan that year.
Wanliang Ginseng Market has undergone several expansions, and finally built a comprehensive ginseng market integrating commodity trading, finance, entertainment, and catering services.
The annual transaction volume reaches more than 100 million.
As a result, various industries such as ginseng processing, plastic processing, wood processing, and ginseng product packaging have been driven in the entire town.
By the end of 2,000 years, Wanliang Ginseng Market had become a typical ginseng distribution center and trading center in the northern region.
Actually, in the 1990s, there was also a ginseng market in Donggang, which is now the Granary Compound.
It was very prosperous at the beginning, and many people came to trade in autumn.
As a result, I don’t know what Donggang Town was thinking, but sold the land in Canshi to someone.
That man was very courageous. He directly invested money and covered up the ginseng market. There was a store outside and market stalls inside.
People have invested so much money, the fees must be high.
It was okay for the first two years, but after the ginseng market went bad and the Wanliang ginseng market became more and more prosperous and other reasons, the ginseng market turned yellow and no one went there.
Many people would rather trade on the street than go to the market.
Around 2005, several large ginseng households in Donggang joined forces, and bought the land of several companies on the west side of Xu Chenghou's home road, and re-established a ginseng market.
This market participation is too simple, there is no fence, and no management fee is charged, but when the transaction is completed and weighed, a weighing fee is charged.
