This ginseng market has only been booming for a few years. Later, as the planting of ginseng in Donggang became less and less, coupled with road construction and demolition in the development zone, the ginseng market disappeared.
Xu Shiyan meant that, taking advantage of the fact that there is no sign of the Wanliang ginseng market, build one in Donggang first, maybe it can seize the opportunity.
As long as it is well managed, it can definitely drive the local economy and form an industrial chain.
In that case, it will be of great benefit to the overall economic development of Donggang.
This is the way that the common people can benefit. Giving money directly to the town is absolutely nonsense.
"Oh, that's a good idea. Third Uncle, I really admire you. How do you think of it?"
On the other end, Zhou Qingguo slapped the table down when he heard it, and stood up excitedly.
Zhou Qingguo is a cadre in the town, and his vision is different from others. He can see the economic benefits behind Xu Shiyan's idea at once.
"How is it? Do you think there is something in your third uncle's mind?"
Xu Shiyan laughed when he saw Zhou Qingguo's excited expression.
"That's more than a little bit, it's too much.
Third Uncle, hurry up and tell us how you plan to build this city. Be specific. "
Zhou Qingguo sat down and looked at Xu Shiyan expectantly.
"Simple, I plan to buy the house on the west side, just flatten it and rebuild it.
Look, just leave a gate in the northeast corner, and the entire east and north facing the street are covered with two-story storerooms.
Inside, it can only be used in the open air for the time being, with concrete or asphalt ground, a few rows of stall beds in the middle, and lines on the ground around it. Large piles of goods can be piled directly on the ground. "
Xu Shiyan has been thinking about this matter for a long time, and he already has a prototype in his mind. Now he takes out a pen and paper, and while drawing, he tells everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: Dividend
chapters.content:
Chapter 375 Accounting and dividends
Daoxi is under the jurisdiction of Xican Village, where the residents are not densely populated, and the yards are very large.
A family occupies at least a few hundred square meters, and some even thousands of square meters. If you buy ten or eight households, the area is enough.
Houses are cheap these days, and the average three-bedroom house with a yard is only one thousand and eight hundred yuan.
They are all old houses. Many people want to renovate and have no money, so they will give more money, and the town will cooperate with them, and they will approve some real estate and so on.
These people sell their houses and build another one, and there is still a fortune left. Most people can agree.
Buy the land, and build storefronts on the east and north frontages, and turn the inside into a ginseng market.
At that time, the property rights will be returned to Xu Shiyan, and the right to participate in the market management can be given to the town.
These outlets outside can be rented out. If the family has staff, they can also open a restaurant, hotel, store, etc., and keep them to earn money.
Even if it really doesn’t start to operate in a few years, don’t be afraid. Donggang will be developed sooner or later, and when the time comes, it will be demolished. With such a large area, it can make a fortune.
As for why it is necessary to build the Ginseng Market on the west side of the Martyrs’ Cemetery Road, the main reason is that the transportation here is convenient.
It happens to be a crossroads, extending in all directions, making it easy to come and go.
And there are residents all around, everyone can benefit from it
Not to mention anything else, Xu Chenghou's entire small shop, the storage business is booming, this is a business opportunity.
If it is placed elsewhere, for example, there is a large open space in front of the kiln factory in the north of the building materials, and you can tell the town directly that it can be built without spending money, but what is the use of building it like that?
There are no households around, only woods and big bubbles, others will not be able to benefit from it, and there is no benefit to speak of, that is not acceptable.
The ginseng market is used for ginseng trading in autumn, and it can also be used as a market in summer, killing two birds with one stone.
However, this is much more useful than directly giving money to the town.
Xu Shiyan said his idea in this way, and everyone thought it was feasible.
This money must be paid out, but the money paid out must be meaningful. It is very good to arrange it according to Xu Shiyan. The money is not lost, and the town can also benefit.
Not to mention anything else, Chen Jianzhang is in office and fully supports the establishment of the first professional ginseng market in Fusong and even Northeast China.
This achievement, who can compare with him? I can't believe he's not tempted.
"Third brother, let me tell you, you don't want to leave our brothers behind in this matter. If you don't take us with you, we will be impatient with you."
This time it was Zhao Jianshe's turn to pat the table, "Well, if you vote 200,000, we will also contribute 200,000.
Let’s make the whole thing bigger, don’t be petty and make people laugh, be generous, and save yourself from worrying in the future. Right? "The latter words are for Huang Shengli and others.
"Yes, yes, Jianshe is right, third brother, if you abandon us in this matter, I will be in a hurry with you."
Several other people nodded, and even Han Limin expressed his opinion that he must have a share.
Listen, what are these people saying? Want to turn against him?
Xu Shiyan laughed, "Okay, why don't you listen to me?
That’s how it is, I’ll give 200,000, and you guys will give 200,000, and we brothers can do some business together.
Of course, this matter has to be in the name of your sister-in-law, and I came up with the idea behind the scenes. "
Xu Shiyan now, it's best not to be too high-profile, anyway, it's a family, it doesn't matter who comes forward, as long as the benefits are in his hands.
"Qingguo, I will leave this matter to you. Go talk to Secretary Chen."
Xu Shiyan glanced at Zhou Qingguo. Zhou Qingguo worked in the town government, and it was better for him to negotiate with him.
"It's done, it's up to me, this matter can definitely be done." Zhou Qingguo patted his chest and assured that he must have done a good job.
The interests of the town have been resolved, and Guo Shouye's side, everyone has to share it equally.
What Xu Shiyan said, everyone disagreed, and in the end, there was nothing to do, so this item could only be deducted as an expense.
The small Clivia seedlings were sold for a total of 5.56 million. After deducting various expenses, taxes, and what was just discussed, there was still a net profit of 4.9 million.
Xu Shiyan himself took half, and the rest was shared equally among the seven families, each with 350,000 yuan.
Before in the provincial capital, each family distributed 10,000 cash in cash, and in the county town in the morning, each family distributed another 200,000 deposits, so this time, each family distributed another 140,000.
The money given to Guo Shouye was taken from the cash at home.
The money for ginseng market will be deposited in a separate account from the farm account, and all accounts will be clearly recorded at that time, and no one is allowed to tamper with the money.
"Our brothers have been together for so many years. I didn't treat you as outsiders, just like my own brothers."
The accounts are clear, and Xu Shiyan still has a few words to tell everyone.
"We are all considered rich now, needless to say, two million or so.
To put it bluntly, from now on I will just do nothing and save my money in the bank for interest, which is enough for me. "
In order to attract deposits this year, the interest rates given by banks are particularly high.
Not to mention anything else, the interest rate for a three-year period is 5.7%, and the interest of 1 million a year is more than 60,000 yuan.
Xu Shiyan has two million four hundred and fifty thousand in his hand, and the annual interest is one hundred thousand in the bank. How can he earn so much?
It’s really like what he said, from now on doing nothing, lying down all day is enough to spend.
"It's the same with you, 300,000 yuan, and the annual interest is nearly 20,000 yuan. We are desperately planting sticks, can we earn so much a year?"
Xu Shiyan glanced at everyone, and everyone shook their heads there.
"Is there a lot of money? It's quite a lot.
If we are going through life seriously, the money, not to mention for our pension, can live a good life for more than ten years.
Judging from the current consumption level, the interest alone can’t be spent. It’s impossible to say that it’s impossible to provide for the elderly, but it can definitely guarantee a very nourishing life for more than ten years.
"Don't look at the amount of money, but if it's about eating, drinking, prostitution, gambling, especially the latter two, as long as you get involved in any of them, the money will not resist it, and it will be slow in three to five years.
This is the money our buddies earned by taking a lot of risks, but we must never take advantage of others.
I’m leaving my words here today. If anyone among us goes out to make money or play with women, don’t blame me for breaking up with him.
In the future, no matter what happens, I will not take him with me. "
In fact, Xu Shiyan didn't need to say anything about it.
How to spend your own money is your own decision, and outsiders should not interfere.
But Xu Shiyan couldn't help it. He had seen too many rich people, and it was because of these two things.
Well, after waiting for ten or twenty years, there is still one thing.
With these three things, no matter how big a family business is, it can be wiped out, let alone three hundred thousand.
"Third brother, don't worry, we are definitely not that kind of people.
When I am rich, I can eat delicious food with my wife and children, buy two beautiful clothes for my wife, and be filial to my parents. How nice is that?
Then why can’t you go down the road? "Zhao Jianshe and the others shook their heads, thinking that it was impossible for them.
"It's impossible to say now, and you'll know when you actually meet." Xu Shiyan sneered.
"I know your character, and you won't take the initiative to do those things, but I'm afraid that someone will set you up.
In the future, be more careful, don’t believe in new friends and the like, because if you believe, you will suffer. "
Being defensive is essential. Don’t think that there are good people in the world, and good and bad people don’t have engravings on their faces.

chapters.title: Chapter 376: River money
chapters.content:
Chapter 376 Crossing the river money
All the accounts were settled, and Xu Shiyan also gave instructions if he needed to. It's annoying to say too much, so enough is enough.
It happened that the food was ready, so good wine and good food were served, and everyone happily celebrated together.
Originally, Li Zongliang was going to leave after sending everyone back, so the amount of money here has nothing to do with him.
But the big guys didn't let him go, so they insisted on keeping Li Zongliang here to have dinner together.
It happened that Su Anfang hadn't seen her sister for a long time and refused to leave, so the couple stayed here for dinner.
Just as the food was packed here, Su Anhua also came back from get off work, and naturally Li Chengrong was with her.
Li Chengrong went out to study for several months but failed to see his partner, so the two could only write letters back and forth. After finally coming back to meet each other, they wished they could always follow behind Su Anhua.
One morning, Su Anhua was working in the comprehensive factory, and Li Chengrong followed suit.
Colleagues who worked together laughed, and Su Anhua felt very embarrassed.
"Yo, Xiao Li is here. It's time for dinner at home. Hurry up, sit down and eat together."
Zhou Guilan greeted Li Chengrong to enter the house and asked him to eat.
Li Chengrong originally wanted to send Su Anhua back, and didn't intend to come for dinner.
But this time, everyone greeted him, and Li Chengrong couldn't leave anymore, so he sat down and had dinner with the big guys.
Everyone pushed cups to change cups, ate, drank and chatted, and it was extremely lively.
There were a lot of people, two tables were set up in the east room, and Zhou Guilan led his daughter-in-law, daughter, sisters and children from the Su family to the west room to eat together.
I have something to do in the afternoon, and the big guys didn't dare to drink too much, just make up your mind.
At one o'clock in the afternoon, everyone went out together to Songjianghe Savings Office, and according to the previous plan, the money in the farm account was processed.
Huang Shengli and the others this time directly deposited 140,000 cents for one, three, and five years.
The annual and monthly interest rates are quite high, so there is no need for so much money for the time being, and there is no need to keep too much money.
Hundreds of thousands of dollars are saved for regular interest, and there are thousands of dollars a year, which is enough for their family’s living expenses, and it’s fools who take it all out.
After saving the money, I lost my mind now, so I hurried home with the deposit receipt.
With so much money, you have to keep it safe and not lose it.
Xu Shiyan and Xu Shiqin went back to their parents together.
Xu Shiqin only holds the 50,000 current passbook, and the rest are all handed over to Zhou Guilan for safekeeping.
"Mom, you can hold all these for me, and I can just go out with 50,000 yuan.
Fixed deposit, let my third brother and third sister-in-law help manage it, and withdraw the interest when it is due, and parents keep the flowers. "
950,000 fixed term, with tens of thousands of interest a year, the old couple spend a lot of money, but they can't finish it.
Zhou Guilan and Xu Chenghou didn't know how to calculate interest, if they knew, they would definitely not accept it.
Of course, they didn't intend to take advantage of the daughter, they just helped keep it.
"Mom, this is 30,000 yuan from my second brother. I have saved it for a year. Please help me put it away and keep it alone.
Wait for my second brother to come over one day and tell him. "
Deposit for a fixed period, at least one more interest, and it is also safer. The members of the Wei family can't force Xu Shi'an to take out the time deposit.
Anyway, Xu Shian usually doesn’t spend much money. He is paid for working in the farm, and he was paid 10,000 yuan before. Why can he spend so much?
"Father, Mom, the 20,000 yuan is for Yingzi and I to show filial piety to you.
In the past two years, for that little Clivia, my parents have been busy with me. Now that I have made money, is there more? The 20,000 yuan is spent by the second elder. "
There was still some cash at home, so Xu Shiyan took out two stacks and gave them to his parents.
"Other things, this won't work. We didn't do anything, so we can't ask for this money. The two of you have been busy talking about earning some money for more than two years, and we don't want it."
Xu Chenghou looked at this and thought it was okay? Quickly push the money back.
Twenty thousand yuan? The old couple don't have much daily expenses, so why do they need so much money?
It's not easy for the son and daughter-in-law. He has been helping for a few months, but he can't accept 20,000 yuan.
"Father, you can't say that. Yingzi and I are both busy, and it's not you and my mother who help outside the house. How can we take care of it?
Just say Xu Haiyuan and the others, aren’t they all here all day long?
If I don’t have one, that’s all. Now that I’m earning money, I should respect my parents. "Xu Shiyan pushed the money to his parents again.
"Look at what you said, Yuanyuan and the others aren't our grandchildren? Why do grandparents love their grandchildren?
No, I can’t ask for this money. "Xu Cheng put on a hard face and refused to accept it.
"Father, you and my mother are both old and can't do much in the future.
Although there are big brothers and they give some pension, in fact it is not much.
My words may not sound good, you two keep this money, right to use it as the head office of cross-river money, right? "
Su Anying saw that her husband couldn't persuade her, so she took the money and pushed it in front of her in-laws.
In the Northeast, when going through a funeral, you have to lose some money when you pass an intersection, river or bridge.
This money is used by the dead souls to cross the river or find their way, so it is called crossing the river money.
Later, it was extended as the last pocket money left by the old man after he got old.
With this money, even if the old man leaves suddenly, even if he has no descendants, he can still take care of his affairs.
After the average old man is over sixty, he starts saving birthday materials, shrouds, and money for crossing the river for himself.
Xu Chenghou is also in his sixties. Although he has a good physique, he has been quietly touching him for the past two years, and asked Zhou Guilan to save him materials to make a shroud.
"Yingzi, what are you talking about? Both my father and mother are in good shape.
Besides, how many of our brothers are there, how can they save money to cross the river? "
Xu Shiyan glared at his daughter-in-law, obviously to train her, but secretly he deliberately provoked the old couple with words, just to make the old couple accept the money.
"Look at you, what are you talking about Yingzi doing? I'm already this age, and I don't taboo about anything. There are still people who don't die? If they don't die, they will become old monsters."
Xu Chenghou glared at his son, then turned his head to look at his wife Zhou Guilan.
"Old woman, what do you think about this?" Xu Chenghou was very thoughtful. What his son and daughter-in-law said just now really spoke to his heart.
This man, as he grows older, he will inevitably get sick. He has no money, so he will have to rely on his son.
If the son is filial, it’s okay to say, but what about the unfilial son? What's the matter?
The five sons of the Xu family, although they seem to be good on weekdays, are actually reliable, and the third is the only one.
The old couple are very good, in fact, they are filial to their parents, and they think about the old people in everything.
The second child is okay, but the daughter-in-law is not very good, and if something happens in the future, she dare not say anything.
In the past two years, for Xu Shiqin's surgery and medical treatment, the money in the hands of the old couple is almost exhausted.
Xu Chenghou is getting older, and he can't do much in the future. He only counts on the little money his son gives every month. To be honest, it's just a daily meal. When something big happens, it's not enough to do anything.
You can't just take care of the third child whenever you have something to do, right?
Living at home, no one can leave all the money at home, what if it is inconvenient to catch up with the third child?

chapters.title: Chapter 377: tacit cooperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 377 Cooperation tacit understanding
Xu Chenghou glanced at Zhou Guilan, then pouted at her, motioning for her to speak.
"You want me to say? Then I mean, call all the brothers to come to me some other day.
The big guy was a witness, and we sold the house to the third child for 20,000 yuan. "
Having been an old couple for so many years, there is nothing to say about the tacit understanding. Zhou Guilan immediately understood what her husband meant, so she played a game with Xu Chenghou.
This matter, when the two of them couldn't sleep at night, they didn't know how many times they thought about it.
Especially last night, after learning that Clivia had earned so much money, Zhou Guilan didn't sleep much all night, thinking over and over again.
When the third child was taken with the second child, no one thought that Clivia could earn so much money, but they just wanted the third child to help the second child.
At that time, I thought about it, earning at most one thousand and eight hundred yuan, and even if those few knew about it, it would be no big deal.
I won’t bring them, what can I do?
They all have jobs. The boss, the fifth child, or the couple work and work both jobs. How short of this money is it?
But that’s not the case now, the third child earned more than two million yuan, the sixth child earned more than one million yuan, and the second child earned 40,000 yuan.
Outsiders like Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli each shared more than 300,000 yuan.
With so much money, who wouldn't be jealous?
There will always be a day when I can't hide this matter. In the future, I will let the brothers know that I can't escape by complaining, and maybe I have to bear the grudge.
At the beginning, it was Xu Chenghou who said that he was not allowed to take those brothers with him. How can they not hold grudges when they know about it?
It was far away, but I came back twice a year to give some money and food.
If you know the cause and effect again, you won't be able to come back in the future, and you won't be able to say whether you will pay or not.
If these **** turned their faces and refused to recognize anyone, then the pension agreement they signed at the beginning would definitely be useless.
Now they don't care about the elderly, but it doesn't mean that their parents will be gone in the future, and they won't jump out and want to divide the family property.
So, this matter has to be prepared in advance.
Originally, what Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan meant was to find an opportunity to tell their sons that they wanted to transfer the ownership of the house to the third child, and they would live with him from now on.
Anyway, it is no different from living together now. Speaking of it, it is to support the third child and save trouble in the future.
However, they were also worried that the youngest couple would not take advantage of this.
It happened that the old couple had to give 20,000 yuan, and the old couple didn't need to discuss it, they understood it with just a glance.
Why don't you just use the money as an excuse to get the house done so you don't have to worry about it later.
When they die, they don’t know anything when they close their eyes, and their children and grandchildren will be overwhelmed by that time. No, that would be too embarrassing.
"The third child, Yingzi, I agree with what your mother said.
You two have a look, if you two are willing, I will accept the money, if you two disagree, then I will never accept the money. "
Xu Chenghou winked at Zhou Guilan. Sure enough, it had to be an old couple, and this was done beautifully.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were dumbfounded. What's going on? Isn't it about money? Why did you go around the house?
"Dad, Mom, there are only six of us in our family, why do we need so many houses?
The three houses on the east side of my house have been said to be rebuilt. We haven’t had a chance to build them yet. We can’t live in them. It’s useless for me to give you the five houses. "
Xu Shiyan is speechless, what is going on with his parents?
From the beginning, he didn't intend to have this house, otherwise, he directly paid for the house and saved it for his parents to live in, so why bother.
"Then if you don't want this house, we don't want this money.
Anyway, you get the money back every month, and I’m not afraid that no one will care about me when I get old. Why bother to ask for this old money?
Put it at home for fear of thieves, and I don’t know how to withdraw it from the bank, and it’s troublesome. "Xu Chenghou spread his hands, with an expression of indifference.
Yes, Xu Shiyan couldn't laugh or cry when he was generalized by his own father.
He finally found out, now the old man stopped playing high games with him, and played tricks instead. My mother also learned badly, so she played tricks along with her.
"Father, Mom, actually, I know what you are worried about.
Don't worry, no matter what day it is, no matter how many of the brothers are, I will definitely take care of you two, give you two pensions, and take care of them so that you two will not fall to the ground. "
Filial piety to the elderly, to take care of the elderly, is the duty of a son, and has nothing to do with the house.
Before, Xu Shiyan also emphasized fairness, that is, the five sons must fulfill their responsibilities as sons, and no one can be left behind.
Now that I have seen it, how can there be so many absolutely fair things in the world?
home is not a reasonable and fair place. People are biased. How can there be absolute fairness? It's just to be worthy of my conscience.
As long as you fulfill your responsibilities and have no regrets, that's enough.
"If your two elders insist, then wait for the younger sister to get married and the eldest brother to come back. Let's find a chance to sit down and discuss again.
I'll keep the 20,000 yuan first, and I'll talk about it later, right? "
What can Xu Shiyan do with his parents? The old man and the old lady are nothing more than fearing that he will suffer in the future, and they are thinking for him, can he not see it?
"Okay, let's talk about it later." Xu Chenghou glanced at Zhou Guilan and nodded.
Everything is guessed by the couple. They can't say exactly how the sons will react, so let's wait and see.
Xu Shiyan glanced at the watch on the wall, it was four o'clock in the afternoon.
"Father, Mom, I have to go out again. I have to send Brother Guo's share of money. At this time, he is about to leave work."
Guo Shouye hasn't sent the 100,000 yuan yet, so he definitely can't go to the office during the day, and the impact will be bad.
"Oh, yes, yes, then hurry up, it's a big deal, don't delay."
Xu Chenghou came to his senses, and kept urging Xu Shiyan to do serious things. Let's talk about these messy things at home later.
I left some cash at home, so Su Anying found a big back pocket and stuffed it into it while counting. It happened to contain a hundred bundles, worth 100,000 yuan.
"It's quite heavy." Su Anying lifted it with her hand, not light.
"That is, one hundred bundles, can it be lighter?"
Xu Shiyan took the back pocket with a smile, put it on his back, then found the knife he always carried with him, put it in his waist, put on his hat and gloves, and walked out.
"I may not be able to come back for dinner at night, you don't have to wait for me."
Guo Shouye’s family actually lives not far away, in the corner building.
The corner building is a former store of the Forestry Bureau. It is a two-story building on the corner of the street, which happens to have a corner.
People in the past didn’t have much knowledge, so they just found it novel, so they all called it that.
Guo Shouye’s home is in a bungalow on the north side of the corner building. Xu Shiyan has been here many times and is very familiar with it.
When I came to the gate of Guo’s house, Dangdang knocked on the door. After knocking a few times, someone inside asked a question. "Who is it?"
"Sister-in-law, my little Xu, is my Brother Guo home from get off work?" Xu Shiyan responded outside.
"Hey, brother Xu, I heard from your brother Guo that you went out to study, what's the matter? Are you back from vacation?"
Guo Shouye's daughter-in-law, Peng Yucui, opened the door from the inside, and welcomed Xu Shiyan into the courtyard with a smile.
"Your brother Guo just got off work and entered the door. You two step forward and backward. Come in and talk."

chapters.title: Chapter 378: send money
chapters.content:
Chapter 378 Send money
"Old Guo, Brother Xu from Donggang is here."
Peng Yucui is a very straightforward person. While pushing the door to let Xu Shiyan enter the room, he yelled at the room.
"Yo, my big brother is back? When did you get home?
Hurry up and get in the house, look, why is it so dark outside? If there is something to do during the day, I will come to the unit to find me. "
Guo Shouye heard that Xu Shiyan had come, so he hurried out of the east room to greet him.
"Hey, I haven't seen my big brother for several months. How about studying outside?"
When Guo Shouye saw Xu Shiyan, he smiled very affectionately, and hurriedly dragged Xu Shiyan into the room and sat down.
Guo Shouye’s family lives in the public housing of the Forestry Bureau. The three rooms are not too big. There are sofas and coffee tables under the south window in the east room, modular furniture in the east, and a kang in the north.
Guo Shouye and Xu Shiyan sat directly on the sofa, and there was a small coffee table between the two sofas.
"Fengxia, hurry up, make a pot of tea for your Uncle Xu. No one can see, and your Uncle Xu will not say hello when he comes."
Over there, Guo Fengxia, who was lying on the kang table doing her homework, quickly put down her pen and smiled at Xu Shiyan.
"Uncle Xu, I didn't solve a problem just now, so I was busy writing it."
Guo Fengxia is the youngest of the three daughters of Guo Shouye's family.
This child is serious about learning. The school is on holiday these days, so she doesn't go out to play, so she does the questions at home.
"It's okay, it's okay, I learned from you, and I can't delay you from doing the questions." Xu Shiyan quickly waved his hand and smiled.
"Brother Guo, look at you, what are you doing tormenting the child if you have nothing to do?
Let the children do the questions well. My eldest niece studies well, and she has to get into a good school next year. "
The three children of Guo Shouye’s family are all very promising. The eldest and the second are admitted to technical secondary schools, and the third is in the third year of junior high school with good grades.
Guo Shouye saw Xu Shiyan's appearance and knew that something must be wrong with him.
"Put your books to the west room first, boil a pot of water to make tea, and then go to the kitchen to help your mother cook.
Tell your mother, add a few more dishes, and let your Uncle Xu have dinner at our house in the evening. "
Xu Shiyan came at this time, so it must be no small matter. Since he came, there is absolutely no reason for people to leave on an empty stomach, so they have to stay for a meal.
Guo Fengxia is quite a sensible child. Upon hearing this, she hurriedly took the tea pot to make tea, then gathered up her homework and went to the kitchen to help her mother.
Guo Shouye and Xu Shiyan were the only ones left in the east room, so Guo Shouye opened his mouth.
"Brother, you are here at this time, are you looking for me for something? Just speak up if you have anything to do.
Our brothers are not that particular. If your brother can do it, he will do it for you. If he can't, I will find someone to do it for you. "
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this, "We have been brothers for so many years, don't I know Brother Guo?
In these years, I have troubled Brother Guo a lot. Guo Ge treats me like my own brother, and I don't treat Guo Ge as an outsider. "
As Xu Shiyan spoke, he dragged the bag on his feet over.
"Brother, I asked my brother to help me find out about Clivia before. To tell you the truth, brother really made some money this time.
I said at the beginning that you can't let brother Bai be busy. This little money is brother's wish, brother, you accept it. "
Xu Shiyan took money out of his pocket while talking, and placed piles of money on the coffee table.
The coffee table is not too big, and there are teapots and cups on it. This is great, it is full of money.
Guo Shouye was dumbfounded at once, and quickly reached out his hand to stop Xu Shiyan, "Brother, brother, don't dig out, you are trying to scare your brother to death."
How much is this? Guo Shouye has only seen so much public funds in the bureau, but he has never seen private individuals who can take out so much money at once.
How much is this? Is there fifty or sixty thousand? My God, Clivia's business can make so much money?
"Brother, please explain to my brother what's going on first. If you take it out like this, my brother won't dare to ask you for a penny."
It is impossible to say that Guo Shouye is not tempted after seeing so much money.
Who is not greedy for money? Everyone knows that money is a good thing, and anyone who sees it will be rare, but with so much money, Guo Shouye is afraid that it will be hot.
"Brother, the source of the money is aboveboard, you can rest assured." Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this.
He knew what Guo Shouye was worried about. He was afraid that the money would come from a bad way, that it was black money or something.
"It's Clivia. I built several flower sheds to plant Clivia. A while ago, didn't you ask you to find a car for me to send to the provincial capital? It's Clivia."
Xu Shiyan knew that if the matter was not explained clearly, Guo Shouye would definitely not want it, so he told him everything about planting Clivia.
"Since October this year, the price of Clivia has skyrocketed.
I happen to be studying in the provincial capital? I saw that the price was too good, so why not hurry up and wait? So I sold all the Clivia at home.
It’s okay, I partnered with a few friends, and in the end each of them shared about 300,000 yuan. "
Xu Shiyan was telling the truth, and Zhao Jianshe and the others did share about 300,000 yuan.
"The money is thanks to Brother Guo. At that time, thanks to Brother Guo's help, we were able to find so many Clivia seedlings and seeds.
Besides, without Brother Guo's help to find a car, we couldn't transport it to the provincial capital.
So the brothers discussed it, and they were so embarrassed, they must be counted as a share of Brother Guo.
Here is a total of 100,000 yuan, which is Guo Ge's dividend. "In this way, it means that Guo Shouye is an investment dividend, which has a different meaning.
In these years, whoever is capable in the work unit does not start a business outside? Just pointing at that little salary, how can it be enough to spend?
Many people in the Forestry Bureau are now secretly contacting old timber customers in the south to dump wood.
Otherwise, it is to cooperate with others to approve ginseng soil and plant sticks.
People who have no skills can only go to work honestly to earn a dead salary, but anyone with a little brain wants to develop a side job and earn more.
This is so normal, it’s all like that.
So when Xu Shiyan said this, Guo Shouye let go of most of his worries.
As long as the money comes from the right path, then don't be afraid.
"Oh, no wonder, many people in Songjianghe have been hunting for Clivia.
I heard people say the other day, how much does a seed cost? How much is a pot of flowers?
My God, what is the value of this thing? How can it be so expensive? "Guo Shouye suddenly realized, but at the same time he was a little puzzled.
It’s just a potted flower. It can’t be eaten or drunk, and it can’t be used as medicine to treat diseases. Why is this stuff so valuable?
"Brother, let me tell you the truth, this thing is purely made up by people.
The current situation of Clivia is similar to playing the game of drumming and passing flowers when I was studying.
Pass it down one by one, and when the drumbeat stops, whoever gets it will have to smash it.
This thing is not worth the price at all. "
In front of Guo Shouye, Xu Shiyan didn't say anything out of the ordinary. He was mainly afraid that Guo Shouye would take the money and invest it in Clivia in a flash of his head, which would be bad.
"I estimate that within half a year, the superiors will definitely take action to rectify it, so I made a fortune and ran quickly.
Brother, you don’t have to worry about why that thing is worth money, we just take the money and live in peace. "

chapters.title: Chapter 379: Leave
chapters.content:
Chapter 379 left
Guo Shouye can become the director of the resource department from the leader of the logistics procurement team, can he be an ordinary person?
As soon as Xu Shiyan said it, he understood.
"Okay, brother, I understand this matter. But this money, I can't keep so much, you give me 20,000 is enough."
Guo Shouye knew that Xu Shiyan would definitely not be happy if he didn't accept the money today, but he felt it was too much if he accepted all of it.
He just asked relatives and friends to inquire about it, and did nothing else. The Clivia seedlings and seeds were all collected by Xu Shiyan.
For the transport vehicle of the Forestry Bureau, he just moved his mouth and passed a word from the middle.
Xu Shiyan paid the fare with real money, and I heard that Xu Shiyan bought cigarettes and delicious food for the driver every time, and the driver was very happy when he came back.
Now the drivers at the Automobile Transportation Department, as soon as they hear that Guo Shouye arranges the use of the car, they jump up and down and rush to work. The benefits are so luscious.
So, Xu Shiyan didn't owe Guo Shouye much, if he really got 100,000, Guo Shouye felt that he was too greedy.
"Brother, that's not what you said." Xu Shiyan was not in a hurry, and just smiled at Guo Shouye.
"The Chinese New Year is coming soon? It's a big Chinese New Year, does my sister-in-law want to visit relatives?
Now that there is such a commotion, how many people do you think don’t know that the price of Clivia has increased?
Brother Guo was kind enough to help get in touch at the beginning, but he was afraid that some people would not say anything, but complained in their hearts, thinking that the sale was cheap.
You take the money, and when you ask your sister-in-law to leave relatives, buy more things for them, and you don’t need to say anything else.
At least this relative will get along in the future, right? "
In this world, there really is that kind of villain, this thing is in his own hands, and he is happy if it stinks.
But if others bought his things and changed hands to make money, they would be able to **** him off.
He never considered how much others paid to earn money.
He just stared at others to make money, and he earned it from his stuff, which was as uncomfortable as gouging out his flesh.
Although there are not many such people, if there are one or two relatives, it is enough to disturb people.
When Xu Shiyan said this, he didn't really ask Guo Shouye to compensate anyone, but just to remind Guo Shouye.
Once the money is collected, you can do whatever you like and spend it however you like. But when you complain later, don't blame me, I will compensate you.
Guo Shouye was silent for a moment when he heard this, and then laughed. "You, everything is right for you.
In that case, you leave me 50,000, and you take the rest back. "
Fifty thousand yuan, which is more than his salary for decades, can buy dozens of them in his small yard, which is quite a lot.
Xu Shiyan smiled, put all the money on the coffee table back into his pocket, and then pushed the pocket directly to Guo Shouye's feet.
"Brother, you said that I struggled to recite it, but why do you want me to recite it again?
I made an agreement with my brothers, the 100,000 is for you, but you just kept 50,000, how can I explain to my brothers later?
how? Did I get a kickback in the middle? Didn't you let me sit on wax? "
"Accept it, I won't give you anything for Chinese New Year this year.
In the future, there will still be places where I can ask my brother for help. If you don’t accept it, how can I have the nerve to come to you again in the future? "Xu Shiyan said that on purpose.
Guo Shouye laughed loudly when he heard it, but he didn't push back his bag again, he just got up and went to the door, and yelled towards the kitchen.
"Daughter-in-law, is the food ready? Find me a bottle of good wine. My brother comes to our house once in a while. Tonight, I have to have a good drink with my brother."
"Okay, Fengxia, go set the table and eat." Peng Yucui responded in the kitchen, and then ordered her daughter to set the table.
Guo Fengxia came into the room, set up the side stand, and then went to the kitchen to serve meals and dishes, and set up dishes and chopsticks.
Peng Yucui worked swiftly, and in such a short time, he got six dishes and one soup right.
Scrambled eggs, peanuts, canned luncheon meat, stewed vermicelli with sauerkraut, fried pork with green onions, fried mung bean sprouts with meat, cabbage heart and braised pork vermicelli soup.
In winter in Northeast China, apart from radishes, potatoes and Chinese cabbage, there are sauerkraut, and there are only a few dishes on the dinner table every day.
To be able to prepare these few dishes in such a short period of time, one is Peng Yucui's hard work, and the other is that Guo's daily life is good.
"Come on, brother, let's have a drink." Guo Shouye called Xu Shiyan to sit down, picked up the wine bottle, and poured wine for Xu Shiyan.
"Brother Guo, I can do it myself."
Xu Shiyan gave way, but Guo Shouye insisted on pouring the wine, but Xu Shiyan had no choice but to hold the glass with his hands. "Thank you, Brother Guo."
"Sister-in-law, Fengxia, you two should come over for dinner too. We are all on our own, and eating together is fun."
There are four people in total, there is no need to divide them into two places, just eat together.
Xu Shiyan insisted, Guo Shouye looked at it, said nothing, and let his wife and daughter sit down.
"Hurry up and eat, and go to Westinghouse to do homework after eating."
Peng Yucui put some vegetables for her daughter and put them in a bowl, signaling her to finish her meal and leave the table quickly, so as not to delay Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye's drinking and chatting.
Guo Fengxia lowered her head and grabbed the rice in the bowl, eating quickly.
Xu Shiyan felt very embarrassed when he saw this, so he quickly picked up a lot of meat and eggs for the child.
"It's okay, eat slowly, your dad and I are just chatting, it doesn't matter."
"Thank you, Uncle Xu." Guo Fengxia raised her head and said thank you, then continued to eat with her head down.
Not long after, Guo Fengxia finished her meal, "Dad, Uncle Xu, I'm full and going to do my homework."
Guo Shouye hummed, and Guo Fengxia turned around and left the east room, "This kid is not as smart as her brother, and her grades are not as good as her sister's.
Alas, I think the entrance exam to the technical secondary school is not good enough, if it doesn’t work, I have to go to high school. "
Guo Shouye sighed, the eldest and second child in the family are doing well in studies, but the third child is much worse in comparison.
The only advantage is learning. I was at home during the holidays, and I also did the test and endorsement every day.
"Looking at what you said, I think Fengxia is pretty good, how many children are there who love learning so much?
If she doesn’t pass the technical secondary school, she can go to the high school to enter the university. Maybe Fengxia can get into a pretty good school in the future. "
In these years, the mainstream thinking is to work early and earn money early.
After four or five years of technical secondary school, you can graduate and work. It takes three years to study in high school, and a minimum of three years to enter a university, and an extra four years.
So many people think that technical secondary schools are good, so that the scores of technical secondary schools are particularly high, and only children with particularly good grades can go to technical secondary schools.
Those who are a little worse can only go to high school to take the university entrance exam, and those who are even worse can't go to high school, so they can only come down to work.
For the forestry bureau, it’s okay to talk about it, maybe they can recruit workers when they catch the opportunity, or they can take over after their parents retire.
If you have an agricultural household registration, you can only go home and farm.
"Oh, brother, you don't understand, this girl has a lot of thoughts after she goes to high school, and few of them can study well.
You still have to take the entrance examination for a technical secondary school, even if you take the entrance examination for a teacher training school, becoming a teacher is better than going to high school and failing to pass the entrance examination. "Guo Shouye shook his head.
The Forestry Bureau has its own high schools, all of which are under the Forestry Bureau system. Guo Shouye knows more than Xu Shiyan.
Girls are everywhere in high school, and few of them can study hard.
Besides, girls are affected by innate factors. After high school, it is very difficult to study, so it is better to take the technical secondary school.

chapters.title: Chapter 380: Kotobuki material
chapters.content:
Chapter 380 Shoucai
Xu Shiyan knew what Guo Shouye meant, but he didn't think it was so absolute.
Girls do get worse and worse grades when they go to high school.
For example, the two daughters of his eldest brother's family, Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu, both of them had good grades in junior high school, but their grades kept declining in high school.
Xu Jinfeng repeated his studies for two years and failed to get into university. Later, Xu Shixian asked someone to find a relationship, and finally managed to find a way to send him to a banking school for a junior college. After graduation, he was assigned to CCB.
Xu Jinxiu seemed to repeat her studies for three years, but in the end her brother-in-law figured out a way to arrange for her to go to a banking school, and after graduation she was assigned to the Agricultural Bank of China.
Take the above two as examples. When Xu Jinping took the high school entrance examination, the whole family asked her to enter the technical secondary school, and what they said was basically the same as Guo Shouye.
Girls have too many thoughts in high school, and it is difficult to study well, anyway, it’s just that way.
Xu Jinping was high-spirited and didn't want to take the technical secondary school, and the technical secondary school in those years wasn't too good.
So Xu Shiyan ignored the suggestion of his brother-in-law and supported his daughter to go to high school.
Because of this incident, the brothers in the family were very angry, and felt that Xu Jinping was ignorant and disobedient.
I also feel that Xu Shiyan is too used to children, letting them mess around.
It may be that Xu Jinping also has a lot of energy in her heart, so she has always had good grades in high school.
Girls study science, and their grades are always the top three in the grade, followed by a large number of boys. It is impossible to see that girls are not as intelligent as boys.
Of course, Xu Shiyan couldn't say these words.
Guo Shouye's daughter is not Xu Shiyan's daughter, so it's useless to say too much.
It happened that Guo Shouye's wine glass was empty. Xu Shiyan took the wine bottle and poured it for Guo Shouye. They chatted while drinking.
While chatting, we talked about the elderly. Guo Shouye's parents are both in the forest farm, and they are not too young.
Guo Shouye said that with this money, he would buy a bigger house in Songjianghe and take over his parents for the elderly.
He also said that his parents were old and not in good health, and he had prepared everything for the old man's birthday.
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan's heart moved, "Brother, can you still get good longevity materials?
If you can fix it, you can get me one or two pairs, and I will pay for the amount. "
Xu Chenghou has talked about it several times, saying that it is his age that he should prepare for his birthday.
A few years ago, feudal superstitions were broken, and there were no wreath shroud shops, birthday material shops, etc. for a long time.
Whoever has an elderly person will prepare birthday materials in advance, and wait for the old person to disappear, and quickly find a carpenter to gather them together.
In the past, there was a poor family who had no money to buy birthday materials. After the person died, they nailed a thin-skinned coffin with a mallet and board, and buried it casually.
Xu Chenghou is old-fashioned, so he doesn't care about these things.
Xu Shiyan also understood that he just had no chance to find someone to find someone to find him. Just at this point, he asked a casual question.
"Shoucai? What do you think you want? Red pine or sand pine?
Let’s choose red pine, the best of red pine, and the worst of sand pine. How thick do you want, four to five to six? "
Guo Shouye laughed when he heard it. Is there anything else I can do with this thing? The Forestry Bureau lacks nothing, not wood.
Shoucai, red pine is the best, followed by sand pine, and white pine is the worst.
Guo Shouye said four, five, six, and he was talking about the specifications of longevity materials.
Four inches at the bottom, five inches at the top, and six inches at the top.
"No, no, don't do four, five, six, two, three, four are fine." Xu Shiyan waved his hands quickly.
The four-five-six longevity material is too thick and heavy, in fact, there is no need to make it so thick. Two, three, and four are fine, and they are normal specifications.
"Cut, what are the two, three, and four? You don't have to worry about this matter, it's on me, and I can ask any forest farm director I want.
Don’t worry, I’ll find the best one for you without any scars. "
Guo Shouye patted his chest and promised that this little matter was up to him, and it was nothing, and it would be settled with one sentence.
"Okay, then please Guo Ge, I'm still wondering who to turn to for this matter." Xu Shiyan laughed.
Human relationship, that’s all. Open your mouth when you should. If you ask for help, you don’t have to worry about it.
Besides, the closer you are, the closer you get. Feelings, don’t you just deal with things slowly?
"Come on, brother, let's have another drink." Xu Shiyan picked up the wine glass and touched Guo Shouye, and they each drank half of the glass.
Baijiu can be dried up without a sip. Besides, Xu Shiyan has to go home soon. It's cold and the road is slippery. Why go back drunk?
The two of them drank half a bottle of wine just like this, and Xu Shiyan said no more.
It was getting late, he had to go home quickly, the house was still waiting.
Guo Shouye saw that he had indeed drunk a lot, so he asked Peng Yucui to serve the two of them a meal, and they each had something to eat, after which Xu Shiyan said goodbye and left.
"Brother, it's not easy to walk in the cold weather, you must slow down.
Well, the matter of uncle and aunt is on my shoulders, don't worry.
Waiting for the Chinese New Year, bring your wife and children over for a visit. Your sister-in-law has talked about it several times, but she hasn’t seen what your wife and children look like. "
Guo Shouye followed to see off outside the gate, exchanged greetings with Xu Shiyan, and watched Xu Shiyan leave.
Waiting for Xu Shiyan to go far away, Guo Shouye turned around and entered the door, locked the door with his backhand, and walked quickly into the house.
In the east room, Peng Yucui had just cleared the table, and the bowl was soaking in the pot before being washed, when Guo Shouye dragged her into the east room.
"No, Lao Guo, why are you holding me back? Are you drunk and drunk?"
Peng Yucui looked puzzled, quickly wiped her hands on her apron, and followed Guo Shouye into the east room.
"Daughter-in-law, let me show you something."
Guo Shouye dragged his daughter-in-law into the house with a mysterious expression, then stretched out his head and glanced at the door of the west room. The daughter should be doing homework, and nothing happened.
Only then did he carefully close the door of the east room, lifted the bag on the ground with great effort and put it on the kang, and then took money out of the bag.
Peng Yucui was dumbfounded, "Old Guo, you, where did you get so much money here?
My God, did you make a mistake? This is not a joke, will go in. "
Peng Yucui was so frightened that her hands trembled and her voice trembled.
"Look at you, this is too timid. I can usually row a little, so I don't have the courage to reach out to the public."
Guo Shouye glanced at his daughter-in-law, alas, this woman is not good at all, she will be scared when encountering some things.
"This was given by the brothers of the Xu family. He came here today to give this to us.
Didn’t you help him inquire about Clivia seedlings and seeds before? He made a lot of money, and this is to thank us. "
Guo Shouye looked at the bundles of brand new unity, and grinned with joy.
"Huh? Brother Xu, how much money do they earn, and give you so much? Don't talk nonsense, I don't believe it."
Peng Yucui had an unbelievable look on his face, how much money does it cost to give them this bag all at once?
It costs tens of thousands. How can Clivia earn so much money?

chapters.title: Chapter 381: fat fox
chapters.content:
Chapter 381 Fat Fox
"Look, it's like I lied to you, is it useful for me to lie to you?
Someone in Songjianghe took Clivia these days, haven’t you heard of it? It's quite expensive.
Brother Xu paid a few cents for a seed at that time, and even if it was sold for a hundred and eighty per pot for two years, it was still a lot of money, what do you think? "
Guo Shouye shook his head, why don't you say that this woman has long hair and short knowledge? Why can't you believe it?
People who are capable have already earned money, but she still can't believe it.
"Tomorrow, go and deposit this money, don't deposit it all at once, divide it into several places over a few days, and don't let others know.
We don't have much skill, and don't even think about doing big business to make money.
Save the money and keep it. In the next spring, I will find a place to build a house, or buy a house, and let my parents take over.
Waiting to talk to the boss about a daughter-in-law, the rest is enough for us to provide for the elderly. "
Guo Shouye really listened to Xu Shiyan's words, and didn't plan to do anything. It's better to save the money quietly and keep it for interest than anything else.
His current job is not good enough to be too ostentatious. It would be nice to keep a low profile and live a stable life.
"Don't mention it when you go out, let alone mention it to your children at home.
If outsiders know about this, we really can’t tell, after all, my job is different now. "
The higher the status, the more cautious one must be. It is not easy to be the head of the resources department, how many people are greedy.
"Understood, can I not count this matter?"
Peng Yucui looked at the money in her pocket, and she was also full of joy. With this money, she will really have no worries in the future.
"Okay, put the money away quickly, what's the matter? Are you still planning to sleep with your arms around?"
Guo Shouye glanced at his wife and urged her to put the money away.
"My head is dazed, let's lie down for a while." Guo Shouye can't drink normally, but now that he's drunk, he wants to lie down and sleep.
Peng Yucui hurriedly locked the money together with the bag in the cabinet, then spread the quilt, let Guo Shouye sleep, and she went to clean the kitchen.
Xu Shiyan didn't drink too much alcohol. After going out, he was blown by the cold wind and soon became sober.
The winter month is at the end, there is no moon at night, and it is freezing cold outside. Thanks to Xu Shiyan wearing a lot of clothes, he can walk quickly without feeling too cold.
From the corner building to the Donggang Martyrs' Tomb, it takes about 20 minutes to walk quickly.
At this time, Xu Shiyan went home without disturbing his parents.
Xu Shiyan had just entered the courtyard and closed the gate, before he could take a few steps inside, a black shadow jumped over.
Don't even think about it, it must be a rascal.
This guy lives in Xu's house beautifully. He eats and drinks all day long, and Xu Haiqing and the others play together.
When I have free time, I go to the woods behind to catch a bird, squirrel, mouse, etc. I have such a good life, and I don’t want to leave at all.
Having been together for a long time, Xu Shiyan also regards Lai Pigui as a member of the family. He hasn't seen him for a long time, and he really misses him.
So when he saw Lai Pigui rushing towards him, Xu Shiyan picked it up and hugged it in his arms.
"Hey? Are you getting fat again? No, I will start reducing your food tomorrow. You can't eat so fat."
Xu Shiyan felt that the rascal seemed to be sinking a lot.
I want to know, I don’t have to worry about eating and drinking every day, and those little ones feed it secretly at every turn, can they not get fat?
Lai Pigui didn't know if he understood Xu Shiyan's words, anyway, he made a buzzing sound in Xu Shiyan's arms.
Xu Shiyan flicked the rascal's head with his other hand, "Don't be a rascal here, you will get sick if you get fat, and you will die early."
Foxes are too fat, it will cause many diseases.
Xu Shiyan didn't want Raipi Ghost to get sick and die in the end because of artificial breeding, that would be a pity.
Xu Shiyan carried Lai Pigui in his arms, and went to the three houses in Dongtou, and opened the door to let Lai Pigui in to sleep.
At this time, Xu Haiqing and the others must be sleeping, otherwise Lapigui would not have time to run out to meet him.
The rascals sleep here at night. After all, this guy is a bit smelly, and it's really unbearable to live with others in the house.
Lai Pigui jumped to the ground, still a little reluctant to part with Xu Shiyan, and circled around Xu Shiyan several times.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to bend down and rub Lapigui's head again, "Okay, go to bed quickly, I have to sleep too, and I have to go to work tomorrow."
On the first day back, I was so busy calculating the accounts and dividends that I didn't even have time to visit the unit.
It is estimated that if he does not go tomorrow, Lin Qiyue will have to send someone to find him.
Lai Pigui pestered Xu Shiyan to play for a while, then went back to his nest to lie on his stomach, Xu Shiyan closed the door for it, and then returned to the house.
"Are the two young ones asleep?" When I entered the room, I saw that there was a table in the middle of the kang in the east room, and Su Anying, Xu Haiyuan, and Xu Jinping were reading a book in their hands.
At the top of the kang, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui are sleeping soundly.
Su Anying can now recognize a lot of characters, and can read ordinary books.
As long as she has time, she will turn a few pages with a book in her hand. Just in the evening when Xu Haiyuan's brother and sister are not sleepy, the three mothers read and write while waiting for Xu Shiyan to come back.
"Well, those two have been sleepy for a long time, but these two are not sleepy, and still have to read for a while.
Your son is preparing for next semester, and your daughter is also studying first grade. "
During the day, Huang Shuqing and the others came to do their homework, and dragged Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping out to play.
In the afternoon, Xu Haiyuan had to teach Shuyun and Sun Yu about the second semester of the first grade. Xu Jinping sometimes followed her, and sometimes her little friend came to play together. Anyway, the two children are very busy.
At night, after the brothers and sisters are all asleep, I can just calm down and learn something.
"I'm watching, my daughter will be in first grade next fall.
It's useless to stay in Yuhong class any longer. If you have learned everything, you may not be in the mood to study in the future. "
Su Anying looked at the two children who were studying hard, both happy and worried.
It is a good thing that children love to study, but it is too much to study at night, who has seen such a child?
Xu Shiyan walked up to him and took a look. His son was doing math problems in the second semester of the second grade, and his daughter was practicing calligraphy with a pen and notebook.
"Daughter, who taught you to write? You are learning to write Chinese characters now, isn't it too early?"
This child just passed his fifth birthday, so it’s too early to start writing at such a young age?
Remember someone said before that if a child is too young to write, the opponent is not good?
"When my brother taught sister Shuyun and sister Tingting, I listened by the side, and I will get it."
Seeing her father coming back, Xu Jinping quickly finished writing the last few words, closed the notebook, and put the book away.
"I write four lines a day, not too much. My brother said, don't write too much, but the rules to write, you can't crawl like a spider."
Xu Shiyan burst out laughing when he heard this.
He heard this before, it was when Xu Haiyuan buried Sun Yu during the summer vacation.
Sun Yu’s handwriting is not good-looking, Xu Haiyuan said angrily, grabbing a spider and crawling over it with ink is better than Sun Yu’s handwriting.
However, Xu Haiyuan can't be blamed for this. The kid is only in the second grade, and he can already write beautifully.
He dislikes crooked characters the most, but Sun Yu writes like that.
Taught Xu Haiyuan completely, and taught him stroke by stroke. At any rate, before the start of school, Sun Yu's calligraphy could be horizontal and vertical.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Visit Han Liwei
chapters.content:
Chapter 382 Visiting Han Liwei
"Well, it's good to know, try to find time to write during the day, don't write at night, it's bad for your eyes.
Xu Haiyuan, you also remember to read and write questions during the day and try to rest your eyes at night.
Don't be young and have two short-sighted eyes. "
It is a good thing for children to love learning, but they must pay attention to the method, everything, and focus on health.
"Oh, I see, Dad." Xu Haiyuan just finished finishing the problems in the book, and quickly packed it up.
Xu Shiyan took the kang table away, Su Anying hurriedly spread the bedding, and urged the children to brush their teeth and wash their feet.
Everything was packed, and I quickly got under the covers and went to sleep.
After breakfast the next day, Xu Shiyan went to the store to buy some things, and took them to Han's house first.
Han Liwei was injured and hospitalized for so long, now that he is back, he has to go and have a look.
When the Han family saw Xu Shiyan, they were very enthusiastic, "Look at you, just come here, what are you doing with these things?
Ordinarily, it should be Liwei who went to see you. As soon as he heard that you were back the night before yesterday, he was going to go.
Didn't I hear that you are busy and can't take care of it? "Han Wenzhong went down the mountain and happened to be at home. When he saw Xu Shiyan coming, he hurriedly asked him to sit on the kang.
"Third brother, thank you, if it wasn't for the third brother who went all out with the medicine made from old mountain ginseng, I would definitely not be able to come back."
Han Liwei was also sitting on the kang, and when he saw Xu Shiyan coming in, he hurriedly put on his shoes and went to the ground.
"Okay, sit down quickly." Xu Shiyan pressed Han Liwei's shoulder to prevent him from getting off the ground.
"How's it going now? I look okay, what do you think?"
"It's okay, there is no delay in walking or anything, but I feel tired after a long time.
When I was discharged from the hospital, the doctor said that I still have to recuperate for a while. "
When Han Liwei was at 301, he was definitely treated with the highest standard. If it weren't for this, how could he have recovered so quickly and been discharged from the hospital?
Xu Shiyan glanced at Han Liwei, um, his complexion was still a little pale.
It's also normal, after all, he almost died. With such a serious injury, it is impossible for the lost vitality and blood to fully recover so quickly, and it will take a while.
"I'll make you some more medicine when I have time, take it slowly and recuperate, and you'll feel better after a while." It's not difficult, Xu Shiyan can do it.
Han Wenzhong and others were both happy and sorry when they heard this.
"Look, this has to trouble you again.
Tell me what kind of medicine to use this time. I also have a few old wild ginseng trees in my hand. They may not be as old as yours, but they will work anyway. "
Han Wenzhong has been on the mountain for so many years, so he is a veteran. Xu Shinayan learned all his skills from Han Wenzhong, and the Han family must have hidden ginseng.
"Success, I will tell Uncle Han what medicine to use then." Xu Shiyan smiled and did not give way to Han Wenzhong.
"By the way, Liwei, how did you get hurt?
That, if it falls within the scope of confidentiality, don’t mention it, don’t violate discipline. "
Xu Shiyan regretted it when he asked the words. It seems that he heard Han Wenzhong say in his previous life that Han Liwei sacrificed for a long time, and the organization only informed the family members of the reason.
"Third brother, the specific cause of the injury is indeed still in the scope of confidentiality.
I can only say that the assumption you told me at the time really happened.
Fortunately, I argued with the leader and took a team of people to investigate, but was discovered by the other party and directly exchanged fire. "
Han Liwei couldn't say too clearly, after all, it was related to the confidentiality regulations, and he couldn't reveal too much before receiving orders from his superiors.
But Xu Shiyan understood that Han Liwei should have been spotted by the monkey during the investigation with his men, and the two sides exchanged fire directly.
Han Liwei led few people, and he was seriously injured for some reason.
But looking at Han Liwei's treatment after injury, it should be Han Liwei who made a great contribution this time.
"Alas, this is also a mistake.
If I sent you a telegram asking you to come back to get married, but you didn’t have a mission, you would ask for leave after receiving the telegram.
It is estimated that he could miss the rotation, and he could not have suffered such a serious injury and almost died. "
Xu Shiyan lamented that everything is preordained, and his power as a moth is still too small to affect much.
"Third brother, you may not know our discipline.
Even if I come back, even if the wedding is in progress, as soon as the order arrives, I have to return to the team immediately.
So no matter when I receive a telegram to ask for leave, I have to go for the rotation. "
Han Liwei smiled and shook his head, how could things be as simple as Xu Shiyan thought? They have iron-like discipline, which is not allowed.
"Huh?" Xu Shiyan was stunned, did he think it was too simple?
Well, forgive him for not being a soldier in two lifetimes, so I really don’t understand.
"Forget it, no matter what you say, you are still fine, that's fine."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand in embarrassment, don't worry about that, as long as he is still there, he will be considered a success.
"By the way, when do you and Shiqin plan to get married?" Let's ask the most concerned topic.
The two of them dragged on for several years, and the wedding failed, so it should be possible by now, right?
"Well, we are thinking about it and want to go to your house to discuss this matter with the in-laws.
Today is the twenty-fourth of the winter moon, how about we hold a wedding for them on the twenty-sixth of the twelfth lunar month?
In fact, things have been prepared long ago, just let your relatives and friends know, and then you can hold a few banquets. When Han Wenzhong heard this, he quickly expressed his opinion.
"Okay, after entering the Layue Gate, every day is a good day, and any day is good for a wedding.
Uncle Han will discuss this matter with my father, and it will be fine. "
Yes, this month, Han Liwei will take care of his body again, and when the time comes, he will marry a daughter-in-law in good health, and everyone will be relieved.
Xu Shiyan still had something to do, so he didn't stay at Han's house for a long time, so after chatting for a while, he got up and left.
"Uncle Han, Auntie, let me go to work first.
I have been away for so long, and I don’t know what the venue is like, so I have to report to Secretary Lin about my studies. I'll come back when I'm free. "
"Hey, good, good, you have a job, go get busy first, wait for the Chinese New Year and everyone will be idle, let's drink together."
They are all from their own family, so there is no need to be polite.
Han Wenzhong knew that Xu Shiyan had just returned and had a lot of things to do, so he didn't bother to keep him. He only put on his shoes and went out to see him off.
"Uncle, you can do nothing else, I can go with brother Limin, doesn't he have to go to work today?"
Han Limin has taken several days off, and today is exactly Monday, so he must go back to work.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan and Han Limin left the Han family together and went straight to the field.
At the field department, Han Limin went to the technical department first, while Xu Shiyan went directly to the second floor to find Lin Qiyue.
"Secretary Lin, I'm back." Xu Shiyan knocked on the door and went in.
Lin Qiyue also just went to work, and was pouring a cup of hot water, drinking water while flipping through documents.
"Hey, Xiao Xu is back, hurry up, come over and sit down, tell me, how are you going to study at the Agricultural University these days?"
Lin Qiyue actually knew about Xu Shiyan's affair with Han Limin and others, but he didn't ask a word.
As long as it does not affect the job, there is no need to worry about the sideline business of the employees.

chapters.title: Chapter 383: idea
chapters.content:
Chapter 383 Ideas
"It's so useful. I didn't know until I went out to study. I didn't know that much before. It's really too little. I'm a frog at the bottom of a well."
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard the words. When he went to university, he would find that it was really different.
It is not only the improvement of knowledge level, but also the growth of vision and experience, which is really very useful.
Lin Qiyue nodded when he heard this.
"Yes, that's right, if it's useless to go to school, why does the country train so many college students?
Study hard, what you learn in school will be useful in the future. "
Lin Qiyue didn't say later that it's not just about knowledge, but more about the expansion and accumulation of contacts.
It is not easy for those who can go to the cadre training college to study. In the future, they will be people who can speak in various counties. If they are not guaranteed, they will be promoted.
Xu Shiyan and them are classmates, so there are many benefits.
But Lin Qiyue couldn't say this clearly, Xu Shiyan had to realize it and experience it by himself.
There are some things that everyone knows well and there is no need to say it.
"Xiao Xu, it's just in time for you to come back. Our beverage factory is currently in a bit of a difficult situation. Please help me think about it."
Lin Qiyue thought of something and happened to ask Xu Shiyan for advice.
"Secretary Lin said, what's wrong with the beverage factory? Sales?"
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, and the beverage factory seemed to have difficulties in this aspect, and nothing else.
"Isn't it just a matter of sales? You see, we have produced Coke now, but the market won't open for a while.
I actually contacted the Huacheng Soda Factory in Yangcheng, and wanted to use their sales channels, but they were not happy.
We cooperated with them for the ginseng flower soda before, but now this ginseng flower cola is made by ourselves. They can't make money at the other end, so naturally they don't want to help us. "
Lin Qiyue sighed, isn't it just about sales?
Now the factory has been operating all the time, but the beverages produced have nowhere to sell and can only be piled up in the warehouse.
Yes, you can wait for the Spring Fair. Lin Qiyue believes that if this thing is brought to the Spring Fair, as long as it works properly, there will be some orders.
But when is the Spring Fair? It's still a few months away, and I have to sell some more or less now, just look at the market feedback.
"Secretary Lin, has the order for our honey chips been shipped?"
Xu Shiyan didn't answer Lin Qiyue's words, but instead asked if the honey chips had been shipped.
"Not yet, it's only been a few days, what's the matter? Didn't we talk about drinks? Why are you talking about honey chips again?"
Lin Qiyue was taken aback for a moment, not understanding why Xu Shiyan changed the topic.
Xu Shiyan laughed, "Secretary Lin, let me give you a trick, bring them a few boxes of Coke for each honey chip order.
Let Li Cheng allow them to make up the product introduction better. Don’t they have photos of our ginseng flowers, our farm, and the spring water? Printed on.
It would be best if you could make up a few folk tales about the spring water, emphasizing that it is pure natural aerated mineral water, rich in a variety of essential minerals for the human body. "
An order does not need to come with too many gifts, mainly for customers to taste and try.
Xu Shiyan has confidence in the products of their beverage factory, especially the use of natural mineral water as raw material, which is a major selling point.
Foreigners like this. As long as the product introduction is done well and the taste of Coke is not too big, this product will definitely sell well.
As for the cost of giving away drinks, it doesn’t count.
If you spend money on advertising, you will spend tens or hundreds of times more than this, and the effect may not be as good.
In order to open up the market, it is acceptable to pay an appropriate cost.
Lin Qiyue's eyes lit up, he slapped the table excitedly, and stood up abruptly.
"Or I have to find you, take a look, and it will be resolved in one go.
Well, since you are back to work, I will leave this to you, get our product introduction out as soon as possible, and prepare for delivery. "
"Okay, I'll go back to the technical department and send tasks down." Xu Shiyan smiled, turned around and was about to leave.
"Hey, wait a minute, wait a minute, I still have several certificates and certificates from you.
You should have heard of it, right? The Changbai Mountain red ginseng and honey slices we participated in were all rated as famous and high-quality products.
Ginseng flower cola also won the provincial technical appraisal, and Changbai Mountain red ginseng won the special prize for scientific and technological progress.
How about you, you have won a provincial science and technology research award, and you have joined the industry as a technology pacesetter.
These are your things, I will keep them on your behalf, you can take them back. "
Lin Qiyue took out a portfolio from the cabinet and handed it to Xu Shiyan.
"Thank you Secretary Lin, then I'll go back to work first."
Maybe it's a bit of a habit of winning more prizes, but now Xu Shiyan is not as excited as before.
He took the file bag and didn't open it, so he hurried back to the technical department to arrange work.
Of course Li Chengrong came back to work, so Xu Shiyan assigned the task to their team and asked them to hurry up and write product introductions.
"The little story made up by the honey film last time was pretty good, go on, just follow that, it's all folklore anyway."
Xu Shiyan gave the general scope, and Li Chengrong led the team members to play the rest freely.
Having the experience of the last honey chip, it was really difficult for Li Cheng to tolerate them. The product introduction was written within two hours.
Then Li Chengrong took the materials they wrote and photos, went directly to the city, and went to a printing factory to print them directly.
Xu Shiyan went out to study for such a long time, and the work unit couldn't take care of him at all.
Although Han Limin was very capable and Corey didn't delay in anything, Xu Shiyan had to read all the relevant documents and materials when he came back.
Looking at it, it was noon, and when he came home from get off work, he found an antenna erected in his yard.
"Oh, look at my memory, I forgot to install the TV antenna. Who installed it?" Xu Shiyan asked as soon as he entered the room.
"Who else could it be? Shengli and Xiaofeng.
Today they all fixed the TV antenna, and then Shuqing went home and said that our house is not yet installed.
Isn’t it that Shengli and the others came over just now, moved the TV, washing machine, and refrigerator back from our mother, and erected the antennas, and connected everything that should be connected. "
Su Anying was busy cooking, so she didn't bother to raise her head, and replied casually.
"Oops, aren't these shops really busy today?"
These families bought color TVs, washing machines, and installed antennas all at once. The neighbors in the neighborhood saw it, why don't they go to join in the fun?
"Well, isn't it? In the morning, Shengli's house and Xiaofeng's house were full of people. Many people came to watch their TV installation.
A lot of people came to our house. At noon, they all went home to cook.
You watch it in the evening, many people will come to watch TV at home. "
Normal, whoever has a TV these days is definitely the most beautiful family in the village.
Before, Xu Chenghou installed a TV on his side, and he wished that everyone from Donggang and Xican villages could watch it. It is estimated that Xu's side will not be able to stop tonight.
"Okay, come and see, we can't say no to this thing.
Wait for another two years, and everyone will buy TVs. "
No one else has it, only a few of them have it, it must be something new.
Waiting for two years to cancel the ticket, everyone's life will be better, and everyone can buy a TV back, so it's not so rare.

chapters.title: Chapter 384: Participate in city planning
chapters.content:
Chapter 384 City Participation Planning
Xu Shiyan made an agreement with Huang Shengli, Zhou Qingguo and others that no one would tell outsiders about their making money from Clivia.
How much money you earn, it is best not to disclose even your family members, so as not to cause trouble.
Even the branch in the county and the savings bank on the Songjiang River side talked with the relevant person in charge at that time and asked them to keep it secret.
Actually, none of this works.
Such a large-scale transfer, remittance, deposit and withdrawal, even if the bank wants to help conceal it, it is impossible.
In this era when households with ten thousand yuan are rare, a county bank has absorbed more than two million deposits. Is it possible not to report it?
Xu Shiyan and the others went ahead, but the person in charge of the bank then reported to the county finance department.
Then the next day, several main leaders in the county heard the news.
The county immediately sent people to investigate, and they found Xu Shiyan.
Thanks to the fact that the bank opened an account under Xu Shiyan's name, and thanks to Guan Enxue's promotion to the top leader of the county.
After Guan Enxue heard the news, he called a participant to inquire about the specific situation.
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to talk to Guan Enxue. This is not a good thing, and it is not worth promoting.
So please ask Secretary Guan to help press this matter, and don't publicize it in the whole county. Once the public hype Clivia is aroused, the consequences will be disastrous.
Guan Enxue still values ​​Xu Shiyan very much, no matter what Xu Shiyan said is right or not, he is willing to help.
