So after hanging up the phone, he immediately ordered that anyone who knew about it should shut up and stop spreading the word.
Of course, this kind of thing is not an order from above, so it will not be passed on.
As far as the current year is concerned, how much annual fiscal revenue can a county have? There is so much money in one's hand, who is not jealous?
Some people just wanted to play tricks and tried to investigate Xu Shiyan and the others.
Check whether the business of Xu Shiyan and others is legal, whether they have not paid what should be paid, etc.
Guan Enxue wanted to protect Xu Shiyan, but he couldn't go too far, he had to do superficial things.
So he called Donggang to investigate related matters.
At Donggang, Zhou Qingguo found Chen Jianzhang on the night of the dividend.
I mentioned to Chen Jianzhang that it was Xu Shiyan's idea to build a large ginseng professional market in Donggang, with an estimated investment of 400,000 yuan.
Chen Jianzhang was so happy that he held a meeting with someone early the next morning, and the relevant leaders were all very interested in this project.
So Zhou Qingguo was asked to come up with a detailed plan, as well as a floor plan and so on.
Zhou Qingguo couldn't help Zhou Qingguo with this little thing. He had also been a scout after all, so drawing a picture was nothing to worry about.
Zhou Qingguo approached Xu Shiyan to discuss, since they have 400,000 funds in their hands, then the entire larger market will be completed in one step, and the provincial one will have to be expanded in the future.
So the roughly demarcated area is from the intersection of the Martyrs’ Tomb as a benchmark, going west to the alley in front of the primary school, and going south to the outside of the hospital wall.
That is to say, it is about less than 400 meters long from north to south and more than 200 meters wide from east to west.
It probably includes nearly twenty families, and it happens to be square and square.
Delineating the scope, making a cost budget, and formulating a relocation compensation plan, Huang Shengli and the others can't help with these tasks.
Only Zhou Qingguo and Xu Shiyan could discuss it in the evening to make it.
In addition to these, Xu Shiyan also wrote a report on the county's ginseng planting area, output, and purchase amount over the years.
According to the percentage increase in production of ginseng land fertilizer, it is speculated that within three years, the provincial medicinal materials company may not be able to purchase all ginseng, and the free trade of ginseng will inevitably become a trend.
From this report, it is deduced that if it is completed and participates in the market, the approximate range of the annual transaction volume and the additional benefits brought by the participation in the market will be obtained.
I have to say that Xu Shiyan really didn't study this university for nothing. If this thing is left behind, he really doesn't have the ability to do it.
So when a thick stack of documents was submitted to Chen Jianzhang, Chen Jianzhang was fascinated by it.
"You definitely didn't write this thing, right, Qingguo?"
After reading the beginning, Chen Jianzhang knew that this was not something that Zhou Qingguo could write.
"Well, this is written by Xu Sanshu, I can at most draw a picture for it.
Secretary Chen, do you think these materials are enough? If there's anything missing, I'll go back and add it. "
Building such a large market is by no means an easy task, and the town can't fully decide, and it has to be handed over to the county.
Chen Jianzhang is helping to check, if there is something missing, make it up now, and the province will hand it over to the county and be called back.
"Don't be in a hurry, I have to take a closer look, and if there is something missing after reading it, I will find you again.
If there is no shortage, I will send it directly to the county, and it is estimated that there will be a reply soon.
Qingguo, I think this matter is completely feasible. If the city is built, it will be very beneficial to our Donggang, and even to the county.
I will do my best to support this matter. Don’t worry, I will definitely find a way to help. "
Nonsense, the town does not need to pay a penny, at most it is a matter of relocating a few people to follow the busy work, and then the city will give the town the right to operate.
Fame made Chen Jianzhang and the others earn, and all farmers in Donggang also benefited.
Such a good thing, whoever gets in the way, is a fool.
Chen Jianzhang is very clear that if this is done, he is likely to be able to take another step forward.
From the township to the county level, it is absolutely different, and this must be done.
Chen Jianzhang was happy when the county secretary called.
As soon as he heard that someone wanted to investigate Xu Shiyan and his wife and wanted to make trouble for them, Chen Jianzhang was the first to be unhappy.
"Secretary Guan, Comrade Su Anying's farms and flower companies are all registered in our town.
And this is approved by the superior, and it belongs to the key support project of our county and our town, and there are special concessions.
This, our county also has a record, if someone is not convinced, you can check it. "
Chen Jianzhang belongs to the kind of leader who protects the calf. Even if the people under me make mistakes, no one else needs to care about them.
Besides, both the farm and the flower company follow the formal procedures, and there are special discounts, so why check them?
"There is one more thing, I just want to report to the leader.
Comrade Su Anying, together with several comrades such as Huang Shengli, Feng Chao, Zhao Jianshe, intends to invest 400,000 yuan to build a large-scale professional ginseng market of tens of thousands of square meters in our Donggang Town.
There are related planning drawings, feasibility reports, and relocation compensation plans. I immediately sent someone to the county for review by the leaders.
Secretary Guan, please finish reading the material first. I believe that after you read it, you will not be able to sleep at night if you are so happy. "
Chen Jianzhang was on the phone, secretly admiring that Xu Shiyan played beautifully.
If he didn't join the market, even if the town wanted to protect him, it would be very troublesome.
However, once the investment project of 400,000 yuan is launched, do you believe that those people in the county are not interested?
Waiting for the ginseng market in Donggang to be completed and put into use, the ginseng farmers in the entire Erxian County will benefit from it. Can the county leaders be unhappy?
Sure enough, on the other end of the phone, Guan Enxue was so happy that he almost threw the phone away.
"Old Chen, hurry up, get someone to send me all the relevant documents.
If this matter is done, I will give you a big credit. "

chapters.title: Chapter 385: Full support
chapters.content:
Chapter 385 Full Support
"Leader, it doesn't matter whether you remember your merits or not, the key is that we have to kill people in this way.
It’s not good to be jealous when you see someone who is rich, and try to find a way to check on them.
We all understand what we have experienced in the past few years.
Now that we are going to vigorously develop the economy, using these methods will deal a big blow to the enthusiasm of the people to create economic value, right? "
Chen Jianzhang is angry. Some people just can't see others getting better, and they don't want to make progress.
It's too bad to want to make trouble when you see others are capable.
"Cut, what if you haven't waited, are you protecting the calf?
Hahaha, okay, I will take care of this matter, some of the atmosphere is not very good, it should be corrected. "Guan Enxue laughed on the phone.
"Hurry up, deliver the materials, that's the big deal." After finishing speaking, Guan Enxue hung up the phone.
Here, after Chen Jianzhang hung up the phone, his expression turned ugly.
"Qingguo, you are troubled, take these materials, go to the county, and give them to the secretary."
Speaking of this, Chen Jianzhang sighed.
"Thanks to the plan for the ginseng market, otherwise, all of you would have to deal with it.
I just have that kind of pink eye disease, and I can't see others well. "The angry Chen Jianzhang wanted to curse.
Just now when Chen Jianzhang answered the phone, Zhou Qingguo was by his side. He listened to everything that was said on the phone, and he was also secretly startled at this time.
Thanks to Xu Shiyan who came up with this trick, if he did something good for the town as he said before, he might end up doing something bad, and even Chen Jianzhang and the others would be implicated.
Fortunately, thanks to Xu Shiyan's long-term perspective, they also escaped a catastrophe.
"Secretary Chen, don't worry, I'll go to the county right away." Zhou Qingguo didn't dare to neglect, immediately put away all the documents and packed them, and then went out with the documents.
At this time, the big customers who went to Fusong left early, Zhou Qingguo gritted his teeth, rode directly to the farm, and drove straight to Fusong.
When I arrived at the county, I found Guan Enxue and submitted the materials.
"Secretary Guan, here are some materials about the ginseng market that Secretary Chen sent us.
Please take a look at the secretary, if any materials are missing, I will go back and prepare. "
Guan Enxue roughly flipped through it, shook his head, "No need, all the necessary materials are there, and you have prepared very well.
From this point of view, it is Comrade Xu's handwriting, and only he has the ability to analyze the development of our county's ginseng industry in a clear and logical manner.
Success, I will immediately find someone to hold a meeting to discuss this matter, and the results will come out soon.
After the results come out, you should act quickly, negotiate the relocation related matters as soon as possible, and strive to start construction in the spring and summer of next year. "
As soon as Zhou Qingguo heard this, he was convinced that the county should give full support, and this project of participating in the city must be no problem.
So he left the secretary's office and immediately returned to Donggang.
As soon as Zhou Qingguo left, Guan Enxue immediately called for a meeting.
At the meeting, Guan Enxue took out the material and let everyone pass it on.
"Look, this is the person you want to check.
Look at his mind and vision, you guys are short-sighted. "
Guan Enxue took the opportunity to fire the fire first and discipline the relevant personnel.
"Invest 400,000 yuan to build a 60,000-square-meter large-scale professional ginseng market.
You, who could have imagined it? Who has the courage?
Focusing on petty profits every day, no one considers serious matters.
When you go back, tell me about the people below. Don’t always stare at others, think more about yourself.
It’s a new era, don’t do the same things as before, the whole county should be twisted into a single rope, and wholeheartedly promote the economy, understand? "
Guan Enxue was really angry.
Some idiots don’t know how they got here. If they don’t know anything else, they will find fault with others.
"The ginseng market, this is definitely a good idea, you see, so many of us didn't think of it, but a technical consultant participating in it, someone thought of it.
This Xu Shiyan, I really didn't let him study for nothing.
I think this plan is very good, and it will definitely play a big role in developing the local ginseng economy. "Deputy Secretary Chang Hongfa sighed after reading the materials.
After reading it, other people also said that it is indeed necessary to build a ginseng market.
Of course, some people also raised whether the ginseng market is too remote to be built in Donggang.
After all, the traffic conditions there are not very good. Some people also said that it is better to build in the county or other towns.
"Build it elsewhere, and you pay for it?
This is someone who paid out of his own pocket to do good deeds for the town. Do you think he is a living Bodhisattva and build it elsewhere? "
Guan Enxue glanced at the one who spoke, and couldn't help shaking his head. Some people are just too short-sighted.
"The road is not good, but it can be repaired. This matter should be put on the agenda.
The road from Songjianghe Railway Station to Donggang needs to be repaired as soon as possible. You can’t wait until the city is completed. If the road is not repaired, it will be too late. "
If you want to get rich, you must first build roads. This is a principle that has not changed since ancient times.
The road conditions in Songjianghe and Donggang are indeed a little worse. The situation of being covered in dirt on sunny days and muddy on rainy days must be changed.
"You guys make a related plan, and then we will report to the top.
Cooperate with Donggang Town as much as possible to complete and complete this city, not to mention supporting facilities, roads must be repaired. "
Guan Enxue is still very courageous, and immediately made a decision to fully support the construction of Donggang's ginseng market.
In this way, the county passed the application of Donggang Town.
It is agreed that Su Anying, Huang Shengli and others will invest in the construction of a large-scale ginseng trading market with an area of ​​more than 60,000 square meters within the designated area of ​​Donggang Town.
Relevant departments must fully cooperate, and no one may hinder the construction of the ginseng market for any reason.
After the county's approval, Chen Jianzhang immediately appointed Zhou Qingguo to be fully responsible for this matter, and arranged for someone else to assist.
Be sure to complete the relocation and resettlement work before the beginning of spring.
Because Huang Shengli and several others are investors, they should also participate in the construction of relevant projects and play a supervisory role by the way.
As soon as the relevant documents came out, Huang Shengli, Feng Chao and others were considered to be out of the dire straits.
Ever since they came back from the provincial capital to settle accounts and pay dividends, these companies have not stopped.
These people strictly kept secrets according to Xu Shiyan's instructions.
It is useless to tell the family that I have earned some money, without even telling the exact amount.
Many people know that Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others partnered with Xu Shiyan to cultivate Clivia.
Nowadays, Clivia is very popular, and everyone knows that Clivia can be raised to make money. Thinking about Xu’s family and the farm, who doesn’t know that Xu Shiyan has made money?
Not to mention, those militiamen have received a lot of money.
One or two can keep a secret, but if there are too many people, there will always be those who are not strict.
If one of them speaks out, the others will no longer be able to keep their secrets.
Others earn thirty or forty a month, but those militiamen pay thirty a day. Doesn't this show that Xu Shiyan and others are making a lot of money?
One more thing, these houses have added TVs, washing machines, and bought a lot of things. Some people saw that they also bought several cars.
There are so many things, but whoever has eyes can't see them?

chapters.title: Chapter 386: rich also worry
chapters.content:
Chapter 386 Rich and Troubled
At the moment, there are many people who are secretly envious and have all kinds of discussions.
Some people are very curious, so they ask all kinds of questions, wanting to know how much money these companies have earned.
But no matter how they asked, Huang Shengli and others remained silent. As for their family members, they didn't know anything about it.
But those trustworthy people are anxious, they feel like dozens of cats living in their hearts, scratching their hearts with their claws, don't mention this uncomfortable feeling.
There is not much work in the crop yard in winter, and Huang Shengli and the others are not like Xu Shiyan and Zhou Qingguo who still have a class, so they are idle at home at this time.
Some people have a wrong mind, and they go to these few companies all day long, soliciting Huang Shengli and the others to drink, play cards and so on.
Huang Shengli and others finally understood what Xu Shiyan said. Sure enough, most of the people who posted up after they had money had bad intentions.
Everyone was vigilant, and naturally they didn't want to fall into the trap of others, so they got together to discuss, what can they do to avoid these people?
Huang Shengli said that it would be better if they led the dogs up the mountain to hunt.
Don’t care if you can hit anything, it’s mainly to hide from those who don’t know what to do.
In case someone is careless one day and really falls into someone else's trap.
But Zhao Jianshe and the others disagreed, thinking it was not the case.
It seems that the Chinese New Year is coming soon, if you go hunting in the mountains and encounter some beasts, if something happens, these few families can't make it through?
To put it bluntly, something really happened to them with their current wealth, who might be the cheapest, so don't make trouble.
Instead of hunting, a few people pondered for a long time, and finally decided to simply go to the farm and learn how to drive along the way.
Men, they like to fiddle with cars and things like that.
It happened that Li Zongliang didn't have much work in winter, so a few people asked Li Zongliang to teach them how to drive.
In this way, everyone left early every day and returned home after dark at night. They squatted at the other side of the farm all day learning to drive, at least avoiding most of the people.
It’s good for outsiders to avoid them. If they come to look for them a few times and ignore them, if they don’t see the bait, they won’t come to look for it after a long time.
But relatives cannot be avoided. Who doesn’t have many relatives?
There are always those people who are jealous of people who are rich, and only want to take advantage of it, so they go home and cry about being poor all day long.
The inside and outside of the words means that your family is rich, so you have to drag and pull poor relatives.
Huang Shengli and the others, even their family members, are the same, so what can they do?
Bite the bullet and send them out one by one. Anyway, if you want money, you don’t have to die. Whatever you like, you can’t borrow money.
Obviously, if you borrow it, there will be no shadow. No one is being taken advantage of, so why do you take advantage of others.
It’s okay to offend relatives, don’t offend them now, but they will also offend them when they ask for money later, so let’s do it this way.
Xu Shiyan's side, thanks to the absence of the other brothers. Both Xu Shiqin and Xu Shian benefited, and no one disturbed them.
As for Su Anying's natal family, Su Anfang and Su Anhua have been living in Donggang all the time, and their sister and brother-in-law provide all the food, drink, and flowers, and their work is also based on Xu Shiyan.
The two sisters don't have such a thick skin, and they come to trouble the sister and brother-in-law again.
It was Xu Shiyan who told Su Anying secretly that when she was waiting for Su Anfang to have a baby, remember to give more money.
Also, when Su Anhua got married, she also gave more dowry. After all, she is her own sister, so she should take care of her as much as possible.
Xu's family is relatively stable. On Zhou Qingguo's side, both younger brothers are serving as soldiers outside. The house is quiet and no one disturbs them.
As for those relatives outside, as long as Zhou Qingguo turned black, most people would be afraid of that aura, and no one dared to speak indiscriminately.
At this time, Chen Jianzhang spoke and asked Zhou Qingguo to take charge of relocation and negotiation.
Shao Mengyong, Secretary of Xishen Village, and Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others assisted.
The news came too timely. Huang Shengli and the others had serious business to do, so they consulted Xu Shiyan seriously and formulated the detailed rules for relocation compensation.
Each household will be compensated according to the area of ​​the house and the total land area. Others, such as warehouses and pigpens, will be given some moving subsidies.
Basically, the relocation compensation for each household can more than double the current house price.
Moreover, if the relocation is completed within the specified time, a corresponding amount of rewards will be returned.
Xu Shiyan suggested that Zhou Qingguo buy a camera and take pictures from door to door, that is, the existing buildings, and make lists and take pictures.
Avoid some people's thinking and unnecessary verbosity.
So Huang Shengli and the others are very busy every day, going door to door to register, take pictures, and explain the relevant compensation rules to others.
If anyone agrees to move out, sign the agreement immediately.
The town also hurriedly approved the housing site, and wrote a note to approve various materials for building the house.
Of course, some people don’t want to build a house, so they can buy a house elsewhere with the money.
Now that I am busy with work, those few people are not at home every day. I want to find them crying poor, but I can't find a shadow.
Talk to their family members, and the family members only know one sentence.
No way, I can’t decide this matter, let’s wait until our masters come back.
One pole was spent far away, and those who wanted to take advantage had no choice but to leave.
Zhou Qingguo and the others were busy with their own work, so Xu Shiyan didn't need to come forward for this matter, he still went to work wholeheartedly.
All the ginseng honey chips have been shipped, and now we are only waiting for the customer's feedback after receiving the goods. If the customer's feedback is good, the beverage factory may have to work overtime for production next.
In addition to these, Xu Shiyan began to lead people to improve the extraction process of ginsenosides.
Before, Fusong Pharmaceutical Factory and related units developed and researched the extraction process of total saponins from ginseng leaves and stems.
There are butanol method and water alcohol method.
Butanol method, using ethanol four times the raw material, n-butanol 1.4 times the raw material, and gasoline three times the raw material, as a solvent for soaking and extraction.
Hydroalcoholic method, using twice as much ethanol as the raw material and 1.4 times as much n-butanol as the solvent.
These two methods require the use of flammable and explosive organic solvents such as gasoline and n-butanol, which are not conducive to safe production and are also harmful to the human body.
So Xu Shiyan led people to study another method, using three times as much ethanol as the raw material as the solvent.
Improve the process, increase the yield of saponin, and reduce the production cost.
After the ginseng leaves and stems are dried, they are immersed in a solvent for extraction, followed by adsorption, elution, preliminary preparation, and purification to finally obtain total ginseng saponins.
After the efforts of everyone in the technical team, the new method was finally completed.
No gasoline, n-butanol and other flammable and explosive organic solvents are used, which is conducive to labor protection and safe production, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.
The product has stable quality and high purity, especially the content of arsenic salt is lower than the national standard.
And the new method is closely integrated with production, which greatly reduces the cost.
For every ton of total ginsenosides produced, the butanol method costs 860,000 yuan, the water-alcohol method costs 680,000 yuan, and the new method developed by Xu Shiyan only costs 380,000 yuan.
Save nearly half of the cost, and have significant economic benefits.
So when the experimental data was sent to Lin Qiyue, Lin Qiyue was very happy.
"Okay, all relevant data is secured.
When you go back to school in the next year, submit the samples we made and the data directly to apply for technical appraisal.
As soon as the appraisal result came out, I sent people to register the patent as soon as possible. "

chapters.title: Chapter 387: dowry
chapters.content:
Chapter 387 Dowry
Lin Qiyue has now learned this trick. As long as he develops a new product, he must first apply for technical appraisal.
After the appraisal result came out, immediately arrange for someone to go to Hong Kong City to register the global technology patent. If others want to use this technology in the future, they must pay the patent fee first.
If you want to come here without paying the patent fee, there is no way.
"The technical department has been working hard recently. The Chinese New Year is coming up in a few days. The technical department is on vacation and will go back to work after the new year."
Lin Qiyue waved his hand and gave all the technical departments a holiday.
Indeed, the ordinary workers participating in the field basically have nothing to do in winter and can rest.
But the people in the technology department have to do research and development, develop various new products, and be responsible for the technical guidance of various venues.
This won’t work, we still have to combine work and rest, just in time for the successful development of the new technology.
Lin Qiyue hurriedly gave the technical department a holiday, so that everyone can have a good rest, so that they can devote themselves to work energetically after the year.
"Thank you, Secretary Lin, then I will tell everyone quickly that the new year is almost approaching, and the family is busy. Now I can go back and celebrate the new year with peace of mind."
Xu Shiyan was very happy when he heard it, and hurried downstairs to the technical department to tell everyone the good news.
Everyone cheered for a while, it has been really hard for a while, and besides, it’s the New Year, who doesn’t grow grass in their hearts?
So when I heard that it was a holiday, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
"That's how it is, the holiday starts tomorrow, and I go to work until the eighth day of the new year.
Still, I guess I'll have to go back to school by then.
There are no important technical projects in the next year, and the main one is Gastrodia elata production.
If possible, we should cultivate Armillaria mellea, small mushrooms, etc. to reduce costs as much as possible.
Furthermore, the cultivation of related medicinal materials such as schisandra chinensis and earthworm can also be started.
Let’s develop bit by bit. In the future, we will build a ginseng field into a comprehensive industry integrating planting, production, and processing of medicinal materials, and strive to walk on two legs and develop in multiple aspects. "
The industry is too single. Once something happens, the entire child industry will face desperation.
If it develops in many ways to form an industrial chain and have a stable industrial structure, even if one aspect is affected, it will not cause too much loss.
"Chief, don't worry, we have mastered the relevant technology, and next year we will be able to cultivate our own strains.
Waiting for another year or two of development, we will set up a separate cultivation group for edible and medicinal fungi to specialize in this.
At that time, selling bacteria and so on will make a lot of money. "Han Limin joked over there.
"Well, let alone, it's a good idea. In the future, we can grow some fungus, Hericium erinaceus, morel, ganoderma and so on.
All of these can be carried out on the old ginseng land, comprehensively utilized, and can be used in one fell swoop, which is very good.
Don’t think it’s inconspicuous, it’s amazing to really study a technology thoroughly. "
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this. The people in the technical department were brought in by him, and now their brains are alive.
No matter what you see, you will wonder if you can create some income, and if you can get in touch with the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land.
This is the benefit of expanding the mind.
"Okay, don't chat here, just go home and rest.
I've been very tired these days, so let's go home with my wife and children. "Xu Shiyan smiled and waved his hands, telling them to go home from get off work.
In this way, everyone in the technical department will have a holiday on the 21st of the twelfth lunar month, and will not go to work until the eighth day of the new year.
With such a long vacation, everyone is very happy, discussing to hurry up to buy new year's goods and so on, and prepare for the new year.
Compared to others, Xu Shiyan is busier.
Xu Shiqin is going to get married on the 26th of the twelfth lunar month. She and Han Liwei are finally going to get married after many twists and turns.
And now that he has money in his hand, Xu Chenghou said that he must organize the wedding well, so that Xu Shiqin can get married in a good manner.
With what Xu Chenghou said, the wedding must be well prepared.
Originally it was said that Xu Shiqin was married, and the family gave him a washing machine. Now that he has money, the washing machine alone feels too little.
Just when Xu Shiyan and the others made deposits, they gave away a lot of tickets, including TV sets, tape recorders and the like.
Xu Chenghou said, then simply buy them all as dowry.
Anyway, many people know that the Xu family is rich, and they can't keep a low profile if they want to, so what should they do.
Didn’t steal or grab, why can’t the money earned openly be spent openly?
Buy it when you need it, what others like to say, how can it be Chinese New Year after listening to the rabbit?
It happened that Li Zongliang was not busy at this time, so he drove Zhou Guilan, Su Anying, Xu Shiyan, and Xu Shiqin to Fusong for shopping.
When a woman enters a store and has money in her pocket, isn’t she open to buy?
Color TVs, refrigerators, tape recorders, etc. Needless to say, you can buy them when you need them.
Other high-end items such as blankets and suitcases, which I didn’t dare to look at before, are not relentless when I buy them this time.
"Little sister, buy two suitcases.
Liwei doesn't know where he can go after returning to the team after the year. The Huaquliu box that my father gave you is too heavy to take with you when you go out.
Buy two suitcases of this kind, and you can carry them around when you go out in the future. I think it is very convenient. "
Xu Shiyan saw that the suitcase looked good, so he reminded Xu Shiqin and Zhou Guilan that they had to buy a suitcase.
"Huh? You don't need to buy it, right? That suitcase is very expensive, several times more expensive than a wooden box, and it can't hold much stuff."
Xu Shiqin was a little hesitant. He spent a lot of money this morning, so why not buy a pair of suitcases? Isn't that necessary?
"No, you have to buy it. Brother Ni is right. When you get married, your natal family will give you a dowry box. This is the rule.
At that time, I will also bring you the wooden one, and add a pair of suitcases, just right. "
Zhou Guilan didn't care about that, and told the salesperson directly that she wanted a pair of bright red leather suitcases with the word "Hi".
When the salesperson saw it, he knew it was a wedding and a happy event.
Quickly followed Zhou Guilan's request, took a pair of suitcases, and asked Zhou Guilan to check that there were no defects before issuing an invoice for payment.
My mother and I went shopping in several shops in the county town, buying what we should buy and what we should not buy. Anyway, after a lot of paddling, the rear bucket of the car almost didn't fit.
At noon, the big guys didn't go to Xu Shixian's place, so they found a small restaurant to eat.
In the afternoon, I was sure there was nothing to do shopping, so I drove back.
"Oh my god, are you guys bringing the store back?"
As soon as the car arrived home, Xu Chenghou heard the noise and came out. When he saw the buckets behind the car, Xu Chenghou's jaw almost dropped in surprise. How much did he buy?
"Didn't you let us open the door to buy? Then the head of the house has spoken, so we can't do it?"
Don't look at Zhou Guilan's age, she doesn't get motion sickness in the car, and she has the energy to go shopping. Now when she hears Xu Chenghou's words, she laughs.
Xu Chenghou made his wife choke on a single sentence, yes, he said it.
He did say this before leaving the house in the morning, and let him open the door to buy. Now the man bought the things back, and he did exactly what he ordered.
"Hey, I just haven't turned around for a while, when did our family become so rich?"
Xu Chenghou smiled at his old wife, "Okay, it's good, that's how it should be, just buy more."

chapters.title: Chapter 388: tooth knocked out
chapters.content:
Chapter 388 Teeth knocked out
Actually, Xu Shiqin has almost prepared the things that Xu Shiqin will use for her wedding, and buying them later is just icing on the cake.
So it is enough to go shopping once, there is no need to go again.
On the 22nd day of the twelfth lunar month, Xu Shiyan went to the farm, led his men, and killed a batch of sheep, as well as chickens and geese.
This is not for banquets.
The Xu family is marrying a daughter, so there is no need to prepare many banquets. Later, the Han family discussed and said that the banquets will be held in the canteen.
The place over there is big, so there is no need for the Xu family to make a fuss, and the two families entertain guests together, which is also lively.
Xu Chenghou thought it was a good idea, and privately told Zhou Guilan that the Han family would not be able to pay for all of the banquet expenses when the time came.
The banquet is held together, and the Xu family does not need to buy banquet noodles. Xu Shiyan bought such meat mainly to give away.
The town and the village have contributed a lot to Clivia's matter. Although Xu Shiyan and others invested in building a market, they must express their gratitude.
The Chinese New Year is coming soon, and everyone involved will share a few catties of mutton, a chicken or a big goose, and celebrate the New Year happily.
Everyone looks good and doesn’t make mistakes, so it’s right to pay benefits. How good is that?
"When you moved to our place, I saw that you were not an ordinary person.
Look, it’s only been a few years. I went to work in the field, became an engineer, and went to college.
That's great, Uncle is really happy for you.
Not bad, the matter of participating in the market this time is too beautiful.
We went to the town for a meeting that day, and Secretary Chen even praised you, saying that you have a unique vision, and you will definitely achieve a lot in the future. "
Xu Shiyan went to deliver something to Yu Shouguang, Yu Shouguang happily dragged Xu Shiyan to talk, and praised Xu Shiyan repeatedly.
"Uncle, speaking of it, it's you and Secretary Chen who helped me.
It wasn’t my uncle who valued me at the beginning and gave me a chance to make my mark. How could I be where I am today? "
Xu Shiyan's words were sincere. He was able to get to this point thanks to meeting a nobleman.
Whether it is Yu Shouguang, Chen Jianzhang, Lin Qiyue, Guan Enxue, these people are very protective of him.
How should I put it, perhaps without the help of these people, Xu Shiyan could have achieved success, but it would never be so smooth along the way.
In this world, there are many good cadres, but there are also bad ones.
Not to mention anything else, if you meet someone like Hu Liancheng, not only will you refuse to reuse it, but you will even steal the credit behind your back.
If he met such a person, Xu Shiyan must have had a much harder time getting to where he is today.
So, a good cadre is really important.
"Look at you, what are you talking about? You are a talent, talent should not be buried, talent should shine.
Uncle believes that people like you can stand out no matter where they go.
Work hard, uncle also expects you to lead the people in our village and town to become rich together. "
Yu Shouguang looked at Xu Shiyan very pleased, and smiled very happily.
On the twenty-third day of the twelfth lunar month, Xu Shiyan didn't go anywhere that day, and stayed at home to coax the children.
Starting from the day of participation, all employees are also on vacation.
Originally, there is nothing worthy of rest in winter.
All the honey chips have been shipped, and the beverage factory has already produced a lot, but the customer feedback has not yet come, so it cannot continue to produce.
Besides, who is still in the mood to go to work at this time, just go home on vacation and prepare for the New Year.
It is supposed to be a holiday, so Su Anhua should go back to Daying, but Xu Shiqin is getting married soon, Su Anhua wants to stay and help for a few days.
Besides, when Xu Shiqin got married, Su Weizhong had to come to congratulate him, so it would be great to go home with his parents.
So Su Anhua was not in a hurry to go home after the holiday, but stayed behind to help Xu Shiqin organize things and Zhou Guilan to clean up the house.
On the day of Xiaonian, it was still the old rules, Xu Shiyan led his wife and children, and his family of six came to eat with his parents.
Zhou Guilan mixed two kinds of fillings, mutton with scallions and pork with cabbage. The mutton is wrapped into flower dumplings, and you can tell which one it is at a glance.
Children don’t know what a small year means, they only know that there will be delicious food on this day, especially candy.
Xu Shiyan is afraid of children's tooth decay, so he rarely shows them candy on weekdays, and only during the holidays can the children satisfy their hunger.
There are delicious dumplings and sweets that you can't eat on weekdays. The children are very happy.
Xu Haiqing couldn't peel off the candy wrapper, so he went to his brother and asked Xu Haiyuan to help.
Xu Haiyuan didn't know what happened today, but he suddenly became interested and purposely played with his younger brother.
After pulling it away, he pretended to put it in his mouth, so scared that Xu Haiqing rushed to grab it.
Xu Haiqing was a little fat man, and when he was in a hurry, he exerted a lot of force, and immediately threw the defenseless Xu Haiyuan back to the ground.
It doesn't matter, the key point is that Xu Haiyuan is holding up the candy and pretending to eat it.
All of a sudden, the sugar hit my teeth.
"Dad, my tooth fell out."
Xu Haiyuan covered his mouth, his small face wrinkled like a steamed stuffed bun, ran up to Xu Shiyan, and said vaguely.
"Huh? Lost teeth? Come, let Dad see."
When Xu Shiyan heard this, he quickly squatted down and asked Xu Haiyuan to open his mouth.
As a result, when Xu Haiyuan opened his mouth, he saw that one of his front teeth was missing, and there was still blood in his mouth.
"Well, it's a change of deciduous teeth, it's okay, didn't you call the front teeth to move before?
This will be dropped sooner or later, it just happened today.
Hold on, I'll get you some cotton wool. "
As Xu Shiyan said, he went to the drawer and dug out new medical absorbent cotton, rolled it into a small ball, and let Xu Haiyuan bite it.
"Where's the tooth that fell out? Give it to me, and I'll throw it on the roof for you."
In the past, when a child changed his teeth, he would throw the replaced tooth on the roof, and the child's teeth would grow back together.
Xu Haiyuan stretched out his hand, and there was a tooth in his palm.
Not letting the children eat too much sugar, and brushing their teeth frequently is still useful. Xu Haiyuan's teeth are quite intact.
Unlike the children of later generations, many children have rotten teeth.
"Dad, it's okay not to throw it away, I want to keep it." Xu Haiyuan felt that it was a pity to throw it away, so it's better to keep it as a souvenir.
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, "That's fine, then you can keep it for yourself and don't lose it."
It’s just an old custom to drop teeth and throw them on the roof. If children don’t want to throw them away, they want to keep them as a souvenir, so let’s keep them.
Xu Haiyuan got his father's permission, Le Diandian went to Guan Zhou Guilan to ask for a brown glass bottle filled with medicine, put his own teeth into the glass bottle, and put it away carefully.
"The next time I lose a tooth, I'll put it in, and I won't lose every tooth."
The little guy bit the cotton ball, slurred his speech, but looked smug.
"Okay, it's all up to you." Xu Shiyan stretched out his head and rubbed the top of his son's head. This baby has an idea.
"Xu Haiqing, did you see that? Your brother lost a tooth.
If you always think about eating candy all day long, your teeth will fall out one by one, and you will have no teeth to eat delicious food. "
The two older ones can no longer be confused, but the younger one is okay.
While they are still young, they can still scare them for a few years, hurry up, it will be hard to fool them in a few years.
Xu Haiqing is already stupid.
Watching my brother take a bite of candy, a tooth fell out, and his mouth was full of blood.
Hearing what his father said again, the child burst into tears and quickly threw the candy aside.
"Dad, I don't eat candy anymore, I won't eat candy anymore."

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Keep warm
chapters.content:
Chapter 389 Keeping warm and cold
Xu Haiqing cried so much, Zhou Guilan and Xu Chenghou couldn't bear it anymore, and they hugged and coaxed them as soon as they were busy.
But was stopped by Xu Shiyan, "It's okay, let him improve his memory, so that he won't be thinking about eating all day long.
Eat to become a little fat man, it’s not good for a child to be too fat. "
Now the family's living conditions are better, there is no shortage of food, and they eat meat every now and then, and the children they raise are quite fat.
Xu Haiqing is especially greedy, no matter what he eats, he can't have enough. This problem is not good, so he has to take care of it.
"Who said that? It's good for the child to be fat. When you were young, you were skinny, and you almost couldn't support yourself."
Xu Chenghou heard it and felt that what his son said was wrong.
People who have passed through those difficult years are rare in fat dolls, who look healthy.
"Father, the years have changed, so we can no longer look at things with old eyes.
When you were in the provincial capital, what did the doctor tell you?
If a child is obese since childhood, the heart and brain will be affected, which is not good. "
Obesity affects not only appearance, but also health.
Xu Shiyan met the kind who was very fat when he was a child and did not develop in adolescence. The parents at home were anxious and asked the child to lose weight.
The result is that the weight loss is too fast, and all organs of the body can't bear it, the hormone secretion is abnormal, and the blood sugar is low. Later, it was found that he also had a heart problem, and he fell ill and was hospitalized every now and then.
So obesity is a big deal and must be controlled from an early age.
Xu Chenghou had nothing to say when he heard this.
When he was in the hospital, the doctor told him to eat less greasy food and animal offal.
People say that money can't buy you old and thin.
Xu Chenghou worked as an adult, but he wasn't fat, but people of his age loved to eat fat.
The doctor said that this habit is not very good and should be changed as much as possible. You can eat some lean meat and high-protein food to supplement nutrition, and you should mix meat and vegetables.
Don't look at Xu Chenghou, who always disagrees with others and is always energetic, but he doesn't dare to talk to the doctor.
Since she came back from the provincial capital, she has taken the initiative to control her diet, try to eat less greasy and fatty food, and let Zhou Guilan cook as lightly as possible.
So when Xu Shiyan said it now, Xu Chenghou was speechless.
"Forget it, your son, do whatever you want, I won't talk about it."
Don't look at Xu Haiqing who was crying just now, but he was young after all, so he didn't concentrate that much.
Hearing grandpa and dad talking, he stopped crying and stood there.
When Xu Shiyan finished talking to his father, Xu Haiqing stopped crying, and there were only two tears still hanging on his cheeks.
This big-hearted baby, listening to other people chatting, he forgot to cry.
Xu Shiyan glanced at his son, but was also speechless. This baby, alas, what will happen in the future?
After dinner, it’s late, so we should hurry home in this cold weather.
Then the couple dressed the children properly, holding the little one in their hands, followed by the big one, and hurried back home.
Thanks to the fact that when I came back to burn the kang in the afternoon, I also turned on the stove, so the room was okay and not too cold.
There is still a fire in the stove, throw in a few pieces of firewood to re-ignite, and then throw in two pieces of pimples, and the night is almost over.
"I think next summer, the three rooms at the east end will be rebuilt.
I just took the opportunity to install the heater. It is more convenient and cleaner than the stove to turn on the heater in winter.
Especially for this furnace, it takes a few days to pour cans and bottles. "
While talking, Xu Shiyan untied the canning jar from the stove, took it out and poured it out.
Xu’s house built a fire wall at that time, the stove was outside, and half of the partition wall was a fire wall, and then the furnace tube was connected to the top, and it went out through the front window.
The advantage of burning the stove in this way is that when the fire in the stove starts, the barrel of the stove will heat up first, and the room will then heat up.
Wait until the fire wall is also hot, you can continue to dissipate heat, and keep the room at a certain temperature.
But there is also a disadvantage, that is, the furnace will drip water.
Especially in the sections near the window, when there is no heat in the stove, the cold air from outside will pour in and condense on the inner wall of the stove tube.
When the fire is lit again, water will drip down.
Don’t underestimate the furnace water, it smells of rust and is very corrosive.
Clothes or something dripping with stove water will rot soon.
So as long as every household needs to burn a stove, they have to prepare a few cans and bottles, wrap iron wire around the mouth of the cans and bottles, and then tie them to the stove tube to catch water.
After a few days, you have to take down the canning jar and pour out the black water in it, otherwise the water will overflow and the things underneath will suffer.
Compared to burning a stove, heating is cleaner, and the heat dissipation time of the heating is longer, and there is no stove or anything in the house, so it is not a problem.
Press the coal in the boiler at night to keep it warm all night. When you get up early the next day and turn on the stove, it will heat up quickly.
Of course, coal is used for heating, and you need to spend money to buy it. Unlike firewood, you can just go up the mountain to collect firewood in winter.
"You can do what you say. If you say build a house, we will build it. If you say it has heating, we will do it. It doesn't cost much anyway."
Su Anying was coaxing the two children to sleep in Zhengpu, and smiled when she heard it.
It doesn’t matter what kind of stove is used for heating, as long as it can keep warm.
"Well, when winter comes next year, put shelves in the yard and fasten the entire south wall with a plastic shed.
In this way, the room can be much warmer, which is better than our current light-sealed windows. "
Xu Shiyan remembered the method of the later generations with plastic sheds on the outside of the house.
Buckle up the plastic shed, which can keep out the wind, the sun is shining during the day, the temperature in the shed is high, and children can play in the shed.
When it was night, there was a layer of plastic shed to block it, and the temperature was much stronger than without buckle.
No way, the winter in the Northeast is really too cold, especially the bungalows. In winter, it feels that no matter how many fires are burned, it will not be warm.
In order to keep warm from the cold, people can only think of various ways.
At the beginning, the windows were sealed with plastic sheets, then the sheds were closed with greenhouse film, and later, the outer walls were kept warm.
All kinds of means are used, that is, to keep warm in winter.
"Duct the plastic shed? I don't know much about this, so it looks like the flower shed we built?"
Speaking of this, Su Anying was a little confused, the key is that she has never seen it before, so she doesn't understand.
"Well, almost, I will draw it for you when I have time, and teach you how to do it.
I guess I was still studying at school at that time, and I have to leave all the things at home to you. "
Xu Shiyan went to fetch water and asked the two elders to wash their feet. After the two elders finished washing, he changed the water and washed them himself, and then wiped his feet on the kang.
"It's getting late, you two are not allowed to read tonight, go to bed early.
It’s time for people to come to the house the day after tomorrow. When the time comes, there will be a lot of people with grandparents, so you two will study at home. "
Xu Shiqin went out on the 26th of the twelfth lunar month, and relatives and friends would be able to come almost tomorrow or the day after tomorrow.
Xu Shiyan had to tell the children in advance, don't let them start to compete with each other when there are too many people at home, and they can't get rid of them anymore.
"Understood, Dad, I watch my younger brothers and sisters and don't let them be naughty."
Xu Haiyuan had a serious face with a small face.
"Okay, our family is still the best, I know to help Dad share."
Not to mention, the little guy has grown up very fast in the past six months, much more stable than before, and looks like a big brother.
Good boy, great performance.

chapters.title: Chapter 390: are back
chapters.content:
Chapter 390 is back
On the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth lunar month, the Xu family slaughtered pigs.
Although Xu Shiqin is married, there is no need to hold banquets here to entertain guests, but he has to prepare some food to entertain relatives from afar.
Besides, don’t you have to prepare for the New Year?
The Xu family has been like this for the past few years, killing pigs and celebrating the New Year with excitement.
No matter what age, killing pigs during Chinese New Year is the most lively event.
In the yard, a large iron pot was set up, with dry firewood under it, and the water in the pot was boiling with white flowers.
The pig butcher raised the knife with a sharp knife in his hand, and the big fat pig let out a few desperate screams before falling silent.
Here, the pig blood should be picked up. After the pig's blood is picked up, hot water is poured immediately to remove the hair, open the meat, and then cut the meat into pieces.
Then wash what should be washed and cut what should be cut. Put a pot of meat in the big pot, and cut a big pot of sauerkraut at the other end.
Come and serve a pot of stewed sauerkraut with big bones, or sauerkraut white meat blood sausage. It is very beautiful to have a hot meal.
The Xu family slaughtered a pig for a wedding, Zhao Jianshe and others stopped what they were doing and came to help.
Xu Shian was also there. He was in the provincial capital before passing by. Xu Shian, Huang Shengli and others were also familiar with each other and got along well.
The big guys were talking and laughing together, grinning big and so on from time to time, it was lively and interesting.
Being busy with work, Xu Shixian, Xu Shide, and Xu Shixiang's family also arrived together.
Needless to say, this must have been an appointment in advance, and we came back together.
"Yo, did the family slaughter a pig? It's so lively." Xu Shixian smiled when he saw the scene in the yard as soon as he entered the gate.
"Father, mother, the fourth and fifth children and I are back. The sixth younger sister is going out the day after tomorrow. Let's come back and see if there is anything we can do to help?"
The brothers all carried things in their hands. After greeting everyone in the yard, they entered the east room with smiles on their faces.
In the east room, Xu Chenghou was chatting with Zhao Dahai, Yu Shouguang, Zhou Changhe and others.
It’s a New Year’s slaughter pig, and you must invite relatives and friends to come and have fun.
Hearing his son's voice, Xu Chenghou showed a kind smile on his face at the right time, and looked up at the door of the house.
I saw three sons leading their wives and their children, and a dozen people came in from outside.
"Yo, you're back so early? Still thinking that you have to get home tomorrow.
Aren't you busy at work? Is it okay to ask for a long time off? " Xu Chenghou asked with a smile.
"It's okay, seeing the Chinese New Year is coming, who wouldn't take a few days off to make New Year's goods?
Father, Mom, how are the two elders doing recently? Are you okay? "
Before anyone else could speak, Xue Xiulin was the first to speak, and while speaking, she put the things in her hand on the table.
"Well, it's almost Chinese New Year, and there are quite a lot of goods sold in the county these days.
Buy some food for the family, just to save the elders from buying new year's goods. "
"Fourth and fifth, put down the things in your hands, it's strange to carry so many things."
Xue Xiulin winked at her brother-in-law and sister-in-law, telling them to say something and put their things down.
"Father, mother, what sister-in-law said is that we don't come back often, and we buy something for the family, and the two elders keep it to eat slowly."
On the other end, Xu Shixiang and the others came to their senses and quickly put everything on the table.
The three families did buy a lot of things, and the ones on the ground stood aside, and half of the tables were piled up.
"Look, it's not easy for you to go to work and earn that little salary, why spend so much money?
Your mother and I don’t need anything, and the young couple have bought everything they should buy. "
Xu Chenghou didn't even look at the things on the table, he just smiled at the children.
"Jingyi, Jingwen, come, come to grandparents, let grandparents see, is our good granddaughter getting fat again?"
The old man clapped his hands and greeted the two little granddaughters with a smile.
I didn't want Xu Jingyi and Xu Jingwen's two babies, but each hugged their mother's thigh, and refused to find Xu Chenghou.
Wu Qiuyan and Chen Chunling's expressions immediately changed, and each gave their daughter a push.
"What are you doing? Your grandparents miss you and want to hug you, why don't you come forward? What the **** are you?"
The two little girls pursed their mouths and were about to cry. When Zhou Guilan saw it, she hurried down to the ground, took out a few pieces of candy from her pocket, and distributed them to the two granddaughters.
"Come on, grandma has delicious food here, two yuan per person."
The two girls stopped crying when they saw Tang, and each took Tang in their hands.
"How old is the child? What is your rivalry with the child?
They come back twice a year, and usually don’t look at us, so why not give birth? Just tell them well. "
Zhou Guilan was not very happy, and glanced at the two daughters-in-law.
Wu Qiuyan and Chen Chunling each opened their mouths, wanting to speak but didn't know what to say.
At this moment, Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu who were next to her came over and hugged Zhou Guilan with smiles on their faces.
"Grandma, we miss you, and you won't go to the county to live for a few days."
Xu Jinfeng is fourteen, the fifteenth year of the new year, Xu Jinxiu eleventh, the twelveth year of the new year.
Both of them are old and sensible, and they both grew up with Zhou Guilan, so they have feelings after all, and they kiss each other when they meet.
Zhou Guilan smiled when she saw the two granddaughters, "Oh, I haven't seen each other for half a year, and the two children have grown up again, and the longer they are, the more handsome they are.
Old Xu, look, our granddaughter has grown into a big girl. "
For the old lady, her grandchildren are her treasures, especially the ones she brought up since she was a child, which really hurts her heart.
"Grandma, and me, why don't you say that I have grown into a young man?"
Xu Haibin jumped out from behind his sister, pouted and said.
"Isn't that right? You are a serious young man.
Oh, looking at you children, me and your grandpa, my heart is so beautiful. "
Xu Haibin, who is nine years old this year and will be ten years old in the next year, has inherited the Xu family's tall gene, so he is indeed not short.
It's just that his personality is eccentric and mischievous. He is definitely a naughty monkey.
Of course, in the eyes of grandparents, no matter how naughty he is, he is their grandson, which is rare.
"Quick, come here, go to the kang, and grandma will find something delicious for you."
Zhou Guilan dragged the two little girls, Xu Jingwen and Xu Jingyi, and greeted the older ones, and they all went to the kang.
Xu Jinfeng, Xu Jinxiu, and Xu Haibin all came to Grandpa right now.
Xu Haibin beat his grandfather's back, Xu Jinfeng filled his grandfather's cigarette pouch, and Xu Jinxiu took a match to light the fire.
The three children wandered around their grandfather, making Xu Chenghou so happy that they made him happy, and the wrinkles on their faces deepened a lot.
But Xu Haiyang was the only one standing beside Xu Shide, he neither stepped forward nor spoke to his grandparents, but quietly looked at everyone in the room.
Wu Qiuyan couldn't help being a little angry when she saw her son like this, so she pushed Xu Haiyang.
"Look at you, you said you missed your grandparents when you were at home, why don't you say a word here?
Hurry up, go talk to your grandparents? "
Xu Haiyang was pushed by his mother, turned to look at Xu Shide, saw his father pouting at him, Xu Haiyang walked to the front of the kang.
"Grandpa, Grandma." He called out in a moderate tone.
"Hey, hey, good, our Haiyang has also grown taller, have you gone to school yet? Is it time for first grade?"
Xu Cheng smiled thickly and dragged Xu Haiyang to him, and asked.
"Father, Haiyang hasn't started elementary school yet, go in autumn." Wu Qiuyan explained later.
"Oh, I haven't gone to school yet.
Look at me, I can’t remember clearly when I’m old, Haiyang is eight years old after the Chinese New Year, right?
I thought Yuanyuan was in the second grade, how could Haiyang be in the first grade? "

chapters.title: Chapter 391: child leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 391 Child leader
The sons rarely came back, and the family reunion was extremely lively.
"Mom, where are the third siblings? Why haven't you seen Yuanyuan and Pingping?"
Xue Xiulin looked around, but she didn't see Su Anying's shadow in the room, not even the children from the third family's family, she couldn't help being surprised.
"Huh? Isn't Yingzi busy cooking in the yard? Then she probably went home to light the fire.
Yuanyuan leads a group of children to do their homework at home, the room is too cold.
It’s okay, I’ll have dinner later, and call them all over. Zhou Guilan looked up and smiled.
The slaughter of pigs here is crowded and chaotic, so Su Anying told the children to stay at home.
It's time to study and study, just play for a while, don't come to join in the fun, just call them when you are waiting for dinner.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui are too young, if they can't see them, there is fire and hot water in the yard, what should they do if they get hurt?
"Oh, I thought my siblings were busy with something. If she can't be busy, we'll go over and help."
Xue Xiulin smiled, and asked tentatively, "Mom, have all the Clivia at home been sold? Are there any more?"
Zhou Guilan was happy coaxing her children to play, when she heard this sentence, her smile gradually faded.
"Well, you sit down first, I'll go out and see how the meat in the pot is, if it's ready, let's have dinner."
Zhou Guilan didn't pick up on this, and went out with her shoes on to see if the food was ready.
In the yard, Su Anhua, Ji Yufeng, and the wives of Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others are all busy.
Seeing Zhou Guilan coming out, he greeted with a smile.
"Auntie, the meat is ready, take it out and let it cool down, just cut it and put it on a plate, and the rice is also stewed, the gold and silver rice is delicious."
Gold and silver rice is usually cooked with small ballast and rice. After the rice is cooked, there are yellow and white rice grains, so it is called gold and silver rice.
But Xu’s is different today, using rhubarb and rice.
Rhubarb rice is glutinous, and when cooked with rice, the rice is sweet and soft, yellow and white in color, delicious and beautiful.
"Thank you for your hard work. Everyone in the cold weather came to help. Call the children over later and have dinner together."
Zhou Guilan didn't show politeness to them either, she just said thank you.
Those who can come to help today are because of their relationship. If they are too polite, they will be obviously unfamiliar.
"Mother, don't call them over to eat, those live monkeys are too disruptive.
After a while, we can fill up the food and send it over. Let them do it over there. After we have done enough, we will go back and clean up. "
Zhao Jianshe's daughter-in-law Li Chunlan said with a smile.
There are a lot of people here, especially the children of the Xu family are back. With so many children together, it will be bad if they fight again.
The two groups of people on the left and right can't get together, so it's better to eat separately.
Those brats are more at ease when they are not in front of adults.
Zhao Tingting and Yang Jianguo are both grown up, especially Xu Haiyuan, even though he is younger, he is the leader of that group of children.
As long as Xu Haiyuan is not drifting away, and he is in charge of the place, those brats will not dare to swear, and they will do their homework and eat honestly.
"That's okay, anyway, the dishes are the same, so put more meat for the children."
This is indeed the case, children are not in front of adults, so feel free, okay, let the children play.
While talking, Su Anying came back. She was indeed going home to see the children just now, and she took the opportunity to light a fire.
"Sister-in-law, how is the house? Has the roof been lifted?"
When Ji Yufeng saw Su Anying came back, she deliberately joked.
"It's not bad, they are all very good, Yuanyuan watched them practice calligraphy.
Our family, Xu Haiyuan, said that if anyone does not write beautifully today, they will not be allowed to eat meat.
All of them are anxious to eat meat, and they all write well. "
Su Anying wanted to laugh when she thought of what she saw when she went home just now.
In Westinghouse, everyone who goes to school or is about to go to school, no matter how big or small, even Zhao Tingting and Yang Jianguo, are supervised by Xu Haiyuan to practice calligraphy.
Xu Haiyuan still held a pointer in his hand, while watching Sun Yu and Yang Jianjun write, he scolded others with a stern face, thinking their handwriting was ugly.
"Your Xiaoyu and our Pingping, those who coax the little ones, both care about my fox and hang around the rascal."
Yang Haoyu and Xu Jinping are very smart. They have basically finished the first semester of primary school.
It is estimated that these two are the reason Xu Haiyuan stared at them all day long. Both of them have good handwriting, so they are allowed to coax the children to play.
The younger ones are rare in Laipigui, and Laipigui is also very patient with children, and they don't get annoyed by rubbing them casually.
The house is not as messy as expected, but rather quiet and harmonious, and the children are very well behaved.
"Sister-in-law, Ni Jiayuanyuan is really amazing, he can control those monkeys."
Yang Chunming's daughter-in-law Hu Yanqiu laughed when she heard this, but was more emotional.
They are all children, Xu Haiyuan went to school at the age of six, and he can also be the class monitor with excellent character and learning.
The children of their family went to school at the age of eight, but they knew everything about playing.
Therefore, it is not unreasonable for Xu Haiyuan to become the leader of the children.
No matter what time it is, ability comes first, regardless of age, a capable person, no matter how young, can be the leader.
"Mom, since the food is ready, let's clean up and eat?
Eat early and rest early, relatives from every family will arrive tomorrow, so it must be very busy. Su Anying turned her head and asked Zhou Guilan's opinion.
Zhou Guilan nodded, and everyone started to work together, serving vegetables and rice.
The Xu family killed two pigs today, cooked the meat in a big pot, cooked the rice in a big pot, and steamed the steamed buns in advance, so it doesn’t matter if you open them up and eat them.
Sauerkraut white meat blood sausage, sauced big bones, garlic paste white meat, pork offal platter.
Anyway, it doesn’t require much refinement, as long as the quantity is large and full.
All the meals were served in small enamel pots and served on the table, and the cooking started.
"Sister-in-law, you go back to eat, I will stay and watch the children, tell my sister, don't wait for me."
Su Anhua, together with Li Chunlan and Ji Yufeng, brought a lot of meals back to the children and arranged for them to eat.
Originally Ji Yufeng said she wanted to stay, how could Su Anhua let her?
Urged Li Chunlan and Ji Yufeng to go back to eat quickly, as long as she stayed and took care of the children.
Ji Yufeng and Li Chunlan didn't want to argue with Su Anhua after seeing it, so they only told the children not to be naughty.
"Eat well, listen to my aunt, don't cause trouble, if anyone is mischievous, I will beat him later."
Auntie, of course it was Su Anhua. Among these children, except for Zhou Zhicheng and Zhou Cuiling from Zhou Qing Country, everyone else was named after Xu Haiyuan.
"Understood." A group of children responded in unison.
Just like that, Li Chunlan and Ji Yufeng returned to Xu Chenghou's house.
When I entered the room, I saw that there were men on one table on the Kang in the East Room and one table on the floor in the West Room, and women with their children.
"Sister-in-law, sister Anhua is staying there, she said she wants to watch over the children." Ji Yufeng sat down next to Su Anying and said in a low voice.
Before Su Anying could say anything, Wu Qiuyan suddenly said, "Sister-in-law three, what about Haiyuan and the others?
Haiyang has been talking about looking for Haiyuan to play all day long at home, why didn’t I see Haiyuan and the others come over for dinner. "
Originally, I wanted to ask for leave today, but I had a headache, but I still gritted my teeth and wrote it out.
The author suffered from nervous headaches in high school, the kind that hurts like **** and makes you want to hit the wall. I don't know why in those years, but it was very serious. I took all kinds of headache medicines, and even took a lot of strong painkillers. When there is really no other way, I just take painkillers and sleeping pills, and force myself to fall asleep, because the pain is so unbearable.
In the end, the headache didn’t get better, the stomach was broken, neurasthenia, and various problems.
In those years, in order to cure the headache, the family really tried their best, but it was useless. In the end, my studies were delayed, and I could only go home to farm and work.
Maybe that’s the fate. After I don’t go to school, I don’t take injections or take medicine, and my headache gradually gets better.
However, in the past few years, the code words are probably due to the use of the brain, and they have started to make mistakes after good times and bad times.
Before writing this book, I actually took a half-year rest and took medicine to recuperate. However, there are too many things at home recently, I am upset, and I am under the pressure of using my brain and updating, so I have started to feel weak these days, my head hurts faintly, and I feel dizzy every day.
I try to keep up to date, and if I can't hold on one day, I will ask for leave.
Sometimes I think, if I had the perseverance I have now when I was studying, I would grit my teeth and insist on finishing school, even if I take a junior college exam, I can still get a job. Therefore, it is true that if you can’t bear the hardships of learning, you have to suffer the hardships of life.
Maybe this is why I am obsessed with letting the protagonist read books. I failed to do it, and I hope that the characters I write can do it.

chapters.title: Chapter 392: various thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 392 Various thoughts
Su Anying was stunned when she heard the words, Xu Haiyang from the fourth family wants to play with Xu Haiyuan?
Hehe, why do you sound so unbelievable? Although these two children are only two months apart, they have never been able to play together.
Xu Haiyang came back twice a year, and every time he came back, he would leave as if he was picking up a fire.
The children separated before they got to know each other well.
By the way, the attitude of the sisters-in-law this time is a bit strange, is it too enthusiastic?
As soon as Su Anying entered the room just now, she felt that the attitude of these sisters-in-law towards her has changed drastically.
Seeing her enthusiasm, is it true that my sisters are like that?
"It's okay, let Haiyang go there later, just find Yuanyuan to play.
The main purpose is to kill pigs, and there is fire and hot water here. My mother and I were worried about the children, so we let them play there.
I haven’t seen each other for a long time, my little buddies, why don’t you panic? "
Su Anying didn't have the nerve to tell her sisters-in-law's thoughts, but just pretended not to know.
"Sister-in-law three, let's live at your side tonight. It just so happens that a few children are playing together, and it's also lively."
On the other end, Chen Chunling also expressed her affection to Su Anying very enthusiastically.
"Okay, anyway, we have a lot of houses. I will burn more fire in the west room at night. You can just live in there."
The sisters-in-law took the initiative to show their favor, what can Su Anying do? Can you still keep your face down? That would be outrageous.
Relatives have to arrange accommodation when they come, let alone brothers?
Live as long as you want, at most two days, it’s almost Chinese New Year, who can live outside all the time?
After Xu Shiqin got married, these people had to go home quickly.
Xue Xiulin secretly glanced at her mother-in-law when she heard what her sister-in-law said.
She deliberately mentioned Clivia before, but her mother-in-law didn't take it up at all. It seems that she really asked about it from the third daughter-in-law.
The third daughter-in-law is simple-minded, careless, unable to withstand cross-examination, and she can tell when asked.
It's just that the two sisters-in-law both said that they were going to live with the third child, so Xue Xiulin couldn't bring it up, otherwise the in-laws would be unhappy.
The parents-in-law in her family are very smart, and they can't be fooled, so it's better to be safe.
Zhou Guilan sat at the table on the kang, surrounded by her daughter and grandchildren. While serving the children, she glanced at the table on the ground and sighed softly. These daughters-in-law, their minds are like a sieve, and they are all shrewd. I don't know if the third daughter-in-law can handle it?
The West House is harmonious and lively on the surface, but secretly they have their own thoughts, and the East House is actually not too much behind.
Xu Shixian and the others dragged Xu Shiyan to drink, while inquiring about how Xu Shiyan was studying in the provincial capital.
Xu Shixiang was intentional or not, so he brought the topic to Clivia.
The people in this room, except for Yu Shouguang and Yang Junxian, are basically related to the Clivia business.
Yang Junxian mainly met Xu Shiyan late. Although the two families are relatives, they don’t have much economic contact after all. At that time, Xu Shiyan didn’t take Yang Junxian with him.
The relationship has gotten closer in the past two years, but Clivia's business has already been finalized, and there is no way to add more people.
This year's ginseng soil, Xu Shiyan also counted Yang Junxian as one.
Although Yang Junxuan is now the village secretary of Dongsan Village, but that little salary is really not worth it, and the family has to grow sticks.
Xu Shiyan didn't have any other intentions. The left and right were partnered to criticize ginseng soil. It doesn't matter if you bring Yang Junxian one more.
Xu Shixian and others inquired round and round, but Yu Shouguang and Yang Junxian did not participate. They really didn't understand and had nothing to answer.
But Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli participated in the whole process, so they can't hear it?
Don't look at Zhao Jianshe who is careless and heartless all day long, but today, his mouth is very strict.
No matter how Xu Shixiang, Xu Shixian and others inquired, Zhao Jianshe and others didn't know what to ask, or deliberately avoided the topic, and ignored the problem at all.
Xu Shiyan sighed in his heart while eating, the meal was really tiring.
I originally wanted to take this opportunity to have a good chat with Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli, but now I can't mention anything.
Well, wait for the Chinese New Year. I’m free in the first few days, so I’ll call my brothers over and have a good chat.
"Boss and fifth, have a good meal.
Today is our family butchering pigs, the big guys are here to help, and your sixth younger sister will go out the day after tomorrow. I'll talk about other things later. "
Xu Chenghou who was sitting on the kang couldn't stand it anymore, and spoke.
He had guessed a long time ago that these few came back early, definitely not to come back to help, there must be other things.
If they didn't have a plan, could they ask for more leave and come back? Is it possible?
No one responded, Xu Shixian was as anxious as a cat scratching, but there was nothing he could do.
Dad had already spoken, but they didn't dare to mention it again, so they had to hold back and eat first.
It was supposed to be a lively meal, but everyone didn't talk much and didn't drink much.
"Third brother, there is a happy event at home. All relatives will come tomorrow. There must be a lot of things to do. Let's go to bed early today.
That, let's not bother, the meat today is all stored outside separately, remember to pack it up later.
If you want to employ someone at home tomorrow, just go and call us. "Zhao Jianshe and the others got up to leave after eating and drinking enough.
"What time is it? Sit for a while before leaving.
You can see that I have been busy for a long time today, and I didn't take a break. I am tired. Let's sit down and chat for a while. "Xu Chenghou had no choice but to persuade him to stay.
"Uncle Xu, you don't need to stay. Is there anything else to say about our relationship?" Zhao Jianshe stepped forward to support his father Zhao Dahai, and smiled.
"One day after I go out, the house has to be lit, and besides, I have to pick up those naughty buns in my house.
I don’t know what happened at the third brother’s house on this day? "
"You are content, the third girl is well-behaved and obedient, they are not bad." Xu Chenghou laughed as soon as he heard it.
While joking, the women brought their children back, and Zhao Jianshe and others left one after another, leading their wives and children home.
Xu Shiyan had to go out to see him off, and walked outside the gate.
Yang Chunming glanced back, "Third Brother, are your brothers also greedy for Clivia's business?
We didn’t take them with us before, can we be unhappy with you this time? "
Yang Chunming was a little worried. Xu Shiyan would rather bring his friends to earn money instead of bringing his own brothers.
Now that the Xu family brothers are back, can they trouble Xu Shiyan?
"It's okay, there is our old man, he was the one who refused to take it."
Xu Shiyan didn't mean to shirk, but just reassured Yang Chunming and others.
Clivia's business, Xu Shiyan didn't expect to make money like this at the beginning. At that time, he thought that it would be good to earn a hundred and eighty thousand.
Now that they earn so much money, Xu Shixian and the others know it, and it is normal to feel aggrieved.
The brothers of the Xu family can get angry if they want to, and it has nothing to do with Xu Shiyan.
In recent years, Xu Shiyan has treated his brothers well enough.
Hadn’t he brought his brothers to earn money back then, could all of them move out of the big house smoothly?
Is it because they have no family in their hearts, they don’t care about their family, and they want others to think of them? How can there be such a good thing in the world?

chapters.title: Chapter 393: can't wait
chapters.content:
Chapter 393 Can't wait
Xu Shiyan went out to see off his friends, while Su Anying went back to bring her children over.
After all, the uncles and aunts are back, so it’s wrong for the children to avoid seeing each other.
On the way, Su Anying told the children that they should call people when they meet each other, and that they should also be intimate with brothers and sisters, and that they should not argue or fight.
So when Xu Haiyuan and the others entered the door, they were very sensible and called people one by one, making Xu Shixian and the others very rare.
"Yuanyuan, come quickly, let aunt see you.
I heard that you passed the double hundred exam at the end of the semester, are you still a triple-good student? Oh, it's amazing, much better than your sisters and brothers.
This child is smart at first glance, and he will definitely be promising in the future. "
Xue Xiulin grabbed Xu Haiyuan's hand and praised Xu Haiyuan.
The Xu family moved here from Kuandian.
The rule in my hometown is that aunts are not usually called aunts, but aunts.
The second aunt is not called the second aunt, but the second mother.
If you don't know what's going on, you may think that this is because your father has married several daughters-in-law.
Xu Haiyuan and the others have called their elders this way since they were young, but they are used to it and don't find it strange.
But Xu Haiyang, Xu Jingyi, and Xu Jingwen probably didn't live with their grandparents, so they weren't affected.
They don’t call it that way, it’s all the aunts, the second aunts, and the third aunts.
So when the Xu family came back for the holidays, they called them indiscriminately, aunt, aunt, whatever.
Xu Haiyuan was not used to being held by the hand.
I wanted to pull my hand out, but I was afraid that my aunt would be unhappy, so I had no choice but to endure it.
Xue Xiulin praised him, but he couldn't answer it, and he couldn't answer it wrong, so he could only stand there with an embarrassed face.
Fortunately, my sister is caring. At this time, Xu Jinping jumped over.
"Auntie, why do you only praise my brother and not me?
