It’s good for me to study in Yuhong class, the teacher praises me all the time. Aunt, do you not love me anymore? "
The little girl had an innocent face, as if she was fighting for favor with her brother, but when others were not paying attention, she turned her head and winked at Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan couldn't hold back, bowed his head and smiled, and took the opportunity to withdraw his hand to give the place to his sister.
Xu Jinping lay in Xue Xiulin's arms, and began to chat with her aunt and aunt with a small mouth.
From the new things in school, to how disobedient the younger siblings are at home, they speak clearly and logically.
The little girl is handsome, with a red apple face, big flickering eyes, well dressed, no matter how she looks, she looks innocent and cute.
This girl is very talkative, and when she speaks alone, no one else can get in the way.
Xue Xiulin and the others patiently listened to a few words at first, but then they became impatient and annoyed.
"Feng'er, er, take your younger sister to play, take good care of your younger sisters, and take care of them."
Xue Xiulin felt that it would be too late to let her little niece continue talking, so she pushed Xu Jinping to sister Xu Jinfeng.
Xu Jinfeng is very close to these younger sisters in the family.
So they came over, led Xu Jinhui, Xu Jingwen, Xu Jinxiu led Xu Jinping and Xu Jingyi, and the sisters went to the Westinghouse to play.
Of course, at this moment, Xu Haiyuan has long since disappeared. He has already followed his brothers to the yard to watch his father clean up the pork.
The pork is shaved and chopped into large pieces. The ones that will be used for cooking tomorrow will be brought to the house later, and the ones that are not used will be placed on the panel.
At four or five o'clock in the afternoon, the temperature is already quite low, the pork has been completely cooled, and the outside is a bit hard.
Just pour some cold water, put it outside to freeze overnight, put it away in a wooden barrel and bury it in snow tomorrow morning, and it can be eaten for a long time after putting it away.
Although there is a refrigerator at home now, Xu Shiyan still thinks this is a good way to deal with it.
The storage space of the refrigerator is actually not too large, and it can't hold many things at all.
Xu Shiyan was cleaning up here, and the dogs were sitting at the door of the kennel, blinking and tilting their heads.
These dogs are all psychic. There are so many people slaughtering pigs in the family, they don't say a word, they don't make noise or bark.
Seeing the pork, I didn’t say it was greedy and wagged my tail, so I just sat outside the nest and watched.
"Then, this is yours."
Xu Shiyan couldn't bear to treat the dogs harshly after all, and distributed the few big bones with a lot of meat reserved in advance to the dogs.
I don’t have a chance to take them up the mountain to hunt this year. The dogs can’t eat meat, and they can’t bark when they see meat. This dog must be rewarded with something delicious.
Seeing Xu Shiyan coming over with the bone, the dogs became excited at once.
He shook his head, choked and yelled, his tail almost went up to the sky.
Xu Shiyan touched the dogs' heads one by one, and then handed them the big bones. The dogs carefully took the bones away, and hurried back to the den to chew.
"It seems that the third brother's family is living a good life. There is still a lot of meat on the big bone, so I just feed it to the dog?"
It happened that Xu Shide came out and saw it, so he had to sigh.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard the words, "I'm too busy this year, I don't have time to take them up the mountain to hunt, it's actually their fault.
If you have time to go up the mountain, why don't you bring back a few wild boars with just our dogs?
They have followed me these years and have contributed a lot.
When the pigs are slaughtered at home, everyone can be quiet and not noisy, so why not reward them with some benefits? "
Xu Shiyan didn't think so. These dogs have done too much for the family. If they have merit, they must give them delicious food.
The dogs came to Xu's house in the summer of 1978, and it has been more than six years. In terms of the lifespan of the dogs, they are now middle-aged and old.
Hunting dogs are always injured, so they don't live long.
Let’s take good care of it. I worked hard when I was young, but I have to feed it well when I’m old.
Xu Shide was always looking for something to say, but when Xu Shiyan said that, he was at a loss for words.
"Third brother, have you sold out all the Clivia in your family? Did you plan to plant more?" Xu Shide still couldn't hold back, and finally asked.
Xu Shiyan turned his head to look at his younger brother, smiled, "Let's go, let's talk in the room."
I know that these brothers will definitely not be able to hold back to ask, no matter, sooner or later they have to explain things clearly, so it is better to talk about it together.
Xu Shiyan brought the pig's head into the house and put it in the kitchen.
Tomorrow, put asphalt or something on it, remove the hairs, and then put it in the pot.
It’s good to keep it for entertaining guests, or eat it during Chinese New Year.
After packing up his things, Xu Shiyan washed his hands and entered the room.
The brothers, sister-in-law, and sister-in-law were all there, and when they saw Xu Shiyan coming in, their eyes lit up.
"Father, I've packed up the meat and everything, put it outside overnight, and put it away in the morning."
Xu Shiyan walked up to Xu Chenghou and said in a low voice.
"Well, it's enough to clean up, let's sit down. It's cold outside, sit on the kang to keep warm."
Xu Chenghou moved to make room for his third son.
Then he picked up the pipe pot, filled the bag of cigarettes slowly, pressed it firmly, lit it, took two puffs, then looked up and looked at the people in the room.
"Originally, I wanted to wait for the sixth child to get married and go out, before I told you.
But I look at it, you all seem to be unable to wait, so let’s talk now. "

chapters.title: Chapter 394: without you
chapters.content:
Chapter 394 Without you
Xu Shixian came back early, not only for the sake of his sister's marriage.
The main thing is to come back and ask Xu Shiyan about this Clivia.
Guan Enxue ordered people to shut up and not spread it, but it was actually useless.
In private, I don’t know how many people are saying that there are people in Donggang who grow Clivia and earn millions.
Xu Shixian is in the county, and he also works in an agency. He is the most well-informed, so how can he not know?
At that time, he was guessing that it should be Xu Shiyan. After all, they have seen those Clivias at home.
Later, it came out that Donggang was going to invest in Jianshen City. It was said that Su Anying led people to invest.
Needless to say? It must be the idea of ​​my third brother.
Isn’t that how their family is now? The third child came up with ideas behind the scenes, and the third wife's daughter-in-law managed it under the pretense of fame.
Xu Shixian immediately contacted Xu Shixiang and Xu Shide. The three brothers got together and complained to Xu Shiyan in various ways.
This old couple is not particular about it. They don’t bring their own brothers with them in the money-making business, but they lead outsiders.
An investment of 400,000 in a ginseng market, 400,000, how much is this?
How much money did the young couple earn? This guy, don't know how to spend the money?
Extravagant and messy, what is there in this poor place in Donggang?
Loess soil on sunny days, yellow mud soup on rainy days, is this poor place worth 400,000 yuan? Isn't this just a shame about having money and no land?
At that time, the three brothers wanted to come back to ask Xu Shiyan to clarify, but after thinking about it, that was not the case.
Just learned that Xu Shiqin got married on the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, so they discussed that it would be better to go home two days early, break it up with parents, break it up, and talk about it carefully, and they can't let the old couple do things indiscriminately.
So, the three brothers got together in the county this morning, and then came back by car.
But when they came back, they found that the attitude of their parents seemed not quite right.
I was rushing home to slaughter pigs again. There were a lot of guests, and the three of them didn't feel good, so they asked directly. I could only endure it and inquire about it.
But the young couple are all sharp-minded now, and they don't care about their quarrels at all. This is so depressing.
The three couples were scratching their heads and scratching their heads, when Xu Chenghou suddenly said such a sentence, which immediately stunned everyone.
Several people looked at Xu Chenghou in a daze, not understanding what Xu Chenghou was going to say.
"Father, what are you going to say? My little sister is getting married the day after tomorrow, can't there be any problems?"
Xu Shixian was startled, he seemed to understand what the old man was going to do, so he hurriedly opened his mouth to interrupt, and let this matter go first.
Xu Cheng gave the eldest son a thick look, "Don't think that you are so thoughtful, I don't know.
You guys are just playing around, I know how many dung you guys are pulling, and you are still pretending like me? "
Xu Chenghou snorted, just these bastards, still want to jump in front of him? Practice for another twenty years.
"Shut up, everyone, and listen to me first."
Xu Chenghou took the last two puffs of his cigarette, and knocked the pipe and pot under the edge of the kang. Looking up, he spoke again.
"The family Clivia was indeed sold, and it sold for a lot of money. But, this is not for the three of you, not a penny.
Why not? Do you want to ask? hehe. " Xu Chenghou sneered.
"At the time when your sixth younger sister was undergoing surgery, none of you went to accompany and help, all of you were the third child, who contributed money and effort.
The sixth child has been discharged from the hospital. None of you who are brothers and sisters-in-law came back to see.
I don't even say how many things you bring, even if you come back empty-handed, it can be regarded as the bond between you brothers and sisters.
Let me ask, do you have this family in your heart, is there anyone in this family?
That's your own sister, she had surgery, what a big deal.
You are so cold-hearted and cold-blooded that you don't care about it, and you still expect good things at home to think about you? "
Xu Chenghou has been holding back his dissatisfaction for several years, and has never mentioned it, just waiting for this opportunity.
If these few come back generously, don’t worry about anything and don’t inquire about it. Xu Chenghou also thought about it and don’t care about it with his sons.
Each family has its own difficulties, and it is not easy to live in front of the family. As a father, he has to be considerate of his son.
But these few are not like that.
They are in trouble at home, and they all shrink back. There are advantages and advantages at home to take advantage of, and they run faster than anyone else.
If the opportunity is given to them, but they have to hit the muzzle of the gun, then don't blame him.
"At that time, I asked you to pay for the operation and hospitalization expenses of the sixth child. You all cried with me and couldn't get a penny.
Indeed, it’s all difficult. If you don’t have money, what do you do if you don’t have money? I can't say that I want you to sell everything, can I? "
"The old three Clivias need to invest a lot of money. He can't get it out by himself, so he must find someone to partner with.
You are all poor, if you can’t afford the money, you can only find someone else.
What's the matter? It can also be said that you don't pay a penny, just do dividends? "
Xu Cheng rolled his eyes at his sons, each of them dreaming of marrying a wife, thinking of beautiful things.
Xu Shixian and the others were left speechless by what his father said.
Yes, they were the ones who said they were poor and couldn’t afford it.
Could it be said that if you can’t spend money to share the medical expenses with your sister, you can spend money to invest in Clivia?
They dug a hole and buried themselves in it. Who can blame them?
But after thinking about it, it seems wrong. What did Dad say just now?
The benefits of not having the three of them, there are six brothers and sisters in the family, without the three of them, what about others?
"Second brother, did you share the money?" Xu Shixiang asked Xu Shian in a low voice.
"Speak louder if you want to talk, what's wrong? You think I'm deaf and can't hear?"
Before Xu Shian could reply, Xu Chenghou became unhappy.
"Such a big man, he can't do anything aboveboard, sneaky, what does he look like? You don't need to ask the second child, you can ask me."
"The second child did share the money, a total of 40,000.
At that time, he gave me 200 yuan, saying that I would use it to pay back the famine.
He borrowed the money from outside, and I didn't want it, so I transferred it to the third child, Clivia.
The second child has been working with her for the past few years, plus she still has this little share, so she was divided into 40,000 yuan, what's the matter? Is there something wrong? "
Xu Chenghou is determined not to spoil his sons, and he will be angry when he needs to.
Anyway, it’s like that, no matter what they are offended, these few can’t be counted on, so don’t even try to win them back.
The stubborn old man has always had this temper all his life. Anyway, he is very nice to whoever he likes, and if he doesn't like it, it's not bad if he doesn't swear.
"My brother can't be counted on, why don't you want the third child to find someone else?
At that time, no one knew whether Clivia could make money, but they built and won them, and invested money and shares without saying a word. Can you trust the third child? "
Xu Chenghou had seen through his sons a long time ago, and every word he said was rooted in the root.
Xu Shixian looked at each other in blank dismay, no one dared to say a word was wrong. At this time, the three of them really regretted it.
At the beginning, they didn't expect that the old man would have a backhand.
Besides, even if the third child told them at that time that Clivia can make money and asked them to invest money, they would not dare to be honest.
Who would have thought that a flower could be so valuable? It's even more expensive than gold, and it's like a fairy tale when you say it.

chapters.title: Chapter 395: money obsessed
chapters.content:
Chapter 395 Money Obsessed
"Father, we didn't mean to blame the family or the third child.
Really, we are not jealous of the money that the youngest earns by his own ability. "
Xu Shixian glanced at the two younger brothers, and the three of them met, and immediately understood what the boss meant.
"Yes, Dad, we just want to ask the third brother, what's going on with this Clivia?
I think the county has been going crazy recently, it seems that the prices in the provincial capital are always high.
We just want to ask the third brother, do you still have Clivia seedlings at home? Do you have any plans next year?
The third brother and the third sister-in-law have been cultivating Clivia for a long time, and the place is ready-made. It can’t be said that they will stop doing it after earning this money, right?
Otherwise, this time we brothers and I will join forces, and we will be more organized. "
Xu Shixiang immediately changed his words, saying that he didn't care about his third brother's money at all, he just wanted to partner with his brother and do some business or something.
"Yes, yes, Dad, I heard that the third brother and the third sister-in-law are going to invest in the ginseng market, how much money can they make?
The third brother now has money in his hand, and he invested it all in Clivia, so he won’t earn several times the money back?
Now the price of Clivia has gone crazy. " Xu Shide also hastily opened his mouth to agree.
"Isn't it so bad? I asked someone to inquire, and they said that the provincial capital Clivia has risen a lot in recent days.
Oh, my third brother is still in a hurry, and sold it early. If I wait until this time, I guess I can earn half more. "
Xu Shixiang was so sorry, it felt like he had lost a lot of money.
Ever since they found out about Clivia making money, the three brothers also inquired about it.
Xu Shixiang's classmates in the agricultural school, some of them work in the provincial capital.
Xu Shixiang asked someone to ask, and said that in recent days, the price of Clivia has nearly doubled compared to when it just entered winter.
This thing is completely crazy.
"Third brother, look, why don't we partner up and find some Clivia from various places, sell them in the provincial capital, and make a fortune?"
Xu Shixiang was really moved, this thing is too profitable, who can bear it?
"Third brother, you can tell them, let them all calm down, and stop thinking about it."
Xu Chenghou glanced at his third son and signaled Xu Shiyan to speak.
He played the black face, but Xu Shiyan had to play the white face.
Although Xu Chenghou didn't like to see these people, he couldn't just let them fall into the pit.
"Brother, fourth, fifth, do you think Clivia is worth that price? Where is its value?"
Xu Shiyan did not directly reply to the brothers' request, but asked a question instead.
"Don't worry about what's going on outside, just tell from the bottom of your heart, how much do you think a pot of flowers is worth?"
Xu Shixian and the others were stunned, not understanding what Xu Shiyan meant.
"Since it can be sold at such a high price, it is worth it. What else is there to ask?"
Everyone is puzzled, if it is worthless, why buy it for anything?
"Fifth, are you transferred to the Finance Office now? At any rate, you are also involved in economics.
Tell me, is Clivia worth the current price? "Xu Shiyan looked at the fifth child and asked him.
"Even our parents know that this thing can't be eaten or drunk, and it's not that the medicinal materials don't cure the disease, and it's not worth the money at all.
You are all people who have studied and go to work, don’t you understand?
You are blinded by money, and feel uncomfortable if you don’t get involved with making money like this. "
Xu Shiyan's face turned cold, and his tone became a little more serious.
"When I planted Clivia, a seed cost only a few cents, but now? How much should a seed cost?
What's that? It's made of gold, so expensive?
You don’t even think about it, why is a flower that can’t create value itself and is hyped up by the circulation link so expensive?
Isn't it because some people want to make money on this, and they forcefully create momentum to coax it up? "
“When we were studying, we all played drumming and passing flowers, passing them around, until the drum stopped at the end, and whoever got the flowers had to get up and perform.
Isn’t this Clivia the same now? Just go and ask, how many of the Clivia bought from me really like it and want to raise it well?
How many pots are still left in the hands of those people? Isn't it all sold again?
Until now, how many hands have those flowers changed, who knows? "
"Clivia can't be so crazy all the time, the drum will stop sooner or later, once the drum stops, everyone's dream of getting rich will have to wake up.
By that time, you will have to throw as many Clivias as you have in your hand.
It’s like blowing bubbles. Blow hard. Sooner or later, when the bubbles burst, there will be nothing left. "
Xu Shiyan didn't expect that these guys would come up with such an idea.
The old birthday star drank arsenic, tired of life, right?
With just a few brothers, what is it enough for? I'm afraid I can't even buy two pots of flowers, right?
They still want to roll in this big wave? Aren't you afraid that if you fold in all of a sudden, you will lose your life?
The brothers of the Xu family are not stupid, the main reason is that their cleverness is all used at home.
Hearing what Xu Shiyan said at this time, the faces of the brothers are not very good.
"Can't it? How can it be as serious as you said? It's really like what you said, so many people will go bankrupt?"
Xue Xiulin couldn't believe it. No matter what she heard, it seemed that the third child was deliberately scaring them.
"Brother, fourth and fifth, please listen to the third, what he said is not unreasonable.
You didn’t stay in the provincial capital, so you don’t know what the provincial capital is like? Now the whole provincial capital seems to be crazy, and everyone is insane.
There are countless cases caused by Clivia, some of which were stolen, robbed, and murdered.
I think that the higher authorities must find a way to control the situation and suppress this trend.
Don’t think about it blindly, living a good life is better than anything else. "
I have to say that Xu Shi'an has also experienced a lot of shrewdness in the past few months, and he speaks clearly and logically, which is much better than those few people who are full of money.
"Have you heard it? Even the second child can say that, are you still obsessed with ghosts?
What should be said, the second and third children and I have finished talking to you. If you don’t listen to the good words, then we have nothing to do.
That is a big pit, fall into it, no one can save you.
I’m here to tell you something, if you don’t believe me, you have to get involved, and you will bear the consequences yourself.
I'm really waiting for the day you fall into it, so don't expect the third child to reach out and drag you. "
Xu Chenghou knocked on the pipe and pot again, and today's conversation came to an end.
Everything that should be said has been said, whether they can listen to it or not is their business.
If these people are deceived by lard, they have to drill in, and others say nothing.
I said it in advance, if they really don’t listen, don’t come to ask for help if something goes wrong in the future, no one will care.
Regardless of the fact that Xu Shiyan has this money in his hand, it sounds like a lot, and it is indeed too much to live an honest life.
But if you step back and step on it again, it will only take a few minutes to fold it in.
I'm not afraid of anything else, but I'm afraid that these brothers will not give up and really fall in. When the time comes, it won't count if they destroy their own home, and if they make trouble, they will drag relatives and friends down.
This is the reason why Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan tried their best to persuade them. If they are other people, what does it matter to them if they love to die?
Thank you for your concern. It’s okay so far. As long as I get enough sleep, I can hold on.

chapters.title: Chapter 396: cartoon
chapters.content:
Chapter 396 Cartoons
I don't know whether Xu Shixian and the others were persuaded or frightened.
Anyway, several people were lost in thought, and no one spoke.
"Several of you have jobs, the boss and the fifth family are still dual-employees, the salary is enough, so don't worry about it.
When I was the third child, I couldn't sleep all night long, just because I was afraid that something would happen to them.
You didn't hear your father say that they were in the small courtyard on the other side of the provincial capital, and five or six thieves all went in.
Every time we go back to the provincial capital to transport flowers, the militiamen from our town have to **** the cart with guns.
The farm of the third child, even the police station and the militia, not to mention the guns, even the mountain cannons were brought over to calm down the place. "
Over there, Zhou Guilan, who had been silent all this time, finally spoke.
"You just watched the third family make money, how easy is it for the couple to make money?
It's a bit mysterious to say that you put your head on your trouser belt, but you really took the risk of the boss to earn back the money.
You feel your conscience and say to yourself, do you three have this ability? "
Zhou Guilan doesn't easily talk harshly to her children, but this time she couldn't help it either.
"He also said that the price is high now, if they stay in the provincial capital until now, who knows if they will come back?
Is that a joke? There were cars going to the provincial capital to transport Clivia, but they were all robbed.
Those big bosses, who doesn't hire some people to guard the car? Are you better than those big bosses? "
Zhou Guilan asked several questions in a row, directly turning Xu Shixian's face red and white.
Several people were dumbfounded, no one thought that it was a Clivia, and there was such a danger behind it.
"Let's stop here, don't mention it in the future.
Third son, you are not allowed to deal with such hanging things in the future. No matter how you earn money, you have to spend your life.
You're all frightened to death by messing around every day. "
Zhou Guilan's words were clearly referring to Xu Shiyan, but she was actually beating those few.
"From now on, read your books honestly, and come back to work safely.
Yingzi planted sticks if she liked it, and if she didn’t like it, she didn’t do it at all. Didn’t it mean that a circle of retail houses should be built around the city?
At that time, our entire small shop, who sells steamed buns, steamed buns and wonton dumplings, will be able to live, have you heard? "
Speaking of this, his voice raised a lot, and he deliberately stared at the third son and third daughter-in-law.
"Understood, Mom, we will be safe and secure in the future, and we don't dare to make a fuss anymore." Xu Shiyan hurriedly agreed.
Adventures are indeed enough once, and there is no way to do it a second time.
Anyway, the start-up funds are sufficient, so we can spend some ginseng and plant some sticks in time for next year.
In two years time, I will find a way to make the whole processing plant and do some ginseng deep processing business, which is very good.
"Okay, it's getting late, it's time to clean up, hurry up, wait until six o'clock, and there will still be people watching TV.
Where do you all live? Make arrangements quickly, the third child has to go back to light the fire. "
Xu Chenghou glanced at the clock on the wall, it was past half past five, and after a while, it was time for the neighbors to watch TV.
"Father, Lao Wu and I, we live with the third brother." It was agreed before and cannot be changed.
"Well, I won't be going home tonight, and I'm staying here too. Tomorrow morning, Ming Rong will come directly with the child."
Xu Shian saw that it was getting late, and he didn't bother to go home anymore, so he simply stayed with his parents for one night, and it happened that the brothers were all there, and it was also lively.
"Father, Mom, I went back just now and set fire to the Westinghouse Kang and the flue wall. Just add some more firewood when I get home later."
When Su Anying went home to pick up the child, she deliberately set the West House on fire.
The Westinghouse Kang is connected to the kitchen stove, which is usually used for cooking and cooking, but the fire wall in the house is usually not burned.
Just now when Su Anying came home, she lit up the stove, threw a few pieces of pimples, and pressed a few pieces of firewood at night.
Xu Chenghou nodded, the third daughter-in-law is still very safe.
"Then sit here for a while, chatting, and later if you think there are too many people, go home and watch TV, anyway, there are at home."
While talking, the dog outside barked. Needless to say, he must have come to watch TV.
Go out and have a look, and sure enough there are a few old men and women with their children.
Since Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others bought TVs at home, fewer people came to Xu Chenghou's place to watch TV.
It's not like before, the room is full of people who can't move.
But there were still quite a lot of people, and the room was soon filled with people.
Xu Shiyan saw this, so he simply told Xu Shide and the others that it is better to go there. Anyway, there is a TV at home, and they are all the same color TV.
So, Xu Shide and Xu Shixiang's family got dressed and went there with Xu Shiyan's family.
Xu Jinfeng and the three brothers and sisters saw that their brothers and sisters had all left. The three of them felt bored, so they also went to live with the third uncle's house.
"Hurry up, the cartoon is about to be performed, I won't be able to catch up when I get home late."
As soon as he went out, Xu Haiyuan dragged Xu Jinping to run quickly.
"Sister Feng'er, sister Xiu'er, brother Dabin, hurry up, there are moles at night."
Xu Haiyuan was talking about "The Mole's Story", in which he played a chubby little mole.
That is the children's favorite. Every time this time comes, Xu Haiyuan can watch it without moving.
Xu Jinfeng and the others were in the county, and they would go to the neighbor’s house to watch TV every night. Of course they knew about moles, so they ran after each other.
"Oh, time is enough, don't run away, it's dark at night, and the road is slippery, falling on you."
Xu Shiyan saw this and hurried to follow. Xu Haiyuan didn't have the key to the door, so he couldn't open the door.
Sun Xiaofeng lived next door to Xu Shiyan's house, and Huang Shengli's house was in Daonan, both of which had TVs.
In addition, Xu Shiyan is always busy here, and he is not at home all the time, so no one usually comes to Xu Shiyan's house to watch TV at night, and it is quiet here.
Xu Shiyan came to the front door of his house, took out the key to unlock it, and opened the door for the children to enter.
The moment the door opened, the children rushed in and rushed straight into the east room.
The kang and the fire wall were very hot, and the room was not cold at all. After the children entered the room, they didn't bother to take off their coats.
Xu Haiyuan hurried to turn on the TV, the cartoon just started.
In an instant, the room was quiet, and the children were all staring at the TV, motionless.
"They all took off their coats and hats, and then went to the kang to watch TV. Don't get too close to the TV, or you will be nearsighted."
Xu Shiyan saw this and hurried the children to the kang.
When I saw this group of children, they all made one move.
Staring at the TV, he groped to unbutton his coat, and then stepped back step by step until he reached the edge of the Kang.
During the whole process, no one took their eyes off the TV for fear of missing any wonderful shots.
Xu Jinfeng and the others are better, and they have seen it in the county.
Like Xu Haiyang and Xu Jingyi, no one in Daying or Hebei has bought a TV. They have never watched it at all, and they are immediately attracted, staring at the TV with good eyesight.
"These brats are obsessed with watching TV."
Xu Shide, Xu Shixiang and others followed in, seeing the operations of these children in the room, they couldn't laugh or cry.

chapters.title: Chapter 397: Full of guests
chapters.content:
Chapter 397 The guests fill the door
On the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth lunar month, the day before Xu Shiqin got married, relatives from the Xu family arrived one after another.
At Daying, Su Anying's natal family, Zhou Guilan's natal family, and Wu Qiuyan's natal family all came by train.
At the other end of the big house, several families who had a good relationship with the Xu family also came.
When a group of relatives and friends met, they were naturally very happy, and they were very lively talking and laughing together.
Seeing the prosperity of the Xu family, everyone is also emotional, especially the big houses, they are very envious.
Wang Zhijun and Li Erniu have a good relationship with Xu Shiyan, so they asked Xu Shiyan, if they want to move here, can they do it?
"It's okay to move here, maybe this is the trouble.
Now the land is allocated to households. If you move here, you can’t move the land. The land here is all allocated. "
Nowadays it is not troublesome to move, and it is also easy to change the household registration, but the land is difficult to handle.
"Anyway, if you really want to move, you can just go back to farming in the first few years without changing your household registration.
If it develops in a few years, it is fine to give the land to others without planting it. "Xu Shiyan has no other way, it's hard to have both.
Li Erniu and the others thought about it, and it was indeed the case, so they shook their heads immediately.
There is a lot of land on the side of the big house, and they are really reluctant to part with those lands.
If there is no land to grow here and no capital to plant sticks, then it is better to stay in the big house.
Xu Shiyan can only give a suggestion whether others like to move or not, so he didn't say anything else.
Whether it’s red or white, it takes a lot of people to be lively.
Although there is not much money for gifts this year, so many people at home congratulate her, which proves that she is very popular.
Relatives and friends are all here to join in, and they must be entertained with good meals.
If you marry a daughter-in-law and hold a banquet at home, today will be full of excitement, and the yard can be filled with helpers alone.
But this is marrying a daughter, and the family does not hold banquets, so they all go to the Han's house, which is not so lively in comparison, and only a few tables can be arranged at home.
According to the local rules, when a girl gets married, she has to make a lot of dumplings on the night before she gets married.
The next morning, before the groom came to pick up the bride, he cooked the dumplings for relatives and friends to eat, so he couldn’t send the bride out on an empty stomach.
So that night, Xu’s house was brightly lit, and the house was full of laughter.
Women all get together to make dumplings, while men play poker, drink tea, and chat.
Neighbors in the neighborhood knew that the Xu family was going to have a wedding, but no one came to watch TV that night.
Everyone made dumplings until nine o'clock, and all the dumplings covered by the seven or eight curtains were finished, covered with white cloth, and placed in the yard.
With the temperature at this time, the dumplings don’t need to be left outside overnight, and they can be frozen hard in the middle of the night.
Others were busy making dumplings, Xu Shiqin was asked to rest early.
Su Anhua, daughter of Zhou Anping's family, Zhou Lirong, daughter of Zhou Guizhi's family, Zhang Fengyun, and three unmarried girls accompanied Xu Shiqin.
It was less than six o'clock in the morning on the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, Xu Shiqin was woken up to wash up.
Most people who get married in this year don't pay much attention to it, and there is no special place for makeup.
In those days when Xu Shiqin was in the capital, he found some cosmetics.
So I got up in the morning, after washing my face and mouth, with the help of several little sisters, I braided my long hair and tied it behind my head, and put on a few red satin flowers.
Then apply some cream, powder, blush, eyebrows, and lipstick.
This is amazing. Most people get married and don't even have these things.
After finishing her makeup, she put on a set of red satin padded jacket and trousers. The padded jacket was specially made thinner, and she put on a red woolen dress and a red woolen skirt.
This outfit costs a lot of money just for the materials.
Originally planned to get married in spring, all I made were spring clothes, but it turned out to be useless.
Later, Su Anying bought the material from the provincial capital, and Xu Shiqin made it himself.
When you get married this year, it would be nice for a woman to wear a set of satin red padded jacket and trousers.
Xu Shiqin's woolen clothes are rare, let alone in Donggang, even in the county town.
Xu Shiqin has good craftsmanship, the tailoring fits well, and the workmanship is also exquisite. On the top of the clothes and skirt, patterns of peonies and colorful phoenixes are embroidered with colored silk threads.
Xu Shiqin's craftsmanship is really amazing, the colorful phoenix is ​​so lifelike, it really looks like it is about to fly.
"Sister Qin, you look so good dressed up like this."
Xu Shiqin was already handsome, but after such a tidying up, he is really radiant.
It is said that the bride is the most beautiful, and it is true for Xu Shiqin.
Everything was packed, and it was just after seven o'clock.
At this time, relatives and friends who live in Songjianghe and Donggang also arrived one after another.
Xu Shiqin's master, fellow apprentices who have a good relationship with him, and the family members of Wei Mingrong, Xue Xiulin, and Chen Chunling are all here.
Neighbors, neighbors, everyone who has a good relationship with the Xu family and has a relationship, all came over.
In the kitchen, two pots boil water together, and when the dumplings are cooked, take them out and bring them to the east room.
All the guests who come to see off their relatives, no matter whether they eat at home or not, have to eat as much as they want, and they can't be empty.
The room was busy, when suddenly a car stopped outside, then Xu Haibo waited for a few children and ran back to the room.
"Third Uncle, hurry up, a jeep is coming outside, saying it is looking for you."
Xu Shiyan was eating in the house. Hearing this, he quickly put down his chopsticks and ran out. When he went outside, it turned out that Guo Shouye had brought his wife.
"Yo, Brother Guo, sister-in-law, I didn't expect you to come here, come in quickly.
Have you had breakfast yet? Freshly cooked dumplings in the house, come in and eat some. "
"Brother, don't worry, I ate at home with your sister-in-law." Guo Shouye said with a smile as he helped his wife walk to the courtyard.
"Our sixth younger sister is getting married today. I, the big brother, have to come and send my younger sister out of the court."
Based on the friendship between Guo Shouye and Xu Shiyan, knowing that Xu Shiyan's sister got married, Guo Shouye would definitely come to congratulate her.
Xu Shiyan accompanied Guo Shouye and his wife into the door and went straight to the east room.
"Father, Mom, this is what I often call Brother Guo, and Guo's sister-in-law. They know that the sixth sister is going out today, so they came here to congratulate and send off their relatives."
"Hey, it's Director Guo, it's amazing, how come you are alarmed by this? Hurry up and sit on the kang."
Xu Chenghou and his wife were originally sitting at the top of the kang. When they heard that it was Guo Shouye, they hurriedly moved to the edge of the kang to put on their shoes and go to the ground.
"Uncle, but other things, you are the elder.
Shi Yan and I are like brothers, so we can’t let my uncle go down to meet me, that’s outrageous. "
Guo Shouye took two steps forward and supported Xu Chenghou.
"Uncle, Auntie, don't be strangers to the relationship between our two families. Just call me Xiao Guo or Shou Ye, but don't be the director."
Guo Shouye smiled all over his face, and helped Xu Chenghou back to the kang.
Over there, Peng Yucui also stepped forward and supported Zhou Guilan.
"Auntie, our old Guo and Brother Xu had a fateful friendship. Today we are here to send the sixth sister out of the house, so don't be too far-fetched.
In the future, I will come and go often. During the Chinese New Year, I bring my children to pay New Year's greetings to the two elders. "

chapters.title: Chapter 398: Block the door and ask for a red envelope
chapters.content:
Chapter 398 Blocking the door and asking for a red envelope
Guo Shouye had just passed through the door, and before everyone had a chat, Chen Jianzhang, several cadres in the town, Yu Shouguang, Shao Mengyong, Yang Junxian and others also arrived one after another.
At this time, there were already quite a few people inside and outside Xu's house, most of them were from Donggang.
Seeing this, the town secretary led three village secretaries, and other cadres, all came to congratulate him.
Everyone was also talking about it, and they all lamented, look at the days when the Xu family is holding a happy event, and even the leaders of the town have come, so they can't accept it.
Brothers Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang saw the situation, and each shook their heads and smiled wryly.
Originally, they thought they were doing well in the work unit, and they could enjoy themselves, but now they are nothing compared to this.
The sixth younger sister is married, and the cadres of Donggang Town can come to congratulate her, whose face is it for?
It must not be Xu Chenghou or Xu Shiqin, they are all here for Xu Shiyan.
And not only Donggang Town, but even the director of the Forestry Bureau came in person, as their brothers, no one has the ability.
"I used to think that among the five brothers, the third child was the most stupid, and Baden didn't have much ability. His family must have a bad life.
Looking at it now, among the five of us, he is the best. "
Xu Shixian sighed. In the past, he thought that he was doing well in the agency, like a fish in water, and was highly valued by the leaders.
But when I saw it today, I realized that was the case.
"Big brother, the third brother's family has long been better than us.
We are now far behind by the third brother. "Xu Shixiang felt even deeper.
Before, he was the only one in his family who went to college. No matter how you say it, he was the most promising person with his degree.
It’s different now, Xu Shiyan also went to university, and it’s still a provincial agricultural university, a special course for cadres.
The people studying there are all deputy county-level or candidate cadres in various places.
With such contacts, even if Xu Shiyan doesn't enter the relevant department after graduation, that would be great.
Xu Shiyan didn't know how the three Xu family brothers sighed and sighed. He was busy entertaining guests at the moment.
"I'm really sorry, I don't know if you can come, I don't have any food and wine prepared at home.
Secretary Chen, let’s eat a few mouthfuls of dumplings, it’s kind of interesting. "
Xu Shiyan asked his daughter-in-law to quickly bring more bowls and chopsticks, and greeted everyone to eat dumplings.
This is the rule of seeing off relatives, no matter how much, at least eat a few meanings.
Chen Jianzhang and the others were not polite, they sat at the table and ate a few dumplings at will.
"Well, this dumpling is fragrant and the stuffing is well seasoned. Whose craft is this? What's in it so fresh? It's pretty good."
Chen Jianzhang nodded in praise while eating, saying that the dumplings taste very good.
"Cough, what's the matter? It's just our own pork and cabbage, nothing special." Over there, Zhou Guilan smiled from ear to ear.
Chen Jianzhang and the others all came over after breakfast, and they couldn't eat much, so it's enough for one person to eat three or two for a while.
The other helpers and those who sent relatives off also ate whatever they wanted, so they hurriedly cleaned up here.
The kitchen helpers hurriedly prepared two tables of banquets for the people from the Han family who came to pick up their relatives.
While everyone was busy, they suddenly heard someone shouting, "Here, come, the bridegroom is here.
Oh, there are several jeeps, what kind of car is that in the back? It looks like a truck, why is it smaller than a truck? "
I saw a car coming from the east, turned a corner and stopped in front of Xu's gate.
The one at the beginning is a military green jeep, with big red flowers hanging on the front of the car.
There are a few brand new trucks in the back that look like trucks but are smaller than trucks. The same is true for cars with buckets, with big red flowers hanging on the front.
In the twelfth lunar month, there are many marriages, but this year, most of the weddings are in horse-drawn carriages. Occasionally there is a bicycle team, which is very remarkable.
The car suddenly came, and I really wanted to make a sensation in Donggang.
Whether they were in the courtyard of Xu's house, outside the gate, or pedestrians on the street, they all stared at those cars intently, watching them stop in front of the gate of Xu's house.
Han Liwei got out of the first jeep in a neat grass-green uniform.
Immediately, a few boys in uniforms also came down from other jeeps.
All of them are tall and straight, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, and their eyes are very upright. When they stand there, others can't help but straighten their bodies when they look at them.
People outside the gate of Xu's family were dumbfounded, and no one understood what was going on?
Everyone knew that Han Liwei was a soldier, but why did the bridesmaids wear the same clothes as him? Doesn't this scene look a little scary?
The people who were in charge of lighting firecrackers outside the gate, and those who were in charge of blocking the door, were stunned, unable to recover for a long time.
I don’t know who reminded me to set off the firecrackers, and then I realized that I lit the firecrackers quickly.
Han Liwei directly entered the gate amidst the thunderous sound of firecrackers.
Yes, that's right, there was no one blocking the door.
Zhou Wanlu, Zhang Fenghua and other young men who were scheduled to block the door were all stunned and forgot to close the door at all.
So Han Liwei entered the yard unimpeded all the way. The candies and red envelopes he had prepared were useless.
However, when it came to the door of the house, Han Liwei's body was not easy to use, because it was Xu Haiyuan and a group of children who blocked the door.
Children don't care what you wear or what you do, they only have one request, give red envelopes and candies, and if you don't give them, you won't be allowed in.
"Uncle Han, quickly give the red envelope, the big one." Xu Haiyuan took the lead in booing.
"Brother Yuanyuan, no, it should be my little uncle."
Xu Haiyang listened to him and felt that something was wrong. Isn’t this my little uncle? How can I call you Uncle Han?
"Stupid, if you don't give red envelopes, who will change your words?" Xu Haiyuan glanced at this cousin.
How stupid, such a good opportunity is only once, if you don’t rush to ask for a red envelope now, there will be no chance in the future.
The people who watched the excitement around heard it and burst out laughing.
"Hahaha, take a look at the kid from the third brother's family, why is he so smart? He also knows to take the opportunity to change his money."
Han Liwei also laughed, and immediately took out a stack of red envelopes from his pocket, and distributed them to the children one by one.
There was another person behind, who specially carried a small basket with candies in it, and let the children grab a handful and put them in their pockets one by one.
When you get the red envelope, you put the candy in your pocket. Naturally, you can’t count the benefits if you get the benefits.
So Xu Haiyuan led a group of children and shouted loudly, "Hello, little uncle."
Then, these children scattered around and let Han Liwei into the house.
At this moment, the east room has been tidied up.
Xu Shiqin was wearing a red wedding dress and sitting on the kang, beside Su Anhua and other girls, Xue Xiulin, Chen Chunling and others stood around.
Han Liwei entered from the outside, came to Xu Shiqin, stood at attention and saluted.
"Daughter-in-law, I'm here to pick you up, sorry for keeping you waiting for me for so long."
In an instant, Xu Shiqin burst into tears, "Don't do this, don't salute me, this is the highest etiquette, it can't be done like this."
"No, you are the most admirable person, worthy of it." Han Liwei looked serious.
"Starting today, the left hand is you, our small family, and the right hand is the country, all of us. I, Han Liwei, are willing to sacrifice my life for the country and the family."

chapters.title: Chapter 399: pick up daughter-in-law
chapters.content:
Chapter 399 Picking up a daughter-in-law
Inside and outside the house, there was silence. Everyone had tears in their eyes and smiles on their faces, looking at the couple in front of them.
It's not easy, it's really not easy. It's really hard for these two people to get to where they are today.
Almost, Han Liwei left his life in the frontier, and almost, Xu Shiqin became a widow before he got through the door.
"Okay, love the country, love the family, dedicate your life, a hot-blooded man should be like this, good job."
Suddenly, someone said something and immediately applauded. Then, the warmest applause erupted inside and outside the house, even in the yard.
Xu Shiqin smiled through tears, and dragged Han Liwei to the kang to sit down. Then Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu went to the kang, and lit a pair of red candles on the window sill.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping came forward to put red flowers on the chests of the bride and groom, and had to say a few auspicious words.
"I wish my aunt and uncle a happy new marriage and an early baby." Han Liwei was so happy that he couldn't close his mouth from ear to ear.
The people behind Han Liwei quickly took out the red envelopes and gave them one by one.
The children took the red envelopes and went to the side happily.
Marriage in this year is not so particular, unlike later generations, the groom has to prepare two suits when he gets married, and he has to change into another suit when he arrives at the bride's house.
There is no need to change clothes, but the red belt must be tied.
This red belt is usually made of a six-foot-long whole piece of red cloth, torn from the middle, exactly half of the bridegroom and half of the bride.
My mother’s family wants to put money on red cloth bread and tie it around the waist. This is called being rich.
Of course, most of the time, if you can pack in ten yuan, it is considered good. Even in later generations, it is only one or two hundred yuan.
Money, Zhou Guilan prepared in advance.
In each belt, Zhou Guilan put sixty-six yuan, implying that the couple will have a smooth future.
The red cloth is quite long, so you have to wrap it around from the front to the back, and then wrap it back. You can’t tie a knot, you have to tuck it in on both sides.
Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei stood on the kang, Xu Shiqin tied it to Han Liwei first, and then Han Liwei tied it to Xu Shiqin.
The belt will be untied at night and kept. Most of them will be used as diapers or small clothes for the children when they have children in the future. Anyway, they are not thrown away casually.
After fastening their belts, the two sat down again. At this time, the lasagna in the kitchen was cooked, with poached eggs lying on it.
Zhou Anping's daughter-in-law, Li Shi, brought a bowl to the couple.
"After eating the comforting noodles, there will be no shortage of food and clothing in the future. Husband and wife should be tolerant, love each other, and be consummated."
The wide heart noodles are noodles that are as wide as your thumb. When you eat them, you have to eat them whole and don't bite them off.
Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei fed each other a bite of poached egg and then a whole stick of noodles.
Then the remaining noodles and eggs were taken away. This is a ritual, and usually they are not eaten completely.
Over there, Li Chengrong held a camera and a camera in his hand, and took several photos of the bride and groom while they were eating noodles.
The Li family is next to the Han family, and Li Chengrong and Han Liwei can be regarded as partners who have played together since they were young, and they must come to pick up their relatives.
Li Chengrong has only one task today, which is taking pictures.
That was the color camera that Shenchang bought just a few years ago, and it was used by Li Chengrong when he was introducing beverage products.
With the permission of the venue, it was specially used to take photos of Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin as a souvenir.
"Uncle Xu, Aunt Xu, come quickly, and take a photo of you and the bride and groom as a souvenir."
Li Chengrong took a few photos of the couple, and then called Xu Chenghou and his wife to come and take pictures.
In this day and age, there are not many cameras, let alone color cameras, and many people are looking at it fresh.
Besides, what a rare moment for a daughter to get married, the old couple naturally refused to miss it, so they came over with a smile and took a photo with the daughter and uncle.
"Smile, hey, yes, yes, smile, keep still, one, two, three." In the sound of the shutter, the most precious memories were left.
Now, the others couldn't help it anymore, especially those little babies, who jumped up and down and shouted to take pictures with their sister-in-law and uncle.
Anyway, there are still some negatives, so Li Chengrong agreed with a smile.
So the children all went to the kang, Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei hugged Xu Haiqing, Xu Jinhui, and Xu Jingwen in front of them.
Besides sat Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, Xu Haiyang, and Xu Jingyi.
Standing behind them are Xu Jinfeng, Xu Jinxiu, Xu Haibin, Xu Haibo, and Xu Haitao.
"Look at the camera, keep smiling, don't blink, yes, yes, that's it."
Li Chengrong pressed the shutter button one after another, and took two pictures. He was afraid that someone might blink his eyes, so he took two pictures to be safe.
Here to take pictures, the people from the Xu family at the other end greeted the people who received the relatives from the Han family to eat, no matter whether they were hungry or not, it meant a bite.
"Well, it's not early, you can take pictures after the ceremony is over, let's take the newcomers back first."
Da Zhang Luo, who came to pick up the bride, is the secretary of the trade union participating in the venue. He organizes various activities in the venue, and the small scene of marriage is naturally out of the question.
Da Zhangluo glanced at the itinerary in his hand, calculated the distance and time to go back, and felt that it was almost the same, and if it was later, it would delay the ceremony.
The procedure at my natal family's side is almost done, and at this time someone brought over a pair of red leather shoes.
Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao came forward to put on the shoes for the little aunt. While putting on the shoes, they also had to say a few auspicious words.
These two are grown up and have been studying for several years, and the adults have instructed them in advance, but they have not lost the chain, and they are quite decent.
The two children put on shoes for their aunt, and someone over there hurriedly stuffed them with red envelopes.
In fact, there is not much money in the red envelope, it is just for celebration, and the children are very happy with the red envelope.
When the bride gets married, her feet do not touch the soil of her mother’s family, so her brothers from her mother’s family either carry it on the back of the car, or the groom hugs her.
Originally, Xu Shixian and others were worried that Han Liwei had recovered from his serious injury and lacked physical strength. They were afraid that it would be inconvenient for him to hold her, so they wanted Xu Shixian to go out with his sister on his back.
Han Liwei said no, he has already taken care of himself, his body has fully recovered, and it is no problem for him to hold his wife.
Seeing Han Liwei bending over, he easily picked up Xu Shiqin, turned around and walked out.
Xu Shiqin quickly put his arms around Han Liwei's neck, leaning against Han Liwei's arms, and was carried out of the door by Han Liwei.
Outside the door, stood a few young men who were also wearing uniforms.
Seeing Han Liwei coming out with Xu Shiqin in his arms, several people stood at attention and saluted together. "Hi, sister-in-law."
Xu Shiqin was taken aback, not knowing what was going on, "Liwei, this is?"
"Well, the leader arranged for me to get married, and they couldn't make it, so I asked the brother unit here to come and congratulate me."
On this occasion, it is not suitable to go into details, Han Liwei said something casually, and strode outside with Xu Shiqin in his arms.
There are a total of four military green jeeps outside, which Han Liwei said were arranged by the brother unit.
Behind, there were two ordinary jeeps, which were sent by Lin Qiyue.
Behind them, there are three light trucks, Xu Shiyan and the others drove back from the provincial capital, and they drove here from the farm in order to pick up the relatives today.
Han Liwei hugged Xu Shiqin and got into the first car directly. Xu Haiyang and Xu Jingyi also got into the first car. They were the boys escorting the car.
There are many children in the family, and it is necessary to arrange something for each child to do so that they can earn a red envelope.
Don't worry about how much, just entertain the children.
Many people have asked the group, that, really no. If you don't mind that I don't have much time to watch the group, and probably don't have time to chat with you, I'll apply for one and see how it gets posted.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: new house
chapters.content:
Chapter 400 New house
Han Liwei hugged Xu Shiqin and went out to get into the car. Everyone in the Xu family started to get on the car to get married.
The Xu family accompanied them with four beds and four covers of luggage, two beds of blankets, a pair of flower and willow boxes, a pair of suitcases, a color TV, a washing machine, and a tape recorder.
In addition, the clothes of the four seasons, as well as various door curtains, curtains, curtains, pillow skins, etc. embroidered by Xu Shiqin at home were packed in the box.
Zhou Guilan put a lot of money in the four corners of the box, all wrapped in red paper.
The Li Niang meat, vermicelli, Mingzi, and scallions brought by the Han family to welcome the relatives are all double portions.
The Xu family kept half of it, and put the rest in a red enamel basin with the pattern of double happiness and mandarin ducks playing in water, and took them back.
The small dowries were carried or carried by the Xu family, and the large ones were put directly on the light truck at the back, which was later called a half-truck.
A few boys jumped onto the car and held the box to prevent the road from being too bumpy and knocking things over.
The number of people from the Han family who came to welcome their relatives was not too many, but there were quite a few people from the Xu family who came to see their relatives off.
It has been agreed that the two families will treat guests together, but it is not good to divide them into two groups.
The natal relatives who sent off their relatives in the front took a jeep, and the neighbors who came to catch the gift came later.
If you can squeeze into the driver's building, you can squeeze in. If you can't squeeze in, you can only stand in the back of the car.
Guo Shouye and Chen Jianzhang both came by car, and several people can fit in their car, anyway, the last squeeze is almost enough.
The car in front honked its horn, and the cars in the back honked one by one to respond. When the last car was reached, it gave a long press to indicate that the arrangements behind it had been made.
So the driver in front started the car and drove south, and the cars behind followed one after another.
When the girl is out of the house, her parents can't see her off.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan stood at the gate of their house, watching the convoy slowly leave.
At this moment, Zhou Guilan couldn't bear it anymore, tears kept falling down.
"Hey, look at you, it's a good thing for a daughter to marry, why are you still crying?"
Xu Chenghou felt uncomfortable seeing his old wife like this.
But he is a big man, how can he cry along with him? Instead of crying, Zhou Guilan had to be persuaded.
"Liwei is not bad, do you see the scene today? I feel that he should have made meritorious service this time, and the credit may not be small.
If he said that, he would not be able to change jobs and come back. He would definitely stay in the army, and he might be able to rise up.
I remember that he was at the deputy battalion level before, but I don’t know how many levels he can advance this time? Doesn't the lowest minimum have to be the regular camp? "
Men, after all, they should be more rational. What Xu Chenghou cares most about is his daughter's life after her marriage.
"If it's a regular business, even if you change jobs and come back, you're on the same level as Secretary Chen, right?
Whoops, that's pretty cool, sure to get a good job.
If this was a few years ago, when we were still in a big house, would we dare to think about it?
Who would have thought that our daughter could be cured of her illness and find such a good uncle as Li Wei. "
Xu Chenghou was also feeling empty and uncomfortable. He said this to comfort Zhou Guilan, so why not comfort himself?
The old couple stood outside and watched until the convoy was far away and the shadows were gone, then they turned and went back to the house.
When the Han family came to pick up their relatives, they took the east-west road behind Xu's house.
Pick up the newcomers and go back, then go south, turn east when you reach the village head of Donggang Village below, and turn north when you reach the village head of Dongshen Village, which is equivalent to the convoy going around Donggang.
This is not to show off on purpose, the main reason is to be particular about welcoming relatives, and not to go back, but in any village or town, you have to go around if you can.
Such a long line of cars, most of them are tied with big red flowers in front, which looks like they are used for weddings.
Running on the road, no matter who saw it, their eyes widened in surprise.
"Oh my God, whose family is this getting married? Are they all cars?"
"Look at the back, oops, how many things must this be a dowry? My God, what's in the cardboard box above?"
Many people happened to meet when they were going out, and they all stopped to watch.
I don’t know who it is, but the marriage is so ostentatious? I don't know which girl from that family brought so much dowry when she got married.
"You don't know yet? The old Xu's family in front of the martyrs' tomb, his daughter went out today, and married someone who attended."
If anyone knows the details, he will explain it to those around him.
"Oh, old Xu's family, when you talk about his family, who doesn't know? Their family is now very powerful and rich.
The third son of the old Xu family is capable, so it doesn’t count that he went to work in the field by himself, and made both his sisters-in-law into workers in the field, and even found a partner in the field.
Didn’t expect the girl from the old Xu’s family to marry to participate? Oops, this can really work.
If you don't say it, there don't need to be many promising children, one can bring the whole family together.
Don't you see that the old Xu's family is like this? Their family is all rich with the third son. "
Everyone who saw the convoy along the road had to talk about it, but as for the people in the car, they didn't care at all.
Others can say whatever they want, as long as they live their own lives.
Cars are much faster than horse-drawn carriages and bicycles. After going around half a circle, head east, and go straight to the Han’s house at the east end of the venue.
The Han family is also very lively.
Han Wenzhong is an old man participating in the field. Both father and son of the Han family work in the field, and they are very generous.
Most of the workers in the field have contacts with the Han family, so of course they have to come to help and follow the ceremony at this time.
The Han family is in the tight east end of the venue, which can be regarded as the outermost area, and the space here is spacious.
Han Liwei got engaged to Xu Shiqin in the winter of last year and got the certificate. Last summer, the Han family took over three more houses in the east.
At that time, I thought about it. Han Liwei had been in the organization for several years.
There are six houses in the family, and there is no place for Han Liwei to get married when he comes back, so he took another three and reserved them for Han Liwei's wedding.
Last autumn and winter, the house was tidied up, and all the necessary furniture was done, and we were just waiting for the wedding in the spring of this year.
Who would have imagined it? Han Liwei was suddenly transferred to the southwest border, and the marriage was not consummated.
Now that he finally came back whole, and got married quickly, the family felt relieved.
The subsequent houses, regardless of those old principles, just happen to live in new people in the new house.
The house here is neatly tidied up, with white-ash walls, concrete floors, cement window sills, and double-glazed windows inside, clean and bright.
All kinds of furniture in the house are also very complete, and there is nothing missing.
On the windows, on the door, and on the wall of the kang head in the east room, there are large-scale happy characters, and around the happy characters are cut out patterns of dragon and phoenix showing auspiciousness.
Even the roof of the shed is pasted with bright red happy character flowers. The decoration of the whole house makes it even more festive.
The convoy stopped outside the gate of Han’s house. Before the bride got off the car, the firecrackers at the gate were lit first.
There was a burst of crackling firecrackers, red confetti flying all over the sky, and the smell of gunpowder in the air, which added a bit of festiveness and excitement to today's wedding.
There are people inside and outside the courtyard, everyone has a smile on their faces, and everyone looks at the first car.
"The bride is out, the bride is out, look, it's so beautiful."

chapters.title: Chapter 401: People from the county
chapters.content:
Chapter 401 Someone from the County
A red woolen dress, with red flowers on her head and chest, a dignified and beautiful bride with exquisite eyebrows.
Wearing a grass-green uniform, the tall, straight, handsome and upright groom carefully helped him out of the car.
At the Han family's side, Li Yuexiu came down to the gate surrounded by the crowd, and took the enamel basin wrapped in a red bundle from his daughter-in-law with a smile on his face.
This pot is exquisite, called cornucopia.
The past two years are not the same, many old rules have begun to rise again, and weddings have begun to pay attention to various things.
Li Yuexiu took the pot, and Xu Shiqin took out a red flower from the pot, put it on her mother-in-law's temple, and called out to her mother with a smile.
"Hey." Li Yuexiu was so happy that she didn't know why, she hurriedly took out a red envelope from her pocket, and stuffed it into the hands of her daughter-in-law.
Then Han Liwei protected Xu Shiqin, and was surrounded by everyone and walked into the yard.
The courtyard of the Han family was full of people. Many young men were holding whole grains in their hands and sprinkled them on the newcomers non-stop.
This item, when it evolved later, became a throwing at newcomers.
If it's just corn and beans, it won't hurt too much if you hit it.
The point is that some people are too bad, they mix it with stones, and just throw it at newcomers, then who can bear it?
Fortunately, right now, it wasn't too much, so Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin walked through the door smoothly.
All the cars lined up in front of the gate of the Han family, and those who picked up and sent off all got out of the cars.
In the car at the back, the young man carried down the big dowry, while the older girl and daughter-in-law in the front carried bedding, luggage and other things, talking and laughing as they walked into the house.
The first couple of newcomers entered the room, and Xu Shiqin stepped on the bricks wrapped in red paper in front of the kang and got on the kang.
Sit on the quilt with peanuts, chestnuts, dates and other nuts under it.
Under the quilt, there is an ax wrapped in red paper, which is called Zuo Fu.
The longer the newcomer sits in the blessing, the greater the blessing.
The youngest son of Han Lixin's family was carried up and rolled all over the kang, which is called rolling kang.
While the child was rolling, there were still people muttering, anyway, they were all auspicious words.
Waiting for the child to get out of the kang, I have to give a red envelope to mean it.
The newlyweds went to the kang to sit on the blessing, while Su Anhua and the older girls hurriedly arranged the dowry. The curtains, door curtains, and all kinds of curtains had to be hung up, so that people could see Xu Shiqin's craftsmanship.
This item will slowly disappear over time.
In the future, more and more girls will not learn needlework, and no one will embroider curtains and door curtains.
Not to mention the curtains, you can go directly to the fabric shop, you can find all kinds of them, and you don’t need to embroider them yourself.
Su Anying and other sister-in-laws put the dowry bedding, blankets, etc. into the kangqin on the top of the kang.
The locals also call it quige, anyway, they are all the same thing.
The quilt prepared by the Han family is two-layered, as tall as one person, with a quilt on top.
There are four doors at the bottom, where you can put clothes, and there are two drawers below, where you can put some needles and thread.
For the ash used on the front of the quilt, first paint a layer of light red paint on the outside of the finished furniture, and then apply two layers of clear oil instead of painting directly.
The texture of this kind of wood is clearly visible, and the color is slightly reddish. It looks a bit like the mahogany furniture in the south. It is the most fashionable way of making furniture in recent years.
Whether it is a quilt, a cabinet, a desk, or a box, most of them are handled in this way.
Waiting for another two years, such furniture will be eliminated.
People began to like pure white or off-white furniture, and various patterns were branded on the cabinet doors with soldering irons and the like.
Then in a few years, it will be the kind of modular furniture with decorative panels, and most of them are Shanghai brands.
Others unpacked the dowry color TV, washing machine, tape recorder and other large items, and put them in a suitable place.
The Han family thought of these things when they were making furniture. A set of cabinets on the ground were empty above the tops, where TVs and tape recorders could be placed.
There is a place in the corner of Westinghouse, where a washing machine can be placed.
The Xu family did not accompany the refrigerator, mainly because they thought it was useless.
Besides, I still don't know where Han Liwei will be next, and it will be troublesome to accompany too many things, so I might as well just buy them slowly later.
Anyway, as long as you have money, it is not difficult to buy anything.
The bride and groom are sitting on the kang, and the group of young men in attendance must come up with some bad ideas to tease the couple.
Xu Shiqin was thin-skinned, and blushed from being teased by these people.
It is said that there is no big or small for three days of newlyweds, anyone can make trouble, and they cannot turn their faces.
Fortunately, people are pretty good at this time, just some harmless little jokes, just to amuse the big guys.
When the house was full of laughter, joy and excitement, suddenly there was a sound of beating gongs and drums outside.
The voice was quite loud, and it was obviously right in front of Han's house.
People inside and outside the house were stunned, not understanding what was going on, and the young man with fast legs ran out to check, and then ran back.
"Outside, there are several cars coming outside, not only jeeps, but also the kind that lie on both ends.
There was a big car following behind, and someone in the car was beating gongs and drums, and they didn't know what they were doing. "
Participating secretary Lin Qiyue and deputy director Li Bingzhuo are both at Han's house.
After listening to those people's description, Lin Qiyue immediately felt that the cars lying on both ends seemed to be cars.
"Secretary Chen, Director Li, Shi Yan, let's go, go out and have a look, where is the leader here?"
Nowadays, most of the county leaders can only take a car, and ordinary township leaders can only take a jeep.
Han Liwei got married, and all the county leaders came? What's going on?
Han Liwei couldn't do it any better at this time, so he quickly put on his shoes and went out with everyone.
Although Xu Shiyan is from her natal family, he couldn't be left behind on this occasion, so he went out together.
When they got outside, the people in the car had already got off.
Guan Enxue, Chang Hongfa, Xu Shiyan knew each other, and there was a man in a grass-green uniform, who seemed to be from the Ministry of Human Armed Forces.
Xu Shiyan doesn't know the rest.
"Hey, Secretary Guan, Secretary Chang, why are you here?"
Lin Qiyue and Chen Jianzhang knew these people who were not recognized by others. The first and second leaders in the county are here, followed by the Minister of People's Armed Forces. What is this for?
"Just received the document from the superior, and learned that Comrade Han Liwei was awarded the honorary title of Hero and Model.
This is an honor that our county has never had before. The few of us came here to congratulate. "
Guan Enxue laughed when he saw Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan, and hurriedly explained.
When everyone heard the title of hero and model, some didn't quite understand it, and they were all at a loss.
But Lin Qiyue, Chen Jianzhang and others who were also soldiers, their expressions changed in an instant.
The honorary title is higher than the first-class merit. It is a legendary figure, and there may not be one in many years.
"Liwei, how much credit have you made?" Lin Qiyue couldn't hold back and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 402: glory
chapters.content:
Chapter 402 Glory
What Lin Qiyue said was actually what Xu Shiyan wanted to ask.
From the way Han Liwei came to greet the bride this morning, Xu Shiyan guessed that this matter was not easy.
Based on Han Liwei's previous level, it is absolutely impossible for him to get married, and the organization gives him such great support.
Arranged a car, and also arranged for the person to accompany the wedding, which seems to be a high-standard treatment.
Combined with what Xu Shiqin once said, when she went to the capital to accompany her, the hospital was also the highest level of care.
It can be guessed that Han Liwei's contribution is not small.
Xu Shiyan thought that the most powerful is first-class merit.
According to Han Liwei's situation at the time, his family members almost took over, so he should be eligible.
But the current result really surprised Xu Shiyan.
A role model? God, if this is put into later generations, the major TV stations and websites will not report it overwhelmingly?
Even now, it can be recorded in the county annals. No wonder the top leaders of the county came to the scene in person and celebrated with drums and gongs.
What's more important is that Han Liwei is now standing in front of everyone healthy and healthy, and he is still catching up with his wife today.
Twenty-seven years old, in the prime of life, with a bright future and a bright future.
His brother-in-law is amazing.
While speaking, the car over there got on top, and a few people jumped off, carrying two plaques back and forth. Needless to say, the county must have rushed to make it after getting the news.
"Fighting heroes, youth role models." "Home of heroes and models."
The big golden characters lifted the spirits of everyone present, and looked at Han Liwei with infinite reverence.
The young men in uniform who were arranged to help pick up the bride stood at attention directly at the plaque and saluted.
Han Liwei's eyes were calm, and he didn't seem to have many disturbances. He just stood there straight and saluted the people around him.
"Defending the family and the country is an incumbent duty. I dare not take credit for my responsibility."
The voice is sonorous and powerful, but careful people can still hear a trace of vibrato behind the voice.
There was a burst of warm applause at the scene. Han Wenzhong, his wife, Han Limin, Han Lixin brothers, and even Xu Shiqin, who was supposed to sit on the kang, came out and applauded desperately with tears in his eyes.
But Li Chengrong and a reporter from the county didn't bother to applaud and took countless photos one after another.
Scenes like this are rare to see, and we must seize the opportunity to snap up shots.
At this time, Guan Enxue noticed that the situation of the Han family is a little different today.
Han Liwei wore a red flower on his chest, and there was a woman in a red dress with a red flower, who looked like a bride at first glance.
Looking at so many people around, there is also a red happy word in the yard on the gate of the Han family.
What else do you not understand? The battle hero is getting married and having a happy event today.
"Oh, I didn't know Comrade Han was getting married today. If I knew we should prepare a congratulatory gift."
Guan Enxue and others sighed. After they received the documents, they immediately sent people to rush to work, and sent the plaques immediately after they were made.
I didn't expect such a coincidence, it happened to coincide with Han Liwei marrying his wife.
Han Liwei smiled when he heard the words, and looked at the plaque, "This is the best gift, nothing more precious than this. Thank you."
Yes, what gift can compare with this glory?
"Secretary Guan, Secretary Chang, since you are here, please come in and sit down.
Later, the wedding ceremony of Comrade Han Liwei and Comrade Xu Shiqin will be held in the participating cafeteria, and the two will be invited to be the officiant and witnesses. "
Who is Lin Qiyue? Doesn't he have enough eyesight? Immediately welcomed a group of people from the county into the yard.
Originally, it was said that Lin Qiyue would be the officiant and Li Bingzhuo would be the witness, but when Guan Enxue came, they had to give way.
Let the number one and number two be the officiant witnesses, Han Liwei's wedding can be said to be of the highest standard, right?
Guan Enxue didn't shirk it when he heard it. He only took a look at Chang Hongfa, and then agreed with a smile.
"Okay, since the rush is so coincidental, no matter what, we must join in the fun."
While speaking, a group of people walked to the courtyard of the Han family.
But at this time, Lin Qiyue hurriedly called someone over, "Hurry up and inform the cafeteria to add more food, and the banquet will be held according to the highest standard, hurry up."
For such a big happy event, everyone in the county is here, so the banquet must be the best.
The other party hesitated a little.
The dishes for the banquet are all ordered in advance, and the semi-finished products were prepared yesterday. Today, as long as what should be steamed, what should be stewed, what should be stewed and thickened, it can be served on the table.
At this time, I said that I want to add more vegetables, but I don’t have any ingredients, what should I do?
"Shengli, Xiaofeng, Zong Liang, hurry up, the three of you drive to the farm quickly, kill a few sheep and deer, and send them to the cafeteria quickly.
Let's see if the master has any ideas to make more dishes. "
