Xu Shiyan quickly called a few brothers over and arranged for them to go to the breeding farm.
At this time, I can’t take care of anything else, let’s prepare the banquet first.
For such a big scene, if the standard of the banquet is too low, it will be really ugly.
Huang Shengli and the others didn't dare to be negligent when they heard it. They hurried to drive and went straight to the farm.
Lin Qiyue thought it was still not enough, and he needed to have some excitement, so he hurriedly notified the participating art troupe to prepare the program immediately.
Then I discussed with Da Zhang Luo, postponed the time of the wedding ceremony for a while, and arranged more programs in between.
This way the atmosphere of the wedding is more lively, and the chef in the cafeteria can spend a little more time to prepare the meals.
This kind of thing is not a problem for Zhang Luo. He is a trade union officer himself, and he is the best at doing this.
So I hurriedly negotiated with the art troupe, urgently arranged the program, and made sure to complete today's venue.
Guan Enxue and others entered the courtyard and sat down in the new room to talk, and the plaque was also hung on the wall.
Everyone looked at the layout of the new house and nodded, "Comrade Han is very lucky to have married a good wife.
I wish the two husbands and wives harmony, happiness, early birth of a son, and loving life. "
Guan Enxue had to praise Xu Shiqin a few words, and at the same time send his most sincere blessings.
Several other people also sent blessings one after another, and then Xiao Yunsheng from the Armed Forces Department started chatting with Han Liwei.
"Comrade Han Liwei, congratulations, double happiness, gratifying.
By the way, have you seen all the superior’s documents? About your next arrangement? "
Xiao Yunsheng has a different identity and knows more than others, so he pays more respect to Han Liwei.
"Well, I received a notice the day before yesterday that I will go to the capital to participate in the meritorious service award ceremony after the next year, and then I will study at the Capital Military Academy."
Actually, when Han Liwei was discharged from 301, some leaders visited him, allowing him to go home to recuperate with peace of mind, first to solve his personal problems, and to get married.
Regarding Han Liwei's future arrangements, there will be official documents issued.
Han Liwei was recuperating at home, and relevant leaders would come to visit him from time to time, and the official documents came down the day before yesterday.
This time, Han Liwei made an exception to advance, and then he will go to study first, and make arrangements after the study is over.
How many of those who wear this uniform don’t want to go to the capital for further studies?
This item alone is enough to make everyone envious.

chapters.title: Chapter 403: wedding
chapters.content:
Chapter 403 Wedding
The wedding procedures at the Han family's side are almost in progress. Next, everyone moved to the dining hall to carry out the next wedding ceremony and other items.
First, there are guest houses, canteens, cultural palaces, clubs and other related institutions run by the venue.
The cafeteria is next to the guest house. It has a large area and can accommodate many tables.
At this time, in the cafeteria, there were lights and festoons everywhere, and a temporary reception desk was set up.
On the wall of the reception desk, a pink quilt was hung, with a big red letter of happiness pinned on it with a pin, and a big red flower on it.
A lot of tables and chairs were placed beside him, Lin Qiyue hurriedly greeted Guan Enxue and others, as well as relatives and friends of the man and woman, and sat down on the left and right.
Other guests, those from the mother’s family sit together, and those from the husband’s family sit together.
At 10:58 in the morning, the ceremony officially began.
Originally, I didn’t intend to make it too grand, so I thought about coming here. The officiant and witnesses will say a few words, the bride and groom salute, and then the banquet will begin.
As a result, when the county leaders came, the original procedure was too simple.
Han Liwei has made such a great contribution, won such a high honor, and the county leaders came to attend the wedding, so what if the whole thing is too simple?
So, the director of the participating art troupe was invited to act as the master of ceremonies for the wedding temporarily.
The actors of the art troupe also rehearsed the show temporarily, making sure that today's wedding ceremony is exciting and lively.
So, the song and dance of the art troupe started, and then the master of ceremonies came on stage to say the opening remarks, and then invited the bride and groom to come on stage, and the master of ceremonies introduced the newcomers to all the guests.
In this, many links can be interspersed, such as asking the bride and groom to talk about the process of the two getting to know each other and love each other.
The master of ceremonies will also make jokes in the middle and say some funny things to bring up the atmosphere of the scene.
Not to mention, this person really has two brushes, witty words, all kinds of witty words emerge one after another, and the burden is shaken one after another, making all the guests who came to congratulate him laugh.
Then, the officiant and the witnesses came up to speak one after another, and the witnesses read out their marriage certificates to prove that they are legal couples.
Then, representatives of relatives and friends from both sides will also take the stage to speak, expressing their wishes and expectations for the couple.
After the representatives of the relatives and friends of both parties have finished their speeches, the couple should thank both parents for their kindness in nurturing.
Then, the newlyweds exchange tokens, and the groom will say the marriage vows.
These were not in the original process. Fortunately, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin bought gifts for each other, which happened to be a pair of watches, which came in handy.
As for the marriage vows, Han Liwei is not afraid.
In front of everyone, he promised Xu Shiqin that he would love her for the rest of his life, be loyal and never betray her.
There was warm applause at the scene, and the couple embraced happily amidst the applause of the guests.
Added another item at the end, handing over a glass of wine, which is also a procedure that has never been done before.
The cup was ordered from the back kitchen, and the wine was the wine that Lin Qiyue sent someone to take back home.
Put a piece of red paper on the tray, put two cups on top, pour wine into the cups, and a little cousin of Han Liwei will serve them.
There were not so many programs in this year and month, and naturally no one used their brains. After a few years, they would not dare to say what was in the cup of wine.
Some people are mischievous and will put mustard, soy sauce, chili oil and other things in the groom's glass of wine, just to trick the groom.
Han Liwei had caught up with the good time, no one noticed this, and no one harmed him, this is serious wine.
The couple linked their arms together, lowered their heads and took a sip of wine each.
Xu Shiqin had never drank wine before, even though it was just wine, he also felt that the taste was quite strong, and his face flushed.
Han Liwei is fine, this little wine is just drizzle to him.
After drinking a glass of wine, the wedding ceremony was completed, and no one knew who was outside, so they picked up two more firecrackers and let them go off crackling.
"Now I announce that the wedding ceremony of Comrade Han Liwei and Comrade Xu Shiqin is over.
Thank you for coming to the wedding. In order to express our gratitude, the Han family specially invited comrades from the art troupe to present wonderful performances.
At the same time, the Han family and the Xu family also prepared sumptuous banquets to entertain the guests.
Everyone, Chinese New Year is coming soon. I would like to wish you all a New Year in advance. I wish you good health, smooth work and all the best in the new year. "
The master of ceremonies has enough chatter, and even came out to talk about the Chinese New Year, which made everyone on the scene laugh out loud.
The master of ceremonies leaves the stage, and the actors of the art troupe enter the stage.
Errenzhuan, Huangmei Opera, Pingju, Crosstalk, Kuaibanshu, dance, anyway, everyone tried their best.
Don't look at it as a temporary performance, but the performance is very exciting.
Those guests below, and the employees who participated in the venue were better, after all, they have seen the performance.
People from the Xu family were all dumbfounded. Who has ever seen a show at a wedding?
Now, I am so busy watching the show that I even forget about being hungry.
After the performance of the art troupe, someone grabbed Han Liwei again and asked him to sing a song.
After Han Liwei finished singing, the back kitchen finally started to move, and the daughters-in-law of the helpers came out with dishes.
The first must be cold dishes, skin jelly, soft fried meat, cabbage heart vermicelli and fungus cold dish.
In the middle are fish, chicken stewed with mushrooms, braised meat, crispy white meat, stir-fried meat, sauerkraut blood sausage, stir-fried lamb, braised venison.
The last dish must be Sixi meatballs.
As soon as Sixi meatballs came on stage, everyone knew that there was no more food to come.
Some people also say that when the Sixi meatballs are served, it means to get out after eating, so this dish must be served last.
For today's banquet, the Han family bought two big fat pigs from other places, butchered them yesterday morning, and they worked hard all day in this cafeteria.
I also bought a lot of other chicken, fish, meat, and eggs.
Originally thought that such a dish would be hard enough, but I didn't expect Guan Enxue and the others to come.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan sent venison and mutton, and the master chef quickly added two more convenient dishes.
Twelve dishes, except for the cold dish, which is considered as Maocai, the others can be called hard dishes in this year.
The table is already of a super high standard, no matter who is called, there is nothing wrong with it.
In addition to these twelve dishes, there will be two more desserts, candied sweet potato and honey braised three delicacies, for the guests of my natal family.
This is called natal appreciating dishes, which are specially prepared by the master chef for natal family.
Of course, the natal family also has to arrange someone to go to the back kitchen to reward, at least a few tens of dollars for the hard work of the master.
Actually, this is a rule that has only emerged in the last two years. In the past few years, life was bad, and I couldn’t even eat enough. How could there be such a saying?
Xu Shiyan had to go over this matter, "Master Zhang, you have worked hard. Thanks to Master Zhang's good craftsmanship, today's banquet is really good."
Xu Shiyan went to the back kitchen, and while talking, he stuffed two red envelopes to the master.
"Hey, isn't Section Chief Xu's words offended? Then your sister is married to Liwei, a battle hero.
My old Zhang has no other skills, but can cook a dish, so he must do it well. "

chapters.title: Chapter 404: The fox sends the pheasant
chapters.content:
Chapter 404 The Fox Gives the Pheasant
In this year and month, most wedding banquets only have eight dishes, and it is very good if you can make ten dishes.
The Han family originally prepared ten dishes, but the venison and mutton were added later.
The twelve dishes are quite firm, and the size of the dishes is not small, and the taste is even better. All the guests who came to Hexi were very happy.
Not long after the banquet started, Da Zhang Luo called the bride and groom to toast.
According to the logic, one should respect one's mother's family first, and then one's in-law's family.
But today is special, with so many leaders coming from the county, they must make a toast first.
Guan Enxue and his party, accompanied by Lin Qiyue, Li Bingzhuo, Chen Jianzhang, and Xu Shiyan, saw the newcomer coming, and everyone sent their most sincere blessings.
Xu Shiqin couldn't drink, but Han Liwei didn't care, so he drank a glass directly.
"Well, Liwei, drink less, after all, he is recovering from a serious injury, everyone understands."
Lin Qiyue was afraid that Han Liwei would drink too much and affect his health, so he hurriedly called a few young men over to protect Han Liwei and prevent some people from booing and drinking.
"Yes, yes, the body is important, we all understand, as long as the meaning is enough." Guan Enxue and others also expressed their understanding.
Han Liwei thanked everyone, and went to the next table with Xu Shiqin to toast.
The young men in the back all got Lin Qiyue's instruction. If anyone makes a fuss and wants to drink, these few will go up and help drink.
In this way, Han Liwei avoided the risk of getting drunk. He only drank a few glasses of wine from the beginning to the end, and blocked everything else.
Everyone can understand, after all, it is a person who almost lost his life, so it is better to be careful.
The banquet at this time is still very lively, everyone is drinking and chatting.
The young man punched a few times, and shouted loudly. Although it was a bit noisy, the atmosphere was good.
Guan Enxue and the others still have jobs, so it is impossible to stay for a long time. The newcomers got up and left shortly after toasting.
It is necessary to keep it here, but the work is important, and it really cannot be delayed.
Just like that, Guan Enxue and his party left by car and returned to the county seat.
After a while, the guests from my natal family had almost eaten, so I chatted with the Han family for a while, and then left one after another.
Hexi’s neighbors, relatives and friends, and those nearby all left separately. For those who were far away or needed to drive, Xu Shiyan arranged for someone to drive to see them off.
Su Wenzhong and other relatives in Daying had to catch the 3:00 p.m. train, and together with Su Anhua, they left by car.
In the end, only the brothers from the Xu family were left, going home to stay with their parents.
"Father, Mom, you didn't see that scene. The county leaders all came and gave the sixth brother-in-law a plaque.
The sixth brother-in-law is amazing this time. I heard that the sixth brother-in-law will go to the capital to study in the next year. When he finishes his studies, it will be even more amazing. "
Brother Xu Shixian returned home and began to happily tell his parents what he saw at Han's house today.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were dumbfounded. They were still talking at home, wondering where Han Liwei would be arranged when he returned to the team after the next year.
Unexpectedly, Han Liwei actually made such a great contribution and went directly to university for further studies.
"What is that university for? Where can I be arranged after finishing my studies?"
Xu Chenghou had never heard of these before, so he had to ask.
"Father, that university does not recruit external students, but only recruits the best and outstanding people in the organization to study further.
After further study, the minimum must be regiment level, right?
I heard that Li Wei broke the rules and advanced. I didn’t say how many levels he advanced. I guess, at least he can reach the deputy group. "Xu Shiyan thought for a moment and said.
Xu Shiyan ate with Guan Enxue and the others. Judging from Xiao Yunsheng's words, Han Liwei definitely wasn't promoted to a higher level this time.
You must know that Han Liwei has always performed well in organization. Before he went to the Southwest, he was a sub-battalion.
Now that he has made such a great contribution, it is definitely not a matter of being promoted to a higher level.
"Oh, how much credit has Liwei made to win such a high honor?" Xu Chenghou said with emotion.
"That's right, third child, you didn't ask carefully? We only know that Liwei has made meritorious service, but how did he do it?"
Xu Shixian suddenly remembered, didn't he? Caring and happy, no one asked, how did Han Liwei get the credit?
"Brother, you can't ask about this matter. If you can tell me, when Secretary Guan and the others come, you can tell me directly.
Since he didn’t say anything, it proves that it’s still in a state of secrecy, and it’s not something we can inquire about. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head and sighed. Normally, the eldest brother must understand this.
Xu Shixian slapped his forehead, "Isn't it? I forgot about this problem. Don't ask, don't ask about anything."
"Yes, don't ask around, we don't care what Liwei does, as long as he does well."
No matter how much meritorious service you make, it is all done by risking your life.
Han Liwei was like stepping into the gate of **** with one foot, and was rescued alive again.
Outsiders are all looking at the glory of meritorious service. Only the family members will love him. I don’t know how much suffering and blood shed to earn this honor today.
"Okay, you have been busy for several days and are quite tired, so let's rest first.
Tomorrow will be in-laws, and Shiqin and his wife will return home the day after tomorrow.
If you guys are busy, you can go home separately after meeting your in-laws tomorrow. Anyway, there is no banquet when you go back home, and you can sit with your family and chat for a while. "
My daughter is out of the house, and the family has nothing to think about.
Xu Chenghou took a look, it was almost three o'clock, and there was nothing to do today, only one meal tonight.
There is still a lot of food left in the morning, just heat it up as you like, and rest when you need to rest, let's talk about other things later.
Xu Shixian and the others all drank some wine, and they were indeed tired at the moment, so they simply went sideways.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying saw it, and hurried home to light the fire. They were so busy that day that they didn't take care of the family, so they got up in the morning and lit the fire.
Without a fire in this cold weather, there is no way to stay in the house at night.
"Yuanyuan, you guys are playing with your brothers and sisters here. Your mother and I will go home and light the fire. I'll be back later."
Xu Shiyan instructed his son, and hurried home with Su Anying to start a fire.
There are two kangs in the east and west houses, plus the fire wall, all of them have to be lit. Xu Shide and the others have to come and live in the evening, so the house can't be too cold.
Fortunately, there is plenty of firewood at home, such as whole tree roots, pimples, etc., fill a few more pieces into the stove, and burn it slowly to keep it hot for a long time.
After the kang was heated up and the room warmed up, the couple sat down and wanted to chat for a while.
As a result, as soon as I sat down here, I heard something scratching the door. Needless to say, it must be a rascal.
Xu Shiyan went out and opened the door, and saw Lai Pigui standing outside the door with a pheasant in his mouth and his big fluffy tail flicking.
"You guy, you ran out last night and only came back now? What's wrong? Bring me something delicious?"
Xu Shiyan stepped aside to let the rascal into the house.
Xu Shide and others came to live yesterday, but the rascal didn’t show up, and I didn’t see it this morning.
This fox is about to grow into a spirit. Whenever someone unfamiliar comes to the house, it doesn't show its face at all, and hides far away.
The rascal didn’t enter the house, just put the pheasant in his mouth on the ground, turned around and ran back to the east house.

chapters.title: Chapter 405: Encouraging Learning
chapters.content:
Chapter 405 Encouraging Learning
The twenty-seventh day of the twelfth lunar month is the day when the Han and Xu families meet their in-laws.
Around nine o'clock in the morning, Han Liwei, accompanied by his two elder brothers, came to pick up the father-in-law's family.
Everyone arrived at the Han family and was warmly received by the Han family.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan also saw the girl who got married yesterday, and seeing that the girl looked good and smiled, the old couple felt relieved.
Although the two families of Han and Xu are meeting relatives, they have to invite a few people with good relations to come and accompany the guests.
Lin Qiyue, Li Bingzhuo, and Da Lao Li were all invited, and everyone chatted and laughed together, which was very lively.
"Third brother, come here, I have something to tell you."
Everyone was talking in the room where Han Wenzhong and his wife lived, but Xu Shiqin quietly dragged Xu Shiyan away.
"What's wrong?" Xu Shiyan asked his sister when the two came to the yard.
"Third brother, my master told me yesterday that I want you to help sell the few pots of Clivia in her house."
Xu Shiqin specially called Xu Shiyan out for this matter.
"What's the matter? Master Ni has figured it out again?" Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it.
Xu Shiqin raised Clivia, and at the beginning he asked for seedlings from Master Qin.
Later she fell in love with raising Clivia, so she searched everywhere for good-looking varieties.
Master Qin’s family has two pots of Great Victory and two pots of Oiler, both of which are very good varieties.
Before Su Anying took the flowers to the provincial capital, according to Xu Shiyan's instructions, she went to the tailor shop to find Master Qin.
I want to ask if the potted flowers at her house are for sale. If so, I can help to bring them over.
Master Qin didn't believe how much Clivia was worth at that time.
Besides, people really like flowers. Those potted flowers have been grown for many years, so how can they be willing to sell them? So I declined.
"My master said that Songjianghe is also not very stable recently, and many people are eyeing her flowers.
My master was so scared that I couldn't sleep at night. She said that it would be better to sell it and cultivate seedlings later. "
Xu Shiqin sighed, he didn't expect that the Songjiang River was so far away from the provincial capital, and this gust of wind would blow over.
"Isn't that the reason? Earn the money first, even if you like it, you can raise it later. Why bother staying at home and causing trouble?"
Xu Shiyan also sighed when he heard it, Hua is innocent, but those who are guilty are those who are greedy.
What can I do? Master Qin is so kind to Xu Shiqin, besides, Xu Shiqin's raising Clivia was also influenced by Master Qin, so we must help him with this favor.
"It doesn't matter, it's easy, your third sister-in-law has a lot of phone numbers of second-hand traffickers in provincial capitals.
In the afternoon, we will call when we go back. If we call today, someone will come to buy it in a few days. "
Those people who are clinging to Clivia now only have money in their eyes, so why don’t they celebrate the new year?
Especially in the past few days, the Clivia market in the provincial capital has been bullish all the way, and I don’t know how many people are frantically buying it.
Within a few days after returning from the provincial capital, Xu Shiyan applied to the Post and Telecommunications Bureau to install a telephone. He was the first person to install a telephone in Donggang Town.
Of course, the installation fee also cost a lot of money.
Hearing what the third brother said, Xu Shiqin was relieved. "It's causing trouble for the third brother and the third sister-in-law again."
Xu Shiqin felt very embarrassed. Over the years, her elder brother and sister-in-law had helped her too much.
"Thank you? My siblings are so polite?" Xu Shiyan laughed.
"By the way, Liwei is going to study in the capital after the year. What about you? What are your plans?"
It's useless to say that, let's talk about something serious.
"Me? I don't know. I still have a job here. He is going to study. We probably have to live in two places, right?"
Bringing this matter up, Xu Shiqin's expression was a little sad. The two of them were about to separate just after they got married, and they really couldn't bear to part with it.
"You listen to me, tell your master to suspend without pay, and then go to the capital with Liwei.
The first thing I did when I got there was to buy a house. I bought a better courtyard house in the capital, which cost around 20,000 yuan.
You have more than enough money in your hand, buy what you need. "
Are you kidding me? If you have this opportunity, why don't you hurry up and buy a house?
Although I don't know what the capital's current housing policy is, but right now is definitely an opportunity.
With the rise of going abroad, many people have sold their old houses in China and went abroad to develop.
Spend tens of thousands of dollars to buy a courtyard house, and decades later, it will definitely make a fortune.
"Second, find a way to go to a night school.
I seem to have heard that there is a chemical fiber and textile college in the capital, or a fashion college.
You go to inquire about it, and if there is an evening school, sign up for a class. Other schools are fine, anyway, I just have to learn something. "
Han Liwei is about to go to the Capital Military Academy for advanced studies, and if Xu Shiqin can't follow up and hurry up to study, he will be easily left behind.
Between husband and wife, the most fearful thing is that one person stays in place while the other goes further and further away.
People like Han Liwei have a bright future, and their future achievements will definitely be extraordinary.
If Xu Shiqin doesn't want to make progress, he will be left behind sooner or later.
Although the marriage of the two people is special, the possibility of the marriage breaking up is extremely small, that doesn't work either.
Xu Shiqin must be a person worthy of Han Liwei. Being worthy is not only about his external identity, but also his mind, knowledge, and vision.
Only when two people are evenly matched, appreciate and help each other, can such a marriage be the most secure and happiest.
"Remember, times are changing.
In the past, the kind of men who served as soldiers outside to defend the country, while women farmed at home, respected their parents-in-law and raised their children, has long been unsuitable.
Women also have to make progress, and they can't hang around at home all their lives.
Liwei's parents are not very old, besides, there are Limin and Lixin taking care of the family, so you don't need to worry about it.
You two just got married and have no children. It's a good time to be light-handed. How many years will you have to wait if you don't study? Will you carry your child to school in the future? "
In Xu Shiyan's view, there is no better way out than reading. No matter men or women, as long as they have the opportunity, they should read.
"Look at your third sister-in-law, she didn't go to school all day, now? She can write and count.
In the past few days, your third sister-in-law told me that if she had the chance, she would also like to go to a university and learn more knowledge.
How about you? Anyway, I graduated from middle school, and now my health is better, so I can find a way to study.
In the future, if I have the opportunity to enroll in a correspondence class, or directly take the adult college entrance examination, whatever. "
Xu Shiqin's current money is not enough to spend her whole life, but it is about the same.
It is no longer necessary to go to work to earn money, so study hard.
Enriching yourself with knowledge is the best investment.
Many people lose their purpose in life and don't know what to do in the future after they suddenly have a lot of wealth.
Just like the later generations who dismantled the second generation and got millions at once, but without clear goals and plans, such people basically have no future.
They couldn't hold on to the money they got from demolition. Maybe after three to five years, the money would be squandered and they would have nothing.
Xu Shiyan persuaded Zhao Jianshe and them before, but now he persuades Xu Shiqin with only one purpose, that is, not to want their lives to be ruined by this sudden huge wealth.
Xu Shiqin is still young and has a lot of time to study. Only by learning and making continuous progress can he keep up with the pace of society and not be eliminated and abandoned.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: talk business
chapters.content:
Chapter 406 Talk about business
Xu Shiqin has always obeyed the third brother's words, and she herself regrets not being able to take the college entrance examination.
When the news of the resumption of the college entrance examination first came out, Xu Shiqin was eager to sign up.
As a result, the first item was the requirement of good health, and she was unqualified, and it was a long time since she was sad.
Having had a job in the past few years, she didn't think so much, but what the third brother said today rekindled her desire to learn.
"Okay, I will listen to the third brother, and I will tell the master in the next year that I will go to the capital and find a chance to study."
The siblings chatted for a while, then went back to the house, talking and chatting with their relatives and friends.
Everyone has the same aspirations, and no one has ever asked how Han Liwei achieved his meritorious deeds.
It was Han Wenzhong who expressed his gratitude to Xu Shiyan.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't immediately arranged for mutton and venison to be delivered yesterday, Chef Zhang really didn't know what to add.
"Shiyan, how much was the mutton and venison yesterday? I'll bring it to you." The Han family set up a banquet, and Xu Shiyan could not be allowed to pay for it.
"Uncle, why are you being polite to me?
We agreed that the two families will hold a banquet together. There are so many people passing by my house, and the money for the banquet has not been counted to you yet. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and waved his hands, what are you doing so clearly? As long as Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin live a good life, everything else is floating clouds.
"How can I do that? A deer costs a lot of money. You raised it to get antlers. That's good, just kill it."
Han Wenzhong felt very distressed. One deer can get two crops of velvet, and the velvet alone can be sold for more than 1,000 yuan a year.
Besides, this deer can get antlers for many years. If this is the calculation, killing a deer will cost a lot.
Originally, the Han family said they were holding a banquet together, but it was just a trick, and they didn't intend to charge the Xu family for the banquet at all.
There are only seven or eight tables of guests at the Xu family's side, and there are three tables for the natal family who sent off their relatives, which can't be counted.
How much is a table banquet this year? How can it be compared with a deer.
"Uncle, there is no need for our two families to argue about this. I won't give you the banquet money, and you don't need to give me the money for mutton and venison. That's it.
Quan thought it was our call from up the mountain, just to add food to Liwei and Shiqin's wedding. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and waved his hands, refusing to accept no matter what.
Xu Shiyan doesn't want it, and the Han family has no choice.
At noon, the Han family prepared a sumptuous meal, and everyone ate, drank and chatted together, which was very lively.
After one o'clock, the banquet broke up, and everyone in the Xu family left and went home.
It is already the 27th of the twelfth lunar month, and this year is the 30th New Year’s Eve of the twelfth lunar month. Xue Xiulin has a few sisters-in-law, and grass begins to grow in her heart, thinking about going home quickly.
I haven't prepared much for the New Year, and I can't always live at my in-laws' house.
But Xu Shixian and his brothers insisted on staying another day, and they would leave after the younger sister came back tomorrow.
If Han Liwei accompanied Xu Shiqin back home tomorrow, it turned out that only the second and third brothers were there, and the rest of the elder brothers had left, how bad would it be?
Not only Xu Shixian and his brothers didn't want to leave, but the children didn't want to leave either.
There are food and entertainment here, and there are color TVs to watch.
Especially when Chinese New Year is approaching, CCTV also has programs during the day, these brats are obsessed with watching TV, and wish they could stay at their grandparents’ house forever.
Xue Xiulin has several sisters-in-law, but her husband and children are no match for her. She has no choice but to agree to live here.
Seeing this, Zhou Guilan knew that the daughters-in-law couldn't wait because of something, so she simply led them to make noodles and started steaming steamed buns in the afternoon.
It’s the Chinese New Year, so I have to steam some jujube steamed buns and flower buns to celebrate.
In order to make the children happy, Zhou Guilan used all the unique skills of pressing the bottom of the box, making all kinds of jujube steamed buns and flower steamed buns.
They even dug out molds and asked the children to help them make fish steamed buns, ingot steamed buns and so on.
The children were happy now, and they had a great time playing one by one.
Now, I have been busy until 8 o'clock in the evening. I steamed five or six pots of various steamed buns, and all the kangs in the East and West Houses were burned.
Originally, they all squeezed to the top of the kang, but now, they all ran to the top of the kang, no one wanted to sleep on the top of the kang, it was too hot.
On the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth lunar month, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin returned home with a lot of things, and the Xu family warmly and grandly entertained the young couple.
The Xu family prepared more than a dozen dishes of chicken, duck and fish. Xu Shiyan and others accompanied Han Liwei to drink some wine, and then the young couple stayed at Xu's house until around two o'clock in the afternoon before leaving.
Waiting to see off Han Liwei and his wife, Xu Chenghou called his sons to him.
"There is one thing, I have been wanting to say since you came back, but I never had a chance.
Now that the sixth child is also married, and today’s visit is over, it’s time to tell you. "
Xu Shixian and the others are now most afraid of their father's move. Every time father makes such a move, they have to be dealt with.
But Xu Chenghou has already spoken, and these few can't hide if they want to, so what can they do? Just bite the bullet and listen.
It is estimated that the pension fee for next year will be fixed, and it is likely to increase some more money.
Hey, let’s go up if it goes up, the prices are also going up, old men and old ladies have to live too, don’t they?
"That's the thing, your mother and I are getting older and can't do much in the future.
The old-age pensions given by you guys are just food for the year, so you can’t save much.
I thought about it for a long time, and after thinking about it, I sold the house. "When Xu Chenghou said this, he paused and looked up at the sons.
Xu Shixian and the others were all stunned for a moment, with puzzled expressions on their faces.
Ordinarily, there is also such a custom in rural areas, that is, after the elderly are old enough to completely lose their labor force and cannot live independently, most of them are taken care of by several sons in turn.
A few months in this family, a few months in that family, each son will live in the house for a period of time, taking turns to take care of them.
Xu Chenghou is only sixty-five years old after the new year, and Zhou Guilan is only fifty-seven years old after the new year. It is still too early to be unable to live independently. Why are you going to sell the house and take care of your son at this time?
Xu Shixian glanced at his daughter-in-law, thinking that this matter is not easy to handle.
Mom has a good temper, so it’s okay to say, but Dad’s temper is too weird. If I go to his house, can I do it?
Besides, there are only three small broken rooms in his house, and it is not very spacious for a family of five. Parents have passed, where do they live?
Among the five brothers, apart from the most spacious of the third oldest, the second eldest is Xu Shian. His house in Sentie is not small and quite spacious.
The other three houses are all small houses, and the population is too large to live in.
But you can’t say that.
The brothers looked at each other, "Father, are you willing to give up such a spacious and big house at home? What a pity to sell it?
Otherwise, if our brothers give you a little more pension, don't sell this house, right? "
Xu Shixian felt that he would rather give the family some more money than take his parents to live there, otherwise, there would be no peace in the future.
Xu Chenghou glanced at his sons and snorted, "I know, you brothers, you don't have the intention to take us to the elderly."
All the white-eyed wolves, when they were told to let them retire, they all dared not say a word, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 407: sell house
chapters.content:
Chapter 407 Selling a house
"I discussed it with your mother, and I don't intend to make things difficult for you."
Xu Chenghou sighed, he is his own son after all, what can he do? Who told them to have such a son?
"We told the third child about this, and sold the house to the third child for 20,000 yuan.
The third child spent money to buy a house, and temporarily returned it to us to live in. When we leave later, he can handle the house as he likes.
Look, if you guys can pay the money, the house can be sold to you. "Xu Chenghou said that on purpose.
"We don't have any other intentions, just want to keep some money in our hands, and use it as money for crossing the river.
In case something happens in the future, you will be embarrassed. "
Xu Shixian heard this, what else do you not understand?
Mom and Dad are thinking about relying on the third child to provide for the elderly in the future, and they are afraid that the third child will suffer, so they make arrangements in advance.
Twenty thousand yuan is a huge sum of money for them, but it is just a drizzle for the third child.
Brothers are a little hesitant, not knowing how to express their views on this matter.
Ordinarily, the house is only worth a thousand dollars now, but who knows what will happen in the future?
However, no matter how much the house goes up, it probably won't sell for 20,000 yuan, right? So, if you do this, the third child will definitely suffer.
"Father, Mom, since you both discussed it, we don't have any objections.
The third child is close, and the third child takes care of his parents every day, so the third child suffers.
We are far away and busy with work, and we don’t come back several times throughout the year, so we really can’t take care of them. "
Xu Shixian is the eldest son, of course he must speak first.
"If I really want my parents to move to our place, alas, the place in the county is small and narrow.
I was afraid that my father would be breathless if he went over to take a look. "Xu Shixian sighed.
County towns have a large population and small places, and the living conditions are far worse than those in rural areas.
If the house of the Xu family was placed in the county, it would be absolutely amazing.
"Then do as parents say?
Anyway, in the future, we have to give what we should pay, and we can’t say that our parents sold the house and have money in our hands, so we don’t care, right? "
As long as they don't ask them to pay 20,000 yuan, and don't let the elderly move into their home, do whatever you like.
It is the third child who pays the money around, and the third child will also contribute in the future. They just give some living expenses every month, and come back a few times a year to have a look. This is the best way and saves worry.
Xu Shide and Xu Shixiang thought about it, and it was the same thing. It would be impossible for them to get the money, and it would be inconvenient for them to take their parents to live there.
What can I do then? It's just a house, not to mention selling it for 15000 yuan, even if it is 15000 yuan, how much can each of the five brothers get?
Since the third child is willing, then he will pay for it, why would anyone want to rob him?
"Okay, let's do it like this, and do as our father said." The two also agreed.
Xu Shi'an has now learned a trick, that is, no matter what the time is, don't speak indiscriminately.
The more you talk, the more mistakes you make, be honest and keep quiet, talk less and make fewer mistakes.
So he didn't say a word just now, the brothers can talk whatever they like.
But now it was his turn to express his opinion, and he refused to say a few more words. "Father can do as he sees, I have no objection."
"All right, fourth child, I will give you a pen and paper, and you can write.
Third child, go and call your neighbors over and let them be witnesses. Let's make this happen while we're all here. "
Xu Chenghou spoke to arrange work for his sons.
Xu Shiyan hurried out and found the two neighbors in Dongtou and Nanfang.
The north is the tomb of the martyrs, and the west is the road. Jiancan City will be demolished after the first day of the road, so there are actually only two neighbors.
Don’t worry about the number of companies, as long as someone can bear witness.
Here Xu Shide wrote the house sale contract, and Xu Chenghou, Xu Shiyan and his son wrote their names and fingerprints on it.
Then the neighbors also signed and pressed their fingerprints, and it was considered successful.
House sales contract, in duplicate, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan each take one.
After writing the contract and thanking the neighbors, Xu Chenghou told them that they would invite them to drink to thank them another day.
The other party naturally wants to be polite, and they often bother Xu's family on weekdays. They still watch TV every night. How can such a small matter be thanked?
Nian Gen'er was in a hurry, and he was busy, and the neighbor didn't stay at Xu's house for a long time, so he left in a hurry.
After the neighbor left, Xu Chenghou asked Xu Shide to write another agreement, which was still for the elderly.
Regardless of whether there is this house or not, the brothers must fulfill their support obligations. The monthly money must not be less, and the food is too troublesome.
In the future, if the old couple suffers from some kind of illness or disaster, these few will have to be in the forefront.
Compared with the previous agreement, there is only one house short, nothing else.
This time, there is no need to find anyone to be a witness. The father and son all signed their fingerprints on the agreement, and Xu Chenghou asked Zhou Guilan to put it away.
With such a delay, it will be too late.
In the afternoon, there was no bus back to the county, and the train to Xianrenqiao also passed a little later.
What can I do then? Even if Xu Shiyan's family has a car, one is that Xu Shiyan hasn't learned it yet, and the other is that the car can't handle so many people, so everyone can only stay here for one more night.
The next morning, Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang's family were going to take the bus from Donggang to Fusong at 7:30 to go back to the county.
Xu Shide's family had to catch the 8:40 train.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan, the old couple, prepared a lot of things for their three sons.
Jujube steamed buns, sticky fire spoons, pork, etc., filled more than half of the woven bags, which was more than what they brought back.
Xu Chenghou also packed some cabbage, sauerkraut and so on for Xu Shixian alone.
There is no vegetable garden in the county seat, so you have to buy everything you eat. Wouldn’t it be cheaper to take some back home?
"Take these things back home, add some more things, and the Chinese New Year is almost done."
Don’t look at your son and daughter-in-law, you have to look at your grandchildren. They finally come back, and they can’t go back empty-handed.
It is rare for the children to live at their grandparents' house for such a long time, and they are reluctant to part with each other.
Xu Haiyang, Xu Jingyi, and Xu Jingwen, the three little ones, cried and didn't want to leave, but wanted to stay with their grandparents.
"Do you want to stay with your grandparents? You obviously want to stay and watch TV.
Hurry up and leave, tomorrow is the Chinese New Year, and there is nothing prepared at home. "
Wu Qiuyan and Chen Chunling both had dark faces, dragging the child out.
"Otherwise, you can let the children live here for a while, because they don't go to school anyway.
Put it here, play with Yuanyuan and the others, and have a companion. "
Zhou Guilan couldn't bear to see her grandchildren crying so badly, so she interceded.
"During the Chinese New Year, my parents are also busy here, how can I have time to take care of them?
Besides, we may not be able to come back after the year, and no one will come to pick them up. "
Xu Shixian and the others came back from the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth lunar month and stayed there until the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth lunar month, which was quite a long time.
So I discussed with Xu Chenghou and his wife that I will not go back to the second day of the new year, and come back when I have time.

chapters.title: Chapter 408: gala
chapters.content:
Chapter 408 Gala
Xu Haiyang and the others were finally dragged away by their parents while crying.
Looking at the backs of his children and grandchildren leaving, Xu Chenghou couldn't help shaking his head and sighing.
"What do you think the children can do if they stay? Are we not their grandpa and grandma? Can we still abuse the children?
The fifth daughter-in-law, isn’t her natal family also in Donggang?
Even if she doesn't come back to us in the second year of junior high school, she won't return to her mother's house in the third year of junior high school? It's time to take the child away. "
"On the other side of the fourth child, Hua'er got engaged on the sixth day of the new year, even if they don't come back to pick up the child, the third child and his wife can bring the child back when they return to the camp.
This one must make the child cry. Look at how the child is crying? "
The old man felt sorry for his grandchildren, so he couldn't help but toot.
"Hey, they are the parents of the child, what can we say?
It is said that the child does not kiss us, and every time he comes back, he will leave as quickly as if he is picking up a fire. Can the child kiss us?
Didn't you hear Haiyang talking about his grandparents all day long? The Wu family is close, of course they are close. "
Speaking of this, Zhou Guilan was also dissatisfied, but what's the use?
Children can't help their mothers. After marrying a daughter-in-law, they have to listen to their daughter-in-law.
It's useless for the old couple to babble any more, so they simply don't think about it. It's important to pack up and prepare for the New Year.
On New Year's Eve, Xu Shiyan still took his wife and children home to celebrate the New Year.
Compared with previous years, there is less Xu Shiqin at home, and Zhou Guilan had to say a few words during the reunion dinner at night.
"Or do you say that you have to raise a son? Anyway, the son will marry a daughter-in-law to enter the house and add more people to the family.
This girl is not good. After more than 20 years of raising her, she finally became a family member. "
"Okay, old woman, you, don't say anything, daughters and daughters are the same.
son? Raising a son depends on whether there is a good daughter-in-law. As for the five sons in our family, the one who comes back to accompany us for the New Year is not the third one?
Come on, let’s not talk about those who celebrate the Chinese New Year, come, come, eat vegetables. Haiqing, come, this fish is delicious. "
Xu Chenghou doesn't like to mention those things. If he has the time to think about it, he might as well coax his grandson to eat more.
"Hurry up and eat, you can only watch TV after finishing the rice in the bowl.
I heard there is a gala this year? Let's make dumplings earlier in a while, and save time to watch the party. "
Compared with previous years, this year's New Year's Eve is even more exciting. The main reason is that the Xu family has a TV.
Ever since he learned that there will be a gala on New Year's Eve, Xu Chenghou has been looking forward to watching the gala on TV.
"I know, I know, don't worry, I've chopped the minced meat ahead of time, and I'll chop some vegetables and noodles after dinner.
You don’t have to start making dumplings until six o’clock, so you can keep them so you can watch the gala. "
Not only Xu Chenghou is thinking about it, Zhou Guilan is also thinking about it, so the preparations for making dumplings have been done early this year.
As soon as the party was mentioned, the whole family cheered up, and the children ate quickly.
After the reunion dinner, I was supposed to rest for a while, but I will not rest now.
Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan hurriedly found melon seeds, pine nuts, and hazelnuts, stir-fried them in a large pot, and kept them for the guests.
Su Anying grabbed a few babies, and the Westinghouse was burning hot, so they had to take a bath and change clothes for the New Year.
Zhou Guilan chops vegetables, kneads noodles, adjusts stuffing, and prepares to make dumplings.
It was less than six at half past five, everything was ready, Xu Shiyan rolled the skin, Su Anying and Zhou Guilan made dumplings.
Xu Chenghou coaxed the two young ones not to make trouble, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping both washed their hands, and ran to serve as dumpling legs, helping to arrange dumplings, press cakes, etc.
This time, Zhou Guilan didn't require that the medicine must be picked up by hand, that would be too slow.
Still use a knife to cut quickly, raise the knife with your hand, and cut out uniform white and fat noodles one by one.
Sprinkle thin noodles and flatten them, roll them thin with a rolling pin, wrap them with meat stuffing mixed with cabbage and radish, and the rows of white and fat dumplings are finished.
Not only the Xu family wanted to make dumplings in advance to watch TV, but other people also thought so.
Especially those who don’t have a TV at home and have to go to other people’s houses to watch TV, they all start making dumplings early.
It was less than eight o'clock, and the Xu family's dumplings were all wrapped.
Fearing that the dumplings would be left on the curtain for a long time, Zhou Guilan simply found a white cloth to cover the dumplings, and took them outside.
The dumplings in this cold weather are put outside, and they will freeze hard in a short time. When the dumplings are cooked at night, they will be brought back to the pot and eaten directly.
As soon as the dumplings were brought out and the panel was cleaned up, the dog outside started barking.
As soon as I went out, many people from the neighbors came to see the party.
"Brother Xu, sister-in-law, Happy New Year, I wish you a New Year in advance.
Well, I heard there is a gala tonight? We'll be at your house tonight. "Someone laughed after entering the door.
"I didn't bring anything, these are freshly fried melon seeds, and this is the tea given by my relatives.
Later, let’s make a pot of tea and watch the party while drinking tea and cracking melon seeds. "
Those who are particular about it, come here with something. After all, it’s not good to come with nothing empty-handed.
"Oh, look at you, why are you being polite? We have everything at home, just come here."
Xu Chenghou saw it, and he had to be polite, and then asked Su Anying to make a pot of tea, put the kang table, and someone came to sit on the kang, watching TV while drinking tea.
The party started not long after, and people watching TV came in an endless stream.
People who rarely come to watch TV on weekdays, came to join in the fun tonight.
In the room of the Xu family, don’t worry about the kang being on the floor, it’s full of people, so there’s really no place to stand.
The Spring Festival Gala in 1985 was changed to the gymnasium, and it was broadcast live.
It was the first time for the female host to wear a suit skirt, while the male host wore a red shirt and white suit, which was refreshing.
Although there were many situations in the live broadcast, the people who watched the gala for the first time in front of the TV watched it with gusto, and were so amused by some funny programs that they leaned forward and laughed together until they couldn't straighten up.
I saw that it was past eleven o'clock, and the party wasn't over yet, but it was time to cook dumplings.
Most people are reluctant to leave, and leave after every step. There are also some children who refuse to leave no matter what, and have to finish watching.
Zhou Guilan and Su Anying went to light a fire to boil the dumplings, while Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan went outside to set up the heaven and earth table and offerings, put the dumplings inside, and put whip paper outside.
If it were in previous years, before the firecrackers were set off, the children couldn't wait to watch the fireworks.
It didn’t happen at all this year, Xu Haiyuan and the others were all watching TV in the house, and no one came out.
If the children don’t come out, those flash mines and colorful pearls bought in advance will be useless.
Xu Chenghou and his son simply put two, and then entered the house with the basket.
As soon as this end entered the house, the daughter-in-law of the neighbor's family hurried over, grabbed her child's ears, and dragged the child away.
"I don't know when it is? Are you eating dumplings and watching TV? Why, you still want to eat at your grandpa Xu's house? Hurry up and go home."
The aggressive daughter-in-law scolded the child while walking.
The child was caught by the mother, and while begging for mercy, the child had to watch the TV.
It wasn't until he was dragged out of the house that he reluctantly went home.

chapters.title: Chapter 409: help sell flowers
chapters.content:
Chapter 409 Help selling flowers
After eating dumplings on New Year’s Eve, it’s another new year.
On the first day of the first lunar month, it was another day to visit relatives and friends to pay New Year greetings to each other. Xu Shiyan went to the homes of Chen Jianzhang, Yu Shouguang, Lin Qiyue, Li Bingzhuo and others to pay New Year greetings.
Going home in the afternoon to light the fire, the phone rang suddenly, and it was only when I answered that I realized that the co-author was a relatively large Clivia dealer in the provincial capital.
The other party called Xu Shiyan's house several times, but no one answered, but this time they finally got through.
The other side said that there are two merchants who want to buy Clivia, and they will come to Songjianghe tomorrow.
Indeed, in the eyes of these people, there is no such thing as celebrating the New Year, making money is the most important thing.
Years pass every year, but opportunities to earn money are rare.
Xu Shiyan doesn't care if these people have a place to eat and live, anyway, he just needs to help Master Qin sell Clivia.
So I made an appointment with the other party. At noon tomorrow, Xu Shiyan went to the train station to pick them up, and then took them to Master Qin's house to see Clivia.
At noon on the second day of junior high school, Xu Shiyan found Li Zongliang and drove to the train station to pick him up.
Sure enough, I saw a few people coming out of the station, and two of them were dressed unusually, and they should be the foreign merchants that the other party said.
The other ones are tall and strong, so it goes without saying that they are bodyguards.
There is only one thin monkey-like man, a well-known Clivia second-hand dealer in the provincial capital, surnamed Hou, who looks thin and thin, so everyone calls him Thin Monkey.
"This way." Xu Shiyan waved at the thin monkey. "I thought you could come by car, but I didn't expect to come by train."
"Oh, who dares to drive now? The road is very chaotic.
It is possible to fly by plane, and if the plane is not available, take the train. At least it is safer. "
Shouhou shook his head. There have been several cases of road robbery on the road leading to the provincial capital.
Either Clivia was robbed, or the money to buy Clivia was robbed. Now no one dares to drive by themselves, they all take public transportation.
"Let's go, I have a car here, but it can't fit so many people. I guess they have to sit in the back of the car."
Xu Shiyan was too busy years ago to learn how to drive, but now he can barely drive the car away, how dare he drive by himself?
So I called Li Zongliang and asked Li Zongliang to be responsible for driving.
At this time, don’t care about the car, Shouhou leads the two merchants in the car, and the other bodyguards are sitting in the back of the car.
Li Zongliang started the car, followed the route Xu Shiyan pointed out, and went straight to Master Qin's house.
Master Qin's family lives in Baishan Street, which is the area behind the bureau building.
Xu Shiyan has been there several times, and he found the place with familiarity.
Xu Shiyan told Master Qin and his wife in advance, and besides, there must be no one at home during the Chinese New Year, so Xu Shiyan and his party went directly to the hospital.
"Master Qin, I brought the person you are looking for for you." Xu Shiyan entered the door and called.
The movement was heard in the house, Master Qin's husband, Zhao Yonggang, came out of the house.
Seeing that Xu Shiyan led the people, Zhao Yonggang also heaved a sigh of relief, and hurriedly welcomed everyone into the house.
"Master Qin, Master Zhao, these two are the big bosses who came to see Hua.
That, tweed? Move it out and let the two of you see it. "Xu Shiyan introduced it to everyone, and then asked where the flowers were.
In the past, the flower was placed on the window sill of the south window, but now the window sill is bare, and it is obvious at a glance that it is hidden.
"Wait a minute, I'll go and hug her right away." Zhao Yonggang hurried out.
After a while, I saw several people coming in with something behind them.
Behind him are two sons and a daughter of his family. They are holding something tightly wrapped in clothes and blankets in their arms. It is Clivia.
Many people in this neighborhood know that Master Qin has Clivia in his home. Many people come here these days and say they want to buy it.
Some of them really want to buy it, and some of them just want to steal it.
Frightened, Master Qin didn't dare to keep Clivia in his house, so he simply moved to his son and daughter's side, hiding it carefully so as not to be stolen.
The four pots of Clivia are finished orchids that have been grown for many years. The leaves are green and tall, especially the oilman, whose leaves are oily and extraordinarily energetic.
The two merchants immediately took a fancy to it, and began to negotiate the price with Master Qin and his wife.
Master Qin didn't understand, so he asked Xu Shiyan for help.
These potted flowers are all high-quality goods, Xu Shiyan naturally can't be too low.
"One pot is 35,000, and four pots are 130,000." If this was in the provincial capital, Xu Shiyan would have to pay 40,000 per pot.
After all, when someone comes over, they should give way to some extent, and they can't make people toss in vain.
The price would be scary to ordinary people, but the two merchants were not surprised at all. They knew at a glance that they were all prepared.
"130,000 is too expensive, 80,000, let's take 80,000 and pay in cash."
The two merchants had nothing to say, but the thin monkey began to bargain.
A middleman like Shouhou, if the business is successful, the two merchants will have to give him a certain amount of bonuses, and the locals also call it Duofenger.
If the thin monkey can help negotiate the price, the other party will also give him a bonus fee, so the thin monkey bargains very hard.
But Xu Shiyan just refused to give in. Anyway, they stayed at home, and if this group of people didn't buy it, he went back and called others.
If it doesn’t work, he will go back to the provincial capital after school starts in two days, and at worst, he will take the flowers back.
Any flower and tree company can sell at a high price, so what are you afraid of?
Instead, these few people came all the way from the provincial capital, not to mention the cost, Songjianghe, which is so big for Chinese New Year, doesn't even have a place to eat and live.
If the business fails, they just lose money and make trouble.
Xu Shiyan grasped this point and refused to give in no matter what. The two sides talked and talked, and the last four pots of flowers were sold for 125,000 yuan.
The other party really came with cash, and those tall and burly bodyguards were all carrying big back pockets on their backs, which contained money.
Immediately, he poured out the money in his back pocket, and counted a hundred and twenty-five bundles.
Master Qin's family's eyes were wide open. Who would have thought that four potted flowers could be sold for more than 100,000 yuan?
When Zhao Yonggang packed up the money, his hands were shaking.
The other party directly asked Zhao Yonggang for those clothes and blankets, and kept the package Clivia. Zhao Yonggang agreed without saying a word.
Just kidding, more than 100,000 yuan, how many clothes and blankets can’t be bought? Why bother about that?
Zhao Yonggang also rummaged through two dirt baskets and asked them to put the flowers in the dirt baskets.
The surrounding area is surrounded by things, and the outside is wrapped with two layers of plastic sheets to seal the windows.
This is enough to keep warm, as long as it is not kept outside to freeze, it will be fine.
The transaction was completed, and the other party asked Xu Shiyan to take them to the train station.
For those who celebrate the Chinese New Year, the hotels around the train station are still open. They have to stay near the train station for one night and return to the provincial capital by car tomorrow.
Xu Shiyan didn't show courtesy to these people, and asked Li Zongliang for a fare of 200 yuan, and then let Li Zongliang drive and send those people to the train station.
With those two earthen baskets, too many people can’t sit in the cab, and the thin monkey has gone to the back of the car.
Xu Shiyan simply didn't follow, and waited for Li Zongliang at Qin's house.
"Xiao Xu, thank you so much, you take this little money, it is our heart."
As soon as the car drove away, Zhao Yonggang dragged Xu Shiyan into the house and insisted on giving him 5,000 yuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 410: benefit
chapters.content:
Chapter 410 Benefits
According to the logic, the business negotiated and facilitated by the middleman should benefit the middleman.
This majority is drawn according to a certain percentage, which is the gap among the local population.
The transaction price of 125,000 yuan, 5,000 yuan, is less than 5%, which is not much.
After all, those who come to Zhao’s house these days to inquire about Clivia will only give a pot of five or six thousand yuan at most.
The price Xu Shiyan sold was much higher than the price offered by those people.
Zhao Yonggang is a fastidious person. As soon as the buyer left, he immediately grabbed five stacks of money and had to give it to Xu Shiyan.
"Oh, uncle, this can't be done.
Master Qin is so kind to my sixth sister. Ever since my sixth sister came to the tailor shop, Master Qin has been taking special care of her.
Without the help of Master Qin, how can my sister be a worker? I can never accept this money. "
How can Xu Shiyan ask for this money? He just helped to make a phone call, and then came to help negotiate the price.
The total is less than two hours, give him 5,000 yuan? How can you make such money?
"Xiao Xu, that's not what you said. Without your connections, how could your aunt and I sell flowers for so much money?
Alas, to tell you the truth, Auntie has already regretted it.
I knew it would be like this, so I should have entrusted you with the flowers and went to the provincial capital to sell them.
This is a good time, the house is chaotic all day long, and there are always people coming.
Your aunt was so frightened that she was in fear all day. It was a trivial matter for others to steal, but she was afraid that someone who would die would come to rob her. "
Zhao Yonggang naturally refused to give up, so he had to give the money to Xu Shiyan.
"Look, you're on the phone again, you're being picked up by the car, you're helping out, your aunt and I have to show something.
You have to accept this money no matter what. If you don’t accept it, we won’t be able to deal with it again in the future. "
"Uncle, you take this money, and wait for the savings office to open, so hurry up and deposit it.
So much money can’t be kept at home, it’s easy to get in and get thieves. "
Xu Shiyan pushed the money back and told Zhao Yonggang that he must deposit the money and not leave it at home.
The Zhao family knows about the Clivia. Today, there are people who come to the house, and they are not guaranteed to be seen.
In case of being targeted, who knows when the thief entered? The money was easier to steal than Clivia, so he took it away in his pocket.
"Okay, okay, it's up to you.
Come on, this money, no matter what you take it, if you don't take it, we men will really have no way to communicate in the future.
Although your uncle doesn't have much money, he never does anything about Tang Langzi. "
Tang Langzi, the local dialect, probably means that he is not authentic, unreliable, and not interesting enough.
If there is a rumor outside that whoever is in charge of Tang Langzi, no one will associate with him in the future.
"Yes, yes, Xiao Xu, no matter what, you have to collect the money, this is the rule.
You helped your aunt to sell Clivia, which relieved your aunt's heart troubles, and you sold it for so much money. Your uncle, my family and I are grateful to you.
If you don’t take the money, I’ll send you home tomorrow. "
Over there, Master Qin, who had counted and hid the 120,000 yuan, also came over, and had to stuff the 5,000 yuan into Xu Shiyan's pocket.
"Don't, don't, Master Qin." Xu Shiyan quickly waved his hand, "Then, just give me a thousand."
It seems okay not to ask for money, but he absolutely can’t ask for so much, a thousand dollars, meaning, both sides look good.
Xu Shiyan took one out of the five stacks of money, but Zhao Yonggang saw that it was not good, so he took two more stacks and put them in Xu Shiyan's hands.
"That's it, don't tear it up with uncle anymore. Those who celebrate the New Year have the right to give the children at home the New Year's money."
Who has heard of giving three thousand lucky money? Isn't this a joke?
But Zhao Yonggang and his wife refused to take back those two stacks no matter what.
At this time, Li Zongliang also came back and honked the horn outside.
"Okay, okay, that's it, another day, another day, Uncle buys you a drink."
Zhao Yonggang stuffed the money directly into Xu Shiyan's arms, and sent Xu Shiyan out of the house.
"Young man, thank you today, come over to drink with Xiao Xu some other day."
Zhao Yonggang greeted Li Zongliang, thanked Li Zongliang, opened the car door, and pushed Xu Shiyan into the car.
Li Zongliang didn't know what was going on, so he nodded with a smile and greeted Zhao Yonggang.
When Zhao Yonggang closed the car door, Li Zongliang honked the horn, started the car and left.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to leave with the three thousand dollars.
Waiting for the car to drive outside his gate, Xu Shiyan took out 1,000 yuan and gave it to Li Zongliang. "Well, this is your share."
For those who celebrate the Chinese New Year, Li Zongliang cannot be asked to contribute in vain. For 3,000 yuan, give him 1,000 yuan.
"Brother-in-law, what are you doing? Those people gave me two hundred just now. I can't take this money."
Li Zongliang was dumbfounded. Li Zongliang thought it was unbelievable to ask those people for a two hundred yuan fare just now, but now something even more mysterious happened.
His brother-in-law gave him a thousand dollars at once? What are you doing?
"The Clivia business is over, and they give us a lottery.
See that skinny monkey? Let me tell you, he has benefited a lot more than us. Take it, I can't let you work in vain. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, and was about to get out of the car when he opened the door, "Leave the car with you first, or you can help me take it back to the farm. I'm not good at driving now, so it's useless to keep it at my house."
Xu Shiyan has to go back to school in a few days, and he doesn’t have much time to learn to drive
This car is useless to him for the time being, and there is no place to park it at home, so it is better to put it on the other side of the farm.
"Okay, I'll send it to the farm right now." Li Zongliang readily agreed.
Nonsense, one thousand and two hundred yuan, not to mention sending it to the farm, even if he was asked to drive it to the county, he would happily do it for safekeeping.
Xu Shiyan got out of the car and went straight home. Li Zongliang drove away, sent the car directly to the farm, and then walked home.
As soon as I got home, I handed over the 1,200 yuan to Su Anfang. "Daughter-in-law, you put the money away."
Su Anfang was shocked when she saw so much money, "Where did you get the money? My God, more than a thousand?"
The monthly salary of the couple is less than 200 yuan, 1200 yuan, which is enough for them for more than half a year.
Su Anfang was worried that Li Zongliang was doing something bad, so she hurriedly asked.
"What can I do? Didn't I tell you? I went to do something for my brother-in-law today.
My brother-in-law contacted the client and sold four pots of Clivia, and they gave me a commission, and then my brother-in-law gave me 1,000.
The two hundred was the fare given by me to send the client to the train station. My brother-in-law didn’t ask for it, so he gave it to me. "
Li Zongliang saw his daughter-in-law turned pale, and hurriedly explained.
Hearing this, Su Anfang breathed a sigh of relief.
"Oh, co-authoring is such a thing, then you shouldn't ask for money from your brother-in-law.
You just go to drive a car and get back with so much money, isn’t it? "
"I also said no, and my brother-in-law said that I can't let me work for nothing, I have to give it.
Oh, you can put it away, what work does my brother-in-law have in the future, I will run more frequently.
You don’t know about my brother-in-law’s temper? If I don't accept it, he will be unhappy with me. "

chapters.title: Chapter 411: future development
chapters.content:
Chapter 411 Future Development
On the third day of the first lunar month, Han Liwei accompanied Xu Shiqin back home, and Xu Shiyan told his sister about selling Clivia.
When Xu Shiqin heard that he bought more than 120,000 yuan, he was also happy for Master Qin.
On the fourth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan treated guests and called all these friends who got along well together.
Eating and drinking are still secondary, mainly to discuss how to develop this year.
It’s too late for the Chinese New Year this year. On the first day of the 20th of February and the ninth day of the next year, Xu Shiyan has to go back to the provincial capital to study.
This time, I will not be able to return until at least mid-July, so I have to explain the family affairs.
The first one is naturally to participate in the market.
At present, except for one household that has not yet signed an agreement for the houses within the designated area of ​​participating in the market, the rest have signed a relocation agreement.
With the suggestions of Chen Jianzhang and the county leaders, some improvements were made to the relocation agreement.
In the area of ​​Xican Village, to the west of Mulenchang, a large area of ​​housing has been approved.
Years later, Su Anying and others were responsible for building the house together, which was equivalent to building the house directly, and then moving the residents in the area of ​​Canshi to it, and just compensated for some moving expenses.
In this way, the house can be built by a construction team, which is faster than building a house individually.
Moreover, the cost is also easy to control, which is much cheaper than building a house by an individual.
When each family signs the agreement, it is adjusted according to the desired area.
There is not much moving and resettlement fee for the expansion. If the original area is not expanded, you can get some money. There are also people who don’t need a house and only need money.
"For a while, I still have to go to Qin's house to get things done. If I really don't want to move, then I can find Xishen village and town and let them come forward.
Remember, everything is done in accordance with the established regulations, no matter how they make trouble, they can't open their mouths to give more.
I would rather flash out that piece of land and let it go, than let the Qin family blackmail me. "
That's right, the one who refused to move and insisted on asking for more money was Mrs. Qin.
Grandma Qin's house has three small broken houses, but the lion opened her mouth, asking for more than the other five houses.
Xu Shiyan is not used to this kind of person, he likes to move, not like to move.
Anyway, the Qin family is in the northwest corner, and the area is not large, so it just popped out and kept it.
When the fence around the city is built, how much sunshine will there be in his small courtyard?
"Just tell the Qin family that I plan to build a row of public toilets in that area, whether their family wants to move or not, and if they don't move, just wait for the smell to go."
It's not that anyone is ruthless, obviously the resettlement compensation is very reasonable.
There are so many families who can move out, but those who want this or that are not willing to move. It is clear that they are deliberately trying to blackmail people.
Then don’t move, what are you afraid of?
"Yes, yes, we should find a way to deal with that Mrs. Qin, it's too hateful, counting his family as the most troublesome.
His family was almost disturbed, and several families refused to move.
The third brother still has a lot of ideas, saying that whoever signs the agreement first can choose the building address first, and choose a good place.
When these people heard something wrong, they quickly signed the agreement. "
Negotiating the relocation is the most cumbersome, but fortunately, people in this age are okay, knowing that this is for the development of Donggang, and it is the plan of the entire town.
Moreover, the new house has a brick building with concrete floors, and you can choose the location you like, so I happily signed the agreement.
Just wait for the new house to come down, receive compensation such as moving expenses, and happily live in the new house.
"There is one more thing, which is the area of ​​Shendi.
All of us have money in our hands, so we can’t spend it indiscriminately, we have to develop.
So I mentioned it to Brother Guo. This year, 50,000 feet of ginseng soil will be approved. These ginseng soils will be sold out for 20,000 feet, and the rest will be kept for us.
What is it used for? Sprinkle ginseng seeds.
Remember, don’t plant too much in your own house, at most one hundred feet, if there is too much, we can’t handle it, and if we don’t grow good sticks, we won’t make money.
If you want to develop, ginseng seeds are necessary. If you sprinkle ginseng seeds, we will keep some for ourselves and sell the rest. "
Xu Shiyan had been thinking about this move for a long time.
Currently, it is unstoppable for all units to participate in the venue, so take advantage of the opportunity and make a fortune first.
Those units are not ordinary farmers, they just want to make quick money.
It is impossible to sow seeds to grow for three years like ordinary ginseng farmers, and then transplant them to grow for three years. Those people must have bought ginseng seeds and planted them in the ground.
But how many years has it been since the farmland has been distributed to households? I don't even have enough for myself, so how can there be so many ginseng seeds to sell?
Pointing to several state-run participants? It is also impossible for state-run participants to sell good seeds, and they have to keep them for their own use.
So this is an opportunity, Xu Shiyan has already planned to get more ginseng seeds from several participating venues this year.
In summer, water seeds can be produced, and it is just right to sow them in autumn.
Xu Shiyan has already drawn the sketch of the jukebox, and will find someone to make it after a while.
Use the method of on-demand sowing of ginseng seeds. The ginseng seeds grow evenly, most of the same size, and the probability of large seeds is high.
The two years of growth and experience have made Xu Shiyan's vision much better than before.
Now he can also see that the rise and fall of ginseng market is affected by many factors, not simply the output.
Although the output of ginseng fertilizer is indeed high, at present, the price fluctuation will not be too obvious.
Because after the ginseng field is fertilized, the production rate of large-branched ginseng has been greatly increased, which means that the yield has increased and the quality has also improved.
Moreover, the price is still set by the state, which has a certain protective effect on farmers.
In fact, what really affects the price of ginseng is the international situation, especially countries such as South Korea and Dongyi.
Those capitals are manipulating behind the scenes, trying to turn domestic ginseng into their origin.
In addition, there is also a reason for the deterioration of relations with the beautiful country.
Xu Shiyan has no ability to contend with this matter for the time being, so he can only follow the trend and avoid danger in advance.
Ginseng market soared in 1986 and 1987. Those years were also the craziest time for all units to plant ginseng, and they could sell as many ginseng seeds as they had.
If the ginseng seeds grow well, they can grow in two years.
The two-year-old ginseng seed is called Wuye, but it is actually better than Erjiazi with long heads.
The main reason is that Erjiazi has grown for another year, and the skin is old. After transplanting, the skin does not like to be peeled. In fact, the long head is not as good as the five leaves.
However, the long head of the five leaves is not all advantages. If they grow fast, the body may not be good, and it is easy to climb forks. Anyway, each has its advantages and disadvantages.
Regardless of Wuye or Erjiazi, they can catch up with the best ginseng market in the years of 1987 and 1988, and they can just make a fortune first.
After earning this sum, I happened to open a processing factory.
When the market went down in 1989 and 1990, in order to get rid of the burden, many of the participation venues run by those units sold water ginseng at a big price reduction.
At that time, water ginseng can be purchased at a low price, and the processing plant will have sufficient raw materials for production.
In the intervening years, Xu Shiyan devoted himself to studying and researching and developing health care products, just in time to catch up with the era when domestic health care products are popular.
