Through the deep processing of ginseng, the market will get through the trough. After the Ninth Five-Year Plan, the market will gradually improve again, and the processing plant will have a foothold at that time.
Food, you have to eat slowly, one bite at a time, no one can eat a fat man in one bite, you have to develop step by step in a down-to-earth manner.
Uh, I created a group. Although I don’t have much time to chat with friends, you can find me if you are in a hurry.

chapters.title: Chapter 412: eat something different
chapters.content:
Chapter 412 Eat Something Different
"Ginseng seeds are easy to care for, and there is no need to top-dress and loosen the soil, that is, to weed twice.
Calculated, it is no less profitable than planting ginseng and making goods. Don't worry, this trick will definitely work. "
It is impossible for Xu Shiyan to tell everyone about all the plans, but Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others have absolute trust in Xu Shiyan, so they can resolutely implement what Xu Shiyan says.
On this point, Xu Shiyan is quite at ease. Besides, although he is not at home, Su Anying is still watching.
Su Anying has grown very fast in the past few years, and she looks like a strong woman.
I feel that after a few more years of experience, I can be completely independent.
At that time, Xu Shiyan only needs to come up with ideas behind his back, and Su Anying has no problem with other things.
Very good, the husband and wife, a researcher, a business, can always make some achievements.
"Of course, the third brother and the third sister-in-law are taking us with us, what are we afraid of? Just do as the third brother said."
Huang Shengli and others agreed with Xu Shiyan's proposal.
Now that they have money in their hands, they are actually worrying about what they should do, keep the money in their hands, instead of eating and drinking and making it up.
Put money in the field and plant sticks to make money. This is the right way.
The men were discussing things in the house, and the daughters-in-law of each family were busy preparing today's food in the kitchen.
Xu Shiyan said that it’s boring to cook a big table of dishes every year, and you’ve had enough.
This year we will lead the big guys a little differently.
So he found a blacksmith stove a few days ago and specially got a few barbecue stoves.
One is the kind of normal skewers, a long strip box made of thin iron sheet, put charcoal on the bottom, put meat threaded with sticks on the top, and just grill.
This stove is set up in the yard.
It’s February 23rd, and it’s not that cold outside during the day.
Besides, the charcoal is very hot when it burns. Standing in front of the barbecue stove can roast people, who can be cold?
Years ago, the family killed pigs, and the farm also killed sheep and deer, leaving a lot of meat.
Cut it into pieces, marinate it with the seasoning, then go to the back woods and cut two large bundles of hollow willow branches.
This hollow willow is a kind of shrub that grows straight and thinner than the small head of chopsticks, with a hollow in the middle.
This thing has no peculiar smell, and the outer scalp is scraped off with a knife or glass slag, and it is used to wear candied haws.
Of course, the sharpened end is also very good for skewers.
This work is left to the children of each family.
These little guys are always idle, and they always make troubles. It's better to let them learn to peel and wear flesh.
When they heard that they were going to eat barbecue, all of them were in a hurry. They all sat there and worked obediently, and no one ran around.
There are skewers outside, and there is another barbecue stove in the house.
It is a bit like a drum, with a flat top with a rim, and a big belly underneath for charcoal.
Before using it, put sauerkraut to wipe the pot, and then put large slices of marinated meat on it. It is a joy to eat.
In addition to this kind of stove, there is also a brass charcoal hot pot that Xu Shiyan brought back from the provincial capital.
That's even easier, put charcoal at the bottom, and add a big bone broth to the pot.
At that time, add sauerkraut, Chinese cabbage, frozen tofu, dried tofu, and various sliced ​​meats.
Cook it out, dip it in sesame sauce, red square, chili oil and other prepared seasonings, and it will be absolutely comfortable to eat.
Let’s not talk about this time, eating a hot pot meal in nine cold days can make people sweat.
"How are you doing? Have you finished chatting? If you finish chatting, come out and turn on the stove outside first.
The children were in such a hurry that they wanted to eat meat. "
Su Anying led everyone's daughter-in-law, cut and marinated the meat, and set up the stove outside.
But she doesn't know how to bake, so she came back to find Xu Shiyan.
"It's over, let's go, I'll take you to the barbecue."
It happened that what should be talked about was finished, the big guys came out of the room together, and looked at Xu Shiyan poking.
The charcoal at this time is the kind of wood block charcoal, which is sold, and Xu Shiyan specially prepared a lot of it before.
Pull out some unburned oak wood charcoal from the stove pit and spread it under the barbecue stove, and put the bought charcoal on top.
Hold the cardboard fan for a while, and the charcoal is slowly ignited.
Wait for the charcoal to burn completely, and after the initial smoke is gone, put the meat skewers dressed by the children on the barbecue stove, and just watch the fire turn over.
Not long after, the alluring aroma began to waft around, and the children were so greedy that they salivated.
"Dad, I want to eat right."
Snack guy Xu Haiqing went online in an instant, Ha Lazi almost fell to the ground, walked up to Xu Shiyan, raised his head, pitifully Guan Dad wanted meat.
"Okay, you can eat meat if you want, stay away from Dad, my charcoal fire is very dangerous, don't burn you.
It will be ready soon, don't worry. "Xu Shiyan flipped the meat skewers with a smile, not forgetting to comfort his youngest son.
The meat skewers on the stove were roasted at high temperature, the fat was roasted little by little, and small bubbles bulged on the surface of the meat.
The meat also loses moisture rapidly, and some places begin to turn slightly yellow and burnt, and the aroma becomes stronger and stronger.
Not to mention children, even adults can't stand the smell.
"Third brother, you really want to recruit a child, who can bear this? I'm so hungry." Zhao Jianshe and the others also yelled over there.
"Don't just stand there and watch, come here to help turn over the skewers, we have to roast some first, and get rid of this group of greedy cats."
It was quite a big barbecue stove, and Xu Shiyan put a lot of charcoal in it. He couldn't take care of it alone, so he called Huang Shengli and Yang Chunming to come over and help turn the skewers.
Others looked at this posture, and it seemed that the speed of the children's strings was not very good.
So, the men also washed their hands and hurried over to help.
The big guys joined hands, and after a while, two large pots of meat skewers came out.
By this time, Xu Shiyan and the others had already grilled a lot of skewers.
The meat skewers are sprinkled with sesame seeds, peanuts, perilla seeds, salt, monosodium glutamate and other things to make the fragrance stronger.
The children took the meat and took a quick bite, regardless of whether it was inside or outside the house.
"Wow, it's so delicious, Dad, this skewer is so delicious."
Xu Haiyuan held the meat skewer, and quickly took a bite regardless of whether it was hot or not.
Xu Shiyan mastered the heat well, and the meat was roasted until it was charred on the outside and tender on the inside.
The meat is marinated with seasoning in advance, and the dry ingredients are sprinkled after roasting. It tastes so delicious that it really makes people want to swallow their tongues.
"The third brother will still enjoy it. It's really delicious to eat meat like this."
On the other end, the daughter-in-laws of Huang Shengli and others shared a bunch and tasted each of them. Everyone said that this is called eating meat.
"But it's too wasteful, how much meat do we people have to eat today?
伱Look, the skewers outside are like several pots.
Not counting the ones in the house, this meal is probably more than a year’s worth of meat from other people’s homes, right? "
Zhou Qingguo's daughter-in-law was worried while eating. Isn't this a good way to eat?
Even if life is better now, they eat meat like this, and the older generation will feel sorry for them when they see it.
"I don't know if those seniors will be angry if they know that we eat like this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 413: BBQ Shabu Shabu
chapters.content:
Chapter 413 Barbecue Shabu Shabu
At this very moment, the elders that Zhou Qingguo's daughter-in-law referred to were cooking at Xu Chenghou's house.
Old people have a bad spleen and stomach, and they are too greasy to eat.
So when Xu Shiyan was discussing with the old men what they would eat, the old men said that they didn't dare to think about barbecue or something, and a pot would be fine.
Originally it was said that everyone ate at Xu Shiyan's, but the old men panicked because there were too many people.
It’s not as good as they are here, and the whole pot is still comfortable to eat slowly.
Xu Shiyan had finished roasting the meat, and Su Anying specially reserved two handfuls, wrapped them in white cloth, and sent them over while it was still warm.
"Don't talk about it, your third son is really good at thinking, this pot is nothing, try this meat, it's really delicious."
Zhao Dahai praised it while eating the meat skewers.
"Yeah, he's the best at poking and gooing every day.
When I went hunting in the mountains before, I also brought salt or something, and I baked some to eat when I got the chance.
On these, no one can beat him. Fortunately, he knows what to do, not the one who just knows how to eat, drink and have fun.
Otherwise, no amount of wealth would be enough for him to fail. "
Xu Chenghou is also eating meat skewers, don't look at what he said, the smile on his face can't be hidden.
The son is capable and can earn money, but he earns that money, how much meat he wants to eat, can’t he earn it?
Not to mention, there are plenty of them on the other side of the farm, eat them.
For those who are celebrating the Chinese New Year, please have a meal with everyone. How about some hard dishes?
It’s good to eat like this, it’s delicious and lively, everyone thinks it’s interesting, not bad.
Several old men didn’t dare to eat too many meat skewers. Two skewers per person is enough to taste, and most of them are shabu-shabu.
The big bone soup is very good. Put in the cabbage, tofu, sauerkraut and so on, boil it for a while, take it out, dip it in some ingredients, it tastes great, not worse than eating meat.
A few old men ate the pot and drank some fruit wine, and felt that they were happy in their childhood, and there was no better life than the present.
At the other end, Xu Shiyan and others grilled meat skewers for a while, which fed the group of brats to eighty percent full, and they were no longer in a hurry to eat.
At this time, change people, Su Anying and others are here to watch the roast, and finish the last skewer.
Xu Shiyan went to put charcoal on the hot pot and the roasting pot in the house, pour soup into the hot pot and slowly boil it.
After the baking pan is hot, wipe the pan with sauerkraut first, and then put oil on the meat slices.
When the sliced ​​meat touched the hot grilled pan surface, it made a sizzling sound, and the aroma wafted around with the heat.
"Come here, the skewers are all grilled, sit down and eat slowly."
At this time, Su Anying and the others also finished grilling the remaining meat skewers, and brought two large plates to the house.
Xu Shiyan greeted Yang Junxian, Zhao Jianshe and others to sit down and eat together.
"Daughter-in-law, do you have meat skewers in your house? Don't patronize us, you eat too."
Xu Shiyan glanced at the meat skewers, and hurriedly asked.
"Don't worry, keep it, this is wine, you guys drink slowly, just call me if you need anything."
Vegetables and meat are ready, no one needs to wait for this one, just make it yourself and eat it.
Su Anying came over with a few bottles of wine and put them beside the table, letting them do whatever they wanted.
Then turned around and went out, coaxing the children to eat hot pot with Zhou Qingguo's wife and others.
The little ones are already eating meat skewers, and they will be full after taking out the hot pot and eating a few bites, so they have to go out to play.
Su Anying only said to tell the children to be careful not to touch the barbecue stove outside.
"Mom, let's put the sledge on the **** instead of playing at home."
These brats stopped for most of the day and went to work.
Now that they are full, they all feel like long grass in their hearts. Who is willing to stay at home?
Each of them went home and pulled the sledge out, and went directly to the road south of the weather station to put the sledge on the slope.
There happened to be a big ditch at the other end, with slopes on both sides, not long or steep, and the **** was just right for children to put the sledges on.
A group of more than a dozen children hurried away dragging the sledge.
The adults are not worried either, just these brats, who are outside all day long, are not afraid of being bullied.
To put it bluntly, there are so many children, a large group, it’s good if they don’t bully others, but can they be bullied?
"Come on, let's sit down and have a good meal, don't worry about those brats."
Su Anying greeted the daughters-in-law of various families, and set up a table on the Westinghouse Kang. There were hot pot and barbecue. It was really good to cook what I wanted.
"Sister-in-law, is there any secret recipe for this cured meat? Why do I eat it differently from our usual ones? It tastes really good." Zhao Jianshe's daughter-in-law couldn't help asking.
"I don't know if there is any secret recipe, but the child's father poked it.
Anyway, I watched him make a lot of things, which were crushed in the medicine grinder. Then when the meat was marinated, he gave it to me. "
Su Anying shook her head, she really didn't know this, it was Xu Shiyan's fault.
"I feel that if the third brother and the third sister-in-law stop planting mallets one day, the whole shop will be destroyed.
Like what I ate today, I cook the pot while grilling meat, so the storage business is very good. "Huang Shengli's daughter-in-law said with a smile while eating.
"Think about it, this is the condition of the third uncle and third aunt's family, who would be willing to eat like this for others?
Our life is pretty good now, right? Is your family willing to open up like this? "
Zhou Qingguo's daughter-in-law shook her head, she didn't think it was realistic.
How much does it cost to eat such a big meal? You have to earn money to open a shop, who is willing to go to a restaurant to eat like this?
"What kind of store are you opening? It's just for our own fun. It's Chinese New Year. It's rare for everyone to get together."
Su Anying just laughed, what kind of store are you opening? His family now has those sticks and a breeding farm. They are too busy with these, and they still open a shop?
However, if they don't do it, others can.
Su Anying suddenly thought of something, and felt that she could discuss it with Xu Shiyan.
Women get together and have various topics to talk about.
From the husband to the children, to daily necessities, rice, oil, salt, and prices, we can find common topics.
Among these people, except for Ji Yufeng, who was added later, the rest of them were already familiar with each other, not to mention the same as their own sisters, and everyone was chatting and laughing very lively.
Not to mention in the east room, the men are together, cooking hot pot and roasting meat, and can drink some wine and brag, there is no one in these days.
While drinking, the phone rang suddenly, and everyone was taken aback.
Xu Shiyan saw it, and hurried to grab the phone, "Hello? Hello, who is it?"
"Xiao Xu, you are at home, that's great, come to the venue quickly.
A call came from that province, saying that a foreign businessman wanted to order our Coke in large quantities.
And people also said, if you want to order our mineral water, come quickly, let's discuss it. "
On the other end of the phone, it was naturally Lin Qiyue, and hearing Lin Qiyue's voice was particularly exciting.
That’s right, there’s been no news about Coke for so long, and everyone thinks it’s going to be dirty, but when the order comes, who isn’t excited?
"Huh? An order for Chinese New Year?" Xu Shiyan was taken aback when he heard this.
Isn’t it a new year? No, foreigners really don’t celebrate our Spring Festival, they celebrate Christmas and New Year’s Day.
"Come on, I'll go right away."

chapters.title: Chapter 414: coke pricing
chapters.content:
Chapter 414 Coke Pricing
"Well, construction, victory, you eat first, I will go to the venue."
Secretary Lin called, and Xu Shiyan had to go, so naturally he didn't have time to eat with everyone.
Zhao Jianshe and others could hear what was said on the phone just now.
"Third brother, let's do your work first, the work of the unit is important.
We don’t need you to care about us, we are not outsiders, we should eat and drink, and wait for you to come back. "Everyone said hurriedly.
Xu Shiyan put on his coat and hat, went out, got on his bicycle, and went straight to the venue.
On the way, I saw children setting up a sledge **** in front of the weather station.
"Secretary Lin, what did the province say? What is the specific situation of the order?"
Xu Shiyan came to the field department and went straight to the secretary's office on the second floor.
After entering the door, Lin Qiyue and several other deputy directors were there. Xu Shiyan asked directly without any scruples.
"Didn't the honey chips we shipped contain the coke from that beverage factory as a gift?
As a result, a foreign businessman contacted to discuss the order. They said that the first batch would order 50,000 pieces of ginseng flower cola and 50,000 pieces of ginseng cola, one packaged in twelve cans.
Because our export authority is not enough, the other party did not contact us directly, but first contacted the province.
The other party also wants to order mineral water. I came to you to discuss the export price and mineral water. "
Lin Qiyue briefly explained what happened.
"Now the merchants are waiting for our quotations, and the province is asking if there is any difficulty in our mineral water production.
If we can't produce, the province will arrange people to come. "
The meaning of these words is self-evident, and someone is jealous again.
"Secretary Lin, there must be no problem with mineral water. We only need to add a filling production line to customize mineral water bottles.
But for this mineral water, the production volume must be controlled. Rare things are more expensive, and too much cannot be produced.
Moreover, our main products are ginseng cola and ginseng flower cola, which have high added value. "Xu Shiyan pondered for a moment before saying.
The line of mineral water was originally not intended to be used so early.
In fact, there are many natural active mineral water sources in the Changbai Mountain area, which are rich in various natural minerals and are high-quality drinking mineral water.
But how to develop requires a long-term plan, and should focus on high added value.
It’s just a simple production of a bottle of water, which doesn’t make much sense.
How much can a bottle of water sell for? It seems that this kind of exported water is better, the whole package is beautiful and high-end, and it is not a problem to sell 500ml of water for more than ten yuan.
Like the ordinary plastic bottled mineral water of the later generations, if a bottle costs one or two yuan, the profit is indeed not low, but it cannot drive other industries, so it is not the best choice.
"Well, have you found out the production costs of the two types of cola? How much can you get?"
Xu Shiyan is more concerned about these two beverages. After all, they are participating in the market, and the most important thing is to develop related industries.
"Well, I found someone to do the calculations. The cost of ginseng flower cola is more than 70 cents. The cost of ginseng cola is higher, but it is not more than one yuan."
After all, it is a drink, and the main body is actually water.
Of course, because of the addition of ginseng flowers and ginseng ingredients, and the packaging in cans, the cost is much higher.
How much is a bottle of soda in this year and month? It was sold for twenty-five cents, and five cents of it was for the bottle.
That is to say, a bottle of soda actually sells for 20 cents, and the cost price is even lower, only a few cents.
And Jianlibao, which is also a canned drink, probably sells for more than one yuan at this time, and the cost may be more than 50 cents, or even less than 50 cents.
This is also the most difficult part for Lin Qiyue. The cost of two kinds of Coke produced in one factory is so high, and the price is really hard to determine.
If it’s too high, I’m afraid merchants will think it’s too expensive. If it’s too low, the cost is too high and there’s no profit.
Before Xu Shiyan came, everyone was discussing this issue. What is the most appropriate price?
"We discussed just now, otherwise, let's try to set a price of two yuan?"
Lin Qiyue gritted his teeth and set a price that he thought was already high.
Two dollars? Xu Shiyan thought it was too cheap for two dollars.
You should know that they use natural sparkling mineral water. Don’t talk about anything else, just talk about the water, and put it in a nice glass bottle.
A bottle is not five hundred milliliters, but three hundred milliliters, which costs at least ten yuan.
It makes no sense that cola with ginseng added is cheaper than pure water.
If that's the case, what kind of Coke are they producing? Forget about producing water directly, the cost is low and the money is more.
"Secretary Lin, you listen to me on this matter. A Coke is priced at forty-five dollars."
This stuff is not for domestic people to drink, nor can it be viewed with the eyes of ordinary people.
Since it is an export, it must be a high-quality product, which is priceless.
"Huh? Forty-five dollars a piece? Twelve cans, an average of nearly four dollars a can? Crazy?
The foreigner is rich, but not stupid, can he agree? "
Several other people in the office were all dumbfounded. Is this a bit of a joke?
The cost is less than one yuan, and the selling price is nearly eight yuan? Is this too black-hearted?
"It's not expensive at all, don't worry, why do you think foreigners order from us?
People don’t have Coke? To put it bluntly, we also learned from others.
Then why do people come to order our goods when they have their own Coke? Is it because our stuff is cheap?
Isn't it? It is because our products are unique and cannot be produced in other places.
Since it is your unique thing, why did you sell it cheaply? "
Xu Shiyan sighed, feeling that these people's ideas still need to be changed, and they don't pursue high quality and low price for everything.
In many cases, the price represents the status, and the higher the price, the more scarce it is.
"In addition, replying to the province, the amount of spring water is not enough.
We can only send 60,000 pieces in this batch, and we have to wait for the next batch. "
Since it is a rare mineral spring, it cannot be adjusted too much, too much is not rare.
Controlling shipments and engaging in hunger marketing are always the only ways to increase your value.
Lin Qiyue and the others were dumbfounded, not understanding what Xu Shiyan meant by this.
There are quite a lot of drinks in the warehouse of the beverage factory now. Even if the first batch totals 100,000 pieces, it is not impossible to complete it with hard work and overtime workers.
Why do you have to pay less? Doesn't more production make more money?
"Listen to me this time, and see the follow-up reaction. If my proposal is not good, let's discuss it separately."
It is an eternal truth that things are rare and expensive. You can’t just say that when an order comes, you will work hard and go all out to ship the goods.
If an enterprise wants to develop, it must formulate a long-term and sustainable plan.
Rather than a big battle as soon as the blood is hot, what goals can be achieved in a hundred days of the battle.
It’s not necessary, and there’s no need for that. It’s still the same sentence, the road needs to be taken step by step, and the meal needs to be eaten bite by bite. Don’t be in a hurry.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: The city is full of wind and rain
chapters.content:
Chapter 415 The city is full of wind and rain
"Okay, just do as Xiao Xu said.
Now it is the merchants who take the initiative to find us, not us to find the merchants, but we should hold something. "
Lin Qiyue trusted and relied heavily on Xu Shiyan. Since Xu Shiyan said to do this, he must have his reasons, so he made a decision on the spot.
Although the other people still had some concerns, Secretary Lin nodded, and it was difficult for them to say anything.
Furthermore, since Xu Shiyan came to participate in the field, every thing and every thing is for the development of the field. His contribution is obvious to all.
Xu Shiyan did it for the sake of the occasion, everyone firmly believed in this. That being the case, then listen to his arrangement.
At this time, regardless of whether it is still the Chinese New Year holiday, quickly call the relevant personnel of the beverage factory over for a meeting.
As soon as the meeting started, it was evening, and I finally made a rough plan for the next thing to do.
By the time Xu Shiyan got home, it was past six o'clock, and the snow began to fall outside.
"Xiangshe and the others have left?" Xu Shiyan entered the room and saw several children were sitting on the kang watching TV.
Su Anying holds a book in her hand and reads on the kang.
The inside and outside of the house were all cleaned up neatly. It was obvious from a glance that Zhao Jianshe and others had left long ago.
"Well, wait and see and wait until you don't come back, they said they didn't wait and went home to light the fire.
Anyway, I have told them what should be told, and I will talk about the rest in due time, and I will watch. "
Su Anying put down the book in her hand, stepped forward to take Xu Shiyan's hat and coat, patted the snow on them, and hung them on the wall.
"Is it snowing outside?"
"Well, it just started to snow a little, not too big.
Tomorrow we have to go back to the camp. Have you got everything ready? "
Xu Shiyan sat next to the children and saw them staring at the TV intently.
"Xu Haiyuan, school is about to start, have you finished your homework yet? Just watch TV all day long?"
Xu Shiyan did it on purpose, he was afraid that Xu Haiyuan would be obsessed with TV all day and delay his studies.
Soon he will go to the provincial capital to study, and he won't be able to come back for another half a year. No one is watching these little guys for fear that they will grow crooked.
"Father, I finished all my homework before you came back from the provincial capital."
Xu Haiyuan was extremely helpless. His father must have been so busy and confused that he couldn't even remember his son's homework.
pitiful.
"Not only did I finish my homework, I also finished previewing the courses for the second semester of the second grade.
Dad, otherwise, you can talk to the principal, can I skip a grade?
I think I can finish the courses in the first semester of the third grade in less than a month. "Xu Haiyuan intentionally made it difficult for his father.
"Cut, brat." Xu Shiyan is not stupid, so he can't hear the sarcasm in his son's words?
This kid is getting more and more difficult, and he dares to mock his father openly and secretly?
"Are you going to heaven? Still skipping a level?
You originally studied for two years in the morning and then skipped a grade? What do you want to do after finishing school so early?
Go to school honestly, don't learn so much so fast.
You are a child, you should have a complete childhood, but don’t act like a little old man, it’s not good. "
Xu Shiyan reached out and rubbed the top of his son's head. The baby's hair was quite soft.
Xu Haiyuan used to wear a pothead, but later he thought it was ugly, so he specially asked to cut it shorter.
So rubbing his hair now doesn't give me any sense of accomplishment, and it doesn't mess up.
"Cut, what's so good about a child?
I can’t do anything except eat, drink and have fun every day, so I might as well grow up quickly. "
Xu Haiyuan wrinkled his little nose, shrugged like Xu Shiyan, with a look of disgust.
Children are all like this, they all look forward to growing up quickly, and only when they grow up will they realize how wonderful the carefree time of childhood is.
"Dad, brother, can you two chat while watching the mole? It's noisy."
Over there, Xu Jinping, who was staring at the mole on TV, turned to look at the father and son with a helpless expression.
After finally looking forward to acting for such a short time, do you have to talk and make noise?
Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan looked at each other and laughed.
Xu Shiyan raised his index finger and made a shush gesture to his son. After that, the children quietly went to watch cartoons.
On the morning of the fifth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying led the four children and went straight to the train station.
Su Anhua was going to get engaged on the sixth day of the first lunar month. They had agreed with Su Weizhong in advance that there were many things to do this year, and the third day of junior high school was the first time Xu Shiqin returned to her natal home for the Chinese New Year after getting married, so they delayed for two days and went back on the fifth day of the new year.
Arrived at the train station and met Li Zongliang and Su Anfang and his wife.
Su Anfang has been pregnant for four months. She is in good health and strong, and she will not delay in doing anything.
Originally, she wanted to go back in the third day, but when she heard that her second sister was going back to her natal home in the fifth day, Su Anfang said that she would also be with her in the fifth day.
There are a lot of people on the train in the first month of the lunar year. Xu Shiyan and his party have children and pregnant women, so they have to be more careful.
Fortunately, the distance is short, and after an hour or so, the train arrives at Xianrenqiao.
As soon as I got off the train, I saw the Su family arranged for Su Anhua and Su Anmin to pick them up in a car.
Everyone got into the carriage and went straight to Daying Village.
As a result, it didn't take long to enter the village, and before arriving at Su's house, I saw many people watching the fun outside.
Seeing Xu Shiyan and others getting off the car, many people surrounded him with a whoosh.
"Hey, isn't this the third child of the Xu family? I heard that you made a fortune from Clivia? Did you earn money from the old man?
Look, the folks in this village are very familiar, if there is any good thing in the future, bring the big guys. "
Someone came over and said with a smile on his face.
Xu Shiyan was stunned immediately, Daying is far away from Donggang, how do you know this?
Who is this, who owes so much to spread the word about his money making?
At the beginning, he didn't collect Clivia seeds at Daying, but he didn't want to cause these troubles.
Alas, this is really, really annoying.
"Old Aunt Cong, who did you listen to? What's the matter? Don't listen to people's nonsense." Xu Shiyan frowned and hurriedly dismissed it.
"Look, why don't you admit it?
Old Wu’s house in Hebei Village, the mother-in-law of the fourth child in your family, told us personally.
Said that you led people to sell Clivia in the provincial capital to earn old money.
well? My aunt's house also has one, otherwise, you can buy it.
I don’t need too many aunts, just give me something worth a thousand dollars. "
The old woman of the Cong family was full of anticipation, waiting for Xu Shiyan to buy her family's flowers and sell them for 18,000 yuan at once, and her family could become a household of 10,000 yuan.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about it just now, not many people in Daying know that he earns money, that is, on the side of the husband’s family, the sister-in-law can mention a few words when she comes back.
Even the uncles and uncles may not know that well. How can this be spread all over the city?
I didn't expect it to come from the old Wu's family in Hebei.
Well, needless to say, the fourth couple must have come back and brought it up to the Wu family.
The old woman of the Wu family didn't know what to say, and she was babbling everywhere, and everyone who passed on knew about it.
"Auntie, don't listen to people talking nonsense. It's nothing like that. I went to the provincial capital to study, but I didn't make any fuss about it."
Yes, it wasn't him who did it, it was his wife and friends who did it.

chapters.title: Chapter 416: move away
chapters.content:
Chapter 416 Move away
Xu Shiyan ignored those people, protected his wife and children, and entered the gate of Su's house.
"Grandma, Grandpa, we are back."
As soon as they entered the gate, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping shouted loudly, and ran into the house while shouting.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui also ran into the house with their short legs upside down.
"Nao Nao, Master Nao, I'm here." It was Xu Haiqing who said that.
Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing were born on June 1, 1982. They should be four years old now, but they are actually two and a half years old.
If you compare it with Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping when they were young, such a big baby is already very slick.
Xu Haiqing also spoke a lot, but there were a few sounds that were always pronounced incorrectly.
Grandma is called Naonao, aunt is called Dudu, and Rourou is called Youyou. These pronunciations are the worst, and the others are better.
In contrast, Xu Jinhui speaks normally. Although she is not as good as her elder brother and sister, she is much better than her younger brother. At least she can speak clearly.
Regarding this, Xu Shiyan was not in a hurry to correct it.
The child is still young, so take your time. Generally speaking, after learning pinyin, you can correct it.
Besides, I am used to Xu Haiyuan's very correct pronunciation, and occasionally hear my youngest son speak like this, but I think it's cute, and I feel that this is what a child looks like.
The little guys ran into the house in a hurry, Xu Shiyan, Su Anying, Li Zongliang and Su Anfang, each with their own things, followed into the door.
"Father, mother, Happy New Year. Big sister, big brother-in-law, Happy New Year."
Xu Shiyan put the things he brought aside and greeted his father-in-law, mother-in-law, and Qin Meiling.
"Hey, hey, good, all good, all good." Su Weizhong and his wife smiled happily when they saw their daughter and uncle coming back.
"Oh, look, you guys are fine when you come back, what are you doing with so many things?
It’s like this every time, and I never come back empty-handed. You don’t need to bring anything in the future, as long as you come back, it’s better than anything else. "
On the other end, Su Anzhen, Nan Zhendong, Su Anfen, Ji Tongzhong, and his wife also came to pay New Year greetings to Xu Shiyan and others.
Then, Su Weizhong took out red envelopes for the children, and Xu Shiyan also took out red envelopes and distributed them to his nephew and niece.
The kids all jumped up happily when they got the red envelopes, and ran outside to play.
Han Cai'e held Su Anfang and Su Anying's hands, and the mothers went to the side to chat, and Su Weizhong also chatted with the young men here.
"Shiyan, how much did you earn last year? I asked the sixth child, but she refused to say, but said that she did earn some.
But what is rumored outside that you earned millions?
Many people have come to our house to inquire about it these days, and they all asked me, do you know that the second son-in-law made millions of dollars from Clivia? "
Su Weizhong still couldn't hold back and asked.
When Su Weizhong and his wife went to Donggang to attend Xu Shiqin's wedding, they only heard their daughter say that they had earned some money during the winter.
But the specific amount, Su Anying didn't mention it, and Su Anhua didn't say either.
Su Weizhong thought to himself, at most eight thousand, it would be pretty good.
But after returning from Donggang, things changed.
In less than two days, the two villages of Daying and Hebei are spreading rumors that the second son-in-law of the Su family has made a lot of money, several million, by dumping Clivia.
This time, several families in the village with Clivia came to Su’s house to inquire.
I want to ask Su Weizhong, what's going on, is this Clivia really that valuable?
Can Su Weizhong tell my uncle to help them sell the flowers.
Some people asked if they could ask Xu Shiyan for help, so that their children could also be sent to Donggang to work as workers.
Su Weizhong is so annoying, his head is about to explode.
Xu Shiyan made money, how much does it have to do with his old Su family?
The Su family has been taken care of by Xu Shiyan a lot these years, how could Su Weizhong ask Xu Shiyan for help?
Why are you recruiting workers? If Xu Shiyan is really that capable, he must first help Nan Zhendong and Ji Hongliang solve their jobs.
In addition to these two brothers-in-law, Su Anyu, the daughter of Su Weicheng's family, has not worked yet.
Besides, there are Zhou family and Zhang family, these are all serious relatives, so why not arrange it?
As an individual, you know what it means to be close and distant, and you can't take care of your own family, and you still care about outsiders?
Su Weizhong didn't get used to those people, and pushed them back one by one.
But there are still a lot of people who come to him. Su Weizhong is really annoyed these days.
"Father, earning money is indeed a little bit, but it's not worth millions.
We are a partnership of seven or eight people, and there are points for the town, the village, and various expenses. In fact, there is not so much left. "
Xu Shiyan sighed, it seems impossible to hide all this matter, so he can only say a little bit selectively.
"Oh, that's not a lot. It's good. If you have money, you can live a better life."
As soon as Su Weizhong heard it, he knew that my uncle must not be telling the truth.
It's normal, whoever earns money can still go all over the street shouting, how many thousands have I earned? That's what fools do.
"It's okay, it's fresh for a few days, and the wind will blow away in a few days.
It’s just in time for the New Year’s Eve, everyone is full and has nothing to do, what else can they do when they have nothing to do but talk about their wives?
It doesn't matter, after a while the weather will warm up and the spring plowing will stop. "
Su Weizhong didn't want my uncle to follow suit, so he waved his hand, intending to leave this article alone.
"Dad, um, have you thought about living in another place?"
Originally, Xu Shiyan didn't intend to mention it now, but now that he sees it, forget it, let the father-in-law and mother-in-law move.
It's dark and chaotic here all day long, and it's troublesome to live here.
"Ah? Where to go?" Su Weizhong was stunned when he heard it, and live in another place? Where can I change to?
He has been in Daying all his life. Now at this age, he can't do much heavy work. If he moves to another place, what else can he do?
Xu Shiyan glanced at Qin Meiling and his wife.
In the previous life, after Su Weizhong passed away, the couple suggested that Han Cai'e sell the house in Daying and move to Hunjiang with Su Anfang and Su Anhua.
Now that Su Weizhong is safe and sound, he is in good health and delicious, so it is estimated that Qin Meiling will not be able to mention this matter again.
After all, Han Cai'e is Qin Meiling's biological mother, and Su Weizhong is not her biological father. They are separated by several floors, and they are completely different.
"How about moving to Donggang?" Xu Shiyan asked tentatively.
"Yingzi and Fang'er are over there, Hua'er is going to get engaged to Xiaoli soon, and she will marry this winter.
There are your three daughters over there, why can't you take care of the second elder? "
The Su family has a total of six daughters, one is in Hunjiang, one is in Daying, the other is in Shuanglong, and the other three are all in Donggang.
In comparison, moving to Donggang is still a reasonable suggestion.
There are three daughters in front of me, and both Su Anfang and Su Anhua are dual-employees, and the conditions are good, so they won't let the old couple fall to the ground.
"Move to Donggang?" Su Weizhong was stunned, he had never thought about this before.
"If we move there, what will happen to the land? Can't it be returned to the village?"
Not to mention, Su Weizhong was really moved. Compared with Daying, Donggang is obviously more suitable for them to retire.

chapters.title: Chapter 417: look at the gate
chapters.content:
Chapter 417 Look at the gate
"Keep it in the land, just plant it for the third sister and third sister-in-law, and don't need to return it to the village."
Su Anzhen and Nan Zhendong are old and capable couples. In their previous lives, they worked in Daying, contracting land to grow and raise cattle, and they could earn tens of thousands a year.
It is just right to give them the land, so there is no need to rent other people's land.
"That doesn't work either, the couple of us went to Donggang, and there is no land.
At my age, even if I want to grow mallets, I don’t have the money. So how do we old couple live these days? "
Su Weizhong was really moved, but felt it was inappropriate. If they moved there, wouldn't that be a burden to the three daughters?
"Father, we participated in the establishment of a beverage factory, and there is a lack of a janitor and watchman. If you don't dislike it, why don't you go to work?"
If Xu Shiyan didn't know what to do, he couldn't raise this issue at all.
During the meeting yesterday, I heard Lin Qiyue mention something.
It is said that at the other end of the beverage factory, the old Antou who had been guarding the gate had a stroke and could no longer go to work.
There is a shortage of people over there, so we have to find one from the participating family members.
Xu Shiyan felt at the time that it was good to leave this job to Su Weizhong.
Su Weizhong and his wife have only six daughters and no sons, and the old farmers have not retired.
Right now, Su Weizhong can still work, and he can support the old couple by farming a little land, but in a few years?
When he can't do the work anymore, what is the way out?
The beverage factory looks at the gate, and it is easy to live without being tired. It earns a lot in a month, and the wages and benefits are similar to those of workers.
Su Weizhong is in good health, just look at the work of the gate, there is no problem at all for ten or eight years.
On the day when they really can’t move, the life of these six daughters will get better at home. Why can’t the old couple have no support in their old age.
"Huh? Look at the gate, that's a good job, can I do it?" Su Weizhong was surprised and happy when he heard it.
The wages and benefits of participating in the show are quite good, even if the gatekeeper is a temporary worker, the salary must not be too low.
The work is not tiring and the salary is not bad. This is indeed a good place to go.
My daughter is out of the house, and the old couple didn't spend much.
Plant a vegetable garden to eat vegetables, watch the gate to earn some wages, and support the old couple without any problem.
"Shiyan, you arranged for me to go to the beverage factory to look at the gate, and your father's side, do you have any ideas?"
Su Weizhong thought more comprehensively. It is said that there is no way to grab the job of looking at the door.
Xu Shiyan's biological father doesn't have much work yet, so he arranged it for his father-in-law first, so can Xu Chenghou be unhappy?
"Father, you don't have to worry about this, my father will definitely have no objection." Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard this.
With Xu Shiyan here, the brothers still pay monthly money, even if Xu Chenghou doesn't go to work, life is not bad.
Xu Shiyan has already planned it, and also mentioned it to Xu Chenghou, waiting for the spring to clean up the house in Xitou, the whole small shop.
Nowadays, there are not many stores in Donggang. Except for a Limin grocery store that was opened last year opposite the team headquarters of the Second Brigade, most people still go to the store to buy things.
It is good to have a shop in a store, and the convenience of a small shop in a small shop.
The Martyrs' Tomb is just at the crossroads, and there are many people coming and going from east to west, north to south.
Waiting for the city to be built, more people pass by. There is a small shop here, which is convenient for the big guys. Xu Chenghou and his wife are still earning a lot.
The old couple had 20,000 yuan from Xu Shiyan in their hands, and they saved it in the bank to earn interest, plus some from their sons, and some from the small shop.
What a beautiful day, it’s so beautiful, I can’t keep up with any work.
Besides, everyone now knows that Xu Shiyan is rich, and if he asks his own father to look at the gate, he is afraid of others talking.
Why not arrange a job for the old man, which looks good to outsiders.
After all, this father-in-law is different from his own father, Xu Shiyan has been sitting for this step for his father-in-law, and others have to agree.
The work of guarding the gate and doing shifts is not tiring, the salary is not low, and all benefits are paid according to the workers.
Su Weizhong used to work for the elderly, which is good.
Actually, when the old couple goes there, they really don’t have to worry about food and drink.
Participants ordered a lot of honey chip gift boxes last year, and those gift boxes were made by the old ladies of the participating families.
A few cents for a box, those old ladies have nothing to do at home all day long, earn three or five dollars a day, and earn eight cents, which is enough for oil, salt, sauce and vinegar.
Besides, Xu Shiyan plans to develop some gift products this year, so more boxes will be needed. These old ladies almost have things to do as adults.
Three or five people get together, talk and chat, and do the work, and earn money, isn’t it great?
Of course, Xu Shiyan didn't mention this. If Su Weizhong moved to Donggang, he would naturally know at that time. If he didn't want to move, it would be useless to say more.
Anyway, he is just a suggestion, and it is up to Su Weizhong whether he listens or not.
Originally, Xu Shiyan didn't intend to say so early. He was thinking about the opening of his own processing factory in a few years, so he would arrange for the old man to come over.
But as soon as he came back today, Daying was full of smog, Xu Shiyan felt that it would be better to settle the father-in-law and mother-in-law earlier, so as to save trouble.
"Okay, let me discuss this matter with your mother. If she agrees, we will move when the weather gets warmer."
Moving is a major event, and the couple has to discuss it.
"Father, you'd better discuss it with my mother in these two days. If you agree, you can go with us the day after tomorrow.
The beverage factory has started production in the past few days, let alone guarding the door. If you don't go, you will have to find someone else in the factory. "
Su Anying heard it clearly over there.
From the bottom of her heart, she wished that both her parents would move there so that they would be close and convenient for taking care of her.
So when she heard that her father was still hesitant, she added Ganger beside him.
"Mom, what do you think? It's pretty good if I ask you.
You move in, you can live with me for the time being, and slowly look for a house. If you can’t find a house, you can find a way to approve a house and build it yourself.
It doesn’t need too much space, just three small rooms and a single courtyard.
Just right, waiting for Hua'er to get married this winter, so I don't have to travel so far to meet the bride. "Su Anying didn't persuade Su Weizhong at all, and asked Han Cai'e directly.
Before Han Caie could speak, Su Anfang and Su Anhua looked at their parents expectantly.
"Mom, please agree. You see, my fifth sister is also four months pregnant. If you move in, she will be closer, so I can help take care of her.
I'm getting married this winter too. If I get closer, I can go home and see you when I miss you.
Now it's too far away, and I have to take the train, which is too inconvenient. "Who doesn't want parents to be closer to themselves?
Su Weizhong and Han Cai'e thought about it, and it seems that this thing is really possible.
"Otherwise, after the sixth child gets engaged, I will go to Donggang to work first.
You tidy up at home and see if you sell the house, shall we move? " Su Weizhong asked tentatively.
"Okay, then move, I also think Donggang is very good, better than ours."
Of course, Han Cai'e hopes to be closer to her daughter, especially the two little ones, who are her darlings, so she really can't rest assured.
It’s a little closer, so I can go and have a look when I’m free. It’s good.

chapters.title: Chapter 418: whimsical
chapters.content:
Chapter 418 Whimsical
Successfully done the work of Tong Su Weizhong and his wife, and made the old couple agree to move to Donggang. The three sisters Su Anying were very happy.
Qin Meiling over there opened her mouth twice, not knowing what to say.
But Sui Hongzhi kept shaking his head at her, so Qin Meiling couldn't speak.
It was Ji Tongzhong, with bright eyes, leaning towards Xu Shiyan.
"Second brother-in-law, look, you can arrange for my father to see the gate, and you can find me a job, even if it is a temporary worker participating in the field.
Oh, this farming is really not profitable, Anfen and I both want to find a place to work. "
Ji Tongzhong has always had this idea. He was afraid of making great efforts, so he wanted to find something light and light.
"Xiao Ji, arrange for our father to visit the gate, one is that our father is too old to do anything else.
The other one is that the camp is full of chaos now. Our parents are getting older and can't stand those people messing around all day long, so I told them to move out. "
Xu Shiyan sighed, this Ji Tongzhong, he has committed an old problem again, and he only wants something beautiful.
As soon as I participated in the venue, there are still many unemployed young people who have no jobs. Even if they recruit jobs, they cannot get outsiders.
Su Weizhong is equivalent to the father-in-law of the three participating workers, and he can be regarded as a family member anyway.
Even so, it’s just a temporary worker, Ji Tongzhong? How is it possible?
"You are young and good at hands and feet, can you still let you see the gate? Isn't that a joke?
You, it would be great if An Xin and Fourth Sister planted some land.
After two years, the mallet on my side has developed. If you really don’t want to put Ssangyong, then come here, and I will take you to plant some mallets.
Otherwise, this fall, I partnered with some friends to build a 50,000-foot ginseng land. Come up and show the ginseng.
Most of this ginseng field is for sowing seeds, and ginseng seeds are generally not stolen, and they look good. "
"I'll give you a few dogs, and put ground guns and cannons around, and you can work in the yard, and I'll count your wages.
Looking at the participation fee for three years, it costs four yuan per ten feet. If the five leaves grow in two years, it will cost three yuan per ten feet.
You can’t see it yourself, just hire three or four blind people and pay them a monthly salary. Anyway, you can do the math yourself. "
Brother-in-law finally opened his mouth to beg, if Xu Shiyan didn't care about it at all, he didn't think it was very good, but recruiting would definitely not work.
Work hard, Xu Shiyan can help.
50,000 feet of ginseng soil, let alone four yuan for three years, all count as three yuan for two years, which is 150,000 yuan.
Employ four vagrants, deduct the salaries of the vagrants, and deduct all kinds of food, drink and flowers on the mountain. After two years, there will be 100,000 left.
If you were more diligent, digging the soil for others, weeding weeds and spraying medicine, you would earn more.
If it weren't for Ji Tongzhong, Xu Shiyan wouldn't have opened his mouth so easily.
He directly hired five or six blind workers, no need to pay more for a month, one hundred yuan salary, food and housing, do you think those blind workers can rush to work?
Those blind wanderers not only look at references, but also do all the work of weeding and spraying medicine together, and they don't need to pay extra.
If you know that those people are busy all year round, it would be great to have a few hundred dollars left over to send home.
Is there any cost for food and housing? There is only one thousand or eight hundred a year left.
The few of them who are partners can take turns to go up and watch those blind wanderers work. Anyway, their own family is also there, so they have to go up to work.
The 20,000 zhang that was sold was paid for the participation fee, which was more than enough to pay the wages of the blind Liuzi.
These houses are 30,000 feet long, and they don’t need to pay a penny for the participation fee. After three years, there will still be money left. What a great thing?
This is just pulling the brother-in-law for the sake of the daughter-in-law.
"Huh? Go up the mountain to see ginseng? No, no, second brother-in-law, I can't do this job."
Ji Tongzhong frowned when he heard this, and waved his hands saying that he couldn't do it.
He just wants to find a lively and decent job. If he goes up to the mountain to see ginseng, he will live on the mountain for a year, and he won't see many people.
He was made to look like a savage all day long, no, when he thought about it, he felt that he couldn't do this job.
Xu Shiyan wished he could roll his eyes. How can you help him?
It costs nearly 100,000 yuan in two years. If someone has to sharpen his head and rush to do it, there are really people who don't care.
What is this called? Well, it's better not to go, he saves money.
"Then if there is any chance later, let me help you pay attention, it is not easy anyway.
There are no arrangements for the unemployed young people participating in the venue. It is the turn of outsiders. "
Xu Shiyan gave the idea, since people don't use it, what else did he say? He can't arrange what he likes to do.
"Second brother-in-law, tell me, if I follow your example, let's raise some Clivia at home.
At that time, if you sell it, can you make a lot of money? "Ji Tongzhong refused to give up, and asked again.
"Xiao Ji, I advise you to give up your heart as soon as possible." Before Xu Shiyan could speak, Su Weizhong over there said in a deep voice.
"When did your second brother-in-law start planting Clivia? Several years ago.
At that time, how much was the Clivia seedlings and seeds? How much is it now? are you crazy? Are you going to tinker with these at this time?
Let’s not talk about whether you have the capital, but just say that you start planting now, and when you plant it, will the flowers still be so valuable?
You spend a lot of money to collect seeds and flower seedlings, and raise them yourself for two years. Will the price drop by then? No one wants it?
The money you borrowed from scraping together is all in vain. What do you give back to others?
People are chasing their **** for debts all day long, how are you feeling? "
I have to say that these older people are well-informed, and their experience and experience are there, they are really a hundred times better than young people.
Whether it is Xu Chenghou or Su Weizhong, facing such a crazy price of Clivia, they can keep calm and never naively think that this business will continue to flourish.
On the contrary, it is young people, all of whom are confused by the crazy market with high prices of Clivia, and want to get into it like crazy.
Actually, it’s normal to think about it. Young people, who doesn’t have a dream of getting rich overnight?
Especially with the living example of Xu Shiyan in front of him, who can resist such a temptation?
"Fourth son-in-law, you are supposed to be the son-in-law and I am the father-in-law.
Your parents don’t care about you. It’s not good for me as an old father-in-law to say something serious, and I don’t bother to say anything about you in normal life. "
Su Weizhong's face darkened, and he stopped calling him Xiao Ji, and called him Fourth Young Master directly.
"Don't look at the height of this mountain every day, don't you know what you are capable of?
Are you highly educated, or how much money is your family taking advantage of? What do you have more than others?
Why can you go to work as a worker when so many people from rural areas can’t find jobs?
If you don’t farm the land honestly, you just think about those useless things.
I can tell you, as long as you live a good life, it’s fine. If you don’t want to live a good life, I will take my daughter back.
It's fine if our daughter follows you and can't enjoy the blessings, what's wrong? Do you still want to beg for food with you? "
Su Weizhong was really angry, he had never lost his temper with uncle so much.

chapters.title: Chapter 419: beat Ji Tongzhong
chapters.content:
Chapter 419 Beat Ji Tongzhong
Ji Tongzhong has nothing wrong with him except that he doesn't want to make great efforts and spends his days doing dreamy things.
Whether she is good to the daughter-in-law or to the father-in-law or mother-in-law, there is nothing to say about the relationship with Su Anfen.
Besides, this person is timid. When Su Weizhong threatened him like this, Ji Tongzhong immediately became scared.
"Father, don't be angry, don't be angry, then what, can't I stop thinking about it?
You must not bring Anfen back. We still have a child here. If Anfen leaves, what will happen to me and the child? "
Ji Tongzhong was so frightened that he begged for mercy.
How capable his wife is, she manages everything outside the house, how will he live without his wife? That is absolutely not acceptable.
"If you know that leaving your daughter-in-law will make your life difficult at home, you can live in peace.
Let’s get rid of those moths, and let them farm the land honestly.
As your second brother-in-law said, wait for two years, and you will also plant some mallets, which I think is okay. "
As soon as Su Weizhong heard that his uncle had softened and begged for mercy, his expression relaxed a lot, and he softened his tone of persuasion.
Su Weizhong didn't say to ask Ji Tongzhong to visit Shen, it's not that he couldn't figure it out.
Rather, he felt that with Ji Tongzhong's character, if he didn't go up the mountain to see the ginseng, and if there were some tricks, Xu Shiyan would have to follow behind to wipe his ass, so he simply didn't let him go.
Besides, even if Ji Tongzhong didn't make any mistakes and finished reading the three-year ginseng smoothly, I'm afraid that his character won't be able to keep so much money.
Or, in case Ji Tongzhong gets rich, what if he dumps Su Anfen?
It's not impossible. Ji Tongzhong's face is enough to attract people's attention. If he has more money, he really can't stop women from posting it.
This man, few can resist the temptation, once it gets on, it won't be torn apart.
When the time comes, the wives and children will be separated and the family will not be able to form a family. It is better not to be able to earn the money.
Su Weizhong had a lot of worries, so he said, let Ji Tongzhong follow Xu Shiyan to plant a stick in the future.
As for Xu Shiyan, he actually had other plans in mind.
Last night when the couple were lying in bed chatting about nothing, Su Anying mentioned something.
Said that it was waiting for the market to be built, and in the store allocated by the family, one was reserved for Su Anfen, who asked her to come and open a snack bar.
It doesn’t need much. The money earned in the past three months in Qiudong alone is estimated to be able to catch up with others in a year. It’s a pretty good business.
Xu Shiyan also thought it was good. If Ji Tongzhong and his wife planted some sticks and set up such a small shop, they could live a good life.
But Xu Shiyan didn't mention this today.
The main reason is that the market participation has not yet been built, the house has not yet been seen, and the first two years of participation in the market may not be particularly prosperous, there must be a process.
If he said it now, he was afraid of Ji Tongzhong's temper, and he couldn't stand it any longer, and refused to farm the land to live.
That's why Xu Shiyan said, let Ji Tongzhong go up the mountain to watch the ginseng for a few years, just in time for the husband and wife to have capital in their hands, and it would be good to do any business.
Fortunately, he didn't say anything, otherwise Ji Tongzhong wouldn't know what to do.
So when the father-in-law was training his brother-in-law, Xu Shiyan didn't say a word.
Yes, this kid needs to be cleaned up, if you don't beat him twice, you will dare to jump anywhere.
"Well, what Dad said is that it's better to plant some sticks." The old man spoke, and Xu Shiyan nodded quickly.
"In two years, I will have seeds in my hands, and I can get ginseng soil. You can start with me and develop slowly."
With him, even if the market falls, there is a way to make money. If you can’t lose it in custody, this is the safest.
Ji Tongzhong didn't dare to talk nonsense this time, he just nodded a series of times, "Well, well, I heard from my father and my second brother-in-law."
Weng and son-in-law teamed up to suppress Ji Tongzhong, who was a little swollen and almost floated, and he was relieved.
On the other end, Su Anying didn't hear her husband mention the store, so she probably could have guessed it, so she didn't tell Su Anfen either.
Just tell Su Anfen to beat Ji Tongzhong more on weekdays, how old is he, why do you want to make it out?
In general, the atmosphere of the Su family is quite good.
Of course, it should be ignored that people would come in from time to time, making friends with Xu Shiyan, asking for warmth, and throwing face if they failed to achieve their goals.
Xu Shiyan said before that the smaller the place, the more troublesome things will happen.
Daying is bigger than Big House, but still far behind Donggang.
At the other end of Donggang, many people looked at Xu's family in surprise. I don't know how many people ran to Xu Shiyan and Xu Chengcheng to try to take advantage of it, let alone Daying.
One thing that pleased Xu Shiyan was that the cousins ​​of the Zhou family and the Zhang family did not join in the fun.
It should be said that the Zhou family and the Zhang family are very smart, they live a good life, and they are also somewhat proud.
Before Xu Shiqin got married, the Zhou family and the Zhang family heard Xu Shiyan say something about Clivia.
At that time, Xu Shiyan mentioned a few words to his cousins, and sure enough, they all listened to it, and didn't want to get involved at all.
Just like that, the noisy day finally passed.
Early in the morning on the sixth day of the first lunar month, the Su family began to be busy.
At ten o'clock in the morning, Li Chengrong, his parents, and Li Yuexiu came to Daying with the four engagement gifts and clothes for Su Anhua.
Because there was an example of Li Zongliang and Su Anfang getting engaged before, Li Chengrong also followed suit this time.
In addition to the four gifts, there is also a set of clothes, a pair of leather shoes, a watch, two catties of wool prepared by the Li family for Su Anhua, and a bride price of 160 yuan.
Now, I am envious of those people who are leaning on the window and looking outside.
Look at other people's engagements, and the bride price, and then look at the time when my daughter got engaged, there was nothing, it just got worse the more I thought about it.
Hey, the daughters of the Su family are all workers, why can't their daughters only farm?
No matter how jealous and envious those people outside are, there is harmony in the Su family house.
Su Anhua has been with Li Chengrong for more than two years, and they have a good relationship.
Li Chengrong is not only the son of the head of the field, but now he has gone to college and is waiting to come back after graduation. How can he be a small cadre.
In a few years, if the guarantee is not complete, it can be raised again, how wonderful.
Of course, Su Anhua is also good. She works in a comprehensive factory and her work is excellent.
Now he is the leader of a small team, and he will work his way up slowly. When the comprehensive factory expands in the future, Su Anhua can also be a section leader or something like that.
Both of them are working to earn wages, how can this day be worse?
The two families had no opinion on the marriage, and they got engaged smoothly.
Su family prepared a sumptuous feast for the guests, including a lot of meat brought by Xu Shiyan.
Anyway, everyone was satisfied with the engagement banquet, and Li Bingzhuo and his wife couldn't find anything wrong with the Su family.
After dinner, we chatted for a while, and it was almost time. Su Weizhong sent my son-in-law to drive the car, and sent everyone from the Li family to the station.
Su Anhua had to go to the station to send it off, "I'll go back with my second brother-in-law and the others tomorrow. Well, I even knit a sweater for you, and I'll give it to you when I go back."

chapters.title: Chapter 420: Sure enough, there is a problem
chapters.content:
Chapter 420 Sure enough, there is a problem
On the morning of the seventh day of the first lunar month, Su Weizhong took his clothes and luggage, and returned to Donggang by car with Xu Shiyan and others.
As soon as he got home, he received a call from the participant. Lin Qiyue said that he had something urgent to discuss with Xu Shiyan.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard this, he hung up the phone and hurried away on his bicycle.
While pedaling the bike, Xu Shiyan thought in his heart that this bike should be replaced, he should buy a motorcycle.
Motorcycles are so convenient, you can run when you start the fire, and you will arrive as soon as you get out.
Go back and inquire, see how motorcycles are sold, and think of a way to buy one.
It was only when I rode a bicycle to the field department that I saw Lin Qiyue that I realized what was going on.
Nothing else, but their products, the quotations of the two kinds of cola, and the other merchants gave their opinions.
As for the price set by the participants, they say it is acceptable, but there is a condition, that is, one Coke, paired with two natural sparkling mineral water.
The packaging of mineral water should be upscale, the more beautiful the better, the price can be more expensive than cola.
"Xiao Xu, do you think we have to hurry to buy mineral water filling equipment.
Also, the packaging needs to be upscale and beautiful. How beautiful is this thing? "
Lin Qiyue looked at the customer feedback sent from the provincial capital, and his face was confused. What should I do with this thing?
At that time, Xu Shiyan quoted a higher price on purpose.
There are also Coke abroad, how much is that Coke? No matter how expensive they are, they are cheaper.
Yes, this product is produced by Shenchang. It contains ginseng flowers and active ingredients of ginseng, and it is also made of natural aerated mineral water.
In terms of quality, it is indeed better than ordinary cola, and it can even be said to be a type of health care product or functional drink.
But the ex-factory price of this thing is 45 dollars a piece, including the shipping cost and the promotion and sales expenses of the other party, how much will it cost?
How can such an expensive cola compete with foreign cola? How to open up sales?
But as soon as this feedback arrived, Xu Shiyan immediately understood.
For those foreign merchants, what they want to focus on is not cola at all. Their main purpose is mineral water.
Natural aerated mineral water, many factories boast so much, but in fact it is artificially added soda bubbles.
Really pure natural mineral water with no additives, very rare.
Those people proposed that one cola is paired with two cups of water, and the purpose is to promote this kind of water at a high price. As for the cola, it is enough to not lose money.
This way is wrong. If they follow the other party's way, then their Coke will easily fall into an embarrassing situation.
The production of Coca-Cola requires both recipes and materials. It takes a lot of processes. In the end, the sales are not as much as the direct sales of water, and the income is not as much as the direct sales of water.
What will happen? It is estimated that even the people in the beverage factory will think that it still produces a fart of Coke.
Directly fill the water and sell it to takeaway. It is easy to earn a lot.
The deep processing of the ginseng industry that they have worked so hard to develop may have just started and was directly killed.
"Secretary Lin, let's reply like this.
The price of a Coke can drop to $5 or even a little lower, but we have two Cokes with one water. "
Foreign merchants want to make this water a high-end consumer product similar to luxury goods, so this water is the key.
Before the Coke market opened, Xu Shiyan had to use water to hook those merchants, and it was absolutely impossible to ship so much.
"No, Xiao Xu, what kind of way are you playing? Why can't I understand?
We took the initiative to lower the price, and also reduced the shipment of mineral water. In this way, wouldn’t we make less money? "
Lin Qiyue felt that his brain was getting weaker and weaker. What kind of medicine did Xu Shiyan sell in the gourd?
Xu Shiyan could only explain to Lin Qiyue bit by bit, breaking apart all the twists and turns and explaining clearly.
"Secretary Lin, if you think about it this way, they must ask for our Coke for mineral water.
Then they bought Coke, so they have to sell it, right? As long as you find a way to sell, you will gradually occupy a part of the market.
The foreign market is so big, it is impossible for us to eat all of them. It is enough to maintain a certain balance between the amount of spring water gushing out and the sales volume of our factory.
To be honest, no matter how much there is, we have no place to get this water. "
External constraints determine that their Coke must be at a high-end price, and it is impossible to become an ordinary consumer product.
"When everything in our beverage factory is on the right track, our Coke will have a bit of a reputation. We can also try to produce domestic models and compete for the domestic market."
The domestic market is temporarily out of consideration.
Based on the current domestic consumption level, there are still people who are reluctant to drink a bottle of soda for 25 cents.
Who is willing to spend so much money to buy a can of ginseng flower coke and drink it back? How can you go to heaven after drinking it?
Chinese people have always paid attention to practicality. The so-called high-end atmosphere is mostly fancy.
This is in China, anyway, there must be no market in the past ten years.
If you want to develop the domestic market, you can only use another version, the same production process as ordinary cola, without this natural mineral water.
Let’s talk about this matter slowly, don’t worry.
"There is one more thing to do now, which is to quickly design the packaging of mineral water. People demand high-end atmosphere and grades, so we have to figure it out."
What troubled Xu Shiyan was how to design the outer packaging of mineral water well.
It is not a small problem to think that it is expensive at first glance, and that it is a good thing at first sight.
Xu Shiyan felt it was a bit difficult, but for Lin Qiyue, it was even more confusing.
In his opinion, what kind of flowers can be made out of that glass bottle? It's almost like a soda bottle, how high-end is that thing? How beautiful?
"Okay, let's find someone to hold a meeting." Xu Shiyan knew it, and he couldn't explain it to Lin Qiyue.
So they called people for a meeting directly, this time it couldn't just be the technical department, the stage designer of the art troupe and the propaganda officer of the trade union were all called in.
These people are somewhat artistic anyway, brainstorming.
In addition, Xu Shiyan also called out specifically to ask Han Liwei's daughter-in-law, Xu Shiqin, his younger sister, to come over too.
Why? Because Xu Shiqin is a woman, and she is a fashion student, so she has a bit of talent in design.
In this way, all relevant personnel were called to the meeting room of the field department, and Xu Shiyan explained his thoughts and ideas.
distributed paper and pens to everyone, let them think about drawing by themselves.
Not only the bottle body design, but also the logo, the pattern on the bottle, etc., have to come up with a plan.
Not to mention, the power of the masses is huge, and there are really a few good ideas.
Xu Shiqin designed a bottle that is thin in the middle and thick at both ends, a bit like a beautiful woman in a long skirt.
Xu Shiyan thought it was good, and added some suggestions, making the bottle cap into the shape of a golden crown.
Looking at it this way, it really looks like the queen in a western fairy tale.
As for why the bottle cap is designed as a crown, this matter has to be told from the stories they made up.
When writing product introductions, Xu Shiyan said, let’s make up a few folklore or stories.
Licheng allowed those people to be able to do it, so he made up a story about the old Han king who went to the mountain and got sick, and drank the spring water to save his life.
Dear friends, Happy National Day.

chapters.title: Chapter 421: holy mountain spring
chapters.content:
Chapter 421 Holy Mountain Tianquan
Old King Han is talking about Nurhachi.
In the Changbai Mountain area, there are many legends about the Old Han King.
For example, Manchu people regard crows as divine birds, why?
According to legend, Nurhachi was hunted down by someone, and he was seriously injured and passed out in the mountains.
When the pursuers arrived, they found that Nurhachi was covered with crows.
People say that crows eat carrion, so the man must be dead, and the pursuers left without checking the body.
Nurhachi escaped a catastrophe and swore from then on that the crow was regarded as a divine bird and would not be harmed.
It is also said that when Nurhachi went to the mountains to dig wild ginseng when he was young, he fell ill and almost died. After finally climbing to the edge of a pool of water, he recovered from his illness after drinking the water.
After Nurhachi became king, he came back to worship this pool of water and named it the king's pool.
The legend of Wang Chi has been circulating in the local area for a long time.
Xu Shiyan did not expect that Li Chengrong and others would actually move the story of Wang Chi to the spring.
But if you think about it carefully, it’s nothing. Anyway, it’s all folklore, and no one has literature to support it, so just use it casually.
Since it is the water that the old Han King once drank, it is not too much to have a crown or something with the royal family. Anyway, everyone thinks it looks pretty.
In addition to this one, the publicity officer of the trade union also designed one.
Compared with the current soda bottle, the **** part is as downward as possible, forming a shape with a big belly at the bottom and a thin neck at the top.
Around the big belly at the bottom, the shape of the sixteen peaks of Changbai Mountain is engraved to indicate that the water source comes from Changbai Mountain.
Overall, the bottle body is good, and the bottle cap is a bit simpler.
Xu Shiyan thinks that this one and the one designed by Xu Shiqin are quite distinctive, and the bottle cap can also be designed in the style of a crown.
"This crown has a slight change, designed as a king and a queen.
One is named Jun, and the other is named, they can make a pair. "
The bottle with a big belly has a sense of calm and heavy, like a man, for the king, and the thin waist bottle is a little elegant and flexible, like a woman, for the queen, just a pair.
"Then our spring water, do we need a name?
We sell this water as a commodity, there must be a brand, right? "Someone asked next to him.
Xu Shiyan thought for a while. In his previous life, this spring was named Shixi Spring, and it was the main product of Linhaixueyuan Mineral Water Company.
In this life, I will definitely not be called Shixiquan anymore.
"How about calling it the Holy Mountain Tianquan?"
Changbai Mountain was named "Xingguo Yingling King" and "Kaitianhong Holy Emperor" in the Jin Dynasty.
In the Qing Dynasty, he was directly named the "God of Changbai Mountain".
Therefore, Changbai Mountain has always been regarded as a sacred mountain and a holy mountain by the Northeast regime.
Since the legend of Laohan King has been used, what else is there to use the name of the holy mountain? The spring itself is located in the Changbai Mountains, so there is nothing wrong with it being called that.
"Sacred Mountain Tianquan? Eh? It sounds nice, I think it's okay.
Then let’s call it this. Our beverage factory will also be called this name in the future. "
When Lin Qiyue heard it, he thought it was very good, and immediately decided that the mineral water factory should be independent, and it would be called Shengshan Tianquan Mineral Water Factory.
The name of the product is Shengshan Tianquan·Jun·Natural Soda Water, Shengshan Tianquan·Hou·Natural Soda Water, and the trademark is Baishan Brand.
"Okay, let's do this today first, tomorrow Limin is on a business trip, go to the glass factory and ask them to produce bottles for us according to the drawings.
Xiao Xu, are you going back to the provincial capital in two days? Then I will go to the provincial capital with you, we have to buy a set of mineral water filling equipment.
In addition, I have to go to the province to implement the export right.
This is not possible now, and everything cannot go through the province, it is too troublesome.
We have to have the right to independently manage exports without any constraints, and I will try to find a way to poach two foreign language talents. "
There is no professional translator for the first participant. Li Chengrong and Xiao Peng have only studied in Normal University for half a year and cannot do independent translation, so they have to find two professional translators.
In the future, there will be a lot of export orders, so professional talents are necessary.
"Secretary Lin, not only a translator, but also two legal advisers.
