In the future, if we want to sign contracts with foreign companies, we must have professional people who understand relevant legal knowledge to operate.
There is another one that we will have more patents to register in the future, and these require talents who understand the law. "
Not to mention anything else, as far as the design of these two bottles is concerned, the appearance patent must be registered as soon as possible after the product is released.
"By the way, there is also the outer packaging of Coke.
We currently only have Chinese and English versions, which is okay for the time being, but other languages ​​should also be prepared. Once there are orders from other countries? "
The beverage factory has not been mass-produced since its opening, and there are only Chinese and English on the cans.
After all, English is the universal language of the world, and it has a wide range of applications. I didn't think about those when I sent the samples before, so I sent them directly.
This time, two European and American companies contacted the participating companies through the province, so there is no major problem with the outer packaging, and they can be used directly.
But next, no one knows whether there will be orders from other countries, so it is best to prepare.
A meeting lasted from noon to evening, and everyone was hungry. Since most of the problems have been solved, let’s end the meeting.
Lin Qiyue originally wanted to invite the big guys to the cafeteria for dinner, but after thinking about it, the cafeteria is closed during the first lunar month, and there is nothing there.
"Okay, that's it, it's getting late, let's all go home.
Waiting for our Coke and mineral water to be sold out, I invite everyone to have a good meal. "
Lin Qiyue waved his hand, everyone got up and left the meeting room, and went home.
Xu Shiyan was the last one to leave. He took the opportunity to tell Lin Qiyue that he wanted Su Weizhong to go to the beverage factory to watch the gate.
Lin Qiyue agreed without saying a word, "Okay, let Li Zongliang send your father-in-law to the beverage factory tomorrow.
Over there, they work one night for one day and one night for rest, and they work in shifts.
The salary is the same as that of the old Antou before, and other labor insurance and welfare benefits are the same as ordinary workers.
If your father-in-law is serious and responsible in his work, he will be transferred to a regular job after a while, and he can retire or something. "
Given Xu Shiyan's contribution to the participation, Lin Qiyue was fine with arranging a few more people, let alone an old man.
Xu Shiyan really didn't expect Lin Qiyue to be so happy, "Then thank Secretary Lin.
I must tell my father-in-law to be serious and responsible for his work. "
Su Weizhong is several years younger than Xu Chenghou, only fifty-eight this year.
It would be great if he could become a full-time employee, retire after working for a few years, and receive a pension.
Of course, this matter is very difficult to operate. It's all up to Lin Qiyue to find a way, that is, Lin Qiyue. If it's another person, he wouldn't dare to agree like this.
"Thank you for what? You have made so much contribution to our site, and the site has to think of you anyway.
That's it, I will arrange for your father-in-law to go to work tomorrow, and you don't have to worry about other things, I will arrange it. "
The two came out of the field department pushing their bicycles side by side, and chatted for a while.
It wasn't until the front of high school that Lin Qiyue went east and Xu Shiyan went west, and then they went home separately.

chapters.title: Chapter 422: partner cheating
chapters.content:
Chapter 422 Partner cheating father
The matter of participating in the venue is considered to be over for the time being.
About the quotation of the Coke and mineral water, Lin Qiyue said that he would go directly to the provincial capital and report directly to the leader.
Lin Qiyue inquired about the news, saying that the merchant was also coming, so naturally it would be better to talk face to face.
This year’s New Year’s Eve is late, school starts on March 1st, and it’s only the tenth day of the first lunar month.
Xu Shiyan had to go back to school before school started, so he had to leave on the eighth day of the first lunar month.
Thanks to Su Anying having prepared all the luggage and clothes at home, so Xu Shiyan didn't need to bother.
In the evening, Xu Shiyan had to tell his daughters and daughters to listen to their mother at home and be obedient not to make trouble. When he comes back next time, he will bring something fun for the children.
"Dad, I don't want toys, you can buy me books. Buy more, any books are fine."
Xu Haiyuan's request is always so weird.
Other children are so old, they either want powder guns or slingshots, but this kid wants books.
"There are so many books in our family, but it's not enough for you to read? Why buy so many books?"
Xu Shiyan was speechless, and now Westinghouse has set up a bookshelf, and there are already many books written by Xu Haiyuan and his sister.
"Not enough, I have read those several times, Dad, let's buy some new ones."
Xu Haiyuan knew that his father was deliberately embarrassing him, so he flirted with Xu Shiyan awkwardly, pleading all over his face.
Over there, Xu Jinping was more straightforward, grabbing Xu Shiyan's arm and began to shake it.
"Dad, my brother and I want to read a lot of books.
Dad is the best dad in the world. Dad loves us the most and will definitely buy it for us. right? "
The little girl has a sweet mouth and can act like a baby. Anyone who meets her will be confused.
Xu Shiyan was coaxed by his daughter to grin and nod repeatedly. "Okay, okay, buy it, Dad promises to buy it for you."
Done.
Xu Jinping immediately let go of her father's arm and gave her brother a high five.
"Oh, that's great, Dad agreed to buy books for me." The two children cheered together.
Xu Shiyan almost spit out a mouthful of old blood, was he kidnapped by his daughter and son just now?
These two brats are doing everything they can to buy books.
"Okay, you two are really good. I warn you, study hard, don't watch TV all the time, and don't get into trouble.
Our family now has a telephone, and I can often call back. If you let me know that you are disobedient, the book will be gone. "
Xu Shiyan put on a hard face, held back his smile, and warned the children.
As for Su Anying, she couldn't laugh anymore.
Ever since Xu Haiyuan went to school, this kind of scene of father and son fighting wits has often been seen, and now a daughter is added, which is simply too funny.
Seeing Xu Shiyan slumped, Su Anying didn't help, just sat there and kept laughing.
"It's a good thing the two younger ones aren't so smart, otherwise, I'm really afraid that the two of us will be played around by the four of them in the future."
Enough laughing, Su Anying wiped the corner of her eyes, and then said.
"It's good, the child is smart and won't suffer at all, don't be like the two of us, foolish and silly, wherever we go, people think we are honest and easy to bully."
Nowadays is not bad, and most people have a good impression of honest people. When the children grow up, honest people will be bullied to death.
So, it's better for the kids to be smarter and not be bullied in the future.
"Father, I've made an agreement with Secretary Lin, you will go to work tomorrow.
Tomorrow morning Zong Liang will come to pick you up and take you to the beverage factory.
The job is to work all day and take one day off. The factory has a shuttle bus, and you take the factory car to and from get off work. Anyway, after you work for a few days, you will find out the rules. "
Xu Shiyan looked at Su Weizhong who was coaxing Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui to watch TV, and gave some instructions.
Although Su Weizhong coaxed the child, he actually listened to what the aunt, aunt and grandson said.
Just now Xu Haiyuan's brother and sister teamed up to fool Xu Shiyan, and Su Weizhong was also secretly having fun here.
Hearing talking to him now, he nodded hurriedly. "Okay, I see. You don't have to worry about this. I'll just ask."
It's just a commute to and from get off work, and Su Weizhong can't help it.
"Well, Shi Yan, you still have a year and a half to go to university, right? Are there any girls in your class?"
Su Weizhong held Xu Jinhui in his arms, and asked a seemingly casual question.
"Women? In our class? There are two or three."
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, thinking about it carefully, there were less than a hundred of them this year, and there seemed to be only two or three women.
"Yo, there are really female cadres going to study?"
Su Weizhong looked surprised, and turned to look at Xu Shiyan. "It's not easy for a female cadre, how old are you?"
Xu Shiyan was even more confused, "How old are you? I haven't asked, it seems to be over 40 years old, right?
Father, think about it, the cadre training class mainly recruits cadres at the deputy county level or quasi-deputy county level.
If you get to this position, most people will be in their forties.
Lesbians, you have to have outstanding work ability to have this opportunity. "
"Oh, oh, so that's what happened. Well, it's really not easy if you say so."
Su Weizhong looked at his daughter with an expression of sudden realization, and immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
Don't blame him for being overwhelmed, Xu Shiyan went out to study, and it took half a year after he left.
The man has been outside for a long time, who knows if he can have other thoughts?
Especially Xu Shiyan is only in his thirties, he looks pretty good, and now he is considered to be of some wealth and status, such a man is quite attractive.
Those outside the school may not have a chance.
Su Weizhong was worried that if there were a few young and beautiful women in their school, especially among the students studying together, it would be difficult to talk about it.
After hearing that there were only a few women in their forties, Su Weizhong breathed a sigh of relief.
His niece has just turned 30. Although she is the mother of four children, she can still be considered young and beautiful.
Moreover, the relationship between the young couple has always been very good. As long as Xu Shiyan is not obsessed with ghosts, he will not be seduced by a woman in his forties.
"That's right. Most of the female cadres are in family planning, health care, and publicity, but it is difficult for these to rise to the position of deputy county or quasi-deputy county.
Those who can reach this level have very strong personal ability and ideological awareness. "
Xu Shiyan had never had any wrong thoughts, so naturally he couldn't think of what his old man was thinking about, and he was explaining it in a serious manner.
Xu Shiyan couldn't hear it, it doesn't mean that Su Anying couldn't hear it either.
Knowing the father is more like a daughter, how can Su Anying not know about her father's thoughts? Su Anying was also embarrassed to point it out, so she was having fun by the side.
As for what her father was worried about, Su Anying wasn't afraid at all.
The man in his family also has a brilliant mind on planting sticks. Outside of work, he is still full of stupidity and simplicity.
His mind is on study and work, and he is only thinking about how to make money, but he is careless in other aspects, and he doesn't notice anything else at all.
People outside don't know the basics. When they see Xu Shiyan, they think this is an honest piece of wood, naive and stupid.
But when Su Anying looked at her man, she felt that the more he looked the more pleasing to the eye, no matter how he looked.

chapters.title: Chapter 423: The reason for meritorious service
chapters.content:
Chapter 423 Reasons for meritorious service
February 27th, the eighth day of the first lunar month.
Xu Shiyan, Li Chengrong, Xiao Peng, Han Liwei, Xu Shiqin, Lin Qiyue, and Lin Qiyue's secretary.
A group of seven people took the participating jeep, went directly to the railway station, and took the train from Baihe to Tonghua.
Xu Shiyan, Li Chengrong, and Xiao Peng went to study in the provincial capital, and Lin Qiyue led his secretary to the province on business.
As for Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin, needless to say, Han Liwei went to the capital to participate in the meritorious service award ceremony, and at the same time went to the Military Academy for advanced studies.
Only now did Xu Shiyan know that the company that followed Han Liwei to investigate had won first-class collective merit.
Among them, about ten people won the first-class personal merit, and the rest were also second-class personal merit.
As for why he made such a big contribution, Han Liwei finally didn't hide it.
At that time, he led a company to investigate, and he found a lot of troops ambushed on the monkey's side.
Han Liwei immediately ordered people to go back to pass the message. On the one hand, he took the rest of the people and went directly to the center of the enemy's position.
Destroyed the opponent's forward headquarters and captured two commanders.
It was this move that angered the monkey and stabbed the hornet's nest.
Houzi didn't care about ambushes anymore, and concentrated firepower to encircle and suppress Han Liwei and others.
You know, if the monkey is captured, even the family members will be implicated.
Moreover, a higher-ranking commander was arrested. Once taken away, how many secrets will be revealed. Can you not be anxious over there? He went crazy and wanted to stop Han Liwei and others.
Han Liwei took a dozen people as cover and ordered others to take the prisoners away.
These ten people fell one after another, and finally Han Liwei was also seriously injured and fell into a coma. Fortunately, our side launched an attack in time, and the situation was immediately reversed.
However, due to the complicated situation at that time, when his comrades found Han Liwei, Han Liwei was already dying, and the others were also seriously injured.
Fortunately, none of these people died.
Although some were seriously injured and some were disabled, they all survived in the end. This can definitely be called a miracle.
The commanders of the two monkeys were also brought back safely, and sure enough, they learned a lot of monkey deployment secrets from them.
According to the intelligence, our side destroyed many positions on the monkey's side one after another, winning successively.
"Third brother, I distributed the pill you sent me to the dozen or so people who performed the cover mission.
At that time, I told them that if the situation is not right, take the medicine first. If you are injured, you have to take two seconds to take the medicine anyway.
I reckon that they were able to save their lives, most likely because of the medicine. "
The Chu family has passed down hundreds of years of palace secret recipes, using hundreds of years old mountain ginseng, supplemented with pills extracted from various precious medicinal materials, it is not unusual to have such magical effects.
At the beginning, Xu Shiyan prepared the pills and packed them in plastic bottles.
He thought it was too inconvenient, so he found that kind of small porcelain bottle from the pharmaceutical factory, and divided the pills into the porcelain bottle.
The porcelain bottle is very small, and it can only hold six or seven pills in it. This amount of medicine is definitely enough for most cases, and there is no need to add more.
Xu Shiyan mailed only a dozen bottles of pills to Han Liwei, hoping that Han Liwei could carry them with him, and if something unexpected happened, it might work.
Because the medicine bottle is small and easy to carry, it can be stuffed anywhere, so Han Liwei almost never leaves the medicine bottle.
When leading people to carry out the cover mission, Han Liwei gritted his teeth and distributed the medicine to the dozen or so people, just in case.
I just didn't expect it to come in handy.
"Two days ago, the superiors called to inquire, and wanted to ask you for the formula, but I refused.
It is too difficult to obtain the old wild ginseng that is prepared as medicine, so there is no way to promote it. "
Han Liwei felt that it was not good for him to reject Xu Shiyan without consulting him.
But that was the secret recipe that Xu Shiyan worked so hard to research, how could he hand over the recipe casually?
Besides, even if you hand it over, it's useless if you don't have suitable medicinal materials.
The hundreds-year-old mountain ginseng is hard to come by. Even people like Han Wenzhong who have grown up on the mountain don’t have it in their hands, let alone others.
For medicines that cannot be mass-produced, even if Xu Shiyan handed in the prescription, it is useless, it is better not to hand in.
Xu Shiyan nodded when he heard the words. The secret recipe could not be handed in without Elder Chu's consent.
That is something handed down from the Chu family. Although it is in his hands now, he just keeps it.
It’s okay to use it for relatives, but he really can’t make decisions about handing over the secret recipe or something.
"It's a pity that third brother won't get the reward he deserves for his contribution." Han Liwei sighed.
If the recipe is handed in, the superiors must acknowledge Xu Shiyan's contribution. This is actually a great opportunity for Xu Shiyan.
"What credit is not credit?" Xu Shiyan shook his head and smiled.
"As long as our people can survive, it's not a waste of my thoughts. I haven't thought about anything else.
This time you go to the capital to study, Shiqin used to take care of you. I've told Shiqin everything I need to say, she knows it well, as long as the two of you get along well. "
No matter what, his painstaking efforts were not in vain, that's all.
As for those who don’t deserve credit, that’s it. The prescription is not his, so he can’t exchange the prescription for some credit.
Xu Shiyan and the others are going to the provincial capital and get off at the Hunjiang River.
Han Liwei and his wife wanted to go to Tonghua to reverse the train, and then go to the capital, so when the train arrived at Hunjiang, everyone separated.
Xu Shiyan and others got off the train at Hunjiang, had something to eat near the train station, and took a bus to the provincial capital at night.
Sleep in the car for one night, get off at the station the next morning, and then go to their respective destinations.
Back to school and found that those in the same dormitory have also returned.
Everyone met and said Happy New Year to each other, and then began to communicate and communicate with each other about how they went home to celebrate the New Year.
"Hey? Xiao Xu, have you heard? Someone in your county cultivated Clivia and made a lot of money?"
While chatting, that Shao Yong of Jingyu suddenly brought up this matter.
Xu Shiyan was taken aback, isn't it, the Clivia matter has already spread to neighboring counties?
Sure enough, some news can’t be blocked if the leader doesn’t allow it to be passed on. There are always people who will talk about it in private.
And these news spread far faster than other news.
Look, even the next county knows it, alas.
It seems that he is a flapping moth, this time flapping a bit too much.
I don’t know how many people would want to get involved in the Clivia business because of his aggressiveness.
"What's the matter? Brother Shao, you're also moved? You won't be involved too?"
Xu Shiyan glanced at Shao Yong and asked worriedly.
Shao Yong hurriedly shook his head, "No, I don't dare to meddle, ouch, this thing is not something that ordinary people can get involved with now.
Originally, I really had that kind of thought. Didn’t I come to school early?
I went to those flower markets yesterday, and I found out that this thing can’t be bought. "
For the double monthly ticket campaign, the promised goal needs to be added. There will be more updates today, but the time is uncertain. I will post it as soon as I finish writing.

chapters.title: Chapter 424: Prescription (National Day monthly ticket plus update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 424 Prescriptions (National Day Monthly Pass plus update)
Actually, the stock of Clivia in the market is certain.
After all, not everyone is like Xu Shiyan, who can predict in advance and cultivate so many flower seedlings early.
Most people have only one or two pots in their hands, and there are three or five pots in the sky.
After several months of hype, these vendors in the provincial capital have almost bought the Clivia in the surrounding areas.
It should be said that except for the relatively remote mountain villages like Daying and Big House, most Clivia are gathered in the provincial capital.
Either in the major flower companies, or in the hands of some factories and mines.
With the current price of Clivia, it takes a lot of capital to get a foot in it.
Individuals basically don’t have to think about it, most of the units that can play well are various units.
Most of these people only want to invest in the short term. No one wants to buy seeds and plant them by themselves at this time, because the cycle is too long.
Short-term investment, quick results, and large returns are what most people think.
But this kind of investment requires a huge amount of money, and ordinary people can't handle it.
Xu Shiyan was relieved when he heard Shao Yong say that.
"Brother Shao, you are a sensible person, let's not get involved in Clivia's business.
The current prosperity itself is abnormal, and the upper echelon will certainly not allow the situation to get out of control.
I don't feel that within half a year, there will definitely be changes in the Clivia market.
Once the iron fist comes down, the false prosperity of the Clivia market will be beaten back to its original shape.
By that time, I don’t know how many people will go bankrupt. "
Xu Shiyan didn't know if these people could listen, he just fulfilled his duty of reminding.
When Shao Yong and the others heard this, their faces were a little ugly.
"Xiao Xu, is it true what you said? Did you hear about it through some special channel?"
Shao Yong asked eagerly, you know, there is a unit in their county that is buying Clivia seeds and seedlings, and plans to develop a batch of them.
"It shouldn't be wrong.
The administrative secretary of our county has issued a death order that no unit, factory or mining enterprise shall use public funds to engage in Clivia-related production and business activities.
Once found out, they will be severely punished. "Xu Shiyan's words are true.
Guan Enxue listened to Xu Shiyan's suggestion and strictly prohibited all units from getting involved, for fear that if something happened, it would cause losses to the county.
"My God, something bad happened, let's talk first, I have to make a phone call."
When Shao Yong heard this, he was so frightened that he ran out in a hurry.
What a joke, those people in their county are still ambitious and want to follow suit to make money.
If something really happened, it would be a poor county, wouldn't it make things worse?
Shao Yong ran out quickly, while the other two students shook their heads.
"Thanks to the fact that our county is far away from your county seat, the news didn't spread, and we didn't hear any rumors." Jin Yongqing from Changbai and Pu Zhengzhe from Antu said with lingering fear.
Shao Yong went out and made a phone call, but came back with a bad face, and no one asked him the result of the call.
Xu Shiyan gathered his luggage and put everything away. Anyway, there was nothing else to do, so he left the school and took the car, heading straight to the family hospital of the medical department.
On the ninth day of the first lunar month, the new year has not yet come, so I have to pay New Year's greetings to Mr. Chu.
Elder Chu was also very happy to see Xu Shiyan. He dragged Xu Shiyan and told him that the formula of the functional drink proposed by Xu Shiyan last time has already taken shape.
Xu Shiyan was naturally very happy when he heard it, and the master and apprentice discussed it for a long time.
At noon, Xu Shiyan stayed at Mr. Chu's place for dinner. After lunch, the two chatted about other things.
Xu Shiyan mentioned Han Liwei's injury and talked about the secret recipe.
"Oh, you are talking about that prescription." Elder Chu shook his head.
"It's fortunate that you have the hundreds of years old ginseng used as medicine in your hand, otherwise, the effect would not be so good.
It's a pity that our Chu family's ancestral prescription could not be passed on in the end because of insufficient medicinal materials. "
"It's okay, if the relevant department above asks for the formula, you can hand it in.
The strength of an individual is ultimately incomparable with that of the country, and it is useless in our hands, but there are always ways to hand it over to the country and gather the power of the whole country.
Even if it cannot be mass-produced, it can still be useful for some special groups.
If a few more people could be saved, the prescriptions left by the Chu family would not be in vain. "
Mr. Chu sighed, this is the current dilemma that Chinese medicine is facing, there are too few good heirs, and there are even fewer good medicines.
So many useful prescriptions cannot be prepared and produced because there are no qualified medicinal materials, and there is no way to play their role in curing diseases and saving lives.
"Okay, everything is under Master's arrangement." Xu Shiyan nodded without saying anything else.
After all, the secret recipe belongs to the Chu family, as long as Mr. Chu nods in agreement, any arrangement is fine.
Xu Shiyan stayed with Mr. Chu until about two o'clock before returning to the Agricultural University by car.
The next day the class officially started, and after a month's rest, I was a little lazy when I went home to eat and drink.
So everyone cheered up, listened carefully, took notes carefully, and tried to keep up with the instructor's train of thought.
On the other side, Lin Qiyue went to the provincial capital, found relevant leaders, and discussed with the leaders about the independent management of export rights.
The leaders of the province hesitated for a long time, but failed to agree directly, and only said to hold a meeting to discuss it later.
Afterwards, the leader asked about the beverage factory, asked the merchants about ordering Coke, and whether they could complete the order in one session.
Lin Qiyue followed Xu Shiyan's example and said that the amount of spring water gushing out is not particularly large, and it may not be possible to satisfy all of it.
If possible, Lin Qiyue would like to meet and talk directly with foreign businessmen.
In fact, the merchant was in the province. At first, some people didn’t want to delegate power directly, so they didn’t let the two parties meet.
After a meeting was held to discuss, I felt that it should be a good situation to give a participant the right to independently manage exports.
In this way, it can stimulate the enthusiasm of participating in independent research and development and exporting to earn foreign exchange, and the province can also save some energy and invest in other aspects.
Of course, all external cooperation matters in a venue must be reported to the province.
Lin Qiyue met with the merchants directly, and according to what Xu Shiyan said, the price of each Coke can be reduced by five dollars, and two Cokes can be paired with one mineral water.
After three months, the first batch of 60,000 pieces can be shipped, and another 90,000 pieces will be shipped in succession.
This is the largest output of a participant, there is no other way.
The merchant really wanted mineral water as Xu Shiyan speculated.
They want to turn this mineral water into a high-end consumer product, which is mainly used in major high-end hotels in Europe, America and other countries, for the rich and nobles to enjoy.
This kind of natural sparkling soda water is definitely the favorite of the nobles in the upper class, and the price is naturally not a problem.
But Lin Qiyue insisted that only this output was available, and he could only have this kind of supply plan. In the end, foreign businessmen had no choice but to agree.
However, the price of the Coke was lowered by another four dollars, and the final price was set at thirty-six dollars per piece, which was converted to three dollars a can.
As for mineral water, a bottle of 500ml, 12 bottles a piece, the two parties finally agreed on a price of 62 dollars a piece.
This price really surprised Lin Qiyue. He never imagined that the Coke they developed with great pains could not sell water.
This a double monthly ticket for the National Day, thanks to all readers who voted for this book. The leader Su Nian's reward will be updated tomorrow, and I would also like to thank all the readers who have rewarded and cheered for this book in the past few days. I can't thank you, I can only grit my teeth and add more code words. I won't go anywhere today, just code words at home. Whoever won't let me code words, I am anxious to him.
Bye, go to codewords, prepare to update tomorrow, I wish you all a happy National Day.

chapters.title: Chapter 425: Set up a company to sell ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 425 Establishing a company to sell ginseng soil
The price of cola is not as good as the price of mineral water. This result directly confirmed Xu Shiyan's deduction, and also surprised Lin Qiyue.
Maybe what Xu Shiyan said has some truth, this is not a good thing.
Mineral water is only bottled in the place of origin, and what is sold is the raw material itself. No matter how high the price is, there is no other added value, let alone a technical core.
Once there are uncontrollable factors in the water source, the mineral water business will be directly affected.
Beverages are different. At any rate, there is still technology research and development. Even if there is an accident in the water source in the future, it can be changed from natural soda water to artificially added bubbles.
This in itself is an idea of ​​development. At present, we can only use natural water as raw material to earn foreign exchange and reputation, and then try to develop the domestic market.
As long as they can occupy a certain share in the domestic market, their beverage factory will really stand firm.
So for beverage factories, the water source is not an absolute factor, but only a means to attract the attention of foreign businessmen.
Of course, water source protection has been put on the agenda.
That is not a spring, it is a cornucopia, which must be protected.
Xu Shiyan has proposed that a certain range around the spring and the nearby river be designated as protected areas.
In the water source protection area, human habitation and wild swimming are prohibited, and the water source must be guaranteed to be natural and pollution-free.
Lin Qiyue was on a business trip in the provincial capital for a week and signed a supply contract for Coke and mineral water.
And two translators and two legal consultants were required from the province, and then they were satisfied and brought them back to Donggang.
From March 10th to 16th, the county held a ginseng technology training class to teach new techniques of ginseng cultivation.
And hold the annual meeting of the Ginseng Society, read the papers, and conduct awards.
Xu Shiyan is studying in the province. This year he only participated in one paper and was awarded the first prize.
This time there are not only prizes, but also bonuses. Xu Shiyan is not here, and Lin Qiyue will receive the prizes and bonuses on his behalf.
At the same time, the Ginseng Society re-elected a new board member, Lin Qiyue was elected as the chairman of the Human Body Society, and Xu Shiyan was elected as the vice-chairman.
In a blink of an eye, the willows are green and the peaches are red, and it is a good time for spring and flowers.
Relocation of Donggang Ginseng Market, with the joint efforts of the town and Xishen Village, all the signing work was finally completed.
The Qin family made a fuss to the end, but didn't get much benefit, so they could only obediently sign the contract.
The house construction work in the west of Mulenchang also officially started.
According to Xu Shiyan's instructions, Su Anying invited a professional construction team to work.
The town cooperated vigorously, and all kinds of materials used in the construction were contacted by people from the town, and the price was the lowest.
At the same time, through Guo Shouye, Xu Shiyan applied from the Resources Department of the Forestry Bureau, and the 50,000-foot ginseng soil located on the top of the Liumao River was also approved.
This is the largest cutting area of ​​the Forestry Bureau last year. It is located in the lower reaches of the Liumaohe work area and is a broad-leaved forest in Dapinggang.
The soil is fertile and the black soil layer is thick, which is very suitable for planting ginseng.
With such a large area of ​​ginseng, it is naturally impossible to clean it manually as before, and must use machines.
But this machine is not easy to get.
Su Anying approached Lin Qiyue to discuss the lease, but there were tens of thousands of feet of soil in the field, and the machines were busy for personal use, so there was no time to rent them to Su Anying.
No way, Su Anying can only call Xu Shiyan and ask Xu Shiyan to find a way.
This is easy, Xu Shiyan asked Su Anying to register a comprehensive ginseng production and processing company in the county.
Su Anying is the largest shareholder, accounting for 52% of the shares, and concurrently serves as the general manager.
Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others accounted for 48% of the shares, and they each held corresponding positions in the company. Su Anying had the decision-making power of the company.
Nowadays, it is not the first time to make small troubles. It is enough for a few people to agree on the dividends verbally.
If you want to have long-term development, everything must go through formal procedures, and everything must be done in accordance with the rules and regulations.
It is inevitable to establish a company. Only by clearly dividing the responsibilities and rights of each person can there be no other conflicts and better development.
After the company is established, file an application in the name of the company.
After receiving the approval from the county, he submitted the materials to the province. Xu Shiyan ordered four brush cutters, two rotary tillers, and some related agricultural machinery from the province.
It’s not a disadvantage to buy these gadgets, and you can rent them out to other participants when you run out of them.
In 1985, in addition to the original four state-owned ginseng farms in the county, the county ginseng company also co-organized the Fulu, Fulin, and Fuquan ginseng farms with the Lushuihe Forestry Bureau, Linjiang Forestry Bureau, and Quanyang Forestry Bureau. .
In addition, there will be an overseas Chinese joint venture, and then there will be another overseas Chinese participating.
Not to mention, there is a village and town participating in the field, and the participation of various units will also be launched one after another.
With so many participants, those with a small investment cannot afford to buy machinery, and they cannot all point to manual digging.
Su Anying's company's machinery can be leased out, and within two years, the money for buying the machine will be earned back.
After the machine was bought, an operator who participated in the field was invited to come and guide it for a few days.
Huang Shengli and the others are very smart, and they are quite slick with these machines, so they joined the field and started construction. Qinglin lays firewood and prepares to hang strings.
With such a large participation, it is impossible to point all of them at Huang Shengli and others.
So Su Anying directly said that there are 20,000 feet of ginseng soil for sale this year. Anyone who wants to buy ginseng soil should go up the mountain to work first.
When the ginseng farmers in the three villages of Donggang heard about it, they flocked to it. In less than three days, all 20,000 feet of ginseng soil were ordered out.
Then each family arranges people to go up the mountain to work, and after hanging strings, they start drawing lots.
When selling ginseng soil, the ginseng soil is generally divided into plots of different lengths according to the terrain and terrain, and then labeled.
Buyers draw lots to determine the location and specific length of the soil. Generally speaking, a difference of three to five feet from the expected one is not a big deal.
Some can draw lots first, and then exchange each other.
This piece of ginseng land is better than last year's Goutangzi, and the price is also higher. It costs 240,000 yuan in total for 60 fields.
Pinggang is very good at ginseng land, and it costs more than 800 zhang per shovel. Even batches of ginseng soil plus various expenses cost about six yuan per zhang of ginseng soil.
The price of good ginseng soil is high, 11 yuan is 1 zhang, and 20,000 zhang ginseng soil is sold for 220,000 yuan.
Su Anying is busy building a house and selling ginseng soil at home.
Xu Shiyan not only has to study in the provincial capital, but also cooperates with the professors of the Agricultural University to test new functional drinks with the formula provided by Mr. Chu.
At the same time, you have to pay attention to the beverage production and order status of a participant.
Not long after Lin Qiyue returned from the provincial capital, the beverage factory received two more orders.
In May, Lin Qiyue took people to the Spring Fair again.
Many honey chips, Changbaishan red ginseng, ginseng cola, and ginseng flower cola produced by Yishenchang have been ordered out, earning nearly five million dollars in foreign exchange.
"Xiao Xu, do you think we should expand the planting area when we participate in the field?
After several years of development like this, our ginseng output seems to be insufficient. "
Lin Qiyue called Xu Shiyan and asked Xu Shiyan for his opinion on whether to expand production.
"Secretary Lin, there is no need for that for the time being. For the current orders, our annual output can guarantee the supply, no problem.
You can’t blindly expand the scale of production. If you don’t have enough raw materials in the future, you can buy them from other participating farms or participating farmers. "

chapters.title: Chapter 426: Can not expand blindly
chapters.content:
Chapter 426 Cannot expand blindly
Since the spring of this year, Yichang has responded to the call of the state, and in order to mobilize the enthusiasm of employees for production, it has also implemented a contract system.
However, it is not the same as contracting by farmers. Each family of employees of a ginseng field contracts a corresponding amount of ginseng land according to their own labor force.
Participants will provide land and production materials in a unified manner, and the contract workers are only responsible for management.
After harvest in autumn, wages will be calculated according to the contracted quota. Those who exceed the contracted quota will be rewarded according to the market price. If the contracted quota is not enough, they will be fined.
The contract quota is formulated according to the average output of ginseng land in recent years.
As far as the current situation is concerned, this quota is not high and can be completed. As long as you work hard, you can get rewards after harvest in autumn.
There is no way to do this. After all, the quality of the participating workers varies from good to bad.
Especially in the past few years, the big gang made money the same for good or bad. There were always a few people who were lazy and didn't want to put in more effort.
After contracting, there will be rewards beyond the quota. For the rewards, the big guys have to work hard, at least not be punished.
This contracting method is different from the other participants.
Several other state-run participants started the contract responsibility system as early as last year.
The adoption is to set up a family farm under the main farm, divide the annual ginseng in the main farm into small parts, and contract it to the family for field farming management.
Products are handed over to the general farm, which is accounted for by the general farm, and the family farm is responsible for its own profits and losses.
Both methods are contracted, and each has its own advantages.
One ginseng farm did not adopt the same contracting method as other ginseng farms. The main reason is that the first ginseng farm is currently not only planting ginseng, but also involves comprehensive utilization of ginseng land and deep processing of ginseng products, all of which require manpower.
If family farm contracting is adopted, it may not be regarded as unified management, but people will easily lose their minds.
The current contracting method, although the authority of the employees is not high, has an advantage, that is, a high degree of obedience, and they listen to the deployment and command of the participants.
Field management is carried out in spring, summer and autumn. After autumn and winter, most of the labor force can be concentrated in several factories to create more value.
As long as the factory gives enough wages and incentives, these workers will not develop outward.
Xu Shiyan has experienced in his previous life that, in addition to contracting the ginseng land, the participating employees also vigorously develop their own ginseng land outside.
Over time, people's hearts will disperse, which is not good for the development and growth of participants.
So when the first participant was discussing the contract, Xu Shiyan gave this suggestion, and he should try his best to gather the employees together.
All people unite and twist into one rope to make the ginseng industry bigger and stronger.
From the current point of view, industrial processing has made a good start, and as long as it develops steadily, the profits it will bring will not be low.
The number of employees participating in the factory is fixed, and the number of factories under it is gradually expanding, and more and more manpower will be needed.
In this case, if the ginseng production area is to be expanded, workers must be recruited.
But large-scale recruitment involves too many aspects.
If a participant can maintain a steady development trend, more regular employees can afford it.
But no one can predict what the future will be like.
What if Yi Shen is still like Xu Shiyan in his previous life, and will be unsustainable and yellow after two thousand years?
What to do with so many employees? By that time, having too many employees will not be an asset, but a burden.
It is better to maintain the current planting area of ​​ginseng land and purchase from other ginseng farms and ginseng households.
It can not only alleviate the shortage of raw materials, but also stimulate the local economy.
Moreover, the venue does not have to worry about wages, benefits, housing and other issues after the increase of regular employees.
Anyway, the entire county is currently expanding ginseng planting. In this case, there is no need to worry about raw materials.
Direct acquisition is the best way to save worry and effort, which is beneficial to all parties.
There are so many pharmaceutical factories in the later generations, and they don’t approve ginseng and plant ginseng themselves, they all buy them directly. Aren’t they all developing well?
When you can't take care of all aspects, you have to make a choice, and you can chew more than you can chew. This is how many years of experience.
Xu Shiyan's words finally persuaded Lin Qiyue, and Lin Qiyue thought about it for the same reason.
There are so many participants in Fusong. If the first participant really develops well, the county will have to say that if the first participant is rich, you can’t forget your roots, and you have to drag your brother units.
It is impossible to hand over the deep processing industry to outsiders, so what should we do? Wouldn't it be enough to treat the other participants as raw material production bases?
Several other participants planted sticks, and one participant was in charge of processing, um, okay, this idea is fine.
Xu Shiyan was relieved when he successfully persuaded Lin Qiyue to dispel the momentum of blind expansion.
Next, Xu Shiyan devoted himself to the research of functional drinks.
At the same time, he also wanted to ask Mr. Chu to get some prescriptions for health care products, which he planned to keep for his own company.
As for the prescription of health care products, Mr. Chu doesn't really agree with it.
In the eyes of the elderly, this is a bit of nonsense.
I have never heard of any kind of prescription that can cure the disease and strengthen the body without disease.
Everyone's physique is different, and the condition is also different. Traditional Chinese medicine pays attention to syndrome differentiation and treatment. How can there be such a thing?
Besides, the medicine is three-point poisonous. What kind of medicine should I take if I have nothing to do? If I have that time, I might as well eat and exercise.
"The Yellow Emperor's Internal Classic says that the five grains are for nourishment, the five fruits are for assistance, the five animals are for benefit, and the five vegetables are for filling.
Rational diet, balanced nutrition, no overeating, regular work and rest, and proper exercise, all these points are enough.
If you look for medicine for nothing, it's all brain problems. "Elder Chu was not polite, and directly reprimanded Xu Shiyan.
"Master, I know this too." Xu Shiyan could only smile wryly after being scolded.
Why doesn't he understand these things? But the future trend will develop in this direction.
In the next few years, the trend of domestic health care products will rise, and various health care products will emerge in an endless stream.
Those manufacturers of health care products make a lot of money.
Although there will be troughs in the future, many health products will disappear.
However, people's emphasis on health and their awareness of health care products have all increased.
As a reborn person, Xu Shiyan is not immune to the common sense, and really wants to earn some money from health care products.
Of course, unlike those people who have a mentality of making a fortune, Xu Shiyan wants to take advantage of the trend of health products to pull ginseng out of its low price.
Wait for the participating farmers to get over this breath, and then switch to medicine or cosmetics.
It's the same sentence, no matter what you have to do step by step.
Compared with medicines, health care products have a lower threshold and less difficulty, and can be put into production within a few years to reap high profits.
With this money, we can continue to invest in drug research and development and promotion. This is a progressive relationship, and we must take it step by step.
"Master, we don't do false propaganda that cures all diseases. Our health products also pay attention to the symptoms.
For example, it is aimed at the elderly and frail people, women with insufficient energy and blood, and those who use their brains too much and have severe mental exhaustion.
Anyway, it is targeted, making some products with tonic effect, so it should work, right? "
Xu Shiyan did not give up, and asked tentatively.

chapters.title: Chapter 427: street stall
chapters.content:
Chapter 427 Street stall
Elder Chu couldn't resist Xu Shiyan's request, and finally agreed to try it out.
With Elder Chu's promise, Xu Shiyan felt confident.
"Master, I won't eat at your place at noon today. In time for the weekend, I have to go shopping and buy something."
The weather is getting warmer, so it’s good to go out for a walk if you have nothing to do.
Xu Shiyan is not very interested in parks and the like.
Those places are best to be with the wife. It’s quite interesting for the two of them to walk and chat while watching Jing’er.
He is alone, what is he doing in the park? Look at other young couples who are loving and sweet? Isn't that nonsense?
The weather is getting warmer, Xu Shiyan doesn't bring much clothes, so he has to buy some clothes, shoes and socks.
I inquired with someone, and they said that there are several large markets on Guangfu Road, where clothes are sold, and they are cheap.
Men don’t care so much, as long as they can wear them, so Xu Shiyan drove straight to Guangfu Road.
At the end of Guangfu Road, there is a relatively famous place, Xiaobailou, which is the palace of Emperor Kant.
So Guangfu Road Market was very famous during the Puppet Manchukuo period.
The open-air market here is very lively. There are all kinds of goods, and the dazzling array is dizzying.
Xu Shiyan is not in a hurry, he just strolls around casually, walk around and have a look, buy something that suits his heart, and forget it if he doesn’t.
There are also a lot of snacks on the street. When you are hungry, you can find a place to sit down and eat a bowl of noodles.
Xu Shiyan was eating noodles, when he looked up occasionally, he happened to see a person passing by with a pot of Clivia in his arms.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, why did he feel that the figure was so familiar? It seems to be Wu Jinsheng, the younger brother of the fourth daughter-in-law's family?
No, Daying is so far away from the provincial capital, how could Wu Jinsheng be here?
But the figure looked more and more like it, Xu Shiyan quickly pulled the bowl into his mouth, paid the boss, and was about to catch up and take a closer look.
In the end, it was time to pay, and when I turned my head again, the man disappeared.
Xu Shiyan wandered around looking for it, but couldn't find it.
The main reason is that there are too many people here, and there is a constant flow of people coming and going. It is really too difficult to find someone in the crowd.
Xu Shiyan wandered around, but didn't see the figure just now, so he could only give up.
"Forget it, maybe I was dazzled just now, and I misread it." Xu Shiyan shook his head, comforting himself like this.
"Brother, come, take a look at these things, they are all old things."
Xu Shiyan was standing on the corner of the street, and there happened to be a young man setting up a stall there.
The young man saw Xu Shiyan standing there looking around, thinking he was going to buy something, so he greeted him.
Xu Shiyan turned his head to look at the stall, and was stunned for a moment, what are these?
Oddly shaped and black?
Many things are black with mud on them, and they can't even see their original appearance.
"Brother, what are you selling here? You can't see the true colors when you look at this dark one."
Since there was nothing else to do, Xu Shiyan started chatting with the young man.
"Brother, don't you understand this? Old things, can they not be dusted after a long time?
Oh, to tell you the truth, isn't this cleaning the house at home? Just dug out these things.
I don’t know much about them either, so my grandma kept nagging, saying they were all old things, so keep them.
I thought it was taking up space, so I thought about setting up a stall here.
Anyway, it will only be placed for a few days, and no one will pull it down.
Brother, take a look, if there is something you like, take it, it's not expensive anyway. "
The young man didn't know if what he said was true or not, but he looked quite sincere.
After thinking about it, Xu Shiyan thought that he had already bought everything he needed to buy, and there was nothing wrong with it, so he might as well just take a look.
So I stood in front of the stall, picked up everything and took a look.
They are indeed old things from the past, such as old-fashioned tin wine jugs, pharmacy scales, old-fashioned irons, locks on old-fashioned wooden boxes, old bamboo-carved pen holders, powder boxes, weights, glass lamp holders, lantern.
Anyway, there are all kinds of old and young things, some Xu Shiyan can recognize, and some can't.
Xu Shiyan looked around, but there was nothing he could see.
How to say these things, keeping them for later generations is also more commemorative, and the collection value is not high.
"Your things are really not easy to sell, I guess they might as well be sold to the buying station.
There are a lot of copper, iron, and tin, which may be worth a few dollars. "
In these years, the price of recycling various metals is not low, especially copper and tin, which are not cheap.
When Xu Shiyan was talking, his hand happened to touch a black bone that looked like a weight.
He picked it up and weighed it casually, and just wanted to say that this thing should be made of copper, it is quite heavy, and it might sell for some money.
As a result, after a closer look, it seems wrong. This is not a weight, but a seal.
Xu Shiyan was startled, if this is a seal, it might be interesting.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to show any expression, he just put down the thing casually, and went to look at other things.
There is a round ring at the end, look, it is a little smaller than that kind of door knocker, and it is slightly oval.
I don’t know what it is, but it’s black anyway, with a layer of sludge-like substance on the outside, so that the true color cannot be seen.
"What is this, do you know?"
Xu Shiyan picked up the ring and felt that it was heavy on the top. He didn't know what material it was, so he just asked casually anyway.
"I don't know, it's all kept by my grandma, she is so confused now, she doesn't know anything when she asks, so she just says she keeps it.
What can you do with these crap? "The young man shook his head and asked three questions.
"Yeah, I've been lingering with you for a long time, picking and looking at things, which is a waste of your time.
Don’t just look at it but don’t buy it, let’s do it, don’t worry about anything, I’ll pick two, even if we buddies have this destiny. "
Xu Shiyan seemingly inadvertently pulled the ring and the weight-like thing together.
"How much are these two? If it's cheap, I'll take it."
The young man glanced at it, "Come on, these two, give me eight yuan.
That thing seems to be made of copper. If I sell it to a junk collector, I think it can give me three or four dollars. "
The young man gritted his teeth and was cruel, asking for eight yuan.
To be honest, these things, except for the metal ones that can be sold as scraps, are useless at all, and they don’t want to give them for free.
That piece of copper lump was sold to the junk collector for at most two yuan, and the ring was worthless in the eyes of the young man, so it was not bad to sell it together for eight yuan.
"Eight yuan is a bit expensive, so how about this, you can give me something else.
I think this small box is pretty good, I go back and wash it and clean it up, so I can coax my daughter. "
Xu Shiyan casually picked up a small wooden box.
There is a small lock on the wooden box, which looks very delicate, so let’s keep it for my daughter.
"Come on, you can just take that box, and just give me eight yuan for these three pieces." The young man was quite happy, and he happily agreed.
Xu Shiyan took out the money, counted eight yuan and handed it to the other party, then put these three things in his pocket, turned and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 428: bubble burst
chapters.content:
Chapter 428 The bubble burst
Xu Shiyan just thought that the copper lump might be a seal, and he was a little interested in it.
The other two items were taken casually, lest the young man be suspicious.
Besides, it’s only eight yuan, whatever it is, just buy it for fun.
I bought what I needed to buy, and I finished what I needed to go shopping. It was meaningless to go shopping again, so I went to the bus stop and waited for the bus before returning to Agricultural University.
After returning, Xu Shiyan gathered up the clothes, shoes and socks he had bought, and kept the three items in his pocket without moving them.
It turned to Monday, Xu Shiyan studied a lot of majors and courses, and he was so busy studying every day that he forgot that there was still something in his pocket.
Xu Shiyan hid in the Agricultural University to study in peace, but the outside world at this time was full of blood and blood.
On June 1st, 7th, and 13th, the provincial newspaper published three commentators' articles attacking the overheated Clivia phenomenon.
On the 10th, a higher-level daily newspaper also published related articles, saying that the Clivia transaction is a false business, and that the construction of the four modernizations needs to do more practical things.
When the first edition of the report came out, there were still many people clamoring that the Clivia market would not be hit.
But after several articles in succession, most of the sane people can understand that this is the action of relevant departments to rectify the deformed Clivia market.
Public opinion sent the crazy Clivia transaction to the guillotine.
Relevant departments quickly introduced measures, and high-pressure policies followed immediately. The Clivia transaction taxed up to 60%.
The originally hot Clivia market was suddenly deserted and no one cared about it.
As a result, foreign capital quickly left the market, leaving a lot of chicken feathers. Clivia, which was originally tens of thousands or thousands of dollars, was not even worth tens of dollars.
Clivia seedlings discarded in garbage can be seen everywhere in the streets and alleys.
Then, a comprehensive review began, and many people began to have bad luck, losing their jobs, officials, and even going in for free meals.
Except for a few lucky ones who quickly evacuated after finding the first pot of gold, many people went bankrupt, and some disappeared without a sound.
"Fortunately, I listened to your suggestion and issued a death order, not allowing any unit in our county to intervene in this matter. At any rate, we have saved our county's property.
It's too hanging, this time, many places have been implicated. "Guan Enxue called Xu Shiyan and told Xu Shiyan so.
It is true that many people are unlucky, and the county next door is it.
The government paid for the construction of flower sheds and the purchase of Clivia, which cost nearly a million dollars, but all of them fell through, and the relevant responsible persons directly stepped down.
Shao Yong originally called back to warn them, but no one listened, what happened in the end?
"It's still you who has the foresight, so you withdrew early and used the money to do practical things.
All right, when you come back from summer vacation, go to the county seat, and I will treat you to a drink. "Guan Enxue said so on the phone.
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone and heaved a sigh of relief.
For more than half a year, the city has been boiling with Clivia, restless and frantic.
By this time, the dust has finally settled and everything is calm.
Flowers are not guilty at all, and there is nothing wrong with loving flowers. Those who are wrong are only those who are obsessed with money.
In fact, those people knew in their hearts that Clivia is not worth so much money.
But these people who have just smelled the smell of money, driven by the supremacy of profit, have no one to point out this lie.
Some people say that this is a demonic release of the poor people who have been impoverished for a long time, but the price is too huge.
Of course, the Clivia incident may not give people much warning.
After time passes, there will be tulips and more things like Clivia, which are hyped by capital and attract countless ordinary people to flock to them.
Finally the bubble burst, leaving a ruined place.
Xu Shiyan doesn't care what other people do. He himself will firmly remember the experience and lessons learned this time, and will use it as a warning.
Xu Shiyan thought that this turmoil had subsided and there would be no more surprises.
However, just ten days later, the administrator of the dormitory greeted him, saying that it was a call from his family, and asked him to go downstairs to answer the phone.
Xu Shiyan lives in the school. There is no telephone in the dormitory here. There is only a telephone in the administrator's downstairs in the dormitory, which can only be answered but not called.
Usually, Xu Shiyan would go out to find the post office and call home. Su Anying would not call here if there was nothing particularly important.
So when Xu Shiyan heard this, he immediately ran downstairs, "Daughter-in-law, what's the matter?" Xu Shiyan asked after answering the phone.
"The fourth child and the fourth daughter-in-law came back and said they were responsible for borrowing money from us.
The fourth brother's brother-in-law fell into Clivia, owed more than a hundred thousand, was beaten and hospitalized. "
On the phone, Su Anying's tone was not very good, it seemed to be angry.
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard this.
The fourth brother's brother-in-law, Wu Jinsheng? So, last time on Guangfu Road, the figure he saw was Wu Jinsheng?
"Grass, what is this kid doing?
The fourth child, the fourth child is also too courageous to cause trouble. "Xu Shiyan couldn't help but swear.
"Daughter-in-law, where are the fourth and fourth couple? Are you by your side? Give them the phone."
"Not here, they were scolded away by our father.
Our father scolded the fourth child well, saying that the Wu family deserved it, because they were too greedy, and they didn't know how to accept it. "
Su Anying told the story on the phone.
Xu Shide came back from the Chinese New Year, and was told by Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan that he gave up the idea of ​​throwing Clivia.
But unexpectedly, the Wu family would not listen to persuasion.
Wu Jinsheng privately contacted people who own Clivia in Daying and Hebei, and told them that he took Clivia to the provincial capital to sell, and if he sold it back, he would give him 30% of the money.
Although outsiders know that Clivia is valuable, they don't know how to sell it. Some people have never been to a county town in their life, let alone a provincial capital.
Although Wu Jinsheng is only 20 years old this year, he drove for the leader at Xianrenqiao and went out, so he has some experience.
I also asked a lot of things from Xu Shide, so I said that he came forward to sell it and got a commission from the sale, and those families agreed.
So after the beginning of spring, Wu Jinsheng brought four pots of Clivia to the provincial capital.
At that time, Clivia was very popular, and the provincial capital was full of people dumping Clivia.
Wu Jinsheng took flowers to those well-known flower markets. As soon as he faced him, he was surrounded by people, and many people bought flowers.
Wu Jinsheng was a ghost, he knew the value of Clivia was very high, so he was not in a hurry to sell it, after a long time, he finally sold it at a high price.
Wu Jinsheng took four pots of flowers to the provincial capital and sold them directly for more than 80,000 yuan.
This kid ghost, when he went back, he said he sold it for 50,000 yuan, and then took 30% of it, and he had a lot left.
If he accepts it as soon as he sees it, that's fine, but this kid is not greedy enough, so he starts to expand the scale and dump Clivia.
Draw a lot of money from parents and relatives to buy flower seeds and flower seedlings to cultivate, and the finished Clivia will be sold in the provincial capital.
If you don’t have enough money in your hand, you will owe money to others, and you will pay it back after selling it.
In the first two times, I brought less people and made money. The third time I was more courageous. I took several people to collect dozens of words, and hired a car to go to the provincial capital. As a result, just in time for the policy to come down, I lost everything.
The leader will send it later. In addition, those who read books, please go to the book circle, there is a check-in card in the upper right corner, click to get benefits, thank you

chapters.title: Chapter 429: don't borrow
chapters.content:
Chapter 429 Do not borrow
Wu Jin made money twice before his death. If he stopped at that time, he could live a good life with the money.
But he is too greedy and wants to earn a big one.
As a result, when I folded it in, not only did I lose the money I earned before, but also the money from my parents, sister, and relatives, and I owed hundreds of thousands of dollars outside.
After all, he is young and has nothing to do.
If someone else encounters this situation, they will run away without saying a word.
He ran away, leaving his parents at home. Even if he owed so much money to outsiders, what could he do to his parents?
As a result, this kid went home in despair, and was blocked by creditors asking for money. Where would he have money to give? In the end, he was beaten and seriously injured and hospitalized.
Wu Qiuyan's father was hit so hard that he suddenly fell ill and had a stroke.
However, those people are not finished yet, and the Wu family must pay back the money.
The Wu family had nowhere to go. Thinking of Xu Shiyan, they asked Xu Shide and his wife to accompany the Wu family's mother-in-law to Donggang.
I begged the Xu family to lend them money, first to treat the wounds and diseases of the Wu family father and son, and then to pay off the debts owed outside.
Xu Shide refused at first, but his mother-in-law knelt down and kowtowed, and then hanged herself.
Xu Shide was forced to have no choice but to bring his wife to Donggang. As a result, when he arrived at Xu's house, Xu Chenghou found out and scolded him and left.
"My father asked me to call you, to give you an advance notice.
If the fourth child looks for you, or calls you, don't be soft-hearted.
This matter has nothing to do with our family’s dime. If we borrow money, it’s like meat buns beat dogs and never return. "
Speaking of this, Su Anying was also furious. My uncle is just a fool. Isn't it clear that he came back to trick his brother?
"Okay, I understand, don't worry, I won't agree."
He is not stupid, so he would not agree to borrow money. If the fourth child wants to save face, he can't call him.
Of course, with the temperament of the fourth child who loves his wife, I am afraid that the daughter-in-law can't help being soft-hearted, and finally she really asks the third brother for help.
Su Anying called mainly to talk about this matter, and nothing else happened at home recently.
Furthermore, Xu Shiyan will be able to go home on vacation soon, and long-distance calls are quite expensive. Su Anying only asked Xu Shiyan to pay more attention, and then hung up the phone.
"Master, thank you, some troubles at home have delayed me for so long."
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone, and nodded embarrassedly at the administrator.
"It's okay, who hasn't had a bad time?
You all brought your work to study, and you are already busy, so you can understand. "
The administrator's attitude was quite good, and he waved his hand towards Xu Shiyan with a smile.
Xu Shiyan went upstairs to his dormitory, went straight to the bed, and sighed.
When other people in the dormitory saw this, they came over to join in the fun.
"What's the matter? My daughter-in-law is going to run away with someone? Seeing that you are worried, you still sigh.
The sky is falling? The sky is falling and there are tall ones holding it up.
Look at Brother Shao, what is going on in their county, can't they just live on? "
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes, couldn't help but laughed again, "Your wife is just going to run away with someone. You can't say anything good every day."
Yes, what is he worrying about?
It wasn't him who owed money, it wasn't him who was beaten and hospitalized, and it wasn't his father who had a stroke. What was he worried about?
The fourth child? The fourth child deserves it.
The Wu family has such a big movement, and the fourth child doesn't know at all? As long as he tried to persuade him, maybe Wu Jinsheng would stop in time.
Have the money earned from the previous two rounds, do something serious, and live a carefree life, how nice?
Who knows if the fourth child is unwilling and secretly supports the brother-in-law? Therefore, the fourth child deserves what he deserves, and is not worthy of sympathy at all.
"Let's go, go to the cafeteria to eat.
Hurry up and eat, I have to go to the library to look up information later. Are you going to the library tonight? "
Xu Shiyan raised his hand and looked at his watch. It was getting late and it was time to eat.
Eating is the biggest thing in the world, and no one can influence him to eat.
Unexpectedly, just after dinner, before going to the library, the administrator said that someone called Xu Shiyan just now.
Knowing that Xu Shiyan was out for dinner, they said they would call back later.
Xu Shiyan sighed, without even thinking about it, it must be the fourth child.
This bastard, he puts the most importance on the affairs of his wife's family all day long. This is even cheating his own brother.
While talking, the phone rang again, the administrator answered it, said hello, and said he was looking for Xu Shiyan.
"Then, I'm looking for you." The administrator handed the phone to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan answered the phone without even asking, just talking.
"Fourth, you don't need to say anything, there is no way to borrow money.
Whoever beats Wu Jinsheng, you should call the police and arrest him. As for the money Wu Jinsheng owes to others, that is his own business.
It has nothing to do with you, and it has nothing to do with me. He did it himself.
Fourth, you better not be confused, this is not your business.
Don’t let yourself fall into it and you can’t pull it out, don’t say we don’t care about brotherhood when the time comes.
You remember, you have parents and children, they are the most important, your father-in-law and mother-in-law are no better than your own parents. "
Xu Shiyan didn't even give Xu Shide a chance to refute, so he talked a lot.
On the other end of the phone, Xu Shide just said two words, third brother, Xu Shiyan hung up the phone directly.
Not willing to listen to what the fourth child said, and got angry when he heard it.
"Go, go back and pack up, take notes, and go to the library."
The life and death of others has nothing to do with him, the most important thing is to hurry up and study.
The final exam is coming soon, he has to study hard, the opportunity to study is not easy to come by, so he can't waste time on those useless things.
On the other side of the phone, Xu Shide looked at the phone in his hand and listened to the beeping busy tone, with a dazed expression on his face.
"How is it? What did the third brother say? Does he agree to borrow money?" Beside, Wu Qiuyan asked eagerly.
"Borrow what? I just said don't make this call, it's useless, the third brother can't borrow it at all.
You have to let me call. I didn't even say a word when I called, and the third brother gave me a big meal.
Just you, clean things up every day, root locks and clean Clivia, what are you mixing with?
Now it’s all right, even our family’s money is in it, and you still borrow money from outside, how do you pay it back now? What do you pay back?
Do you still have to do away with my work? "Xu Shide rarely lost his temper with his daughter-in-law.
Since he learned of the accident, Xu Shide has been holding back his anger. Today he was scolded by his father and almost hit him, and now he was beaten by his brother.
No matter how much Xu Shide loves his wife on weekdays, he can't stand this, so why not get angry?
"What are you calling me? How did I know it would happen?
The third brother and the third sister-in-law have made money, and Gensuo has also made money the first two times, so I am also doing it for our family, right?
The two children are so hungry for TV that they have to fight with me all day long, wanting to buy a TV.
Where does our family get the money to buy a TV? Pointing to your salary, when can you afford it?
Let the third brother take us to earn money, but the third brother is not happy, so I will go to the head office of my own brother, right? Who knew that something bad would happen this time? "
Wu Qiuyan stood there, wiping away tears.
This the leader Su Nian's reward and update, thank you very much for your support.

chapters.title: Chapter 430: summer vacation home
chapters.content:
Chapter 430 Going Home During Summer Vacation
Xu Shiyan didn't care about the life and death of the Wu family at all, nor did he care about what happened to Xu Shide and his wife.
The only thing to do now is to hurry up and review.
On July 18th, the school started the final exam. After the exam, everyone packed their luggage, bought tickets and walked back.
Fortunately, there are few people going to college this year, and these universities in the provincial capital are not gathered together for holidays, so the return bus is okay and not crowded.
On the afternoon of July 24th, when the train arrived at Songjianghe Station, Xu Shiyan got off the train and got on a donkey cart, all the way back to Donggang.
As soon as I entered the gate of my parents, I heard the dogs start to choke. This is the sound that dogs will make when they see someone close to them.
Sure enough, I saw Xiao Huang, Er Hei and other dogs all wagging their tails and raising their front legs, wishing to throw themselves on Xu Shiyan and lick him.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to put down the things in his hands first, walked over to pet the dog's head, and scratched the dog's chin.
The dogs were so happy, they squinted their eyes and enjoyed it.
"Dad? It's Dad who's back. Grandpa, grandma, it's Dad who's back."
There was movement from the dog outside, Xu Haiyuan came out to check, and saw that it was his father who came back, but Xu Haiyuan was so happy that he shouted loudly.
Xu Jinping in the room ran out when she heard this.
After seeing her father in the yard, the little girl ran towards her father with a look of surprise.
"Daddy is back, oh, Daddy is back. Hugs, Daddy."
No matter how smart and sensible she is, she is only a seven-year-old girl. She hasn't seen her father for several months, so it's normal to be coquettish and want to hug her.
Xu Shiyan bent down and picked up his daughter, "Oh, our Pingping has sunk again, has she grown in size too?
Well, I think it has grown, and it has grown into a big girl. "Xu Shiyan deliberately teased his daughter.
With Xu Jinping's shrewdness, how could he not know that Dad was teasing her on purpose?
But this time, she didn't expose her face very much, she just pursed her lips and kept having fun.
"Huh? Where are your brother and sister? Why didn't you see them?"
Xu Shiyan put down his daughter, picked up the big and small packages on the ground, walked into the house with his daughter and son, and asked casually.
The two younger ones must not be at home, or else they should have run out.
"Oh, my mother led them to go to dimethoate.
The mill below has a whole machine, which can pop dimethoate, take the grain by yourself, spend a little processing fee, and pop as much as you want. "
Xu Haiyuan helped carry a lighter bag and explained.
Bran dimethoate, also called rice crackers in some places, is generally a puffed food made of rice.
Everyone manages this production process, which is called dimethoate.
The rice is white when it pops, and the big **** and small **** are yellow when they pop.
When the rice is put into the machine, a little saccharin is added to it, and the dimethoate that pops out has a sweet taste and different shapes.
It can be wrapped into a ball, or it can be wrapped one by one, with a hook bent at one end. Many children call this kind of stick.
In this era, the fragrant and sweet dimethoate is a very rare snack for children.
In the past, it was occasionally sold in the Songjianghe market. No matter who met, bought a walking stick with three or five sticks, or bought a ball, the children rushed to eat it up quickly.
This time, Donggang has a machine. As long as there is a processing fee, it can explode a pile of bran dimethoate. Many people in Donggang use grain to explode.
Su Anying happened to have nothing to do today, so she wanted to give the children something to eat as snacks.
Originally, Su Anying wanted to go by herself, just go and go back quickly.
As a result, the two younger ones saw it, and they had to follow. There was no choice but to lead.
"Oh, dimethoate, that's delicious. I didn't expect that there is a machine in Donggang, it's very good.
If you are willing to eat, we can often explode in the future. "
The processing fee for that thing is not much, a catty of grain can pop a big ball, and the four children in the family can feed them for two days.
Coax the children to be happy, you can have this.
While speaking, the father and son entered the east room.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan are both at home. Zhou Guilan is unpacking clothes on the kang. Looking at it, it should be the padded jacket and trousers that Xu Haiyuan and the others used when they were young.
I guess I want to take advantage of the good weather outside in summer to unpack and wash the cotton clothes, and then make them in advance, so as to save myself from rushing to wash and make them when the weather is cold.
"Dad, Mom, I'm back."
Xu Shiyan put the things in his hand aside, and greeted his parents with a smile.
"Well, it's good to come back, the journey is safe, right?"
Xu Chenghou was also very happy to see his son come back, so he knocked the pipe and pot aside and talked to his son.
"It's pretty good, it's been much more stable recently, and there are no disturbing people in the car."
In fact, there are still a lot of petty thefts in the car, which cannot be eliminated. Xu Shiyan just doesn't want his parents to worry.
"Father, is there anything going on at home? I couldn't make it back for your birthday. Well, have my elder brother and the others come back?"
What Xu Shiyan wants to ask the most is, how many of these brothers in the family exploded.
At the beginning, he said that to his brothers and persuaded him earnestly, but there was still something wrong with the fourth child.
Xu Shiyan was worried that if something happened to the boss and the fifth, his parents would not know how to get angry.
"Well, they are all back." Can Xu Chenghou not understand Xu Shiyan's meaning? So nodded.
"On the twenty-eighth day, the eldest brother and the fifth child came back with their wives and children, and the fourth child came back by himself.
It’s okay, the boss and the fifth family are fine, so you don’t have to worry about it.
The boss was frightened and timid in those years.
Old Fifth, you don’t know him yet? It's smarter than a monkey when it's stained with fur. You've persuaded him so much, how can he fall in it foolishly?
It's just the fourth child's bastard, who can't control his wife's natal family, and makes Lao Wu's family a burden. "
Bringing these things up, Xu Chenghou became angry.
"Then, how did the old Sizhang's matter be resolved in the end?"
Xu Shiyan breathed a sigh of relief when he heard that the eldest brother and the fifth child were fine.
If the brothers were tornado one after another, how anxious would the parents be?
If that's the case, three of the five brothers have accidents, it is estimated that this family will not be able to survive.
