"How can it be solved? The fourth child said that the trick you gave is to call the police and arrest the people, arrest all the beating people, and then manage the compensation for medical expenses and so on.
I heard that, the money owed by Wu Jinsheng, apart from his own parents and relatives, the rest was not paid by Clivia who was credited by him.
Also, the few families who helped sell Clivia before were all greedy and were fooled by Wu Jinsheng and put money in again.
So this time, the fight will end with the dog biting the **** bubble empty joy.
The others are that Clivia is gone, and the money is gone. The Wu family even invested their own money, and one was seriously injured and the other had a stroke. "
When Xu Chenghou said this, he couldn't help but sigh.
This is the result of greed. They don't know how to accept what they see, and they all want to earn a big one.
This is down, the bamboo basket is empty, and nothing is fished.
"So, you guys ran back quickly at that time, it was really right.
As long as any of you have other thoughts, it is estimated that we will be the ones who have lost everything at this moment. "
Zhou Guilan, who was unpacking her clothes, let out a long sigh.

chapters.title: Chapter 431: Stationery
chapters.content:
Chapter 431 Stationery
Wu Jinsheng's side is probably even.
The Wu family will not pursue the beating and hospitalization, and the money owed outside will not be repaid.
It’s just that Wu Jinsheng was injured and hospitalized, and the old man of the Wu family had a stroke. I don’t know where the money came from.
There are also those relatives of the Wu family who want to follow the glory, but now they don’t take advantage of it, and all their own money is invested in it. I don’t know how the Wu family is arguing with those people.
"Then, what's wrong with the fourth daughter-in-law? Didn't it mean that she borrowed money from outside?"
Xu Shiyan was a little worried, if Wu Qiuyan borrowed a lot of money outside, would the fourth child make any mistakes?
After all, the fourth child works in the financial office. If he embezzles public money to pay for the famine, he may even lose his job.
"The fourth daughter-in-law didn't borrow too much outside, so she borrowed 500 yuan.
The fourth child works alone, and the salary is not too high. It is not counted to support a family of four, and he has to supplement the husband’s family. How many can be left?
Even the savings at home and borrowing from outside, a total of 800 yuan was given to Wu Jinsheng. "
In this day and age, most people don’t have much money to spare, and those who have money will not easily borrow from others.
Wu Qiuyan was able to lend five hundred yuan, which was considered quite capable.
But when Xu Chenghou mentioned this matter, he became very angry. The fourth daughter-in-law is too courageous to borrow so much money from outside.
"Don't worry about them, the fourth daughter-in-law can find a way to repay it if she borrows it, and it's her business if she doesn't." Xu Cheng snorted thickly.
"Since ancient times, the father's debt has been repaid by the son. I have never heard of the son's debt being paid by the father. Anyway, if you want to expect me to repay his debt, there is no way."
Xu Shiyan curled his lips and looked towards Zhou Guilan.
My mother is so soft-hearted, she probably slipped money to the fourth child secretly.
Alas, this old couple is not worried at all, and they are full of moths.
"Mom, didn't you say to ask the fourth child to send the two children over?
The Wu family is probably very busy, so the fourth daughter-in-law has to go back to her mother's house to take care of her? What's wrong with those two kids? "
Xu Haiyang is eight years old this year. His birthday is enough. He should be able to go to elementary school in autumn, but Xu Jingyi is still young.
There is no Yuhong class at the other end. Wu Qiuyan is busy, afraid that she will not be able to take care of the children.
"What to give? I used to look down on your mother and me, and the children never left us to care.
I'm too busy now, do you know how to send it here? in spite of.
The fourth daughter-in-law doesn't have a job, and she takes care of her own children. Who cares to help her? "
Xu Chenghou, a stubborn old man, has a stubborn temper again, and he also deliberately wants to punish Xu Shide.
Anyway, I don’t care about anything, I do it on my own, and I find a way to do it myself.
Well, since the old man said so, Xu Shiyan didn't bother to care about it.
At this time, Su Anying led the two young ones in from the outside.
The two little babies each held a walking stick in their hands, and Su Anying took two bundles. It seemed that there were nearly twenty sticks.
As soon as the three mothers entered the room, they saw Xu Shiyan, and the two younger ones immediately widened their eyes, "Father."
Now, I don't care about the dimethoate in my hand, and I just rush over to let my father hold it.
Xu Shiyan picked up the two babies and put them on his lap, one in each hand.
"Look you two are hot and sweaty. Are you good at home? Do you listen to your mother? Do you miss your father?"
It's late July, the weather is hot, and it's one or two o'clock, and the two children have to go out with them. Isn't that sweaty?
"Huihui is good, my brother is not." Xu Jinhui glanced at Xu Haiqing who was opposite, and the little girl decided to sue. "Brother steals popsicles."
"Huh?" Xu Shiyan didn't react for a while.
"Dad, my mother went to the popsicle factory to buy some popsicles and put them in the refrigerator.
It was agreed to have one a day, but Xu Haiqing always secretly opened the refrigerator to get popsicles, and when we wanted to eat, there were no more popsicles. "
On the other end, Xu Haiyuan, who was wandering around a kraft paper bag brought back by his father, wanted to open it but didn't dare, took the opportunity to file a complaint.
Oh, Xu Shiyan remembered, he has a refrigerator at home.
Cooperating with my youngest son who is a foodie, the problem of gluttony has been committed again, and he always steals popsicles.
"Hey, every day, let's see what has happened to your brothers and sisters? They are all here to sue you."
Xu Shiyan can't laugh or cry, eat more and take more, little brat.
In hot weather, it’s okay to hold the child for a while, but it’s actually uncomfortable for both adults and children after a long time.
So Xu Shiyan put the two babies down and asked them to eat together.
"Mom, um, let me use the scissors. Look at those two. I'm so anxious that I want to read a book."
Inside the kraft paper bag, there are naturally books for children.
The two children also knew what was inside, but their father didn't speak, so they didn't dare to move.
I can only squat in front of it and watch it eagerly, waiting for my father to open it.
Xu Shiyan stepped forward with scissors, cut off the rope outside the kraft paper, unpacked it, and revealed the book inside.
In the past two years, Xinhua Bookstore has a much richer variety of books than before.
Besides, Xu Shiyan has also improved compared to before, so he picked a lot of good-looking books this time.
"Children's Literature", "365 Night Stories", "The King of Stories", "Grimm's Fairy Tales", etc., even Xu Shiyan got two issues of "The King of Fairy Tales", which was launched in May this year.
"Wow, a lot of books." Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping looked at the books in front of them, exclaimed, and they were so happy that they didn't know what to do.
"Dad, can we read two books?" Xu Jinping picked out two books, looked at her father expectantly, and asked.
"Let's see, choose which one you like." The book is bought for children to read, so why not let it?
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping carefully moved the books to the small desks, and then they took the books and flipped through them.
The two older ones have presents, so the two younger ones can't be left behind either. Xu Shiyan pulled a back pocket and dumped all the things inside.
"Huihui's doll, Haiqing's car."
Xu Shiyan gave the toy to the two younger ones, and then rummaged through to find three pencil cases.
The stationery case this time is beautiful. It is the kind of plastic with magnets on it and a pencil sharpener.
Xu Jinping's is pink, and Xu Haiyuan and Yang Haoyu's are blue, with cartoon patterns on them, exquisite and unique.
It is said that it is new, and Xu Shiyan does not know whether it is true or not. Anyway, he saw it and thought it looked good, so he bought it for all three children.
"Yuanyuan, Pingping, look at the pencil case and adhesive tape that Dad bought for you."
The adhesive plaster that Xu Shiyan mentioned was the kind of rubber with bright colors, various shapes, and fragrance.
When he went to buy a pencil case, the salesperson recommended it, saying that it was a particularly good and new product.
Xu Shiyan thought it was very delicate, and thought his daughter would like it, so he bought it.
In addition to these, Xu Shiyan also bought two boxes of crayons, two pens, two brushes, and some odds and ends.
The crayons are thick six-sided, not as thin as those sold in local stores.
Xu Jinping loves to paint and paint, so she happened to see it, so she simply bought two more boxes to make her daughter happy.
The fountain pen and writing brush were bought for Xu Haiyuan. When school starts again in autumn, Xu Haiyuan will be in the third grade.
After the third grade, students should start using pens and calligraphy lessons.
Hero brand pens are of good quality and durable.
The writing brush is only purple. That kid Xu Haiyuan likes calligraphy very much, so I bought two better brushes for him to use.

chapters.title: Chapter 432: bracelet
chapters.content:
Chapter 432 Bracelet
Brother and sister Xu Haiyuan were flipping through the books, reading with gusto, Xu Shiyan called them, and they were still a bit reluctant to part with the books in their hands.
As a result, when they turned around and saw those things on the kang, the two children's eyes widened instantly, and they rushed over with a whoosh.
"Dad, are these for us?"
Even Xu Haiyuan couldn't hold back, his big eyes were full of surprise and excitement.
"Well, there are three pencil cases, including Xiaoyu's.
Crayons for your sister, pens and brushes for you, and these adhesive plasters, they should be called this.
If you two like it, share it, and leave two yuan for Xiaoyu.
There are also these notebooks, drawing paper, rice paper, etc., and I put them away by myself.
I guess you will be able to use it after you are in the third grade. "
Xu Shiyan gave all these stationery to his son and asked him to watch the distribution.
Xu Haiyuan looked at those things, and liked all of them.
So I hurried to get my schoolbag, and put everything in the schoolbag.
The two little ones in the province might break something while people are not paying attention later.
Xu Shiyan looked at the schoolbag and slapped his forehead.
"Yes, yes, I forgot to buy a schoolbag, look at this memory, Pingping is going to elementary school in autumn.
Wait until I go back to the provincial capital to buy it, and then send it back to you. "
The schoolbag is not in the same place as the paper and pen. Xu Shiyan was so busy picking out stationery that he forgot that his daughter didn't have a schoolbag for school.
"Oh, don't buy it, I'll just make one for you.
You have bought a lot of things here. Whose child is going to school, there are such old pens, erasers, and that stationery box. I have never seen such a beautiful one.
If this is going to school, what if a child looks at it and steals it? "
When Su Anying heard this, she quickly stopped, these would cost a lot of money, a child studying, how can it be so paved?
Those who know say that the couple value their children’s reading, but those who don’t know have to say that they have money to burn, and it’s a shame to buy so many things for their children?
"No, our children are good housekeepers, can they still lose their things?"
This is not Xu Shiyan's bragging. The two older ones in his family are absolutely strict about things.
Whatever you bring to school by yourself, you must find everything by the time school is over, and it won’t do if you leave anything behind.
Unlike Huang Shuqing and others, who forget about things all day long, and don’t know how to learn, the pencil and eraser will be lost in three to five days.
Su Anying couldn't help laughing when she heard this.
The two children in his family don't know who to follow. They are really good housekeepers, and they can't lose anything.
The couple were talking when they suddenly heard the youngest son cry.
The two hurriedly turned their heads, only to see the youngest son sitting in front of Xu Shiyan's pocket, stroking his right hand and crying.
"What's the matter?" Xu Shiyan hurriedly crawled to his son and asked.
Then Xu Haiqing cried miserably, crying like he was bitten by something, how could he answer his father's words? Just cry there.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly pulled the bag over and dumped it out. As a result, a few dark things fell out of the bag.
"What the **** is that? Why are you so shabby?"
Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan, and Su Anying were all anxious about the child, and they were all looking this way.
Zhou Guilan was the first to frown when she saw a few things that had buried Gutai falling out of her pocket.
"Oh, I remembered, that was something I bought for eight yuan at a stall in the provincial capital.
Didn’t think it was a good thing, so I threw it in my pocket and didn’t take it out. "
When Xu Shiyan saw the item, he remembered that he bought it from a street stall on Guangfu Road. He didn't take it out when he brought it back to school, and just put it in his pocket.
It is estimated that Xu Haiqing just wanted to look through the bag for something delicious, and he didn't know if he dropped it or touched it, so he cried.
Three things, among them the wooden box, arrived in front of Xu Jinping and Xu Haiyuan.
The seal-like thing rolled to Xu Chenghou's feet, and the ring rolled to Zhou Guilan.
Zhou Guilan reached out to pick up the ring and glanced at it.
"Oh my God, you said that you too, you buy everything, this thing is so ugly that you can't see its true colors. What is this?"
Zhou Guilan frowned, looking disgusted.
"I don't know, I mainly sell the copper bumps, and these two are picked up at random.
The young man set up a stall to sell some old objects, and I just took a fancy to that copper lump, thinking it looked like a seal.
He asked for eight yuan, and I couldn't tell him, so I paid these two and came back. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, he didn't know what the ring was. "Could it be the door knocker or something?"
Zhou Guilan shook her head, "No, this is definitely not a door knocker.
The door knockers are all iron, rusty, and scarred and not smooth. I looked at it, like a bracelet. "
Zhou Guilan measured her own wrist while talking, huh? It really looks like a bracelet.
"Hey, Yingzi, hurry up, go get a basin of water, get a brush, I'll try it. This thing is not made of iron or copper, but jade."
The Zhou family had a good time back then, and Zhou Guilan had seen good things.
At this time, she suddenly remembered that when she was a child, she had a pair of jade bracelets at home. She was curious and played with them specially, and it felt a bit similar to this one.
As soon as Su Anying heard this, she immediately fetched water and brought a shoe brush.
Zhou Guilan put the ring in the water and soaked it for a while, then carefully brushed off the layer of sludge on the outside with a brush.
After the dirty layer of sludge on the outside was brushed off, the emerald green essence inside was revealed. "Yo, it really is jade."
Zhou Guilan glanced at it, and it was different from what she saw when she was a child. This one was obviously greener, as people said, it was like a green puddle of water.
"Grandma, that's not jade, it's emerald."
Xu Haiyuan was poking around the small wooden box with his younger sister. He shook the box several times and frowned, feeling that there was something inside.
Hearing grandma say it was jade, Xu Haiyuan hurriedly corrected it.
"Little kid, you still know about jadeite."
Xu Shiyan glanced at his son, this brat knows everything, even jadeite?
As a father, he doesn't even understand what emeralds are. Can a kid understand?
"Oh, don't believe me." Xu Haiyuan sighed and glanced at grandma.
"Grandma, just wash the bracelet and put it away, don't wear it, it's a pity if it breaks."
After speaking, Xu Haiyuan continued to shake the wooden box in his hand.
"Brother, do you think there is something in it? I didn't feel right just now."
Xu Jinping looked at her brother shaking the box, and asked.
"Well, I feel that there is something inside, but I can't guess what, it feels like it's wrapped with something."
Xu Haiyuan wrinkled his face, deeply puzzled.
This box is obviously much heavier than pure wood, and shaking the box will feel different inside, which is quite strange.
"Dad, you can get this lock off, I want to see what's inside." Xu Haiyuan handed the box to Xu Shiyan.
The ring at the end was scrubbed and it turned out to be a bracelet, and it looked like a rather unusual bracelet.
Xu Shiyan also got excited now, and quickly took the wooden box over, and shook it hard twice, and it really didn't feel right.
"Wait, I'm looking for something."

chapters.title: Chapter 433: put it up
chapters.content:
Chapter 433 Put it up
The box is actually not big, just like Xu Shiyan's slap, and the small lock is very delicate.
Ordinarily speaking, with just this lock, Xu Shiyan can squeeze it off with a little effort.
But the bracelet reminded him just now, what if this box is also a good thing?
Others don't understand, Xu Shiyan had to live again, and he had watched a lot of Jianbao programs in his previous life.
The box still has a lock and it looks like it is quite old. Although I can’t tell what kind of wood it is, what if it is worth money?
It's easy for him to squeeze it down, it's a disaster.
So, Xu Shiyan went to find a wire, bent it, and tried it back and forth in the lock.
Hey? I don't know which one got it right, but with a click, the little lock was really pushed open.
Xu Shiyan took off the small lock and opened the box.
At this moment, Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan, and Su Anying all looked into the box.
Inside the box is a pile of red silk.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand, and took out the silk. His hand was heavy, and there was something wrapped inside.
Carefully unwrapping the red silk layer by layer, there are several pieces of yellow silk wrapped inside.
"What kind of treasure is this? It's so mysterious, layer after layer." Xu Shiyan complained while unrolling the silk.
There are three pieces of yellow silk in total, and it seems that each piece is wrapped with something.
Open one of them, and there are two buttons inside, the size of a thumb, with a gold-yellow button plate, and the top is inlaid with red, blue, and transparent ones, all of which sparkle and dazzle the eyes.
"This one is gold, right?
It seems that only gold can be so yellow and so bright. After a long time, copper will become dark even if it is wrapped well. "
Xu Chenghou stared at the pair of buttons, feeling that they were unusual and seemed to be quite valuable.
If it’s really gold, then those shiny things on it are probably all kinds of gemstones.
"Quickly, open the other ones and have a look. Your eight yuan is worth it." Xu Chenghou didn't forget to tease his son.
Xu Shiyan quickly opened another silk bag, which looked like a piece of jade.
This color is greener than that of the bracelet, a very strong green, which seems to be blue.
Look towards the sun, the light can pass through, the green one is shining.
"This stuff, can't it be emerald too?"
Xu Shiyan didn't know much about these things, he thought it was impossible, and the young man didn't look like he came from a wealthy family.
Besides, if it is such a precious thing, how could it be sold casually?
"Dad, put that up quickly, be careful, don't drop it."
Xu Shiyan thought it didn't matter, but Xu Haiyuan on the other side looked nervous, and quickly asked Xu Shiyan to wrap the jade pendant and put it away.
"Tch, brat, I don't know why you are so nervous.
The things I found from street stalls, can they still be real? Maybe it's glass, so why be so nervous? "
Although Xu Shiyan said so, his subordinates were very careful, wrapped the jade pendant and put it aside.
Now, everyone is curious about what is inside the last piece of silk bag.
Xu Shiyan directly picked up the last piece, this silk bag is bigger.
Opened the yellow silk and found that there was a layer of oil paper inside, and then opened the oil paper, there was actually a layer of tissue paper inside.
"What's hidden here? It's layer by layer, covering so many layers?"
Xu Shiyan shook his head, opened the last layer of tissue paper, and found a bead inside.
"What is this? Why does it look like Huang Shuqing and the others playing around?"
Xu Shiyan said yo, but it is actually a glass ball, which is used by children to play with.
Xu Shiyan looked at the bead, and felt that it was similar to a slightly larger yoyo, with a diameter of more than two centimeters and less than three centimeters.
It's just that the color of this bead is light green and slightly blue, and the surface is very smooth and translucent. What is this thing?
"Son, can you recognize it this time?" Xu Shiyan deliberately angered Xu Haiyuan and asked him what it was.
Xu Haiyuan frowned, carefully took the beads in Xu Shiyan's hand, and looked at them carefully.
"Dad, put this away, you can save it to see at night."
"Look at it at night, I'm too busy at night, should I watch it?"
Xu Shiyan didn't take it seriously, and wrapped the beads again.
Together with the two items just now, they were all put back into the box and put on the lock, but this time it was not locked.
"Come on, don't worry about the stuff, you can put it away later, just keep it and don't throw it away." Xu Shiyan handed the box to Su Anying.
In front of the children, Xu Shiyan couldn't say anything.
Although he felt in his heart that these few things were not simple, they couldn't show it on the surface.
Otherwise, what if the children are not strict with their mouths and go out to talk nonsense?
"There is also this thing, I don't know what it is.
Old lady, why don't you take a brush and try it? Let's see what's inside, why do I feel heavier than copper? "
Xu Chenghou handed the pimple to Zhou Guilan again, asking her to brush it for a look.
Zhou Guilan didn't care, she reached out to take it, but when she took it, it was heavy, not too big, very heavy.
"It doesn't seem to be copper, such a little thing, it's quite old, it's definitely not copper."
Zhou Guilan took it, brushed it with a brush in the basin a few times, and then stopped.
"Third brother, find something to wrap it up, turn around and hide it and don't move."
There is a corner exposed under the pimple. It is golden in color, and it is not copper at first glance.
Zhou Guilan is also a bit knowledgeable, so she immediately stopped and didn't dare to swipe anymore, and asked Xu Shiyan to put it away.
Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan also saw the exposed corner, and both father and son were surprised.
"Put it up, put it up. Third child, go back and hide this thing well, and don't take it out in the future, remember."
Xu Chenghou seemed a little excited, and asked Xu Shiyan eagerly.
"Yes, I see." Xu Shiyan immediately wrapped the pimple and ring with a red cloth, and put them back in his back pocket.
"Father, I didn't think about anything at the time, I just picked it at random."
Xu Shiyan sat there, a little bit unable to recover.
He really didn't think about anything at the time, but the young man took the initiative to talk to him, and he rummaged through other stalls for a long time. He was really embarrassed, and only bought three items for eight yuan.
Xu Chenghou filled a bag of cigarettes and smoked there.
“I heard people say that when the Manchukuo fell, some people went in to grab things.
It seems that people from Maozi later collected tickets, and anyone can enter as long as the money is paid.
The things you take out, you can take them away with a little money. "
"Well, I seem to have heard of this too." Xu Shiyan has heard more than this.
It is said that Emperor Kant fled to Linjiang Dalizi, and a farm family took him in, and he gave a lot of things to that family.
A few years ago when there was a lot of trouble, that family was almost beaten to death, and they gritted their teeth and refused to speak.
In her previous life, Xu Shiyan's second daughter was looking for someone from Linjiang.
I heard from him that many houses and stores in Linjiang are bought by that family.
The child of that family also said that when he was a child, he saw gold bars at home, which looked like chopsticks.
Dear friends, check in the upper right corner of the book circle, comment and like more, after unlocking the level of the book circle, there are rewards such as starting point coins that can be claimed, okay?

chapters.title: Chapter 434: no way
chapters.content:
Chapter 434 No way
"Don't care if it's true or not, put those away properly, keep them, and save them for future generations."
Xu Chenghou took a few more puffs of cigarette before speaking.
"In the future, don't even think about going out of your way, no matter how lucky you are, there will be time when you run out.
Don’t let people cheat you if you don’t find something.
Just remember this, let’s live a good life, better than anything else. "The old man was worried and told his son.
"Yeah, Dad, I know." Xu Shiyan nodded, he never thought about playing these things.
Maybe others are reborn, and they all want to speculate in stocks, buy antiques, buy real estate and so on.
To be honest, except for the house, Xu Shiyan really didn't think about anything else.
He knows how much he has, and knows that his ability is not enough. He also knows that whether it is stocks or antiques, it is a big pit.
If he really fell in, let alone two million in his hand, even if there were more than two million, he would still be cheated for nothing.
In this life, he will honestly grow some sticks, open a processing factory, and order some deep-processed ginseng products. This will be fine, but he dare not think too much.
There are so many **** examples, he dare not.
Xu Chenghou is still at ease with Xu Shiyan. Before that Clivia, the business of several million, if he said he would stop it, he would stop it.
It is impossible for ordinary people to do it.
Maybe others think this is a bit cowardly, but Xu Chenghou thinks so too if it is put aside.
But after a lot of experience, I found that this personality is still good. At least it is safe and does not take risks, and the chance of major accidents is small.
The father and the two are playing charades here, and Zhou Guilan's mother-in-law and daughter-in-law saw it over there, so let's hurry to prepare food.
"Yingzi, go to the market to see if you can still buy meat. If there is, buy a piece and come back. Let's make dumplings and eat."
My son has been studying outside for several months, so the food in the university cafeteria is not as good as at home.
Zhou Guilan felt sorry for her son, so she wanted to cook something delicious to make up for her son.
"I have some minced meat in my refrigerator, but I just don't know if it can be opened slowly at this time.
Otherwise, I’ll take it out when I get home and put it on first.
If there is no meat in the market, we will use frozen meat, and if there is meat, we will use fresh meat, and put the frozen meat away. "
Su Anying agreed and went out immediately.
Here, Zhou Guilan also hurried to the vegetable garden to find some vegetables that can make dumplings.
This spring, Xu Chenghou had nothing to do, so he used the flower shed at the farm to raise seedlings, specially cultivating eggplants, peppers, tomatoes, cucumbers and other vegetable seedlings.
It’s warm in the flower shed. When the earth warms up and you can grow vegetables, the vegetable seedlings are already tall, and the cucumbers are covered with flowers.
The vegetable garden is covered with plastic film, the temperature is high, and the vegetable seedlings grow well after planting.
So this season, other people's eggplants, peppers, and tomatoes are still half-grown, but Xu's is ready to eat.
Pick off a few bell peppers, which are called big peppers by the locals, and chop some celery, and make dumplings filled with celery and peppers today.
Zhou Guilan was picking vegetables in the vegetable garden, and Xu Shiyan came to the vegetable garden as an excuse to go to the toilet.
"Mom, is there anything I can do for you?"
In the room just now, Xu Shiyan looked at his mother's hesitation to speak, and knew that his mother had something to say, but it was hard to say it in front of Xu Chenghou.
So now he came out and asked, which saved a long time, and the old lady couldn't think of what to say.
"Oh, no need, just chop some celery, so don't touch your hands, make your hands muddy."
Zhou Guilan hurriedly waved her hands to prevent Xu Shiyan from working.
"Mom, did you want to tell me something just now?" Xu Shiyan squatted on the path in the middle of the vegetable garden and asked casually.
Zhou Guilan stopped chopping celery, thought for a while, "Oh, yes, I wanted to tell you.
Well, you know a lot of people, can you think of a way to transfer the fourth child away from the camp?
No matter where he goes, let him leave that place. "Zhou Guilan said, sighing.
"We can't let the old Wu's family drag down the fourth child like this anymore, and the two children of the fourth family.
If this goes on like this, I'm afraid Haiyang and Jingyi will have to be led astray by the old Wu family.
I originally said that I wanted to bring the two children together to go to elementary school. After all, our side is good at teaching, which is better than Daying.
Besides, we have both junior high school and high school, so it is convenient to go to school.
But your father has committed another stubbornness, and the fourth child is also reluctant to let the child come, and he does not allow the child to come. "
Isn’t that what mothers do? She has to worry about any child.
Since the fourth family had such a big scandal this time, Zhou Guilan couldn't sleep all night, thinking about what the fourth family would do in the future.
Want to let the fourth child divorce his wife? The old Xu family couldn't do such a thing.
Besides, even if this one leaves, finding another one may not be better than this one.
There are still two children. For the sake of the children, the fourth child can't be divorced.
But without a divorce, how can the fourth child be kept away from those in the Wu family? This is also worrying enough.
That family is like a leech, they won't let go when they catch Xu Shide. If Xu Shide is still in the camp, the family will make them mess up sooner or later.
Zhou Guilan couldn't think of any way, so she thought about asking Xu Shiyan if he could think of a way to transfer Xu Shide away.
It doesn't matter how far or near, as long as you stay a little farther away from Wu's house.
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard this, then shook his head, "Mom, I'm afraid this trick won't work.
The Wu family, now they are eager to move away, if the fourth job is transferred, they will definitely move along. "
In the previous life, Xu Shide was transferred to Xigang Township for work, and the old couple of Wu family did not follow, but the two daughters of his family moved to Xigang, not far from Xu Shide's home.
Now the Wu family has offended most of the people in the village. At this time, Xu Shide is transferred to work, and the Wu family has to follow up and move away quickly?
Then it’s not just Xu Shide’s two sister-in-laws, the whole Wu family may have to move with them.
Zhou Guilan really didn't expect this. Hearing her son's analysis now, she felt a headache.
"What's wrong with this? Didn't this make them rely on it?
You said that the fourth child, you said that he was not allowed to have a girl from the Wu family at the beginning, but he insisted on refusing to listen, which really made him very upset. "Zhou Guilan was almost dying of worry.
"Mom, no one can help with this matter, it all depends on the fourth child himself.
If the fourth child has a long memory after suffering this loss, and knows to take care of his daughter-in-law and stay away from the Wu family in the future, he will not be afraid.
If the fourth child has no brains and doesn’t have a long memory after being like this, it’s useless for anyone to help. "
The outsider gang is only temporary, and it can only treat the symptoms but not the root cause. Only you can change it yourself.
"Oh, let him worry to death all day.
Last time your father celebrated his birthday, and the fourth child came back by himself. I took advantage of your father’s inattention and gave the fourth child 300 yuan.
At least pay back the anxious famine first, don't affect the work because of this.
His family just points out the fourth child to go to work. If things go wrong again, that life will really be over. "Zhou Guilan muttered sadly there.
Yes, I guessed right, right? I knew that this old lady couldn't just sit and watch her son in trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 435: Su's mother and daughter
chapters.content:
Chapter 435 Su Family Mother and Daughter
The two women muttered in the vegetable garden for a while, but they couldn't come up with a charter. At this time, Xu Chenghou also came out, so the two women kept silent and didn't mention anything else.
Zhou Guilan chopped two handfuls of celery, picked a few peppers, and went back to the house with her son to pick celery leaves.
Su Anying rode a bicycle to Songjianghe Market to buy meat.
The meat in summer is not as easy to sell as other times, and there are still some meat left in the afternoon.
This is a little bit, and I don’t want to pick anything with a front and a back. It’s good to have meat.
It happened that the piece weighed about three catties, so Su Anying took it all.
Back home, Su Anying started chopping meat and vegetables, and Zhou Guilan went to make noodles.
"Xu Haiyuan, go to your grandma's house and ask your grandma to come over and eat dumplings." Su Anying was busy with her work while calling her son to run errands.
Su Weizhong's family moved to Donggang a while ago.
Coincidentally, just to the west of the weather station, there is a family surnamed Li, who is also a participant.
His son got married and built five other houses. Money was tight, so he wanted to sell the house here to make up for it.
Three rooms, stone foundation, brick stacks, rough walls, roof tiles.
In the house, the cement floor, cement window sill, and pot table are still inlaid with white tiles.
This house has only been built for two or three years, so it is quite new. The asking price is okay, one thousand and one hundred yuan.
Su Anying knew the news and went to talk to that family.
The Li family was also present, of course they knew Xu Shiyan and his wife.
When I heard that I was going to buy a house for Xu Shiyan's father-in-law, the other party was very polite and said that if Su Anying wanted it, he would sell it for 1,000 yuan.
For such a new and well-organized house, there is quite a lot of space in the front and back of the house. One thousand yuan is really not expensive.
Su Anying didn't feel ashamed to go any further, so she agreed to buy the house.
Su Weizhong and his wife have also saved some money over the years, five or six hundred.
The house in Daying sold for 300 yuan, plus the salary Su Weizhong had saved in the past few months, it was enough.
So the old couple rejected the daughter's proposal to help pay for the house, and bought the house with their own money.
Then Li Zongliang took his people and drove to move all those things from the Su family.
Su Weizhong went to work in the field to watch the gate, and then the Su family moved to Donggang. Those people in Daying knew about it, and they were all envious.
The weather station is just east of the Martyrs' Tomb, and it's not too far away.
Xu Haiyuan is so old, there is no problem with running errands or anything.
"Oh, got it mom."
Xu Haiyuan reluctantly put down the book in his hand, came out of the house, ran all the way east, and went to find his grandma.
Here, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law have prepared the dumpling stuffing and noodles, put the panel on the kang, and start making dumplings.
The wrapping here was about to be covered, and Han Cai'e and Xu Haiyuan came in from the outside.
"Shiyan is back?" Han Cai'e already knew that Xu Shiyan was back, and she just entered the door to say hello.
"Well, mother, I just came back at noon. Isn't this what my mother said to make dumplings? I was thinking about asking mother to come over and let's have fun together."
Xu Shiyan responded while rolling the skin.
Han Cai'e was not too polite. Seeing that dumplings were being made in the house, she went to the kitchen to wash her hands and came back, and she also started making dumplings.
Xu Shiyan rolled the skin by himself, which was just right for two people, but it took a little effort for three people, so he could only speed up.
"Mom, is my father not at home today? Did he go to work in the morning?"
Su Anying saw that only Han Cai'e was coming, and knew that Su Weizhong must have gone to work.
"Well, your dad went to work this morning and won't be back until tomorrow morning."
Su Weizhong’s job of guarding the gate and shifting shifts is two shifts, the big shift, one night a day, so he left this morning and came back tomorrow morning.
"Oh, my in-laws won't be able to eat dumplings tonight, I'll take some back later, and my in-laws will come back from get off work tomorrow morning and let him have a taste."
Zhou Guilan said while making dumplings. Every time the Xu family makes a lot of dumplings, it's not bad for Su Weizhong to eat alone. Take some back, and it will be convenient for breakfast tomorrow.
"No, no, he can eat whatever he wants when he comes back." Of course Han Cai'e had to be polite.
This is at the in-law's house, not my daughter's house, so how can I even eat and take food?
Zhou Guilan didn't try to persuade her anymore. Needless to say, when Han Cai'e left later, she just asked her third daughter-in-law to give those dumplings.
Four people were making dumplings, Xu Chenghou looked at the two young ones, saving them from always wanting to lean against the panel, trying to steal a piece of dough to play with.
As for Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, they are addicted to reading, so they don't come to join in the fun.
At five o'clock, Su Anhua came home from get off work, saw General Tie at the door, and went to her sister's house.
When I went to the door of my sister's house, I locked the door and came here again.
"Yo, the second brother-in-law is back, what do I say, the house is locked, and the door of the second sister's house is also locked."
When Su Anhua saw Xu Shiyan, she realized that the co-author was her brother-in-law who came back, so it was delicious.
"How much is left unpacked? I'll wash my hands too." Then, he rolled up his sleeves to wash his hands.
"Don't, there's only one piece of noodles left, don't touch your hands, you're really tired after working all day, let's take a rest."
Zhou Guilan hurriedly called Su Anhua to stop, not letting her do anything.
"Hua'er, go and light the fire. The water is just boiling. After wrapping this side, cook the dumplings directly."
Now buy the meat and prepare it now, it's a bit late. Hurry up and boil the dumplings, or you won't have the meal later, and everyone watching TV will come.
Su Anhua nodded, went to hold the firewood to light the fire, and looked at the bottom of the pot while chopping garlic.
Wait for the water in the pot to boil, and the dumplings are finished making in the house, just in time for cooking.
The dumplings with celery and chili peppers are also delicious, everyone is very satisfied with the food.
Just finished eating, those watching TV came again.
Seeing this, Xu Shiyan quickly packed up his things, and asked Xu Haiyuan to pack up his books for a while and go home.
Su Anying used that kind of enamel straw hat basin to fill a small basin of dumplings, wrapped it in a net bag and gave it to Su Anhua, asking her to take it back for Su Weizhongming to eat in the morning.
Su Anhua wasn't polite to her sister, she just took it, and Han Cai'e was so angry that she went out with her eyes.
"Mother, look at you, why are we being polite here with my aunt?
Since the second brother-in-law is back, why don’t you cook something delicious some other day and invite my second brother-in-law’s family, as well as the uncle and aunt, to have a meal?
Why do you have to deal with those stupid people? "
Su Anhua doesn't care about my mother's eyes, she's used to it since she was a child, who is afraid?
"You are the only one who can say it. Do you still need to talk nonsense? When your second brother-in-law comes back, you must ask them to come over for dinner."
Han Cai'e glared at her daughter, but the daughter looked indifferent, and she didn't do anything, so she could only tell Xu Shiyan and his wife to go home.
A lot of people are watching TV here. Although Han Caie really wants to watch it, she always feels that it is not the case.
So let’s go home, wait until we save money, and buy one for ourselves.
Mother and daughter Han Caie and Su Anhua left first, and Xu Shiyan and his wife also packed up their things and led the four children home.
There are too many people here, it is noisy, Xu Shiyan still has a lot of things to tell Su Anying, so let's go home.

chapters.title: Chapter 436: night pearl
chapters.content:
Chapter 436 Night Pearl
Xu Haiyuan and the others were in a hurry to go home to watch cartoons. After leaving the house of their grandparents, they ran back home.
Xu Haiyuan has the key in his hand, so he doesn't have to wait for his parents, he just opens the door and enters the house and turns on the TV quickly.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying followed behind with big and small bags. Seeing the children running away in a hurry, the couple smiled and didn't tell the children to be careful.
These fur kids are running wild, don't worry about them.
The couple walked into their yard unhurriedly. Xu Shiyan saw at a glance that the three houses in the east end had been demolished, and it was already a piece of flat land.
"The house at the west end of Mulenchang is almost finished, and it will be handed over and moved in a few days.
As for Canshi, as long as they move, they will break ground immediately. I don’t think it will be finished this year. It would be great if they can get the big frame up. "
Su Anying glanced at the open space and said.
"I was thinking about building the east end of our house when the ground was broken in Sanshi.
Don’t build three rooms, isn’t there still some open space in the east? Forget about covering four rooms.
What about the two sons, who knows where they will be in the future?
If you don’t stay with us for a while, these nine houses will be enough to live in. "
Su Anying pointed to the area at Dongtou. The area of ​​his house is spacious, and there is no problem in building four more rooms.
"I have something else I want to tell you, um, there is a lot of open space on our parents' side, the warehouse in Xitou.
I mean, build five wing rooms directly on the west head.
Didn't you discuss with our father about opening a store? If you want me to say, don't use the room at the west end, put the wing room directly, get two rooms, the space is a little bigger. "Su Anying has other plans.
"I feel that after the city is built, the land on this piece of land will be worth a lot of money.
Let’s not talk about anything else, build five wing rooms, parents use two, and rent out the other three are cost-effective. "
"Okay, you are very powerful now, and you know how to build more houses?" Xu Shiyan glanced at his wife beside him.
I have to say that after several years of experience, his wife is absolutely impressive. Does this understand the importance of real estate? really not bad.
"Well, the main reason is that the house doesn't belong to us now?
If we leave it before, if we want to do something, we not only need the consent of our parents, but also the consent of the brothers.
No need now, we just need to discuss this matter with our parents, and we can do whatever we like, and no one else can control it. "
Su Anying laughed when she heard that, she can build as many rooms as she wants in her own house and her own yard.
Xu Shiyan nodded when he heard the words, it is so reasonable, as long as the city is built, the houses here must be valuable.
Among other things, just those stores, many people robbed them.
My parents’ house is just opposite to Sanshi, just across a road. There are a lot of houses built here, and they can earn money by doing everything.
"Okay, this idea is right, then arrange it according to what you said."
Look, his daughter-in-law is getting better and better, so ah, people must study.
Reading books may not necessarily change your destiny, but it will definitely make you wiser and increase your knowledge.
"By the way, where is the rascal? The house here has been demolished. Where does the rascal live?"
Xu Shiyan realized at this time, he went home today, but the rascal didn't come out to meet him.
"I temporarily settled the rascal in the barn, and later, the family will reserve a special place for it.
Probably went out to grab something, right? When the weather gets warmer, it doesn't like to stay at home, and always runs to the mountains.
Still taking things home, such as squirrels, pheasants, and hares, they all swipe home. I really feel that it is going to become a sperm. "
While talking, the two entered the room and saw four children sitting on the edge of the Kang, staring at the TV intently.
The "Black Cat Sheriff" is on TV. Although there are only five episodes, it has always occupied a very important position in the hearts of the children.
When Xu Shiyan and his wife saw this, they didn't dare to disturb the children, so they hurried to light the fire.
Kang is not a bed, even in summer, it must be heated and ventilated. Sleeping on a cold kang is prone to problems.
"How is the other side of the ground?" The couple chatted while lighting the fire and tidying up the kitchen.
What Xu Shiyan is most concerned about is the other side of the ginseng soil.
"We don't care about the 20,000 zhang sold, they dig the soil themselves.
The remaining 30,000 feet, doesn’t our company have machines? The rotary tiller has turned over the ground.
I know your temper. If the work is too rough, you will not be used to it, so I asked them to turn the floor twice.
The weather is good these days, let the soil dry out for a while, and wait until autumn, and hire thirty or forty blind people to pour the soil. "
Participating in the use of soil for the ground, each process is very particular. It does not mean that the sooner the better with the machine, after the soil must be dried to sterilize and kill insect eggs to increase the ground temperature.
Wait until autumn, then pour the soil finely and evenly, and save the seeds for planting ginseng.
In recent years, more and more blind wanderers have come from Guanli, especially those who work for Xu's family in the farms. They have introduced their relatives and want to find a job in Xu Shiyan.
So there are plenty of blind people, and most of them are young men in their early twenties and less than thirties, all of whom are good at work.
"Thank you for your hard work. I will go out to study and be a shopkeeper. You have to take care of everything at home, which is enough for you."
Farms, ginseng market, and ginseng land, Su Anying doesn't have to do the work by herself now, but she has to watch over everything, which is even more tiring.
"What else is there? I'm just talking about it, and it's not me who does the work.
Besides, isn’t it your idea behind this? I'm just a messenger, don't get tired. "
Su Anying smiled indifferently, what's the point of being tired?
When I was at home, she used to farm and reap the land and collect firewood. Didn’t she have to do all kinds of work? Those are called tired.
These brain and mouth tasks are really nothing to Su Anying.
Summer is hot, so there is no need to burn too much fire on the kang, just a little fire, and two pots of water are enough.
Ordinary households set up two bricks in front of the stove, put an aluminum kettle on top of the bricks, and burn firewood underneath.
The smoke goes away along the stove without choking people, and when the kang is heated, the water is boiled along the way.
Boil the water in the kettle and fill the thermos. When the water in the pot boils, add some cold water to mix it up, and ask the children to wash their feet.
After they were all cleaned up, they were driven to bed, and they were not allowed to stay up late watching TV.
After working on a few children, it was past eight o'clock.
Xu Shiyan saw that the children were asleep, so he greeted his wife. The two of them carried their bags and went to the basement storage room of Westinghouse.
"Come on, let's see what the **** is that bead?"
It was dark in the storage room. Xu Shiyan took a flashlight, opened his back pocket, turned out the small wooden box from inside, and took out the bead.
"Oh, how bright is this thing?"
As soon as the beads came out, there was a bluish light. The light was very soft, not comparable to a flashlight, but much brighter than the light of a candle.
"This is a luminous pearl. You can't see anything during the day, but it glows at night." Xu Shiyan looked at the bead and sighed.
"No wonder Yuanyuan said, let you watch it at night.
What are you talking about, you only read it when you are in a hurry, and now you are in a hurry? "Su Anying thought of this and deliberately teased Xu Shiyan.

chapters.title: Chapter 437: baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 437 Baby
"Cut, what do you know?
If I said it was Ye Mingzhu at that time, you wouldn't be afraid of those children in our family who would go out and talk nonsense? "Xu Shiyan shook his head.
At any rate, he has also experienced the age of information explosion. Do you really think he is so stupid that he doesn't understand anything? I still understand a little bit.
The children in the family are all grown up, and they speak very slippery.
As for the children, they all make a mistake. The more the parents solemnly told them not to talk about things when they went out, the brats wouldn't know who to show off to if they couldn't get out of the house.
Don't look at Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping who are smarter than monkeys on weekdays, but they are children after all, if they can't control their mouths, one day they will miss it?
Let outsiders know that the Xu family still has Ye Mingzhu or something. Is there still a time for his family to stop?
And children are very curious. The more things that adults cherish and value, the more curious they are and the more they want to see them.
I just want to know what it is and what's so great about it.
So Xu Shiyan was very calm at the time, and didn't care at all.
Children are the best at observing words and expressions. When they see that adults don't care, they don't care, or even don't pay attention at all.
If Xu Shiyan was surprised and excited when he recognized something, the children would be even more curious.
Maybe one day they will be able to turn the house upside down when there are no adults in the house.
"My father and I guessed that these things should come out of the palace.
When Emperor Kant fell, countless national treasures were left in Xiaobailou.
I don’t know how those things fell into the hands of the young man’s elders. I guess they didn’t know where to hide them in order to avoid disasters in those years.
The renovation of the old house was discovered, but it was not taken seriously, so a stall was set up in the whole market. "
Xu Shiyan once heard that when Emperor Kant fled, he brought a large number of national treasures with him.
In addition to calligraphy and paintings by famous masters of past dynasties such as "Dongting Spring Ode" and "Wen Ji Returning to Han Picture", there are also four boxes of "Tripitaka", four boxes of various jade wares, jade stamps, and small furnishings.
Eighteen portable safes and small portable boxes, which are said to contain gold watches, gold pocket watches, and gold watch chains.
Gold tie pins, gold cufflinks, gold bracelets, rubies, large diamonds, gold knives, gold necklaces, gold brooches and other jewelry inlaid with various precious stones.
Fleeing all the way and losing all the way, while waiting to be caught, Maozi also detained a large number of treasures.
What a gold plate weighing more than 500 grams, a gold insect pocket watch inlaid with 174 diamonds and two rubies, and so on.
So many things are lost among the people, it is not unusual for Xu Shiyan to encounter one or two.
"Let's put the night pearl away, and sell it when the children need money to start a business."
It is said that most of the night pearls contain radioactive substances, so this thing may not be good, and it should not be too close to people.
Put it in the basement for the time being, wait for the house on the east end to be built, then put it over there to build a bigger basement, and move things there.
As Xu Shiyan said, he rewrapped the bead, opened a box on the shelf, and stuffed the bead into a corner.
"The bracelet and jade pendant should be jade, and the color is old, I think it should be glass.
Store it for 20 or 30 years, it can be worth a lot of money, so make sure to hide it well, don’t let those monkey cubs find out and drop it. "
Xu Shiyan wrapped the bracelet and the piece of jade in red cloth, and put them back into the small wooden box together with the pair of cufflinks.
Carefully put it under the box and cover it with something.
"When our son said it was jadeite, didn't you still believe it? You also said it was made of glass. Why do you believe it?"
Su Anying is too embarrassed to complain about her own man. This man obviously believes in the child's words, but he has to be stubborn.
Xu Shiyan shook his head when he heard the words, "Some things are not that simple. The family members talk too much, so it's not good to talk too much."
At that time Xu Haiyuan said it was jadeite, but Xu Shiyan deliberately said it was glass, just not wanting those children to understand.
Children don’t understand, it doesn’t mean that outsiders don’t understand, this matter can be kept secret.
Su Anying curled her lips and shook her head, saying that her man is heartless, he is the worst one.
This man, as long as it is related to money, he is better than anyone else.
"Huh? No, how does our son know this?
What is that called? Emerald, right? How did our son meet? And that bead, why do I feel that he saw it right then? "
Su Anying suddenly sensed something was wrong, how old is his son? Eight-year-old child, he knows jadeite?
Go out and ask, how many of those adults know about jade? At least Su Anying didn't know before today.
"What's the matter? Where does our son have such great skills?" Su Anying suddenly felt cold from the bottom of her heart.
The son of his family has been smart since he was a child, and everyone has always thought he was smart, but now it feels like it can't be explained by being smart.
No matter how smart he is, it is impossible for him to know something he has never seen?
"What are you doing? Are you scaring yourself?" The basement was dark, and even with a flashlight on, I couldn't see anything clearly.
But Xu Shiyan could tell something was wrong from his wife's tone.
"What are you thinking about? Our son reads books all day long. Do you know which book he reads from?
Don’t be suspicious every day, that’s our son, raised since he was a child, how could he be wrong? "
Xu Shiyan didn't allow Su Anying to think about it, but he was haunted in his heart.
This eldest son died shortly after he was born in his previous life.
At that time, people said that the child was a wealthy man, and the Xu family couldn't bear that, so the child left.
In Xu Shiyan's view, these are just some comfort in the heart, which can make parents feel better.
There is even some hope that the child may find a good family after reincarnation.
But at this moment, Xu Shiyan suddenly became a little uncertain.
The son of his family has been different from other children since he was a child, no, it should be said that he is too different.
The eldest daughter is also smart, but no matter how smart she is, she is still a child. If Xu Haiyuan hadn't brought her along, she wouldn't have so many thoughts.
This Xu Haiyuan is different, sometimes watching him act like an adult.
Is there anything else to say?
Xu Shiyan shook his head, not allowing himself to think about it. It is better to turn a blind eye to some things.
Anyway, it's their son, so it's fine to make no mistake about it, and don't think too much about the others.
Su Anying didn't refute her husband's words, but just helped Xu Shiyan put all the things together and put them away, and locked the box.
The two came out of the basement lightly, carefully covered the wooden boards, and pushed a broken cabinet back to its original position.
The children slept soundly in the east room. No one would have guessed that the west room even had a basement.
What's more, they didn't know that while they were asleep, their parents stored all the treasures in the basement.
It was late, the couple washed up and got into bed.
It's been a long time since we saw each other, so we had to make out. Anyway, the next morning, Xu Shiyan almost overslept.

chapters.title: Chapter 438: Deputy Director Xu
chapters.content:
Chapter 438 Deputy Director Xu
Since Xu Shiyan is back, he must go to participate.
Su Anying is also busy here, the new house is ready to be handed over soon, and the people who are going to move out must be called together for a meeting.
The main thing is to mobilize them to move away as soon as possible, without procrastinating.
This, it’s useless to talk about it, and it has to be rewarded. Within a limited period, whoever moves out first will be rewarded with 500 yuan.
The more you delay, the less money you will get, and those who hang around at the end and refuse to leave will not be rewarded.
After doing this, many people shouted when the house could be handed over, and they would move immediately as soon as the house was cleaned up.
Xu Shiyan went to the venue, met with Lin Qiyue, and chatted about his recent participation.
Currently speaking, whether it is participating in various sub-fields or several factories, it is a normal and steady development.
Lin Qiyue went to the Spring Fair and signed a lot of orders, among which Coke and mineral water accounted for a large part. These two alone can create a very large profit for the factory.
While speaking, Lin Qiyue took out another stack of certificates and awards.
"Our ginseng honey slice was rated as the provincial excellent new product in 1984. This is the certificate."
"Our Ginseng Cola was awarded the New Product Golden Dragon Award."
"Your ginseng buckle shed technology research won the first prize of this year's Ginseng Society, and this is your certificate.
There is also a bonus of 300 yuan. "Lin Qiyue put the certificate and bonus in front of Xu Shiyan.
"This is the letter of appointment from the Ginseng Society, appointing you as the vice chairman of the Fusong Ginseng Society."
Xu Shiyan can be promoted to vice chairman within one year, which is fast enough.
At the same time, he also explained his ability, level and contribution in the field of ginseng research.
"In addition, the meaning of the county and city leaders is led by you, with the assistance of our county magistrate Jiang and I, and the three of us jointly compiled a set of "New Ginseng Cultivation Technology" series.
The main purpose is to sort out our ginseng cultivation techniques systematically and in detail.
Published by the Publishing House, and distributed to participating technicians in various townships and villages, as materials for subsequent training in various places. "
This can be regarded as writing a teaching material, that is to say, if the book "New Technology of Ginseng Cultivation" is finalized and published, Xu Shiyan can also be regarded as a top figure in the ginseng planting industry.
Next, you can be rated as a mid-level engineer.
"Also, our participating leadership team held a meeting and unanimously agreed to appoint Comrade Xu Shiyan as the deputy director of a participating field, focusing on technology research and development."
The last one is the heavyweight news.
Xu Shiyan went to the special training class for cadres of the Agricultural University to study, and came back after graduation. I really dare not say where he will be arranged.
But no matter where it is arranged, it is definitely higher than the original head of the technical department.
Participants discussed for a while, and felt that Xu Shiyan had to be kept. Such a talent could not be snatched away by other units.
So Lin Qiyue discussed with several deputy directors and secretaries and decided not to wait for Xu Shiyan to finish his studies, but to promote Xu Shiyan as deputy director now, and still focus on technology research and development.
The previous awards and certificates were all expected, so Xu Shiyan didn't have much mood swings.
Xu Shiyan was a little excited about the later manuscript of "New Technology of Ginseng Planting".
If this book is published, he can be regarded as a cultural person after all.
Xu Shiyan did not expect the last one.
He seems to be the technical section chief who was mentioned last year, right? It's only been a year, and you're going to be the deputy director again? Same as Li Bingzhuo?
"Secretary Lin, is this too fast? I am not old enough and have insufficient qualifications. I am afraid that many people will not be convinced by the appointment of deputy director?"
In this year and month, seniority is always considered in state-owned enterprises.
It doesn’t mean that you can be promoted to a certain position if you have the ability, you have to endure it and the number of years of experience, otherwise there will be a bunch of people who are not convinced.
"It has nothing to do with those, I have long been tired of those old almanacs.
Why can’t young people go up if they have the ability? Must a whole bunch of antiques take up space there?
I don't care about other places. Anyway, after participating in the game, this situation has to be changed.
Whoever has the ability will be promoted, regardless of age and qualifications, as long as they contribute to the field, they can be promoted.
Talents are the rarest thing to come by, and these talents should not be chilled. "
It can be said that Lin Qiyue is very courageous and resourceful, and he does things vigorously and eclecticly.
"You can be your deputy director with peace of mind. If anyone dares to have an opinion, let him come to me." Lin Qiyue said this aggressively.
The secretary has already talked about this, so what else does Xu Shiyan say? If he is more modest, won't it appear that Secretary Lin has no vision?
Since Secretary Lin has set up the platform, he will work hard, use his housekeeping skills, research a few more projects, and earn more money, which is better than anything else.
"Thank you, Secretary Lin, and the trust of the leaders in the field. I will definitely live up to the expectations of the leaders.
Leading the technical department, do more research, produce results as soon as possible, improve the industrial processing of our participating companies as soon as possible, and earn more foreign exchange. "Xu Shiyan expressed his position immediately.
"That's right, that's what makes sense, young people, you have to dare to break through and fight hard.
Don't worry, there is a venue, me, and the county secretary to back you up, what are you afraid of?
You are responsible for rushing forward, and those of us are responsible for escorting you behind.
If we do a good job, we are worthy of the country's training and trust, right? "Lin Qiyue was quite satisfied with Xu Shiyan's statement.
Xu Shiyan is a typical technical talent, that is, in his professional field, he can fully utilize his strengths like a fish in water.
However, he is not good at the hypocrisy and meaningless politeness in the system, and he is not good at both sides.
That's why Lin Qiyue said that Xu Shiyan is only responsible for rushing forward, and for the aftermath work, there is him, the venue, and the county secretary in charge.
They are responsible for taking care of the aftermath, and will never let anyone hold Xu Shiyan back.
"Yes, yes, I have to show you a few documents.
I sent our holy mountain Tianquan mineral water to the province to do various analyzes again. This is the composition report. "
Lin Qiyue took out another stack of documents from a cabinet and handed them to Xu Shiyan.
"This is the appraisal report sent by our merchant who brought the samples back for appraisal."
Before production, the beverage factory has conducted water source identification to confirm that the water used meets the drinking water standard, and various bacterial flora and harmful substances are far below the national standard.
Later, isn’t this going to build a mineral water plant? Then send the water samples to the province for specific component analysis, to see what are the various major elements and trace elements contained in this mineral water?
There are no standards related to mineral water in China at present, only an analysis of the ingredients has been done.
It was foreign merchants who took the samples back for appraisal, and the authoritative organization issued an appraisal certificate.
The identification results show that the holy mountain Tianquan mineral water contains potassium, selenium, germanium, lithium, zinc, cobalt, molybdenum and other macro and trace elements that are beneficial to the human body.
It belongs to extremely rare carbon dioxide containing metasilicate, strontium, lithium, bicarbonate-calcium magnesium composite natural mineral water.

chapters.title: Chapter 439: from the province
chapters.content:
Chapter 439 Sent by the province
Xu Shiyan was chatting with Lin Qiyue when someone knocked on the door suddenly, and several people came in.
There are deputy directors Li Bingzhuo, Dai Rongchun, and another person Xu Shiyan doesn't know.
"Just now I heard people say that I saw the deputy director Xu, and we hurried over to join in the fun." Li Bingzhuo said with a smile.
"If you don't come here, I plan to call you later. Sit down and talk."
Lin Qiyue glanced at the last person who came in, and introduced him to Xu Shiyan with a smile.
"Xiao Xu, this is Chen Jihui, the deputy director of our beverage factory.
It was specially transferred from the provincial beverage factory to guide the production of beverages and mineral water in our factory. "
When he said this, Lin Qiyue gave Xu Shiyan a wink.
Xu Shiyan suddenly understood that this was someone from the province who looked at the mineral water factory and the beverage factory with envy, and probably put in the whole thing.
Originally, Dai Rongchun, the deputy director of the beverage factory and mineral water factory, was concurrently in charge.
Their factory is not too big, and there are not so many things to do. Dai Rongchun has no problems in supervision, and there is no need to arrange another deputy factory manager to come over.
This person, is he here to make trouble?
"Hello, Director Chen. Xu Shiyan, the former head of the field technical department."
Xu Shiyan reached out his hand first, and greeted the other party with a smile.
Chen Jihui glanced at Xu Shiyan, and seemed to frowned slightly.
Only then slowly stretched out his hand, shook hands with Xu Shiyan, and then separated. "Hi, I'm Chen Jihui, deputy director of the beverage factory."
"Sit down, sit down, Xiao Cao, hurry up and make a pot of tea."
Lin Qiyue was still smiling, and asked the secretary outside to make tea and bring it in.
Everyone sat down, before anyone else could speak, Chen Jihui spoke first.
"Secretary Lin, how did you think about the matter I proposed to you earlier?
Now foreign merchants are urging our mineral water all the time, but according to the previous rules, two Cokes must be paired with one water.
This is obviously unreasonable. Coke is not as expensive as water. "Chen Jihui looked eager and spoke in a very aggressive tone.
Xu Shiyan glanced at Lin Qiyue, haven't they discussed this matter?
"Well, I haven't had time to tell you just now." Lin Qiyue nodded towards Xu Shiyan.
"At present, our ginseng cola and ginseng flower cola are selling well abroad, and the supply of mineral water is in short supply.
So foreign customers suggest that we can change the natural gas added in the two kinds of cola into water to artificially add bubbles.
The water saved is used to produce mineral water, so that the profit can be higher. "
When Lin Qiyue said this, he looked at Chen Jihui.
Chen Jihui is a supporter of this statement and has been suggesting this matter recently.
But Lin Qiyue remembered what Xu Shiyan said before, so he never agreed.
"The province sent geological experts over to investigate, and said that the mineable amount of Tianquan in the holy mountain is only 100 tons per day.
Experts also said that if such precious mineral water is used to produce cola, it is really a waste.
I have proposed this matter several times, modifying the formulas of the two types of cola and adding bubbles artificially.
It is a serious development plan to use the saved water to directly produce mineral water for export.
I don't understand, why do we have to stick to the current production ratio? "
Chen Jihui seemed a little impatient with Lin Qiyue's slow and leisurely way of narrating, so he rushed to speak directly.
Xu Shiyan sighed. Sure enough, their beverage factory was too much for people to worry about, and someone was jealous and sent someone to stir it up.
"Director Chen, I have been studying in the province, and I don't have time to ask about the specific production of beverage factories and mineral water factories.
Well, I have something to ask Director Chen. "Xu Shiyan said unhurriedly.
Chen Jihui was stunned for a moment, "Huh? You ask."
"How much is our current order for the first quarter? Coke plus mineral water, the total is counted."
Xu Shiyan took a pen in his hand, and took a piece of paper from Lin Qiyue's desk, as if he was ready to record at any time.
Chen Jihui came back to his senses, and immediately said, "I came late, but after checking the information, the order for the second quarter is 120,000 pieces of two types of cola, and 60,000 pieces of water.
Secretary Lin went to the Spring Fair and brought back some orders, so starting from the third quarter, our orders are 300,000 pieces of Coke and 150,000 pieces of water. "
As the deputy director of the factory, I still remember this data clearly.
"Oh, that's right.
Then I want to ask, Director Chen, have you calculated it?
How many pieces of water or beverages can be produced according to the daily production of 100 tons given by experts? "
Xu Shiyan remained calm and asked another question.
Chen Jihui was stunned for a moment, he really hadn't calculated this.
"Well, Director Chen didn't calculate it at first glance, so let me calculate it for you.
We don’t need to count Coke, because the capacity of Coke is small, so we will count everything as mineral water.
One ton of water produces two thousand bottles of mineral water, one hundred tons of water, how much is produced, two hundred thousand bottles.
Twelve bottles of water are one piece, that is to say, if our factory works overtime to produce, then one hundred tons of water can produce 16,666 pieces per day. "
Xu Shiyan said while calculating on paper.
"Of course, there is always some loss in this production process, right? That's 15,000 pieces.
The amount of mining in that month is enough to meet the orders for the first quarter. For the remaining two months, who will sell it to?
Foreign merchants say that the supply exceeds the demand, and we actually produced 900,000 pieces, can they all want it? "
The so-called spring water gushing out is not enough, it is purely to fool foreigners.
Without this trick, how can you hook them into buying mineral water and carrying Coke?
"The pricing of foreign products is different from our domestic ones. They are not calculated according to the cost, but according to the rarity of the product.
Why is mineral water so expensive? Because it is rare, it is worth less.
If 400,000 to 500,000 pieces are produced a month, do you think those foreign people will pay such a high price? "
Xu Shiyan glanced at that Chen Jihui, does this guy really know how to do it? Don't mess up the factory.
Decades later, the Linhaixueyuan Mineral Water Factory combined two springs, Shirao Spring and Canyon Spring, with an annual production capacity of only 100,000 tons.
"How big is our factory now, and we still want to start production with full firepower? What do you want to do, want to go to heaven?
It is good to produce honestly. There is an output value of more than two million dollars a quarter, and the beverage factory and mineral water factory alone have an output value of more than eight million dollars a year.
What else do you want, how much is too much?
If you can stabilize the current market and orders without any problems, you will be able to make your nose bubble beautiful. How about beautiful things? Are you crazy? "
Xu Shiyan thinks that he should not be too polite, otherwise people will always think he is easy to bully, so just hate him.
Regardless of whether he is from the province or the central government, this thing is not that foreign monks can chant scriptures, so laymen should not come to give orders.
Xu Shiyan's series of questions directly left Chen Jihui speechless.
I want to refute, but people use data to speak and calculate the accounts clearly. How can he refute?

chapters.title: Chapter 440: to make trouble
chapters.content:
Chapter 440 To make trouble
“There are some things that can pursue yield, and some things that can’t.
We are taking high-end products, do you understand what high-end products are? That is, you have to lift the shelf up high, so you can buy it or not. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at that Chen Jihui, sighed, and slowed down his tone.
"It's not that mineral water cannot be developed, but it is definitely not the development of the existing one.
Our Changbai Mountain has beautiful mountains and water, and there are many high-quality mineral water.
Not to mention, the Quanyang Forestry Bureau has a Quanyang Lake, which is also very high-quality mineral water.
A little closer, not far from our mineral water factory, also within the scope of Songshan Forest Farm, there is also a spring that is also very good.
Do we have the conditions to develop now? Where will it be developed and sold?
Doesn’t work domestically, all point to export? unrealistic
So in many cases, instead of blindly pursuing output, less and better, actually earn more money. "
"Did you understand what Deputy Director Xu said?
Look at you one by one, want to make money like crazy, just keep staring at the mineral water to make money.
Well, I can’t say enough to you guys, then the deputy director Xu is engaged in technology, and he went to college again, you should believe what he says, right?
We are participating in the field, and we have to focus on ginseng planting. Everything else is auxiliary.
right? "
Lin Qiyue answered the conversation over there. Although he was speaking to everyone, in fact, he was speaking to Chen Jihui.
"Yes, yes, we've gotten into a corner recently.
The key point is that I am afraid of being poor. As soon as I make money, I do everything possible to make more money. It is really too simple to think. "
On the other end, Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong hurriedly nodded in agreement.
These are all old people participating in the field. They have worked together for so many years, and they have a tacit understanding. They don't even need to give a glance, and the two automatically answer the conversation.
Now the three of them sang together, ridiculing and belittling Chen Jihui.
It's not to blame for their partnership to bully others. Since Chen Jihui came to participate in the competition, he has looked down on you from the province and looks down on you bumpkins.
No matter what you say or do, you always keep your eyes upwards, so you really want to look at people with your nostrils.
What is there to be proud of? So what if they are from the provincial capital? Are those from the provincial capital superior to others?
He is not an important person in the beverage factory in the provincial capital, but if he has some weight, can he be brought to the small place of Donggang?
It is said that it is to arrange a deputy factory director, but in fact, it is not a secret?
This person just doesn’t recognize the situation clearly. Since you are from outside, you can go to work honestly and have to jump around.
Before, the big guy was saving money and didn't like to argue with him, but this jumping around was too much fun, and it seemed that it had to be cleaned up.
Chen Jihui is not stupid, can he not hear what these people mean?
Immediately, his face flushed from holding back, but he had nothing to say. After all, people didn't mention him directly.
"Well, I still have some documents to deal with, I'll go back first."
No one stepped down the steps, so Chen Jihui could only make excuses by himself, saying that he still had work, turned around and left.
"Secretary Lin, what does the province mean? It's intentional, right? This person is in our beverage factory, can't something happen?"
Xu Shiyan looked at Chen Jihui's back thoughtfully.
"Is it because our beverage factory is too conspicuous, who cares about it?"
"Well, indeed, some people think that our mineral water and drinks are too profitable, so they don't want to give them to us and want to take them away.
So talking about the production volume means that we don’t have the ability to develop it, so it’s better to give it to a capable unit.
Their unit was thinking about it, and arranged to come here after going out of their way, just to cause trouble for us. "
Lin Qiyue sighed. Based on the current orders, the output value of the beverage factory and mineral water factory is more than 8 million US dollars a year.
It is indeed too eye-catching, it is not surprising that some people miss it.
"Then we can't let him stay. He is messing around like this. Our factory itself is not big, so don't let him mess up." Xu Shiyan was a little worried.
"Director Dai, you have to be careful about this matter, keep an eye on him, and don't let him make trouble." Xu Shiyan looked at Dai Chunrong.
"Well, don't worry about it, I've been staring at the beverage factory recently." Dai Chunrong nodded.
Of course he knew that the guy was uneasy and kind, and had already arranged for someone to watch him.
An outsider, still want to stir up trouble with them? dream.
