"However, it's best to find a way to get rid of him. There are people who can be a thief for a thousand days, but there are no people who can guard against thieves for a thousand days."
Dai Chunrong was also a little worried, what if this person never leaves?
Qiuu is busy, who can stare at him all day long?
Lin Qiyue and Li Bingzhuo looked at each other, but there was nothing they could do. They were sent by the province.
There is no such thing as firing people in the public office these days. As long as they don't leave, they can't be kicked out.
"Don't worry, wait for me to think about it and find a chance to get rid of him."
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, but he has an idea, which should work.
Everyone knew that Xu Shiyan had always done things safely, so they didn't ask any questions. They just chatted casually for a while, and then they left.
Everyone else left, only Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue were left, and Lin Qiyue only asked at this time.
"Xiao Xu, do you really think we can't develop more of this mineral water? This thing is really making money."
It is impossible to say that Lin Qiyue is not moved. No one can remain indifferent when faced with so much money.
But Lin Qiyue is good at this. He knows how to listen to other people's opinions. If he doesn't understand, he is willing to ask people who really understand.
"It can be developed, but not now, preferably a few years later.
Not to mention anything else, the packaging alone is quite a problem. "
What do you say? To continue to develop mineral water, the first thing to solve is packaging.
Glass bottles are too heavy and easily broken, so they are not suitable for long-distance transportation. If you want to ensure the integrity of the product, you have to work **** the packaging, and the cost is too high.
After all, not all mineral water can be sold at such a high price as the Holy Mountain Tianquan.
If the packaging cost is too high and the selling price is low, there is actually not much profit.
Mineral water is best packaged in plastic, but the current domestic production of plastic is too low.
Even plastic washbasins and plastic sandals can be recycled these days.
From time to time, there are hawkers who carry some odds and ends and go around the streets to exchange plastic products with people.
Why is that? Isn't it because there is too little plastic?
Ordinary plastic products are rare, let alone food-grade plastic packaging. The level of raw materials alone is very difficult.
"Let's not be in a hurry about this, first find someone to walk us through."
Xu Shiyan smiled, no need to say clearly who is behind the back, everyone knows it well.
"Come on, you can do whatever you want with this matter, and the venue fully supports it."
Lin Qiyue understood in an instant that he wanted those jealous people to test their way first.
If it works, they copy it directly, if it doesn't work, they can also avoid the pit.
As I said before, there is a lot of good water in the Changbai Mountain area. I don’t believe that those people can develop all the mineral water?
"Let's do this today. You are quite tired just after you come back. Go home and rest for two days, take care of everything at home, and then go back to work.
Your new office is on the second floor. Turn left at the stairs and take the second room. Go and see the office yourself, and tell Xiao Cao if you are not satisfied. "

chapters.title: Chapter 441: report results
chapters.content:
Chapter 441 Reporting Results
Xu Shiyan was promoted to the deputy director of the field, focusing on technology research and development, and the office was moved to the second floor.
The head of the technical department is now Han Limin, so Xu Shiyan's original office was used by Han Limin.
Recently, the technical department has recruited some more staff. Some of them are students from the field who were admitted to the Agricultural University, Tonghua Agricultural School and other schools and assigned back after graduation.
Han Limin was promoted to section chief, Li Chengrong went to study, and it was estimated that it would be impossible to be a team leader when he came back, so the technical department re-promoted two technical backbones to be team leaders.
Although Lin Qiyue said he wanted Xu Shiyan to go home and rest, how could he be at ease.
I still went to the technical department downstairs to meet and chat with the big guys.
"Congratulations to Vice Director Xu Gao Sheng, um, do you have to treat me? When will it be arranged?"
When Han Limin and the others met Xu Shiyan, while congratulating him, they also had to blackmail him.
"You have to eat something good, you can figure it out." After speaking, everyone laughed.
"That's a must, eat whatever you want, fly in the sky, run on the ground, swim in the water, you pick, I'll find a way."
Xu Shiyan agreed nonchalantly, and laughed with the big guys.
"If I'm not greedy for anything else, I'm greedy for your barbecue.
Another day, let’s set up a few tables outside in the evening, drink and chat while grilling meat, how about it? "
Han Limin has been thinking about it ever since he ate it once during Chinese New Year, so he brought it up on purpose today.
"Section Chief Han, what kind of barbecue, look at you, if you don't bring us any delicious food, it's too embarrassing."
Others haven't eaten it, and they don't understand what it is, so they just yell there.
"Well, you don't understand even after talking about it. Grilling skewers is laborious, and you have to wear them one by one.
If we are like this, we will be idle any day, and a few whole sheep from my farm come over, how about we roast the whole sheep? "
There are now more than 30 people in the technical department, and they eat skewers. They don't feel sorry for the meat, but the people who wear skewers can get tired.
It's better to eat roasted whole lamb, that's easy.
"It's better that Director Xu is straightforward, so it's decided. Another day, Director Xu will treat us to roast whole lamb."
Everyone became happy and angry when they heard it. Even though life is better now, they haven't reached the stage of eating meat.
Not to mention roasted whole lamb, most people have never eaten it.
"Okay, what to eat has been decided, should I report the recent achievements of the technical department?"
Xu Shiyan let the crowd cheer for a while, and then asked.
"Yes, yes, hurry up and report what we have done recently to Director Xu."
Han Limin waved his hand, signaling everyone to be quiet and report all the items that should be reported.
"Our group has made a lot of breakthroughs in the research of edible fungi.
The technology of producing fungus from sawdust fungus bags has been fully mastered, and the fungus can be mass-produced.
Armillaria armillae and small mushrooms can also be cultivated by themselves. The strains we cultivate are more stable in quality than those obtained from Fusong.
Currently, the edible fungus group is preparing to do a strain culture test of Ganoderma lucidum. A few days ago, we took people back from the mountain to bring back several pieces of wood with buds of Ganoderma lucidum.
is observing all day, preparing to collect spore powder for bacterial culture. "Wang Tiesheng, the leader of the first group, reported first.
"Hericium erinaceus, elm yellow mushroom, morel and other strains are also trying to collect and cultivate."
One group is mainly responsible for the cultivation of edible and medicinal fungi, trying to domesticate the natural wild strains for artificial cultivation.
"In our group, the cultivation of dianguo has made some progress.
The Dianguo collected from the mountain last year was cultivated as seedlings. This year, young seedlings have grown. As long as they are carefully cared for, they should be able to bloom and bear fruit. "
Zhang Hengyuan, the leader of the second group, is relatively stable, and speaks neither too fast nor too slowly.
The dianguo he mentioned is actually the wild blueberry in Changbai Mountain, also called dusi bilberry.
Different from the blueberries that were all over the street later, this wild blueberry has a sour taste and small fruit. It is best used to make drinks and jams.
"Dian jujube is also experimenting, but the effect is mediocre, the germination rate of the seeds is low, and the survival rate is not high, and technical research is still needed."
Dian jujube refers to the blue indigo fruit, which belongs to the Lonicera family plant and is a variety of blue fruit honeysuckle.
The berries are oblong, rich in seven kinds of amino acids and VC, and also rich in VP active substances, such as rutin and anthocyanins.
It can be eaten raw, or it can be brewed, made into drinks and jams, and it can also be used to extract pigments.
In the woods behind Xu's house, there are many blue indigo fruits, and the blue indigo fruits are usually ripe at the end of June.
Many children went to the woods to pick and eat them. Their mouths and tongues were purple when they ate.
There are also children who get the green fruit, take off a little bit of the front, and squeeze out the pulp inside, leaving only the skin.
Put it in your mouth and play like a mushroom girl, anyway, the brats have all kinds of tricks.
"The cultivation of soft jujubes is okay, and it has already taken shape. The seed reproduction is afraid of instability, and we are trying cuttings.
Vine grapes are the easiest, and can be propagated by cuttings. "
The second group is mainly responsible for the cultivation of berries, laying the foundation for making fruit juice, fruit wine, and jam in the future.
Although there are wild ones on the mountain, the output and quality are uncontrollable. It is better to have your own planting base.
There is a large area of ​​ginseng wasteland every year. The current policy is to replant the pine tree directly. This is not good. The original broad-leaved forest has become a coniferous forest.
So Xu Shiyan suggested that while planting saplings, it is best to develop small berry shrubs or vines, which is also beneficial to the recovery of plant populations.
The ginseng soil in Pinggang is planted with jujube, schisandra, and grapes, etc., and the place where meadow seeds used to be can be planted with dianguo or dianzao.
Make full use of the advantages of the land, make rational use of the land, and create greater value.
"The cultivation of Gastrodia elata has taken shape.
Our old ginseng field cultivation technology of Gastrodia elata is more advanced than the one announced by the county, with higher yield and quality, and is currently applying for technical appraisal.
Schisandra chinensis cutting technology is no problem, and seed propagation is also fruitful.
Cultivation of Dilonga is also on the horizon. It can be planted and propagated, or it can be propagated by underground rhizomes.
Other Fritillaria, Asarum, etc., also have special nurseries and test fields, and if they grow slowly to a large scale, there will be no problem. "
The third group is the medicinal material group, which specializes in research on the cultivation of medicinal materials in old ginseng land.
No matter which group, the ultimate goal is to make rational use of old ginseng land.
Before the reforestation saplings grow to a certain extent, the comprehensive utilization of ginseng and land can be achieved and the purpose of increasing income can be achieved.
"Okay, everything is pretty good, amazing." Xu Shiyan nodded.
Not to mention all of these have been researched, even if there is only half of them, combined with the deep processing of various products, it can create very large profits for the participants.
Of course, some projects will take some time, and the results will not be so fast. This requires patience, not rush.
"Come on, don't say anything else, just work so hard for the big guy, I have to treat this meat too.
Looking back, I asked Secretary Lin and the others, if one day is free, we will have a small bonfire party together.
You prepare the show, I prepare the meat, let's celebrate. "
It's really not easy. The people in the technical group are not like other workers who can rest when they are dead. They really want to stay in the laboratory every day, or squat in the nursery or the cultivation room all day long.

chapters.title: Chapter 442: new task
chapters.content:
Chapter 442 new mission
"I believe that all the leaders in the field are aware of your hard work. The participation in the field has developed to this day, and the comrades in the technical department have indeed made great contributions.
Regular research is what I just said, so let me talk about the goals we will work hard for in the second half of the year. "
Xu Shiyan took out a small notebook, which was some ideas he had discussed with several professors of the Agricultural University when he was studying in the provincial capital.
“This fall, we’re experimenting with a new way of processing ginseng, natural active ginseng.
This is a brand-new processing method, which uses low-temperature freezing to sublimate the water in ginseng, thereby dehydrating and drying it.
In this way, the active ingredients of ginseng can be preserved to the maximum extent, especially those enzymes, proteins, and vitamins that are not resistant to high temperature, and the nutrition is fully preserved. "
This is a new processing method that Xu Shiyan discussed with the professor of Agricultural University for a long time, and finally decided.
Using this method to process ginseng, the nutritional components are fully retained, and the texture is very brittle and easy to crush, which is beneficial to the feeding of preparations.
Of course, there are also disadvantages, that is, it is easy to get damp, so it should be vacuumed with polyethylene plastic film or filled with nitrogen for storage.
"In addition to natural active ginseng, there are also products such as Tianma ginseng honey and nutritional functional drinks, all of which will be researched and produced this year.
This is to prepare for the Spring Fair next year.
After we go to the market, we need to produce more self-developed products, and produce as little traditional craft products as possible. "
why? It is because they now have the right to export independently.
Now all kinds of products produced by a ginseng factory can be exported directly without going through the county ginseng company and the provincial medicinal material company.
The profits of self-developed products are higher than before, and they can be exported directly to earn foreign exchange.
Especially earning foreign exchange through export is very important, and it is related to the status of a participant in the county or even the province.
Moreover, there are subsidies for export earnings, and this aspect also benefits a lot.
In fact, there are many products that can be made. Xu Shiyan, Mr. Chu and the professors of the Agricultural University discussed no less than twenty kinds of products that can be processed.
However, it is not realistic to make so many products in one go, so we can only choose a few.
Choose ginseng gastrodia honey, mainly because after two years of development, this year there are already hundreds of feet of ginseng gastrodia to be shipped.
If these Gastrodia elata are the same as before, simply boiled in water and dried, they can be sold, but the price is not high and the profit is low.
If you develop new products by yourself and carry out further processing, the value may be multiplied several times, and most people will calculate this account.
Functional drink, this is the formula developed by Xu Shiyan, Mr. Chu and the professor of Agricultural University.
In addition to the essential ingredients of ordinary functional drinks, the formula also adds a small amount of ginseng extract, royal jelly, deer antler essence and other ingredients.
It can replenish qi and blood, resist fatigue, and has certain effects on neurasthenia and loss of energy.
Of course, this is for the time being aimed at those high-end white-collar workers abroad, who often stay up late and use their brains, and are high-end products.
For the time being, don’t think about the domestic market.
"Director Xu, just tell us how to do it. We all follow your command, and we will go to work if you say what to do."
People in the technical department, now one counts as one, are all enthusiastic.
Lin Qiyue said before that as long as the products produced by technical research make money, everyone in the technical department can get bonuses and salary increases.
Nowadays, the wages of even ordinary staff in the technical department are almost catching up with those of the seventh-grade workers.
Not to mention those team leaders, technical backbones, etc., the salary is not low, and the benefits are also high.
Since the venue became rich, the technical department has purchased a lot of research equipment and experimental instruments.
Not only that, but other aspects have also changed.
This year, another eight Dongfanghong tractors were added to the venue, and the staff bath and club were rebuilt and expanded, and the conditions are much better than before.
The newly built garage in the field also has more than 8,000 square meters of staff housing, and more than 70 households have adjusted their housing. The average annual income of each employee can increase by more than 500 yuan.
Where did these come from? Of course, it is the value created by the comprehensive utilization of ginseng, and it is also the result of the hard work of the people in their technical department.
No matter when, this research result must eventually be transformed into visible and accessible benefits, so as to encourage people to move forward and continue to work hard to create research.
The same is true for these people in the technical department. They have tasted the sweetness of independent research and development, so they will definitely work harder to research new products. This is the motivation.
"Okay, then I will assign tasks next, and arrange all the work we have to do in the next stage."
Xu Shiyan nodded, he just likes this group of boys, all of them are full of energy.
How wonderful, life has to work hard to move forward, so that it will become more and more hopeful.
By the time Xu Shiyan finished arranging his work, it was already noon.
Originally, he wanted to go home for dinner, but Han Limin dragged him to Han's house.
Han Wenzhong has not gone up to the mountain to look at the ginseng since the beginning of the contract in the spring of this year. Instead, he has contracted a ginseng land.
He is almost sixty. Although his mental and physical strength are good, Han Limin is worried about his father going up the mountain.
If it was before, I wouldn’t say anything.
But now that the Han family is also rich, Han Limin shared so much money at that time, how could he let the old man go up the mountain to suffer hardship?
If it weren't for Han Wenzhong's retirement in three years, Han Limin would have thought that he wouldn't even let the old man take over the hammer, and just stay at home peacefully.
Han Wenzhong was very happy to see Xu Shiyan coming, so he insisted on asking Li Yuexiu to prepare some good food, and he wanted to have a drink with Xu Shiyan.
As for Xu Shiyan, he hasn't seen Han Wenzhong for such a long time, and he has a lot to chat with the old man for a while, so they simply sat outside in a cool place and chatted.
"Uncle, don't you think it's boring to stay at home like this.
That, how about I find you something to do? "While chatting, Xu Shiyan said suddenly.
"Ah? Just tell me if you have anything to do, and I will do it for you if I can."
Han Wenzhong agreed without any hesitation.
Xu Shiyan just laughed, "That's the way it is, the children in our family are all gone.
The society is in chaos now, so I’m just worried, they will suffer.
Uncle, you are very capable and good at martial arts. I was thinking, can I let the two older ones from my family come over first, and learn some boxing and kicking from my uncle? "
Xu Shiyan has been thinking about this matter for a long time.
He can do some punches himself, but teaching children, after all, is a bit short of fire.
The ancestors of the Han family started an **** agency, and they are the real masters of the skills passed down from their ancestors.
Since the children want to learn from a teacher, they must find a capable person, and they cannot learn from him.
In the past, when Han Wenzhong went up to the mountain to see ginseng, Xu Shiyan was not easy to speak.
Now that Han Wenzhong can’t go up the mountain, Xu Shiyan thought, first let the two older ones come and learn, and wait for the two younger ones to come when they are older in a few years.
Han Wenzhong was stunned when he heard the words, "Huh? You mean to let Yuanyuan and Pingping come to me to learn some kung fu?
Can they be happy? Today's children all pay attention to reading, how many of them pay attention to these? "

chapters.title: Chapter 443: farm planning
chapters.content:
Chapter 443 Farm Planning
"How can we not pay attention to it? The school also pays attention to the comprehensive development of morality, intelligence, physique, art and labor.
No matter what you do, you must first have a good body. What's the use of studying well if you are not in good health? "
Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head. He didn't know whether others valued it or not, but he attached great importance to it.
When he was studying at school, he got up every morning and went for a run.
Without a good body, no matter how many ideas you have, it’s useless.
For the children of the younger generation, they will face greater competition pressure in the future.
The high school entrance examination, college entrance examination, and work are all barriers. Without a good body, it is absolutely impossible.
This must be taken seriously from an early age.
"Well, that makes sense.
That’s fine, you go back and talk to Yuanyuan and Pingping.
If the two of them are willing, they will get up at 4:30 every morning, run to my place by themselves, and practice basic skills with the little ones at home. "
Han Zhenwen, the eldest child of Han Limin's family, Han Zhenan, the second child, and Han Zhenhong, the eldest child of Han Lixin's family, also learned how to practice Changquan from the old man.
One is for teaching, and one group is also for teaching. Two more are nothing, just right.
"Hey, then I'll thank you uncle first, kid skin, uncle can take care of whatever you want." Xu Shiyan was very happy when he heard that.
The children can follow Mr. Han to learn martial arts, no matter how much they can achieve in the future, at least they will not be worse than him, a half-way student, that's all.
At noon, Xu Shiyan ate at Han's house and drank some wine with Han Wenzhong and the Han family brothers.
In the afternoon, he didn't go home directly, but went to the farm.
Currently, Xu Shian is basically in charge of the farm, employing a dozen blind people to work.
The policy has been relaxed in the past two years, and it is nothing to hire more workers.
Unlike before, there was a saying that there should be no more than seven employees.
Everything is developing very well on the farm. After several years of development, the animal population of the farm has gradually expanded.
There are a total of more than 140 sika deer in stock, and there are about 50 adult male deer that produce antler, and the rest are female deer and young deer.
Two crops of velvet antler every year can earn nearly 100,000 yuan.
There are more than 100 musk deer in stock, and there are more than 60 adult male musk deer that can pick musk.
Now the price of musk has risen again, and the farms earn nearly 100,000 yuan a year just from picking musk.
The number of otters remained at about 100 and did not expand, and most of the cubs were sold to breed otters.
The number of sables and raccoon dogs is relatively small, less than a hundred, and some of them are also sold as breeding mink and raccoon dogs.
At present, many farmers in the county have started to engage in special breeding, and Su Anying has also attended several exchange meetings.
Exchange or buy male animals with other farms in Ji'an, Jingyu, Tonghua and other places to improve genes.
Avoid diseases caused by inbreeding of all kinds of animals in the farm.
"Second brother, tell Xiaobo and Xiaotao to study hard.
If they are interested, they will study animal husbandry and veterinary medicine in the future, and then I will let them take care of the farm. "
Xu Shiyan talked to Xu Shian while wandering around the farm.
"Actually, I really want to send you to study, but I don't know if you can learn it?"
Xu Shi'an didn't like studying since he was a child, and he felt sleepy when he read a book. Xu Shiyan was not sure whether his second brother could learn it when he went out to study.
"You go back and discuss with my second sister-in-law. If the second sister-in-law agrees, you have the heart to learn it yourself, and I will find a way to send you to the Agricultural University.
We don’t need a diploma, the main thing is to learn technology, I will pay the tuition fee for you, and it’s almost enough for you to go out and study for two years. "
Xu Shiyan was in the Agricultural University for a year, and he also got a little bit of knowledge.
If you don’t drop out of school, you don’t need your graduation certificate, you pay your own tuition fees, and you go to audit. It’s not impossible to find a relationship.
Of course, most people go to school for the diploma recognized by that country, so it is difficult to handle.
As her own stall gets bigger and bigger, Su Anying may not be able to care about the farm in the future.
But the farm is still very important, especially the deer and musk deer. Xu Shiyan is really reluctant to sell the farm, so he can only find a reliable person to manage it.
No matter how good others are, they are not as reliable as my second brother, but Xu Shian's cultural level is still a little bit worse.
So Xu Shiyan thought, get Xu Shian to study at Agricultural University for two years.
Turning around and officially handing over the breeding products to him, it can be regarded as lightening Su Anying's burden.
If Xu Shian really didn't want to go to school, there was nothing he could do, Xu Shiyan could only worry about it himself.
In the future, choose one of Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao, and see how their academic performance is.
It really didn’t work. After the senior high school entrance examination, I tried to send the two of them to an agricultural school or something, and handed over the farm to them directly when they came back.
It can be regarded as fulfilling the friendship between uncle and nephew in the previous life.
"Huh? Let me go to school? Can I do it?" Xu Shian hesitated a little.
He was very skinny when he was studying, and he would fight with others at every turn. He stopped studying before finishing junior high school.
For so many years, I have already eaten the things I learned at the beginning. Is it okay to go to school now?
"Try it, if people don't put some pressure on themselves, they won't have the motivation to move forward.
My second sister-in-law is a worker, so you should work hard anyway. "
Xu Shian is not stupid, he just didn't put his mind on his studies back then.
Now I just go to learn professional knowledge, mainly practice, animal husbandry and veterinarians can get along with farms.
Xu Shian manages the farm very well, maybe he can learn it.
Xu Shi'an pondered for a moment, gritted his teeth, "That's fine, as long as you can trust me and not be afraid of spending money in vain, then I definitely can't persuade you.
Learn as soon as you learn, can learning with that thing compare to our tiredness of working in the mountains? "
It is impossible to say that Xu Shian didn't regret it all these years if he didn't study hard at the beginning.
Look at the eldest and fourth child, they have at least graduated from junior high school, and now they all have jobs and sit in offices.
Needless to say, the fifth child went to the university he was admitted to, and the third child did not graduate from junior high school, so he has already gone to university.
I heard that the sixth son is in the capital, and he also attends night school.
The brothers in the family were all born to the same father and the same mother, what happened? Is he really worse than others?
"Okay, as long as you think about it, there is nothing that can bother us.
Next year, when I come back from the Agricultural University, I will replace you. I will find out all the relationships in advance and make arrangements for you.
When the time comes, you should work harder and practice more. If there are any training courses in our county this year, you can also go to learn. "
As long as you are willing to learn, it is never too late, and learning is wealth.
"Okay, I'll follow your arrangement, and you can do whatever you want." Xu Shian nodded heavily.
This is a real brother. If you change someone else, who will give you advice and show you the way?
"I won't say thank you buddy, in the future you can rest assured that I will take good care of the farm for you so that nothing goes wrong." Xu Shi'an solemnly promised.
"That's right, I can't trust others, can I still not trust my second brother?
I'll take some time to discuss this matter with Feng Chao and the others to see how to give you a part of the shares.
You can’t be allowed to receive salary, management shares, you still have to give them. "
Having your own shares and working for others are two different concepts. If you want to retain people, you must be willing to spend money.

chapters.title: Chapter 444: Visiting arrangements
chapters.content:
Chapter 444 The Arrangement of Participation
Lin Qiyue gave Xu Shiyan two days off, saying that he was going home to rest, but in fact, he was mainly asking him to arrange things at home.
After all, it was only half a year since I left, and the Xu family is now in the market and the market. The stall is so big, why not go and have a look?
At the other end of the city, the residents within the designated area have already started to tidy up the houses at the west end.
It is estimated that they can move there within three to five days at most.
I have to move early and late, and I don’t have time until autumn when I’m busy.
Besides, there are bonuses, which are not counted in the relocation compensation. It's this time, who doesn't want to make more money?
Xu Shiyan discussed with Su Anying, and then approached Chen Jianzhang and others, and decided that the construction of the city would be broken on August 1st.
"Xiao Xu, hurry up and write the invitation card. It is a major event for the whole county to break ground in our city, and we must invite the county leaders to come over.
There are other villages and towns, all participants are welcome, and no one is left behind.
Let them know that we have participated in the market. "Chen Jianzhang gave Xu Shiyan an idea.
Xu Shiyan was right when he thought about it. Whether the market can develop or not depends on whether it is well-known.
If the ground-breaking ceremony can invite leaders at all levels in the county, and also invite reporters from the county radio station, that will be the best advertisement.
"Don't worry about the hospitality, the town has covered it, and the leaders can't fault it for safekeeping."
The management right of the city belongs to Donggang Town, and after the city is completed and used, Donggang Town will benefit from it.
So Chen Jianzhang took over the hospitality without saying a word.
"What you have to do is to invite people, whether you know them or not, try your best to invite them."
With what Chen Jianzhang said, why is Xu Shiyan hesitating? Start writing invitations now.
After writing the invitation, send people to send it everywhere.
Those students of the Agricultural University sent invitations to those who were near, and made calls to those who were far away. They invited all who could be invited.
After the job was arranged, Xu Shiyan followed Su Anying, Huang Shengli and the others to visit the site.
50,000 zhang to the ground, and the 20,000 zhang sold, many people were shirtless, digging the soil under the scorching sun.
They left the 30,000 feet, and the tractor has turned the ground twice.
The grass roots and tree roots in the soil are all hooked out and piled on the heads of each pool, waiting for a while to dry out, and then just burn them with fire.
Xu Shiyan made a special trip to the field to take a look at the mechanically turned field.
How to put it, it’s really not as fine as manual digging and beating, but it’s not the same.
"While waiting to dump the soil, we must ask them to work more carefully." Xu Shiyan grabbed two handfuls of soil and said with a frown.
If this is left before, anyone who digs the soil will have to deduct work points.
But now it’s completely different from before. This time, it’s 30,000 feet all of a sudden, and it’s all about labor. How many people do you have to hire? Not busy at all.
Mechanization only wins in speed, and in terms of precision, it can't compare to manual labor.
"Well, third brother, don't worry, we will come up to watch in autumn.
There are fewer products this year, so the family can be busy. "Huang Shengli nodded in response.
This fall is the first batch of ginseng production after the division of fields.
At that time, each household allocated more than ten or twenty feet of new planting. Although each family worked very hard, it was small after all.
Deduct the ones that go to hand in the task, and the rest, just wash it at home and make the goods.
"There is also a reference, think about the manpower in advance, such a large area, at least find five blind people.
If possible, it is best to have a local foreman.
Is there such a person in each relative? Can you go up the mountain to see ginseng? Can the salary be higher? "
With such a large piece of land, there must be a leader who can do a good job.
Originally said that he wanted to entrust it to Ji Tongzhong, but after thinking about it, it was thanks to him that he did not agree.
Just like Ji Tongzhong, if he came to see Shen, Xu Shiyan would have to hire a good worker to come up and watch, which is not worthwhile.
"Third brother, can my brother do it?
He has always wanted to move out of the big house, isn't it tight? This year I gave him thirty feet of ginseng soil.
It would be great if he came back to the mountain to watch clubs for three years and then bought a house in Donggang after earning money. " Zhao Jianshe asked hurriedly when he heard it.
At the beginning, Zhao Jianshe moved to Donggang after Xu Shiyan. After that, Zhao Dahai retreated and followed him. Zhao Jianguo and his family stayed in the big house.
In recent years, the big house has become less and less developed. Zhao Jianguo also wants to move out, but he is reluctant to part with the land there, and he is always hesitating.
Last year, Zhao Jianshe earned money, but he didn't give it directly to his brother, even if he was a real brother, he didn't do that.
But when approving ginseng soil this year, Zhao Jianshe left 30 feet of ginseng soil for his brother, and said that his brother doesn't have to worry about ginseng seeds, as long as he can take care of it himself.
So when Xu Shiyan said that he wanted to find someone to work as a leader, Zhao Jianshe immediately thought of his brother.
"Okay, Brother Jianguo is going to come up, so I can rest assured, it's fine, this thing will work.
Then turn around and tell Brother Jianguo that the salary will be double that of the blind man. "
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard this, he immediately agreed.
Zhao Jianguo has also grown ginseng before, and he is familiar with these things, so there is no problem with the foreman.
Besides, Zhao Jianguo is also very nice, with a good personality, so he is the perfect fit.
The crowd wandered around the mountain for most of the day, and Xu Shiyan watched the whole circle of the field.
Kansan is a professional, and he can see at a glance where people are easy to come in.
So I gave some pointers and told Su Anying and the others where to build the kansan’s small house, where to build the watchtower, and where the dog should be tethered.
Ground guns, crackers and other things, where are they mainly buried.
There is no way, Xu Shiyan has to go to school, he has no time to arrange these at home, so he can only arrange them in advance.
After a while, it’s time to come up and build a house. It’s too late. If it’s too late, the weather will be cold and the mud and water will not mix, and the house will not last.
What Xu Shiyan said, the people next to him remembered very carefully.
Su Anying is no stranger to these things now, and she understands them all. Xu Shiyan said that she probably has the terrain layout in her mind, and she can remember it with a little effort.
"Third brother, did you say hello to that ginseng in advance?
We’ve dug out such a big place, don’t let the ginseng seeds go wrong when the time comes, and we can’t spread the seeds, that’s just staring at us. " Huang Shengli asked uncomfortably.
"Well, it's okay, I have made an appointment with our participating secretary Lin, and the remaining ginseng seeds for this year's participation will be reserved for us.
In addition to the first participation, I have also told the leaders of the second and third participation that this year's participation will be tight to us first. "
In fact, the ginseng seeds left by each participant have a surplus every year. Otherwise, there are so many new participants, where did they get the ginseng seeds?
Xu Shiyan made an agreement with several secretaries attending the venue that the remaining ginseng seeds will be given priority to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan doesn't want it anymore, and will sell it to others, so don't worry about ginseng seeds.
"Is the jukebox ready? Don't delay things."
Xu Shiyan was worried about the jukebox. He went to study after drawing the blueprint before, and he didn't know if he could make it.
"It's done, that thing is actually quite simple." Su Anying answered on the other end.

chapters.title: Chapter 445: Participate in the groundbreaking ceremony
chapters.content:
Chapter 445 Participating in the Groundbreaking Ceremony
Walking around the farms, ginseng market, and ginseng land, I have seen everything I need to see.
Xu Shiyan didn't have any thoughts, so he went back to work directly.
Chanshi was relocated soon, Su Anying found some people and set up a special house demolition team.
Whoever’s house has moved, ask the house demolition team to check and accept it. As long as the captain of the house demolition team signs it, the accountant of the company here will settle the relocation compensation and rewards.
Sign for a family, and immediately pick up the house.
Most of the houses in this era are adobe houses. When the roof is lifted, the doors and windows are cut out.
Crowbars, sledgehammers, picks, etc. were placed on the remaining adobe walls and smashed, and the house collapsed in minutes.
Pile up the wood and so on separately, one pile that can be used, and another pile that cannot be used. It is also a good thing to keep the fires in each family in winter.
There are less than twenty houses in total, and they have not been used for two days. All the houses have been removed after moving, just in time to break the ground.
On the morning of August 1st, the ground-breaking ceremony of Donggang Town Can City started amidst the ruins.
Because of this event, Donggang is also extremely lively.
Donggang Central Primary School was originally on vacation, and for this event, all the children from the drum team, waist drum team, and dance team were called back to perform.
Comrades from a participating art troupe also came to help out, singing and dancing were particularly lively.
A large banner was specially pulled up above the venue, which read the groundbreaking ceremony of the Donggang Town Ginseng Market.
This is because there are no such conditions for future generations. If there were, hot air balloons, various banners, etc., could all be produced.
Guan Enxue, Chang Hongfa, Jiang Yunfeng and other county magistrates and secretaries all arrived.
Relevant leaders from the Bureau of Specialty Products, Bureau of Agriculture, Ginseng Company, Ginseng Research Institute, and Ginseng Society also came along.
The four state-run venues in the county and the township venues have arranged for people to come.
The three forestry bureaus of Songjianghe, Quanyang, and Lushuihe also arranged for people to be present.
Songjianghe's side happened to be Guo Shouye.
But Xu Shiyan was too busy to chat with Guo Shouye, mainly Xu Shiyan's classmates from the Agricultural University, and many people came.
Shao Yong, Jin Yongqing, and Park Zhengzhe all came.
"Brother Shiyan, congratulations, the siblings are really capable, and they invested in such a big project."
In fact, everyone here knows that the market participation project was Xu Shiyan's idea, but Su Anying is the legal person of the company, and she came forward for everything.
"Brother Shao, Brother Jin, can't you come a day earlier?
Come early, let’s get together and have a drink together, you have to rush today, right? "
Xu Shiyan was also very happy to see his classmates, especially those who lived in the same dormitory.
"You Brother Shao is not easy now, he has been promoted to deputy county, and he is busy, if he can find time to give you a show, it will be beautiful.
Still thinking about our early arrival? Dreaming. "
Pu Zhengzhe laughed as soon as he heard it, and patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and said.
"Yo, Brother Shao, why didn't you tell me when I called you about such a big matter?
Congratulations, you are amazing. Among our classmates, you are the first one, right? "
This group of students are indeed candidates for deputy county-level cadres, but even if they want to be promoted, they should be promoted after returning from their studies.
How can anyone get promoted after halfway through college?
"Cough, don't you know?
In their county, they dealt with a lot of people because of Clivia's incident, and a lot of seats were vacated.
Besides, at the beginning, Brother Shao tried his best to dissuade you. You called back several times to explain the situation. Didn’t those people not listen?
So this time when Brother Shao went back, you directly referred to the deputy county. "
Jin Yongqing and Park Zhengzhe are in different positions, of course they know more than Xu Shiyan, so they have to explain it to Xu Shiyan in a low voice.
Xu Shiyan finally realized that there was a reason for the co-authorship.
"Brother Shao, help me more in the future."
Regarding this matter, it is not appropriate to say congratulations. After all, Shao Yong and his county lost a lot of money and lost a lot of people.
But without this matter, it would definitely not be so easy for Shao Yong to raise the issue.
Xu Shiyan thinks it's better to change the subject, so as not to embarrass Shao Yong.
"Still helping you? You are the God of Wealth now, and I still want to ask you to help you.
Can you see what projects we can develop? Give me a trick.
You are now well-known and rich in the province, earning more than 10 million dollars a year in foreign exchange. You can ask, who wouldn’t be envious? "
Shao Yong understood Xu Shiyan's thoughts, so he continued to follow the words, with a look of wanting to blackmail Xu Shiyan.
When everyone heard this, they all laughed, "Yes, yes, Lao Shao's words are reasonable.
Brother, please go to our place some other day, and help us think about it, what projects are there.
Let us also get some projects on the other side, and export to earn foreign exchange.
We don’t ask for much, and we don’t want 10 million. If we can have 5 million a year, we will be satisfied. "
Jin Yongqing and Park Zhengzhe put their arms around Xu Shiyan's shoulders on the left and right, and smiled half-truthfully.
"Okay, when I'm free another day, I'll come to you, and you can have fun, eat, drink, and have fun, as long as I'm satisfied."
Xu Shiyan knew that they were joking, so he followed suit.
How can men be so serious when they are together, they are considered civilized.
There was shouting over there, the ceremony was about to start, Xu Shiyan and others hurried over, each found their own seats and sat down.
In this kind of ceremony, all the leaders must speak one by one. The county, the town, and the general manager of the investment company, that is, Su Anying, all have to speak a few words.
Needless to say, Guan Enxue, Chen Jianzhang, etc., they are all professional, and there is no problem with the scene.
The most surprising thing was Su Anying. I didn't expect her to speak on stage with a calm expression, and the whole process was unscripted.
"Hey, brother and sister are amazing, Xiao Xu, you wrote this manuscript, right?
Brothers and sisters can do it, I don’t read the manuscript the whole time, and I don’t stop in the middle. "
Lin Qiyue is the attending secretary, he will definitely come on this occasion, and he happened to sit next to Xu Shiyan.
Looking at Su Anying's demeanor on the stage, Lin Qiyue was also in admiration.
In this occasion, if his daughter-in-law were to go up, she would definitely have her calf twisted from fright, and she would speak out of script throughout the whole process. It would be difficult to say a few words.
Xu Shiyan was also full of pride when he looked at his wife who was smiling and speaking calmly on the stage.
At this moment, he finally found his roots, because his child is smart, and he followed his wife.
This manuscript was written by him, but it only took one night to get it into Su Anying's hands.
Look at others, not only memorize it, but also the expression and tone are natural, flowing and flowing in one go, without any pause in the middle.
As far as this ability is concerned, it is quite convincing.
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan also felt a little regretful.
The daughter-in-law of his family, if she had studied at the beginning, she might be a cadre somewhere now. It is definitely not the situation it is now.
Of course, if Su Anying had read the book, she would definitely not marry him, an old farmer. This might be fate, and the marriage is destined.

chapters.title: Chapter 446: Guan Enxue is dissatisfied
chapters.content:
Around the venue, there are all people who heard the news and came to watch the excitement.
Thanks to the simple clearing of the open space, earth and stone wastes are piled up in the corner.
Although the scene is broken, it is not chaotic. Even with so many people around, there is no safety hazard.
After each leader spoke, there was thunderous applause, and the drum team even played a piece of music.
When Su Anying came to speak on stage, Su Weizhong, Han Cai'e, Xu Chenghou, his wife and everyone who knew Su Anying were very excited.
"Old woman, look, that is our daughter-in-law.
Hey young man, I really didn't realize that our Yingzi is so powerful, listen to her, how well she said. "
156n.
Xu Chenghou looked at his daughter-in-law in the distance, he was more excited than he was when he came to speak on stage.
"Isn't it? Just now I didn't dare to recognize that it was our Yingzi.
Take a look at her outfit, how pretty is she dressed? Just like the host in the New Year's party.
No, our Yingzi looks prettier than them. "
Zhou Guilan is a woman, which is naturally different from Xu Chenghou.
Xu Chenghou paid attention to the content of the speech, while Zhou Guilan paid attention to the image of his daughter-in-law.
Su Anying wore a white silk shirt and a dark blue skirt with dark patterns today. These were the clothes that Xu Shiqin specially sent back from the capital.
After Xu Shiqin went to the capital, Han Liwei found an evening school for Xu Shiqin through his connections, specializing in learning about clothing fabrics and design.
When Xu Shiqin is not studying, he likes to wander around the shopping malls, or else he just goes to places with many foreigners.
When I see the style of clothes I like, especially the clothes worn by foreigners, I buy fabrics and cut them out when I come back.
Xu Shiqin knew that Su Anying had started a company and became the general manager, so he made a lot of clothes for his sister-in-law for various occasions and mailed them back.
Xu Shiqin's craftsmanship is impeccable, this outfit is simple and majestic yet dignified.
Su Anying cut her hair short and curled her hair at the end. She looks fashionable and foreign, especially like a strong woman.
Xu Chenghou couldn't help sighing when he heard what his old wife said.
"I asked you to listen to what my daughter-in-law said, but I didn't let you see how my daughter-in-law dresses up."
Xu Chenghou is an old-fashioned figure. To be honest, Su Anying's outfit is a bit out of order in his eyes.
Xu Chenghou also understands that the status of the daughter-in-law is different now, and she can no longer dress up in a rustic way like before.
So even though Xu Chenghou didn't like it in his heart, he never said it.
"I just watched my daughter-in-law look so well-dressed, what's wrong?
I’m just getting old, and I haven’t caught up with the good times. If I was young, I would also dress like this, how beautiful it is. "
Zhou Guilan glanced at her husband, "You old man, old-fashioned, I have to punish you."
At one end, the old couple of the Xu family were arguing, while at the other end, Su Weizhong was full of remorse.
Looking at the dignified and generous daughter who spoke calmly on the stage, Su Weizhong regretted it. Why didn't he let his daughter study in the first place?
It's a pity, if his daughter could study at the beginning, she would definitely be successful.
Thinking in his heart, Su Weizhong couldn't help but look at Han Cai'e next to him, but seeing Han Cai'e also had a face of remorse. …
Yes, among the six daughters, only this one did not go to school, but looking at it now, this is the only one who has the ability to count.
Things in this world are always so unexpected.
Not to mention that the people who watched the fun had different thoughts, but only mentioning that on the stage, after Su Anying finished speaking, there was even more enthusiastic applause and cheers on the scene.
Everyone knows that this participation in the market is led by Su Anying's investment.
When people are rich, they can still think about these local folks in their hometown, and invest in such a large project to benefit the local people in the future.
Then who is not happy? Everyone applauded vigorously.
After all the leaders finished speaking, the drum team over there played music again, and then the host announced that the groundbreaking ceremony officially began.
Guan Enxue, Chen Jianzhang and others came to the front of the venue with shovels tied with red silk in their hands.
The music continued on this side, and the firecrackers were lit on the other side.
Guan Enxue and others, in such a lively atmosphere, bent down to pick up a shovel of soil, which was considered as the start of construction.
At the other end, newspaper and radio reporters, photographers and videographers, all carried various equipment to record this historic moment.
There was applause again, and then, the elementary school waist drum team, dance team, and actors from the art troupe performed on stage.
The show was actually for the audience present, and the leaders on the stage began to whisper to each other at this time.
It is rare to have such an opportunity to communicate, who wouldn't want to take the opportunity to chat about something useful?
The show was still going on, and all the leaders on the stage had quietly come down, and left the scene one after another, heading to the town guest house.
Donggang Town prepared a sumptuous banquet to entertain all the guests.
Everyone also took advantage of this opportunity to chat with those who knew each other, and find someone to introduce to those who didn’t know, and took the opportunity to connect with each other.
Multiple contacts lead to multiple paths, this friend has been handed over, who knows when it will be useful?
These people are different from ordinary people. Maybe someday there will be project cooperation and make money together.
"Old Lin, you're acting so dishonestly. The county hasn't said anything yet. You first promoted Xiao Xu to be the deputy director.
Why, are you afraid that I will **** Xiao Xu away? "
Guan Enxue had long wanted to settle accounts with Lin Qiyue, this old boy was too dishonest, so he took care of things first without even saying hello.
"I also want him to host a research institute and specialize in research and development. That's good, let you take the lead."
Originally, Guan Enxue had discussed with Chang Hongfa. After Xu Shiyan finished his studies at the Agricultural University, Xu Shiyan was transferred to the Ginseng Research Institute as the deputy director.
Xu Shiyan is young after all, so he may be dissatisfied with being the director directly.
Start working as a deputy. After five or six years, the old Liu of the research institute will be old enough to retire.
At that time, Xu Shiyan will be the director, isn't it good?
Unexpectedly, Lin Qiyue took the lead and appointed Xu Shiyan as the deputy head of the field, focusing on technology research and development.
"That's needless to say? Who doesn't know that Xiao Xu is a talent? When he comes back from his studies, will it be our turn to participate?"
Lin Qiyue laughed when he heard Guan Enxue's words, and didn't take Guan Enxue's words to heart at all.
"Actually, this matter is not difficult to solve. The county can move the ginseng research institute to our office." Lin Qiyue said this deliberately.
"Secretary Guan, I'm really not joking with you, it's the truth.
Our participation, whether it is funds or experimental equipment, is fully supported.
The county research institute still has to wait for the county financial appropriation. How much money can the research institute receive each year? "
Lin Qiyue's words were not intended to poke Guan Enxue's heart, but really for the good of the county.
Ginseng technology research is actually a very expensive project.
Which one must not have a large amount of ginseng to do the experiment? Is there any research?
Where is it like participating in the field, there are so many ginseng, you can experiment as much as you want, you can have multiple projects if you succeed, and it doesn’t matter if you fail.
Those products that have failed in research can still be crushed and refined to add active ingredients to other products.

chapters.title: Chapter 447: Quanyang Lake
chapters.content:
Chapter 447 Quanyang Lake
Guan Enxue gave Lin Qiyue a blank look, "You old boy, did you do it on purpose?
The appetite is big enough. You have a technical department yourself. It doesn’t count if you have a technical talent like Xiao Xu. Do you still want to get the research institute there? You are so beautiful. "
Actually, Guan Enxue was really moved by Lin Qiyue's suggestion, but this matter involves all aspects, and it is not that simple.
Lin Qiyue shrugged indifferently, "Look, if the county can't offer better conditions, then don't blame Xiao Xu for staying with me.
Anyway, on the side of the field, we fully support the research and development of the technical department, give people, give money, and buy equipment if we want it.
If the research institute in the county can have this condition, I will definitely not stop Xiao Xu if he wants to leave. "
No way, money is such a stubborn thing.
Now a ginseng market can earn more than 8 million US dollars a year just for mineral water and Coke, plus honey chips and Changbaishan red ginseng, it can earn almost 11 or 2 million US dollars.
This is foreign exchange. Those who can export and earn foreign exchange are subsidized. After deducting costs, profits and taxes, etc., the number of participants is several times higher than before.
Lin Qiyue has tasted the sweetness of independent research and development, so he naturally fully supports the technical research and development.
When the comprehensive utilization of ginseng and land is fully developed in the future, it will be awesome as soon as it participates in the field.
Xu Shiyan, it is absolutely impossible to release it outside, and the county is not easy to handle.
Of course, Lin Qiyue really misses the Ginseng Research Institute, the top ones there are all scientific and technical personnel with real materials.
If these people can be lulled into a participating arena, with Xu Shiyan leading them, then they will be awesome when they participate in the arena.
But this is very difficult, the county will not release people easily, so we will slowly find a way in the future, and sooner or later we will poach all the people.
Guan Enxue was very angry at Lin Qiyue, so he talked to Lin Qiyue without hesitation, and turned to look for Xu Shiyan.
"Xiao Xu, don't just think of ideas for the participants.
When I have time, I will also help our county to make moves, at least to help drive the economy of our county.
I see that mineral water is a good idea, so you have no other suggestions? "
Not to mention the province is concerned, the county is also concerned about mineral water. The main reason is that it is too much money, and everyone is jealous.
When Guan Enxue mentioned mineral water, Chen Jihui at the next table immediately pricked up his ears and listened attentively.
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, then smiled, "Secretary Guan, it's not that there is nothing to say.
There is a Quanyang Lake under the jurisdiction of the Quanyang Forestry Bureau, which is also a very high-quality mineral water, and the gushing volume is huge, which has great potential.
To be honest, Secretary Lin and I are both thinking about it.
But there is one thing, it is a bit far away from the venue, and it is not convenient for management.
Moreover, with such a large amount of outflow, we may not be able to develop it just by pointing at our factory. "
"Quanyang Lake? Oh, there is a plan to build a brewery over there."
Guan Enxue listened and patted the table.
If a brewery is to be built on the other side of Quanyang, the water from Quanyang Lake will be used. The project has been approved by the county, and the next step is to build a factory for production.
"It doesn't matter if you produce beer, it doesn't conflict with mineral water.
The water in Quanyang Lake is good, so it can be multi-faceted.
Look, beer, liquor, wild mountain wine, mineral water, fruit juice, and cola are all a series of products.
As long as the money is in place, the overall development series will be launched, and the product competitiveness will be improved. As long as it is done well, who else can compare with us? "
Xu Shiyan smiled. In fact, as long as the mind is open, these are not difficult.
On the other side, Chen Jihui was dumbfounded. He came from a beverage factory anyway, but he didn't have these things in his mind.
If this is really what Xu Shiyan said, with such a factory, how much money will it make a year?
Chen Jihui is not the only one who is dumbfounded? Even Guan Enxue and Lin Qiyue were dumbfounded.
Especially Lin Qiyue, he doesn't know anything else, but he knows about mountain wine and fruit juice.
The technical department of their field is now researching these things, and the participants even specially approved a nursery for them to cultivate saplings.
If those hadian fruits, dianzizi, soft jujubes, schisandra, and mountain grapes are successfully cultivated, how many ridges are planted, and the fruits are produced to make wine and beverages, I think the prospect is too bright.
Lin Qiyue quickly winked at Xu Shiyan, not letting him talk anymore.
"Oh, Xiao Xu, you say that you are an honest boy, and your heart is too real.
With a few good words from Secretary Guan, he brought out all his understated skills.
You have said all the ways to get rich and generate income, can we still seize the opportunity to invest in this place? "Lin Qiyue complained half-truthfully to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan had an incredulous expression on his face, "Can't you?
Secretary Guan, we came up with this idea, no matter who the county finds to develop it, they have to bring us one, right? "
"Bring, bring, definitely bring you. But even this investment is probably not a small amount.
Well, the county will go back and think about it. At that time, it will attract investment, set up the factory, and hire you as a consultant. "
Guan Enxue was very happy, he never expected to come to Donggang to gain such a big reward.
While chatting, the dishes came out.
For this meal, Donggang is going all out, flying in the sky, running on the ground, swimming in the water, whatever is rare.
In terms of fish alone, there are Aohua, Xilin and Daozi, all of which are well-known cold-water fish.
Venison and roe deer meat are common, and there are even flying dragons.
The Feilong Stewed Soup doesn’t need any seasoning, the taste is old and fresh.
In addition, there are shredded ginseng and tremella snow clam soup.
Anyway, what I can think of comes up, and the unexpected also comes up. Just this meal is really worth a lot of money.
This kind of occasion is not for eating and drinking, but Donggang has prepared so many rare dishes, which really makes everyone admire.
It can be seen that Donggang has turned over all his family fortunes for this participation in the market.
As the company's largest shareholder and general manager, Su Anying is the largest investor participating in the market, so she must have entertainment on this occasion.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan was always by her side, and the husband and wife toasted to the leaders together.
Others actually know that Su Anying, the general manager, is just a person who does things on the surface, but Xu Shiyan is actually making suggestions.
Nowadays, no relevant policies have been issued, and family members and children of public officials can do business.
Besides, Xu Shiyan is just a worker in the factory, and now he has become the deputy director of the factory, and he has nothing to do with government officials.
So Su Anying's business is not in violation of the policy at all, and no one can control it.
"The virtuous couple contribute money and efforts to their hometown, this level of mind is worth learning from.
Come on, let's have a toast to Mr. Su and Mr. Xu. "
Someone suggested it, everyone agreed, and everyone raised their glasses together to show their respect for Xu Shiyan and his wife.
Su Anying doesn't drink, so it's very difficult to look at the wine glass in her hand.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan has a good capacity for alcohol. After drinking his own cup, he also drank the one in his wife's hand.
They are all people on the scene, and they pay attention to decency. The big guys look at Xu Shiyan's face, and no one will deliberately embarrass Su Anying.
So there are not many people who really toast to Su Anying, so Xu Shiyan doesn't need to block too much wine.
Of course, there were quite a few people looking for Xu Shiyan to drink, and there were quite a few people who were drinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 448: with cut beard
chapters.content:
Chapter 448 has a beard
The couple Xu Shiyan and Su Anying are currently considered to be the hottest figures in the county.
On such an occasion again, many people came to chat with the couple.
Just like those in charge who participated in the venue, they all found a chance to chat with Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan also took the opportunity to finalize the purchase of this year's ginseng seeds with several other participants.
The three participating secretaries all agreed that Shenzi must keep Xu Shiyan tight first, so that there will be no trouble in keeping it.
After wandering around, I arrived at the leaders of the Forestry Bureau.
"Brother Guo, I'm really sorry that I couldn't chat with you for a while.
Well, Fengxia's high school entrance examination is over, right? Have the results come out? Can I be enrolled in a secondary school? "
Xu Shiyan toasted a round of wine, and then he had time to sit next to Guo Shouye and chat with Guo Shouye.
"The high school entrance examination has ended long ago, and the score is not bad, just over 600.
The school of post and telecommunications in the newspaper at that time also had a school of banking. Judging from the results, the post and telecommunications school was probably not enough, but the bank was about the same. "
The Changchun Bank University mentioned by Guo Shouye is a college run by the Bank of China, which was later upgraded to a financial college.
After graduating from this school, they are directly distributed to various banks.
From the current point of view, it is indeed a good school, with a solid job, which is pretty good.
"Oh, that's really good. You see, you always think that the child is worthless. Isn't that a good test?"
Xu Shiyan heard this and was also happy for Guo Shouye. The banking industry is still very good these days.
"She did well in the exam, and she can't usually get this score." Guo Shouye was naturally happy when his daughter did well in the exam.
"Wait for the notice to come down, treat you to a drink.
If the child goes to the provincial capital to study, I will not send it off. I will directly entrust the child to you and you will take it to the provincial capital. "
This is to really stop treating Xu Shiyan as an outsider, and even dare to entrust Xu Shiyan to his daughter to go to college.
"By the way, there is another thing, your sister-in-law said that she is very fond of your eldest son.
You said that our family is not young enough to arrange a doll kiss with your family, let me see, how about treating your family as a godson to me? "
Guo Shouye is not drinking and talking nonsense, he and Peng Yucui have already had this idea.
The relationship between the Guo family and the Xu family must be strengthened. It is not possible for children to be in-laws, but it is okay to be in-laws.
Xu Haiyuan's baby is quite rare, and Peng Yucui always said it after seeing her a few times.
Guo Shouye also thought it was a good idea. When he saw Xu Shiyan today, he suddenly remembered it, so he mentioned it casually.
"Hey, Brother Guo, you are thinking about my son.
Hahaha, okay, I'll talk to Yuanyuan about this later, that kid has a good idea, I have to ask him.
As long as he is willing, let's set up a few tables some other day. "
In this day and age, it is very important to recognize godfather and godmother, and it is necessary to set up a few tables of wine.
"Success, that's the deal, after you ask the child, send me a letter.
Well, there are a lot of people here today, so don't just chat with me, the two of us can chat whenever we get together.
Hurry up to accompany the secretary, and your classmates, these are all resources and contacts. "
Guo Shouye is not an easy person to get to where he is today.
He was afraid that Xu Shiyan would not be able to entertain him, and he would offend someone, so he instructed Xu Shiyan to chat with others.
Xu Shiyan naturally understood that he just came to chat with Guo Shouye, so he answered, got up and went to talk to others.
Donggang Town warmly entertained all the guests.
Satisfied with wine and food, we have almost talked about what we should talk about. Everyone still has work, so they leave.
After the guests were gone, Xu Shiyan and his wife chatted with Chen Jianzhang, Zhou Qingguo and others for a while, and then went home.
The performance over there in Sanshi is over.
Donggang Elementary School Drum Horn Team also participated in an art troupe. The money that should be given has already been paid, and they can just leave after the performance.
Of course, after the foundation stone laying ceremony is over, construction here will officially start. The construction team that built the house before will continue to work here.
At present, this market is an open-air market, so it is not difficult to build it.
The east and north frontages are covered with a second-floor store, with a gate left in the northeast corner.
The west and south sides were originally said to be directly repairing the fence, but after thinking about it, the money is enough anyway, so just build a cold storage and forget it.
Keep the stock for future use, you can rent it out, or use it for yourself. You can’t waste such a large space in vain.
In this way, it is equivalent to building houses around the city, and the corresponding water supply, drainage and other issues must be carefully studied and planned.
The design drawings were specially invited from the province to lead the design by the professors of the University of Architecture.
The other party also arranged for a few students who were planning to do internships during their junior year holidays to come and give on-site guidance, and they were treated as internships by the way.
Professional people design and plan, and watch the work on site, so there is no need to worry about it here.
For a layman like Xu Shiyan, it is better not to point fingers in the past, and it is important to return to the field to work honestly.
If you want to research new products, natural active ginseng, you need to buy related equipment.
Xu Shiyan mentioned this to Lin Qiyue a long time ago. When Lin Qiyue went to the Spring Fair, he negotiated with foreign customers about the relevant equipment.
In addition to freeze-drying equipment, the site also took the opportunity to purchase related equipment for water quality testing.
It is said that a mineral water and cola production plant must be equipped with a water quality inspection laboratory.
But the factory is too small and there are no relevant talents, so at the beginning of the establishment of the factory, sampling samples were sent to the county for testing every day, and sent to the provincial capital once a month.
This is not a long-term solution, so when Lin Qiyue came back from the Spring Fair, he asked for two college students from the relevant departments of the province. They had just graduated, and they happened to be assigned to participate in the fair.
The equipment ordered for the Spring Fair just arrived in the past few days, and the two college students also came to report with relevant documents.
Just selected a few young people from the technical department, and then selected a few students who graduated from high school but did not go to university as apprentices. The water plant quality inspection station was officially established.
The quality inspection station not only conducts random inspections on the pass rate of products, but also conducts random inspections of water source samples three times a day in the morning, noon, and evening.
Ensure the safety and quality of water sources in beverage factories and mineral water.
Since returning from the day when the city broke ground, Chen Jihui asked for leave, saying that he had something to do at home and went back to the provincial capital.
Who hasn't had a big deal? Lin Qiyue couldn't say no to leave, so he granted leave.
As a result, Chen Jihui left and didn't come back for several days.
Chen Jihui's absence is actually quite good, at least it's quiet, and no one messes around all day long.
But no one expected that ten days later, news came from the county that the provincial beverage factory had invested 3 million yuan and cooperated with the county to build a large beverage company in Quanyang.
The business items include beer, liquor, mineral water, beverages, etc., and the overall person in charge of this project is Chen Jihui.
"Fuck, co-authoring this kid back to the provincial capital is just to cut off our next investment.
Hey, it's so unnatural, you can grab everything.
Didn’t Secretary Guan agree to bring us a share? Why doesn't this count? "
When Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong heard the news, they all went to find Lin Qiyue.
"Director Li, Director Dai, isn't this pretty good? We don't need to kick him out, he left by himself."
Xu Shiyan had already guessed that they would come, and had been waiting in Lin Qiyue's office for a long time.
"Huh?" Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong were dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: Lulu appeared
chapters.content:
Chapter 449 Wandering appeared
"Old Li, Lao Dai, sit down, let's sit down and talk slowly."
Lin Qiyue waved with a smile, asked Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong to sit down, and asked the secretary to make tea.
"This matter was originally planned by me and Xiao Xu."
Lin Qiyue personally poured tea for Li Bingzhuo and the others, explaining with a smile.
Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong were even more confused, not understanding what this meant.
What do you mean by negotiating in advance? Co-author Xu Shiyan said that the hype was falling on purpose the other day, were they acting on purpose?
"That's the case. Secretary Lin and I have had an in-depth discussion on the matter of the mineral water plant.
Both of us believe that it is not suitable for mass production at present, and the problems of sales channels and packaging are not easy to solve. "
Xu Shiyan continued on.
“Currently the mineral water and cola produced by our factory are all high-end.
Do not ask for output, but only for high quality and high price, less but better, just our spring water is enough, no need for additional development.
I mean, at least three to five years later.
Wait until the problem of plastic packaging can be solved, when our high-end products have gained a firm foothold abroad, and we can develop domestically later.
Find another place to build another factory, and it is completely in time. "
"Isn't our technical department currently studying the artificial domestication and planting of various wild fruits? This is a favorable condition for us to enhance the competitiveness of our products.
In the future, we will have our own wild fruit production base, and we can build a factory for production by finding any good spring water.
Now that we are building a factory, what can we do? Brewing beer and liquor?
We are participating in the field, isn't the main business still ginseng?
If it is to produce some medicinal wine or something, it is barely reliable, but there is no need to invest millions in the whole factory, right?
Even if we really want to produce medicinal wine, there are plenty of good wineries in the county, just let them make wine according to our standards.
Why bother to invest millions in the whole factory to make wine? "
Actually, no matter which industry you are in, if you can specialize in it, it will be great.
Sometimes it is not necessarily good to be big and all-rounder. Why can’t many big factories survive?
The main problem is that they want to get involved in everything, and all kinds of downstream and upstream industries want to do it themselves.
Too large a stall will result in a bloated, clumsy and inflexible organization. Once an accident occurs, it is difficult to change the direction.
"Our factory will soon research and produce nutritional functional drinks, and we will still take the high-end route.
Let’s play something with technical content that others can’t play for a while, earn more money, and don’t have to work overtime to produce, that would be great.
As for Quanyang, let the surname Chen to toss it. If he can figure out the factory within three years, he is considered capable.
If he doesn't understand, the provincial beverage factory will invest several million, and if things go wrong in the end, it will be for naught.
It's not that we are expecting bad things from others, we also hope that someone will walk us ahead, right? "
Xu Shiyan laughed while talking, but there was more meaning in this smile.
Many people in the province are envious of the mineral water industry because of its low cost and high profit.
Otherwise they could have sent Chen Jihui over?
Since they are jealous, let them try and see if they can play well?
If you can play well, there are examples over there, and you can avoid detours once you join the game.
The mineral water market is huge, and no one can monopolize it. As long as the market positioning is accurate, everyone can get a share.
If they can’t play well, and after a few years they will make themselves crippled and foolish, it’s because they have no ability.
I only know that I am jealous of others making money, but I can't manage it myself. No need for others to tell me, I have to leave in despair.
For a participant, it doesn't affect anything at all, and it's also good to get rid of people who are bothering and confusing.
That's the end of the story, if Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong don't understand, then the deputy head of the field doesn't have to do it.
"Come on, don't say anything, go to work."
As long as they don’t suffer from participating in the field, it doesn’t matter to them that others love to die and live. If you have that spare time, you might as well go back and watch the production.
Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong came like a gust of wind, and left like a gust of wind.
Xu Shiyan also stood up at this time, "Secretary Lin, if there is nothing else, I will go to work.
There are still a lot of things on the technical team, I have to watch them do the freeze-drying test.
There is also the functional drink, which needs to be sampled as soon as possible. "
Xu Shiyan led people to do experiments all day long, so he couldn't care about other things.
Fortunately, Zhou Qingguo was watching over the city. Zhou Qingguo had just been promoted as the deputy mayor a while ago, and he was in charge of the construction of the city.
With him here and with Su Anying, the progress of the construction of the city is not too slow.
Su Anying suggested before that she would build four houses on the east side of her family, and Xu Chenghou would build five wing rooms on the other side.
She is watching this matter personally, and it is progressing very smoothly. The foundation has been laid and built to the level.
This time, Su Anying also learned from Canshi, and used steel bars to make ring beams, making the house stronger.
After the ring beam is laid, the cement needs to be cured, and the brick wall can only be built up after it is cured.
With Su Anying and Xu Chenghou watching, the progress of building a house at home is not slow.
As for the mountain, Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others were watching, and when it was not raining and it was sunny, they set the grass roots on fire.
Big tree roots, Xu Shiyan said don’t burn them, they have a car now, and they will bring them back when they come back in the evening.
Waiting for the winter to be all right, cut it out with a chainsaw. The roots are strong, and it is best to burn the stove.
Zhao Jianshe and the others were obedient. When they came back every afternoon, they greeted those who worked, put half of the roots of the big trees on top, and pulled them back.
One car for this house today, one car for that house tomorrow. Just pile it up outside the garden stick, no one would steal it.
Surrounding the ground, you can see that the small house of Kansan also has a look.
Those timbers dismantled in the market, such as girders, purlins, eight boards, shed boards, door frames, window frames, doors, windows, etc., were not good and were kept for fire, and all the good ones were transported to the mountains.
With housing materials for more than a dozen households, isn’t it more than enough to build a few small houses that you have chosen to build?
