Just right, save money, effort and worry, very convenient.
In a blink of an eye, it was almost August 20th, and Guo Shouye's daughter was admitted to Changchun Bank School.
At the request of everyone, Guo Shouye arranged several tables to entertain relatives and friends.
Guo Shouye specially called Xu Shiyan and asked Xu Shiyan to take his parents, wife and children to the bustling past.
Before, Guo Shouye said that he would recognize Xu Haiyuan as his son.
Xu Shiyan discussed with his parents and daughter-in-law after returning home, but Xu Chenghou and the others had no opinion.
Xu Chenghou also said that both Guo Shouye and his wife have both parents, and they also have sons and daughters.
Xu Haiyuan is a bit too smart and precocious, which is not a good thing. It is a blessing to know a godfather and godmother, and maybe you can take it with you.
Although Xu Shiyan didn't really believe these words, but his father said, he would not object.
Regardless of whether the Xu family and the Guo family have a relationship or not, they should get along as usual.
So I asked Xu Haiyuan again, and Xu Haiyuan didn't object to that kid being a ghost. So this matter is considered to be an oral agreement between the two parties.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: Acknowledgement
chapters.content:
Chapter 450 Acknowledging the relationship
On August 18th, Guo Shouye arranged five or six tables at the Forestry Bureau Guest House.
Didn't call outsiders, they were all relatives and close friends, just having fun together.
Xu Shiyan and his wife brought a lot of congratulatory gifts to congratulate Guo Fengxia on the gold list.
"Everyone, this is the son we have recognized, Xu Haiyuan, the fourth child of our family."
Before the banquet began, Guo Shouye formally introduced Xu Haiyuan to relatives and friends.
In this day and age, it is not like before, there are still so many things to pay attention to.
In front of relatives and friends, setting up two tables of wine is nothing more than that.
Guo Shouye intends to kill two birds with one stone. He even celebrates his daughter's entrance into school, and brings him to congratulate him on accepting his son.
Otherwise, these relatives are busy and don't have time on weekdays.
"Yuanyuan, go, kowtow to your godfather and mother." Xu Shiyan whispered to Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan is so smart. Hearing this, he immediately came to Guo Shouye and Peng Yucui, knelt on the ground, and slammed his head three times.
"Hello godfather, hello godmother."
"Hey, good boy, we don't like this old ritual anymore, get up, get up."
Peng Yucui quickly helped Xu Haiyuan up, took out the red envelope from his pocket, and stuffed it into Xu Haiyuan's pocket.
"This is from the godmother, you keep it.
These are clothes, shoes and socks bought for you. Your godmother is stupid and doesn’t know how to make them herself, so she can only buy them. "
Xu Haiyuan was not polite, he just accepted the red envelope, and took things. "Thank you godmother, my godmother is the best."
The little guy had a sweet mouth and stood beside Peng Yucui with a smile, coaxing Peng Yucui into a dizzy state.
Guo Shouye and Peng Yucui are not young anymore. Guo Fengxia, the youngest in their family, has passed the high school entrance examination this year. There are no children around her, and the rarest thing is children.
Xu Haiyuan is good-looking, fair and chubby, and behaves very well when he goes out, he can deceive people.
Peng Yucui met Xu Haiyuan, so why not be confused?
"Yuanyuan, come, this is your godfather and grandma."
Guo Shouye's parents also came down from the forest farm today. Guo Shouye called Xu Haiyuan over to greet the two old people.
The old couple of the Guo family heard their son and daughter-in-law talk about the Xu family, and they knew that the relationship between the two families was good.
Although the old couple didn't quite understand Guo Shouye's recognition of his role, but seeing Xu Haiyuan's obedient appearance, the old couple was quite surprised.
So they each took out a red envelope, counting it as a meeting gift for their grandson.
Guo Shouye recognized Xu Haiyuan as his son, and all three children of the Guo family came to recognize his younger brother.
The children of the Guo family are all grown up. The eldest has already graduated from a technical secondary school and has been assigned a job.
They already knew that their parents were going to take a job, so they prepared gifts for Xu Haiyuan in advance.
Now, Xu Haiyuan has gained a lot, and he is very happy to have three more brothers and sisters who love him.
At Guo Fengxia's college entrance banquet, Guo Shouye recognized her god-son, and since then, the Xu family has gained another god-in-law.
In the future, every year and festival, Xu Haiyuan will come over to visit his godfather and godmother.
In the future, no matter whether Xu Haiyuan goes to school or gets married and has children, Guo Shouye and his wife will also contribute.
All those who can come are close relatives and friends. Although everyone is a little puzzled about Guo Shouye's employment, they don't care what Guo Shouye does.
Everyone can just congratulate her. "Cousin, congratulations.
Look at you, the three children have all been admitted to technical secondary schools, and they are all promising.
It’s really good to have such a cute baby as a baby today, double happiness, congratulations. "
Everyone called this cousin, and that called brother-in-law, anyway, they were all talking about celebrating.
Guo Shouye's current status is one of the best among his relatives, so no one can be flattering. Everyone is very polite to the Xu family.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were arranged next to Guo Shouye's parents. The four old people got together and had something to talk about.
After a while, the banquet started, and everyone was pushing cups and changing cups, eating and drinking, and it was quite lively.
After the banquet, the relatives and friends of the Guo family left one after another. Xu Shiyan chatted with Guo Shouye for a while before he left.
"Dad, Mom, come out to the left and right for a while, let's take a stroll around and have a look."
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan seldom come out for a stroll, so Xu Shiyan wanted to take his parents around the Songjiang River and look around.
"What is there to see on a hot day? It's better to go home."
Xu Chenghou raised his head and glanced at the sky, it was past two o'clock in the afternoon, when it was hot, what did he do for a stroll?
People who are exposed to the sun are getting oily, so they might as well go home quickly.
Xu Shiyan thought about it too, it's a bit hot today.
"Didn't I just watch you and my mother stay at home all day and have no time to come out?" Xu Shiyan laughed.
"Forget it, let's go west and take that road, there is a donkey cart passing by."
The Guest House of the Forestry Bureau, later known as the Pine Forest Hotel, is on the north side of the Pine Forest Hospital.
This area belongs to the Forestry Bureau's territory. Go west from here to Songjianghe Street, and the other side belongs to the town.
The donkey carts pulled from the train station usually go straight, and only turn around at the corner building to go to Donggang.
There are eight people in this family, including children.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui are still young, and they led them all the way back home. The children are tired, and the adults are suffering, so let's find a cart.
The key point is that Huang Shengli and the others drove up the mountain to work in the three half-units. Xu Shiyan just came to have a meal, so why not drive a car?
A group of people walked west from the road north of the guest house, walked to Songjianghe Street, and waited for the passing donkey cart.
As a result, I saw a lot of people surrounded the labor insurance store.
"What's that for? What new things are there in the labor insurance store?
Go, go and have a look, let’s buy some if you don’t need a ticket. "
Zhou Guilan saw that there were a lot of people on the other end, and she immediately regained her spirits.
Don’t blame her, it’s been like this every year, no matter which store, as long as there are people together, there will be things that don’t need a ticket in storage, and many people will go to grab them when they see them.
"Yingzi, take the child to find a shady place to stay. I'll accompany my parents to have a look. There are too many people, don't crowd the child."
Xu Shiyan thought it was funny when he saw his mother's eagerness to try, so he asked Su Anying to take care of the child, and he accompanied his parents to have a look.
Su Anying led the four children and sat down in the shade to rest.
Xu Haiyuan was actually thinking about the excitement over there, but his father told him not to let him squeeze, so he didn't dare.
You have to know that he has several red envelopes on him. With so many people, what if the red envelopes are squeezed out by him?
Let’s just stay put.
So he sat on a rock and stretched his head to look at the door of the labor insurance store.
Xu Shiyan walked into the crowd with his parents, "Excuse me, please, don't crowd the old man and old lady."
While speaking, he pulled the crowd with both hands, and got out of the way a little bit, just like that and squeezed in with his parents.
As a result, I squeezed in and found that there was a row of six motorcycles in the crowd.
The new mopeds from the labor insurance store are produced by Yuzhou Jianshe Machine Tool Factory, with an orange body and a Jianshe brand.

chapters.title: Chapter 451: motorcycle
chapters.content:
Chapter 451 Motorcycle
In this day and age, motorcycles are still rare, and there are not too many big cities, let alone a small town near Songjiang River.
So the six motorcycles displayed at the entrance of the labor insurance store attracted many people to watch.
It’s a new thing for everyone to look at, and you can’t afford it, why don’t you take a look?
"Yo, motorcycle, this is a motorcycle produced jointly by Yuzhou and Dongyi Yamaha, it's okay."
Xu Shiyan's eyes lit up when he saw the motorcycle.
Xu Shiyan had been thinking about buying a motorcycle before. When he was studying in the province, he also wandered around. He had seen both imported and domestic ones.
But there is one thing, if he bought it in the provincial capital, it would be too troublesome to ship it back.
After thinking about it, I didn't buy it in the provincial capital.
I was too busy after I came back, so I didn't bother to go around the county. I didn't expect to see it in the labor insurance store today.
"How did you sell this car?" Xu Shiyan was very moved, so he asked him about the price.
"Why are you asking about those? You still want to buy it?" Zhou Guilan looked at the motorcycle, how expensive is this thing?
"You go to school, and you can't ride this thing when you go to school. When you come back to work, don't you still have that half at home?"
"Look, son is still studying? He can't come back to work?
In the future, I will have to work everywhere in the mountains, venues, and homes, pointing out how strenuous it is to ride a bicycle.
The half is used for working in the mountains. How can anyone drive that thing in normal life?
They all burn oil, and that thing consumes too much oil. When Xu Chenghou heard this, he quickly explained to his old wife.
"What's wrong? Do you want to buy one to take home?"
Xu Chenghou looked at the motorcycle, and he also looked at it very nicely. With such a thing for transportation, it is much better than a bicycle.
"Then if you like it, buy it. Is the money enough? If not, let's go home and get the money."
Otherwise, Xu Chenghou has also changed his concept in the past two years.
Now is not the same as before. You can no longer look at things with old eyes, and get in touch with new things more.
Furthermore, no matter how old a man is, he has no resistance to cars.
Xu Chenghou is old, but if he is twenty years younger, he will definitely not be able to move when he sees this motorcycle.
"Well, I want to buy one to go home. Wait a minute, I'll go over and ask how much it is."
Xu Shiyan still likes this motorcycle, and the moped is very good for transportation.
It’s more convenient than a bicycle to go to work or go to a farm without pointing at the load.
As Xu Shiyan said, he went to the salesperson to inquire about the price, and when he asked, it was 870 yuan.
How to say, Xu Shiyan's place is not expensive, but in the eyes of ordinary people, this thing is really not cheap.
After inquiring about the price, Xu Shiyan murmured with Xu Chenghou and thought the price was acceptable.
However, they didn't bring that much money with them when they came out to eat.
So he hurried out of the crowd, dragged Su Anying's mother and son, stopped a donkey cart that was pulling its feet, and hurried back to Donggang.
Then Xu Shiyan took the money from home, returned to the labor insurance store, and spent 870 yuan to buy a motorcycle.
The car had a little gasoline in it, so Xu Shiyan went directly to Guo Shouye and asked him to get some gasoline for him.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan had a motorcycle and knew how to ride it. Moreover, this kind of moped has a continuously variable speed, no need to shift gears, no difficulty, and he can ride it.
Xu Shiyan rode his motorcycle back to Donggang, stopped in front of his parents' house, and deliberately honked his horn twice.
The wing room is being built here, and the brick wall of Sanqi has been built up to the position of the door and window.
When the workers in the construction team heard the sound, they all looked down.
"Yo, new motorcycle, just bought? It's so beautiful.
Or you have to be Director Xu, you are the first one to buy a new motorcycle in Donggang, right? "
The leader of the construction team looked at it and asked with a smile.
"Well, I went to eat at noon, and when I walked back, I saw that the labor insurance store sold them.
I couldn't move my legs when I saw it, so I simply bought one, otherwise it would be troublesome to run around all day.
With this thing for transportation, you can travel a long distance with just one kick, which is very good. "
Xu Shiyan put the motorcycle up and locked it with a smile, and entered the yard from the back.
The west side connects to the wing room, and the original gate has to be moved. For the time being, a door is opened at the north side of Yuanzhangzi, waiting for the house to be built.
Before Xu Shiyan entered the room, Xu Haiyuan who heard the movement in the room all ran out.
"Dad, I want to ride a cart." This time, Xu Haiqing ran first.
He heard from his grandfather at home that his father was going to buy a car and came back, and this kid was thinking about it, and he had to ride a big cart.
Xu Shiyan picked up his youngest son and put him on the motorcycle.
"Sit tight, how about this car? Do you like it?"
Men, from seventy to eighty, down to just able to walk, probably all the same, like cars.
Xu Haiqing was no exception. Sitting on the motorcycle, his eyes were shining brightly.
"Wow, big cart. It's so beautiful." This kid still can't understand some words, but others can understand.
Over there, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping also gathered around, all staring at the motorcycle with bright eyes.
"Dad, take us around." Xu Haiyuan stretched out his small hand, touched the car body, and liked it very much.
"Okay, let's go around and say yes first, the four of you will be divided into two, I can't afford to take four."
There are many children in the family and there are also worries. At this time, the father is not enough.
Xu Shiyan put Xu Haiqing on top of the fuel tank in front, he was in the middle, and Xu Haiyuan sat behind.
"Sit still, Yuan Yuan hugs Dad's waist."
After telling the children to sit still, Xu Shiyan kicked the motorcycle and took the two sons around slowly.
Turn back, put on the two daughters again, and go for a walk in the same way.
"Hey, Director Xu bought a motorcycle? How much is it?
It’s amazing. You said that your home has a color TV and a refrigerator, a big car and a motorcycle. It’s really enviable to live a small life. "
Everyone is out in the summer to enjoy the cool, Xu Shiyan is wandering around with the child, can others not see?
No matter who sees it, they will all be envious.
"That's right, he is the head of the factory now, and his wife is the general manager, so can it be the same as us ordinary people?
With this condition, I can afford anything. "Of course, there are also people who have a sour taste in their words.
The Xu family is booming these days, who wouldn't be jealous? It's normal to be sour.
"Well, I just bought it today, and the kids have to sit down and try it out. Isn't this taking them out for a while?"
Xu Shiyan didn't care much about what other people said, anyway, he just wanted to live a comfortable life.
Where is the money, don't steal it or grab it, earn it by skill, and spend it as he likes.
It’s just a motorcycle. If he’s willing to move around in a few years, he’ll even buy a car.
That night, Zhao Jianshe and others came back from the mountain, and before they had dinner, they learned about Xu Shiyan's purchase of a motorcycle.
"Third brother, where did you buy the motorcycle? It's very good. Otherwise, I'll just buy one too. It's convenient for everything."

chapters.title: Chapter 452: The test was successful
chapters.content:
Chapter 452 The test was successful
Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli saw that the motorcycle Xu Shiyan bought was very good, and they also wanted to buy it.
This thing usually goes up the mountain to play with clubs and other things, which is much better than riding a bicycle.
The key point is half the waste of oil, if it is not pulling people and things, but just going up the mountain to collect weeds and spray medicine, it is a waste.
Zhou Qingguo is also very interested in this motorcycle. Now that he has been promoted as the deputy mayor, he has to go down to the village from time to time.
Especially since the autumn harvest is coming soon, I have to run everywhere, and a jeep is not as convenient as a motorcycle.
There are some roads where jeeps cannot drive, but motorcycles can run, which is convenient.
After these discussions, they all went to the labor insurance store the next day.
As a result, a total of six new motorcycles came in to the labor insurance store, and within two days, Xu Shiyan and his group covered them all.
On August 20th, elementary school returned to school and Xu Haiyuan officially entered the third grade.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu also entered the first grade of primary school from Yuhong Class, and started their primary school career.
Speaking of which, the two were able to enter the first grade because of Xu Shiyan's finding someone, and because of Xu Haiyuan's face.
The school teachers all know that Xu Haiyuan is good at studying, and they also heard that Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu are both Xu Haiyuan's younger siblings, and Xu Haiyuan watches and studies all day long.
With an elder brother like Xu Haiyuan who is both good in character and academics in charge, the two children will definitely not be bad, so the first grade teacher agreed to admit the two children to school.
Otherwise, with Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu, it is impossible for her to enter the first grade even before she turns six.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu were in first grade together with Zhao Lili, Yang Jianjun, Su Lijuan, Jiang Chunhong and others.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu were in the same class, Jiang Chunhong was in the same class, and the other children were in the other three classes, but they all went to and from school together.
Anyway, there are more children now, and every day is a big gang.
That's fine, at least you don't have to worry about your child's safety.
Before, Xu Shiyan was still worried. He knew that his family was rich, so he was afraid that someone would take advantage of the opportunity to kidnap Xu Haiyuan or Xu Jinping.
This thing really happened.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan’s cousin, Zhou Wanxiang, started his business with dumping wood and saved millions. His wife was almost tied up.
There is also the boss of Jinlong Wood Industry, whose children are kidnapped at every turn.
The kidnappers don't want human life, they just want money, and if they give the money, they will be released.
Finally, the boss had no choice but to arrange a veteran to be the driver to pick up and drop off the children to and from school.
In this day and age, the outside is still quite chaotic, and Xu Shiyan dare not say that no one really thinks of him.
Fortunately, the Xu Haiyuan brothers and sisters are very popular, and every time they go out, there are a large group of people.
Even if someone cared about it, it would be hard to deal with so many children.
Another one, Xu's house is also close to the school, and it takes less than five minutes to get home after leaving the school.
Xu Shiyan often tells his children to go home after school and never stay outside.
If you want to play, go home and say hello to the adults first, and then go out to play with your friends.
Don’t go too far, there is an open space next to the martyr’s tomb at the back, people come and go, there are so many people watching, nothing will happen.
Xu Haiyuan and the others are obedient.
Wake up at 4:30 every morning, run to Han's house, then practice boxing until 6:00, then run home, and go to school after dinner.
Yang Haoyu, a follower, doesn't leave anything behind. He heard that Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping learned their skills from Han Wenzhong, so he also cried and wanted to go.
His family lives in a large group, and there is a small road behind the house leading to the front of Shenchang Primary School.
Every morning, he waited for Xu Haiyuan and the others at the entrance of the alley, and then went to Han's house together.
Not to mention, this kid runs and exercises with Xu Haiyuan all day long, nothing else can be seen, his appetite is good, and his appetite is much better than before.
Little blushed, much stronger than before.
Yang Junxian and his wife were also very happy to see that the child could bear it and that his health was getting better and better.
Taking some time and carrying something, I went to thank Han Wenzhong.
After school started, the children went to school every day, and the house became much quieter.
It's land ginseng and house building, Su Anying is busy enough.
Fortunately, Han Cai'e moved here, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui were coaxed away by Han Cai'e.
Zhou Guilan and Xu Chenghou are taking care of the workers who are building houses on both sides, so they are busy anyway.
Xu Shiyan can't take care of the stall at home. He is leading people to research this low-temperature freezing technology.
Don't look at this thing, it sounds simple, but it's actually very complicated to operate.
How much temperature should be controlled, how long does it take for each specification of ginseng to freeze-dry, and ensure that the nutrients are not destroyed?
In order to do the test, Lin Qiyue specially approved to dig a few feet of sticks from the mountain, and repeatedly tested the data every day to see if the finished product was qualified.
"Director Xu, this product has passed the inspection and is completely qualified.
Low moisture content, ginseng keeps its shape intact after freeze-drying, in a crisp state, and shatters when touched lightly.
This is the data from the laboratory. Our natural active ginseng has more nutrients than ordinary sun-dried ginseng and red ginseng. "
After several days of work, the product made today finally passed the inspection.
Xu Shiyan broke open a freeze-dried ginseng with light force, and observed it carefully with a magnifying glass.
You can see that the cross-section is full of loose small holes, which are formed by the water in the ginseng condensing into ice and directly sublimated.
Looking at the test data again, the expected goal was indeed achieved, and some components that were not resistant to high temperatures were retained.
"Okay, save all the records of the test, and then follow the records of this time, and test a few more times.
If we can ensure that the quality of the product remains consistent, our new product will be considered a success.
Later, I went back to the province to study, took the samples to the medical university for testing, and then applied for technical appraisal and so on. "
Now basically this is the process. Every time a new product is produced, it is first sent for inspection.
After passing the inspection, it will be sent for technical appraisal.
Wait for the inspection report and technical appraisal to come down, and then take it to Hong Kong City to apply for a patent.
Avoid shameless people from certain countries and learn from them secretly.
Although the cost of registering a patent is not low, compared with the cost, the profit is greater.
Lin Qiyue fully supports this, and will give as much as he wants. Anyway, as long as it is developed by the company, don't run away, and those who can register must register.
The test of natural active ginseng was successful here, and the experimental production of functional drinks has also come to an end.
The new product is light red in color, with the fragrance of ginseng and honey, sweet and sour taste, refreshing taste with fine and dense bubbles, much better than that cola.
After tasting tests by people in the field, this product does have refreshing, anti-fatigue and other effects.
Of course, there are ginseng and deer antler ingredients in it, even if it is less, it still has some effect.
You should know that ginseng and velvet antler, in ancient times, were the things that ministers had to use before they went to court, and they were called ginseng antler supplements.

chapters.title: Chapter 453: Submit the prescription
chapters.content:
Chapter 453 Handing in the prescription
In the past, those ministers got up early in the morning and went to court, discussing things until almost noon.
Can’t cry hungry, can’t go to the toilet, what are they pointing at to cheer up? This is the ginseng tonic.
The formula of this functional drink comes from this.
Of course, the weight has been adjusted, and many other ingredients have been added.
While ensuring the taste, it also increases its functionality. It is definitely the first choice for those who often stay up late, overuse their brains, and feel tired.
Not only is it refreshing, but it also has the effect of nourishing qi and blood and improving energy. This is something that other products do not have.
These two more labor-intensive products have been successfully developed. As for the ginseng and Tianma honey, there is not much technical difficulty.
Fresh ginseng and Gastrodia elata are sliced ​​and prefabricated, and soaked in good honey.
Make the medicinal properties fully integrated into the honey, and then it can be sold in jars.
Several expected new products have been successfully developed, and Xu Shiyan can finally breathe a sigh of relief.
These days he is so busy that he lives in the field for several days, wishing he could just sleep in the laboratory, and he can't take care of anything at home.
He couldn't even go back to build a house and put up beams.
Seeing that the day to return to school is not far away, he has to go home quickly to pack his things.
"Limin, I'll leave this to you, I have to go home and clean up.
It's time to go back to school in two days, and I promised Brother Guo to **** Fengxia to the provincial capital, so I can't delay things. "
Xu Shiyan took off the laboratory, changed the clothes used for the experiment, and casually explained to Han Limin.
"Okay, go home quickly, you've been growing up in the laboratory for a while."
Han Limin glanced at Xu Shiyan, who had an unshaven beard and black eye sockets, and shook his head.
Aside from other things, Xu Shiyan's ability to delve into research is really unmatched by ordinary people.
"By the way, tell the big guy about it, tomorrow afternoon, we will roast the whole lamb in the yard of the field department.
I promised you before, but I have been busy and haven't fulfilled it. It just so happens that the development of new products is almost done.
Recently, everyone has been working very hard. Tomorrow night, our small party will be very lively. "
When I came back at the end of July, I promised to eat roasted whole lamb. Until the beginning of September, I was always busy and had no time.
I'm going back to school and back to the provincial capital soon, so what I promised must be fulfilled.
"Come on, with your words, those monkey cubs can work hard today." Han Limin laughed when he heard it.
Xu Shiyan smiled and patted Han Limin on the shoulder, "I will be making goods in autumn soon, I will leave the technical department to you.
Be sure to control the quality of the products, which is the foundation of our site's survival.
All right, I'll go home first, if I don't go back, I guess your siblings will dislike me. "
Xu Shiyan came out of the field department and didn't go home directly. He went to the barber shop to shave his head and face to tidy up.
The things made these days are really out of shape, and they go back in a sloppy manner, and the family must be worried if they see it.
When passing by the participating store, Xu Shiyan even bought some food for the children.
There are no good things, such as biscuits, peanuts, soda, etc., I carry a bag, hang it on the handlebar of the motorcycle, and sneak out home with one kick of the accelerator.
The motorcycle just turned the corner from the weather station, and after walking a short distance, it seemed that there were several cars parked in front of my house, all of which were military green jeeps.
When I came to take a closer look, it turned out to be the door of my own house. What's going on?
Xu Shiyan got out of the car quickly, put the motorcycle towards the door, and walked in.
It turned out that several young men in grass-green uniforms were standing in the yard in an orderly manner.
Xu Shiyan was surprised, who is here? It wouldn't be such a big show when my brother-in-law came back.
Xu Shiyan walked quickly into the house, entered the east room and found that besides Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan, and Su Anying, there were several people in uniforms.
One of them knew from looking at the clothes that he seemed to be a big cadre. What's the situation?
"Comrade Xu Shiyan, right? We were entrusted by our superiors to come and talk to Comrade Xu about the prescription."
When the people in the room saw Xu Shiyan enter the door, they immediately stood up and saluted Xu Shiyan.
"Comrade Han Liwei reported that Comrade Xu was willing to donate the prescription to the organization.
Thanks to Comrade Xu for his selfless dedication.
The organization believes that this prescription is very useful, and the organization cannot ask for it in vain, and specially ordered us to bring corresponding compensation. "
After saying this, Xu Shiyan understood that these co-authors came to get the secret recipe.
As for the secret recipe, Xu Shiyan wrote to Han Liwei after seeking Elder Chu's consent, saying that he could hand it over.
When dispensing the medicine, Xu Shiyan didn't have any good equipment on hand, and the craftsmanship was not so exquisite.
Xu Shiyan hopes that after the prescription is handed in, the relevant departments can summon medical experts to use some high-tech means to purify the ingredients of the medicine and maximize the efficacy of the medicine.
His strength alone is too small, I hope that after the prescription is handed in, it can play a big role.
"The prescription, right? Please wait a moment, I'll get it right away." Xu Shiyan nodded, then turned and went to the inner room of the east room.
The original secret recipe and medical handbook given by Mr. Chu were hidden by him, and there were only two separate prescriptions.
One is oral pills, and the other is topical powder for pain relief and bleeding. Xu Shiyan copied these two copies in advance and put them in the study.
Xu Shiyan found the secret recipe he had copied in advance from a book, and then came out of the east room and handed the secret recipe to the other party.
"This is a total of two secret recipes, one of which is the pills that Liwei and the others take after they are injured, and they need to be prepared with more than a hundred years old wild ginseng.
The other part is for trauma, it can quickly stop bleeding and relieve pain, anti-inflammation and detumescence, and it also contains ingredients of old mountain ginseng. "
When dispensing the medicine, Xu Shiyan wasn't sure what would happen to Han Liwei. He just did his best and prepared all the medicines for internal and external application.
Now that the organization needs it, Xu Shiyan doesn't hide it, and gives it all to others.
"The prescription does not belong to me, it is the ancestral secret recipe of the old professor Chu Xuanhuai.
Compensation, I can't ask for a penny, and Mr. Chu said that he doesn't want it either.
We only have one request, the prescription must be kept secret and must not be leaked.
This is something that has been handed down by the Chu family for hundreds of years. It is the essence of traditional Chinese medicine and a legacy left by the ancestors.
It cannot be taken by those who are greedy for profit in exchange for benefits. "
Don't care who the other party is, you have to say what you have to say.
Chu Lao is dedicated to the public, and his family has passed down the secret recipe for hundreds of years, so he handed it in as soon as he said it.
Not for fame and wealth, but just want to contribute to the development of medicine.
The old man is in his seventies, and what he looks forward to most is that these prescriptions handed down by the Chu family can be carried forward again.
Xu Shiyan doesn't have the ability to inherit the mantle of the master, so he can only find a good place for these prescriptions.
Dedicating it to the organization is undoubtedly the best way. I believe that with the ability of the medical experts in the organization, this prescription will not be buried.
"Comrade Xu, please rest assured, and please tell Elder Chu, we will definitely live up to the elder's wishes."
The other party took the secret recipe with a solemn expression, and carefully stored it in a box.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: couple gossip
chapters.content:
Chapter 454 Husband and wife gossip
Xu Shiyan insisted that the prescription was not his, and he just handed it in for free according to Elder Chu's wishes.
The other party is helpless, and it is not easy to talk about compensation.
I can only go back first, report to the superior, and then look at the meaning of the superior.
So the other party bid farewell and left, and Xu Shiyan's family went out to see them off.
Seeing those jeeps running away without a trace, Xu Chenghou and the others breathed a sigh of relief.
"When the person came, I was taken aback. I thought it was something wrong. Later, I said that I was looking for a prescription from you.
All right, Mr. Chu's secret recipe is not very useful in your hands, maybe it will be of great use if you hand it in. "
"Well, I think so too. Let's not ask for anything else, just don't bury Elder Chu's prescription."
Xu Shiyan smiled, turned around and walked into the house.
"Well, since there is nothing else to do, let's go back.
The house is still tidying up at home, maybe there is something missing. "
Xu Chenghou saw that nothing was going on here, so he told Xu Shiyan, and they went home.
Someone saw several jeeps parked at the gate of Xu Shiyan’s house just now. Xu Chenghou and his wife thought that something happened to the uncle’s unit, so they hurried over to have a look.
It's okay now, they have to go home and watch the house clean up.
The houses of the two families are progressing very fast, and the beams were completed a few days ago.
Xu Shiyan was at the most critical time in the laboratory at that time, wishing he could sleep in the laboratory, how could he have time to come back and take care of the upper beam?
Fortunately, Xu Shian is here, and the brothers-in-law Nan Zhendong, Ji Tongzhong, Li Zongliang, and Li Chengrong all came to help.
In addition, all the neighbors who have a good relationship with the Xu family came to help, and the nine houses of the two families were successfully built.
In the past few days, we have been building partitions, setting up stoves, etc. It is estimated that in half a month, we will basically finish cleaning up.
Su Anying followed what Xu Shiyan said, and planned to install a heating boiler.
Xu Chenghou resigned. He thought it was not cost-effective to turn on the heating because there were few people in his family.
Just the old couple, they usually cook and cook, and the house is not cold.
It's really cold, just burn the stove and fire wall or something.
The old man said that the old couple are too old to burn the boiler. If they don’t know how to do it, what can they do about the soot poisoning?
Su Anying can't stand Xu Chenghou, so I can only let him.
Anyway, the house is built first, and there is still time to install the heating in the future.
"I'm going to have dinner tonight, and I happen to have some meat at home, so I'll make dumplings for you.
Look at you, you are suffering from this, your eyes are closed, pay attention to your body later, no matter how busy you are, you have to rest when you should. "
Zhou Guilan followed her husband and left. Before going out, she glared at Xu Shiyan, thinking that Xu Shiyan didn't know how to take care of her body.
What can Xu Shiyan say? Hehe smiled and fooled the past.
No way, he still has to go back to the provincial capital to study. If he doesn’t take advantage of the summer vacation to produce new products, wouldn’t it be a big delay?
Parents have left, Su Anying went back to the house and took out clean clothes from Kangqin, and handed them to Xu Shiyan.
"Hurry up and change your clothes, my God, look at your shirt collar.
You said that it’s okay for you to live in the venue, at least bring a few more clothes for a change of clothes.
Boil some hot water and take a bath at night, it’s also for you. "
Xu Shiyan has been busy doing experiments recently, and really can't take care of anything.
"I was afraid that you would dislike me, so I went to shave my head and face." Xu Shiyan smiled and changed his clothes.
Su Anying hurriedly took away the changed clothes, threw them into the basin and soaked them, and scrubbed them out later.
"By the way, daughter-in-law, I promised Limin and the others that tomorrow night, I will treat them to roast whole lamb.
We plan to be in the yard of the field department, and the whole small bonfire party is a celebration of the successful development of new products. "
I have to tell my wife about this matter.
"Oh, all right, bake it.
If you want to use it tomorrow night, it is best to tell the other side of the farm today, use a few sheep, and let the second brother lead someone to kill them directly tomorrow morning. "
Su Anying doesn't care much about these things, there are plenty of sheep on the farm.
Ewes produce goat milk to make milk tofu to feed sables. What else can rams do if they don’t eat it?
Xu Shiyan was right when he thought about it, so he grabbed the phone and called the farm.
Tell Xu Shian that he will kill some sheep tomorrow morning, and he will treat his colleagues to roast whole sheep in the evening.
Xu Shian asked how many to use, and promised to pick a few fat ones to kill tomorrow morning.
"Hey? Didn't see the two little ones, where did they go wild?"
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone before he realized that he had been home for so long and hadn't seen the children.
The two older ones started school, and it was only around three o'clock in the afternoon, so it wasn't time for school to end yet.
What did the two little ones do? Not with grandparents, not at home?
Su Anying rolled her eyes, "You are so busy that you are about to lose your home, and you still remember the two younger ones? They are with my mother.
My mother and I were busy kicking the back of our heads, and those two were shopping again. People who build houses here come and go, but the key is that there is everything on the ground, so what if they mess around and get hurt?
So let my mother pick it up, and pick it up after dinner at night. "
No way, the couple are too busy to take care of the children.
"Thanks to the mother-in-law who moved in, you said that our husband and wife are so busy all day long that we don't know what to do."
Xu Shiyan shook his head and laughed, sometimes thinking about it, he also felt that it was unnecessary.
Even if their family doesn't do anything now, it seems that there is no shortage of food, drink and flowers, but they still work so hard, why?
"It will be fine when I come back from school. I will be at home then, so I can share some of it."
Xu Shiyan felt that he felt sorry for his wife. He went to study and let it go, and all the people outside the house pointed at Su Anying.
Thanks to Su Anying's ability, it might not be possible to arrange it if it were a different person.
"Okay, don't say sweet things about me here.
Even if you come back from school, there are so many things in the unit, how much can you share? "
Su Anying curled her lips, old couples, don't use this kind of talk to fool people.
"Okay, if you are tired, go to sleep for a while, I will rub out these two clothes you changed.
The collar of the clothes is almost stained to death, and it is useless to put it in the washing machine. "
In Su Anying's view, washing clothes in a washing machine is the same thing, it can't keep up with washing hands.
Anyway, there are only two of these, and it’s not worth using the washing machine. It’s not too cold at this time, so I put them in the yard and rub them a few times before they come out.
Xu Shiyan didn't feel tired, so he simply went to the house to the east of his house to wander around and look around.
It’s okay, these four houses are similar to the five on the west side, the two on the east side are also bigger, the kitchen in the outhouse, and one on the west side.
Su Anying means that the new house can accommodate people, so she plans to move here in winter.
Anyway, there are many houses, so it’s the same where you live, so arrange it as you like.
"Wait for a few days, and after finishing cleaning up there, I will find someone to nail the shed. According to what you said, I will fasten the front with a plastic shed.
Then install a heater in the house, and burn more fire in winter, it will definitely keep you warm. "
Su Anying moved swiftly, quickly washed the clothes and hung them on the rope, and came to look at the house.
It happened that there was no one working here today, so Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand and hugged his daughter-in-law to lean on his shoulder.
"Family affairs are all arranged by you, and you can do whatever you want. Daughter-in-law, you have worked hard."

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Roasted Lamb
chapters.content:
Chapter 455 Roasted Whole Lamb
On the morning of September 7th, Xu Shiyan told Lin Qiyue that the people in the technical department would eat roasted whole lamb in the evening, which was an early celebration.
Lin Qiyue heard that this new product was successfully developed. Just say that money is paid in the field.
Xu Shiyan naturally refused to take it, he only said that the sheep had been killed, and that Lin Qiyue and others would come to have fun at night.
Lin Qiyue thought about it, and there were quite a few people in the technical department alone, plus there were still people in the field office.
It’s impossible for people in the technical department to eat while others watch, right?
For such an old person, how many sheep can be roasted to eat?
So Lin Qiyue hurriedly ordered the cafeteria to prepare a minimum of five tables in the evening.
It’s good to have some hard food, some wine and so on, and the big guys will be lively together.
The 7th happened to be Saturday, and around four o'clock in the afternoon, the big guys started to tossing around in the yard of the field department.
Move out all the tables and stools in the cafeteria and arrange them, and set up a rack for roasting whole lamb over there.
Pile hardwood firewood under it, and light it in advance.
When the wood is heated to a certain extent, there is no smoke, and when there is only red burning charcoal, the mutton marinated with seasoning and fixed with wire is placed on the shelf.
Grilling while turning the handle.
The red hot charcoal fire quickly dried the moisture on the surface of the mutton and began to emit oil.
The meat marinated with special seasoning gradually released its aroma and drifted away with the wind, causing everyone to sniff and swallow.
"Wow, isn't this too delicious? When will it be ready? It's too greedy."
Someone couldn't bear it, so they approached the fire and asked when it would be ready.
"It will take a while, don't worry, take your time, make sure there is enough food.
Didn’t you see several of these? I'm sure you'll be satisfied with what you eat tonight. "
Xu Shiyan pointed to a row of several sheep, all of which were roasting on the rack.
Han Limin and the others stood by the rack, turning the handle from time to time to ensure that the mutton was heated evenly.
"Hey, hey, don't join in the fun over there, hurry up and work.
Come a few people and serve the dishes up. Others should carry the wine, and prepare the show.
Whoever doesn’t come out with the whole good program later, I will punish him for drinking. "Over there, Lin Qiyue called people to work.
As soon as everyone heard this, they hurried to work, those who served the dishes served the dishes, and those who carried the wine carried the wine.
It will be ready in a short time, and the roasted lamb here is similar. Take a small blade and put it on a plate, and continue to roast the rest.
"Xiao Xu, come here and let Lao Zhang lead the apprentice to look at the mutton first.
You are the protagonist tonight, why can't you let this barbecue. "
Lin Qiyue asked the canteen master Lao Zhang to bring his apprentices to help watch the barbecue, and then dragged Xu Shiyan back to sit down there.
"Everyone, please be quiet, tonight, our deputy manager Xu pays for it out of his own pocket, and invites you to eat roasted whole lamb.
As for why? Needless to say, everyone knows it.
Under the leadership of deputy director Xu, the technical department continued to tackle key problems and added three new products to our participation.
All new products passed the inspection today, so tonight is a celebration banquet for comrades in the technical department. "
In such an occasion, Lin Qiyue would of course have to say a few opening words.
"Come on, let's give warm applause first, thank you Deputy Director Xu.
Without him leading you to test new products, our place would not be where it is now, right? "
Lin Qiyue took the lead and applauded first, and everyone present applauded together.
"Next, let deputy director Xu tell us a few words?"
"Yes, yes, say a few words, say a few words."
A group of young men booed and pushed Xu Shiyan to the front.
Xu Shiyan smiled all over his face, "Well, Secretary Lin asked me to say a few words, what are you talking about?
One is to thank Secretary Lin for giving our technical department this opportunity.
You said, if Secretary Lin didn’t support us so much, no matter how capable the technical department is, we have no raw materials or machines, what can we do?
So, the person who should be most grateful is not me, but Secretary Lin. "
He can say a few words in the scene, but Xu Shiyan's words are from the heart.
If Lin Qiyue hadn't dug him into the arena and provided him with this platform, even if Xu Shiyan was full of ambitions, he would have nowhere to display them.
In fact, Xu Shiyan admires Lin Qiyue a lot. This person is really courageous, dares to employ people, and dares to do things.
If it is replaced by a general leader, the kind of person who does not seek merit but seeks no faults, he will not care about new products or not.
As long as the original ginseng production and processing is maintained, it is enough to make money, so how can it be prosperous today?
When Xu Shiyan said this, everyone applauded again, "Thank you, Secretary Lin." A group of young men shouted loudly.
"Another one, I should actually thank everyone.
I go out to study, and I don’t have much time to be present, so I rely on everyone’s hard work.
Our technical department has not delayed anything, and various researches are progressing steadily. I have to thank you all. "This is also true.
A single thread does not form a thread, and a single tree does not form a forest.
Without these people thinking together with him and exerting their energy in one direction, everyone has put all their energy into researching, so what can Xu Shiyan do alone? What can be done?
"So, we all achieve each other, we all have a common goal, for our field, right?"
Xu Shiyan laughed again when he said this.
"It's just a few words, but it's too much. Well, let's eat with chopsticks. The meat won't taste good when it gets cold."
In this kind of occasion, you can’t talk endlessly, and you’ll be done with it. Talking so much is annoying.
Everyone laughed loudly, "That's right, let's eat, I'm so hungry, come on, sit down and eat."
It's time, don't worry about the director and secretary, everyone is the same, they should eat and drink.
Master Zhang led someone to barbecue over there, and when the roast was almost done, he sliced ​​it and put it on a plate and served it here.
The mutton marinated with special seasoning is delicious, fat but not greasy, and dipped in some dry ingredients, it is so delicious that you can't even swallow your tongue.
Eat some meat and have some wine, there is no one left in this small life.
Most of the technical subjects are young people. How can this group of people get together? After a while, he shouted and shouted, jumping up and down.
Lin Qiyue yelled, telling them to sing and show off their talents.
So some people got up and sang, and some people danced beside them, and everyone clapped their hands to beat the rhythm.
Everyone's face was filled with satisfied smiles.
In the Changbai Mountain area, the temperature difference between day and night is relatively large. In the early autumn of September, it is very hot during the day and cool at night.
But no one at the scene felt cold.
One is that there are several fires in the middle of the venue, and the other is that everyone is in high spirits, talking and laughing very lively, so it doesn't feel cold.
A group of people were happy to drink, and they held hands and started dancing around the fire.
Don't care if it will or not, it's just a jump anyway.
The red charcoal fire is just like the prosperous days, and it also looks like a beautiful and bright future.
is reflected in everyone's face and heart, making everyone's heart full of hope.

chapters.title: Chapter 456: Old Chu's text
chapters.content:
Chapter 456 Old Chu's article
On September 8th, Xu Shiyan packed his bags and embarked on a journey to the provincial capital to study again.
But this time, apart from Li Chengrong and Xiao Peng, there were also two daughters of Guo Shouye's family, Guo Fengying and Guo Fengxia, who were accompanying him.
Guo Shouye and his wife are both busy with work, and it was agreed before that the daughter should follow Xu Shiyan to the provincial capital.
So Guo Shouye and his wife just let go and let their daughter follow Xu Shiyan.
Five people walk together, taking care of each other on the way.
Although the outside is still not calm, Xu Shiyan and his party are going well.
Arrived in the provincial capital on the morning of the 9th, Xu Shiyan followed Guo Fengxia to the Banking School, helping with the admission procedures.
After everything was settled, Xu Shiyan threw another 100 yuan to Guo Fengxia, and then hurried back to the Agricultural University campus by car.
Most of them are cadres, and most of them are agricultural workers.
This autumn is busy, many people can't let go of work, so returning to school is rare.
After Xu Shiyan came back, he found that there were still people in the same dormitory who had not returned, and the same was true for other dormitories.
Before class started, Xu Shiyan hurriedly sent the samples he brought back to the Laboratory Department of the University of Medical Sciences for testing.
Then, I went to visit Elder Chu again, and told him about the prescription.
"Well, someone has already contacted me, asking me if I have any other requests?
I said, just one request, don't let the prescription get buried.
Not only these two prescriptions, I hope that all the good things passed down from our ancestors can be effectively protected. "
After listening to Xu Shiyan's words, Elder Chu laughed.
"Come on, take a look at my recent article.
Didn’t you mention patent protection to me before? I think this is very necessary.
So I plan to unite with some authoritative experts in traditional Chinese medicine in China to make a common voice, and we must pay attention to the traditional Chinese medicine culture of our motherland.
This is a treasure left by thousands of years of civilization, and it cannot be declined in modern times. "
Old Chu enthusiastically took a stack of manuscripts and handed them to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan just picked up the manuscript and looked at it. It said that the authors were Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Shiyan, and he was taken aback.
"Master, what are you doing? This is an article you wrote, how can you put my name on it?"
Is this not a joke? Xu Shiyan is a stickler, why did he become the second author on a medical paper?
"If you look carefully, you will know. Normally, it is not too much for you to be the first author of this article.
It’s just that my name is there, and the effect will be better if I publish it in my name. "
Old Chu waved his hand and asked Xu Shiyan to take a closer look.
Xu Shiyan read on, the more he read, the more he felt familiar, as if part of this was the content of his chat with Mr. Chu before.
Xu Shiyan was born again, especially in the age of information explosion.
What sound, hand, various official accounts, etc., I have more or less contacted.
At that time, people had realized the decline of TCM in China and the rise of TCM abroad.
Even some countries have registered more than 200 ancient prescriptions in "Treatise on Febrile Diseases" and "Synopsis of the Golden Chamber" as their patents and changed them to Chinese prescriptions.
People take the prescriptions passed down from our ancestors and sell the medicines all over the world.
But what about our medicine? People in the country don't pay much attention to it, and no one applies for these patent protections at all.
In the end, the good medicine handed down from our ancestors cannot be sold abroad because we have no patents.
What's the name of this girl?
Xu Shiyan has been studying in the provincial capital for a year, and every Sunday he visits Mr. Chu and chats with him.
Sometimes we talk about this aspect.
Old Chu kept it all in his heart, recently sorted it out, and wrote an article for publication.
"I'm already at this age, and I'm not afraid of offending people. I have to say what I have to say.
There has never been any distinction between Chinese medicine and Western medicine, and there is no saying that Western medicine is more scientific than Chinese medicine.
Science by no means means absolute correctness and uniqueness. "
Old Chu looked solemn, his eyes were firm, and his words were sonorous and powerful.
This is the conclusion reached by an ancient old man who has survived the war-torn era and survived the hail of bullets. After experiencing confusion, searching, learning, and reflection.
Facing this bustling and troubled world, the old man uses his own experience and the vicissitudes of his mental journey to give the world an answer.
"Master, please erase my name from this article, I really don't fit to appear on it."
Xu Shiyan feels that the weight of this article comes from the life experience of Mr. Chu.
Although there are influences from his half-baked remarks, on the whole, it is still Mr. Chu's own thoughts.
Well, it's really inappropriate for him to appear on the top. If others see it, why don't you think that Mr. Chu is paving the way for his apprentice?
If Xu Shiyan really studied medicine, it would be fine. Whether it is for academic qualifications or professional titles, it is understandable for a teacher to lead students.
But he didn't study medicine, and he didn't have any real talents, so why bother to take such a signature?
He is really guilty of this thing.
Old Chu glanced at Xu Shiyan, and couldn't help laughing.
"You, you have always been like this. You are too cautious. Why, are you afraid that I will offend someone and implicate you again?"
Xu Shiyan was so frightened that he quickly waved his hands, "No, no, that's not the case.
If this really offends people, I will be the first to rush forward without needing to be told by Master.
The point is, Master, you have done a good deed with immeasurable merit. "
If, Mr. Chu's article can really attract the attention of relevant people, thus changing some aspects.
Not to mention anything else, if someone can be inspired, first register the patents of these medical books and prescriptions left by our ancestors, which will definitely be enough for some small countries to drink a pot in the future.
This is really a good thing that will benefit thousands of years. Only Elder Chu is qualified. For people like Xu Shiyan, please stay still.
Old Chu only smiled when he heard the words, but didn't say anything. He took back the manuscript and kept it properly.
"By the way, that, the functional drink we talked about before, has it been made yet?"
Mr. Chu is also very concerned about the new product development of the first participant. In his opinion, this is a good way.
Only by improving its own scientific and technological strength, transforming raw material suppliers into processors, and improving core competitiveness, can enterprises go further.
Speaking of this, Xu Shiyan regained his energy, and started talking to Mr. Chu endlessly.
Mr. Chu listened with relish, did he nod his head in approval?
"Not bad, really good.
Shi Yan, if you have a chance in the future, you must go out for a walk and go abroad.
Look at the outside world and learn from the advanced management system abroad.
I feel that your participation is still lacking in related aspects. "
"Yes, yes, this is inevitable.
But I guess my level is not enough, I will mention it to our secretary when I go back to see if there is a chance. "
Xu Shiyan quite agrees with this.
We are confident, but not blindly arrogant. We know our strengths and are more aware of our weaknesses.
Working hard to learn from foreigners is to make up for our shortcomings, not to erase our strengths.

chapters.title: Chapter 457: Microbial compound fertilizer
chapters.content:
Chapter 457 Microbial Compound Fertilizer
Xu Shiyan has to attend classes and is also in charge of writing the book "New Technology of Ginseng Cultivation". Now, he is even busier.
In addition to class and meals every day, most of the time is spent in the library, or in the dormitory writing hard.
The people in the same dormitory are all from neighboring counties. Although it is not as famous as Fusong for planting ginseng, there are also ginseng plants, and everyone knows about them.
So everyone is also very interested in what Xu Shiyan wants to write, and they often get together to discuss.
Later, I didn't know what was going on, even their mentor knew.
I also specifically asked Xu Shiyan to go there, and was particularly concerned about the writing process of this book, saying that I would show it to the school first when the manuscript comes out.
Xu Shiyan did not object to this. One person counts on the shortcomings, and two people count on the long. It is time to brainstorm.
Professors from the Agricultural University are all talented and learned. Being able to get their corrections and opinions is of great benefit to both this book and Xu Shiyan.
Just taking the opportunity, Xu Shiyan proposed the idea of ​​ginseng biological compound fertilizer and biotechnology foliar fertilizer.
"Teacher, this is my idea, which is to use complex microbial bacteria, such as 5406 strains.
Combined with compound amino acids, organic main materials, auxiliary materials, etc., and composted using bio-fermentation technology, it should be better than the previous ginseng soil fertilizer. "
This is an idea that Xu Shiyan came up with after reading countless related books and checking various documents after studying at Agricultural University.
Before, the cake fertilizer for ginseng ground invented by Xu Shiyan had obtained relevant technical appraisal.
A few days ago, the ginseng field called to announce the good news, saying that this year’s ginseng field had a bumper harvest, which was more than 30% higher than last year’s yield.
This year, the ginseng field is the form of base fertilizer plus fertilization, so the output of ginseng field has been greatly increased.
The secretary of the county also specially called Xu Shiyan, saying that the production of ginseng land in various places this year is good, and the results of ginseng land fertilizer are gratifying.
The most outrageous thing is that Su Anying called and said that the deer dung on the farm has become delicious.
Many places come to order deer dung, and go back to compost and ferment it as ginseng fertilizer.
"It's okay to talk about bean cakes, but the deer dung is really restricted too much.
Moreover, everyone has different degrees of fermentation technology, which actually affects the utilization rate of this fertilizer.
If a better formula can be formulated and mass-produced, I think it will be better than the current one.
Especially in the aspect of heavy cropping ginseng soil, if it can resist soil compaction, enrich the soil microbial flora, and supplement various nutrients needed for ginseng growth.
The effective use of ginseng land will definitely be very helpful. "
The so-called double cropping of ginseng soil means that after a crop of ginseng has been planted, there will be no ginseng soil in a few years, and you want to reuse the planted ginseng. This is double cropping.
The growth of ginseng consumes a lot of fertility, which can be said to be a predatory absorption of the soil.
So the places where ginseng has been planted will not be able to recover after ten or twenty years.
In addition, in the soil where ginseng has been planted, a lot of bacteria will be produced. If it is replanted, many germs will appear, which will cause ginseng to rot.
This is also a big problem facing the development of the participation industry.
After all, forest resources are limited, and the land that can grow ginseng will become less and less. Improving the utilization rate of ginseng soil is a big problem.
Xu Shiyan knew that with his current level, he could not reach this level, so he took the opportunity to ask the academy tutor for help.
The instructors of Agricultural University each have their own unique skills, maybe they can find a way.
"Well, what you said is really interesting.
Using microbial technology to provide nutrients necessary for ginseng growth, restore soil fertility, and at the same time play a role in sterilization.
It's a bit difficult, but it can be studied as a subject. "
One of the mentors was very interested in Xu Shiyan's ideas, and he decided to lead others to study it.
"By the way, let's talk about the foliar fertilizer. I remember that there was a method of diluting calcium superphosphate with water before spraying it.
What do you think about biotechnology? "
Another mentor is interested in the foliar fertilizer that Xu Shiyan said.
"It is to use microbial fermentation and extraction technology to extract nucleotides, various amino acids, fulvic acid, trace elements, etc., to prepare foliar fertilizers.
I think this will be a development trend in the future, which is conducive to environmental protection and renewable resources. "
"The growth period of ginseng rhizomes is from July to September, and at this time, the fertilizer applied in the early stage can no longer meet the needs of ginseng growth.
Spraying foliar fertilizer can supplement the lack of ginseng nutrients, promote stem and leaf growth, disease resistance, and lodging resistance.
Calcium superphosphate is still too simple to supplement all the nutrients needed for ginseng growth.
And superphosphate is a mineral after all, a non-renewable resource.
There used to be a phosphate fertilizer factory in our county, but it stopped production because of insufficient raw materials. "
The last one is the most important reason.
It should be said that Xu Shiyan, who has two lifetimes of experience, has the most advanced and top-notch knowledge in the ginseng planting related industry.
So the theories he put forward are really attractive.
Don't look at these are professors from Agricultural University, but in this respect, no one can compare with Xu Shiyan.
"Well, I think this is more interesting, let's do it, leave this matter to us.
伱 Go back and write your book first, and then we will set up a special research group to study this issue. "
They are all experts in related fields, and they knew what Xu Shiyan was talking about as soon as they heard it. At present, it is a very advanced concept even in the international arena, not to mention domestic.
If the research is successful, it may not only be applied in the field of ginseng cultivation, but also other crops.
This is a good thing and must be taken seriously.
In this way, Xu Shiyan, who proposed two new theories, continued to bury his head in a pile of manuscript papers, burning night and writing.
The college really called a meeting of people to discuss related topics, and after research and decision, a related research group was established.
Xu Shiyan, as the project proposer, has rich knowledge in the field of ginseng cultivation, so he was naturally selected into the research group.
Do various experiments with many elites in his eyes.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan wrote a part of the book "New Technology of Ginseng Cultivation" when he was at home, and it was basically finalized by mid-October.
So the manuscript was mailed back to a participating venue for correction by Lin Qiyue.
Then submit it to Jiang Yunfeng, the deputy county magistrate and deputy director of the Ginseng Research Institute, who will do the final review and then submit it to the publishing house for publication.
Of course, this is a long process. Xu Shiyan is only responsible for completing the first draft, and the rest has nothing to do with him.
Xu Shiyan can't take care of those anymore. The most important thing right now is this biological compound fertilizer.
For Xu Shiyan, this is a rare opportunity, and it is also the biggest achievement of his two years of studying at the Agricultural University, so Xu Shiyan is very attentive.
Xu Shiyan's conscientious and cautious attitude has also been praised by many mentors.
Actually, most of the students in the cadre specialization class come here with mixed diplomas and qualifications. Like Xu Shiyan, they can really specialize, and few of them study hard.

chapters.title: Chapter 458: Ginseng seeds on demand
chapters.content:
Chapter 458 On-demand ginseng seeds
"Secretary Chen, I have good news for you.
The Agricultural University plans to set up a ginseng microbial compound fertilizer research base in our town's ginseng field, specializing in the research of ginseng microbial compound fertilizer.
If this is successful, we can specialize in a fertilizer plant. "Xu Shiyan called Chen Jianzhang.
The reason why it was Chen Jianzhang instead of Lin Qiyue was mainly due to the fact that the stalls were already quite large, and the technical department had no energy to study compound fertilizers.
On the contrary, in the town, Chen Jianzhang is very supportive of Xu Shiyan and his wife's career development. Now that he has this opportunity, Xu Shiyan also wants to repay it.
In addition, he is also thinking about a fertilizer factory.
The microbial compound fertilizer project was put into Donggang for experimentation. If the experiment is successful, it will definitely be put into production.
With Xu Shiyan in the middle, this compound fertilizer factory must not be taken elsewhere.
At that time, Su Anying's ginseng planting company can cooperate with the town to jointly set up a factory.
Now that the ginseng industry is being vigorously developed everywhere, there must be a huge demand for fertilizers, and this is definitely an opportunity.
Xu Shiyan can imagine it, so can Chen Jianzhang.
"Oh, this is a great thing.
Okay, I see, I definitely attach importance to this, don't worry, nothing will go wrong. "
Ginseng industry is the top priority of Donggang's economic development.
Chen Jianzhang is too aware of the importance of this, so naturally he dare not neglect.
Hung up the phone, and immediately told the person in charge of the town hall, trying to find a way to arrange a research room.
In addition, fully cooperate with the relevant experiments of the Agricultural University.
Of course, it’s the end of October, so it’s definitely too late this year. We can only wait for next year and prepare in advance.
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone, and then called home to inquire about the situation of this year's ginseng.
Su Anying spoke briefly on the other end of the phone.
The ginseng field has already been cleaned up. This year, each family has planted a hundred feet, and the rest of the ginseng soil is all sown with seeds.
At the beginning, Xu Shiyan made an appointment with several participants in charge to buy ginseng seeds, and it was okay.
In the past few days, seeds are being sown on the mountain.
"I followed what you said, and cooperated with elementary and junior high schools, and assembled a group of students to order ginseng seeds.
Not to mention, it’s really good, these kids are pretty good at work, and the jukebox you got is also pretty good. "
Students in this year have labor tasks. The school does not ask students for class fees directly, but they will accept some jobs every year.
For example, a participating processing factory is busy every autumn, so it negotiates with the junior high school to recruit the first-year students, and earns money for shift fees.
Regardless of primary or junior high school, there are these activities. How about the all-round development of morality, intelligence, physique, art and labor?
Actually, students also like to do this kind of work. They don’t need to study and play while working, which is much better than studying in school.
The on-demand device is actually a large wooden barrel with the same width as Chimianzi, but there are many finger-thick wooden prongs nailed in rows on the wooden barrel.
Put the player on the surface of the pool and roll it, and rows of small holes will be left on the surface of the pool, and then manually put ginseng seeds in the small holes.
Children have sharp eyesight and quick hands. Each child is given a small plastic basin, follows behind the player, and puts ginseng seeds into the small hole.
If you are not tired from work, you can earn money by laughing and joking.
At noon, Su Anying gave them bread, twists, etc., and they were all happy.
The ginseng seeds sown on demand have the same row spacing and plant spacing, so the seedlings emerge evenly, and the yield rate of large seeds is high, and they will not be sparse and uneven like manual sowing.
Later, some people modified the on-demand device to adjust the distance between rows and plants.
The ginseng seeds sown on demand in the ground grow for four years, and the ginseng is directly used for production. This kind of ginseng is called four-year direct rooting.
Some of the four-year straight rooted plants are not small, but they have only grown for four years, and the medicinal power is not enough.
Because of the low cost, it does not need to be transplanted, so it is mostly used in the development of ginseng land in HLJ across provinces.
One crop of soil is used for four years, and it is directly picked up and sold.
"The house at home has also been tidied up. There is no heating at the parents' side, only the stove is turned on, and a little fire is lit every day.
Heating is installed here in our house. At this time, the weather is not so cold, and the boiler has not yet been fired.
Let’s not talk about it, the shed is really useful, it’s warmer during the day, and it’s also fine at night, better than before. "
Xu Shiyan is too busy these days and doesn't have time to call back. Su Anying seized the opportunity, of course she had to talk about everything at home.
"I got the ten-foot-long stick this year, and it looks pretty good. It can lift about twenty-six or seven catties. Anyway, there are quite a lot of big sticks.
My mother and I put it at home to scrub and wash it, and we didn’t use the drawer, so we put it in the big aluminum pot of our house and steamed it in the pot.
Very good, the color is beautiful, and there is no gutter. "
This is the first time since the sub-fields were assigned to the households, they started to make products by themselves. Xu Shiyan's family is only nine feet long, and Xu Chenghou's is only three and a half feet long.
It is true that there are too few, but fortunately, the output is good, which can be regarded as a little consolation.
After dividing the field, you have to hand in the task after harvesting the ginseng.
Each person is required to hand in eight catties of fresh ginseng per year, and the rest can be processed by themselves and sold at the county ginseng company.
That is to say, the output is high now. Before that, the task delivery accounted for almost one-third of the work.
Xu Shiyan's family has a large population, and the nine-foot stick weighed about two hundred and forty catties. After deducting the task, there were nearly two hundred catties left.
If you make red goods, you can make about four catties for one catty, which means you can have almost fifty catties of dry goods.
According to the average of 90 yuan per catty for a dragon, it can be sold for about 4,500 to 5,000 yuan.
Those who hand in tasks are actually priced according to the national purchase price. After deducting various payments receivable by the brigade, some money can be recovered.
So after all the calculations, the remaining 5,000 yuan is still about the same.
Of course, the 5,000 yuan for an ordinary family is not only the living expenses of a family of five, but also the capital needed for the development of ginseng in the next year.
If you want to develop more ginseng land next year, buy ginseng soil, ginseng seeds, plastic sheeting, and see the ginseng fee.
It takes a lot of money to calculate all kinds of costs.
So the 5,000 yuan can't help but be spent, and it has to be calculated and spent carefully.
For Su Anying, it's not enough to save money on food and expenses, but she also has to be a little bit calculated, and she can't eat and drink and make things indiscriminately.
The money at home is also of great use.
Isn’t there such an old saying? There is no shortage of food and clothing, and there is no limit to suffering.
Su Anying is a good hand at living, she understands this better than anyone else.
"Okay, daughter-in-law, you have worked hard, persevere, and I will go home for winter vacation in two months."
Holding the phone, Xu Shiyan felt warm in his heart when he heard his wife nagging.
Never mind whether long-distance calls are expensive or not, it would be good to hear more from your wife.
"Oh, have we chatted for a long time again?
Yes, hurry up and hang up the phone, anyway, you will be back after a while, if you have anything to say, we will wait for you to talk about it. "
Su Anying was talking vigorously, when she suddenly looked up and saw the clock on the wall, whoops, it seems like they chatted for seven or eight minutes, right?
The long distance is precious, Su Anying was so frightened that she hurriedly told Xu Shiyan and hung up the phone.
Xu Shiyan held the phone in his hand, listened to the busy tone from inside, smiled wryly and shook his head.
When did the daughter-in-law change her son? It's such a rush, it's a nuisance to hang up the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 459: happy event
chapters.content:
Chapter 459 A lot of happy events
This year's autumn and winter should be said to be good news one after another.
A ginseng farm had a bumper harvest, and the output reached a new high. The output directly proved the effectiveness of the ginseng field fertilizer.
The theory of microbial compound fertilizer and microbial foliar fertilizer proposed by Xu Shiyan.
Received the attention of the Agricultural University, directly reported to the Agricultural Science and Technology Commission, and was approved as a provincial key project.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan acted quickly, and negotiated with the Agricultural University in advance to put the project research base in Donggang Township.
Otherwise, I don’t know where it was snatched away.
On December 14th, the Provincial Science and Technology Commission held a meeting on "Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng Achievement Appraisal and Standard Approval" at Nanhu Hotel.
The meeting invited 29 experts in relevant fields. Xu Shiyan, as the main researcher of Changbaishan red ginseng and the deputy director of the first state-owned ginseng field, attended the meeting.
The experts participating in the meeting unanimously praised the processing technology of Changbai Mountain red ginseng as having an international advanced level.
As the research leader of Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng, Xu Shiyan has also been recognized and praised by many people.
The Changbai Mountain Ginseng Technology Development Board sent an invitation to Xu Shiyan.
Specially hired Xu Shiyan as a member of the expert group of the board of directors, and issued a certificate of honor to Xu Shiyan.
On December 27th, Xu Shiyan presided over and participated in the research of "Ginseng Buckle Shed Technology", and made an appraisal at the Changbai Mountain Ginseng Technology Development Board.
Nine experts, including associate professor of Jilin Agricultural University, jointly signed and issued the certificate.
Related papers previously won the first prize at the 85th Annual Meeting of the Ginseng Society, and this time they were appraised at the provincial level and recognized by provincial experts.
In the blink of an eye, 1985 passed, and 1986 arrived.
Xu Shiyan, who was originally scheduled to be able to go home on the 10th of January, did not take the holiday until the end of January because he participated in the compound fertilizer research project.
The Chinese New Year in 1986 was on February 9th. When Xu Shiyan was on holiday, it was only a few days before the Chinese New Year.
"Master, why don't you go back to Donggang with me this year to celebrate the New Year."
Before leaving, Xu Shiyan went to visit Mr. Chu, but found that Mr. Chu's family members did not come back.
Ordinarily, there are only a few days left before the New Year, even if you ask for leave, you should come back to accompany the elderly.
"You don't have anyone to accompany you, I don't worry."
