Not only did the old man's children and grandchildren not come back, but even the nanny at home was not here all day long.
Because it’s the Chinese New Year, even though the nanny is close, she still has to go home and tidy up.
So every day at noon, I come here to cook a meal and clean up the house. At other times, Mr. Chu will heat up the meal by himself.
"No, I've gotten used to it all these years. Don't you think I'm in good shape? I can do everything.
What is this? When the war was fought back then, wasn't the condition the same as it is now? Is it different? "
Old Chu waved his hand, he didn't want to trouble Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan didn't stay in the provincial capital until Nian Gen'er before, so he didn't know what it was like for Mr. Chu to celebrate the New Year.
He thought that no matter how far away the two sons from Chu’s hometown were, they would still be able to ask for leave after the Chinese New Year and come back to spend time with the old man.
Now I know that they are not coming back at all.
"No, this matter can't be left to you.
Master, pack up your things and go, I will take you home to celebrate the New Year.
Just in time, let you take a look at the little boys in our family, they are all fun.
I can guarantee that Master will fall in love with them as soon as he sees them. "
How could Xu Shiyan let Elder Chu spend the New Year at home alone? Without further ado, I went to help Elder Chu pack his clothes.
After packing up, Xu Shiyan found another piece of paper.
It wrote that the owner went back to the country for the New Year, please call if you have anything to do, and left your own phone number.
This is for those who come to Chu’s hometown to pay New Year’s greetings during the Spring Festival, so that they can’t find Chu when they come and worry.
"Shi Yan, don't be so busy, I'm doing fine by myself."
Old Chu felt very sorry to see Xu Shiyan busy back and forth.
Although he and Xu Shiyan have the status of master and apprentice, it is not easy to go to Xu's house for the New Year.
"Master, you can't do anything today, even if I hold you up, I have to take you away.
I used to not know how you spend the Spring Festival every year. When I called you to pay New Year's greetings, you didn't mention it.
How did I know that you were celebrating the New Year at home alone?
This won’t work, really, I don’t know, that’s all. Now that I know, I will definitely take you home for the New Year. "
Xu Shiyan didn't care about that, he found glue, pasted the piece of paper directly on the gate, and told the neighbors.
Then let Mr. Chu get dressed neatly, and went out to find a handy Mr. Baner.
Just carrying the luggage, supporting Mr. Chu, he went straight to the train station by car.
Arrived at the train station, went directly to the person Chi Hao asked him to find last time, and bought two sleeper tickets.
The people at the train station knew Xu Shiyan, and when they heard that they bought the ticket for Mr. Chu, they immediately arranged a soft sleeper for him.
Then he called Hunjiang and told him that no matter what, he had to reserve two tickets for the soft berth.
Old Chu is at this age, he must be as comfortable as possible when going out, and he cannot be wronged at all.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan is also rich, so he doesn't care about soft sleepers or hard sleepers.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan accompanies Mr. Chu in the car, all the way from the provincial capital to Hunjiang, and then from Hunjiang, back to Songjiang River.
"Brother-in-law, this way." As soon as he got out of the station, he saw Li Zongliang and Li Chengrong crowded up with smiles on their faces.
"Secretary Lin arranged a car, let us pick you up and Mr. Chu."
Xu Shiyanti went to work and called, hoping that Lin Qiyue would arrange a pick-up station for him.
In fact, Xu Shiyan's current level can be equipped with a car.
But he spends most of his time studying in the provincial capital, so he doesn't think it's necessary. He usually rides a motorcycle to work.
If it wasn't for Mr. Chu coming together, Xu Shiyan himself would have been able to go back in a donkey cart.
Li Zongliang and Li Chengrong came forward, took the luggage, and then helped Mr. Chu into the car.
Li Zongliang was driving, Xu Shiyan and Li Chengrong were all accompanying Chu Lao from behind.
Fortunately, there are sleeper berths along the way, soft berths are much better than hard berths, and Mr. Chu is not much troubled.
Plus his physique is really good, so his mental state is not bad.
It took only about 20 minutes from the train station to Donggang. Li Zongliang parked the car directly outside the gate of Xu Chenghou's house.
Xu Chenghou’s house originally had five houses facing south, and then five wing rooms were connected north-south on the head of the west house.
In this way, the gate was moved to the south, to the south end of the wing room.
Enter the gate, turn around the wing room and go north, which is the main room.
Xu Chenghou also shut down the plastic shed as Xu Shiyan said.
Although the plastic shed is not very thick, it can keep out the wind and keep warm. When the sun is shining during the day, the shed can be warm.
"Father, Mom, Shiyan brought Mr. Chu here."
Su Anying guessed that she had been guarding in the plastic shed early on. When she saw Xu Shiyan and others entering the door, she hurriedly greeted them, then came out in a hurry, and stepped forward to support Elder Chu.
"I've been looking forward to your coming for a long time. As soon as I got a call here, the children in the family were in a hurry, and they were all waiting."
"Hello, Grandpa Chu."
Before Su Anying finished speaking, Xu Haiyuan and his brothers and sisters shouted in unison from behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 460: meet
chapters.content:
Chapter 460 Welcome
Chu Xuanhuai has been devolved since the 1960s, his wife passed away, and his son held a grudge against him. He has been alone all these years.
Although there are nannies to take care of and students to visit from time to time, they are not relatives after all.
The old man is also somewhat withdrawn. He didn't want to trouble Xu Shiyan, and he didn't want Xu Shiyan to force him to come to Donggang.
As soon as he entered the door, he was greeted by Xu Shiyan's wife and children with smiles on their faces.
Especially those little babies, all of them were so cute and cute, the old man's heart melted instantly, and a kind smile appeared on his face.
"Hey, hey, hello."
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping jumped to Elder Chu's side, supporting Elder Chu from left to right.
"Grandpa Chu, I've been looking forward to seeing you for a long time.
It's a pity that you are too far away, I have to go to school, otherwise I will go to the provincial capital with my dad to see you. "
Xu Haiyuan glanced behind him, then supported Elder Chu to take two quick steps, waved at Elder Chu, motioned Elder Chu to bend down.
Then stand on tiptoe, put your hands by your mouth, close to Old Chu's ears.
"I'm telling you quietly, I've read your book.
My dad put it in the study, and I peeked at it while he wasn't paying attention. "
Xu Haiyuan was talking about the medical handbook, Xu Shiyan sometimes read it, so he stayed in the study.
As for the secret recipe, he had hidden it long ago, because he was afraid that the little **** Xu Haiyuan would always go to the study to search for things.
Old Chu laughed as soon as he heard it, and raised his hand to touch Xu Haiyuan's small head.
"How old are you, can you understand?"
This kid is smart and smart, no matter who sees him, he likes him, and Mr. Chu is no exception.
"Most of them can be understood, but there are some places that I don't understand." Xu Haiyuan frowned and shook his head.
He can understand most of the medical handbooks, mainly about dialectics and prescriptions, and some he can't understand.
"I dare not ask my dad, for fear that he will know that I secretly searched his study."
Xu Haiyuan continued to whisper to Old Chu's ear.
Even if Xu Haiyuan's voice is quieter, can Xu Shiyan and Su Anying, who are following behind, still hear?
Xu Shiyan shook his head helplessly, this brat, almost everything with words in the house was turned over by him.
Thanks to the fact that the secret recipe was well hidden, otherwise it would be unsure what it would look like if it was translated by this bastard.
Su Anying was right next to Xu Shiyan. At this moment, she quickly tugged on Xu Shiyan's sleeve and shook her head at him.
That means, Mr. Chu rarely comes to the house, so don't scold the children in front of Mr. Chu.
Let’s tidy up when I have a chance later, don’t rush it for a while.
Xu Shiyan sighed, the bear son of his family is really convinced, he can turn over and take a look at everything.
Forget it, as long as you don’t harm the book, just read it. Anyway, there is nothing at home that is not suitable for children to read.
Don't care if he can understand it or not, just treat it as a way to pass the time.
Just in time, Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin also came out of the room at this time.
When Xu Chenghou saw Elder Chu, he hurried forward and grabbed Elder Chu's hand.
"Old brother, I'm looking forward to you.
Come on, come in, come in and talk.
I made dumplings at home, just waiting for you to come, let's cook dumplings for dinner. "
In Northeast China, when guests come and treat them with dumplings, it is definitely giving enough face and showing that they value the guests.
"Old woman, hurry up, lead your daughter and daughter-in-law, and cook dumplings.
Brother Chu came here by car along the way, it’s already this time, he must be hungry, let’s get all the food up quickly. "
Xu Chenghou held Elder Chu's hand, turned his head and said to his wife.
"Okay, okay, let's cook the dumplings now, and I'm waiting for you to come back.
The dumplings we ate today are quite colorful, including celery, thorn sticks, and sauerkraut. "
Zhou Guilan laughed as soon as she heard it, nodded towards Elder Chu, and walked quickly into the room while talking.
Since Xu Shiyan's family had a refrigerator, Zhou Guilan wanted to freeze everything.
Spring is the best time for wild vegetables, Zhou Guilan got some celery and thorn sticks.
Wash them all, scald them with hot water, wrap them in plastic film, and freeze them in the refrigerator.
Although it has been frozen for such a long time, it is definitely not as good as the fresh ones, but it is still a rarity to be able to eat wild vegetable dumplings this winter.
Especially Elder Chu, who has been away from Daying for ten years and has never eaten these wild vegetables again.
"I made you bother, you see, how much trouble I have caused the family when I come here."
As soon as Chu Xuanhuai arrived at the Xu family, he felt the enthusiasm of the Xu family, which made him a little uncomfortable.
I'm afraid that because of my arrival, I will cause trouble to the Xu family.
"Look at what my brother said, that Shiyan is your apprentice, isn't he just like a son?
Picking you back for the New Year, it should be given, what's the trouble?
I wish you could come, just in time for someone to talk to me. "
Heaven and earth kings and masters, why don’t you call them masters, if this is put in the past, it will be great.
Xu Chenghou felt guilty about what happened back then, and always felt that he was sorry for Chu Xuanhuai.
Chu Xuanhuai was able to ignore the past, helped treat Xu Shiqin's illness, and even taught Xu Shiyan with his heart, Xu Chenghou was too late to be grateful.
So when his daughter-in-law said that Chu Xuanhuai was coming to celebrate the New Year, Xu Chenghou was the first to lose his temper.
Shouting, hurry up and prepare something to eat, and greet Chu Xuanhuai.
While speaking, everyone had already stepped into the east room, and they saw that there were Su Weizhong and his wife, and Han Wenzhong and his wife in the room.
Knowing that Xu Shiyan brought Mr. Chu back for the New Year, he came here specially to greet him.
Su Weizhong and Han Wenzhong both met Mr. Chu in the provincial capital, and they were no strangers to meeting each other, so they sat down and chatted directly.
Zhou Guilan hurriedly led her daughter and daughter-in-law to the kitchen to cook dumplings.
Xu Shiyan found a place to put down his luggage at this moment, and then sat down to chat with Han Liwei and the others.
"When did Liwei get home? I thought you might not come back for the Chinese New Year."
Xu Shiyan really thought that Han Liwei and his wife might spend the New Year in the capital, but he didn't expect them to come back.
"I came back two days ago. I was studying at school. I don't have as many holidays as ordinary university students. I usually take a break once a month.
It's Chinese New Year, the holiday can be longer, and I can stay at home for less than 20 days. "Han Liwei explained with a smile.
"Well, that's not bad. It would be nice to be back for the New Year."
Xu Shiyan nodded when he heard the words, his identities are different, even though they are all studying, the difference is huge.
Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin are in the capital, and they write letters or make phone calls from time to time, so the family probably knows about their situation.
After Xu Shiqin followed Han Liwei to the capital, he really did what Xu Shiyan said, and bought a second yard there.
The price is not expensive, around 20,000 yuan.
They are just a young couple, so there is really no need to buy that kind of big house with three entrances or several entrances, a detached house is fine if they have a place to live.
Han Liwei was studying at the Military Academy, and took two days off a month to come home to see Xu Shiqin.
Han Liwei arranged for Xu Shiqin to go to night school through his relationship, where he studied clothing fabrics, cutting and sewing.
Xu Shiqin, apart from going to class, spends her days growing flowers, reading books, and drawing pictures.
If there is a style of clothes that I like, I can buy suitable fabrics by myself, and when I come back, I can draw pictures and cut them to make clothes. Anyway, I live a comfortable life.

chapters.title: Chapter 461: Xu Chenghou's little thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 461 Xu Chenghou's Little Thoughts
Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin have been married for a year and have no children yet. The old people on both sides are anxious, but no one dares to urge them.
The Han family felt that Han Liwei was injured so badly that he almost died.
This body has suffered a lot, how can it be easily recovered?
The Xu family felt that Xu Shiqin's health was not very good before, and he had two surgeries.
This physique is also not good, it is estimated that he has not recovered yet.
So the old people at both ends have the same aspirations, and no one urges them.
The young couple didn't know the old man's thoughts, but they were happy to live in the world of two.
Parents didn't bother to remind him, Xu Shiyan couldn't mention these things when he was an older brother.
So when chatting with Han Liwei, I just asked them how they are doing in the capital, whether housing prices in the capital are expensive or not.
Han Liwei is not very clear about this, but Xu Shiqin bought the house by himself.
"Third Brother, please come to Shiqin later, she is quite familiar with these things.
Before she said that she wanted to set up a shop in the capital and open a clothing store by herself. "
"Oh, that's pretty serious, open it if you want."
Xu Shiyan regained his energy when he heard it. If he buys a shop in the capital at this time, he will make a lot of money in the future.
No, he has to talk to his younger sister later, and take him with him when he buys a shop.
This side was chatting vigorously, the dumpling was cooked, Su Anying called for someone to bring the dumplings.
When Xu Shiyan heard this, he hurried out, and together with Su Anying and Xu Shiqin, brought the dumplings into the house.
Today's reception feast is absolutely ostentatious, not only boiled dumplings, but also six dishes.
Usually, there is no need to add side dishes to eating dumplings. This is to welcome Mr. Chu, so they put up such a big battle.
"Master, Dad, Uncle Han, that dumpling is ready, and the dishes are ready.
Let's come over for dinner. After the meal, there is plenty of time to chat. "
Xu Shiyan saw that the food was ready, so he called everyone to eat.
"Hey, why are there so many dishes? It would be nice to have dumplings.
Our own family, it’s so grand, how bad is it? "
Old Chu saw that there were dumplings as well as chicken, duck and fish on the table, and he immediately felt sorry.
Because he came, they prepared so many delicious food, isn't this causing trouble for them?
"Brother Chu, it seems that you are only talking outrageous things, what else is there?
On this table, pork, chicken, and mutton are all raised by us.
Isn’t it the Chinese New Year? Why don't we kill something to eat?
The fish was caught by the brother of the third brother, from the big house on the edge of the river, through the hole in the ice.
This is now. When I was in the big house, the third child could get back more than a dozen pieces a day. "Xu Chenghou explained with a smile.
The fish was sent by Li Erniu.
Li Erniu also wanted to move to Donggang before, but he was reluctant to move because he thought there would be no land here.
Isn’t this Zhao Jianguo and his younger brother who went to see ginseng in Liumaohe? It costs 2,500 yuan a year to manage food and housing.
Li Erniu knew that envy was not good enough, so he wanted to discuss with Xu Shiyan, if he could help him find some errand, he also wanted to move here.
Who is empty-handed when asking for help? So Li Erniu smashed a hole in the ice to get a few thin scales and sent them over.
Speaking of which, Li Erniu's ability to smash ice holes and fish was brought out by Xu Shiyan.
"Come on, try it quickly, this is home-raised, the meat is delicious.
There are also these dumplings, the one with lace is stuffed with celery and pork, the ears of wheat are stuffed with sticks, and the one is made of sauerkraut.
You can eat whatever you want, this is your own home, so don’t let anyone else see you. "
Xu Chenghou enthusiastically took a small dish for Chu Xuanhuai, and then spooned it with garlic sauce.
"There is vinegar and sesame oil, you can adjust whatever you eat."
"Hey, hey, okay, okay, I can do it myself, I will do it myself."
Chu Xuanhuai also saw that the Xu family sincerely welcomed him.
He is so generous and thoughtful, if he is still coy, it will be a joke.
After all, he is someone who has seen the big scene, and he soon let go of his mind.
"I'll try this big leaf celery's dumplings first, oops, I haven't eaten this dish for many years.
I remember that I was in the cowshed at that time, eating bran-swallowed vegetables all day long, and when spring came, the mountains were full of wild vegetables to eat.
Shepherd's purse, mother-in-law Ding, the most delicious thing is this big leaf celery.
But at that time, there were no current conditions. If you say dumplings, you can make them.
It seems that once, Shi Yan took two buns made of corn flour, which were stuffed with big leaf celery.
Oh, that tastes delicious. "Chu Xuanhuai recalled, while holding the dumpling and putting it in his mouth.
"Well, well, it's that taste, it's really delicious."
Frozen celery is not as juicy as fresh ones, but the taste remains the same.
"If you really want to eat, just stay and forget it, you will live here.
When it comes to spring, the mountains are full of wild vegetables, and we can make any kind of stuffing for the dumplings we want.
Don't care if it's shepherd's purse, celery, or yellow elm mushrooms, you can eat whatever you want. "
Xu Chenghou sincerely wanted to stay with Chu Xuanhuai, and this was not just casual talk.
Chu Xuanhuai laughed as soon as he heard it, "What's the matter? I'll be fine here for the New Year, how can I live here all the time?"
Xu Shiyan is his apprentice, but he is not qualified as a master, and he didn't teach much.
It will be fine if the child kindly picks him up for the New Year, how can he stay here and not leave? Relied on?
"Look, this is what you want to go wrong, right?
Did you look at it? I took over five houses on this side, and I plan to keep two to open a small shop.
The other three rooms, if you are willing, you can open a small clinic there.
Needless to say, if you put your medical skills in our small place, wouldn’t that be amazing? What is our Donggang hospital?
If you can really stay and open a clinic, whoops, someone here has a headache, but it will be much more convenient. "
Speaking of which, no one is as thoughtful as Xu Chenghou.
As soon as he heard that Xu Shiyan had brought Chu Xuanhuai to celebrate the New Year, he began to think about it.
Xu Chenghou knew that his son was studying in the provincial capital, and he would go to Chu Xuanhuai's place for dinner on weekends, learning skills from his master.
The recipe of the drink that participated in the venue was still thought of by others.
The old man thought about it, Xu Shiyan will graduate in half a year, so what should he do in the future?
Can’t go to the provincial capital to live and study every once in a while, right?
Also, Xu Shiyan is too old to catch up with the good opportunity, but the young ones in the family are a good time to learn things.
As far as this year is concerned, what job can be better than being a doctor?
Among the four, no matter which one is interested in studying medicine, learning from Chu Xuanhuai is probably more useful than going to university.
So Xu Chenghou specially told Xu Haiyuan and the others to be more enthusiastic when they meet this Grandpa Chu.
They are all elderly people, who doesn't know who? For people of their age, the rarest thing is children.
Children from other families dare not speak, but Xu Chenghou dares to speak of his family.
As long as the children get too close to Chu Xuanhuai and make Chu Xuanhuai confused, the custody will refuse to leave.
If Chu Xuanhuai can stay, all problems can be solved.
In the future, Xu Shiyan will be off work, and he can follow me to study medicine when he comes back. If these young people are interested, they can also follow him.
In the future, it would be a big deal for Xu Shiyan to provide for Chu Xuanhuai in the future. This is the duty of an apprentice, and it should be.

chapters.title: Chapter 462: Rare
chapters.content:
Chapter 462 Recruiting rare people
Xu Chenghou put his mind to it, so naturally he kept persuading Chu Xuanhuai to stay.
Chu Xuanhuai has just arrived at Xu's house, how can he agree? But it's hard to say too clearly, so I can only not answer.
Xu Chenghou was not in a hurry, and walked over with a smile, still warmly greeting Chu Xuanhuai to eat vegetables and dumplings.
Today, it is all my own family, there is no distinction between men and women, adults and children. Xu Haiyuan and the others are also eating on the kang.
What a ghost Xu Haiyuan is, he can keep his grandfather's instructions firmly in mind.
"Grandpa Chu, try this fish. My grandfather said it's called Xilin, and it's the most delicious fish in the river. It's delicious."
The little guy took a big piece of fish belly and put it in front of Chu Xuanhuai.
Now, it’s impossible to give Chu Xuanhuai to the rare one, “Brother Xu, your grandson can do it, he’s really sensible.”
The sons of Chu Xuanhuai's family don't come back very often, and the grandson has never met. People of such an age are the most rare children.
At this moment, Xu Haiyuan was picking up vegetables and dumplings. Chu Xuanhuai looked at the child, and the more he looked at it, the more he liked it.
"Grandpa Chu, I'm being good too."
Xu Jinping also took the opportunity to come over, blinking her big eyes, and talking to Chu Xuanhuai with a smile.
"I wanted to catch fish for you just now, but my brother preempted me.
Grandpa Chu, you eat chicken. My mother has specially stewed this chicken for a long time, but it is mushy. "
The little girl quickly picked up a piece of chicken thigh, and put it in front of Chu Xuanhuai.
"Hey, hey, good, good, they are all good children, grandpa eats them all."
Now, Chu Xuanhuai was so happy that he couldn't keep his mouth shut, let alone him, anyone would be fooled by these two children.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui are still a little younger, and they don't know much about what's going on, and they don't know how to serve guests.
But when they saw Grandpa Chu boasting about his elder brothers and sisters, they couldn't sit still anymore, so they simply went forward.
This one sat in Xu Chenghou's arms, and that one sat in Chu Xuanhuai's arms, looking up at the grandpas with small faces.
"Yo, this is the twins, right? They look really good.
If you don’t say that Shi Yan is blessed, look at the four sons and daughters, they are all so energetic. "
Chu Xuanhuai has never hugged other children except for the little patient.
Now seeing this fat, chubby, elf-cute baby, how can you not be surprised?
Then I really wish I could hug him and kiss him, the old man is so happy, the wrinkles on his face have deepened a lot.
Speaking of these four children, Xu Chenghou is also full of pride.
"Well, it's true, you just say that from now on, who can have four children?
In the future, there will be fewer children with two children, and most of them will be only children. It is impossible to have such a lively time.
When talking about this matter, Han Wenzhong and Su Weizhong nodded again and again.
Han Wenzhong's gaze involuntarily turned to Han Liwei.
The third son didn't catch up with the good times. It is estimated that they are a young couple. It would be nice to have one.
Oh, it’s fine, as long as there is one.
I have to ask the old lady to ask, it’s not a big deal if you don’t rush, how old are you and don’t want children?
Su Weizhong looked at Li Zongliang.
Su Anfang gave birth to a boy, and both of them are workers in the field, so that's about it.
All right, it’s good to have one, and if the child is promising, one will be helped too.
There are several kinds of stuffed dumplings, as well as several dishes of chicken, duck and fish. It is said that we should drink some on this occasion.
But at Mr. Chu's age, no one dared to talk about it, so no one mentioned it. Everyone was very happy to eat, and the chatting and laughing were very lively.
Chu Xuanhuai lived alone these years, and when the students went to see him, the house was more lively.
Usually he reads, the nanny works, and the house is deserted.
Old people actually like to be lively and don't like to be alone.
Chu Xuanhuai came to Xu's house, saw the lively atmosphere, and really liked it.
So happy, the old man ate a plate of dumplings and a lot of dishes.
Old rice grains Old rice grains, if a person can no longer eat when he is old, his body will not work.
A person like Chu Xuanhuai who eats a lot, naturally has good health.
If you don’t drink, you can eat quickly. After a while, everyone put down their chopsticks after eating.
Su Anying and the others rushed to clean up, while the old men sat on the Kang and chatted.
This person is old, and he likes to recall the past, and he started to talk about the past as he talked.
Xu Haiyuan originally wanted to play, but when he heard the stories told by his grandpas, his eyes widened, and he sat beside Mr. Chu to listen.
Occasionally, when he heard something interesting, he still asked a question, and he felt that what these old grandpas said was more exciting than what was said on TV storytelling, it was so good.
Everyone sat at Xu's house for a while, but it was getting late, so they went home.
Here, Su Anying looked at it and asked Xu Shiyan.
"Well, I've already arranged Elder Chu's residence. I think we should let Elder Chu live in our house in the east, right?"
The east is the top, and Chu is the elder, so he should live in the east.
The new house is suitable for people to live in, otherwise it is easy to suffer from frostbite in winter.
Su Anying moved to a new house in the east with her children a while ago.
Hearing that Elder Chu was coming, Su Anying hurriedly packed her things and vacated the new house in Dongtou.
Thanks to the fact that the new house also made furniture or something, Mr. Chu moved in, and there was no problem at all.
"Okay, I'll follow your arrangement, and you can do whatever you say."
Xu Shiyan believed in Su Anying, and would definitely be able to arrange it properly.
Just like that, Mr. Chu stayed here to chat with Xu Chenghou, and Xu Haiyuan and the others also accompanied him.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying sent Elder Chu's clothes and other things home.
He took out the new quilt they made when they got married, which had not been covered before, and was reserved for Elder Chu to use.
Before, Su Anying brought her children to live in Dongtou, so of course the TV also moved here.
Since Elder Chu wants to live, Su Anying said, just leave the TV behind.
Older people feel lighter, and it’s good to watch TV for a while when they can’t sleep at night.
Anyway, the husband and wife are busy every day, so they go to bed early at night and don't watch TV very much.
As for the children, they are restricted from watching TV every day to save them myopia.
Everything has been tidied up here, and the house is also very warm.
Xu Shiyan looked around and thought it was okay, so he went back with his wife.
"Well, Master, the living place has been tidied up.
I see it's not too early, let's go back and rest, shall we? I have time tomorrow, come again. "
Chu Xuanhuai usually takes a rest in the afternoon. Today, he came here by train and ate and chatted at Xu's house. He was really tired by now.
"Brother Xu, I'll live there first, let's talk tomorrow when we have time."
People of this age love to get together.
Elder Chu's temperament is a bit withdrawn, but Xu Chenghou can chat with anyone, so the two of them are quite at odds and throw temper tantrums.
"Okay, I'll find you tomorrow, let's continue chatting.
Let me tell you, I have a few old friends who usually play chess and chat with me nearby.
I’ll call you over some other day to get to know you. Let’s play chess together when we’re free, drink tea or something, it’s good. "
Xu Chenghou put on his shoes and went to the ground, he had to come out to give him a gift, but Mr. Chu quickly pushed him back.
This tomorrow morning. It snowed heavily on my side all day, the wires were broken, and there was a power outage. I saved the manuscript in the background, but somehow it was sent by mistake. It has already been released. There is no way to change the chapter name tomorrow. sorry, sorry

chapters.title: Chapter 463: Stay with Grandpa Chu
chapters.content:
Chapter 463 Stay with Grandpa Chu
Xu Shiyan and his wife supported Mr. Chu, and the four children followed behind, chattering, and the group went back to their home.
"Master, this is the residence arranged for you, you live in the East Room.
Westinghouse sometimes lives with a firefox, the rascal I mentioned earlier. "
Xu Shiyan helped Mr. Chu into the east room while explaining something.
Originally, the rascals lived in the first three houses in the east. After the houses were demolished, the rascals temporarily lived in the warehouse.
During those days, there were bricklayers and carpenters building houses at home, and rascals basically didn’t come back very often.
When the new house was finished and Su Anying led the children to live there, the rascal came back and lived in the Westinghouse.
Now that Mr. Chu is coming to live, Xu Shiyan has to tell Mr. Chu, lest Mr. Chu feel strange when he sees the fox.
"Oh, is that the fox you mentioned earlier? Well, it just happens to be my company."
Chu Xuanhuai laughed as soon as he heard it. He has always been particularly interested in the fox that Xu Shiyan said only needs to become a spirit, and this time he can meet him.
Xu Shiyan and the others arrived home from the train station after two o'clock. They ate, chatted, and packed things. It was already past five o'clock and almost six o'clock.
"Master, go to the kang and rest for a while, Xu Haiyuan, take good care of your grandfather Chu.
After watching the cartoon, you all go back to the Westinghouse. "
Xu Shiyan knew that these brats would never leave until they had finished watching the cartoon, so he asked the children not to disturb Mr. Chu's rest.
Of course, at this time, Mr. Chu can't sleep either, he just sits on the kang or rests on his side.
It is good to have children watching TV with him, so he is not lonely.
"Dad, can I stay and live with Grandpa Chu? I don't want to live with you."
Xu Haiyuan glanced at Xu Shiyan, and asked a question tentatively.
"You want to stay in the east room, do you like your Grandpa Chu, or do you want to watch TV?
Don't think I don't know what's on your mind. " Xu Shiyan snorted.
Brat, it’s fake to be with Grandpa Chu, but it’s real to want to watch TV, right?
"Dad, I only watched the news broadcast, I promise not to watch too much.
I just want to live with Grandpa Chu, I like to listen to his stories. "
Xu Haiyuan smiled at his father, blinked his eyes, and made a sincere promise.
"Cut, who will believe what you say."
Xu Shiyan curled his lips, this brat is so cautious, do you really think he can't see it?
"Manly man, you have to keep your word, and after you finish the news broadcast.
If your words don't count, I'll take you back to the Westinghouse. "
Old Chu is old after all, so it is not bad to leave a child to follow orders.
Xu Haiyuan will be nine years old soon, this kid is a ghost, he can do some errands and learn his tongue better than anyone else, it is indeed possible.
Xu Shiyan thought so, and he had to threaten his son, so that this brat would go to heaven with pride.
Since Xu Haiyuan agreed not to watch the news broadcast, he can definitely do it. This, Xu Shiyan still believes.
Xu Shiyan was actually very satisfied with his eldest son.
It's just that I'm always disgusted by my son every day, and I have to make things difficult for him when I have a rare opportunity.
As for Xu Haiyuan, he understands what his naive father thinks, and besides being helpless, he can only accompany him.
"Well, I promise, if I can't do it, I don't need Dad to lead me, I will go back by myself."
Just like that, the father and son discussed and decided that Xu Haiyuan stayed with Mr. Chu, and the other children went back to the Westinghouse to sleep after watching the cartoon.
This time, Xu Jinping did not argue with her brother.
She likes Mr. Chu, but she likes her mother more, so let's sleep with her.
She can come and chat with Grandpa Chu during the day.
Xu Shiyan told the children not to make noise while watching TV, and absolutely not to disturb Grandpa Chu's rest.
The children were quite obedient and nodded, and Xu Shiyan went back to Westinghouse.
"Daughter-in-law, take Yuanyuan's quilt home later, the child will stay in Dongtou with Master."
Xu Shiyan entered the door and talked to Su Anying.
"Well, I see, I'll hug it later."
Su Anying was not surprised by this at all. No one knew better than her the virtues of her eldest son.
Since Xu Haiyuan met Mr. Chu today, Su Anying knew that this little guy really had a temper with Mr. Chu.
Xu Haiyuan is actually very proud.
The person he likes can be anything, if he doesn't like it, no matter what the person does, he can at most nod and call when he meets him.
This kid admires the kind of people with real abilities the most, like Han Wenzhong, Xu Haiyuan admires them so much, he keeps talking about them all day long.
So don't think it was Xu Chenghou who ordered him in advance, it must be that Xu Haiyuan really wants to get close to Mr. Chu.
Otherwise, he would at most put on a show and get away with it.
But Xu Haiyuan is obviously not pretending to Mr. Chu, he really likes it.
"Tell me, our son learned martial arts from Uncle Han. If he also studied medicine from Mr. Chu, what will happen in the future?"
Su Anying thought about this question while flipping through the cabinet.
If the eldest son practices both martial arts and medicine, will he be considered both civil and military in the future?
Oh, thinking about it this way, Su Anying felt very proud.
She was happier than when she went to school to hold a parent-teacher meeting and the teacher praised her son for his good study.
Xu Shiyan was also stunned, "Does Yuanyuan like to study medicine? Why don't I know?"
In Xu Shiyan's eyes, there is nothing his son dislikes, and he is interested in everything. Can this kid like studying medicine?
"You? You are almost no longer a member of this family, what do you know?"
Su Anying couldn't hold back, she complained, and then laughed again.
"I should like it. He flipped through all the books in your study. I looked at them, and he was a little interested in those medical books."
Xu Shiyan patted his thigh happily, "Oh, it would be great if Yuanyuan really likes to study medicine."
Mr. Chu has always regretted that there is no inheritor for the ancestral medical skills. If Xu Haiyuan is really interested in this, it is a good time to start learning from Mr. Chu now.
"No wonder our father persuaded Master to stay and open a clinic here today. He co-authored it to pave the way for our son."
At this moment, Xu Shiyan finally understood.
Su Anying just laughed, "Yeah, you just noticed it? Yesterday my father was chatting with my mother there.
I also think what our father said makes sense, Mr. Chu is so old by himself, he can't live in the provincial capital by himself, and he doesn't have a close person to look after him.
Yes, the state and work unit must control the status of a person.
But the nanny you hired is not as careful as your relatives, right?
You are his apprentice, regardless of how many years this apprentice has been, that is also a serious master, and you should be responsible for taking care of Mr. Chu.
I also think it's better for Mr. Chu to stay, but let's not rush this matter, take your time.
Waiting for the next year, you take the time to ask Mr. Chu to see what he means. "
"Come on, it has to be my daughter-in-law, what I think is thoughtful."
Xu Shiyan felt so beautiful in his heart, so he leaned over and kissed his daughter-in-law on the face.
"Daughter-in-law, you've worked hard, my wife is better."
There was a power outage last night. I used my mobile phone to turn on the hotspot and uploaded the code words on my notebook. I made a mistake and published a chapter. Therefore, there are only three updates today, and there are no manuscripts.

chapters.title: Chapter 464: layout
chapters.content:
Chapter 464 Layout
The next day when I arrived home was the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth lunar month, and the participants were already on holiday.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan carried some things and went to Lin Qiyue's house.
Lin Qiyue was naturally very happy to see Xu Shiyan, and he dragged Xu Shiyan to sit down, and the two chatted.
"I didn't expect you to stay in the provincial capital until this time. I originally thought of holding a celebration party for you."
This autumn, Yishenchang’s ginseng production has hit a new high, and its foreign exchange earnings from orders are also much higher than last year.
Especially Changbai Mountain red ginseng, which is gradually gaining popularity outside the world, and orders from merchants have increased a lot this year.
Functional drinks have been approved by the province and approved for production
Lin Qiyue also arranged for people to go to Hong Kong City to register related patents.
"Our functional drinks have received a good response, and the price is higher than mineral water, and we have received a lot of orders.
Years later, the beverage factory will recruit another batch of workers.
Waiting for the weather to warm up, the beverage factory has to be expanded, and the current production workshop is not enough. "
"Didn't you say before that there is another spring not far from our holy mountain Tianquan?
When you come back from graduation next year, I think we can try to develop the spring water in that place and plan ahead.
This, nothing else, the main thing is to occupy the space first. What do you say? "
Lin Qiyue still has a very strategic vision. Quanyang Lake was taken away by the province. Who knows who is targeting the spring here?
Regardless of whether it is currently in production or not, what should be occupied must be occupied first, so as not to be robbed by others.
"Well, yes, this can be arranged."
The water at the Canyon Spring is ordinary mineral water, which is incomparable with the Tianquan of the Holy Mountain.
But it is really necessary to occupy it in advance, otherwise their layout here will be easily disrupted.
"By the way, what about the compound fertilizer you and the Agricultural University are researching?
When can the experiment be put into operation? When is it expected that the factory will be built and put into production? "
Lin Qiyue knew about the compound fertilizer used for ginseng.
In fact, Xu Shiyan discussed this matter with Lin Qiyue at the beginning.
Both of them feel that the current layout of the competition is already very reasonable, and they can't do everything, because they can't take care of it.
Of course, when the experiment successfully enters the stage of plant construction and production, a participant can cooperate with Donggang Town and Su Anying's company to build a fertilizer factory together.
As soon as you participate in the market, it is very good to buy shares and pay dividends, and avoid a lot of trouble.
"Well, there are already some eyebrows, and it is estimated that the basic ingredients will be finalized in the next year.
After the beginning of spring, the Agricultural University will specially arrange a research team to come over to conduct field tests and monitor the effectiveness of fertilizers on the spot. "
The organic fertilizer main and auxiliary materials of this compound fertilizer are actually the formula that Xu Shiyan researched before, and this is an upgraded version.
Add microbial powder that is beneficial to ginseng growth and soil improvement, as well as related amino acids and other ingredients.
Using microbial fermentation technology and modern production technology, scientifically and accurately control the production process, so that the fertilizer can be used to achieve the most reasonable effect.
“Actually, what I want to do most is to use controlled-release technology so that the fertility can be effectively and slowly released.
But at present, we do not have this technology in our country, and we need to study it further. "
Xu Shiyan remembered that before he was reborn, many fertilizers used this technology.
But he asked the professors of the Agricultural University, and they all said that there is no such thing yet.
Xu Shiyan felt that this compound fertilizer should be upgraded again to create an improved version.
Of course, this needs more in-depth research, if controlled release technology is not used.
After about two or three years of experimentation, we can enter the link of plant construction and production.
"Well, um, good, well done.
That day, I discussed publishing a book with County Magistrate Jiang, and he even praised you, saying that you have brought honor to our county.
If this fertilizer factory can really fall to our Donggang side, Donggang in the future will be great. "
Lin Qiyue couldn't understand those professional words, but he knew one thing anyway.
But whatever Xu Shiyan takes the lead to study, it must be beneficial to the development of the ginseng industry, so there is no need to say anything, just give full support and it will be over.
"By the way, our book is expected to be printed and published in April next year.
This time, County Magistrate Jiang and I are all in love with you. "
No matter who it is, it is a great achievement to be able to write a book.
Lin Qiyue never thought before that he would still be able to publish a book one day.
Even if it is co-authored, the ranking is at the bottom, and that is something to be proud of.
Xu Shiyan stayed at Lin Qiyue's house for a long time, and the two had an in-depth discussion on the current development and future planning of the venue.
Originally, Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong should be called over to chat together.
Ke Li Bingzhuo's son Li Chengrong is getting married tomorrow, and the Li family is extremely busy.
Lin Qiyue said that after the next year, several people will get together to finalize the development plan for next year.
Lin Qiyue wanted to keep Xu Shiyan for dinner, but Xu Shiyan didn't agree.
"Well, my sister-in-law is getting married tomorrow, and my husband doesn't know how busy he is right now.
I'll go over to have a look and help.
Let’s go to another day, whether it’s at my house or at your place, let’s get together and have a good drink. "
"Okay, I'll go over to Laoli tomorrow too, let's talk then." Lin Qiyue nodded upon hearing this.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan bid farewell to Lin Qiyue and left the Lin family.
Riding a motorcycle in the winter suffered, and the slippery roads were prone to danger, so Xu Shiyan didn't ride a motorcycle, but walked back.
Su's side is also very lively today.
The youngest daughter of the Su family is getting married tomorrow, and many relatives and friends have come.
The daughters of the Su family returned with their sons-in-law and children, Su Weicheng's family, and some relatives from Daying.
People from the Nan family and the Ji family have all come here.
Everyone gathered together, talking and laughing while busying themselves, which was quite interesting.
Given Xu Shiyan's current status in the Su family, when he comes, everyone will definitely welcome him warmly.
When the big guys saw Xu Shiyan, they were all overjoyed, and surrounded Xu Shiyan to greet him, not to mention being very enthusiastic.
Xu Shiyan kept smiling and chatting with everyone, no matter what people mentioned, he would answer in a leisurely manner.
"Second brother, you have got a good son-in-law. This second son-in-law is really capable and capable.
Look at your family, isn’t it much better than in Daying? "
Su Weicheng looked at Xu Shiyan who was surrounded by a group of young people, feeling very emotional.
"Brother, what you said is true, our family Yingzi has a good life and got a good son-in-law.
Our family has all followed the son-in-law. "Su Wei is so beautiful that he can't even close his mouth.
Speaking of which, the second uncle really did too much for the family.
If the old five and the sixth didn't have Xu Shiyan's help, would they be where they are today?
He, Su Weizhong, is not a son-in-law, can he go to the beverage factory to watch the gate?
Don't look at him as a temporary worker, whoever sees him in the beverage factory can't respect him?
Is that respect for him? That's all respect for Xu Shiyan.
People say that a son-in-law is half the size, but this second son-in-law is no worse than a son.

chapters.title: Chapter 465: celebrate new year together
chapters.content:
Chapter 465 Celebrating New Year Together
Su's house was brightly lit this night, and everyone was busy preparing things for tomorrow's wedding.
Making dumplings, checking the dowry, and confirming the list for sending relatives tomorrow, I have been busy until midnight.
On the morning of the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, Li Chengrong, accompanied by relatives and friends, came to Su's house to welcome his relatives.
Wherever he went, Xu Haiyuan from Kidswant led people to block the door.
Fortunately, Li Chengrong was well prepared and prepared a lot of red envelopes, and finally passed the test smoothly.
After going through a series of procedures to meet the bride, Li Chengrong finally embraced the beauty as he wished.
Li Chengrong was incomparable to Han Liwei, and he couldn't put on that kind of ostentation.
Li Bingzhuo lent his son the car arranged for him by attending the event.
Xu Shiyan also transferred the three halves of the farm to use, and it looked pretty good anyway.
All the cars are tied with big red flowers in front, and two red balloons are specially tied to the rearview mirror, which looks very festive.
The newcomer sat in the front jeep, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui became the golden couple this time.
The two babies are now grown up and sensible, very well-behaved, sitting in the car without moving anything, which is very rare.
The convoy left from Su's house, and returned to Li's house at the east end of the venue after a half-circle.
When Li's family saw the convoy arriving, amidst the sound of firecrackers, Sun Limei stepped forward to greet her and took her daughter-in-law next.
Su Anhua got out of the car, put flowers on her mother-in-law, and called mom affectionately.
Sun Limei was so happy that she didn't know why, she hurriedly responded, then took out a big thick red envelope and stuffed it into Su Anhua's hand.
The newlyweds enter the door, and everything proceeds according to the normal wedding procedures.
Li’s place is not too big, and it’s troublesome to set up banquets at home, so they also set up tables in the canteen.
The Li family prepared a sumptuous banquet to entertain the guests who came to congratulate, and Lin Qiyue served as the attending secretary.
This occasion will definitely come, everyone gathers together, eating, drinking, talking and laughing, it is extremely lively.
On the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth lunar month, the two families of Su and Li will meet each other.
On the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth lunar month, Li Chengrong accompanied Su Anhua back home.
The young couple got along for several years and finally got married. The newlyweds are naturally very affectionate.
Li Chengrong loved his wife in the first place, let alone this time, he took such good care of Su Anhua that all the sisters were envious of her.
Su Weizhong and his wife looked at the situation and knew that their daughter had a good life after marriage, so they were relieved.
The six daughters belong to each other, and they are all doing well. The old couple is completely lost.
In the future, as long as you take care of yourself and don't cause trouble for the children, it's better than anything else.
Getting married before the year, the excitement is lively and busy.
So after Su Anhua returned home, the sisters who were far away hurried away by car.
Before he left, Ji Tongzhong told Xu Shiyan that if he had the opportunity in the future, he would find a way to help him. He also moved here, and this place is still lively.
What can Xu Shiyan say? I can only hum and agree.
He is also the uncle of the Su family, so he can help as much as he can, but Ji Tongzhong has to work hard.
This busy, one year passed quietly, and it was New Year's Eve in a blink of an eye.
This year, Chu Xuanhuai is celebrating the New Year here, and Su Weizhong and his wife are also in Donggang.
After discussing with Zhou Guilan and Xu Shiyan, Xu Chenghou said that it would be better to let Su Weizhong and his wife come over too, and the big guys will have a lot of fun together.
Otherwise, all the daughters of the Su family have gone out, and there will be only the old couple left. It would be so boring to be deserted.
Xu Shiyan and his wife are naturally eager, but they are afraid that Su Weizhong and his wife are paranoid.
After thinking about it, it would be better to celebrate the New Year with Xu Shiyan.
At the very least, Su Weizhong and his wife are celebrating the New Year at the house of their daughter and uncle, not at the house of their in-laws, so they can feel more at ease.
Xu Chenghou didn't object to this either.
He is very open-minded now. The houses on both sides belong to the third son’s family. Where is the New Year’s Eve?
It’s enough to be happy and lively during the Chinese New Year, don’t worry about it so much.
Children are not easy, why bother to worry about those, and add trouble to your son and daughter-in-law?
Just like that, on New Year's Eve, Su Weizhong, his wife, Xu Chenghou and his wife, all came to Xu Shiyan's side.
Now, the house is very lively, Xu Haiyuan jumped up and down, happily celebrating Grandpa Chu and grandma and grandpa coming to the house for the New Year.
Su Anying, Han Cai'e, and Zhou Guilan were doing various tasks in the kitchen, frying, frying and frying.
The three old men, Su Weizhong, Xu Chenghou, and Chu Xuanhuai, were sitting on the kang, drinking tea, playing chess and chatting.
Xu Shiyan looked at the scene in front of him, and felt very beautiful in his heart.
How wonderful, I just like this reunion scene.
Let’s say it is now, and after many years of waiting, there will not be many such scenarios.
"Come on, look this way."
Xu Shiyan held the camera in his hand, beckoned all the three old men to look at him, and with a click, recorded this beautiful moment.
"Dad, Dad, take pictures for us too, we want to take pictures too."
Xu Haiyuan and the others saw that their father was taking photos of the grandpas, and they all jumped up and down and asked Xu Shiyan to take photos of them too.
"Okay, go to the kang and sit with grandpa, I'll take photos for you all."
Chinese New Year is just to coax children to be happy. These are the most precious image memories.
It’s just a film, he bought several, just take a picture.
So, Xu Shiyan took a few photos of the children and the old man, and then took photos of the children alone, making the children very happy.
After taking pictures of the room, Xu Shiyan went to the kitchen with the camera, just in time to take pictures of Zhou Guilan and others busy cooking.
"You, if you don't work, you will make trouble. What is there to take pictures in this kitchen? Waste that film.
Hurry up and get out, this is oily smoke and water vapor, be careful with that camera, it was bought for a lot of money, don’t be fooled. "
Zhou Guilan saw it, and she had to teach her son a few words.
This bear thing is becoming less and less serious now, but I bought a camera and used it all day long.
"Didn't you take a lot of photos on Hua'er's wedding day? Why haven't you had enough fun yet? This has started again?"
On the day of Su Anhua's wedding, Xu Shiyan snapped a lot of pictures with his camera.
"Send the photo to be washed earlier, and leave a copy for Hua'er after washing."
"Mom, isn't there still some film left? I have to wash it together after taking the photo." Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard that.
On the day of Su Anhua's wedding, one film was not enough, so she took a few more photos after changing the film.
You have to get all the pieces together before you can wash them, otherwise it would be too wasteful.
"Okay, you go out first, don't get in the way here, and when we eat later, let's take a group photo together."
Zhou Guilan waved her hand and knocked her son out of the kitchen.
When all the food was ready and brought into the room, Xu Shiyan first took a picture of the food on the table.
Then waited for the mother, mother-in-law, and daughter-in-law to all enter the house. The old man sat on the edge of the kang, holding a child on each lap, and Su Anying stood aside.
Xu Shiyan found out the camera bracket, and after setting the time-lapse shooting, he quickly ran to the other side and stood up.
With the flash light on, there was a click, and the most beautiful moment was recorded.

chapters.title: Chapter 466: want to stay
chapters.content:
Chapter 466 Want to stay
In order to celebrate the coming of Mr. Chu and Su Weizhong to celebrate the New Year, this year's reunion dinner is extraordinarily rich.
Thanks to Xu Shiyan's family, the side table is quite big, even so, eighteen dishes are piled up on the table to form a hill.
"Come on, sit down, everyone pour a glass of hawthorn beer."
The family is either an old man or a child, so don’t even think about drinking.
This hawthorn beer is a new drink that came out recently, and it costs 50 cents a bottle.
It is similar to soda water, the light red one has a taste of hawthorn, so it is called hawthorn beer.
This stuff is the favorite of children, and it is usually not drinkable.
It’s Chinese New Year, give them some drinks.
Sure enough, when they saw the bottle of Hawthorn Beer in their father's hand, the children all sat down obediently, staring at the bottle.
Watching Dad pour everyone into the cup one by one.
You can’t use the half-two small wine cup for drinks.
It happened that there were six fine porcelain teacups that Xu Shixiang brought back from Tonghua that year, and several transparent glass cups at home.
Anyway, it doesn’t matter what it’s for, this time it’s used to pack hawthorn beer.
Xu Shiyan first poured it for Mr. Chu, Xu Chenghou, and Su Weizhong, and after a circle, there were a few babies at the end, which happened to be glass.
The children watched eagerly, seeing their father pour the light red hawthorn beer into the glass, and then white bubbles burst into the glass.
"Dad, more, more."
Xu Haiqing was in a hurry, because he was afraid that his father poured too little.
"Cut, little silly hater, pour too much and the bubbles will come out.
I'll run out of drink later, let Dad pour it again. "
Xu Jinping glanced at her younger brother with a look of disgust.
Is this silly thing a child of their family? Why are you so stupid, you have nothing else to do but eat.
The cups in front of everyone were filled with hawthorn beer, and then Xu Shiyan also sat down.
"Come on, it's a rare reunion this year, let's all raise our cups and have a drink together.
Wish the old people good health and a long life.
I also wish a few children, in the new year, how tall they are, how long their hearts are, and they will study hard and make progress every day.
Wish my daughter-in-law be as beautiful as a flower and rich in wealth. "Xu Shiyan said with a smile while holding the cup.
All the people followed and raised their cups.
The little ones couldn't hold it with one hand, so they simply held the cup with both hands, all with excited faces.
"Father, I also wish you success in your studies and advancement."
Xu Haiyuan held the cup and said solemnly.
"Hey, listen quickly, whose baby is this, why is he so good at talking?"
Old Chu and the others were so happy when they heard this, they couldn’t close their mouths from ear to ear.
This kid is really rare, he can talk about everything at a young age.
"Okay, okay, let me borrow your blessing, come, let's all have a drink."
Xu Shiyan was also very happy. This eldest son, who usually looks at Pi, can always bring some little surprises at critical times.
Everyone clinked glasses together.
A few small ones did not fall down, and they had to touch the crooked ones, almost spilling the drink in the cup.
The cups touched each other, making a crisp sound, and everyone's faces were filled with happy smiles.
Take a sip of the sweet and sour hawthorn beer. Although it has no taste of wine, it is more intoxicating than wine. This is the taste of happiness.
"Okay, let's eat vegetables, let's all eat vegetables, today's reunion dinner is great, you can eat it all." Zhou Guilan called everyone to use chopsticks to eat vegetables.
The reunion dinner on New Year's Eve was too delicious.
The children were dumbfounded looking at the delicious food on the table, and they didn't know what to eat.
The adults are by your side, hurry up and get some sweet and sour pork ribs for the children, or good places like chicken thighs and fish stomachs.
With a few chopsticks, the small plates in front of the children are full.
Children don’t have to worry about which one to eat, they just eat vegetables, and take a sip of hawthorn beer from time to time while the adults are not paying attention.
The unique taste of carbonated drinks fascinates children, and they drink up a glass before they know it.
"Dad, have another drink."
Xu Haiqing drank the fastest, so he put the empty cup in front of Xu Shiyan, and said proudly.
Xiaowa's cute appearance made everyone laugh out loud.
"Quick, pour it for my grandson, it's so much fun, little guy."
Chu Lao is very happy. The four children of the Xu family each have their own characteristics, which is really interesting.
The old Chinese New Year coaxed the child to have fun, so Xu Shiyan naturally couldn't care about his son.
So he took the bottle and poured another glass for his younger son.
"Drink it slowly, this stuff is full of steam, and it's time for my stomach to feel bloated and uncomfortable later."
Xu Shiyan knew that everything he said was in vain, and these skinny kids wouldn't listen to him, but he still had to give instructions.
Where does Xu Haiqing care about that? Carefully bringing the cup back, he lowered his head and took a sip from the side of the cup.
"It's delicious." This guy, with a satisfied expression on his face, looks like an alcoholic after drinking.
Children, no matter what actions they do, they are rare.
The appearance of the little guy made the big guy laugh again.
Chu Xuanhuai looked at the people in the room, then looked at the apprentice couple, and these four lively and cute babies. How many years has it been so lively?
The old man felt a little lost for a moment, then shook his head.
Hey, forget about those things in the past, cherish the present and cherish the future, that is the most important thing.
"Shiyan, what do you think if I really open a clinic here?"
Chu Xuanhuai took a sip of the hawthorn beer, looked at the light red drink in the cup, and suddenly asked.
Since Xu Chenghou made this suggestion that day, especially after meeting Xu Haiyuan, Chu Xuanhuai has really been thinking about it for the past few days.
He is alone and has a high pension. In fact, he can live well anywhere, and there is no need to open any clinic.
After getting along with each other these days, Chu Xuanhuai can also see that this child Xu Haiyuan is not pretending to like medical skills, this child is really talented in this area.
Chu Xuanhuai casually taught the formulas of medicinal properties and pulse formulas, and the child could memorize them verbatim after only listening to them once.
This child is too spiritual, it is really a waste of money not to study medicine.
Chu Xuanhuai thought about it for a long time.
The medical skills passed down from the Chu family's ancestors have no successors in his generation. When he dies in the future, he will really have no face to see his ancestors.
My son refused to learn, and those students in the medical school all studied Western medicine.
Although Xu Shiyan has a heart, he is past his best age.
Only this Xu Haiyuan is at the right age and has spiritual understanding.
Such a good seedling is rare, and Chu Xuanhuai really doesn't want to miss it.
The old man is in his seventies, and his health is not bad. It is estimated that there will be no problem in living for more than ten years.
If he can stay by Xu Haiyuan's side, with the ten years of hard work and careful teaching, he will surely achieve something in the future, and it can be regarded as leaving a legacy.
Of course, studying medicine cannot only teach theory, but must be combined with practice.
The best way is to open a small clinic as Xu Chenghou said.
As long as Xu Haiyuan has time, let him watch from the sidelines and teach by hand, so that he can learn real skills.
"Master, do you really want to stay?" When Xu Shiyan heard this, he almost stood up excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 467: teacher
chapters.content:
Chapter 467 Teacher
Chu Xuanhuai smiled when he saw Xu Shiyan's excited face.
"Well, this place has nice scenery and people, I quite like it.
However, if you want me to stay, I still have one condition. "
"Brother Chu, just say what conditions you have, as long as you can stay, no matter what the conditions are, we will agree."
Before Xu Shiyan could speak, Xu Chenghou nodded first.
Why are you hesitating about this? It is also impossible for Chu Xuanhuai to make any request that is difficult for others, so why dare not agree to it?
"Yes, yes, Master, just ask for any conditions you have, and I will definitely help you to meet them." Xu Shiyan echoed.
Xu Chenghou's straightforwardness made Chu Xuanhuai appreciate it. He nodded and looked at Xu Haiyuan.
"Let Yuanyuan study medicine with me, just such a request, if you agree, I will stay."
The old man looked at Xu Haiyuan with a loving smile on his face.
"Xu Haiyuan kowtowed to Master.
Being favored by his master, he doesn’t think Haiyuan is ignorant, ignorant, clumsy and clumsy. Xu Haiyuan is willing to study medicine with his master, heal diseases and save lives, and inherit Chu’s medical skills. "
Before Chu Xuanhuai could finish his sentence, Xu Haiyuan knelt down in front of Chu Xuanhuai quickly and kowtowed three times.
Everyone in the room was dumbfounded, no one expected that Xu Haiyuan reacted so quickly, and directly kowtowed in salute.
What's more, I didn't expect this little guy to speak clearly and logically.
It was Chu Xuanhuai who reacted the fastest, and quickly stretched out his hand to call Xu Haiyuan to get up.
"Ouch, good boy, good boy, get up, get up.
It’s been so many years, I don’t like this old etiquette.
As long as you really want to learn from me, the master will keep everything you have learned in your life and give it to you. "
The old man had tears in his excited eyes and trembling hands. The regrets of these years were finally made up for today.
"Come, come, sit beside Shigong.
Unexpectedly, my old man has been teaching for half his life, and when he is old, he meets such a good boy.
That's great, this kid is very clever, and he is a rare seedling.
You can rest assured that I will do my best to cultivate children into talents. "
Chu Xuanhuai dragged Xu Haiyuan to sit next to him, couldn't hold back, but still hugged Xu Haiyuan in his arms, weeping.
In the room, no one spoke aloud.
Sometimes, no amount of persuasion or comfort is superfluous, and emotions still need to be vented.
Xu Jinping seemed wrong, so she ran to Elder Chu, took out her small handkerchief, and raised her hand to wipe Elder Chu's tears.
"Grandpa Chu, don't cry. If you think that brother alone is not enough, I will follow you."
The little girl frowned. She wasn't really interested in any medical books, but Grandpa Chu was so sad, and she didn't know how to comfort her.
Is it not enough to accept one student? Then she followed suit.
Children's words, full of sincerity, Mr. Chu was amused by Xu Jinping.
"The female doll doesn't study medicine, it's too tiring.
Grandpa Chu taught you piano, chess, calligraphy and painting, and raised you into a little lady. "
After getting along with each other these days, Elder Chu has already figured out the temperament of several children.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, the two elders, are both extremely intelligent children, but they have their own strengths.
Xu Haiyuan has the spirituality and understanding in medicine, as long as he cultivates it carefully, he will definitely not be bad.
Xu Jinping is smart, but she doesn't care about it.
Children at such an age, no matter what they learn, they should focus on their interests.
If you like it, you can learn it well. If your ambition is not here, you can't force it.
Xu Jinping loves to sing, dance, and paint. You can start from these aspects to cultivate. In medicine, you can’t force it.
Old Chu was also from a famous family back then, with a long history of family education.
I dare not say anything else, but it is more than enough to teach a little girl like Xu Jinping calligraphy and painting.
"Really? Wow, that's great, I've got someone to teach me, too."
Sure enough, when the little girl heard that she was being taught piano, chess, calligraphy and painting, she immediately became happy, jumping and clapping her hands.
"Dad, did you hear that?
Grandpa Chu said, he wants to teach me piano, chess, calligraphy and painting, remember to buy me a piano next time you go out. "
The little girl was so proud that she started to ask her father.
"Okay, okay, this is fine. When Dad returns to the provincial capital, I will find a way to find it for you."
As long as Mr. Chu is happy and the child is happy, you can buy anything.
With such a little girl to adjust the atmosphere, how can Mr. Chu care about feeling sad?
Leave all the sad things out of the blue, and just have fun.
"This girl is very interesting. I don't know where she can develop in the future?"
Old Chu shook his head, this little girl has a wide range of interests and hobbies, I really don't see what she can do in the future.
"Cough, it doesn't matter so much, as long as the child grows up healthy and can read and write, he can do whatever he wants."
Xu Chenghou can take it easy. In the hearts of these old people, the most important thing is for children to grow up healthy.
"Yes, yes, that makes sense.
Come on, let's drink another one, congratulate our family and find a good teacher. "
Over there, Su Weizhong also nodded, and then raised his cup to congratulate Xu Haiyuan and Elder Chu.
"Come, come, drink all."
During the Chinese New Year, you should be happy and bustling. How nice it is, it’s another happy event, and it must be celebrated.
Everyone talked and laughed, ate and drank, and unconsciously, they ate a lot.
Several children are in love with hawthorn beer, and they don’t eat much food.
Adults can also eat vegetables vigorously, just some steamed buns at the end.
After the reunion dinner, Su Anying and his wife cleared the table away.
Su Anying washed the dishes and cleaned the kitchen, Xu Shiyan began to find melon seeds, peanuts, pine nuts, hazelnuts and other things, and fried them in one pot.
Zhou Guilan and Han Cai'e are chopping stuffing and noodles, and preparing dumplings in advance.
I will start making dumplings later, so I can watch TV in peace at night.
There is an advantage of celebrating the New Year with Xu Shiyan, that is, no one watches TV, so it is less noisy.
This year is the first time since the sub-fields went to households to start making products.
Although each family did not start much, but the market is good and the price is high, and each family has a lot of money left.
Sometimes life is good, and I don’t care too much, so I simply go to Songjianghe or the county, buy a TV and come back.
I can’t afford a color TV, so why don’t you bring back a head office in black and white?
As life gets better and better, there will be more and more TVs. In the future, fewer and fewer people will go to other people's homes to watch TV.
It's six o'clock, and the children can't wait to turn on the TV, listen to storytelling, and watch cartoons.
Dongwu kang put the panel a little bit, and then put the basin, stuffing basin, curtain, etc. on it.
Zhou Guilan, Han Cai'e, and Su Anying started making dumplings.
Xu Shiyan was still rolling the skin, while the old men were sitting on the kang, watching TV and chatting.
After the animation finished, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping also came to help.
There are many people, and the work is fast. Before eight o'clock, the dumplings have already been made.
Hurry up to clean up, bring melon seeds and candy, and everyone sits on the kang, staring at the TV screen, watching this year's Spring Festival Gala.
From time to time, the funny performances of the actors on TV made the whole room laugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 468: This year's ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 468 This year's ginseng
New Year's Eve reunion night, every family celebrates and every household is auspicious.
The Spring Festival Gala in the house was full of joy and laughter, and firecrackers burst out outside the house, and the whole country celebrated and celebrated the New Year together.
The Xu family has a lot of people this year, so this New Year's Eve is much more lively than previous years.
Chu Xuanhuai has never had such a lively and festive Chinese New Year, and this night, the smile on his happy face has never stopped.
"It's better if there are more people, it's really lively, not deserted at all."
Seeing the children bouncing up and down following the dance on TV, Elder Chu couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"That's right, Chinese New Year, that is, celebrating children, with children in front of you, it's very lively.
It will be fine in the future, you are here, we are so lively every year. " Xu Chenghou also laughed.
After eleven o'clock, the sound of firecrackers sounded outside one after another.
Xu Shiyan saw that the time was almost up, so he led the children out to set off cannons.
The second year of the Spring Festival Gala, the children probably watched TV all day, not as reluctant as last year.
One by one, they put on their coats and hats, and ran out to watch Dad set off firecrackers and fireworks.
When all kinds of fireworks exploded in the air, the children all exclaimed.
"Wow, so beautiful, Dad, next year our family will buy more of this."
This year, Xu Haiyuan is a little bit older, more courageous than before.
Some small fireworks, such as small planes and bees, are not dangerous, so he dares to do them.
So I led my younger brothers and sisters to set off various small fireworks in the yard to play.
When it comes to burning money, setting off fireworks and firecrackers can definitely be regarded as fast.
In less than half an hour, the basket of firecrackers and fireworks was all set off, and the children still had more fun.
"Wait until the fifteenth day of the first lunar month. Let's put some more at that time. It's too cold. Let's go back to the house for dinner."
I don’t know if it’s a human illusion, but I always feel that New Year’s Eve is the coldest time.
Xu Shiyan led the children to set off fireworks outside for such a long time, fearing that the children would freeze, so he hurriedly led the children back to the house.
Just at this time, the dumplings have been cooked and taken out to serve.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly asked the children to take off their coats and hats, warm their hands, and eat dumplings.
As usual, the dumplings on New Year’s Eve are still stuffed with cabbage and radish.
The children all wanted to make money by eating, so they all stared at the plate eagerly, seeing which dumpling looked rich, and then picked it up and ate it.
When I ate it, I clapped my hands happily, and when I couldn't eat it, I held back my energy and continued to look for it.
Zhou Guilan saw that they ate a lot of these, and eating too much at night is easy to accumulate food.
Thanks to her thinking of a way, she specially packed a few marked ones.
So I quickly searched out, one for each person.
The children finally got the money, and they were all satisfied. They all touched their swollen bellies and ran to rest.
After eating dumplings, I kowtowed to my grandparents and received red envelopes.
This is the perfect year for kids.
Even if they slept in the afternoon, by now, the children couldn't bear it anymore, and they all rubbed their eyes and wanted to sleep.
So Su Anying led the children back to the west room to sleep, while the others sat on the Kang and watched TV and chatted.
It wasn't until the end of the party that there was no TV left, so the TV was turned off, and everyone just found a place to stare.
Visit relatives and friends on the first day of the Lunar New Year.
Xu Shiyan left half of his son at home in advance. After breakfast, he took the children and went to Han's house first to pay New Year greetings to Han Wenzhong and his wife.
After leaving the Han family, he went to the Li family, Li family, Lin Qiyue, and Dai Chunrong's house.
They are all participating, and it’s not too far away. You have to go from house to house in this circle.
The Xu family's children are quite sensible, not annoying, and attract people's attention wherever they go.
Among other things, the pockets are full of candy and other delicious food.
For the Chinese New Year, Xu Shiyan is not good at controlling the children, he just tells them to control them, not to eat them all at once, and save them to eat slowly.
After walking around the field, Xu Shiyan drove, and took the children to Songjianghe to pay New Year greetings to Guo Shouye and his wife.
Guo Shouye and his wife are Xu Haiyuan's godfather and godmother, and they specially picked up Xu Haiyuan to live there for two days a year ago.
On the first day of the Lunar New Year, when children come to pay New Year’s greetings, red envelopes must be indispensable.
Each of the four children gets a share, but Xu Haiyuan's share is a bit thicker than the other children.
Children don't care about those, as long as they have red envelopes, they will be beautiful.
"Okay, go play with Sister Fengxia, keep all the money, don't lose it."
Xu Shiyan couldn't stop the children from receiving red envelopes, so he could only ask them.
Xu Haiyuan nodded in agreement, and led his brothers and sisters to play with Guo Fengxia.
The eldest and second child of the Guo family went out to visit, and the third child was at home, leading Xu Haiyuan and the others to make snowmen and put flowers.
Guo Fengxia is very patient in coaxing the children, and the children are also willing to play with her.
In the room, Guo Shouye and Xu Shiyan sat on the sofa chatting.
While chatting, Guo Shouye suddenly remembered that there are some good ginseng land in the resource department this year.
"Shi Yan, where are you going to make the soil this year?
The Resource Department has a few good places this year, let me tell you, if you are optimistic about which one.
We will make a decision when we go to work next year.
The past two years have not been better than before, and the ginseng soil is not very easy to clean up, so I am thinking about it.
As far as our relationship is concerned, I'm sure you will come first. "
When Xu Shiyan heard it, hey, this is a big deal, "Brother, tell me, where is it all?"
Xu Shiyan is familiar with most of these logging areas under the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau.
He knows exactly where the stick is good, and where there are mistakes. Since he is spending money to buy ginseng soil, he must be the best.
"There is a piece on the side of the five branch line, there is a piece in Shuguang Forest Farm, and there is a piece behind the machine repair factory.
The nursery is not far from Dajiang Gang, and there is also one. "
Guo Shouye thought about it, these pieces are all large in size, Xu Shiyan will definitely not ask for a too small area.
"Brother Guo, leave the mechanic shop to me.
Has there been logging areas over there for several years? If there is one next year, leave it to me. "
Xu Shiyan had an impression of the pieces of ginseng soil that Guo Shouye mentioned.
The fifth branch line goes to Quanyang, which is a bit far away.
Shuguang Forest Farm is quite far away, and the ginseng soil in that place is not good, and it suffers from sclerotinia.
Whoever planted a club there could lose everything.
Not far from the Nursery Bridge, there is a river face, the **** is too steep and the soil layer is thin.
And that piece is full of water, and it will grow red and rust if it is planted with a stick, and it will rot easily.
The soil quality at the machine repair shop is good.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan made twenty-eight feet of ginseng soil near the machine repair shop in 1993.
At that time, the ginseng market was still at a low point. Xu Shiyan had lost a lot of money by planting ginseng before, and had no money in hand.
I can only buy the seeds from the supply and marketing cooperatives, pick out the usable ones from them, and plant them in the field.
