Even the plastic sheeting for ginseng, I don’t have the money to buy it. I just buy waste plastic sheeting that other people have been towing for three years, and it will come down year by year.
As a result, in 1996, the twenty-eight-foot stick was sold for more than 10,000 yuan.
At any rate, it's a bit of a slowdown, the family is not so tight anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 469: Can we cooperate
chapters.content:
Chapter 469 Can we cooperate
"Okay, you have chosen a place, and after you go to work, let's go over and go through the formalities.
The specific area can be found on the other side of the unit.
There is indeed a cutting area next year. If you want it, I will keep it for you next year. "
Guo Shouye nodded. For him, this matter is a piece of cake. He can do it with his mouth, no problem.
"Brother, I really have something to do and I want to ask you for help."
Guo Shouye pondered for a moment, then hesitated and opened his mouth.
"Huh? Brother, do we still have to see each other like this?
If you have anything to do, you can just say it, as long as I can do it, I will definitely do it. "
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, what happened to Lao Guo? What could make him hesitate to speak?
"Brother, you have gone out to study, and you are also knowledgeable.
Tell me, just like the current logging volume of our Forestry Bureau, in a few years, will it still be as prosperous as it is now? "
Guo Shouye glanced at Xu Shiyan and asked a very in-depth question.
When Xu Shiyan heard this question, he suddenly regained his energy. He didn't know anything else, but he knew this all too well.
In the early 1990s, the Forestry Bureau was still a prosperous unit. As long as there was timber to send out, the Forestry Bureau would have money.
At that time, many old timber customers in the South were in the Northeast, and those who gouged out doors and robbed holes tried to find a way to find connections, just to buy timber from the Forestry Bureau.
This thing really earned a lot of money back then.
How did Zhou Wanxiang become a millionaire? Isn't it just dumping wood?
He contracted the Mulenchang of Xianrenqiao, hired people to carry the wood and load it into wagons, and shipped it to the south, earning a lot of money.
At that time, many people in Xianrenqiao, Daying, and Hebei made money by lifting logs.
At that time, Zhou Wanxiang was also a well-known figure in the county, and everyone knew Zhou Wanxiang's name. Zhou Wanxiang was also a guest of the county magistrate back then.
How about saying that people are afraid of being famous and pigs are afraid of being strong? As a result, he was dragged by others, eating, drinking, whoring and gambling.
He also hooked up with a woman from the county radio station, and in the end his wife and children were separated, and the family was also ruined.
Of course, a lean camel is bigger than a horse.
Even if they were defeated in the end and the couple divorced, each of them still got 1.8 million yuan.
When was that? In less than two thousand years, 1.8 million is definitely a lot.
Even Zhou Wanxiang earns so much money by dumping wood. One can imagine what the Forestry Bureau was like when it was prosperous.
But as the forest resources are getting less and less, the annual logging area is getting smaller and smaller.
From clear felling to selective cutting, and then to closure of mountains for afforestation, the Forestry Bureau also became more and more depressed.
The factories under the Forestry Bureau cannot afford wages, and many people have to find another way out.
By 1996, the Forestry Bureau was really failing, and slowly switched to other fields of development, but it would be difficult to restore its former glory after all.
"Brother, neither of us are outsiders, you asked me this, and I will tell you my opinion.
Based on the current situation, the Forestry Bureau should be fine for another decade or so. I really dare not say what will happen in the future. "
Xu Shiyan pondered for a moment before speaking.
"I didn't expect that brother can think in this way, you have a long-term vision."
Xu Shiyan admires Guo Shouye for this point. Most people don't think about it at all.
Nowadays, the forestry bureau still engages in big battles all the time.
All feel that the future is bright and the future is very beautiful.
No one knows what kind of situation the Forestry Bureau will face in more than ten years.
"I'm in the resources department. I've been transferred for several years anyway. How can this matter still be on my mind?" Guo Shouye laughed when he heard that.
"I just want to ask my brother, can the comprehensive utilization and sustainable development method you participated in be applied to forestry?
For example, this abandoned ginseng land.
After all, not all the people who approved the participation in the soil have the ability to participate in your field.
What about these ginseng? Is it possible to think of a way? "
Why did Guo Shouye hesitate? It was because of this that he was a little embarrassed.
This is a plan made by someone who participated in the field. When he asked this question, he was a bit suspected of wanting to get something for nothing.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard it, he immediately understood.
"Brother, we are not outsiders, I'll make a solid deal with you, I've really considered this aspect.
After all, there are only thousands of employees in the field, and it is really busy to plant sticks and set up factories.
We try our best to make comprehensive use of the waste ginseng soil we have used, but in other places, we can't take care of it at all.
Brother, if you have the heart, I will find a chance someday, and I will find Secretary Lin.
Let’s study this together and see how we can work together to make this happen. "
Effective utilization of forest resources cannot be accomplished by one participant or one department.
The Forestry Bureau has so many employees and unemployed young people. If the Forestry Bureau can join in, it will be of great benefit to the long-term development of the local area.
Participating in the field can provide technology, and the Forestry Bureau will send out people to work together to make this happen.
No matter what industry it is, only when it grows bigger can it have the right to speak, and win-win cooperation is the correct way of development.
One participant does not have the ability to monopolize, and only by joining forces with brother companies can he have the ability to resist greater risks.
Xu Shiyan can only say so much, after all, he is not yet the top leader in the field, no matter what he does, he must always ask Lin Qiyue for instructions.
Although Xu Shiyan doesn't know much about the ways of the system, he understands the minimum rules of life and work.
"Okay, I'll bring this matter up to our director later.
If it works, let's get together and get this done. "
Guo Shouye became happy when he heard this.
This is my brother, right? If it were someone else, who would help make this happen?
Everyone knows that I have been in the field for the past two years, and I have the ability to earn foreign exchange.
To be honest, as long as there is a lot of wind in the field and you want to find someone to cooperate with, there must be units rushing.
Let's not talk about Donggang Songjianghe, maybe even the county is looking forward to it.
"Success, you should ask your leader first to see what the leader thinks.
You have a letter, I will mention it to Secretary Lin. "
Xu Shiyan is, after all, the deputy head of a participating field, where the position is, speaking is still useful.
He and Lin Qiyue work very well together, and many things can be thought of to go together, as long as it is for the sake of participating, it is not difficult.
But Guo Shouye is different. He is the director of the resource department, and he is still some distance away from the director. He has nothing to say about the affairs of the bureau.
And now that the Forestry Bureau is booming, people may not be willing.
Just like that, the two discussed it properly, and it happened that it was getting late, and Xu Shiyan was about to take the child home.
Guo Shouye wanted to keep them, but now someone came to the family again.
No way, Guo Shouye had no choice but to say, invite Xu Shiyan's family to come over for dinner another day, so that everyone can have a good get-together.
Xu Shiyan led the children out of Guo's house, drove back, and came home just in time for dinner.
Those who celebrate the Chinese New Year have fat in their stomachs, and besides, they all go out to visit relatives and friends, and most of them eat two meals.
Su Weizhong and his wife went home early, and Xu Chenghou and his wife also returned home after breakfast, so the family is Chu Lao and Xu Shiyan's family.
There are leftover meals and dumplings from yesterday, just heat them up to deal with stuttering.

chapters.title: Chapter 470: in a hurry
chapters.content:
Chapter 470 Anxious
Not long after eating here, Guo Shouye called.
Ask Xu Shiyan when he is free, and several leaders of their bureau want to meet with a participant here.
Xu Shiyan immediately understood that the Forestry Bureau also wanted to cooperate.
"Brother, wait a minute, I'll give Secretary Lin a call, and I'll get back to you later."
Xu Shiyan immediately hung up the phone and called Lin Qiyue.
As soon as Lin Qiyue heard that the leader of the Forestry Bureau intended to cooperate with the participants, he immediately agreed.
"Shiyan, tell them that it will be on the fifth day.
Come to my house, I will ask my sister-in-law to prepare some delicious dishes, let's get together and discuss it. "
Before the third day of the first lunar month, every family has to visit relatives. There are too many things to do.
It was scheduled to be on the fifth day of the lunar new year, and everyone was almost busy, so I made time to talk about business.
Xu Shiyan also felt that the fifth day of the new year was very good, so he called Guo Shouye back.
It was fixed on the fifth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan went to find Guo Shouye, and the two of them accompanied the bureau leader to Lin Qiyue's house.
The two of them discussed it in this way, and then hung up the phone.
The first day of the first lunar month passed like this, and the second day of the first lunar month was a day for the Xu family to reunite.
After getting up early in the morning and just having breakfast, Han Liwei accompanied Xu Shiqin back first.
"Why did you two come back at this time? Would your parents-in-law be happy if you returned to your mother's house before the end of the year?"
When Zhou Guilan saw her daughter and uncle coming back, she was happy but more worried.
So he dragged his daughter into the back room and asked.
"Mom, it was my father-in-law who asked us to come back. He said that in today's new society, the old rules don't matter."
Xu Shiqin laughed as soon as he heard it, and hurriedly explained to his mother.
The sons of the Han family still live together when they get married. In previous years, the daughter-in-law returned home on the third day of the first lunar month.
This year, Han Wenzhong spoke directly, saying that he didn't care about those things.
Whoever is willing to go back to the second year of junior high school can go to the second year of junior high school, and whoever is willing to go to the third year of junior high school can do it, it makes sense.
Han Wenzhong's words were actually meant for Xu Shiqin.
The three sons of the Han family are all in front of them, within a day and a half, but several of the Xu family are far away.
Xu Shiqin has been in the capital for a year, and it is rare to come back, so she has to go back to her natal home to see her brothers and sisters-in-law.
The head of the family spoke, and Han Liwei accompanied Xu Shiqin back to her natal home.
After hearing this, Zhou Guilan finally felt relieved. She was afraid that Xu Shiqin would have to come back, so don't make the Han family unhappy.
"That's good, that's good, you are married to a good family, and I know how to understand you.
Remember to treat your in-laws better in the future, you know? "
"Got it, mom." Xu Shiqin hugged her mother's arm and acted like a baby.
"How old are you? You're still acting like a baby to your mother when you're so old? I think Huihui is older than you."
Zhou Guilan expressed disgust on her lips, but she had a happy smile on her face.
My daughter has been out for nearly a year now, and it is rare to come back. No matter how rare it is, I feel that rare is not enough.
"By the way, the few times you came back, in front of Liwei, I didn't have the nerve to ask.
You and Liwei never had a child? Or are you two not pregnant? "
As a mother, you have to worry about everything.
I didn’t dare to rush before, but it’s been a long time, I’ve been married for more than a year, and there is still no movement.
Zhou Guilan was worried that the Han family was unhappy, so thinking about it today, she hurried to ask.
Xu Shiqin was stunned when he heard the words, and then smiled wryly.
"My mother-in-law also asked that day, Mom, it's not that we don't want this.
Liwei is studying at school, and usually goes home once a month, and sometimes he has a mission, but not necessarily when.
We don’t see each other very often, how can we have children? "
Xu Shiqin is also very helpless, it's not that she doesn't want it, what else can she do?
"No, it's not those things, if you are both fine, you can't miss it.
Let's go, I'll take you two to your third brother's side, and ask you Uncle Chu to show you. "
Zhou Guilan shook her head, always feeling that something was wrong, no, I'd better ask someone to take a look and rest assured.
Xu Shiqin was also anxious. After being reminded by her mother, she suddenly remembered that Mr. Chu was not only the principal of the medical university, but also an imperial physician.
"Yes, yes, I forgot about it, let's go and have a look."
Xu Shiqin hurriedly followed Zhou Guilan out of the back room, walked up to Han Liwei, and whispered something in his ear.
Han Liwei nodded and got up after hearing this.
"Then what, do we have to buy something? How can there be empty hands here?"
It's not just the old people on both sides who are anxious. In fact, Han Liwei is more anxious than anyone else. How old is he? Haven't had a baby yet.
"You don't need to buy it, just take what you two brought back.
There are a lot of guests coming to our house, and we don’t lack anything.
You two beg someone to see a doctor, it doesn't look good with empty hands. "
When Zhou Guilan heard this, she quickly picked up the pile of things on the table and stuffed them into the hands of the uncle and daughter.
"That's fine, I'm not an outsider, let's go."
As he spoke, he couldn't help but push the two of them out.
Mother-in-law expressed kindness, but Han Liwei couldn't say anything else, so he went straight to the third uncle's house together with mother-in-law and daughter-in-law.
Xu Shiyan and his wife were leading their children towards their parents, when they met halfway.
"Mom, little sister, Liwei, what are you doing here?"
Xu Shiyan felt strange, why did these three people go in such a hurry?
Also, why did Han Liwei and his sister come back in the second year of junior high?
"I want your master to show them both." Zhou Guilan walked up to her son and whispered.
Xu Shiyan opened his mouth, and just wanted to say, how can someone seek medical treatment in the second year of junior high school?
There is no such rule, why have to wait until the fifteenth day of the first lunar month.
But after thinking about it, it is estimated that Han Liwei and his wife will have to return to the capital before the fifteenth day of the first lunar month.
"Well, Mom, then you can go with them. My master is reading at home. He said he won't join us in the fun today."
Today is the Xu family reunion, and Mr. Chu is unwilling to join in the fun, so he stays with Xu Shiyan to read.
When it comes to seeing a doctor, the fewer people there are, the better.
Xu Shiyan and his wife brought several children with them, so they didn't go back with them, so as not to embarrass Han Liwei.
Zhou Guilan nodded, and led Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin to continue walking, heading straight to her son's house.
"Brother Chu, that, I have something to ask you."
As soon as he entered the east room, he saw Mr. Chu sitting on the kang, flipping through a book.
Zhou Guilan signaled to her daughter and son-in-law to put things on the kang table.
Old Chu looked up and saw Zhou Guilan leading Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin, and immediately understood the purpose of the three of them.
"Come on, sit down, both of you sit down and take a while, don't rush."
Mr. Chu didn't say no to showing it, he just smiled and asked Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin to sit down.
"Brother and sister, you don't need to say anything, I understand.
I'll show them later and I'll know, it doesn't matter. "
Chu Xuanhuai saw what Zhou Guilan wanted to say, so he waved his hand. He knew everything about the Xu family, and he understood it without saying it.
"Hey, hey, thank you, Brother Chu. Ordinarily, this is the second day of the first lunar month, so you shouldn't bother.
But they are far away, and they will have to return to the capital in a few days. "
Zhou Guilan looked embarrassed, it's not that she doesn't understand the rules.
Those who celebrate the Chinese New Year, unless there is an emergency, most of the ordinary problems will not be seen by the doctor. It must be after the fifteenth day.
Isn't there no way?

chapters.title: Chapter 471: academic performance
chapters.content:
Chapter 471 Academic Records
Xu Shiyan and his wife led their daughter and son to sit down with their parents, and Xu Shian and his wife also brought their two sons.
Fourteen-year-old Xu Haibo and twelve-year-old Xu Haitao are not short anymore.
The two children are very good-looking, and they are full of energy, which makes people like it at first sight.
"Happy New Year to grandpa, happy new year to third uncle, and happy new year to third aunt."
As soon as the two boys entered the room, they quickly called for someone.
"Happy New Year to the second uncle, happy New Year to the second mother. Happy New Year to the eldest brother and the second brother."
Here, Xu Haiyuan also led his brothers and sisters to greet the elders quickly.
"Good, good, all good, all good."
Brothers Xu Shian all smiled and nodded, each took out a red envelope and gave it to the children.
Xu Shiyan specially put more money in the red envelope. His family has four children, and the second brother's family only has two, so he must give more.
"Third uncle, we are getting older, so we don't need lucky money."
When Xu Haibo saw his third uncle handing over the red envelope, the young man felt a little embarrassed and quickly waved his hand.
He felt that he was fourteen, and he couldn't be like his younger brothers and sisters, and he still received red envelopes.
"How old is it? How old is a child with your third uncle, who gave it to you, so take it as you need."
Xu Shiyan couldn't help but stuff the red envelope into the pockets of the two nephews.
It was Xu Haiyuan and the others who didn't care about those things. After thanking the second uncle and second mother, they ran away happily.
"Look, it was fun when I was a child, I didn't know anything, and I was having fun every day.
Both of them are grown up, and I know I'm embarrassed. "
Xu Chenghou was very surprised to see the two grandsons' faces.
"Come on, sit next to grandpa, and tell grandpa, how are you two studying?"
Xu Haibo scratched his head and laughed, "It's average, it's only average in school anyway."
Boys, most of them are naughty, playful, and not very fond of learning.
Xu Shian doesn't have much education, and he is usually busy, so he doesn't care about his children's studies at all.
Let’s talk about parents these days, who cares if their children are good or bad in their studies?
Anyway, it’s the path you choose yourself, so don’t regret it after suffering hardships in the future.
"Will Xiaobo be promoted to junior high school this summer? Study hard, and if you want to be successful, you have to go to college."
Xu Chenghou took a puff of his cigarette, looked up at his two grandsons, and said softly.
"Well, I am promoted to junior high school this year. Grandpa, I know, I have to study hard."
If the five-year primary school system had been followed, Xu Haibo would have been in the first grade of junior high school last fall.
As a result, the year before last was just in time for the pilot program of the six-year system, and last year the county unified the six-year system, so Xu Haibo had to start junior high school one year later.
"If you know how to study, you are too old to patronize and play.
Study hard and pass the exam is the best way out.
Your father doesn’t have a job, but your mother only has one job. Even if you are allowed to take over in the future, who will you two give it to?
Now the forestry bureau is struggling to recruit workers. If they can’t recruit workers, what can they do in the future? "
Xu Chenghou knew that children didn't like their elders talking about their studies, but he was really worried about it.
At present, among the children of the Xu family, one is counted as one. In terms of study, I am afraid that they are not as big as the two children of the third family.
Xu Haiyuan is in the third grade, and the final exam is 99.5% in mathematics and Chinese.
It is said that the 0.5 was deducted because the teacher changed the test papers.
The child not only studies well, but also has outstanding abilities.
I'm only in the third grade, and I'm already the captain of the school's Young Pioneers.
He has to host any school activities or the like, which is really unacceptable.
Girl Xu Jinping is not inferior, she also got double hundred in the final exam, and was chosen by the teacher to be the class monitor.
I heard from the teacher that Xu Jinping will be selected to join the school dance team in the coming year. Anyway, she is very happy in school.
At the beginning, the teacher thought she was too young and refused to accept her. Now if anyone says that Xu Jinping is not allowed to go to school, the teacher will probably be able to fight her.
Of course, Xu Chenghou couldn't say these words in front of Xu Haibo and the others.
If this is said, people can't think that his grandfather is eccentric and only loves the children of the third family?
Therefore, Xu Chenghou could only persuade him with good words, and this was also for the good of his grandchildren.
"Grandpa, I know, my dad told the two of us that we should study hard."
Xu Haibo is not stubborn, he does whatever his grandpa says.
While talking, Zhou Guilan, Han Liwei, and Xu Shiqin came back, looking at Zhou Guilan with a slightly heavy expression on his face.
In front of the child, Xu Chenghou couldn't ask what was going on.
It was Xu Haibo and his brothers who hurriedly wished grandma and sister-in-law and uncle a new year.
Xu Shiqin smiled and gave each of the children a red envelope, and then the big guys sat down and chatted.
Xu Chenghou took advantage of the time when Xu Shian and his wife were chatting with Han Liwei, and asked his old wife in a low voice.
"How are you doing? I don't look very good looking at you."
Zhou Guilan sighed slightly, "Brother Chu said, both children are physically deficient and need to take medicine for a while.
He prescribed a prescription, first took three doses of medicine to explore the way.
After eating it, I will look at it again. I guess I have to take seven or eight medicines for it to work. "
Xu Chenghou heard this, and glanced at Zhou Guilan, "What are seven or eight secondary medicines?
Looking at your faces, I thought it was a big deal.
What did Liwei not know at the time? That life is almost gone, so can the body not be at a loss?
Our daughter has been in poor health since she was a child, so she had two surgeries, can she take good care of her?
Brother Chu is capable, what are he afraid of? Just take the medicine when you need it, and just take care of your body. "
Xu Chenghou is a big man with a big heart, unlike Zhou Guilan who can't let go of some things.
"Well, yes." Zhou Guilan was only worried about her daughter.
Xu Shiqin finally found such a satisfactory son-in-law. If the two of them never had children, would the Han family have any idea?
But after thinking about it, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin have such a deep relationship.
Even if they really don’t have children, the two of them can live on forever, but it’s a bit of a pity.
It is best to have a child, regardless of boys and girls, just one, which is considered complete at any rate.
"Okay, don't think too much, the kids are coming back today, hurry up and get something delicious." Xu Chenghou whispered.
There are delicious ones at home, and the melon seed candies are on the table.
Just a few years ago, a batch of fruits came from Songjianghe. Zhou Guilan and Su Anying went to buy two baskets of apples, one basket of oranges, as well as frozen pears, frozen persimmons, jujubes and black dates.
Zhou Guilan hurriedly found a basin, and pulled out some of everything.
Frozen pears and frozen persimmons are soaked in cold water and eaten after a while, they are delicious.
Sure enough, as soon as all kinds of fruits were served here, Xu Haiqing's eyes widened.
"Grandma, I want to eat frozen pears, and I want to drink the soup inside."
The soup he was talking about was pear juice from frozen pears.
"As beautiful as you think, you still drink soup and eat pears, otherwise who would pick up your leftovers?"
Without waiting for others to speak, Xu Jinping began to lecture others.
"I grow a heart every day, let you recite an ancient poem, it's been three days, how many words have you recited?
If you can’t recite any more today, don’t eat anything.
Xu Jinping looked at her younger brother with a look of resentment.
This idiot is so simple, he can't read, doesn't learn pinyin, he eats and plays every day, pigs are smarter than him.

chapters.title: Chapter 472: blood pressure
chapters.content:
Chapter 472 Blood Suppression
Xu Haiqing is the youngest child in the family, so he should be the most favored.
It's a pity that there are two brothers and sisters who are against the sky, and they can't show him at all.
Moreover, Xu Shiyan has never been used to his youngest son, and the four children are treated equally, and sometimes he even goes out of his way to be strict with Xu Haiqing.
Xu Haiqing is at home, so he really doesn't have the capital to do whatever he wants with his youngest.
That is, the old couple Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan, sometimes they can be a little bit biased, but not many.
So, Xu Haiqing will not be able to become the overlord of the Xu family, but will be controlled by his older brothers and sisters instead.
Brother is not far behind. Although Xu Haiyuan is very proud of others, he is very tolerant of his younger brother.
Leading his younger brother to be mischievous, Xu Haiqing is a little stupid, but he doesn't dislike it.
But my sister doesn't, Xu Jinping is very strict with her younger brother, staring at Xu Haiqing all day long.
Recently, Xu Jinping began to teach Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing how to read characters, learn pinyin, and recite ancient poems.
Xu Jinhui is okay, learn slowly, she is serious, learn whatever you are asked to learn.
But if Xu Haiqing can't do it, he will be like Sun Monkey, who can't stay idle at all.
When he was asked to study, he scratched his head and scratched his head, and when he talked about playing, he ran faster than anyone else.
Xu Jinping was so angry with her younger brother all day long, she really wanted to slap him.
"Oh, I see, can't I eat my own pears?"
Xu Haiqing is not afraid of others, but his sister.
Xu Jinping stared, Xu Haiqing didn't dare to speak immediately, her small face wrinkled like a bitter melon.
It’s not for pears, but mainly because I have to recite ancient poems, which is worrying.
It was Xu Haiyuan who looked at it, sighed, and called his younger brother to go out and set off a small whip.
Xu Haiqing's eyes lit up when he heard it, and he followed his brother out in a dizzy manner.
Over there, Xu Haibo and his brothers were worried, so they also went out to watch.
The grown-ups in the room watched Xu Jinping scold his younger brother, but none of them spoke of love, all of them suppressed their laughter.
When these children ran out to play, there was a burst of laughter in the room.
"My God, third child, why did you raise such a powerful girl like Pingping?
Oh my god, this kid is so fun, and he will be a worry when he grows up.
With her here, you two don't need to take care of the younger ones. Guaranteed to treat them submissively. "
Xu Shi'an couldn't help but smile, this third niece is so funny, why is she so powerful?
There are two sons in Xu Shian's family, but he is very rare for his daughter, especially the smart and smart niece of the third family.
"This child will definitely not be wrong in the future."
"What's the matter? I'm a little person, maybe I'm worried, thinking about everything.
In autumn, I was busy at home. She came home from school to help me cook, pick vegetables, and do everything. "
Mentioning her granddaughter, Zhou Guilan looked proud.
Children are sensible and know that adults are working hard, so they don’t go out to play after school, and help with work first.
Such a child, who is not rare?
"The youngest couple are lucky, and these children are all good." Xu Shian said enviously.
"Third child, Haiqing, don't be too strict with the two of you.
With two older brothers and sisters above him, it is not easy for the child.
As long as he doesn't learn bad things, don't ask too much of him. Third child, you know this best. "
Xu Shian also noticed it, and he had to persuade his younger brother a few words. Back then, Xu Shiyan was the least conspicuous among the five brothers.
The elder brother at the top is excellent, and the younger brother at the back is excellent. Although no one can compare between brothers, there is pressure after all.
"We all look forward to the future of our children, but the five fingers are not even enough. You can't ask your children to be successful in college, right?
As long as the children grow up safely and healthily, they know how to be filial to their parents, and don’t go down the wrong path, and don’t eat, drink, **** or gamble.
Based on the conditions of your family, Haiqing will always have a way out in the future.
It’s more capable to keep people from being incomplete. What about being a boss? right? "
Xu Shian dared to say that when his son was not in front of him. In front of the child, he definitely said that he must study hard and go to college.
"Well, I know, second brother." Xu Shiyan nodded.
In the past, he was always worried that Xu Haiqing was still as useless as the younger son in his previous life, so he was even stricter on the younger son.
But thinking about it now, what the second brother said makes sense.
There are Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping in front, but Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing in the back are really under a lot of pressure.
After all, not all children can be like those two, most of the children are mediocre.
So the requirements should not be so high, otherwise it would be unfair to the latter two.
While talking, I heard the children shouting outside. Needless to say, it must be the other brothers who came back.
Sure enough, the three families of Xu Shixian, Xu Shide, and Xu Shixiang came back together.
The whole family gathered together, so it was naturally very lively. The children paid New Year's greetings first when they met their elders, and Xu Chenghou and others gave out red envelopes one by one.
It’s Chinese New Year, let’s celebrate it, don’t care whether the red envelope is one yuan or fifty cents, for children, this is the greatest joy.
Of course, how long this happiness can last is not certain.
Maybe it will be kept by mother when it turns around, and then it will never be seen again.
But at this moment, the children were all overjoyed, each holding a red envelope and jumping happily.
Xu Chenghou's gaze involuntarily glanced towards Xu Shide.
I heard from people in Daying that the fourth son, Zhang, stayed in the hospital for a while.
Later, he was discharged from the hospital. Half of his body was not working well, and he couldn't speak very clearly. At least his life was saved.
As for that boy Wu Jinsheng, he was beaten quite badly at the time. After all, he was young and recovered well, and he didn’t hear of any sequelae.
The Wu family could no longer live in Hebei Village after this hardship.
Thanks to the fact that his family has relatives in Pine Town, it is said that Qiu Hou sold the house and moved to Pine Town.
When he heard the news, Xu Chenghou was really relieved.
Whether Wu's family moved out or not, Xu Shide and his two children were affected by the province.
Actually, the Wu family hasn’t helped Xu Shide much these years. On the contrary, Wu Qiuyan always subsidizes her natal family.
Except for the chaos in the fourth family, the eldest and fifth families are fine.
The boss is just like that in the work unit, and there is no chance of advancement. Anyway, he just drinks tea and reads newspapers all day long, and writes documents for the leader.
As long as you don't make mistakes, you can get along safely until retirement, which is not bad.
The fifth child is not bad, after all, his degree is there. From civil affairs to finance, his work is very good.
I heard that the deputy director was promoted a while ago. If it continues like this, it may be a few years before it will become a full-time director.
In general, among the five sons, the third child is the best developed, but the others are not bad.
Anyway, Xu Chenghou is quite content, and he doesn't ask for more, and he doesn't dare to think about getting promoted and getting rich.
As long as these few are in good condition, don't cause any trouble.
Working steadily and steadily, receiving a monthly salary, and waiting to retire when old, in Xu Chenghou's eyes, this is a good life.
Anyway, the sons are better than his father, so I am content.

chapters.title: Chapter 473: regret but too late
chapters.content:
Chapter 473 Too late to regret
On the second day of the first lunar month, the brothers of the Xu family all came back. There are twenty-six or seven people in a big family, which is considered a lot in this day and age.
Before, because Xu Shiyan refused to bring his brothers to make money, everyone was actually not very happy.
Xue Xiulin and Zhao Chunling secretly encouraged their own men to earn some money from Clivia.
Fortunately, Xu Shixian was timid and Xu Shixiang was smart enough, so neither of them agreed.
Furthermore, the Zhao family and the Xue family did not have anyone like Wu Jinsheng who could make money, so they failed.
When the matter of the Wu family came out, Xue Xiulin and Zhao Chunling were also in a cold sweat.
Thanks to them not daring to make a fuss at the time, otherwise, they might be the ones who went bankrupt.
So when they came back this time, the two sisters-in-law treated Su Anying a little more attentively.
When a few people were cooking in the kitchen, Xue Xiulin and Zhao Chunling told Su Anying that if there is any business to make money in the future, don't forget to bring them and count them as a share.
"Sister-in-law, younger siblings, my family just grows some sticks now.
Shi Yan goes to work, and I don't know anything else. Anyway, I hired a few blind people to work. "
What can Su Anying say? It is said that the business that his family is doing now has a lot of capital, and it is not enough to invest in it if there is less money?
Isn't that obviously looking down on sister-in-law? Even if it is true, it cannot be said that way.
Xue Xiulin lived in the big house for several years. Zhao Chunling also worked in the agricultural team for a while. Of course, she knows how to grow sticks to make money, but she also knows the hard work.
Both sister-in-law and sister-in-law are a little bit scared, this thing is not easy to play with.
Besides, they don't live in Donggang, they are so far away, and they don't care about serving the land at all.
The two sisters-in-law and sisters-in-law lost their charter, so naturally it is not easy to rely on Su Anying anymore, and they have to be brought to earn money.
Su Anying happened to be happy at leisure, and the sisters-in-law didn't mention the money, and cheerfully cooked the meals, and quickly packed them up and brought them to the house.
"Shiyan, you see that the food is ready, hurry back and invite your master over."
Xu Chenghou saw that the food was ready, so he urged Xu Shiyan to go home and invite Mr. Chu.
When Xu Shiyan went out in the morning, Chu Xuanhuai said that today is the day of the Xu family reunion, and he would not come to have fun.
That’s what I said, but I’ve cooked dinner here, so I’m sure I’ll go over to invite you.
Whether to come or not depends on Chu Xuanhuai, please or not depends on Xu Shiyan's wishes.
"Okay, I'll go right away."
Xu Shiyan got up and put on his overcoat, went out and yelled at Xu Haiyuan, and the two went home to invite Chu Xuanhuai.
"Father, who is the master of the third child? Why is it at the third child's house?"
Xu Shixian felt strange, so he asked casually.
"Who else could it be? It was that Mr. Chu who was in Daying and the third child studied medicine with him.
Later, the sixth son went to the provincial capital to have an operation, and it was all with the help of others.
Years ago, the third child took Mr. Chu over and celebrated the New Year with us. What's wrong? Can not be done? "
Xu Chenghou drooped his eyelids, and without looking at Xu Shixian, he asked in a moderate voice.
"No, that's not what I meant, Dad, I just asked."
How dare Xu Shixian provoke his father? He quickly waved his hand to express that he had no opinion.
"Oh, I thought you guys had an opinion.
Mr. Chu has agreed to stay and take Xu Haiyuan to study medicine. From now on, Mr. Chu will be a member of the family.
You guys should be more polite to me when you see him. "Xu Chenghou raised his eyelids and glanced at his sons.
Xu Shixian was quite surprised when he heard this.
They all knew who Mr. Chu was.
He is the principal of the University of Medical Sciences, a top medical expert in the country, and he wants to stay and guide Xu Haiyuan?
Then Xu Haiyuan is already good enough. If he learns medical skills from Mr. Chu again, and Mr. Chu paves the way and escorts him, will he be able to pay off in the future?
The brothers felt that there was too much difference between their family and the third family.
Now it seems that not only are they much worse, but even their children are inferior to others.
Xu Shide's bowels are remorseful now.
When I came back in the summer, my mother once mentioned that the two children in the family should come and live.
Said that the school here is good and the teachers are good, much better than Daying.
At that time, Xu Shide thought that a wife could not do without the child. If he sent the child here, his wife would cry eight times a day, so he didn't agree.
In autumn, Xu Haiyang started the first grade in Daying Primary School.
Who would have imagined, the third brother actually brought Mr. Chu home, and Mr. Chu also fell in love with Xu Haiyuan and wanted to teach him medicine.
It's over, it's a pity to miss this good opportunity.
"The third brother is getting more and more capable. Not only is he getting promoted step by step, but he also started paving the way for the children so early. It's really good."
Xu Shide couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"How can your third brother have such a heart?
He just saw that Mr. Chu was alone in the provincial capital, and it was too deserted to celebrate the New Year with no one to accompany him, so he brought him here.
Do you think he is like you, with eight hundred minds, but he can't use the right place? "
Xu Chenghou scoffed at the words of the fourth son.
Man, that’s it. The more you do things with a purpose, the harder it is to achieve.
Xu Shiyan didn't think about that at all, and it actually worked out.
This is the gap, the level of human beings.
Xu Chenghou's words made the sons very ashamed. They looked at each other and sighed.
How about saying that stupid people have stupid blessings?
The youngest of the family didn't think about anything, but in the end, they accidentally inserted willows and willows into shades. They have been calculating all day long, but nothing can be achieved after calculation.
Well, it seems that in the future, you have to learn from the third child.
Just as he was thinking about it, he saw Xu Shiyan and his son, helping Mr. Chu to come in from the outside.
"Mr. Chu, Happy Chinese New Year."
Xu Shixian stood up hurriedly and said hello to Elder Chu. This person's status is too high, they dare not be disrespectful.
"Good, good, all good.
Oh, don't call him old man, just call him Uncle Chu.
Shiyan is my apprentice. Your father calls me elder brother, but you can call me uncle. "
Chu Xuanhuai didn't want to come here at first, the Xu family is reunited, why is he here?
But when Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan went back, they insisted on letting him come. Chu Xuanhuai really couldn't persuade Xu Haiyuan, so he came here.
These are Xu Shiyan's brothers. From Xu Shiyan's point of view, it is not a loss to them to let them call the uncle, so Chu Xuanhuai said so.
"Master, Happy Chinese New Year." The brothers said in unison.
Then turned around and quickly found all the children from each family, asking them to say hello to Elder Chu.
"Hurry up, give Grandpa Chu a New Year greeting."
Brothers all look forward to it, if any of their children is caught by Mr. Chu, they have to keep the child no matter what.
As long as you follow Mr. Chu and study hard, you will definitely not make mistakes in the future.
Xu Haibo, Xu Jinfeng and the others are sensible, so they came over in a proper manner, and wished Elder Chu a new year.
Those young ones don’t know much about it yet, anyway, they just follow behind the older brothers and sisters, doing what others do.
Old Chu was also very happy when he saw the room full of children, "Okay, okay, everything is fine.
Oops, they are all good boys, look at how energetic they are.
Brother Xu, you are so lucky. Look, you are the most blessed here. "

chapters.title: Chapter 474: One shop raises three generations
chapters.content:
Chapter 474 Raising three generations in one shop
The atmosphere of the Xu family reunion was not affected by the arrival of Mr. Chu, on the contrary, it became more eager.
Xu Shixian and the others all knew about Elder Chu's ability, so they naturally respected Elder Chu very much, and they were very enthusiastic about chatting with Elder Chu.
It’s rare to have a complete family, so Xu Chenghou said, why not take a family portrait.
Naturally, everyone did not object, and it happened that there was a camera at home, so they placed a row of chairs in front of the Kang in the east room.
Xu Chenghou and his wife led Han Liwei and his wife and a few younger ones to sit on the chairs, and Xu Shixian and his wife led their daughter-in-law to sit on the edge of the kang.
Xu Haibo, Xu Haitao, Xu Haibin, and Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu sat on a few stools on the kang.
Old Chu held the camera and asked everyone to look at the camera, "Yes, all look at me, one, two, three, that's it."
Old Chu pressed the shutter, leaving the most precious image.
Old Chu was still worried that one photo would not work, so he took two more photos.
Then Xu Chenghou and his wife took a group photo with their grandchildren, and then with their son, daughter-in-law, daughter-in-law and uncle.
Back then, the five Xu Shiyan brothers took a photo alone, and Su Anying's sister-in-law also took a photo together, and the children also asked for a photo and took a group photo.
After taking pictures, eat quickly.
During the Chinese New Year reunion, the brothers of the Xu family want to drink something.
Xu Chenghou is getting older now, and he doesn't drink too much, besides, Elder Chu doesn't drink, so Xu Chenghou and Elder Chu drink hawthorn beer together.
Not to mention the children, they are all eagerly waiting for the hawthorn beer.
Good food and good food, family reunion on Chinese New Year, so what's the point? Eat and drink.
Xu Shixian and the brothers also understood that the third child is no longer comparable to them.
So each of them calmed down, let go of their competitive thoughts, and focused on getting along well with Xu Shiyan.
Furthermore, Han Liwei and Mr. Chu were there, and Xu Shixian and the others were not stupid, so they wouldn't say anything to spoil the atmosphere at this time.
Everyone talked and laughed, and had a lively reunion dinner.
Everyone was not in a hurry to leave this afternoon, and they all shouted to stay with their parents for a while.
For Xu Chenghou and his wife, having children and grandchildren around their knees and family happiness is what they look forward to most.
The kids are happy to stay, isn't that good?
"Our family has plenty of space, so we can live wherever we want, for a few days if we like." Xu Chenghou nodded with a smile.
When Han Liwei saw this, he told Xu Shiqin that they would not go back tonight.
Xu Shiqin couldn't be happier, since she hasn't lived in her mother's house since she got married.
It's rare that the family is so complete, and she also wants to chat with her brothers and sisters-in-law for a while.
As for taking medicine and so on, even the pharmacy will not be open in the second grade of junior high school, so let’s go tomorrow.
Xu Shian's house is close, and the two of them want to go back, but Xu Haibo and his brothers are in love with playing with their sisters and younger brothers, and they refuse to leave.
In the end, there was nothing to do, so I simply stayed. The house caught fire when I left in the morning, so let’s talk about it when I go back tomorrow morning.
Brothers seldom have free time to get together, Xu Shixiang said that it is better to play poker, anyway, just play for a while, and lose the sticky note.
So Xu Shixiang, Xu Shide, and Xu Shian dragged Han Liwei to play three-on-one together.
Xu Shixian didn't play, just sat and watched the excitement, while Xu Shiyan chatted with his sister.
"I heard from Liwei that you are going to buy a shop in the capital, are you optimistic about it?" Xu Shiyan thought of this and hurriedly asked.
"Well, I have this idea.
I have taken a good look at a few places, all of which are shops facing the street with a yard behind them.
Some asking prices are high and some are low. Anyway, they range from 30,000 to 40,000 to 60,000 to 70,000.
I want to get something to do, it’s not that the night school is over, you say I can’t be idle all day long.
I thought about it, set up a shop, sell some fabrics and so on, and I can also make clothes for others.
Not only make clothes, but also sell ready-made clothes. If I have time, I will go to Yangcheng to have a look.
They all said that the clothes there are pretty good and not expensive, so I thought about the whole clothing store and hired two shop assistants to sell the goods.
I don’t ask how much money I earn, I have a daily income, otherwise it’s not good to just sit and eat. "
Actually, with the money in Xu Shiqin's hands, she would spend it without doing anything.
But she is a successful person, and she doesn't want to mess around all day. For this person, she still needs to do something to make sense.
"Okay, I think your idea is very good.
The shop in the capital is not expensive, buy it, people say, one shop can support three generations?
What's more, it's a shop in the capital, you can buy it, buy two more.
Well, there are no restrictions on buying a house in the capital now, right?
If there are no restrictions on foreign hukou and the like, after a while, I will find an opportunity to let your third wife go to the capital with you.
You two are thinking about buying more sets of shops. "
Xu Shiyan is very supportive of his sister's idea. Who wouldn't want to buy a house in the capital if they have the opportunity?
After that, it’s all money, it’s always worth money, just kidding.
Catch up with such a good opportunity and have money in hand, why not invest in a few houses quickly, why keep the money? Will putting it in the bank survive inflation in the future?
Hoarding houses in other places may not make you a profit. If you invest in houses in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen, you will definitely not suffer a loss.
In this family, Xu Shiqin listens to the third brother the most, and when the third brother says yes, she has a bottom line in her heart.
"Okay, then let the third sister-in-law go to the capital with us and stay for a few more days.
It's a pity that you have to go back to study, third brother, otherwise, I can rest assured that you will be with us and have your help. "
"Cut, what kind of eye can I help with? I don't understand either.
I knew that it was the capital. Before that, it was called the feet of the emperor, and every inch of land was precious.
If you don’t take advantage of the opportunity to buy it now, you may not be able to buy it if you want to. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head when he heard the words, his eyes were darkened even when he went to the capital, and he didn't understand anything.
I can't keep up with my little sister, but I've lived in the capital for a year.
"In two days, I will go to the county to withdraw some money, and let your third sister-in-law take it.
Don't care about the high or low, you have to buy two shops anyway, it's better to buy another house or something.
In the future, if your little nephews and nieces are admitted to universities in the capital, or go to work, and we have our own house, how nice? "
Xu Shiyan decided to ask his wife to inquire first. If the price of the shop is not bad, at least buy two.
It is best to buy four, which happens to be a shop where each child has a capital.
Even if they don’t go to the capital to live in the future, the shop will be rented or sold, it will be money, and it will be considered as the family property that the couple saved for their children.
Xu Shiyan doesn't have much ability, he can't leave any gold and silver mountains, and he can save a house in the capital for his children, which is considered as a little bit of love from parents.
The brothers and sisters were chatting here, and Xu Shixian and the others next to them didn't miss it, but they couldn't get in their mouths at all.
The third child of the family now has nearly 20 houses in the two houses, and there is a quite big ginseng market invested there, which is enough for many industries.
Now people still want to buy a house or shop in the capital, how much will it cost?
My little sister said just now that it costs tens of thousands. Who of them owns it?
Nothing, how to participate in this topic?
Well, it’s still a quiet bird, so just pretend you didn’t hear anything.
Start talking indiscriminately, and it will be even more embarrassing if you can't speak well.

chapters.title: Chapter 475: Nice to meet you
chapters.content:
Chapter 475 Fortunate to meet
Xu Shixian and others stayed at home for one night. After breakfast the next day, they each had their own places to go.
Xue Xiulin's father passed away the year before last, and her stepmother was gone. There were only four sisters left, and it was difficult to get together because they were scattered around.
So the couple are not in a hurry, and they will take a bus back to the county in the afternoon to catch up.
Zhao Chunling's natal mother is gone, and her father now lives with her elder brother, right above the team headquarters of the Donggang Third Brigade.
So Xu Shixiang and his wife took their daughter to Zhao's house.
Xu Shide will definitely accompany his wife back to Wu's house. Songshu Town is on the side of Xianren Bridge, so he has to take the train.
It happened that Xu Shian and Wei Mingrong had to go back to Wei's house in the north of the railway station, so they went together.
Of course Han Liwei and his wife had to go to Songjianghe to find a pharmacy to get medicine, and Xu Shiyan accompanied his wife back to her natal home.
Fortunately, Su's house is close. From Xu Shiyan's house to Su's house, it's only three or four hundred meters away. It doesn't take ten minutes to walk, which is very convenient.
The Su family also had a big reunion today. Qin Meiling, Su Anzhen and others all brought their husbands and children back.
Su Weizhong specially transferred the class with others, and made the third day of junior high school free, and the family was reunited, and naturally it was very lively and joyful.
On the third day of junior high school, I played at Su's house for a day. On the fourth day of junior high school, Xu Shiyan was invited by Yang Junxian and his wife again, and spent most of the day at Yang's house.
In the blink of an eye, it was the fifth day of the first lunar month, which was the day that Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye had agreed upon.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan drove to Guo Shouye's house, and then he and Guo Shouye went to pick up Secretary Zhao and Deputy Bureau Chen back to Donggang for a field trip.
When I arrived at Lin Qiyue's house, I saw that Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong were there.
"Secretary Lin, this is Secretary Zhao, and this is Bureau Chen. You have met Director Guo before."
"Secretary Zhao, Bureau Chen, this is our participating secretary Lin, director Li, and director Dai."
Xu Shiyan had to introduce to both parties.
"I've always wanted to meet Secretary Zhao and Bureau Chen, but it was a pity that I was always on the same side. Today I finally met. It's a pleasure to meet you."
Lin Qiyue came forward with a smile on his face and shook hands with Secretary Zhao and Bureau Chen.
Regardless of whether one is in Songjianghe and the other is in Donggang, they are both state-owned units.
Ke Yishenchang is an enterprise under the county, with a total of only a thousand employees.
The Forestry Bureau is a provincial enterprise. The Songjianghe Forestry Bureau and its subordinate forest farms have more than 20,000 employees.
That is not a level at all.
Yi Shenchang and the Forestry Bureau only have occasional intersections, and they don’t have much contact.
Lin Qiyue, Zhao Xiwen, and Chen Chengbin are busy people, and they don't run into each other on weekdays.
If Guo Shouye and Xu Shiyan hadn't been able to connect with each other, it would have been very difficult to meet each other.
"Secretary Lin, you're being polite, it's quite a reputation to participate now.
We all know that Yichangchang earns more than 10 million US dollars in foreign exchange every year. It is a key export enterprise in our province. We have always wanted to meet Secretary Lin, but we always have no chance.
Nice to meet you. "
Zhao Xiwen and Chen Chengbin also shook hands with Lin Qiyue, Li Bingzhuo, and Dai Chunrong with smiles on their faces.
Everyone meets, shakes hands and greets each other, and then sits down.
Because it was at Lin Qiyue's house, and it was Chinese New Year, they were all casual, and no one carried them.
Lin Qiyue's daughter-in-law at the other end made tea, served fruits and melon seeds, etc., and then went to work in the kitchen.
The two children in the family are both in high school, and today they specially sent them out to play, but they were not at home.
In order to leave Lin Qiyue and the others a quieter environment.
Zhao Xiwen took a sip of tea before speaking.
"Well, Xiao Guo mentioned to me a few days ago about the sustainable use of forest resources, saying that you are currently studying this.
To be honest, in fact, our bureau is also considering this aspect. Didn’t we take this opportunity to go to Secretary Lin to learn from it? "
In recent years, many state-owned enterprises are engaged in tertiary industries in addition to their main business.
The Forestry Bureau actually has some related industries, which can generate income, and can also accommodate some unemployed youth.
For example, every forest farm has its subordinate service stations.
In the past two years, the forest farm service station has also considered planting ginseng to generate more income for the forest farm and the forestry bureau.
But the forestry bureau employees are not good at planting ginseng, so they have to find someone to give technical guidance.
When it comes to the technology of planting ginseng, who can be better than a group of technicians participating in the field?
There are also many forest farms under the Forestry Bureau. These forest farm service stations plant a lot of ginseng every year, plus the abandoned ginseng land left by the village and town ginseng farms and individual ginseng farms, the combined area is not small.
Zhao Xiwen also listened to Guo Shouye's words, and put his mind on these ginseng.
If these abandoned ginseng land can be utilized, it is indeed a good way to increase production and generate income while ensuring afforestation.
What's more, each service station will begin to produce ginseng one after another next year or the year after.
If each forest farm processes it by itself, without the guidance of technical personnel, it may be difficult to guarantee the quality.
If the Forestry Bureau buys the entire processing plant, it will have to invest another sum, which is not worth it.
So when Guo Shouye mentioned a participation, Zhao Xiwen immediately thought that he could cooperate with a participation.
It doesn’t matter whether you entrust the processing, or you sell fresh ginseng directly to a ginseng factory, it’s always a way out.
This is the reason why Zhao Xiwen and Chen Chengbin came to Donggang to meet Lin Qiyue on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year.
"Secretary Zhao, you are being polite. As for the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land, our deputy director Xu is in charge.
He was originally the chief of the technical department at our site. He is proficient in all processes from ginseng cultivation to processing, and has unique insights into comprehensive utilization of forest land, planting of medicinal materials and other related aspects.
Secretary Zhao can ask Director Xu to tell you something. "
Lin Qiyue has a lot of brains, and he is even more tactful and thoughtful in handling things.
He understood that Xu Shiyan was responsible for this incident, so he must give Xu Shiyan a chance to show his face.
Xu Shiyan was called out, but he didn't hesitate, so he began to explain his own theory in an orderly manner.
Of course, these are currently being explored bit by bit in practice, some have already achieved initial results, and some still need some time.
Xu Shiyan spoke very honestly, without those gaudy bragging.
It is to talk about his ideas realistically, and the current research progress on these.
Zhao Xiwen and the others became fascinated after listening to it. As forestry-related professionals, they certainly know how much maneuverability and benefits it has for forestry development.
"Okay, that's great. Deputy Director Xu is indeed a person whom even Secretary Guan respects very much. He is indeed capable."
After Xu Shiyan finished speaking, Zhao Xiwen nodded in praise.
"Secretary Zhao has won the award. It's just some immature suggestions. At present, there are still some waiting to be practiced." Xu Shiyan replied very modestly.
"Secretary Lin, Director Xu, we came here today mainly to discuss cooperation with the participants.
We have woodland and manpower, and you produce technology.
Let's take a look at how to join forces to build ginseng and related industries to increase production and generate income. "
Zhao Xiwen's attitude is very sincere, today is for cooperation, there is no need to hide it, just let it go.

chapters.title: Chapter 476: Go to Beijing to buy a house
chapters.content:
Chapter 476 Entering Beijing to buy a house
The three of Zhao Xiwen and Lin Qiyue discussed together for a long time, and reached a preliminary intention to participate in the cooperation with the Forestry Bureau.
The Forestry Bureau produces forest land and manpower, and a ginseng field produces ginseng seeds, ginseng seeds, and technology. The first phase of cooperation between the two parties is to jointly plant ginseng.
To solve the problem that the planned planting area of ​​a participating farm is insufficient to expand production, and the Forestry Bureau has idle forest land and manpower cannot be arranged.
The ginseng planted by the two parties will be priced according to the market price when harvested three years later, and will be purchased by a ginseng farm.
The second phase of cooperation is to jointly complete the comprehensive utilization of old ginseng land.
At this stage, don’t worry, you can take your time.
Anyway, the cultivation technology of Gastrodia elata in the old ginseng field in Yishenchang has matured, and other cultivation medicinal materials, edible fungi and medicinal fungi are also gradually improving.
Waiting for three years to start participating in the production of goods, these technologies will definitely be no problem, and then we can further discuss the details of the next cooperation.
Today is just to reach a cooperation intention and set the general direction.
The specific details need to be discussed in detail by professionals from both parties, and then the contract is signed.
After all, this is not as simple as two people helping each other. These are two units, and all the details must be implemented.
After a rough discussion, both parties were very satisfied with the results. Just at this time, Lin Qiyue's wife also prepared all the meals.
It's rare to come to the house on the fifth day of the first lunar month, so why not keep guests for dinner?
So the wine and dishes were served, and several people chatted while eating and drinking.
Northeast people, friendship starts with wine, and you get to know each other while drinking, and things will be easier after you get to know each other.
The wine was drunk from one o'clock in the afternoon until after three o'clock, and several people drank a little wobbly.
Finally, Han Lixin and Li Zongliang rushed over to help drive and send Zhao Xiwen and the others back.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to drive himself, so he threw the car to Han Lixin, and walked home by himself.
On the sixth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan called Han Limin, Zhou Qingguo, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Junxian, and a group of people together.
Roasted a lamb at Xu Shiyan's house, and made other food, and it was another lively day.
By the way, discuss the development plan for this year.
Ginseng seeds only grow once, just make a fortune. You can't be greedy.
It happened that the ginseng land of the machine repair factory was taken directly, and each family kept a hundred feet of ginseng land for their own development, and the rest was still sold.
Tossing this crop of ginseng soil can earn a lot of money in addition to the ones left by the family.
That’s enough, you have to be content, too much development may not be a good thing.
In addition, in terms of participating in the market, after the beginning of spring, the construction speed must be accelerated, and the market can be opened for business in autumn.
"It's okay, anyway, I will graduate in July and August, what to do next, we buddies will discuss together at that time.
My consistent view is not to be impatient, but to be safe. "
If you take too many steps, you will easily fall into trouble. It is better to walk steadily step by step.
Regardless of the fact that everyone has some money in their hands, they can’t fool around, what if they can’t get it folded in?
"Third brother, don't worry, we know this matter well.
We all remember what the third brother said. "Zhao Jianshe and others assured.
On the seventh day of the first lunar month, the Han family treated guests.
Invited Xu Chenghou, his wife, Xu Shiyan's family, and Elder Chu, and they played at Han's house for another day.
On the eighth day of the first lunar month, the Forestry Bureau went to work.
Xu Shiyan, together with Su Anying, Zhao Jianshe, and Huang Shengli, went to the Resource Department of the Forestry Bureau, found Guo Shouye, and settled for the machine repair factory.
There are 25 fields in total, 100,000 yuan. Su Anying paid 50,000 yuan as a deposit first, and the rest will be paid after the weather is warmer and measured again.
On the ninth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying went to the county seat and took out more than 100,000 yuan.
This is intended to be taken by Su Anying to buy a house in the capital.
Bring these first, too much is not acceptable, it is too dangerous.
The point is that the wire transfer is quite troublesome now, and it is impossible to make domestic deposits and withdrawals, and this is a personal transaction, and it cannot be used in a company account.
So I can only bring these. Go over and have a look. If you can buy a shop or a shop, you can buy two yards if you can’t.
Xu Shiyan participated in the research of microbial compound fertilizer technology, so he couldn't go back to school until the end of February like last year.
So on the tenth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan packed his bags and embarked on a journey to the provincial capital to study.
On the thirteenth day of the first lunar month, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin were about to leave for the capital.
The two of them took three sets of medicine each on the third day of junior high school, and then went to see Mr. Chu twice, and took another six sets of medicine.
Before leaving, I went to Mr. Chu for a consultation, and Mr. Chu gave them another prescription, telling them to take the medicine and take another six doses after arriving in the capital, so that they don’t need to take it.
But you cannot have **** within two months after stopping the drug.
Both of them remembered clearly, so they left with the prescription.
Su Anying also took a bag of cash, and left with Xu Shiqin and his wife.
After returning to the capital, Han Liwei asked for leave from the school. He stayed at school during the day and went home to take medicine at night.
After the six doses of medicine were finished, there happened to be a mission at the school, so Han Liwei took a team of people and went directly to carry out the mission.
Han Liwei was not at home, Xu Shiqin and Su Anying, the sisters-in-law, were fine and wandered around the capital every day.
After all, Xu Shiqin has lived here for a year and knows some people.
So I found a middleman to help me set the line, and went to see a few houses and shops.
Actually, the houses in the capital are not as tall as imagined.
Nowadays, most people are rushing to the buildings, and no one takes bungalows seriously.
Of course, the shop is also more expensive than the courtyard.
Su Anying is optimistic about two places, and finally grinds them down, one is 40,000, and the other is 45,000.
They are all two-story shops facing the street, with a yard at the back. They are very well-organized and located in a good location.
Xu Shiqin led Su Anying to the housing management office to check the relevant procedures, and made sure that the other party did not fool them, and that the shop was indeed all right, so he was relieved.
Su Anying was rich and powerful, so she simply bought both shops, and bought another small courtyard with the remaining money.
The hundreds of thousands brought to the capital cost about the same, but there were three more properties.
Su Anying didn't care, anyway, it was Xu Shiyan who asked her to buy it. She believed in her man, and would never do business at a loss.
Compared to Su Anying's big money, Xu Shiqin is not bold, so she just bought a shop.
It is also a shop front facing the street, with a small courtyard at the back, which can be used as a residence or as a warehouse, which is very good.
I bought a house, but it took a lot of time to go through the procedures.
At this time, the weather is getting warmer, Su Anying is thinking about the ginseng land at home, and grass begins to grow in her heart.
Seeing this, Xu Shiqin simply said, let the sister-in-law go back first, and she will go through the formalities.
Waiting for the housing permit to be completed, when Su Anying is free, she can come to the capital again.
Su Anying thinks about it too, it's useless for her to stay here, it's a waste of time, it's better to go home.
My sister-in-law is not an outsider, so she is very relieved to leave it to her, so Su Anying went to buy some things, and hurriedly set foot on the return journey.
There is still one chapter left, and I will upload it later.
Yesterday morning, my son had a stomachache at school. The teacher asked him to pick him up. When he came back, he went to the hospital for an examination. He said it was early appendicitis and needed an injection.
Accompanying the child for inspection and injection all morning, I really didn’t have time to code words, so I didn’t write the last chapter, I tried to finish writing and uploading as soon as possible.
The child has to get injections for a few days, maybe the update will not be too stable in these few days, I will try my best to write.

chapters.title: Chapter 477: late spring cold
chapters.content:
Chapter 477 Falling Cold
At the beginning of April 1986, the Changbai Mountain Ginseng Compound Fertilizer Research Base of the Provincial Agricultural University was completed in Donggang Town Ginseng Field.
This project was promoted by Xu Shiyan, and it didn't go through the county at all, so when the news reached the county, all the things that should be done had already been done.
A group of jealous people in the county stared blankly but there was nothing they could do.
"This Xu Shiyan is unorganized and disciplined. He didn't discuss with the county in advance about such a big matter, so he just decided it?
Donggang town participation? How could it be chosen in such a small place?
There are four state-owned companies in our county participating, so where can’t the research base be selected? Why do we have to participate in Donggang Town? That's true. "
There have always been people who looked at Xu Shiyan disliked in the county, and this time they seized the opportunity, so they must find something to do.
"Aren't you talking nonsense? He Xu Shiyan came from the Second Brigade of Donggang. If he doesn't go to his own town, can he go to outsiders?
If it were you, can you push the benefits out? "Guan Enxue was still very close to Xu Shiyan, so he had to say a few words for him.
"Whether it's Donggang Town or Xigang Township, they haven't left our county. Isn't that pretty good? Why think so much?"
"No, Secretary Guan, the Fulin Shenchang jointly organized by our county and the Linjiang Forestry Bureau is in Liangshan, Xigang.
If we knew about this, we would definitely put the research base in Fulin as well. "
The other party seemed to be still reconciled and made an excuse.
The Fulin Shenchang jointly organized by the county and the Linjiang Forestry Bureau was officially established. It is located near Liangshan Village and has a scale of more than 70,000 feet.
The person who spoke was the person in charge of Fulin Forest Farm, so of course he had selfish intentions.
Everyone knows the benefits of using fertilizers for ginseng. Although I don’t know the status of this agricultural university project, the fertilizers that Xu Shiyan studied before are quite good.
This time it is cooperating with Agricultural University again, so it must be better.
Such a good opportunity did not come to Fulin, but fell to Donggang Town. Someone must be unhappy.
"The Fulin venue has only just been completed, and there is nothing there. Why do you ask others to study it?"
Guan Enxue took a look at that person, this guy is just too selfish.
With Guan Enxue's protection, no one can trouble Xu Shiyan, and no one will mention the matter of the research base.
In the blink of an eye, the beginning of May came, and the ginseng in the field began to germinate and was about to break out of the ground, and the ginseng sheds began to grow in various ginseng fields.
On the morning of May 8th, Su Anying got up to pack and cook, and was about to go up the mountain to work, but when she opened the door, she found that it was raining outside.
It's not only raining outside, but also quite cold.
At any rate, she has been married to Xu Shiyan for these years. The family grows ginseng, and Su Anying has also learned to understand the weather.
It may be that women are naturally sensitive, and Su Anying felt that something was wrong.
Simply ignore those and call Xu Shiyan directly to the province.
Xu Shiyan just woke up and finished washing, and was planning to go downstairs to have breakfast.
Suddenly heard the uncle in charge of the dormitory downstairs calling him, Xu Shiyan hurried downstairs to answer the phone.
"Daughter-in-law, what's the rush, call me so early?"
Early in the morning, the daughter-in-law called, and Xu Shiyan immediately felt that there was a problem.
"Shiyan, it's raining this morning, I don't think something's right, the temperature is quite low.
You said that at this time, will there still be a cold spring? " Su Anying asked very worriedly on the phone.
Xu Shiyan was shocked when he heard this, "Oh, what date is it today?"
At the beginning of May 1986, it snowed heavily in Fusong area, crushing many ginseng sheds.
What was even more terrible was that the temperature dropped sharply the next day, and the mallet had just sprouted from the soil. This big drop in temperature directly froze nearly 40,000 feet of the garden ginseng.
Xu Shiyan had a bit of an impression of this, but he didn't know how he remembered it before.
Xu Shiyan kept reminding himself to be careful.
But he is not in his hometown, the temperature here in the provincial capital is much higher than at home, and the weather here is warm, so he didn't react.
If Su Anying didn't realize something was wrong and called, maybe he really forgot.
"Today? Today is the eighth.
You said it was already May 8th, and the celery on the mountain had to be half-pressed. Why is the temperature so low? It froze to death. "Su Anying complained on the phone.
"Daughter-in-law, it's useless to say these things now, hurry up and take people up the mountain, and go to the scene of hanging the land and opening the peak fork.
Didn’t I tell you last year to prepare more straw curtains? Go quickly and cover the ginseng ground with straw curtains.
Don’t worry about the newly planted ones, they are mainly for making goods and freezing. "Xu Shiyan said eagerly on the phone.
The ones that will be shipped this year will be plotted at Nantianmen, and the ones that will be shipped next year will be at Kaifeng Fork Road. These two places are the most dangerous.
The mallet seeds are usually planted in the ground in late autumn, and germinate only after the spring of the second year.
Because the new planting needs to slow down the seedlings, the seedlings emerge late and have not yet emerged at this time.
But it’s not the ones who freeze and make goods. The seedlings have been slowed down, and they will be unearthed earlier. At this time, they should have just emerged and have not yet stretched their hands.
If this is a drop in temperature, it can directly freeze the mallet seedlings to death, then it will be all in vain.
As soon as Xu Shiyan remembered what happened this year, he told Su Anying to prepare some straw curtains.
Su Anying is really obedient, and has prepared a lot in advance, all of which are stored at the farm.
"You mean, the temperature is probably wrong? Can it cool down tonight?"
Su Anying immediately understood what it meant, and she was in a hurry.
"Then what should we do? Just cover the grass curtain?"
"Has the freezer and product maker already put on the shed?
Hurry up and find someone to cover the surface of the pool with the grass curtain, and then remove the plastic sheet from the shed, and find a way to cover the surface of the pool. "
This time, it was different from the anti-frost time a few years ago.
At that time, it was the end of May and almost June, the temperature was higher than now, and it was frost, so you can use smoke to get rid of the frost head.
It is raining this time, and it may snow later, the temperature has dropped too much, and the smokiness is useless.
The only thing that can be done is to cover the surface of the pool with a layer of cold-proof grass curtain, and then cover it with plastic sheeting.
In this way, the ginseng shed can be prevented from being crushed by the heavy snow, and secondly, when the snow falls on the surface of the pool, it can also play a role in insulating the temperature a little bit, and it may be able to keep the ginseng seedlings.
"Understood, I will find Shengli and them right away, we will work in two groups."
Guanghuadi and Kaifeng Fork Road are far away from each other. We can’t run there after finishing work here, we can only act separately.
Especially on the side of Kaifeng Road, there are many sticks planted by each family, and it is also close to Changbai Mountain, so the temperature will be lower, so we have to act quickly.
Just like that, Su Anying hung up the phone in a hurry, and hurried to find someone to discuss.
Huang Shengli and others are most convinced by Xu Shiyan. Since Xu Shiyan said that things are not good, why don't they act quickly?
The matter is urgent, regardless of men, women and children, as long as anyone who can go up the mountain to work, all wear raincoats and rain boots, and go up the mountain quickly.
Su Anying urgently called the farm and asked Xu Shian to make arrangements.
Leave one person at the farm to look after them, and the other blind wanderers also went up to the mountains to work.
Now is the time, the more people the better.
Fortunately, the family had a car, so they were divided into two groups. Huang Shengli and Sun Xiaofeng drove a car, and took their father, daughter-in-law and others to hang out the land, and there were few ginseng lands there.
At this end, Su Anying, Xu Chenghou, Zhao Jianshe, and Feng Chao drove two cars and went straight to the Kaifeng fork.

chapters.title: Chapter 478: Effective early warning
chapters.content:
Chapter 478 Effective Early Warning
Before departure, Su Anying notified Zhou Qingguo, and asked Zhou Qingguo to quickly notify Yu Shouguang and Chen Jianzhang.
Su Anying told Zhou Qingguo the method taught by Xu Shiyan. Anyway, if others want to believe it, they will believe it. If they don't believe it, it's okay.
After all, the fields are divided into households now, unlike the production team in the past, when the brigade secretary gave an order, everyone went to work.
On the other end, Xu Shiyan was in a hurry even after hanging up the phone.
Hurry up to find a place, and call the venue and the county. Tell them about the damage caused by this abnormal weather.
Especially in the first ginseng field, most of the ginseng land is in the Caozi River, which is closer to Changbai Mountain and the temperature is lower.
Once the temperature cools down, the one who suffers the most losses is Yishen.
Lin Qiyue went to the Spring Fair but didn't come back, and Li Bingzhuo worked temporarily.
