Li Bingzhuo naturally had complete trust in Xu Shiyan, so after hanging up the phone, he immediately ordered all the employees and family members to go up the mountain to work.
Even the beverage factory and the mineral water factory were all shut down, and all the cars in the factory were mobilized to transport the workers up the mountain.
Even so, the car is not enough.
Li Bingzhuo had an idea, and immediately called the Forestry Bureau and borrowed more than ten large trucks from his brother unit to help.
The Forestry Bureau didn’t hesitate to listen, and sent the car over in a short while.
So all participants were dispatched, no matter men, women, old or young, went up the mountain together.
There are not so many grass curtains to protect against the cold in the first ginseng field. If there is no other way, we can only withdraw the ginseng shed and cover the pool surface with plastic sheeting, which can always play a role.
The workers here are working in the rain, but they feel that the temperature is getting lower and lower, and gradually it stops raining and starts snowing.
This snow is different from the goose feather snow in winter, this is the kind of snow with small grains.
Everyone in the Northeast knows that the heavy snow is easy to say, and it will stop in a while.
The smaller the snow, the longer it will be, the next day is possible.
Everyone was in a hurry, and they didn't care about the cold at this time, so they quickly pulled out the shed and covered it with plastic sheeting.
Following the cover, I saw the snow falling on the plastic sheet.
The falling ones melted a little at first, but gradually stopped melting. The light blue plastic sheet was soon covered with a layer of snow.
"Hurry up, everyone, I think the snow is going to fall heavily, and the snow is heavy at this time, and if there is any trouble, the shed will collapse.
Quickly remove the plastic sheeting, as much as you can remove. "
It snows after spring, which is different from winter snow.
Winter snow is dry with loose particles, while spring snow is wet and sticky and can hang anywhere.
So the tree hangings in the north generally appear in spring or late autumn, and rarely appear in the cold winter months.
In spring, this kind of snow is very destructive to trees and buildings. The main reason is that it is too heavy and sticky.
In severe cases, the branches can be bent or broken.
The top of the wire can be wrapped with a thick layer, which makes the wire overwhelmed, and sometimes it will break.
So under this kind of weather, it is easy to have power outages and the like.
At the moment, Guan Enxue, who is in the county, looks at the snow that keeps falling outside the window, and his heart is as anxious as a fire.
The impact of this extreme and severe weather is too great. If measures cannot be taken in a timely and effective manner, it will have a great impact.
After hanging up Xu Shiyan's phone call, Guan Enxue didn't stop.
Convene staff for meetings, make emergency plans, issue orders for various departments to activate blizzard and extreme weather warnings, and take necessary measures to prevent possible weather disasters, etc.
Actually, many people don’t understand, and they all think that Guan Enxue is making a fuss?
Yes, it is indeed a bit abnormal that it is still snowing this season, but it is not so overkill, right?
No matter how many people oppose it, Guan Enxue has always insisted on one idea, that is, it is better to spend manpower on prevention than to remedy the disaster after it occurs.
The county issued orders one by one to various towns and towns. At first, some people felt that the fuss was so fussy and unconvinced.
Especially for some ginseng households, the plastic film was put on a few days ago, and now it has to be removed. Many people don’t understand it, and some simply ignore it.
But as the snow kept falling, the snow on the ground became thicker and thicker, and more and more snow hung on the trees.
Most people also understand that this snow is too unusual, and it is likely to cause losses.
However, it was too late to go up the mountain to work at this time.
On the 8th, it snowed all day, and it didn't stop at night.
In some places on the flat ground, the snow reached the knees, and even in some places close to Changbai Mountain, the snow reached the thighs.
The snow was so thick, and it was very heavy. Those ginseng sheds that hadn’t been removed couldn’t bear the weight at all, and they collapsed directly.
Even some old thatched houses, if the snow is not cleared in time, their roofs will collapse.
Fortunately, after a busy day, Su Anying and others have already removed the ginseng sheds from the two venues and covered them on the surface of the pool.
By evening, there was already a thick layer of snow on the surface of the pool.
Su Anying was also a little worried, whether the snow would crush the buds of the stick that had just been unearthed and had not yet stretched.
But it’s useless to worry about it. There’s no way to clean up the snow that much. We’ve done everything we can, and the rest is God’s will.
On the side of the field, after all the workers raced against time, the sheds were withdrawn anyway.
"Old Li, thank you for seeing the opportunity early, if something is wrong until the evening, no matter how many people we can mobilize, it will be useless.
You didn’t see it, the snow on the mountain is too thick. "
Dai Chunrong took people up the mountain, and Li Bingzhuo was sitting at home. The two met in the evening, and each said happily.
Li Bingzhuo let out a long sigh when he heard the words, "It's not that I saw the opportunity early, it was our deputy director Xu who called back from the provincial capital to say it.
He said that this situation is a bit abnormal, and there will be snow if there is trouble.
And it is expected that the temperature will drop sharply tomorrow morning, which may damage the ginseng seedlings. It is recommended that we do a good job of preventing cold and freezing in advance. "
Li Bingzhuo heaved a sigh of relief. He had been worried for a whole day, and now he felt a little relieved.
Secretary Lin is not here. If something serious happens in the field, he will not be the deputy head of the field.
"God doesn't want us to grow ginseng. This rain turns to snow. If we don't take measures in advance, I don't know how many ginseng sheds will be crushed.
The temperature will drop again tomorrow morning, and I don’t know how many club seedlings have been frozen to death. "
Li Bingzhuo sighed, this is the disadvantage of relying on the weather, no one can predict what kind of weather will be.
If God is perfect, it’s okay, but if you catch up with the blind years, there is really no place to cry.
Dai Chunrong finally realized that the co-author today is Xu Shiyan's advance warning.
"No, Director Xu is in the province, how does he know?"
The two of them suddenly realized that something was wrong, and none of them in the local area noticed anything unusual.
The local weather station, the weather station in the county, did not warn in advance, how did Xu Shiyan feel it in the province?
" Said that his daughter-in-law felt that the temperature was wrong when she woke up in the morning, so she called him, and then he guessed that the weather was not good.
This is quite a mystery. I heard people talk about Director Xu. When he was in Donggang Village, he also warned several times in advance of abnormal weather.
It is estimated that Director Xu may have also studied the weather. "Li Bingzhuo didn't understand what was going on either.

chapters.title: Chapter 479: thoughtful little padded jacket
chapters.content:
Chapter 479 Intimate little padded jacket
Others go to the mountains for a day and go home to rest at night, but Su Anying can't.
She had to take someone to the farm to clear the snow over there.
During the day, I left alone to look after the house. With such a large farm, it is busy enough just feeding, how can I have time to clear the snow?
The snow is still falling. If we don’t clean it up quickly, the shed of the pen may collapse at night, and the animals inside will be crushed to death?
Huang Shengli, Feng Chao, and Sun Xiaofeng, together with the scumbags from the farm, took a casual bite at home and hurried to the farm.
Looking over here, a road has been cleared in the farm to feed the animals back and forth, and the rest of the place is covered with thick snow.
At this time, I didn’t care about cleaning the ground, so I hurriedly built ladders and supports, tried little by little, and cleared the snow on the roof of the shed.
Everyone worked until midnight, the snow finally stopped, and the snow on the pens was almost cleared.
At this time, everyone felt that the temperature had dropped a lot.
"This bad weather, I don't know how many sticks will be frozen." Huang Shengli sighed.
"Yes, thanks to our third brother and third sister-in-law who saw the opportunity early, we have another car and move quickly.
It might be enough to replace someone else, it just depends on how much you can grab. "Feng Chao also followed with emotion.
It’s true, they have three cars anyway, although the back of the car is not as big as a big truck, it’s no problem to pull a dozen people.
Cars always run faster than horse-drawn carriages and bicycles, and they acted earlier. This time, the loss should not be too great.
If it were someone else, it wouldn't be so much, others don't have such convenient conditions as them.
Of course, other people's houses don't have as many ginseng land as they do. If the number is small, even if they go late, they can grab it.
"Sister-in-law, why don't you tell third brother, let's buy three more cars. The lack of cars is not enough."
Huang Shengli had wanted to say this for a long time, but he had never had a chance to say it. Today, because of this matter, he happened to bring it up again.
"Well, that's fine. I'll call Shiyan another day and ask him to ask how much this car costs in the provincial capital. Let's buy a few more."
With more and more ginseng land, the farms here also use it, so there are really a few more cars.
The snow stopped, and the snow on the livestock pen in the farm was also cleaned up. Everyone who worked this day had backaches and backaches, and their bodies were weak.
Everyone was tired and sleepy, so they hurried home and lay down on the hot kang to rest.
So Huang Shengli drove, pulling Su Anying and others back.
"Well, Xiao Liu, you guys' wages today are counted separately, one hundred yuan each.
I didn’t bring so much money when I came here today. I’ll bring you the money another day. "
Before getting into the car, Su Anying talked to the blind people working in the farm.
These blind wanderers are very good at their work, and the farm is doing their best.
Moreover, they should not have done the work today. Since they are hired to do the work, the money must be paid.
Otherwise, if something happens in the future, people will not give their best.
"Oh, thank you, Manager Su." When the workers heard it, they were all beautiful.
For people like them, strength is the least valuable thing.
I was a little tired after working for a day, but if I could earn a hundred yuan, that would be a sky-high price. Who would be unhappy?
Just like that, Su Anying and others left the farm and returned to their homes.
Tired from the day, I didn’t care about anything when I entered the door, so I took off my clothes and went straight to the kang to sleep.
This sleep was so deep that I slept until dawn.
When Su Anying woke up, it was almost eight o'clock, and the house was quiet and there was no movement at all.
Su Anying hurriedly got up, put on her clothes and went to the ground, and found a piece of paper on the table.
"Mom, the food is in the pot, Grandpa Chu and brother have already cleared the snow in the yard.
My brother and I sent my younger siblings to my grandparents’ house and went directly to school. Mom remembers to eat. "
The writing on the note is neat and delicate, it is exactly the handwriting of my daughter Xu Jinping.
Su Anying took the note to the kitchen and saw that there were small pickles and miso on the table.
Open the pot, and there is a large bowl of porridge, two flower rolls, and two eggs in the pot.
The flower rolls should have been brought from my mother-in-law last night, and the porridge and eggs must have been cooked by my daughter this morning.
Looking at the food in the pot and on the table, Su Anying felt this irony in her heart.
My daughter is big, caring and sensible. Knowing that her mother is too tired from work, she quietly cooked a meal in the morning to coax her siblings to eat, and left the meal in the pot for her mother.
That's great, how about the girl is a caring little padded jacket.
Su Anying hurriedly scooped some water to wash her face, combed her hair, and brought out the rice to eat a few mouthfuls.
After tidying up the kitchen, he came out of the house.
Open the door, and the air-conditioning suddenly hits the face, and the temperature is below zero.
Su Anying couldn't help worrying about the sticks on the mountain, and wondered if the straw curtains and plastic sheeting would be useful.
I hope it can play a little role, otherwise this year's club is finished.
The snow in the yard was quite thick, and a road more than one meter wide was cleared in the middle.
Chu is over seventy years old, Xu Haiyuan is only nine years old, how can this old and young one have much ability?
It's pretty good if you can clear a path.
Su Anying took out the wooden shovel and began to clear the snow in the yard.
Such thick snow must be cleared, otherwise the temperature will rise tomorrow, and the yard will be filled with water.
The terrain of Xu's yard is high in the middle and low on both sides, so Su Anying cleared the snow bit by bit to the slopes on the east and west sides.
Waiting for the snow to melt, the water will flow down the **** to the bottom of the ditch and pond, so that the yard will not be full.
After a lot of effort, the snow was almost cleared away, so Su Anying locked the door and went to see her parents-in-law.
Originally, the five wing rooms at the west end of Xu Chenghou's house were planned to keep two for sale and rent out three.
Isn't it Elder Chu's decision to stay? Leave those three rooms to Mr. Chu to run a clinic.
It is definitely no problem to open a clinic with Mr. Chu's qualifications. In March, all the procedures will be completed.
Xu Shiyan bought a batch of medicinal materials and equipment for the clinic from the provincial capital, and specially shipped them back. A few days ago, the clinic officially opened.
At Mr. Chu’s age, he opened a clinic not to make money, but mainly to take care of his grandchildren.
So we set a rule right after we opened our business, and we only see a doctor every morning, and only see ten patients.
In the afternoon, unless it’s a matter of being anxious, I don’t watch it at all.
Anyway, there is a hospital in Donggang, and it’s quite close. Mr. Chu doesn’t show it here, and they can go directly to the hospital.
Mr. Chu’s medical skills, can those doctors in Donggang Hospital compare to it?
Some difficult and miscellaneous diseases or old chronic diseases, the hospital does not recruit children, but when they come to Mr. Chu, it is very likely that they will be greatly improved after taking a few medicines.
So despite the fact that this small clinic has just opened for a short time, there are quite a lot of people. Many people have come from all over the world, and they have been queuing up here for a long time.
When Su Anying came over, the clinic was already full, and Su Anying didn't dare to disturb her, so she went directly into the hospital.
In the yard, Xu Chenghou was also clearing the snow with a wooden shovel.
Yesterday, during the day, Xu Chenghou went up the mountain to work, and Zhou Guilan just cleared a trail at home.
The terrain here is flat, and Qingxue is not as convenient as Xu Shiyan's side. We have to get all the snow out here, so as not to flood the whole yard.
Xu Chenghou is in his 60s after all, he was tired after going up the mountain yesterday, now Qingxue is a bit strenuous.
Su Anying saw it and hurried forward to help.

chapters.title: Chapter 480: loss
chapters.content:
Chapter 480 Loss
It’s already May, how can this snow stand up?
As soon as the sun came out, the temperature rose, and it quickly melted, and there was water everywhere.
But the troubles brought by this snowstorm are far more than that.
The crops had just been planted in the field at this time, and a snowfall delayed the germination of the seeds. Many seeds were powdered directly in the ground, and there were no seedlings at all, so they had to be replanted.
Those who planted the land late, now have to wait for the snow in the field to completely melt and the water to go down before continuing to cultivate, which will inevitably delay the farming time.
This year's harvest may not be very good.
The ginseng field is the worst thing. In some places, the snow is not cleared in time, and the ginseng shed is crushed, and the ginseng seedlings just unearthed underneath are directly crushed.
The ginseng shed did not collapse, and the next step was another cooling down.
How can the young tender seedlings that have just been unearthed survive? It froze to death.
After the weather warmed up, the seedlings were all wilted as if scalded with boiling water.
In places like this, we can only hurry up and make goods. Although production is reduced, at least the roots can be retained.
If you don't clean up quickly, the germs will spread down the rotting part, and the roots may also be infected.
Two days after the snowfall, the results of the disaster came out and were sent to Guan Enxue.
The entire county was crushed and collapsed more than 20,000 feet of sheds, and the area suffered from frost damage was more than 10,000 feet.
This is because the county issued an early warning in time, and most areas have taken measures. Otherwise, I am afraid that the loss will exceed several times.
"The results reported by Donggang Town show that the area affected by the disaster is not large.
Villages took active actions and adopted the method of removing ginseng sheds and covering the ground with plastic film, which basically kept the ginseng seedlings.
The same is true for the first participant. The reported data shows that there are not many disasters. How is this going? "
Someone was newly transferred and not familiar with various places. Looking at the information, I felt strange.
"Donggang and Yisanchang have expert advice." Guan Enxue took a sip of tea and said.
"The cadres in Donggang Town are as smart as monkeys.
They followed Xu Shiyan and avoided natural disasters several times, so why not be vigilant?
As long as they hear a little wind, they will act quickly, and they would rather waste their time than wait foolishly.
So, they respond the fastest every time. "
"It's the same for the first participant, Lin Qiyue and the other directors obeyed Xu Shiyan's words.
For such a big event, it must have mobilized all the participants to work on the mountain. "
Guan Enxue laughed as soon as he heard it, and continued.
"Okay, this time we responded in a timely manner, and the power department also launched the snow clearing plan.
There was no damage to the power supply line due to sudden snowfall, which ensured the normal supply of electricity in the county, which is very good. "
In the case of heavy snowfall in Fusong, and even Changbai, Antu, and Jingyu, there are large-scale snowfalls to cool down.
This is the only area affected by the disaster in the entire county, and the survival of the people in the county has not been greatly affected.
Compared with Fusong, the snowfall in Changbai and Antu is more serious.
After all, Jingyu is far away from Changbai Mountain, and the snowfall area is small. On the other hand, Antu is in the north of Changbai Mountain, where the snowfall is heavier and the temperature is lower.
When Xu Shiyan went to call, several people in the same dormitory also knew about it, and they all called back to remind each other.
Although these positions are not low, but the influence in their county is not as good as Xu Shiyan, even if they remind, not many people believe it.
When the provincial meteorological department sent the early warning information in the afternoon, it was too late to do anything, and it was too late.
At any rate, Shao Yong has been promoted to the deputy county, and because of the Clivia incident he had warned in advance, the leaders hold Shao Yong in high regard.
As soon as he called back to report the abnormal weather, the leader took it seriously and immediately organized a meeting and took some measures.
Plus Jingyu does not belong to the center this time, so the loss is the lightest.
Compared with Fusong, Changbai and Antu have much smaller ginseng planting area.
So although the snowfall was heavy this time, it had little impact on the participation of the two places, but there were some losses in other aspects.
It was because of this incident that Park Zhengzhe and Jin Yongqing got the attention of the leaders.
After the snowstorm, life goes on.
The ginseng shed was removed due to the removal of the plastic sheet, reducing the load pressure, and most of the places remained intact. After the snow melted, it was only necessary to put the plastic sheet on again.
But the plastic sheeting was spread on the surface of the pool, with soil underneath and water on top.
When the plastic sheets were made, there was mud and water, and the workers made them like mud monkeys one by one.
Regardless of whether it was a mud monkey or something, it was luck that the stick didn't suffer any losses.
Big guys rejoiced while working, thanks to the proper protective measures, at least this year's stick was saved.
A few days later, Lin Qiyue rushed back from Yangcheng. After learning about the situation, he also greatly praised Xu Shiyan, Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong, and was also terrified.
Thanks to Xu Shiyan's timely warning, Li Bingzhuo did not question Xu Shiyan at all, and the order was issued very quickly.
If it is half a day late, even if the frozen belts are used to make goods, the total area will be 70,000 to 80,000 feet. Even if all the employees and family members are mobilized, it will be enough to complete the cold protection measures in time.
"This time the collective has done meritorious service. Waiting for Deputy Director Xu to come back, we have to hold a celebration party.
Without your full cooperation, our participation this year would have suffered a lot. "
Lin Qiyue immediately stated that the relevant personnel must be commended.
Spring is the busiest season, and because of this heavy snow, a lot of work was delayed.
Waiting for the ginseng shed to be re-covered and tidied up, it will be after the middle of May, and it will be the first time to weed and loosen the soil again.
I'm so busy, there are only a few days left in May.
On May 30th, the overseas edition of domestic mainstream newspapers published Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng.
As reported above, Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng is a ginseng product newly developed by Fusong No. 1 Ginseng Plant.
Its remarkable feature is that the total amount of ginsenosides is higher than other ginseng products, its appearance is neater and more beautiful than other ginseng products, and its processing formula is unique.
Therefore, it has a unique fragrance and is dark red in color.
Dozens of pieces are pressed together to form a square whole, which is beautiful and affordable.
And the packaging is vacuum-treated, so that the product will not be moth-eaten or mildewed after summer, and can be properly guaranteed for collection.
Once this article was published, the reputation of Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng became more and more famous.
Originally, some goods were ordered at the Spring Fair, but now, the attendees received several orders, which made Lin Qiyue beautiful, and he was happy every day.
Now that a participant has reached cooperation with the Forestry Bureau, he no longer has to worry about raw materials.
If there are many orders, more workers will be recruited. If it is not possible, the processing plant will expand its scale. As long as the money is in place, these will not be a problem.
"Xiao Xu, when will you come back from graduation? Just wait for you to come back.
We are going to flex our muscles this fall, so many orders are waiting. "
At this year’s Spring Fair, Yi’s performance was still impressive, earning more than US$5 million in foreign exchange.
Combining the original customer orders, it is expected to earn nearly 20 million U.S. dollars this year.
This number is also one of the best in the whole province.
It can be said that Yishangchang is now a key enterprise in the province, and the salary is much higher than before.

chapters.title: Chapter 481: research leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 481 Research Leader
"Secretary Lin, I will be able to go back in a while.
The formula and production process of the fertilizer are almost the same, but the experimental data is missing. I will take the team back in a few days. "
Xu Shiyan's research projects are progressing rapidly. The formulations of microbial compound fertilizer and foliar fertilizer are basically finalized, but there is currently a lack of experimental records.
Nongda and Donggang Township jointly established a research base, and Xu Shiyan is the main person in charge of the research base.
A few days ago, the instructor discussed with Xu Shiyan and asked him to lead the team back to Donggang to be responsible for the subsequent experimental records and data analysis.
As for graduation thesis, what Xu Shiyan has done now is the best proof of grades.
Xu Shiyan's strength no longer needs that paper to prove it.
"Oh, that's great, you come back as soon as possible.
It is best to come back before the end of June. The fourth council of the Ginseng Society is scheduled to be held on June 20.
You were not here last year, if possible this year, try to come back. ",
Lin Qiyue was very happy when he heard it.
Nowadays, this participation is becoming more and more prosperous, earning more and more foreign exchange, but Lin Qiyue is also extremely uncertain in his heart.
When Xu Shiyan came back, the four of them cooperated with each other and twisted into a rope, so that they could lead all the staff in the field to run forward together.
"By the way, that book has been published, and it has been distributed to participating venues, various operating companies, technical stations and so on through the Ginseng Society.
It means that there is no manuscript fee, and we are obliged to write. "
Lin Qiyue's words sounded regretful, but he was actually explaining to Xu Shiyan.
Lin Qiyue is the chairman of the Ginseng Society. This matter is promoted by the society and the county, and distributed for free. Not only is there no profit, but the county has to pay for it.
"Secretary Lin, are we short of money?" Xu Shiyan laughed on the phone.
Are they writing books for money?
For the sake of money, what is wrong with doing something, is it worth the effort to write a book?
Lin Qiyue laughed loudly on the phone, "That's true, who doesn't know that you two are the richest people in our county?
By the way, I heard from the management secretary that next year our county's advanced individuals and March 8th red-banner bearers will have daughters-in-law.
We will definitely reward you for participating next year, and then you two will go to receive the award together. "
The county benefited from the heavy snowfall before, and Guan Enxue knew that it was Xu Shiyan's credit.
But some things are not easy to put on the bright side, so this is the only way.
Xu Shiyan doesn't have much interest in these anymore. The awards of advanced individuals and model workers in his family are all posted on the wall, and it doesn't matter if they are there or not.
But his wife is different. Su Anying hasn't won any honor yet, so she can.
"Then thank you, Secretary Guan and Secretary Lin."
Long-distance calls, you can’t keep chatting, talk about important things, and hang up quickly.
On June 5th, Xu Shiyan returned to Donggang with a research group from the Agricultural University, several carts of experimental equipment, fertilizer test products, etc.
The office of the research base and the dormitories of the relevant researchers have been prepared in Donggang Township long ago, so everyone settled down and started to do related experiments.
Although Xu Shiyan is the person in charge of the research base, he doesn't need to live with them.
So after the graduate students from the Agricultural University were settled, Xu Shiyan went home.
In June, the weather is hot, and Su Anying is busy.
Zhou Guilan looked at the two children, and sometimes she couldn't care less, and was worried that something might happen to the younger sister and younger brother when they ran across to the construction site.
So Zhou Guilan asked Xu Chenghou to tie a rope to the beam of her gate and make a swing for the children.
This thing is very good. There is a gate above the gate, which is just in the shade. The children are sitting on the swings, and it is not hot at all.
The two children switched to play on the swing. The morning passed quickly, and they took a nap after lunch.
In the afternoon, when the sun was shining, I went to play something else, and the day passed.
When Xu Shiyan got home, Xu Haiqing was sitting on the swing, and Xu Jinhui was pushing it behind.
Seeing that her father was back, Xu Jinhui didn't bother to care about her younger brother anymore, and ran towards her father on her short legs.
"Daddy hug." The little girl stretched out her arms, raised her head, and insisted on being hugged by her father.
Xu Jinhui is five years old, and they are on June 1st, the tenth day of the fourth month of the lunar calendar, so they are already four years old.
The little girl has grown up and is quite sensible. She is very happy to see her father.
Xu Shiyan threw his things on the ground, and quickly bent down to pick up his daughter.
"Hey, my daughter is sinking again, how many good things have you eaten? Do you miss Dad?"
"I think so, Huihui misses her father." Xu Jinhui pointed to her heart with her chubby little hand while talking.
This is a habit that her family always teases her and develops. No matter whether others ask or not, she will point to her heart, showing that she is thinking from her heart.
Xu Shiyan was amused by his daughter's actions, so he lowered his head and kissed his daughter's cheek.
"It's awesome, our family Huihui is getting better and better."
Then, Xu Shiyan looked at the youngest son who was still dangling on the swing.
This heartless thing, even when my father came back, I didn't even know to come here.
"Xu Haiqing, didn't you see your dad?" Xu Shiyan couldn't laugh or cry, why did he raise such a big-hearted child.
"Hey, Dad." Xu Haiqing who was on the swing smiled, stopped the fall, and walked up to his father.
"Little heartless, you won't even kiss your father when you see him, so it's useless to raise you."
Xu Shiyan put down his daughter, and stretched out his hand to pinch his son's chubby cheek.
"At first glance, I didn't eat less. This face is full of meat. Can you cook a plate of food and drink if you cut it off?"
Xu Shiyan deliberately scares his son.
"Father, human flesh doesn't taste good, so don't eat it."
Xu Haiqing was still smiling, and then stretched out his little arms to let his father hug him too.
The two children naturally couldn't lean towards each other, so Xu Shiyan bent down and picked up his son again.
"Oh, you are heavier than your sister, like a stone egg.
You, a little pig, know how to eat all day long, and you have become a little fat man. "
The son is obviously much heavier than the daughter. This kid has nothing else to think about all day long, just thinking about eating, can he not be heavy?
"The third child is back? Why don't you go to the hospital?"
Just at this time, Xu Chenghou came out, seeing that it was his son who came back, Xu Chenghou was quite puzzled.
"When is this? Why are you back?"
"Father, doesn't that Agricultural University have a cooperative project with our town? I am the person in charge, and this time I am leading the team back to do experiments and research."
Xu Shiyan put down his son, picked up the luggage on the ground, and explained to his father.
Xu Chenghou seems to understand, but anyway, he feels that his son is getting better and better now, and he is even in charge of the project of the Agricultural University.
"No, then who are you now? Where do you get your salary?"
The old man was a little confused. Isn’t Xu Shiyan the deputy director of the first participating field? Why did he become the person in charge?
"Father, my working relationship is still in the first place. Of course, the first time I pay the salary, and the rest is just a trick."
Xu Shiyan carried his luggage with a smile, and entered the yard with Xu Chenghou.

chapters.title: Chapter 482: bring grandchildren
chapters.content:
Chapter 482 Bringing disciples and grandchildren
It was almost eleven o'clock when Xu Shiyan entered the house, and Zhou Guilan was busy cooking in the kitchen.
After a while, when Xu Haiyuan and the others came back from school, they would be hungry as soon as they entered the door, so they had to prepare meals in advance, and the children would eat as soon as they entered the door.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about Mr. Chu, so he didn't chat with his parents, put down his luggage, turned around and went to the clinic.
Because Mr. Chu set the rules a long time ago, he only sees ten people every morning.
So at this time, there were not many people in the room, and there were four or five people including the doctor and his companions.
Old Chu was taking a pulse, Xu Shiyan didn't want to disturb him, so he stood quietly beside him.
Old Chu finished his pulse diagnosis and asked the patient about some symptoms, the patient nodded in agreement.
Then Elder Chu nodded, took a pen and began to write the prescription.
It's the same for all doctors, but the words on the prescription are flying and dancing, and ordinary people can't understand it.
Old Chu finished prescribing the prescription, and when he looked up and saw Xu Shiyan, he handed the prescription to Xu Shiyan.
"Apply the medicine according to the prescription, three times." Someone can order it, and Mr. Chu is happy to worry about it.
Seeing a doctor and prescribing Xu Shiyan dare not say that he can do it, but there is no problem with taking the medicine.
Xu Shiyan immediately washed his hands, stood in front of the medicine cabinet, and took the medicine according to the prescription.
Weigh it with a scorpion, and then divide it into three equal parts and pour it on the paper.
After grabbing all the medicines, fold the paper bags, tie them into a string with paper strings, and hand them over to the other party.
And told the other party how to decoct the medicine and when to take it.
With Xu Shiyan as his helper, Mr. Chu only cares about seeing a doctor and prescribing prescriptions, but it is faster.
Not long after, another patient was seen and a prescription was prescribed.
Xu Shiyan was taking medicine according to the prescription. Xu Haiyuan ran in after school.
"Father? You're back?" Xu Haiyuan was stunned when he saw Xu Shiyan who was grabbing medicine as soon as he entered the door.
"Keep down, your master is treating people."
Xu Shiyan made a shh gesture to prevent Xu Haiyuan from speaking loudly.
Xu Haiyuan nodded, walked slowly to Elder Chu, and listened quietly to Elder Chu's inquiry about the condition and the patient's description of the illness.
Xu Haiyuan is still young, and the time to study medicine with Mr. Chu is short, and he still has to attend classes, so it is only in the theoretical study stage at present.
However, Xu Haiyuan is indeed very spiritual in this aspect. No matter what Mr. Chu teaches, he can master it as soon as he teaches it.
Old Chu is very satisfied with this little disciple.
After the patient finished seeing the doctor, after Mr. Chu prescribed the prescription, Xu Haiyuan took the prescription and gave it to Xu Shiyan, and then stood beside Xu Shiyan, watching Xu Shiyan take the medicine.
Xu Haiyuan has already followed Mr. Chu to learn how to recognize medicines and identify medicinal materials, and he has learned the properties of medicines by memorizing verses.
So Xu Shiyan grabbed a blind medicine, and Xu Haiyuan whispered about the properties and effects of the medicine.
Xu Shiyan heard that the child recited everything correctly, and couldn't help sighing, this kid has a really good memory.
When he was studying with Mr. Chu, it took a lot of effort to memorize it.
"Okay, you can go back to eat first, Grandma has already cooked all the meals. I will go there with your teacher in a while."
Xu Shiyan grabbed the medicine for the last person, wrapped it tightly and tied it tightly, and then handed it to others. He ordered everything that should be ordered, and then collected the money.
The other party went out, Xu Shiyan fetched water again, asked Mr. Chu to wash his hands, closed the door, and went back to the house for dinner together.
Zhou Guilan had already packed up the food and put it on the table. When she saw Chu Xuanhuai and her children and grandchildren entering the room, she hurriedly greeted them with a smile.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu were a little surprised when they saw Xu Shiyan, and they went to Xu Shiyan's side and chattered.
"Let's eat first, and Dad will chat with you after the meal."
Xu Shiyan touched the tops of his daughter and godson's heads. These two little guys have been inseparable since they were young. They have always been together, and they are divided into the same class at school.
Xu Jinping studies well, so Yang Haoyu is not bad either. The two tied for first place at the end of last semester.
Yang Haoyu's health has improved a lot since he practiced martial arts with Han Wenzhong. Now that Mr. Chu came over, he took some time to give Yang Haoyu some medicine for him to take every day.
So this little guy looks much better than before, and he is in good spirits.
The children were obedient, washed their hands and came back to sit down to eat.
In this season, there are many kinds of small green vegetables in the vegetable garden, such as lettuce, water radish, Chinese cabbage, and chrysanthemum chrysanthemum.
Zhou Guilan stir-fried chrysanthemum chrysanthemum with sauce, and made a cabbage, tofu, vermicelli and meatball soup.
Then wash some lettuce, radish, scallions, fry an egg sauce, the staple food is rice and steamed buns.
Su Anying went to work on the mountain and didn't come back to eat at noon, so everyone sat down to eat directly.
"Grandma, I want rice wrapped with lettuce." Xu Haiqing looked at the food on the table and began to think about what to eat.
Xu’s family grows purple leaf lettuce with large and thick leaves.
A lettuce leaf, put some egg sauce, green onion leaves on top, and then put rice, just like this, it’s delicious to eat.
Xu Haiqing is not picky, she can eat anything, she wraps rice with lettuce, she eats it in a few mouthfuls, Zhou Guilan hurriedly wraps another one.
"Don't just eat bread, the soup made by grandma at noon is also ready, try it quickly."
Xu Haiqing killed three rice buns in a row, thanks to the fact that the lettuce leaves grown at home are not that big, so they can't hold too much rice.
But for a five-year-old child, this appetite is really not small.
After eating three rice buns, Xu Haiqing broke another piece of steamed bun, ate the steamed bun and drank the soup.
There are meatballs in the soup. Zhou Guilan is very good at making meatballs. The meatballs are tender, delicious and full of fragrance.
Paired with Chinese cabbage and tofu, the soup is even more delicious.
The little guy ate deliciously. After a while, a bowl of soup and a piece of steamed bun entered his stomach again, so he was satisfied and stopped eating.
"Xiaoyu, eat more, I see that your brother's appetite is about to catch up with yours.
How many years are you older than him, don't let him catch up. "
Xu Shiyan saw this, and quickly filled another bowl of soup for his godson, and specially filled a few more meatballs.
"Thank you godfather, I have eaten a lot."
Yang Haoyu used to be in poor health and had a weak spleen and stomach, so he really ate less. Now that he is getting older, his health has improved a lot, and his appetite is better than before.
However, he eats delicately and elegantly, unlike Xu Haiqing who devours so much, so he doesn't seem to eat much.
The living conditions of the Xu family are good, and Zhou Guilan tries to mix meat and vegetables with every meal.
Five children get together, and the food is delicious, and the picky eaters are no longer picky eaters, so they can eat whatever they want.
So watching the children eat is also very interesting.
"Mom, when I saw them eating, I remembered when we were teenagers.
All of them are like carrying hungry pockets, which can’t be filled like a bottomless pit.
At that time, you had to cook a lot of dishes for a meal, and they were very salty. "Xu Shiyan watched the children eating, and suddenly said with emotion.
Zhou Guilan also laughed when she heard it, "What were the conditions at that time? It's pretty good to eat big pancakes with pickled vegetables.
It’s okay if the dishes are not salty. You guys can make a big pot of vegetables for a meal. If the dishes are weak, it’s not enough to eat.
At that time in our family, we had to bake pancakes once a month, and when I was cooking, I was in a panic, and I had to cut a pot of sauerkraut. "

chapters.title: Chapter 483: gorge spring
chapters.content:
Chapter 483 Canyon Spring
From April 1986, daylight saving time began to be implemented, that is, the watch was set forward by one hour.
The school’s class timetable will also be adjusted according to summer and winter.
Xu Haiyuan and the others start self-study at 7:00 in the morning, the first class at 7:30, and school ends at 11:10.
In winter, class starts at 1:10 pm, in summer it is 2:10.
Most of the elementary school teachers don’t hold the class, and the children rush out after school. Xu’s house is close to the school, and it takes less than five minutes to get home.
Eat as soon as you enter the door. If you eat fast, you don’t even have to finish eating at 11:30.
So there is plenty of time at noon.
Xu Haiyuan was called by Elder Chu after lunch to help Elder Chu copy the medical records.
This is the task that Mr. Chu gave him.
Every day, Mr. Chu will retell the patients to Xu Haiyuan at noon, and Xu Haiyuan will record them.
Including the patient's main complaint symptoms, pulse condition, Mr. Chu's diagnosis, medication, etc., all must be recorded.
If it is a patient who has been here before, they will be sorted together according to the time, so that you can see the changes in the condition and medication.
Traditional Chinese medicine pays attention to symptomatic treatment, and there are also methods such as treating the same disease with different methods, and treating different diseases with the same method.
There are even some old Chinese doctors who use one prescription to go all over the world, adding and subtracting according to the symptoms.
These are not things that can be learned in medical school, and there is no one to teach them, so you can't learn the essence at all.
Xu Haiyuan is young and has a good memory. Every time he records a medical record, it leaves an impression in his mind.
Elder Chu does not require him to be able to comprehend it now, it is better to memorize it first, and remember it later.
When Xu Haiyuan finished writing and sorting out his daily medical records, the time was almost up.
So Xu Haiyuan went to school with his younger siblings, while Mr. Chu took a nap on the bed in the back room of the clinic and rested for a while.
Xu Shiyan still has something to do, so naturally he can't stay at home for a long time. After eating and resting for a while, he went to participate.
Lin Qiyue was very happy to see Xu Shiyan come back, and hurriedly explained his recent work.
Currently, there are nearly ten flagship products in one session.
Changbai Mountain red ginseng, ginseng honey slices, ginseng Tianma honey, high-end gift ginseng, natural active ginseng, holy mountain Tianquan mineral water, vitality source functional drinks, ginseng cola, ginseng flower cola.
Each has its own characteristics, and they have received many orders.
Based on the current situation of participation, both Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan feel that it is not appropriate to be greedy and aggressive. The most important thing is to stabilize these products first.
As long as they can maintain the current output and quality, and keep these current orders from being lost, the annual foreign exchange earning of nearly 20 million dollars is already very good.
There are too many products, it is inevitable that there will be some emphasis, and the merchants are likely to be confused.
Regarding research on edible fungi, medicinal fungus cultivation, and small berry cultivation, the focus has been shifted to the Forestry Bureau through cooperation.
After all, there are sufficient manpower and various conditions are more suitable.
The two sides are still adopting a cooperative approach. One participant will provide technology, and the Forestry Bureau will provide labor and venues.
In this way, the problem of insufficient manpower and the large number of idle personnel in the Forestry Bureau was solved.
"Then do as you said, let's take Canyon Spring first.
Next year or the year after, we will start to lay out the domestic market and open up the coke market first.
Just a few years later, the cultivation of this small berry will also bear fruit, and we can develop fruit juice drinks.
As for this, I think what you said is reasonable, you can cooperate with the Forestry Bureau to create another brand.
Different target groups, the market does not conflict, just can seize different levels of the market, this is very important. "
Lin Qiyue agreed with Xu Shiyan's idea.
For the current employees participating in the field, it is really impossible to take into account all aspects. It is better to invest and cooperate with others. A win-win situation is the best way to survive.
Taking profits alone will cause dissatisfaction with others sooner or later, and if one of them plays tricks behind the scenes, the loss will be even greater.
"Okay, then follow what we discussed. I will take people into the mountain tomorrow."
The location of Canyon Spring has been found by the people from the technical department according to Xu Shiyan's guidance.
What they need to do now is to delineate the scope of water sources, plan a new plant site, and occupy the place first.
Xu Shiyan, who returned home from school, started to get busy again. On the one hand, he had to focus on fertilizer research, and on the other hand, he had to take care of the field.
New spring water has been found. In order to prevent others from making trouble, Yichang decided to jointly develop a new beverage factory with the Forestry Bureau.
The two parties are joint ventures, and the Forestry Bureau will come forward to approve various procedures.
The spring is located within the scope of Songshan Forest Farm, which is under the jurisdiction of the Forestry Bureau, so it is much more convenient for them to go through the formalities.
At present, not to mention the county, even the city and province, there is no idea how many people and how many pairs of eyes are staring at the participants.
There are always some people who have no skills themselves, and are envious of watching others make money.
So this time, the forestry bureau is responsible for everything.
The Forestry Bureau is an enterprise directly under the province, and it is also a key unit. Others dare to trip up a participant, but they may not dare to trip up the Forestry Bureau.
In this way, all the procedures were handled smoothly.
One venue has the Holy Mountain Tianquan, the Forestry Bureau has the Canyon Spring, and the Provincial Beverage Factory, Fusong and Quanyang have also jointly established factories.
For a while, many people seemed to smell business opportunities from it, and many people began to think about it, thinking about the whole beverage factory or mineral water factory.
Changbai Mountain is a dormant volcano. The unique landform has bred countless underground springs, and there are many types of hot springs and mineral springs around.
As long as you have the heart, it is not difficult to find a place to develop.
The province has received no less than ten related applications, and this matter has attracted the attention of relevant departments in the province.
Some experts pointed out that mineral water resources should not be over-exploited.
Without relevant qualifications, without field exploration, without clear water quality and composition, it cannot be approved at will.
Otherwise, once over-exploitation and improper operation and management, it is likely to cause water pollution, which will damage the local environment and cause irreversible losses.
But this suggestion didn't have much effect.
This is the same as Clivia before. Others are already eyeing it with jealousy. Unless the higher authorities explicitly order to prohibit it, it is impossible to stop it.
Local departments are eager to have multiple factories to make money, and higher-level departments are also counting on the development of mineral water industry to earn foreign exchange through export. How can they explicitly prohibit it?
Only relevant market regulations can be made, and the approval system should be clarified.
In a short time, several counties near Changbai Mountain began to occupy land and build factories, and many places arranged people to study in a field.
Regarding this situation, Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan could do nothing.
As the first enterprise to eat crabs and earn money from the mineral water industry, the current situation has long been expected.
The general environment has always been like this, and they cannot reverse it. They can only continuously improve their own strength and improve product competitiveness.
Fortunately, the Holy Mountain Tianquan has its unique scarcity and non-reproducibility, and all kinds of beverages in the market have their own formula patents, so they are not afraid of imitation by others.
If others want to occupy a place in this, they have to find another way.

chapters.title: Chapter 484: graduated
chapters.content:
Chapter 484 Graduated
The approval and construction of the canyon spring water plant are all in the hands of the Forestry Bureau. The first participant is only responsible for technical and financial support, so it doesn't take too much thought.
On June 20th, Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue attended the fourth council meeting of Fusong Ginseng Society.
Lin Qiyue was re-elected as the chairman of the board, and Xu Shiyan was still elected as the vice chairman.
Graduation season in July, the cadre training class of the Agricultural University is about to end, and the instructor asked Xu Shiyan to go back to school.
It happened that Huang Shengli and the others had been talking about buying a car, so they simply went to the provincial capital with Xu Shiyan to find out the current price.
They plan to buy three more cars to come back, saving enough.
A group of people came to the provincial capital, and Huang Shengli settled down in a guest house.
Xu Shiyan went back to school to attend the graduation ceremony and take graduation photos.
After two years of getting along, we are about to part, so I am reluctant to part.
So someone proposed to go out to get together at night.
This proposal was supported by everyone, so the big guys booked a place and booked the venue directly at night, eating, drinking, singing and dancing, and the noise went up to ten o'clock.
In the end, everyone drank too much, and staggered out of the restaurant one by one with their shoulders on their backs.
Some people still carry wine bottles in their hands, drinking and singing while walking.
When you meet pedestrians on the road, you keep away from them, and no one dares to move forward.
Just kidding, such a large group of people are all drunk and howling.
Not to mention ordinary people, even those small local ruffians would not dare to provoke them.
At any rate, they all entered the dormitory before the entrance guard.
The uncle in charge of the dormitory knew that this group of people was leaving after graduation, so he didn't hesitate to argue with them.
I only told a few people who were still awake, and told them not to shout after going upstairs, so they just turned a blind eye and closed their eyes.
The next day, everyone with a hangover woke up with a splitting headache.
Then they swayed and started to pack their luggage, and each went to his own future.
"Xiao Xu, no matter what happens in the future, you must call brother.
What I can do, I must do for you. If I can’t, I will find a way to do it for you. "
Shao Yong’s unit arranged a car to pick him up. Before getting into the car, Shao Yong hugged Xu Shiyan and patted Xu Shiyan on the back.
As the first person in this group of students to be promoted to the deputy county, Shao Yong knew very well that Xu Shiyan had a lot to do with his ability to be promoted so quickly.
The two times he showed his face in front of the leader, he was instructed by Xu Shiyan. This kindness is too great.
That's why he said that as long as Xu Shiyan has something to do, he will find a way no matter whether it can be done or not.
"Okay, Brother Shao, I will remember what I said. If I encounter difficulties in the future, I will definitely ask Brother Shao for help."
Xu Shiyan just laughed, whether it is necessary or not, I will talk about it later, but Shao Yong can say this, which makes people feel warm.
Shao Yong let go of Xu Shiyan, and embraced both Jin Yongqing and Park Zhengzhe.
"Brother, take care, if you have something to say in the future, we are not far away, and we often come and go."
Shao Yong was the first to leave, followed by Jin Yongqing and Park Zhengzhe, who also came to hug Xu Shiyan respectively.
"Don't say anything, just talk about things in the future." A lot of long-winded words are not as useful as one sentence.
Both of these two have heard some gossip. When they go back this time, they can basically go a step further, and they are in a better position.
In this, Xu Shiyan is somewhat credited.
The last time it snowed and the temperature dropped, the leader named and praised them. These are qualifications and necessary conditions for promotion.
Xu Shiyan was not polite to them either, he smiled and nodded in agreement.
Send these two away, just as Huang Shengli and the others came to pick up Xu Shiyan, everyone helped Xu Shiyan carry his luggage and went directly to the guest house to stay.
Then, they found an acquaintance to buy a car.
In the past two years, the price of the car has not changed much. Now buying a car is not so difficult, just pay the money and pick up the car.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan and the others brought three more light vehicles, all with domestic engines.
I picked up the car, and there was nothing else to do. After thinking about it, everyone decided to drive back.
So I bought a lot of food and loaded it into the car, and just drove back all the way.
Huang Shengli's driving handles are good, but he has never traveled long distances, and he dare not drive too fast on the road.
It was getting dark halfway, so I found a place to stay for one night, and drove back to Donggang the next morning.
Bought three new cars all at once, which made the neighbors envious.
When the car stopped at the gate of Xu's house, many people gathered around to watch.
"Oh, the old Xu's family is rich, so I bought three of these cars at once."
Someone looked at the brand new car and said enviously and jealously.
"Not only that, they have not only cars, but also tractors.
Haven't you heard? The ginseng land does not need to be dug manually, it is all mechanized.
Oh, what kind of machinery is on the back of the big tractor, once it passes through the ground, the soil will all turn up, which is much more worry-free than digging with a pickaxe. "
There is a sensible person next to him, and he said while gesturing.
"Yes, this year the Xu family sells ginseng soil, all of which are finished soil.
How convenient it is to have a machine to work, and it is cost-effective to sell finished soil. ’ another person answered.
"But it's too expensive. The finished soil is more than 20 feet long, which is twice as much as the raw soil."
This year, only more than 20,000 feet of ginseng soil was approved. A while ago, Su Anying had already brought people up to hang strings.
Su Anying said that these ginseng soils are not too much. I can’t sit idle with my tractor after buying it, so I just turned over the soil directly, and I can sell the finished soil this year.
Raw soil, that is, ginseng soil that is sold directly on a string, costs only eleven or twelve yuan per ten feet, and the finished soil can sell for more than twenty yuan per ten feet.
The finished soil can be sold for an extra ten yuan per foot, of which two yuan is the hired labor for manual pouring of the soil, and the cost of using machines for digging and other processes is less than four yuan.
That is to say, after deducting the cost, selling the finished soil for one foot makes more than four yuan more than the raw soil.
More than 20,000 feet of ginseng soil, and this alone makes an extra 80,000 yuan. Who wouldn't count this business?
Whoever it is, wouldn’t be foolishly selling it.
As for whether someone will buy it? There is no need to think about this question, just this ginseng soil, I don’t know how many people are robbing it.
And you don’t need to dig it yourself, you can save money by doing other things manually, which is a good deal.
The 20,000-foot ginseng soil has not yet started selling, so it has been booked out.
As far as this is concerned, Xu Shiyan is convinced. His daughter-in-law is becoming more and more savvy now.
She earned the money, who wouldn't be jealous?
This piece of ginseng land has a total of twenty-five feet. When the turf was dug and hung on strings, the edge of the forest was slightly expanded, and a total of 21,000 feet of ginseng soil could be produced.
One thousand zhang was deducted, each family kept it for their own use, and the remaining twenty thousand zhang was set aside at twenty-two yuan.
This crop of ginseng alone can earn nearly 200,000 yuan.
Su Anying owns half of the shares, that is to say, in addition to the 100 feet of ginseng soil for the Xu family's own use, this year's only ginseng soil has nearly 100,000 income.
I earned back the money I used to buy a house in Beijing.

chapters.title: Chapter 485: gang war
chapters.content:
Chapter 485 Fighting in groups
Xu Shiyan is not only responsible for the daily work of the first participant, but also responsible for the corresponding affairs of the research base, which is enough for him.
Fortunately, this year's first participation does not plan to add new products. Without this item, Xu Shiyan can breathe a sigh of relief.
I usually run around on weekdays, and on weekends, I have time to take care of my own ginseng.
Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping and others have already finished their final exams and are on vacation.
With Xu Haiyuan leading them, these brats finished their holiday homework early.
It's summer vacation, Xu Haiyuan follows Mr. Chu every morning, observing and studying.
This time, there is no need to sort out the medical records at noon.
Mr. Chu sees people, and Xu Haiyuan writes and organizes them, taking notes while listening.
The little guy is extra careful and memorizes carefully.
Mr. Chu would check every day at the end of his consultations to see that the medical records were organized in an orderly manner.
But Mr. Chu is so rare, he praises him again and again.
Xu Haiyuan is busy, so naturally he has no time to restrain Huang Shuqing, Sun Yu and others.
Those brats finished their homework for the holidays and had nothing to do all day long, so they started to let themselves go and go out in various ways.
As a result, he was inattentive, and started working with the guy from the grain depot again.
For the first time, Huang Shuqing and his group had more people, but the group of grain depots had fewer people, so Huang Shuqing and his group won.
As a result, on the second day, the gang from the grain depot found helpers, so they surrounded Huang Shuqing and his group directly.
"Brother Haiyuan, hurry up, my brother, brother Shuqing, Sun Yu, sister Ping, and brother Haoyu are fighting with someone.
There are many people over there, my brother and the others will suffer if they can’t beat them. "
In the morning, Xu Haiyuan was studying beside Mr. Chu, when Yang Chunming's daughter, Yang Lihua, ran in panting, and dragged Xu Haiyuan out.
"What the hell? Got into a fight with someone?"
Xu Haiyuan heard it, is it okay? Just run outside.
Xu Haiyuan followed Yang Lihua all the way to the open space in front of the building materials factory, and saw two groups fighting together.
Here Huang Shuqing, Huang Shuping, Sun Yu, Sun Ning, Yang Jianguo, Yang Jianjun, together with Xu Jinping, Zhao Tingting, Zhao Lili, Huang Shuyun, and Yang Haoyu.
It doesn’t matter if they are male or female, they went up together and got into fights with many people on the opposite side.
The group on the opposite side was a lot of people, and they were all boys, and they were ruthless. Seeing that Huang Shuqing and others were no match, they were about to lose.
Xu Haiyuan saw that it was okay, so he rushed forward without saying a word.
Xu Haiyuan also learned boxing from Han Wenzhong for a year. Although he is small and not strong enough, among his peers, there is really no one who can match him.
Xu Haiyuan rushed forward, punched and kicked several people.
When Huang Shuqing and the others saw Xu Haiyuan approaching, they all savaged their hands, catching the person opposite, and punched and kicked them regardless.
Not dodging after being punched by others, it is completely a way of fighting to the death.
Even the girls like Zhao Tingting and Xu Jinping didn't care about that, they grabbed the arm or leg of the person opposite, and started to bite directly.
There are few clothes in summer, who can stand this? Doesn't it hurt to scream?
At first, I was thinking about the girl in front of me, so I should save some energy, but now my eyes were red, and I hit someone like crazy.
However, at this time, Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan and others who heard the news had already arrived.
Xu Chenghou let out a groan, and immediately calmed down the group of children whose eyes were red from fighting.
"What the **** are you doing? All the **** didn't learn well, but they also learned how to fight, right?
Get the **** out of here, let me see who dares to fight? "
Xu Chenghou was furious when he saw the bruised nose, swollen face, little skin and hairless appearance of these children.
"Grandpa, it's not us who pick things up, it's they who deliberately find trouble.
Yesterday we played football at the Tomb of the Martyrs, and we had a good time.
They came to grab the space, not to mention, and pushed Xiaoyu and Feng Bin to the place, so we started fighting with them.
Today they recruited a bunch of helpers to beat us. There are many of them and they are all older than us. They are the ones who bully us. "
Xu Jinping endured the pain in her body, pointed at the guy from the grain depot, and gritted her teeth.
"What the hell?" Xu Chenghou heard it, is it okay? Turning around, I was going to settle accounts with the guy from the grain depot.
There were many children in that group, and some of them were clever and turned around and ran away when they saw that something was wrong.
As soon as he ran, the others followed, and in an instant, the group of brats disappeared without a trace.
"You all wait for me, I have to find your parents." Xu Chenghou shouted towards the backs of those children.
With such a shout, those children ran faster.
Just like that, Xu Chenghou and his wife brought a group of children back to the clinic, asked Chu Xuanhuai for help, showed the children what was going on, and applied some iodine or red syrup to those who were injured.
Don't look at how fierce they were all in the fight just now, but now they are whimpering and screaming in pain.
"You deserve the pain, bear it all, who told you to fight?
Little children don’t learn well, and dare to fight with others? Should. "
Old Chu spoke harshly, but was very gentle in his hands, and gently applied the children with potions to reduce inflammation and relieve pain.
In the evening, when the adults of each family came back, they were all furious when they saw this virtue.
First went to the parents of the children in the grain depot, and then gave their own children a bad reprimand.
But light training is useless at all, these kids are too skinny to care.
Gotta find something serious for them to do before they run wild and get into trouble.
Just when Xu Shiyan remembered that the new ginseng land on the mountain was going to build a small house for ginseng.
"Simply, starting tomorrow, take these mischievous things up the whole mountain and let them work.
Also let them know what it means to work hard. If they don’t study hard, they will all have to work hard in the future. "
It's no wonder Xu Shiyan is so angry, even Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu, who are usually well-behaved and sensible children, have been playing wild recently.
If these brats don’t punish them severely again, they will really go against the sky.
"Yes, yes, I think the third brother's move will work.
They need to be dealt with properly. These skinny ones are going against the sky.
It’s okay for boys to be skinny, but girls are also so skinny, and they can still fight with others, is that okay? "
It was Zhao Jianshe who said this, and his family Zhao Tingting and Zhao Lili were the ones fighting.
I don’t know if it’s because he hangs out with a group of boys all day long, or because he’s born a tiger. The girls in his family are all boy-like.
She doesn't have the tenderness of a girl, and she fights harder than a boy.
"Yes, I think so too.
That's it, starting tomorrow, let them go to work in the mountains.
It’s not just about building houses there, we have so many ginseng land, weeding weeds and spraying medicine, let them do it.
Everyone in the province knows nothing else at home, so they know that fighting and causing trouble. "Yang Chunming also quite agreed with Xu Shiyan's proposal.
"This is because the conditions are good now, and I want them to study hard so that they can be successful in the future.
If this is put back when we were young, which one didn’t we get up in the morning and shovel the ground to work, and then go home to eat and go to school after finishing the work?
Let them scavenge, they should be cured. "
Just like that, the fathers agreed to send the children to the mountains to work and experience life.

chapters.title: Chapter 486: and mud wall
chapters.content:
Chapter 486 and the muddy wall
It is not easy for the daughters-in-law to object to what the gentlemen decide.
Besides, these skinny kids really need a lesson.
So it was such a happy decision to send all the brats to work on the mountain the next day.
The children who heard the news were not afraid at all.
For them, they are playing everywhere, and they can't wait to go up the mountain.
I usually play near my home, and my family disagrees when I go a little farther away.
This time I can go up the mountain, no matter whether it is work or doing something, it doesn’t matter.
One by one started to look forward to it at night, and the next morning, without being called by adults, they all got up early.
Xu Haiyuan and the others still run to Han’s house every morning, and come back after boxing and martial arts.
However, today was obviously different from usual. Not only Yang Haoyu came back together, but even the boys from the Han family all followed.
"Uncle, my grandfather heard that Pingping and the others were going to work in the mountains, so he sent us over and asked us to help."
Han Limin's boss, Han Zhenwen said excitedly.
Xu Shiyan froze for a moment, then shook his head and smiled wryly.
No need to guess, it must be that these few did not do good things at home and **** off the family.
As soon as he heard that Xu Jinping and the others were going to work in the mountains, Han Wenzhong simply sent them along.
It’s not asking them to help, it’s purely letting the children go up the mountain to suffer and have a long memory.
However, seeing the excited faces of the children, Xu Shiyan suddenly felt that this trick might be useless.
Forget it, since it’s been agreed, don’t care about whether it’s useful or not, let them go up the mountain for a few days and suffer a little.
Just like that, the children from each family, except Xu Haiyuan, all over the age of eight went up the mountain.
Forget about those under the age of eight, they are too young to do anything, and they have to be taken care of.
Huang Shengli and Zhao Jianshe drove, the younger children sat in the driver's seat, and the older children sat in the front car.
Su Anying and Yang Chunming were also sitting in the cart, and had to watch over the children so that nothing would happen to these bratty children.
The site of the machine repair factory is on the road to Quanyang, after passing the Liumaohe work area and walking north for a while.
The ginseng land is not on the side of the road, so you need to walk a long way inside, and there is no road, only the tractor road for harvesting in winter.
Huang Shengli and the others drive a new car that was brought back a while ago, how could they be willing to build it to death?
So they parked the car on the side of the road, and everyone got out of the car and walked inside.
The children each brought dry food and water, got out of the car and walked in together.
Children these days are naughty all the time, they really don’t care about walking this way.
After walking for about half an hour, I finally arrived at the Shendi inside.
Last year, I bought two tractors with a rotary cultivator, which are specially used for tilling the soil.
What about the two thousand feet of ginseng soil, how can it be done in a few days? The tractor and the rotary cultivator cannot run back and forth every day, and they can only be placed on the mountain at night.
At night, someone had to stay and look after them, so Feng Chao, Huang Shengli and others built a shack next to the ginseng ground.
These days, a few people are on duty on the mountain in shifts to guard the tractor and those machines.
This is also the reason why the small house was built so early, mainly to get a place to live, otherwise, who can afford to sleep in a shack all day long?
Looking at the small house on the mountain, of course, it doesn’t have to be built with bricks and tiles like the house at home.
Most of them are smashed and rammed with yellow mud, or nailed up with wooden planks and branches inside, and yellow mud is pasted on the outside.
The small house here also adopts a similar method. A simple house frame is first nailed up with wooden boards and branches, and then yellow mud is pasted on it, and then smoothed.
Of course, this paste yellow mud is not simply smeared with a mud trowel, it will not hang at all.
First mix the loess with pagoda grass or hemp knife, add water, and then grab the yellow mud with your hands and throw it on the frame of the house.
The harder the fall, the stronger the hanging. Wait until the wall is covered with a thick layer of mud, and then smooth it with a mud trowel.
This job sounds interesting and not too difficult, but in fact, it is so exhausting that I will die.
After falling in the mud all day, not to mention the sore arms, there are mud spots from head to toe.
Xu Shiyan asked the children to do this job.
Isn’t it possible to do it? Don't you usually like to play with mud? This time, let you have enough fun, and keep it in the future, so you don’t want to play with mud anymore.
"Yang Jianguo, Han Zhenwen, you two used a guillotine to cut those pagoda grasses section by section.
It must not be too long, so be careful with your hands.
Others, those who should carry the soil should carry the soil, there is a big bubble over there, carry the water, and mix the mud later. "
This mud cannot be cured the first day, or it will harden overnight, and you have to work again.
So most of them wake up in the morning and use it after waking up for a while, which is just right.
Anyway, several parents have discussed it, and this time the children will be harmed, otherwise they will be full of dirt all day long.
Come up to the mountain this time and let them do whatever they want, as long as they do the job well, they will be beaten if they don’t do it well.
Children usually like to poke mud and water, and they just look at it, and no one takes it to heart.
So there was no delay in cutting the grass that should be cut, and those who should lift the soil and water.
Usually, they have seen how the adults in the family get along with each other, so no one is afraid.
Bring back the loess and pile it up, dig a hole in the middle, put the pagoda grass cut into sections on it, and then pour water into the hole.
Soak for a while, and start turning the soil with a shovel.
Let’s work on this, it’s definitely different from doing it yourself.
In the past, adults and mud at home seemed to be quite simple, but in fact, it was not until they did it that they realized that this thing is really not easy.
The water is disobedient. Wherever there is less soil, you will run there. If you don’t pay attention, the water will leak, so quickly find a way to pinch a shovel of soil to block it.
The water was blocked in the east and the west was blocked, and finally the water did not leak out, but it had to be reconciled. During this reconciliation, water was flowing everywhere, and they hurriedly rowed together.
The shovel was stained with muddy water, and it became a lump after a while. The soil was all stuck to the shovel, and it was too old to be lifted.
Oops, everyone stopped laughing now, and quickly thought of a way, find a piece of wood and scrape the shovel to scrape off all the yellow mud, and then stir the pile of mud again.
After a lot of effort, I finally mixed the pile of yellow mud evenly, put it there to wake up for a while, and then the group of children started to play.
There are small rubber buckets specially made on the mountain, and each person fills a bucket of yellow mud and carries it to the base of the wall.
Then I dug a lump of mud out with my hands, and with all my strength, I threw it **** the wall, regardless of where I fell, as long as I fell on it.
"Yes, put in a little more effort and be stronger.
Look at each one of them, they didn’t eat. Just as you fell into the mud, before you wiped the wall, it all fell down.
Work hard, whoever doesn't work hard will not let him eat at noon today. "
Zhao Jianshe took some time to come back and take a look. Seeing that the children fell badly, he even demonstrated and taught them.
"Just do as I do, no one is allowed to be lazy, I see whoever is lazy, just go home and wait to be beaten."

chapters.title: Chapter 487: too tired
chapters.content:
Chapter 487 Too Tired
At the beginning, the children thought it was very fun, and they all thought it was very interesting.
"Haha, Second Sister, your face is full of mud spots."
Yang Haoyu turned his head and saw that Xu Jinping's head and face were covered with mud, he pointed at Xu Jinping and laughed.
"Tch, you are no better than me, your face is like a cat."
Xu Jinping glanced at Yang Haoyu. This kid has all kinds of tricks on his face, and he still talks about others.
Yang Haoyu wiped his face with his sleeve when he heard it.
There are also mud spots on the sleeves of his clothes. It doesn't matter if you wipe it off, there will be more mud on his face.
When the big guys saw it, they all laughed, and Yang Haoyu was not annoyed, so he laughed with everyone.
Enough laughing, let’s continue to work and throw mud on the wall.
But as you keep doing it, it gradually becomes boring. Just wrestling with mud is too boring.
Besides, the arm became sore and sore after a long time, and the children began to play around with their bears, and simply sat on the ground and couldn't rest.
"What are you doing? You can only do more work, so stop? No, hurry up, hurry up."
At the other end, when the adults saw it, they yelled loudly and drove the children to continue working.
This time, the children know how powerful they are.
But all the pirate ships are coming up, so I can’t do without work. So they all got up and continued to throw mud at the wall.
The small ones fall to the lower half, and the tall ones fall to the upper half.
After all, there are more people and more strength. In the whole morning, these children really fell all over the wall.
"Okay, let's go wash your hands and eat, and continue to another wall in the afternoon."
At noon, several adults came back, and seeing the children's virtues, they all held back their embarrassed smiles.
So he urged the children to wash their hands and faces and come back to eat.
It’s very hot in summer. The dry food brought out from home in the morning has not cooled down until noon, and it doesn’t even need to be heated.
Don’t look at the adults saying that they want to teach the children a lesson, but they are still reluctant in their hearts, as you can see from the meals the children brought.
These ones bring either steamed buns or flower rolls, all of which are white noodles.
The family also scrambled eggs, or it was meat or something.
Xu Jinping brought pies, and Zhou Guilan specially baked them for her granddaughter when she got up early in the morning, with minced meat and green onions inside.
The most outrageous thing is Yang Haoyu, Ji Yufeng actually brought him canned luncheon meat and canned fish.
Where are you here to work? This is clearly out for a picnic.
There are delicious foods, which finally heal the young hearts of the children.
The big guys don’t care about that, they put all the dishes they brought together, and whoever likes to eat can eat whatever they like.
Xu Jinping also broke open her own pie and gave it to everyone to taste.
"Well, it's delicious, it's so fragrant."
These children are really tired and hungry all morning, even if they are given a piece of corn flour pancake, they feel old-fashioned.
Not to mention the pie with meat inside, it is simply delicious in the world.
Su Anying and the others couldn't laugh or cry when they saw it. They could see that the children's treatment is high.
"Hurry up and eat. Continue to work after eating. At least two walls must be fixed today." Su Anying said this deliberately.
"Huh? Isn't it? Have to fall out of a wall this afternoon?"
When the children heard this, they all wailed, it was terrible, this job was really tiring.
"What's wrong? Tired?
