Usually, you climb up the house one by one, dig out birds and catch fish without feeling tired, and get injured in fights without pain. It’s only been this morning, are you tired?
Hehe, where is this? There is still life behind.
I have discussed with your mother. From now until the end of the holiday, you will go up to the mountains to work every day, and no one will be left behind. "
Su Anying glanced at the children and sneered.
This group of brats, if you don’t treat them like this, you will go against the sky.
"It's over, this is going to exhaust us." Han Zhenwen and the others also wailed.
In the morning, when they heard that they were coming up the mountain, they thought it was a good thing, so Le Diandian followed. The result? Oh, forget it.
"Huh? No, where is Yuanyuan? Why didn't he come with us?"
It was only now that Han Zhenwen realized that Xu Haiyuan didn't go to work on the mountain.
"My brother studied medicine with Grandpa Chu, he didn't follow us to be naughty.
Yesterday, it was Lihua who went to rescue soldiers, so she called my brother there. "Xu Jinping curled her lips and said aggrievedly.
Knowing that she was going to go up the mountain to be tired, she and Xiaoyu were reading at home, so she didn't want to go out to work with Huang Shuqing and the others.
The key point is that she has finished previewing the lessons of the first semester of the second grade, and she has almost read the books at home.
It's really boring, so I went out to play with my brothers and sisters. Who would have thought that they could fight with others and cause so much trouble?
At this point, it’s too late to say anything, eat obediently, and work honestly.
If they behaved well, perhaps the adults would not bear it in a few days and would spare them.
If you stay lazy and don’t work hard, I’m afraid you’ll have to work for the rest of the holiday.
No, this is absolutely unbearable.
Xu Jinping looked at those adults not paying attention, quietly gathered Huang Shuqing and others together, and whispered to them.
When everyone heard it, it was the same reason.
Come on, now that you’re up the mountain, don’t talk so much, just work with peace of mind, and cry to your grandparents when you turn back.
I don’t believe it anymore, moving out of grandparents, can’t cure parents?
Just like that, the children finished their meal in a hurry, then drank some water, sat and rested anywhere, and then started working again.
In the morning, I used up the mud several times, and it was all used up. In the afternoon, I continued to lift soil and water, and mud.
Not to mention, I have experience in working in the morning, and in the afternoon the mud work is quite good, fast and good.
In the afternoon, the children didn’t say a word, they all worked hard and threw mud.
Zhao Jianshe and the others took the opportunity to take a mud trowel and leveled the wall that the children fell in the morning with yellow mud to make it firm.
It is estimated that I have worked all morning and have experience, and everyone worked smoothly in the afternoon.
At three o'clock, another wall was completely covered with mud, and then Zhao Jianshe and others followed to smooth the wall.
Waiting for the work to be finished, it was almost half past four, Su Anying called the children to wash their hands and faces and prepare to go home.
"Mom, there's no need to wash. If you're late, go home quickly and get some hot water to take a shower at night.
This body of yellow mud, why not wash it well? "Xu Jinping winked at Huang Shuqing and the others, then said.
"That's right, Aunt Xu, we still have a long time to go outside, I'm starving to death, let's go, go home." Huang Shuqing echoed in unison.
Just kidding, can this be washed? I have to keep the evidence so that I can go home and cry with my grandparents. If this is all washed away, what can I do to make my grandparents feel bad?
Su Anying didn't know what the children were thinking. It was indeed getting late, and they still had to go a long way.
"Then don't wash it if you don't wash it, pack up your things and go."
Su Anying waved her hand, telling the children to pack up their things and go home.
Today it was Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli's turn to stay on duty overnight, while Feng Chao and Sun Xiaofeng drove.
So the children took their rice pockets and walked out while humming.
Don’t think it’s not far when you come in, but you’ll be there after a while, and you’ll be tired and uncomfortable when you go out.
Now I feel that the road is too long, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 488: Distressed
chapters.content:
Chapter 488 Distressed
Finally, Bara struggled to get out of the ground and arrived at the place where the car was parked by the side of the road. The children groaned and climbed into the car.
This time, no one sang or laughed, and all of them sat with blank expressions.
After making sure that the children are all seated, the driver in front drives and carries two cars of children back.
More than half an hour later, the car stopped in front of the gate of Xu's house, and Su Anying led Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu out of the car.
"Oh my god, Yingzi, what are you doing with your child?
How did you make your whole body full of mud? Fall into a puddle? "
It’s five o’clock in summer, and it’s quite bright outside. There are several old men and women sitting at the door of the clinic, chatting there.
As soon as they saw Su Anying leading the two muddy children back, those people asked curiously.
"No, I took them up the mountain to work today.
Isn’t there a house built on the mountain? Let them help with plastering the walls with mud. "
Su Anying turned her head, glanced at her daughter and godson, and suddenly felt that something was wrong.
"Oh, look at you, you can really be ruthless.
This good boy, what has happened?
伱 said how good your daughter is at studying, why are you willing to let her go to work in the mountains?
Have more children, you let them clean the walls? "
Sure enough, when the group of old men and women heard it, ouch, it’s terrible, you just started talking about me.
"Isn't it? With the conditions of your family, do you still need your children to work?
Just hire a few people to go up, why can't the house be built? Look at the big market in Xitou, isn't it all finished?
You look at the small house on the mountain, what are you doing with the children at home? "
"I think you are in a hurry, good boy, let's see what you have been tossed about?
Look at that child who is tired and has slumped shoulders. This mother is really cruel. "
There are those sharp-eyed ones who, seeing Xu Jinping's baggy appearance, know that the child is exhausted, so they have to open their mouths to complain about Su Anying.
When Xu Jinping heard this, hey, that's not right, these grandparents can't talk nonsense anymore.
In case her mother gets impatient, the consequences are unpredictable.
"Several grandparents, thank you for your kindness.
That is because we have nothing to do at home, and we always get into trouble when we are idle, so my parents told us to go to the mountains to work.
Schools often encourage us to do more labor practice?
Look, don’t we just take advantage of the holidays to work and exercise? It's fine, we're not tired, really. "
Take care of your own affairs, and don't let outsiders get involved.
These old men and women are too destructive. Once they get involved, good things can turn into bad things.
"Look, how sensible is the child? Yingzi, you two should be content.
The four children are so worry-free, what else do they want?
Look at those brats from other people’s homes, they don’t study well, they come first in class, they know how to play all day long, and they didn’t say that they sent the children to work on the mountain.
It’s fine as long as it’s about the same. How many kids are not mischievous? "
These old men and women didn't seem to understand Xu Jinping's intentions, and they were still talking there.
Xu Jinping saw it, well, it's better not to talk nonsense with them.
Go on, be careful that her mother will become angry and give them a few more days of labor.
"Mom, let's go into the house and see what delicious food my grandma cooks? I'm hungry."
Xu Jinping hurriedly dragged her mother into the hospital, but she didn't dare to let these old men and women talk anymore.
Su Anying was so moved by her daughter's thoughtfulness, look, she must be a caring little padded jacket, who knows how to protect her mother outside.
"Why don't you stop working tomorrow?"
Mother is always soft-hearted. The disgraceful appearance of my daughter and Ganer this day is not in a good shape. How could Su Anying not feel distressed?
When those old men and women accused her just now, Su Anying became angry. She really wanted to say, I can take care of our children as I like.
Let’s not talk about today, the day after tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, these brats will have to go to work in the mountains.
But when the girl protected her and helped her speak, Su Anying couldn't bear it immediately.
Yes, isn't it normal for a child who is only eight years old to be playful and mischievous? Why do you have the same knowledge as children?
Unbearable, the words came out of the mouth.
"Mom, don't listen to the nonsense of those grandparents, we are all happy to help the family with work."
At this time, you can’t just climb the pole directly, that’s not okay, you must let the adults know, they are very happy to help the family share the burden.
"Yes, yes, godmother, we are not tired, today is actually quite fun.
Anyway, we are idle, leaving home and causing trouble, so it’s good to go to the mountains to work. "
Yang Haoyu has been with Xu Jinping since he was a child, and the two have a perfect understanding.
As soon as Xu Jinping said something, Yang Haoyu immediately understood, so he continued to follow Xu Jinping's words.
Sure enough, after saying this, Su Anying regretted it even more.
Why did she promise her man last night that she had to punish the child on the mountain?
His family’s children are so obedient and sensible. In normal days, they help the family to cook, cook and coax the children. They never let their husband and wife worry about it.
Then get naughty once in a while, fight once in a while, what about these grown-ups? What do you care about with your child?
Su Anying was about to speak when Zhou Guilan came out of the room and saw the two mud monkeys at a glance.
"Oh my god, how did this make the two children like this?
Hurry up, hurry up, there is hot water in the room, you two should wash your hands and face first. "
Zhou Guilan didn't even look at Su Anying, so she quickly found a hand towel and helped the two children pat the dirt off their bodies.
Then fetched water again, let the two children wash their hands and faces, and then let them go into the house to rest.
Over there, Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai also saw that the children were so virtuous, and the two old men didn't say anything, they just shook their heads and sighed.
I can't talk to Su Anying about this matter, but I have to talk to Xu Shiyan.
Coincidentally, Xu Shiyan was off work at this moment, rode a motorcycle to the door of the house, took the car, and went straight into the hospital.
"Shi Yan, come, come, I have something to tell you."
Chu Xuanhuai waved to Xu Shiyan and asked him to go to the clinic to talk.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, why did he feel that the faces of his father and master were not quite right?
He didn't think about anything else, and followed his father and master into the room of the clinic.
"You bastard, you are capable now, right? Do what you can. Why are you tossing my granddaughter when you're free?"
I don't want Xu Chenghou to swear at people as soon as he enters the house.
"Look at what that child made, what is it like? Why do you think you have the heart?"
When I saw the appearance of my granddaughter and god-grandson just now, I didn't feel sorry for Xu Chenghou to death.
At any rate, he has been able to bear it more than before in recent years. He got angry without Zhou Guilan, Su Anying, or the children. This is already an embarrassment for Xu Shiyan.
If this had been left in the past, Xu Chenghou wouldn't have cared about that, he would curse at people as long as he could stand in the yard.
At this moment Xu Shiyan entered the room, and there was no one else in the room except Chu Xuanhuai, so Xu Chenghou couldn't bear it anymore, so he scolded directly.
This bad idea must have come from Xu Shiyan, who else would you blame?

chapters.title: Chapter 489: sensible
chapters.content:
Chapter 489 Sensible
"Father, this is my idea.
It's also those children who have been making too much trouble recently, so I have to let them know that life is not easy. "
Xu Shiyan had just entered the door, but he didn't see his daughter's embarrassed appearance, so he was speaking quite forcefully at the moment.
"What do these little brats know?
There is nothing lacking at home, they eat and drink all day long, and they don’t need to do anything, just make trouble all day long.
Dad, do you remember what we did when we were kids? When we were their age, we could do everything.
Get up in the morning and shovel the ground to weed the grass, and then go to school after work.
Catching up with the weekend in autumn, my brothers and I went up the mountain to hunt pine cones. It took us a day to go back and forth for fifty miles. At night, each of us came back with a basket of pine cones.
The bark of the second brother let the bark open at once, wrapped a handkerchief, and climbed up to hit the pine cone as usual.
Later, the second brother couldn't hold on anymore, so I climbed up.
When I was young, I couldn’t climb up with shoes on. I was barefoot. After I went up and shot the pine cone, I came down with blood on my feet and my belly was worn out. "
At that time, pine nuts were more than four cents a catty, and their brothers could sell more than one hundred for just cracking pine nuts in autumn.
What year and month was that? In the past six or so years, more than one hundred yuan was a big deal.
"Now these children, what do they know? They don't have to worry about eating and drinking now, and there is not even a patch on their clothes.
Did they wear open-toed shoes? There is only a little bit of connection between the upper and the sole, and they keep opening their mouths as they walk. Have they seen it?
The clothes are patch upon patch, a pair of single pants are worn until the snow falls, shivering all day long, have they experienced it? "
"These children have never suffered or suffered. They only know that their parents are capable of making money, and their lives are better than others.
Father, aren't you afraid that these brats will develop bad habits and idle around all day long?
Don’t say that the whole family is like that, as long as there is one, no matter how big the family business is, it is not enough for him to lose. "
Xu Shiyan is really not afraid of his father now.
Some things must be persisted. This is a matter of principle, and there must be no compromise.
"What? You mean me, right?
伱You bastard, I am your father, you are capable now, your wings are stiff, you dare to call me, don’t you? "
Xu Chenghou poked his lung tube when he heard what his son said later.
Wasn’t he like this back then? If it weren't for him, how could the Xu family's life be so ruined? This time, the old man was very angry.
"Brother, calm down, let me tell him."
When Chu Xuanhuai saw Xu Chenghou like this, he was afraid that he would lose control, so he jumped up and slapped Xu Shiyan twice.
Chu Xuanhuai hurriedly held Xu Chenghou down, patted him on the shoulder, and then turned to look at Xu Shiyan.
"Shiyan, you want to exercise your children and let them understand the hard work of adults. Your father and I understand this, and we can't say no.
Last night you said you were letting the children go to work, and we didn't object. "
"But you have to understand that the times are different, you can't compare your childhood with the children.
If this is the case, when I was your age, we were still fighting wars, fighting in the hail of bullets all day long, and even if we didn’t pay attention, our lives would be lost.
Then can you compare with me? can't you? "
Chu Xuanhuai's words were a bit domineering, and Xu Shiyan didn't know how to answer for a while.
Chu Xuanhuai glanced at Xu Shiyan and sighed.
"You want your children to know that life is not easy and that adults are hard-working. I have no objection to this.
I told Yuanyuan today that I will let him go to work on the mountain tomorrow to experience it. Everyone else has gone up the mountain, so he can't be special.
But you can’t bear them so much, after all, they are still children, the oldest is only eleven or twelve, and the youngest is only eight years old.
How capable are they, you let them muddy the house? Isn't that nonsense?
Even if you want to exercise them, at least find some brisk ones first?
This day made the children look ashamed, and Pingping walked with a limp and her shoulders were slumped.
How tired is the child? Don't you feel bad? "
In Chu Xuanhuai's eyes, these children are all pimples. Seeing the children suffering and suffering is even more uncomfortable than Chu Xuanhuai himself.
"Huh? Can't you? Is the child really tired like that?"
Oops, Xu Shiyan couldn't stand it anymore after hearing that his daughter and godson were exhausted to such a virtue.
"Father, Master, you two sit down first, I'll go back and see the child."
Who's child doesn't feel distressed, it's all heart and soul, Xu Shiyan jumped out of the clinic in a few steps, and went straight to the landlord's room.
Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai looked at each other and snorted.
"Let's go, let's go too, look at this bastard, how will he go down next?"
On the first day, the children were so tired that they wanted to drag the cat's tail onto the kang. Tonight, every household kept keeping them.
Just watch and see how they finish.
Xu Shiyan came to the east room. At this time, Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu had washed their hands and faces, but they didn't change their clothes.
The two children are really tired, and they don’t like to move when they sit there. Even the cartoons they love to watch on weekdays can’t attract them anymore.
If they hadn’t eaten and were hungry, they would probably have fallen asleep sitting there.
Xu Shiyan felt very distressed when he saw the appearance of the two children.
These children have suffered and suffered so much on weekdays, but now they are all wilted.
"Pingping, Xiaoyu, aren't you very tired after a day's work?"
Xu Shiyan came to sit down in front of his daughter and godson, and asked softly.
"Dad, we're okay, but we're not too tired."
Xu Jinping was so tired that she could hardly lift her arms, and she was still talking hard.
"Dad, I understand this time, it turns out that Mom and Dad are working so hard.
From now on, I won’t be naughty anymore. I will study hard. In the future, I will do as long as my father orders me to do any work at home. "
Little girl's words are not deceiving, they come from the heart.
They only work for one day, where are the parents? I have been doing this for years and months, but I have never heard my parents complain about being tired.
Mom and Dad are the hardest, they are nothing.
The more the girl said that, the more Xu Shiyan couldn't bear it, but the water that was spilled by what was said could not be taken back casually.
It was he who came up with the idea of ​​letting the children exercise hard, and he regretted it after only one day, so what can I do?
"Daughter-in-law, should the ginseng field at the other end of the Liumao River be weeded?
Otherwise, why don’t you take them to pull weeds tomorrow? "
Well, there is really no way, let's find an easier job for the children.
At this time, weeding is easy, just remove the grass on the surface of the pool, no need to loosen the soil, this should not be difficult for children.
Of course, being tired must be tiring, at least it is easier than today.
When Su Anying heard this, what else did she not understand?
The man in his family has softened his heart, and he can't directly say that the children are not allowed to go up the mountain to work, because he is looking for a step down.
Weeding is fine too, it’s easier than plastering walls with live yellow mud.
"Well, shouldn't it be weeding? Then I will take them to weeding tomorrow."
Su Anying followed Xu Shiyan's words and continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 490: Rapier goes up the mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 490 Lappy Ghost Up the Mountain
Over there, Zhou Guilan hurriedly packed the food.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu, who were tired and hungry that day, couldn't care less, and ate their meals hungrily.
I always looked at Xu Haiqing as a fool, usually the third brother eats slowly, but what happened today, he ate faster than him?
"Xiaoyu, Pingping, is it fun to go up the mountain today?" Xu Haiyuan looked at his younger siblings with a thoughtful expression.
"It's fun, it's interesting. Brother, it's a shame you didn't go up the mountain, really."
Xu Jinping rolled her eyes and laughed.
"Xiaoyu, am I right?" After finishing speaking, he didn't forget to pull in someone to add some persuasiveness.
"Well, it's quite interesting."
Yang Haoyu glanced at Xu Haiyuan, coughed softly, then lowered his head and pulled the last bit of rice in the bowl into his mouth.
"Grandma, godmother, I'm full."
Yang Junxian had made an agreement with Xu Shiyan before, let Yang Haoyu live in Xu's house these few days.
So after dinner, Su Anying led the children home, and boiled hot water for Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu to wash their bodies.
As a result, Xu Jinping fell asleep in the bathtub after washing.
Thanks to Su Anying hearing something wrong, she fished out the child in time, wiped it dry and carried her back to bed.
Yang Haoyu didn't feel much better, he was so sleepy after barely taking a bath, and before 7:30, both of them slept like little pigs.
The next morning, neither of them got up to exercise.
It wasn't until six o'clock, when Xu Haiyuan came back from training, and Han Zhenwen and the others came together, that Xu Jinping and his siblings quarreled.
"Hurry up and eat, our mother said that we will go up the mountain to weed today.
Our grandfather and master are going together, hurry up. "
Needless to say, it must be that Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai were worried about the children, for fear that Su Anying and the others would cause problems for the children again.
So they decided to follow up the mountain, and they were relieved to see it with their own eyes.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu hurried out of bed, dressed, washed and ate.
After eating, the car outside had already arrived, and the children packed up their things and ran outside.
As a result, the rascal ghost didn't know what was going on, and jumped up with the children, and it jumped into the car.
"Laipi ghost, we are going to work in the mountains, you can't follow, what if you lose it?"
Xu Jinping saw that Lai Pigui had also gotten into the car, and hurriedly wanted to hug him, but Lai Pigui hugged Xu Jinping's leg tightly and didn't let go.
Xu Jinping had no choice but to call someone. "Father, Lai Pigui has to follow up the mountain."
Xu Shiyan hadn't gone to work yet, so he came over as soon as he heard his daughter calling.
Looking at Raipi Gui's posture again, okay, this is completely cheating.
"Forget it, take it with you, it hasn't been up the mountain to play for a long time.
There is a small broken pine forest near us, it may be tired of playing. "
Since Lai Pigui came to Xu's house, he seldom goes too far, at most he doesn't come back for two or three days.
Xu Shiyan felt that this guy was probably tired of wandering around, so he wanted to go out to play with him.
I don’t know if the rascal can really understand Xu Shiyan’s words, or it’s just a coincidence.
At this moment, Lai Pigui let go of Xu Jinping, started to circle around her, and made a buzzing sound again.
"Naughty and mischievous all day, I can warn you, don't run around when you go up the mountain, too far away, if you get lost, we can't find you."
Xu Haiyuan glared at Laipi Gui, warning it.
Lai Pigui hurried to Xu Haiyuan's side, swiped Xu Haiyuan twice with his big tail, and then made a buzzing sound, just like acting like a spoiled child.
Xu Haiyuan was completely speechless by the rascal, and could only rub the rascal's hair twice vigorously.
"Being coquettish, thanks to the fact that you're still a man, don't you think it's embarrassing to be humming all day long?"
How can the rascal understand this? Instead, he lay on his back in the bucket of the cart, allowing Xu Haiyuan to rub it.
Seeing this, the other children also came to tease Laipigui.
Over there, Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Chenghou also changed into old clothes and sat in the driving building respectively.
The two of them are still going up the mountain at this age, so of course they have to be more careful, how dare they let them ride in the car.
"Master, Dad, don't go up if you want me to tell you, the children are going to weed today, it's fine."
Xu Shiyan was speechless. Isn't it a little too much for these two old men to spoil their children?
how? These dear parents, can they still abuse their children? Do the two old men have to follow up the mountain and watch with their own eyes?
"Stop talking nonsense, the two of us are bored at home all day, can't we go up the mountain to have a look?
You have made tens of thousands of feet of sticks, I haven't seen it yet, let me go and see what it can do? "Xu Chenghou naturally refused to admit that he went up the mountain for the children, he only said that he was going to see the ginseng land and see his stick.
"I want to take Yuanyuan to the mountains and let him recognize the herbs.
It’s not enough to learn it at home, because there is a lot of knowledge in the herbal medicine. If the child doesn’t even know how to distinguish the herbal medicine, how can he prescribe the medicine? "
Chu Xuanhuai's excuse is more justified.
The great forest of Changbai Mountain is a huge treasure house, containing countless precious herbs. Is it wrong for him to take the child to recognize the herbs?
Yes, these two stubborn old men are more difficult to deal with than the other.
Xu Shiyan stopped persuading, and only told Su Anying and the others to take good care of the children and the elderly.
There are obviously fewer children going up the mountain today than yesterday.
Zhao Jianshe's daughters Zhao Tingting and Zhao Lili, Huang Shengli's daughter Huang Shuyun, youngest son Huang Shuping, Sun Xiaofeng's son Sun Ning, Feng Chao's son Feng Bin, none of these children came.
Don't even have to think about it, this must be the virtue that the children made when they went home yesterday, the family couldn't stand it anymore, so they simply left the girl and the younger ones behind.
Now only Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu, Huang Shuqing, Sun Yu, Yang Jianguo, Yang Jianjun, and three boys from the Han family can be placed.
Actually, Su Anying really wanted Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu to stay as well. They are not very big, and they were already exhausted yesterday, so it's better to rest at home.
However, Xu Jinping refused. She spoke so beautifully yesterday, how could she not go up the mountain today?
Besides, isn’t today weeding? I'm not that tired, why not go?
Just like that, the children sat firmly, and the driver in front started the car and went straight to the Liumao River Ginseng Field.
The Liumao River ginseng land is closer than the machine repair shop yesterday, and it is also closer to the roadside. Get off the car and walk a short distance to the place.
Zhao Jianshe's elder brother, Zhao Jianguo, led five or six blind wanderers on the mountain to visit.
The four dogs of the Xu family are also on the mountain, just guarding the gate.
Although it has been a long time since I saw Xu Chenghou and the children, Xiao Huang and the others can still recognize them.
As soon as they saw Xu Chenghou and Xu Haiyuan approaching, they immediately choked up, and the wagging tail caught up with the installation of an engine.
Before Xu Chenghou and the children came to the front, Lai Pigui jumped up first.
As a result, when the dogs saw the rascal, they immediately turned around and burrowed into the den.
No way, they have been smoked by rascals since they were young, and they already have psychological shadows.
So even though they are all big now, and have killed many prey, as long as they see raspy ghosts, they will be scared.

chapters.title: Chapter 491: Ginseng weeding
chapters.content:
Chapter 491 Ginseng Weeding
Zhao Jianguo took five or six people to see ginseng at the Liumao River ginseng site.
Hearing the movement, Zhao Jianguo thought that there was a householder coming to work, so he hurried out to check, only to see Xu Chenghou and others.
"Uncle Xu, why did you come to the mountain? Hey, why did you bring the children here?"
Zhao Jianguo looked puzzled, what are these children doing up the mountain?
Su Anying came from behind.
"Brother Jianguo, what's the matter, shouldn't our ginseng land be weeded? You guys are too busy, and it happens that the children are on vacation and let them come up to help with work."
Zhao Jianguo thought to himself, where is this going? The work on the mountain is all contracted to them, and it's not said that they can't do it.
Why did this bring the children here again?
But since the boss said so, Zhao Jianguo couldn't object, so he could only follow along.
"Oh, yes, I've been very busy these days, and there's a lot of grass growing in that three-flowered bunch."
Sanhua means that the seeds were sown last year, and the seedlings emerged this year, with only one leaflet divided into three petals, so it is called Sanhua.
"Okay, then I will lead them there, you can do whatever you need to do, don't worry about this side."
Su Anying nodded, and led the children into the arena.
Fifty thousand feet across the ground, the boss is all alone, the children walked for a long time, and finally arrived at the place.
"This piece is our own.
伱 The two of us face each other in a group, kneel on the pool surface, and just pull off the grass on the surface of the pool.
But don’t squeeze the mallet seedlings. Come, come here, I will teach you. "
Su Anying led the children to Chi Chuan, and taught them to identify what is grass and what is ginseng seedlings.
They are all children from Shenxiang, and they know a little bit. As soon as Su Anying said it, everyone understood.
So the two of them started weeding with a pool skewer on their heads.
This piece of ginseng seeds was planted by Su Anying, Huang Shengli and others in cooperation. Last year, the seeds were sown on demand.
Not to mention, the emergence rate is quite high, and the spacing between rows is the same, which is very neat.
It is not difficult to weed the weeds like this, as long as the ginseng seedlings are avoided and the weeds are pulled up.
Besides, Sanhua is small, so you can see everything on Chimian at a glance, and you can't hide things.
The newly planted one will not work, the mallet seedlings grow tall and dense, and sometimes there will be snakes hidden in them.
Snakes in the Northeast are less poisonous, but if children encounter them, they can be frightened.
For the sake of safety, they were arranged on the side of Sanhua.
Of course, the ginseng field work is not easy to do. The ginseng shed is on the top and the ginseng soil is on the bottom. People have to kneel on the side of the pool and crawl under the ginseng shed to work.
In summer, the temperature in the ginseng shed is so high that it’s so hot that when I kneel there to pluck the grass for a while, I get sweaty due to the heat.
"Okay, hurry up and go over there and do some work, I'm watching over here."
Su Anying guided the children for a while and taught them everything. Xu Chenghou on the other end waved his hand and let Su Anying go.
Su Anying also couldn't laugh or cry, did this old man drive her away on purpose?
Keep her out, and the children can do whatever they want. They can work as they like, and if they don’t like to work, they can play for a while.
Forget it, originally I didn’t point them to serve food, but I just fooled them for a few days to let them know that the work is not easy, so I will stop being naughty in the future, and do as much as I can.
Just like that, Su Anying told her daughter and son to pay attention to safety and not to run around.
There are ground guns and cannons around this place, as well as various traps and so on. A bad mess can hurt people.
"Okay, okay, I'm here with Old Chu, what are you afraid of?
Hurry up, isn't this end far from the machine repair shop? "
Xu Chenghou waved his hands impatiently, and pushed Su Anying away.
What can Su Anying say? He could only leave with a wry smile.
There is nothing serious here, she has to go to look at the Xinshen land, and the other side has to take advantage of the good weather to quickly turn the land up.
In a few days, someone will come up to dump the soil. Before the last autumn, the ginseng soil must be finished and handed over, so that the final payment can be made.
As soon as Su Anying walked away, Xu Chenghou yelled, "Children, don't work too hard, take your time.
If anyone is tired, sit down and rest for a while. "
The old man almost shouted directly, stop doing it, and play with me.
Those who can still work in the mountains today are not ordinary children, at least they are all grown up and sensible.
Although Xu Chenghou said so, the children did not indulge themselves, they still knelt on the pool gang, weeding the weeds with peace of mind.
Compared to yesterday and muddying the wall, weeding is simply too easy, and it can be done by playing.
Now that I have come to the mountain, I have to persevere.
Xu Chenghou and Mr. Chu looked at each other and smiled, "Let's go, find a cool place to sit for a while.
They are still fresh, and when the freshness wears off, they should be tired of playing bears. "
Xu Chenghou had seen through these brats a long time ago, so he and Mr. Chu found a shady place to sit and rest on top of Chi Chuan.
Since Lai Pigui entered the arena, he ran away without a trace.
Xu Chenghou wasn't worried either, the fox was so close to talking, he was smarter than humans, so he was definitely fine.
Xu Chenghou went up the mountain with Chu Xuanhuai and led a group of children, can Zhao Jianguo rest assured?
Simply take people with you today and work around here.
Zhao Jianguo also specially boiled two pots of boiling water, carried them to the ground and put them on the ground. When the children were thirsty, they would come and drink.
"Uncle Xu, Uncle Chu, the two elders are resting here, if you have something to say, I will come over."
"Success, go to work, it's okay." Xu Chenghou waved his hand, telling Zhao Jianguo what to do.
The children went under the ginseng shed to pull weeds, while Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai took a rest under the tree to enjoy the shade.
They arrived on the mountain early and started working at 7:30. By 9:00, the children were a little tired. One said they were thirsty and the other said they were hungry.
"Come, come, come here, it's cool here, come and rest for a while before working."
Xu Chenghou saw that his granddaughter was sitting on the side of the pool, resting there leaning against the foot of the pillar, and knew that the child was tired, so he hurriedly called the children to come and rest.
Even though it was only nine o'clock, the sun was shining on the plastic sheeting, and it was quite hot inside the shed.
The children were all sweating, and when they heard Xu Chenghou calling them, they all came out to drink water and rest.
The water in the kettle was no longer that hot, it was still warm, and there were several white porcelain bowls with blue borders beside it.
Xu Chenghou carried a jug, poured water for the children, and came to drink water one by one.
"Are you tired? Take a break when you're tired. Don't worry, take your time."
The old man looked at the children lovingly, and persuaded them gently.
Zhao Jianguo, who was working not far away, couldn't help shaking his head when he heard this.
This old man, his heart is on his ribs, right?
When I was in the big house, I don’t know how many times I was scolded by the old man because of Xu Shiyan’s slow work.
If you change to grandson, don't you worry?
Zhao Jianguo could only say this in his heart, but he didn't dare to say it.
And on the ground, the children drank water now, their little faces were flushed, and they found a place to sit and rest.
Suddenly, a shadow flew towards Xu Haiyuan, and jumped right in front of Xu Haiyuan, biting Xu Haiyuan's trouser leg and pulling.
"What are you doing, rascal? Don't tear my pants apart."

chapters.title: Chapter 492: wooden club
chapters.content:
Chapter 492 The mallet
Lai Pigui suddenly ran back, biting Xu Haiyuan's trouser leg and not letting go.
Everyone was taken aback, not knowing what this meant.
"Brother, did the rascal discover something and want you to go and see it?" Xu Jinping looked at the fox and said suddenly.
"Huh? It's possible." Xu Haiyuan also understood, this guy seemed to want to tell him something.
"Grandpa, can we go out with the rascal?" Xu Haiyuan asked Xu Chenghou.
Xu Chenghou also noticed that there seemed to be something wrong with this rascal.
"You alone can't do it, how about this, I'll be with you."
Xu Chenghou is only in his sixties, and he has a good physique, and he doesn't hesitate to walk through the forest.
"Old Chu, you can stay here and watch these children.
I didn’t know what was there, so I led Yuanyuan and the others over to have a look. "
It is not easy to walk in the woods. Mosquitoes, blind midges, and small planing adzes are quite thick, wandering around people, and children must not go.
Xu Chenghou couldn't take care of it alone, he was afraid of danger, so he planned to take Xu Haiyuan to have a look.
"Grandpa Xu, let's go with you."
Han Zhenwen, Yang Jianguo, and Huang Shuqing are older and sensible. They are worried and have to follow.
Xu Chenghou nodded without objecting.
"Let's go, let's follow the rascal to see what it found." After speaking, he stood up and was about to lead the child away.
"Old Xu, wait a moment, take this with you.
If there are too many mosquitoes in the woods, let the children light this thing and hold it in their hands. "
Chu Xuanhuai spoke suddenly, called to Xu Chenghou, and then took out a few sticks of incense from the pocket he brought.
That is the incense specially prepared by Chu Xuanhuai, which is very effective in killing insects. If you light one at home at night, all the mosquitoes will be smoked to death.
There is a lot of space on the mountain, and the effect may not be as good as at home. It can't kill the bugs, but it can smoke them away.
Xu Chenghou recognized the thing, so he took it and let the children hold it.
He is an old man, and he has been smoking all year round. His flesh is completely smothered by cigarette oil, and most mosquitoes will not hesitate to bite him.
Children are not good, they are all delicate and tender, and they are the most vulnerable to mosquitoes, blindness and so on.
Give it to them, and if they feel unbearable, light the smoked mosquitoes.
"Jianguo, I'm holding a dog and a gun."
Xu Chenghou didn't dare to be careless, he yelled at Zhao Jianguo, and then led the children to the small room near the gate of the venue.
Untied Xiaohuang and Erhei by the rope, and went into the room and took the gun from the wall.
Xu Chenghou has been watching ginseng on the mountain for several years, and he can also use guns. If there are dogs and guns, even if something happens, don’t be afraid.
Just like that, Xu Chenghou led four boys and two dogs, followed Laipigui, out of the gate of the venue, and walked eastward.
This ginseng land is in Daoxi, and there is a river in the south of the ginseng land, which is the Liumao River.
Lai Pigui led them across the passage, walked along a small hairy road opposite, walked for a while, and turned north again.
At this time, there is no road, and the only way is to pass through the forest.
Turning around, I came to a hillside with lush vegetation and leeward to the sun.
Lai Pigui stopped, bit Xu Haiyuan's trouser leg and walked forward.
It didn't let go until it was in front of an old pine tree, and moved its big tail not far ahead.
"Yuanyuan, there are old signs here."
Xu Chenghou has lived in the Northeast for so many years after all, and he still has some experience. He can see at a glance that the old pine tree is different from ordinary pine trees.
On a tree trunk about one person above the ground, a piece of bark was stripped off, and a mark was cut on it with an axe.
Needless to say, this is a sign that the people who released the mountain back then chopped it down.
There is a sign, which proves that wild ginseng has come out of this area.
Xu Chenghou was not as proficient in these things as Xu Shiyan, but he could understand it somewhat, so he went forward to see the omen.
As a result, Han Zhenwen stepped forward faster than Xu Chenghou, touched the omen and said, "It's said above, five people entered the mountain at the beginning and got a tree of six leaves."
The Han family, that’s called family history, Xu Shiyan was taught by Han Wenzhong.
Not to mention that Han Zhenwen is the grandson of Han's parents, so this housekeeping ability, so why not teach it all?
So, Han Zhenwen understands better than Xu Chenghou.
Han Zhenwen waved and asked Xu Haiyuan to come over.
"Come on, come here, come with me, let's kowtow to this old omen, let the old Fangshan people bless us, we can meet a big guy today."
Han Zhenwen was very familiar with these rules, so he dragged Xu Haiyuan, Huang Shuqing, and Yang Jianguo to their knees.
The four brothers sincerely kowtowed to the old omen, and then got up.
"Just look around this circle, I guess it won't be too far away.
But the mallet seeds haven't turned red at this time, and the Green Hammer City is not easy to find, so be careful. "
Han Zhenwen gave Xu Haiyuan and Huang Shuqing instructions as if holding his head.
Xu Haiyuan, Huang Shuqing, and Yang Jianguo have never been in the mountains before, and they don't know much about it. Where can I find this thing?
Worried about it, Lai Pigui came to bite Xu Haiyuan's pants again.
Xu Haiyuan's heart skipped a beat, this old omen was met by the rambunctious ghost, did it also see the wild ginseng?
"Let's go, lead the way." Xu Haiyuan patted Lai Pigui's head and asked Lai Pigui to guide him to find the stick.
This time, Rapier wasn't as happy as before.
Instead, he took Xu Haiyuan a few steps forward cautiously, and then bared his teeth at a bunch of wormwood in front of him, making a sound like a warning.
Xu Haiyuan looked in the direction where the rascal was baring his teeth. In that cluster of wormwood, there seemed to be a cluster of half-green and half-red things, like the fruit of something.
Looking down the fruit, you can vaguely see the purple stems, as if there are a few palm-shaped leaves underneath.
At any rate, he is also a child living in Linhai, Shenxiang, and he heard Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong talk about releasing the mountain.
Xu Haiyuan immediately realized that the plant with a cluster of fruit in front should be an old mountain ginseng.
"Balm." Xu Haiyuan shouted.
Xu Chenghou, Han Zhenwen and others who were looking around over there were all refreshed when they heard this, and hurriedly picked up the mountain. "What goods?"
Xu Haiyuan wanted to get closer to see how many leaves it was, but at this moment, Lai Pigui was biting his trouser legs, not allowing him to go forward.
Xu Haiyuan had no choice but to reply, "Big goods."
I don't know how many leaves there are, but the cluster of fruits at the top probably won't be too small, that's why Xu Haiyuan said so.
"Quickly, quickly, take it."
Han Zhenwen picked it up very smoothly. While talking, the person also walked over quickly.
As a result, as soon as he got to the front, he saw Lai Pigui baring his teeth in that direction again and making a whining sound.
Han Zhenwen immediately sensed something was wrong, "Wait a minute, let's not move forward."
While speaking, he stretched out his hand and stopped Huang Shuqing and Yang Jianguo who were about to move forward.
"There may be something in front of this, don't worry, let's take a look."
While Han Zhenwen was speaking, a pretty bird hovered in mid-air for a few times.
Probably saw the ginseng fruit below, and flew to the ginseng fruit chirping, wanting to peck at the ginseng seeds.
Suddenly, a black shadow flashed, and the bird disappeared immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 493: Spirit snake protection ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 493 Spirit Snake Protector
The bird that was chirping just now disappeared in an instant.
Where did the bird go? Xu Haiyuan and Han Zhenwen were shocked, what's going on?
At this time, Xu Chenghou also came over. He was not far away and saw that scene just now.
"Stand back, stay a little farther away."
Xu Chenghou directly took off the gun and raised it, telling the children to get behind him.
The children backed away as promised, straight to Xu Chenghou's side, still staring at the half-green and half-red ginseng seed.
And at this moment, a chipmunk rushed over from the nearby tree.
Probably also saw the ginseng seed, hovering nearby.
I saw the chipmunk nimbly climbing up a small tree as thick as an egg next to the ginseng.
When it climbed to the height of a ginseng hammer, the two claws on the back grabbed the small tree and leaned out to eat ginseng seeds.
Suddenly, the black shadow struck again like lightning, and the chipmunk squeaked, and immediately disappeared.
The birds and chipmunks disappeared one after another, leaving Xu Chenghou and the others dumbfounded, but at this moment, the rascal raised his head and bared his teeth in the air.
Xu Haiyuan looked in the direction where Lai Pigui bared his teeth, whoops, a "trunk" as thick as an arm can move.
"It's a string of money, so big."
Xu Haiyuan looked carefully, and finally realized that it was a big snake.
Half of the body is coiled on the big branch above the ginseng, and the half of the body sticks out like a dead branch, which is difficult to be found.
When a small animal such as a bird or a chipmunk wants to eat ginseng seeds, it will launch a surprise attack and eat the small animal directly.
This is what the mountain people often say, the story of the spirit snake protecting ginseng.
In fact, the snake is not to protect the ginseng, but to wait for the opportunity to prey on the birds and small animals that come to devour the ginseng seeds.
It is estimated that Lai Pigui discovered the snake just now, so he bared his teeth to warn.
However, at this moment, Xu Chenghou and the others were in a difficult situation. They couldn't take the mallet right in front of them.
The snake was entangled in the tree and refused to leave. Xu Chenghou and his four children dared not act rashly.
If it is not done well, the children will be hurt.
If that's the case, it's better not to use this ginseng.
Xu Chenghou was in a dilemma, he didn't know what to do, don't want this ginseng, and take the children out?
It seems a little reconciled, that ginseng tree seems to be quite big, if it doesn't make trouble, it will be a treasure.
They are not short of money now, but old wild ginseng is getting less and less, and they are all of great use. It is good to save them for Chu Xuanhuai to make medicine.
"Brother Jianguo, Brother Shuqing, you two go back with Lai Pigui, come with my master and Uncle Zhao.
I reckon that Uncle Zhao has something to put on the mountain, so let him bring it with him. Don't yell loudly, talk to them in a low voice. "
Xu Haiyuan was clever and immediately thought of an idea.
Lai Pigui knows the way, let it lead, Yang Jianguo and Huang Shuqing will not get lost.
Go back and bring in rescuers. If there are more people, it will be easier to handle. This snake can scare it away no matter what.
"Yes, yes, the two of you will go find someone to rescue the soldiers." Xu Chenghou was right when he heard it, and the grandson's arrangement was quite reasonable.
Not to mention, the rascal is really clever.
Xu Haiyuan only patted it on the head and told it to lead the way to find someone, but the rascal turned around and ran away.
Huang Shuqing and Yang Jianguo hurriedly followed and ran back.
Here, Xu Chenghou protected the two children and took a few steps back, putting away the gun.
Guns are useless against snakes. Xu Chenghou's marksmanship doesn't dare to say that a single shot can blow the snake's head off.
So I simply put it away, took out the pipe and pot from my pocket, put a bag of cigarettes on it, and started smoking.
Xu Chenghou smoked heavily on purpose, blowing the smoke in the direction of the snake on purpose.
Sure enough, the big snake that stretched its body just now and threatened people with a message, after taking a few puffs of smoke, retracted its body and coiled itself on the tree.
I can see it, it is a little afraid of smoke, but it is not reconciled, so it doesn't want to go.
Xu Chenghou wasn't in a hurry, as long as the snake didn't move and didn't attack the child.
Just like that, a snake was on the tree, and a child and a child were on the ground, forming a confrontational situation, and no one would give way.
There are a lot of mosquitoes in this forest. If a person moves, he is almost bitten. If a person stops, it will really be black and straight up.
Xu Haiyuan remembered the incense his master had given him, so he quickly took it out and lit it.
Cigarettes curled up, with a little medicinal and floral fragrance, lingering around the three of them.
It's also strange, those mosquitoes flew away as if they had met their nemesis.
A gust of wind blew by, and the cigarette drifted along the wind towards the big snake on the tree.
I don’t know if the snake was incensed or what happened, but it stopped coiling on the tree, and slid down the big tree in a flash, disappearing in an instant.
Xu Chenghou breathed a sigh of relief, who would have thought that the incense given by Chu Xuanhuai could scare the snake away.
However, they didn't dare to be careless, for fear that the snake was still hiding in the nearby grass.
Xu Chenghou hurried to get some branches, repaired a few times to make a stick, and got some cigarette oil from the pipe pot, and rubbed it on the top of the stick.
Then he took the stick and beat the surrounding grass and tree trunks.
After beating for a long time, but he didn't see the shadow of the big snake again, Xu Chenghou felt relieved and came to the clump of wormwood.
In fact, ginseng is not as unique as it is said in the legend. It is not the case that there is no grass around the big stick.
Xu Chenghou pushed the grass aside to reveal the ginseng tree in the middle, and carefully counted the leaves below, and it turned out that there were six leaves.
In other words, they met a six-leaf tree.
"This rambunctious ghost is really good. It can still find sticks. If we take it back into the mountains, can we make a fortune just by digging sticks?"
Xu Chenghou really didn’t let go of the mountain, and besides, he came to watch the children work today, so he didn’t expect to meet the mountain ginseng, so he didn’t prepare any hammer lock at all. What should I do?
Han Zhenwen was clever enough, and suddenly remembered that the belt around his waist was red.
Han Zhenwen is thirteen years old this year. According to the local custom, this is called the genus year.
Adults are called Benmingnian, and thirteen-year-old children are called Benmingnian.
In this year, you must wear red pants and red socks. If you don’t have any, you can wear a red belt.
The red belt is actually a piece of red cloth, which goes directly through the nose of the trousers, just tie it on.
It is impossible to wear red pants and red socks every day, but the red belt is always tied around the waist.
Han Zhenwen gritted his teeth, untied the red belt and pulled it off, tore a small strand of red cloth from the top, went forward, and tied it to the mallet.
There are green leaves all around, and the bright red cloth strips are particularly conspicuous. Now, I won’t be afraid of being blinded by the mallet.
At this time, Lai Pigui led Zhao Jianguo and Chu Xuanhuai back here.
As soon as Chu Xuanhuai saw Xu Chenghou, he asked, "Old Xu, what about the long worm?"
"Let's go, you made the incense that smoked the worms, and smoked the long worms away."
Xu Chenghou laughed when he saw Chu Xuanhuai. No one thought that the incense that is good for fuming mosquitoes and blind midges would also be effective against long insects.
"Come and see, here is a tree with six leaves."

chapters.title: Chapter 494: will not
chapters.content:
Chapter 494 will not
"This is the six leaves. I have only heard about it before, but I have never seen it before."
Chu Xuanhuai is a doctor, but he has only seen ginseng collected from medicine shops, but not wild ginseng growing in the forest.
At this moment, when I saw the six leaves tied with red cloth strips, my eyes were full of surprise.
"Jianguo, what happened to the set of digging sticks you brought?" Xu Chenghou asked Zhao Jianguo.
Speaking of it, although Xu Chenghou was born and bred in Northeast China, he really never went into the mountains and let go of the stick.
He also doesn't know how to do this job.
"Master, I brought the household items with me, but I dare not touch this six-leaf tree."
Zhao Jianguo frowned, looking at the ginseng tree with a troubled expression on his face.
In the past, when he was in the big house, he was the deputy captain of the production team. He was usually busy with the affairs of the team and rarely went into the mountains to release the mountains.
Even if he went into the mountain once in a while, he always followed others and never took the lead.
This kind of ginseng job is not his turn at all.
Don't look at him having a set of household items, that's what Guan's younger brother Zhao Jianshe wants.
Originally, I was thinking, looking at ginseng on the mountain, waiting to go into the forest to try my luck when I get to Honghamtou City.
Who would have thought that this is not yet Honghammer City, but Xu Chenghou's grandparents met Bangchui. And it's still a six-leaf tree.
If it was a small tree, he would still dare to try it.
Six leaves, if there is trouble, there will be a big stick underneath. He doesn't have that skill, so he dare not do it.
If a bad guy scratches the skin of the mallet, he will be blind in vain.
He didn’t see it, and he didn’t have any part in it, so what if he broke it?
"Well, in this group of people, there isn't even a single person who knows how to give a reference."
Xu Chenghou spread his hands, what is this? Co-authoring and arguing for a long time, the group of them gave it for nothing.
"What can I do?"
"Uncle Zhao, please run to the machine repair shop and find someone.
If they don’t dare to do anything, then drive down the mountain to find my dad. "
Xu Haiyuan thought about it, he might have to ask his father to come up with this matter, which is probably enough for most people.
Zhao Jianguo nodded repeatedly when he heard it.
"Okay, then I'll go find your mother right away, and let them drive down to find your father. Forget about this job, I guess he really needs to come."
Everyone knows that Xu Shiyan is famous for being a leader. It is better for Xu Shiyan to carry this six-leaf tree.
Anyway, the grandparents of the Xu family saw the mallet. No matter what Xu Shiyan carried out when he came up, it had nothing to do with others.
After Zhao Jianguo finished speaking, he turned around and left. He knew the site on the machine repair shop, so just go out from the forest here and go straight north.
Zhao Jianguo is gone, and Xu Chenghou and the others are here, so they can't wait here with big eyes.
Fortunately, although Han Zhenwen doesn't know how to lift ginseng, he basically understands the procedure of lifting ginseng from the mountains.
So he brought Xu Haiyuan and the others together, and started to gather around the fire and make preparations in advance.
On the other side, Zhao Jianguo hurried to the machine repair shop and found Su Anying.
When Su Anying saw Zhao Jianguo coming, she was quite frightened. She thought something happened to Xu Chenghou or the children.
"Brother Jianguo, why are you here? What happened over there?" Su Anying asked eagerly.
"Siblings, don't worry, Uncle Xu and the children are fine.
There is something wrong, you have to drive down the mountain quickly and pick Shi Yan up. "
Zhao Jianguo waved his hand to reassure Su Anying.
"That's how it happened, Uncle Xu and your family came across a big stick when they went into the mountain, Liupiye.
I dare not raise my hands. You'd better ask Shi Yan to come up with this matter. "
Zhao Jianguo was afraid that Su Anying would be in a hurry, so he finished the matter in one breath.
Su Anying's eyes widened when she heard this, what the hell? Entering the mountain and meeting a stick?
What did the grandfather and grandson do? Can you meet the mallet? Didn't they say they went up the mountain to weed and work? Why did you go into the mountains again?
Can you save some snacks for each of these? Old and young, young and old, what are you doing in the woods?
What if I meet a beast or something?
Su Anying complained in her heart, but at this moment, the grandparents and grandchildren are still in the mountains, so I can't ignore it.
"Okay, I see, let's go down the mountain." After speaking, Su Anying turned around and called Zhao Jianshe and the others.
When Zhao Jianshe heard that he had to go down the mountain to pick up Xu Shiyan, he immediately put down his work, and together with Su Anying and Zhao Jianguo, came out of the machine repair factory and drove straight to Donggang.
Just when they got home, Xu Shiyan came back from get off work at noon and was waiting for dinner.
Seeing Su Anying and the others come back, Xu Shiyan also thought that something happened on the mountain, and was quite frightened.
As a result, Su Anying told him that his father and his son had encountered a stick when they entered the mountain.
Then what are you talking about? let's go now.
Xu Shiyan hurried home to get the set of things he put on the mountain, and called Lin Qiyue to ask for leave.
I couldn't care less about eating now, so I hurried up the mountain by car and went straight to the forest on the east side of the Liumao River.
Xu Shiyan is a person who often runs mountains. Even though he has gone to the mountains less in the past two years, he still has experience.
Without Zhao Jianguo leading the way, following the traces of Xu Chenghou and the others, they found the young and old who got together without a charter.
"What's the matter? Why do you still want to go into the mountains and release the mountains? You don't know how to do it."
On the way here, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were still thinking about it.
The old man went up the mountain to supervise the children, why did he lead the children into the mountain? This is too worrying, right?
Xu Chenghou, Chu Xuanhuai and others finally breathed a sigh of relief when they saw Xu Shiyan.
"Aren't you a rascal? You have to drag Yuanyuan into the mountain.
I thought that there was nothing wrong, so I led the dog and followed with a gun on my back.
How can you think that Lapigui has met an old omen? There is also a big long worm guarding a mallet.
At least I used the incense made by your master to smoke away the big worms.
But none of us know how to raise ginseng, so why don't we call you up? "
Xu Chenghou casually pointed over there, and both Xu Shiyan and Su Anying saw that tree, and all the surrounding grass was cleared away from the stick with a red cloth strip tied to it.
In addition to the club, the fire in the wind has also been gathered.
Under the guidance of Chu Xuanhuai, Han Zhenwen got some herbs and put them on the fire, and a puff of white smoke came out.
White smoke floated along the wind, carrying a scent of medicine, and there were not many mosquitoes around.
Well, it’s all here, what else can I say, let’s work.
"Daughter-in-law, go back to the other side of the field and see if the children have eaten, and bring us something to eat."
What time is this? I haven't eaten yet, if I don't get something to eat quickly, how can I have the strength to lift the ginseng?
"Zhenwen, lead them around here.
Since there is an old sign in this place, it is impossible to have only one ginseng seedling. "
There is a spirit snake to protect the ginseng. It is estimated that there is more than one tree here. Let the children wander around, and maybe there will be something to gain.
Xu Haiyuan and Han Zhenwen were also hungry and had no energy.
As a result, when they heard this, they all stared, cheered up, and searched around.
And the rascal, who had been lying on the ground without moving, now had some skills, got up and shook his hair, and started to wander around in this area.
Not long after, I heard Xu Haiyuan yell, "Band mallet."

chapters.title: Chapter 495: dug out the mallet nest
chapters.content:
Chapter 495 digging out the mallet nest
Hearing Xu Haiyuan's shout, everyone was refreshed. Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan asked at the same time, "How many leaves?"
"Six leaves." Over there, Xu Haiyuan shouted something that surprised everyone.
Xu Shiyan was not calm when he heard this, and rushed to his son in a few steps.
Looking forward along his son's hand, sure enough, a ginseng seedling similar to the one just now, shaking its half-green ginseng seeds, was hidden in a tuft of grass.
Xu Shiyan stepped forward and counted, and it turned out to be six leaves.
"Fuck, two trees with six leaves? Can't it?" Xu Shiyan was stunned and couldn't help but swear.
"Look, look again, this is a pile of clubs, there must be more around here."
The ones headed by Liupinye are called a pile, and two Liupiye trees have been found so far. There must be a lot of sticks nearby.
"Oh, I see." Xu Haiyuan responded, and immediately turned around to look again.
As a result, the rascal ghost moved faster than Xu Haiyuan, and jumped out with a whoosh. After a few moments, he came to a tree and circled around that tree.
Seeing the rascal like this, so what? It must have been discovered again.
Xu Shiyan walked over a few steps, and sure enough, he saw another tree under the tree.
"Balm." This time, Xu Shiyan called Shan.
"How many leaves?" Later, Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai asked together.
"Six leaves." Xu Shiyan himself was stunned.
He went to the mountains countless times in his two lives, but he has never met a place where three seedlings and six leaves can grow.
"How many seedlings?" Everyone lost their composure when they heard that six leaves were mentioned, and Xu Chenghou hurriedly followed up.
"It's all over the mountain."
This sentence, most of the time, is people’s yearning for a better life, hoping to meet many sticks
But for Xu Shiyan and the others today, this is not mysterious at all.
Because in such a short time, Xu Shiyan had already seen that there were two ginseng trees ahead.
Headed by three trees and six leaves, there must be a lot of clubs around here, so why not call it Manshandu?
"Quickly, quickly, take it." Later, Han Zhenwen and others hurriedly answered.
"Zhenwen, come and guard this tree, I'll look for it."
Xu Shiyan moved very nimbly. He pushed a branch from the side and inserted it near the six-leaf tree. Then he took out the mallet lock and wrapped the mallet around.
Han Zhenwen came forward as he said, and guarded the ginseng tree.
Xu Shiyan went forward, cleared out the surroundings of the other two Wupiye trees, and called Huang Shuqing to guard them.
After that, Xu Shiyan led Xu Haiyuan and Lai Pigui around here.
Sure enough, just around here, I saw another six-leaf tree, three five-leaf trees, and one four-leaf tree.
"Lumpy ghost, you are planning to earn money to support yourself, right?
My God, are you digging out a stick? The God of the Mountain's hometown has made you a nest. "
Xu Shiyan knew that there must be Shen nearby, but he didn't plan to hang around anymore.
It’s still the same sentence, the God of the Mountain must enjoy the food and eat, and when you see four leaves, you can stop.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand, picked up Lai Pigui, and walked back with Lai Pigui directly on his shoulders.
Lai Pigui is not afraid of heights, squatting on Xu Shiyan's shoulders, wagging his big tail, his appearance is simple, and he is very arrogant.
Zhao Jianguo heard from his younger brother that Xu Shiyan's family raised a psychic fire fox. He had never seen it before, but today he finally opened his eyes.
Where is this a fox? This is a vixen, right?
"Father, Master, you two are taking care of the children, I will carry them.
Construction, that has to trouble you to run around.
Go down the mountain to pick up Uncle Han and Limin. It is best to call Lixin to tell them to keep quiet and come up with guns.
There are several guns in our farm, bring them all. "
With so many big goods, it would take Xu Shiyan ten days and a half months to carry them out by himself, so he had to find helpers.
Han Wenzhong is Xu Shiyan's master. He is a serious old man. It is only safe to ask him to go up the mountain to help.
The participants today were met by Yang Jianguo and Han Zhenwen along with Xu Haiyuan, so these children must be involved.
Call the Han family, there is nothing wrong with this.
There are so many big mallets, I am afraid that the news will leak out, and once people find out, I am afraid that someone will be tempted to grab it.
That's why Xu Shiyan said, let Zhao Jianshe get the gun, and later call Huang Shengli and the others to take charge of the defense.
"Come on, don't worry, I know what to do about this."
Zhao Jianshe has followed Xu Shiyan all these years, how can he not know how to do things? So he promised, turned around and left.
Go to the machine repair shop first, find Huang Shengli, Yang Chunming, Feng Chao, and Sun Xiaofeng, and drag them back to help Xu Shiyan keep watch.
After that, Zhao Jianshe drove down the mountain again, first went to the farm to get the gun, and then went to Han's house to invite someone.
"Old Uncle Han, well, my third brother asked you to go up the mountain to help, saying that the children came to the mountain and met a big guy."
Zhao Jianshe arrived at Han's house, dragged Han Wenzhong aside, and said in a low voice.
There was no loud shouting about this matter.
As soon as Han Wenzhong heard that the children went up the mountain and met a stick, and Xu Shiyan asked someone to invite him, he knew that things were not that simple.
So he immediately sent his grandson to find Han Lixin and Han Limin, and then asked Li Yuexiu to prepare some food quickly.
Li Yuexiu doesn't understand what's going on, but she has been married to Han Wenzhong for many years, so she knows the seriousness.
So without further ado, he packed all the steamed buns in the cabinet.
Let the little grandson go to the store again, buy some cakes and biscuits, and pack a big bag of things.
At this time, Han Limin and Han Lixin also came back. The two brothers thought that something happened at home, so they hurried back.
"Father, what's going on?"
"Don't say anything, go, follow me up the mountain to find Shi Yan."
Han Wenzhong waved his hands, signaling the two sons to put their things on their backs and go up the mountain by car.
Han Limin and his brothers became even more flustered when they saw this posture.
The children went up the mountain again this morning. Could it be that something happened to the children on the mountain?
The two of them didn't dare to ask, they followed their father and went out to take the car.
"Just now Xiao Zhao came over and told me that Zhenwen and Yuanyuan went into the mountains and met Dahuo.
Shi Yan went up, busy alone, and asked us to go over and help. "
Han Wenzhong didn't tell his two sons until the three of them got into the car.
Han Limin and his brothers were relieved when they heard this. It wasn't that something happened to the child.
But after thinking about it, oops, what kind of big guy has to meet, Xu Shiyan can't figure it out, so he has to invite Han Wenzhong to go up the mountain?
"Jianjian, how many ginseng trees did the children meet? Why is this calling people and holding guns?"
Han Limin sat in the back row, saw those semi-automatics, and asked hurriedly.
"Four trees with six leaves, five trees with five leaves, and one tree with four leaves." Zhao Jianshe made a calculation in his mind before saying.
The father and son of the Han family were stunned, "What the hell? Where did they go? Can they meet so many?"
Han Wenzhong has been watching ginseng on the mountain for so many years, and he goes to the mountain every year.
I have seen six leaves before, but I have never heard of them. Four trees with six leaves appear together.
How big is this pile? How did the children meet?

chapters.title: Chapter 496: fox who makes money
chapters.content:
Chapter 496 The fox who can make money
Zhao Jianshe doesn't know exactly how the children met the club, anyway, it has something to do with the rascal.
The father and son of the Han family understood it as soon as they heard it. They had all seen the fox raised by Xu Shiyan, and the little guy had psychics.
The fox's sense of smell is very sensitive. It is estimated that it has entered the forest and smelled the aroma of ginseng.
The three father and son felt emotional, look at his luck, they all know how to repay a fox after picking up a fox from the mountain.
Zhao Jianshe did not drive slowly, and the Liumao River was not too far away, and it took about half an hour to reach the place.
The car stopped on the side of the road, and Zhao Jianshe led Han Wenzhong and the other three, carrying guns and dry food, and went straight into the forest, where they found Xu Shiyan and others.
At this moment, Su Anying has already brought food, and Xu Chenghou and others have already had a meal.
Xu Shiyan has already held the deer bone stick and carried the first ginseng. The reed head of the ginseng has been fully exposed, and the shoulder part is slightly exposed.
Han Wenzhong walked over and looked at the shoulder, and he knew that there was a big mallet under it.
"Well, be careful, this ginseng plant will weigh half a catty."
It’s old-fashioned, and you can tell what the stick in the soil looks like at a glance.
"Uncle Han is here? There are still several over there. I asked Shengli to carry five leaves. Uncle help me carry six leaves."
Five leaves or less are easy to say, and people with a little experience can carry them out.
But most of these six leaves have to be done by hand.
Han Wenzhong nodded, said nothing else, and directly took out the guy who carried the ginseng from the things he brought.
Go straight to the other side, find the Liupiye tree, and start to lift the ginseng.
Originally, Han Zhenwen and Xu Haiyuan were watching by Xu Shiyan's side.
As soon as Han Wenzhong came, Han Zhenwen immediately followed his grandfather.
Here, only Xu Haiyuan is left.
As for Huang Shuqing and Yang Jianguo, they also followed their fathers and helped them out.
Xu Haiyuan is clever enough, watching Xu Shiyan lift the ginseng, and when encountering tree roots and grass roots, Xu Shiyan doesn't need to speak, and he just passes it over as scissors.
When encountering a thick tree root, Xu Haiyuan used it as a saw for the courier.
Xu Shiyan was tired after squatting there for a long time, so Xu Haiyuan went to get his water bottle and gave his father some water.
Now Xu Shiyan can feel comfortable serving him, and it is really useful to say that this son is not raised for nothing.
Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai, who were sitting watching the fun, also looked at Xu Haiyuan with joy.
This kid is really rare, not to mention anything else, just this cleverness, who wouldn't like it?
Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng and others are all here. Those who carry the ginseng carry the ginseng, and those who carry guns are in charge of guarding. No one is watching the ginseng field at the machine repair shop.
Zhao Jianshe saw that there were enough people here, and there was nothing wrong with him, so he should stop watching the fun here, and go back and guard the ground.
There are quite a few tractors over there. Even though people are hired to work, they can’t be left alone.
Not to mention Zhao Jianguo, he has nothing to do here, he has already returned to the venue.
Zhao Jianshe left, and Su Anying followed, it was useless for her to stay, why not arrange work first.
Later, I have to send the children down the mountain, dump things back, and so on. I guess she has to be in charge of logistics.
Finding so many ginseng at once, even with the ability of Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong, it is impossible to easily carry them out, and they must live here at night.
Han Limin and Han Lixin didn't bother to carry the ginseng, they simply built a box nearby, picking up firewood and so on.
Lai Pigui stopped running now, and lay obediently beside Xu Chenghou, while Xiao Huang and Er Hei lay on the other side.
The dog and the fox are in harmony without interfering with each other.
At 4:30 in the afternoon, Su Anying came back and said that she was going to send Xu Chenghou, Chu Xuanhuai and the children down the mountain.
But Xu Haiyuan and the others refused to leave at all. In desperation, Su Anying could only send Xu Chenghou, Chu Xuanhuai, and a few children from the venue back home.
Don't look at Su Anying as a woman, she doesn't feel at all afraid of driving, but usually there are Zhao Jianshe and others, so she is not needed.
Now everyone is busy, no one is driving, so Su Anying drives halfway, and directly sends the children home.
And told each family that something happened on the mountain, and the men of each family would not come back at night, and asked each family to prepare some bedding, luggage, thick clothes, and food.
Huang Shengli's daughter-in-law and the others could more or less guess something when they heard it, so they quickly pulled some food and handed it to Su Anying
Su Anying drove the car again, carrying food, luggage, bedding, pots and pans, etc., and returned to the mountain.
With Su Anying as the logistical support, Xu Shiyan and others settled down in the cabin on the mountain with peace of mind, guarding the sticks, and arranged people to be on duty at night.
At night in Changbai Mountain, the temperature was a bit low, and the fire was burning all night. The night watchman held a gun and chatted in front of the fire.
The rambunctious ghost doesn't want to live outside, so he has to squeeze together with Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan slept with Laipigui in his arms, which was more comfortable than leaning against the fire, and he slept until dawn.
As soon as it was dawn outside, Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong began to carry the ginseng.
The six leaves are not small, and the ginseng beards are long. Each one must be carefully pulled out of the soil. This is a delicate job, and it will not be fast.
Xu Shiyan worked for a long time, and finally brought out a big stick. Feng Chao and others came to see it.
"Tsk tsk, this tree must not weigh more than half a catty? My God, isn't this rambunctious ghost too powerful? How can it let go of mountains?"
Everyone was amazed, and the way they looked at the rascal was different.
This is not a fox, it is clearly a cornucopia and a cash cow. If you take it into the mountains in the future, you will encounter big goods every time you go back?
Lai Pigui seemed to notice that the eyes of others were different, and immediately shrank into Xu Haiyuan's arms and hid.
Everyone looked at it and laughed.
"Okay, come out, who can do anything to you?
This time I made a great contribution, so I don’t care what I want to eat when I go back. I'll kill two chickens for you first. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and stretched out his hands to rub Lapigui's soft fur. This little guy understands everything day by day.
Lai Pigui poked his head out of Xu Haiyuan's arms, turned his triangular eyes, and yelled at Xu Shiyan. This is starting to act like a baby again.
Xu Shiyan couldn't care less about playing with the rascals. There are still six leaves left, so he has to hurry up and work.
It's not too far from the Songjiang River here, and it can even be said that it's not too far from the side of the road.
In this season, there are a lot of people going up the mountain to do side jobs. Does anyone know if anyone is passing by?
In case someone sees it and something goes wrong, it’s better to hurry up.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan hurriedly packed the six leaves of the seedling that had been carried out into ginseng bags with moss and birch bark, and put them away carefully.
Then he started to lift another Liupiye.
Huang Shengli and the others have already carried out the five leaves and four leaves, not to mention, those five leaves are not small.
As Xu Shiyan said, this time, Lai Pigui gave Duan Woer the hometown of the mountain god.

chapters.title: Chapter 497: The dog bit someone
chapters.content:
Chapter 497 The dog bit someone
At around three o'clock in the afternoon, Han Wenzhong also brought out one seedling and six leaves.
It looks a bit longer than the seedling that Xu Shiyan carried out. It has a delicate body, and its skin, grain, and reed are all top-grade.
Han Wenzhong was very rare, and he said that he had been in the mountains for so many years, and he had never seen such a beautiful ginseng.
At this moment, I didn’t care about being happy and celebrating, so I quickly packed the ginseng bag and put it away, and continued to carry other ginseng.
The two were busy carrying the ginseng, while the others were watching around, afraid of any accidents.
Fortunately, everything went well during the day, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
The six leaves of these two seedlings in the back are not too small, and they can’t be lifted out for a long time. There is no choice but to stay on the mountain for another night.
Still like last night, Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong rested and slept, and the others were on duty in two shifts.
The first half of the night was okay, and there was no movement at all.
Just after two o'clock in the middle of the night, Yang Chunming, Han Limin, and Sun Xiaofeng were chatting around the fire while warming up.
Suddenly, Xiao Huang and Er Hei Pu Leng who were lying on the ground got up suddenly, and started barking towards the northwest corner.
The people sleeping in the closet also woke up, and the rascal rushed out, bared its teeth in the northwest corner, and made whining noises.
Han Limin and the three had already raised their guns, "Who? Don't come here, go forward, and shoot."
While speaking, Han Limin pulled the safety button and fired a shot in the air.
At this time, regardless of whether it is a person or a livestock, it is best to scare them away. If they cannot be scared away, it may be a fierce battle.
The northwest corner was completely silent, there was no sound, but Gouzi and the rascal did not stop.
Especially the rascals, the whole thing is in a state of fried hair.
That is to say, there still seems to be danger hidden in the northwest corner.
