Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong also got up. They held guns in their hands and formed a circle with their faces facing the outside.
No one is sure if there is any hidden danger in other directions. At this time, this is the only way to defend.
As for the children, they hid in the box and did not come out.
After a while, there was no sound coming from the northwest corner. Xu Shiyan calmed the dogs and stopped them from barking.
No one dared to move, they still held their guns and guarded there.
After an unknown amount of time, the surrounding area was still silent.
Xu Shiyan waved to everyone, "Okay, it's okay, I guess it was some bobcat and beast passing by just now, our dog didn't go through the battle, and was scared.
Let’s all rest and sleep, I didn’t sleep well last night, I was overwhelmed, no, I can’t take it anymore. "
Xu Shiyan yawned as he spoke.
Over there, Han Wenzhong also answered, "Yeah, you've been exhausted all day, go to sleep, you have to get up early tomorrow morning."
While speaking, everyone dispersed and walked towards the side of the gate.
Xu Shiyan untied Xiao Huang and Er Hei's ropes and patted their heads.
Xiao Huang and Er Hei rushed out without even calling.
Then, everyone heard a few screams, needless to say, the dog bit someone.
Xu Shiyan and the others looked terrified, the visitor was very scheming, and kept hiding.
Probably waiting for Xu Shiyan and the others to relax and rest again, so that they can touch it.
I just didn't expect that Xu Shiyan was more thoughtful than them. He pretended to be resting, but let the dog out.
It is estimated that the people who came here did not expect that Xiao Huang and Er Hei are not only dogs that can bark, but also dare to bite people.
Let alone humans, wild boars and black blinds have all bitten them, so what is it to bite a person?
At the northwest corner, there was a burst of panicked footsteps and cries of pain.
Needless to say, it must be that Xiao Huang and Er Hei are biting someone, and the other party is struggling.
Suddenly, when he heard the dog barking, Xu Shiyan's heart skipped a beat. "Limin, go over and have a look."
The dog’s movements were wrong, it didn’t look like he was injured and screaming, but a bit like he was being beaten, he choked twice, and then barked loudly.
Xiao Huang and Er Hei were very ruthless in their mouths. The other party was bitten unprepared, and probably just reacted and kicked the dog.
The dog let go of the pain and wanted to jump up again, but the other party was on guard and couldn't bite, so the dog barked loudly, which was calling someone.
Xu Shiyan was afraid that the dog would suffer, so he immediately greeted Han Limin, and the two walked towards the northwest corner with their guns in hand.
While walking, Xu Shiyan raised the muzzle of his gun and fired another shot into the air.
Then, I heard a burst of noisy footsteps ahead, running towards the distance.
During this period, there was also the barking of the dog. You could tell from the sound that the dog was chasing after him.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly whistled and called the two dogs back.
Just drive the people away, but don't hurt the dogs.
Xiao Huang and Er Hei have followed Xu Shiyan since they were young, and they have a tacit understanding with Xu Shiyan.
As soon as Xu Shiyan whistled, they knew it was the master calling them back.
So he yelled at the black shadows a few more times, and then rushed back.
In an instant, Gouzi ran up to Xu Shiyan, panting heavily.
These two dogs have been with the Xu family for seven or eight years, and now they have been for eight years. Calculated according to the dog's age, this dog has already entered old age, and his physical strength is not as good as before.
Xu Shiyan quickly touched the two dogs, they were okay, there was no wound on his body, he should have been kicked just now.
"Good job, well done, let's go, go back."
Xu Shiyan patted the heads of the two dogs, and led them back to the vicinity of the gate.
"How's it going? Have you seen how many people are there?" Han Wenzhong asked.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "I didn't see clearly, probably Xiao Huang and Er Hei bit them.
Limin and I went over and fired warning shots again. They knew that nothing would happen, so they ran away. I was afraid that Xiao Huang would suffer, so I didn't dare to take the dog to chase him. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, it was too dark to see clearly at night, and there were trees blocking it in the forest, so he couldn't see the other party at all.
But judging from the sound of footsteps, there should be three or four people.
"Well, it's right not to chase, no one knows what's going on at the other side this night.
If they chase after them desperately, they will easily suffer. "Han Wenzhong nodded.
You have to be careful in everything outside, safety is the top priority, don't fight for that moment.
What else can I do if I catch up? Send people to the police station? What crime?
People say that they got lost in the mountains and went to the wrong place, what can they do?
After all, to catch a thief is to catch the stolen goods. There is no evidence, so it is useless.
This black light is blind, and he doesn't know how many people are on the other side. What if people are too impatient and lose money if they fight twice?
As long as the person and the stick are fine, you can't be too aggressive.
After such a commotion, no one needed to sleep, so the big guys got together, gathered around the fire, and began to think about how to divide the few seedlings.
Nowadays, every family is not short of money to spend, and the ginseng dug up must not be sold, but how to divide it is also strange.
This time is different from before, Xu Shiyan used to take them into the mountain.
The big guys met together, Xu Shiyan abided by the old rules and shared with the brothers equally.
But this time, it was Laipigui who met ginseng, and it came back to look for Xu Haiyuan, and Han Zhenwen and the others followed to join in the fun.
It’s hard to say about this matter, how can it be reasonable?

chapters.title: Chapter 498: rascals take half
chapters.content:
Chapter 498 Reckless ghosts account for half
"That's how it is, Lai Pigui himself will get half, and the other half will be shared equally by his in-laws and four children."
Han Wenzhong pondered for a long time, and finally spoke.
"We are all following the rascal, if it weren't for it, we wouldn't be able to find these ginseng at all."
What Han Wenzhong said is the truth.
If it were an adult, for example, Xu Shiyan went into the mountain alone, and he would meet as many as he had, and it had nothing to do with anyone.
But this was met by the rascal, the rascal is a fox, it can't lift the ginseng, so it can only ask someone to help, so it can only give half of it.
Xu Chenghou brought Xu Haiyuan, Yang Jianguo, Han Zhenwen, and Huang Shuqing together, so everyone who sees will get a share, and these people will share equally.
As for the others, they all got the news, so it's nothing to do with them.
Whether it is Xu Shiyan or Han Wenzhong, they are just helping the children of each family. If the children are divided, there will be no adults.
But Feng Chao, Sun Xiaofeng, and Zhao Jianshe. After all, they have a good relationship and helped them, so I should be more considerate.
At the very least, I have to get some delicious treats when I go back.
Han Wenzhong put forward this opinion, and neither Yang Chunming nor Huang Shengli had any objection.
Their children just come out to play with them. This is purely for cheap, and it would be good to share it. How much is too much?
Three people from the old Han’s family came out to help, and they didn’t say it was too much, so why do they have more than the Han family? Why do you want more?
As for Feng Chao and Sun Xiaofeng, they had nothing to say. They were purely here to help Xu Shiyan.
No matter how this matter is divided, it has nothing to do with them.
So, everyone also agreed with Han Wenzhong's words.
"Uncle, you really treat the rascals like adults." Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it.
From the heart, Han Wenzhong's arrangement is reasonable.
Of course, the rascal is raised by the Xu family, and its share naturally belongs to the Xu family.
As for whether the Xu family will treat the rascals badly after taking the money, that is no one else's business.
"That's fine, let's take out the ginseng tomorrow, find a scale later, and roughly estimate the price.
Then calculate how much the three of you should share, and I will give you cash directly.
This ginseng will not be sold, I have to keep it for Master. "
Now that the family is not short of money, there is no need to sell it.
Selling that little money is not enough to do anything, but it also caused a mess.
It would be better to just leave it quietly and hide it. This thing will become more and more difficult to find in the future, and it is a treasure.
Especially Xu Haiyuan is studying medicine now, and the father doesn't have much ability to support him, so let's stock up some useful medicinal materials for the child.
Keep them all, don’t sell a single one.
Everyone understood Xu Shiyan's thoughts, but they also wanted to keep some.
"Third brother, keep the six leaves, and give me one of the five leaves? I also keep one for what." Huang Shengli said.
"How much money, you can directly convert it down."
More than five leaves are big products, and those five leaves are not small. If they are not kept together, they will become six leaves in a few years, and the medicinal power is supposed to be enough.
There are elderly people in every family, who knows where they can be used?
For people like Huang Shengli, it is not a big deal at all, and it is better to keep a ginseng.
"Yes, yes, leave one for me too. Five leaves will do." Yang Chunming immediately said that he would also keep one for use.
Han Wenzhong pondered for a while, but there are still a few ginseng trees in his house, which he got when he was on the mountain, and he has never been willing to sell them.
It doesn’t hurt to keep this thing, and the money you get from selling it may be spent casually.
"Well, then leave one for me too. It will be useful to ask your master to make a medicine later."
Since everyone has said so, Xu Shiyan certainly does not object, so it is decided.
Wait for all the ginseng to be carried out, and then evaluate and separate after going down the mountain.
In summer in Northeast China, the dawn is early, and before three o'clock, the east will be pale.
It was quite bright outside four o'clock, so Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong didn't care about that, and hurriedly continued to lift the ginseng.
Han Limin and Han Lixin saw that there were many people here, they looked at each other, and walked towards the northwest corner last night with their guns on their backs.
They want to go over and see what's going on over there.
Sure enough, when I walked here, I found that the fallen leaves and grass blades on the ground were all stained with blood.
The two dogs must have bitten someone last night, and the bite was not light.
Following the bloodstains, the two brothers chased all the way forward, and found that this group of people had gone out from the forest and onto the road outside.
It may be that the wound was bandaged on the side of the road, and the blood stains were not so obvious. After chasing for a while, the footprints were no longer obvious.
If you look at the direction, it is Wo turned around and ran south along the road.
In the south, you can go to the Songjiang River, or you can take the Dongtou Fork Road to Kaifeng, Xilinhe, Shuguang and other places. It is difficult to judge where this group of people are from.
But judging from the footprints, four people should have come.
Han Lixin shook his head, "There's no need to chase, we can't catch up, it would be okay if there was a police dog."
In fact, it is useless to catch up, they cannot report the crime.
Maybe people will have to bite back, saying that they are letting dogs bite people.
Of course, dog bites are common these days, and few people lose money.
Han Lixin and the others couldn't catch someone stealing things, so there was no point in pursuing this matter.
So the two brothers turned around and went back again.
In the morning, everyone casually dealt with dry food, and then Xu Shiyan and Han Wenzhong went to carry the ginseng again.
Until one o'clock in the afternoon, the last two seedlings and six leaves were also unearthed. They are not small in size, really look like a chubby baby, not to mention how rare people are.
All the clubs were unearthed. After Xu Shiyan asked everyone's opinions, he decided not to chop off the omen.
There is an old sign over there, and anyone who sees it will know that there is a ginseng nearby.
Another one, the people who came over last night, maybe they all know each other.
They cut off the omen here, and people will know what's going on when they look at it later, four seedlings and six leaves, who can't be red-eyed after seeing it?
Today is not the society it used to be, and people are not very good-looking now.
No one dared to say, did anyone touch Xu Shiyan's house or Huang Shengli's house with bad intentions?
Just like that, everyone packed up their things, Huang Shengli went to the machine repair shop, drove a car over, and dragged everyone down the mountain to Xu Shiyan's house.
Xu Shiyan has a balance there. He uses it for weighing things in his experiments, and it can just weigh ginseng.
Those ginseng seedlings weighed a lot, in fact Xu Shiyan probably knew in his heart that the balance was his own, and he used it even more smoothly.
Not long after, all the ginseng seedlings were weighed out.
The largest seedling weighed 298 grams, that is to say, it almost sank to six taels.
What kind of concept is this, that is, if you change to the old system, this tree will cost more than nine taels.
In ancient times, it was said that seven liang is a treasure and eight liang is a treasure. This, that is, it can be called a national treasure.
Among the other three seedlings and six leaves, one seedling weighed half a catty, and the rest were a little smaller.
The five leaves are of different sizes, the big one is more than three taels, the small one is about two taels, which is not too small, and the four leaves are small and not heavy.
"Uncle Han, please give me an estimate, and I will give you the money."
Xu Shiyan couldn't bid on this matter, Han Wenzhong and the others had to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 499: save for children
chapters.content:
Chapter 499 Saving for children
Five seedlings with five leaves and one seedling with four leaves, each of the three families will choose the big one to keep, and the rest will belong to Xu Shiyan, so there is no need to count the money.
In recent years, the price of wild ginseng has increased a lot compared to previous years.
The six largest leaves of that seedling were estimated by Han Wenzhong at around 18,000.
The slightly smaller seedling is estimated to cost 12,000, and the remaining two seedlings cost about 8,000.
So if you do the calculations like this, it's about 45,000 to 6,000 yuan.
Such a large amount of money, if it was put aside for a few years, it would be really scary.
But for these companies, there are too many, but there is no fuss.
"Well, then calculate according to 46000.
Deduct half of the rascal's, leaving 23,000, I will give 4,600 to each of the three families, right? "
Xu Shiyan nodded, the price Han Wenzhong said was quite fair.
Currently speaking, if you go to the Tonghua medicinal material purchasing station, the price is almost the same.
Of course, if you take this to Yangcheng and find a merchant in Hong Kong City, doubling it is like playing.
This thing pays attention to selling ginseng on the spot at the price, so there is no need to think about Yangcheng and the like.
Just follow Tonghua’s, fair and reasonable.
For this little account, you don’t need anything, just count it out with your mouth.
Xu Shiyan quickly said the number, and turned to Yang Chunming and the others.
"Yes, that's right." Everyone nodded.
For them, the four thousand dollars are all for nothing, so why ask for so much?
"Okay, that's it, I'll get the money later and distribute the money to everyone." Xu Shiyan nodded.
There are more than 10,000 cash in cash. I really don’t have any at home, so I have to go to the bank to get it.
"Well, let me say something more, we'd better not use this money, save it for the children, and keep them for their school expenses."
Every family does not lack these thousands of dollars. Since it is distributed to the children, they must keep their word.
It's not good to use the name of a child, and finally let the adults spend it.
"Xu Haiyuan's share, I will also save it for him."
Save for the children, as long as it is for reasonable use and can support the children, if it is spent indiscriminately, it is absolutely not acceptable.
"Yes, yes, the third brother reminded me right.
Otherwise, third brother, don’t give me cash, just write the whole passbook and write the name of our son.
I will keep it for him. If he studies hard, he will keep it for future school use.
If he doesn’t study hard, give him capital in a few years and let him plant a stick by himself. "
Huang Shengli thinks long-term. He even plans to understand why his son doesn't go to school.
At least he didn't say that Huang Shuqing kept the money to talk about his daughter-in-law, which is already pretty good.
Han Limin and Yang Chunming also nodded. No matter what you say, this is the first money the child has earned, and it should be kept for them.
"Then let's do the same for ours, and save them for the children."
In this way, it is much easier. You can go directly to the savings bank later, open a few other accounts, and deposit the money in them.
Otherwise, if you withdraw more than 10,000 yuan at once, you are afraid that if you don’t make an appointment in advance at the savings bank, you won’t be able to get that much cash.
"Success, this is simple, let's go to the savings bank together.
Just in time to buy some delicious food, we will have dinner here at night, let’s get together. "
Xu Shiyan nodded, treating guests to dinner is a must.
Everything that should be divided has been divided. Each family takes the five leaves that they have chosen, and goes home first, and tells the family to make the family feel at ease.
Xu Shiyan also hurriedly put those seedling sticks in the basement first.
When Chu Xuanhuai came back in the evening, they packed up the ginseng and processed it together, and put it away properly.
It may be of great use in the future if you keep it, even if you don’t need it, it will be a lot of wealth in the future.
Then, Xu Shiyan grabbed a chicken from the chicken coop, killed it directly, and gave it to the rascal to eat by himself without shedding its feathers or anything.
Lai Pigui really didn’t eat well on the mountain these days, and now he is not polite to Xu Shiyan, and left with the dead chicken in his mouth, looking for a secluded place to eat.
At three o'clock in the afternoon, Xu Shiyan, Han Limin, Huang Shengli, and Yang Chunming went to the savings office together.
I told the staff that I need to open several accounts and transfer some money into them.
Xu Shiyan is a major customer of the savings bank, and all the staff here know him, so the business is handled quickly.
Xu Shiyan also opened a passbook for Xu Haiyuan alone, depositing 4,600 yuan for him.
In addition, Xu Shiyan took out another four thousand six, which was for Xu Chenghou.
Father and son also have to settle accounts clearly, whose money is theirs.
After finishing their work, several people went to Songjianghe Market to see what to buy.
The market today is not the same as it was a few years ago. There are many people selling things in the market now, and there are many types of things.
Xu Shiyan looked around, and there was a stall selling cooked food.
There are not too many types of cooked food these days. Some sell roast chicken, and some sell elbows, pork heads, pork hearts and livers, and that’s all.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about that, pulled a pile of cooked food, went to the butcher stall, bought some meat and so on, and brought a lot of things, and several people went back to Xu Chenghou's place together.
"Mom, invite everyone to dinner tonight. Well, you are always tired, so make something to eat."
There is no way, Su Anying is still leading people to work on the mountain, the family can only count on Zhou Guilan.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan bought a lot of cooked food, so he just needs to cut everything and put it on a plate, and then make a few random dishes.
Of course Zhou Guilan understood, so she took the things and nodded.
"Well, don't worry, this matter is left to me, you go into the room quickly and talk to them."
At the beginning of August, there was no shortage of vegetables in the vegetable garden, and Xu Shiyan also bought a lot of cooked food. This meal was easy to prepare.
Zhou Guilan has never been afraid to cook. After looking at the things her son bought, she went to the vegetable garden and found several dishes.
Since the discovery of wild ginseng that day, Su Anying stopped letting the children go up the mountain to weed, she was afraid that something else would go wrong.
Besides, I'm too busy to take care of it.
Xu Jinping didn't go to work in the mountains, she learned to be good, and just read at home. Seeing that grandma was cooking, the little girl quickly helped pick and wash vegetables.
Despite her small size, she works very quickly. With the help of Xu Jinping, Zhou Guilan can cook with ease.
It was less than five o'clock, and Su Anying also came back early. She guessed that the family might have a treat tonight, so she came back from work early and planned to help Zhou Guilan cook.
It is not appropriate to make a public announcement about the children getting sticks in the mountain, so they didn't call too many people.
Except for the few who knew about it, even Yang Junxian and Zhou Qingguo didn't say hello.
It's not about being on guard against anyone, but mainly because I'm afraid of leaking the news and causing trouble.
Originally, there were a lot of cooked food, and with the help of Su Anying, the food was naturally prepared quickly.
At this time, Xu Shiyan took out a few passbooks on the kang in the east room.
"Come on, all of you little ones, I have something to tell you."
Xu Shiyan waved, and called Han Zhenwen, Huang Shuqing, Yang Jianguo, and his own son Xu Haiyuan to him.
"I have discussed with your father, and you have a share in this participation.
These are four passbooks, each with 4,600 yuan in them, and they are opened in your names.
That is to say, the money is your own. "
"This is the money you earned yourself. The family members don't move, and you can't spend it carelessly, save it for school.
If you don’t go to school in the future, you can use this as capital to do some small business. "

chapters.title: Chapter 500: keep secret
chapters.content:
Chapter 500 Confidential
Among these children, Han Zhenwen was the thirteenth, Yang Jianguo was the twelfth, and Huang Shuqing was the eleventh.
If you study well, you can go all the way to junior high school, high school, university, or take a technical secondary school after junior high school.
In the future, when they go to college, they will just catch up with the college fees, so they will save the tuition fees.
If you don’t study well, you will come down after graduating from junior high school, and it will not be a few years. The money will probably come in handy soon.
It is reasonable to keep the money you earn for yourself to spend in the future.
The children didn't think too much about it, but they were very happy when they heard that they had thousands of dollars.
"Uncle Xu, don't worry, we will definitely not spend recklessly."
Han Zhenwen nodded solemnly, expressing that he must take good care of the money.
"Yes, Uncle Xu, we are all obedient. When I get home later, I will give the passbook to my mother for safekeeping."
Huang Shuqing is young, so he is not stupid. It is better to keep the money with his mother.
Xu Shiyan nodded, anyway, he has reminded everything that should be reminded, and the rest is up to him.
"Yuanyuan, this is yours, you can keep it yourself, don't give it to your mother."
Xu Shiyan has confidence in his son, Xu Haiyuan is not the kind of kid who spends money recklessly.
He has plans for everything, let him take care of the money, Su Anying is very busy all day, so don't bother her with this matter.
"Father, you have one too, I'll give it to you later." Xu Shiyan whispered to Xu Chenghou.
The old man is old, and he is definitely not used to withdrawing money from the savings bank, so Xu Shiyan took out the cash specially.
"Why do I need so much money for food and drink? You can save it for my grandson."
Xu Chenghou waved his hand, he didn't help much by following into the woods, so don't give him any money.
Xu Shiyan listened to his father's words, but did not argue with him.
In front of so many people, the two of you should not quarrel over this little money. Let's talk about it after the outsiders have left.
Just in time, the food is ready at this time, Su Anying serves the food on the table.
Xu Haiyuan hurried to help, and the children were not idle, they all went to help.
These days on the mountain, although the children didn’t do much work, they just stood by and helped, but they also understood that no matter what they did, it was actually quite hard work.
In contrast, learning is probably the least labor-saving thing.
So the children have really changed a lot, and they are much more sensible than before.
With the help of the children, all the meals were served on the table in a short time.
Roasted chicken, pork knuckle, pig ears mixed with cucumber, pork heart and liver dipped in garlic sauce, fried eggplant box, fried pork with big pepper, tomato mixed with sugar, pork ribs and beans.
"The time was too rushed, and I could only serve eight dishes.
Eat as soon as you can, wait until the day is not busy, let's have a good meal. "Zhou Guilan entered the room with two bottles of wine and said with a smile.
"Oh, aunt, this is very good, what are you thinking about?
Hurry up, you've been busy for half an afternoon, so sit down and eat quickly. "Han Limin and others hurriedly greeted Zhou Guilan to sit down.
On the kang table, Zhou Guilan, Su Anying's mother-in-law and daughter-in-law led the children, and on the floor, Xu Chenghou, Chu Xuanhuai, Han Wenzhong, Xu Shiyan and others.
The meals on both tables are the same, just eat whatever you want.
Xu Shiyan had to have a drink with Han Limin and the others.
During the meeting, Xu Shiyan also told everyone that the events of the past few days should be kept secret as much as possible and not shared.
Especially about the rambunctious ghost, I hope everyone can keep their mouths shut.
For Northeast people, most people will not provoke animals such as foxes and yellow skins.
It has always been such a legend that these things have a small face and love to hold grudges, and many people are in awe of them.
But it does not rule out that some people who are blind to money and obsessed with money will not care about anything for money.
If someone knows that rascals will release mountains, they will really have some ideas if they don’t keep them neat.
Although Lai Pigui is clever and smart and will not be easily fooled, he dare not say that there is no time for negligence.
If it was really that capable, it wouldn't have fallen into Xu Shiyan's hands several times. Therefore, what should be guarded against is still to be guarded against.
"Third brother, don't worry, we must not go out and talk about this matter, and besides, no one dares to mess with it.
You can see that the rascal has been in your house for many years. In fact, everyone in the neighbors knows that it is not annoying, and it is fine. "
Huang Shengli and Sun Xiaofeng laughed when they heard this, and quickly expressed their opinions.
Lai Pigui has never stolen a chicken from a neighbor in the past few years in the Xu family.
I don't know if it's because of its presence. There are not many families around, and there are not many mice.
So everyone actually has a bit of respect for the rascal, and no one will provoke it.
Feng Chao and the others also nodded in agreement, expressing that they would not tell the story of the rascal.
Xu Shiyan just wanted a guarantee, and he couldn't shut up everyone's mouths and keep people from talking about this kind of thing.
He tried his best to protect the rascal, and he just wanted his family to be careful in the future.
Everyone ate and drank at Xu's house until almost eight o'clock.
These days on the mountain were very tired, and they couldn't eat or sleep well, so after eating and drinking enough, they each said goodbye and prepared to leave.
"Well, Aunt Xu, shall we still go to work in the mountains tomorrow?"
Before going out, Huang Shuqing suddenly turned to ask Su Anying.
Su Anying froze for a moment, then laughed, "Take a few days off, I don't have much work recently.
You are tired enough to be on the mountain these days, so take a good rest for a few days. "
Are you kidding, still going up the mountain? This time the mountain is enough to worry about, and if we go up the mountain again, these families may not be able to sleep.
"Oh, then I won't get up tomorrow morning. I haven't slept well in the past few days. It's too uncomfortable to fall asleep in that place."
Huang Shuqing heaved a sigh of relief when he heard this. He wanted to go home and have a good sleep.
When everyone heard this, they all laughed, "Go to sleep, go to sleep, you will recover after you sleep."
It is not easy for a teenager to live in the mountains for several days.
No parent would be so cruel and let them go to work.
Originally, the purpose was to teach the children a lesson, but now the children know that they are wrong, and they also understand that it is not easy for the adults in the family. The purpose has been achieved, so let it be.
Then can you really point the children to work? Just mean it.
In the future, I know that studying hard and not going out to make troubles is better than anything else.
Xu Shiyan took out some other money and gave it to Feng Chao, Sun Xiaofeng, and Zhao Jianshe.
"Well, buy something delicious for the kids."
Five hundred yuan for the family, mainly to thank Feng Chao and Sun Xiaofeng for their help.
"Third brother, what are you doing? Our brother has dealt with these things, and we can't get along in the future?"
Feng Chao and the others naturally refused to take it, so they stuffed the money back into Xu Shiyan's hands in a daze.
"Third brother, let me tell you, if you ask for money again, I will turn against you." Feng Chao said with a tiger's face, his eyes widening.
"That's right, third brother, it's rare for us to follow you to pick up bargains these years.
You pay back the money for this little thing, why do you look down on us? "Zhao Jianshe was not happy either.
"I'm not thinking, isn't it difficult for the children to go up the mountain once? Look at you, why are you staring at me?"
What can Xu Shiyan do, he can only explain with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 501: all baby
chapters.content:
Chapter 501 is all babies
Feng Chao and others didn’t ask for Xu Shiyan’s money.
Tell Xu Haiyuan as a joke, if Xu Haiyuan goes up the mountain again in the future, remember to call Feng Bin and the others.
If Xu Haiyuan becomes promising in the future, don't forget to bring along a friend.
Everyone laughed, and the matter was over.
Xu Shiyan has nothing to do, he can only do this, anyway, the days of getting along with each other will be long, and there will be plenty of opportunities in the future.
The outsiders left, Xu Shiyan turned around and took out 4,600 cash, and handed it to Zhou Guilan.
"Mom, this is my father's share, please keep it for him."
If dad doesn’t want it, just give it to mom. Xu Shiyan has always done this.
"Huh? Your father still has it? Oh, no, we are all a family, what are you doing all this?"
It is not necessary to take it out of your pocket and give it to us, and turn your left hand into your right hand. "
The old lady quickly waved her hand, not wanting Xu Shiyan's money.
The two families are actually one family now, except that they live in two houses at night, there is really no difference.
On normal days, Xu Shiyan and his wife don't spend less money and things, and the old couple basically don't need to spend money on daily expenses.
"Our money is enough, otherwise, you will give this money to my eldest grandson?"
On this matter, Zhou Guilan and Xu Chenghou have the same attitude, they don't want it, let's save it for the grandson.
"That's right, I told you just now that I don't want that money.
I went to the mountain with me, but nothing helped me. Why did you give me money?
My eldest grandson will study in the future, and there are many places to spend money. You leave the money to him. "
On the other end, Xu Chenghou stared at his son and said.
Xu Shiyan couldn't stand his parents, so he could only glance at Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan understood immediately, smiled and approached, and handed his passbook to Zhou Guilan.
"Grandma, this is the money my dad gave me. You said I have to go to school all day long and I'm not at home. Can you put this stuff away for me?
My mother is not at home every day, and there is no one on the other side of my house during the day. If someone enters the house, wouldn’t it be lost? "
Xu Haiyuan directly put the passbook and the more than 4,000 yuan into Zhou Guilan's hands.
"Grandma, save it for me. I'll take care of you when I need it in the future. Is that okay?"
After thinking about it, Zhou Guilan seems to be right. Her son and daughter-in-law are always away from home, and the children should not know where the money is hidden at home.
It is not safe for Xu Haiyuan to leave it alone.
"Then, grandma will help you put it up first?"
"Well, all the money is with grandma. If I want to buy books or something, grandma will take it."
Xu Haiyuan immediately laughed and nodded repeatedly.
Just like that, Zhou Guilan smiled and put away the money and passbook.
As soon as he turned his head, his smile faded away, and instead he gave Xu Shiyan a hard look.
The two of them were singing oboe in front of her eyes, I really thought she couldn't see it.
It's just for the sake of his grandson, he doesn't hesitate to care about Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan was stared at twice by his mother, and he just pretended to be silly and laughed.
"Well, Dad, Mom, it's getting late, let's go home and sleep first.
Yuanyuan hasn’t slept well in the past few days on the mountain. I think the two little ones are also sleepy. Let’s go back to rest. "
Xu Chenghou waved his hand, "Well, let's go back.
Well, take good care of the rascal, you are taking his share of the money, and you can treat him better in the future. "
The old man specially instructed Xu Shiyan.
According to the old saying, the rascal is the guardian of the family and must be treated well.
"Don't worry, when I just came back in the afternoon, I killed a chicken for it."
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it. The old man didn't need to tell him about this matter, he knew it best.
So, the couple accompanied Chu Xuanhuai and took the four children back to their home.
Yang Haoyu has gone back to his home since the day he went up the mountain to pull weeds. These days, he comes to play during the day and stays home at night.
Xu Haiyuan did not sleep well during the past few days on the mountain, so he went home to wash his body briefly, and then went back to the east room and got under the covers to sleep.
Not to mention Xu Jinping and the two little ones, they fell asleep shortly after returning home, similar to little pigs, sleeping soundly.
Waiting for the children to fall asleep, Xu Shiyan took out the ginseng seedlings from the basement and showed them to Chu Xuanhuai and Su Anying.
Su Anying has seen it several times, although the big one is indeed rare, but she is still calm.
It was Chu Xuanhuai who was very excited when he saw those ginseng trees.
"Good stuff, these are all treasures, hey, your rascal is amazing, he can hunt for treasures."
Chu Xuanhuai took the ginseng seedlings and looked at them carefully, and couldn't put it down.
For doctors, seeing rare and good medicines makes them happier than gold and silver treasures.
"Master, these are ours now, we can't sell even one seedling, we keep them all.
Tomorrow, Master and I will prepare ginseng and put it away properly. These things will become less and less in the future. "
These will be difficult to buy in the future, no matter how much money they have, it will definitely be of great use to keep them.
"Okay, okay, okay, keep it, keep it all.
Shiyan, put it away quickly, put it away carefully, remember it in the future, and don't let others see it. "
Chu Xuanhuai said three good words in succession excitedly, and then solemnly told Xu Shiyan to hide quickly.
Xu Shiyan nodded, rewrapped the ginseng, and sent it to the basement to hide carefully.
It was getting late, Xu Shiyan helped Chu Xuanhuai back to the east room to rest, and even took a special look at Lai Pigui.
Seeing it lying on the sack and sleeping soundly with its big tail covered, it made me feel relieved.
Xu Shiyan returned to his room, Su Anying had already laid out the bedding, and the water for washing feet was also prepared.
Xu Shiyan washed up, got into bed, and chatted with his daughter-in-law.
This time I got several ginseng trees, but also took out a lot of money. Xu Shiyan was afraid that his daughter-in-law would not understand, so he always had to explain a few words to her.
Su Anying didn't care much about these things. Since her man said it would be useful to keep it, it must be useful.
Besides, she spent more than one hundred thousand yuan to buy a house in the capital. What are these things today?
The two of them were chatting, and they talked about Shendi.
Su Anying said that the ginseng soil should be completed early this year. At that time, each family will re-measure and hand it over to the ginseng households who have reserved the ginseng soil.
"Didn't we hire a lot of people to dump the soil? After a few days, the work is done, and we have to pay them the wages.
It's not easy either, let's not cheat other people's money.
By the way, two people didn't come today. I heard that they accidentally fell when they got home yesterday.
I don't know what happened to the fall, and I can't come to work yet.
Tomorrow, let's see if they can go to work. If they are seriously injured, they may have to be replaced. "
Su Anying suddenly remembered that there were two fewer people working today, so she casually mentioned it.
Machine is used to plow the ground, but it is not possible to dump the soil, and manual work is required.
It takes a lot of people to pour the soil for 20,000 feet of land. How can there be so many blind people to hire? Most of them are now locals.
Many people have little ginseng land at home, or don’t plant sticks, and some people in the vegetable team in Songjianghe have no jobs, so they can only come out to work for others to earn money.
Su Anying just said it casually, but Xu Shiyan's heart skipped a beat.
Why is it such a coincidence that the two of them fell together?
Why can the two fall together? Still fell so hard? Jump up and down together?
"Daughter-in-law, do you know where those two people are from?" Xu Shiyan asked casually.

chapters.title: Chapter 502: Products from Quanyang
chapters.content:
Chapter 502 Products from Quanyang
"It seems to be from Songjianghe. Anyway, the usual work is not very good.
Sit down for a while and smoke a cigarette or something, or find someone to chat with.
Thanks to our personal piecework, the more we do, the more we earn. If we were part-time workers, we would suffer. "Su Anying thought for a while and said.
Individual piecework, that is, two yuan for one zhang of land.
People who do a good job can make more than twenty feet a day, and those who do poor work can make more than ten feet a day, so the money earned is not a small amount.
Timely workers, that is, calculated according to the time, how much is paid for a few hours a day.
Both methods have their own advantages and disadvantages.
In terms of piecework, some people work rough and fool around in order to earn more money.
So someone has to watch and supervise, and the quality must be controlled.
Time workers, needless to say, must be slow, anyway, they are paid the same money for more or less work, who is stupid, so they have to work hard?
So there must be someone watching and urging them all the time.
Su Anying and the others don't do anything else on the mountain, mainly supervisors. She knows who is doing good or bad work.
"Songjianghe's, so what, tomorrow you can see if they go to work, if not, then ask where they live.
Let Jianshe go there and settle the wages. No matter whether the work is good or bad, we don’t owe others money. "
Xu Shiyan probably knew it well, so he only asked Su Anying.
Some things still need to be inquired clearly before they can be fully understood, so as to take precautions in the future.
"Oh, okay, I didn't really want to use them at first, but if they don't come tomorrow, then I don't need them."
Su Anying didn't think about anything else, she just nodded and agreed.
After chatting for a while, the couple were both sleepy, so they went to sleep separately.
Early the next morning, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping got up, ran to the Han family to practice martial arts as usual, and then ran back to have breakfast.
After breakfast, Xu Haiyuan followed Chu Xuanhuai to the clinic.
Xu Jinping had nothing to do at home, so she simply went with Huang Shuyun, Su Lijuan, Zhao Tingting and the others to pick mushrooms in the woods with a small basket.
Behind it is a pine forest, and there are quite a lot of pine mushrooms in the forest.
Xu Jinping and the others often go into the forest, and they know where there are mushrooms. They get up early and go with their baskets, and within two hours, they can each pick up a basket of mushrooms and come back.
Mushrooms are picked up, and the pine hairs and fallen leaves are picked while they are fresh. They can be dried directly, or they can be boiled and fried with peppers.
Fresh pine mushrooms are fried and slippery, especially if you put some homemade miso, it is delicious. Children can eat an extra bowl of rice with mushrooms.
Su Anying still went up the mountain to look at Shendi. The two people who asked for leave yesterday did not come.
Su Anying found someone who was familiar with them, and asked about their addresses.
Ask Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and the others to send wages to those two when they pass by Songjiang River after work at night.
On the other side, Xu Shiyan packed up all the ginseng brought back yesterday at home, handed it to Zhou Guilan to watch, and hung it up to dry.
No way, Xu Shiyan and the others are not at home. If this thing is missed, what if the thief really goes in?
Zhou Guilan and her husband rarely go out, and there are always people at home.
In addition, Xu Shiyan brought Xiao Huang and Er Hei home yesterday, and there are two dogs looking after the home and nursing home, and there are people coming and going here, so they can't come in and grab them in broad daylight.
Zhou Guilan knew the importance, so she specially put the ginseng on the Baomi building and hung it.
The Baomilouzi is found in every household. There are four pillars at the bottom, and it looks like a small warehouse on the top. There are wooden boards nailed around it, and a small door is locked.
Two dogs were tied to the pillars of Baomilouzi. Except for my own family, when outsiders approached, the two dogs would bark their teeth and bite people, so it was safer.
Besides, no one would have thought that such a valuable ginseng could be hung in the Baomi House without knowing the basics.
Xu Shiyan took several days off, so he must go back to work.
Lin Qiyue met Xu Shiyan, but didn't ask him why he asked for leave. Anyway, there is nothing serious these days, and everything in the venue is going on as usual.
"The construction of the factory on the Canyon Spring side is progressing smoothly, but it is on the Quanyang side. I heard that they have researched a lot of things."
Being free, Lin Qiyue chatted with Xu Shiyan.
While chatting, they mentioned Quanyang, that is, the mineral water factory where Chen Jihui was the director.
"I heard people say that the factory over there not only makes wine, but also drinks.
It seems that they made some schisandra champagne, ginseng honey champagne, red bean honey champagne, and schisandra champagne puree, ginseng honey champagne puree, red bean honey champagne puree.
It seems that it has passed the technical appraisal of the city's Science and Technology Committee? "
Lin Qiyue has always been paying attention to Quanyang. Besides, even if he doesn't pay attention, someone will deliberately pass on these news, just to see a joke about participating.
There are ginseng cola, ginseng flower cola, energy source functional drinks, and mineral water in the first ginseng field, which can earn tens of millions of foreign exchange every year.
Some people think that participating in the game is purely **** luck, ordering some drinks before others, blind cats and dead mice to try their luck.
So when the factory in Quanyang was built, it also started from these aspects.
Can’t a participant produce Coke? Champagne is produced there, so it's not a thing, is it?
Once participating in the field, the formula patent or something can't restrain them.
When Lin Qiyue heard the news, he was a little bit worried. Will the champagne on the other end affect the participants here?
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this, "There is nothing to worry about, the products of the two companies are not the same.
Our original ginseng cola and ginseng flower cola were all sold out with the holy mountain Tianquan, and it was hard to open up the market.
They don't have the holy mountain Tianquan, and there is nothing too outstanding about the product formula. It is probably not enough to take the high-end route.
If you take the low-end route, unless you focus on the domestic market and sell it abroad, it is really meaningless. "
Actually, these state-owned ginseng farms in Fusong have been exploring the development and comprehensive utilization of ginseng products.
Xu Shiyan remembers that in his previous life, there were ginseng flower cola and ginseng cola, but those products were jointly developed with Huacheng soda factory.
One participant here only provides raw material concentrate juice to others, and earns more than 100,000 yuan a year.
Later, I didn’t know what was going on. The Ginseng Coke and Ginseng Flower Coke were discontinued, and there was no news.
So when Xu Shiyan was involved in research and development in this life, he no longer cooperated with Huacheng Soda Factory, but built his own factory.
Improve the formula, use natural mineral water with gas as the main body, improve product competitiveness, and export directly.
Currently, this road is on the right track. The two kinds of cola produced in one factory are gradually being accepted, and there are separate orders recently, which are no longer bound to mineral water.
As for the champagne or champagne puree, Xu Shiyan has heard of it before.
It seems that it was developed by the second participant, but there are only projects and scientific and technological achievements, but it has never been put into production, let alone any sales revenue.
It is estimated that it is Chen Jihui, who cooperates with the second participant, puts his research results into production, and wants to learn from the first participant to export and earn foreign exchange.
All right, let them try it out. In many cases, it’s not just learning from others that will lead to a smooth journey.
"It's okay, let them toss.
If they make a fuss, it will be really useful. We can also produce blueberry, blueberry fruit juice, champagne and so on. This is not difficult. "Xu Shiyan comforted Lin Qiyue.

chapters.title: Chapter 503: Lin Hai Cang Township Concert
chapters.content:
Chapter 503 Lin Haican Village Concert
One participant cooperates with the Forestry Bureau in order to lay out the domestic market.
In the spring of this year, a field technician has assisted the Forestry Bureau in planting tens of acres of small berry orchards.
It is estimated that in about three years, blueberry orchards and indigo orchards will be able to bear fruit on a large scale.
As the planting area expands, they will have the first wild berry raw material base in Northeast China.
The raw materials are in your own hands, and you can produce whatever you want without being stuck by others.
In the past two years, if the Forestry Bureau wants to produce a small amount, it is not impossible. They can buy wild fruits.
These things grow in Dadianzi, which is found in many places under the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau.
Directly mobilize the family members of the Forestry Bureau employees to enter the mountain to engage in sideline business, and the beverage factory purchases and produces according to the price.
It is not impossible to produce a small amount and sell it in this province.
After Xu Shiyan said this, Lin Qiyue was no longer worried.
Yes, their products have already opened up the market, so why are you afraid of those?
Chen Jihui just came up with a product idea, and it is still far away from being officially put into production.
Not to mention anything else, Schisandra, do they have a planting base? If not, point to the acquisition of wild ones?
Red bean honey, how much is that thing worth? Want to use that thing to export and earn foreign exchange? Is it too simple?
Thinking about it this way, Lin Qiyue didn't worry too much. If he had that time, he might as well focus on production.
It's not too far away from September, and it's time to start participating in the production of goods soon. It's better to understand my own affairs first, which is better than anything else.
"Oh, by the way, the County Federation of Literary and Art Circles plans to hold a concert in Linhai Cang Township in September, and we have to send people to attend.
I told our participating art troupe to arrange some wonderful programs. "
Originally, it was just a small talk, but when he thought about it, Lin Qiyue thought about it, so he mentioned it.
"Concert? When will it be held? Where will it be?"
Xu Shiyan didn't want to hear it, but he was very interested and asked a question.
"It seems to be mid-September? It must be in the county, where else?"
Lin Qiyue glanced at Xu Shiyan, not understanding why Xu Shiyan asked such a question.
"Oh, then I'll call Secretary Guan.
Ask if it is possible to put the venues in Songjianghe and Donggang areas in the city of Sanshi for the entire tour. "Xu Shiyan explained with a smile.
Chanshi has been completed a few days ago, with a three-story building on the north, a two-story store on the east, a row of warehouses on the south, and a wall on the west.
The middle field is made of sand and gravel mixed asphalt, which is flattened with a road roller.
Underground drainage channels and drainage wells are reserved on the ground to ensure smooth drainage in case of heavy rain.
Then leave a part of the thatch, and use the rest as an open field.
Currently, this is the only way to do it. The cost is too high for the whole roof to be covered.
Xu Shiyan originally planned to open the market in September, but he was still worrying about what activities to do during the opening to promote the market.
As soon as I heard that there was a Lin Haican Township Concert, I immediately put my mind on it.
In terms of venue, there is no better place to participate in the market. Discuss with the management secretary, maybe it will work, this is also to promote the county.
Lin Qiyue also laughed when he heard that, "Okay, I support you in this matter.
The opening of the city must be grand and lively, and the invitations should be distributed in advance. It is best to print a leaflet or something and distribute it to various villages and towns. "
The participation market is located in Donggang. The development of the participation market is also good for participation. Lin Qiyue is very supportive.
"Okay, I'll call Secretary Guan right now."
Xu Shiyan got up, returned to his office, and called Guan Enxue directly.
"Secretary Guan, it's me, Xiao Xu." The call was connected, and Xu Shiyan greeted Guan Enxue with a smile on the phone.
"Hey, you are so busy, why do you have time to call me? Tell me, what can I do for you?
Don't say you miss me, just chat with me, you are a busy person who doesn't have time to chat. "
Guan Enxue also laughed on the other end of the phone.
We are all familiar with each other, who doesn't know who?
If it's okay, why can't Xu Shiyan call Guan Enxue to chat with Guan Enxue during working hours.
"Well, I really want to ask Secretary Guan about something.
I heard that what kind of concert is going to be held in our county? On my side, isn't the market opening soon?
Can you take advantage of our county concert to promote it? "
Xu Shiyan didn't imitate Guan En's politeness, and went straight to the point, expressing his thoughts.
"I don't know how the county plans to hold this concert? Is it possible to use a touring performance?
Put the sites of Donggang and Songjianghe in Donggang Canshi? "
"Hahaha, you are the smart one, right? You will really take advantage of the opportunity." Guan Enxue laughed.
"Okay, if you don't come to me about this matter, I have to go to Chen Jianzhang and the others.
I originally meant this. Now that Donggang Sanshi and Yishenchang can be regarded as the business cards of our county, the opening of Shenshi must be given enough ostentation.
When will your place open? I set the opening ceremony of the Lin Hai Can Township Concert to be on your side. "
People get along with each other, and they are all mutual.
Xu Shiyan helped Guan Enxue to help the county several times, and Guan Enxue knew it in his heart. At this time, he must support Xu Shiyan.
"The opening is scheduled for September 12th. If the date is out of sync with the concert, it can be adjusted." Xu Shiyan said hurriedly after hearing this.
"No, the concert was originally scheduled to be on September 12th, so that's it, the opening ceremony of the concert will be on the same day as the opening of Sanshi.
You prepare the venue, backstage, and rest area on your side, and you must keep our actors in the best condition and perform energetically. "
Guan Enxue is determined to fully support the city, regardless of the date of the concert, as long as the city opens, it must be the same day.
"Thank you, Secretary Guan, don't worry, everything will be ready here, and we will cover all the actors' food and lodging."
Xu Shiyan is not talking crazy, the three-story building in the north of the city, the hotel on the first floor, the second floor, and the third floor.
Public rooms plus standard rooms, there are nearly 100 rooms in total, and the reception must be no problem.
"Okay, then it's settled like this. The opening of the market must be grand and focused, and everyone who should be invited will be invited.
The county will set up the stage for you. As for whether you can sing well in the opera, it depends on your ability. "
Guan Enxue made a decision directly, and the matter was settled.
Hung up the phone, Xu Shiyan immediately called Chen Jianzhang, and discussed with Chen Jianzhang about the opening of the market.
This is currently the biggest project in Donggang Township, and the town naturally does its best to support it.
Chen Jianzhang said that the opening ceremony must be as grand as possible. The town will arrange people to be responsible for the reception of guests and actors, so we must do our best.
With the support of the town and county, Xu Shiyan can let go of his preparations.
So I asked Li Chengrong, who has been promoted to the chief of the sales department, to help design the leaflet and find a printing factory to print it.
After discussing with Zhou Qingguo, let the town arrange a few people to go on a business trip with them, and go to the medicinal material shops in Yingkou, Dalian, and some southern cities together, and send leaflets and invitation letters to them.
If you want to make Donggang City famous all at once, you must have customers.
Only when there are customers to buy, can farmers be willing to trade, and the market can prosper.

chapters.title: Chapter 504: opposing view
chapters.content:
Chapter 504 Objections
On the other side, after Guan Enxue hung up the phone, he immediately notified the relevant units.
The time of Lin Hai Can Township Concert was changed to September 12th, and the opening ceremony and first performance were arranged in Donggang Can City.
As soon as the news came out, many people in the county did not understand.
Many people think that Guan Enxue is too partial to Donggang, and it is really irrational to do so.
Some people also question whether Guan Enxue has received any benefits, so he is always planning for Donggang to participate in the market.
Some people approached Guan Enxue to report the situation, and some directly raised doubts in person.
Guan Enxue had no choice but to call people temporarily and hold a meeting.
"You all think that I am partial to Donggang, and I am escorting Donggang City.
You think that the existence of Donggang Ginseng City itself violates the provincial policy on the unified purchase and marketing of ginseng, right? "
Guan Enxue cut to the chase, preemptively, and asked all the participants directly.
"Secretary Guan, our county has always implemented the policy of the higher authorities, and the ginseng business has unified pricing, unified purchase, and unified sales.
The emergence of this ginseng market will break this situation, and will cause foreign merchants and even foreign merchants to directly face-to-face with ginseng farmers or ginseng farms.
If this happens, it will disrupt the management of the ginseng market in Er County and even our province, and the price will be out of control.
If there are serious consequences, we cannot take responsibility. "
Sure enough, as soon as Guan Enxue finished speaking, someone eagerly stood up to express his opinion.
Before, everyone didn’t pay much attention to Donggang Sanshi.
Don’t look at the fact that when the foundation stone was laid last year, people from the county also went there. In fact, many people still have a skeptical and negative attitude towards this participation in the city.
I feel that it is just a market created by a small town and an individual, and it is just a small mess.
Under the current unified purchase and marketing policy, how much can the market develop?
Can the individual market be compared with acquisitions by related departments? Isn't the main one still the county ginseng company and the provincial medicinal material company and health care product company?
The publicity is not strong enough, farmers don’t recognize it, and there are no merchants from other places. What kind of transaction does the market refer to? Without the transaction volume, the participation in the market simply cannot continue.
Even though the foundation laying was very grand and prosperous, the real test came later.
But if Guan Enxue moved the opening ceremony and the first performance of Lin Hai Can Township Concert to Donggang Can City, the effect would be different.
With this publicity, all farmers in the county and even surrounding counties know about it.
If there are more foreign merchants coming to buy, then this market is likely to become prosperous.
This will have a certain impact on the operation of the county ginseng company, and the loss will be huge.
Of course, the last reason can only be that everyone knows it well but it is not appropriate to announce it.
To put it simply, the existence of the ginseng market will affect the interests of many people.
This is the reason for their opposition.
"Childish. Do you think that without this participation in the market, there would be no private transactions for participation in agriculture?
Since 1983, every autumn and winter, some people will go to remote villages and towns to buy the stocks in the hands of Cannon.
Then they went to Tonghua, Changchun, Shenyang and other places to sell. Make money from the difference. "
Guan Enxue shook his head, some people are short-sighted and self-righteous.
Always put on a high air, don't understand the actual situation, only know how to sing high-profile.
"If you don't believe me, go down and ask, ask, are there many villages and towns that our county belongs to?
In fact, there are a large part of participating farmers. For convenience, they sell directly to those second-hand traffickers.
And these second-hand traffickers go from village to household, it is difficult to manage, this is the disadvantage. "
"The ginseng market itself is trying to curb this phenomenon.
Put the private transactions between farmers and second-hand traffickers on the table, and standardize the operation, so that the market can be effectively regulated. "
"The five-year acquisition contract signed by our county with the provincial medicinal material company and the provincial medical and health care product company has an order base.
In the past two years, the production of ginseng has increased significantly, which has exceeded the order base by a lot, and it is currently operated by ginseng companies.
If the production of ginseng continues to grow, our county does not have the ability to purchase it in full. If so, it will cause a large backlog.
The emergence of the ginseng market can attract foreign businessmen, which itself is a supplement to the lack of purchasing power of ginseng companies.
As long as the relevant policies are implemented in place, the price can still be controlled. "
"Everyone, we have been open for many years, and our thinking cannot remain rigid. We must keep up with the pace of the times.
Otherwise, you will be eliminated. "Guan Enxue couldn't help shaking his head and sighing at the end.
This is the gap between the north and the south. When the market economy has been generally invigorated in the south, they are still rigid in thinking and self-sufficient here.
How can this keep up with the trend of the times?
Guan Enxue's words made some people understand, but some people still insisted on their original ideas.
But Guan Enxue is a very courageous person, and several deputy county supervisors also agree with Guan Enxue's point of view.
So the matter of the opening ceremony of the concert was finally decided like this.
Official documents were directly distributed to units at all levels. On September 12th, the opening ceremony and first performance of the Linhai Cancan Township Concert was held in Donggang Canshi.
All relevant departments participating in the concert performance must make preparations in advance.
Donggang Town and Baishan Ginseng Comprehensive Company, which is the company opened by Su Anying and others, are responsible for the venue, stage and related reception work.
The documents were officially sent to Donggang, Chen Jianzhang and Su Anying were really relieved now.
There is still nearly a month before September 12th, which is enough for them to make adequate preparations.
The printed promotional pages and invitations were all ready, so Su Anying and Zhou Qingguo hurriedly arranged for a business trip.
While distributing promotional pages to various villages and towns, on the other hand, arrange for people to send invitations.
If there is an address, direct mail, if there is no address, simply arrange for someone to send it directly with the invitation. All merchants who come with invitations will be provided with food and accommodation here.
In order to do a good job in the reception work, the hotels in Shenshi and the guest house in Donggang Town are all making preparations.
At the same time, Xu Shiyan also greeted the Shenchang Guest House and the Forestry Bureau Guest House.
Naturally, there is no problem on the side of the field, and there is Guo Shouye on the other side of the Forestry Bureau, so there will be no trouble.
Mid-August is the time when ginseng seeds are ripe and red.
Mature ginseng seeds must be picked in time, the peels are washed off, and the seeds are left to dry in the shade.
Then either save it and distribute ginseng seeds next summer, or directly distribute ginseng seeds this year.
Retained ginseng seeds are usually frozen for this year.
Because the new planting is too small, the ginseng seeds produced are not good, and the ginseng seeds are left in the year of production, and the pulp of the mallet is insufficient, so it is easy to ditch and not weigh the scale.
In the ditch and pond on the Kaifeng fork road, each family left fifty feet of ginseng soil, of which forty feet were planted with ginseng, and ten feet were sown with seeds.
The forty-foot stick happened to be the ginseng seeds left by freezing this year. At this time, it's time to pinch the ginseng seeds.
But on Xu Shiyan's side, it happened that foreign businessmen came to visit, and Su Anying's side was busy preparing for the opening of the market, and no one went to pinch the seeds.

chapters.title: Chapter 505: Raipi can't go up the mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 505 The rascal can't go up the mountain anymore
"What's the matter? The ginseng seeds are red, so you have to pinch them back quickly, otherwise it's easy to fall, and you'll be eaten by raccoon sticks and mice."
Xu Cheng was in a hurry, so he talked to Zhou Guilan.
The raccoon stick that Xu Chenghou mentioned is actually a chipmunk, a type of squirrel.
There are several patterns on the back, so the locals call it Hualibangzi or chipmunk.
Chipmunks eat all kinds of nuts or seeds, and ginseng seeds can't escape being eaten by it.
Even though this little thing doesn't grow very big, those two cheeks are especially good at hiding things, and a few ginseng seeds are more than enough.
In addition to chipmunks, voles will also steal ginseng seeds, and even some birds will steal ginseng seeds after they start to turn red.
In order to prevent the ginseng seeds from being harmed, most people mix rat poison such as zinc phosphide with melon seeds or peanuts when the ginseng seeds just turn red, and sprinkle them on the surface of the pool to poison the mice or chipmunks to death.
Wait until the ginseng seeds are completely red, and pick them back quickly.
But the Xu family is busy, no one cares about pinching the ginseng seeds, can Xu Chenghou not be in a hurry?
"Grandpa, if it doesn't work, my sister and I will go up the mountain to pinch ginseng seeds, shall we?
My parents are busy, we can do this job. Seeing that Grandpa was in a hurry to get angry, Xu Haiyuan proposed.
"Huh? You go? No, no, no nonsense.
The last time you went to work in the mountains, hey, I was worried at home, so don't go. "
As a result, Zhou Guilan waved her hands quickly when she heard it, no, the children can no longer be allowed to go up the mountain.
"Grandma, it's okay, this time we won't go into the woods, we will just work in the field, and we will never run around.
Well, didn’t Uncle Zhao and the others also have a ginseng land on Kaifeng’s side? It seems that my second uncle's house also has ginseng land over there, right?
That's just right, let's go together, we will keep it safe and not run around. "
If Xu Haiyuan didn't see how busy his family was, he really couldn't take care of it, so he didn't care.
School is about to start, and he wants to learn more from the teacher.
Xu Chenghou thought about it, and what his grandson said made sense. The family is really busy, so what can we do?
"That's fine, I'll follow along and call Xiaobo Xiaotao and the others.
The second child's family has only twenty feet of sticks, and the few of us have pinched back all the ginseng seeds in a day. "
Xu Chenghou has spoken, what else can Zhou Guilan do? "Then wait for your son and daughter-in-law to come back, and you can tell them."
In the evening, when Xu Shiyan and Su Anying went home, Xu Chenghou and Xu Haiyuan brought up the matter of pinching ginseng seeds.
Xu Shiyan sighed, "If it doesn't work, I can only do as my father said.
Oh, everything has been rushed together these days, who would have thought that a foreign customer would come over suddenly and say that he was coming for an inspection.
Accompanies them to visit water plants, water sources, and processing plants every day.
Hey? They also have to climb Changbai Mountain.
I said, let’s just go up the west slope, but they still don’t agree, so they have to climb the north slope.
Tomorrow I will accompany them there, I have to live in Erdaobaihe for a day, and climb the mountain the day after tomorrow, oh my god, I am so worried. "
Although they grew up at the foot of Changbai Mountain, to be honest, most people have never climbed Changbai Mountain unless they are engaged in sideline business or hunting up the mountain, and no one takes it as a big deal.
Since August 1983, when the old man climbed Changbai Mountain and wrote an inscription with his own hand, Changbai Mountain became famous.
I don’t know how this foreign businessman knows, but he has to go to the North Slope, to see the waterfall, to see the Chengcha River, and to see the autograph.
This autumn is already busy, so I can't say I won't accompany you.
Lin Qiyue said, let Xu Shiyan and Li Chengrong take the translator and accompany the foreign merchants to the North Slope.
"Dad, are you going to climb Changbai Mountain? Oh, I want to go too."
When Xu Haiyuan heard that he was going to climb a mountain, his eyes widened immediately, full of anticipation.
"Next year, next year Haiqing and Huihui will be older too, let's go hiking with the family when the weather is nice.
Dad hasn’t been there either, this time it’s a front stop, okay? "Xu Shiyan touched the top of his son's head and comforted him.
Xu Shiyan went to Wangchi to collect Niu Mao Guang in his previous life, and he also went to the alpine tundra to plan Rhodiola.
But when it comes to sightseeing, he has never been to Changbai Mountain, let alone the North Slope.
It's his daughter, who used to be a tour guide, and often goes to the north and west slopes of Changbai Mountain. When she comes back, she will tell Xu Shiyan what she has seen on the mountain.
In fact, Xu Shiyan also wants to know, what is the difference between climbing a mountain today and climbing a mountain decades later.
Xu Haiyuan nodded when he heard it, "Well, then next year."
Children are easy to be satisfied, since Dad said next year, then go next year.
Just like that, it was decided to pick the ginseng seeds tomorrow.
Xu Shiyan called the farm and told Xu Shian to ask Xu Shian to bring his two sons to work on the mountain with Xu Chenghou tomorrow.
It happened that Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others didn't pick the seeds, so they simply discussed and went there in one day.
At six o'clock in the morning on August 16th, Xu Shian drove over from the farm.
Xu Chenghou and his grandchildren all changed into working clothes, brought water and a lot of food, so they planned to go up the mountain to pick ginseng seeds.
Before he got in the car, Sun Yu from Sun Xiaofeng's house next door came out and yelled at Xu Haiyuan.
"Haiyuan, do you want to bring your rascally ghost with you today? Or take it with you."
I don’t know whether Sun Yu is joking, or if he really wants to take the rascal.
"Slow down your voice, it will be terrible for him to hear you." When Xu Chenghou heard this, he quickly waved his hands in fright.
"We are going to work today to pick ginseng seeds, and we don't go into the woods, why bring it? We have to take care of it."
Are you kidding, this is a serious job to do, it's different from the time weeding the weeds before, and you must not bring the rascals to make trouble.
If it hears it, it must follow.
Xu Haiyuan smiled when he saw his grandfather like that, "Grandpa, don't be afraid, the rascal is lazy today.
Before we went out just now, my sister ran to Raipi Ghost and asked if it wanted to go up the mountain with us.
Lai Pigui ignored her, rolled his tail, turned over and continued to sleep. "
Recalling the situation just now, Xu Haiyuan wanted to laugh.
After getting up and packing up in the morning, Xu Jinping said, go up the mountain today, or go ask Lai Pigui if he wants to follow.
Let it also go out for a stroll to relax.
As soon as Xu Haiyuan heard this, he hurriedly stopped them, saying that they were going to work, and they couldn't bring rascals with them.
As a result, Xu Jinping refused to listen, and had to go to the rascal.
Xu Haiyuan was quite worried at first, if the rascal really followed up the mountain, what if something goes wrong again?
Who would have imagined it? Xu Jinping called Lai Pigui several times and told it to go up the mountain. As a result, Lai Pigui didn't even open his eyes and didn't even look at them.
The little thing turned over, covered its big tail, and slept soundly.
Xu Chenghou laughed out loud when he heard it, why don't you say that this rascal is about to become a genius?
"Come on, then there is nothing to do, let's go, let's go up the mountain to work.
After pinching the ginseng seeds, I have to wash them quickly, and take advantage of the good weather recently, and dry them quickly. "

chapters.title: Chapter 506: pinch ginseng seeds
chapters.content:
Chapter 506 Pinch Ginseng Seeds
Xu Shian was driving, pulling along Xu Chenghou, Xu Haibo, Xu Haitao, Xu Haiyuan, and Xu Jinping.
Together with Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli, they went to the venue on the other side of the Kaifeng fork.
The so-called Kaifeng Fork Road is a road that forks eastward on the half way from Songjiang River to Quanyang.
This road belongs to the firewood transportation road of the Forestry Bureau, and this road will diverge if you go inward.
There are Kaifeng Forest Farm, Xilinhe Nursery, Shuguang Forest Farm, Qianchuan Forest Farm, Shengli Forest Farm, and Dajianchang Village under Donggang Town.
The Xu family's ginseng land is just ten miles north of the fork in the road, and it is not far to walk in. It used to be a few ditches and ponds.
The year before last, Xu Shiyan approved the ginseng soil and bought this area. The area is not large, about three thousand feet.
At the beginning, each family kept fifty feet, and sold the rest.
The area of ​​the ginseng land is small, so Xu Shiyan didn't bother to think about it. It happened that someone said that they wanted to buy ginseng, so they directly gave it to others.
Here, Xu Chenghou has been here before, when it snowed before, he went up to work on the mountain.
Arriving here, he walked into the venue with ease, and led the child straight to his home.
"Well, second child, you lead Xiaotao, and the two of you go to pinch your house.
Xiaobo is in a group with Yuanyuan, and I am with Pingping, we will pinch this end.
Let's hurry up and work, this thing will be finished in less than a day. "
As soon as he arrived at the head of Chi Chuan in his own garden, Xu Chenghou hurriedly arranged work.
"Success, then do as father ordered.
That, Dad, don’t worry, take your time, Xiaotao and I will finish pinching the ginseng seeds in no time, and I’ll come over to help you when the time comes. "
Xu Shian nodded, and instructed the old man again.
Pinch ginseng seeds, usually in groups of two, kneeling on top of Chi Gangzi facing each other.
Reach out and cut off the tender stems under the red ginseng fruit, and then put the ginseng fruit into the basket.
Some ginsengs grow shorter, and you have to poke the ginseng leaves with your hands, so as not to miss them.
Speaking of this work, it is not too tiring. The main thing is that you have to bend your body to work under the shed, and your waist is tired.
Children can be better, short, small and dexterous.
At Xu Chenghou's age, it is really not easy to do this job again.
That's why Xu Shi'an specifically asked his father, for fear that his father would be brave and tired again.
"Okay, let's work quickly.
Yuanyuan, Pingping, you two have little hands, if you can't pinch, use scissors.
When you went out in the morning, didn’t your grandma bring scissors for the two of you? "
For adults, it is fastest to pinch directly.
But for children, they are small and have no strength, and their hands are tender. If they pinch them with their hands, even if they can be cut off, it is estimated that after pinching a few flowers, their tired fingers will hurt.
So when she came out in the morning, Zhou Guilan specially brought scissors for the two children and asked them to use the scissors to cut down.
Just put in a little effort, it's better than a child with a sore hand.
"Hey, I see, Grandpa."
The two children agreed crisply, and then they carried the basket and scissors, starting from the end of the pool, kneeling on the pool to work.
Under the ginseng shed, there are ginseng seedlings more than one foot high. On top of the blue-purple main stem, there are five palmate compound leaves in whorls. On the top, there is a bright red ginseng fruit.
Xu’s family took good care of the mallet. The base fertilizer used when planting ginseng was topped with bean cake water this spring, and foliar fertilizer was sprayed in summer.
So the leaves of this ginseng grow very well, green and black.
The flowers of ginseng seeds are also big, similar to Xu Jinping's fist.
Blooming red ginseng fruit, plump, round and shiny, looks extraordinarily rare.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping both took scissors and carefully cut off the ginseng fruit one by one and put them in the basket.
Wait until the basket is full, then carry it to the head of the pool, and pour it into the woven bag.
Chi face is wide, and one person cannot cover them all, so two people have to work face to face.
Xu Jinping's small arms are short, so she must not be able to reach the middle, so Xu Chenghou stretched his hand in.
The grandparents and grandson cooperated well. Although they couldn't work as fast as Xu Shian and the others, anyway, after a while, they could carry a basket of ginseng fruits and pour them into the woven bag.
When you are tired, take a break, and then do it again.
By noon, Xu Chenghou and Xu Jinping, who were twenty feet long, had done most of the work.
The weather was hot, and everyone didn't go to see the small room at noon, but just took out the dry food and water they had brought, and ate casually on the ground.
Huang Shuqing, Feng Bin, and Sun Yu also came up the mountain. The big guys got together and exchanged meals with each other.
For children like Huang Shuqing who don't like studying very much, working in the mountains is much more interesting than reading at home.
Xu Shi'an and his youngest son finished picking up their own ginseng seeds in the morning, and helped Xu Chenghou and the others in the afternoon, so the work was done before three o'clock.
So he drove the people and ginseng seeds, went straight down the mountain, took Xu Chenghou, his grandparents and grandchildren home, and then drove back to the farm.
