Xu Chenghou and his grandpa and grandson returned home early, so they quickly poured the ginseng fruit out of the woven bag, and rolled the red ginseng fruit off the torus one by one.
The red ones fall off easily when you touch them. Occasionally, if there are half-green and unripe flowers, you just pick them off one by one. In fact, most of these flowers are flat.
Pick off a small red kidney-shaped fruit, and you need to grate the thin outer skin and wash it with water.
Xu Chenghou led his grandson, put the small fruit into a woven bag, and asked Xu Haiyuan and the others to step on the bag with their shoes on.
After stepping on it for a while, I saw some reddish-brown juice flowing out from the bottom of the woven bag, which is the juice that flowed out from the crushed pulp.
It is said that this juice can also be used as medicine, and Sanshenchang is researching ginseng fruit granules.
Of course, the average ginseng farmers don't care much, they are just like Xu Chenghou, just step on it and let it flow into the ditch.
The children stepped on for a while, turned the woven bag over and shook it, and continued to step on it.
Wait until the juice flowing out of it becomes less and less, pour some water into it, tie the pocket tightly and step on it for a while, then pour it into a large basin and rinse it with clean water.
Good mature seeds will sink to the bottom of the water, and those floating on the water surface are deflated, and most of them will float out.
Just like that, scrub and then rinse, leaving the snow-white ginseng seeds in the end, take them out, pour them on a fork that has been covered with gauze, and drain the water.
Ginseng seeds should be dried, but not exposed to the sun.
It is necessary to put it in a cool place when the sun is poisonous during the day, and take it out when the sun is not so strong in the morning and evening.
If the drying is not timely, the seeds will be powdered.
If it is exposed to the sun, it will be easily roasted and will not germinate, so this thing is extraordinarily delicate.
Dried ginseng seeds, if the ginseng seeds were directly grown in the same year, this is called hair water seeds.
Because the ginseng seeds have not gone through the dormancy period, the germination rate is not high and they are easy to rot.
If it is kept properly for one year, ginseng seeds will be grown in the next summer, which is called dry seeds.
Dried seeds have a high germination rate and a high seedling preservation rate, much better than water seeds.
Xu Shiyan has no shortage of ginseng seeds, so naturally he refuses to produce water seeds.
These ginseng seeds can be dried and put away, waiting for the seeds to dry next summer, and then planted in autumn.

chapters.title: Chapter 507: God is not good
chapters.content:
Chapter 507 God is not beautiful
Here, Xu Chenghou led his grandson to wash the ginseng seeds and spread them out on a fork to dry before eating and resting.
On the other side, Xu Shiyan and Li Chengrong took two translators and accompanied several foreign merchants to Erdaobaihe Town by train.
In this year and month, the environmental protection road from the west **** to the north **** has not yet been repaired, and there are only firewood transportation roads between various forest farms.
The firewood road was built for logging and transporting timber down the mountain.
In order to facilitate transportation, it is always repaired wherever there is a cutting area, and it is often a big turn.
The mountain road is rugged, and driving is too troublesome and dangerous. It is more convenient and safer to take the train.
Erdaobaihe Town is under the jurisdiction of Antu.
Even though they are two adjacent counties, Erdaobai River is not too far from Songjiang River, but it has a different style.
This is a place where ethnic minorities live in concentrated areas, most of whom are Korean compatriots.
Therefore, there is a strong ethnic style here. On the street, especially women, most of them wear brightly colored clothes, with short tops and long skirts underneath.
Many people do not speak Chinese, but the Korean language.
Even some newspapers and magazines are written in the Korean language, and even the signboards on both sides of the street are mostly in two languages.
Although they are all yellow-skinned people, they look similar in appearance, but if you look closely, there are still some differences.
The foreigner is very curious looking at this place, so he has to ask.
Li Chengrong has studied foreign languages ​​in the provincial capital for two years, and ordinary conversation is no problem, but it takes a little more effort to answer this kind of question.
Fortunately, there is a professional translator, so Xu Shiyan talked about the development and changes of the dynasty.
The foreigner was very interested and asked questions one after another.
Xu Shiyan said everything he knew and could say, and naturally he would not talk about some sensitive topics.
It stands to reason that when you come to this kind of ethnic minority settlement, you must experience the special customs of the ethnic minority area, and at least taste the special food.
There are still a lot of Chao nationality cuisines, such as cakes, rice sausages, sauce muli soup, and cold noodles, but the most famous one is dog meat.
Xu Shiyan does not eat dog meat, but anyone who hunts does not eat it. Dogs are partners for them.
And Xu Shiyan is worried that many countries in Europe and the United States prohibit the consumption of dog meat.
He didn't know whether these people would eat or not, so he didn't dare to decide on his own, so he asked the translator to ask.
Sure enough, when the foreigners heard about eating dog meat, they all refused.
I don’t eat dog meat, and there are no western restaurants here, so I can only eat whatever I want.
Fortunately, those foreigners just don’t eat dog meat, but they can eat other dishes.
It’s hot, so everyone ordered a cold noodle, roast beef, rice cake, rice sausage, etc., with Korean pickles, and that’s it.
Cold noodles are made of white flour mixed with corn noodles or buckwheat noodles, starch, etc., pressed out by a machine, cooked in a pot and taken out.
After cooling with cold water, add the cold and refreshing soup, as well as side dishes such as beef slices, cucumber shreds, tomato slices, eggs, spicy cabbage, and spicy sauce.
The soup is sweet and sour, cold and refreshing, and the beef slices in sauce are also very tasty. It is really comfortable to eat on a hot day.
Foreigners are still rare these days, and many people around look at them.
Xu Shiyan could only smile and nod to those people, signaling that the world should not point and point at those foreigners.
But this is difficult to prohibit, and Xu Shiyan has no choice.
After all, this is a remote town, not a big city. This is really unavoidable.
After eating, I have to find a place to live.
This is not a county seat. At present, the tourism industry has not developed to the level of later generations. There must be no high-end hotels, only Chao nationality hotels.
The house here is also very distinctive. The door is a sliding door, and the inside of the house is a floor kang. You take off your shoes when you enter the house.
Two people share a room, Xu Shiyan and Li Chengrong live together, and sleep on the kang at night, which is not bad.
"I hope tomorrow will be a sunny day, and we can see Tianchi when we go up."
Before going to bed, Li Chengrong said so.
Just now he specifically went to inquire about it, and said that it has been sunny for the past few days, and it was hard to come here, and everyone wanted to go up to see Tianchi.
But no one expected that when they got up early the next morning, it was gloomy outside. It didn't rain, but there was fog.
Xu Shiyan could only sigh when he saw the sky outside, probably this time it was for nothing.
After breakfast, go to the designated place to take the bus.
Climbing Changbai Mountain this year is different from later generations. There are no eco-friendly cars or reverse cars.
There are only big passengers, who send people to the climbing point at the bottom of the mountain, and then tourists climb up by themselves.
Tickets are not expensive, five yuan per person.
Since we are here, no matter whether it is cloudy or sunny, we must go up and have a look.
So a group of people got on the bus, walked up the mountain road slowly, and headed for the mountain.
Sitting in the car, I can only see the continuous mountains and trees coming towards me, and then flashing past the car endlessly.
People like Xu Shiyan and Li Chengrong, who lived in the mountains and forests since childhood, didn't feel anything at all.
But those guests from other places felt strange, pointing to the scenery outside the car window from time to time and exclaiming.
There are also some people who are whispering, hoping that the weather will clear up, at least it will not rain.
The bus ride point is still dozens of kilometers away from the climbing point. As the car goes higher and higher, the fog outside is getting thicker and thicker.
When the car drove to the climbing point, the fog had turned into drizzle.
Near the climbing point, there are hotels and restaurants, as well as a place specializing in hot spring eggs. The construction is not bad.
At this moment, they are all shrouded in misty rain and fog.
Looking far ahead, the high-hanging Tianchi Waterfall is also shrouded in rain and fog, and the water vapor below is transpiring, making it even more hazy and mysterious.
Before coming, Xu Shiyan had prepared raincoats, so he quickly took them out and everyone put them on.
Climbing at this time, you have to go up the Julong Hot Springs, and walk up the stone-step corridor on the side of the waterfall.
Go all the way to Chengcha River, go up and down along the river to the edge of Tianchi.
The stone steps in the corridor next to the waterfall are steep and difficult to walk. There are many places where you can’t wait to use your hands and feet, and you really have to climb up.
Mountain climbing is very difficult on sunny days, not to mention this rainy day. There are moss on the stone steps, and it is very slippery in rainy days. Mountain climbing is extremely dangerous.
Many tourists went directly to the hotel, so they refused to take the risk of climbing in such weather.
Under such circumstances, Xu Shiyan naturally refused to let those foreigners climb the mountain again.
But they were all stubborn and insisted on going up. In desperation, Xu Shiyan could only go forward with him.
Just after passing the hot spring, if you walk further, you can hear the sound of the waterfall rushing.
The water from the waterfall is slightly light blue in color, rolling up foam, and roaring under a small bridge.
After walking a short distance, it became difficult to walk on my feet.
At this time, the rain seemed to be much heavier, and several foreigners began to hesitate whether to continue to move forward.
At this time, on the bare hillside in the distance, a lot of sand and stone rolled down with a whirring sound.
This Changbai Mountain was originally a dormant volcano, and the main body of the mountain is volcanic ash, which is loose in texture.
In rainy days, some loose sand and gravel will fall down.
The foreigners were obviously frightened, and this time they didn’t insist anymore, and hurriedly turned their heads and went down the mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 508: hot spring boiled eggs
chapters.content:
Chapter 508 Hot Spring Boiled Eggs
The main peak of Changbai Mountain has high altitude, low temperature, strong wind and abundant water.
When it rains, the temperature drops sharply. Even in the summer, it can make people shiver.
Even if Xu Shiyan and his party were wearing long-sleeved trousers and thick clothes, as well as a raincoat, they couldn't stand the cold, so the group went straight into a restaurant.
At this time, there were more people in the restaurant, noisy and steaming.
Most people are sighing, it is rare to come to Changbai Mountain, but they catch up with such weather.
Some people said that they should stay in a hotel in the mountains and see if the weather will be fine tomorrow.
Xu Shiyan had to consult the opinions of those merchants. If they wanted to stay, they had to book a room quickly.
Several foreigners shook their heads regretfully. Their itinerary has fixed arrangements, and there is really no extra time to stay.
There was no other way, so Xu Shiyan had to go out, bought a bag of hot spring boiled eggs, and ordered a few stir-fried dishes in this restaurant.
The big guys opened all the cans and other things they brought before going up the mountain. At the starting point of the mountain climbing, the big guys had lunch.
The hot spring boiled eggs are a bit interesting. The egg yolk is solidified, but the egg white is not completely solidified, and it tastes slightly sulfurous.
Everyone thought it was fresh, and ate most of the bag of eggs.
After lunch, the rain on the mountain became heavier and heavier. Xu Shiyan and the others could only take a bus down the mountain, and then dared to go to Erdaobaihe Railway Station, and took the afternoon train back.
When I arrived at the foot of the mountain, I found that the sky was still cloudy, but it was not raining.
Everyone can't help but sigh with emotion, no wonder it is said that "a mountain has four seasons, and the sky is different for ten miles." It is indeed a well-deserved reputation.
With regret, the group boarded the train from Erdaobaihe to Songjianghe again, and it was already evening when they arrived home.
Songjiang River here is a sunny day, the sun sets in the west, and the sky and clouds in the west are reflected orange-red, magnificent and gorgeous.
Before boarding the train, Xu Shiyan found a place to call his work unit, so the jeeps who participated in the show were already waiting outside the train station.
So the foreigners were sent back to the hostel to settle down, while Xu Shiyan went home directly.
"Huh? Why are you back so early?"
Su Anying and Zhou Guilan, who were busy serving meals on the table and preparing to have dinner, were surprised when they saw Xu Shiyan come back.
Didn't you say when you left that you have to come back tomorrow morning? Why did you get home tonight?
"Hey, don't mention it, it was quite sunny when we were there yesterday, and the heat is unbearable.
As a result, it was cloudy when I woke up this morning, and it was raining on the mountain, so I couldn't climb the mountain at all.
No way, we can only come back. " Xu Shiyan shook his head and sighed.
It’s rare to go back to Changbai Mountain, not to mention the Tianchi Lake, I didn’t even go to the edge of the Tianchi Lake, I can only look at the waterfall from a distance at the foot of the mountain.
It is impossible to say that there is no regret.
"Huh? Is it raining over there? It's not raining at all at home, but the sun is good.
How far do you think it is, why is there such a big difference? "Su Anying was also amazed when she heard this.
"Okay, hurry up and wash your hands and eat, this is probably waiting for you to lead us to climb mountains next year.
At that time, if the weather is good, we might be able to go up. "Su Anying smiled and comforted her man.
Xu Shiyan is a big man, why can't he get through this little thing?
"Well, we're close, we can go whenever we want.
Let’s go to eat. I also brought a few hot spring eggs, and I will give the children a taste when I come back. "
He bought too much on the mountain, and he didn't finish eating at noon, so he put the rest in his pocket, just in time for the children to taste.
The children were very happy to see their father, and they were also very curious about the hot spring eggs that their father brought back.
But when the egg was opened and found that the egg white was not cooked, Xu Haiyuan frowned and looked embarrassed.
"Dad, how do you eat this, it's not cooked yet."
"It was really boiled in the hot spring, and the hot spring water on the mountain is only 85 degrees, so it was boiled like this.
The yellow inside is ripe, and the outside is half-cooked. Try it, it's quite delicious. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and explained it to the children.
"Okay, then I'll try it." Xu Haiyuan ate the egg with a look of reluctance.
It may be because the eggs are cold, but they didn’t taste so delicious anyway.
Eggs, no matter how hard you try, you can’t taste other flavors.
Maybe for other children, eggs are rare, but for Xu Haiyuan and the others, it is really not rare to eat eggs at home.
It's just that my father carried it all the way back from the mountain, so the children don't want to waste it.
Changbai Mountain has not been climbed, but the ginseng seeds at home have dried up.
Two days later, until August 19th, it's time for the children to return to school.
At this time, Xu Shiyan also received news from the Agricultural University.
Before, Xu Shiyan asked someone through his connections to send Xu Shian to the Agricultural University to study animal husbandry and veterinary medicine at his own expense.
The Agricultural University replied that Xu Shian can go to school now, try to report before the end of September, so as not to delay the course.
"Father, my second brother can go to college this time." Xu Shiyan hung up the phone and told Xu Chenghou the good news.
Don't care whether to give a diploma or a diploma, Xu Shi'an went to study for two years, at least he has finished college.
No matter what time it is, reading is always useful.
Xu Chenghou was also very happy to hear that, but he was worried about the tuition fee again.
"Hey, the second child is different from you. He is studying at his own expense, so he earns a lot of money, right?"
"It's not bad, it's not too expensive, the tuition fee is not much, the main thing is that you have to pay for your own food and accommodation."
It doesn’t cost much to go to college these days, even if it’s all at your own expense, the fees are not high.
Others not only don’t spend money to go to university, but also have various subsidies. If you live economically, you can save some money.
Xu Shi’an can’t do this, he has to pay for meals and lodging himself, which is more expensive.
"Oh, oh, then tell your second brother to save a little and don't spend like crazy."
All the expenses of Xu Shian's study abroad were paid by Xu Shiyan.
The old man is not partial to anyone, but mainly because he loves money.
Most people in this year have this kind of thinking, they are very simple, proud of hard work, and ashamed of extravagance and waste.
"Yes, yes, I know." Xu Shiyan responded casually, but he didn't intend to really say that to his second brother.
How much can one person spend on food and drink?
Xu Shian is married, has a wife and children, how can he not know how to live?
If Xu Shiyan asked these things again, it would be superfluous, as if he couldn't afford his second brother to study.
Xu Shian was naturally very happy to hear the news.
He discussed this matter with his wife, and Wei Mingrong was okay and quite supportive.
In the autumn of 1983, with the support of his younger brother, Xu Shi'an planted ten-foot-long sticks in the garden behind his house.
Xu Shi'an made some calculations, the school told him to report before the end of September, and he must pick up the stick before leaving.
There is no need to worry about selling, just ask Xu Shiyan to help with it when the time comes.
So it was decided to start making goods on September 15th.

chapters.title: Chapter 509: nervous preparation
chapters.content:
Chapter 509 Intense preparations
In the blink of an eye, September entered, the weather gradually turned cooler, and the leaves on the trees began to turn yellow.
It’s been a few days since the children started school, and after having played like crazy for a summer vacation, the children gradually put away their nonsense and started to study hard.
Especially for students like Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, and Yang Haoyu, who are academically dominant, they can quickly enter the learning state without the teacher staring at them all day.
Listen carefully in class and complete homework on time.
There are also some children who are still not interested in studying after school starts, which makes the teacher angry all day long.
No matter what, the crazy summer vacation is over.
The adults also breathed a sigh of relief and began to prepare for the autumn harvest to welcome the harvest.
Most of the Xu family's land is contracted to others for planting, only private land and two acres of good land.
Xu Chenghou grows everything, just to make more varieties for the children to eat.
There is little land, so don’t worry, the old man slowly went back to collect it.
Catching up with the children not going to school on Sunday, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping went to the fields with their grandfather, breaking corn, cutting soybeans, and sorghum, millet, millet, etc. for brooms.
Ever since I got a car, the original carriage at home has been sold, and I only have a two-wheeled cart with personal power.
When going up the mountain in the morning, Xu Chenghou pulled a two-wheeled cart and asked his grandson and granddaughter to sit on it. The three of them talked and laughed and went up the mountain to work.
When he came back in the afternoon, Xu Chenghou was pulling the two-wheeled cart in front, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping were pushing it behind.
After a busy day, bring the harvested food home.
Tired, but the grandparents and grandchildren were all very happy. In the evening, Xu Haiyuan ate an extra bowl of rice than usual.
Xu Shiyan and his wife really can't care about the family's autumn harvest at the moment.
The preparations for the opening of the city have reached the last juncture, and there are many things.
Su Anying really couldn't take care of it, so Xu Shiyan could only ask for leave to be with his wife.
The venue for the performance was in the Sanshi Courtyard. Xu Shiyan asked someone to build a large stage for the actors to perform.
There are performances, lighting, sound and other things have to be prepared.
There are not so many devices these days, mainly microphones and loudspeakers.
Fortunately, the concert is held during the day, so there is no need to arrange lighting.
These are still second, the most important thing is the reception of relevant personnel.
Xu Shiyan sent his cousin Zhou Lirong and Su Anying's cousin Su Anyu to train for a while in advance.
The hotels and restaurants recruited people for simple training, and additionally recruited some temporary workers to do cleaning work, striving to perfect the reception tasks.
The hotel has quadruple rooms and double rooms, which are different from the iron-framed beds in the guest houses. They are all wooden beds made by carpenters, and mattresses are specially ordered.
The sheets, quilts and pillows are all pure white, and the boards are upright.
Double rooms are equipped with washrooms, quadruple and six-person rooms do not have bathrooms, and there are public toilets at the end of the corridor.
There is a large bathroom next to the boiler room on the first floor, where you can take a shower.
Anyway, based on the current conditions, this is the only thing that can be achieved, and it is really impossible to do more.
Busy with work, it is only a few days before the opening of the city.
Businessmen from other places came one after another, and Donggang Town arranged for people to pick them up outside the train station holding a sign.
Anyone who comes here with an invitation card will be directly arranged for a car to be sent to a hotel in Canshi to stay, and the board and lodging will be settled for them.
Xu Shiyan made great efforts to publicize, and arranged for people to send invitations everywhere.
Not to mention, it was really useful, many people came, and the hotel on the second floor to the north of the city was already full.
Customers from some coastal cities are very interested in this place, and some even went to visit a participating processing factory or comprehensive factory.
There are also some customers who directly signed a supply contract with a participant.
This time, Lin Qiyue was very happy. Who would have thought that before the opening of the market, the first participation would be a good start.
"Shi Yan, how are you preparing? There is not enough manpower, so I will be transferred from the field.
It's okay, we are all a family now, no matter what, we must understand the opening of the market. "
Lin Qiyue directly stated that he fully supports Donggang's participation in the market.
It is not only Yi who participated in the event that benefited, even Donggang Town participated in the event and signed contracts with several medicinal material suppliers.
Donggang Town’s exhibitors shipped a total of 10,000 feet this year, half of which were booked directly.
Moreover, the price is much higher than that purchased by Ginseng Company.
At present, the purchase and wholesale prices of ginseng are clearly stipulated.
Taking twenty sticks of second-class red ginseng per catty as an example, the purchase price in the county of origin is 321 kg, the wholesale price in the county of origin is 381 kg, and the wholesale price at the station of origin is 420 yuan a kg.
Waiting for it to be sold to foreign merchants, the minimum cost is 440 to 450 yuan per kilogram.
In order to participate in the opening of the market this time, the county specially stipulated the selling price, which should not be lower than the wholesale price in the county of origin.
Moreover, if the price is higher, the corresponding tax amount must be paid to the county.
Even so, by eliminating so many procedures in the middle, participants can sell for a lot more money, and the purchase price of foreign merchants is much lower than before.
In fact, it is a mutually beneficial situation, but the ginseng company and the provincial medicinal material company cannot make money in the middle.
Of course, there are also great disadvantages.
Without government functional departments playing a balancing role in the middle, customers and growers face to face directly. After all, growers are scattered individuals and cannot resist the manipulation of capital.
Chen Jianzhang and the head of the field were so happy that they couldn't close their mouths.
"Look, let me just say it, this market participation will definitely work.
Look, we ordered four to five million goods at once, and the price is much higher than in previous years. "
Chen Jianzhang happily patted the table, "At the beginning, there were people who were not optimistic about this market. Look, the market has not opened yet, so we signed the contract first.
Okay, ok, really good. Otherwise, it would have to be Director Xu and Manager Su who are very smart, powerful, too powerful.
Manager Su and Director Xu, congratulations in advance for our prosperous participation in the market. "Chen Jianzhang was so happy that he didn't know what to say.
"Secretary Chen, don't think that way, the previous policy is different from the current one.
This year, the county specially relaxed the policy.
As long as the goods are successfully traded in the market, our county will issue a shipping permit certificate. Without this, it will be difficult for our goods to be shipped out. "
Compared to the other people who were so excited, Xu Shiyan was much calmer and kept calm all the time.
Fusong Ginseng has been implementing the unified purchase, sales, storage and transportation system.
Needless to say, during the commune period in the past few years, after the land was divided into households, the superiors had clear documents.
Anyone who ships ginseng to other provinces, including water ginseng, ginseng plants, ginseng seeds, and finished ginseng, if the quantity exceeds five kilograms, they must have a transportation certificate issued by the Provincial Ginseng Development Leading Group Office.
Transport management departments such as highways, railways, civil aviation, ports, etc. will handle the shipment with the transportation certificate, and will not be released without the transportation certificate.
Without this certificate, even if the merchants of medicinal materials in the south came to order the goods, they would not be able to ship them.
In order to support the opening of the market, Guan Enxue specially reported the application to the higher authorities and slightly relaxed the transportation certification system, which led to these orders for the market in Donggang Town.
It is a participant, which itself has the right to operate import and export independently, and is not restricted by this transportation system.
"Yes, Secretary Guan has indeed given the greatest support for our participation in Donggang City.
You don't know, just because of the opening of the market and the concert, Secretary Guan got angry with many people. "
Bringing this matter up, Chen Jianzhang couldn't help sighing. He actually knew quite a lot about what happened in the county.
"Many people are worried that once the opening is opened, it will cause a lot of trouble.
Under pressure, Secretary Guan decided to open up the market.
Xiao Xu, we really have to work hard, or we will let down Secretary Guan’s heart. "Chen Jianzhang couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"Well, with the liberalization of the market, some people will definitely take advantage of the opportunity to fish in troubled waters. This requires the town and county to issue some relevant management regulations.
I believe that with the macro control of the county and the specific control of the town, we will not go wrong if we participate in the market. "
Market economy is the trend of the times, and it will come sooner or later. Controlling the specific size is not a small problem, and requires the joint efforts of all.

chapters.title: Chapter 510: well arranged
chapters.content:
Chapter 510 Arranged properly
With the advent of the market economy, people have gone from being at a loss and drifting with the tide at the beginning to doing business with ease. This is also a lesson full of blood and tears, and they have paid a big price.
Before 1992, the main market for domestic ginseng was in Yangcheng.
Merchants in Gangcheng purchased a large amount of red ginseng products from Yangcheng and sold them internationally.
At that time, there were many people who bought red ginseng from the Northeast and sold them in Yangcheng, and made a lot of money from it
Xu Shixian and his wife were born at that time. They partnered with others to ship goods to Yangcheng in containers, and people flew over there.
When making the most money, the cash is carried back in suitcases.
Xue Xiulin bought a large amount of gold jewelry from Yangcheng, and used them as dowry when the two daughters got married.
After 1992, the ginseng market fell to a low point, and all the customers in Yangcheng withdrew, and many people lost money.
Later, South Korean customers received white raw sun-dried ginseng in Anguo, so another group of people emerged, who received the goods from here and shipped them to Anguo.
Within a few years, the Anguo medicinal material market also fell into a trough, and many people lost money.
Further on, both Yangcheng and Anguo fell into a long-term trough and lost their former glory.
Until 2009, the ginseng market gradually recovered. With the development of self-media and electronic shopping platforms, the sales of ginseng gradually shifted from physical stores to e-commerce.
No matter what period it is, there are people who can ride the wind and waves and set sail in the wave of market economy. Some people were also submerged in the tide, silently.
The early appearance of the ginseng market can allow southern customers to come directly to order goods, and local ginseng households can also directly bring their own ginseng to the market for sale.
At the same time, it is beneficial for relevant departments and participants to control market information and obtain timely market feedback.
With the price standard set by the superior department, coupled with formal management and timely market feedback, it may play a certain role in the development of the ginseng industry.
Of course, if the control is unreasonable and timely, it is likely to cause a lot of trouble.
The speed of this still needs to be controlled by the higher authorities. Xu Shiyan has no control over this, he can only offer suggestions.
"Yes, yes, on this point, I will find an opportunity to have a good talk with Secretary Guan."
Chen Jianzhang nodded, market management is also a subject of knowledge.
Now that the tide of the market economy is coming, everyone should be vigilant at all times and keep learning.
If you don’t study and your thinking is outdated, you can only fall behind and be eliminated.
"In any case, we are off to a good start, a good sign, and worthy of congratulations.
After waiting for the opening of the market, we have to find a chance to celebrate. "
Chen Jianzhang is still very confident about the current development of the city, and everything is moving in a good direction.
On the afternoon of the 11th, all the art troupes of various units in the county who participated in the concert had arrived in Donggang.
Donggang has also done a lot of preparatory work in advance, and the future people will settle in the Donggang Guest House and the Canchang Guest House.
Do everything possible to ensure that there are no problems in terms of food and accommodation for the people participating in the performance.
In the afternoon, the general manager of the concert arranged for the performers to go to the rehearsal.
The staff of Donggang and Canshi also made some adjustments according to the actual requirements.
The row of second-floor stores on the east side of Canshi has not been rented out yet, and it happens to be used as backstage dressing rooms for the actors of various units.
Anyway, everything that can be thought of has been arranged, and everything is going well.
In the evening, all the staff and merchants from other places dined at the restaurant downstairs of the Canshi Hotel.
Each staff member has a catering coupon specially issued by the activity center, and the restaurant provides working meals.
There are hot and cold dishes, local snacks, as well as drinks and fruits, in the form of self-service, and you can take it as you like.
The back kitchen can add dishes at any time according to the dining situation of the guests.
Many people are particularly interested in this method. This method is much more convenient than a table for several people, and it can also avoid waste.
The opening time of the city is set at 10:18 am on the 12th.
Early in the morning, Su Anying found for Xu Shiyan the suit that Xu Shiqin sent back a while ago, and asked him to change into it.
Navy blue three-piece suit, with a white shirt inside and a deep wine red dark pattern tie.
Xu Shiyan is in his thirties, he is so busy and tired all day long, and he has no chance to get fat and have a beer belly, so his figure is reasonable.
Put on a neatly pressed suit, which is kind of like that.
Su Anying also changed into a dark burgundy cheongsam with exquisite patterns embroidered on it, and matched it with a white cloud pattern shawl.
The short hair that had just been permed a while ago was combed back, the pearl hairpin that Xu Shiyan specially chose before going out was pinned to his ears, and a string of pearl necklaces was around his neck.
With such a dress, it feels a bit like the wife of a wealthy family in the past, gentle, intellectual, graceful and elegant.
"Don't talk about it, my sister's skill is really amazing.
The clothes made by her hands look better than those made by our local tailors.
I heard that the store she opened in the capital is doing very well. "Su Anying chanted while helping Xu Shiyan tidy up his clothes.
Xu Shiyan looked down at his busy wife and couldn't help laughing.
"Yeah, didn't she call back a while ago and say that the business in the store is booming, and she wants to open a small garment processing factory."
Xu Shiqin bought the shop with Su Anying at the time, and after Su Anying left, she started to work on opening the shop.
Xu Shiqin has a good eye. The ready-made clothes and fabrics from the south sell well in the capital.
Especially the clothes designed by Xu Shiqin, they look better than many ready-made clothes.
Some people specially asked her to make clothes, and gradually became famous.
Now Xu Shiqin's small shop business is booming, Xu Shiqin has taken in several apprentices, and plans to take in a few more skilled female workers to open a small garment processing factory.
"Our mother didn't let her go, she is double now, what kind of factory does she open?
It is better than anything else to raise the child well and give birth to the child safely. "Su Anying laughed when she heard that.
Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei took medicine for a while after returning to the capital, and then Han Liwei went on mission for two months.
Some time ago, Xu Shiqin called back and said that he had it, and Zhou Guilan was too beautiful.
The Han family was very happy to hear the news. Li Yuexiu said that she was busy with the time and went to the capital to serve her daughter-in-law.
Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin, the child that the two finally got to have, both of them care more than their eyes.
Zhou Guilan said, what kind of factory to open? Let's talk about giving birth to the baby safely first.
Xu Shiyan also laughed when he heard that, yes, it’s really not easy for these two people, it’s better to be Mr. An Anwen’s child.
The two chatted while tidying up. After tidying up, Su Anying put on her high heels and went out.
Xu Shiyan glanced at his daughter-in-law, and always felt that there was still something missing.
"Didn't I tell you to take out that emerald bracelet and wear it? Why didn't you bring it?"
It turned out that the daughter-in-law had bare wrists, without jewelry, and looked awkward.
"Don't wear that thing, I'm afraid it will be broken if there are too many people stumbling around.
Didn't you say that the bracelet will be very valuable in the future? What if I break it? "Su Anying smiled and shook her head.
"When I have a chance in the future, I will buy you a beautiful bracelet to wear."
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything else, took his wife's hand, and the two left the house together, heading straight to Canshi.

chapters.title: Chapter 511: Participation in the market
chapters.content:
Chapter 511 Participation in the market and opening
Today’s visit to the market is very grand.
On both sides of the city gate, there are a bunch of colorful balloons tied to each other.
The balloons are filled with hydrogen gas, tied with ropes underneath, and they are all floating in mid-air.
The gate of the market faces east, and on both sides of the gate are stores on the second floor. At this moment, someone is pulling a banner from the roof of the store.
Although there are no direct printed banners these days, it is hard for people with ingenuity.
Someone specially cut the characters out of colored paper, and put pins on the whole red cloth.
Most of the words above are, such and such unit, warmly celebrate the opening of Donggang City, anyway, they are all similar words of this type.
In order to participate in the opening of the market, Donggang Town has done its best.
All agencies and units have been notified, so people must come to support the show.
So, just the banners pulled by various units covered the stores on both sides of the gate of the city.
That is to say, it is not popular to send flower baskets at the opening of the store these days. If there are, the flowers on both sides of the gate of Shenshi can be placed like mountains.
In the city courtyard, on the west side is a large stage that has been set up in advance. The performance will be in the afternoon, so this morning it will be used as the rostrum for the opening ceremony.
In front of the rostrum, there are several rows of tables and chairs. These are tables and chairs borrowed from junior high school, specially for the guests.
The other places in the yard are reserved for those who come to watch the fun, and they can stand there casually.
At this moment, the red flags were flying in the courtyard of the city, and the drum team arranged by Donggang Town over there was already in place, and all the equipment on the rostrum had been adjusted.
Seeing Xu Shiyan and his wife coming over, Zhou Qingguo, who was in charge of the opening, hurried forward to greet Xu Shiyan.
"Third Uncle, Third Aunt, you two, take a look. If there is anything you are not satisfied with, I will send someone to clean it up immediately."
"It's pretty good. I can see that everything is good. You have spent a lot of effort to get it to this level. You are tired."
Xu Shiyan patted Zhou Qingguo on the shoulder.
In this life, Zhou Qingguo's promotion path has also changed. Not only did he mention the deputy mayor early on, but he didn't change the place.
With Zhou Qingguo's working ability, it is estimated that he will be promoted to a full-time job in two years, which is really good.
"Okay, the third uncle and three aunts hang around first, I still have something to do here, let's talk later."
Someone called Zhou Qingguo at the other end, he quickly said something, turned around and left.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying wandered around the city courtyard, making sure that there were no major problems everywhere.
The two came to the gate, and together with Chen Jianzhang and a few comrades in the town, greeted the guests who came to congratulate them.
Around nine o'clock, all kinds of vehicles arrived in front of the gate of Canshi one after another.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan had anticipated the parking issue when Shenshi was making plans, and specially repaired the parking space, which happened to come in handy right now.
Those who can come today are the leaders of the county and townships.
The four state-run camps under the jurisdiction of Fusong, the township camps in various townships, and the camps jointly organized by the county and several forestry bureaus all arranged for people to come.
Not only did they arrange for people to come, they also brought products.
Just kidding, who doesn't know this is a great opportunity? If you can really take the opportunity to sign a few contracts, wouldn't that also generate income?
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan had anticipated this situation long ago, and reserved a special area in the south, which is the place to display products for all participants.
Relevant persons in charge brought the products and put them on display. If there are customers to see them, they will explain them.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were always at the gate, shaking hands with the guests non-stop.
While talking to someone, I saw a few cars coming over there, and Guan Enxue, Chang Hongfa, and Jiang Yunfeng got out of the car.
"Oh, Secretary Guan, County Magistrate Chang, County Magistrate Jiang, welcome.
I thought you were busy with work and couldn't come today. "
Chen Jianzhang, Lin Qiyue, Xu Shiyan, Su Anying and others hurried forward to greet them.
Guan Enxue shook hands with everyone one by one, and then patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder.
"I heard that this market hasn't opened yet, but once you entered the market and Donggang Town, you signed a lot of orders? It's amazing."
In fact, Guan Enxue was always in a state of anxiety.
He put so much effort into supporting the market, if this city did not make any splashes, it would be a big joke.
Unexpectedly, before the opening of the market, a lot of goods have been ordered. Guan Enxue was relieved when he heard the news.
Donggang Ginseng City has had a good start, which has really relieved a lot of pressure in the county.
Ginseng production has increased rapidly in recent years, and the situation that Xu Shiyan predicted before has also faintly revealed some clues.
The five-year acquisition contract signed by the provincial medicinal materials company and the county is about to expire, and Guan Enxue has no idea what will happen next.
He has asked Ginseng Company to actively expand sales channels, but how is this sales channel so easy to expand?
Originally, Guan Enxue supported participating in the market, but he just wanted to have another way.
Unexpectedly, Shenshi gave him a surprise, signed many supply contracts before opening.
This gave Guan Enxue a lot of confidence. With the ginseng market, the provincial medicinal material company, and the county ginseng company, the three should cooperate with each other and should be able to sell Fusong ginseng smoothly.
"I also have to thank Secretary Guan and the county for their strong support. Without the support of the leaders of the county, how can this city participate in business?"
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard the words. He was grateful to Guan Enxue from the bottom of his heart.
Still the same sentence, Xu Shiyan has really met noble people everywhere along the way, and many people are helping.
Otherwise, I really wouldn’t be able to get to where I am today.
"Secretary Guan, please come inside, the opening ceremony is not long away, please sit inside, we will start later."
The visitor is a guest, not to mention a distinguished guest like Guan Enxue, who would block the distinguished guest at the gate to chat? Always ask to come in and sit down and talk.
Therefore, Chen Jianzhang and others accompanied Guan Enxue and his party to the city courtyard.
Guan Enxue looked around and nodded again and again. This market is much better than he expected.
"Xiao Xu is really quite intelligent.
Old Chen, we need to cooperate well with him in the future, and strive to make our ginseng business flourish. "
"Yes, yes, Secretary Guan, I know this, and there are still many things that need to be discussed with you.
Find a quiet time another day, we have to have a good chat about related matters. "
Of course Chen Jianzhang knows the importance of participating in the market. When the participating market is booming, it is nothing to collect a little tax, but it can drive the surrounding economy and bring economic benefits to the participating farmers in Donggang and even the entire Er County.
This benefit is definitely not a one-shot, but a long-term benefit. If you participate in the market, you must do it well.
"Okay, then another day, when the time comes, call the directors of the field, the general manager of the ginseng company, and Xiao Xu.
I think we should discuss carefully about the standardized management of this ginseng market.
This is not a small problem, if it is not done well, it will cause big problems. "
Guan Enxue nodded. For new things, we should not be afraid, we must face them bravely, and we must brainstorm to find the most effective solution.
There is another chapter ahead, it’s in the little black room, I’ll see how to modify it and release it during the day

chapters.title: Chapter 512: Ten million transaction volume
chapters.content:
Chapter 512 Transaction volume of tens of millions
Before ten o'clock, all the guests had already sat down, and a large number of people gathered in the market courtyard to watch the fun.
Donggang, the villages around Songjiang River, and even many other villages and towns, many people came here.
At ten o'clock sharp, Zhou Qingguo came on stage as the main manager.
"Leaders and guests, thank you for taking time out of your busy schedule to participate in the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the opening of Donggang Town Ginseng Market, and the opening ceremony of the first Linhai Ginseng Township Concert in Fusong." There was applause.
"Next, let me talk about today's schedule.
At 10:18 in the morning, the ribbon-cutting for the opening ceremony, the speeches of the leaders, and the on-site exchange and exhibition.
At 1:30 in the afternoon, the concert opened, the first performance. "
This schedule is determined jointly with relevant units and leaders.
It happens to open in the morning, there is an opening reception at noon, and performances in the afternoon, which is also very good.
When Zhou Qingguo spoke, someone over there had already started preparations.
At 10:18, two long strings of firecrackers hanging at the gate of the city were lit.
On the rostrum, Guan Enxue, Chen Jianzhang, Su Anying and others, holding scissors, cut off the red silk in the hands of the etiquette personnel.
I have never seen this opening ribbon-cutting ceremony before, and it was Xu Shiyan's suggestion.
Don’t worry about the people on and off the stage, they all think it’s very fresh, and many people are still discussing it in the audience. It’s a pity that the good red silk is cut off like this.
After the ribbon-cutting for the opening, leaders at all levels and guests gave speeches.
These are just going through a process, and what they are talking about is the same set, and everything is inseparable from it.
Over there, the reporters and cameramen arranged by the county were shooting with their belongings on their shoulders. This is also news material, and it might be reported to the province.
After the relevant leaders and guest representatives finished speaking, the product exchange meeting on the other side began.
The news of the opening of the participating market was notified to each participating venue almost a month in advance, and the invitation letter also specifically stated that you can bring products to display.
Although some people in the county have a negative attitude towards participating in the market, in fact, the people in charge of each participating market think this is an opportunity, so they have made preparations in advance.
Either rush out a batch of products, or print brochures and the like.
The so-called booths are actually the booths in the ginseng market. Each unit has a section of booths, which are filled with various ginseng products.
Red ginseng with whole beard, red ginseng with light branch, vigorous ginseng, white dry ginseng, raw sun-dried ginseng with peeled skin, sugar ginseng, red straight beard, white straight beard, side strip ginseng, skin tail ginseng.
There is also a ginseng field that has successfully developed Changbai Mountain red ginseng, natural active ginseng, fresh ginseng, etc. in recent years.
In addition to ginseng products, Yishenchang also brought medicinal materials such as Gastrodia elata, Asarum, Fritillaria, and Ganoderma lucidum.
Needless to say, it must be a product grown from the comprehensive utilization of ginseng land, and I just took it here to show the results.
Businessmen from the south wandered back and forth between the stalls, and asked the price if they had a fancy product.
This price is still set uniformly throughout the county.
Each type of product is divided into first, second and third grades according to quality. The county ginseng antler company has a special catalog, which stipulates the wholesale price and retail price of each ginseng.
Those over 100 catties are calculated at the wholesale price of the county of origin, and those less than 100 catties are calculated at retail prices, and the price will be higher.
The price is clarified, and the price is unified in the county. The main reason is naturally to prevent growers from underselling each other and standardize market management.
At the same time, it can also attract farmers to sell ginseng products, increase the income of ginseng households, and prevent second-hand dealers from disrupting the market.
But in the middle, there is actually a lot of maneuverability.
For example, how to divide the parameters of first, second and third grades, this is all based on experience.
Some people can take advantage of the loopholes, buy from ginseng households at the price of third-class ginseng, and pick and choose a little later.
Pick out the bad ones and sell them as the third class, and the rest can be sold as the second class, so that you can make money.
There is another one, add a small amount of second-class ginseng to the first-class ginseng, as long as it is not too much, it will not be tested when the grade is checked, and you can make money again.
Also, all kinds of mixed ingredients are called one-stop, and they are directly collected and sorted by themselves, and then sold separately.
Some people have bad eyesight, and they can tell at a glance how much the goods of each grade account for, how much maneuverability there is, and how much money they can earn.
Anyway, the water in the ginseng market is also very muddy.
When buying, the grade is lowered to pick faults, and when it is sold, the grade is lowered, and a small amount is mixed with inferior products.
This thing, as long as there are interests, there will be loopholes to exploit, and this cannot be completely eliminated.
Some second-hand dealers rely on this to eat. The powerful people in this industry can make money by receiving goods from one side of the market and selling them on the other side.
In the future, pricing will be relaxed and all operations will be left to the market, let alone.
Those second-hand dealers are just like playing for a while, earning hundreds of thousands of dollars.
If some have contacts with customers in the south and directly receive the goods for them, that’s not to mention. If they receive it and send it to the south, they can earn a lot of money.
So, a ginseng industry actually feeds too many people.
Of course, the first day of the product exchange meeting will not cause any trouble.
Businessmen are optimistic about which type of product, just place an order directly with the participants.
The two parties agree on the unit price, quantity, delivery time and method, and then sign the order contract, and pay a certain percentage of the reservation payment, so that the business is concluded.
Business negotiations are concluded and a contract is signed, and the office team of the county ginseng antler company will file for the record.
While waiting for the shipment, the ginseng company will issue a shipping certificate.
"How is it? How many goods have you ordered?"
Guan Enxue was standing next to the office team of Ginseng Company, watching the staff's accumulated transaction volume and transaction value in the morning.
"Secretary Guan, thirty-five contracts have been formally signed this morning, and hundreds of letters of intent for orders have been signed. In total, the turnover is 35 million yuan."
The staff calculated the transaction amount and reported it directly to Guan Enxue.
Guan Enxue and other people in the county were shocked when they heard this. The transaction amount was beyond their expectations.
No one expected that there would be such a large transaction volume in just an hour or so.
You know, the total storage area of ​​ginseng in the county this year is about 1.1 million square feet, and the area for making goods this year is more than 300,000 square feet.
In just one hour, about one-tenth of the year's production volume was ordered. This speed is really amazing.
And this is just the beginning, and there will likely be more orders in the future.
In addition to the acquisition base of the provincial medicinal material company and health care product company, the export contract of the county ginseng company, and the annual export orders of one participant.
The county's ginseng sales this year are likely to hit a new high again.
"Look at it, this is the ginseng market that you strongly oppose.
Now, do you think it is necessary for this ginseng market to exist? "
Guan Enxue turned his head and looked at the people behind him, especially those who had been against him before.
Those people are all blushing at the moment.
The ginseng market had such a large transaction volume on the first day it opened, it was like two loud slaps in the face.
Now, what excuse do they have to object?

chapters.title: Chapter 513: reception
chapters.content:
Chapter 513 Reception
At 11:30, the on-site exchange meeting ended, and all participants and guests went to the restaurant on the first floor to the north to attend the opening reception.
The reception also takes the form of self-help.
There are all kinds of food on the tables around, vegetables, fruits, snacks, various snacks, wine, drinks and so on.
Guests can take whatever they want, and eat whatever they want.
Actually, few of the people who come here really come here to eat, but to contact more people and make a few deals.
This kind of reception is more fluid and more convenient than the previous table of ten people eating at a table, which helps the guests communicate with each other.
The first floor is an open hall, the place is big enough that hundreds of people will not feel particularly crowded in it.
People get together in twos and threes to chat and exchange business cards with each other. This is the future network resource.
"Who came up with this idea? I think it's pretty good. It's much better than our previous reception. It's very good, and it's interesting."
Guan Enxue and the others were also quite novel about this way of eating. They held wine glasses in their hands and exchanged greetings with others, and they gathered together to discuss in a low voice.
"It was taught by Director Xu. He said that this method is now popular in many places outside. It is flexible and convenient, and it can increase the chance of mutual understanding.
Dinners are basically in this way these days. I think it looks good, much better than what we used to do. "
Chen Jianzhang has always been by Guan Enxue's side, so he had to explain it at this time.
"Well, you can learn from it, this is pretty good.
Don’t talk about it, this restaurant is quite decent, better than those in our county. It's a bit like a restaurant in Yangcheng.
Otherwise, you have to go out and wander around, which really broadens your horizons. "
Guan Enxue looked around and was quite satisfied with the environment of the hotel.
At this time, someone came to toast, Guan Enxue, Chen Jianzhang and others stopped chatting and chatted with the guests about the Fusong ginseng industry.
Xu Shiyan and his wife walked around with wine glasses in their hands, chatting with each other one by one.
Those foreign businessmen who came early knew Su Anying and Xu Shiyan, but those who came late were not so familiar.
As soon as I heard that Su Anying is the manager of Baishan Ginseng Industry Comprehensive Company, this ginseng market is invested by others. The hotel they live in and the place where they eat now are also owned by others, and they all praise Su Anying.
In this circle, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying received a lot of business cards.
Xu Shiyan carefully put away his business cards, keeping them for future use.
There were Xu Shiyan's classmates and some leaders of the Forestry Bureau who came to the opening ceremony, and Guo Shouye was naturally among them.
But at this moment, Guo Shouye and the others are also busy looking for someone to chat with.
Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye only nodded when they met, and had no chance to chat.
Anyway, they always meet, and there is no need to talk about it here, so no one cares.
Wandering to the end, then turned back to Guan Enxue, Chen Jianzhang and others.
Xu Shiyan raised his hand, loosened his tie, and smiled embarrassedly.
"No, this thing is really not good. It's only been this morning, and it makes me really uncomfortable."
Who dresses so neatly on normal days?
Xu Shiyan is indeed the director of the field. He focuses on technology research and development, and spends time in the laboratory, dressing in whatever way is comfortable.
This sudden suit and leather shoes, and tie, was really uncomfortable for most of the day.
Guan Enxue and others laughed when they heard this, "Get used to it slowly, and you will be fine in the future.
I see that Manager Su is much better than you. He walked all morning in high heels, and he didn't see him complaining of being tired. "
Guan Enxue nodded to Su Anying as he spoke.
With a faint smile on Su Anying's face, she nodded towards everyone, but she was complaining in her heart.
The high heels are not on your feet, anyway, you are not tired.
You can't show your tiredness on your face. She is the manager of the company. In this kind of occasion, you must keep smiling and be graceful.
"Xiao Xu, today's opening ceremony went well and was a success.
The reception at noon is also pretty good, but you still have a lot of tricks. "When Guan Enxue said that, it was a great affirmation of Xu Shiyan.
"Hey, this is all done by Qing Guo, I just gave an idea.
Deputy mayor Zhou is mainly responsible for the opening of the city. "Xu Shiyan waved to Zhou Qingguo not far away.
Zhou Qingguo saw it, hurried over, and greeted Guan Enxue and others.
Guan Enxue glanced at Zhou Qingguo, nodded, "Well, you are a good young man, with a good spirit and strong execution ability.
Work hard, Donggang will have better development in the future. "
This is the highest praise for Zhou Qingguo. After all, with Zhou Qingguo's current qualifications, there are still very few opportunities to show his face in front of Guan Enxue.
"Thank you, Secretary Guan, Qingguo will definitely make persistent efforts to contribute to the development of the village."
Zhou Qingguo was a little excited and almost stood at attention to salute.
Everyone laughed and toasted together to celebrate together, and then went off to do their own business.
The concert is scheduled to start in the afternoon, and all the actors participating in the performance will have their meals in the lounge.
The food is also prepared here, it is very rich, and no one can fault it.
After all, the performance is the most important thing, and the most important thing is to finish the meal early and make up quickly.
Around one o'clock, the venue has been rearranged.
All the tables, chairs and other equipment on the rostrum were removed, and they were withdrawn to the audience. The relevant performance props and musical instruments for the soundtrack were all ready.
At half past one, the show officially begins.
There were more people watching the excitement than in the morning, and the entire Ershen City was crowded with people, all of whom were there to watch the show.
The host of the county radio station came to host the program. This time the leader simply said a few words, and then the concert began.
All the participating units presented well-arranged programs, such as solo, chorus, poetry recitation, singing and dancing, etc., the programs were brilliant.
In this day and age, there are still very few entertainment programs, and it is difficult for the masses to see such a wonderful program. People in the distance are looking in with their feet up.
There are also people who don’t know where they brought bricks or something under their feet, anyway, they all look at them with gusto.
The reporters of the county radio station also videotaped and took pictures of the whole process. Anyway, they were really tired enough on this day.
The concert lasted from 1:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. The cadres in the county and some people from far away places basically left after three o'clock.
Xu Shiyan, his wife, Chen Jianzhang and others have been seeing off guests at the gate of Canshi, and no one has the intention to watch the show.
At 4:30, the concert ended, and the spectators left one after another. The actors over there also hurriedly packed their things, changed their clothes and removed their make-up.
Let’s go back to the guest house in the town for dinner and rest, and then head to the county seat tomorrow morning. There will be several performances in the county after the concert.
Some of these merchants from other places will leave tomorrow, and some will stay for a while.
It's rare to come here, I need to buy more medicinal materials to go back.
As agreed at the beginning, during the opening period of the city, the board and lodging of foreign merchants is free.
But it can’t be free forever. After the 15th, if you stay and eat again, you will have to spend money.
Of course, Xu Shiyan also said that a certain discount will be given.

chapters.title: Chapter 514: Ginseng from the mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 514 Up the mountain to participate
Donggang Ginseng Market signed more than 30 million supply contracts and letters of intent on the first day of its opening.
The leaders of the county were very satisfied, and all the cadres in the town were also very happy from ear to ear.
The busy and hard work these days, and the various expenses for receiving customers, finally paid off.
Of course, this reward is not immediate and obvious, but invisible and long-lasting.
The name of the ginseng market is publicized, and merchants from other places come to buy goods, which will attract ginseng farmers from the county or even other counties to come and sell their goods.
Thus driving a series of benefits related to transportation, catering services, labor, etc., and at the same time increasing the income of participating farmers.
In contrast, the transaction tax and bed fees charged by the ginseng market are not the main ones.
For Donggang Town, being able to own the first professional ginseng market in the country will bring huge economic benefits.
The previous investment is nothing compared to this.
Xu Shiyan and his wife have been busy with their work during this time, and the hotels and restaurants are all free.
Moreover, the management of the market was handed over to Donggang Township, and they had no way of making profits from it.
In some people's eyes, this is purely helping the town to carry the sedan chair, without much benefit.
But in fact, Xu Shiyan, his wife and their company also made a lot of profits.
The market is booming, where do people from other places eat and live? Of course, the first choice is hotels and restaurants near Sanshi.
The shops and hotels in the circle outside the city belong to Su Anying's company.
Many people inquired today whether to sell or rent the stores outside the city, and how to rent them.
Xu Shiyan and his wife also took this opportunity to meet many businessmen from other places.
In fact, when these foreign merchants first came here, they also had the mentality of trying it out, and many of them were unprepared.
As a result, looking here, the ginseng market is indeed doing well, and the relevant departments also attach great importance to it, and the price of ginseng is indeed exciting enough.
The exchange meeting at noon was too short, and many people did not actually order the goods.
So many people plan to stay and wait to see what the ginseng will look like after it is released in bulk.
Some people really couldn't wait to rush back, so they discussed with Su Anying whether they could let Su Anying be their agent.
They sent the list of goods, and Su Anying picked up the goods and shipped them directly according to the list.
Of course, acting as an agent is not in vain, and the profit is also very rich, and the two parties are mutually beneficial and win-win.
It is much more cost-effective than those merchants coming directly to grab the goods themselves.
Thus, people who don’t know the inside think that Xu Shiyan and his wife are working in vain.
In fact, the couple's name has also gained benefits, and it has paved the way for the future. There are many benefits.
In order to celebrate the successful start of the city, Chen Jianzhang specially arranged a celebration banquet at the guest house in the town.
When the celebration banquet was over, it was almost nine o'clock in the evening.
Xu Shiyan drank a lot of wine, and walked awkwardly. Su Anying walked around in high heels for a day, and her feet also hurt.
Chen Jianzhang arranged for a driver to take the couple home. Once the couple arrived home, they lay down on the kang and didn't want to move.
Fortunately, Xu Chenghou and his wife took the children to take care of them early and did not let the children come back at all.
The couple didn't have to take care of the children, so they simply fell asleep and slept until after 7 o'clock the next morning before they recovered.
The opening of the market is only the first step, and there are still many things to deal with, but these have nothing to do with Xu Shiyan and his wife.
The management of the city is in the town, and Xu Shiyan and his wife don't intervene. They have to be busy with other things.
Mid-September is a good time to start making products.
Before, I was busy with the opening of the market, and I couldn’t spare time. Now that the market is also open, it’s no problem to hand over the hotel to Zhou Lirong and Su Anyu.
Together, the couple will start participating on Sunday the 14th.
You have to get up early and late, don’t rush too late, there is so much work at home, don’t delay.
The ginseng land to be made this year happened to be the ginseng soil that was distributed in the year when the fields were distributed to households, and the land was allocated at Nantianmen.
Xu Shiyan's family has a total of twenty-seven feet, Xu Chenghou and his wife have a little more than ten feet, and the two families together are more than thirty feet.
The two of them set up a pair of clubs, and the day is about twenty feet.
These clubs, if Xu Shiyan and his wife went back and even removed the shed and cut the ginseng leaves, it would probably take more than two days to finish it.
It's troublesome to toss back and forth, it's best to get up every day.
I had no other choice, so I had to discuss with Huang Shengli and Zhao Jianshe and the others to see if they could join the time together and change jobs or something.
In the Zhuanghu courtyard, au pairing is normal, that is, if your family has work, I will go to help, and when my family has work, you will help me.
Huang Shengli and other companies didn’t even get their clubs out yet. After such a discussion, they simply took the time to join in and rushed to get all the clubs back.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan and his wife took Xu Chenghou, Xu Haiyuan, and Huang Shengli and others to drive to Nantianmen in the early morning of the 14th.
What the big guys discussed was to start with Xu Shiyan's house over there first, then go to Feng Chao's and Sun Xiaofeng's houses after the house, and then pick up all the others' houses tomorrow.
When we arrived at the place, we removed the shed and cut the ginseng leaves. The people behind took the three-toothed tool and started digging out the stick from the soil.
"Hey, third brother, your mallet is not small, can this one be as big as three or two?"
Just started digging, and before digging out a few trees, Zhao Jianshe started to shout.
The Xu family is quite old, and they do a good job of taking care of them, and their sticks are also big.
The clubs were dug out from the ground one by one, all of them were white and fat like little dolls, not to mention how rare they are.
Xu Chenghou and Xu Haiyuan also followed up the mountain. They were binding ginseng leaves in front. When they heard that the sticks were good, they rushed over to have a look.
"Yo, it's not small, this mallet is long, so rare.
How about saying that the bean cake fertilizer is really useful? In the past, such a big stick was rare in a big house. "
Xu Chenghou stretched out his hand to pick up the mallet in the soil, weighed it, and sighed.
"Uncle Xu, when did you say that?
In the past, an average of 1 zhang ginseng weighed 13 to 4 catties, and it was considered a stick if it could lift 15 to 6 catties.
If it weren't for my third brother's ability to make this bean cake fertilizer, how could it have the current output.
Nowadays, a foot of ginseng can lift more than 20 catties, and the best place is 25 catties, which is more than double that of the past. How can it be the same? "
Zhao Jianshe swung his three-toothed tool and carefully planed the stick from the ground, saying proudly.
"Well, that's true, now the ginseng land is more than ten catties, the price of the stick has also increased a lot, and the income can almost double.
These ah, I really have to thank the third brother.
Not only us, but all farmers in the county should thank Third Brother. "
On the other end, Huang Shengli also swung the three-toothed stick and started planing the mallet. When one tooth went down, it happened to bring up three sticks, which were not small in size.
"Cough, thank you, you said that we worked desperately and stooped all day, didn't we just hope to start more goods in the field and earn more money?
As long as everyone can live a good life, it doesn't matter if you don't thank you. "Xu Shiyan laughed at the other end.
It’s not that there was a lack of updates yesterday, but another chapter was locked in a small dark room and was released at noon.

chapters.title: Chapter 515: high yield
chapters.content:
Chapter 515 High Yield
There are many people, and the work is fast. The Xu family's 30-foot clubs all got up in the afternoon without any use.
Not to mention, the output is really good, with a 37-foot stick, there are more than ten sacks.
Although it is true that some sacks are not filled enough, it still depends on a hundred catties.
The participants of the second brigade are all here, and there are only a few days to participate every year, so many people here are playing sticks.
There are quite a few people who are very trustworthy, so let's come and see, Xu Shiyan, a master in the industry, how about the sticks they made?
Looking at it, it’s amazing. On average, a sack of water ginseng can be produced from three feet of ginseng soil. How can it be more than thirty catties from one foot?
"Brother Xu, how do you handle this stick in your family? It looks so good?
Oh my god, can you weigh thirty catties in this one foot?
Good guy, such a big mallet is really rare. "
Someone went to the sack that hadn't been seamed yet, and when they saw the size of the mallet inside, they couldn't help but exclaimed.
"How many times has your family been chasing fat? This is too good-looking.
Brother Xu, do you have any tricks? "
The same ginseng land, they also used base fertilizer, and topdressed it last year.
The club is bigger than before, but compared with Xu Shiyan’s, it’s still far behind.
Some people couldn't help it, and came to inquire, wondering if Xu Shiyan had any other tricks that he didn't tell everyone.
"What's the trick? You're talking nonsense every day.
When my third elder brother’s family first planted ginseng, they used the first and second big seeds.
Didn’t you see it when the stick was planted? The seed was almost as thick as a finger.
Such a big plant is planted in the ground, and the fertilizer and water can keep up with it, and take good care of it. Can it grow smaller? "
When Zhao Jianshe heard this, he was unhappy.
"Why are you all so dissatisfied?
My third brother taught you all the fertilizer formulas for free, and you learned them one by one. The output of sticks is so much higher than before, and I haven’t seen anyone invite my third brother to have a meal to express their gratitude.
Oh, seeing my third brother’s stick is ready today, you guys are red-eyed, thinking that my third brother still has a trick to hide from the public?
Don’t say there is no such thing, even if there is, what can you do? What are you? Why did I tell you? "
Zhao Jianshe's temper is determined not to get used to others, and no matter who is facing him, he just chugs and pouts anyway.
Zhao Jianshe's words made those few people who couldn't help being jealous when they looked at others' sticks feel very angry.
It made the faces of those people turn blue and red, but they had nothing to say.
"Look, we just inquired casually, and didn't say anything else. As for?" Someone said awkwardly.
"Then why not?
Just now we were talking about how many catties of a mallet could be lifted by a foot of ground? Fifteen or six catties is good, right?
How much is your home this year? Do you have more than twenty catties?
The reason for the extra? Don't you know anything about yourself?
Without the fertilizer formula disclosed by my third brother, how can your ginseng land increase so much?
If you want me to say, the third brother didn’t make it too public at the beginning, he just set up a fertilizer factory and sold fertilizer, whether he likes to buy it or not.
It also saves some people, who are not satisfied with the benefits. "
Zhao Jianshe didn't care about that, and the crackling was just a rant, which directly left those people speechless and went back to work in despair.
"Who the **** are they? I can see that these people can't treat them well."
Zhao Jianshe said deliberately towards the backs of those people.
Zhao Jianshe's loud voice could be heard from far away, but how could Xu Shiyan and Su Anying, who were holding wire to seal the mouth of the sack nearby, couldn't hear it.
Su Anying shook her head and sighed.
"Ever since Clivia made money by beating us, many people didn't say anything explicitly, but they also had ideas secretly.
Now that the market is open, it is very prosperous. I see, how many people are jealous behind their backs. "
People, there are always those who are not satisfied.
In the past, the Xu family had a good life, that is, they were a little taller than others.
At that time, no matter what good deed Xu Shiyan did, everyone would benefit from it, and he would be sincerely grateful.
But now the Xu family has far surpassed everyone in their lives. If he does something that is beneficial to everyone, people will only think that it should be done.
He Xu Shiyan is so rich, so rich, so he should turn around and help a bunch of fellow villagers, shouldn't he deserve it?
Although not all people think this way, there is always a part of them. With these people involved, no matter how good things are, they can change their taste.
"In the future, let's talk to Jianshe and Shengli to understand the company's management, and we don't have to think about helping anyone when we should make money.
You think that you have made money and are capable, and you should give back to your neighbors, but in reality, how many people really appreciate it?
We are not saints, so why bother to care so much, it is not bad to live our own little life well. "
In the past two years, Xu Shiyan has been studying outside, and went to work to do research when he came back. He had little contact with other people and knew little.
Su Anying is different. In the past two years, she has built a ginseng market, opened a company, and sold ginseng soil. She has dealt with villagers like Xishen and Donggang.
Su Anying still can't see through what those people are thinking?
"Well, what the daughter-in-law said makes sense, and I won't care about that from now on.
Anyway, if the city is built, we promise that the things in the town will be done, and I won't bother to care so much in the future. "
Xu Shiyan nodded, not arguing with his wife.
If you are poor, you will benefit yourself alone; if you are rich, you will benefit the world.
Many people may have this idea at the beginning, if I am rich and capable, I will take care of it.
However, ideals are full and reality is very skinny. Some things are really not that simple.
With insufficient people and limited manpower, no matter how powerful Xu Shiyan is, he cannot satisfy everyone's wishes.
So, there is no need to think so much at all, just do what you should do.
No one is a savior, and he has no responsibility and obligation to plan for others.
"Shouldn't it be Feng Chao's family? Come on, let's see how Feng Chao's club looks like?"
