Xu Shiyan didn't bother to pay attention to those people's gossip, as long as he had a clear conscience, it was enough for him to do what he should do.
There is still a lot of work ahead, how can there be that time to hurt the spring and the autumn?
All the dozens of sacks were sewn up with wire, carried to the ground and stacked together, leaving Xu Haiyuan to watch.
Then the big guy took the belongings, went to Feng Chao’s house a few strings away to visit the ground, and started to strike the stick.
After Feng Chao got married, the family separated. When the land was divided, the couple brought their two children, so they divided the ginseng land among four people.
Not much, just over twenty feet.
Just now Feng Chao came over to evacuate the ginseng shed, and cut the ginseng industry with a sickle.
"Yo, the club of Chaozi's family is not small, it looks pretty good."
Zhao Jianshe picked up three sticks with a three-toothed stick, shook them a little, and the sticks were exposed when the soil fell, and they were not bad in size.
Although it is not as good as Xu Shiyan's family, it is not too small.

chapters.title: Chapter 516: harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 516 Harvest
Feng Chao’s family is only about twenty feet long, and it doesn’t take long for the big guys to get up together.
The output is also good. It is estimated that one foot will be about twenty-six or seven catties or more.
It’s really hard to say about ginseng production. The size of the seeds in the ground, whether the fertilizer and water are sufficient, and whether the field management can keep up are all affected.
Sometimes, even the same person tends the same piece of land, and the size of the sticks produced is different.
That's why the old people say that planting ginseng is called blood wealth, and a large part of it depends on luck.
Just finished playing Feng Chao’s club, everyone stopped to rest and have lunch.
He didn't stay idle after dinner, and started to visit Sun Xiaofeng's house again.
Sun Xiaofeng's family's ginseng production is about the same as that of Feng Chao's family, which is pretty good.
The big guys have been busy until more than 3:30 in the afternoon. After kicking up the club, they cleaned up the shed and so on.
Those plastic sheets have only been used for two years, and they are not considered completely aged. If you keep them, you can use thatch to cover the warehouse at home, or build a small vegetable shed.
Otherwise, you can still sell waste products, which cost a few cents a catty, who is willing to throw them away?
Pillars, poles, etc. can’t be thrown away. If you want to build a shelf at home, you can use them. Otherwise, they can be used as firewood.
If it was someone else’s house, I might not want it. It’s quite a long way to drive a carriage, so it’s not worth transporting back.
But Xu Shiyan and the others are fine. Those who drive up are more or less loaded, and all that can be transported back are shipped back.
Waiting to finish pulling these things before walking back, it was only 4:30, and it was after 5:00 when I got home.
The club of Xu Shiyan's family was sent directly to Xu Chenghou.
"Oh, so much? How many bags are these? Isn't our family only about thirty feet long? How come there are more than ten sacks here?"
Zhou Guilan was stunned when she saw Xu Shiyan and his father carrying sacks into the house. Why did they come back with so many sticks that were thirty feet long?
"Old lady, this year our mallet is very good, you didn't see that the mallet looks good, there is no rust at all, it is rare.
We touched it, and it can lift more than 30 catties in one foot. You can see it tomorrow when you swipe the water. It's beautiful. "
Xu Chenghou didn't feel tired after a day's work, so he walked into the house with the sack on his shoulders.
Throw the sack directly on the ground in the innermost room of the Westinghouse, and said to Zhou Guilan with a smile.
"Look at it, this year our stick can sell for a good price." Nothing makes farmers happier than a bumper harvest.
"Really? Geez, that would be great.
Well, you unload the car, I will go up and pack the food, and the meal will be served immediately. "
Zhou Guilan was so happy that she could not close her mouth from ear to ear. After three years of busy work, she was looking forward to this moment.
So happily went to the kitchen to pack up the food and prepare to serve.
Xu Chenghou and his son carried sacks into the house, while Su Anying dragged plastic sheets and put them into the warehouse.
Chu Xuanhuai wanted to help, but found that he couldn't do anything, wandering around couldn't help.
"Master, let's go, let's wash our hands and eat. I can't do these jobs. You can see our stick tomorrow."
Xu Haiyuan, who had been building on the mountain for a day, dragged Chu Xuanhuai into the house with a smile.
The old man is already in his seventies, how can he do such strenuous work, it’s better to stay still than anything else.
After a while, Xu Chenghou and his son finished unloading the car, and Xu Shiyan drove the car back to his home.
A carport was specially built over his house for parking.
Xu Shiyan had just stopped the car, and before he turned around to go back to his parents for dinner, Lai Pigui jumped out from the side, jumped lightly, and jumped into Xu Shiyan's arms.
"Hey, you little one, you're playing tricks on me again, aren't you?
how? I'm so busy working today, no one feeds you? let's go then. "
Xu Shiyan saw that the little rascal was lying motionless in his arms, and he didn't know if he was hungry or sleepy, or just wanted to find someone to hug him.
Xu Shiyan has nothing to do with the rascal, so he can only hold the rascal, lock the door of the house, and then take the rascal to Xu Chenghou's side.
After the ginseng trees were processed and dried, they were hidden by Xu Shiyan, and the two dogs at home were sent to the mountain again.
No way, Zhao Jianguo only has a few puppies on the other side, and they haven't grown up yet. It's not a big deal, not as good as Xiao Huang Erhei.
Although there are a lot of plants on the side of Liumao River, the others are all newly planted, so don't be careless.
When autumn is the most critical time, we have to let Xiao Huang and the others stay on the mountain for a while, and wait for the snow to fall before bringing them home.
Without a dog, the rascal had no chance to show off his prestige, so as soon as he entered the yard, he jumped directly to the ground and hopped into the house.
When Zhou Guilan saw the rascal coming, she was quite puzzled, why did this little thing come here today?
"No, I went to feed it during the day, is it not full?
Wait a minute, I'll find you another piece of meat. "
Zhou Guilan hurried to the kitchen, and threw the small piece of meat left over from cooking to the rascal ghost to eat.
Lai Pigui ate the meat lying on the outside corridor.
Xu Shiyan didn't bother to care about it, so he hurried to wash his hands and face, and went to eat with his family.
If the old rules were followed, on the day when the club was played, pigs and sheep would be slaughtered to invite theatrical troupe, and it would be in time for the festival.
A few years ago, it was a commune, and those particularities were gone, and some old rules were dropped.
However, Zhou Guilan still made a lot of delicious food to celebrate the autumn harvest.
Chicken stewed with mushrooms, pork ribs stewed with beans and corn harvest vegetables, fried peppers with meat, stuffed eggplants, tomatoes mixed with sugar, and pig ears mixed with cucumbers are everyone’s favorites.
"Yo, the dishes served tonight are so tough? Mom, I'm tired."
Xu Shiyan looked at the dishes on the table and knew that his mother was busy.
"Then our family has a stick? Why can't we have something delicious?
Do you two drink alcohol? I boil the jug of wine? Drinking just to relieve fatigue? "Zhou Guilan asked, going to the cupboard to look for wine.
"Father, if you want to drink, you can drink some, I won't drink." Xu Shiyan didn't plan to drink.
The mallet in his house is a bit conspicuous, and no one dares to say whether anyone is thinking about it.
He should be alert at night, don't drink, it will easily delay things.
"Old woman, don't be so busy, I won't drink either.
What kind of wine are you drinking at this time? Wait until the mallet is made and sold for money. "
Xu Chenghou is an old man, how can he still not understand what his son means? He thought about it too.
In the past, the production team had to be watched by militiamen even when they played the stick, let alone now.
Whoever brings back more than a dozen sacks of clubs at once, has to keep one eye open at night.
In case something happens, three years of hard work will be in vain.
The two of them refused to drink, and Zhou Guilan didn't persuade them, so everyone sat down to eat.
After a busy day, I will be tired and hungry at night, and I don’t need to pretend at home, just open it and eat it.
Chicken stewed with mushrooms is cooked very well, and the meat is soft and rotten. The mushrooms are the pine mushrooms that children go to the forest to pick up in summer.
This stewed chicken with pine mushrooms is fresher than hazel mushrooms and frozen mushrooms. It is definitely delicious in soup and meat.
Don't talk about eating meat, just scoop some soup into the rice, and you can eat two big bowls of rice with the soup.
"It's delicious and delicious. I've gained weight in the past half a year." Chu Xuanhuai laughed while eating.

chapters.title: Chapter 517: Brush ginseng to make goods
chapters.content:
Chapter 517 Brush ginseng to make goods
The clubs are all here, and Xu Shiyan's family will definitely live here at night.
So after dinner, everyone started to work again.
Zhou Guilan and Su Anying packed up the quilts and put them on the kang to cover them, while Xu Shiyan and Xu Chenghou took a lot of boards and nailed the front and rear windows of the innermost room of the West House from the inside.
Xu Chenghou's side also has five main rooms, with a door in the middle.
If you want to enter the west room, you have to jump in through the front and back windows instead of going through the front door and through the outer room.
When the house was first built, it was not popular to install steel bars on the windows. At that time, there was no place to install steel bars, so there was no inlay.
The windows have two layers, the outer layer opens outwards, and the inner layer opens inwards.
So the windows are nailed up with wooden boards from the inside, even if a thief really comes in, there is no way to enter the house through the window.
Xu Shiyan and his wife lived in the outer room of the Westinghouse at night, and locked the door. If there was any movement, the husband and wife would know first.
Chu Xuanhuai didn't go back there at night, so he simply stayed in the clinic with Xu Haiyuan.
As for the three rooms in the clinic, Xu Chenghou specially found someone to set up a small kang a while ago, as well as a fireplace and stove, because he was afraid that Chu Xuanhuai would be cold in winter.
Chu Xuanhuai is old and feels light at night. If there is any movement outside, he can hear it.
There are three Xu Jinpings. Needless to say, they must be living outside the east room with Xu Chenghou and his wife.
As for the rambunctious ghost, he didn't know what was going on, he didn't leave after eating the meat, he had to lie down in the outer corridor.
Zhou Guilan saw it, so, hurry up and find a sack for the bunk, let it go.
Now this is the God of Wealth, no one can afford to offend, so do whatever you like.
In this way, each settled down, the door was bolted and locked, the door of the house was plugged, and the family went to sleep in their beds.
It was safe and sound overnight, and everyone was relieved to wake up early.
It's Monday, Xu Shiyan can't always ask for leave, he has to go back to work.
Xu Chenghou and Su Anying had to help Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli, and Yang Chunming's family with the club today.
"Mom, if you can't handle the mallet, wait until I come back.
Anyway, I’m not in a hurry for this day, I’m free tomorrow, so let’s brush together. "
Before going out, Su Anying had to tell her mother-in-law.
She is worried that her mother-in-law is too tired to watch the children cook and work hard.
Is Zhou Guilan the kind of person who can take time off? If the mallet comes back and doesn't brush it, how can she be happy?
After the son and daughter-in-law had left, the old lady poured out a sack, soaked it in the big vat outside, and slowly brushed it.
It is estimated that Han Cai'e knew that her in-laws had joined the party, and she was having a hard time at home, so she came to help brush the clubs at eight o'clock.
Even Su Anyu, who was at the hotel and restaurant, was not busy in the morning, so she handed over all the hotel and hotel affairs to Zhou Lirong, and she also came to help with the work.
It’s not just a matter of random brushing.
Pull off the remaining stubble of the mallet straw, and clean the reed bowl left over from the previous year with a bamboo stick.
Then brush off the mud on the main body of the mallet little by little, and then carefully brush the ginseng whiskers.
Don’t use too much force when brushing. Red ginseng is not peeled and raw sun-dried ginseng, so you can’t brush it to break the skin.
If the skin is broken and the pulp is lost, it is easy to have white skin and grooves, and it will not be rated well without being scaled.
The tool for brushing parameters used to be a shoe brush.
Split that kind of bamboo shoe brush into two halves, and use a knife to trim the handle of the brush to a point, so that one brush can be used at both ends.
Later, someone discovered the business opportunity in it and specialized in this kind of brush for brushing ginseng.
It is half narrower than a shoe brush. The black bristles are relatively hard. The handle of the brush is pointed and can be used as a bamboo stick.
Since last year, each company has made products. Zhou Guilan went to the store to buy this kind of brush for brushing ginseng.
Han Cai'e and Su Anyu were also quite sloppy at work, they kept their hands on while talking, and after a while, a big white and plump mallet came out.
"Ma'am, your mallet is really nice, it looks so good."
Su Anyu looked around with the mallet she had brushed, and it was rare.
"Let's not talk about it, this mallet really looks like a little fat doll, no wonder there are ginseng dolls in the ginseng story, how do you look like it?"
"Well, this year our stick is pretty good.
Waiting to pick two big ones for the in-laws, and the elder brother of the in-laws to keep, and then get a bottle and put it in wine or something. "
Zhou Guilan said while brushing the mallet.
Ginseng soaked in wine is a great tonic. If others don't give it to you, why should you keep one for your serious relatives?
"Oh, don't, this ginseng is not expensive.
My uncle is very busy every day, and finally planted some big sticks. It would be a pity to keep the wine. "
Han Caie quickly shook her head and waved her hands when she heard this.
How much does such a big mallet cost? Save the wine? Isn't that spoiling something good?
What’s so good about that wine? Let's keep the selling money for my daughter and uncle.
Zhou Guilan laughed as soon as she heard it, "The ones from our own farm, no matter how expensive they are, won't make the in-laws reluctant to make wine.
Not much, just one tree for each family, buy a big glass bottle, fill it with five or six catties of wine and soak it.
People go to the house during the holidays, so make something out to entertain guests, that’s a good thing that can’t be found anywhere. "
If you put some deer antler, tiger bone, and old grass in it, the wine will be very powerful.
"That's okay, don't get used to their problems.
What’s the point of drinking that wine? It's so spicy, I don't know what those old men think, why do they like this? "
Han Caie shook her head. She has been married to Su Weizhong for many years, but she still hasn't figured it out.
Why do men can't move when they see alcohol? That stuff is so delicious?
When Zhou Guilan heard this, she laughed, "I don't understand this either, maybe they think it's delicious."
Here, the in-laws led Su Anyu to brush the sticks, graded them while brushing, and put the sticks into the large aluminum basin when there were enough brushes.
The reed head of the mallet faces outward, and the beard faces inward, neatly placed in a large basin layer by layer.
Pour half a pot of water into the big pot, put the pot curtain on it, and then the two of them put the big pot on top of the pot curtain together, and add some water to the pot, not too much.
There are a lot of mallets in the big pot, and the big pot with the tip will definitely not be able to cover the pot.
So cover it with a double layer of ginseng plastic film, and tie it tightly with a rope to ensure that the steam inside will not leak out.
Heat the bottom of the pot on a high fire, and steam for two and a half hours.
This is the way to make red goods. It is relatively simple. The difficulty lies in controlling the heat during steaming. The time should be determined according to the size of the stick.
Zhou Guilan did the same thing last year, and she is already very experienced, so there is nothing wrong with this.
While steaming ginseng in the pot, Zhou Guilan found old sheets and clothes that were not used at home, and tore them into strips and bundled sticks.
"In-law, what are you doing here?"
Han Cai'e has never seen this before, so she finds it strange, this is a good product for brushing sticks and mallets, why do they have to be wrapped in cloth strips?
"Oh, these sticks are too big, I'm afraid they will break their petals when steaming. It will be better to wrap them with cloth strips."
The Xu family has a big mallet, so we must pay attention to it. If it is cracked, it will not be sold at a good price if it is not in good condition.

chapters.title: Chapter 518: work well
chapters.content:
Chapter 518 works well
In autumn, not only the planting households are busy, but the field is even busier.
One ginseng field has started to produce 40,000 feet of ginseng this year. This year's ginseng production is good, and it can increase compared to last year.
40,000 feet to make goods, almost can produce more than one million catties of fresh ginseng.
How can such a large output be produced in three to five days?
I started participating on September 6th, and it’s only a little over halfway through now.
It is natural for everyone to be happy with the increase in production of ginseng, but the pressure on the processing plant is also extremely high.
The amount of processing is too large, but the manpower is not enough. There is no choice but to mobilize the family members of the participating workers, and all who can come to work.
In addition, a group of temporary workers will be recruited from surrounding areas such as Donggang and Songjianghe.
Fortunately, the beverage factory and the mineral water factory grabbed orders for the autumn in the summer, so at this time, most of the workers can be dispatched to work.
The processing plant belongs to the source of materials. There is no output here, and the production line behind has no raw materials and cannot produce.
But the processing factory is only busy for two or three months, after which time there is nothing to be busy, and they cannot recruit workers alone.
No way, no matter how nice the ginseng may say, it is actually a kind of ginseng.
Farming season is here, we must seize the time and rush to get people to work. This is the top priority.
Students from Donggang Middle School have come to the annual classic project again to work in the processing factory to earn class fees.
Anyway, those students are laughing and joking about their work, and they don't feel tired at all, and they think it's quite interesting.
"How is it? Are you all busy with the family affairs?" Lin Qiyue saw Xu Shiyan coming back to work, and asked him with a smile.
"Your family is coming back, how is it? Is the output high?"
Not only the members of the Second Brigade were curious, but even Lin Qiyue wanted to know what the output of Xu Shiyan's sticks was.
"It's okay, the output is good, and I haven't checked the scales specifically. Anyway, a sack can be lifted at three feet. With the soil and skins deducted, it is estimated that it can lift about 30 catties at one foot."
Xu Shiyan is quite satisfied with the output of his own sticks.
This year, my family’s 30-foot-long clubs can produce a lot of big-budget products. If the market is good, they can sell for a lot of money.
"Thirty catties? You are still amazing.
The best mallet in our field weighed twenty-eight catties in one foot, making Lao Li and Lao Dai jump high with joy.
Your family produces an average of 30 catties, which is really good. When Lin Qiyue heard this, he gave a thumbs up.
Xu Shiyan smiled, "There are only thirty-odd yards in my family who make goods, and my daughter-in-law takes care of the stick like it is her own child.
In the spring of this year, I gave the stick a chance to fertilize it. Is it not going to grow well? "
As the so-called people are not lazy, this is still reasonable.
Thirty feet long, carefully cared for, provided with fertilizer and water, looks very normal.
"Well, yes, this is true. I also care about my own things.
But our place is pretty good, I checked, and basically it can be higher than the task amount set by Kaichun.
This is not bad. I never thought before that our ginseng field could produce so much. "
Lin Qiyue was just curious and had no other intentions.
So far, the output, orders, and profits of the participants have far exceeded expectations, and Lin Qiyue is quite content.
"Here, look at these reports.
The county kept urging our site to fully implement the contract system.
But I looked at the financial statements of the past few years, and the profits of our factory have doubled in the past few years, and the wages and bonuses of the workers are also much higher than in previous years.
Besides, I asked someone to find out that the yield per unit area of ​​the second and third ginseng farms this year is not as high as ours.
I think we should maintain the current form, what do you think? "
Lin Qiyue took out a stack of documents and reports and asked Xu Shiyan to study them.
Both of them feel that the current venue is running well, the venue is cohesive, and the employees have centripetal force.
The whole audience was twisted into one rope, and they were all working hard in a good direction. It seemed that there was no need to contract.
"Well, based on this year's production, each employee will be rewarded generously in addition to completing the tasks assigned by the beginning of the spring.
I also think that the current form is quite good, and there is no need to change it. "
Xu Shiyan looked through those documents and reports, and compared this year's production with the task amount set in the beginning of spring, and calculated it in his mind.
Based on the current production and market conditions, it is estimated that this year's workers will earn one or two thousand yuan more than last year.
This year, quite a lot.
With the backing of the site, the employees don't have any worries. They should work hard, and they can get more bonuses at the end of the year than in previous years.
That's fine, there's really no need to change anything.
"Yes, I thought so too, but I still need to hold a staff meeting in a few days to listen to the workers' opinions." Lin Qiyue smiled.
Actually, several leaders in the field have the same idea, but the higher-ups require that they have to come up with a charter.
Hold a staff meeting and let the employees express their opinions on whether or not to completely contract the contract. In this way, there will not be so much trouble.
The staff meeting will definitely take a while, and now I am so busy that I want to split it in half. Who cares about holding a meeting? So that's all for this topic.
Then, Lin Qiyue discussed with Xu Shiyan about processing and making goods this autumn, and the coordination between various orders.
At present, there are more than a dozen products in one exhibition, and the order quantity of each product is different, and the processing method is also different.
100,000 glass bottles of ginseng honey flakes, 250,000 plastic bottles, 12,000 gift boxes, and 20,000 bottles of ginseng honey.
For these alone, about 120,000 catties of fresh ginseng are needed.
Honey slices have size requirements, and most of them need to pick two to two halves of fresh ginseng to make.
There are 5,000 boxes of high-end gifts. This one is in a very beautiful gift box, with a red whole beard and a white whole beard.
are all sewn with gold thread on cardboard wrapped in red velvet, and what is sold is actually the packaging.
This requires picking fresh ginseng from three to two to work. Basically, the largest ginseng is picked in, and it takes about three thousand catties of fresh ginseng.
Changbaishan red ginseng has become famous in the past two years, and there are many orders. This year, there are 8,000 boxes of orders.
Calculated, nearly 40,000 catties of fresh ginseng would be enough.
Changbaishan red ginseng does not have too much requirements on the branch, but the body must be good.
In addition, there are 2,000 boxes of natural active ginseng, and it is estimated that 10,000 catties of fresh ginseng are enough.
These are all foreign trade exports, and they are orders for ginseng as the main ingredient.
The rest are domestic orders.
A few days ago, several customers in the South signed an order of 50,000 catties for Hongquanxu, Hongguangzhi, and Hongzhixu with a participant.
Based on four catties of fresh ginseng and one catty of fresh ginseng, 200,000 catties of fresh ginseng would be needed.
The rest are the orders signed with the provincial medicinal materials company.
In the end, there were some scraps left, which were just enough for the beverage factory, and nothing was wasted.
That is to say, at present, the one million catties of fresh ginseng in a ginseng market have not all been produced, and all of them have found their in-laws.
"Shiyan, you said that without our independent research and development, there would be no introduction of southern customers.
Our output is so large now, what should we do with the rest beyond the purchase contract of the provincial medicinal material company? "
Lin Qiyue looked at the pile of numbers in front of him, and suddenly said this.

chapters.title: Chapter 519: hand in tasks
chapters.content:
Chapter 519 Turn in the task
Lin Qiyue suddenly asked this question, which directly stunned Xu Shiyan.
"What should I do? The medicinal material company can't buy that much, so we can only keep it in our hands.
But I think, with Secretary Lin's ability, this will never happen.
If the merchants don’t come, let’s go find them ourselves, there is always a way. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, can a living person be suffocated by urine? As long as you are willing to think of a way, there is always a way out.
Of course, the effect is definitely not as good as it is now.
Lin Qiyue also laughed, "That's why I said, it was very wise to recruit you back then."
That is more than wise, it is simply a treasure.
Now Yishenchangguang is a self-developed product, earning nearly 20 million US dollars in foreign exchange every year.
Now if Xu Shiyan goes out and says that he doesn’t want to participate in the field, there are countless units out there vying for important people.
So every time Lin Qiyue thinks about it, he feels very proud.
When Lin Qiyue said this, he seemed to be praising Xu Shiyan, but also seemed to be boasting.
But the two of them didn't care, they all laughed.
"Secretary Lin, if you have nothing to do here, I have to find someone to hold a meeting.
We have so many products now, and the requirements of each product are different. I have to ask them to come up with a plan, how to complete the processing task in an efficient and time-saving manner.
There is more than one million catties of fresh ginseng, there is no time to delay. "
Enough laughing, Xu Shiyan walked out of Lin Qiyue's office with the stack of documents just now.
Call the heads of the technical department, quality inspection station, and processing plant over, and hold a meeting.
Clarify the processing tasks for this year, the technical department will guide, the quality inspection station will check, and the processing factory will go all out to produce.
All departments cooperate with each other and must complete this year's processing tasks with high quality.
After the meeting, Xu Shiyan was not idle, and went directly to the processing factory with Han Limin and others.
From the time when ginseng entered the processing plant, Xu Shiyan personally took care of every process, and if he encountered unreasonable arrangements, he immediately discussed and improved them.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan stayed in the processing factory for a whole day, didn't go home for lunch, and dealt with it directly in the cafeteria.
Xu Shiyan came home after eight o'clock in the evening. As soon as he entered the house, he smelled a very strong aroma of steamed ginseng.
Needless to say, the family must have signed up for work.
"Mom, you're fast enough, I haven't picked out the mallet to hand in the task yet." Xu Shiyan said as he entered the door with a smile.
The land allocated by Donggang Village belonged to Donggang Village at that time. There was no need to spend money to buy ginseng soil, but it was necessary to hand in tasks to the village.
At that time, the three-year ginseng and soil were divided together, so three-year tasks had to be handed in.
Each person has eight catties of ginseng per year, even Xu Chenghou and his wife have a total of seven people, that is one hundred and sixty-eight catties of sticks.
In the future, the ginseng soil from the village will no longer be required, so you will have to pay the general fund-raising fees to the village as normal, as well as the special product tax.
Generally speaking, there are rules for handing in tasks.
How much is the first-class, how much is the second-class, and the rusty ones are not allowed, and the scars are not allowed.
That's why Xu Shiyan said that he hasn't picked a stick to hand in the task yet.
"Hey, we still need to pick this mallet? If you want me to say, you have to throw the big one out."
Zhou Guilan laughed as soon as she heard it. During the day, she brushed out a sack of clubs, which was so big that it looked like a rarity.
"A lot of people came to our house today to see our club, and everyone who saw it said yes."
Many people saw it yesterday when they started participating in the mountain, and they knew that the Xu family was doing well this year.
Those aunts and six wives who are trustworthy, why don't they watch the fun?
This matter is really unavoidable, and Zhou Guilan can't block the gate to prevent anyone from entering. This is not how things are done in life.
Xu Shiyan naturally understood this and didn't say anything.
"Well, let's pick out the task tomorrow, my daughter-in-law and my father will go to the village together and hand in the task.
Don't worry, come back and let's make goods safely and steadily. "
After handing in the task, the ginseng company will settle the settlement with the village according to the grade price. After the village deducts various expenses, the remaining money will be distributed to the farmers.
Of course, the price of the hammer for handing in tasks is lower.
"Okay, I'll take care of this tomorrow, don't worry.
You haven't gone to work for a few days, is there anything wrong with your work unit? Secretary Lin didn't say anything? "
Xu Shiyan asked for leave for several days to participate in the market, and Su Anying was worried that in this busy season, the participants would also be busy, and whether Lin Qiyue would have any opinion on Xu Shiyan.
"It's okay, what can Secretary Lin say?
At any rate, I brought a client over to a market and ordered 50,000 catties of dry goods.
Although it is not as good as exporting, it is more expensive than selling to pharmaceutical companies. "Xu Shiyan laughed.
"I made a calculation with Secretary Lin today. With the order of 50,000 catties of dry goods, the production of sticks this year happened to be arranged.
Don’t worry about exporting all the good and big products, and there is no place to sell the remaining cheat sheets and ginseng. "
The current strategy of one participant is to keep the good and big ones for export to earn foreign exchange, and sell the rest to the provincial medicinal materials company.
However, this year's production is high, and there will be some left over, which will be sold to customers in the south, and the price is not low, which is very reasonable.
"That's fine, as long as you have nothing to do at work.
You don’t need to worry about the family, my parents and I can take care of it. "Su Anying nodded.
"By the way, have you eaten yet? Where is the rice left for you in the pot." Su Anying suddenly remembered, and hurriedly asked.
"I didn't eat it, I just stayed in the processing factory all day.
I ate in the cafeteria at noon, and in the afternoon I was busy looking at steamed ginseng pots and so on, so I didn't take care of it. "
Xu Shiyan hit the back of his head with his feet busy, how could he care about eating? Now my stomach is empty, and I am gurgling with hunger.
As soon as Su Anying heard this, she hurried to bring out the meal, don't put the table on it, just sit at the pot table, take a small bench and eat.
Lai Pigui hasn't left yet, and still lives here. Seeing Xu Shiyan eating, Lai Pigui leans over.
Xu Shiyan saw that this little guy was so shameless, he had no choice but to break a piece of steamed bun for it, anyway he likes to eat it or not.
There is no raw meat for it to eat at night, and those dishes have salt.
Foxes can’t eat salt. If they eat it, they will lose their fur, and even their big tails will become bald.
Foxes are omnivores, and rascals have been with people for a long time, so they can eat anything.
Steamed buns are also fine, just take them to the corridor outside, lie there and chew and play.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan went to the west room to have a look.
The sticks steamed during the day have been placed on the fork, and they are all stored in the Westinghouse. They can be taken out to dry in the morning.
Xu Shiyan tried the steamed ginseng with his hands. Well, the heat is okay.
If the steaming time of this red product is short, the color will be light, and the conversion of various active ingredients will be less.
If the steaming heat is too high, the color is too dark, and the scale is not pressed.
It seems that my mother's skills are still good, and the fire is well controlled, so Xu Shiyan felt relieved and came out of the room.
"Daughter-in-law, what about the construction and victory of their house today? Is it okay to have a long head?"
"Well, they are all pretty good, similar to the ones in Feng Chao's house yesterday.
These few also said that this year, try to plant as many seeds as possible in the ground, and if it doesn’t work, go buy some, or make big purchases with big seeds. "

chapters.title: Chapter 520: Shanhuozhuang
chapters.content:
Chapter 520 Shanhuozhuang
The stick came back, and the crops in the field were almost cleaned up, so I can just make goods with peace of mind.
On the morning of the 16th, Xu Shiyan went to work as usual. Su Anying picked out a 168-jin club in the morning, and went to the village with Xu Chenghou to hand in the task.
Yu Shouguang is still the secretary of Donggang Village. When he saw the stick sent by the Xu family, it was really good.
Yu Shouguang was quite satisfied, so he had to chat with Xu Chenghou for a while, and praise Xu Shiyan well.
Xu Chenghou's favorite thing to hear now is when people praise his son and grandson, making him laugh from ear to ear.
While Yu Shouguang was chatting with Xu Chenghou, the accountant in the village had already registered the tasks according to their grade and weight.
After registering, Xu Chenghou and Su Anying pressed their fingerprints on the booklet before leaving.
After handing in the task, I don’t have much time to think about it. I just need to wash and steam my stick as soon as possible.
Su Anying, Zhou Guilan, and Han Caie and Su Anyu also came to help.
These people are responsible for brushing the ginseng. Xu Chenghou looks at the steamed sticks in the pot, and makes them as soon as possible, so as not to prevent the sticks from returning to pulp after a long time.
The Xu family’s 37-foot sticks weighed more than 1,200 catties in total, and after deducting the task, there was still 1,000 points left.
The Xu family's mallet has a high output and is naturally not small, with a large proportion of large sticks.
Following her mother-in-law's wishes, Su Anying singled out a dozen or so big ones to keep.
I only washed the soil, and then came back with a drink, and found something to soak in it first.
This, keeping it for the Chinese New Year gift, is rarer than anything else.
The rest are cleaned, steamed in a pan, and then dried.
In the past few years, we have mainly made red goods, and the main players in the market also buy more red goods, and the price is higher than that of white goods.
The Xu family only had these sticks, it wasn't worth getting a steamed ginseng basket, so they used a big pot.
Every time the mallet is picked out from the basin, there will be some viscous light yellow liquid left under the bottom of the basin.
This is a good thing, it can be reused, and it will be poured in again when steaming ginseng next time.
The steamed ginseng has less white skin, more beautiful color, and oily.
Wait until the last pot of ginseng is steamed, the liquid is already very viscous, you can add some brown sugar or not, put it in the pot to boil.
Evaporate the water to form a dark brown paste, which is ginseng paste.
One thousand catties of sticks, scrubbing is quite fast, and it was finished in two days.
Steaming ginseng took some time, especially those big ones, which need to be wrapped with cloth strips, which is more laborious.
But there is always something to be gained from hard work. The sticks wrapped in cloth strips do not hit the petals, and each one is quite complete.
It’s also very plump when exposed, so it’s worth the effort.
Su Anying makes goods at home, and goes to the market from time to time to wander around to see the situation.
Some of the southern customers who were invited for the opening of Canshi left, but most of them stayed, and many of them received goods at Canshi.
Although the purchase price of southern merchants is similar to that of the county ginseng company, the pressure is not so strict, and those who are not bad will accept it.
So the participating households are very happy to sell them.
This rumor has been widely spread. Whenever the goods at home are dry enough to be sold, some people will go to the market to sell the goods.
Donggang Town listened to Xu Shiyan's opinion, and instead of directly collecting fees at the gate of the city, they collected money by scale.
After the transaction is successful, go to the designated weighing area for weighing.
The people in the town guard here and charge a certain fee based on the turnover, which is not too high.
The fee is charged here, and the ticket is directly stamped on the other side. The person receiving the goods will take the ticket and go to the county to exchange the transportation certificate at that time.
In this way, it prevents some people from running out to find the scale in order to avoid the small fee.
The person who receives the goods can also rest assured that the scale is notarized, and there will be no shortage of weight.
The merchants can store the goods in their own rooms or in the warehouse after receiving the goods. The large warehouse in the south of the city is for them.
The warehouse is charged separately on a daily basis, which is not expensive and affordable.
The news of these merchants is also exchanged. Some people didn't know that there was a market here before, and they didn't catch up when it opened.
I heard the news later, so I had to come over to see the situation in person.
These people are here, and they must eat and live in the restaurants and hotels in the north of Canshi, so the business here is also very good.
The hotels and restaurants are mainly managed by Zhou Lirong and Su Anyu.
The minimum of these two is a junior high school education, and they have been specially trained and have management experience.
Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli's daughters-in-law also thought that the hotel was doing well, and wanted to participate in the management, but Su Anying vetoed it.
No matter what kind of business or business, too many shareholders should not be allowed to participate in the management, let alone the family members of the shareholders.
Otherwise, the seven heads of the family and the eight heads of the family each have their own ideas and abilities, and the people below don't know who to listen to, so no business can be done well.
There is a row of more than 20 large and small stores in Xitou, and the company reserves the largest office for itself.
In addition to this, a place is reserved for each family. Su Anying doesn't care whether they do it by themselves or rent it out. Anyway, as long as each family does not participate in the management of restaurants and hotels.
For the rest, directly post advertisements for rent.
There are those who are so open-minded. Seeing that the business in the market is good, they think that the sales outside will definitely be good.
So I found Su Anying, negotiated the rent, and rented it to do some business.
After about half a month since the opening of the store, all the remaining stores were rented out, and none of them were left.
"Shiyan, almost all of the stores in Dongtou of our city have been rented out. Originally, the two of us were thinking about leaving a place for the fourth and fourth couple to set up a snack bar.
I see that many people have this idea. If you think about it again, what else can you do? "
The Xu family also kept a store for themselves. At night, Su Anying consulted with Xu Shiyan to see what their store could do.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it, "Then what are you doing? Build a Shanhuozhuang.
You asked Xiao Ji to collect all kinds of wild goods everywhere when he had nothing to do, while the fourth younger sister guarded the store to deliver food.
All kinds of local medicinal materials, such as gastrodia elata, ganoderma, fritillaria, codonopsis, astragalus, elixir, schisandra, mushrooms, fungus, pine nuts, walnuts, hazelnuts, etc., you can get them.
Those merchants from other places don’t just sell ginseng, they also sell special products from the north and the south.
People came over to have a look, didn’t they just buy it?
The deer products from our farm can also be sold here.
Doesn’t this thing make more money than a snack shop? Not tired yet. "
So, this means that the idea has not been opened yet. When the development here is good in the future, and there are all kinds of mountain products, the business will be better at that time.
When doing business, you can’t all rush into one project. You won’t make money that way, you have to think of something that others can’t think of.
Back against the market, the traffic is not small, why not the whole Shanhuozhuang? Sure can.
"Look, I said I'll discuss everything with you, right? This is really good, but isn't it a little bit late this year?"
Su Anying was a little hesitant. Is it too late to do it at this time?
"You see, you didn't say it earlier, why don't we prepare earlier?"
"What you said, I can predict that our market will be so prosperous as soon as it opens."
Xu Shiyan glanced at his daughter-in-law, thinking that he has front and back eyes, and he is not a fairy.

chapters.title: Chapter 521: Make money and burglarize
chapters.content:
Chapter 521 Earned money and broke into thieves
Su Anying got her husband's advice, and the next day, she hurriedly tried to find a way to send a letter to Ji Tongzhong and his wife, asking them to come and discuss something.
Ji Tongzhong and his wife have just taken back the crops in the field, and they haven't waited for everything to be processed.
As soon as I heard that my second sister and second brother-in-law were looking for them, I immediately put down my work and came to Donggang.
Hearing here, I knew that the second sister’s family wanted to open a shop again, and asked the two of them to come over to help with the work, and the couple would pay wages. After thinking about it, the two of them thought it would be great.
Ji Tongzhong didn't want to farm in the village for a long time. When he heard that there was work to do, he went back to Shuanglong Village happily.
Entrusted all the food and livestock at home to parents, and came to Donggang with the children and luggage.
The storefronts are all on the second floor, the store is opened downstairs, and people can live upstairs.
Ji Tongzhong's family lived upstairs, and then began to make arrangements for opening a store.
I didn’t prepare before, but now I’m making shelves and counters, and I have to collect all kinds of wild goods, which is enough for Ji Tongzhong and his wife anyway.
The two of them were busy, so the child was handed over to Han Cai'e to help look after it. Anyway, it is good to be close to the old man.
Shanhuozhuang can’t be opened in a day or two, so don’t be in a hurry, Xu Shiyan and his wife know it well.
Just let Ji Tongzhong and his wife take it easy and work slowly. It doesn't matter if they don't make it this year, it doesn't matter what they can make.
At this time, the Xu family's clubs were almost all processed.
The small ones have been dried in the sun, and the big ones need to be dried for a few more days.
Su Anying picked up the agents of several customers and wanted to help them receive the goods.
The two parties have agreed that the payment will be sent over there, and Su Anying will receive the goods according to the order form, and send them away after receiving enough.
Coincidentally, the Xu family doesn't need to go to the market to sell this little product, and it will be done by selling it directly to merchants in the south. It saves worry and effort, and the price is not low.
"We ordered 2,500 catties for this batch of goods, and now we have received half of it.
The little hexagon strips left in our house will be completely dry in another five or six days, and I will be able to completely free up my hands to receive the goods. "
In the evening, when Xu Shiyan got off work, Su Anying had to talk to him about these things at home.
"I did the math, our family's sticks came out with a total of two hundred and sixty catties of dry goods.
The market is good this year, and there are a lot of big sticks in our products. All in all, we can sell about 34,000 this year. "
When Su Anying said this, she smiled broadly.
Don't look at the more than 30,000 yuan, it can't compare with their ginseng soil, and it can't even keep up with the income of the farm.
But in Su Anying's view, this is the right way. As for ginseng farming, ginseng is still the main species.
Think about it differently, if their family doesn't have such great skills, they just live by planting ginseng.
The thirty-seven-foot club sold for more than 30,000 yuan, and the whole family was so happy that they couldn't sleep for several days.
As far as this year is concerned, who can earn more than 30,000 yuan a year? Even after deducting the various expenses required for planting ginseng this year, there would still be more than 20,000 yuan left.
Besides, next year, their family will still start shipping.
The year-by-year cycle has started, and there are more than 20,000 yuan every year. What kind of life can compare with them?
Of course, the more than 30,000 yuan included Xu Chenghou and his wife.
But now the two of them are almost the same as one family, separate calculations and total calculations are the same.
"Also, we collect more than 2,000 catties of goods for others, and there is ten yuan for hard work per catty.
Let’s not count too much, even if it costs ten yuan, we can still earn 20,000 yuan.
Oh, I figured out that we can draw a lot of money this fall, so I feel happy. "
No matter what time it is, earning money is something that makes people feel happy. Su Anying is very happy, and feels that such days are the most enjoyable.
If it’s really like someone else said, the two of them don’t have to do anything, and they can live by lying down and earning interest, then it’s really meaningless.
"Looking at you like that, you look like a money fanatic who has never seen money."
Xu Shiyan looked at his daughter-in-law with a smile on his face, deliberately teasing her.
"Are you not a money fan? If you are not a money fan, where did our family get all this money? Are you still talking about me?"
Su Anying was annoyed, and reached out to pinch Xu Shiyan's neck.
As a result, Xu Shiyan hugged him, and the two laughed together.
Smiling and laughing, it seems that the taste has changed.
In the east room, Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan had just put the children to sleep, and the old couple hadn't rested yet.
Hearing Westinghouse's laughter, Zhou Guilan shook her head and smiled.
"These two people have been married for ten years, and Yuanyuan has grown up to such a big person. They can still go crazy when they say they are crazy."
Xu Chenghou reached out and pulled down the light cord, and the room was completely dark.
"You don't care about them, if you love crazy, go crazy.
This is now, if we don’t want to have more children, we have to put it aside before, there are more than four in the family?
You were thirty-two when you gave birth to our old girl. "
Zhou Guilan thinks about it too. In the past, there were women in their forties who gave birth to children. There were seven or eight children in a family, and even more powerful ones could have more than ten children.
"Sleep, sleep, I've been busy working and making goods for a while, and I'm so tired every day. Finally, it's almost over."
Zhou Guilan yawned and fell asleep shortly after touching the pillow.
During this period of time, I was very tired from ginseng and making goods at home.
Especially this year, the mallet grows well and has a good reputation. The few people in the family are always in fear, for fear that something will happen.
Most of the goods are now completely dry. The beards that need to be unpacked and the ones that need to be boxed are only a few big goods left, and they will almost be ready to be boxed in a few days.
After all these days, the big guys really couldn't bear it anymore. After relaxing, they slept soundly at night.
Xu Shiyan slept in a daze until midnight, when he heard something.
At the beginning, I was still in a daze, and I couldn't react a bit.
But the movement continued, he woke up in a jerk, and quickly put on his shoes and got off the ground.
There are rascals living in the outer room, and it seems that rascals were knocking at the door just now.
For a while now, Raipi has been living here and never returned.
There is no small hole on the door for the raspberry, so if it goes out at night, it has to slam the door hard. The people in the house heard it and got up to open the door for it.
However, the rascals seldom go out at night most of the time. I don’t know what happened tonight, and they slammed the door for a long time.
Xu Shiyan just walked to the door of the house and wanted to unlatch it, but suddenly felt something wrong, as if there was light in the outer room.
Moonlight? No, at the end of the eighth month of the lunar calendar, there is no moonlight outside at all, and it is impossible to shine in from the north.
Lights? What light? Headlights?
Not right, there are very few cars these days, let alone cars running on the back road at night.
It's not the car lights flickering, what is that? flashlight?
No, someone.
Xu Shiyan reacted immediately, and took the gun off the wall in response.
Then, Xu Shiyan gently unlatched the Westinghouse door, and opened the door carefully.
The Westinghouse door opens inward, so you don’t need to open it too far, as long as there is a gap.
Xu Shiyan directly pointed the muzzle of the gun outside along the crack of the door, and then looked outside with one eye closed.

chapters.title: Chapter 522: grab one
chapters.content:
Chapter 522 catch one
There are five main rooms in Xu Chenghou's house, and the four rooms in the east and west rooms all have double windows at the front and back.
Only the kitchen is a single-floor opening, mainly for the convenience of ventilation.
At night, the windows are plugged in from the inside, and it is not easy for outsiders to come in silently.
But at this moment, there were two black shadows, holding glass knives in their hands, and cut off the corners of the upper and lower panes of glass on the right side of the kitchen rear window.
I don't know what method they used, the glass didn't fall, and there wasn't much movement.
Then, someone reached into the window and pulled the latch
Then quietly pushed open the window, gently climbed onto the window sill from the outside, and jumped down carefully.
The room was pitch black, and the two walked inside while groping.
Zhou Guilan and Su Anying's mother-in-law and daughter-in-law are both extremely clean and neat people, and they tidy up the kitchen very neatly.
So these two people came in without encountering any messy things, and they didn't make any noise.
Just as the two were about to walk out of the kitchen and came to the corridor outside, suddenly, a shadow rushed over.
The person in front felt a pain in his leg, which made him groan.
When the person behind heard this, he was so angry that he couldn't help cursing in a low voice, "Damn, what are you shouting?"
Damn, I managed to get in, but this stupid thing yelled, something bad happened.
"There is a dog, he has a dog, and he bit me." The one in front endured the pain and replied in a low voice.
"Fart, how can there be a dog in his house? The dogs are all on the mountain." The man behind muttered in a low voice, hesitating whether to move on.
The sound just now probably alarmed the Xu family, if they woke up, their trip would be suspended.
Just as the person behind was hesitating, he suddenly smelled a foul stench.
The two took a big mouthful without any precautions. In an instant, all the snot and tears came down. They were dizzy, nauseated all the time, and couldn't help sneezing.
"Fuck, let's go." At any rate, the one behind was still a little sober, and dragged the one in front back.
"It's all here, why go? Stay and chat for a while."
At this time, Xu Shiyan opened the door from the West Room and pointed his gun directly at the two of them.
Those two moved quickly, jumping onto the kitchen window sill while speaking, Xu Shiyan fired without saying a word.
When the shot rang out, the man in front had already jumped out, while the man behind was climbing onto the window sill and was about to jump down.
Then, the man was shot in the left buttock, and the hurt man screamed and fell out of the window.
At this time, Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan from the east room, Su Anying from the west room, and even Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Haiyuan who lived in the wing room were all alarmed.
In an instant, all the lights in the east and west rooms were lit.
"San'er, is there a thief?" Xu Chenghou opened the door and rushed out.
At this moment, how could Xu Shiyan have the time to answer his father's question? With a gun in one hand, he jumped out of the kitchen window.
The garden stick in the vegetable garden behind Xu's house was opened with a wide opening, which is where the thief must have come in.
Xu Shiyan walked out from the garden stick with his waist down, and saw a few black shadows running north not far away.
One of them is limping, obviously the one who got shot.
The gun in Xu Shiyan's hand is not a semi-automatic, it is an air gun he specially made, the kind that shoots lead bullets, and it was originally for Xu Haiyuan to play with.
This thing is not very lethal. Generally speaking, you may not be able to kill a bird.
So the kid got shot and was able to run.
Xu Shiyan didn't care about that, he pulled the trigger again, and fired another shot at those people.
It was still unlucky for the kid in the back, and got hit again on the bend of his leg.
Although it is a lead bullet, it can't kill anyone, but it hurts enough to hit it all at once.
The man groaned in pain, and immediately fell to the ground, unable to get up this time.
The sound of the air gun is not too loud, but those few people are already frightened, and with the addition of Ye Jing, a little bit of sound will be amplified.
Those people were terrified and ran away in fright. How could they care about their companions? In an instant, those few all ran away.
Xu Shiyan fired a shot and ran after him. The one who was shot just struggled to remember before running, but Xu Shiyan kicked him over.
Xu Shiyan threw the gun aside, stepped forward and held him down.
"Can you still run away? Cut, can you run away in my hands?"
"Brother, buddy, I'm sorry, I was also fooled, please forgive me this time."
The man was really miserable. He was bitten and shot twice for no reason.
Right now, I’m almost regretting it to death, why would he come to steal someone’s mallet?
Now it’s all right, I haven’t even touched the hair of the mallet, not to mention the injury, and I was caught by others.
"Don't tell me that, tell the police."
Xu Shiyan didn't care about that, and just picked that person up.
In the middle of the night, they were running around and yelling outside, and the dogs nearby were all alarmed. Dogs barked continuously, and lights in many houses were turned on.
Coincidentally, the militiamen from Donggang Town just happened to be patrolling here, and when they saw that something was wrong, they rushed over immediately.
"Brother Xu, what's going on?" Someone came over to take a look, recognized Xu Shiyan, and asked hurriedly.
"A thief broke into the house, let me catch one, why are you patrolling here?"
Xu Shiyan took a look, he knew the person who came, the militia company commander of Xisan Village.
"Well, our secretary Shao said, isn't there a market?
Those old customers from other places receive their goods here, and if they don't keep them in order, they will have to worry about it.
So I specifically asked us to pay more attention to this side when patrolling. "
The other party came forward, grabbed the person directly, grabbed his arm and pressed him there.
Lao Keer is a local dialect, referring to those people who come to do business in the south.
Whether they sell ginseng or wood, they are all called old customers.
At this time of year, almost every family in Donggang has made goods and has sticks, so the town has arranged militia patrols.
Because the Tomb of the Martyrs has Can City, which is a key area, the militia company commander of Xisan Village leads people to patrol here.
As a result, they just turned around from the warehouse of the market when they heard that there was something wrong here, so they hurried over, just in time to meet Xu Shiyan holding him down.
"Brother Xu, did you shoot him?" The other party glanced at the ground and asked.
If someone is shot and injured, things will not be easy to handle.
That end is considered theft, and Xu Shiyan’s end is considered wounding with a gun.
A minor injury is fine, but if it is a serious injury, even if it is justified, I am afraid that there will be trouble.
"It's okay, air gun, I bought it for my son to play with." Xu Shiyan smiled.
Can he still not know the severity? At home, he didn't dare to use semi-automatic or anything, for fear that the children would make noises.
"Oh, oh, that's fine, brother Xu, you can go home and rest.
This person is handed over to us, and we will send him to the police station. "
The other party breathed a sigh of relief, as long as it is not a real gun, air guns are fine.
Most of the birds cannot be killed, they are just stunned.
This big living person is estimated to be a wound on the inside and outside at most, so it doesn't matter.
"Okay, then I will trouble you."
There are militiamen here, Xu Shiyan is naturally relieved that he is not afraid that this kid will run away.
So he handed over the people to them, built the gun and walked back.
"How's it going? Is anyone caught?" The two old men asked eagerly when they ran into Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai.

chapters.title: Chapter 523: ran three
chapters.content:
Chapter 523 ran three
"Catched one and ran away for three times. It happened that the company commander of the Xishen Villagers came on patrol with someone and gave them to them."
Xu Shiyan quickly explained to his father and master.
Xu Chenghou heaved a sigh of relief when he heard that, if they all ran away, it would be a waste of work tonight.
As long as one is caught, those few will not even try to escape.
"Everywhere in our house is very tight. Before going to bed at night, I looked around. Why did they come in?"
The old man is very puzzled, the doors and windows are all plugged, how can people come in?
"I don't know too well, I just slept until midnight and heard the rascal knocking on the door.
Then I got up, and felt a light shaking through the door curtain. I thought it was wrong, so I took off the gun. "
The door curtain is made of white Dacron cloth embroidered with some flowers, which is very thin and transparent. Xiwu Xu Shiyan did not turn on the light, so he can see the light outside.
"This is an air gun tonight. If it is replaced with a pistol or a semi-automatic gun, the boy will be half disabled if he is not dead."
Of course, if that's the case, something will happen.
Speaking of which, in these days of burglary, being beaten to death by the owner would be regarded as what he deserved.
How can I say it, if it doesn’t hurt people or don’t, it’s not easy to solve if it gets into trouble.
There was such a thing in my previous life. Someone entered the ground to steal a mallet, tripped over the ground gun, and was injured by the ground gun. The injury was very serious.
The man climbed onto the avenue to ask for help, but unfortunately there was no car passing by at night, and he died on the side of the road.
It was fine at the time, and no one was held accountable for hurting others.
But after a few years, the policies and regulations changed, and the family of the deceased sued.
That's why Xu Shiyan believes that one thing more is worse than one thing less. If you can avoid trouble, then don't cause trouble.
The three of them walked back while talking, and before they reached their door, Huang Shengli and Sun Xiaofeng ran over from the house with flashlights.
"Third brother, what happened just now?"
The dogs outside are all barking, can the neighbors stop watching?
Huang Shengli and the others came out to check, and happened to see the three of them, Xu Shiyan, and suddenly felt something was wrong, so they came to ask.
"Well, a thief broke into the house. I grabbed one and ran away three, and the man was taken away by the militia."
Xu Shiyan smiled when he saw these two buddies.
"Let's go, go home and have a look, I'm also wondering, how did you get in?"
A group of people entered the gate and went back to the kitchen to check. As soon as they entered the room, there was still a faint smell in the room.
"Did your rascal fart? My God, is it still so stinky?" Sun Xiaofeng and the two hurriedly covered their noses.
"Well, two people came in, and the rascal took a bite, and then it farted again.
Smothered those two people to death, turned around and ran away. "
Xu Shiyan was watching through the door of the west room. Although he couldn't see the kitchen, he could hear the movement and smell the outside room.
Just at this time, Lai Pigui jumped into Xu Shiyan's arms. Xu Shiyan held it, and rubbed Lai Pigui's head, not thinking it smelled bad.
"I did another meritorious service tonight, thanks to you knocking the door open, otherwise I wouldn't have heard anything."
If it wasn't for the rascal's knocking on the door, Xu Shiyan would probably have heard those people knocking on the door of the West House.
It was a bit late at that time, and it was tantamount to face-to-face. If the other party had something in his hand, it would be easy to get hurt if there was a bad quarrel.
At this moment, all the lights in the room were turned on, Xu Shiyan was going to the kitchen to check the window, when Su Anying beside him spoke.
"I saw it just now, they should have cut the glass with a glass knife.
It was quite strange, the glass did not fall to the ground, and there was no movement, so they asked them to remove a corner.
Then he unplugged the latch and jumped in through the window. "
Su Anying was very puzzled, how did these people do it?
"They all have special skills, it's not easy." Xu Shiyan sighed.
"Ask someone tomorrow to see if it is still possible to install steel bars on the windows. This alone is not enough."
If there is no protective window in this year, then you can only try to install steel bars.
"Well, that's fine too. Do you need to reinforce the warehouse in the city?"
Su Anying was a little worried, if there was a problem with the warehouse, it would be a big loss.
"No, the warehouse should be fine, it's pretty solid."
To the south of the warehouse in Canshi is a wall, and inside the wall is a warehouse. The walls of the warehouse are all 50 thick.
General residences have thirty-seven walls, and warehouses use fifty-zero walls. The interior and exterior are plastered with cement and reinforced, so it should be fine.
There are no windows on the south side of the warehouse, the whole side is a wall, and the north side is a door.
The door has three layers inside and outside, with iron railings on the outside, an iron-clad door in the middle, and a wooden door inside.
The doors on the three floors are all locked with big locks. At night, the outermost iron railing is powered on. Anyone who leans forward should pass for a while.
The walls of the city are very high, and the walls are also blocked with barbed wire and glass shards.
Besides, Sanshi also hired two old men in their fifties to work shifts, and they changed shifts at night, wandering back and forth.
Generally speaking, unless there is an insider, it is impossible for someone to enter the warehouse.
Xu Shiyan said so, Su Anying naturally said nothing.
It's late at night, you can't just look at the window, you have to sleep when you should sleep.
But the glass of this window is broken, and the latch can be pulled out with one hand, which is not acceptable.
No choice, Xu Shiyan could only find nails and boards, nail the window sash and window frame from the outside, and then use the boards to nail the outside a few times.
In this way, once someone wants to break the window and come in, he has to lift the wooden boards and remove the nails on the window sash.
This is very strenuous, and it is impossible to have a little movement.
Huang Shengli and Sun Xiaofeng helped to nail up the window, and temporarily restored the garden stick to its original state before leaving.
The two went home and told their family members to be careful.
Although their family's club is not as good as Xu Shiyan's, it is worth a lot of money. If it is lost, why don't you feel so distressed?
Xu's side, close the door again and go back to the house to rest.
After such a toss, I no longer felt sleepy, and kept my eyes open until dawn.
In the morning, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping still went to Han's house to exercise. Xu Shiyan called Lin Qiyue's house and told him that he would go to work later.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan went to the border police station in the town to inquire about the situation.
"Hello Comrade Xu, well, last night we received a report from the Xishen villagers, saying that they had caught a suspect of burglary.
After interrogation, the specific situation has been learned. Four of them committed the crime, and the other three ran away.
We immediately sent people to the homes of the three people to arrest them, but the three people didn’t come home, so they probably ran away.
We will send an investigation report to other jurisdictions, and if there is any progress, we will notify Comrade Xu as soon as possible. "
The comrades at the police station were very polite and directly told Xu Shiyan about the situation.
Xu Shiyan could only sigh when he heard that the three had run away.
"Thank you, comrades, for causing you trouble."
The comrades at the other police station have tried their best, so he can't say anything, he can only express his thanks.
Xu Shiyan was the person involved in the incident, and he had to leave a record. After that, he had nothing to do with him, so he left.

chapters.title: Chapter 524: strict law and order
chapters.content:
Chapter 524 Strictly Control Law and Order
Xu Shiyan knew that his family was thinking about it, so he didn't go directly to the venue, but went home first.
As soon as he entered the house, he saw Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others were in his house.
Needless to say, this is all because I heard the news of Xu's burglar last night and came to listen to it.
Xu Shiyan told everyone what he learned at the police station.
"Li Jianyou, Wang Tiejun? Fuck, so it's these two fuckers."
When Zhao Jianshe heard Xu Shiyan mention the names of two of the three people who ran away, he suddenly cursed.
"Why, you know them?" Xu Shiyan was taken aback, why did he know someone who did this?
"Third brother, do you still remember that in the summer, someone dumped the ground for us, and then said that the two of us broke our legs and couldn't go to work?
At that time, my sister-in-law said, let me send their wages? It's just these two calves.
At that time, you also said, let me find someone to find out what these two calfs do, and how did they hurt their legs.
I really asked someone, but no one knew how they fell. "
Zhao Jianshe became more and more angry and panicked as he talked, and he also regretted it.
"It happened that we were all busy at that time, so I didn't ask anyone to inquire carefully.
Fuck, I didn't expect it to be these two bastards, they must have made us resign, and they still hate us, so they want to take revenge on us.
I guess I didn’t know where I heard about it. The third brother’s family had a good club this year, so they asked someone to steal it. "
Zhao Jianshe has a simple mind and can only think of this level.
"Oh, so it's the two of them, then I know."
As soon as Zhao Jianshe said, Xu Shiyan remembered it, and he had an impression of it.
The first day when they were digging sticks on the mountain, someone approached and was bitten by a dog. On the second day, Su Anying said that the people who worked in the field broke their legs.
Xu Shiyan was easy to go at that time, how could the two of them break their legs together? Let Zhao Jianshe inquire more.
Afterwards, because I was busy with participating in the market, I didn't get to the bottom of it. I didn't expect that this time, there were shadows of those two people in it.
It seems that they planned to steal wild ginseng last time, and this time the two of them brought someone to steal the mallet again.
Xu Shiyan immediately picked up the phone and called Guo Shouye.
"Brother Guo, you help me find out that both of them were former members of the food team of the Forestry Bureau.
Talk to those **** in Songjianghe again, and let me out.
The two of them should never go back to Songjianghe if they are capable. If they come back and let me know, I will break their legs. "
Mo Dan, you really think he's easy to bully, don't you? If you didn't steal it once, how about a second time?
What are you doing, are you competing with him? Okay, let's try it and see who is capable?
Guo Shouye had never seen Xu Shiyansheng so majestic, so he had to ask what was going on.
As a result, after hearing what Xu Shiyan said, Guo Shouye also became angry.
"Come on, brother, this matter depends on your brother.
As long as these two people dare to show their heads in the Songjiang River, there will be no good fruit for them. "
Guo Shouye has been in Songjianghe for so many years, what kind of people do not get in touch with?
Those people have no way to curry favor. As long as Guo Shouye speaks out, no matter how many people are crowded, he has to help him with the matter.
"Okay, brother, talk about how much it costs, you can't take this."
Looking for someone to help, and they are some gangsters, will definitely have to spend money. Xu Shiyan can't let Guo Shouye pay for this money.
"Oh, don't worry, your brother still needs money to do this?"
On the other end of the phone, Guo Shouye just laughed. In his eyes, this matter is nothing like fart.
After finishing speaking, Guo Shouye hung up the phone, and then went to the local snake in Songjianghe to inquire about the situation of the two people.
At the same time, let the words out and tell those **** on the ground in Songjianghe that whoever sees those two people will beat them to death.
Turn around and invite Guo Shouye to dinner, so I can find him in the future if I have something to do.
With Guo Shouye's words, those **** still don't stare? All stared at those two.
As long as there is any trouble, those two **** will not even try to run away.
After arranging this matter, Xu Shiyan went to the carpenter again and asked if it would be okay to install steel bars on the window frame now?
The carpenter was in a dilemma for a long time, and then he said that he could try to find a way.
So Xu Shiyan made an appointment with the carpenter, and when he got back the steel bars, he asked the carpenter to install steel bars on the back windows of his house.
Forget about the front window, it’s inconvenient, I’ll find a few more dogs when I’m free.
It’s not the same. The four dogs I raised before were all male dogs, and none of them were female.
The family didn’t have any puppies these years. It seems that they have to find a few more powerful ones for housekeeping.
After finishing these things, Xu Shiyan went back to work.
Regardless of Xu Shiyan's late arrival, the news of the burglar at home has already reached Lin Qiyue's ears.
Lin Qiyue met Xu Shiyan and patted him on the shoulder, "Well, you still have to pay attention to the safety of your home.
If I don’t think it works, forget about the entire safe in your home. It’s not available for other people’s homes, but I guess you can use it in your home. "
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, "What's the point? Return the safe? How can there be so many valuable things in my house?"
Although he said so on his lips, he remembered it in his heart.
Not to mention, I really need to get one at home. There are so many valuable things, I guess they may not be enough if they are too small.
The matter of burglars in the house can only be like this for the time being.
The one who was caught was bitten by a fox on the leg, and shot twice on the left buttock and right leg.
Fortunately, it was an air gun, and the lead bullet only broke through the skin and was embedded in the flesh, without hurting the bones or blood vessels.
Just find a doctor and take it out.
Someone was caught for burglary. There is nothing to argue about this. Just lock him in and squat down.
The remaining three people didn't know where they went, and they never showed up anyway.
Because of this incident, the town has put special emphasis on security issues, and the police station cooperates with the militia to patrol at night.
Especially around the city, it is designated as the focus of attention.
After the opening of the market in the morning, the police station and the militia are stationed. Anyone who dares to make trouble will be directly held down and arrested. There will be no mercy.
When the foreign merchants saw it, they felt even more confident.
People like them have been traveling all year round to do business, and what they worry about most is the issue of public security.
I have encountered it before. When I went to buy medicinal materials somewhere, the local hooligans bought and sold second-hand goods.
The merchant was not willing to argue with others, so he was beaten directly, and had no choice but to leave.
No matter how good the business is, they dare not do it.
Donggang Town has taken various measures to protect the safety of merchants and maintain the order of trading in the market.
In this way, both merchants and resident households can be effectively protected within the Donggang area. This trick has made many people feel at ease.
Chen Jianzhang listened to Zhou Qingguo's suggestion and applied to the county to open a savings bank near Donggang Can City.
After those ginseng farmers sell their clubs, if they feel that it is not safe to bring cash, they can deposit the money in a savings bank.
The gradual improvement of supporting facilities is extremely beneficial to the development of the city, and naturally attracts more merchants.
These merchants may not be the purchasers of some big pharmaceutical companies, nor are they big exporters.
They may just be some small bosses in the south, opening a small shop selling local products from all over the world.
But there are many people and power is great. When these people all come to Donggang to participate in the market, they must not be underestimated when they gather together.

chapters.title: Chapter 525: little larks concert
chapters.content:
Chapter 525 Little Braun Concert
On September 30th, Donggang Central Primary School held a concert of San Xiang Xiao Bai Ling.
All classes in the school must arrange programs to participate in, and there will be judges to score each program, and select the first prize of the grade and the excellent award of the whole school.
So from the beginning of the fall semester, the teachers of each class began to prepare with all their strength.
Every afternoon self-study class, all set aside time for rehearsal.
Xu Haiyuan in the fourth grade and Xu Jinping in the second grade are both the best students in the class. How could they be missing in this kind of occasion?
Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu, Jiang Chunhong, and Zhao Honghui were chosen by the head teacher, Teacher Yu, to lead the singing and recite poems.
Not to mention Xu Haiyuan, who was directly selected by the school to partner with a few students in the fifth grade as an announcer.
Anyone who participates in this kind of program, especially lead singers and hosts, has requirements. They must be good-looking and well-dressed.
The teacher of Class 1, Grade 2 decided that the children who sang in the back should wear white shirts, black pants and white shoes uniformly.
This set of clothes should be regarded as a unified feature of this year, but it is basically this one for any activities.
Of course, not everyone can get it together, and many children have to borrow it.
The teacher in Class 1, Year 2 is not very old, and has just started working for a few years.
It is the time to actively and actively work hard to evaluate excellent teachers, no matter what activities are full of enthusiasm.
The teacher felt that the four lead singers in front had to dress up to look better than others.
