It happened that one day the teacher saw Xu Jinping, wearing a red plaid suspender skirt, a white shirt, red leather shoes, and a plastic hairpin on her head.
The teacher looked very good-looking, and felt that wearing this dress to participate in the performance must be suitable.
But I called Xu Jinping over and asked carefully. Her aunt sent her back from the capital, and she didn't buy it locally.
The teacher felt embarrassed, the clothes were not easy to adjust, and he was afraid that Jiang Chunhong's family would not be able to get them.
There was no other way, so the teacher called the parents of the four lead singers over, and wanted to discuss with the parents what clothes the children would wear in the performance.
Su Anying naturally doesn't care, her children's clothes are contracted by her sister-in-law all year round.
Without waiting for the season, Xu Shiqin sent back big bags from the capital, everything.
Yang Haoyu's is also fine, the Yang family's conditions are good, and there is only such a child, so there is no shortage.
In addition, Xu Shiqin didn't treat Yang Haoyu as an outsider, and every time he picked clothes for Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping and the others, he would send them back to Yang Haoyu.
Not to mention anything else, Yang Haoyu has a set, a red plaid suit that matches Xu Jinping's skirt, and he looks handsome in it.
The two children are fine, and Jiang Chunhong's family is fine.
My parents both work in the grain depot, and they are not short of money. If it is not possible, I will go to a tailor shop to do it.
But that other little boy, whose family conditions are average, can't compare with these three.
White shirts, black pants, etc., I can still pick up my brother’s clothes. If I want to make other clothes, my family really doesn’t have the ability.
It was Su Anying who remembered that Xu Haiyuan wore a blue suit when he participated in Little Bailing's concert last year.
Xu Haiyuan goes to school early, his clothes from last year should be fine for that little boy.
So I told Teacher Yu that I could lend it to Zhao Honghui for use.
But Jiang Chunhong's is not good, because there is no suitable one at home.
After all, Xu Jinping is more than a year younger than Jiang Chunhong, and Jiang Chunhong is taller than Xu Jinping.
Fortunately, Jiang Chunhong's family was not short of money, so I told the teacher that they would make a set of blue suspender skirts.
So, on September 30th, the four lead singers in class one of the second year, two red and two blue, were all dressed up very energetically.
Xu Jinping has a good voice, she sings well, and she can recite poetry without any problems.
As for Xu Haiyuan, let alone, he was dressed in a small black suit, white shirt, and red tie.
The little boy was already fair and clean, so he looked even better with this dress.
The teachers and students below, as well as the spectators around, all looked at the good-looking little boys who announced the curtain, and some of them didn't know each other, so they had to inquire.
I heard that he was the eldest son of Xu Shiyan's family, the captain of the Young Pioneers of Donggang Central Primary School, and a student of the city's three good students.
It suddenly dawned on him that he was a child of the Xu family, no wonder he was so outstanding.
The performance ended, and Class One of the second year won the first place in the second grade without any accident, and also the first place in the whole school.
The children were very happy. Teacher Yu, the head teacher of Class 1, Grade 2, was very happy and bought candies for the children.
Then inform everyone that there will be a five-day holiday on October 1, together with Saturday and Sunday.
Students in this year still have busy farming leave, which will be on May 1st and 11th, and it will be gone in two years.
Because the children behaved well, there is no homework left during the holidays.
Now, the children were even happier. They rushed out of the classroom with a whimper, and ran home happily.
"Grandma, I'm back. We have a five-day holiday on November 1, and the teacher hasn't left homework yet."
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu ran into the yard holding hands, and told grandma the good news immediately.
No matter what age, no matter how much a child loves to learn, they all have a point of view on the fact that the teacher does not leave homework. I am so happy.
"Look at your little face, how happy you are without leaving homework?
That's just right, the weather seems to be changing tomorrow, you two hurry up and change your clothes, and help me pick all the vegetables and go home. "
Zhou Guilan glanced at the two children, one was wearing a red plaid skirt and the other was wearing a red plaid suit, and quickly asked them to change their clothes and come out to work.
Anyway, Yang Haoyu stays at Xu's house all day long, so he is no different from his own children. He works as he should, and never treats him as an outsider.
Yang Haoyu has clothes in Xu's house, and Zhou Guilan has washed them and put them away.
So the two hurried back to the house, changed into a set of old clothes, and then came out to help Zhou Guilan pick vegetables.
The weather this autumn is good. It hasn’t rained before, and the sun is also good. There is no need to put the goods in the house to dry.
But last night the weather forecast said that there would be rain today, and it was cloudy in the morning.
Zhou Guilan was worried that it would rain at night, and then frost would immediately cool down on a sunny day, so she quickly packed up all the vegetables in the vegetable garden.
Xu Chenghou took great care of the vegetable garden of Xu's family, and the vegetables grew well.
There are still a lot of beans on the bean shelf, late cucumbers are growing just right, and there are many large and small eggplants in the eggplant field, not to mention slices of red peppers.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu are young after all, and the bean stand is too high to reach, so they carry the soil basket and pick peppers, eggplants, tomatoes and so on.
No matter how big or small they are, they are all picked off, even the tender leaves of peppers are picked off.
Blanch the tender peppers, pepper leaves, and tender beans in boiling water.
Add scallions and garlic slices, then add salt and monosodium glutamate, marinate, and you can eat it in a few days.
Small pickles for dinner, it’s delicious.
Not to mention the red peppers, which are picked off and threaded on, hung under the eaves to dry, and can be used for cooking or making spicy cabbage.
Zhou Guilan also learned a way to make hot sauce from others. It happens that there are a lot of peppers planted this year, and there are many red peppers.
She also plans to make some chili sauce and put it away, and save it to eat slowly.
Due to special reasons this month, all the posts and comments in this chapter and the book friend circle have been blocked, and it is estimated that they will be released in a few days.
For the same reason, the event rewards for the title of fans in our book circle cannot be distributed for the time being, and will be distributed after recovery. The title of fans is "Shenwa".
Finally, it’s the end of the month, so let’s roll around to show off our cuteness and ask for a monthly pass. mwah.

chapters.title: Chapter 526: harvest autumn vegetables
chapters.content:
Chapter 526 Harvesting autumn vegetables
Xu Haiyuan came in later than his younger brothers and sisters, because they didn't get the first place in the class, and the teacher normally left homework for the students.
Fourth grade is naturally different from second grade. During the five-day holiday, the teacher left a lot of homework for the children.
"What is this for? Picking vegetables?"
As soon as Xu Haiyuan entered the door, he saw his grandmother leading his younger siblings to work in the vegetable garden, so he hurriedly asked.
"My grandma said that the weather may change and the temperature will drop. We should pick these vegetables and take them home and store them. Don't get frosty and freeze them so they can't be eaten."
Xu Jinping replied while picking peppers.
"Oh, then I'll help too, wait a minute, I'll change my clothes."
When Xu Haiyuan heard this, he stopped going to study with his master, went to change his clothes first, and hurriedly helped pick vegetables.
Zhou Guilan led the children to pick beans, cucumbers and peppers in the front yard, and Xu Chenghou planed celery root and ghost **** in the back garden.
The ghost **** is also called the frost flower. It is said that the ghost **** blooms for eighteen days and then frost falls.
The underground tubers of ghost ginger, pickled pickles are delicious, especially crispy.
The farmyard is like this every autumn, and all kinds of edible things are taken home.
Marinate everything that should be pickled, and save it for winter and spring to eat slowly.
The concert ended at ten o'clock in the morning, and the children were busy in the vegetable garden for an hour.
Zhou Guilan saw that it was not early, so she hurried back to the house to cook, while Xu Haiyuan and the others continued to work.
When Zhou Guilan cooked the meal and called the children to eat, all the eggplants, peppers, tomatoes, etc. in the vegetable garden were picked.
Basket after basket was sent to the warehouse for storage, and slowly tidied up, salted what should be pickled, dried what should be dried, and kept the rest for a few days to eat.
After lunch, Xu Haiyuan and the others went back to work at home.
Xu Shiyan's house has a big place, and there are more vegetables in the vegetable garden.
In addition to vegetables, there are also Xu Jinping's favorite mushrooms, grapes, sand fruits, etc. It is best not to let Shuang beat them.
Mushroom girl can't eat after being beaten by frost. Grapes are better, but after being beaten by frost, the taste is not right.
Xu Shiyan's family grows several kinds of sand fruits, including crabapple fruit that can be eaten in summer, and abacus beads and small apples that are only delicious in autumn.
These have to be picked off, otherwise they will not taste good if they are frozen.
There are so many things, enough for the children to be busy for a while.
In the afternoon, the sky became more cloudy. Before we packed up our things and went home, it started to rain a little.
"Hey, let's hurry up, it's time to play big later."
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan both speeded up, and the children hurried back to carry the vegetables.
They were cleaning up here. After a while, it rained heavily, and everyone had to run back to the house.
"Well, if it rains today, if it is sunny tomorrow, there will be frost in the morning of the day after tomorrow.
You are on vacation for five days, just in time for the weather, so you can't do anything. "
Zhou Guilan entered the room, patted his clothes a few times, and said.
"Grandma, we don't do anything, just accompany grandma to clean up vegetables and pickles at home."
Xu Jinping's clever mouth can make anyone confused.
"Okay, okay, then let's put the pickles at home tomorrow." Zhou Guilan smiled happily.
After working for a long time, I finally picked up everything that should be picked.
It was raining outside, and I couldn't do anything else. I just picked the red pepper, threaded a part of it with a thread, and kept it to dry.
Xu Jinping also found a needle and thread, and threaded Gu Niang'er into a few strings.
Of course, it’s the skin of Gu Niang’s outer skin. Wearing it like this and hanging it up, the skin won’t rot, and you can still eat it for a while.
In the evening, Zhou Guilan stewed potatoes with eggplants.
The young eggplants are not big, they are bigger than eggs, they are just split in two, and stewed with meat, the taste is very good.
The children have been busy for a long time, and they didn't eat less of this meal at night, so they felt that the stewed tender eggplant was delicious.
The rain didn't last long, and it stopped in the evening, and the temperature outside suddenly dropped, and it was cold.
When Yang Junxian came to pick up Yang Haoyu in the evening, Zhou Guilan was afraid that the child would be cold, so she specially found a thick coat for the child to wrap around it.
"If you two are too busy to take care of the child, it's the same to let him live here."
Zhou Guilan now feels pain as if she regards Yang Haoyu as her own grandson.
Yang Jun is now the secretary of Dongshen Village. He is busy in autumn. The village has to collect tasks and calculate various expenses.
Besides, his family also grows mallets, and they want to grow ginseng and make goods. This autumn, the couple has been extremely busy, and the couple really can't take care of their children.
Yang Junxian's father was ill the year before last, and his third sister took him to the city to raise him and was not at home.
Some time ago, Yang Junxian's mother also went to the city, and now no one cares about Yang Haoyu.
So Yang Haoyu didn't go to class in the afternoon and didn't go home, so he stayed at Xu's house.
"Thank you ma'am, oh, this autumn is really busy.
If there is no aunt to help take care of our Xiaoyu, this child will not know what he will be like in the fall. "
Yang Junxian had to express his gratitude to Zhou Guilan.
"Ever since I started school, I almost grew up with my aunt. Oh, I don't know how to thank my aunt and uncle."
"Look at you, you only talk about heretics, isn't Xiaoyu the son of Shi Yan and his wife?
This is just like your own children. " Zhou Guilan laughed.
Yang Junxian wrapped his son in a thick coat, carried him onto the bicycle, and then rode the bicycle to take his son home.
Zhou Guilan watched Yang Junxian and his son leave, turned around and entered the room, and began to mutter.
"Oh, all of them don't care about anything when they get busy.
Our family is the same, and they haven’t come back yet. "
Xu Shiyan was still busy processing goods at the venue, while Su Anying led people to pick grades and pack them.
At the beginning, I received orders for 2,500 catties, and in the past two days, two more customers called to place orders.
So in the past few days, Su Anying took Huang Shengli and their daughter-in-law together to go to the market to grab goods, and when they came back, they picked grades and packed boxes. They were busy every day until late.
"How can it be hard to make money? Be busy. If you are busy, you have money to earn."
We can't do anything, just serve the children. "Xu Chenghou is quite open-minded.
The son and daughter-in-law are now spreading such a big stall, and they can't do anything else. It's better than anything else to take good care of the children.
"Yeah, let's not think about anything, just take care of the children.
That day, the third child asked me if I would like to open a store or something for the remaining two houses in the north.
I told him, forget it, I’m too busy.
We have something to eat and drink now, so what are we doing with that? "
Zhou Guilan nodded. When you get old, don't think about being competitive. You should take good care of your grandchildren.
"Yes, you are right to think so, we are all at this age, why are you still making such a fuss?
It's not bad to take care of a few children and grow them up.
My son and daughter-in-law are all busy outside, so let’s take care of the house and cook and take care of the house, so that they can have a warm meal when they come home, which is good. "
Xu Chenghou has no other thoughts now, as long as his son and grandson are good, he is better than anything else.
While the old couple were talking, Zhou Guilan put the food in the pot, then scooped out hot water, and called the children to wash their feet.
It was less than eight o'clock, and the children were sleepy, so they coaxed them to go to bed.
It was past nine o'clock when Xu Shiyan and Su Anying entered the house. Neither of them had dinner, and they were so hungry that they ate and rested.

chapters.title: Chapter 527: pickles
chapters.content:
Chapter 527 Pickles
It rained for a few hours, and it became sunny in the middle of the night.
Donggang is close to Changbai Mountain, and the temperature affected by it is already lower than other places, and this drop in temperature is even more obvious.
Woke up in the morning and opened the door to see that there was a layer of hoarfrost on the grass and leaves outside, and it was frost in the middle of the night.
It's chilly outside, and when you take a breath, you can see white mist.
"Thanks for grabbing all the food back yesterday, if we didn't grab it back, it would have been frozen all night and couldn't be eaten."
When Zhou Guilan was cooking in the morning, she looked at the frost outside and muttered.
"It's thanks to my parents who were there and helped us.
Otherwise, Shiyan and I are so busy, it will be too late when we come back. "
Su Anying also got up, and said while lighting the fire.
"What are you talking about? You two have business to do, and you didn't go out to eat, drink and have fun.
I'm idle at home with your father, why don't we do something? "Zhou Guilan laughed when she heard that.
"Well, I discussed with your father, let's not open any small shops in the two houses in Beitou, because they are too busy.
If someone rents it out, you will rent it out directly.
Don’t care how much you charge a month, even if it’s ten yuan or eight yuan, someone will light a fire for us in winter, just don’t freeze the house. "
Su Anying hesitated.
Originally, she and Xu Shiyan were thinking about setting up a small shop, and they didn't ask for much money, because the old couple had a job to earn money.
However, the family is really busy.
It became obvious this autumn, and when it came to the month of ginseng and goods, it was simply a busy family.
"Okay, then I'll tell Shi Yan, and if someone wants to rent it, they can rent it out, and forget it if no one rents it.
We live comfortably in our own private courtyard, but it would be inconvenient if all outsiders come here. "
Su Anying nodded, her parents-in-law said they didn't want to do it, so she couldn't force her to do it, as if she disliked her parents-in-law for not making money.
As far as the current situation of their family is concerned, the in-laws don’t have to do anything, and it’s good to have food and drink.
The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law were cooking while chatting. When the meal was ready, Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, and Yang Haoyu came back together.
So the two young ones were woken up, and the family had breakfast.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan went to work, Su Anying went to visit the market, and the children accompanied Zhou Guilan to start packing the various dishes brought back yesterday.
Cut the cucumber in half, put it in a basin, sprinkle with salt, and press it with a clean slate.
After pressing for two days, the water in it comes out, wash it with clean water, dry it and put it in an altar.
Pour the cold sauce boiled with various seasonings and soy sauce, seal it and put it in a cool place.
Take out some when eating, cucumber pickles, the taste is super good.
Wash and chop the red pepper, cut the lean meat into minced meat, and stir-fry it with homemade miso.
Put sugar, crushed peanuts, sesame seeds, etc., and seal them in a jar.
When you want to eat, scoop out a bowl, whether it is a meal or mixed with noodles, it is delicious.
Wash the ghost **** and control the moisture, and throw it into the pickle jar together with mustard greens to marinate.
In the pickle jar, a piece of schisandra vine is specially placed. The pickled vegetables have the special taste of schisandra vine, and they are also very delicious.
What other garlic eggplant, celery root, coriander root, spicy cabbage.
Anyway, during the holiday two days before the National Day, Xu Jinping did nothing else but pickled vegetables with her grandma.
The little girl is not too annoying, and she is very patient. She follows her grandma to do this and that, and she does a decent job.
Zhou Guilan was so rare, she kept calling for something delicious to reward her granddaughter.
"Yingzi, don't be too busy tonight, come back early.
Look at the eleventh day, I said, let’s make dumplings, you are all busy and don’t have time.
The child finally has a holiday, so we can make dumplings anyway. "Woke up in the morning on the 3rd, Zhou Guilan told her daughter-in-law.
"I'm too busy to take care of the August Festival. I don't have time for this eleventh?"
"Mom, I can't, I have to go up the mountain today.
Our ginseng field has to be tidied up at the end, and it’s time to plant the seeds and sticks in two days.
I don’t know what the soil that hired people to dump is like, I have to go and see. "
Su Anying smiled wryly. She also wanted to make a good meal at home, but this season is too busy, so she really doesn't have time.
When Zhou Guilan heard this, she could only wave her hands, "Well, I don't need you, I will take care of it with your father, and you can come back early for dinner at night."
The ground is busy, so what can I do?
Waiting for Xu Shiyan to go out, Zhou Guilan also told her son to come back early in the evening and make dumplings tonight.
Xu Shiyan fully agreed, saying that he would come back as early as possible at night.
In the afternoon, Zhou Guilan chopped stuffing and noodles early, and Xu Chenghou and Xu Chenghou started making dumplings.
Xu Jinping saw that her grandparents were making dumplings too slowly, so she also came over to help.
Not to mention, the little girl is very dexterous, Zhou Guilan taught a few, and then she made her own bag, and she was pretty decent after a while.
Yang Haoyu doesn't know how to make dumplings, but he learned how to roll cakes, and he looks decent. The dumpling skins are quite round, and the thickness is just right.
Xu Haiyuan saw that there was nothing wrong with Chu Xuanhuai, so he also came over to help press the dumplings, serving as dumpling legs and so on.
Although Xu Haiyuan is very smart in other aspects, but in this one, he can't compare with his sister or Yang Haoyu.
He rolled out the dumpling wrapper, and it stuck to the panel easily, or there was a gap, or one side was thin and the other was thick.
He tried to make a few dumplings with his hands, and the dumplings were made by him, they were strangely shaped.
"Okay, Yuanyuan, don't make dumplings, oh my god, if you make these dumplings, they will turn into slices of soup."
Seeing this, Zhou Guilan quickly pushed her grandson aside.
Even if the Xu family is not short of money, they can't let their children harm the dumplings.
Xu Haiyuan frowned deeply as he looked at the dumplings he made, and then at the dumplings made by his sister.
"What's going on here? Obviously I think Pingping's bag is very simple, why is it so difficult for me once I get started?"
Xu Haiyuan, who has always been good at everything, doubted himself for the first time. Is he so stupid?
"Brother, this makes people have their own strengths, and you are not omnipotent."
Xu Jinping showed the delicate dumplings in her heart to her brother, with a proud face.
My brother knows everything all day long, but now he finally found someone he can't.
"Well, it seems that girls are really talented in cooking."
Is Xu Haiyuan someone who can be easily hit? Immediately found a fair reason for himself.
"Cut, don't say it so nicely, you are not as good as Xiaoyu, and Xiaoyu is also better at rolling dumpling wrappers than you."
Xu Jinping finally had the opportunity to hit her brother, how could she let her go so easily?
The siblings bickered, making both Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan laugh out loud.
The two children, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui, didn’t quite understand why their grandparents were laughing, but they laughed too.
The whole room was full of laughter, lively and festive.
At five o'clock, the dumplings were almost finished. Xu Chenghou went to boil water, and Zhou Guilan led the children to finish.
In a short while, all the dumplings are finished, and the water is boiling, so cook the dumplings quickly.
As a result, the dumplings were cooked and fished out. After waiting, the dumplings were almost cold, and Su Anying came back.
As for Xu Shiyan, there is not even a shadow.
"Don't wait, let's eat first, the children are hungry." Xu Chenghou waved his hand to signal everyone to eat dumplings.

chapters.title: Chapter 528: want to go up the mountain again
chapters.content:
Chapter 528 I want to go up the mountain again
Everyone had eaten half of the dumplings, so Xu Shiyan came home.
"Oh, the machine in the venue broke down this afternoon. It took a lot of effort to fix it."
Xu Shiyan entered the door and quickly explained.
Xu Shiyan is busy with work, nothing else, no one can say anything.
Zhou Guilan saw that the dumplings were cold, so she asked Su Anying to bring two plates to the pot to heat them up.
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, "No, no, no, I'm going to starve to death this day, it's good to have something to eat."
Hungry Gulu screaming, no matter what is hot or cold, as long as you have a stutter.
Xu Shiyan went to wash his hands, came back and sat down, didn't care about that, grabbed the dumplings and started eating.
"Well, the dumplings are delicious, mustard greens, right? It's really delicious to make dumplings with this thing."
"Well, yesterday the children and I pulled out the mustard greens, pickled half of the pot of mustard pimples, and pickled some tassels.
There is still a lot left, tie it up to dry some dried vegetables, and keep the Kaichunyu small tofu, which is tender enough to make dumplings. "
Zhou Guilan brought a plate of dumplings in front of her that she didn't eat much to her son.
Xu's family grows mustard greens with crushed leaves. Mustard lumps are pickled, and mustard stalks can also be pickled and eaten.
Pickled mustard stalks can be stewed with potatoes and tofu, both of which are very good.
If you don’t pickle the vegetables, tie the mustard stalks with a rope, hang them on the wall or in the warehouse, and keep them in the spring after drying in the shade. Small tofu is also very good.
Of course, the most delicious is the dumplings made with mustard tassels.
Blanch the mustard stalks in boiling water, chop them up, mix them with meat stuffing, and the dumplings are the most tender.
Xu Shiyan was indeed hungry. After eating two plates of dumplings, it seemed that he was still not full.
He didn't dare to eat any more. He ate too late in the evening, and if he continued to eat, he would easily accumulate food.
"The dumplings served tonight are really good and delicious." Xu Shiyan said very satisfied.
Since I started ginseng, my family is too busy to take care of anything, so I really haven’t cooked anything delicious.
"Daughter-in-law, how is the ginseng soil on the mountain? Can you plant seeds and sticks recently?"
After eating, I finally spared time to ask what's going on on the mountain.
"The ginseng soil is almost done, and the soil clods, grass roots and so on have been re-excavated.
Shen Zaizi will be able to get up in two days. Let's see if you have time someday, can you ask for a vacation or something.
Let's go up the mountain and bring back the ten feet long ginseng seeds. "
When the fields were distributed to households, every household did not have many ginseng seeds and ginseng seeds.
Xu Shiyan scoured the ginseng seeds from the ginseng field that year, and saved the ginseng seeds in the second year and scattered them in the ginseng field on the side of the Kaifeng fork.
Ginseng seeds are sown in the ground for two years, they are called five leaves, and they can also grow ginseng, and the growth of five leaves is better than Erjiazi.
But Wuye is a little bad, it can't get a good figure.
Last year, 20,000 feet of seeds were planted on Liumao River, and those ginseng seeds that Xu Shiyan planned to keep for three years.
So this year, we will not sow seeds for this hundred feet, and keep all the planting sticks.
First, I picked up my own ten-foot ginseng seeds, picked them and planted them, and then had to find another place to buy the rest.
"Then the day after tomorrow. It's Sunday the day after tomorrow. It's okay for me to ask for a day off."
Xu Shiyan made a calculation, the processing factory is not as busy as it was a few days ago, and it should be fine for him to ask for a day off on Sunday.
"Dad, we didn't have class the day after tomorrow. Let's go together and help pick ginseng seeds."
Xu Haiyuan immediately said that they could go up the mountain to help.
It happened that he had already finished his homework, Xu Jinping was even better, he didn't even have homework, what else could he do if he didn't go to the mountains to work?
Xu Shiyan can think about it, children should exercise from an early age to let them know how difficult life is.
The conditions of the family are good, which is earned by their parents, not their laziness.
Children, they should know that the world is difficult, otherwise, it is easy to raise some bastards.
The two elders in the family are quite sensible and good at studying.
No matter how good you study, you can't ignore moral education. You must let them know that parents are not easy.
"Okay, then you will go up the mountain together the day after tomorrow." Xu Shiyan nodded, agreeing.
"Godfather, I'll go too." Upon hearing this, Yang Haoyu immediately said that he was also going to work in the mountains.
"Xiaoyu, if you don't do your own work, you come to work for my family, are you not afraid of your father scolding you?"
Xu Shiyan looked at his godson and deliberately teased him.
"Don't be afraid, I live and eat at my godfather's house, what's wrong with doing some work?"
In the past few days, Yang Haoyu simply stayed at Xu's house and didn't go home.
What is he doing at home? Parents are not at home during the day and come back at night.
He went back, and he had to run back early in the morning, so he might as well live at his godfather's house, play and study with his brothers and sisters.
"Listen, how can this kid talk? Then let's go together.
Anyway, I don’t expect you to do much work, let’s go and play, there are walnuts, hazelnuts and so on around the field.
You can work as long as you like, or pick walnuts and mushrooms if you don’t.
There seems to be a lot of hazel mushrooms on the other end. I saw people picking up a basket of mushrooms during lunch break today.
Pick up some mushrooms and come back to dry in the sun. Stewed chicken in winter is also very good. "
Su Anying smiled and touched the top of Yang Haoyu's head. This child is sensible and obedient, and he is very rare.
"Actually, there should be a lot of hazel mushrooms around our new site.
I see that there are a lot of hazel trees over there, and there are a lot of Gastrodia elata in summer. "
Hazel mushroom is actually the fruiting body of Armillaria armillaria. It usually grows in broad-leaved forests, especially hazel forests, which is what Xu Shiyan said.
When they heard that there were hazel mushrooms and walnuts on the mountain, both Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping's eyes widened.
"Dad, if you didn't say it earlier, you would have known that we would go up the mountain with my mother today.
It's a five-day holiday, it's too boring to be at home all day.
Mom, are you going to work in the mountains tomorrow? Let us go with you too. "They want to go up the mountain to pick up walnuts and mushrooms.
Su Anying pondered for a while, there was nothing wrong with the new ginseng land, and the ginseng soil left by her was almost cleaned up.
Those who were sold also handed in the work and collected the final payment, and this crop of ginseng soil made a lot of money.
Waiting for a while to finish all the busy work, it’s just time to settle the accounts, and just calculate this year’s dividends to everyone.
On the other side of Kaifeng Fork Road and Liumao River, Shendi should withdraw its shed.
"It's time for Shendi to move out of the shed, and your heads are not good enough, you can't do it."
Now the ginseng ground is covered with plastic sheeting. If the plastic sheeting is still on it in winter, the snow will not fall, and the sticks will be damaged by freezing.
Another, the plastic sheeting will age quickly in winter, so the plastic sheeting should be removed in winter.
Some took them home, and some directly dug a hole in the ground and buried them, and then pulled them out in spring and put them on thatch.
Let’s remove the plastic sheeting, it’s not too tiring, just untie the wire on the bead and peel off the plastic sheeting.
But the kids aren't tall enough for the job.
"Mom, take us up the mountain, let's go pick mushrooms."
Xu Jinping still didn't give up, she didn't have homework for the five-day holiday, and the little land at home was collected.
It’s too boring for them to be idle like this, why not go up the mountain to pick up some mushrooms or something, it’s quite fun.

chapters.title: Chapter 529: Take off your pants to catch fish
chapters.content:
Chapter 529 Take off your pants and catch fish
Su Anying never screwed up the children, and finally agreed to take the children up the mountain.
So the next day, the three children followed Su Anying to visit the land. How could Xu Chenghou feel relieved? Follow along too.
Xu Haiyuan is bigger, barely tall enough to help untie the wire.
Untie the wire, remove the bead and throw it on the surface of the pool or in the driveway.
Then Xu Chenghou and Su Anying rolled up the plastic sheeting tightly, and when they reached the ground, Su Anying carried the plastic sheeting into the car.
It is best to take this home and put it in the warehouse, and then transport it up in the spring of the next year.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu are small, so they can't really do much.
Su Anying found a forest for the two children that was close to where she worked, and there were no ground guns nearby.
Let the two children pick mushrooms, walnuts and so on over there.
It happened that the two children saw a jujube tree. Although Xu Jinping was a little girl, she was very skinny, so she climbed up the tree to reach the jujube vine, and then went down to pick the jujube.
The jujubes that have been beaten by frost are soft, and the outer skin is a little wilted, but they taste extremely sweet.
"Xiaoyu, continue." Xu Jinping rode on a tree branch, picked jujubes and threw them to Yang Haoyu.
"Second sister, be careful." Yang Haoyu was under the tree, looking up at Xu Jinping with a worried expression.
"It's okay. I'll throw it down, you caught it, let's pick some more, and go back to feed Haiqing and Huihui."
Xu Jinping didn't care. Seeing a string of branches in front of him had a lot of jujubes, she hurriedly pulled the branches over, picked all the fruits and threw them to Yang Haoyu who was underneath.
Not to mention, the two cooperated very well, throwing one and picking it up, picking a small half basket of jujubes in a short time.
"Okay, that's all. If you eat too much of this thing, it won't work. If you make trouble, you will have diarrhea."
Xu Jinping took a look around and found that she had almost picked all the soft dates, so she quickly slipped out of the tree.
In fact, the tree is not very tall, and the tree that can be climbed by the soft jujube vine is not too tall.
However, Yang Haoyu below still looked nervous, and hurried over to support Xu Jinping, for fear that she would fall.
The two picked a jujube tree, but it was gone.
The two of them didn't dare to go deep into the woods, so they looked around for things.
Walnuts, scallion seeds, hazel mushrooms, etc., pick whatever you see.
The walnuts went back and burned and picked the walnut kernels, which were delicious. Needless to say, the mushrooms were dried and eaten fresh.
The scallion is also useful. It can be fed to pigs. If it is soaked in water, ground and washed to get the powder, it can also be made into scallion jelly, which is also quite delicious.
Anyway, in this season, there are plenty of good things in the mountains, and it’s rare to come here, so can’t you just paddle?
Said that it was not far away, but the two of them bowed their heads to pick up mushrooms and walnuts, and one of them was not paying attention, so they walked for a while.
Wandering around, I don't know why, so I wandered near a small river ditch.
There is water in this small ditch in summer, but it is now the dry season.
The water in the ditch is extremely shallow, and there is only a thin layer of water in the slightly deeper puddles.
The two children passed by the small river ditch, Yang Haoyu had sharp eyes, and found that there seemed to be something moving in the puddle, so he leaned over and turned over a stone.
"Second sister, come quickly, there are fish here, and there are a lot of muddy hooks."
Under the rock, there is a pile of black loaches. In the local dialect, they are called mud hooks.
Xu Jinping hurried over when she heard that, and looked at the puddle, didn't she? When a large lump of mud hit the hook, it squeezed around in the small puddle.
"Then what are you waiting for? Grab it."
There is no child who does not like to catch fish and shrimps. Usually, their parents don’t let them go down the river to go to the big paozi, so there is no chance.
I met you today, and it’s such a convenient place, so what’s the point? Grab it.
"But, Second Sister, we have nothing to pretend."
Yang Haoyu pointed to their wicker baskets. One contained walnut seeds and the other contained mushrooms.
The jujubes are covered under the basket with big leaves.
Xu Jinping saw that there was really no place to install it, so what should I do?
"Pants, you take off your pants and put them on." She pointed to Yang Haoyu's pants and said.
The weather is cold at this time. Usually, people wear underpants inside and a pair of pants on the outside.
Because Yang Haoyu was in poor health since he was a child, Zhou Guilan was not at ease, so she specially put on a pair of Xu Haiyuan's old trousers for him.
This is just right, take off the outer pants, pull the bark from the wicker, and tie the two trouser legs tightly.
Then pick up the fish from the puddle and put it directly into your pants.
This small river ditch is not short, and the two children turned over stones one by one.
This side is far away from my house, and no one comes here. There are a lot of fish in the ditch, and there are fish under almost every stone.
Three or five items are missing, and there are a lot of them.
The two children didn't care about that, they just kept stuffing their pants until they were almost full.
"Second Sister, enough is enough, no matter how much it can hold, we can't carry it."
Yang Haoyu saw that his sister was still being arrested, so he hurriedly shouted.
"Okay, that's it." Xu Jinping sized up Yang Haoyu and looked at his pants.
Forget it, take off another one, what if he freezes it? These are enough for the two of them to take back, so be it.
So, the two of them stopped, and Xu Jinping went to get some willow bark, and **** the waist of her trousers tightly.
Then the two of them carried the trousers full of fish and the basket, and walked back with great effort.
Just halfway there, I saw Su Anying greeted her eagerly.
Three skewers were withdrawn over there, and she sat down to rest. Su Anying called her daughter and godson twice, but she didn't hear a response, so she was so frightened that she hurried into the woods to look for it.
"What did you two do? Didn't I tell you, don't forget to go far away?
What if there is some beast in the woods that hurts you both? "Su Anying said anxiously and angrily.
"Mom, look, we caught a lot of fish.
There is nothing to put it in, and I used Xiaoyu's pants, which are full of fish. "
Xu Jinping looked excited, and quickly showed her mother that they caught fish.
"There is a small river ditch over there. There is no water in the ditch, and it is full of fish."
The little girl is so beautiful in her heart, why don't she just learn how they catch fish.
Su Anying looked at the two children who were full of joy, and looked at the pants that were clean at first, but now they were full of mud and water, full of fish, and suddenly became angry from the bottom of her heart.
She took three deep breaths and tried to tell herself that the children were still young and not sensible.
This one is a biological daughter and the other is a godson. They cannot be beaten or beaten.
"Okay, you two are really good, use pants to hold fish.
Xu Jinping, did you wash the pants tonight, did you hear that? " Su Anying gritted her teeth and said.
No matter how stupid a child is, they can tell that the taste of these words is not right. Xu Jinping looked at her mother, and suddenly felt that her mother's face was ugly, and the expression was even weirder.
"Oh, got it, Mom."
The little girl knew something bad happened, and her mother was angry, but she didn't know why her mother was angry, so she could only obediently nodded and agreed first.
Su Anying stared at her daughter fiercely, and reached out to take the two baskets.
"Xiaoyu, you just listen to what your sister says? She told you to take off your pants and pretend to be a fish, so you just give it to me? You are not afraid of freezing."

chapters.title: Chapter 530: Damn it
chapters.content:
Chapter 530 Mom Sees Hit
"It's okay, godmother, I'm wearing three pairs of pants.
When I left in the morning, my grandma specially put on an extra pair for me. "
Yang Haoyu didn't notice it, and laughed happily.
Su Anying glanced at the bewildered godson who didn't understand anything, and sighed helplessly.
"You, silly boy."
This kid listens to that girl for everything. If the girl sells him one day, he probably will help count the money.
"Let's go, go back quickly, your grandfather and your brother are in a hurry, don't let you go far, you have to run around."
What can Su Anying say? Hurry up and take the child back.
Just like that, the three mothers returned to the venue with their baskets and trousers in their hands.
As soon as Xu Chenghou saw the two little boys coming back carrying a pair of fish trousers, he couldn't stretch himself anymore, and couldn't help laughing.
"Grandpa, what are you laughing at? Greedy fish?"
The three children were all dumbfounded, what's wrong with grandpa, what's so funny?
"I remembered how many times your father and brothers were young.
Once, your second uncle, your father, and your fourth uncle went to Daying Donggou to beat pine nuts or pick up scallion seeds?
When there were fish in a small ditch, your dad and second uncle tricked your fourth uncle by asking him to take off his pants and pretend to be fish. "
Xu Cheng smiled and told the children about the past.
"The three of them caught more fish than the two of you, and the fish in the trousers went back and poured out half a large basin.
Then, your grandma gave the three of them a good meal, because they bury their pants. "
The trousers were filled with fish, and they were fishy, ​​so they were hard to wash.
At that time, life was bad, who would be willing to use soap?
It was plant ashes that were scalded with boiling water and soaked overnight. The next day, the clear water was cleared to soak the clothes, and then they were taken to the river to beat hard with a mallet.
There are a bunch of brats in the family, and the clothes are not made properly all day long.
Zhou Guilan was exhausted from washing clothes. How could she not be angry when she saw children ruining their trousers and putting fish in them?
Not to mention, the grass, wood and gray water are especially good for clothes, and the cotton cloth will be ruined after running in it for a long time.
The more you wash the clothes, the more likely they are torn. Who has the money to make clothes for their children? Any mother would go crazy seeing that.
Xu Jinping now finally understood why her mother had a hideous face just now.
"Mom, did you want to beat me up just now?"
That’s the thing about co-authoring, let’s just say, my mother’s expression and tone just now were wrong.
"You still know, I should have slapped you hard just now.
Thanks to the fact that our family now has a washing machine, so you don’t need to wash it by hand.
That doesn’t work either, the washing machine still has to pay for electricity, water, and laundry detergent. You’re quick to ruin your clothes. "
Su Anying rolled her daughter's eyes. This brat is no worse than a kid.
"Okay, okay, what do you care about with a child? They are so big, and what they love most is catching fish and shrimp.
That is to say, I am busy now, and I don’t have the same conditions as before.
Didn’t Shi Yan go to catch fish every day when he was on the edge of the river?
Not to mention being by the river, when he was in Daying before, he would catch fish Liangzi under the Tanghe River, and he could catch hundreds of catties of fish in one night.
At that time, our family lacked other things, but we ate a lot of fish. "Xu Chenghou is getting older, and he starts to miss the past.
"Grandpa, grandpa, can you tell us about my dad's childhood?"
The children listened intently and looked curious.
They were all born in Donggang and grew up in Donggang. Although there is a river in the south of Donggang, it is far away and not so convenient.
The children all longed for the day when they lived by the water and caught fish and shrimp all day long.
"I'll tell you when I get back, let's do the work first."
Xu Chenghou just finished smoking the bag of cigarettes, got up and went to remove the plastic sheeting with Su Anying and the others.
In this piece of ginseng land, Xu's family also planted a hundred feet of clubs, and the remaining ginseng seeds are a partnership of the big guys.
The ginseng seeds of the partnership all hire Zhao Jianguo and others to work and take care of them.
It was not easy to remove the 100-foot plastic sheeting, and most of it was removed in one morning.
At noon, I had a meal in the Kansan Xiaofang, and continued to work in the afternoon. By three o'clock, the plastic sheeting was removed.
Su Anying and Xu Chenghou loaded the plastic sheet into the car, and then took the plastic sheet and the children home together.
As soon as she got home, Xu Jinping called on her grandma to quickly find her a big basin, and dumped all the fish in her pants into the basin.
The loach is the most survivable, and it will be fine if it is out of the water for a while. When it is poured into a large basin, it will not slip out.
Zhou Guilan hurriedly scooped up some water and poured it in. The fish had to spit out mud and sand before they could be stewed.
"Don't mention it, the fish you caught are not small, they are quite fat.
Waiting for two days to spit out the silt, I will stew tofu with loach for you to eat, or you can stew it with sauce, it is delicious. "
Zhou Guilan is getting older now, and she doesn't have the temper she had when she was young.
Besides, this was brought back by the grandson and granddaughter, can it be the same as the son?
The old lady is not only not angry, but also quite happy. His grandchildren have grown up and can catch fish.
When Xu Shiyan came back at night, it was quite strange to see those fish in the basin.
After asking, I found out that the co-author was put back in Yang Haoyu's pants by his daughter, but Xu Shiyan couldn't be more happy.
"Hey, my big girl, why are you so casual with me, and you still know how to wear pants?
How are you doing? Did your mother beat you?
Back then, your second uncle, your fourth uncle, and I gave you a good meal. "
Xu Shiyan was so happy that he hurriedly called his daughter over to ask her.
Xu Jinping glanced at her mother and laughed, "No, my mother didn't hit us.
However, my mother's expression at that time was also old and terrifying.
Dad, you didn't see it, what's your face so hideous. "
Relying on the pampering of grandparents, father is also in front of her, the little girl gets bolder and teases her mother.
"Ahem, girl, stop. Let me advise you, wash your pants."
Xu Shiyan glanced at his daughter-in-law's face, but he didn't dare to show his amused face, so he quickly pointed out a way for his daughter.
This child has been a bit skinny lately, and if he keeps his skin like this, he will be easily beaten.
"Oh, okay." Xu Jinping saw that her mother's face was not very good again.
So I went out obediently, threw the pants into the basin, poured some washing powder on them and soaked them.
The pants were originally cleaned by Zhou Guilan, and they just put them on in the morning, but they used them to hold fish, making them fishy and dirty.
Fortunately, it is not a difficult stain to wash. Soak it for a while, find a washing board and rub it twice.
Xu’s washboard is quite interesting, it’s not the kind carved out of wood with a knife.
Instead, they used the rubber covers on the penicillin bottles in the hospital, and screwed them to the wooden boards one by one.
Zhou Qingguo's daughter-in-law is in the hospital, is there still no rubber cover?
After a period of time, I can save a lot of pockets, and let others go to them, and go home to make a washboard.
This thing is much better than the plastic washboard of the later generations, and it doesn't rub your hands.
Xu Jinping is a small person, but she works quickly. She sits on a small bench and rubs clothes, and she has that posture.
"Second Sister, how about I help you, I'm stronger than you."
Yang Haoyu saw that his sister was being escorted to do the laundry, so he hurried over to help.
"No, a pair of pants, I'll rub them out in a while.
Who told me to come up with that idea? "Xu Jinping smiled nonchalantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 531: rat biting mallet
chapters.content:
Chapter 531 A rat bites a stick
After rubbing the trousers, throw them in clean water several times, then wring them out and put them in a basin, and take them out to dry tomorrow morning.
No one hangs clothes outside at night, there is no such rule.
After washing the trousers, Su Anying over there has already picked up all the mushrooms in the basket on the fork, waiting to be carried out to dry tomorrow morning.
Underneath the mushrooms are jujubes covered with big leaves. Pick them up in a small basin, wash them with water, and bring them into the house for the children to eat.
The Xu family is not short of food, but this kind of wild fruit in the mountains is usually rare.
Jujubes are very sweet, with a special aroma, both Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui love to eat them.
Over there, Xu Haiyuan picked out some walnuts with rotten skins from the walnut pile, knocked off the skins with a stick, picked some and threw them into the pit at the bottom of the pot to burn them.
In the evening, when Xu Chenghou had nothing to do, he took a hammer to crack walnuts for the children, and the children each found an awl or something to pick the walnut kernels.
At this time, the walnuts are not yet dry, and the walnut kernels also contain water, which tastes unique and sweet.
All the children are so beautiful, especially the three who go up to the mountain to work. The fruits of their labor taste very delicious.
It was agreed that I would go to pick up ginseng seeds tomorrow, and Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were preparing things over there.
Ginseng seeds are not as good as goods, they are too tender, and they have to be planted in the ground again, so special care must be taken.
In the sack, put a layer of plastic film to seal the window.
The plastic film itself is barrel-shaped, just tie up the bottom and put it in the sack.
There are not many seeds planted at ten feet, and two or three sacks are enough.
The children were actually tired after going up the mountain for a day. They went to bed early at night and got up early the next morning.
Zhou Guilan baked pancakes in the kitchen and brought food for Xu Shiyan and the others up the mountain.
Burnt-flavored noodle cakes, with a lot of green onions inside, filled the room with the aroma of green onion cakes.
In addition to the scallion cake, Zhou Guilan also cut a piece of sauced beef.
The beef was delivered by others some time ago. I was too busy to eat it, so it was frozen in the refrigerator.
Doesn’t this mean that you have to go up the mountain to plant seeds? Yesterday Zhou Guilan took it out of the refrigerator and put the sauce in the stewing pot.
Cut it out right now and put it in a lunch box.
In addition to these, there are pickles and homemade chili sauce.
Zhou Guilan baked a lot of pancakes, and in the morning she got scallion pancakes and potato soup.
With the homemade chili sauce, small pickles, eating biscuits and hot soup, this meal is delicious.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying threw all the tools into the cart, and the three children sat in the back seat of the driver's building.
There is not much to live today, so Xu Chenghou will not be allowed to go up the mountain. The old man is getting old, and he can't go up the mountain.
Xu Shiyan drove, Su Anying sat in the co-pilot, and the family of five drove straight to Shendi at the Kaifeng fork.
In this season, the leaves of ginseng are already withered and yellow.
After withdrawing the ginseng shed, use the four teeth to draw and pull on the ground a few times.
The seedlings of the ginseng seeds are small in themselves, and they will be gone if you pull them, so you don’t need to delay the seedlings.
Xu Shiyan started planing with four teeth, Su Anying and the children hurried out to pick up seeds.
Not to mention, this piece of land is a real long mallet, and the seeds have been sown for two years, and the seeds have grown really well.
The good ones are as thick as an adult's little finger, the strips are also good, and there is no rust.
Xu Shiyan paid special attention to every stroke, for fear of breaking the seeds.
Su Anying led the children and picked them up very carefully.
The seeds of the Xu family are pretty even, the big ones are about the size of a finger, the small ones are about as thick as a cigarette, and almost none are too small.
This is the benefit of spreading dry seeds. After a one-year dormant period, the ginseng seeds have a high opening rate and good seedling emergence.
If it is water seeds, it will not work. The opening rate is not enough, and some ginseng seeds will germinate one year later.
As a result, five leaf ginseng seeds were mixed with a lot of three flowers.
So later someone soaked ginseng seeds with gibberellin before sending out, which can increase the opening rate.
Ginseng seeds are good. Everyone is very happy. While chatting and laughing, they picked up the ginseng seeds and put them together.
Su Anying saw that there were too many piles, so she packed the ginseng seeds into sacks one by one.
It is also particular about when it is installed, the beard should face outward, and the reed head should face inward.
This is to be replanted in the ground. If the reed head falls off, it will not be able to germinate.
There is a plastic sheet inside the sack, which can ensure the moisture of the ginseng seeds, and will not be lost by the wind, especially the reed heads will not dry out.
The seeds were small and dense, so Xu Shiyan dug it alone, and Su Anying led the three children to pick it up.
By noon, it was seven or eight feet up.
If Xu Shiyan and his wife went up the mountain, they would definitely finish their work before eating.
But they have three children, and the children are easy to be hungry. After another morning of work, they are already hungry.
How can I make them hungry? So I took the children to see Can Xiaofang for dinner.
The cakes baked in the early morning were already cold. Su Anying was worried that the children would feel uncomfortable eating them, so she put them in the pan to warm them up.
Spicy scallion pancakes, rolled with thin slices of sauced beef, and some homemade chili sauce, take a bite and feel old.
There is no hot soup on the mountain, so the people watching the ginseng boiled hot water for them to eat cakes and drink hot water. The meal was quite comfortable.
After lunch, and resting for a while, Xu Shiyan saw that the sky was very cloudy, so he said he should hurry up and go home early.
So the couple led the children to plant seeds again.
As a result, after digging a few times, a hole was exposed in the ground, and some seeds were dug out by the four-toothed planer, but there was no head or tail, only a bare rod left.
"Oops, this is a rat."
Su Anying looked at it and felt distressed. At least two or three catties of seeds were dug out of this litter.
And the most harmful thing about rats is that they only pick big ones. This is cutting off the head and tail, planning to hoard food for the winter.
Xu Shiyan also sighed. What is the crop yard most afraid of? One is bad weather, and the other is pests and rats.
This rat is too capable of harming people. It bit off its head and tail with a good mallet and hid it in a hole.
"It's okay, isn't that the old saying? A mouse bites a mallet, and the price of the mallet will increase."
Seeing his wife's distressed appearance, Xu Shiyan could only speak words of comfort.
My man said this on purpose to ease her heart, how could Su Anying not know?
Su Anying could only smile, "Well, it would be great if the price really increased.
Let’s work, let’s get this out quickly, pack up our things and go home. "
Xu Shiyan dug out all the sticks in the hole.
Even if it can’t be planted, it can still be washed and made into goods. Why can’t it be left for mice as winter food?
It wasn't much in the afternoon, and it was over soon. The seeds were ten feet long, and three loose sacks were filled.
The ginseng seeds are not too solid, mainly because they are afraid of crushing the seeds.
All these seeds have been planted, so don’t put them in the bucket at all, what if they are accidentally turned upside down?
Su Anying and her daughter sat in the passenger seat, her son and Shen Zaizi sat in the back row, and her fourth son and other belongings were placed in the car bucket.
Just like that, the family of five drove back.
After lunch, the sky became cloudy, and it started to rain when they were loading the car. Halfway through the car, it started to rain heavily.
Su Anying sat in the car, watching the windshield wipers kept brushing, very fortunate that they came here today.
Otherwise, the rain would have delayed for several days.
"Thanks to our family having a car, otherwise everything would have been watered."

chapters.title: Chapter 532: pick seeds
chapters.content:
Chapter 532 Picking seeds
Waiting for everyone to get home, it was already raining heavily.
Fortunately, there was still unused plastic film in the car. Su Anying got out of the car, holding a plastic sheet with both hands, covering the three children under it, and protecting them into the hospital.
Xu Shiyan couldn't take care of those things anymore, and hurriedly carried the sack and dumped it in the yard.
By the time he carried the three sacks of ginseng seeds into the house, most of his body was already wet.
Zhou Guilan saw it, and quickly handed over a dry towel to let her son wipe his head and face, and then urged Xu Shiyan to go back to the room to change clothes.
Everyone came back early, and there was still some time before dinner.
It happened that there was hot water in the pot, so Zhou Guilan turned on hot water, heated up the kitchen, and asked the children to take a bath and change their clothes.
School starts tomorrow, and I have been going up the mountain for the past two days, especially since today, the three children are all disgraced.
How can I go back to school like this? I have to wash and tidy up.
The three children took a bath and changed into clean clothes.
Over there, Chu Xuanhuai also cooked some **** soup for Xu Shiyan, his wife and three children to drink, so as not to catch a cold.
After taking a hot bath and drinking some warm **** soup, my whole body feels warm.
The three children were all blushing, sitting on the Kang and laughing.
"Okay, okay, don't make a fuss, let's eat quickly, after dinner, you go to bed early, and you have class tomorrow.
Yuanyuan, you have finished your homework, right? "
Su Anying came into the room with the meal in hand, seeing the children making a fuss together, she greeted them to eat with a smile.
Dinner has eggplant stewed potatoes, and loach stewed tofu.
The loach tofu has some homemade sauce in it, and some chopped chili, which is spicy and delicious.
The children like it very much. They mix it with rice and eat half a bowl more than usual.
After dinner, Xu Haiyuan followed Chu Xuanhuai back to the clinic to live, and took a test of the homework he had learned recently.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu packed their schoolbags, put them all together, previewed the new lesson, and then went to sleep.
The five-day holiday is over, and on Monday, October 6th, the children return to school.
Xu Shiyan went to work, while Su Anying went to the market to see if he could catch some goods.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan cleaned up the house and began to pick seeds.
Pick out the ginseng seeds that are taken home, with complete beard and reeds, no water rust, no rotten scars, and good body shape.
According to the size, it is divided into four levels: the first road, the second road, the third road, and the fourth road.
The outer skin of corn is also called corn nest.
Pick the two soft layers inside, soak them in warm water, and then split them into strips.
The selected ginseng seeds are **** from the beard with corn nests one by one. The corn nests are not knotted, just twist them twice and tuck them in.
When planting ginseng, just pull off the corn nests from under the beards and place them in the ground one by one.
Corn nests are easy to rot in the soil, even if you forget to roll them down, or accidentally fall into the soil, it doesn’t matter.
Unlike the plastic ropes used later, those things will not rot for many years after being put into the soil.
If you are accidentally tied to the mallet plant, it is easy to strangle the mallet into two knots.
The picked seeds are packed into sacks or cardboard boxes.
Whether it is a sack or a cardboard box, it must be covered with plastic film to prevent water loss.
Pay special attention to protecting the reed head. If the reed head is damaged, the seed will be useless.
Picking seeds requires not only good eyesight, but also patience.
Xu Chenghou and his wife put their eating side to the side in the middle of the ground, and spread a plastic sheet on top.
One of them sat on the edge of the kang, the other sat on a stool, grabbed a pile of seeds from the sack, and picked them one by one.
Pick them up and put them on the side. No matter which one you have saved up, quickly bundle them up and pack them into boxes.
It took one morning to go to the market. When Su Anying grabbed enough goods and went home, the old couple picked out a sack.
"Hey, it's getting late, I have to cook quickly, otherwise the three will be hungry when they get home."
Zhou Guilan was busy picking seeds at noon, and the two little ones didn't bother themselves to play. Suddenly, it was almost eleven o'clock.
So I hurried to wash my hands, and set fire to cook. Fortunately, last night's food is still available, so just heat it up.
Not long after the water in the pot boiled here, the children were heard on the other side.
"Grandma, is the meal ready? I'm starving to death."
Sure enough, the children all said this when they entered the door, starving to death.
"Okay, okay, hurry up and wash your hands, I'll clean up here, let's eat."
Zhou Guilan laughed when she heard the movement of her grandson and granddaughter, and hurriedly cleaned up the ginseng standing beside her.
Put the selected ones in the box, and put the plastic cloth in a pocket for the unfinished ones, and put them aside.
Then I took the broom to sweep the floor and wipe the table, and hurriedly put the food on the table.
After September 14th, daylight saving time will end, so the children arrive at school at one o'clock in the afternoon and start class at ten o'clock in the afternoon.
Don't look at the hour, there are a lot of things to do, and I am a little nervous at noon.
So the food was quickly packed and brought up, and the family sat down to eat.
Xu Shiyan would not come back at noon, and everyone did not wait for him.
After lunch, Xu Haiyuan still went to accompany Chu Xuanhuai to write medical records, while Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu helped pick the seeds.
The child has good eyesight and quick hands. Not to mention, the two babies work decently, and they can pick out quite a few in a while.
At 12:55, the three children left home.
Anyway, it’s close, so there’s no need to run. When the bell rang at one o’clock, I just entered the class, sat down to catch my breath, and the teacher also entered the door.
In the afternoon, Su Anying was fine, and she was also picking seeds at home. There were only a few things in total, and they would be finished before evening.
When Xu Shiyan came back in the evening, Su Anying discussed with him that the family should not plant this kind of trouble.
She planned to go to Ji'an with Huang Shengli and others, and come back with some ginseng.
In recent years, Fusong has vigorously developed ginseng in various places, and there is a big gap in ginseng seeds.
If the past years were left behind, Xu Shiyan would still be able to take part in the competition.
But this year, we cooperated with the Forestry Bureau, and all the extra seeds were distributed to the Forestry Bureau.
Xu Shiyan can squeeze out a little bit by himself, but Huang Shengli and the others haven't planted any seeds yet.
Because of the topography of Ji'an and Huanren, the ginseng seeds are in better shape, and there are more ginseng seeds there.
Su Anying met a few ginseng farmers who came to sell goods in Ji'an in the city, and heard that there are many ginseng seeds for takeaway.
So Su Anying decided to go out with Huang Shengli and the others, go to Ji'an to collect ginseng seeds and come back.
In addition to some for home use, some can also be sold outside.
"I found out, you are getting more and more capable now.
It's a good idea to go out and flip the seeds. "Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it.
This daughter-in-law of his family is really very brainy now.
"Wait a minute, I'll make a call." After Xu Shiyan finished speaking, he turned and went to make a call.
"Brother, how many gaps are there in your bureau this year?
Well, your siblings are planning to go to Ji'an to make some money and come back. Do you need it? Use it together. "
Xu Shiyan called Guo Shouye.
Guo Shouye was involved in this matter, the Forestry Bureau has a large cart, how convenient would it be to pull a cart back directly at that time?

chapters.title: Chapter 533: Inverted ginseng seeds
chapters.content:
Chapter 533 Inverted ginseng seeds
The Forestry Bureau has also organized a lot of ginseng soil this year to develop ginseng. Although there is a ginseng plant that we cooperated with here, there is still a shortage of many.
Guo Shouye was in charge of this matter and was worried, but when he heard the news, he immediately cheered up.
"It has to be my younger siblings, they are really capable, and they can still contact Shen Zaizi.
Come on, when will the siblings leave? I am with them. "
Xu Shiyan turned his head and glanced at Su Anying, Su Anying gestured twice, Xu Shiyan nodded knowingly.
"Tomorrow, I will leave tomorrow morning, and the few of them will drive there.
Your siblings have agreed with the resident households over there to help them buy more.
Brother, let me tell you, bring an extra big car? "
"Okay, what else is there? Let the siblings come over tomorrow morning, and we will go together.
I bring a few more people on this side, and the road is safer. "
This is to transport ginseng seeds. It is estimated that there are some small valleys there, so you must bring cash.
Needless to say, when I came back, I pulled several carts of ginseng, and I was afraid that someone would rob me halfway.
That's why Guo Shouye said, bring more people.
Xu Shiyan also thought so, so he dragged Guo Shouye on. Anyway, the Forestry Bureau is a public unit, so it is convenient to go anywhere.
Even if there is some problem on the way, Guo Shouye can solve it.
Su Anying and the others said they have a company, but it is still a private business after all.
In these years, in many matters, private transactions are not as convenient as public ones.
After the two sides discussed it, Xu Shiyan hung up the phone, and Su Anying gave Xu Shiyan a thumbs up.
"Okay, you still have a trick, and you dragged Guo Ge here.
Yes, then tomorrow I will take the money and go to Ji'an and Huanren.
It happened that the money from selling ginseng soil was not saved a while ago, and with the money received from customers in the south, it was enough to dump a carload of ginseng seeds. "
This year, the ginseng soil in the machine repair factory, the final payment received a while ago, earned nearly 200,000 yuan for a crop of ginseng soil.
In addition to the benefit fee earned by receiving goods for southern customers, there are still tens of thousands.
Su Anying has inquired about it, and the ginseng seeds in Ji'an are cheaper than here, about three or four hundred yuan per zhang.
They brought over 200,000 yuan, which was enough.
Just like that, the next morning, Su Anying led her fourth younger sister Su Anfen, fourth younger brother-in-law Ji Tongzhong, and Yang Junxian's daughter-in-law Ji Yufeng.
Together with Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe, Sun Xiaofeng, Feng Chao, and Yang Chunming, they also brought one or two relatives.
Ji Yufeng is the accountant of Dongshen Village, and she also manages the company's accounts. At this time, she must follow her to manage the accounts.
Anyway, Dongshen Village is not busy recently, so Ji Yufeng can go out for a few days without any problem.
Zhou Qingguo and his wife both go to work, and Yang Junxian has no time, so he can only stay at home.
A group of people went to Songjianghe Forestry Bureau and found Guo Shouye.
Guo Shouye also brought an accountant and cashier here, and he also brought a dozen young men in their twenties and thirties who were in good health from the security team of the Forestry Bureau, and drove three large trucks.
Just like that, a group of twenty or thirty people, driving six or seven cars, headed for Ji'an in a mighty way.
Su Anying made an agreement with Ji'an and several farmers, and left an address there, so she took people all the way to inquire about the place.
There are more mountains in Ji'an, and every family has mountains, and they also grow ginseng. The edge ginseng produced there is more famous.
Led by local people, Su Anying and his party wandered around the villages over there to see the price of the seeds, and hired people to pick up the ginseng seeds.
After a total of seven or eight days of busy work, Su Anying and the others collected 10,000 catties of ginseng seeds, and Guo Shouye collected almost 10,000 catties of ginseng seeds.
The big truck was loaded with a lot of sacks, and the top was covered with canvas. Except for the driver and a few women, the rest of the people were sitting in the car and escorting the car.
The members of the security team of the Forestry Bureau, as well as Huang Shengli and Zhao Jianshe, all carried guns.
What about hundreds of thousands of things? If something goes wrong on the road, who can bear it?
Fortunately, Ji'an is not too far away, and the journey is fairly safe.
Even if there were a few petty thieves, seeing their posture, they didn't dare to panic.
The sacks are marked with marks. Go to Songjiang River to unload the part of the Forestry Bureau to the warehouse, and the rest will be directly pulled to Donggang Canshi.
There is no need to enter the market, it is just outside the open space, and the sacks can be unloaded and placed on the ground.
When Su Anying and the others were walking back, they called home to report.
Zhou Qingguo, Yang Junxian, and Xu Shiyan released the news a few days ago, and when they learned the exact time of their return, they informed everyone.
So as soon as the truck was unloaded here, people who knew Xin'er rushed over and surrounded the pile of seeds.
These people are optimistic about the seeds, you have a sack and I have a sack, and I will carry it away after weighing some money.
Thanks to Su Anying and the others, they reserved what they needed at home in advance, and pulled half of it back to store it alone, otherwise, they might have been bought by others.
Su Anying and the others arrived home at noon, and before nightfall, all the seeds except for their own use were sold out.
Buyers are not only people from various villages, but also elementary schools, junior high schools, high schools, supply and marketing cooperatives, and industrial units.
Every place has its own participation venues. These have no foundation at all. Don’t they all have to be bought?
It is impossible for these units to make ginseng land of tens of feet, but they are all hundreds of feet of ginseng soil. Can there be fewer seeds?
Su Anying and the others came back with all these, but it was not enough.
Many people came late and didn't buy it, and kept asking, is there any more in a few days?
Su Anying and the others went out to use ginseng seeds for their own use, and to earn a fortune along the way.
Now that I have enough at home, who has nothing to do and then runs again? Just say no more.
Those who didn’t buy it looked disappointed, so they had to go to other places to search for it, while those who bought it went home happily to pick seeds and plant sticks.
"We bought it at 1 zhang 350 over there, and it probably weighs about 15 catties per zhang.
A total of 11,000 catties were bought back, and 2,000 catties of our eight households were deducted, leaving 9,000 catties of ginseng seeds.
There is no need to pick and choose the ones that are sold at thirty-two pounds a catty. After deducting the various expenses for a while, there will be less than 30,000 yuan left.
That is to say, the seeds we used for our own use did not cost money, and we made a small fortune. "
In the evening, Su Anying collected all the accounts, and finally calculated the profit of this trip.
"Okay, it's really powerful." I have to say that Su Anying's brain is getting better and better now.
On this trip, the ginseng seeds I used did not cost any money, and I also made a small fortune.
The ginseng soil does not cost money, and the ginseng seeds do not cost money. After three years, no matter how much you sell, it will be nothing.
That one-hundred-foot-tall mallet, wouldn’t it cost at least one hundred and eighty thousand?
So, it is much easier for a rich person to make money than for a poor person to make money.
Xu Shiyan thought about it, what was he doing at this time in his previous life?
It seems that you are still in the big house, pointing bitterly at farming the yellow smoke, right?
In the two lives, they were still the same husband and wife, but their development was completely different.
Man, sometimes you really take the right step, and then everything goes smoothly.
"Daughter-in-law has worked hard, hurry up, wash your feet quickly, take a good rest, and hire someone to pick the seeds tomorrow.
The ones at home, my father and I had already planted them on Saturday and Sunday.
Hurry up and pick these out, and plant them quickly while the weather is okay, and it will freeze in a few days. "

chapters.title: Chapter 534: good business
chapters.content:
Chapter 534 Business is good
It’s mid-October, and the temperature is getting lower day by day. Some people plant less ginseng, and at this time, the work has been done and there is nothing to do.
So it is easy to hire people at this time. As long as the wages are in place, many people can be hired.
On the second day, Su Anying, Zhou Guilan, Han Cai'e, and Su Anfen picked the seeds together, and after a busy day, they finished picking all the seeds.
Then hired people to go up the mountain, and quickly planted the seeds down to the ground.
Even Xu Shiyan helped plant the tens of feet of Xu Shian's house.
The ginseng planted a mallet, and those who should sow seeds basically didn't have much thought about it.
This year, in this ginseng field, Xu Shiyan still hired people to come up to watch the ginseng work, and the leader was none other than Li Erniu.
I found Zhao Jianguo in the area of ​​Liumao River last year.
This year, Zhao Jianguo even saw that he had made a lot of money by participating in the work. Li Erniu was also moved when he saw it, so he went to Xu Shiyan and wanted to come and do something.
Xu Shiyan is short of manpower here, and when he heard about this, he agreed.
Li Erniu took a few blind wanderers on the mountain, and Lian Kan participated in the work.
Xu Shiyan's family's 100-foot stick shed was all handed over to them.
At this time, the big work is basically nothing, so I can finally breathe a sigh of relief.
But at this time, the southern customer called again.
The main reason is that the goods received by Su Anying are good, and the other party is very satisfied. Can you add another batch?
Now, Su Anying felt embarrassed.
It’s nothing else, it’s about this time, the sticks around Donggang were either sold to the ginseng company, or they all came to the ginseng market to sell to those old customers, and the stocks of each household are not too much. .
It is estimated that it is some remote small villages and the like, too far away from the city or county, it is inconvenient to go out, and there are still stocks in such places that are not sold.
This time Su Anying didn't dare to promise too much, she only said to help as much as she could.
Then, with Ji Tongzhong, Huang Shengli's wife and others, they drove to various small villages to collect the goods.
Not to mention, this is the right way. They ran like this all day long, but their efforts were not in vain. They really brought back a lot of clubs and other mountain goods.
Send it according to the customer's request, and earn a few small sums.
Su Anying is busy receiving, sorting, packing, and delivering goods, and she is too busy to go home every day.
As for Xu Shiyan, the rough processing of ginseng at the processing factory is over, but the remaining ginseng seeds are missing, and they still have to clean up for a few days.
In addition to some follow-up work, such as cutting beards, smoothing beards, secondary processing of Changbai Mountain red ginseng, packaging of ginseng honey slices, etc., I am still very busy, and I rarely go home on time.
The couple are too busy to take care of the family. Thanks to the help of parents, everything in the house is in order.
The couple came back from a busy day, and the house was warm, with hot meals, smiling faces of the elderly and children.
Days like this, although busy, are also full of happiness.
The weather is getting colder and colder. In November, with several heavy snowfalls, the land was directly sealed off.
Many families in Donggang this year have learned from Xu Shiyan how to buckle up the plastic sheds and put up the houses, which makes them much warmer.
Of course, it is necessary to have a fire in the house, otherwise it will be too cold in winter, and it will be freezing.
After the snow falls, Donggang Sanshi no longer opens the market every day. It is only on the fifth day of the market that some people will come to sell goods.
Those old customers from the south who came to receive the goods, some also left.
