Originally thought that the business of restaurants and hotels in the city would slow down, but it turned out that the people who stayed and ate were okay.
One reason is Chu Xuanhuai.
Now Mr. Chu's medical skills are well-known, not to mention the whole county, and even people in other counties know that there is an old doctor in Donggang.
Exquisite medical skills, cured many difficult and miscellaneous diseases.
Because Chu Xuanhuai only sees ten patients a day, some people have come from a long distance and have not been assigned a number, so they can only stay first.
Where is the closest to Chu Xuanhuai's clinic? Naturally, it is a hotel in Sanshi.
Some people are too far away from Donggang, and they feel troublesome to go back and forth for consultation, so they simply live in a hotel.
Bring a place in the hotel to make medicine or something, live here for treatment, until the condition is better, then grab a few more medicines and go home.
Seeing this situation, Su Anyu specially asked someone to buckle up a plastic shed at the back of the restaurant, and set up a small charcoal stove in it, which is specially used to boil medicine for people.
People who live in hotels can use small stoves to cook medicine for free, which is convenient for everyone.
Another, Southern lumber veteran.
When winter comes, there are many old timber customers coming from the south.
Those who gouged out the door and robbed the hole looked for a trustee, and bought wood, plywood, fiberboard, etc. from the Forestry Bureau.
In the past, these people lived in those small hotels in Songjianghe, and they didn't say whether they had room or board, but the security problem was not easy to solve, and some troubles often occurred.
Now I know that there is a city in Donggang, which is very close to the Songjiang River. There are restaurants and hotels in the city.
The most important thing is that the owner of the restaurant is familiar with the people in the Forestry Bureau and has a very strong relationship.
Others are fine, but the last one is so exciting.
After inquiring about it, many old wood customers went straight to Donggang Sanshi and came to stay.
Another point is the bathing place on the first floor of the hotel.
Originally, it was only for hotel guests to take a bath, but after winter, people around also came to ask if they could take a bath.
It’s too hard to take a bath at home in the cold weather. There is a bathhouse here. Who doesn’t want to come out and take a warm bath, so it’s more comfortable?
Su Anyu saw that the left and right sides also had to burn boilers for heating and bathing for the guests. One sheep was also driven, and two sheep were also herded, so it was easy.
In this way, even though it is winter, the business of the hotel is still going well, at least the heating and labor costs can be covered.
Su Anying saw this, well, there is no need to close the door now, let's continue to operate.
Otherwise, there will be no work when the door is closed, and it is not worthwhile to pay for others. If you don’t pay for it, these people will not come to work next year if you can’t guarantee it.
Anyway, as long as you can maintain it and don’t spend money in it, let’s open for business.
"Son, are you busy this Sunday? Do you have a lot of homework?"
At the end of November, on a Saturday, Xu Shiyan came in after get off work and asked Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan was taken aback, "I'm not busy, I've finished my homework."
Elementary school is different from other places. Other units have a day off on Sunday. Primary school teachers have a meeting to study on Saturday afternoon, so they also have a holiday.
For a contestant like Xu Haiyuan, can the teacher leave some homework for him?
He started writing after lunch, and he finished his homework before three o'clock in the afternoon.
"Then you will go up the mountain with me tomorrow?
That year, the snow was too heavy, and the ground was covered directly. This is not good, and the ground will not freeze.
I'm afraid that some mice will get in and make a nest for the winter, which will harm our family.
You will go up the mountain with me tomorrow, and we will walk over the pond to drive the snow away and freeze the ground. Fine? "
Why did you find Xu Haiyuan? The main reason is that the child is small and short.
Qiu just removed the plastic sheeting, but the curtains were fine. If someone like Xu Shiyan walks on top of it, he has to bend over hard, which is very tiring.
Xu Haiyuan's head is just right, just lower your head slightly, which is more convenient than adults.
"Okay, what else is there? Then go." Xu Haiyuan heard that this was a serious matter, so of course he had to go.

chapters.title: Chapter 535: footprints of black blind man
chapters.content:
Chapter 535 Black Blind Footprints
Xu Haiyuan readily agreed, and Xu Jinping on the other end also shouted to follow, how could Xu Shiyan agree?
"No, you're too short, the snow on the mountain is probably down to your chest, you can't even move in the snow."
Xu Shiyan scares his daughter.
Xu Jinping is one and a half years younger than her elder brother. Xu Haiyuan is tall, and the two are quite different in size. Xu Jinping is really too short.
"Okay." Xu Jinping pursed her lips, and reluctantly went to the side.
Early the next morning, the father and son Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan packed up and dressed neatly.
Put a leather jacket over the big cotton jacket, and pair the big cotton trousers with those kind of big-toed cotton shoes, with high tops and felt socks inside.
Tuck the cotton trouser legs into the upper of the shoes, and then tie the leg straps, so that the snow will not pour into the shoes and freeze people.
Both fathers wear fur hats on their heads.
Now their family lacks anything else, absolutely no shortage of skins.
The otters and raccoon dogs in the farm, although they don’t kill and skin them, but raising these open-mouthed beasts, it’s hard to guarantee that there won’t be any accidents, and it’s not uncommon for a few of them to die.
Those skins were not sold, so they were kept for their own use.
The raccoon fur hat is warm.
When it’s cold, put down the ears of the hat on both sides, tie the rope, and the fluffy raccoon skin sticks to the face, which is soft and warm, which is very comfortable.
The two of them got dressed and went out with food. Xu Shiyan drove to the side of Kaifeng Road first.
This place will be making products next year, and we can’t let rats harm them, so I’m the first one to come here.
When he arrived at the venue, Xu Haiyuan realized that he was not the only one who went up the mountain today.
Huang Shuqing, Sun Yu, and Yang Jianguo also went up the mountain with their fathers, and they all came for a trip to the snow.
The snow on the mountain was indeed heavier than at home, and of course it wasn't as thick as Xu Shiyan said, and it didn't reach Xu Jinping's chest.
It probably reaches Xu Haiyuan's thigh, which is actually not too small, more than two feet deep.
No way, if you come too early, you are afraid that the snow will not be able to stand and melt, or there will be less snow in the future.
The main reason is that the weather was fine before the heavy snowfall this year, but after the sudden heavy snowfall and cooling down, the snow did not melt.
In this case, due to the thick snow, the temperature is blocked, and the ground cannot be frozen, and mice are easy to drill in and make nests.
If it catches up with the average year, the next one will melt, and it will stop after several consecutive snowfalls, the ground will be frozen, and there is no need to go up to the snow.
Before Xu Haiyuan and the others came, they thought it was a fun job.
As a result, they only found out when they got on the face of the pool. How could it be so easy to think?
It has snowed several times, and a hard cover has formed on it, and the snow has turned into particles.
The most important thing is that the ground underneath is not frozen through, it is soft, and once you step on it, it sinks in immediately.
The snow was so deep that it was difficult to pull up your legs, so you could only move forward slowly.
Compared to children, a few adults can be better. They move more easily, but they have to bend over and lower their heads.
It’s not easy anyway, it’s quite tiring.
Fortunately, there are fewer people on the side of Kaifeng Fork Road, and a family of four to fifty feet, even if they walk through it once, no matter how strenuous it is.
There are many on the side of Liumao River, each family has a 100-foot stick, and there are collective 20,000-foot ginseng seeds.
Not to mention whether the snow is easy to walk or not, just say that the ground is 20,000 feet long, which is nearly 70,000 meters.
The 70-kilometer road, all of them go to Xuewozi, and if one gets stuck, it is really not easy.
"I'm exhausted. When I was at home, I was still thinking, how tired can this thing be? Isn't it just a walk?
After finishing the work, maybe I can chase a rabbit, catch a pheasant or something.
Looking at it, well, there is no need to think about anything, if we can go through this area today, it will be considered good. "
Huang Shuqing walked on the pool again, talking to Xu Haiyuan next door.
This child doesn't like studying, and his grades are not very good.
Isn’t there nothing to do in winter? Huang Shengli's wife always stares at her son's study.
Especially on Saturdays and Sundays, they were even more closely watched, and Huang Shuqing was miserable.
After finally having the opportunity to come out with his father, Huang Shuqing felt liberated, which is a great thing.
It turned out that I came up the mountain to find out that this trip to Xuewozi was more tiring than doing homework.
"It's beautiful to think about it, and you're chasing rabbits to catch pheasants. Can you run in such heavy snow?
Besides, there is something to see in this scene, the dog is barking all day long, how can there be any pheasants and rabbits? "
Xu Haiyuan pursed his lips, thinking about beautiful things every day, and chasing a rabbit to catch a pheasant, why didn't he just think about catching a wild boar?
Huang Shuqing raised his hand and rubbed his nose, he laughed, "Why don't you think about it?"
The grandfather of the family can hunt, and his father also went hunting in the mountains last winter. Huang Shuqing is very curious about hunting. He is eager to meet some prey and see it.
"Well, you don't have to think about it, just like you, it's okay to meet a pheasant and a rabbit, but if you meet a wild boar, hehe." Xu Haiyuan sneered.
He has never been greedy about this matter, he knows how old he is and how capable he is.
As young as they are, if they really meet wild boars and black blind men, their lives will be gone, just kidding.
Huang Shuqing chuckled, he was just thinking about it, nothing else.
Several people walked along the pool from south to north, and as soon as they reached the head of the pool on the north side, Xu Haiyuan had sharp eyes and saw two lines of footprints on the snow not far away.
"Dad, come and see, what footprints are here?"
It is obviously not left by humans, and it is much larger than human footprints.
A few children walk slowly, so arrange them to go to the short pool next to it.
Xu Shiyan and others walked fast, so they picked the long one in the middle, and Xu Haiyuan guarded the one on the edge, so they saw the footprints at the first time.
Xu Shiyan and the others knew something was wrong when they heard it, and immediately ran over here, "What's wrong? Yuanyuan."
It was quite far away, and there were pool skewers in the middle, so Xu Shiyan walked around with difficulty, asking questions as he walked.
"Dad, look, what kind of footprints are these? Why do I look like the blind man you said?"
At this moment, Xu Haiyuan has come to the set of footprints. The footprints of this thing are bigger than human footprints, and it looks like there is no heel.
Xu Shiyan's expression changed immediately when he saw the footprints.
"Shengli, hurry up and take all the children to see the small room."
That footprint, isn’t it the Heixiazi’s? And looking at it, at most it was left the day before yesterday, or even yesterday.
At this time, it is said that black blind people should find a place to squat, so why are there still black blind people?
But no matter what the reason was, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to take risks, but they brought the children, what joke?
What if the black blind man comes out of nowhere and hurts the child?
The Huang Shengli and others heard that something was wrong, so they hurried over, and when they saw the footprints, they were also stupid.
"No, our place is not too far from the roadside, how can there be black and blind people?"
Never mind the reason, they can't take care of the blind man at the moment.
One is that they lead the children, and they don’t bring guns, and the dogs of each family haven’t entered the mountains for a long time and have come back to life.
Without a gun or a dog, how can I take a photo with a black blind man? Fighting a black blind man with bare hands, looking for death?

chapters.title: Chapter 536: Arrange for people to go down the mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 536 Arrange for people to go down the mountain
"Jianguo, who is in charge of the area in the west? There are black and blind people in that place, why don't you know?"
Xu Shiyan led the children back to the kansen room near the gate of the venue, found Zhao Jianguo, and asked him.
"What? A blind man is coming in? Can't you?" Zhao Jianguo looked confused.
He is the foreman of the factory, and he arranges all the affairs in the factory.
Yesterday morning, he strolled around the whole place, and he seemed to be fine.
"I looked at the land covered by snow, and saw that it was already December, and there was nothing going on outside.
Let a few of them bring the dogs here, and the people live here.
We get together and burn a kang.
They just moved in the day before yesterday, and I was walking around the place yesterday morning, when did you come here and be blind? "
Zhao Jianguo was scared enough, how could there be black and blind people in this place?
Xu Shiyan sighed, yes, no one thought that there could be black and blind people in this place.
Thinking about it now, thanks to the fact that all the workers on the mountain have withdrawn here.
Hei Xiazi passed by from Daxitou, if the dog didn’t come over, in case the Hei Xiazi passed by the dog biting, if people were curious and went out to look, it would cause trouble.
"Go out for a walk in the future, remember to bring a gun, the few of you are together, don't go out alone.
If you persist, you will be able to go down the mountain in less than a month. "Xu Shiyan must remind him, don't make trouble.
"Also, don't try to kill that blind man.
Our dogs haven’t hunted for a long time, and when they come back to life, they don’t necessarily bite black blind men.
Your marksmanship is also terrible, the black blind man is facing the gun, if something happens, who will blame it? Can't get by? "
"Hey, I see, Shi Yan, don't worry, I will tell them."
Zhao Jianguo's expression froze, this must be paid attention to.
He definitely didn't dare to measure the black and blind, because he was afraid that those blind people would be greedy for money.
If he is not paying attention and takes a gun to chase the blind man, something will happen.
Knowing that there are likely to be black blind people near the venue, why would Xu Shiyan dare to let the children out?
He asked Xu Haiyuan and the others to stay in the small room.
Xu Shiyan went over to Zhao Jianshe and the others, and it was fine to go to Xuewozi quickly.
"Third Brother, if it's according to me, it's better to let those blind wanderers go down the mountain later.
At this time, there can be no major incidents on the mountain. Pay them the wages, go back to their hometown when they should go back to their hometown, and go to their relatives if they should go to their relatives.
On this mountain, brother Liu Jianguo, we take turns to come up to see it for a few days.
After a while, the weather will get colder and the ground will be frozen, so we can go down the mountain. "While working, Huang Shengli discussed with Xu Shiyan.
"Brother Jianguo is a native of Northeast China, he knows how powerful Heixia is.
Especially this black blind man who didn't take a position, if we didn't bring a dog, we wouldn't dare to take it lightly.
But those blind people are different. A black blind man is worth a lot of money now, so he secretly went to measure the black blind man because he was afraid that someone would ask for money.
What if something goes wrong? "
Zhao Jianguo kept his family on the ground, had a wife and children, and his own house and land, so naturally he couldn't afford to take risks.
But those blind wanderers are different. Most of them didn’t marry a wife and came to the Northeast alone.
That black blind man is worth almost a thousand dollars now, right?
These people worked on the mountain for more than half a year, earning about a thousand yuan.
If you take the risk of killing a black blind man, one gallbladder is equivalent to a year's wages.
With all this money, why not go back and build a house and call your daughter-in-law? Who can not be tempted?
"Hey, I actually thought about it just now, isn't it because I'm afraid you will be troubled? I didn't mention it."
Why didn't Xu Shiyan think of it?
He just felt that he was going to work, Su Anying was a woman, and neither of them could come to the mountain to take shifts.
Just letting Huang Shengli and the others come, it seems not very good.
"What's the matter? Two days alone, at most two rounds is enough.
If this hurts someone, we don’t care if it seems unbenevolent. If we care, how much will it cost? "
Huang Shengli shook his head, he felt that this matter was a bit hanging.
Since ancient times, money has moved people's hearts. Money must not be used to test people's hearts, especially the poor.
When a person has nothing, who cares whether it is dangerous or not? Just make money.
Risk your life, if you are lucky, how about getting money back?
But people like Huang Shengli and the others, even if they are asked to go hunting now, they will not go.
Nowadays, among them, who cares about the one or two thousand dollars? It's not worth getting hurt.
"Okay, then do as you said, and take the person down later when you go down the mountain.
Go back and ask your sister-in-law to pay them the salary. It is just at this time to go back to my hometown, and the train will not be so crowded. "
Xu Shiyan thought it was reasonable, so he agreed.
A few adults bent their waists and lowered their heads, and finally walked all over the pool here, and then hurried out to find those blind people.
Tell them that they will be given a holiday in advance, and the wages will be paid according to the agreement before going up the mountain.
Zhao Jianshe dragged his brother out again and explained to him.
Zhao Jianguo can also understand that he may not be able to see all the six or seven people on the mountain.
In case something happens if you don’t watch it, it’s really hard to explain.
Then a few people were very happy when they heard that they could go down the mountain early and their wages would be returned, so they all agreed and went down the mountain.
In the evening, Zhao Jianshe stayed with his brother first, and the rest sent the workers and the children home.
Back to Donggang, Xu Shiyan hurriedly asked Su Anying to calculate the wages for others.
Some of these people have relatives here, and go to relatives at night, and those without relatives can temporarily settle in a hotel for a good night.
Tomorrow morning they will go to buy a train ticket, and then they can go back to their hometown in Shandong.
When paying wages, Su Anying also specifically asked not to take the money with you, keep the travel expenses, and remit the rest to be safe.
Xu Haiyuan and the others were busy on the mountain for most of the day, and played in the small room for a while in the afternoon. They were also quite tired when they returned home, and they all went to rest early after eating.
Xu Shiyan mentioned the matter on the mountain to his father and master, and the two old men said that this matter was done right, and they should be more careful.
Otherwise, if something really happens, I can't tell.
This matter was well arranged, so Xu Shiyan and others didn't take it to heart, what should they do.
As a result, on Monday evening, when Xu Shiyan got home from get off work, he saw Zhao Jianshe, Zhao Jianguo, Huang Shengli and others waiting at his house.
"Jianguo, Jianshe, why did you both come down? What happened to the mountain? What happened?"
Xu Shiyan saw these people, his heart skipped a beat, and he hurriedly asked.
"Third brother, something happened. The third son Yan who worked for us was kicked by the black blind man." Zhao Jianshe said solemnly.
"What the hell? Yan Sanzi let the blind man kick him?
What's the matter? Didn't they all go down the mountain and go home? How can something happen? "
Fuck, what the **** is this called?
In order to avoid accidents for these blind wanderers, Xu Shiyan specially arranged for them to go down the mountain and return to their hometown early. Why did someone else have an accident?
"It's not just Yan Sanzi, but also the old Qin's family in Xitou who had an accident together.
The second child of Qin had the black blind man blow his head, and the other two who went up the mountain with him were also injured. "

chapters.title: Chapter 537: one dead one wounded
chapters.content:
Chapter 537 One dead and one injured
The third son of Yan works in the Liumao River ginseng field. His surname is Yan, and he works at home.
The family was poor and couldn't marry a wife, so he came to the northeast to join his distant cousin, the mother-in-law of the Qin family.
This kid is doing a good job, especially working hard. He used to dig the soil in the Liumao River ginseng field.
Xu Shiyan saw that he was doing a good job, so he left him to watch. Food and housing are in charge, and the salary is more than 1,000 yuan a year.
In addition, they worked in the field, served sticks and so on, and they paid for their wages.
Going down the mountain that day, Su Anying calculated the wages for these people, and according to Xu Shiyan's instructions, specially gave each of them an extra 100 yuan.
Sanzi Yan went to his cousin's house happily with a salary of 2,000 yuan.
Thinking about staying at my aunt's house for one night, and buying a bus ticket to go home for the New Year the next day.
When the Qin family saw that Sanzi Yan had left the mountain early, they had to ask. When they learned that there was a blind man on the mountain, Mrs. Qin was moved.
A black blind man, from what Yan Sanzi said, it should be quite big. If he has the guts of a black blind man, it can be sold for a lot of money.
It’s just winter, when Heixiazi is at his fattest, he is fat. If he gets it back, he won’t be able to burn several jars of oil?
There are also meat and bear paws, which are also good things.
Mrs. Qin was greedy, so she encouraged her nephew to stay.
Then asked her son Qin Laoer to find a few people, and together they went up the mountain to beat the black blind man, and then shared the money with them.
No matter what age, there are greedy people. Although the Qin family doesn't do things well, there are a few people who get along well.
So Qin Laoer found two people who had guns at home and could hunt. Together with Yan Sanzi, the four of them got up early and set off with their dogs, heading straight to the other side of Liumao River.
The third son of Yan was digging soil in the Liumao River in the first year, and he was there in the second year. He knew the terrain there very well, and led his men to follow the trail in the snow to chase the black blind man.
As a result, several people killed Heixiazi and Tulu, and all four dogs were harmed by Heixiazi.
Qin's second child was slapped off the head by the black blind man, and fell on the snow on the spot.
The other two were also injured. They were both local and had hunting experience, so they ran away.
Thinking about Qin's second son, the third son of Yan hesitated when he ran, but was held down by the black blind man and sat under his back.
The two people who went together stumbled and ran to the field for help.
When Zhao Jianguo and Zhao Jianshe heard this, they couldn't do nothing but rush over with a gun.
Zhao Jianshe knew that Xiaohuang and Erhei hadn't hunted for a long time, and they might not even recognize the blind man.
Besides, his marksmanship is not good, so how dare he take a test with the blind man?
So I didn't wait until the front, and fired the gun continuously. As soon as the gun was fired, the dog also barked.
If the black blind man saw someone shooting, he would point the gun at him, but he didn't see anyone from a distance, he only heard gunshots and dogs barking.
The blind man was injured, so naturally he didn't want to fight, so he left.
When Zhao Jianshe and the others rushed over, Yan Sanzi was sat down several times by the black blind man and was bitten in many places on his body.
The melon skin of Qin Laoer's head was lifted, bloody.
Zhao Jianshe and the two brothers saw it, and could only find a way to cut down trees and get a stretcher to carry them out.
Thanks to a car on the mountain, they were dragged down the mountain and sent to the hospital.
The third son of Yan was out of breath when he arrived at the hospital, and the second son of Qin was sent to the operating room for emergency treatment. The two slightly injured were also bandaged, and then reported to the Qin family.
"The mother-in-law of the Qin family is crying in the hospital.
She deserves it, let her be greedy, it's all right now, it's a life in vain.
It's a pity that Yan Sanzi is a young man, he is honest and strong, and he is willing to work hard.
Do you think he is mentally ill? Wouldn't it be nice to go home with a small two thousand dollars and marry a wife?
You have to listen to that dead old woman and go up the mountain to beat some black and blind people. It's all right now, Xiao Ming'er will go in directly. "
After Zhao Jianshe finished talking about what happened, he couldn't help cursing.
"Daughter-in-law, among the people who work on the mountain, how many live in hotels? How many live in relatives' homes? Are you leaving?"
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered something, and turned to ask Su Anying.
"There are seven people in total, three are staying at relatives' homes, and four are staying at hotels. Except for Yan Sanzi, all of them should have left, right?"
It’s been a year since I’ve been out. Who doesn’t want to go home? After getting so much money, why don’t you go home quickly? Who is fooling around outside?
Only Yan Sanzi, an idiot, let Mrs. Qin fool him, and lost his life.
"Jianjian, call the police. Hurry up." Xu Shiyan turned his head and said to Zhao Jianshe.
"Huh? Call the police? What's the use of calling the police on this matter?
Yan Sanzi was kicked by the blind man, can the police go and catch the blind man? "
Everyone in the room was a little dumbfounded. The police can't care about this matter.
"You are stupid, the police don't care, but we have to keep a record.
The other two people who went up the mountain together had to make things clear.
Don't you know what kind of virtue Mrs. Qin is? Don't come back to blackmail us again. " Xu Shiyan sighed.
The third son of Yan is dead, and there is no one alive. Why can't Yan's family be notified?
I'm afraid that Mrs. Qin's nonsense is going on. What if the Yan's family gets a letter and come here to blackmail people?
After all, Yan Sanzi was a ginseng for their site before, what if the Yan family insisted that Yan Sanzi met a blind man while he was a ginsenger, and let the blind man kill him?
They gathered all the witnesses together and made a record.
Even if the Yan family finds them in the future, no matter how they bite, they will not be able to bite the scene.
The field arranged for them to go down the mountain, and the wages were settled. Even if the employment relationship ended, what Yan Sanzi did after that had nothing to do with the field.
"There is another one, which was pulled back by you by car.
What if they are unconscionable and wantonly biting, you have to say that you didn’t take care of them on the way back, so they died? "
The evil of human nature is unimaginable for normal people.
Xu Shiyan felt that he would rather do useless work than be really blackmailed by the time.
There is nothing wrong with them taking advantage of the reason here, but they are so annoying, who wants to make trouble with those people?
"Yes, yes, why did I forget Mrs. Qin's flirt? Wait, I'll report the case."
Zhao Jianshe slapped his thigh, got up immediately and walked out.
Now Zhao Jianshe and others are in Donggang, and they are also people who speak with weight.
As soon as he went to the police station and told others about the matter, even though the comrades at the police station felt that this matter was out of their control, they still arranged for someone.
First went to the hospital to understand the situation, and confirmed that the cause of Yan Sanzi's death was that he was attacked by a black bear and died of serious injuries.
Then called the two people who went up the mountain together to take notes and asked what happened.
Confirmed that Zhao Jianguo and Zhao Jianshe went to the rescue, not hunting together.
In this way, the Zhao brothers have no responsibility.
After rescue, the second son of Qin finally saved his life, but the third son of Yan could only be sent to the cold morgue.
At the hospital, if they demanded that the corpse be taken away quickly, Mrs. Qin would just cry and howl, not caring about anything.
Helpless, Xu Shiyan had no choice but to go to the post office and send a telegram to Yan Sanzi's home to inform the situation and ask Yan's family to come to deal with it as soon as possible.
Here, Xu Shiyan told the hospital again, temporarily stop for a few days, there is Zhou Qingguo's daughter-in-law at the other end of the hospital, and this matter can always be accommodated.

chapters.title: Chapter 538: Year-end summary meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 538 Year-end Summary Conference
A few days later, Yan Sanzi's two elder brothers came here by train to deal with his younger brother's funeral.
Sure enough, as Xu Shiyan expected, that Mrs. Qin was full of lies and completely shifted the blame.
Mrs. Qin knew about the police here, so she didn't dare to go to the venue to bite.
It only said that after Yan Sanzi went down the mountain, he found Qin Lao Er, and wanted to go up the mountain with Qin Lao Er to beat the blind man.
Qin Laoer was encouraged by Yan Sanzi, so he found someone to go up the mountain with him. As a result, Yan Sanzi died and Qin Laoer was seriously injured.
The brothers of the Yan family didn't believe this, but he was already dead, and there was no proof of death.
The brothers of the Yan family have nothing to do, they are gone, and they were not murdered by anyone.
I went hunting by myself and let the black blind man harm me, what can I do? Hurry up and deal with the funeral.
The only good thing is that Yan Sanzi listened to Su Anying's words.
I went to the post office first that morning, and sent all the rest home except for the one hundred yuan I left with me to spend on the road.
The two brothers of the Yan family found the remittance certificate on their younger brother, so at least the money was not lost.
Cremation is out of fashion these days, so how do you get this corpse that is so far away?
Besides, Yan Sanzi died unexpectedly, not to mention that he couldn't get back to his hometown, even if he could get it back, he wouldn't be able to enter the ancestral grave.
As soon as the two brothers discussed it, they simply made a thin-skinned coffin here, and dug a hole in the woods to the north to bury it.
"Sigh, the old Qin family who did the damage really lacked great virtue.
What a good boy, just gone.
She said that someone encouraged her son. If you want me to say, she was the one who encouraged her. "
In the past few days, the most popular topic in Donggang is that Yan Sanzi was kicked by a black blind man, and the things about the Qin family.
Anyone who knew Mrs. Qin's character talked about it behind her back, saying that Mrs. Qin's actions were detrimental to her virtue.
"That is, if it were me, with so much money in my pocket, I wouldn't take that risk. Wouldn't it be good to bring money home and marry a wife?
This is the way to go, take your life in vain, blind in vain, a young man in his twenties. "
Others also agree, whoever thinks about it, Yan Sanzi shouldn't take this risk.
It's a pity that the person is already dead, so it's useless to say anything.
"Hey? Brother Xu, didn't you hear that the blind man was injured?
Your family's third son, didn't you say that you went up the mountain to beat the black blind man to death? " Someone thought of this and asked Xu Chenghou.
"What are you fighting for? Isn't it good to live a quiet life every day? What's the fight with black blind people?" Xu Chenghou snorted.
"Whoever wants to fight will go, we will not go."
Once this incident happened, no matter the Xu family, the Zhao family, or the old people of the Sun family and Huang family, they all strictly ordered their sons not to go up the mountain to make a fool of themselves.
No matter how valuable a black blind man is, it costs two thousand yuan at the top, and these few companies can earn it by doing a little bit of work.
This year, even selling ginseng soil, bringing in goods, and dumping ginseng seeds, each family has earned a lot.
At this time, I went up the mountain to fight the black blind man, so my mind was squeezed by the door.
If something happens to this, the family can't make it through?
The black blind man can go to beat whoever wants to. Anyway, if anyone dares to make a fool of these companies, the old men will break their son's legs.
The elders of the various families refused to let it go, and Xu Shiyan and the others didn't think so.
Only people were arranged to watch the place in shifts for a few days. When the ginseng ground was completely frozen, Zhao Jianguo and others went down the mountain with dogs and luggage.
The four dogs of the Xu family were sent back, and Xu Shiyan asked someone to find out who had such a powerful dog, and he wanted to find some dogs.
Or if someone’s **** starts to play tricks, it’s okay to let Xiaohuang or Erhei to match, and then just give his family a pup.
We all know that these dogs of the Xu family are powerful, so someone really agreed to borrow the dogs of the Xu family when the **** in spring is ready to grow.
In December, there is not much work to do in Shendi, and every household starts cat winter.
There is not much work to do in the field, and most of the workers are idle.
On the other side of the comprehensive factory, ginseng honey slices, Changbaishan red ginseng, active ginseng, etc. have all started to be packaged and shipped.
Just do these things slowly, instead of working overtime all day like before.
After discussing with several leaders of the factory, Lin Qiyue rushed to hold a year-end summary meeting for all employees on December 29th.
At the meeting, a participant made a summary of the work of the year, and also disclosed the relevant production profit report to the workers.
Everyone listened, this year, in addition to making nearly 20 million US dollars in foreign exchange this year, the domestic sales also reached 14 million.
After deducting various costs, turning over profits, etc., you can save a lot just by participating.
So every employee has a salary increase this year, and in addition to salary, each employee can also get a lot of bonuses.
Those who do well and have high yields of ginseng land can get up to two thousand yuan, and those who are slightly worse can get more than one thousand. This makes everyone very happy.
After talking about this first, Lin Qiyue brought up the matter of contracting.
Lin Qiyue obtained the contracts for the second and third participants from elsewhere, and read the contents of the contracts to everyone.
Then seek the opinions of all employees to see if a site should be contracted to the household.
After listening, everyone shook their heads.
The content of the contract, they roughly understood.
It is based on the unified leadership, unified financial management, unified planning management, unified technical management, and unified harvesting of the participants.
Sign a production responsibility system contract with capital preservation, professional contracting, independent operation, and self-responsibility for profits and losses.
Self-responsibility for profit and loss makes some people retreat.
The latter retains the identity and length of service of employees, but cancels benefits such as public injury, sick leave, and labor insurance, which is even more unacceptable to everyone.
"Secretary Lin, isn't our place fine now?
The big guys are all twisted into one rope, running forward with all their strength, why bother to contract?
I don't agree with contracting, I think it's fine. "Someone stood up and made a statement.
"That's right, Secretary Lin, we disagree with this matter.
No contracting, we all feel that it is very good now, and there is no need to contract. "The others followed suit.
"Okay, since everyone thinks the current situation is good, let's maintain the status quo.
If one day you feel that contracting is better, we will make another decision. "
Lin Qiyue and others also feel that the current situation is very good. It can not only mobilize the enthusiasm of workers, make them work harder, but also maintain the overall development of the participants, so that they will not become a mess.
As for the future, let’s talk about it when the time comes. For now, it’s good to maintain it.
Lin Qiyue asked everyone to sign a statement, and all the employees in the venue unanimously decided to maintain the current operating status and not contract for the time being.
This is for the above reply, it’s not that we don’t implement it, it’s the workers’ decision.
After signing, this item is over, and the most important thing is the finale.
There are bonuses for the selection of this year's advanced employee representatives, factory model workers, advanced teams, etc.
This was the scene everyone was looking forward to the most, and the atmosphere suddenly became lively.
Lin Qiyue took the list and read it out one by one. The workers who won the awards came to the stage beaming. There were certificates and bonuses.

chapters.title: Chapter 539: Bonus holiday
chapters.content:
Chapter 539 Bonus holiday
"Daughter-in-law, here are the bonuses and certificates that our venue gave out today, please keep them."
After the summary meeting, Xu Shiyan went home early in the afternoon.
As soon as he entered the door, he took out the money and certificates and sent them to Su Anying.
"Yo, your venue has given out prizes? Let me see what prizes are there?
Advanced worker, technology leader, model worker? That's great, there are so many of them. "
Su Anying flipped through the certificates, looked at the money, and smiled.
"Your place is rich, and I will send you so much money at the end of the year." Three and a half bundles, which is quite a lot.
"Those benefit awards with a place, and selection bonuses.
The efficiency of the site is good this year. Some workers can get 2,000 yuan just for the performance award. "
When the land is contracted in the beginning of spring, each employee has a quota base.
Participate in the production of goods in autumn, and those who exceed the quota base will have benefit bonuses.
The specific amount depends on the income of the ginseng land. Those with high yields can get nearly two thousand this time, and those who are slightly worse can get about one thousand.
The wages of the participating workers are already high, plus performance bonuses, year-end bonuses, etc., the male workers in the field can earn three to four thousand yuan a year.
This is nothing to worry about, no expenses are paid, and you get paid when you go to work, which is a net surplus.
If there are two employees in the family, and the woman works in a processing factory, a comprehensive factory, or a beverage factory, and the salary and bonus of the two are combined, then the little life can be very nourishing.
Ordinary farmers seem to have seen their income increase a lot in the past two years.
But actually do the math, tens of feet of land, the couple must be busy, and then various expenses and expenses.
The most important thing is that workers are paid well, and there are places to manage medical treatment and children's education.
Families with dual employment, children can be sent to participating nurseries from the age of three until they graduate from elementary school, without parents worrying.
Workers still retire when they get old, but how can farmers? Therefore, in the long run, it is still suitable for participating workers.
"Today's year-end summary meeting, bonuses and so on will be given out after the meeting.
Anyway, Xiaoli and the others both work as double-jobs and earn a lot of money.
Our sixth sister was also appraised as the leader of the advanced team, and also got a bonus. There are fewer fifth sisters, anyway, and they are all pretty good. "
Su Anhua married Li Chengrong during the Chinese New Year last year. She was young, and Li Chengrong had been studying in the provincial capital before, so the two discussed to have another child in two years.
Su Anhua is very capable. She was the team leader before, so she has to mention what she means.
After two years, I will mention the position of section chief before considering having children.
Anyway, I want one now, sooner or later.
Li Chengrong was obedient and obedient to his daughter-in-law. Anyway, the two of them were not in a hurry, so they never had children.
Su Anfang just gave birth to a baby in the autumn of last year, and she has returned to work this year.
A while ago, when the processing plant was at its busiest, she was the leader there, and she did a good job.
"We will have a holiday starting tomorrow, and it will be on the second day.
Xiao Li and the others said, take advantage of the few days of the holiday in the Gregorian calendar, find some time, and let's go back to our parents to get together.
The busy guys this autumn have not stopped. "Now, the four daughters of the Su family are all in Donggang, so it's quite easy to get together.
Participating in winter is not so busy, so there are more holidays.
Just in time for the Gregorian calendar year, a few days off after the bonus is paid, so that the employees can celebrate the festival happily.
"Well, okay, I've been busy this autumn, it's time to take a break."
Su Anying nodded, and gave Xu Shiyan the half bundle of money, and put the rest in the cabinet first.
"It just so happens that my son and daughter are also on winter vacation. We have plenty of time to go back to our parents' place to play for a day."
The school exam is on December 25th, and today I just go back to school to listen to the grades, take winter vacation homework and so on.
Next, there will be a two-month vacation. These brats can be full of fun again.
"Oh, yes, they're on vacation too. Huh? Where are the kids? What are you doing?"
Just now, he was too busy giving money to his wife, but he didn't pay attention to the children. It was only now that Xu Shiyan realized that none of the children were here.
"Are the children at our parents' end?"
After the beginning of winter, Xu Shiyan and his family moved back to live after all the sticks and sticks were dealt with.
The house needs to be set on fire to live in, otherwise it will be easy to suffer from frostbite. There are a lot of houses here, can’t they all be idle?
"No, they are all in Mr. Chu's house.
Isn't it a holiday? The daughter learned calligraphy and painting from Mr. Chu, and the son studied medicine from him.
The two little ones were purely bored and went to join in the fun. "Su Anying explained with a smile.
Chu Xuanhuai only sees ten people every day, and rests after seeing them.
Now that Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping are on vacation, Xu Haiyuan studies medicine with his master in the morning, and does homework in the afternoon, memorizing medical books and so on.
After Chu Xuanhuai took a lunch break, he instructed Xu Jinping in calligraphy and painting.
Chu Xuanhuai went to school and stayed abroad. He is also a person who has learned both Chinese and Western, and has a good knowledge of the past and the present.
I said before that I want to teach Xu Jinping piano, chess, calligraphy and painting. That was really not a joke, the old man is really capable.
Usually, Xu Jinping has to do her homework and help with the housework, so she doesn't have much time to study other things.
It's a holiday, and there is almost no homework for her. Apart from previewing the homework for the next semester, she has a lot of time to learn things.
This child is a fast learner and is willing to work hard to practice. Which teacher doesn’t like such a child?
Chu Xuanhuai liked Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping very much, and wished to pass on what he had learned all his life to the two students.
The old ones teach carefully, while the young ones study hard.
Anyway, with the children around, Chu Xuanhuai didn't feel lonely, and the afternoon passed quickly.
"Well, looking at it now, the two big ones are almost the same in the future, but I don't know what the two young ones can do in the future.
I saw that the two of them were not that interested in studying, Huihui was okay and could listen carefully, that Xu Haiqing, there will be headaches in the future. "
Children have different natures, and sometimes it is really impossible to generalize.
The brothers and sisters in a family always have different IQs, so we can't expect the children to be promising.
Mentioning the youngest son, Su Anying also sighed.
"That child is very worried, he doesn't care much, he doesn't care about anything, and he just eats and laughs all day long.
Ping Ping said angrily that she lost her mind when the fourth child was born. "
Xu Shiyan was amused by this sentence.
"That girl is talking every day, and her mouth is very poisonous. By the way, how about taking the exam for both elders?"
The couple chatted for a long time before Xu Shiyan remembered that he had forgotten to ask the child about his test scores.
"It's pretty good, Yuanyuan is still the first in the grade, with a perfect score in math, but the composition of Chinese seems to be a bit deducted.
Pingping is fine, double hundred, same as Xiaoyu, they are still tied for first place.
It seems that Jiang Chunhong is the third in their class, and I didn't ask after that. "
Su Anying was never worried about her child's academic performance.
As long as the two elders in his family don't go off track in the future, it should be fine.

chapters.title: Chapter 540: Company dividends
chapters.content:
Chapter 540 Company Dividends
Xu Shiyan issued a bonus certificate and had a holiday again, and the children also finished their final exams and had a holiday.
Xu Shiyan said, why don't we have something delicious at night, and ask his parents to come over and have a meal together.
So, in the evening, Su Anying made a sumptuous meal, and invited Xu Chenghou and his wife over to have a meal together.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were also very happy to learn that their son had won a certificate and a bonus.
Don't care about the bonus, it's an affirmation of Xu Shiyan's ability to work.
Xu Shiyan had nothing to do on a rare holiday, so he hugged his daughter-in-law contentedly and slept late.
Coincidentally, Xu Shiyan doesn't go to work, and New Year's Day is coming soon.
Su Anying suggested that it is better to take the opportunity to find Huang Shengli and others to go to the company for a meeting to calculate this year's accounts and dividends.
After closing the account, the dividends are distributed, and each family is happy to share the money for the New Year.
Xu Shiyan naturally doesn't care, he can do whatever he wants during the holidays, including doing some calculations.
So, Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng, Zhao Jianshe and others were called to the second floor of the shop over there.
The big guys sat down for a meeting, and Su Anying asked Ji Yufeng to read the general financial statements for this year to everyone.
This year, I made a small 200,000 yuan from a crop of ginseng, and received goods from old customers in the south.
Sanshi spent a lot of money when it opened.
The current income of restaurants and hotels, after deducting various expenses and employee wages, can barely fill in the previous pit.
So there is no profit point for participating in the market this year.
To earn this money, you have to deduct relevant taxes and fees. Fortunately, Donggang has given discounts, and the payment is not too much.
After deducting all miscellaneous and miscellaneous things, Su Anying divided more than 110,000 points, and the remaining half was shared by several other shareholders.
In addition to the company, Su Anying and Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng, and Feng Chao also counted the dividends from the farm.
The scale of the farm has now been fixed.
There are more than 80 male deer that can pick antler, and nearly a hundred male musk deer that can pick musk.
Just for these two items, there is an income of more than 300,000 yuan a year.
The rest of the sables, raccoon dogs, otters, etc. also have an income of nearly 100,000 yuan.
Of course, the cost here is higher, especially for sables and otters, the requirements for feed are too high.
"At present, the scale of our farm is already like this, and there is no way to expand it.
I discussed with Shi Yan and decided to exchange the sable, raccoon dog, and otter.
These kinds of fur animals also make money, but the cost is too high, we can't afford to raise them, but compared to deer and musk deer, the income is still a bit lower.
The sables were exchanged, and the pens were changed to deer pens and musk deer pens to expand the breeding scale of these two animals. "
This matter was decided by Xu Shiyan and Su Anying after a long time of thinking.
Xu Shiyan intends to expand the scale of deer and musk deer breeding to prepare for the future.
But the farm is so big, it is really impossible to arrange it.
Sables also make money, but they are not as worry-free as deer and musk.
Both deer and musk deer are vegetarians. They eat all kinds of branches in summer, and silage and dry feed in winter.
Sables can’t do that, they eat meat, and they need a carefully proportioned feed. Meat, eggs, milk, bone meal, etc. are indispensable.
In order to raise sables, you have to raise sheep, chickens and geese. The pens for these animals alone take up a lot of land, which is really too troublesome.
It is better to sell these, concentrate on breeding deer and musk deer, and develop deer products at the same time.
"Third brother and third sister-in-law, you two can decide on this matter, we have no objection."
When the farm was first built, Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng, and Feng Chao all invested some money and contributed.
So the farms also have their shares, not many, only 30%.
The operation and management of the farm is in the hands of Su Anying, and the others just receive dividends and do not participate in decision-making.
Su Anying nodded, "Then it's settled.
Many people have inquired and wanted to buy these days, so I wrote back to them and tried to sell the sables, raccoon dogs, otters, and those sheep, chickens and geese before the beginning of spring.
When the weather gets warmer next year, the pens will be rebuilt to expand the breeding of deer and musk deer. "
This is to develop from large and comprehensive to specialized, concentrate on developing the medicinal animal industry, and prepare for the next industry development.
On the farm side, after deducting various expenses and so on, Xu Shiyan and his wife shared another one hundred thousand.
That is to say, this year, not counting the income from participating in the land, not counting Xu Shiyan's salary, the company and the farm alone, Xu Shiyan and his wife have earned more than 200,000 yuan.
When the hotels and restaurants in the ginseng market are profitable next year, and the ginseng seeds are sold, there will be a lot of profits.
Although Huang Shengli and the others didn't get much, they were content.
It wasn't Xu Shiyan and his wife who brought them, what could they do?
It is estimated that it means planting thirty to fifty feet of sticks a year, and working hard in the field all day long. It is good to have 18,000 left all year round.
How is it like now? There are two or three hundred feet of sticks in the ground, and there are thousands of feet of ginseng seeds at the other end.
Not counting the production in the own land, the dividends alone are tens of thousands a year.
There are still hundreds of thousands of deposits in the bank, and the interest is not much a year.
Such a good day is all enjoyed by Xu Shiyan and his wife, so how can you not be satisfied?
Anyway, no matter what they do in the future, they just follow Xu Shiyan and his wife unswervingly.
After the accounts were settled, each family confirmed the dividends, and each received their own share of the money, all of which were beautiful.
Then Su Anying said, since the year-end dividends have been distributed, and everyone’s income is good this year, why not get together at night to have fun.
This time, I don’t need to go to anyone’s house to do some work. If there is a restaurant, I can book a few tables directly at the restaurant.
Every family calls their wives and children, and they get together to have a small New Year's banquet.
It’s still a company anyway, and it’s been a busy year, so let’s celebrate at the end of the year.
When the company grows bigger in the future, it will have to hold a New Year celebration in a serious way.
Naturally, no one objected to this proposal.
So Su Anying told the other side of the hotel to prepare a few more tables, and even the staff of the hotel and restaurant would have fun together at night.
After all, it’s been a hard autumn, so relax
Just like that, four or five tables were arranged at the hotel in the evening, and each family brought their wives and children.
But the elders didn't come, saying that this kind of occasion was too noisy and they couldn't bear it.
If they want to get together, they can find a chance by themselves, and a few old men and women can get some food and sit comfortably on the kang to chat.
If the elders don’t come, don’t come. You can’t force this. If the elders come, the younger ones won’t let them go either.
As soon as the children arrived here, they had fun and ran around. Anyway, the restaurant is a big place and it is our own. No one cares about what the children like to do.
All kinds of delicious food are prepared on the table over there, such as fruits, cakes, biscuits, melon seeds and candies. The children can take whatever they like.
You are not allowed to control the children today, let the children be happy.
Now, Xu Haiqing caught him, and he didn't go anywhere else, just wandered around the tables where the delicious food was placed, and stuffed it into his mouth when he saw something.
Xu Haiqing was small and greedy. He stuffed his mouth, and his cheeks bulged up, just like that chipmunk.
"Eat, eat, eat, you know how to eat, and you don't have a different mind every day. You are reincarnated from a pig."
Over there, Xu Jinping saw his younger brother's virtue and couldn't help but want to teach him a lesson.

chapters.title: Chapter 541: Fun facts about Shanhuozhuang
chapters.content:
Chapter 541 Interesting facts about Shanhuozhuang
December 30th, the company settled the profit and dividends, and everyone had dinner in the evening.
December 31st happened to be when Su Weizhong was off duty.
Sisters Su Anying brought their husbands and children back to their natal home for reunion.
Now the Su family has six daughters, four of them are in Donggang, and the four sisters bring their husbands and children back. There are more than a dozen people.
The three rooms in the Su family are not big, and there are only two elderly people in normal life. Han Cai'e always said that the house is empty.
Now that the daughter, aunt, grandson and grandson come back, they feel that the room is full all of a sudden.
The children chattered around grandma and grandpa, making Su Weizhong and Han Cai'e happy, I don't know what to do.
"Hurry up, take out some delicious food for the children.
Well, what else is there at home? Cook something good for lunch. "
Su Anying and the others were afraid that their parents would spend money, so they didn't say hello to the family in advance. They all came back unexpectedly, and Su Weizhong and his wife were not prepared at all.
Su Weizhong hurriedly told his wife to ask her to prepare some meals or something.
"Look, you didn't say anything in advance when you came back, so at least let your mother buy some meat."
"Father, mother, you don't need to prepare anything, we brought them all back.
It’s enough for us sisters to cook for a while, let mother rest quickly.
This autumn also made my mother very tired, helping us to make goods and picking seeds, and helping the fourth child to look after the children.
Today, the two elders don’t need to worry about anything, we will do it. "
Han Caie was about to put on her shoes and go to the ground when she was held down by several daughters.
The daughters were filial and refused to let Han Cai'e go to the ground, so Han Cai'e did not insist.
Only holding Li Jiarui, the son of the fifth son of Su Anfang's family, playing with the little baby.
Li Jiarui was born last autumn, and now he is more than one year old. The little guy has a tiger head and a tiger brain, which is very interesting and rare.
Han Cai'e hugs her grandson and doesn't let go.
The three boys, Xu Haiyuan, Xu Haiqing, and Ji Hongliang, were not interested in their little cousin, so they ran away to play.
On the other hand, Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui are both very curious about this little cousin who looks like white dough.
Xu and Su, the only ones who are younger than Xu Jinhui are Nan Xiaoliang, the second child of Su Anzhen's family, and Li Jiarui.
Nan Xiaoliang is in Daying, far away, and we can only see each other once after Chinese New Year.
It's rare for Xu Jinhui to see a baby younger than her, let alone the rarity.
Xu Jinhui touched her cousin's fleshy little hand, and couldn't help kissing her.
"Sister, look at how playful his hands are, they are soft and fleshy."
"You were like this when you were young, so chubby and cute."
Xu Jinping just laughed. In her eyes, her sister is not very big.
Xu Jinhui was a little embarrassed by her sister's praise, her big eyes flashed suddenly.
"It's still fun to be a little brother."
Xu Haiyuan led his younger brother to play with his cousin, and sister Xu Jinping coaxed the younger cousin, just when the adults could spare time to chat.
Han Cai'e glanced at Su Anhua. This girl has been married for almost a year, and her stomach hasn't moved yet. She is really worried.
Han Caie couldn't speak in front of so many people.
I have already made up my mind, I have to talk to my daughter about it when I find a chance later.
How can anyone get married without having children?
Uncle is the youngest child in the Li family. The in-laws have already embraced their grandchildren.
What you should want and what you need, have a child early, take care of you early, and let go when you are older.
If it is too late, it is dangerous to have children at an advanced age.
Su Anhua naturally didn't know what her mother was thinking, she was chatting with her sisters.
This autumn is busy, even though Su Anhua and Su Anfang are both participating, and they live not too far away, it is true that there are not many opportunities to meet.
I was so busy day by day, I went to work all day long with my eyes open, worked overtime until dark, and when I got home tired, I wanted to lie down and go to sleep.
How can I have the time to chat with my sister?
It’s like this in one unit, let alone other people, I really haven’t seen it for some time.
"Fourth sister, how are you and fourth brother-in-law doing?" Su Anhua was most concerned about Su Anfen.
After all, among the sisters, the worst life today is the fourth sister's family.
"It's okay, it's good.
The second sister’s Shanhuozhuang store originally thought that it opened late and there would not be much business this year. I didn’t expect those old customers from the south to order a lot of goods.
Your brother-in-law is driving a car, going around to small villages to collect all kinds of mountain goods.
According to the requirements of other old customers, I pack and ship by category.
Even though it opened late this year, it is not too late. The business in the store is also OK. "
Speaking of Shanhuozhuang, Su Anfen has become more energetic.
Although the couple came late, but Ji Tongzhong did not make a lot of purchases this autumn, and the business in the store was still good.
At the beginning, Xu Shiyan and Ji Tongzhong made an agreement to give Kai a guaranteed minimum salary and a commission for selling the goods.
A couple of days ago, the couple calculated that the two of them were busy this autumn, and they could earn around 2,000 yuan, which was much better than farming at home.
Moreover, Ji Tongzhong is quite satisfied with the business of collecting mountain goods, and he happily goes out to collect mountain goods all day long.
The couple have discussed it, and they will go back and plant the land when things will be less in the next spring.
Ji Tongzhong has time to go back to tend the land, and his parents can help.
The couple worked hard to earn money, and after fighting for two years, they moved to Donggang.
"You don't know, the second sister's house is not growing well this year, how big are the sticks? The second sister has left more than ten sticks to make wine.
After the opening of Shanhuozhuang, I specially bought glass bottles and put those sticks in the store to look good.
As a result, it was favored by old customers in the south, and they insisted on buying it. The biggest one sold for more than 500 yuan. "
Su Anfen talked about the store opening with a smile on her face.
"A ginseng is worth hundreds of dollars? My God, isn't it too expensive?"
Su Anhua and Su Anfang couldn't help being amazed when they heard this.
"That tree weighs half a pound, and was originally intended to be kept for our father.
It turned out to be attractive to others, and they had to buy it for life and death, and had no choice but to sell it. "Su Anying smiled.
"If I hadn't stopped me later, those ginseng trees would have been bought away.
At any rate, it was left as a tree for our father. It is a little small, only about three or two, but the shape is quite beautiful. "
Fresh ginseng infused wine is so popular, which gave Su Anying another idea.
Next year, you can try to save some fresh ginseng wine.
Especially for the big ones, it’s troublesome to make red ones, and if you don’t make it right, you’ll be beaten. It’s better to keep the wine, and the selling price is also high.
"No matter what you say, it's the second sister and the second brother-in-law who can handle the stick. For ordinary people, where can I find a stick that weighs half a catty?"
Su Anhua has been working in the field for several years, and she knows a little about these things. She is so big in the field, and she has never heard of a few half-pound mallets.
"Well, your brother-in-law said that in the future, we will specialize in the development of large goods, which will make more money."
The couple also discussed about the future development of Shendi.
Su Anying wants to develop ginseng on a large scale. Taking advantage of the current conditions, it is better to plant thousands of feet. After three years, the goods can be sold for a lot of money.
But Xu Shiyan disagreed, and he still insisted on taking the boutique route.
There are too many things to talk about, and it’s useless to expect to hire someone to do the work. No matter how hard you hire someone, you can’t compare with your own staff.
Xu Shiyan said that he will plant a hundred feet a year, and in the future he will develop into large-scale products and make high-quality products among high-quality products.
If it is done well, it will make more money than a thousand feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 542: Help Ji Tongzhong
chapters.content:
Chapter 542 Advice to Ji Tongzhong
As for the development direction of the family, Xu Shiyan has always been in control, and Su Anying is only the specific executor.
Since Xu Shiyan decided to take the boutique route, Su Anying has nothing to say, just follow through.
If you really want to make a thousand feet or two thousand feet, let alone other things, it will be very troublesome to make goods in autumn, and you will be too busy.
"Well, the cost of large-scale products is a bit high, but if they are planted well, they will indeed pay for it."
Sisters Su Anhua are all married to the venue, so they understand more or less, so they all nodded.
Han Cai'e sat next to the daughters. She didn't understand what the daughters said, and she simply didn't mix it up. She just focused on teasing her little grandson.
On the other end, Su Weizhong listened to the four sons-in-law discussing the future development direction of the mallet.
Ji Tongzhong looked at the value of the stick, and also wanted to plant some sticks with Xu Shiyan.
"Xiao Ji, it's not that my brother-in-law is stingy and doesn't want to take you with me. You'd better not think about it in the past few years.
Nowadays, the price of sticks is so high, and ginseng soil, ginseng seeds, and ginseng seeds are all quite expensive.
You have no foundation at all. You are just starting now. If you keep investing money in it, it will take three years before you start to pay back.
Who knows what will happen in three years? It’s okay if the market is good, and you can earn some money, but what if the market is not good?
A large sum of money has been invested, and if you don’t earn, you will be compensated. Don’t you regret it to death? "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, the past few years are no longer suitable for beginners to develop clubs.
Plant in the field next year, and start making goods in 1990, just in time for the years when the market was bad. Isn't that just waiting to lose money?
Xu Shiyan and the others develop sticks. They don’t spend money on ginseng soil or ginseng seeds. No matter how much they sell, they make money.
Even so, Xu Shiyan didn't let Huang Shengli and the others develop more, one hundred feet a year.
Ji Tongzhong is different from them. If he planted ginseng, invested too much money in the early stage, and sold the goods just in time for the bad business, that would not work.
"Xiao Ji, you just listen to me, make some wild things first.
Next year spring will begin, you should go home to plant the land, and then go back to plant, and the land will just catch up with the cattle.
Let me tell you, the price of Niu Mao Guang has been rising all the way in the past two years.
Our family has a car, and you drive to those forest farms and villages near the protected area, such as Shengli, Shuguang, Dajian Field, Qianchuan, and Ma'anshan to receive goods.
Go back to Fusong to sell, and you can make a lot of money in the middle. "
Xu Shiyan knew that Ji Tongzhong would not give up unless he showed him a way, so he gave advice to his brother-in-law.
"If you can bear hardships, you can drive people into the mountains with a car, whether it is to Jinbei or Dashahe, where there are many cattle and hair.
One person collects a little fare, and you follow into the forest to collect some more.
You are busy on the mountain, and the fourth younger sister is at home watching the cow hair grow and dry, and this season is actually a lot of money. "
In this year, there are actually quite a lot of opportunities to make money.
Especially if they have a car now, this is the most favorable condition, and they can really make money by doing anything.
It’s not a big deal to be rich, but it’s okay to live a life, and you can earn more from storage than from farming.
Ji Tongzhong immediately became happy when he heard what his brother-in-law said.
"Oh, it has to be my second brother-in-law, it's amazing.
That's fine, then I won't plant ginseng, and listen to my second brother-in-law, and make a fool of myself. "
Ji Tongzhong is such a person, with soft ears and no idea, listening to the wind is rain, so there must be someone behind the helm to direct the direction.
"Fourth brother-in-law, you see that the second brother-in-law has already suggested tricks for you, so just listen to him.
We all know how the second brother-in-law is. Whatever he asks you to do must be for your own good. "
Over there, Li Zongliang and Li Chengrong both nodded in agreement.
They all felt that Xu Shiyan had a good idea.
Even if they had jobs, they were too busy at that time, otherwise, they would have gone to collect money.
Both brother-in-laws said the same thing, so why would Ji Tongzhong have any concerns? Then why don't you nod your head immediately?
Su Weizhong couldn't understand what the aunts were talking about. Anyway, he just listened with a smile, regardless of whether he understood or not.
Su Weizhong looked at these uncles, and the more he looked at them, the rarer they became, and the more he looked at them, the more pleasing to the eye.
These daughters are all married well, and they all live a good life.
Needless to say, Xu Shiyan and his wife are developing better and better.
Xu Shiyan is the deputy head of the field, and he already has the meaning of second in command. Lin Qiyue always consults with him on big and small matters in the field.
Everyone said behind their backs that maybe in a few years, if Lin Qiyue was promoted, Xu Shiyan would be able to be promoted to the secretary.
Su Anying is not bad either. She runs a company and a breeding farm, and has grown so many ginseng fields on the mountain, earning hundreds of thousands of dollars a year.
The couple went hand in hand and worked hard together, and that little life was prosperous, no one else could compare.
The key is that the children are also up to the challenge, and both of them have very good grades in school.
The two younger ones haven't gone to school yet, but they are both obedient and sensible, and they will be the same in the future.
Originally, Su Weizhong was most worried about the fourth and fourth couples, but the key was that Ji Tongzhong was too stingy, and he couldn't afford the work in the crop yard, pure seedlings.
But since Xu Shiyan and his wife brought the fourth wife to Donggang and asked them to help manage Shanhuozhuang, the fourth son-in-law has become more and more formal.
I heard that the couple did not lose money this fall, which is good.
As long as the fourth son-in-law is willing to work steadily, with the second son-in-law at the helm to help, the life of the fourth son-in-law will be no different.
As for the fifth and sixth families, there is nothing to worry about.
The couple are both participating employees, receiving a fixed salary, and a bonus at the end of the year, how nice?
The only worrying thing is the sixth child, who has been married for almost a year and has no children yet.
Su Weizhong decided to let the old wife find a chance to talk about the sixth girl later, that would not work.
Work is important, but family cannot be ignored.
Sisters Su Anying chatted for a while, and seeing that it was getting late, they went to cook.
They brought back a lot of food, including chicken, duck, fish, and some cooked food.
So this meal was not difficult, and it was made quickly.
At noon, everyone had a meal at Su's house. The four uncles got together and had to drink something.
Ji Tongzhong and Li Zongliang kept toasting Xu Shiyan's wine. In the end, Xu Shiyan drank a little too much.
Fortunately, Xu's house is not far from Su's house, only three or four hundred meters away. Su Anying supported her husband and wobbled home.
"You, you drank a lot last night, and you drank again today.
Don’t you know how capable you are? What a healthy body, just drink like this all day long? "
Outside, it's not easy for Su Anying to criticize her own man in front of others.
Back home, she couldn't help it anymore, and helped Xu Shiyan take off his coat, hat, and shoes while nagging.
Relying on the strength of his wine, Xu Shiyan hugged Su Anying into his arms, and kissed his daughter-in-law on the cheek.
"Isn't this happy?
Look, our family has made so much money this year, the parents on both sides are in good health, and the children are obedient and sensible.
The life of our family is getting better every year, who is not happy? "
Su Anying was left speechless by all kinds of troubles from her husband, "Relax, in front of the children, you can save some face."
The children are at home, how bad is it for them to see?
At this time, Xu Haiyuan, who was about to go to the east room outside, saw this, and immediately turned around and covered the eyes of his younger siblings.
"Let's go, let's go to Shigong's house."

chapters.title: Chapter 543: greenhouse
chapters.content:
Chapter 543 Greenhouse
Eyes closed and then opened, it was already New Year's Day in 1987.
Xu Shiyan went out to study for two years, but he couldn't spend New Year's Day at home. This year he finally stayed at home, so of course he had to go to accompany his parents.
According to the Xu family's custom, dumplings must be made every new year and festival.
Of course, this time there are not only dumplings, but also eight dishes.
The whole family sat around the table, the table was full of delicious food, and the reunion was lively and lively. New Year's Day.
Sanchang went to work on the 3rd, and on the 2nd, Xu Shiyan and his wife went to the farm for a tour.
Aren't they going to exchange the sables? I just figured out how to plan the vacated space and make effective use of that land.
The two wandered around the farm for a long time, and drew a picture when they came back to re-plan the farm.
The holiday is over, and No. 3 Xu Shiyan returns to work normally.
As a result, as soon as he arrived at the field department, Lin Qiyue called him to the office.
"Well, Secretary Guan is going to be transferred to the city, do you know?"
As soon as they met, Lin Qiyue broke the big news.
"Huh? Secretary Guan is going to be transferred? I didn't hear that.
It's good to be transferred to the city. This is considered a high promotion. We must be happy for Secretary Guan. "
Xu Shiyan said this on his lips, but in his heart he was thinking about it.
Secretary Guan fully supports Yi Zhan and the development of Donggang. If this person is changed, will the relevant policies change?
Obviously, Lin Qiyue was also worried about this issue.
"That's true, we should be happy for Secretary Guan.
But here we are participating, I am just worried, will the newcomers think of us? "
The two looked at each other and sighed.
They are not afraid of doing work. They do things in a down-to-earth manner. They are dedicated to the development of the site and the welfare of the employees. These are what they should do.
But it’s just like being afraid, the wind direction above is always changing.
Secretary Guan devoted himself to developing the local economy and cared a lot for the participants.
The first participation is a critical period of development. At this time, the secretary in charge is gone. If someone else comes up who doesn't like the first participation, then things will be difficult to handle.
"Why don't we go to the county to meet Secretary Guan and find out?"
Xu Shiyan is also a little fuzzy. His wife still has a lot of business.
If the wind direction changes, things will be serious.
"I came to you for this matter.
We can't go empty-handed, but we don't know what is appropriate to give something.
Can you give me an idea, what should we bring, which can neither cause trouble for Secretary Guan, but also let others know that we are not just dealing with it casually? "
Lin Qiyue is in such a panic, he can't give it too expensive, and people will say that there is something shady about it.
Guan Enxue is just about to rise, once people get caught, it will harm Guan Enxue.
But if you want to send ordinary things, such as snacks, canned food, etc., I feel that I can’t afford it.
"Secretary Lin, I have an idea, can you listen to it?" Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it.
"Didn't there used to be two flower sheds on the side of my farm? Ever since Clivia was sold, that side has been empty.
My daughter-in-law said it was a pity that the flower shed was empty, so she changed it. I asked them to grow edible fungi and wild vegetables in the flower shed. "
The two warm sheds cost a lot of money at the time. After the Clivia was sold, they have been idle and are not willing to dismantle them, and they have not put anything in them.
Last winter, Xu Shian led people to plant some cucumbers, eggplants, peppers and the like in the greenhouse.
In winter, how can there be bees and butterflies pollinating, how can artificial pollination be done? So that batch of vegetables was considered in vain, and nothing came out.
This year Xu Shiyan said, don’t mess with those, isn’t it good to get some fungus bags to grow elm yellow mushrooms?
There are all kinds of bacteria in the Shenchang Technology Department, and sawdust is easy to find now.
All the mushrooms came out a few years ago, so we can have more dishes during the Chinese New Year.
In addition to the yellow elm mushroom, there are also some thorny shoots on the other end.
After winter, the Forestry Bureau began to cut clear forests, and there was a large logging area near the machine repair factory.
Xu Shiyan told Li Erniu to ask them to do a favor and go to the logging side to pick up some sticks that **** the young shoots and come back.
Newly cut thorn bud sticks, planted in the soil to give sufficient water and maintain a certain temperature, although they cannot take root, they can urge sprouts.
Originally, Xu Shiyan meant to keep it for the New Year.
It's not easy to see a little green in this world of ice and snow, let alone thorn buds, which are definitely rare.
It would be very beautiful if there was an extra plate of prickly sprouts on the Chinese New Year's dinner table.
Not to mention visiting relatives and friends, if someone gives someone two catties of fresh thorn sprouts, it is probably more enjoyable than giving ten catties of meat.
However, when they went to the farm yesterday, they saw some thorny buds sprouting early, and the buds are now more than two inches long.
Chinese New Year is a little earlier this year, New Year’s Eve on January 28th, by then, I’m afraid it will be too long.
Xu Shiyan still wants to say, if it doesn't work, the first crop will be picked in a few days.
It’s fine to keep it at home, give it away when it’s time to give it away, don’t wait for it to be a pity when you get old.
