Since you are going to see the secretary, it is not good to bring anything else, why not this home-grown mushroom and wild vegetable, no matter who knows it, you can’t find fault with it.
how? When relatives and friends walk around, they still like that little thing, so why not bring some food? How can there be such a wide tube?
"Coincidentally, I went to see it yesterday, and a small part of the yellow elm mushroom can be picked, and some of the thorn buds can also be picked.
There are also some ground fruits, which are also red.
We might as well bring some homemade things. Secretary Lin, what do you think? "
Diguoer is also a local dialect, but it is actually a strawberry.
There are no varieties of milk strawberries this year, but there is a kind called Yueyue fruit, also called Siji strawberry, which can produce many stubbles a year.
There are a lot of fruits on the other side of the farm. When Xu Shiyan went to look at them yesterday, some fruits were ripe, and the red ones were very beautiful.
It doesn’t matter whether something is high or low, but the heart is the key. When the heart comes, it’s enough for the other party to appreciate it.
It is not rare for people to give away those canned snacks, cigarettes and alcohol, and they don’t know who they are when they turn around.
"Oh, that's great, or else you just have ideas, one idea after another.
Success, then follow what you said, when shall we go? "
Lin Qiyue slapped the table and stood up, as if impatient to leave.
"Now go to the farm, pick up the box and go."
Xu Shiyan understood Lin Qiyue's thoughts, and to be honest, he was also a little anxious.
If this matter goes wrong, it will affect the subsequent development, and no one will be anxious.
"It is estimated that we will be able to reach the county before we get off work at noon."
When Lin Qiyue heard this, what else was he thinking about? Hurry up.
So they hurriedly asked someone to find some cardboard boxes, and the two of them took a car and went straight to the farm.
The two flower sheds in the breeding farm are not small, but they could hold nearly ten thousand pots of Clivia.
Now one of the tops is covered with grass curtains and other shades to keep warm. There are many shelves inside, and there are mushroom bags one by one on the shelves.
At this time, the first batch of yellow elm mushrooms have grown well, and the bright yellow mushrooms are like naughty babies showing their small heads.
As soon as you enter the shed, you will smell the aroma of mushrooms.

chapters.title: Chapter 544: new stuff
chapters.content:
Chapter 544 Fresh stuff
Another shed split in two.
There is also a shelf on one side, and there are long wooden slots on the top of the shelf.
Strawberries are grown in the wooden troughs. Now some fruits are ripe, and they are hung outside the troughs.
The bright red fruits are very rare to look at.
The other side of the shed is also a wooden trough, but it can be wider and higher.
Inside the trough, there are densely packed thorn buds.
At this moment, most of the thorny shoots have germinated, and a bud bulged out of it.
Some may have sprouted early, and now they are almost half-pressed, which is a good time to eat thorny shoots.
"Okay, you can really think about it, these things are really rare in winter."
Lin Qiyue visited the next two flower sheds, and it was too rare for him.
"Hey, do you think this thing can be mass-produced?
Our participating workers have nothing to do in winter, why don't we try some of these things? "
Lin Qiyue looked at the purple-red thorny buds in front of him, and was really hungry.
"At present, mushrooms can be used, and the technology is fully mature.
It’s time to harvest vegetables in winter. If we build a greenhouse to grow mushrooms, it’s really feasible to go on the market during the New Year’s Day and Spring Festival. "
Xu Shiyan pondered for a moment and said.
"It's not easy to get thorny shoots. I picked them up directly from the cutting area. After this crop of buds, the pole will be useless."
These thorn buds were cut off when clearing the forest. They have no roots, and it seems that these things cannot be cut and survived.
The current method is actually the same as buying a few flower buds home and inserting them in water to let the flowers bloom. After the flowers bloom, it will be useless.
"If there is any way, we can artificially plant it, maybe it will work.
However, the cost of this thing is high, and it will be released in winter, and I think it is enough for ordinary people to accept. "
Thirty years later, the thorn buds can be sold for thirty or forty yuan a catty when they are in season.
At that time, people all realized the value of this wild vegetable.
Now, it doesn’t feel very good, it’s too expensive, and most people are reluctant to buy it.
Lin Qiyue nodded, "Okay, let's discuss this stuff later.
Come on, pick it up quickly, don't waste time. "
These can be discussed in the future, and it is important to go to the county right now.
Lin Qiyue, Xu Shiyan, and the driver hurried to do it.
There is not so much work on the farm in winter, and the workers are also idle. Everyone came to help, and now they picked everything that could be picked.
"Oh, is this too much for us? How can Secretary Guan's family eat it all?"
After waiting for all the picking, Lin Qiyue was dumbfounded.
These people work really hard, my good guy, there are more than a dozen boxes on the ground, all of them are full.
It seems that they only brought two or three. Where did they come from?
"It doesn't matter, let's send some to Magistrate Chang and Deputy Magistrate Jiang.
This can be regarded as a small experiment of using the slack time to generate income in winter. Let the leaders have a look at the results of the experiment, right? "
Xu Shiyan had a quick idea and thought of it immediately.
It's not good to send it to one person alone. After making so many left and right, it's better to send it over.
The people in the leadership office share a little bit, and they all try something new.
Maybe from here, you can really make some money, isn't it a good thing?
Coincidentally, they also have an excuse, or what else are they going to talk about?
Reporting? Or just be inquisitive? Is that plausible?
"Yes, yes, makes sense."
How can someone as smart as Lin Qiyue not understand? He immediately understood what Xu Shiyan said.
These things just gave them the best excuse to go to the county. "Get in the car, let's go."
Just like that, all the boxes were placed on the rear seats of the two jeeps.
Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan both sat in the co-pilot, and the driver drove.
Nowadays, no one cares about the mixed load of passengers and goods, anyway, they just run all the way to the county.
The roads are slippery in winter, and the jeep is fairly fast. It’s almost eleven o’clock in the county, not far from get off work.
Lin Qiyue didn't care about that, the car parked outside the office building, got out of the car and asked the driver to go with him, moved the boxes and walked inside.
"Hey? What are you doing? What are you trying to force your way in?"
When the doorman saw this, he rushed forward to stop him.
"One of the participants in Donggang, the new product test was successful, and samples were sent to the leaders. What's wrong? No way?"
Lin Qiyue was anxious, so he didn't care about those things. He glared at the guard and continued walking in.
Everyone who looks at the gate has a little sharp eyesight, and when they hear that they are from the same field, their attitude changes immediately.
"Yo, it's a leader who participated in the field.
That, which leader do you want to send it to? So many, let me help too. "
The guard saw that the four people were carrying two boxes each, and there seemed to be some more in the car, so they hurried over and helped carry the two boxes down.
"Let's find Secretary Guan, has he come to work?" Lin Qiyue didn't hesitate to share his knowledge with the other party, and only said who to find.
"Come here, Secretary Guan is busy these days, and he will go to the city after the next year."
The doorman held the two suitcases, closed the car door, and led Lin Qiyue and his party to head upstairs to Guan Enxue's office.
It was not far from getting off work, and Guan Enxue was too tired to deal with the documents all morning, so he just sat down to rest.
Hearing the knock on the door, he answered casually, "Come in."
As a result, Lin Qiyue came in with two cardboard boxes, followed by Xu Shiyan and others.
Guan Enxue was stunned for a while, "What are you two doing? Delivering goods to me?
It’s just after the festival, what are you two doing in the county? "
In fact, Guan Enxue knew in his heart that these two people must have come to ask him about something.
But on the bright side, he still has to ask.
"Secretary Guan, that's what happened.
What about Xiao Xu, who has nothing to do and planted some mushrooms and wild vegetables in the greenhouse.
Isn't this just the first harvest? Sent something new to the leaders. By the way, I would like to ask the leaders, is there any development value for this thing? "
On the way, Lin Qiyue had already figured out what to say, and had a ready-made excuse, which happened to be embarrassing to no one.
Guan Enxue became energetic when he heard this. "Oh? Mushrooms and wild vegetables in winter? Come on, open it for me to see?"
At this time, greenhouse vegetables have not yet developed.
In addition to radish, cabbage, potatoes, pickles and sauerkraut, what can be eaten in winter in the north is tofu, bean sprouts and the like.
There are hard-working people who put some soil at home in winter and send out garlic sprouts, leeks, green onions and the like.
So when Guan Enxue heard that there were mushrooms and wild vegetables, he also found them fresh and curious, so he couldn't wait to ask someone to open the cardboard box.
Xu Shiyan signaled the driver to put the boxes on the ground and asked them to go down again and bring up the remaining two boxes in the car.
Here, Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan opened the boxes one by one.
Guan Enxue took a look inside the box, there were bright yellow and light yellow mushrooms, slightly green thorn buds in purple red, and bright red fruits in a small box over there, and his eyes were full of surprises.
"Hey, there are ground fruits here, so fresh."

chapters.title: Chapter 545: early adopters
chapters.content:
Chapter 545 Early adopters
"Well, let alone, it's delicious. It's sweeter than the one we eat in summer."
Guan Enxue saw that the fruit was very good, couldn't help but pinched two of them and put them in his mouth to eat, nodding while eating.
"It's delicious, and you can still have ground fruits to eat at this time, you are really good."
"The previous flower shed is useless to keep, and I am reluctant to tear it down, and the big guys are just doing nothing." Xu Shiyan explained with a smile.
"That fruit is in the shed and has not been drenched by rain, so it is a little sweeter than summer ones."
Guan Enxue nodded, "Very good, young people just have ideas.
That little Wu, share these things and leave a portion for me.
Send the rest to County Magistrate Chang, Deputy County Magistrate Jiang, and Minister Yuan, so that everyone can follow suit. "
There are a dozen cardboard boxes on the ground, none of which are too big.
Among them, there are four boxes of thorn buds, two boxes of strawberries, and the rest are elm yellow mushrooms.
With so many things, how could Guan Enxue keep them all by himself? Then those people in the office can share some.
Secretary Xiao Wu hurried over and put all the boxes on the ground together.
He knew roughly how many parts to divide, so he separated the things very quickly.
The strawberries were packed in a small box and put in a cardboard box, which is convenient.
Xiao Wu called someone to help him send the things to the offices of those who are in charge of the En theory.
I will get off work at noon soon, and everyone is free at the moment.
Seeing the fresh mushrooms, thorny shoots, and ground fruits, everyone else was surprised.
"Hey, old man, where did you get these things? Elm yellow mushrooms, thorny shoots, and ground fruits?
This winter, it's freezing and snowy outside, how did you make it happen? "
Seeing that it’s time to get off work, I couldn’t sit still, but when I saw these new things again, everyone was curious.
Thus, seven or eight main leaders all came to Guan Enxue.
There were also sharp-eyed people who saw Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan next to them.
"Couldn't it be that deputy director Xu came up with a whim again?"
Jiang Yunfeng knew Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue better. In his opinion, this matter must have something to do with Xu Shiyan.
"Xiao Jiang is still smart, it was Xiao Xu who poked it out.
This is the first crop, and it is said that it is to show the results, so that we can all follow along and try something new. " Guan Enxue laughed when he heard that.
Just now he wanted to call people over directly, but he felt that it was not appropriate, so he asked people to deliver the things first.
These people must be curious and come to inquire after seeing something, so that Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan can show their faces in front of them.
"Originally, the leaders should be invited to my flower shed for a field visit.
I thought that all the leaders are very busy, and this is only in the experimental stage, so it is not good to disturb the leaders.
So I discussed with our Secretary Lin, why not come to the county with your things, and ask the leaders to give their opinions and check it out.
In the future, can we develop in these areas? Turn winter slack into winter busy? "
Xu Shiyan followed Lin Qiyue, came forward to shake hands with a few people, and then explained with a smile.
"You are already busy enough to participate, what's the matter? You want to be more busy? Are you busy participating?
Besides, you, deputy director Xu, still care about this small amount of money? "
Before Guan Enxue could speak, someone said this.
It was originally a harmonious and lively atmosphere, but as soon as this sentence came out, the expressions on everyone's faces froze.
"You can't say that, I'm busy in the venue, but not in other places.
Xiao Xu’s side is just a preliminary idea now, mainly to let us help judge whether it is worthwhile to make vegetables in greenhouses in winter? Right? "
Guan Enxue saw that Xu Shiyan wanted to speak, so he waved to him, signaling Xu Shiyan to stay calm.
"Yes, this is something I came up with on a whim. I really don't know what to do, so I want to ask the leaders."
Xu Shiyan's level is not high enough, so naturally he can't stand up to others in this situation.
Anyway, there is Guan Enxue, Xu Shiyan only needs to answer well.
"Well, well, the idea is good, and the starting point is also for the convenience of the common people.
However, for this specific matter, it is estimated that I have to discuss it carefully with the people in the agricultural port.
But I think it is feasible, and this matter can be studied slowly. "
Guan Enxue actually knew in his heart that Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan definitely didn't come for this.
Besides, at this time, it is impossible to hold a meeting in his office to discuss this matter.
"I see it like this, seeing that it's almost noon when I get off work, and I happen to take those mushrooms home.
Try it with your family, let's try the taste of the food from this greenhouse first.
If yes, discuss feasibility next.
After all, this matter is also related to the food basket of the common people, what if it really happens? Right? "
Seeing that it was time to get off work, Guan Enxue knew that Lin Qiyue and the others were coming, so he must have something to discuss with him.
So I wanted to take advantage of the noon time to have a good chat with Lin Qiyue.
There is no one in this room who is stupid, how can people not see it?
"Yes, yes, it's getting late, so I quickly packed up and got off work and went home.
I can add two dishes at noon today. That box of ground fruit is just for my two children to taste. "
Jiang Yunfeng looked at his watch, then nodded to Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan with a smile, and went out first.
Others turned around and walked out when they saw it.
Chang Hongfa seemed to have something to say, but fell behind. At this time, Guan Enxue called him.
"Old Chang, why don't you go to my place for lunch today, let your sister-in-law make some good dishes, how about it?"
Chang Hongfa was waiting for this sentence, so he stopped immediately.
"Okay, ouch, I haven't tasted my sister-in-law's cooking for a long time, and it just so happens that there are two more dishes for lunch today."
Chang Hongfa was not polite and stayed directly.
"Xiao Lin and Xiao Xu, we will be together at noon today, come home with me for a meal.
It's rare for you two to come to the county once, so why can't you go back on an empty stomach. "
Guan Enxue followed suit and called Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan.
The leaders have stepped up. If Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan don't understand, then they are fools? The two nodded immediately.
"That's so embarrassing, isn't this troublesome sister-in-law?"
Guan Enxue waved his hands and smiled, everyone left Guan Enxue's office, took their things, and went straight to the housekeeper.
"Jin Ling, this is what I often bring up, the first secretary Lin Qiyue and the deputy director Xu Shiyan.
I don’t need to tell you often, you all know each other. "
Guan Enxue led the three into the house and introduced the people behind him to his wife Dong Jinling.
Chang Hongfa and the others rushed to greet Dong Jinling, calling her sister-in-law.
"Hey, Secretary Lin and Director Xu, I often hear our old manager mention you.
Now in the entire Er County, there is no one who doesn't know the first participant or the second. "Dong Jinling laughed as soon as she heard it.
"Hurry up, get in the house quickly, I'll cook a few more dishes, and you will have a drink or two with the old manager at noon."
After finishing speaking, he turned around and was about to go to the kitchen.
"Sister-in-law, these are the yellow elm mushrooms and thorn buds we brought, grown in the greenhouse, and give it to my sister-in-law to taste."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly handed the box in his arms to Dong Jinling.

chapters.title: Chapter 546: high hopes
chapters.content:
Chapter 546 High hopes
Dong Jinling liked the mushrooms and thorn buds very much when she saw them.
Cooking in the winter is the hardest thing to do. You spend all day with cabbage, tofu, sauerkraut and so on. No matter how good a cook is, you can’t make any tricks.
It's rare for everyone to see fresh dishes.
"Oh, this is really amazing. There are fresh mushrooms and thorny shoots in winter. Xiao Xu, you are really amazing."
Dong Jinling took the box and looked at the things in the box with a smile on her face.
"Is there any ground fruit here? My God, this is really a rare thing."
"Old Guan, invite Xiao Lin and Xiao Xu to sit down, and I'll make tea for you.
I have to cook something delicious for lunch today, so I’m waiting. "Dong Jinling happily carried the box and went to the kitchen.
Guan Enxue lives in a family courtyard, and the three rooms are not too big.
There is a combination sofa under the south window, and a tea table is placed in front of the sofa.
Xu Shiyan and others sat on the sofa, and Dong Jinling made tea and washed apples and brought them up, allowing Xu Shiyan and the others to eat and drink whatever they wanted.
"I guess you guys are definitely not here to send some mushrooms and wild vegetables, but to inquire about news?"
Guan Enxue looked at Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan, and laughed, without beating around the bush with them, he said straightforwardly.
Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan felt a little embarrassed when Guan Enxue directly broke their minds.
"Ahem, well, since Secretary Guan said it, we can't deny it.
Indeed, after hearing some news, I wanted to see Secretary Guan. "Lin Qiyue coughed twice, then said with a smile.
"Congratulations to Secretary Guan on his promotion."
No matter what, Guan Enxue's promotion is a happy event and must be congratulated.
Guan Enxue smiled and nodded, "Actually, if the two of you don't come, I would like to take some time to attend."
Guan Enxue has been here for some years. He works diligently and wholeheartedly for the public, and has indeed made a lot of achievements.
Especially in Fusong’s fight against natural disasters several times, Guan Enxue has done a good job with outstanding achievements.
Moreover, a ginseng market supported by Guan Enxue has achieved new highs in foreign exchange earnings year after year, and the ginseng industry is booming.
Although the ginseng market has just been established, it is also very prosperous, which plays a leading role in the immediate economy.
These are important results that affect the assessment. Guan Enxue should say that he has done very well.
So the superior leader transferred him to the city as a deputy based on various considerations.
Guan Enxue is less than 50 years old, and it is definitely very good to be a deputy in the city.
This is the affirmation of his ability by his superiors. If he works hard, he may be able to hold a full-time job before retirement, and even enter the province.
"The economic situation in our county is very good, the ginseng industry is thriving, and everything is going in a good direction.
To be honest, I actually don’t want to leave, but this is an organizational consideration, not based on personal opinions.
Originally, I wanted to fight for the position of secretary, but the above did not agree. "Guan Enxue sighed.
Fusong is not a key area, and there is no such special case, so it was rejected by the above.
"I specially stayed with you two for dinner today, and I also wanted to have a heart-to-heart chat with you."
Guan Enxue turned his head and looked at Chang Hongfa.
"The new secretary was directly transferred from the province. He is not familiar with our side. You must cooperate well with him at work."
"I know, old Guan, don't worry about this, everyone is for the good of the whole county, I understand." Chang Hong nodded.
"Xiao Lin, originally, you should have moved up a step, but I suppressed you.
Our county ginseng antler company is now merged with the Specialty Products Bureau.
When the director of special products was elected, someone proposed to let you come up, but I rejected it. "
Guan Enxue looked at Lin Qiyue again, and said a surprising news with a little apology.
Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan didn't expect such a thing to happen.
Ginseng Velvet Company, now also called the Specialty Products Bureau, happens to be the direct leader of a ginseng field.
Lin Qiyue has been in the field for many years, and he is most familiar with the ginseng industry in the county.
Ordinarily, he didn’t ask any questions at all, so why was it rejected?
"As soon as you participated, you are now fat in the eyes of many people. I don't know how many people miss your position as the secretary of the participation.
I'm afraid that if you are brought up, the other deputy directors in your field are not qualified enough.
At that time, people will definitely be transferred from other places. If the new secretary and Xiao Xu can't get along, how will your business develop next? "
Guan Enxue spent a lot of thought in order to participate.
Nowadays, a company is a key enterprise in the county, so you must be careful when choosing a company secretary.
Lin Qiyue understood as soon as he heard it, and nodded immediately.
"Thank you, Secretary Guan, I understand, don't worry, I will work in the venue with peace of mind, and work with Xiao Xu and Lao Li to develop the venue."
Lin Qiyue also devoted all his efforts to participate in the competition.
Nowadays, participation is getting more and more prosperous. To be honest, Lin Qiyue is not reconciled to being transferred at this time, he still wants to watch the participation go further.
"Xiao Xu, you are young, daring to work hard, and professional in learning. You are an elite in the ginseng industry in Fusong, and you can be regarded as an expert level figure.
In the future, we still need to do more research on the ginseng industry.
Remember what you said before, we must lead our county in the intensive processing of ginseng, so that our Fusong ginseng can become a world-renowned product.
No matter what time it is, no matter how much money you have, even if you are the richest man in the country, don’t forget your original intention.
Don’t forget, you came out of ginseng, what was your original wish. "
Guan Enxue smiled and looked at Xu Shiyan. From the bottom of his heart, he admired Xu Shiyan very much.
I also hope from the bottom of my heart that one day in the future, Xu Shiyan can really realize what he wrote in his original paper, to make the Fusong ginseng industry bigger and stronger, and to do a good job in the deep processing and finishing of ginseng.
Xu Shiyan was a little excited when Guan En learned what he said, so he nodded repeatedly.
"Don't worry, Secretary Guan, I will, and I will firmly remember why I came to participate in the first place."
This is not only a commitment to Guan Enxue, but also Xu Shiyan's biggest goal after his rebirth.
"Although I have been transferred to the city, it is not far away. If you need anything in the future, you can still find me anytime.
In the future, if any of you go to the city, you are welcome to find me. Even if we don’t work together, we are still friends.
It’s still the same sentence, as long as I can do it, I will definitely help. "Guan Enxue is actually quite reluctant to give up here.
"That's for sure, in the future, we have plenty of places to trouble you.
Don’t think that you can go to the city to relax, I will bore you to death then. "
Chang Hongfa is a big man, a little uncomfortable with this atmosphere, deliberately scaring Guan Enxue.
Everyone burst out laughing when they heard the words, the sentimentality of parting just now vanished in no time.
They are all big men, so why are there so many emotions that hurt the spring and the autumn?
Just in time, Dong Jinling yelled in the kitchen, saying that the food was ready, and asked everyone to wash their hands and eat.
Taking advantage of Xu Shiyan's washing his hands, Guan Enxue dragged Lin Qiyue aside.
"You stay with Xiao Xu in the first place for a few more years, and when he is older, his qualifications will come up."
Guan Enxue didn't say what happened next, but Lin Qiyue understood it instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 547: Future prospects
chapters.content:
Chapter 547 Future Prospects
Dong Jinling scalded the thorn sprouts with boiling water, then marinated them with seasonings, wrapped them in batter and fried them in a pan.
This is a popular way of eating in the local area. When eating, you can dip a little salt and pepper or not.
The fried prickly sprouts are crispy on the outside, fresh and tender on the inside, with the unique fragrance of wild vegetables, delicious.
The yellow elm mushrooms are washed in water, and fried with eggs and leeks is the best.
There are no leeks at this time, but Dong Jinling has cultivated some garlic sprouts in flower pots, and the growth is just right.
So I cut it out and paired it with scrambled eggs with elm yellow mushrooms. The bright yellow and light green color is very attractive.
Dong Jinling took off the flower stalks of the box of ground fruits, washed them with water, sprinkled them with sugar, and brought them up.
In addition to these three dishes, Dong Jinling also fried sauerkraut, cabbage and fungus, stewed pork ribs and potatoes, braised meat and tofu, and cut a canned luncheon meat, exactly eight dishes.
"I don't know that the old man brought guests here, and there is nothing prepared at home, that's all, let's just eat.
When you come back someday, ask the old manager to tell me in advance to cook something delicious. "Dong Jinling greeted the four of them to eat with a smile.
"Hey, this is rich enough, my sister-in-law is tired and hard."
Chang Hongfa and the three of them came over to take a look. What do you want to do with eight dishes? So they all thanked Dong Jinling.
"Sister-in-law, sit down and eat too, let's go together."
The food on the table was all ready, but Dong Jinling turned to leave. How could everyone let her eat in the kitchen by herself? So quickly stopped.
Dong Jinling wasn't because of anything else, she just felt that Guan Enxue, Chang Hongfa and the other two attendees were having dinner together, and there must be work or something to discuss at this dinner table.
Dong Jinling felt that it was inappropriate for her to be in front of her, so she might as well be alone, but everyone refused to let her, so she had to sit down.
There is no shortage of good wine in Guan Enjiao, so he took two bottles and opened them, and all four of them filled them up.
Chatting while drinking and eating.
"Hey? Don't tell me, these thorny shoots are no different from spring ones, they seem to be a little tenderer."
Guan Enxue took a piece of prickly shoots and tasted it, and it tasted really good.
"Well, this thing is cut off the thorn bud sticks from the mountain, put them back into the soil, and the humidity is higher.
Or put it directly in a bucket, as long as there is enough water underneath. Put it in a warm place and it will germinate slowly. "
Xu Shiyan had to tell how the thorny bud came out.
"Oh, oh, that means, this thing can take advantage of it.
Oops, it's a pity, if there is some way to continue to use it, it would be great. "
Guan Enxue nodded, and said something regretful.
"It's not very easy to do. It is estimated that it will take a lot of work to study this thing, and the cost is estimated to be not low.
Based on the current standard of living, it is unlikely that ordinary people will accept it. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head. This meant that he had his own space and manpower, but he was idle and bored and made food for himself.
"To do this, it is better to develop greenhouse vegetables.
Especially leeks, cabbage, lettuce, chrysanthemum, and radish, these green leafy greens do not require flowering and pollination.
If it can develop and form a certain scale, it will still be profitable. "
To put it simply, people's living standards have not yet developed to that point, and no one regards wild vegetables as good things.
It’s the season to go to the vegetable shop on the mountain. If you spend money to buy wild vegetables in the market, most people may not be able to accept it.
"Well, well, this is the way you said.
If this can increase the vegetables in greenhouses, it can enrich the dining tables of urban and rural residents, and it can also generate income.
It’s a good idea, let’s wait until the next year, I’ll arrange someone to go to your greenhouse to have a look, and then discuss it. "
Chang Hongfa thinks that Xu Shiyan's proposal is very good, but the winter in Northeast China is too cold, and heating may cost a lot.
If the cost is too high, the market may not accept it.
This is definitely not something that can be settled with a slap on the head. It still needs to be studied carefully.
After tasting the thorn buds, try the yellow elm mushroom.
Everyone felt that it seemed to be lighter than the one grown on wood, not as fresh as the wild one.
After all, it is artificially cultivated, and it is still cultivated with mushroom bags, not wood segments, so it is normal to have a milder taste.
Currently, most of the edible fungi are cultivated by wood segment, which has low output and consumes a lot of wood.
So Guan Enxue was very interested in this fungus bag cultivation of edible fungi, and asked quite a lot.
When it is learned that the mushroom bag is mixed with sawdust, bean stalks, corn cobs and other things in a certain proportion, and then inserted into the bacteria for cultivation.
Guan Enxue nodded again and again, saying that this is very good, and it doesn't cost so much good wood.
"When spring starts tomorrow, our farm plans to cultivate fungus with fungus bags in those old ginseng fields.
Worry-free, there is no need for a warm shed, just put it directly on the surface of the pool, and just cover something with the original ginseng shed, and this crop can also gain a lot. "
Participating in the technology department, it can be regarded as understanding the cultivation technology of edible fungi.
The fungus, elm yellow mushroom, oyster mushroom, and Hericium erinaceus cultivated at the experimental base all grow very well.
The artificial cultivation technology of Ganoderma lucidum has also made progress. It is estimated that the final problem will be solved soon and large-scale planting will be realized.
There are few exports of fungus, and Europeans and Americans do not recognize this thing. It feels like they are chewing rubber.
However, some surrounding countries are very fond of fungus, thinking that fungus is a kind of longevity vegetable, which can remove blood garbage and dust in the body, and is good for health.
So in the past two years, there have been some export orders.
Of course, fungus is also in great demand in China. After all, as a food giant, fungus is a beneficial ingredient recognized by both the north and the south.
However, at present, most of them adopt the method of wood segment cultivation, and the yield is not high.
Mushroom bag cultivation method, the quality of the fungus is not as good as the wood section, but fortunately, the cost is low, the yield is high, and it is convenient for field management.
So the fungus bag cultivation method will be the future trend.
Guan Enxue and Chang Hongfa didn't know much about these technologies, but it didn't affect them listening to Xu Shiyan's lecture.
"Very well, these are ways to get rich.
Xiao Xu, you have time to sort out the things you have studied in your field.
Let’s keep it secret, let’s not talk about cultivation techniques such as mushrooms and fungus. Can you see if you can have half a training class and get people from various villages to train and learn? "
Chang Hongfa was very interested in these, so he made a request to Xu Shiyan.
"By the way, our county plans to hold a training course on high-yield ginseng cultivation techniques.
You are the keynote speaker, so you can’t refuse when the time comes. "Chang Hongfa suddenly remembered this matter.
Originally, the county proposed to invite professors from the Agricultural University to give lectures.
As a result, when I contacted the Agricultural University, they said, didn't Xu Shiyan have graduated and returned to work? Just talk to him.
In terms of ginseng production technology, there are too few people in China who are more skilled than Xu Shiyan. There is no need to go to the Agricultural University to find someone.
"Let me tell you? Can it work? Shouldn't this matter be brought in by an agricultural export expert?"
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, and asked him to give a lecture again?

chapters.title: Chapter 548: advice
chapters.content:
Chapter 548 Advice
"It's not you who will speak, who will? In our county, who else is more professional than you in this area? The books have been published, and you are still humble here?"
Chang Hongfa glanced at Xu Shiyan, this kid is usually very smart, but at critical times he pretends to be stupid.
"By the way, how many years has it been since you got that assistant engineer? Shouldn't you be rated as a mid-level engineer?
You have finished your university studies, your book has been published, and you have enough academic qualifications and qualifications. Hurry up and apply. "
As soon as publishing a book was mentioned, Guan Enxue thought of one thing, so he had to mention Xu Shiyan a few words.
"Well, it's been three years since I got it, and I plan to apply this year."
Xu Shiyan nodded. After the beginning of spring, there will be relevant job title evaluations, and he will try to apply for the evaluation then.
"That's good, let's participate in the evaluation.
This is a big event, it is related to your personal future, and you are also participating, isn't it the face of our county?
If one day, you can be rated as a senior engineer, that would be great. "
Guan Enxue nodded, as long as Xu Shiyan didn't give up studying hard.
Several people were drinking and chatting. Dong Jinling quickly finished his meal and went back to the house to rest.
Everyone on this side chatted at home at first, but as they drank a lot, they probably became more relaxed, and then they chatted about other things.
"Xiao Lin, Xiao Xu, actually you two shouldn't be here today." Guan Enxue sighed.
"Ah? Why?" Both Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan were stunned, shouldn't they come?
"Yeah, you two know I'm leaving.
Come at this time, let someone who is interested take it down, and when the next one takes office, what if someone secretly gives you two some eye drops? "
Guan Enxue shook his head, these two people are not in the agency, after all, they are still a little bit off.
Lin Qiyue was born in the army. After retiring from the army, he first worked on a farming farm and was later transferred to participate in the field.
Although he has reached the stage of participating secretary in these years, he is always working at the grassroots level, and after all, he does not have a deep understanding of some of the above matters.
As for Xu Shiyan, let alone.
Technical people only know how to study technology, how can they understand those twists and turns?
So the two of them were a little dumbfounded when they heard what Guan Enxue said.
Yeah, the two of them came here in such a hurry, would it make people feel that they were too close to their ex?
Will the person who came later have a preconceived opinion of them?
"Secretary Guan, actually we came here to congratulate you.
When you were here, you took great care of the participants. Now that you are going to be promoted to the city, we are really happy for you from the bottom of our hearts.
The second time I came, I really thought about it and wanted to ask you who the newcomer is.
To be honest, we also have no idea. "
Lin Qiyue felt a little nervous, did they accidentally go astray?
"The newcomer was directly arranged by the province, the Deputy Department of Agriculture, about the same age as me.
I'm not very familiar with him, I've only heard people mention him, saying that he's not bad.
You don't have to worry too much, just do what you should do.
Anyway, everything is on the right track as soon as you join the field. You don’t need to be too brilliant for the time being. It’s good to keep the current situation stable. "
Guan Enxue is not easy to say too much, but the implication is to let Yi participate in the field to be more stable in the near future, keep a low profile, and don't push yourself.
No matter when, it is not a good thing to be too limelight.
Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan looked at each other, and they probably knew it.
"Okay, we got it, thank you Secretary Guan for reminding me."
"It's okay, that Chen Jianzhang will be transferred to the county after the next year, as the director of the Specialty Products Bureau and the chairman of the ginseng company.
You are all familiar with it, and you have cooperated well at work, so there is no problem. "
Guan Enxue saw Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan's worries, so he gave them another reassurance.
Fusong specializes in ginseng, so the importance of this specialty bureau and ginseng company is self-evident.
The following manages the ginseng research institute, the county ginseng factory, the four county-owned state-run ginseng farms, the county deer farm, and several joint venture ginseng farms, which belong to the immediate boss of a ginseng farm.
Chen Jianzhang's promotion should not be regarded as a high promotion, but only a mediocre transfer.
But since the Specialty Products Bureau is here, it is obvious that it needs to be reused. Let him work in the Specialty Products Bureau for a few years to get a seniority, and then arrange it elsewhere.
There is a Specialty Products Bureau as a buffer, even if the county takes any measures, it will not come to the scene all at once.
When Lin Qiyue heard this, his hanging heart finally relaxed. "Thank you, Secretary Guan."
There are some things that don't need to be said clearly, but Lin Qiyue has written down this feeling.
Guan Enxue waved his hand and smiled, "Thank you? He did a good job and was transferred normally, which has nothing to do with you.
Come on, don't talk about those useless things, drink this wine, take a look in your cup, why do you have so much left? Are you going to raise fish? "
Having said everything that needs to be said, order as much as you can, Guan Enxue stopped talking, and dragged the three of them to start drinking.
Guan Enxue and Chang Hongfa have to go to work in the afternoon, so naturally they can't drink too much at noon, the four of them actually only drank a bottle of wine before they finished.
After lunch, they sat for a while, Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan saw that it was not early, so they got up and said goodbye to leave.
It happened that Guan Enxue and Chang Hongfa were going back to work, so the four of them came out together.
"Go back and work hard. Your hard work can be seen by the leaders. Don't worry."
When parting, Guan Enxue patted Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan on the shoulders.
"Yes, Secretary Guan, don't worry, we will work hard."
The two nodded and watched Guan Enxue and Chang Hongfa enter the office compound.
Over there, the drivers of the two had already finished their meal and were waiting in the car, so they drove over quickly.
"Xiao Xu, you can take a car with me, we both sit in the back, we can still talk."
Lin Qiyue glanced at Xu Shiyan, obviously he had something to say to Xu Shiyan.
"Okay." Xu Shiyan nodded, and got into the car with Lin Qiyue, and the two sat down in the back seat.
The driver started the car and walked back, Lin Qiyue rubbed his forehead.
"I have a bad feeling that our work will not be easy to develop in the next few years."
After a moment of silence, Lin Qiyue spoke.
"Yes, so Secretary Guan reminded us not to show off again."
The first two years of participating in the show have been a big show, and it must have attracted envy. After all, the export earns 20 million yuan a year, and the domestic sales are nearly 10 million yuan.
It’s okay to say that the domestic part has an output value of six to seven million in previous years.
But the profits of foreign exchange earning through export are too high. Who wouldn’t be envious after seeing it?
"Thanks to listening to you, we didn't expand production."
Lin Qiyue is very fortunate at this moment. If they were overjoyed at the beginning, they directly recruited workers to expand production, and then produced a few more products. They really don't know what the follow-up will be like.
"Okay, let's stay safe and secure, and live a peaceful life."
Anyway, they reserved their last move and cooperated with the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau. Do you believe that there are still people who have trouble with the Forestry Bureau?
"Secretary Lin doesn't have to worry too much. Our participation is only a little bit famous in this three-acre land. If we come out of our place, who knows, right?"
What can Xu Shiyan say? I can only ease Lin Qiyue's heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 549: Fried Sticky Spoon
chapters.content:
Chapter 549 Fried sticky fire spoon
Back from a trip to the county, Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan were both worried.
The two of them didn't return to the scene, and went home separately.
"Why did you come back so early today? Is the unit okay? Quick, wash your hands quickly, and help us watch the pot.
Our mother said that she wanted to eat a sticky fire spoon. She soaked 50 catties of rice a few days ago, and it was ground yesterday. "
As soon as she entered the door, she happened to see Su Anying walking towards the kitchen with a sticky spoon that had just been wrapped with a curtain.
"My mother, my mother, and Pingping are in the house. I am watching the pot in the kitchen. When you come back, you are watching the pot. I will also go in to make the pot.
Hurry up and bake it out. When you go to work tomorrow morning, send some to Uncle Han, and then send some to the fifth and sixth younger sisters. "
"Okay, wait a minute, I took off my coat."
Things at work should not affect the family.
Besides, there is nothing wrong with participating in the field at present, so it won't be a mess.
So Xu Shiyan nodded happily, turned around and entered the house to greet his parents and mother-in-law first.
Then he took off his coat and jacket, only wore the sweater inside, rolled up his sleeves, went to the outer room to wash his hands, and then took the shovel from Su Anying's hand.
"Okay, I'll take a look at the pot, you go into the house and wrap the fire spoon." Just in time, he was alone, thinking about something.
Su Anying glanced at Xu Shiyan, sensitively aware that something was wrong with her husband, and she didn't care too much.
Working outside, there are so many troubles every day, it is normal to go home with a little emotion.
Men are different from women. Women may need to find someone to comfort them when something happens.
Man, give him space and let him figure it out on his own.
"Okay, then watch the pot, don't burn it."
Su Anying turned around and went into the house, and went to wrap the sticky fire spoon with Zhou Guilan and the others.
Xu Shiyan sat on the bench, looking at the bright red flames in the stove.
Everything about going to the county today, and what Guan Enxue said, went through his mind.
I always feel that something is wrong, but he can't say it.
Xu Shiyan used the fire stick to pull the firewood in the stove pit. The fire sticking spoon should not be too hot, and it should be done slowly, otherwise it will be easy to burn.
Yes, with the booming market of ginseng in recent years, it is not only a boom in ginseng, isn't Fusong also booming?
Someone wants to pick peaches? Haha, if that's the case, then there will be good things to come.
There are various crises hidden behind the prosperity, and it is also hot. If you want to pick it, how can it be so easy?
Xu Shiyan was thinking in his mind, but his hands didn't stop.
Feeling that the heat is almost ready, I quickly opened the lid of the pot and turned over the sticky spoons one by one with a shovel.
Sure enough, the heat was just right, and the bottom side was slightly browned.
After all the sticky spoons are turned over, put the lid back on.
One pot has to be turned back and forth twice to see if there is no white place on the side, and this is considered cooked.
"Dad, I want to eat sticky fire spoon."
Xu Haiqing came to Xu Shiyan at some point, staring at the pot with longing.
"You little chubby boy, you know how to eat."
Xu Shiyan glanced at his son, smiled and reached out to pinch his chubby little face.
"Wait for a while, it's too hot, wait a minute and dad will fry two for you, it's delicious and delicious."
Xu Shiyan opened the lid of the pot while talking.
The sticky spoon in the pot has been turned over twice. At this moment, the skin of the sticky spoon is browned, and there is a slight sweet fragrance in the air.
This feeling is really good.
"Son, step back, be careful of burning. Don't worry, Dad will make it for you in a while."
Xu Shiyan held a shovel in his hand, scooped up all the sticky spoons in the pot, piled five or six together, shoveled them out and threw them into the wooden trough next to the pot stand.
The slot is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, so it can hold a lot of things.
In the big house back then, before he married his wife, the house had to be filled with fire spoons in the winter, and two slots had to be installed.
At that time, there were a lot of people in the family, and they were all strong laborers, so they really could eat.
Now, I don’t even dare to think about it. Sometimes Xu Shiyan himself doubts, where did he eat all his food at that time?
Shoveling out all the sticky spoons in the pot, Xu Shiyan took the oil pot and poured some oil into the pot.
Put the sticky fire spoons that have been baked together before, and the skin is a bit soft, put a few into the pan, and fry them again.
The sticky fire spoon cut with oil is crispy on the outside and soft and glutinous on the inside. It tastes fragrant and sweet, not to mention children, adults also like it.
That’s it now, how could there be so much oil before? Who can give up?
It was already cooked, just fry it in oil, of course it will be very fast.
After frying for a while, both sides of the sticky fire spoon are oily and fragrant.
"What is so fragrant? Oh, you are really good, put a frying stick on the fire spoon."
Su Anying happened to come over with a sticky fire spoon wrapped in a curtain, glanced at the pot, and smiled.
"Hey? Were you greedy for this when you were young?" Su Anying put down the curtain and asked Xu Shiyan with a smile.
"Well, at that time, when there was a sticky fire spoon at home, our brothers especially wanted to eat this kind of hot food just out of the pan.
At that time, our mother told us that the ones that were just out of the pan were not yet fully cooked, and they were not strong enough to eat, so we need to bake them for a while. "
Xu Shiyan laughed when he thought of the past.
“At that time, I was reluctant to use oil, because the skin would turn red if I baked it for a while.
We all took it one by one and ate it, and we all thought it was delicious. "
Xu Shiyan scooped out the sticky spoons from the pot and put them on a separate plate.
"Then, go find your brother and sister, and eat slowly one by one.
There is honey at home, ask your brother to find it, you can eat it with honey. "
Fire sticky spoons are sticky things that are not easy to digest. Children have weak spleen and stomach, so eating too much is not good, and it is easy to hurt the spleen and stomach.
Generally speaking, dipping sticky food in honey will not hurt your stomach.
Xu Haiqing happily entered the house with a plate, looking for his brothers and sisters.
Here, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying's husband and wife saw their son running so fast on their short legs, they were both funny and helpless.
"It's better to be a child. He knows how to eat, drink and have fun all day long, without any worries." Xu Shiyan said with emotion.
"What's wrong? Have you encountered a difficult situation?" Su Anying answered at the right time.
She didn't ask on purpose, but she sensed that Xu Shiyan was in a low mood, so she casually cared about it.
"It's nothing, those messy things at work, it doesn't matter, it will be fine slowly."
Xu Shiyan shook his head and smiled, not planning to say anything to Su Anying.
Su Anying can't solve these things even if she knows about them, on the contrary, she will worry about them all day long.
There is no need for that, there must be a way for the car to reach the mountain, he is a big man, can't he handle this thing?
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, and Su Anying didn't bother to ask, so she took the empty curtain back to the house and continued to wrap the fire spoon.
In this way, the three generations of grandparents in the house made curtain after curtain of bags, and Xu Shiyan cooked pot after pot in the kitchen.
Even though it was winter, the room was so hot that Xu Shiyan was sweating standing in front of the stove.
There is another chapter to add more

chapters.title: Chapter 550: Bath business is booming
chapters.content:
Chapter 550 Bath business explodes
After half an afternoon of baking, the sticky fire spoon is finally finished. Needless to say, what I eat at night is sticky fire spoon and sauerkraut.
Just after dinner, before Xu Shiyan could send his mother-in-law home, Zhou Qingguo, Feng Chao, Zhao Jianshe and others came to Xu's house together.
"Third brother, have you heard? Secretary Chen is going to be transferred to the county?"
Needless to say, Zhao Jianshe must have heard the news and came to share it with Xu Shiyan.
"Well, I went to the county today, and Secretary Guan mentioned something."
Xu Shiyan nodded. He knew about it at noon. He was busy in the afternoon, so he didn't have time to discuss it with Zhou Qinguo and the others.
"Qing Guo, do you know who took Secretary Chen's position?"
Now it mainly depends on who succeeds Chen Jianzhang in the town. If he is transferred from another town, it will be difficult to handle.
"Oh, it was Wang Changhe, the original mayor of Wang, who took over the position of Secretary Chen, and then I promoted him to a higher level."
Zhou Qingguo did not hide it, and told everyone the news of his promotion.
"Qingguo, you are not authentic. When we went to find you just now, you didn't say a word."
Zhao Jianshe glared at Zhou Qingguo, boy, why didn't he say that just now?
"I told you before, don't I have to say it again now? It's not too late to know now." Zhou Qingguo laughed.
Xu Shiyan was a little surprised when he heard the news.
Unexpectedly, Zhou Qingguo was not only promoted to a full-time job earlier than in his previous life, but also stayed in Donggang without being transferred.
"Since he is still a cadre in our town, there is nothing wrong with him. I thought he would be transferred from outside."
Thinking about it, Guan Enxue had arranged all of these. Although he left the county to go to the city, he was also afraid of making trouble from the latter.
Donggang City Participation was established with the full support of Guan Enxue. If there were outsiders in Donggang, it is very likely that there will be some changes in the city next year.
Now Donggang is still an old acquaintance from the old team, so it's okay.
There is Wang Changhe in the town, Chen Jianzhang in the county, and people like Chang Hongfa and Jiang Yunfeng, so there is nothing to worry about.
Everything is fine as usual, as long as it doesn't stand out too much, it shouldn't be a big deal.
"Qingguo has been promoted, that's a good thing, has the official appointment document come down? If it comes down, I must treat you."
As soon as Xu Shiyan relaxed, he made a fuss for Zhou Qingguo to treat him.
Zhou Qingguo is thirty-four this year, according to local customs, after the thirty-five year.
Thirty-five-year-old mixed into the regular department, it's okay, the future is bright, it should be celebrated.
"Needless to say? Must please.
It must be busy these days, so let’s celebrate the New Year. We will be free for the New Year and find time to get together. "
Zhou Qingguo has nothing to say, no matter what, he has been promoted, so it's time to treat everyone to a meal.
Everyone burst into laughter, and Xu Shiyan's thoughts that had been bothering him all day disappeared in the laughter.
Never mind that, if the sky falls, there will still be a big man holding it up, and it won't fall on him.
You should eat and drink, and don't take those messy things to heart.
Zhao Jianshe and others sat in Xu's house for a while, drinking tea and chatting, and they didn't leave until after eight o'clock.
The outsiders have left, and Xu Shiyan and his wife put the child to sleep and rest.
On the morning of the 4th, Su Anying packed some sticky fire spoons in a bag and asked Xu Shiyan to take them to the Han family, Li family, and Li family.
A ginseng farm does not farm land, but eats food supplies. Without these whole grains, if you want to make a sticky fire spoon, you have to buy all of them, and most people are reluctant.
It is just a thought to send some to several families.
Xu Shiyan was the first to go to the Han family to visit Han Wenzhong.
Xu Shiqin was pregnant, and the elderly on both sides were worried, but Zhou Guilan took care of Xu Haiyuan and the others, so she couldn't spare time.
So after being busy in autumn, Li Yuexiu packed her things and went to the capital to accompany her daughter-in-law.
It is said that Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei do not plan to come back this winter.
The journey was too far, and the car was too crowded during the Chinese New Year period. Han Liwei was worried that Xu Shiqin's body would not be able to take it.
So I don't plan to come back for the Chinese New Year, I'll wait until Xu Shiqin gives birth.
Fortunately, the Han family lived together, and while Li Yuexiu was not at home, Han Wenzhong also had a good life.
Leading the children to run and jump every morning, practicing boxing and so on, the old man is in great shape.
Xu Shiyan sat at Han's house for a while, then went to Li's house and Li's house to deliver the sticky fire spoons to each other, and then went to work.
During this period of time ago, there were not many things going on in the arena.
Lin Qiyue approached Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong, and the four of them got together to discuss the next development. Everyone agreed that the status quo would be maintained for the time being.
No recruitment, no construction of factories, no expansion of production, just comprehensive utilization of ginseng land, and quietly perfecting it.
Money must be earned, but the limelight must not be displayed, lest people miss it.
There was no major event before, and the ginseng land next year is now being harvested by the Forestry Bureau or forestry workstations, so the participating workers are all idle.
So this time period is the peak time for marriages in various households.
From the sixteenth day of the twelfth lunar month, Xu Shiyan was called to have a wedding almost every day.
From the twentieth of the twelfth lunar month, Chu Xuanhuai stopped seeing patients.
Go to the hospital for emergencies, and come back a year later when you are not in a hurry. The old man himself opened the clinic not to make money, he is just so willful.
The old timber customers from the south are also leaving at this time, and they have to go home for the New Year.
Not to mention, during this period of time, through Su Anying's matchmaking, she really helped many people buy the wood and plywood they wanted.
The old timber customers of the family were very grateful to Su Anying, and they also gave away a lot of things.
He also said that he would come back next year and still live at the Canshi Hotel.
No one is seeing a doctor, and the old timber customers have all left. Originally, Su Anying thought that the hotel and restaurant would be closed directly, and everyone would go home for the holiday and prepare for the New Year.
But who would have thought, there is no one else, and the bathroom on the first floor is full every day.
It’s the Chinese New Year, who doesn’t want to take a bath and celebrate the New Year cleanly?
In the past, I didn’t have that kind of condition. I just put it in my own house, made a big basin, rubbed it casually a few times, and the meaning was pulled down.
Nowadays there is a bath in the town, where you can take a bath or take a shower, so who doesn’t want to soak in a bath, rub it, and wash it well?
How can this be fixed? Zhou Lirong and Su Anyu are both from Daying. They have been away from work for such a long time, and they have to let people go home for the New Year.
In the end, there was no other way, Su Anying could only give the people from other places a holiday, and then called Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli and others to watch the boiler burn and clean up.
Don’t worry about whether you earn money or not. Since the folks in this village are going to come, why don’t you let them spend the New Year comfortably.
On the twenty-eighth night of the twelfth lunar month, the bathing pool was closed to the public.
Then the elderly and children of each family came over and washed them well.
Xu Haiyuan, Huang Shuqing and other monkey children finally seized an opportunity to play in the water openly.
Everyone was so happy that they wished they could lift the roof of the bathing pool.
"Third Brother, take a look at these skinny kids, they've been scoured one by one. Today is your chance."
Zhao Jianshe sat on the edge of the pool, looked at the children playing wildly in front of him, and smiled.
"Where is this going? When we have money in the future, we will find a place, a hot spring hotel or something, and build a place for children to play with water."
Xu Shiyan was also very happy looking at the children.
On the first day of November, let’s add a new chapter, thanks to those who voted first last month.

chapters.title: Chapter 551: Mentor's Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 551 Invitation from a mentor
Busy, another year.
January 28th, 1987, the 29th day of the twelfth lunar month, New Year's Eve, the whole family reunited and had a happy New Year's Eve dinner.
Xu’s New Year’s Eve dinner table this year, there are a few more different things, thorn sprouts and elm yellow mushrooms.
Not only the Xu family, but also all the leaders present, relevant leaders of the Forestry Bureau, people from Donggang Town, and people who have a good relationship with the Xu family.
They all received a special annual gift from the farm on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth lunar month.
Two catties of thorn buds, four catties of yellow elm mushrooms, and one catty of ground fruit.
All are freshly picked in the morning, packed in boxes, and very fresh when they are delivered to your hands.
This special annual gift has attracted the attention of many people, and many people have called to ask Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan only said to celebrate the New Year first, no matter what happens, wait until the New Year.
On New Year’s Eve, the family had a lively reunion dinner and watched the party attentively in front of the TV.
Eat another delicious dumpling meal in the evening, and this year will be complete.
On the first day of junior high school, relatives and friends visited the streets to pay New Year greetings to each other, and on the second day of junior high school, the Xu family brothers came back for a reunion.
Compared with previous years, Xu Shiqin and his wife are missing in the family, and the other one is that Xu Shian has changed a lot.
Xu Shian, who has been studying for half a year, has not changed much in appearance, but it just makes people feel different from before.
Brothers Xu Shixian and Xu Shide already knew about the fact that the second child went to college, and it would be a lie to say that they are not envious.
There are five brothers in a family, the fifth is admitted to university, and the third is the key training in the county, which they can't compare.
But the second child, who always skips classes and fights, can go to college now?
Oops, I really envy them.
But it's useless to be envious, the two of them can't afford the money to go to college at their own expense.
"Third brother, if you hear any news about correspondence classes in the future, remember to tell us.
My eldest brother and I can’t go to full-time university, so we can do some correspondence courses anyway. "Xu Shide asked Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan glanced at his fourth brother, then at Wu Qiuyan.
At that time, if the fourth child hadn’t been chained by his partner, and he also signed up for the college entrance examination, what would have happened?
When the first session of the college entrance examination resumes, you can apply for a junior high school diploma.
The fourth child has taught books for those years, isn't it easy to pick up cultural lessons? So, sometimes it really is life.
"Okay, I will inquire about the logistics, and the second brother can also help inquire.
If there is a chance, I will definitely tell you. "
After all, they are still brothers. Xu Shiyan can't refuse such a thing.
During the meal, everyone was surprised to see the thorny shoots and mushrooms on the table.
After asking this question, I found out that it was made by the farm.
Xu Shixiang said at the time that this technology can make money and has a future.
"Well, the county is also studying this matter. From what I hear, it seems that the leader intends to try this.
Let’s talk about it after a while, even if it is done, it will be this winter, so I won’t be in a hurry right now. "
Xu Shiyan certainly knows that this technology is useful, and greenhouse vegetables will develop rapidly in the future.
Edible mushroom technology not to mention, people not only cultivate yellow elm mushrooms and oyster mushrooms, but also more types of mushrooms have been domesticated and turned into artificial breeding, which enriches the dining table of the people.
The reunion of relatives is naturally extremely lively, but the reunion time is too short, and they leave after a hasty reunion.
On the third day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan accompanied Su Anying back to her natal home.
Now that the Su family is in Donggang, it’s good to be close.
On the fifteenth day of the twelfth lunar month, Ji Tongzhong and his wife took their children back to Shuanglong. No matter what happened, they had to go back to accompany their parents.
On the third day of the first lunar month, the couple brought their children here again for a family reunion.
From the second day of the first lunar month, there are Yangko dancers in Songjianghe Town, and it has been lively until the fifteenth day of the first lunar month.
As for Donggang, this year, it also joined forces with a participating theater to show movies in the town cinema starting from the fourth day of the first lunar month.
On the sixth and seventh day of the first lunar month, there will be performances in the countryside.
All the villages and units under Donggang Township, as well as several sub-sessions, all arranged people to participate in the performances, one in the morning and one in the afternoon, for two consecutive days.
This year, it’s much more lively than previous years. Everyone said that this is what it’s like to celebrate the New Year.
In such a festive and lively atmosphere, Zhou Qingguo, Xu Shiyan and others took time to invite their relatives and friends to have a small gathering.
The leaders of the Forestry Bureau also found time to invite Lin Qiyue and others to come over. Everyone is full of hope and confidence for the new year.
February 7th, the tenth day of the first lunar month, the Fusong Specialty Products Bureau hired an associate professor from the Agricultural University to give lectures on ginseng high-yield technology to the heads of the first, second, and third state-run ginseng farms, relevant county-level units, and township leaders.
For this lecture, the county originally appointed Xu Shiyan.
I didn’t know what was going on, and then there was no news, and then I appointed a professor at the Agricultural University.
Xu Shiyan, as the deputy head of a participating field, also went to the scene to listen to the professor's class.
As a result, in class, Professor Yang called Xu Shiyan by name directly.
Communicate with Xu Shiyan on-site about ginseng field management, pest control and other related high-yield and harvest methods.
This action directly made some people in the audience look very ugly.
In the past two years, Xu Shiyan has been in the limelight too much, and many people dislike him.
This time, he deliberately suppressed him, and didn't want him to show off again.
But no one expected that Professor Yang from the Agricultural University, who was so polite to Xu Shiyan, actually called Xu Shiyan up.
After the class, Professor Yang also specially found Xu Shiyan.
"I told them several times that you don't need to come to me for this class, just you.
As a result, I called several times, and finally asked someone to invite me. I can't shirk it either, so I can only come here once. "
Professor Yang was Xu Shiyan's tutor when he was studying at the Agricultural University, and he had a very good relationship with Xu Shiyan.
When this matter was brought up, Professor Yang also felt baffled.
"If you are unhappy working here, remember to tell me.
If it doesn’t work, you go back to school and study with me for graduate school. After finishing your studies, I will find a way to keep you teaching at school. "
Professor Yang is a very straightforward person, and he also admires Xu Shiyan's talent and ability.
When Xu Shiyan was studying at the Agricultural University, Professor Yang had the idea of ​​keeping Xu Shiyan to continue his studies.
But after thinking about it, Xu Shiyan was trained by the unit, and it is not easy to complete two years of study. It is a bit too much if he goes to graduate school for another two or three years.
Besides, Xu Shiyan is at this age, and he can't just study, he has to work hard for his career, so he gave up the idea.
When I saw it now, Professor Yang felt that something was wrong, so he brought up the old story again.
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard it, and then smiled, "Thank you, Professor, for your kindness.
After listening to what the professor said just now, I feel a little flattered. "
Indeed, Xu Shiyan never thought that Professor Yang could invite him to go to graduate school again.
"However, I am no longer suitable for graduate school."
What to say, if Professor Yang said so when he was in school, maybe Xu Shiyan would really agree to stay and continue his studies if he was tempted.
But now that he has come back, and has already made plans for the future, he really can't leave this big mess at home anymore and go to graduate school by himself.
Being irresponsible to too many people like that, he is already such a big man, and he has heavy responsibilities on his shoulders, so he can't be too willful.

chapters.title: Chapter 552: Spring fair quota
chapters.content:
Chapter 552 Spring Fair quota
In March, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying participated in the county's commendation meeting.
This list was made by Guan Enxue last summer.
Don't worry about Guan Enxue's transfer, but he was not demoted, but promoted to the city, just in charge of the following people.
Even if some people in the county want to do something, it is impossible to make a fuss about it.
The husband and wife both won the Advanced Individual Award in 1986, and Su Anying also won the honor of March 8th Red Banner Bearer.
The couple stand together on the stage to accept the award, which can be regarded as a good talk.
Xu Shiyan also participated in the annual meeting of the Ginseng Society and brought a paper "Preliminary Report on the Optimum Harvest Period of Ginseng", which still won an award.
At the same time, Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan continued to be re-elected as the chairman and vice chairman of the Ginseng Society.
In April, the annual Spring Fair is approaching.
However, in the list of participating in the spring product exchange meeting this year, there is not a single participant.
"Secretary Li, what's going on? Why isn't there anyone on the list for this year's Spring Fair?"
Chang Hongfa was very strange after getting the list. In previous spring fairs, the province called for a participant to participate. What happened this year?
Why did Quanyang Beverage Factory and Second Participation add instead of the first part?
Li Jingyu didn't seem surprised to see Chang Hongfa looking for him with a list, so he just smiled.
"Old Chang, you have to know that one participant has participated in the Spring Fair three times in a row, and the foreign exchange earning amount has reached the limit.
It is useless even if you let them go. They have no new products this year, so they cannot earn too much foreign exchange.
We should also change a batch of products, and we can't always expect to participate in the show.
Our county has four participating venues, and the second participating venue is also good. Let them have a try. "
Chang Hongfa took a deep breath, put the list on Li Jingyu's desk, turned around and left.
Looking at Chang Hongfa's back, Li Jingyu snorted and continued to work with his head down.
Lin Qiyue received the news soon.
After hanging up the phone, Lin Qiyue let out a long sigh and looked up at the three people in front of him.
"Sure enough, there will be no one participating this year, and the second participating field and Quanyang Beverage Factory will replace us."
Xu Shiyan and others also sighed, "This is expected, we have guessed it before, and we are not disappointed."
What can we do now? I can only unravel Lin Qiyue.
"We really don't have any new products that can be sold this year. Even if we go to the Spring Fair, it may be difficult to earn more foreign exchange than the previous few times.
Moreover, the current production capacity of our factory is here, and the requirements for export products are high, so only those that can be selected.
The cooperation with the Forestry Bureau is estimated to be effective next year at the earliest. If you don’t go, don’t go. There will be opportunities in the future, so don’t worry. "
What Xu Shiyan said is the truth, not that they are incapable of research, but that the current product composition can perfectly solve the ginseng that is produced every year in a ginseng field.
If he wants to produce other products, Xu Shiyan naturally has ideas, but at present, it is not suitable.
Guan Enxue had told them before to keep a low profile and bide their time elsewhere.
Now it seems that it is true. In this case, it is better to stay in peace.
"Well, what you said is reasonable, we can't rush now, let's talk when we stabilize." Lin Qiyue nodded.
"By the way, is the new cola product from the cooperation with the Forestry Bureau out?"
As I said before, Ginseng Coke and Ginseng Flower Coke will try to make domestic versions.
The natural aerated mineral water in the raw materials is replaced with ordinary water to artificially add air bubbles, and the formula is adjusted to suit the taste of domestic people.
Once a participant has already made a foreign version, it is not easy to make a domestic version, which may easily cause dissatisfaction among domestic consumers, who feel that this is a differential treatment.
So for the domestic version of Coke, we discussed cooperating with the Forestry Bureau to produce another brand.
In this case, it is easier to open up the domestic market.
"Well, the new formula has been adjusted.
We also asked many people to try it, and they all said it was okay, better than those canned sodas on the market today.
I have discussed with Director Guo that production will start on May 1st, and then we will use the sales channel of Linyekou to open up the three northeastern provinces first, and then we will talk about it later. "
Yitengchang has reached an in-depth cooperation intention with the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau. From ginseng planting to comprehensive utilization, beverage production, etc., we will join hands to cooperate and strive to make this one bigger.
For the forestry bureau, Guo Shouye is in charge. Xu Shiyan is familiar with Guo Shouye. Moreover, he is the main force of the R&D team and is familiar with all production links.
So, Xu Shiyan has been in charge of the new product development of the cooperative factory since the end of the year.
"I have discussed with Director Guo, we will start buying wild fruits this summer.
Produce our characteristic fruit juice drinks, fruit wine, etc., and strive to fully expand the domestic market in the next few years. "
Since a player who develops too quickly will make people jealous, then change the strategy.
In short, as long as you can earn money, you don't have to care too much about the rest.
"Okay, that's it, let's not compete with others.
Let's go our own way and do our own business, as long as we can get benefits. "
Lin Qiyue nodded, as a human being, you still have to be able to bend and stretch. If you change your mind, maybe the development will be better in the future, right?
"The field is busy in spring, Lao Li, we must keep an eye on each subfield, and let the person in charge of each subfield keep an eye on the plots they are responsible for.
If someone under his command makes a mistake, don't blame me for being rude.
It is true that we have a big family and a big business as soon as we participate in the game, but we have to be more careful when the family business is big, we can't afford losses. "
Lin Qiyue had to instruct the deputy directors to cheer up and complete the current production tasks first.
"Yes, Secretary Lin, don't worry, everyone knows that.
We paid so much dividends last year, but now these workers are staring at each other with eyes bigger than cow bells, and no one dares to be careless. Li Bingzhuo nodded in response.
"That's good. We must mobilize the enthusiasm of the workers and increase the production of ginseng in our field. This is the foundation of our survival.
No production, everything else is a joke. "
Lin Qiyue is still very relieved of the deputy directors, and the people in charge of the sub-fields below are also good.
It should be said that now is the stage for a participant to work together to increase production and income.
Everyone is very motivated, exhort, just take precautions.
Because everyone had been mentally prepared, the fact that they could not go to the Spring Fair did not cause much fluctuation within the participants.
Leaders go to work as usual, and workers produce as usual.
Even if someone occasionally discusses it, the big guys say that anyway, they have already received a lot of orders this year. Even if they go to participate, they will not be able to produce if they receive too many orders.
Compared to the indifferent one who participated in the fair, the two units that were notified that they could go to the Spring Fair were ecstatic and rushed to prepare the products for the fair.
Ginseng fruit granules, Schisandra granules, and Wujiashen granules jointly produced by Ershenchang and County Pharmaceutical Factory.
The ginseng honey champagne, red bean honey champagne, schisandra champagne, etc. produced by Ershenchang and Quanyang Beverage Factory are all packaged and shipped, ready to participate in the Spring Fair.

chapters.title: Chapter 553: Slow Yang jelly
chapters.content:
Chapter 553 Xuyang Jelly
On May 3, the temperature in Fusong area generally dropped, the temperature was as low as zero to minus four degrees, and the lowest in the eastern mountainous area could reach minus six degrees.
Yiganchang and the villages of Donggang Town have also accumulated a lot of experience in the past few years to prevent them in advance.
The surface of the pool is covered with straw curtains, and the pool strings are surrounded by waste plastic films to keep out the cold.
Take people up the mountain that night to cool down, and use methods such as lighting a fire to smoke, and finally minimize the loss.
This time, the meteorological department was very helpful and gave early warning.
But in many places, there is no preparation in advance, and there is still no way, so we can only do it in a hurry.
A few days later, the results of the disaster were calculated, and the ginseng damage in the county was about 60,000 feet, and the direct loss was estimated to be nearly one million.
Li Jingyu looked at the data report, his heart was bleeding.
"The temperature in the eastern mountainous area has dropped so badly, why is there no report on the loss of Yishenchang and Donggang Town?"
He took the report and read it carefully, checking them one by one, but he didn't see anything about the frost damage in Yichang and Donggang Town this time.
Li Jingyu felt very strange, so he asked the people around him.
Chang Hongfa looked calm and serious.
"Well, Donggang is close to Changbai Mountain, and there is frost damage almost every spring.
They are all used to it, so they took precautions early on, and took various measures better. "
