As far as this is concerned, I have to say that Donggang really has a very good awareness of prevention, and every household has this mental preparation.
As long as the meteorological department or the town issues an early warning, every household will act immediately.
It is also the experience accumulated in the past few years, so I can take immediate action after receiving the warning.
As for other places, there is really no way to rely on others. Who told them not to care?
Originally, the Fusong area is prone to the phenomenon of slow sun freezing and late spring cold. It has been several years, and the experience and lessons have not been learned. There is really no way to do this.
"Hey, this frost damage has caused a lot of losses. I am afraid that the production of ginseng will be reduced a lot this year."
Li Jingyu sighed, he had only been working here for a few months, and it was really frustrating to be faced with this situation.
"This time, it's thanks to our deputy director Xu who made preparations in advance, otherwise, we would have suffered a lot of losses."
As soon as he joined the field, Lin Qiyue let out a sigh of relief after learning about the disaster situation in the county.
Thanks to their lessons learned over the years, various preventive measures were taken properly, otherwise, the loss this year would have been severe.
"Looking forward, let's not talk about those useless ones, straw curtains must be prepared every year.
Don’t worry about wasting money or not, it’s better to prepare and not use it than to really have something to use.
There is also the waste plastic film, don't spend the waste money, the ones that are used up in three years will be directly put into the warehouse.
During the beginning of spring, they are all transported to the mountains. After the surface of the pool is finished and the ginseng shed is covered, the pool is immediately surrounded by waste ginseng film.
Cold protection work must be done every spring. " Lin Qiyue proposed directly.
This thing is really no way, ginseng is in the ground, and it will germinate in season.
The cold-proof soil covered on the surface of the pool in winter will form a hard cover after being covered and melted by rain and snow.
If the anti-cold soil on the surface of the pond is not removed in spring, the ginseng buds will not be able to arch out from the hard-covered soil layer, and the buds will be suffocated.
But if the pool face is done, I will worry about the slow sun in the spring.
One crop of freezing damage is likely to cause a large-scale reduction in production or even a failure of harvest. This loss is really unbearable.
Covered with grass curtains and old ginseng membrane enclosures, it is laborious and costly, but this is the best way to deal with cooling damage.
Especially on the Donggang side, there are frost damage year after year, so it’s really not too troublesome, so you have to prepare in advance.
Not being able to use it is better than really suffering a disaster.
"Yes, I also think this will be better.
Then listen to Secretary Lin, and do this cold prevention every year in the future to avoid unnecessary losses. "
Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong and others also agreed with Lin Qiyue's proposal.
Xu Shiyan didn't have any opinion on this either. Donggang was like this. Five or six years out of ten, there was a lot of trouble, and there was frost damage in the beginning of spring.
It is said that ginseng is expensive, can it not be expensive?
Various natural disasters throughout the year can affect ginseng.
In spring, it is sunny and windy, and in summer it rains and there are floods. In autumn, it is prone to drought. In winter, it may be dry and cold without snow, and the sticks will freeze to death in the soil.
Planting a stick is like a catastrophe. It doesn’t matter if you kowtow and kneel all day long to work. You have to pray for God’s blessing all day long. Don’t make any mistakes this year. It’s really not easy.
"No matter what happens, it's good that our bats are fine.
The other places have nothing to do with us, and we can’t control it if we want to. It’s better than anything else if we understand our own one-third of an acre of land. "
Finally, Lin Qiyue summed up the sentence and adjourned the meeting.
After a drop in temperature, the temperature rose again quickly. As a result, many people caught colds.
Even the children of the Xu family were recruited. The young Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui coughed and had a runny nose in the evening.
Children of this age are tough, and they act like donkeys all day long.
Many children have two tubes of snot hanging all day long, and the sleeves look like blacksmiths all the year round, but they all have a good time playing.
Su Anying saw that the two children were in good spirits, did not eat less food, and watched TV very enthusiastically, so she didn't care too much.
As a result, in the middle of the night, Su Anying listened to the breath beside her, why is it so heavy and rough?
reached out to touch it, and was startled, the child was scorching hot.
"Shi Yan, turn on the light quickly, the child has a fever."
Su Anying was so frightened that she sat up and asked Xu Shiyan to turn on the light.
Xu Shiyan was sleeping on the kang, and when he heard the sound, he immediately got up and pulled the light cord to turn on the light, and turned to see the child.
I saw the daughter-in-law next to her. The two younger ones were flushed, and when they touched her, their foreheads were hot.
"Oh, it's a cold. Wait a minute, I'll go find medicine."
Xu Shiyan immediately put on his shoes and went to the ground to rummage in the east room.
Not long after, I found a few packs of medicine powder and handed them to Su Anying, "Rinse it with water and give it to the child to drink."
Most of the antipyretic and fever-reducing medicines these days are Qutong Tablets or Antongding Injection.
There is no such thing as ibuprofen, or paracetamol granules.
Antongding should be regarded as the fastest fever-reducing medicine. Generally, a fever can be subsided quickly after injection.
However, the antipyrine in the Antongding formula has relatively large side effects, so it is better for adults, and children must be cautious when using it.
The children of Xu's family are usually quite healthy, and they don't have these medicines at home.
But there are some medicinal powders prepared by Xu Shiyan and Chu Xuanhuai when they are free.
Some of them have good antipyretic effect, although not as fast as Antongding, but the side effects are much smaller.
Following Xu Shiyan's instructions, Su Anying washed the medicinal powder away with warm water.
Then Xu Shiyan held the child, and Su Anying gave the child medicine with a spoon.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui are also six years old. They can understand words when they are not young.
So in a daze, I heard my mother tell me to open my mouth to take medicine, but the two children were obedient, so they opened their mouths and fed the medicine.
The medicine is bitter, and the child will vomit after tasting it.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly fed the child with water, and found a piece of rock candy for the child to stuff in his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 554: Squibs
chapters.content:
Chapter 554 put a squib
This night, Xu Shiyan and his wife couldn't rest, and they kept looking after the two children.
Take medicine, apply cold compresses, massage acupoints, clear river water, stir with egg white and medicinal powder, and apply to the soles of the children's feet.
Until dawn, the temperature of both children dropped and their breathing returned to normal.
"Look at you two, why don't you call me?"
When eating in the morning, Chu Xuanhuai saw that the couple were only yawning, and the younger one was still asleep, so he asked a question.
Knowing that the two children had a fever at night, Chu Xuanhuai complained.
"It's okay, the child just has a cold and a fever, just take some medicine and the fever will subside. If it's not good in the middle of the night, Master will be alarmed."
Chu Xuanhuai is at this age, he must have a good rest at night, otherwise he will not be energetic during the day, which is not good for Jiankang.
"Okay, you two go to work as usual during the day, and the child will be handed over to me, and I will take it with you."
Chu Xuanhuai went over, felt the pulse of the two children, and confirmed that there was nothing serious, so he was relieved.
So he said, let Xu Shiyan and the others do what they should do, and just leave the child to him.
Xu Shiyan and his wife are of course relieved. After breakfast, the two younger ones also woke up, washed and tidied them up, and sent them to Xu Chenghou's side.
Chu Xuanhuai prescribed some medicines that were not too strong, and asked Zhou Guilan to add them to the millet and boil them, coaxing the two children to drink them.
Then Chu Xuanhuai prepared some medicine for her, crushed it into powder with a medicine roller, and told Zhou Guilan to feed the child to drink.
Not to mention, it really worked. At night, neither child had a fever anymore.
Except for a little runny nose and a slight cough, he is in good spirits, and he does not eat less food. It is not obvious that he has a severe fever at night.
Xu Haiyuan sleeps with Chu Xuanhuai at night, and Xu Jinping sleeps on a kang with the two younger ones.
Chu Xuanhuai was worried that the two elders would be infected, especially Xu Jinping, so in the evening, he specially made some herbal tea for the two elders.
The two older ones drank it obediently and went to bed, and felt that the warm body was really comfortable.
It is probably also related to their exercise all day long. Anyway, they wake up the next day still alive and well, and go to school happily.
However, many children in the school have cough and runny noses.
When the teacher saw this, he quickly got disinfectant, sprayed it all over the room, and told the children to go home and drink some **** soup or something.
"Teacher, drinking **** soup doesn't work.
I went back and asked my master to dispense some medicine and put it in the boiler of our school water room.
Let the students drink the hot water inside, and it will be fine. "
Xu Haiyuan remembered the herbal tea he drank last night, so he told the teacher so.
Nowadays, there is no Donggang person who does not know the name of Chu Xuanhuai.
As soon as Xu Haiyuan said this, the teacher immediately went to report to the principal.
The principal only knew at this time that in many classes in the school, there were children with colds, fevers and coughs, which were obviously flu.
The principal still trusted Chu Xuanhuai's medical skills, so he went to find Chu Xuanhuai at noon and asked Chu Xuanhuai for help.
Of course we need to help with this kind of thing. Chu Xuanhuai prescribed medicine according to the symptoms of this batch of children's colds.
After the principal took it back, he put it in the boiler of the water room on the left side of the school gate.
And let all the teachers ask the children to drink hot water, not cold water.
It should be said that the physique of children these days is still good.
Two days later, these children were alive and well again, able to climb up the house.
As for the two children of Xu Shiyan's family, they should eat and sleep, they are happier than anyone else, and they have nothing to do.
On May 8th, the results of Xu Shiyan's professional title evaluation came out, and he was indeed rated as an intermediate engineer.
"Congratulations, Xiao Xu, you are the first mid-level technical engineer in our Fusong area, you are amazing."
When the certificate came out, Lin Qiyue and others also congratulated Xu Shiyan one after another.
Don’t look at this small certificate, with it, Xu Shiyan’s salary can be raised by another level. After he retires, his pension will be much higher than others.
"Thank you, Secretary Lin, and thank you Director Li and Director Dai." Xu Shiyan accepted the congratulations from everyone with a smile.
"By the way, Secretary Lin, it's already the eighth day, why haven't I heard of the results of the Spring Fair?"
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered this matter and felt puzzled.
I remember that when I participated in the Spring Fair and broke the record, the county was eager to publicize it with gongs and drums. Why is there no movement at all this time?
Lin Qiyue was stunned for a moment, then came back to his senses, "Yeah, why is there no movement?
Wait a minute, I'll make a phone call and ask someone. "So, Lin Qiyue grabbed the phone and dialed out, looking for someone to inquire about the news.
The phone was connected, Lin Qiyue chatted with the other end of the phone for a few words, and then hung up the phone with a strange expression.
"Well, I just inquired about it, and this spring fair, our county set off a squib."
When I successfully earned foreign exchange in the previous participation, everyone said it was a big firecracker.
Now when Lin Qiyue mentioned Squibs, everyone understood that this spring fair, the transaction volume in the county might not be large, so it was called Squibs.
This time at the Spring Fair, the pharmaceutical and beverage factories, and the second exhibitors, went to the exhibition with their new products developed with confidence.
At the beginning, what kind of ginseng flower coke, ginseng honey slices, etc. were made in the first place, and they directly earned millions of dollars in foreign exchange.
This gave other people an illusion that as long as the deep-processing products of ginseng, mineral water, and beverages are beautifully packaged and introduced in detail, they can successfully earn foreign exchange, sign large orders, and get back millions of dollars.
The reality slapped these people in the face. The products they brought did not attract many people's attention.
At any rate, the mineral water of Quanyang Tianquan attracted the attention of a few people, but because of the price, the negotiation failed.
All other products were put together, and few orders were signed. The total amount was less than $100,000.
Compared to the situation at the beginning of the first participation, this is almost like no order, isn't it a squib?
"Shiyan, what do you think is going on?" Lin Qiyue was particularly puzzled, wondering why there was such a big difference?
"Inaccurate product positioning, unclear customer needs, and blind self-confidence are all related.
We haven't seen the specific situation, but I guess it is these points. "
Xu Shiyan said before that the champagne made by Quanyang Beverage Factory is not very competitive.
As for the mineral water, it doesn't have much advantage compared with the Holy Mountain Tianquan.
If the price is a little lower, the product positioning is accurate, and there is a little skill in operation, there should be some orders, at least hundreds of thousands.
But at present, it is the hot sale of the Holy Mountain Tianquan, which gives outsiders the illusion.
What kind of mineral water do you think are especially popular with foreigners?
Do you really think those foreigners are stupid? People are rich, but not stupid, okay?
As soon as they joined the venue, Lin Qiyue and the others were analyzing the reason for the squibs at the Spring Fair.
At this moment, Li Jingyu, Chen Jihui, Li Jingming and others who were walking back by train all had gloomy faces.
They just don't understand why they can create miracles at the Spring Fair just by participating, and they also brought a lot of products, why can't they?
Unfortunately, no one gave them an analysis.

chapters.title: Chapter 555: twins again
chapters.content:
Chapter 555 Twins again
Every year, the Spring Fair and Autumn Fair are important opportunities for domestic enterprises to win foreign orders and earn foreign exchange through exports.
The province is very concerned about this aspect, not to mention the city, how many eyes are staring at it.
In the past years, I participated in the competition all at once, and every time I got very impressive results, but this time I fired a squib, and now everyone knows about it.
Li Jingyu hasn't come back yet, the phone here is about to explode.
Li Jingyu didn't come back, so Chang Hongfa could only answer the phone. This guy's head was about to explode after being bombarded with phone calls all morning.
"Are you saying I was wronged or not? It has nothing to do with me. No one will listen to what I say.
At the beginning, I proposed to let a participant bring the product to the venue. Didn’t some people disagree?
This is all right, if the earning of foreign exchange is not successful, I have to follow suit. "
Chang Hong lost his temper, answered the phone all morning, and dealt with it carefully, he was really on the brink of explosion.
Hung up the phone and complained to the secretary.
"County Chang, you can have fun secretly, thanks to the fact that you are not leading the team this time." The secretary reminded Chang Hong.
Chang Hongfa slapped his forehead, "Isn't that bad? If I lead the team out, all the responsibility will fall on me."
Thinking of this, Chang Hongfa felt a cool breeze on his back.
This time, I don’t complain anymore, hurry up and do what I should do.
It's just that at night, Chang Hongfa couldn't help calling Guan Enxue to complain.
How could Guan Enxue not know about this situation? He just didn't call here.
Hearing Chang Hongfa complain, Guan Enxue could only sigh.
"Old Chang, don't get angry, this matter, sooner or later, it's better to come sooner than later.
I think, after this lesson, those who are secretly unwilling and always want to poke things, the president will teach them a lesson.
No matter when, you have to be really strong.
The background of the relationship is just incidental, and you have to be strong yourself to strike the iron. If your own strength is not strong enough, it is all nonsense. "
This spring fair, I don’t know how many people were sighed, disappointed, annoyed and regretted.
When Li Jingyu returned to the county seat, he had to face the questioning and censure of his superiors, and had to review his own mistakes.
If it weren't for someone above protecting him, this fall would have been enough for him.
However, for the Xu family, it was a moment of joy and joy.
Nothing else, because news came from the capital that Xu Shiqin was born.
At ten o'clock in the morning on May 8th, Xu Shiqin gave birth to a pair of twins by Caesarean section in the hospital.
In fact, after Xu Shiqin was three months pregnant, her body shape was different from other pregnant women, and her belly was particularly prominent.
At that time, no one thought about it. They thought that Xu Shiqin was too thin in normal times, and her belly appeared big after pregnancy.
During Chinese New Year, Li Yuexiu called Zhou Guilan to talk about it.
Xu Shiyan felt that something was wrong, so he asked Han Liwei to take Xu Shiqin to the hospital for a proper checkup.
At this time, there was already a B-ultrasound. Han Liwei took Xu Shiqin to the hospital for a checkup, and found that his wife had two babies in her stomach.
This frightened Han Liwei. He was worried that his wife would not be able to bear it. How can these two do it?
Simply let Xu Shiqin do nothing, and stay at home to raise the baby.
Fortunately, Xu Shiqin's health is much better than before after taking the prescription given by Chu Xuanhuai.
Coupled with Li Yuexiu's meticulous service, cooking food for her daughter-in-law in different ways all day long, Xu Shiqin's pregnancy was fine.
It's just the uncomfortable panic in the late pregnancy, and the stomach is like a pot.
I can't fall asleep at night, I can't lie on my back, and it's uncomfortable to lie on my side.
It was finally the end of the month, and Han Liwei rushed his wife to the hospital.
After some examinations, several obstetricians gave advice that it would be best to have a caesarean section.
Because Xu Shiqin's spine was damaged for so many years before, the pelvis will also be affected to some extent, and natural delivery may be difficult and dangerous.
Han Liwei didn’t worry about having a natural cesarean section, as long as his wife and children were safe and sound, so he signed a letter agreeing to the operation.
So on the morning of May 8th, Xu Shiqin was pushed into the operating room, and a pair of twins were taken out by caesarean section.
Boys are born first, weighing six taels of weight, and girls are born later, weighing one tael of four catties.
The two children are basically full-term, so their development is very good, and their weight is normal. The only thing is that Xu Shiqin has worked hard.
The dragon and phoenix twins were born safely. The doctor checked them and said they were all healthy.
But Li Yuexiu, Han Liwei's mother and son were overjoyed, and hurriedly took Xu Shiqin, mother and son to the ward.
After it was settled properly, Han Liwei remembered that he should call his family to announce the good news.
"Liwei said, our family, Shiqin, gave birth to a pair of twins, the elder brother is the elder brother, and the younger sister is the younger sister.
The child is very healthy, and Shiqin is also doing well, but it was a caesarean section and another operation was performed.
This kid is really suffering from old age. "
When Xu Shiyan came home from get off work, Zhou Guilan hurriedly told Xu Shiyan the good news, but it was hard to avoid feeling sad after talking about it.
My daughter has suffered too much in her life, and has undergone several surgeries.
"Mom, don't you worry about my sixth sister? Or, you're going to the capital too?
Sixth sister gave birth to two children at once, and it was a caesarean section. Aunt Han alone might not be able to take care of her. "
Xu Shiyan was also happy to learn that his sister gave birth safely, but he was more worried about what to do next.
Han Liwei still has to study and go on assignments, even if he has a few days off, Li Yuexiu takes care of the mother and two babies alone, but it is enough for her.
"Oh, I'm still discussing with your father, I really want to take care of your sister.
But this family can't do it. You said that you two are so busy that you can't see a shadow all day long.
Don't I have to take care of the children's eating and drinking? If I leave, what will happen to this family? "
Zhou Guilan sighed when she heard the words, why doesn't she want to go to the capital to take care of her daughter? Looking after newborn grandchildren?
But there is a big stall here at home, and we can't get rid of it.
"Mom, it's okay, you should go to the capital, I'm here at home."
On the other end, Su Anying heard this, and quickly said that with her at home, everything would be fine.
"I'm usually at home when I'm not busy. If I'm busy, and my mother is there, just ask my mother to come and help for a few days."
At this time, the daughter-in-law must express her opinion.
In the past few years, the mother-in-law has helped take care of the children, and those outside the house have followed suit. It can be said that without Zhou Guilan's help, Xu Shiyan and his wife would not have achieved what they are today.
Su Anying is very grateful to her parents-in-law. Now that her sister-in-law has a baby and her mother-in-law wants to take care of her, Su Anying must support her.
"Mom, don't worry about going to the capital, there is no problem at home.
Otherwise, you go with my dad. Anyway, our land has been planted, so there is not much work for the time being.
You go to the capital to live for three or two months, and when the younger sister recovers, hire a nanny for her, and then you come back. "
Xu Shiyan also advised. "I have Yingzi at home, so you don't need to worry."
"Old woman, or you can go to the capital by yourself, I can't help much in the past.
I might as well stay at home and help take care of the house and so on. I happen to be with Brother Chu, and we can be companions. "
Over there, Xu Chenghou pondered for a while, and finally said.
My daughter is in confinement, and he, as a father, couldn't help much in the past. It's better to be at home, at least he can take care of the house.
Son, daughter-in-law, and wife persuaded her, but Zhou Guilan was really worried about her daughter.
Finally nodded in agreement, she went to the capital to take care of Xu Shiqin for a period of time, and when Xu Shiqin recovered, she would come back.

chapters.title: Chapter 556: iceberg cola
chapters.content:
Chapter 556 Iceberg Coke
On May 9th, Xu Shiyan sent Zhou Guilan to Tonghua.
When I arrived in Tonghua, I bought a sleeper ticket to the capital, and then sent my mother to the car to settle down. After watching the train depart with my own eyes, Xu Shiyan went home in peace.
Zhou Guilan arrived in the capital smoothly, and Han Liwei arranged for someone to pick him up.
After Zhou Guilan got off the car, someone took her directly to the hospital.
Seeing her daughter lying weakly on the bed, Zhou Guilan felt extremely uncomfortable, and she couldn't help crying while holding her daughter's hand.
At any rate, there are in-laws and uncle persuasion, and the little grandson and granddaughter are so cute.
Zhou Guilan gradually became happier, and took care of her daughter and grandson in the hospital with peace of mind.
Originally, Li Yuexiu and Han Liwei were really in a hurry to take care of the mother and the three children.
Especially Xu Shiqin had a caesarean section. She couldn’t eat until she exhausted the gas. Where did the milk come from if she didn’t eat?
The child has nothing to eat, and it's hard to cry.
At any rate, milk powder is available these days and can be bought.
Han Liwei went to buy milk powder bottles and other things for the two children to eat, so they stopped crying.
But feeding milk powder is not as convenient as breast milk. When two children are hungry, they will be hungry together, and when they cry, they will cry together.
Li Yuexiu and Han Liwei could make a fuss, and they were in a hurry and burned out.
Zhou Guilan has experience in serving twins, better than Li Yuexiu, besides, she is calmer if she has more hands.
The child is crying, and the mother-in-law and mother-in-law are hugging and coaxing each other, so as not to be too noisy.
A few days later, the stitches were removed, and the family carefully took the mother and child back to their residence.
This is also the first time for Zhou Guilan to enter her daughter's house. Zhou Guilan is also very happy when she looks at the well-behaved courtyard house in front of her.
His daughter has a house in the capital, how wonderful.
Zhou Guilan lived in the capital with peace of mind, and she and Li Yuexiu took care of Xu Shiqin in confinement and took care of the two babies.
Before Zhou Guilan left home, Chu Xuanhuai prescribed some nourishing medicinal recipes and brought some medicines for her.
Zhou Guilan and Li Yuexiu followed Chu Xuanhuai's instructions and cooked food for Xu Shiqin in different ways.
So Xu Shiqin's body is recuperating well, with a rosy complexion and a good complexion, and he has gained a lot of weight.
Zhou Guilan took care of her daughter and grandson in the capital, while Xu Chenghou, the head of the family, helped her son and daughter-in-law and took care of several children.
During the time of spring, there was a lot of work in the ground, and Su Anying was very busy.
Needless to say, Xu Shiyan, the Canyon Spring Beverage Factory, which was jointly established with the Forestry Bureau, has started construction, and Xu Shiyan is fully committed to the production here.
Fortunately, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui are both grown up, so they were sent directly to Yuhong Class.
There are older brothers and sisters who pick me up after school, so I don’t go home to eat at noon, and eat directly at the Canshi Restaurant.
In the evening, Su Anying and Xu Shiyan went home, and the couple cooked and took care of their children.
Anyway, the big guys stretch out their hands and do whatever they can, and the days go by.
By the beginning of June, the first batch of beverages passed the inspection and shipped out.
Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye are respectively responsible for the expansion of part of the sales channels.
Guo Shouye is a member of the Forestry Bureau, so naturally he has to borrow the sales channel of the Forestry Bureau.
The Forestry Bureau has its own stores, including various forest farms under it.
Iceberg Coke produced by the beverage factory will be delivered directly to these stores, and the stores will sell it on consignment first, and then check out after a while.
Moreover, if there are more sales, there will be a certain percentage discount.
For workers in the forest industry, there are still many rich ones.
There were originally other canned sodas in the store, and they all sold the same kind. Of course, whichever earns more sells whichever one.
It doesn’t take too much effort, as long as someone comes to buy it, the salesperson can say a few more words and introduce it.
Guo Shouye is in charge of the online sales channels of the forestry department, while Xu Shiyan is in charge of other sales channels.
This is also easy, there are so many students in the province, and now this group of people are basically people who keep their word in various counties.
What is this matter? It's just a matter of talking, and Bingberg Coke has easily entered the supply and marketing cooperatives in various places.
Most people are still willing to try something new.
This new cola has been adjusted according to the tastes of Chinese people. Most people feel good after drinking it.
And the price is similar to other canned sodas.
It costs money anyway, and everyone is willing to support it when they hear that it is produced by our province or the forestry system.
Everyone has an inertia. When you get used to a certain thing, you don’t bother to change it.
Personal taste is the same. At first, it might be curiosity. After one or two times, I get used to it. When I meet again, I will choose it unconsciously.
Although Bingberg Coke gave part of the profit to the sales department, there was no advertising expenditure. Overall, the profit was quite good.
After all, it is a new brand that has just been launched, and it cannot be expected that the sales volume will be so high all of a sudden.
If the factory can maintain normal operation, it is good that the factory can make some profit, and the rest should be developed slowly.
The beverage factory has arranged for many unemployed young people from the Forestry Bureau, which can be regarded as solving a lot of problems.
In addition, the cooperation between the Forestry Bureau and other participants is proceeding in an orderly manner, and both parties are very confident in the future development.
The beverage factory can't only have these two kinds of cola. Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye started to research new products under the leadership's instruction.
This is difficult for others, but it is too easy for Xu Shiyan.
I have seen so many kinds of beverages in my previous life, among other things, I can make several kinds of beverages with gas.
Is this thing just flavor, color, sweetener, carbonic acid? It's actually not that difficult.
If they don’t research and develop, sooner or later someone else will occupy the market, so what’s the point? The production should be produced, and the market will be occupied first.
In addition to carbonated drinks, Xu Shiyan also plans to produce wild blueberry juice and indigo juice. This is to prepare for subsequent development.
Blueberries and indigo fruits are rich in anthocyanins, which have antioxidant effects and are especially good for eyesight.
Indigo fruit also contains a special substance, which has an effect on children's anorexia.
These are all selling points, it depends on how to operate it.
But the blueberry and indigo fruit trees they co-planted were too small to bear any fruit, so they had to buy wild fruits.
So in late June, when the blue indigo fruit is ripe, they advertised everywhere to buy the blue indigo fruit, which is Dianzao.
It is required to be fully ripe, free of rotten fruit, green fruit, branches and other impurities.
This season is just when Niu Mao Guang is coming to an end and Gastrodia elata has not yet been unearthed.
Those who went to the mountains to do a side job happened to have nothing else to do, so they all looked for the kind of daluodianzi that grows indigo fruit, and took dustpans, buckets, etc., to beat the dates.
Now, Ji Tongzhong also has something to do. He drives a car every day and pulls a car full of people to hunt dates.
Before when we were collecting Niu Mao Guang, Ji Tongzhong took people to Jinbei, Dashahe and other big places to collect Niu Mao Guang every day.
No fare is charged, everyone just gives him a basket of cow hair.
That car can pull nearly 20 people. After all, Ji Tongzhong doesn't have to go to Niu Maoguang by himself, but Niu Maoguang who pays the fare can sell more than ten catties.
After half a month, the couple saved more than 200 catties of Niu Mao Guang dry goods.
Now, the price of this cow’s hair has risen quite a lot, rough vegetables cost about seventeen or eight yuan a catty.
That is to say, this season alone, Ji Tongzhong and his wife earned more than 3,000 yuan, and after deducting gas expenses, there is still a lot left.

chapters.title: Chapter 557: Go to Erdaobaihe
chapters.content:
Chapter 557 Go to Erdaobaihe again
Dian dates and blueberries actually grow in the same place as Niu Mao Guang, and they are all in Laodianzi.
I've seen it when I was in Niu Maoguang before, so I'm naturally familiar with it now.
Dian jujube tree is a small deciduous shrub that grows in laodianzi with water.
Cluster after cluster, the branches are tender and soft, covered with purple oblong fruits.
Ripe Dian dates fall off easily with a light touch.
So many people carry a dustpan and attach the dustpan to the branches.
Then tap the branches lightly, and the Dian jujube will fall into the dustpan. Therefore, the local people call picking Dian jujube as Da Dian jujube.
If you encounter a place with a lot of fruit, it doesn't take much time to fill a bucket.
It is still very easy for one person to harvest two buckets of dates a day.
Dian dates are brought back, and they go directly to the purchase point of the beverage factory. After picking out green fruits, branches, caterpillars and other impurities, they are weighed and calculated, and the price is 80 cents per catty.
A barrel of Dian dates weighs about 20 catties. A quick-handed person can easily earn 30 to 40 yuan by harvesting two barrels of Dian dates a day.
This kind of work, everyone is looking forward to more.
The beverage factory has set up purchase points in several places, and can purchase a lot of dates in a day.
The Dian dates received are directly packed in large white plastic buckets and shipped back to the beverage factory.
Wild Dian jujube is free from pesticides and fertilizers and pollution-free. The surface of the fruit is covered with a layer of white cattail, which is rich in yeast.
But the peel of this thing is very thin, and it is easy to break during picking and transportation.
After entering the factory, simply rinse with water, then crush and extract the juice to concentrate and store.
The beverage factory is busy developing new products, buying wild fruits, and storing concentrated juice.
As soon as you participate in the field, you also need to take care of the development of comprehensive utilization.
Last year, there were 50,000 feet of ginseng from one ginseng field, and it was impossible to plant all Gastrodia elata, so we made fungus bags to grow fungus.
Ganoderma lucidum cultivation technology is also becoming more and more perfect, just set aside a piece of land for artificial cultivation of Ganoderma lucidum.
Collecting Ganoderma lucidum spore powder, or making Ganoderma lucidum bonsai, it is useful anyway.
In addition to these, Xu Shiyan also has to visit the microbial compound fertilizer research project in Donggang often.
Currently, the research on compound fertilizers has made a lot of progress. Various data show that the microbial compound fertilizers they studied have an excellent effect on promoting the growth of ginseng.
The effect of foliar fertilizer is better. It can not only make the leaves of plants grow vigorously and promote the production of chlorophyll, but also can treat some diseases.
The people at the research base discussed with Xu Shiyan that basically next spring, this microbial compound fertilizer and foliar fertilizer can be officially put into production.
Busy, June has passed in a hurry, and half of July has passed.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping finished the final exam and are on vacation.
The grades of the two children are not bad, and they are still among the best.
Xu Shiyan remembered what he had promised the children last year, that he would take the children to Changbai Mountain to have a look.
So I discussed with Su Anying to find a time to take the children to climb Changbai Mountain.
Su Anying has not been idle for a while. This year, she bought another 20,000 feet of ginseng near the original machine repair factory.
Still in the same way as last year, the family hired people for their tractors to plow the land and sell finished soil.
Su Anying has to manage several places, and has to watch the progress of the soil, which is enough for her to be busy.
The couple discussed it and decided to take the children to the north **** of Changbai Mountain on July 18th.
In fact, the west **** is close, but the current development of the west **** is too poor, there is nothing interesting, so let's take the children to the north slope.
Waiting for a few more years, when the development of Xipo is better.
Originally, Xu Shiyan wanted to bring Xu Chenghou and Su Weizhong with him, but when the old people heard this, they all shook their heads.
They are all at this age, what mountain are they going to climb? Let's spare their old bones.
As for Chu Xuanhuai, an old man in his seventies, it is better not to torment him.
Since you want to go out to play, you must not leave Yang Haoyu behind.
But Xu Shiyan and his wife have five children, and they can't take care of them.
Finally, Yang Junxian and his wife said that they had lived at the foot of Changbai Mountain for so many years and had never been to Changbai Mountain, so why not go together.
In this way, on the morning of July 16th, Yang and Xu's family took the train to Erdaobaihe Town.
Although it was only a year later, Erdaobaihe Town seemed to have undergone some changes compared to last year.
The streets are more tidy, there are a lot more new houses than last year, and there are more shops than before.
"Whenever we can develop the west slope, it will be great."
Xu Shiyan led his wife and children walking on the street, talking while admiring the scenery.
In the previous life, the official development of Xipo began in 1996.
At that time, there was not much money in the local area, and the Xipo Mountain Gate was built with donations from South Korea’s Han Wen Group.
In 1998, the west **** was officially opened after completion, more than ten years later than the north slope.
So, the development of Songjianghe and Donggang is much later than that of Erdaobaihe.
Even when Xu Shiyan was reborn, his economic level was not comparable to that of Erdaobaihe.
"That's not easy? You work hard to make more money, and if others don't come to develop, let's find someone to develop together." Su Anying said half-jokingly.
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard the words, and then he laughed.
"You can really think highly of your man, such a big Changbai Mountain, even if it develops scenic spots, it belongs to the country, how can we have any problems?"
In the future, Changbai Mountain will be rated as a 5A-level scenic spot. Tianchi International Travel Service is regarded as a key provincial enterprise. This is not the turn of individuals.
However, when the time comes to find a way to get a hotel or something, you can think about it.
Over there, Yang Junxian and his wife laughed when they heard it.
"Brother Xu, it's not impossible. It depends on human effort. If you work hard, maybe you can."
After speaking, everyone laughed.
"Dad, is there a pine tree over there? It grows so beautifully."
Get off from the train station and walk south, you will pass a pine forest.
The pine tree looks different from other places. The bark is red, and the branches are concentrated in the upper part.
Xu Jinping looked at the tree and was very interested, so she pestered Xu Shiyan and asked what the pine tree was called.
"That's the Beauty Pine, scientifically known as Changbai Red Pine. This kind of pine tree is very special, and only a few are found on both sides of the Erdaobai River.
Look at these trees, they are graceful, like beauties, so they are called beauty pine.
Many botanists are very interested in the beauty pine.
It is said that foreign botanists transplanted the beauty pine back, but the water and soil were not acclimatized, so it was not the beauty pine, but grew into a spoiled little daughter-in-law. "
Children are very curious and always like to inquire. Of course Xu Shiyan has to tell the child.
Of course, these words were all told by his eldest daughter in his previous life.
That is the knowledge accumulated by the girl when she led the group. Xu Shiyan occasionally heard her recite it at home and wrote it down.
Unexpectedly, in this life, he would tell his daughter first.
"Wow, Meirensong, what a nice name, she looks really good-looking, like a big beauty."
Children's words made people laugh, and everyone couldn't help but laugh when they heard it.

chapters.title: Chapter 558: how to eat dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 558 How Can You Eat Dogs
A beautiful pine forest is in the center of the town, and pedestrians pass through the pine forest.
In a few years, this beautiful pine forest will be built into a park, and there will be several hotels nearby.
Then, the neighborhood will be better built, with various small scenic spots, and the green mountains and green waters are particularly beautiful.
Xu Shiyan and others walked through the beautiful pine forest, found a small restaurant, and took the children to taste the authentic Korean food.
The children were very interested in cakes, rice sausages, and cold noodles, so they ordered a table of delicious dishes to try.
The person at the next table ordered dog meat, which was delicious when dipped in dog sauce and chili noodles.
Xu Haiqing was very greedy when he saw people eating meat, so he turned to ask his father.
"Dad, they are eating meat. It looks delicious. I want to eat meat too."
This little baby belongs to the kind who loves meat and loves meat the most.
Xu Shiyan glanced aside, then turned to look at his son meaningfully, "It's dog meat, are you sure you want to eat it?"
The five children on the table were all stunned, with incredible expressions on their faces.
Xu Jinhui pursed her mouth and burst into tears.
"Dogs are so cute, why do you eat them? Uncle is a bad guy, eat dogs."
This baby's voice was a bit loud, and the person who ate dog meat next door heard it, and froze instantly.
Looking back at Xu Jinhui who was crying, she looked embarrassed.
"Brother, I'm sorry, the child is young, so I don't know what's going on. That, you eat slowly."
Xu Shiyan nodded towards him, and smiled embarrassedly.
"Our family has a few dogs. They play well with the dogs, so they are sad. There is no other meaning."
"Huihui, different people have different eating habits.
Our family doesn’t eat dog meat because Dad is hunting and treats dogs as his best companions.
Our dogs are so cute, no one would be willing to eat them.
But just because we don’t eat it doesn’t mean others can’t eat it either. We have to respect other people’s eating habits, understand? "
When the children are older, we should tell them the truth.
Just like Xu Jinping, who used to be the younger brother with a vicious tongue, and beat Xu Haiqing in various ways every time.
Later, Xu Shiyan couldn't bear it anymore, and talked to his daughter, telling her to be tolerant, and to be tolerant of everything
A bitter and mean person will not have friends, and will ruin his own luck.
Of course, the eldest daughter of his family is actually very kind to everyone else, but she is really picky about this younger brother in every possible way, and she is very strict.
It's also because Xu Haiqing's **** is too skinny, and it always makes Xu Jinping angry.
However, after that conversation, Xu Jinping's attitude towards her younger brother was obviously better, and she stopped belittling and belittling her at every turn.
Xu Haiqing seemed to be aware of her own problems, she behaved a lot better when facing her sister, and was willing to listen to her control.
Children are just like young saplings.
If you want a small tree to thrive and grow into a straight towering tree, you have to be disciplined.
Fortunately, these children at home, although they each have their own tempers, are still quite obedient, and they listen to whatever Xu Shiyan says.
So it’s not a big problem in principle, Xu Shiyan seldom preaches to the children, lest these little kids get bored after listening for a long time.
Xu Jinhui stopped crying and blinked her big eyes with teardrops on her eyelashes.
After thinking about it, he moved from his seat and ran to the next table.
"Uncle, I'm sorry, I shouldn't call you a bad person."
Such a well-behaved and cute little girl, who would be willing to be angry with her?
The other party quickly waved his hand, "It's okay, it's okay, such a cute and well-behaved child.
Uncle won’t eat dog meat anymore. According to you, dogs are so cute, let’s stop eating them. "
The other party looked at Xu Jinhui tenderly, coaxing her carefully.
When the little girl heard this, she became happy and nodded heavily. "Well, well, thank you uncle."
After finishing speaking, he happily bounced back to his seat.
A small episode passed like this, and the food came first. The children quickly forgot what happened just now and began to concentrate on eating.
Especially the cold noodles, sweet and sour, very in line with the taste of children, everyone is happy to eat.
After eating, find a place to rest.
Thanks to the floor kangs here, Xu Shiyan and his wife asked for a bigger room and brought their four children to live in it.
Yang Junxian and his wife led Yang Haoyu to live in the opposite door.
At first, the children couldn't fall asleep, and ran between the two rooms. Later, when they got sleepy from playing, they went to sleep peacefully.
As soon as it was dawn, I found that the weather outside was a bit cloudy again.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help sighing, why is it like this every time I come back? Can't we meet a sunny day?
No matter what happened, we have already arrived, so we got up, washed and ate, and then bought something to eat on our backs, and went to the bus point to buy a ticket to go up the mountain together.
The children seldom take a bus, and they all find it very strange.
Especially the mountain road up the mountain is rugged and winding, and the driver can't drive too slowly, he will definitely shake in the car.
The children felt that this was a new thing. Every time the car made a sharp turn, the children would yell, making everyone around laugh.
Xu Shiyan and others had no choice but to appease the children and prevent them from shouting.
It took a lot of time to drive dozens of kilometers of mountain roads, and the car finally arrived at the climbing point.
It was still cloudy when they got up early, but when they arrived at the climbing point, the sky turned out to be clear, blue sky, and snow-white clouds.
In the middle of the gray-white mountain, a white waterfall seems to cascade down from the sky, making a booming sound, arousing layers of water vapor, like smoke and fog.
Xu Shiyan took the children to rest at the foot of the mountain and find a place to go to the bathroom.
Everything is ready, and then start climbing.
Everyone walked along the stone steps, passing by the hot spring group.
The hot spring water is steaming, and there is a slight smell of sulfur in the air.
Colorful springs condense on the stone walls, grotesque and eye-catching.
Curious babies Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping started the question mode again.
There is no tour guide these days, so Xu Shiyan can only patiently explain to the children.
Tell them that the colorful colors on the stone wall are called springs, which are minerals in hot springs, formed after hundreds of years of condensation, once damaged, it is difficult to recover.
Pointed to the children, the dancing grass beside the spring, and told them that it was called Pinger grass, a heat-resistant plant.
Anyway, the children were fascinated by listening to it, and the people who climbed the mountain together later also listened with gusto.
A group of people passed by the hot springs in this way and headed towards the waterfall.
The closer you get to the waterfall, the more you can feel the water vapor and the sound of roaring water.
Changbai Mountain Waterfall, with a drop of 68 meters, is the highest crater lake waterfall in the world.
From the middle of Tianhuo Peak and Longmen Peak on the north side of Tianchi Lake, Chengcha River flows through 1,250 meters, and suddenly falls down.
After being cut by the barberry stone on the cliff, two streams of water, one large and one small, are formed, rushing down with thunderous momentum.
At this time, the protection of the scenic spot is not so perfect, people can get close to the waterfall.
Go to a place very close to the waterfall to experience the spectacular scene of thousands of horses galloping out.
"Okay, don't go any further, the front is too dangerous, come on, stand still, I'll take a photo for you."
Xu Shiyan came with a camera. At this time, he must take some pictures of the children.

chapters.title: Chapter 559: Tianchi water
chapters.content:
Chapter 559 Tianchi Water
People walked up the stone steps on one side of the waterfall slowly.
The stone steps are not wide and are covered with moss. On the left side of the stone steps is a canyon, and on the right is a steep stone wall.
There are some places where the rocks are easy to fall off above the stone wall, and a promenade was built to prevent falling rocks from hurting tourists.
The first half was okay, everyone went up the stairs, admiring the waterfall next to them while walking.
But in the second half, the stone steps are steep and precipitous, and you have to be careful at each step, for fear that any step will be missed and knocked.
Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, and Yang Haoyu are better, they are older after all.
The children are full of energy and don't feel tired at all, and they are working hard to climb the mountain.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui were younger, and they began to cry when they crawled to the back.
But such a steep stone step, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to hold the child, so he could only drag and coax the child to go up.
It took a lot of work, and finally climbed to the top of the mountain.
Regardless of July, the weather at the bottom of the mountain is hot, but the top of the mountain is still gusting cold, and the temperature is nearly ten degrees lower than that at the bottom of the mountain.
Thanks to the thick clothes that everyone is wearing, they only feel chilly, but they are not freezing.
Standing on the mountain peak overlooking the Tianchi Lake, a pool of clear green water, like a piece of beautiful jade, inlaid in the center of the sixteen peaks.
Surrounded by peaks, the sky and clouds are so beautiful.
Because of the occlusion of Tianwen Peak, the whole view of Tianchi Lake cannot be seen from the north **** mountain, but the scene hidden by these peaks adds a bit of mysterious beauty to Tianchi Lake.
"Oh, what luck, I saw Tianchi today.
When we had dinner yesterday, we heard people say that some people could not see Tianchi after several visits.
Every time it comes up, it rains, or else there is fog. "People around are sighing.
Xu Shiyan and his wife looked at each other and suddenly smiled, didn't they? When Xu Shiyan came last year, it just caught up with the rain.
"Come on, I'll take pictures for you." Xu Shiyan greeted everyone, and took a group photo for everyone on the main peak.
Especially in front of the tablet with the inscription written by the old man himself, the big guys took their own pictures and took a group photo together.
Xu Shiyan also asked passers-by for help and took a group photo of them together.
While everyone was taking pictures, a thick fog came from nowhere.
The water surface of Tianchi was instantly covered by water mist, and the mist rolled and danced on the water surface, like a fairyland.
The peaks are also looming in the dense fog, adding a bit of mystery.
Tourists are in the thick fog, hazy, and seem to have a bit of immortality.
After a while, a gust of strong wind suddenly blows away a corner of the thick fog on the water.
Tianchi has been lifted the mysterious veil, looming, adding a bit of mysterious and quiet charm.
The wind continued to blow, the dense fog gradually dissipated, and the Tianchi Lake gradually appeared in front of people's eyes.
"The fog is gone, the fog is gone, look quickly." The crowd exclaimed and cheered happily.
Such a scene is really rare. No wonder everyone is so excited.
Xu Shiyan and the others lingered on the top of the mountain for a while, took a lot of photos, then turned to the other side, followed the path between the mountain peaks, and headed towards the water surface of Tianchi Lake.
At this time, tourists can touch the water surface of Tianchi.
It's just that this road is very steep and not easy to walk. It's okay when you go down, but it's hard to go up.
However, this did not affect the enthusiasm of the crowd. Many people walked along the path towards the water surface of Tianchi.
Don’t look at it from above as if you are looking at the water surface of Tianchi very close, in fact there is an altitude difference of nearly 400 meters in the middle.
It takes a long way to go down from the hillside.
When I was at the top of the mountain, it felt like Tianchi was not that big.
Some people even belittle it after seeing Tianchi, what’s the big deal, isn’t it just a footbath?
But when everyone gets closer and closer to the water surface, they feel the vastness of the waters in front of them. The shock is something that cannot be experienced when overlooking from the top of the mountain.
At the end of this path, there is a stone protruding into the water of Tianchi, which is called the Tianchi Stone.
Everyone came to the Sky-Mending Stone, squatted down and gently touched the water of the Tianchi Lake.
The water in the pool was crystal clear and icy cold. Some people couldn't help but filled a pot of Tianchi water with the kettle they brought.
Xu Shiyan couldn't avoid it either. He happened to run out of the water he brought, so he also filled a pot of water with a water bottle, intending to save it and go back for testing.
After all, this is a very rare opportunity. After a few more years, they will not be allowed to come to the edge of Tianchi Lake, and they will not be able to touch the water of Tianchi Lake.
Someone threw a coin into the pool, and saw that the coin was dangling as if it never fell to the bottom.
In fact, it is because the water is too clear.
When you get here, you must take photos as souvenirs. These will be the most precious commemorations and memories. When the children grow up, they will not have this opportunity.
So Xu Shiyan, the photo-crazed demon, took a lot of photos for everyone, and then he took the children back with a lot of enthusiasm.
Don't look easy, but it's hard to go back.
Such a steep hillside, the mountain itself is loose, so it is not too strenuous to walk.
This time, even Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, and Yang Haoyu couldn't help but start complaining, they were so tired.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying could only coax, Xu Shiyan carried Xu Haiqing behind his back, and pulled Xu Haiyuan.
Yang Junxian helped carry Xu Jinhui on his back, Su Anying pulled Xu Jinping, and Ji Yufeng pulled Yang Haoyu.
When they returned to the main peak, they were all exhausted. They sat on the rocks and couldn't get up.
Before they set off in the morning, they brought some food, including cakes and tins. They didn’t care too much at the moment, so they quickly opened them and gave them to the children.
Just like that, rest while eating, at least take a breather.
After the children had had enough rest, they went down the mountain again.
Just as they were going down, another burst of fog shrouded the top of the mountain in hazy mist.
Everyone was hidden in the mist and slowly walked down the steps.
The way up and down the mountain is the same, and it is still the same stone steps.
Fortunately, there were few people going up the mountain in the afternoon, and they all went down the mountain, so it was unlikely that we would run into each other head-on.
It’s just that the stone steps are steep, and it’s not easy to go down the mountain. It’s tiring to climb the steps one by one.
After much difficulty, when they got down to the climbing point when they came, everyone felt that their legs were weak and their calves were straight.
Looking back at the mountain, the gray-white mountain is majestic and majestic, and the Changbai Waterfall is rushing endlessly.
Everyone has infinite pride and ambition in their hearts, and they have climbed Changbai Mountain.
"Well, let's live on the mountain tonight, don't go down the mountain, anyway, there are places to eat on this mountain.
Stay for one night, and you can wake up to watch the sunrise tomorrow morning. "Xu Shiyan suggested, looking at the children who were exhausted and listless.
There are hotels and restaurants on the mountain, but they are more expensive.
This is also a rare experience. In another twenty years, all these hotels on the mountain will be moved.
When you come out to play, you can't feel bad about money. Besides, they are not the ones who are short of money, so they might as well stay on the mountain for one night.
Otherwise, these brats probably wouldn't be able to make it down the mountain by car, so they all fell asleep from exhaustion.
Just like that, everyone found a restaurant nearby, ordered a few stir-fried dishes, and each had a big bowl of rice.
In the restaurant on this mountain, I started to gobble up.
Although the children ate something on the mountain, they were too tired to climb the mountain, and there was not enough to eat.
Now, all the hungry wolves, even Yang Haoyu, who always eats very delicately, eats fast this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 560: Watching the sunrise from the top of the mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 560 Watching the sunrise from the top of the mountain
After eating enough, the group found a hotel nearby.
Not to mention, this hotel is really good, the accommodation conditions are okay, and you can also soak in hot springs.
This is very exciting. It is rare to come to Changbai Mountain and soak in a hot spring to relieve fatigue. It is simply not too beautiful.
Of course, the price of a hotel with such a good condition is definitely not cheap, more than double the price of the hotel at the foot of the mountain.
Fortunately, everyone agreed, so I booked a room, arranged a place to stay, and then went to the hot spring pool to soak in the hot spring under the leadership of the hotel service staff.
The hot spring here is not like the later generations, you need to wear a swimsuit.
This is a separate pool for men and women, each soaking their own.
The most amazing thing is that this is an open-air pool. When you look up, you can see the main peak in the distance.
Fortunately, the hot spring pool is on the hillside, and there are steep cliffs below, which no one can see.
People who are tired from climbing the mountain, soaked in the warm spring water, feel that the pores of the whole body are opened, which is very comfortable.
The children are no longer crying and tired, and playing in the water is so much fun.
Xu Haiqing is a bastard, and he deliberately poured water on others.
Thanks to the fact that there are no outsiders at the moment, it won't be annoying.
Xu Shiyan grabbed his youngest son directly, tickled him, and made Xu Hai giggle, not daring to play tricks again.
The hot springs can’t be soaked for too long, and it’s getting dark outside, so it’s not good to continue.
So everyone led the children out of the hot spring and returned to their respective rooms to rest.
It was exhausting to climb the mountain this day, and I had just soaked in the hot springs again, and now I was so lazy that I lay down on the bed and didn't want to get up at all.
The children were so exhausted that they fell asleep almost as soon as they touched the pillows, and even snored all the time.
Xu Shiyan and his wife were even more tired, and they couldn't take care of talking and chatting at the moment, so they quickly fell asleep.
This sleep was so sound, not even turning over.
But the habit of getting up early for many years is there, and a biological clock has been formed.
In addition, Xu Shiyan was thinking about going to see the sunrise, so the couple woke up before four o'clock in the morning.
Then dig the kids out of bed and dress them.
Take them out of the hotel, come to the steps of the hot spring again, and look east.
In summer, the sunrise is very early, so Xu Shiyan and the others came out a bit late.
When they stood on the steps, a round of red sun had jumped out of the ground, reflecting the eastern sky into an orange-red color.
The mountains are shrouded in the morning light, and the rising red sun reflects the original blue-blue mist like smoke into a purple-red color, like a dream.
"Dad, the sunrise on the top of the mountain is so beautiful, it's so beautiful."
In the early morning, the temperature on the mountain was a bit low, but none of the children shouted that it was cold, and they were all fascinated by the sight in front of them.
Especially the three older children who are already in school already have the ability to appreciate beauty.
At this moment, the three children have been immersed in the beauty of nature, feeling relaxed and happy, and sighed inadvertently.
"Wow, that sun is so beautiful, like the salted duck egg yolk that grandma pickled."
In the eyes of foodies, everything is delicious.
For Xu Haiqing, it would be great if he could take a bite of the big sun in front of him, it must be better than duck egg yolk.
When everyone heard this, they couldn't help laughing, and burst out laughing.
Xu Jinping looked at her silly younger brother, and couldn't help but sigh, "You, you have a heart for eating, and I really convinced you."
Anyway, this time Xu Jinping didn't call her younger brother a pig, but only sighed.
Some people can't change the nature of foodies no matter how much they do.
"Dad, hurry up and take a picture. When we go back, I must draw the sunrise scene. It's so beautiful."
Xu Jinping hurriedly urged Xu Shiyan to take a picture of the scene in front of her.
Xu Shiyan nodded with a smile, quickly took out the camera, clicked and took several pictures, this time only the scenery, not the people.
Everyone stayed here for a while, and the mountain wind seemed to be a little cold.
The children were still yawning continuously. Seeing this, Xu Shiyan simply took the children back to the hotel.
It was still early, and everyone didn't care about that, and fell asleep under the covers.
When I woke up again, my stomach was already rumbling with hunger, and it was bright outside.
So I hurried up to pack up and find a place to eat.
Climbed the mountain, saw the Tianchi Lake, and enjoyed the sunrise.
The scenic spots on the North Slope have not been fully developed these days, neither the underground forest nor the small Tianchi, let alone the Lvyuantan.
There is nothing fun on the mountain, so a group of people went down the mountain by car.
Go back to the foot of the mountain, find a place to buy some Korean specialties such as rice cakes, rice sausages, etc., and then return to Songjiang River by car, which is the end of this trip to Changbai Mountain.
"Dad, where shall we go next time?"
The children seemed to have more than enough to say. When getting off the car, Xu Jinping couldn't help but ask her father.
"In the future, our west **** will also be developed. Dad will take you to the west **** to see Tianchi. You can see the whole picture of Tianchi here."
Xu Shiyan touched the top of his daughter's head and promised.
"Then when will it be?" Xu Jinping seemed dissatisfied with her father's answer, so she asked again.
Until when? If everything is fully developed, it is estimated that it will be many years later.
In fact, I can go up in the past two years. The main reason is that climbing the mountain is too tiring. For these little kids, it is probably a bit difficult.
"In two more years, when your younger brother and the others are older, they won't be crying all over the mountain." Xu Shiyan laughed.
The trip to Changbai Mountain was successfully concluded, and Xu Shiyan sent the negatives to a photo studio for development.
The pot of Tianchi water was sent to half of the water for testing, and the other half was put into bottles for specimens.
After testing, Tianchi water is rich in various minerals and is extremely rare mineral water.
Of course, this is just to test and know the result. It is impossible for Tianchi water to be developed.
After the vacation was over, Xu Shiyan and his wife returned to their respective jobs.
As for children, learn what you should learn, and act wild if you should play wild.
Anyway, the two older ones are much more stable now, and Xu Jinping, that worry-free girl, watches the two younger ones study all day long.
The youngest of the two is six years old. Anyway, he is not as evil as his elder brother and sister. Compared with other children in Yuhong Class, he is quite outstanding.
After all, there are older brothers and sisters watching and teaching them a lot of things, which is not the case for other families.
With Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping taking care of their younger siblings, Xu Shiyan and his wife are relieved.
The couple can do whatever they need to do, and they don't have to worry too much at home.
On July 24th, Han Liwei and his wife returned from the capital together with their children, Zhou Guilan and Li Yuexiu.
Han Liwei's study in the capital has ended, but his original unit was withdrawn after the war in 1985.
Most of them were demobilized, and others belonged to various places.
So Han Liwei was assigned to a certain place in Guangshui, Hubei Province, which is said to be a mountainous area not far from the Dabie Mountains.
Han Liwei was among the best in all subjects during his study at school.
And led the team out on missions several times, all of which were successfully completed with excellent performance.
Officially promoted to regimental level.
For Han Liwei's age, this is pretty good.

chapters.title: Chapter 561: Han Liwei and his wife go home
chapters.content:
Chapter 561 Han Liwei and his wife go home
As far as Han Liwei's level is concerned, Xu Shiqin can follow suit and arrange everything in the organization.
But Xu Shiqin just gave birth, and they are another couple.
It is said that it is quite remote there, and the conditions may not be so good. Han Liwei was worried that the two babies were too young for Xu Shiqin to take care of them alone.
Right now, there are two mothers standing in front of me to help and take care of her, but they can’t follow her there anymore, can the family leave it alone? Han Liwei was in a difficult situation.
Later, it was Li Yuexiu who said that it would be better to let Xu Shiqin go home first, since there are many people at home who can help take care of the children.
Wait for Han Liwei to settle down there and let Xu Shiqin take the children over there after the two children are one year old.
If it doesn’t work, go find a nanny over there, since their family can afford it anyway.
Besides, after the two children were born, the family members haven't seen each other yet.
Grandpa and grandpa are looking forward to it, so they have to go back.
Han Liwei also thought about it, why not **** his wife and children, mother and mother-in-law back home while he still has a little vacation.
Wait for him to settle there, and then find a way to take his wife there.
Just like that, the couple took care of things in the capital.
Xu Shiqin's shop in the capital chose two capable apprentices as store managers to be responsible for maintaining the daily operation of the shop.
Xu Shiqin will send the clothing design drawings every month, and the store will be responsible for new product styles.
The courtyard where they originally lived was temporarily entrusted to take care of it, and they will discuss whether to rent it out or what.
Everything was packed, the four adults took their two children and took a lot of things back in the car.
At noon on July 24th, Xu Shiyan, Han Limin, and Han Lixin took their cars to the train station to pick them up.
"Liwei, this way."
Han Liwei's clothes were so conspicuous that he could be seen from afar. Han Limin hurriedly waved his hand towards the inside of the station and shouted.
"Mom, it's the eldest brother and the second brother who came to pick up the station. Come on, let's go this way."
Han Liwei saw Xu Shiyan and Han Limin outside the exit, and hurriedly waved at them.
Then, protecting his wife and children, and two mothers, he followed the flow of people out of the station and walked out of the station.
Xu Shiyan and others came forward to welcome them, and everyone was very happy to meet each other.
The daughter-in-laws of Su Anying and Han Limin hurried to the two old ladies, and each quickly took one.
"Hey, whose little baby is this, he looks really handsome, like Liwei."
"That's the eldest, boy, Li Min's daughter-in-law is holding this in her arms is the second, daughter.
My daughter is like Seqin. "Zhou Guilan said with a smile all over her face.
Su Anying hugged her little nephew, and looked at her niece in Liu Chunhua's arms.
Sure enough, the appearance of the two children is somewhat different, not that similar.
"I really didn't expect that another pair of twins came out of our family.
Mom, you didn't think about it carefully, did any of our elders ever have a pair? "
Su Anying is actually very curious about this. People say that most twins have heredity, but neither the Su family nor the Xu family.
As a result, Su Anying gave birth to a pair, and Xu Shiqin also gave birth to a pair. What's going on?
Zhou Guilan shook her head, "No, your father is the only son, and I haven't heard of it from above.
My natal family doesn’t have any either, who knows what’s going on?
Forget it, don’t worry about that, the child is born, what’s the use of caring about that?
It is better to have a pair of children. The two children grow up together and have a companion. "
"Yes, yes, what the in-laws say is reasonable. It doesn't matter so much, as long as the two children are healthy and brought up."
Over there, Li Yuexiu also smiled.
Xu Shiyan and the others came in three jeeps, and the cars of Lin Qiyue and Li Bingzhuo were borrowed.
It happened that Xu Shiyan and Han Limin and Han Lixin each drove a car, and the others got into the car respectively.
Just like that, three jeeps drove all the way from the train station back to Yichang Han's house.
As soon as the car stopped at the gate of the Han family, the children of the Han family and the Xu family all gathered around.
"Grandma, third uncle, third aunt, quickly let me see my younger siblings." Han Zhenwen and the others leaned over and stretched their necks to look.
"Grandma, sister-in-law, little uncle, we also need to look after our younger siblings."
Brother and sister Xu Haiyuan didn't dare to lag behind, they raised their feet and looked into the arms of their mother and Aunt Han.
"Come on, let's go into the room first, come in and sit down and talk, you guys have to watch."
Han Limin's daughter-in-law Liu Chunhua laughed when she saw this, and beckoned the children to go into the house.
So, Han Zhenwen supported Li Yuexiu, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping supported Zhou Guilan.
At this time, it can be seen that whoever's grandma loves, this grandson is not in vain.
Han Liwei supported Xu Shiqin, Su Anying and Liu Chunhua were holding the baby, and Xu Shiyan was carrying large and small luggage, and the group entered the Han's house just like that.
Xu Chenghou and Han Wenzhong had been waiting in the room for a long time. When they heard voices and footsteps outside, the two old men couldn't sit still anymore and hurried out of the room.
"Hey, they're all back, hurry up and get in the house." Han Wenzhong grinned happily.
Everyone entered the room together, and Su Anying and Liu Chunlan put the two babies on the kang.
The two children slept a lot in the car, and now they opened their eyes as soon as they put down.
The two babies didn't cry, they just rolled their eyes and looked at the roof.
Li Yuexiu and Zhou Guilan hurried forward, checked the diaper, saw that the diaper was not wet, and quickly carried it outside to urinate back.
Then Xu Shiqin took one to another room for breastfeeding, and the other was fed milk powder.
No way, the two children can eat quite well, but Xu Shiqin doesn't have enough milk, so he can only feed them mixed.
Fortunately, these two babies are not picky, and they can eat breast milk or formula milk, whichever is fine.
After feeding and hiccupping, the two babies began to walk around in the arms of everyone in turn, this one was rare, and the other kissed.
Anyway, the two children have a good temper, neither crying nor fussing. When Han Wenzhong hugged the boy, the little one smiled at his grandpa.
But Han Wenzhong was so beautiful that he wanted to grin to the base of his ears.
"Look, look, Zhenlin is smiling at me."
The two children of Han Liwei's family, the boy is called Han Zhenlin, and the girl is Han Yu.
The Han family has been male for several lifetimes, and it is rare to see a female doll, which is the treasure of the whole family.
When Han Liwei called back and asked Han Wenzhong to name it, Han Wenzhong thought about it for three days, but he still couldn't decide what to call it.
Finally, I found a teacher from Canchang Elementary School and named him Han Yu.
Yu means beautiful jade. It means that the little girl is the treasure and beautiful jade of the Han family.
Xu Chenghou hugged his granddaughter Han Yu, and was completely attracted by this little girl.
"Xiao Yu'er looks like Shiqin when she was a child, she is prettier and chubby than Shiqin at that time."
Xu Chenghou hugged his granddaughter, remembering how his daughter looked when she was born.
At that time, the family conditions were poor. When Xu Shiqin was born, she was thin and small, just like a kitten.
Unexpectedly, so many years have passed in a blink of an eye, and the daughters have daughters.
"Grandpa, let me hug Xiao Yu'er too?" Xu Jinping leaned over and looked at the little cousin very much.
Aunt and uncle, blood nature, this is really amazing.
"Pingping, Xiao Yu'er is still too young, you can't hold her now, wait for her to grow up."
Before Xu Chenghou could speak, Su Anying over there spoke first.
Babies who are less than 100 days old are too soft and their necks are not strong enough to stand up. It is better to be careful.

chapters.title: Chapter 562: Xu family reunion
chapters.content:
Chapter 562 Xu family reunion
Han Liwei and his wife came back with their two children. Naturally, it was a great joy. The Han family prepared a sumptuous meal, and the big guys had a lively reunion together.
Xu Chenghou's family had dinner at Han's house, and they agreed with Han Liwei to let them rest for a day, and come to pick up their family the day after tomorrow to get together.
Han Liwei naturally had no objection. It was rare for him to come back, so of course his father-in-law had to go.
Xu Chenghou and his wife took their children and grandchildren away and returned to their home.
After returning home, Xu Chenghou had to inquire about Zhou Guilan's situation in the capital.
Xu Chenghou felt relieved when he learned that the son-in-law was good to his daughter and mother-in-law.
Then let Xu Shiyan call the brothers and tell them to come back the day after tomorrow to be lively.
On the twenty-eighth day of the fifth lunar month this year, brothers Xu Shixian and the others were going to come back to celebrate the old man's birthday, but Xu Chenghou refused.
The old wife is in the capital, what kind of birthday did he celebrate at home? Not in that mood.
This time the old wife came back, and the daughter, uncle, and grandson all came back, and it happened to call the children and grandchildren back for a gathering, and that was the same thing.
Dad said, Xu Shiyan didn't hurry? So I called my brothers one by one.
Xu Shixian and the others received a call and learned that Han Liwei and his wife had returned with their child in their arms. What else do they have to say?
He quickly agreed, saying that he would definitely come back the day after tomorrow.
It happened to be Sunday on the 26th, and everyone who went to work had a rest, and Xu Shian, who went out to study, also came back.
So on the morning of the 26th, the brothers all carried a lot of things and entered the door one after another.
"Sixth Sister, Sixth Brother-in-law, I hope you are back.
Sister Six gave birth in the capital, and we couldn't help take care of her because we were far away.
These are clothes bought for the children, these are bought for the sixth younger sister, to make up for the body. "Xue Xiulin smiled as soon as she entered the door.
"Hey, let me see the two children, these two children look really good, they are rare people with tiger heads and tiger brains."
Over there, Chen Chunling put down the things in her hands, and went to the kang to see the two babies.
The two babies are full and have urinated. It is hot in summer, so there is no need to wrap them.
Wearing a small shirt and underpants, lying on the kang, kicking his legs and having fun by himself, that small appearance is really rare.
Wei Mingrong and Wu Qiuyan also put down their things, chatted with Zhou Guilan and Xu Shiqin, and went to see the children.
These aunts took turns holding the baby, you coaxed for a while and I teased for a while.
It is probably due to the fact that there are many Han family members. These two babies do not recognize their birth, and anyone can hug them.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were very happy to see their children and grandchildren back.
Call several grandchildren to the front, ask the older ones how they are studying, and ask the younger ones if they have grown taller.
"Fourth, your Jingyi is going to elementary school this fall, right?
Is the old Wujia Jingwen coming next year? Are you all going to the Yuhong class? "
There is a baby in the family, Xu Chenghou is not good at smoking, he only plays with the cigarette bag and pot, rubbing the foam in the cigarette bag, and has a dry addiction.
"Well, Dad, Jingyi is going to elementary school this fall.
There is no Yuhong class at Daying, anyway, I teach a little at home. " Xu Shide responded.
Daying’s conditions are incomparable to Donggang’s. There is a Yuhong Class in Xianrenqiao Town, but it’s too far away.
