Six or seven miles away, the child is too young to go there.
So Xu Shide can only let Xu Jingyi stay at home, and he has time to teach him how to read and count.
"Father, there is no Yuhong class on our side.
I was still thinking about discussing with my parents, would it be okay to let Jingwen come to Yuhong class in autumn?
It happened to be with the third brother Jia Pingping and Huihui, and asked Pingping to teach our Jia Jingwen.
This child is a bit stupid, and Chunling and I are both busy, so we really don't have time to teach her. "Xu Shixiang glanced at his father and asked tentatively.
Xu Chenghou was stunned for a moment when he heard what the fifth child said, and then raised his head to look at the fifth daughter-in-law.
"This is the only one in your family. Jingwen comes to study, doesn't your wife want to panic?"
These two treat their daughters like eyeballs, can they be separated?
Over there, just as Chen Chunling was about to say something, Xu Shixiang rushed to speak.
"Yes, what else is there? The child is studying here for her own good."
Xu Chenghou nodded, "That's fine, anyway, Jingwen is old enough.
The Autumn Yuhong class started, and I was with Huihui and Haiqing, and I happened to have a companion. "
They are all descendants of the Xu family. The old man welcomes anyone who comes to live.
At the beginning, Xu Shide was angry that he couldn't figure it out, so he refused to let him go.
Of course, Xu Shide was also reluctant to let the child come over, otherwise he would discuss it with the old man, and Xu Chenghou would soften his heart.
"Feng'er? How are you doing? Are you going to be in the third year of middle school in autumn?
Next year in the senior high school entrance examination, what school do you plan to take? Is it technical secondary school or high school?
What about wavelet? You should be in the second grade of junior high school in autumn, right? How are your final grades? "
Children are the future hope of the Xu family. As the head of the family, Xu Chenghou still hopes that his grandchildren will have a bright future.
So when I met the children, I had to ask about their academic performance.
Xu Jinfeng was born on the 23rd of the winter month in 1971. Her birthday was too young, so she started school a year later.
At first, I went to elementary school in a big house, but later I moved out of the big house, transferred to Forestry Bureau Primary School, and then moved to the county.
In those years, the things learned in different places were different, and the quality of teaching in the big house was not good. Xu Jinfeng couldn't keep up with his studies, so he couldn't stay a level.
Otherwise, he should have passed the senior high school entrance examination this year.
Xu Jinfeng, who is already seventeen years old, is already a slim girl. When she heard her grandfather ask her, she smiled embarrassedly.
"Grandpa, I plan to take the high school entrance examination. The technical secondary school examination is too difficult. I feel that I can pass the entrance examination."
In this year and month, the distribution of technical secondary school graduation packages and the ability to work early are particularly popular.
Of course, the scores are also high. Only children who study well can pass the exam, and those with average grades are not good enough.
Fifteen-year-old Xu Haibo is just like Xu Shi'an in height, already over 1.7 meters tall, a serious young man.
Facing Grandpa's question, he scratched his head in embarrassment.
"Grandpa, I'm average. The class can be around 20, and the technical secondary school is not enough anyway."
Xu Chenghou had high hopes for both his eldest grandson and his eldest granddaughter, and sincerely hoped for their success, but he couldn't help but sigh when he heard the child's achievements.
"Okay, if you don't pass the technical secondary school, go to high school.
You must study hard so that you can be admitted to a university and be assigned a good job in the future. "
These big ones can't be counted on from the way they look like, alas, let's look at Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, they are probably the only ones who can produce food.
Xu Chenghou sighed silently in his heart, but of course he couldn't say it out loud.
Even if Xu Chenghou doesn't say it, the big guys can actually see it.
Not to mention anything else, the wall is covered with certificates of awards, all of which belong to Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, who can't see it?
Beside the award certificate, there is a painting, the scene of the sea of ​​clouds and the sunrise, the artistic conception is particularly good, and the artist is also quite good.
The most important thing is that the characters on the inscription above are neat and elegant in Zanhua lower script, which is particularly beautiful.
"Father, who painted that painting on the wall? It's really pretty." Xu Shixiang couldn't help asking.
"Oh, that was drawn by Pingping.
A few days ago, your third brother led them to Changbai Mountain, watched the sunrise on the mountain, and when she came back, Pingping drew this painting.
I looked pretty good, so I stuck it on the wall. "Xu Chenghou glanced at the painting on the wall and said casually.

chapters.title: Chapter 563: a bunch of bastards
chapters.content:
Chapter 563 A group of bastards
"Drawing by Pingping? How old is she, is she good at writing and drawing?"
The Xu Shixian brothers exclaimed for a while, and looked at Xu Jinping, who was coaxing the baby over there, with a look of disbelief.
They saw the painting just now, but no one thought about Xu Jinping, thinking that whoever wanted it.
"Yes, Pingping learned painting, calligraphy, and chess from Brother Chu. She started learning last winter vacation and has never stopped.
I usually do my homework when I get home from school, and practice for a while after I finish.
Practice more on Saturday and Sunday afternoons if you have nothing to do, and practice every day during summer vacation. What's wrong? "
Xu Chenghou looked puzzled, his granddaughter is quite talented and hardworking in this area, it's just a painting, what else?
"Old Mr. Chu can teach children calligraphy and painting?" Xu Shixiang's tone was a little eager, and he looked at his wife.
"Yes, brother Chu knows a lot, what's wrong? You still don't believe what I say?"
Xu Cheng gave Lao Wu a thick look, and looked at his virtue, what is it worth making such a fuss about.
"No, no, Dad, how can I not believe your words.
I mean, Pingping is very good, she has learned so much from Mr. Chu. "
Xu Shixiang hurriedly apologized, how dare he question what his father said? Isn't that waiting to be cleaned up?
Xu Chenghou's expression softened a little, and he looked up at the sons with disgust.
"Keep your voice down, don't scare my grandson."
This is all a fuss, as for it? bumpkin.
Xu Shixiang and the others were a little embarrassed, they were really shocked.
No one expected that Mr. Chu not only has superb medical skills, but also has a good research on piano, chess, calligraphy and painting.
Xu Shixiang's eyes were even more fiery, and he pursed and winked at his daughter-in-law.
Chen Chunling over there sighed and could only nod.
Xu Shixiang was very happy to see his wife nodding, so he chatted with Han Liwei and the others very enthusiastically.
Ask about the situation of Han Liwei and his wife in the capital, and then inquire about Han Liwei's next arrangements.
When they heard that Han Liwei was now at the regimental level, they were all amazed.
It seems that Han Liwei made a lot of contributions back then, and he was able to reach this level in his early thirties.
A group of brothers admired and envied Han Liwei, chatting more enthusiastically around Han Liwei.
The men chat, while the women go to the kitchen to cook.
Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu are both grown up, so they have to help pick and wash vegetables.
Xu Jinping led a few younger sisters back to her vegetable garden, where she picked watermelons, cantaloupe, apricots, plums, and sand fruits to eat.
The vegetable garden of Xu’s family is huge, and the hillsides on both sides are full of various fruit trees. You can pick whatever you want to eat.
As for the boys, they couldn't stay idle.
Xu Haibo led his younger brothers, went straight to the back woods, and ran to climb trees and knock down pine cones.
At this time, the pine cone has not yet fully grown, and the seed kernels inside are very watery.
But the children didn't care about that, they swished up the tree and hit more than a dozen towers to get down.
Then in the open space in the woods, I got some dead branches of pine trees or something, pressed the tower down, and ignited directly.
Thanks to this being the end of July, the woods are not so dry in summer, and the ground is covered with green grass, so at least there was no fire.
Waiting for the firewood to burn out, the pine cones underneath are also cooked.
So he pulled out the pine cone with a stick, kicked it standing upright, and the pine nuts flew around.
Xu Haiyang, Xu Haiqing and the others quickly picked it up and ate it.
"Why doesn't it smell delicious?" Xu Haiqing ate a few in a row, and couldn't help frowning.
The pine nuts are tender and juicy. They have just grown and are not fragrant at all.
For a foodie, this is unbearable.
"Oh, it's good to eat some, I still choose.
It’s not the elder brother and the second brother climbing the tree, can you eat it? I can really pick and choose. "
Beside   , Xu Haiyang glanced at the youngest cousin.
A small child with a sharp mouth, is it delicious to eat? Why does he think it's delicious?
Xu Haiqing curled his lips, "Brother Zhenwen and Brother Jianguo can also climb trees and pine cones. When I grow up, I will too."
Boys are skinny, and climbing trees and houses is a daily operation.
Xu Haiqing was still young, so everyone didn’t allow him to climb trees, but Han Zhenwen, Huang Shuqing, Yang Jianguo and others who played together could climb trees.
Don't look at Xu Haiqing who is the youngest in the family, has no sense of presence, and is suppressed by her sister all day long.
Leaving his sister, this kid is not easy to provoke, his tongue is quite fierce, and he always speaks in a hurry.
Xu Haiyang was so choked by his little cousin that he simply turned around and left, not hesitating to talk to the little boy.
Xu Haiqing looked indifferent, and turned around to find his brother.
Xu Haiyuan is actually not interested in these things, but his brothers rarely come back, so it is not easy for him to leave the guests behind and go to study with his teacher.
What can I do? I can only be patient and play with them.
Seeing Xu Haiqing approaching, Xu Haiyuan quickly patted the ashes on his younger brother.
"It doesn't matter what you eat, pay attention to your clothes, be careful not to get your clothes dirty, my mother will smoke."
This guy, eating too much, made dust all over his body, as well as his hands, he was really convinced.
Xu Haiqing just laughed, no matter what his brother said, he would not refute, and even gave the pine nuts in his hand to his brother to eat.
Xu Haiyuan glanced at his younger brother's little black hand, took it with disgust, and put his mouth on it.
"It's too early, this pine nut kernel has just grown up, it hasn't grown yet, it's not fragrant."
At this time, hitting pine nuts is purely a scourge, and it is boring to eat.
"Well, I said it was not good just now, and Brother Haiyang still said me."
Finally someone agrees with him, Xu Haiqing nodded again and again, his brother is better, as he thought.
"Come on, talk less, eat more if you like it, and eat less if you don't like it."
Xu Haiyuan rubbed his younger brother's head, and whispered to him.
After all, it was the elder brothers who worked hard to climb the tree and beat it down, and then cooked it. No matter whether it is delicious or not, you can't say it in front of others.
"Oh, I got it." Xu Haiqing nodded, and went to pick up pine nuts and chewed for fun.
There is nothing to eat here. The pine nuts are not fragrant, but they are better than nothing.
Besides, he has to show some face for the hard work of his brothers, right?
A group of brats worked in the forest for a long time, regardless of whether the pine nuts were fragrant or not, until the last dozen or so towers were all eaten up.
It happened that the charcoal fire in the fire was almost lit, and there were still some sparks left.
These stinky boys just **** and watered it out, and then they came out of the woods and went home to eat.
As soon as I entered the house, I saw a few girls washing melons and fruits.
So this one took a piece of watermelon, that one took a cantaloupe, and didn’t care about those, just picked it up and ate it.
Half-sized children eat poor old people. For such a big child, the stomach is like a bottomless pit.
Anything can be put in it, so what are those pine nuts? Not enough teeth.
So Xilihulu, several people actually ate most of the pot of melons and fruits.
"You guys, you ran away when you went to pick melons. Pingping and the others picked them up and washed them. You can eat them better than the other."
Xu Jinfeng came out with a basin of water and splashed it in the yard. Looking at the group of younger brothers who could eat more than pigs, he was speechless for a while.

chapters.title: Chapter 564: Not what it used to be
chapters.content:
Chapter 564 is not what it used to be
In the kitchen, Su Anying's sisters-in-law were busy cooking.
It’s a lot of trouble to cook and cook in summer. Fortunately, there are a lot of cooked food prepared at home. Simply stir-fry a few dishes, and then make some cold dishes.
The sisters-in-law are cooking and chatting at the same time. The content of the chat is nothing more than the men and children of each family.
Both Xue Xiulin and Wei Mingrong were worried about their children's studies.
"I don't agree with others, but I admire Yingzi, how do you raise your child?
Yuanyuan and Pingping don't worry about anything, they study so well. "
Xue Xiulin sighed while mixing vegetables.
"Sister-in-law, children have their own way out, so it's useless for us to worry about it.
You just look at the two older ones in my family, and you don’t see the virtues of the two younger ones.
You don't know, Pingping makes the two little ones angry all day long, and she is like a fire.
Especially the fourth child, who refuses to eat, refuses to listen to what he says, and refuses to fight. I am worried for him. "
Su Anying was cooking over there, and when she heard what her sister-in-law said, she could only sigh helplessly.
Every family has unmanageable children, and the two younger ones are incomparable to their elder brothers and sisters, which is enough to worry about.
Besides, the two big ones, if one day they become stubborn, it would be terrible.
"It's pretty good if two of the four are good, what are you thinking about?
The older brothers and sisters are promising, and they will be able to pull the younger brothers and sisters in the future.
Besides, you two are so capable, why can't you arrange for that child Haiqing? "
Xue Xiulin shook her head, let alone a family, it’s pretty impressive to have one.
Just like the third child, without him, would the sixth child be where he is today? Can the second child go to college?
"That's right, sister-in-law three, please be content." Chen Chunling echoed.
"Third sister-in-law, my family Wenwen came to study in Yuhong class in autumn, you let Yuanyuan and Pingping pay more attention.
If there is anything you don't know about homework, let Pingping explain it to you. "
Chen Chunling has also turned the corner now. The environment in which a child lives is very important.
There is a peer around me, and a reminder from time to time is more effective than an adult saying it a hundred times.
Right now, the situation is already obvious. The third sister-in-law is not only the two children studying well, but also Mr. Chu, a capable person who gives advice.
In this year and month, where can I find such a good learning environment?
No matter how much money they spend, they can't find someone like Mr. Chu.
Xu Jingwen didn't say how well she learned, Chen Chunling was content to be half as good as Xu Jinping.
For the sake of her child's future, no matter how reluctant she is, she has to be ruthless.
"Well, I'll tell Pingping and Yuanyuan about this." Su Anying agreed without hesitation.
The five old families want to keep their daughter here to study, Su Anying has no objection.
They are all grandchildren of the old couple. It cannot be said that the children of Xu Shiyan's family can live in the grandparents' house, but the children of other brothers' families can't?
As for asking Xu Jinping to help with homework, the neighbor's child came to ask a question, so he had to help explain it.
My cousin doesn't know how to watch the excitement?
The sisters-in-law are in the kitchen, chatting while cooking, and the atmosphere is quite good.
After all, Su Anying is not what she used to be. The difference is so great that Xue Xiulin and the others can't even think about comparisons.
Not to mention running on others like before, isn't that a joke?
Get along well, and there will be a chance in the future, let the young couple lead them to earn some money or something.
Furthermore, Chen Chunling still wants to send her child to study, and she still expects the child of the third sister-in-law's family to take her daughter with her. Does she dare to offend Su Anying?
As for Wei Mingrong, the man in his family is now the youngest couple paying for college, how dare she talk nonsense?
So, when the level gap is too great, others will not be able to feel jealous.
Because I know that no matter how hard I try to catch up, I won’t be able to catch up, so I might as well make friends, maybe it will be beneficial.
The kitchen was very harmonious, and brothers Xu Shiyan and Han Liwei also had a good chat in the east room.
Han Liwei's current status, even if it is placed in the county, is enough to be seen, and he can sit on an equal footing with Chang Hongfa.
How many brothers from the Xu family can't talk to each other properly?
Han Liwei, on the other hand, didn't put on airs at all. He was still the same as before, talking and laughing in the same way.
Xu Shixiang and his village also grow ginseng. Last fall, Xu Shixiang, together with some cadres in the village, got some ginseng to plant in the ground.
Xu Shiyan is considered an expert in the ginseng industry. Xu Shixiang had to ask his brother about the secret to high yield and good harvest of ginseng.
Xu Shiyan has nothing to hide from his younger brother, so he can give advice when he needs to.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shide next to him also listened attentively.
Nowadays, the ginseng industry in Fusong is booming, but anyone with a bit of ability wants to do something related to ginseng.
Even if you can’t do anything else, why don’t you get some ginseng to plant the head office?
Xu Shixian's job is very leisurely. It's not a problem to go to tend the ginseng land on Sundays. Usually, he can outsource some work to others.
Xu Shixian has already made a plan. This fall, he will plant tens of feet of ginseng soil in the villages around the county seat and plant it with sticks. After three years, he can sell it for some money.
Facing these problems of the brothers, Xu Shiyan explained them patiently, and at the same time explained his point of view again.
"Anyway, in my opinion, it's best not to develop sticks in the past few years.
Especially those who had no foundation at all before, it is easy to fall into it.
I can't help it now, the stall has been rolled out, and I have to do whatever it takes to make money. "
Xu Shiyan knows what the brothers are thinking, and he can tell them everything he can say, and he can listen to them or not
This matter can't be stopped, anyway, as long as you don't complain in the future.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang looked at each other, but neither of them took Xu Shiyan's words to heart.
Those units dare to make tens of thousands of feet, but they count as a fart for tens of feet?
Don't say that ginseng is booming right now, even if you really lose, it won't be worthless, and you can always get back your money.
No matter what business you do, you will lose money and make money. In comparison, planting sticks is considered safe.
The conversation became more and more heated, and when the food was ready and served, they still couldn't stop.
Made a lot of delicious food at noon, and everyone had a lively meal together.
Everyone has to go to work tomorrow and Monday, so Xu Shixian and others all left in the car in the afternoon.
But Han Liwei and his wife were not in a hurry. The two babies fell asleep, and they had to wait for the baby to wake up before going back.
"Third brother, didn't I help rent out those shops of yours before?
The rent is still here with me, and I will bring it to you when I come back next time. "
Su Anying bought several shops in the capital, and the couple didn't have time to take care of them, so they simply rented them out and let Xu Shiqin take care of them.
Xu Shiqin collected the rent and didn't send it back, so he brought it back together this time.
"Then why are you in a hurry? It's okay, let me let you go first."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, he didn't care about the little rent, as long as someone took good care of the shop, the rest didn't matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 565: Han Liwei left
chapters.content:
Chapter 565 Han Liwei leaves
Han Liwei didn't want to make a fuss when he came back this time, he just wanted to go home to be with his parents, wife and children, and he had to leave in a few days.
I don't know what's going on, but the news of his return is still known.
Many people from the People's Armed Forces Department of the county, those stationed in Quanyang, and the Changbai Mountain border guards all came to visit Han's house, and invited Han Liwei to eat and give lectures.
As a result, Han Liwei has not been able to relax at all during the past few days at home, he is very busy all day long.
The Han family is not dissatisfied with this.
Han Wenzhong knew that his son's identity is different now, and these are normal contacts, which are necessary.
On July 29th, Han Liwei set off for Hubei Province.
Before leaving, Han Wenzhong repeatedly told Han Liwei that he must work hard when he arrived in the new place.
The daughter-in-law is not around, but you must pay attention to personal problems.
"Your wife has given birth to two children for you, and now she is taking care of the children at home and cannot accompany you.
If you dare to offend her, brat, I'll break your leg, do you hear? "
Han Wenzhong's words are domineering. He is probably the only one in the whole family who can talk to his son like this.
"Dad, don't worry, I won't.
I have been in love with Shiqin for so many years, and there are two children, how can I have other thoughts? "
Han Liwei was speechless after hearing this. Did his father worry too much?
He is a man who has a family, a business, a wife and a son, so he can't do the thing of abandoning his wife and children.
Han Wenzhong snorted, who would dare to say something like Xindao?
Regiment-level cadres in their early thirties have also made great contributions and received awards.
I went to college again, and I don’t look bad, and I can attract many little girls by being serious.
There is also a cultural troupe in the organization, and there are all kinds of beautiful girls in it.
There is also the hospital, and the nurses in the hospital are also very good-looking. Who knows what will happen to his son?
The big man is away alone, and his wife is in his hometown, so everything is possible?
"Anyway, you just remember it for me. If you dare to have ulterior motives, don't look at me as an old man. It won't take much effort to clean up someone like you."
Han Wenzhong doesn't care about that, he only knows one thing, the most important thing is his daughter-in-law and grandchildren.
If this **** dares to offend his wife, Han Wenzhong can really deal with him.
The rest of the Han family watched with great interest as the old man trained his son, but no one helped Han Liwei.
In the end, Xu Shiqin couldn't stand it anymore, so he hurriedly helped Han Liwei with a few good words.
Then he urged Han Liwei to leave, otherwise he would miss the bus.
Finally, Han Wenzhong spared his son, and together with the others, sent his son to the gate.
Han Liwei stood at the gate, turned around and saluted his family.
"Father, mother, my son has to leave, take care of yourself, I will come back to see you when there is another vacation.
Brother and sister-in-law, I’m not at home, my parents and my wife and children, so I ask my brother and sister-in-law to take care of them.
Daughter-in-law, take care of yourself and take care of Zhenlin and Yuer. "
Everyone felt sour in their eyes, and they tried their best not to let the tears fall.
"Don't worry, we have us at home, you can work with peace of mind outside.
It is your mission and responsibility to defend the home and the country. With people like you, we can live a safe life in the rear. take care. "
Han Limin stepped forward and patted his brother on the shoulder.
Han Liwei looked back at his family again, then turned around and got into the car, leaned out halfway along the window, and waved at the Han family members.
The driver started the car and drove away. Everyone in the Han family kept waving until the car was gone and could no longer be seen.
After Han Liwei left, Xu Shiqin was sad for two days.
But life has to go on, and the two children are waiting to be fed, so there is not so much time to be sentimental.
Xu Shiqin discussed with her in-laws and said that she wanted to take the child back to her mother's house for a few days.
What else can Han Wenzhong and his wife say? Of course you have to agree.
It’s not yet the autumn harvest, the Xu family is not busy, so let’s go back and live for a while.
So, Xu Shiyan and his wife came over and took their sister and nephew home to live with them.
This made Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui very happy. They could look at their little cousins ​​all day long, coaxing the baby to play.
At the beginning of August, Chen Jianzhang, Director of the County Special Products Bureau, reported the "Report on the Development of Ginseng Production and Opinions" to the county.
This report was actually ghostwritten by Xu Shiyan.
In the report, Xu Shiyan expounded his point of view. The main thing is not to blindly expand production, but to prevent the overheating of the ginseng industry.
In case of a large increase in ginseng production in the future, foreign merchants cannot digest it, resulting in a backlog of ginseng products and damage to the interests of ginseng farmers.
However, the county didn't seem to pay much attention to this report, and it didn't take long for it to make a decision to accelerate the development of the industry.
Xu Shiyan could only shake his head and sigh when he heard the news.
Let’s do it, but work hard, just like this, the good times are really coming to an end.
In the blink of an eye, in late August, Xu Shixiang and his wife sent their daughter Xu Jingwen over.
After discussion between Xu Shide and his wife, they also sent Xu Jingyi here, hoping that Xu Jingyi could study in Donggang primary school.
Regarding this, Xu Chenghou and his wife have nothing to say. They are both granddaughters.
Anyway, one sheep is herding, two sheep are herding, and it’s nothing more than eating for multiple children.
Just like that, the Xu family had two more daughters. Xu Jinping and the others had two more playmates.
The children go to and from school together every day. After returning home, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping stared at the homework of their younger siblings.
Anyone who fails to write homework or memorize ancient poems will be punished.
Xu Haiqing found out that he was miserable. After the two cousins ​​came, his status further declined.
Among so many people, he was the worst and received the most punishment.
But what can he do? Who told him to be the youngest one?
With his older brothers and sisters pressing him down, does he dare to resist? If you can't resist, you can only bear it silently.
At the end of August and the beginning of September, Chen Jianzhang, the manager of the ginseng company, participated in the provincial inspection team to Dongyi to investigate Dongyi's ginseng cultivation and processing technology.
At the same time, the county held a meeting and decided to designate September 15th as the Fusong Ginseng Festival.
During the Ginseng Festival, there will be various performances, and celebrities from all walks of life will be invited to participate in various exhibitions.
"Tch, I thought they could play tricks, aren't these the same ones as we did last year?
Follow our **** to learn, what kind of skill is it? "
After hearing the news, Lin Qiyue, Li Bingzhuo and others couldn't help complaining.
This is obviously because they are afraid that Donggang Ginseng City will steal the limelight again this year, so they put aside the ginseng festival in the county.
"Secretary Lin and the head of the field, we don't have to worry about those things. They can do whatever they like. We have more important things to do right now."
Xu Shiyan has no opinion on this. The Fusong Ginseng Festival was held for the first time in 1987 in his last life, so it is not considered a follower.
Although this festival is useless and messed up in the eyes of the majority of farmers, it is considered an annual event in the county, and there is nothing to object to.
"What's more important? What's the matter?" Lin Qiyue and Li Bingzhuo were really attracted and asked quickly.
"Secretary Lin, didn't I mention that to you before, the Eureka World Invention Expo.
You lead the team and send our Changbai Mountain red ginseng to an exhibition? "
Xu Shiyan was speechless for a while, Lin Qiyue forgot such an important matter?

chapters.title: Chapter 566: Participate in the expo
chapters.content:
Chapter 566 Participating in the Expo
Eureka World Invention Expo, September 26th to October 4th, held in Brussels.
China started to pay attention to this expo last year and went to participate in the exhibition.
In 1987 in my last life, Fusong Ginseng Company arranged for people to take their products, that is, Changbaishan red ginseng, to the expo.
Finally, it was unanimously praised by the judges and was awarded the gold medal of the judges' expo.
This is also the highest award for Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng, Fusong Ginseng, so it is famous.
Although some media people later questioned this award, some people said that if you have money, you can participate in this expo, and if you have money, you can win the award.
I also took a certain pharmaceutical company as an example to illustrate that this award does not have much gold content.
However, in those years and months, Fusong ginseng was able to win the world award, which was still very sensational news.
That year, the price of Fusong ginseng rose again, and orders for Changbai Mountain red ginseng were several times higher than in previous years.
At that time, it was really a major event that made the people of Fusong proud.
In this life, because of Xu Shiyan's rebirth, there have been some changes. He took the lead in developing Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng, but some major events have not changed.
A while ago, Chen Jianzhang received the news of the expo.
Since Changbaishan red ginseng is not a product of Ginseng Company, Chen Jianzhang notified Xu Shiyan directly.
Xu Shiyan talked with Lin Qiyue, and wanted Lin Qiyue to lead a team out to participate in this expo.
"Oh, look at me, I've been busy working on our business recently, so I forgot."
Lin Qiyue slapped his forehead, and he forgot about it.
Actually, it’s not to blame for Lin Qiyue’s ignorance. In his opinion, what’s the use of participating in such a small place as long as they participate in such a world-class exposition?
So when Xu Shiyan proposed, Lin Qiyue didn't take it very seriously, and left everything to Xu Shiyan to arrange.
"Secretary Lin, all relevant procedures have been completed.
In the next few days, you pack up, take Xiao Li, Xiao Xiao and the others, and just set off as soon as possible. "
Xu Shiyan could probably guess what Lin Qiyue was thinking, so he didn't expose it.
Anyway, he has already arranged everything. It is enough for Lin Qiyue to take people abroad to participate in the expo.
"What? Xiao Xu, are you not going?" Li Bingzhuo asked curiously.
"I won't go, as long as Secretary Lin leads the team.
Our place is 40,000 to 50,000 feet this year, and we are too busy making ginseng and goods, so I will stay and take care of it. "
For this kind of publicity, it must be done by the top leader. It would be wrong for others to go.
Furthermore, the Xu family has a lot of things to do this year. Xu Shiyan is so busy, how can he have the time to go abroad to participate in some exhibitions?
Lin Qiyue trusts Xu Shiyan unconditionally. Since Xu Shiyan said that he wants to participate in this expo, he should go.
So, a few days later, Lin Qiyue led Li Chengrong, Xiao Peng, and several entourages.
With a sample of Changbai Mountain red ginseng, I set off from home and took a car to the capital.
Fly from the capital again, and after several transfers, we arrive at the Expo site.
Lin Qiyue led a team to participate in the exhibition abroad, and Xu Shiyan, Li Bingzhuo, and Dai Chunrong were in charge of a participatory work and other related matters.
This year, 47,000 feet of ginseng will be produced from one ginseng site. At the same time, ginseng from cooperative units, multiple service stations of the Forestry Bureau, will be received totaling 5,000 feet.
Such a large processing volume is indeed a big challenge for the processing factory.
Fortunately, new machines were added to the processing factory, and the Forestry Bureau also selected many people from the family members of the employees to directly participate in the processing.
In this way, the manpower is almost enough.
Of course, the school’s classic repertoire is still going on, and every student in the first and first grades of junior high school has to come to participate in the labor for three to five days.
Xu Shiyan is going to be busy with the processing and production here. As for Su Anying, she bought the original processing factory of the second brigade, and added machines for processing ginseng.
This year, these companies are all making goods over fifty feet long. It would be too troublesome to process them as before.
I don’t need to do anything else this autumn, I just fiddle with the stuff.
It is better to set up a processing factory, with machines and drying rooms, and processing is also convenient.
One more thing, this year in autumn, many customers from the south called to order.
Su Anying felt that instead of going to the ginseng market to collect dry goods, the quality of which is uneven, it is better to grab water, that is, fresh ginseng from the market, and process it by yourself, which can also control the quality.
The processing plant is still under the management of the company.
The daughter-in-laws of these families are the lead workers, and some people are hired, with machine assistance, which is much faster than the purely manual work in the past.
The quality of the ginseng produced is also good, and it can be sold at a good price.
Since the goods of each company are processed in the processing factory this year, they can't all come out in a swarm, and each company has to stagger their time.
For the sake of fairness, we can only draw lots, and each family will start with the number they get.
It was a coincidence that Su Anying caught the thirteenth, which happened to be a Sunday.
Sunday is also very good, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping can also go up the mountain, no matter how much work they do, let them know that life is not easy.
The two children have no problem studying, but they must also pay attention to other aspects, so as not to develop their habit of being extravagant.
Xu Shi'an followed his younger brother that year, and also planted twenty feet of clubs on the side of the Kaifeng fork.
It happened that Xu Shian hadn't left at the beginning of the school night, and on Sunday, Wei Mingrong didn't go to work, and Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao didn't go to class.
The whole family did it, and the sticks were taken back.
Just like that, on September 13th, everyone drove up the mountain to attend the ceremony together.
The soil on the side of the Kaifeng Fork Road is really good. When the ginseng was planted, the seeds planted were not small, so this year's production of sticks is still very gratifying.
"Third son, you must dig slowly, this stick is too rare, and it would be very distressing to plow a tree down."
On such a big day as raising the stick, of course Xu Chenghou had to follow him up the mountain.
There are plenty of people on the mountain, but he doesn't need to work, but the old man must come up to see it with his own eyes, so he can rest assured.
Seeing that the mallets in the field grew so well, the old man was very happy.
He hurriedly greeted his son, telling Xu Shiyan to be careful, and don't hurt himself with the stick.
"Understood, Dad, don't worry."
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it. He has been doing it for many years. Can he still do this kind of work?
"Uncle Xu, just rest assured, we will all be more careful.
This year, the third brother’s club is still so good, it’s rare to see it. "
On the other end, Zhao Jianshe and others boasted while planing sticks.
"Second brother, how is your stick?" Xu Shiyan turned his head and asked Xu Shian.
Xu Shian's family's Shendi is not far from Xu Shiyan's house. When he heard his younger brother calling him, Xu Shian hurriedly raised his head.
"It's pretty good, the stick is not small, third child, this piece of ginseng land is really good, we planted too little at that time."
Xu Shi'an regretted it a little. At that time, he thought of a way to plant more. How rare is this stick.
If there is a hundred and eighty feet, this year I can earn a lot of money.

chapters.title: Chapter 567: Tired of studying or tired of working
chapters.content:
Chapter 567 Tired from studying or tired from work
"Dream, where did you plant so many ginseng seeds? You want to plant more." Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head when he heard this.
In 1984, the second year of land division, every household had a poor foundation.
This little ginseng was something that Xu Shiyan managed to free up from the first round.
Want to plant more? At that time, even if you wanted to, there was no such condition.
Xu Shian laughed when he heard this, "Yes, there is no time for people to be content.
I planted 50 feet this year, and I want to plant 100 feet next year.
I still listen to you, just plant a little in a year honestly, don’t be greedy for money. "
"Xiaobo, come on, come over and plan a few times."
Xu Shian felt tired after planing the stick for a while, so he called his eldest son over and taught him how to plan the stick.
Fifteen-year-old Xu Haibo is not short and has strength, but he has never done this kind of work before, and he is afraid that the planer will damage the mallet, so he clumsily planed the soil with the three-toothed stick.
Xu Haibo was very careful every time he swung the mallet, for fear of breaking the mallet. After a while, he was so tired that he was sweating profusely.
"How are you? Are you tired?
伱If you don’t study hard, I’ll let you down and throw a hammer after you graduate from junior high school.
I will also let you know, is it tired from work or from studying? "
Xu Shian saw his son was sweating, smiled, and went over to take the third tooth and replace his son.
"How is it, how do you feel?"
Xu Haibo wiped the sweat from his forehead, took a few breaths, "Tired, so tired.
Those three-toothed teeth have to dig deep, for fear of hurting the mallet if the planing is too shallow, a large lump of dirt will be dug up all at once, which is old and heavy. "
Don’t care about your height or strength, you are a child after all, you haven’t done this kind of strenuous work before, and you won’t be able to stand it after a while.
"It's still easy to study, and the work is too tiring."
Xu Haibo quickly picked up the water bottle and took a sip of water, saying with emotion.
"Well, if you know that you are tired from work, you should study hard, otherwise, you will be tired in the future."
Xu Shian nimbly planed the stick, not forgetting to tell his son.
"Second, how are you doing? Do you want to try it too?"
Xu Shian turned his head, looked at Xu Haitao who was cutting ginseng leaves with a sickle behind him, and asked with a smile.
"Dad, no need, cutting ginseng leaves is quite tiring, let alone planing sticks.
I can’t even keep up with my brother, if I plan to damage a few more sticks, it will be a waste of money. "
When Xu Haitao heard it, his head shook like a rattle. His brother was so tired that he was still young, so he didn't dare to try it.
Xu Shian taught the two children a lesson, but Xu Shiyan on the other side laughed when he saw it.
"See? If you work hard, there is no work that is not tiring.
If you two don’t study hard in the future, you will both work hard. "
Of course, this is purely a joke to scare children.
Based on the current state of Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, they will definitely not be bad in the future.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, who were following behind to pick up the mallet, heard what Dad said, and they hecked twice, but neither of them answered.
Xu Haiyuan actually wanted to tell his father, stop scaring people there, as if we were afraid?
Not to mention their grades are good or bad, but their grades are really bad in the future. He can still study medicine from his teacher, and his sister can learn fashion design from his little aunt.
Really think that their brains are for nothing, and they can still run and exert great strength? Dad underestimated them too, right?
What does the brain do when it grows up? Who can use their brains to make money, come out and work hard?
But right now grandpa is right in front of him, and there are several uncles beside him.
Xu Haiyuan felt that if he really dared to say that, his father would probably beat him up in anger.
Forget it, in front of outsiders, I still have to save some face for my father.
So he coughed and signaled his sister not to answer, and the two of them bowed their heads to work.
"What's the matter? Are you scared and afraid to speak?"
Xu Shiyan didn't hear his daughter's answer, and felt strange, so he said another sentence.
"Work honestly, what do you have to say to the children? You don't know the character of our two children?"
Su Anying, who was squatting on the ground to pick up a mallet, stood up and gave Xu Shiyan a look.
This person doesn't know what he's thinking every day, knowing that the two monsters in the family are not ordinary children, yet he has to fight with them.
Interested? With the time for small talk, I can do more work.
Huang Shengli over there followed up, "That's right, third brother, you think too much.
If the two of your family don’t make any progress, then those brats in our family will have to beg for food. "
Everyone burst into laughter when they heard this.
Xu Shiyan was stared at by his wife, he thought about it, and laughed too, isn't it just looking for something?
"Work, work, we have to get all the fifty feet out today."
Judging from the current situation, the output is not low. The bigger the hammer, the slower the production. Don't look at fifty feet, you have to hurry up.
So everyone stopped laughing and concentrated on playing the stick.
Xu Shi'an's side, after Xu Haibo rested for a while, went to see the small room, and borrowed a three-toothed tool.
Xu Haitao and Xu Haitao, who had finished cutting the ginseng leaves, put together a frame and picked them up one by one.
Slow down and slow down, it's better than Xu Shi'an digging alone.
In the evening, Xu Shiyan's family pulled out seventeen sacks from the two 50-foot-long strings, sixteen of which were seamed and one tied.
Roughly estimate, an average of one foot can lift more than 30 kilograms.
Xu Shian's side has a total of twenty-eight feet, and nine sacks are produced, which is not a low output.
Everyone happily carried the sacks to the car outside the venue. Xu Haibo, Xu Haitao, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping followed out with tools to look at the car.
The two families have a total of nearly thirty sacks, and they need to be divided into two cars. The cars are all outside the field, and they have to be carried a long way.
If someone outside takes advantage of the time they are carrying the bag back and forth, lifts a sack from the car and sneaks away, the loss will be great.
That's why I arranged for the children to go out to watch the car and goods.
The people went back and forth several times, and finally carried all the sacks out and loaded them into the cart, and sealed the sacks one by one with rope.
Then they drove separately. Except for the woman and the two children, everyone else sat on the sack and escorted the car, and walked all the way back.
This time, there is no need to unload the car at home, and send it directly to the processing factory.
There is a large warehouse on the processing plant side, which is a special place to release goods, and each family keeps people on duty at night.
There are so many goods, who dares to be negligent?
Xu Shian has to go to school, Wei Mingrong has to go to work, there is really no one at home who can make goods.
So Xu Shi'an had already discussed with Su Anying that he would put his goods in the processing factory as well, entrust the processing factory to process them, and pay a certain processing fee.
They are all from my own family, so I have to help with this favor.
Anyway, the processing factory is very big and has enough manpower, but it is a matter of convenience.
The dogs of Xu's family were taken to the processing factory again, and they were scattered around the four corners.
The walls of the processing factory are quite high, surrounded by barbed wire, it is very difficult for thieves to get in.
At night, the men stay on duty, and there is a special resting place here.
Get back with the club, and pour it directly into a large pool for soaking early the next morning.
The pool draws water from the small river outside, which is running water. The sticks are soaked and rinsed in it, and then they are taken out and used to brush the ginseng machine.
As for the reference machine, when Xu Shiyan was studying, he mentioned it to a classmate who had a lot of research on agricultural machinery.
The man went back and studied for quite a long time, and he came up with it.
The diesel engine drives a high-pressure water pump, and the water pump carries a water gun, which sprays high-pressure water mist from the nozzle of the water gun.
People brush ginseng with a nozzle, and the effect is much faster and cleaner than brushing.
This machine can carry three to four spray guns, and there are three machines in the processing factory.
It took less than a day for the sticks of the Xu family to be cleaned.

chapters.title: Chapter 568: The 1st Ginseng Festival
chapters.content:
Chapter 568 The First Ginseng Festival
For the ginseng that has been scrubbed, pick out more than two or three ginseng that have no rot, no water rust, and no damage as a whole.
After controlling the water, soak it directly in a large tank filled with loose wine.
The wine is pure grain loose wine bought from Xinglong Xiaoshao.
Last autumn, the dozen or so ginseng stalks left behind were bought by old customers in the south.
A few days ago, several merchants called and said that they would order more ginseng of this kind of wine this year.
It happened that the Xu family's clubs were pretty good this year, and they were quite a bit bigger, so Su Anying simply picked out some more and prepared the wine.
Pick out the big ones to soak in wine, and put the rest directly into the steamed ginseng tank.
This steamed ginseng tank is evenly heated, the temperature is controllable, and it has a large capacity, which is much better than a large pot or cage at home.
Steamed red ginseng, the color is good when the fire is good.
Ginseng comes out of the steamed ginseng tank, placed on a fork, dried outside during the day, and directly into the drying room at night.
For large-scale processing, you can’t point them all to the sun, which is too troublesome.
During the day, Su Anying watches the work in the processing factory, and sometimes goes to the ginseng market. Some sell fresh ginseng, and the price is almost the same.
However, there are not many such opportunities. Most of the ginseng farmers do not have the same conditions as the Xu family.
It is mainly ginseng run by some units. They do not have processing equipment, so they can only sell fresh ginseng directly. Or find a processing factory for processing.
Su Anying has money in hand, and when she encounters a good product, she buys it back and takes it to a processing factory for processing.
On September 15th, the first Fusong Ginseng Festival opened.
As the big brother in the county-owned ginseng field, this kind of occasion is naturally indispensable.
Lin Qiyue is not here, Xu Shiyan, as the second in command, must attend.
On this day, the urban and rural areas of Fusong County were full of jubilation, with gongs and drums, singing and dancing.
280,000 people celebrated their festival together, the first Ginseng Festival.
At the ginseng festival celebration meeting, relevant leaders announced the “Decision on Establishing Fusong Changbai Mountain Ginseng Festival”.
That is, starting from 1987, celebrations will be held every year during the ginseng harvest season.
At the Ginseng Festival, there was a large-scale song and dance performance reflecting the life of the people in Sanxiang, which was last year's "Linhai Cangxiang Concert".
This will be four performances in four consecutive days, pushing the atmosphere of Ginseng Festival celebration to the highest level.
At the same time, more than 120 works of art, photography, and calligraphy that reflect the production and life of Sanxiang are also on public display.
Among them, famous calligraphers and painters such as Shen Peng and Zhou Sicong all painted inscriptions for the hometown of ginseng.
In the ginseng story meeting, well-known folk experts in the county will tell the story of Changbai Mountain ginseng. The content of the story is novel, interesting and fascinating.
After nightfall, the fireworks rise into the sky, colorful.
There are also several Yangko teams, beating gongs and drums, singing and dancing, and the whole Er County is immersed in the festive atmosphere of the festival.
"Magistrate Chang, why haven't I seen the Agricultural Products Fair? It seems that I haven't seen many domestic and foreign merchants?"
When it was time for dinner in the evening, Xu Shiyan sat beside Chang Hongfa and asked in confusion.
Chang Hong was stunned for a while, "Ah? What trade fair are you talking about?
We are holding a ginseng festival, a cultural event, to celebrate our county's bumper ginseng harvest this year. "
In 1987, the county's ginseng planting area was 1.5 million square feet, and it is estimated that 7 million catties of water ginseng can be produced this year. This is the most prosperous period in the history of Fusong ginseng development.
The county decided to hold a ginseng festival, mainly to celebrate the harvest.
Xu Shiyan was speechless for a while, what's the matter?
Make such a big move, spend so much money, just for a cultural celebration? What international joke?
"Culture sets up the stage, economics and trade play, we must know how to take the ginseng festival as an opportunity to vigorously promote economic development.
Oh my God, such a great opportunity, no one thought of inviting more domestic and foreign customers, organizing participants, farmers, and enterprises to hold an agricultural product trade fair.
Not to mention anything else, just these few days of ginseng festival, the minimum transaction volume is hundreds of millions. "
The ginseng market opened last year, and the transaction volume on that day was tens of millions.
This year, the county has such a large scale and grand ceremony. As long as we invite more domestic and foreign enterprises and merchants, and the transaction volume exceeds 100 million, it will be like playing.
Has no one in the county thought of this matter?
Chang Hongfa was dumbfounded when he heard this, "Damn it, no one mentioned it at all.
I said before that I called you here and asked you to preside over the planning and preparation of this ginseng festival, but some people disagreed, saying that this is a cultural event. "
Chang Hongfa slapped his thigh regretfully. The county spent a lot of money on organizing the ginseng festival this time, but the most important thing was not done.
If we can use the ginseng festival to attract merchants from all over the world, it will be a big gain.
This is a good deal, wasting such a good opportunity in vain.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, someone who Chang Hongfa said disagreed, and he didn't need to guess who it was.
Well, let him talk too much, he won't be bothered to give any ideas in the future, and the county has money to do whatever it likes, and it has nothing to do with him.
"Well, County Magistrate Chang, it's getting late, I have to go back, it's the busiest time for participation, I have to go back and watch."
Xu Shiyan didn't think it was interesting, so let's go home.
It seems to be quite lively here, but in fact it is just a waste of time, and the business is not done.
"Is it okay to go back so late? Or stay in the county for one night and go to my house."
Chang Hongfa intends to keep Xu Shiyan, and wants to have a good chat with Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "No, the family is too busy.
Secretary Lin has gone out, and I have several things in charge here, and I really can't let it go.
Waiting for this busy period, I will visit again when I find a chance. "
Chang Hongfa couldn't keep people, so he had no choice but to tell Xu Shiyan to pay attention to safety on the return journey.
Xu Shiyan bid farewell to all the leaders, boarded the car, and returned to Donggang from the county.
I didn’t go home either, and went straight to my own processing factory.
He was worried about that place, and lived there at night, so he could deal with anything in time.
The first Ginseng Festival lasted for four days. Xu Shiyan only showed his face on the first day, and then he simply stopped participating.
Because of what Xu Shiyan said, Chang Hongfa had a private conversation with Li Jingyu.
Li Jingyu didn't expect that Xu Shiyan would have such a proposal, but he didn't want to admit that he didn't expect it.
Just keep emphasizing that this ginseng festival is a purely cultural event, not an economic trade.
Chang Hong was so angry that he turned around and left.
The first Ginseng Festival finally came to an end, and the grand occasion of the festival was reported by the provincial TV reporter and broadcast on the provincial TV news.
The entire province knew about the ginseng festival, but that was all there was to it, and it didn't bring any additional benefits.
On the other side, Lin Qiyue, who was in a foreign country, participated in the nine-day World Invention Expo.
The Changbai Mountain red ginseng selected by a participant was unanimously praised by participants from various countries.
And has been awarded the gold medal of this expo by 30 judges from all over the world.
Lin Qiyue excitedly called Chen Jianzhang of the Specialty Products Bureau to report the good news.
Then, the entire Erxian County was boiling. This is the first time that Fusong ginseng has won an international award.

chapters.title: Chapter 569: world gold medal
chapters.content:
Chapter 569 World Gold Medal
Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng won a world-class award for the first time, and it was also a gold award.
When the news came back, not to mention the county and city, even the province was very excited. News media such as newspapers and TV reported in large lengths.
Lin Qiyue hasn't come back yet, and various celebrations have been prepared here.
Lin Qiyue and his people had just landed at the Capital Airport when the people sent by the province were ready to greet them outside the airport.
To be honest, when Lin Qiyue led the team to participate in the exhibition abroad, he really didn't think about these things.
I felt that the formalities were done anyway, so I went out and had a look, so I could gain some insight.
When the results of the awards came out, Lin Qiyue and his party were surprised and excited, so Lin Qiyue immediately called back to announce the good news.
A group of people hurried back with medals, award certificates and other things.
When I was on the road, I was still very excited, and I thought it was like a dream.
As a result, when we got off the plane at the Capital Airport, there was such a grand welcome ceremony here.
Lin Qiyue and the others were dumbfounded, what are they doing?
The province sent a special car to take the provincial and Taiwan reporters to the capital to pick them up.
After resting in the capital, return directly to the provincial capital the next day.
When we arrived in the provincial capital, it was even more remarkable. It was even bigger than the one that came back from the Spring Fair last time.
Primary school students present flowers, leaders wear red, and the crowds line up to welcome them. It's like a hero returning triumphantly.
Lin Qiyue has experienced it once, but this time he can keep calm.
Li Chengrong, Xiao Peng and others were all dumbfounded. Isn't this too grand? It's scary.
The leaders of the province personally received them, held a celebration party, and interviewed all the news media reporters on the scene.
The medals and award certificates were placed on the stage, and a bunch of people gathered around to watch. The reporters took pictures with long guns and short cannons.
For a while, no matter which newspaper, the headlines on the front page were all about Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng winning an international award.
Lin Qiyue and his party were originally scheduled to return to the venue around October 10th, but the return date is uncertain.
Provinces, cities, counties, wherever they have to stay to celebrate, hold a celebration party.
Talk about the award-winning experience of Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng, and then talk about the ideas and difficulties of research and development.
Nowhere can it be done in a day or two.
Thanks to the participants here, Xu Shiyan, Li Bingzhuo and others were all quite capable.
Lin Qiyue has been away for so long, and the work in the venue has not been delayed at all, and he has done it very well.
All the 47,000-foot sticks that participated in this year's fair were sent to the processing plant. The processing plant rushed to work day and night, and successfully completed the first rough processing task.
The next step is to plant seeds, pick seeds, and plant ginseng. These activities are done every year, and everything is carried out step by step.
Of course, Xu Shiyan, Li Bingzhuo and others are also busy like spinning tops, non-stop all day long.
Xu Shiyan went to work in the field during the day, and went to work at the processing factory at night. In the past month or so, he lost a lot of weight.
Su Anying is not easy, she has to go to the market to catch goods during the day, and she has to watch the processing factory work.
After the processing season is over, it's time to sell the seeds of the ginseng field in Liumaohe.
At that time in 1985, a total of 50,000 Zhang of ginseng land was obtained, and 20,000 Zhang of land was sold.
For the remaining 30,000 feet, each family keeps 100 feet to plant ginseng, and the rest are all ginseng seeds on demand.
Now this ginseng has been planted for two years, with five leaves, all of which are growing quite well.
Su Anying followed Xu Shiyan's instructions and let the wind go, saying that she would sell seeds this year.
The seeds sown on demand grow well, regardless of the five leaves, they are no worse than those Erjiazi, and they can lift 15 to 6 catties of ginseng seeds in one foot.
The ginseng market is good this year, and the ginseng seeds have also risen with the tide, which is even higher than last year.
Originally, Su Anying thought about picking up the ginseng seeds and going to the ginseng market to sell them.
But with so many seeds, it all refers to hiring people, not to mention how many people to hire and how much it costs. The key is that there are simply no such people at this time.
In the end, I had no choice but to sell it in the field by zhang, how much is a zhang.
Whoever is optimistic about the purchase, they can go back by themselves. In this case, it can save a lot of worry.
Su Anying discussed with Huang Shengli and the others. The seeds that are less than 30,000 feet in total will be sold for 20,000 feet this year, and the rest will be sold next year.
The ginseng market has soared in the past two years, and ginseng farmers are thinking about developing more, racking their brains to find ways to buy ginseng soil.
Buying tens of feet or hundreds of feet, some people can't wait to throw all their family money into it.
Not to mention those units, no matter what the unit is, they all want to invest some money in it.
Get hundreds of thousands of feet and wait for three years to earn a fortune.
In this case, the shortage of ginseng seeds is very large. I don’t know how many people are anxious to buy ginseng seeds.
So when Su Anying let out the news that there were 20,000 feet of ginseng seeds for sale, many people asked someone to find connections and come to buy seeds.
In order to save worry, the seeds are sold in bunches.
This string is 30 feet or 50 feet, whichever string you like, measure it directly on the spot.
The on-demand ginseng seeds are not as dense as the ginseng seedlings that are sown by hand. Although there are more large seeds, the price is slightly cheaper than that of manual sowing seeds.
Su Anying, Huang Shengli, and Zhao Jianshe have all done experiments and calculated in advance, and set the price according to the output and quality of ginseng seeds, and the price is 370 yuan for ginseng seeds.
Twenty thousand feet of seeds were planted, and all of them were sold within ten days.
Not only some local units, but even some places in neighboring counties came to buy seeds.
Anyway, no matter who comes, no matter whose face it is, this thing is optimistic about paying and paying in cash.
When the other party pays the money, a receipt will be issued here, and the receipt will be marked specifically, what number and number the other party wants.
The pegs smashed on the head of each pool string, with numbers marked on them, and numbers on the feet of the pillars.
The buyer comes with the receipt and takes a seat according to the number, and there will be absolutely no confusion.
Those units demand a lot, and some of them buy several strings at once.
Individuals buy a small amount, but don’t sell it for zero feet, so three or five people can only get together to buy a bunch and divide it among themselves.
Su Anying doesn't care about this matter, she is only responsible for collecting money.
Once the money is in hand, people can get as much money as they like, she doesn't worry about it at all.
The ginseng field in Liumaohe is good. The ginseng seeds sown at the beginning were open-ended ginseng seeds bought from various ginseng farms. All of them are dry seeds, and the seedling preservation rate is high.
Zhao Jianguo and others were also very careful in serving them, never delaying weeding and spraying medicine.
In addition, the on-demand ginseng seeds grow well and evenly, so the ginseng seeds grown out are very rare.
All the people who bought the seeds were very satisfied.
Then, this ginseng land became famous, and the county specially arranged people to come down to investigate and learn this ginseng seed on-demand technology.
Su Anying therefore also received the attention of the above.
Some people are concerned about whether this ginseng needs to pay special product tax.
According to the principle, ginseng pays the special product tax, which is paid to the local financial office when the goods are shipped in six years.
Ginseng seeds are all for home use. They are planted from one field and then planted in another field. In fact, there is no need to pay for this.
But Su Anying and the others are selling out on a large scale, so that's another story.
Fortunately, before the ginseng seeds were sold, Su Anying approached the Songjianghe Finance Office and the Forestry Bureau Resources Office, and paid all the taxes and fees that should be paid.
So no matter how many people come to inspect or inspect, Su Anying is not afraid.
They have complete procedures, and the taxes and fees that should be paid are not bad. Even if someone is jealous, there is nothing to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 570: earned millions
chapters.content:
Chapter 570 earned millions
"This year's ginseng seeds are all sold, guess how much money you made?"
This day, the processing factory was not too busy, so Xu Shiyan went to the processing factory at night and then went home.
When Su Anying saw her man, she couldn't help showing off to Xu Shiyan.
"How much is it? Seems to make you happy."
Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing when he saw his wife's excited look.
This crop of ginseng land was originally bought for six yuan per ten feet.
Adding all expenses such as ginseng seeds, plastic sheets, ginseng fees, labor, special product taxes, soil erosion fees, etc., the approximate cost is only more than 60 yuan, less than 70 yuan.
If you sell it for three hundred and seventy yuan per foot, you will make a net profit of three hundred, twenty thousand feet, or six million.
No matter how stupid Xu Shiyan is, he can still figure out the accounts.
He just looked at his daughter-in-law so happy, so he didn't want to spoil her interest.
"It's more than six million yuan, which is more than we earned when we dumped Clivia.
My God, I really didn't expect that selling ginseng seeds can make so much money. "
Su Anying is still excited. To be honest, the family has made a lot of money in the past few years, otherwise Su Anying would not have dared to buy the processing factory of the second brigade without saying anything.
But she earned 6 million at once, and Su Anying holds 52% of the shares. That means she can get more than 3 million. This figure is quite scary.
At the beginning, when they turned to Clivia, they were afraid that after spending so much effort, they didn't earn so much money.
"If it starts at 20,000 zhang, how much will it cost?" Su Anying couldn't hold back, and also looked forward to it.
"This year's market is so good, if there are really 20,000 feet, just like our production, then it won't be sold for tens of millions?"
"Stop, don't think too much, it's impossible.
We didn’t have that much ability back then, we couldn’t get so many ginseng seeds.
Twenty thousand feet, you can ask Brother Guo, does their Forestry Bureau have that much a year?
Let’s not talk about their rounds, even if they participate in three games and four games, I dare not say whether this year’s production will be 20,000 feet. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, his wife really dared to think about it.
Not to mention anything else, twenty thousand feet can make them tired just by making ginseng and making goods. That's not a joke.
"Why don't we plant more clubs this year?
Now we have planted seeds and ginseng soil, just hire more people to work. "
Su Anying feels that a hundred feet a year doesn't seem to be too much.
"Daughter-in-law, you don't feel tired, do you? Stop, don't fix so much."
Xu Shiyan took advantage of the fact that there was no one at home and the children were at Chu Xuanhuai's side, so he directly hugged his wife over.
"Look at you now, you are already busy enough with ginseng soil in summer, sticks and hammers for processing in autumn, and you have to receive goods for customers in the south.
I'm still at work, so I can't help much.
Let’s plant less, one hundred feet a year, and focus on the development of large goods, isn’t it good? Not tired, but also earn a lot. "
Xu Shiyan can't tell his wife that this ginseng has been booming for a few years, and the price will drop soon, right?
Whoever invests more money now will cry more miserable in the future.
Xu Shiyan knew that this was a pit, so he definitely couldn't jump into it.
So I can only coax my daughter-in-law, so that Su Anying can stop worrying about planting ginseng.
Su Anying thinks about it, the people who have been busy with her this autumn have lost a lot of weight, and they can't slow down until now.
"Okay then, let's plant less, it's still a hundred feet a year."
Su Anying is good at this, no matter what time she listens to Xu Shiyan, as long as Xu Shiyan makes a decision, she never questions or opposes it.
"Well, my daughter-in-law is the most obedient, listen to people's persuasion to eat enough, let's develop slowly."
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to kiss his wife on the face.
During this period of time, the couple are busy, and they don’t even have time to see each other. It is a rare opportunity to get close, and someone’s hands start to be dishonest.
"Second sister, what are you doing? Why do you and elder brother always cover my eyes?"
Before the couple could do anything, they heard the movement of the youngest son.
The two people in the room quickly separated, Su Anying glared at Xu Shiyan angrily, and then came out of the room.
"You don't watch TV anymore?"
Outside, Xu Jinping blocked her sister behind her, and covered her brother's eyes with her hands.
Seeing her mother coming out, Xu Jinping quickly put down her hands and smiled at her.
"Well, I won't watch TV anymore. They are both sleepy and going to bed. I brought them back to sleep."
It's almost eight o'clock, and it's not easy for children to stay up late, so of course they have to come back to sleep.
"There is hot water in the pot, you guys should wash your feet quickly and go into the house to sleep."
Su Anying hurried back to the house and went to spread the quilts for the children. She was too busy talking to Xu Shiyan about making money just now, and forgot to spread the quilts for the children.
"Mom, can I bring my younger siblings to live in the Westinghouse?"
Xu Jinping blinked her big eyes and asked innocently.
Su Anying froze for a moment, "Huh? Are you going to live in Westinghouse?
Can it work? They may have to get up at night to go to the bathroom. "
I said before that when the children are older, they will live separately.
But the eldest daughter is only nine years old this year. Is it okay to let her sleep with her younger siblings?
The two little ones sometimes get up at night to go to the toilet or something, shouldn't it delay my sister's sleep?
"It's okay, I can take care of them."
Xu Jinping nodded solemnly, she should take her younger siblings to live in the Westinghouse, and stop mixing with her parents.
Su Anying looked at her daughter's serious face, and sighed helplessly.
"That's fine, I'll carry the quilts over to you. If you have anything to do at night, you can call me."
Since the girl insists, let her do it, try it for a few days, and move back if it doesn't work.
"Okay, thanks mom."
Xu Jinping nodded happily, led her siblings to the kitchen, scooped water for them, let the two children wash their feet, and brushed their teeth first.
After the two little ones finished washing their feet, they found a dry cloth and wiped their feet, then watched the two little ones brush their teeth, and coaxed them back to sleep.
After the two little ones were settled down, Xu Jinping fetched water again and washed her feet, wiped clean and went back to bed.
"Close your eyes and sleep, don't mess around, or I will beat you."
Seeing her younger siblings playing around without sleeping, Xu Jinping glared at them to scare them.
The two of them who had changed rooms to sleep and were having fun fighting, saw their sister's stern face, and immediately didn't dare to be embarrassed.
Obediently get into bed and lie down, close your eyes.
Xu Jinping pulled down the light cord and turned it off. After a while, all three babies fell asleep.
After a while, the worried Su Anying quietly opened the door and glanced at the West Room.
Seeing that the three children were lying neatly in the bed, sleeping soundly, they felt relieved and turned back to the east room.
East Room, Xu Shiyan was reading a book, and when he saw his daughter-in-law came back, he asked. "How is it? Are you all asleep?"
"Slept, I slept soundly." Su Anying smiled.
"Our girl is really like a big sister. Those two little ones are more obedient in her hands than in mine."
I can't accept this point, even that brat Xu Haiqing didn't dare to make a fuss in front of his sister.
Xu Jinping is really twitching when she is angry, and she is not used to her younger brother.
"It's good to fall asleep, in fact, it's time to sleep in a separate room." Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it.
"The children are here, what a delay."
Su Anying rolled a blank look at her man, "I blame you for not being serious every day.
The children are all grown up, and I don’t know how to avoid it. "
"What are you avoiding? My own daughter-in-law, she can hug her however she likes, and kiss her however she wants.
What the hell, who can control it? "
Xu Shiyan threw the book aside, hugged his daughter-in-law directly, gave him a kiss, pulled off the light cord, and turned in the task.

chapters.title: Chapter 571: Huge benefits
chapters.content:
Chapter 571 Huge benefits
On October 22nd, Lin Qiyue and his party finally returned to the venue.
"Xiao Xu, thanks to listening to you this time, look, our Changbaishan red ginseng won an international award.
You don’t know, on the way back, from the province to the city to the county, there are celebration parties and banquets everywhere.
Xiaoli and I have gained a lot of weight. "
When Lin Qiyue returned to work, he was not overjoyed yet, and started talking to Xu Shiyan, Li Bingzhuo and others.
"Secretary Lin, although we haven't seen these, we can guess them.
Guess, how much has our order of Changbaishan red ginseng increased this year? Twenty thousand boxes.
As soon as the news of the award spread, many merchants called to order. "
Xu Shiyan and others also laughed.
In any case, this time, for one participant, the harvest is huge.
Just for this batch of orders, you can earn a lot of money just by participating.
"This year, the price of our Changbai Mountain red ginseng has increased again.
Four hundred and forty-three for sixteen pieces, three hundred and forty-four for twenty pieces, two hundred and seventy-five for thirty pieces, two hundred and twenty-eight for forty pieces, one hundred and eighty-seven for fifty pieces. "
In recent years, the price of Changbai Mountain red ginseng has been rising, but this year's increase is really unexpected.
I remember that when it was first developed in 1983, it sold for 388 boxes of 16 tablets. It has only been a few years, and it has increased by more than 50 yuan.
Not to mention anything else this year, the order of 20,000 boxes alone can bring in millions of dollars in revenue.
"Thanks to our cooperation with the Forestry Bureau, otherwise, we have orders but no raw materials now."
Lin Qiyue was even happier when he heard it. This is the direct benefit of winning the award.
Compared with these benefits, the cost of going to the fair is really a drop in the bucket.
"Xiao Xu, we really don't plan to expand the scale of the venue?
I was in the county this time, and many leaders said, let's take advantage of this opportunity to expand production.
There is no problem with ginseng soil, and the leader will solve it.
I didn't dare to agree, I thought about it and discussed it with you guys when I came back. "
Lin Qiyue has now formed a habit, that is, no matter what happens, he has to come back to discuss with Xu Shiyan and listen to Xu Shiyan's opinion.
Xu Shiyan wanted to say yes, so he had the bottom line in his heart. If Xu Shiyan said no, he really didn't dare, because he was afraid that something was wrong and he would fall into it.
"Hehe, they wish that all the forests in the county would be planted with clubs." Xu Shiyan snorted.
Before when Guan Enxue was here, he could restrain himself a bit. There were restrictions on the ginseng approved every year to prevent too fast development.
But since I changed this person, I really don’t care about anything. I heard that this year, the approval of ginseng soil was directly released.
All forestry stations in the county have approved whether it is suitable for planting ginseng or not.
This is pure nonsense, just wait, there is something exciting to watch.
"Secretary Lin, if you listen to me, let's maintain the current level and don't expand.
If we don’t have enough raw materials, it’s easy, just go to the market to buy them.
Now any unit dares to plant ginseng, regardless of whether they have the conditions to process it.
They don’t have a processing plant either, so what can they do? Cover now? Are you selling fresh ginseng?
It’s not more cost-effective to buy the ones we choose than to plant our own? "
This is also the reason why Xu Shiyan didn't let Su Anying get hurt.
In the future, there will be fresh ginseng sold in the ginseng market.
As long as the money is in place, which one is easy to buy, do they need to work hard to grow it by themselves?
As long as you have stable customers, you can earn a lot of money for a year just by collecting water and participating in labor.
When Lin Qiyue and the others heard this, they all laughed.
"Look, it has to be our director Xu who sees it clearly, come on, then I don't bother to think about it.
At worst, let’s expand the processing plant and buy more machines. "
Instead of investing money in the fields, it is better to invest in processing plants, and more efforts must be made in deep processing.
"By the way, Xiao Xu, you still have to work hard, lead people to develop a few more products.
The provincial leader told me this time that next year's Spring Fair will give us a separate quota. "
This year's Spring Fair, Fusong did not produce any results, and the relevant provincial leaders were also very annoyed, especially for a participant who failed to participate in the Spring Fair, very dissatisfied.
Just taking advantage of this opportunity to celebrate the award, the leader specially approved that there is a separate quota for each participant.
Whether it is the Spring Fair or the Autumn Fair, as long as you want to go to the fair, you don't need the county's approval, you can directly participate.
Xu Shiyan wanted this effect, so he laughed when he heard it.
"Success, this is not difficult. I will discuss with Limin and the others later this winter to make several products suitable for export."
Regarding the research and development of new products, Xu Shiyan has already discussed with people from the technical department.
According to Xu Shiyan's prediction, several production directions were set.
Strive to produce one generation, develop one generation, and reserve one generation.
