Regardless of sales, research and development tests cannot be stopped, and technical reserves can be used for those that are not in production for the time being.
Lin Qiyue liked Xu Shiyan's calm and calm demeanor, so he smiled.
"Well, everyone has worked hard during my time abroad.
In this way, I will give you three days off and go back to have a good rest.
Waiting for the snow to fall and when there is nothing to do in our venue, I will treat guests and treat everyone to a good meal. "
Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng won this honor, and there are so many new orders this year, so there must be a celebration party and a celebration banquet to make everyone happy.
When Lin Qiyue came back, all the production in the field had stabilized as soon as he joined the factory. The processing factory can finish it in a few days, and the rough processing in the early stage is almost done.
The next step is deep processing and finishing. Don’t rush, take your time.
Everyone finally breathed a sigh of relief, Xu Shiyan asked for two more days off, and went home to plant a stick.
This year’s site is still near the machine repair shop, next to last year’s, and it’s also about 20,000 feet long, not too much.
Each family left 120 to 30 feet of ginseng soil, planted 100 feet of sticks, and left the rest to sow seeds.
The ginseng seeds that Xu Haiyuan and the others picked last year were mixed with sand this summer and opened.
Get it out of the ground a few days ago, use a sieve to remove the sand, keep it properly, and sprinkle it directly on the ground in a few days.
One hundred feet of land, let’s hire someone, Xu Shiyan is not at ease, fearing that the hired person is a novice, and the planting will not be good.
So I discussed with Su Anying, and just in time for him to have a five-day vacation, the couple went up to the mountain to plant sticks.
For this thing, no one can hire anyone to keep up with doing it yourself, and it’s better to plant the stick yourself.
How about not planting too much, too much to be able to handle it, and if you don’t care about it, you still want to grow a stick?
The old man Xu Chenghou couldn't stay idle, so he went up the mountain with his son and daughter-in-law to help put the pond and hand the seeds.
In this way, Xu Shiyan and his wife don't have to do chores, and can concentrate on planting sticks.
The two of them worked together again, and they worked very quickly. They planted twenty feet a day, and sprinkled ginseng seeds on the fifth day.
The work of participating in the ground, this is considered to be more than half completed. The remaining work such as building a shed can be contracted out.
Here is still Li Erniu's leader, leading people to look at frozen skins, make sheds and so on.
It happened that Xu Shiyan was relieved, and Li Erniu and the others could also make money.

chapters.title: Chapter 572: Another Spring Fair
chapters.content:
Chapter 572 Another Spring Festival
The influence of Changbaishan Red Ginseng winning the award is not just as simple as an increase of 20,000 boxes of orders for one ginseng, and a price increase.
Fusong participates in the industry, so it has also gained popularity.
Many merchants along the coast have come to buy ginseng, and even merchants from Hong Kong, Taiwan and other places have begun to gather in Fusong.
Donggang Ginseng City, as the distribution center of Fusong ginseng, has also gradually gained fame.
In addition to ginseng, there are also wild ginseng, American ginseng, fritillary, Gastrodia elata, elixir, rhodiola rosea, antler, snow clam oil, ganoderma lucidum, honey products, various wild vegetables, mushroom fungus, pine nuts, walnuts, etc. Souvenirs.
The annual transaction volume of various products is nearly 100 million yuan.
Market transactions radiate to Fusong, surrounding counties and the entire Changbai Mountain area.
The hotels and hotels in the north of the city were full from late August to the end of November.
There are already many small businesses in this slippery store on the east side of Canshi, and every business is doing well.
Not to mention the Shanhuozhuang opened by Su Anfen and Ji Tongzhong, the daily shipment volume is very large.
Thanks to Ji Tongzhong, he listened to Xu Shiyan's words and started hoarding goods since spring.
The two rooms on the north side of Xu Chenghou's house were not rented out, but instead became the warehouses of Shanhuozhuang.
The second floor of Shanhuozhuang is also full of goods except for the place where they live.
As a result, the goods were almost sold out before November.
Fortunately, You Ji Tongzhong drove to various small villages to collect mountain goods all day long. At least it lasted until the beginning of December, and the shipments gradually decreased.
This year, the price of ginseng has risen again.
Xu Shiyan’s family started ginseng 50 feet this year, and they produced more than 1,700 catties of fresh ginseng. They picked out 200 catties or more of fresh ginseng infused wine, and made the rest.
The wine-soaked ginseng is big, even wholesale and retail, and sold for more than 40,000 yuan.
The rest of the goods sold for nearly 40,000 yuan.
Fifty-foot-long clubs were finally sold for nearly 80,000 yuan. This is already very good.
This autumn, in addition to the ginseng from various families, Su Anying led people to catch 15,000 catties of fresh ginseng and 2,000 catties of dry goods.
After deducting labor and electricity costs, etc., they can probably earn less than 100,000 yuan, and the money to buy the processing factory is returned.
Now it’s short of the money to buy the machine, and I haven’t earned it back yet, but the machine can be used for many years, so it’s a good deal.
Shentu earned 170,000 yuan, and at the hotel in the city, after deducting all expenses and employee wages, the net profit was nearly 100,000 yuan.
Of course, the big head is still selling ginseng seeds, which alone earned about six million yuan.
The company's various profits, after deducting relevant taxes and fees, left more than 6 million yuan, and Su Anying divided more than 3 million yuan herself.
In addition to these, on the farm side, this year, sables, otters, raccoon dogs, etc. were sold, and sheep, chickens, ducks, geese, etc. were sold for a total of 300,000 yuan.
Deer and musk deer have expanded their breeding scale, but the production is still the same as in previous years, about 300,000.
Nowadays, the cost of raising deer and musk deer is not as high as before, and the profit is higher.
So in total, Xu Shiyan and his wife earned nearly 3.5 million this year, and Huang Shengli and others also made hundreds of thousands.
This little day is getting better every year, which is really the envy of everyone who sees it.
In the blink of an eye, the ice and snow melted, the spring was warm and the flowers were blooming. The annual Spring Fair was about to begin.
There is a special permit from the province to participate in the event, and a special quota is given. This time, there is no need to worry about the county.
So Xu Shiyan and his team prepared all the products for this year.
"Brother, are you ready? We are going to ship the goods in a few days."
Xu Shiyan finished counting the delivery list in his hand and called Guo Shouye after confirming that there was nothing missing.
One participant has reached in-depth cooperation with the Forestry Bureau in all aspects. During the Chinese New Year, the leaders of the two sides met and conducted a lot of discussions and research on future development together.
So this spring fair, a participant will take the Forestry Bureau to participate, to see if they can find any opportunities to earn foreign exchange through exports.
"Ready, just as you said, mineral water, blue indigo drink, blueberry puree, etc., are all packed in the car and ready to be shipped.
Brother, do you think our products can work? Why do I have nothing in my heart.
Didn’t you say that the mineral water in Quanyang didn’t produce food last year? Can our canyon spring do it? "
Guo Shouye chatted with Xu Shiyan on the phone.
"Brother, whether you can do it or not, you have to take this step.
If you don't even dare to take this step outside, what do you expect? "Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard that.
"Don't put too much pressure on yourself, our beverage factory is developing very well now, even if we don't earn foreign exchange through export, we still earn a lot.
This time, let’s just go out and hang around, gain insights and broaden your horizons, maybe you can find some business opportunities from the Spring Fair?
If you don’t go out, how can you know how big the outside world is? "
Xu Shiyan's persuasion gave Guo Shouye a little more confidence.
“I was afraid of failing the leadership’s expectations, and I was under a lot of pressure.
Success, as long as my brother is here, I have nothing to worry about. After finishing speaking, both of them laughed on the phone.
Hung up the phone, Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye started to go about their business again.
They are about to leave soon, and each of them has a lot of work on hand that has not been arranged.
The agricultural and sideline products and medical and health products of the Spring Fair are in the third phase, which is still from May 1st to May 5th.
Exhibitor samples will be packaged and shipped in advance, and transported to Yangcheng by rail.
As for the exhibitors, they still go to the provincial capital first, and then go to Yangcheng together after gathering.
During the beginning of spring, participating in the venue is the busiest, and now participating in the venue can be regarded as a big business, and there are so many things to do, so people have to stay guarded.
Lin Qiyue led people to participate in the World Expo last year, so this year's Spring Fair will be led by Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan brought Li Chengrong, Xiao Peng, and two translators.
Guo Shouye, who has been promoted to the deputy bureau, also brought five or six people with him according to Xu Shiyan's intention.
They are specially approved by the province, and have nothing to do with the county, so it's okay to bring a few more people.
The group set off directly from Songjianghe, and took the train to the provincial capital first.
Arrived in the provincial capital, stayed in a hotel arranged by the organizing committee, and had a meeting in the afternoon.
As a result, during the meeting, I found that I knew a lot of people.
The leader of the team this time in the county was Chang Hongfa, accompanied by Chen Jianzhang, Li Jingming, and director Xue of the pharmaceutical factory.
Li Jingyu led the team to release squibs last year, but this year he refused to lead the team to the Spring Fair, so he gave the opportunity to Chang Hongfa.
Chen Jianzhang is the director of the Specialty Products Bureau and the manager of the ginseng company. He also brought a lot of ginseng products this year. He hopes to have a good result in the Spring Fair.
"Xiao Xu, you are not authentic, why don't you come with us?" Chang Hongfa saw Xu Shiyan and waved to him.
"County Chang, um, we started late, so we didn't go to the county, and walked directly from Songjiang River.
Unexpectedly, you will lead the team this year. "Everyone has taken the initiative to greet him, so Xu Shiyan can't go over and say a few words?

chapters.title: Chapter 573: old classmates meet
chapters.content:
Chapter 573 Meet old classmates
"Cough, someone led the team to fire Squibs last year, so they dare not lead the team this year?
That’s why you gave me the chance. Chang Hongfa couldn't help shaking his head and smiling wryly when he heard what Xu Shiyan said.
Really think leading the team is a good job? This is to go out to work, not to travel, how can it be so easy?
Besides, if a bad quarrel happens, he will be blamed. Only Chang Hongfa can understand the sadness in this.
Xu Shiyan glanced to the side, and heard that Li Jingming from the Commercial Bureau is in the same family as Secretary Li.
It seems that they are cousins ​​or relatives, anyway, they are related.
Chang Hongfa just said that in front of Li Jingming, isn't it good? Are you not afraid that Li Jingming will go back and sue?
After all, we still have to work together, so it’s too stiff, isn’t it?
"Xiao Xu, you must work harder this year and take our county along the way.
This time, the province has set a task amount for our county, which is $500,000 in foreign exchange earnings.
Oh, just thinking about it gives me a headache, and I don’t know what to do. "
Without waiting for Xu Shiyan to remind him, Chang Hongfa said again.
Last year, the province was very upset when the Squib was fired, and this year it specially assigned a task.
If they fail to complete the task, they will be disqualified from participating in the Spring Fair next year.
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard the words. He didn't expect that there would be such an operation with a fixed task quota?
"Chen Ju, what products did you bring?" Xu Shiyan didn't bother to remind Chang Hong, and turned to ask Chen Jianzhang.
The task amount of 500,000 yuan is estimated to have to be contributed from the ginseng company.
The products of the county pharmaceutical factory are not bad, but the product positioning is not accurate, and it is not suitable for export sales. Even if there are orders, there will not be too many.
Chen Jianzhang also smiled wryly, "What can I have? Isn't it ginseng products?
Red ginseng, white ginseng, vigorous ginseng, deer antler slices, what else can there be?
Our ginseng antler company doesn't have you as a master, what kind of deep processing can we do. "
The Spring Fair, no matter which county or city is thinking about it, but there are not many in this province who can really shine at the Spring Fair and earn millions of foreign exchange.
After all, not all units are as capable as Yi Canchang, and can independently develop new products.
Why doesn't Chen Jianzhang want to bring some new products?
But didn’t Ershenchang and Quanyang Water Plant bring new products last year? How did it turn out?
Chen Jianzhang felt that it would be better to honestly bring some traditional ginseng antler products, as much as possible to earn foreign exchange.
At least it's not risky, and it won't make people laugh.
Xu Shiyan really couldn't answer these words.
Chen Jianzhang didn't ask him for any advice, and he couldn't get on the pole to help.
Besides, with the current situation, even if Xu Shiyan helped to come up with an idea, there is no way for the county to adopt it.
Xu Shiyan is almost too busy now, so he doesn't want to use a broken car to do those thankless things.
Just when Xu Shiyan was hesitating about how to answer the conversation, someone patted his shoulder suddenly.
Xu Shiyan turned his head and saw that it was Shao Yong and others.
It turned out that Shao Yong, Jin Yongqing, Park Zhengzhe and others were all in the team for this spring fair trip.
It's also normal. In that group of cadres' training class, except for Xu Shiyan, who is now only a field leader, everyone else has been promoted to the deputy county level.
The Spring Fair is such a big event, which county doesn’t want to join in the fun?
Jin Yongqing and others were entrusted with important tasks to attend the Spring Fair.
"Oops, I haven't seen you for some time.
You kid is too mean, you come to us if you have something to do, and you leave us behind if you have nothing to do, right?
My place is not far from your county, so you don’t know how to ask me for a drink during Chinese New Year. "
Shao Yong saw Xu Shiyan a few miles away, so he came directly over.
Patting Xu Shiyan on the shoulder, he took advantage of the situation and put his arms around Xu Shiyan's neck, as if to strangle him.
"Brother, please forgive me, I'm over this year, and I almost ate dumplings in the laboratory.
I don’t have time to go home, so I don’t have time to find you guys for a drink. "Xu Shiyan hurriedly begged for mercy.
Xu Shiyan's words are not false. He took the task before and led the technical department to develop new products.
The Chinese New Year period is the busiest, and I really can’t take care of anything. I almost eat the New Year’s Eve dinner in the laboratory.
Years later, I didn’t bother to visit relatives and friends. I was relieved until all new products were researched and passed the technical appraisal of the superior.
"Busy man, I found out that among us, he is the busiest.
Also, how much did their family spend last year? I heard people say that there are several million, right? "
Jin Yongqing also came over and said with a smile.
The story of selling ginseng seeds last fall was not only spread throughout Fusong, but also in neighboring counties.
Especially the ginseng on-demand technology, many places have specially sent people to learn it.
In the spring of this year, Su Anying was selected as an advanced individual, a March 8th red-banner bearer, and also won the title of Ginseng King.
Not to mention Fusong, Su Anying's name is known everywhere where ginseng is grown.
Others don't know the background, but Jin Yongqing and the others know that Su Anying is Xu Shiyan's daughter-in-law, and Xu Shiyan is behind her company to give advice.
"Hey? I heard that you are going to build a microbial compound fertilizer factory and produce biological foliar fertilizer.
It seems that the effect of the foliar fertilizer is particularly good?
Brother, as far as our relationship is concerned, when I ask you to buy fertilizer, you must leave some for me. "
Pu Zhengzhe also made a request to Xu Shiyan with a smile.
Ginseng microbial compound fertilizer and biological foliar fertilizer, after two years of research and experiments by Xu Shiyan and the researchers of the Agricultural University, finally succeeded.
Donggang Township, Yicanchang, and Xu Shiyan jointly funded and established a fertilizer factory in Donggang.
The project has been approved by the superior department. The factory is currently under construction and is expected to be completed and put into operation this summer.
Planting ginseng this fall will allow you to use new microbial compound fertilizers.
"Don't worry, as long as you pay without credit, you can keep the supply of fertilizer as much as you want." Xu Shiyan deliberately joked.
The fertilizer factory is expected to produce more than 100 tons of compound fertilizer per year, and several units have already made reservations.
Of course, if Park Zhengzhe wants to buy it, he can definitely keep it.
"Listen all of you, how stingy is this kid? It's as if I don't want to pay for fertilizer."
Park Zhengzhe knew that Xu Shiyan was joking, so he laughed.
Several students from the Agricultural University also laughed.
"Brother, come, let me introduce a few people to you."
Xu Shiyan smiled and called Guo Shouye over to introduce him to everyone.
"These are all my classmates from the Agricultural University. The sales of our drinks are so good because of their help."
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to introduce Guo Shouye to these students.
Multiple friends and multiple paths, the network of contacts is accumulated little by little, and it may be used someday.
"This is my brother, my dear friend, my son's godfather.
Currently the deputy director of Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, currently in charge of the beverage factory. "
By saying this, Xu Shiyan is telling everyone that his relationship with Guo Shouye is unusual.
Guo Shouye knew that Xu Shiyan's classmates were not low-status, so he hurried forward to shake hands with Shao Yong and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 574: Chang Hongfa's worries
chapters.content:
Chapter 574 Chang Hongfa's Worries
Guo Shouye knew that Xu Shiyan wanted to expand his contacts for him, so he was naturally very grateful, and he was also very enthusiastic about Shao Yong and others.
"Thanks to your help for the sales of beverages in our factory before, I am really grateful."
This is true. The Bingshan Beverage Factory of the Forestry Bureau had good sales and good profits last year.
If it weren't for this, how could Guo Shouye be promoted to the deputy bureau?
"They are all from our own family, wouldn't it be too alien to say thank you?
We and Shiyan are buddies in the same dormitory, it’s just a matter of talking, if we can help, we must help. "
Shao Yong and others shook hands with Guo Shouye and smiled.
Xu Shiyan and his classmates haven’t seen each other for a long time, and they feel very close when they meet. There are countless things to say, but they can’t neglect Chang Hongfa and Chen Jianzhang over there.
Fortunately, Chang Hongfa and Shao Yong also know each other. They have met several times, and they are no strangers to each other.
Even with Xu Shiyan's face, we can chat together.
Xu Shiyan thought about it, he hadn't seen his classmates for a long time, and he owed them favors.
He simply suggested that after the meeting, he would be the host and invite everyone to drink.
At this time, the person in charge of the event came over and held a meeting for everyone, mainly to talk about the process of participating in the Spring Fair.
After all, there are some counties that have never participated before, so what should be explained must be explained clearly.
After the meeting, everyone went out, found a good restaurant nearby, and asked for a large private room.
Xu Shiyan was the host, ordered a table of delicious food, and brought over a case of wine.
The big guys ate, drank and chatted, mainly talking about some things about this spring fair.
"Xiao Xu, I forgot to ask, what products did you bring to the show this year? Do you have any new products?"
At the wine table, Chang Hongfa suddenly remembered this and asked a question.
"Yes, but the new product is kept secret for the time being, and will be announced after arriving in Yangcheng.
In addition to new products, we also brought products from previous years.
In addition, our beverage factory jointly established with the Forestry Bureau also brought some products this year. "
Xu Shiyan made a fuss, but didn't say clearly what the new product is.
It's not that I'm afraid that others will learn from it, the main reason is that I don't want to reveal my cards too early.
Yi Shenchang’s cooperation with the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau couldn’t be concealed when he declared his profits and taxes at the end of last year.
Once the financial statement is handed over, who can't understand it?
But by that time, participation in the field is no longer just for anyone to decide.
Lin Qiyue has shown his face in front of the provincial leaders, and all the discounts are specially approved by the provincial government. Who dares to make trouble in the middle?
So, Xu Shiyan generously admitted that this time he brought the beverage factory to participate in the Spring Fair.
Chang Hongfa and Chen Jianzhang are naturally not the kind of people who are idle looking for things. They wish there were more companies in the county that can export.
It doesn’t matter which factory it is, if it succeeds in earning foreign exchange in the end, it will all be counted in the county’s account, and it’s too late for them to be happy.
"Shiyan, what products does the beverage factory bring?
Have you figured this out? Last year at the factory in Quanyang, I came here for nothing, but nothing was done.
After returning, Chen Jihui gave Secretary Li a good training.
Thanks to Chen Jihui who was arranged by the province, otherwise, he wouldn't even think about being the factory manager. "
Chang Hongfa was sitting next to Xu Shiyan, taking advantage of other people's chatting time, Chang Hongfa whispered to Xu Shiyan.
The main concern is that if the beverage factory of the Forestry Bureau does not produce food this year, will it affect the impression of the leaders in the field?
"County Chang, the beverage factory must have brought beverages and mineral water.
I know you are worried and afraid that your busy work will be wasted, but this matter, you must try it. If you don’t try it, no one will know the result. "
What can Xu Shiyan say? He didn't dare to guarantee that the things brought by the beverage factory would really sell well.
Give it a try, what if it works? Isn't everyone happy?
Even if it fails, learn from experience and improve later.
Sure enough, Chang Hongfa became even more worried when he heard that Xu Shiyan was talking about drinks and mineral water.
Last year, these things were also sold, but they were not sold. This year, when Xu Shiyan comes, what will change? This is not realistic, is it?
But in front of so many people, Chang Hongfa couldn't say much, so he just sighed.
"Well, no matter what, since it's here, I have to give it a try."
A group of people drank and chatted until midnight, and then went back to the hotel to rest.
The next day, I got on the train going south and went straight to Yangcheng.
Now the speed of the train is slightly faster than before, but in Xu Shiyan's view, it is still as slow as a tortoise.
The crowd wandered around on the train for another four days, and finally arrived in Yangcheng.
Xu Shiyan hasn't been to Yangcheng for four years. When he got off the bus, he found that the changes here are too great. It can be said that it is changing with each passing day.
"Hey, we in the north, it will be great when we can be so developed."
Chang Hongfa, who came here for the first time, sighed when he saw the scene in front of him.
"Yes, as long as we work hard, there will always be a day when we develop. However, I feel that it is enough to compare with others."
Until Xu Shiyan's rebirth, the development of the north has always lagged behind by a large margin.
There are too many reasons for this, and there is no way.
When I arrived in Yangcheng, I went to the hotel to rest first, and went to the station to pick up the goods the next day, and started to set up the booth.
Xu Shiyan also went to the relevant departments of the exhibition to apply for a matter.
Hurry up, the third phase of the Spring Fair opened as scheduled.
Early on the opening day, Xu Shiyan specially arranged for Li Chengrong, Xiao Peng, and those from the sales department who could speak foreign languages ​​to form a team with the entourage from the Forestry Bureau.
At each entrance of the exhibition hall, put more than a dozen boxes of mineral water, and then hold their pre-printed leaflets in their hands.
At eight o’clock in the morning, the third phase of the Spring Fair officially started. Those foreigners who came to participate in the exhibition got off the taxi and walked into the exhibition hall in groups of three and four.
Licheng allowed them to get Xu Shiyan's advice, as long as someone came over, they would hand him a bottle of water.
Although it is only eight o'clock, the weather in Yangcheng is already very hot in May, and today's weather is particularly good.
When foreigners saw free water, they readily accepted it and thanked them.
Some people even took a closer look at the bottle, and saw that the packaging design is good, and the product description on it is bilingual in Chinese and English.
Many people nodded secretly, feeling very caring.
Li Chengrong and the others remembered Xu Shiyan's instructions, so they took the opportunity to chat with each other and introduce the advantages of this mineral water.
Produced from the deep mountains and old forests of Changbai Mountain, pure natural and pollution-free underground mineral water, filtered through layers of basalt, rich in various minerals.
While talking, they will also hand over the leaflets they have printed in advance.
The leaflet contains photos of the spring water production area, introduction to the natural environment, mineral content appraisal report issued by an authoritative organization, environmental introduction of the water plant, and so on.
Some merchants found it interesting, so they simply unscrewed the bottle cap and took a sip. Not to mention, the taste of this water is good.
Although the canyon spring is not as good as the scarce natural gas bubble water of the holy mountain spring, the water quality itself is excellent, and there is really nothing wrong with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 575: New product off to a good start
chapters.content:
Chapter 575 New Product Good Start
When he decided to bring the beverage factory to participate in the exhibition, Xu Shiyan began to think about what method to use to make the mineral water of the beverage factory available to merchants as quickly as possible.
Later he remembered that there was no such-and-such conference sponsor in this year.
So he came up with an idea and specifically told Guo Shouye to prepare more goods.
As soon as they arrived here, Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye immediately went to the comrades in charge of the exhibition and discussed with them about the free sponsorship of water for the exhibition.
Because there is no such thing at present, the relevant departments of the exhibition have not encountered it.
After checking the qualifications of the beverage factory, the person in charge confirmed that all the licenses of the beverage factory were complete and the mineral water had no quality problems, so he agreed.
Xu Shiyan and the others took advantage of this, because there was no precedent, so the relevant departments of the exhibition did not confiscate any sponsorship fees from them.
If it’s a few years, if you don’t pay hundreds of thousands of sponsorship fees alone, people will ignore you at all.
So at this moment, Li Cheng allowed them to distribute water for free at the entrance of the exhibition hall, but the staff of the exhibition hall did not come to chase them away.
Moreover, the relevant leaders of the exhibition passed by and saw it, and even boasted, saying that the staff were very smart, and the matter was handled well.
At this moment, many people gathered at the entrances of several exhibition halls.
Li Chengrong and others played by ear, and after handing out the leaflets, they told them the location of the booth.
And tell the other party, take the flyer and order in the past, there will be a discount.
Not to mention, someone actually took the flyer and went to the booth.
When I came here, I saw not only mineral water, but also blueberry juice, blueberry juice, and puree.
Products that have been available in previous years, such as ginseng flower cola, ginseng cola, energy source functional drinks, ginseng honey slices, ginseng Tianma honey, Changbaishan red ginseng, active ginseng, etc., are also displayed on the booth.
In addition, this year's first exhibition also brought several new products.
Ginseng antler coffee, canned ginseng snow clam honey, ginseng nourishing qi tea, ginseng rhodiola capsules.
Ginseng Rhodiola Capsule, this was researched by Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Shiyan with a lot of effort.
Choose a variety of medicinal materials and carefully mix them, which have the effects of invigorating vitality, nourishing the spleen and lungs, anti-fatigue, and increasing the oxygen-carrying capacity of the blood.
Originally, Xu Shiyan didn't plan to develop this capsule now, he planned to let Su Anying set up a factory in a few years, and then develop these products.
Last winter, Han Liwei went to the plateau on business.
When Xu Shiyan contacted him when he came back, Han Liwei mentioned that the conditions of the soldiers stationed on the plateau were difficult and the rebellion was serious.
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered one of the functions of rhodiola, which is anti-high reaction.
So Chu Xuanhuai and Chu Xuanhuai spent a lot of effort to successfully develop this capsule.
Some time ago, a participant donated 2,000 bottles of capsules to the troops stationed on the plateau through relevant departments.
Brought it this time, it is purely to hug the grass and beat the rabbit, so I will give it a try.
If you can sell it, you can sell it, and you can make a fortune.
As long as they can do their part for those lovely people, their work is not in vain.
All kinds of products at the first booth were introduced in detail, and the two translators who participated did their best to answer questions for foreign businessmen.
Among these merchants, there are several customers who participated in the show before.
When you see a new product, you have to ask about the efficacy, price, etc. of the new product.
Someone curiously picked up the bottle of Rhodiola Ginseng Capsules and asked what it was.
Xu Shiyan quickly explained, "This is a health product, the main function is to resist fatigue, increase the oxygen carrying capacity of the blood, and it has a good effect on altitude sickness.
Like some people who love mountaineering and travel, it is most suitable to take it when climbing some mountains.
Capsule formulation, easy to carry and easy to take. "
At this time, tourism is not very popular in China, but in foreign countries, mountaineering and exploration is a very fashionable sport.
Many adventurers, climbers, travel friends like to carry a bag to conquer those famous mountains and rivers.
The most famous ones are of course the Himalayas and Mount Everest.
Every year, countless people aim to conquer Mount Everest and head towards the highest peak in the world, and there are also countless people who leave their lives on that snow mountain.
The businessman obviously knew these things very well, and immediately discovered a lot of business opportunities.
"Your capsule, are you sure it really works?"
The other party seemed very excited, but also a little worried, fearing that the effect of the capsule would not be good.
"Well, how do you want me to promise you this?
Our capsules are exclusively for domestic border guards. Do you understand the designated products? "
Xu Shiyan did not lie. Not long after the capsule was donated to the plateau soldiers, the above document came down
It is confirmed that this ginseng rhodiola capsule produced by Yishenchang has entered the list of plateau supplements.
Before coming here, Xu Shiyan had already consulted the relevant department, asking if it could be used to publicize.
The superior department can respond, after all, there is a cost to donate so much for one participation.
If it is possible to export and earn foreign exchange, the superiors are also very supportive.
When the other party hears this, what is there to question? Asked about the price immediately.
The capsules that Xu Shiyan brought out to participate in the Spring Fair are all specially packaged. There are two bottles in a box, and there are twenty-four capsules in a bottle.
Xu Shiyan discussed with Lin Qiyue that a box of such capsules would be priced at $45 for export.
In these years, there are few poor people who can afford mountaineering.
These people spend money and don't care, and they have to question the effect when the price is low.
Sure enough, when the other party heard the price, they ordered 5,000 boxes without any hesitation. ,
Five thousand boxes of two hundred thousand dollars, can be regarded as a good start.
Xu Shiyan didn't think there were too many orders. Originally, he didn't expect to make a lot of money. As long as he could spread the donation cost evenly, he would be satisfied.
The order was negotiated, and the other party asked about the efficacy and price of several other new products, and then ordered 2,000 boxes of ginseng coffee and 3,000 cans of ginseng snow clam honey.
This ginseng coffee has a unique formula, which has the effect of nourishing the kidneys and essence, and strengthening the body. It is very effective for men, and it has good nourishing power and does not hurt the kidneys.
There are twelve packs in a box, and each pack is ten grams, which is exactly the amount of a cup.
A box is priced at $30, which is equivalent to $2.50 per pack, which is not expensive.
Canned ginseng and snow clam honey, nourishing and beautifying, has the effects of nourishing qi and blood, beautifying the face, regulating endocrine, and delaying aging for women.
There are six cans in a box, each can is 60ml, just take it once. This box is sixty dollars.
Women’s money is best earned. Which woman doesn’t want to stay young forever?
In order to keep themselves youthful and beautiful, how many women put a lot of skin care products on their faces?
Those things are not cheap, but how useful are they?
Just this one merchant has ordered nearly half a million dollars worth of goods, and at this moment, the shop has been open for less than an hour.
This speed stunned Chang Hongfa and others at the booth next to him.
Of course, what surprised them even more was that at this moment, Bingshan mineral water has also ordered hundreds of thousands of goods.

chapters.title: Chapter 576: Hot selling products
chapters.content:
Chapter 576 Hot Selling Products
Since the Soviet Union's nuclear leak, the issue of food and drinking water safety has been a dark cloud hanging over the hearts of Europeans.
Especially drinking water, the most concerned.
Although it has been two years since the incident, this worry has not been alleviated much.
Canyon Spring comes from the dense forest deep in Changbai Mountain, hidden under the basalt layer, and is pure natural drinking water without any pollution.
Rich in various minerals, metasilicate type calcium magnesium carbonate, high-end mineral water.
Bingberg mineral water comes from Canyon Spring. The sales concept is natural good water, drinking healthy life.
Don't say anything else, just this sentence can resonate with many people.
If it is only exhibited on the booth, it is estimated that there will be some effect, but it is not enough to attract too many people.
But Xu Shiyan used such a trick to sponsor the conference and distribute drinking water for free.
Coupled with the publicity of Li Chengrong and others, this mineral water immediately entered the sight of many foreign merchants.
Coupled with that slogan, it touched the hearts of many people.
So at this moment, a lot of people surrounded the small booth, and many people asked about the price of mineral water.
Bingshan mineral water is packaged in a new type of plastic. The bottle has a beautiful design. Each bottle has a capacity of 500 milliliters, and one piece of water contains 24 bottles.
Before coming here, Xu Shiyan had negotiated with Guo Shouye that this piece of water would cost twelve dollars, which is fifty cents a bottle.
Based on the current exchange rate, that is, a bottle is equal to more than one yuan and eighty cents.
This price is considered quite expensive in China.
Who is willing to spend nearly two yuan to buy a bottle of water? Is the tap water bad?
But in foreign countries, the price of a bottle of water can only be said to be drizzle.
For many people, this is really not a problem.
So when the quotation came out, many people ordered directly without saying a word.
Order 1,000 pieces for this one, 2,000 pieces for that one, and soon there will be orders for tens of thousands of pieces.
The daily gushing volume of Canyon Spring is about 1,000 tons, and the allowable mining volume is 850 tons.
Mineral water production is not difficult, just introduce a production line and fill it directly.
The only thing that is restricted is the plastic bottle on the outer packaging. At present, the raw materials for domestic plastic production are still a bit tight.
So Xu Shiyan reminded Guo Shouye not to oversell the order.
After all, their mineral water factory is not too big at present. If it is sold out, the production cannot keep up.
Guo Shouye is sweating all over his face right now, who would have thought that this mineral water could be sold so hotly? It's scary.
Of course, more excited and happy.
Looking at the situation today, it should be no problem to earn hundreds of thousands of foreign exchange. He also explained to the leader when he went back.
Finally, this good opportunity to participate in the Spring Fair was not wasted.
The sales at the booth here are booming, and letters of intent to purchase are constantly being handed to Chang Hongfa.
Chang Hongfa is now directly incarnated as a stamp-stamping madman, there is no need to think about anything else, just stamping.
"How many orders are there now?" Chang Hong asked the staff around him while stamping.
"County Chang, there are currently about two million orders for various products in a participating market.
Mineral water and some beverages cost more than three hundred thousand. "
Over there, the minds of the entourage were spinning rapidly, counting the amount, and reporting it to Chang Hongfa.
"Our ginseng company also has orders for some products, about 150,000."
Xu Shiyan's booth was very popular, attracting a large number of merchants.
Some people couldn’t squeeze in the front for the time being, so they looked at the booth next to them and saw that there were some ginseng products.
After all, not everyone deals in deep-processed high-end products. Some merchants just buy them and go back to process and produce them themselves.
So they saw that the quality of Ginseng Company’s products was not bad, and the price was very reasonable, so they ordered some.
When Chang Hongfa heard the number, he was so frightened that he almost dropped the chapter in his hand on the ground.
Before he came, he was worried that the tasks given by his superiors would be difficult to complete.
It turned out that it only took a while. Not only was the sales booming at the ginseng market, but it also drove the ginseng company to sell a lot of products.
This is the additional benefit brought by heat and traffic, and the surrounding booths also benefited.
Participation is a provincial franchise quota, and the amount of foreign exchange earned will not be counted in the county.
But the mineral water plant is different. Although it is invested by the Forestry Bureau, it is produced in Fusong, and the water plant is registered in Fusong. This is considered a product of the county.
That is to say, the amount of foreign exchange earned from mineral water can be counted within the county's task amount.
Including the order from Shenrong Company just now, it seems that the task amount given by the province is almost completed?
Chang Hongfa made such a calculation in his heart, he was so happy that he wanted to jump up on the spot.
Before, he was still worried, what if the mission cannot be fulfilled? Can I eat it when I go back?
It turns out that the museum has only been open for less than two hours, and the task is almost completed? God, is this too fast?
Thinking of this, Chang Hongfa's waist no longer hurts, his legs no longer hurt, and his arms can be lifted up. Standing there is a seal.
Not to mention stamping for an hour, he would be happy even if he stamped for a day.
It’s all about money, and if you have money, you have motivation. He can do it, no problem.
The whole morning exhibition ended in such an atmosphere. By noon, one participant had already placed an order of 3 million dollars.
This speed is simply breaking the record.
Among them, new products this year accounted for 60%. After all, those products in previous years have regular customers, and the new increase is not so large.
Bingshan Beverage Factory's mineral water, blueberry and indigo fruit juice, and puree also have orders of more than 500,000 yuan.
Among them, mineral water accounts for more, and juice orders are only worth one hundred thousand dollars.
Guo Shouye was very satisfied with this. He was tired and hungry right now, his body was exhausted, and his consciousness was in a trance.
Everything in the morning feels like a dream.
An order of more than five hundred thousand dollars, just got it? This is too simple, right?
Then what happened at the Quanyang Beverage Factory last year? How can you still shave your bald head?
This question is also in the hearts of Chang Hongfa and others.
So during lunch, Director Xue of the pharmaceutical factory finally couldn't bear it anymore and asked Xu Shiyan.
"Director Xu, I don't quite understand, what's going on here?
Last year, the Quanyang factory also had mineral water and beverages. Why couldn’t they sell them.
And this year it's also mineral water, why are those people shooting guns like they don't want money? "
Xu Shiyan turned his head to look at Director Xue, and smiled.
"Quanyang Factory? That Chen Jihui?
He thought that he had succeeded in stealing the game in the first game, so he cut off halfway and grabbed the Quanyang Lake side in front of our game, so he would be able to replicate our success?
Cut, how can it be so easy? "
When Chen Jihui participated in the first stage, he didn't even understand the superficial, so he wanted to leave the teacher and set up a new school? What international joke?
Really thought that he would be invincible with just a few champagne he made, and there would be no opponents?
Hehe, reality will teach him to be a man.
As for why Bingshan Mineral Water is successful today, hehe, sorry, some thinking is not easy to pass on to the outside world.
If you don't have any wrists, don't come to the Spring Fair to embarrass yourself.

chapters.title: Chapter 577: call to announce the good news
chapters.content:
Chapter 577 Call to announce the good news
Compared to the humble and respectful past, Xu Shiyan's current attitude is a bit arrogant.
Director Xue was choked up by Xu Shiyan's few words. The key is that he was choked, and he didn't ask the specific reason.
Factory Director Xue felt that he couldn't restrain Xu Shiyan, so he stabbed Li Jingming from the Commercial Bureau next to him.
No, Li Jingming didn't even bother him.
This time when he came out to participate in the Spring Fair, Li Jingming's sense of presence was very weak, and he hardly said anything.
He must come to every spring fair, and he has experienced all the ups and downs.
Now he can see through one thing, that is, Xu Shiyan is really proud of his capital, he is a person with real material and real ability.
No matter how arrogant he is, the county will have to endure it. There is no way, who told him to leave him, and the Spring Fair will not work?
As long as Xu Shiyan is present, the ability to earn foreign exchange will become stronger year by year.
Complain with Xu Shiyan, is his head crowded by the door? Now he is still pointing at Yi Shenchang and pointing at Xu Shiyan to serve the dishes.
Li Jingming's eyes are not blind, and Chang Hongfa's mouth is almost grinning to the ear.
At this time, he is going to trouble Xu Shiyan, is he looking for smoke?
Li Jingming remained silent, while Chang Hongfa chatted with Xu Shiyan with a smile on his face.
Chang Hongfa saw that Director Xue was deflated, and knew that Xu Shiyan didn't want to talk about it.
So people simply didn't ask, just chatted with Xu Shiyan to cheer up Guo Shouye.
Guo Shouye said that he was still dizzy as if he was dreaming at the moment, and Chang Hongfa said that he was the same, the key was that he was too excited.
Chang Hongfa's approachability moved Guo Shouye even more, and the other people who accompanied him also showed a little more respect for Chang Hongfa.
Look at his attitude, no wonder he can be a leader.
After a simple meal to replenish energy, the exhibition continued in the afternoon, and Li Chengrong and others continued to deliver water.
Guo Shouye brought over a thousand pieces of water this time, and Xu Shiyan meant that he would send all of them if he could in the next few days.
Don't be afraid to spend money, how much does this thing cost.
If you go to the TV station to advertise, the effect is unknown, and the advertising fee must be much more expensive than these waters.
The effect of delivering water in this way was surprisingly good, and the beverage factory received another 200,000 orders in the afternoon.
By the time the museum closed in the afternoon, one participation had earned five million foreign exchange.
Bingshan Beverage Factory, including mineral water and various beverages, earned more than 700,000 foreign exchange. The ginseng company followed suit, and there were orders of more than 300,000 yuan.
Only the pharmaceutical factory has not gained much after several visits, and Director Xue's face is almost turning green.
On this day, the big guy was so tired that he felt like he was falling apart.
At least I ate a bit of dinner, so I don’t have time to chat this time, so I hurried back to the hotel to take a shower, lie down on the bed, and go to sleep.
Others went to sleep when they went back, and Chang Hongfa had to call back to report today's results.
"Secretary Li, I have some good news for you.
The Spring Fair starts today, and our county participated in the fair, earning $5 million in foreign exchange. "
Chang Hong made this bad intention. When he called Li Jingyu, he deliberately said how much foreign exchange he earned from participating in the event.
Li Jingyu on the other end of the phone, when he heard the amount, he felt blood rushing to his head and his ears were buzzing.
Last year, I didn’t let Yi participate in the exhibition. He said that there were no new products in Yi’s participation, and it was impossible to make a breakthrough in foreign exchange earning.
As a result, last year they set off a squib, and they were ashamed, and they were given a good training by their superiors when they came back.
Participation this year was a quota specially approved by the province. As a result, on the first day of the Spring Fair, they earned 5 million foreign exchange.
The third period is five days in total. Even if the transaction amount is smaller in the future, it is estimated that there will be no problem until the last seven or eight million.
This is called impossible to have a breakthrough? This is obviously a big breakthrough.
Unfortunately, the five million yuan is not counted in the county's foreign exchange earning quota. Are you saying this is annoying?
"Old Chang, what's the use of telling me these things?
One participant doesn’t count as our county’s quota. The task given to us by the province is 500,000. How much do we have now? "
After these few lessons, Li Jingyu is very polite when talking to Chang Hongfa.
"Look, why are you in a hurry? Didn't I tell you this?
Do you know the beverage factory jointly established by Yishenchang and Songjianghe Forestry Bureau?
They sold mineral water, blueberry juice and so on this year, and earned more than 700,000 foreign exchange on the first day. "
Chang Hongfa was finally elated, if he didn't give Li Jingyu a good run, the resentment in his heart wouldn't come up.
Therefore, Chang Hongfa deliberately did not mention how much foreign exchange the Ginseng Company earned, but instead mentioned Bingshan Beverage Factory.
When Li Jingyu heard this, he felt that his heartbeat was not normal.
"Is this impossible?
Last year, the factory in Quanyang in our county also drank mineral water to participate in the Spring Fair, so they shaved their heads.
Why is it only over 700,000 this year? "
This is too evil, Li Jingyu thinks he can't accept it.
"I can't figure out this matter, but it must be Director Xu who gave advice.
The beverage factory has a stake in the market, they must have some tricks. "Chang Hongfa laughed on the phone.
"By the way, our county ginseng antler company has done well this year, with orders of over 300,000 yuan.
The main reason is to have a good time with others, and it has attracted many foreign businessmen there.
Some people couldn’t squeeze in, so they looked to both sides. Our county and Jingyu next door were all covered. "
Chang Hongfa finally revealed the amount of foreign exchange earned by the ginseng company.
Hearing this, Li Jingyu finally felt that his breathing became much easier.
"On the first day, there were about 300,000 yuan. If you work hard in the next few days, the task amount set by the province should be able to be completed."
Li Jingyu breathed a sigh of relief and said.
"Secretary Li, you forgot, the beverage factory is also an enterprise in our county, so their foreign exchange earnings are also counted in our county.
Today is the first day, we have already exceeded the task. "
To say that Chang Hongfa is unhappy is pure nonsense, he is so happy right now that he is going crazy.
I originally thought that coming to the Spring Fair in Yangcheng this time was purely a fault.
Who would have thought, the first day was off to a good start and the task was completed.
Now, he can go home with his head held high.
Li Jingyu on the other end of the phone didn't know how he felt when he heard the news.
Last year he led the team to Yangcheng full of confidence, but he returned with a squib.
This year, Chang Hongfa was ordered in a crisis, but this old boy took advantage of it.
Why is there such a big gap?
"Old Chang, you have been tired all day, go to bed early at night, you have to go to the exhibition tomorrow.
Hope to achieve another success tomorrow and let our county also make a beautiful turnaround. "
Li Jingyu felt that the chat could not continue this day, and if he continued, he would probably have a heart attack.
So he said a few words to Chang Hong and hung up the phone directly.
Chang Hongfa held the phone in his hand, listening to the busy tone on the phone, hehe hehe.
Since Guan En was transferred to the city, today is the happiest time for him, happy, so happy.
No, he has to make a phone call to congratulate Guan Enxue.
For such a big happy event, you must chat with Guan Enxue.
Thinking of this, Chang Hongfa started making phone calls again, calling Guan Enxue.
"Hey, old Guan, I'm old Chang, I'm in Yangcheng, I have some good news for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 578: Celebration all the way
chapters.content:
Chapter 578 All the Way Celebration Party
On the second day of the Spring Fair, there were still many people around the booth of the first participant, but the order speed gradually slowed down.
On the second day, the turnover of the first participation here was 2 million, and the turnover of the mineral water factory was over 200,000.
After the end of the five-day spring fair, there was still a little of the thousand pieces of water that Guo Shouye brought, and they were sent directly to the relevant departments of the exhibition for their disposal.
This year’s Spring Fair set a new record with a turnover of US$11 million.
The Bingshan Beverage Factory that came along with it also earned $1.2 million in foreign exchange.
Ginseng Antler Company has finally completed the task set by the province.
Of course, with the addition of the beverage factory, this time it can be regarded as a successful completion of the task.
One participant once again became the province's top performer, and the news spread back to the province. The relevant leaders were so happy that they went crazy, and immediately arranged people to prepare for the welcoming ceremony and celebration.
At the same time, call a participant, if you have any requests, just ask.
No matter how difficult it is, the provincial government will be the backer and must complete the order in full and on time.
Lin Qiyue received a call from Xu Shiyan earlier, and the two had discussed it on the phone, so they only made one request to their superiors.
Ask the provincial leaders for help to allocate the medicinal material Rhodiola rosea from the western region.
Changbai Mountain also produces rhodiola, but the output is not as good as those in Yun, Gui and Tibet.
There are quite a lot of orders for ginseng rhodiola capsules this time, although local medicinal resources can supply them temporarily.
But such a large amount can easily cause damage to the overall ecology.
The reserves of Rhodiola rosea in Yun, Gui, Tibet and other places are relatively large, and the quality is also very good.
Transporting from there can make up for the lack of local resources, and at the same time can generate income for the local area, which is a good thing that kills two birds with one stone.
So the province heard it, and immediately agreed without saying a word.
Turn around and think of a way, contact Yunnan, Guizhou, Tibet and other places, and transfer Rhodiola and other medicinal materials from there.
After the end of the Spring Fair, Chang Hongfa and his party rested in Yangcheng for another two days, and the big guys took the opportunity to go shopping quickly.
Two days later, the group got on the return train and walked back.
It took another four days to go back, and at least I wandered back to the provincial capital.
The province had prepared a welcome ceremony long ago. As soon as everyone got out of the car, they felt the enthusiasm of the people in the provincial capital.
Outside the train station, colorful flags were fluttering, and many people were waiting outside the station holding banners.
Seeing Chang Hongfa and his party leaving the station, the relevant staff immediately greeted them and sent flowers.
Then some primary school students came forward, wearing red scarves and big red flowers, and the leaders over there came to shake hands with everyone one by one, and then put ribbons on everyone.
Then, everyone was surrounded and boarded the special car, and they were directly picked up at the Provincial Hotel, and then there was the celebration party and the celebration banquet.
Xu Shiyan experienced it once before, and Li Chengrong experienced it once last year, but no one else has experienced it.
Provinces, cities, and counties, when Xu Shiyan and the others returned to Songjianghe, it was already May 16th.
No way, I won’t let you go anywhere, you have to stay and celebrate.
The county also changed its previous attitude, and was extremely enthusiastic towards Xu Shiyan and others.
The kindness is hard to turn down, so what can I do? I can only stay here.
"My mother, I'm finally back. If you don't let me go home, my wife will give birth."
When Li Chengrong entered the area of ​​Songjiang River in the special car arranged by the county, he sighed.
After Su Anhua and Li Chengrong got married, both of them were unwilling to have children too early, no matter how urged by the Li family and the Su family, nothing happened.
When the comprehensive factory was the busiest last fall, Su Anhua worked overtime for two consecutive days and felt dizzy, nauseous and uncomfortable.
As a result, I went to the participating health center for an examination and said that I was pregnant.
Since I have it, I have to, so Li Chengrong hastily asked Su Anhua for a few days off to rest at home.
A few days later, Su Anhua couldn't stay idle at home, so she went back to work in the factory.
The leader knew that she was in a special situation, so he arranged some light work for her, and didn't dare to let her work overtime continuously.
Su Anhua's due date is at the end of May, and Li Chengrong has been away for nearly a month, and she is worried about it.
He was really worried. If he came home a few days later, his wife would have a baby.
Xu Shiyan glanced at Li Chengrong, and couldn't help laughing.
This silly boy, after many years, still cares so much about Su Anhua.
It’s pretty good, the sister-in-laws are all married well, and life is booming now.
The sixth child has another child, regardless of the girl and boy, the two of them are considered complete.
The special car arranged by the county escorted Guo Shouye, Xu Shiyan and his party home.
As a result, as soon as he arrived at Songjianghe, he saw lights and festoons on the side of the road, and Xu Shiyan suddenly had a bad premonition in his heart.
Will the Forestry Bureau hold a welcome ceremony or a celebration banquet?
"Comrade Xiao Zhao, don't turn to the east for that trouble, go directly to the south, and send us back to Donggang."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly told the driver in front to go straight on the road in front of the department store.
Don’t turn towards the Dongtou Forestry Bureau, otherwise, once you turn the corner, the people from the Forestry Bureau will come to pick you up, why don’t you get off the car?
Going out for so long, he will be home soon, he doesn't want to waste another day in Songjianghe.
The driver was ordered to **** Xu Shiyan and others back, and everything was arranged by Xu Shiyan.
Since Xu Shiyan said so, the driver must be obedient, so the driver honked the horn and signaled the car behind to follow.
Two cars, one in front and one behind, drove south from the road in front of the department store.
Take the firewood road of Donggang Forest Farm and go straight to Mulen Farm, then turn east and go straight to Shenchang.
When you come back from a trip, you must report back to the unit first, explain the situation to the leader, and then go home.
Then, Xu Shiyan discovered that red flags were fluttering and colorful flags were flying in the entire area of ​​the venue, and banners were hanging on the garden sticks of many people.
Warmly celebrate the foreign exchange earning over 10 million in one session, and make persistent efforts to create greater glories.
Anyway, it is this kind of propaganda slogan, everywhere.
"My God, what is Secretary Lin doing? All these things in this busy season." Xu Shiyan couldn't laugh or cry.
Thanks to Lin Qiyue, he couldn't tell when they would arrive home, and the venue was too busy at this time, so there was no welcome ceremony.
If this was changed to another time, it is estimated that the participation would have to be very grand.
The car stopped in front of the entrance hall, Xu Shiyan and others got out of the car, turned around and shook hands with the driver.
Xu Shiyan also gave the driver two packs of cigarettes, which he brought back from Yangcheng, which were quite expensive.
The two drivers put away the cigarettes in embarrassment, greeted Xu Shiyan and others, returned to the car, and drove away.
They have to go back to the county quickly, there is no delay.
Waiting for the driver to leave, Xu Shiyan and his entourage entered the field department with their bags and went straight to Lin Qiyue's office.
"Secretary Lin, we are back."
Lin Qiyue happened to be in the office. When he saw Xu Shiyan coming in, he was stunned for a moment, and then laughed.
"Hey, our great heroes are back, hurry, hurry, sit down quickly.
Xiao Li, hurry up and pour water for Director Xu and the others. "Lin Qiyue hurriedly called everyone to sit down, and asked the secretary to pour water.
"I thought you would come back tomorrow, what's wrong? The Songjianghe Forestry Bureau didn't keep you?" Lin Qiyue asked curiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 579: hurry home
chapters.content:
Chapter 579 Go home quickly
"I saw that something was wrong, so I took Xiao Li and they slipped away.
No, I really can’t take it anymore. If we continue to eat and drink like this, we will all be too fat to walk. "
Xu Shiyan smiled embarrassedly. He slipped away temporarily, and he didn't know what Guo Shouye would say when he found out.
But this journey was really uncomfortable, and they wanted to go home quickly. No matter how nice the outside was, it couldn't compare to their own home.
Lin Qiyue pointed at Xu Shiyan and laughed.
"You are the only one who can do such a thing. Others would like to have such excitement."
Lin Qiyue recalled the time he brought people back from the exhibition last year, and later on, he was so homesick that he wanted to go crazy, and he didn't want to delay outside.
"Come on, Shi Yan, let's match up the orders and calculate the raw materials.
We must prepare quickly, so as not to delay production. "
There are so many orders, even if the work is delivered in batches, it will be enough for them to work for a long time, and some raw materials must be prepared adequately.
Lin Qiyue and the accounting team have already calculated according to the order sent back, and now they need to check with Xu Shiyan again.
After confirming that there is no error, the materials will be prepared for continuous production.
Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue spent nearly an hour just checking the materials and data, and they finally finished it, and they were about to leave work at noon.
"So what? Come to my house for lunch, let your sister-in-law cook a few dishes?"
Lin Qiyue intended to celebrate Xu Shiyan and the others, but the venue was quite busy at this time.
Everyone is working on the mountain, and production cannot be delayed, so the celebration party cannot be held.
Lin Qiyue thought about it, why not put some good wine and food at home, as a reward for these people who went out.
"Secretary Lin, don't be so polite, we are all for the show.
Well, we’ve been out for so long, and we miss our family, so let’s go home first.
Xiao Li was still talking about it on the way back, because he was afraid that his wife would give birth early. "
Xu Shiyan just laughed, it's not that he didn't give Lin Qiyue face, he was really tired.
I want to go home now, I like to lie down, I like to sit and sit, no matter how comfortable I am.
"Okay, then we won't stay here. Another day, after you all recover, let's find a chance to have a good time."
Lin Qiyue could also tell that these people looked exhausted, let them go home and rest.
"Then I will give you a few days off and rest at home."
Hearing about the holiday break, Li Chengrong and the others cheered up.
It's just about time. After get off work at noon, a group of people left the field department.
Lin Qiyue wanted to ask the driver to take them off, but Xu Shiyan stopped him.
It’s actually quite uncomfortable to take a car wherever I go these days, so why not go for a stroll by yourself.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan strolled home with a big bag on his back.
The field department is actually not too far away from Xu's house, and they arrived home in twenty minutes.
There is a big lock on the gate of my house, no need to ask, it must be with my parents.
Saturday the 16th, the elementary school is on holiday in the afternoon, Xu Haiyuan and the others are eating in the house.
Suddenly, I heard a dog choking outside. As soon as I heard the movement, I knew that this was the return of a very familiar person.
Xu Haiyuan quickly put down his chopsticks and came out, only to see Xu Shiyan.
"Dad, Grandpa and Grandma, it's Daddy who's back."
Xu Haiyuan didn't see his father for some days, so he hurriedly shouted into the house happily.
As soon as he heard this, several children in the room rushed out all at once, and Xu Haiqing ran the fastest.
"Dad, you are finally back, oops, you miss me so much." The little guy rushed towards Xu Shiyan like a cannonball.
Xu Shiyan quickly hugged his son, "Oh, so enthusiastic.
Little Fatty, you have grown fat again, and Dad can hardly hold you anymore. "
Xu Haiqing, who will be six years old soon, is already 1.26 meters tall.
This kid has a strong mouth and eats everything. Not only is he tall, but he is also stocky. Now he weighs more than 50 catties.
Xu Shiyan hugged his son and quickly put it down, the baby was too heavy.
"Dad, give me the backpack, I'll help you carry it."
Being put down by his father, Xu Haiqing was not unhappy. Seeing that his father was still carrying the bag behind him, he reached out to help him carry it.
I have to say that Xu Haiqing has grown a lot over the past year.
It's not the heartless appearance before, but with sharp eyesight, hard work, and knowing how to work.
The son wanted to show his good intentions, but Xu Shiyan didn't refuse. He simply took off the backpack and handed it to the younger son.
The backpack was quite big, and it was full of clothes inside. It was quite old, how could Xu Haiqing handle it?
Blushing all over his face, he took two or three steps with his hands.
"Eating so much food all day long, I haven't seen you gain strength. Come on, give it to me."
At the other end, Xu Haiyuan couldn't bear it anymore, stepped forward to pick up the bag, and walked into the house.
Xu Haiyuan, who is eleven years old, is already over 1.4 meters tall, and the boy who is growing taller is not so strong and a bit thin.
Xu Haiyuan has practiced martial arts with Han Wenzhong since he was a child, but he is very strong.
That big backpack, in Xu Haiyuan's hands, was like a toy, and he carried it and left.
Xu Haiqing followed behind his brother, seeing his brother carrying the old and heavy bag so easily, his eyes were full of envy.
"Oh, it will be great if I can be as capable as my brother sometime."
"Huh, you are dreaming, you can't get up to exercise all day long, and you still want to be like a big brother?"
Didn’t want to, but his sister over there came to tear him down.
Xu Jinping looked at her younger brother and snorted coldly. This guy eats and sleeps all day long. He's so lazy.
I asked him to get up for a run in the morning, not to mention the strenuous effort. If it wasn't for my aunt's sake, Grandpa Han would have driven this bear back long ago.
When Xu Haiqing saw her sister, she was like a mouse seeing a cat, and immediately wilted.
"Hey, sister, my dad just came back, save me some face." The little guy salivated and smiled at his sister.
Xu Jinping was dumbfounded by her younger brother's sloppy appearance, and this hob meat was becoming more and more difficult to deal with now.
"Hurry up and go back to the house for dinner, what are you talking about?" Xu Jinping glared at her younger brother and told him to enter the house quickly.
Then, he turned back and asked Xu Shiyan. "Dad, have you had lunch yet?"
Xu Shiyan is holding Xu Jinhui in his arms right now.
Don't look like twins, but the difference between the two children is quite obvious now. Xu Jinhui is a little shorter than his younger brother, and not as heavy as his younger brother.
Xu Shiyan walked into the house with the little girl in his arms, and when he heard the eldest girl ask, he answered casually, "I haven't eaten, is there anything else to eat at home?"
"Dad, wait a minute, I'll dust off some pancakes for you, and scramble an egg for you."
Xu Jinping immediately became anxious when she heard that her father hadn't eaten.
Hurriedly went to the kitchen, opened the wooden barrel containing the pancakes, and uncovered five or six pancakes from inside.
Take a clean brush and dip it in water, dust off the water one by one, and then put it there to suffocate.
Turn around and take out a few eggs from the cabinet, knock them into a bowl, cut some green onions into it, and stir the eggs.
There is no fire at the bottom of the pot, so we can only rekindle the fire, then brush the pot, scoop out the water in the pot and pour it out.
Then pour oil into it, scramble eggs, and enlarge the sauce.
At this time, Zhou Guilan also came to the kitchen.
Xu Jinping smiled when she saw grandma, "Grandma, you go into the room and chat with my dad
I just finished scrambling the egg sauce, stacked the pancakes, and went to the garden to gather some lettuce or something. "

chapters.title: Chapter 580: Company short board
chapters.content:
Chapter 580 The company's shortcomings
Zhou Guilan didn't expect Xu Shiyan to come back at noon today.
The children in the family shouted hungry as soon as they came out of school at noon, so they ate early.
With the addition of Xu Jingyi, Xu Jingwen, and Yang Haoyu, if the seven children in the family eat, it will be like a devil mopping up, and there is not enough food for them.
So when Xu Shiyan came in, he was almost done eating. Zhou Guilan saw it and wanted to cook something for his son.
As a result, I went to the kitchen and saw that the eldest granddaughter had scrambled egg sauce and stacked pancakes quickly.
I have to say that his granddaughter really followed her daughter-in-law, and she worked too quickly.
"Okay then, you go to the yard and collect the vegetables, and I'll bring the pancakes and eggs to the house."
The old lady happily entered the house with food.
"Pingping scrambled egg sauce for you, and stacked pancakes.
It happens that there is still some soup made at noon, so you can just eat it.
I'll go buy meat later, we'll make dumplings for dinner, and it happens to be the big leaf celery they gave me. "
This season is the time to eat wild vegetables. No one in the Xu family went to the mountains to gather vegetables, but it didn't delay them at all.
Neighbors in the neighborhood went to pick up vegetables, and they would send them to Xu's house when they came back.
On the kitchen floor, there are more than a dozen handfuls of Dayeqin alone, which is enough to make dumplings once.
"Yingzi went to work in the mountains today, so she probably will be back in the evening.
At this time, Shendi is busy, so many sticks in our house are enough for her to be busy. "
Over there, Xu Chenghou took a puff of his cigarette and said.
Xu’s family now grows a hundred feet of clubs a year, and more than three hundred feet in three years.
Although most of the work is done by hirers, someone has to go to lead the work. Without your family watching, who will really work for you?
Xu Shiyan is not at home, all these tasks have to be done by Su Anying.
The news that Xu Shiyan went to participate in the Spring Fair and broke the record in foreign exchange has already reached the ears of Xu Chenghou and his wife.
The old couple are naturally happy for their son, but sometimes when they think about it, they feel sorry for the couple.
He was so busy all day long that he couldn't see anyone, and he couldn't take care of his family.
Thanks to the fact that the children are obedient and sensible, if this is changed to someone else's house, wouldn't all the children have to herd sheep?
"Going out this time, will there be nothing to do when you come back?" Xu Chenghou asked casually.
"It should be, the Spring Fair is a big event every year, and we must go out.
Even if there is something else, I don’t need to go out once in a while, and I can come back in three or two days. "
Now, things like technical appraisal don't require Xu Shiyan to run away.
The people in the technical department can arrange anyone to go out. Xu Shiyan still sits in the field most of the time.
"Well, that's fine, those who worship in the next week should take care of themselves more.
Don't push everything to Yingzi, she is tired enough.
Take a look at the Sanshi Market in Xitou, there are two more floors added.
The fertilizer factory started construction some time ago, and she went over to stare at it for several days. "
These two are now spreading their stalls bigger and bigger, but the family doesn't have enough staff.
If the couple were okay together, Xu Shiyan was still working at the unit, and he had a lot of things to do, so he would work overtime and not go home for several days.
Xu Chenghou really couldn't see it anymore, so he reminded his son.
Last year, the business in the city was very good. The hotels in the city were full every day. Many merchants from other places and farmers who came to sell their goods had no place to stay.
The conditions in other places are not as good as here, and it is not convenient to be far away. Many people have complained to Su Anyu that the hotel has too few rooms.
Later, Xu Shiyan discussed with Su Anying that it would be better to build two more floors above the Dongtou retail store and use it as a hotel.
The side of the hotel is also covered with another layer, so that it will be used as a hotel, so that there will be no fear of too many people and no place to live.
When the city was first built, room for future expansion and addition was reserved.
The roof of the second floor of the store is a slab, and the foundation is dug much deeper than the normal second floor, so it is no problem to add one or two floors.
Because it is covered, there is no need to lay a foundation, so the construction will start as soon as the spring warms up.
Currently, the second floor has been leveled and is being capped.
Adding these two layers is enough, so this time the roof is ridged to facilitate waterproofing.
The ginseng microbial compound fertilizer factory was chosen next to the processing factory, mainly because there is a small river there, which is close to the water source, which is more convenient.
Currently, the fertilizer factory is under construction. In order not to delay the use of fertilizer when planting ginseng this fall, the machines and raw materials are currently participating in the factory.
It means building a factory over there, and temporarily producing first here, without delaying both ends.
The fertilizer factory was funded by Yishenchang, Donggang Town and Xu Shiyan.
A lot of thought was spent on the selection of this manager.
Finally, it was decided that Yang Junxian would be in charge of the factory.
Yang Junxian has been transferred from the first brigade to work in the town, and he is Xu Shiyan's god-in-law, and the two get along well.
Both Xu Shiyan and his wife trusted him, so Yang Junxian was mainly in charge of the fertilizer factory.
How should I put it, one of the shortcomings of Xu Shiyan and his wife now is that they don't have so many available talents.
In these years, the vast majority of people are still working hard for the public sector. Who would like to come to your small broken company?
There are few talents, and there are not many people who can be trusted.
Zhao Jianshe and Huang Shengli can be trusted, but each of them has their own things.
Moreover, these few people are not very educated. It is okay to run errands and do things with a little effort, but if you are in charge of a project or something, it will be extraordinarily difficult.
Xu Shiyan's brothers, except for Xu Shian, have formal jobs.
It is impossible for someone to leave their serious work and come to be Xu Shiyan's helper.
Furthermore, Xu Shiyan really couldn't trust those few.
Su Anying's natal family has many younger sisters.
The fifth and sixth children all have jobs, so it is impossible to come to help. The fourth and fourth couple are in charge of Shanhuozhuang, and they are not idle all year round, which is already busy enough.
The old couple are still in Daying. During the Chinese New Year, Xu Shiyan mentioned that he wanted Nan Zhendong to come to Donggang.
Nan Zhendong didn't really think about it, his parents were not in good health and couldn't leave.
Besides, they still have a lot of land in Daying. Nan Zhendong has been planting the land for these years, and he can only do this, and he doesn't understand and can't do other things.
The three sons of Su Weicheng's family now have their own arrangements.
The eldest is on the railway, the second is in the credit union, and the third is in the coal mine in Pine Town.
Only the fourth child, Su Anyu, was found by Xu Shiyan to take charge of the restaurant.
As for Zhou Guilan's natal family, the population is not prosperous.
The uncle’s family has two sons and a daughter, the eldest son is in Heilongjiang Province, the second son works at the Xianrenqiao power supply station, and only the old daughter, Zhou Lirong, is in charge of the Sanshi Hotel.
The second uncle’s family has only one son, Zhou Wanxiang, who is currently dumping wood, and will become famous in the county as Zhou Wanxiang in the future.
This kid is arrogant, he doesn't want to do things for others, he just wants to be his own boss.
The third uncle is in Ji'an, and there is only one daughter, and he can't count on it.
"Oh, there is really no other way. We can only wait for my second brother to come back from school this year, so that I can have more people to help." Xu Shiyan sighed.
It is not necessary to make a family business, but in the initial stage of the company, only relatives and friends are the most reliable.
When the company expands to a certain scale, it must employ people in accordance with the rules and regulations.
"Father, you think I can't resign at this time?"

chapters.title: Chapter 581: able daughter
