chapters.content:
Chapter 581 Capable Daughter
Xu Chenghou's face changed immediately when he heard his son said that he was going to resign.
"If you dare to resign, I will break your leg."
The bastard, listen to what he said?
In these years, he has spent a lot of effort and effort, and finally mixed from a technician to a field director.
Seeing that he is only one step away from being the leader of the field, if he says he wants to resign at this time, is that okay?
Xu Shiyan smiled, and took the plate that his daughter had just brought over.
Put the washed lettuce and sprouted onion on the pancake, add some egg sauce, then roll the pancake and take a big bite.
Pancake rolls with scallions and soy sauce, this thing is delicious, much better than the meals at the celebration banquet.
Those things are fancy but not useful, they are all tricks.
"Father, even if you want me to resign, I can't do it now."
For Xu Shiyan today, earning money is no longer the most important thing.
Participating in the field can give him a platform, a platform that allows him to fully display his talents and ambitions.
In today’s era, it is absolutely impossible to get strong support from superiors if you leave a field and work alone.
This is the difference between self-employed and state-owned enterprises. At present, there is still an insurmountable gap between the two.
Xu Shiyan is not stupid, so he will not resign at this time.
It's just that his daughter-in-law has suffered, so he has to worry about everything.
"No way, I can only persevere and get through this period of time.
I think it would be very difficult for the two of the second brother's family to pass the exam.
If it really doesn’t work, I will pay for Xiaobo and Xiaotao to go to study, and help me when he finishes his study. "
These two nephews, no matter in their previous life or in this life, are very rare to Xu Shiyan.
Learning this matter sometimes really depends on talent. Those two children are sensible, and it's not that they don't study hard, but their grades are just like that.
Currently, it is estimated that the entrance to technical secondary school is not enough, and I dare not say that I will be able to enter university in the future after high school.
After all, the gold content of this university is there now, and the admission score is also very high.
If the two nephews really fail the exam, there is no need to go to high school to take the university entrance exam.
Why don't you send it out to learn some professional knowledge, and it would be nice to come back and help manage the factory.
Xu Chenghou listened to his son's words, but did not express his opinion directly, but lowered his head and took several puffs of cigarettes.
As far as the old man is concerned, in fact, he still hopes in his heart that his grandsons will be successful.
But the old man also understands that his grandson doesn't have the talent for reading, so he can't force it.
"Okay, it's rare that this uncle can think so long-term for the child.
We can’t be anxious about this matter, let’s take it slowly, after Xiaobo’s high school entrance examination next year, you can discuss it with your second brother and sister-in-law, and then ask Xiaobo what he means. "
It's about the future of the child, Xu Chenghou didn't dare to make any decisions hastily.
The conversation between the father and son came to an end here, and Xu Shiyan concentrated on eating.
The pancake rolls are topped with scallions and lettuce, and served with egg sauce, which is very fragrant.
At noon, there was still some shepherd's purse and potato soup left by Zhou Guilan. Xu Shiyan ate the pancakes and ate the soup. After a while, he ate five pancakes and finished the soup.
By the time Xu Shiyan was eating, the children had already finished eating.
Xu Haiyuan led his brothers and sisters to the Westinghouse together, and those who had homework finished it first.
Those who don’t have homework, also go to practice calligraphy, read a book or something.
Xu Jingyi is already in the second semester of the first grade, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping are watching here, Xu Jingyi's homework is not bad.
In the final exam of last semester, Xu Shide and his wife passed the double hundred exam, which made Xu Shide and his wife very happy, and said that it was thanks to sending the child here.
Xu Jingwen will start elementary school this fall.
This year in the Yuhong class, I studied with Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing all day long. Xu Jingwen can now master pinyin, can write a lot of Chinese characters, and can add and subtract within 20 in mathematics.
Compared to other children, this is pretty good.
Yang Haoyu's father, Yang Junxian, is now working in the town and managing the fertilizer factory.
Now I am watching the construction of the factory and managing the production at the same time.
Yang Haoyu's mother, Ji Yufeng, was originally an accountant for a large team, but now she is also in charge of the company's finance. She follows Su Anying around all day long, and she is too busy.
Both of them are busy, and there is no elder at home who can help.
In desperation, Yang Haoyu could only stay at Xu's house, eating and studying with Xu Haiyuan and the others all day long.
Thanks to the child's peace of mind and understanding, if it were another mischievous person, he would probably have skipped school, skipped classes, and gotten into a fight.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu quickly finished their homework, and then went to the kitchen to help Zhou Guilan pick vegetables.
May 10th is the best season for celery.
It is more than half a foot high, and the leaves are not old. You don’t need to remove them. You just need to pick out the grass and pinch off the roots.
Zhou Guilan went to buy a piece of pork belly just now, and now it is very convenient to buy meat, and you can buy everything in the market opposite.
Since the participation in the market has become popular, there are a lot of shops here to buy everything.
Someone opened a fresh meat delicatessen shop, butchered pigs and sold pork, and also made all kinds of cooked food. The business was very good.
The shopkeeper saw that Zhou Guilan was going to buy meat, and specially picked the best piece of meat for Zhou Guilan, and even shouted that he would give it away for nothing.
Can Zhou Guilan want other people's meat for nothing? It's easy to talk about it, and persuaded the other party to weigh the meat and pay quickly.
He was very polite to Zhou Guilan. Not only did he give him a small change, but he also gave him some big bones.
Big bones in this era are not as valuable as in later generations, so the bones are really smooth, and there is not much meat on them.
Most people don’t buy much, most of them are given away.
The kindness was hard to turn down, so Zhou Guilan had no choice but to accept it, and just kept it to feed the dog when she came back.
The dogs in the family are getting older and older, and they dare not let them go hunting in the mountains anymore. They can only feed them with something good to give them old age.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu pick vegetables, while Zhou Guilan chops meat and noodles.
Wait for the vegetables to be picked and washed again, then throw them into boiling water and scald them out, squeeze the water dry and start chopping the stuffing.
"Grandma, you should rest, I will do this job."
Xu Jinping felt sorry for grandma, fearing that the old lady would be too tired after working for a long time, so she took the kitchen knife from grandma's hand and began to chop.
Even though Xu Jinping was only ten years old, she was quick to do the work. Two kitchen knives were flying up and down in her hands, and the vegetable stuffing was ready in a short time.
It is considered a happy event for the son to come back from going out for such a long time.
Zhou Guilan thought about it, made more dumplings in the afternoon, and called her in-laws over for dinner.
I happen to have a lot of celery at home, so I use them all. So I chop up the vegetable stuffing twice, a pot.
"Huihui, Haiqing, one of you will call your Aunt Lirong and your fourth aunt, and the other will call your grandma.
Just say your dad is back, let’s eat dumplings tonight. "
Everything that needs to be prepared here is almost ready, Zhou Guilan calls her grandson and granddaughter to run errands to work.
Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing are practicing calligraphy under the supervision of their elder brother. Xu Jinhui is okay, doing the questions very quickly, and practicing calligraphy seriously.
Xu Haiqing dawdled while writing, picking his ears and scratching his back. Anyway, he felt uncomfortable when he did his homework.
Xu Haiyuan was speechless when he saw his brother like that, and just about to teach someone, the grandma over there spoke.
Hearing grandma calling him, Xu Haiqing jumped up as if he had seen a savior, and disappeared with a whoosh.

chapters.title: Chapter 582: wild vegetable business
chapters.content:
Chapter 582 Wild Vegetable Business
It is not busy to visit the market in spring, but only go to the market every Friday, and usually no one comes.
The other side of the hotel and hotel can also be more leisurely.
So as soon as Xu Jinhui went over to talk, Su Anyu and Zhou Lirong immediately came over to help Zhou Guilan with work.
Shanhuozhuang didn't have so many things to do recently. Su Anfen and Ji Tongzhong were both at home. When they heard that Xu Shiyan was back, they quickly led Ji Hongliang over.
Ji Hongliang is the same age as Xu Jinhui, but he was born half a year late, and will not be able to go to elementary school next year, so the family is not in a hurry to send him to Yuhong Class.
This brat is just playing around all day long, and he doesn't care if he asks him to study.
Coincidentally, Su Weizhong didn't go to work today and was cleaning the vegetable garden at home.
Knowing that my uncle was back, the old couple packed up their things and locked the door, and hurried over.
Now, the Xu family is bustling.
Zhou Guilan put panels, basins, vegetable bowls, etc. on the kang, and made dumplings with Han Cai'e, Su Anfen, and Su Anyu.
Xu Jinping, Xu Jingyi, and Xu Jingwen also helped.
Xu Jingwen is an only child. When she is at home, her parents are used to her and don't let her do anything.
Here, with so many children together, there is naturally a competitive pressure among the cousins.
Not to mention, the little girl has grown up a lot this year, and she can stretch out her hands to do some of the work at home.
Regarding this point, Zhou Guilan is actually quite satisfied.
Regardless of the new society today, the requirements for women are not so high.
Unlike before, it is required to have a pair of scissors, a pot and a shovel on the kang, all of which can be afforded.
But girls, at least they should learn to cook, not to serve anyone, the key is not to starve themselves in the future.
At the other end, Xu Chenghou, Su Weizhong, Xu Shiyan, and Ji Tongzhong were sitting on the sofa chatting.
The most talked about by everyone is naturally the matter of the Spring Fair.
Xu Shiyan and his entourage shined brilliantly at the Spring Fair, and the record-breaking foreign exchange earnings were all on the provincial and Taiwan news.
In addition to the publicity of the county and Yishenchang, who doesn't know?
Ji Tongzhong was envious, so he kept asking what Xu Shiyan saw and heard at the Spring Fair.
Then I asked what was going on in Yangcheng, and they all said that it was an open window and the most modern city. What kind of modernization is it?
Xu Shiyan told Ji Tongzhong about his experience of going to Yangcheng this time.
"Huh? Xiao Ji, I suddenly remembered something.
Well, you collect wild vegetables everywhere, do you know where there are many wild vegetables? They are Dayeqin, Cantonese cuisine, monkey legs, and Niu Maoguang.
When I went to Yangcheng this time, I had a good chat with several merchants from Dongyi and South Korea.
Someone said that he wanted to build a wild vegetable processing plant in Dalian and buy wild vegetables in large quantities. "
While talking, Xu Shiyan quickly found a few business cards from his backpack and handed them to Ji Tongzhong.
"I haven't had time to discuss this matter with the other party in detail, I think this is a bit interesting.
You run around all day, you know this best.
If you are willing, I can talk to them and ask you to help them purchase wild vegetables.
Not to mention anything else, just this spring, you can earn a lot of money, and you don't need to put in too much effort. "
Xu Shiyan felt that Ji Tongzhong was the most suitable for this job.
This kid can speak well, and he can talk to anyone.
Not to mention anything else, as long as this person stands there, the daughters-in-law and women in the village will be able to surround him.
I have to say that Ji Tongzhong's face is inherently superior to others.
Such a good condition, if you don’t take advantage of it, wouldn’t you be blind?
When Ji Tongzhong heard this, he immediately stared at the boss, "Second brother-in-law, you didn't lie to me? Is this a good thing?"
Acquisition of wild vegetables for foreign companies? Whoops, that's great.
Among other things, he has traveled all over these places around Changbai Mountain in the past two years, and there are people he is familiar with in every village and forest farm.
As long as the foreign businessmen decide what kind of wild vegetables to accept, set the price and quantity, and send the money.
He took care of getting things done, and didn't bring out any mistakes.
"Really, why am I lying to you? Later, I will ask our translator at the scene to help me and contact the other party to clarify the specific cooperation matters.
If it is done well, this year's crop of wild vegetables can make a lot of money. "
This crop of big leaf celery, Cantonese food, monkey legs, and cow hair in spring, if you understand it, you can earn a lot of money.
Xu Shiyan is not greedy for the money, but it would be a good thing if he could take the opportunity to let others pay more.
The export of wild vegetables can not only earn foreign exchange, but also increase the income of local people, which is a good thing.
The husband and wife don't have time to discuss this matter. If Ji Tongzhong has the ability, let him do it.
"Xiao Ji, do you think your second brother-in-law is the one who makes jokes?"
Over there, Su Weizhong was unhappy when he heard what the fourth uncle said, and said with a sullen face.
"Your second brother-in-law is looking at the poor life of the two of you, and wants to help you. Don't be ungrateful."
Su Weizhong took this opportunity to beat Ji Tongzhong.
Speaking of which, Ji Tongzhong has changed a lot since he helped Xu Shiyan manage Shanhuozhuang.
People are much more mature and stable than before, and they are reliable in handling things.
But Su Weizhong is also worried. This kid's face is already attractive enough. If he has some money in the future, can he show some extravagance?
It's really hard to say, even if Ji Tongzhong didn't have that idea, he was afraid that some shameless woman would jump up.
For the sake of his own daughter, Su Weizhong had to type a few words.
"Xiao Ji, you are living a good life now, but you have to remember, how did you get this good life?
That was brought to you by your second sister and second brother-in-law. If they didn’t back you up and support you, no matter how capable you are, you wouldn’t have a chance.
Don't question your second brother-in-law's words in the future, do you hear me? "
Su Weizhong is helping Xu Shiyan establish his prestige, so Ji Tongzhong must have someone to fear.
I have to let him know that the reason he is today is because of Xu Shiyan's backing.
As long as Ji Tongzhong can remember this, he won't dare to show his wings or make a fool of himself outside.
"Yes, yes, Dad is right, then I have to thank my second brother-in-law.
Without the help of my second brother-in-law, I was still farming in Ssangyong.
Second brother-in-law, don’t worry, as long as you entrust me with the errand, I will keep it clear for you. "
Ji Tongzhong is not stupid, so he can tell who is good and who is bad. He is grateful to Xu Shiyan from the bottom of his heart.
Xu Shiyan nodded with a smile, "Okay, I'll do this matter as soon as possible, and we can earn a fortune by fighting for the crop of wild vegetables in spring.
It’s just right, after you’ve finished your work, the two of you should hurry up and buy a house. You can’t live in the store all the time, that’s outrageous. "
Ji Tongzhong and his wife lead their children, and they still live on the second floor of Shanhuozhuang.
There were a lot of goods on the second floor, and the couple left two beds for sleeping.
Living at home, forever, this is not acceptable.
"Hey, hey, I see, brother-in-law.
Am I thinking that the little money in my hand is not too much? I don't want to. "
In the past two years, housing prices in Donggang have also been rising.
Ji Tongzhong and his wife have saved a little, but if they buy a house, there will not be much left, so they are reluctant.
Ji Tongzhong also thought about it, it would be best to buy a house in Donggang, and take his parents over to live with him in the future, and also have a care.

chapters.title: Chapter 583: someone misses the beverage factory
chapters.content:
Chapter 583 Someone is thinking about the beverage factory
At five o'clock, Su Anying came back from the mountain, just as the dumplings at home were finished, and the first pot was about to be cooked.
The most tender wild vegetable in spring, celery, is wrapped into dumplings with pork belly. The taste is really not boastful.
After dinner, everyone chatted together for a while before Su Weizhong and others left.
Yang Haoyu's parents are busy today, so they don't have time to pick him up.
This kid lives in Xu's house at night, together with Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing, and they all sleep in the same room with Chu Xuanhuai.
Xu Shiyan always goes out, and now he rarely brings back gifts.
Besides, the children don't lack for anything, and they don't look forward to it as much as before.
So after dinner, Xu Haiyuan led his brothers and sisters home to clean up the house, burn the kang, and watch TV.
Leave Xu Shiyan and Su Anying here, and sit here for a while to chat with the old man.
"Mom, I'll bring you something back."
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered that he saw a pretty good seller of gold jewelry on the other side of Yangcheng, so he bought them for his wife, mother, and mother-in-law.
So I hurried to rummage through the bag, and found two boxes from the inside.
"I'm too busy going out this time, so I don't even have time to wander around.
Besides, our family doesn’t lack anything now, so we didn’t buy those messy things, and only picked a few gold jewelry.
Mom, you wear the earrings and gold plate. "Xu Shiyan pushed the box to Zhou Guilan.
Earrings are naturally earrings. The style of gold earrings is very simple, just a twisted circle with the ends buckled together.
金镏子 is a local dialect, which is actually a gold ring.
Nowadays, there are not many styles of gold jewelry at this time.
The gold ring is an ordinary double stirrup, but the weight is not low, about 4.0 grams.
As soon as the box was opened, revealing the golden jewelry inside, Zhou Guilan immediately smiled.
Women, from 80 to 18, there are probably not many who don't like gold jewelry.
"Look at you, what are you doing with all this money? This thing is so expensive."
At this time, the price of gold is about sixty or seventy yuan per gram, which seems not expensive compared with later generations.
Actually, if compared with daily expenses, it is not a lot. How much is the wages of workers now?
"Why is it expensive? The price of a few catties of red goods." Xu Shiyan laughed.
"Didn't you always talk about it before? When you married my father, the dowry gift included a silver hairpin and a pair of silver bracelets. Have you never seen gold jewelry?
This time, the earrings and golden cups are available, so you can wear them vigorously.
I will go out again when I have a chance, and I will buy you a gold bracelet. "
When Zhou Guilan married Xu Chenghou, the Xu family was already in decline, and they couldn't come up with any decent dowry gifts. Two pieces of silver jewelry were considered pretty good.
Now that life is better, Xu Shiyan wants to make up for his mother's regrets back then.
"That is, your son is capable and capable, so you can wear the gold jewelry you should wear."
On the other end, Xu Chenghou coughed and motioned for the old wife to put on the jewelry.
Zhou Guilan pierced her ears and eyes, but she hasn't worn earrings for many years, and she is dying, so she can't wear them directly.
The gold rings are all open and can be adjusted.
In order to prevent the legs of the ring from scratching things, it is generally necessary to wrap it with a red thread before wearing it.
So Zhou Guilan tried wearing the gold ring on her finger. After adjusting the size, she took it off and put it in the box again.
"In the daytime tomorrow, I'll find a red thread and wrap it well before wearing it.
The ears and eyes need to be poked open again with a broom or something. "
Anyway, I bought something and gave it away, Xu Shiyan didn't care if my mother wore it or not.
The couple said a few more words here, then got up and left, and went back to their home.
As soon as he got home, Xu Haiyuan said that his godfather called.
Xu Haiyuan's godfather is naturally talking about Guo Shouye.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard this, he immediately called Guo Shouye.
"Brother, shouldn't you attend the celebration banquet? Why do you have time to call me?"
The phone was connected, and Xu Shiyan teased Guo Shouye on the phone.
"How dare you say that, boy? It's already Songjianghe, you left your brother and me, and ran home by yourself.
Dude, I almost got those people pumping me down at noon.
If it wasn’t for our director’s words, I wouldn’t even be able to get up tonight. "Guo Shouye complained on the phone.
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it. He was afraid of this, so he ran away.
I really can't bear to drink like this, it's best to stop and go home.
"Well, I called you to remind you that someone is starting to miss our beverage factory."
Guo Shouye was just joking. In fact, he had a serious business to call.
Xu Shiyan was taken aback, "Missing our beverage factory? Hehe, I have a lot of appetite.
Brother, who are you talking about? Don't tell me, it's the Quanyang side. "
Xu Shiyan pondered for a while. At present, there are about three or four mineral water and beverage factories that have been declared in the county.
But except for the one in Quanyang that has been completed and put into production, the others are still under construction.
If there is someone who is worried about it, it is on the other side of Quanyang.
"The guess is pretty accurate, it's over there.
The beverage factory in the province asked our bureau through the provincial forestry department.
Ask how much sales can our factory produce in a year, and what is the output like?
This time, we earned more than one million yuan in foreign exchange. Can so many orders be completed on time? If it is difficult to complete the order, the brothers can help. "
Guo Shouye snorted twice on the phone.
"Before we came back, they couldn't hold back their energy. They were jealous of us earning foreign exchange."
"Brother, what is your bureau's attitude?"
Xu Shiyan knew too well what kind of person that Chen Jihui was. To say that he was not profitable would be regarded as a compliment.
On the other side of Quanyang, there is a good factory, let Chen Jihui make it half dead.
At present, no product has made a name for itself.
No one wants those champagnes for export, but they are sold domestically, and the price is not low, and they cannot be sold.
As for the mineral water, because I always want to compete with the holy mountain Tianquan, the price is quite high.
There was no noise at the Spring Fair last year. I heard that the project was directly canceled by the higher authorities.
"What's your attitude? It's useless for our bureau chief to speak, and the leaders above pushed back.
The leader has spoken, let alone an order of 1.2 million dollars, even if it is 12 million dollars, there is no need to ask outsiders for help.
In the forestry system battle, which one of us forestry people is a coward?
Let it stay there wherever it is cooler. "Guo Shouye said very domineeringly.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this.
The reason why the Forestry Bureau was chosen to cooperate with it was because of their strong backs and confidence.
You must know that many leaders in the forestry system were from Dongye and Shino back then.
Later, I received a task to support the construction of the Northeast, and changed jobs on the spot to establish the Forestry Bureau.
These people have a tough temper and a tough style. Even after all these years, some of the traditions in their bones have not changed.
In addition, the Forestry Bureau is a provincial key unit, and it is not far from the big brother in the Northeast.
Dare to think about the industry of the forestry department, isn't that breaking ground at the age of Taisui?
"That Chen Jihui doesn't have much skill, but he's happy to jump up and down.
He heard that we had earned so much foreign exchange, and he couldn't hold back anymore, and wanted to find an opportunity to steal from him. "
Just this little trick, do you still want to hide it from Xu Shiyan?

chapters.title: Chapter 584: gold jewelry
chapters.content:
Chapter 584 Gold Jewelry
"Go and dream of his Spring and Autumn Dream.
As far as his virtue is concerned, he may not be able to learn it if he is taught by hand, so he still steals the teacher? "Guo Shouye snorted coldly.
"Brother, I just want to remind you, this bad guy is not giving up, he is still thinking about holding back.
My side is fine, most people don’t dare to mess with our bureau, so be careful on your side, beware of someone stumbling behind your back. "
Guo Shouye made this call mainly to remind Xu Shiyan.
Don’t get lost just because you broke the record in foreign exchange earning, you still have to be cautious, and beware of someone stabbing a knife in the back.
"Well, brother, I see, thank you for reminding me.
Well, wait until these days are busy, and we brothers will get together and chat again. "
Xu Shiyan had some new ideas when he went out this time.
"Okay, okay, let's rest if there's nothing to do, I'm too tired, so I'll lie down quickly."
Guo Shouye didn't talk anymore, and hung up the phone directly.
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone and dumped the contents of his backpack.
This time I went out for a long time, and it was quite cold here when I left, so I brought a coat, suit, shirt, and many sets of clothes alone.
During the few days in Yangcheng, Xu Shiyan washed his clothes every day when he returned to the hotel.
It’s too hot over there. After a busy day at the exhibition, the shirt is full of sweaty smell, so I can’t do without washing it.
It is inconvenient to come back by car, and after arriving in the provincial capital, I was dragged to a celebration party. I often drank too much and went back to the hotel, so I had to entrust the hotel staff to wash it.
So Xu Shiyan's clothes are not discarded, but with Su Anying's diligent temperament, he will definitely wash them all again.
Now Songjianghe also has a Xinhua Bookstore, so the children are not like before, pestering Xu Shiyan to buy books every time.
When going out this time, Xu Shiyan didn't bring anything for the children.
In addition to my own clothes, I bought gold jewelry for my daughter-in-law, mother, and mother-in-law.
"Daughter-in-law, this is for you, a gold necklace and gold earrings.
Wait until the next opportunity to buy rings and bracelets. I don’t have that much money this time. "
Xu Shiyan took out a long box, which contained a gold necklace with a pendant underneath.
The weight of this gold necklace can hold seven or eight rings, more than 30 grams.
The pair of gold earrings are different from Zhou Guilan's. There are two small gold beads on the rings, which are quite beautiful.
"I bought this ring for my mother. When you have time, you can give it back to my mother."
Mother-in-law is different from mother-in-law. Xu Shiyan can think about buying the same for mother-in-law, which is not bad.
In the afternoon, Xu Shiyan didn't take it out.
I didn’t give this stuff in front of the two old ladies, that would only be a disservice to both sides.
My mother would think that if her son had money to burn the bag, he would not only buy things for his mother and daughter-in-law, but also buy things for his mother-in-law.
When the mother-in-law sees that she has only a golden trotter, she feels very upset.
Cooperating with this mother-in-law is inferior to others, and she even has less shopping.
The gold jewelry bought with good intentions, in the end, can only be mixed.
But if Su Anying sent it another day, Han Cai'e could only think of Xu Shiyan's benefit.
My uncle did not forget to bring her something when he went out, and it was such a precious gold jewelry. This kindness is so rare.
In that case, how much face does Su Anying have in front of her parents?
Sure enough, when Su Anying saw that her natal mother also had gold jewelry, she immediately became happy, even happier than herself.
"No wonder our father always praises you, saying that you are a good uncle.
Isn't it? When I went shopping, I was thinking of bringing one for my mother-in-law. "
Don't care if she's a stepmother or not, after all, Han Cai'e has been in the Su family for so many years.
Su Anying was so young back then, but if Han Cai'e was a little bit mean-hearted, could Su Anying grow up to be this big?
Benefits are important, but this kindness should not be forgotten.
Su Anying is a very generous person, she doesn't care too much about it. To Han Cai'e, she has always been the same as her sisters, there is no difference.
"Since our mother moved here, she has helped our family a lot.
It's just a matter of convenience for me, and it's fun to coax our mother, you are also happy, aren't you? "
Xu Shiyan just laughed, he did this for the sake of his wife.
I owed so much to Su Anying in my previous life, but I originally said that Su Anying would be blessed in this life.
As a result, the stall grew bigger and bigger, all relying on Su Anying's busy work.
Xu Shiyan felt ashamed of his daughter-in-law, so he could only treat her and her family better, which can be regarded as making up for it.
Su Anying naturally understood her husband's intentions, and immediately smiled.
"Success, then I will send it to our mother another day.
You wait, I'll boil some hot water, and you can soak your feet later.
I'm exhausted after going out these days, so go to bed early. "
Su Anying put several jewelry boxes in the cabinet and locked them, then turned and went to the kitchen to boil water.
Xu Shiyan went to spread the quilt, originally wanting to be crooked for a while.
But he has been outside for a while, especially when there are celebration parties here and there recently, he has been tense.
When I got home, I relaxed and fell asleep not long after.
When Su Anying came back after boiling the water, Xu Shiyan had already slept soundly.
Su Anying was not willing to call him, so she let Xu Shiyan sleep with his head turned inward.
Xu Shiyan woke up in the middle of the night and found that he was sleeping in the wrong position. In a daze, he readjusted and continued to sleep.
This sleep was really sound, and Xu Shiyan didn't wake up until eight o'clock the next morning.
There is no one in the house, it is quiet.
After Xu Shiyan got up and washed, he opened the pot, and he ate a few bites of the rice left in the pot to deal with it, and then rode a motorcycle to find Li Chengrong.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about the wild vegetable business, so he asked Li Chengrong to help him, and contact those merchants.
Li Chengrong studied in the provincial capital for two years, working very hard, not only learning English, but also learning Japanese and Korean.
Although the latter two are generally learned, there is no problem with ordinary conversation, but it takes a little effort to learn too professional things.
When Xu Shiyan arrived at Li's house, Li Chengrong probably had just woken up and was eating.
Su Anhua, who is about to give birth, has a big belly, and is packing the baby's things there.
Ever since they found out that Su Anhua was pregnant, Han Caie and Sun Limei started preparing things for the baby.
Small quilts, quilts, urine mattresses, big quilts, small quilts, small clothes, all kinds of things are quite complete.
The due date of delivery is approaching, and Su Anhua is afraid that she will start at any time, so she packed up her things in advance.
If you really have to give birth at that time, you don't have to rush to show up.
Seeing Xu Shiyan coming over, the young couple were very happy.
"Second brother-in-law? Oh, why are you here? Come on, sit down quickly, and I'll make you tea."
Su Anhua hurriedly greeted Xu Shiyan, and went to boil water to make tea for Xu Shiyan.
"Sixth sister, don't be so busy, I'm so dizzy looking at your body, you'd better sit down obediently.
Xu Shiyan was so frightened that he quickly waved his hands. He just came out of the house and he wasn't thirsty. What tea should he drink?
My sister-in-law is already of this size, so let's take a good rest.
"Xiao Li, I have something to do with you, please call these phone numbers for me and talk to them about something."
Xu Shiyan took out his business card and told Li Chengrong which number to call.

chapters.title: Chapter 585: Su Anhua is about to give birth
chapters.content:
Chapter 585 Su Anhua is about to give birth
When he was not busy a few days after the Spring Fair, Xu Shiyan had the opportunity to chat with foreign businessmen.
Among them, several merchants from Dongyi and South Korea, after buying some products from Yichang, talked to Xu Shiyan about wild vegetables.
The Dongyi businessman built a wild vegetable processing factory in Dalian, purchased all kinds of wild vegetables after rough processing, processed them and then shipped them back to China.
There is also a South Korean businessman who has set up an office in Shenyang. He also plans to buy some wild vegetables back in time for the wild vegetable season.
The other party has an interpreter by his side, but, Xu Shiyan can't trust outsiders, so his brother-in-law is more reliable.
So I asked Li Chengrong to help and call the other party.
Following Xu Shiyan's instructions, Li Chengrong first called the Dongyi customer, and the two parties had a chatter.
In the middle, Li Chengrong would stop from time to time and ask Xu Shiyan what to do.
The two sides talked for a while, and the other side agreed to come over in a few days, bringing the purchase list and legal personnel.
If the two parties reach an agreement, the contract will be signed directly.
The other merchant from South Korea was not so happy.
Gen Gen Chi Chi said that Xu Shiyan should buy it first, and then sell the goods to him.
Can Xu Shiyan do this? If he spent money to collect a bunch of wild vegetables, but they didn't want them there, wouldn't that be a waste of money?
"Xiao Li, don't bother with him anymore.
Tell him that if you want to buy, come over to sign the contract and call for the payment.
We will accept it, and we will earn a hard fee in the middle.
If you don’t want to cooperate, you can pull it down and expect us to pay for wild vegetables, that’s not okay. "
Xu Shiyan's temper is also the master who doesn't see the rabbit and doesn't scatter the eagle.
Hung up the phone, Xu Shiyan chatted with Li Chengrong for a while, got up and left when there was nothing else to do.
Li Chengrong and Su Anhua got up to send them off, but Su Anhua suddenly felt something was wrong after spending so much time together.
"I, why does my stomach hurt?"
Actually, Su Anhua wanted to say that she felt like she peed her pants, but in front of Xu Shiyan, she didn't have the nerve to say so.
Su Anhua doesn't say anything, but there are some things she can't hide.
At this time, the weather was warm and she was wearing few clothes. When Su Anhua stood up, her pants were quite wet.
She also said that her stomach hurts, so who wouldn't be nervous to take a look?
Xu Shiyan knew what was going on at a glance, "Xiao Li, hurry up, call your aunt here, your wife is about to give birth."
That's obviously because the amniotic water broke, and she's about to have a baby.
When Li Cheng heard this, he hurried out of the room and ran to the east room to call Sun Limei.
Sun Limei is afraid to go out at home these days, for fear that her daughter-in-law will have a stomachache and give birth sometime.
Today, Li Chengrong came back. She was thinking about going back to the house to do some laundry, but she was not in the daughter-in-law's house.
As soon as she heard that her daughter-in-law had a stomachache and peed on her pants, Sun Limei immediately understood that she was about to give birth.
So he hurried over and asked Su Anhua nervously how he was feeling now.
"stomachache."
The amniotic fluid broke, and my stomach started to hurt.
Su Anhua could bear it quite well, but she couldn't bear it a little bit, so she gritted her teeth and replied.
"No, this is about to give birth.
Son, hurry up, go to the venue to find a car, and take your daughter-in-law to the hospital quickly. "Sun Limei hurriedly instructed her son to find a car.
"Don't, Xiao Li stay at home, I'll find a car."
Xu Shiyan saw it, well, let him go, he is riding a motorcycle, hurry up.
So he came out from Li's house, got on his motorcycle and went straight to the field department.
On Sunday, there were not many people working in the field department. Xu Shiyan was on holiday, and the driver of his car was not there either.
Fortunately, the car keys are placed in a fixed place. Xu Shiyan put the motorcycle aside, looked back for the car keys, and drove the jeep back to Li's house.
"Is it packed? Hurry up and get in the car." The car stopped at the gate of Li's house, Xu Shiyan quickly walked into the house and asked.
"It's packed, brother-in-law, which hospital should we go to?"
Li Chengrong was so nervous that he didn't know what to do, and he couldn't even decide which hospital to go to.
"Then why bother? The Forestry Bureau Hospital."
Donggang Hospital moved out a while ago, to the south of the town government, on the edge of Hetao.
The main reason is that the hospital is too small, with the junior high school in the front and the city in the back, so there is not much space between the two ends.
So last year, we got a place under Nanshan Mountain and built a hospital.
Donggang Hospital has been getting worse and worse in the past few years. Several famous doctors have been transferred away, and there are not many famous doctors who can offer them.
Last year, there were two accidents during the obstetric delivery. In this situation, who would dare to send them to Donggang Hospital?
Songjianghe has two hospitals, Forestry Bureau Hospital and Town Hospital.
The forestry bureau hospital is a staff hospital, and it is much better than the township hospital in terms of medical equipment and doctors.
But there is one thing, this forestry bureau hospital generally treats employees and their families, and does not treat people from other places.
So when Xu Shiyan said to go to the Forestry Bureau Hospital, Li Chengrong was stunned, "Huh?"
"What are you? Hurry up and help your daughter-in-law into the car, I'll make a call."
Xu Shiyan was angry and speechless, this stupid boy, his claws numb when he was nervous.
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, he picked up the phone and called Guo Shouye.
"Brother, tell your bureau hospital that my sister-in-law is going to have a baby, and she will go to your bureau hospital to give birth."
Actually, Guo Shouye is not the one to ask for this matter, Wei Mingrong is also fine.
Wei Mingrong is an employee of the Forestry Bureau, and she used to be able to just say a few words.
But Wei Mingrong is far away, and there is no phone at home, so it is inconvenient to contact, so it is better to find Guo Shouye quickly.
"Come on, brother, just take someone with you. I'll call the hospital."
Guo Shouye didn't ask anything, and agreed directly, then hung up the phone and immediately called the Forestry Bureau Hospital.
Inform the other party that in the future, a staff member in Donggang will go to see a doctor, and he will be treated as an employee of the Forestry Bureau, so he is not allowed to wait any longer.
Now the Forestry Bureau has reached an in-depth cooperation with Yichangchang, and the brother units must take care of it.
Guo Shouye is now a big celebrity in the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau. The director of the staff hospital agreed without saying a word.
As soon as he greeted him, Xu Shiyan drove him to the Forestry Bureau Hospital.
"The mother is going to have a baby, Director Guo called just now."
Li Chengrong and Sun Limei supported Su Anhua into the Forestry Bureau Hospital, Xu Shiyan followed behind and directly explained to the doctors and nurses.
At the staff hospital, the dean had just put down the phone, and when he saw Xu Shiyan, he rushed forward.
"Yo, it turned out to be Director Xu, don't worry, the doctors are here, and you can enter the delivery room right away."
Now Xu Shiyan is quite famous in Donggang, Songjianghe, and even in the county, everyone knows him.
While talking, the dean ordered the doctors and nurses to send Su Anhua to the delivery room.
Li Chengrong and Sun Limei accompanied her to wait outside the delivery room, but Xu Shiyan's brother-in-law couldn't follow him, so he talked to the dean here.
While talking, Guo Shouye's daughter-in-law Peng Yucui came with some things.
"Sister-in-law, why are you here?" Xu Shiyan was quite puzzled when he saw Peng Yucui.
"Old Guo told me that your daughter-in-law's sister is going to have a baby.
I'm here to see what's going on and see if there's anything I can do to help. "

chapters.title: Chapter 586: Great Mr. Su
chapters.content:
Chapter 586 The Powerful President Su
"Hey, take a look at this, please trouble my sister-in-law to go."
Xu Shiyan knew as soon as he heard it that Guo Shouye was worried, so he asked his wife to come and have a look.
"Sixth sister has already entered the delivery room, and it may take a while."
When a woman gives birth, the time is not fixed, and Xu Shiyan can't care too much, so he can only wait here.
"Oh, well, I'll go up and have a look.
It happens that there is nothing to do today. If there is not enough manpower here, I can help. "
Peng Yucui directly handed the things in his hand to Xu Shiyan, then went up to the second floor from the side stairs, and went straight to the delivery room.
As a result, not long after Peng Yucui went up, the baby's cry came from the delivery room, and Su Anhua gave birth to the baby very quickly.
"Who is the family member of the puerpera? The puerpera gave birth to a younger sister, five pounds and two taels."
After a while, the nurse came out holding a candle and explained the situation to the family.
"The mother is still inside, and she can go in to pick up her soon."
Sun Limei hurried forward to pick up her little granddaughter. "Oh, this is the little baby of our Li family."
Li Chengrong also came over, looking at the newborn daughter, she liked it very much.
"Mom, look quickly, how beautiful my daughter is."
In fact, most of the newborn children are red and wrinkled, just like a little old man, how good-looking can they be?
It's just that the child is good for the family, and it's just a psychological effect.
The nurse pursed her lips and put Erle next to her. Just at this time, there was a voice inside, and the nurse reminded Li Chengrong that she could go in to pick up people.
So Li Chengrong hurried in with the nurse, dressed Su Anhua, and carried her off the delivery bed.
He carried her directly out of the delivery room, and went directly to the ward to rest under the guidance of the nurse.
Suan Peanut’s baby went well. The baby was young, and he gave birth without suffering a major crime, so his physical strength is not bad, and his spirit is not bad.
Sun Limei has taken care of the eldest daughter-in-law during confinement, and knows how to take care of the child, and Peng Yucui is also helping her.
There were enough people, and Li Chengrong couldn't help much, so he was sent back to announce the good news.
Su Anhua gave birth to a baby girl in Ping An, so why not go to the Su family to announce the good news?
So, Li Chengrong hurried downstairs, found Xu Shiyan, and drove back to Donggang with Xu Shiyan.
Under Xu Shiyan's guidance, he went home and cooked red eggs first, and then went to his mother-in-law's house to announce the good news with the eggs.
Su Weizhong went to work today and was not at home.
Han Caie left the house by herself. When she heard that the old girl had given birth to a little girl, Han Caie was also very happy, and cleaned up another pile of urinals.
These are all made from old clothes from home. Old clothes are softer and more absorbent, so they are best used as diapers for babies after they are washed.
"Tell your mother that she has been tired for the past two days, and I will go to see Huanxi after she is discharged from the hospital in three days."
The elders are more particular about these things.
Even though Han Caie misses her daughter in her heart and wishes to see her daughter and granddaughter right away, that won't work.
You have to wait until three days, seven days, or twelve days to see it.
This is the respect that the mother's family must give to the in-law's family. If you go too early, you will appear to distrust the in-law's family.
Unlike later generations, when a woman gives birth to a child, it is always with her natal mother in front of her.
No matter what the mother-in-law said, Li Chengrong nodded in agreement.
Then took the scorpions, eggs, and old hen given by the mother-in-law, came out of Su's house, and returned to the hospital.
This time, Xu Shiyan doesn't have to follow, he has to find his own wife.
Su Anying didn't go up the mountain today, but was supervising the workers at the city.
The project here is progressing very fast, the upper second floor has been capped, and the doors and windows, interior and exterior walls, interior decoration, etc. will be installed next.
"The progress of the project is a bit slow. We need to speed up. The work must be handed over in August this year. I can't delay my use."
Su Anying put on a hard hat and talked with the person in charge of the construction unit, emphasizing the progress of the project again.
It is already the middle and late May, and it is not long before August.
Starting from the second half of August, the city will be filled with people one after another. It cannot be still under construction at that time, which will affect the opening of the city too much.
"Don't worry, Mr. Su, I will definitely let the workers work overtime, and the construction period must not be delayed."
The person in charge of the other party patted his chest and assured Su Anying that the normal opening of the city would never be delayed.
"Okay, I can trust Li Gong.
Li Gong can tell the workers that it is better to be fast, but don’t just try to be fast, the quality is not up to standard.
If the inspection fails, I will be held accountable.
If it can be completed quickly and easily, I will also express it here, so that everyone can rest assured. "
Su Anying is a straightforward person, and she also knows that only benefits are the most touching.
She doesn't care about the bonus money, but the speed and quality of the project must be guaranteed.
It is not the first time that the other party has cooperated with Su Anying. Originally, they built this market, and they know Su Anying's style of work very well.
As soon as Su Anying said this, the group leaders next to him became happy.
"Come on, President Su, just watch it."
As long as there is a bonus, why don't everyone work with their eyes wide open?
Li Gong waved his hand, and the group leaders immediately ran to express their spirit to the workers.
Everyone was very happy when they heard it, so they cheered up and started working with all their strength.
"Okay, Mr. Su, it's great now."
Xu Shiyan looked behind for a long time, then made a sound, walked up to Su Anying, and said with a smile.
Su Anying saw her husband approaching, but gave him a blank look.
"Where's the hard hat? If you don't wear a hard hat, why are you going to the construction site? Don't you die?
Didn't you see those shops outside, most of them are closed? The rest is to put the stalls on the side of the road. , quite far from the building.
You came here without a helmet, what do you want to do? "This man, why is he wandering around the construction site without wearing a helmet?
Thanks to the fact that the main body has been capped, if it was a few days ago, anyone who dared to approach without a helmet would be punished first.
"Where's Uncle Li? Why didn't he stop you when you came in?"
The Uncle Li that Su Anying mentioned was the one who watched the gate in the market, and it was the same old Li who was the one who watched the big house back then.
After Uncle Li got sick that year, he took care of him for a long time, but he recovered pretty well.
He has no son or daughter, so he and his wife depend on each other for life.
When there is a production team, the team finds ways to subsidize and support them.
Later, the land was divided into households, and the old couple was old enough to not be able to farm, so life was a bit difficult.
In the past, Xu Shiyan asked Zhao Jianshe or Yang Chunming to bring some money or food to the big house, even if it was to subsidize the old couple.
Later, I went to the city to break ground, and all kinds of building materials here need someone to take care of them.
Xu Shiyan discussed with Su Anying, and brought Uncle Liu and Uncle Li, who were on the boat at the other end of the big house, over to take care of Canshi.
"Uncle Li hasn't seen me for a long time, we chatted so happily that we forgot."
Xu Shiyan was indeed negligent.
The main reason is that he saw that the main body was almost done, and most of the shelves and blocks were removed, so he didn't care that much.
Chatted with Uncle Li for a while, then wandered in.
As a result, as soon as I saw my daughter-in-law, she was so upset by her.
"I mainly want to come and tell you something, I'm in a hurry."
Su Anying's face softened a little, "What's the matter, so anxious? You don't even care about your own safety?"

chapters.title: Chapter 587: signing the contract
chapters.content:
Chapter 587 Signing the contract
"Well, the sixth sister was born." Xu Shiyan smiled and told Su Anying the good news.
"The flower is born? Didn't it mean the due date at the end of the month? Why is it earlier?
How are you doing? How are the flowers and children? "As soon as Su Anying heard that her sister had given birth, she immediately became anxious.
"Didn't I go to my sixth brother-in-law this morning and ask him to help contact those foreign merchants?
As a result, when I was about to leave, my sixth sister had a stomachache.
I helped to send her to the Forestry Bureau Hospital, where she gave birth not long after, little girl, I heard it weighed five catties and two taels. "
This baby is not too big. I remember that the eldest daughter of his family weighed six to seven catties at that time.
"Don't worry, the sixth sister and the child are doing well, Xiao Li just went to our mother's place to announce the good news.
I have nothing to do, so I came here to tell you. "Xu Shiyan smiled and explained a few words, reassuring Su Anying.
"Give birth so soon?
Five catties and two taels, well, the child is not big, no wonder the child is born quickly. "
Su Anying nodded, the speed of giving birth is related to the woman's physique, age, and the size of the child.
No matter what happens, it’s good that my sister can give birth safely.
"Then when we're waiting for three days, my mother and I will go to Li's house to see my sixth sister and nephew."
Su Anying was very happy. The youngest sister also had a child and had a good home. This life is considered complete.
"Shiyan, come, I happen to have something to discuss with you."
Su Anying waved to Xu Shiyan, and the two came out of Canshi and walked south all the way.
"Look, the original hospital has moved away, leaving a big space here.
I thought about buying this piece of land with the town and temporarily keeping it as the sales office of the chemical fertilizer factory.
In the future, we can also act as an agent for seeds, fertilizers, plastic sheets, agricultural machinery and so on.
In the future, if the market size is too small, there will be room for expansion if we want to, what do you think? "
Su Anying pointed to the empty yard of Donggang Hospital and said.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it, "Daughter-in-law, you went with me.
When I sent my sixth younger sister to the Forestry Bureau Hospital just now, I also thought about this. This place is good, so we should keep it. "
Don’t worry about what you will do in the future, just occupy the space first.
Now you can buy it for a little money, just about any business.
Waiting for a few years to go to the market, the land here is worth a lot of money.
"Come on, since you think it's okay, then find a chance and talk to Qing Guo."
Su Anying had already guessed that her husband would support her idea. The husband and wife looked at each other and smiled, and the matter was settled.
It happened that Xu Shiyan had been away for so long, and he hadn't seen Zhao Jianshe and the others when he returned home.
So in the evening, the family made a few good dishes, and called Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli, Feng Chao, Yang Junxian, Zhou Qingguo and others over, and the big guys had a lively time together.
While drinking, Xu Shiyan mentioned the empty space in the hospital, and Zhou Qingguo agreed without saying a word.
The hospital occupies an area that is not too small, and ordinary people don't have the strength to buy it. Besides, even if ordinary people buy it, it won't be useful.
The place is idle, so it’s better to sell it to Xu Shiyan and the others, and the town can get some money.
Su Anhua stayed in the hospital for two days. She is in good health and did not suffer too much from giving birth.
Sun Limei and Li Chengrong took great care of her.
So on the third morning, after the doctor checked the condition of the mother and daughter, they agreed to leave the hospital.
Although I only stayed in the hospital for two days, there are many things for adults and children.
Su Anying, Su Anfen, and Su Anfang all went to the hospital to help.
Xu Shiyan and Li Bingzhuo also arranged for drivers to pick them up at the Forestry Bureau Hospital.
Su Weizhong and Han Cai'e didn't go to the hospital to pick him up, but went directly to Li's house.
The old couple brought a lot of things, eggs, old hen, millet, brown sugar, etc., and made new clothes for the granddaughter.
Li Chengrong is the youngest child in the Li family, and his daughter is also the youngest in the next generation.
Li Chengrong's older brothers and sisters all came back to visit their little niece, and for a while there were people inside and outside the Li family's house, which was very lively.
Su Anhua was discharged from the hospital and went home. After all, Han Cai'e couldn't let go of her daughter and granddaughter, so she took care of her at Li's house for a few days.
Su Anying and the other sisters also went over to help take care of her from time to time.
Sun Limei stayed with her daughter-in-law all day long, except for breastfeeding, she didn't need Su Anhua to do anything else.
With so many people helping to take care of her, Su Anhua sat comfortably and recovered well during this confinement period.
On May 20th, Dongyi merchants brought their translators and entourages to Donggang Town to meet Xu Shiyan and his wife.
The two parties had a detailed discussion on the acquisition of wild vegetables and reached a cooperation intention.
It was funded by merchants, and Xu Shiyan arranged for people to come forward to buy it, and then carry out rough processing according to the requirements of merchants.
Roughly processed products are shipped to the wild vegetable processing factory in Dalian by railway, and then shipped back to Dongyi after finishing.
The purchase catalog includes big leaf celery, Cantonese cuisine, and monkey legs. Of course, the most abundant one is Niu Mao Guang.
This thing is very popular in Dongyi, and it is known as a mountain delicacy. Customers ask for as much as they want, and the more the better.
Regarding this, Xu Shiyan is naturally happy to see it succeed.
Anyway, it was the other party who sent the payment first, and they only paid for the purchase, rough processing, and delivery according to the quality and quantity, and they didn't need to pay.
It’s better to have more deals like this.
At first, Xu Shiyan just wanted to find a good business for Ji Tongzhong to earn some money.
But Dongyi merchants will not do it. They require the partners to have considerable qualifications, otherwise they will not be credible.
There is no other way but to sign an agency acquisition contract with Su Anying's company.
In this way, it is impossible for Ji Tongzhong to own this business alone.
Of course, with the amount of supply requested by the other party, Ji Tongzhong simply cannot complete it by himself, it must be done by teamwork.
After the contract was signed, the other party directly sent the foreign exchange equivalent to 500,000 yuan in the first installment, and the money was transferred to the company's account in the county.
When Su Anying and the others went to withdraw the money, the bank directly gave them RMB.
Forex? Such precious foreign exchange has long been withheld by the county, how could it be in the hands of individuals?
In this season, there is not much work in the field, and the field is also in the period of hanging hoe.
Ji Tongzhong, Zhao Jianguo, Huang Shengkai's younger brother Huang Shengkai and others drove a car and pulled a large white plastic bucket, and went straight to the forest farms of Qianchuan, Shengli, Ma'anshan, and Caozihe.
It will take a few more days for Niu Maoguang to post an advertisement to buy Dayeqin, Cantonese cuisine, and monkey legs.
"Take big leaf celery, 30 cents a catty, the requirement is no less than 20 centimeters, no leaves.
It has to be straightened from the head to the tail, **** with this kind of rubber band for hair, and weighed when you come back, and how much you have is directly cashed. "
Ji Tongzhong came to Shengli Forest Farm. He has acquaintances here, and he received a lot of wild goods through them last year.
This year, I still receive the goods at that station, which is so convenient.
"Oh, why do you have to pick off the leaves? That's quite troublesome."
Several women heard this and couldn't help but mutter a few words.
"Auntie, what are you talking about, how tall is Da Yeqin at this time?
We have to pick off the leaves and keep only the stems to eat at home. Then foreigners are not fools, they don’t know? "
Ji Tongzhong smiled at the women and explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 588: Acquisition of wild vegetables
chapters.content:
Chapter 588 Acquisition of wild vegetables
When Ji Tongzhong said this, the women all grinned and didn't worry about it.
"Then your price is too low, isn't it? Thirty cents a catty, how much money can you make?"
"Auntie, don't fool me, a foreigner, don't think I don't know, there are a lot of wild vegetables here.
I heard that there is a bald mountain here, and the whole mountain is full of big leaf celery, so you don’t have to go, just sit at the bottom of the mountain and squeeze it hard.
At this time, Da Yeqin was tall and weighed on the scales. For a capable person like my aunt, wouldn't it be the same as playing if she gained one or two hundred catties a day?
One hundred catties is thirty yuan, and two hundred catties is sixty yuan.
Auntie, if you earn sixty a day, it will almost catch up with uncle's half-month salary.
Going home at night, my uncle can't help but make you a footwashing water. Are you comfortable serving you? "
Who is Ji Tongzhong? How many women can be fooled? It's good if he doesn't fool others into limping.
The dark-faced Nan Zhendong next to him was almost amused by Ji Tongzhong's words.
So he coughed twice and tried his best to hold back his laughter, just to tell Ji Tongzhong to restrain himself and stop talking glibly.
Nan Zhendong firmly remembered the mission entrusted to him by his father-in-law, which was to always pay attention to Ji Tongzhong and not allow him to get too close to any woman.
Originally, Nan Zhendong didn't really want to come to Donggang. He was so stubborn that he thought it would be good to plant some land and raise some livestock at home.
Although I come to Donggang to earn a lot, I have to listen to others and feel uncomfortable.
A few days ago, when Su Weizhong learned that Xu Shiyan had signed a contract with Dongyi merchants, and that Ji Tongzhong was the main force in purchasing wild vegetables, he lost his composure.
While not at work, I personally went back to Lie Daying and found Nan Zhendong.
Break it apart and smash it into pieces, and have a good meal with my uncle.
Nan Zhendong finally agreed, and came out with his father-in-law to help his second brother-in-law Xu Shiyan complete the business of wild vegetables.
In addition, Su Weizhong also gave Nan Zhendong a secret task, which was to watch Ji Tongzhong.
The main reason is that Ji Tongzhong's face is too flamboyant, and he can chat with anyone very warmly.
Su Weizhong was worried that Ji Tongzhong had to collect vegetables outside for a while, what if he was confused with any woman?
Yes, it is impossible for Ji Tongzhong to be alone, and someone must be arranged with him.
But who cares about Ji Tongzhong? Even Zhao Jianguo and the others wouldn't meddle in their own business.
So Su Weizhong asked Nan Zhendong to keep an eye on it.
Ji Tongzhong still respects these brothers-in-law, especially Nan Zhendong has a dark face all day long, not smiling, and can scare away women with ulterior motives.
"Look, this young man is still listening."
Ji Tongzhong's words moved Ji Tongzhong's heart, so what are you still talking about here? Hurry up the mountain to collect vegetables.
Shengli Forest Farm is the smallest forest farm on the northern line of Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, with only about a hundred households.
But Shengli Forest Farm is close to the Changbai Mountain Reserve, and is rich in various forestry resources.
With few people and many resources, there is a lot of wild vegetables without going too far.
This season is the interval between timber and forestry production, and forestry workers don't have much to do.
So many families are a family of two or three, carrying baskets on their backs and going up the mountain to collect vegetables.
They are all locals. They are very familiar with the surrounding terrain and the distribution of wild vegetables, so they naturally know where the wild vegetables are thick.
Those who have a heart will remember the location, keep it a secret and don’t tell others, and go straight there every year during the wild vegetable season.
Now I know that Dayeqin has also been bought by someone. Those big girls, young daughters-in-law, middle-aged women, and half-wives all went up the mountain with dry food.
Come to the foot of Bald Dingzi Mountain, just find a place to squat there, and just reach out to pick up the vegetables.
Pick up the vegetables first, and wait until the back basket is almost full for a while, and people are too tired to panic, so they sit down and rest.
During the break, I picked off the leaves of celery and tied them smoothly one by one.
In this way, you don’t have to pack it up after going down the mountain, and removing the leaves can also reduce the weight, so you can carry more when going down the mountain.
After a busy day, the big back basket is filled to the brim, compacted over and over again.
At the end, I staggered and walked back down the mountain with my back on my back. When I came to the purchase point, I went directly to the scale.
At this time, there were few platform scales, and most of them were large steelyards. Ji Tongzhong hired two local boys from Shengli to help lift the scales.
Ji Tongzhong looked at the scale to keep accounts, Huang Shengkai settled accounts, and Nan Zhendong paid.
Mountain wild vegetables are all time-sensitive. After this price season, they will get old and cannot be eaten.
So when they came out this time, they were divided into several groups.
Ji Tongzhong was at Shengli Forest Farm, while Zhao Jianguo, Li Daniu, and Yang Chunsheng went to Qianchuan Forest Farm and Dajianchang Village.
Brothers Feng Yue, Feng Yuan, and Sun Xiaofeng's younger brother Sun Xiaoli went to Ma'anshan and the other side of the Caozihe forest farm.
The resources of wild vegetables over there are not as good as those of Qianchuan and Shengli, Feng Yue and the others took turns buying them.
Packed celery costs 30 cents a catty, and Cantonese food costs 20 cents a catty.
Cantonese cuisine also requires a height of about 20 centimeters, no palms stretched out, the roots are straightened, and tied with rubber bands.
After these two vegetables are purchased, a small section of the root has to be cut off, and then salted.
At this time period, these two kinds of dishes are at the right time. In a few days, it's time to squeeze the cow's hair and grow the monkey's legs.
Niu Mao Guang and Hou Zi Keg Er Cai are both dried vegetables, so there is no need to worry if there is enough time.
Ji Tongzhong and others collected the vegetables in the evening, and hurriedly cut up pickled vegetables the next day during the day.
They brought a lot of large white plastic buckets and salt this time. They put bundles of wild vegetables in the bucket, sprinkled a layer of salt on each layer of vegetables, and sent them back to Donggang after a full cart.
It happened that Su Anying bought the original courtyard of Donggang Hospital, and built two rows of sheds. The plastic buckets were directly placed in the sheds, and they could be transported away by car after a while.
Su Anying, Huang Shengli and others will not be involved in the wild vegetable business. It is all operated by brothers and relatives of each family.
The name of the company is only used to sign the contract, 30% of the money earned is set aside as the company's profit, and the remaining 70% is shared by Ji Tongzhong and others.
The point is that Huang Shengli and the others are too busy, how can they have time to mix in?
It's better to help the brothers of each family, and it can be regarded as finding a job for them.
Xu Shiyan is even busier. He has received so many orders in the first place, so why not hurry up and produce?
When Xu Shiyan decided on the direction of new product development last winter, the factory stocked a lot of various medicinal materials.
Last year's ginseng was not sold to the provincial medicinal materials company too much, and a large part of the ginseng was kept for its own research and development of new products.
In the ginseng coffee, the main ingredients are various medicinal materials. Although there are also coffee ingredients, the proportion is not too high.
The required coffee has been imported from abroad through relevant departments, which is enough.
Ginseng snow clam honey, which uses snow clam, which is what the locals call toad oil, is not difficult.
Xu Shiyan suggested to Guo Shouye a long time ago that they can encourage the family members of Forestry Bureau employees to contract mountain forests and river sections, cultivate under-forest ginseng, and raise toads.
Last fall, Shenchang bought part of it from others, and it is estimated that this fall, they will be able to receive a large amount of toad oil.
As for velvet antlers, there are plenty of them on the farm, and this year's velvet antlers should be harvested soon, so there is no need to worry about raw materials.

chapters.title: Chapter 589: Games guests
chapters.content:
Chapter 589 Sports meeting guests
When an industry has formed a scale, it can drive the rise of other upstream and downstream industries.
It’s like a ginseng market. Nowadays, all kinds of products are deeply processed and exported. What is needed is not only ginseng, but various medicinal materials.
Most of these medicinal materials come from the comprehensive utilization of ginseng and ground in a ginseng field.
But there is also a part that needs to be purchased from elsewhere, so that other people's income can be increased.
For another example, there are special factories to supply all kinds of outer packaging required by these products.
One, the more orders there are, the more orders from related factories will increase, thereby increasing jobs and driving local income.
The province has issued an order to fully support the foreign exchange earning by participating in the export, and no one or anything should obstruct or delay it.
In this way, how many people in the county dare to use their brains?
Li Jingyu even said directly that no matter whether they want people or things, they are all satisfied, and no one is allowed to make trouble.
Having said this, as soon as you participate in the field, you can call on the resources of the whole county, and the horsepower will be fully utilized for production.
Xu Shiyan, the head of the factory who mainly focuses on the deep processing of products, is also very busy, and he gets off work late every day.
"Father, why did you come back, we have had you for a long time."
This evening, Xu Shiyan rarely got off work early, and entered the house at six o'clock.
As a result, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping hurried over when they saw Xu Shiyan.
Xu Haiyuan brought over a glass of water, Xu Jinping hurriedly rubbed his father's shoulders and beat him twice along the way.
"What's the matter with you two? Tell me quickly if you have something to do. You don't have to talk to your father about it."
Xu Shiyan saw the expressions of his son and daughter, and felt something was wrong.
These two little brats have nothing to do to be courteous, so there must be something wrong.
"Dad, um, our school will have a sports meeting tomorrow.
The meaning of the principal, I want to invite you and my mother to go to school as guests. "
Both brothers and sisters were embarrassed by their father.
Donggang Primary School holds a sports meeting every year before June 1st, which is also an old tradition.
Xu Shiyan glanced at the two children, chuckled, "Don't say it so nicely.
Is that for us to be guests? That obviously wants your parents to sponsor something, right? "
Ever since Xu Shiyan and his wife got rich, they have invested a lot in local education.
A batch of new desks were replaced for Donggang Primary School the year before last, and heating was installed for Donggang Junior High School last year.
This year, Donggang High School said it was going to build a library, and Xu Shiyan got a lot of books from his contacts.
This society is like this. When you suddenly become rich, countless things will come up.
Xu Shiyan and his wife are also ordinary people and cannot escape these mundane things.
But the couple agrees, and other things can be ignored, but in terms of education, they can properly help a few local schools, which can be regarded as setting an example for the children.
No matter what age, investing in education is a good thing for everyone, and it can be done.
So when he heard that the principal of the primary school let the couple go there, Xu Shiyan's first reaction was that the primary school was planning to get some sponsorship again.
Xu Haiyuan shook his head, "No, our teacher didn't say that, the teacher just said that the principal invited you to be guests."
After all, I am a child, and I still can't figure out the twists and turns of the adult world.
"Come on, I see. I'll discuss it with your mother after dinner."
Xu Shiyan raised his hand and rubbed the top of his son's head.
In a blink of an eye, the eldest son is eleven years old, so tall.
In a few years, my son will be taller than him. At that time, if I want to rub the top of my son's head, I'm afraid he will have to raise his feet.
"Okay, don't think so much with your little head, you don't understand the things of adults."
Children, no matter how precocious and smart they are, they should not step into the world of adults prematurely. It is better to let them maintain their innocence.
"Oh, I see, Dad." Xu Haiyuan nodded.
At this time, Su Anying yelled that dinner was ready, so she hurriedly cleaned up the meal.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan called Guo Shouye.
Fifty boxes of mineral water will be transferred from the beverage factory and sent to Donggang Primary School tomorrow. This will be counted on Xu Shiyan's own account.
While on the phone, Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered something.
"Brother, remember to ask the driver to deliver water tomorrow.
Well, I have an idea, after I finish my work tomorrow, let's meet up. "
Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered that sports drinks were quite popular in his previous life.
Now that the concept has not come out yet, they can take advantage of the opportunity to produce a new product.
Of course, how this works still needs to be considered, so let’s talk about it after getting the product out.
Xu Shiyan happily hung up the phone, but when he looked up, he saw his son and daughter with worried and guilty expressions on their faces.
"What's the matter with you two?"
"Dad, are we giving you trouble.
The mineral water, I heard that it is exported for foreign exchange, is expensive for a box.
You want to send fifty boxes to the school at once, and you can sell them for a lot of money. "Xu Haiyuan said quite distressed.
He seems to have heard someone say that the export of mineral water costs more than ten dollars a box, how much is fifty boxes?
Because of what they said, Dad had to spend so much money, Xu Haiyuan felt that it was too bad.
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, and stretched out his hands to rub his son's face.
"Don't think too much about it, kids. Dozens of boxes of water are a lot of money for others, but it's not a big deal for your dad.
Your school holds a sports meeting. Since Dad was invited to be a guest, he must send some congratulatory gifts. This is normal. "
This is indeed the case. Every year there is a sports meeting in elementary school, people from many units are invited to participate.
For those who go, most of them will send a plaque, decorative painting and the like as congratulatory gifts.
Xu Shiyan knew the news was too late, and it was too late to do those things, so he could only send some mineral water as his wish, which was nothing.
"Besides, because of this incident, Dad has a new inspiration. You will know it later."
If it wasn't for the sports meeting, Xu Shiyan would still not be able to remember about sports drinks.
This idea itself is infinite wealth. With this inspiration, many kinds of drinks can be made.
In the future, when these beverages are produced, they will sell for far more than the fifty boxes of mineral water sponsored to Donggang Primary School today.
"Oh, that's fine." Hearing what his father said, Xu Haiyuan's guilty mood finally got better.
But this also strengthened his idea that in the future, no matter whether he is in junior high school or high school, he will not tell others who his parents are, so as not to cause trouble to them.
The siblings glanced at each other, went to the outhouse to mutter for a long time, and then went to watch TV.
Xu Shiyan saw the two brothers and sisters together and didn't know what to mutter, and didn't care, just smiled.
"Boss Su, tomorrow morning, let's go to the elementary school together and see what's going on there."
So, the debt of favor owed will always be repaid.
In order for Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping to study early, Xu Shiyan asked the principal for help. How is it now? Are you all back?

chapters.title: Chapter 590: Principal's request
chapters.content:
Chapter 590 Principal Gao's request
On May 31st, Tuesday, Donggang Central Primary School held a sports meeting.
Early in the morning, Xu Shiyan and his wife woke up to change and tidy up the children.
Xu Haiyuan is the captain of the Young Pioneers and also the head of the school radio station. Who else is the announcer of the sports meeting besides him?
The teacher had already ordered Xu Haiyuan to wear a good-looking suit and tidy up neatly.
For this reason, Xu Haiyuan went to shave his hair yesterday.
Xu Haiyuan can say something, boy, a suit and shirt will do.
Xu Jinping and Jiang Chunhong are two guards of the class square team, and the class teacher asked the two children to wear white shirts and red suspender skirts.
The hair is tied into a high ponytail and then coiled up, with a red head flower and makeup.
If it's just a ponytail, Xu Jinping can handle it by herself.
But with this set of hair and makeup, it's a bit difficult for a ten-year-old girl.
Fortunately, we have everything at home, so Su Anying got up early and started working on the children.
After the two children here are done, they have to go to Xu Chenghou's side.
Xu Jingyi is in the first grade, and she is also the guard in the class.
The child is young, and Zhou Guilan doesn't know what to do, so Su Anying has to take care of everything.
"If it's the year after next year, Jingwen, Huihui, and Haiqing will all go to elementary school.
Oh my god, just busying them is enough. "
Zhou Guilan said with emotion while handing a comb and rubber band beside her.
"It's okay, Yuanyuan will be in junior high school at that time, and Pingping can clean up by herself when she grows up, so just take care of these little ones."
Su Anying is quite optimistic. With the intelligence and capability of her eldest daughter, it is estimated that Su Anying will not need to do it next year, and she will do everything by herself.
In another two years, Su Anying should not need to take care of these young ones, and the eldest daughter can take care of them all by herself.
Zhou Guilan agreed when she heard it. The eldest granddaughter is capable of doing these tasks. These tasks are really hard for her.
The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law finally cleaned up the children, and it was almost seven o'clock.
So Xu Shiyan and his wife led the children out together, joined other children, and went straight to school.
Arrived at school, Xu Haiqing, Xu Jinhui, and Xu Jingwen went to Yuhong Class.
Then Xu Shiyan accompanied his son to class every five years, and Su Anying accompanied his daughter to class every three years.
Go and chat with the class teacher for a while, if you can help with anything, do it. If there is nothing wrong with the class, just go to the principal.
Xu Haiyuan's class teacher is a female teacher in her forties. She wears a pair of glasses.
Teacher Li was very polite when he saw Xu Shiyan. The two chatted a few words and exchanged information about Xu Haiyuan's situation at school.
