In fact, there is nothing to say. Xu Haiyuan is smart, sensible and precocious. He has been the king of children since he was a child.
No matter how difficult the thorny student in the class is, he would not dare to show his wings in front of Xu Haiyuan.
It can be said that Xu Haiyuan's prestige in the class is higher than that of the teacher.
After all, they have changed four class teachers from the first grade to the fifth grade, but the class leader has always been Xu Haiyuan.
Mr. Li had to praise Xu Haiyuan, and at the same time expressed his gratitude to Xu Shiyan for his strong support for the work of the school and the class.
Xu Shiyan had a few polite words with Teacher Li, and seeing that there was nothing to help here, he told Teacher Li, and left Class every five years to go to the principal's office.
Just at this time, the driver of the mineral water factory drove the water over and asked where it was unloaded.
"Oh, Director Xu, how embarrassing it is to make you spend money?"
Principal Gao of the elementary school was quite surprised when he heard that fifty boxes of mineral water had been sent.
Now people in Donggang and Songjianghe, who doesn’t know that there is mineral water in their local area that can be exported for foreign exchange?
A box can sell for more than a dozen dollars, which translates to tens of dollars.
Fifty boxes, thousands of dollars, they delivered it without blinking an eye. Could Principal Gao be unhappy?
Immediately arrange the physical education teacher and logistics teacher of the school to move the water down and put it next to the sports water rostrum.
This water must be reserved for the leaders who came to participate in the sports meeting, and let everyone taste it. What does the water that comes out of this mouth taste like.
"Director Xu, I actually came to you today because I have something to ask for your help."
Principal Gao arranged for someone to carry water, turned around and asked Xu Shiyan to sit down and chat with Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan thought to himself, look, isn't this here?
"Principal Gao said that if I can help, I will definitely not refuse."
Forget it, this principal Gao is a nice person, he is dedicated to the elementary school and the children, as long as you can help, try to help.
"That's the thing, isn't there a school office in our school?
There are a lot of products produced this year. It would be a pity to sell them immediately.
I wondered if I could ask Director Xu for advice, and we also learned some new products to earn more money.
Look at the school building at the east end of our school, it has been there for many years, it is too old.
The roof leaks rain in summer, and the wind leaks in winter. Children attend classes inside, and they don’t feel warm no matter how many fires they burn.
If the school can make some money, earn more money, the school building can be overturned, and the children can have a better environment to go to school. "
Principal Gao didn't mention asking Xu Shiyan to donate money, but his words made Xu Shiyan even more difficult to accept.
"Principal Gao, let me do the math for you, can you listen to me?"
Xu Shiyan pondered for a while before speaking.
"The school wants to make some deep-processed products, right? Does that mean it has to have its own processing factory?
Have your own production line? Need to hire workers? These are all costs, and they are not low.
Principal Gao, let’s not care about me as the head of the factory. Without the permission of the factory and superiors, it is not wrong to give advice to others to process products.
Just talk about these costs, can your school afford it?
With so much money invested in it, once there is any change in the industry in the future, the money from the school is likely to be wasted. "
Nowadays, everyone has seen the huge profits of the deep processing of the ginseng industry. It is understandable that everyone is tempted to see it.
But there are some things that ordinary people can't play with.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't participated with his back leaning on him, no matter how powerful he is, he would still be able to do it.
Let’s talk about it now, the husband and wife have several million assets in their hands, and they have their own processing factory at the other end. Aren’t they still doing rough processing?
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to ask Su Anying to set up a factory for fine processing and deep processing, just because he was afraid that someone would accidentally fold it in.
Not everyone can repeat the success of the first game.
The reason behind the current development of a participating company is that it is a state-owned enterprise, supported by departments at all levels.
What does Xu Shiyan have?
Just a few million, building a factory to buy production lines, various machinery and equipment, is it enough to talk about it, not to mention self-production and research and development?
Don’t think too much if the timing is not enough and capital accumulation is not enough.
It is better to develop slowly and accumulate strength.
And for elementary schools, these are even more nonsense.
How much money does the elementary school have? What do they invest in it? This is simply not realistic.
"Principal Gao, look at this, I will discuss it with my wife later.
Next summer, I will invite the engineering team to help flip the school building on the east side. What do you think? "
It’s definitely not good to help with further processing, but Principal Gao said that it’s not good if Xu Shiyan doesn’t agree to anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 591: teacher sue
chapters.content:
Chapter 591 The teacher complained
Principal Gao's words just now belonged to the three poles before the date.
What's going on in his school, he doesn't know what's going on? But what can be done?
The conditions of the school are here, but the house in Dongtou is too old, and the school has no money to repair it, so we have to think of a way?
But Xu Shiyan directly agreed to help renovate the school building, and Principal Gao felt embarrassed again.
Isn't this the same as opening your mouth to ask Xu Shiyan for money?
There are so many houses in one visit, and it costs a lot of money to rebuild them. How bad is that?
"No, no, how embarrassing is that?
See if it can be done like this, our elementary school will start shipping five hundred feet this fall.
At that time, can I ask Mr. Xu to help me sell it to a southern customer? "
Principal Gao thought about it for a while, and felt that it would not be good to just reach out and control people asking for money, so I better ask Xu Shiyan for a favor.
This five hundred feet stick is the hope of all the teachers in the school.
Back then, the big guys tightened their belts and raised funds to collect money, so it was considered to be these sticks.
Even the field work is done by the teachers during the holidays.
Finally looking forward to the three-year launch, and now I hope to sell more money.
Otherwise, he would not be able to put his ideas into processing, because he was really short of money.
In addition to the dividends from the teachers, if there is a little more left over, and if we put it together, we can almost renovate the school building.
Xu Shiyan heard that this is fine, he can be a bridge to help sell goods.
At this time, the leaders of several units came, and then shouted outside, the sports meeting review will start soon, please sit down.
So, everyone came out of the principal's office and went straight to the podium.
Su Anying helped a few girls in class one, three years, put on makeup and change their clothes.
In the middle, I also chatted with Mr. Jiang from Class 1 of the third year.
Wait until the children are packed up, according to the teacher's intention, go out to stand in the square line, hurry up and go through the line again.
Yang Haoyu held up the guide sign. Xu Jinping and Jiang Chunhong were wearing white shirts, red skirts, white high socks and red leather shoes.
The two girls are dressed in the same dress, about the same size, and have heavy makeup on their faces. If you don't look carefully, they look similar.
When the time came, the broadcast over the rostrum called out to all classes to stand in line and wait for the sports meeting review.
At this time, someone ran over and invited Su Anying to sit on the rostrum, sitting with Xu Shiyan.
The music started and the entrance inspection began. The National Flag Team, Drum Team, Waist Drum Team, Garland Team, Knife Flag Team, etc. entered the venue first, circled the playground in a large circle, and finally came to the reserved position.
Xu Haiyuan and another girl in the fifth grade held manuscripts in their hands.
As each team entered the arena, the two recited impassionedly and passionately.
Xu Shiyan tilted his head, looking at his son with pride.
This boss is really outstanding in every way.
If the child can maintain the current level after entering junior high school and high school, the child really doesn't need to worry about the parents at all in the future.
The teams in front entered the arena, followed by the students from each village primary school.
Donggang is subordinate to many villages, and each village has a primary school. Every year, each village primary school will arrange people to participate in the sports meeting.
After the entrance of the village primary school, it is the various classes of the central primary school.
From the first grade to the sixth grade, the children who have undergone long-term queue training walked in with their heads held high and neat steps.
At the rostrum, Xu Haiyuan and the girl also read the entrance speeches of each class.
"Oh my god, the makeup on my daughter's face is too thick, right?
This is due to the fact that it is my own child. Can an outsider recognize which child it is? "
Xu Shiyan was staring at the square teams. As soon as he saw Yang Haoyu holding the three-year-one sign, Xu Shiyan hurriedly looked behind him, looking for his daughter.
As a result, I saw it, okay, I almost didn't recognize it.
The faces of the two girls are just plain.
"Forget it, I put on makeup at home in the morning.
When I arrived at school, the teacher said that this is not good, it is too light and unsightly, and asked the trainee teacher to re-transform it. "
When the school just started this year, a female intern teacher came to Class 1 of the third year. It is said that she is a student of Tonghua Normal School.
There is a sports meeting, so of course the intern teacher has to follow along the whole process, and the makeup is given by the intern teacher.
It should be said that the aesthetics of this year are just like that, especially this kind of performance, which requires heavy makeup, so I think it looks so good.
"The two girls are dressed in the same clothes, and their faces are transformed into this. I guess no one else can tell who they are except their own parents."
Xu Shiyan couldn't hold back, and secretly complained, how could it look good with makeup like this?
Oh my god, it's terrible. When I go home at noon, I have to let my daughter wash her face well.
This guy can't handle it well, can't he make a big face?
While the husband and wife complained in a low voice, the square team of the third class had already passed by, and the rest had nothing to do with them, so they just took a look.
Entrance inspection, opening ceremony, playing the national anthem, speeches by school leaders, speeches by referee representatives, and speeches by athlete representatives, this is the process anyway.
But people inside and outside the school all watched it with gusto.
No way, there are few entertainment programs these days, so watching a sports meeting is quite interesting.
After the relevant leaders finished speaking, the athletes left the field, and the school also arranged some performances.
Xu Jinping is a member of the school's dance team. Together with the students of the dance team, they performed two dances in succession, and this is the end.
After the performance, the athletes of each class are ready, so the competitions begin.
For Xu Shiyan and others, this is meaningless.
But they can't leave right away, they have to stay for a while anyway.
So they sat for another half an hour before the couple got up.
Talked to the school leaders, and left to go to Yuhong Class to see Xu Haiqing, Xu Jinhui and the others.
Yuhong Class is still the same as before, delimiting a range to hold interesting sports games for children.
When Xu Shiyan and his wife passed by, the children happened to be playing a game of running and calculating.
I saw Xu Haiqing running to the finish line like a flying arrow, but the small blackboard in his hand didn't answer the questions at all.
The teacher was dumbfounded, explain to Xu Haiqing, and the child looked at her with an innocent expression.
What can I do? In the end, I could only give Xu Haiqing a piece of candy to show comfort.
"Mother Haiqing, you just came here, I have to tell you about the situation of the children."
After the teacher comforted the children, he looked up and saw Su Anying, and hurried to Su Anying.
"The three children in your family, Jingwen and Huihui, are all okay, they can listen to the teacher, and they can do whatever the teacher tells them to do.
Jingwen has no problem going to the first grade in autumn, and Huihui is also very serious in her studies, and she will be able to go to elementary school next year.
But your Haiqing, a boy, has a lively personality and can’t sit still. He doesn’t listen to lectures in get out of class, and always fights with his classmates after class.
I hope you go back and talk about the child.
As for his bastard, I'm really afraid that he will be ruthless sometime and beat other children severely. "The teacher told Su Anying helplessly.
When Su Anying heard this, she felt her head buzzing.
"Oh, teacher, I'm sorry.
Our family Haiqing is indeed a bit skinny, always causing trouble for the teacher, I will blame him later.
In the future, if he doesn't listen to lectures and fights with others at school, the teacher will beat you up, it's fine. "
What can Su Anying say? What's wrong with her own child, can she still not know what's wrong with her mother?
At home, Xu Haiqing dared not be ashamed because of Xu Jinping's formidable supervisor.
Out of his sister's sight, the child is like a wild horse, can he not do it?
How else can he run faster than anyone else when he goes to school?
Going to school is more fun than being at home. No one cares about beating him up at school, and no one forces him to write and memorize ancient poems.
Su Anying said so, what else can the teacher do?
Can only sigh, "It's okay, boy, it's natural to be naughty, I'll take it easy."

chapters.title: Chapter 592: hob meat
chapters.content:
Chapter 592 Hob Meat
The sports meeting will be held for one and a half days. On June 1st, the work will be finished in the morning and the afternoon will be off.
Xu Shiyan and his wife only sat for a while on the day of the opening ceremony.
I'm busy at this time, who has the spare time to sit and watch the children run the sports meeting for a day?
At night, when Su Anying came home, she called her younger son to her and had a good chat with her son.
Warned his son not to fight with others at school.
Xu Haiqing was terrified when he knew that the teacher had filed a complaint.
So she behaved well, she did whatever her mother said, no matter what she said, she nodded in agreement.
"Anyway, I told your teacher, if you are disobedient at school, have you seen this pointer? Let the teacher whip you with this pointer."
Su Anying threw a stick more than two feet thick with a thumb in front of her youngest son.
This stick belonged to Xu Jinping, and it was usually used to give lectures to younger brothers and sisters. Anyone who disobeyed would be beaten with this stick.
So, when Xu Haiqing saw the stick, his calf twisted a little, and he was frightened.
"Mom, I know I was wrong. I will keep it safe and listen to the class in the future, and I will not fight with my classmates."
The little guy was so frightened that tears almost fell, he hugged Su Anying's leg and begged for mercy.
"If you know something is wrong, you have to correct it, do you hear me?
Tomorrow, I will take this pointer to the school and give it to your teacher, remember. "
For the sake of the child, Su Anying had no choice but to frighten the child with a straight face.
People like her generation don’t know how to educate children, and they believe in the idea that dutiful sons are born under the stick, and children will fail if they don’t fight.
Su Anying is considered good, and usually doesn't do much.
Some parents don't care about those things, they just pick up any household items and directly smoke them on their children.
Feather dusters, broom bumps, belts, fire sticks, use whatever is in front of you.
"I heard it and remembered it, Mom, I will definitely change it."
Xu Haiqing is good at this, unlike Xu Haiyuan who refuses to admit his mistakes.
Xu Haiyuan's kind of stubbornness admits death, as long as he believes in it, no one will say it will work, and it will not work.
The children are like this, what can Su Anying do?
You can't give your son a fat beating just because of this incident, right?
Such a small child may not have a long memory after beating up, and forget it in a few days, what's the use?
Parents can only use more care and be diligent.
"Okay, let's have a better memory in the future.
Next time, if the teacher comes to me again and tells me that you are disobedient at school, I will slap your ass. "
Su Anying put on a tiger face and didn't give her son a good face, so she asked her son to reflect on it.
Xu Haiqing obediently went to stand in the corner. He was familiar with this, and he didn't know how many times he was punished since he was a child.
Looking at the younger son like that, the couple can only sigh.
This brat is a hob meat, so difficult to deal with.
Don't look at him agreeing very well at the moment, but when he turns his head and forgets about it, he should play or play, and do what he should do.
"Forget it, this brat will only have a long memory sooner or later.
You don’t need to be angry with him, it will be better when he is older. "
When the daughter-in-law was training the children, Xu Shiyan didn't say a word.
Educating children is afraid that one side will fight and the other will pull over there.
So Xu Shiyan and his wife made an agreement long ago that no matter which of the couple takes care of the children, the other is absolutely not allowed to talk about love.
Regardless of whether you are accustomed to seeing it or not, the couple will discuss and resolve it afterwards, and are not allowed to argue in front of the children.
At this moment, the younger son went to stand in the corner, so Xu Shiyan whispered to his wife.
"I know, didn't you see that I didn't beat him tonight? I was just scaring him.
This kid is more difficult to manage than the boss, too slippery, alas. "Su Anying sighed.
The two sons in the family have completely different personalities.
The eldest son admits to death, and he will not admit his mistakes when he is killed.
The younger son is not like that, as long as the adult's face is wrong, he will immediately admit his mistake, but when he turns his head, he will forget it, and he will make the mistake again next time he is in custody.
Su Anying felt that it was possible that they always cleaned up Xu Haiqing, and this kid slipped.
In order to avoid disadvantages, this brat learned to admit his mistakes first no matter what happened, so as to save him from being beaten.
So Su Anying planned to talk to Xu Jinping later, so she can't always deal with the fourth child like before.
If you really made a big mistake that is unforgivable, then you should beat it hard. For minor problems, you still have to take care of them slowly and talk about them carefully.
Xu Shiyan also sighed, educating children is really a headache.
Thanks to these four children, only one is difficult to manage.
If it's not easy to manage, the couple don't have to do anything, just go and have a headache.
Xu Haiqing stood in the corner for an hour.
Xu Shiyan deliberately put on a show, taking advantage of Su Anying's inattention, dragged his younger son into the east room, and had a heart-to-heart talk with him.
"Do you know why mom is angry today?"
"I know, the teacher sued me today, saying that I didn't listen well in class and even fought with the children."
Xu Haiqing nodded, he understood everything.
"Then tell Dad, why can't you sit still in class and listen carefully?
Look at your mother punishing you to stand up just now, can't you also stand like this honestly?
Then why can't you be more honest when you are in class? "
Xu Shiyan pretended to be curious and asked his youngest son.
"Dad, that's different. I'm the only one who is punished to stand. If I don't stand properly, I will be beaten.
There are many children in the school, and there are many fun things to do. I want to talk to the children, and I want to see the white clouds and birds outside the window. "
Xu Haiqing tilted his head and thought for a long time, so he said.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help but rolled his eyes, this brat just has too many thoughts and is uncertain.
"Then why do you fight with people?"
“I don’t know why, but they played well at first, but they got impatient, and then they started fighting.
When they hit me, I didn't cry. When I hit them, they cried, and the teacher scolded me. "
Xu Haiqing was also in a daze, and he didn't know why they were fighting.
But since someone else made a move, and he can't suffer, he must fight back.
He fought back, and then he was sued and scolded by the teacher, what can he do?
Xu Shiyan was speechless, what should I do?
It was just a bunch of little kids messing around, and no one probably took it seriously.
But if the teacher finds out, things will be troublesome. The teacher will definitely have to settle the lawsuit for the children and decide whether they are right or wrong.
Alas, in the world of children, how can there be so many right and wrong?
"Well, you, be more serious in class in the future and listen to the teacher's lectures more. In fact, the content of the teacher's lectures is also very interesting.
The blue sky and white clouds outside can be seen after class.
You are an adult, not a child, you have to learn to restrain yourself and observe discipline, understand? "
Xu Shiyan pinched his son's little face. This little face is chubby and very playful.
"Well, I see, if I don't listen carefully in class again, the teacher will whip me with a pointer."
Xu Haiqing nodded obediently, he remembered what his mother said just now.
Xu Shiyan sighed, feeling that his baby would not be so easy to take care of.
In the future, sometimes I will worry about him.
"You, when will you grow up and be sensible, just like your brother and sister, I don't need to worry about it."

chapters.title: Chapter 593: Ji Tongzhong was beaten
chapters.content:
Chapter 593 Ji Tongzhong was beaten
When the class started on June 2nd, Xu Haiqing really took the pointer to the school and gave it to the teacher.
I don't know whether it was Su Anying's intimidation that worked, or Xu Shiyan's chat with his son played a role.
In the next few days, Xu Haiqing felt a lot better.
Anyway, both Xu Jingwen and Xu Jinhui came back and said that Xu Haiqing hadn't fought with anyone recently.
Xu Shiyan and his wife also breathed a sigh of relief, no matter what, as long as the child can remember it, let's take care of it later.
Ji Tongzhong and others harvested the celery and Cantonese food for about a week, which is basically out of date.
So this side first loaded this batch of wild vegetables into trucks and shipped them to the processing plant in Dalian by railway, and settled the accounts with the other party.
After returning, continue to purchase Niu Mao Guang and Monkey Legs.
Niu Maoguang and Monkey Legs are both dried vegetables, which are not as limited as Dayeqin and Cantonese dishes, and they must live in a forest farm.
And this is only available in the villages around Changbai Mountain, so Ji Tongzhong took people and drove around.
At the same time, they also set up acquisition points in Donggang and Songjianghe.
It has been more than ten years since Fusong has exported cattle hair. In the past two years, with the increase in demand in the international market, the price of cattle hair has been rising.
Many people saw the business opportunities, not only went to the mountains to collect cattle and hair, but also collected them from all over the place.
In the past, it was collected from various remote areas and sold to the county purchase station.
Later, there were also people who established relationships with merchants from other places, purchased for them, and profited from it.
So compared to the acquisition of Dayeqin and Cantonese Cuisine, the acquisition of Niu Maoguang is more troublesome and very competitive.
Fortunately, Ji Tongzhong and others have cars, which is much more convenient than others, and they can go to those remote forest farms and villages before others.
Especially those places that are far away from the county seat or Songjiang River, where news is blocked.
Forest villages like Qianchuan, Caozihe, Ma'anshan, Baixi, Funan, Heihe, and Manjiang.
These places are relatively close to the Changbai Mountain Reserve. In order to make money, some people take the risk of crossing the environmental protection road outside the reserve and entering the reserve to collect cattle.
The ecological environment in the protected area has not been destroyed, and Niu Mao Guang is not like other places outside. After many years of harvesting, it has begun to degrade.
So the quality of the dishes coming out of the protected area is much better.
There is a lot of emphasis on harvesting cattle hair, it depends on where the dish comes from, and the quality of the post-processing kneading.
Therefore, there is a lot of water between the grades, and the operability is very strong.
Don't look at Ji Tongzhong's hard work, these things can be said to be self-taught.
That mouth was full of hype, which directly confused people.
In addition to the lack of news in those remote areas, I don’t know that the price of Niu Mao Guang has risen again this year.
Ji Tongzhong gave him a few dollars more symbolically, and the other party cheerfully sold Niu Maoguang to him.
So Ji Tongzhong led the team out, and he gained a lot every day.
By comparison, the acquisition points of Donggang and Songjianghe are mediocre.
Because there are several purchase points, everyone is waiting to see whoever offers the highest price, and then sell it to whomever.
Although the purchase price in remote areas is low, the quantity is small after all, and the bulk is still on the east side of the Songjiang River.
So after discussing with several other people, Ji Tongzhong raised the price of the purchase point.
Anyway, they are acquired by foreign companies, and the profit margins are large.
As a result, this move annoyed people at other acquisition sites.
"Shiyan, the third brother-in-law and fourth brother-in-law, as well as Shengli's younger brother, were beaten in Songjiang River."
This morning, Xu Shiyan was still watching the production at the comprehensive factory, so Su Anying called him.
As soon as it was connected, I heard Su Anying's eager voice.
"Ah? What's going on?" Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard that, Xiao Ji and the others were beaten? "Who hit it?"
"It's some gangsters from Songjianghe."
Su Anying didn't know what was going on, she was at the construction site in the city today, and someone came to deliver a letter.
As soon as Xu Shiyan heard it, he understood what was going on.
The late 1980s and early 1990s were the most chaotic times in Northeast China.
Hooligans are everywhere, causing trouble all day long.
There are many such things in my memory.
Businessmen from other places come to buy something, and then they are extorted by local gangsters.
If the other party refused to pay, they beat them up and drove them away. These people bought them themselves and then sold them out.
It is said to be a purchase, but in fact it is not paid on credit, and whether it is paid afterwards, ordinary people dare not mess with them anyway.
It's okay to provoke others, and if you provoke him, it won't work.
"Daughter-in-law, don't worry, well, how is Xiao Ji and the others doing now? Have you been sent to the hospital?"
"Those people didn't move their belongings, they just beat and kicked, and even smashed the purchase point.
Xiao Ji and the others were not seriously injured, they were all flesh injuries, so they were not sent to the hospital. "
The other party just wanted to scare them, so they didn't move anything.
It is estimated that there is no one behind Ji Tongzhong and the others, so they did not kill them.
"Daughter-in-law, you listen to me, send Xiaoji and the others to the hospital for hospitalization.
The rest of the matter, wait for me to solve. "
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone, came out of the comprehensive factory, and went to the field department to ask Lin Qiyue for leave.
When Lin Qiyue heard that Xu Shiyan's brother-in-law was injured, he became angry at that time.
"Go, call those people from our guard team.
Grandma has such a leg, she dares to provoke anyone, so take care of them. "
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, "Secretary Lin, no need, this trivial matter is not enough to use our guard team.
I'll go over to check the situation first. If it's really useful, I won't be polite to you. "
The guard team in their field are all great guys in their early twenties and less than thirties.
Many of them are veterans, and everyone is equipped with guns, even machine guns and mountain cannons.
Are you kidding me, a few punks still need to use the guard team?
"That doesn't work either. Bring a few people there, so you don't suffer."
Lin Qiyue was worried, so he called the captain of the guard team over and asked him to take the two of them to accompany Xu Shiyan to Songjianghe.
Lin Qiyue expressed his kindness, and Xu Shiyan couldn't refuse any more, so he drove with someone and went straight to Songjianghe's purchase point.
The purchase point is a house in the south of Songjiang River No. 1 Middle School.
When I came here, I saw that the doors and windows were smashed, and the house was in a mess.
The purchased cow hairs were all dumped on the ground, crushed to pieces.
Ji Tongzhong, Nan Zhendong, and Huang Shengkai were not there, so they probably went to the hospital.
Only Feng Yue and Feng Yuan are left on this side, and their faces are also covered with blood. It is estimated that the two of them were injured slightly, and they stayed and waited for Xu Shiyan.
"Third brother, look, what's the matter? The more than 100 catties of ox hair we harvested today are all crushed."
When the two saw Xu Shiyan, they didn't talk about the injury first, but they felt sorry for the bull on the ground first.
This year's Niu Mao Guang cost more than 30 yuan a catty, but the hundred catties were trampled to pieces and mixed with glass shards, so they couldn't be sold.
More than 3,000 yuan is gone, can Feng Yue and the others not feel bad? It hurts even more than those blows on the face.

chapters.title: Chapter 594: look for a job
chapters.content:
Chapter 594 Looking for trouble
"Don't worry, you two, tell me carefully, what's going on?
Who beat you? "
Xu Shiyan didn't even look at the crushed cows on the ground, but comforted Feng Yue and Feng Yuan with a gentle voice.
Feng Yuan is young, so he was probably scared just now.
Seeing Xu Shiyan now, he just cried there.
Feng Yue, after all, was old enough to be safe, so he told Xu Shiyan what happened before and after.
Ji Tongzhong took people to a remote forest farm for several days, and basically they were almost paid.
So I didn’t go out today, and stayed at the Songjianghe purchase point.
Ji Tongzhong bought Niu Mao Guang at a higher price, and many people came to sell the goods.
At half past nine, a group of people came, brought in six or seven sacks, and said they wanted to sell the goods to a buyer.
When a big client came, Ji Tongzhong received him warmly.
As a result, I opened the sack and inspected the goods, and found that the sack was not ox hair at all, but sweet potato stalks.
The locals say sweet potatoes are sweet potatoes, and the stems of sweet potatoes are naturally the petioles and seedlings of sweet potatoes.
This thing is made into sections, and it is also scalded with boiling water and dried out, which is quite similar to Niu Maoguang.
So many people use it to make fakes and pretend to be Niu Maoguang.
Dried ox hair costs 20 to 30 yuan a catty, and this sweet potato stem is worthless at all.
Many people dare not be too blatant, and they all mix it in.
Ten catties mixed with one catty, if you mix them together, you won’t see anything, so you can sell them for more money.
Of course, ordinary people can't do this method, it's all those second-hand dealers who do it.
Otherwise, what’s the difference in the price alone? Most people are mixed in this way.
After all, Ji Tongzhong has been playing with wild goods for several years, so he still has eyesight.
Besides, these people are too blatant, there is no such thing as a cow, it's just sweet potato stalks.
How can Ji Tongzhong accept such a dish?
So I told the other party very politely that this dish is too high-grade, they can't accept it, and they can't give such a high price.
As a result, the other party refused to give up and insisted on selling it to them, and even drove away the people who lined up outside to sell the goods.
It seems that he is here to stir things up, and Ji Tongzhong is not easy to mess with.
Relying on the first five or six people, I just argue with others.
Who would have thought that more than a dozen people suddenly rushed in from outside, punching and kicking Ji Tongzhong and the others.
He also poured out all the cows and hairs he bought this morning, trampled them to pieces, and smashed all the doors and windows of the house.
"Before they left, they warned us that they would immediately withdraw the acquisition site, and that they would not be allowed to buy Niu Mao Guang in Songjianghe in the future.
Otherwise, we will be killed next time. "Feng Yuan said crying on the other end.
Feng Yue saw his younger brother's virtue, and kicked him angrily.
"Look at your water as a diaper, what a coward, you haven't been hit a few times, what's the matter?"
Xu Shiyan raised his hand and stopped Feng Yue.
"Look at you, how old is he? Nothing happened, why are you kicking him?"
Feng Yuan is the seventh child of the Feng family, the youngest, only twenty this year, and the most favored one at home.
Feng Yuan didn't go through these things and was frightened, isn't that normal?
"How are you two? Do you need to go to the hospital?"
Xu Shiyan looked at the two of them a few times, and felt that there was nothing wrong with them, probably because they were slapped and kicked a few times.
"Third brother, we are fine, we don't need to go to the hospital."
Actually, Ji Tongzhong and the others are fine. The other party mainly wants to scare people, not wanting to break them.
Xu Shiyan nodded, "Then, what about you two, you don't have to stay here anymore.
Put that scale away, then lock the door and go home.
You don’t have to worry about the rest, I’m here. "
Xu Shiyan patted Feng Yue on the shoulder, and then came out from the purchase point.
"Go, go to the place opposite the bureau building."
Xu Shiyan got into the car again, asked the driver to drive, and went straight to the opposite side of the bureau building, that is, the open space.
Nowadays, there are relatively few entertainment items, except for the cinema, which is the open-air billiard hall that became popular this year.
On the edge of the open space opposite the bureau building, someone has built a long shed.
There is a billiard case in the shed, which attracts many people to play billiards.
Of course, most of these people are social idlers, also known as gangsters.
Xu Shiyan asked someone to drive straight here, got off the car at the place, and walked over in a calm manner.
The players here are all young men in their 17s, 18s and 20s, all of whom are smoking cigarettes and wearing toad mirrors.
Some people wear an electronic watch on their wrists, and their hair is long and hot, as hot as a bird's nest.
Suddenly came a clean-cut man in his thirties, wearing a white shirt, black trousers, short hair, without toad glasses.
The pool players, including the owner of the open-air billiard hall, were stunned.
What is this for? Isn't it taxable?
That's not right, the tax collector should wear a uniform, and he has already found a relationship, so he doesn't have to pay.
"Yo, which uncle is this? Why did you come here? What are you doing?"
Several young boys surrounded him and asked in a calm manner.
Xu Shiyan raised his hand, unbuttoned the cuff buttons of his shirt sleeves, and rolled up his sleeves twice.
"What are you doing? What can you do in the billiard hall? Play billiards." As he said that, he found a case that no one had.
The billiard tables of this era are different from those of later generations. They are very simple, and many of them are directly made by carpenters.
The wooden shelf is on the bottom, the case on the top is a standard size, and there are cloth pockets to hold the **** under the six holes.
The tabletop is a whole piece of red or green flannelette, standing on the wood with white latex, and wrapping it to the edge.
Some of the elastic parts on the edge of the case are made of triangular belts, and some are made of rubber hoses.
Nail it on the case first, then wrap it with big flannel, and finally nail the big flannel with small nails.
This case should be that the person who played before has just left, and the boss has not had time to clean up.
Xu Shiyan didn't speak, just took out the **** one by one from the cloth pocket.
Put the white ball aside, put the other fifteen balls, and put the black ball in the middle to form a triangle.
Most people will use a triangular frame to place the ball, just place the ball directly and push it to the designated position.
Xu Shiyan didn't use the wooden frame, and directly leaned the ball against the edge of the case.
After placing all the balls, with a slight push of the hand, the triangle formed by the fifteen **** rolls forward as a whole.
When he reached the kick-off position, Xu Shiyan used his two arms to lightly block the ball, and the ball stopped completely without any confusion.
This move directly suppressed the group of young people around them.
You must know that this open-air billiard hall has only been popular for a short time, and even the boss who set up the billiards case may not know how to do it.
No one thought about it, this person who doesn't look like he can play billiards at first glance, actually played such a skill.
"Okay, pretty good, looks like a master.
Well, let me play a game with you, whoever loses will pay? "
The kid next to him couldn't bear it anymore, and spoke first.
Xu Shiyan looked up at the other party, smiled, "You are not qualified enough.
Who is running around? I found Cao Libin, and told me that there was a man named Xu, and asked him to play billiards. "

chapters.title: Chapter 595: offended God of Wealth
chapters.content:
Chapter 595 Offended the God of Wealth
When these people heard Cao Libin's name, their faces changed immediately.
"Fuck, who are you? You're so crazy, you're still looking for my elder brother?"
Over there, a person came over sideways, squinting at Xu Shiyan.
Cao Libin, the leader of the gangsters like Songjianghe, is in charge of him.
All those who hang out in Songjianghe or even the surrounding areas of Fusong, when they see Cao Libin, they have to call out big brother in a polite manner, and few people dare to call him by his first name.
So when Xu Shiyan mentioned Cao Libin, the people present all stared in surprise.
The person in front of him, it doesn't look like a **** at all, why do he know their boss?
Xu Shiyan waved, and the driver behind him handed over a bag.
Xu Shiyan took out two packs of cigarettes from his bag and threw them on the billiard case.
"I don't want you to run errands for nothing. Whoever goes, the cigarettes can be taken away."
Xu Shiyan doesn't usually smoke, but for men, smoking is a must when walking outside.
As soon as the cigarette was thrown on the case, everyone's eyes followed.
Ordinary people smoke a spring festival and shake hands these days. The better smoked local smoked red ginseng costs one yuan, and the better yellow ginseng costs more than two yuan.
There are fewer cigarettes coming in from other places, and the price is more expensive.
Xu Shiyan threw out two boxes of Hongtashan, which are not the top quality cigarettes, but they are not cheap either.
It is said that it is Sichuan Jiuyunyan, and this Hongtashan is produced by Yuxi Cigarette Factory, which is considered a good cigarette.
So many of these people's eyes straightened at once.
Immediately, two people with sharp eyesight and quick hands stepped forward and snatched the cigarette away. "Wait, I'll go find my brother right away."
Xu Shiyan smiled, ignored those people, picked up the club, and put the white ball on the serving position.
Aimed at the ball in front of him, and hit the white ball with a snap.
The white ball goes forward, hits the triangle directly, knocks fifteen **** out of the way, and rolls around.
I saw two **** in the bottom corner, rolled directly towards the hole and fell into the cloth pocket.
The two **** in the pocket, one is full color and the other is suit, the local name is global and hemisphere.
Xu Shiyan didn't ask anyone else to play, just by himself, first put the whole world into the hole, then the half ball, and finally hit the black eight.
There is almost no pause in the whole process, one stroke and one ball.
These people around were all dumbfounded.
"Awesome, if anyone fights with him, he will lose his pants." The person next to him muttered in a low voice.
Xu Shiyan smiled after listening. I haven't played this stuff for too many years, and my hands are a little raw.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan moved out of the big house in 1987, and now lives in Xu Chenghou's place.
Donggang seems to be around the 1990s, when it started to set up a billiards case.
Su Anying said that she has nothing to do at home, why not set up a billiards case, and earn some pocket money a day.
So we built a shed on the west side of the house and set up a billiard case.
At that time, one person often went to play, and if they couldn’t get the game together, they dragged the boss to play.
If the guest loses, he will give money, and if he wins, he will play for nothing.
The Xu family has set up a billiards case for several years. Su Anying, Xu Shiyan, and even daughter Xu Jinping can play.
And the game is very good, it’s not good, you can’t make money if you lose.
It was a chaotic year, and there were often some punks who would not give money after beating.
Or two groups of people are playing and fighting, and they directly start a fight, and some even break into the house and swing a kitchen knife.
Su Anying's heart was a little unwell at that time, and she couldn't stand such a shock.
There are also people who specialize in stealing balls. Often, after a group of players finish playing, they find that one ball is missing.
These **** are bought in boxes one by one, and if you lose one, it will not match the set. So after putting it on for a few years, I no longer put it on.
Xu Shiyan was bored playing alone, so after playing a round, he rearranged the ball and sat beside him.
There are several cases here, and those young people are playing elsewhere, and no one bothers them.
The boss may have noticed that something was wrong, so he didn't dare to come and talk, and let Xu Shiyan sit there.
After another ten minutes, I saw the two boys wandering over behind a person.
It was mid-June, and the weather wasn't too hot, but the man was wearing a big vest and had tattoos all over his arms.
The man should be about 1.75 meters tall, quite strong, with a bald head, dark complexion, and also wearing a toad mirror.
A gold chain of unknown authenticity was hung around his neck, and he walked over swaying all the way.
"Who? Call me by name?"
The man walked to the shed, threw the cigarette in his hand on the ground, stomped hard, and then asked.
"Me. What's the matter? I'm still drinking together during Chinese New Year. It's been less than half a year, so I can't recognize you?"
Xu Shiyan leaned on the billiard table and waved towards the opponent.
"Fuck, Brother Xu, why are you here?
Oh, if you want me, you can go home, let's have a good wine and food, drink a pot. "
Cao Libin took off the toad mirror and glanced over there, his expression changed immediately, he walked up to him a few steps, and said with a smile.
Just now, the group of young people nearby were waiting to watch the play, but Cao Libin changed his face first, which shocked all the people around.
Cao, who is this? How can they make their elder brother speak in such a pleasant manner?
"Libin, um, I came to see you today because I have something to ask you about.
The people under your command ran to the south of the No. 1 Middle School today, a place where there is a lot of money, and they beat people, right? "
Xu Shiyan was still leaning on the edge of the billiard table, fiddling with the white ball in his hand, and asked the other party in an unhurried tone.
"Huh? I don't know."
Cao Libin knew as soon as he heard it that something bad happened. It must be that his subordinates didn't know this person and caused trouble.
"Brother Xu, who is the one who collects Niu Maoguang over there? Are you relatives or friends?"
Others don't know who Xu Shiyan is, but Cao Libin does.
That year Xu Shiyan’s house broke into thieves, and one of them was caught and ran away.
At that time, Xu Shiyan said that if those people dared to return to Songjianghe, they would break their legs.
As a result, last winter, Li Jianyou sneaked home and was caught and beaten.
After Xu Shiyan found out, he took Li Jianyou directly to the police station.
Because of this, Xu Shiyan also met Cao Libin.
During the Chinese New Year, Guo Shouye specially found an opportunity to call Cao Libin and Xu Shiyan together for a meal.
Xu Shiyan directly gave Cao Libin 10,000 yuan, which was regarded as the hard work of these people.
Cao Libin got to know Xu Shiyan just like that, and he also knew who Xu Shiyan was.
Especially when the news came out a while ago that a record-breaking foreign exchange was achieved by participating in the event, Cao Libin was still thinking about inviting Xu Shiyan to dinner again when he had time.
Ask Xu Shiyan to suggest a way to earn a little money or something.
Hearing what Xu Shiyan said at this moment, I couldn't help feeling a little bit in my heart.
Broken, some people are ignorant and offended the God of Wealth.
"Two are my brothers-in-law, and one is my brother's younger brother.
Everyone is in the hospital now, and I don’t know what’s going on.
The purchase point was also smashed to pieces, and there were more than a hundred catties of beef hair, which were also smashed by these people. "
Xu Shiyan is not exaggerating, he is telling the truth.

chapters.title: Chapter 596: Behind the scenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 596 Behind the Instigation
"It was a small business I did for my two brothers-in-law, earning two money to spend.
Who knows which land is offended? So off-putting?
It’s fine if I smashed the house, and even beat up people, why do you want me to go back and explain to your sister-in-law?
Then you say I won’t come to you, who should I look for? "
Xu Shiyan threw the white ball on the case, looked up at Cao Libin, and smiled.
"You guys, do you know who went to No. 1 Middle School today to find trouble?
Damn it, I don’t worry about it every day, and what the **** is causing me trouble. "
Cao Libin jumped into a rage, turned around and asked the young man playing over there.
A few people at the other end were already stupid, their legs trembling with fright, they were the ones who went there just now.
"Big, big, big brother, yes, yes, it's a big dog, he, he led us there."
"Where is the big dog? Where did it go? Who else? Hurry up and find everyone.
Damn it, I'm crippling all of you today, so that you don't do your serious business, so why don't you find something for me.
Who do you dare to offend? "Cao Libin was so angry, he was furious, pointed at those boys' noses and cursed.
Immediately, someone ran away in a flash, looking for Dagou and those people.
The rest of them all stood there in order, and no one dared to make a sound.
"Brother, I, we don't know what's going on.
The big dog came to us, and said that it would be good for him to do something for him, so we went. "
The stutterer next to him is a little bit softer, at least he can speak fluently.
"Those people are unfamiliar, they have never met, and they don't know that they are familiar with the eldest brother, and they didn't mention it."
Is this injustice? The big dog is the leader of their group, so what does he say, don’t they have to listen? Then who knows that the other party is someone who can't be offended?
Cao Libin turned to look at Xu Shiyan, "Brother Xu, I will keep a satisfactory answer for you today.
These shriveled puppies, who the **** are going to beat them, I will chop off one of their paws.
I asked them to pay for the smashed things. "
"Let's not talk about whether to pay or not, you first find me all the people, I have to ask clearly.
The group of them made six or seven sacks of sweet potato stems, and they insisted on selling them as ox hair.
Libin, where did these people under your command get so many sweet potato stems? "
Xu Shiyan waved his hand. What he cared about was not the gangsters, but the people behind the gangsters.
There must be someone behind this matter. He has to ask who is behind it before he can determine what to do next.
Cao Libin understood as soon as he heard it. Needless to say, the big dog was using people's money to eliminate disasters for others, and it ended up stabbing a hornet's nest.
Cao Libin couldn't help but sigh, this big dog is so **** stupid.
Before doing business, why don’t you inquire about it? Does anyone have any background? Can this be a joke?
Xu Shiyan patted the stool next to him and asked Cao Libin to sit down and wait together.
After a while, I saw seven or eight people running over panting.
"Brother, are you looking for me?"
The man in the lead was tall and thin, with a long face, wearing a floral shirt, and had long curly hair.
Right now, I don't know whether I was tired from running or scared, but I was sweating.
"Grass, do you still know that I am your big brother? Why don't you say hello to me in advance when you go out to do errands?"
Cao Libin stood up, raised his foot and kicked the big dog out.
Big Dog now knows that he has offended someone he shouldn't, and he has to bear whatever the boss does to deal with him.
So he was kicked, and the big dog got up from the ground without saying a word, and stood in front of Cao Libin again.
Cao Libin raised his foot and wanted to kick again, but Xu Shiyan stopped him this time, "Libin, don't beat him up, wait until I finish asking."
Cao Libin stopped and glared at the big dog.
"Brother Xu has something to ask you, you answer me honestly, if you don't understand, I'm going to **** you up today."
These words were actually meant for Xu Shiyan, the big dog is one of his subordinates, how can he really be killed?
"Brother Big Dog, right?" Xu Shiyan glanced at the man in the floral shirt, calling him that was really awkward.
"Look, I don't know what your last name is. How bad is it?"
"Brother Xu, my surname is Gou, and I'm the eldest in the family, so everyone calls me Dagou." Hua Shirt hurriedly explained.
Xu Shiyan nodded, "Da Gou, who told you to take someone to make trouble at the purchase site south of No. 1 Middle School? Tell me."
There must be someone instigated behind this incident, maybe the other party is also a person who takes a lot of money.
Because Ji Tongzhong and the others offered high prices and robbed the business, they asked Big Gou for help and went to Ji Tongzhong to make trouble.
Big Gou opened his mouth, but didn't dare to speak directly, and glanced at Cao Libin.
When Cao Libin saw Dagou's virtue, he became so angry that he raised his foot and wanted to kick him again.
"Brother Xu asked you, just say, what are you doing?"
"It's Li Jihong, he asked us for help." Big Gou gritted his teeth and said.
"He has a good relationship with me. A few old customers from the south came to us that year, and we were the ones who beat them away.
In the past few years, the few companies that Songjianghe has acquired are not long-term, and he asked us to do it.
The one in the south of No. 1 Middle School has a high purchase price, and Jihong’s purchase point can’t receive the goods, so I’m in a hurry.
Let us use the old method to try to run that company away. "
"Li Bin, who is this Li Jihong? His wrists are quite high."
Xu Shiyan didn't know who Li Jihong was, so he turned around and asked Cao Libin.
"Brother Xu, this kid was also under my command before, and he has been with me for more than a year.
He has no skills, his sister is a character, Brother Xu should have heard of it, the famous Li Damei in Songjianghe. "
Cao Libin coughed twice and said in embarrassment.
That Li Damei once had an affair with him.
As soon as Li Damei was mentioned, Xu Shiyan knew who it was.
Song Jianghe is quite famous for such a person, it is said that he is quite beautiful.
I heard that she used to be a waiter at the Tianchi Hotel. In the early years, an old wood customer from the south came to dump wood and lived in the Tianchi Hotel.
The two hooked up, and then the woman ran away with the old timber customer.
It turned out that the old customer had a wife in the south.
The girl surnamed Li had been with her for two years, and when she came back with a lot of money, she opened a hotel in front of Songjianghe Station.
The title of Li Damei was called after that.
It is said that Song Jianghe's prominent figures are all closely related to this beautiful Li.
Come to think of it, Li Jihong is backed by his sister.
This Li Jihong was originally a gangster, so he did not follow the right path when doing business, and specialized in such things as forced buying and selling, intimidation and threats.
Squeezed away other people who bought Niu Mao Guang, and wanted to monopolize Songjianghe's business.
As a result, this year, Ji Tongzhong and the others are also collecting a lot of money in Songjianghe, which can be regarded as a conflict of interest with Li Jihong.
So the other end repeated the same trick, and asked Dagou and the others to come to the door to make trouble, in an attempt to scare Zou Ji Tongzhong and his group.
If it were someone else, I would probably be really scared.
Can only admit defeat, move away in desperation, not daring to do business on the ground of Songjiang River.
Unfortunately, what they met was Xu Shiyan, so it was not so easy to let it go.

chapters.title: Chapter 597: Li Damei
chapters.content:
Chapter 597 Li Damei
"Xiao Wang, that, you drive and take the big dogs with you.
Go to the station and find the proprietress of the Maple Birch Inn and her younger brother. "
Songjianghe’s territory is not small, and it takes nearly half an hour to walk from here to the station.
Xu Shiyan still had something to do and didn't have much time to wait, so he called the driver and went to find him.
"Brother Xu, behind that Li Minna, there are a few tough people."
As soon as Cao Libin heard this, he hurriedly reminded Xu Shiyan that it's best not to confront this matter head-on.
Li Dameiren, originally named Li Jimin, later changed her name to Li Minna.
"Li Bin, no matter how strong the person is behind her, she has to come over and explain to me about today's matter.
We, brother-in-law and a younger brother, can't be beaten in vain.
Losing so many things, she can't have a strong relationship, so I'll just suffer from being dumb, right? "
Xu Shiyan smiled, no matter how hard the relationship is, this matter must be cleared up.
Cao Libin looked at it and knew that today's matter could not be good, so he could only nod to Big Dog.
"Brother Xu told you to go, why don't you hurry up, what are you doing here?
Hurry up, stare at each other day by day, and can't do a single thing to make people perfect.
Clean up these rotten things, and you still have to wipe your ass. "
Da Gou bowed towards Xu Shiyan and nodded, turned around and followed the driver Xiao Wang.
As for the young men from the guard team who joined the field, they came over now and stood behind Xu Shiyan.
From here to the station, it took a lot of walking, but the drive was fast. In less than 20 minutes, the jeep came back and stopped on the side of the road.
As soon as the car stopped, I got out of the front seat and opened the door at the back.
In the back seat of the car, a slender and slender woman wearing a red skirt and loose hair came down.
The woman also wore a toad mirror, covering half of her face so that she couldn't see her face clearly.
But the skirt is not long, it is above the knee, and two big white legs are exposed when getting off the car.
The eyes of the young people who are watching the excitement here are all straight.
The girl in the red skirt got out of the car and came to the shed with a twist.
"Yo, Brother Bin is here too, but I haven't seen Brother Bin for a long time."
She didn't know Xu Shiyan, but she knew Cao Libin, so she took off her toad mirror, smiled at Cao Libin, and greeted Cao Libin affectionately.
Brother Bin, I wish I could turn eighteen corners.
The voice was so sweet and whiny that some people felt their bones crumble when they heard it, but when Xu Shiyan heard it, he felt goose bumps all over his body.
Oh my god, this voice is too charming, and women in the Northeast really rarely have this kind of voice.
"Ahem, um, let me introduce someone to you. This is Director Xu from Donggang No. 1."
In front of Xu Shiyan, Cao Libin naturally couldn't flirt with Li Minna.
So he coughed twice and signaled Li Minna with his eyes not to offend the person in front of him.
When Dagou went to find Li Minna just now, he had already told her that the people behind the group who beat up today have come forward.
Da Gou didn't know who Xu Shiyan was, but he could tell that Cao Libin respected him.
It can be guessed to some extent that the other party is not a good stubble.
So Dagou reminded Li Minna and Li Jihong, the siblings, to speak up and talk softly, so that they can be resolved peacefully and don't cause trouble.
Who is Li Minna? Can be called Li Damei, that can be said to be the river flower of Songjiang River.
She can get along in Songjianghe or even Fusong, is that an ordinary person? She knows best who is rich and who is capable in the local area.
So upon hearing Cao Libin's introduction, Li Minna immediately understood, and the expression on her face immediately changed.
"Oh, it turned out to be Director Xu, who am I supposed to be.
Looking at the demeanor of this suit, one can see that he is not an ordinary person. "
Li Minna's eyes fluttered, and she stepped forward alluringly, and was about to lean towards Xu Shiyan.
He had heard about this director Xu for a long time, and she wanted to get to know him very much, but she had no chance, so she did not expect to meet her today.
Although the situation was not right, Li Minna felt that with her appearance and means, it shouldn't be difficult to win this person.
If this person can be taken down, then he will have nothing to worry about for the rest of his life.
Thinking of this, the smile on Li Minna's face became brighter.
"Director Xu, look at this incident, my sister really doesn't know that it's your people over there.
You said that this is not the flood that washed the Dragon King Temple, and the family does not recognize the family?
Director Xu, if you don’t look at anything else, you just look at my sister and me, a woman who has no one to rely on, and the world is hard to make a living. Can you just let this matter go? "
These soft words, charming to the bone, but no man can bear it.
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, and the two guys from the guard team stopped him directly.
"Li Damei is a beautiful woman who has admired her name for a long time.
But it's a pity that my eyes are not good enough to distinguish between beauty and ugliness.
The steel hook can't catch the glazed ball. Your set is useless to me, and I can't use it. "
This Li Damei, how should I put it, is indeed quite pretty.
The main reason is to dress well, the clothes and makeup are a bit like Hong Kong stars.
Especially in this gesture, there is a sense of enchantment, and the age of less than thirty is indeed the best time for a woman.
This kind of woman is really different in this northeast town right now, no wonder she can eat well.
Also, if a woman can spare it, she will generally do well.
But it's a pity, Xu Shiyan has only had his own wife in his eyes in his two lifetimes, and no matter how beautiful or raunchy the women outside, it has nothing to do with him.
The smile on Li Minna's face froze. She took down countless people with this hand, and it can be said that there is no benefit.
Unexpectedly, in front of Xu Shiyan today, he couldn't use it.
"Director Xu, are you being so shameless?" Li Minna softened her voice and spoke again.
"You'd better talk well, hold your throat and talk, you don't feel tired yourself, my ears hurt from listening to it."
Xu Shiyan made a gesture to pick his ears, raised his eyes and glanced at Li Minna and Li Jihong behind her twice.
"Ling sister and brother are very capable. They are just doing a small business, and they also play tricks such as bullying and dominating the market?
Now two of my brothers-in-law and one younger brother were beaten and hospitalized by you. I don’t know what’s going on.
Tell me, how to solve this matter? "Xu Shiyan asked with a cold face, not being influenced by Li Damei at all.
"Director Xu, how do you solve it? I also ask Director Xu to be lenient and raise your hand high."
Li Minna bit her lower lip, her almond eyes were misty, and she asked in a soft voice with an aggrieved look on her face.
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes speechlessly, all kinds of amorous feelings are not easy to use, this is playing cute and pitiful again, right?
"It's very simple, the person who injured me, the hospital expenses, medical expenses, and lost work expenses cannot be less.
If you crush more than 100 catties of my ox hair, you will be compensated according to the price.
The doors and windows at the purchase point were smashed, maintenance costs, and, if the business of the purchase point was delayed, the loss must be covered. "
Xu Shiyan drooped his eyelids, ignored the other party's virtue at all, and stated his request in a calm tone.
When Xu Shiyan said that, the faces of the Li family siblings were both ugly.
If you really pay according to this, it will be a small amount.
Where is this going? They can't bear to pay so much money to pay.
"Director Xu, you have to be forgiving and forgiving, you think you are quite capable, and others are not vegetarians.
If it really makes me anxious, I will not be easy to mess with. "
Li Minna stopped pretending to be weak now, and stared at Xu Shiyan.

chapters.title: Chapter 598: Beauty is not good
chapters.content:
Chapter 598 Beauty is not easy to use
"Yo, you are not easy to mess with? Why don't you try?
With those few ounces of meat, hooking a few people, do you really think you can do it? Do you think they can really stand up for you?
You are just a plaything raised by others. How many dare to put you on the table? " Xu Shiyan snorted coldly.
If someone else said this, maybe he would have to think about it, but what kind of fart is this woman in front of him?
If he is afraid of such a woman, he should go home and farm in the future, and don't do anything else.
Li Minna was annoyed by Xu Shiyan's words, her face turned red and then pale, and she could no longer pretend to be charming or pitiful.
"Hmph, just wait, I just won't pay, let me see what you can do to me?"
As she spoke, Li Minna twisted her water snake waist and turned to leave.
"It's not that good, anyway, your hotel won't need to be opened in the future.
I have plenty of ways to keep you from driving.
I don’t even need to play evil, I just want to trouble you, do you believe it? "
Xu Shiyan leaned on the billiard case without raising his eyelids, and his voice was low, but Li Min stopped in a daze.
"You, don't brag here, my mother has someone behind me, who dares to check me?"
Li Minna's angry facial features are all distorted, how can she still have the charming look just now? Right now, she's just a shrew.
The young people next to them also had their glasses shattered, alas, their dreams were shattered.
"If you don't believe me, just try it, I'll just look at the people behind you, how many dare to stand up for you?
Whoever comes out, I can find his wife and father-in-law, and I can report life style problems to the higher authorities. "
This kind of woman is just acting on occasion.
Those men with families and status are all smart, who would ruin their reputation and lose their positions because of such a woman?
The more prestigious the person, the more they care about these things. Family harmony and stable status are the most important.
As for this woman, she is just a plaything.
It's nothing more than a small fight to let her pretend to be a tiger to take advantage of her power. If their status and interests are really threatened, how many people can protect her desperately?
Xu Shiyan's words can be regarded as hitting Li Minna's wound.
In these years, she has had a lot of success among men, and she is given the title of Li Damei, which sounds like she has a lot of beauty, but only she knows how much she feels wronged inside.
However, in front of so many people, Li Minna refused to lose face no matter what, so she stomped her feet hard and walked away twisting her waist.
Seeing that Li Minna had left, Cao Libin hurriedly smiled and said that he wanted to invite Xu Shiyan to dinner as an apology.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "No, I have to go to the hospital to see my two brothers-in-law.
Let’s talk about it another day, when I finish dealing with this matter. "Xu Shiyan said, getting up to leave.
At this time, Dagou and his group of men stood respectfully in a row.
"Director Xu, we really didn't know that they were relatives of your family. Regarding today's matter, you can do whatever you want, and the few of us have nothing to say."
Crap, even their eldest brother has to greet him with a smile and push back Li Damei, can they afford to provoke him?
If you can't afford to offend him, then you can only bow your head and admit your mistake, accept the punishment and accept the punishment.
"Okay, you are Libin's brothers, and you are being instigated by others, so I don't want to make things difficult for you.
Go and clean up the purchase point at the other end, and fix the doors and windows.
When I see my two brothers-in-law in the future, just be more polite. "
What happened this time was also Xu Shiyan's negligence. He should have told Cao Libin in advance.
Let these people know that he is behind the purchase point, and no one will trouble you with the custody.
No way, just this year, no matter what you do here, you always pay attention to background and backing.
The whole society is a complex network of relationships. No matter who you have a relationship with, things will be easy.
It is difficult for people who have no background and no backer to get along.
So every time Xu Shiyan thinks back on his journey, he has really met many noble people, otherwise, he would not have made it this far.
Actually, Xu Shiyan doesn't have to come here in person for today's matter.
Just arrange someone to go to Cao Libin and explain the relationship between Bai Ji Tongzhong and Xu Shiyan.
In the past, Xu Shiyan didn't like to have too much involvement with these people, so he just met Cao Libin for a meal that time, without publicity.
But it is different now, Xu Shiyan is not alone, there are so many relatives and friends around him.
People are here for him, to help him earn some money, so he has the responsibility to protect these people.
He chose this place on purpose today because he knew that this place was a gathering point for Cao Libin's subordinates.
He and Cao Libin met here and settled the matter. In the future, these little **** will have to be more cautious.
"Did you hear that? Don't thank Director Xu?" Cao Libin raised his foot and kicked the big dog again.
"This is the boss Xu, who doesn't hesitate to care about you.
Hurry up, go and clean up that house, and then go to the hospital to see the person who told you to beat him. "
Cao Libin is not an ordinary person who can get to this point, so of course he has to support Xu Shiyan at the moment.
When Dagou heard this, he quickly led the group of people, saluted Xu Shiyan, thanked Xu Shiyan, and then ran to buy some doors and windows for maintenance.
"Li Bin, we two brothers are also considered to be hits, I'm a little older than you.
Today, I will take advantage of my age to tell you something from the bottom of my heart.
It's not a good thing for you to make such a fuss with your brothers. If you listen to my brother's advice, find something serious to do. "
Seeing those boys running away, Xu Shiyan turned around and patted Cao Libin on the shoulder, giving him a suggestion.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan didn't reach this level, so he didn't know much about it.
As for Cao Libin, no one mentioned it again.
Thinking about it, there should be something that caused them to disappear.
Xu Shiyan is not a saint, but after contacting Cao Libin these two times, he felt that this person was quite open-minded, so he reminded him.
Cao Libin was taken aback when he heard this, and then smiled wryly.
"Brother Xu, if there is another way out, who wants to fight and kill all day long?
Isn't there nothing we can do? We have to live on. "
"Okay, I will talk about this matter later, I will go to the hospital first.
That, I’ll treat you to a drink when I’m free, so we brothers can have a good chat. "
Xu Shiyan had other things to do, so he didn't have much time to talk to Cao Libin, so he just waved to him and led them away in the car.
"Go to the Forestry Bureau Hospital." Feng Yue said just now that Su Anying sent Ji Tongzhong to the Forestry Bureau Hospital.
The last time Suan gave birth to a baby, Guo Shouye called the Forestry Bureau Hospital, and agreed that the workers and their families who participated in the field could see a doctor in the Forestry Bureau Hospital in the future.
Ji Tongzhong and the others were accompanied by Su Anying, and the Forestry Bureau Hospital would definitely not refuse to accept them.
When I arrived at the hospital, I asked someone to find out that Ji Tongzhong and the three lived in the surgical ward on the second floor, so Xu Shiyan went straight there.
When I entered the door, I saw that all three of Ji Tongzhong had bruised noses and swollen faces, and Ji Tongzhong's head was wrapped in a circle of gauze, probably touching his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 599: Apologize
chapters.content:
Chapter 599 Acknowledging Mistakes and Apologizing
"Brother-in-law, are you here? Look, the few of us have been beaten badly."
When Ji Tongzhong saw Xu Shiyan, hey, he was aggrieved, so he complained quickly.
"You don't rest there, what can a big man do if he takes a few hits?
When the nurse applied medicine to bandage your head just now, didn’t you still chat and laugh with him?
Why are you still crying when you see our brother-in-law? "
Before Xu Shiyan could speak, Nan Zhendong had a dark face, glared at the fourth brother-in-law, and curled his lips.
"Then, wasn't there no support just now?
This time the backer is here, why don't you allow me to complain? "
Ji Tongzhong was reprimanded by his third brother-in-law, but he didn't dare to confront Nan Zhendong, so he muttered in a low voice.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing when he heard Ji Tongzhong mumbling.
"Come on, I'm to blame for this matter, I didn't think carefully, I should introduce a few people to you in advance.
Well, the person who beat you has been found, and I think he will come to apologize later.
At that time, you will just cry about headaches, nausea, and feel uncomfortable all over. "
Ji Tongzhong was stunned for a moment, "Brother-in-law, you didn't call the police and let the police arrest them?
Those people should be sent to squat on the fence. "
"It's really simple to think about. At most, this is fighting, picking quarrels and provoking trouble. How long do you think they can stay?
As far as the injuries of the three of you are concerned, they are at most in public security detention. They go in for a few days and then come out. What's the point? "
This year is not perfect in many aspects. Besides, it is common for those gangsters to go in and out of the police station all day long. Calling the police cannot scare them at all, and it is useless.
"The key is not to get them in, it's your safety in the future.
It’s easy to send them in. After five or six days, they’re going to come out to trouble you? "
Unless these people can be wiped out, otherwise, it will be easy to leave future troubles.
Those people who have no family and no job can get out, can Ji Tongzhong and the others?
In case these people miss her, will something happen sooner or later? Who can guard against it all day long?
So sending those people in is not the best way, you still have to find a way to solve the matter.
Ji Tongzhong thought about it, and it seemed that he did too.
In case someone thinks about it, one day when he goes out, a sap will come from behind, just like him, why don't you explain it?
"Then, let's forget it?
The place we bought was rented, and the doors and windows were smashed, so why do we have to deal with the landlord then?
What else is so rich, more than a hundred catties, thousands of dollars. "
When it comes to money, Ji Tongzhong is so distressed, so don't mention it.
"I asked them to repair the house, so you don't need to worry about it.
Those cows that are crushed will be compensated by someone, don't worry.
You guys should stay in the hospital for two days first, treat it as a rest, and go back to work after the matter is resolved. "
What can Xu Shiyan do? Do your best to comfort them.
Ji Tongzhong and the others were not seriously injured, just a little skin trauma, just apply some red syrup or something, and they don’t even need anti-inflammatory injections.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't told them to come to the hospital, they wouldn't need to come at all, they would just go back to Donggang, Chu Xuanhuai's clinic, and just apply some medicine.
Xu Shiyan glanced at it, and found that the three of them were all in normal spirits, so he was relieved.
It's getting late, the driver and the guards are here, it's not easy to make people hungry.
So Xu Shiyan and Su Anying accompanied the driver Xiao Wang out to dinner.
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to find a place to make a few phone calls.
Su Anying ordered a few plates of dumplings for Ji Tongzhong and the others, and brought them back for them to eat, so as not to be hungry.
Not long after lunch, the big dog brought people here.
Carrying a lot of fruit, milk powder, pastries, and canned food, he nodded and bowed, apologizing to Ji Tongzhong and the others.
Ji Tongzhong and the others looked a little silly when they saw this, and they forgot to pretend to have a headache.
It was Xu Shiyan who spoke a few words to Dagou and the others.
Da Gou told Xu Shiyan honestly that as soon as they went to clean up the house, people from the Donglin Police Station went over, took pictures to collect evidence, and asked them to make notes.
But they were not locked up, they were only reprimanded, and then ordered to restore the house to its original state.
Da Gou understood that this was the step Xu Shiyan gave them.
With such a program, you won’t be afraid to turn over old scores in the future, which is good for everyone.
The house has been tidied up, the glass of the doors and windows has been reinstalled, and the broken glass and ox hair in the house have also been cleaned out.
In the end, the big dogs left five hundred yuan, saying that it was for Ji Tongzhong and the others, and it was regarded as nutrition expenses.
Xu Shiyan was not polite to these people either, who told them to beat them? How is it possible without paying a little price?
Five hundred yuan, if he really pursues this matter, these people will be arrested, and the fines for public security alone will not exceed this amount. Five hundred yuan is considered cheap for them.
Dagou and the others had a good attitude in admitting their mistakes, and Xu Shiyan was not unreasonable, so he raised his hand and let it go.
Big Gou led his people and left with gratitude.
Before he left, he told Ji Tongzhong and the others that no matter what happened in Songjianghe in the future, it would be helpful to go to him.
Xu Shiyan still has a job, so it's not good to stay here for a long time.
Anyway, Ji Tongzhong and the others are fine, now we just need to see Li Minna's attitude.
Xu Shiyan has already arranged for someone to arrange this matter, so he doesn't need to be here to watch over it himself.
So Xu Shiyan asked Ji Tongzhong and the other three to stay in the hospital well, and if someone comes to make peace, just remember to pretend to have a headache and dizziness.
No matter what the other party says, let them contact Xu Shiyan.
All three of Ji Tongzhong agreed, and Xu Shiyan saw that nothing was wrong, so he led his wife away.
There are a lot of things going on at home, and besides, I have to go back and talk to Su Anfen.
Xu Shiyan and his wife left, leaving Ji Tongzhong and three in the ward.
They were not seriously injured at first, but now they had enough to eat and drink, so they simply lay down on the hospital bed.
Many have harvested wild vegetables for a while, and they are all very tired. It's good now, lie down and sleep soundly.
The doctors and nurses in the hospital have never seen such a thing before, and they all find it incredible.
I have never met such a good person, and those who had to be hospitalized all shook their heads and were speechless.
Four o'clock in the afternoon, Ji Tongzhong woke up after sleeping enough.
Not long after, I saw a woman leading several people into the ward with a lot of things.
It was none other than Li Minna who was the leader.
Li Minna left angrily at noon, and when she got back, she tried to find a way to find her backers, and asked them to help to settle this matter.
As a result, those people who coaxed her one baby at a time on weekdays all shook their heads like a rattle when they heard that they had offended Xu Shiyan.
In this matter, who dares to stand up for Li Minna? Isn't that uncomfortable?
Anyway, someone said that he could ask someone to help him find out if he could make peace.
