As a result, the man went to make a phone call, and when he turned around, he said with an ugly face that he couldn't help with this matter, and asked Li Minna to find a way to solve it.
Li Minna was anxious to find a solution, but a group of uniformed people came and immediately sealed off the hotel.
Said that they had received a report that the hotel was suspected of multiple illegal operations and would be closed down.
Before it could be resolved, another group of people came and held Li Jihong down without saying a word.
It is said that someone reported that Li Jihong bullied the market, threatened others with violence, and hindered public safety.
That's it, Li Jihong was taken away.

chapters.title: Chapter 600: talk to me nicely
chapters.content:
Chapter 600 Talk to me well
Li Minna's claws went numb now, and she knew that she had kicked the iron board.
In desperation, he had no choice but to lose face and find someone quickly to save his brother first so that he doesn't suffer.
I have to say that this Li Minna still has some energy, and she has acquaintances in several police stations.
The other party promised to protect Li Jihong and prevent Li Jihong from being beaten.
At the same time, he pointed out the way for her, and quickly obtained the understanding of the person concerned, and this matter will be handled easily.
The situation was stronger than others, Li Minna had to bow her head.
Hurriedly went to buy some things, found someone to accompany her, and came to the hospital to visit the three of Ji Tongzhong who were beaten.
It's easy to talk nicely to Ji Tongzhong and the others, pretending to be pitiful, please forgive Ji Tongzhong and the others, and hope this matter can be turned into a small one.
Speaking of it, although Ji Tongzhong is usually unreliable in his slick tongue, he was not affected by Li Minna.
Ji Tongzhong remembered what Xu Shiyan explained, and said that he had a headache, nausea, and couldn't see clearly.
Tell Li Minna not to talk to him, and go to Xu Shiyan.
Ji Tongzhong doesn't eat soft and hard, and doesn't eat oil and salt, so Li Minna can't be recruited. He can only leave the hospital and think of a way later.
On the other side, Xu Shiyan went back to work as usual in the afternoon.
When Lin Qiyue saw him, he had to ask him what was going on. Xu Shiyan said everything, including Cao Libin and Li Damei.
"It turned out to be her, tch, I thought she was such an awesome character.
Return to Li Damei? Song Jianghe and his group can really speak for her. When Lin Qiyue heard this, he shook his head and laughed.
"Well, you will kill this matter, and you must ask them to compensate, and it won't do anything less.
If you don’t teach her a lesson, does she really think she’s such a great person? "
"Well, I thought so too.
Songjianghe should take care of the law and order issue.
With these people bullying the market and making troubles, no matter how many good things they can't sell, merchants from other places dare not come. "
In this regard, Donggang did a good job, strictly enforced law and order, such a big market, with so many people in one autumn, there were not many troubles.
If this is to put Song Jianghe on hold, at the very least, those gangsters will have to charge some fees.
As for those old customers from the south, they are still not sure how they were threatened.
Of course, this is also related to the simplicity of Donggang's environment.
Most of them here are old farmers, too busy farming and growing ginseng to earn money.
There must be gangsters, but there are absolutely no ones who dare to make trouble in the city.
Songjianghe is not good. Nowadays, there are many unemployed young people. If these people get together, can they do anything?
"What's the matter? Are you going to make a suggestion to the higher authorities and take care of law and order?
It’s okay. If the local area wants to develop its economy, the public security environment does have a great impact. "
Lin Qiyue is not a simple character either, how can he not see through this matter?
"Thinking about it, but I haven't thought of the most suitable time.
It is imperative to focus on law and order, but I am not qualified enough, and no one pays attention to it when I raise it. I guess I have to find an opportunity. "
Xu Shiyan is just a field leader of the county-owned state-run field. If counted by level, he is at most a deputy department level, which is not enough to look at.
If he had a serious proposal, no one would care.
So we can only look for opportunities, and only when it is appropriate can this matter be facilitated.
"Well, that's the reason, don't worry, there will always be a chance." Lin Qiyue nodded.
Law and order are not under their control, so they really can't bring it up rashly, even if they offend people, it won't work.
Xu Shiyan's most reassuring point is this, no matter what he does, he never acts recklessly.
Xu Shiyan chatted with Lin Qiyue for a while, then went back to the office to read the materials.
Not long after he returned to the office, Guo Shouye called.
"Brother, what's going on? I heard people say that your relatives were beaten?" Guo Shouye asked directly as soon as he picked up the phone.
"Brother, how did you know? Such a small matter, still alarmed you?"
Xu Shiyan was quite surprised, how did Guo Shouye know?
"Cough, someone is looking for me, let me intercede with you." Guo Shouye coughed twice on the phone.
"A director of our bureau, knowing that our two families have a good relationship, asked me to intercede with you, and let me go back.
What the **** is your mind so unclear? For a woman outside, I don't know what he thinks. "
On the phone, Guo Shouye couldn't help complaining.
After he heard what the man had said, he couldn't help but kick that guy.
Are you so confused? For such a woman. How dare you get involved in anything?
"I thought, that beautiful Li, who took down my brother, even asked my brother to intervene."
Xu Shiyan deliberately joked on the phone.
"Bah, are you like that?" Guo Shouye laughed on the other end of the phone.
"What's the matter? How do you want to end this matter? Tell me, brother, I will help you as a staff officer."
Guo Shouye was worried that Xu Shiyan had no sense in this matter.
If it is not handled well, and then falls into Li Minna's trap, if it is not easy to get in, it will be ruined.
That Li Damei, Guo Shouye met once, is really attractive.
Guo Shouye is old and doesn't have those thoughts.
But he was afraid that Xu Shiyan was young, and his thirties were a good time for a man.
If Li Minna accidentally hooks this one up, his wife will be separated if things go wrong.
That's why Guo Shouye called Xu Shiyan in a hurry, wanting to know how Xu Shiyan would deal with this matter.
By the way, let Xu Shiyan be reminded that that kind of woman is unacceptable.
Xu Shiyan is now successful and famous, his wife Su Anying is virtuous and capable, and his four children are all smart and lovely. It can be said that the family is harmonious and happy.
If a good home is ruined because of such a woman, it's not worth it.
"Brother, there is no other solution to this matter.
Songjianghe has been too chaotic in the past few years. It is not uncommon for this kind of bullying to disrupt the market.
It’s fine to bully others, but if you bully me, then you have to deal with it.
Although those gangsters are hateful, they are just using people's money to eliminate disasters for others.
The most hateful people are those who dare to act recklessly because of their own energy.
No matter what, I have to teach him a lesson, let him know that it is not his turn to be domineering in this area of ​​Songjiang River East. "
Xu Shiyan stated his position, no matter who comes, these are necessary.
"Yes, that's the way it should be, and let her know how great it is.
Tiantian really regards herself as someone else, and she dares to provoke anyone, so she is treated like this. "
Guo Shouye was relieved when he heard Xu Shiyan's words. It seemed that Xu Shiyan had no interest in that beautiful woman at all, so that's fine.
The two chatted for a few more words before Guo Shouye hung up the phone, and Xu Shiyan concentrated on processing the documents.
When I was waiting to get off work, the phone rang again, "Who is it? Who are you looking for?"
"Director Xu, it's me, Minna." On the other end of the phone, there was a woman's delicate and sweet voice.
Xu Shiyan frowned, and put the phone away a little. Every time he heard this movement, he felt goose bumps on his body.
"Well, if you want to talk to me, first straighten your tongue, let go of your throat, and speak normally.
If you still hold your throat and talk like this, I will hang up the phone. "
Damn, is this woman not able to speak properly? What the hell.

chapters.title: Chapter 601: really someone loves
chapters.content:
Chapter 601 Someone Really Intercede
On the other end of the phone, Li Minna was so angry that she had no choice but to let go of her throat.
"Director Xu, I went to the hospital to see your relative in the afternoon, and he asked me to talk to you.
Director Xu, just take pity on me, hold your hand high, and let me go, okay? "
"No, according to what I said this morning, you can compensate as much as you want, this matter is easy to solve.
If you procrastinate any longer, let me tell you, no one knows what the consequences will be, and you can decide for yourself. "
Xu Shiyan doesn't plan to follow the girl anymore, it's too boring.
With that time, he quickly finished processing these materials, and it was so sweet to hug his wife when he went home.
"You are a lion with your mouth wide open, deliberately blackmailing people.
I went to see those people, their injuries were not serious at all, you are extorting. "Li Minna was in a hurry.
"Whatever you want to say, anyway, you hired Dagou to beat people and smash the store, this is a certainty.
I have already found someone to file a report at the police station, and Dagou and the others have also made notes. "
During the time of lunch, Xu Shiyan had already called the relevant people, and had already arranged the things that should be arranged.
If he wants to say that he is now joining forces with the county to take over these gangsters in one go, he may have to work hard. He needs to think about it carefully and ask someone to find a relationship to do it.
But it is easy to make trouble for Li Minna.
"Our county is now actively attracting business and investment, attracting more foreign businessmen to come over, either to purchase goods, or to invest in the construction of factories.
If the higher-ups know that someone has repeatedly bullied the market, ran out of foreign merchants, and discredited local law and order, I don’t know what the leaders will think and do.
It is hard to say whether you can beat your siblings as a model. "
Hearing Xu Shiyan's words, Li Minna completely panicked.
In recent years, she has traveled all over the world to do business, and she also runs a hotel, so she has some knowledge.
Of course she knows that economic development is the top priority at the moment.
If she is really labeled as bullying the market and hindering economic development, then it will be over.
Not to mention whether her hotel can be kept, maybe even she has to go in.
With her braids all over her head, why don’t she just grab it once she gets in? Can it still come out?
"What do you really want? Is it interesting for a big man to argue with a woman like me?" Li Minna was impatient.
"You, a man with a net worth of several million, don't you think it's a drop in value when you compare it with me to the thousand or eight hundred yuan?"
"Don't, what you say is as if my millions were blown by a strong wind.
How much money I have is my business. I didn’t steal or rob. I earned it by my own ability. What does it have to do with you? "
Damn, is this moral kidnapping? how? If he has money, he deserves the loss? Why?
"It's you who went the wrong way and didn't do business well.
How those people were bullied by you in the past has nothing to do with me, I don’t care.
But this time it didn’t work. My people were beaten and my things were lost. If you don’t pay for it, I’ll find someone to justify it.
It's that simple, don't talk so much with me. "Xu Shiyan didn't bother to pay attention to that woman, and hung up the phone directly.
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone and hurriedly processed the documents. He didn't plan to work overtime today.
After a while, Huang Shengli and others came home from work on the mountain, and they must be anxious when they learned what happened during the day.
Xu Shiyan has to go back and take a look, don't get angry and cause something.
But the more anxious I was, the more calls came in one after another.
A few of them were talking about work, and a few of them were actually peacemakers who talked and interceded with Li Minna, including people from the county.
What he said was pretty much the same, so let Xu Shiyan stop fussing with a woman, raise his hand, and let others go.
Anyway, they are very polite, but no one uses their status to overwhelm others.
It's all good things to say, let Xu Shiyan save face and don't make things too rigid.
Seeing this, Xu Shiyan knew that he still underestimated Li Minna's ability, and someone really dared to help.
Xu Shiyan was in a hurry to go home, and Li Minna even moved the people in the county to intercede, so it was hard for him not to give any favors.
Finally, he put forward a condition and asked Li Minna to pay 10,000 yuan in compensation, and the matter was settled.
The other party was quite satisfied with what he said, so he agreed to let Li Minna pay.
Xu Shiyan finished his work and hurried home by bike.
Sure enough, as soon as he entered the house, he saw Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli, Feng Chao and others were there.
This is when they got down from the mountain and got the news, they all came to Xu Shiyan and asked what to do.
"Third brother, what's going on? What the hell, does anyone dare to mess with our buddies?
who is it? I took someone to level him up. "Zhao Jianshe couldn't bear it anymore.
When I got home just now, and learned that Ji Tongzhong and others had been beaten, Zhao Jianshe was furious immediately.
If it wasn't for Huang Shengli to drag him, he would have gone out and yelled, gathered his hands, and settled accounts with those bastards.
"Who did you beat?
How old are people, why are they still like the 17-8 boy, beating and killing at every turn? "
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it. This guy is so stupid. Those who didn’t know thought he was the boss of Donggang.
"You give me a break, what age has it been, and you can still shoot with a slap in the face?
We all have families, businesses, wives and children, how can we fight fiercely with others as soon as our brains are hot?
Who are those people, a bunch of gangsters, if you fight with them, no matter whether it hurts or not, don't you think it's a drop in price?
It’s not ashamed to use your brain, why do you have to shout and kill? "
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes at Zhao Jianshe, thinking that he had become calm all these years, why did he still behave like this when something happened?
"Then Xiao Ji and Sheng Kai were beaten for nothing?"
Zhao Jianshe was stared at by Xu Shiyan, the momentum just now was gone, he could only scratch his head, sat on the chair holding his breath, and muttered.
"Calm down for a while and listen to what the third brother has to say. Why are you in a hurry? Is our third brother the one who can suffer?"
Huang Shengli, on the other hand, was able to hold his breath better than Zhao Jianshe, and sat there steadily, not in a hurry.
Xu Shiyan was just about to talk about something, when the phone rang.
Su Anying was right next to the phone, and picked it up casually.
"Xiao Ji, what's the matter? Oh, oh, that's fine, I'll ask your brother-in-law."
Su Anying turned her head and looked at Xu Shiyan.
"Well, Xiao Ji called and said that someone sent 10,000 yuan to ask Xiao Ji and the others to issue a letter of understanding or something.
Xiao Ji asks you, what should we do about this matter? "
"Tell Xiao Ji, keep the 10,000 yuan, and just write them an understanding." Xu Shiyan nodded after hearing this.
Li Minna is quite a character. The money is really taken out. Ten thousand yuan is more than double those losses. It's almost enough.
Since Li Minna can move people in the county to intercede, Xu Shiyan can't do it right.
After all, no one dares to say where to go next. It is not easy to make friends with someone, and it is too easy to offend someone. If you can give some face, you still have to give it.
Su Anying turned her head and talked to the phone, then hung up.
"Come on, the matter is settled, you guys go to the hospital and bring those three people back.
If the discharge procedure cannot be completed, I will find someone to do it tomorrow. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at Zhao Jianshe, and deliberately ordered him to work.

chapters.title: Chapter 602: Take the opportunity to stand up
chapters.content:
Chapter 602 Taking the opportunity to stand up
As soon as the matter was settled and the other party paid 10,000 yuan, Zhao Jianshe lost his temper.
Together with Huang Shengli, we went out to drive and went straight to the Forestry Bureau Hospital.
When they got there, the person who gave the money had already left, and Ji Tongzhong and the others were about to leave the hospital and go home with the money.
Everything is settled, who wants to stay in the hospital, so go home quickly.
Just like that, the three of them were picked up from the hospital, and it happened that they made some delicious food at home, which was a comfort to Ji Tongzhong and the others.
Back home, Ji Tongzhong was able to show his skills, and he talked about today's events from beginning to end.
He didn't know how Xu Shiyan found Cao Libin.
But when those **** went to make an apology, they didn't have the slightest arrogance before, and they all looked like the third grandson.
Those few people who went to the back also had a very good attitude.
It is conceivable that Xu Shiyan has done a lot of things behind this.
"It's thanks to the second brother-in-law who came forward, otherwise, we would have to suffer from being dumb."
Ji Tongzhong sighed at the end.
In this day and age, if they hadn’t had some background, today’s beating would have been in vain, and the purchase point might not be able to open later.
When everyone heard this, they all sighed.
That’s true, the current society is like this, without money and background, no matter what you do, it’s hard.
Huang Shengli and the others looked at each other and sighed.
If they hadn't followed Xu Shiyan, they would have struggled to stand out at this moment.
"Third brother, didn't you get a lot of favors for today's matter?
If you want to return favors in the future, please tell me, I can't let you take care of everything. "
Huang Shengli approached Xu Shiyan and asked in a low voice.
"It's okay, I just made a few phone calls, let's talk about it later."
Xu Shiyan smiled, not taking these things to heart.
He owed favors to others, and they owed him too. Anyway, it's a debt, and I can't explain why.
Even if there is no today's matter, if others come to him, he will do what should be done.
When he asks for something, most of them will give him some face.
Human relationship social network, that's it.
Ji Tongzhong was still talking in the vernacular, from the gangsters apologizing, to the person who gave the money later.
"Hey, you haven't seen that girl, **** it, she looks so good-looking.
Tall, with a fair face, slim waist, and twisted buttocks when walking, oops.
As soon as she speaks, the small movements are always annoying. "
When men get together, can they still say good things?
Ji Tongzhong relied on his wife and sister-in-law to lead the children to dinner in the Westinghouse, so he bragged to others.
"Third brother, where is such a woman? Why is there a woman here?"
Huang Shengli didn't hear it right at first, but according to Ji Tongzhong, the person who gave the money behind was a woman, what's the situation?
"Have you heard of that beautiful Li Songjianghe? She is behind this incident.
I found her through Cao Libin. At that time, she was quite arrogant.
In the afternoon, when I saw that there was no recruiting, I went around looking for someone to intercede.
If it weren't for someone from the county calling to intercede, the matter of this time, ten thousand yuan would definitely not come down.
My buddies, it’s time for us to stand up, otherwise, in the future, any dubious people will dare to trouble us. "
Xu Shiyan smiled indifferently, picked up the wine glass, touched Huang Shengli, and sipped half of the glass.
"In these years, people are good at being bullied, and Ma Shan is being ridden by others. Being a human being, sometimes it is really tyrannical."
Before, Xu Shiyan was worried that Zhao Jianshe and the others had money in their hands, so they would go out to misbehave.
In case of falling into someone else's trap, if things go wrong, the family property will be ruined, and the wife and children will be scattered and the family will be ruined.
So Xu Shiyan has always been in charge of several brothers, letting them work, do business, and live honestly.
But in today's society, it's not just that you just want to live in peace, there will always be people who don't have good eyesight to provoke.
This time, Xu Shiyan let go of Dagou and the others for the sake of the future safety of each family.
I have to be serious with Li Minna and her siblings, taking the opportunity to beat those people with ulterior motives.
Songjianghe is a very complicated place, and Li Minna is not the only one who is capable, but it's just that there is no conflict of interest with Xu Shiyan and the others right now.
Taking advantage of today's events, let those people understand that Xu Shiyan and the others are not soft persimmons, and they are not something whoever wants to handle it.
What's the matter in the future, it's best for everyone to be polite. If you really get anxious, who doesn't have any skills?
"Well, the third brother still thinks long-term, anyway, we will listen to whatever the third brother says.
The third brother said where to go, we all followed. "Huang Shengli and Feng Chao all said with a smile.
"Hey, third brother, what does Li Damei look like? Is she as beautiful as Xiao Ji said?"
Zhao Jianshe didn't hear that mountain cannon at all. Xu Shiyan deliberately changed the topic to another place and asked.
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes, "What's wrong? Are you thinking about it?
That’s okay, I’ll introduce you tomorrow, and you go and see for yourself whether she’s pretty or not.
I want to see, can your wife hack you with a kitchen knife? "
Xu Shiyan regrets this, why did he hand in such a thing? Can you ask nonsense about anything?
This loud shout was heard by Su Anying from Westinghouse, can it stop?
Zhao Jianshe was not annoyed by Xu Shiyan, and immediately scratched his head and laughed.
"Don't, third brother, my guy is really capable."
It is said that the Northeast woman is a tiger, and Zhao Jianshe's daughter-in-law is a tiger among tigers. These two couples are definitely a match made in heaven.
Otherwise, why would the three girls in his family look like boys? Isn't that genetic?
Zhao Jianshe's cowardice made everyone laugh so hard that they burst out laughing.
Zhao Jianshe has a thick skin, and he didn't feel anything wrong, and was still muttering there.
"Don't laugh at me, as if you are not afraid of your daughter-in-law."
What's the matter? Is he afraid of his wife? He loves his wife, okay?
"Come on, let me shout out, I am not afraid of my daughter-in-law standing up, how many of you dare to stand up?
Big brother, don’t laugh at second brother, they are all the same, who is making fun of whom? "Zhao Jianshe deliberately provoked everyone.
Everyone stopped laughing when they heard this, "Come on, eat vegetables, eat vegetables, that, Chunming, let's have a drink."
No one took up Zhao Jianshe's fault, and went to eat and drink.
After eating at Xu's house, the big guys chatted for a while before going home.
Xu Shiyan was a little tired from the busy day, so he drank two more cups in the evening and lay on the kang.
Su Anying led the two daughters together to clean up the table, dishes and chopsticks.
After finishing everything that needed to be done and tidying up the kitchen, they were coaxed to go back to the house to rest.
Waiting for the west room to be quiet and the daughter to fall asleep, Su Anying returned to the east room. At this moment, Xu Shiyan had already made his bed and was lying down.
"I heard you saw a very beautiful woman today? What kind of beauty is she?
Come on, tell me, how beautiful is it? "
Su Anying slapped Xu Shiyan across the face, glanced at him, and asked viciously.
Xu Shiyan heard it, so the daughter-in-law must have heard what they said in the east room.
"Beautiful fart, even half of my daughter-in-law can't keep up."
Damn, don't rush to coax this, do you still want to sleep on the kang in the future?

chapters.title: Chapter 603:
chapters.content:
Chapter 603
Ji Tongzhong’s injuries were minor and did not affect anything, so the purchase point continued to open for business the next day, and continued to receive the goods that should be received without any delay.
Li Jihong stayed inside for a whole night, thanks to someone taking care of him, he was not beaten.
Early the next morning, Xu Shiyan called, and Li Minna took her brother out with a letter of understanding.
Over there, the seal of the hotel has also been removed, and it can operate normally.
Li Minna now understands that some people can't be offended.
This time she risked everything to ask someone to make peace, and the other party also said that it was only this time, not another example.
Although the matter was resolved this time, Li Minna no longer dared to continue operating in Songjianghe, so she sold out the hotel and left with her brother.
Xu Shiyan naturally doesn't care about this, whether Li Minna leaves or not has nothing to do with him.
In the blink of an eye, it was late June, and the Dian dates were ripe.
Bingshan Beverage Factory has many orders this year and needs a lot of wild fruits.
Fortunately, some of the saplings planted by the Forestry Bureau are bearing fruit this year, so just ask someone to pick them.
The Forestry Bureau also mobilized the family members of employees in various forest farms to go to Dadianzi near the forest farm to hunt dates and pick fruits.
There are also collection points in many places, and a large number of dates are collected.
Collecting cows and hairs is more profitable than driving people up the mountain, so Ji Tongzhong has no time to do this this year.
He didn't do it, but it didn't delay others to hunt dates.
This year, several families in Donggang spent money to buy that kind of agricultural tricycle.
The Wuzheng agricultural tricycle produced by Wulian, the most basic and crude version, costs nearly 10,000 yuan.
Someone drove the tricycle, took people into the mountains to harvest dates, and sold them back for purchase.
If you find a good place and someone with quick hands can sell it for one hundred and eighty yuan a day.
Bingshan Beverage Factory has set up purchase points in various places. The wild fruits are harvested every day and night, and they are directly transported back to the beverage factory to be processed into concentrated juice and stored for one year's production materials.
Just in time for this year's weather, there is no frost in the beginning of spring, and the jujube harvest is bumper.
Beverage factories don’t care about those, they charge as much as they have, they would rather process and stock up than lack materials.
In addition to mineral water and beverages for export, several carbonated beverages such as Bingberg Coke, Bingberg Lemon, Bingberg Sweet Orange, Bingberg Grape, and Bingberg Apple produced by the beverage factory are also being produced and launched one after another.
The sales are also good, and they are gradually spreading in the three northeastern provinces.
Originally, the beverage factory was not particularly large. Neither Xu Shiyan nor Guo Shouye had great ambitions, and they didn't want to occupy the national market.
As long as it can gain a firm foothold in the three eastern provinces, it will slowly expand outward in the future.
Xu Shiyan has always maintained his own style of work, seeking stability rather than speed, and taking steps step by step.
It is best to develop slowly. Right now they are not that strong, and they cannot go out and compete with others.
Nowadays, there are quite a few beverage factories at home and abroad, let’s just talk about Coke, and those big international brands have already entered.
Xu Shiyan and his small factory, how can they compete with foreign brands?
It’s best to be so inconspicuous, earn money quietly and get the job done, too conspicuous, easy to get beaten.
Xu Shiyan discussed with Guo Shouye that although the sports drink has begun to make experimental formulas, it will not be produced for the time being and will be used as a reserve.
Wait for the next year to see the situation, whether to bring new products to the Spring Fair for a try.
Guo Shouye has always been obedient to Xu Shiyan, and he will do whatever Xu Shiyan says.
So the two agreed on the operation of the beverage factory.
At present, the main purpose is to ensure that the current order is completed without delaying the export. If the domestic side is maintained, everything will be fine.
Saturday, July 11th, May 28th in the lunar calendar, Xu Chenghou's birthday.
And this year's birthday is quite special, it is Xu Chenghou's sixty-sixth birthday.
In the Northeast, most of the elderly do not start to celebrate their birthdays until they are sixty years old. Among them, sixty-six, seventy, and eighty are big birthdays, and they must be carefully arranged.
Especially sixty-six, the family attaches great importance to it.
Coincidentally, Xu Shian's two-year study at the Provincial Agricultural University is over by this time.
He doesn't have a diploma and doesn't attend the graduation ceremony, so he can just come back and take care of the farm.
For his father's 66th birthday, Xu Shi'an graduated early and returned home.
Brothers Xu Shixian, Xu Shixiang, and Xu Shide also asked for leave and came back.
At this time, elementary school and junior high school had finished their exams and had a holiday, and the children happily ran back to celebrate grandpa’s birthday.
"Grandpa, we are back, happy birthday to you. This is the birthday cake we bought in the county."
Xu Jinfeng, three siblings, carrying a big box in their hands, entered the house first to send birthday wishes to grandpa.
"I wish grandpa such blessings as the East China Sea and Shoubi Nanshan."
Behind Xu Haiyang, a little slower, also echoed.
"Hey, hey, good, good.
Look at you, what kind of cake should you spend all this time on?
Our store has all kinds of cakes, so you don’t need to go all the way back to buy them. "
Xu Chenghou didn't know what a birthday cake was, and thought it was similar to those snacks sold in stores.
I feel that it is too troublesome for the grandchildren to spend a lot of time buying some pastries from the county.
"Father, this is not the kind sold by the supply and marketing agency.
This is called a birthday cake. It is a specially made big cake with flowers and old birthday stars on it.
It’s similar to the one that foreigners eat on TV when they celebrate their birthdays. "
Xu Shixian, Xu Shixiang, Xu Shide and others followed the child into the house. Xue Xiulin couldn't help explaining with a smile when she heard her father-in-law's words.
"A while ago, we opened a cake shop in our county, which specializes in selling this kind of birthday cakes.
Isn’t dad’s sixty-sixth birthday today? I discussed with Shixian for a long time and didn't know what to buy, so I specially bought a birthday cake and came back to taste something new. "
Xue Xiulin pointed to the big box that Xu Jinfeng put on the table.
"It's right here, it's a big one, open it before eating, cut up the big one and share it, try it all."
Hearing what the eldest daughter-in-law said, Xu Chenghou realized that there was a big cake in the co-authored box.
"Hey, look, I'm too old to keep up with the situation, right?
Birthday cake, such a big thing, I have never heard of it. "
The old man was so confident, he leaned forward and looked around the box.
The cake box of this year is opaque, and it is impossible to see what it looks like inside. The old man is a little disappointed.
"Father, the capital already has a birthday cake."
Just at this time, Xu Shiqin and Han Liwei came in from the outside with a baby in their arms.
Han Wenzhong and his wife followed behind, and the old couple were carrying things in their hands.
"There is a special cake shop in the capital, which sells all kinds of Western-style pastries, and there is this kind of birthday cake for sale, and there are quite a lot of patterns.
It didn't happen, the county now has it. "Xu Shiqin said with a smile.
"Hey, when did Liwei come back? Why haven't you heard of this?"
Xu Chenghou was surprised when he saw that it was his daughter-in-law and his in-laws who came back together.
Isn’t my uncle stationed somewhere in the south? I didn't hear that he was coming back to visit relatives, why did he come back so suddenly?

chapters.title: Chapter 604: One piece of meat
chapters.content:
Chapter 604 A Knife of Meat
"Family, why are you here too?
Look, just come here, what are you doing with these things? "Xu Chenghou was about to put on his shoes and go to the ground in a hurry.
When the younger generation comes over, it’s fine for him to sit on the kang, but when this in-law comes, he’s still sitting on the kang, that’s outrageous.
Over there, Zhou Guilan was also very happy to see her in-laws and her daughter and uncle back.
hurriedly came forward, took Li Yuexiu's hand and sat down, chatting with Li Yuexiu.
Han Wenzhong was sitting next to Xu Chenghou on the kang.
"Don't you know that your in-laws are over sixty-six? Come and join in the fun." Han Wenzhong laughed.
"Father, I came back from a business trip this time. I got home last night, and I didn't tell anyone in advance."
Han Liwei smiled at everyone in the room, put the child on the kang, and explained something casually.
"Oh, so that's what happened, I just said, why didn't you hear your third brother mention it?"
Xu Chenghou nodded when he heard the words. The co-author was on a business trip, so he went home to take a look, so it's no wonder.
Like Han Liwei now, it is estimated that missions and so on must be kept secret, and no one else can know, not even family members.
"Just come back, just come back.
Oh, you haven't been back for almost a year, right?
How many days can you stay at home this time? If you have time, stay at home for a few more days, just to accompany your parents. "
Xu Chenghou is hard to say, let the uncle stay and spend more time with the daughter?
"Father, I won't be here for a few days this time, and I have to leave as soon as I finish my work.
I discussed it with Shiqin, and now I have settled down there, and the two children are so old, I want to take their mother and child three.
After all, a family cannot always be separated from the two places. "
Han Liwei fought back, and put the daughter in Xu Shiqin's arms on the Kang.
The baby who is more than one year old can already walk, but the walk is not so smooth, and the two short legs move forward one by one.
Simple and stupid look, not to mention how interesting it is.
Xue Xiulin and Chen Chunling, sisters-in-law, couldn't help teasing Xiaowa.
Xu Chenghou is very fond of these two babies, and wants to tease them.
But Han Liwei rarely came back, and his in-laws were there, so he always had to talk with him.
"Well, this is reasonable. How can the couple live in two places? How can a family not live like a family?"
Xu Chenghou wanted to say it a long time ago, it is shameful that Han Liwei and his wife are always separated like this.
How old is Han Liwei? So young, the couple are not always together, if someone with a heart takes advantage of this, what will his daughter do?
"Yes, I thought so too.
I was outside, and both children were left to Shiqin to take care of alone, which was enough for her to get tired.
Over there, I have already arranged a place to stay, and I even specially found a nanny, who can help Shiqin take care of the children when the time comes.
Waiting for the child to grow up, I can send it to the kindergarten. The kindergarten and elementary school are equipped with supporting facilities, which is very convenient. "
Since Han Liwei came back to pick up his wife and children, everything must have been properly arranged.
Xu Chenghou nodded his head again and again when he heard it. My uncle's work is very safe, so this arrangement is fine.
Over there, the Xu Shixian brothers also took the opportunity to say a few words.
It’s nothing more than saying, if you need help, just tell them.
"Thank you big brother and fourth brother, there is nothing wrong now, my mother has cleaned up the house.
The return journey by train is also arranged, and the children will not be wronged. "
Han Liwei expressed his gratitude to his uncles, and he made all the arrangements in advance. Certainly will not let the child be wronged.
"Don't worry, in-laws, my wife and I will follow along. We will help take care of the children on the way, and it will be fine."
Han Wenzhong knew that the Xu family was worried, so he spoke.
Now it is different from before, Han Liwei now has a house allocated by the government and a place to live.
It is estimated that Han Liwei will not move for at least five or six years.
So the old couple planned to follow over to see what was going on there, and then help Xu Shiqin look after it for a while.
They will come back when everything goes smoothly for Xu Shiqin.
"Hey, that's a good idea. At our age, we should really go out and have a look. Okay, that's good."
Xu Chenghou nodded repeatedly, this arrangement is very good.
Not only let Han Wenzhong and his wife go out for a walk to relax, see the different styles in the south, but also take care of Xu Shiqin and the two children.
It's pretty good, or else, the Han family is very considerate.
"Liwei, you are here to talk with my father and brother.
I went to chop the meat, make up the noodles, and make dumplings for our father later. "
Over there, Xu Shiqin saw that the child was coaxed, so she didn't need to bother, so she got up and went to work.
Local custom, when the old man celebrates his sixty-sixth birthday, he asks his daughter to buy six taels of meat, six taels of noodles, and wrap sixty-eight small dumplings.
One for the day, one for the ground, leaving sixty-six for the old man to eat.
Sixty-six and one cut of meat, that's what you pay attention to.
Some people say that sixty-six years old is a hurdle for the elderly. After eating this knife, you can pass the hurdle, and there will be no disasters or difficulties in the future.
This must be bought by the girl, and made by the girl, no one else can.
So Xu Shiqin had ordered Liuliang noodles with the grain store early in the morning, and went to buy Liuliang meat this morning, just to make dumplings for his father when he came back.
How much meat can there be in six taels? Xu Shiqin finished chopping after a while.
There is no need to put other dishes in the meat stuffing, just put some green onion for seasoning.
6 Add water on both sides, reconcile and wake up for a while.
Then knead the dough well, knead it into long strips, raise the knife with your hand, and cut out sixty-eight doses.
The dumplings are not big, and the dumplings are of course very small, with two and a half rows placed on the curtain.
"Little sister, let's not eat at home today. We will go to the restaurant later, bring the dumplings over there and let them cook them."
Seeing that Xu Shiqin had finished making dumplings and was about to light the fire, Su Anying hurriedly stopped her and said.
Sixty-sixth is a big birthday, relatives and friends all have to come, Xu Shiyan thinks it is a hot day at home and suffers.
So I said in advance that Xu Chenghou celebrated his birthday this year and arranged it in a hotel.
Anyway, the Canshi Hotel is not busy at this time, so it is just right to entertain there.
"Oh, good." Xu Shiqin thought it was strange just now, why didn't he see what was prepared at home?
It's been a long time since they're going to hold a birthday banquet in a restaurant.
It's also very good, my family can save a little worry, don't have to worry about cooking, and can sit down and chat for a while.
Since there is no need to cook at home, everyone is free.
So the aunt and sister-in-law went back to the house and sat down again, and the whole family coaxed the baby and chatted.
Girls Xu Jingyi and Xu Jingwen haven't seen their parents for some days, and now they are clinging to their mother's side.
On the other end, sister Xu Jinfeng was sitting next to grandma and chatting with grandma.
"Hey? Has Feng'er's high school entrance examination results come down yet? What school did she apply for?"
Xu Chenghou suddenly remembered, the eldest granddaughter took the senior high school entrance examination this year, how is her result?
"Father, the grades haven't come down yet, and it will take about a week.
I applied for technical secondary school, normal school, health school, etc., but I don’t know if I can pass the exam. "
Hearing his father asking, Xu Shixian shook his head and sighed. His daughter's academic performance is not very good, and he also has a headache.
No way, if you can’t pass the technical secondary school entrance examination, then you can only go to high school, what else should you do?

chapters.title: Chapter 605: Cooperate to build a pharmaceutical factory
chapters.content:
Chapter 605 Cooperating to build a pharmaceutical factory
Xu Chenghou hoped that the children could study well and get into a good school or something.
But learning can't be forced, and the old man doesn't want to put too much pressure on the children.
"Well, no matter high school or technical secondary school, as long as you are willing to study, then go for it.
Anyway, the two of you can afford it, so just don’t lose the child.
Our family doesn’t favor boys over girls, don’t worry about daughters and boys, anyone who is promising is fine. "
The old man told his son that he was afraid that the burden would be too heavy for his son, and he would not support his granddaughter to study at that time.
"That can't be done, Dad, don't worry, as long as the children want to study, they can provide it at home."
Xu Shixian smiled, the couple of them both had jobs anyway, he still had some manuscript fees this year, and last year he followed suit and fell a little bit.
Money is not so tight, so it is no problem for children to study.
"Well, as long as you think clearly, don't let people get confused."
Xu Chenghou nodded, he was quite relieved about this.
The old Xu family has never had this tradition, regardless of daughters and boys, they are treated the same.
While talking, Xu Shiyan's group of buddies also came over with their parents and carrying things.
These families are like a family, that is, they are not in the mood to kowtow to their elders, otherwise they would be godbrothers who kowtow to the ground, and Xu Chenghou would be their old godfather.
The old man celebrated his sixty-sixth birthday, can they still come?
Huang Shengli and others didn't go up the mountain today, so they specially celebrated Xu Chenghou's birthday at home.
This group of people had just entered the door, followed by Su Weizhong and his wife, leading Su Anzhen and Su Anfen.
Li Bingzhuo and his wife brought their son, daughter-in-law and granddaughter, and the elder Li and his wife also brought their son, daughter-in-law and grandson.
The Li family and the Li family are close in-laws with the Xu family, and at the same time they are colleagues in the same unit as Xu Shiyan. On this occasion, they must come to celebrate their birthday.
Yang Junxian and his wife led Yang Haoyu, Guo Shouye and his wife, Yu Shouguang who had retired, Chen Jianzhang who had rushed back from the county, Lin Qiyue, Dai Chunrong and others also arrived one after another.
Everyone gathered together, and the laughter was very lively.
Even though the Xu family's east room is quite big, but with so many people coming, no matter how big the room is, it can't be opened.
When Xu Shiyan saw it, he simply greeted everyone and headed to the restaurant.
The space over there is spacious, just sit down and chat over there.
Chu Xuanhuai also closed the clinic today, joking and chatting with those old men.
The restaurant has already been arranged. There are melon seeds and candies on the table, and everyone is chatting while eating melon seeds.
Han Liwei took the opportunity to find Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue, and the three of them went to the second floor to find a room to talk about things.
"Secretary Lin, third brother, I came back with a mission this time."
Han Liwei didn't beat around the bush, and just made it clear.
"That's what happened. The batch of medicine donated by the previous participant was very effective.
But with so many soldiers in the frontier, two thousand bottles are really not enough. "This is the main task of Han Liwei's return this time.
"The higher-ups said that you can't always donate, that doesn't comply with the regulations.
Can the two parties cooperate to build a pharmaceutical factory?
Brother, the prescription you donated last time was studied by the superiors for a long time, and they all believed that the efficacy of the prescription was miraculous.
Although mass production is not possible due to the limitation of raw materials, it should be possible to produce a small amount and distribute it to special groups of people.
What the leader means is that this prescription was donated by you and Mr. Chu. Since you want to give birth, you must never find someone else.
Just build a factory, the third brother and Mr. Chu can use their strengths to develop several more good medicines for exclusive use. Can you see it? "
Han Liwei looked at Xu Shiyan, this is a rare opportunity, and he didn't want Xu Shiyan to miss it.
Xu Shiyan was also a little dumbfounded when he heard this. He really didn't expect such a good thing to happen.
If you really cooperate with the organization, you can develop some useful medicines for the soldiers.
Don't talk about whether you earn money or not, even if you want to put money in it, he is willing to do so.
Besides, how can the organization treat them badly?
"Liwei, tell me the truth, did you help fight for this matter?
Actually, Secretary Lin and I had no other ideas when we donated medicine.
We are just trying our best, nothing more.
As for the Rhodiola ginseng capsules, we have received a lot of export orders and earned quite a lot of foreign exchange, so we didn’t lose money, so we don’t need to think about compensation. "
Xu Shiyan was more worried about this. He was afraid that it would be bad for Han Liwei to fight for this opportunity just to participate.
"Yes, yes, Liwei, we know that you are a participant, and you are only thinking about our participation.
But this matter, I really don’t need you to feel sorry for us, we donate medicine, that’s voluntary. "
Lin Qiyue also hastily expressed his opinion. Of course, this matter is a great joy, but both of them are not at ease.
What is a participation? It's just a small break.
Plant some sticks, do deep processing and so on, but if they set up a pharmaceutical factory for the soldiers to use medicine, both of them feel that this responsibility is a bit big, and they are afraid that they will not be able to shoulder it.
"Secretary Lin, third brother, if you say that I didn't help in this matter, then I am fooling you.
But in fact, the general direction is determined by the leaders, so I just make a small suggestion.
Originally, the leader wanted to transfer my third brother away to manage a factory.
I know that the third brother is always thinking about his hometown, and he especially wants to contribute to the development of the ginseng industry in his hometown.
So I suggested that it is better to build the factory here, and the third brother can also preside over it. "Han Liwei didn't hide it, he told the truth.
"Secretary Lin, third brother, I think this is the best way.
Several of these medicines belong to confidential formulas, and the output is not large, so they are not suitable for handing over to other pharmaceutical factories, let alone building a factory alone.
So I thought about putting the pharmaceutical factory under the name of Yishangchang, you produce as usual, and you should export it.
Other drugs are produced, and the organization will arrange for people to transport them away. "Han Liwei's words contained a lot of information.
Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan looked at each other. If they really cooperated with the organization and put the pharmaceutical factory under the name of a participant, that participant would be old-fashioned. There are many benefits.
Both of them were a little moved, "Then, let's discuss this matter in detail?" Lin Qiyue asked Xu Shiyan.
"Okay, let's go to the venue tomorrow, and let's discuss the specific matters carefully. This is also an opportunity for us to go to the venue." Xu Shiyan nodded.
This is a huge opportunity. If you really cooperate with the organization, once you participate in the competition, it will be considered that your back is really hardened.
Who wants to think about participating in the field in the future, hehe, it is enough for him to drink a pot.
After all, today is Xu Chenghou's birthday party, Xu Shiyan is his son, and Han Liwei is his uncle, so it's hard not to show up.
Since the three of them have reached an agreement, it is enough to study the follow-up questions slowly.
So the three of them came down from the second floor and returned to the first floor, laughing and chatting with everyone.
The food was served at eleven o'clock. Before the banquet began, Xu Jinfeng and Xu Haibo took the cake out of the box and arranged it, then lit the birthday candles.
Then brought the brothers and sisters together, imitating the appearance on TV, and sang the birthday song to grandpa.

chapters.title: Chapter 606: birthday
chapters.content:
Chapter 606 Over a birthday
After the birthday song was sung, the children yelled for Grandpa to blow out the candles.
Xu Chenghou saw that the children were so excited, so he cooperated with a smile and blew suddenly, blowing out the candles.
Next, Xu Jinfeng and Xu Haibo took the lead, leading the brothers and sisters to kneel down and kowtow to grandpa's birthday.
"I wish grandpa good luck as long as the East China Sea, and his life is not as old as Nanshan. May grandpa have today every year and today every year."
This time, the old man was very happy, and hurriedly called the children to get up quickly.
After that, Xue Xiulin came over, cut the cake, and distributed it to the elders present, each with a small piece.
Just taste it, this thing is sugar and cream, old people should not eat too much.
The cakes of this year are very different from those of later generations. Instead of fresh cream, they use solid substances similar to sugar sand.
The old birthday star above is also a shell made of sugar.
Anyway, everyone thought it was quite fresh. After the old man had finished sharing, he gave each of the children present a small piece.
The children were holding small plates and spoons to eat, and they all shouted that it was really fragrant and sweet.
"Dad, take a bite, it's delicious and sweet."
Xu Jinhui held up the spoon in his hand and brought it to Xu Shiyan's mouth, insisting that Xu Shiyan take a bite.
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to bite a little bit, it was indeed sweet enough.
"Well, well, it's sweet and delicious."
Over there, Xu Jinping also gave her mother to taste.
Su Anying doesn't have the nerve to eat it, just pretend to dip a little.
Boys are rough-hearted, so they can't think of this.
But Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing got together and discussed whether the cake was delicious.
"Brother, do you think this cake is delicious?"
Xu Haiqing started to frown after taking a spoonful and eating it.
"What do you think?" Xu Haiyuan took a sip, and frowned, not knowing what to think.
"It's not good, the cake inside is too hard, it must not be freshly made this morning.
The layer of stuff wrapped outside is too sweet, it's so sweet.
This person's skills are not very good, and he can't keep up with the pastry master hired by the restaurant before. "
With Xu Haiqing's mouth, no one can compare to him in eating. He can taste the quality of this cake with just one bite.
When the restaurant opened, a pastry chef was specially invited from other places.
The pastry chef makes good pastries, and all kinds of small cakes are very delicious.
In order to coax the child, Su Anying took it back several times. Although Xu Haiqing is young, the delicious food he has eaten is absolutely unforgettable.
"Unfortunately, the master has only stayed here for a few months, and the apprentices in the store are not good at craftsmanship."
Xu Haiqing sighed, since the master left, he has never eaten such a delicious pastry.
The apprentices in the restaurant were not good at their skills, and it seems that they gradually quit.
Xu Haiyuan laughed when he heard what his younger brother said, and raised his hand to touch the top of his brother's head to show comfort.
"You are a serious foodie. If you want to eat, you should study hard. When you take the exam in a big city, you will have everything delicious."
Is this a disguised form of encouragement to my younger brother?
"Cut, you have to study hard for stuttering? Brother, your requirements are a bit high."
Xu Haiqing curled his lips, since when did eating have to be linked to studying?
"Then what do you want to do? Be a cook or a pastry chef in the future?"
Xu Haiyuan looked down at his younger brother, right? Is this the only way out?
It's okay to think about it, this bear doesn't like to study, if he learns a craft or something, he won't be hungry anyway.
"Brother, I feel that I can't continue to communicate with you. I love food, but it doesn't mean I'm willing to do it.
As long as you have money, what can't you eat? "
Xu Haiqing is speechless, and his brother hooks him up to study all day long. In order to let him study, he really racked his brains.
"Okay, you have the ability, I want to see, what can you do in the future?"
Xu Haiyuan didn't take it seriously, as a brat, he always felt that he was more capable than anyone else.
While the two brothers were chatting, the other children finished eating the cake.
Only the two brothers thought the cake was not tasty, and they were afraid of being scolded for wasting food, so they ate slowly, bite by bite.
"Look at all of you, each of you is like a reincarnation of a starved ghost, eating up the cake in a few bites.
Look at Yuanyuan and Haiqing again, they are very gentle, taste each mouthful carefully. "
The two brothers here thought the cake was unpalatable and forced to stuff it, but in the eyes of others, it became that the two brothers had a special tutor, eating politely and following the rules.
Huang Shengli and the others pointed at Xu Haiyuan and his brothers and scolded their children.
Xu Haiyuan and his brothers heard it, and they could only smile wryly. If this is delicious, can they eat it very quickly?
Before the two of them finished eating the cake leisurely, the waiter over there had almost finished serving the dishes.
As the eldest son, Xu Shixian must come out and say a few words on this occasion.
"Thank you, my family and friends, for taking time out of your busy schedule to attend my father's 66th birthday party and celebrate my father's birthday.
For today's good day, our brothers have specially prepared a banquet with simple tea and light meals. Please don't be disgusted with it, please have fun. "
After Xu Shixian finished speaking, the banquet officially began, and everyone congratulated Xu Chenghou on his birthday.
The restaurant also cooked the sixty-eight dumplings and brought them up. Xu Chenghou wanted to eat a few, and the rest would be eaten when he got home.
The children of the Xu family even ran to the stage to perform some programs and so on, adding a little festive atmosphere to today's birthday banquet.
Xu Jinping led the three younger sisters to change their clothes and come up to dance.
The four little sisters were standing in a row according to their size, dancing the red silk in their hands, and they danced quite decently.
Everyone in the audience applauded and encouraged the children.
After that, Xu Jinping dragged the two sisters and sang a song together.
Brothers Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing came to the stage to talk about a cross talk.
I learned this from TV. Anyway, what the two children said was very interesting, and everyone was amused.
Xu Haibo, Xu Haitao, and Xu Haiyang didn't prepare any programs, so they were dumbfounded.
It was Xu Haiyuan who saw it, and hurriedly dragged his brothers up, and sang a song that everyone knew, which was considered a circle.
"Okay, okay, everything is good, everything is good, hurry up and eat."
Xu Chenghou waved quickly, calling the children down and eating quickly.
The chefs hired by the restaurant are very skilled, and the banquet is quite good. Everyone chats while eating, and they all praise the food.
In such a lively occasion, the men had to drink a couple of cups. Xu Chenghou was happy, so he also drank some.
At the beginning, everyone was still in their seats, but at the back, they all came down to toast, and their faces were flushed when they drank.
"Second brother-in-law, well, I'll toast you with Xiao Ji.
That, I didn’t say anything, I was all in the wine, no matter what happened in the future, call us, keep it for you, understand. "
Nan Zhendong dragged Ji Tongzhong over to toast Xu Shiyan.
In front of so many people, I didn't say why, but they all know it well.
Nan Zhendong and Ji Tongzhong led Feng Yue and others to collect wild vegetables such as Dayeqin and Niu Maoguang.
The wild vegetables were just sent away a few days ago, and everyone calculated their accounts. This year's crop of wild vegetables, in less than two months, the family can have more than 10,000 yuan left.
Nan Zhendong was too awkward to come here before, but now he was so happy that he smiled on the back of his head.
Pointing to farming, how can I not earn so much.

chapters.title: Chapter 607: came with a mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 607 came with a mission
In front of the Xu family brothers, Nan Zhendong couldn't say it clearly, but he had to express his gratitude.
Xu Shiyan naturally understood, so he just smiled.
"Well, our family, don't say those out-of-the-ordinary words, I will definitely ask you for help if I have something to do."
As he spoke, he clinked glasses with the two of them and took a sip each.
There were so many guests, Nan Zhendong and Ji Tongzhong couldn’t keep dragging Xu Shiyan to drink, so they turned around and went to find someone else.
Everyone enjoyed the meal, and after the meal, everyone chatted together for a long time.
"Shiyan, I have something to tell you first.
The county is discussing that this year they want you to host and organize the ginseng festival.
I guess I will be able to officially notify you soon, so don't refuse by then.
I think this is an opportunity. It will be beneficial for you to perform well. "
After the meal, Chen Jianzhang didn't leave, but dragged Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue to chat together.
Chen Jianzhang's words surprised both Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan.
Lin Qiyue slapped his thigh, "Oh, this is a great thing.
Shiyan, listen to me, this matter must continue.
Let's do it well, make it beautiful for him, and let people know your skills.
Didn't someone say that this is a cultural event? You are a bit cultured, so let those people see it. "
Lin Qiyue's intention was naturally to show off all his skills, and let these people take a look.
Some people in the province always feel that Xu Shiyan is not very capable, and he only got up when he caught up with a good opportunity.
Lin Qiyue believes that with Xu Shiyan's ability, there is no problem in handling personal festivals and so on, and the preservation is better than last year.
Not only can it be done well, but it can also bring benefits.
Just like the opening of the city, the turnover was tens of millions in less than a day. Just kidding, how many goods are sold in the whole county in a year?
If Xu Shiyan succeeds in organizing the Ginseng Festival, he will cooperate with the organization to build a factory.
In the future, let alone in this county, even in the city, no one would dare to underestimate him.
Therefore, Xu Shiyan must accept this task.
"Yes, what Qi Yue said makes sense, and that's what I mean too.
Shi Yan, young people have to dare to break through, fight hard and stand out.
Don't care how many people in the county don't like you, as long as you have real skills, they will do whatever they like, and no one will dare to touch you anyway. "
Chen Jianzhang is in the county, so he knows more things than Lin Qi.
His words are also to remind Xu Shiyan that he can't always fight or grab.
In these years, if you don’t fight or grab, some people will think you are easy to bully, always thinking about how to step on you, to show his ability.
Xu Shiyan led a team to participate in the field before, and earned so much foreign exchange, it can be said that he contributed a lot.
Even so, some people say that this is not the credit of Xu Shiyan, but the credit of all participants.
Based on Xu Shiyan himself, he is nothing.
That's why Chen Jianzhang suggested that Xu Shiyan take over this task. This time, let everyone see his personal ability.
As long as this task is completed, don't you believe that there are still people who can make irresponsible remarks?
Xu Shiyan didn't speak yet, Chen Jianzhang and Lin Qiyue just tried to persuade him.
Xu Shiyan thought about it, and it seems that this matter can be done in the future.
Isn’t it just personal participation? It's not too difficult either.
Next, do it well, and let those who are waiting to see the joke gain a little insight.
From what happened last time, I can see that sometimes I will only do things honestly, and it is really not good to be too low-key.
"Thank you Bureau Chen, since you and Secretary Lin have said so, if I step back further, I will feel sorry for both of you.
As long as the county can trust me, then I will try my best.
We have to take the opportunity to get something for our county so that the common people can get some benefits. "
Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief and nodded, agreeing with what Chen Jianzhang and his wife said.
"Come on, with your words, I feel relieved.
Looking back, I will help you make a condition with the county magistrate Chang. You said you want people and things, and the custody will fully support it. "
Chen Jianzhang also came with a mission today, mainly to communicate with Xu Shiyan in advance and persuade Xu Shiyan to accept the mission.
Since Xu Shiyan nodded in agreement, his task is considered complete.
So, Chen Jianzhang said goodbye to everyone, and happily drove away.
"Okay, you probably still have something to do here, so I'll go back to the arena first.
Whether it is the ginseng festival or the pharmaceutical factory, we have to strive to win both, and if we can make some achievements, the road ahead will be easy. "
Lin Qiyue saw that it was getting late, so he also left.
Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong, Guo Shouye and the others had something to do, so they came to chat with Xu Shiyan, and then left one after another.
Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe, Ji Tongzhong and others are also busy.
Besides, they are all close, and they can usually talk about anything, so there is no need to talk about it now, so they all left.
Xu Shixian and others were in no hurry to leave. They will not go to work tomorrow and Sunday.
It's rare to come back, wouldn't it be nice for the whole family to get together and have a lot of fun?
The guests were all gone, so there was no need for my family to talk in the restaurant, so the big guys finished packing and returned to Xu Chenghou's side.
The two babies Han Zhenlin and Han Yu stayed in the hotel for less than an hour and became sleepy, so Xu Shiqin and Su Anying brought them back and coaxed them to sleep.
He hasn't woken up yet, so naturally he can't go home, so Han Liwei and his wife sat here for a while, and left after the child woke up.
The brothers haven't seen each other for a long time, especially Han Liwei, who didn't come back last year for Chinese New Year.
Xu Shixian and the others had to ask Han Liwei how he was doing there.
Han Liwei picked up what he could tell and told everyone, of course, he did not miss a word about confidential matters.
Everyone understood, but they just listened to the fun and didn't ask questions.
After a while, the two babies woke up, Xu Shiqin and Su Anying hurriedly carried the children to pee.
The two children woke up without crying or fussing. After urinating, they sat obediently on the kang.
Xu Shiqin made some milk powder for the two children and let them drink some.
The two babies were weaned from breast milk when they were one year old, but they were still drinking formula.
The two children didn't eat much at noon, so they must drink some milk pads now.
Both babies are grown up, hugging the bottle and drinking a bottle in a short time.
There is something in the stomach, the two babies are happy, and they stumbled and strolled on the ground.
Xu Jinhui and the others liked these two babies very much, so they led them to play for a while.
After the two babies woke up completely and the sweat disappeared, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin packed their things and went home with the baby.
"Little sister, brother-in-law, you two wait a moment, I will go back and drive and take you home."
Su Anying saw that the couple had to carry things and hold the child.
It's a long way from Xu's house to Han's house. How tiring is it to walk all the way back?
It happened that I didn't go up the mountain today, and the car was at home. Su Anying didn't say anything, and went home and drove directly.
The main reason is that Xu Shixian's brothers are all here, so it's not easy for Xu Shiyan to abandon his brothers and drive to see them off.
Anyway, Su Anying has good driving skills, so she didn't feel scared, so she went home and started the car, picked up Han Liwei and his wife, and sent them home.
"The third brother and sister are really good at it. They can do everything, even learned to drive." Xu Shixian and others couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"I can't help it. I go to work all day, and I have thrown all the big stalls at home to her, so I have to know everything?"
Xu Shiyan didn't feel very proud, but rather panicked with guilt.

chapters.title: Chapter 608: Pharmaceutical factory site selection
chapters.content:
Chapter 608 Pharmaceutical Factory Site Selection
In the past few years, the Xu family brothers have lived well.
Xu Shixian is still working in the unit, he is just average, there is no room for improvement, and he is better at leisure.
In addition to writing manuscripts for the leaders, most of them just drink tea, read newspapers, and write articles at home.
Needless to say, Xu Shian went to the provincial capital to study for two years, and now he has changed a lot.
Xu Shiyan has already told his second brother that the farm will be fully managed by Xu Shian, and everything will be decided by him, and Xu Shian will also be allocated 10% of the management shares.
Last winter, Xu Shixiang brought people from his hometown to learn how to grow vegetables and edible fungi in greenhouses and sell them in the county.
I earned a lot of money in one winter, which can be regarded as driving the masses to become rich, so Xu Shixiang was promoted to the deputy director of the Finance Office.
Xu Shixiang had a brain, and followed the people from his hometown last fall to plant some sticks.
Thinking about slowly developing a sideline business, you can't just point to dead wages.
Xu Shide, in the spring of this year, was transferred to the Xigang Finance Office, and the couple moved to live in Xigang.
Xigang Township was established late, and the conditions are average, but there are many mountains and forests there, which are more suitable for growing ginseng.
Xu Shide plans to get some ginseng soil this autumn and plant some more.
After all, Wu Qiuyan didn't have a job, and the couple couldn't compare with their brothers, so they had to work harder.
Xu Shiyan chatted with his brothers, but did not mention the pharmaceutical factory and the ginseng festival.
The pharmaceutical factory is supposed to be a confidential unit. Even if the factory is confirmed to be established, it cannot be mentioned to outsiders.
The county has not yet issued an official notice about the ginseng festival.
Xu Shiyan's temper will never talk nonsense.
Anyway, the brothers are just chatting about family affairs, and the atmosphere of talking and laughing is very good.
Everyone ate dinner at Xu Chenghou's side. After dinner, Xu Shi'an and his wife took their two sons home, and Xu Shixian and others lived at his parents' side.
The next morning, Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang led their family to leave, and Xu Shide left first.
Wu Qiuyan took the child to live with her in-laws for another day. On Monday, Xu Jingyi went back to school to listen to her grades and received her holiday homework, and their mothers went home together.
On Sunday, Xu Shiyan went to the venue as before, and discussed with Lin Qiyue, Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong and others about matters related to the participating pharmaceutical company.
Xu Shiyan felt that this was an excellent opportunity.
If they cooperate with the organization to build a factory, they can use this to develop the pharmaceutical industry.
Don't look at the booming foreign exchange earning in the next market, but Xu Shiyan knows that the boom in front of him will not last for a few years.
Then the ginseng market plummeted, and no one can guarantee whether the products they export will be affected.
Right now, it is best to think of another way out.
If a pharmaceutical factory is built to provide medicines for soldiers, at least it can be stabilized.
If you think about the rest, it won't collapse as a whole.
Although Li Bingzhuo and the others didn’t know what Xu Shiyan was thinking, being able to cooperate with the organization was enough to make them excited.
What else is there to say? That must be agreed.
In this way, several leaders participating in the meeting reached an agreement and fully cooperated with the organizational arrangements to build a factory together.
Separate the pharmaceutical workshop under the original comprehensive factory, operate it independently, and make independent accounting.
Everyone discussed properly and notified Han Liwei. Han Liwei also contacted the organization immediately, and the organization arranged for someone to come over to implement specific cooperation matters.
On Monday morning, Xu Haiyuan and the others all went back to school to listen to their grades and receive homework for the holidays.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping's grades are of course very good, even Xu Jingyi's scores are double hundred.
But Wu Qiuyan was so happy that she turned around and discussed with Xu Haiyang, wanting Xu Haiyang to come here.
The quality of teaching at Xigang is not as good as that of Daying, and it is even more incomparable with Donggang.
But Xu Haiyang, a stubborn guy, doesn't agree with it.
He and Brother Xu Haiyuan couldn't hang out together, but they just lived here for two days and felt uncomfortable.
If you study here, you will live here for many years, how can you bear it?
The child is not happy, and Wu Qiuyan can't force it.
Otherwise, even if she sends Xu Haiyang here, Xu Haiyang just refuses to study, what's the use?
Wu Qiuyan had no choice but to go back and discuss with her son slowly.
So I left Donggang in this way, went to the county by car, and then reversed from the county back to Xigang.
After going back to school and listening to the grades, and taking the summer homework, the vacation has officially begun.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping are still the same. They start writing the homework when they get it, and try to finish it early to save worry.
So Xu Haiyuan didn't go to the clinic to study in the morning, but stayed at home doing homework.
Xu Haiyuan has good grades, and the teacher doesn't give him more homework, only two booklets.
The vacation homework for this year and month is two thin booklets, one with 64 pages.
Most of the time, one side needs to be written, and the other side doesn't.
With Xu Haiyuan's speed, he can write both homeworks without waiting until tomorrow.
The two older ones are busy doing their homework at home, and the two younger ones can only play at home because they don’t go to Yuhong Class.
Just ran out with Ji Hongliang and the children in the neighborhood.
Family members don’t care, go and do whatever you like, as long as you remember to come back for dinner.
On the other side, Xu Shiyan went to work in the field in the morning, and discussed with Lin Qiyue and Han Liwei about the location of the pharmaceutical factory.
Currently, there are two places to choose from. One is east of the comprehensive factory and west of Shenchang Primary School. There is a large open space.
For now, it is enough to build a small pharmaceutical factory.
There is another place, which is the easternmost part of the venue, there is a large open space there, enough to build a factory of any size.
"Secretary Lin, in my opinion, it's better to choose Dongtou.
The place is big, if you want to expand or something in the future, there is room.
The vacant land next to the comprehensive factory is reserved for the time being, to see the follow-up development of the comprehensive factory. If the development is good, this side will also have to be expanded.
We can't just think about immediate convenience, we still have to think about the long-term. "
Xu Shiyan carefully considered the two places, and still felt that the east end is spacious and convenient, and it is best to be able to expand outward.
Taking advantage of the fact that the current participation is a key county-owned enterprise, it will occupy more land if it can.
"Well, I think it's okay, so let's go to this one."
Lin Qiyue looked at it, and felt that what Xu Shiyan said was reasonable, and he couldn't just think about it now.
In case it develops well in the future, do you still want to expand? Could it be possible to move again at that time? How troublesome is that?
While discussing, someone came to Xu Shiyan and said that the county leader had called.
Xu Shiyan and Lin Qiyue looked at each other, and both probably guessed that this should be about the ginseng festival.
"Secretary Lin, I'll go back and answer the phone first. For the follow-up matters, we should wait for the organization to send someone over, and we will discuss in detail."
Xu Shiyan talked to Lin Qiyue, then turned and went back to his office.
"County Chang, what do you want me to do?" Xu Shiyan actually knew what Chang Hongfa was looking for him for, so he asked on purpose.
"You don't pretend to be confused here, kid. Hurry up and come to the county for a meeting." Chang Hongfa laughed and cursed on the phone.
"Regarding the ginseng festival, the county wants to hear your thoughts, come quickly."
"I know, let's go now." Xu Shiyan smiled, hung up the phone, talked to Lin Qiyue, and went straight to the county by car.

chapters.title: Chapter 609: Preparatory Team Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 609 Preparatory Team Leader
As soon as Xu Shiyan arrived in the county, before he could go to Chang Hongfa, he was notified that several leaders were in the meeting room, so he could go directly to the meeting room.
Xu Shiyan followed the instructions of the staff and came to the conference room.
Knocked on the door and entered, and found that in the conference room, several leaders from the county were there, as well as people from the Federation of Literary and Art Circles and other departments, and Chen Jianzhang was also there.
"Secretary Li, Magistrate Chang, I'm sorry I'm late." Xu Shiyan whispered.
"It's not too late, we've just started here, come, sit here."
When Li Jingyu met Xu Shiyan this time, he was much more polite than before. He greeted Xu Shiyan and sat next to Chang Hongfa.
Xu Shiyan went to sit down as promised, and then Li Jingyu spoke.
"Okay, everyone is here, let's have a meeting next.
That's right, in September this year, the county will hold the second Ginseng Festival.
Considering the organization, Comrade Xu Shiyan is an expert in the ginseng industry and a capable person who earns foreign exchange through export.
So I want to ask him to be the main person in charge of this ginseng festival, and other departments will work together to make this year's ginseng festival a success.
Not only must it be done well, but the most important thing is to be able to sell goods.
It's still the same sentence, culture sets up the stage, and the economy plays a role.
All departments in the county must actively cooperate to create a ginseng festival that not only has a cultural atmosphere, but also activates the economy. "
Li Jingyu paused for a while when he said this, his eyes swept over everyone in the conference room.
"I don't know what opinions you all have? If you have an opinion, you can say it."
Everyone who came to the meeting knew this in advance.
Besides, what opinions do other people have on the matter decided by several main leaders in the county? That must be fine.
"Xiao Xu, what about you? If you have any ideas or conditions, feel free to mention them. Don't worry.
Ginseng Festival is a major event in our county. Even the city attaches great importance to it. If you ask for any conditions, the county will definitely meet them. "
Li Jingyu's attitude is really a 180-degree turn.
But Xu Shiyan could hear something different from it.
He smiled, "Since Secretary Li and County Magistrate Chang value me so much, it is a great honor to entrust such an important matter of the Ginseng Festival to me, and it is indeed a bit uneasy.
There are so many young talents in the county, and there are so many talents, I am really under a lot of pressure. "
When Xu Shiyan said that, everyone present would smile heartily upon hearing this.
"Xiao Xu, you don't need to be humble, since the leader asked you to come, it means that the leader trusts you and knows that you are competent.
An event as big as the Ginseng Festival has a lot to do with it, and no one would joke about it.
You can safely and boldly say that no matter which department, if someone dares to make trouble and obstruct the work, the county will definitely take strict action. "
Over there, Chang Hong said seriously.
"Yes, yes, you can say it boldly and let go of it.
With our backing, what are you afraid of? "Li Jingyu also echoed.
