"Well, that's good, then I will briefly talk about my thoughts, and the leaders will listen to it and give you an opinion.
Looking back, I will make a detailed plan, and then follow the plan. "
Xu Shiyan did not directly raise conditions, but first expressed his own thoughts.
With last year's Ginseng Festival as a model, it is not difficult to organize this year's Ginseng Festival.
Xu Shiyan has been thinking about it for the past two days, and he probably has a draft in his mind, so he speaks out his thoughts.
Basically, in addition to those activities last year, Xu Shiyan plans to hold a program related to the Weighing Festival.
The Scale Opening Festival is an ancient custom handed down in the Changbai Mountain area.
In the past years, at the end of autumn, those who stayed in the mountains for a year to let go of the mountains would go down the mountain with the harvested ginseng.
Come to the county seat and hold a weighing opening ceremony.
At the Weighing Festival, several respected elders from the local ginseng association will jointly evaluate the ginseng that has gone down the mountain this year, and select this year's ginseng king.
The selected ginseng king can be sold at a high price.
Xu Shiyan wanted to use the program of the Opening of the Scales Festival to hold a selection of candidates and an auction along the way.
If this is done well, not only the king of ginseng, but all the ginseng participating in the selection can be auctioned for a high price in the end.
This in itself is very effective in driving up the price of ginseng and increasing the popularity of Fusong ginseng.
Besides that, there must be a ginseng and native products trade fair.
This, not only ginseng, but also various other agricultural products can come to participate.
It is not limited to the county, but all surrounding counties and famous specialty counties in the province can invite.
The more people, the larger the scale, the higher the popularity.
On the other side, domestic and foreign merchants are invited to come and exchange orders on the spot.
If this is done well, the turnover will be very considerable, and it will definitely have a great effect on driving the local economy.
Others are basically doing some optimization on the basis of last year and adding some awards.
Not only cultural products can be awarded, but those who come to participate in the agricultural products expo can also select various awards, so that the participants are more motivated and have a sense of accomplishment.
Of course, all means, the ultimate goal is to sell goods.
Only by selling the goods and creating value is the ultimate meaning.
Xu Shiyan just gave a general idea, but none of the people present were fools.
From Xu Shiyan's simple narrative, they all perceived the business opportunities contained in it.
There were people who were not convinced by the decision of the county leader, but now they are.
The county's economy is a game of chess, whether it is cultural activities or commercial activities, it is all for economic development.
As long as you have money, you don't need to say anything, this thing can be done.
"Okay, okay, I found the right person." Li Jingyu applauded with a smile on his face to show his approval and encouragement to Xu Shiyan.
"Well, let's set up a working group for the preparation of the Ginseng Festival in our county.
We invite Comrade Xu Shiyan to be the team leader, Jianzhang, you will be the deputy team leader.
This is the ginseng festival after all. You are the director of the Specialty Products Bureau, and you are duty-bound as the deputy group leader. "Li Jingyu began to order.
"The Federation of Literary and Art Circles, the County Art Troupe, the Shanli Red Opera Troupe, the Agriculture Bureau, and the Commerce Bureau all arranged one or two people to join the group.
Cooperate fully with Comrade Xu Shiyan to complete the preparations for this year's Ginseng Festival, and make sure it is perfect.
Regardless of anyone or any unit, if they do not cooperate or obey the command, they will be dealt with severely and severely. "
This is the biggest event in the county this autumn, and it must not be sloppy.
"Xiao Xu, look, what else do you want? Just say it, just mention it, and the county will fully cooperate."
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, "Secretary Li, can you transfer some people to me?"
He intends to transfer Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang over. Others may not do their best in this matter, but they have to be his own brothers.
After all, Xu Shixian has been in the county for many years, and he is familiar with all the connections, and Xu Shixian's pen is indeed enough.
Not to mention Xu Shixiang, who graduated from university, has a good brain, and is in the system himself, so he knows a lot.
"Okay, you can tell who you want, and you call the name."
Li Jingyu was very generous. He didn't even ask Xu Shiyan who he wanted, and just nodded without saying a word.

chapters.title: Chapter 610: Cooperation conditions
chapters.content:
Chapter 610 Cooperation Conditions
The preparatory group for the County Ginseng Festival was formally established after the meeting. The county has arranged a separate temporary office with complete facilities.
As for the members of the preparatory team, they are selected from various units, and Xu Shiyan personally decides the candidates.
Xu Shiyan has known some people over the years.
Coupled with the support of Chen Jianzhang and Chang Hongfa, a dozen or so comrades who have a good relationship with him and are excellent in all aspects are selected.
After consulting the brothers, Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang were also temporarily transferred to the preparatory team to serve as Xu Shiyan's assistants in line with the principle of promoting talents and not avoiding relatives.
As for Xu Shide, he has just been transferred to Xigang not long ago.
It was far away from the county seat, and it was inconvenient to go back and forth, so I rejected Xu Shiyan's invitation and worked in Xigang with peace of mind.
After the preparatory team members arrived, Xu Shiyan led everyone to hold several meetings to implement the specific plan for the Ginseng Festival.
Then let Xu Shixian write a detailed plan, and at the same time arrange people to send invitation letters to domestic and foreign merchants, counties, cities, and county affiliates in the province.
And in the province's major newspapers and TV broadcasting stations, advertise, welcome farmers from all counties and cities to actively participate in the agricultural product fair.
After that, I finalized some details of the Weighing Festival performance with the art troupe and the Shanli Red Opera Troupe.
The program is rehearsed in advance, and the performance effect must be guaranteed.
Anyway, to hold a ginseng festival, there are many things to do.
Fortunately, the support of the county is strong, and all units are actively cooperating, but no one is holding back.
In the first few days, Xu Shiyan drove to the county in the morning and drove back in the afternoon.
After a few days, it will be a bit overwhelming. It takes several hours a day to go back and forth, which is too time-consuming.
Finally, it was decided to live in Xu Shixian's house.
On July 19th, the results of the high school entrance examination came out.
Xu Jinfeng just passed 500 points, which is a bit far from the technical secondary school score line, that is, just passed the high school admission line.
This result was also expected by the family, so Xu Shixian and Xue Xiulin didn't say anything.
They all know what their daughters study, and they have already prepared for this.
Anyway, if you have passed the high school admission threshold, then go to high school.
This is the case for most of the years. During the senior high school entrance examination, they all fill in their volunteers, and very few of them directly apply for high school.
Anyway, if you can be admitted to a technical secondary school, you can go to a technical secondary school.
Most junior high schools will have a split test at the beginning of the third year of junior high school.
There are two or three fast classes for large schools, one fast class for smaller schools, one returning class, and the rest are slow classes.
Students in the slow class are still hopeful in the first few days, and the rest are basically mixed with junior high school diplomas.
Most of them don’t study in the second semester of the third year of junior high school, and they don’t even take the senior high school entrance examination. Those who are well-connected at home go to work, and those who are not able go directly to work in the fields.
Separation in the third grade of junior high school can get rid of at least one-third of the students.
After the senior high school entrance examination, a small number of students are admitted to technical secondary schools, and most continue to study in high school.
There are still some, or the scores are not enough, or the family conditions are not good enough to afford high school, so they have to find another way out.
Although Xu Jinfeng didn't get into a technical secondary school, he was able to pass the high school admission threshold, which is considered acceptable.
Xu Shixian's family conditions are not bad, so of course he has to continue to support his children's education.
On July 20th, the organization arranged for someone to come over to discuss the specific details of the cooperative factory construction with a participant.
The other party requested that Xu Shiyan must be present to talk in person, so Xu Shiyan rushed back from the county immediately.
Anyway, the first phase of preparations for the Ginseng Festival is almost done, and all tasks are assigned to various units.
The preparatory team has Chen Jianzhang in charge, and Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang to help. It doesn't matter if Xu Shiyan leaves for a few days.
The two parties met and discussed specific cooperation matters.
The two parties jointly invested 5 million yuan, one participated in the factory building and workers, and the other provided the production line and technology.
Once the participating side recruits workers in advance, the other party will arrange for workers to enter other pharmaceutical factories for training.
After the pharmaceutical factory starts work, the other party will send some professional technicians.
At the same time, the other party also offered a favorable offer that people could not refuse.
One participant can select 50 students and entrust Shenyang Pharmaceutical University to conduct a three-year specialist training. Those with excellent grades can be recommended to continue their studies.
As for the raw materials, the two parties will work together to find a solution, such as rhodiola and other medicinal materials, and the other party can assist in solving them.
Organized as a strong backing, once participating in the field, there will be no worries, and you can let go of production.
Of course, the other party also has special conditions, that is, the person in charge of the pharmaceutical factory must be Xu Shiyan.
Without the permission of the superior department, no one has the right to transfer Xu Shiyan's position.
The pharmaceutical factory operates independently and has independent accounting. Although it is still under the name of Yishangchang, Yishenchang has no right to intervene in the operation and management of the pharmaceutical factory.
This is also understandable, mainly because he is afraid that the pharmaceutical factory will be disturbed by others, so Lin Qiyue naturally has nothing to say.
Whoever is in charge is on the site of a participant, and a participant is a shareholder, as long as there is a benefit.
After the general direction of cooperation was finalized, the two parties discussed some cooperation details in detail, and then signed a series of documents such as a letter of intent for cooperation and a contract for investment and construction of a factory.
The other party left with the documents, and after a few days, the agreed investment amount was remitted to a participating account.
At the same time, people from relevant departments in the province also contacted Xu Shiyan, saying that they can contact him directly if they encounter any problems at the pharmaceutical factory.
The Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory affiliated to Yishenchang officially broke ground on August 8, 1988.
The address was chosen in the barren forest land to the east of Yishenchang, and the relevant procedures had already passed the review of the relevant departments of the county.
The pharmaceutical factory covers a large area, and the planning map of the factory area was specially designed by a professor from the Design Institute.
On the day the pharmaceutical factory broke ground, a grand ceremony was also held. The relevant leaders of the county all came to participate in the groundbreaking ceremony.
"Old Lin, Xiao Xu, congratulations, you are still amazing, and you will build a pharmaceutical factory by yourself so soon.
Okay, okay, really good, our county has another powerful company.
In the future, we can count on you to earn foreign exchange through export. "This time, Li Jingyu took pride in himself and came here in person.
"Thank you, Secretary Li, we will work hard, work hard, and live up to the expectations of the leaders.
Strive to earn foreign exchange for the export of our county and contribute to it. "
On the day of great joy, Lin Qiyue and Xu Shiyan greeted him with joy when the leader came in person?
The ground breaking ceremony was held at 10:18 am.
Li Jingyu, Chang Hongfa, Lin Qiyue, and Xu Shiyan worked together, holding a shovel, and picked up a few shovels of soil on the construction site, which meant that.
Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory is under the name of a participant, and the cooperation with the organization is temporarily kept secret.
The county didn't know about it, and thought it was a factory built by a ginseng factory alone for the convenience of exporting and earning foreign exchange in the future.
Li Jingyu and Chang Hongfa didn't pay much attention to it. Anyway, for them, once the field develops well, the county can follow suit.
At least in terms of export earnings and profits and taxes, the county has followed suit.
But the next thing happened, Li Jingyu and others noticed something unusual.

chapters.title: Chapter 611: selection test
chapters.content:
Chapter 611 Selection Examination
August is the time period for admissions to colleges and universities across the country.
The admissions work of this year is not carried out on the Internet like later generations, but in the admissions offices of various places.
The county admissions office has to cooperate with the city's admissions office and the distribution of admission notices from colleges and universities, and is very busy.
As a result, on this day, I suddenly received an unplanned admission notice from the University of Pharmaceutical Sciences.
It is said that it was entrusted by a participant to recruit fifty oriented students majoring in pharmacy.
The recruiters were a little dumbfounded when they saw it. When did they have the energy to train college students?
This side felt that it was not easy to deal with, so they reported it directly.
"Xiao Xu, why did I hear people say that when you participated in the event, you entrusted the University of Pharmaceutical Sciences to train 50 junior college students?
That, isn’t that in compliance with the regulations? "
Xu Shiyan, who was busy preparing for the Ginseng Festival, suddenly received a call from Li Jingyu. As soon as the call was connected, Li Jingyu asked.
"You guys didn't report to the county at all, which didn't comply with the formal procedures.
Now, many people are dissatisfied, and they all come to me to respond, and I am still troubled by them.
Xiao Xu, what you are doing is wrong. "
Li Jingyu knew that Xu Shiyan was in charge of the pharmaceutical factory, so he directly approached Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan was a little dazed when he picked up the phone, and only then did he react.
It should be known by the county when the admission plan was issued to the recruitment office.
"Secretary Li, we entrusted the school to train the children of employees, mainly for the follow-up talent reserve of the pharmaceutical factory.
All the expenses for students to go to school are paid in one place, and there is no need for the county to spend money. "
Xu Shiyan looked at the large stack of documents in his hand, he could only sigh, and explained to Li Jingyu.
"That doesn't work either. If this hole is opened, in the future, each unit will find a way to entrust the school with targeted training. Will the county not be in chaos?"
Li Jingyu was still not very happy on the other end of the phone.
Fifty places, the appetite is too big to participate in one game, how can this be done?
"Xiao Xu, let's see if this works. There are 50 places, 20 of which will be reserved for you to participate, and the rest will be distributed to brothers.
Anyway, after finishing school, I will go to work in your factory. "
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes. This must be because the news has spread, and there is jealousy.
For this directional training, all kinds of expenses are paid out at the same time, and after the completion of the studies, they go directly to work in the pharmaceutical factory.
Whoever gets this quota is equivalent to having an iron rice bowl. What a wonderful thing, who wouldn't be jealous?
But this is a benefit for the children of participating employees, why should it be distributed to outsiders?
Not to mention outsiders, Xu Shiyan didn't even take care of his niece to get a quota, how can outsiders **** it?
"Secretary Li, I can't decide on this matter.
How about this, I'll give you a call, you ask where?
If they say that we have too many places in the first round and let the points go out, then I promise you have nothing to say. "
Xu Shiyan opened his notebook while talking, and reported the provincial phone number.
Li Jingyu was originally transferred from the province, and when he heard the phone number, he knew it was from the province.
This time, his heart skipped a beat, and he immediately realized that something was wrong.
"Ah, that's fine, I'll write down this phone number later, and you can read it to me again."
Xu Shiyan read it again as he said, and Li Jingyu hung up after memorizing the phone number.
He didn't call directly in a reckless manner, but entrusted a friend in the province to help find out where this phone number is from.
Li Jingyu's friend did his best, and found out after a while.
When Li Jingyu heard who the phone belonged to, he was so frightened that a chill came down his back. After thanking the other party, he hung up the phone directly.
As a result, not long after he hung up the phone, a call came from a provincial capital.
It is said that after Li Jingyu answered the phone call, his face was very ugly.
Then they called a lot of people and scolded them.
Afterwards, the admissions office will directly distribute the quota to the participants.
As soon as they participated in the venue, they made preparations in advance and sent out the enrollment information.
Let children who have suitable conditions in the family come to sign up, and then get a copy of the materials to go back to study.
After studying for a period of time, take the unified exam.
Chu Xuanhuai was asked to help with that information, and Chu Xuanhuai also helped to prepare the exam questions, which were some basic knowledge of pharmacy.
Since you are going to study in a pharmaceutical university, you must choose a child who has some interest and talent in this area.
If you really don’t have that talent, it’s useless to study, and it’s a waste of three years.
More than 1,000 employees participated, and almost every family had three or four children.
It is true that there are quite a few children who should have graduated from junior high school in the past and are under the age of 18.
After hearing the news, there were more than two hundred people who signed up.
Passed the exam, and finally selected the fifty with the best grades from the two hundred people, and went out to study.
After consulting his brother and sister-in-law, Xu Shiyan also asked Xu Jinfeng to take the exam.
No matter what you say, this is your own niece, and I can't take care of anything else. You can always give it a chance.
It is estimated that Xu Jinfeng really has no talent in this area, and his test scores are not good, so he was not selected.
Regarding this, Xu Shixian and his wife didn't say anything else. As an uncle, Xu Shiyan has already taken care of what he can.
Xu Jinfeng himself didn't pass the exam, so he can't blame anyone, so he should go to high school honestly.
Xu Haiyuan, on the other hand, sneakily got a copy of the exam questions, did it himself, and easily got a perfect score.
"Dad, do you know what their highest test score is?"
On this day, while Xu Shiyan was going home, Xu Haiyuan asked. "It's the selection test."
"Uh, it seems that the highest score is around 130 points, right?
Take two papers, the full score is 200, which is okay anyway, after all, the study time is short, less than a month. "
Those papers were not approved by Xu Shiyan, but by the help of the doctors in the health center who participated in the examination and approved the answers.
Xu Shiyan only listened to it once, and it seems that the highest score is only one hundred and thirty.
This result is not bad, after all, the study time is short.
"Only one hundred and three? That's not okay? My master said that for that set of papers, you have to answer at least one hundred and eight to pass."
Xu Haiyuan curled his lips, he only got such a few points in the test, and went to university, what grades can he learn?
"You little brat, that's what your master asked of you, right?
You have been studying for several years, if you can’t answer one hundred and nine, I will beat you. "
Xu Shiyan didn't know whether to laugh or cry when he heard the words, this little brat, this is deliberately pretending in front of him.
"Hey, I'm sorry, I got full marks." Xu Haiyuan took out the paper he made and showed it to Xu Shiyan.
"This was approved by my master, I didn't cheat." The little guy looked proud.
"Okay, don't show off there, what's the point of this? In the future, you will have to face many exams.
Study medicine, study and take exams, there will be times when you cry. "
Xu Shiyan couldn't understand his son's complacent appearance, so he deliberately poured cold water on him.
In the end, Xu Haiyuan was not afraid at all, "Just take the exam, since when is your eldest afraid of passing the exam?"
Xu Shiyan was speechless for a moment, yes, in the world of top academics, how can scumbags understand?
Others regard the exam as a scourge, but his son regards the exam as a routine, how can it be the same?
"Okay, you'd better go and play, don't be angry at me here."

chapters.title: Chapter 612: Shenwang Auction
chapters.content:
Chapter 612 Attending the King's Auction
The results of the selection examination were ranked on the big list, and together with the admission list, they were posted on the wall next to the gate of the field department.
Just like the big list at the entrance of the high school, they are all written on red paper, which is very festive.
All the children and parents who took the exam went to the department entrance to watch the rankings.
"Son, is that your name? Oh, my son passed the exam."
Some parents were very happy when they saw their children's names.
"That is my daughter, my daughter is ranked second."
"My son is the first, son, you are the first, and you are also recorded."
In the crowd, people kept cheering.
Although this is not as good as the high school entrance examination, it is still an excellent way out.
Being able to go out to study in college, and after graduation, you can have a job and a solid job. I don’t know how many people are jealous.
The admitted families were overjoyed. They hurried to the trade union to get the notice, and happily packed their children's things for school.
Those who were not admitted have nothing to say.
Those who participated in the labor union have been notified a long time ago, and have also sent relevant materials for learning.
My child just doesn’t have that ability, and the test scores are not good. What can I do?
If you can’t go to school, you can only work honestly at home.
The pharmaceutical factory has already started construction. Will we not be able to recruit workers then? The child is too young to be a formal worker, so he can always go in and become an apprentice, right?
No matter how bad it is, I can still take over from Lao Tzu in the future, so there is a way out.
The selection process was fair and just. The factory manager's niece did not pass the exam, and there was no special quota.
So everyone was very convinced, and no one had anything else to say.
The pharmaceutical factory is under construction in an orderly manner, and fifty directional training places have also been selected, and they can go to study after a while.
After the busy period in autumn, the pharmaceutical factory also began to recruit workers and send people to training.
In the pharmaceutical factory, it should be said that everything went smoothly, and Xu Shiyan didn't need to worry too much.
As for the ginseng festival, it is also in the final stage of preparation.
This year's Ginseng Festival is scheduled from September 1st to September 5th, which is earlier than last year.
On August 29th, Xu Shiyan took people around the county.
All venues, museums, exhibition halls and other places of the ginseng festival should be checked one by one.
Every procedure is checked, and after confirmation, the museum is closed and no one is allowed to enter.
On August 30th, representatives and farmers from all over the country who came to participate in the agricultural products exchange meeting also arrived in the county.
There is a special arrangement for the reception to ensure the board and lodging of the participants.
On August 31st, all the performances that participated in the festival will be rehearsed.
Xu Shiyan led people to recheck all the processes, and must ensure that every link can not go wrong.
On September 1st, the entire city of Er County was decorated with lanterns and festoons, and the sound of gongs and drums.
Colorful flags and ribbons were planted on both sides of the main street of the county seat, and people from various units formed a Yangko team, performing Yangko happily.
Yangko performances in previous years were all dressed up as Zhu Bajie, Monkey King, Seven Fairies and other characters.
It’s different this year. Children wear bellybands and braids on their heads, pretending to be ginseng dolls.
Young women in red coats and green trousers, dressed as stick girls.
Some old men with white beards, holding Suobao sticks, pretending to be veterans.
Joyful teams, cheerful dances, joyful singing, made the festive activities full of vibrancy.
Integrates the folk customs of the hometown of ginseng, and shows the simple and hardworking spirit of the people of ginseng.
At ten o'clock in the morning, the celebration of Ginseng Festival officially began.
According to the usual practice, the relevant leaders of the county still spoke to announce the opening of the second ginseng festival.
Then, various celebrations began.
This year's Ginseng Festival, Xu Shiyan put forward the idea of ​​taking the ginseng festival as an opportunity to vigorously promote economic development.
Centered on economy and trade, cultural and tourism activities are coordinated.
During the Ginseng Festival, cultural activities such as concerts, dances, bonfire parties, Yangko performances, art photography, calligraphy exhibitions, and lantern shows will be held.
At the same time, tourism activities on three routes including the Changbai Mountain Road, the Songhua River Road and the Ginseng Road were carried out.
Especially the unique Changbai Mountain Weighing Festival, which is very attractive.
The ginseng king selection and auction activities after the weighing festival also pushed the ginseng festival activities to a new height.
Not to mention, there are really many people who came to the mountains and encountered big goods, and brought wild ginseng to participate in the selection.
There are also participating farmers. In order to participate in the election, they specially picked up the best sticks and picked the big ones to bring.
Su Anying and the others didn't fall behind either, and each played their best sticks.
Choose a dozen or so big trees, wrap them in moss, put them in a box and bring them to the selection.
In the end, the mountain ginseng king was won by several people from Beigang.
The mountain ginseng they brought, which weighs four or two or six dollars, is beautiful in five shapes, a rare encounter, and was successfully auctioned off by a businessman in Hong Kong at a price of 128,000 yuan.
Other wild ginsengs were also auctioned off. The expensive ones were 70,000 to 80,000 yuan, and the cheap ones were several thousand yuan. The prices were several times higher than those purchased in the county.
Even if the auction takes 10% of the fee, the income is much higher than usual.
Su Anying brought a ginseng tree weighing six and a half, and was named the king of garden ginseng.
This ginseng was auctioned for a high price of 2,000 yuan.
Other half-jin ginseng can be sold for about 1,000 yuan.
The price is much higher than selling to southern customers after making wine, let alone participating in the market, it is simply incomparable.
Su Anying brought these ten ginseng trees and sold them for more than 10,000 yuan.
There were many reporters at the scene, and they hurried forward to take pictures.
The people in Beigang rejected the reporter's invitation to take pictures of them.
This is also normal, after all, several people got hundreds of thousands. If the photos are published in the newspaper, they will not have to stop in the future. I don’t know how many people will miss it.
Su Anying was not afraid, and happily joined the buyer, holding the box, taking photos, and exchanging business cards.
The other party was a Hong Kong businessman. Seeing that Su Anying was the manager of the company, she was very happy and said that they could cooperate if they had the opportunity in the future.
And other ginseng farmers also brought some ginseng that was half a catty or more than four taels, and the price was several times higher than the usual selling price.
Participants were very happy, and many people asked the staff if there will be an auction next year?
If it is held next year, they will still come.
How do the staff know if there will be an auction next year? I can only tell them to remember to pay attention to the news when the time comes.
If there was one, it would definitely be on the news.
In this auction alone, the turnover exceeded one million yuan.
"Secretary Li, did you see it? This is just a small auction, and the turnover is so much.
Tomorrow's ginseng and native products trade fair will open. Xu Shiyan said that it is conservatively estimated that the turnover can reach hundreds of millions.
If it really can break through 100 million, we will make money this time around the Ginseng Festival. "
Chang Hongfa and Li Jingyu also came to see the auction. Hearing the turnover reported by the staff, Chang Hongfa was so happy that he didn't know what to do.
In contrast, Li Jingyu was much calmer.
"Well, Comrade Xiao Xu is still very capable, but well, the young man is still too proud.
What is the total output of ginseng in our county? Want to break 100 million at the fair? Is this estimate too high?
I think we should treat it with a normal mind, don't have too high expectations, and don't put too much pressure on Comrade Xu. "

chapters.title: Chapter 613: The transaction volume exceeded 100 million
chapters.content:
Chapter 613 The transaction volume exceeds 100 million
On the evening of the first day of the Ginseng Festival, a grand fireworks display was held.
In the open space in front of Beishan, a bonfire party and a food market were held.
All the shops in the county have set up stalls here, and arranged various delicacies.
The huge fire in the middle of the venue, the bonfire is burning, and the flames are rising high, dancing with the music and singing.
All the people who participated in the party, while tasting all kinds of delicacies, followed the music and jumped happily around the bonfire.
"Daughter-in-law, come on, please dance."
Xu Shiyan pulled Su Anying and joined the cheerful dance team.
People were playing and laughing to their heart's content, their faces were reddened by the raging bonfire, and their smiles became brighter.
On the second day of the Ginseng Festival, the Ginseng and Native Products Fair officially kicked off.
The trade fair was chosen on the embankment of the Xijiang River, and there was a long queue along the embankment from north to south.
Many counties and cities in the province have arranged for people to come to the exhibition with their products.
Various enterprises and exhibitors in the county brought a lot of products, and even some wineries and beverage factories came to participate in the exhibition.
Guo Shouye did a lot of help this time, and Bingshan mineral water sponsored ginseng water conservation throughout the process.
Not only the mineral water used at the conference, but also free mineral water and drinks in the hotels where foreign friends and compatriots from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan live.
Yesterday, someone asked the staff about the iceberg mineral water, and some people called directly to inquire.
Today, Guo Shouye also came to set up a stall with various beverages produced by Bingshan Beverage Factory.
Yi Zhan this time, not only brought a variety of ginseng products, but also brought medicinal materials such as Ganoderma lucidum, Gastrodia elata, Asarum, Fritillaria, Longgu, and Schisandra.
These are the output of waste ginseng land after comprehensive utilization of ginseng land.
Nowadays, a complete system has been formed for the utilization of old ginseng land in a ginseng field, with various products, high quality and large output.
This is because the pharmaceutical factory has not yet been built, so it is sent here for exhibitions. When the pharmaceutical factory is built in the future, these medicinal materials can be sent to the pharmaceutical factory, and the source supply will be more profitable.
Even Xu Shian brought deer antler, venison, deer blood, deer tendon, deer blood wine, deer penis, deer fetus, etc. from the farm to participate in the exhibition.
It doesn't matter how much you sell, the main thing is to join in the fun.
More than 300 enterprises and more than 400 merchants from all over the country were invited to come.
and more than 200 foreign friends from 12 countries and regions, compatriots from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, all came to participate in the fair.
Many people are very interested in the fair, and even have the intention to purchase the products exhibited at the fair.
Many merchants chatted with the staff of the exhibitors one after another to learn about products and negotiate prices.
After the two parties reached an agreement, many merchants placed orders directly.
"How much is the transaction now?"
Chang Hongfa didn't have time to wander around to watch the exhibition. What he cared most about was the transaction volume, how many goods were sold.
"County Chang, the turnover has reached 50 million now.
This is just the beginning, and there are still many merchants talking over there. It is estimated that the turnover will exceed 100 million this morning. "
Xu Shixiang was in charge of leading people to count the transaction data today, and when Chang Hong asked him a question, he immediately reported the current data.
Chang Hongfa was overjoyed when he heard that the turnover had reached 50 million.
It has only been an hour or so since the beginning, and there are 50 million. It should be easy to break 100 million this morning.
Happily, I began to feel distressed again.
Jesus, how much did they miss last year? Thinking of this, Chang Hongfa jumped up in distress.
Such a good opportunity was missed.
Thanks to his insistence that Xu Shiyan be the host to participate in the festival this year, it seems that this step is really right.
"Old Li, how are you? It's 50 million, and there seems to be another order over there."
Chang Hongfa was so happy that he stopped calling Secretary Li and called Lao Li directly.
Li Jingyu next to him is also bleeding from his heart.
How come no one proposed to hold a souvenir fair last year? Such a good opportunity, they wasted it?
The county spent so much money and ended up with nothing?
Li Jingyu felt uncomfortable, but he couldn't show it on his face. Hearing Chang Hong's question, Li Jingyu smiled.
"Yeah, I really didn't expect that in just a short time, there will be a turnover of 50 million.
It seems that I underestimated Comrade Xu.
He came up with a really good idea. This time in our county, it is really like what he said, it’s a good idea. "
No matter what you say, the county has really benefited from this Ginseng Festival.
The bigger the turnover, the better. These are the achievements of Li Jingyu's tenure, and they will benefit him a lot in the future.
Chang Hongfa glanced at Li Jingyu, and snorted coldly in his heart, why didn't he just speak hard this time?
If you have the ability, tell me, is this a cultural event?
Hehe, it’s also a cultural activity. Look at Xu Shiyan, what’s wrong with it?
Not only is it not bad, it is even better than last year.
As long as everyone who participated, who would not say, this year's Ginseng Festival has a strong cultural atmosphere of ginseng, and it really shows the demeanor of ginseng?
Especially, it has played a very good role in the inheritance and development of various folk customs in Canxiang.
While Chang Hongfa and Li Jingyu were talking, many customers placed orders over there.
Xu Shixiang made a quick count here, and then reported the amount to Chang Hongfa and Li Jingyu.
"County Chang and Secretary Li have just received another batch of large orders, and the current turnover has exceeded 100 million."
The two people who were still chatting here were dumbfounded, "So fast?"
"Yes, just now a few foreign merchants directly ordered nearly ten million mineral water and blue indigo juice with Bingshan Beverage Factory.
In addition, Hong Kong has negotiated an order of 4 million yuan, which is also mineral water. "
That is to say, just for the iceberg mineral water, nearly 15 million goods have been ordered in a short time.
"In addition, there are also large foreign exchange orders for Yishenchang's energy drink, ginseng coffee, ginseng rhodiola capsules, ginseng snow clam honey and other products."
Any product that participates in the fair can create miracles at the Spring Fair, let alone this moment.
In addition to these deep-processed products, the medicinal materials cultivated in a factory have also been favored by many customers in the south, and many orders have been placed.
“Most of the products currently exhibiting at the exhibition have more or less transaction volume.
Zan County Pharmaceutical Factory, this time there are also many customers ordering.
Even Xinglong Township's small pure grain roast, just ordered thousands of catties. "
Xu Shixiang laughed as he spoke. He forced the Xinglong pot into it, but he just wanted to join in the fun.
But who would have imagined it, even this one was taken by someone, and it was a surprise that a customer ordered a lot just now.
"Okay, okay, great, this is really good news." Chang Hongfa said several good words in succession.
How long has it been since it started? It hasn't even passed the whole morning, and the turnover has directly exceeded 100 million.
If you calculate it in one day today, it can't be two or three hundred million? This time, the county has really gained a lot.
"Everyone, do a good job. After the end of this ginseng festival, the county will hold a celebration party, and all the staff will be awarded certificates."
Li Jingyu was also very happy, so he asked the staff to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 614: wonderful event
chapters.content:
Chapter 614 Wonderful event
The ginseng and native products trade fair only lasts for one day, and there will be no other activities for the whole day on September 2nd.
By 4:30 p.m., the trade fair ends.
According to the final statistics, on the day of the trade fair, the total transaction volume of various products was 500 million.
The cadres in the county were so happy that they all drank too much at night, and Li Jingyu shouted that there was going to be a celebration banquet.
On the first day of the Ginseng Festival, Guan Enxue attended the opening ceremony together with provincial and city leaders.
Due to too much work, I left in the evening and failed to see the grand occasion of the trade fair.
However, with Chang Hongfa here, as soon as Chang Hongfa got home, he immediately called Guan Enxue and talked about the situation of the trade fair vividly.
Guan Enxue was naturally very happy when he heard this, but at the same time, he also told Chang Hongfa that he must remember that Xu Shiyan should not be transferred to work elsewhere.
Chang Hongfa's brain is not very sharp after drinking too much, and he still doesn't quite understand.
Guan Enxue didn't say that much, just let Chang Hongfa remember this.
Chang Hongfa agreed, hung up the phone, lay down and fell asleep.
On the third day of the Ginseng Festival, Xu Shiyan transferred all the buses in the county.
Organized a tour group, took people to climb Changbai Mountain, climbed from the west **** to the main peak, and watched Tianchi.
In August of the year before last, strong typhoon No. 15 made landfall, and Changbai Mountain Nature Reserve was severely hit by the typhoon, and large trees were uprooted by the typhoon.
After the typhoon disaster, after several twists and turns, the superior finally agreed that the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau would pick up and transport the windfall trees from the disaster area.
Due to severe typhoon damage, the area of ​​forest land destroyed by the wind is too large. After two years of hard work by the forestry department, there are still some wind-fallen trees that have not been cleared out.
Forestry workers have been working in the dense forest of Changbai Mountain.
For the safety of sightseeing this time, Xu Shiyan greeted the Forestry Bureau in advance.
On the 3rd, the Forestry Bureau suspended construction to avoid accidents caused by too many vehicles on the road.
Currently, tourism on the west **** of Changbai Mountain has not yet been developed, and there is no decent road. It is the road for transporting firewood for forestry logging.
Due to the cleaning of fallen trees, two deep ruts were formed on the road by the original car.
The bus was driving slowly towards the Changbai Mountain Reserve under such road conditions.
Pass the Baixi Forest Farm and go further in, to Weidong Frontier Defense Station.
This side has also received the notice a long time ago, and there is no need to issue any certificates, and vehicles can directly drive into the Changbai Mountain Reserve.
Climbing the west **** of Changbai Mountain this month, you can drive all the way to the mountain. As for how far you can go, it depends on the performance of the car.
After crossing the Tizi River, the mountain gradually became steeper, and the bus stopped moving when it was driving.
The people in the car can only get out of the car, carry their bags and things, and walk up the mountain step by step.
In Changbai Mountain in September, the leaves of Rhododendron tiger skin on the alpine tundra have turned purple, and the grass on the tundra has begun to turn yellow.
It happens that the colors are interlaced to form a pattern, just like the fur of a tiger.
The people climbed over the tiger's back and the panting slope, and after a lot of effort, they finally climbed to the top of the snow cliff and looked down at the Tianchi water.
Catch up with the good weather today, the sky is high and the clouds are light, and a pool of blue sky water is located among the mountains, like a blue gem.
Looking at Tianchi from the west slope, you can see the whole picture of Tianchi, which is different from the north slope.
Even if Xu Shiyan had just seen it last year, he still felt that the beauty of Tianchi was indescribable.
The tourists around him all had the same feeling as Xu Shiyan. Many people exclaimed and praised the scenery in front of them in various languages.
The more daring young people climbed directly to the Qingshi Peak, which stands dangerously high on the left, and walked on the Qingshi Peak.
There are also some young, bold, quick-moving, and vigorous tourists who go down the cliffs and go directly to the waterside of Tianchi.
This time, Xu Shiyan did not follow.
He is the overall person in charge of the event, and must be responsible for controlling the entire venue, and he can deal with it in a timely manner if there is an unexpected situation.
If he goes down, something will happen above, which is hard to solve.
Xu Shiyan instructed the accompanying staff to remind tourists to pay attention to safety.
On the west **** of Changbai Mountain, there is the No. 5 boundary marker between China and North Korea. Many people take pictures at the boundary marker.
After shooting this side, I want to go to the other side to experience the feeling of stepping into two countries.
Unfortunately, before he could take that step, he was called back by the border guards on duty at the top of the mountain.
At noon, everyone was on the top of the mountain, eating the food they brought. Everyone was full of praise for the beautiful scenery of Changbai Mountain.
Many people came to ask, why is such a beautiful scenery not open to tourists?
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to explain that the current tourism development on the west **** of Changbai Mountain has not yet been recognized, and the supporting facilities are not perfect.
Moreover, Changbai Mountain is too big, with tall trees and dense forests, and there are many kinds of wild animals in the forest. If you walk around casually, it will be dangerous.
Perhaps in the near future, the west **** of Changbai Mountain can be opened to the outside world, allowing tourists to climb the mountain.
After eating, everyone rested on the top of the mountain for a while, and then went down the mountain one after another with their bags on their backs.
The staff counted the number of people, and after confirming that all the tourists had gone down the mountain, they followed at the end of the team and went down the mountain step by step.
Because the Changbai Mountain West Scenic Area has not yet been developed this year, the Jinjiang Grand Canyon was only discovered last year when the wind felled trees were cleared, and it is still in a dense forest and cannot be approached.
So after going down the mountain, everyone just went to see the Tizi River, and then returned by car.
On the fourth day of the Ginseng Festival, Xu Shiyan arranged for tourists to ride on specially-made bamboo rafts, found a smooth water area, and drifted down the river.
Sitting on a bamboo raft, watching the beautiful scenery of the mountains and rivers on both sides, and wild ducks and mandarin ducks flying by from time to time, this is also a very novel experience.
Someone asked, Xu Shiyan would tell everyone the story of the former wood gang felling logs and placing rafts.
Those tourists who were on a bamboo raft with him all listened with gusto.
"Xu, you should be a tour guide, you are great." Someone gave him a thumbs up and praised.
"Yes, I really think about it too, I very much hope that one day, I can travel all over the famous mountains and rivers of the motherland.
Our country has a vast land and rich resources, and there are too many beautiful scenery. Welcome friends to travel, see the beautiful scenery, taste delicious food, and experience different folk customs. "
Xu Shiyan was very happy, and had a great chat with the tourists on the bamboo raft.
The drifting time was not long, only an hour or so. Everyone was still thinking about it, and returned to the county to change clothes and wash.
In the afternoon, there are concerts, folk performances, and dances in the evening.
On the fifth day of the Ginseng Festival, it is arranged to visit various exhibition halls, as well as folk exhibitions, Changbai Mountain ginseng history and culture exhibitions, etc. Anyway, tourists like it very much.
Everyone felt that the five-day Ginseng Festival was full of harvest, very happy, and super awesome.
Of course, no matter how happy the journey is, there will be an end.
On September 5th, the 2nd Fusong Ginseng Festival officially closed amidst the reluctance of everyone.
Businessmen at home and abroad left one after another, and everyone received a set of small gifts carefully prepared by the Organizing Committee of this Ginseng Festival.
There are ginseng festival badges, commemorative books, postcards, etc. inside, which are beautifully made and very commemorative.
Recommend this new book

chapters.title: Chapter 615: Han Wenzhong's Vision
chapters.content:
Chapter 615 Han Wenzhong's Vision
The second Ginseng Festival received a total of more than 300 enterprises across the country and 600 to 700 domestic and foreign merchants.
There are also more than 90 journalists from 40 news organizations in the capital and all over the country, and nearly 100 leaders and comrades from the central, provincial, and municipal departments.
All the guests celebrated the festival together with the people of the whole county. The whole county has a strong festive atmosphere, which is comparable to the New Year.
During the ginseng festival, the auction and native products trade fair unexpectedly achieved an economic and trade volume of 500 million yuan, which greatly exceeded the expected 100 million yuan turnover.
The successful holding of this year's Ginseng Festival has greatly improved the popularity of Ginseng Township.
Leaders at all levels, as well as relevant leaders of the National Calligraphers Association, Photographers Association, Dramatists Association, and Artists Association, famous Pingju performance artists, famous writers and other celebrities from all walks of life in the country have painted inscriptions for the Ginseng Festival.
People's Daily, Provincial Daily, Provincial TV Station and other news units rushed to report on the grand occasion of the Ginseng Festival.
At the World Tourism Products Expo held in Hong Kong City and West Germany, a special booth for "Changbai Mountain Ginseng Festival" was set up, which attracted the attention of the world.
It can be said that this year's Ginseng Festival was very successful.
On September 8th, all follow-up affairs related to the Ginseng Festival were completed, and the county held a commendation meeting.
Leaders from the province and city also attended, commended and distributed rewards to relevant staff.
The leader emphasized the outstanding performance of the staff in this conference, including the members of the preparatory team.
Of course, Xu Shiyan, as the leader of the preparatory team and the leader of this ginseng festival, received commendations from the province and city.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang, as Xu Shiyan's assistants, also performed well at this year's Ginseng Festival, and their work ability has been recognized by many leaders.
At the Propaganda Department, Xu Shixian was sent directly to the Propaganda Department as the deputy section chief.
The Finance Bureau also lost no time in talking to the Xinglong Township Finance Office and transferred Xu Shixiang to be the chief of the budget section.
Other members of the preparatory team have also made appropriate job transfers. Anyway, they are much better than their original positions.
For meritorious service, this cannot be rewarded in cash. In addition to giving out some prizes, it must be compensated from other places.
Originally, many units also fell in love with Xu Shiyan and wanted to transfer him away.
But Lin Qiyue was determined not to let anyone go, and Chang Hongfa also insisted on refusing.
Xu Shiyan himself doesn't like to join those departments.
He felt that his temperament was not suitable for entering the agency, so he might as well be on the side of the field and concentrate on studying.
What's more, at the pharmaceutical factory, he was appointed by the superior to take care of it, so he should just stay in the field.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan successfully completed the task assigned by the leader, and returned to Donggang from the county with a certificate of honor and rewards.
"Oh, it's such a pity.
Xiao Xu, why are you so stubborn? The leaders have told you to go to work in the county, but you won’t go.
If you enter the county, with your ability, you may not be able to enter the province in the future. "
Although it was a busy season, relatives and friends still held a small celebration ceremony for Xu Shiyan.
Yu Shouguang also came, and after listening to Xu Shiyan's narration, he felt sorry for Xu Shiyan.
"No, that's not what you said.
You have to know that Shi Yan is now the head of a participating field, and Secretary Lin and Shi Yan are very close to each other, and they discuss everything no matter what they do.
I heard that Shi Yan is in charge of the pharmaceutical factory, how good is that? No one is in charge of the above, what he says has the final say.
If Shi Yan is transferred to the county, it is impossible to lead directly, right? Doesn't that mean you have to listen to others?
It’s boring, it’s not interesting, the salary is not much, there are a lot of things to do, and you have to listen to the boss talking in front of you all day long.
If you do a good job, the results are determined by the leader. If you don’t do a good job, he will have to take the blame. "
Over there, Han Wenzhong shook his head. He felt that Xu Shiyan was right in not agreeing.
The work in the county is not easy to do, so it's better to just stay in the first field and be his field leader, which is better than anything else.
The two old men almost quarreled over this matter, Xu Shiyan quickly persuaded him.
"Uncle Yu, look at me, I am straight-hearted, simple and stupid, and I don't have a seven-holed heart.
I go to work in the county, if the insurance is not complete, if the leader is dissatisfied one day, he can kick me back, why do you think I have to do it?
I have never had much ambition, so I just guard our Donggang, guard the field, and lead the big guys to do something, and I feel pretty good. "
When everyone in the room heard this, they couldn't help complaining.
"Well, don't say you are stupid, if you are stupid, you will not be smart.
I've seen it for a long time, you boy, you look indifferent on the outside, but your stomach is full of heart.
Anyone who believes you are stupid is an idiot. "Yu Shouguang rolled Xu Shiyan's eyes angrily.
In his heart, he felt that Xu Shiyan had put in so much effort and effort, and in the end he was not promoted or given any other rewards.
It's a shame to just get two certificates of honor.
Xu Shiyan was not annoyed, he still chatted with everyone with a smile.
The guys chatted until after seven o'clock, and it was already dark outside.
At this time, every family was busy, and they were tired from going up the mountain during the day, so they all said goodbye and left.
Xu Shiyan went out to see him off. Before Han Wenzhong left, he whispered to Xu Shiyan.
"Shi Yan, let me tell you, we don't want any job offered by the superior.
You can stay at the same place with peace of mind, there is no harm in keeping it.
I reckon that Secretary Lin will have to be reassigned if things don’t go well at the end of the year, and you will be the number one participant by then, and it’s up to you.
How wonderful, why do we go to the county to be angry with others? "
"Hey, I know, Uncle Han, I'm definitely not going anywhere.
Right here at the venue, leading our team of participants to live our days. "
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, and he didn't say whether Han Wenzhong's guess was right, he just nodded in agreement.
Han Wenzhong was quite satisfied with Xu Shiyan's attitude, and then continued.
"There is one more thing, uncle told you in advance.
Next year, you should think of a way in advance and hide out early, and we won’t help you with the ginseng festival.
No matter who says this, don’t take it again. If you do it, it’s easy to smash it, understand? "
This year's Ginseng Festival was too successful, even if Xu Shiyan manages it by himself later, it will be difficult to surpass it.
At that time, everyone will place high hopes on Xu Shiyan. If the effect is not as good as this year, the fault will be all on Xu Shiyan.
Han Wenzhong is at this age, so he doesn't understand anything.
He was afraid that Xu Shiyan's ginseng festival would be so beautiful this time that people would be lost, and he would continue to do it next year.
If that's the case, it's likely to be a thankless effort.
Han Wenzhong protects Xu Shiyan wholeheartedly, of course he has to be reminded, but don't make such a low-level mistake.
"Hey, thank you uncle for reminding me, I know, I know, I will remember this, I will definitely remember it."
Xu Shiyan hasn't thought that far ahead yet.
He feels that the possibility that the county will let him handle it next year is almost zero.
The success of this year's Ginseng Festival will make too many people envious. Next year, many people will definitely rush to grab it.
So anyone who likes to grab it can grab it, Xu Shiyan is too lazy to take over.
The past few months have been exhausting for him, and the skin is almost peeled off. He doesn't want to suffer from this tiredness again.

chapters.title: Chapter 616: Another harvest season
chapters.content:
Chapter 616 Another Harvest Season
The ginseng festival is over, the ginseng field has already started to participate in labor, and the pharmaceutical factory is still under construction.
Everything is going on as usual.
Lin Qiyue knew that Xu Shiyan was too tired these days, and said that he would give him a few days off so that he could have a good rest at home before going back to work.
How can Xu Shiyan have time to rest? With so many things to do, he had no choice but to reject Lin Qiyue's offer and go to work as usual.
Then on Sunday, September 11th, together with Su Anying, they led the people up the mountain and brought back the rest of their sticks.
The ginseng land in Liumaohe is the ginseng land that the Xu family made goods this year, and it was planted a hundred feet back then.
A few days ago, in order to catch up with the ginseng festival auction, Su Anying brought people out to the best place in twenty feet.
Except for the dozen or so trees that were sold at the auction, the rest were sent to the processing factory for processing and making goods.
The Xu family's sticks are still growing well this year, otherwise they wouldn't be able to win the honor of King Ginseng at the Ginseng Festival.
The average of the twenty feet, one foot can lift thirty-six to seven kilograms, this output is absolutely amazing.
There are so many ginseng lands, so we can’t point them all at our own family like before.
Either hire someone or ask for help.
Every household in Donggang is planted with clubs, and they are busy at this time. Few people go out to work for other people's homes, so they can only ask for help.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan's popularity is still here.
Not to mention anything else, this group of brothers didn't need Xu Shiyan to say anything, knowing when the Xu family would start joining, the big guys came directly with tools.
This time, not only Huang Shengli and the others, but also brothers, brother-in-law and brother-in-law from various families came to help.
Ji Tongzhong bought out his own little land when the spring began and stopped planting it.
Nan Zhendong came late, and he was really worried about his family during the big autumn harvest season, so he went home to reclaim the land a few days ago.
Most of them were drawn out, and Su Anzhen slowly tidied up the few scattered pieces of land left at home.
Nan Zhendong and Su Anzhen have also discussed that next year they will rent out the land, and the couple will take their children to Donggang directly.
No need to say anything, just follow the second brother-in-law and it's over.
Catched up with Sunday, Xu Haiyuan didn't go to class, Xu Haiqing was clamoring to follow up the mountain.
Where did he want to go to participate? He clearly knew that the Liumao River was fun and wanted to follow along.
"Dad, just take us there, we promise not to make trouble, I can help pick up the club."
Xu Haiqing rolled his eyes, hugged Xu Shiyan's arm and kept begging.
"No, just stay at home honestly and mess around.
Don’t think I can’t see your narrow-mindedness, do you want to work? Just want to play. "
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes at his youngest son. With his virtue, how can he still know how to work?
"Xu Haiyuan, get my brother away, don't delay me, I don't have time to talk nonsense with him.
That year when you went up the mountain and saw the footprints of the blind man, you forgot about the fact that someone made the blind man kick, right? Nonsense. "
In previous years, there was not enough manpower, and Xu Haiyuan was older anyway, so he dared to lead him.
How old is Xu Haiqing? At the age of seven, the bear boy has a lot of thoughts, and he wants to follow him up the mountain, so beautiful.
The black blind man who hurt someone didn’t hear where he went. Anyway, Zhao Jianguo was watching ginseng on the mountain and didn’t hear anything.
Probably either died or walked away. Anyway, the blind man suffered a lot in that area, so he will definitely not go back.
But the children didn't understand, so Xu Shiyan deliberately used this to scare Xu Haiqing.
Sure enough, when Xu Haiqing heard about the **** blind man, he didn't dare to mess around anymore, and was dragged away by Xu Haiyuan.
"I said it a long time ago, don't mess with our dad, you think you are me? Just stay at home honestly.
You will go to elementary school next year, just write those words, not to mention your second sister wants to beat you, I want to.
Let's go, quickly write the homework I left for you, if you don't write well again, be careful I will whip you. "
When talking about the study of the fourth child, Xu Haiyuan panicked.
They are all children born to the same parents, why is the fourth child so stupid.
Just like that, Xu Haiqing's little thought of going up the mountain was suppressed by his father and brother.
At this time, everything was packed, Xu Shiyan carried the three-toothed child outside and got into the car.
"Daughter-in-law, how about some good dishes tonight."
There were so many people this time, Xu Shiyan didn't let Su Anying go up the mountain, but asked her to order delicious food at home and entertain the helpers at night.
"Don't worry, don't you know about this? I won't embarrass you." Su Anying replied with a smile.
Everyone is here, the tools are thrown on the car, and the three cars set off together, heading straight for the Liumao River.
The ginseng land in Liumao River was more than 50,000 feet in total at the beginning, but it was sold for 20,000 feet.
The remaining 30,000 zhang were planted, and 20,000 zhang were sold last year, leaving 10,000 zhang.
Xu Shiyan told Huang Shengli that they only sold 8,000 zhang to takeaway this year, leaving 2,000 zhang to be used by each family for planting ginseng this year and next year.
The ginseng seeds sown on demand are thinner than those artificially sown, and have enough room for growth, so they can be kept for four years.
The four-year-old seeds are called Wo Laoer in the local area. Some people even come out to make goods directly. It is conceivable that they have grown quite large.
Transplant four-year-old seeds and put them in the ground for another three years. Generally, they can grow quite large and produce large quantities.
Huang Shengli and the others also saw that it was a big business to make money, so they all agreed with Xu Shiyan's proposal.
Anyway, the big guy has only one thought, Xu Shiyan will listen to whatever he says, and follow the third brother to have meat to eat.
During the daytime, the ginseng field is full of work, and there is no fear of thieves coming.
So Zhao Jianguo also led those who were watching the parade, and came to help Xu Shiyan lift the mallet.
So many people worked together, those who removed the shed, those who cut the ginseng leaves, those who swung the three-toothed sticks, and those who squatted and half knelt followed to pick up the sticks, needless to say, each went to find a job.
There are many people, so the work is fast. After a while, several sacks were filled there.
"Third Brother, your Bangchui is doing well this year. I don't think it's worse than it was a few days ago."
Zhao Jianshe quarreled with Xu Shiyan. He swung a three-tooth planer mallet, and Xu Shiyan squatted there to pick it up.
The two of them chatted while working.
Zhao Jianshe also helped Su Anying get up a few days ago, knowing what the Xu family's stick looks like, so he chatted with Xu Shiyan.
"Well, this year the mallet is very good, the figure is good, and there is no rust.
What do you think we have been working hard for three years? Why don't you just hope that the stick will get better? "
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it. He has lived his whole life again. How can he not know which part of the land is good and which part is not good?
It costs money, so you must find a good place.
I’ve heard people say before that the ginseng land in Liumao River is good, and the long stick is really true.
"I'll ask brother Guo if there is a cutting area near here during the Chinese New Year, let's get it down.
This piece of ginseng is good, and it’s quite long. "Xu Shiyan looked at the large forest at the west end of Candi, and couldn't help muttering.
"Hey, third brother, look quickly, this club seems to be quite big."
Xu Shiyan was mumbling, when he heard Zhao Jianshe exclaimed.
Then, a mallet came out from the soil, like a big carrot.

chapters.title: Chapter 617: Follow Brother Xu to have meat
chapters.content:
Chapter 617 Follow Brother Xu to have meat
Xu Shiyan's family's sticks are growing well, and all the people who plan the sticks are extra careful, and the three-toothed teeth dig as deep as possible into the soil.
Zhao Jianshe dug out one of the three-toothed trees, but brought up a big lump of dirt.
Three Teeth shook slightly, and the loose black soil fell, revealing the shoulders of the mallet.
This guy looks almost as thick as Xu Haiqing's arm.
Zhao Jianshe sent the three-toothed child back, and the mallet came to Xu Shiyan.
Then, Zhao Jianshe threw the three-toothed tree and came over to shake off the soil on the ginseng tree with Xu Shiyan.
"I'll go, this is as big as the big radishes that grow in our family in autumn, third brother, this mallet must be so small that it weighs a catty?"
When the ginseng tree was fully exposed, Zhao Jianshe couldn't help but exclaimed.
This ginseng tree is really not small, the main body is as long as a palm, the beard is nearly half a foot, and the few large beards on the top are thicker than a finger.
"Hey, come and see, this ginseng is the real king of ginseng."
Zhao Jianshe shouted loudly, urging everyone to come and watch.
"Oh, really, is this mallet so big?
Third brother, you are at a loss. If this tree was sent to the auction a few days ago, this tree would not sell for four to five thousand yuan? "
Yang Junxian and others all came over, and when they saw the ginseng tree, everyone felt sorry for it. It didn't catch up with the good time, and it cost less money, right?
"Yes, this thing grows in the ground, and if it doesn't come out, no one knows what it looks like underneath."
Xu Shiyan smiled while holding the mallet.
The bunch that Su Anying brought up, the ones who got off the ground at the beginning were the first ones. Since they are going to participate in the auction to select the best candidates, they must start with the best one.
But who would have thought that there was such a big tree among the remaining mallets.
So, this mallet has been planted in the ground for three years, and no one knows what it will be until the moment it comes out.
"This tree is not for sale, keep the wine, and put it in Shanhuozhuang, as the treasure of the store.
Otherwise, our dignified Shanhuozhuang doesn't even have a bigger mallet, which is shameful. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at Ji Tongzhong, and directly threw the ginseng tree to him.
"Xiao Ji, this ginseng tree is under your control, go get some moss or something, wrap it up, and keep it alone.
Turn around and let your second sister wash it, and throw it in the big glass jar in your shop. "
Ji Tongzhong saw that his brother-in-law threw the mallet to him casually, his legs almost went limp in fright, and he quickly hugged the mallet in his arms.
"Second brother-in-law, this is King Shen, and it's all money. Are you too casual? Just throw it away like this?
If you break a beard or something, don’t you feel sorry for me? "
Ji Tongzhong said while holding the ginseng tree and ran away.
He ran directly to the ground, found a sack to cover it, then asked Zhao Jianguo for a tool, and went into the woods.
Such a big ginseng tree needs to be stored properly and must be wrapped with moss.
Ji Tongzhong found a place with moss in the shade, lifted a large piece with tools or something, rolled it up and brought it back.
Wrap the ginseng with moss, then find a cardboard box and put it under the sack to cover it.
Ji Tongzhong finished working on the ginseng tree before returning to work with Huang Shengkai.
Huang Shengkai planed the stick, and Ji Tongzhong picked up the stick. The two of them worked together well, and they worked very quickly.
Xu Shiyan’s family’s mallet is really good. Although there are no more eight taels in the follow-up, there are quite a few more than four taels, not to mention three or so.
Many people in this area are playing sticks. Anyone who is trustworthy will come and have a look. Seeing the size of this stick, they are all envious.
"Brother Xu, where will you approve the ginseng soil next year? Please wait a little longer then.
As long as you prepare the ginseng soil, we will keep it and buy it from you.
We can see it, and follow Brother Xu to have meat to eat. "
This one is also from Donggang Village, and he had a good relationship with Xu Shiyan before.
From Kaifeng Fork Road, to Liumao River, and then to the machine repair shop, they all bought ginseng soil from Xu Shiyan and the others.
This brat, last year the mallet grew very well, and this year it is also growing well, he sort of understands it.
Needless to say in the future, wherever Xu Shiyan approves ginseng soil, he will follow, and keeping it can make money.
"Yes, yes, Xiao Qu said, Brother Xu, remember to take us with you next year." The people next to him echoed.
"I don't know what's coming next year. I'll let you know when the time comes. Anyway, no matter where it is, as long as you are willing to buy it, I will definitely take it with you."
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it. These people are smarter than each other, and they can even think of this.
Everyone laughed together. The harvest days are always full of laughter.
There are eighty feet of clubs in total. With so many people working, of course it is fast. Most of them get up in the morning.
There were a lot of clubs piled up here, and we couldn’t leave people at noon, so Zhao Jianguo went back and warmed up everyone’s meal.
Lunch is Zhou Guilan and Su Anying's steamed meat stuffed buns last night. Once the big pot in Kansan Xiaofang is hot, it's almost as if it's just been steamed.
Ji Tongzhong and Nan Zhendong went to bring the buns back in a large basin, and brought two pots of water along the way.
The big guys are looking for a place with the sun, eating delicious meat buns, drinking hot water, very comfortable.
After eating, smoke a cigarette and rest for a while, then continue to ginseng.
Before three o'clock in the afternoon, all the eighty-foot-high ginseng came out.
Xu Shiyan's ginseng yield per unit area this year is good, with an average of thirty-five to six catties of fresh ginseng.
A total of twenty-nine sacks were made, one of which was tied and the rest were seamed.
After all the ginseng has been counted, someone turns the four-toothed wheel and turns it over again in the field. This is called a stick.
The local people say that blocking is probably similar to picking up leaks, that is, looking for leftovers from the fields that have already been harvested.
For example, to block the stick is to rummage through it after starting the ginseng, and to block the seed is to rummage it again after the seed is removed.
Stopping ginseng seeds, most of them are talking about the sticks used to make ginseng products. When the ginseng flowers are pinched in spring, the ginseng flowers fall and grow into ginseng seeds, which are picked by others.
Generally speaking, no matter what is blocked, it depends on the welfare of the ginseng. This is a convention.
Only when the ginsengers are too busy, or the whole field has finished playing the clubs, and the ginsengers go down the mountain, will others be allowed to come in and stop them.
The ginseng falls less, and the bigger the stick, the more carefully it will not fall too much.
At most, it is just some ginseng whiskers buried in the soil, and the harvest will not be too great.
The longer the mallet is, the worse it is, especially if there is a rotten place, it will tend to fall a little.
Compared to blocking sticks, blocking seeds will yield better harvests, because the seeds are small and can easily fall into the soil.
Xu Shiyan's family's clubs are very good, and everyone is very careful.
Therefore, very few fell, and everyone took turns to plan with four teeth, and it was fine if there were none.
"Okay, that's it, quickly carry it outside and load it into the car."
Huang Shengli yelled at the crowd, packed up his things, and carried the club outside.
So, everyone walked out either carrying tools or sacks.
Go to the outside of the field to load the car, and leave people to watch, while the others continue to go back to carry the sacks.
All the sacks were carried out, loaded on the car, and tied firmly with thick hemp or nylon ropes to ensure that the sacks would not be knocked over.
Then everyone got into the car and sat on the sacks to press the car.
When ginseng is packed in bags, the reeds face inwards, and the bags are very solid. Such sacks are not afraid of people sitting on them.

chapters.title: Chapter 618: Treasure of the Town Store
chapters.content:
Chapter 618 The Treasure of the Town Store
After the sticks are picked up, they don’t need to be kept at home, and they are directly shipped to the processing factory.
In the processing factory, some people were specially hired to work this year, and they lived in it to keep watch.
And there are several dogs raised here, all offspring of Xiao Huang and Er Hei.
Xu Shiyan told people that year that when a **** is raising a seedling, let Xiao Huang and Er Hei go over to breed dogs, and then just give his family a few puppies.
Later, four or five puppies were indeed brought in, but these puppies were not brought home, but were raised in the processing factory.
The dogs at home are just old and not stupid.
If the puppies are brought back, the dogs will feel that the owner raised the puppies to replace them.
Dogs don’t know how to speak, but they are all smart. They also have feelings.
Xiaohuang and Erhei have been in the Xu family for so many years and have made countless contributions.
They are all old, Xu Shiyan just wants to let the dogs live in peace and stability for a few years, and doesn't want to make them sad.
Although there are puppies here, they have perfectly inherited their father's genes, and they are all very powerful.
With these dogs around, there are still crackers hanging around the walls of the processing factory. There are people watching and guns inside.
Every family also arranges people to guard here at night, so there is no need to worry.
Twenty or so sacks were unloaded directly from the truck, carried to the large warehouse of the processing factory, and locked the warehouse directly.
Xu Shiyan explained to the guards here again, to be alert at night, after that, everyone drove back to Xu's house.
On the Xu family's side, Su Anying and Zhou Guilan started to work early.
Su Anfen and Han Cai'e also came to help and cooked more than a dozen dishes together, including chicken, duck and fish.
Hearing a car stop outside, Su Anying sent her son out to have a look.
Xu Haiqing ran out and saw Xu Shiyan and others get off the car.
"Mom, it's my dad who led the uncles back." Xu Haiqing hurried back to the house to report.
Su Anying came out of the kitchen with a shovel in her hand, and happened to meet Xu Shiyan, "How is it? Is the mallet okay?"
"Very good. Have you seen the sack that Xiao Ji is holding? There is a ginseng tree in it, which is not small.
Find a scale and try it later to see how heavy it is. We estimated on the mountain that the minimum was eight taels. "
Xu Shiyan glanced back and saw that Ji Tongzhong was still holding a sack in his arms, so he couldn't help laughing.
This guy is really, he was holding a sack all the way, for fear of losing the whole mallet.
"Huh? Is it that big? Can't it be, these were not too big seeds at the time?"
Su Anying was stunned when she heard it. According to this, the one that got up today is bigger than the ginseng king selected from the ginseng festival?
"Then who knows, it looks pretty good anyway.
I told Xiao Ji, wash it and throw it into a glass jar to soak in wine, and keep it as the treasure of the store, you see how beautiful he is. " Xu Shiyan laughed.
"By the way, didn't you say you want to keep the ginseng leaves for washing your hair? I brought back a bundle, what do you think of it?"
Ginseng leaves boiled in water, used to wash hair, black and smooth, the effect is very good.
There are several women in the family, and Su Anying keeps some ginseng leaves every year, tie them up and dry them in the shade, and keep them for shampooing.
In the past, a ginseng farm used ginseng leaves to extract ginsenosides, and Xu Shiyan led people to improve the technology.
However, the sales volume of this extracted ginsenoside is average, and the cost is particularly high. Compared with other products, the profit is too low.
Moreover, a lot of flammable and explosive solvents are needed in the operation process, which is harmful to the human body and dangerous.
In the later stage, when the sales volume of other products participating in the exhibition increased, this item was suspended.
There are so many high-profit orders that no one is doing. Who would waste manpower and material resources on this kind of project?
Therefore, the ginseng leaves will not be collected once every two years.
Xu Shiyan only brought back a large bundle, and reserved it for Su Anying and her mother and daughter to wash their hair.
