"Oh, let's put it outside first, I'll tie it up and put it in the barn to dry in the shade tomorrow morning.
Well, hurry up and tell everyone to wash their hands, and go into the house to rest for a while and wait for dinner. "
Su Anying was thinking about the dishes in the kitchen, and turned around to go back to work.
Xu Shiyan called everyone into the house, washed his hands and face, and then went in and sat down to smoke a cigarette.
Over there, Xu Jinping hurriedly made a pot of tea and brought it over, and also brought a lot of fruit and so on. There are many fruit trees in the house, so there are quite a lot of delicious food at this time.
"Uncle, grandpa, let's eat fruit. These are the grapes I just cut. Those are our sand fruit and fragrant pear. They are all delicious."
"Hey, you have to be a girl, look at it, how careful is this, it's tea and fruit, how considerate?"
Yang Junxian looked at Xu Jinping, very surprised, and praised repeatedly.
Xu Jinping smiled, turned and went to Westinghouse.
Not long after, the meals were ready and brought to the house.
Today, there are so many people that one table cannot be arranged, so one table is on the kang and the other is on the ground, and the east room is reserved for men.
Zhou Guilan and others led the children to Westinghouse to eat.
The Xu family prepared a sumptuous meal. Everyone was tired and hungry after a busy day, and no one was polite. They ate and drank as much as they wanted.
Su Anying eats fast over there, and after finishing eating, she thinks of that ginseng tree.
So I quickly found a scale, and when I weighed it, the weight of this ginseng was about two or three.
"Shiyan, that tree is 823." Su Anying specifically told Xu Shiyan.
When the people in Dongwu heard this, they were very happy, and panicked for Xu Shiyan's pity.
This is the real king of ginseng, more than eight taels, if it is left a few days ago, it can really sell for a good price.
Ji Tongzhong was even happier. This ginseng tree must not be sold, as the second brother-in-law said, keep it as the treasure of the town store.
Su Anying had nothing to do, so she soaked the ginseng tree in the water and scrubbed it carefully with a small brush.
Don't say it, it looks even more beautiful with this brush.
"Fourth sister, take it away later, go back and soak it in the glass jar in the store.
Your brother-in-law said, we will not sell this ginseng tree, but keep it as a signboard, the treasure of the store. "
After cleaning up, Su Anying put the ginseng in a basin and handed it to Su Anfen.
"Hey, I see, Second Sister." Su Anfen was also overjoyed when she glanced at the ginseng tree.
Such a big ginseng tree will look bigger when soaked in a glass jar. This is a veritable ginseng king.
The old customers who came to grab the goods saw it, and they didn't know how to like it.
Zhou Guilan and the others have never seen such a big ginseng, and they all look at it very strangely.
Not to mention Xu Haiyuan's little ones, they all wandered around the basin.
Xu Haiqing wanted to touch it, but Xu Jinping slapped it away.
"Just look at it, don't slack your claws, if you knock off the beard on it, it will run away.
Didn't you hear from our mother that this ginseng tree is going to be put in Shanhuozhuang as the treasure of the store? How did it break? "
Little boy, his hands are too short, neither light nor heavy.
"What's the matter? Don't you want to return the goods next year? There must be bigger ones by then.
Returning the treasure of the town store, I think we will build a bigger one next year, which one is the treasure? "
It is said that seven and eight years old are hated by dogs. Seven-year-old Xu Haiqing not only acts, but also speaks more slippery than before, talking quite annoying.
"That's all treasure, what's wrong? Where do you come from so much nonsense?
If you are not allowed to move, you can just calm down. You have to find something wrong and let someone beat you, right? "
Xu Jinping was annoyed by this impoverished and owed younger brother, so she waited for him with a hard look.
My sister got angry, and Xu Haiqing fell silent immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 619: labor exercise
chapters.content:
Chapter 619 Labor Exercise
After eating at Xu's house, everyone chatted for a while. After seven o'clock, those who were supposed to be on duty in the processing factory went on duty, and those who were supposed to go home also went home.
The next day Xu Shiyan went back to work as usual, and Su Anying brought people to make goods in the processing factory.
In addition to the relatives of each family, the processing factory also recruited a lot of people this year.
Recruiting people is actually very simple nowadays. Qilu and other places have a lot of people going to the Northeast due to various reasons.
Like the workers on the farm, most of the few people who came to the farm came from there.
These people made money in the Northeast, and some went back and talked about their wives, so they brought their wives with them.
Some wrote letters to introduce their brothers and relatives.
The fertilizer factory next door to the processing factory, the town has arranged for Yang Junxian to be the secretary and director of the factory.
In addition, a cashier, an accountant, and a custodian were arranged for them, and these are considered to have formal staffing.
Other workers, a small part were recruited from the villages under Donggang.
The kind of family that has more brothers but less land and clubs can earn more money by working than farming.
Most of them are foreigners recruited.
These people from other places are all strong and capable, and they don’t grow land or ginseng at home, and they don’t need to ask for leave to go back to work during the busy farming season.
There are canteens and dormitories in the factory. Singles can take care of food and housing, and those with families can help rent a house and arrange accommodation.
The conditions are much better than their hometown, so it is easy to recruit workers.
The processing factory can be regarded as having a good time with the neighbors. Those who married their wives, some even brought their wives.
These little daughters-in-law are old and capable, and they can't stay idle at all, so they can just work in the processing factory.
The manpower is sufficient, and the processing plant has added several ginseng brushing machines this year.
In addition to the clubs of various companies, Su Anying wandered around the ginseng market all day long, buying fresh ginseng.
Sometimes, they will go to other towns, even Jingyu, Changbai, Antu and other places to collect fresh ginseng and process it.
The goods are received and processed here, and the goods are sent to the south immediately after drying.
This year, the orders from southern customers are not small, so the processing factory is also working overtime, and they are very busy.
Donggang Primary School, I told Xu Shiyan before, asking Xu Shiyan to help find a southern customer and sell the goods directly.
Xu Shiyan remembered this incident. Just during the Ginseng Festival, Su Anying chatted well with a Hong Kong businessman and signed a large order with him.
The other party entrusted Su Anying to purchase and process here, and then ship it directly. Su Anying did the math, and the profit was very large.
So I discussed with Principal Gao and the two sides cooperated.
The five-hundred-foot ginseng from Donggang Primary School was handed over to the processing factory for processing, and after processing, it was sent to Hong Kong businessmen, and the profits were shared equally by both parties.
Principal Gao calculated that the profit would be much higher than selling locally.
If this is the case, not only the teachers will get a share, but the school will also be able to leave funds for the repair of the school building.
So he readily agreed, and the two parties happily signed the agreement.
"Well, this Sunday, our classmates will go up the mountain for labor exercise.
Go home and tell your parents to change into a set of old clothes on Sundays, and those who have water boots are best to wear water boots.
If you don’t have one, you can also wear work shoes, the main thing is that the upper of the shoe should be higher, and you don’t need to pour soil into the shoes.
In addition, everyone should bring rice. It is best to bring dry food and pickles. Don’t bring soup and water, because you can’t get it on the mountain. "
The last class on Saturday morning, the head teacher of the four classes of the sixth grade told the children like this.
"Do you remember everything? You must remember to tell your family when you get home.
There is no class this afternoon, so remember to do your homework, and you must complete all your homework.
You are going to take the graduation exam next year. This is related to whether you can go to junior high school. You must pay attention to it, understand? "
Nowadays, it is not nine-year compulsory education. There is also an examination for entry from elementary school to junior high school.
In order to prepare for the junior high school, the school is also very hard-working. The sixth grade teacher is very busy studying all day long.
What the teacher talks about all day long is homework.
Donggang Elementary School has a total of 500 feet of sticks. It’s the end of September now, and there will be no more sticks.
But the teachers usually have to teach and go to work, so they can only catch up on Sunday.
How many teachers are there in primary school? With five hundred feet of sticks, I can't be busy even if I go there, so I can only ask the students to follow me to work.
Most of the sixth graders are thirteen or fourteen years old. They are older children. Nowadays, children are not delicate and have to do everything.
They are the ones who plant the land in spring, shovel the land in summer, and harvest the land in autumn. At least they can pick up sticks, so what’s the point? Must work.
"Got it, finish your homework this afternoon." The children shouted in unison.
Just like that, when the school bell rang, the children rushed out of the school with their schoolbags on their backs and ran home.
Xu Haiyuan gathered Huang Shuqing, Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu, Xu Jingyi, Xu Jingwen and others. This group of a dozen or so children rushed out of the school, shouting and running home.
"Grandma, tomorrow we will have a club at school, and the teacher said that we all have to go to the mountains to work.
Bring me some rice tomorrow morning, preferably dry food or something. "Xu Haiyuan said to Zhou Guilan as soon as he entered the door.
"Oh, you guys have to go up to the mountain to participate tomorrow?
Okay, what meal do you want to bring? Do I give you pancakes, steamed buns, or pancake rolls? "
Zhou Guilan didn't have any opinion on this, even in these years, parents are used to it.
The only thing the old lady cares about is what to bring for her grandson to go up the mountain?
The weather is cold at this time, and there is probably no place for hot meals on the mountain. It is probably not easy for children to eat something warm.
"Otherwise, go to the store across the street and buy you bread, cakes, and canned luncheon meat? Can those things satisfy hunger?"
"Huh? I remembered, there is your dad's insulated lunch box at home.
Well, let me bring you rice and meat, it’s also convenient. "
The old lady suddenly remembered that there was something at home.
The insulated lunch box is quite big, the outside is made of aluminum, the inner layer is made of plastic, and the insulation layer is sandwiched in the middle.
The lunch box is divided into two parts, one end can hold hot water, and the other end can hold rice and vegetables.
Put the rice and vegetables in while they are still hot, fill with freshly boiled hot water, and close the insulated lunch box.
It will not be cold at noon, and the children can eat some warm meals.
"Grandma, you can bring whatever you want, I will eat it."
Xu Haiyuan almost confused his grandma, how would he know what to bring?
Anyway, he is not picky, he can eat whatever he gives, how can there be so many things?
"Okay, then the milk will know what to do for you, don't worry, I will keep it for you to eat well."
Zhou Guilan had already calculated what to bring to her grandson, so she happily went to prepare food.
This old lady simply regarded her grandson's going to work as a picnic.
Xu Haiyuan looked at grandma's back and scratched his head, feeling that something was wrong, but he couldn't tell.
Well, don’t think about it, let’s wash our hands and eat quickly.
The teacher left a bunch of homework. After finishing the homework in the afternoon, I have to go to the mountain to work tomorrow.
"Brother, I also want to go up the mountain and play with a stick."
At the other end, Xu Haiqing leaned over again, looking at Xu Haiyuan eagerly.
"Go to the other side for me, I am a labor of the school, not our family.
What's the matter with me taking you there? The teacher can't let it either.
Don't worry, when you go to elementary school next year, there will be plenty of opportunities for off-campus labor.
As long as you are lazy, just don't cry and shout that you don't want to go. "Xu Haiyuan was speechless by his younger brother.

chapters.title: Chapter 620: Participation from primary school
chapters.content:
Chapter 620 Participation from primary school
In order to bring his grandson up the mountain to bring food, Zhou Guilan went to the butcher stall in the opposite market, bought a piece of pork belly, and made braised pork back.
On the morning of September 18th, the old lady got up early, stewed potatoes with braised pork, and stewed a pot of fragrant rice.
Put the meat and vegetables out of the pan while they are still hot, and put them in an insulated lunch box.
Fill the other side with boiling water, tighten the lid of the water bottle, and fasten the insulated lunch box.
There is a special cloth cover on the outside of the insulated lunch box, which is similar to a schoolbag and can be carried on the back.
The old lady pondered for a while, and fried some small dried fish with a ladle.
The fried ones are fragrant and crispy, with a little bit of dried chili, and then cooked with vinegar, the room is full of aroma.
The small dried fish is fried, put it in a small canned bottle, and stuff it into the pocket outside the cloth cover of the insulated lunch box, which is just right.
Xu Haiyuan also packed up after dinner, so he took the lunch box carefully prepared by his grandma, slung his shoulders on his back, and was about to leave.
"Wait a while, let's decorate some shaguo, eat it when you're tired from work.
Do you want some biscuits at home? Bring you something? "
Zhou Guilan grabbed two more handfuls of fruit from the basket, stuffed them in his grandson's pocket, and wanted to get another bag of biscuits for his grandson.
"Grandma, no need, I'm going to work, not to go for an autumn outing.
Don't bring me so much food, my classmates will laugh at me. "Xu Haiyuan waved his hands and ran away in fright.
Zhou Guilan held the biscuit, watched her eldest grandson disappear in a flash, and shook her head.
"My child, what's the point of bringing more food? No one wants it yet.
For such a big child, the stomach is like a bottomless pit. How can one meal at noon be enough? "
"Grandma, my brother doesn't want it, just give me the biscuit."
On the other end, Xu Haiqing jumped out, salivating and asking grandma for biscuits.
"I just finished eating, and it hasn't even been ten minutes yet, you want biscuits again?
伱 If you are not full, go back to the house and eat. If you're full, what do you want biscuits for? "
Behind Xu Haiqing, his sister Xu Jinping folded her arms, looked at the back of his head with cold eyes, and said coldly.
"Uh, I'm not full, I'll go back to the house and eat something."
Xu Haiqing shrank her neck in fright, turned around and went back to the room to eat another bowl of rice.
"The rice this morning is really delicious, and the braised pork and stewed potatoes are also very fragrant.
Grandma, where did the rice crust go? Keep it for me, I will eat it during the day. "
Xu Haiqing touched his chubby belly and said contentedly.
Xu Jinping rolled her eyes, but at least she restrained herself from scolding her younger brother.
"After eating, hurry up to study, have you written all the Chinese characters and pinyin I left for you yesterday?
Let me tell you, if you don’t finish writing, don’t even think about going out to play today. "
"Oh, can't I go and write? Write, write, let me write all day long."
Xu Haiqing went to Westinghouse to do homework while muttering.
On the other side, Xu Haiyuan came out of home with a lunch box on his back, met Huang Shuqing and the others on the way, and went to school together.
Going to the school side, there are several cars parked at the gate.
That car was transferred by Su Anying from Guo Shouye.
The site of Donggang Elementary School is on the other side of Xiaoshan Village, on the way to Xinglong Township, it is more than 20 miles away from Donggang.
Usually, the teachers ride bicycles to work, but today they started to use the sticks. Five hundred feet of sticks are quite old. We can’t let the teachers bring them back by bicycles, right?
Principal Gao approached Su Anying, and asked Su Anying to help out with the car.
But the cars of Su Anying's company are all half-trunks. Even with a club and a child, those half-cars are not enough.
So I found Guo Shouye, transferred a few big cars from the Forestry Bureau, sent the children there in the morning, and picked them up in the afternoon.
There are four classes in the sixth grade. Each class gathers at 6:30 in the morning. After counting the number of students, the teacher takes the students out of the school and directly onto the bus.
No matter what year or month it is, people can sit in the back of the car.
Put down the rear compartment panel of the car and set up a springboard, and the group of thirteen and fourteen children jumped into the car.
A driver recognized Xu Haiyuan, and hurriedly yelled Xu Haiyuan to sit in the driving building in front.
Xu Haiyuan felt that he was not good at doing this special, so he rejected the driver's offer and sat in the back car with his classmates.
The students are all sitting in the cart, and the teacher is no exception. If these brats are not watched by the teacher, wouldn’t they go to heaven?
So except for Principal Gao, the Vice-Principal, and the dean, all the other teachers sat in the cart.
Fortunately, the school prepared a lot of sacks, which happened to be spread in the car.
The children sat directly on the sack, talking and laughing along the way, and they arrived at the place happily.
Before departure, the school has already assigned tasks. After arriving at the place, take the class as the unit, and each class is responsible for how many strings.
Male teachers basically hold a three-tooth planer, and strong female teachers also have to use a three-tooth planer.
The other female teachers led the boys to remove the ginseng shed and cut the leaves of the ginseng, and the girls followed the teacher to pick up sticks.
Anyway, most of the country children have work in their eyes, and no one dares to be lazy. They are all very serious about finding work.
Don't worry about what you say, even if it's a child, it's useful to have more people.
By noon, the five-hundred-foot stick had already been raised for the most part.
Not to mention, Donggang Elementary School's stick is pretty good, it can be of any size and figure, and it doesn't have much rust or rot.
Principal Gao spent the whole morning planing with a three-toothed stick, which made his back ache from exhaustion.
"It's noon, let the children rest and eat.
Oh, it’s not easy, I’m tired, so I take a break to have a meal, and then work again in the afternoon. "
The principal has spoken, who dare not listen?
Besides, this morning was really tiring, so the teachers put down their tools, and the children stopped their work.
Everyone gathered at the head of each pool, and took off their schoolbags from the stumps, branches, and pillars.
The schoolbag is naturally not books, but dry food.
"Don't eat it yet, there is a small river ditch over there, hurry up and wash your hands.
Look at your little hands, how dark it is, how can you eat without washing your hands? "
Over there, the teachers of each class saw it and hurriedly urged the children to wash their hands.
The children ran to Xiaohegou one after another, washed their hands, and then came back to open their schoolbags and take out the meals they brought.
"Xu Haiyuan, what kind of food did you bring? What is this?"
Those who were curious, saw Xu Haiyuan opened a rather strange box, so they came to ask.
"Oh, this is an insulated lunch box issued by my dad and his unit. My grandma asked me to bring it with me."
Xu Haiyuan opened the lid of the insulated lunch box while talking.
Inside are two small aluminum lunch boxes stacked together, with vegetables on top and rice on the bottom.
Whether it is vegetables or rice, they are all hot.
The water in the plastic bottle next to it is also hot.
Open the lunch box above, there is braised pork and stewed potatoes inside, but compared with what I ate in the morning, there is more meat and less potatoes.
It’s September, and it’s really not too warm on the mountain. It’s good to be able to eat hot meals.
Xu Haiyuan was also tired and hungry this morning, so what are you talking about, just bow your head and eat.
"Oh, you also brought braised pork, that's great."
Someone next to him saw it, and his mouth was almost drooling.

chapters.title: Chapter 621: To work is to be able to eat
chapters.content:
Chapter 621 To work is to be able to eat
Xu Haiyuan looked at the envious eyes of his classmates, and hesitated a little in his heart, whether to share the meat with the classmates.
But the lunch box itself is not too big, and there is not much left for him to eat the meat.
And there are so many students in the class, who will he eat or not?
Just as Xu Haiyuan was hesitating, the class teacher at the other end spoke.
"Students, sit down by yourself, eat the meals you brought, and don't be curious about others."
When the teacher said this, no one was curious anymore, and they all ate with their heads down.
Xu Haiyuan doesn't have to worry about it anymore, he can eat while it's hot, let's feed himself first.
Everyone brings food, don’t worry about good or bad, it’s no problem to eat enough.
Probably due to hunger, Xu Haiyuan ate a lot of this meal, the rice, braised pork and potatoes were all eaten up, and the fried fish was half eaten.
A child of this age can already eat, but if he is a little tired from working in the mountains, he will be like a rice bucket.
Xu Haiyuan just picked up the water bottle after finishing his meal, and gulped down half of the water.
This time, I finally feel comfortable in my stomach.
The child eats quickly, and finishes eating in a short time, then rests for a while, and starts to work.
It was more than three o'clock in the afternoon and less than four o'clock, and finally the hammer was finished.
Didn't care to stop him, the male teacher hurriedly started carrying the sack outside.
Half of the students stayed here, and half of them went out carrying tools and plastic sheets to look outside.
"Oh, I finished all the lunch I brought, why do I feel hungry again now?"
While walking outside, someone was muttering.
Xu Haiyuan also felt that his stomach was empty again.
Oh, I should have brought biscuits if I knew it earlier, what should I do if I am hungry now?
Xu Haiyuan carried a few tridents on his shoulders, and reached out to touch his pocket.
Suddenly, I found that there was still something in my pocket, which was the Shaguo stuffed by my grandma in the morning.
All right, don’t worry about anything, as long as you have something to eat.
So he took out a sand fruit and gnawed it while walking.
How big can a fruit be? After two or three mouthfuls, it all went into the mouth.
"Xu Haiyuan, what do you eat?" Someone next to him saw it and asked.
"Sha Guo, when I came out of the house in the morning, my milk was stuffed in my pocket. Do you want to?"
Xu Haiyuan touched his pocket and took out three more.
"Yes, I'm starving to death, I can eat whatever I have." The other party reached out and took one.
The boy next to him saw it and came over to take one, leaving the last one for Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan was not polite, he ate the last one again, and then went to the side of the road with the tools to wait for the car.
After a while, the big bus came, and the male teachers also poured out the clubs one after another to load the car.
Everything is installed, and nothing is left behind, and the children have counted the number of people, and then they get in the car and go back.
Five hundred feet of sticks, a total of more than one hundred and forty sacks were produced, and this output is still acceptable.
Thanks to the large number of vehicles, several large vehicles were loaded with sacks and filled with people, and they were pulled all the way back to Donggang.
Principal Gao made an agreement with Su Anying to send it directly to the processing factory for on-site weighing.
Scale on one side, keep accounts on the other end, and finally add up the total.
After removing the skin, there are about 14,000 catties left, and the average yield is about 28 catties per zhang.
is not bad, compared to before, the output is good.
After all, this is all done by the teachers on Sunday, so it can't be as meticulous as a regular accountant.
After the on-site weighing, all the sacks were written and marked with black pen.
It happens that the previous goods have been processed, the warehouse is empty, and there will be no confusion.
"Principal Gao, don't worry, I will lead people to start processing these goods tomorrow, and try to process them as soon as possible."
With such a large quantity, you really have to hurry up, otherwise the mallet will take too long to return to the pulp, and the product will not be good.
Thanks to the large number of manpower and machines this year, we should be able to drive them out.
"Manager Su, I have caused you trouble.
Oh, I really appreciate you and my wife.
If it weren’t for the help of your husband and wife, you said that even if we planted these five hundred feet of sticks, wouldn’t we worry about processing and making goods for takeaway? "
Principal Gao couldn't be more grateful.
At the beginning, I was looking at the ginseng market so that I could make money. The big guys didn’t care about anything else, and raised money to invest in planting clubs in the field.
But who wants to follow up with so many troublesome things.
If there is no processing factory here, what will happen to the sticks they make? Can the whole school be suspended for processing? It is estimated that only fresh ginseng can be sold.
In that case, earning money is earning, but you can’t earn that much.
After deducting the teachers' dividends, how much is left? How do you repair the school building?
"Principal Gao is polite, this is what we should do.
Principal Gao is dedicated to children and education. This sentiment is admirable.
As long as we can help, we will definitely not refuse. "
Everyone can talk about the scene, and Principal Gao has indeed done a good job.
After the handover was completed, it was agreed that the school would arrange teachers who were not in class to come over to help with processing the next day.
If you are too busy, I will transfer the fifth grade children to work for a few days, and try to finish the goods as soon as possible.
Principal Gao watched Daku lock the big lock with his own eyes, and then led the teachers away with confidence.
As for the children, they got off the car at the tomb of the martyrs and went home.
"Grandma, is the meal ready? I'm starving to death."
Xu Haiyuan, who made a mistake in judgment, entered the door crying and looking for grandma.
"It will be ready soon, there are cakes and biscuits in the room, let's take a bite first.
I told you in the morning, bring more food, but you didn’t listen, how are you doing? Are you hungry? "
When Zhou Guilan heard the news of her grandson, hey, my heart hurts.
Thanks to the fact that she went to the store to buy some food during the day, she knew that the stomachs of these brats were like bottomless pits, and they would scream out of hunger when they came back.
"Old Xu, quickly find something to eat for your grandson, it's in the cabinet.
I'll cook quickly. When Yingzi comes back, we'll have dinner. "Zhou Guilan yelled towards the east room.
Xu Chenghou heard it in the room, and went to the cabinet to find something delicious to feed his grandson.
"Are you hungry? Oh, your milk is for you in the morning, why don't you want it?
Your grandma is so old, how can you still not know? You are the fastest hungry now. "
The old man was talking while taking food out.
"When your father and your uncle were your age, ouch, the family didn't have enough food all day long.
How could these things be available at that time? All eat big pancakes.
Your fourth uncle is studying, and he can run home to dust off some pancakes in the middle.
At that time, he was shopping, and several pancakes were rolled together, with scallions inside and miso.
Turning around, I went out and told people that the pancakes baked by your grandma are so thick.
We all know that your milkmanship is good, besides, who can't see that there are several pictures? "
Xu Chenghou laughed and talked about the past.
"Our family is still doing well, you didn't hear your aunt say, her grandma Xue.
Oops, in order to prevent the children from stealing dry food, they put dry food in baskets and hung them on the beams of the house, and all the cabinets at home were locked.
Even though your aunt is from a worker’s family, she can’t keep up with our rural areas, and she doesn’t have enough to eat. "
This kind of situation was too common at that time, and there was not enough food to eat, so people had to save food and money.

chapters.title: Chapter 622: want to go to yangcheng
chapters.content:
Chapter 622 Want to go to Yangcheng
On Monday, the primary school really sent the fifth grade students to two classes to help with the work.
The children are young, and they can't do the work of brushing the water, so they can only do some odd jobs.
Help with soaking fresh ginseng, loading ingredients, scraping water and rust, putting forks out of the pot, etc. Anyway, it can help a lot.
On Tuesday, I changed two classes.
They rotate like this, at least the 10,000 catties of fresh ginseng are washed, steamed, and placed on the fork, so that the children don't need to come over later.
Autumn is so busy, Su Anying's small processing factory is like this, not to mention the other side of the field, it is so busy that everyone almost can't take care of eating.
One participant has produced 40,000 feet of goods this year, plus the more than 30,000 feet of Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, these are not a lot.
The processing plant had to be busy from the beginning of September until almost November before it could breathe a sigh of relief.
In mid-October, the seeds in the ground should be planted.
There are 2,000 feet on the Liumao River for everyone to use, and the remaining 8,000 feet are to be let out for takeaway.
The ginseng market is still very good this year, and the price of ginseng seeds has also risen. One foot of ginseng seeds is more than 100 yuan higher than last year.
The ginseng field in Liumaohe is good and big, so the price is definitely not low.
But the number of people who came to buy ginseng seeds this year is not as many as last year.
The main reason is that the seeds are too large, and the cost of planting is also high.
Many people are reluctant and want to buy something smaller, which costs less.
Fortunately, there were only eight thousand feet, and they were all sold in the end.
Five hundred yuan is one zhang, and the eight thousand zhang alone was sold for four million yuan. After deducting taxes and various expenses, there are still more than three million yuan left.
The ginseng land in Liumao River was calculated, and the ginseng seeds alone sold for tens of millions.
After deducting all kinds of miscellaneous and miscellaneous items, there are still nearly nine million left, which is too much money.
"Sister-in-law, if we didn't sell the 20,000 zhang to the takeaway, if we sprinkled all the seeds, we would have to earn money."
Zhao Jianshe and others were so happy that they could hardly find the north, and kept yelling there.
"Go ahead and dream, those ginseng seeds were bought from several participants begging grandpa and grandma.
We found a lot of ginseng seeds given by students.
Are you still thinking about throwing all the seeds at 50,000 zhang? how is this possible? You can't do it even if you are exhausted. "
Huang Shengli glanced at Zhao Jianshe, deliberately **** him off.
"You are content, our crop of ginseng seeds can last for three years.
I reckon next year the seeds will grow as thick as a thumb.
If it is planted in the ground with enough fertilizer and water, how big will the sticks be after three years? Then you can make some money.
伱 It’s beautiful, if it’s not our third brother and third sister-in-law, we won’t be able to earn this kind of money in this life. "Feng Chao also said over there.
Zhao Jianshe is not annoyed when he is told, he will be happy, "Then I just think about it?"
Eight thousand zhang seeds are sold, and it's time for every family to plant ginseng.
Nowadays everyone is busy, how can I have the time to work slowly? Simply hire someone.
Anyway, at this time, those who planted less ginseng have finished their work and have a spare labor force.
So they hired people to go up the mountain, and in one day they got up a hundred feet of ginseng seeds, and they went home and hired people to pick them.
"Shiyan, isn't our seed too big? It costs a lot to plant such a big seed."
Su Anying led someone to pick the seeds for a day, and when Xu Shiyan came back in the evening, she talked to Xu Shiyan.
"It doesn't matter, daughter-in-law, you listen to me, we can plant as many seeds as we can, and only eight to ten trees per centimeter are planted.
Food and water will keep up, and there will be more big goods at that time. Even if there is any change in the market, we will not be afraid. "
It was planted in the field in 1988, and it should normally start in 1991.
According to the rules of the previous life, the market of sticks and hammers was not very good at that time, but it has not yet reached the bottom.
Xu Shiyan's meaning is to plant big seeds and strengthen fertilizer and water management. Even if the market is bad, the price of big goods is still not low.
"As for the high cost you said, how much cost do we have to plant now?
Ginseng soil and seeds are all earned, so what is the cost? " Xu Shiyan laughed.
Every year, just selling ginseng soil can earn one hundred and eighty thousand.
Not to mention these ginseng seeds, they have earned millions of dollars. No matter how much they can sell for three years later, these ginseng seeds are all for nothing, so who cares?
It’s better to use big seeds to go to the ground. When the time comes, they will all produce big goods and sell for more money.
When Su Anying thought about it, it was also the same reason, "Well, I listen to you, and you can do whatever you say."
Just like that, the next day Su Anying led people up the mountain to plant sticks.
Su Anying remembered Xu Shiyan's instructions. When planting ginseng, the system was changed. Originally, it was planted with sixteen centimeters per foot, which means sixteen lines, but now it was changed to twelve centimeters.
One cent changed from the original twelve to ten or eight.
The workers don't care about those, they will do whatever the boss says.
Besides, these people are not stupid, just look at the size of the seed.
Such a large seed must be given enough room to grow, otherwise the nutrition will not be enough to grow.
Su Anying led the people, planted ginseng for two days, and then sowed 30 feet of ginseng seeds. This year's work is basically the same.
This year's ginseng site is still in the machine repair factory. This area has been in operation for three years. Both brothers Li Daniu and Li Erniu lead people to look at the ginseng.
Su Anying told Li Daniu to ask them to find a few more people from their relatives to come up to see the ginseng.
If you can't find it, Su Anying will find a way.
Which family doesn’t have many relatives?
The brothers of the Li family agreed without saying a word, and then told their daughter-in-law that they should go back to their natal family to find someone, and they should be young and strong to work and have a good character.
Looking at ginseng on the mountain can make money, and when spring and summer are not busy, you can dig some medicinal materials and gather some wild vegetables.
When you participate in autumn, you can also block sticks and seeds, and in winter, you can also take out jobs such as smashing pillars, making sheds, and making curtains, all of which make a lot of money.
After all, not everyone has the ability to plant a lot of sticks.
Furthermore, some places are not suitable for planting ginseng, so how much money can you earn by farming? It's better to come and see the ginseng.
The natal families of the two daughters-in-laws of the Li family had suitable people, so it was really useless for Su Anying to bother, so they found all the people.
The mallets are planted in the ground, and the goods from the processing factory have already been shipped out as ordered by customers in the south.
Su Anying received a lot of goods this year, and she planned to take the remaining goods to Yangcheng.
"The Hong Kong businessman who did business with us said that there are many merchants in the ginseng business there, but the supply channels are not good enough and the quantity is not enough.
I plan to bring a batch of goods to try. If the market is not good, sell these and come back.
If the market is okay, let the fourth sister and the others hurry up and deliver the goods. "Su Anying discussed with Xu Shiyan.
"You take the goods to Yangcheng to do business with Hong Kong companies? Can you do it?
Daughter-in-law, your ginseng has not been sold by others, and you have run away. "Xu Shiyan deliberately joked with his wife.
However, his daughter-in-law is really getting better and better, and she still thinks of going to Yangcheng to sell goods?
In her previous life, this was the job of sister-in-law Xue Xiulin.
At that time, the efficiency of the lumber factory was not very good. Xue Xiulin went to Yangcheng to sell goods in partnership with others. Xu Shixian grabbed the goods at home and delivered them. The couple earned a lot of money.
But Xu Shiyan never mentioned this, he didn't know how his wife thought of it.
"You don't give me poor, and I didn't go by myself. Yufeng, Shengli's daughter-in-law, and Feng Chao's daughter-in-law were all with me.
The few of us go to sell goods, and we always have a companion no matter where we go. "
Su Anying gave Xu Shiyan a blank look, this man is always out of shape.

chapters.title: Chapter 623: Yangcheng sells goods
chapters.content:
Chapter 623 Yangcheng sells goods
Su Anying decided to take people and goods out for a venture, but Xu Shiyan didn't have much objection to this.
This is the only way for Fusong ginseng to go to the outside world. Without Su Anying, there will be others.
Or it can be said that whoever goes out first is the first person to eat crabs.
Definitely make money, and you can make a lot of money.
Xu Shiyan felt that it was right for Su Anying to go out.
If this step goes well, with their foundation as husband and wife, they will be able to do a lot of great things in the future.
Although Xu Shiyan has been calling for deep processing of products, this is a very long road of development.
One participant currently has limited ability, so if he can work and sell the ginseng from this field and brother units, it is already very powerful.
How much ginseng is produced in the county? With such a large output, it is impossible to keep all of them for further processing, and most of them must be sold.
Since most of them are still sold in the form of primary products, who doesn't want to sell them at a high price?
Su Anying has this channel and ability, why not go to Yangcheng? So Xu Shiyan is very supportive of his wife's approach.
Xu Shiyan has no objection. As for the old couple of the Xu family, although they still have some worries in their hearts, they can't say anything else.
They were mainly worried that if they were dazzled by the flamboyant world in Yangcheng, a few women would go there, what merchant would they follow?
But there is no way to say that, the old couple can only say a few words in private.
At the beginning of November, Su Anying packed more than 10,000 catties of red goods stored in the processing factory and shipped them to Yangcheng by railway.
Su Anying and Yang Junxian’s daughter-in-law Ji Yufeng, Huang Shengli’s daughter-in-law Yu Lihua, Zhao Jianshe’s daughter-in-law Li Chunlan, Yang Chunming’s daughter-in-law Hu Yanqiu, Sun Xiaofeng’s daughter-in-law Dong Yuehong, Feng Chao’s daughter-in-law Song Yuping, and Han Limin’s daughter-in-law Liu Chunhua.
Several people took the train from Songjianghe to the provincial capital, and then flew from the provincial capital to Yangcheng.
People come first, goods last.
Before Su Anying came, she had contacted Hong Kong businessmen and asked Xu Shiyan a lot.
Xu Shiyan remembered a place he had heard of in his previous life, Fengan Hotel.
There is a concentration of ginseng merchants in the Northeast, and almost all those who go to Yangcheng to sell goods live there.
And those merchants also went directly to grab the goods.
Xu Shiyan didn't know if this hotel exists now, but he gave Su Anying a suggestion, that he could find a place to live there.
Su Anying took Ji Yufeng and the others to Yangcheng, and inquired about it through people.
Not to mention, there really is such a place, so I went to live there.
The hotel is very new and in good condition. The proprietress is very nice and very polite.
Su Anying and the others are the first batch of Northeast people who came to sell goods, and they are also a few women.
The proprietress took care of everything, and even vacated a warehouse in the backyard, saying that it would be used as a warehouse for Su Anying and the others.
Even if Su Anying and the others have settled down, in a few days, they will go to the train station to pick up the goods, hire a car to transport them to the hotel, and then call the previous Hong Kong businessman.
Not to mention, the other party was pretty awesome, brought a few over, and sold thousands of catties of dry goods on the first day.
The price is much higher than the previous purchase for southern customers, almost double the price of local ginseng in Fusong.
Seeing this, Su Anying knew that she was on the right track this time.
So he called back immediately and asked Xu Shiyan to arrange someone to quickly grab the goods and deliver them to Yangcheng.
It's winter, Huang Shengli and others are not so busy, and there is a lot of money in the company account.
So Huang Shengli and others acted immediately and began to buy dry goods everywhere.
Don’t think about these places near Donggang, most of them have completed transactions in Canshi.
So Huang Shengli and the others drove to a farther place.
Quanyang, Lushui, Wanliang, Beigang, Pumping, Yushu, these towns in this county are nothing to worry about.
Even Jingyu, Changbai, Antu, and even Ji'an, Huanren, Kuandian and other counties, these people just drove there.
After all, there are more people and more strength, and they have cars, so they drive everywhere, which is convenient, and they quickly collected more than 10,000 catties of dry goods.
Huang Shengli and others received the goods outside, and the relatives of each family led people to pick the heads and grades in the processing factory.
Then pack it up, and if you save enough once, it will be shipped directly.
Originally, the processing factory would not be active at the end of October, and those female workers would go home for winter, so there would be something else to do.
The daily wages are not low. Those female workers come to work every morning and go home with cash in the evening.
Everyone is beautiful, I wish I could be like this every day.
In the blink of an eye, Su Anying and the others had been out for almost two months, and Xu Haiyuan's brothers and sisters also ushered in the final exam.
"Sigh, this Yingzi has been away for almost two months, and she doesn't know when she will be back.
In my opinion, this Gregorian calendar year is probably enough to come back. "
Zhou Guilan made sticky rice at home, and she planned to wrap some sticky fire spoons or something.
Children love to eat, and Xu Haiqing talks about when to make it all day long.
The old lady was entangled to no avail, so she planned to soak thirty or forty catties of rice and wrap some for the children to satisfy their hunger.
"You don't have to think about the Gregorian calendar year. It's good to come back before the new year."
Xu Chenghou sat on the kang, smoking a pipe while answering the conversation.
"Didn't you listen to what your son said? Yingzi and the others seem to have made a lot of money this time.
Shengli and the others have delivered three shipments in a row, weighing tens of thousands of catties.
The last batch of goods seems to have been shipped only a few days ago, right? I don't know if it will continue there or not.
I have to wait until the last batch of goods are sold out before I can come back. "
"Back when Yingzi brought the goods to Yangcheng, we were quite worried. We were afraid that she would go there in a false manner, and people would deceive me if she didn't know anything, and we were afraid that the goods there would not be easy to sell.
The results of it? Good guy, the delivery of tens of thousands of catties, and this year's earning a lot, really works. "
Mentioning this daughter-in-law, Zhou Guilan really likes it, she can do everything, and she can catch people outside the house.
When I was looking for a partner for my son, I failed to introduce this, because people thought the third child was incompetent.
Introducing that one is not enough, people think that the third child is too honest.
It was not easy for someone to introduce the second daughter of the Su family. Zhou Guilan was actually not very satisfied at the time.
The main reason is that Su Anying lost her mother when she was a child. It was rumored outside that the second girl of the Su family was determined to restrain her relatives.
He lost his mother not long after he was born. There are six sisters in the family and no brother.
Then Zhou Guilan couldn't help her to pick and choose. It would be nice for her son to be a daughter-in-law.
Looking at each other later, seeing that the girl doesn't talk much, she will work with a smile.
Zhou Guilan thought it was okay, anyway, marrying a daughter-in-law doesn't require so much, as long as she can live with the third child wholeheartedly.
Who would have thought that after the couple got married, life would be different day by day.
Up to now, there are companies, farms, and processing plants, and the family takes advantage of several million.
This life let them live, no one can compare.
"The third child is also, he is too busy to see him all day long, you said he often calls Yingzi or something.
I can’t go over there to accompany her, so it’s okay to make a phone call and ask questions. "
While working, Zhou Guilan muttered, thinking that her son was too incompetent to coax his daughter-in-law.
"Mom, why are you talking about me again? My ears are red and hot."
Just in time, Xu Shiyan pushed the door in and asked Zhou Guilan with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 624: Hunjiang Oriental Ginseng Company
chapters.content:
Chapter 624 Hunjiang Oriental Ginseng Company
"What time is it? Why did you come back at this time? Is the work not busy today? No need to work overtime?"
Zhou Guilan glanced at the wall. It's not yet four o'clock in the afternoon. Why did my son come back?
For a while, the third child didn’t get home until after eight o’clock every night.
It is said that a lot of things in the unit are busy, and they work overtime every day. What's going on today?
"Busy, is the unit still busy?
I work overtime until midnight every day, and that's the case. "Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard that.
Can you not be busy? This year, the number of orders for participating in the show has increased a lot.
On the ginseng festival alone, there are orders of nearly 100 million yuan. In addition to the orders of the Spring Fair, old customers add more orders.
This year, the sticks from the Yichang Farm and the Forestry Bureau were not sold to the province at all. They were all processed by themselves and kept for export.
The factory building at the pharmaceutical factory has not yet been completed, but workers have been recruited in advance.
The job recruitment notice posted at the beginning of winter recruited 200 people from among the unemployed young people participating.
Through the help of the above, I was sent to several large pharmaceutical factories as apprentices, and the pre-job training was carried out first.
Waiting for the pharmaceutical factory to be completed and put into operation, these are skilled jobs, and you can directly lead apprentices.
The pharmaceutical factory is still unable to start production, and all kinds of orders are placed on the comprehensive factory. The workers there are now working in three shifts, and many temporary workers are hired to work.
Fortunately, it is winter, and labor is easy.
It’s winter in the agricultural industry, and I have nothing to do in winter, so I come out to find a temporary worker to work or something, and earn some money to supplement the family.
"The unit is so busy, why did you come back early? Let the leader know, how bad is it?"
Xu Chenghou also felt strange, his son is not the kind of person who spends his days and doesn't do business, why did he come back so early today?
Xu Shiyan sat down on the edge of the Kang with a smile, "Father, I have something nice to tell you."
Xu Shiyan didn't say directly, but stopped for a while, intending to make a fool of himself.
Xu Chenghou just finished smoking a bag of cigarettes, knocked the pot of the cigarette bag, and looked up at Xu Shiyan.
"What's the matter? What's wrong? Secretary Lin is going to be transferred?"
Based on the old man's understanding of the third son, this is probably the case.
"Where did the transfer go? Is the Bureau of Special Products or the Bureau of Agriculture the head?"
A participating secretary, if counted by level, should be at the official level.
The various bureaus in the county are actually at the department level.
Ordinarily speaking, Lin Qiyue has worked in the field for so many years, so it can be said that he has contributed a lot and should be promoted.
However, he is moving from participation to administration, so he has to stay in such a place for two years to get acquainted with the work of the agency, and then he can be promoted seriously.
Xu Shiyan chuckled, "It's still my father who knows me well, so he can guess right.
Received a document from the superior today, Secretary Lin is indeed going to be transferred, but not from the county. He is transferred to the city's Commerce Bureau and directly serves as the director. "
The Bureau of Commerce is a very good department, in charge of the city's domestic and foreign economic and trade activities.
And the city bureau belongs to the department level, which is much higher than the county level.
Lin Qiyue was able to be directly promoted from the county secretary to the city bureau in one fell swoop, which is not a small leap.
Of course, this is not difficult to understand, after all, the achievements of the past few years of participating in the competition are obvious to all.
A participation in the field ranks first in the province in earning foreign exchange year after year, not to mention the county, but also the city.
So Lin Qiyue's promotion seems quite high at first glance, but it is actually reasonable.
"Oh, this is really unexpected.
If you want to put it this way, he has become the director of the city bureau directly from the attending secretary? Gao Sheng. "
Xu Chenghou has grown up in the past few years, and he is quite familiar with these things. Hearing this, he nodded repeatedly.
"Then, who did you change as the attending secretary? Are you someone transferred from another place?"
Looking at his son's joy, it must be that someone was transferred from outside, but the old man was still worried and asked.
If this person is transferred from other places, it means that someone has come to pick peaches with jealousy.
If that's the case, it doesn't matter whether Xu Shiyan does the job or not.
No matter how good your job is, you won’t be able to get promoted. All you do is carry sedan chairs for others, so what’s the point?
Why don't you come down and start a company with Su Anying to do business and make money.
"Father, who else do you think? It must be me.
If someone is transferred from outside, then I will simply resign. "
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard the words, and it was obvious that his father was worried about him.
Xu Chenghou breathed a sigh of relief when he heard the words, "That's good, that's good.
I'm afraid that if you work for so long, it will be cheaper for others in the end. "
Everyone is selfish. No one dares to say that he is selfless and does not consider himself. This is normal.
"Father, I haven't finished talking yet, there is one more thing." Xu Shiyan still smiled.
"We participate in the field, and now we are not called one in the field, but changed to the Hunjiang Oriental Ginseng Company."
Now, Xu Chenghou was stunned, unable to understand what it meant.
"Didn't you participate in the event? How did it become a company? Is it called a company or a state-owned company?"
My daughter-in-law started a company, and the old man felt that if it was called a company, wouldn’t it be a state-owned enterprise?
"Haha, dad, you are really interesting, not all companies are private companies.
Isn’t there a ginseng company in the county? "Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing.
"Just to tell you briefly, we are participating, and now the scale is large.
The bottom is a comprehensive factory and a pharmaceutical factory. It can no longer be simply called a ginseng, but a company.
Moreover, it is no longer under the jurisdiction of the county, but a key enterprise under the municipality. "
To put it simply, it is the adjustment of the enterprise, and the market has been upgraded. It has been managed by the county and now by the city.
Just because of this matter, I heard that Li Jingyu's superiors have been arguing for a long time.
Li Jingyu refused to let go. After all, it was related to profits and taxes. Once he let go, the county lost a lot.
But the attitude of the above is very clear, such a large enterprise, its output value, foreign exchange earnings, profits and taxes are almost catching up with the capabilities of provincial enterprises, so why is it possible for you to manage it?
If this is not acceptable, it must be managed by the superior.
The two sides fought to the end, Li Jingyu was defeated, probably because he asked for other benefits from the city, and finally agreed.
Thus, a county-owned ginseng company became a city-owned Dongfang ginseng company.
Xu Shiyan also changed from a field manager to the general manager of Dongfang Ginseng Company.
"What do you mean by that? It means that you have also been promoted? If so, what level are you now?"
I have to say that the old man is a fan of officials. He doesn't care about anything else, but whether his son will be promoted along with him.
"Well, it should be upgraded, from the county to the city. Now I am not under the management of the county."
The principal position of a municipal enterprise should be counted as the principal position, but the enterprise is still different from the government office, it can only be said to be the same.
"Oh, isn't that a promotion?
Okay, great, my son is amazing, and now he is the general manager.
Oh, the ancestral grave of the old Xu's family is smoking. Look at your brothers in our family. They are all doing well now.
Old woman, let’s find a chance next year and go back to my hometown to have a look, why don’t we have to repair my parents’ grave or something?
Look, the children are promising, and we have to go back to report the good news. "
This time, Xu Chenghou was overjoyed, and grinned continuously.
"To make you beautiful, isn't it time for you to scold your son for being worthless?"
Zhou Guilan also laughed, but she still didn't forget to poke her old man's heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 625: What happens to bully cocks
chapters.content:
Chapter 625 The Fate of the Bully Rooster
Xu Chenghou was not annoyed when his old wife pierced his heart, he just laughed.
Zhou Guilan glanced at her husband, "If you want to go back, next summer when your son and daughter-in-law are not busy, let's find a chance to go back.
I know, you have been thinking about it all these years. "
After all these years, Zhou Guilan still doesn't know what her man is thinking about?
At the beginning, I couldn’t get along in my hometown, so I came out in despair, but now I’m doing well, why don’t I go back and show off?
"San'er, what do you want to eat tonight? Tell me, Mom will make it for you.
My son is promising and has become the general manager. I have to cook something delicious to celebrate. "
In the old lady's place, there must be delicious celebrations for happy events.
"Oh, at this time, the butcher's stall should be out of pork, or else they should make dumplings." Zhou Guilan said regretfully.
"Mom, don't be too busy, wait for Yingzi to come back, let's make some delicious food, and eat whatever we have in the evening.
As long as it is made by my mother, I think the pickled vegetable pancakes are delicious. "
Xu Shiyan didn't eat at home for quite some time, he always had a bite in the cafeteria after get off work, and went back to work overtime. To be honest, he really missed the food at home.
Don't worry about what Zhou Guilan can cook, just want to eat the meal cooked by her mother.
"Come on, I'll go and have a look, what's delicious tonight, wait."
The old lady went to prepare happily, but there was really nothing delicious at home, only a small lump of stir-fried meat.
The key point is the meat stall opposite. If you want to eat meat, it would be great to buy it directly. It is still fresh, so there is nothing in the house.
After thinking about it, the old lady decided to kill the chickens. It happened that it was dark outside at this time, and the chickens raised at home went into the chicken coop by themselves.
The chicken coop at home was nailed by Xu Chenghou. It is surrounded by wooden strips, with a door and a baffle on the side.
After the chicken enters the nest, just plug in the baffle. Pull out the baffle in the morning, and the chickens will come out to eat by themselves.
The cover on the top of the chicken coop is alive, it’s just some wooden boards pressed on it, for the convenience of catching the chickens.
It's dark outside now, but it's not dark yet.
The old lady first blocked the door of the chicken coop, then lifted the upper board, reached out and lifted a big rooster out of the chicken coop.
"Let me push people away all day long, and always call Huihui and Wenwen, and I will end you today."
The old lady was holding the big **** and muttering.
Big geese and big roosters, those are the tyrants in the countryside.
This big rooster is the best at bullying, and he only picks on children to bully.
Fluttering her wings at every turn, chasing Xu Jinhui and Xu Jingwen away, trying to tease people.
Xu Chenghou said several times that such a chicken is not acceptable, just kill it.
But Zhou Guilan was thinking about having a litter of chicks next spring, and she had to save a big rooster, so she didn't want to.
This time, the son was promoted, and the old lady didn't say she was reluctant.
Carrying the big rooster in one hand, he entered the house, found a rope, and directly tied the big **** tightly.
The old lady was not in a hurry to kill the chicken, but went to start the fire to boil the water.
Then I found a bowl, put some water, noodles, green onion, salt, etc. in the bowl.
After all the preparations were done, the water in the pot was overturned before picking up the big rooster on the ground.
Zhou Guilan held the wings of the big rooster with her left hand, and the head of the rooster with her right hand.
The right hand was on the chicken's neck below the head, and quickly plucked the hair, then picked up the kitchen knife, and cut the blood vessel directly on the chicken's neck.
Blood came out all of a sudden, the old lady put down the kitchen knife, held the chicken leg upside down, and dripped all the chicken blood into the bowl.
Until all the blood was collected, he let go and threw the **** on the ground.
The big rooster, who has been domineering all day long, can no longer be arrogant anymore. He lay on the ground and twitched a few times, and then stopped moving.
At this moment, Zhou Guilan found a large aluminum basin and threw the dead rooster into the basin.
Mix the boiling water in the pot with a scoop of cold water, then scoop it out and pour it directly into a large basin.
"Oh, what's the smell at home? Grandma, did you kill the chicken?"
Zhou Guilan was busy taking off the chicken feathers when Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping came in from the outside.
Xu Haiyuan is in the sixth grade, Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu is in the fourth grade, Xu Jingyi is in the second grade, and Xu Jingwen is in the first grade. They all just finished their exams yesterday.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping were called to school by the teacher in the morning to help grade the papers.
I had nothing to do in the afternoon, so I was dragged out by Huang Shuqing and others to play.
It’s just finished the exam, the results haven’t come out, and the winter homework hasn’t been sent out yet, the children have been playing like crazy for two days while taking the opportunity.
Waiting for the results to come out, most of them won’t be able to eat stick stew, and they won’t be able to play if they want to.
Xu Jingyi and Xu Jingwen have to wait until the test results come out, and then go home after receiving their winter vacation homework.
Although Xu Shixiang has been transferred to work in the county, his family has not yet moved there. For the time being, Xu Jingwen has to study in Donggang.
In the next year, the family will move to the county, so Xu Jingwen will probably have to transfer to the county.
As for Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing, they will start elementary school next year, and there is no homework in Yuhong class, so they just play casually.
Xu Jinping sniffled when she entered the room, and could smell the smell of slaughtered chickens, so she hurried to the kitchen.
"Grandma, it's still a few days before the Gregorian calendar year, why did you kill the chicken today?"
Xu Jinping felt strange, why are you killing chickens this year? Have guests at home?
"It's nothing, your dad came back early today and left home for dinner.
Don’t you all think that this big **** is nagging you all day long? I slaughtered it and stewed it in a pot. Let's eat chicken stewed with mushrooms at night. "
Zhou Guilan explained with a smile, but her hands kept pulling, and she plucked the hair very quickly.
"My dad is back, no wonder. That's okay, I'll take off the big padded jacket first, and I'll help you tidy up later."
After Xu Jinping finished speaking, she ran into the east room, took off her big cotton jacket, cotton hat and cotton gloves.
I didn't bother to say hello to my father, and turned around and went to the kitchen again.
First clean up the chicken feathers and other **** on the ground, then help to disembowel the big rooster, wash it with water, and pick the fine hairs with tweezers.
Xu Jinping has good eyesight and quick work, and cleaned up the chicken in a short time.
Zhou Guilan also tidied up the kitchen, then swung a large kitchen knife, clangingly chopped up the chicken, and started frying it in the pan.
This is a serious farm chicken, the kind that is not fed feed, the meat is firm, and it needs to be stewed for a while.
Just taking advantage of the time of stewing the chicken, I found some pine mushrooms and soaked them in warm water, and then soaked some vermicelli.
There are many people in the family, and one chicken is not enough to do anything, so some side dishes must be added.
The stewed chicken with pine mushrooms and vermicelli absorbs the umami taste of the chicken soup, which is more delicious than chicken.
Two big pots, one stewed chicken, and the other stewed a pot of rice.
In this kitchen, the aroma wafted straight out. The greedy Xu Haiqing came to the kitchen over and over again, asking what is delicious for dinner.
"You go into the house to watch TV honestly, and my dad is at home, and you dare to swear, you are really not afraid of our dad whipping you, are you?"
Xu Jinping glared at his younger brother, really convinced, this guy shouldn't be a dog, he really should be a pig, he doesn't care about eating or beating.
When the chicken is cooked, and the rice over there is also cooked, quickly put them out and bring them to the house.
"Come on, it's time to eat, today's meal is a bit late, are you hungry?"
It must be slow to kill the chicken and stew it now.
It's past 6:30, can the children not be hungry? So one by one sat at the table honestly, waiting for the meal.

chapters.title: Chapter 626: the first person to eat a crab
chapters.content:
Chapter 626 The first person to eat crabs
In front of several children, there are two small bowls, one for rice and the other for vegetables.
Zhou Guilan picked out some good meat such as chicken legs and chicken wings, distributed a few pieces to each of the children, and then served some mushrooms and vermicelli.
After eating these, you can eat the ones in the small pot.
It's not that the old lady is harsh, but that there are many children in the family, so there must be rules.
Otherwise, I would go to the basin to search for what I found to eat, would that make sense?
The children are also used to this, and no one feels it.
Besides, the good meat is given to them, so what else to choose? Just keep your head down and eat.
The home-raised chicken is freshly killed and stewed. The meat is firm and delicious. Take a bite and chew a few times, not to mention the fragrance.
The pine mushrooms are all picked up in the woods in summer and dried, stewed with chicken, and eaten with jiuer, they are more delicious than meat.
The vermicelli is full of chicken soup, chewy and slippery, it is full of flavor after taking a sip, it is delicious.
"Then, you should eat more too.
I've been working overtime all day long, so the food in the cafeteria of your unit probably isn't very good. You're skinny. "
The old lady put several pieces of meat in the bowl for her son, looked at his thin cheeks, her heart ached so badly, she kept persuading her son to eat more.
"Mom, you don't need to worry about me, you and my dad should eat more.
The food at the unit is okay, but the main reason is that I am too busy to be free all day long. "
Autumn is the busiest time for participating in the field. Although Xu Shiyan is the field leader, he can't always sit in the office.
Sometimes I have to go up the mountain to see how the ginseng is planted, and sometimes I have to go to a processing factory or a comprehensive factory workshop.
Anyway, I have to worry about things everywhere, and I don’t eat in time, so it’s strange to be fat.
"Master, you should also eat more meat. The stewed chicken tonight is quite mushy, and the mushrooms are also delicious."
Xu Shiyan picked up a few pieces of meat for Chu Xuanhuai. The old man's teeth are fine, and the chicken has been stewed for a long time tonight, so it's easy to eat.
"If it had been put in the past, why would I go to the mountains to pick up some hazel mushrooms and frozen mushrooms in autumn, and now I'm so busy that I almost can't even take care of food.
Thanks to these little guys, I can pick up some pine mushrooms in summer, otherwise this little chicken stewed with mushrooms would be nothing but greedy. "
As Xu Shiyan said, he scooped up some soup with a spoon and poured it into a bowl.
Chicken soup soaked in rice is fragrant, and he can make two bowls without eating vegetables.
At this moment, Xu Haiqing has already finished eating the chicken and mushrooms in his bowl.
The vermicelli and soup were left, and they were simply poured into the rice bowl together, and then the soup and rice were pulled into the mouth.
This baby has a strong mouth and tastes delicious in everything. He finished a bowl of rice in a short while.
Zhou Guilan took a look and quickly filled another half bowl.
"You can't eat too much at night, if you eat too much, you will be overwhelmed.
Such a small person has a lot of food. Where do you think you ate all your food? "
The old lady was muttering while serving the meal.
No matter what grandma said, Xu Haiqing just laughed.
Waiting for grandma to serve him half a bowl of rice, and then scooped up two pieces of meat, some mushrooms and vermicelli, Xu Haiqing took the bowl with a smile.
"Thank you grandma, the chicken served tonight is really delicious, and my milk skills are the best."
Don't worry about it, I'm just a good talker, and I can coax people.
The old lady cheerfully asked the other children, who would eat it, and then serve it.
Xu Haiyuan has a big appetite, one bowl is not enough, so he filled a bowl by himself, Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu both added half a bowl.
Xu Jingyi and Xu Jingwen are young, and the girls don't eat much, so these are enough.
The whole family finished their meal happily. The girls didn't need grandma to do it. They cleared up the table together, cleaned the dishes and cleaned the kitchen.
Xu Shiyan chatted with his parents for a while, and Zhou Guilan kept urging his son to call his daughter-in-law.
After the news broadcast, Xu Shiyan picked up the phone and called Su Anying.
When the proprietress of Feng'an Hotel heard that she was looking for Su Anying, she hurriedly put the phone aside and ran to the second floor to call for someone.
Su Anying has been busy all day and just finished eating and resting.
As soon as she heard someone called her, she knew it was at home, so she hurried downstairs to answer the phone. "Hey?"
"Daughter-in-law, it's me. Have you had dinner yet? Is it cold over there?"
Actually, it’s nothing much, it’s just a daily chat. The couple haven’t seen each other for a long time, so of course they’re panicking.
"It's okay here, it's warm in the south, but the temperature inside and outside the house is the same.
Basking outside in the sun during the day, at night, Yufeng and I looked for the glucose bottle and put a few bottles of hot water under the bed, so it would be warmer.
I don’t think it’s as comfortable as being in our house. At least there is a kang in the house. "
Northeast people go to the south, and most of them are not used to winter.
The locals don’t seem to wear much, but Su Anying and the others can’t do it. Wool trousers are normal. Sometimes it’s too cold to wear cotton trousers.
"Are you busy today? Call me when you are free?"
The couple haven't talked on the phone for some days, and Su Anying felt very at ease when she heard her husband's voice.
"The last batch of goods sent by Shengli just arrived today, and we just packed them up.
A few merchants here are waiting for the goods. It is estimated that the goods will be processed in half a month.
The goods will be sold out in a few days, and we will go back. It should be fine before the fifteenth day of the twelfth lunar month. "
Su Anying knew that her family was worried about her, so she said it before Xu Shiyan asked.
"In the past few days, it may be that the market has risen a lot. Those merchants are eager to ask for goods, and the prices are a little higher than before.
I think this year is really the right time. This time, we can earn more money. "
Business is good, and Su Anying is also very happy, so she must announce the good news to her man.
As the first person to eat crabs, Su Anying and others really got a bonus.
They shipped a total of 70,000 to 80,000 catties to this place this year. So far, only the last batch of goods that have just arrived have not been sold.
Su Anying and Ji Yufeng checked the accounts that day, nothing else was counted this year, it was just the goods dumped in Yangcheng, earning six or seven million was just like playing.
So, it is really not difficult to make money if you have capital in hand and catch up with a good opportunity.
Xu Shiyan was on the phone, listening to his daughter-in-law's somewhat proud and excited narration, he was also happy.
Well, the couple, for this family and for the people around them, are working hard, learning and growing.
"Daughter-in-law, I have good news for you. Secretary Lin has been transferred to the city, and I have become the leader of the field.
Besides, our participation is not called participation anymore, it is called Dongfang Ginseng Company, which is under the jurisdiction of the city.
Xiao Li's father is now the director of the participating factory, Lao Dai is the director of the beverage factory, he is now the director of the Limin Poll Comprehensive Factory, and Xiao Li is now the head of the sales department. "
Lin Qiyue was transferred, but the superior didn't arrange for other people to come, so there must have been personnel changes in the venue.
These are not the decisions of Xu Shiyan alone, they are all decided by the meeting of leading cadres at all levels of the venue.
Important positions must be assigned trustworthy people.
We have been working together for many years, and we are familiar with each other and have a tacit understanding, which is very good.
"Really? Geez, that would be great.
Well, when will Secretary Lin go to work in the city? Find a chance, you want to treat someone to a meal. "
Su Anying was also very happy, and didn't forget to remind Xu Shiyan that it doesn't matter if the person is transferred, the relationship must remain the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 627: class during winter vacation
chapters.content:
Chapter 627 Winter vacation class
The couple talked for almost half an hour regardless of whether the phone bill was expensive or not.
During the period, Xu Haiyuan and others also came over and rushed to talk to their mother.
It wasn't until almost eight o'clock that Xu Shiyan hung up the phone and led the children back home.
As soon as he entered the door, the rascal ran out.
During the summer, this guy goes home once every ten days and half a month. He doesn't like to stay at home.
In winter, I go out every three to five days and come back soon.
Anyway, there is no shortage of it to eat and drink at home, and there is also a place to live. These little days are quite comfortable.
That is, there is often no one at home during the day, and the little thing feels lonely at home by himself.
So when I see Xu Haiyuan and the others at night, I always have to play tricks.
It's weird, it's perfectly normal to act coquettishly.
Just like at this moment, the little guy jumped into Xu Haiyuan's arms all at once, whimpering.
"You're older than them, and you're still acting like a spoiled child?" Xu Shiyan reached out and rubbed Lapigui's head.
"I'll act coquettishly all day long, so you can find a wife anyway.
It’s been all these years, and I haven’t seen you bringing a daughter-in-law back. "
When Lai Pigui heard Xu Shiyan's words, he didn't know if he was angry. He turned his head, lay in Xu Haiyuan's arms, and did not hesitate to talk to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan couldn't be happier, "What's wrong? Why don't you let people say you're single?
Oh, by the way, you are not a single dog, you are a single fox, hahaha. "
Xu Haiyuan shook his head dumbfounded, hugged Lai Pigui with one hand, supported Chu Xuanhuai with the other, and helped the old man into the east room.
Here, Xu Shiyan led the two daughters back to the house in Xitou.
Thanks to the kang and heater that Xu Chenghou came over to burn during the day, the room is quite hot.
Xu Shiyan went to the boiler room again, added some coal to the boiler, and then asked his daughter to wash her feet and get ready for sleep.
The children were crazy for a long time, and they were all tired. They washed their feet and tidied up, and fell asleep quickly under the covers.
Xu Shiyan was alone, and he didn't want to go to bed too early, so he simply lay down under the blanket and read the Chu family's secret recipe written by Xu Haiyuan.
The secret recipe has been properly kept by him. It is an antique and a priceless treasure. It must be kept well and left to future generations.
As for this copy, Chu Xuanhuai specially asked Xu Haiyuan to copy it in order to impress Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Shiyan felt that the word "eldest son" was beautifully written, so he simply asked for the manuscript for his own use.
A well-copied copy of the secret recipe, after Xu Shiyan got it, he marked a lot of things on it.
There are both red and blue letters, like patches, and Xu Haiyuan's neatly handwritten notebook is lost.
Of course, the two of you don’t care about these things, as long as they are practical, it doesn’t matter if they are beautiful or not.
Xu Haiyuan can copy another copy if he can copy one, so what are you afraid of?
Just like that, while Xu Shiyan was watching, holding a red ballpoint pen in his hand, he marked it and wrote his experience.
These are the secret recipes of the Chu family that have been passed down for hundreds of years.
How to turn ancient prescriptions into modern ones, how to inherit the essence of ancient Chinese medicine, and use modern technology to create real good medicines are the issues that Xu Shiyan thinks about most at this stage.
In this area, he is still a novice and must study hard.
Xu Shiyan has entrusted those students who are going to study in pharmaceutical universities to help them find a set of textbooks and come back.
He has to study it carefully.
If a pharmaceutical company wants to grow and develop, it must have its own unique things that cannot be replaced by others. These are the directions of future research.
Xu Shiyan felt that his ability was not enough, so he had to consult an expert.
Xu Shiyan made a mark while flipping through the secret recipe.
I don’t know what time it is anyway, so I feel sleepy, so I reach out and pull down the light cord, and go to sleep.
Although the transfer document for Lin Qiyue has been issued by the superior, there is still a lot of work to be handed over to the participants.
So Lin Qiyue was still participating in the competition a year ago, and only went to work in the city a year later.
In addition, a ginseng farm was changed to Dongfang Ginseng Industry Company, which was upgraded to a city-owned company.
