Enterprise upgrade and adjustment involves all aspects.
It is necessary to clear the relevant aspects with the county and report the information to the city. Anyway, Xu Shiyan is very busy.
December 28th, the elementary school will return to school to listen to the grades, receive the report card and winter homework.
Needless to say, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping had excellent grades and were among the best. The teacher not only gave the grades, but also a certificate of merit.
Xu Jingyi from the second grade and Xu Jingwen from the first grade had simple homework and both got very good grades.
Zhou Guilan was so happy that she bought meat and made dumplings for the children to celebrate.
As for the other children, they have all kinds of grades.
Yang Haoyu and Xu Jinping are evenly matched in grades, often tied for first place.
Huang Shuqing was dragged by Xu Haiyuan at any rate, the first few were middle class, and Sun Yu, Sun Ning and others were middle class.
The daughters-in-law of each family are not at home when they go out. Men don’t like to get angry with their children. I guess they also think that it’s good that the children’s grades don’t drop.
So I just threatened, wait until your mother comes back, it will be strange if your mother doesn't smoke you, so forget it.
It's normal. People in this age mostly care about their children's studies, and very few people watch their children study all day long.
Anyway, I didn’t study well, so I went down to farm and work.
If it doesn’t work, processing factories, fertilizer factories and so on can all be stuffed into work, so I don’t have to worry about panic anyway.
After all, not everyone has the talent to study, and some things cannot be forced.
The grades came out, and the homework for the winter vacation was assigned. Wu Qiuyan and Chen Chunling came over and took their daughters home.
Su Anying was not at home, Xu Shiyan was also busy, and the girls Xu Jingyi and Xu Jingwen also left.
In this Gregorian calendar year, Zhou Guilan didn't think too much about it, so she simply made something to eat, which was a fool.
Xu Haiyuan and the others next summer will take the primary entrance examination, which is still very important this year, so the school arranges that this year's winter vacation, the sixth grade students will take classes at school together.
Years ago, from January 3rd to January 29th, which is the 22nd day of the twelfth lunar month.
Years later, from the eighth day of the first lunar month, which is February 13th, to February 25th, Xu Haiyuan and the others had to attend classes.
The teacher asked the children to borrow books for the second semester of the sixth grade, trying to complete the course during the winter vacation.
After the school starts, the general review will begin.
In the school, each class still burns the stove for heating.
The firewood that was originally handed in is only up to this time, and there will not be too much left in each class.
So, the students in the four classes of the sixth grade have to go to school to hand in some more firewood.
In addition, if you attend classes during holidays, you have to pay tuition fees.
For the Xu family, this is no problem.
On the morning of the 3rd, Xu Chenghou dragged a sledge for firewood, and followed Xu Haiyuan to school.
Hand over the firewood to the class for stacking, then hand over the tuition fee to the class teacher, and then go home.
Sixth graders in this year should normally have subjects such as mathematics, Chinese, history, geography, politics, physical education, music, and art.
But during the holidays, no minor subjects are taken, only mathematics and Chinese.
And in this year, the general mathematics and Chinese are a teacher, a class teacher.
So, the children are studying under the supervision of the class teacher all day.
There is no time taken up by small subjects, and mathematics and Chinese are studied all day, so the progress of the course is not fast?

chapters.title: Chapter 628: daughter in law is back
chapters.content:
Chapter 628 The daughter-in-law is back
Xu Haiyuan went back to school for holiday classes, while Xu Jinping watched her younger siblings at home, helped her grandma with work, and she had to do her homework.
Yang Haoyu's father is in charge of the fertilizer factory. This fall, the fertilizer factory sold a lot of compound fertilizers, and many people even made reservations for next year.
Plus the foliar fertilizer will be on sale in spring and summer next year, so don’t we have to hurry up to produce it?
Yang Junxian was busy with the fertilizer factory, and Ji Yufeng went to Yangcheng to sell goods.
Although Yang Junxian's parents came back from the city, Yang Haoyu didn't like living at home at all.
So after the holiday, this kid lived in Xu's house again.
Everyone who knows said that this is the real son of the Xu family, how can he be a godson?
Yang Haoyu doesn't care about that, he is very happy living in Xu's house.
Go for a run with Xu Jinping in the morning, come back to have a meal, do some homework, and preview the next semester's courses.
Then help the family to burn the boiler, sweep the snow, and chop firewood.
When I was free, I led Xu Haiqing and the others, together with Sun Yu, Sun Ning, Yang Jianjun, and others, to go out to climb plow slopes, skate and so on.
Sometimes, the children also do some serious business, go to the backwoods to collect firewood.
There are many larch trees in the woods. These children sharpen the sickle, tie the handle of the sickle to a pole, and then hold the sickle to hook the pine branches of the larch.
Larch branches are cut down and dragged home, chopped into sections with an axe, and left to blow in the wind for two days can be used to start a fire.
Pine branches have pine oil, which can ignite the fire quickly, and it can be used for cooking and so on.
Especially in summer, it’s good to burn pine branches and stir-fry vegetables without heating the kang.
Speaking of which, the Xu family has no shortage of firewood.
Every year, the ginseng soil on the mountain, the roots of the trees dug out, are brought back and sawed, and used as firewood.
There are also those woods on the mountain, such as pillar feet, large joint poles, crossarms, branch poles, layering bars, bow bars, etc., which can be drawn home and used for fire.
In addition, every year when the Forestry Bureau cleans up the situation in Lengchang, Guo Shouye will ask people to pull two large carts of wood over.
Xu Shiyan asked someone to help him, cut it off with a chainsaw, split it up and piled it up.
There are two piles of firewood in Xu's yard, enough to burn for several years.
But the children don’t care about that, they see others pulling pine branches at home, they think it’s fun, and they have to do it too.
This work is actually very tiring. The sickle is tied to the pole, and the neck is raised to hook the pine branches. After a while, the neck is sore and the arms also hurt.
Drag the branch back, the snow hole in the forest is very old and deep, step on it and sink in, and it takes a lot of effort to get out.
How could Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan want their children to suffer from these jobs?
Especially Yang Haoyu, who doesn't necessarily work at home, and goes to Xu's house to do everything, the old couple thinks this is not good.
So the old couple stopped and tried to persuade them not to let go.
But it was useless to persuade them several times. Yang Haoyu and Xu Jinping didn't listen at all, so they did what they should do.
At noon, they dragged back two large bundles of pine branches from the back woods. Before it got dark, the two of them chopped them up with axes.
Then they were **** smoothly and stacked on the side of the garden stick, saying that they were reserved for summer fires.
How can I fix it? The child has business to do, and it's not like he's going out to misbehave and cause trouble.
No choice, Xu Chenghou and his wife had no choice but to agree.
Sometimes Xu Chenghou was worried, so he followed along and helped to drag back.
Not to mention, the old and the young have been busy for half a month, and there is an extra pile of pine branches and firewood in Xu's yard.
As soon as Laba passed, Zhou Guilan began to look forward to her daughter-in-law's return every day.
Not only she is looking forward to it, but everyone is looking forward to it. Seeing that the Chinese New Year is not far away, who is not in a hurry to have a family reunion?
At any rate, on the tenth day of the twelfth lunar month, I received a call from Su Anying and the others, saying that all the goods had been sold.
They packed up and walked back, and they will be home in about three or four days.
Upon hearing the news, hey, everyone is very happy, counting the days until their daughter-in-law comes back.
January 21st, the 14th day of the twelfth lunar month, Su Anying and his party brought some old things with them, and got off at Songjianghe.
"Daughter-in-law, this way." Xu Shiyan, Han Limin, Yang Junxian, Huang Shengli and others all went to the train station and waited.
Seeing the daughters-in-law of various families come out of it, okay, everyone is so excited, I can't wait to jump over the fence and go inside to pick up my daughter-in-law.
Su Anying and the others were all carrying large backpacks, dragging a travel trailer in one hand and a small bag in the other, and were wearing bread jackets.
Following the crowd with great effort, he walked out from the exit.
The men from all the families rushed forward, took the big backpack from the daughter-in-law's back, and then took the travel trailer.
"My God, what have you guys packed up? Don't you feel tired of all the big and small bags?"
The men looked at the big suitcase on the travel trailer and tried the heavy backpack.
are all very curious, what did you bring back? So old?
"We lived there for nearly three months, and we didn't bring enough clothes, so we bought all of them there.
In addition, bring something for the family, what can be less? "
Who goes out and doesn’t buy something for his family when he returns home?
Xu Shiyan thought about it all the time when he went out, let alone these women.
Buy, buy, buy, that's a woman's pleasure.
Su Anying and the others usually go out for a walk when they are not busy, and buy whatever they like when they see it. Before leaving, they even go to the mall to have a good meal.
The suitcase, the trailer, and so on were all bought from there, otherwise why put them back?
The men looked at each other, but no one dared to say anything.
The daughter-in-law earns money by herself, so she can buy it if she likes it, so what else?
Buy, must buy, and I’m not happy if I buy less.
"Well, let's go back to our respective houses today. Let's find time some other day. Let's get together."
Su Anying looked back at Ji Yufeng and the others, and said.
It’s been a long time since I went out, and my family is looking forward to it, so I must go home first.
Let’s take a two-day rest first, and take it easy, as the remittance is due to arrive.
At that time, the general ledger for this year will be collected, and each family will directly distribute the dividends for the New Year.
Xu Shiyan and Han Limin both drove the cars assigned by the venue. On the other side of Yang Junxian, Xu Shiyan was the master and also assigned a car.
After all, he is also the director of the fertilizer factory, so he can't walk on two legs when he goes out, right? A car, arranged in the factory.
As for the others, they are all half-drive.
The key point is that Huang Shengli and the others have nothing else to do. They already have a car at home, so can they buy another jeep? Isn't that nonsense?
Everyone broke up at the train station, each driving their daughter-in-law home.
Yang Junxian and Ji Yufeng went to Xu's house first with Xu Shiyan and his wife.
Picked up Yang Haoyu, who lived comfortably in Xu's house, and was reluctant to leave, and the family of three went home for a reunion.
On the Xu family's side, Su Weizhong and his wife, Ji Tongzhong and his wife are all there.
Seeing Su Anying come back, everyone was extremely happy.
The four of Xu Haiyuan hugged Su Anying and refused to let go, and finally let go after trying to persuade her.
Zhou Guilan grabbed her daughter-in-law's hand and told her to sit on the kang quickly.
"Look, I've been out for almost three months, I miss us so much.
How is the journey going? nothing wrong?
Oh, I'm thinking about it at home, I'm afraid that you wives will encounter something on the road. "
It's a mess outside these years, a few women are walking outside, and they have a lot of money, can you not worry?

chapters.title: Chapter 629: Bakery Gold Bracelet
chapters.content:
Chapter 629 Bread Dress Gold Bracelet
"Mom, the road is okay, we will fly to the provincial capital and then return by train.
I didn’t bring too much money with me, it was all from the company account, so there was nothing wrong with it. "
If this is a long-distance train ride, wandering along the way for several days, I really dare not say what happened to me.
Back by plane, only the distance from the provincial capital to home is left.
Although it is not peaceful, at least the road is short, and everyone can survive if they are more vigilant.
"Oh, oh, that's good, that's good." Zhou Guilan nodded upon hearing this.
"Well, let's eat first, you must be thinking about the food at home after you have been away for more than two months.
We made dumplings today, as well as your favorite dishes. You just sit on the kang, and I'll clean it up. "
Daughter-in-law went out for a trip, blamed for being tired, Zhou Guilan couldn't bear to order her daughter-in-law to work anymore.
So Su Anying was pressed on the kang to rest, and she led her granddaughter to serve all the meals.
The dumplings were just out of the pan, and they were still hot, so they quickly packed them up, and the whole family sat down to eat.
There are not only dumplings, but also eight dishes. When Su Anying saw it, they were the most missed ones outside.
"Well, it's delicious, and our food is still delicious.
I don’t know what to eat at the other end, I feel like I can’t eat enough. "
At home, why not be polite, just eat.
"Mom, this is your favorite fish, eat more." Xu Haiyuan took a piece of fish belly for his mother.
"Mom, you eat pork ribs. My grandma specially made sweet and sour pork ribs today. They are delicious." Xu Jinping picked up a piece of ribs for her mother.
The two little ones at the other end looked at it and didn't let it go. This one put chicken for mother, and the other put mushrooms for mother.
Su Anying's bowl was immediately full.
"Okay, okay, you guys can eat too, Mommy can pick whatever she wants."
Su Anying is so beautiful, look at the children in his family, how filial they are?
The family ate happily, then packed up and sat chatting.
It's rare for everyone to ask about Su Anying's affairs in Yangcheng.
Su Anying has lived there for nearly three months, and she must have more knowledge than Xu Shiyan, so let me tell you about the people there talking, eating and so on.
Especially when they just passed by, they couldn’t understand what people were saying and often made jokes.
Made everyone laugh, leaning back and forth.
Su Anying came back today, Xu Haiyuan specially took the afternoon off to skip class, so today he ate two meals.
It was past three o'clock after dinner, and after chatting for a while, it would be dark outside.
Su Weizhong and his wife saw that it was getting late, so they hurriedly said goodbye and went home to light the fire.
Ji Tongzhong and his wife bought a house near here a while ago, and now they are no longer living in Shanhuozhuang, and they have to go home.
"When you're done with your work, we'll have a family gathering when you have time.
The old five and the sixth are all thinking about you, isn't this a busy place? It's not easy to ask for leave, so I didn't come today. "
Before going out, Su Weizhong told Su Anying this.
Actually, it was Su Weizhong who prevented the elders from coming over.
It's a bit unreasonable for all of them to come, so let's go back to Su's family to reunite another day.
"okay, I get it.
Father, I will finish my work in the company these few days before going home. "Su Anying nodded.
Ji Yufeng went out with her. The company's accounts are estimated to be correct for a few days.
And it’s not far from the New Year’s Eve. I’m going to settle accounts and pay dividends, and I’m busy with the New Year’s work. I’m afraid I won’t have time to go back to my mother’s house for a while.
Let’s talk about it at that time, anyway, we are all in Donggang, so we can get together anytime.
Su Weizhong also knows that the daughter's business is getting bigger now, and she is busy, so she can be considerate.
Then nodded, and with the support of Ji Tongzhong and Su Anfen, they left Su's house together.
The house bought by Ji Tongzhong's family is not far from Su Weizhong's place.
Come out from Xu’s house and walk east along the road behind, and turn north after a small intersection, the second house on the left is.
Three brick-and-tiled houses with water-washed stone walls, just built last year.
After buying it, Ji Tongzhong hired someone to clean it up, and then moved in.
Just happened to be on the way, and the three members of Ji Tongzhong's family sent Su Weizhong and his wife home first, and then returned to their own home.
Here, Su Anying saw off her parents, sister and brother-in-law, and returned to the east room to chat with her in-laws.
"Dad, Mom, I went out this time and bought some clothes for you.
Now it’s popular to wear bread jackets outside. The quality is better than before, light and warm, and it’s just for the two of you. "
This bread jacket is actually a down jacket.
The quality of the down jackets of this year is not as good as later ones, and the down jacket inside is not so fine.
There is a lot of filling, and it is bulging like baked bread, so everyone calls it a bread service.
Su Anying found a pair of black and a dark purple clothes from the suitcase, all wrapped in bags.
The bag evacuated the air, so the clothes looked flat.
Su Anying opened the bag, took out the clothes from inside, rubbed and shook them, and the bread clothes visibly stretched out and became fluffy.
"Father, try it on, it's lighter and warmer than our big padded jacket."
Su Anying handed the shaken one to Xu Chenghou, then took out another one, shaken it and handed it to Zhou Guilan.
The daughter-in-law expressed her affection, and the old couple naturally couldn't refuse, so they both tried it on.
"Huh? Don't say yes, this dress seems to be quite warm and light."
Zhou Guilan pinched the clothes on her body with her hands, and felt that the fabric was quite soft.
"Isn't this thing cheap?"
"Mom, your daughter-in-law is rich.
People are called big money now, they don’t care about the money, they buy it for you, and you wear it. "
Xu Shiyan knew that the bread and clothes were not cheap, and he was afraid that Su Anying's words would make the old man feel sorry for the money, so he deliberately answered the question.
"Yes, yes, Yingzi bought it for us with good intentions, what do you care about the money?
how? They have money, why don't they honor us with filial piety? Dressed, I look good. "
Xu Chenghou also answered the conversation, "We are all at this age, eat what we need, wear what we need, don't ask how much it costs."
The old man is very appreciative, the daughter-in-law bought it with good intentions, don't ask anything, just accept it with a smile.
Su Anying rummaged through and found two woolen sweaters, one for each of the old couple.
Xu Chenghou's is dark blue with black checks, and Zhou Guilan's is purple with flowers embroidered on it, very pretty.
And it's not as hard as the sweater knitted by yourself, it's extra soft, and it's definitely comfortable to wear.
In addition to these, Su Anying also took out a box and handed it to Zhou Guilan.
"Mom, here is a bracelet for you.
Thanks to having a mother to help take care of the children, otherwise how could I have given up so much and gone out for several months? Mom, you have worked hard. "
The parents-in-law are willing to help, and the daughter-in-law must know how to be grateful.
Without the help of the old couple, would Su Anying dare to go out? If you don't go out, how can you make money?
"Oh, this is a gold bracelet, my God, this is really beautiful."
Zhou Guilan opened the box and saw that there was a gold bracelet inside.
The bracelet is live, with longevity characters and cloud patterns on it, which is suitable for the elderly to wear.
This time, Zhou Guilan didn't say whether it was expensive or not, she took the bracelet out of the ordinary and put it on her wrist directly.
"This, I usually wear it for work, can it work?"
The old lady is a little worried, won't it be worn out?
"Okay, sure, mom, don't worry about wearing it." Xu Shiyan and his wife said in unison.

chapters.title: Chapter 630: messy bear kids
chapters.content:
Chapter 630 Troubled kids
After distributing the belongings of Xu Chenghou and his wife, Chu Xuanhuai's was next, which was the same bread jacket and woolen sweater.
Chu Xuanhuai has been here for a few years, and Su Anying handles the clothes all by himself, so the numbers are quite accurate, and the clothes fit well.
Chu Xuanhuai was very happy, and accepted it with a smile.
"You all have bread clothes, but I didn't buy anything else.
I'll bring it to you when I get home later, otherwise it won't be easy to put it open. "
Su Anying looked up and saw the four children, and smiled.
"Mom, we have no shortage of clothes to wear, we don't care if we buy them or not." Xu Haiyuan laughed when he heard that.
The few of them have never been short of clothes. A few days ago, my little aunt even sent me a lot of winter clothes.
Although they don't have this kind of bread, they have cotton coats.
Ordinary children, how can they have several sets of new clothes every year?
It's getting late, and I didn't go back to light the fire in the afternoon. I'm afraid it's quite cold at home.
Xu Shiyan and his wife didn't waste much time with their parents. They packed up their things, supported Chu Xuanhuai, led the four children, and hurried home to light the fire.
As soon as I got home, the room was really not too warm. The fire was burning at noon. Wouldn't it be cold this afternoon?
So he hurriedly started to burn the kang and boiler.
The boiler couldn’t keep up with the previous stove, the stove was on fire, and the furnace tube was hot after a while.
As soon as the furnace tube is hot, the room is also hot.
This boiler doesn’t work. You have to heat the water inside and cycle it on. After the radiator is hot, the room will be hot.
The Xu family’s big house is going to be very hot, why don’t they have some time?
Fortunately, there is still a while before going to sleep.
The children all wore more clothes, and gathered together to watch TV in Chu Xuanhuai's room, while Xu Shiyan and his wife were busy lighting the fire.
"By the way, I bought a color TV from the other side of Yangcheng, a 21-inch color TV.
It is said to be the latest imported model, but it is quite expensive anyway.
It is estimated that it will be delivered in a few days. When the time comes, it will be placed in Master's room, and the small one will be exchanged for our room. "
Su Anying was chatting with Xu Shiyan while lighting the fire, and just remembered about the TV.
The TV at home was bought from the provincial capital. It has been several years, and it has always been placed in Chu Xuanhuai's house.
Xu Shiyan thought about buying another one before, but Su Anying refused.
The two of them are away from home all day, and they can’t watch it a few times after buying a TV. There is no need to waste that money.
This time, I saw a big color TV in Yangcheng, and Hu Yanqiu and the others bought it.
It is said that there are many people in the family, so it is better to buy another one to go home at night, so as to save the fight at night.
Su Anying thought about it, and this is also the reason, so let's buy one and go home.
Change it when the time comes, and bring the younger one into their room. I can’t sleep at night, and I can watch TV for a while.
"Buy it, our family is still short of the money for a TV? Buy whatever you want.
How about buying you a car? No matter what you say, you are also the manager of the company, so it's not good to go out without a car, right? "
Xu Shiyan doesn't care about these things. For the couple, a TV or a car is just a number.
I really don’t need to care too much, just buy it if you like it.
"I'll buy another car for you, and let Xiao Ji drive the half of our house.
He collects goods all day long, and it is really inconvenient not to have a car.
I also told my second brother that a truck, half a truck, will be bought at the farm in the next year. "
Xu Shiyan didn’t think that buying a car was a waste of money. Having a car is definitely different from not having a car. Having a car is really much more convenient.
Whether it’s harvesting wild vegetables in summer or harvesting goods in autumn and winter, they can’t do anything without a car.
So sometimes, you really can’t be afraid of spending money. If you have some money, you should spend it.
Su Anying was right when she thought about it, "Okay, then if you think it's okay, buy one."
Some things should be done.
The couple chatted while working, and Xu Shiyan had to explain all these things outside the house.
Talking and chattering, time passed.
As the boiler heats up, the water gradually circulates, and the temperature in the room also rises, and the kang in the room also heats up.
The couple looked at the same fire, threw two pieces of pimples into the bottom of the pot, added coal to the boiler, and then the two of them went into the house on the kang bunk to be chattered.
The couple haven't seen each other for several months, and the chatter seems to have changed.
Xu Shiyan put his arms around his daughter-in-law, and began to think about other things.
Coincidentally, at this moment, the door opened with a bang.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing rushed into the house holding the quilt.
Then, Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui also came over from the Westinghouse with bedding and pillows in their arms.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, "What are you doing?" Are these brats planning to rebel?
"We're going to sleep with Mommy."
The children simply ignored their father's ashen face, and climbed onto the kang to separate their parents' bedding.
Xu Shiyan's is at the top of the kang, with two younger ones in the middle, then Su Anying, then Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping.
This intention is very obvious. Tonight, they will stay here and not leave.
Xu Shiyan can't laugh or cry, he hasn't seen his wife for a long time, okay? He wants to be intimate with his wife.
These brats, they came here to make trouble on purpose, right? Deliberately come to **** his wife.
Su Anying looked at her husband's gloomy face and couldn't help but smile.
"Then go wash your feet and come back to sleep.
All of you are only allowed to stay overnight, and you will all go back to your own room to sleep tomorrow night. "
The children cheered happily, and hurried to scoop up water to wash their feet, clean up and wash.
Then they jumped onto the kang one by one, and got into the bed contentedly.
Xu Shiyan looked at the joy of the children, what else could he say? Who told them to give birth to these four bear children?
Bear it, anyway, these bears can go away tomorrow night.
Besides, the daughter-in-law is probably quite tired after coming back this way, so let her have a good rest.
Su Anying is really tired. She can't sleep well these days when she is away from home.
A few women are outside, with so much goods, and a lot of money around them, how dare they rest assured and boldly sleep soundly?
They have to be vigilant at all times, and they have to get up and check if there is any trouble, for fear of losing the goods they brought.
The same goes for taking a plane or a car when you come back.
Now that I’m back home, I’m completely relieved, not to mention the sound of my sleep.
Almost fell asleep next to the pillow, and slept until dawn.
Thanks to the next Sunday, Xu Shiyan didn't have to go to work, and Xu Haiyuan didn't have to go to school.
Xu Shiyan woke up first in the morning, followed by Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping.
The three masters got up and put on their clothes lightly, then Xu Shiyan led his son out to sweep the snow, and Xu Jinping cooked.
At seven o'clock, the food was ready, and then all three of Su Anying were called out.
"What time is it?" Su Anying slept soundly this time, and was still a little dazed when she woke up.
After a while, she realized that she was going home.
Turn your head and look at the wall, okay, it's half past seven.
So he quickly got up from the bed, put on his clothes and went to the ground.
"Why don't you call me? What do you have for breakfast?"
"Mom, breakfast is ready, just wash your face and eat."
Xu Jinping opened the pot, put steamed buns and porridge out, cut a few salted duck eggs, scooped up some pickles and cut them up.
Breakfast, not so particular, just take a casual bite.

chapters.title: Chapter 631: Xu Haiqing's specialty
chapters.content:
Chapter 631 Xu Haiqing's specialty
The Chinese New Year is almost here, and every household is busy unpacking and washing bedding, making clothes for the children, buying new year’s goods, and so on.
Su Anying came back, but she couldn't stop, she was busy.
First, with Ji Yufeng and others, they collected all the accounts of the company during this period.
Two days later, after all the money arrived, all the families were called together for a meeting to calculate the dividends.
Compared to last year, this year's income is more.
The ginseng soil earned more than one hundred thousand yuan, and the ginseng seeds were sold for four million yuan.
Not counting the ginseng from various companies, the processing factory processed a total of 130,000 catties of fresh ginseng in autumn, earning 1.5 million yuan.
I took the goods to Yangcheng later, and sold nearly 80,000 catties of dry goods in total, earning more than 6 million yuan.
Of course, the more you earn, the more you spend. Everywhere you have to hire people to work, and the wages of the workers are quite a lot.
Although Ji Tongzhong, Huang Shengkai and others do not have shares in the company, their salaries plus bonuses each get 10,000 to 20,000.
The purchase of machinery and equipment, water and electricity, etc. at the processing factory is a large expense.
In addition to various taxes and fees, even if the town and the county offer discounts, they still have to pay a lot.
In the city, restaurants and hotels are also making good profits.
The hotel has been built this year, and the number of rooms is more than double that of before. Even so, the rooms will be full at the busiest time.
However, restaurants and hotels employ a large number of people and the cost is high. In fact, the profit value is not as good as that of ginseng planting and processing.
It’s just that Xu Shiyan wants to occupy a piece of land, as long as it can maintain normal operation, it’s fine if he doesn’t pay for it.
All expenses were deducted in a random manner, and there were more than 8 million yuan left in the end. This is considered net profit, and each family can share dividends.
In addition to these, every family has played a hundred feet.
The market is good this year, and the output of sticks is also high, and they process and sell it themselves. The sales of ginseng soaked in wine are particularly good, and the price is also high.
So this year, each family can basically sell 160,000 to 70,000.
The fertilizer factory has just started production and sales, and it hasn't paid off yet, so there is nothing to say. It is estimated that it will take another two years to make a profit.
The farm has been handed over to Xu Shian for management.
Not to mention, Xu Shian studied for two years and improved a lot.
The management of the farm is well-organized, and a deer farm was established with Kaifeng Forest Farm to expand the scale of breeding.
In general, after the hard work of everyone this year, everyone's wallets have bulged a lot.
The assets of Xu Shiyan and his wife have already exceeded tens of millions, which is news worth celebrating.
After the accounts were settled and the dividends were distributed, everyone was very happy.
On the seventeenth day of the twelfth lunar month, the restaurant is reserved for a small party to celebrate.
This time, each family requires the children to prepare a show and perform on stage.
Especially those with poor grades like Huang Shuqing, whoever performs well will not be beaten.
Otherwise, don’t care if it’s almost Chinese New Year, this meal of fried pork with sticks will definitely be unavoidable.
In order not to be beaten, these children can only seriously prepare for the show.
So the party that night was very lively and lively.
The children sang and danced, and some even learned from the TV, performing sketches and cross talks.
The most surprising thing was Xu Haiqing. This kid came on stage and told everyone a story about General Yang.
Not to mention, the speech is really good, the expressions and movements are in place, and the speech is also very smooth, and it is done in one go.
"Third brother, your Haiqing, when did you learn such a skill? My God, this is amazing."
All the people eating and drinking under the stage were dumbfounded. No one thought that such a young child as Xu Haiqing would have such abilities.
Xu Shiyan was also stupid, he really didn't know that the fourth child could do this.
This kid is usually so lazy that he writes like ghosts, and he can't memorize a single ancient poem in three days.
Whoever thinks about this child has a bit of ability to comment on storytelling.
Although what he told was not exactly the same as what he told on the radio and TV, the content of the story was correct and the story was very exciting.
For a child who is less than eight years old, it is already very good to be able to do this.
"Third brother, I think if Haiqing is really not good at studying, you might as well send him to learn folk art.
This kid is kind of mean. "Sun Xiaofeng was at the side advising Xu Shiyan.
“A child is uncertain, I don’t know what he can do, let’s talk about it when he is older.
No matter what happens, he has to finish junior high school. If he really doesn't want to study at that time, he should find a way. "
Xu Shiyan looked at his young son who was in high spirits in the stands, smiled and shook his head.
This child is a crazy person. It’s uncertain, so we can’t make a conclusion at this time.
But it can be properly guided in this direction.
Wait for him to find someone to ask if there are any kind of talent classes for children's poetry recitation, broadcast hosting, or singing in the county or city, so that children can try it.
If it doesn’t work, find a teacher from a cultural troupe to teach.
If Xu Haiqing really has the talent in this area, he can properly cultivate it.
In the future, if your academic performance is really not that outstanding, you can also try to get on the art test.
It’s a big deal to spend a little more money, as long as the child can be raised, it doesn’t matter if you spend a little more money.
Xu Shiyan has always felt that investing in children's education is the most cost-effective deal.
No amount of money can buy a child's success.
Although their family has a little wealth now, it looks like a lot.
But once a prodigal son comes out of the family, let alone these things, even if they come again, they will still be defeated.
If the child becomes a talent, the little money invested now can be earned back hundreds of times and thousands of times in the future.
Moreover, the child has a skill and can live comfortably on his own, and his parents will not have to worry about it in the future.
The four children in the family, the eldest and the second, Xu Shiyan really never worried about their future.
The boss studied medicine with Mr. Chu, and even if he doesn't go to university in the future, he can get a certificate to become a rural Chinese medicine doctor or something.
Besides, there is a pharmaceutical factory over there. Through the pharmaceutical factory, Xu Haiyuan will be sent to the University of Pharmaceutical Sciences to study Zhenger Bajing for a few years.
Looking back, it’s almost time to exercise, and I’m going to work as a technician in a pharmaceutical factory, and I’m sure it will be fine.
Needless to say, the second child, this kid is quite talented in writing and drawing.
If she really stopped studying, she could find a way out by following her sister-in-law to learn fashion design or something.
Of course, this is the worst.
Based on Xu Jinping's current grades and status, I dare not say that she will be admitted to Tsinghua University in the future. The universities in this province have no problems at all, so don't worry about it.
The youngest girl is not as smart as the first two, she can only be said to be well-behaved, and she is very serious in everything she does.
Xu Shiyan and his wife also thought that it would be best for Xu Jinhui to be admitted to university in the future.
If she doesn’t pass the exam, arrange for her to participate in the competition, and she can live a good life as a worker or something.
With Xu Shiyan protecting him, I'm not afraid of living a bad life.
Only the fourth child, I really don’t see any strengths in him, he is lazy and mischievous every day.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were both worried, because they were afraid that in the future, the child would be a fool and a fool.
Unexpectedly, today he found out that this kid also has some strengths. Xu Shiyan was really happy in his heart.
As long as you can discover the advantages of the child, find out what he is good at, and cultivate it slowly, the child will never become a waste in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 632: don't want to learn anything
chapters.content:
Chapter 632 Don't want to learn anything
A small get-together made Xu Shiyan discover the specialty of his youngest son, Xu Shiyan was very happy.
After the youngest son finished performing, he quickly called the child to him.
"Come on, tell Dad, why do you know how to talk about storytelling?" Xu Shiyan grabbed his son's fleshy little hand, feeling extremely rare.
Xu Haiqing was a little confused, when did his father talk to him in such a pleasant and soft voice?
What happened today? How do you feel so fuzzy?
"I didn't learn from anyone. I just listened to it all day long. I talked about it on TV and on the radio. After listening to it a lot, I remembered it."
Xu Haiqing looked puzzled, does Pingshu still need someone to teach it?
The TV and radio talk every day, and there are several stations.
Grandpa loves to listen, and he also loves to listen. After listening to it for a long time, he will talk about it. What else is there?
Xu Shiyan thought, I'll listen too, why can't I?
"Son, do you want to learn something? For example, poetry recitation, singing, broadcasting and hosting?"
Although Xu Shiyan seemed calm when he talked to Sun Xiaofeng and the others just now, he was actually very excited inside.
Finally discovered that his son has some special skills, he really wants to find a teacher now, teach him from an early age, and cultivate them well.
Unexpectedly, when Xu Haiqing heard this, his little head shook like a rattle.
"No, no, I don't want to study, I'm too tired.
I will go to primary school next year. I do my homework every day, and then I learn other things. There shouldn’t be more homework, right? don't don't. "
Xu Haiqing thought that since his father found a teacher for him, he would have to do more homework in the future, so what?
Now that my sister is arranging those for him, it's almost killing him, and I can't write them.
If the teacher stays here again, will he cry to death?
Xu Shiyan, Sun Xiaofeng, Huang Shengli and others were stunned when they heard this, and then laughed.
"Haiqing, come, uncle will tell you."
Huang Shengli waved to Xu Haiqing and asked Xu Haiqing to come to him.
"The teacher my father mentioned doesn't give you homework for writing, but just teaches you singing, reciting, etc., without writing."
Xu Haiqing listened, can you learn something without doing homework? Is there such a good thing?
"Dad, really?" The little guy's eyes lit up immediately, it would be great if he could not do his homework.
Xu Shiyan looked helpless, he couldn't laugh or cry.
This kid, how could he be so lazy? When he heard that he didn't do his homework, how could he be happy?
"This is what I think, you should go to school next year, and I will find a teacher for you alone, so that you can learn something along the way.
You have to read the book as usual, and you have to write the homework left by the school.
On Saturdays or Sundays, you can learn some singing and reciting skills from the teacher. "
Look, this kid doesn't want to study at all, what can he do?
Study must be studied, books must be read, as for talents and specialties, they can be properly developed, this must not be put the cart before the horse.
Xu Haiqing lost his face when he heard it. He thought that if he wanted to learn something, he wouldn't need to study.
"Let's do whatever we want, it doesn't matter if we learn or not." If you can't play during the holidays and have to learn something, then it's meaningless.
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes and sighed, "Okay, go play first, and talk about it when you're older in two years."
The child is too young and uncertain, so don’t think too much about it.
I'll watch it in two years, and if he's still interested then let's talk about it.
"Hey, I got it." Xu Haiqing breathed a sigh of relief when he heard it, and went to play with his friends.
"How is it? I said this brat is too young to be sure, right?
Don't think about anything right now, let's wait until he is older. "
Such a big child is so focused on playing, who is willing to learn?
There are not many weirdos like Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, and normal children love to play.
What can Huang Shengli and others say? I can only advise you.
"The child is too young to see anything, so don't put too much pressure on the child.
Guide slowly in the future, who knows how much the child will achieve in the future, right? "
So, everyone put aside this topic and stopped discussing. They ate and drank while watching the performance on the stage.
The big guys have made a lot of money this year, like Ji Tongzhong, he alone has earned more than 20,000 this autumn and winter.
If the salary and commission from Shanhuozhuang are added, the couple will earn thirty to forty thousand.
And how about earning more than 10,000 yuan when harvesting wild vegetables in spring? In total, it adds up to a lot.
If you leave the family farming, how many years can you earn so much money?
Nan Zhendong went back to Daying a while ago, and Su Anying specially called him to come back to collect the money.
This year, Nan Zhendong worked with him and earned about 30,000 yuan. With so much money, Nan Zhendong was so happy that he couldn't find the north.
He has made up his mind to bring his wife and son over after the new year, and the land at home will be rented out and not planted.
As for parents, if they are willing to move here, they can stay together. If they are not willing to move, they will live in Daying for the time being, and we will talk about it later.
These two people can earn so much, let alone others?
At this time, the average worker only earns 150 or 60 yuan a month. If they can earn more than 2,000 yuan a year including bonuses, that would be pretty good.
They earn tens of thousands at once, catching up with others for more than ten years. Who is not happy with so much money?
Huang Shengkai and the others, from the moment they received the money, kept a smile on their faces.
His face was stiff with laughter, but the corners of his mouth were still raised.
I'm so happy, it's beautiful from the heart, I can't control it at all.
The children sang and danced, while the adults ate and drank underneath.
Every time the children performed a show, no matter whether the performance was good or not, everyone responded with warm applause.
Straight away the children jumped off the stage happily, and ran back to their seats to eat delicious food.
This meal started at five o'clock in the afternoon and didn't end until after eight o'clock.
In the end, the men all drank a lot, and they all walked a little wobbly.
I'm happy to make money, and the women can't say anything, so they each support their men and walk back.
It's easy for others to say, but Han Limin, Yang Junxian, and Xu Shian's families are all quite far away.
Walking back in the freezing cold at night was enough for them.
These guys were all drunk again, and they couldn't be allowed to drive.
Xu Shiyan said, let Yang Junxian and Han Limin's family live with him, and Xu Shi'an's family live with Xu Chenghou.
Take a good night's rest and go home tomorrow morning.
It’s okay for these few to think about it, anyway, they are not outsiders, so where do they live?
So, Yang Junxian's family of three and Han Limin's family of five went to Xu Shiyan's side.
Xu Shiyan's house has a big place, and there are plenty of residences, and they can live in whatever arrangement they want.
The children were so happy now, Xu Haiyuan, Han Zhenwen and others had to urge them to sleep together.
Xu Shiyan was afraid that they would disturb Chu Xuanhuai's rest by making too much noise, so he arranged for them to live in Lai Pigui's house.
Anyway, these kids don't think the rascals are tasty, but they are very rare. They teased the rascals for a while before going to sleep.
Su Anying, Ji Yufeng, Liu Chunhua led Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui to live in the east room.
Xu Shiyan, Yang Junxian, and Han Limin live in Westinghouse.
The three big men all drank, lay down and chatted for a while, and then fell asleep.
The snoring made them so loud that it was like thunder.
"It's a good thing to sleep separately, otherwise, it will be noisy to death this night." Several women in the east room said so.

chapters.title: Chapter 633: Money can't buy meat
chapters.content:
Chapter 633 Money can't buy meat
After the accounts were settled and the dividends were distributed, each family took hundreds of thousands, happily preparing for the New Year.
At the venue, the staff meeting has long been over, and the year-end bonus has also been distributed in advance.
There are more bonuses this year. In addition to the fixed task salary, ordinary employees can also receive more than 2,000 year-end bonuses.
But everyone was so happy that they wanted to go to the market to buy more New Year's goods when they were not busy.
But at this time, everyone suddenly realized that they had money to spend and nothing to buy.
The pork stall had a long line up early in the morning.
Two big fat pigs were sold out in less than two hours, and they were late, so they couldn't be queued at all.
Is this nonsense? For Chinese New Year, who doesn’t want to buy more meat, make dumplings, buns, fried meatballs, fried tenderloin, and crispy white meat.
What can I do without meat?
Because most of the local ginseng is grown, the grain output is low.
Even if each household raises pigs, there are at most one or two pigs, and they save their roots to kill themselves for food.
Don’t wait for takeaway, relatives and friends will come over and share a piece with you.
It is still like this to raise pigs in crop yards, but the workers in the field don’t raise pigs at all, where can they get it?
Pointing to the point that the state purchases and supplies, it’s okay to eat in normal life, how can it be enough for Chinese New Year?
This is true for pork, not to mention other non-staple foods.
The participating workers couldn't buy things with money, and they were all in a hurry and didn't know what to do.
"General manager, everyone responded that it was the Chinese New Year and there were not many things to buy.
Look at this matter, can you respond to the above? "
Li Chengrong, Xiao Peng and the others were at a loss, so they came to Xu Shiyan.
I hope Xu Shiyan will respond to his superiors, can he send a batch of pork, fish, fruit, etc. to the participants, so that everyone can have a prosperous year.
In the past, it was okay to have less money, but with more money, you can’t buy anything. Who wouldn’t feel bad?
"When is this? Seeing that the new year is almost over, I will respond to the higher authorities. When the leader approves it, the new year will be over." Xu Shiyan shook his head.
"Then what should I do? I don't know what's going on this year. The Songjianghe market is the same. There is a shortage of everything, and the prices have also risen.
If you say it will go up a little bit, you can go up a little bit, and you can buy it, but you can’t buy anything now. "
Li Chengrong, they were all panicked, what is this?
Now it’s strange, the more the price increases, the crazier these people will buy and grab them all.
Not only the participating employees rushed to buy things, but those from the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau and farmers in various towns rushed to buy things.
It's a big New Year's Eve, and I can't buy anything. How can I live this year?
"You should know that we earn money by participating in the field, and others also earn money by participating in households. Not to mention the Forestry Bureau, they are richer than us."
The ginseng market is still very good this year, and the economy is on the rise. Both workers and farmers have money in their hands.
What do you say when you have money? Don't you want to buy more?
Furthermore, it is also related to the overall environment. Nowadays, the prices of many commodities are rising, and many people are hoarding things at home, and the more they hoard, the more they go up.
"Okay, you two don't worry.
In this way, you go to arrange the team, and I will contact you later.
Let the financial staff of our field, plus the logistics staff, go out and go shopping. "
At this time, you can no longer rely on your superiors, and there is no room for time, so let's find a way by ourselves.
Li Cheng let them hear it, and knew that Xu Shiyan must have an idea.
So I hurriedly called the logistics, finance, and transportation teams to a meeting.
"Just now I contacted both Changtu and Dandong in Liaoning Province. You are divided into two groups, and one group goes to Changtu.
It is very common for farmers to raise pigs there, with a large stock of live pigs and low prices.
I made an agreement with the people in the county over there, let them help with the acquisition.
You go over there, butcher it over there and freeze it directly, just pull the pork belly back. "
At the Ginseng Festival, Xu Shiyan met a lot of people, including cadres from Liao Province. Through them, he made a lot of connections, so the news is relatively well-informed.
The price of live pigs in Changtu is cheaper than here, and the quantity is large.
It’s Chinese New Year, and all participating households have shared a lot of money, so they simply went to pull a few carts of pork back and share a share, so that everyone can have a prosperous year.
As for Dandong, it is close to the sea, and there are more seafood.
At this time, they are all frozen and can be transported long distances. Bringing back a batch of frozen fish and shrimp can also enrich the dining table.
No way, for those who don’t rely on the sea, it would be nice if they can eat some frozen goods, so I dare not ask for too much.
"There are also fruits over there. You can get apples, pears and so on. You can get a few carts and cover them with straw curtains and sacks. Just don't freeze them.
The money is first used on the mat in the field, and the cost is calculated later, as long as the field does not lose money, it is right to give benefits to the big guys. "
It’s New Year’s Eve, everyone has been busy for a year, and it’s good to have some cheap non-staple food to make everyone happy.
When Li Chengrong and the others heard this, they were overjoyed, and immediately arranged for people to leave for Liao Province.
Participants have their own transportation team, and more than a dozen trucks set off in a mighty manner.
According to what Xu Shiyan said, one team will pull all kinds of frozen sea fish, and the other team will pull pork.
Frozen sea fish is simple, and Xu Shiyan contacted them in advance, and they paid for loading there and then pulled them back.
Pork is a bit more troublesome. After Li Chengrong and others arrived there, they helped collect a lot.
But this thing can't just pull the pig back, the journey is quite long, what if it dies along the way?
So they have to be slaughtered locally, frozen into pork buns and shipped back.
So they hired local people to slaughter, and the slaughter continued to be harvested, and they also rented a warehouse to store meat.
During the cold winter months in Northeast China, the temperature is tens of degrees below zero, and the pork can be frozen so hard overnight that even a dog can’t eat it.
Anyway, just watch and don't let people steal it.
In a few days, more than 200 pigs were harvested, the pigs were unloaded, and several carts were loaded.
The leaders here in Changtu helped to obtain the transportation quarantine certificate, hired someone to load the truck, and shipped it back directly.
When Li Cheng allowed them to return to Donggang, it was already the end of the Spring Festival.
As soon as the car arrived, the loudspeaker blared.
When the workers and their family members heard that pork and frozen fish and prawns were brought in, the prices were much cheaper than those on the market, so many people came here.
There are now more than 1,300 employees at the venue. Now that everyone has money, who doesn’t want to prepare more things for the New Year?
Now, your family has 30 catties, mine has 50 catties, your family has pork knuckles, and my family needs a pig’s head to add more goods.
Two hundred or so pigs, in a day's work, these people are almost divided.
As for those frozen fish and frozen shrimp, not to mention, some people directly carry a lump back home, and those with poorer conditions are also carried by two partners.
Soon, those frozen fish and shrimps are not much left.
Some people in Donggang Town heard that they were also relying on their connections, and they all wanted to buy some.
"Okay, let's keep the leftovers first, don't sell them for now." Xu Shiyan saw that there were not many things left, so he stopped immediately.
The cadres in the field have to save some relatives or something.
As long as there are enough workers in the field, don’t sell the rest, just keep it.
"Old Li, Lao Dai, um, let's go to Secretary Lin together later, and send him something for the New Year."
Lin Qiyue has already handed over the work, and recently went home to clean up, preparing to go to the city next year.
No matter how you say it, this is also the secretary of the venue, he must have a share of the New Year's goods, and it happens to be delivered, and the big guys can chat for a while.
Waiting for the next year, people will go to the city, so it is not easy to find a chance to chat.

chapters.title: Chapter 634: behind the transfer
chapters.content:
Chapter 634 behind the transfer
Lin Qiyue has been transferred to work and is about to go to work in the city.
His wife was originally a teacher at Canchang Elementary School, but this time her job was transferred to a city elementary school.
The children in the family are grown up, so there is no need to worry about them when they are studying outside.
So the couple are packing up their things at home these days, preparing to move in the next year.
Xu Shiyan, together with Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong, and Han Limin, carried half a fan of pork, a lump of frozen fish, and a lump of shrimp to the Lin family.
"Secretary Lin, are you at home? It's Chinese New Year, and I'll bring you New Year's goods."
The big guy is used to calling Lin Qiyue, and he can't change it for a while, so he still calls it that way.
"Hey, look at you, what are you doing? Why did you arrange so many things?"
Lin Qiyue is packing things at home.
He has worked in the field for nearly 20 years, and he has lived in this house for more than ten years.
Now that I have to move away, don’t I have to pack up all these things outside the house?
Don’t look at the usual feeling that you can’t see how many things you have at home. At this time, you will find that there are countless old and new ones, and there are corners and corners everywhere.
There are so many things in one swipe, why don’t you choose?
Divide the useful and useless ones, take away the ones that can be taken away, and give away or throw away the ones that cannot be taken away.
Lin Qiyue and his wife were packing their things, when they heard someone calling him outside, they hurried out to look.
Seeing Xu Shiyan and the others carrying things, Lin Qiyue was a little surprised.
"Where did you get so much food? Didn't you say that meat is difficult to buy this year?"
In recent days, Lin Qiyue stayed behind closed doors, and his wife didn't go to work.
The couple didn't know what happened outside, let alone a batch of non-staple food brought back from other places.
"This was shipped from our factory a few days ago, and sold to the employees of the factory at a low price.
I saw that both of you didn't go, I guess you two are packing your things at home, no, we brought them here specially for you.
No matter what happens, have a good time in the new year, and some of us have to come to drink with you when we have time. "
Xu Shiyan put down the half-skimmed pork on his shoulders and said with a smile.
"Oh, look, you are still thinking about it. Come on, hurry up and sit in the house.
Daughter-in-law, pack up these things quickly, and put the water on slowly.
After a few dishes at noon, I have to have two drinks with Xiao Xu Laoli and the others. "
Lin Qiyue was very happy, he quickly reached out to take all the things, and greeted Xu Shiyan and others to enter the east room to talk.
Lin Qiyue’s family has two children, one is studying at university and the other is studying at technical secondary school.
Seeing Xu Shiyan and others, the two children came over to say hello, made tea and served them, and then went to the kitchen to help their mother pack things.
"Sit down, oops, I've been busy cleaning up the house these days, so I didn't go back to work.
I really want to talk to you about something.
Just right, you are not allowed to leave today, eat at home, we have to drink. "
Lin Qiyue warmly greeted Xu Shiyan and the others to sit down, poured tea for everyone, and called his wife, bringing melon seeds and candies.
"Secretary Lin, don't be busy, and don't make sister-in-law busy.
This is just like our own home, we can do it ourselves. "Xu Shiyan waved his hands hurriedly.
"I've been transferred, and I can no longer be called the secretary. You can call me by my name, or Lao Lin." Lin Qiyue laughed.
"Xiao Xu, I just wanted to chat with you these days.
It's not easy for you to be in the current position, but you have to lead our field and work harder to make some achievements. "
"I don't know how many people miss your position.
If it wasn’t for the support of the old management and the provincial government to promote you this time, the county would have made up its mind a long time ago. "
Lin Qiyue went to the city a few days ago, met Guan Enxue, and learned a lot of inside stories.
"Do you know? At the other end of the field, I'm optimistic about your position.
There is also that Chen Jihui, who is also moving around, so he wants to transfer here.
Originally, the county wanted to get me to the county people's congress and transfer you to the ginseng research institute.
Then the director of the second participant was transferred to be the secretary, and Chen Jihui came over to be the director. "
Lin Qiyue didn't hold anything back, so he told Xu Shiyan all the things in the county.
Xu Shiyan and others froze on the spot.
"Who is so wicked to come up with such an idea?
Damn it, is this an enmity with the two of you? "When Li Bingzhuo heard it, he was blown up on the spot.
Lin Qiyue's position has no real power, and it is purely a place for people who are almost sixty years old to retire.
Lin Qiyue is not yet fifty, and his work ability is outstanding. Isn't it nonsense to transfer him there?
As for Xu Shiyan calling the Ginseng Research Institute? Not even Lin Qiyue.
In a field, you manage more than a thousand employees, but when you go to a research institute to manage those 20 or 30 people, you have to look at other people's faces and ask for money?
Damn, who is so talented and can come up with such a bad idea?
"Who needs to say?" Xu Shiyan shook his head, as expected, his father had guessed it, and there were really many lawsuits behind it.
"Thanks to our cooperation with the organization to set up a pharmaceutical factory, they appointed you as the factory director.
Because of the two of us, the old manager quarreled with several leaders in the county and the city.
Later, it was the province that called, so we didn't really transfer the two of us to the county.
At that time, the province issued a statement, saying that it would transfer our venue directly to the provincial management. The city saw that things were not good, so it didn't dare.
Finally decided, I was transferred to the city, and the participating venue was changed to a participating company, which was under the jurisdiction of the city. "
Lin Qiyue shook his head and sighed, how about saying that he is not afraid of bad things, but afraid of bad people?
Yi Zhanchang has developed so well in the past few years, everyone is jealous and wants to pick peaches.
This time, if they hadn’t cooperated with the organization, had a strong waist, and had Guan Enxue’s arguments to try to **** them, they really wouldn’t have been so good.
"If you have free time, remember to go to the city to see the old manager, and the old manager in the county, and don't cut off contact.
Oh, by the way, he also transferred that Chen Jianzhang, to the Municipal Bureau of Agriculture.
Isn’t his family still in Donggang? During Chinese New Year, you remember to visit his house.
These old relationships and acquaintances must be maintained. "
Lin Qiyue was worried that Xu Shiyan was so focused on studying how to make money that he didn't know how to manage other things.
These human relations have to be maintained as hard as possible, and they may be useful at any time, so they must not be unfamiliar.
"Uh, uh, okay, I know."
Xu Shiyan knew that Lin Qiyue was doing it for his own good and for the sake of the occasion, so he nodded quickly and agreed.
"Hey? Isn't that Chen Jihui the director of Quanyang Beverage Factory? Why is he thinking of transferring here again?"
Dai Chunrong next to him suddenly remembered something wrong, Chen Jihui didn't want the beverage factory over there?
"Don't mention it, they originally wanted to set up a brewery, but they got in the middle and had to learn from us, making champagne, drinks, and mineral water.
As a result, the brewery didn't get up, and neither did others.
Ginseng Festival is such a great opportunity, even the Shaoguo in Xinglong Township ordered nearly ten thousand catties of liquor.
In their factory, they ordered thousands of pieces of champagne, not to mention mineral water, almost no orders.
I heard that the factory was going to be yellow, and Chen Jihui was in a hurry, so he tried to dig around and wanted to move the place. "
When Chen Jihui was mentioned, Lin Qiyue shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 635: don't pick up the mess
chapters.content:
Chapter 635 Don't pick up the mess
Xu Shiyan knows more about the beverage factory in Quanyang.
During the Ginseng Festival, Bingshan Beverage Factory received a lot of orders, after which someone found Guo Shouye.
I want to make peace, let Bingshan Beverage Factory give up some orders to Quanyang.
The other party said it nicely, why is the Bingshan Beverage Factory too busy to complete the order and deliver the goods when the time comes.
Brother units couldn't bear to watch and wanted to help.
He also said that if he wanted to arrange for someone to come to study, he could also pay to buy the formula from Bingshan Beverage Factory.
Alternatively, it is also okay to cooperate with Bingshan Beverage Factory, and Quanyang can become a branch factory to grow together.
Guo Shouye's attitude is very clear, we don't need help, and we don't want to cooperate with anyone.
I just want to earn my own money, and no one should take advantage of it.
No matter who came to intervene, Guo Shouye just gritted his teeth and refused to let go, and the leaders of the Forestry Bureau also supported him.
Although the beverage factory is on the boundary of Fusong, it is a subsidiary enterprise of the Forestry Bureau, and the county has no control over it.
There is no other way, this matter can only be left alone.
Later, Quanyang also wanted to follow the example of Bingshan Beverage Factory, replacing all mineral water with plastic packaging.
As a result, I was told that at present, food-grade plastic packaging in the province is given priority to Bingshan Beverage Factory.
After all, it is an export-earning enterprise, no matter where it is, it must fully support it.
Quanyang wants output but no output, wants orders but no orders, and still wants to use plastic packaging? No.
"Hey, it's a good factory, it's running like this, Chen Jihui still wants to transfer elsewhere?
If I were his leader, I would just hit him and tell him to go home and farm.
How much money was invested in that factory? I haven't earned any money in the past few years, and it's all in vain. "
Dai Chunrong said angrily after hearing Lin Qiyue's words.
"If they didn't compete with us at the beginning, if we voted for this project, what do you think the factory looks like now? The storage is more prosperous than the factory in Bingshan."
Hearing Dai Chunrong's words, Xu Shiyan also sighed.
It is really a good water source for nothing, the water quality is good, and the water flow is large.
The spring in Quanyang binds the holy mountain spring and the canyon spring together, and the water gushing volume cannot keep up with one-tenth of others.
What a good source of water, I'm blind for nothing.
"Huh? Xiao Xu, otherwise, we can take down Quanyang's place.
I think that end is really good, but it is almost yellow now, which is a pity.
If we take over this place and join forces with Bingshan Beverage Factory and our beverage factory, we can do something big. "
Dai Chunrong has always been thinking about that spring water, so he gave Xu Shiyan an idea.
"Old Dai, this matter is not easy, and the Provincial Beverage Factory will not let it go easily.
Even if you let go, you will definitely have to kill a lot of money, and it won't be too cheap.
And there are full-time workers over there, and the outside insurance is not complete and they are in arrears of foreign debts. Whoever takes over now is tantamount to holding a hedgehog in both hands, which is not worthwhile. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, he doesn't want this mess.
If he wants to expand the factory, there are plenty of places.
On Jingyu's side, Shao Yong called several times and wanted to talk to him about cooperation, but he hadn't made up his mind yet.
Furthermore, where is the good spring water? If Xu Shiyan wanted to, he could find a lot of them. There was really no need to pick up a broken factory.
The key is that the factory is now a piece of dog skin plaster, whoever touches it will have to stick it, and it cannot be shaken off.
Chen Jihui is a fart. If he wants to grab other people's water, he will grab it. If he wants to build a factory, he will build it. Now that the business is not good, he wants to run away?
How can it be so easy?
Looking at the whole county, no, even the whole city and the whole province, except for the Bingshan Beverage Factory on Guo Shouye's side, and the Shengshan Tianquan Water Factory on the other side of the field, no one dared to take over the stall on the other side of Quanyang.
As long as no one picks up, Chen Jihui has to lie there obediently. He wants to transfer? Still want to call here? He is so beautiful.
Just wait, after the new year, the old boy will suffer, let him play? Let him play big this time.
As for the factory in Quanyang, what's the rush? Wait until Chen Jihui plays himself to death.
The water source in Quanyang is good, and it is also close to the Songjiang River, so it is easy to manage.
It would be a lie to say that Xu Shiyan was not tempted, but no matter how tempted he is, this matter cannot be rushed.
Wait, be patient and wait, now, whoever is in a hurry is the loser.
Wait until the factory is so dead that no one can save it, and then we can start all over again, saving money and worry.
Now, forget it, he doesn't want to get in trouble.
When Dai Chunrong heard it, he also had the same reasoning.
"Well, that's right, forget it, let's just stick to what we have now and it's fine."
Lin Qiyue listened to the conversation between Xu Shiyan and Dai Chunrong, but nodded without expressing any opinion.
Xu Shiyan is the most reassuring because of this, no matter what time it is, he is so safe and does not take risks.
If it were another person, knowing that the factory in Quanyang would not be able to continue, and he had the strength to revive the factory, many people would think about picking up a leak or something.
But Xu Shiyan just doesn't want to be tempted. This guy, just focus on this point. If the participation is in his hands, don't worry.
Several people were originally participating in the old team, they are familiar with each other, and they cooperated very well before.
Although it is said that Lin Qiyue is leaving now, he still wants to participate.
Everyone gathered together, talking and chatting, all discussing how to participate in the venue, no, the participating companies will be better and better.
Everyone was chatting, and time passed before they knew it.
When Lin Qiyue's daughter-in-law Qiao Yaru prepared the food and served it, everyone realized that it was getting late.
"Oh, look, we're just chatting here, leaving my sister-in-law busy for so long."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly got up and was about to help serve the meal.
"No, no, let's sit and talk, it's rare for you to come, how can I let you work?
Just in time to chat with Lao Lin, alas, he has been participating in the field for many years, and he is reluctant to leave, always sighing. "
Qiao Yaru waved his hand, making Xu Shiyan and the others sit at ease.
"Just a few dishes, no one needs to move, I'll serve them right away.
Later, you will have a few drinks with Lao Lin, and then go to the city. There are probably not many people who can drink with him. "
These are old friends and partners for many years, and they are reliable and trustworthy.
Going to the city to change to a new environment, who knows who is around?
Qiao Yaru worked very quickly, and served eight dishes in a short time.
Stewed mackerel, fried saury, boiled prawns, stewed tofu with braised pork, these were all brought over by Xu Shiyan and the others just now.
The frozen fish shipped out from the market include mackerel and saury.
The knifefish should actually be called hairtail, which is what the locals call it.
The prawns are not small, they have not been frozen for a long time, and they are quite fresh.
Since it was sent by others, I just made it and tasted it together.
So Qiao Yaru put everything in water to slow down, and cooked everything that should be stewed and fried to entertain Xu Shiyan and the others.
The other four dishes are fried cabbage slices, sauerkraut vermicelli, canned luncheon meat, and canned fruit.
"Well, aren't we going to move out after the next year? We don't have that much food at home.
Eight simple dishes, you can deal with them. We have enough drinks, you can have whatever you want. "
Qiao Yaru felt embarrassed, half of the eight dishes were just delivered.
"Sister-in-law, this is rich enough. Sister-in-law is working hard, let's sit down and eat together."
Xu Shiyan and Han Limin both invited Qiao Yaru to sit down and eat together.
"Where are your family Lin Hong and Lin Hao? Let's call them together, they are all from our own family, we just want to eat together."
Lin Hong and Lin Hao are the two sons of Lin Qiyue's family.
Qiao Yaru didn't want to bring the children over for dinner, but he couldn't hold back the big guy's kindness, so he finally brought the children over to eat with Xu Shiyan and the others.
Lin Qiyue and others poured wine, and no one tried to persuade them to drink. They just chatted and drank, chatting and chatting intimately.
Although Lin Qiyue was transferred to the city, he was in the Commerce Bureau and was in charge of various commercial activities in the city, so he was able to control the participants.
They got along well in the first place, and with this level of relationship, they will definitely take care of the participants more in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 636: New Year's gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 636 Send New Year's goods
The Chinese New Year is approaching, the venues are closed, and the work unit is fine.
Xu Shiyan and the others drank and chatted at Lin Qiyue's house until four o'clock in the afternoon, then left and went home.
Xu Shiyan had just returned home and sat down for a while, when the phone rang again.
"Hello? Excuse me, who are you looking for?" Xu Shiyan was a little confused, and his voice was a little higher.
"Brother, who did you drink with?"
On the other end of the phone, Guo Shouye could tell right away that Xu Shiyan had been drinking.
I don’t know how much, but it must be the top.
"Brother, it's you, oops, I just came home after drinking at our secretary Lin's at noon.
What's the matter, brother, are you busy? "Xu Shiyan became energetic all of a sudden, and asked quickly.
"I can't find you if I have nothing to do?
You are not righteous, where did your unit go to get so much pork? Why don't you tell me a word? "
Guo Shouye smiled on the phone, complaining about Xu Shiyan.
"Huh? Didn't your bureau give out welfare this year? I thought you had it every year, so I didn't ask you."
Xu Shiyan was taken aback. Didn’t the Forestry Bureau give benefits to workers every Chinese New Year?
The Forestry Bureau has wood, and every year it exchanges wood with fellow units for rice, oil, etc., and provides benefits to workers.
Xu Shiyan thought that they could also get meat.
"How can there be? In previous years, there were not many, and they were all made of rice noodles.
Usually there is enough meat to eat, but who knows what’s going on this year, it’s the end of the year, and the supply of meat is not enough. "
Guo Shouye couldn't help complaining on the phone.
"That's no problem, it's time to collect the pigs and pull them back, so I won't be in a hurry."
Xu Shiyan glanced at the solar calendar card, it is already the 26th of the twelfth lunar month, and this year the Chinese New Year will be on the 29th of the twelfth lunar month, so it is too late.
"My unit still has some, others don't, bro, you must have them here.
Let Xu Haiyuan deliver it to you tomorrow, it will be enough to keep it for the Chinese New Year. "
He doesn't care about outsiders, his family must have something to eat.
The unit still left some, just thinking about giving away favors to Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong and others.
Originally, Xu Shiyan was also thinking about it. Tomorrow, together with Xu Haiyuan, he would send some to Guo Shouye and the leaders of the Forestry Bureau.
I just didn't expect Guo Shouye to call.
"Well, I won't be polite to you, it just so happens that I haven't seen my eldest son for a while.
how? Do they still have classes during the holidays? "The eldest son that Guo Shouye mentioned was of course Xu Haiyuan.
"Hey? By the way, where does the child go to junior high school? If not, he can transfer to the No. 1 Middle School of the Forestry Bureau.
The quality of teaching here is better than that of Donggang, the source of learning is good, and it will be better when you come here. "
Guo Shouye suddenly remembered that his godson will start junior high school next fall.
The Forestry Bureau is a large unit with its own primary school, junior high school, and high school.
Enterprises run schools, the conditions are good, and the quality of teachers is also high. Of course, the quality of teaching is good.
Guo Shouye said this, naturally hoping that Xu Haiyuan can have a better learning environment and be more promising in the future.
"Brother, let me ask Xu Haiyuan about this and see what he means.
One middle school is good, but it is a little far away, and there is no companion for going back and forth.
We Yuanyuan is young, so I am still not at ease. "
No. 1 Middle School is indeed good in teaching quality, but there is a shortcoming. The Songjiang River is in chaos, and No. 1 Middle School is also in chaos. The children in it are wild.
Speaking of it, Xu Haiyuan's ability is not afraid of being bullied.
Xu Shiyan is just worried that his son is young and not qualitative enough, so it is easy to go astray if those children take him with him.
Compared to Donggang, the law and order is much better.
Of course, Xu Haiyuan had to decide where to study.
If he is willing to go to the No. 1 Middle School, he can go. Anyway, with Guo Shouye around, no one dares to bully him.
Guo Shouye agreed, "Well, that's fine, I'll wait for you to ask him, if he's willing to come, I'll say hello to No. 1 Middle School."
Normally, No. 1 Middle School only accepts children from the families of employees of the Forestry Bureau, and does not accept students from Donggang and surrounding villages.
Of course, it is only Guo Shouye who will accept it or not.
"By the way, have you heard about the Quanyang Beverage Factory?
Shouting over there, the factory will be exchanged for two million.
Our leader was really tempted, and if he said it was not enough, he would pay for it, take over and rectify it, and definitely make money. "
Actually, this last matter is what Guo Shouye wants to talk about.
"Brother, we will meet and talk about this tomorrow, but I can't explain it clearly in a few sentences on the phone."
Xu Shiyan did not reply directly to Guo Shouye, some things had to be discussed in detail in person.
Just like that, the two hung up the phone.
Xu Shiyan drank wine in the afternoon and was not hungry.
When Su Anying saw it, this guy fell asleep soundly.
Su Anying didn't wake him up either, she just found a quilt and covered him up so that Xu Shiyan could sleep well.
The next morning, Xu Shiyan led Xu Haiyuan to the work unit, loaded some meat, fish, shrimp, etc. from the warehouse, and asked someone to record the account first.
Then I went to the farm again, and loaded some mutton and venison from the farm.
Since all the meat-eating fur animals have been withdrawn from the farm, there are fewer other poultry and livestock.
The main thing is to keep what I eat at home, not to take out.
It’s Chinese New Year, Xu Shiyan told Xu Shian in advance to kill a few sheep, deer, etc., and save it for the New Year’s gift.
