In winter, meat is better stored, so Xu Shian prepared it a few days in advance.
Xu Shiyan came here, loaded the car directly, then drove the car, took his son, and went to Guo Shouye's place together.
Met with Guo Shouye, and Guo Shouye accompanied Xu Shiyan to the homes of the leaders of the Forestry Bureau to deliver things there.
It's not that Xu Shiyan has to pamper someone and give gifts on poles, but that there must be exchanges between people.
What happened to Xu Shiyan? The leaders of the Forestry Bureau never left behind.
It's the Chinese New Year, so Xu Shiyan has to feel sorry for it, it's such a thought.
It’s not an expensive gift, just a little food, if you don’t make a mistake, it’s just exchanges between friends.
Sure enough, when the leaders of the Forestry Bureau saw Xu Shiyan coming to deliver things in person, ouch, they were all very happy, and the director had to keep Xu Shiyan for dinner.
Xu Shiyan naturally wouldn't stay, he chatted with him for a while after delivering the things, and then got up to leave.
gave away a circle of things, and then the two of them followed Guo Shouye back to Guo's house.
Peng Yucui also cooked here, leaving them to eat at home.
Xu Shiyan used his time to mention the matter of Quanyang Beverage Factory to Guo Shouye.
"Brother, this matter can't be rushed, we have to wait for a while.
Waiting over there is really dead, no one can save it, let's talk about it.
You have to know, don't look at the two million shouting over there, who knows how much you owe outside? Who knows how much wages are owed to workers?
I don't understand these junk things, whoever takes advantage of it will have to get involved.
We are not in a hurry. Anyway, our factory is developing very well now, and everything is on the right track. There is no need to deal with those bad things. "
"If we really want to develop elsewhere, there are plenty of places. Besides, we can't just do it for the unit, we have to earn some money ourselves."
Xu Shiyan laughed as he spoke. He knew these things in his heart and was not in a hurry.
"By the way, brother, I still have something to do. I need to ask you for help. Do you have someone at the Quanyang Forestry Bureau? I'll ask them for help."

chapters.title: Chapter 637: Prawns for reunion dinner
chapters.content:
Chapter 637 Prawns at the reunion dinner
When Xu Shiyan said this, Guo Shouye stopped being entangled.
Yes, there are many good springs in the Changbai Mountain area. If you really want to build a factory, you can’t do it. Why bother to pick up other people’s junk?
This advantage may not be easy to take advantage of, and it will cause a mess if it is not good. You really can't worry, let's talk about it later.
It's the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth lunar month, and everyone is very busy.
Xu Shiyan and his son had dinner at Guo's house, stayed for a while, and then hurried home.
Chinese New Year is early this year, and the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth lunar month is New Year’s Eve.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying are both busy, and there are several children at home eating.
So at the beginning of spring, Xu Chenghou said that he would catch pigs and raise them, but Xu Shiyan and his wife refused to let them.
I don’t have pigs at home, so I don’t need to kill pigs.
There is a tofu shop in Donggang, and they have a good relationship with Xu Shiyan.
People have said a long time ago that Xu Shiyan doesn’t need to make tofu at home during the Chinese New Year, and he will send a plate when the time comes.
The kindness is hard to turn down, and Xu Shiyan is not easy to refuse, so there is no need to make tofu.
Pork, fish, shrimp, etc. are all made by the unit, just spend money to buy some and bring them back.
The farm has processed mutton and venison, as well as various vegetables, mushrooms, and wild vegetables grown in the greenhouse.
Xu Shi'an sent his son away, and he sent them here, young and old.
Many other things were sent by relatives and friends.
Xu Shiyan and his wife's current influence in Donggang, who wouldn't want to have a good time with him?
At that time, if the couple give them any chance, others will be able to make a lot of money along with them, right?
Asking for something, it's Chinese New Year, why don't you give me something?
People like Huang Shengkai, Zhao Jianguo, Li Daniu, etc. are all earning money, and they can’t send something over for the New Year. Look at the old couple Xu Chenghou?
Xu’s family pushed everything they could, and confiscated most of their belongings, especially those of the participating workers.
Of course, relatives, and some close friends, don’t care about this, you can stay.
In this way, there is really nothing to buy in the market.
Not to mention the clothes, Xu Shiqin sent them back early, and Su Anying bought them back in Yangcheng.
All are ready-made clothes, and there is no need to make clothes for Chinese New Year as before.
This does not kill pigs, does not make tofu, and does not need to make new clothes. It is worry-free.
But I just feel that this year is not as lively as before.
Fortunately, there are these four children at home, and they are bouncing around and making noise all day long, which adds a lot of fun.
On the twenty-ninth New Year's Eve of the twelfth lunar month, Xu Chenghou and his wife came to Xu Shiyan's place to celebrate the New Year this year.
Zhou Guilan and Su Anying started to work in the morning, and Xu Jinping followed to help.
Xu Shiyan led the two sons to erect lantern poles in the yard, and paste couplets, blessing characters, and window grilles.
The children are all grown up and can help with work. Xu Shiyan looked at the two sons and felt very beautiful in his heart.
The reunion dinner is as rich as ever. In addition to the must-have dishes in previous years, this year there are more braised mackerel, fried octopus, and boiled prawns.
Spanish mackerel, you can see it in the market in winter in the past few years, and you can buy it once or twice a year and stew it.
Hairtail is not common, I have only eaten it twice, and I have never seen that prawn before, let alone cooked it.
Neither Zhou Guilan nor Su Anying knew how to make it, but Xu Shiyan said that if they really couldn’t do it, just put some green onion and **** and cook it directly.
This is simple, so it won't go bad, so Su Anying followed Xu Shiyan's instructions and made boiled shrimp.
In fact, apart from these, the Xu family also has a lot of seafood.
Dried shrimp, dried clams, scallops, sea cucumbers and other dry goods, and two boxes of frozen crabs.
These are all friends from Dandong, and they were specially sent to Xu Shiyan, saying that they were for the family to try something new.
Those dry goods can be saved and eaten slowly, but those two boxes of frozen crabs made the whole family suffer. Su Anying didn't know how to make these things at all.
The crab was frozen, and Xu Shiyan didn't know how long it had been frozen.
If the time is short and the meat quality is okay, it should be okay to eat, but it is not as fat as fresh crabs, and the meat will be empty.
If it is frozen for a long time, the crab meat will become mushy and not tasty.
Finally, Xu Shiyan said, don’t make crabs for the reunion dinner on New Year’s Eve, but cook two crabs another day to see how they look, and then talk about it.
"Mom, I want to eat prawns." As soon as the table was served, Xu Haiqing rushed to the plate of prawns.
I haven't eaten this thing before, and it makes me hungry just looking at it.
Not only Xu Haiqing, but several other children also stared at the shrimp, wanting to taste the taste of this thing.
Xu Shiyan started to teach the children how to peel the shrimp shells, and then put the grilled shrimp into the bowls of Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan.
"Father, Mom, try this shrimp. It's pretty good. I ate it at Lao Lin's that day. It was pretty good."
The prawns are really good. They should have been fished out and frozen. The prawns are firm and taste good.
Of course, it’s still incomparable with living people, so there’s no way, why tell them to live inland?
The storage and transportation conditions are not good this year, even if there are live shrimps, they cannot be shipped at all.
What do you mean by eating something cold? When I have a chance in the future, I will take my family to the beach and eat whatever I want.
"Well, it's good. This shrimp is really big and delicious."
Xu Chenghou picked up the shrimp meat and chewed it in his mouth, then nodded repeatedly.
"In the past, we have seen small shrimps in the river at most, or small shrimps, but we have never eaten such a big shrimp.
Old woman, you should try it too, it’s very good. "
Over there, Zhou Guilan ate it too, and it was really good, not the same as fish or meat.
Xu Shiyan picked up several more and gave them to Chu Xuanhuai.
"Master, when we have a chance in the future, let's go to the beach and eat well."
Chu Xuanhuai has never been there before when he traveled all over the world. This thing is not a rare thing in his place.
However, Chu Xuanhuai was very happy to pick up the prawns grilled by his apprentice.
"Don't say it, I haven't eaten it for some years.
Let’s save it, it’s good anywhere, but seafood can’t be eaten fresh. "
The old man happily put the shrimp meat in his mouth, chewed it, and nodded.
"It's okay, it's pretty good, eat it all, I'll do it myself, and you eat yours."
While speaking, those children had already picked up several shrimps and ate them, and only half of them were left on the plate.
Xu Chenghou and the others saw that these children were really willing to eat, so they all went to eat something else, and specially left the shrimp for the children.
Xu Shiyan also saw it, and asked Su Anying, how much did you cook? Add some more, if any.
Su Anying didn't expect the boiled prawns to be so popular, so she cooked that plate.
The plate of the Xu family's dishes is quite big, but there are quite a few of them.
I originally thought that there were so many dishes, enough to eat, but who would have thought that the children would be so rare when they see new things, so they can pick up so many in a short time?
Seeing this, Su Anying was about to get up and cook some more, but was stopped by Chu Xuanhuai and the others.
"It doesn't matter, it doesn't matter, let them eat it.
What about the dishes on this table? It's still hard to grill that stuff, so why not eat fish or chicken or something.
Today, the stewed chicken is very good, it is mushy enough, and the mushrooms are fresh. I love this. "
Old people are rare in children, Chu Xuanhuai loves these children, no worse than Xu Chenghou.
Children can eat whatever they like. With so many delicious foods, how can adults compete with them?

chapters.title: Chapter 638: ice grape juice
chapters.content:
Chapter 638 Iced Grape Juice
Chu Xuanhuai, Xu Chenghou and the others stopped her, and then Su Anying sat down to eat.
Over there, a few children had already eaten up a plate of prawns.
It was the first time for the Chinese New Year reunion dinner that the dishes could be eaten up.
But no one cared, Xu Chenghou smiled and watched his grandchildren eat, and felt more comfortable than eating in his own stomach.
After eating the shrimp, there are still so many delicious food. The children moved their positions and continued to eat other dishes.
When you can eat it, your digestion is good, everything tastes delicious, and it is a good dish on this table, so what are you waiting for if you don’t eat it?
There are not only delicious food on the table this year, but also a lot of drinks, which were brought by Guo Shouye.
In addition to the aerated ones, there are also blueberry juice, blue indigo juice, and the new winter product of the beverage factory, ice grape juice.
In recent years, a ginseng farm has cooperated with the Forestry Bureau to use old ginseng land and wasteland to develop various cash crops, including several mountain vineyards.
This autumn, some mountain vineyards are bearing fruit, and the yield is not bad.
In autumn, I was busy and had no time to pick them. I picked them after the snow fell.
The mountain grape juice that has been frozen by frost and snow is sweeter and more delicious than those picked in autumn, with a unique flavor.
Guo Shouye specially sent some over for the Xu family to drink during the New Year.
Several children each have a bottle of drink, eat two mouthfuls of vegetables, and then have a mouthful of sweet and sour drink. This little life is so beautiful.
Not long after, I ate one by one and my belly rounded.
"I can't, I can't eat anymore." Even Xu Haiqing, who can eat the most, also declared defeat.
Several adults shook their heads when they saw the children like that.
"You guys, how can this be full? It's clearly full.
Drink a stomach full of drinks, before the night, it's time to cry hungry again. "
How can it be adjusted? Anyway, there is a lot of food at home, whatever, they can't be hungry.
Children don't listen to adults at all, as long as they are full at the moment.
The reunion dinner was late, it started around four o'clock, and now it's almost five o'clock.
Xu Haiqing yelled that he wanted to watch TV.
A few days after Su Anying came back from Yangcheng, the TV also came back.
Originally, Xu Shiyan said that he would change the big TV to Chu Xuanhuai's room and the small one.
Chu Xuanhuai refused. He said that he was used to looking at the small ones, but his eyes were dizzy when he saw the big ones.
Xu Shiyan knew that these were all excuses, but the master disagreed, and Xu Shiyan didn't do anything, so he could only put the big TV in his room.
As soon as the big TV was installed, the children all ran here to watch TV.
The big one looks great, the people inside are big, the picture quality is clear, and it looks comfortable.
Xu Haiqing was anxious to watch TV, and Xu Haiyuan went to turn on the TV after obtaining the consent of the adults.
During the winter vacation, there are more TV programs, but during this time period, there are no good TVs, all over the world and Baihua Garden, that's all.
"Oh, why are there no monkeys? I want to see monkeys, and I want to see Monkey King."
Xu Haiqing watched those programs on TV, and said in a whimpering manner.
The monkey Xu Haiqing was talking about was, of course, Journey to the West.
Since all the 25 full episodes were released this year, my good fellow, these children are all obsessed, thinking about watching monkeys all day long.
Xu Haiqing is also like this. He wants to find monkeys as soon as he turns on the TV, but the TV station has the final say on this thing, and it is impossible to show monkeys every day.
"Is the TV station run by your family? You can watch whatever you want?
It’s good to see some, but if you keep talking about it, it will annoy our dad for a while, be careful that he won’t let you see anything. "
Xu Jinping glared at her younger brother twice, it would be nice to see some of them.
This is the Chinese New Year. Change to a normal day. It’s not past six o’clock. Want to watch TV? Go dreaming.
Xu Haiqing was trained by her sister, and suddenly stopped talking, and sat there obediently watching TV.
For children of this age, the appeal of television is still great.
It doesn’t matter what the performance is, as long as there are people on TV, they can watch it.
The children were watching TV, Su Anying cleaned up the table and the kitchen, and then together with Zhou Guilan, they chopped stuffing and noodles to make dumplings.
This year’s dumpling stuffing, in addition to the must-have cabbage, radish and pork stuffing every year, also has leek, elm, yellow mushroom and shrimp stuffing.
Leeks and yellow elm mushrooms are grown on the farm.
The two greenhouses in the farm don’t do anything else in winter, just grow a variety of vegetables, and save a few families to eat during the New Year.
Anyway, they don't point to making money, just for the convenience of their own food.
The emerald green chives and the tender yellow elm mushrooms all exude an attractive aroma.
Slowly boil the frozen prawns with water, peel off the shells, remove the shrimp threads, cut them into small pieces, and mix them into the stuffing.
In order to prevent the vegetable filling from getting watery and not easy to wrap, some meat filling is also mixed in it.
This dumpling stuffing doesn’t need to be cooked to eat, it just smells fresh, and the taste is really great.
The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law were busy kneading noodles and chopping stuffing, while Xu Chenghou followed Chu Xuanhuai and went back to the east room.
Especially Chu Xuanhuai, after all, he is getting older, no matter how good his physique is, his spirit will always be weaker.
I have to stare for a while now, otherwise I will have a hard time at night.
Years ago, everyone took a bath in the bathhouse at the Sanshi Hotel.
There is no need to wash in a large basin like in previous years, which saves a lot of trouble.
Xu Shiyan had nothing to do, so he was in the room with the children, watching TV and cracking sunflower seeds.
A few days ago, people sent a lot of frozen pears and persimmons, so I simply picked up a pot and soaked them in cold water.
It is said that New Year's Eve is the coldest time, but the Xu family can't feel it.
The windows were pasted with cloth strips as soon as winter came, and a layer of window film was sealed on the outside, and then a plastic shed was fastened on the outside.
As far as this warm-keeping measure is concerned, the three layers inside and outside can still be ventilated?
Cooking at noon, the kang was so hot that it burned my buttocks.
The boiler has not been turned off, and the radiator is hot.
Xu Haiyuan and the others were in the house, all wearing sweaters, and it was still too hot, so it was very comfortable to eat a frozen pear to cool off.
At 6:25, the cartoon, "Donald Duck and Mickey Mouse" began to show on the TV.
Now, Xu Haiqing stopped talking and stared at the TV intently, wishing he could get in.
"All of you stay away from the TV and come on the kang. If anyone is so close to the TV, I won't let him watch it."
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to lower his face and warn the children.
So, the children all went to the kang, sat down and watched TV obediently.
The exaggerated voice of Donald Duck on TV made the children laugh out loud, not to mention how happy they were.
"Listen, everyone, as long as there are cartoons, they will be happy.
This is living a life, that is, living a child.
You said that if there weren’t these children making noise, just a few adults at home, even if it’s Chinese New Year, it wouldn’t be much fun. "
Zhou Guilan was making noodles in the kitchen, and when she heard the laughter of the children in the room, she couldn't help laughing too.
How wonderful, living a life is popular.
If there are only two or three people all day long, quietly and without much movement, what's the point?

chapters.title: Chapter 639: tachymeter
chapters.content:
Chapter 639 Mind and Brain Calculation
Zhou Guilan's mother-in-law and daughter-in-law prepared the noodles and stuffing for making dumplings, so they put the panel and curtain on the kang and started making dumplings.
Xu Shiyan washed his hands and rolled the skin. Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui also washed their hands and came over to help with the wrapping.
Even though Xu Jinhui is still young, her hands are not stupid, and the dumplings are so small and exquisite that they are very beautiful.
Xu Haiyuan glanced at the panel, then quickly turned his head.
No way, this thing was beaten every time he saw it, and he had practiced it many times, but the wrapping was not good, and it couldn't catch up with the good-looking ones made by the third sister.
It's too shocking and sad, let's watch TV.
The leek stuffing loves water, so wrap the leek stuffing first, wrap a curtain, cover it with a clean white cloth immediately, and bring it to the shed outside.
This plastic shed is quite warm during the day when the sun is shining, and the temperature drops to minus ten degrees at night.
The dumplings were put in the shed, and when it was around ten o'clock, the outer skin was frozen hard, and the filling inside was not completely frozen, which was better than putting them in the house.
Start making dumplings before seven o'clock, and there are so many people working, no matter how young Xu Jinhui is, she never fails to make dumplings.
So at 8:30, all the dumplings are finished, so I can watch the party with peace of mind.
This year’s party was very lively, with comedians from all walks of life, and the cross talks and sketches were very exciting.
There is a program in the middle, which is selected and sent by the Liaoyuan No. 2 Experimental Primary School in this province. It is a collective quick calculation for children.
This program attracted Xu Jinping's attention.
Watching the children on TV quickly calculate the numbers reported by the host, the little girl's eyes widened immediately.
"Dad, I want to learn this."
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan could only smile wryly, "Girl, you seem to be too old. Look, they are all younger than you."
It is said that this kind of quick calculation is best practiced from the first grade, and the small abacus is simulated in the child's mind.
Through some formulas and high-intensity calculation training, children can form a mechanical memory.
So after hearing the host's report, he will give the answer very quickly.
Xu Shiyan didn't know how to train this.
Anyway, it seems that there were a few years in my previous life. There are a lot of trainings for quick calculation in this province, and many children go to learn it.
It became popular for a while, and then it disappeared and no one learned it anymore.
It is said that this does not have much effect on the improvement of mathematics ability.
Especially in junior high school and high school, mathematics pays more attention to logic and thinking, and this kind of quick calculation is useless.
"Besides, we don't have this locally, haven't you heard? This is from Liaoyuan, which is quite far from our place.
Even if I can send you there, you can only train for a period of time during the winter and summer vacations.
If you don't practice normally, you will soon become unfamiliar, and it will be useless in the end.
If you really like mathematics, why not buy some mathematics books for you when I go out next time, and you can read them yourself. "
Donggang is a rural area, and the development is slow.
It will take at least five or six years for these special interest classes to be passed on. Right now, there is really no such thing, and I can’t learn it.
"Okay, then I won't study, Dad, remember, buy me more math books next time."
Xu Jinping didn't commit any crimes, so she had to learn. Since Dad said he couldn't learn, let's forget it.
So, the father-daughter conversation is over, and everyone is watching TV again.
With the wonderful performance on TV, everyone laughed out loud.
Brilliant programs that attract everyone's attention and make people forget the passage of time.
Suddenly there was a burst of firecrackers, reminding Zhou Guilan, she turned her head and saw, ouch, it's almost eleven o'clock.
"Okay, let's boil the dumplings quickly, don't delay the paper delivery."
No matter how beautiful the party is, it can't delay the business, so the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law hurried to the kitchen, lit a fire and boiled water to cook dumplings.
At the other end, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan also quickly took out a large pile of burnt paper and spread it on the ground.
Xu Shiyan took out a ten-yuan bill and measured it a few times on the burnt paper.
Some people say that if the burnt paper is not printed, it will be blank after burning, which is useless.
In the early days, copper coins were used to print. In the middle years, feudal superstitions were abolished, and the copper coins of each family disappeared.
Nowadays, banknotes are used, and the banknotes with the largest denomination are compared a few times before they are printed.
Waiting for a few more years, this burnt paper will also come out new, with copper coin patterns on it, and specially printed Ming coins, so there is no need to bother so much.
After the burnt paper is printed, turn and draw with both hands, then fold it up and divide it into several parts.
The other side said that the water was boiling and the dumplings would be cooked immediately. Xu Shiyan held the paper and asked Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing to carry firecrackers, and the three of them went out to distribute paper and set off firecrackers.
With the sound of firecrackers saying goodbye to the old year, the new year is here.
The three of you set off a few strings of firecrackers outside, and then set off a few flash thunders, colorful pearls, diamond monkeys and so on.
It happened that the house was shouting for dinner, and the three of them didn't bother to put too much, so they hurried back to the house with their hands in their hands, ready to eat dumplings.
Dumplings stuffed with chives, when boiled, there will be a burst of aroma.
Before I stayed in the house, I couldn’t feel it. If I entered the house from the outside, the fresh fragrance would go straight into my nose, which would make people come out.
Especially Xu Haiqing, for the reunion dinner in the afternoon, he just went there in love with those drinks and filled his stomach with water.
I was hungry just now and ate some snacks.
Now smelling the aroma of dumplings, the little guy finally couldn't bear it anymore, and rushed into the house, yelling to have dinner quickly, he was hungry.
"Why did you say you were here in the afternoon? I have to ignore it. Are you hungry this time?"
Su Anying brought dumplings into the house, and when she heard her son shouting, she sneered.
"Wait, the adults haven't eaten at the table yet, what are you doing? There are no rules."
Su Anying glared at her youngest son, not allowing him to secretly reach out to eat the dumplings.
Xu Haiqing was stared at by her mother, so she could only sit there obediently, staring at the dumplings in front of her, and kept muttering in her heart.
Hurry up and eat, hurry up.
Two large pots, just cooking two kinds of fillings separately, and after a while they were all taken out and served on the table, and the big guys sat down to eat.
"Come on, let's all try this year's dumplings, leeks, shrimps, elm and yellow mushrooms, ouch, this is so delicious.
If you don’t like leeks, you can eat stuffed cabbage and radish.
Inside the two fillings, I put money, dates, peanuts, and sugar, to see who can eat the money. "
This is a clever trick to induce children to eat more, and it will work after all trials.
The children who were already hungry, when they heard this, didn’t they all stare?
But the dumplings are all wrapped in the same shape, with skins on the outside, so how do you know what's inside?
After looking at it for a long time, I couldn't see anything, so I had to eat it casually.
"Well, it's delicious. The leek and shrimp dumplings are so fresh and delicious."
Xu Chenghou took a bite out of a leek stuffing and nodded repeatedly.
"Tell me about how much better the conditions are now than before?
If this had been put in the past, who would have thought that they would be able to eat dumplings stuffed with leeks, elm and yellow mushrooms during Chinese New Year?
There is also this shrimp. In the past, at most, there was a whole little shrimp, which would be great.
Now, who would dare to think about making dumplings with prawns? "Xu Chenghou said with emotion while eating.
I don’t know why the following chapters can’t be published, and there is no abnormality in the background. Wait a minute, when the editor is back to work, I will ask about the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 640: Quanyang factory
chapters.content:
Chapter 640 Quanyang Factory
Unsurprisingly, the dumplings with leek, elm, yellow mushroom and shrimp are very popular. Everyone loves to eat them, and there are not many left in the end.
It was stuffed with cabbage and radish. Everyone just ate two for a token, and all were left in the end.
After eating dumplings on New Year’s Eve, the countdown started on TV at this time.
As soon as twelve o'clock struck, Xu Haiyuan and his younger brothers and sisters hurriedly kowtowed to their grandparents and master to pay New Year's greetings.
"Grandpa, grandma, and master, Happy New Year. I wish grandparents, grandma, and master good health and all the best."
Oops, the three old people were so happy that they quickly took out the red envelopes from their pockets and stuffed them for the children.
Regardless of how much money the family has or how good the children’s living conditions are, as long as they enter the Layue Gate, the children will look forward to the lucky money for the New Year.
The four children took the red envelopes, thanked the elders happily, and then ran away happily.
Sneakily opened the red envelope to take a look, then carefully put it in his pocket, and watched TV with a grin.
At 12:30, the melody of "Unforgettable Tonight" sounded, and this year's party ended.
The children let out a groan, and Xu Haiyuan turned off the TV casually.
"Come on, go to bed, I have to pay New Year's greetings in the morning."
Xu Shiyan urged the children to go to bed. These little guys can really endure it. After taking a nap at noon, they are still not sleepy at this point.
Watching TV, I really didn’t feel sleepy, but when the TV was turned off, the children immediately yawned.
So Chu Xuanhuai led Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing back to the east, Xu Chenghou and his wife led Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui to this room, and Xu Shiyan and his wife went to the west room.
Busy all day during the day, stay up until midnight at night, lie down and sleep soundly until dawn.
The first day of the first lunar month, a new year and a new look.
Wake up in the morning and eat hot dumplings or something, and the children put on new clothes.
Then Xu Shiyan and his wife took their children to the neighbors' houses to pay New Year's greetings, and then went to Han's house.
Taking advantage of the time when the children were playing at Han's house, Xu Shiyan went to Li Bingzhuo, Lin Qiyue, and Dai Chunrong to walk around.
On the road, I met those people who came out to pay New Year's greetings, and everyone greeted Xu Shiyan warmly.
Xu Shiyan has been in the field for six or seven years, and his popularity has always been good. Now that he has become the top leader, who is not polite to see him?
Turned around in a circle, went to pick up his wife and children, and then went to Songjiang He Guo Shouye.
Why are the two families close? Xu Haiyuan, who is celebrating Chinese New Year, can't go to see his godfather and godmother?
Guo Shouye was also very happy to see these Xu family children, and gave red envelopes to each of them.
Xu Shiyan also prepared red envelopes, but the children of the Guo family are all grown up, so how can they receive red envelopes? Don't wave your hands one by one.
"Brother, Fenghua is in his twenties this year? Do you have a date?"
The eldest and second child of Guo Shouye’s family both graduated from technical secondary school and started working. They are usually busy with work and have no time to come back.
It’s Chinese New Year, go home to visit your parents, and celebrate the New Year together.
"Twenty-five, how can there be a partner?
He works in the piano factory in the city. He has just worked for a few years, and the salary is not high, but the expenses are not small.
Other people have a crush on him, he doesn't like him, he has a crush on him, we can't meet the conditions. "
Guo Shouye gave his son a blank look, and every day, they would die of anger.
He doesn't find a partner when he's so old, and other people's families have to import children during the Chinese New Year. He looks forward to it every year, but he can't look forward to it.
"Brother, look at what you said, our family's conditions, there is still Fenghua who can't match it? It's because Fenghua has a high vision and wants to find a good one."
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it.
Guo Shouye is the deputy director of the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau. According to his rank, he should also be the deputy director.
He is also in charge of Bingshan Beverage Factory, which is also a key enterprise that earns foreign exchange through exports, and is also well-known in the city.
Guo Fenghua graduated from an industrial college and majored in mechanics. The young man is not bad, and his family background is not to mention that he can't find a partner?
But this job, to be honest, is not very good, the piano factory will be obsolete in two years.
Even if there is a place to arrange, no matter where you go, you have to start all over again, making trouble.
But Xu Shiyan can't say this, he can only persuade Guo Shouye to be more careful, marriage is a matter of fate, how can you say for sure.
Guo Shouye doesn't like to get angry with the children when it's the New Year's Eve.
So he waved his hands and asked his son and daughter to lead Xu Haiyuan and the others out to play. Guo Shouye wanted to talk to Xu Shiyan about something.
"Brother, have you heard? The factory in Quanyang is in trouble."
After the children had gone out, Guo Shouye said to Xu Shiyan with a gloating expression on his face.
"Chen Jihui, this year I didn't get to go back to the provincial capital for the New Year.
I heard people say that on the night of the 27th night of the twelfth lunar month, the workers directly blocked him in the factory. "
Chen Jihui was transferred from the provincial capital. He didn't bring his family with him, and he always lived in the dormitory of the factory.
In this year and month, people usually don’t take too long holidays during the Chinese New Year. They will last until the end of the year before the new year, and they will have an extra two days after the new year.
Like participating in the field, the main reason is that there is not much work on the mountain in winter, and the holidays used to be early.
This year is not good either, the comprehensive factory is busy, and many workers go to the comprehensive factory to help, and it is also the 27th day of the twelfth lunar month that is officially on holiday.
The factory in Quanyang is in a downturn, so it is supposed to have an early holiday.
But Chen Jihui has been jumping up and down and moving around recently, wanting to get rid of the burden, leave the beverage factory behind, and transfer to other places.
So I dragged on and couldn't return to the provincial capital too early.
In the end, I didn’t know what was going on. It was rumored among the workers that Chen Jihui was going to leave the factory and never return to the provincial capital.
Now, the workers will quit.
The beverage factory has been losing money, and the workers have not been paid wages for several months.
It's a big Chinese New Year, Chen Jihui wants to leave the factory and Zihui's provincial capital to celebrate the New Year? Is it possible?
The workers of the factory quickly assembled, and directly blocked Chen Jihui in the dormitory. If the factory's problems were not resolved, and wages were not paid, there was no way to go anywhere.
This year, the whole factory is not doing well, and everyone is making noise. Let the factory give an explanation.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this, "Where is this going? The fun will come later."
Chen Jihui relied on his connections, his background was strong, he didn't take others seriously, and messed up everywhere.
Here, a factory is ruined, and you just want to be irresponsible, pat your **** and leave? The beauty of thinking.
The counties and provinces, as well as the local area of ​​Quanyang, invested several million at the beginning, so they just threw it for nothing? Is it possible?
"Brother, you can watch the show with peace of mind, we will not interfere with anything, wait, wait until the county comes to beg you.
Don't worry, there must be such a day. At that time, they won't need a penny, and they will beg us to take over the factory. "
Xu Shiyan smiled.
Play slowly, don't worry, it's not them who are anxious now, but Chen Jihui and the people in the county.
"Okay, I can see it, you, you have a lot of tricks, it depends on whether you want to cheat people or not."
Guo Shouye gave Xu Shiyan a thumbs up. This move was beautiful.
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "Brother, I never want to cheat, but there are always people who make trouble for me.
You said that I didn't recruit anyone or provoke anyone, they had to secretly think about me, and I didn't do anything, so I have to protect myself, right? "
What a loss to those people. To transfer him to the Ginseng Research Institute, it is too blatant to let them pick the peaches, isn't it?

chapters.title: Chapter 641: Dogs get older and smarter
chapters.content:
Chapter 641 Gou Zi gets older and smarter
On the first day of junior high school, Guo Shouye had constant guests at home.
Xu Shiyan didn't stay at Guo's house for too long, the two chatted for a while, when someone came, Xu Shiyan led his wife and children away and returned to Donggang.
As soon as they returned home, Yang Junxian and his wife led Yang Haoyu to come.
Xu Shiyan didn't have time to chat with Yang Junxian and his wife for a while, and there was an endless stream of guests at home.
Most of them are employees who participated in the field, and there are also people from Donggang Town.
The person who came didn't say anything else, just said that it was Chinese New Year, and he came to see the two elders of the Xu family and wished them a new year.
Some people came with things, insisting that they were for the elderly.
Xu Shiyan's family entertained the guests, but no matter who brought them, Xu Shiyan confiscated them all.
Now it’s different from before. In the past, it was a human relationship. It’s because of the relationship that people come.
No matter how many things others bring, Xu Shiyan always adds some before returning the gift.
Now that Xu Shiyan is in this position, if he collects things casually, it will be easy for people to catch him.
The Xu family doesn't lack anything. With the wealth of their husband and wife, they can do everything, and there is no need to collect things.
So no matter who came, Xu Shiyan had a good word and returned the things to them.
"Xiaoyu, Brother Xu is very happy that you come to your house for a sit-down during Chinese New Year.
But things, no matter what you say, Brother Xu can't accept them.
伱 There are also old people and children at home, so take the food home and feed it to the family.
Don't worry, there must be no problems at work. You just need to go to work with peace of mind, and we can talk about the rest. "
Xu Shiyan talked to this point, but the other party had no choice but to leave with his things.
After the others left, Xu Chenghou said that many people from home came with their things in the morning, and Xu Chenghou and his wife pushed them away.
Although the old couple are old, they are not confused. This is related to their son's future, and they must not make this mistake.
This is the benefit of being rich in the family. From old to young, the Xu family has seen the world, and no one's eyelids are so shallow.
My family has a lot of money. In terms of the current assets of Xu Shiyan and his wife, they can be counted even in the city and province.
They don't do anything in this life, just lying down and earning interest is enough, so there is really no need to charge others.
If it's someone with a poor family, then it's really not certain.
Even if Xu Shiyan can stick to his principles, his family members may not be able to do so.
"Well, that's good, father, mother, and Yingzi, I will remember them all from now on.
Except for the group of people from Shengli and Jianjian, the rest, especially at the other end of the field.
No matter who comes, no matter what they take, we cannot accept it. "Xu Shiyan nodded, and told his family members solemnly.
"Don't worry about this, we can't help you with anything else, but we certainly can't hold you back."
The old couple solemnly nodded their promises.
It is not easy for the third son to have what he is today, but the son's future cannot be ruined because of the two of them being confused for a while.
On the first day of the first lunar month, I spent the New Year visiting relatives and friends. On the second day of the first lunar month, the Xu family brothers all came back for a reunion.
Xu Shiqin and his wife were in Hubei Province this year, but they failed to come back.
So Xu Shixian and his brothers were the only ones who went home for a reunion in the second year of junior high school.
Xu Shi'an is the closest and the first to arrive. Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang came together in a big guest, a little later than Xu Shian.
Only Xu Shide lives in Xigang now, and it is a long way to go there, and it is troublesome to come back once.
Go from Xigang to the fork of Yinshan Forest Farm, then take a car to Xianrenqiao, and then take a train back from Xianrenqiao.
Or else, just walk from Xigang to the big house, and then cross the river from the big house to Songjiang River.
Calculated, in fact, it is close from the big house, but there is no traffic here, so the whole journey is walking.
It’s winter, and I’m still taking care of my children, so I’m too tired.
On the night of the first day of the new year, Xu Shide called Xu Shiyan to discuss with Xu Shiyan.
The four of them walked from Xigang to the big house, and Xu Shiyan drove to Jiang to pick them up.
In winter, the surface of the river is so cold that it’s okay for people to come here.
The younger brother’s family was coming back, so of course Xu Shiyan had to pick him up, so he drove to the big house after dinner in the morning.
Xu Shiyan has never crossed the river, nor has he wandered around the village. Few in the village have a good relationship with him now.
Zhao Jianshe and Yang Chunming were the first to move out, followed by Li Erniu, Zhao Jianguo and others. Even Uncle Li and Uncle Liu moved out.
Last winter, Wang Zhijun found out that Brother Li Daniu had earned so much money, so he found a house in Donggang and moved there.
It is true that there are no close friends here, and there is no need to go to the village to chat with others.
After waiting by the river for a while, Xu Shide and his wife arrived with their children.
"Fourth brother, here it is."
Xu Shiyan saw the family of four from a long distance away, so he lowered the car window and waved towards the opposite side.
Xu Shide led his wife and children, walked across the frozen river, and got into the car quickly.
Xu Shiyan drove a jeep today, and the space is big enough. Besides, there are only four people in Xu Shide's family, so it can be driven completely.
"Third brother, have you been waiting for a long time?
Oops, the brat couldn't get up this morning. After a long time, he finally got out of the door. "Xu Shide got into the car and quickly explained a few words.
"It's okay, I didn't wait here for a long time, Haiyang and Jingyi are all settled, let's go home."
Xu Shiyan smiled, started the car, and took Xu Shide's family of four back to Donggang.
At home, other people have arrived and are sitting on the kang chatting.
Hearing the sound of a car stopping outside, he knew that Xu Shiyan and the others had returned.
"The dogs at home look really old. We came back, but we didn't see any movement from them."
Only the movement of the car, but no dog barking, Xu Shixian couldn't help sighing.
"That Gouzi has been with our family Yuanyuan for one year, and Yuanyuan is twelve years old this year. Why isn't Gouzi old?"
Xu Chenghou also sighed when he heard this.
"But they are not too old to move, those dogs are sensible.
Knowing that there are many people at home during the Chinese New Year, they are just too lazy to move.
If a thief comes in at night, they can also tear the thief apart. "
It is said that people are old and treacherous, and dogs are smart when they are old.
These dogs have been in the Xu family for many years, and they have experienced many things. Anyway, when the Chinese New Year comes, they lie in the nest, and no one is bothering to talk to them.
If strangers came into the house on normal days, they would have to bark twice.
Just as Xu Chenghou was talking, Xu Shiyan and Xu Shide's family entered the house.
Xu Haiyang and Xu Jingyi entered the door, and hurriedly wished their grandparents, and the circle of uncles and aunts New Year's greetings.
"Hey, good, good, all good. Come on, come to grandpa, grandpa has a red envelope."
It’s Chinese New Year, just to make the children happy, the old man prepared a stack of red envelopes early, just to coax the grandchildren.
When those few people entered the door just now, they had already sent them out. Now that the Xu Haiyang brothers and sisters came in, naturally it was inevitable.
Xu Chenghou gave red envelopes, and Xu Shixian, Xu Shian, and Xu Shixiang also took out red envelopes and gave them to the children.
Now, Xu Haiyang is so happy that he likes to celebrate the New Year. When the New Year comes, he will get lucky money.

chapters.title: Chapter 642: two more taps
chapters.content:
Chapter 642 Two more taps
"Fourth, come, come and sit for a while. I'm chatting with your elder brother."
After Xu Chenghou gave out the red envelopes to the children, he beckoned and asked Xu Shide to come over and sit in front of him and talk.
Xu Shide came to the front as he said, and called Dad, but he didn't know what to say.
Brothers in this family, he is now the worst.
Big brother Xu Shixian is now the deputy section chief of the Propaganda Department, and he can be regarded as a cadre.
He has a strong pen, and last year's Ginseng Festival was brilliant, which was valued by the leaders.
Now whenever there are any activities in the county, the manuscripts are all written by Xu Shixian.
Needless to say, Xu Shixiang, the fifth eldest, was transferred from the deputy director of the Finance Office to the section chief of the Finance Bureau.
It seems that there are not many promotions, but where is the budget department?
All financial expenses and budget declarations in the county have to go through Xu Shixiang's hands. This is the leader's reuse.
How old is Xu Shixiang? At the age of thirty-two, there is still a long way to go.
Not to mention the third child, he is now the leader of a municipal state-owned enterprise and the general manager of a participating company.
In this day and age, no matter the enterprise or the institution, they are all interconnected.
Xu Shiyan has done a good job, maybe one day, he will be transferred from the company.
Before, I felt that among the brothers, the second child was poor, did not study much, and did not have a job.
Look at it now, he has finished his university studies and manages the farm. In addition to his salary, he also has 10% of the management shares.
I heard that the farm made a profit of nearly one million last year? And also expanded production, and built a branch factory elsewhere?
Not only these, the second child also planted sticks with the third child. I heard that last year the sticks were also sold for over 100,000 yuan.
In this comparison, Xu Shide felt that he was the only trash in the family of five brothers.
Xigang Township Finance Office accountant, the work is average, the salary is not high, and it is not as good as the brothers in terms of position, let alone earning money.
Xu Shide regretted it now. When the third brother called him to help the county, why did he listen to his wife and didn't agree?
The people in the preparatory group for the Ginseng Festival last year were transferred to good jobs. If he agreed, would he be able to work in the county?
Xu Chenghou glanced at his fourth son and knew what this kid was thinking about.
The old man took a deep drag on the cigarette, and then spit it out again.
"Fourth brother, you don't have to regret anything, this person, whatever step he takes, is fate.
Since you have been transferred to Xigang, you can work hard in Xigang with peace of mind. If there is any opportunity in the future, you can find a way. "
What can the old man say? It's already this time, let's talk about other things, isn't that stabbing your son in the heart?
"Your job is not bad, at least you can have a good job in rain or shine.
Take good care of the two children and bring them up, which is pretty good. "
At this time, I can only say good things to comfort my son, otherwise what else can I do? The old Chinese New Year scolded his son?
That is to say, Xu Chenghou's temper has gradually improved over the years. If it hadn't been before, Xu Chenghou met his fourth son and would not say anything, but first scolded him.
Don't give up such a good opportunity, squatting in such a poor and remote place like Xigang, what do you think every day without knowing?
"Well, I see, Dad."
Xu Shide was ready to be scolded when he went home, but he didn't expect that his father not only didn't scold him, but also comforted him, Xu Shide heaved a sigh of relief.
"No matter what you say, you brothers have a way out, which is very good.
In the past, I was most worried about the third and sixth children, but now that one is better than the other, I feel relieved.
You all remember that my brother occasionally has a little quarrel, which is normal.
The spoon does not touch the edge of the pot, and it is normal to live in a noisy house.
But no matter what time it is, the brothers have to be united. "
In the past, the old man was angry with those who ignored the family and had their own selfishness, so he didn't like the boss.
But since the ginseng festival last fall, the old man has also seen that it is indeed true that brothers who fight in battle are father and son soldiers.
Anyway, those who have stumbled and stumbled over the years have come here, and now the youngest son is in his thirties.
Everyone is stable and mature, and has a successful career, unlike when they were poor before, they were always intriguing and hiding.
After these few lessons, I believe that the bosses will also understand in the future, what should be done and what should not be done.
If they still don't know how to listen to the third child by now, then these few will be living for nothing, and they will die of stupidity.
So taking advantage of the time when the sons were all coming back for a reunion, the old man typed a few words more or less, and everyone understood the meaning inside and outside the words.
"Father, we all understand what you said. No matter what the third child does in the future, as long as he shouts, we will keep it safe."
Xu Shixian, as the eldest brother, was the first to express his opinion.
What a fart to refuse, now if the third child asks to do something, he has to be the first to rush forward.
An idiot can see that in the past few years, whatever the third child has done, he can earn a lot of money.
The third child leaked a little bit through the cracks in his fingers, and it was enough for the few of them to earn for a lifetime.
It wasn’t the third child who called him last year, how could he be what he is today? Xu Shixian had long established a belief that he must move closer to the third child.
Xu Shixiang and Xu Shide also nodded and promised that they would definitely listen to the third brother in the future, and they would do whatever the third brother told them to do.
As for Xu Shian, let alone, his current job is still given by the third child.
He doesn’t know anything else, he just needs to do his best to manage the farm well.
Xu Chenghou was quite satisfied with his sons' attitude and nodded.
"Xiao Bo, come here." The old man glanced at the eldest grandson over there, and waved to him.
Xu Haibo heard his grandfather calling him, hurried over and stood in front of his grandfather. "Father, you have something to order."
Xu Haibo has grown rapidly in the past two years. He is already 1.8 meters tall at the age of 17, and he probably can grow a little longer.
A young man needs to be tall and handsome, he needs to look good, and he is also very energetic, so he is rare.
The old man looked at his eldest grandson, full of joy, "Come, sit in front of grandpa, grandpa has something to tell you."
The old man patted the place beside him and asked his grandson to sit down.
Xu Haibo sat down beside his grandfather, "Grandpa, just tell me what you want, and I promise to do it."
"Well, I discussed your study with your father and your third uncle, and now I just want to ask you what you mean."
Xu Haibo's grades are not good, according to the current situation, basically there is no hope for the entrance examination for the technical secondary school.
Even if you are in high school, you will probably just fall down after finishing your studies, and you don't have much hope.
So the old man discussed with his son a while ago, and wanted to see how to arrange for the eldest grandson.
"One, you graduated from middle school, let your third uncle find a way to send you to a junior college.
Your third uncle has now signed a targeted training agreement with the Provincial Agricultural University and Shenyang Pharmaceutical University. After graduation, he will work directly in the field or in the pharmaceutical factory.
What about the other one, you go to high school.
You are registered with the Forestry Bureau, so it is easier to go to high school than other places.
After you graduate from high school, let your third uncle and your little uncle find a way to send you to the army. "
I don’t study well, and it’s impossible to expect to pass the exam, so I can only think of other ways.

chapters.title: Chapter 643: choose
chapters.content:
Chapter 643 Selection
With Xu Shiyan's current ability, it is not impossible to directly arrange Xu Haibo into the venue.
But Xu Shiyan felt that since it was for the benefit of the children, it had to be a long-term plan.
Whether it is studying or serving in the army, it is a good way out.
After returning from university, I can work as a technician or inspector after a year of internship in a factory.
Easy to be promoted in the future, definitely not an ordinary worker.
It would be even better if he went to the army.
As long as you perform well in the army, stay for a few more years, and get promoted, even if you change jobs in the future, you will have a bright future, and you can arrange it wherever you go.
These are Xu Shiyan's two best ways out for his nephew.
No way, who said that learning is not good? If you can't get into university, it's not bad if you can have these two paths.
That is, the Xu family, now has this condition.
Switch to someone else’s family, and the children who don’t study well will either come down to work in agriculture after graduating from junior high school, or they will be fools around in society.
Even though Wei Mingrong is an employee of the Forestry Bureau and works in a factory, the Forestry Bureau now has a lot of unemployed young people, counting on succession? That's simply not realistic.
In a few years, the Forestry Bureau will not be profitable, and even Wei Mingrong will not have a job, let alone a child?
Of course, adults only care about their children, but children don’t appreciate it, and no one can say how to choose.
Xu Chenghou called his eldest grandson to Qianer because he wanted to ask the child what he meant.
It happens that these uncles and uncles are all around, and they can also help analyze and analyze.
Xu Haibo actually heard his father mention it once, and thought about it carefully.
"Third Uncle, I want to study. If possible, can I go to Agricultural University?"
"Are you sure you've considered this matter clearly? Don't you want to join the army?" Xu Shiyan had to reconfirm, after all, it was related to his nephew's future.
"If you go to be a soldier, with your little uncle and me, you can work hard no matter what.
伱 When you join the army, you can also go to university. "
In fact, Xu Shiyan would rather his nephew to serve in the army, but Xu Haibo, a child who is more stable than aggressive, can indeed study better.
"Third uncle, I'd better go to school, I don't want to be a soldier." Xu Haibo thought about it carefully, and decided to go to the Agricultural University to study.
"Okay, you just need to be sure, and the rest will be left to third uncle." Now that the child is sure, Xu Shiyan can't say anything else.
This year, a group of participants will be selected from the fresh junior high school graduates to study at Agricultural University or Pharmaceutical University.
It is still the same as last year, all the expenses are borne by the participating companies, and the students have to come back to work after graduation.
This is to cultivate talents in advance.
If an enterprise wants to develop in the long run, it must have its own talent pool.
Not all of them have to be top-notch high-tech talents, but management and technical posts must have a college degree or above.
It is expected that at least 80 students will be selected this year. There may not be enough fresh graduates participating, so some will be selected from Donggang or Songjianghe.
Xu Haibo meets the conditions, there is nothing wrong with stuffing it in, it is normal.
"Thank you, Uncle San, for letting Uncle San take care of me." Xu Haibo scratched his head with a look of embarrassment.
If he studies well and can pass the exam by himself, then why let his family worry about it?
"It's okay, as long as you study hard and have a good future in the future, you will be filial to your parents."
Xu Shiyan smiled, not taking it seriously.
"Third uncle, what about me? I will graduate from junior high school in the next year, otherwise, I will go to the army?"
Over there, Xu Haitao came over and asked Xu Shiyan with an embarrassed face.
This kid is dumbfounded, his academic performance is even worse than Xu Haibo's, don't even think about technical secondary school, maybe even high school will have to work hard.
"You, if you don't study hard, let alone be a soldier, I will kick you a few times first."
Xu Shian gets angry when he sees the second child. This **** is just like him back then.
He gets sleepy as soon as he holds a book, and he can be energetic when he does other things. He doesn't do anything else at school all day long, and he is the best at skipping classes and fighting.
Seeing his father raising his leg to kick him, Xu Haitao jumped to the side and quickly avoided.
"Dad, look, you're going to kick me in front of my grandfather, won't you?"
This **** has found a backer, so he is not afraid of his father, he said with a playful smile.
Sure enough, Xu Cheng's thick face was ugly.
"You still have the face to talk about your son? Back then you couldn't keep up with Xiaotao.
Xiaotao simply followed you, how dare he beat the child? Take your skills. "
Being scolded by his father, Xu Shian didn't dare to refute, so he could only stare at his second son viciously.
Hearted, brat, you wait for me, you see how I will deal with you when I go back.
Xu Chenghou saw his son and grandson staring at each other, and quickly waved his hands to let Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao leave.
"Don't just stay in the house, take those few out to play together.
There are a lot of firecrackers at home, let's lead them out to set off firecrackers. Adult chatter, you also do not understand. "
"Hey, I see."
Xu Haitao is only fifteen, so it’s uncertain. When he heard that he was asked to go out to play, he didn’t have to look at his face in front of his father, and he immediately became happy.
Leading Xu Haibin, Xu Haiyang and the others, carrying two bags of firecrackers, went out to set off firecrackers.
Now there are several new kinds of small firecrackers, such as woodpeckers and three firecrackers, all of which are very interesting.
The three firecrackers are the most interesting. When they are lit, they circle around the ground, one color per circle.
After three colors, it will explode, and the sound is very loud. It is the boy's favorite firecracker.
"Brother, let's go, let's go too." Xu Haiqing saw it, dragged Xu Haiyuan and ran out.
Xu Haiqing belongs to the kind who likes it very much, but he is small and timid.
Every time I set off a cannon, I have to follow my father or brother, but Xu Shiyan doesn't have much time to play with the children.
As for Xu Haiyuan, he lacks interest in these things, so he can just post a few meanings on New Year's Eve.
Normally, he is too lazy to do these things, so why not read more medical books when he has time.
Xu Haiqing, who is good at food and loves to play, is usually not taken with him, but this time his cousins ​​are back, so he must go out to watch the fun.
But it’s not enough for him to go out alone, he has to drag Xu Haiyuan.
So regardless of whether Xu Haiyuan was happy or not, he dragged Xu Haiyuan out.
The children didn’t play in Xu’s yard, and there were a few dogs at home. The cannons were fired too loudly, which easily frightened them.
So Xu Haibo led his younger brothers to play in the open space outside Can City.
For those who celebrate the New Year, there is no one in the market, and the store outside is also closed, so they can play whatever they want, and no one cares.
The children went out, and Xu Shiyan and his brothers sat on the kang, discussing last year's ginseng market and predicting what this year will be like.
Many people know that Su Anying and others went to Yangcheng to sell goods.
This matter can't be hidden.
Before Huang Shengli and others went around grabbing goods, the company account remittances were large, and the accounts were frequent. How could the relevant personnel not know? It has already spread throughout the county.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang also heard about it in the county, and now they have to ask Xu Shiyan about the specific situation.
Xu Shide listened by the side, and asked if he didn't understand. Anyway, the brothers chatted very warmly.
"Shiyan, come here and help lead the charcoal. Don't we want to wash the pot later?"
While chatting, Su Anying came into the room and whispered in Xu Shiyan's ear.
Didn’t my friends from Dandong send a lot of seafood?
Last night, Xu Shiyan specially boiled two crabs to have a look. They were okay, the meat looked fresh and the taste was okay.
But it’s also frozen crabs, so Xu Shiyan said, it’s better to have a hot pot, use crabs, shrimps, scallops and so on as the soup base, and add sauerkraut and so on.
The whole sauerkraut pot, everyone eats it fresh and lively.
Besides, there are a lot of fresh vegetables at home. Wash them and eat them together in a pot. It’s more worry-free than stir-frying, and I like to eat them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 644: Chu Brothers
chapters.content:
Chapter 644 Chu Brothers
Xu’s family has two large pure copper hot pots, and they eat them twice a year anyway.
This thing is easier than cooking. Make a soup base, wash some vegetables, and cut some meat.
Wait for the soup in the pot to boil, put the vegetables and meat in and rinse it, and you can eat it when it is cooked.
This year's pot is different from previous years. The bottom of the pot is boiled with seafood, which is more delicious.
The frozen crab is cut open, thrown into the pot and rinsed, the soup base is more delicious.
When the crab is cooked, whoever wants to eat it can also eat the meat.
The children have never eaten crabs, and they think it is quite novel, so they must try it.
"Well, it's okay to eat crab roe, you can't eat too much.
It’s not that the third uncle is reluctant to give it to you. This food is frozen and not as fresh as the live one. If you eat too much, I’m afraid that you will have a stomachache.
Eat half of one person, just taste it. "
Actually, there are not many lumps. There is no air-freezing technology in this year, and it is still frozen. It looks quite big, and a lot of it is ice.
The most important thing is that I am still worried that the children will feel uncomfortable after eating. It is not worthwhile for the big Chinese New Year to eat crabs.
The children were obedient, and when the crabs were cooked, each of them fished out half of them.
Under the guidance of Xu Shiyan, he learned to peel the shells for meat.
This frozen crab, the meat is not so full, it will be empty.
One crab didn't have much meat, and the children worked hard to get the meat out, and they all said it was good to eat.
"At my hometown, when I was young, there were crabs in the river, but they were not as big.
Sometimes we got fish, smashed it and wanted to catch crickets, but ended up catching a crab.
It’s the same thing after eating, it doesn’t feel as fresh as cricket.
It takes more effort to eat than a cricket, and it is not big, so none of us liked to eat it when we were young. "
Xu Chenghou looked at the crab, and it was different from the ones he had seen when he was a child. I guess this is the difference between sea crabs and river crabs.
The old man is not very interested in these hard-shelled animals. If he has the time, he might as well eat some sauerkraut.
Seafood soup with sauerkraut, which tastes very fresh, and then dipped in sesame sauce, chive flower sauce, red fermented bean curd and other ingredients, it is really good to eat.
"Brother Chu, eat more, we are all our own family, so we don't need me to greet you, we can do it ourselves." Xu Chenghou greeted Chu Xuanhuai to eat.
Chu Xuanhuai has been in the Xu family for several years.
When Xu’s family was reunited in the second year of junior high school, he didn’t want to come, Xu Chenghou and Xu Shiyan would ask Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing to invite him.
Now that he is used to it, Chu Xuanhuai is not so pretentious. He eats and drinks what he wants. This is the home of his apprentice and grandson.
"Yeah, um, it tastes better than the one we usually stew in a big iron pot."
Chu Xuanhuai nodded while eating, sauerkraut hot pot, very good, tastes good.
All the older people recognize it, not to mention the little ones.
Xu Haiyuan and the others each had a bottle of drink.
Anyway, it’s Chinese New Year, adults don’t care about children, they can drink whatever they like, with or without gas.
The children eat two mouthfuls of vegetables and drink a mouthful of sweet water.
Especially the aerated drinks, the taste fascinates the children even more, and they all shout that they are delicious.
There were a lot of people, and a round table was placed on the kang, and everyone sat around the table, eating and drinking in a very comfortable way.
While eating, suddenly I heard the dogs barking outside.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, the dogs never barked when people came to the house during the Chinese New Year.
What's wrong? Who is here, alarming the dogs?
"Father, eat slowly, I'll go out and have a look." Xu Shiyan put down his chopsticks and came out of the room.
Outside the gate of Xu's house, two men in woolen coats and leather shoes were hesitating whether to walk into the courtyard.
"Is this the house?" The older one looked into the courtyard and asked.
"The address Chi Hao gave is here, it should be correct."
The younger one held a piece of paper in his hand, looked carefully, and felt that he had gone right.
The dog who has been lazy and unreasonable for the past few days seems to have gone crazy at this moment.
Wishing he could break the chain, he kept yelling towards the gate.
The two people outside the door were so frightened that they didn't dare to go into the courtyard.
At this moment, Xu Shiyan came out. When he saw the two people outside, Xu Shiyan was also stunned. Who is this? Why don't you know me?
"Excuse me, who are you looking for?"
"Oh, we are from the provincial capital, I want to ask, is this the Xu family?
Is there an old gentleman named Chu who lives here? "
The two breathed a sigh of relief when they saw someone coming out, and hurriedly asked.
"You are here to see my master, what's the matter, are you looking for him to see a doctor?"
Xu Shiyan heard that he was looking for Mr. Chu.
But these two people don't understand the rules too much, right? How can anyone find someone to see a doctor in the second year of junior high school? What an acute illness? Do you have to come at this time?
"You are Xu Shiyan, right? Our surname is Chu, and we are here to find my father."
As soon as the other party heard Xu Shiyan's words, his attitude changed immediately, and there seemed to be something different in his tone.
Xu Shiyan was stunned, surnamed Chu? Elder Chu's son?
Oops, it's not easy. After all these years, I finally saw him alive.
"Oh, so it's the two of the Chu family. Mr. Chu is here, let's go in."
No matter who they are or what they are doing, they are guests when they come to the door during the Chinese New Year, and there is absolutely no reason to refuse them.
Xu Shiyan nodded politely, and let the two into the yard.
"Xiao Huang and Er Hei, stop barking and go into the nest."
The four dogs were still barking, so Xu Shiyan could only lower his face and teach the dogs to go back to their dens.
Not to mention, the dogs all gave Xu Shiyan face, choked up, and went back to their nests.
But it's not the same as lying down in the nest in the past, this time although they are all in the nest, they are lying on their stomachs.
And that posture, it looks like it will rush out at any time and directly rush over.
Gouzi may feel that these two people are not local, and he doesn’t know that they are good and bad people, so he is always vigilant.
"It's okay, let's go into the house." Xu Shiyan restrained the dog, and then led the two into the house.
"San'er, who's here? Why isn't our dog barking?"
Before Xu Shiyan entered the east room, he heard Zhou Guilan's question.
"Mom, he's from another place. He probably dresses differently from us here. The dog is not familiar with it, so he bites a few times."
Most of the local people wear big cotton jackets, leather hats, big-toed cotton shoes, and stuffy hands.
These two have woolen coats and leather shoes. Gouzi has never seen them before, so can they not bite?
"From out of town? Why do people from out of town come to us in the second year of junior high school? What are you doing? Are you looking for your master to see a doctor?"
Now, Xu Chenghou also became curious, and leaned over to look at the door of the house.
At this moment, Xu Shiyan led the two of them into the east room.
"Master, these two people said that their surname is Chu, and they came to look for you."
Xu Shiyan didn't have a good impression of the two sons of Chu Xuanhuai's family, so he could only be polite to them, not warm at all.
People who can ignore even their own parents, and expect others to be enthusiastic about them?
Chu Xuanhuai was eating, when he heard this, he raised his head and glanced at the two people who came in behind Xu Shiyan.
"Who? I don't know. I have no relatives for a long time. I am a lonely old man. I don't know anyone."
That's what he said, but there was a bit of sadness in the old man's eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 645: beat up
chapters.content:
Chapter 645 Beat up
"Dad, what are you talking about? My brother and I are still here, so why do we have no relatives?
You moved from the provincial capital to such a crappy place without saying a word, and you didn't tell me or my brother.
We came back to see you during the Chinese New Year, but people told us that you have moved away for several years.
If we hadn’t found Chi Hao and found out where you were, we would have nowhere to find you. "
When Chu Yuanchao heard his father's words, he immediately became unhappy. What does this old man mean? Do not recognize them?
"Brother, look at you, why are you talking to our dad?
We haven't come back to see our dad for many years, it's normal for our dad to have resentment in his heart. "
Chu Yuanlang quickly pawed his brother twice with his hands, then took two steps forward, and smiled at Chu Xuanhuai.
"Dad, you also have to be considerate of us. You said that we were all in the Northwest a few years ago. It was too difficult to come back, and there was really no way."
"Dad, there was really no way before, the conditions in the northwest were too harsh.
You said we took you over, but your body can't stand it.
You have the treatment given by the University of Medical Sciences here, which is much better than that in Northwest. We can't let you suffer. "
As Chu Yuanlang spoke, tears came down.
"It's okay this time, my brother and I have gone to the south to do business.
Now that we have settled down in Shenzhen City, we have settled down, so I want to take you over to enjoy the blessings.
The children in the family also miss you very much, but they miss you, Dad, come with us. "
Chu Yuanlang wiped away his tears, and when he came forward, he was about to reach out to help Chu Xuanhuai.
Chu Xuanhuai slapped his son's hand away.
"Don't talk about those nice things, you broke up with me and left.
Later, I went back to the provincial capital, but you didn't come back. After so many years, did you remember that there is still me as a father?
Who knows what kind of moth you guys are doing?
No, I’m living a good life here. It doesn’t matter to me where you like. "
These years, the old man's heart has long been broken.
When he had an accident, the two sons severed ties with him for the sake of their future. He was not angry.
At that time, in order to survive, there was no way.
Later, he was taken back to the provincial capital, thinking about his son, so he wrote to them several times, wanting his son to come back.
As a result, these two **** never came back.
also said that since the relationship between father and son has been severed, there is no need to contact them in the future.
He, Chu Xuanhuai, let alone go back to be the principal, even if he becomes a senior cadre, the brothers will not engage in this relationship, let alone return to the Northeast.
After so many years, the two brothers came back only once, and that year was the eleventh anniversary of the death of Chu Xuanhuai's wife.
There is a local rule, called ten years grave nine years.
It means that the 10th anniversary of the deceased is usually arranged on the 9th or 11th anniversary, and there is nothing to say after that.
Chu Xuanhuai's daughter-in-law passed away in 1966. In 1977, Chu Xuanhuai had already returned to the provincial capital. Chu Yuanchao and Chu Yuanlang came back to visit their mother's grave.
No matter what Chu Xuanhuai explained, the two just refused to forgive Chu Xuanhuai, and insisted on blaming Chu Xuanhuai for his mother's death.
When the father and son met, there was a quarrel in the end, and Chu Xuanhuai's heart was so cold.
Since then, the two never came back.
Chu Xuanhuai has been in the Xu family for more than three years, and there is no news about the two brothers. Now they came to pick him up to enjoy the blessing? What are you kidding?
"What's the matter? Your son can't live at home, and you're living in someone else's house, but you're happy?"
Chu Yuanchao had a bad temper, and when Chu Xuanhuai said that he had broken ties with them, his face turned ugly.
He looked at the environment of the Xu family, and at the people of the Xu family, his eyes were full of disgust.
"With this poor place, what future do you have if you stay?
You go to Shenzhen City with us, the conditions there are much better than this, it is also close to the port city, and the environment is good. Didn’t you care about taking care of yourself in the past?
You have a son and a grandson, what does it look like to live in someone else's house? "
Chu Yuanchao said as he walked over, he also reached out to pull Chu Xuanhuai.
At this time, Xu Shiyan and the brothers all stood up.
Xu Shiyan pushed the opponent away, "What are you talking about?
For those who celebrate Chinese New Year, I respect you as a guest from afar, and I will not hesitate to argue with you.
I didn’t use a big broom to drive you out, it’s considered a face for my master.
Are you a fart? Talking nonsense in my house?
If you have the heart, what have you been doing all these years?
Don’t say you come back to see the old man during the holidays, even if you come back every three to five years, I frankly believe that you are doing it for the good of the old man. I really want to take him to enjoy the blessings. "
Xu Shiyan was impatient, but it wasn't because the brothers of the Chu family wanted to take Chu Xuanhuai away.
They are relatives of father and son. If Chu Xuanhuai's son sincerely takes the old man to take care of him, Xu Shiyan will not stop him from keeping him, and will happily send the old man to the south.
But what is the attitude of these two brothers?
Being virtuous as soon as you enter the door, who can believe that they took the elderly to take care of them?
In front of outsiders, the two brothers didn't even do superficial efforts, and yelled and yelled at the old man.
Anyone who believes that they are sincerely treating Boss Chu is a fool.
Xu Shiyan has always felt that his own EQ is low enough, and he can't learn to be slick and versatile.
Being able to get to this point is purely luck, taking advantage of rebirth.
But no matter how low his EQ is, it can't compare to this one in front of him.
When you come to someone else's house, you don't even know how to be polite. Anyway, if you put on a show, you have to pretend to be decent, right?
With such an attitude, if Xu Shiyan can get Chu Xuanhuai to follow them, he will be kicked by a donkey.
This person not only lacks EQ, but probably also has IQ problems.
"For Master's sake, I don't care about you. Leave my house immediately and don't let me do it."
Xu Shiyan clenched his fists and glared at Brother Chu Yuanchao angrily. He really wanted to punch him and vent his anger on behalf of his master.
"Who are you? Wu Xuan in front of me?
An outsider who can't beat you, what's the matter with you?
That's my dad, I can do whatever I like.
He owed my mother his life back then, and owed our brothers a lifetime of future.
how? Now that he runs to someone else's house and hides, he can write off the past, right? He is so beautiful.
Today he has to go with us, and no one will stop him.
Let me tell you, there are people above me, if you dare to stop me today, I will let you know what will happen if you offend me. "
Chu Yuanchao's attitude was very arrogant and bad, pointing at Xu Shiyan and yelling.
"Fuck, there's someone above you? What the **** did I call someone above you.
Even if you are the king of heaven above you today, I have to beat you up. "
Xu Shiyan has been around to this day, no matter how displeased he is, he can only play tricks behind his back.
No one has ever dared to yell like this in front of him.
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, and turned his fist directly, hitting Chu Yuanchao in the face.
Chu Yuanchao really didn't expect that Xu Shiyan dared to make a move. He was caught off guard for a while, and this fist was solid.
Suddenly, I only felt a sharp pain in the nose, a hot flow from the nasal cavity, and the nose was bleeding.

chapters.title: Chapter 646: don't suffer
chapters.content:
Chapter 646 Don't suffer from immediate losses
"Fuck, do you really dare to hit someone?"
Chu Yuanchao raised his hand and wiped his nose. When he saw the blood on his hand, he was immediately annoyed. He raised his hand to hit Xu Shiyan.
The five Xu family brothers are all here, how can an outsider bully you?
Xu Shian saw this, went up and locked Chu Yuanchao's neck, and dragged him outside.
