There is a room full of people eating, so it doesn't matter if you beat this bastard, if the table is overturned, there will be a hot pot on it.
There are people of all ages and children in this room, and no one will be seriously injured. If you want to fight, you still need to find a spacious place.
Xu Shian is about 1.8 meters tall, tall and strong, and tall.
He works all year round and has great strength.
This time, Chu Yuanchao's neck was tightly locked, and Chu Yuanchao was strangled so hard that he could hardly breathe.
His face turned purple from holding back, and he didn't have the slightest chance to struggle, so he was directly dragged outside the gate by Xu Shi'an.
Chu Yuanlang next to him just wanted to persuade him.
Before he could open his mouth, Xu Shixiang and Xu Shide pushed him out, one on the left and the other on the right.
When they came outside the gate, the two brothers tried their best together, and Chu Yuanlang was also thrown out of Xu's house.
Fortunately, it is winter, and there is snow outside. The brothers fell on the snow, but they were not hurt.
But being thrown out like this, the brothers lost all face.
"Okay, you're ruthless, you just wait for me, this matter is not over today, you will regret it."
Chu Yuanchao got up from the snow, slapped the snow on his body, looked up at the five Xu family brothers, and said viciously.
"If you have any tricks, just use them, and I will follow."
Xu Shiyan crossed his arms, looked at Brother Chu Yuanchao coldly, and snorted.
At this time, a few people got off from the two cars that were originally parked in the Canshi open space opposite.
These people came directly to the brothers of the Chu family.
"Mr. Chu, what's going on, do you need our help?"
The speaker has a very blunt accent, with some different accents.
Chu Yuanchao gave Xu Shiyan a hard look, "No, let's go, let's go back first."
The current situation is not good for them.
Regardless of how many people he brought here, there are five brothers in the Xu family.
Besides, this is their territory.
If there was a fight and people yelled, the neighbors would come out to help, then they wouldn't even think about leaving today.
Chu Yuanchao lived in the Northeast for more than ten years, and he is very clear about the peeing nature of the people in the Northeast.
Northeast people are all tigers. If you yell, a lot of people can come out.
When fighting, don't ask why at all, just finish the fight first.
A hero doesn’t suffer from the immediate disadvantages. If he wants to deal with this Xu, there are many ways. There is no need to confront them head-on.
Chu Yuanchao said so, and those few people naturally couldn't say more, so they followed Chu Yuanchao brothers and went back to the car directly.
Then the driver started the car and left Donggang directly.
In the car, Chu Yuanchao covered his nose, hissing in pain and sucking in air.
Beside   , Chu Yuanlang couldn't help sighing seeing his brother like this.
"Brother, why are you so impatient?
Didn't we agree before we came? Talk to the old man in a good voice, and persuade him to go back to the provincial capital first.
Look at you, as soon as you get here, if you don't say a few words, you are like an old man whose nose is not his nose, and his face is not his face.
The boy was able to take the old man over to live for several years, he must be loved and trusted by the old man.
You act like this in front of others, can they agree that the old man will go with us? "
"I get angry when I see that old thing, I can't help it."
Chu Yuanchao took out a handkerchief, covered his nose, and said in a muffled voice.
“As soon as I saw him, I remembered what we had suffered and suffered in those years.
It’s not that he’s implicated, we are at least two cadres in the provincial capital now, why should we spend all these years in the Northwest? "
"You just don't have a brain, no matter how much you hate him in your heart, we have to coax him right now.
Wait until the thing is in your hands, do whatever you want with him.
That's good, nothing was done, and someone threw it out. "
Chu Yuanlang shook his head and sighed. If he had known earlier, he shouldn't have brought his brother along.
"Then what should we do now? We can't go back empty-handed, right?
Both of us have looked for it at home, but there is no one. The old man must have hidden it. If he doesn’t go with us, we can’t find it. "
Chu Yuanchao covered his nose for a while, but the bleeding stopped, so he put down his handkerchief and asked his brother.
"Go back first, and find another way to put pressure on this side through the people in the province. If it doesn't work, arrest the person surnamed Xu.
I don't believe it anymore, what can he do?
Obstructing foreign investment and hindering local economic development, I wonder if he can afford this crime? " Chu Yuanlang snorted.
The brothers of the Chu family left in a car. On the side of the Xu family, the brothers looked at the two cars with slightly dignified expressions.
Two cars, with the brand name of the capital, the brothers of the Chu family seem to have a lot of background.
"Third brother, hurry up and ask someone to find out where the two sons of Mr. Chu came from?
The two of them are so arrogant, there must be someone behind them.
Don't be a person with a strong background, you have provoked people who shouldn't be provoked. "Xu Shixiang was a little worried.
"It is certain that someone will support you.
Didn't you hear those people who appeared behind them speak differently? That's the little devil from Dongyi. "
Xu Shiyan has participated in the Spring Fair twice and is familiar with many Dongyi merchants.
The tone of those people's speech just now was blunt, just like those Dongyi businessmen speaking Chinese, so Xu Shiyan heard it all at once.
"Dongyi's? Why did the brothers of the Chu family get involved with the little devil of Dongyi?"
Xu Shixian and the others were taken aback for a moment, unable to figure out what the connection was.
"I guess, they came for the secret recipe in the hands of Mr. Chu." Xu Shiyan sighed.
It's not been a day or two since the little devil coveted traditional Chinese medicine. I don't know how he got to know the brothers of the Chu family. Knowing that the Chu family has a secret recipe handed down from their ancestors, he probably moved his mind.
The other party must be Xu Yizhongli, otherwise, why would the brothers of the Chu family come all the way to Donggang to pick up Mr. Chu?
"Then what should we do?" Xu Shixian asked in unison.
"It's okay, I'll ask someone first, and find out where the brothers from the Chu family came from."
Xu Shiyan didn't care too much, even if the Chu brothers were behind Dongyi merchants, so what?
It is impossible for the province to turn to outsiders and deal with Xu Shiyan, right?
Besides, he didn't make any mistakes. The two brothers went to Xu's house and chattered, and it was easy to beat him.
The brothers entered the east room while talking, and as soon as they entered, they saw everyone in the room sitting there, no one was eating with chopsticks, everyone was full of thoughts.
Old Chu was sitting on the kang, not in a good spirit.
An eighty-year-old man, replaced by someone else, is the time for children and grandchildren to enjoy family happiness.
But when he arrived at Mr. Chu's place, he found two sons who were not stingy. Whoever it was would be sad.
Xu Haiyuan was sitting next to Chu Xuanhuai, holding a handkerchief in his hand, it seemed that he was wiping away tears for Elder Chu just now.
Xu Shiyan sighed, "Master, I was wrong just now. I couldn't hold back for a moment and punched him."
Chu Xuanhuai raised his head and glanced at Xu Shiyan, "That's right, I wanted to call you just now, and beat him to death."

chapters.title: Chapter 647: Inquire about the details
chapters.content:
Chapter 647 Inquire about the details
Xu Shiyan couldn't help but sigh when he heard Mr. Chu's words.
What did the old man do to hurt the two **** sons? Can you say something that beats you to death?
It's normal to think about it. Whoever this matter happens to, would have already been heartbroken.
Two lives, father and son turned against each other, Xu Shiyan has seen a lot, but the two of the Chu family are really the strangest.
What happened back then was a tragedy of that era, and Chu Xuanhuai was not at fault.
These two brains squeezed the door, and they hated their own father. It's simply, I don't know what the structure of their brains is.
"Master, I have to call Brother Chi first.
I’m afraid there is something strange about this matter. Just now we got his two brothers out, only to see that they still have two capital brand cars.
And the people who came with them spoke in a strange way, not like people from our country. "
Xu Shiyan didn't have time to comfort Chu Xuanhuai, he had to find out as soon as possible what the origins of the two brothers of the Chu family were, and take precautions early.
As Xu Shiyan said, he picked up the phone and dialed the number of Chi Hao, the Provincial Medical University.
After a while, the call was connected, but it was a woman.
The other party informed that Chi Hao was in the operating room and had already performed several operations in a row.
Xu Shiyan, please, wait for Chi Hao to come out of the operating room, and tell Chi Hao that someone surnamed Xu is looking for him.
"Brother Chi is undergoing surgery, the person who answered the phone said that he is very busy these days.
It seems that something happened somewhere, Brother Chi performed several surgeries in succession. "
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone and spoke to Chu Xuanhuai.
Chu Xuanhuai nodded, "It's okay, no matter what the origin of those two beasts is, you don't have to worry.
Everyone eats, don't delay us from eating because of the two beasts. "
Chu Xuanhuai already had a rough guess in his heart, and he had already figured out how to deal with it.
So he waved his hand, signaling the big guys to go and sit down, and eat with peace of mind.
Elder Chu had spoken, and the big guy didn't think about anything else.
I haven’t eaten half of the meal yet, and my stomach is still not full, so of course I have to continue eating.
It's just that after such a commotion, the atmosphere was not as lively as before. The Xu Shiyan brothers were all preoccupied, and Mr. Chu didn't smile much.
Children are just young, naive and ignorant of worldly affairs.
There are so many delicious food and delicious drinks in front of them, they don't care so much, they are eating, drinking, and playing.
With the laughter of the children, the room became more lively.
Eating hot pot, don’t be in a hurry, just eat and chat slowly, and when everyone finishes eating, it will be around three or four in the afternoon.
Xu Shixian and the others didn't intend to leave. It was a rare holiday, so they stayed to spend more time with their parents.
Xu Shian's house is close, so he is not in a hurry. When he went out in the morning, he specially burned a lot of firewood at home.
There are pimples stuffed into the pit at the bottom of the pot, and the boiler is also pressed coal, so it doesn’t matter if you go back later.
The brothers have not seen each other for a long time, and it is rare to get together, anyway, there is something to talk about.
While talking, the phone rang, Xu Shiyan went to answer the phone, and it was indeed Chi Hao calling.
"Shiyan, oops, I've been too busy these two days, and an accident happened in a factory in the province, killing and injuring many people.
Our hospital led a rescue team, and they have been in the operating room for the past few days. "
Before Xu Shiyan opened his mouth to ask, Chi Hao said in a crackling voice.
"Those two **** from the teacher's house, did they go looking for you?
That day they came to the hospital to find me and asked where the teacher had gone.
At first I didn’t want to tell them, they pestered me for a long time, the patient was going to be operated on, and they wouldn’t let me into the operating room.
There is no recruiting, so I gave them your home address.
I was thinking about calling you after my operation is over, and asking you to be on guard against them.
As a result, before my operation came out, something happened in that factory, and this operation has not been interrupted. "
These students of Chu Xuanhuai have special respect for Chu Xuanhuai.
Chi Hao is in the Medical University Hospital, close to the teacher, and takes care of him as much as possible on weekdays.
But he is the director after all, and the hospital is too busy to take care of it sometimes.
So Xu Shiyan took Chu Xuanhuai away to take care of him. Chi Hao and others were very grateful. They often contacted Xu Shiyan to ask about the situation of the old man.
Originally, Xu Shiyan knew Chi Hao, not to mention the relationship now.
Although Chu Yuanchao and his brothers are the sons of Chu Xuanhuai, in terms of closeness, in the eyes of Chi Hao and others, Xu Shiyan is much closer than those two.
"Brother Chi, they came to my house at noon, and they were about to pick up Master, but Master said he didn't recognize them, so they fell out.
In a fit of anger, I beat up the boss. When they left, they cursed and asked me to wait, saying that there was someone up there.
I looked at these two people very arrogantly, and there were a few people around them.
So I thought to ask you if you know their background. "Xu Shiyan briefly explained the matter.
"Well beaten, I saw them that day, if my colleagues in the hospital didn't stop me, or if there were patients waiting for me in the operating room, I would have kicked them first too."
On the other end of the phone, Chi Hao couldn't hold back, and also sweared.
These students don’t have a good impression of the two brothers of the Chu family. It’s really good self-cultivation to be able to resist beating them when they meet.
"I really know a little about their details, they told me that day.
It seems that the two of them met the Dongyi businessman for some reason, and became the agent of the Dongyi businessman.
Then the two of them met a second generation in the capital. It is said that they are quite energetic in the capital.
This time you said you are coming back to invest? Help attract local investment or something? Anyway, he looks like a dog, it seems that the province really values ​​this matter.
I don't have time to inquire about what's going on.
In this way, you wait for me for two days, I will find someone to find out for you, and then I will tell you. "
Chi Hao just came out of the operating room, and didn't even care about rest.
As soon as he heard that someone surnamed Xu was looking for him, he knew it was Xu Shiyan, so he rushed back to make a phone call before he changed his clothes.
"How is the teacher? Please persuade the teacher, let the teacher look at it more, don't be angry with those two little kids, it's not worth it."
Chi Hao is more worried about Mr. Chu, who is in his eighties. If it is really because of those two beasts, it is really not worthwhile to get angry again.
"Master is fine, my eldest son is with me, don't worry, I will definitely take good care of Master."
Xu Shiyan knew Chi Hao's worry, and hurriedly reassured Chi Hao.
"Then brother Chi, please help me find out, which **** is this? I also have a countermeasure here.
I always feel that these two people are uneasy and kind. "
Those two beasts are uneasy and well-intentioned for sure.
Now it is not clear who is behind them and what is the purpose of these people.
If they really came here for the secret recipe, then they would definitely not give up easily. Xu Shiyan must be prepared.
"Okay, don't worry, I'll ask someone in a while."
Chi Hao underwent several surgeries in a row, and he was so tired that his voice was full of exhaustion. After promising to help, he hung up the phone.
"Master, Brother Chi said that he will help make inquiries." Xu Shiyan also hung up the phone, and turned to talk to Chu Xuanhuai.
"Shiyan, when you go home, there is a small book in the drawer under the kangqin in my room, please bring it to me."

chapters.title: Chapter 648: eightieth birthday
chapters.content:
Chapter 648 Eightieth Birthday
Xu Shiyan didn't know why Mr. Chu asked him to go back to get the notebook, but since the master ordered him, he would definitely do it.
So he hurried back to his home, and found a red plastic work diary from the drawer Chu Xuanhuai mentioned.
"Master, is this what you're talking about?" Xu Shiyan handed the small red notebook to Chu Xuanhuai.
Chu Xuanhuai waved his hand, "Don't give it to me.
You just call them according to the phone number written on this book, and say that you are my apprentice, Chu Xuanhuai.
Tell them that on the twelfth day of the first lunar month, I will go to Changbaishan Hotel in the provincial capital, and I will celebrate my eightieth birthday. "
"Oh, okay, I see, I'll make a call now." Xu Shiyan froze for a moment.
Chu Xuanhuai is eighty-one years old this year, and his birthday is March 28.
It stands to reason that this year's birthday should indeed be celebrated, but two months in advance? What is this operation?
But if you think about it carefully, it seems that there is no problem. There are also local sayings.
When the elderly are over sixty-six, or when they live their whole life, they do not follow the real month, but move it to the first month.
I don't know why, but some people do it anyway.
Thinking about it, Chu Xuanhuai thinks that everyone is free during the first month, so they can have time to attend the birthday, right?
It’s okay, the old man has passed his 80th birthday, so he really should take care of it.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan picked up the phone and started making calls according to the notebook.
Telephone numbers can generally be connected, and there will be forwarding for long-distance calls.
There are also some, the number has been upgraded, and the switching station will remind you, and you can call through the upgrade.
The other party received the call, and as soon as he heard that Chu Xuanhuai was going to celebrate his 80th birthday, he immediately agreed to be there.
Although it is just a small book, there are many phone numbers written on it.
Xu Shiyan didn't do anything else, so he made dozens of phone calls, and at least he was notified.
"Master, I have informed you, and the other party said that I will definitely go." Xu Shiyan returned the small book to Chu Xuanhuai.
Chu Xuanhuai waved his hand, but didn't answer, "Give it to Yuanyuan, let him hold it.
If there is anything going on in the future, just call these people. These are all my former students. "
The old man has been a professor at North China Medical University since liberation. After so many years, he has students all over the country.
These are just some of them, and of course, they are all students who have a close relationship with Chu Xuanhuai and are very valued by him.
"Ah? Master, isn't this inappropriate?" Xu Shiyan was a little silly now, what is the old man going to do?
"It's okay, don't worry, I'm fine, but I'm getting older and my memory is getting worse.
These will have to be given to Yuanyuan sooner or later, let him keep them for me. "
Chu Xuanhuai understood what Xu Shiyan was worried about, so he smiled immediately, and waved his hands while laughing.
"I'm fine, nothing happened, don't worry, I won't be so sad that I don't want to live because of the two beasts, I won't.
I still have to train Yuanyuan well. If I don't train this child into a talent, can I rest assured? "
A person in his eighties, who hasn’t experienced anything, why can’t he look down on life and death just because of this little thing?
Those two bums, he has long since ignored them.
Hearing what Master said, Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief, as long as the old man can think about it.
He was really worried, what if something happens to someone who is so old and gets angry because of this?
"Okay, then let him keep it. Whoever Master wants to find in the future, I can ask this source to call or write letters for you, it doesn't matter."
"Master, if you want to hold a birthday banquet at Changbaishan Hotel, do I have to find someone to arrange it in advance?"
The old man has been in the provincial capital for so many years, and he has a lot of connections.
The 80th birthday, it is estimated that the scale will not be small, so let's book the place in advance.
"Don't worry about it, someone will decide."
Chu Xuanhuai waved his hand, Xu Shiyan doesn't need to worry about this matter, someone just took care of it in those calls just now.
"Both you and Yuanyuan take a few days off, and accompany me back to the provincial capital. I have to go back and deal with some things. We'll come back when we're done."
In the past few years, Chu Xuanhuai lived comfortably in Donggang.
Because of his good physique, he didn't rush to deal with the affairs of the provincial capital.
Chu Yuanchao came to them today, and the old man realized that he should handle all the things that should be dealt with properly before he was confused, so as not to cause trouble to his disciples and grandchildren in the future.
Since Chu Xuanhuai said so, Xu Shiyan is not good at anything else.
I just reminded myself to find an opportunity to call the provincial capital and ask about the hotel.
If no one decides, he will make a decision quickly.
Don't care how much it costs, the old man only has one 80th birthday, so it must be done well to make the old man happy.
"Okay, then you guys chat, I am old and mentally weak, I have to go back and rest for a while.
Yuanyuan, let's go, help Master to go home. "It's getting late, Chu Xuanhuai is going back to rest.
Xu Shiyan saw that it was indeed getting late, and the family should go back to light the fire or something.
So he and his son supported Chu Xuanhuai, one on the left and the other on the right, and sent him back to rest.
Then Xu Shiyan hurried to heat up the kang and the boiler, and then went back to his parents.
Xu Shian's family also stayed here for a long time, thinking about going home to light the fire.
Xu Shiyan saw it, and then drove the second brother's family of four back to Sen Tie.
Xu Chenghou has plenty of space here, Xu Shixian and others stay here at night.
It was the children, all of whom had gone to Xu Shiyan's house, and they were going to watch a 21-inch color TV.
A group of children made a fuss and didn’t go to bed until almost ten o’clock, and slept until after seven o’clock the next morning. Then they got up, washed up, and went back to grandparents’ house for breakfast.
The third day of the first lunar month is the day to go back to her natal home, so Su Anying and her sisters-in-law naturally have to go back to their natal homes.
Fortunately, Su's house is close. After breakfast, the couple took their four children and went to Su's house for a stroll.
The Su family also had a big reunion today. The six daughters came back with their uncle and children. Everyone gathered together and were very happy.
Especially Ji Tongzhong and Nan Zhendong, they made money with Xu Shiyan and his wife last year, and life is getting better and better, so the smile on their faces can't be hidden.
"Second brother-in-law, I have already discussed with An Zhen that we will lease out the land and stop planting it ourselves.
We’ve been looking for a house in Donggang for a while, but we can’t. We’ll buy a house when the weather gets warmer, we’ll build one ourselves, and then move here. "
Nan Zhendong earned tens of thousands of dollars last year, and he figured it out. There is no development at Daying. If he wants to live a good life, he must move here.
At that time, follow Xu Shiyan to plant some sticks, and then do some business. If you catch up with those who have been in Daying for several years a year, you will be a fool not to move.
"Okay, that's good, let Xiao Ji and Shengli find it for you.
If you really don’t have a good idea, you can buy a house and build it yourself. "
Donggang is not too densely populated at this time, and there are still housing estates. Buying a house to build a house is actually more cost-effective than buying a house.
"Then Xiaoming has to transfer here to go to school?"
Nan Xiaoming was born in 1980 and is in the second grade this year.
Nan Xiaoliang was born in 1983 and will start elementary school next fall. Now he should be assigned to Yuhong Class.
"Let's see where the house is first. If it is too far away from Donggang Primary School, I will arrange for Xiaoming to go to Shenchang Primary School. The teaching quality is good."

chapters.title: Chapter 649: floor factory
chapters.content:
Chapter 649 Floor Factory
If Su Anzhen's family moved here again, it would be equivalent to the six daughters of the Su family, and all five of them would be here.
is also very good, the sisters are all together, close to their parents.
When I have free time, I go home to visit the elderly, help with washing clothes, cooking, chopping firewood and so on.
Work when you have work, and chat with the elderly if you don’t have work, and have a meal by the way.
Su Weizhong is now a full-time employee of the beverage factory. He is in good health now, and he will not delay at all when he looks at the gate.
Waiting for a few more years. If you don’t want to do it anymore, you can retire and stay at home.
Have a pension, have a few nieces filial living expenses, a good life.
Don't look at Su Weizhong's old couple who have no sons. In their day, they may not be able to compare with other families with sons.
The family reunion is naturally very lively.
Xu Shiyan, his wife and children stayed at Su's house for a long time, and they didn't go home until the children had had enough fun.
Relatives and friends all know the Xu family's New Year's habits, so before the third year of junior high, no one asked Xu Shiyan for dinner or anything.
After the third year of junior high school, Xu Shiyan became busy.
On the fourth day of the lunar new year, Zhou Qingguo invited guests, and they happened to call Xu Shiyan, Chen Jianzhang, Yang Junxian, Shao Mengyong, Wang Changhe and others.
The big guys gathered together to celebrate Chen Jianzhang's promotion to work in the city so quickly.
When Chen Jianzhang was transferred to the county, he knew that he might not be in the county for too long, so he didn't move his family there.
This callback to the city, it is estimated that this is the case, there is not much room for improvement, and it is almost possible to retire in the Agricultural Bureau.
So when he came back for the New Year this time, he planned to take his wife there with him.
Chen Jianzhang and Xu Shiyan also rarely meet, so naturally they have a lot to talk about when they get together.
The big guys got together and had to discuss how Donggang Town should go next, whether it should expand the scale of ginseng production.
Xu Shiyan gave a suggestion, don't expand blindly, maintaining the status quo is better than anything else.
Having known each other for so many years, Chen Jianzhang, Wang Changhe and the others were absolutely obedient to Xu Shiyan.
So when Xu Shiyan said this, everyone immediately understood, secretly vigilant, and must remind the family members not to be too greedy.
In Zhou Qingguo on the fourth day, on the fifth day, I brought Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong, Han Limin and others to meet and have a meal with the leaders of the Forestry Bureau.
The two sides discussed the cooperation in the new year based on the attitude of mutual benefit and win-win.
At the same time, Xu Shiyan also reminded the Forestry Bureau not to expand blindly.
For the time being, it is good to maintain the current scale.
"Brother Xu, we have known each other for many years, and we don't treat you as an outsider.
That, people say that you brother Xu has a little bit of ability to turn metal into gold, and is a capable person who earns foreign exchange through export.
Look, do you want to give us an idea and help us find a way.
Sell our wood abroad, and earn some foreign exchange? "
When the wine was hot, Sun Shirong, the director of the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, asked Xu Shiyan through the alcohol.
Xu Shiyan was taken aback when he heard this, and then laughed.
"Brother Sun, listen to those people outside fooling around, how can I have such great skills?
It’s all rumors outside, don’t listen to them. "
There are ideas, really.
In the previous life, the floor factory where his eldest daughter worked part-time made three-layer parquet.
It is specially exported to Europe and the United States, and it is said that it can sell for one or two hundred dollars per square meter.
It is the earliest factory in China to produce three-layer solid wood composite flooring, and it is also a well-known brand.
At first it was a joint venture between the county and a foreign businessman, but later it was contracted by an individual, and it was directly under the management of the province.
When it was most prosperous, the factory had branches in Dalian, Nanxun, and even Russia.
It is considered to be the largest factory in the local area, and it is a big profit and taxpayer.
In those years, it can be said that many people in Donggang and Songjianghe relied on that factory for their livelihood.
After that factory became prosperous, the original plywood factory, fiberboard factory, and timber factory of the Forestry Bureau were also contracted to individuals.
Floor factories have been established one after another to make this kind of three-layer solid wood composite floor.
For several years, the flooring manufacturing industry in Songjianghe was very prosperous, with many large and small factories.
At that time, there was no domestic timber, and logs were imported from abroad, processed and then exported.
Even if raw materials are imported, they still earn a lot.
Xu Shiyan thought about this before, but he is not very clear about the current situation of domestic flooring production.
He couldn't just give this suggestion rashly.
He has a bald mouth and said it doesn't matter, what if there is no such production technology yet? Isn't this nonsense?
So you can’t talk about this matter indiscriminately. It’s better to talk about it later when you understand it after investigation.
"Brother Sun, I will remember this matter.
If I really have a good idea in the future, I will definitely not hide it. Do you think this will work? "
The two parties are in a cooperative relationship, and Xu Shiyan can't talk too hard.
Leave a live story, if it is really investigated in the future, this technology is available now, and it is not impossible for the two parties to cooperate again at that time.
Sure enough, Sun Shirong was very happy when he heard Xu Shiyan say that.
"That's good, I believe in my brother.
When the time comes, don’t forget to call us and we’ll earn foreign exchange. "
In these years, earning foreign exchange through export is a major event, and departments at all levels have tasks.
Enterprises that can export and earn foreign exchange are the treasures in the eyes of leaders, and they are especially valued.
If Xu Shiyan didn't have this ability, how could he become the top leader of a municipal state-owned enterprise in his thirties? Are so many people jealous?
Everyone chatted together for a while, and then dispersed.
Xu Shiyan went back to Donggang a few times. Just after entering the door, the phone rang at home, and when he answered it, it was Chi Hao.
"Oh my God, you're home.
I called you several times, and my siblings said that you went out and didn't come back. "
Chi Hao was on the phone, seemingly in a hurry.
"I asked you about the Chu family's two things."
"Brother Chi, tell me, I'm listening."
Xu Shiyan found it interesting that Chi Hao called Chu Yuanchao and Chu Yuanlang two things, so he couldn't help laughing.
"The two of them have a sales office in Shenzhen and start some kind of company, which they say is doing import and export trade.
But I asked someone, it is a leather bag company, and there is not much business.
The two brothers are mainly helping those foreigners, dumping antiques and so on. "
Chi Hao is not an ordinary person either. It is very easy for him to find out the details of the Chu brothers.
"They met a man named Zhou in the capital.
It is said that the man's father used to be in the security department, and he was from the Northeast Anti-Japanese Federation, and he had a lot of connections.
Although the surname Zhou didn't work in any department, he has the network of contacts left by his father, so he does have some skills in the capital. "
"This time, the two brothers of the Chu family, under the guise of introducing foreign capital to our province and wanting to invest in building factories, came back and received the attention of the province.
But the other party has never said what kind of factory they want to build or what kind of investment they want to invest in, only that they want to inspect various places.
Isn’t it just in time for Chinese New Year? So for the time being, they are still in the provincial capital, and they haven't heard where they are going to investigate. "
Chi Hao was able to inquire about this in such a short period of time, which is quite impressive.
"Brother Chi, I see. They will probably come to me after a while."
When Xu Shiyan heard it, he probably guessed what the other party would do next.

chapters.title: Chapter 650: find out
chapters.content:
Chapter 650 Find out the details
As long as you find out the details of the brothers of the Chu family, you can probably guess where these two people will make their move next.
Chu Yuanchao was beaten here, and he will definitely inquire about Xu Shiyan when he goes back.
Knowing that Xu Shiyan is the general manager of Shenye Company, they used the pretense of coming to investigate investment.
Naturally, it is necessary to pull the tiger's skin to pull the banner, and come to participate in the trouble under the banner of investment.
At this time, attracting investment is the most important project for various departments.
If this can attract Dongyi merchants to invest in the construction of factories, it will be a great achievement for many people.
Don’t talk about others, if the guys in the county heard about it, they might be able to confess those people as if they were their ancestors.
The Chu family brothers only need to bring Dongyi merchants to participate in the competition, and try to make things difficult for Xu Shiyan, but in the end the investment fails, and the fault all falls on Xu Shiyan.
When the superior blames him, it will be enough for Xu Shiyan to drink a pot.
If it is more serious, the position of the general manager may be gone.
If Xu Shiyan was no longer in this position, he would naturally not be able to protect Chu Xuanhuai, nor the secret recipe.
At that time, the brothers of the Chu family will be able to get their wish.
Before the phone call, Chi Hao didn't think of this, but when Xu Shiyan said it, he understood.
"Then, what are you going to do?
This investment attraction is a big deal, if you are forced to put this charge on your head, it will be difficult to handle. "
Chi Hao was a little worried, these two grandsons could really do such a thing.
"It doesn't matter, as long as I know where they can come from, I can find a way."
Xu Shiyan was not particularly worried about this. If this matter was done well, it might make those two beasts suffer a bit.
"By the way, you know about Master's birthday, right?
If you are not busy, help me to make a reservation at the Changbaishan Hotel. Don’t be afraid of spending money. The more grand the arrangement, the better. "
No way, we are rich, and it’s just a big birthday, so we can do whatever we want, we must make the old man happy.
"Got it, isn't it the twelfth day of the first month?
You don't need to worry about the hotel, you just need to be responsible for escorting the teacher to the place safely.
It is best to come a few days in advance, the journey is long, so the teacher has to rest for two days to refresh himself. "
Chi Hao was most worried about Chu Xuanhuai. As for the hotel, how much effort would it take for them to book a hotel?
"Well, I left home on the eighth day of the eighth day, so I must have gone early.
Help me book two rooms in the hotel, and prevent Master from going home, so as not to meet those two brothers and make Master angry. "
Definitely have to go to the province ahead of time, Xu Shiyan is going to meet the leader of the province.
In this matter, they may have to be invited to come forward in the end. Xu Shiyan is not high enough now.
It's okay to deal with the Chu family brothers, but if people from the capital really get involved, Xu Shiyan is really not enough to watch.
Chi Hao agreed to this matter without even thinking about it. The two chatted for a few more words before hanging up the phone.
Afterwards, Xu Shiyan called Li Bingzhuo and the others again and told them to go to work tomorrow. Xu Shiyan had something to tell them.
After hanging up the phone, Xu Shiyan felt uneasy again, so he called Guan Enxue again.
After listening to Xu Shiyan's words, Guan Enxue pondered for a moment, and then assured Xu Shiyan that he would carry it in the city, and the custody would not cause trouble to the Shenye company.
At the same time, Guan Enxue also reminded Xu Shiyan to pay attention to the county.
Xu Shiyan made the preparations that should be done in advance, and then greeted the elementary school, and asked Xu Haiyuan for a few days off.
On the morning of the eighth day of the first lunar month, the driver of the unit drove and took the three of Xu Shiyan to the train station.
From Donggang to the provincial capital, the roads are difficult to walk in winter, and it takes more than a day to drive by myself.
Chu Xuanhuai is getting old, sitting in the car for such a long time, no matter how spacious the car is, he can't bear it.
So he could only take the train. Xu Shiyan asked someone to buy a sleeper ticket. From Songjiang River to Hunjiang River, and then from Hunjiang River to the provincial capital, they were all soft sleepers.
Chu Xuanhuai can lie down in the car, not so tired.
This is Xu Haiyuan's first time traveling far away. If it was another child, he would have been so excited that he didn't know what to do.
However, after Xu Haiyuan got into the car, he was not very curious, as if all this was normal.
In Xu Haiyuan's eyes, only Chu Xuanhuai took good care of him along the way.
No matter what Chu Xuanhuai is going to do, Xu Haiyuan can guess it accurately and reach out to help at the right time.
Now the road is still not very peaceful, Xu Shiyan remains vigilant at all times.
Fortunately, the soft sleeper side is okay, there are not so many messy people, and the three of them are not too conspicuous. At any rate, they arrived at the provincial capital station on the morning of the ninth day of the first lunar month.
As soon as I got off the train, before I got out of the platform, the staff of the station over there greeted me and arranged for Xu Shiyan and the others to get out of the station.
Outside the station, Chi Hao also had a few people that Xu Shiyan didn't know, but at first glance, they seemed to be very bookish, waiting.
Seeing Chu Xuanhuai, these people all saluted respectfully.
"Hello teacher, you have worked hard all the way, the car is ready, let's go directly to the hotel."
"Okay, I'm causing you trouble this time, let's go, go to the hotel, and we'll talk over there."
Chu Xuanhuai nodded, he was also very happy to see these students.
Chi Hao and others stepped forward, supported Chu Xuanhuai and walked out, and came to several cars.
Xu Shiyan and his son accompanied Chu Xuanhuai in a car, and the others got into other cars.
The driver started the car and went straight to Changbaishan Hotel.
Chi Hao booked the best two rooms at the Changbaishan Hotel, and after entering the room, Chu Xuanhuai introduced it to everyone.
"This is Feng Qiyu, the principal of the University of Medical Sciences, my student.
This is the dean of the Medical University Hospital, Yuan Jincheng, who is also my student. You called them before. "
These words were addressed to Xu Shiyan.
"This is my apprentice, Xu Shiyan, you should have heard of it.
This is my little grandson, Xu Haiyuan. I brought them here this time to go to the administration for filing. "
What Elder Chu said was the certification of the teacher-inheritance relationship.
Before, Mr. Chu felt that Xu Haiyuan was still young, so he was not in a hurry. At least he had to wait for Xu Haiyuan to graduate from junior high school before he could do the certification.
But now he has changed his mind, the sooner the better, after the master-student relationship is certified, it will be good for Xu Haiyuan.
If it wasn't for this, how could Mr. Chu, a low-key person like Mr. Chu, hold such a big birthday party?
Cook a bowl of noodles with two poached eggs, isn’t it good? Why bother to run back to the provincial capital?
Chu Xuanhuai has moved to Xu's family for several years, how can his students not know the existence of Xu Shiyan?
If it weren't for the fact that everyone knew the teacher's character well, and didn't like to be disturbed, they would have to go and visit him during the holidays.
For this apprentice that the teacher accepted, everyone was very impressed.
After all, in the past few years, I have earned a lot of foreign exchange and won many awards. Everyone has heard of Xu Shiyan's name, and they are also very happy that the teacher has such a good apprentice.
But the appearance of Xu Haiyuan is really surprising.
The teacher also accepted a young disciple? It seems that this time, it is mainly for the sake of this child that the teacher's certification is required.
How old is this baby? Are you in your teens? Is it that great? Can the teacher like it to this extent?
If this is the case, the future of this baby is limitless.

chapters.title: Chapter 651: must teach them a lesson
chapters.content:
Chapter 651 must teach them a lesson
"Teacher, don't worry, I'll find someone to arrange this matter, you can take a good rest in the hotel first.
In the past few days, those brothers and sisters from far away will come over.
Your 80th birthday will definitely be held in a splendid and grand manner. "
Feng Qiyu and the others were astonished in their hearts, but they didn't show it on their faces. They only told Mr. Chu in a warm voice to rest first.
After all, he is 80 years old, so even if he was sitting on a sleeper berth, he would be in a panic.
Mr. Chu was indeed not very comfortable. The sleeper berth was narrow, and it was difficult to turn over.
Furthermore, there are many people on the train, Chu Xuanhuai likes to be quiet, but he finds it annoying to be noisy.
The train rattled along the way, and I felt dizzy and flustered.
So he nodded and didn't say anything to the students, he just waved his hand and told Feng Qiyu and others to go out first.
"Yuanyuan, you stay and take care of your master, I live next door." Xu Shiyan instructed his son.
Xu Haiyuan is very careful despite his young age.
Besides, he has been with Elder Chu for several years, and the tacit understanding between the grandfather and grandson is very good, but Xu Shiyan's staying is actually getting in the way.
Xu Shiyan and the others came out of the room, and when they got outside, they formally shook hands with Feng Qiyu, Yuan Jincheng and others to say hello.
"I'm sorry to cause trouble for you guys." Xu Shiyan said politely.
"No trouble, the teacher's business is our business.
Since you are the teacher's disciple, you are our junior, so you don't have to be so polite in the future. "Feng Qiyu nodded and smiled.
"I would also like to thank you for taking care of the teacher these years.
It can be seen that the teacher is in good condition and you are very attentive. "
Although Chu Xuanhuai's spirit of tossing and tossing along the way was a little bit weak, his complexion was rosy and he was a little fatter.
Overall, it’s much better than living in a family courtyard before.
"Sure, it's my honor and blessing to take care of Master." Xu Shiyan smiled.
He never thought it was a big deal to take over Mr. Chu, and he didn't take credit for it.
This is why Xu Shiyan didn't take the initiative to contact students like Mr. Chu, for fear that people would think he was asking for credit.
It’s just Chi Hao, mainly because we have known each other before. Every autumn and winter, Xu Shiyan will send some mountain goods to Chi Hao. This is an old friendship.
"Let's go, let's find a place to have a good chat, tell me about the two brothers from the Chu family.
Let's discuss how to deal with it, and we must not let them hurt the teacher's heart again. "
Feng Qiyu has a good impression of Xu Shiyan. This person seems to be easy to get close to. It is very comfortable to talk and chat with him.
So, several people went downstairs and found a place to sit down, and then Feng Qiyu and the others listened carefully to Xu Shiyan and Chi Hao's narration.
"It's a good beating, a beating is right, you should beat them both hard.
The teacher only had them when he was very old, and he was always tolerant of them. Who knew that these two were not stingy and ignorant at all.
When I was studying, I didn't worry about it, and I always got into trouble. Later, when something happened, I put all the responsibility on the teacher.
At that time, the two of them were young men in their 17th and 18th years. They couldn't even take care of their teachers and mothers well, and they still had the face to blame others? "
Feng Qiyu is in his fifties. He was studying at the University of Medical Sciences. At that time, Chu Xuanhuai was Feng Qiyu's tutor and took good care of Feng Qiyu.
At that time, Feng Qiyu and the others also went to the countryside separately, and it was Chu Xuanhuai who brought them all back later.
It can be said that without Chu Xuanhuai, Feng Qiyu and others would not be where they are today, so everyone respects Chu Xuanhuai very much.
They watched the brothers of the Chu family grow up with their own eyes, and they knew the virtues of the two brothers.
Those two **** didn't learn well at the beginning, so what kind of good people do they expect to become now?
They are all too civilized, but if there was someone who came forward to beat up those two, maybe they wouldn't be so messed up.
"However, right now the two of them are involved with foreign businessmen.
If it is really like Xu Shidi said, using the name of obstructing foreign investment to suppress people, it is really not easy to handle.
We really have to think about this matter.
Also, who is the one in Beijing? Inquire and see who can speak?
Back then, the older generation fought and killed the little devil from Dongyi. Now even if the two sides have contacts, shouldn’t some people know right from wrong?
Why can anyone hook up? "
Yuan Jincheng's family also has elders who came from that **** storm. The family motto is not to associate with outsiders, and to forget the ancestors.
That's why Yuan Jincheng doesn't understand. How many years have passed? Why did you forget all of them?
"Hey, what's the use of talking about that?
People's hearts are changeable, and in the face of interests, who cares about the family precepts of the ancestors?
If my father was still around and knew about this, he would be able to kill these people with a gun. "Feng Qiyu shook his head.
"We don't care about others, but the two teachers, this time we must teach them a lesson.
Brother Xu, what are your thoughts on this matter? We can discuss it together. "
Feng Qiyu looked at Xu Shiyan who didn't talk much, and always felt that he didn't seem to be too worried.
"Well, I probably know about this matter, but at present it needs the cooperation of manpower.
I'm going to visit a leader later, and I can only do it after obtaining his consent. "
Xu Shiyan was talking about the organizational leader who is directly responsible for the pharmaceutical factory in the province.
This incident must be taught to the Chu family and the others, to let them know the price of betraying their ancestors and colluding with outsiders.
"Okay, as long as you know what's in your mind, we'll be relieved, and if you need us to do something, just ask.
No matter what, we can be regarded as fellowship.
The teacher treats us with great kindness, whoever treats the teacher badly is our public enemy. "Feng Qiyu and others nodded in agreement.
Xu Shiyan seems to be a very stable person, and it is easy to gain the trust of others.
Although it was the first time for Feng Qiyu and others to meet him, they had heard Chu Xuanhuai and Chi Hao mention it before, so they had a very good impression of Xu Shiyan.
Meeting today, the goodwill has increased a bit.
So Feng Qiyu and others are willing to make friends with Xu Shiyan and help him.
"Well, brothers, let's do this first, I'll make a phone call first, and then visit a leader.
Wait for me to come back, and then find everyone to discuss the next thing. "
The most important thing right now is to report the situation to the leader and get his support before it can be deployed later.
Xu Shiyan bid farewell to everyone, borrowed the hotel phone, and called the other party.
When the other party heard that Xu Shiyan was going to meet him, he was also very happy, so he told Xu Shiyan directly that it was enough to let Xu Shiyan wait at the hotel, and he sent someone to pick him up.
So, Xu Shiyan hung up the phone and waited at the hotel with peace of mind.
After about half an hour, two jeeps with license plates on a white background stopped at the entrance of the hotel.
Then, a few straight young men in uniforms got out of the car and walked into the hotel neatly.
One of them glanced around the hotel lobby, and happened to meet Xu Shiyan's gaze.
At this time, Xu Shiyan had already stood up and nodded towards the other party.
"Hello Mr. Xu, the leader asked me to pick you up." The other party saluted Xu Shiyan and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 652: Chu Lao's details
chapters.content:
Chapter 652 The Background of Elder Chu
On the ninth day of the lunar new year, Chu Xuanhuai rested in the hotel. On the tenth day, accompanied by Xu Shiyan and his son, he went back to his small courtyard.
Although Chu Xuanhuai does not live here, the University of Medicine still arranges people to clean the house every day.
Come over to light the fire in winter to avoid damage to the house due to being unoccupied for too long.
When Chu Xuanhuai and others entered the door, the nanny happened to be lighting the fire and cleaning the house.
As soon as she saw Chu Xuanhuai enter the door, the nanny was so excited that she almost burst into tears.
"Mr. Chu, you are back. You have been away for several years. I thought you thought I didn't take good care of you."
Chu Xuanhuai waved his hand, "Xiao Zhao, don't get me wrong, it really has nothing to do with you.
I just got tired of living in the city, so I went to the countryside to live comfortably. "
The nanny wiped away her tears, and helped Chu Xuanhuai into the east room.
"Old Chu, you don't know, a few days ago, many people came to the house.
Two people said it was your son, they had to look for something, and turned the house into a mess.
I wanted to call the police, but they left later. "The nanny suddenly remembered this, and hurriedly told Chu Xuanhuai.
"Well, I see, it's okay, I'm at ease with you at home."
The old man sat on the kang and nodded. As soon as the nanny saw so many people, she hurried to boil water and make tea.
"Shiyan, Yuanyuan, you two go to the study in the back room and sort out my books.
All stacked up and tied up, I will buy some cardboard boxes later and put them in.
Going back this time, we have to take all these books back. "
Chu Xuanhuai came back this time to deal with family affairs.
He has already made up his mind to stay with Xu Shiyan, and he can deal with it here, there is no need to keep it.
The house is owned by the public, so if you hand it back, he doesn’t care what the public wants to do with it.
These books are mainly his collection for half his life, and many of them are isolated copies of ancient books, which are very valuable, no worse than the secret recipe of the Chu family.
That is to say, those two beasts don't understand anything, but if they understand a little bit, they should have been cleaned up long ago.
Chu Xuanhuai intends to pass on all these things to Xu Haiyuan, so naturally he has to take them away.
Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan followed their advice and went into the study to tidy up.
As soon as Xu Haiyuan entered the back room, he was shocked by the books in the room, "My God, there are so many books in Shigong's house."
"Yeah, this time you can watch whatever you want, it's enough for you to watch for a lifetime."
Xu Shiyan glanced at his son on purpose. If he can read all the books in this room thoroughly, his future achievements will definitely not be low.
"Anyway, just don't cry in the future." These words are intended to provoke his son.
Xu Haiyuan looked speechless, simply shook his head, and did not hesitate to talk to his childish father.
There are so many books to read, it's too late for him to be happy, how could he cry? Cut, is it too small to look down on people?
Xu Haiyuan took off his coat, rolled up his sleeves, and began to take books from the bookshelf.
Originally, the books on this shelf were arranged in different categories.
But when the Chu Yuanchao brothers came back, they rummaged through the mess, making a mess.
Although the nanny tidied it up, she didn't understand. She just put it back on the shelf, so it was a bit messy.
Xu Haiyuan took it down, and sorted it out by category, so that it would be easier to put away when going home.
Although Xu Shiyan is a half-baked guy, he knows a little bit anyway, and he cooperates with his sons. He takes the high ones, and Xu Haiyuan sorts them out, and the two start to work.
Old Chu rested on the kang for a while, just as the nanny entered the room.
Mr. Chu took out the money and asked the nanny to buy something, cook a few dishes for lunch, and eat at home.
When the nanny heard this, she immediately took the money, changed her clothes, and went out to buy groceries.
Xu Shiyan and his son started to clean up at nine o'clock and continued to clean up until noon, at least half of it was cleaned up.
After lunch, Xu Shiyan went to buy cardboard boxes and woven bags in the afternoon.
Put all the books in cardboard boxes, put them in woven bags, and write the numbers on them.
Working till evening, I finally put away all the books, and the boxes were piled up on the floor.
There are also some documents, certificates, certificates, etc., find a backpack separately, and pack them up and take them away first.
Back to the hotel, Xu Shiyan immediately called Su Anying and asked Su Anying to lead Xu Shian, Huang Shengli and the others to bring more money.
Before Xu Shiyan said that he would buy a truck, a half truck, for the farm, and a car for Su Anying.
In time for the Chinese New Year, I didn't take care of it. It happened that this time I had the opportunity to let them come over.
Bought a car, drove back directly, and took all these books away along the way.
With so many books, I dare not go to the post office. If one or two boxes are lost on the way, Xu Shiyan and his father will be so distressed.
It is better to drive back by yourself, be careful not to lose it.
Su Anying answered the phone and agreed directly. She will take the train to the provincial capital on the morning of the 11th.
As for the provincial capital, on the eleventh day of the first lunar month, many people came to the hotel one after another to visit Chu Xuanhuai.
By this time, Xu Shiyan finally knew how many students Mr. Chu had taught these years.
Among these people, the oldest is nearly sixty, many are in their fifties, and the youngest is in their forties.
Among them, there were many others, all wearing grass-green uniforms, with bars and stars on their shoulders, and Xu Haiyuan was dumbfounded.
"Dad, why do the clothes these uncles wear resemble my little uncle's?
Aren’t they students of Shigong? Why are you still in uniform? "After all, the child is young and doesn't know much about it.
"Your master used to be a professor and president of a medical university.
You have to know that before the medical university, it was actually a military medical university, so it is normal for them to wear this outfit. "
Bethune Medical University used to be a military medical university, but it was changed later.
It is not uncommon for some of Mr. Chu's students to wear uniforms.
But Xu Shiyan was quite surprised that so many people could come to participate in the old man's 80th birthday. The old man's background is a bit amazing.
"Yuanyuan, come here, come, come to Master." Just as he was speaking, Chu Xuanhuai waved to Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan immediately ran to Shigong's side and stood still.
"Master, what do you want? I'll get it for you." Xu Haiyuan thought that Master was looking for him to work.
Chu Xuanhuai smiled, took Xu Haiyuan's hand, and hugged him in front of him.
"Come on, let me introduce you, this is my new apprentice.
He was supposed to be my closed disciple, but his father was also my apprentice, so he took in his grandson because he was afraid that his father and father would not be able to calculate their seniority. "
"Come, Yuanyuan, call Master, these are all your masters.
Now that there is a new society, you don’t have to kowtow to them regardless of the old rituals.
They don't need to give you any greetings, just give you a greeting. "
Chu Xuanhuai did this on purpose, just to let Xu Haiyuan show his face in front of these people.
Bringing Xu Haiyuan here this time is to pave the way for him in the future.
The people in front of me, whoever they call out, are all elites in the medical field.
No matter where Xu Haiyuan goes in the future, with Chu Xuanhuai's face, these people will take care of Xu Haiyuan a little more, that's enough.
Xu Haiyuan felt good, stood up quickly, and bowed to the people in front of him in a polite manner.
"Disciple Xu Haiyuan, pay homage to all the masters."
Xu Shiyan looked at this scene from the side, and he had the feeling of entering a master's school to learn from a master in a martial arts movie.
This is actually quite interesting.

chapters.title: Chapter 653: birthday
chapters.content:
Chapter 653 Birthday
February 17th, the twelfth day of the first month of the lunar calendar, on this day, the Changbaishan Hotel was directly reserved.
Although there are no flowers, arches and the like this year, the banquet hall is still very warmly decorated by the staff.
A huge cake was placed on the table of the reception desk. Behind the reception desk was a dark red velvet curtain, on which were pinned a few large golden characters.
Congratulations to my mentor, Mr. Chu, on his 80th birthday.
Chu Xuanhuai was dressed in a satin Tang suit with a black background and a dark red birthday pattern, and with a cane in his hand, he entered the banquet hall accompanied by Xu Haiyuan.
All the people in the banquet hall stood up, applauding with smiles on their faces.
Chu Xuanhuai looked at everyone present and smiled, very happily.
Among these, some of them were called by Xu Shiyan, and some of them came without notification.
Having been teaching for more than forty years, he has never calculated how many students he has taught.
But at this moment, the old man is really proud and proud.
It can be said that these people are now top figures in the medical field, and each of them has made remarkable achievements in their respective fields.
Xu Haiyuan supported Elder Chu, and sat on the chair at the reception desk, while he stood beside him in an orderly manner.
Old Chu looked at the students in the audience, some of them had gray hair, and the traces of time had also crawled onto their faces.
In my memory, they are still the group of young people in full bloom and full of youth. In a blink of an eye, so many years have passed.
They have long faded from their greenness and become calm and capable.
"Sit down, sit down and talk.
I never thought that there would be a chance to bring you all together and meet and chat with you. "
Old Chu was a little excited, his hands were shaking.
"My old man is getting old, and I am afraid that one day I will close my eyes and never see you again.
So taking advantage of the opportunity of my 80th birthday, I called you all here, just to meet you and see you people. "
Mr. Chu raised his hand to signal the students to sit down.
"Hello, teacher, I wish you the best wishes for your 80th birthday. May you be as blessed as the East China Sea, Shoubi Nanshan, the sun and the moon, and Songhe Changchun."
Everyone congratulated Mr. Chu Xuanhuai on his 80th birthday in unison.
Xu Shiyan also stood in the middle of this group of senior brothers, sending blessings together with a smile on his face.
"OK, ok, all ok, thank you."
Old Chu laughed happily, but he couldn't control the tears in his eyes.
Eighty, how many eighties do people have in this lifetime? He lived to be eighty years old, and having such a group of outstanding students was enough, and he was really content.
Xu Haiyuan saw his master like this, quickly took out his handkerchief, and wiped his tears for him.
Chu Xuanhuai held Xu Haiyuan's hand and smiled happily.
"You came early, you probably have seen this kid, but you just came here today, and you don't know him yet.
I introduce this child to you. This is my newly adopted young disciple. He is intelligent and quick-witted, and he is extremely talented in medicine.
I have made up my mind to pass on Chu's medical skills and what I have learned all my life to him.
Take this opportunity today to formally meet with you.
If I am no longer here in the future, I hope you will take good care of me and take care of him a little bit, and I will be satisfied. "
There were sixty or seventy people present, half of them had met Xu Haiyuan and knew Xu Haiyuan's identity.
Moreover, when we met yesterday, we took Xu Haiyuan's medical knowledge test consciously or unintentionally, and the child answered clearly.
Among these people, many are quite old.
When they were studying medicine, it was very difficult. How could there be so many western medicines? Not to mention any western medical examination equipment, don't even think about it.
So in the concept of this group of people, they don't care about the difference between Chinese and Western medicine at all, as long as they can cure diseases and are useful.
And many people have been advocating the integration of traditional Chinese and Western medicine over the years.
So don’t look at them as graduates of medical universities, but they all have a certain understanding of Chinese medicine.
So when they passed Xu Haiyuan's homework, they were also very surprised.
It is really rare for this child to have such a reserve of knowledge at such a young age.
For the teacher, they are very happy and gratified that the teacher can find such a talented, intelligent, and suitable inheritor who can be cultivated from an early age.
The other people who didn't know were still surprised at the moment, and the people next to them told them.
After learning about the child, everyone was also very happy.
Chinese medicine is a treasure left by our ancestors. It should not be submerged in the long river of history. Someone must inherit and carry it forward.
"Yo, it's been a long time, the teacher found a little nephew for us?
That, little nephew, which school do you plan to take in the future?
Otherwise, come to me. Welcome to Jingcheng Medical University. "Someone said with a smile.
"Hey, Lao Liu, it's not natural, it's not a big deal, you started robbing people, right?
Then our school is also very good, why does my nephew go to your school? "Someone next to him made a fuss, and everyone laughed.
"Don't be in a hurry, don't be in a hurry, he is still studying, homework is the main thing, where he will take the exam in the future depends on his preferences.
Anyway, we are studying well. In the future, it depends on who of you is lucky enough to accept such a good student. "
Old Chu smiled happily. These people in front of him are the greatest achievements in his life.
"Well, there is one more thing. I called you here today, and I also want you to be a witness." Elder Chu restrained his smile.
"You guys all know about my family affairs.
Being old and not talented, he has been obsessed with studying medical skills all his life and devoted himself to curing diseases and saving lives, but he has neglected his family and relatives, and failed to educate future generations.
It was my fault that the two sons felt resentment towards me and ran counter to me. "
Having said this, Elder Chu paused for a moment and let out a long sigh.
"Chu Yuanchao and Chu Yuanlang took the initiative to sever the father-son relationship with me back then, it was really helpless.
I didn't take it to heart, and I don't blame them.
Later, I sent letters to the two of them several times, hoping that their brothers would return to me and share the joy of family together, but they were all rejected. "
The more the old man talked, the more sad he became.
"Father and son have been separated for more than ten years, and the two of them have not fulfilled the responsibility of being a son.
The family was unlucky, and two unfilial sons came out.
Today, I am in front of you, oh, and there are several reporters and lawyers outside the door.
I declare now that the newspaper will sever my father-son relationship with Chu Yuanchao and Chu Yuanlang.
From today, I don't recognize them as my Chu Xuanhuai's children.
I don't have any property under my name, only the medical skills and secret recipes passed down by the Chu family for hundreds of years, which will be inherited by my little disciple, Xu Haiyuan.
I hope that Xu Haiyuan can inherit my mantle and carry forward Chu's medical skills so that they will not be cut off. "
Since the two of Chu Yuanchao went to Donggang to make trouble that day, Chu Xuanhuai had already thought about what to do.
He just wanted to cut off the thoughts of the two rebellious sons in front of everyone, and cut off the way for them to legally inherit.
These in front of me are all important figures in the medical field. They are witnesses, and there are also reporters from the provincial newspaper and professional lawyers.
With these people around, there is no fear that those two beasts will be able to make waves after he leaves in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 654: adopt
chapters.content:
Chapter 654 Adoption
Mr. Chu was coming back to celebrate his 80th birthday, and he called so many students.
Xu Shiyan guessed that this birthday must not be easy.
But he only thought that the old man wanted to take the opportunity to deal with all the affairs in the provincial capital, at most he just paved the way for Xu Haiyuan by the way.
I really didn't expect that the old man still kept this hand. Is this planning to make a will in advance?
When were the reporters and lawyers hired? Xu Shiyan really didn't know anything.
But at this time, in front of so many people, the old man has already talked about this.
Regardless of whether they knew it beforehand or not, they must support Elder Chu's decision, and they cannot tear down the stage at this critical moment.
So, Xu Shiyan immediately winked at Xu Haiyuan.
Both father and son moved at the same time, kneeling directly in front of Chu Xuanhuai.
"Thanks to my mentor for not giving up, I have high hopes for Quan Zi, not only giving me medical skills, but also giving me Chu's secret recipe.
The disciple has nothing to repay, but he can only promise to his teacher here that he will serve his teacher with all his heart until he grows old, and dare not treat him in the slightest.
In the future, if Xu Haiyuan marries a wife and has children, no matter how many children he has, the first son will be named Chu. "
Xu Shiyan had discussed this matter with his father before.
Chu Xuanhuai treats Xu Haiyuan like his own grandson, but Xu Haiyuan is already grown up, and his household registration and school status are all settled, so it is not easy to change.
So we can only wait for the future. After Xu Haiyuan gets married and has a child, he adopts one of the children to the Chu family.
How to say, maybe later people don't care much about these things, no one has a throne to inherit, and they don't care about incense, inheritance and so on.
At that time, there were so many people who were not married, who cares about these things?
However, in the hearts of the older generation, this concept of spreading incense and successors is still deeply rooted.
Although Mr. Chu doesn't talk about it on weekdays, anyone can see that the old man has regrets in his heart.
For this matter, Xu Chenghou also supports it. After all, Xu Haiyuan has the inheritance of the Chu family, and it is also reasonable to adopt a child.
The elders all believe in this, and don't think there is anything wrong with it.
But the two of them didn't tell anyone about this matter, let alone Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Haiyuan.
The main reason is that it is not suitable, as if Xu Shiyan took Chu Xuanhuai home because he was greedy for his medical skills and secret recipes.
He, Xu Shiyan, is a disciple of Elder Chu, and it is his duty to send Elder Chu to the end of his life, and he will not ask for anything because of this.
Chu’s secret recipes, except for the two that were handed in after Mr. Chu’s consent, are not among them.
For the others, Xu Shiyan has already discussed with the leaders. If the secret recipe of the Chu family is used in the future, 10% of the profits will be shared and left to Mr. Chu or his descendants.
Fangzi is not useless, and 10% of the profit is not a lot. As long as the Chu family lives in peace, they can definitely live comfortably.
But no one expected that the two brothers of the Chu family would be such a jerk.
The virtues of those two people, it is impossible to be satisfied with a 10% profit. They are afraid that they want to sell the secret recipe directly to foreign businessmen.
Things have come to this point, and Elder Chu has publicly expressed his attitude in front of so many people.
At this point, if Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, it would be outrageous.
That's why Xu Shiyan took the initiative to mention that in the future, Xu Haiyuan's children will be adopted by the Chu family, which can be regarded as inheriting the incense of the Chu family.
When Xu Shiyan said this, Chu Xuanhuai, Xu Haiyuan, and those present were all stunned.
Xu Haiyuan is still young, and he doesn't understand these things, so he looks indifferent.
But Chu Xuanhuai is different. After hearing Xu Shiyan's words, such an old man immediately shed tears.
The Chu family was not prosperous at all, so they finally came to Chu Xuanhuai, and they had two sons in their forties or fifties.
When the child was born, Chu Xuanhuai was very excited.
I also hoped that the two children would be successful in the future, inherit the medical skills of the Chu family, and carry forward the unique knowledge of the Chu family.
But no one would have imagined that these two children would have such virtues when they grow up.
Not to mention inheriting the medical skills of the Chu family, they really wanted to sell their ancestors.
Chu Xuanhuai felt that he was ashamed of his ancestors by failing to teach his two sons well.
Absolutely no longer let the secret recipe passed down by the Chu family for hundreds of years go to foreign little devils.
That's why the old man chose this time, gathered so many people, and publicly severed the father-son relationship with his two sons.
Deprive them of their inheritance rights, so that they will no longer have the opportunity to get their hands on Chu's secret recipe.
Chu Xuanhuai has achieved this step, and has no intention of inheriting any more incense from the Chu family.
If the two sons are like this, how can the grandson be better?
But he never expected that Xu Shiyan would adopt Xu Haiyuan's child to the Chu family.
The old man who had always been strong couldn't help crying, and he didn't know whether he was sad or happy at the moment.
Seeing this, Xu Haiyuan hurried over and hugged Chu Xuanhuai, but he didn't know how to comfort Chu Xuanhuai.
This is still too difficult for Xu Haiyuan.
"Master, if you think it takes too long for me to get married and have children, otherwise, I can change my surname to Chu."
In desperation, Xu Haiyuan could only say so.
Chu Xuanhuai is a big man after all, and he is such a strong person on weekdays. It is already shameful enough to cry in front of everyone. How can he keep crying?
Hearing Xu Haiyuan's words, the old man wiped away his tears, and stretched out his hand to hold Xu Haiyuan in his arms.
"No, no, you are the pride of your parents, your grandparents are still waiting for you to honor your ancestors, how can you let me have my last name?
You have to be careful, just like your father said, you will have a child in the future, and the first child will be named Chu, and pass on the medical skills of the Chu family to him.
Even if I am under the Nine Springs, I can still close my eyes. "
This is the sincere heart of the disciples and disciples, and it is also the best way.
For Chu Xuanhuai, this is the greatest comfort, he really can't refuse such a proposal.
When Chu Xuanhuai said this, it was tantamount to agreeing to Xu Shiyan's proposal.
Everyone around looked at the old man who had experienced vicissitudes and the innocent child in front of him, and mist appeared in their eyes.
"Okay, this is the best way, congratulations teacher.
In the future, this will be your own grandson. When your great-grandson is born in the future, the Chu family will have an heir. "Everyone congratulated Elder Chu one after another.
The old man also became happy, and hugged Xu Haiyuan with a smile on his face. This child is really in his heart.
"Okay, okay, I didn't expect that I would be old enough to have such a good grandson, and this life would be enough."
The old man laughed through his tears, and everyone in the audience applauded.
At this time, the lawyer came over, took a will that had been made in advance, and asked Elder Chu what else he wanted to order, and whether there were any additional clauses to be added.
For example, what Xu Shiyan said just now, Xu Haiyuan's future child's surname is Chu, should we leave a written agreement on this.
Old Chu shook his head, "No need, even if there is no such thing as adoption, my heart is the same.
I am optimistic about the child Yuanyuan. I give everything to this child without any strings attached. "

chapters.title: Chapter 655: spiritual child
chapters.content:
Chapter 655 Spiritual child
The will was made in advance, since Mr. Chu didn't have any clauses to add, so he only needed to sign it.
In order to ensure that the authenticity of the will will not be questioned, Feng Qiyu and another student of Mr. Chu were invited as witnesses, and they also signed it.
On the other side, a reporter from the provincial newspaper also showed Elder Chu the statement published in the newspaper to sever the relationship between father and son.
After reading it, Mr. Chu confirmed that there was no problem, and nodded in agreement with the reporter to go back and publish the article.
"You guys have worked hard, don't worry, stay for the birthday banquet first, just go back and do it later."
After all these things were done, the hotel staff handed over candles and matches.
Xu Shiyan and his son helped the old man to light the candles, and everyone sang birthday songs for Mr. Chu, wishing Mr. Chu a happy birthday and a long and healthy life.
After that, Elder Chu dragged Xu Haiyuan and asked Xu Haiyuan to help him blow out the candles.
After the candles were blown out, the staff over there began to serve dishes to the tables.
At this time, Su Anying outside the door waved at Xu Shiyan.
"When did you arrive? Why didn't you go in?" Xu Shiyan came out of the banquet hall and asked his wife with a smile on his face.
"Come here a long time ago, just like Mr. Chu, I can't go in and get involved, so I just watch outside.
It's okay, I just don't feel relieved to come and have a look, it's okay if I don't go in. " Su Anying laughed.
"Your proposal is very good.
I was worried that the old man was hurt by his two sons, so I couldn't think about it anymore.
With the matter of adoption as an introduction, Elder Chu will definitely take extra care of himself.
I think the old man is in good health, maybe he can live to be in his nineties, seeing us marrying wives and having children. "
Su Anying didn't accuse her husband of making random ideas or anything. In her opinion, everything the husband did had his reasons.
Besides, this is indeed a good way.
In the future, Xu Haiyuan will marry a daughter-in-law and discuss it with her. It is not a big deal to have more children.
Even if there is only one child, whether the surname is Chu or Xu, isn’t it still the blood of the old Xu family?
Could it be that a surname can cut off a family relationship?
The Xu family still has Xu Haiqing here, what are you afraid of?
Besides, those who only have daughters at home, what can they do? Life is not the same?
What really matters should never be what the child's last name is, whether it's a boy or a girl.
It's about whether you can have a healthy child, and whether the child will be promising in the future.
As long as the children are promising, regardless of gender, they will take care of their parents and family members equally.
Just like the Su family, what happened to the six daughters? Is it good to be different?
The lives of Su Weizhong and his wife are actually more nourishing.
"Well, you go in quickly, Yufeng, Shengli, and the second brother and I will go to the front desk of the hotel to check in.
I won’t participate in the banquet inside, you stay with Mr. Chu well, and when things here are over, let’s go to see the car together. "
Su Anying glanced into the banquet hall, seeing that all the dishes seemed to be served inside, and the banquet was about to start, so she urged Xu Shiyan to go in quickly.
Xu Shiyan wanted to let Su Anying in. Thinking about the men in this room, Su Anying must be uncomfortable by herself.
"Okay then, at noon, you, Jun Xian's wife and second brother and the others, find a better place to eat.
I don’t think there’s much going on today. You can take a rest, or go out for a stroll.
Jun Xian’s daughter-in-law may not have been to the provincial capital, so you two go out and hang around, buy something, don’t be reluctant to spend money. "
Xu Shiyan explained a few words, just in time to hear someone calling him, so he quickly agreed and went back inside.
Su Anying led Ji Yufeng and others to check in at the front desk of the hotel.
These are people who are not short of money, how can they lose themselves if they come out? Definitely a better room.
Coincidentally, it happened to be on the same floor as Xu Shiyan and the others.
After completing the check-in procedures, a few people went out to eat, and took a few laps along the way.
On Xu Shiyan's side, it was a lively birthday party.
Mr. Chu and these students, some Xu Shiyan knew, some didn't.
