Just took this opportunity to introduce each other, and then leave a contact information for each other.
Although they are all elites in the medical field, they will not be domineering and look down on anyone. They are very approachable.
Even those who wear uniforms with two three-star or four-star bars on their shoulders are still very friendly.
And someone even took the initiative to greet Xu Shiyan and chat with Xu Shiyan.
After this chat, people found out that Xu Shiyan and the others were the ones who donated medicine to the frontier soldiers before.
And that prescription came from the hands of Xu Shiyan and Chu Xuanhuai. When many people heard this, they had a high opinion of Xu Shiyan.
Everyone has a good impression of Xu Shiyan and his son.
Especially that Xu Haiyuan who has been standing by Elder Chu's side all the time, who doesn't talk too much, and looks extraordinarily well-behaved and quiet, has attracted the attention of many people.
Many of these people are professors or deans and directors of various medical schools.
This type of people has a problem. When they see students, they always want to come up with questions to take a test.
Since Mr. Chu boasted that this child is hard to find in the sky, it is really hard to find someone in the school.
So he called Xu Haiyuan to his side and asked him what he had learned from his master, and what would he know? Then just randomly ask some questions to test the little doll.
Unexpectedly, Xu Haiyuan was not at all frightened, no matter what problems people had, he could tell them all.
Okay, but these people are rare.
"If the students I teach have half the spirituality of my junior nephew, I won't make them so angry.
Alas, there is really no comparison between this person and this person.
How old is this kid? Dialectics, treatment, can speak clearly and logically.
It's amazing, what a seedling. "Many people are feeling like this.
So much so that when these people return to their schools, they will say something to the students again.
Take a look, what have you all learned? Even a ten-year-old child can't compare to it, and he has studied for several years in vain.
Xu Haiyuan hadn't been admitted to university yet, but he was aroused by these uncles.
Thanks to his young age, when he goes to school, those people have already graduated and worked, otherwise, he will probably feel better.
On occasions like this, in fact, few people come here to eat, but to connect with each other.
The age span of these people is very large. Those who are a little younger have at most heard the names and achievements of the seniors, but they have not seen them when they were studying.
It's rare to get together nowadays, and I'm very happy, they all get together in twos and threes to chat.
Others surrounded Chu Xuanhuai, booing and inquiring.
Ask the teacher about the current situation, ask the teacher how he is doing in Donggang, and whether there is anything good there.
Elder Chu had calmed down his excitement a long time ago, chatted with the students with a smile, and when he mentioned Donggang, Elder Chu had something to say.
The scenery there is beautiful, there are many delicious things, there are several lively and cute babies, and there is even a fox who is about to become a spirit.
Listening to the situation described by the teacher, those older people are really envious.
After they retire, they will also look for such a place with a beautiful environment surrounded by mountains and rivers.
Raising fish and growing vegetables and so on, how nice is it to live a leisurely life?

chapters.title: Chapter 656: The follow-up triggered by the statement
chapters.content:
Chapter 656 statement triggering follow-up
The birthday banquet lasted for a long time, from eleven o'clock to four o'clock in the afternoon.
The dishes on the table were all cold in the end, and no one cared. Everyone chatted happily together.
If the usual days were left behind, Chu Xuanhuai would have to rest for a while in the afternoon, so as not to lose energy.
I don’t need it at all today. The old man is very happy chatting with these students, and he is in good spirits.
"Teacher, it's late, you should rest.
We will stay here for another two days, and tomorrow we will come to chat with the teacher. "
These students of Chu Xuanhuai, none of them are simple, and they can still make the 80-year-olds sit here all the time?
Besides, it's really getting late, so how can we keep chatting in the banquet hall.
"Well, well, you have come back all the way, and the road is hard.
Then let's all go to rest, and come to talk to me when you are free. "
Chu Xuanhuai was indeed tired, but he missed the time spent with the students too much and was reluctant to part.
Everyone got up together, someone came over, helped Chu Xuanhuai upstairs, and sent the teacher back to the room.
After chatting with Mr. Chu for a few more words, he took his leave and left.
Xu Haiyuan has been by Shigong's side all day long, and never left for half a step, so he naturally wants to be with him now.
Everyone can see that this child is really caring and hardworking, so everyone is very satisfied and relieved.
Furthermore, many of them live in this hotel, so they can come over soon if there is anything to do.
So everyone said a few more words to Xu Shiyan, and then they left.
Those lawyers and reporters have already gone back.
The lawyer has to arrange matters related to the notarization of the will, while the reporter has to go back and sort out the statement and send it to typesetting.
Tomorrow's provincial newspaper will publish a statement that Elder Chu has severed ties with his son.
Of course, this kind of statement does not actually have legal effect, it can only be said to be an irrational behavior under the anger of the person concerned.
Chu Xuanhuai didn't expect to change anything with a statement. This statement only showed his attitude.
It is also to let the world know what the two brothers did, so that no one will intervene in the future.
The old man was very tired this day, and he fell asleep not long after returning to his room.
Xu Haiyuan was reading in his room, accompanying his master.
But as a growing child, he didn’t eat well at noon, and he was hungry at night. Gradually, he couldn’t read books, and he was so hungry that he scratched his heart.
Just at this time, I heard someone knocking on the door, so I hurried to open the door, but saw Xu Shiyan and his wife, bringing a lot of food.
"Knowing that you will definitely be hungry, I specially brought you something to eat.
伱Master is sleeping? Or you come to my room to eat? "Xu Shiyan asked his son in a low voice.
Xu Haiyuan looked back at the sleeping Elder Chu and shook his head.
"No, I'll eat here, maybe the master will wake up in a while." It's impossible for the master to find him when he wakes up.
Xu Haiyuan insisted, Xu Shiyan didn't say anything else, just handed all the food to his son and asked him to bring it into the house.
"Put it at the door when you're done eating. I'll clean it up later. Don't leave it in the room. It smells bad."
Xu Shiyan asked, and then went back to his room to rest. He was actually quite tired this day.
On the morning of February 18, all those who subscribed to the provincial daily saw the statement.
Many people were surprised when they saw Chu Xuanhuai's name on it.
Some people immediately ordered the people around them to find out where Mr. Chu is now and why he made such a statement.
It's too easy to find out, just make a phone call to the newspaper office.
Then, the hotel became lively, and many leaders from the province came to visit Mr. Chu.
At this time, the Chu brothers who accompanied the foreign businessmen to leave the provincial capital rushed to Fusong proudly and proudly.
The two brothers have already made up their minds, and under the name of foreign business inspections and investment cooperation, they went to Fusong to talk to the local leaders.
The one in the capital has already greeted everyone in the province, city, and city through the network.
When they arrive in Fusong, they can use the name of the county leader to pressure Xu Shiyan, force Xu Shiyan to bow his head, and cooperate with them to set up a pharmaceutical factory.
As long as Xu Shiyan agrees, the secret recipe must be handed over, and they will sell it to Dongyi merchants after they get the secret recipe.
What kind of investment and cooperation will you make in the future? There is no fart, they take the money and leave, what else can they do here?
If Xu Shiyan does not agree to cooperate, it will be easier, and the foreign businessman will leave.
The investment of nearly ten million yuan has disappeared. I don't believe that the leaders of the county are not in a hurry?
At that time, Xu Shiyan can't afford to walk around, and the field manager and general manager will all have to fuck.
Then, they used the name of Xu Shiyan's malicious deceit to sue him directly.
Said that he used despicable means to deceive Chu Xuanhuai, illegally obtained the secret recipe of the Chu family, and asked Xu Shiyan to return it.
That kid lost his job, **** is nothing, what can he use to fight them?
Use these two tricks first, and then they have other methods, there are black and white ones.
Anyway, they are determined to obtain the secret recipe of the Chu family, no matter what means they use, they must obtain it.
Dongyi merchants offered sky-high prices. As long as they got the money, the two brothers would emigrate abroad with their families.
At that time, I will be free and easy, and I can do whatever I want, and I will never have to go back to the poor place in the northwest, and live a miserable life.
The two brothers, together with the merchants from Dongyi, drove two cars with Beijing license plates, and walked to Fusong in a calm and unhurried manner.
How did they know that the provincial capital at this time had caused an uproar because of that statement.
Several people who have a very good relationship with Chu Xuanhuai, after learning about the Chu family brothers, were furious, and bluntly said that they must take good care of the Chu family brothers.
Once Chu learned about it, he thanked the other party for his kindness, and only said that it was not yet used.
If it is needed in the future, I hope they will look at their own merits, support Xu Shiyan, and help Xu Shiyan.
Not to mention Chu Xuanhuai's face, even if he didn't, with Xu Shiyan's current ability and reputation, there are many people in the province protecting him, so this is not a problem at all.
Chu Xuanhuai took the time to lead Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan to the relevant departments for the certification of the teacher-inheritance relationship.
After the certification is successful, the master-apprentice relationship is equivalent to official recognition.
Even if Xu Haiyuan does not go to university in the future, as long as he has studied with Chu Xuanhuai for enough years, he can still obtain relevant qualification certificates and work in hospitals.
This is the so-called Western medicine depends on academic qualifications, and Chinese medicine depends on inheritance.
It is more effective to have a good master to guide and personally guide than to go to university.
At the same time, Xu Shiyan, Su Anying and others went to buy a car together.
A big truck, a half-truck, and a car.
Three cars cost a lot of money, but everyone was very happy.
Buying cars is for real use, not spending money indiscriminately. With these cars, you can do a lot of things in the future.
I bought the car, and the relevant departments also went through the formalities. I paid the due fee and got a temporary license plate.
Afterwards, I drove to Chu's home, and loaded the packed boxes into the car.
The top was covered with a sheet of tarpaulin, and then it was tied firmly with a rope, and everyone drove back first.
Xu Shiyan and his son, the matter in the provincial capital has come to an end, so the two accompanied Chu Xuanhuai and went back by train.

chapters.title: Chapter 657: Chen Jihui fell
chapters.content:
Chapter 657 Chen Jihui is planted
When they came to the provincial capital, it was Xu Shiyan and his son who accompanied Chu Xuanhuai. The return journey was different.
In addition to Xu Shiyan and his son, there are another hundred handsome and upright young men in their twenties.
The leader decided to set up a radar observation station on the mountain over Donggang.
This group of people went there first to survey the terrain, choose the location, and **** Chu Xuanhuai and others home along the way.
With so many escorts, the road must be safe and sound. At noon on the 19th day of the first lunar month, I returned to Songjiang River.
The family knew that Xu Shiyan and the others were coming back, so they specially arranged someone to pick them up.
But I didn't expect so many people to come, and I didn't know how to arrange it for a while.
The young man who was still the team leader said that as long as he told them how to go, he didn't care about the rest.
Quan should be going out to practice, this little distance is not a big deal at all.
So, Xu Shiyan drew a road map for them and told them how to get there, and then he accompanied Chu Xuanhuai and the others back first.
The car drove to Xu's house, Xu Haiyuan helped Chu Xuanhuai get out of the car, but Xu Shiyan didn't get out of the car, and went back to the venue directly.
The one hundred and ten people who came here are currently performing a secret mission, so Xu Shiyan arranged them in the dormitory for the employees of the pharmaceutical factory.
Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory, the construction of the plant has been completed, and all kinds of machinery and equipment have been put in place.
Just wait for Xu Shiyan to come back from the provincial capital, and start work on auspicious occasions.
Some of the employees of the pharmaceutical factory were directly selected from the unemployed young people participating in the field, and were sent to other pharmaceutical factories for training in advance.
There are still some young people in their twenties recruited from villages around Donggang.
In addition, there are also some veterans who have transferred from the army, all of whom have registered permanent residence in Fusong or the Hunjiang area, and they are arranged to work in pharmaceutical factories.
One is to solve their jobs, and the other is to solve the shortage of workers in the pharmaceutical factory, which can be regarded as killing two birds with one stone.
Years later, those workers who went to other pharmaceutical factories for training did not leave, and went directly to the factory to give pre-job training to other workers.
Explain the safety production rules, introduce the use of various machines and so on.
The scale of the pharmaceutical factory is not small, with complete supporting facilities, and a special canteen and dormitory, which are very spacious.
So it is not a problem at all to arrange a hundred or eighty people in.
After settling these people, Xu Shiyan went back to the field department, found Li Bingzhuo and others, and asked him about the situation at home during the time he was away.
"General Manager, a few days ago, Director Li of the County Bureau of Commerce, Director Xue of the Pharmaceutical Factory, Wang Xicheng of the Specialty Products Bureau, and others accompanied Dongyi merchants to our site for a visit.
It is said that the Dongyi businessman wants to invest tens of millions of yuan to build a modern pharmaceutical factory.
The county attaches great importance to this merchant, and the county pharmaceutical factory is actively striving to cooperate with Dongyi merchants. "
Originally, Chen Jianzhang was the director of the Specialty Products Bureau. Didn’t Chen Jianzhang go to the city after a year?
The one who took his place after him was the former secretary of the second field, Wang Xicheng.
"But that businessman seems to be very interested in our pharmaceutical factory and insists on visiting it.
You are not here, we did not agree, we only said that we will discuss cooperation matters after you come back. "
Li Bingzhuo and others reported recent work to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan nodded when he heard this, and sure enough, the two brothers from the Chu family really came up with this idea.
Okay, as long as they dare to come, this time we must teach them a lesson they will never forget.
"Oh, by the way, here is an invitation letter for the Singapore Science and Technology Achievement Expo, inviting us to participate in it.
General manager, can you see if we want to go? If you go, you have to go through the formalities immediately. "
Over there, Xiao Peng took out an invitation letter and handed it to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan accepted the invitation letter and looked at the description above. This year's Science and Technology Achievements Expo will be held in Singapore on March 30.
It is already February 24th. If you want to participate, you really have to go through the formalities quickly, or you may not be able to make it in time.
"Lao Li, this time Ni and Xiao Peng led a team to participate in the exhibition abroad, and I stayed at home.
The pharmaceutical factory is about to start production, so I have to stay and watch.
Another, the Spring Fair is coming soon, and I have to keep an eye on our new products, so this time, I have to trouble you. "
This expo is just the icing on the cake for the current participants, and it doesn’t matter whether they go or not.
Xu Shiyan is too busy. The matter of the brothers of the Chu family has not been resolved yet, so he can't leave.
Furthermore, for this kind of thing, Li Bingzhuo and the others should be allowed to show off, not Xu Shiyan always.
"Ah? I'll take someone there, is that okay?"
Li Bingzhuo was stunned when he heard it. Shouldn't this be the leader leading someone to participate in the exhibition? Why let him go?
"What's wrong? Hurry up and go through the formalities.
Didn’t we all apply for passports collectively before? Hurry up, apply for a visa with the invitation letter, and bring more of our products to the exhibition.
It would be best to win an award or something, then our company's reputation will become bigger and bigger in the future, and the products will sell well.
It’s okay, alas, even if you go abroad, you don’t have to have any psychological burden.
It’s best if you can win an award at the exhibition. If you don’t win an award, it’s because you guys went out to play. It’s an eye-opener, it’s nothing. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, handed the invitation letter to Xiao Peng, and told him to go through the formalities quickly.
Being able to lead a team abroad made Li Bingzhuo and the others very happy, so they hurried back.
Select products to be exhibited, prepare relevant materials, handle procedures for going abroad, etc.
Li Bingzhuo and the others were talking about big things. After they left, the secretary came over to report on the trivial daily things.
"General Manager, Secretary Li of that county has called several times, saying that he has something to ask for you.
Also, Director Guo of the Forestry Bureau also called you and said when you will come back, please call him back. "
The secretary flipped through the notepad in his hand, and told Xu Shiyan the main things.
"Okay, I see, I'll call them back."
Xu Shiyan nodded, picked up the phone, and called Guo Shouye first. "Brother, I heard you were looking for me?"
"Oh, brother, you're back."
Over the phone, Guo Shouye was very happy when he heard Xu Shiyan's movement.
"Let me tell you something, Chen Jihui has completely fallen this time."
Guo Shouye approached Xu Shiyan mainly to discuss the matter of the factory in Quanyang.
"Oh? How did it happen? Brother, tell me." Xu Shiyan became interested and asked.
"Didn't Chen Jihui be blocked by factory workers in the factory a few years ago and didn't go back to celebrate the New Year?
After the county went to work, these workers went directly to the county to seek explanations from the county leaders.
What can the county say? Hemming and hawing can't figure out anything useful, so those workers don't leave, anyway, it's quite noisy. "
Guo Shouye's voice on the phone was a little excited and excited, and somewhat gloating.
"Later, it seemed that the Provincial Beverage Factory arranged for someone to come over, saying that they were going to take over the factory and asked Chen Jihui to go back first.
Are those workers capable? Chen Jihui was blocked again.
I don’t know which tiger it is, but the tiger came up and stabbed Chen Jihui directly.
Now, Chen Jihui doesn't have to leave, he is living in the hospital. "Guo Shouye said a surprising news.
"Huh? My God, this is really a tiger. How is the person? Is the injury serious?"
Xu Shiyan couldn't help shaking his head when he heard this, how hated this Chen Jihui is, that makes people give him a desperate blow.

chapters.title: Chapter 658: Li Jingyu on fire
chapters.content:
Chapter 658 Li Jingyu who got angry
"The injury is not serious, nothing serious.
Wearing so old and thick in winter, it was just a flesh injury, and he was hospitalized in the county hospital. " Guo Shouye said nonchalantly.
"The main reason is that the person who stabbed Chen Jihui reported it when he was taken away.
Said it was Chen Jihui, who had a lot of hugs in the beverage factory.
The counties and provinces seem to have received reports. This time, Chen Jihui had to squat on the fence after leaving the hospital. "
"Well, according to what you say, Chen Jihui is really going to be cold this time."
Why is Chen Jihui jumping up and down like this? Do you really think he is doing it for the public? Is it not for personal gain?
He was almost hugged and wanted to run, but he was blocked by someone and stabbed.
This is a good move, Lao Dier has missed it, just wait, there is a good show to watch.
The two chatted on the phone for a while, and reached an agreement on the matter of Quanyang Beverage Factory.
It's just that no matter who comes looking for it, they don't take over the mess.
It’s not that they are cruel and throw stones into the well to watch the fun, that thing knows it’s a pit, who is willing to jump into it?
After chatting, he hung up the phone. Before Xu Shiyan could call the county, the phone rang.
Picking up, it was Li Jingyu's voice.
"Oh, Mr. Xu is very busy, it's really hard to find you." On the phone, Li Jingyu's voice was very gentle and polite.
"Don't dare, I'm just busy every day.
No way, there are thousands of people in the venue, all waiting to eat.
You said that if I was not busy, so many people would not go hungry? "Xu Shiyan chattered nonsense on the phone with a smile.
Xu Shiyan can probably guess why Li Jingyu came to him.
Now the county is in a hurry, but Xu Shiyan is not in a hurry, so he is just playing around.
"That's true, that's true. Mr. Xu, I have something to discuss with you."
Li Jingyu's heart is clear, Xu Shiyan did this on purpose, but what can he do?
Chen Jihui on the other side of Quanyang made such a big mess. The workers are not finished now, and they are making all kinds of noises to ask for wages.
Where did the county get the money to fill in holes for Chen Jihui? Then don't we have to quickly find someone to take over the factory so that the matter can be settled?
Otherwise, if this matter becomes serious, how will Li Jingyu's work be carried out?
Li Jingyu is now regarded as a burning **** in the stove, holding his breath and causing fire.
At the beginning, I saw that the ginseng industry in Fusong was developed, and the export earned a lot of foreign exchange, and the results were outstanding.
He just wanted to come here for gilding and get some political achievements. After returning to the province in a few years, he will be able to work hard at the department level.
But who ever thought that, ever since he came here, everything went wrong.
The Spring Fair puts up squibs, and the ginseng festival costs a lot of money to make it lively.
The Quanyang Beverage Factory, which was vigorously supported, did not sell many products in the end, and it was about to turn yellow.
What's the matter with this, I have to find a way to remedy it, otherwise, he really can't be a secretary.
"Secretary Li, if you have something to say, you can talk about it. As long as I can do it, I will do my best."
"That's right, the beverage factory in Quanyang is not well managed and its profits are not very good.
Now the Provincial Beverage Factory wants to transfer the factory.
At the beginning, the provincial beverage factory and the county invested a lot of money, but now they don't ask for that much, and they can transfer it for one million.
The plant and equipment over there are all new, and the machines are imported from abroad. "
"Mr. Xu, how about your company come forward and take over the factory.
It just so happens that your company also has beverage and mineral water business, so you can produce and sell directly after taking over, without any delay.
The water quality of Quanyang Lake is very good, and the water inflow is particularly large.
With Mr. Xu's ability, bringing a beverage factory back to life, isn't that just like playing? "
What Li Jingyu said was simply too polite.
"Oh, Secretary Li, you've put me in a difficult situation.
It is said that if you call yourself, if I don't agree, I won't give you face.
But the pharmaceutical factory here is about to start operation. I have invested a lot of money in this pharmaceutical factory, building factories, buying equipment, recruiting workers, and importing raw materials.
Let me tell you the truth, this pharmaceutical factory alone has already invested more than 10 million yuan.
The funds of the venue and the beverage factory have all been invested in the pharmaceutical factory.
I really can’t afford the money now to take over another beverage factory. "Xu Shiyan said in great difficulty.
one million? But I really dare to think, even if I don't want a penny and give it away for nothing, Xu Shiyan still has to think about it.
What kind of trouble did Chen Jihui make in that factory? Hundreds of workers have not been paid for several months, and it is estimated that they still owe a lot of foreign debts.
A million dollars was thrown in, and I'm afraid I couldn't even hear a sound.
Xu Shiyan's brain has been filled with water, and now he takes over the factory?
Even if he wants it again, the county and the province have to come forward and talk about it after everything is settled.
Really think he is stupid? With Li Jingyu's few words, he jumped into the pit?
"Secretary Li, you also have to understand my difficulties.
Don’t look at our farm as if it earns a lot of foreign exchange a year, but we also hand over a lot of profits. You know how much our farm handed over to the county last year.
Besides, the scale of our farm is also large now. Thousands of people, old and young, all open their mouths waiting to eat, counting on the farm to support them.
One million is not a small sum, I don't dare to make decisions randomly, right? "
Xu Shiyan doesn't know anything else, he knows how to make a move, crying poor.
I am poor, really poor, really poor, how can I have the money to take over some Quanyang factory?
It would be great if we can run these factories well and let the workers have food.
On the other end of the phone, Li Jingyu was so angry that Xu Shiyan fell on his back.
A ginseng farm is so rich that it fills the county, no, let alone the county, even the entire city.
Among all the factories and mines, there is no one that is richer than Yishangchang.
A participating employee received thousands of dollars in year-end bonuses last year, which was more than a year’s wages for workers in other factories.
Are you crying poor? How shameless?
But what can Li Jingyu do?
Nowadays, the first ginseng field is Hunjiang Dongfang Ginseng Company, which is not managed by the county, but by the city.
Moreover, Xu Shiyan's level is the same as his Li Jingyu.
In the past, he could take advantage of his current position to overwhelm him. Now that they are at the same level, what does he mean?
"Mr. Xu, don't you think you're too shameless like this?
Then, on my side, there happens to be a merchant from Dongyi who wants to come to our county to invest and build a factory.
Originally, we planned to cooperate with the County Pharmaceutical Factory to build a modern pharmaceutical factory with the investment of merchants, and the products will be exported directly.
If Mr. Xu agrees to take over Quanyang's factory, I will do the work and lead the way for both parties.
Let Dongyi merchants invest and build factories, which is a good thing, to your pharmaceutical factory. Do you think this will work?
They said that it will cost tens of millions of dollars.
We have all inquired about it. This merchant has strong financial resources and has a specialized pharmaceutical business abroad.
The medicine produced can obtain the European and American drug certification.
Mr. Xu also deals in pharmaceuticals. Knowing this, it is too difficult to export pharmaceuticals in our country.
Europe and the United States do not give us certification at all. If we can get the certification, it will be a great thing for the pharmaceutical factory. "
In order to convince Xu Shiyan, Li Jingyu could only throw the biggest bait.

chapters.title: Chapter 659: Foreign inspection
chapters.content:
Chapter 659 Foreign business inspection
If Xu Shiyan hadn't known the real purpose of Dongyi merchants' investment, Li Jingyu's words would probably have confused him.
This guy is too tempting, right? Tens of millions of investment, European and American drug certification.
Whichever one is thrown out, can attract countless domestic pharmaceutical companies to break their heads to grab this cooperation opportunity.
It's a pity, Xu Shiyan knows all too well what kind of conspiracy is hidden behind this, how could he be fooled?
"Secretary Li, which Dongyi businessman is so generous? This is too powerful.
The drug certification in Europe and the United States is very strict, and people do not recognize our Chinese patent medicines. "
It's okay right now, let's chat with Li Jingyu for a while.
Hitting children on rainy days is idle time, right?
"Yes, it is very difficult for our medicine to be exported in the name of medicine, because of this certification.
People abroad don’t recognize our medicine, Mr. Xu also knows this.
The ginseng rhodiola that you produced before is clearly a medicine, but it can only be sold as a health product.
It is because foreign countries use drug certification to get stuck in our necks. "
When Li Jingyu heard this, Xu Shiyan seemed to be tempted, so he tried harder to persuade him.
"That's why I said, this is a perfect opportunity.
If this cooperation is successful, will the pharmaceutical company still make money in the future?
Mr. Xu, you can think about it, such an opportunity is rare, if you don't grab it, it will be gone in a flash. "
In Li Jingyu's mind, no one would be able to refuse such a good offer, so he couldn't help but feel a little proud.
"But I don't quite understand, our traditional Chinese medicine is not recognized abroad.
After Dongyi merchants cooperate, how can he pass the certification? "
Xu Shiyan deliberately rambled, but didn't directly respond to Li Jingyu's words.
"I heard that they want to cooperate with us to change the medicines they produce to Chinese prescriptions.
Then do export certification and sell to European and American countries. "
Li Jingyu thought about it carefully, those merchants said so.
"Oh, don't care if it's Chinese medicine or traditional Chinese medicine, aren't they all produced by us?
As long as we can make money, then why bother? "
Li Jingyu doesn’t know these things, but he knows one thing. It is a great achievement to be able to set up a joint venture with a foreign businessman.
If there is such a factory in Fusong, his grades are absolutely excellent, and those mistakes before are nothing to worry about.
Xu Shiyan on the phone listened and snorted coldly in his heart. Sure enough, the little devil is the best at playing this trick.
Whether it is Chinese or Korean, they are all stolen from traditional Chinese medicine.
It's a pity that the country doesn't pay attention to these aspects, and the result is that those thieves are cheaper.
"Secretary Li, how about this, I will hold a banquet another day, and invite those Dongyi businessmen to come over and have a good discussion.
After all, this is not a trivial matter. It involves all aspects. You have to allow me to think about it and discuss it with people from our company, right? "
Xu Shiyan and Li Jingyu have talked enough, and the fox's tail is also exposed. There is really nothing to talk about, that's all I can say.
"Okay, then I will help to arrange it. At that time, the county will arrange people to accompany Dongyi merchants to inspect and negotiate with you there."
Li Jingyu felt that Xu Shiyan's attitude should be successful, so he was also very satisfied, and hung up the phone happily.
Xu Shiyan got off the train and went back to work. After finishing the matter, he talked nonsense with Li Jingyu, and now he was so hungry that he was gurgling.
Looking up, it’s already past 3:30 in the afternoon, well, don’t worry about that, go home after get off work.
The Xu family, no accident, Zhou Guilan made dumplings as usual, this is the old custom of the Xu family, don't even think about it.
This time, Xu Shiyan didn't reach out to help, he just took a look at his parents, and then went back to his home to help Xu Haiyuan sort out the books.
After the two of you finished sorting out the books in the provincial capital, Xu Shiyan told Xu Chenghou when he called back.
Ask Xu Chenghou to find a carpenter for help, and seize the time to build a bookcase and bookshelf.
Xu Shiyan's house had eight houses on the east and west sides, among the four in the east, Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Haiyuan lived in the outer part of the east house, and the inner part was empty.
So Xu Shiyan planned to turn the whole room in the back room into a study room just like the one where he lived.
When this house was first built, there was no Kang, and there was a lot of heating.
Xu Shiyan meant to make the entire room into bookcases and shelves for the books of Mr. Chu.
Xu Chenghou answered his son's phone call, regardless of whether it was the first lunar month or not, he immediately found someone to work.
It should be said that the banknote ability is still useful. Xu Chenghou found two carpenters and four or five apprentices.
In a few days, the bookshelves and bookcases were finished.
Xu Haiyuan got out of the car and went straight to the house, going back to tidy up those books.
But there were too many books, so he spent half an afternoon talking about it, and only set up a bookshelf.
"Dad, come and help."
When Xu Haiyuan saw Xu Shiyan, it was like seeing a savior, and hurriedly called Xu Shiyan for help.
"Little kid, you don't think your dad is useless this time, do you?"
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand and rubbed Xu Haiyuan's head vigorously, and then went over to help Xu Haiyuan sort out the books, and put them on the bookshelf by category.
The two fathers placed books at home until after five o'clock, when Xu Haiqing came over and called them to eat.
The two stopped and went to eat dumplings.
Xu Haiyuan followed his father and teacher back home on February 24th, and the school holiday class lasted until the 25th.
It’s just one day, how much difference is there between going back to school and not going back? Xu Haiyuan simply didn't go back the next day, and continued to organize books at home.
Xu Shiyan also went to work as usual, handling various affairs of the unit.
Li Jingyu should be very anxious and very active in matching.
Not to mention Dongyi merchants, they are more anxious than anyone else.
So, Li Jingyu quickly gave Xu Shiyan the news that the Dongyi Merchant Association was going to Donggang for inspection on February 28th.
If the two sides negotiate an agreement, the investment intention should be reached soon.
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, hung up the phone, and immediately asked someone to prepare something as he asked.
On the morning of February 28th, two cars with Beijing license plates, accompanied by several cars with local license plates, arrived at Donggang together.
Come to the building of Dongfang Ginseng Company, which is the field department of the original one.
According to the logic, now that it has become a company, this office building needs to be rebuilt.
But right now it is still ice and snow, the ground is frozen and hard, how to construct?
So everyone is still working in the field department, but there is an extra set of signs hanging on the gate of the field department.
The county arranged for Li Jingming from the Commerce Bureau, Wang Xicheng from the Specialty Products Bureau, and a few others to accompany the merchants.
In order to show the importance of the participation company, Xu Shiyan also prepared a very grand welcome ceremony.
Xu Shiyan specially borrowed the drum team from Donggang Central Primary School, and the participating children's primary school here specially arranged for children from several classes to come and welcome them.
As soon as the merchant's car stopped, firecrackers were lit here, crackling, confetti splashing, and the air was filled with the smell of gunpowder.
Dongyi merchants got off the car slowly during such a grand welcome ceremony.
Xu Shiyan led someone forward to greet him, and happened to walk face to face with Chu Yuanlang.

chapters.title: Chapter 660: visit a pharmaceutical factory
chapters.content:
Chapter 660 Visiting the Pharmaceutical Factory
"President Xu, let me introduce you, this is Mr. Takeno from Dongyi Sencheng Pharmaceutical.
These two are his assistants and translators. This is Mr. Takeno's agent in China, Mr. Chu Yuanlang. "
Li Jingming came over and introduced to both parties.
"Mr. Zhuye, this is Mr. Xu from Dongfang Ginseng Company. These two are the director and deputy director of the field."
Li Jingming's attitude towards Xu Shiyan and others is a bit more attentive than before.
There is no other way, who said that the participation in the field is now under the management of the city.
In the past, he and Xu Shiyan were on the same level, but now Xu Shiyan is higher than him, so he must have a good attitude.
"Mr. Zhuye, hello, it's a pleasure to meet you." Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand with a smile on his face, and shook hands with the person opposite.
"Mr. Xu, hello."
The other party greeted Xu Shiyan in very blunt Chinese, and shook hands with Xu Shiyan very enthusiastically.
Over there, Chu Yuanchao stepped forward with a smile on his face, "Mr. Xu, I didn't expect to see you again today.
I'm really sorry about what happened last time, my brother was too irritable and offended Mr. Xu.
Please also Mr. Xu have a lot, don't worry about it.
My brother has other things to do today, so he can't come to make amends. Another day, our brothers will host a banquet to make amends, and ask Mr. Xu to speak kindly in front of my father.
We really miss the old man and want to take him to the south to enjoy happiness. As Chu Yuanlang said, he reached out to shake Xu Shiyan's hand.
"Mr. Chu came here for investment.
There is no need to talk about personal grievances, right? "
Xu Shiyan smiled faintly, and did not answer Chu Yuanlang's words, nor shook hands with him.
The smile on Chu Yuanlang's face suddenly faded, and the raised hand stopped in mid-air, and he could only put it down in embarrassment.
On the other hand, Li Jingming and Wang Xicheng over there saw something was wrong, and immediately made a relief with a smile.
"Oh, it turns out that Mr. Xu and Mr. Chu know each other, and the wine is even better. Our investment promotion this time will definitely succeed."
"Well, I hope so.
I also very much hope to cooperate with Mr. Takeno, and hope that the next study tour will go smoothly. "Xu Shiyan nodded with a smile.
"Everyone please, small place, not so ostentatious office building, Mr. Takeno laughed."
As Xu Shiyan spoke, he led the crowd to the field.
At this time, the translator beside Takeno spoke.
"Mr. Xu, Mr. Takeno is more interested in the pharmaceutical factory. I wonder if Mr. Xu can take us to visit the pharmaceutical factory first?"
Xu Shiyan glanced at Mr. Takeno and smiled, "Of course.
I heard that Morinari Pharmaceutical, where Mr. Takeno works, is a well-known pharmaceutical company in Dongyi, and it can be ranked among the top few, and it is also ranked very high in the world.
Just in time, our pharmaceutical factory will open soon. Mr. Takeno is very welcome to visit and give valuable advice. "
Xu Shiyan's attitude towards Takeno is very good and polite.
Because the pharmaceutical factory is located in the southeast of the field, it is a little far away from the village, and even farther away from the field department.
With so many people, it was impossible to walk past, so everyone got on the bus again.
The participating cars lead the way, followed by the two Beijing brand cars, and then the county cars.
As soon as these cars left, the drum team of Donggang Central Primary School and the children of the participating primary schools were also led by their teachers.
Xu Shiyan led the people all the way to the gate of the pharmaceutical factory. Everyone got out of the car and walked into the pharmaceutical factory.
Dongyi merchants are obviously very interested in the pharmaceutical factory and want to visit everywhere.
Xu Shiyan naturally didn't say anything else, he took the Dongyi merchants wherever they wanted to go.
Several workshops, office buildings, medicinal material warehouses, staff dormitories, canteens, etc. Xu Shiyan took them around.
When the other party had any questions, Xu Shiyan also dutifully answered them. His attitude was exceptionally good, and no one could fault him.
"President Xu, Mr. Takeno would like to ask, what is this room for? Why is there a big iron door with a big lock on it?"
Chu Yuanlang pointed to a house behind the office building and asked.
"Oh, here is the material library of valuable medicines, and it is also an important document library.
Some formulas from the pharmaceutical factory are stored in it. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at Chu Yuanlang and said casually.
When Chu Yuanlang heard this, his eyes lit up immediately, and then he turned his head to whisper a few words to Mr. Zhuye.
"Mr. Xu, Mr. Takeno asked, can we go for a visit?
Mr. Takeno is very interested in the precious medicinal materials you store here. "Chu Yuanlang asked tentatively.
"Mr. Takeno is our most honored guest, of course.
Please wait a moment, I called the person in charge of the warehouse and asked him to open the door, and we went in for a visit. "
Unexpectedly, Xu Shiyan agreed without any hesitation.
Xu Shiyan immediately greeted someone and went to call the person in charge of the valuables warehouse.
Then he took the key and opened the big iron door outside the warehouse, then took out the key and unlocked the second floor door.
All the people followed the administrator and filed in.
The valuables warehouse is divided into two parts. The big one contains rows of containers.
There are all kinds of precious medicinal materials displayed in the container, such as wild ginseng, musk, pearl, snow clam, bezoar and so on.
Put one kind in each cabinet, with a label on it.
Regularly change the dehumidifier in the container to keep the medicine dry and free from moisture.
Mr. Takeno and his party are obviously not very interested in the medicinal materials of this play, they just took a look at it.
"Mr. Xu, where's the room over there? What's in it?"
Chu Yuanchao has been looking around since he entered the warehouse.
What interested him the most was a room on the other side, which also had a big lock on the door.
"Oh, there is a database over there, which stores most of the formulas of our pharmaceutical factory's finished medicines, as well as the formulas we bought from major medical schools with a lot of money.
Currently the pharmaceutical factory is trying to produce and apply for clinical trials. "Xu Shiyan glanced at Chu Yuanlang and said something meaningful.
Chu Yuanlang's heart skipped a beat, and he turned around to talk to Mr. Zhuye again.
After a while, Chu Yuanlang turned his head and made a request to Xu Shiyan.
"Mr. Xu, I don't know if we can go in and take a look. Mr. Takeno is very interested in this.
We sincerely want to cooperate with your factory, so we really want to know how strong your factory is.
If your factory really has a secret recipe, Mr. Takeno is willing to invest more, and the two sides will cooperate sincerely to create a better future together. "
"Oh, no problem, Mr. Takeno is a distinguished guest who came from afar.
I can also see that Mr. Takeno is sincere and wants to cooperate with pharmaceutical companies.
If the two parties reach a cooperation intention, we are good friends and partners.
For our partners, we have always treated each other with sincerity, without hiding anything, of course you can visit, no problem. "
Xu Shiyan was very talkative today, and he agreed to whatever conditions the other party asked.
Beside Li Jingming and Wang Xicheng saw this situation, they couldn't help curling their lips secretly.
Look, no matter how arrogant a person is, when faced with an investment of tens of millions, is it polite?
So it is true to say that money touches people's hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 661: The secret recipe
chapters.content:
Chapter 661 The secret recipe
"Mr. Xu is indeed a man of temperament, bold and cheerful."
Chu Yuanlang never expected that Xu Shiyan would agree so readily, and couldn't help but be overjoyed.
Before coming, Chu Yuanlang asked a lot about Xu Shiyan.
It is said that this person is talented and rich, and ordinary things are hard to impress him.
Chu Yuanlang thought that they would have to spend a lot of effort to impress Xu Shiyan and ask about the secret recipe.
In Chu Yuanlang's mind, since Xu Shiyan got the Chu family's secret recipe, such an important thing must not be left at home casually.
I will definitely find a safe and proper place to keep it well.
The pharmaceutical factory has a special warehouse for valuables, as Xu Shiyan said just now, all the important materials are here.
The secret recipe of the Chu family must be here.
Before coming, the brothers of the Chu family studied and discussed carefully, and made several plans.
The first one, if Xu Shiyan meets them, he will have a bad attitude and will not cooperate with the investment.
Then they will find a way to use the backers behind them to exert pressure on the cities and counties.
Deal with Xu Shiyan by sabotaging investment promotion, and then find a way to get the secret recipe.
If Xu Shiyan agrees to cooperate, then take advantage of the investment opportunity of Dongyi businessmen, get along well with Xu Shiyan on the surface, and secretly find out where the secret recipe is hidden.
At that time, we will find a way to get the secret recipe.
The best thing is not to use the strength of the capital, they settle it by themselves.
Otherwise, people will think that their brother is too incompetent to handle such a small matter.
Chu Yuanlang thought so much in the county, but he didn't expect that today would be so smooth.
Xu Shiyan's attitude was simply too good, and he was very cooperative, so he didn't need to try to find out, Xu Shiyan spontaneously sent them the secret recipe.
This is like walking through iron shoes and finding nowhere to find it. It takes no effort to get it. If you want to sleep, you will send a pillow.
It seems that God is still on their side, and it is right for them to get rich.
So, don’t listen to the rumors outside, no one is short of money.
No matter how rich a person is, he can't say that he doesn't care about money.
People say that Xu Shiyan is worth millions, so what?
When he said that the investment was tens of millions, didn't he laugh too hard? Who still has a grudge against money?
Xu Shiyan didn't answer the other party's words, but asked someone to open the door of the database.
The room here is not big, and there are some books, drawings and the like.
In addition, there is a safe in the corner.
Chu Yuanlang looked at the safe, his eyes straightened, that's right, it must be here, the secret recipe must be hidden in this safe.
"On these shelves, there are some common medical techniques and prescriptions, such as Ginseng Jianpi Pills and Qiju Dihuang Pills, which are all prescriptions recorded in the Pharmacopoeia."
Xu Shiyan didn't seem to see Chu Yuanlang's excited expression, and introduced to Mr. Zhuye step by step as usual.
"Mr. Takeno, don't underestimate these prescriptions.
Although these prescriptions can be produced by any pharmaceutical factory, the raw materials are different, the production process is different, and the drugs produced have different effects.
Our factory selects the most authentic medicinal materials from the place of origin and uses the most advanced production technology, so the medicinal effect must be the best. "
Xu Shiyan sincerely introduced those prescriptions to the other party, which book they came from, what medicinal materials were in the formula, and what effect they had.
Ignoring it completely, Mr. Takeno and others looked at the safe with fiery eyes.
"Ahem, Mr. Xu, we, Mr. Takeno, know all about these, and Sencheng Pharmaceutical also produces these proprietary medicines.
What we want to see is whether Mr. Xu has something special here.
For example, the ginseng rhodiola capsules before, such as the ginseng coffee, etc., are the product formulas independently developed by your factory. "
Over there, Chu Yuanlang finally couldn't bear it anymore, coughed twice, and said.
"Oh, oh, you mean the ones independently developed by our factory are all in the safe."
Xu Shiyan suddenly realized, with a look of embarrassment.
"Well, Xiao Zhang, Xiao Chen, you two open the safe." Xu Shiyan hurriedly beckoned someone to come over and open the safe.
"Mr. Xu, isn't this against the norm?
Our factory has regulations that the safe cannot be opened easily.
If you want to open it, you need to submit a formal written application, and you can only open the safe with the signature and seal of Mr. Xu and several other leaders.
And there must be at least three witnesses in the whole process. "Xiao Zhang, the warehouse manager, looked embarrassed.
"You said why are you so brainless? Who am I? I am the direct person in charge of this pharmaceutical factory.
The few people here are our participants and the leaders of the county, and there are also foreign guests here.
I didn’t say to take away the contents, but to open it for everyone to have a look. What are you doing all this effort for?
Don't talk nonsense, hurry up, delay our factory's cooperation with foreign companies, can you bear the responsibility? "Xu Shiyan lowered his face and scolded Xiao Zhang.
Over there, Li Bingzhuo and the others also started training Xiao Zhang.
Xiao Zhang had no choice but to go forward with Xiao Chen and open the safe.
Chu Yuanlang also had another interpreter, his eyes were fixed on Xiao Zhang and Xiao Chen's movements, trying to write down the password of the safe.
However, Xu Shiyan didn't care about it as if he didn't see it at all.
The door of the safe was opened, and everyone's eyes were focused on the safe.
The safe is divided into upper and lower layers, the upper layer has a small space and the lower layer has a large space.
There is a thick stack of document bags on the lower layer, while only one book is placed on the upper layer.
The book looked different from ordinary books, it was very worn and old, the color was yellow, and the pages were very worn.
When Chu Yuanlang read the book, he was so excited that he almost jumped up. It was clearly the secret recipe of their Chu family.
Sure enough, the secret recipe exists in the pharmaceutical factory.
At this time, Xu Shiyan stepped forward and took out several document bags from the lower layer of the safe.
"Look, Mr. Takeno, these are several new drug formulas we have developed.
Ginseng Tonifying Kidney Tablets, Ginseng Zaizao Pills, Lixin Pills, Musk Baoxin Pills. "
Xu Shiyan enthusiastically introduced to Zhuye and the others that these are also the prescriptions developed with the help of Mr. Chu. The combination is exquisite and the effect of the finished medicine is very good.
If such a large pharmaceutical factory wants to develop well, it is impossible to produce only a few kinds of medicines, and it is necessary to develop more medicines with good curative effects and put them on the market.
These medicines are specially developed based on the planting and cultivation advantages of the existing medicinal materials in the field.
Strive to obtain as much raw material as possible locally to ensure the quality and curative effect of medicinal materials.
It can be said that these drugs are well developed and definitely have great potential.
However, the focus of Takeno and others is not on these prescriptions at all.
All they want is the secret recipe of the Chu family, that is, the yellowed book on the upper floor of the safe.
Chu Yuanlang couldn't control his feet, and took a step forward involuntarily.
At this time, Xiao Zhang and Xiao Chen stood in front of the safe very vigilantly, looking at Chu Yuanlang with an unkind expression.
Chu Yuanlang knew that his heart was not good, and he almost showed his feet, so he hurriedly stabilized his mind.
"President Xu, I don't know what's on it?"
Chu Yuanlang looked at the book with fiery eyes. If it weren't for the fact that there were too many people in the room and there were people from the pharmaceutical factory outside, he would have rushed straight up, grabbed the secret recipe and ran away.

chapters.title: Chapter 662: push nose up face
chapters.content:
Chapter 662 Pushing the nose on the face
"The above is a secret recipe that I got from other places by chance.
It is said that the secret recipe has a history of hundreds of years, and the owner of the secret recipe was once a court physician.
This is a treasure. Our factory has spent millions of dollars for this secret recipe. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at the book and said proudly.
"Mr. Xu, I don't know, can we take a look at this secret recipe?"
Everything went so smoothly today, which made Takeno feel that as long as he opens his mouth, anything can be done.
Takeno looked at the secret recipe at this moment, as if he saw infinite wealth.
This made him extremely excited, and he asked Xu Shiyan directly, wanting to see the secret recipe.
No, Xu Shiyan shook his head at this time
"Sorry, Mr. Takeno, this is the most confidential thing in this field, and it cannot be displayed easily.
After all, Mr. Takeno only has investment intentions, and he has not yet decided to invest.
Only when we become a real partner, Mr. Takeno is qualified to view the secret recipe. "
As Xu Shiyan said, he directly put the file bag in his hand into the safe, and then closed the safe.
Takeno and the others were all dumbfounded, weren’t they all fine just now? Why did you change your face in an instant?
"Mr. Xu, what do you mean? Are you questioning the sincerity of our investment, Mr. Takeno?"
I think you are not cooperating with sincerity at all, you are playing us on purpose. "
Chu Yuanlang's complexion changed drastically, and his eyes suddenly became dark.
The secret recipe is right in front of you, and the sky-high wealth is almost at your fingertips, but Xu Shiyan suddenly changed his mind. How could Chu Yuanlang not be angry?
"I would like to ask, what does Mr. Chu mean?
Since you came to me, which one of your requests did I not do right away?
You are going to visit the pharmaceutical factory, and I will take you around every corner of the pharmaceutical factory.
You guys want to come and see my valuable drug storehouse, so I opened it for you to see without saying a word.
You want to see my database and prescription safe, did I get someone to open it too? "Xu Shiyan's face was also ugly.
"You are only interested in investing, and have not yet signed a contract with us, and the funds have not yet arrived.
To put it bluntly, who knows if you turned around and left today, will you come back to invest later?
The secret recipe was purchased by us with a lot of money. It is the foundation of our pharmaceutical factory. Can it be easily shown to outsiders?
What if you look through it, write it down secretly, and steal our secret recipe? "
"Ju Li, Ju Wang, you have witnessed all this with your own eyes today.
Since Mr. Takeno came to our factory, my attitude is obvious to all.
You guys comment on this matter, what am I not doing enough? "
Xu Shiyan turned his head to look at Li Jingming and Wang Xicheng. These two have been watching the show for a long time, so it's time to say something?
Li Jingming and Wang Xicheng came back to their senses. Faced with Xu Shiyan's question, they could only bite the bullet and speak.
"Yes, yes, Mr. Xu is right.
Today, Mr. Xu led all the leaders in the venue to receive Mr. Takeno and his party very warmly and thoughtfully.
This is indeed obvious to all, and we can all bear witness.
Mr. Takeno, Mr. Chu, the secret recipe is of great importance. It is really not easy to show it to outsiders.
Mr. Takeno, if you really want to see it, please implement the investment as soon as possible.
As long as the contract is signed and the investment funds are in place, we are a family, and there is no problem seeing anything we want. "
Li Jingming was almost annoyed by these people.
What the hell, relying on the name of foreign investment, come to the county to eat and drink, and domineering.
It's been a few days, and I haven't seen what project they selected.
If it wasn't for the fact that someone from the county had checked and said that Takeno was indeed an executive of Sencheng Pharmaceutical, Li Jingming would have regarded these people as liars.
After they arrived in Donggang today, Li Jingming saw what both sides did.
Takeno's side is getting more and more over the top, daring to ask for anything.
At the beginning, Li Jingming was quite worried. If Xu Shiyan got angry and the two sides broke up, the investment would be in vain.
Unexpectedly, Xu Shiyan could really bear it, and he agreed to all conditions with a smile, even opening the safe for Zhuye and the others to see.
But people like Takeno are too much, right? Also look at other people's secret recipe? Isn't this an inch?
Li Jingming belongs to the kind of person who is more knowledgeable about current affairs. He doesn't speak easily, let alone offend anyone.
But today he couldn't bear it anymore, this little Dongyi devil is too bullying.
Really think that without their investment, they really can't do anything?
Tens of millions? What is tens of millions of dollars? Xu Shiyan and his wife are now estimated to be worth tens of millions.
Besides, with Xu Shiyan's ability, it doesn't take much. Two months later, at the Spring Fair, he will be able to win orders worth tens of millions.
People are really short of your money?
People greet each other with a smile and treat each other with kind words. That is the way of hospitality in a state of etiquette.
It's too shameless to stick your nose in the face because of the good looks of others, isn't it?
Li Jingming didn't speak to Zhuye and his party at all, and spoke fairly and impartially, which surprised Xu Shiyan a little. He didn't expect that Director Li would be able to clarify things sometimes.
I thought that Li Jingming and Li Jingyu were cousins. This time I came here, I must help Li Jingyu to facilitate the investment.
Xu Shiyan nodded to Li Jingming, "Thank you, Director Li, for speaking out.
Mr. Takeno, just like Director Li said, if you want to see the secret recipe, it's very simple.
Let’s finalize the investment contract first. You transfer the first phase of investment of 5 million yuan to the designated account, and I will keep it and show you the secret recipe. "
Those people in Zhuye, don’t they know that what they did today was too much?
It's just relying on the status of a foreign businessman, under the name of investing, and deliberately suppressing people.
At this time, Xu Shiyan and others sternly rejected their excessive demands, and Zhuye lost his temper, and his arrogance suddenly fell.
"Mr. Xu, sorry, I was just too impatient.
In this way, I will go back immediately and report to the company, striving to set cooperation matters and sign the contract as soon as possible. "
Zhuye is a man who can bend and stretch. Seeing this situation, he immediately bowed to Xu Shiyan in apology.
Then he brought Chu Yuanlang and others out of the pharmaceutical factory, got in the car and left without leaving anything for food.
"Don't worry, Mr. Xu, I will report to Secretary Li and County Magistrate Chang about what happened today.
They really went too far, so don't blame Mr. Xu. "
Li Jingming shook hands with Xu Shiyan, and assured Xu Shiyan that he would report fairly.
Then Li Jingming and Wang Xicheng also boarded the car and returned to Fusong together.
After the group of people left, Xu Shiyan immediately ordered people to remove all the valuable medicines from the warehouse and move them to the basement of the office building.
That side is the real valuables warehouse, this side is just a deception.
"General manager, what about the secret recipe in the safe? Don't you need to remove it?" Li Bingzhuo asked worriedly.
"Lao Li, do you think I would put such an important thing in the factory?" Xu Shiyan smiled mysteriously.
The one in the safe is Xu Jinping's hand-copied half of "Chengfang Qiyong", which was then made old with potions.
The real secret recipe has long been hidden by Xu Shiyan.
I set the monthly ticket target wrongly with a shake of my hand. Regardless of whether it can be achieved this month, there will be an update on the first of next month. Recently, there have been a lot of troubles. The eldest son has online classes at home, and the younger one is also at home, causing trouble. Ugh.

chapters.title: Chapter 663: Can't agree
chapters.content:
Chapter 663 Disagreement
Xu Shiyan didn't care about how Zhuye and his party went back to discuss.
The most important thing right now is when the pharmaceutical factory will start construction.
Since the factory equipment, raw materials, and staff are all ready, it is natural that the sooner the construction can be started, the better.
Xu Shiyan discussed with everyone in the field, and finally decided that on March 13, which is the sixth day of the second lunar month, the Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory will start construction.
This is considered a big event, and those who should be invited must be invited.
So Xu Shiyan personally wrote an invitation card, inviting relevant leaders from the county, city, and province to come and participate.
As for whether people come or not, he doesn't care. Anyway, he invited, and he has done all the courtesy.
The pharmaceutical factory is preparing to start construction, and the comprehensive factory and beverage factory are preparing for this year's Spring Fair.
Participating in so many spring fairs one after another, to be honest, the pressure becomes more and more the later.
Because it is very difficult to develop new products and sell them.
In addition, the records created by participating in the competition over the years are too high.
If you can’t set a new high this year, in the eyes of others, it means you have no achievements.
In this case, it is really difficult.
The technology department has been doing high-intensity research and development, and many people couldn't even relax during the Chinese New Year.
It is to develop several new products, which can earn more foreign exchange when they are brought to the Spring Fair.
"This year's main focus is still those products in the past.
Especially ginseng coffee and ginseng snow clam honey are still in great demand and can be used as the main products.
In addition, our ginseng essence oral liquid and ginseng royal jelly oral liquid are products with relatively mature technology.
Relevant qualification certificates have also come down, and you can send them over for a try this year.
In the future, there will not be too many new products, and only one or two will be released every year.
Too fast is useless, our products are increasing, which will make buyers confused. "
Xu Shiyan took the time to hold a meeting with the technical department, emphasizing that it is necessary to set aside an advance amount.
Reserve more products, but don't be too anxious to go public.
"Don't put too much pressure on it, our annual foreign exchange earning is still considerable, and there is no need to set new highs.
We don't live in the expectations of others. As long as we make our own products well, ensure that the product quality does not decline, and the sales volume is stable, this is success. "
Xu Shiyan was afraid that the R&D personnel would be under too much pressure, so he specially enlightened them.
“We can try to upgrade the previous products, adjust the formula to be better, and innovate the design of the packaging, all of which can attract new customers.
So you must be steady. Only when you are all steady and not in a hurry, can we go further. "
No matter what step he takes, Xu Shiyan always has this kind of mentality, seeking victory steadily and not taking risks.
After Xu Shiyan's enlightenment, the group of people in the technical department eased up a lot.
Xu Shiyan gave them a few more days off and asked them to go home and rest.
Those who have a daughter-in-law go back to accompany their daughter-in-law, and those who don’t have a daughter-in-law hurry up to go on a blind date to find a partner.
On March 10th, Zhuye and his party came to Donggang again to discuss matters related to investment cooperation with Xu Shiyan.
Sencheng Pharmaceutical invested 10 million yuan in three phases, and cooperated with Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory to jointly develop a series of new drugs to open up the international market.
Invest 3 million in the first phase, and then invest another 7 million in succession.
In contrast, Takeno put forward a condition that he wanted someone to verify the formula of the pharmaceutical factory first to determine the effect.
After all, an investment of 10 million yuan is not a small sum, and Dongyi naturally does not want so much money to be wasted.
"I'm very sorry, Mr. Takeno, I can't agree to your condition.
The first one, I am asking for two phases of investment, the first phase is at least 5 million, you can’t do it.
Second, prescriptions are the lifeblood of a pharmaceutical factory, and I can’t say that you can verify them if you want to verify them.
You can question the strength of our pharmaceutical factory, or my prescription, so please invest in other pharmaceutical factories.
Our pharmaceutical factory will start construction in three days. If Mr. Takeno is interested, you can come and have a look.
Waiting for the medicine to be produced, you can bring some samples to test, or find someone to do an experiment to verify the efficacy of the medicine. "
However, this time, Xu Shiyan's attitude was completely different from the last time, very tough.
Now it's not me begging you to invest, but you are the one who is willing to invest, so you have to do as I ask.
Want to steal our prescriptions without paying a penny? Hehe, it's so stupid to think of others.
No matter what Zhuye, Chu Yuanlang and others said, Xu Shiyan had this attitude, which made Chu Yuanlang very angry.
"Mr. Xu, you really don't want to cooperate, right?
An investment of 10 million yuan, you want to grab it elsewhere, but you push it out?
If Mr. Takeno hadn’t been optimistic about the strength of your pharmaceutical factory, why would you come over again and again to discuss cooperation? "
"Mr. Chu, you also said that it is Mr. Takeno who is optimistic about the strength of our pharmaceutical factory.
Since he is optimistic about it, why does he need to verify the prescription?
Isn't this taking off your pants and farting, and you have to go through two procedures? "Xu Shiyan sneered directly.
"I still say the same thing, if you want to cooperate, get the money, otherwise, forget it.
I'm not afraid to tell you the truth, our factory really doesn't lack your ten million investment.
To put it a little harshly, I can personally put up 10 million.
Asking you, a company, to come up with these, but it's so unfavorable. "
Xu Shiyan's attitude made a 180-degree turn, which was really unexpected.
Neither Zhuye nor Chu Yuanlang expected that they had already bowed their heads and agreed to sign the contract and invest money, but Xu Shiyan refused to budge. What should we do?
"Mr. Xu, if you are like this, can I understand that you deliberately don't want us to invest?
You are deliberately making trouble and destroying the overall situation of investment promotion. If your leader finds out, what will be the consequence?
Have you never thought about it? "Chu Yuanlang finally couldn't bear it anymore, and began to use the leader to suppress people.
"Mr. Chu, don't scare me with the leader, I can't afford this title." Xu Shiyan still smiled.
"I never meant to sabotage investment promotion, it's because of your insincerity.
I’ve said it all, the first call will be 5 million first, so we can talk about this cooperation.
A company as big as Morinari Pharmaceuticals, wouldn't it be impossible to spend five million?
If that's the case, I have to question the sincerity of your company's investment, or the strength of your company?
Maybe, Mr. Takeno is not the real executive of Morinari Pharmaceutical? "
Xu Shiyan looked at Mr. Takeno, with some amusement in his half-smile expression.
Xu Shiyan's words made Chu Yuanlang explode in an instant.
"President Xu, what do you mean? Are you questioning Mr. Takeno's identity?
You are insulting foreign businessmen, we can sue you. "
"What are you doing? Are you out of breath? The more you are like this, the more guilty you appear."
Xu Shiyan was still smiling, and his smile was calm and breezy.
"Since you're here to discuss business, don't be so impulsive. It's not good to be too hot-tempered. What matters in business is harmony and wealth."
Chu Yuanlang was about to attack, but was stopped by Zhuye.
"Mr. Xu, just now you said that No. 13 pharmaceutical factory opened, I would like to ask, can I come to participate then?"
"Okay, so I'm a guest, welcome."

chapters.title: Chapter 664: Pharmaceutical factory opened
chapters.content:
Chapter 664 Opening of Pharmaceutical Factory
Chu Yuanlang, Zhuye and others once again failed to return. How to discuss and deal with them when they go back is unknown.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan is making intensive preparations for the opening.
On March 13, Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory opened for business.
On this day, the inside and outside of the pharmaceutical factory were decorated with lanterns and festoons, and various colored banners and colorful flags decorated the inside and outside of the factory in a particularly festive manner.
Before nine o'clock, the leaders of the county and city came one after another.
Guan Enxue, Chen Jianzhang, Lin Qiyue and others also came from the city to meet Xu Shiyan and celebrate the opening of the pharmaceutical factory together.
Zhuye, Chu Yuanlang and others also came over.
And in front of those leaders, Zhuye personally announced that he would cooperate with Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory.
If the contract can be signed today, within three days, the first phase of investment of 6 million will be credited.
This is undoubtedly good news. Li Jingyu and others were very happy to hear this.
Although Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory belongs to Dongfang Ginseng Company and is a municipal enterprise, the investment was made by the county.
At the beginning, Li Jingyu proposed a condition. If the investment was successful, Xu Shiyan would take over the Quanyang Beverage Factory.
It's a mess over there now.
Chen Jihui was not seriously injured, and he could be discharged from the hospital after a few stitches and a few days of rest, but he was taken away by the relevant department before he was discharged.
It is said that Chen Jihui has spent a lot of money in the past few years, and has also confessed a lot of things. At present, even relevant people in the province have been investigated.
The place in Quanyang was completely neglected. The workers were clamoring for wages every day, and Li Jingyu's head was getting bigger.
So he desperately hopes that Xu Shiyan can take over the Quanyang factory.
Not to mention two million or one million, even if you don’t pay a penny now, as long as Xu Shiyan is willing to take it and can appease the workers.
So Li Jingyu was relieved to know that Dongyi merchants really wanted to cooperate with Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory.
Now, the ears are finally clean.
Compared to Li Jingyu's happy expression, Director Xue of the Fusong Pharmaceutical Factory over there can only force a smile.
Before, he had been actively contacting Dongyi merchants, and secretly gave a lot of benefits to the two brothers surnamed Chu.
It is hoped to cooperate with Dongyi merchants, introduce foreign capital, and make Fusong Pharmaceutical Factory bigger and stronger.
Who knows, the two brothers surnamed Chu took advantage of it and ignored it, and didn't speak well of him at all.
After working for a long time, the investment matter finally fell to Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory, a factory that just opened today.
Xu Shiyan can't pay attention to the reactions of those people right now, the opening ceremony in front of him is the most important thing.
No matter what the opening ceremony is, the basic procedures are those, the relevant leaders give speeches, then cut the ribbon, set off firecrackers, etc.
At 10:18, the opening ribbon was cut, and then firecrackers were fired, and Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory officially started production.
"Leaders, please come into the factory with me and take a look around to see the production situation of our factory."
After the opening ceremony, Xu Shiyan led a group of leaders and guests to visit the factory.
At this time, Zhuye and Chu Yuanlang gestured to the accompanying people.
Those people understood, and took advantage of the opportunity, so they didn't know where to go.
There are many leaders and guests here today, as well as many entourages.
With so many people rushing into the factory, who can notice how many people are missing?
In fact, the factory has already started operating these days, and the so-called opening ceremony is just a name.
So when Guan Enxue and others changed into clean clothes and visited the factory, the factory was already in normal operation.
Workers are all wearing uniform dust-free clothes, hats, masks, and shoe covers on their feet. The whole workshop is clean and tidy.
The pharmaceutical factory is divided into several workshops, powders, tablets, water pills, honey pills, tinctures and so on.
As Xu Shiyan said, in addition to the special-purpose drugs that are produced in separate workshops, other workshops also produce some drugs that are suitable for sale in domestic pharmacies and clinics.
These leaders don't know much about the drug production process, but they just look at the fully mechanized production line and find it very interesting.
Those medicine powders go through several machines and come out as pills.
The tablets come out of one machine, sent to the next machine for bottling, and then come out bottle by bottle.
Then the worker puts a label on it, and the machine over there stamps the production date, and then it can be boxed and packaged.
Walking around, that's all. No one came to see how those machines were working.
So soon everyone came out of the workshop, changed into the dust-free clothes, took off the masks, etc., to get some air.
At noon, Xu Shiyan didn't go to the restaurant to arrange a banquet. Instead, he asked the master chef to prepare meals in the canteen of the pharmaceutical factory to entertain the leaders and guests.
The chefs in the cafeteria are good at their craftsmanship, and the dishes are delicious in color, fragrance, and everyone praises them.
After lunch, some people left first.
Li Jingyu, Chang Hongfa, Guan Enxue, Lin Qiyue, Li Jingming, Chen Jianzhang and other relevant leaders stayed behind to watch the contract be implemented with their own eyes.
So, the legal counsel brought by Takeno discussed the relevant details of the contract with the professional lawyers from the pharmaceutical factory.
After seeking the opinions of Xu Shiyan and Takeye, after several discussions and studies, the details of the contract were finally implemented.
After both parties confirmed that there were no loopholes in the contract, Xu Shiyan and Zhuye both signed the contract.
"Mr. Takeno, I am very much looking forward to the cooperation with Morinari Pharmaceutical.
Please be sure to transfer the funds to the designated account within three days, otherwise, we will not recognize this cooperation and the contract will be invalid. "
The two parties signed the signature together, and then Xu Shiyan and Takeno shook hands, wishing a happy cooperation.
The contract was finalized, and Guan Enxue and the others also breathed a sigh of relief.
As long as the other party's funds are in place, then the products of the pharmaceutical factory can apply for European and American certification and be sold abroad.
The contracts are all signed, so we must celebrate.
So in the evening, Xu Shiyan held a banquet at the Canshi Hotel to entertain Zhuye and his party, as well as Li Jingyu and others who stayed to participate in the contract signing ceremony.
The pharmaceutical factory got off to a good start. On the first day of opening, it signed a contract with a foreign businessman and received a large amount of investment.
This is excellent news for the county and the city.
So during this evening meal, the big guys didn't drink less, and everyone drank a little too much in the end.
They could not be allowed to go back to the county or city at night, so they arranged rooms for everyone in the hotel upstairs.
Even Zhuye and Chu Yuanlang arranged to stay in the hotel.
Xu Shiyan drank a lot at night, wandered back to his home, and didn't bother to wash up, and fell asleep soundly while lying on the kang.
The night is silent and the fields are silent. It should have been a moment of falling asleep.
However, under the shadow somewhere in the pharmaceutical factory, there are several shadows moving quickly.
These shadows seemed to be very familiar with the terrain, and they touched the valuables warehouse behind the pharmaceutical factory very skillfully.
Someone of them took out something unknown, poked it for a while, and the big iron lock was opened.
Several people opened the big iron door lightly, and then used the same method to open the second door and entered the warehouse.

chapters.title: Chapter 665: where to run
chapters.content:
Chapter 665 Where to run
These black shadows went into the precious material library, but they didn't go to the medicinal material library at all, but went directly to the next database.
After reaching the database, several people went straight to the safe by the wall.
