One of them put his ear next to the combination lock of the safe while the other operated it.
Not long after, a slight sound was heard, and the safe was opened.
When the safe was opened, several people were overjoyed.
One of them held a small flashlight in his mouth, and reached out to take out the very old book on the upper shelf of the safe.
Randomly flipped through the front pages of the book, and it turned out to be the secret recipe of the Chu family.
"This is it, let's go."
The man took out the flashlight from his mouth, put the secret recipe in his arms, and led him out quickly.
However, when these people just left the material library, they didn't even walk out ten steps.
Suddenly, a whistle was heard, and then twenty or thirty figures jumped out from around.
These figures are unusual. They all hold guns in their hands, and the muzzles of their guns are aimed directly at those black shadows.
"Don't move, you will shoot if you move, and you will be killed." Someone among them shouted in a deep voice.
At this time, sirens sounded around, and then the lights came on.
The five people surrounded by people have fully seen the surrounding situation at this moment.
Twenty or thirty men in training uniforms, with guns in their hands, full of murderous looks, were watching them covetously.
As long as these five people make the slightest move, they can be shot into a sieve in an instant.
"Misunderstanding, misunderstanding, pure misunderstanding, we are Mr. Takeno's subordinates, and we are our own people."
Among the five people, the leader was Chu Yuanchao.
At this moment, Chu Yuanchao could only bite the bullet and come out, trying to make friends and try to escape.
However, the people on the opposite side were unmoved, and still pointed their guns at them.
Facing the black muzzle of the gun, these five people were so frightened that their legs were weak. This is too scary.
"Everyone, it's really a misunderstanding, we are really Mr. Takeno's people.
If you don’t believe me, you can ask Mr. Takeno, really, I didn’t lie to you. "
Chu Yuanchao looked at the situation and knew that things were not good. They seemed to have fallen into a trap set by others.
I just don’t know what’s going on with Zhuye and his younger brother Chu Yuanlang.
Chanshi Hotel, Zhuye, Chu Yuanlang, and the so-called legal staff they brought with them, none of them are sleeping at the moment.
At this moment, they were all in Zhuye's room, opened the window, ran down the rope through the window, and then slipped down while grabbing the rope.
Thanks to the fact that they live on the second floor, which is not too high. After some effort, they all finally got down from the windows and landed safely.
"Quick, hurry up and drive to meet my brother and the others."
Chu Yuanlang supported Zhuye, while talking, he ran towards their car.
Takeno and the others’ car parked in the open space outside the shop on the east side of Sanshi.
March 13th, the sixth day of the second month of the lunar calendar, the moon is less than half at night.
Thanks to the fact that it is not cloudy tonight, there is still some light.
Several people dared not make any noise, for fear of disturbing the surrounding dogs.
The dogs in the countryside are terrible. They can hear a little movement.
Besides, a single call can summon all the dogs in the whole village, which would be a bad thing.
There were many cars parked in the open space. Chu Yuanlang and others came to the open space cautiously, looking for their cars.
Finally found it. Just as I was about to open the car door, I heard someone laughing.
"Who the **** is laughing?" Chu Yuanlang was furious.
Which idiot is laughing out loud at this moment?
Are you going crazy? What should I do if I disturb the dog by making noise?
"Mr. Zhuye, Mr. Chu, you are not resting in the hotel in the middle of the night, where are you going?"
Xu Shiyan came out from the shadows, and looked at the people opposite him with a smile.
"Xu Shiyan, didn't you drink too much and go home to sleep? Why are you here?"
When Chu Yuanlang saw that it was Xu Shiyan, he immediately realized that the situation was not good.
In the middle of the night, Xu Shiyan is not sleeping at home, so why come here?
"Mr. Takeno didn't go to sleep, did he come out to look at the moon? Me too.
Come out for a stroll casually, isn't this just a chance? "
Xu Shiyan was still smiling, but this laughter, in the ears of others, gave chills in his heart.
"Get in the car, rush over, just him, kill him."
Chu Yuanlang said in a low voice. The few people around are about to open the door and get in the car.
"Don't move, or you'll regret it."
Xu Shiyan was not afraid at all. With a wave of his hand, in the shadow not far away, many people surrounded him.
These people were also wearing training uniforms with guns in their hands.
As long as Xu Shiyan gives an order, they will shoot without hesitation, and beat the few people in front of them into a sieve.
Chu Yuanlang and the others were almost scared to pee their pants. No matter who is pointed at by so many guns, they can still be scared out of their souls.
"Mr. Xu, did you misunderstand something? We are friends and just signed the contract today."
Takeno spoke blunt Chinese, trying to explain something.
"We, we are in a hurry and have to go back quickly. I'm sorry to disturb you, so we left in the middle of the night."
"Mr. Takeno? Do you believe what you say?
No matter how anxious you are, you won’t be able to jump out the window, right? Only thieves would skip the main entrance and jump out of the window. "
Xu Shiyan took a few steps forward in his spare time, and looked at the people opposite him with a smile.
"Xu Shiyan, you'd better understand.
Mr. Takeno is a foreign businessman, a distinguished guest who came to invest. If you treat foreign businessmen like this, can you afford the consequences? "
Chu Yuanlang already had a bad premonition in his heart.
His side has been discovered, so what about his brother? What's going on over there?
Right now, what they can rely on is Zhuye's identity.
Zhuye is from Dongyi, this is the most effective amulet, Xu Shiyan will never dare to touch them.
"Foreign businessman? To invest? Hehe, you're telling a lie, but you take it seriously, right?
You came here under the guise of investing, and swindled food and drink all the way. You really think that no one can expose your old background, right? "
Xu Shiyan glanced at Mr. Takeno and said with a sneer.
"The real Mr. Takeno, he is still working in Dongyi.
You counterfeit, you just came to our country to steal and sell antiques in the name of investment.
You can fool others, can you fool me? "Xu Shiyan shook his head.
Since Chu Yuanlang and the others came for the first time and said that there were people above, Xu Shiyan began to inquire about their details.
As for that Zhuye, Xu Shiyan had already asked the real Dongyi merchants who participated in the event to help him find out.
Mr. Takeno from Morinari Pharmaceuticals didn’t come to China at all, and he went to work very well.
Of course, it's hard to say whether the person in front of me dared to impersonate blatantly.
Xu Shiyan didn't want to guess too much, he only had to deal with the person in front of him.
"You, Xu Shiyan, you are talking nonsense.
This is Mr. Takeno, if you dare to do this to foreign businessmen, just wait for the relevant departments to deal with you. "
Chu Yuanlang was still putting on airs over there, trying to scare Xu Shiyan.
"Too lazy to talk nonsense with you, do it, hold them all down and tie them up, and send them to the pharmaceutical factory."

chapters.title: Chapter 666: steal secrets
chapters.content:
Chapter 666 Stealing Secrets
With dozens of guns pointed at them, would Chu Yuanlang and the others dare to resist?
If they don't resist, maybe they can still survive.
When the capital knows the news, they will definitely be able to get rid of them.
If they resist at this time, what if the other party really dares to shoot?
With so many guns pointed at them, if they were to shoot, wouldn’t they be smashed into briquettes in an instant?
In desperation, a few people could only obediently tie their hands together.
However, Chu Yuanlang didn't dare to move his body, his mouth was not idle.
"Xu Shiyan, you don't need to be arrogant, you dare to treat us like this, just wait, there will be good fruits for you to eat."
Chu Yuanlang yelled loudly on purpose, trying to alert Li Jingyu, Li Jingming and others living in the hotel.
Not to mention, this trick is really useful. When he yelled, the surrounding dogs were first alarmed.
The dogs of Xu Chenghou's family were too lazy to meddle in business before, so they all lay down in the den and made no sound.
But when Chu Yuanlang yelled like this, the dogs probably remembered the voice, okay, now it's time to come.
Jumped out of the nest and barked wildly towards the outside.
The reason why the head dog is called the head dog naturally has its own abilities.
Don't think that Xiao Huang no longer hunts when he is old, but when he barks, all the dogs in the neighbors' houses bark.
In an instant, the barking of the dog became one.
However, no matter how barking the dog is, it is still not easy to wake up the people living in the hotel.
One is Li Jingyu, who drank a lot and slept soundly.
Another one, this is a hotel, not my own.
Even if they heard a dog barking vaguely in the middle of the night, they didn't bother to look at it.
Chu Yuanlang yelled for a long time, but it was of no use except to wake up the dogs.
"Come on, if you shout people up like that, it will be dawn."
Xu Shiyan shook his head and turned to look at the people around him.
"Captain Qi, you lead someone to watch them. If anyone dares to move, you are welcome to shoot directly. I will call someone."
This matter must be handled in front of Guan Enxue and Li Jingyu.
Otherwise, he would be retaliating because of personal grievances.
Although the name of the fake Zhuye is fake, the identity of the Dongyi people is real. If this matter is not handled well, it will involve a lot.
Xu Shiyan went directly to the hotel, knocked on the door, and then went up to the second floor, calling out Li Jingyu, Li Jingming, Chang Hongfa, Guan Enxue, Chen Jianzhang, Lin Qiyue and others.
"Xiao Xu, what's the situation? You've got us all together in the middle of the night? What happened?"
Chang Hongfa came out of the room sleepily, and asked while yawning.
"Yeah, what time is it? It's just after twelve o'clock, what are you doing? You don't sleep in the middle of the night to be a monster?"
The same is true for Li Jingyu. If anyone sleeps and stares, and is quarreled by others, the mood will not be too beautiful.
"Don't be ridiculous, is Xiao Xu the one who is reckless? Since he came to see us in the middle of the night, something must have happened."
Guan Enxue knew Xu Shiyan well, and when he opened the door, he was already dressed and ready to go out at any time.
"There is indeed a big event. Tonight, the pharmaceutical factory caught five people who stole things from the valuable material warehouse. They are all Mr. Takeno's entourage.
One of them, surnamed Chu, still shouted that he was from Zhuye. "
Xu Shiyan didn't have time to explain in detail to Guan Enxue and the others.
In March, it was very cold outside at night.
The people under Captain Qi’s hands have been squatting outside for most of the night, so they can’t wait outside all the time.
Hurry up, deal with the matter, and let people rest.
Hearing Xu Shiyan's words, Li Jingyu and others suddenly became sober.
"What? Mr. Takeno's people, go to your material library to steal things? What about others?"
Li Jingyu thought for a moment that something was wrong, so he asked immediately.
"Jumped out of the window and ran away. Let Captain Qi lead someone to stop him below. Now they are all under him."
Xu Shiyan pouted towards Zhuye's room and said.
Having said that, what else do you not understand? These people's investment is fake, but their idea of ​​building a pharmaceutical factory is true.
"Go, go and have a look."
At this point, what are you talking about? Hurry up to the pharmaceutical factory to see what those people stole.
So, a group of people quickly went downstairs.
Looking outside, the well-trained young men on the 20th and 30th held guns and pressed several people to the ground and dared not move.
What else do you not understand? Xu Shiyan must have been on guard in advance.
"Take them and go."
These leaders each have a car, so everyone discussed and squeezed into several cars.
Make room for those in the whole team, **** Zhuye, Chu Yuanlang and his party, and go straight to the pharmaceutical factory.
At the pharmaceutical factory, several people from Chu Yuanchao were pinned to the ground with guns pointed at their heads, and no one dared to move.
In March, the sun is out during the day and it is warmer.
At night, the ground was frozen hard, and the cold wind blew in gusts. Chu Yuanchao and others were shivering from the cold.
Xu Shiyan brought people to the pharmaceutical factory, dragged Zhuye, Chu Yuanlang and others out of the car, escorted them into the factory, and went straight to the material warehouse behind.
Looking over here, sure enough, Chu Yuanchao and others are there.
"Mr. Xu, these people came out from inside and were taken down by us directly.
We just caught them, didn't ask anything, didn't search them. "
One of the leaders saluted Xu Shiyan and reported.
"Vice-captain Liu has worked hard. After dealing with them later, you can go back and rest." Xu Shiyan nodded.
These people were the same people who escorted Chu Xuanhuai from the provincial capital back to Donggang, and planned to build a radar station on Donggang Mountain.
Qi and Liu are the captain and deputy captain, and it is said that they were specially transferred from the special forces.
Although they are young, they are all experienced in battles. It is really overkill for them to catch such a few small thieves.
"Xu Shiyan, you are really sinister and ruthless, you deliberately set a trap to lure our brothers into the bait.
I don't accept it, we came here to get the secret recipe of our Chu family.
That belonged to us originally, it was you, a sinister and cunning guy, who fooled my father and got the secret recipe into his hands.
What's wrong with us taking back our own stuff? "
When Chu Yuanlang saw his brother, he understood that the two brothers had fallen into Xu Shiyan's trap from the moment they brought Zhu Ye to invest.
These people were obviously laid in ambush in advance, just waiting for them to come to the material warehouse.
"The secret recipe of your Chu family? Did you make a mistake?
Here is the item warehouse of the radar unit, and what is stored in the safe is the defense map of the radar station, which is a military secret.
You are clearly stealing military secrets by using the name of the secret recipe. "
Xu Shiyan looked at the Chu Yuanchao brothers in surprise, as if the Chu family brothers made up a very poor excuse.
The two brothers of the Chu family were stunned immediately, "Impossible, absolutely impossible, Xu Shiyan, you liar, you fooled us.
I read it just now. It is a medical book, the secret recipe of our Chu family. "Chu Yuanchao shouted loudly.
"Are you guys stupid? Isn't there a sign on the door of the warehouse?
Radar Troop Preparation Department's quarters depot, please do not approach. Didn't you see? "
Xu Shiyan pouted towards the warehouse door behind everyone, motioning for them all to take a look.
Guan Enxue and the others really looked over there. Under the lights, there was indeed a sign next to the warehouse door.

chapters.title: Chapter 667: report up
chapters.content:
Chapter 667 Report to the top
"This, how is this possible? We came here before, and this is clearly a material library."
The brothers of the Chu family are all dumbfounded. How could a material warehouse of a pharmaceutical factory become a military supplies warehouse?
"This, because our factory is jointly established with the organization.
A radar station is going to be built here, but it is too cold to be stationed temporarily, so Captain Qi and others are temporarily staying at the pharmaceutical factory.
I freed up the material warehouse and filled them with various materials. Is there any problem? "
Xu Shiyan was very kind and explained to them.
Changbai Yam Factory was co-organized by a participant and the organization. It has always been kept secret and has not been made public.
Only when someone called for a directional training place in a pharmaceutical university, the provincial leader called Li Jingyu.
But he didn't say what happened specifically, only that the quota was specially given by the province to participate in the competition, and no one was allowed to misappropriate it, otherwise the consequences would be at their own risk.
Even so, Li Jingyu was so frightened that he called people over and gave him a stinky training.
As for the others, I really don't know much about it. I just think that Xu Shiyan has some backing in the provincial capital.
Stealing the prescriptions in the material library of the pharmaceutical factory and stealing the supplies of the radar unit are completely different concepts, and the Chu Yuanchao brothers were dumbfounded at once.
Now, it seems that Takeno's identity is not easy to use.
"No, I read it clearly, that is the prescription, it is the secret recipe of our Chu family, don't fool me."
Chu Yuanchao's mind is still good. He remembered that he had read the first few pages of the book, which were prescriptions, not any defense maps.
"Ju Li, I can't do anything about this matter, if I do, it seems that I deliberately planted the blame.
Please go search him and see what he has. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, these two people will not give up until the Yellow River, okay, let them see.
When Li Jingming heard this, without further ado, he went straight over and took out a thin book from Chu Yuanchao's arms.
I don't know if he was careless or what happened, but when I took it out, something fell out of the book.
Li Jingming hurriedly picked it up, opened it, and saw a map the size of a quarto.
It is clearly written on it, the radar deployment map of the Changbai Mountain area.
Li Jingming was so frightened that he immediately closed the picture.
Are you kidding, he dares to look at this thing? If the secret is leaked, don't ask him to settle the score.
"Secretary Li, in charge of the mayor, is really a radar map."
Li Jingming nodded towards Li Jingyu and Guan Enxue, and said solemnly.
"Secretary Li, let you handle this matter.
Their brothers colluded with foreigners and stole military secrets, which is no small matter.
My small factory is not capable of handling this. "Xu Shiyan glanced at Li Jingyu, and directly blamed him.
Li Jingyu has been stupid for a long time.
How could he have imagined that a person who put on the air of a foreign businessman during the day and openly discussed investment cooperation with pharmaceutical companies would become a thief who steals secrets at night? Not just any thief.
This matter is a bit big, and he doesn't seem to be able to handle it.
"Deputy City Guan, what do you think about this?" Li Jingyu quickly turned his head and asked Guan Enxue.
"Put the person under arrest first, and I will report to the superior immediately. We have no right to interfere in this matter."
Are you kidding, this matter is too big, how can the local government have the right to intervene in this matter? Report directly to the province.
Captain Qi and the others heard this, and immediately came forward, detained Zhuye and the others, and locked them in a warehouse of the pharmaceutical factory.
Then arranged ten people to guard with guns.
If these people try to escape, they can shoot.
On the other side, Guan Enxue followed Xu Shiyan to the office building, borrowed the phone, and called the city secretary.
In the middle of the night, when the other party heard this, he broke into a cold sweat from fright, and hurriedly called the province to ask for instructions.
When the other side of the province heard about it, they were also quite frightened.
While reporting to the relevant higher-level departments, he arranged for people to set off immediately, and took Zhuye and others to the province for interrogation.
Guan Enxue hung up the phone and turned to look at Xu Shiyan.
"Shiyan, tell me, is this something you did? Then brothers of the Chu family, what's wrong with you?"
The discerning person knew that the brothers of the Chu family had fallen into a trap.
The person who dug the pit was naturally Xu Shiyan.
It's just this pit, dug too deep, and there is a deadly knife hidden in it.
"Leader, if I say no, you won't believe me, but these two brothers really didn't do a good job.
They secretly stole many cultural relics and antiques and sold them to foreigners.
That Takeno is specialized in this, he is not an executive of Morinari Pharmaceuticals at all. "
Of course, behind the theft of the prescription this time, there must be a shadow of a certain pharmaceutical company in Dongyi.
It’s hard to say who it is, anyway, Zhuye and others specialize in this business, and they will do whatever the customer orders.
In Xu Shiyan's mind, it is probably the ginseng rhodiola capsules or other medicines that have attracted the attention of others.
People carefully inquired about the participants and the details of Xu Shiyan, and knew the existence of Mr. Chu.
For some reason, they hooked up with the Chu Yuanchao brothers, and then they thought about the secret recipe and tried their best to get it.
Of course, Xu Shiyan can't argue with Guan En about these words, because there is no basis after all.
"The Zhuye group, in the name of investment cooperation, cheated food and drink everywhere.
Then find a way to steal a large number of cultural relics and antiques by stealing, coaxing, etc., and find a way to transport them out of the country to obtain high profits. "
Really think Xu Shiyan is idle these days to eat dry food?
He has already used all his contacts to find out the background and origin of Zhuye and others.
There is no impenetrable wall in the world. Since Zhuye and the others have done it, they will definitely be able to leave traces.
It's just that these people's hammering and sticking are too scattered, and no one has collected them, so naturally they don't attract the attention of others.
But Xu Shiyan asked someone to check it out, and it would be quite impressive if it was put together.
So this time, whether it is Zhuye or the brothers of the Chu family, there is definitely enough for them to drink a pot.
Guan Enxue let out a sigh of relief when he heard this.
"Okay, I see, if someone criticizes the grievances between you and the brothers of the Chu family, I can also have reasons to argue for you.
This matter is done right. These beasts who have forgotten their ancestors and betrayed their ancestors will have to pay the price. "
"Thank you for your understanding, the leader, that, disturbed the leader's rest in the middle of the night, otherwise, go back to the hotel to sleep for a while?"
Xu Shiyan looked at it, and it was not yet three o'clock, so it should be fine to go back to sleep.
"Why do you sleep when you are like this? Come on, just stay here for a while and wait for the news.
I reckon that the city should send someone over soon to take those people away.
You are a factory after all, not a formal investigation department. "
Guan Enxue shook his head, he was so refreshed now, how could he sleep?
Just like that, the two came out of the office and met Li Jingyu, Chang Hongfa and others.
"It has been reported to the leader, maybe there will be news later.
If you are sleepy, you can go to the worker’s dormitory to rest for a while, and we will go back after the above arranges someone to come over to deal with it. "

chapters.title: Chapter 668: deserved
chapters.content:
Chapter 668 You deserve it
At this point, how can everyone still be in the mood to sleep? Simply stay in the conference room of the office building and wait for news.
Before seven in the morning, people from the city came.
"We were ordered to **** the group who stole the secrets to the provincial capital."
The visitor saw Guan Enxue and said after saluting.
Guan Enxue nodded, "Well, be careful on the road, just don't let these people get away."
The chief of the Municipal Public Security Bureau came here in person, which is enough to prove that the higher authorities attach great importance to this matter.
What else can Guan Enxue say? Nod, let Captain Qi hand over to the other party.
Ten people, including Zhuye and the Chu family brothers, were all untied from the ropes, put on handcuffs, and were escorted into the car.
The city attaches great importance to this matter, and the city bureau dispatched all of them, and arranged for several vehicles to come over, and all of them were equipped with guns.
With this posture, Zhuye and the others want to run?
"Shiyan, since there are people from the city, we won't delay with you, and we just happened to drop by and go back together.
You should pay more attention here. I don’t know if this group of people has any accomplices. In case they retaliate or something, be careful. "
Guan Enxue patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and asked Xu Shiyan a few words.
"Thank you for your concern.
Please invite the leader to come over this time. I didn’t expect to encounter such a thing. I’m really sorry. "Xu Shiyan nodded.
Although he intended to take advantage of the opportunity to clean up the Chu brothers, but in the middle of the night Guan Enxue and others were tormented enough, and he felt a little sorry for the truth.
"It's nothing, no one thought that this group of people turned out to be liars.
Thanks to your vigilance, you found out their details.
If not, I’m afraid that those people in our city and your county who have lost their minds will be deceived miserably if they don’t keep it. "
When Guan Enxue said this, his eyes happened to look at Li Jingyu.
When Li Jingyu heard this, his face felt hot, almost like being slapped.
Before this group of people came here and said they wanted to invest, and he was so beautiful that he wished he could fly to the sky, eat, drink and entertain.
The results of it? These people turned out to be liars.
This slap in the face is really slapping, where does Li Jingyu still have a temper? Hurry up and leave.
Just like that, a group of people didn't even eat breakfast, they drove directly, followed the police car in front, and left Donggang directly.
Li Jingyu and the others returned to the county, while Guan Enxue and others returned to the city.
Just when they arrived in the city, people sent by the province also came down, the two sides joined together, and directly detained Chu Yuanlang and others alone for interrogation.
Chu Yuanlang Chu Yuanlang still didn’t give up at this time, he kept shouting, there are people above them, there are people in the capital, so what.
When the interrogators saw this situation, they immediately reported to their superiors, and the province immediately reported the news to the capital.
When the capital heard about it, they immediately summoned the second generation.
As a result, when the second generation heard that Chu Yuanlang and the others stole the military supply depot and the defense map, he immediately denied any relationship with Chu Yuanlang and others.
He only said that when Takeno came to the capital, he had a meal together.
There is no other relationship, let alone the so-called backstage and backer of these people, and they directly pick themselves out.
At present, there is indeed no direct evidence of this collusion with Zhuye, Chu Yuanlang and others.
The relevant departments have no choice but to let people go back.
After hearing the news, the brothers of the Chu family immediately lost their arrogance.
I can only admit that they have colluded with the Dongyi people in the past few years, cheating, stealing, etc., and exporting a large number of antique cultural relics out of the country, and profiting from it.
However, they refused to admit that the military secrets were stolen this time, and claimed that Xu Shiyan deliberately framed it and took the opportunity to retaliate.
Relevant departments also came to Xu Shiyan to inquire about what happened. Xu Shiyan has nothing to hide, he has said everything that needs to be said.
Anyway, at that time, people got all the stolen goods, and under the watchful eyes of everyone, it was not Xu Shiyan who made up random things.
As for whether the brothers of the Chu family came to steal secret recipes or military secrets, the nature of this distinction does not make much difference.
The prescription that Xu Shiyan and Chu Xuanhuai dedicated to the country originally came from the secret recipe of the Chu family, and it is now a state-secret formula.
Even if it is not the theft of military secrets, it is also the theft of state secrets, and the end is not too bad.
"Master, I heard people say that this time, the two brothers will probably be sentenced to at least 20 years in prison, and if it is too much, they will have no term."
After work this day, Xu Shiyan went home and told Chu Xuanhuai about the two brothers.
Chu Xuanhuai shook his head, "That's what they deserve.
Even without this incident, they stole so many antique cultural relics out of the country, and they would be jailed for many years if they were caught.
You don’t have to blame yourself for this matter, it’s thanks to your painstaking planning that they were arrested.
Otherwise, if they were allowed to bluff and deceive, how many people would be deceived by them.
I don’t know how many national treasures were emptied out of the country by them and sold to foreigners.
These two bastards, who didn't even want their ancestors, did such a thing. The Chu family has no such descendants. "
Chu Xuanhuai is now bearish.
After the two sons were born, it was the busiest stage of his work, and he really neglected the growth and education of the children.
When he found out that something was wrong and wanted to discipline him, something happened and he was locked up.
At that time, I didn't even know if I could save my life, so why should I care about other things? Everything can only be left to fate.
For such an ending, Chu Xuanhuai knew that he really couldn't escape the responsibility.
If he could have done a little bit of the responsibility of being a father and disciplined his two sons, maybe they would not have gone to the point of no return.
But now, regretting is useless.
"Shiyan, please do Master a favor." Chu Xuanhuai hesitated for a while, and finally spoke.
"Master, you want me to put your grandchildren in place, right?"
Master and apprentice have been together for so long, how can they not even have this kind of tacit understanding? Xu Shiyan had already thought of it.
"I have asked someone to inquire about their situation. They are currently in Shenzhen City, and the two brothers have a small savings, so they lived well before.
I have already asked others to take care of them secretly, and also observe the character of these children by the way.
If the children are not bad, after a period of time, I will find a way to give them another place. "
Chu Yuanchao had a son and a daughter, and Chu Yuanlang had a son and two daughters. They have followed the Chu family brothers to Shenzhen City for the past two years.
Before, the Chu Yuanchao brothers had money, and the family could live well.
However, after their accident, it is estimated that the illegal income will be confiscated, and the lives of their wives and children may be somewhat difficult in the future.
Xu Shiyan entrusted the students of Chu Xuanhuai in Shenzhen City to find someone to pay attention to the daily life of these people.
Also take a good look at the character of the children, whether they have followed their father.
If the children are not bad, even if they are a little naughty, as long as they can be corrected, Xu Shiyan will find a way to arrange a more stable life for them, so that they can study and work smoothly.
If there are really outstanding ones, you can also focus on cultivating them.
In any case, this is Chu Xuanhuai's own grandson, the real descendant of the Chu family.
It cannot be said that Xu Shiyan deliberately sent the brothers of the Chu family in, regardless of how many children there were, just to defraud the Chu family of the secret recipe.
Of course, the prerequisite for everything is that those children are still alive and have not been taught badly by their fathers.
If the child is incurable, forget it. Everyone understands the truth of raising tigers.

chapters.title: Chapter 669: leave early
chapters.content:
Chapter 669 Departure early
Chu Xuanhuai nodded after listening to Xu Shiyan's arrangement.
"Well, you have always done things safely, so let's do as you say.
You don’t need to take care of it too much, as long as you can get by daily.
Sheng Mien fights Mi Qiu, who was too kind to them at first, but will become more and more dissatisfied.
These years they were able to live in the Northwest, but they had no reason to go to Shenzhen City, but they couldn't get along. "
It is impossible to say that Chu Xuanhuai doesn't care about the blood of the Chu family.
But Chu Xuanhuai lived to be eighty years old in this life, and has experienced many storms and waves. Human feelings are cold and warm, and the world is hot and cold. What else can't he see through?
When the Chu and Yuanchao brothers embarked on this path, they should have known what would happen if they capsized in the future.
So these two brothers will not leave a way for their wives and children.
Xu Shiyan let someone take care of them a little bit, and don't let them bully them, that's enough. The rest depends on the individual.
If those children are good, self-reliant and self-reliant, they can always find a way out.
If you blindly help them, but turn them into moths, it will harm them.
"Well, don't worry, master, I will be careful, and I also hope that they will all be successful in the future."
Xu Shiyan nodded and agreed.
Brothers Zhuye and Chu Yuanchao were arrested. As the interrogation deepened, many problems were exposed and many people were dug out.
This is almost a complete and mature profit chain of cultural relics theft and sale, and Chu Yuanchao and others are just the tip of the iceberg.
Relevant departments took this opportunity to launch an in-depth and detailed investigation.
The country also attaches great importance to this, so a series of regulations have been issued.
Regulate the domestic cultural and antique market, clearly define the difference between antiques and cultural relics, and prohibit the outflow of cultural relics.
Although Takeno is a foreigner, he has done a lot of illegal things in China, especially the theft of military secrets this time is serious.
The brothers of the Chu family became Zhuye's accomplices out of greed for their own self-interest.
Stealing and trafficking cultural relics, and assisting Takeno to steal secrets, the circumstances are serious and the nature is bad.
In the end, the main members of this gang were all sentenced to life. Some of the others were twenty years or fifteen years, but they didn't end well anyway.
Regarding these, Xu Shiyan has no interest in paying attention to them. He still has a lot of things to do.
On March 30, at the Science and Technology Achievement Expo held in Singapore, the Changbai Mountain Red Ginseng selected by the participating companies won the gold medal.
Natural active ginseng, ginseng royal jelly oral liquid, vitality drink, ginseng Tianma honey, and canned natural blueberries from Bingshan Beverage Factory have all obtained honorary certificates for high-quality products.
The news was sent back to China, and it was another lively and jubilant celebration.
Of course, as more and more awards are awarded, everyone doesn't take it seriously.
A small celebration within the company is fine, but it is useless not to organize those celebrations that waste people and money.
Li Bingzhuo took people abroad to participate in the exhibition, and he must not come back so soon. The Spring Fair here is about to start, so Xu Shiyan can only lead the team to Yangcheng.
"Brother, let's set off early this time to catch the first phase of the Spring Fair."
Xu Shiyan called Guo Shouye and discussed with Guo Shouye. They set off first and arrived in Yangcheng before the opening of the first phase.
As the first promotion platform for foreign trade, the Spring Fair and Autumn Fair are known as the barometer and vane of foreign trade, and their status is self-evident.
In the past few years, the domestic economy has also developed rapidly, and various factories and products have emerged in an endless stream.
Xu Shiyan felt that he had to go out and have a look, instead of just working behind closed doors at home.
It is necessary to know what the foreign market needs.
Go there ahead of time, do some research in advance, and find out the direction of the nearest export wind.
It is of great significance to the next industrial layout and enterprise product adjustment.
Unfortunately, the Spring Fair is still only an export fair.
When it becomes an import and export fair, it will be even better, and you can directly order the machinery you want from foreign manufacturers.
"Okay, you can do whatever you want, let's leave whenever you say."
For Guo Shouye, Xu Shiyan was right no matter what he said.
Xu Shiyan wants to leave early, so there must be his reason, let's go, what else is there?
"Okay, then let's go on the 12th and fly to Yangcheng in Shenyang. This time we don't take the train, it's too slow.
Before the opening of the first phase, let's go to the place and take a good look around, maybe there is another opportunity. "
Xu Shiyan looked at the calendar and calculated the date.
I left home on the 12th, and I was able to arrive in Shenyang in the evening. On the 13th, I flew from Shenyang to Yangcheng, and I arrived on the same day. It happened to be a day off on the 14th.
This is more worry-free than taking the train. The first ride on the train lasts three or four days, which is too tiresome.
"Success, I'll listen to you." Guo Shouye agreed very happily.
Bingshan Beverage Factory now earns tens of millions of foreign exchange a year from exports, how much is the air ticket? Just sit on the plane.
In this way, the two reached an agreement and set off early for the Spring Fair.
They took a few people over to have a look first. As for the products, they can still ship them according to the time of previous years. It just so happens that they have enough time to receive the goods and set up the booth there.
"Daughter-in-law, I'm going to Yangcheng ahead of schedule this year, do you want to follow me to have a look?"
When returning home from get off work in the evening, Xu Shiyan asked Su Anying.
"Huh? You want to leave early? When?
Shendi is busy now, I will follow you to Yangcheng, what about the stall at home? "
Su Anying was stunned when she heard it, and she also went to the Spring Fair? Can it work?
Isn’t this all arranged by the county or city? She is at most a private entrepreneur, going to the spring fair? Why go?
"What's wrong with that? If we don't sell anything, why don't we go over and have a look?
I was thinking, we have so much money in our hands, we can't just let it lay in the bank and give birth, we have to move and do some business.
Didn’t I always discuss with Master before, saying that I want to make health care products?
How about you open another factory? Specialize in health care products? "Regarding this, Xu Shiyan has also planned for a long time.
For the participants, the current production capacity is almost reached.
Unless there is another large-scale recruitment and expansion, otherwise, the current situation will basically be maintained.
But large-scale recruitment and expansion, there are too many hidden dangers behind.
Once the ginseng market drops, the benefits of participating in the market will definitely decline. It is hard to predict what will happen in the future, and we should not take risks easily.
However, the domestic health care product industry will usher in a scene of a hundred flowers blooming and competing for beauty in the next few years. It is a pity to miss this opportunity.
Xu Shiyan wanted Su Anying to lead people to form a health care product company and open a factory.
Take advantage of the opportunity of the rise of health care products in recent years, earn a fortune first, wait for a few years to stand firm, and then develop in other areas.
In this case, the participating side will focus on export, while Su Anying's side will mainly focus on domestic production, without affecting each other, and both sides can make money.
In the coming downturn of the ginseng industry, we can also make a moderate buffer and plan ahead to avoid some risks.
"Also, can we also go to Yangcheng to have a look, buy two houses, and the entire store, specializing in the sale of Northeast specialties?
Taking advantage of gaining a firm foothold now, wouldn’t it be better than staying in a hotel every time you go to Yangcheng? "

chapters.title: Chapter 670: first time flying
chapters.content:
Chapter 670 Flying for the first time
What Xu Shiyan said about the health care product factory hasn't moved Su Anying much.
The main reason is that Su Anying felt that the goal of building a factory was too big, and she was afraid that she didn't have the ability to do it.
But Xu Shiyan said that buying a house and opening a store in the past attracted Su Anying more.
She stayed there for a long time last winter, and she knows a little about it.
If you really open a Northeast specialty store over there, the business will definitely be fine.
"It's okay to buy a house, let's go find a better location, buy a place and open a store.
It happens that we will sell goods in the future, and we will have a place to stay. This is OK. "
Su Anying immediately became happy, regardless of whether the family is busy or not, it is important to do serious business.
"Then let the third brother-in-law and the fourth brother-in-law take care of the ginseng land at home, anyway, it will be the thatch shed and the pool in a few days.
There are already people working on these mountains, they just go up and watch. "
During the beginning of spring, the wild vegetables hadn't come down yet, and neither Ji Tongzhong nor Nan Zhendong was busy.
It happened to let them go up to the mountain to lead the work, and when Su Anying came back, Dayeqin and Niu Maoguang were almost done, and they happened to dump wild vegetables.
"Okay, then it's settled. Later, you prepare your money, bring some nice clothes, and jewelry.
This time we are going out, we are going to hang out at the Spring Fair. If you are dressed too rustically, be careful that people will not let you in. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and added two more pieces of firewood to the stove, then clapped his hands, turned and went back to the house.
Xu Shiyan set off on the 12th, and it was already after Qingming, so of course he had to pack up and prepare quickly.
So the next day, Su Anying called several managers and shareholders of the company over, and held a simple meeting.
Arrange the next thing, and also mentioned Xu Shiyan's idea of ​​wanting to make health products.
No one has any opinion on this. Now that everyone has money in their hands, they can do whatever they want.
"Mr. Su, you can rest assured to investigate and study. We will take care of the company, so I guarantee that there will be no problem."
In spring, except for the busy people in Shendi, everything else is simple and there is nothing to be busy with.
Whether Su Anying is at home or not has little effect.
"Okay, then I'll take care of everyone at home. After we get back, let's discuss the company's next development direction."
We have been partners for so many years, what else can we not believe? As long as the arrangement is arranged, it will be fine.
It's okay for Su Anying to say, after all, it's a private company with few things to do.
It's Xu Shiyan's side, which is now a participating company anyway.
Subordinates include a ginseng factory, a pharmaceutical factory, a comprehensive factory, and a mineral water beverage factory, and the business involved is also in all aspects, so it must be explained clearly, right?
After working for several days, I finally settled all the affairs, and explained it to my family later.
Especially a few children, let them be obedient at home and not cause trouble.
Early in the morning on April 12th, Xu Shiyan and his party went to Songjianghe to join Guo Shouye and others.
Afterwards, take the train from Baihe to Shenyang and go straight to Shenyang.
This train is a direct express train, and there is no need to back up halfway, unlike going to the provincial capital, where you have to back up on the Hunjiang River in the middle.
Take the bus at 8:30 in the morning, and it was almost midnight when we arrived in Shenyang. Everyone got off the bus and found a hotel near the station to stay.
The next morning, I had breakfast, took a taxi and went straight to the airport, and then flew to Yangcheng.
Among the group, only Su Anying had been on a plane, and Xu Shiyan had never been on a plane in his previous life, let alone this life.
Thus, Su Anying became the tour guide for everyone, guiding them through the formalities and boarding the plane.
Xu Shiyan has never been on a plane, and he has seen it on TV in his previous life.
So when the announcement in the waiting room said that it was possible to board the plane, he was still looking around, looking for the corridor bridge or boarding bridge or something.
As a result, I didn’t see anything. I just saw a group of people, who were similar to the crowded train during the Spring Festival. They went straight out of the waiting room, and then ran all the way towards the apron.
"Brother and sister, do you really understand, is it this plane? Don't make a mess, let's fly somewhere else."
When Guo Shouye walked up the gangway, he was still muttering.
"Brother, don't worry, this is the plane."
Su Anying laughed as soon as she heard it, the radio said it all, can it be wrong?
Guo Shouye also thought about it. Others can make mistakes, but Su Anying can't either. She has been on a plane before.
So Anxin followed the crowd on the plane, found his seat and sat down.
"Hurry up, hurry up, who brought a camera, hurry up and take a picture."
It’s no wonder Guo Shouye is so excited. Nowadays, people who can fly by plane are not ordinary people.
Except for the official business trips of leading cadres, they are very rich and very rich people.
Of course Guo Shouye doesn't belong to the particularly rich group. If he didn't come out with Xu Shiyan, he would be reluctant to take the plane.
So when I got on the plane, I was very excited, and I had to shout for a photo.
Of course, Guo Shouye is not the only one who wants to take pictures.
On this plane, most of the people must be sitting on the plane for the first time, and some people want to take pictures as souvenirs.
Not to mention, Xu Shiyan really brought a camera, so he clicked and took several pictures for the big guy.
If the stewardess hadn’t come to remind me that the plane was about to take off, please sit down and fasten your seat belts, these people would still be able to take pictures.
"Well, I want to ask, can I get airsick by plane? I get motion sickness by car.
What if you vomit from airsickness? This is in the sky, can this window be opened? "Not far away, someone asked the stewardess.
The stewardess smiled and handed her a bag.
"Sir, if you really feel sick and want to vomit, please spit into this bag.
As for the portholes of the aircraft, you cannot open them, please do not move them. "
The man took the bag and nodded, "Oh, oh, yes, yes, I'll listen to you."
The person next to him asked some questions that would sound idiotic in later generations, and the stewardess answered them very well.
At this time, the broadcast said that the plane was about to take off, so the stewardess reminded everyone to sit still and fasten their seat belts.
The plane taxied on the runway and gradually accelerated to take off.
When ascending into the sky, the ears will feel uncomfortable. After the plane stabilizes, it will gradually get better.
At this time, everyone's hanging hearts finally let go, and they started chatting in the mood.
In April, I was still wearing a thick coat when I left home, and it was chilly when I boarded the plane just now.
But the temperature in the plane is so high right now that many people feel hot and want to take off their coats.
As a result, at this time, someone saw white steam coming out from the top of the luggage rack, and was terrified at that time.
"Oh, look, what's wrong with this plane? Is there an air leak somewhere, is there going to be an accident?"
Su Anying turned her head to look, smiled, and patiently explained to others.
"Don't worry, this is the air conditioner on the plane just turned on, it will be fine in a while.
The temperature on the plane is high, and we wear a lot of clothes. Turning on the air conditioner will make us feel more comfortable. "
"Hey? This **** is very powerful. Looking at her young age, she understands everything. She is very powerful.
Where are you a cadre? What are you doing when you go out to Yangcheng this time?
It sounds like your accent doesn’t sound like Shenyang’s. Where is your home? It should be our fellow from the Northeast, right? "
The person next to him glanced at Su Anying, and immediately became interested, and began to get close to Su Anying.
There will be Zhang Jiageng in a while.

chapters.title: Chapter 671: Opening of the Spring Fair
chapters.content:
Chapter 671 Spring Fair Opening
Su Anying is thirty-four years old this year. She looks good. She has lived a comfortable life in the past few years and dresses fashionable.
Although it no longer has the radiance of a young girl, it has the charm of a mature woman, which is more attractive.
Especially on this plane, most of them are men.
Suddenly there is a pleasing beauty, everyone wants to take a second look, and no one blames others for making trouble.
"We are from Kyrgyzstan, and she is the general manager of Baishan Ginseng Comprehensive Company.
I am her lover, general manager of Hunjiang Oriental Ginseng Company. "
Xu Shiyan turned around and stretched out his hand towards the other party with a smile on his face.
"Oh, oh, you are from Kyrgyzstan, the general manager of Shenye Company, whoops, that's amazing.
I heard that the ginseng over there is very valuable. I'm really envious.
I am from Haicheng, does Haicheng know? It is the place where the Northeast King was born. "
The other party didn't have any other thoughts, but he was able to chat with anyone he knew.
So I didn't feel embarrassed, and immediately chatted with Xu Shiyan with a smile.
"I know, I know, my hometown is Kuandian, and it's not too far from Haicheng."
Xu Shiyan didn't think much of it either, so he chatted with the other party with a smile.
Su Anying glanced at Xu Shiyan, pursed her lips and smiled, quietly reached out and took Xu Shiyan's hand.
There was nothing interesting on the plane. Last night, the conditions of the hotel were mediocre. There were trains coming in and out of the station from time to time, so I couldn't sleep well due to the noise.
Being bored right now, Su Anying held Xu Shiyan's hand, closed her eyes and stared dazedly, but fell asleep after a while.
Xu Shiyan was chatting casually with people, when he suddenly felt that something was wrong, he turned his head and saw that his wife had fallen asleep.
So he quickly picked up the armrest of the seat between the two of them, reached out and hugged his daughter-in-law, so that Su Anying could sleep more comfortably.
The person chatting over there, seeing this situation, also shut up and stopped chatting.
The plane took off at noon and arrived at Yangcheng Airport in the evening. Compared with the previous few days of taking the train, it was much faster.
Arrive in Yangcheng, find a similar hotel to stay.
Nowadays, going out is not like a few years ago. You need a letter of introduction where you live. Now you can live wherever you want.
Although flying is fast, sitting for such a long time makes you feel uncomfortable.
In addition to the hot weather here, it is a bit uncomfortable to come here suddenly.
So I didn't have time to eat, so I went back to the room to change clothes and tidy up.
No one was in a hurry to go out the next day, so they rested in the hotel.
On the morning of the 15th, everyone packed up and went out of the room to gather.
Because it was agreed in advance that they must dress up well, so everyone worked hard and groomed themselves well.
Xu Shiyan naturally has a neat suit, polished leather shoes, short hair with some pomade, and wearing sunglasses. He looks similar to those Hong Kong businessmen.
Su Anying is also very well dressed, with a white silk shirt, the corner of the shirt is tied at the waist, and decorated with silver rings.
A burgundy skirt with burgundy high heels, simple but not simple.
The short hair before was left, neither long nor short, and the slightly curly tail just hangs on the shoulder socket.
Thin braids were braided on the temples, fixed with black pearl-studded hairpins, beautiful and elegant.
"Hey, with your husband and wife dressed like this, we are really followers."
Guo Shouye laughed when he saw Xu Shiyan and his wife's outfits.
There is really no way, Guo Shouye and his suits are mostly bought off-the-shelf, or else they are made by someone in the tailor shop in Songjianghe.
The habit of local tailors to make clothes is still a little fatter, so it doesn't fit that well, and the style can't keep up with the trend.
The clothes of Xu Shiyan and his wife were all designed by Xu Shiqin and made by his own clothing factory. They are definitely of two grades.
Xu Shiqin opened a garment factory there since he followed Han Liwei to Guangshui.
It happened that there were many military wives who went with the army, and they didn’t have any jobs. The garment factory solved their job problems.
Xu Shiqin himself is very interested in fashion design. He learned relevant knowledge when he was in the capital, and then went to Shanghai, Yangcheng, Hong Kong and other places to gain experience.
So the clothes she designed are very fashionable, and they sell very well in the capital, Shanghai stock market, Yangcheng and other places.
Xu Shiqin contracted the clothes of Xu Shiyan's family for four seasons.
With this professional clothing consultant, the clothes of Xu Shiyan and his wife can keep up with the trend even if they wear them to Hong Kong City.
How can people like Guo Shouye compare?
"Brother, how about we go back and change?" Xu Shiyan asked with a smile.
"No, it's fine like this.
Just now I was thinking about it, we don’t look like a big boss of a Hong Kong businessman.
伱 said that we went to the Spring Fair to wander around, would people be willing to talk to us?
Not to mention, seeing you two gives me confidence, let's go, that's it.
Let’s also be the big boss this time, and have a good time wandering around the Spring Fair. "
Guo Shouye hurriedly waved his hands, how good it is, as long as they don't open their mouths, no one dares to treat them as old hats from the mainland.
Of course, when you speak, you will definitely reveal everything.
Everyone laughed, came out of the hotel, and went outside to find a car.
It is estimated that Xu Shiyan and his wife are dressed very conspicuously, and those are very proud. At this time, the taxis that only take foreign guests and do not accept locals, when they saw someone waving in front of the hotel, they really stopped.
Xu Shiyan and his party of six or seven people took two separate cars and went straight to the exhibition halls of the Spring Fair.
Today's Yangcheng, the weather is good, early in the morning, the sun showed its heat.
Just like today's Yangcheng, it is full of energy, vitality and passion everywhere.
On the first day of the opening of the Spring Fair, there were crowds of people inside and outside the exhibition hall. When the opening time came, everyone rushed in.
The first to come in are naturally the staff and local enterprises and institutions participating in the exhibition.
When these people are ready, foreign merchants will enter the market one after another.
Last year, Xu Shiyan advised Guo Shouye to provide free bottled drinking water for the Spring Fair.
This trick can be said to be very effective. Last year, Bingshan Beverage Factory received many orders for mineral water alone.
Originally, Xu Shiyan thought that this trick must be learned this year, and it is estimated that other beverage factories and mineral water factories will also come to sponsor this year.
But when I came to the exhibition hall, I searched left and right, but couldn’t find it.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help being taken aback, why is no one copying homework? Don't you know how to take advantage of such a good opportunity?
"Brother, quickly arrange someone to discuss with the organizing committee about matters related to our factory sponsoring mineral water."
Xu Shiyan regretted it to death. If they knew that no one would **** it, they should have brought all the water and so on in advance.
This is so good, the opportunity was wasted in vain.
Guo Shouye has tasted the sweetness. As soon as Xu Shiyan said it, he understood.
"Okay, I know, let's talk about it."
So, Guo Shouye didn't bother to visit any venues anymore, so let's find someone to discuss cooperation matters.
If this is discussed, get someone to ship it here from home as soon as possible. If you missed the first issue, you will definitely be able to catch up with the second issue.
How much water is there for a few days? If this popularity spreads out, it's all money.
I promised to send it to you, and asked for a guaranteed monthly pass along the way.
In the past few days, there has been an unexpected situation. Children have online classes at home, and in the large class group, they will pass this one to another in a while, and fill in the form in a while. I couldn't go to the small kindergarten, so I just circled around me when I was free at home. It was so busy that I was dizzy.
It’s really not that I deliberately broke the chapter, but I just wrote it there, and I can’t write it if there are too many, because I really don’t have time.

chapters.title: Chapter 672: Sponsorship fee
chapters.content:
Chapter 672 Sponsorship fee
Guo Shouye took people to talk about things, Xu Shiyan, his wife and Li Chengrong, and the three of them walked into the exhibition hall.
The first phase of the Spring Fair is mostly industrial products, large machinery and equipment, small machinery, bicycles, motorcycles, auto parts, chemical products, hardware, household appliances, etc.
Ordinarily speaking, these things really have nothing to do with participation.
But Xu Shiyan watched it with gusto, and walked over to every booth.
Not to mention, after several years of development, most companies have experience.
Those large-scale machinery and equipment could not be transported to participate in the exhibition, so they took photos and printed brochures.
This brochure is quite exquisite, and the introduction inside is also very detailed.
Xu Shiyan nodded, yes, it's really good.
Thanks to the fact that they thought of another way this time, otherwise, just pointing at the brochure might not attract many people.
Xu Shiyan and his wife dressed very stylishly, they looked either Hong Kong businessmen or overseas Chinese.
So they lingered at any booth to look at it, and they were very enthusiastic about introducing it to him.
Xu Shiyan listened patiently to other people's introduction. After the introduction, he nodded, smiled at him, turned around and walked to the next booth.
"Shiyan, what's the use of us talking about these things? I don't think you have any fixed goals, just wandering back and forth like this?"
While walking, Su Anying asked in a low voice, puzzled.
"These are all for the purpose of exporting and earning foreign exchange. Although the products are different from ours, the purpose is the same.
You have to know that the wisdom of the masses is infinite, and you may see some fresh ideas.
We are already here, so it doesn’t take much to take a look around, just take your time.
There are really good and suitable things, even if we don’t buy them now, we can leave his contact information and talk about them after the exhibition is over. "
Those who come to participate in the Spring Fair are mainly to earn foreign exchange through export.
Xu Shiyan is not a foreign businessman, and he doesn't have any foreign exchange in his hand, so try not to buy it at this time.
Take a good look at it and wait until the end of the exhibition to talk about it. It will definitely be cheaper than it is now.
Su Anying seems to understand but half understands, anyway, she will listen to what Xu Shiyan says.
So several people wandered around the exhibition hall like this.
The huge exhibition hall has fixed areas in each province and city. If you really want to go shopping here, you can really finish it in one day.
Xu Shiyan took people for a walk for half an afternoon, but he didn't meet anything he wanted.
But Xu Shiyan was still very interested, and it was a joy to turn around anyway.
"Oh, brother, you guys are really good at shopping. I've been wandering around for a long time, and I finally found you."
It was almost noon, and Guo Shouye finally found Xu Shiyan. This guy made him sweat.
"Brother, how are you doing? Has the talk been settled yet? Is there really no one sponsoring this year?"
When Xu Shiyan saw Guo Shouye, he hurriedly asked about the result.
"Cough, don't mention it, do you know why there is no sponsorship this year? There is a sponsorship fee of 200,000 here.
I asked just now, and when I heard that they wanted 200,000, I was scared back.
Tell me, it’s enough for us to provide water for free, but he also needs a sponsorship fee? "
As soon as the content of the previous discussion was mentioned, Guo Shouye felt angry.
How can there be such a thing? Even if they provide water for free, they have to pay? What's up? Backfired?
Isn’t that ridiculous? How can I explain to the leader this time, to participate in the spring fair, I have to pay for it first?
This is not to blame Guo Shouye, but the limitations of this era. Today's people don't understand these things at all.
If Xu Shiyan hadn't thought of the trick of providing water for free last year, Bingshan mineral water would not have had that sales volume.
Xu Shiyan's eyes widened immediately upon hearing this.
"This is a good thing, 200,000 is 200,000, let's place more orders, and a few 200,000 will come out."
What can two hundred thousand do? The TV station is more than this money for advertising, right?
If this can be named as the designated water for the Spring Fair, wouldn't it be more effective than advertising on TV?
"Go, go, I'll talk to them, don't say 200,000, we can do 500,000."
Xu Shiyan can't hold his breath now, he doesn't have the mind to go to the exhibition, so hurry up and find someone to discuss sponsorship.
"Ah? Isn't it? You really want to give them two hundred thousand? Is this possible? Don't let our money go to waste."
Guo Shouye didn't understand. This is sponsorship fee and water. How much money does it cost?
"Don't worry, custody will earn you several hundred thousand."
Xu Shiyan doesn't care about explaining at this time, the most important thing is to hurry up and finalize the sponsorship.
So, a group of people quickly left the venue, found the relevant departments of the organizing committee, and talked with them about sponsorship.
The person in charge of the organizing committee was the one from last year, but he recognized Xu Shiyan when they met, so he had a good attitude towards Xu Shiyan.
However, the organizing committee still insisted on the previous statement that sponsorship water is allowed, and a sponsorship fee of 200,000 yuan is required.
"Leader, the 200,000 sponsorship fee is no problem.
But can we sign a long-term contract, such as three or five years?
Every year at the Spring Fair and Autumn Fair, we are the only drinking water sponsor designated by the conference? "
Fools only sponsor one episode, and this, the longer the time, the more useful it will be.
It is best to sign for five years. If not for five years, you can sign for three years.
At that time, they can repackage and directly print, the only designated drinking water for the Canton Fair. Just this sentence is better than any advertisement.
The other party had obviously never met someone like Xu Shiyan before, so he was taken aback.
In fact, there is more than one mineral water factory in China. Since Tianquan became famous in the Holy Mountain, some factories have appeared one after another.
The operation of Bingshan Mineral Water at the Spring Fair last year can be inquired about by anyone who is interested, so this year someone really came to discuss it.
But when they heard that the organizing committee wanted a sponsorship fee of 200,000 yuan, they basically backed down.
Those mineral waters can’t keep up with Bingshan Mineral Water Factory.
At least Bingshan made money last year, but they haven't even made any money yet. Who would be willing to throw another 200,000 in it? So it didn't work out.
Last year, the way of providing free water was good, and the foreign guests were very satisfied. In fact, the organizing committee really wanted to find a company to cooperate with.
This sponsorship fee is also an attempt by the organizing committee, but unexpectedly, most people would not accept it.
Xu Shiyan came to talk at this moment, and he didn't think two hundred thousand was expensive, but he wanted to negotiate a long-term contract.
This was too unexpected. The organizing committee immediately asked someone to discuss it, and felt that such a long-term and stable cooperative relationship would be better.
Therefore, the organizing committee reached an agreement with Xu Shiyan that Bingshan Beverage Factory will provide 3,000 to 5,000 cases of mineral water for the spring fair and autumn fair every year, and pay 200,000 sponsorship fees every year.
Bingberg mineral water can be the only designated drinking water for the Canton Fair, which can be used in packaging and advertising.
The two parties signed a three-year contract. After the contract expires, Bingshan Mineral Water Factory also has the priority to renew the contract under the same conditions.
"Okay, then it's settled, I'll call back immediately and ask someone to arrange delivery.
However, it is estimated that the first phase may not be able to catch up. We will strive to provide free drinking water throughout the second and third phases.
While waiting for the Autumn Fair, we delivered the goods in advance. "After the contract was signed, Xu Shiyan shook hands with the other party.

chapters.title: Chapter 673: special treatment
chapters.content:
Chapter 673 Special Treatment
The two parties reached an agreement, and it happened that the museum was closed at noon, so everyone hurried to have a meal.
Then Guo Shouye called back and asked someone to remit 200,000 to the designated account immediately, and the factory also immediately loaded the car and shipped it.
The beverage factory has already prepared products for the Spring Fair, and will deliver the goods as soon as the order arrives.
After receiving a call from Guo Shouye, the factory immediately organized people to load and deliver the goods.
At the same time, Guo Shouye also called the city and the province, asking for the cooperation of relevant departments.
Send 3,000 pieces of mineral water to Yangcheng as quickly as possible.
Although the Bingshan Mineral Water Factory is not big, it earns a lot of foreign exchange through export. It can be regarded as a key foreign exchange earning enterprise in the city, and it is also well-known in the province.
Since the beverage factory is asking for help, and it is related to the export earnings of the Spring Fair, the city and the province are very cooperative.
Relevant departments immediately contacted the Shenyang Railway Bureau to open a separate train from Songjiang River to Shenyang.
Then send to the capital from Shenyang, and then transfer from the capital to Yangcheng. Be sure to be fast, and try to send it to Yangcheng before April 23rd.
At the same time, Guo Shouye also asked the factory to send a dozen people to come with the goods, bringing brochures and other things.
Guo Shouye went to contact the remittance and delivery, Xu Shiyan was not idle, and immediately went to find someone to make banners and other promotional materials.
Now, I don’t care about going to exhibitions anymore, let’s clear up the matter of drinking water sponsorship first.
After working for two days, I finally got the banners ready, and three days later, people from Bingshan Beverage Factory and the county arrived.
This time in the county, Chang Hongfa led the team.
"It still has to be you guys. If you are really capable, you can come and join in the fun in the second issue. Okay, you did a great job."
Chang Hongfa laughed when he saw Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye.
Fusong itself is an agricultural county, with underdeveloped industrial products, and most of them only point to the export of native products, so they have never participated in the second phase.
Even in the third period, it used to be followed by a participant.
Originally thought that Yishangchang became a municipal enterprise this year, and there were no major foreign exchange earners in the county. It would be ugly if the Spring Festival Fair was not going well.
So Li Jingyu didn't pay much attention, and decided a few days ago to let Chang Hongfa lead the team to participate.
Chang Hongfa is still worried, these factories in the county really have nothing to sell, this year's Spring Fair wants to be as brilliant as last year, it is probably too much.
It’s too bad to have to prepare, so I asked several ginseng companies, ginseng companies, and pharmaceutical factories to prepare products quickly, no matter what they have to come and try.
Where did I expect that before they packed up and were ready to go, Yangcheng made a phone call back.
Said that the Bingshan Beverage Factory was going to participate in the second spring fair, and asked the county to quickly arrange people to go there.
When Chang Hongfa heard it, he knew that this must be what Xu Shiyan and the others did.
So without further ado, he took Li Jingming and hurriedly joined the people from the beverage factory. Instead of going to the provincial capital, he went directly to Shenyang by car, and then drove to Yangcheng.
"Come on, who will tell me, what's going on? Why are you leaving the team this year and acting alone?"
Chang Hongfa felt strange, what is Xu Shiyan doing?
Xu Shiyan told them to come here early and discuss with the organizing committee about sponsoring water.
Chang Hongfa sounded stupid. In his mind, there was no such marketing method.
Spending 200,000 yuan on a designated water facility, can this thing work? You won't lose money, will you?
But the contract has been signed, and the money has been transferred to other people's accounts. What can I do now? Bite yourself and do it.
It happened that the people arrived at the front, and the goods also arrived at the back, so everyone was busy sending the water to the designated warehouse.
The conference specially arranged a booth for Bingshan Beverage Factory in a more conspicuous location, which was regarded as special treatment for sponsors.
This booth can be placed from the second phase to the end of the third phase. Not to mention anything else, the factory will take advantage of this alone.
So everyone arranged booths and hung promotional banners in conspicuous places of various exhibition venues, all kinds of busy work.
Finally finished the work, and the second spring fair also started.
The second phase of the Spring Fair, most of the exhibits are daily necessities, tableware and kitchen utensils, daily ceramics, craft ceramics, furniture products, various rattan crafts, clocks and glasses, etc.
April 23rd, as soon as the second phase of the exhibition opened, everyone felt that something was different.
Colorful banners were hung on both sides of the entrances of several venues.
There are several languages ​​on the banners, and some read "Bingshan Mineral Water, I wish the Spring Fair a complete success."
There are also some, which say "Bingshan mineral water, the only designated drinking water for the Spring Fair."
In addition to the banners, there are many boxes of mineral water piled up at the entrance of each venue.
There is a person with a work card, who enthusiastically distributes mineral water to the guests for free.
And introduced to others that this is the designated drinking water of the conference, from the virgin forest of Changbai Mountain, pure natural and pollution-free.
Not to mention, just this trick attracted many people, and many people actually went to the booth to inquire about the price and so on.
Of course, the second phase is not focused on food and beverages, and most of the foreign businessmen who come here are not here for this.
But there are many merchants, where is the traffic, and the booth location is particularly good.
Even if a small number of people are interested and go to inquire about ordering, that is a very large transaction volume.
Xu Shiyan didn't bother to go to the exhibition this time, as his own booth was too busy.
Some merchants not only want to order this kind of bottled mineral water, but also want to order bottled water.
Water dispensers have become popular in foreign countries, but they are still rare in China, and there are no domestic mineral water factories to produce this kind of bottled water.
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan knew that this was a new profit point, and immediately started an in-depth discussion with the other party.
The more we chat, the more I feel that this has a lot to do.
Like some developed countries, or areas where fresh water is scarce, drinking water dispensers with barreled drinking water does have a very broad prospect.
Of course, this requires follow-up discussions and cooperation.
Because the canyon spring of the Bingshan Beverage Factory does not gushes out that much, there is no way to supply bottled water in large quantities.
Although the gush of Canyon Spring is not enough, other springs are fine.
"County Chang, what happened to the factory in Quanyang?"
Xu Shiyan asked Chang Hongfa when there were few merchants and it was not too busy.
"How can we deal with it? Chen Jihui left a mess, no one took over, and the factory went bankrupt.
Workers who can be arranged elsewhere can be arranged elsewhere, and those who cannot be arranged can only go home and find employment again.
Bai blinded a good factory, just for this factory in our county, a lot of money was thrown in. "
Chang Hongfa sighed unceasingly, he is an old Fusong man, and grew up here.
Nowadays is not like later generations, it is a rotation system, after working for three to five years, they will be transferred away.
At this time, many cadres have served in their hometowns all their lives.
Chang Hongfa has worked his way up from the grassroots step by step to where he is now, and he really feels sorry for the county.
"County Chang, there is no outsider here, you have to be honest with me.
If I want to re-contract the Quanyang factory, what conditions can the county ask for? "
At this point, Xu Shiyan felt that Quanyang Factory could take over.
There is a brand-new production line over there, which can start production directly, and here is a soft order.
It would be a fool to push the opportunity out at this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 674: Take over Quanyang Factory
chapters.content:
Chapter 674 Takeover of Quanyang Factory
"Repay the conditions? If you can take over the Quanyang factory now, the county can't wait to give it to you with drums and gongs."
When Chang Hongfa heard this, he immediately stopped sorting out the orders and looked up at Xu Shiyan.
"Shiyan, we are not outsiders, you also tell me the truth, can you take over the factory?"
"Magistrate Chang, take it, I really mean that.
I didn’t pick it up before, mainly because Chen Jihui was tossing it a lot. It was a mess, and I didn’t have the energy to clean it up and continue to toss it.
But isn’t the bankruptcy and liquidation completed now? All the factory buildings and machinery belong to the county.
If the county offers a favorable condition, then I can take it. "
Xu Shiyan and Chang Hongfa did not see each other, and spoke directly from their hearts.
Quanyang Beverage Factory is a joint venture between the provincial beverage factory and the county, as well as the Quanyang area. Originally, the province took the majority.
As a result, the Quanyang factory went bankrupt because of a mistake in the provincial beverage factory, leaving the county in a mess.
The county has spent a lot of effort and put a lot of money into it. At least it has settled all the wages owed to the workers before, and settled down some workers.
So this factory was directly seized by the county, and the factory buildings and equipment were directly sealed up.
At the Provincial Beverage Factory, a lot of things have been found out, and they have already burned their eyebrows and can't take care of themselves. How can they care about the small factory on the other side of Quanyang? I can only pinch my nose and recognize it.
So, now this factory is owned by the county, but there is really no one in the county who has the ability to run the factory.
Li Jingyu's anxious mouth was bubbling, but how could he have that face this time, so why not go to Xu Shiyan again?
All I could do was worry, but there was nothing I could do.
"Shiyan, you just need to say that you want to take over this factory, and I will handle other things for you.
The county doesn’t want a penny from you, you can just take it to produce.
As long as you settle the remaining workers, everything else is fine. "
Chang Hongfa slapped his thigh excitedly and almost jumped up.
You know, the factory buildings and equipment are kept, although they don’t eat grass, they don’t earn a penny.
Moreover, those machines must be running, the more idle, the equipment will age and rust.
If this is idle for a few years, it will really become a pile of scrap iron.
"County Chang, what you said is very good, but don't change your mind on Secretary Li's side as soon as I agree."
Xu Shiyan smiled, and first sounded the alarm for Chang Hongfa.
Chang Hongfa this person, he really has the ability to work, otherwise it would be impossible to step from the grassroots to the current position.
But this person has a shortcoming. He is soft-tempered, too generous, and doesn't like to care about others.
So he is okay as a deputy, but he always feels a little less courageous when he is a full-time officer.
Not to mention anything else, Chang Hongfa is a native of the country, he can be said to have a large network of connections in the county, and he is supported by Guan Enxue.
