Ordinarily speaking, as far as Li Jingyu is so virtuous, Chang Hongfa wants to empty him, isn't that just like playing?
But Li Jingyu has been here for three years, and he keeps doing all kinds of stupid tricks all day long, and he hasn't seen Chang Hongfa doing anything.
Xu Shiyan really can't believe it, but Chang Hongfa has the final say.
"No, no, even if he wants to, the few people in our county can't agree.
You can rest assured about this matter, leave it to me, and take care of it for you. "
Chang Hongfa almost patted his chest to promise Xu Shiyan.
It should be said that Li Jingyu has been here for less than three years, and he has already made the county angry.
If he still messes up this time, the big guys can't let him go.
This is not Li Jingyu's words, how can they let Li Jingyu go his own way?
"Okay, then I will arrange for someone to discuss this matter, and it is best to resolve it as soon as possible."
Xu Shiyan is still in Yangcheng, this is only the second period, and the third period has not started yet, so we must not go back to talk.
So he planned to arrange Dai Chunrong and Han Limin to go to the county to talk about the factory in detail.
There must be some wrangling in this matter, let's talk about it first, and hold the county so that they don't have time to find another house.
After they participated in the Spring Fair and went back with the order, Li Jingyu had no choice but to agree.
In order to earn foreign exchange through export, no matter how bad the county suffers, it has to admit it.
Otherwise, Xu Shiyan will find other places to cooperate, and this order will not go to Fusong. See if they are in a hurry?
It just so happened that someone came over to ask about the price of mineral water and other matters, so the conversation between Xu Shiyan and Chang Hongfa ended here.
On the first day of the second phase of the Spring Fair, Bingshan Mineral Water has already received an order of 500,000 dollars, which made Guo Shouye so beautiful that he couldn't close his mouth.
It’s only been one day. You should know that they can participate in two exhibitions for 10 days, and the third exhibition will be the main venue for food and beverages. At that time, there will be more merchants.
"Brother, thanks to listening to you, we can take so many orders.
If this is done in ten days, how many millions of foreign exchange can we earn? "When Guo Shouye thought about the situation, he felt very excited.
"But there is one thing. The gushing volume of our canyon spring is fixed. If we receive too many orders, what should we do if we can't supply the goods later?"
After being happy, Guo Shouye became worried again.
Right now, there are quite a lot of orders. If the supply is not timely, they will have to pay for it.
"Brother, don't worry, I have already told Lao Chang that we plan to take over the factory in Quanyang.
Everything is ready-made at the other end. As long as the two sides have reached an agreement, production can start immediately.
The water quality of Quanyang is better than that of our Canyon Spring, and the gushing volume is huge. What are you afraid of? "Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this.
"Besides, there is my classmate.
Shao Yong has called several times and wants to cooperate with us, including the whole mineral water factory.
There is also very good spring water over there. If there is a problem with Quanyang, let’s go to Jingyu. "
Xu Shiyan had already planned in his heart, so he comforted Guo Shouye with a smile.
"Well, as long as you know what's in your mind, then I won't say anything. No matter which side you choose, we will work together as a partner."
Although Bingshan Beverage Factory is a subsidiary of the Forestry Bureau, Guo Shouye has the final say and he has the right to call the shots.
At that time, no matter who wants to get involved, the right to speak must be in the hands of Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye.
The first day of the Spring Fair ended, everyone was a little tired and excited.
Guo Shouye had to call back to report the result to the bureau leader.
Xu Shiyan also immediately contacted Dai Chunrong and Han Limin and asked them to go to the county to discuss matters related to the Quanyang factory.
Just let them talk slowly, don't rush to agree to the conditions, you can call and discuss with Xu Shiyan if you have something to do.
Dai Chunrong had long been envious of looking at Quanyang Factory, and now he became happy, and assured Xu Shiyan that they would have a good talk.
Needless to say, Chang Hongfa must call Li Jingyu.
Tell Li Jingyu that it was because of his great effort, begging Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye that the two factories planned to join forces and take over the Quanyang factory.
When Li Jingyu heard this, he was very happy, and quickly said that he would let Chang Hongfa feel at ease.
The county must give enough preferential policies to ensure that the Quanyang factory can be successfully handed over and started.

chapters.title: Chapter 675: Windfall
chapters.content:
Chapter 675 Windfall
On the second day of the Spring Fair, many people still came to the booth of Bingshan Beverage Factory to inquire, and the transaction was about 300,000 US dollars a day.
Guo Shouye was happy and smiled from morning to night, and Chang Hongfa was also very happy.
Only Bingshan Beverage Factory can earn hundreds of thousands of foreign exchange every day, which is already very good. Anyway, the task given by the province has been completed.
Wait for the third issue, don't care how much it sells, at least you won't have your head shaved, that's good.
Xu Shiyan stayed here for three days, and taught everything that should be taught.
On the fourth day, Xu Shiyan simply led Su Anying to wander around the exhibition halls.
This issue has home decoration and so on. There are not many concepts in this area in China these days, and there are few related products.
However, Xu Shiyan still saw some ceramic products, tiles, toilets and other products.
What interests him the most are several solid wood floor factories.
Wooden floors have actually existed for a long time.
Like some exquisite houses in the northeast forest area, they will use red pine boards, cut them into uniform specifications, splice them on the ground with nails, and then paint the whole with red paint.
When the floor is new, it is really beautiful, smooth and shiny, with bright colors. Most people have to take off their shoes when entering the door, and it is also carefully maintained in normal days.
In recent years, specialized wooden floor factories have appeared in many areas to produce pure wooden floors for urban decoration.
Places like Dunhua in Kyrgyzstan Province and Fushun in Liao Province have experienced solid wood parquet flooring for a while.
Most of them are sold as floors made of surplus wood processed by forest farms and simply spliced ​​with glue.
This kind of floor is not very high in terms of technology and quality, and the market feedback is also average.
So in the past two years, the solid wood floor factory has begun to march southwest.
What Southwest birch, beech, and teak flooring began to appear, and the small size flooring gradually decreased, and the medium and long size flooring gradually increased.
Xu Shiyan looked through it with his hands. The current floor has less flat joints and more grooves.
Of course, at present, the unpainted plain board is more popular to show the texture of the wood itself.
However, there are too many restrictions on the boards of this kind of floor. To be able to make pure solid wood flooring, it must be a good wood that is one in a hundred.
Because of the texture of the wood itself, this kind of pure solid wood floor is easy to warp and deform after being damp.
Not as good as that kind of solid wood composite flooring, which is strong and durable.
Xu Shiyan turned around twice, but didn't see any solid wood composite floor, so he stepped forward to chat with him.
"Hello, I want to ask, how do you sell this floor, how much is it per level?
Is there only this kind of single-piece solid wood floor now? Are there any other types? "
Xu Shiyan is well dressed, people think he is some kind of Hong Kong businessman or overseas Chinese.
When he was looking through the brochures and floor samples just now, the attitude of the other party was very good.
Keep telling him how good this floor is, pure solid wood floor, durable, no deformation, warping, absolutely guaranteed quality, etc.
As a result, when Xu Shiyan spoke, Mandarin with a Northeast accent came out, and when he heard it, his face immediately changed.
"Cut, I thought it was a Hong Kong businessman or an overseas Chinese. I kept looking through it just now, and I was arguing for a long time. It's not a waste of my time."
"You say you are from China, why come here to join in the fun?
These are all exported items, they are expensive, can you afford them? "
The other party glanced at Xu Shiyan and Su Anying, looking unhappy.
"You? How can you talk like that? Co-authoring a foreign company is superior to others, but your compatriots will be looked down upon instead?
What's the point? " Su Anying was very angry, glared at the man, and asked.
"Why don't foreign businessmen just be superior to others? They have foreign exchange and can buy things, can you?"
Can you afford it? Don't know your identity day by day, and still imitate how foreign businessmen dress up?
Open your mouth and talk like a scumbag, what are you pretending? "
As long as they are not facing foreign businessmen, these people are not afraid at all, looking at Su Anying sarcastically.
Su Anying was about to speak back to fight back, but Xu Shiyan held his hand.
"Don't be familiar with such a person, there is no need for that.
We just came here to take a look around, don't have any conflicts with others. "
This is an exhibition, not a street vegetable market, so there is no need to argue with them.
Su Anying was still indignant, but Xu Shiyan was in a good mood, so he pulled Su Anying and walked to the booth next to him.
This is an area of ​​a certain province in the southwest, and the two adjacent booths should be the neighboring counties.
The quarrel between Su Anying and the other side just now was noticed by this side, but they didn't say anything.
Seeing Xu Shiyan and Su Anying coming over, the other party didn't say they were impatient.
"Comrade, do you want to buy flooring, or just ask casually?
I have no other intentions. If you just inquire about things casually, there is no need to be here.
Waiting for the exhibition to end, let's find a place to chat. "He was very polite and handed Xu Shiyan a business card.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he saw it, and also took out a business card, and handed it to the other party.
"It's really just to inquire, mainly because I am very interested in this."
The other party took the business card and looked at it, "Hey, you are from Jilin Province, the general manager of Shenye Company.
You produce ginseng over there, really good. We produce Panax notoginseng here, which is also a good medicinal material.
If you have a chance in the future, you can have a good exchange. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at the other party's business card just now, he is a member of the Commercial Bureau of a certain county in Yunnan Province.
"This is really possible. Our company not only deals in ginseng and other local products, but also has a pharmaceutical factory.
In the medicines currently produced, a large amount of Panax notoginseng is needed. "
Xu Shiyan smiled at the other party. He didn't expect that a casual stroll would be really rewarding.
The Panax notoginseng and rhodiola that the pharmaceutical factory purchased before were all through organizational help.
In the future, the demand for pharmaceutical factories will increase, and it is not good to always trouble the organization. It is best to supply directly from the place of production.
"Well, I'll write you an address, and when the exhibition is over, I'll invite you to have a drink.
Let's have a good chat, maybe there is a chance for cooperation. "
Xu Shiyan has a good impression of this person, and the pharmaceutical factory also really needs some medicinal materials from the southwest, such as Rhodiola, Panax notoginseng, Dendrobium, etc., and there will be a lot of demand in the future.
Wouldn’t it be great if we could find a suitable supplier and have a win-win cooperation?
"Okay, okay, I'll go find you when the exhibition ends today."
The other party was very happy, and quickly accepted the address, and at the same time wrote a copy of the address to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan chatted with him for a few more words before turning around and leaving.
As soon as the couple left, the person next to the booth, the one who satirized Xu Shiyan just now, glanced this way.
"Hey, let me tell you, some people are just idle. Why do you talk to that kind of person? Can he buy your things with foreign exchange?
Don’t do serious things, and I don’t know why you are here?
Look at how many goods you have ordered in the past few days? I don't know that I'm in a panic, and I'm still chatting with people there. "
The people here were not annoyed, they glanced at each other with a smile.
"Well, you didn't chat with anyone, so how much did you sell?"

chapters.title: Chapter 676: It's important to buy a house
chapters.content:
Chapter 676 Buying a house is important
"Shi Yan, why are you asking about other people's floors?
If our family wants to lay the floor, we can just ask Brother Guo for some. Do we still need to buy it? "
Leaving there, Su Anying asked in puzzlement.
"It's not for laying the floor for our house. I want to inquire about the flooring market. In the future, I want to develop in this area."
Xu Shiyan smiled and explained to his wife.
“Eggs cannot be put in one basket, and all our money cannot be invested in the ginseng industry.
Then tell me, besides ginseng and medicinal materials, what resources do we have more? Isn't it wood?
I'm thinking about cooperating with the Forestry Bureau to set up a factory or something, and we will also do our wood finishing.
Regarding the ginseng market, no one dares to say what the future will look like, and there will definitely be more and more mineral water plants.
Business is getting more and more difficult, can't just point at the pharmaceutical factory? Still have to think about something. "
According to the law of development in the previous life, this autumn, Fusong ginseng has been on the market in large quantities.
The provincial medicinal materials company no longer executes the purchase contract, and can only be sold by the local government department.
How capable is Kefusong? How much can you sell? This has caused a large backlog of ginseng in the place of origin.
In the next few years, due to the impact of the international situation, foreign merchants desperately lowered the price, so that the price of ginseng continued to drop.
In this life, there is a ginseng market that drives the fine processing of the ginseng industry, and Donggang ginseng market, plus the success of the ginseng festival last year.
In Xu Shiyan's mind, as long as there are no major policy issues this year, even if the provincial medicinal materials company is not executing the purchase contract, it may not be able to backlog too much.
But what will happen next, I dare not say.
After all, the power of individuals is still too small to completely reverse the situation.
Once the price of ginseng falls to the bottom, I am afraid that related products will also be affected. It is estimated that the price will be reduced, and the sales volume may not be very good.
If this is the case, you must make other plans.
If the east side is not bright and the west side is bright, you must find a profitable business to resist for a while, right?
Su Anying is not reborn, how does she know the future direction?
So it's good that she can understand part of Xu Shiyan's words.
"You mean, how will the market for ginseng be?
Well, there is also this possibility. In the past few years, the county has vigorously advocated the development of the ginseng industry, and all localities have desperately planted sticks regardless of whether they have the conditions.
If the excess production cannot be sold, I really dare not say anything. "
I have to say that Su Anying has indeed grown up through experience in the past few years.
I dare not say anything else, but the ginseng industry has indeed made great progress.
"If this is the case, it is really necessary to set up a store and open a store here.
No matter what, it is good to have one more sales channel. "
Su Anying finally understood what Xu Shiyan meant this time.
They have their own stores and sales channels, and they cannot control others, but the company must have a way to sell them.
"Well, I won't accompany you to the exhibition tomorrow. I have to find a place to go. This matter can't be delayed. It's best to settle it early."
Su Anying is in a hurry, this is the most important thing.
She doesn't know anything about the exhibition, and she can't help much. It's a waste of time to stay here.
"Okay, you can arrange it as you like." Xu Shiyan smiled.
His daughter-in-law is in a hurry right now, no matter what happens, she has to get it done right away before she can feel at ease.
Just like that, on the second day, Su Anying did not accompany Xu Shiyan to the exhibition, but wandered around the city to find out where there were houses or land for sale.
Su Anying is a foreigner. Even though she lived here for a while last year, she still doesn't know enough about this place. It is not easy to find a house.
Traveling around for two days without finding anything, in the end, I had no choice but to go to Feng'an Hotel and ask the hotel proprietress to ask her for help.
If you can buy it, there will definitely be benefits.
Not to mention, this trick worked, and the proprietress immediately agreed, saying that she would help find it.
Su Anying's side is busy buying houses and land, and Xu Shiyan's side, the last day of the second phase of the Spring Fair, is finally over.
Bingshan Beverage Factory earned nearly 2 million foreign exchange in five days, hundreds of thousands more than last year.
This is a US dollar, and now a US dollar can be exchanged for RMB 3.70, which is quite a lot of money.
And in the third period, they can still participate for five days, and when the autumn fair, they can also arrange people to come to participate.
In such a calculation, 200,000 yuan is simply a bargain.
"Brother, thanks to you this time, we made money again this time.
Fortunately, we signed a three-year contract all at once, otherwise someone would definitely come to grab this sponsorship next year. "
This is for sure. Bingshan Beverage Factory has played such a trick this year, but anyone who is interested can find out.
The profit generated by the 200,000 sponsorship fee is many times more than that. Who knows and is not tempted?
At that time, there will definitely be many occasions to discuss sponsorship.
Without this contract, the sponsorship quota for next year will definitely be taken away.
But with this contract bound, it is difficult for the organizing committee to change their minds. If others want to grab it, they have to wait until the three-year contract expires.
With these three years, Xu Shiyan is confident that he will make Bingshan mineral water and Bingshan drink bigger, and he will not be afraid of being robbed by someone.
The museum will be closed in the afternoon on the 28th, and on the 29th, all exhibitors will come and remove their products.
On the 30th, the county ginseng company, medicinal material company, and several participants all arrived in Yangcheng.
On the 31st, Xu Shiyan took people to the train station to transport this year's products to the exhibition hall, and then began to arrange the booth.
Nowadays, the company has more and more products, and one booth is full.
Thanks to the special approval of the province, they were given a separate booth. If it was with the county or city, the products brought by Xu Shiyan and the others would not be able to be displayed.
In addition to arranging the booth, Xu Shiyan also asked people to go to the mall, bought a TV and a video recorder, and put them on the booth.
"Mr. Xu, what are you doing here? We are agricultural by-products and health care products. What do you mean by putting a TV on it?"
Over there, Wang Xicheng from the county ginseng antler company felt strange seeing Xu Shiyan get a TV here.
What kind of trouble is going to happen here?
Chang Hongfa and Li Jingming were also puzzled, but they didn't ask any questions.
The experience of the past few years told them that if Xu Shiyan did something different, it must have some deep meaning.
Don’t inquire, even if you inquire, they may not tell you, just wait and see the result.
Sure enough, Xu Shiyan raised his head and only glanced at Wang Xicheng.
"It's okay, I just feel that there is nothing interesting in this museum. The whole TV is here to show the merchants something to watch."
Xu Shiyan didn't reveal what to look for specifically, this is their secret weapon, how can they tell outside in advance, let's wait and see tomorrow.
Wang Xicheng used to be the secretary of the Second Candidate, and had some intersections with Xu Shiyan.
The construction of the second entrant is later than that of the first entrant, and it is not as solid as the first entrant, and the annual profits and taxes paid are much worse than that of the first entrant.
Although on the surface, the participants seem to be quite harmonious, in fact they are competing secretly.
The second participant tried his best to catch up with the first participant, but who knew that the first participant poached Xu Shiyan, and since then, the second participant has been left behind.
Wang Xicheng saw that there was really no progress in the second entrant. He originally wanted to be transferred to the first entrant, but his superiors disagreed and sent him to the Specialty Bureau.
Wang Xicheng wanted to go to Yishang but failed, but Yishang became a municipal enterprise, and Xu Shiyan became the general manager of the company, at the top level.
Wang Xicheng felt very uncomfortable in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 677: promotional video
chapters.content:
Chapter 677 Promotional Video
On May 1st, the third phase of the Spring Fair officially started.
Xu Shiyan and others have come to participate several times in a row, and they are no longer as flustered as they were the first time.
Everyone was calm and smiling, waiting for foreign businessmen to enter the venue.
After the opening of the exhibition hall, foreign businessmen entered the exhibition hall one after another, accompanied by the staff, and began to wander around the exhibition hall.
Xu Shiyan looked at the time, and asked someone to turn on the TV, put a pre-prepared video tape into the video recorder, and start playing.
It was a promotional film with the theme of Changbai Mountain ecology.
It was a promotional film that was filmed by a person from the city's TV station after nearly a year.
In the promotional video, Changbai Mountain changes throughout the year, animals thrive, the time changes in the forest, flowers bloom and leaves fall, and springs and streams flow clear.
Every picture is extremely beautiful, coupled with the commentary of the announcer's voice.
The filming of this promotional film is no worse than the documentaries of provincial and central channels.
"Fuck, this is too bad, isn't it? Others make a brochure, and you make a promotional video. Okay, you are awesome."
Chang Hongfa saw it over there, and was so shocked that he swears directly. The others were also dumbfounded, can they still play like this?
Xu Shiyan smiled and said nothing.
This is because there are no big screens in the venue now. If there were, he would have to reserve a period of time to show the promotional video.
This is the best way of publicity, allowing more people to understand the geographical features, ecological nature, and cultural relics of Changbai Mountain.
While talking, I saw the staff over there accompanying a group of foreign businessmen coming over.
Everyone couldn't care less about chatting anymore, and they all cheered up and prepared to receive foreign businessmen.
Xu Shiyan's trick really worked.
When those foreign businessmen passed by the booths of participating companies, their eyes were immediately attracted by the pictures on TV.
Many people stopped in front of the booth, concentrating on admiring the beautiful picture.
Especially the naive little black bear, the cute roe deer, the rare and protected animal merganser, the snow elf sable and other animals are particularly eye-catching.
Under the lens of the photographer, these animals are having fun on the snow and jumping on the branches, perfectly interpreting the harmony between life and nature.
Among the ice and snow, the spring water still flows slowly, crystal clear, flowing in the most moving rhythm in the valley.
In early spring, the ice flowers that bloom in the snow are proud of the snow and frost, independent in the wind.
In the early morning of summer, the dewdrops in the forest are crystal clear, reflecting colorful light against the sunlight.
In the mountains and forests in autumn, the maple leaves are dyed red by frost and dew, and the thick ink and colorful colors are more beautiful than oil paintings.
In the ginseng field, the blossoming red ginseng seeds are as bright as rubies.
The newly unearthed ginseng is like a fat little doll.
The girls and daughters-in-law who scrubbed the ginseng had happy and satisfied smiles on their faces.
At the Ginseng Festival, people danced happily with red silk in their hands, expressing their love for a better life.
Many people couldn't help exclaiming, and hurriedly asked the people in the booth where this is and what is so beautiful.
The accompanying interpreter asked the people in the booth, Xu Shiyan introduced to them with a smile on his face, and Li Chengrong gave the translation simultaneously.
With the promotional video and Xu Shiyan's introduction, many people yearned for Changbai Mountain.
At the same time, he also developed a strong interest in various specialties from Changbai Mountain.
Many people began to inquire about the functions, functions, and prices of various products on the booth.
Xu Shiyan and others began to get busy, introducing the features of the product in detail.
The promotional video attracted too many people, the booth was surrounded by crowds, and more and more people gathered.
The venue staff saw this and hurried over to maintain order and evacuate the crowd.
But those foreigners refused to leave at all, and still stretched their necks to look in front of the booth. The staff could only persuade them to go to a nearby booth and come back later.
In this way, some peripheral people temporarily shifted their targets and went to the adjacent booth to inquire about products.
"I don't agree with anything else, so I agree with the president's ability.
Their booth attracts a lot of people every year, and even if we are nearby, we can also follow. "
Li Jingming stood behind the booth in the county, while stamping, talking to Wang Xicheng and others.
"Just for a while, we followed suit and took several orders.
I looked over there, Lin Qiyue and Mayor Guan didn't care about anything, they just stamped their seals. There is also the county magistrate, who probably has a lot of orders. "
Dongfang Ginseng Company is now a municipal enterprise, or a key provincial export-earning enterprise, so the treatment is naturally different.
Guan Enxue and Lin Qiyue came here in person to sign and seal the letter of intent or order.
Anyway, at this moment, Guan Enxue's arms, which had already been sealed, were sore, and the corners of his mouth were almost grinning to the base of his ears.
Perfectly interprets what is pain and happiness.
On the other side, the Bingshan Beverage Factory, which was supported by promotional banners and booths, also had a steady stream of orders this morning.
Chang Hongfa is in charge of signing and stamping here, and it is also beautiful, his smiling face is stiff.
On the first day of the third phase of the Spring Fair, participating companies earned more than 8 million foreign exchange, and Bingshan Beverage also earned nearly one million foreign exchange.
The ginseng antler company and several ginseng farms in the county probably have more than 100,000 orders.
Overall, it’s pretty good.
On the second day, the booth of the participating company still attracted many foreign businessmen, and everyone was fascinated by this promotional video.
While watching the promotional video, it is imperative to order some products.
Some merchants also asked Xu Shiyan if they could give them a copy of this promotional video, so that they could take it home and play it in the store.
"Hello, sir, I need to report this to the relevant department, because this involves copyright issues."
Xu Shiyan did not directly agree.
The company paid for this promotional film, and invited the camera crew of the city's TV station to shoot it. It stands to reason that he has the right to decide.
But this promotional video has not been broadcast in the city yet. Now that the promotional video is shining brightly at the Spring Festival Fair, it is estimated that the provincial TV station can ask for it.
So Xu Shiyan can't agree directly, he has to ask the leader first to see if the leader agrees.
"Don't worry, sir, I will try my best to coordinate."
This should not be difficult, after all, this is the best way to publicize Changbai Mountain to the outside world, and the leaders will agree if they think about it.
"If our leader agrees, I will copy the video tape of the promotional film and send it to you along with the goods.
You are also very welcome. In your spare time, come to our Changbai Mountain for a tour and experience the scenery of Changbai Mountain for yourself.
I believe it will make you feel worthwhile. "
Xu Shiyan explained to the other party very politely, and at the same time invited him to travel.
The other party was very satisfied, and happily placed a large order, and even left Xu Shiyan a personal contact information.
And said that if he had the opportunity, he would definitely take his family to Changbai Mountain for vacation, hoping to meet Xu Shiyan again at that time.
Xu Shiyan quickly accepted his business card, and at the same time gave him his own.
Tell others that international friends are welcome to come to Changbai Mountain for tourism, investment and trade at any time.

chapters.title: Chapter 678: Add another property
chapters.content:
Chapter 678 adds another property
A promotional video can achieve hundreds of times better than ordinary brochures, and many people are very interested in this method.
When foreign businessmen are interested, they will increase their purchase intentions, and the orders of participating companies will increase sharply.
Even the booths in several surrounding counties had more sales than in previous years.
Everyone was so happy that they could not close their mouths from ear to ear. Many people shouted that they would buy Xu Shiyan a drink in the evening.
Those who follow the glory are naturally happy, but there are so many participating counties and cities in the exhibition hall, and those who are not shining are even more.
They watched so many foreign businessmen being attracted away, and saw the people surrounded by three floors inside and three floors outside the participation company, and they were very envious.
Some people are thinking too much, so they quickly arrange for someone to come over to see and learn from it.
But there are also some people who have a dark mind and simply report to the organizing committee.
It is said that someone used improper means to attract foreign businessmen, and this behavior should be stopped immediately.
The organizing committee didn't respond at all. They just provided a platform. As for how exhibitors attract customers' attention, this is beyond their jurisdiction.
As long as there are no fights and troubles, no disputes, normal business behavior and publicity methods, the organizing committee will not take care of them.
In this way, under the attention of everyone, Dongfang Ginseng Company earned more than 20 million US dollars in this Spring Fair.
All kinds of ginseng products, health care products, and medicines have received more orders than in previous years.
Ginseng coffee, ginseng snow clam honey, orders are several times that of last year.
There are also many orders for new products this year.
It can be said that this time at the Spring Fair, Xu Shiyan has created a record that no one else can match.
Bingshan mineral water factory also performed well, earning nearly 6 million foreign exchange, of which mineral water accounted for more than two-thirds.
Blueberry juice, indigo juice, and ice grape juice account for less than one-third of the total. Overall, they are quite good.
"Shiyan, the provincial leaders called to praise your company, especially you.
The leader also asked, if you have any requirements or conditions, you can mention them as much as possible. "
Guan Enxue conveyed the meaning of the superior to Xu Shiyan with a happy face.
"Well, leader, can you respond to the above, and don't hold the celebration party or anything.
Let's not say that it is a waste of time and money, but it is really too much trouble.
It’s okay to say, someone will pick you up when you get off the bus, and you can go back to the hotel directly.
Then you said that those who pick up the station, especially those elementary school students, have to wait outside all the time, how difficult is it?
Respond to the leader, and cancel all these bells and whistles. "
It's not that Xu Shiyan lost his grades because of a little grade, it's really that he feels so sorry for the children who went to greet him.
Trains these days are often late. The longer the distance, the easier it is to be late. Sometimes it’s as little as half an hour late.
Although the weather is not too cold or hot in May, it is really a lot of trouble to let a group of children wait outside for a whole afternoon.
"Huh? Are you kidding? This is an honor that others can't ask for."
Guan Enxue was taken aback. He had never heard of such a request. If it were someone else, he would wish that it would be more grand and lively.
"I'm not joking, to be honest. If the leader has the heart, just give a certificate or something.
It is true that we cannot afford to delay.
For such a large order, I have to go back and sort it out quickly to see how to arrange the delivery, as well as the production this autumn, all have to be arranged in advance.
Another one, the factory in Quanyang, I want to follow up here.
Lao Dai and Limin at home are talking with the county, I have to go back and make a decision, and make a quick decision to clean up the factory for production. "
Xu Shiyan explained to Guan Enxue helplessly that it wasn't that he was a little proud of his achievements, but that he was too busy.
With the time to celebrate all the way, he can go back and start the factory to start production. Don’t you know which one is important?
Guan Enxue listened and nodded. "Success, I will report this to the leader.
Xiao Xu is a good comrade, he only cares about his work and does not want to make a name for himself.
This time, regardless of whether the province will give you any rewards, the city will definitely not lose you. "
Nonsense, earning 20 million foreign exchange, how much foreign exchange could the entire Erji Province earn in the past? For such a great contribution, can it be done without rewards?
"Then thank you leader."
Xu Shiyan was not too polite, and he continued with peace of mind when the reward was given by the superior. He didn't complain if the higher-ups didn't give it.
The Spring Fair was a complete success, and everyone went to remove the booth the next day.
After that, go shopping if you should go shopping, and pack up your things if you don’t go shopping, and prepare to go back.
Xu Shiyan is not in the mood to go shopping. He has to go and book a house with his wife.
After Su Anying's hard work in the past few days, with the help of the proprietress of Feng'an Hotel, Su Anying took a fancy to a place on Feng'an Street.
Feng'an Street is located in the southwest of the city hall, on the west side of the northern end of Industrial Avenue, from Fengning Street in the north, to Haiwai Side Street in the southwest, so it got its name because it is in the southwest of Feng'an Bridge.
There are steel rolling mills and Mingxing Pharmaceutical Factory in the area, and most of the rest are low-rise buildings with brick and wood structure.
One of Su Anying's fancy is a two-story brick and wood building, which occupies a large area and has a yard.
The house is a bit old, but the location is good. The other party asked for 55,000.
Nowadays, the price of commercial housing in Yangcheng is only six to seven hundred and one square meters. Such an old house costs 55,000, which is not low.
Su Anying talked to the other party several times, but she didn't talk about it.
"I think it's too expensive, much more expensive than our house price.
The house that the fourth sister and the others bought cost only about 6,000 yuan at the time, and they cleaned it up later, and it cost less than 10,000 yuan.
The shop we bought in the capital cost only 40,000 yuan, which is not that expensive. He's still not as big as the one in the capital. "
Su Anying led Xu Shiyan, muttering as he walked.
"Daughter-in-law, you have to know that we bought the house in the capital earlier.
Are you going to try again this year? I guess those two shops are now doubling like a joke.
Yangcheng is at the forefront of opening up. You can see how fast this area is developing now. It costs 50,000 to buy it now. I don’t know how many times it will be doubled in a few years. It’s not a loss if you buy it. "
How expensive is 50,000 yuan? According to Xu Shiyan's wishes, he wants as much as the house at this price.
If they sold dozens of places, what kind of business would the couple still be doing? In the future, more than a dozen buildings will be demolished, and the rent will not be enough to spend.
Su Anying couldn't say no to Xu Shiyan, so she had to lead him to find the landlord.
The owner of the house was not in a hurry to sell it, and Su Anying came here several times, but they just refused to lower the price.
Finally, the proprietress of Feng'an Hotel came over and sold her to save face. It was 3,000 yuan cheaper, and the deal was 52,000 yuan.
Su Anying thinks it is still expensive, but Xu Shiyan thinks it is okay.
This place is not too small, there are four or five houses facing the street, and it is a two-story building with a yard in front.
In a place like Yangcheng, it’s not a loss if you buy it at this price.
Xu Shiyan thinks it's okay, but Su Anying naturally can't say anything else.
So Xu Shiyan and the other party went to the street and the real estate management department to verify the condition of the house.
Make sure that the house belongs to the current owner, and there are no other disputes, so you can rest assured.
Afterwards, the homeowner invited people from the neighbors to testify, and wrote a house purchase contract with Xu Shiyan, and Xu Shiyan directly gave the other party all the money for the house.
The two parties went through the transfer procedures, and the house was officially bought by Xu Shiyan and his wife.
As for homeowners, they can wait for a while to vacate the house.

chapters.title: Chapter 679: As expected
chapters.content:
Chapter 679 As expected
The house was successfully bought and completed the formalities, which was delayed for several days.
Where do the husband and wife still want to stay here? He quickly packed up his things and headed back.
Fortunately, the leader has listened to Xu Shiyan's opinion, so there will be no welcome ceremony this year.
Just made a simple report in newspapers and news. In addition, the province rewarded Xu Shiyan with a car.
Xu Shiyan didn't have time to receive any rewards. He and Su Anying flew to Shenyang, and then took the train from Shenyang to Songjianghe.
Even so, by the time they got home, it would already be May 11th.
Xu Shiyan couldn't go home after getting off the train, so he got on the pick-up car and went straight to work.
"Lao Li is back? It's just right, call the manpower, let's quickly check all the orders.
Look at how many can be shipped at present, and then calculate, what is the shortfall of our fresh ginseng this fall.
Is it necessary to order some fresh ginseng from other venues. "
Just for this season’s spring fair, there are more than 20 million US dollars in orders, plus orders from old customers, reserved by pharmaceutical factories and other places.
This year, 40,000 feet of participants participated in the field to make goods. I don’t know if they can use it.
"Old Dai, tell me quickly, how is the negotiation with the county going? Are there any conditions in the county?"
Before in Yangcheng, Dai Chunrong and Han Limin called Xu Shiyan every day to report the situation.
Xu Shiyan has been walking back for the past few days, and he can't answer the phone anymore. He doesn't know the result of the specific talk, so I have to ask.
"General manager, it really is as you expected.
As soon as we said we wanted to move to Quanyang's factory, Secretary Li put forward conditions.
Said that we will not charge us money at the moment, but starting next year, it will be paid to the county for a contract fee of one million yuan every year, and the time limit is five years.
Besides, we must accept all the workers in the original factory, and the treatment is the same as ours. "
Dai Chunrong took out his notebook and recounted the content of the negotiation between the two parties to Xu Shiyan.
"We talked with them these days, and they finally gave in, half a million per year, for a five-year period.
But I think it is still high.
And it’s not cost-effective at all. We are contracted, and the factory, water source, land, etc. are still owned by the county.
We are equivalent to renting a place to work, which is boring. "
Dai Chunrong pouted, those people are catching fat sheep and want to take a bite.
"Not only that, I guess the county is still not giving up, and it's wishful thinking.
They intend to let us operate the factory for five years, and when we operate the factory, they can take it back when the five years are up.
With the foundation we laid, they can get a golden mountain without much effort. "
On the other end, Han Limin couldn't help snorting coldly. This is treating them as fools and coaxing them to play.
"Let me just say, Lao Chang can't figure out who's surnamed Li."
Xu Shiyan was not surprised by this, he had already guessed the result.
"I'll take care of this. I'll call the mayor first."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, and asked Dai Chunrong and Han Limin to assist Li Bingzhuo and the others to collect all the orders first.
Calculate the consumption of various raw materials, and then take stock of the current inventory.
How much is the gap, make up for it as soon as possible, so as not to delay production.
Here, Xu Shiyan grabbed the phone and called Guan Enxue directly.
"Leader, I beg you for something.
I want to take over the factory in Quanyang, but the county’s requirements are too high and I can’t afford it.
I want to set up a venue with Jingyu, what kind of support can the city provide? "
Guan Enxue was blown away when he heard it, "What the hell? Li Jingyu has another moth?
All right, you don't need to take care of this matter, I will handle it for you. "
Guan Enxue went to the Spring Fair with him. He went back earlier than Xu Shiyan, but the train was slow and couldn't catch up with the plane, so he just came back.
He didn't know much about the situation at home, and he thought that, as Chang Hongfa said, the county would hand over the factory to Xu Shiyan and the others.
Unexpectedly, Li Jingyu made a moth in the middle again, Guan En is so angry.
So he directly hung up the phone here, then called Li Jingyu, and gave Li Jingyu a good training.
"Do you know how many foreign exchange orders Bingshan Beverage Factory has received this year?
Now it is Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye who plan to join forces to take over the Quanyang factory and divide the order.
You hand over the factory to them as soon as possible, and the factory will still belong to your county. At that time, whether it is foreign exchange earnings or profits and taxes, it will still belong to your county.
If you think these are not important, well, I will contact Jingyu immediately, he wants to build a factory there, you can figure it out. "
Annoyed Guan Enxue finished speaking, he didn't listen to the explanation on the other end of the phone at all, and hung up the phone directly.
Li Jingyu was dumbfounded. The conditions he proposed were just to win more for the county. After all, the county had paid a lot for the Quanyang factory.
That factory is worth three to four million yuan including the land and plant equipment.
Now it costs 500,000 a year, how much? Not much.
This is not enough, is it really necessary to give it for nothing?
"Old Chang, what do you think about this matter? Our county has paid so much money, do you really want to give it to them for nothing?"
Li Jingyu had no choice but to discuss with Chang Hongfa.
"I don't know what to do about this matter. I was in Yangcheng, and I made a promise with Mr. Xu, saying that the county would definitely give the biggest discount.
Finally, when I came back, I heard that your abacus is better than anyone else, what else do you want me to say?
I don't have that face, I'll talk to Mr. Xu again, whoever has the ability should do it. "
Chang Hong spread his hands, expressing that there was nothing he could do to help in this matter.
"Don't, Lao Chang, you still need to come forward in this matter.
You go talk to Mr. Xu, the condition is up to him, and we will fully cooperate here, is this the head office? "
Li Jingyu really has his claws this time. If he really goes to Jingyu to build a factory, Quanyang will really be finished.
The county smashed those things, and you can't get back a penny.
"Don't, you'd better talk about it yourself, the extent to which it is discussed is just up to you.
It is not easy for others to be the master. After all, our county has paid a lot of money. "
Chang Hongfa is also completely gross this time, Zhu Bajie throws a rake and doesn't serve the monkey.
You have the ability, do it yourself, I can't control it.
What did Li Jingyu say?
"Mr. Xu, congratulations, this time your participating company has broken the foreign exchange record again. I heard that the province even rewarded you with a car."
Xu Shiyan picked up the phone and listened to the movement on the other side, humming coldly in his heart.
This is because the old guard has disciplined you, and you can't move the old routine, so you called yourself?
"Oh, Secretary Li is polite, thank you Secretary Li for your concern.
I came back directly from Shenyang. I didn’t go to the province. I haven’t seen the car yet. "
Crap, the one who is anxious now is over there, not Xu Shiyan.
At the Bingshan Beverage Factory, although there are many orders received, the factory already has some stocks in stock.
When signing the contract, most of them agreed that the supply will be delivered in batches. If the workers work overtime and work hard, this batch should be completed.
The main reason is that they still have to go to the autumn fair, and they are afraid that if there are more orders for the autumn fair, they will be overwhelmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 680: win
chapters.content:
Chapter 680 won
Xu Shiyan wanted the factory in Quanyang mainly because the quality and water flow of Quanyang Spring there was attractive.
As for factory buildings and workers, that’s the second thing.
In the past few days in Yangcheng, Xu Shiyan met many merchants from all over the world.
Among them, several Hong Kong businessmen intend to cooperate with Xu Shiyan in the production and sales of large barrels of mineral water.
In addition to Hong Kong businessmen, Dongyi merchants and South Korean merchants all have this intention.
Xu Shiyan also feels that this is a direction for future development.
They can plan in advance, starting with exports, and when the country rises in the future, they can also seize the opportunity.
But good mineral water is not only found in Quanyang, but also in other places. There is really no need to smash this old crooked neck tree.
The advantage here is that the factory equipment is ready-made, and the production can be profitable after taking over.
If the factory is built elsewhere, it is estimated that it will not be able to start production until around winter at the earliest, which is a bit of a delay.
This is why Xu Shiyan could still talk patiently with Li Jingyu, otherwise, he would have called Shao Yong long ago.
"Mr. Xu, I'm calling here mainly to talk to you about the Quanyang factory."
As soon as Li Jingyu heard it, Xu Shiyan was rambling and didn't take the initiative to bring it up. He was in a hurry and couldn't take care of so much, so he could only bring up this topic first.
"Oh, Changzi, that, I'm thinking about it.
As you know, Secretary Li, I have a few good friends in Agricultural University, and one of them is now Jingyu's secretary.
The water source at Jingyu is also very good. We are discussing to build a factory there.
The discounts given there are very strong, not a penny, and after the completion of the factory, there will be a five-year tax exemption. "
This is not Xu Shiyan fooling people, it really happened in the previous life.
It is the porter of nature, who originally planned to invest here.
Here, the lion opened his mouth wide and said that he wanted millions of dollars, but the negotiation failed.
Later, they went to Jingyu to build a factory, but there was no need for a penny, and all kinds of taxes and fees were all reduced or exempted, as long as they recruited workers from the local area.
Comparing past and present lives, Xu Shiyan discovered that some of the county's behavior styles are really the same.
I don't know if it was Li Jingyu in his previous life, but this habit of biting three points when he sees benefits is really a virtue.
In comparison, the structure is really too small, and it is no wonder that this side has not been able to develop.
Li Jingyu was numb when he heard it, isn't that too ruthless?
"President Xu, if you can take over the factory in Quanyang, the county can also give you the biggest discount.
We are also exempt from tax for five years, is this possible? "Li Jingyu gritted his teeth and said ruthlessly.
On the other end of the phone, Xu Shiyan smiled.
"Secretary Li, this is not good. I heard that the county paid a lot of money for the factory in Quanyang. How can I take advantage of it?
Otherwise, you should find someone else to cooperate with. "
This discount is okay, but it is not enough, Xu Shiyan continues to take Joe.
"Don't, don't, we can only trust Mr. Xu." Upon hearing this, Li Jingyu quickly expressed his opinion.
"Mr. Xu, you can put forward the conditions, as long as you can take over the factory."
Now it's like holding a hedgehog in both hands, holding it can't hurt your hands, and you can't bear to throw it away. Li Jingyu is almost upset.
"Hey, Secretary Li, you've already said so much, what else can I say?
Let’s do this, 1.6 million, the entire Quanyang factory will be transferred to us, and I don’t need you to exempt it for five years, just three years.
Also, there is no staffing for the workers, and they are all treated as temporary workers, with three-year contracts.
When the contract expires, the good ones will be retained and transferred to regular workers, and the bad ones will leave directly.
You can do the ideological work of the workers. Anyway, if you don’t want to leave it casually, I can recruit other workers.
If you think it’s okay, I’ll arrange for someone to sign the contract right away. "
Xu Shiyan felt that the heat was almost ready, so he couldn't be too harsh.
Li Jingyu opened his mouth, wanting to say something but didn't know what to say.
1.6 million, that is, the money that the county poured into the Quanyang factory, which is flat.
Three years of tax exemption, alas, if it is exempt, it can be exempted, there is no other way, if the factory remains closed, all the money will be invested, where will the tax come from?
But it’s the workers, it’s difficult.
It used to be considered a large group, but now it is a temporary worker, and there are no benefits, can the workers be happy?
"Okay, then do as Mr. Xu said, Mr. Xu can arrange someone to come and sign the contract."
In the end, Li Jingyu couldn't say anything else, the situation was stronger than others, and he refused to agree, not even these.
As for the workers, the same is true. If they disagree, then they will not even have a place to earn money. They should all go home and farm.
"Okay, I'll arrange someone to sign the contract."
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone contentedly, and then called Guo Shouye.
"Brother, arrange for the two of you to go to the county with Lao Dai to sign the contract, and the Quanyang factory won 1.6 million yuan.
It’s still the same as before, let’s each vote in half.
In addition, I don’t trust others if I transfer your eldest son back to Quanyang Factory as the factory manager. "
Xu Shiyan had already made up his mind that no matter whether the new factory is in Quanyang or Jingyu, he must find a trustworthy and educated person as the factory director.
At present, Guo Fenghua is more suitable.
"Huh?" Guo Shouye was stunned when he heard this.
He probably knew about the matter of the Quanyang factory. Xu Shiyan had talked with the county for so long, and he would definitely win it.
But let his eldest son become the factory director? Is this a step too big?
"Brother, can we do this?
Our family Fenghua is the team leader in the piano factory, so why don't you let him be the factory manager? Can he do it?
Besides, don't you have to tell the leader about this? "
"What are you afraid of? With the two of us backing you up, that kid Fenghua is smart and steady. Are you afraid he won't be able to run a factory?
Hurry up and transfer the child back. The piano factory in the city has not been profitable for the past two years, and the child has no future there. Why let him stay there?
This factory is our Bingshan Beverage Factory's own expansion of production, and the Bureau can't interfere.
If you don't call Da'er back to take care of him, then who do you plan to let him take care of? "
1.6 million, Xu Shiyan can take it out by himself, but things can't be done that way.
If he votes by himself, Quanyang will be the new factory.
It is not easy to operate a brand new factory, the risk is too high, and Xu Shiyan has no suitable person to manage it.
Continue to cooperate with the Forestry Bureau, and then integrate the resources of the Bingshan Beverage Factory with the new factory, and then arrange Guo Fenghua to be the factory director.
With the order received by Bingshan Beverage Factory this time, the factory over there can be revived immediately.
As for the distribution of benefits, Xu Shiyan can easily discuss it here, and it depends on how Guo Shouye discusses it with the bureau.
Anyway, when Guo Fenghua is the factory manager, there are only advantages and no disadvantages.
Guo Shouye heard the same thing, such a good opportunity, why are you still hesitating?
Participating in the Spring Fair this time, when Guo Shouye arrived home, the provincial leaders called.
The leader affirmed and praised Guo Shouye’s achievements, and said that Guo Shouye will be fully in charge of the Bingshan Beverage Factory in the future, and the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau will no longer intervene in management matters.
To be precise, the superiors have completely delegated power, and all decisions and actions are made by Guo Shouye, and there is no need to consult the bureau leaders.
Everyone is selfish, who is not for their own family?
There is a better position in front of me, why let the child feel aggrieved as the team leader in the piano factory?

chapters.title: Chapter 681: layout adjustment
chapters.content:
Chapter 681 Layout Adjustment
In this way, Quanyang Factory was transferred to Bingshan Beverage Factory by the county.
The workers who stayed in the original factory were really unhappy when they learned that the new factory recruited all the workers as temporary workers.
Noisy and troublesome, but to no avail.
The original factory has turned yellow. This is a new factory, which has nothing to do with the previous factory.
No matter how much trouble they make, they can't find the new factory.
The factory directly posted advertisements to recruit workers, and the wages and benefits were clearly stated.
Guaranteed basic wages, collective piecework in division of labor, good work will make more money, bad work, even if you want to come to the factory, you don’t want to.
Someone did some calculations. If it is true as mentioned above, the salary will be much higher than before.
Those who are smart, rush to sign up.
This has been idle for several months without wages, and life is not easy for every household. Why not go to work?
Planting the land or planting sticks?
Farming? I'm exhausted all year round, and I don't earn much money.
Kind of mallets? Now that the cost of planting sticks is so high, they can hardly even afford to eat. How can they still have money to develop sticks?
It would be nice to have a job, earn money, and support the family more than anything else.
So, except for those few who can jump, everyone else came to sign up and signed a contract with the factory.
These people were not enough, so Guo Shouye went to the Quanyang Forestry Bureau and recruited some of the unemployed young people from the Forestry Bureau.
The factory equipment is ready-made, and the workers are skilled.
Clean up the factory a little bit, rearrange the layout, and the factory can start working.
Xu Shiyan led Dai Chunrong and others to hold several meetings with Bingshan Beverage Factory, and made some adjustments to the production plan of the new factory and the original beverage factory.
To put it simply, it is half of the previous orders for bottled mineral water, and in addition, the production of various juices will be placed in the new factory.
Half of the mineral water orders and the production of sparkling drinks are reserved on the Songjiang River side.
In this way, the division of labor is clear and easy to manage.
The factory on the Songjiang River side is indeed a bit small, and it has been operating at a high load before.
After a part is allocated, normal production can begin, and workers can breathe a sigh of relief.
The scale of the new factory is large, and it is like playing with them.
So Xu Shiyan discussed with Guo Fenghua and restarted the original beer production line in the factory.
In addition, some berries from the comprehensive development and utilization of ginseng land in the past two years have also reached the fruit-producing period.
The new factory can have two fruit wine production lines here, specializing in the production of wild fruit juice and wild fruit wine with local characteristics.
The Quanyang Forestry Bureau saw that Songjianghe had made a lot of money by cooperating with the participants, so he was moved.
So I took the initiative to find it, and also learned from Songjianghe, using waste ginseng land and waste forest land to develop traditional Chinese medicine, edible fungi, and various wild fruits.
Especially for all kinds of berries, the finished saplings are purchased directly from the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, and they can bear fruit after more than two years of planting.
The fruits produced are purchased directly from Quanyang Factory, which saves the transportation link and is more convenient.
After nearly a month of busy work, everything at the Quanyang factory is on the right track, and Xu Shiyan can finally breathe a sigh of relief.
"Dad, I'm going to the county for a race this Saturday."
This afternoon, when Xu Shiyan got off work, he just stepped into his parents' yard with one foot, when the eldest son Xu Haiyuan came over and told him about going to the competition.
"Huh? Competition? What kind of competition?" Xu Shiyan was dumbfounded.
During this period of time, he was so busy that he couldn't tell the north from the south, and he didn't go home for several days.
My son is going to compete and he doesn't know anything about it.
“One-minute quiz, a bit like a quiz.
At the beginning of spring, the teacher chose me to go to recite the questions every afternoon.
This Saturday, that is, the 17th, we are going to the county to participate in a competition, and all schools in the county will send students to participate. "
Xu Haiyuan smiled and explained. Dad is too busy with work, so he doesn't know any games, which is normal.
"Oh, oh, this one. It's good, let's go.
well? Are you led by a teacher? Do you want me to take you to the county?
Where do you live? If you don't have a place to live, you can go to your uncle's house, or your fifth uncle's house. "
When Xu Haiyuan said this, Xu Shiyan remembered it.
The eldest daughter of his family also participated in the previous life. It seems that there has been this competition in those years.
Unexpectedly, the eldest son in this life went to participate first.
"With the teacher leading it, there is no need for my father to deliver it.
The school will arrange accommodation, no need to go to my uncle or fifth uncle. "
Xu Haiyuan smiled, it was just an ordinary competition, there was no need to make it too grand.
The teacher led the group action and asked his dad to deliver it. What's the matter?
Xu Shiyan took out fifty yuan from his pocket and handed it to his son.
"Oh, that's fine, you take the money, don't be reluctant to spend it when you go out, buy more delicious food.
The weather is hot at this time, so don’t just eat popsicles, ice cream and soda, please classmates.
When you meet something you like, you don’t have to save it, just spend it when you need it. "
Xu Shiyan is very happy, his eldest son is very promising, and he has to go to the competition.
"Dad, you don't have to give me any money.
When we go out, travel expenses and accommodation expenses are all paid by the school.
Just now my grandma gave me 20 yuan, my grandfather gave me 20 yuan secretly, and my teacher gave me 20 yuan. "
Xu Haiyuan didn't know whether to laugh or cry, even if he went to the county to participate in a competition, it wouldn't be a big deal, what about it?
All of them gave him money, and the sum totaled more than 100.
He is a child, so he takes so much money to go out, okay?
"It's okay, it's okay, I'll take it for you, it doesn't matter how much it costs, just keep the rest for yourself.
In autumn, you will be in junior high school, and there are many places to spend money.
Your mother and I are busy all day long, and we can’t take care of you. We have some money in hand, so don’t be embarrassed when you need it urgently. "
Xu Shiyan chuckled, raised his hand and rubbed the top of his son's head.
In a blink of an eye, my son is twelve years old, and he will start junior high school in autumn. This child grows up very fast, about 1.5 meters?
It is estimated that in two years, he will be taller than him, which is really good.
"Oh, well, I'll put it away first, thank you Dad.
Dad, I went back to the house to read a book. "
Dad said so, and Xu Haiyuan couldn't return the money, so he took the money carefully and went back to the house to read the book and memorize the questions.
The school released a book, and it is said that all the questions in the competition came from it.
The six students participating in the competition each had a copy, and the teacher asked them to memorize them all.
"Well, well, let's read a book, don't be too tired, and pay attention to your eyes.
You read all day long, so don't be short-sighted. "
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, told his son a few words, stepped into the house, and went straight to the kitchen.
Su Anying has been very busy these days, and there is a lot of work on the mountain. This year's ginseng soil has been approved again.
In addition, the order of wild vegetables this year has nearly doubled that of last year, and they are all busy.
Both of them are busy, the child must be on Xu Chenghou's side, Zhou Guilan has to cook a lot of meals a day, so Xu Shiyan wanted to go to the kitchen to help.
As soon as she entered the kitchen, she saw Zhou Guilan leading three girls, Xu Jinping, Xu Jingyi, and Xu Jinhui, who were busy cooking.

chapters.title: Chapter 682: discuss going home
chapters.content:
Chapter 682 Negotiation to return to hometown
Years later, Xu Shixiang found a job for Chen Chunling in the county, and the two bought a house in the county and moved to the county.
So Xu Jingwen stopped studying in Donggang and transferred to the county.
Turn one away, and there are still five or six children eating at home.
These little guys are bouncing around, crazy and noisy all day, which is the time to eat.
At noon, Zhou Guilan cooks something simple, so that the children can go to school after a bite.
In the afternoon, Zhou Guilan will carefully prepare some delicious food and make more.
Xu Jinping and the others got out of school around four o'clock in the afternoon. They went home and did their homework first, and then went into the kitchen to help grandma with work.
Eleven-year-old Xu Jinping is quick at work, and no one can beat her when cooking.
Xu Jingyi and Xu Jinhui helped to light the fire, pick and wash vegetables.
With the help of three granddaughters, the old lady can save a lot of energy. The grandparents and grandchildren are talking and laughing and cooking, which is quite lively.
"Mom, I'm back. Well, what can I do?" Xu Shiyan entered the kitchen and asked.
"Oops, are you not busy today?"
Zhou Guilan turned around when she heard the movement, and was quite surprised to see Xu Shiyan.
Since the third son came back from Yangcheng, it seems that he got off work twice and ate at home, right?
It feels like I haven't seen anyone for a long time.
"I don't need you, the food here will be ready soon, go into the house and talk with your master and your father.
I sound like your father is looking for you. "Zhou Guilan waved her hand, telling her son not to meddle in the kitchen.
Xu Shiyan saw that he really didn't need him, so he turned and went into the east room.
"Father, Master, I'm back."
When I entered the room, I saw that the two old men were sitting on the kang and playing chess.
Xu Shiyan took a few steps forward, stretched his head to look at the chess game, as if his father was about to lose.
The two old men were very happy when they saw Xu Shiyan came back, so they stopped playing at all and packed up the chessboard.
"How is the other end of the factory? Are you all arranged?" The two old men asked in unison.
"Well, everything is almost done. Quanyang is now on the right track, and the output of mineral water is not low every day.
Dian dates and so on are being harvested recently. They cooperate with Quanyang Forestry Bureau, and the Forestry Bureau will provide wild fruits in the future.
Everything is normal at the pharmaceutical factory.
The medicines produced by our factory, except for the ones that are exclusively for organizations, the conventional medicines have been certified by the state, and are distributed to various hospitals and pharmacies.
Several new drugs independently developed by the factory are currently undergoing approval, and they can be mass-produced after approval. "
Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory, in addition to the special medicines and conventional Chinese patent medicines, there are more than a dozen kinds of specific medicines that are undergoing formalities for approval.
These medicines were all discussed by Xu Shiyan and Mr. Chu, and evolved from the secret recipe of the Chu family.
New drugs must be approved by relevant departments before they can be produced and marketed.
The program is currently going through, and it is estimated that it will be ready for production and sales in a short time.
"These two are the busiest right now, other departments are okay.
Lao Li, Lao Dai, and Li Min are all quite capable, so I don't need to worry about it. "
Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong and others are all old people who participated in the field.
It can be said that the participating companies are now working with one mind to develop for the benefit.
"Well, that's good, you have to pay attention to rest when you have time.
The business of the two of you is getting bigger and busier now, so you still have to pay attention to it. "
Chu Xuanhuai glanced at Xu Shiyan, no one needs to tell this time, anyone with a discerning eye can see that Xu Shiyan has lost weight again.
The fat raised by eating, drinking and drinking during the Chinese New Year has disappeared after a while.
"You are also a person who is running from 37 to 40, you have to pay attention to your daily life, don't think that you are still young, and keep working hard.
The work belongs to the company, but the body belongs to oneself, so we still have to pay attention to it. "Chu Xuanhuai had to give a few more words of advice.
Most people are like this. They don’t pay attention to anything because they are young, and wait for the age to come up. It hurts and itches, and it’s too late.
"Oh, I see." Xu Shiyan nodded and sat on the edge of the kang.
"Father, listen to my mother, do you need me for something?"
"Well, didn't we say before that we want to go back to our hometown this year?
When you are free, you discuss with those few, you should ask for leave, and our family will go back and have a look. "
Going back to his hometown has always been Xu Chenghou's heart knot, the thing he misses the most.
A few years ago, the days were not so good, and I didn't miss it. Since I mentioned it during the Chinese New Year, the old man has been thinking about it all day long.
But the sons all have jobs and are busy, so how can they leave without saying anything?
You have to find an opportunity, arrange a time, and ask for leave to go back together.
"Okay, then I'll ask my elder brother and them, or else I can just catch up with the summer vacation.
Xiaobo seems to be about to take the high school entrance examination, right? Our family Yuanyuan's primary school will be promoted at the end of this month, and the other children will be born on July 10th. "
Xu Shiyan did some calculations, and it seems that July will be fine.
One is that the children are on summer vacation, and those who can follow them go back, which can be regarded as letting them know where their hometown is.
One more thing, in July, the ginseng is not busy, and the harvesting of wild vegetables is basically finished, so Su Anying can spare time.
It doesn't matter if Xu Shixian works, they can ask for leave anytime.
"Okay, then you can discuss with the boss and the others. Once it is settled, I will ask your mother to prepare in advance."
According to Xu Chenghou's thinking, it is best to go back at the end of September and the beginning of October.
All kinds of pears and hawthorns have come down in my hometown, and they are delicious.
But after thinking about it, how busy was it back then, who had time to go back to their hometown?
July is July, take advantage of a little free time, go back, even if you have lost your mind.
"Okay, after dinner, I'll call my brother and the others."
At this time, Zhou Guilan led the children to put food on the table, Xu Shiyan agreed, and went out to help, and packed up all the food in a short while.
At this time, there are a lot of small green vegetables, and the seedlings of eggplant and pepper have not grown yet, so most of the small green vegetables are on the table.
Chrysanthemum chrysanthemum in sauce, spinach salad, cabbage meatball vermicelli soup, radish and green onion dipping sauce.
It is estimated that Zhou Guilan felt that this kind of food was too vegetarian, and the children couldn't bear it, so she specially stewed tofu with braised pork.
This is not bad, the bright red soup is oily, and it is rare at first glance.
The staple food is gold and silver rice, which is rice stewed with rhubarb rice.
Rhubarb rice has a certain degree of stickiness, so the rice is softer after stewing, suitable for old people to eat.
Xu Jinhui ran to Westinghouse and called Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing out for dinner.
Yang Haoyu's grandparents are back, so after school starts this year, they can only eat at Xu's house at noon.
After school in the afternoon, he walked home to eat by himself.
Yang Junxian and his wife were so busy that no one was free to pick him up.
Furthermore, Yang Haoyu is eleven years old, so there is nothing wrong with going home by himself, and there is no need for his parents to pick him up.
"Wow, there is braised pork and meatball soup tonight, it's great.
Grandma, I want a big bowl of rice. "
Xu Haiqing came over to look at the dishes on the table, his eyes widened immediately, and he couldn't wait to sit down and prepare to eat.

chapters.title: Chapter 683: eldest son goes to the game
chapters.content:
Chapter 683 The eldest son goes to the competition
Everyone sat down and was about to eat when Su Anying also came back.
Xu Jinping hurried to get a pair of bowls and chopsticks for her mother, and helped her serve the meal.
Su Anying washed her hands and sat down. Her stomach was empty after a busy day, and her family didn't care about that anymore, so she hurried to eat.
"Daughter-in-law, how are Xiaoji and the others doing this year?" Xu Shiyan picked a few pieces of meat for his daughter-in-law and asked casually.
The couple are both busy and haven't seen each other for almost ten days, so Xu Shiyan had to ask.
"It's okay, this year's dishes are good.
The fourth brother-in-law may have been patient, so he collected fresh vegetables from the forestry team and transported them down.
The third and fourth younger sisters hired someone to heat the vegetables at home, and then kneaded them to dry. They earned more than last year when they harvested dried vegetables, and the quality was also better. "
When it comes to making money, Su Anying doesn't feel tired, she is very energetic.
Every year in this season, the forest management and tending of the forest farm just came to an end, and the workers all went to the mountains to harvest the cattle.
In the past, men went to the mountains to collect vegetables, scalded them with boiling water at night, and women rubbed them at home to dry them the next day.
Ji Tongzhong told people this year that when fresh vegetables are collected, they can be sold directly to him in cash.
The people in the forest farm thought about it, so that they don’t have to heat and dry at home, so they can free up a person to go to the mountains to collect vegetables.
Even if a woman is weak and can't squeeze out that much, two people can earn more than one person.
So many people in forest farms changed their strategies. The couple went into the mountain together, picked up the vegetables and carried them out, and sold them directly after weighing them, and continued to go up the mountain the next day.
Don’t care if the dish is rubbed well, or whether the weather is good or bad, whether the dish will damage the long hair or something.
As for Ji Tongzhong, he drives a car every day to collect fresh cow hair and transport it back.
It was in the courtyard of the old hospital, and at night, two large pots were set up to boil the vegetables.
The next morning, Sister Su Anzhen led the hired old ladies and daughters-in-law to pluck out the ox hair and put it in the courtyard of Sanshi to dry.
There are no sellers in the market at this time, the yard is empty, the ground is flat and clean, covered with plastic sheeting, it is suitable for drying cow hair.
The house on the other side of the old hospital has been converted into a drying room and a storage room. If it is rainy, the vegetables will be sent to the drying room to dry.
In this way, the quality of the dishes is guaranteed, and the money is earned, so everyone is happy.
"I used to watch Xiao Ji act foolishly all day long, pick and choose and didn't want to make a big effort, and was worried about the fourth sister.
Unexpectedly, this guy just didn't find the right way.
Look at him now, he can admit to doing it. I guess this season of this year, they will not be able to earn less. "
Su Anying couldn't help but praise Ji Tongzhong a few words. This guy is a good businessman. He used to farm land in the countryside, so he was really inferior.
Xu Shiyan nodded along, so it is really important for people to find their own position.
"It's the best way. Parents don't have to worry about the life of the fourth sister anymore."
It’s pretty good, and the brothers-in-law are doing well now.
My father-in-law is in good health, there is nothing wrong with him, and the old couple are living well, which is not bad.
The couple haven't seen each other for a while, so naturally they have a lot to talk about, and the more they talk, the more heated it becomes, and others can't get in the conversation at all.
Xu Haiyuan opened his mouth several times, wanting to talk about his going to the county to participate in the competition, but he didn't have a chance to mention it.
It was Xu Shiyan who saw his son's expression was wrong, and when he remembered this, he quickly mentioned it to his wife.
"My son is going to compete in the county? Oh, look, I'm so busy these days, I don't even know.
Are you free recently? How about you accompany your son to the county? "
Su Anying was also very happy when she heard that, out of the 160 to 70 children in the sixth grade, only six were selected, and there was one of his eldest son, how wonderful.
"Mom, I don't need my father to accompany me. The teacher leads the team. Let's act together."
Xu Haiyuan finally had a chance to speak, so he quickly explained the matter to his mother.
"Mom, just pack two pieces of clothes for me. The game is two days old, we will start early, and it is estimated that we will stay in the county for two nights.
Just bring me two shirts or something, in case it gets dirty, there is a replacement. "
When you go out to compete, you have to pay attention to your image.
Xu Haiyuan hasn't messed around with Huang Shuqing and Sun Yu much in the past two years, and he loves cleanliness more and more, and can't stand mess.
"Oh, okay, I'll clean it up for you when I get home."
Saturday game, if you start early, you have to leave on Friday.
It's Wednesday, and Su Anying is always busy. She was afraid that she would forget about her son's going out, so she said that she would prepare it when she got home.
After dinner, Su Anying led the two daughters to clean up the table, cleaned the dishes, and then the family left here and went back to their home.
Su Anying went to prepare clothes and backpacks for her son when she entered the house, while Xu Shiyan called Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang to discuss going back to her hometown this summer.
