Nowadays, among the Xu family brothers, it is not Xu Shixian, but Xu Shiyan who is talking.
So when Xu Shiyan said that he would go back to his hometown in mid-July, neither Xu Shixian nor Xu Shixiang had any objections.
As for Xu Shide, he was in the Xigang Finance Office, and he didn't have much work in July, and his family only had a little land participation, so it wouldn't delay anything.
Not to mention Xu Shian, he has the final say on the farm, and he can leave whenever he wants.
Just like that, the brothers agreed to leave after the children finished their final exams.
Actually, it will take at most three or four days to go back, and there are no close relatives there.
A few years ago, Xu Chenghou's cousins ​​died of illness one after another.
The remaining cousin and nephew-in-law have not seen each other for so many years, and the relationship is not very close.
So they just went back to visit the grave and worshiped, and it wouldn't take too long.
Xu Shiyan discussed with his brothers about going back to his hometown, while Su Anying also packed his son's things for going out and put them in a backpack.
The couple have been very busy these days, and they were finally at home today, so they washed and rested early.
Xu Haiyuan and the others competed on the 17th, and on the morning of the 16th, the teacher took them to the county in a bus.
The departure from Donggang to the county is at 7:30 in the morning and 12:30 in the noon.
Songjianghe Passenger Transport Station, there is a bus at 8:00 in the morning and a bus after 1:00 in the afternoon.
The teacher who led the team found someone to book a bus from Donggang to the county at 7:30 in advance.
So on the morning of the 16th, a few children went directly to Donggang Passenger Station, which was actually just a gathering in the backyard of the town government.
In order for her grandson to participate in the competition, Zhou Guilan got up early, rolled out noodles and cooked them.
The noodles are also filled with frangipani, sprinkled with minced chives and dried shrimps, which are very fresh.
"Come, Yuanyuan, eat a bowl of noodles, and go out to compete smoothly."
The old lady brought a bowl of noodles with a smile and put it in front of Xu Haiyuan for him to eat.
It was the first time for the child to go to the county in a bus, and he didn't know if he would get motion sickness. Zhou Guilan didn't dare to make it too greasy, so it was just right to eat.
Chu Xuanhuai gave his apprentice a small medicine bottle, saying that if he felt uncomfortable in the car, he would take two pills, which would make him feel better.
Xu Haiyuan looked at the medicine bottle in front of him and was speechless.
He is really just going to participate in a competition, it's very simple, how come everyone is facing a big enemy?
If he goes to take the high school entrance examination and college entrance examination in the future, or if he goes to study in college in the future, what will happen to his family?

chapters.title: Chapter 684: Go to the county seat by car
chapters.content:
Chapter 684 Going to the county seat by car
Xu Haiyuan ate a bowl of noodles, then put on the backpack prepared by his mother, and carried the small medicine bottle given by his master.
Xu Shiyan drove his son specially to Donggang Passenger Station, greeted the driver and asked him to take more care of Xu Haiyuan.
Whatever the case, this is the first time the child has left home to go to the county.
Twelve-year-old children, no matter how mature and stable they are on weekdays, there is no way to rest assured after all.
"When you go out, you must listen to the teacher, don't go out and run around, do you hear me?"
Xu Shiyan sent his son to the car, and gave a few instructions with concern.
"Understood, Dad, I will be careful."
Xu Haiyuan is speechless, he has never been out of the house before, so why not go to the provincial capital?
This time, there is a teacher leading the team when we go out, and each one of them seems to be how far he has to go.
At this time, the teacher who led the team also got on the bus, Xu Shiyan chatted with the teacher a few more times, then got off the bus and drove to work.
Here, all six students from the school have arrived, and other passengers have also boarded the bus one after another.
It stands to reason that this bus can hold about 30 people, but there were nearly 50 people on the bus at the end.
The ones on the Maza, the ones on the machine cover, anyway, the car is packed to the brim.
Thanks to the tickets given by someone from the school and Xu Shiyan's face, the driver arranged good seats for the children, near the front.
Most of these people in the car are from Donggang, and most of them know each other.
Especially Xu Haiyuan, to be honest, few people don't know him.
So even if those people were not crowded there, no one said that a few students gave up their seats.
Even if Xu Haiyuan stood up and gave way once, he was pressed down and continued to sit.
Others are so polite, Xu Haiyuan can't say anything, so he can only continue to sit in his seat.
When everyone is ready, the driver starts the car.
Nowadays, not many children can go out, and the farthest for many children is to go to Songjianghe.
So when the car started, everyone was very curious. They looked left and right, and they were very happy.
The road from Donggang to Songjianghe is okay. There is a ginseng market in Donggang. For the convenience of merchants, the county paid for the road repair.
But when the car passed the hill and walked on the winding mountain road, many people in the car couldn't bear it.
The road itself is bumpy, and it feels really uncomfortable to make a sharp turn.
Xu Haiyuan was originally sitting by the window, and beside him sat a girl, the monitor of the second class.
The girl was fine before, and chatted happily with the girl in the back seat, but now her face started to turn pale, and she looked uncomfortable.
"Come on, let's change seats, you sit here by the window.
Push the window open, let the air feel better. "
Xu Haiyuan saw the appearance of the girl next to him, and knew that the girl was motion sick.
So he took the initiative to stand up and asked the girl to sit inside, leaning against the window.
At this time, the windows on the bus can be opened, and they can be pushed forward to reveal a gap.
When the cool wind blows in from outside, people will feel much better.
"Then, these two pills are in it." Xu Haiyuan took out the medicine bottle given by the teacher again, and poured two pills for the girl.
Xu Haiyuan's name is known to everyone in Donggang Primary School, and everyone in other grades knows it, let alone students in this grade.
The girl knew that Xu Haiyuan had a doctor who opened the clinic, and she heard that her medical skills were particularly good.
So without further ado, he picked up the two small pills and put them in his mouth.
There is a slight bitterness in the sweet and sour, and there is a bit of coolness of mint, and the girl suddenly feels less disgusting.
In addition, leaning against the car window and being blown by the wind, people are also more energetic.
"Thank you." The girl thanked in a low voice.
"No need." Xu Haiyuan didn't look at the girl, just closed his eyes to rest.
There are two roads to go to Fusong, one passing through Xinglong Township and the other passing through Songjiang Village.
No matter which one it is, it is a mountain road, and the road conditions are not too good.
In addition, there are always people who get off and get on the bus on this road, so the bus does not go fast, and it takes nearly two hours to get there.
Xu Haiyuan didn't like to chat with people, and he didn't care about the scenery outside the window, so he closed his eyes and rested the whole time.
As for the other students, some looked out of the window curiously, some chattered, and some remained silent due to motion sickness.
Many people in the car were talking loudly, some smoked, and even those who were careless just took off their shoes.
So don't mention it in this car, it has all kinds of smells.
Thanks to the warm weather at this time, the car windows can be opened.
With the car windows open, the wind blows in, so the smell will be worse anyway.
At around nine o'clock, the bus passed through Malugou, and after a while, a large building could be seen in the distance.
The children who stretched their necks and looked outside hurriedly asked, "Teacher, is the county town ahead?"
The children are very excited, this is their first time in the county.
The teacher glanced outside, hummed, "Sit down, be honest."
Can’t these live monkeys be more secure?
Look at my classmate Xu Haiyuan, who has been sitting there steadily since getting on the bus.
Where do the children care what the teacher says? It's the county seat in front of me, and I haven't been here before, why are they not allowed to be curious?
The bus continued to move forward, and there was a big elm tree in front of it. The trunk of the elm tree was so thick that it was estimated that two people would not be able to hug it together.
A lot of red cloth strips were tied to the trunk of the elm tree, and some offerings were placed under the tree roots.
This big elm tree can be regarded as a landmark of Fusong. It is said that it has grown for nearly 300 years.
According to the local customs, if a child is sick and difficult to support after birth, someone will suggest an idea to let the child recognize his relatives.
Yang Haoyu is like this. Since he recognized Xu Shiyan and his wife, his health is getting better and better. Now he is no different from ordinary children.
Some people find it too troublesome to identify their godmother, and they have to move around during the holidays, so they will find a very old tree to be their godmother.
Generally speaking, many people recognize elms, and some recognize poplars.
The big elm tree in Fusong is almost three hundred years old, and it has always been flourishing and prosperous, so many people come to be godmothers.
The red cloth was tied on when she recognized her godmother.
The bus passed the big elm tree and then went forward, and entered the county seat.
However, this place belongs to the south of the county seat, which is similar to the suburbs of big cities, and it is also a piece of bungalows.
Some of them don’t look as new as the houses in Donggang.
Going further in, gradually there are fewer bungalows and more buildings.
The smooth streets and the tall buildings on both sides amazed the children who had never been to the county, and they exclaimed from time to time.
"Wow, that building is so tall."
Xu Haiyuan finally opened his eyes, looked out the window, shook his head and continued to close his eyes.
It’s just a few buildings, what’s there to see?
There are more buildings in the provincial capital, and that’s actually all there is to it. It’s not as comfortable as the small courtyard at home.
The children went to the competition and had to live in the county teacher training school, so the teacher greeted the driver before they got to the passenger station.
"Master, get off at the Grain Bureau."
The driver stopped the car, and the teacher led the children out of the car with great effort.
When everyone got out of the car and got down to the ground, they suddenly felt like they were stepping on cotton.

chapters.title: Chapter 685: Preliminary pass
chapters.content:
Chapter 685 Passing the preliminary round
Children who come to the county for the first time are curious about everything.
Looking up at the tall buildings around, looking down at the flat and solid asphalt road under your feet, it is really fresh everywhere.
"Teacher, where are we going?"
"Go east, go to the teacher training school, keep up, don't wander around, there are many people in the county, if you get lost, I can't find you."
Teacher Jiang, the team leader, pointed to the east and led the children forward.
The children who first arrived in the county could not tell the difference between east, west, north and south, so they could only follow behind the teacher obediently.
While walking, he looked at the scene along the way.
The teacher training school is located at the foot of the Dongshan Mountain in the county seat. Walk eastward from the alley in front of the Grain Bureau, and you will arrive at the root of the Dongshan Mountain.
Here is a rather large courtyard, with office buildings and conference rooms to the south, the canteen to the east on the north, and dormitories to the west.
"You guys stay in the yard for a while, I'll go through the formalities."
All participating schools must go to the office building to sign in, and then arrange rooms and accommodation.
Mr. Jiang let the children play in the yard, while she took the school's introduction letter and other things to the office building to sign in and go through the formalities.
Not long after, Teacher Jiang came out and led the children to the north dormitory.
Under the arrangement of the staff, four girls live in one room, and two boys temporarily live in one room.
If there are many people coming in the afternoon, people will be arranged inside. Teacher Jiang lives with teachers from other places.
The dormitory has three floors, Xu Haiyuan lives on the second floor, and the monitor of class three is with him.
This kind of competition is to pick the best grades in the class. Most of them are the monitors, or they are also the school committee members. Ordinary students simply don't get the turn.
Everyone went to the dormitory to rest, and went downstairs to eat in the cafeteria at eleven o'clock at noon.
Ten people per table, ten dishes, no matter if the people around you know each other or not, just sit down and eat.
Is the food okay? There are several cans, and everyone rushed to eat the cans. After Xu Haiyuan took two bites, the plate was empty.
He wasn’t picky, he could eat whatever he wanted, and he ate two bowls of rice.
There is nothing to do in the afternoon, so the teacher asked the children to recite the questions in the dormitory.
Woke up early the next morning, washed up, had breakfast, and then all went to the meeting room in the south office building to prepare for the game.
There are 16 central primary schools in the 16 townships in the county, plus several primary schools in the county. Each primary school arranges one or two groups of students to participate in the competition.
In some larger villages, a group of students will also be arranged, so this meeting room is full of people.
The competition is divided into two rounds, the preliminary round and the final round.
The competition questions for central primary schools and village primary schools are different, and the questions for central primary schools are more difficult.
A group of three came forward to draw lots, and asked which set of questions they got, and the teacher asked questions one by one.
Ask ten questions in one minute, ask and answer quickly, and answer one question correctly.
I originally thought that the scope of the questions was in the book, but it turned out that this competition found out that many questions were not in the book at all.
Some children are dumbfounded directly, and they don’t know it at all.
There are also some children who are usually very proficient in reciting at home, but when they play, they are immediately stunned when they see so many people below.
Ten questions in one minute, I can't respond at all.
Some children stuttered and couldn’t answer when they came on stage, and cried when they stepped off the stage.
"Remember it all for me, don't be nervous after going on stage, just treat these people in the audience as carrots and potatoes."
Mr. Jiang called the six students together and repeatedly told them to calm down and not to be nervous.
Two groups of students in Donggang Central Primary School, each group consists of one boy and two girls.
The group led by Xu Haiyuan has the monitor of the second class, and a school committee member of the fourth class.
The monitor of the third class is Liu Qiang, and he also leads a monitor and a school committee.
The order in which each group of students came to the stage was determined by the teacher's lottery. There was a long time gap between the two groups of Donggang Central Primary School.
Liu Qiang's group came to the stage first, and the group leader drew questions, probably because he was unlucky, and the questions drawn were quite difficult.
The school committee member in Class 1 was dumbfounded as soon as he listened to the questions. After all, he answered 5 out of 10 questions correctly. When he stepped off the stage, the little girl cried.
Xu Haiyuan and the others were in the back row, finally got on stage, Xu Haiyuan went to draw questions.
It’s okay, luck is good, most of the questions are from the book they memorized, only Xu Haiyuan encountered two out-of-range questions.
Based on Xu Haiyuan's knowledge, this is all drizzle, so he answered it easily and got full marks.
There were too many schools and students participating in the competition, and the competition continued in the afternoon without finishing the work all morning.
Then, from all the groups in the preliminary round, the top ten central schools and the top five village schools will be selected, and the next day will be the final.
The group led by Xu Haiyuan successfully advanced with the first overall score.
Another group was eliminated because the members did not perform well.
"It's pretty good. They all played well. Hurry up and eat. After eating, I'll take you to Xijiang Park for a stroll."
Ms. Jiang is quite satisfied with this result.
This is the first competition in the county. No matter whether the teachers or students have little experience, it would be great if one group can enter the final.
The students cheered up when they heard this.
The little girl who had been crying for a long time stopped crying and hurried to eat.
The big guy followed Mr. Jiang, came out of the training school, followed the path from the county town east to the embankment of the Xijiang River.
Don't care about Li Jingyu's working ability, but for the construction of this city, he has really worked hard.
Last year, in order to hold the Ginseng Festival, the county specially repaired the embankment of the Xijiang River.
Built guardrails, sidewalks, pavilions, stone tables and benches, etc., the whole is very beautiful.
After the beginning of spring this year, the county arranged for people to put up many statues on this embankment.
There are dancing fairies, black bears coming out of tree holes, deer, squirrels and so on.
So the Xijiang embankment has now become a place for people in the county to relax after dinner.
In early summer, after dinner, a few members of the family come out to wander around, watching the sunset, blowing the river breeze, not to mention, it’s quite pleasant.
When did these children in Donggang see such a beautiful park?
It’s not good for everyone to be happy, touch this and look there, it’s rare everywhere.
Especially those statues, the children have to stand and look at them for a long time.
"It's a pity that I don't have a camera. It would be great if I had a camera. I can take some pictures for you as souvenirs."
Mr. Jiang is also very sorry, the children rarely come out, how would it be if there was a camera?
Xu Haiyuan didn't make a sound over there.
He had a camera at home, but the teacher didn't tell him, and he didn't bother to look for those troubles, so he didn't bring it.
Besides, it’s just a county seat, what about it?
When I have the opportunity to go to the province or the capital in the future, I can take as many photos as I want.
In the evening, there were many people in Xijiang Park, and some small vendors also found business opportunities. Many people were shouting for popsicles, ice cream, soda, and melon seeds.
Xu Haiyuan remembered what his father told him, so he went over and sold everyone an ice cream for 20 cents, and distributed it to everyone.
"Wow, ice cream, this is delicious, and it's much more expensive than popsicles." Everyone was happy when they saw it.
On weekdays, it would be nice to be able to eat popsicles that cost five cents, but this ice cream costs two cents.
Maybe Xu Haiyuan is willing to do so, who would be willing to buy such an expensive ice cream for someone else?
"Well, it's delicious, much better than popsicles."

chapters.title: Chapter 686: Winner of the final
chapters.content:
Chapter 686 Winner of the Final
The children played in Xijiang Park until dark, and Teacher Jiang led them back.
During the day, I was racing and strolling. I was tired, and I slept soundly at night.
After having dinner the next morning, the schools that did not advance to the finals basically went home, and the rest went to the finals.
The final of the village primary school is simple, and it is still a group of three to answer the questions, and the total score will be accumulated after answering.
The winner with the highest total score in the preliminary round and the final round will only be awarded one prize.
For the trouble of the central primary school, the first round of questions will be answered by group, and the top five groups with a total score will have a round of rush to answer.
This is a test of knowledge reserve and on-the-spot reaction speed.
Fortunately, Xu Haiyuan's mentality has always been stable. With the two girls in this group, he will fight every problem, and he won the first place smoothly all the way.
When the judges announced that Donggang Central Primary School won the first place, Teacher Jiang almost shed tears of joy in the audience.
This semester, the teacher took the children to recite the questions every day.
On Saturday afternoon, other children are off, and these children have to go to school to study, which is really hard enough.
Hard work pays off, and the children won the first place.
The finals are over, and the winners will be announced soon.
A teacher announced the list of winners on the spot, and let the students and teachers who won the prizes come to the stage to receive the prizes.
The group award is a certificate of merit, and the first, second and third prizes are awarded by the instructor.
In addition to this, there is also a student individual award, which is ranked according to the results of the two answers.
Xu Haiyuan deserved the first prize. The prize is a hard-shell notebook and a pen.
Mr. Jiang took six students from two groups, holding certificates, and took pictures together.
The game ended like this. After lunch, everyone packed up and went to the passenger terminal.
Fusong Passenger Station is in the north of the county seat, next to the department store, Xinhua Bookstore and so on.
The car back home was after two o'clock in the afternoon, and there was still enough time, so Teacher Jiang led the children to the department store for a stroll.
As a result, as soon as they reached the stairs on the second floor, several girls screamed in fright.
"What the **** is this? Why do the people inside look like ghosts?"
"That's a distorting mirror, which is actually a concave mirror and a convex mirror.
Through the radian of the mirror to change the reflective imaging, it can make people longer and thinner or smaller and fatter. "
It turns out that there are two distorting mirrors on the stairs on the second floor, one with a convex surface and the other with a concave surface.
When a person walks in front of a convex mirror, he will become thin and long, with two ends larger and the middle smaller.
If you go to the concave mirror, you will become short and fat, with small ends and a large middle, round and fat.
Xu Haiyuan glanced at the mirror, and explained to the girls helplessly.
Really stupid, a living person can be scared by a mirror, what's so scary about this thing?
Hearing what Xu Haiyuan said, these people became interested.
A few girls stood in front of the distorting mirror and looked carefully, and made all kinds of strange expressions towards the mirror, which made them laugh.
This is also the origin of the name of the distorting mirror.
The children played in front of the distorting mirror for a while before going up to hang out.
In fact, shopping is also a waste of time, and you don’t have much money, so you can only take a look.
Even so, the girls were all very excited, pointing to the comments about the clothes.
There is a yellow gauze skirt with several layers of fringe, which is very pretty.
Several girls looked at it for a long time, and when they asked the salesperson, they said it was fifty yuan. The children were so scared that they stuck out their tongues, turned around and ran away.
Xu Haiyuan is not interested in shopping, the upstairs is full of clothes, shoes and socks, and there is no shortage of younger brothers and sisters at home.
So a group of people left the department store, Xu Haiyuan talked to Mr. Jiang, then turned and entered the Xinhua Bookstore.
Going around here, there is nothing to buy. Now the Xu family's books are almost more diverse than the books in this Xinhua Bookstore.
In the past, every time Xu Shiyan went out, the place he would go to was the bookstore.
Chinese and foreign classics, all kinds of popular science books, as long as they are suitable for children, he will buy them back.
Plus Xu Shiyan's textbooks from various universities and Chu Xuanhuai's collection.
It can be said that if there are some in the bookstore, the Xu family keeps them, and if there are not in the bookstore, maybe the Xu family has them.
In this small bookstore in the county seat, Xu Haiyuan walked around twice, but couldn't find the book he wanted to buy.
In the end, I had no choice but to come out empty-handed. It happened that the train was about to leave at this time. Teacher Jiang led the children to check the tickets and board the train.
At 2:30, the bus departed and returned to Songjianghe around 4:00 pm, and then hired a donkey cart to take the children back to the Donggang Martyrs Tomb, and the children went home.
"Oops, my eldest grandson is back. How's the game going?"
Zhou Guilan and Han Cai'e are leading Xu Jinping and the others to make dumplings at home.
This is a classic project of the Xu family. No matter who comes back from the house, the old lady must cook dumplings.
Su Weizhong happened to be off work today, so he and Han Cai'e also came over to make dumplings for Xu Haiyuan.
"Grandpa, grandma, grandpa, grandma, master.
The competition was very good, and everything went well. Our school won the first prize, and there is a certificate with the teacher.
I also won an award, the first prize for individuals, no certificate, only prizes. "The elder asked, Xu Haiyuan answered politely.
"Oh, my in-laws, listen quickly, we have won awards one after another.
It has to be my eldest grandson, that’s fine, he can win prizes in county competitions. "
When Zhou Guilan heard this, she was very happy, and the wrinkles on her smiling face became much deeper.
The old men and women in the room were all happy, and all of them smiled like flowers.
"Hurry up, get on the kang and rest. Our side will finish making dumplings soon. When your parents come back, we will cook dumplings for dinner."
Han Cai'e hurriedly greeted her grandson to go to the kang, and the older grandson became rarer and rarer the more she looked at her.
"Family, you are blessed to have such a promising grandson.
Look, Yuanyuan is good at studying, obedient and sensible, and he studied medicine with Mr. Chu, this kid will definitely be a big deal in the future.
There is also Pingping, that child too, and it will be the same in the future.
How do you think these two children grew up? How can you study so well without others worrying about it? "
Han Caie was talking to Zhou Guilan while making dumplings.
"That's right, the old Xu family's grave is smoking, and I don't know how many lifetimes it took for these two children to come out."
When Zhou Guilan said this, she deliberately glanced at Xu Chenghou.
She didn't mean to belittle anyone.
Old Xu's family has three generations of children, and they have never heard of anyone who has a good education. It is really not easy to have two children who are good at school.
Xu Chenghou was not annoyed when he heard what his old wife said, and he still smiled.
"If you don't talk about me, I have to go back to my hometown and pay homage.
Pray for the blessings of the ancestors, the descendants of our Xu family will be promising, and if there are a few more college students, it can be regarded as honoring the ancestors. "
When the old couple said this, the others laughed along with them.
While talking and laughing, the dumplings were almost finished.
Zhou Guilan looked at the time and estimated that her son and daughter-in-law would be back soon.
"Let's go, let's boil the dumplings.
In the morning, I told them that the children came back from the game today and had dumplings at night, so they couldn’t come back too late. "

chapters.title: Chapter 687: Xiaoshengchu
chapters.content:
Chapter 687 Xiao Shengchu
Xu Haiyuan went to participate in the competition and came back. On the next Monday, he went to class normally.
When the national flag was raised in the morning, the principal also specially praised the students who went to participate in the competition.
And rewards were given to the children to encourage them, which made many students envious.
Sixth grade students have an entrance examination, which is what everyone calls the junior high school.
There is no such thing as nine-year compulsory education in this day and age, and the entrance examination for entering junior high school is also very important. If you fail the exam, you can only go home to farm.
This year's junior high school exam is scheduled for June 24th, which happens to be Saturday.
I started reviewing from the winter vacation, and the teachers and students were all stretched.
By this time, there is no need to put pressure on the children.
So I chose a sunny day, and the teacher led the children to take graduation photos.
First is a group photo of the class, with the school leader in the middle and the head teacher sitting next to the leader.
The children squat in a row in front, the class leader sits next to the teacher, and stand two rows behind.
The school’s art teacher held a camera and shouted one, two, three, leaving an unforgettable moment for the children.
After the group photo, the school leaders withdrew, and the head teacher led the class cadres to take a group photo.
The students have a good relationship, and they will take pictures together in twos and threes.
At this time, the differences among students are reflected.
Family conditions are good, so I don’t care at all, and took many photos with teachers and classmates.
Those with poor conditions, except for the group photo, dare not take more than one photo, for fear that their parents will be unhappy and not give money after returning home.
Like Xu Haiyuan, who is good at learning and popular, teachers, classmates, and many people ask him to take pictures with him.
I didn’t do anything else this afternoon except take pictures.
On Saturday, other grades in elementary school are on holiday, and the entire school has only sixth graders.
All candidates are divided into examination rooms and single tables, and the school arranges teachers from other grades to invigilate the examination.
Fortunately, there are no minor subjects in junior high school, only mathematics and Chinese. One subject in the morning and one in the afternoon, it is very easy.
After the exam in the afternoon, the teacher called the children back to class to discuss the graduation party.
The teacher asked the class leader to collect the remaining class fees in advance, and each student charged a little more to buy melon seeds and candies.
The class saved a lot of colored paper, and let the dexterous girls cut garlands or paper strips to decorate the classroom.
Everyone was busy all afternoon, put the classrooms in order, and returned to school on Sunday for a party.
This season, strawberries are a good time. The teacher specially ordered a few baskets of ground fruits with people in the orchard, plus melon seeds, candy and so on.
Xu Haiyuan's class, and the soda specially sponsored by Guo Shouye.
The children ate, drank, sang and danced at school until noon.
Children of this age don’t even know what separation is.
Besides, they are all in Donggang, not far away, and we can see each other whenever we want.
So everyone didn't feel uncomfortable, but everyone was very happy.
Because there is no homework this summer, I can play casually, and my parents won't scold others.
When the noon party is over, everyone will work together to clean up the classroom and arrange the tables and chairs neatly.
Then one by one, like wild horses that had run loose, they rushed out of the school screaming.
"Squad leader, what are your plans for the holiday? Let's go and play with you another day.
I know a place where there are quite big bubbles, where we can catch fish, touch gala, and swim. "
Several boys approached Xu Haiyuan and invited him to play together.
"I have to study with Shigong. My dad said that he would take us back to our hometown in a few days. I don't seem to have time to play with you." Xu Haiyuan shook his head.
"It's better not to go to any bubble, it's too dangerous.
My dad said that every summer, children have accidents in those Paozi and Hetao. "
Xu Haiyuan always remembers that he was beaten up by his father because of this.
In the past few years during the summer vacation, he, Huang Shuqing, Sun Yu and others did not go to Da Paozi again.
There are so many fun places, there is no need to take risks, if something happens, life will be gone.
"Cut, it's not as serious as what you said, I go swimming every summer.
Forget it, if you don’t go down, let’s go. "
When the children heard this, they were quite disapproving.
So I stopped talking to Xu Haiyuan, and several people gathered together to discuss what they would bring to catch fish.
Xu Haiyuan shook his head, didn't say anything more, and walked home quickly.
"Grandma, grandma, we're on vacation, just go to school in two days to listen to the grades, and then on August 20th, go to junior high school and report."
Xu Haiyuan entered the room, and first told his grandparents.
"Oh, okay, okay, you can take it easy when you are on vacation, let's take a few days off and stop reading.
Waiting for your eldest sister and the others to finish the final exam in a few days, we will go back to our hometown together.
Let me also show you the place where grandpa lived when he was a child. "
Xu Chenghou nodded with a smile when he heard it. He didn't ask his grandson how the exam was.
As far as his grandson is concerned? That must be the best result.
Xu Haiyuan responded, and went to the clinic to study with Chu Xuanhuai.
Two days later, the children went back to school to listen to their grades. Unsurprisingly, Xu Haiyuan's grades were still far ahead.
Not only the first in the whole grade, but also the first in the whole school district.
But his head teacher was so happy that he had to give him a notebook.
The teacher also wrote a message on it, hoping that Xu Haiyuan will refrain from arrogance and impetuosity, and make persistent efforts to strive for greater progress.
Xu Haiyuan finished the junior high school entrance examination, and Xu Haibo's high school entrance examination also ended.
Another ten days later, Xu Jinping, Xu Jinfeng, Xu Haitao and others also finished their final exams.
Xu Jinfeng is in the second year of high school in autumn, and they don't have classes this summer, not to mention other children. I haven't heard that there are classes in summer vacation in elementary and junior high schools.
The children of this age are actually quite happy, and they don’t need to go to this or that cram school during the holidays.
Apart from the little vacation homework left by the teacher, there is nothing else to do, except to eat and play all day long.
The children are all on vacation, and the Xu family brothers have also taken vacations.
So on July 15th, Xu Shiyan drove the car that the province rewarded him, and picked up Xu Chenghou and his wife.
Su Anying drove the one she bought, with her four children sitting on it.
Xu Shian drove Xu Shiyan's previous jeep with his wife and son sitting in it. The three cars set off together and headed straight for the county seat.
Originally Xu Chenghou said that he wanted to take Chu Xuanhuai out for a walk to relax, but Chu Xuanhuai was unwilling to move.
He is getting old, and he is most afraid to go out, so it is better to stay at home.
There is no other way, so I can only ask sisters Su Anfen and Su Anzhen to take care of them, help with washing clothes and cooking.
Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang can also drive, and sometimes they use the unit's car, so they negotiated with the leader to borrow it and paid for it themselves.
These two people are enjoying themselves in the work unit now, how can the leader be so rigid? It's just a little thing, just nodded.
Xu Shide led his wife and children to the county in advance by bus. After Xu Shiyan and the others arrived, the four of them were divided into several cars, which happened to be able to drive.
Just like that, a family of more than 20 people and five cars set off from the county seat in such a mighty way, and walked to Jingyu to the Hunjiang River and then to Tonghua.

chapters.title: Chapter 688: shijiagou
chapters.content:
Chapter 688 Shijiagou
Xu Chenghou’s hometown is Yinkuangzi Village, Qingshangou Township, Kuandian. To go there from Fusong, you have to go through Hunjiang, Tonghua, Huanren, and then go to Qingshangou.
Nowadays, there are no highways, and driving is actually not fast.
Besides, there are old and young people in this group, how can they drive forward all the time?
So in the afternoon, everyone stopped in Tonghua and found a hotel to stay overnight.
There were five cars all at once, and the people at the hotel thought they were some cadres, and they were very warmly entertained.
This group of children, except for Xu Haiyuan, is the first time to travel far, and they all look at everything new.
They slept in the car during the day, and they didn’t want to sleep at night, so they had to go for a walk.
"What is there to see this big night? Let's all have a good rest.
Waiting for us to stay here when we come back, and then I will take you to Yuhuangshan Zoo to see animals. "
In order to coax the children to stay in the hotel honestly, Xu Shiyan could only promise to take them to play when he came back.
When the children heard that they could go to the zoo, they cheered up and stopped clamoring to go out. They stayed in the hotel honestly.
Early the next morning, everyone continued to set off from Tonghua to Huanren.
Although Qingshangou Township is under the jurisdiction of Kuandian, it is actually closer to Huanren.
Everyone found a place to rest in Huanren, had a meal, did some shopping, and then continued on their way.
After passing Huanren, you will arrive at Qingshangou.
In this year and month, Qingshangou has not yet developed tourism. It is actually quite poor here. You can see it along the way, and the houses are not very good.
Since hitting Huan Ren, Xu Chenghou has been looking out the window.
At that time, he couldn't get along in his hometown, so he had to take his wife and children with him and leave his hometown for Fusong.
Who would have thought that Xu Chenghou would come back in a glorious way?
"Old lady, when did I come back that year? Shiqin didn't seem to go to school, did she?
It’s been so many years, why doesn’t it seem like nothing has changed in my hometown? "
When the car passed Qingshangou Township, Xu Chenghou looked at the scene outside and talked to Zhou Guilan.
Xu Chenghou came back at least once, but Zhou Guilan never came back since he left that year.
Looking at the familiar scenery in front of her, Zhou Guilan couldn't control her tears.
This is also the place where she was born and raised. After leaving for so many years, how could it be possible to say that she didn't think about it at all?
"It has changed a bit, it seems that there are more residents than before, but the house is still quite old.
Hey, in our place, the land is bad, and we don’t collect food.
The little pear trees and hawthorns planted by every household can’t be sold, and they just eat and drink all year round. How can they develop? "
Zhou Guilan looked outside, mumbling.
The car continued to drive forward, passed Yinkuangzi Village, and then went a short distance to Shijiagou.
At the mouth of Shijiagou, there is a big stone monument.
According to legend, when Liu Yong came to inspect the local area, an old man lay paralyzed on the kang and wanted to see Mr. Liu.
His son carried him on his back, walked out of Shijiagou, and walked to the county seat.
Master Liu saw the son looking behind his father's back, and thought he was quite filial, so he erected a filial son monument at the mouth of Shijiagou.
"The elders say that the atmosphere of Shijiagou is suppressed by this stele, so it is getting poorer and poorer.
Shijiagou Shijiagou, put a stele on the stone, isn't that good? "
Going in from the silver mine, the road conditions are getting worse and worse, and it is quite bumpy. After finally reaching the mouth of Shijiagou, it is really impossible to drive in.
So everyone got out of the car, Xu Shiyan and the others looked for a place to park, so they couldn't get stuck on the road.
Xu Chenghou pointed to the stele and told his grandchildren about the origin of the stele.
Don't look at the children who have been in the car for so long, but they are all very energetic.
Now listening to grandpa telling stories, everyone's eyes widened and they listened with gusto.
"I heard from the elders that the monument could not be erected even after being erected twice.
Later, the person who erected the monument asked the son, saying that if the monument of filial son cannot be erected, it must be because you have done something unfilial in the past.
The kid thought about it, and finally remembered that when he was young, he once hit his father with a broom. "
Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao supported Xu Chenghou to go forward, and Xu Chenghou continued to tell stories to the children.
"Someone gave that kid an idea to make him kowtow to his father in apology, and after that, the monument was really erected.
Look, it is this monument. "Xu Chenghou said, pointing to a big stone standing next to the mouth of the ditch.
Everyone looked at the big rock, a **** rock with some moss growing on it.
It can be vaguely seen that the words are indeed engraved on it.
But it’s been too long, the wind and rain and the moss cover have made many characters illegible.
Walking in from the mouth of the ditch, everyone finally understands why this place is called Shijiagou.
The ground is really full of rocks, all stone cannons, and there is not even a road.
Xu Shiyan looked at the stone cannons in front of him, but he was thinking about other things.
In fact, he came back twice in his previous life. In 1983, in order to get that **** Xu Haichao, he came back and issued a certificate.
In 2016, Xu Shiyan came back with his brothers, fulfilling his old mother's last wish.
When Zhou Guilan got older, she always talked about her hometown and wanted to go back.
But until she passed away, she never had a chance to go back to her hometown.
In 1916, Xu Shixian and others were not too young.
The brothers discussed and said that while they can move, they should come back and take a look, even if they came back for their parents.
At that time, Xu Haibo drove a taxi, and Xu Jinping also had a car for traveling.
So the brothers and sisters drove the four elder brothers back to Shijiagou to have a look.
The stone cannon under my feet had already become a concrete road at that time, so it was easy to walk.
The houses are also different from the ones in front of them. They are all brick and tile houses, which are quite regular. How can they be like now, where they are still all stone and earth houses?
The ground is full of stone cannons, it is difficult to walk, and it is obviously only more than one mile. Everyone took a lot of effort to walk in.
There are not many families in Shijiagou, and Xu's old house is in it.
"Our family was here at the beginning, the lower part of Kan'er is our house, and the upper part of Kan'er is your grandpa's house."
Xu Chenghou walked to the old house, the stone house was already dilapidated.
The old man pointed to the stone **** behind the house, and told the children.
"See the trees over there? The peach and pear trees belong to our family.
When Nai Nai was pregnant with your father, she loved to eat green peaches, which are small fruits that have just fallen from the peach tree.
It's sour and astringent, I don't know how she can eat it? "
Xu Chenghou said this to Xu Haibo.
Seeing the scene in front of him, the old man's mind was full of the past, and he couldn't help but tell the children about the past.
"Your milk devoured all the fruit on that peach tree before it grows up.
I thought she loved peaches, and when the peaches were ripe, she brought back a basket of big blood peaches from our peach grove.
As a result, she didn't eat any of them. "The old man said and laughed.
"Come on, let's go up, the front is your grandpa's house.
Alas, your great-grandfather and great-grandmother were gone a few years ago, and now only your great-grandfather and great-aunt are left here. "
Xu Chenghou pointed to the house on Kaner and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 689: meet relatives
chapters.content:
Chapter 689 Meeting relatives
The uncle Xu Chenghou mentioned is also a version of their hometown.
Generally speaking, cousins ​​like Xu Haibo and Xu Haiyuan are ranked in order.
As for those with the same surname but more distant blood relationship, they will not be ranked according to their own family.
Xu Shiquan here is of the same generation as Xu Shixian, but much older than Xu Shixian, so Xu Chenghou said that this is the children's uncle.
The two families were already very close to each other, and they were just a few steps up.
Rural people, the door is not closed in broad daylight, the door is always open.
From outside the door, one can see the situation inside at a glance.
There are four rooms in the courtyard, the stone walls are built below the windows, the upper part is adobe, and the roof is covered with asphalt paper.
The west end is the warehouse and the corn building, and the east end is stacked with firewood by the garden sticks.
There is a dog **** in the yard, which is very fierce.
As soon as Xu Chenghou stood at the door, the dog jumped out of the den and barked outside the door.
Xu Chenghou and the others had lunch early in Huanren, and it was only after one o'clock when they arrived here.
It was the hot time at noon, and the workers did not go to the field, resting at home.
So when the dog barked outside, the people in the house heard it and came out to look.
"Who is it?" Someone in the room asked as they walked out.
"Xiao Quan'er, it's me, your uncle." Xu Chenghou knew it was his nephew Xu Shiquan as soon as he heard it, so he smiled.
Xu Shiquan is in his fifties, and there are not many people who can call him Xiaoquan.
So when he heard this, he was stunned for a moment, then walked out of the yard quickly, and looked at the gate, dumbfounded.
Why are there so many people outside? What are you doing? Look at how these people are dressed, why don't they look like locals?
Look at the two older people in front, especially the old man, why do you think they look familiar?
"What's wrong? I don't know your uncle anymore? It's me, your uncle who used to live in Kanerxia."
Xu Chenghou looked at his cousin and said with a smile.
"Oh my god, my uncle is back.
My God, how did you come back, uncle? This is my aunt? Oh, how many years have we not seen each other? "
Xu Shiquan recognized Xu Chenghou, and became excited for a moment, his eyes were red.
"My child, hurry up, come out quickly, and see who is here? Our uncle and aunt."
Xu Shiquan excitedly held Xu Chenghou's hand, turned his head and shouted into the room.
"Uncle, aunt, let's go, let's go into the house and talk.
Behind this are all the children of the uncle and aunt's family? Oh, such a big family is really rare.
Go, go, enter the house, enter the house and talk. "Xu Shiquan was so happy that he dragged Xu Chenghou to the courtyard.
The dog is smart enough, and it stopped barking when its master was so affectionate with the visitor.
Without waiting for the master to reprimand, he went back to the nest and lay down on his stomach.
At this time, Xu Shiquan's daughter-in-law Hu Chunhua also came out of the house, just in time to meet Xu Shiquan and the others.
"This is it?" Hu Chunhua was puzzled when she saw the intimacy between her husband and the visitor, so she carefully looked at Xu Chenghou's eyes.
"Is our uncle back? Is this my aunt?"
When Xu Chenghou left Shijiagou with his wife and children, Hu Chunhua had just been married for less than a year, so he still had a little impression of Kaner's uncle and aunt.
In the next six or a few years, Xu Chenghou came back once, so after Hu Chunhua looked carefully, he recognized the two.
"Oh my god, uncle and aunt are back? Oh my god, hurry up, come in and talk."
Hu Chunhua was also very happy, and hurriedly took Zhou Guilan's hand and walked into the house.
"Auntie, do you still remember?
At that time, not long after I got married, I became pregnant with the eldest of our family.
When you left, our eldest was not born yet.
You made clothes, hats, shoes and so on for the children. My aunt is very good at crafting, and the clothes made by my aunt are very suitable for the boss. "
Hu Chunhua is a very straightforward person. Seeing Zhou Guilan, he remembered the past.
"I didn't expect to see him for so many years.
Oops, thanks to being at home, if I were on the road, even if I ran into my aunt, I wouldn’t be able to recognize her. "
Xu Chenghou's father was the youngest in the family, and it took several years after he married his wife to have such an only child as Xu Chenghou.
Xu Chenghou also had a daughter-in-law who died before him, and Zhou Guilan was actually seven or eight years younger than him.
Xu Shiquan's grandfather is the eldest son, and he married a wife early and gave birth to children early.
So in this way, Xu Shiquan's daughter-in-law, Hu Chunhua, is actually not a few years younger than Zhou Guilan, but they are a generation behind.
After talking, everyone entered the east room.
Xu Shiquan and his wife gave Xu Chenghou and his wife to sit on the kang, and gave Xu Shixian a few stools to sit on.
As for the children, they all stood behind their parents.
Xu Shixian and others also put the things they bought from Huanren City on the top of the kang and on the cabinet.
This place is far from Fusong’s, and everything is similar, so when I left home, I didn’t bring any special products.
But when passing by Huanren, I bought some snacks, canned food, milk powder and other things in the city.
"Uncle, you see that you are too out of touch. It would be nice if you come back from a long distance to have a look. Why buy these old things?"
Xu Shiquan looked at it and shook his head again and again. This guy has stolen a lot of things and earned a lot of money.
"That's all your brother's wishes.
You brothers haven't been together these years, so you finally came back, so why don't you bring something for his brother and sister-in-law? "
Xu Chenghou just laughed, this thing, regardless of relatives and friends, come all the way, can you still do it empty-handed?
"Oh, how nice this big family is.
This is the big brother, right? That's the second brother? Ouch, is that the third brother?
I remember that the third brother was sick all day long, and my aunt spent a lot of effort to support him, but I didn't expect that he was doing well now.
Hey, the third brother is so lucky. This is the birth of four children, two sons and two daughters. Well, that's great. "
Xu Shiquan looked at the five brothers from the Xu family who were sitting across from him. From their ages, he could probably tell who they were.
"When we moved, the fourth brother seemed to be a little over two years old. Look, he has both children now.
Is that the fifth brother? Was it born after moving to Fusong? It's really good to have a good-looking talent. "
After all, they have the same root and surname, connected by blood.
Even though we haven't seen each other for many years, this meeting is still very cordial.
Xu Shiquan looked at these cousins ​​in front of him, and he was also very happy.
"Hey? I remember that uncle still has a daughter at home?
When you came back that year, you still led her, where was the sixth sister? "
Back in the 1960s, Xu Chenghou specially took Xu Shiqin back to his hometown because of his problems.
Xu Shiquan met Xu Shiqin, so he asked.
"The sixth child is married, has two children, and is now in a place in Hubei Province.
Her man is organized and not free, so he didn’t come back with us this time. "Xu Chenghou explained with a smile.
"Oh, oh, whoops, that's really good, good, good."
Xu Shiquan has met Xu Shiqin and knows what is wrong with Xu Shiqin.
When Xu Chenghou came back with Xu Shiqin, everyone didn't say anything, but they were all worried in secret.
A good girl like this, what can I do in the future?
Unexpectedly, not only did she get married, but also gave birth to two children. From that point of view, it should be a good marriage.
For special reasons, it may not necessarily be updated tomorrow, so two chapters will be posted in advance, please read it first. If not tomorrow morning, wait until tomorrow night to update. Please understand.

chapters.title: Chapter 690: have a good time
chapters.content:
Chapter 690 are all doing well
"From this point of view, my uncle's family is doing well now. Look at how nice this big family is."
Xu Shiquan looked at the twenty people in front of him and sighed.
You don’t even need to think about it, it must be better days before you can go back to your hometown with your family.
You must know that it is troublesome to come here from Fusong. You have to take a train to Tonghua, then take a bus from Tonghua to Huanren, and then reverse from Huanren to Qingshangou.
There are more than 20 people in this family, needless to say anything else, the fare plus room and board, it’s a lot of money.
Ordinary people, who would be willing to harm money so much?
There are about 20 members of the Xu family, old and young, all dressed better than the average person. Anyway, in Yinkuangzi, I have never seen such a well-dressed person.
And judging from everyone's demeanor, it's not the kind of special dress for going out, it should be like this in normal life.
Xu Shiquan looked at his relatives who came from afar, and besides being happy, he was also deeply moved.
Perhaps this is the case in life. The uncle couldn't live here, so he had to leave with his wife and children.
At that time, many people in the village said that they were also targeted wherever they went like this? Can you still have a good life?
But looking at it now, it is clear that the family is living a good life with their children and grandchildren returning home.
What's the old saying? Oh, yes, Homecoming.
"Well, it's okay, your brother and the others all have jobs.
Sister-in-law and daughter-in-law are either working or doing business. Anyway, life is okay and they can live on.
Your aunt and I have been thinking about our family all these years.
Why don't we take advantage of the children's summer vacation and bring them back to have a look and pay homage to my parents. "
Xu Chenghou didn't say what his sons did in detail, just vaguely.
It's not that the work of the sons is shameful, but that there is no need to show off too much.
The main reason for coming back this time is to settle a concern while the old couple can still move.
Otherwise, if you wait for a few more years, even if you think about it in your heart, you will be too lazy to move around.
Come back to see your hometown, see the people in your hometown, and pay homage to your ancestors, even if you have lost your mind.
In the future, if the sons are interested, they will come back every few years to take a look. If they are really busy with work and cannot spare time, there is no way.
"Oh, oh, that's good, I should come back and have a look, no matter what happens, I have to know what my hometown is like."
Xu Shiquan nodded when he heard the words, and didn't ask any more questions.
Why ask so many questions? It is their ability to live a good life.
What can he do no matter how much he inquires? How many people can help him?
Although his family is still farming in silver mines, but now that the year is getting better, life can get by, there is no need to cling to anyone.
"How many children are there in your family? The eldest is in his thirties, right? What are those children doing now?"
Xu Chenghou had been sitting in the room for so long, and he didn't see any grand-nephews or grand-nieces. He probably wasn't at home, so he asked casually.
"My family has four children, the eldest Dahaihe, who was born in the year you left. He is thirty-four this year and works in Dandong.
The second child is a girl named Jin Zhi, who is thirty-one this year and married to Fengcheng a few years ago.
The youngest is twenty-nine years old, didn’t there be educated youths who went to the countryside in our village at that time? Jin Yu met an educated youth.
The educated youth is from Kuandian City. After he returned to the city, he tried to find a way to bring back our gold and jade, and now the couple is fine.
The fourth son, Hai Run, was twenty-six. After graduating from high school, his brother-in-law helped him and went to Nongkuandian city.
I just started as an apprentice, and now I have become a regular worker.
Speaking of which, the children are fine. "
Bringing the four children, Xu Shiquan spoke with a little pride.
Yinkuangzi is such a poor and remote place, the four children of his family have all gone out, and none of them stayed in the valley to farm, which is quite good.
As for whether life is good or bad, that is a personal matter.
Parents can only be raised from childhood to adulthood, and the rest depends entirely on the individual.
Xu Chenghou nodded after hearing this.
"Okay, okay, that's great.
Our old Xu’s family has been farming here for several lifetimes since they moved here from Dengzhou Prefecture. "
As an elder, Xu Chenghou was really happy to learn that the younger generations of the Xu family had their own homes.
How to say, Shijiagou is really not a good place, as long as you can leave this small valley and go out, you can always create a world, which is better than farming at home.
"Yeah, I don't expect anything in my life, I just hope that the children will be well, and that they will do well.
Uncle, Auntie, it’s rare for you to come back, and you have to stay at home at night.
Children, mother, hurry up, kill two chickens, and stew chickens for uncles, aunts, brothers and sisters to eat at night. "
Ordinarily, this kinship is not too far away, and the fifth server has not yet been released.
That is, the Northeast, which does not pay so much attention to clan relations. If it is placed among the big clans in the south, it will be regarded as a close relationship.
The relatives who are serious come back, so why not treat them well? Killing chickens to entertain guests is a must.
"Oh, no, no, we don't eat at home.
Nephew and daughter-in-law, don’t be busy, we just come back to sit and see you.
Tomorrow morning we will come back to visit the grave, and we will not stay here for a long time. We are all at work, so please do not come down for a few days off. "
Xu Chenghou heard this and hurriedly stopped him.
Just kidding, there are more than 20 people in their big family, how can they stay for dinner? How much food is enough for that?
It was agreed when they came that they would either go to Qingshangou Township or live in Huanren City at night.
If three or five people come back, it will be easy to say.
There are more than twenty people, young and old, how thick-skinned is it to eat and drink in other people's houses?
"Uncle, you look down on your eldest nephew, don't you?
Even if your eldest nephew's life is a little bit worse, he can't even afford a meal, right?
I can tell you, if someone leaves today, I will not be happy. "
When Xu Shiquan heard this, was it okay? I was anxious at that time.
Northeast people are like this, regardless of whether the family is rich or poor, they can't do errands.
My relatives come back from a long distance, if they don’t stay for a meal, the neighbors will have to poke his back when they go out, what’s the deal?
Xu Chenghou was about to say something, when suddenly he heard the dog outside barking again.
Then, someone spoke loudly outside.
"Uncle Xu, is your house a visitor? Where did you come from?
Good guy, this is a big show, five cars are parked at Mizoguchi.
There are sedan chairs and jeeps, where is this a big cadre? "The man outside had a loud voice, yelling as he stood at the gate.
Xu Shiquan was stunned for a moment, and then looked at brother Xu Shixian opposite.
Did you drive back? Don't you take a bus by train?
God, this is not an ordinary person, is it a sedan chair or a jeep?
"Uncle, are the younger brothers driving back?"
Xu Shiquan quickly winked at his daughter-in-law and asked her to go out and see who was outside.
"Boss, where did you park your car? Didn't you just park on the road?
Don’t block the way and make things difficult for others. "
Xu Chenghou didn't answer his nephew's question directly, but instead turned to ask his sons.
"Dad, how could we do that, there is an open space just across the mouth of the ditch, and we parked the car there."
Brother Xu Shixian quickly explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 691: The pomp is a bit big
chapters.content:
Chapter 691 The scene is a bit big
Father and son didn't answer Xu Shiquan's question, but their question and answer was like an indirect answer.
The cars were driven by them. Five cars are at the mouth of Shijiagou.
Xu Shiquan immediately stood up, "Uncle, tell me, what do these younger brothers do?
Why are you still driving? Is it a sedan chair or a jeep? "
In these years, people who can drive are either officials or wealthy businessmen, and ordinary people can't even touch it.
Isn't Xu Shiquan excited that five cars came back at once?
Before Xu Chenghou could elaborate, Hu Chunhua had already led two people in from the outside.
"The person in charge is our village party secretary, Fuhai."
"Oh, it's Fuhai, come in quickly.
It’s my house, this is my uncle, from Fusong.
Speaking of it, you may not know it, but your father must know it. It is the one under the hurdle of my family.
Moved away more than 30 years ago, didn't you bring your children and grandchildren back to have a look? "
As soon as Xu Shiquan saw the visitor, he hurriedly stood up and beckoned him to enter the house.
"Uncle, this is Jiang Fuhai, the Party Secretary of our Yinkuangzi Village.
You know his father, he is my big brother Chunzhu.
I remember that you used to have a good relationship. It seems that the Jiang family is still somewhat related to my aunt, right? "Xu Shiquan quickly introduced to both parties.
When it comes to Jiang Fuhai, Xu Chenghou may not be able to remember it.
But when it comes to Jiang Chunzhu, of course he remembers that he is a partner who grew up with him naked, so can he forget?
"Oh, this is Fuhai from Zhuzi's family? He was only three or four years old when I left, and he doesn't remember much.
Good luck, this is the village party secretary. "
When Xu Shiquan said this, Xu Chenghou remembered who it was.
The eldest of Jiang Chunzhu's family played with Xu Shixian and the others back then.
"Master Xu? Oh, I know, my dad mentioned it."
This ye means grandpa, not grandpa or other titles.
"The co-author is you coming back from old age? Good guy, this whole scene is too big.
I was resting at home at noon, and a few boys came to my house, saying that some big cadres seemed to come from our village.
There are five cars in a row, which are sedan chairs and jeeps.
I thought it was the superiors who came to inspect, so I hurried out to inquire.
I saw that the car was parked at the mouth of Shijiagou. I went door-to-door to inquire, and I kept asking where my Uncle Xu was. "
Xu Chenghou is in Yinkuangzi Village. He is considered senior. Many people who are about his age have to call him uncle.
The same goes for Jiang Chunzhu, who calls Xu Chenghou uncle, so his son has to call Xu Chenghou grandpa.
The smaller the village, the more they pay attention to these things, but they dare not shout.
"Did those cars come from your hometown?
Master Xu, how big a cadre must your family be? Can drive a car to go out? "Jiang Fuhai asked with a look of shock and curiosity.
He really couldn't figure out what kind of family could drive five cars out at once.
This is too scary, what kind of official is this?
Xu Chenghou really didn't think so much.
At the beginning, my son suggested that I would drive back to my hometown, and it would be convenient to not have to reverse the car several times on the way.
Xu Chenghou thought about it. The place of his hometown is remote, and it is troublesome to go back by train and car. There are twenty people in their family, which is too much trouble.
It’s better to drive at home, you can stop wherever you go, and you can stop wherever you want, so the old man agreed.
The key point is that there are several cars at home, and they usually drive when their son and daughter-in-law go out to run errands. Xu Chenghou is used to it and doesn't feel uncomfortable.
He forgot, where is the silver mine? In the remote small valley, there are very few outsiders.
If a visitor comes to someone's house, the whole village will know it before the evening.
Once these five cars entered the village, the news spread quickly? It's all fresh.
Xu Chenghou glanced at Xu Shiyan, meaning to ask his son if he could speak.
Xu Shiyan understood the look in his father's eyes, and nodded with a smile.
It means to say, the more you hide it at this time, the more people will think about it?
Having said that, they know what's going on, so they don't think it's a big deal.
"Ahem, that, it's actually nothing.
These are the few in the family, the eldest and the fifth work in the county, and they drive the car of the unit.
The fourth child works in the financial office of the village, and the second child works in a breeding farm, which specializes in raising deer and musk deer. "
The old man didn't want to brag, so he tried to understate it as much as possible.
"The third child used to be the director of the state-owned ginseng farm, but now the ginseng farm has become a ginseng company. He is the general manager and is under the management of the city.
Cough, that's all it is, they are all public cars, isn't it convenient to drive back? "
What can I say? As for the two cars, one was rewarded by the province, and the other was bought by his daughter-in-law herself?
If you say that, wouldn't Jiang Fuhai and Xu Shiquan be even more surprised?
Come on, it's best to keep a low profile, so as not to cause trouble.
Even if they said that, Jiang Fuhai and Xu Shiquan were so surprised that their jaws almost dropped.
Xu Shiquan may not understand these things, but Jiang Fuhai does.
Units that can allocate cars must be at least department-level.
Even if the car is not equipped, but borrowed from the unit, the relationship is very strong, and the celebrity in the unit can do it.
The general manager of a company under the management of the city seems to be the deputy chief at the very least, and generally has to be the principal.
Okay, this has caught up with the top leaders in the county, no wonder there is such a big show, the old Xu family has a high-ranking official.
"Well, Uncle Xu, you chat with my Master Xu first, I'll go home and talk to my father first.
If my father knew, my Master Xu was back, and he would be so happy that he couldn't sleep. "
How can Jiang Fuhai sit still at this time? Get up quickly.
"Master Xu, you sit at my uncle Xu's house first, and I will find my father.
Also, go to my house tonight, let's get together and have some delicious food, and give my Master Xu and a few uncles a clean slate. "
After Jiang Fuhai finished speaking, before Xu Shiquan and Xu Chenghou could speak, he left Xu's house in a flash.
The young man who came with him chased after him, but failed to catch up.
Xu Chenghou was dumbfounded. This Jiang Fuhai ran too fast, right?
This incident caused trouble, and he just wanted to come back to worship his ancestors. There was really no other meaning.
It was Xu Shiquan who smiled.
"Look, let me just say, my uncle is back, can I let you live elsewhere?
Let’s stay at night, I don’t have enough room here, isn’t there a few more in Shijiagou?
They are all old neighbors from the past, you just watch, the safekeeping will come to see my uncle in a while. "
That's not necessarily to see Xu Chenghou, but mainly to see what kind of family can drive five cars.
What else can Xu Chenghou say? It's all here, and these old neighbors and old neighbors haven't met yet, so let's wait a while.
"San'er, why don't you go and see our car?
Check that the place where you stop is not in the way, but don't delay other people's work or something. "
Xu Chenghou gave Xu Shiyan a wink and told him to drive to buy something to eat and come back.
Silver Mine is poorer than Donggang Songjianghe, and every household is struggling.
Then let the big guys come out to entertain them? Hurry up and buy some meat or fish.
There is delicious food all night, even if the big guys get together to have fun.

chapters.title: Chapter 692: meet old friends
chapters.content:
Chapter 692 Meeting old friends
Xu Shiyan has been by Dad's side for so many years, how can he not even have such a tacit understanding?
As soon as he heard what his father said, he immediately stood up, "Okay, then I'll go and have a look."
Su Anying also stood up when she heard this.
"Well, let me go with you, the car I parked just now may have been too far out."
So, the husband and wife left Xu Shi's family together, and walked all the way downhill to Mizoguchi,
When I came outside, I saw many people standing around the five cars of my family, all looking at the car curiously.
Xu Shiyan and his wife squeezed through the crowd and nodded towards them.
"Everyone in the neighborhood, we are from the old Xu's family in Shijiagou.
Well, please give way to the big guy, and we will drive out. "
There are so many people surrounding the car, why go out?
Everyone saw that the owner of the car was coming, so they quickly got out of the way.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying drove back along the original road and went straight to Huanren.
Qingshangou Township is not too big, and there are probably not many things to buy, so there is no need to waste time there, let's go straight to the county seat.
Xu Shiyan and his wife went shopping in the county without mentioning it, only talking about this side.
Not long after Xu Shiyan and his wife left, several groups of people from Xu Shiquan's family came.
Jiang Chunzhu, Jiang Fuhai's father, and several old friends Xu Chenghou got along with before.
It's Zhao Tieniu and Li Dashuan, I don't know if it's a nickname or a name.
Anyway, this group of old men got together, ouch, don't mention it, everyone was so excited that they almost hugged and cried.
"Just now I heard from our eldest son that Master Xu is back.
I'm still wondering, where does such a master Xu come from? It was only after I said this that I realized that it was my Uncle Xu who had returned. "
Jiang Chunzhu sat down next to Xu Chenghou, and said with great emotion.
"How many years do you think you have been away? It seems that you only come back once in six years or so? You haven't come back since then.
伱If you don’t come back again, we old fellows will all have no way to go. "
"Isn't it something?
I'm staying at home. I heard from my grandson that we parked several cars in Mizoguchi, and I don't know where the cadres came.
I was thinking about going out to take a look, when I happened to meet Chun Zhu, who said Uncle Xu had returned.
I really didn't expect that Uncle Xu and his family are back, it's really lively. "
Li Dashuan, who spoke, also lived in Shijiagou, the first one.
This Li Dashuan and Xu Chenghou are neighbors, and they got along very well back then.
So when Jiang Chunzhu said that Xu Chenghou was back, he quickly followed.
"Oh, I always wanted to come back, but I didn't have a team a few years ago, and there was a lot of farm work in the field, so I couldn't wait for a long time.
Besides, life was tight in those years, and it was really not easy to come back.
Anyway, now that I am old, I don’t work any more, so no one cares about me.
Isn't this just thinking of taking the children back to have a look while I can still move? "
Xu Chenghou was also very excited when he saw these former partners. After finally calming down, he sat there chatting with these people.
Xu Shiquan’s family’s room was originally small. There were more than 20 members of Xu’s family in the room, and many people came later, it was too crowded.
Seeing this, Zhou Guilan left Mr. Xu Chenghou and the others in the east room to chat and chat with others.
She led her daughter-in-law and grandchildren out of the house, sat in the yard, and chatted with Hu Chunhua and the neighbors in front of her.
"Auntie, how have you been in Fusong all these years? You must have had a good life, right?
Your natal family seems to be in Fusong too, right?
These years, I haven’t seen them come back. What’s going on at home, is my aunt still there? "
It was Jiang Fuhai's mother who was speaking, Jiang Chunzhu's daughter-in-law.
The Zhou family used to live in Jiangjiabaozi. Zhou Guilan's mother's surname was Jiang, and she was of the same clan as Jiang Chunzhu's grandfather.
So, Jiang Chunzhu's family is related to Zhou's family, and Zhou Anping is called uncle, and Zhou Guilan has to be called aunt.
But Jiang Chunzhu's family has a very good relationship with Xu Chenghou's family, even before Zhou Guilan married.
So after Zhou Guilan married into the Xu family, her address was changed, and Jiang Chunzhu and his wife both called her aunt.
"Not here, left in the summer of 1982." Mentioning the old lady of the Zhou family, Zhou Guilan couldn't help but sigh.
When the old lady was still sane, she always talked about coming back to have a look, but when she became crazy, she stopped talking about it.
At that time, the old lady passed away, and Zhou Anping and his brothers discussed whether it was necessary to send the old lady's bones back for burial.
There is also Zhou Huaimin's grave here, there is no one inside, just a few clothes or something, it can be regarded as a tomb of clothes.
Ordinarily, the old lady should be sent back to be buried together.
But think about it, how do you go back and forth after such a long journey? even
How much will it cost to send it back with the coffin? If the ashes were sent back after cremation, Zhou Anping and others would not accept it.
The idea of ​​the elders is to go to the ground for peace, burial, how can anyone be willing to be cremated?
So in the end we discussed, don't come back, let's bury it in the camp.
In the future, Qingming, July 15th, etc., it will be convenient to add soil to the grave.
"Oh, my aunt is not too young, so it's a happy death.
Then my uncle, are they all okay? There has been no movement in these years, and the letters have not been communicated. "
This uncle is talking about the Zhou Anping brothers.
"By the way, there is one thing that you may not know until you come back.
A few years ago, someone came back to our place to inquire about Lao Zhou’s family.
Inquire about my aunt and uncles, and ask where they have been.
I heard from others, it seems that those people are from the capital. "
Jiang Chunzhu's daughter-in-law suddenly remembered something and hurriedly told Zhou Guilan.
"From the capital? Ask about my mother and my brother? Our family doesn't have any relatives in the capital."
Zhou Guilan froze for a moment, a little confused about what Chunzhu's daughter-in-law meant.
Someone inquired about the whereabouts of the descendants of the Zhou family? You're still from the capital, what are you doing?
"I don't know what's going on, it was many years ago, June 7, June 8, right?
Anyway, that year was in chaos, everyone was afraid that someone was going to harm my aunt and the others, so they said they didn’t know where they were going. "
Chunzhu's daughter-in-law thought about it carefully, but she couldn't remember what happened. After all, it's been too long, who can remember so much?
It's been so long, it's useless to think about it now.
Zhou Guilan didn't bother to inquire about those, so she chatted with Chunzhu's wife and Hu Chunhua.
"Grandma, can we take a look around?"
Xu Jinfeng and the others were quite bored staying in this small courtyard, and they couldn't understand what their grandparents were talking about.
Sitting just doing this is boring, so I want to go out for a stroll.
"Go, er, this piece of mountain up is our family's, play whatever you want.
Unfortunately, there is nothing delicious at this time, the pears have not grown well, and the hawthorns are not good either, they are all green.
The chestnuts haven’t grown well yet, Taoyuanzi is not here.
Waiting for tomorrow, let your uncle take you to the Taoyuan to pick peaches and eat them. At this time, our peaches are in season. "
When Hu Chunhua heard this, she smiled and pointed to Xu Jinfeng and the others.
Most of the mountains here are the private mountains of each family.
Xu Chenghou and the others moved away, and the share was given to Xu Shiquan's father, and now they are all under Xu Shiquan's name.
The two families are together, quite a large area.

chapters.title: Chapter 693: foodie attribute
chapters.content:
Chapter 693 Foodie attribute
The children got permission, hula all ran out at once.
There is a small river ditch opposite the gate of Xu's house, formed by the spring water flowing down from the mountain.
The small river ditch is not too big, adults can walk across it with a big stride, and the water is not too deep.
The little ones were squatting on the stones by the river ditch, stretching out their hands to play with the river water.
"Brother, look quickly, there are small shrimps in here, so small. Come on, help me catch it."
Xu Haiqing pointed at the clear river water and exclaimed.
Xu Haiyuan came over and squatted down to take a closer look. Sure enough, there were a few transparent small river prawns swimming in the water between the rocks.
"Such a small thing, why are you grabbing it? Eat it?"
His younger brother is a real foodie, but such a small shrimp is not enough to fit between the teeth, isn't it a bit too much?
"Brother, no matter how much I love to eat, I can't eat such a small thing, right? It's just for fun."
Xu Haiqing pouted, who do you think he is?
Such a small shrimp, and there are only a few of them, how can he eat them?
The dialogue between the two brothers made everyone laugh.
