"Come on, let's take a stroll up that mountain, isn't it said that there are chestnut trees over there?
We don’t have this stuff there, go over and see what it looks like. "Xu Haibo said, pointing to the forest in the distance.
Indeed, there is no such thing as chestnut in Fusong.
Everyone has eaten chestnuts, but I have never seen a chestnut tree, so they all became interested and walked up the mountain over there.
The mountain here is different from the mountain at home.
The mountain at home is huge, and there are many mountains that stretch for dozens of miles, so most of the mountains are flat and the slopes are relatively gentle.
The mountains here are small, and each one is quite steep.
And this Shijiagou is worthy of its name, the mountain is full of stones.
Even in a large field, you can see a lot of stones.
The crops in that field should be quite tall at this time, but the growth of the crops here is very ordinary, and it seems that the soil fertility is not enough.
"No wonder my grandfather said that when the Shijiagou side is shoveling the ground, the mountain can hear the shoveling.
Look at this mountain full of stones.
The crops here are much worse than ours.
I don’t know how those grandparents stayed in such a place?
Since we have all gone to the northeast, why don't we go north again? "Xu Haitao muttered as he walked.
The children have heard from their family members that where is the ancestor of the old Xu family, because they moved here.
But why did you choose such a place? Everyone doesn't understand.
"Second brother, when Qilu people went to the Guandong, one of them took land, that is, went through Shanhaiguan to go outside the pass, and the other took a boat by sea.
Generally speaking, if the wind is smooth, it will be there in one day and one night.
Most of the sea roads go to places like Dalian and Yingkou. "
Xu Jinping has read the relevant information, and has a little understanding of this.
“The boats at that time were not like big boats now, but ordinary small fishing boats.
If you catch up with the wind and the water is smooth, you can float to the right place. If you catch the wind in the wrong direction, you may not know where you will go, and some of them will go to the Sea of ​​Japan.
It's not bad to go ashore wherever you drift, but I don't know how many people died in the sea directly. "
The situation at sea is unpredictable, and no one can say this kind of thing.
"Our ancestors were fishermen, why do you think they came here? It must be by boat.
It is beyond their control to drift this way by boat, and it will be wherever it goes.
Maybe someone from our ancestors drifted to Dandong.
Then I found a random place to settle down, and felt that I could still live on, which was better than my previous fishing life.
Then who will continue to move forward? "
Liao Province is the first stop for Qilu people to enter the Guandong, but no one wants to go north if they can gain a foothold here.
Further to the north, the mountains are high, the forests are dense and the wild animals are overgrown, which is too dangerous.
Although Shijiagou is not very rich, it has a small population, and the natural resources in those days were estimated to be rich enough.
In front of it is the Xiaoya River, and it is actually quite nice to be surrounded by mountains and rivers.
The farming society is self-sufficient, and it is quite good to have such a piece of forest land.
Regardless of how many years older Xu Haitao is than Xu Jinping, but when it comes to the ink in his belly, the three of them tied together can't keep up with Xu Jinping.
Xu Haitao rolled his eyes helplessly, "Well, I can't say no to you, you have a reason."
The people next to them listened to the conversation between the siblings and held back their laughter.
The whole family knows that Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, the monsters, love to read books, no matter what kind of knowledge they have dabbled in.
Whoever argues with the two of them will lose so badly?
Xu Haitao is considered sensible, if he continues, the brother and sister will be provoked to go to bed together.
It is estimated that everyone else is tied together, and they may not be able to speak of those two.
The bottom of the mountain is cultivated land, and the higher you go, there are forests. There are some pear trees and some hawthorn trees.
At this time, the fruit on the pear tree has not yet matured, and the hawthorn is also green with fruit, which is not very big yet.
There is no hawthorn in Fusong, only Shanlihong. The children compared the two plants and found that there are some differences between the two plants.
"Oh, what a pity, it would be nice if autumn came, and we could climb trees and pick pears.
Didn’t grandma say that the pears from my hometown are delicious?
It is said that when pears are picked in autumn, there must be someone underneath them with a sheet, otherwise the pears will break when touched. "
Xu Haiqing looked at the still green fruit on the pear tree and drooled.
He really wants to taste it. The sour, flat-topped, flower-covered pear, and fragrant pear that grandma said are all flavors.
Also, grandma said that frozen pears are actually a special variety called frozen pears.
That kind of pear cannot be eaten in autumn, it is sour and astringent and not tasty at all.
Waiting for the winter to be frozen, the pear meat is white and delicate, and the pear juice is sweet and sour, which is delicious.
Xu Haiqing really wanted to know, how delicious are those frozen pears?
How is it different from the frozen pears that are now common apple pears or flower-covered pears?
"Then wait for the autumn, you ask our dad to bring you back again.
What should I do? You can't live here until fall, either. "
Xu Jinping turned her head to look at her younger brother. This foodie has nothing on his mind, only thinking about eating.
This ability, I am convinced.
"Sister, I have to go to elementary school in autumn.
Besides, how busy our parents are in autumn, do they have the time to bring me back?
Cut, if I dare say it, their **** would have to be beaten into eight pieces. "
Xu Haiqing rubbed his butt, muttering in fear.
Does his sister think he is stupid? It's true that he likes to eat, but he has brains and is not stupid.
"Then what are you talking about? You came back to eat?" Xu Jinping glanced at her younger brother and snorted.
Xu Haiqing was about to say something more when he heard the brothers in front shouting.
"Come and see, what is this? Why do you have thorns all over your body? Is this a fruit?
A whole body of prickly fruit, how can I eat it? "
As soon as Xu Haiqing heard this, he couldn't care less about bickering with his sister, so he ran forward.
On the hillside ahead, there is a tree that you have never seen before.
There are thorns on the tree, and there are many green fur **** growing, and the fur **** are covered with thorns. What is this?
"This should be the chestnut that the aunt said? I read it in a book, and it said that the shell of the chestnut is full of thorns."
The guys have never seen chestnuts on the tree, so they can only guess.

chapters.title: Chapter 694: shocked a lot of people
chapters.content:
Chapter 694 shocked many people
The children have never seen chestnuts growing on trees, so they can only guess.
Xu Haitao simply found a shorter tree, and broke off a branch with fluffy fruit from it.
Then the children found stones or something, and gently smashed the thorny fur **** open, revealing the chestnuts that hadn't grown yet.
"It turns out that this chestnut has grown into such a virtue? I thought this thing was smooth on the tree."
When everyone saw the chestnuts inside, they suddenly realized that co-authorship is such a thing.
The pears are green, the hawthorns are not ripe, and the chestnuts are not growing well. The children feel that it is meaningless.
It was Xu Haiyuan who had a sharp eye, and noticed that there were dots of red in the bushes next to him. When he went over to look, it turned out to be a tray.
"Come on, there is a tray here, it's so big, it's bigger than the one over there, no wonder my grandma said."
Looking around, there is a large tray of seedlings in front of them, all bearing red fruits.
The fruit is really big, about the size of an adult's thumb, but much larger than the ones at home.
The children have come to their senses now, and went to the roadside to pick a few leaves of the old sow Henghenger, which are the seeds of Dali.
It is the same size as a cattail fan, which is just right for a tray.
These little guys were not afraid of getting stuck, they went into the bushes and started picking pallets.
This piece of Ershan belongs to Xu Shi's family. His children have all gone out, and no one goes up the mountain to pick up trays.
Now the children were caught, just like a big sweep, they were all picked.
The children were picking trays on the mountain. At this time, many people came down the mountain.
Among them are the secretary and head of Qingshangou Township. Needless to say, Jiang Fuhai must have called.
In fact, when Xu Shiyan and others drove past Qingshangou Township, someone saw it and reported it to the village head.
The township head was also asking, he was worried that he didn't know where the leader came from, so he went straight to the village.
While inquiring, I received a call from Jiang Fuhai, saying that old Xu's family from Shijiagou had come to visit relatives.
The ones from Fusong drove five cars, two sedan chairs and three jeeps.
Among those people, there are two department-level cadres who work in the county, and one is the general manager of a municipal state-owned enterprise.
The village head of Qingshangou immediately hung up the phone and found the secretary.
Once the two discussed it, this matter had to be reported to the police, and it could not be kept secret. So I called the county leaders again.
It’s no wonder that the cadres in the village are so mobilizing teachers and mobilizing the masses. How about Qingshangou, it’s really not a big place, and there may not be any cadres in a few years.
Don't care which province or county it is, people with identities like Xu Shiyan and the others rarely come to places like Qingshangou.
Besides, Jiang Fuhai said, the person who came was from Fusong.
Last winter, someone from Changtu came to collect live pigs.
The price given was not low, and hundreds of pigs were taken away at once. I heard that the pig farmers over there made a lot of money last year.
Also, Dandong is near the sea. Last winter, some people came to buy sea fish and prawns in large quantities.
The person who came to buy it happened to be someone from Fusong.
During the Chinese New Year, when the big guys heard the news, they were all envious.
If they also come here to buy something, wouldn't life be easier?
So when we heard that it was from Fusong, everyone's thoughts came alive.
Don't care about what they do, such a big cadre comes over and treats them well.
In the future, if you can get involved with Fusong, maybe you will be able to get some light?
It is not only the cadres of Qingshangou Township who have this idea, the county also received the call with the same idea.
So, the county ordered the secretary of Qingshangou Township to entertain them well, and arrange people to come over here immediately.
Just like that, when Xu Shiyan thought that he came out this time to be low-key and didn't disturb others, the cadres of Kuandian City hurriedly drove to Qingshangou.
I don’t blame them for being like this. It’s true that there are no good projects to get rich here in Kuandian.
In the past, Kuandian mainly focused on mining and smelting, and locally produced boron ore, magnesite, lead-zinc ore, copper ore, iron ore, etc.
Later, due to industrial adjustments, many mining and smelting enterprises lost money and were forced to close down.
In 1985, Niumaowu Township and Henan Kaifeng Chemical Factory jointly established a boric acid factory, which was considered a fairly large enterprise.
In the past, there were also chemical fertilizer factories in the county, but later the benefits were not good, and they all switched to producing borax one after another.
This mining industry is a non-renewable resource, and the more it is mined, the less reserves it has, and other local industries are not very developed.
In the past, tussah silkworms were raised here, and the silk in this county was mainly sold to Dandong.
But with the gradual reduction of forestry resources, the tussah breeding area is also getting smaller and smaller. The county silk factory has been merged into the second Dandong silk factory.
There are several canning factories in the whole county, producing several kinds of canned fruits.
But now this canned food is not what it used to be a few years ago, sales are not very good, and many canning factories are also facing difficulties in survival.
The cadres in the county are also worried. Who doesn't want the local people to live a good life?
But the environmental conditions are limited, and they can't do anything about it.
Everyone knows that Fusong produces ginseng. I heard that the ginseng export there can earn foreign exchange, and the people there are rich.
So I heard that someone came from Fusong, don't care who it is, just go and meet, maybe you will gain something, right?
So, when Xu Shiyan and Su Anying returned to Shijiagou with two cars purchased from Huanren, they saw several cars parked at the mouth of Shijiagou.
Xu Shiyan is still wondering, which one is here again?
It seems that Shijiagou is a very small place, and all the visitors come by car.
"Daughter-in-law, you wait here for a while, I'll go back and call for help to get things.
We bought these old food, we can't make it together alone. "
The two walked around Huanren City several times, dragging dozens of catties of pork.
I also bought cooked food such as roast chicken, roast duck, pork head meat, pork knuckles, and various types of pig offal.
I also met a fish seller, bought some more fish, and finally pulled some canned luncheon meat and braised pork from the store.
The two of them had food in the back seat and trunk of the car.
It’s so old, how can I expect them to get it back? Of course we have to go back and bring in reinforcements.
"Okay, then don't carry too much, it's quite heavy, and call the children over later and let them work."
Su Anying smiled, raising soldiers for a thousand days and using them for a while, now it's time for these little guys to show their skills.
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, he just padded the meat with newspapers and carried it on his shoulders.
Just stepping on the stone cannon step by step to walk inside.
Xu Shiyan struggled to carry the meat, and before he reached the gate of Xu Shi's family, he heard the commotion inside and outside the house.
Many people were talking loudly, as well as the laughter of children.
Xu Shiyan didn't think too much, and stepped into the yard.
"Xiaobo, Xiaotao, hurry up, I bought a lot of things, and led my brothers to help move everything in."
It was almost five o'clock, Xu Haibo and the others had already had enough fun to go down the mountain, and even ate up the trays they picked.
At this moment, the children were joking and playing in the garden. When they heard that they were asked to help move things, the children became energetic.
Hula stood up several times, and then ran out.
Xu Shiyan carried the meat and sent it to the kitchen.
"Oh, three brothers, don't you think this is too outlandish?
You have come all the way, why can’t your family afford food and drink for you, why are you still going out to buy meat? "
In the kitchen, Hu Chunhua had already slaughtered and plucked two chickens, and was about to chop them up and stew them in the pot.
Seeing Xu Shiyan coming in with a lot of meat, Hu Chunhua felt quite embarrassed. How could there be a guest coming in and bringing the meat himself?

chapters.title: Chapter 695: are fellow
chapters.content:
Chapter 695 are fellow villagers
"Sister-in-law, why did you really kill the chicken? The chicken is growing at this time, so it's a pity to kill it.
Let’s just grab some food, we’re not outsiders, and we don’t have to be particular about it. "Xu Shiyan put down the meat and said with a smile.
"What's the matter? My uncle and aunt led you all the way back, and you can fool me casually? Today this chicken must be killed.
Three brothers, you don’t have to worry about these, I’m busy here.
伱 Hurry into the house, many people came to the house today.
The secretary and head of our Qingshangou Township, the deputy secretary and deputy head of the county, all came.
The big guy was full just now, where can I find you, go into the house quickly. "
Hu Chunhua smiled nonchalantly, let alone more than a dozen chickens at home, even if there were only these two chickens, they had to be killed today to treat the guests.
"Huh? The county deputy secretary and deputy county magistrate are here? Why did this alarm people?"
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, what's going on?
This is not from the same province. It is purely a personal act for them to return to their hometown to worship their ancestors. Why did the leaders in Kuandian know about it?
"Sister-in-law, then you should be busy first, Yingzi and the others can get back a lot of things later."
Xu Shiyan explained, and hurried into the house.
Enter the room and take a look, okay, the East Room is quite lively.
In addition to Xu Chenghou, Xu Shiquan, and Xu Shixian brothers, as well as Jiang Fuhai, there are also several elderly men.
There are also four or five younger ones, who look like they are not ordinary old farmers, but should be the township or county cadres that Hu Chunhua said.
"Hey, Uncle San, where have you been? Where were we looking for you just now?
Hurry up, get on the kang and sit down, chatting with Master Xu about your participation in the field. When Jiang Fuhai saw Xu Shiyan, he hurriedly got up.
"Secretary Qu, County Magistrate Gao, this is my Third Uncle Xu, the general manager of Hunjiang Oriental Ginseng Company."
"Third Uncle, these two are Secretary Qu and County Magistrate Gao of our county.
As soon as I heard that Master Xu brought some uncles back, he came here from the county, just to meet the third uncle. "
When Xu Shiyan was not around, Jiang Fuhai had already found out everything, and now he introduced it to both parties with a smile on his face.
"Hello Mr. Xu, I have heard of your name for a long time.
Mr. Xu leads your company, making foreign exchange records at the Spring Fair year after year, which is really enviable. "
Qu Jiacheng and Gao Mingyuan got up quickly and shook hands with Xu Shiyan respectively.
In the small county town of Kuandian, there are no foreign exchange-earning products that can be sold, so Qu Jiacheng and the others have never participated in the Spring Fair.
But these cadres in the county are very concerned about these things.
Not to mention other places, the provinces will send a document to each county on the annual foreign exchange earnings of the three eastern provinces.
The intention is naturally to let the leading cadres of each county refer to the content in detail and learn from others.
Try to find a few projects that can be sold, go to the Spring Fair to show them, and get some foreign exchange back.
As soon as Fusong took part in the fair, today's participating companies have performed extremely well in the Spring Fair year after year.
The record of earning foreign exchange is not only within Jilin Province, but even in the entire three eastern provinces, this performance is also at the top.
Others don’t know, but the cadres in these counties must have heard of it.
Before they came, they thought about coming over to have a look and chat. It would be best if they could establish a relationship.
Even if you can't climb anything right now, getting to know more people may be useful in the future.
When they came here to inquire, the two of them were also taken aback. They didn't expect this powerful man to come.
Why don't you take the opportunity to build a good relationship with them?
"Hello, Secretary Qu, and County Magistrate Gao.
I just went back to my hometown with my parents to take a look. I really didn't expect to alarm the two of you. I'm really sorry. "
The other party was very enthusiastic, so Xu Shiyan naturally couldn't hold it, and replied with a busy smile.
"Don't, don't, don't call me a secretary or county magistrate.
Well, both of us may be a little older than you, so I will call you brother today, and you can call me Brother Qu, just call him Brother Gao.
Otherwise, you call me Lao Qu and Lao Gao. When Qu Jiacheng heard this, he quickly waved his hands.
He has a higher level than him, how can he let people call his position again, no good no.
"Look, you've said it all, this is coming back to my hometown, right? Aren't the people in my hometown all relatives?
Let's not talk about those, just treat them as relatives. "With Qu Jiacheng's attitude, don't mention how enthusiastic he is.
"That's right, what Lao Qu said is right, we are all from Kuandian, the mountains are not close to the water, and the water is not close to people.
You are coming home, don't look outside. "Here, Gao Mingyuan also echoed.
People are so enthusiastic, what can Xu Shiyan say? Then I can only accept it.
"Okay, then I won't be polite to Brother Qu and Brother Gao."
When others give you a face, you have to follow it, and you can’t drop it on the ground.
It’s all said and done, if Xu Shiyan backs down again, it’s not called modesty, it’s not giving people face.
Sure enough, after Xu Shiyan agreed, Qu Jiacheng and Gao Mingyuan laughed even happier.
The three of them sat down again and chatted casually.
When you first meet, you must not talk about any real problems, just rambling in vernacular.
Qu Jiacheng asked Xu Shiyan and the others where to stay at night, or if not, they might as well live in the county town, where he arranged the best guest house.
Xu Shiyan could only refuse with a smile, saying that he just came back today, and he has promised his brother to stay at home tonight.
"Brother Qu, Brother Gao, just right, I just went to buy some food and drink.
Let my daughter-in-law cook a few dishes later, don't leave at night, let's have some drinks. "
Kuandian City is quite far away, people come all the way here, it’s already this time, so we must save food.
"Fuhai, and these few comrades, don't leave at night, stay here to eat, it's prepared temporarily, just don't dislike it."
These people came for Xu Shiyan and the others, and Xu Shiyan didn't show politeness to his cousin, he just opened his mouth and left everyone for dinner.
Xu Shiquan on the other end also nodded repeatedly, "Yes, yes, I'll just tell the kid's mother, hurry up and prepare some good dishes."
Except for Jiang Fuhai who had eaten at Xu's house, let alone the two in the county, even a few cadres in the township, it would be a great thing for them to come to his house for dinner.
Xu Shiquan never thought in his life that the county magistrate and secretary could come to his house?
Now let alone a few chickens, he would be happy even if he could kill the pigs raised at home to entertain guests.
As Xu Shiquan said, he was about to go to the kitchen.
At this time, Su Anying led her nephew and sons, and also came in from the outside.
I saw the children carrying a lot of things on their backs like ants moving house.
"Oh my god, brother and sister, what are you doing? Why are you ordering so much food?"
Xu Shiquan was surprised when he saw the food, but also heaved a sigh of relief.
The people who came to the house tonight were of unusual identities, and just now he was thinking about what kind of hard food to entertain.
Looking at what Su Anying and the others brought in, there is no need to worry, they have thought of everything and prepared so much.
"Not many, so many people are eating, why don't you prepare more?
Brother, you are busy. My sister-in-law and I will cook together. We will have dinner later. "
As Su Anying said, she put down everything in her hand, and then went into the kitchen to help Hu Chunhua with work.
Xue Xiulin and the others who were sitting and chatting outside saw it, and hurried into the kitchen to work.

chapters.title: Chapter 696: Deliberately test
chapters.content:
Chapter 696 Intentional Exploration
It was hot in summer, and there were too many fires on the kang, so it was too hot, so Xu Shiquan set up a pot in the yard.
There are still two pots in the kitchen, so I don’t care about those at the moment, I will use them all.
The pot of stewed chicken outside, the pot of stewed fish in the kitchen, and the other pot of fried vegetables.
With Su Anying and the others buying these meat and cooked food, cooking is naturally much easier.
All kinds of cooked food should be cut and torn, and put on the plate directly after finishing.
Go to the vegetable garden to pull some green vegetables casually, come back to wash and fry a few, and the meal will come out in the evening.
The only thing that takes a lot of effort is the chicken. It needs to be stewed for a while, and the vermicelli can be added after the chicken is stewed.
Don’t even think about mushrooms, last autumn’s mushrooms were eaten up in winter.
Besides, it doesn’t matter if you don’t finish eating. By this time, it would have been eaten away by bugs.
It's almost seven o'clock after this busy meal.
Xu Shiquan led the people and borrowed all the tables and chairs from the Shijiagou houses.
The tables are set up in the east and west houses and the outside area, and all kinds of delicious food are served.
In the east room, several older people, together with village cadres, Qu Jiacheng, Gao Mingyuan and others, accompanied Xu Chenghou and his son.
In the outer room, several neighbors from Shijiagou sat, as well as the drivers of Qu Jiacheng and Gao Mingyuan.
The neighbors are all old acquaintances. When they learned that Xu Chenghou brought his family back, he came here specially and decided to keep them for dinner.
Not to mention the driver, it must be treated well.
Westing two tables, Hu Chunhua and Jiang Chunzhu's daughter-in-law accompanied Zhou Guilan's mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, as well as the Xu family's children.
The dinner is very rich. In addition to stewed chicken and stewed fish, there are several kinds of cooked food and canned food.
Add a few stir-fried green vegetables and cold salad, which is no worse than what you eat in a restaurant.
In the east room, the Xu family brothers sat at a table with Qu Jiacheng and others.
When it comes to the wine table, it doesn’t matter about that, brother and brother let go of the address, and it’s also possible to pour wine with your neck around your neck when the drink is hot.
"Brother Xu, do you think we are your hometown? Do we count as your hometown?
The life of the fellow is not good, can you help me think about it? "
After drinking a certain amount of wine, people no longer have any scruples. Qu Jiacheng put his arms around Xu Shiyan's neck and chatted with Xu Shiyan.
"Brother Qu, I really can't promise you anything about this right now.
The point is, I have never been back here, and I don’t know much about our place.
No matter what you develop, it is not a matter of rush, take your time. "
Actually, Xu Shiyan knew that Qu Jiacheng didn't drink too much, but he just said so by using wine to cover his face.
If there is no excuse for this wine, the people who just met in the afternoon can't mention these things no matter what.
Qu Jiacheng can mention it with the help of alcohol, but Xu Shiyan can't rely on drinking and just talk nonsense.
For a manly man, what he says must count, is he still called a man?
But Xu Shiyan really doesn't know much about his hometown, he heard it from his parents before.
From those stories, I really can't hear any useful information, so Xu Shiyan didn't dare to agree indiscriminately.
"Then when you come back this time, you will stay in your hometown for a few more days and walk around more, won't you be familiar with it?"
Qu Jiacheng understood what Xu Shiyan meant, but he still didn't give up.
He is a native of Kuandian, can he not think about the development of his hometown?
Finally got an opportunity, how could I miss it?
"Brother, let me ponder this matter, I really can't give you any answer now.
This time you came back, as you can see, this is a big family, the brothers all have jobs, no one can take too long vacation. "
Xu Shiyan was a little embarrassed, not that he didn't want to help his hometown get rich, the key was that he didn't know how to help.
The tourism resources here are not bad. There is a Qingshan Lake in Qingshangou, which is said to be good.
When I came back in 2016 in my previous life, every household in Qingshangou Township was a farmhouse.
They came and went in a hurry that time, and they didn’t have a chance to visit Qingshan Lake, and they didn’t even know what Qingshan Lake looked like.
It’s too early to talk about tourism development. Most people don’t have a good life yet. How can they have the money to travel?
As for the others, Xu Shiyan really doesn't know what special products are available here. If he doesn't understand, how can he give an idea?
"Brother, I can see that you are a real person."
Qu Jiacheng still put his arms around Xu Shiyan's neck, and laughed when he heard this.
"If it's someone else, how can you fool us if you don't keep it all together? My brother is honest, he's not playing tricks, he's a good person.
Just for you, come on, let's have another drink. "
Qu Jiacheng can get to where he is today, is that an ordinary person?
Even if he was anxious to help the county get rid of poverty and become rich, he wouldn't be so reckless?
Half of what I said just now must be a deliberate temptation.
I just want to know what kind of person this Xu Shiyan, who is said to be a foreign exchange earner in Jilin province, is, and whether someone else made it up.
After this attempt, I dare not say anything else. This person must be down-to-earth and practical.
Qu Jiacheng has a better impression of Xu Shiyan, so he must drag Xu Shiyan to have another drink together.
Drinking business, as long as there is no mention of investment, no mention of cooperation, and just drinking, Xu Shiyan is still happy.
In fact, it is not impossible to cooperate, but how to cooperate and what projects can be cooperated must be cautious.
Never drink happily on the wine table, just pat the table and make the decision.
"Come on, Brother Qu and Brother Gao, let me offer you a toast.
For nothing else, I rushed all the way to the two of you, and I had to drink one. "
Now, it was Xu Shiyan who dragged him to drink, one cup on the left and one cup on the right. It was true that he did not drink less.
The big guys didn't talk about anything serious, they just chatted with each other.
Qu Jiacheng, Gao Mingyuan, and the cadres in Qingshangou Township, intentionally or unintentionally, recommended to Xu Shiyan local places to visit, what to eat, what specialties and so on.
Didn't Xu Shiyan say that he didn't understand this place? Then tell him.
Xu Shiyan didn't point it out, just listened with a smile, and asked a few questions from time to time, neither abrupt nor too indifferent.
Xu Shixian and the others over there also ate and drank while listening, and occasionally Xu Shixian could still say a few words.
After all, when the Xu family moved away, he was quite old, and he still had some things in his memory.
No matter what you say, the atmosphere of this banquet is quite good. Everyone eats, drinks, chats and laughs, and the time passes without knowing it.
It was nearly nine o'clock when Qu Jiacheng and others said, stop drinking, it's getting late, and they have to go back to Kuandian.
In Qingshangou Township, can the county magistrate and secretary go back at night? That must be kept.
So he said that the guest house in the village had already made arrangements for Qu Jiacheng and Gao Mingyuan to live in the guest house.
Both Qu Jiacheng and Gao Mingyuan drank a lot, and besides, it was so late, when they drove back to Kuandian, it would be almost midnight, right?
So the two pushed their boats along the way and decided to live in a guest house in the countryside.
"Brother, it's rare for uncles and aunts to come back, stay for a few more days, and leave when you have enough.
Take a walk around here when you are free. The scenery over our Qingshan Lake is also good, so you can go for a stroll.
It's getting late, so let's go back first, and call later if we have anything to do. Qu Jiacheng patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and said.
"Uncle, let's go first then.
When you finish your work here, you must go to the county town and I will arrange it, okay? "Gao Mingyuan, talking to Xu Chenghou.

chapters.title: Chapter 697: ancestor worship
chapters.content:
Chapter 697 Ancestor Worship
After sending away Qu Jiacheng, Gao Mingyuan, and the cadres of Qingshangou Township, Jiang Fuhai and others helped send back the tables, chairs and other objects to each family.
Then arranged for the members of the Xu family to stay.
Xu Chenghou and his wife lived in the east room with Xu Shiquan and his wife, while Xu Shixian lived in the west room with his wife and children.
Xu Shian and his brothers lived in other families in Shijiagou with their wives and children.
It is more convenient to live separately. After all, although each family has enough space to live in, it does not necessarily have so many bedding.
The children had a good time playing during the day, but they slept late, and they slept soundly this night.
When I woke up in the morning, I had a few mosquito bags on my body.
This is also normal. There are many mountains and forests in Shijiagou, and there must be many mosquitoes.
Xu Shiyan saw the children scratching in pain and itchiness, so he told them to wash their faces quickly, and put medicine on their faces after washing.
In the past, at the end of Shijiagou, there were very few people with washbasins at home.
There is a small river ditch in front of the door. No matter whether it is spring, summer, autumn or winter, you can wash your face as soon as you go out and squat by the river.
Now that life is better, there is a washbasin at home, but I seldom use it.
Following Hu Chunhua's instructions, the children squatted on the edge of the small river, and washed their faces with two handfuls of water.
The water in the ditch is clear and cold. After washing my face, I wake up immediately, which is very comfortable.
After the children finished washing their faces, Xu Shiyan took out the ointment and applied it on them.
Not to mention, after the ointment is applied, it feels cool and cool, and it doesn't itch so much.
The children are all skinny, so they don't care about that, they are playing around in the garden.
Breakfast was eaten at Xu Shiquan's side. After dinner, Xu Shixian and others went to the village store and bought some incense, burning paper and other items.
The people took their things and followed the path that Xu Haibo and the others took up the mountain yesterday, turned south, and came to the Xu family's ancestral grave.
Several generations of the Xu family are buried here. Xu Shiquan's parents are currently at the bottom, and Xu Chenghou's parents are in the row above.
It is different from the customs in Donggang. The graves here are very small, and the small graves are very inconspicuous.
There is no stele in front of the grave, except for the tomb gate built with three stones, there is nothing else.
Xu Shixian and the others were puzzled, so they asked Guilan next week in a low voice. Zhou Guilan said that this is the custom here.
Xu Chenghou led his children and grandchildren to the grave of his parents, placed offerings, lit incense and burned paper.
In front of the other graves, some burnt paper was also distributed.
The old man was still murmuring something.
It is nothing more than asking parents to forgive him for not being able to come back these years.
Then, let the sons come forward and introduce them one by one. As for the grandchildren, they are not even adults yet, so don’t come forward.
"Father, mother, I have brought my son and grandson back to see you.
Old Xu's family is really promising in this generation.
The son was foolish and ruined his family business, so he had to leave his hometown and go to Fusong.
At any rate, it is a way out, and the children also have jobs and prospects.
If parents know about it, they will bless their children to be prosperous and promising in the future. "
As Xu Chenghou spoke, he fiddled with the pile of burnt paper with a stick.
Most of the burnt paper in this year is still the kind of thick grass paper, which smokes a lot when it is lit.
Maybe because of the smoke, Xu Chenghou's eyes were a little red, so he raised his hand to wipe the corners of his eyes.
Xu Shixian and others saw this, hurried forward and helped Xu Chenghou to stand up.
Then he took the stick in Xu Chenghou's hand, and fiddled with the burning paper bit by bit, so that the burning paper could be fully burned.
After all the paper is burnt and turned into black ash, use a stick to poke it away to ensure that no sparks are left.
Although the vegetation is lush in July, it is generally not easy to catch fire, so you have to be careful, in case something happens, it will be terrible.
"Come on, kowtow to your grandparents."
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were in front, brothers Xu Shixian led their wives in the second row, and Xu Jinfeng and Xu Haibo led their brothers and sisters in the third row.
Together they kowtowed three times to the ancestors of the Xu family before getting up.
Xu Chenghou spilled wine in front of the grave, and Zhou Guilan also took apart the offerings, that's what it meant.
The ancestor worship ceremony is not very complicated, and it will be over here.
Xu Chenghou muttered a few more words, and then walked back with his children and grandchildren.
There is another small grave on the way, where Xu Chenghou's first daughter-in-law is buried.
died at a young age, unable to enter the ancestral grave, so buried outside.
Xu Chenghou stepped forward to burn some paper, didn't say anything, just watched the paper burnt quietly, Xu Shixian and the others came over to salute, and everyone went down the mountain together.
After visiting the grave to worship the ancestors, the purpose of this trip to my hometown has been achieved, so I don’t have much thought, so I should go back.
Which one would have thought, before they were about to leave, Qu Jiacheng and Gao Mingyuan hurried over again.
"Uncle Xu, brother Xu, that, you must go to the county today.
Dandong called just now, and someone will be arranged to answer it.
The leader said, no matter what I say today, I can’t let you just leave like this. "
It turned out that the two drank a lot last night and woke up late this morning.
After breakfast, Qu Jiacheng thought about it, so he called the city and talked to the leader.
As a result, when the city leaders heard this, they immediately said that Qu Jiacheng and the others must keep the person behind, and they will arrange someone to come and pick them up.
You must know that last winter, Yishenchang imported a lot of seafood from Dandong, and the price was not low.
Those fishermen who went out to sea took the money and had a good year.
It is said that Xu Shiyan is here, so the leaders of the relevant departments should not invite Xu Shiyan to sit down, have a meal and chatter or something?
Not to mention anything else, if I can buy another batch of seafood this winter, wouldn’t I be able to earn another fortune?
So let Qu Jiacheng and the others over there, make sure to keep Xu Shiyan and his party behind, and let them go without saying anything.
Qu Jiacheng and others received the task assigned by the leader, so what are they talking about? Hurry up and drive over, just in time.
Xu Shiyan and his party originally planned to say goodbye to Xu Shiquan and the others, and then go to Qingshan Lake to have a look.
Walk around for a stroll, and stay in Huanren at night.
Get up early tomorrow and go back to Tonghua, then go to Yuhuang Mountain to have a look, and you will be home the day after tomorrow.
Who would have thought that before they left, Qu Jiacheng and the others came back and said they would come from the city to pick them up.
Xu Shiyan was also very helpless when he made such a commotion. When he came out this time, no one who said it was Niao Qinger was alarmed, but no one escaped.
"Brother, how many days have you all asked for leave? Can you go back later?
How about you go back first? How many more days will I stay here with my parents? "
It’s easy to say anything else, the key point is that Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang both borrowed cars from their units, so how can it be said that they were delayed outside for too long?
"I just took four days off." Xu Shixian and the others looked at each other and said.
July 15th is a Saturday. There is no such thing as weekends and months this year, only Sundays.
So they all invited Saturday, and Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, a total of four days.
Originally, I thought it would be a total of five days including Sunday, and it would be quite easy to play back and forth on the road.
But no one expected that these situations would happen.
If we go to Dandong again, we may not be able to go back someday. How can this work?
The holiday can be extended if you talk about it. This car is not good. How can you drive the car of the unit for several days without going back?

chapters.title: Chapter 698: Legend of Qingshan Lake
chapters.content:
Chapter 698 The Legend of Qingshan Lake
"That's it, this morning, it's still according to our original plan.
Go to Qingshan Lake first, and lead the children to play for a while.
You go back in the afternoon, and we will take our parents to Kuandian City, and we will stay here for a few more days.
Our father and mother are at this age, it is not easy to come out for a trip. "Xu Shiyan pondered for a while, and he could only arrange it this way.
My parents are getting old, so if I come out for this trip, I am afraid that there will be no chance to come out again in the future.
Even if they have time, the old man's body can't help tossing.
Simply hang around with the elders. Anyway, the children are on vacation, and Xu Shiyan at the work unit has made arrangements.
The elders in the family are very capable, and they don't have anything to worry about.
Xu Shi first thought about it a few times, and that's the only way to go.
"Okay, listen to you, let's go back as planned, you stay with your parents and play here for a while."
Xu Shiyan is the general manager of the company, he has the final say on everything, and the car is his own.
Su Anying started her own company, giving her more freedom and doing whatever she likes.
How do their brothers compare? They all go to work and listen to others.
If you don’t go back during the holidays, the salary deduction will be small. What if the leader is unhappy and wears small shoes in the future?
That's it, the brothers discussed it properly.
Xu Shiyan turned his head and discussed with Qu Jiacheng and the others.
"Brother Qu, do you think this will work?
I first accompanied my brothers and nephews to go for a walk in Qingshan Lake.
Looking back, our family went straight to Kuandian, and went to the two of you tonight, and tomorrow I will go to Dandong.
The two elders haven’t come back for many years, so we just hang around our hometown for a few more days. "
Qu Jiacheng was happy when he heard it, "Okay, why not, it must be done.
Brother, let’s make an agreement, I’m waiting for you in the county seat. "
These two people, a deputy secretary and a deputy county magistrate, are very busy with work, and they can't stay in Qingshangou all the time. They have to go back to work.
Xu Shiyan's arrangement is quite reasonable, and nothing will be delayed, so Qu Jiacheng directly agreed.
"Okay, that's it. If people from the city come over, brother Qu Gao, please tell them."
Xu Shiyan didn't bother anymore, this matter is considered a deal.
Therefore, Qu Jiacheng and the two left happily, while Xu Shiyan and others said goodbye to Xu Shiquan.
Xu Shiquan really wanted to keep everyone staying for two more days, but he also saw what happened just now.
There are county and city leaders waiting, what is he, an ordinary person?
"Uncle, Auntie, if I have my way, I would have to keep you at home for ten and a half months.
You said that we met yesterday and we are going to leave today, it is really not enough.
But I can also see that the younger brothers have business to do, so there is no delay.
Uncle and Auntie, I will be free in the future, and come back to be lively. "
"Okay, okay, come back when I'm free later." Xu Chenghou nodded repeatedly.
Since you want to leave, you must go door-to-door to tell people. When the families in Shijiagou heard about it, they were very reluctant.
Just when Xu Shiyan remembered, he came with a camera.
Quickly took out the camera and took a group photo of Xu Shiquan and his wife, as well as these old neighbors.
Then Xu Shiyan and his brothers took a photo with Xu Shiquan.
"Brother, wait for me to go back, develop the photos, and mail them to you."
Xu Shiyan finished taking photos, put the camera in his bag, and told Xu Shiquan.
"Okay, okay, brother, I will come back often when I have a chance in the future, this end is also home."
Xu Shiquan shook hands with Xu Shixian and others one by one, and said reluctantly.
Everyone parted at this point, Xu Shiquan, his wife, and a group of old neighbors followed the Xu family until the mouth of Shijiagou.
Seeing Xu Shiyan and others get into the car and leave with their own eyes, they went back separately.
Xu Shiyan and others turned around and drove straight to Qingshangou Township, and then turned from Qingshangou Township to Qingshan Lake.
Although Xu Chenghou has been away for these years, he still remembers this place quite clearly.
On the way, he showed Xu Shiyan the way, and he arrived at the place quite smoothly.
"It's called Qingshan Lake now, but we called it Diaoshui Lake back then."
Xu Chenghou got out of the car and told stories to the children.
"This place used to be amazing, the elders said that there were some kind of ghosts living in this lake.
Some people say that he is a big turtle who can make clouds and rain. "
With the support of his grandson, Xu Chenghou walked slowly inside. While walking, he told his grandson the stories that the local people have passed down for many years.
“In the early years, when spring started here, there was often drought and no rain.
The villages hurriedly negotiated, planted the land first, and then prepared three sacrifices of wine, and came to the lake to pray for rain.
When praying for rain, people from every village will come here with three offerings of wine and a big vase, and they will kowtow in three steps.
Arrived at the lake, put offerings, sang and danced, and then fished a small old turtle from the lake.
Not too big, about the size of a copper coin, put it in the vase, and carried it back. "
“When I first walked from the lake, there was a small piece of cloud in the sky, just like the little turtle in the vase.
Walking and walking, hey, it’s almost like a millstone, and after walking for a while, it’s almost like a kang.
I walked slowly, and it started to rain a little while I was still ten or eight miles away from home.
Before the big guys got home, the heavy rain was shot, and everyone was soaked when they got home. "
"It rained for three days, and after three days, people from each village organized people to carry the vase and send the little old turtle back.
That's enough. This spring, the weather will be smooth, and there will be no drought. "
What Xu Chenghou said was so mysterious, the children were all fascinated by what they heard, and their eyes widened.
"Grandpa, did you see this with your own eyes? Did you also ask for rain at that time?" Xu Haiqing asked curiously.
"No, I was in chaos at that time, the kings of the Northeast, the devils, the Manchukuo, and all the turbulent soldiers were fighting.
Every household is struggling to live, who can afford three animals to pray for rain? " Xu Chenghou shook his head and sighed.
"Oh, I thought Grandpa saw it with his own eyes."
When the children heard this, they were all discouraged. What they said was so mysterious. It was rumored by the elders for a long time, and no one had seen it with their own eyes.
"Your grandfather didn't lie to you, the elders did say so.
Before we moved out, Qingshangou Primary School organized children to come here for picnics as soon as spring and summer came.
Those children were naughty, and when they saw an old turtle drying its cover on the bank, they threw stones at it.
Anyway, when I come back for an outing, it rains and gets watered in storage, so I can’t run back. "
Over there, Zhou Guilan also spoke up, testifying for her old man, this is not what they made up, that's what the old people said.
"I don't believe it. If I meet the little turtle later, I'll catch one. I wonder if it's raining?"
Xu Haitao curled his lips, what, this is a folk tale, made up to fool children, he doesn't believe it.
"Cut, you have to be able to meet Suan.
When did our grandpa and grandma talk about? Decades ago, when the population was small, no one harmed the fish, turtles, shrimps and crabs in this lake.
Now you try? It's almost time to be caught. "
Xu Haiyuan snorted, why is his second brother so naive?
Don't say the story is true or false, now you still want to catch a little old turtle? How is it possible?

chapters.title: Chapter 699: dare not promise
chapters.content:
Chapter 699 Don't dare to promise indiscriminately
At the time before Xu Shiyan was reborn, the Qingshangou Scenic Area was divided into several scenic spots such as Qingshan Lake, Flying Waterfall, and Tiger Leaping Gorge.
At that time, the tourism development of Qingshangou was already in a good shape.
Although the supporting facilities are not as complete as those of the big tourist attractions, there are many farmhouses around, and it is very convenient to eat and live.
But at the moment, the tourism here has not been developed at all, and everything is still in its original state.
Most of the surrounding mountains and waterfalls have no names.
How should I put it, Xu Shiyan and the others live in the Changbai Mountain area, and everyone is not very interested in the mountain.
But this Qingshan Lake, the lake is clear and green, with rippling microwaves, which is somewhat attractive to everyone.
Coincidentally, it happened that there were fishermen rowing boats on the lake, and the children had to sit when they saw it.
Xu Shiyan negotiated with them, and gave them some money to let them take the children around the lake for a while to have a good time.
Afterwards, under the guidance of the other party, everyone went around and saw various scenic spots that would be named in the future.
Anyway, it’s okay, it’s worth watching, as long as the children are having fun.
Walking around from Qingshan Lake, I went to Feipujian again, and looked at Qingshan Waterfall and Fairy Pool.
Anyway, that's the thing, it's incomparable with those famous waterfalls.
But the kids were jumping up and down, all yelling that it was fun, and that would do.
Xu Shiyan took a camera and took a lot of photos for everyone. The group wandered around and returned to Qingshangou Township.
Eat something casually, and then part ways.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying drove, took the old couple Xu Chenghou and four children to Kuandian.
Brothers Xu Shixian, Xu Shian, and Xu Shixiang drove their respective families and Xu Shide's family of four back to Huanren by the same road.
Ordinarily, there is actually one more person here.
Fortunately, Xu Jingwen and Xu Jingyi are still young, and the two little sisters are in the middle, and the jeep is also spacious, so it is easy to drive.
Xu Shixian and others went to live in Huanren to rest for the night, and got up early the next day and drove back.
Xu Shiyan drove to Kuandian.
It is more than 60 kilometers from Qingshangou to Kuandian City. The road here is very ordinary, and Xu Shiyan is not very familiar with the road, so it took two hours to drive there.
Originally Xu Shiyan and Qu Jiacheng agreed to go to the county government to find them.
As a result, Xu Shiyan was stopped by someone just as he was driving towards Kuandian City.
"Hello Mr. Xu, Secretary Qu has arranged for us to wait here to guide Mr. Xu."
Good guy, Qu Jiacheng actually arranged for someone to wait on the only way into the city.
The other party knew Xu Shiyan's license plate number, and when he saw the car with Ji Sheng's photo taken from a distance, he stopped the car and spoke politely to Xu Shiyan.
"Oh, I'm so sorry, I'm sorry, thank you."
Xu Shiyan didn't get out of the car, but rolled down the window and nodded to thank the other party.
"It's our honor that Mr. Xu can come. Then I will lead the way, and Mr. Xu's car will follow."
The other party nodded with a smile, and returned to his own car. The car in front started to lead the way, and Xu Shiyan and Su Anying drove behind.
"Third brother, I think you really have to think about it later, see if there are any suitable projects here, and help if you can.
Look at how polite they are to you. We're not talking about anything else. Anyway, this is my hometown. "
Zhou Guilan was in the car, witnessed all this with her own eyes, and couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"Old woman, look at you, can we meddle in this matter?
The company is not owned by our family, no matter what we do, don’t we have to agree to it?
This side is a little far away from our house, and it’s not like you don’t know that what’s here, we have over there.
Why do you want us three to invest here? Which project are you working with? "
When Xu Chenghou heard what the old wife said, he spoke before his son could speak.
"San'er, well, your mother doesn't understand these things, she just saw that these people in the county are very polite to us, and her heart softened.
Business is not about denying relatives, but you have to see the situation clearly and have a suitable project.
Don't just agree to it for the sake of face.
Your company is not your own, it’s a public business, if you don’t make the right investment, you’ll lose money, and you won’t be able to explain it.
Not to mention Yingzi's end, you two earned it back with your life. If it's not easy to pay for it, wouldn't our family's money be in vain? "
The old man sees things deeply and far. He knows that investment cooperation is not a simple matter, so he can't be arrogant.
"If you want me to say, no matter what they say, you can't just agree right now.
After waiting to go back, discuss with the venue.
Didn’t last year prepare a lot of fish and meat from Dandong and Changtu?
You ask this year, if you add some apples and pears this year, do you want it?
This apple is quite delicious, and pears are also good. It’s Chinese New Year, who can’t buy some fruit? "
Xu Chenghou knew the difficulties in his hometown, so he could not just agree to invest.
But it should still be possible to buy something from here and give workers benefits for the New Year.
"It's not just your field, but ask the Forestry Bureau if they want it? Isn't that a lot?
You can still discuss with Xiaoji and the others, anyway, their group is fine in winter.
Let them sell seafood, fruits, etc. in Songjianghe or Fusong, the entire store.
I guess it’s okay, you can’t make a lot of money, but you can definitely earn it by eating at home, what do you think? "
Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing when he heard what his father said.
"Dad, what you said is exactly what I thought.
I also think that if you rashly agree to invest, this project is not easy to find, it is quite risky, and the results are slow.
Why don't you just buy some things from here, just as the Chinese New Year is approaching, people take the money and celebrate the New Year happily, which is very good. "
Xu Shiyan stayed up half the night last night, thinking about it.
Right now, all he can do is this, and he really can't promise anything else.
"Yes, yes, that's right, as long as you don't get confused.
Don’t think that you can do everything, it’s really not the case.
We are just planting and processing sticks, and we have some skills.
If you can enjoy yourself in the venue, you may not be able to do it elsewhere, so we dare not promise everything. "
Xu Chenghou felt confident when he heard his son's answer.
Those years are going well these days, so I'm afraid that he'll get carried away and not know where he will fall, and he'll be ashamed.
"Well, it's all according to Dad's arrangement. I definitely can't promise anything indiscriminately. Don't worry, Dad."
Xu Shiyan laughed, how about having an old man in a family is like having a treasure? People of this age have experienced many things, and they are indeed more stable than others.
While talking, the car in front stopped.
Xu Shiyan looked outside, oh, the co-author led them directly to the county government guest house.
It’s just right, it’s about this time, the elderly and children are probably quite tired, so I arranged accommodation first, and it’s good to rest for a while.
Just thinking about it, the staff in front got out of the car and came over.
"Mr. Xu, Secretary Qu said that you must be very tired all the way, so go up and rest for a while.
In the evening, Secretary Qu prepared meals at the guest house to greet Mr. Xu. "

chapters.title: Chapter 700: Hospitality
chapters.content:
Chapter 700 Hospitality
The condition of the county guest house is good, otherwise Qu Jiacheng wouldn't be able to arrange Xu Shiyan's family here.
Xu Shiyan asked for two rooms, Xu Chenghou and his wife led the two boys, and Xu Shiyan and his wife took the two daughters. It is more reasonable to live in this way.
Everyone got up early to go up the mountain, wandered around Qingshangou for a long time in the middle, and drove for such a long time in the afternoon, it is true that they were a little tired.
Lying on the bed, I really don't remember much.
Around half past five, Qu Jiacheng and Gao Mingyuan came to the county guest house.
Along with them were other cadres from the county, as well as people from the Bureau of Agriculture and the Bureau of Commerce sent by the city.
The director of the Agriculture Bureau met Xu Shiyan at the Fusong Ginseng Festival.
Last year, through him, Xu Shiyan bought a lot of sea fish, prawns, etc. from the seaside of Dandong. They also sent Xu Shiyan frozen crabs and some dried seafood.
This time, when they heard that Xu Shiyan was coming, the other party took the initiative to ask for orders to come to pick up Xu Shiyan.
I just want to catch up with Xu Shiyan, and ask if we can cooperate again this year.
When everyone met, Qu Jiacheng introduced each other, and Xu Shiyan shook hands with each other one by one.
On the other side, they bought some things for Xu Chenghou's old couple and their four children.
Xu Shiyan can’t say no to it. People have said that this is for the elderly and children.
I have no choice but to accept it, and I will return the gift when I have a chance in the future.
"Everyone, it's getting late, so that's it, let's go down to eat and chat while eating."
Qu Jiacheng saw that the room was not big, and the room was crowded with people, how about sitting down in the restaurant downstairs and chatting?
"Yes, yes, you see, I am happy to see Mr. Xu.
Let's go, let's go downstairs to eat, there's nothing too good in the local area, just don't be disgusted with Mr. Xu. "
The top leader in the county, Secretary Yan, laughed when he heard Qu Jiacheng's words.
Just like that, a group of people went downstairs to the restaurant of the guest house.
The family specially ordered two tables of dishes, one for Zhou Guilan, Su Anying's mother-in-law and children.
Xu Chenghou was supposed to sit with Xu Shiyan, Qu Jiacheng and others.
Xu Chenghou felt that he was getting old, he didn’t drink alcohol, and he couldn’t talk to those cadres, so he shirked a few words and sat at another table.
The food is quite rich, not to mention delicacies from mountains and seas, but it is almost the same.
There are several kinds of fish alone, such as Aohua, heavy lips, and thin scales, all of which are well-known local freshwater fish.
There is also a kind of small fish, stewed with sauce.
Zhou Guilan said at first glance, it is called Hong Niangzi, a unique fish in Kuandian, and it tastes best when it is stewed with sauce.
Needless to say, thin scales, I used to eat them in the big house.
Back then, Xu Shiyan got to know Guo Shouye through the thin scale fish and earned living expenses.
Aohua is one of the three flowers and five Luos. The meat is tender and plump, especially the steamed Aohua, which is extremely delicious.
The heavy lips, according to Xu Chenghou and the others, are called Chongchong in local dialect.
The mouth of the insect fish is the most delicious, and this fish has a nourishing effect.
In addition to fish, there are also tree chickens, which are also known as dragon birds.
The dragon meat called the heavenly dragon meat and the earthly donkey meat is this thing.
Feilong stewed soup is delicious without any seasoning.
In addition, there are beef, mutton, etc., which can be said to fly in the sky, swim in the water, and run on the ground.
Although most of these things are also available at the other end of the house, they have prepared them carefully, and you can tell that they are intentional at a glance.
"Look, isn't this causing trouble to Brother Yan and Brother Qu again?
This table dish costs a lot of money. " Xu Shiyan said politely.
"What's the trouble? The main reason is that I don't know what uncles and aunts like to eat. These are the favorite foods of our local people.
I was thinking, my uncle and aunt have been away from home for these years, and they must also be thinking about it, so I can taste the taste of our hometown.
It is a pity that there are no tussah silkworms at this time.
If there is such a thing, it will be a whole plate, let my uncle and aunt taste it, it is a good thing. "
The tussah silkworm mentioned by Qu Jiacheng is also called mountain silkworm.
Eating oak leaves, the ribbons spit out have a natural yellow color.
Many farmers in Kuandian used to raise tussah silkworms. Zhou Guilan also raised tussah silkworms in her natal family before marrying into the Xu family.
The flesh of this tussah silkworm is relatively firm, and it tastes particularly delicious.
Generally, we wait for the tussah silkworms to grow up, and catch some before they spin silk and form cocoons.
Holding the silkworm with one hand, the index finger of the other hand pushed back the head of the silkworm, and the green intestines came out.
This process is also called a dai by some people.
Blanch the tussah silkworms that have been stewed to death in hot water. They can be fried and eaten directly, or wrapped in noodles and fried, or chopped to make dumplings. They are all very fragrant.
And tussah silkworm has high nutritional value, which is very good for children.
Spring silkworms cocoon in late June, and it’s already mid-July, and there really aren’t any.
"Oh, don't bother with that.
Although I have never seen tussah silkworms, my mother always said that they were raised at home before.
It is not easy to raise this thing, and it is quite expensive. When Xu Shiyan heard this, he waved his hands quickly.
Cultivating tussah silkworms is different from silkworms.
Mulberry silkworms are raised at home, and a separate house is set aside, and the mulberry leaves are picked and fed back, so silkworms are also called silkworms.
Tussah silkworms are called mountain silkworms, which need to be raised in the forest.
Large areas of oak forests start to release silkworms when the leaves of the oak trees are young, and harvest after cocooning in late June.
Tussah silkworms are plump and delicious, and are the favorite of many birds.
Therefore, when raising tussah silkworms, we must pay attention to driving away birds, otherwise, the whole mountain farm will be easily destroyed by birds.
Xu Shiyan heard from Zhou Guilan that it was very hard to raise silkworms in the past, and he had to go to release silkworms and drive birds every morning.
Some people specialize in keeping guns, and when they see a flock of birds coming, they fire two shots to scare the birds away.
Those who don’t have guns can only shoot with slingshots. After a season of hard work, they can harvest silkworm cocoons and sell them for some money.
"Yes, we have fewer silkworms now, and they are too tired to make money." Qu Jiacheng sighed.
Kuandian’s tussah silkworms were able to supply many cities in the Northeast, and even sold to the capital.
Now it’s gone, most people are thinking about going to work in the factory, who is willing to spend so much effort to raise tussah silkworms in the morning and night.
"Brother Xu, I heard that you sell ginseng very well and make a lot of money.
In fact, we also have ginseng here.
Like Shizhuzi Village, there is Shizhu Ginseng which is famous all over the country.
Ordinary garden ginseng is also planted, but the area is not so large.
I was thinking about discussing with you. I bought some ginseng seeds from you in autumn. How about vigorously developing ginseng here? "
Yan Shaoqing asked Xu Shiyan tentatively.
Ginseng is also produced in Kuan and Huan, but due to the limited terrain, the ginseng production here is low and the planting area is not large, so the ginseng industry has never developed.
The cadres in the county felt that ginseng was quite profitable.
If the county increases support, gives more preferential policies, learns from Fusong, and develops the industry, it can drive the local people to become rich.
They have this idea, but they are not sure how to implement it.
I happened to meet Xu Shiyan today, knowing that Xu Shiyan is an expert in ginseng production-related industries, so I asked Xu Shiyan for advice.

chapters.title: Chapter 701: good advice
chapters.content:
Chapter 701 Good words to persuade
"Brother Yan, normally, I can't say too much about some things.
I said it as if I was stingy and afraid that people would come and steal my business.
But today I am back to my hometown, and my parents are sitting there.
I really can’t go against my conscience to brag with you and encourage you to vigorously develop ginseng. "
Xu Shiyan was silent for a long time, and finally said with a sigh.
"If it was three or five years earlier, and you said you wanted to lead the common people to develop ginseng, I would have said that you could do it.
But for now, this matter really cannot go any further.
The ginseng market has been booming in recent years, not to mention our Kyrgyz province, and even Liao province is followed by many places.
The situation we are now facing is that production is far greater than sales. "
I thought a lot before coming here, but I didn't expect that these people turned out to be the idea of ​​playing ginseng.
"In the past, the sales of ginseng were based on exclusive production and supply, unified purchase and unified sales, and the state provided the guarantee, so we didn't have to worry about selling ginseng.
It’s different now. It seems that our province has stopped implementing the minimum purchase plan since this year, and relies entirely on market operations.
Brother Yan also knows that most of this ginseng is exported and sold to foreigners, and we consume less domestically.
The international situation has changed rapidly in the past two years, and no one dares to say what the wind is going outside.
We don’t have the country’s bottom line now, and we spend a lot of money to plant sticks. Once the market falls, farmers will have to lose money. "
Xu Shiyan didn't know how many times he said these words.
But good words are hard to persuade, **** ghost, there are still countless people trying to get involved.
Xu Shiyan has persuaded everything that should be persuaded, and that's all he can do. Believe it or not, it's up to others.
“Our participation has always maintained a certain scale in recent years and has never expanded.
My wife also grows ginseng, they are all the same, no matter how good the market is, they will always be those.
Anyway, if you really want to develop, it is recommended to wait a year or two and see how the market is going this year and next. "
That's all that can be said, and that's all. As for whether people believe it or not, Xu Shiyan doesn't care.
Although there are plantation ginseng here, Yan Shaoqing and others are not engaged in this industry themselves, so they don't know much about it, otherwise they wouldn't be able to ask Xu Shiyan for advice.
Now hearing what Xu Shiyan said, everyone gasped.
If it is true as what Xu Shiyan said, then they encourage farmers to plant ginseng. Once the market falls and loses money, farmers should not blame them.
"Oh, I thought it was a good project to make money, but I didn't expect there are so many things in it.
Thanks to the fact that I met brother Xu today, and I didn’t see anything wrong, so I explained it to us with all my heart.
If it were another person, who would be so realistic? "
Qu Jiacheng looked at Yan Shaoqing and sighed.
If it were someone else, who would be so honest?
People would like you to buy ginseng seeds, learn techniques, and invest a lot of money in it.
As for the market falling, what does it have to do with others? That is affected by the international situation, and it is not something that others can decide.
Yan Shaoqing was also in cold sweat right now.
Ever since the fire at the Fusong Ginseng Festival last year, he has been thinking about the ginseng industry.
I have always advocated that the county should also vigorously develop the ginseng industry, and then go to a spring fair or something to strive for export earnings.
In fact, Kuandian also has products for export.
However, minerals such as talc, talcum powder, and boron ore account for a large proportion, while agricultural and sideline products such as deer antler, cashmere, ginseng, and pond male fish account for a small proportion.
This structure itself is unreasonable.
Minerals are non-renewable resources. Yan Shaoqing and others also have some foresight. They know that the more the minerals are developed, the less they will be. In a few years, there may be nothing to sell.
It is better to develop agricultural and sideline products, sustainable regeneration and recycling, and among them, ginseng has the highest profit.
So Yan Shaoqing and others are thinking about developing the ginseng industry, and also want to learn from Fusong.
I dare not say what the festivals are all about. At least some kind of processing factory can make farmers' lives better.
But they never thought that behind the planting of ginseng, there are also many hidden dangers and crises.
After listening to Xu Shiyan's words at this time, I was really terrified.
If this is not good, he can't sit on the wax? They are all local, and the common people will scold him to death.
"Thanks for meeting Mr. Xu, otherwise, I would have made a mistake.
Mr. Xu, thank you very much. I really appreciate you reminding us.
Well, I won’t say anything else, it’s fate that we met, come on, I respect you. "
Yan Shaoqing is a good person, and he didn't think in a wrong way. But a toast of gratitude.
Xu Shiyan picked up the wine glass, touched Yan Shaoqing and others, and everyone drank the wine together.
"The price of ginseng, I guess, will definitely drop. I don't dare to say what will happen in the future.
It depends on the next two years. If it can be stable in these two years, then it will be no big deal.
If it is not stable, at least within ten years, it will be difficult to return to the market conditions of the year before and last year.
So, choose this industry, you really have to be cautious, after all, the cost is too heavy.
If it has always been there before, there is no other way out. There is no other way, and I have to continue.
Otherwise, it is really not recommended to enter the market at this time. "
Xu Shiyan could also see that Qu Jiacheng and this Yan Shaoqing were good people.
To put it bluntly, these few are much better than Li Jingyu and others, and they can be persuaded.
On the other side of Li Jingyu, Xu Shiyan reported several times that he was restricting the rapid development of the ginseng industry, but the county simply ignored him.
Right now, let's see how the ginseng market will be this year and next year. If it really falls to the bottom like in the previous life, it will be exciting to watch.
"Mr. Xu, if you say so, when is the best time to enter?"
Yan Shaoqing guessed that he was still a little unwilling to give up, so he asked a question.
Xu Shiyan glanced at Yan Shaoqing and then at Qu Jiacheng, seeing that both of them were full of anticipation, he couldn't help but sigh.
"Brother Yan, I can't guess the exact time, but within at least three years, don't make up your mind."
Once the market falls, those units participating collectively will definitely try their best to throw their burdens out.
The market conditions will be messed up by them, and whoever enters the market at this time is a fool.
As for when it will be better, Xu Shiyan can't give a specific answer now.
After all, many things have changed, and the experience of the previous life may not be all useful today.
Yan Shaoqing still wanted to ask, but Qu Jiacheng stopped him with a look.
They didn't know Xu Shiyan at all before, and they didn't have much friendship. It's enough for them to save face if they can talk about it.
It would be too much to continue to get to the bottom of it.
Yan Shaoqing thinks about it, too, some things can't be rushed.
"Forget it, I don't dare to think about it, it sounds scary.
In the future, let’s do something else honestly. In these days, as long as people are not lazy and willing to work, they can always get rich. "
Yan Shaoqing waved his hand, don't bother thinking about it.
"Come on, let's toast Mr. Xu again. If nothing else, come back to your hometown. You must eat, drink, and have fun, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 702: play around
chapters.content:
Chapter 702 Play around
Everyone echoed in unison, and then everyone raised their glasses together and drank another drink.
Next, everyone stopped talking about these heavy topics, but chatted casually about other things.
Yan Shaoqing and the others have never been to the Spring Festival Fair. They are very interested in this, so they asked Xu Shiyan to tell them what it is like in Yangcheng.
It is said that there is a modern society over there, but what kind of modernization is it?
Without mentioning investment cooperation, the atmosphere becomes more relaxed, and Xu Shiyan doesn't mind chatting with them about other things.
So he talked about his experience in Yangcheng, where there are many tall buildings and factories.
At the Spring Fair, foreigners gathered, merchants from all walks of life traveled across the ocean, and these domestic enterprises competed for excellence.
Yan Shaoqing and others were dumbfounded.
In their eyes, Shenyang is a very good city, but compared with the open frontier cities such as Yangcheng that Xu Shiyan said, there is simply too much difference.
"I have a chance in the future, I really have to go out and have a look.
Otherwise, all of them are like frogs in a well, thinking that their three-acre land is quite powerful. "
“Yes, we really should go out and see the developed coastal cities.
Learn the advanced concepts from others and broaden your horizons. This is definitely useful. "
Xu Shiyan quite agrees with this statement. If you don’t go out, you will never know how big the outside world is.
Xu Shiyan and Qu Jiacheng chatted fairly well, and the big guys were talking nonsense, but they were quite happy.
Over there, Xu Chenghou and his wife led their fed children back to the room to rest. Xu Shiyan drank and chatted with these people until late.
It was almost ten o'clock, Yan Shaoqing and others left, and Xu Shiyan also went back upstairs to rest.
I slept until 8 am the next day, and I was still a little dazed when I woke up.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan led his parents, wife and children, to wander around the county together.
Xu Chenghou came to the county when he was young, and he still has the appearance of the old county in his memory.
So I gave pointers to my children and grandchildren, saying what this place used to do, and what place there used to be.
While talking, there are also various emotions. Today's county is much more prosperous than before.
The family wandered around all morning, and bought some when they saw something they liked.
Find a place to have a meal at noon, and drive to the city with those from Dandong in the afternoon.
It was evening when we arrived in the city, and as usual, there was another welcome banquet.
Several city leaders also came to meet Xu Shiyan and have a meal together.
Of course, the city leaders are not in such a hurry to settle something with Xu Shiyan.
They didn't say anything, they just talked and chatted with Xu Shiyan, as a landlord.
Xu Shiyan said that he wanted to take the children to the beach for a stroll. On the 18th, the city arranged for someone to send Xu Shiyan and the others to Donggou.
Donggou, the former Andong County, will be renamed Donggang in 1993.
Back then, people who went to Changbai Mountain to seek a living, besides hunting in the mountains, had another way out, which was to go to the mountain farms to log.
Cut wood in the mountains in winter, tie the wood into rafts after spring, and drift down the river.
At that time, the discharge was divided into south flowing water and north flowing water.
Bei Liushui drifts along the Songhua River to the shipyard, and Nanliushui flows downstream from the Yalu River to Andong.
Nanliu has stable water, and it takes a long time to discharge. If the weather is bad, the journey will take more than two months.
Bei Liushui is relatively short, and when it is good, it can be reached in half a month and twenty days.
However, the north current is fast, and there are many dangerous shoals. If you don't pay attention, you will be destroyed and killed.
So many platoon gangs like to travel southward, and this Anton has become a well-known wooden capital.
In today's Donggou, we can no longer see the scene of Mudu in those days.
But this side is near the sea. For children who have never seen the sea, any history and culture are not as good as the sea in front of them.
With the help of the accompanying staff, the group boarded a fishing boat and went to Dalu Island to play for a long time.
The accompanying people also told Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping about the Sino-Japanese War of the Sino-Japanese War, the inscription on Mao Wenlong's resistance to gold, and the nautical lighthouse that England built here.
The children were fascinated by what they heard, and at the same time they were extremely disgusted with the corruption of the imperial court at that time.
Xu Shiyan thinks this is pretty good. It not only allows children to play, but also receives education, which is very meaningful.
Of course, photos are also indispensable. Xu Shiyan took a camera and took many pictures of his parents, wife and children.
