Also asked the accompanying staff to help and take a group photo with their family.
Enough playing on the island, they returned to Donggou by boat and had a very special lunch here.
Although this is not the season for the most plentiful seafood, the staff was very attentive and helped arrange it.
Dandong's most famous yellow clams, noodle fish, and crabs.
This made Xu Haiqing so happy that he would eat as soon as he caught it. If his stomach couldn't hold it, he would probably be able to eat it all the time.
Xu Shiyan and his party lived in Dandong for two days and wandered around.
Xu Shiyan also took Xu Haiyuan and the others to climb down the Hushan Great Wall.
The children were having fun and didn’t miss home at all, but Xu Shiyan and his wife couldn’t do it.
There are so many things going on at home, how can I play outside all the time?
So, on the night of the 19th, I bid farewell to the people here.
The people in Dandong failed to persuade them to stay again and again, so they bought a lot of things for Xu Shiyan and asked them to take them home to share with relatives and friends.
Xu Shiyan couldn't refuse, so he could only accept it.
Then quietly told the person in the Agricultural Bureau that a batch of seafood will be ordered here this winter, so you can prepare more.
The other party was very happy, the entertainment these days was finally not in vain, and this winter they can earn more money.
Early in the morning on the 20th, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying drove, left Dandong and walked back.
The return journey is not delayed by messy things, and it is faster to drive on the road. In two days, I finally rushed back to Donggang.
At home, Su Anfen, Su Anzhen and others cook for Mr. Chu every day, and burn kangs for both sides.
Here received a call from Xu Shiyan in advance, and knew that they would arrive home on the evening of the 21st.
So everyone has prepared the meal and is waiting at home.
In the evening, Xu Shiyan and his wife drove home.
When Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan got out of the car, they felt their legs were soft, as if they were walking on cotton.
This is because of the long-term driving and the blood is not active.
"Uncle, Auntie, you guys are back. How is the journey going? Is it going well?"
Ji Tongzhong and others heard the movement of parking, and hurried out to greet them, just in time to come forward, and helped Xu Chenghou and his wife.
"It's good to go out, the food and accommodation are good, and I have played around for a few days.
It’s just thinking about the family and growing grass in my heart, so I’d better come back early. "Xu Chenghou said with a smile.
Going back this time, I finally settled my mind, and wandered around again.
I have never been to Dandong before, but I have also visited it this time.
The old man is satisfied, although the car is very tiring, the smile on his face has never stopped.
"Brother Chu, you are not at home these days, are you lonely?
This time I don't have much to think about. From now on, my brother and I will play chess and drink tea all day long. "Xu Chenghou smiled when he saw Chu Xuanhuai.

chapters.title: Chapter 703: drowned two children
chapters.content:
Chapter 703 Drowning two children
Chu Xuanhuai laughed when he heard what Xu Chenghou said.
"That's okay, you are not at home these days, the morning is fine, I don't feel bad about seeing a doctor or anything.
In the afternoon, I’m alone, so it’s really boring.
Thanks to Yingzi's father, Dahai, and Shengli's father, who came to chat with me and so on.
Without Yuanyuan by my side at night, I really feel uncomfortable. "
When people are old, they are most afraid of being alone. Although Xu Shiyan and the others have only been out for seven or eight days, Chu Xuanhuai feels that every day is difficult.
Looking back now, how did he live when he was in the provincial capital?
"Master, I won't go out from now on. I will stay with Master at home until school starts."
Xu Haiyuan jumped to Chu Xuanhuai's side, hugged Chu Xuanhuai's arm, and said with a smile.
"I can't sleep well without Shigong, I always feel out of breath."
This kid wants to coax people, so why not open his mouth?
Sure enough, when Chu Xuanhuai heard this, he laughed happily.
"Okay, okay, our Yuanyuan is the most caring." Chu Xuanhuai happily hugged Xu Haiyuan in his arms.
"Shigong, and me, I am also at home with Shigong."
Xu Jinping also jumped to Chu Xuanhuai's side, smiling to make the old man happy.
Over there, Xu Jinhui, who was two steps late, also walked up to Chu Xuanhuai, "Master, and me."
This little girl is the third child, with two older brothers and sisters who are as smart as monsters, and a younger brother who is not worried.
And this girl is very well-behaved and quiet on weekdays, she can do whatever she is asked to do, and she will not make noise or cause trouble.
So among the four children, this little girl has the weakest sense of existence.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan and his wife have never been partial, and treat the children equally, and have not caused any psychological shadow to the little girl.
The three older brothers and sisters have all expressed their opinions. Xu Haiqing, who is staring at the food on the table, is drooling, so he can't lag behind.
So he also stated that he would also stay at home with his master.
"Hey, good, good, they are all good boys, good boys.
Well, you must be hungry when you come back so late, right?
Let’s stop chattering, hurry up, eat first, you see Haiqing’s eyes are staring with hunger. ",
While Chu Xuanhuai was happy, he didn't forget to tease Xu Haiqing.
Everyone laughed, and hurried to wash their hands and sit down to eat.
While eating, Ji Tongzhong and the others asked how the trip was going and where they all went.
Xu Shiyan had to tell them a little bit, and by the way, he also mentioned the suggestion of setting up a store to sell seafood and fruits in the twelfth lunar month.
Ji Tongzhong and Nan Zhendong heard this, this is good, anyway, they didn't have much to do at that time.
It is really rare to see seafood for sale in winter here, and occasionally a little Spanish mackerel and herring are considered good.
They also ate all those sea fish and prawns from the market last year, which was very good.
As soon as it enters the Layue Gate, it will pull two carts back and sell it in the county and Songjiang River.
Not to mention earning too much money, the expenses of each family for the New Year can be kept.
Fruits are also fine. In addition to frozen pears and persimmons in winter, how can you see a few fresh fruits here?
"Second brother-in-law, what you said is fine.
In winter, my third brother-in-law and I teamed up with Sheng Kai and the others to transport two batches back, and we will definitely make money. "
Ji Tongzhong immediately stated that they were willing to do this job.
"Well, anyway, it's just a little bit of trouble, and it's not as comfortable to go out to sell goods in winter as it is to be a cat at home.
If you are willing, you can go to transport it twice, and the right is to earn something to eat for yourself.
It’s okay if you don’t like it. After I discuss it with Brother Guo, the two units can also ask for a lot. "
On the side of the participating company alone, there are now nearly 2,000 employees.
Not to mention the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau, not counting the various forest farms, the bureau alone plus the timber factory, plywood factory, automobile transportation department, machine repair factory, as well as schools, hospitals, etc., there are probably thousands of employees. .
Not to mention, the two factories of Bingshan Beverage Factory.
How many of these people are drawn together? So before Xu Shiyan left Dandong, he told him to prepare more goods this year.
"It's okay, who wants to suffer for making money? As long as you have money to make, you can do whatever you want."
In the past few years, Ji Tongzhong has changed a lot, unlike before, he was always picky and unwilling to contribute.
Besides, earning money with this money is much better than farming the land, why not?
Xu Shiyan nodded when he heard this, knowing that it is good to make money.
In these years, as long as you have the capital, you can use your brains and work hard, it won't be too bad.
"How's the family doing these days? Is there anything wrong?" Su Anying asked over there.
"Nothing, everything is fine.
The cow hair we harvested this year was extensive, and we hired people to pick the grade and cut the roots.
When the goods were delivered to Dalian, Dongyi merchants were very satisfied, and the final payment was settled with us very happily.
This year's season of wild vegetables, we have not lost much money. "
Ji Tongzhong laughed as soon as he heard it. There are people watching from all aspects of the house, so what else can happen?
"I heard that the fertilizer factory has been booming recently, especially the foliar fertilizer, which is selling well.
I heard that many newspapers and magazines have published articles confirming that the foliar fertilizer is super effective.
It is not only useful for the growth of ginseng, but also has a growth regulating and promoting effect on many plants.
So now many places are ordering. I heard from Director Yang that there are so many orders that we can’t take them. "
Ji Tongzhong remembered about the fertilizer factory and told Xu Shiyan about it.
"Well, that's good, you can only make money if you have an order, not bad." Xu Shiyan nodded.
The main components of that Qingfeng foliar fertilizer are nucleotides, amino acids, fulvic acid, and various trace elements.
It can regulate the healthy growth of plants and enhance the ability of plants to resist diseases and insect pests, cold and drought.
It has a control effect on many common plant diseases and insect pests, and it can also increase production by about 10%.
At the beginning, this was Xu Shiyan who participated in the research, and all the experimental data proved the effect of this foliar fertilizer.
So what Ji Tongzhong said did not surprise him at all.
"Oh, yes, there is something. Yuanyuan's primary school head teacher came to the house to find Yuanyuan."
Su Anfen suddenly remembered something, and told Xu Haiyuan quickly.
"Your teacher said that you are not allowed to go to places like rivers and bubbles during the holidays.
There are two students in your class. A few days ago, they went to play in a big bubble in the west and drowned.
I can’t remember what they were called, but I remember one surnamed Zhang and the other surnamed Cui. "
As soon as these words came out, the whole room fell silent, and Xu Haiyuan was dumbfounded at the time.
"Zhang Xinmin and Cui Wei'an? Are they?"
Xu Haiyuan remembered that on the day of the holiday after the exam, Zhang Xinmin asked him to go swimming in Dapaozi and touch Gala together.
Xu Haiyuan said that he was going out and didn't have time to go with him, and he also said specifically that water bubbles are very dangerous, so don't go there.
Unexpectedly, the two went to play anyway.
"Hey, yes, yes, these two, your teacher cried when he said that.
I have taught students for several years, but I just graduated from elementary school and my child is gone. "
Su Anfen felt sad when she thought of the teacher's appearance at that time.
If such a thing is spread, the parents at home must not cry to death?
It was hard to raise him until the 13th and 14th, and he was about to grow up, but the child died in the end. Who can bear it?

chapters.title: Chapter 704: award again
chapters.content:
Chapter 704 Awarded again
"Oh my god, this is ruined, how will the two families live in the future?"
When Zhou Guilan heard this, she slapped her thigh in distress. Whoever puts up such a thing will have a bad day.
"Yuanyuan, did you all hear that? But you must never go to the riverside and still have Paozi, this is too scary."
The faces of the children turned pale with fright.
Especially Xu Haiyuan, that is his classmate, who studied and played together for six years in elementary school.
As a result, just after graduation, the person disappeared. That feeling was really uncomfortable and made people speechless.
“That day, they asked me to go with them, and I said I was busy with work, and told them not to go to the riverside or Paozi.
Why are they disobedient? "
Growing up so much, it was the first time I experienced the departure of people around me, and they were still the same age.
Xu Haiyuan couldn't accept it a little bit, and felt that something was blocked in his throat.
"When you were young, I told you not to go to those places.
Hey, please pay attention in the future, this is really not a joke.
Later, I have to hold a meeting for the venue, and tell the parents of each family to tell their children well that they must not go to these places. "
Xu Shiyan was in a bad mood after hearing this.
Two boys in their teens, at a good time, suddenly disappeared like this, and anyone who heard about it would feel distressed.
If this is the same as in the later generations, when the various remedial classes come during the holidays, the children are busy with various make-up classes, and there is no chance to go out to play wild.
So, many things are one and two sides, with advantages and disadvantages.
At this time, children are herding sheep when they are on vacation.
Parents don’t have time to take care of it, and they can do whatever their children do. If they are not careful, their lives will be gone.
Children of later generations are under great pressure to study and have no time to play.
No matter how hard it is, as long as the children are there, they are a complete family.
If the child is gone, how will you live in the future?
This matter, we have to think about it carefully, find a way to set up a youth activity center, library or something, so that the children have a place to play.
I really can't let them go, they will act wild when the holidays come, and children have accidents every summer vacation.
From now on, there will be only one child in every household. If something happens, life will be really difficult.
However, these are only symptoms, not the root cause. The most important thing is that the school and parents control the children and must not go to those dangerous places.
"Yuanyuan, you are an elder brother, usually the most stable, you must take good care of your younger siblings in the future.
Especially Xu Haiqing, you must think about it, no matter who asks you to go to the water, you can't go, you know? "
Xu Shiyan looked at the two sons, the girls were not as good, especially these brats, who wanted to go to Hetao and Dapaozi when it was hot.
Once something happens, it will be too late to save.
"Dad, I understand, don't worry, I'll watch them." Xu Haiyuan nodded heavily.
He will definitely take good care of his younger brothers and sisters, not only his own family, but also those of Huang Shuqing.
"Well, later on, Dad will discuss with the venue to find a place to build a youth activity center.
Let's find a fun place for you, so that you have a place to play. "
Xu Shiyan nodded, his eldest son is still very reliable.
It should have been a very happy meal, but because of this incident, everyone felt heavy in their hearts.
Xu Shiyan and the others were really tired after driving back, and they were in no mood to chat anymore after dinner, so they hurried home to rest.
After a night of rest, I felt much more energetic the next day.
Su Anying had to go to Shendi for a stroll, and Xu Shiyan had to go back to work, so she sent Xu Haiyuan to deliver something to Guo Shouye.
They brought back a lot of dried seafood from Kuandian and Dandong. How could these relatives and friends get a share.
"Hey, the general manager is back?
Why did you come back so soon, it’s rare to go out, why don’t you play for a few more days? "
As soon as Xu Shiyan arrived at the unit, Li Bingzhuo and the others greeted him with a smile and chatted with Xu Shiyan.
"There is nothing to play, just to accompany the old man around and settle his worries.
There are so many things at home, I can't let go of my heart at all outside. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, and distributed a few bags in his hand to Li Bingzhuo and the others.
"It was given as a gift when I was in Dandong.
There are shrimps, clam meat, scallops, sea cucumbers, seaweed, etc., one for each family, and it’s good to keep it for stewing soup or making a dish when you go home. "
Going out for a trip, even buying by myself and being given by someone else, the trunks of both cars are full.
When I came back, I happened to share it with relatives and friends, and each family took some to taste something new.
Everyone took it, each carrying a bag, "Well, these things are rare here.
Then thank the general manager, you still think of us when you go out. "Everyone laughed.
"Well, I'm not at home, how is the family doing recently? Is the production going well?" Xu Shiyan waved his hand and asked by the way.
"Everything is fine, everything is working fine everywhere.
Didn't Limin take people to participate in the first selection of high-quality health products a few days ago?
Our ginseng flower cola, ginseng royal jelly oral liquid, vitality drink, ginseng coffee, ginseng snow clam honey were awarded the Golden Crane Award, and ginseng honey slices, ginseng gastrodia elata honey, and fresh ginseng were awarded the Silver Crane Award .
I heard that the fresh ginseng honey and ginseng tea at Ershenchang also won the Silver Crane Award.
Shenwang Yuye Liquor, Changbai Mountain Shanbao Liquor, and Ginseng Duobian Liquor from the county winery also won silver awards. "
Li Bingzhuo hurriedly reported to Xu Shiyan about his work.
"By the way, there is one more thing. The vice president and executive director of Lexi Commercial Company in South Korea recently visited the county.
I said that I wanted to come to our company to take a look, but I didn’t dare to make a decision, so I said that you were not on a business trip at home, and I will talk about it when you come back. "
Li Bingzhuo suddenly remembered this matter.
Because of what happened to Takeno and his party last time, these people attending the event were all wary of those foreign businessmen.
Their company had no business relationship with this commercial company before, and they suddenly said that they wanted to come to inspect, what to inspect?
Li Bingzhuo asked someone. It is said that this trading company used to be in the chemical industry, but now it is in the TV industry.
This has nothing to do with medicines or health products. What are they doing here?
Li Bingzhuo didn’t understand why these people came here, and what happened last time made him wary of foreigners.
So when he heard that he was going to come for an inspection, Li Bingzhuo excused Xu Shiyan's absence and directly pushed it away.
Their company is developing well now, and there is no shortage of millions of investment, so why bother to deal with Bangzi?
If you have time to accompany them wandering around, why not go to the mountains to see what the ground is like this year.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it, "Well, you did it right.
We had no business relationship with them before, and suddenly we said we were coming to investigate. Who knows what's going on behind the scenes? "
Xu Shiyan liked the attitude of Lao Li and others very much.
Unlike some people, when they heard that a foreigner was coming to visit, hey, that kindness is closer than seeing a real father.
As for what? Cooperation between the two parties should be based on the principle of mutual benefit and equality.
If people want to invest, it must be a profitable business that does not make money. If you beg on your knees, they will not come.
Why do you have to be so humble, half shorter than others? There is absolutely no need for that.

chapters.title: Chapter 705: activity Center
chapters.content:
Chapter 705 Activity Center
Here has not yet established diplomatic relations with South Korea, but non-governmental exchanges have always been very close.
Not to mention the distance, Xu Shiyan led the children to play on the northern **** of Changbai Mountain. The climbing corridor was actually built by South Korea.
Most of the ginseng in Fusong is sold to Dongyi and South Korea. There are also many South Korean customers on the side of the participating company.
When dealing with customers, Xu Shiyan has no prejudices, so he will not be left out, but he will never take the pole.
What is this Lexi Commercial Club? I have never cooperated with it before. Xu Shiyan doesn't know what it means.
If they come, they will receive them as normal, and show their friendship as a landlord. It doesn't matter if you don't come, there is nothing to regret.
"Old Li, don't mention these things anymore, well, I have a few things to discuss with you."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand and told everyone to sit down.
"The first one, hurry up and hold a meeting for the workers of each factory.
Especially if there are half-old children in the family, let them all go home and educate the children well.
Absolutely not allowed to go to those places like Hetao and Dapaozi. "
This is the most important thing. Children are the future and hope of every family, and the safety of children is the top priority.
"Our classmate, Yuanyuan, went to play in Da Pao Zi a few days ago, fell into it and drowned.
Every summer, such things happen, and workers and their families must be vigilant.
This is really no joke. Once something happens to the child, the family will be ruined. "
Hearing the news yesterday, Xu Shiyan felt uneasy.
Usually emphasizes the safety of workers in production, but never promotes safety education for children.
Now it seems that this is an imminent problem.
"I will write a student safety code or something later, and we will find a place to print it out and distribute it to every worker.
It is required that children in every household must be able to memorize safety knowledge.
After school starts, let the teacher draw a test, and whoever memorizes it well will be rewarded. "
This was the idea that Xu Shiyan came up with last night.
The bear children are used to acting wild all day long, so it is not easy to control, and it may not be useful for parents to wear their mouths.
It's better to have something real, with rewards, which is more effective than preaching.
The children have memorized it by familiarity, so it is always useful.
"Another one, I'm thinking about whether to join forces with Donggang to set up a youth activity center or something?
Give the children a place where they can learn and play, and find a few people to watch, so as to save them from running outside and running wild. "
This is just a concept, and how to implement it needs to be discussed carefully.
“The best thing is to find a few teachers with special skills, such as painting, calligraphy, music, dance, and martial arts, and let the children learn something during the holidays.
Don’t expect them to be talented, just let them have something to do during the holidays, so as not to go out and cause trouble.
One more thing, you can also set up some table tennis, billiards, swimming pool, roller skating rink, etc. in it, so that they have a place to play. "
No way, for the safety of these bear children, I can only arrange something for them to do.
It's better to learn something than to go out and make troubles, and make your life miserable.
Of course, the venue is just doing its best. As for whether each family will implement it, Xu Shiyan has no control over whether the children will listen or not.
He is doing his best within the scope of his ability, and Xu Shiyan has no control over whether others appreciate it or not.
"Yes, yes, what the general manager said is very good.
Oops, every summer vacation, something always happens.
Don't say you are Yuanyuan's classmate, didn't we have it two years ago?
Didn’t the eldest son of the old Qiu family drown in the big bubble in the kiln behind him?
Old Qiu's daughter-in-law passed out several times crying, what's the use? Isn't the child still gone?
Just one son is gone, and there are several daughters in the back, who don’t meet the policy and can’t have any more, alas. "
Mentioning this, everyone felt a little heavy. Every summer, children have accidents. This should indeed attract attention.
"The activity center mentioned by the general manager probably takes up quite a lot of land. I'm afraid there is no room on this side of our field right now. I guess we have to discuss it with Donggang.
However, if it is simpler and deal with it first, there is a way.
Doesn’t our venue have a staff club? At this time, we are all busy with work and no one is going to play. We can tidy up and add something for the children to play with.
Wouldn't it save them from going out and making noises? " Li Bingzhuo pondered for a while and suggested.
"Yeah, why didn't I think of that.
That's it, quickly arrange people, tidy up the staff club, and then go shopping.
Then tell the children that whoever has memorized the safety rules, let them go in and play. "
Xu Shiyan slapped his forehead, but really, he actually forgot about the staff club.
The club hasn't been opened since it was expanded.
It used to be idle in winter, and the employees went to play when they had nothing to do. Now, the orders are too busy, and the employees only take vacations at the end of the year. How can they have time to play?
The club is also idle, let the children use it first.
"Success, I'll let someone handle this matter." Li Bingzhuo nodded, he could just order someone to do such a trivial matter.
"One more thing, do you have any requests for the benefits of the New Year's goods this winter?
Last year we brought back pork and sea fish and frozen shrimp. I think everyone likes it very much. This year I still want to add some fruit.
Like pears, apples, etc. When I plan to give out year-end awards, I will give some to everyone.
If anyone still wants it, then buy it yourself, what do you guys think? "
Going back to my hometown, Qu Jiacheng and the others gave such a warm reception, why can't I not show it at all.
Besides, the pears and apples over there are really good, but the transportation is inconvenient, and the price is low if they are sold less.
At this time, there are still not many self-employed merchants, especially there are few self-employed people engaged in transportation, even fewer in Kuandian.
Therefore, some good things cannot be shipped out, nor can they be sold at a high price.
Xu Shiyan didn't have much ambition, he just thought about getting the best of both worlds, and offered to help if he could.
"Okay, of course that's fine. General manager, do you have a connection?
Then don’t wait for the Chinese New Year. When winter comes, our participating stores will ship a batch first and sell them. "
On the other side, Dai Chunrong's eyes lit up. His wife is working as the director of the store, and he knows this best.
Fusong belongs to the alpine mountainous area, and many fruits cannot be grown. In winter, it is difficult to eat some fruits except frozen pears and frozen persimmons.
In the past few years, the participants have become rich, and the employees have money, but they can't buy what they want.
Especially for Chinese New Year, who doesn’t want to buy more delicious food?
"Okay, then it's settled. I'll make a reservation with Kuandian later, and all the houses in the province are sold out."
Xu Shiyan nodded, as long as they discussed it properly, that would be the case.
Outsiders have nothing to do with the company's benefits, as long as the workers can get benefits.
With these people in charge of the company's daily work, all affairs are running normally, so Xu Shiyan really doesn't need to spend much thought.
Everyone briefly reported their work, discussed some things, and then went back to work.

chapters.title: Chapter 706: not selected
chapters.content:
Chapter 706 was not selected
Xu Shiyan and others didn't care about the South Korean business company.
A few days later, someone called Xu Shiyan and revealed the news.
It is said that the trading company has reached an investment intention with Xianrenqiao Deer Farm, and initially plans to invest one million US dollars, and the two parties will cooperate to set up the farm.
"An investment of one million dollars is still just an investment intention, so it is worth calling you specially?
If you want me to say, this Wang Xicheng has nothing to say, and he is deliberately trying to scare people.
Don't pay attention to him, his little tricks are not enough to watch. "
Han Limin was listening by the side, and when he hung up the phone over there, he would complain there.
"Ever since Wang Xicheng was transferred to the Specialty Products Bureau, hey, I can't get rid of him anymore.
While making efforts to expand the production of the second ginseng factory, build a factory for independent processing, and at the same time make efforts to introduce American ginseng, saying that they need to walk on two legs.
This is another South Korean business company investing in Deer Farm. He is very good at playing. "
Han Limin escorted Wang Xicheng to the capital to participate in the health care products expo. The two met, and Han Limin had a bad impression of Wang Xicheng.
Han Limin sneered while talking, "What happened to the Quanyang factory back then?
Isn’t it just to cooperate with them to produce ginseng honey champagne and red bean honey champagne?
Is that the deep-processed product he came up with?
The Quanyang factory was ruined, dare to say that he is not responsible at all?
At that time, Quanyang Factory was full of chaos, and he shrank his neck like a quail.
This is the ginseng honey and ginseng tea of ​​the second ginseng won the award, and he felt that he could do it again. "
Wang Xicheng was originally optimistic about the position of secretary of a participating party, but he wanted to transfer but was not transferred, so he was transferred to the Specialty Products Bureau.
The Bureau of Specialty Products and the Ginseng Company currently have one set of personnel and two brands, which is a form of integration of government and enterprise.
So Wang Xicheng is both the director of the Specialty Products Bureau and the general manager of the ginseng company.
In addition to several corresponding departments of the Specialty Products Bureau, it also manages several county-owned ginseng farms, ginseng research institutes, county ginseng factories, Xianrenqiao Deer Farm, and several joint venture ginseng farms.
Ordinarily, a ginseng market has been upgraded to a ginseng company, which is under the management of the city, and has nothing to do with the county at all.
Wang Xicheng also called specifically to talk about foreign investment, which was purely showing off.
It's a pity that with an investment of one million dollars, let alone Xu Shiyan, even Han Limin and the others don't like it.
"Look at it, he doesn't have a good slapstick, be careful to lose his hair, he won't survive the winter.
Sooner or later something will happen, and I won’t even have time to see him cry. "
Han Limin doesn't like people who don't work with peace of mind and only love to go around.
Xu Shiyan kept laughing when he heard Han Limin's complaints.
"Okay, let's not be familiar with him, anyway, what else can he do besides make a phone call to show off?
We are not under the jurisdiction of the county now. No matter how good he is with the regulations and skills, he will not be able to win us over. "
Xu Shiyan didn't take Wang Xicheng seriously. Anyway, he's not in the same system now, and it's best not to interfere with each other.
However, what no one expected was that the county leaders held a meeting to discuss the preparations for this year's Ginseng Festival, and Wang Xicheng was selected as the leader of the preparatory team.
Last year, the leader of the preparatory team was Xu Shiyan, and the deputy leader was Chen Jianzhang.
Now one of the two has become the general manager of a municipal enterprise, and the other has been transferred to work in the city.
Many people in the county were interested in the position of the head of the preparatory team, and rushed to **** it. I don't know what method Wang Xicheng used, but he finally snatched it away.
Wang Xicheng took up the post, and he was very good. He selected people from various units to join the preparatory team.
This guy is also shrewd. Afraid of his lack of experience, he selected some members from last year's team members.
Unfortunately, Xu Shixian, who was in the publicity department, and Xu Shixiang, who was in the financial department, were not selected.
"Brother, if you didn't choose, you didn't choose. First of all, you can enjoy yourself in the unit now. It's good to do your job well.
The preparatory team you entered last year, and you know how tiring it is.
After the ginseng festival, these people can't wait to peel off a layer of skin.
Coincidentally, the three of our brothers are not in the group this year, so we don't have to worry about those leisurely things. "
When Xu Shiyan heard the news, he was afraid that Xu Shixian would be overwhelmed, so he made a special call to chat with Xu Shixian.
"Third brother, elder brother is fine.
Oh, your eldest brother is usually a little narrow-minded, but in this matter, I can definitely see it.
We did so well last year, but this year they can jump high, but they can't jump to the sky.
These people are all jealous and think it's a good job, but I don't think so. "
On the other end of the phone, Xu Shixian smiled.
Really think that he has been a fool in the agency all these years? Can't get over anything?
"That's fine, as long as the eldest brother has some thoughts in his heart, and then he can hold his breath and get angry.
Then you talk to the fifth child, let him not care about it, and work hard at the unit. "
Xu Shiyan was relieved when he heard what his elder brother said.
Actually, he is not worried about the fifth child, but the eldest.
The boss is narrow-minded, and can't get over anything.
In his previous life, Xu Shixian could cry for several days because the eldest daughter was looking for someone to stay away from.
At that time, Xu Shixian and his wife were in the ginseng business. Every time before going out, he steamed a pot of steamed buns.
If the steamed buns are ready to grin, he will happily go to Yangcheng.
If the steamed buns are not steamed well, and there are dead faces, he will slump and sigh all day long.
Just such a person, the brothers all know what the eldest brother is like, otherwise Xu Shiyan would not be in a hurry to call to comfort him.
"Hey, hey, okay, don't worry about this.
Old Wu has a broad heart, he never cares about these things. "Xu Shixian readily agreed.
The two brothers chatted a few more words on the phone before Xu Shiyan hung up the phone.
As a result, just as he put down the phone, the phone rang again. "Hello, who are you looking for?"
"Mr. Xu is busy with affairs, have you forgotten that you promised me to come to our place?"
On the other side of the phone, someone spoke not-so-standard Mandarin and laughed.
"Oh, Xiao Zheng, right?
Look, I've been busy since I came back from the Spring Fair, so I forgot to contact you again. "
When Xu Shiyan heard the voice, he remembered that he met Zheng Yuyang from the Commercial Bureau of a certain county in the southwest, whom he met at the Spring Fair.
The two met at the Spring Fair and exchanged contact information.
The next evening, Xu Shiyan had a drink with someone else.
It was agreed at the time that I would go over there some time and discuss the matter of medicinal materials.
Of course, what Xu Shiyan most wants to study is floor production.
It's just that since I came back from the Spring Fair, there are too many things here, too busy, and I really didn't arrange it.
"Mr. Xu is so busy, understandable.
Mr. Xu, when will you be here? Now is the best season here, you will regret not coming. "Zheng Yuyang asked with a smile on the phone.
Xu Shiyan flipped through the calendar on the table. Today is August 2nd. Before September, the shop will start to produce goods, and it will be busy until winter.
If you want to go out to investigate, it is the closest.
Anyway, there's nothing serious these days, so it's okay for him to go out for a while.
It is best to drag Guo Shouye together, and they go to see how the flooring factory produces.
Go back and ask where the machines come from, and whether the machines can be customized according to their requirements.
For some things, it is still necessary to plan as soon as possible to seize the market. You can only eat soup if you follow others, and you can only eat meat if you take the lead.

chapters.title: Chapter 707: Yunnan province trip
chapters.content:
Chapter 707 Trip to Yunnan Province
Xu Shiyan went directly to Guo Shouye's house after get off work, chatted with Guo Shouye for half the night, and told Guo Shouye all his thoughts.
Guo Shouye just heard that Xu Shiyan planned to set up a flooring factory, but he shook his head, saying no, the flooring here is not easy to sell.
After listening to Xu Shiyan's explanation, Guo Shouye also felt that this was a good idea.
So, Guo Shouye agreed, and went to the Southwest with Xu Shiyan for inspection.
The two agreed, and Guo Shouye talked to the leader.
The leader naturally has nothing to say. Now the Forestry Bureau is eager to have a good project.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye arranged work, left home on August 5th, and took the train to Shenyang.
Fly from Shenyang to the capital, and then transfer from the capital to Kunming.
Zheng Yuyang took people personally, picked them up at Kunming Airport, and then entertained them grandly.
Afterwards, Zheng Yuyang took Xu Shiyan and the others to some medicinal materials producing areas over there.
Xu Shiyan saw the growth environment and cultivation methods of the medicinal materials with his own eyes, and thought it was good, so he immediately signed a supply contract with there.
Every year, Zheng Yuyang provides a minimum of two million medicinal materials to Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory.
Zheng Yuyang’s county has medicinal materials, so they order them from there. The medicinal materials in their county are not the main production area, and Zheng Yuyang arranges people to go to other counties to buy them.
As for the purchase price of Zheng Yuyang and the difference in price, Xu Shiyan didn't care.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan only recognizes Zheng Yuyang, and if there is a problem with the quality of medicinal materials, he will only look for Zheng Yuyang.
Regarding this, Zheng Yuyang nodded without saying a word.
A minimum of 2 million a year, most of the medicinal materials are produced in their county, and a small part can be purchased from other places, and they can also earn money.
Two million may not seem like much in a developed city, but here, it is already considered a big business.
When the news spread, people in neighboring counties asked about it.
I want to know where the merchants who came to buy are from, and can I also go to them to buy some medicinal materials and so on.
Nothing is unachievable.
Xu Shiyan and his entourage came to investigate, and Zheng Yuyang accompanied him all day long. As long as anyone who is interested in inquires, they will know.
So the other party immediately rushed to the guest house where Xu Shiyan lived, wanting to have a chat with Xu Shiyan to see if he could steal a big client from Zheng Yuyang.
As a result, when the other party saw Xu Shiyan, he was shocked.
Isn’t this the person who dressed up overseas Chinese and Hong Kong businessmen at the Spring Fair, and went to the front of their booths to browse and look? The other party regretted it at that time.
"President Xu, I'm really sorry, I didn't mean to speak badly in Yangcheng that time.
Mr. Xu, you have a lot, so please forgive me this time. "
Meng Zhaoke, who was the one who satirized Xu Shiyan at the Spring Fair, apologized to Xu Shiyan with regret.
"Old Meng, you are not authentic, are you?
Xu is always my guest. Isn't it too good for you to go directly to Mr. Xu's residence and pry openly? "
When Zheng Yuyang saw the other party, his face was very ugly. This guy is too dishonest. How could he pry someone on other people's territory?
"Zheng Yuyang, we are classmates after all, and you are too careless.
With such a good resource, I don’t know how to share it with others. "Meng Zhaoke gave Zheng Yuyang a blank look.
This kid knows how to giggle all day long, has no temper when he sees everyone, and does silly things every day.
But who would have imagined it, he is a fool, he is a fool, why did he meet a big client? No, he had to pry him away.
"Mr. Xu, in fact, the conditions in our county are much better than here. We also have all kinds of medicinal materials over there, and the quality is very good.
Xu can always go to our side to have a look, the safekeeping will not be disappointed. "
Meng Zhaoke turned his head, changed his expression again, and talked to Xu Shiyan with a smile on his face.
The speed of face-changing has caught up with Sichuan Opera, and Xu Shiyan wanted to laugh when he watched it.
"Comrade, our company has signed a supply contract with Director Zheng, and this contract cannot be broken.
Sorry, you are late, maybe in the future, we will have the opportunity to cooperate. "
Xu Shiyan admired Zheng Yuyang, an honest, stable, and very friendly person.
Whether it's good to chat with him, or work or do things with him, I feel comfortable.
As for Meng Zhaoke, who is aggressive and mean-spirited, Xu Shiyan really doesn't want to embarrass himself.
"Sorry, I'm tired, I have to go back to rest, Comrade Meng, please help yourself."
Xu Shiyan ignored the other party, and went back to the room with Guo Shouye and others to rest.
Meng Zhaoke hurried over to get a piece of the pie, but was turned away.
Xu Shiyan ignored him, what could he do? He could only complain to Zheng Yuyang, and turn around and get angry with the people around him.
In the end, it can only return in vain.
On the way back, Meng Zhaoke regretted it so much that he wished he could slap himself twice.
As long as he had a better attitude at the time, it might be their county that cooperated with the pharmaceutical factory.
Xu Shiyan stayed in Yunnan Province for about a week, wandered around a lot with Guo Shouye, and also visited the flooring factory in Zheng Yuyang's county.
Zheng Yuyang has a real heart. As soon as he heard that Xu Shiyan inquired about the machines that produce flooring, he immediately explained clearly the origin of several machines in their factory.
At present, there are related manufacturers in China, but the quality of the machines they produce is worse than that of foreign countries.
Although the price is much lower, it is still a lot including the cost of later maintenance.
"Mr. Xu, if you want to buy a machine, it's best to import it from a foreign country.
I have the contact information of the foreigner here. You can contact him directly, explain your requirements to them, and see if they can modify the machine according to your requirements. "
Zheng Yuyang was very straightforward, and directly gave Xu Shiyan the contact information of a West German manufacturer.
Xu Shiyan did not bring an interpreter with him when he went out this time. How could he dare to call foreigners?
People are talking a lot, but he can't understand a word, how embarrassing it is.
So Xu Shiyan didn't make contact on the spot, let's talk about it when we get back.
"Okay, Xiao Zheng, don't send it any further, we'll board the plane and return.
These days, thank you and your county leaders for your hospitality. It was really wonderful. "
Seven or eight days here, the food is really eye-opening.
This is a good time for all kinds of bacteria to sprout, and there are all kinds of bacteria every day.
Combined with other local specialties, Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye have eaten in a circle these days.
Thanks to not eating any poisonous bacteria, Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye were able to wait for the plane safe and sound.
When I ate it, I only cared about the deliciousness, and then I was afraid when I thought about it.
If you don’t pay attention to this and eat something with red umbrellas and white poles, you don’t know what the end will be like.
"Mr. Xu, welcome to come again next time. Next time, bring Mr. Xu's lover and children to play together.
There are many beautiful places here, let the children have a look. "
Zheng Yuyang is still smiling all over his face, and people can't help but want to laugh along with him after seeing it.
"Well, okay, if you are free, you can also come to my place, and I will take you to climb Changbai Mountain."
Xu Shiyan waved to Zheng Yuyang and the others, turned around and walked towards the boarding gate with Guo Shouye and the others with their luggage.

chapters.title: Chapter 708: start of school
chapters.content:
Chapter 708 School starts
Xu Shiyan stayed in Yunnan Province for seven or eight days, and was delayed on the way back. When he got home, it was already August 20th, and the school started.
There is only one middle school in Donggang Township, which is jointly run by the town and Canchang.
So the source of students includes Donggang Central Primary School and its subordinate village primary schools, as well as Canchangzidi Primary School.
Because of the joint organization of the two parties, the students participating in the primary school, regardless of their grades, can directly enter the junior high school.
In the local language, it is called Quanguolift.
Students from so many schools are promoted to junior high school. It is conceivable that there will be many students in junior high school.
Xu Haiyuan and his class have six classes in junior high school, and each class has about fifty students.
When Donggang Middle School was first built, it used the site of Donggang Old Hospital. Originally, there were only bungalows on the east, north and south sides.
The westmost rooms of the house in the south were the bungalows of the old hospital.
Later, there were more students, and the classrooms were not enough. It happened that as soon as I participated in the event, I contributed money and built a school building.
Also built a three-story office building on the west side of the school, reserved for teachers' offices and various laboratories.
According to the rules of Donggang Middle School, freshmen in the first year of junior high school are arranged in the house in the south, and those in the second and third year of junior high school are moved to the house in the east or north.
Xu Haiyuan was assigned to Class 2. The classrooms of Class 1 and Class 2 should be old houses, much larger than those of Class 3, and the floor is paved with bricks.
From Class 3 to Class 6, the classroom area is smaller, but the floor is cement.
For the students, it doesn't matter whether the floor is brick or cement, nor does it care about the size of the classroom.
The only thing they worry about is whether the head teacher is strict and whether there is too much homework.
The head teacher of the second class is surnamed Gong. She is an English teacher. She wears a pair of glasses and smiles all day long. She looks very good-tempered, and the students also like her very much.
Xu Haiyuan's junior high school life begins here.
And Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing also started their primary school career.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui did not go to Donggang Central Primary School, but went to Canchang Primary School.
There are two main reasons for this arrangement.
One is that Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping are both studying in Donggang Central Primary School. These two children are too evil, and their academic performance is so good.
Both Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were worried that if the two young ones went to Donggang Central Primary School to study, they would not be able to escape the shadow of their older brothers and sisters.
The teachers at the school will definitely compare the grades of their older brothers and sisters with these two.
Maybe the teacher is unintentional, but this kind of behavior will hurt the child's self-confidence, which is not good for the child's future development.
In a new environment, even if the teachers on the other side have heard of Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, they haven’t taught them after all.
If you don’t understand, you won’t make comparisons on purpose, which is good for children’s physical and mental health.
Another one, I am also worried about Xu Haiqing, a brat.
What if he fails to pass the junior high school after finishing six years of elementary school?
It’s better to go to Shenchang Primary School to study. In this way, regardless of the grades, everyone can go to junior high school anyway.
As long as he graduated from junior high school, Xu Shiyan would be able to find a way to arrange a way out for his son.
Xu Shiyan is the general manager of Shenye Company. It is normal for his own children to go to junior schools, and no one can find fault with them.
The only disadvantage is that Shenchang Primary School is a bit far away from Xu’s family, which is not as close and convenient as Donggang Central Primary School.
It's not difficult. Nowadays, children at this time are running wild outside all day long, and they don't feel afraid to walk that way at all.
Besides, Xu Shiyan has to go to work every day, and when he leaves in the morning, he takes his two children with him.
At noon, the two children were out of school, so they went to the field department to find him, and the three of them had lunch in the cafeteria.
After school in the afternoon, the two children went home with their schoolbags on their own, without any delay.
Just like that, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing successfully became first-year Xiaodouding.
Before going to school, Xu Haiyuan specially called his younger brother out and had a good talk with him.
He told Xu Haiqing, if you go to Canchang Primary School and do not study well, you will lose face to our father.
Our dad is the general manager, but you don’t know anything because you don’t know anything, can you still obey our dad?
Not to mention, Xu Haiyuan's trick is very effective. Xu Haiqing seems to be a different person after going to school.
Sit there obediently in class, don’t worry about what you understand or don’t understand, anyway, it’s not like in Yuhong class when you can’t sit still and always get into trouble.
"Ms. Ye, if the two children are disobedient at school, you should discipline them and beat them up. You can't control them too much.
Especially Xu Haiqing, if he is disobedient at school or makes trouble in class, you will beat him hard. "
In the morning, when Xu Shiyan sent the two children to school, he happened to see the teacher of the children's class, so he chatted with Teacher Ye for a few more words.
Teacher Ye is a young female teacher, and she laughed when she heard Xu Shiyan's words.
"What the general manager said, how could the children be so naughty? The two children have behaved well in the past few days since school started.
Listen carefully in class, actively answer questions, and finish homework very well. The two children are smart. "
Ms. Ye praised the two children, saying that she had never seen such a worry-free first grader.
Xu Shiyan was quite puzzled, did the teacher mean his son? Why doesn't it sound like it?
Actually, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing are not stupid, they are even much smarter than ordinary children.
The key point is that they have two brothers and sisters who are too outstanding. Even if they are not bad, they don't show it at all.
But after leaving the shadow of their elder brothers and sisters, compared with other children, these two are definitely upper-middle children.
What's more, Xu Jinping has been staring at the two of them studying all day for the past two years.
Even if it’s a waste, the homework of the first grade has already been memorized, so it’s naturally better than other children.
So the primary school life of the two children unfolded like this. Xu Shiyan observed it for a few days and felt that it was okay, so he was relieved.
In late August, ginseng began to make products one after another.
This year’s participation is still 40,000 feet, but the forestry bureau also needs to add 30,000 feet, so the processing factory has a lot of work.
So at this time, all the family members of the employees participating in the field, as long as they can still move, will go to the processing factory to work.
In addition, a group of temporary workers will be recruited from the surrounding villages.
The wages paid by the processing factory are not low. Many girls and daughter-in-laws come to work and take advantage of this time to earn more money.
"Sister-in-law, when will our processing factory start to catch and process the goods? Hurry up, because we won't be able to catch the goods if it's too late.
There are a lot of orders this year, so don't fail to complete the orders. "
Ji Yufeng, Yu Lihua and the others were all in a hurry, for fear that they would start late this year, not catch too many goods, and make less money.
"Don't worry, your third brother said to wait a few days to see the market. If the market can stabilize, we will have time to grab the goods."
Su Anying didn't quite understand why Xu Shiyan didn't let them grab the goods too early this year for processing.
But her husband has a certain reason for doing things, Su Anying never doubted, so she was not in a hurry, and kept waiting.
"If you are in a hurry, you can bring back our own and process it first. Let's wait a few more days."
Su Anying only knew that Xu Shiyan asked her to wait, so she waited, but Su Anying didn't know exactly when she would wait.

chapters.title: Chapter 709: screwed up
chapters.content:
Chapter 709 screwed up
No one knows why Xu Shiyan asked to wait. I don't even know when I need to wait.
Even Su Anying was dumbfounded, she couldn't tell what Ziwumaoyou was.
But Su Anying is the general manager of the company, she has the right to call the shots, and other people have to listen to Su Anying's arrangements no matter how doubtful they are.
So each family went back to wait for the news, or they would bring back their own ginseng land and process it first.
This fall, each company’s production is still 100 feet.
Since they are not in a hurry to grab the goods, each family is not in a hurry to get up all of them, and they will go up to 20 feet in a trip, and they will process slowly when they come back.
Be more careful, and the quality of the products will be better.
While Su Anying and the others were waiting anxiously, the third Ginseng Festival was about to open.
This year's Ginseng Festival was chosen to be held on September 3rd, and the location is still in Fusong City.
Originally, the city wanted to join hands with Fusong to hold this year's Ginseng Festival, but Li Jingyu and others disagreed desperately.
If it is co-organized with the city, it is tantamount to bringing other counties along.
In the past two years, they have spent so much effort and put in so much effort, and they finally laid the groundwork. How can they let other counties follow suit and take advantage of it for nothing?
Li Jingyu argued with the city leaders, saying that they have been preparing for such a long time this year.
If the city wants to do it, it should be discussed in advance next year, and then it will be done in the city.
The city was originally a proposal. Since Li Jingyu and others disagreed, they did not insist on it.
So, this year's Ginseng Festival is still held in the county.
This Ginseng Festival was prepared and organized by Wang Xicheng and his staff.
I don’t know whether Wang Xicheng wants to make another breakthrough, or if he deliberately wants to get away from Xu Shiyan, overthrowing the design and process of last year’s Ginseng Festival, and redoing the planning and design.
The first day opened, the second day and the third day led domestic and foreign merchants to play, the fourth day was the agricultural product fair, and the fifth day closed.
Wang Xicheng means to let domestic and foreign merchants play first.
When they are happy and satisfied, they will be willing to buy more things and place orders later in the fair.
"If we make them happy, we will definitely be able to buy more things then.
Last year, it was too careless, as if people didn’t buy things, and they didn’t arrange for people to play around in the future. "
Wang Xicheng told the preparatory team this way when designing the process of the Ginseng Festival.
"Yes, yes, Wang Ju is still thoughtful, so it will indeed be better.
I feel that our ginseng festival this year will definitely be able to create another glory, and the transaction record is even higher than last year. "
Many people in the preparatory team were picked by Wang Xicheng himself. They have a good relationship with Wang Xicheng and immediately agreed.
There are also some people who have reservations about this.
The level of transaction volume is not at all about coaxing merchants, it’s just about doing business, why do you still have to coax people? What's the point?
But these people don't have much voice, and Wang Xicheng simply ignores what they say, so what can they do?
On September 3rd, colorful flags were fluttering in the county town, gongs and drums were blaring, and the people of the county were singing and dancing to celebrate their festival together.
When it came to September 4th, the people in the preparatory team arranged for the merchants to play around.
Last year, I went to climb Changbai Mountain and go rafting. This year, Wang Xicheng is ingenious and plans to take merchants to visit the place.
This is also a request from merchants, because those merchants proposed last year that they want to go to the ginseng field to see the growth environment of ginseng.
At that time, Xu Shiyan refused on the pretext that the ginseng land was in deep mountains and old forests, the road conditions were not good, and it was not easy to enter the mountains.
So this year Wang Xicheng took the initiative to take merchants to visit the site.
The merchants were very happy, and they kept praising Wang Xicheng, saying that Wang Xicheng was capable of working, and this could be arranged.
There are still some people, so they brought it up, saying that they want to go to a participating site to have a look.
Wang Xicheng could only explain to others that Yishenchang is now under the jurisdiction of the city, not the county, and he has no right to take anyone to visit Yishenchang.
"Our county has not only one participating venue, but also two participating venues, three participating venues, and four participating venues.
I was transferred from the second spectator, and I can arrange it there.
Just at this time, the ginseng field has started to participate. I will take you to see how we ginseng farmers work in the field. "
Wang Xicheng explained to the other party proudly, explaining the reason.
Those merchants didn’t know how to visit the market, anyway, there is a place to see it, so they took the car specially arranged by the county and went straight to the second market.
Ercanchang is located in Xingcan Town, about the same distance from Songjiang River and Fusong.
The group of people arrived at a sub-field under the second ginseng field within less than two hours by car.
At this time, the workers of the No. 2 Can Factory in Candili were kicking out the mallets.
"Ladies and gentlemen, this is a branch of our second ginseng field. The large ginseng area in front of us is the place where ginseng will start making goods this year.
Over there, workers are digging sticks out of the field. This year's ginseng production is good, and the quality is also very good. "
When they arrived at the place, the merchants got out of the car, and Wang Xicheng and others led them to the ginseng field, introducing them proudly as they walked.
However, what they didn't notice was that the foreign businessmen in the back were all frowning at this moment, and many of them were talking in low voices.
Wang Xicheng in the front is still eloquently introducing, saying how good their second participation is, their development prospects are broad, and they hope that merchants from all over the world will come to invest and place orders, etc.
But the people behind became more and more impatient. Finally, someone swears.
"This is so unreasonable.
Your ginseng is sold to us so expensively, we thought how harsh the growing conditions are and how difficult the planting process is.
The results of it? Your ginseng is dug out like carrots and potatoes in such fields.
You guys, this is cheating, we won't order this ginseng again. "
Someone yelled loudly, and others followed suit, shouting loudly and making noise, asking the county staff to give an explanation.
Wang Xicheng was still spitting, when he heard the noise suddenly, he was quite dazed.
"What's the matter? What are they doing? Is this happy?" Wang Xicheng asked the translator beside him.
"Ju Wang, things don't seem right.
They are all making noise, saying that we lied to them, that our ginseng is worthless at all.
Things like radishes and potatoes grow out of the ground, but they are so expensive to sell to them. They want to ask us for an explanation and return the product for a refund. "
The translator's face is white and grey, it's broken, it's too much fun, what should I do?
Wang Xicheng was also dumbfounded when he heard this. It's over, he screwed up the ginseng festival.
"Everyone, everyone, please be quiet and listen to me.
Our garden ginseng planting has a history of hundreds of years, and it has always been cultivated in this way.
Not only here, Dongyi, Northern Dynasties, and South Korea, these places grow ginseng just like us.
They also sent people to learn our technology. Ginseng has high nutritional content and high medicinal value. How can carrots and potatoes compare with ginseng?
And we grow ginseng, the cost is relatively high, so the selling price is also high. "Wang Xicheng shouted loudly, trying to explain to the person in front of him.
However, no one listened to him at all, those foreign businessmen just turned around and left, and no one paid attention to Wang Xicheng.
Now, Wang Xicheng was dumbfounded, what should I do now?

chapters.title: Chapter 710: More than a failure
chapters.content:
Chapter 710 There is more than enough to reveal
Yi ginseng is already a ginseng company, and it is not under the jurisdiction of the county.
Besides, this year’s Spring Fair received so many orders that workers had to work overtime to get out, so Xu Shiyan didn’t attend the Ginseng Festival this time.
So many foreign trade orders are very important. Xu Shiyan thinks that he should stay in the unit and watch the processing and production.
"Third brother, something happened."
Xu Shiyan was looking at the data report in the office, when suddenly the phone on the desk rang, and when he picked it up, he heard Xu Shixiang's eager voice.
"What happened? You speak slowly, don't worry.
Is it Big Brother or something went wrong with your work? What are you doing? Did you stab someone? "
Xu Shiyan was taken aback by his younger brother's words, thinking that Xu Shixian or Xu Shixiang's work had gone wrong.
"Third brother, many of us, it's the ginseng festival. Something happened to this year's ginseng festival." Xu Shixiang said anxiously and angrily.
"Wang Xicheng, he took the merchants to the site of the Second Candidate.
When the foreigners saw that the workers were kicking the hammer, they immediately quit.
Said that ginseng was dug out of the ground like carrots and potatoes, but it turned out to be so expensive for them.
They didn't buy it, and the original order was cancelled.
When those people came back from Xingshen, they went directly to Secretary Li and the others, and started arguing. Now those foreigners are packing their bags and preparing to leave. "
Can such a big matter be kept secret? Almost as soon as the bus returned to the county, it immediately spread throughout the entire county.
"Fuck, Wang Xicheng is an idiot.
Did a donkey kick his head? Or is his head full of shit?
If you don’t have the diamond, don’t take on the porcelain job. If you don’t have the skills, you have to grab it.
Damn it, why can't you even copy homework? Even if he copied it like last year, it wouldn't be like this.
This idiot, let him make such a move, and the ginseng market will drop immediately. "
Xu Shiyan couldn't hold back, swearing on the phone and swearing directly.
In my previous life, there was no ginseng market, and there was no deep processing of ginseng. All ginseng in this county was purchased by the provincial medicinal materials company and health care product company.
In the autumn of 1989, the Provincial Medicinal Materials Company no longer carried out the plan to purchase ginseng with a minimum guarantee, and the purchase could only be organized by the local government.
How capable is the county government? They simply do not have the ability and financial resources to purchase all of them, resulting in a large backlog of local ginseng, resulting in unsalable ginseng.
After 1990, affected by the international situation, the price of ginseng continued to drop, and fell to a trough in 1992.
At that time, there was a saying among farmers.
It is said that Fusong opened the ginseng festival, and brought foreign businessmen to the ginseng field, so that they could see the sticks in the field.
As a result, foreign businessmen were annoyed when they saw it, saying that ginseng was dug out of the ground like a big radish, but they were sold at such a high price.
Immediately, the foreign businessman canceled the order, and the price never rose again.
This kind of saying has always been said, and many people have spread it like this. Xu Shiyan can't be sure if this is the case. He hasn't seen it with his own eyes.
But the majority of ginseng farmers have hated the ginseng festival since then.
So many years later, when they heard that the county was going to hold the ginseng festival for the first time, many people still scolded it.
Last year, many foreign businessmen wanted to go to ginseng to see the growing environment of ginseng.
Xu Shiyan remembers what happened in his previous life, regardless of whether it is true or not, he will never make this mistake.
So no matter who asked, Xu Shiyan said that ginseng is planted in deep mountains and old forests, and the roads are not easy to go.
The foreign businessmen heard what Xu Shiyan said, so they didn't ask for it anymore. Anyway, they were having fun elsewhere.
Xu Shiyan didn't join the preparatory team this year. He thought that no matter how stupid Wang Xicheng was, he would always copy his homework.
Who would have thought that this idiot could actually do such a stupid thing?
"No, today is not the second day of the opening, should it be the Agricultural Products Fair? Why did you go to the Second Participation Fair?"
Xu Shiyan felt strange, why didn't the foreigners sell the goods first when they were in high spirits, why did they let them play?
I'm so tired after going out to play, who has the energy to go to the trade fair when I come back?
Many people originally wanted to buy a lot of things, but because they were too tired and out of energy, they subconsciously wanted to finish earlier, so they reduced the purchase amount.
If there is a trade fair today, go to play tomorrow.
Even if they went to the second ginseng field and saw the situation of ginseng, they were dissatisfied, and because they had already placed an order, they were somewhat scruples, and they would not make such a big fuss.
So, Wang Xicheng is a big idiot, and such a simple job can be messed up.
"Third brother, what should we do? The ginseng market has dropped, and our county's economy has been directly set back for many years."
Xu Shixiang is in the financial department, and you can tell how serious the follow-up impact will be when you hear it.
"What to do? If only I knew what to do.
伱When your third brother is a big international chaebol? If I had that strength, I would have already rounded up all the clubs in our county. "
Xu Shiyan was angry, and his tone was a bit unpleasant.
Of course, Xu Shixiang understood that the third brother was in a hurry to get angry, so he didn't care at all.
"Then there is really no other way? My eldest brother, my fourth brother, and I planted some clubs last year and the year before the year before. I'm afraid we will lose money now."
At this moment, Xu Shixiang feels as if he wants to cry but has no tears.
Xu Shiyan took a deep breath to calm down.
"Old Five, you don't have to get too angry, let's see the situation first, you and your eldest brother's sticks, no matter what, you won't lose too badly.
When the sky fell, there was a taller person to hold it up, and those units suffered more damage, so they were the ones who had to pay for it.
Listen to me, don’t invest any more money in these few years, at least within five years, the market will not go up. "
In 1995, merchants from South Korea bought a large number of ginseng, and the market finally improved a bit, but it never recovered to the most glorious time in 1987 or 1988.
In the past few years, I just don’t have to think about anything. Those who used to have the foundation, just keep planting the hammer and don’t stop the flow.
If you haven’t laid a solid foundation before, then you should let it go, you should go to work, you should work part-time, as long as you can make ends meet.
When Xu Shixiang heard what his brother said, his heart, which was half cold, was completely cold now.
"Third brother, will your company be affected as well?"
Xu Shiyan sighed, "Yes, definitely, but it's hard to judge the impact now.
What can I do then? Carry it, the participants have a solid foundation and can bear it. "
There must be an impact. The overall environment is not good, and it is impossible for the participants to be alone.
But Xu Shiyan has been making arrangements in advance these years, just to reduce the impact.
Now the participating companies have mineral water factories, beverage factories, and pharmaceutical factories.
Even if the price of ginseng has dropped, those self-developed and produced products have already made a name for themselves, so it is unlikely that there will be no orders at all.
Even if there is a little fluctuation in the price, it is basically within an acceptable range.
"Fifth, hang up the phone first, I have to call the higher-ups, this is not a trivial matter, I have to report it quickly."
Xu Shiyan sighed and talked to Xu Shixiang, and the two brothers hung up the phone at the same time.
Xu Shiyan had just hung up the phone, but the ringtone came back again, so he quickly picked it up. It was Guan Enxue on the other end of the phone.
"Shiyan, have you heard about the ginseng festival?"

chapters.title: Chapter 711: can only endure
chapters.content:
Chapter 711 Can only endure
"Mayor Guan, I just wanted to call you. I just heard about the Ginseng Festival."
Xu Shiyan guessed that as long as Guan Enxue heard the news, he would definitely not be able to sit still.
He was going to call Guan Enxue just now, but before he called, Guan Enxue called first.
"Shiyan, tell me, is there any way to save the current situation?"
Guan Enxue was on the other end of the phone, anxious like a headless chicken, not knowing what to do.
This kind of thing, the first time I meet it, everyone is numb.
"The mayor, I really can't do anything about this."
He, Xu Shiyan, is just an ordinary person, taking advantage of rebirth, how can he have the ability to turn the tide?
What's more, he had warned long ago, and these people didn't listen.
What happened today, on the surface, was Wang Xicheng’s mistake at work, but in essence, it was still a game of capital.
The huge profits of the ginseng industry have been seen by some chaebols, and they certainly cannot allow the domestic ginseng industry to continue to flourish.
The sickle is raised, and it is bound to harvest a wave.
The past few years have been safe and sound. It can only be said that the leeks have not grown well, and now it is time.
Wang Xicheng created such a good excuse again, why don't he slash him hard?
"If even you can't do anything, then there is really no way out.
This year, the provincial medicinal material company and the health care product company will no longer implement guaranteed purchases, so what can Shennong do now?
Well, at the beginning, you wrote several reports and wrote articles advising relevant departments to control the rapid development of ginseng, but unfortunately no one listened.
This time, they all lost a lot. The club must not rot in the ground, no one wants it anymore? "
Guan Enxue was on the other end of the phone, almost crying in a hurry.
Provincial medicinal materials companies and health care products companies no longer implement guaranteed purchases, and foreign businessmen are clamoring not to place orders, and those who have already placed orders will also cancel their orders.
In this way, where will the sticks grown by Shennong be sold? If they can't be sold, can they all rot in the ground?
"Be in charge of the mayor, no one will want it, ginseng is not like Clivia, Clivia is useless at all, purely ornamental.
Ginseng is a precious medicinal material. Its efficacy is here, and it must still be sold. It’s just that many merchants will no longer buy in large quantities like before.
In the past, foreign businessmen were stockpiling goods for sale, but in the future they could only sell them on the spot and buy them on the spot. The inventory was all put in our ginseng producing areas, and in the hands of ginseng farmers. "
On the one hand, the output of ginseng continues to rise, and a large number of ginseng is backlogged in the production area.
On the other hand, foreign businessmen no longer buy in large quantities.
Farmers in the production area and planting and processing enterprises, in order to sell their own goods as soon as possible, they can only lower the price of each other, and in the end, it is cheaper for outsiders.
Just like what Xu Shiyan said to Xu Shixiang, if a large amount of capital pours in at this time, and directly controls the acquisition of ginseng, the situation may be stabilized.
If you can control the purchase of ginseng in full for several years, foreign merchants will have to be anxious, and the price will be stabilized.
But just think about it, it's impossible.
The county's ginseng production this year is about 3 million kilograms. Based on last year's average price, the minimum cost is 200 million yuan.
This is only one place in Fusong. There are many surrounding counties and cities that grow ginseng. How much is the output after all?
And this is not a year, at least four or five years in a row, but the output will be higher next year and the next year will require more money.
At present, in China, I am afraid that there is no enterprise that dares to invest 18 billion in one go.
With that money, why don’t they do something wrong, do they have to throw it here? If one is not done well, it will lose everything. That's what fools do.
"Then can the life of participating in agriculture be easier?" Guan Enxue heard this and murmured.
"What can I do if I'm having a hard time? Don't I have to live on?"
Xu Shiyan sighed, wasn't it like this in his previous life?
Desperately watching ginseng on the mountain and earning some money, I invested all of it in the ginseng field, but lost it all at once.
In those years, the life at home was the real torment.
In addition to planting ginseng and planting fields, he ran mountains to collect cattle hair, dug Gastrodia elata, dug large soil for others, and went to ginseng fields in autumn to block seeds.
It’s okay to meet people who are easy to talk to. After they stop once, they will let people in and stop again.
When you meet someone who is difficult to speak, why don't you let him go, and let the dog bite you.
Later, Han Wenzhong couldn’t see it, and tried to find a way to ask Xu Shiyan to participate in the venue, and asked him to go up the mountain to see the participation.
At any rate, you don’t have to run around, and you can earn money steadily on the mountain.
Xu Shiyan was watching ginseng on the mountain, and Su Anying didn't dare to be idle at home, working for others everywhere.
Picking fruit in the orchard in summer, earning eight yuan a day.
After picking the ground fruit and weeding, it takes eight yuan to dry it in the sun for a day.
In autumn, if anyone has a lot of goods, they will go to work for them, such as picking ginseng, planting seeds, brushing water, setting forks, picking seeds, and doing any work that can make money.
What can I do if I quit? Who told me that my family didn't have enough savings, there are old people and young people, this family is waiting to eat, what can I do?
In winter, Su Anying and her mother-in-law grow bean sprouts together, and then go to Songjianghe Market to sell them.
During the twelfth lunar month of winter, I stood in the open-air market for a whole day, and my hands and feet were frozen. When I came home at night, they were red, swollen, and painfully itchy.
Su Anying's face can't be tanned even in the sun in summer, but in winter, it turns black and red when blown by the cold wind.
The two girls in the family are sensible, and they help pick soybeans and filter bean sprouts when they come home from school.
It’s winter vacation, and the boss goes to the market to sell vegetables. She’s a good girl, but her cold hands are like carrots.
The whole family lived frugally and suffered so much. They invested any money in the ginseng field.
At any rate, it was not until 1995 that the market price rose a bit, so I was relieved.
After two lifetimes, for so many years, Xu Shiyan always feels sad when he thinks back to the beginning.
In that year, there were too many people like the Xu family.
Xu Shiyan, at least with the help of Han Wenzhong, found him a job as a supervisor, and he could earn some money steadily.
There are still families who don’t even have this kind of work. It was really hard at that time.
"It's over now, the price of ginseng has dropped, the county's economy has collapsed, and the lives of ordinary people are difficult.
Alas, how can I explain this to the elders and fellow villagers of Sanxiang. "Guan Enxue was on the other end of the phone, sighing nonstop.
The ginseng industry can be said to be the largest local economic support. The impact of this collapse is really too serious.
"Shiyan, your company may also be affected.
I have no other requirements for you, you must do your best to stabilize your company, and don't make any mistakes.
You have to know that you are related to the lives of thousands of employees and their families.
Your place is a key enterprise in our city. If your place is also unstable, it will be even more difficult. "
The economic situation in the past two years has not been very good, and this time will undoubtedly make things worse.
Other enterprises in the city are also in a downturn. Now that the ginseng industry has been hit hard by this, it will become more and more difficult in the future.
"If you have any good ideas, you must tell me and try to save it." Guan Enxue repeated it several times on the phone.
"Well, I will. If I think of any ideas, I must report to the leader."

chapters.title: Chapter 712: return order
