chapters.content:
Chapter 712 Cancellation order
The domestic and foreign merchants who came to participate in the ginseng festival packed their luggage and left after making a lot of noise.
The trade fair originally scheduled for the fourth day can only be canceled temporarily.
Those farmers and enterprises who came to participate in the agricultural product fair could only sigh and curse and pack up their things and leave.
A good ginseng festival ended up being a mess.
The original foreign trade orders of the provincial medicinal material company and health care product company were also cancelled.
Even Su Anying's company, the merchants who were scheduled to acquire this autumn, called one after another to suspend the acquisition.
The southern merchants who originally lived in Donggang Canshi Hotel also checked out one after another.
Under this situation, who would dare to grab the goods rashly?
Hurry up and go back and deal with those in your hand. I don’t know how much I will lose.
The originally bustling market suddenly calmed down, not to mention foreign merchants, and local second-hand dealers disappeared.
There are complaints from farmers in the whole county, and many people are scolding, but what is the use of scolding? It doesn't solve the problem at all.
For such a big event, the superiors got the news immediately.
Do you know what can be useful? They also can't solve the situation that there is a large backlog of ginseng, and there is no foreign purchase.
Therefore, we can only be held accountable first, and the relevant responsible persons should be held accountable.
As the leader of the preparatory team, Wang Xicheng made the plan, and he was the first to bear the brunt of it. He was immediately dismissed from office and quarantined for review.
Half of the other members of the preparatory team also ate and died.
Only those who raised objections but were not adopted were able to retreat unscathed.
But Wang Xicheng is just the general manager of the ginseng company and the director of the special product bureau. If he is not backed by someone, how can he mess around?
The relevant responsible persons should also be held accountable, and no one should try to run away.
So, Li Jingyu and several other people in the county were directly slapped to the end, and even people in the city and province were held accountable and investigated.
Guan Enxue became a full-time post, fully presiding over various tasks in the city.
Chang Hongfa acts as the acting secretary and is responsible for various affairs in the county.
The former director of the Finance Bureau was transferred to the deputy county, and Xu Shixiang was promoted to the deputy director of the Finance Bureau.
However, these measures cannot solve practical problems at all.
When the common people hear about it, they can only curse at what they deserve, and it has no other effect.
The majority of ginseng farmers are most concerned about whether this year's ginseng can be sold, how much the price of ginseng will drop, and how to live in the future.
But these, no one can give them the answer, no one in the county, city, or even the province has the ability.
Someone thought of Xu Shiyan, but now Xu Shiyan is also devastated and full of anger.
"General manager, just now a few foreign customers called and wanted to modify the order."
Li Chengrong came over with a stack of documents, looking for Xu Shiyan.
“They feel that our product prices are inflated, and they hope we can lower the price.
If we don't agree, they will cancel this year's order. "
"Fuck the fuck, cancel the order.
They dare to cancel the order?
They all paid half of the deposit. According to the contract, if they cancel the order without reason, the deposit will not be refunded. "
Xu Shiyan has been getting angry these few days, his eyes are red, his beard is unshaven, and his temper is much more irritable than before.
"Fuck, threaten me with this? I've been guarding against them for a long time.
Let them all take a good look at the contract.
Notify all customers who call that our products will be executed in accordance with the previous contract if the price does not drop. "
Xu Shiyan threw the stack of documents in his hand on the table and rubbed his temples. He suffered from severe suffering these days, and his head throbbed with pain.
"Our products are patented abroad, and others dare not imitate them.
Besides, we have made a name for ourselves over the years, and consumers recognize our products.
Foreigners are not stupid either. What they look for more is quality and effect.
Our products have passed the quality inspections of various countries and meet the standards. The quality is guaranteed, accurate and effective.
The price fluctuations of raw materials will not affect the position of our products in foreign markets. "
Xu Shiyan has been planning the layout since 1983. After so many years of hard planning, the results are still remarkable.
One of the participating products has a good reputation outside, and its quality and efficacy have been recognized by the vast majority of consumers.
Needless to say, the continuous increase in foreign trade orders in recent years is not only due to creativity.
It was done step by step and down-to-earth by the participants. No one can deny this.
"These people are following the trend to join in the fun, they are just chatting, thinking of taking the opportunity to bite us.
In case we can’t bear it and really lower the price, they will take advantage of it.
They are so beautiful, we have spent so much effort to develop the product, are they just letting them handle it? " Xu Shiyan snorted.
"But the general manager, if we force them to follow the contract, will they stop ordering from us next year?"
Li Bingzhuo and Dai Chunrong also came in from the outside at this time, asking worriedly.
These two people have had a hard time in the past few days.
I have to go to the ginseng and the processing factory to watch every day to appease the emotions of the employees, for fear that these employees will be affected and unable to work well.
These two people are not too young, and they live in the field all day long. They can't eat well and sleep well.
"As long as our products are competitive and have irreplaceable advantages, we can stand up straight and speak hard."
Participants spend a lot of money every year to register patents, and the money is not spent in vain.
At this time, the role of patent registration is revealed.
Their products are patented and recognized by consumers, and their annual sales are good.
Those dealers are all smart, who can't make money?
Xu Shiyan leaned on the chair, rubbing his temples.
"Xiao Li, I didn't speak well just now, so don't take it to heart.
In this way, you go back and call those merchants back and talk to them.
In our products, ginseng is only a part of the raw materials, and more importantly, the formula and craftsmanship are the core value. "
No way, people who have been up for many days will inevitably have a bad temper.
But Xu Shiyan has a relatively mild temper and can control his temper, so he quickly adjusted his emotions and regained his sanity.
"Tell them that if they agree to keep the price unchanged, we can give away some new products as a reward for years of cooperation.
In addition, our new products will be given priority to customers with good relationships in the future. "
The price can never be lowered. Once the price is agreed to be lowered, the business will be impossible in the future.
If you don’t lower the price, those foreigners must feel uncomfortable, and you should give them a little bit of sweetness.
Give away some new products to make the other party feel more comfortable, and at the same time, it is equivalent to promoting next year's order in advance.
This concession is regarded as the promotion fee for new products.
Under the current situation, it is very difficult to maintain a stable development, so where there should be concessions, you can consider it as appropriate.

chapters.title: Chapter 713: Steady
chapters.content:
Chapter 713 Steady
Currently, the products of participating companies are divided into several sections.
Health products such as ginseng honey slices, ginseng gastrodia elata honey, ginseng coffee and other health products with ginseng as the main raw material.
Mineral water, ginseng flower cola, ginseng cola, energy source functional drinks and other beverages.
There are also various medicines produced by pharmaceutical factories, as well as pure ginseng products such as Changbai Mountain red ginseng, natural active ginseng, and fresh-keeping ginseng.
The profit of pure ginseng products is low, not as high as other comprehensive products, and the proportion of raw materials is large.
So in the past few years, Xu Shiyan intentionally or unintentionally reduced the number of pure ginseng products as much as possible, but developed more comprehensive products.
In the case of fixed ginseng output, create as much value as possible.
According to Xu Shiyan's request, Li Chengrong led the company's professional translators and negotiators to conduct several negotiations with foreign businessmen.
In the end, most of the merchants agreed with the suggestion of the participating company.
The price will not drop, but the participating companies must compensate some new products appropriately.
It should be said that the advance layout of the past few years and the hard work of the R&D team have played a vital role at this time.
Leng Shengsheng While the ginseng market continued to fall and was upset, the ginseng company maintained its orders for this year and did not suffer too much loss.
Of course, there are also a small number of merchants who insist on not agreeing to this approach.
Especially those customers who ordered Changbaishan red ginseng, natural active ginseng, and fresh ginseng.
The current international market continues to decline, and people are unwilling to bear such losses.
In this part, after Li Chengrong consulted Xu Shiyan, he discussed with the other party.
If the other party agrees to exchange other products, the participating company can make appropriate compensation.
I really don’t agree, and it’s not like I’m going to do everything right here, and I have to withhold the deposit from others.
According to the amount of the deposit, the corresponding goods will be delivered, and this year's cooperation will be suspended.
Whether we will cooperate again in the future, we will discuss again.
In this regard, some customers understood and agreed to the exchange, while others did not understand and clamored not to cooperate in the future.
The team led by Li Chengrong fought hard without being humble or overbearing, and acted in accordance with the contract, trying to minimize losses.
Li Chengrong and others spent a lot of effort, and finally appeased the customers and kept more than 90% of the orders.
After the discussion over there came to a result, Xu Shiyan immediately called a meeting with his staff.
Discuss and discuss the processing focus of this year, and reduce the share of Changbai Mountain red ginseng, natural active ginseng, and fresh ginseng again.
These kinds of pure ginseng products will not be produced for the time being except after a small number of orders are completed this year.
Reserve the saved raw materials for use by pharmaceutical factories.
After the meeting, the managers of various departments of the company immediately went back to hold a small meeting with the employees under them, and truthfully explained the current situation of the company to the employees.
As soon as the employees heard it, most of the company's orders were kept.
In addition, the Bingshan Beverage Factory and Qingfeng Microbial Compound Fertilizer Factory, which the company invested in as shares, are currently developing well and earning stable profits.
Now, everyone is relieved.
"This time I put my heart in my stomach, with our general manager here, the company will not collapse.
Your wages and benefits are indispensable.
Work hard and hurry up to produce, the general manager said, the year-end bonus this winter is also indispensable to you. "
The heads of all departments hurriedly conveyed the spirit of the meeting to everyone.
"Come on, what are we worried about if we have a leader? Brothers, go to work.
How the factory develops and how to make money is something that the leader considers.
Our mission is to work hard no matter what happens and whenever. "
The team leader below hastened to call on the workers to speed up production. The more this is the case, the more they must be stable and not mess up.
In this way, the mood of the workers stabilized, and Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong and others also breathed a sigh of relief.
Finally, they can go home and sleep well.
Xu Shiyan is the same, he hasn't been home for more than half a month, and he can breathe a sigh of relief when the dust finally settles.
As long as the orders for this year are kept, we can ensure that this year's profits will not be lost.
As for explaining the next year, there is no need to worry, Xu Shiyan has already planned it.
"Dad, Mom, I'm back."
Xu Shiyan drove back to his parents by himself, and when he entered the door, he saw Su Anying and Zhou Guilan packing up the meals and putting them on the table.
Xu Haiyuan is in junior high school, and school ends later than before, around five o'clock.
There is no evening class yet, and I am waiting for the third grade of junior high school, and there will be evening classes until after seven o'clock.
Xu Jinping is in the fifth grade. At the beginning of school, she was selected as the captain of the Young Pioneers, and she was a little busier than before.
For her, it doesn't affect anything, the fifth grade homework can't help her.
Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing leave school early.
Recently, Xu Shiyan lived in the company and did not go home. The two children carried their schoolbags to school in the morning and walked back in the afternoon. Anyway, they did not hear them shouting that they were too tired.
At this moment, the two children have already finished their homework and are sitting at the table waiting for dinner.
The whole family was surprised when they saw Xu Shiyan enter the door.
Especially Xu Shiyan's unshaven beard, sunken eye sockets, and wrinkled clothes made Zhou Guilan and Su Anying feel bad.
"Oh my god, you're back, how did you make yourself? Have you become such a virtue?
You are in the company, at least clean up yourself. "Zhou Guilan couldn't hold back, and babbled a few words.
"Old woman, don't talk about that.
Encountering such a big event, how can San'er have the mood to clean up himself? "
Xu Chenghou hurriedly stopped Zhou Guilan, not letting her continue talking.
The son can come back, which means that the company is temporarily stable.
In today's situation, the company has not fluctuated much, which is the best news.
"San'er, come and sit down." The old man waved to his son, motioning him to sit beside him.
"How is the company doing now? Are the workers still emotionally stable?"
Although Xu Chenghou already had a guess in his heart, Xu Chenghou was still worried and had to confirm it again.
Over there, Chu Xuanhuai also looked concerned. Recently, there has been a lot of commotion outside, and Chu Xuanhuai has also heard from others.
"Father, Master, the company is still doing well, and most of the customers have calmed down.
Although we have paid some costs, our sales price has not dropped.
More than 90% of the orders have been kept, and this year's profit can be slightly less, but it is within a controllable range.
The mood of the workers is fairly stable. Today, each section held a meeting and explained the current situation of the company to them.
Everyone can understand, and they don’t have any complaints. It’s time to work. "
It should be said that the participation in the field has been developing very well in the past few years, and the workers' backgrounds are quite strong.
No matter when, the thickness of the wallet determines the tolerance of the situation.
The participating workers are quite well-off. Even if this year is a little bit sluggish, everyone can accept it.
There was a lot of confusion before, mainly due to the commotion outside. The workers didn't know where the future was going, and whether the company would be affected too much and lead to bankruptcy or something.
Now that the company is operating normally and the impact of the crisis is not too great, the workers feel relieved.
"That's good, that's good, as long as your company can stabilize, you don't care about anything else.
If Yingzi really can’t manage the business, then each will find a way out. "Xu Chenghou nodded and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 714: the sky won't fall
chapters.content:
Chapter 714 The Sky Will Not Fall
Since the accident, Xu Shiyan hasn't been home for more than half a month.
Although sometimes he called Su Anying, but Xu Shiyan was too busy there, and from time to time someone reported work or something.
The couple's phone calls were always interrupted, so they couldn't have a good chat with Su Anying.
Now hearing Xu Chenghou's words, Xu Shiyan turned to look at his wife.
"What's the matter? At the other end of the company, is someone gossip or is it a pick?"
"No, what's the challenge?
Thanks to everyone listening to you, no one dared to move to receive the goods this year.
After the accident in the county, Yufeng and Lihua said you were amazing.
If I hadn't listened to your arrangement, the big guy would have fallen into it this year. "Su Anying shook her head and explained.
"The sticks and mallets in the ginseng fields are all finished, and now I am worried, and I don't know what to do next?
Currently, the market is stinking to death, and there are no merchants in the market to grab the goods.
I called people, and they said that no one dares to seize the goods now, because they are afraid that they will not be able to sell.
Big guy is just a little anxious, I don’t know how long this situation will take, how can we sell the stick in our hand. "
Speaking of this, Su Anying couldn't help but sigh, in such a market, don't expect to make money, it's fine if you don't lose money.
"Talk to each family, let's hold on for a while, if it doesn't work, store all the goods of each family in the cold storage in Canshi.
Anyway, the few of us are not short of that little money, and the goods are directly stored and kept. Wait, wait until the market eases up. "
Xu Shiyan couldn't help sighing, this is really useless, why did most of the ginseng point to the exit?
At present, foreign merchants are likely to unite, just to suppress the domestic ginseng industry.
Unless the country comes forward, relevant departments join hands.
Especially when various domestic pharmaceutical companies unite to control the situation, invest large sums of money, and compete with foreign capital.
Otherwise, there is little hope.
But this is difficult. The country is in the construction stage, and money is urgently needed everywhere. Where can money be invested here?
The major pharmaceutical companies are eager to lower the price of ginseng, and they can also reduce costs. Who would be stupid to do such a thing that hurts others and does not benefit themselves?
So, the price of ginseng is bound to fall, and now it depends on how far it can fall.
What can be done right now is to properly store the goods of each company, keep them, and sell them out when the market is good.
Anyway, Huang Shengli and the others are well-off, so even if they don’t make money in the past few years, they won’t be unable to survive.
Let's stand up first, or what can we do?
"Well, okay, wait for me to tell them, there is really no way, so I can only be tough."
Su Anying sighed again and again. After such a toss, the loss of each family is not small.
They have a strong foundation and can afford it.
Those households who don’t have much savings in their families and have all their wealth in the fields are the most worrying people.
I don’t know how many people, this year may be difficult.
"Then what should I do next? I plan to plant a stick in a few days. What can I do after planting a stick?"
Su Anying is a little uncertain now, should he receive the goods and send them to Yangcheng, or not? Just stay at home cat winter?
Xu Shiyan was about to speak when Zhou Guilan brought the meal into the room and greeted everyone to eat.
"Stop nagging, hurry up and eat first, no matter what happens, you have to fill your stomach first when the sky falls."
In the old lady's place, eating is the biggest in the world.
"Don't think about anything, just take a step and look at it.
God can't starve to death, the blind bird can always find a way out.
In the past, it was difficult for the family to get over it. Although it is difficult now, but after all, the family is there, no matter how hard it is, it is better than before. "
Xu Shiyan and his wife burst into laughter.
Yes, their family is living better than most people now.
As for this one hundred and eighty-foot stick, when the market is good, it is more than a hundred thousand.
Sticks don’t make money, but farms and fertilizer factories still make money. What are you afraid of?
"Yes, eat, eat and drink, the sky won't fall." Xu Shiyan got up with a smile and sat down at the table.
"Oh, I haven't had a serious meal for several days, I'm so hungry, I don't care, let's eat first."
Before, I was worried every day, and I couldn’t eat because I was anxious to get angry.
Now that most of the things have been settled, as soon as I relax, I feel hungry.
"Eat, eat, see how thin you are, eat more.
This is the last crop of beans picked two days ago, and it was stewed with ribs tonight.
I didn’t know you were coming back, you know, I’ll put more meat. "
Zhou Guilan picked two pieces of meaty ribs and put them in her son's bowl.
There is no fat man in the Xu family. Among the sons, the fifth son is a little fleshy, and the rest are dry and thin.
Xu Shiyan was better last winter, but he gained weight from eating and drinking all day long.
I lost a lot of weight when I was busy in the spring. After suffering these days, I was almost as thin as a monkey.
"No, this is fine. I feel that everything tastes good when I come home and eat my mother's cooking." Xu Shiyan smiled while gnawing his bones.
No matter what time it is, the dishes my mother cooks are always so ironic.
Xu Shiyan was very hungry. He did not eat less of this meal. There were two big bowls of rice and a lot of vegetables. Only then did he feel that his stomach was full.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan sat on the edge of the Kang, talking and chatting with Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai, and while they were chatting, a dog barked outside.
Xu Haiyuan ran out to have a look, then turned around and shouted into the room, "Dad, it's Uncle Huang, Uncle Sun, and Big Brother Zhou are here."
Xu Haiyuan was talking about the eldest brother of the Zhou family, and he was talking about Zhou Qingguo.
Zhou Qingguo is a generation shorter than Xu Shiyan, and Xu Shiyan is called the third uncle, so why does Xu Haiyuan have to call Zhou Qingguo brother?
There is no way, don't look at Xu Haiyuan as a young man, he is there.
"Just now our kid went back and said that he saw your car. I thought he was talking nonsense, so I thought about it."
After Huang Shengli entered the room, he said with a smile.
The others followed into the room, and also greeted Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai.
"I've been busy for more than half a month, oops, I can't take it anymore, I'm going home today for a meal.
Sit fast, sit fast. Daughter-in-law, go and make a pot of tea, I will chat with Shengli and Qingguo for a while. "
Originally Xu Shiyan planned to take his wife and children home, and discuss with Su Anying what to do next.
I didn't expect Zhou Qingguo and the others to come over, so let's chat with them for a while.
"Oh, sister-in-law, don't be too busy, we are all drinking water at home, just come and sit for a while."
Everyone hurriedly stopped Su Anying and prevented her from making tea.
"Just sit for a while, it's getting late, and I have to go home and sleep later."
Zhao Jianshe and the others refused to let them, so Su Anying simply didn't make tea, and found a bench to sit on the side.
These people must be here to discuss the matter of sticks, and Su Anying also wants to hear it.
"Third Uncle, now that there is such a virtue as a stick, there is no one in our market to grab the goods.
The town is also worried now, and we don't dare to go out.
I was afraid that we would meet folks from the village on the road, and they would ask us when this stick would be sold. "
Zhou Qingguo started with a sad face. "Third Uncle, is there really nothing you can do now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 715: not ruthless
chapters.content:
Chapter 715 Not ruthless and not in harmony
"There is no good solution. Even if there is, the cost is too high, and there is no way to implement it."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, what can he do? There were so many ways before, but no one listened to it?
Now something happened, he is not a god, how can he have the stamina to turn the tide?
"The cost is high, what do you mean?
Third Uncle, just talk about it. Anyway, the few of us have the right to gossip. "
Zhou Qingguo has no clue now, no matter what Xu Shiyan says, he is willing to listen to it.
"One, is rich.
Put 18 billion in it, collect all the sticks in the hands of farmers and hoard them instead of selling them.
Within three years, all foreign merchants will be impatient, and they will take the initiative to discuss receipt of the goods. "
Among other things, Dongyi, South Korea and some Southeast Asian countries are very recognized for ginseng.
They are inseparable from ginseng products every day, let alone three years, at most two years if they are not supplied, they will be anxious to death.
"If we were more ruthless, half of the received goods would be destroyed directly, and the price of ginseng would be higher than before."
During the Ming Dynasty, Koryo State did this.
Their Korean ginseng had a good harvest, but the merchants in Daming suppressed the price and refused to accept their Korean ginseng.
Those people became ruthless and threw the good Korean ginseng into the fire and burned it.
Box by box was thrown away, box by box was burned, right in front of the Ming businessman.
Later, the businessman of Ming Dynasty couldn't hold back, so he hurriedly stopped him and bought all the remaining Korean ginseng at a higher price than before.
Zhou Qingguo shook his head helplessly when he heard this, "Third Uncle, aren't you joking? Where are you going to go for the whole 18 billion?
Let alone our county and city, even the province can’t afford such a large sum of money.
Even if you really have the money, you can’t buy it with real money and destroy half of it. Isn’t this a prodigal? "
Xu Shiyan smiled, this is the common thinking of Chinese people, no one would be willing to destroy things bought with a lot of money.
But if you don’t have this ruthlessness, you won’t be able to deter those foreign businessmen.
People will think you are easy to bully, so if you don’t bully, who do you bully?
"There is one more, the higher-ups intervened.
Decreed that all households are not allowed to sell sticks, and all sticks are suppressed and not sold.
Whoever sneaks in to sell food will be severely punished.
Especially those from enterprises and public institutions. If the quantity is large, they will be killed. They are not allowed to sell a single ginseng.
As long as everyone can work together and survive two years, the market will continue to recover. "
If you are not ruthless enough, you must be united.
As long as everyone is twisted into one rope, gritting their teeth and refusing to sell food, foreign businessmen will also be impatient.
But this trick is more difficult to implement.
How many kinds of ginseng are there in the three eastern provinces? With so many participating households, how is it possible to unite as one?
There are always people who are unwilling to bear such a loss and secretly sell them.
This matter is like the flood control levee, as long as there is a small opening, no matter how hard others try, it will be in vain.
"Uncle, we Cannon live by selling sticks and mallets. If they are not allowed to sell goods, how will they live?"
Zhou Qingguo shook his head, this is even more difficult and impossible.
"So I can say that the higher-ups will come forward, and the finance will provide living subsidies for farmers.
As long as the big guys grit their teeth and survive, foreign businessmen will definitely not dare to trick us in the future. "
You must let those foreigners see the ambition of the Chinese people, so that they dare not underestimate you.
Otherwise, as long as there is a chance in the future, I want to step on you.
Anyway, you don’t dare to resist, so make up your mind.
Zhou Qingguo sighed louder, isn't this a joke? Also financial subsidies?
If the finances are rich, there is no need to charge fees for participating in agriculture. "Uncle, is there really no other way?"
"No, there's really no other way.
Now we can only wait. Waiting is the cheapest way.
Wait until those merchants lower the price so low that it can't be lowered, and when the farmers can't afford it, they can only sell it with tears in their eyes.
Three years of hard work are all in vain, and it is good to be able to sell the cost back in the end. "
This is the ultimate goal of foreign businessmen. They don’t want to accept the goods, they just want to lower the price and lower it until they are satisfied.
Zhou Qingguo, Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others all turned pale, "Can we really get to this point?"
Then what's the point of planting this mallet?
"No way, rare things are more expensive, why is our ginseng production surplus now?
I have said several times that the excessive growth of the ginseng industry must be controlled. Isn’t it true that no one listens? "
Xu Shiyan shook his head and sighed, this is the price of disobedience.
This ginseng festival just doubled the price in advance.
"Third brother, I'm a rough person, you know what I usually say.
Other people have nothing to do with me, and I can't care about them. I just want to ask the third brother, what should we do. "
Zhao Jianshe was impatient. He heard Zhou Qingguo and Xu Shiyan rambling, but they couldn't get to the point, so he became anxious and asked directly.
"It's still easy to build." Xu Shiyan smiled.
"Simple, the goods of ours are directly stored in the cold storage, not sold, but kept.
Wait, wait a few years.
Waiting for those big players now, especially those that are held by various enterprises and institutions.
When they all get rid of their burdens and get rid of all the sticks, and they don’t dare to throw sticks indiscriminately in the future, the market price of ginseng will go up, so let’s sell it at that time. "
It is these people who really disrupt the market. With these people, no matter what policy they are, they can also mess up the mess.
Therefore, we have to wait until they have lost their bottom line, and they will not dare to meddle in it again. Only then will the ginseng market recover.
With these people around, forget about it.
When everyone heard this, they each sighed. They had no other ideas at the moment and could only listen to Xu Shiyan's arrangement.
"Well, okay, I believe the third brother, the third brother will definitely not cheat us.
That’s it. We’ll store up the stock and wait for the market to improve. "
Although Zhao Jianshe is stupid, he is not stupid. These years of experience tell him that he is right to listen to Xu Shiyan's arrangement.
Zhao Jianshe is not stupid, nor are Huang Shengli and Feng Chao, so they all nodded.
"Yes, we all listen to the third brother, no one sells goods, we all store them."
Even if you want to sell it now, you can’t sell it. It’s better to save it for the time being and put it away. Let’s talk about it when someone buys it later.
"Well, this autumn, each family will still plant a hundred feet, right?
Don't say that because of this, it will be broken all of a sudden.
The ginseng land is still developing as usual, anyway, it is only a hundred feet a year, not too much.
The cost of planting ginseng is considered to be low. At worst, it’s just a matter of time, and we can get back our money anyway.
In case the market picks up one year, wouldn’t you just make money? "
Xu Shiyan smiled and persuaded the big guys, but he couldn't say that it was because of this setback that he threw the rake and did nothing.
In the last life, many people never got stuck because of this.
When the market got better later, these people regretted it too much.
But at that time, they cleaned up the ginseng land, seeds, and ginseng seeds, and it was even more difficult to develop it again.
At that time, if you want to develop ginseng, it will not be solved by tens of thousands of dollars, the cost is too heavy.

chapters.title: Chapter 716: old fox
chapters.content:
Chapter 716 Old Fox
Zhou Qingguo and others were also embarrassed to sit in Xu's house for a long time. Anyone with eyes could see Xu Shiyan's haggard appearance.
Ordinary ginseng households have three to fifty feet of clubs, even if they lose money, they can't lose too much. I don't know how many people can't sleep these days.
How big is the participating company? As the general manager, Xu Shiyan was under countless times the pressure of ordinary people.
"Third Uncle, you should go to bed early, we will go home first.
No matter what happens, people are the most important thing. If money is gone, you can earn it again, and your body is the most important thing. "
Before leaving the house, Zhou Qingguo instructed Xu Shiyan.
"Well, don't worry, the participation is considered to be stable now, otherwise I wouldn't be able to go home.
You all hold your breath, it is useless to be anxious at this time.
Our mallet has a history of hundreds of years, and its value is affirmed, so it will not fail to sell.
Right now, I just have to be patient and get through it slowly, just get over it. "Xu Shiyan patted Zhou Qingguo on the shoulder.
sent away Zhou Qingguo and his party, Xu Shiyan also led his wife and children, and helped Chu Xuanhuai go home to rest.
On the way home, Chu Xuanhuai asked Xu Shiyan.
"Shi Yan, do you think you want to write a report and hand it in?
I think that the current situation requires action from above, otherwise, the life of participating in agriculture is really difficult.
We have to find a way, we can’t really let all the sticks and hammers be backlogged in the hands of Cannon, so how will they live? "
"Master, I can write a report, and I can make a suggestion, but I can't guarantee whether it will be useful.
I wrote so many reports before, but no one listened to them at all. Now, it is no longer something I can solve with just one report.
This really needs to be paid attention to by the higher authorities, and all parties can work together.
And even if measures are taken, it can only prevent people from overstocking ginseng. As for the price, it is impossible to recover. "
Xu Shiyan sighed, to be honest, he didn't want to write any report at all, it was useless.
The people at the top won’t adopt the suggestions, and the people at the bottom won’t actually implement them. Why is he trying so hard to write a bunch of stuff?
But the teacher said so, Xu Shiyan couldn't agree.
Forget it, just write it if you want, whether it is useful to write it, he has done what he should do, as for the others, there is nothing to help.
Xu Shiyan supported Chu Xuanhuai and walked into the yard. Just a few steps into the gate, a shadow rushed over.
Xu Shiyan saw the shadow, and knew it was a rascal, so he quickly let go of Chu Xuanhuai, and stretched out his hand towards the rascal.
Lai Pigui jumped into Xu Shiyan's arms all at once.
This little guy hasn't come back for some days, and it happened that Xu Shiyan also came home today.
"Are you going out again to make fun of yourself? You just came back?" Xu Shiyan rubbed Lai Pigui's head.
"By the way, you seem to be at least a teenager, right? You're old, old fox.
Don’t go out and make fun of yourself every day, I’m worried that you won’t be able to run fast with your old legs and waist, and some other beast will harm you. "
It is said that the life span of wild foxes is only seven or eight years, and the life span of domesticated foxes will be longer, about 14 to 15 years.
Xu Shiyan met Lai Pigui in the winter of 1977, before Xu Haiyuan was born.
Now that Xu Haiyuan is twelve years old, this fox is also a serious old fox.
Vixies and the like are all legends, and should not exist in the real world.
So Xu Shiyan is a little worried about Rapier, this guy is old now, right?
I don’t know, this guy can still be with them for a few more years.
Like the dogs Erhuang and Xiaohei, it has been obvious in the past two years that they are not energetic enough, lying in the nest all day long and drowsy.
I don’t know, these few will be gone in the future, Xu Haiyuan and others, can they cry and howl sadly?
The playmate who grew up with him suddenly disappeared, that feeling must be very uncomfortable.
Lai Pigui didn't know if he understood Xu Shiyan's words, anyway, he whispered to Xu Shiyan a few times, and then lay in his arms without moving. This
Guy hasn’t seen Xu Shiyan for a long time, this is acting like a baby.
Xu Shiyan followed Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Haiyuan to the Dongtou house, talked with Chu Xuanhuai for a while, and teased the rascal for a while, and then went back to the west.
Su Anying had already boiled a large pot of hot water and waited. First, she used a manual hair clipper to push Xu Shiyan's hair.
Then pour the hot water in the pot into the big wooden barrel, let Xu Shiyan take a hot bath.
I'm at work these days, I can't take care of anything, my body is almost smelly.
Now I shaved my head, took a shower, and put on clean clothes. I finally feel much more comfortable on my body.
"Daughter-in-law, I didn't bother to tell you just now, you should go to Yangcheng as soon as you plant the mallet."
At this point, the couple finally had time to talk about something serious.
"Why are you going to Yangcheng? In the current market, how can there be merchants grabbing goods?
At this time, do we still dare to take so many goods to Yangcheng? I received a lot of money for the goods. I dare not dare, for fear of falling into my hands. "
Su Anying is a little worried. Under the current situation, can going to Yangcheng solve the problem?
"Listen to me, bring less goods and test the market."
Xu Shiyan smiled, and hugged his daughter-in-law over. He hadn't hugged his daughter-in-law for many days, and his heart was empty.
"Didn't we buy a house over there? Go over there and find a way to buy the neighbors too.
Then find a construction team to tear down the house and rebuild it.
I’ve seen that place. If you buy it together with the neighbors, it’s quite a large area. It’s not a problem to build a four or five-story building. "
"A four-story building, preferably with a basement, the basement is used as a warehouse for inventory, and a shop is opened on the first floor, specializing in various local products in the Northeast.
Now it’s not enough to just point to the export, and we have to find a way to do retail in the south.
You may not understand it well, but there is a saying called “Northern Medicine and Southern Use”.
Our local area is dry, and most of them will get angry if they eat ginseng, but it is cold and damp in the south, so they will not eat it.
And the dryness of ginseng will remove the cold and damp air in the body.
So southerners pay great attention to these things. They like to buy ginseng to make soup and so on. "
“In the past, they could only buy by the gram from pharmacies, no matter how expensive or cheap, the products must not be so rich.
We used to open a store specializing in Northeast souvenirs. I will also authorize you to participate in the products there, and there will definitely be sales.
Next year, we will go to Shenzhen, Shanghai and other coastal cities to find places to open stores and build up our sales network.
The store is bigger, and it can be retailed or wholesaled. I don’t believe it, can a living person be suffocated by urine? "
Xu Shiyan hardly slept these days, thinking about it all the time.
How can we maximize the profits of the ginseng industry?
Deep processing is a mandatory condition. Only by increasing the technological content of ginseng products and making them irreplaceable products can they become more competitive.
But at the same time, you also need to have your own sales network
You can’t all point to merchants to buy, it’s too easy to get stuck in the neck.
At present, there are not too many large supermarkets in China, and duty-free shops at airports are not yet fully fashionable.
So let’s start with the shops in the coastal cities, and gradually expand the sales outlets.
Because housing prices in various places have not risen so abnormally now, stock up on houses when you need to stock up.
They don't point to real estate speculation, but they can use it to open a store and do business, killing two birds with one stone. No matter what happens in the future, there will be no loss.

chapters.title: Chapter 717: write a report
chapters.content:
Chapter 717 Writing Reports
Xu Shiyan hugged his wife and nagged for half the night, and finally got through the work, Su Anying promised to go to Yangcheng in a few days.
The couple have been exhausted for a while, and they don't have any other thoughts. They chatted and fell asleep at some point.
This time I slept until dawn, and when Xu Shiyan got up, the children had already finished their meals and went to school.
Xu Shiyan quickly took a few mouthfuls of food, cleaned up, and drove to work.
As soon as I arrived at the unit, the phone in the office was always on.
People from the city and the province called to care about the current situation of the participating companies.
As soon as I heard that the company was stable and most of the foreign trade orders were kept, the provincial leaders almost jumped up for joy.
Leadership is so beautiful, praise Xu Shiyan, and say that Xu Shiyan is capable.
Under such circumstances, being able to hold on to the order under pressure can be regarded as saving a lot of losses for the province.
While the leader was happy, he had to ask Xu Shiyan if he had any difficulties in the company.
If there is, don't hesitate to say it directly, the superior will definitely support it.
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to cry poorly with the leader, not the funds, but the technical talents.
Now the company is too short of technical talents, I hope the leaders can arrange more technical talents to come over.
At this time, Xu Shiyan, let alone some technical talents, even if he wants a research institute, his superiors will give it without a second thought.
So, with a wave of his hand, the leader promised to transfer all the Fusong Ginseng Research Institute to the Dongfang Ginseng Company, and the research institute will be under the management of the Ginseng Company in the future.
Anyway, the situation in the county probably can't afford to support those people in the research institute. It's better to be transferred to a ginseng company, which can play a greater role.
In addition, the leader also promised to select a group of college students who will graduate next year and arrange them to participate in the company.
For this, Xu Shiyan can go directly to the university in the provincial capital to choose, which university and major he is optimistic about, and choose someone by himself.
"I'll give you the official documents later on, don't worry, what I promised will definitely count.
You just need to stabilize our foreign trade orders, don't make any mistakes, and the province will handle the rest for you. "The leader made a bold promise on the phone.
"Come on, then thank the leader. With this group of people, I can flex my muscles and do something else."
Xu Shiyan did have other ideas. According to the current situation, he had to continue to refine the deep processing.
In-depth development of ginseng products can create more value.
"Ahem, Shi Yan, we are very clear about the current situation.
伱 Tell me the truth, in the current situation, is there anything you can do?
Let’s not say that the price of ginseng will return to the previous level. That is wishful thinking. It is how to solve the problem of a large backlog of ginseng.
At the very least, Shen Nong has to breathe a sigh of relief and have food to eat. "
The benefits are enough, and Xu Shiyan is coaxed into a good mood, so I will have the nerve to ask the question later.
Xu Shiyan had already guessed that the benefits are not for nothing, and there must be problems later.
"Leader, this cannot be explained in a few sentences.
How about this, I will write a complete report, writing out everything I can think of, the current situation and the way out for the future.
I don’t know if it’s useful or not, but I’m at this level, and I can only see and think about it.
The leader can consult with other people. "Even if the superiors don't ask, Xu Shiyan intends to write a report.
Now that I have taken so many benefits, I am content and write.
Anyway, he wrote it, and the higher-ups will accept it or not, it’s up to them.
"Okay, okay, great, then I'll just wait for your report."
On the other end of the phone, the leader happily said a few good words.
From the incident to the present, from various counties to provinces, the relevant leading cadres are all in a state of headless chickens.
I was in a daze the whole time, and didn't know how to ease the situation in front of me.
In fact, someone suggested long ago to find Xu Shiyan.
But the leaders of the province felt that at this time, Xu Shiyan must be racking his brains to keep the order, so how could he have time to take care of other things?
So they waited patiently and finally got through the most difficult time before calling Xu Shiyan.
At present, there are not many people who can come up with effective ideas under this situation.
Xu Shiyan should be regarded as an expert among them. If he can't figure it out, others will probably be in vain.
Xu Shiyan did not disappoint the leader, as soon as the leader opened his mouth, he agreed to write a report.
The leader happily hung up the phone, and praised Xu Shiyan to the people around him.
But how did he know that Xu Shiyan was thinking about how to create a problem for his superiors at this moment.
Such a big matter, can it be solved easily?
If the higher authorities don't show some courage and don't act serious, how can it be solved?
After Xu Shiyan hung up the phone, he told the secretary not to report ordinary matters to him, and he had to calm down and write the report first.
Anyway, the company’s orders have stabilized and the sticks on the mountain are about the same. At present, the processing plant is working hard, and everything is normal.
The secretary agreed, closed the door and went out. Xu Shiyan picked up a pen and began to write on the manuscript paper.
Write a little, stop and think, think for a long time, and write another paragraph.
The report mainly elaborates from several aspects.
The first one analyzed the current situation. According to Xu Shiyan's speculation, this is an operation of foreign capital for the purpose of harvesting profits.
So under the current circumstances, it is the worst policy to take the initiative to reduce prices to seek summation.
The more proactive this side is, the harder they will be suppressed. At present, the best way to deal with the outside world is to deal with it coldly and ignore it.
The second is to stabilize agricultural participation. Xu Shiyan suggested that the relevant higher-level departments should contact domestic pharmaceutical companies to find ways to purchase some products first.
Send a signal to farmers that the higher authorities will not ignore them, and are currently actively coordinating.
At the same time, banks can also be encouraged to lend to farmers.
The ginseng farmers can use the ginseng in their hands as collateral to borrow a certain amount from the bank to maintain their daily life and planting production in the next year.
The third is to introduce a protective price sales policy, and customize a relatively reasonable price through the calculation of professionals.
It can make the losses of ginseng farmers not so serious, and at the same time, it can also be accepted by these domestic pharmaceutical companies.
Each takes a step back, win-win cooperation, and the cheapness cannot be made by outsiders.
The fourth is to encourage farmers to automatically form production mutual aid cooperatives with townships (towns) and villages (tunnels) as units.
This is not a backward move, but a new cooperation model. Participating farmers unite and unite to jointly resist risks.
At the same time, I also call on the general public to participate in the farming. If you have the conditions, don't be too anxious to sell the goods, you can wait and see.
The best way is to organize a participation association with certain authority in the province or city.
The participating associations manage the cooperatives below, plan sales in a unified way, and formulate relevant regulations.
Guide the direction for participating farmers, so that all participating farmers can unite.
Unity is strength. At this time, foreigners must see this, show the spirit of fighting the enemy with one heart and one mind, and have to bear it even if it is hard.

chapters.title: Chapter 718: meeting is useless
chapters.content:
Chapter 718 Meetings are useless
While Xu Shiyan was still immersed in writing the proposal, the documents from his superiors were passed down.
In the county, Chang Hongfa received a document from the province to allocate the ginseng research institute to Dongfang Ginseng Company, and it will no longer be under the jurisdiction of the county in the future.
Relevant personnel of the research institute, if they do not agree to be transferred, find another way out.
Chang Hongfa and others also sighed after receiving the document, what can they say?
With the current situation in the county, how can there be extra expenditure to support the research institute? Just give it, and it can lighten the burden a little.
As for the relevant personnel of the research institute, when they heard that they had been assigned to Dongfang Ginseng Company, they were all so happy that they packed up their things and moved away immediately.
In the county, research funding has to be applied over and over again before some can be given, and the institute has to take on additional jobs to support these people.
Shenye Company is good, it has a lot of money, and they don’t care about the little research funding.
Look at how well the participating companies have developed in the past few years. All kinds of deep-processed products are exported to earn foreign exchange, and the participating workers are all very rich, which is too enviable.
This is the most ideal place, no fool would be willing to go there.
Just like that, the director of the research institute contacted Donggang as soon as possible.
The two parties discussed the specific moving matters and set a time.
The research institute rushed to pack all kinds of research materials and experimental equipment, and the staff went home to pack some clothes and luggage.
Wait until they have made arrangements in the past, and then find a way to settle their families.
Here to participate, quickly arrange a place for the research institute.
The original staff club was expropriated again and became the temporary office of the research institute.
Waiting for the spring of the next year, the field will find a place to build a separate yard, not only a research institute, but also staff housing and so on.
Xu Shiyan spent several days of work, and finally finished the report, and asked the secretary to pass it to the province.
After receiving the report in the province, several leaders began to worry.
If you really follow Xu Shiyan's suggestions, you can't say anything else, and the current situation should be stable.
Participating farmers must suffer losses, but the market will not go straight to the end.
But the point is, this is too difficult, and it is not easy to implement any of them.
Can this really be done?
No matter whether it can be done or not, we have to try it, so we quickly called a meeting of people,
"Leader, isn't Mr. Xu's suggestion too difficult? It seems we can't do it?"
When the staff below heard this, they retreated immediately.
Isn't this embarrassing? Let them contact domestic pharmaceutical companies and negotiate with them to purchase ginseng?
It is necessary to set a protective price, so that farmers cannot suffer too much loss, and pharmaceutical companies should be willing to buy orders.
Isn't this a joke? Who can do it.
Many people said it was difficult, and the leader directly blackened his face.
"It has been almost a month since the incident happened, and you are asked to find a solution, but you can't think of it.
Now someone has made a suggestion, and you think it is too difficult. What do you want us to do? Eat plain rice? "
"Difficult? Isn't that nonsense?
It's about the whole province, no, it's about billions of dollars in agricultural output value in the three eastern provinces, and it's about the jobs of so many farmers, isn't it difficult?
Do you think this is a matter of 30,000 to 20,000? Thirty twenty thousand, I still have to call you all to a meeting? "
The leader directly slapped the table and got angry.
"We're all meeting here today to discuss the plan, and if we don't come up with a charter, don't leave.
All departments have to think about how to improve this plan.
The ginseng industry is the top priority of our province's agriculture, and it is even more related to export earnings.
This is a big deal, no matter how difficult it is, it has to be done. "
The people in the room stared wide-eyed, and no one dared to speak again.
What are you talking about? If you speak well, these things will fall on him, and if you speak badly, you will suffer the collapse of the leader.
This thing is not right, so stop talking.
The meeting room was in a strange state of silence, no one dared to make a sound, and even controlled their breathing to be as light as possible.
It is really like that sentence said, the needle can be heard when it falls on the ground.
After being silent for a long time, the leader couldn't take it anymore.
"No, what does it mean that none of you speak?
I told you to come to the meeting, not to meditate.
What are these people who are watching the nose and the nose and the heart doing? Want to become a monk?
Hurry up to discuss and come up with the charter. What are you thinking about? "
"Leader, there's really no rules for this matter, none of the top few rules can be completed.
Participated in farming for three years, just relying on selling goods to get money to live well.
The situation is not clear right now, and everyone is eager to sell it quickly.
Money is called money if you put it in your pocket. If the goods are stored there, who knows what will happen next year? What if it goes down next year? "
Someone shook his head and pointed to the last one.
"That's right, why are you talking about setting up a new type of cooperative to unite farmers.
Then we can’t skip meals even if we are united? The sticks cannot be sold, and the farmers have no food to eat. How can they unite? "
These people couldn't come up with an idea, and instead took Xu Shiyan's suggestions as an argument.
"There is also this contact with domestic pharmaceutical companies, except for the pharmaceutical factories in our province, and those in other provinces, can we talk to them? Who can listen to us?
But just the few companies in our province, how capable can they be?
Pharmaceutical factories do not use ginseng in all their medicines, and it is enough to store a thousand or eight hundred catties a year.
This is simply a drop in the bucket, and it won't do much. ’ Others started to chime in.
"Bank loans are not feasible, how can banks have money to lend to farmers?
Besides, with the current market situation, which bank dares to lend money to Cannon?
Don’t talk about using ginseng as a mortgage. If the price of this ginseng keeps dropping, the mortgaged goods may not be loaned much in the end.
No, no, this really won’t work, it can’t be done. "
Finance-related personnel, shaking their heads like rattles, can't do this, really can't do it.
"This is pure nonsense on paper, Mr. Xu, he is good at doing scientific research, selling goods and so on, and he has a lot of brains.
But in other respects, it is still not ready. How can this matter be so simple? too naive. "
Someone began to seduce Xu Shiyan.
"That's right, that's right, if according to what he said, Shenye Company also has a pharmaceutical factory.
Their pharmaceutical company should take the lead first, right? Let them stock up on a batch first. "
Sure enough, if someone leads, someone will climb along the pole.
The faces of the leaders sitting at the top were all black now, and someone was so angry that they slapped the table on the spot.
"The ginseng company mainly focuses on exports. Under the current situation, they can still keep 90% of foreign trade orders. What else do you want?
The Changbai Mountain Pharmaceutical Factory just opened this year, and only a part of the medicines produced have been put on the market, and most of them have not yet been approved. You let the pharmaceutical factory stockpile ginseng?
The ginseng they participated in had a backlog, so they had to stay in the pharmaceutical factory.
With such a big event, they didn't drag down the province at all, and they solved it all by themselves.
How did you get here? It seems that Mr. Xu is at fault? "
"Let you think of an idea, you can't think of it, this is the idea I asked someone to give me on the pole.
It's good to be here with you, but I despise the person who came up with the idea.
how? Do we still have to put all the responsibility on others? "
The angry one just waved his hand and left. This meeting can't go on at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 719: buy another house
chapters.content:
Chapter 719 Buy a house again
Xu Shiyan soon knew the content of the meeting in the province.
Xu Shiyan was not surprised at all by the reaction of those people.
It's normal. These people are not good at doing practical things, and they are best at shirking responsibility.
So Xu Shiyan didn't intend to wait for any response from his superiors at all, but took people with him to do what he should do.
Anyway, everything is normal at the venue, and all productions are proceeding in an orderly manner. He just needs to take care of himself.
The rest of the people, they can do whatever they want, they can’t control it.
It is estimated that the provincial government also knew about this matter, and Xu Shiyan could not be blamed for this matter, so they did not bother him.
Su Anying took people to Liumao River to pick up ginseng seeds.
These ginseng seeds are from the same batch that sowed seeds in 1985, and it has been four years now.
When the seeds were sowed at the beginning, the on-demand method was used. It was easy to produce large seeds. When the seeds were planted last year, there were many ginseng seeds that were as thick as a thumb.
This year, we started to plant seeds on the mountain, good guy, there are quite a lot of ginseng seeds, almost catching up with the sticks of ordinary people.
"Sister-in-law, we have enough capital to plant such a big plant."
Huang Shengli and others are also on the mountain, and now they are here to join in the fun, so they have to discuss this issue.
If the seeds are too large, the cost of going to the ground will be heavy.
At this time, the market is already bad, and if such a big seed is planted, everyone will have no idea.
"It's okay, your third brother said that such a big plant will be planted in the ground, and we will see the market in three years.
It’s really not good, we won’t be able to afford it at that time, and keep the doubles. " Su Anying laughed.
"Anyway, we earned these seeds, and so did the soil. We didn't spend much money in the first place, and we will earn as much as we sell."
When everyone heard it, it was the same reason.
The big guys make 20,000 to 30,000 feet of ginseng soil every year, save some for themselves, and sell the rest.
In addition to spending no money on what I use for my own use, there are still tens of thousands left.
This ginseng seed has been sold outside for two years, and these have been earned long ago.
Apart from spending a little money on ginseng and serving, there is no other cost.
No matter how much it sells for after three years, it will be earned, so why worry about it?
If such a big plant is planted in the ground, it will grow big in three years.
If it's really like what Su Anying said, the doubles are frozen, that is to say, after four years in the field, by then they will be half a catty taller and sink a catty sooner?
I don’t believe it, the market is still so stinky four years later?
As long as there is a little relief, they can earn a fortune with these sticks, which is a good deal.
"Or it has to be my third brother. His brain is really incomparable to others. Come on, let's go to work."
I'm all busy, so I don't have so much free time to chat, just say a few words for peace of mind, the important thing is to work quickly.
This year, each family still left 100 feet of ginseng soil, and this piece of ginseng seeds is 2,000 feet, which was agreed to be reserved for each family.
If it is an ordinary ginseng seed, about one foot can fall three or four feet.
But the seeds that have been planted on demand and rooted for four years are too big. It would be good if the seeds can be downed by one and a half or two feet.
Each family distributed two hundred and fifty or sixty feet of seeds, in addition to their own use, or distributed to relatives, or sold and disposed of casually.
On the Xu family's side, only Xu Shi'an planted fifty or sixty feet of clubs every year.
Ji Tongzhong and Nan Zhendong wanted to fall, but Xu Shiyan kept refusing.
So Su Anying left forty feet for Xu Shian, and all the rest got up and went home, and picked out the ones that were big, well-bearded, smooth, and free of rust and scars as seeds.
The rest are sent directly to the processing factory to make goods.
Don’t think about selling seeds this year, many people wish they had to.
Even if you want to continue planting, in order to save costs, you still buy small seeds. Who is willing to spend money on big seeds?
The ginseng seeds went home and picked out, and then hired workers went up the mountain to plant the mallets, and then scattered the ginseng seeds, and the work of making sheds was outsourced.
Basically, this year’s work in the field, that’s all.
According to what Xu Shiyan said, Su Anying planned to go to Yangcheng to buy and build a house as soon as the work at home was over.
Xu Shiyan said, you can bring some less goods to try the water to see the market.
Su Anying discussed with the daughters-in-law, and felt that it was too unsafe to receive the goods.
Why don't you choose the grade of your own goods, take away the small goods, and bring less fresh ginseng.
The rest of the big goods are left in the cold storage, waiting for the market to improve.
That's it, each family sends out the goods first.
On November 6th, the daughters-in-law of each family took a train to Shenyang with a lot of money, and then took a plane from Shenyang to Yangcheng.
When we get there, we must still live in Feng'an Hotel.
As soon as Su Anying got there, she first went to her house to have a look.
Since I bought a house at the Spring Fair, Su Anying took time to collect the house, and there was no time to come.
Fortunately, the house is nothing else, and no one can break it and take it away. There is nothing wrong with it except that it is full of dust.
Su Anying remembered what Xu Shiyan said, and asked her to buy the neighbors, even if she spent money to buy it, she had to buy it.
So, I found someone to inquire about hearing and reconciliation.
When they bought the house in spring, they actually spent a lot more money.
An old and old house was sold for 52,000 yuan. People around knew it and said that the owner of the house had been taken advantage of.
Many people are envious, saying why can't they encounter such a good thing?
So when Su Anying asked someone to inquire about the peace, the neighbors were really moved and wanted to order takeout.
Of course, this is tantamount to Su Anying taking the pole to talk to someone, and the price is definitely not low.
The one in the east is bigger, and the price is 65,000, and the one in the west is a little smaller, and the price is 58,000.
Su Anying spent a long time with the family, and the family negotiated 2,000 yuan, and finally reached a deal.
So she wrote a contract and went through the transfer procedures, and Su Anying thought of a way to approve the procedures for rebuilding the house.
This is not difficult. Some of Chu Xuanhuai's students are in Yangcheng. With their relationship, all procedures are easy to handle.
The owner received the money and immediately vacated the house and moved. Here, Su Anying asked someone from the School of Architecture to draw the design drawings.
Then the construction team was called, the old house was torn down, and a four-story building with a basement was built on the spot.
The south is good at this point, and the construction will not be delayed in winter.
Su Anying lived in the hotel, watching the building of the house while contacting the customers of the Hong Kong businessmen.
At the beginning, no one came to receive the goods. Until the beginning of December, several Hong Kong merchants came to see the goods one after another.
But the price offered by the other party has dropped by more than a third compared with last year.
That is to say, this year's price can't keep up with last year's price of receiving goods at home.
Su Anying felt that the price was a bit unacceptable, so she called back.
"Daughter-in-law, just sell if you want something, don't wait, the market at home is even worse now.
Occasionally, a few merchants came to grab the goods at the other end of the market, and the prices they gave were always low. It would be considered good if they were half of what they were last year.
The market on your side is considered good, so sell it when it is time to sell. If the goods are sold there quickly, let the family quickly grab the goods and send them to you there.
伱I don’t know what kind of virtues are in the family, but whenever someone shouts that they want to receive the goods, the threshold can be stepped down, and they are eager to sell the goods.
It looks like the Chinese New Year is coming soon, who doesn’t want to sell their goods for the Chinese New Year. "Xu Shiyan quickly persuaded on the other end of the phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 720: to ship
chapters.content:
Chapter 720 Shipping
The situation at home is actually more complicated than what Xu Shiyan said, and it is also more severe than the situation in the last life in 1989.
After all, there was no such accident in Xu Shiyan's Ginseng Festival in 1989 in his previous life.
The agricultural product fair that year had a turnover of more than 200 million yuan.
Moreover, at that time, the production of ginseng was not so high, and the backlog was not so serious.
It's just that the acquisition contract between the provincial medicinal material company and the health care product company and Fusong has expired, and the full purchase will no longer be made.
The county was unable to organize sales, resulting in a certain backlog.
The real lowest point in the previous life was in 1992. Although the previous few years were poor, they could still handle the past.
But many things have changed in this life, so the ginseng market fell off a cliff and fell to the lowest point directly.
Xu Shiyan's suggestions to the province, in the end the province still adopted some of them, and really persuaded some pharmaceutical companies in the three eastern provinces to come and grab the goods.
But it’s useless to have someone to grab the goods. Without financial support, the farmers’ backs are not strong, so how can there be a protection price to talk about?
Those units and individuals with a large backlog of ginseng rushed over as soon as they heard that someone was coming to receive the goods.
No matter how low the price is, they will still be sold out, and no one dares to keep the goods in their hands.
So, the market did not get better because of this, only those pharmaceutical companies took the opportunity to stock up some goods.
But just like what the cadres at the provincial meeting said, there are too few pharmaceutical companies that they can hire, and the receipt of the goods is only a drop in the bucket and cannot solve the big problem.
Even, if Shen Nong wants to sell goods, he has to rely on connections, otherwise he will not be able to sell them.
So when Xu Shiyan learned of Su Anying's market situation in Yangcheng, he immediately persuaded Su Anying.
Since all the goods have been brought over, sell them if they can be sold, or they will have to be sent back if they are kept, which is troublesome.
As soon as Su Anying heard this, she stopped being entangled, and agreed to the price of the other party, and sold most of the goods in her hand.
Those Hong Kong businessmen and Su Anying are old acquaintances. The two parties reached a deal so happily, and the other party is willing to help Su Anying.
They promised to help introduce a few clients after returning home.
Just like that, the goods in the hands of Su Anying and others were slowly sold out.
Although it is not as good as last year's price, it is much more cost-effective than selling at home.
Seeing the situation, Su Anying felt that the international market should be picking up, so she immediately called those former customers.
Not to mention, Su Anying really guessed right.
From the beginning of September to the end of November, for nearly three months, merchants from various countries have remained silent and refused to purchase ginseng.
Some people let it out, saying that all the ginseng they collected before were fed to the horses.
But at the beginning of December, some people couldn't hold on anymore.
Especially in Dongyi and South Korea, their domestic demand for ginseng is too high. If they don’t purchase stocks, the production raw materials will face a crisis of out of stock.
Followed by Hong Kong City and Wanwan, as well as Southeast Asian countries, they also need a lot of ginseng products.
So in mid-December, many merchants from South Korea and Dongyi began to move and release signals.
After all, they just want to lower the price, not really want to sell.
No one can easily give up such a big raw material market.
Su Anying just caught up with this opportunity, so she successfully reconnected with many merchants and agreed to receive the goods from them.
Of course, it is impossible to restore the price to last year's level. Basically, it has to be reduced by more than one-third.
But in any case, there is still a profit in the middle.
So, Su Anying immediately called back and asked Huang Shengli and others to start receiving the goods.
At this time in previous years, Donggang Sanshi basically went to the market every Friday.
But this year's market is not good, no one came to receive the goods, so the market was closed early, and there was no such thing as going to the market.
Now if you want to catch the goods, you can only use the big speakers in each village to shout, and then post a few advertisements.
Participants are all looking forward to someone coming to grab the goods, so as soon as they heard the news, outside the market department of the city, it was crowded with people, waiting in line to sell the goods.
How dare Huang Shengli and others be careless? All goods are seized according to the requirements of customers, and the inspection level is very strict, for fear that customers will return the goods.
At this time, what else does the participant care about? Don't care about the price, as long as you can sell it, don't hold it in your hands.
It’s better than anything else to be able to keep your capital, and to spend the New Year with peace of mind when you get the money.
Some foreign merchants have returned.
Donggang ginseng market looked at it, and simply reopened the market, allowing ginseng customers and merchants to enter and trade in the market.
In addition to the participating households in Donggang, people from other parts of the county, after hearing the news, also rushed over with their goods.
But this time, no matter whether it is Su Anying or other merchants, no one dares to stock up.
It’s all outside customers who decide how much, and how much will be caught here, and the goods will be shipped as soon as they are caught, without daring to delay for one more day.
I am afraid that the market is not right and the price will fall again.
"Sister-in-law three, I heard that you sell goods in Yangcheng, what's the situation now, is the market going well?"
On this day, Su Anying was in the hotel and received a call from Xu Shide.
"The market is mediocre, the price has dropped too much compared to previous years. Fourth, what are you doing?"
Su Anying felt strange, the fourth child didn't call Xu Shiyan for something, why did he call her?
"Well, I want to ask how you are doing in Yangcheng, and how fast the goods are leaving.
Well, there are quite a few ginseng households in our township who haven’t sold their clubs yet.
I just want to ask my sister-in-law, can you help me to receive a batch of goods from our township? "
Xu Shide couldn't explain it away, it's really hard to talk about it.
But when he thought of the task assigned by the leader, Xu Shide could only bite the bullet and finish speaking.
"Oh, that's all, okay, it doesn't matter where you get it from."
Su Anying is still easy to talk to.
Xu Shide can make a phone call to Yangcheng Feng'an Hotel, which means that he should have discussed with Xu Shiyan and obtained Xu Shiyan's permission.
They are all family members, what can they do? Help me.
Anyway, as long as the product is qualified, you can receive the goods from any town or town.
"Well, I'll call Shengli and the others later and ask them to separate the two of them and go to Xigang.
You send a few people to help, try to stay with you for a few days, and charge more. "Su Anying readily agreed.
"Thank you, sister-in-law, thank you, sister-in-law."
Xu Shide said several thank yous on the phone before hanging up.
Su Anying quickly called Huang Shengli and the others, and asked Huang Shengli to take someone to Xigang.
Huang Shengli and the others all pointed and fought, what Xu Shiyan and his wife said, and what they listened to.
So two people went to Xigang and lived in Xu Shide's house. Xu Shide brought a few people from the financial office to help, and collected the goods for a while.
Su Anying brought the daughters-in-law of various families, but they were busy in Yangcheng.
The goods are sold here, and Su Anying wants to watch the progress of building her house.
Ji Yufeng and the others wandered around to inquire about the goods while they were not selling goods.
They watched Xu Shiyan and his wife buy a house here, and they felt that they would definitely make some money, so they also planned to buy a house here and keep it.

chapters.title: Chapter 721: R & D direction
chapters.content:
Chapter 721 Research and Development Direction
Su Anying was busy selling goods and keeping an eye on the progress of house construction in Yangcheng. She was so busy from morning till night.
Xu Shiyan is also busy at home, he has to watch several factories for production and delivery.
It was hard to keep the order this year, but there must be no problems.
Product quality must be strictly controlled, and nothing goes wrong.
Several factories are working overtime and doing their best to deliver the goods. As soon as the production here is completed, they will be sent to the customer immediately, and they dare not delay half a minute.
In case something is delayed along the way, what about the customer filing a claim?
At this time, people want to find fault and are worried that they can't find an excuse, so they can take the initiative to give the blame?
Therefore, it is necessary to strictly control all links, make good advances, and resolutely not give the other party any excuses for trouble.
For this matter, executives at all levels of the company now have a small meeting every three days, and a meeting every five days.
If something goes wrong in any section, the responsibility will be investigated.
The whole company is tense up and down, really walking on eggshells, for fear that if something is not done well, it will affect the export.
In addition to daily production, Xu Shiyan has to focus on the research and development work of the technical department and increase research and development efforts.
Participating companies can survive this crisis mainly by relying on unique products with technological core.
This has made many people see the potential of technological research and development and industrial deep processing.
The ginseng research institute is now merged into the ginseng company, and people from the technical department work together to speed up research and development.
Not to mention, these people in the Ginseng Research Institute do have some real skills.
When I was in the county, many ideas could not be realized due to the lack of research funds.
Now in the participating company, the whole company pays high attention to the research and development of new products.
Xu Shiyan even directly approved a large sum of research and development funds, and introduced a variety of advanced instruments from abroad.
The people in the research institute finally realized what it meant to be rich and powerful.
Now, with the funding and equipment, everyone is working hard to develop new products with unique technologies.
Xu Shiyan also set a rough R&D direction for the R&D personnel.
One is a variety of health supplements, such as ginseng deer whip oyster cream, ginseng deer whip pills, ginseng cream, super concentrated ginseng essence drink, ginseng qi and blood drink, etc.
This is basically Chu Xuanhuai's help to come up with the recipe, and the R&D personnel do various experiments to improve the process.
Use modern extraction and concentration technology to improve the technical content of products and increase product competitiveness.
Another one is some snacks or tea drinks with the same origin of medicine and food.
Such as ginseng blueberry soft candy, ginseng crisp candy, ginseng cocoa candy, ginseng charcoal roasted coffee candy, canned fresh ginseng white fungus, canned instant ginseng chicken, ginseng Wujia tea, ginseng angelica tea, etc.
Xu Shiyan also invited several researchers from the Provincial Institute of Chemical Technology to lead a team to study daily chemical products.
