Such as ginseng essence cream, ginseng essence body lotion, ginseng essence body lotion, ginseng essence shampoo, hair conditioner, ginseng essence hand cream, ginseng essence body lotion, ginseng essence soap and a series of toiletries.
No matter what year, women's money is the best earned.
I didn’t plan on this before, mainly due to insufficient technological strength
Since the province has strongly supported it, don't be shy, just dig people if you need to, and research and develop if you need to.
Anyway, the above has only one attitude, as long as Xu Shiyan can earn back the money, in other respects, the land will be given to the land, and people will be given to it.
In addition, the pharmaceutical factory is also fully fired.
In addition to conventional Chinese patent medicines, Xu Shiyan personally led the team of the University of Pharmaceutical Sciences to focus on research and development of various new drugs.
Relevant departments also strongly supported and actively cooperated, simplified many approval procedures, and designated several hospitals to conduct clinical drug experiments.
Suxiao Ganmaoling Granules, Ningxin Pills, Baoxindan, Tongxinluo Capsules, Jiannaoling Syrup, Shenqi Royal Jelly Nourishing Blood Essence, Shenrong Tonifying Kidney Tablets and other products produced by the pharmaceutical factory directly enter the pharmacies of major hospitals.
In this regard, Xu Shiyan has a very obvious advantage over other pharmaceutical companies.
Old Chu’s students are now the deans and directors of hospitals in various places, or the deans and professors of major medical schools.
There is no need for Mr. Chu to talk about such a trivial matter. Xu Shiyan calls the other party, and the matter will be settled.
All kinds of prescriptions in the pharmaceutical factory are checked by Chu Xuanhuai. Most of the medicinal materials come from the local area, or are directly supplied from the place of origin, and the effect is naturally needless to say.
The major hospitals initially looked at Mr. Chu’s face, and after subsequent clinical verification, the efficacy of the medicine was indeed good, so many hospitals ordered additional orders.
The medicines that can enter the hospital pharmacy have been certified for their efficacy, so the major pharmacies outside will not refuse them.
Thus, although the pharmaceutical factory has only opened for less than a year, the development situation is still very good.
"Old Li, Lao Dai, the things I got from Dandong and Kuandian have all been shipped back, right?
Then let us know. This Saturday, we will hold a staff representative meeting and a year-end summary and commendation meeting.
It was supposed to open before the Gregorian calendar year, but it was too busy a few days ago.
It happened that this batch of goods was sent out, and the final payment was almost settled. Hurry up and hold a meeting to distribute the workers' bonuses and benefits. "
Having been busy for many days, he was finally able to breathe a sigh of relief. Xu Shiyan immediately arranged for this year's year-end summary and commendation conference.
The workers are all looking forward to it. Seeing that the Chinese New Year is not far away, it is better to hold a meeting quickly and distribute bonuses and benefits, so that everyone can have a good New Year with peace of mind.
"Well, they have all been shipped back, and they are now stored in the warehouse of the processing factory.
I watched them all, the fish and shrimp were better than last year, and the pork was pretty good too.
The fruits were all packed in large flower baskets, with padding such as straw and straw, and they were not frozen at all, and they were all good.
This time, the custodians are all happy. " Li Bingzhuo said with a smile.
He is an old man participating in the field, and he has also come all the way from an ordinary worker.
The apprentices he led back then are now the section chiefs of each section.
That's why he called those people bastards. This is not a curse word, but a kind and unobtrusive expression.
"Okay, that's good, so many things this year, our company has not been affected too much, and we have survived.
Working overtime these days, the workers are working hard in three shifts, so they must be rewarded well so as not to chill the workers. "
Xu Shiyan has always been generous to others, and he never picks up on these aspects.
The rules and regulations that should exist in the company must be abided by. Those who make meritorious deeds will be rewarded, and those who have done wrong will be punished. Everything should be done according to the rules and regulations.
Someone really made a mistake, and no one's sympathy is easy to handle.
But at the same time, the necessary humanistic care is also necessary, and the New Year's benefits are never deducted.
That's why the workers participating in the field have cohesion, and Xu Shiyan shouted, and everyone can stare and rush upwards.
From the beginning of autumn to the present, workers have been working overtime for several months, and no one complains of suffering or tiredness.
The whole company is twisted into one rope, fighting together, and must complete the order without any mistakes.
Of course, Xu Shiyan didn't regard himself as a leader, and he has lived in the unit for a long time.
Follow the workers to work overtime, eat in the cafeteria and live in the dormitory together.
To put it bluntly, when you are tired from work, you will take a bath with the workers after get off work.
The workers like this kind of leader, of course, no matter what Xu Shiyan says, the workers will obey.

chapters.title: Chapter 722: Year-end bonus benefits
chapters.content:
Chapter 722 Year-end bonus benefits
January 6 happened to be Saturday, and the employee representative meeting and the year-end summary and commendation meeting of participating companies were held in the large conference room on the top floor of the field department.
The directors and directors of each factory in the entire company, the section chiefs of the workshops, and the team leaders all came to the site for a meeting.
As for the workers, they stay in the workshop to work.
As the general manager of the company, Xu Shiyan had to say a few words on the spot.
"The situation this year is known to everyone.
In such a difficult situation, through everyone's efforts, we have kept 95% of the orders
As of now, of the 95% of the orders, only a small part has not been completed and cannot be shipped.
Most of them have been sent out, and the final payment has been paid back. "
"Under such circumstances, this year, our company's total output value has reached more than 70 million yuan, which still exceeds last year's total output value.
It is inseparable from everyone's efforts to achieve such brilliant results.
Therefore, I must thank you all. Without your hard work, we would not be able to create such a high output value. "
On the Spring Fair alone, the company earned 20 million US dollars in foreign exchange, and the accumulated orders from regular customers over the years also amounted to more than 10 million US dollars.
In addition, pharmaceutical factories, comprehensive utilization of ginseng land, and dividends from compound fertilizer factories and mineral water factories, etc.
Based on the overall calculation this year, the output value is higher than last year.
"In order to express our gratitude to the employees of the various factories, this year, in addition to the regular dividends, each employee will receive a year-end bonus of 100 yuan, five catties of pork or mackerel, and ten catties of fruit.
Well, later, the section chiefs of each section will go to our logistics office to collect tickets. Everyone has one, and the workers will go to the warehouse to collect things with the tickets.
Well, it’s been a year of hard work. This year, we’ll do everything right and live a prosperous year. "
Last year, the farm brought back pork and sea fish, all of which were sold to workers.
This year, Xu Shiyan waved his hand, so he might as well stop selling it and give out benefits.
Each person has five catties of meat or five catties of Spanish mackerel, and another ten catties of fruit. As for the type, you can choose whatever you want.
If there are two or three people in the family who both go to work, you can ask for it in a different form, and it’s almost enough to keep it for the New Year.
Of course, if someone thinks it’s not enough to eat, there are still some in the market, and you can buy them again. If it’s not enough, you can go to Liao Province to buy more.
Anyway, the preparations were early this year, so there is still time to go again.
Chinese people still pay great attention to celebrating the New Year. Who doesn’t want to celebrate the New Year with all the chicken, duck and fish at home?
When I heard that there are not only cash rewards this year, but also physical rewards, these people are very happy.
In an instant, there was a tidal wave of applause in the conference room.
Next, Xu Shiyan announced the results of this year's selection.
What advanced section, advanced team, advanced individual, etc., each selected will have a corresponding bonus.
The highest one is nearly 1,000 yuan, and the lowest one is 200 yuan.
All the winners came to the stage, and Xu Shiyan handed out certificates and red envelopes one by one.
There is no money directly in the red envelope, but with the note in the red envelope, go to the property to get the money.
All the award-winning people stood together, and someone in the audience held a camera and clicked to take pictures.
Waiting to receive the award, Xu Shiyan talked about the company's development plan for next year.
Under the current situation, I dare not say anything too crazy.
Xu Shiyan's only goal is to try to keep the current order and production value from falling, and it's good. He doesn't dare to think about it.
No matter what, the conference was quite complete and successful, and all the participants were happy.
After the meeting is over, the company's financial staff distributes the workers' contract dividends, year-end bonuses, and welfare receipts together.
After get off work, the workers went to the processing factory to line up to get their things.
At the processing factory, pork, Spanish mackerel, apples, pears, this time you can get whatever you want.
All are divided in advance according to the requirements, five catties a share.
Workers receive one portion of fish or meat and two portions of fruit with the receipt.
Someone just bought five catties of apples and five catties of pears, which happened to be all there.
Some people also said that the distribution is not enough, the person in charge over there said, wait until the benefits are all distributed, and then release it to take out.
There are also many things here, such as prawns, saury, squid, etc., choose whatever you want.
The big guy laughed when he heard it, "The co-author Mr. Xu gave us this year-end bonus of 100 yuan, just for us to buy things.
Come on, this year’s Chinese New Year, I’ll buy more for everything, my wife and children will be rewarded. "
The people next to him also burst out laughing when they heard this.
"This is Mr. Xu, you can try another person?
As far as this year’s situation is concerned, if it’s someone else, it would be great if we can pay the wages, and you still want to have a year-end bonus?
Big guy, turn around and eat the fish and meat in the bowl, but don’t forget, who are we getting rich with. "Someone answered.
After thinking about it, big guy, it really makes sense.
"That's not true, my wife has relatives in the second camp, I heard that it's a bit miserable there this year.
Many people are busy all year round and almost lose money. "
At that time, except for one participant, the other county-owned participants all implemented the household contract responsibility system, and implemented the form of three guarantees and one package, and self-financing.
In general, the price of ginseng is good, and the workers in the field can earn money.
The market is so bad this year, and those participants haven’t sold all their clubs yet. The venue has no money, so what are they going to do to distribute it to the workers?
Besides, even if it is sold, the price is so much lower than in previous years, and the cost will still be deducted according to previous years.
Workers have been busy for three years, and they are thankful if they don’t lose money in the end, and they still think about the year-end bonus? dream.
"Look, it's thanks to the fact that we didn't follow the field and completely contracted it, right? If that's the case, it will be a disaster."
Many people shook their heads, not knowing whether to sigh or gloat.
"Come on, take our things and go home to make your wife and children happy."
Someone took his share of things and hurried home.
Not only the participating companies give benefits, but also the compound fertilizer factory, Songjianghe and Quanyang mineral water factories also give benefits.
This year, the fertilizer factory is doing well, especially the Qingfeng foliar fertilizer, which has earned its name.
Not only people from this province come to order, but even farmers from other provinces come to order.
This foliar fertilizer can be widely used on many economic crops, and it has the effect of disease resistance and yield increase.
Although the ginseng market this year is not good, the sales of the fertilizer factory have not been affected at all. On the contrary, there are too many orders to take over.
Except for a few cadres in the fertilizer factory, most of them are temporary workers.
But after discussing with Xu Shiyan, Yang Junxian decided to pay benefits to both regular workers and temporary workers, as long as they have worked in the factory for more than half a year.
Now, those workers are very happy, especially those who Qilu broke into the Northeast.
When I first came here, I thought it would be nice to have a place to make a living.
Looking at it now, not only is there a job, but also food and housing, and benefits are given during the Chinese New Year.
Oh my god, where can I find such a good place?
If you write a letter and go home, those people in the family must not be envious?

chapters.title: Chapter 723: I made less money this year
chapters.content:
Chapter 723 Earning less money this year
It's not just those people's fellow villagers who envy them? Even the farmers in Donggang, many people envy the temporary workers in the fertilizer factory.
In the past, when the fertilizer factory was recruiting workers, everyone thought they were temporary workers, not regular workers, and thought it would be better to plant sticks to earn money.
Anyway, there are not many people in Donggang who are willing to go.
See now? It’s better for workers to keep their income in drought and flood.
Regardless of whether it is windy or raining outside, as long as you go to work, you will be paid.
There is no need to pay capital, no need to worry about losing money, just go to work honestly and get paid.
Look, now even temporary workers are paid benefits, and there are meat, fish, and fruits.
If it were normal years, these entrants would have made money, and no one would pay attention to the five catties of meat.
But not this year, the mallets don’t make any money, so it took a lot of effort to sell them, that is, to save money.
Next year, we will have to plant sticks, and there will be expenses for the whole family. Who would be willing to spend money indiscriminately?
Many people were tempted to ask someone to ask if they could work in a fertilizer factory?
Temporary workers are also fine, don’t worry about the amount, earning is better than not earning at all.
Now, Yang Junxian's family is very lively, and many people are asking favors to make connections.
This time, Feng Shui took turns, and it was not the time for Yang Junxian to ask someone to help recruit workers.
Yang Junxian told people directly that we are temporary workers, but not everyone wants them.
Those who want to work part-time Maodong, please don’t come, now you have to work for at least half a year.
Just this one, many people were screened out.
Those who planned to spend time in the spring, summer and autumn, and find a place to earn money in winter, directly retreated.
But those who saw that the planting sticks were not making money, and simply planned not to plant them next year, gritted their teeth and made up their minds to enter the factory.
Yang Junxian naturally welcomes these people.
Nowadays, the factory has too many orders and the workers are too busy. He wished more people would come.
The fertilizer factory, the two beverage factories in Songjianghe and Quanyang are the same, no matter temporary workers or regular workers, they all have welfare benefits.
Especially on the other side of Quanyang, when Chen Jihui was here, not to mention benefits, even wages were not paid out, who would dare to think about benefits?
Looking at it now, all workers, whether temporary or formal, are treated equally with year-end benefits.
The things are the same as here in Donggang, each person has five catties of fish or meat, and another ten catties of fruit.
But these workers were dumbfounded, and all of them were so happy that they couldn't close their mouths.
At the beginning, I thought that the beverage factory was a temporary worker, and I looked down upon those who refused to come, but this time I regretted it.
It's a pity that it's too late to regret it. The beverage factory is not expanding or recruiting workers, so I can't get in even if I want to.
Compared to these factories directly distributing benefits, the Forestry Bureau is a little less prepared.
It was the same as last year, except that a large amount of fish, meat, shrimp, and fruits were brought in, and the employees bought what they wanted.
For the past two years, the Forestry Bureau has been a little less flexible.
No way, just this year, with all kinds of triangular debts outside, the bureau's capital turnover is not enough.
No matter what, the workers are quite happy. After all, there was no place to buy what they wanted to buy in previous years.
Originally, Xu Shiyan discussed with Ji Tongzhong and the others, saying that they would set up a store to sell things.
As a result, Su Anying asked for goods, and Huang Shengli and others were too busy.
All these relatives from each family have gone to help with the work, who has time to take care of sea fish and prawns?
Even if the hammer is smashed down, the price is still more expensive than sea fish and prawns. These people are not stupid. How could they give up watermelon to pick up sesame seeds?
This year’s New Year’s Eve is on January 26th, and it’s not far away.
At this point, Su Anying should be thinking about going back.
But there are always merchants asking for goods over there. Although the quantity is not particularly large, it can't support the large number of customers, and the accumulation is also quite a lot.
Su Anying was a little reluctant to part with the business here, so she discussed with Xu Shiyan that she would come back later and sell goods there for a few more days.
At this time, earn as much as you can, no one knows what the market will be like after the new year.
What if no one receives the goods after one year and the market drops again?
Furthermore, the houses here are almost built, and the roof is short.
Su Anying meant that she would go back a while later and watch the main body of the building get up, and talk about the rest of the year.
Xu Shiyan thought about it, too, now it's really hard to say what's going on.
"Oh, it's a pity that the house over there hasn't been built yet.
If this is built, I will take my family with me. It would be great for our family to go to Yangcheng to celebrate the New Year. The children can also experience what winter is like in the south. "
Xu Shiyan was on the phone, speaking with regret.
"Who knows, anyway, I'm not used to it, so I feel that there is no snow in winter, and I feel uncomfortable all over.
Besides, even though there is no snow here, it is actually quite cold. The children may not be able to get used to it. "
Su Anying complained on the other end of the phone. As a native of the Northeast, even though she has spent the winter here for two consecutive years, she is still not quite used to it.
The couple didn't say a few words on the phone.
Su Anying's side, after all, is using a public phone outside.
Although she didn't care about the long-distance call charges, there were a lot of people waiting behind her, and it was hard for her to hold on to the phone all the time, so she hung up the phone after chatting casually.
Su Anying stayed in Yangcheng until the day before the eve of the year. Then she packed her things, flew back to Shenyang, and then took a car back to Songjianghe from Shenyang.
By the time they got home, it was already the twenty-fourth afternoon of the twelfth lunar month.
When Su Anying and the others came back, the first thing they did was naturally settle accounts.
The money earned this year is not as much as last year.
One is that the goods are not picked up for processing in autumn, and the other is that the price of ginseng is not high.
Also, I didn’t sell ginseng seeds this year, and I lost another income.
"We were in Yangcheng this winter, not counting the goods from each family, but the collection alone was about 150,000 catties, and we earned less than four million.
This is gross profit. After deducting various expenses, taxes, wages of Xiao Ji, Sheng Kai and others, the final remaining 2.8 million.
Well, if this was the market last year, how could we earn a small ten million by handling 150,000 catties of clubs? "
Su Anying did the calculations, and couldn't help but sigh, this year she doesn't earn much, and spends a lot.
Yangcheng even bought a house and built a house, and now it has invested hundreds of thousands.
When I go back after the year, I have to clean up and decorate inside and out, and it will cost a lot of money. If the business doesn't make money, what can I do?
"Daughter-in-law, just be content with yourself. In this year, you can still earn a million or so. What do you want?"
Xu Shiyan almost didn't laugh when he heard his wife's words.
This is really true. I am used to seeing a lot of money, and I feel uncomfortable when I earn less, right?
Yes, compared with the small tens of millions earned last year, this year's money is really not much.
But if compared with ordinary people, they can still earn so much money at this time, that would be amazing.
"No matter what you say, with the money you earn this year, our store over there will definitely be able to open.
If this is done, I will be able to give you back next year, believe it or not?
Besides, we still have a breeding farm here, and the breeding farm has not been affected this year, and the benefits are good.
By the way, there is also a fertilizer factory, which is also doing well this year. "
This is the best proof that all eggs cannot be put in one basket.
If his family has no other business, all pointing to ginseng, it will be cold this year.

chapters.title: Chapter 724: Butcher a pig to welcome my uncle
chapters.content:
Chapter 724 Killing a pig to welcome my uncle
After calculating the accounts and sharing the dividends, no matter the shareholders of the company, or Ji Tongzhong and others, they all shared the corresponding money.
No matter what you say, this year's market, if you can still make money, it's pretty good, everyone is quite content.
If it had been put aside in previous years, it would have been lively and lively even if it was so popular, so it was simply canceled this year.
One is approaching the year, and there is no time.
Su Anying waited for these women to come back on the 24th of the twelfth lunar month. At this time, why can't they clean up the house?
Can you still celebrate the Chinese New Year just like this?
One more thing, this year's market is bad, so many people are not making any money, and everyone's eyes are green.
As a result, Su Anying and the others were still chattering about holding an annual meeting to celebrate, so it was not good to spread the word.
People can't say, this is the money earned with their sticks?
This matter, if a reasonable person definitely says it, I should thank Su Anying and the others.
Without their outlets to sell goods, the big guys have to hold all the hammers in their hands.
People should earn money, after all, they have been busy for several months.
There are so many people in Yangcheng and Zhang Luo here, why can’t people earn some money by eating and feeding horses?
But in this world, how many people can be considerate and reasonable? Most of them are unreasonable people with pink eyes.
These people don't think that Su Anying and the others deserve to work so long to make money.
Instead, they will say, you are all so rich and rich, and we are all so miserable, why can’t you help us?
Why do we have to earn so much money from it? Why can't you earn less?
The receiving price is higher, what can I do if I pay a few more yuan per catty? I can't be poor either.
There are definitely people who think this way, probably not in the minority.
So Su Anying and the others are in the same opinion, this year, it's time to calm down, and it's over if the bird quietly earns the money, so don't be dumbfounded by those things.
Besides, the restaurants and hotels in the city are not profitable this year, that is, they are barely maintaining.
So except for the baths, everything else was closed early.
The big guys are not bad for that meal. It would be nice to find a chance to get together to eat and drink after the year.
Just like that, the big guys quietly distributed the money, and no one said a word, and each took the money and went home to prepare for the New Year.
No matter how much money you earn, it’s the Chinese New Year, so you have to be happy and lively.
And this year, the Xu family and the Han family have one more thing that makes them happy.
It was Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin, who were going to bring their children back.
Last year, within a few days of Xu Chenghou's birthday, Han Liwei took Xu Shiqin's mother and son away.
It's been a year and a half since I left, and my family is panicking.
Not only Han Wenzhong and his wife think about it, Xu Chenghou is also thinking about it in various ways.
These old men and women call there every now and then, talking about how tall the two children are, whether they are fat or not, and whether they like to eat or not.
There is no such thing as a video call these days. Just relying on Xu Shiqin talking on the phone, I can't think of anything.
No way, Xu Shiqin can only take the children to take pictures from time to time, and send them back, so that grandparents and grandparents can see the photos of the children.
It’s okay not to send photos, but after sending photos, the old man saw how cute the child was, and even talked about it all day long.
It happened that Han Liwei had a vacation this year, so he said that he would accompany Xu Shiqin, mother and son, and come home to live together for a few days, so that the family members would not worry about it.
On the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth lunar month, a family of four arrived home. Han Limin and Han Lixin went to the station to pick them up.
On the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth lunar month, Han Liwei and his wife returned to Xu's house with their two children.
In order to welcome uncle, daughter and grandson, the old Xu family has prepared the highest etiquette, killing pigs.
The Xu family did not raise pigs this year. Originally, Xu Shiyan said that there is plenty of pork on the farm, so he just spent money to buy some back.
But Xu Chenghou didn't like it, he thought it was boring, and the new year was deserted.
So I spent money to buy a big fat pig from other places and brought it back. After feeding it at home for a few days, I waited for Han Liwei and his wife to come back.
In order to welcome Han Liwei and his wife, Xu Shixian, Xu Shixiang, and Xu Shide all asked for leave and returned with their wives and children.
There are more than twenty people in this big family.
The man slaughtered the pig outside, removed the fur and disemboweled him, and the woman cut sauerkraut, meat, blood sausage, and bread dumplings inside.
Xu Jinfeng, Xu Jinxiu, and Xu Jinping are all grown up, helping in the kitchen.
Xu Jinhui, Xu Jingyi, and Xu Jingwen led their younger cousins ​​to play in the house.
Han Zhenlin and Han Yu were born in May of 1987. They were two and a half years old, three years old at the real age, and four years old after the new year.
The appearance of the two children follows the advantages of their parents, and they are both good-looking. They are about five or six points alike in appearance.
Children of this age are the most interesting. They follow behind their elder brothers and sisters with their short legs, and they can't leave them behind.
"Sixth sister, alas, you don't need to work, you just stay in the house, accompany our parents, and Uncle Zhao and the others to chat."
Xu Shiqin went into the kitchen to help, but was kicked out by his sisters-in-law.
"Look, the kitchen is just such a big place. Several of us are busy here, and we can hardly turn around. How can there be room for you?
You have come back with your children all the way, you are tired enough on the way, go to the house and rest. "
Su Anying smiled and drove the sister-in-law away, why can't Xu Shiqin be allowed to work today.
Xu Shiqin had no choice but to go back to the east room to chat with his parents and several elders.
The big guys have to ask about the situation of the couple over there.
"Liwei is still the same, in charge of two thousand people.
This summer, their regiment won the first place in the big martial arts competition. The superior was very happy and gave a commendation. "
When mentioning her husband, Xu Shiqin was naturally full of pride.
"I'm okay, I set up a clothing factory over there.
Many of the daughters-in-law accompanying the army in the compound are from the countryside and have no jobs, so they just come to work in the garment factory.
I have my own sales department in the capital and Shanghai stock market, even wholesale and retail, and the clothes sell very well.
Years later, I plan to visit Yangcheng, where I want to set up another factory.
It is a coastal city after all, so the transportation is convenient and the materials are much cheaper. "
Xu Shiqin followed Han Liwei to Guangshui. The family hired a nanny, and there was a nursery in the compound. She could spare time to develop her own business.
Xu Shiqin originally had a store in the capital, and later bought a store in Shanghai, which was specially used as the wholesale department of a garment factory.
The clothes she designed are very fashionable, no worse than those in Yangcheng Gangcheng, so the sales are particularly good.
In the beginning, the workers in the factory were young daughters-in-law who went with the army. Now, many older girls and daughters-in-law are also hired from surrounding villages, and the scale of the factory is getting bigger and bigger.
Xu Shiqin heard that the third brother and the third sister-in-law bought a house in Yangcheng and planned to open a shop, so she also had an idea.
I plan to go south to Yangcheng, buy a retail store, and better buy another piece of land to build a factory or something.
Anyway, there is no rush for this matter, just think about it slowly after the next year.
"Hey, listen quickly, our Shiqin is so capable now, it's great to open a factory and buy a store."
Han Cai'e and others were very happy when they heard it, and praised it in various ways.

chapters.title: Chapter 725: to repair the power station
chapters.content:
Chapter 725 Need to repair the power station
Those who can come today have a good relationship. Many people grew up watching Xu Shiqin.
When Xu Shiqin was like that, everyone didn't say anything, but they were all worried about the Xu family.
I don't know what this girl will do in the future, whether she will marry or not.
But looking at it now, she has cured her illness, not only married, but also married well.
A pair of sons and daughters are so rare, healthy, handsome, and so cute.
Let's see how well they are developing now? Design clothes, set up factories, and open stores by yourself, and you have to go to Yangcheng to open a store.
Whoops, this is really amazing.
"Brother, you are still blessed, six children, all of them are very promising."
Zhao Dahai and Xu Chenghou are old friends. From the big house to Donggang, the two families have always gotten along very well.
Zhao Jianshe, the second son of the Zhao family, has made a lot of money with Xu Shiyan these years, and now he brings the eldest Zhao Jianguo and several cousins ​​with him.
The friendship between the two generations, the Zhao family has absolutely nothing to say to the Xu family.
Whenever there is anything, the Xu family only needs to say something, and the Zhao family can't wait for all the Zhao family to come to help.
"You are not bad, Jianjian and Jianguo are doing well now, and your son and grandson are all in front of you, so you are beautiful.
伱Why are you still envious of me? " Xu Chenghou laughed.
"We are doing well now, when we were in the big house, who would have thought that we would still have today?
So, thank you for moving out, otherwise you said there is still something left over there? "
"Well, what my elder brother said is that the other side of the big house is getting less and less developed in the future.
I heard that the Songjiang River is going to build a cascade power station, upstream from the big house, at the Southwest Fork, and another dam is needed.
Drain the water to the Songjiang River, and then build a power station or something on the hill. "
Although Zhao Dahai has been away from the big house for many years, he still has relatives over there, who often pay attention to the situation at the other end of the big house.
"What's the matter? Do you want to get rid of the dam? Then if the dam is removed, will there still be water in the Xijiang River?" Xu Chenghou was stunned when he heard this.
The big house is based on the river. If there is no water in the river, what will be left in the future? Isn't that the end of the calf?
"Isn't that what you said?
Cough, we don't understand the policies of the higher authorities, since the superiors have decided, it must be useful, and we don't care about those. "
Zhao Dahai shook his head. Although the place where the big house is located is not very good, but after all how many years he has lived there, he still has feelings.
Especially that river, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming, Li Erniu, who didn't swim in the river when they were young?
In the summer before, the stinky boys wanted to soak in the water all day long.
That river is rich, and there are many fish and crickets in the river.
Capable people like Xu Shiyan can catch hundreds of catties of fish in one night when they catch up with good times.
For those who don’t have that ability, get a few cans and bottles to make fish docks, and you can catch a lot of small miscellaneous fish in a day.
When I come home, I either stew it with miso, or squeeze out the fish intestines and add some salt, and dry it into small dried fish. Then I fry it with some oil. It is also good to bring rice with you in the mountains.
Not to mention crickets, women can grab a bucket of water in the time it takes to wash clothes.
There are a lot of big crickets in the river, and it doesn’t take too much trouble to catch them. Put some salt in the clear water and boil them. The children eat them deliciously.
Donggang earns a lot of money and life is easy, but sometimes I think about it, it seems that I still have fun in the big house.
"Yeah, we don't understand and don't care about the matters above.
Forget it, anyway, we have already moved out, and it is impossible to go back in the future, so don’t worry about it. "
In his life, Xu Chenghou moved from Kuandian to Daying, then from Daying to Big House, and finally from Big House to Donggang.
Except for his missing hometown Kuandian, the rest of the place is the same, so he doesn't have as many emotions as Zhao Dahai.
Brothers Xu Shiyan finished cleaning up the pork outside and cleaned up the blood on the ground, just in time to enter the house and hear about the dam.
“The cascade hydropower station is a key project of hydropower construction, and the higher authorities attach great importance to it.
Currently still in the planning stage, a Songshan Dam will be built about four kilometers southwest of the Southwest Fork.
Bring the water from the main stream of Manjiang River to Songjiang River, so that the water resources can be intensively developed in Songjiang River.
And build three hydropower stations in Xiaoshan, Shuanggou and Shilong in turn.
It is said that after completion, it can provide 870 million kWh of electricity and 510 megawatts of electricity to the Northeast power system every year. "
Xu Shixiang is now the deputy director of the Finance Bureau. These construction projects must be financed, so he knows more than others.
“I heard from planning and design experts that if this building is built, there will be many benefits.
It can save coal consumption and system costs for thermal power generation, and can also increase the power generation of the Beijiang Hydropower Station in the county.
It can also prevent floods, develop fish farming in reservoirs, and improve the microclimate around reservoirs. "
Xu Shixiang didn't understand this either, so he just read what was written in the document.
"It's pretty beautiful, and when it's built, it's pretty good if it can meet half of what it said." Xu Shiyan muttered over there.
He didn't quite understand what the experts said, but he vaguely remembered that the hydropower station didn't seem to be completed in the end.
After the construction of the upstream dam and the Xiaoshan Power Station were completed, it seemed that the two behind them were not finishing their work, and then they just left them there and no one cared about them.
But the ecological environment of the Xijiang River was completely destroyed because of that dam.
Originally, the water in the Xijiang River was very large and deep. When the dam was built, the river stopped flowing immediately. There was still some water in some places, and there was no water in some places.
In his previous life, Xu Shiyan’s uncle planted a club in the sheep hole above the big house. Xu Shiyan went back to see it when he was helping his uncle with work.
The road that the car traveled was directly at the bottom of the river.
At that time, he was still talking to his daughter, saying that the mountains and stone lazies on both sides used to be river banks.
"Third brother, what are you talking about? Can the experts say this thing be wrong?"
Xu Shixiang has sharp ears, so he heard Xu Shiyan mumbling something, so he asked.
"It's nothing, I just think that sometimes it's a good thing to see in front of you, but it may not be the case in the future." Xu Shiyan waved his hand, ambiguous about the past.
This matter is not within his professional scope at all. He doesn't understand anything, but he dare not speak nonsense, let alone point fingers.
Xu Shiyan only knew one thing. He had to inquire about the construction time and go to the bottom of the cliff before the dam was completed.
There are still a lot of wild ginseng in that place. If the dam is built, it will have an impact on the environment there, and those wild ginseng may not survive.
The place where the ginseng grows is too special, on a platform in Shilazi.
Although the soil layer on the platform is not thin, and there are vegetation such as small trees and shrubs, the environment is still too simple, especially the water source cannot be supplied.
Now the river has sufficient water flow, the air is humid, and the wind from the river rises with moist water vapor, which can supply the plants on the platform with the water they need.
But if the dam is built, there will be no water downstream of the dam, and the plants on the platform may hardly survive.
It’s okay to say other things, such a delicate thing as wild ginseng, probably enough.

chapters.title: Chapter 726: ice wine
chapters.content:
Chapter 726 Ice wine
Xu Shixian and others don't care much about power stations and the like.
Besides, it's rare for Han Liwei to come back, so he must chat with his brother-in-law.
So the brothers surrounded Han Liwei, chatting nonsense.
The big guys in the inner room chatted very lively, and in the kitchen of the outer room, Xue Xiulin's sisters-in-law chatted quite well with Su Anying.
Those three companies have suffered a lot in the past two years. Under the current situation, I don’t know what will happen when they get the hammer.
If the market is not good, then I have to ask Su Anying to help sell it.
Will the sisters-in-law talk to Su Anying properly?
The kitchen was in full swing, with meat in the pot and all kinds of goods.
In another pot, sauerkraut with big bones is stewed, and skin jelly is boiled in the stew pot on the stove. When the skin jelly is cooked, pour it into a basin and take it outside to cool.
It’s a very cold day, and the temperature in the shed outside is just right. After two hours outside, it basically takes shape.
Several old ladies in the house even made dumplings by hand. When the meat in the pot was ready to be cleaned up, the dumplings in the house happened to be finished.
Take out an empty pot, brush it clean and boil water to cook the dumplings.
It doesn’t matter how exquisite the pig-killing dish is, what you want is a good price, a large amount, and delicious food.
烀Cooked pork belly, pork head meat, pork liver, pork heart, pork tongue, skin jelly, etc., all sliced ​​and served on a plate.
The pork belly was sliced ​​very thin, and the chopsticks trembled when picked up.
Dip some garlic sauce and put it directly into your mouth. The meat is crispy and soft, not greasy at all, and it tastes really delicious.
Big-bone sauerkraut blood sausage, the blood sausage is filled with diced meat, old soup, and seasonings.
The greenhouse at the other end of the farm has not been removed. Xu Shian has asked people to grow all kinds of side vegetables every winter. This year, he not only planted small green vegetables, but also some cucumbers, tomatoes and so on.
In order to pollinate the flowering vegetables, Xu Shi'an specially got a few boxes of bees and put them in the greenhouse.
Not to mention, it's really useful, this year's cucumbers are very good.
Xu Shian specially picked a lot of cucumbers and tomatoes for everyone to try.
Sliced ​​pig ears, mixed with cucumber strips, chopped coriander, and minced garlic, it is definitely the best side dish to go with wine.
Another plate of tomatoes mixed with sugar, sitting on the hot kang in winter, eating sour and sweet cold dishes, getting old.
"Second brother, okay, you are getting better and better.
Xinglong Township grows vegetables in greenhouses, and most of them are green leafy vegetables. I really don’t see cucumbers and persimmons. "
Xu Shixiang came from Xinglong Township, and he used the techniques he learned to grow vegetables in a greenhouse there.
Although he has gone to work in the county, he has been in contact with Xinglong Township.
In winter, the greenhouse growers will also send some green vegetables to Xu Shixiang's house. Anyway, he has never seen cucumbers or persimmons.
"Hey, I'm just blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah.
Anyway, the third child is not short of that little money, so why not grow some green vegetables and keep them at home, and when the Chinese New Year comes, there are all kinds of vegetables, so you can eat something fresh. "
Xu Shian laughed when he heard the words. This thing doesn't have much technical content. As long as you have the heart, you can grow anything.
While talking and laughing, the dumplings were cooked and served. The table was full of vegetables and dumplings, which was very rich.
Over there, Xu Shiyan brought out a few bottles of good wine and poured them for Han Liwei, his brothers, Huang Shengli and others.
As for Xu Chenghou, Chu Xuanhuai, Zhao Dahai, Su Weizhong and other old men, each poured some ice wine.
"Father, Master, this is a new product from Quanyang Factory. It used to be ice grape juice, but this time it is ice wine.
Try all of them. It tastes good, and the alcohol content is not high. It is not a big problem for you to drink a few cups. "
The Quanyang factory produces various wild fruit juices, and ice grape juice is also produced there.
In autumn, Xu Shiyan mentioned in passing, why not try ice wine.
Anyway, the factory is so big, and the production lines are all ready-made. Give it a try. If it works, there will be a new product next year.
Iced grape juice is basically frozen mountain grape juice, which can be adjusted to taste and filled.
Ice wine needs to go through a series of brewing processes.
A few days ago, when a batch came out, Guo Fenghua asked someone to send several boxes to Xu Shiyan, and gave them to everyone to taste how they taste and see if there is anything that needs to be adjusted.
"Mom, mother, sister-in-law, sister-in-law, you all taste a little, and then give your opinion or something.
If everyone thinks it is good, next year the factory will brew more. "
Xu Shiyan carried a few bottles and sent them to Westinghouse, so that the women could also taste them.
"Children, don't be greedy. After all, there is wine in there. You should drink juice."
Turning his head, he saw those children staring helplessly.
Xu Shiyan smiled, and ruthlessly punctured the fantasies of these brats. It would be nice to drink some fruit juice, so what are you thinking about?
"Oh, I see." The Piboys replied with some regret.
Boys are inexplicably curious about wine.
Especially Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao, who are sixteen or seventeen-year-old lads, usually smoke and drink with their classmates.
At first, I was wondering what it would be like to taste the wine, but now I see it, it’s no use.
Forget it, anyway, there are juices and various carbonated drinks. They can drink whatever they like, as long as they don’t drink, no one cares.
Xu Shiyan returned to the east room, and everyone greeted him to sit down, and everyone toasted and drank together, which was considered a welcome for Han Liwei and his wife.
"Come, eat, there are no outsiders here today, and you don't have to be polite.
Today we have enough food and wine, so we can eat and drink as we please. "
Xu Shiyan greeted everyone to eat and drink, and the big guys drank and chatted, talking and laughing very lively.
Everyone ate and drank here until evening, when Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others left.
Xu Shiqin didn't go back to her mother's house like this, so she must stay at her mother's house for one night.
Han Liwei has always been a daughter-in-law and he will do whatever he wants, so he will stay.
So, the couple led the two children and stayed with Xu Chenghou.
Xu Shian needless to say, his home is in the local area, and he can come back whenever he wants.
So the family of four chatted with the brothers after dinner, and then drove home.
As for the brothers, it was agreed this time to stay in Donggang for the New Year.
It’s the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth lunar month. I’m sure I won’t be able to go back today. I’ll go home tomorrow, the day after tomorrow for Chinese New Year, and then I’ll have to come back on the second day of junior high school.
It's better to just spend the New Year here, and wait until the second day of junior high school, and they will go home separately, so as to save the trouble of going back and forth.
Regarding the decision of their sons, Xu Chenghou and his wife were very happy.
The older people are, the more they like to be lively. Since moving to Donggang, it is rare for the whole family to celebrate the New Year together.
There are 20 or 30 people in this big family, how lively it is to celebrate the New Year together happily?
Thanks to the fact that there are many houses in the family, a dozen or so houses can be arranged anywhere.
During the day, everyone has been busy all day, no matter adults or children, they are all very tired.
After washing themselves at night, they got into bed and fell asleep without talking a few words.

chapters.title: Chapter 727: Have a reunion year
chapters.content:
Chapter 727 Have a Reunion Year
The son and daughter-in-law are all back for the New Year, and the happiest couple is Xu Chenghou and his wife.
Fortunately, there is nothing missing at home, and the chicken, duck and fish are all well prepared.
So, on the twenty-ninth day, Zhou Guilan led her daughters-in-law and began to cook all kinds of delicious food.
Zhou Guilan had already steamed the big steamed buns, so I only need to steam two more pots of jujube steamed buns.
A few days ago, Su Anying was still selling goods in Yangcheng, and Zhou Guilan didn't know when her daughter-in-law would come back.
I was afraid that it would be too late to prepare anything, so I started steaming steamed buns in advance.
After steaming several pots, they are all frozen in the big tank outside.
Meat is also available. The pigs that were slaughtered yesterday were distributed by Xu Shiyan’s work unit, given by relatives and friends, and all kinds of meat are available at home.
So they all turned out, pork knuckles, pig's trotters, large pieces of pork belly, everything that should be thrown into the pot.
The things that should be fried over there are also prepared in advance.
At thirty this morning, Xu Shian brought his wife and son back with a lot of vegetables, and the house became even more lively.
Now, Xu Shiyan and the others don't need to do the work of posting pairs. Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao led the younger brothers to do it all.
Several boys, some were holding sticks and brooms to wipe on the pillars of the gate, some were holding couplets to stick on them, and some were watching from a distance.
"Brother, go up two centimeters on your side, yes, yes, hey, that's it, okay."
Xu Haiyuan was the one who stood at a distance to see whether it was legitimate or not. Under his command, that brother stuck up the couplets in a few weeks, and then posted the door gods, hanging money, and going out to see the happy.
After that, the children put pairs on the door, barn, chicken coop, and other places.
And then, there is the word "Fu", which can be pasted on windows, doors, and water tanks, anyway.
After posting here, I will post all of Xu Shiyan's house, and then the children set off cannons while walking, and came back happily.
Xu Shixian led his younger brothers to erect lantern poles and chop firewood in the yard.
Usually, Xu Chenghou chops firewood at home. For the New Year, he prepared a lot in advance.
But chopping firewood and hugging firewood during the Chinese New Year have all meanings.
Besides, Xu Shixian and the others haven’t come back for several years to do any work for the family. This year, the brothers agreed to chop more firewood for their parents, so that their parents can save a little effort.
When these people were in the big house, they would go up the mountain to put trees and cut firewood in winter. Naturally, this kind of work was hard for them.
The brothers swung their axes and chopped firewood all morning, filling the firewood shed with firewood.
In the kitchen, Su Anying's sisters-in-law led Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu to do all kinds of frying and frying. Zhou Guilan wanted to come and have a look, but was immediately driven away.
Just a reunion dinner, there are five sisters-in-law and children to help, how can mother-in-law do it?
At two o'clock in the afternoon, the reunion dinner is served on the table.
There are more than 20 people in this big family, and the kang table is too small to sit on, so I brought the kang table from Xu Shiyan's family, and put the two tables together.
The old couple Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Chenghou led the children to eat on the kang. Xu Shixian's five brothers led their daughter-in-law at the table on the ground.
This reunion dinner is much richer than the pig-killing dishes that day.
Not to mention chicken, duck and fish, it’s normal to have these during Chinese New Year.
The key is that there are several kinds of green vegetables on the table, which are all rare things.
There are more than a dozen dishes, and the dishes that come later can only be stacked on top of other plates. This is a big table, and it looks greedy.
The old rule is that those who celebrate the Chinese New Year must take a family portrait.
So the big guys came into the room, some were sitting, some were standing, some were squatting, everything was arranged.
Then Xu Shiyan timed the camera, and when the flash came on, there was a click, which just kept the smiles on everyone's faces.
After taking a complete family portrait, the big guys sat down, and Xu Shiyan took a few more pictures with his camera.
Especially at the table on the kang, Xu Shiyan specially took a few more photos of his parents and children.
The children's faces are filled with happy smiles. The Chinese New Year is the happiest moment for children.
"Third brother, hurry up and eat, don't fiddle with your camera."
Xue Xiulin saw Xu Shiyan taking pictures of the children, so she hurriedly called him.
"Just like your big brother, you can't stop grabbing the camera."
Xu Shixian also bought a camera last year, oops, it’s rare.
On Sundays, if you have nothing to do, go to Beishan or Xijiang to take photos of any flowers and clouds.
Xue Xiulin said, this is like a demon.
Xu Shiyan glanced at Xu Shixian, the two brothers looked at each other and smiled, then Xu Shiyan put the camera in the cabinet, came over and sat down to eat.
When the Xu family had a rare family celebrating the New Year together, the old couple were obviously very happy, and Xu Chenghou insisted on having a drink.
There is a lot of wine at home, and there are all kinds of good wine, most of which are given to Xu Shiyan by friends, Xu Shiyan usually doesn't drink, and puts all of them away.
It's Chinese New Year, don't care about those, find a few bottles of Moutai, and pour a glass for Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Chenghou.
"Father, Master, it's not that you don't want to drink it for you, you should drink less when you are older.
This wine is said to be used for state banquets? Anyway, people say that this is very good, what kind of aging? I don't know either, let's try it. "
These were purchased by Zheng Yuyang for Xu Shiyan a while ago, and there were only two boxes in total.
Xu Shiyan knew the value of this thing, so he didn't want to touch it, so he put it away.
If it wasn’t for the Chinese New Year today, and the whole family was there, he wouldn’t be willing to take it out to drink.
Chu Xuanhuai picked up the wine glass, put it in front of his nose, smelled it, and nodded.
"Well, it's a good thing."
Of the people in this room, Elder Chu is the most knowledgeable.
I have never seen anything in my life, and Moutai is not a rare thing there. So as soon as the old man smelled it, he knew what the wine was like.
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, "It still has to be my master, who has knowledge, and someone gave it to me, and I don't understand anything.
I put it there anyway, and I didn’t want to drink it. "
"Big brother, second brother, fourth and fifth, let's pour some too.
Well, for Chinese New Year, we don’t want to drink too much, we just drink it well, just sip it slowly, let’s also taste the taste of this wine. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and poured all the brothers.
What should I say, when the wine was cheap in the past, the big guys were also poor, and no one was willing to spend seven or eight yuan to buy a bottle of wine and drink it back.
Now that I have money, this wine is also expensive, and it seems that it is not easy to buy.
Waiting for many years, it is absolutely amazing to be able to buy the real one. It is estimated that few people are willing to drink it, and they all keep it for collection.
In two lifetimes, Xu Shiyan drank Moutai for the first time.
In the era when he was reborn, this thing was almost touted to the sky. If you want to buy it, you can't buy it with money.
Even if you buy it at a big price, it may not be true.
Zheng Yuyang said that he had acquaintances in Guizhou Province, and asked someone to make this wine specially for Xu Shiyan, so that Xu Shiyan could keep it for Chinese New Year.
also said that if Xu Shiyan drank well, he would get a few more boxes for Xu Shiyan when he had the opportunity.
Why is Xu Shiyan so troublesome? After calling Zheng Yuyang to thank him, he also tactfully expressed that he didn't want to cause trouble for others.

chapters.title: Chapter 728: The smell of Moutai
chapters.content:
Chapter 728 The smell of Moutai
"Hey? Why is the taste of this wine different? I don't think it's as delicious as the little burnt wine from our Xinglong Winery."
Xu Shixiang took a sip of the wine, and immediately frowned. This taste is wrong, like Moutai?
Xu Shiyan took a sip when he heard this, and then frowned.
Why does this thing smell like this? It shouldn't be.
Zheng Yuyang spent a lot of effort to get it, can it be wrong?
"This Moutai is sauce-flavored.
The Xinglong Xiaoshao you usually drink, including Dehui Daqu, are all Luzhou-flavor liquors.
The fragrance type is different, and the natural taste is different. "
On the other hand, Chu Xuanhuai took a sip of his wine and said very calmly.
“For those who drink Moutai for the first time, most of them are not used to it.
It’s okay, you can taste it again. This wine has a soft mouth, rich sauce, and a long aftertaste. It doesn’t burn your heart or stick to your head.
Even if I drank too much tonight, I won’t feel sick and have a headache when I wake up tomorrow morning. "
Chu Xuanhuai smiled and gave Xu Shiyan a few explanations.
Xu Chenghou hadn't had time to drink yet, so when he heard this, he quickly took a sip.
"Well, good wine, not bad. This wine is delicious. Oh, just get used to it slowly."
The old man smacked his mouth and thought the wine was very good.
"Brother Chu, these monkey cubs don't know much, don't laugh at them."
Xu Shiyan brothers looked at each other.
Okay, they can be regarded as some knowledgeable people, but they made the two old men feel disgusted?
"Come on, let's drink ours, I don't believe it, it's all wine for state banquets, how can we not get used to it?"
Xu Shian was unconvinced, and dragged his brothers and sisters to continue drinking.
Not to mention, take a few more sips and taste carefully, and slowly you will taste something different.
Men drink alcohol, the more they drink, the more addicted they become.
Now that something is interesting to taste, the brothers couldn't stop drinking it one cup at a time.
Reunion dinner, good wine and good food, the whole family sat around the table happily.
Under such an atmosphere, who wouldn't drink two more glasses?
Even Chu Xuanhuai, who usually doesn't drink much, drank two glasses of wine with Xu Chenghou.
The two old men took their time, chatting while eating and drinking, while the children next to them walked up with various drinks.
Years ago, the beverage factory delivered a lot of beverages, but I dare not let them drink too much.
But today is the Chinese New Year, everyone is happy, so I let the children choose whatever they want.
You can drink whatever you want, with or without gas, and everyone carries a bottle in their hand.
These brats don't care about that anymore, they don't even take the cup, they think it's troublesome, so they blow on the bottle directly.
"Oh my god, you guys are planning to drink only water.
Come on, hurry up and eat first, there are enough drinks, drink them later. "
Zhou Guilan laughed when she saw this, and hurriedly stopped her. For those who celebrate the Chinese New Year, how can they make a belly full of water after a good reunion dinner?
Grandma spoke, and the children put down their drink bottles and started eating.
The table is full of delicious dishes, but the children's first goal is still prawns.
Based on last year's experience, this time Su Anying specially cooked some more prawns, and specially placed them on a large plate to put them on top.
Even so, it can’t help that the children like to eat shrimps all the time.
It didn't take long for the children to eat up such a big plate of shrimp.
Looking at the table on the ground, okay, this speed is really fast enough, and hurriedly allocated half of their table to the children.
"Don't just eat shrimp, there are so many delicious ones."
Where do the children care about that? They eat like this. They wait for one to come, and after finishing their favorite ones, they will eat others.
The grown-ups didn’t recruit, so go with them, anyway, you can eat whatever you want.
It’s rare for brothers to get together, and now everyone’s life is better, and they are no longer so fussy about each other as they were in the past, but their relationship is better.
There are good wine and good food in front of me, and these brothers are very happy to change glasses and drink. Two bottles of wine are almost enough for them to drink.
Su Anying has a few sisters-in-law, and they get along well now. They don't live together after they are separated, and there are not so many conflicts between the sisters-in-law.
They got together unexpectedly, and they all felt very intimate.
Originally none of them drank alcohol, but they drank ice wine that day and thought it tasted very good, so they opened two more bottles today.
My sisters-in-law chatted while eating, and it felt good.
"Second sister-in-law, how is Xiaobo at the Agricultural University? I look a little taller than when I went to school in autumn."
Su Anying picked up two prawns for Wei Mingrong, and asked casually.
Xu Haibo's grades in the high school entrance examination were not satisfactory, and he was not admitted to a technical secondary school.
So, as agreed in advance, I went to the Agricultural University to study and learn about agricultural product processing.
They are entrusted with directional training, and their academic qualifications are recognized by the state.
After graduation, it is enough to go back to the company to work directly. No matter which department you are assigned to, it is a good job.
"Very good, I heard that the final grades are not bad.
His third uncle took the trouble to arrange for him to go to school. If this kid doesn't study hard, let alone your second brother, I will have to beat him. "
Bringing up his son, Wei Mingrong laughed.
Originally, both of them were worried that their children would not study well, and they didn’t know what to do in the future. If it didn’t work out, they could only go to work in the farm.
Unexpectedly, the third uncle of the child was capable. He sent the child to study, and after graduation, he would go to work and have a job.
The second eldest couple has been taken care of by their younger siblings all these years, so they naturally respect and appreciate Xu Shiyan and his wife very much.
"Didn't people say that he grew taller after changing the environment? When Xiaobo was growing, I also watched him grow taller again.
Anyway, our family is not too short, so we can be similar to his father. "
Wei Mingrong glanced at the eldest son who was sitting on the Kang and eating, and was full of joy.
This child has grown up, and he looks more stable when he comes back from vacation, unlike the second child, who is like a monkey all day long, so he has no time to be honest.
"The boss has made arrangements, now we will look at the second.
He said he wanted to be a soldier, I think it's okay, send him to exercise and hone his temperament. "
Wei Mingrong glanced at the second son who was dishonest in eating, and said helplessly.
"No matter what the child wants to do, as long as he doesn't steal or rob, and knows to follow the right path." Xue Xiulin and others next to him said so.
That's true, as long as the child is willing to walk the right path, and doesn't sneak around, kill people and set fire, the Xu family can arrange a way out for the child at present.
"The boy is easy to arrange. If it doesn't work, he can still go to the army. What do you think about our two girls?
I saw that the two girls in our family were disgusting. Feng'er was a sophomore in liberal arts and science. She studied literature and her final grades were average.
Xiu’er’s grades were not too good in her third year of junior high school. Whether she can pass the high school exam is still a matter of debate. "
After Xue Xiulin finished talking about Wei Mingrong, she felt worried.
The two girls in the family are average in their studies, barely finished high school, what should they do next?
"Siblings, if these two fail to pass the college entrance examination, they may have to ask the third child to help."
Xue Xiulin looked at Su Anying, unable to erase her face.
In the past, I always looked down on this sister-in-law and ran against her openly and secretly, but now? Everything has to be asked of others.
Hey, if I had known that today would happen, I would have to treat the third daughter-in-law better.

chapters.title: Chapter 729: Chinese New Year is celebrating children
chapters.content:
Chapter 729 Chinese New Year is to celebrate children
"Sister-in-law, why do my family members say to help or not?
Shi Yan would never refuse if he could arrange it. "Su Anying laughed when she heard that.
Her personality has always been like this, she never holds grudges, and never takes the past to heart.
They are all descendants of the old Xu family. The children are promising, and their uncles and aunts also have glory on their faces.
Su Anying said so, Xue Xiulin was naturally happy, so she dragged Su Anying to have a drink.
The sisters-in-law were laughing and making noises, and the big guys didn't drink less.
Fortunately, the ice wine was not high in alcohol content, so they didn't get drunk.
The whole family was reunited, and the meal was very lively.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan looked at the room full of people, and the smile on their faces never stopped.
After the reunion dinner, I hurriedly packed up, then took a rest, and started chopping meat and vegetables to make dumplings.
The children were sent to stare for a while, so that they would not be able to watch the new year in the evening.
I started making dumplings at 6:30 in the evening, and by 8:00, the dumplings had already been half made.
Just at this time, the party also started, and the big guys were making dumplings while watching TV.
The party has been held for several years, and it is no longer as attractive to children as it was in the first few years when there was television.
Cross talks, sketches, etc. are okay, and the children can sit still.
But when they were replaced by singing, dancing and opera, Xu Haitao and Xu Haibin felt as if they had nails growing on their buttocks, they couldn’t sit still at all.
"Let's go, let's go out and set off cannons? This stuff is ugly and boring.
Let’s fire the cannon for a while, and watch the sketch when we come back, isn’t it good? "
The host announced the curtain, saying that the solo will be the next one, so Xu Haitao leaned over to Xu Haibin and Xu Haiyuan, muttering in a low voice.
Boys don’t sit still.
Especially during the Chinese New Year, there are a lot of firecrackers at home, and the sound of firecrackers can be heard outside from time to time.
The children also have grass growing in their hearts, so when Xu Haitao said it, they all stared and became more energetic.
"Okay, my dad bought a lot of cannons, I know where they are, let's go."
Xu Haiyuan looked at the singing on TV, and felt that it was meaningless.
So he ran to the inner room of the east room and dug out a lot of firecrackers from the cabinet.
A few boys put on their coats and hats, went to the stove to pull out some firewood with sparks on the front, and went out to set off the cannons.
For Chinese New Year, the family bought a lot of firecrackers, all kinds of them.
Xu Haiyuan made a lot of them and put them on the ground. Then Xu Haitao and the others took the firewood with sparks and lit the fuse of the firecracker.
Then, the yard became lively, and there was a lot of movement.
From time to time, the Diamond Monkey flew out with a squeak and exploded in the air.
Otherwise, it is the flashing thunder, colorful pearls, etc., which not only explode, but also burst into various colors, and the reflected courtyard is lit up.
"These brats, it's not time to issue papers, they are just messing around."
Xu Shixian heard the movement outside, shook his head, and wanted to get up and call the children back.
Don’t let off all the firecrackers, it’s useless to distribute papers later.
"Brother, don't worry, there are plenty of firecrackers at home.
Let them do whatever they want, the boy is like this, usually no one can make a fuss with him.
This time the six boys got together, it’s good that they didn’t lift the roof of the house, let them go. "
There are boys in the family making noise, and the Chinese New Year is lively.
Let’s celebrate the New Year as usual, Xu Haiyuan likes to be quiet, Xu Haiqing is still young and dare not make a fuss, so Xu Shiyan has to lead his sons out to set off cannons.
This year, the six cousins ​​got together. When Xu Haibo, Xu Haitao, and Xu Haibin were all fearless, when the three of them took the lead, Xu Haiyuan and the others followed suit.
It’s great. The New Year’s Eve is all about being lively. If it’s not lively, it’s not fun.
When it was said that the brothers were going to spend the New Year at home, Xu Shiyan thought about it.
Specially from the other side of the participating store, pull some more firecrackers back, just for the children to play.
Who celebrates Chinese New Year? It's just children, without children jumping around, what's the point of celebrating the New Year?
After Xu Shiyan said that, Xu Shixian didn't go out again, and sat down to eat melon seeds and drink tea while watching TV.
It just so happens that the next one is a skit. The skits of this year are all carefully prepared, full of jokes, and very funny.
Whether the audience in front of the TV or in the studio, they were all amused by the sketch actors on stage.
At nine o'clock, all the dumplings were wrapped. There were so many people in the family that seven or eight curtains were wrapped.
Zhou Guilan rummaged through the cabinet to find some clean white cloths, covered the dumplings, and took them out.
In the past, the white flour bag was a white cloth bag with a red or blue thread woven at both ends.
Ordinary households save flour bags, wash them out specially, and then disassemble the seams to form a square piece of cloth.
It is a good thing to keep as a furoshiki and make an apron.
It will take a few more years before the woven bag-style noodle bags will come out. Once the woven bags come out, there will be no more cloth noodle bags.
The Xu family has a good life, and there is no shortage of flour, so they have saved a lot of flour bags.
Zhou Guilan was cleaned up, and she kept it for covering things.
The dumplings are made, and there is still a while before the papers are issued. Everyone sits down and watches TV.
Seeing the wonderful and amusing show, each of them was laughing and laughing, full of joy.
"By the way, these are apples and pears from our hometown. The third child and his unit brought back several truckloads this year to give benefits to workers. Come and taste them."
Zhou Guilan suddenly remembered that there were still fruits at home, so she hurriedly found them out and washed them, and brought a pot for everyone to eat.
"Well, this apple is very good, very sweet and crunchy, isn't our hometown also has good things?"
Xu Shixian took an apple and took a bite. It was crunchy and sweet and delicious.
"This pear is not an old variety, but it is still very good."
Over there, Xu Chenghou took the pear and looked at it for a long time.
It's not the varieties he remembers. Take a bite and try it, it's okay, it's delicious.
"At our end, the place is too remote, the roads are not good, and some good things cannot be transported out.
If the road here can be repaired, the other end will not be poor. "Xu Chenghou sighed while eating pears.
"Third brother, your unit is better. In this year's situation, you still have money to give benefits to employees."
Xu Shixian muttered while nibbling on an apple.
"I still don't understand this year, he used the big flower basket to hold the fruit.
And the preparations over there are not sufficient, and the quantity is not enough.
After I saw the things brought back, I could only see that they were evenly distributed.
I told Brother Qu that next year, you can use that kind of bamboo basket or cardboard box, which is more convenient and better than this. "
Xu Shiyan also took an apple and gnawed it there. Not to mention, this apple is really delicious, better than that of Guoguang, and quite sweet.
"Our unit is okay, anyway, this year has survived, but I don't know what will happen next fall.
Look at the Spring Fair. If there are good orders at the Spring Fair next year, it will be fine.
If there is no order at the Spring Fair, then next year may not be so.
No matter what the situation is, let the workers have a good year. "

chapters.title: Chapter 730: Set off firecrackers to celebrate the new year
chapters.content:
Chapter 730 Set off firecrackers to celebrate the new year
It was not yet eleven o'clock, and there were bursts of crackling firecrackers outside.
Xu Chenghou couldn't sit still when he heard the commotion outside.
"Otherwise, let's distribute the papers earlier? The children eat earlier and play for a while after eating. They should be sleepy."
Xu Chenghou turned his head and asked Zhou Guilan.
"Okay, then go early. Then you lead the sons to distribute papers, and I will cook dumplings."
Zhou Guilan looked at the clock on the wall, it was only ten forty-five.
All right, it’s better to be early, the wonderful skits are coming later, I cooked the dumplings earlier, just in time to go back to the house to watch the skits.
Just like that, Xu Chenghou led his sons, carried the table out, and put steamed buns, chicken, fish, and meat on it.
I don’t have an incense burner bowl at home, so I put two bowls that I don’t usually use, filled them with plant ash and pressed them firmly.
Xu Chenghou took his son to work outside, and Zhou Guilan led his daughter-in-law to work in the kitchen.
There was already a fire in the kitchen, and there was hot water in the pot.
Now add more dry firewood to the bottom of the pot, the flames are lit up, and the water in the pot will be overturned in a short time.
"The water is boiling." Zhou Guilan shouted towards the outside.
Outside, Xu Chenghou ordered his eldest son to light firecrackers, and here he lit three sticks of incense, and then lit a large pile of printed burning paper.
"Come on, all of you come over and kowtow. Xiaobo, lead your brother and the others over here too."
Xu Chenghou greeted his children and grandchildren, followed behind him, and all knelt down and kowtowed.
Afterwards, the children lit a lot of firecrackers in the yard, and Xu Jinfeng and the others also lit some silent fireworks to watch the excitement.
Sisters Xu Jinping and the others were still holding the ground tendons in their hands and lit the whole place.
The dogs at home are all old, and setting off firecrackers once a year can no longer affect them.
Several dogs are lying safely in the nest, making as much noise outside as they want, and the children can jump as much as they like, without even making a sound.
Xu Chenghou looked at the children and grandchildren all over the yard, and couldn't close his mouth with joy.
"Don't you have a lot of firecrackers at home? Take it out and let it go, just as the children are there, take it out and let it go lively."
Seeing that the children were having fun, the old man urged Xu Shiyan to go back to the house and take out all the firecrackers.
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything else, and went into the room and took out half a basket of fireworks and small cannons of various colors.
Boys grab firecrackers, girls grab fireworks, anyway, the yard is big, so they don't interfere with each other.
Now the yard is bustling with jingle sounds over there, and the yard illuminated by colorful fireworks here is much brighter.
The children were jumping and jumping in the yard, and the cold wind on New Year's Eve did not affect them at all.
While the firecrackers were going off outside, the dumplings were also cooked in the kitchen.
Wait until the children set off the firecrackers and fireworks, and the dumplings in the pot are cooked and taken out, and served on the table.
"Okay, let's all come back to eat."
The temperature was low on New Year's Eve, and the children's faces were flushed from the cold while they were outside.
As soon as grandma called out to eat dumplings, a large group of hula la ran into the house.
Entering the house, taking off their hats and coats, the boys jumped on the kang directly, and the older girls went to the kitchen to help serve dishes, chopsticks and small dishes.
The hot dumplings were served, and the whole family sat down.
Zhou Guilan looked at the people in this room, and she was also very happy.
"Okay, let's eat with chopsticks, today's dumplings have several fillings, eat whatever you want."
According to the old rules, the dumplings are still filled with coins, peanuts, jujubes, and sugar.
The children are not here to eat the dumplings, they are just to eat the money inside. They stare at each other to see which dumpling looks like.
In order to get more money for food, these children kept eating dumplings, and finally ate all of them until their stomachs became round, until they couldn't eat any more.
Today, I cooked dumplings early and ate them early. After eating dumplings, it’s still a while before twelve o’clock.
So I quickly packed up and sat down to watch TV.
When twelve o'clock rang, Xu Haibo and Xu Jinfeng, leading their brothers and sisters, knelt down in front of the kang.
"Grandpa, Grandma, and Grandpa Chu, Happy New Year." The children greeted the New Year in unison.
"Hey, good, good, all good, all good."
The old man is so happy, he can't wait to smile all over the back of his head.
Hurry up to get the children up, then take out the red envelopes that were prepared in advance, and distribute them one by one.
The old man finished handing out red envelopes, and Xu Shixian and others over there also took out red envelopes.
Don’t worry about other children this time, everyone has one, and everyone has a share.
The children received a lot of red envelopes at once, and they were very happy now, jumping up and down and having fun.
Seeing the children jumping and jumping like this, everyone couldn't help laughing.
"Looking at these children, I'm happy to just do nothing. It's great, how lively the Chinese New Year is." Zhou Guilan muttered contentedly.
After eating dumplings and paying New Year’s greetings, the new year is coming. From then on, the children are one year older.
The big guys chatted and laughed for a while, and then the children got a little sleepy, so they each found a place to rest.
