Anyway, it's not long before dawn, so I don't need to take off my clothes, so I just deal with it casually and sleep for a while.
When I woke up, it was past seven in the morning on the first day of the new year.
So he quickly turned on the fire, boiled the three gailian dumplings left over from last night, and put a hanging whip outside.
After breakfast, the house is full of excitement. Neighbors, relatives and friends all come to pay New Year's greetings.
Xu Haibo and others, under the leadership of Xu Haiyuan, also wandered around these houses to pay New Year's greetings.
"Grandma, grandma, let's go to Grandpa Su's house to celebrate the New Year.
After a while, I will go directly to Grandpa Han's house and pay New Year's greetings to Grandpa Han and my sister-in-law. "
The children came back from wandering around outside, Xu Haibo talked to Xu Chenghou and the others.
It is the right thing to visit relatives and friends on the first day of the Lunar New Year.
In the past, they didn’t celebrate the New Year here, so it’s fine if they don’t go to pay New Year’s greetings. Since they are here this year, these relatives’ families must go there.
Especially those of the younger generation, no one will be left behind.
"Oh, okay, let's go, that, be careful on the road."
Xu Chenghou nodded, and waved the children away.
The descendants of the old Xu family are prosperous, with twelve children of six boys and six girls in the younger generation.
When such a large group of people go out, it’s good if they don’t bully others, so don’t be afraid that someone will dare to bully them.
was allowed, and the children came out of the house happily.
How can these brats walk in a proper manner? They found all the sledges at home.
Girls are sitting on the sledge, and boys are running while pulling the sledge.
Nowadays, no one cleans up the snow on the road. The road is covered with a hard shell of ice and snow, and the sledges can slip on it.
At this time, the children are all wearing thick, cotton-padded jackets and cotton trousers.
Boys wear leather hats and big cotton shoes, and girls wear thick scarves and cotton boots.
Both boys and girls wear cotton gloves, which are necessary equipment for going out in winter.
Wearing thickly, the children are not afraid of the cold, so they ran on the road laughing and making noise.
People passing by saw it, and they all laughed. If they meet someone they know, the children will stop to say New Year greetings, and then continue to run.

chapters.title: Chapter 731: The way forward
chapters.content:
Chapter 731 The road to future development
On the first day of the Lunar New Year, the Xu family has been on a regular basis.
Neighborhood neighbors, relatives and friends, colleagues in Xu Shiyan's unit, and town cadres.
This wave of people sat for a while before leaving, and that wave came in again.
On the day of the second day of junior high school, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin brought their children back, and the whole family got together again to have a great time.
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to take another picture of the big guy.
This is a serious family portrait. There is no one missing in the family, and everyone is there.
Woke up early in the third day of junior high school, Xu Shixian and the others went back to their natal homes with their daughter-in-law, and Xu Shiyan and Su Anying also led their four children back to Su's house.
Now, among the six sisters of the Su family, five are in Donggang, and only Qin Meiling lives in Hunjiang. The six sisters are living a good life.
At this time in the previous life, Qin Meiling's man, Sui Hongzhi, had already contracted the Hunjiang Department Store. He was rich and found San'er outside, and Qin Meiling and Qin Meiling were in the process of divorcing.
As a result, in this life, I don't know why Sui Hongzhi stopped, and lived with Qin Meiling honestly.
The couple have a good relationship, and Sui Hongzhi is also very warm to his husband's family.
Regarding this, Xu Shiyan didn't have any ideas, it would be best not to leave, and it would save Su Weizhong and Han Cai'e to follow suit.
After the third day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan never stayed at home.
In the fourth day of the junior high school, the leaders of the Ginseng Company and the Forestry Bureau got together for a drink.
At the wine table, Xu Shiyan proposed to set up a parquet factory in Songjianghe.
When the forestry bureau heard about it, they became interested, so they had to get involved.
Xu Shiyan didn't refuse either. The specific cooperation matters will be discussed slowly later.
On the fifth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan was called to the county by Chang Hongfa. It turned out that Guan Enxue, Lin Qiyue, and Chen Jianzhang were all in the county.
It happened that this group of people got together and chatted for a long time.
In particular, an informal discussion was held on the development of the ginseng industry in the Fusong area and even the Hunjiang area.
"In the future, our ginseng will be high-quality, branded, and high-end.
It is no longer possible to develop popular goods, and they cannot be sold at a price. "Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to express his point of view.
“The first one is to let go of the contracting of mountain forests and develop under-forest ginseng.
Our field has tried this before, but our field does not have its own mountain, and the ownership of the forest land does not belong to us, and then it was left alone. "
"Linxia ginseng is still very promising, and of course it will take a long time.
So it is best to cooperate with the contracted river section to raise forest frogs, cold-water fish, and plant some medicinal materials, so that you can also have income in the early stage.
This requires the cooperation of the forestry department.
Our place can’t keep up with Ji’an and Huanren’s. They have Ziliu Mountains on their side, and they can do whatever they want. "
Forest ginseng has a long development cycle, and it usually takes more than ten to twenty years to see benefits, so the contract period must be long, and it is useless if it is short.
“Another one is to develop ginseng with low pesticide residues.
The pesticides we use in the ginseng industry now have too many drug residues, which is why many sticks cannot be sold at a high price.
There is also a reason why the clubs we participated in have been selling well.
Brother Lin knows that since I came to the venue, I have been advocating the non-use of pesticides such as HCH, DDT, chlordane, pentachloronitrobenzene, and phorate.
Our ginseng is tested, there are no such harmful residues, and the quality is guaranteed.
This matter must be regulated as soon as possible, and the name of our Changbai Mountain ginseng without agricultural residues must be publicized, so that the price can go up even more. "
These are what Xu Shiyan has been thinking about since the accident last fall.
"Before I have always emphasized that the rapid development of ginseng should be controlled, and now I still say that the more the more the less valuable.
In the county, policies must be introduced to reduce the area, adjust the scale, and control development.
Especially those enterprises and public institutions, planting ginseng with public money, try to put an end to this kind of thing.
Control the scale, don’t develop so fast, and avoid oversupply in the market, so that the ginseng industry can develop in the long run. "
Finally, it’s still a cliché. Xu Shiyan has suggested it many times before, but his superiors just don’t listen.
As long as it can be controlled, it will not collapse so suddenly.
"Shiyan, I heard people say that American ginseng is popular abroad now.
The price of that thing is high, and they accept foreign businessmen. There are a lot of American ginseng planted in the second ginseng field and the third ginseng field.
Do you think our county should also adjust its structure, in addition to reducing the planting area of ​​ginseng, and gradually develop American ginseng. "Gao Yunfeng had a somewhat different opinion.
"County Gao, what do you say about this matter, the price of American ginseng is also in the hands of foreign businessmen.
Today he said that the price is high, so we will plant more varieties. When we plant more and the output will increase, he will not accept it? Isn't this routine the same as our stick? "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, whether it is American ginseng or local ginseng, as long as they do not have the right to price autonomy, they are leeks in the eyes of capital, and people can harvest them whenever they want.
Now, looking at American ginseng to make money, they all swarm to grow American ginseng.
Waiting for the production of American ginseng to increase, if people say that the quality is not good, it will be useless.
It was like this in the previous life, the local ginseng was no longer available, and many people switched to American ginseng.
I did make money in the first few years, but what happened later? Isn't it the same routine?
So, it doesn’t matter whether they grow local ginseng or American ginseng. The key issue is that they have the ability to control the price.
“I have always said that we want to develop towards branding, and we want to build a well-known brand.
The most important thing is to make everyone think of our brand when they mention ginseng and ginseng products.
Just like South Korea now, as long as Korean ginseng is mentioned, it must be Zhengguanzhuang, right?
Obviously they are all the same ginseng, even our red ginseng is of higher quality than theirs, but we just can’t sell them.
Why? This is the power of branding. "
Xu Shiyan feels that there is too much lack of ideas in this aspect in China, and many people don't pay attention to this aspect at all.
Not to mention anything else, these participating venues in the county are independent and have their own trademarks.
Before, there were Donglin cards in the first game, Chenyu cards in the second game, and Ruyunlong cards in the third game.
It is impossible to form a unity at all, and naturally there is no brand effect.
"South Korea pays special attention to these things, whether it is a large supermarket, an airport duty-free shop, or even some tourist attractions, they all sell this brand.
I think we should also learn from it, concentrate our strengths, and develop a local brand, so that we can develop in the long run.
Otherwise, we will always be the raw material base for foreign businessmen.
People say that the more money they give us, the more money we will get. Who told us that our waists are not hard? "
Xu Shixian wanted to say these words a long time ago.
"I mentioned it to the leader last time, saying that I wanted to develop a new type of cooperative, set up a ginseng association, etc., but nothing happened.
This is the best way to develop. Only by uniting all participating farmers and taking the route of branding and high-end together can we compete with foreign capital. "
So, this is the disadvantage of contracting to households. Participating farmers are independent, and their power is scattered. It is too easy for others to deal with you.

chapters.title: Chapter 732: go to yangcheng together
chapters.content:
Chapter 732 Go to Yangcheng together
"Shiyan, go back and write me a complete report on what you said today."
Based on Guan Enxue's understanding and trust in Xu Shiyan, these words must be taken seriously.
"I actually saw the previous report, and it was well written.
If it is combined with what you said today, and it is really implemented, it will definitely turn the situation around. "
Two reports, it can be said that one focuses on the present and the other focuses on the future.
This is like treating a disease. The first report treats the symptoms and solves the urgent need. Today’s words are a cure for the root cause and prevent the future.
If the two are combined, an effective solution will be found.
If the superiors intensify their efforts in management and give certain preferential treatment to ginseng farmers, the local ginseng industry can still recover.
Of course, this won’t work in three or two years, it must be persevering.
I was afraid that some leaders were impatient, and when they saw that there was no effect, they retreated.
"Okay, I'll write a complete copy when I get back."
Xu Shiyan didn't refuse. In this position, some awareness is still required.
If the leader asks to write, then it must be written. As for whether the superior approves or not after the writing is finished, it is not Xu Shiyan's decision.
He only has the final say in the one-third of the acre of the participating company. After leaving the company, it is for his face that people listen to him, and it is normal if they don't listen.
After all, it is not easy to implement these plans, and they need a lot of money to back them up. The superiors have their own considerations, and they all understand.
Xu Shiyan, Guan Enxue and others stayed in the county for a day. In the evening, the driver drove him home.
On the sixth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan set up a banquet for guests, and called Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli, Yang Junxian, Zhou Qingguo and others.
The big guys had a lively day together, and they also made a simple plan for the next thing.
On the seventh day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan, accompanied by Su Anying, Xu Shiqin, and Han Liwei, set off by train together.
Didn't Xu Shiqin say that he wanted to visit Yangcheng, set up a store or open a factory?
Going home before, I heard that my brother and sister-in-law bought a house there to rebuild and planned to open a shop. Xu Shiqin said that he would go to Yangcheng with Su Anying after the next year.
Han Liwei originally had a few days of vacation, but Xu Shiqin was going to leave, so he could only go with him.
In the few days since Su Anying came back for the Chinese New Year, people called one after another asking for goods.
Su Anying thought about it, she and Ji Yufeng went over to settle down first, and continued to deliver the goods at home.
Take advantage of the period before the beginning of spring, earn as much as you can, otherwise, the expenses for this year will be quite high, so what if you can’t just go out?
One more thing, the roof of the house in Yangcheng has been capped, and there are still interior and exterior walls, door and window installation, interior decoration and so on. There are many things to be busy.
Xu Shiyan never went to take a look at his own house from the time it was bought to the time it was built.
During the month, there were few things to do at work, so he happened to go to Yangcheng to see how his house was built, and he had other things to deal with along the way.
A group of people took the train to Shenyang, and Xu Shiyan and the others took a plane to Yangcheng.
Han Liwei took his two children, and went to Fengcheng by car first to see the old leader, and then returned to Guangshui by car in two days.
Since the two children were weaned, Xu Shiqin often went around to run errands and open shops, and the two children were used to being with their father.
Han Liwei is also very attentive to the children, taking care of the two children very thoughtfully, there is nothing to worry about.
Xu Shiyan and his party arrived in Yangcheng, settled in the residence, and went to see the progress of the house.
According to the current construction progress, it is estimated that it will take four to five months at the earliest to fully clean up and decorate.
It’s okay, the house is not in a hurry, and the construction period is too fast. Once there are any problems with the quality of the project, it will not be worthwhile.
The couple met with the leader of the project construction party and explained the specific requirements to each other in detail.
The other party agreed, saying that they would definitely pack up the house as soon as possible under the premise of ensuring the quality of the project, so that the opening in autumn would not be delayed.
There was nothing unexpected about the house, so Xu Shiyan then went to visit Chu Xuanhuai's students here.
After all, I asked someone for help before and promoted the medicine of the pharmaceutical factory. Now that I am here, I must go to meet and catch up.
At the same time, Xu Shiyan also inquired about the grandchildren of the Chu family.
Before, Xu Shiyan had been in contact with this place. He asked him to take care of Chu Yuanchao and Chu Yuanlang's wives and children, and even sent some money here.
However, he heard that the wife of Chu Yuanchao did not accept the money, no matter who gave it, they would not accept a penny.
Xu Shiyan came here this time, so he planned to go over and take a look. If there is any difficulty here, he will definitely help if he can.
Chu Yuanchao's wife and Chu Yuanlang's wife are cousins.
Back when the brothers of the Chu family went to the countryside in the Northwest, Chu Yuanlang was so thoughtful and thoughtful that he was taken by the village chief and married his daughter Zhang Jinxiang to Chu Yuanlang.
After Chu Yuanlang and Zhang Jinxiang got married, their relationship was not bad.
Chu Yuanlang was worried about his elder brother not having a family, so he asked his wife for help, and introduced a similar one from his relatives.
This Zhang Jinxiang has a cousin named Zhang Lianxiang, who is a few months older than her.
Zhang Jinxiang took a chance and called Zhang Lianxiang and Chu Yuanchao to their home for dinner, in fact, they were looking at each other.
Chu Yuanchao didn't like Zhang Lianxiang, but after Chu Yuanlang persuaded him, he nodded and agreed, and settled down there to get married and have children.
A few years ago, the brothers of the Chu family were unwilling to stay in the northwest and decided to come to the south to make a living.
After the two of them had made a name for themselves outside, they took over their wives and children.
After the two brothers had an accident, the sales office and residence in Shenzhen City were confiscated. The sisters took their children and came to live in Xin'an Town.
Xu Shiyan brought a lot of things, and led by Deputy Dean Qin of Yangcheng Medical College, he came to the residence of the Zhang family sisters in Xin'an Town.
"I know who you are, you don't have to be so polite.
We are here with our kids and we can get by without your help.
Here, life is much better than our hometown.
My two sisters went to work in the factory to earn money to support our children, which is very good. "
When Sister Zhang Lianxiang saw Xu Shiyan, she guessed who he was.
For Xu Shiyan, the two sisters have a very peaceful attitude, neither hatred nor joy.
It's like the feeling of meeting someone on the street. It's irrelevant, so I don't have any emotions.
To be honest, Xu Shiyan was a little surprised.
He thought that the Zhang sisters refused the help from him and Qin Shaoping because they harbored resentment, so they refused to accept the help from their enemies.
But this meeting found that it doesn't seem to be the case.
"Sister-in-law, Elder Chu misses you very much.
He is too old to dare to let him come here, so I came here to take a look on behalf of Mr. Chu. No other meaning. "
Xu Shiyan knew that although Mr. Chu didn't say anything, he actually missed his daughter-in-law and grandchildren very much.
The old man just didn't want to trouble Xu Shiyan, so he never mentioned it.
"Originally, I was supposed to take you to the Northeast for the New Year years ago. I was busy at that time, and I really couldn't spare time."
Last year was really too busy, the couple couldn't be free and couldn't take care of this side.
It was true that Su Anying was in Yangcheng at the time, but she had to take care of many aspects. How could Xu Shiyan let her come here to meet the Zhang family sisters again?
What's more, no one knows how the Zhang family sisters will react.
What if they meet the Xu family and do something impulsively?

chapters.title: Chapter 733: What are these two thinking?
chapters.content:
Chapter 733 What are these two thinking?
The brothers of the Chu family were sent in by Xu Shiyan's design.
Manly man, one person does the work and the other is responsible. It doesn't make sense for Xu Shiyan to do what Xu Shiyan did, so let his wife stand up for him.
That's why Xu Shiyan didn't ask Su Anying to come and see the Chu family, but came here in person after the year.
But the attitude of the Zhang family sisters was still beyond Xu Shiyan's expectations, and on the contrary, he didn't know what to say.
"Where are the kids? I want to meet them, okay?"
“The kids are out and playing.
It's still a holiday, and school hasn't started yet, so I don't care about them and let them mess around. "
Zhang Lianxiang smiled faintly, and rejected Xu Shiyan's request.
Xu Shiyan frowned slightly when he heard this.
"Sister-in-law, I know that you all have opinions on me and maybe my master Chu Lao.
It's not your fault, it's normal, if it were me, I would do the same.
However, I came here today sincerely, just to meet the children.
Sister-in-law, no matter what, you have to let me take a look at them. I'll go back so I can have an explanation with Mr. Chu. "
Xu Shiyan heard Mr. Chu mention it, it seems that the eldest granddaughter Chu Junyu and the second granddaughter Chu Junling of the Chu family are not young anymore.
Before coming here, Xu Shiyan also made some inquiries with Qin Shaoping.
Knowing that the children of the Chu family were all studying, they seem to be doing well in their studies.
These children were in the Northwest before, and the conditions were not good, so they couldn't keep up when they first came here.
But children have to be strong, and they gritted their teeth and studied hard, and they all got good grades in the end.
If calculated normally, Chu Junyu and Chu Junling should take the college entrance examination this year.
If it is really like what Qin Shaoping said, even if Chu Junyu is not in school at this time, he should still be reading and reviewing at home. How could he go out to play?
This is obviously what they said on purpose because they didn't want him to see the children.
"No, we really have no opinion on you." Zhang Lianxiang shook her head.
"What did my man do, I can't hide it from the person next to me.
When he asked us to move here, I guessed that sooner or later he would kill himself and send himself in.
It's not at your place, it will be elsewhere, this, I don't blame you. "
"I tried to persuade him, but he didn't listen, and then I didn't persuade him anymore, just let him go.
If something goes wrong, none of us blames it, really.
We just want to live our own life in peace and stability, without the help of others, and don't want to be disturbed. "
Zhang Lianxiang's tone was still calm, without any emotion.
Xu Shiyan really didn't have a charter this time. He made it clear that he didn't want to talk to him. What should we do?
"Sister-in-law, then I won't bother you.
This is the address of my home, with my unit’s phone number and my home phone number on it.
In the future, no matter what happens at home, you can call me. "
Xu Shiyan left a note with his home address and phone number on it, and put it on the table.
"Well, okay, then I will accept it, and if I encounter difficulties in the future, I will come to you."
Zhang Lianxiang didn't say anything else this time, and accepted the note.
"Take these things away, the family can live on, these things are not needed."
As Zhang Lianxiang said, he returned the things Xu Shiyan had brought back to Xu Shiyan.
"Sister-in-law, I came all the way here. To be honest, I didn't know what the children liked, so I just bought them.
Whether the family lacks or not, this is my little wish, and you have to accept it anyway. "
Is there any reason to take back what is sent out? If this was in the Northeast, it would be a slap in the face.
Xu Shiyan was patient and talked nicely to Zhang Lianxiang and the others.
"When the children come back, ask them what they mean. If you have time during the summer vacation, I would like to take them to live in the Northeast for a few days.
Elder Chu misses the children, no matter how much grievances and grievances between Elder Chu and Chu Yuanchao and Chu Yuanlang, it has nothing to do with the children.
There is the child's grandfather over there. Anyway, go back and take a look, and the old man will feel better. "
Even though Elder Chu didn't say it, both Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan could tell.
The old man was thinking about his grandchildren, but he was just stubborn and refused to trouble others.
If Mr. Chu didn’t mention it, Xu Shiyan had to do it. It’s just a few children, and the cost of food and drink is not much.
In summer, the climate in Northeast China is good, and Mr. Chu is very happy to pick up the children to play for a while.
Zhang Lianxiang and Zhang Jinxiang looked at each other and sighed.
"Well, you've already said that, we can't make decisions for our children.
Then when the children come back at night, I will ask them what they mean. "Zhang Lianxiang said so.
Xu Shiyan saw that the family really didn't want to see him, so don't stay here to make fun of yourself.
"That's all right, please trouble sister-in-law. It's getting late, and I have some things to go back to Yangcheng, so I won't bother you two here."
Xu Shiyan got up and walked out with Qin Shaoping.
As soon as the two of them walked out of the house, they saw someone rushing back from the outside before they walked out of the yard.
"Mom, Mom, my second sister and I have both signed up. The factory said that we should go to work the day after tomorrow."
Two girls aged eighteen or nineteen shouted as they rushed into the yard.
Xin'an Town is the county seat, very close to Shenzhen City. In a few years, this will become Xin'an Street.
There are many factories here, especially in recent years there are many foreign-funded enterprises, such as textile, electronics, plastic processing and other factories.
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan's expression changed immediately, he stopped and looked behind him.
Behind them, Zhang Lianxiang and Zhang Jinxiang, who came out to give them off, were no longer as calm as before, and their faces were flustered.
"You two are the nieces of Junyu and Junling, right? Didn't I hear that you two study well? Why don't you go to work in a factory after studying?"
Xu Shiyan glanced at the two women behind him, but he didn't get angry. Instead, he turned around and asked the two girls in a pleasant manner.
The two girls are Chu Junling from Chu Yuanchao's family and Chu Junyu from Chu Yuanlang's family. Junyu is twenty years old this year, and Junling is nineteen years old.
Junling repeated a year of study because of a transfer, so the two of them should take the college entrance examination this year.
The two girls didn't see anyone in the yard just now, they rushed in and found out.
Hearing that Xu Shiyan's accent was not local, the two of them were stunned.
"Mom, what is this?" The two girls turned to look at their mothers and asked.
"Sister-in-law, are these two nieces in the family?
Didn't you say they were on vacation and went out to play? Why did the two of them say to sign up and work in the factory? "
Xu Shiyan's face darkened, and he asked without waiting for Zhang Lianxiang and Zhang Jinxiang to answer his daughter.
Both Zhang Lianxiang and Zhang Jinxiang looked embarrassed, "Girls, if you have a high school diploma, you can find a good job.
What university do you want to take? No matter how good the exam is, won't it belong to someone else in the future? "Zhang Lianxiang muttered.
"They came down to earn money, just to pay for my younger brother to go to school, what's the matter?
In our side, it’s good for a girl who can read and recognize a few words. She’s been in high school, what else do you want? "
"Sister-in-law, didn't I just say that? If you have difficulties at home, tell me.
I can still get the money for the education of these children.
You, you don’t want to give you money, but you turn around and tell your daughter who is about to take the college entrance examination to stop studying and go to work in a factory?
What are you thinking? "Xu Shiyan was a little annoyed, what are these two women thinking about?

chapters.title: Chapter 734: study or work
chapters.content:
Chapter 734 Study or work
Before Xu Shiyan came, he was already prepared for the Chu family to curse or cry endlessly.
After all, he was the one who sent the Chu family brothers in. It is normal for the Chu family to have complaints and resentments.
Anyway, for the sake of Mr. Chu, Xu Shiyan can bear it, and he has to settle this family properly.
But when he came here, everything was unexpected.
These two girls are too weird. On the one hand, they don’t want Xu Shiyan and Qin Shaoping’s touching assistance, but on the other hand, they let the girl who is good at studying not to study, to work in a factory.
What kind of trouble is this going to be?
"Since the two nieces are good at studying, they must go to college.
They are promising after being admitted to college, and they will be able to repay the family in the future.
Yes, you can see money immediately when you enter the factory to work, but if you enter the factory, it will be like this for the rest of your life.
In the future, they will be in the factory, find someone who also works, get married and have children for the rest of their lives.
Do you think this is good? "Xu Shiyan found it difficult to understand.
If the Chu family is in trouble, why won't they accept the money he remitted earlier?
The money was quite a lot. He remitted more than 50,000 yuan back and forth. What would they do with the money?
Why don’t you want money, and at the same time let your daughter go to work in the factory? What is this thinking?
"What's wrong with that? In our hometown, women get married and have children as soon as they are seventeen or eighteen, and I haven't heard of any of them going to college.
They are doing well now, they can come out of their hometown and go to such a good place.
You can still go to high school and work in a factory to earn wages, so what else? "
Zhang Lianxiang looked puzzled, isn't this normal?
Why do women read so many books? No matter how much you read, will you not get married in the future?
How can you marry someone who also works part-time? In their hometown, they all married peasants.
Working and farming with the loess facing the loess and the sky behind the sky, isn’t that the same way of life?
"Besides, in this place, there are also many girls who don't study.
Everyone can work in the factory, why can't they? "Zhang Jinxiang also looked puzzled.
They have been here for several years, and as far as they know, the girls here are also the same.
It doesn’t matter whether you study or not, you may start a small business, or go to work in a factory.
Waiting to get old to marry and have children, isn’t that how people live?
Xu Shiyan took a deep breath. There is no need to get angry with these two women. There are differences in culture and people, and they don't understand.
"Junyu, Junling, tell your uncle honestly, do you want to study, or do you want to work in a factory?
If you two want to study, go back to school as soon as school starts. Uncle will pay for your tuition and so on.
As long as you can go to college, you will pay for all the expenses of going to college. "
The Chu family can be regarded as a well-known family of scholars handed down from generation to generation. Mr. Chu has read poetry and books, is proficient in writing and ink, and has outstanding talents.
If the old man knows this, the future generations will not even finish high school, will they panic?
Besides, it’s not that the two girls didn’t study well. They were clearly capable of going to college, but they refused to let them go. What’s the matter?
Chu Junyu and Chu Junling are just stupid there, who is this person? Why does he want us to study?
"Mom? Who is this? Is what he said true? Can you really let us both go to college?"
I have to say that although Chu Yuanchao and Chu Yuanlang are bastards, they are still very good to my daughter.
In places like the Northwest, they insist that daughters and sons go to school as well.
Later, when I got rich, I picked up the child, but still insisted on letting my daughter go to high school.
The children of the Chu family are very competitive, especially the girls, they are all strong.
A child who studies so well, can she not like studying?
So after hearing Xu Shiyan's words, the two girls both showed joy, and asked their respective mothers happily.
"What university do you want to go to? What kind of books do you study? Do you know who he is?
Your father was the one who sent him to prison. "
Zhang Lianxiang and Zhang Jinxiang were in a hurry, and they didn't care about anything at this time, and shouted directly.
Chu Junyu and Chu Junling were stunned there at that time, such a big girl, what do you not understand?
When your father was here before, what was life like at home? What kind of virtue is it now?
As long as life at home is easy, it is impossible for them to agree to go to work in the factory without studying.
It was the person in front of him who caused all this.
Although the mother had emphasized to them before, the father only went in after making a big mistake.
And my father has done a lot of things in the past few years, and sooner or later he will be exposed.
Let them stop resentment and live their lives well.
The two girls are old and sensible. They study so well. How can they not understand what is state-owned and national law?
Father did something wrong, he should pay the price, they all understand.
But if you understand it, you understand it. No matter how you understand it in your heart, seeing the person who sent their father in now, the two of them feel uncomfortable.
"You go, we don't want to study, let alone your charity."
The two of them were very uncomfortable, and finally had a hope to continue studying, but they didn't expect that they turned out to be their father's enemy.
How do they accept this?
Xu Shiyan is so tired, is this because he has met a stubborn family?
Yes, after all, there is Qiu in the middle.
He even tried to make up for it after the fact, after all the brothers from the Chu family went in, this matter was a thorn, and he panicked.
"Brother Qin, let's go, let's leave first."
Xu Shiyan sighed, turned his head to look at Qin Shaoping, and the two walked out of the Chu family helplessly.
"Then what should we do now? Their family is obviously still hostile to you, and they refuse to accept your funding."
After leaving Chu's house and walking for a while, Qin Shaoping asked.
"What can I do? You can't just watch the two girls just stop studying, can you?"
Xu Shiyan sighed, the Chu family hated him for being normal, but he couldn't watch the children stop studying.
If Elder Chu knew about this matter, how uncomfortable it would be for Elder Chu.
For Elder Chu's sake, he must find a way.
"Brother Qin, do you know which school these two girls study in? Let's go to the school and find a way."
There is only half a year left, so it’s okay to stick to finishing school anyway.
Let them take the college entrance examination, if they really fail the exam, it is fate, there is no way, why can't they just stop studying.
In the future, when the two girls look back, don't they regret it?
"I know, it's Bao'an Middle School."
Qin Shaoping nodded. He was entrusted by Xu Shiyan to follow the Chu family for almost a year, and he knew everything.
Just like that, the two went straight to Bao'an Middle School.
I came here to inquire about it and found out that the school's third year of high school will start tomorrow.
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, if it would be too troublesome to find them one by one today, why not live here today.
The school starts tomorrow, so he will go to the school to find out, and think of a way to forget it.
Qin Shaoping was busy with work and had no time to stay here with Xu Shiyan for a long time, so he left first.
Xu Shiyan stayed here and found a hotel to settle down.
Eat casually at noon, and wandered here for a long time in the afternoon, so I have a good understanding of the local area.
Stayed in the hotel for one night, and the next morning, Xu Shiyan came back to the middle school to discuss matters with the principal of the school and the class teacher of the two girls.

chapters.title: Chapter 735: Buy land and build factories
chapters.content:
Chapter 735 Buying Land and Building a Factory
The two girls, Chu Junling and Chu Junyu, are really good at studying, and they are the kind of girls who are in the top grades.
The school learned that the two girls quit their studies and went to work in the factory. The principal and teacher felt it was a pity.
So when Xu Shiyan discussed with them, he said that he was willing to sponsor the two girls to study.
I hope that the school and the teacher will do me a favor, go and persuade the Chu family's sister-in-law to let the child go back to school, and the principal and class teacher directly agreed.
Xu Shiyan discussed with others how to do it, and then the school arranged for a teacher to visit the Chu family immediately.
After the teacher arrived at Chu's house, Zhang Lianxiang and Zhang Jinxiang broke it apart and crushed it, and persuaded him a lot.
Finally, he said that the school is now funded by enterprises, and there are rewards and supports for students who study well.
Tuition fees are free, and living expenses are also subsidized.
If you can be admitted to a university, according to the level of the school, you will be given a reward of 10,000 to 30,000.
With the grades of Chu Junling and Chu Junyu, how can they get an ordinary undergraduate exam and get 10,000 yuan.
If you can get into a key university, you can get 30,000 yuan.
Zhang Lianxiang and the others were not willing to let their daughter study because they thought it was useless for her to study.
No matter how much you study, you will have to marry in the future, and you will take your in-laws with you when the time comes.
But when they heard that the study was good and they could be rewarded with money, the two of them were ready to go, and immediately agreed to let the daughter go back to school to study.
There are only a few months left. Even if the two girls go to work in the factory, they will only earn two to three hundred yuan a month.
But if you insist on finishing your studies in the past few months, if you are admitted to university, the minimum is 10,000.
None of them are fools, can this account be settled?
Just like that, the two girls returned to school on the afternoon of the first day of school.
In order to prevent the two of them from going home and being brainwashed by their mother, the teacher simply said, let’s live on campus.
Anyway, the school has a dormitory, and all living expenses are covered, so you can attend classes at school with peace of mind.
If there is anything you don’t know, the teacher is always there, so you can ask anytime.
The two girls really love to study, it is better to live in a dormitory, and there are not so many worries.
If they are at home, they have to help with the housework and disturb their studies.
Just like that, the two girls agreed, and they lived in the school and studied with peace of mind.
Xu Shiyan came over, after all, Chu Junyu and Chu Junling were settled, so it was not in vain.
As for the three children of the Chu family, Chu Jundong and Chu Junping are two boys, one in the first year of high school and one in the second year of high school, and the little girl is in the second year of junior high school.
These few of them are fine for the time being, as long as the two big ones can be admitted to university, it will be easy to talk about later.
Several children are studying in Bao'an Middle School. Xu Shiyan has contacted the principal this time, and he can control the situation of the children at any time in the future.
So Xu Shiyan left Bao'an with peace of mind and returned to Yangcheng.
He was in Bao'an for a few days, and Su Anying's side has already started selling goods.
As for Xu Shiqin, he still couldn't find a place he wanted.
"What if you go to the vicinity of Shenzhen City? I just came back from there, and it's not bad."
Xu Shiyan thought about it, in fact, Xin'an Town is not bad, the location is good, it is close to Shenzhen City.
After a few years, it will become a municipal district, and the land price must not rise wildly?
Now I used to buy land and build a factory, and then I can make a lot of money if I don’t do anything in the future.
Xu Shiqin has always obeyed what the third brother said, and when Xu Shiyan said that, she also became energetic.
"Oh, look, I would have followed you if I knew you were going there.
Then wait for tomorrow, and the third brother will accompany me to go around again? "
"Okay, then I'll accompany you on an expiry trip tomorrow, and if you fancy a place, just find someone to buy it.
If you don’t have enough money, ask your third sister-in-law to lend you some, or it’s okay if we don’t count our shares. "
Xu Shiyan is optimistic about the land here, but he doesn't have so much energy to manage it.
If you can partner with Xu Shiqin to open a factory, don't care how much the factory earns, as long as the land is worth a lot in the future.
"The money is enough. I have earned a lot in the past few years. However, if the third sister-in-law can get a share, then I am very happy."
Xu Shiqin laughed when he heard the words, she and Su Anying got along well, and the sister-in-law and sister-in-law started some business together, which was very good.
So, the brothers and sisters negotiated properly.
Xu Shiyan accompanied Xu Shiqin back to Bao'an again. After wandering here for a few days, he was really optimistic about a piece of land.
So I found the relevant person in charge and talked about buying land and building a factory.
Some people here are here to build factories, and they don't care, as long as they can afford the money, the procedures are very easy to handle.
The housing prices in Bao'an these days are not too expensive. In 1991, Shuanglong Garden in Xin'an Town was 1,600 yuan per square meter, and Bihai Garden was 1,500 yuan per square meter.
It is said that in 1986, it was only 400 yuan per level.
Industrial land is much cheaper than commercial housing land, so Xu Shiqin spent less than one million to buy a large piece of land.
Xu Shiqin has great trust in the vision of the third brother, and she also feels that there will be great development prospects here in the future.
So I plan to develop well here and build a large garment processing factory.
The contract is signed, the land is bought, and the next step is to build a factory.
Xu Shiqin saw that if the factory was built, she probably wouldn't be able to go back to Guangshui for a long time.
Just staying in a hotel is not cost-effective, so I simply spent money to buy a house here to live in.
The next step is to run at both ends.
As for Han Liwei, the children in the family are taken care of by a nanny, and Xu Shiqin goes back to live for a while.
No way, since you want to develop your career, you must sacrifice time with your family.
Xu Shiyan came to Yangcheng, and there was one more thing, he planned to register an import and export company in Hong Kong City.
Next, he wants to do flooring business, import production equipment from abroad, and export finished flooring abroad.
It will be much more convenient if you register an import and export company in Hong Kong.
Taking advantage of Xu Shiqin's busy time here, Xu Shiyan went to Hong Kong City after completing the formalities, consulted there clearly, and then came back.
Professional matters must be left to professional people.
Xu Shiyan is not good at these things, he plans to go back and send people from the company's legal department.
It just so happens that there are still many products to be registered for patents this year, and the company is also registered at the same time, killing two birds with one stone.
Xu Shiyan has been in Yangcheng for half a month, and has finished all the things that should be done. There is no further delay, so he has to go back quickly.
"Daughter-in-law, I've been out for a long time, and there are a lot of things at home.
Since everything here is done, I have to go back tomorrow. "Xu Shiyan discussed with Su Anying.
"Well, let's go back, the family is important.
Don't worry on my side, anyway, I don't stock up too much, I just keep circulating these in my hand.
Recently, this product is not very easy to sell. Didn’t you see that there are more hotels in Northeast China? Many of them are from our county.
I inquired, and most of them are some enterprise units.
They got their own ginseng mallets, but last autumn the market was not good and they didn’t sell them.
I don’t know why I heard about this seller, so I’m here. "
Su Anying couldn't help but sigh as she spoke.
"It doesn't matter who comes, they are very careless, and the price is several dollars lower than ours.
These days they have been agitated, and the goods are selling very slowly.
Let me take a look. If the market is not good, I will go home after dealing with these things. "
It’s like this no matter what you do, and I’m most afraid that a swarm of bees will come to **** it.
It would be okay if the rules were followed, but these people are not following the rules and lowering prices indiscriminately.

chapters.title: Chapter 736: various measures
chapters.content:
Chapter 736 Measures
"It's okay, these people won't be jumping around for a few days, someone will clean them up, don't worry."
Xu Shiyan had already guessed that such a time would come.
Those units invested money and planted mallets regardless of the cost in the past few years, but the market suddenly fell, and they pressed a large number of goods in their hands, and there were still a lot of frozen, newly planted, and planted seeds in the ground.
How about not deal with it outside as soon as possible?
Xu Shiyan said before that it has never been ordinary farmers who really stir up the market.
Participating in agriculture is a few tens of feet a year, at most no more than a hundred feet, which has little impact on the overall situation.
The most influential people are these people. They use the money from the public, and they fall into the sky all at once.
In the past, when the market was good, it was good to make money. Now that the market is bad, in order to get back the funds as soon as possible, don’t you have to rush out at any cost?
It is these people who need to be cleaned up the most.
"What's the matter? What are you doing again? Don't mess with those things, when the time comes, people won't scold you behind your back?"
Su Anying was quite angry just now, thinking that those people mixed up the market.
The price of this ginseng was already low enough, and it was impossible to watch them stir it up again.
But when she heard Xu Shiyan's words at this time, she became worried again. If Xu Shiyan gave another idea, wouldn't she offend someone again?
"Don't worry about those people, anyway, our store will open this fall, and we will put all our mallets here for retail and small wholesale.
In the future, you will be in charge of the stall in your unit. I look at the processing plant and the store here. We all make a lot of money. Why bother to get angry with these people? "
Su Anying is very clear that although Xu Shiyan has developed very well these years and has been promoted step by step, the leaders above also value him.
But in fact, it also offended many people.
She was just worried that if Xu Shiyan did something that touched other people's interests, would they be able to secretly make harm and recruit black hands to deceive Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan smiled, and hugged his wife.
"It's okay, it's not what I want to do, it's because the higher-ups want to clean up the chaotic business."
Today's Fusong ginseng industry should be thoroughly rectified.
When eating with Guan Enxue, Chang Hongfa and others that day, Xu Shiyan heard this meaning.
Guan Enxue is very courageous and tough, as you can see from his two years of working in the city.
Although Guan Enxue is not the top leader now, he is in charge of all affairs in the city.
During dinner that day, Guan Enxue was very interested in the measures Xu Shiyan proposed, and kept saying that Xu Shiyan should write a report quickly.
Xu Shiyan agreed at the time, and also told Guan Enxue that there is no need to rush.
Wait for him to go to Yangcheng, and then go to understand the market, and then talk about it when he comes back.
Xu Shiyan came here this time, not only to visit Qin Shaoping and others, he went to Hong Kong City a few days ago and spent a long time there.
Understand the market, and also met some old customers who participated in the exhibition, and had in-depth discussions with them.
So Xu Shiyan now has a detailed understanding of the international market for ginseng and ginseng products.
After he goes back and completes the report, he can submit it.
Seeing this, Su Anying knew that she couldn't stop her husband, so she could only tell Xu Shiyan to be careful and not to be too sharp.
The couple chatted for half the night, and Xu Shiyan flew back the next day.
On February 20th, the 25th day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan returned to Donggang.
The driver picked him up at the train station, but Xu Shiyan didn't even go home and went straight to work.
As soon as he arrived at the unit, Xu Shiyan hurriedly wrote a report.
Comprehensively integrated the new ideas of this trip to Yangcheng, together with the methods proposed in the previous two times, I wrote a very long report.
After the report was written, it was submitted to Guan Enxue. After reading it, Guan Enxue thought it was very good, so he handed it to the province.
"President Xu, this is a document jointly issued by the province, the city, and the county."
About half a month later, the secretary handed a stack of documents to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan looked through it, and the top one was "Notice on Some Pesticides Banned on Ginseng".
The notice requires that all townships and state-owned ginseng farms strictly prohibit the use of HCH, DDT, chlordane, pentachloronitrobenzene, Xinshi (red alum), phorate (3911), Tianan, and chlorofuran in the process of ginseng planting. Pesticides such as Dan, Dixad, Quickkilled, Zinc Phosphide, Tuzet, and Trithion.
For ginseng production units and individual ginseng operators who continue to use the above-mentioned pesticides, the allocation of ginseng land will be stopped, and ginseng production licenses will not be issued.
Since then, low pesticide residue ginseng has been developed in an all-round way.
The second document is a notice to comprehensively control the area of ​​participating land.
The notice made it clear that the structure should be adjusted, moderate-scale operations should be gradually implemented, and ginseng per unit yield, returning ginseng to forests, and ginseng land allocation should be linked.
Ginseng yields per square meter of less than 1.5 kg, ginseng returned to the forest did not meet the requirements, will no longer be allocated ginseng land.
Further implement the principles of reducing area, adjusting scale, and controlling development.
Determine the annual approval system for participating in land use, and no longer allow enterprises and institutions to approve participating land.
The third document, from now on, implement the qualification examination and approval system for all persons participating in labor, trafficking, and business operations, and issue business licenses to those who meet the requirements.
Those who do not meet the conditions will not be approved and issued, and they will not be allowed to engage in large-scale labor participation, trafficking, and business activities. Once discovered, they will be severely punished.
The fourth document is to establish a new ginseng franchise system in an all-round way.
County and city special product management departments have strengthened industry license management for ginseng planting and processing.
Designate people with business licenses to participate in factories, ginseng companies, ginseng companies, foreign trade companies, medicinal materials companies, and county (community) grass-roots supply and marketing cooperatives with ginseng business licenses as franchise units, and the franchise units are responsible for purchasing water ginseng.
Through these issued documents, establish a ginseng reserve system, regulate the market in a planned way, and implement unified pricing in circulation.
Mainly adopt the ginseng monopoly method of production, purchase, processing, price and sales management.
Strictly implement the sales price set by the province. Any product that is lower than the sales price will not be released with a transportation certificate.
Punish the market-disturbing behavior.
At the same time, encourage all towns and towns to actively establish ginseng production and management cooperatives, so that ginseng farmers can unite and enhance their ability to resist risks.
For the farmers who join the cooperative, the superiors can give various preferential treatment.
"It can be seen that the higher authorities have made up their minds this time to rectify the local ginseng industry.
I just don’t know if it can really be implemented. "
Li Bingzhuo and others are all in Xu Shiyan's office. The big guys flipped through those documents and exclaimed to each other.
"Yes, the idea above is good, but I don't know if these people below can abide by it.
I hope it works. If these measures don't work, then there is no hope for the ginseng industry in our county. "
Xu Shiyan sighed, in fact, he wrote more than these.
It is estimated that the leader saw that other suggestions were difficult to implement, so he did not adopt them.
Forget it, he has already put forward all the suggestions he can think of, how much can be adopted by the higher authorities, how much can be implemented, and how strong the implementation is, he can't interfere with this.
Now, Shenye Company is also a mud bodhisattva crossing the river, and he can't protect himself, so he should look at his eyes first.

chapters.title: Chapter 737: seize the opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 737 Seize the opportunity
"Leave these things alone, anyway, our company has the right to independently manage exports, and these terms are beyond our control."
Xu Shiyan put those documents aside, looked up at Li Bingzhuo and others.
"The most important thing right now is the future development of our company.
As of now, our foreign trade orders this year are 40% less than the same period last year.
That is to say, many of those old customers are still waiting to see, or they may not have the idea of ​​cooperation this year. "
Xu Shiyan took out a report and showed it to Li Bingzhuo and the others.
"This is what we should be most concerned about now.
Last year, orders did not decrease too much, mainly because people have already paid the deposit.
If they cancel the order, they will lose a lot. They have no choice but to continue to execute the previous contract.
But this year it is obvious that the willingness of foreign businessmen to place orders is not high.
If this situation continues, I think our company's benefits this year may drop significantly. "
Xu Shiyan sighed, barely passed the test last year, and in the next few years, I'm afraid it will be more difficult every year.
"General manager, colleagues in the sales department have contacted most of the customers, but the main problem is the price.
Now that the US dollar has appreciated in value, it is now 4.78 cents for 1 US dollar. Last year it was 3.76 cents.
Businessmen feel that if the prices of previous years are still maintained, they will lose money, so they are all waiting and watching. "
This, Li Chengrong and the others also thought of it. The people in the sales department are actively contacting old customers recently.
"No way, since last year, all industries have experienced a cold winter.
In fact, not only ginseng in our county, but also various domestic enterprises have experienced a process from overheating to sudden cooling.
The economy is sluggish, and many domestic commodities are backlogged, and the phenomenon of triangular debts of various units is particularly serious.
This is good for our company, except that some raw materials and packaging are purchased from outside, and the others are supplied by ourselves.
Sales mostly point to exports, so they are not dragged down by the triangular debt. "
Li Chengrong is now in charge of the market. He works very hard. He collects and sorts out information on the development of various industries at home and abroad.
"Not to mention anything else, the Qishi Fular Heavy Machinery Factory was forced to suspend production last year because of the triangular debt.
Anshan Iron and Steel Company can only mobilize employees to raise funds because there is no money in the account and no coal in the warehouse.
There are still many factories that have been closed because of this.
The domestic economic situation is not good, the currency has depreciated, and now they are rushing to export, but exporting is not easy. "
"General manager, I think it may be imperative to lower the price.
If the price is lowered, those old customers should be able to retain some of them. If the price is not lowered, I am afraid that these customers will be lost. "
Li Chengrong has studied with the people under him for a long time, and feels that there is really no way to break the situation now.
"No, lowering the price is the worst way. Once the price drops, it will be difficult to raise it later."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, the price cannot be lowered easily.
Currently, the appreciation ratio of US dollars is not too large. If the price is lowered now, what should we do later?
"How about this, you take the people from the sales department to calculate the cost for me.
See what kind of promotional discounts are more reasonable on the basis of maintaining the original price.
For example, buy 10 get 1 free, buy 8 get 1 free, buy 5 get 1 free, and see which one can satisfy foreign customers at the current exchange rate without us suffering too much. "
Without reducing the price, we can only adopt other promotional methods.
No way, the current economic situation.
If you want to make a way out of this situation and ensure the normal operation of the company, you can only make a little concession.
"In addition, the method of last year is still adopted. In addition to giving away the same product, we will also give away the new product we are going to launch this year.
If the customer wants to hold any promotional activities, we will try our best to cooperate, and we must capture all the existing old customers, so as not to let these people lose. "
Thanks to the participation of people from the Ginseng Research Institute, the development of new products has been accelerated, and they can take out the new products that were previously reserved.
Now I can’t take care of so much, let’s stabilize this year’s orders first.
"Okay, then I will take someone to do the accounting, and then contact the customer."
Li Chengrong nodded, there is no other good way at the moment.
"The Spring Fair is coming soon, and this year's new products can only bring a few more, let's try the effect.
In addition, I want to bring the medicine from the pharmaceutical factory, try it, I don’t know if it will work. "
In this situation, everyone is panicking, and Xu Shiyan is no exception.
The medicines produced by pharmaceutical factories currently only have domestic drug certification procedures, which are not recognized in many countries.
Drugs that are not certified by foreign countries, especially Europe and the United States, can generally only be sold in the category of health care products.
This is where traditional Chinese medicine suffers, and it is also the reason why Fusong Pharmaceutical Factory brings its products to the Spring Fair every year, but fails to sell too many products every year.
Only Hong Kong, Taiwan, Dongyi, and South Korea will buy in small quantities.
“This year, we will build another cosmetics factory to produce the products I mentioned before.
This must be independent and cannot be mixed with the original factory.
In addition to this, we will also establish a joint venture with other investors to build a flooring factory and a health care product factory. "
Xu Shiyan flipped through the lists in his hand, and took out a plan.
"Health care product factory, mainly for domestic use, the formula is authorized by our company, using independent trademarks and packaging.
In the past two years, health care products have become popular in China, and we must not miss this opportunity. "
This was Xu Shiyan's idea when he was helping Xu Shiqin buy land in Bao'an.
There are actually many reasons for choosing to make health products at this time.
One of the more important reasons is that they are afraid that the Chinese will follow suit.
At present, Dongfang Ginseng Company is able to maintain its current income despite the bleak overall situation of the ginseng industry, relying on the deep processing of products and the registration of foreign patents in advance.
But there is one thing. Patent protection is only useful abroad, and domestically it doesn’t pay much attention to it.
Before, they were all focused on the export, and it was useless to follow suit. Foreigners only recognize those with patents, and those who do not have patents cannot sell them.
Now the export is sluggish, and the domestic health care products industry has begun to rise.
At this time, I am afraid that someone will focus on these products of Shenye Company, and they will not export them, but instead operate domestically.
Anyway, the price of ginseng raw materials in China is so low now, it is definitely not a loss to mix it in.
Imitate the products of the participating company, and others will follow suit, and then sell them in the country. What else can Xu Shiyan or the participating company do with others?
This kind of thing will definitely happen. Instead of letting others take the lead, it is better for them to take this step first.
Instead of building a local factory, choose another location, register a trademark separately, redesign the packaging, and appear in front of the Chinese people with a brand-new look.
From now to 1995 and 1996, it is the golden period for the development of domestic health care products. Taking advantage of this trend, first earn money and then talk.

chapters.title: Chapter 738: strong support
chapters.content:
Chapter 738 Great support
The domestic health care products industry has always been criticized.
The main problem is the overwhelming brainwashing advertising and marketing.
Those companies that produce health care products do not pay attention to product research and development at all, but blindly advertise, resulting in false prosperity of health care products.
Therefore, most of the companies that make health care products do not have a good reputation.
Xu Shiyan wanted to get involved in this industry a long time ago, but he has always been scrupled in many aspects, so he has never been able to take real action.
But now, I can't take care of that much anymore.
If you want to fight your way out of the current predicament, health care products may be a sharp weapon to break the situation.
The health care products that Xu Shiyan thinks are different from the health care products that will be popular in the next few years.
He mainly wants to make some of the products currently exported into domestic versions.
These are market-proven, quality-guaranteed products.
They do it with real materials, even if it is advertising, it is only a necessary marketing tool.
The factory should not be located in the northeast, but in the south.
Xu Shiyan thinks that Bao'an is very good. Taking advantage of the fact that the land is not expensive now, he also bought a large piece of land to build a factory.
Waiting to get through the low period of ginseng in the past few years. If the health care product factory develops well, it will continue to produce and gradually transform to pharmaceuticals.
If the development is poor, you can directly change hands and sell the land, and you can earn a lot of money, which is not a loss no matter what.
Even if someone follows suit, they have already made money, so there is nothing to be afraid of.
Besides, the products they produce must be mainly ginseng.
Don’t others follow suit and buy raw materials from the place of origin? Anyway, it can be regarded as finding a way out for local ginseng.
"No matter what the general manager arranges, we will completely obey. You just say what to do, what to do, and we will obey the general manager's orders."
Xu Shiyan is responsible for the general direction and overall planning of the company's development, and other people are responsible for the specific implementation. It's as simple as that.
Li Bingzhuo and others are all loyal supporters of Xu Shiyan, and they fully support what Xu Shiyan wants to do.
"Okay, then take a moment, let's have another meeting to discuss."
At present, the company has sufficient funds, and it is easy to do something.
As long as the plan is made, what should be done, don't hesitate too much.
"First prepare the products we are going to participate in the Spring Fair, and don't worry about other things."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, signaling the end of the meeting, and everyone can do what they should do.
After the meeting, Xu Shiyan made a detailed plan for what he just said.
While writing something, the phone rang.
"Shiyan, have you seen all the documents?" On the other end of the phone was Guan Enxue.
"I see, thank the leader for trusting, I didn't expect to really accept my opinion." Xu Shiyan smiled.
"I just don't know if these measures will be useful, and I hope they will have some effect."
"There will definitely be an effect, but it will take time, and it also depends on the strength of the implementation.
I will personally handle this matter, so you can rest assured.
Anyway, I am already this age, how many more years can I work? I am not afraid of offending people.
In my tenure, the ginseng industry must be reversed and must not continue to decline. "
Guan Enxue's resolute and serious voice came from the phone.
"Well, it is a blessing to have you as a leader."
Xu Shiyan admired Guan Enxue, he is really knowledgeable and skilled, much better than Chang Hongfa.
"Okay, don't put a high hat on me there.
I’m calling to ask you, the Spring Fair is not far away, how are your preparations going?
This year can be said to be a last-ditch battle, and you must show some real skills on the other side. "
It is not an exaggeration for Guan Enxue to say this. This is the first time for a ginseng company to participate in the Spring Fair after the price of ginseng plummeted.
The amount of this order is of great significance, and will be the weather vane for the development of Changbai Mountain ginseng this autumn.
The city attaches great importance to this, otherwise Guan Enxue would not call to ask about it in person.
"Back to the leader, everything that needs to be prepared has been prepared, and several new products have been added this year. I plan to bring the medicines from the pharmaceutical factory to try.
Waiting for next year, maybe you can send cosmetics there for a try. "
The construction plan of the daily chemical factory has been reported a long time ago, and the superior has already approved that the factory is allowed to be built and produced, and all the procedures have been approved.
But the climate here is not good, and the land has not fully melted at this time, so there is no way to build a factory.
So this year I will definitely not be able to make it in time to participate in the Spring Fair, and it is estimated that I will be able to do it next year.
"Okay, okay, as long as you have the money, you don't have to worry about funds for building factories.
I have already applied to the province to grant your company a special low-interest loan of 20 million yuan, with a five-year period, for the construction of the factory.
You can do it with confidence and boldness, tell me what is missing, and I will do it for you. "
Dongfang Ginseng Company is the vanguard of ginseng industry development in Kyrgyzstan.
Not to mention anything else, how many ideas did Xu Shiyan give the higher-ups? How much profit and tax was created? The higher-ups must also express it.
"Oh, thank you so much for the leader.
In addition to launching a daily chemical factory this year, I also have a flooring factory. It is true that the funds are not sufficient. With this money, there will be no problem. "
The flooring factory will be a joint venture with the Forestry Bureau. This is local, and it must not be hidden.
But at the health care product factory, Xu Shiyan planned to bring his wife to join forces with Su Anying.
It's about various formulas, so it's really uneasy to cooperate with others, and you have to have your own daughter-in-law.
Besides, the situation in the past two years has not been very good, and the development of private enterprises has been restricted. It is better to join hands, which is equivalent to supporting his daughter-in-law and holding an umbrella.
Since he brought his own wife with him and built a factory in the south, then it is not easy to make a public announcement about it, so we can't talk about it for the time being.
The construction plan of the daily chemical factory has been handed in long ago, but the floor factory is still in the negotiation stage, and the higher-ups don't know about it.
So when Guan Enxue heard this, he immediately became happy, "You boy, you really can surprise me everywhere.
Well, hand over your proposal, and I'll take a look for you. If there are any discounts here, I'll do my best. "
In the eyes of Guan Enxue, Xu Shiyan is a cash cow and a cornucopia, which must be coaxed.
"Oh, by the way, the Provincial Ginseng Technology Development Board wants to hire you as the leader of the expert group.
The other side was afraid of your rejection, so they entrusted me to be a lobbyist. How are you? Any ideas? "
Guan Enxue suddenly remembered this, and hurriedly told Xu Shiyan.
"Huh? The leader of the expert team? Me? Can I do it?" Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it.
"Then why not? I think it works, there is no problem at all.
You just accept it with peace of mind, it’s not a bad thing anyway, right? "Guan Enxue also laughed on the other end of the phone.
At present, there are really not many people in the province who are better than Xu Shiyan in participating in the industry.
Based on his qualifications, there is no problem at all as the leader of the expert group.
"Success, since the leader said it's okay, then I have the cheek to agree?"
Actually, these are just titles. At most, they give lectures every year. When someone applies for technical appraisal, they review and give an opinion. There is not much work.
Since you have the face of Guan Enxue, then agree to come down, anyway, you can't lose a piece of meat.
Sudden headache, really can't write, only three shifts.
I woke up yesterday morning with a headache and a cough. I thought it was a cold, so I took some cold medicine. I stopped coughing during the day, but my head still hurts, and the right side hurts from the forehead to the back of the head.
I don’t know if it’s because I feel uncomfortable after taking the cold medicine or something. Anyway, I feel dizzy, flustered, weak hands and feet, and nausea during the day. The headache persisted, and the medicine didn't help. I insisted on writing three chapters, and I couldn't stand it.
Currently, my body temperature is normal, but I feel flustered and uncomfortable when I lie down, plus I have a headache. I don't know what's going on, I'm so worried.

chapters.title: Chapter 739: Two-pronged approach
chapters.content:
Chapter 739 Two-pronged approach
Xu Shiyan accepted the task of the leader of the expert group.
Within a few days, the provincial ginseng technology development board sent someone over to meet with Xu Shiyan, and delivered the letter of appointment to Xu Shiyan.
From then on, Xu Shiyan got another title.
Li Chengrong led the sales department to do a lot of work, and finally decided that buying six and getting one free is a more reasonable promotion method at present.
After Xu Shiyan agreed, Li Chengrong led the sales department to contact the old customers and offered to propose this year's preferential policies.
Some people don’t understand well, so the sales department will calculate it carefully for them and explain it clearly.
How strong is the discount, how much profit does the merchant make when selling, and so on.
Not to mention, this trick is quite effective, and most of the old customers who are still waiting and watching have placed orders.
The customer who originally placed an order also added an order.
Especially for several products that were given as gifts last year, there are also many orders.
In this way, before going to the Spring Fair, the company received a lot of foreign trade orders.
Guan Enxue was very happy when he heard the news, and praised Xu Shiyan.
At the same time, the above also approved the site selection request for the flooring factory.
The flooring factory is a joint venture between the ginseng company and the Forestry Bureau, and the factory must not be located in Donggang.
In order to facilitate transportation, the address was chosen on the outskirts of Songjiang River, a place called Triangular Line.
It is west of the train station, very close to the train station.
At present, the transportation of large quantities of goods in China mainly refers to railways.
The factory is selected here, and a section of track can be connected to the factory. When the time comes, the truck will come directly, and it will be more convenient for loading and delivery.
For this factory, the county and the city have been arguing for a few days, mainly to fight over the ownership of the factory.
The county is afraid that the city will be crossed again, and become a city-owned enterprise. The city really has this idea.
Because everyone now knows that most factories are very profitable after Xu Shiyan's hands.
The two sides argued for a while, because the land was under the jurisdiction of the county, and finally the factory was confirmed, and it was also under the jurisdiction of the county, and the profits and taxes would go to the county in the future.
Xu Shiyan doesn't care who owns the factory, he only cares about how big the discount is.
Chang Hongfa of the county agreed, saying that the factory will be exempted from tax for the first three years, and the profit and tax will also be discounted later.
This is not bad, Xu Shiyan and Guo Shouye are very happy.
The new factory has just been built, so it’s hard to say what the specific benefits are. There are three-year discounts, and it’s good to develop slowly.
After confirming the site of the flooring factory, the preliminary planning and design began.
Guo Shouye selected a few cadres and a few technicians from the plywood factory of the Forestry Bureau, and took them abroad for inspection.
Currently the best machine for tongue and groove floor is West Germany.
Xu Shiyan has already contacted the other side, and also told the other party about his request.
Right now parquet has not yet appeared.
But composite flooring is similar to the second half of the current production of pure solid wood flooring, such as sanding, tenoning, oiling, painting, and packaging.
Mainly related processes such as planing, rotary cutting, core board, press, etc. This is similar to the plywood factory, many processes and machines are interlinked.
Don’t underestimate Guo Shouye, he is an old man in the Forestry Bureau. He also started as an apprentice back then. He has done everything and knows everything about it.
Speaking of it, Guo Shouye is actually better than Xu Shiyan in this respect.
Xu Shiyan can only provide ideas. In terms of technology, Guo Shouye has to come.
This is also the reason why Guo Shouye led the team to investigate.
Everything is going on normally at the flooring factory, and Xu Shiyan also privately talked to Guan Enxue about the health care product factory.
Guan Enxue was puzzled by Xu Shiyan's choice.
"Shiyan, why do you have to send the health care product factory to the south?
There are plenty of places here, tell me where do you want? I will give you where you want, why are you running so far? "
It is still too late to attract investment, so Xu Shiyan wants to go a long way to build a good factory elsewhere.
Guan Enxue felt that he could not understand. If there is a factory with good profits, which can drive a lot of money, how can Guan Enxue let go?
"Leader, I just want to separate this factory from my current company and not be in the same place.
Not to mention not being in the same city, it is not good to be in the same province.
If people know about this, while I am exporting, the things I sell to foreign merchants will be extremely expensive. At the same time, the domestic market is also available, and the price is low.
Can my export business continue? "Xu Shiyan smiled wryly, and had no choice but to explain to Guan Enxue.
There must be differences between exported products and domestic products.
Just like the beverage factory before, why didn’t he produce ginseng cola and ginseng flower cola in China?
The Holy Mountain Tianquan, why is it not sold in China? There are many aspects to this.
Currently, where is the consumption power in China, things that are too high-end can’t be sold, even health care products, who will buy them if they are too expensive?
After a few years, when the domestic economy improves, people have money and can afford high-end luxury goods, it will definitely be different.
Don't say he is too realistic, the businessman himself has to be realistic, the first point is to make money.
The two factories are thousands of miles apart, and they have nothing to do with each other on the surface.
Even if someone finds out that there are similar or similar products over there, most people will only think that someone deliberately imitated the company.
No one would have thought that it was actually made by the participation company itself.
One of the two sides focuses on export, and the other focuses on domestic, without interfering with each other, both sides can earn money, isn’t that great?
Wait for a few years, after this period of trough has passed.
The heat of the health care product market has faded. When the factory wants to transform, it can still use the name of cooperation or acquisition to take the opportunity to let the health care product factory make a gorgeous turn.
People without long-term considerations must have near-term worries. What should be considered must be considered in advance, and all aspects must be considered, otherwise it will be troublesome sooner or later.
"Leader, this matter is a secret, you have to keep it secret for me."
Actually, it’s the same thing if it’s kept secret or not. There are accounts between the two sides, and the relevant agencies will know it after checking.
