But to the outside world, it must be kept secret, and no outsiders should know, otherwise there will be too much trouble.
After listening to Xu Shiyan's explanation, Guan Enxue understood somewhat.
It’s just a pity in my heart. If all of these are placed in this city, wouldn’t there be another factory that makes money?
But Guan Enxue has always trusted Xu Shiyan. He believes that Xu Shiyan must have his reasons for doing so.
So he didn't say anything else, he just told Xu Shiyan that everything should be safe, and don't play too hard and make trouble.
The main thing is to leave the province, even if they want to take care of them, they can't take care of them.
"Leader, don't worry, everything has been arranged over there. My wife has already chosen the factory site over there, and the first installment of the money has also been paid."
Su Anying was originally in Yangcheng, but this spring this product is not easy to sell, the price is too bad.
After finally throwing out the goods in her hand, Su Anying followed Xu Shiyan's intention and went to Bao'an to find Xu Shiqin.
Under Xu Shiqin's guidance, Su Anying also chose a larger piece of land there.
Directly signed an agreement with the relevant local authorities, bought the land, and started building the factory.

chapters.title: Chapter 740: competition training
chapters.content:
Chapter 740 Competition Training
The climate in Baoan is good, unlike the north, where you have to wait for the thaw to do anything.
It’s just late March, and in the northeast, it’s freezing outside during the day and at night, so there’s no way to do construction.
Su Anying's side has already completed the on-site measurement, planning and design, and broke ground.
But for such a large project, it is obviously not enough to just point to the women Su Anying and Ji Yufeng.
Xu Shiyan has already sent several competent people from the company, together with Ji Tongzhong, Nan Zhendong, Zhou Qingjie and others, to help build the factory as soon as possible.
Now, Su Anying and the others don't want to go back to the Northeast for a while.
Zhou Guilan knew about it, so she couldn't help talking about it.
"Tell me about you, have a good time, but why do you have to send your wife so far away?
Which family lives, the couple are not together for years and months? Isn't this nonsense? "
Back when Su Anying was going to sell goods in Yangcheng, Xu Chenghou and his wife were worried.
At any rate, I will go there for two or three months. Now, let’s build a factory over there, so Su Anying must stay in the south forever?
What is this called?
"There is also the sixth child, wouldn't it be great to have a factory over there in Guangshui?
Go to Bao'an to build a factory, abandon their family and business, and don't even care about their children.
Liwei is able to get used to her. If it were a different person, wouldn't he be impatient? "
As soon as it was mentioned, Zhou Guilan became angry.
The daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law in the family have all grown up, and each individual has not learned, but has learned to leave her husband and children to develop a career.
Isn't this nonsense? Is career more important than family?
Zhou Guilan is still old-fashioned, and always feels that women still have to take care of the family.
Like Su Anying and Xu Shiqin, running outside all day without caring about their families is not the way to live.
"Mom, I can be busy these days.
After the factory is completed and put into production, we will hire a cultured factory manager to manage it, and then we will not be so busy. "
What can Xu Shiyan say? Mom is also for the good of the family.
But there is really no way right now, unless the two of them are hanging around at home and waiting to die, otherwise they have to do something.
"I'll go to the Spring Fair in a few days, and I'll go there early, won't I be able to see Yingzi?
Besides, we are both old couples, and Haiyuan is thirteen this year, so how can we stick together all day long? "
Xu Shiyan really wanted to be clingy with his wife, isn't it all right now?
The store in Yangcheng should be cleaned up in a while, and the store will open first in autumn.
The factory is estimated to have winter, so it can just stock up a batch of raw materials and start production.
At the other end of the store, Ji Tongzhong and his wife were in charge.
Waiting for the training of all the shop assistants, and selecting two shop managers, basically you can let go, and just watch it twice a year.
When the factory is completed, a few serious, responsible and capable people will be transferred from the pharmaceutical factory to take charge of daily production, and financial personnel will be arranged to manage the accounts.
Su Anying has the name of the general manager, and stays there for a long time every autumn and winter, and usually goes to visit occasionally.
After the factory gets on the right track, it will not be so busy.
"Anyway, you are right, I don't bother to tell you, I'll pack up the food, and Yuan Yuan will be hungry when he comes back."
Zhou Guilan couldn't say no to her son, so she left angrily and went to the kitchen to cook.
Xu Shiyan glanced at the wall, "That's not right, didn't Yuanyuan leave school at five o'clock? Why didn't you go home after half past five?"
He has lived in the unit again for a while, and it is rare to come back.
The three children who are in elementary school have already returned home from school, what is the boss doing?
Junior high school is only five minutes away from home, why haven't you come back after half an hour?
"Dad, my brother was selected by the teacher to participate in the competition. I heard that there are several subjects, including mathematics, English, geography, and biology.
He doesn't have time to go to Grandpa Han to practice martial arts now, and he goes to school at 5:30 in the morning.
I also went early at noon, and the self-study class in the afternoon was taken up by English, and I had to add an hour of math class after school. "
Xu Jinping, who was reading over there, sighed, dropped the book in her hand, and explained.
"Dad, how long have you been home? You don't even know that my brother participated in competition training."
There was a bit of sadness in the little girl's tone.
Mom went to the South and didn’t come back for a long time, and Dad didn’t see anyone at work for ten and a half months.
Thanks to the few of them, they are still worry-free. If this is replaced by a worry-free one, I don’t know what it will be.
"Competition? Oh, I see, it's the subject competition for junior high school students, right?"
Xu Shiyan slapped his forehead and remembered that his eldest daughter also participated in these in his previous life.
Isn’t the Olympiad very popular in recent years? Both high school and junior high school.
High school students can participate in the national competition and then select how many to participate in the world competition.
Junior high school students can only participate in the national competition, not the world competition.
Normally speaking, the Olympiad consists of three subjects of mathematics, physics and chemistry, and biology and computer were added later.
It is estimated that in order to cultivate children's interest in learning and select students, there are competitions in all subjects in junior high school, and it starts from the first day of junior high school.
As soon as the second semester of the first year of junior high school starts, teachers of various subjects begin to select candidates, attend intensive training, and wait until the end of June to take the unified examination in the county or city.
How to say, Donggang Junior High School, the teacher's strength is not very good, I have never heard of how many awards have been awarded over the years.
But the teacher is keen on competition training.
The teachers these days are really good, they don’t charge any fees, and they are diligent every day to give their children make-up lessons.
I hope that some of the students under my hand will win the prize.
"Well, I heard from my brother that this is it.
They are robbing teachers of all subjects. My brother didn't have so much time, so he only took these four subjects. "
Xu Jinping nodded, cooperating with her father to know.
In the first grade of junior high school, there are mathematics, English, Chinese, politics, history, geography, and biology, and then there are competitions in each subject.
Even Chinese, there are composition competitions.
Xu Haiyuan studies well, and his grades in all subjects are among the best, and he was the first in the grade at the end of last semester.
So, not long after the start of school this year, when the teachers of various subjects were selecting candidates for the competition, they almost fought over Xu Haiyuan.
No way, the child's energy is limited, so Xu Haiyuan could only choose four subjects that he was more interested in.
So, now he comes home for dinner at six o'clock every day.
"Hey, it's useless for the school to clean up these things. What can the teachers of Donggang Middle School train?" Xu Shiyan shook his head.
In her previous life, the eldest daughter of his family did the same, participating in the four-subject competition.
When I sleep in the morning, I have to get up to eat and go to school to recite geography, go home at noon to have a meal, and return to school in a hurry to recite history.
Go to learn English in self-study class in the afternoon, and then switch to math after English get out of class.
When I got home, I hurriedly ate a meal and had to do normal homework.
Especially in mathematics, the teacher is always in class, and sometimes he doesn’t come home until after seven o’clock.
As a result, I was busy with thirteen tricks, and I never won prizes in mathematics and English.
Anyway, history and geography won the first prize in the county and the third prize in the city.
With the strength of Donggang Middle School, it is considered very good.
Unexpectedly, the eldest son of his family experienced this kind of life for the first time in his life, and he doesn't know what mood the eldest son is in now?

chapters.title: Chapter 741: so shocking
chapters.content:
Chapter 741 is too shocking
At 6:05, Xu Haiyuan entered the house on time.
Sure enough, as soon as I entered the door, I yelled, "Grandma, is the meal ready? I'm starving to death."
Can you not be hungry? We eat around 11:30 in the afternoon, and we don’t finish school until 6:00 in the evening. No one would be hungry.
Not to mention the twelfth-year-old boy Xu Haiyuan, who eats a lot every day and gets hungry even faster.
By this time, I was so hungry that my chest was sticking to my back.
"Okay, okay, wash your hands quickly and eat.
Knowing that you are coming back at this hour, I specially served all the rice and waited for you to enter the door to eat. "
When Zhou Guilan heard her grandson shouting that she was hungry, her heart ached and she hurriedly called him into the house for dinner.
"Brother, give me your schoolbag, and wash your hands quickly."
Here, Xu Haiqing hurried forward, took his brother's schoolbag and put it in the room.
Xu Haiyuan went directly to wash his hands, and the brothers went back to the house for dinner.
"Dad? Are you at home today?" Xu Haiyuan entered the east room, only to find out that his father is at home today.
"The unit is not busy anymore? Didn't you say that you are busy preparing for the Spring Fair recently? Are you ready?"
Xu Haiyuan caught his father at home and asked him questions.
"Well, everything about the product is ready, brochures and promotional videos are also ready."
Last year’s promotional video was very popular. The province went to broadcast it as a documentary several times, and CCTV also took it and used the footage in it.
After returning from Yangcheng, Xu Shiyan asked people from the province and Taiwan for help, and took a lot of pictures.
Originally, it was intended to be used for publicity by merchants, but there was such a commotion last fall that there was no promotional video at all.
Later, Xu Shiyan asked someone to make up a lot of shots, so he might as well save it for this year.
Not to mention the products, the company has a lot of technology in stock, just pick some similar ones.
However, Xu Shiyan has no hope for this year's Spring Fair.
In this form, it may be that the food is served at the beverage factory.
The participation company, don't expect to be as brilliant as in previous years, it's impossible.
"Well, Shigong and I have researched a few more prescriptions, and I'll bring them to you later."
Xu Haiyuan nodded. If Dad can come home, he must be busy.
"Dad, can your pharmaceutical factory produce granules?" Xu Haiyuan suddenly remembered something, and asked casually.
"Yes, the pharmaceutical factory has several workshops, which can produce powders, tablets, pills, tinctures, and granules. What's wrong?"
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, not understanding why his son asked this?
The pharmaceutical factory has introduced the most advanced pharmaceutical equipment in the world. Of course, there is a granule production line.
"Dad, I'm talking about granules, not powders. Are you sure you're right?"
Xu Haiyuan seemed a little distrustful of his father, so he reconfirmed.
"That's right, it's granules. Several new medicines released by our pharmaceutical factory this year are granules.
Honeysuckle, Banlangen, Ganmaoqing, Ganmaoling, Qingyi Lidan, Xiao Bupleurum, these are all granules, any questions? "
Xu Shiyan was taken aback by his son's question.
This year, the factory has launched several new dosage forms of drugs, most of which are granules, and the market feedback is very good. Is there any problem with this?
"It's nothing, I heard people say that the dosage form of granules is best used in Wanwan, followed by Dongyi and South Korea.
At present, there are very few people in our country, and there are still many people who have doubts about this.
I feel that it does not belong to the traditional dosage form, and the drug effect may not work. So just asking you. "
Xu Haiyuan shrugged and said with a smile.
"Yanyuan didn't know where he saw it, so he asked me.
I said that anyway, I haven’t seen it much before, and I don’t know what he’s thinking about. It just so happened that you came back, so I asked you. "
Over there, Chu Xuanhuai smiled and explained Xu Shiyan's doubts.
"Oh, that's the thing about co-authoring.
Indeed, there are few types of granules, but this technique is not difficult.
I forgot to mention it to you, but Er Shenchang studied this before.
Ginseng Fruit Granules, Wuweizi Granules, and Wujiashen Granules were made, and it seems that they were certified by the Science and Technology Commission of Tonghua District a few years ago.
Unfortunately, it has not been applied to practice, only technical achievements have not been transformed into products.
But the dosage form of granules, we have mastered it relatively early. "Xu Shiyan suddenly realized that the co-author was curious about this.
To be honest, in fact, these ginseng factories in Fusong area really put in a lot of effort and mastered a lot of advanced technologies in order to study the deep processing and comprehensive utilization of ginseng in those years.
Granules were not used by domestic pharmaceutical companies a few years ago, and Ercanchang had already mastered the relevant technology.
It is a pity that the technology cannot be transformed into a commodity, and the real comprehensive utilization cannot be realized.
"Oh, what about the cell wall breaking technology?" Xu Haiyuan asked again as if he still didn't give up.
"Hey, what are you doing, boy? Are you going to test your father? The cell breaking technology company has already mastered it.
The previous natural active ginseng, didn’t it use ultra-low temperature wall breaking technology?
When the pharmaceutical factory installed equipment, I specially installed the most advanced wall-breaking machinery.
The main reason why the effect of the medicine of our pharmaceutical factory is affirmed is that the technology of cell wall breaking and ultrafine pulverization is applied to pharmaceuticals.
The medicinal materials are crushed fine enough, and the absorption rate of the active ingredients of the drug is high. Of course, the medicinal effect is good. "
Hey, this kid is in a good mood, isn't he? Are you really going to test his father?
Xu Shiyan glared at his son, did he really think he was born again?
At any rate, he has experienced the era of information explosion. Even if he doesn't know too much professional stuff, he has the ability to make money.
When building a pharmaceutical factory and importing equipment, Xu Shiyan spent a lot of money to buy the most advanced wall breaking machine from abroad.
"Huh? No, you little brat, how do you know this?"
Xu Shiyan realized at this moment, something is wrong, how old is his eldest son? How do you know these words?
You must know that there are not many researches on related topics such as cell wall breaking and ultrafine pulverization in China these days.
It seems that in the aspect of pollen wall breaking, ultrasonic wall breaking technology has begun to be applied.
Where did this little brat hear it?
"It's in the book, it's in the magazine I ordered last year, do you want me to find it for you?"
Xu Haiyuan glanced at his father, as if looking at a fool.
Xu Shiyan was completely dumbfounded, "Magazine? What magazine? Which magazine published these?"
As soon as these words came out, even Chu Xuanhuai began to sigh.
"I can see it, you two, you really have nothing else in your eyes except making money.
Yuanyuan came back from the provincial capital last year, and had been in correspondence with his seniors.
I don’t know who instructed him, asked him to order a lot of periodicals and magazines, and sent him a lot of materials. "
Chu Xuanhuai's implication is that what Xu Haiyuan said just now is from those magazines.
Xu Shiyan took a breath, "Can you understand?"
Where did this monster come from? Can't he be like a normal kid?
Why does he have to beat his dad's meager IQ every time?
"I don't understand, and there is Shigong.
If it doesn’t work, I can still call or write to my uncles for advice. What’s so strange about this? "
Xu Haiyuan looked calm. Isn't everyone as good as his father?
Thank you very much for your concern. I should have no Yang, because I have no other symptoms, just headache, dizziness, and palpitation. My head hurts, and even my eye sockets hurt.
I'll take a few days off to rest, and try to keep updating if I can, don't stop.

chapters.title: Chapter 742: wake up
chapters.content:
Chapter 742 Woke up with a word
"Dad, I don't mean anything else by asking you this.
I just want to ask you, do you only use these technologies in pharmaceutical factories, or do you also use them in export health care products?
I seem to have heard you mention the other day that there are several good pills and ointments this year. Do you want to try them?
Then you never thought about making it into a granule? "
Xu Haiyuan felt that he could no longer hit his father, so he should hurry up and give him some sweetness.
"Actually, those people abroad don't like our pill formulation.
They like simple things that don’t require much IQ. It’s best to take them and rinse them with water, or even use them without flushing.
Moreover, they also require a good taste.
Many of our traditional Chinese medicine formulations are too difficult for them to enter, and they don't like it.
So you can give it a try, change some of the products into a shot type, and add a little something to improve the taste.
I think it is better than those pills, ointment and so on. "
Xu Haiyuan has studied this aspect for a long time, and he speaks more clearly.
What the son said was like a thunderbolt exploding in Xu Shiyan's mind, directly splitting the chaos in his mind.
Yeah, how could he ignore this?
The previous ginseng coffee and ginseng snow clam honey are all in this category, no wonder they sell so well.
If you follow your son’s instructions, you can make a granule with a good taste. Isn’t this a solid drink?
Also, if the superfine pulverization technology is applied, and some sweeteners are added to press it out, is it called pressed candy?
Grass, he is so old, he is not even as good as a child.
"Oh my dear, you have helped your father a lot.
No, I have to go back to work quickly. "
How can Xu Shiyan sit still now? He has to go to the unit quickly and find someone from the technical department to research this.
"Sit down honestly and don't worry about this meal any more.
What are you running around? Let's talk honestly after finishing the meal. "
As a result, Xu Chenghou over there turned down his face and directly disciplined his son.
"How many days have you not come back? After finally coming back, you can't sit down and have a meal with us in peace?
how? Your company can't get along without you, right? who are you? "
The old man is impatient. This guy treats his house like a hotel every day?
No, I have to stay in the hotel for one night anyway, so I just sit for a while when I come back, and I get up to leave. This is going through the city gate.
Once the old man got angry, Xu Shiyan didn't dare to move, so he laughed a few times and sat down.
"Yes, yes, it's important to eat, come on, dad, you eat a piece of meat." The dearest dad is the biggest, so what can I do? Coax it.
"Don't mess around here, it's useless.
Just now when your mother said about you, I didn’t hesitate to say anything, and you should be similar.
The company does not belong to you alone, and you did not let the ginseng market fall, so it is almost enough, what are you going to do?
who do you think You Are? Want to go to heaven? "The old man has been holding back for many days, and finally broke out.
"Father, I didn't say that the company is mine. The main thing is that it's not long before the Spring Fair.
This year's Spring Fair is of great importance. The province and the city are watching it. What do you think I can do? "
Xu Shiyan sat there looking at the old man and sighed. Others really couldn't understand how much pressure he was under now.
"No matter what, your own body comes first, and family members are also very important.
Shiyan, isn’t the example of your master and me right in front of your eyes?
Your father has no other intentions, but wants you to slow down a little and stop working so hard. "Chu Xuanhuai also joined the persuasion team.
"Master, I understand everything you said.
All right, after the Spring Fair is over, I will have a good rest when I come back, is this the head office? "
Xu Shiyan thought about it, and it was true that he hadn't had a good rest for a long time, so he could only take a step back.
No matter what, even if it is a break, I have to wait until the Spring Fair is over. Right now, I really don’t have that time.
"Well, your own business is up to you. Let's eat the meal first."
Xu Chenghou sighed and didn't say any more.
What can I say? With the current status of the son, the responsibility is naturally heavy.
Although he is old, he is still not confused and understands priorities.
I was angry just now because I thought my son didn't pay attention to his body.
"Hey, hey, eat."
Xu Shiyan quickly agreed, putting aside all the new product matters for the time being, and having a good meal with his parents.
While eating, Xu Shiyan remembered his son's competition training.
"Son, what do you think about the competition?
If it’s not interesting, why not give back two, or I’m worried that you’re too tired. "
Thirteen years old, growing up, good guy, starting at school from 5:30 in the morning until 6:00 in the evening, isn't it a bit too much?
Xu Haiyuan put down the chopsticks in his hand and looked up at his father.
"Actually, it's okay, geography and biology are not much different from what is taught in class now, but they can be learned faster than in class, and they have to memorize the semester stuff.
Mathematics knowledge is deeper than that in the classroom, and the questions are a little more difficult. English is about grammar.
It’s nothing to worry about anyway. After attending the training, I can relax in class and treat it as learning in advance. "
For Xu Haiyuan, homework is never a problem, so if you want to participate, just participate. Anyway, it’s good to learn more.
Yes, he didn't need to ask.
Don’t your own children know? Others struggle to learn even the little things in class, but in his family, studying is as easy as Chinese cabbage.
"Okay, anyway, you can master it yourself. If you are too tired, just tell the teacher to get rid of one subject and two subjects."
The child is old enough to handle these things by himself. If he talks too much, he will make people hate him.
"Okay, I see, Dad. Don't worry, I will balance it out."
Xu Haiyuan nodded, the conversation between father and son ended here, Xu Haiyuan continued to eat.
After dinner, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing accompanied Chu Xuanhuai to go home.
Su Anying and Xu Shiyan are not at home these days, so the two girls Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui live in their grandparents' house, and live in Westinghouse with Xu Jingyi.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing went back to live with Chu Xuanhuai, just in time to take care of the house.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about something, so he couldn't sit still.
Xu Chenghou also noticed it, so he waved his hand and asked his son to do what he should do.
"Okay, if you have something to do, you can leave. Don't worry at home. With me and your mother, I will take care of the children."
The son and daughter-in-law are busy with their careers, but also for the good of the family, the old man can understand.
Now that the Spring Fair is so important, how can he stop his son from leaving?
"Thank you dad, thank you mom, if there weren't two elders sitting in charge these years, Yingzi and I wouldn't dare to make such a fuss."
Xu Shiyan smiled and sincerely thanked his parents.
"Thank you? My parents still need you to say thank you?
Wait a minute, I'll pack some clean clothes for you. Anyway, he is also a general manager, but don't be too sloppy.
Where did your Mai Tai clothes go? Bring it back and I'll wash it for you. "
Zhou Guilan's face brightened, and she wanted to pack Xu Shiyan's clothes with a smile.
"Oh, there is a washing machine in my unit, I just throw it in the washing machine."

chapters.title: Chapter 743: change process
chapters.content:
Chapter 743 Change process
Xu Shiyan hurried back to the unit, and then called the backbone of the technical department, and the big guys had a meeting together.
Xu Shiyan brought over Xu Haiyuan's argument and told the big guys.
When everyone heard it, they felt a little enlightened.
"This idea is okay, I think it's okay.
The feedback from the sales department is really like this. The simpler the way of eating and the better the taste of the product, the greater the sales.
Didn’t we give away a lot of new products last year? That deer whip ointment and deer whip pills.
People reported that the effect is not bad, but it is troublesome to eat, so the order is not very ideal.
On the contrary, it is ginseng essence drink liquid, and ginseng qi blood drink. These two kinds of drinks are oral liquid at that time, and the feedback given over there is OK. "
Han Limin is the person in charge of the comprehensive factory. Most of these products are produced in the comprehensive factory, so he knows best.
Han Limin and the technical department were quite puzzled by the information fed back by the sales department.
The deer **** pills are made of very good materials, including deer tail, deer kidney, deer penis, ginseng, Eucommia male flowers, dried oysters and more than a dozen herbs.
Using traditional pharmaceutical technology, crushing, grinding, proportioning, and finally made into thumb-sized pills, each pill is exactly one dosage.
The formula of the deer whip ointment is also very good, but the dosage form is different, and finally it is boiled into an ointment.
It is served in a glass bottle, and a spoon is specially provided, so you can drink one spoonful at a time.
Obviously the effect of these two products is very good, but the order volume is not high.
On the contrary, it is that kind of oral liquid, the order quantity is better.
At that time, the technical department saw the feedback and found it very strange, and said that it must be because foreigners don’t understand, and they don’t know what a good thing is.
But now it seems that this is not the case, but that they have not substituted the thinking of foreign consumers and regarded them as natives.
The common people in China have been exposed to these since they were young, and they know that Wansan Gaodan is a normal dosage form.
When taking pills, the larger ones should be separated and not taken whole.
When using the ointment, scoop a spoonful of water and drink it.
Maybe, foreigners are not used to this, they prefer some simple operations.
Oral liquid at least you don’t need to bother, you can drink it after inserting a tube.
Moreover, those dark pills and ointments may give people a bad feeling in the senses.
People have never used it, so they must not be interested.
"Then, according to what Xu Haiyuan said, all kinds of medicinal materials are pulverized through ultra-fine pulverization technology, and then purified.
Then make a granule, or press it into a tablet form, maybe it will be really useful.
Granules are taken one pack at a time, just rinse with hot water.
The style of the pills is even simpler, just pour out two pills at any time. Not to mention, this is really a way. "
Han Limin felt that this proposal was indeed feasible.
"Otherwise, let's try it? Anyway, the formula is still the same, just change the process, it's not difficult."
Everyone is eager to try.
If what Xu Shiyan said is true, it seems that the process is simpler, and the ancient method of making ointment recipes is actually more cumbersome and troublesome.
"Okay, let's discuss the specific process, and then let's try it tomorrow.
Tomorrow, I will report to the higher authorities to see if they can handle an expedited procedure. "
The previous deer whip pills and deer whip ointment have all been certified.
At present, the domestic definition of this type of product is not clear, the control is not as strict as that of drugs, and the approval procedures are simple.
Now just change the process, not the formula, it should be able to pass quickly.
It would be best if they could be approved before the Spring Fair, as long as they could bring a batch of samples with them.
"Well, let's go to the granule and tablet workshop of the pharmaceutical factory to have a look, and then consult with the master over there."
Han Limin is also a short-tempered person, how can he sit still at the moment? Immediately take these people from the technical department to the pharmaceutical factory.
To change the dosage form, the original process flow must also be modified.
Han Limin and the others are not very sure about this, and the time is short, so there is not much time to waste on research.
So the quickest way is to go to the pharmaceutical factory for advice.
Pharmaceutical factories now have a lot of orders. They work in two shifts during the day and night, and work at night.
When the pharmaceutical factory started work, Xu Shiyan hired several masters who were proficient in pharmaceutical technology from other pharmaceutical factories, and these workers in the factory also went to study and train.
After more than a year of study and adaptation, the skilled workers in the factory have mastered the most advanced pharmaceutical technology.
Leading people, Han Limin directly found the old master who was in charge of the pharmaceutical factory, and discussed with him.
The master craftsmen in the pharmaceutical factory have been engaged in this industry for many years, and they understand it as soon as they hear it.
Immediately gave Han Limin and the others advice on how to improve the process, what needs to be paid attention to, and so on.
After some discussions, the people in the technical department finally determined the technological process of the new dosage form.
Then the next day, Han Limin took his people and borrowed the preparation workshop of the pharmaceutical factory for a simple experiment.
After many tests, the final process flow was determined, and the parameters of the product also met the technical requirements.
Han Limin led people to modify the dosage form of the new product, and Xu Shiyan hurriedly reported it.
The leaders of the province knew that this matter was related to the upcoming Spring Fair, so they decided to do something special, give approval first, and then follow up with other procedures.
Received the promise of the provincial leaders, Xu Shiyan hurriedly found a place to customize the packaging.
It is simple to press tablet candies, just use plastic bottles and outer paper packaging.
Of course, the packaging should be neat and beautiful, and instructions in multiple languages ​​should be printed.
The packaging of the solid drink is made of small strips of plastic easy-to-tear packaging, and the outside is a custom-made small gift box, which is also very beautifully made.
In a hurry, at least before the Spring Fair, the new dosage form of the product finally came out, and all the relevant approval procedures were in place.
This time, in order to wait for new products, Xu Shiyan couldn't leave too early.
On April 20th, I flew to Yangcheng with Guo Fenghua.
After arriving in Yangcheng, I first went to see the construction progress of my store.
It’s okay, the exterior walls are all finished, and the interior is being renovated.
According to Xu Shiyan and Su Anying's original plan, the entire first floor will be used as a storefront, the second floor will be used as a hotel, and the basement will be used as a warehouse.
A second-story building was also built in the small courtyard at the back, reserved for staff dormitories and so on.
Anyway, the progress here is very smooth, and it is expected to be handed over in June and July, with a little ventilation.
By the end of August and the beginning of September, when all the goods are delivered, we can find time to open for business.
Everything went well at the store, Xu Shiyan rushed to Bao'an again, and met Su Anying, Ji Tongzhong, Nan Zhendong, Zhou Qingjie and others who were supervising the progress of the factory construction project.
"Oh, brother-in-law, why are you here?"
Nan Zhendong and others were a little surprised when they saw Xu Shiyan.
They knew that Xu Shiyan would go to the Spring Fair in Yangcheng, and they thought they could wait until the Spring Fair was over before coming, but they didn’t expect to come here in advance.
"Look at what you're asking, our second sister is here, can the second brother-in-law come?"
Ji Tongzhong straightened his head with a hard hat on, and winked at Nan Zhendong.
The third brother-in-law of his family is just a lump of wood, can't understand this? The second brother-in-law must miss the second sister.

chapters.title: Chapter 744: couple meet
chapters.content:
Chapter 744 Husband and wife meet
No matter how stupid Nan Zhendong is, he should understand after being reminded by Ji Tongzhong. So he laughed.
Xu Shiyan didn't bother to pay attention to the two brothers-in-law, and only looked at his daughter-in-law.
Su Anying is also supervising the construction site, wearing gray work clothes, wearing a hard hat on her head, and walking this way with a smile.
"I thought you would arrive in a few days.
How are you doing? Are the products for this year's Spring Fair ready? How are you doing at home?
I haven't gone back for so long, do my parents have any objections? "
Su Anying walked to the safe area here and took off the helmet on his head.
Xu Shiyan discovered that Su Anying had cut off her hair that she had managed to grow.
This time the cut is shorter, almost like a tomboy.
But Su Anying has a good-looking face, and she can have any hairstyle, but short hair looks more neat and capable.
"The house is fine, nothing is wrong.
The children are quite obedient, Xu Haiqing is not such a **** now, Teacher Yu even praised him, saying that he is quite talented. "
The music teacher who was an intern at Donggang Central Primary School was later assigned to be a music teacher at Donggang Junior High School, and happened to teach Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Shiyan entrusted his eldest son to find this teacher Yu, and asked him to take Xu Haiqing, Xu Jinhui, and Xu Jingyi with him.
Every Saturday and Sunday, let the three children learn vocal music, recitation, etc. with Teacher Yu.
Don't worry about whether the child has talent in this area, just cultivate it.
There are so many training courses in later generations, but he only found this one, which is already very few.
I don’t know whether Xu Haiqing is really talented in this area or something. Anyway, the information that the teacher gave back was that Xu Haiqing learned faster than the two girls.
This was beyond Xu Shiyan's expectations.
He thought that Xu Jinhui and Xu Jingyi could learn better than Xu Haiqing, but it turned out that Xu Haiqing was often praised by the teacher.
Of course, girls also have their strengths. It is said that they dance well.
As long as the children like it, I don’t expect them to really eat this bowl of rice in the future anyway.
It's just to cultivate some interest and cultivate sentiment.
"The land and land at home are all contracted out, Shengli and Jianshe are taking care of them, don't worry.
My parents and my husband are all fine, don’t worry.
What opinions can our father and mother have? We are here for our family, they are just worried about you.
Before I came back, I specifically asked me to take good care of you when I came here. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and stretched out his hand, taking the helmet from his daughter-in-law.
"Let's go, go change your clothes, let's find a place to talk."
The end of April in Baoan is not in the northeast, the weather here is already very hot.
Haven't seen each other for a long time, I have to find a place to sit down and talk peacefully, don't we still have to tan in the sun and get oily?
Su Anying nodded, "Then go home.
Sister Six bought an apartment here, and I thought it was okay, so I bought another apartment, two next to each other. "
Ji Tongzhong and others came and lived in temporary houses next to the construction site.
Su Anying and Ji Yufeng can't live here, there must be a similar place to stay.
It happened that Xu Shiqin bought a house, sixty-seven to eight square meters, just over one hundred thousand, with two bedrooms and one living room, and it was quite spacious inside.
Su Anying looked good, so she simply bought a set, which is next door to Xu Shiqin, to clean up and decorate, and live with Ji Yufeng and the others.
It is very convenient to cook by myself in the morning and evening.
"By the way, where is Shiqin? How is her factory going?" Xu Shiyan wanted to ask just now, but he didn't know how the little girl was doing.
"Sixth sister went back to Guangshui a few days ago, she is small there, and besides, all kinds of machinery and equipment in the sewing factory are also simple, so it is faster than ours.
I heard that I want to go back to see my brother-in-law and children, and then hurry to get into the machine or something.
It is estimated that her factory will open before autumn. "Su Anying said while walking with Xu Shiyan.
"Third brother-in-law, fourth brother-in-law, Qingjie, let's go home and sit down together.
I'll buy some vegetables at noon, and I'll make you some delicious treats. "Su Anying turned her head and yelled at Ji Tongzhong and the others.
"Second sister, second brother-in-law, no need, there are still many things on the construction site.
We won’t go there, you can cook something for the second brother-in-law. "
Just as Nan Zhendong was about to follow, Ji Tongzhong elbowed him, then waved at Xu Shiyan and the others.
"Are you stupid? How long has it been since the second brother-in-law and the second sister have seen each other?
The second brother-in-law rarely comes over, so the couple can't talk about themselves? What are you running to mix with?
Are you short of that meal? Shall I treat you to a restaurant tonight? "
At this time, he didn't care that the person in front of him was his third brother-in-law.
"Well, I thought Second Sister would really reward us with delicious food."
Nan Zhendong scratched his head, and an embarrassed smile appeared on Dahei's face.
"The food on this construction site is not good, and the surrounding restaurants are not good either. They can't cook the taste of our family."
This is the first time Nan Zhendong has traveled all the way to the south from home, he is really not used to it, he feels homesick.
"Then you can't join in the fun today, how about it, I saw a Northeast restaurant two days ago, and I will invite you to have a drink tonight."
Ji Tongzhong dragged Nan Zhendong, turned around and waved at Xu Shiyan and the others, smiled, and then walked to the construction site.
"Xiao Ji is getting more and more cunning, and he is slick-tongued every day." Su Anying shook her head helplessly.
She really wanted to invite those few people over for dinner just now. It's mainly the restaurants here, indeed the food doesn't suit my taste.
It’s usually not easy to call them home, but Xu Shiyan happened to be here, and everyone went home for a meal together.
As a result, Ji Tongzhong made such a fuss, but Su Anying couldn't help it.
"However, this kid does have some skills, and he can get along well with the contractor on the construction site and the building material supplier.
Zhendong was a little bit too honest, not as eloquent as Xiao Ji.
But he is very thorough about the work on the construction site, and he understands better than anyone else that those workers can't fool him. "
The two brothers-in-law each have their own characteristics, thanks to their coming.
Otherwise, Su Anying, a woman, would have struggled to build such a large factory.
"Qing Jie is also good, the three of them cooperate very well, and the few people arranged with your factory get along very well."
Xu Shiyan arranged for a few people from the company to come over.
Everyone understands that we are all a family, and there is no need to be wary of anyone, so everyone gets along very well.
Everything is discussed every day, so the progress of the project is okay, very fast.
"Well, as long as they are obedient, anyway, you are the master here, and everyone has to obey your orders."
Xu Shiyan smiled. Before those people left, he reminded them thousands of times that they came here to help Su Anying, not to make trouble.
Those few are also old people who participated in the field. Can you still understand this matter?

chapters.title: Chapter 745: Xiaobie wins newlyweds
chapters.content:
Chapter 745 Xiao Biesheng Newly Married
Su Anying bought a motorcycle here for daily transportation.
So at this moment, she took Xu Shiyan on a motorcycle, first went to the vegetable market to buy some food, and then the two went back to their residence together.
There is no shared area for houses in this year and month, and the area of ​​​​60 or so square meters is used.
So the house looks okay inside, quite spacious.
Two bedrooms, one living room, one kitchen and one bathroom. The house is simply cleaned up, tiled, toilet, bathroom, vegetable sink and other things are installed.
The living room has a TV, a sofa, a few stools, and the north and south bedrooms each have a bed and simple cabinets.
"Sit down for a while, I'll change clothes and cook for you later."
After entering the door, Su Anying poured a glass of water for her man, and then went into the bathroom with a change of clothes.
I was sweating all morning on the construction site, and it was so sticky and uncomfortable.
So Su Anying took a shower first, changed her clothes, and then went into the kitchen to cook for Xu Shiyan.
With the conditions of their family, they can afford to go to any restaurant.
But Su Anying felt that the couple hadn't seen each other for a long time, so it would be better to cook something by themselves.
So regardless of the heat in the kitchen at this time, the fryer insisted on making more delicious food for Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan didn't object, it didn't matter where he went to eat, he just wanted to spend some time with his wife.
So Su Anying was cooking over there, and Xu Shiyan was at the door of the kitchen, helping to pick vegetables and chop green onions, and the couple chatted with each other.
There are few range hoods these days, and the kitchen is full of exhaust fans. It is not so easy to exhaust something with a lot of oily smoke.
But Xu Shiyan felt that this was the original way of life, daily necessities, rice, oil, salt, and human fireworks, real and down-to-earth.
Just as the dishes in his hand were washed, he turned around and put them on the chopping board.
Turning her head, she saw Su Anying standing in front of the stove, frying fish with a shovel in her hand.
The weather here is hot, and in the kitchen, Su Anying wore a short-sleeved T-shirt.
Pure cotton clothes may have been washed too many times, and the neckline is a bit deformed and baggy.
Following Su Anying's working movements, her collarbone and a part of her shoulders were exposed.
"It's better to be my wife, who knows what I like to eat."
Xu Shiyan stepped forward, put his arms around his wife's waist, bowed his head and kissed Su Anying's neck.
"Go aside, don't delay my work here.
Be careful that I burnt the fish, you have nothing to eat at noon. " Su Anying threatened with a smile.
"Then I won't eat, it's enough to have a daughter-in-law, what else do I have to eat?"
Xu Shiyan refused to listen, and put his arms around his daughter-in-law and kissed her again.
"If you make trouble again, you won't have anything to eat at noon today. Go out and wait for me, and the food will be ready soon."
Su Anying didn't know whether it was shame or annoyance, anyway, her face blushed a lot, she waved a shovel, and kicked Xu Shiyan out of the kitchen in a daze.
Xu Shiyan came out of the kitchen laughing, sat in the living room drinking water and watching TV.
Not long after, Su Anying shouted that it was time to eat, so she got up and went to the restaurant to sit down.
There are four dishes, one soup and two bowls of rice on the table.
"Here, they cook and then go to the vegetable market to buy, and they don't buy much, which is different from ours.
We buy a lot and stock up to eat. If we buy a lot of food here at once, people will think it is a restaurant. "
Su Anying smiled and explained to Xu Shiyan, while picking up a piece of fish and putting it in Xu Shiyan's bowl.
"Most of them like steamed fish. I'm not used to it, but I still think it tastes better when fried."
Xu Shiyan picked up the fish and took a bite, "Well, it's delicious and fresh. You can't eat such good sea fish in our place."
Sea fish has few bones, and the meat is delicious, which is really good to eat.
"Eat more if you like it. There is nothing rare here, and it is very cheap."
Su Anying picked up a few more pieces for Xu Shiyan, and the couple chatted while eating.
There is no fixed content to talk about, anyway, I just say whatever comes to mind.
Not long after eating and packing up, the two sat on the sofa watching TV and chatting.
There is no such good-looking TV at noon, so watching it, some people are dishonest.
It is said that Xiao Biesheng is newly married, and the couple have been separated for several months, so they must get close.
Thanks to the fact that this is a residential building, no one will disturb you once the door is closed, so it is convenient to do anything.
When I woke up, the sky outside was still bright. Looking to the side, my daughter-in-law was sleeping soundly in her arms.
Xu Shiyan smiled, hugged his wife and continued to sleep.
It’s been too tiring to develop new products for a while, anyway, I have nothing to do, so sleep more.
When waiting to open his eyes again, the person in his arms disappeared, and the sky was full of red clouds outside the window.
Xu Shiyan put on his clothes and got up, walked around several rooms, but found no sign of his wife.
Was wondering, suddenly the door opened, and Su Anying came in with big and small bags in his hand.
Xu Shiyan hurried forward and took the things from his wife.
"Are you shopping for vegetables again? Why do you still buy so much?" Xu Shiyan asked casually.
"Are you awake? I saw that you were sleeping soundly, so I didn't call you.
Let's eat dumplings tonight. I bought meat and vegetables, and I will call Yufeng and Xiaoji to eat together later.
I guess these days are not easy to rely on, let's make some dumplings to satisfy our cravings. "
Su Anying entered the room with a smile, and signaled Xu Shiyan to take all the dishes to the kitchen.
She rummaged in the cabinet, found a bag of flour, and hurriedly washed her hands and kneaded the dough.
"It's time to make dumplings, when can I eat them?"
Xu Shiyan glanced outside, it was dark in the south, by the looks of it, it must be past six o'clock, right?
You can’t eat dumplings at midnight, right?
"No, the minced meat and vegetable stuffing are all chopped, so I'll make noodles.
I told Yufeng and Xiaoji just now, come later, let’s work together, and it will be done soon. "
Su Anying worked quickly, and made the dough together in a short while, and put oil and seasoning on the meat and vegetable fillings.
Waiting for the dough to wake up, you can start making dumplings.
Just as Su Anying had just finished her work, Ji Yufeng, Ji Tongzhong, Nan Zhendong, Zhou Qingjie, and the few people sent to attend the venue all arrived.
The big guys started making dumplings together, rolling out the skin and wrapping them, and it didn’t take long to make a lot of them.
However, living in a building is not as good as living in a bungalow. There is no such a big pot, so I can only cook it in a stewing pot.
"Oh, I have to eat dumplings. I have been here for a long time, and I have never had such a comfortable meal. It is delicious and so comfortable."
Nan Zhendong rubbed his stomach and leaned on the sofa, chanting contentedly.
"Thanks for your hard work, big guy, it's really not easy these days.
Just wait until the factory is built and officially put into production, and then you can breathe a sigh of relief. "
Xu Shiyan served a plate of fruit and put it on the table for everyone to eat.
"Hehe, second brother-in-law, do you think we can trust your words?
The factory is built here, if you can’t guarantee it, where are you going to build the factory. "
Ji Tongzhong reached out to pick up a piece of melon and gnawed on it, then looked at Xu Shiyan with a smile.
Based on his understanding of the second brother-in-law, when the factory here is stable and earning money, it is not sure where to build the factory again.
Everyone was taken aback when they heard the words, and then burst out laughing.
"That's also my pleasure, as long as I can earn money, it doesn't matter how hard or tiring I am."
Nan Zhendong also picked up a piece of melon and gnawed on it, talking as he gnawed.

chapters.title: Chapter 746: The temptation of food
chapters.content:
Chapter 746 The Temptation of Food
On the 29th, Xu Shiyan returned to Yangcheng from Bao'an, received the goods, and then set up the booth.
On May 1st, the third Spring Fair opened as scheduled.
Guo Shouye came back from abroad and took people to Yunnan Province to study, so this time the beverage factory was led by Guo Fenghua.
Thanks to the three-year exclusive sponsorship contract signed with the Spring Fair Organizing Committee.
This year, many beverage factories approached and wanted to sponsor.
There is a contract, so here naturally cannot break the contract, so Bingshan Beverage Factory is still the sole sponsor of the Spring Fair.
In order to participate in this year's Spring Fair, Guo Fenghua has made ample preparations.
After the research of the previous sports drink, it has been used as a technical reserve, and this year it was also sent as a sample.
In addition, there are several kinds of pure natural fruit juices, ice wine, blueberry wine, indigo wine, etc., which are all new products this year.
The beverage factory has developed well in the past two years, especially the Quanyang factory, where the water quality is good and the water inflow is large.
Last fall, Guo Fenghua followed Xu Shiyan's advice and introduced large bucket water production and filling equipment.
Produce the large barrels of mineral water that are matched with the drinking fountains, cooperate with drinking fountain manufacturers, and export to Hong Kong City, Dongyi, South Korea, Singapore and other regions.
and major domestic hotels. Regardless of the production of large buckets of water, the profit is not low. The beverage factory made a lot of money last year.
Guo Fenghua has education and insight, and young people are more aggressive, so the beverage factory has developed well in his hands.
Guo Shouye saw this, and simply handed over the management of the factory on the Songjiang River to his son.
In addition to producing these, the factory now also has liquor and beer production lines, which have also started production.
But this is basically only for the three northeastern provinces, and we don't plan to expand too much.
Bingshan Beverage exclusively sponsors the drinking water of the Canton Fair, and can enjoy some convenience, and Guo Fenghua also participated in the Autumn Fair last fall, so he has experience.
So there is no need for Xu Shiyan to worry about it at all, just let the young people play on their own.
On the part of participating companies, this year is considered a hurdle, which must be taken seriously.
So Xu Shiyan has been busy here, directing a few people to arrange booths and display products, so as to attract the attention of foreigners at a glance.
Last year, some people really learned the trick of setting up TVs to show promotional videos, and some people got TVs, VCRs and so on, and put them there to play promotional videos.
Xu Shiyan had no idea about this.
The Spring Fair is a place where the Eight Immortals cross the sea to show their magical powers. If he can use it, others can use it, whatever.
The main reason is that there is no such big screen at present. If there is, Xu Shiyan promises to discuss with the organizing committee, and spend money to buy a big screen for promotional videos.
Xu Shiyan still has a promotional video this year, and the theme is different from last year.
Last year it was mainly to promote the harmonious coexistence between man and nature, and this year it is to record the growth and processing of Changbai Mountain ginseng.
The promotional film tells the history and evolution of ginseng planting, as well as many technical points of ginseng planting, in the form of Chinese dubbing and English subtitles.
The forests that have grown for decades or even hundreds of years are directly cut down, and the land is plowed, ridged, sown, and managed.
After three years, it was transplanted to another piece of new land, carefully cared for and managed, loosening the soil, weeding, pinching ginseng flowers, pinching ginseng seeds.
has been cared for for another three years before it can be raised from the ground.
The fresh ginseng produced is sent to the processing factory or the farmer's home.
After selection, soaking, scrubbing, steaming, drying and other processes, the dried red ginseng with perfect appearance can be made.
Don’t foreigners think that ginseng is cultivated like radish and potato?
Then Xu Shiyan used this documentary to talk to them.
Look at what kind of radish and potatoes need to be planted in old forest land that has grown for decades or even hundreds of years?
Look at what kind of radish and potatoes can grow for a long period of six years?
Look at what kind of radish and potato can receive such careful management and care?
Everyone said that ginseng was worthless, so Xu Shiyan asked everyone to see where ginseng was worth.
It takes six years of growth to cultivate high-quality ginseng with the best efficacy.
Ginseng is a gift left to the world after countless years of cultivation in the beautiful Changbai Mountain.
In the second half of the documentary, Xu Shiyan hired a well-known local chef to research various dishes specially for ginseng.
What ginseng chicken soup, shredded ginseng is a piece of cake.
Ginseng pot-wrapped meat, crystal ginseng, what else are Phoenix ginseng slices, snow-coated ginseng, happy encounters in life (ginseng), baked ginseng with butter egg yolk, etc.
One after another delicious food is displayed in front of everyone through video.
Although they couldn’t smell the aroma or taste the taste, but looking at the well-matched, colorful and auspicious food on the long table one after another, everyone who saw this paragraph couldn’t help swallowing.
"Have a good spring festival, which almost turned you into a food contest, you can really do it."
Now that Guan Enxue is in charge of all affairs in the city, he can no longer follow him to Yangcheng like before.
So this year, the people who came to the Spring Fair were Lin Qiyue and a deputy mayor.
That person was transferred from elsewhere, not too old, and had never been to the Spring Fair before, so everything looked fresh.
Lin Qiyue, on the other hand, was an old acquaintance with Xu Shiyan, and they were chatting there.
"No way, this year is too stressful, and I can't think of a better idea, so I can only try this.
Otherwise, what should I do? The leaders of the city and the province called every day, and I felt like my hair was about to fall out.
The Spring Fair is over this time, and I must take a few days off to take a good rest when I go back. "
Xu Shiyan deliberately complained in front of the leaders, not to let them think that research and development is easy.
Otherwise, it's time to put pressure on them again next year.
It’s almost enough, so can you still research new products that sell well every year?
"Well, the research and development of the technical department is really hard. Take a rest when you should rest. Only when your body is healthy can you work better."
Lin Qiyue came out of the field, of course he understands.
Back when Xu Shiyan led the technical department to overcome technical problems, he wished he could leave the laboratory for a month and live there.
Just as he was talking, there happened to be a staff member accompanying the foreign businessman.
Coincidentally, the section of cooking food was being shown on TV, and the eyes of those foreigners were directly attracted by the TV.
Someone asked the staff, which food show is on TV?
The staff didn't know what was going on, so they quickly asked the people here.
Xu Shiyan hurriedly explained to others that these are delicacies made with ginseng, which are the characteristics of the Changbai Mountain area.
Many people were interested in this, so they stopped in front of the booth, watching TV and looking at the products on the platform.
Participating companies have brought a lot of products this year.
In addition to the regular products of previous years, there are also ginseng and deer whip oyster essence solid drinks that were just made a while ago, and ginseng and deer whip candies.
The original deer whip pills and deer whip ointment are also available, which can be used for Dongyi and South Korea, as well as Hong Kong and Taiwan merchants.
After all, people in these areas can still adapt to traditional Chinese medicine formulations.
In addition, there are queen pills, red ginseng big bottle concentrated paste, and small foods such as ginseng blueberry soft candy, ginseng mint candy, ginseng crispy candy, and ginseng cocoa candy.
There are also canned fresh ginseng and white fungus, canned instant ginseng chicken, etc., which are full of beautiful things and a whole booth.

chapters.title: Chapter 747: still hot
chapters.content:
Chapter 747 is still hot
The booths of participating companies have attracted many foreign businessmen over the years, and this year is no exception.
Not long after the Spring Festival Fair started, many people gathered here.
Of course, most people are watching the promotional video.
Xu Shiyan and his staff took this opportunity to open various ginseng candies and canned ginseng and give them to the guests for tasting.
So, I saw a group of foreigners, staring at the TV, holding food in their hands, nodding while eating.
Waiting to finish eating, and after watching the video, many people hurriedly consulted with the participating companies about the efficacy and prices of various products.
After the two parties have negotiated, place the order directly.
Many new products have been launched this year, and the response is not bad so far, and orders have been received for many products.
Moreover, the price of the new product is not bad, and merchants are not as expensive as expected.
For them, delicious and useful is the most important thing.
Besides, the sales department also considered a lot when pricing, and the price was within a reasonable range.
The sales of new products are gratifying, which drives the sales of old products.
Old products, there are promotional activities launched by the company, which are actually quite attractive, so the order volume is also good.
Before I came here, I thought that this year's Spring Fair might not be too good, but I didn't expect the scene to be unexpectedly hot.
Lin Qiyue couldn't close his mouth so happy when he saw this.
This time, he will be a stamp-stamping robot, who will stamp the stamp regardless of anything else.
The other deputy mayor was not very familiar with the business, so he helped Lin Qiyue to help count the amount of orders and sort them out.
Contrary to everyone's expectations, under such a gloomy situation, the order of the participating company on the first day reached more than 9 million dollars.
On the other hand, Bingshan Beverage Factory's sales volume today was also beyond expectations, with orders for nearly two million dollars.
When the library was closed, Lin Qiyue was so happy that he wanted to jump into the sky.
Back to the hotel, I didn't even have time to eat, so I called Guan Enxue back to report the good news.
When Guan Enxue heard the good news at home, his heart finally fell to the ground.
I can't make him happy, I have to ask Dong Jinling to cook some good dishes and have a drink with him.
As a result, Guan Enxue was stunned because he had never drunk his daughter-in-law, and was drunk by Dong Jinling in the end.
Northeast women, as long as they dare to go to the wine table, there is no low drinking capacity, it just depends on whether they drink or not.
Xu Shiyan was also very happy here, but the Spring Fair was not over yet, and the big guys didn't dare to go out for a drink, so they just called home to announce the good news.
The family is also very happy to hear the news.
Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong, and Han Limin made an appointment to drink together until midnight.
While drinking, several people cried and laughed for a while.
It is really too difficult. For the past six months, all of them have been trembling, for fear that the situation this year will not be stable.
You know, there are two to three thousand employees participating in the venue, behind which are the livelihoods of two to three thousand families and tens of thousands of people.
If the situation is really bad and the company can't make money, what will the employees do in the future? How will the big guys get through this difficult time?
There were nearly 10 million orders on the first day, and there are still four days left. How can it be the same as last year.
There are these orders, plus those orders from previous customers, and the consumption of the pharmaceutical factory.
Those ginsengs that participated in the market this year don't have to worry about sales.
At this moment, the heart that had been hanging all this time was finally let go, and everyone felt relieved.
A few people drank to the end, they all had too much, and they didn't even return home, so they slept in the field.
Eyes closed and opened, the Spring Fair started again the next day.
The booths of participating companies are still hot, but most of the orders are concentrated on those health products and snacks.
Especially the solid drink and tablet candy, which attracted many European and American customers.
But pills and ointment products attract customers from Dongyi, South Korea, Hong Kong and Taiwan.
Especially the merchants in South Korea, their eyes are shining brightly when they look at the empress pill and red ginseng paste.
These are people who really know the goods, they know what is good.
Compared to the hot sales of health products and snacks, the sales of medicines are much worse.
As Xu Shiyan predicted before, Europeans and Americans do not recognize those medicines at all.
Fortunately, Xu Shiyan didn't bring too many kinds, just the main drugs of several pharmaceutical factories, and came to test the water.
It’s OK, it doesn’t matter if it’s not, because the domestic sales are pretty good.
Here was busy watching documentaries, tasting snacks, and placing orders. Suddenly, there seemed to be the sound of something heavy falling to the ground, and then a burst of exclamation was heard from outside the crowd.
Xu Shiyan, who was introducing the product to others, turned his head to look at the source of the sound.
I saw a fat foreigner about a dozen steps away from their booth, fell to the ground.
Beside him, two people knelt on one knee and tried to help him up.
"Don't move him, he can't move randomly in his current condition." When Xu Shiyan saw the situation, he hurriedly stopped him.
"He probably has a heart problem. If you move around at this time, it will aggravate the condition.
Hurry up, call an ambulance, and, does he have any medicine with him? "
The person lying on the ground is obviously a sign of a heart attack.
At this time, the patient must not be moved indiscriminately, as it will aggravate the condition.
When Xu Shiyan yelled, the staff at the other end went to call an ambulance immediately.
But the exhibition hall is very large, and it is quite far away from several main exits. If you run out and call an ambulance, it may take a long time for the ambulance to arrive.
The two people next to the foreigner might be his assistants. As soon as they heard Xu Shiyan's words, they immediately touched the foreigner's pockets.
Sure enough, he took out a small medicine bottle from a pocket, poured two small white pills, and stuffed them into the unconscious man's mouth with great difficulty.
But everyone waited for a while, and there was no sign of sobriety at all, and their complexions became worse and worse.
"Why hasn't the ambulance come yet? If it doesn't come, people will be in danger."
Xu Shiyan walked up to him, put his hand on the man's wrist, and found that the man's pulse was extremely chaotic, and the situation was very dangerous.
"President Xu, don't we have medicine for heart disease? Can we give it to him first?
The ambulance won't come, and the medicine he brought doesn't work well. Can we still watch someone have an accident? "
Beside   , the staff of the participating company suddenly remembered.
Among the medicines they brought over, there is a kind of heart-saving pill, which is very effective.
At this time, the man didn't think much, grabbed a box from the booth, and handed it to Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan rolled his eyes at his employees.
You idiot, can medicine be given to people easily?
None of them have the qualifications to practice medicine. Even Xu Shiyan's medical skills are not weak, but he doesn't have a certificate, so he can't treat people randomly.
Didn't you see that he just called for an ambulance? Why didn't he say that his pharmaceutical factory has medicine?
how? Do you really think he is so stupid that he forgot what he has? How can he not know what good things he has at home?
This can't be a nonsense.
It is easy for him to give medication, but this week, everyone in the circle is foreigners.
If people compare this to the truth, they will cause trouble if they just give medicine to people.

chapters.title: Chapter 748: save a life
chapters.content:
Chapter 748 Saving a life
The people from the pharmaceutical factory shouted this and handed the medicine to Xu Shiyan again. All the eyes of everyone around were focused on Xu Shiyan's hands.
Xu Shiyan took a deep breath and shouted at the surrounding staff.
"What are you looking at? If you don't rush to call for an ambulance, what are you still doing here?
If something happened to a foreign friend with you, would you be able to take responsibility? "
The anxious staff around heard it, and they also reacted, and ran away.
Not long after, a member of the organizing committee ran over panting.
"The ambulance won't be able to come for a while. Just now, there was an accident not far from our exhibition hall. Now the road is blocked."
"Crap, what a coincidence." Xu Shiyan cursed in a low voice.
"Sir, is your medicine easy to use? Please give our boss medicine.
If he doesn't take medicine, he may be really dangerous. "
The man's assistant was lying on the ground, seeing his boss's increasingly ugly face, he was also frightened, and stumbled to Xu Shiyan.
"We can guarantee that no matter what happens to Mr. Bell after taking the medicine, Mr. Bell will never be held accountable."
Xu Shiyan couldn't understand what the other party was saying. At least there was an interpreter next to him, and someone else was talking in a hurry, so Xu Shiyan hurriedly gave the person the medicine.
Even the members of the organizing committee looked at Xu Shiyan with sweaty eyes and expectant eyes.
"Mr. Xu, act urgently. If you can save someone, save them quickly. We will all testify to you."
"Everyone, saving people is the most important thing, and I can't take care of that much now.
I have to ask everyone to be a witness, now is a special situation, it is not that we take the initiative to give medicine to patients. "
Xu Shiyan glanced at the people around him and said.
Many people nodded, saying that they were the witnesses.
Xu Shiyan opened the package of the medicine, took out a small porcelain bottle from it, and poured out a few pills from it.
As soon as the pill was poured out, those who were near could smell the medicinal fragrance.
Xu Shiyan didn't say a word, pinched the man's jaw with one hand, made him open his mouth, and then stuffed two pills into his mouth.
This medicine is also taken in the mouth, no need to drink water, so just put it in your mouth.
After feeding the medicine, everyone stared at the man on the ground.
After less than ten minutes, the man's complexion seemed to ease, and his breathing seemed to be steady.
After a while, the man let out a long breath, moved slowly, and opened his eyes.
The crowd suddenly cheered, and the foreigner on the ground was quite puzzled, not knowing what was going on.
But he is still weak right now, and it is very difficult for him to speak, so he can only look at his assistant.
"Mr. Bell, you just had a heart attack and fell to the ground.
We gave you the medicine you carried with you, and it didn't help.
It was this gentleman who gave you the medicine produced by their pharmaceutical factory, and you woke up. "
The assistant has been with the boss for a long time, and there is still some tacit understanding, so he quickly explained to him.
The other party nodded towards Xu Shiyan, and said thank you weakly.
"You are welcome, there is a saying in our country that saving one life is better than building a seven-level pagoda.
The old man has also told us since we were young not to ignore death. "Xu Shiyan waved his hand
"How is Mr. Bell feeling?
If you feel okay, try to get up slowly and let the staff **** you to the hospital.
In your situation, it is best to go to the hospital for an examination, and hospitalization is also acceptable. "
Although Xu Shiyan is very confident in the medicines from his own pharmaceutical factory, in this scenario, it is best to let the other party go to the hospital.
Be safe, but don't make trouble.
Mr. Bell nodded, and two assistants helped him up with great effort.
Then Mr. Bell took out a business card from his pocket and handed it to Xu Shiyan.
"Hello, sir, this is my business card. If you have anything to do in the future, you can call me."
Xu Shiyan took the other party's business card, and handed him his own.
"Okay, Mr. Bell, let's talk again when we have time. I wish you a speedy recovery."
This time is not suitable for chatting, so we should hurry this Mr. Bell to the hospital.
It is about the safety of foreign friends, so it is better to be on the safe side.
Coincidentally, at this time, a staff member hurried over with several medical staff in white coats.
"Where is the patient? How is the patient?" A doctor asked.
"The patient is here, he took emergency medicine just now, and seems to be better.
Hurry up and send him to the hospital for a good checkup. "
Here, the person in charge of the organizing committee hurried forward to help **** Mr. Bell and his assistant to the ambulance outside the exhibition hall, and went straight to the hospital.
Watching Mr. Bell leave, Xu Shiyan bowed his hands to everyone around him.
"Thank you for your testimonies just now. Fortunately, I saved my life and woke up people."
In the situation just now, when foreign guests were involved, it was really difficult for Xu Shiyan to act casually.
As far as Bell’s condition is concerned, if you have silver needles at hand, you can wake up faster if you take medicine and acupuncture.
But still the same sentence, Xu Shiyan is not qualified to practice medicine.
If no one is serious about this matter, it will be fine. The big guys will say that this is a cure to save lives.
Especially to save foreign guests again, this is the best opportunity for our motherland medicine to make a name for itself, and it will make Chinese medicine look good.
But if someone really has to care about it, Xu Shiyan will be in trouble if he doesn't make a fuss all of a sudden, and it is not impossible to go bankrupt in a serious way.
No matter how good your medical skills are or how effective your medicine is, if you don’t have a medical professional certificate and are not within the scope of practice, this is called illegal medical practice, and there is no excuse.
Fortunately, the people around are not bad, they all testified, and Bell's assistant also promised.
Even so, Xu Shiyan was afraid for a while.
It's not that he is timid and afraid of being held accountable, but that he is afraid that he will get into trouble and cause trouble for the company and the leaders.
Especially at the Spring Fair, when everyone is looking forward to earning foreign exchange, some accidents happen, and the impact is too bad.
Most of the foreigners around couldn’t understand what Xu Shiyan was saying, but there were translators over there.
After listening to the translation, everyone laughed and applauded enthusiastically.
"Xu, you are amazing, and your medicine is also very good.
Come, let's discuss how your medicine can enter our country's pharmaceutical market. "
There are many people who have come to discuss with Xu Shiyan to see how to introduce the medicine from the pharmaceutical factory to them.
The curative effect of this heart-saving pill was witnessed by the big guy.
Everything just now shows that this is not a collusion between the two parties, but that the Xinxin Pill is really curative.
People from any country are afraid of death, and many people from European and American countries eat high-calorie food all day long.
A lot of people gain weight after reaching middle age, and the three-high population is also very large, with a high incidence of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases.
Now that such a good medicine has been discovered, who would be stupid and refuse to use it?
However, this drug has no European and American certification procedures. How to introduce it to the pharmaceutical market of various countries is a big problem that needs to be discussed.
Suddenly, the booth, which was already quite lively, was full of people on the inner three floors and the outer three floors.
These people have witnessed the curative effect of traditional Chinese medicine with their own eyes. Even if they don't need Jiuxin Pill, they have great confidence in the effect of other products on the platform.
So many people do not discuss the introduction of drugs, but also order some products in the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 749: break the record again
chapters.content:
Chapter 749 broke the record again
An unexpected episode at the Spring Fair made the medicine from Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory become popular, and many people asked Xu Shiyan about the efficacy of the medicine just now.
Anyone who deals in ginseng products is actually in their own country, and they are also engaged in related industries such as health care products and medical supplies.
In the past, what did those ginseng exports in Fusong do?
I really thought they were all eaten directly. In fact, people also took them back to extract the active ingredients, and then made them into medicines or health products, and sold them to various countries.
This depends on whose technology is higher.
Many countries are not origins of ginseng at all, but their companies produce medicines or health products mainly composed of ginsenosides.
Most of them are actually imported from here, processed and packaged, and then sold out.
It should be said that these people are all experts, and none of them are stupid. They can understand whether something is good or not better than anyone else.
The only shortcoming at present is that the medicines of pharmaceutical companies are not certified.
But this doesn’t bother them. Some people propose to introduce the medicine first, and sell it in the category of health care products for the time being.
Then find a way to help apply for certification in your country.
If you can really apply for it, these medicines can be sold in pharmacies as medicines in the future.
Xu Shiyan was not so optimistic about this.
If many countries apply for drug certification, the formula needs to be completely written into the application materials.
If this is an ordinary medicine, it’s fine, after all, it’s all prescriptions in medical books.
However, such as Jiuxin Pills are relatively advanced formulas, which belong to the confidential level, and it is impossible to leak the prescriptions.
So, this matter has to be considered in the long run.
Right now, it is possible to sell the medicine, even if it is sold in the category of health care products, as long as it can make money.
On the second day of the Spring Fair, according to common sense, the number of orders will drop, which is not as hot as the first day.
Because of this little episode, it unexpectedly kept the participation company's booth warm.
By the time the museum closed in the afternoon, the participating companies had already placed more than 10 million orders today.
Lin Qiyueguang was stamping there, his arms were so sore that he lost consciousness.
Later, the deputy mayor saw it and quickly took over Lin Qiyue's job.
