He went over to stamp, and Lin Qiyue made statistics here, which at least made Lin Qiyue breathe a sigh of relief.
In the next three days, the order volume began to decline.
But according to the statistics on the last day, this time, the participating companies set another record, earning more than 30 million foreign exchange.
With the ginseng market in such a bleak situation, it can be said that it is a miracle that the amount of foreign exchange earned by ginseng companies has not decreased but increased.
On the other hand, Bingshan Beverage Factory, this year's foreign exchange earnings are also very impressive, more than last year, almost tens of millions.
This time, no matter whether it is the county or the city, it can be said that they have made a lot of money.
Happy to Lin Qiyue and Jiang Yunfeng, they never shut their mouths.
"Shiyan, I must celebrate your achievements when I go back this time." Everyone said.
"Well, Forest Bureau, County Magistrate Jiang, I won't participate in celebrations or anything like that.
I still have a lot of things to do here, so I will be back a few days later. "
What merits are celebrated? Who has the spare time to celebrate? Can you do something else while you have time?
The factory here has not yet been built, and the store has not yet opened, and the family has to prepare materials quickly.
With so many orders, are there enough raw materials of all kinds, and what is missing needs to be stocked up quickly.
Busy, who has time to waste time outside? Stop and go home.
Lin Qiyue knew Xu Shiyan's temper very well, so he laughed when he heard this.
"Okay, then it's up to you, you can make arrangements for yourself."
It is also true that the participating companies have broken records in foreign exchange and celebrated every year. It is really nothing new, and it is no wonder that Xu Shiyan is too lazy to move.
If you think about it, it’s better to do less formal things and do more practical things to be serious.
The five-day Spring Fair ended, everyone came to clean up the booth the next day, and then Lin Qiyue and others hurried back.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying discussed it and decided to go back together.
Su Anying has been away from home for a long time, and it is time to go home and have a look.
Besides, the major event has been completed, and Ji Tongzhong and others are enough for the construction of the factory. Let Su Anying and Ji Yufeng go home to rest for a while, and come back in autumn.
"Daughter-in-law, when we go back, we will take a detour to the Shanghai stock market.
I want to go over and take a look. If possible, we have to make arrangements there in advance. "
It was Xu Shiyan's impromptu idea, or what Ji Tongzhong said that day, that made him suddenly have such an idea.
You must know that at this time, there is no shadow of Pudong New Area yet.
A few days ago, the country just issued a policy to develop and open up Pudong.
Northern, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen, Xu Shiyan and his wife have bought real estate in three of them.
There is still a factory here in Baoan. Although it is still a county right now, it will be Baoan District in a few years.
The only thing left is the Shanghai Stock Exchange, so it seems that we should arrange something in advance.
Not to mention anything else in the future, it will be a lot of wealth left to the children.
Su Anying has also experienced it now. Once her husband said it, she understood what it meant.
"Okay, let's go and have a look.
However, our family may not have much money right now, so buying land and building a factory may take a little effort. If we only buy a house or a shop, there is no problem. "
The store in Yangcheng has already invested hundreds of thousands of dollars.
The garment factory jointly established with Xu Shiqin also invested a lot of money.
Not to mention the factory in Baoan, where huge sums of money were invested.
Although it is said that Su Anying's company is co-organized with Dongfang Ginseng Company, and Ginseng Company holds 60% of the shares, that is quite a lot of money.
So at present, the funds of the Xu family are really not enough to turn around.
"It's okay, let's just go and have a look this time, don't worry about buying a house."
Xu Shiyan still knows something about the situation at home, he is just a suggestion.
The main thing is that I want to take my daughter-in-law around to have a look around, as if I am traveling with my daughter-in-law to relax.
"Well, as long as you know what's in your mind, I'm afraid you've spread too much and we don't have enough money."
Su Anying nodded, the man in his family is pretty reliable, not so ambitious and out of tune.
The money in the family, as long as it is spent in a decent place, there will be no harm.
The husband and wife discussed it properly, and then talked to Ji Yufeng, and asked Ji Yufeng to pack up and go back to the northeast.
Ji Yufeng followed Su Anying to Yangcheng and Baoan for a long time. Yang Junxian was busy working in the fertilizer factory at home, and the two were busy all over the world, and neither of them could take care of home.
Thanks to Yang Haoyu being grown up now, the old man and the old lady of the Yang family also came back from their daughter.
No matter what you say, when Yang Haoyu comes home at night, he can have ready-made meals, hot kang, and someone to do the laundry.
If the old couple of the Yang family didn't come back, it is estimated that Yang Haoyu would have to live in the Xu family.
After the discussion, everyone didn't delay here, so they quickly packed their luggage and headed back.
Ji Yufeng flew back to Shenyang by herself, and then returned home from Shenyang.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying took a plane from Yangcheng to Shanghai Stock Market, wandered around Shanghai Stock Market for five days, and then flew back to Shenyang to take the train home.

chapters.title: Chapter 750: Set up a sales office
chapters.content:
Chapter 750 Establishment of Sales Department
When Xu Shiyan and his wife returned home, it was already May 16th.
Li Chengrong and Li Zongliang went to the station to pick up people. As soon as they saw Xu Shiyan, Li Chengrong hurriedly reported the situation at home to Xu Shiyan.
"President Xu, all the orders this time have been fulfilled.
The missing raw materials have also been contacted with the origin of the medicinal materials, as well as the medicinal materials markets in Anguo and Camphor, to ensure that this year's orders can be successfully completed. "
Ninety percent of the orders are all kinds of deep-processing products.
Ginseng is the main raw material, but due to the large amount of orders, the demand for other medicines is also very large.
Only part of the medicinal materials can be provided locally, and a large part needs to be purchased from other places.
As soon as the people who went to the Spring Fair came back, all the management people from the company got together for a meeting.
Don't wait for Xu Shiyan to speak, it's time to prepare the medicinal materials, prepare the medicinal materials, and order the packaging.
The company has formed a good system at present, and the daily operation will not be delayed by Xu Shiyan's presence or absence.
It is mainly about the development of new products, which needs to be checked by Xu Shiyan.
"The leaders of the city and the province have called several times, asking if you have returned.
In addition, the second ginseng, the third ginseng, and the county pharmaceutical factory have also called you, but I don’t know what it means. "
Li Chengrong's words are to remind Xu Shiyan that it is very likely that these people are jealous and want to share some benefits.
"Well, okay, I see." Xu Shiyan nodded.
"Daughter-in-law, I'll take you back later, I'll go back to the company.
No matter what, I have to call the mayor back. "
Since he is back, he has to report to the leader, and then meet with Lao Li and the others to straighten out the company's affairs.
"Okay, you go back to work, I will go home to accompany my parents and coax the red children."
The couple took both planes and trains, and spent four or five days in the Shanghai stock market. They were really tired, and Su Anying wanted to go home early to rest.
So, the car drove to Xu's house in front of the martyr's tomb, Xu Shiyan and Li Cheng allowed them to help Su Anying take off all the luggage and send them in.
After May Day, daylight saving time is implemented, and the children don’t go to class until 2 pm, and they are still at home.
As soon as Su Anying came back, including Yang Haoyu, the five children surrounded Su Anying, hugged their mother and refused to let go.
"Dad, Mom, I'll go back to the company first and have dinner at night."
Xu Shiyan looked at the scene in front of him with a smile, and turned to talk to his parents.
"Well, go, come back early in the evening, your mother is going to make you big Yeqin dumplings."
In this season, the big leaf celery grows just right on the mountain.
Neighbors, relatives and friends, whoever went to the mountains to work and collected big leaf qin, would send two to the Xu family, so the Xu family has never been short of these.
Zhou Guilan knew that her son and daughter-in-law were coming back today, so she picked out all the vegetables in advance, washed them, cleaned them and boiled them, and only waited for the afternoon to make dumplings.
"Okay, then I'll go early."
Xu Shiyan nodded, followed Li Chengrong, Li Zongliang and the others to go out, got in the car and went straight to the company.
The office building of Dongfang Ginseng Company is still in its original location.
However, as the company grows larger and larger, the original building of the field department is not enough.
This year, the company plans to build another office building at the east end of the field department, and then move all the offices there.
Currently, construction of the new office building has started, and it is estimated that it should be completed before winter.
Xu Shiyan just arrived at the office, before he could sit down, Li Bingzhuo and others all came over.
"General manager, you have worked hard."
Li Bingzhuo and others came forward and shook hands with Xu Shiyan very excitedly, and Han Limin was so excited that he hugged Xu Shiyan.
Don't blame them, the truth is that the past six months have been under too much pressure.
Now that they have finally passed this hurdle, everyone feels a sense of ease.
Recalling the hard work of the past six months, there are many words that cannot be expressed in words, so I can only express it in this way.
"It's all the same, you have worked hard too, thanks to the big guys, we finally passed this level."
Xu Shiyan patted Han Limin on the shoulder and asked everyone to sit down and talk.
"I just heard from Xiao Li that the arrangement at home is very good, thanks to everyone." After everyone sat down, Xu Shiyan said.
"This time, when I was walking back, I passed by the Shanghai Stock Exchange and was delayed there for a few days.
Mainly, I also want to investigate the development trend of the new area. I think about setting up a sales office there. "
"At present, it is not necessary to build factories in other places.
We now have a pharmaceutical factory, and the health care product factory in Baoan is expected to be put into production by the end of the year.
Currently, I don't know how the health care product factory is developing, so I can't take too big a step. "
The cost of building a factory is too high, and it is not suitable for the current situation. It is not sure what will happen to Baoan.
But it is really necessary to have an export sales office in Pudong New Area.
Shanghai stock market is an international metropolis after all, geographically, it is much better than Donggang Songjianghe.
If the company wants to develop, it can't just point to the annual Spring Fair and old customers' additional orders, but also to display its products through various channels.
Shanghai stock market happens to be such a window.
Find a better place over there, the entire sales department and office, just to help with import and export related matters, which is much more convenient than here.
"Well, that's a good idea, our side is indeed too far away, and we received all kinds of information late.
It should be better if we set up a sales office in the Shanghai stock market and directly face foreign businessmen. "
Li Bingzhuo and the others thought it made sense
"Let the general manager decide, we will listen to you anyway."
Everyone is absolutely convinced of Xu Shiyan, isn't it just a store, and it doesn't have much money.
"Okay, let's settle this matter for now.
Anyway, I’m not in a hurry, I’m just waiting for when I’m too busy, the company will arrange for someone to go over and get the job done. "
Xu Shiyan just gave a suggestion, don't rush to do this matter.
"By the way, Mayor Guan called this morning to ask when Mr. Xu will be back.
Otherwise, you should call the mayor first. "
After finishing what should be said, Li Bingzhuo remembered that the city leaders had called in the past few days, so he reminded Xu Shiyan.
"Okay, then I'll call Mayor Guan right away."
Xu Shiyan nodded, and grabbed the phone on the table. After seeing it, Li Bingzhuo and others got up and left the office one after another.
"Leader, I'm back. I just sat down in the office. I heard that the leader is looking for me."
Here, the phone was connected, and there was news of Guan Enxue, Xu Shiyan laughed.
"If the leader has any instructions, I will listen."
"There is no instruction, this time your company has done a good job again, I wish you a happy."
On the other end of the phone, Guan Enxue said with a smile. "I heard that you rescued a foreigner over there?"
When Xu Shiyan heard this, his heart skipped a beat. "Leader, has someone sued you?"
This matter was indeed a helpless move at the time, and he didn't want to get involved at all.
But the situation at that time was really out of the question, it was just a coincidence.
"It's not enough to file a complaint, it's just that someone muttered a few words and was pushed back by the provincial leaders."
The headache is still going on, and I need to take painkillers. I am so worried that I dare not go to the hospital at this time. I can only wait for a few days to see it.

chapters.title: Chapter 751: Hurry to verify
chapters.content:
Chapter 751 Hurry up to verify
Guan Enxue did not mean to blame Xu Shiyan for calling Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan and the ginseng company have made a lot of efforts and made a lot of contributions to the development of the local ginseng industry. It cannot be said that it is just for such a small matter.
Besides, they have also learned about this matter, and the situation was special at that time.
If it was delayed by that Mr. Bell and caused any consequences, the matter would be even more serious.
On this point, Xu Shiyan is actually meritorious.
The reason why Guan Enxue brought up this matter was also for Xu Shiyan's good.
"Shiyan, I remember you mentioned before that you have studied medicine with Mr. Chu for many years.
Did you go to the relevant department to register for the master-student certification relationship last year? "
"Well, yes, in the first month of last year, I happened to accompany Mr. Chu back to the province to celebrate his birthday, and registered with the relevant department."
Xu Shiyan was a little dazed, not understanding why Guan Enxue suddenly turned a corner.
Didn’t you just say that you saved a foreigner, did someone gossip about it? Why did this suddenly change to the teacher's certificate?
"That's it, with such good conditions, why don't you hurry up and pass the exam?
Our city has a test site this year, how about this, I'll have someone sign up for you, and remember to come for the test when the time comes. "
Traditional Chinese Medicine Practitioner Qualification Certificate has test sites in every city.
Guan Enxue didn’t pay attention to these before, so he didn’t pay attention either.
Because of Xu Shiyan's matter, he asked someone to inquire about it.
Like Xu Shiyan, who is not a medical professional, as long as he has a certificate of teacher-student relationship certified by the relevant department, and has studied with the teacher for a certain period of time, he can take the exam.
There is no academic requirement, you can take the exam.
"Oh, thank you, leader.
I didn’t dare to think about it before, because I was afraid that my half bottle of water would be embarrassing when I ran to the exam. "
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan immediately thanked Guan Enxue.
"Since it was the leader who spoke, even if I go back to my head, I have to work hard and get my certificate."
Let’s take a test. People say that you don’t get overwhelmed if you have too many skills. In Xu Shiyan’s case, you don’t get overwhelmed if you have too many certificates.
Take the exam if you can. Since the conditions are not so strict now, get the certificate first.
"That's right, after passing the test, I see who has something to say? We have this strength, right?"
Guan Enxue laughed as soon as he heard it. He liked Xu Shiyan's seriousness no matter what he did.
"Okay, nothing else, you must be very tired after going out this trip, go home and have a good rest for a few days.
If there is anything that cannot be solved in all aspects of the company's production, you can call me and I will help you. "
Guan Enxue was very happy when he heard that Xu Shiyan agreed to do research.
I didn't mention anything else, after chatting with Xu Shiyan for a few words, I hung up the phone directly.
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone, shook his head and smiled, leaned back on the back of the chair, closed his eyes and meditated.
He's been too busy these days, and there are too many things going on, he has to think about it carefully, and don't miss anything.
Just thinking about it, the phone on the desk rang again.
Xu Shiyan stretched out his hand to pick it up. On the other side of the phone was Wu Qiming, the director of the second field.
"Oh, Mr. Xu is very busy, it's really not easy to find you." The other party was very eager on the phone.
"Director Wu is too polite, it's all a waste of time."
Xu Shiyan held the phone in one hand and a pen in the other, and drew freely on the paper in front of him.
"I've been busy with the Spring Fair for a while, and I went to investigate later, didn't I just get home?"
Xu Shiyan didn't ask why the other party called him over and over again, just chatting.
"Yes, yes, Mr. Xu is in trouble now, your company has broken records year after year, and you are a big celebrity in the city and province.
It is normal to be busy. If you are not busy, where do you get so many foreign exchange orders, right? "
Over there, Wu Qiming laughed and echoed Xu Shiyan's words.
"Ahem, that, Mr. Xu, I want to discuss something with you."
Wu Qiming paused on purpose just now, waiting for Xu Shiyan to answer.
As a result, Xu Shiyan didn't say anything, and Wu Qiming couldn't hold his breath anymore, so he could only speak first.
"Mr. Xu, your company has so many foreign trade orders, do you know if you have enough raw materials for this year? Can you be busy?
I have no other meaning, that is, can Mr. Xu help us? "
Wu Qiming didn't hold back in the end, and expressed his intention.
"Mr. Xu, we used to be participating in the county, and we were also brother companies after all.
Alas, it’s difficult now, you don’t know, last year we almost couldn’t even pay our wages.
Once the price of this mallet drops, the venue will not be able to sell the mallet, and the employees will almost lose it, let alone the income from the contract. "
Before Xu Shiyan could say anything, Wu Qiming started complaining on the phone.
"You also know that our second participation is not as solid as your first participation.
There is no such capable person as Mr. Xu. If he can't produce products that can be exported to earn foreign exchange, he points to the province to buy them.
But now the province does not buy according to the previous quota. You said that we have so many ginseng fields, how can we fix the sticks in the fields? "
Xu Shiyan held the phone and listened to the other party complaining on the phone, but he didn't say a word.
Xu Shiyan has been working in the field for many years, so don’t you know what’s going on in the field in the county?
Ercan Field, located in Xingcan Town, was established in 1957 and currently employs nearly 700 people.
Despite the small number of employees, the ginseng business area is not small. Back then, the ginseng production area was 40,000 square feet.
The second ginseng farm not only grows ordinary garden ginseng, but also specially introduced American ginseng from abroad a few years ago, and the planting was successful.
It is said that the American ginseng cultivated in Ershenchang has passed the identification of Nanjing Pharmaceutical University. The main ingredients and content have reached the level of similar foreign products.
A few years ago, while one participant was researching the deep processing and comprehensive utilization of the ginseng industry, several other participants were not far behind.
Each of them put a lot of energy into researching the deep processing and finishing of ginseng products.
The several kinds of champagne concentrates in Quanyang Factory were provided by Ershenchang.
In addition, Ershenchang has also researched ginseng tea, ginseng clove tea, ginseng fruit granules, Schisandra granules, fresh ginseng honey, ginseng syrup, top-quality ginseng wine and raw materials for ginseng tobacco, etc.
Among them, some products failed, failed to be put into production, or were put into production but not sold.
However, there are also some products that have gained a lot of profit by cooperating with other factories or selling them through the county ginseng company.
Moreover, now only the price of garden ginseng is not good, but the price of American ginseng is rising all the way.
Currently, the local price of a catty of American ginseng is four to five hundred yuan, right?
Moreover, it is said that the supply is in short supply, and foreign merchants are rushing to place orders.
Even if the market for ginseng has plummeted, wouldn’t it still be possible to sell some of it?
Combined with the profit of American ginseng, the second ginseng will not be unable to pay wages or afford food.
Then what is Wu Qiming's reason for calling to cry poorly?
I'm afraid, it's not just as simple as wanting to provide raw materials here, right?
Wu Qiming on the other end of the phone became more and more pitiful as he talked, and he was about to cry.
However, Xu Shiyan on the phone didn't say a word, and didn't follow Wu Qiming's intention and agree to any request.
Wu Qiming was a little confused, why didn't this Xu Shiyan play cards according to the rules? Why are you silent?

chapters.title: Chapter 752: no way to take advantage
chapters.content:
Chapter 752 There is no way to take advantage
Wu Qiming was just like Mrs. Xianglin, complaining about her suffering for a long time.
It is nothing more than wanting to arouse Xu Shiyan's sympathy, and want Xu Shiyan to nod in agreement. This fall, the second ginseng may provide raw materials to Dongfang Ginseng Company.
Or part of the order can be allocated and the second participant can help complete it.
In this way, the second participant can earn more money.
This intention is too obvious, no matter how stupid Xu Shiyan is, he can still hear it.
"Master Wu, I just came back, and I haven't checked the order with the factory yet.
You have to give me some time, let me check a pair, and roughly calculate, to know if there are any gaps in the raw materials, right? "
"As you said, we used to be participating in the county, brother units.
If there is really a big shortage of raw materials on my side, it doesn’t matter who we buy raw materials from, and we all have to pay, so it must be the brother unit first, right? "
The Spring Fair has more than 30 million US dollars in orders, plus nearly 20 million orders from previous old customers. Just these, the demand for ginseng is quite large.
In addition, the pharmaceutical factory has to store a large amount of ginseng, and the southern health care product factory needs a large amount of ginseng.
Based on this calculation, even if there are 40,000 feet of ginseng in the field this year and 30,000 feet of forestry bureau to make goods, it is estimated that the gap is not small, and it is indeed necessary to buy ginseng from other places.
Originally, Li Bingzhuo and the others had considered buying it from Donggang Canshi or Sanhu.
Donggang is a large ginseng producer, with many ginseng farmers and high ginseng output, so purchasing locally saves worry and effort.
But Er Shen opened his mouth at the other end, so he had to give Wu Qiming a little face.
When Xu Shiyan led Huang Shengli and the others to develop ginseng seeds and wanted to buy more ginseng seeds, he evened out a lot from the second ginseng field.
The two sides are more or less friendly, and it is not good to not give a little face.
Anyway, whoever is accepted will be accepted, so it doesn't matter if the second participant is accepted.
As for dividing orders, that is impossible. Their technology and recipes are kept secret. How can they distribute orders casually?
But unexpectedly, when Xu Shiyan said this, the other end of the phone fell silent.
"Mr. Xu, look, these are all brother units, so there must be some sympathy, right?
Look at my side, there are so many workers to support, and there are also quite a few family members of the employees.
Otherwise, can you share some order with us? Just right, let those family members also earn some money or something. "
Co-authors nagged for a long time, they didn't want to sell raw materials at all, they were eyeing the orders of participating companies.
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this.
"Director Wu, I'm sorry, we have a lot of employees and family members in the field, and there is no place to arrange for these family members alone.
We can complete the order by ourselves, no need to distribute it outside. "
Hehe, what a big face, what is the second participation? Do you have the nerve to open your mouth to divide the order?
It's a way to give them face by agreeing to accept the raw materials. Is this going to be a shame?
No, it won't be that simple, this is an idea to learn technology secretly.
In the future, they will also produce some products and sell them for more money.
Then I'm sorry, Xu Shiyan is not a living Bodhisattva, but he doesn't have that much compassion.
If you want to make money, you have to rely on your ability.
Going to him to get cheap? no way.
Xu Shiyan directly refused, and Wu Qiming choked for a moment, so he couldn't continue talking.
What else can I say? They have clearly refused, how can he still beg for nothing and beg again?
It's useless to beg, it's a joke for nothing. Come on, don't say anything.
"Since this is the case, don't bother Mr. Xu. If Mr. Xu needs help with anything in the future, just ask."
Wu Qiming said a few words casually, and hung up the phone.
The phone hung up, Xu Shiyan sat there lost in thought.
Li Chengrong said that Sanshenchang and the county pharmaceutical factory had called, so needless to say, the purpose should be similar to that of Ershenchang.
I can see that this year is not going well, and they are all thinking about the company's orders.
If these people call, it doesn't matter, he just refuses.
I'm afraid that these people will talk to someone above, and then find someone to intercede. This kind of thing is really unprepared.
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan picked up the phone again, called Guan Enxue, and told Guan Enxue what happened just now.
Guan Enxue immediately assured Xu Shiyan that as long as Xu Shiyan didn't nod his head, no one would say it would work, and the order would never be distributed.
With Guan Enxue's guarantee, Xu Shiyan felt at ease now.
Looking up at the watch, it was four o'clock, and he promised his parents to go back early this afternoon.
Since there is nothing too important in the unit, he should go home quickly.
He agreed to Guan Enxue. He is going to take the exam this year. The exam will be in mid-September. Now he has to study quickly.
This is what Guan Enxue asked to take the exam. If he fails the exam, not only will he be ashamed, but Guan Enxue will also lose face, right?
Just like that, Xu Shiyan explained to the secretary that he can call home if there is something urgent.
Then I didn’t use the driver to drive. I drove to Canchang Elementary School by myself, parked the car aside, and stood at the gate waiting for my daughter and daughter to leave school.
At 4:30, Sanchang Primary School closed, and the children came out of school with their schoolbags on their backs.
"Xu Haiqing, Xu Jinhui." Xu Shiyan saw his two little ones and hurriedly waved to them.
"Dad, why are you free to pick us up?" The two children were very happy when they saw his father coming to pick us up.
Dad is usually busy, so it would be nice to be able to send them to school in the morning, but he never came to pick them up from school.
The two children hugged Xu Shiyan's arm, smiling very happily.
"Didn't your grandpa say, let me go back early today to make dumplings?
It happens that there is nothing to do in the afternoon, so I come to pick you up, and the three of us will go home together. "
Xu Shiyan reached out and took off the schoolbags on the shoulders of the two children.
Children in the first grade probably have mathematics and Chinese in their schoolbags, plus a few books on nature and art, and at most a few homework books.
Compared with the students of later generations, he is much lighter.
"Go, get in the car, go home."
Xu Shiyan carried two schoolbags in one hand and put his arms around the child in the other. The three of them walked to the front together and got in the car to go home.
The Xu family is very busy here. Su Anying has been away for such a long time and has come back. Why don't Su Weizhong and his wife come over to have a look?
In addition, Su Anzhen and Su Anfang also lived nearby, so they happened to bring their children over and ask what their man was like outside.
Nan Xiaoming, Nan Xiaoliang, and Ji Hongliang are about the same age as Xu Haiqing.
Several children gathered together, chattering very lively.
"You guys, if you have homework, hurry up and do it, don't make trouble here.
After making the dumplings later, I call you to eat. "
Su Weizhong saw that the grandchildren were too noisy, so he spoke, calling the children to do their homework first.
Nan Xiaoming and Xu Jingyi are both in the third grade, and Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui are in the first grade. These two have homework.
Nan Xiaoliang and Ji Hongliang are studying in Yuhong Class, and going to elementary school in autumn.
Although there is no homework in school, I have to learn something when I go home, so I all went to Westinghouse.

chapters.title: Chapter 753: Candidates for store manager
chapters.content:
Chapter 753 Candidate for store manager
The children all rushed to the West Room to do their homework, and the East Room suddenly became much quieter.
Xu Shiyan just took the opportunity to discuss something with Su Anfen and Su Anzhen.
"Third sister, fourth sister, there is something I want to discuss with you two.
Didn't your second sister and I set up a shop in Yangcheng? I want you two to come over and help run the store. "
The new store has just started, so it must be managed by someone you can trust.
Su Anfen and Ji Tongzhong have managed Shanhuozhuang here for a long time, and they are most familiar with how to manage specialty shops, so Xu Shiyan plans to let them take over the store in Yangcheng.
Su Anying bought several shops and houses in the capital a few years ago, and they are currently rented out. One shop is due this winter.
Xu Shiyan meant that it is better to take it back and keep it and open a shop by yourself.
Su Anzhen and his wife helped Ji Tongzhong last year, so they have some experience.
Let the two of them learn in Yangcheng, and then let them take care of the shop in the capital.
"Yes, your second brother-in-law said that your salary will be double the local salary, and you will be given 10% of the shares.
When we were there, we mentioned it to Xiao Ji and Zhendong, and they didn't have any objections, as long as you nodded. "
Over there, Su Anying chimed in.
The reason why the couple made such considerations is that the store must be managed by their own family members, and they are absolutely worried about managing it by outsiders.
There is really no one suitable for Xu Shiyan.
The brothers of the Xu family all have serious jobs, so it is impossible for them to drop their jobs and run to watch the store.
Ji Tongzhong and Nan Zhendong, on the other hand, have no official jobs.
Arrange for them to manage the store and share 10% of the shares. They make a lot of money, and Xu Shiyan and his wife can rest assured.
Another one, Ji Tongzhong and Nan Zhendong are currently in the south.
What to say, women are less likely to have something happen when they are away from home, but it is really hard to say when men are outside.
Especially Ji Tongzhong, that face is really attractive.
Right now on the construction site, it’s just a group of old men, that’s all.
But what if I meet someone in the future?
If Ji Tongzhong really had something wrong with him, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying shouldn't be held responsible?
As Zhou Guilan said, if the couple stays apart all the time, then it’s not called living.
So it's better for the couple to be together, and it's safer.
Sisters Su Anfen and Su Anzhen really didn't think about it, but when they heard it, they were both stunned.
"Second sister, second brother-in-law, we can go to such a big city and help you manage such a big store, can we do it?"
Both of them were a little hesitant. Like them, the farthest they have ever been before was to go to the Hun River.
Now I’m going to Yangcheng and Beijing to open a store, why do I feel guilty?
"Then what else? Both of you have gone to junior high school and are educated, not much better than me?
Look at me, can't I go anywhere now? "Su Anying laughed when she heard that.
She, who has never studied in a day, dares to go anywhere in the world.
These two still went to junior high school anyway, just manage a shop, what else is so great?
Hearing what Su Anying said, everyone in the Su family suddenly remembered that they seemed to have forgotten about it.
That's right, the only girl in the Su family who never went to school is now the most promising one.
Su Weizhong sighed and coughed lightly.
"Third, fourth, your second sister and second brother-in-law are very considerate, if you want me to tell you, just agree.
You go and get busy first, let your mother take care of the child. After you are all settled there, take the child over there. "
Su Weizhong is at this age, what things can't be seen through?
Second daughter and second son-in-law, this is really planning for the younger sister and brother-in-law below.
If the store is well managed, the daughters and aunts will all take root in the big cities in the future, and the children will also take over to study there. Isn’t it better than Donggang?
"Yes, yes, what your father said is, I will take care of the child for you, so don't worry." Han Cai'e also hurriedly persuaded.
This is a good thing. Others haven't had a chance to go there yet.
When others enter the city, they all go to work, or they are on construction sites, or they are working as babysitters.
The daughter of the Su family went to the city to manage the store, and she had wages and shares. Not to mention being the boss, she would not be far away.
Such a good job, whoever refuses to agree is a fool.
Su Anfen and Su Anzhen thought about it, and what their parents said made sense.
If it weren't for their sister and brother-in-law to take care of them, would such a good job be their turn?
"Okay, then I will listen to the arrangement of the second sister and the second brother-in-law." The two sisters did not hesitate, and agreed very simply.
"Okay, then it's settled. In two days, I will arrange for someone to send you to the south.
Go to see Xiao Ji and the others first, then you two go to watch the store decoration, and then recruit a few shop assistants.
We will start stocking up here immediately, and we will start shipping in two months. "
The store in Yangcheng is quite big, and there is a lot of preparation work in the early stage. Su Anying still has to take care of this side, so she has to find someone close to her to take care of it.
Everyone was talking and chatting while making dumplings.
At 5:30, the dumplings are finished, so hurry to boil water and get ready.
Xu Haiyuan walked in after school at 6 o'clock, and the dumplings happened to be fished out and served on the table.
Xu Haiyuan eats as soon as he enters the door, so he doesn't have to complain that he's hungry.
"Master, Mayor Guan told me to sign up for this year's medical license exam.
It just so happens that I don’t have much work to do recently, so I have to bother Master to show me the back of the book.
If I fail this test, it would be too shameful. "
During eating, Xu Shiyan sat next to Chu Xuanhuai, whispering to Chu Xuanhuai in a low voice.
"Why did you think about the exam again in the middle of the day?" Before Chu Xuanhuai could speak, Xu Chenghou spoke first.
In his opinion, his son is now looking towards his forties, and he is the general manager of the company, and he is not a doctor.
What kind of test should I take again? It seems a bit unnecessary.
"Father, that's what happened. This Spring Fair, I saved someone."
Xu Shiyan told his family about the fact that at the Spring Fair, he saved a foreigner who had a heart attack with a heart-rescuing pill from the factory.
"I don't have a medical qualification certificate, this is called illegal medical practice.
Someone must have questioned this matter and wanted to pursue it.
I guess the leaders of the province knew the news and supported me to settle the matter. They couldn't say anything else later, so they told me to take a test.
If I can pass the exam, it will prove my strength, and it will be more convenient for me to do anything in the future. "
This is Xu Shiyan's speculation, because Guan Enxue only mentioned it in one sentence, without going into details.
Actually, on this matter, even if he has passed the examination, he can't do whatever he wants.
Once you have a certificate, you have to determine the scope of practice, and it is not allowed to go beyond the scope of practice.
But since the leader has spoken, no matter what happens in the future, Xu Shiyan must take the test for this certificate, and he must pass the test.
This is a matter of attitude, the main thing is not to embarrass the leader, or else the leaders above will support it for nothing?
Xu Chenghou finally understood that behind the co-authoring of a certificate, there are so many twists and turns.
"Yes, then you should work harder.
You have been fishing for three days and posting on the net for two days these years. I guess the little things you have learned can’t catch up with Yuanyuan. "
I reckon I got angry a while ago, not Yang.
The main reason is that during this period of time, the children are taking online classes at home, playing solitaire and posting this and that in the group every day, without stopping at all. When I started talking about my son's final exam on the 19th, those teachers rushed to the class like crazy, leaving homework for the child, and there were piles of homework for each subject. I had to stay with him until half past eleven every day.
I just stayed up all night like this and ended up staying up for more than a week in a row, so I didn’t feel very good.
Now I just have a headache, but I have no other symptoms. Besides, I don’t go out very often, so it shouldn’t be Yang.
The main reason is that I have a headache at night and can't sleep, and I don't have any energy during the day. It's a vicious circle. I'm taking medicine, let's take care of it for a few days, I guess it will be almost healed in a few days.

chapters.title: Chapter : come up and ask for leave
chapters.content:
Come up and ask for a leave
Dear friends, sorry, I have to ask for leave.
My cousin passed away this morning, and we rushed over to help with the funeral.
My cousin is fifty-two years old. He was divorced a few years ago. There is only one daughter who is only twenty-five. She is not married, has no partner, and knows nothing.
We, the brothers and sisters, have to help with the funeral.

chapters.title: Chapter 754: Get rid of the burden
chapters.content:
Chapter 754 Shaking off the burden
When Xu Chenghou said this, everyone in the room couldn't help laughing.
Xu Shiyan also laughed, "Father, you don't need to say things that everyone knows."
Lao Tzu is not as good as his son, that's what he should be, otherwise how can this generation improve?
Being inferior to his own son, Xu Shiyan didn't feel too embarrassed.
As far as his eldest son is that evildoer, he is not the only one who can't compare, probably most of the people in this world can't compare, so, don't be ashamed.
"Brother Chu, I have to trouble you again this time, give me advice.
Don’t worry about what you say, if you’re not quick enough to sharpen your guns, you’ll get your certificate, right? "
Xu Chenghou seemed still unwilling to let go of his son, so he turned to talk to Chu Xuanhuai again.
Chu Xuanhuai was also laughing, "Okay, okay, don't worry, this matter is on me.
Shiyan had a good background. Although he was busy these years, he did not stop studying.
Let me sum it up for him again. If you review carefully, it will not be difficult to pass the exam. "
Chu Xuanhuai is still very confident in his apprentice. Although Xu Shiyan is not as spiritual as Xu Haiyuan, he has enough experience.
It takes a lot of hard work to get a certificate easily.
The whole family ate delicious big leaf celery dumplings amidst laughter.
After eating, Chu Xuanhuai called Xu Shiyan over, and instructed Xu Shiyan which books to read and how to review them.
Most of this exam is based on the basics. As long as you study carefully, it is still easy to pass.
From then on, Xu Shiyan went to work during the day and went home to read books at night. If he had any questions that he didn't understand, he would ask Chu Xuanhuai for advice.
Anyway, everything is running normally at the company.
The management of the company knew that Xu Shiyan was going to prepare for the exam, and everyone tried to bear as much as possible.
Those who can not bother Xu Shiyan will not go to him, so that Xu Shiyan can review with peace of mind.
During this period, Xu Shiyan asked someone to send Su Anfen and Su Anzhen to Bao'an, where they joined Ji Tongzhong and Nan Zhendong.
Su Anying brought Huang Shengkai and the others together to collect wild vegetables and various mountain products as soon as possible.
On the one hand, supplying goods to foreign merchants, on the other hand, preparing for opening a store.
Second participant Wu Qiming suffered from Xu Shiyan's failure, but others didn't know.
Sanshenchang and the county pharmaceutical factory also called one after another, wanting to discuss with Xu Shiyan and ask Xu Shiyan to share some orders with them.
Especially the county pharmaceutical factory, the profit has not been good in the past two years, and the factory seems to be unable to sustain itself.
It is also a pharmaceutical factory, and there is no way to continue there, and it seems that it will not survive.
Xu Shiyan's side is booming. Not only can many medicines enter the hospital pharmacy, but now there are export orders.
How can it be said that it is not enviable?
No matter who calls, Xu Shiyan just said that we can drive as quickly as possible without dividing orders to outsiders.
Now is not the era of the planned economy. If you want to dial out anything, you can always dial it out, and you can borrow it if you want it.
Now there is no such thing.
The products that our factory technicians have worked so hard to research, stay up late and work overtime, and spend so much effort to win customers and orders, why should they divide them out?
All the families returned home without a feather, and when things went wrong, they began to look for leaders, and went to the county to cry, saying that life was going to be hard.
Chang Hongfa also suffered from headaches from these people.
But in this matter, Guan Enxue has already issued a death order, and no one is allowed to have any ideas about the company.
Are you kidding me?
How much foreign exchange does a province earn today? The amount of foreign exchange earned by a participating company has caught up with the entire region.
Anyone who dares to cause trouble for participating companies will be causing trouble in the city, and they will be dealt with, right?
Chang Hongfa had no choice but to promise the county to reduce taxes and fees and give some subsidies.
Encourage all participants to learn from the participating companies, be more active and find a way out.
"Secretary Chang, the current situation is just that the ginseng company is booming. In fact, the ginseng market in our county has not yet risen.
It is not an option to continue like this. They can't come and cry for poverty, and the county will give them relief and subsidies.
It’s also difficult in our county. There are many places that lack money, so it’s not enough. "
Some people think that Chang Hongfa's handling is not appropriate.
"The key now is not how much tax relief we give or how much subsidies we give.
Instead, it fundamentally solves the problem that the price of ginseng has fallen, ginseng farmers cannot make money, and the entire ginseng industry is in a downturn.
Since his participating company has this ability, it should bring everyone together to make money.
Instead of taking orders by themselves, co-authors, they are now very rich, and other places have to tighten their belts to live?
The ginseng company is a state-owned enterprise, right? It's not Xu Shiyan's alone, so why let him have the final say? "
No matter when, there are always people with pink eye.
In the past, the ginseng industry was booming, and everyone could make money growing ginseng.
Whether Xu Shiyan brought a team to participate in the field or participated in the company, if he earned a lot of money, the big guy would be envious at most.
Apart from envy, most of them will sigh, the manager Xu and the general manager Xu are really capable.
The same stick, after they process it, can be sold for several times the price and the profit will be doubled.
But now, the entire industry is in a downturn, and no one else is making money, but participating companies are making a lot of money.
Naturally, other people will look at her with displeasure, envy and jealousy, and everyone wants to take advantage of it by taking advantage of it.
It’s okay if you take advantage of it. Some people may think about the benefits of joining the company, and some people may take advantage of it and say that it should be done.
If it doesn't take advantage of this, let alone mention it, you can say anything.
"The participation company, didn't that also evolve from a participation?
Didn’t the county support and help in those years, could we be where we are today?
Oh, the co-authors are now very powerful, they have become a municipal enterprise, and their wings are hardened, so they don’t miss the old feelings at all, right?
This is too careless. "There are quite a few people with red eyes, and they all agree.
It should be said that Chang Hongfa's personality is not as strong as Guan Enxue's.
Don't look at him being promoted now, in fact, he can't hold down these people below.
Chang Hongfa was **** off by these people, full of anger.
"Okay, you have the ability, you can talk to your superiors, don't tell me.
All I know is that now the participating company is not under the jurisdiction of the county, and I don't have such a big mouth, nor such a big face. "
Chang Hong shook his face and left angrily, but the discussion behind him didn't stop.
"If you want me to say, it's better to give all the other participating companies to the participating companies.
Anyway, the market is bad now, and no one knows when the price of sticks will pick up.
Throw it to participating companies together, maybe you can get some benefits in exchange. "Someone said so.
"What are you thinking? Are you an idiot when it comes to participating companies? People are willing to carry the burden?"
The person next to him shook his head, thinking it was a stupid move.
"Look at what you said, there are so many participating sites in the county, and they are all assets.
Isn’t the participating company short of raw materials? Just take over the past, so there is no need to buy additional raw materials.
Workers are also ready-made, how nice? "
The remarks of some people in the county quickly reached Xu Shiyan's ears, and Xu Shiyan just sneered when he heard it.
"They all think we are stupid, if our company wants to buy raw materials, where can't we buy them?
Now just go out and shout, saying that we will accept the hammer, and I don’t know how many people will squeeze their heads to sell the goods.
I still need to annex those participating companies, and then be responsible for their development, and pay wages and pensions to those workers?
When our brain is kicked by a donkey, cut it. "
Merging other participants is a big pit, whoever jumps will be stupid.
The current price of ginseng is so low that all ginseng companies rely on deep processing and export in order to maintain profitability.
Earning 30 to 50 million foreign exchange per year is already the limit of the company.
Where the market is, no matter how much you buy and process, you still have to be able to sell it.
Xu Shiyan is now trying his best to expand the market through various means.
But this requires a process, not a one-off thing.
Even if you think of more ways, it is impossible for participating companies to monopolize all the market, and it is not bad to occupy a small part.
So don’t be greedy, and don’t try to annex several other ginseng markets, and then monopolize the ginseng market to become the leader, that’s all a dream.
The ginseng company has small arms and legs, compared with foreign capital tycoons, it is a scumbag.
So, the bird is developing quietly, and it is good to earn some money carefully, but don't have any unrealistic ideas.
Ginseng market continues to decline, at least in the next three years, there is no possibility of recovery.
Even if it was a little better in 1995 as it was in my previous life, it would only be a little better, and it would be impossible to return to the previous peak.
However, the cost of planting ginseng has been rising year after year, and the profit margin of ginseng farming has been gradually reduced.
In this case, the more the company invests in planting, the greater the cost, and relatively speaking, the less profit.
It is better to maintain the current state. There is a part of the gap that can be solved by purchasing raw materials directly, saving worry and effort.
From 1996 to 1997, these participating factories, like other state-owned factories, reached the bottleneck period of development.
Otherwise, the shareholding system reform would not have been carried out, but this would only quench thirst with poison and would not solve the fundamental problem.
Wait until the turn of the century, with the end of the 33-year plan, the venue will have to face the situation that there is no place to use, so it can only disintegrate.
Xu Shiyan is worried now, how will the company develop in the future, and he still has the leisure to merge other companies?
What is the purpose of the merger? Pick up the mess and give those workers a pension?
Don't talk about assets, in Xu Shiyan's view, those so-called land, machines, equipment, etc. are worthless.
If this is in a coastal city in the south, the land can still be worth a little money, so don't think about it here.
The second ginseng field is in Xingcan Town, the third ginseng field is in Xintunzi Town, and the fourth ginseng field is in Yushu Township.
These places are not even worth developing, so why use the land?
So, those participants gave Xu Shiyan their change, but Xu Shiyan didn't even bring it.
Actually, there are really some people in the company who have the ambition to annex other participants and become bigger and stronger.
So when they heard the news from the county, they were very happy and thought it was a good opportunity.
Xu Shiyan was quite worried about this idea and spread it within the company.
Therefore, all the management of the company was specially summoned and a meeting was held for everyone.
Of course, he can't say it too bluntly. He can't say in front of so many people that he despises those few participants as useless, right?
How bad would it be if people spread the word? What does the leader think of him if he knows it?
So Xu Shiyan told everyone how difficult it is for the R&D department and how hard it is for the sales department. Everyone has worked hard to achieve today's results.
Right now, as long as they can hold on to the current results, that would be a great achievement.
Don't be too ambitious, don't sing high-profile, or do things down-to-earth, step by step.
Regarding Xu Shiyan's remarks, the people below also have different ideas.
Some people think that what Xu Shiyan said is right, a ginseng can go from a county-owned ginseng to a city-owned ginseng company, relying on down-to-earth development step by step.
Some people also think that Xu Shiyan is timid and too conservative.
The development prospect of the company is very good, why can't it take a bigger step?
No matter what other people think, Xu Shiyan and the company's main cadres have the same idea.
Everyone believes that it is not suitable to expand at present, and it is good to hold on.
After all, there is a daily chemical factory and a flooring factory to be built this year. If both of these can be developed, it will be very good, and we should not be greedy.
With the support of these people, the opposition of others is irrelevant.
So whether it's the county leader or the city leader, when they call to insinuate, Xu Shiyan has the right to pretend that he doesn't understand, and simply ignores the arguing.
Otherwise, they complained to the leaders, saying that their research and development is not easy, and the marketing and sales department is hard.
The leaders had nothing to do with the trouble, so they didn't dare to mention it again.
In a blink of an eye, May and June passed, and it was the beginning of July.
The construction of the flooring factory and the daily chemical factory is progressing steadily, and the construction of the health care product factory in Baoan is also very fast.
In addition to being busy with company affairs, Xu Shiyan is reading and studying.
Su Anying stayed at home for the time being, and after finishing her work on purchasing wild vegetables, she devoted all her energy to stocking up the souvenir shop that was about to open.
During this period, that Mr. Bell had contacted Xu Shiyan.
At that time, Mr. Bell woke up after taking the medicine and was sent to the hospital. He recuperated in the hospital for a period of time, and his condition improved.
Among the medicines given to Mr. Bell by the hospital, there is also Jiuxin Pill produced by Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory.
So Mr. Bell was very interested in this drug, so he contacted Xu Shiyan, and when his condition improved a little, he would come to the pharmaceutical factory to inspect it himself.
Xu Shiyan has no opinion on this.
In fact, since the Spring Fair this year, many foreign customers have expressed that they want to come to Changbai Mountain to have a look.
The main reason is that these two documentaries are so attractive that many people want to watch them for themselves.
Is Changbai Mountain really as beautiful as it is shown in documentaries? Is the food in Changbai Mountain really that good?
For this reason, Xu Shiyan also asked people to reorganize and redecorate the company's guest house and canteen.
Specially hired several master craftsmen with excellent craftsmanship to be responsible for receiving customers.
You know, this is also a window for external publicity.
It will be of great help to the development of the company and even the future tourism prospects of the Changbai Mountain area, so it must be paid attention to.
At the end of June, Xu Haiyuan participated in the subject competition.
The so-called competition is actually a joint questioning by the county and the city.
The participating students will take the exam in the exam room of each school, and after the exam, the papers will be collected and graded.
This is the case for the competitions in the first and second grades of junior high school. In the third grade of junior high school, there are only three subjects left: mathematics, physics and chemistry.
This is to go to the county to participate in the preliminary competition, and after the selection, it will go to the province to participate in the semi-finals.
"Dad, I heard from the teacher. I seem to have won prizes in biology and geography."
Thank you for your concern, my cousin's funeral has been completed.
Today, this is a combination of two and four thousand characters. I really don’t have much ability to code words. I will post these first. If I am in good condition during the day, I will write more.
The current situation outside is full of sheep, and my family and I wear masks all the time, which probably won't help. In addition, it is the coldest in the Northeast at this time, and the coffin shed is outside, and the two charcoal stoves are used to warm up the coffin, and it is freezing.
I felt a sore throat yesterday afternoon. This morning my head hurts, my back hurts, and my legs hurt. I don’t know if it’s a sheep. I guess I can’t run.
Medicine and food are all prepared, just squat at home and wait for the sheep, there is no way. The child was sent to his grandparents' house, and we were left to hurt each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 755: Into the mountains to carry ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 755 Entering the mountain to carry ginseng
Xu Shiyan has not been so busy recently, so he leaves work normally every day.
When I got home this afternoon, I found that my eldest son was at home. I only found out after asking.
The last subject in the afternoon was geography, and Xu Haiyuan handed in the paper early and ran home.
Xu Shiyan didn't ask how his son was doing in the exam.
It was Xu Haiyuan, who took the initiative to mention it, saying that the result of the competition came out, and he might win the prize.
"Well, it's pretty good, work hard.
By the way, how many days do you take the exam for? When will you finish the exam? After you finish the exam, go out with me to do some errands. "
Xu Shiyan planned to go to that Shilazi in the big house and dig up all the remaining sticks on the platform.
This trip is estimated to take several days. He doesn't want to take others with him, so he should take his eldest son with him.
"The exam will be over the morning of the day after tomorrow. After the exam, it will be a holiday. Just go back to school in a few days to listen to the results and get the homework for the holiday."
Xu Haiyuan didn't know what his father asked him to do, but since he was called, there must be something important.
"Dad, how many days does it take to go out to do errands?
If it takes a long time, I will tell the teacher in advance, and I can ask someone to help me get the grades and homework. "
"Well, it's estimated to be a week, not sure.
Okay, you can find someone to help you get it. "
Xu Shiyan thought for a while, if the clubs on the platform were still there, it would probably take a few days.
Of course, other situations are not ruled out, so set aside a week, it should be about the same.
Just like that, the father and father made an appointment, and when Su Anying came back, Xu Shiyan talked to his wife again.
Su Anying knew about the mallet on the platform, and thought that Xu Shiyan didn't plan to go back.
Since the two of them were going back to dig the club, Su Anying hurriedly prepared food for them.
It has been a long time in the mountains, and pancakes are a must-have. No bread or cake can compare to this thing.
In addition to pancakes, pickles, meat sauce, etc., Su Anying also prepared instant noodles and ham sausage.
These two things are new gadgets nowadays, and they must be taken when traveling.
July 12th, the junior high school exam is over.
In the early morning of the 13th, Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan packed up their bags, loaded them into the car, and prepared to go up the mountain.
As a result, that rambunctious ghost who ran away for many days and only came back last night followed Xu Shiyan closely, refusing to leave no matter how hard he pushed him away.
Xu Shiyan saw that there was no way out, so he could only let Lai Pigui and Xu Haiyuan sit in the back seat of the jeep.
Just drove the son and the fox and left home.
The construction of the cascade power station has not yet started, and the upper reaches of the Xijiang River have not been cut off, and there is a lot of water in summer.
Xu Shiyan and his son had to take a boat if they wanted to cross the river.
If they took a boat, they would inevitably alarm the villagers, so Xu Shiyan and his son could not go to Shilazi with peace of mind.
So Xu Shiyan drove from the county to Xigang, and then drove from Xigang to the big house.
The road from Xigang to Qingling is not easy.
Fortunately, it was a jeep that drove past Qingling, a few miles away from the big house.
Xu Shiyan managed to park the car on the side of the road, then took his son and the fox, got out of the car and walked to the place where he found the ginseng.
While walking, Xu Shiyan told his son what happened when he went to the mountains to release them.
At that time, how was he chased by the black blind man and had nowhere to escape, so he ran to the side of Shilazi, but it was a blessing in disguise, and met a bunch of sticks.
"Dad, you met that piece of wild ginseng in the summer of 1977, right?
It’s been more than ten years. Will someone find out that the mallet has been dug away? "
Xu Haiyuan was carrying a huge luggage bag, and followed behind Xu Shiyan. It was okay at first, and he didn't fall behind at all.
Children do not have that long-term strength, and they are a little tired later, and they are panting heavily.
“I came back to see it twice before, and the mallets below are still there, but I haven’t been back in the past two years, so I don’t know what’s going on.
I guess it should be nothing serious, unless you jump down there, you won't find it on the top. "Xu Shiyan was also exhausted and panicked.
After all these years, I haven’t made much effort, and I’ve been sitting in an office.
Not to mention his age, he is almost forty, which is incomparable to what he was back then.
My father and I left the house at 3:30 in the morning. After driving around for a long time, it was 7 or 8 in the morning.
Get out of the car and enter the mountain, with a break twice, when they came to the pine tree by the cliff, it was already ten o'clock.
"It's right down here, see? There's a platform underneath.
You wait, I will tie the rope, and we will go down the rope. "
When they came under the pine tree, Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief, and the two of them put down the big backpacks behind them.
Xu Shiyan dug out a long rope from his bag, one end was tied with a pig's trotter buckle on the tree trunk, and the other end was slid under the ladle.
Xu Shiyan went down first, walked around the platform, and found a lot of ginseng.
In this season, the ginseng seeds seem to be unfinished, and they are still green, which is the time when Dajiabianer City is transitioning to Qinglangtou City.
Although the ginseng seeds are green and the same color as the surrounding grass and leaves, Xu Shiyan has many years of experience in mountain climbing.
According to the local people, it means killing grass with eyes.
It was easy to find traces of ginseng from the green grass and bushes on the platform.
Seeing Shen, Xu Shiyan was relieved, so he went back to the rope and shouted towards it.
"Yuanyuan, you roll the things down first, and then you come down again.
Lumpy ghost, try to see if you can hold it down, or let it jump down by itself, and I will continue below. "
Lai Pigui definitely can't stay on it, so he can only bring it down together.
Xu Haiyuan heard his father's shout, and after responding, he rolled the things the two brought down from above.
Xu Shiyan caught the backpack and other things underneath, put them aside, and then stood below waiting for his son and rascal to come down.
Xu Haiyuan carried Laipi Gui on his back with leggings, then he held the rope with both hands, stepped on the Lazi stone wall, and came down the rope bit by bit.
Xu Shiyan was below, picked up his son, and Xu Haiyuan landed safely.
After untiing Laipi Gui, Lai Pigui shook his big tail and wandered around on the platform.
As a result, it just took a few steps when it found the ginseng on the platform, so it jumped back immediately, biting Xu Shiyan's trouser leg and pulling it forward.
"Yes, yes, I know there are ginseng on it, if it wasn't for this, could I bring you here?"
Xu Shiyan was amused by the rambunctious ghost, and quickly found out from the luggage the tools for lifting gins, such as a mallet lock, deer bone sticks, Kuidang axe, and Kuidang scissors.
Xu Shiyan meant that this time, he almost lifted all the mallets from the platform away.
So you don’t need to worry about the size of the ginseng, just carry it next to each other.
But Lai Pigui was unwilling to live and die, so he had to drag Xu Shiyan forward.
Walked all the way to the middle of the platform, and then Lai Pigui walked around a Liupinye seedling in the middle.
"Dad, does it want you to carry this ginseng first? Oops, this is Liupinye.
Didn't you say that you carried away all the sixth-grade leaves on it? Is this a new leaf? "
Xu Haiyuan walked over to have a look, and asked a very strange question.
"It's possible, after all, it's been thirteen years, and the five-rank leaf at the beginning may also grow into a sixth-rank leaf."
Things like wild ginseng can be dormant.
Sometimes in the beginning of spring, when there is drought or other unexpected situations, it is likely that the wild ginseng will not germinate this year, and will be dormant in the ground, and will germinate in the soil when the conditions are suitable.
That's why there are often such legends, saying that they met ginseng when they entered the mountain, but for some reason they didn't dig it out.
So I left a mark and waited to dig it next year, but it disappeared the next time I came.
People will mistakenly think that the ginseng ran, but in fact it is likely that it did not germinate afterwards.
Xu Shiyan was not sure what happened to the extra sixth-grade leaves on the platform.
It is hard to say whether the fifth-rank leaf has become the sixth-rank leaf in the past ten years, or whether the sixth-rank leaf was not unearthed that year.
But the one that Lai Pigui led Xu Shiyan to look at has a thick stem and a large ginseng seed.
So Xu Shiyan estimates that it may not be the new sixth-grade leaves that have grown in recent years.
It is very possible that this ginseng tree was not unearthed the year he came here.
Or else, he didn't pay attention at the time and was left behind.
After all, so many years have passed, even if Xu Shiyan has a good memory, it is impossible to remember the location of every ginseng.
There are many ginseng on the platform, Xu Shiyan greeted Xu Haiyuan, and tied all the ginseng he found with red cloth strips.
According to the rules, it should be locked with a mallet, but there is only one mallet lock, which is tied to the six-pin leaf that Lapigui found.
Others can only be marked with red cloth strips, so as not to be confused with the surrounding grass and bushes.
Xu Haiyuan took the rambunctious ghost around on the platform, looking for ginseng.
It is estimated that the fox has a particularly sensitive sense of smell. This rascal is much more powerful than Xu Haiyuan.
Shaking its big fluffy tail, it hopped here and there, and when it found a ginseng, it yelled at Xu Haiyuan.
As soon as Xu Haiyuan heard the rascal whining, he went over immediately, found the ginseng, and tied it with a red cloth.
After a while, Lai Pigui led Xu Haiyuan to find more than ten trees.
Among them, there are two Liupinye trees. The stems seem to be a little thinner, and the ginseng seeds are not that big.
Amidst the green, the red cloth strips are tied, which is particularly conspicuous, so there is no fear of missing anything.
Xu Haiyuan and Lai Pigui went to find Shen, while Xu Shiyan started to find a way to build the master's mansion first.
After setting up the master's mansion, he folded three wooden sticks and lit them as incense. He called Xu Haiyuan, and the two of them kowtowed.
This is the rule of letting go of the mountain. The first thing to do when entering the mountain is to worship the mountain god.
Even if Xu Shiyan came for this platform this time, he couldn't ignore the rules he should have.
After worshiping the old man of the mountain god, Xu Shiyan climbed up to collect a lot of firewood, filled it with water, and cut a few poles to build a shelter from the wind and rain.
Nowadays, building a shack is much easier than before. You only need to use a pole to build a shelf, and directly cover it with a piece of plastic sheeting, which is windproof and warm.
The shack was quickly set up, Xu Shiyan found something to build a fire, first boiled some water in a small aluminum pot with two ears, and cooked two packets of noodles.
Greeted Xu Haiyuan to come over, and the two ate pancakes with instant noodles.
No matter what, you can only work when you have a full stomach.
After eating, Xu Shiyan found some Artemisia annua and other things, threw them on the fire, and smoked the mosquitoes.
Only then did I take the reference lifting tool and start to lift the reference.
The first ginseng tree is naturally the one that Lai Pigui dragged Xu Shiyan to see.
Xu Shiyan cleared the weeds around the ginseng, then took a deer bone stick, and started to go down the ginseng stem, pushing away the soil bit by bit.
This work must be done carefully and carefully, and not too anxious. Fortunately, Xu Shiyan is very patient and does not feel boring at all.
Xu Haiyuan marked all the participants on the platform, and there is nothing wrong now, just helping Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan handed him whatever he used, and the father and father cooperated very well. After an hour or so, the shoulder of the ginseng tree was finally exposed.
Xu Shiyan looked at it and felt that this ginseng was not small.
"I didn't expect that such a big tree fell on the platform.
This place is really a treasure. If it weren’t for the construction of a dam upstream, the environment here would be easily destroyed.
Just keep it like this, and wait for another 20 or 30 years, and these mallets will grow even bigger. "
Xu Shiyan muttered to Xu Haiyuan while carrying the ginseng.
Xu Haiyuan laughed when he heard this, "Who can say this kind of thing accurately?
Even if the dam is not built, it must be lifted when it is necessary, otherwise who knows what accidents will happen? "
Xu Shiyan agreed when he heard it. The things in the mountains are not the vegetables in his own vegetable garden after all.
Not to say that the participants will not encounter any natural disasters, but what if someone also discovers this place?
After all, wasn’t Xu Shiyan also discovered such a secret place?
The father and father chatted casually for a few words, and Xu Shiyan concentrated on promoting the ginseng.
This ginseng tree is not too small. Xu Shiyan has been busy from noon until it was almost dark at night, so he finally brought out the first ginseng tree.
"This ginseng tree must be at least four or five taels long. It can be processed and kept for many years."
Xu Shiyan looked at the ginseng tree in his hand and liked it very much.
Quickly found moss and birch bark, took some soil from the original place, carefully wrapped the ginseng, and put it in their backpacks.
It was too late to continue carrying ginseng, so the father and father took a bite to eat, and then got into the shack to rest.
There is a layer of branches on the ground, and a mattress of roe deer skin, which insulates against the cold and moisture, and it does not feel cold when lying on it.
The middle of July is supposed to be the hottest season, but the night in this mountain is chilly.
Especially this platform is right next to the river, so there is a lot of water vapor at night, making it even cooler.
Fortunately, the two of you have a lot of luggage, and there is still a fire outside, so it can be warmed up by roasting.
In addition, Lai Pigui is lying between Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan, this natural fur is warmer than anything else, so it won't be cold.
The shack is made of plastic sheeting. The white plastic sheeting is transparent, and you can see the sky full of stars when lying in it.
"Father, how did you spend seven or eight days under the stone ladle?
Where does the water come from? Are there any beasts at night? "
Xu Haiyuan thought this scene was very interesting, and couldn't sleep at night, so he asked his father what happened back then.
"Yes, there were wolves at that time, I was below, and I could hear the wolves howling above.
But they dare not come down, so I am not afraid. "Xu Shiyan smiled and told his son about the situation back then.
"In recent years, wolves have become less and less. Even if there are, they are all in the deep mountains and old forests. There are no such places here. Don't be afraid."
"Drinking water is easy. Go up here and walk southwest for a while. There is a small river ditch. Just get water from there."
The father and father were lying in the shack, looking at the sky above their heads, and Xu Shiyan told his son about the things he used to watch and hunt in the mountains.
Xu Haiyuan was fascinated by what he heard, and kept asking this and that.
The father and father babbled and didn't know when, so they went to sleep separately.
Xu Shiyan brought his son on the mountain, so naturally he didn't dare to be careless.
I got up several times at night, checked the surrounding situation, and then added firewood to the fire to keep the fire alive overnight.
This night, apart from the movement of night owls in the mountains, there were no other sounds of wild animals, wolves or anything, and no movement was heard at all.
During the summer in Northeast China, it is early morning, and the east side is bright at three o'clock.
Xu Shiyan couldn't fall asleep either, so he simply got up and lit a fire to boil water, and then started to lift the ginseng.
Two chapters combined into one. I have a fever and my whole body hurts, let's change these first.

chapters.title: Chapter 756: The rascal makes another contribution
chapters.content:
Chapter 756 The rascal makes another contribution
Xu Shiyan led his son and the fox and stayed on the platform for five days.
During the five days, Xu Shiyan carried out all the ginseng on the platform.
The biggest one is the Liupinye, and there are two Liupinye, which are a little smaller, but not bad.
Four fifth-rank leaves are okay, and the remaining fourth-rank leaves, Dengtaizi, and Erjiazi are relatively small.
Xu Shiyan didn't dislike the small ones at all, he carried them all out and carefully wrapped them with moss and birch bark.
"These big ones are concocted when they go back, and they are all life-saving medicines.
The small ones, I will find a suitable place to close them up later, and raise them for another ten or twenty years, and they will grow up to be quite big. "
The secret spoken by Xu Shiyan is also a kind of local dialect, which was left by the former Fangshan people.
After the Qing Dynasty entered the customs, the Changbai Mountain area was sealed off and no outsiders were allowed to enter.
However, the Manchu nobles had a very large demand for ginseng, which obviously could not be satisfied by relying on the soldiers of Dashou Ula Yamen.
So at that time, Dashang Ula Yamen issued ginseng tickets to some people, and those who took the ginseng tickets and went to the mountains to dig ginseng were called planers.
Planers go into the mountains to dig ginseng, and sometimes the ginseng they bring out is too small to be exchanged for money.
So I found a suitable place next to the shack where I lived, and replanted the small ginseng in the ground. This is called Yishan ginseng or seedling ginseng.
Let’s talk about it now, it’s called wild ginseng.
Not to mention, when the wild ginseng is transplanted to a new place, it has sufficient nutrition, and its growth is better than before, and it can grow up in a few years.
Then the planer handed in the young ginseng as old mountain ginseng in exchange for wages.
The quality of young ginseng is inferior to that of wild ginseng. This use of young ginseng as wild ginseng was discovered by the imperial court during the Jiaqing period.
It is said that at that time, among the fifty-nine catties and seven taels of ginseng, thirty-seven catties and thirteen taels were seedling ginseng.
The emperor was furious and ordered more than 30 local officials to be investigated and dealt with. They were either dismissed from their posts and interrogated, or demoted three ranks in a row. Jilin General Xiulin ordered him to commit suicide.
Since then, officers and soldiers have searched the mountains from time to time, and if they find planers cultivating seedlings and ginseng, they will destroy them all.
But this kind of thing is repeatedly prohibited. In order to preserve the ginseng, the planer tried every means to hide the ginseng in a secret place.
Therefore, there is this secret.
Later, when people cultivated garden ginseng, the ginseng seeds could produce water seeds and dry seeds.
Dried seeds have a high opening rate, a high survival rate, and are relatively uniform.
The water seeds have not gone through the dormancy period, and the opening rate is not good. It is very likely that the seedlings will not emerge in the second spring after being sown, but will come out in the third year.
So when the ginseng seeds are planted, there are three flowers mixed in five leaves.
Sanhua is very small, just like a matchstick, but farmers with poor conditions are reluctant to take such seeds.
So it was replanted in the original field, and then planted again after a year or two. This is called dense seedling.
Of course, generally speaking, the dense seeds are not in good shape, and they are rarely raised for transplanting.
Most of them have been in the field for two years. In the local dialect, it is called a roll, and then they get out to make goods.
Although this Yishan ginseng, or ginseng, is not as valuable as wild ginseng, it is still good to keep it for medicinal purposes. After all, its medicinal value is much higher than that of garden ginseng.
Xu Shiyan’s plan was to find a suitable place later, close up the small ones, and carefully cultivate and keep them.
