As long as it doesn’t rot, just keep it in the ground and dig it out when you need it later.
Xu Haiyuan doesn't know much about this, anyway, he just listens to what his father said.
That's it, early in the morning of the sixth day, the two of them packed up their things.
Xu Shiyan climbed up first, and Xu Haiyuan was underneath. They tied their backpacks and other things to the rope, and Xu Shiyan dragged them up.
After that, Xu Haiyuan picked up the rascal again, and dragged the rope to climb up.
Xu Shiyan also pulled the rope on the top to help his son climb up quickly.
After Xu Haiyuan and Lai Pigui came up, Xu Haiyuan let go of Lai Pigui.
The two of them put on their big rucksacks and walked back along the original road, planning to go back to find their car.
Xu Shiyan is familiar with this side, he leads the way in front, and Xu Haiyuan leads the rascals to follow behind.
Xu Haiyuan was a teenager after all, and he hadn't been in the mountains much, and he didn't go as fast as Xu Shiyan.
Xu Haiyuan was stumbling, stumbling and chasing his father behind him, but the rascal didn't know what was going on, but suddenly jumped out and ran to the side.
"Lumpy ghost, come back quickly, we have to go home, we can't run around outside." Xu Haiyuan saw it and hurriedly yelled.
But the rascal didn't pay attention at all, and ran forward anyway. Xu Haiyuan was worried that the rascal would get lost, so he had no choice but to chase it away.
Xu Shiyan walked in front, about ten steps away from Xu Haiyuan.
When he heard Xu Haiyuan shouting, he looked back and saw that Xu Haiyuan had already chased the rascal and ran towards the south.
"Yuanyuan, come back, that rascal can't lose it." Xu Shiyan hurriedly called his eldest son.
In the past few days, when Xu Shiyan went to fetch water, Lai Pigui would follow him to find a place to hunt.
When it is full, it will bark on the lazi, and Xu Haiyuan will eat it again.
The place on the platform is really too aggrieved, it is estimated that the rascals are here to have fun.
But Xu Haiyuan has chased for a while now, and the rascal in front is still running while turning his head and wagging his big tail at Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan's temper also came up, and he ran after the rascal without saying a word.
When he ran, Xu Shiyan could only follow him, yelling at his eldest son while running.
In the mountains and forests, I saw such a strange scene.
A fox with a bright fur color quickly shuttles through the forest like a ball of fire.
A boy in the back was carrying the boss's rucksack with a lot of things hanging on it, and he was chasing the fox behind.
Further back, a man was also carrying a large rucksack with a pot on it, and the man was walking and shouting.
Lai Pigui ran very fast, but after running for a short distance, he turned his head to look at Xu Haiyuan, and then shook his big tail.
When Xu Haiyuan was about to catch up with it, Lai Pigui turned his head and ran again.
An angry Xu Haiyuan chased after him closely, but Xu Shiyan behind him had nothing to do, so he could only chase his son and the fox, and ran for a while in the woods.
Lai Pigui turned around in front of him and ran for more than ten miles.
The Xu family's father and father, who were carrying so many things on their backs, were so exhausted that they had to stop to rest.
"No, why is this rascal so crazy today? What is it going to do?"
Xu Haiyuan was so tired that he leaned on a tree and gasped for breath.
No matter how healthy a person is, he can’t carry such a heavy thing on his back and run for more than ten miles in the mountains and forests.
What's more, Xu Haiyuan is only thirteen, still a child.
Xu Shiyan looked up at the sky, then at the tree, and identified the direction.
"Here, it seems that it is not too far from the place where your mother and I saw references, right?
At that time, I was on this mountain, and saved the rascal from the mouth of the wolf. Is this guy homesick? "
Although these years have passed, Xu Shiyan still has a little impression of this mountain. It seems that it is not too far from the Qianchuan ginseng land of the big house.
"It's not right, it doesn't even have a daughter-in-law, how can it be homesick?" After Xu Shiyan finished speaking, he laughed first.
After so many years of raising Lai Pigui, I have never seen Lai Pigui bringing back a female fox or something, and I don’t know if this fox has a wife.
Xu Haiyuan hadn't recovered yet, when he heard what his father said, he laughed while panting heavily.
And Laipi Gui, who had already run far ahead, turned around and found that the two of them hadn't followed.
The little guy tilted his head and looked around, then bounced back.
Whispering, biting Xu Haiyuan's trouser leg, insisting on dragging him forward.
"Dad, where does the rascal want to take us?
I remember that year when we went into the mountains and met a snake, it did the same. "
Xu Haiyuan looked at the rascal who kept biting his trouser leg at his feet, trying to drag him away, and asked thoughtfully.
Xu Shiyan became energetic when he heard this, "Oh, I can't tell."
This little thing is full of spirituality, and it has been in the mountains and forests all year round. I can’t guarantee what it is to take them to find.
"Go, follow it, let's go and see."
Just like that, the two of them followed Laipigui, and walked into the woods for more than an hour, and came to a mountain nest.
Xu Shiyan saw this place, the wind is sunny, the trees are lush, oh, the place is not bad.
"Yuanyuan, follow Laipigui closely, I feel that there should be participation in this area." Xu Shiyan instructed Xu Haiyuan.
Before Xu Haiyuan agreed, Xu Shiyan saw a red pine tree not far away.
It was roughly as thick as a person's arms, and a piece of bark was peeled off from the trunk about one person above the ground, revealing the essence of the wood, and omens were engraved on it with an axe.
Looking at the omen, the years will not be short.
"Son, there is an old sign here. Come quickly." Xu Shiyan yelled and called his eldest son over.
"Look, it's engraved on it. At that time, someone dug up a seedling of sixth-rank leaves and two seedlings of fifth-rank leaves near here."
Xu Shiyan pointed to the old sign and explained it to Xu Haiyuan.
Although Xu Haiyuan is talented in learning, but he has never experienced these things, how can he know?
The child is very interested in these and listens to his father's explanation very carefully.
"Father, according to what you said, there should be ginseng nearby, right?"
Xu Haiyuan asked after hearing the origin of the old omen.
"Well, this old omen has been around for more than a hundred years. If we follow our old rules of letting the mountains go, keep the big and keep the small, there must be ginseng nearby.
Of course, after so many years, no one knows if someone has come here and found the old omen. "
Xu Shiyan raised his head and glanced around, just in time to see Lai Pigui looking at them with his big tail dangling.
"Laipigui, you brought us here, is there any ginseng here?" Xu Shiyan asked casually.
In the end, the skinny ghost let go of his joy, bouncing and bouncing on the spot, then turned around and ran forward.
"Let's go, let's follow the rascal."
With Lai Pigui here, there is no need for the two of you to search hard, just follow along.
The two of them followed Laipigui and walked to a position less than 20 meters southeast of the old sign. Lapigui stopped and wandered around a tuft of grass.
Xu Shiyan stepped forward and found a ginseng tree in the grass. "The club." Xu Shiyan shouted hastily.
"How many leaves?"
Xu Haiyuan stayed with his father on the mountain for several days, and knew a lot about the rules of releasing the mountain, so he asked.
"Six Pin Ye."
Xu Shiyan stared at the seedling ginseng in front of him, looking at the thick stalk, he was really moved.
This rascal, as long as it makes a move, it seems that there is no small one.
"How many?" Xu Haiyuan continued.
"The mountains are full." These words are purely beautiful and yearning, just auspicious words, so don't take them seriously.
Of course, if you can meet a six-leaf tree that looks quite old, it is very possible that the mountain is full.
"Quickly be fast."
Xu Haiyuan never looked down on these old rules, but followed them in a regular manner.
Xu Shiyan had already pulled out the mallet lock while he was talking to his son.
Folded a branch from the side and inserted it next to the six-pin leaf of this seedling, and then hung the mallet lock.
Hang up the mallet lock, then you will definitely have to lift the ginseng.
Based on Xu Shiyan's understanding of rascals, this little guy seems to be able to find a big deal every time.
The tree in front of me should not be too small. It is estimated that the two of them will not be able to go down the mountain today.
"Yuanyuan, you stay here, I'll collect firewood and build a hut."
Fortunately, before going out, Su Anying brought them a lot of food.
During the five days on the platform, I have eaten less than two-thirds, and the remaining food should last for three to five days.
The father and father work together in a division of labor, Xu Haiyuan guards here, wandering around with the rascals looking for ginseng.
Xu Shiyan went to collect firewood, chop wood to build a shack, and fetch water.
After Xu Shiyan finished all these things, Xu Haiyuan found a few ginseng trees under the guidance of the rascal ghost.
So, the father and father made some food, and then Xu Shiyan started to carry the ginseng.
Lai Pigui's shots are always big ones, and this one is not small.
Xu Shiyan was so happy that he didn't know what to do. When he was resting at night, he hugged the rascal and rubbed the rascal's hair.
"This little thing, why is it so smart?"
Lai Pigui didn't care how happy Xu Shiyan was, he just covered his body with his big tail, curled up between Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan, and slept soundly.
The past few years are no longer what they used to be. There are far fewer wild animals. In addition, the fire outside is always burning at night, but there are no wild animals coming to harass.
Xu Shiyan and his son stayed in this mountain nest for another four days, and brought out two seedlings with six-pin leaves and three seedlings with five-pin leaves.
Xu Haiyuan wanted to wander around again, but Xu Shiyan refused.
"Let's go back, we've been out for a long time this time, your mother should be anxious at home."
Originally, it was said that he would go back in a week at most, and it has been ten days since then. Su Anying, the head of the family, must be going crazy?
Hurry up and go back, lest the family worry.
"Lumpkin, don't make trouble this time, we have to go home.
Even if you have a mallet, you can't look for it. "Xu Shiyan touched Lai Pigui's head and said.
"Let's go, lead the way, let's go back."
When I came here, I was chasing the rascal, and I walked too fast, and I didn't remember some of the roads clearly.
Although Xu Shiyan can pull the forest away, it takes time and effort to identify the direction and find the location by himself.
With Lai Pigui here, this little guy must know the way, let him take him away.
Lai Pigui seemed to understand, so he jumped ahead, leading Xu Shiyan and his son out of the forest, and went straight to their parking place.
The car has been parked on the side of the road for ten days and has not moved.
Cars are not very common these days. When most people see them, they will only think that they belong to some unit. Most people dare not destroy them.
Besides, many people have moved out of Dafangfang and Qingling, and there are few people here, so the car remains the same.
But on the car window, a lot of bird droppings were pulled by the birds.
Xu Shiyan saw it, and could only get some water from a small ditch, wipe the car windows, and then drove Xu Haiyuan and Laipigui back the same way.
By the time Xu Shiyan and his son returned to Donggang, it was almost dark.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan kept talking at home, "Tell me how old the third child is, why are you still so out of tune?
He actually took Yuanyuan to the mountain, what if something happens to the father and son on the mountain? "
Xu Chenghou was worried about his son and grandson, so he couldn't help mumbling.
"Yingzi, where did the two of them go? Did you tell me before you left?
Otherwise, arrange someone to go into the mountain to look for it. "Zhou Guilan was also worried, and sat there sighing.
"Dad, Mom, he said he took Yuanyuan to the big house.
Originally said he would be back in a week, who knows why he hasn't come back after ten days. "Su Anying is also anxious.
Take all precautions, but still fail, both children in the family have a fever. There is no way, I can only pick it up from my grandparents' house, and the three of us have **** together. The guy in my family is standing among the sheep and trembling now, and he probably will fall when we recover.

chapters.title: Chapter 757: deep cooperation
chapters.content:
Chapter 757 Deep Cooperation
When the jeep stopped outside the gate of Xu's house, everyone in the house was circling anxiously.
Suddenly Xu Haiqing yelled outside, "Grandpa, grandma, mom, my dad and my elder brother are back."
When everyone in the room heard it, they all rushed out.
At this time, Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan had just got off the car and were carrying luggage down.
Seeing that all his family members came out, Xu Shiyan hurriedly explained.
"Father, mother, daughter-in-law, something has delayed this time for a few days. Let's go into the room and talk about it."
It’s not easy to take out so many ginseng outside, right? It's better to go into the room, sit down and talk slowly.
Xu Chenghou nodded, "It's fine if you come back, we're just worried about what happens when you two go out.
Yuanyuan is only a child, what are you doing with him? What if something goes wrong? "
The old man's words were really heartbreaking to Xu Shiyan's ears.
The person who is so impatient with his father is the eldest grandson, not the third son at all.
"Father, you are so partial."
Xu Shiyan shook his head and smiled wryly. Anyway, his status in the family is declining again and again, alas, sad.
"Don't talk nonsense to me, how old are you? I used to run in the woods all day long, why am I worried about you?
Can my eldest grandson be the same? He's only thirteen, and he hasn't been in the mountains much, so what if something unexpected happens? "
Xu Cheng gave his son a thick look. This is a joke, and he started to compete with his son for favor.
Xu Shiyan smiled, followed Xu Chenghou and others into the room, and Chu Xuanhuai who was staying at the clinic over there also came.
Seeing his apprentice and grandson returning safely, Chu Xuanhuai also heaved a sigh of relief.
"What's the matter in the future, take two more people out, or we will be worried at home."
Chu Xuanhuai couldn't hold back, and also warned.
"Master, I won't go to the mountains anymore."
All the wild ginseng on the platform were carried back, and even if he was given money, he would not bring them into the mountain again.
Chu Xuanhuai nodded, followed everyone into the room, and sat down in the east room.
Xu Shiyan glanced at Xu Haiqing, then at Xu Jinping.
Xu Jinping understood immediately, dragged her younger siblings and left.
"Let's go, let's go, have you completed the task I assigned to you two? Hurry up."
Xu Haiqing still wanted to struggle, "Sister, let me stay in this room for a while, I still want to know what happened to my elder brother when he followed our dad up the mountain.
Our dad was too eccentric, he only took my eldest brother up the mountain, and didn't lead me. "
How can Xu Haiqing give up, he just doesn't want to leave, and sits back, trying to break free from Xu Jinping's hand.
"I gave you a face, right? Get out of here quickly."
Xu Jinping stared, raised her foot and kicked Xu Haiqing's ass, kicked him out of the east room door, then turned around and closed the door.
"It's just you, there's no one with this mouth, you can talk about everything all day long, and you can't let you be around if there is anything at home."
Just now, Xu Jinping understood when Dad gave her a look, it was to guard against the loudspeaker in their house.
Xu Haiqing rubbed her ass, turned her head and looked at the door of the east room unwillingly, and then reluctantly followed her sister to the west room.
Xu Jinping assigned the younger brother and sister the task of reciting ancient poems, and asked them to recite them aloud so that they could not hear what Dongwu said.
The two younger ones have nothing to do, so they can only do what their sister wants, reciting ancient poems aloud.
In the east room, Xu Shiyan took out ginseng bags from his big backpack.
"Master, look, these are all good things."
The sixth grade leaves are packaged separately, the fifth grade leaves are packaged together, and the rest of the small ones are directly packaged together.
Otherwise, it would be too troublesome, and it would be useless to get so many ginseng bags.
Even so, Xu Chenghou and others were dumbfounded.
"Here, are you taking over the mountain god's lair?
Hey guy, where did this happen? so much? "Xu Chenghou couldn't help exclaiming.
“I met a place when I was on the mountain before, and I didn’t carry all of them out at that time.
It happened that Yuanyuan was getting older, so he led him there and carried out the rest. "
Xu Shiyan explained with a smile, while opening a ginseng bag, and let Chu Xuanhuai see the ginseng inside.
"Oops, this is good stuff, baby.
Don't show off here, hurry up, pack everything up, and we won't watch it.
You look at the arrangement yourself, just don't damage it. "
Chu Xuanhuai only glanced at it, seeing that the ginseng was not small, he immediately waved his hand to tell Xu Shiyan not to take it out.
He is old, and the old man can't stand the stimulation.
"Master, these two ginseng bags are not big ones, they are all fourth-grade leaves, lampstands and so on.
I plan to find a suitable place to hide it, and I will talk about it when I use it later. "
Xu Shiyan pointed to two big ginseng bags, which were not big stuff.
"Don't worry about the big ones and the small ones, you can deal with them however you want, as long as they don't cause harm."
Chu Xuanhuai doesn't care if there are big or small goods, anyway, he understands that these are life-saving treasures.
When it is really useful, no amount of money can buy it.
This thing, just put it away. Anyway, Xu Shiyan is not short of money now, so he put everything away.
"Well, listen to Master, then I will put it away."
Xu Shiyan laughed, and put all the sticks into the big rucksack, and put them in the corner.
"Yingzi, hurry up, find a change of clothes for the two of them, and then let them go to the bathroom to wash well.
I have been on the mountain for ten days, but I don’t know if I brought back Cao Cengzi. "
Zhou Guilan looked at the way her son and grandson made, her heart ached enough, and she hurriedly asked them to take a bath.
"Third brother, please check Yuanyuan carefully, but don't be fooled."
Being stared at by grass climbers, it is easy to get forest encephalitis. Although the chance is very small, it can't be a risk.
Su Anying had already prepared the clothes and packed them in a separate bag.
Xu Shiyan took the bag and led Xu Haiyuan to the bathhouse under the Canshi Hotel.
The hotels and restaurants in the city have not been doing very well since last autumn.
But there is no other way, we can’t just close the shop, right? As long as it can be maintained, it must be maintained.
It's the bathhouse, because it's the only one in Donggang, the business is quite good, and people come to take a bath in summer.
The two of them went to the bathhouse to take off their dirty clothes and checked each other. There were no signs of weed bites on their bodies.
Then I quickly took a shower, changed clothes and went home.
Meals have been prepared at home, and the father and son sat down to eat as soon as they entered the door.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan chatted with Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Chenghou.
The two old men couldn’t help but ask whether the trip to the mountain went smoothly this time, and whether they encountered any danger.
"It's okay, everything is going well, it's a rambunctious ghost, and he has made meritorious service again.
After we came out of the original old man, we originally wanted to go home, but the rascal had to lure us elsewhere.
Over there, I saw another old sign. I dug out a few ginseng trees, which were not small. "
Participants have already gone home, and there is nothing to hide, Xu Shiyan said in a nutshell.
"Hey, our rascal has done some meritorious service again. Look at you, I didn't say it earlier. I should have killed a chicken for it to eat."
Zhou Guilan just fed a piece of meat to Lai Pigui, and now she can't help but regret it. Lai Pigui has made great contributions, so it should be a live chicken.
Xu Shiyan and his son set off for the mountain on the 13th and returned home on the evening of the 23rd.
Delayed work for more than ten days, Xu Shiyan naturally couldn't rest at home, so he hurried back to work the next day.
I didn't know until I arrived at the unit that the foreigner Bell had been here for several days.
Li Chengrong arranged for someone to accompany Bell, his assistant and others to climb Changbai Mountain, and took them to eat Northeast delicacies.
I can't make those foreigners happy, so I have to discuss cooperation matters with the participation company.
Since Xu Shiyan is back, of course Xu Shiyan is the one to come forward when it comes to cooperation.
At this time, Xu Shiyan knew that Mr. Bell was the head of a branch of a well-known foreign pharmaceutical company.
That company now has hundreds of branches all over the world, covering medicine, health care products, polymers and other related fields, which can be said to be very good.
Mr. Bell was very interested in the pharmaceutical factory. Accompanied by Xu Shiyan, he visited the pharmaceutical factory and praised the management of the pharmaceutical factory.
After visiting the pharmaceutical factory, Bell proposed that he would like to cooperate in depth with this company, share technology, and jointly develop the market.
Bell gave a lot of preferential conditions, including helping the pharmaceutical factory obtain European and American certification for its proprietary Chinese medicines, and including that the pharmaceutical factory can arrange some outstanding young people to go abroad for further study.
At the same time, Bell's company can also entrust their company's medicines to be manufactured and sold here.
It is equivalent to Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory becoming a domestic cooperative branch of the other company.
It should be said that the conditions offered by Bell were very generous, and the accompanying companies of the participating companies were all very excited.
"Mr. Bell, the cooperation between the two parties is very important, and I can't make the decision on my own.
You have to ask your leader for instructions before they can give you an answer. "
Unexpectedly, Xu Shiyan looked indifferent, and instead of directly agreeing, he said that he would ask the leader for instructions.
"General manager, just now the foreigner said that he wanted to cooperate with us, why didn't you just agree?
What a great opportunity, if we can cooperate with foreign companies, our medicine can enter the international market.
Besides, didn’t Mr. Bell also say that we can arrange for our people to study there? "
Everyone sent Bell and his assistant back to the guest house to settle down, and then they all went to Xu Shiyan's office for a meeting.
Li Bingzhuo and others were a little puzzled, why didn't they just agree to such a good opportunity?
Even if it is reported to the leader, the leader will not be happy to agree?
You know, attracting investment this year is a big deal.
If it is possible to bring in pharmaceutical companies as large as foreign countries and learn their advanced technologies, pharmaceutical companies will be in trouble in the future.
"How can there be such a cheap thing in the world? Do you think there is pie in the sky?
Let me tell you, if a piece of pie falls out, there may be some trap hidden behind it. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, not because he was suspicious, but because he was not at ease.
Chinese medicine is not well recognized abroad.
Bringing those medicines to the Spring Fair before was purely to beat the rabbits, and I didn't expect the medicines to sell much.
If it weren't for a little episode that appeared later, allowing those foreigners to discover the utility of the heart-saving pill, there would be no subsequent orders at all.
Wanting to promote Chinese patent medicine to the world is by no means such a simple matter.
Even if the company behind Bell is a well-known pharmaceutical company, it is not so easy.
Moreover, the other party requires technology sharing, so there are many tricks hidden in it.
Since it is technology sharing, should the formula be shared?
A large pharmaceutical company like others has world-leading pharmaceutical technology.
Once you get your formula, people can use more advanced purification and extraction technology to change the formula and produce a brand new medicine.
What does this have to do with you?
Another, Bell said that they can entrust their company's medicines to be produced and sold here.
What is he looking at? One is to see the low labor cost in China, and the other is to see the sales channels of Chinese medicine factories, right?
This year, not only domestic pharmaceutical companies want to go global, but foreign pharmaceutical companies also want to open up the domestic market.
The medicines of Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory, through Chu Xuanhuai's relationship, are now directly supplied to hospitals in various places.
Come to think of it, this sales channel is also very enviable, right?
Under the guise of in-depth cooperation and technology sharing, the bait is to help pharmaceutical factories promote Chinese patent medicines to the world, in exchange for formulas from pharmaceutical factories, as well as sales channels for pharmaceutical factories.
In the future, it can be said that the promotion of Chinese patent medicines abroad is too difficult and the profits are low.
Why not produce our medicine, which has good effect and high profit.
Just use your sales channels to promote, we have a win-win cooperation.
What a good abacus?
If Xu Shiyan hadn't been born again, he would never have thought of these things.
How did so many national brands die in the last life?
Most of them are acquired by foreign companies, or cooperate.
At that time, when these domestic enterprises heard that foreign companies invested, they were all overjoyed.
I really thought that people cooperated with you, or acquired shares, in order to make the company bigger and promote it internationally.
But in fact, most of the brands were hidden in the snow after that, and disappeared without a trace since then.
This is a common method used by foreign capital. If they can't beat it, they simply buy it with money and hide it in the snow.
After waiting for many years, even if domestic companies redeem their own brands, it is useless.
A product that has long been forgotten by the world can't make any waves at all.
Of course, this Bell may not be thinking so much right now, maybe he really wants to cooperate.
But Xu Shiyan felt that it is necessary to be defensive, and it is better to be careful.
"One more thing, have you forgotten, who did our pharmaceutical factory cooperate with?
Our pharmaceutical factory has a lot of exclusive secret formulas, what are you kidding? Cooperation and technology sharing with foreigners? "
No way, Xu Shiyan is such a cautious character.
It can be said that he has no prospects, no ambitions, he just wants to quietly like this, and develop bit by bit.
I don’t want to make a big splash, let alone occupy any international market.
They are a small municipal enterprise, not a big factory, so don't think too much about it.
Xu Shiyan's thoughts, some people understand and others don't understand, but the company's decision-maker is Xu Shiyan, he has the right to call the shots.
Of course, for this kind of thing, you still need to ask the leader for instructions, so Xu Shiyan called Guan Enxue.
When Guan Enxue heard that a foreign pharmaceutical company wanted to cooperate with the pharmaceutical factory, his first reaction was that he was very happy.
In this year and month, attracting investment and earning foreign exchange through export are the mainstream, and no leader is an exception.
But Guan Enxue was not overwhelmed by the sudden surprise, nor did he make a decision immediately.
Instead, after listening to Xu Shiyan's analysis, he pondered for a long time.
"Shiyan, I'll report this matter to the province and listen to the opinions of the leaders.
How about you, also ask what it means in terms of organization. "
Guan Enxue was also quite hesitant. He wanted to attract foreign capital to expand the influence of the pharmaceutical factory, but he was also afraid that, as Xu Shiyan said, the pharmaceutical factory would become a cheap production line for others in the future.
Therefore, this matter must be reported to the higher authorities.

chapters.title: Chapter 758: Chinsodo
chapters.content:
Xu Shiyan and Guan Enxue reported to their superiors respectively. After the provincial leaders heard the news, their first reaction was similar to that of Guan Enxue, and they were all very happy.
Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory is just a pharmaceutical factory affiliated to a municipal enterprise. It is a golden opportunity to attract foreign investment and cooperation.
The province is naturally eager, even if Guan Enxue has stated all of Xu Shiyan's ideas to the superiors, those people in the province will feel that Xu Shiyan's worries are clearly unfounded.
It’s just a small pharmaceutical factory, how can it attract the coveted eyes of such a big pharmaceutical company from abroad.
Compared to the elation of the provincial leaders, the opinions of several leaders in the organization are similar to those of Xu Shiyan.
I always feel that there is something tricky behind this?
The matter of cooperation still needs to be carefully considered, and decisions should not be made lightly.
Both sides insisted on their own opinions, and after many discussions, they could not reach a consensus.
However, the pharmaceutical factory is jointly established by the organization and the participation company.
That is to say, as long as Xu Shiyan discusses and decides with the organization, the province has no right to intervene.
Even, the leaders of the organization directly let go, or they will invest more, buy all the shares, and entrust Xu Shiyan to manage them.
This move was ruthless enough, and several leaders in the province lost their temper.
But they were not reconciled, and they still wanted to think about how to keep Bell, the God of Wealth.
It will take a long time for the two sides to argue, and no one can give an accurate answer.
Xu Shiyan had expected this situation a long time ago, so he was not in a hurry at all, and slowly delayed.
Xu Shiyan can procrastinate, but Bell can't. He has been here for a long time, how can he keep delaying here?
"Mr. Xu, Mr. Bell asked you, how are you thinking about the cooperation?"
Bell's assistant and translator came to ask Xu Shiyan.
"Oh, I'm very sorry, the superiors haven't called me back yet.
You also know that we are a state-owned enterprise, no matter what we do, we must pay attention to a set of rules and regulations.
Without the approval of my superiors, I absolutely dare not make decisions. "Xu Shiyan's attitude is very good.
This is not something he can decide. If the superiors don’t give permission, how can he have the right?
Bell and his assistant finally couldn't wait any longer, so they had to leave first and return home.
As for the matter of cooperation, it can only be discussed slowly in the follow-up.
Xu Shiyan asked someone to arrange a practice banquet, treated Bell and his party well, and then arranged for someone to send them away.
Waiting for Bell to leave, Xu Shiyan finally heaved a sigh of relief.
"I'm finally leaving, otherwise I really don't know how to keep procrastinating."
Xu Shiyan, Han Limin, and Li Cheng let them chatter.
"General manager, does the pharmaceutical company really plan to cooperate with foreign companies? This is a good opportunity."
Han Limin and others were actually a little bit reluctant.
"No plan." Xu Shiyan shook his head.
“The pharmaceutical factory was first established for the convenience of organizing medication, and we can also earn some money along the way.
To be a human being, don’t be too greedy and be content.
It’s good to just keep in front of your eyes. If you think too much, you may not get anything in the end. "
When he came to participate in the first place, what was there to participate in?
20,000 yuan a year, millions of dollars in output value, and tens of dollars in wages for workers a month, I think it's pretty good.
What about now? Not to mention how many sticks there are in the field now, there are just a few in the factory.
The processing plant has been expanded several times and has become several times larger than the original one.
Comprehensive factory also expanded this year, renamed Changbaishan Health Products Factory.
There are also daily chemical factories and fertilizer factories held by Shenchang, as well as flooring factories and daily chemical factories under construction.
This year’s Spring Fair will earn 30 million yuan in foreign exchange, plus the orders from old customers and the revenue of pharmaceutical companies, the annual output value may reach nearly 200 million yuan.
It's just a municipal enterprise, what else do you want? Is this not enough?
Shenchang itself is a planting-based enterprise, and it is already very good to be able to develop to this stage. This is not enough, what do you want to do? God?
"Don't think too much about it, let's run these factories well, and the annual output value must be hundreds of millions.
It’s such a small place like us, what are you thinking about? Right? "
Xu Shiyan smiled, anyway, he is very satisfied with the current situation.
As long as the existing factories can be managed well, so that the workers can happily receive wages and live a good life, he will be very satisfied.
Han Limin and the others thought about it, and it was the same reason. Today, the life of the big guys is much better than before.
"That's right, we are not greedy enough."
It should be said that the participating companies have developed well in the past few years, especially this year. Under such circumstances, the participating companies can still survive, and the foreign exchange earnings from exports once again broke the record, which made everyone full of confidence.
All feel that as long as the whole company is united, they can do whatever they want, and nothing can stop them.
To put it simply, everyone is a little bit floating.
"It's normal to be short of people's hearts, and I'm not satisfied either. Didn't I also say that I want to set up a sales office in Shanghai?"
Xu Shiyan shook his head and smiled, how many people can be as calm as water, without desire or desire?
He is also greedy, he still wants to sell local ginseng to the whole world, it's all the same.
It's just that he thinks that cooperating with Bell's company will do more harm than good, so he doesn't want to take risks easily.
Perhaps, this is just his inference, but once it becomes a reality, it will be a disaster for the participating companies.
Xu Shiyan can't bet on the company's future, it's better to be safe.
The news of Bell's departure spread quickly, and the city and provincial leaders all knew about it.
Many people shook their heads and lamented that a great opportunity was missed.
Many people even complained behind their backs, thinking that Xu Shiyan was too timid, only caring about the small profits in front of him, and disregarding the overall situation.
But there is no way, Xu Shiyan has the support of the organization, and Xu Shiyan has indeed achieved outstanding results in exporting foreign exchange.
Even if someone dislikes him, there is nothing they can do about him.
As far as the current situation of the ginseng market is concerned, if Xu Shiyan is really replaced and someone else becomes the general manager of the ginseng company, I am afraid that the current orders will not be able to be kept next year, and something may happen.
So those people can only suppress their dissatisfaction in their hearts.
Xu Shiyan doesn't care how others discuss and complain behind his back. He just wants to do his best and have a clear conscience, and that's enough.
In the blink of an eye, half of August has passed, and the children who had fun during the summer vacation are about to start school.
Some children are having so much fun that they haven’t written much homework during the holidays. At this time, they start to make up homework like crazy.
No way, the teachers these days are very responsible. After the holiday homework starts, it is really a review and correction one by one.
The children of the Xu family are not troubled by this.
After Xu Haiyuan came back from the mountain, he started to write homework frantically, and finished all the homework left by the teacher in a few days.
The rest of the time is to preview the new lessons for the next semester, and learn medical skills from Mr. Chu.
Not to mention Xu Jinping, not to mention that she finished her homework after the holiday, and stared at her younger siblings to finish their homework.
In mid-to-late August, elementary and junior high schools start one after another.
The students who have gone through the high school entrance examination and the college entrance examination are also looking forward to their admission results at this time.
Xu Shiyan received a call from Baoan Middle School. Chu Junyu and Chu Junling had very good results in the college entrance examination.
One was admitted to South China University of Technology, and the other was admitted to Sun Yat-sen University.
Xu Shiyan heard the news, and immediately sent over 100,000 yuan to the party as agreed at the beginning.
Among them, 60,000 yuan is a reward for the two girls, and the remaining 40,000 yuan is to thank the teachers and the school for their help.
If you want others to help you with things, you have to give benefits after all.
For the children of the Chu family, Xu Shiyan donated a library to the school.
In addition, he also promised that as long as the children are admitted to the ideal university, the teacher and the school will not suffer.
In any case, for the sake of Elder Chu, these children have to be taken care of.
A few days after the remittance, the school called again, saying that they had received the remittance, and thanked Xu Shiyan for supporting their work.
The other party promised that the money would be given to Chu Junyu and Chu Junling as a scholarship as agreed.
Xu Shiyan didn't say much, he really wasn't afraid that something would happen over there, someone was watching over there.
Only let the other party help and take proper care of those children.
Especially the two girls, don't take the money and don't go to college, it will be in vain to blind the big guys.
A few days later, news came from over there that the two girls from the Chu family had received the scholarship and notification letter, and were happily ready to go to school.
Hearing the news, Xu Shiyan felt relieved.
He was mainly worried that the Zhang family sisters would not be able to change their minds, and they still refused to let the two girls go to school.
After Xu Shiyan returned home, he also mentioned it to Chu Xuanhuai. Chu Xuanhuai was also very happy to learn that both granddaughters were admitted to very good universities.
"Shi Yan, if you can do this, it's good enough.
You don't have to feel sorry for me, and you don't have to bother to make up for it.
Master is already at this age, and he can appreciate everything. If his son is not filial, can he still count on his grandchildren? "
The old man was stubborn, and he didn't want to embarrass Xu Shiyan.
"Well, Master, I know.
I can’t control anything else. At most, I want a few children to finish their studies smoothly, and those who can be admitted to university should finish their studies well. "Xu Shiyan didn't say much.
Actually, life in the Chu family is not that difficult.
As Chu Xuanhuai said, Brother Chu Yuanlang knew what kind of business they were doing, and also knew that the car would overturn if things went wrong, so they kept their backs.
The courtyard in Xin'an Town was bought in the name of the Zhang family sisters, and the Hukou of the children of the Chu family also fell on the other side of Xin'an Town, with their mother.
After the accident of the two brothers, only the company and store on the other side of Shenzhen City were seized, and the side of Xin’an Town remained.
Although the Chu brothers didn’t leave much money, in fact, as long as a few children live in poverty, it’s enough for them to grow up.
Right now, what Xu Shiyan can do is to let the children study as much as possible, let's talk about the rest later.
Of course, Xu Shiyan didn't have so much time to pay attention to these things, he was too busy.
In September, the ginseng companies started to make ginseng products.
This year’s participation is still 40,000 feet, and the forestry bureau is a little less, only 20,000 feet.
Shenye Company has a lot of orders this year, and the daily chemical factory has already been built and will be put into production in winter, and a batch of raw materials has to be stockpiled, so the raw material gap of Shenye Company is not small.
When Chang Hongfa heard the news, he called Xu Shiyan several times, hoping that Xu Shiyan could purchase a batch of ginseng from several participants.
With the friendship between Xu Shiyan and Chang Hongfa, naturally they will not refute each other's face.
Anyway, it doesn’t matter where you buy it from, it doesn’t matter if you buy it from other venues or households from different places, as long as the price is reasonable.
Therefore, Xu Shiyan nodded in agreement, and dispatched people to purchase fresh ginseng from several other participants.
The ginseng company purchases a part, the ginseng company is responsible for the rest, and each ginseng finds its own channel to sell part.
At any rate, there are a few participating counties that belong to the county, and there will not be too much backlog this year, but other participating households are not so optimistic.
Although the various products of the participating companies shined brilliantly at the Spring Fair, foreign exchange earnings once again broke the record.
But this will not have much effect on the overall ginseng market.
Although the province and the city have jointly issued policies and established a protective price for ginseng, the international market is still sluggish, and the purchase volume of foreign merchants is small.
There are not many foreign merchants who come to buy, and these local processing factories, ginseng companies and other departments and enterprises that have obtained business licenses dare not let go of the purchase.
So, the ginseng market is still sluggish, and the market has not changed much.
Donggang Sanshi, there are many people who come to sell goods, but few who receive goods, and all the farmers are moaning.
Under this market, no one has confidence, and many people say that they don’t plan to plant another stick this year.
Under such circumstances, Su Anying's company invested a large sum of money and began to advertise in the market, receiving a large number of goods.
The souvenir shop in Yangcheng, named Zhencaotang, is scheduled to open on October 8th.
Su Anying flew to Yangcheng in mid-September. Before opening, Su Anying sent invitation letters to former old customers one by one.
Advertised in local newspapers and TV stations, and there are many promotional offers.
So in the first few days of opening, the business was good and the revenue was very considerable.
In Fujian, Guangdong and other provinces, there are many small shops or stalls that sell special products from various places.
The purchase volume of these people is not particularly large, so it is not cost-effective to go to the Northeast.
Now there is a Northeast souvenir store in Yangcheng, which does both wholesale and retail, and the goods are very complete, with everything.
Not only ginseng, but also ganoderma, gastrodia elata, elixir, fungus, mushrooms, pine nuts, hazelnuts, and various deer products, etc. There are many types, good quality, and reasonable prices.
Many small shopkeepers and small vendors came to batch goods and went back to retail.
At the same time, some local people will also come to pick some nourishing herbs and go back to make soup.
Zhencaotang does both wholesale and retail, and the price is fair and reasonable.
It doesn’t matter whether you buy tens of catties, hundreds of catties, or a few taels, the shop assistants will greet you with a smile, and the service attitude is also very good. So fame opened up quickly.
There are also those old customers who saw that Su Anying opened a store here, and they all came to support them, and ordered a lot of goods with Su Anying.
Yangcheng Zhen Thatched Cottage opened successfully, giving Su Anying and others great confidence.
It happened that a shop in the capital was due to expire, so it was taken back and repacked, and it was ready to open for a while.
The Shanghai stock market also bought a shop, and it will be ready to open after it is refurbished.
The three shops naturally need a lot of goods, and the one with the greater demand is the health care product factory.
The health care product factory on the other side of Bao’an is almost done. It can be put into production as long as it buys machines and recruits workers for training.

chapters.title: Chapter 759: Health Products Factory
chapters.content:
Chapter 759 Health Products Factory
Regarding the positioning of the health care product factory, Xu Shiyan and his wife discussed it and decided to launch one or two main products for key promotion.
Other products are also produced, and try to fully cover all the current product types of participating companies.
To be similar, but not exactly the same, such as slightly changing the formula, dosage form, etc.
Before others realize that they can follow suit, occupy the market first and earn money.
Wait for other people to think of copying, and then launch an upgraded version, so that those who follow the trend will never be able to catch up.
The original intention of the Health Products Factory was to promote ginseng products as much as possible and open up domestic sales.
So, every product here in the factory uses ginseng as the main raw material.
It is conceivable that the demand for ginseng is definitely not small.
Three stores, a health care product factory, plus the orders from old customers that Su Anying has accumulated in the past few years, the number is very large.
In the autumn of 1990, relevant provincial and municipal departments established a guide price for ginseng purchases, which is the minimum protection price.
Special-grade common fresh ginseng costs 22 yuan per kilogram, first-grade ginseng 17 yuan per kilogram, second-grade ginseng 13.5 yuan per kilogram, and third-grade ginseng 10 yuan per kilogram.
Twenty sticks of common red ginseng, first-class ginseng 136 yuan per kilogram, second-class ginseng 122 yuan per kilogram, third-class ginseng 95 yuan per kilogram.
Thirty-two common red ginseng, first-class 105 yuan per kilogram, second-class 94 yuan per kilogram, third-class 73 yuan per kilogram,
Forty-eight common red ginseng, first-class 83 yuan per kilogram, second-class 75 yuan per kilogram, third-class 58 yuan per kilogram.
There are sixty-four, eighty, cheat sheet, red straight beard, red curved beard, mixed beard and other categories of prices, which decrease in order.
Edge ginseng of the same grade can generally reach twice that of ordinary ginseng.
Of course, this is only a guide price, and the market price may rise slightly, but not much.
According to the current market situation, a stick of one foot weighs twenty-six catties.
If there are more big sticks and better bars, maybe it can be sold for four to five hundred yuan.
If there is water rust, and the body is worse, it will only cost two to three hundred yuan per foot.
Compared with 8687, this little income is simply a world of difference.
It can’t even compare to last year’s price, it’s so cheap.
Many people said that this is not as good as the big carrot.
But what can be done?
The bulk of ginseng still relies on export, and foreign merchants insist on lowering the price, and they are still unwilling to buy in large quantities. How much can they absorb if they only point to the domestic market?
Seeing losing money, Shennong hopped his feet in distress, but what could they do?
How many dare to say that the goods are no longer sold and are kept at home?
That must be a very solid foundation, and you don't expect to sell sticks for a few years to make a living.
Ordinary people's homes, there are really not many of them, and they are all eager to sell goods.
The family is still waiting to eat and drink, and the ginseng land next year is still waiting to be spent. Who dares to hold the goods in their hands and not sell them?
Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and other shareholders’ ginsengs are all processed and sent to various stores for sale in order to maximize their profits.
In addition, Su Anying arranged for Feng Yue, Huang Shengkai and others to buy a large number of ginseng in Donggang ginseng market, dry, fresh, and all grades.
Strips and high-quality ginseng are kept for sale in the store, or sold to customers who order.
Inferior goods, but the appearance is not good enough, in fact, the efficacy of the medicine will not be greatly affected.
Health care products factory just keep it for use, which can reduce the cost.
Business is like this. Only by making the best use of everything can we maximize the benefits and earn more.
The market of ginseng is still not good, but there are people buying in large quantities. For ginseng farmers, there is always some hope.
Many people are queuing up at the purchase point outside the market, waiting to sell the goods, especially the locals, even queuing up early in the morning.
Many out-of-town ginseng households learned that there were merchants buying ginseng, so they simply lived in hotels and lined up early to sell the goods.
Some enterprises and institutions that followed suit learned that Su Anying's company received a large number of goods, so they relied on their connections and poached the door, trying to sell all the ginseng operated by the unit.
Some people were even fanciful, thinking about finding Xu Shiyan, Zhou Qingguo, and Yang Junxian to save face, preferably at a higher price.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying had thought of this a long time ago, so they made it clear to Huang Shengli and others in advance that no matter which unit they are in, or whose connections they seek, it will not work.
Buying point only accepts scattered ginseng sticks, and each household can accept up to 500 catties of fresh ginseng and 200 catties of dry goods per day.
In this year and month, ordinary ginseng households can only produce goods for twenty or thirty feet a year, and very few can make goods for fifty feet.
Even if it is calculated on the basis of 1.267 catties of fresh ginseng, most of them are less than 1,000 catties of fresh ginseng and 100 to 200 catties of dry goods.
According to the current market conditions, if there is more, it can be sold for tens of thousands of yuan, and if it is less, it can be sold for thousands of yuan.
"Fellows from the village, don't suppress the ranks too hard, it's not easy for the big guys.
It doesn’t matter if we earn less than a few hundred dollars, we can do a lot of things with them. "
Su Anying was out of town, so she had to call back every now and then, telling Huang Shengli, Feng Chao and others to do things smoothly.
"But remember one thing, no matter who those units find and how strong the relationship is, you are not allowed to accept it.
It's not that they messed up, the ginseng market won't be where it is now.
They are all members of the government, and they use the money of the government to plant sticks, even if they are compensated, it is not their money.
The consequences of today are all caused by them. They find a way to sell the goods by themselves. I will definitely not accept their goods.
If anyone doesn't listen to me and engages in small tricks behind the scenes, then I'm sorry, the company can't tolerate such people.
Our friendship over the years has come to an end. "
What I hate the most is these units. They take the public money and invest it in the fields.
Originally, the market price this year should not be so low, but these people are impatient and sell goods at low prices.
During the beginning of spring, many units learned to go to Yangcheng to sell goods, and all companies competed to lower prices and sell them outside, making the market worse and worse.
During those days, Su Anying was very angry, and now she certainly refuses to accept the goods from these units.
If they have the ability, they will also open a shop or set up a factory? If you don't have the skills, then just do whatever you want, and you deserve it if you hit your hand.
The stores in Yangcheng are making good profits, and the stores in the capital and Shanghai are almost ready and will open soon. It is estimated that the income will not be too bad.
In addition to the old customers ordering, although the market is still not good, the company's prospects are good.
Besides, the health care product factory has not yet started. With Xu Shiyan and Su Anying leading the way, everyone is full of confidence in the health care product factory.
In this case, who would be foolish enough to delay earning money for irrelevant people?
"Don't worry, Mr. Su, we are all watching, no one dares to mess around."
Don't say that Su Anying hates those people, Huang Shengli and the others also hate them.
Because of them, Kaichun almost lost money.
Looking here now and want to sell? Go aside quickly.
The shops in the capital and the Shanghai stock market are all ready-made, and you just need to clean them up.
Although it is smaller than the one in Yangcheng, it is enough for retail and small wholesale.
The shop in Yangcheng was handed over to Su Anfen, and the shop in the capital was handed over to Su Anzhen and Nan Zhendong.
Su Anzhen helped Shanhuozhuang when she was in Donggang, and then followed the various affairs of the store opening in Yangcheng, which can be regarded as exercise.
The couple traveled from Yangcheng to the capital in September. While cleaning up the shop, they recruited shop assistants for training.
On November 8th, Capital Zhencaotang opened.
On the Shanghai stock market, Su Anying had arranged for her cousin Su Anyu to be in charge early on.
Su Anyu is younger than Su Anhua, only twenty-five this year.
This girl has a high spirit. Since she came to Donggang City, she has learned a lot, so she doesn't want to get married too early.
No matter how her parents urged her, she just didn't want to find a partner.
There was no other way. Su Weicheng and his wife went to Su Anying and Xu Shiyan and asked them to help them introduce someone to Su Anyu.
Su Anying knew what her cousin was thinking, so it was hard for her to introduce her clearly.
I'm afraid that this girl is too rebellious, no matter how good or bad the introduction is, she is willing to meet and get along.
It just so happened that the sales department of Shenye Company on the Shanghai stock market also had a plan, and the company wanted to select a few people from the sales department to go there.
Su Anying just mentioned something to Xu Shiyan, and asked Xu Shiyan to arrange for a few more young men with good family conditions and no ones. They happened to set off for the Shanghai stock market with Su Anyu.
Not to mention, this trick is really useful, Su Anyu really has eyes for one of them.
It is said that the two get along well, and they plan to come back during the Chinese New Year to get engaged.
Shanghai Zhencaotang opened on November 18th.
At the same time, Jishengyuan Health Products Factory located in Baoan also started production.
The main products of the health care products factory include ginseng tonifying kidney oral liquid for men, ginseng snow clam essence drink for women, and ginseng and bird's nest amino acid nourishing essence for the elderly.
In addition, there are fresh ginseng royal jelly, ginseng baby blood-enriching honey, ginseng blueberry essence drink, longevity ginseng tea, ginseng royal jelly oral liquid, red ginseng essence concentrated cream, red ginseng sealwort concentrated paste, ginseng deer whip cream, etc. Ten products.
When the factory was first built, various procedures were also applied for approval at the same time.
When the factory is completed, the relevant formalities and certificates are all down, and it just happens to start production.
The factory started construction and put into production, and salesmen in the sales department headed by Ji Tongzhong began to take product manuals and samples to pharmacies and shops all over the country to sell and negotiate business cooperation with others.
In this year and month, the majority of pharmacies and stores are state-owned, and a small number are contracted to individuals.
Those state-run pharmacies and stores are all very good, and they don't even care about this little-known health care product factory, let alone cooperate.
Some pharmacies contracted by individuals are willing to cooperate with the factory.
But people don’t want to take risks, and they only agree to sell on behalf of others, that is, to distribute the goods first, without paying money, and then settle the bill after selling.
Ji Tongzhong and others used a lot of tricks and took a lot of effort. There were only dozens of companies that reached cooperation, but they were very anxious.
So much money has been invested to build a factory, and so many goods have been suppressed, what if it can’t be sold?
"Second brother-in-law, hurry up and find a way to help, this is not going to work, people don't recognize our products."
As soon as Ji Tongzhong came out of a pharmacy, he quickly found a public phone and called Xu Shiyan.
"Xiao Ji, how many companies have you negotiated?"
On the other side of the phone, Xu Shiyan asked with a smile while flipping through the documents.
"All the salesmen from our sales department have been sent out, and they have been running all over the world, so far we have only negotiated 60 or 70 companies.
And it’s still a consignment situation, people don’t believe that our products can sell well. "
Ji Tongzhong was about to cry, but listening to the other end of the phone, it seemed that his second brother-in-law was not in a hurry.
"Xiao Ji, you guys are really amazing.
It’s a new factory with no reputation, but they can still trust you, agreeing to cooperate and sell it on behalf of others, it’s already quite a face. "Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard that.
It is not an easy task to open a factory and sell health care products. This is just the first step.
"Don't worry, I have a solution, you just need to talk step by step.
Write down the first batch of stores that cooperated with us, and get along well in the future. "
"Oh, well, second brother-in-law, you have to hurry up to find a son.
It won’t work like this, our factory is so big, and the output is so big in a day, we can’t put all of them in the warehouse. "
Ji Tongzhong seemed not at ease, and repeatedly urged Xu Shiyan.
Xu Shiyan, after hanging up the phone, immediately called Su Anying and discussed with her about the next promotion.
If a new product wants to be familiar to the masses quickly, the most effective means is of course advertising.
TV, radio, newspapers and magazines, all of these must be continuously advertised.
Among them, TV stations broadcast advertisements, which are the most effective and fastest.
After all, the number of TV sets in China is increasing by leaps and bounds. Many people do not read newspapers or listen to the radio, but they must watch TV.
If you want to promote on TV, you have to shoot commercials first, and then cooperate with the TV station.
Buy out the advertising space and play the advertisement within a fixed period of time.
"Shiyan, we can shoot commercials, but how do we broadcast them?
I've asked someone before. If this ad is to be aired on TV, it will cost a lot of money. "
Su Anying hesitated after hearing Xu Shiyan's plan.
The key is not to shoot commercials, but whether they can afford the subsequent advertising fees.
Advertising fees during prime time are not low these days.
During the prime time at 8:00 p.m. in each province, the minimum fee for a 30-second advertisement is one or two thousand yuan.
Not to mention CCTV, there are almost tens of thousands.
This is the cost of a single broadcast. If you want to achieve the effect of publicity, why don’t you broadcast it ten times or eight times a day?
Even if it is a provincial station, it will cost 20,000 to 30,000 yuan a day, and the CCTV is even more frightening, and it may cost 70,000 to 80,000 yuan a day.
How about a month? How much will it cost?
The health care product factory is a new factory. It has just been put into operation this year, and its foundation is too weak.
The product hasn’t been sold yet, so spending money on it is unbearable.
"Daughter-in-law, don't worry, I have my own plan for this matter, and I will definitely not spend too much advertising money."
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it. He had already planned this matter.
TV commercials are divided into time slots. After the evening news broadcast and before 9:30, this period is regarded as the prime time.
Especially around eight o’clock, almost everyone is watching TV, and the advertising effect is good, so the advertising fee is super expensive.
There is prime time, and there must be junk time.
For example, in the morning, afternoon, and midnight, there are few people watching TV at this time, and the advertising effect is not good.
The major manufacturers don't like it at all, the advertising fee is so cheap that it is almost free, and they have to be sold in prime time for all kinds of collocations.
Xu Shiyan remembers, it seems that in the late 1990s in his previous life, when he turned on the TV during the day, there were all kinds of advertisements for breast enhancement, weight loss, underwear and so on.
An ad lasts more than ten minutes, bombarded indiscriminately in various garbage time periods, which is simply a headache.
At that time, it was not called commercials in the middle of TV dramas, but TV in the middle of commercials.
But I have to say, the effect is really good.
Therefore, Xu Shiyan plans to use this trick in advance, spend the least amount of money, and do the biggest thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 760: Sales are booming
chapters.content:
Chapter 760 Hot Sales
At this time, CCTV is not very popular.
Most people's TV can only receive two or three channels.
Central one, provincial stations, some cities and counties can also receive a city station or something.
Like Donggang, you can’t receive the city station, you can only receive the Central No. 1 and provincial stations, and occasionally you can receive the Central No. 2 station.
The effect of TV stations in this province is better than that of CCTV, so many people are more accustomed to watching TV stations in this province.
Also, the TV air time is not that long.
China Central Station is better, it can have programs throughout the day.
Some provincial stations usually broadcast one episode in the morning and one episode at noon.
From 5:30 p.m. to midnight, there will be no more snowflakes.
What Xu Shiyan wants to use, that is, these time slots that even the TV stations don't pay attention to, is to launch a round-the-clock advertisement bombardment to achieve the publicity effect.
The advertisement is shot in the way of a health lecture hall.
Invite two old Chinese medicine experts who are a bit old, cooperate with a host, and arrange dozens of audiences in the audience.
The host asks questions, experts answer, and popularizes some health care knowledge for everyone, and launches these main health care products along the way.
Two experts use their professional knowledge to explain the efficacy of the product, and do a detailed science popularization of the main raw materials.
The audience below can ask some questions, which will be answered by experts.
The product efficacy, main ingredient introduction, and technological process are all written by Xu Shiyan.
In line with the principle of not exaggerating the curative effect and not misleading consumers, highlight product features, focus on publicizing health concepts, and embody human care.
This time, three products were launched, covering men, women, and middle-aged and elderly people.
It is not like other products advertised, a product is so magical that it can cure all diseases, but it is targeted to meet different needs of people.
In this way, it can win the trust of consumers more.
Among other things, Xu Shiyan has not read books in vain these years, and it is true that he has learned a lot from Mr. Chu.
Related popular science knowledge is well written, even if Mr. Chu comes, he can't find any faults.
The two experts followed the script written by Xu Shiyan.
Relevant medical knowledge not only fascinated the audience, even the host almost forgot that she was invited to shoot commercials.
A nearly 20-minute advertisement took one day to shoot, and then re-edited and produced it later. It took only a few days for the film to be produced.
After the commercials were released, dozens of copies were made.
Su Anying immediately arranged for Ji Tongzhong and others to take the film and find a way to discuss cooperation with various provinces and Taiwan.
In this year and month, there is no shortage of manufacturers advertising.
Manufacturers go all out to grab advertising spots during prime time, and TV stations can’t wait to bid to determine the broadcast time.
So when most TV stations heard that someone was going to advertise, and it was a not-so-famous health care product factory, they really didn't take Ji Tongzhong and others seriously.
When they heard it, Ji Tongzhong and the others didn't want the prime time advertising space, but chose some garbage time.
The people at the TV station thought it was a fool.
You have to squeeze your head out of the door eight times in order to see those advertising spots during garbage hours. What use is that thing?
Of course, the TV station can not take the money delivered to the door?
Especially during garbage hours, everyone in the station is in a panic and doesn't know how to sell to the outside world.
Usually, it is sold together with the prime time package, but now someone buys it separately, isn’t that happy?
If all the junk time is sold out, the price can be raised during the prime time, so that the income will be greatly increased.
The people in the TV station are not stupid, they are all smart, they will settle this account.
In this way, the cooperation was negotiated very smoothly.
A 20-minute commercial, broadcast four times in the morning and four times in the afternoon every day.
At night, the TV station delays turning off the signal by one hour, and this hour is reserved for broadcasting commercials three times.
Some TV stations don't broadcast programs during the day, but for the sake of advertising costs, they even broadcast during the day.
11 advertisements a day, three hours and 40 minutes, if this is during the prime time, the advertising fee alone will be sky-high.
But during garbage time, most TV stations directly calculate the monthly subscription, ranging from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands a month.
Generally, the provincial ones are more expensive, while the local ones are much cheaper.
The health care product factory is in the south, and the coastal provinces in the south are rich, so the advertisements must be promoted from south to north.
In the first batch, Su Anying selected provincial and municipal TV stations in more than a dozen economically developed regions such as the capital, Shanghai stock market, Fujian, and Guangdong.
The advertising investment for the first phase alone is nearly 2 million.
Of course, this overwhelming advertising has a great effect.
The key is that as long as you turn on the TV, you can see this advertisement regardless of the provincial or municipal stations.
Moreover, the ad is so pretentious that many people really think that this is a health lecture hall, where they learn about health care from experts.
After all, it is only 90 years, and the publicity methods that are commonplace in the eyes of later generations will definitely attract countless people at this time.
Just in time, it’s a good time again.
New Year’s Day has just passed, and the Spring Festival is coming. Who visits relatives and buys something to take with them?
Giving a gift means giving health. This slogan is so rooted in everyone's mind.
Those who think about shopping, these products are the first thing that come to mind.
For men, choose ginseng tonifying kidney liquid, for women, choose ginseng snow clam essence drink, for elders, choose ginseng and bird's nest amino acid essence oral liquid.
The packaging of these three products was also specially designed by someone. It is definitely high-end and elegant, and it is definitely a face-saving gift.
Less than ten days after the ad aired, the sales department of the factory was overwhelmed by phone calls from pharmacies and stores all over the place.
This time, it's not the time for Ji Tongzhong and the others to beg their grandpa to tell their grandma to find someone to help them sell.
Countless dealers came to the door with money, begging to be the agent of Jishengyuan health care products.
"I follow what you mean, each city chooses an agent.
Let them sign agency contracts and formulate sales pricing for distributors at all levels.
Each agent can only distribute goods to the counties and townships within the scope of its own agency, and shall not operate across regions.
Terminal retail price, unified nationwide.
Agents and terminal sellers have sales rebate rewards. The higher the sales, the higher the rebate. "
The new factory was first built, Su Anying had to sit there, and the couple could only communicate by phone.
"Well, okay, anyway, you just need to remember that the sales market must be standardized.
It is absolutely impossible to seize the market from each other and fight price wars for sales.
All the discounts that should be given are given. As long as the rewards are enough, those dealers and salespersons will definitely do their best to promote us.
Another one is to give away some of the other unadvertised products as gifts for dealers to use for activities.
Let me tell you, don't look at this as a gift, the effect is actually better than advertising. "
Xu Shiyan was on the phone, earnestly exhorting and imparting relevant promotion methods.
Take these three products as the leader to drive sales of other products.
In the future, when the factory is well developed and the products are enriched, specialty stores can be opened in shopping malls around the world.
The whole store is full of products from their factory, that is the ultimate goal.
Because of the summer leap in May, the Spring Festival in 1991 was on February 15th, which was later than in previous years.
But for Jishengyuan Health Products Company, it is just right.
At the end of December, the advertisements were placed on various TV stations. In mid-January, the three health care products were popular in the southeast half of the country.
Distributors from all over the world came to buy goods one after another, and sold them by various means when they went back.
It is said that in some larger counties and cities, the queues of buyers line up in front of the dealers.
For a while, anyone who does not know the three ginseng products of Jishengyuan will be despised.
If you don’t give Jishengyuan products as a gift during the Chinese New Year, you will feel that you can’t afford it.
Anyone who has not received Jishengyuan’s health care products is not popular.
Spring Festival is the most important festival for Chinese people.
During the Spring Festival, visiting relatives, honoring parents, visiting father-in-law and mother-in-law, visiting leaders, who can’t get some gifts?
I used to worry about what to give, but this time there is no need to worry. Jishengyuan has launched a variety of high-end gift boxes, and there is always one that suits you.
In addition to the three products in the advertisement, there are many other products that are not advertised, and you can choose from them.
The sales staff of those distributors tried their best to sell Jishengyuan's products to customers in order to earn rebates for their performance.
Advertisements bring popularity and popularity, and salespeople add fire.
Jishengyuan's three health care products, at the end of this year, are like a super whirlwind, sweeping all over the place.
The advertising effect is so good, Su Anying took advantage of the situation and continued to advertise in other regions.
Before I was afraid that the money in my hand would not be enough, so I didn’t dare to throw it in.
This time, I am not afraid anymore, just sign a one-year contract and pay monthly.
All over the country are dealers urging for goods, and the factory is working overtime to produce.
Thanks to the fact that the factory has stockpiled a large amount of raw materials, and the oral liquid is relatively cheap.
In order to prevent the shortage of raw materials, Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng and others were all sent out to purchase relevant medicinal materials from various places.
Zhao Jianshe and Feng Chao stayed in Donggang and continued to vigorously purchase ginseng. Taking advantage of the low price of ginseng, they hoarded it in large quantities.
Jishengyuan Health Products Factory is a project jointly funded and operated by Dongfang Ginseng Company and Baishan Ginseng Comprehensive Company.
Management personnel, of course, must be jointly produced by both parties.
Su Anying, as the general manager of Baishan Ginseng Company, of course she is the general manager of the factory.
Dai Lijun, the second son of Dai Chunrong's family, used to work as a workshop director in a comprehensive factory, and his work ability was good.
Was selected by Xu Shiyan and sent to Bao'an as the director of the health care product factory.
Li Zongliang was originally the chief of the transportation department of the ginseng company. In order to support the health care product factory, he was specially transferred to serve as the deputy factory director.
At the same time, Huang Shengli, Sun Xiaofeng and others became the company's procurement personnel, responsible for the procurement of various raw materials.
Ji Tongzhong is in charge of the sales department, leading the staff of the sales department to connect with dealers all over the country.
The original Baishan Ginseng Comprehensive Company became the northeast branch of Jishengyuan Health Products Factory, responsible for raw material supply and other related work.
With the joint efforts of so many people, the health care product factory has achieved a sales volume of 30 million in just two months after the factory was established and put into operation.
Although the 30 million is just sales, various costs, profits and taxes, and various expenses have not been deducted.
However, in just two months, such a performance has surprised many people.
"Shiyan, let's discuss with you, this year's Chinese New Year, you bring your parents and children, as well as Mr. Chu, come here.
I'm so busy, I feel like I really don't have time to go back. "
In late January, Su Anying took a moment to call home.
Discuss with Xu Shiyan and ask him to take the old man and children to the south for a Chinese New Year reunion.
"Well, okay, then I'll go home and discuss it with my parents and see what they think."
Xu Shiyan sighed, but it was easy for others to talk about it, but he was afraid that his father would be stubborn and refused.
But there is really no other way right now, the busy workers in the factory over there can't wait to work overtime to catch up with the new year's shipment.
In the first year of the new factory, orders are full again, and customers are waiting in line to pick up the goods, how can Su Anying leave the factory and come back to celebrate the New Year?
This south-to-north route, even if it is by plane, it will take several days to go back and forth.
In case something happens to the factory, Su Anying has no time to deal with it.
Xu Shiyan went home, so he couldn't tell his parents that it was suggested by his wife.
I just said that I want to take my family to Yangcheng to have a different New Year, so that parents and children can experience what it is like to celebrate the New Year in the south.
"Third brother, you don't have to beat around the bush and say that, we know what's going on at home.
Yingzi hit the back of her head with her busy feet at the other end of Shenzhen City, and she couldn't spare time to go back, so you are going to the south for the New Year, right? "
Xu Chenghou immediately understood what his son said.
So he clicked on the pipe and pot, and asked Xu Shiyan without raising his eyes.
"I can't hide anything from my father." Xu Shiyan smiled without denying it.
"Father, Mom, I was thinking, anyway, there is nothing to do at home, Yingzi is too busy to come back.
Why don't we go there for a reunion with our family, so it will be more lively anyway. "
Xu Shiyan is mainly worried about the old people at home.
He can't lead the children to the south and throw the three old people at home, right?
The house is deserted during the Chinese New Year, so how is it plausible?
"Okay, we both understand what you and Yingzi are thinking.
But we are all old, and we are really not willing to toss.
It's too far from here to Yingzi's place, even if you take a plane, it will take you a lot of time.
Besides, at our age, flying is not safe. "Xu Chenghou waved his hand and rejected Xu Shiyan's proposal.
"Just take the child there.
It’s been almost half a year since Yingzi went to the south this time. The children miss their mother and talk about it all day long.
Anyway, Yuanyuan doesn’t have classes this winter, so you can stay there for a while, and come back before the kids start school.
You don’t have to worry at home, I’ll call the eldest and the fifth and ask them to come back for the New Year.
In this way, both sides are lively, so you don't have to be embarrassed. "
Xu Chenghou came up with an idea that had the best of both worlds. It would not only reunite Xu Shiyan's family, but also keep the house from being deserted.
When Xu Shiyan heard this, he really had no other solution.
