"Then I'll call my elder brother and ask if they can come back for the New Year?"
As long as parents have a way to arrange it, it's easy to say.
Xu Shiyan turned around and asked Chu Xuanhuai again.
Chu Xuanhuai also said that at his age, he doesn’t want to travel long distances to the south, so he might as well spend the New Year here.
Xu Shiyan originally wanted to say that the factory is very close to Xin'an Town, and Chu Xuanhuai could meet his grandchildren in the past.
But on second thought, Chu Xuanhuai is the elder.
The juniors of the Chu family didn’t come to visit, but Chu Xuanhuai went to visit them instead. What’s the reason?
So, Xu Shiyan didn't mention it.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan called brothers Xu Shixian, Xu Shixiang, and Xu Shide to ask who could come back for the New Year.
Xu Shixian and others said that they can come back to accompany their parents, so that Xu Shiyan can take the children to the south for a reunion without worry.
Dear friends, happy new year.

chapters.title: Chapter 761: go south for new year
chapters.content:
Chapter 761 Going to the South for the New Year
With the current status of Xu Shiyan and his wife, it is absolutely true in the Xu family.
This is what Xu Shixian and others are reluctant to do.
In addition to Xu Chenghou's repeated orders, they were never allowed to quit their jobs and go into business, so the brothers didn't dare to talk nonsense.
Otherwise, with their brother's ability, does the health care product factory still need an outsider as the factory director?
Although the Xu Shixian brothers failed to do business with Xu Shiyan and his wife to make a lot of money, but with Xu Shiyan around, they all benefited indirectly.
Not to mention anything else, Xu Shixian and the others planted the sticks they planted in the past few years and began to make goods this year, and they were still worried about how to sell them.
With a word from Su Anying, he sent all the clubs of several families to Yangcheng Zhen Thatched Cottage.
Like Huang Shengli and the others, only part of the expenses were deducted, and the rest of the money was returned to Xu Shixian and the others.
Others sell three or four hundred sticks for a ten-foot stick, but their sticks can be sold for more than two hundred yuan per ten-foot stick.
Although it is not as good as the previous few years, the loss is not too bad.
Not only that, Xu Shide helped the households in Xigang Township to contact Su Anying's company.
Bringing them together and helping many ginseng farmers sell sticks, it can be regarded as solving the difficulties of the township government.
The village attaches great importance to Xu Shide, and intends to promote Xu Shide to be the director of the finance department.
It should be said that leaning against a big tree has a lot of benefits.
So the brothers now understand that they have to try their best to get closer to the old couple.
Not to mention going home to spend the New Year with parents, even if they are asked to move back, they have to agree immediately.
The brothers happily agreed to come back for the New Year, Xu Shiyan also heaved a sigh of relief.
As long as parents and master are accompanied, don’t be too lonely.
It was Xu Haiyuan and the others. When they heard that this year, they would follow their father to the south to find their mother and spend the New Year there.
Several children jumped up and down happily. They have never been to such a far place before.
"It is said that the winter in the south is warm, and the leaves and flowers are green in winter.
I don't believe it, this time I have to take a good look.
Won't the leaves of the tree turn yellow or fall in autumn? "Xu Haiqing jumped up and down happily, shouting.
"Look at your ignorant appearance.
Why do tree leaves turn yellow in autumn? That's because the low temperature in autumn destroys the chlorophyll in the leaves.
Chlorophyll is destroyed and does not occupy the main position. Other pigments originally hidden in the leaves will appear, so the leaves will turn red or yellow.
The autumn in the south is warm, and the temperature is not so low that the chlorophyll is destroyed. Of course, the leaves are still green. "
Xu Jinping looked helpless, and gave her younger brother a popular science about why the leaves in the north turn yellow and red in autumn.
"You, you don't like reading every day, and you don't understand anything.
Go out in the future, talk less, don't embarrass our parents. "
Xu Jinping looked at her younger brother helplessly, alas, it's terrible to be uneducated.
Xu Haiqing was belittled by her sister, but she was not annoyed. She just smiled and ran to pack her things.
Arguing with his sister, even if he has eight mouths in this life, he still can't speak.
The point is, even if he can speak well, so what? One accidentally annoyed his sister, and he still had to be beaten.
Yes, a man is a man, and he does not have the same knowledge as a woman.
Pick up your things quickly and prepare to go south for the New Year, this is the serious thing.
"Yes, go and pack up the things you need to bring when you go out.
Bring both thick and thin clothes, as the winter there is not particularly warm.
Especially when we just went there, we are not used to it, so bring two more clothes.
Also, have you finished your homework yet? Hurry up and finish the unfinished two days.
If anyone can't finish their homework, don't go, stay at home and do their homework. "Xu Shiyan deliberately frightened the children.
Actually, the children have already finished their homework.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping are both the kind of people who start to do their homework as soon as they are on vacation, and only go to play after finishing their homework.
Under the supervision of the two of them, even someone as lazy as Xu Haiqing finished the homework ahead of schedule.
It is to play without any burden during the Chinese New Year.
The children had already finished their homework, so they were naturally not afraid of Xu Shiyan's threats, so they happily packed their things.
Going to such a far place to celebrate the New Year, and Xu Shiyan is bringing four children, there are many things that need to be taken into account.
Zhou Guilan was worried, so she hurried to help clean up and prepare.
"By the way, you didn't ask your father-in-law and mother-in-law? Do they want to go to the New Year together?"
Xu Chenghou suddenly remembered this and reminded Xu Shiyan.
"The six daughters of the Su family, except for the eldest, were originally in Donggang.
Look now, the third is in the capital, the fourth is in Yangcheng, and the fifth is sent to Shenzhen by you.
What to do during Chinese New Year? Anyway, you care about it, so let me ask you a question. "
Xu Chenghou sees things as comprehensive and long-term.
The entire Su family has followed Xu Shiyan, and they are now prosperous.
But for the New Year's Eve, the daughters of the Su family can be found everywhere, not in front of the old couple.
Su Weizhong and his wife celebrate the New Year desertedly, isn’t it good?
"Oh, Yingzi told me about this, the fourth and fourth couple will definitely not be able to come back for the New Year.
The youngest couple are in the capital, they are close, they should be able to come back.
I will take the children there, and let the fifth brother-in-law come back to celebrate the New Year.
If the factory develops well next year, it is estimated that the fifth sister will have to go there with her and settle down there, just to help me manage the factory. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and explained to his father.
"The main thing is that An Yu will come back in a few days to get engaged.
My father-in-law is An Yu's uncle, so I had to show up on this occasion, so my father-in-law and mother-in-law stayed at home. "
Su Anyu and her partner are getting along very well. They plan to take advantage of the Chinese New Year and come back to get engaged and find a chance to get married next year.
Su Anyu is the youngest child of the Su family and the last unmarried one.
It's not easy for someone to get engaged, which is a big deal for the old Su family.
Su Anying and the others are far away, and they are busy with work. If they really can’t come back, they have no choice. Those who are at home must participate.
"When the time comes, I'll just take Ji Hongliang with me. It's the Chinese New Year, and the child has to go to reunite with his parents."
Ji Tongzhong and his wife are both busy in the south, and Ji Hongliang lives at the house of his grandparents.
It’s the Chinese New Year, and we must take the children there for a reunion.
Ji Tongzhong and his wife have already bought a house on the other side of Yangcheng, and the family plans to move there to settle down. It is enough to find a school for Ji Hongliang to study there in the next year.
From now on, Su Anfen will be in charge of Zhencaotang, and Ji Tongzhong will be in charge of the sales department of the health care product factory.
The couple earn a lot of money a year, and they can live well wherever they are.
"Well, as long as you know what to do, you can make clear arrangements for your father-in-law and mother-in-law.
Before you leave, you go there, leave some money for the old couple, and buy some new year's goods for the old couple, so don't lose them. "
Xu Chenghou nodded, anyway, he just reminded him, just don’t forget.
No matter what you say, the old Su family has helped Xu Shiyan a lot.
Aside from brothers, aren’t these brothers-in-law the closest?
Without the help of Ji Tongzhong and the others, even if Xu Shiyan and Su Anying had grown superhuman, it would be too much to deal with.
As the Chinese New Year is approaching, there are many things going on at Xu Shiyan's work unit.
If you want to take your children to the south for the New Year, the work unit must make proper arrangements.
This year, the participation company has a lot of orders, and the pharmaceutical factory and the health care product factory (formerly the comprehensive factory) are fully fired.
In addition to the original workers, the participating workers who have no production tasks in winter are all arranged to work in the factory.
In addition, a group of temporary workers were recruited in Donggang, Songjianghe and other places.
In previous years, when ginseng was valuable, most ginseng farmers would go to cats in winter.
Eating, drinking and having fun at home, sometimes drinking and playing cards, rarely come out to find work.
Nowadays, the ginseng industry is in a downturn, making less money, and some people simply stop growing ginseng, so they have to find a place to make money?
As soon as I heard that several factories over there were recruiting workers, many people went to sign up.
Temporary workers are also fine, at least the wages are guaranteed. In winter, find a factory Maodong to earn some money. Isn’t it good to keep it for the New Year?
Several factories are all working in two shifts, with people shutting down machines and working overtime to complete the order delivery as soon as possible.
The newly built daily chemical factory this year also started production a while ago.
Through the unremitting efforts of the scientific research personnel of the factory, it has developed a series of skin care products such as ginseng ganoderma, ginseng rhodiola, ginseng pearl, ginseng bird's nest, ginseng snow lotus and so on.
Each series includes facial cleanser, toner, skin care milk, skin care essence, nourishing day cream, nourishing night cream, and eye essence.
At the same time, there are various masks, body milk, hand cream, barrier milk, liquid foundation, sunscreen and so on.
Although so many have been researched, it is certainly not possible to produce them all.
Still have to reserve technology in advance as before, and products will be released in batches.
The products of the daily chemical factory have all the certification procedures, and are currently making second-hand preparations.
If it can be exported, it is natural to try to export as much as possible first. If the export is not done well, it will be advertised and sold domestically.
Therefore, there is no rush for mass production. First, send the samples through the company in Hong Kong City, and apply for product certification and technical appraisal in various countries. After all, foreign countries recognize these.
Currently, except for the daily chemical factory, which is not profitable for the time being, other pharmaceutical factories, health care product factories, beverage factories, etc. are all producing at full capacity, and they are all making good profits.
So when the year-end summary meeting was held a while ago, all the employees of the company received year-end bonuses of varying amounts.
At the same time, this year the company also gave each employee a lump of fish, a box of apples, a box of pears, and twenty catties of pork.
Workers work overtime in the factory and work hard, the benefits must keep up, and the workers must not be chilled.
Those temporary workers who come to Maodong factory also have year-end benefits, choose fish or meat.
It’s New Year’s Eve, everyone is happy with it.
In addition to the factory directly under the company, Bingshan Beverage Factory is also developing very well.
Guo Fenghua is worthy of being a college student, young and courageous, and decisive in his actions.
When the Asian Games were held in autumn, Guo Fenghua found a way to sponsor the national team and became the designated sports drink supplier for the Asian Games of the national team.
This item alone has brought huge benefits to Bingshan Beverage Factory.
Moreover, Bingshan sports drink has also become a hit with this. Now not only the domestic sales are very good, but also many foreign merchants place orders.
The other side of the flooring factory will start production in December.
Many machines in the floor factory are imported from West Germany.
Didn't Guo Shouye take people out to study and investigate before? In order to understand the foreign market, I got in touch with some flooring sellers there.
The other party was very interested in the new type of floor described by Guo Shouye.
After the factory started construction, Guo Shouye invited many sellers to visit.
Not to mention, there are already several flooring companies that have ordered products with the factory.
Although the current order amount is not too much, it is better than nothing.
Develop slowly. If new products want to open up the market, there must be a process.
Xu Shiyan sorted out the work in hand, and called Dai Chunrong and others over for a meeting.
"Well, I'm going to take my children to Yangcheng to celebrate the New Year, and I just happened to take a look at the factory over there.
In this case, the family needs everyone to pay more attention. "
"General manager, don't worry at home, the safekeeping is fine.
The factory at the other end is booming now, and Mr. Su really can't do without it. It's also good for the development of the factory there if you go and have a look. "
Dai Chunrong, Li Bingzhuo and others naturally have no opinion.
The company is currently operating normally, and the division of labor between various departments is clear. Just a few days ago, whether Xu Shiyan was at home or not didn't matter at all.
For the development of the factory, the couple have been separated for half a year. They must be considerate.
To put it bluntly, has anyone seen a factory that can achieve tens of millions in sales within two or three months of starting production?
Years ago and these days, now is a great time to shop and give gifts.
Based on the current trend, if there is trouble a year ago, there will still be sales of 10 to 20 million.
In such a profitable factory, Xu Shiyan sits there all the year round, and people like Dai Chunrong don't have any opinions.
"Okay, I'll work hard for you all. I'll give you a turn to take a vacation when I'm not busy in the summer, and you all go out for a walk."
In recent years, Dai Chunrong, Li Bingzhuo and others have been working diligently and conscientiously, and have little time for vacation.
Now the company is on the right track, and the departments are functioning well.
Xu Shiyan felt that his abilities had come to an end, and there was no room for him to display them in the future.
They just need to maintain the company and develop it stably.
It's time to lead the big guys to relax, and people can't stay tense all the time.
"Oh, thank you to the general manager." Everyone laughed when they heard this.
"Let's talk about this matter later. When the general manager returns from the south, we can think about taking turns to take vacations."
Everyone looked at each other, very happy.
The company's affairs were properly arranged, and Xu Shiyan found Guo Shouye, Guo Fenghua and his son, Yang Junxian, Zhou Qingguo and others.
Everyone have a meal together, and explain the affairs of other factories.
After that, I asked someone to help me buy a train ticket, and then called someone to help me book a plane ticket.
Early on the morning of January 26, the driver came to pick up Xu Shiyan and five children, and sent them to the train station.
This time I went out, I still took the train from Songjianghe to Shenyang, and then took the plane from Shenyang to Yangcheng.
Although Su Anying bought a house in Bao'an, the house was not too big, and it was a bit small for their family of six.
On the contrary, there is a hotel upstairs in Yangcheng Zhen Thatched Cottage, and there is a house behind.
The place is big enough to live in, and it is more spacious to lead the children to live there.
The sleeper ticket bought by the train is exactly the six berths opposite.
I originally wanted to buy a soft sleeper, but there are only four berths in a small private room.
Xu Shiyan took care of five children by himself, and he was worried about which one was not in front of his eyes, so he could only sleep hard.
Xu Haiqing and Ji Hongliang are on the upper berth, Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui are on the middle berth, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Shiyan are on the lower berth.
Xu Haiyuan is old, smart and sensible, he can help take care of his younger siblings in the lower bunk, and it is convenient for him to run errands for anything.
The update during this period is really not very effective, there is really no way. At present, my son and I are basically fine, and we still have a little cough. The little girl is seriously ill, coughing constantly, and can't even sleep well at night, I have to hug and coax her, it's really hard. It feels better last night, and it will probably recover after a few more days. I will adjust it as soon as possible, hoping to resume the update soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 762: Take baby south
chapters.content:
Chapter 762 Take the baby south
These six sleeper tickets were bought by Xu Shiyan with the help of someone.
It’s the middle of the twelfth lunar month, and there are a lot of people going out and returning home. It’s hard to buy train tickets, and it’s even harder to find sleeper tickets.
In recent years, Xu Shiyan has also handed over many people. Some people work in the railway system and helped reserve six sleeper tickets together.
Fortunately, I bought a sleeper berth, which is far away from the hard seat, so it is not so crowded.
Get on the bus at 8:30 in the morning, and the children are not sleepy at all.
Especially the younger ones, it was the first time they had traveled far by train, and after getting on the train, they were in great spirits.
They didn't run around to give Xu Shiyan face, it was impossible to stay obediently on the upper bunk.
Xu Haiqing didn't know when to stuff a few boxes of poker into his bag, and this is just right, take it out to play poker with his brothers and sisters.
The children occupied the small table by the window, and several of them played poker noisily.
After playing enough, I dig out all kinds of delicious food from my respective bags.
Both Zhou Guilan and Han Caie prepared a lot of food for the children.
Biscuits, cakes, ham sausages, instant noodles, canned food, fruits, candies, anyway, only Xu Shiyan can't think of, there is nothing they can't stuff in.
This group of children are not polite, they just eat what they catch, and continue to play after eating.
When did I have enough fun and was so tired that I climbed to the upper bunk to rest.
Fortunately, the time from Songjianghe to Shenyang is not too long. Get on the bus in the morning and arrive in the evening.
Before arriving at the station, Xu Shiyan led the children to pack up their things, and led them out of the car with thousands of instructions.
I didn't dare to go too far after leaving the station, so I simply found a hotel opposite the station to stay.
The children slept on the berths during the day, and refused to go to bed early when they arrived at the hotel. Xu Haiqing led Ji Hongliang in all kinds of mischief.
With a nephew around, Xu Shiyan is not easy to turn his face.
Xu Jinping, on the other hand, saw that her father's face was not right, so she immediately stepped forward, slapped her and yelled at her.
"Honestly, go to rest, you are jumping around in the middle of the night, where is this? Do you think this is your home?"
It’s quite old and ignorant, if you don’t go to sleep again, we won’t call you when we get up tomorrow morning, and just throw you here. "
Xu Jinping put her hands on her hips, pointed at her younger brother and started training.
Xu Haiqing was slapped by her sister, and she was quite aggrieved at first.
As a result, when he heard what his sister said, he was so frightened that he didn't dare to say anything, and obediently took off his clothes and went into bed to sleep.
Ji Hongliang was also afraid of this cousin, and he was even more worried that if he couldn't get up tomorrow morning, he would also be left behind.
So he didn't dare to swear anymore, and obediently got into bed to rest.
Xu Jinhui, on the other hand, has already laid down and closed her eyes, behaving well.
Over there, Xu Haiyuan could only shake his head as he watched his younger brother being beaten.
The stinky boy deserves it, he really thought that he could disobey the heavens when he left the house, right? If you don't deserve a beating, it's time for mixed doubles.
Xu Shiyan heaved a sigh of relief when he saw the children lying down obediently.
I have to say, it has to be the eldest daughter of his family, she has been like this for two lifetimes, and she is definitely a good hand at taking care of her younger brother.
"Everyone get a good night's sleep, we have to go to the airport to take a flight tomorrow, and that thing is not as comfortable as the sleeper.
I have to sit for several hours on this journey, and I am exhausted. "
Xu Shiyan went over, tucked the quilts for the children one by one, and saw that the children were all asleep, so he fell asleep with peace of mind.
Woke up early the next day, led the children to wash up, and then went out to find a place to have breakfast.
Near the station, there is plenty of breakfast, but it's a bit more expensive, there's nothing wrong with it.
Guotao, tendon cake, tofu brain, porridge, salted duck eggs, anyway, children can eat whatever they want.
After breakfast, find a way to find two taxis and take them to the airport.
The air tickets are also booked in advance by a trustee. After all, there are six people. If you don’t book in advance, you may not have so many tickets if you buy it temporarily.
After a lot of tossing, I finally led the children to board the plane.
These brats are flying for the first time, and they are so curious after boarding the plane.
At any rate, the two older ones were quite calm. With them in control, the younger ones didn't dare to make too much noise.
Of course, it is impossible to be too quiet, after all, it is the first time to fly by plane.
When the children saw the white clouds outside the window, they all exclaimed, even Xu Jinping was no exception.
The only one who is calm is Xu Haiyuan.
"Sorry, it's the kids' first time flying, and they've never seen anything like this before.
The redneck went to town, making everyone laugh. "
Xu Shiyan didn't want to scold the children too loudly, so he had no choice but to nod and smile at the passengers around him to apologize.
No way, it’s really hard to take a bear kid on a plane and not disturb others.
As a father, he can only risk his face to make amends.
"Brother, there is no need to say anything.
When adults like us take a plane for the first time, we are all so excited, let alone children?
I can understand it, as a child, it is rare to see anything. "
The people next to them all had a good attitude, and they didn't show any impatience with the children's bluffing.
It is not ordinary people who can fly by plane these days, and those who can take five children by plane are not ordinary people.
When you are away from home, no one likes to cause trouble, so let's show mutual understanding and make a good relationship.
"Brother, are these five children from your family? Oh, there are not many people with five children in this year.
But I look like those three are about the same age, triplets? "
Most of the Northeast people are familiar with each other, and there is nothing wrong on the plane, so someone started talking to Xu Shiyan.
"No, no, four belong to my family, and the youngest one is a relative's child.
It’s not that my daughter-in-law and her natal sister are both doing business in the south. This year is too busy to make money and come back for the New Year.
I will take the children of the two families and go to the south to celebrate the New Year together.
It’s the first time for the children to travel far away, and it was the same on the train yesterday. Oh, hey, I wish I could lift the roof of the train. "
When someone chatted with him in a friendly voice, Xu Shiyan naturally didn't want to ignore him, so he started chatting with him.
"Oh, co-authoring is for business, so it's no wonder.
In this year and month, everyone who goes into business has money.
Just now I wondered, whose family is so rich, taking five children on the plane, it turns out that the mother of the children is in business.
Really good, amazing. "The other party said while looking at Xu Shiyan a few times.
"My brother doesn't look like an ordinary person, where is his home? What unit do you work in?"
Xu Shiyan has been working for these years, and his temperament is also different from before.
So when people saw him, they guessed that he worked in the unit.
"I'm from Jilin, working in a small factory.
The efficiency of the unit is not very good, so the daughter-in-law resigned and went into business. "
When you are away from home, you can’t tell the truth, especially when you are on the train. It is most important not to let people know your identity.
Although most of the people on the plane are wealthy and well-known people, it’s not easy to tell the truth.
Half of it is false and half of it is real. Anyway, they don't know each other, so it's just a matter of fooling around.
Xu Shiyan’s scheduled flight takes off at 10:00 am and arrives in Yangcheng around 3:00 pm.
Five hours, whether it is long or short.
Anyway, the children have experienced everything from the initial curiosity to the boredom.
Just when the children were about to lose patience, the flight attendant reminded the passengers that the plane was about to land.
Xu Haiqing and the others cheered, "Finally we're almost there, it's really tiring."
Taking a plane is not as comfortable as taking a train. At least the train is easy to ride, you can sit or lie down, and you can walk around casually.
This plane is too stiff and boring.
The plane landed on time, Xu Shiyan took the children to pack their luggage and went out with everyone.
Here in Yangcheng, Su Anying arranged for Ji Tongzhong and Li Zongliang to pick him up.
As soon as Xu Shiyan came out with the children, he saw the two brothers-in-law waving at them.
"Second brother-in-law, thank you for your hard work. You alone lead five children, and you will be exhausted along the way."
Ji Tongzhong and Li Zongliang were very happy to see Xu Shiyan, and came forward to greet him warmly.
"dad."
When Ji Hongliang saw his father, he didn't care about anything else. He dropped the bag in his hand, and a tall boy jumped into his father's arms, wrapping his arms around Ji Tongzhong's neck without letting go.
The child has not seen his parents for a long time, can he not panic?
"Second brother-in-law, let's go, the second sister is busy today, she said that she will go to Zhencaotang to welcome you in the evening."
Li Zongliang smiled and took the backpack from his nephew, and then took the bag from his niece.
He is tall and big, this thing is not a problem at all.
While talking, everyone walked out from the airport, went to the parking lot outside, and saw a minibus.
Li Zongliang explained, saying that this is a car bought by the factory, mainly for receiving customers, it can seat more than a dozen people, it is more spacious and convenient than a car.
Xu Shiyan nodded and led the children into the car.
Then Li Zongliang drove, pulled everyone out of the airport, and went straight to the location of Zhencaotang on Feng'an Street.
Although it is afternoon, Zhencaotang is very lively, with many customers coming and going.
Zhencaotang wholesales and retails all kinds of local specialties in Northeast China. Since its opening, the business has been very good.
A while ago, Su Anfen specially vacated two store counters, specializing in the distribution of various products of Jishengyuan Health Products Factory, especially the three main products this year.
Now, the business is even more prosperous. From morning to night, the store has a non-stop flow of customers.
People who come to buy health care products will buy some souvenirs and go back, killing two birds with one stone.
The storefront of Zhencaotang is very large, with more than ten rooms facing the street, except for the two rooms on the east side which are reserved for the reception of the hotel, the rest are all opened up and placed on the counter shelves.
The shelves are full of various Northeast local specialties, and each type of product is subdivided into many kinds of packaging and quality.
The store is surrounded by counter shelves, and there are more than a dozen specimens of sika deer in the open space in the middle. Big and small are lifelike and vivid.
In addition to sika deer specimens, there are also several shelves, and five or six white tables, each with four chairs.
This is a place for customers to sit down and have a chat and drink tea. Customers who are tired from walking around the door can sit down and rest.
The clerk makes a pot of Bao Martin tea, or dandelion tea, ginseng tea, etc.
There is a shelf next to each table, but what is placed on the shelf is not goods, but various product manuals.
Those brochures are full of introductions about the efficacy of the products, with pictures and texts, which are lively and interesting.
Guests are sipping tea while flipping through the product brochures at will, and they may be optimistic about some products.
Enough interest, buy whatever you want, and then check out with a lot of things.
"Second brother-in-law, let's go back to the backyard to rest first, there are too many people in the store right now."
Li Zongliang stopped the car and turned around to ask Xu Shiyan for his opinion.
The main reason is that there are a lot of people in the store at the moment, and Li Zongliang is worried that these little kids will get out of the car and enter the store to make trouble.
It's better to go to the backyard to rest first, and wait until the store is not so busy.
What Li Zongliang meant, needless to say, Xu Shiyan naturally understood.
"Well, let's rest and settle down first before we talk. These few people are panicking because they are tired from flying."
Others are better. Xu Haiqing and Ji Hongliang are definitely monkeys who can turn mountains and seas into heaven and earth.
Now is not the time for them to mess around casually. It is better to go to the backyard to settle down first, and wait for Su Anying to come over.
Just like that, Ji Tongzhong and Li Zongliang helped carry the luggage, and everyone entered through the side door and went straight to the backyard.
The backyard is a row of two-story buildings, divided into two parts, east and west, and two doors open.
The east side is reserved for residential use, and the first floor is the living room, kitchen, dining room and several separate rooms.
The second floor is all separate rooms, just like ordinary bedrooms, with beds, sofas, wardrobes and so on.
The half of the west end is not cleaned up. It is full of various shelves, which are used as warehouses.
Currently living here is Su Anfen and several shop assistants from other places. Su Anfen lives on the second floor, and the shop assistants live in the room on the first floor.
Ji Tongzhong can come back and live for three to five days when he is not busy, but he may not be there when he is busy. Sometimes it is too late and he simply lives in the staff dormitory of the health care product factory.
Not to mention Li Zongliang and others, most of them live in the staff dormitory.
Knowing that Xu Shiyan was going to bring the children to celebrate the New Year, Su Anfen asked someone to clean up the room on the second floor in advance.
The largest bedroom is reserved for Su Anying and Xu Shiyan, and Xu Haiyuan and the others live in the next room.
The living room on the first floor is very large, with a sofa, TV and so on.
The children came in and didn't care about anything else, just slumped on the sofa and turned on the TV to watch TV.
But in this time period, there is no good-looking TV. As soon as I turned it on, I saw the advertisement of Jishengyuan health care products.
When the children are at home, the provincial TV station also broadcasts these during the day.
I thought I couldn’t watch this ad when I came to the south, but when I turned on the TV, it was still the same thing, and I couldn’t help but howl.
"Dad, it's all these everywhere, oh, it's so annoying."
Even Xu Jinping couldn't bear it a bit, and complained there.
"Okay, don't watch TV for now, quickly take all your luggage upstairs, choose a room by yourself and settle down.
Waiting for the night to watch TV, what else can I do if I don’t watch commercials at this time? "
Xu Shiyan thought, this effect is what he wants. Without such brainwashing publicity methods, can the product be so popular as soon as it goes on the market?
In order to make money, you have to take some extraordinary measures.
The children got up from the sofa reluctantly, each carried their luggage and walked to the second floor, and went up to the second floor to look around from room to room.
Finally, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing chose the room on the left of their parents' bedroom, and Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui chose the room on the right.
Ji Hongliang didn't choose a room by himself, if his father came to live, he would squeeze with Brother Xu Haiyuan.
If his father doesn't come to live, he will live with Su Anfen.
After the room was selected, the children quickly put all their luggage in the locker, and then went downstairs to play in the yard.
The yard outside is very large, with some flowers and trees planted, and two dogs and a few cats.
The children were not too tired, and they all ran around the yard, playing with cats and dogs, having a great time.

chapters.title: Chapter 763: foodie world
chapters.content:
Chapter 763 The World of Foodies
In the evening, Su Anying drove back to Zhencaotang.
As soon as I entered the backyard, I saw children messing around in the yard. The cats that were playing in the yard were chased by the children and hid in the trees.
"You guys are really good at it. Those cats were raised to catch mice. Look, the ones you scare all ran up the tree."
Su Anying is very helpless, these brats, they are really good.
"Mommy mommy."
Xu Haiqing and Ji Hongliang were gesticulating in the yard with sticks in their hands.
Seeing Su Anying come in, she immediately threw the stick and ran towards her mother, hugged her waist and did not let go.
The girls Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui, who were squatting in front of the fish tank watching the fish, also rushed over and hugged their mother.
Xu Haiyuan is old anyway, and can't act like a baby like his younger brothers and sisters, so he just walks up to Su Anying with a smile.
"Mom, I haven't seen you for a long time. You have lost weight. Is the factory very busy?"
Xu Haiyuan could tell at a glance that Su Anying's face couldn't hide the tiredness.
This is caused by long-term worry and labor. If it is not adjusted in time, it is easy to fall into trouble.
"It's okay, not too thin. The factory has just started, and it's really busy. It's okay. It won't be so busy after the next year."
Su Anying looked at her eldest son who was taller than herself, and smiled.
"Mom, let me help you dredge the meridians tonight, I feel that you are not in a good state now."
Xu Haiyuan was a little worried. He was afraid that his mother would be overworked. What if he got sick?
"Some problems are not obvious at first, but if they are not properly rectified, they will easily become serious problems."
Su Anying naturally couldn't refuse her son's wishes.
"Okay, then listen to my eldest son." Su Anying raised her hand and helped her son tidy up his hair.
"I haven't seen you in half a year, and I've grown taller again. Take a look, she's a bit taller than me.
Go, go into the house, let go of those cats and the fish in that tank. "
Su Anying put her arms around the two younger ones, followed by the two older ones and her nephew, and entered the room together.
In the living room, Xu Shiyan was chatting with Ji Tongzhong and Li Zongliang.
Seeing Su Anying leading the children in, Xu Shiyan laughed.
"Are they going to demolish the yard for you?
After sitting on the plane for several hours, I was so suffocated that I didn't rest here, and they all ran out to mess around.
I didn't care about them, let them run around for a while, otherwise they would not stop sleeping at night. "
Children in their teens are full of energy, and it is their nature to love to play and make trouble. Xu Shiyan can't manage too strictly.
In the yard, you can do whatever you want. Anyway, cats and dogs suffer a little bit, so what should I do?
Su Anying laughed when she heard the words, "Leading five children along the way is enough for you.
How is your home? This year, I don't care about the other side of the house anymore. I talked to Yufeng on the phone a few days ago, and said that the other side of the house is okay? "
Su Anying patted the children and told them to sit down and watch TV. She sat by Xu Shiyan's side and chatted with Xu Shiyan.
"Well, the family is doing well, the market is going well this year, and the turnover is not low.
The hotels and restaurants in the city are also very profitable. The fertilizer factory has made a lot of profits this year, with a net profit of four to five million, right?
Jun Xian said that the factory will be expanded next year.
The benefits of the farms are also very good, and the net profit of the three farms is also three to four million. "
The Qingfeng foliar fertilizer produced by the fertilizer factory has passed several provincial and national scientific and technological research and development awards, and its efficacy has been recognized by many agricultural authorities.
So foliar fertilizers are not only sold in this province, but also ordered by customers all over the country.
Originally, the factory was a bit small and not developed enough, and the geographical location was not very good, so it was inconvenient to transport materials.
So Yang Junxian plans to find another place next year to build another factory and start a fertilizer factory.
The farm is in the hands of Xu Shian, and it can be regarded as developing very well.
Xu Shian built two new deer farms in Kaifeng Forest Farm and Funan Forest Farm, expanding the breeding scale.
The original four kilometers area has also been approved for land expansion, which is about twice the size of the original farm.
Nowadays, most of the deer products and musk in the farms are supplied to ginseng companies and pharmaceutical factories, and they have become raw material suppliers, so there is no need to worry about sales.
Waiting for Kaifeng and Funan's farms to scale up in a few years, the profits will be even higher.
"The company's profit this year is not bad. In this regard, I think Yufeng must have told you."
The company Xu Shiyan mentioned refers to the original Baishan Ginseng Comprehensive Company, which is the company opened by Su Anying and Huang Shengli.
At present, the company is basically equivalent to the raw material supply unit of the health care product factory.
Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others all became purchasers.
On the one hand, they are responsible for the procurement of raw materials for the health care product factory, and on the other hand, they have to ensure the supply of goods to the three stores of Zhencaotang, which is enough for them to be busy.
Of course, being busy is nothing, as long as you can earn money, you are happy no matter how busy you are.
"Well, that's fine, as long as the big guys can make money along with it." Su Anying smiled.
"The health care product factory is currently in a good situation, and sales have soared in the past few days.
I feel that by the end of the year, there will be another increase. It is estimated that the total sales before the year will reach 60 to 70 million. "
The peak period of visiting relatives and friends is the root of the new year and the next year. It is estimated that many merchants have to stock up on a batch of goods the year before, so the sales before the year can be much higher.
"When you said you were going to build a health care product factory, I thought it would be good to earn a few million a year at most. I really didn't expect that you would make such money."
Su Anying still has an unreal feeling, all this seems to be in a dream.
She knows better than anyone how profitable this health product is.
Continuing to develop like this, it seems that it is not impossible for this health care product factory to develop for another two or three years, and their family's assets will exceed 100 million.
"Well, earning money is sure, but everyone has to be steady, don't wander around and toss around.
Remember, product quality must be strictly controlled, and don’t cut corners just to make money.
It is not easy for us to create a brand, so don’t destroy your foundation. "
The trend of health care products in China will still be popular for several years.
In the previous life, some big bosses who made health care products had an annual revenue of more than one billion yuan.
As long as Jishengyuan Health Products Factory develops step by step, it will be difficult not to make money if there is no moth.
Of course, the bonus period of health care products is not so long, let’s make money first.
In the future, we will find a way to transform and try our best to transfer to pharmaceutical companies in order to develop in the long run.
There is no need to say too much about these things right now. Xu Shiyan and his wife can decide on the specific development direction, and they can't tell others.
"Well, I got it, don't worry, the quality inspection department of the factory is not just for nothing.
There is a small meeting every three days and a meeting every five days, and the product quality must be guaranteed. "
Su Anying has experienced these years, how can she not understand these things?
"Oops, it's getting late.
Let's not eat at home tonight, I have booked a restaurant in advance, let's go out to eat tonight, and clean up the dust for you. "
It gets dark much later in Yangcheng than in Northeast China, and the living habits are different. Most people are used to going to bed late.
So many shops here are open late at night.
The business hours of Zhencaotang in winter are from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., and the staff have to get off work after 8:00 p.m.
The shop assistants all adopt the method of base salary plus commission, and the more goods they sell, the more money they make.
There are many customers in the store at night, and no one is willing to leave work early in order to earn more money.
Moreover, the store hired someone to cook, and they took care of two regular meals and one supper.
After get off work at 8:00 p.m., there is still a late-night snack, and the food is good, so no one thinks it’s okay to get off work late.
Earn a lot of money, pay well, if you get off work late, you will be late.
They are all unmarried little girls, nothing to worry about, eager to earn more money.
The aunt who cooks is only responsible for the daily meals of the shop staff. Xu Shiyan and the others came here on the first day, and people don’t know their taste, so this meal is not easy to cook.
That's why Su Anying said that everyone went out to eat together in the evening, which was counted as a welcome for Xu Shiyan and the children.
At around 6:30, Su Anying went to call Su Anfen out, and everyone went out together to the pre-booked restaurant.
Since the children have come to Yangcheng, they must have a taste of the local specialties of Yangcheng, so Su Anying ordered a Cantonese restaurant.
As a result, Xu Haiqing began to shout as soon as the dishes were served.
"Mom, this dish is too little, one small dish, one small dish, why? How much do you need to eat to be full?"
Xu Haiqing looked at the plates on the table, and felt that they were so small, they couldn't compare with the big plates and bowls at home.
"Shut up and don't talk, no one will treat you as dumb.
Each place has its own customs. Do you think that wherever you go, it’s like ours? It’s all big stews, and you can’t wait to serve them?
Eat your meal honestly, how can our mother make you hungry? "
This time, without Xu Jinping talking, Xu Haiyuan glared at his younger brother first.
This brat has been a bit embarrassing recently, I really thought no one would care about him after he came out, right?
Xu Haiyuan didn't speak easily to scold his younger brother, but when he spoke, Xu Haiqing shrank his neck in fright, and didn't dare to say anything anymore.
Fortunately, for foodies, food can heal everything.
Xu Haiqing's attention quickly shifted to the food in front of him.
Although the cooking styles of the north and the south are different, the food has no boundaries.
The food in front of me is not as grand as the Northeast, but it is exquisite enough. It should be said that the north and the south have their own merits.
For Xu Haiqing, as long as it tastes good, it doesn't matter the size of the plate.
My family was reunited, and I didn't find a particularly big restaurant, just an ordinary restaurant.
Although this restaurant is not too big, the master cooks are skilled and the dishes are also very good.
Sliced ​​chicken with **** and scallions, suckling pig with sesame skin, fish maw in clear soup, sweet and sour sweet and sour pork, boiled sea prawns, etc., are all very well done.
The children have never eaten it before, and they all think it is very fresh.
Su Anying didn't care about that, and ordered a lot of dishes, and the children could eat and drink whatever they wanted, as long as they were full.
"How is it? Is it delicious?"
Su Anying couldn't help laughing seeing her youngest son eating so boldly, and wiped the sauce on his face with a handkerchief.
"Eat slowly, no one will grab you, if these are not enough, Mom will order a few more dishes for you."
Watching this child eat, I feel that all the food is delicious.
"Well, it's delicious. Although the cooking is different from ours, it tastes good.
Each has its own flavor, I think it's pretty good. "Xu Haiqing ate until he was 70% full, so he was free to chat.
He only mentioned eating, and he seemed to be a different person, able to speak clearly and clearly.
"A foodie, that's all I can do."
Xu Jinping was sitting next to her elder brother, and the brother and sister were muttering there, laughing while muttering.
"Eat more if you like, let your dad take you for a walk around when you have time, and learn about the customs here.
There are quite a lot of delicious food here, it is close to the sea, and there are many kinds of seafood, so you can buy whatever you want.
The restaurant specially hired an aunt who cooks. She cooks delicious food, especially seafood.
If you don’t like to eat the dishes made by your aunt, then go to a restaurant. "
Su Anying picked up a few more pieces of meat for her youngest son, watching her son eat.
"Mom, won't you accompany us?" Over there, Xu Haiyuan asked casually.
"Mom doesn't have time, the factory is very busy.
Workers are now working in two shifts, working overtime, and there are a lot of shipments from the workshop every day.
Your fifth uncle and the others will go back to the Northeast in a few days, so I have to stay in the factory and watch.
I guess at least it will be the 25th and 6th of the twelfth lunar month. It's not bad if I can relax a little. "
Around the twenty-fifth of the twelfth lunar month, when the last batch of goods from the year before was sent out, the factory can take a break.
It happened to be a holiday for the workers to go home for the New Year, so Su Anying could also breathe a sigh of relief.
In the first year of the factory, no one expected it to be so prosperous. The main persons in charge came here alone, and the wife and children were all at home.
It’s a big Chinese New Year, why can’t the family celebrate the New Year in two places?
Su Anying discussed with several backbones in the factory. Years ago, she and Ji Tongzhong stayed here, and the others went home to reunite for the New Year.
Waiting for the next year, those who have wives will lead their wives, and those who have children will bring their children, and the factory will buy a house for them to settle down here, so as not to worry about the future.
"Mom, otherwise, ask my dad to help you. He should understand these things better than you."
Xu Haiyuan glanced at Xu Shiyan, motioning for his father to speak.
"Yes, I'll go over and help, I can't make you too tired."
Xu Shiyan came here so long in advance, one of the children was missing their mother, and they were clamoring to come quickly.
Another one, Xu Shiyan also wanted to help out and share the burden for his wife.
"No need? If you were busy in the past, what will happen to the rest?
Let them be worried here, lead them there, there are not enough places to live. "
Su Anying wished her husband could go over and help out, but what about the children? Nobody cares.
"Sixth younger sister still has a house, right next door? If not, let's borrow it for a while."
Xu Shiqin has a house, which is next door to the one Su Anying bought.
Let Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing live in the past, so that they can live comfortably.
When I was at home, I actually thought about where to live here.
Xu Shiyan and his wife think that the children are used to living in one-story houses, and they are suddenly asked to live in a building of fifty or sixty square meters. The children are too aggrieved, so they are arranged here.
At least there is a big yard at this end, where the children can play.
"Well, that's fine.
Anyway, there is no rush. It doesn’t matter if you take the children to play for a few days first. It’s been a long time. It’s not bad for three or two days.
Besides, I have been busy for ten or eight days a year ago, and I can take a good rest when the factory is on holiday. "
Su Anying felt that their husband and wife were busy adults, and they didn't have much chance to accompany their children.
It’s not easy for the children to come to the south for the New Year, so we should let them have fun.
If Xu Shiyan went to the factory to help, who would play with the children?
Can't the kids come all the way and just stay at home and watch TV?

chapters.title: Chapter 764: Mouth to clean up
chapters.content:
Chapter 764 Clean up the mouth
"Dad, Mom, are you making simple things complicated?"
Xu Haiyuan looked at the serious parents in front of him who were discussing how to arrange the children.
"We don't need to live there, it's good here, and my dad doesn't need to accompany us.
There should be a travel agency here in Yangcheng, right? Find one and sign up for us.
It doesn’t have to be too much trouble, as long as there is a driver and a tour guide to take us to play. "
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were both stunned, looking at Xu Haiyuan in surprise.
"Travel agency? Why did you think of a travel agency?" Xu Shiyan didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
"Son, the travel agencies are all accepting large tour groups, especially those from foreigners and compatriots from Hong Kong and Taiwan.
Personal small team, I'm afraid they won't be able to receive them, right? "
Travel agencies in this era are not later generations. They are now called China Travel Service, Youth Travel Service or something, and they belong to public institutions.
Generally, large tour groups are accepted, such as a small group of several people, they are not accepted at all.
Xu Haiyuan smiled, "As long as the money is in place, are there still people who won't be accepted?
Now travel agencies seem to be self-operated and responsible for their own profits and losses, right? how? Don't earn money? "
As the forefront of opening up, no matter what unit, it is the first to accept the transformation of the market economy.
I don’t believe it, and there are also fools who don’t earn the money delivered to their door.
"Dad, you don't have to worry about this matter. I'll call Uncle Qin at night and ask him to ask for me."
The Uncle Qin that Xu Haiyuan mentioned was Qin Shaoping.
Xu Haiyuan and these disciples of Chu Xuanhuai often exchanged letters, and those masters were very rare for this little nephew.
There is no need for Xu Shiyan to do this matter, Xu Haiyuan can handle it by himself.
Xu Shiyan and his wife were dumbfounded, okay, the co-authors have already made plans for their children, so they don't need to worry about it at all.
"Okay, then there is no need to say anything, I will chat with your Master Qin tonight.
It would be best if he can arrange it, but if he can't, I'll find a way for you. "
Children have ideas when they grow up, and they can really let them play.
Don't dare to say anything else, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, two monsters, don't have to worry about where they go, as long as they don't sell others.
Besides, they are all children of this age, so it's time for them to exercise.
In this way, the father and son reached a consensus under the surprised expressions of others.
Then the children happily finished their meal, Su Anying went to pay the bill, and the whole family walked back happily.
The night in Yangcheng is much more beautiful than that in the Northeast. Outside the various shops, colorful neon lights are flickering, making the night extremely bright and vivid.
The children were running and jumping on the sidewalk, laughing and laughing happily.
Everyone is wearing thick clothes. It's a little cold outside, which doesn't affect the children's playfulness at all.
"This time, I really believe it. It turns out that in winter in the south, the leaves are really green."
Xu Haiqing said with emotion while walking, looking up at the trees on the side of the road.
"There are still many things you don't know. When you have a chance in the future, your parents will take you out for a walk."
Xu Shiyan and his wife walked forward arm in arm, and couldn't help laughing when they heard what their youngest son said.
"Dad, don't fool us.
You and my mother are so busy every day that you can’t even see the shadows, and you still have time to take us out for a walk?
I think, when you are free, you might as well look forward to my brother. "
Xu Haiqing, who was jumping up and down, curled his lips, his father is just fooling people, they are not children anymore, so I don't believe it.
Xu Haiqing's words caused everyone to be astonished.
Ji Tongzhong, his wife and Li Zongliang both turned their heads to look at Xu Shiyan, holding back their laughter and not daring to make a sound.
These children of the Xu family are ghostly, they are full of minds, and they can't be fooled at all.
Xu Shiyan looked at the younger son who was still stunned in front of him, and sighed.
"Well, it seems that I am becoming less and less prestigious now. Even Xu Haiqing can question what I say."
Xu Shiyan held his wife's arm and sighed half-truthfully.
"Xu Haiqing, are you itchy? I think I haven't been home for half a year. Are you going to heaven?"
Sure enough, Su Anying turned his face in a second, and immediately pointed at Xu Haiqing and threatened.
Xu Haiqing was so frightened that his heart trembled, it was over.
I haven't seen my mother for a long time, and I forgot that his mother is the most powerful one in the family.
His father usually doesn't like to fight, but his mother really hits.
"Mom, I was wrong, can't I be wrong? I don't mean anything else, really, I just want to talk bald for a while.
Dad, I was wrong, please tell my mother. "
Xu Haiqing was so frightened that he hurriedly begged for mercy. He didn't want to be served a meal of fried pork with sticks by his mother on the first day of his arrival in Yangcheng.
Xu Haiyuan and the two younger sisters didn't say a word, and neither of them pleaded with the fourth child.
It deserves it, this kid has been a little drifting lately, and he didn't need to clean up, so he should let his mother give him a good slap, so as to save him from being owed endlessly.
"Daughter-in-law, you should make an account for him first, and we can talk about it when we return to the Northeast. If you discount his dog legs at this time, it will be troublesome to go back."
Xu Shiyan looked at his youngest son with a half-smile, deliberately scaring him.
When Xu Haiqing heard this, his face turned pale with fright. His father is so cruel. He wanted to break his legs.
"Yes, Xu Haiqing, you wait for me, I will record it for you first.
I can't stay here all the time. I'll go home after your fifth uncle and the others come back in the next year.
Do you think I will deal with you when I get home? I think you owe a call, you wait. "
Su Anying put on a tiger face on purpose to scare her youngest son.
This little guy is sloppy all day long, and has a hob meat, so he has to be beaten by someone all day long.
Finished, the mouth is in trouble.
Xu Haiqing finally became listless this time, with his shoulders slumped, not in the mood to jump around, and listlessly followed beside his elder brother and sister, walking back slowly.
"You deserve it, how many times have I told you, be careful when you speak, you can take jokes on anyone, right?
I said a long time ago that you are going to be beaten, hum. "Xu Jinping glanced at her younger brother and hummed.
On the other end, Su Anfen, his wife, and Li Zongliang all felt bad when they saw this.
"Sister, look at you, the child has come all the way to see you, it's only the first day, why are you falling out with the child?"
Su Anfen leaned over to her sister and whispered.
"Fourth, you don't understand, that fart kid must beat him, or he will go to heaven.
Didn’t Yuanyuan say it just now? Next, without our company, he led his brothers and sisters out to play.
I don't worry about anyone else, but I'm afraid that Hai Qing will be silly and ignore me.
Bang him tonight, at least he can be honest for a week. "Su Anying smiled and explained to her sister in a low voice.
During eating, Su Anying could tell that the youngest son was a little unruly recently, and he was too shy.
She was still thinking about finding an opportunity to tap, but the kid came to the door automatically.
The ready-made opportunity is in front of you, can Su Anying let it go? Then you have to make use of the problem, clean up your little son.
When Su Anfen heard this, she felt relieved, the co-authoring of the couple was intentional.
Yes, then leave it alone, the couple will teach the children a lesson, and they should keep out of it.
While speaking, he just returned to Zhencaotang.
It was past nine o'clock at this time, the storefront was closed, and the front door was locked.
Everyone entered the backyard through the side door, went back to the living room and sat down for a rest. Sure enough, Xu Haiyuan called Qin Shaoping.
As soon as Qin Shaoping heard that Xu Haiyuan had come to Yangcheng with his father, he immediately expressed that he would invite Xu Shiyan's family to dinner if he had a chance.
Xu Haiyuan had to say a few polite words to his uncle, and asked his uncle when he was free, and they went to visit.
Qin Shaoping is the vice president of Yangcheng University of Medical Sciences. He is busy every day. It is not easy to take a vacation. He has to check the schedule to decide the day.
"Uncle, I have something to trouble you." Xu Haiyuan held the phone and cleared his throat.
"My parents are busy and don't have time to take us to play.
I was thinking about asking my uncle, does the travel agency here in Yangcheng accept small group tours?
I want to sign up for a tour group, take my younger siblings to play around Yangcheng for a few days, and let my parents take care of their affairs. "
"Why do you sign up for a tour group? It's a waste of money." Qin Shaoping laughed when he heard it.
"Well, tomorrow I will ask your brothers and the others to see who is free and take you to play for a few days."
Qin Shaoping is also taking graduate students, and it happens that Chinese New Year is coming soon, so let the students take a few days off to rest and take the children there.
"Oh, that's a good thing, thank you uncle."
Xu Haiyuan heard that, it’s fine, as long as someone who is familiar with the local area can lead them to play.
"Well, it won't delay my brother's studies, right?"
"It's okay, it's okay, Chinese New Year is coming soon, so give them a vacation and go out for a few days to change their minds.
Rest is for better study. "Qin Shaoping said nonchalantly.
Those who study or not, isn't that what he decides?
It’s only a few days, nothing to do, the most important thing is to let those **** meet their junior.
Everyone in the province feels that they are the pride of heaven, how outstanding they are.
This time, find someone to beat them and see what a genius is.
Xu Haiyuan naturally didn't know that the uncle on the other end of the phone was trying to create hatred for him.
So thanked Qin Shaoping politely, chatted with Qin Shaoping for a while, and then hung up the phone.
"Dad, Uncle Qin said, there is no need to find a travel agency, he arranged for the senior to accompany us to play.
Then you can go to the factory with my mother, I will take my younger brothers and sisters to play, don’t worry. "
Actually, it doesn’t matter if there are any locals, as long as you give him a map, he can still take his younger siblings out to play.
Looking for someone to accompany is just to reassure parents.
"Oh, that's fine, I'll leave some money for you tomorrow morning, don't let senior brother spend money when you go out to play.
Then look at the younger brothers and sisters, and don't allow them to cause trouble. "
Xu Shiyan nodded, his eldest son is absolutely trustworthy.
Qin Shaoping will not arrange too outrageous students to come, so there should be no big problem.
"It's not early, so you all go to rest, don't get up too late tomorrow morning."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, signaling the children to wash up and rest.
"Dad, I promise to help my mother clear the meridians.
My mother must be too tired recently, and her complexion is not very good, it is best to adjust it. "
Xu Haiyuan still remembers the agreement he made with his mother, why would he go to rest like this?
"Well, I don't need you, I'll do it."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, and his son is going to do it. It's not like he can't be a father.
Xu Haiyuan curled his lips, arguing with his father without hesitation, "That's fine, don't forget."
After speaking, I took my younger siblings upstairs to wash and rest.
Ji Tongzhong also lived here at night, so Ji Hongliang shared a room with Brother Xu Haiyuan.
Thanks to the big bed in that room, the three children can live in it.
However, there is one thing that is not good in the south, that is, there is no heating in the house.
Unlike the Northeast, sleeping on the kang at night, the bedding is covered in advance, and it is very warm when you take off your clothes and get under the quilt.
Fortunately, Su Anying had calculated this problem and bought a few electric mattresses in advance.
This thing is currently a rarity, and it's quite expensive, but no matter what happens, it can be much warmer under the bed.
The only disadvantage is that sleeping on the electric mattress is easy to get angry, and the throat is dry when you wake up in the morning.
So Su Anying asked the children to drink some warm water first thing in the morning.
The electric mattress was plugged in in advance and it was warmed up, and it felt okay in the bed.
The children quickly took off their coats, got into the bed in their shirts and shorts, and lay down in the bed obediently.
No one dared to slap the quilt indiscriminately, for fear that the heat would run away.
After taking the plane for a long time, and then spending half a day outside in the afternoon, I fell asleep after lying down for a while.
In the other room, Xu Shiyan and his wife haven't seen each other for a long time, so they have to do some exercise and chat with each other at night.
Anyway, the next morning, the couple didn't get up.
It was Su Anfen and his wife who got up early to cook porridge, and went out to buy a lot of breakfast, which woke everyone up for dinner.
After breakfast, the people arranged by Qin Shaoping came, two handsome, neat young men.
You can tell at a glance that this is still in the stage of theoretical study, and has not yet gone to the hospital for clinical study.
Both young men were very polite, and they greeted Xu Shiyan in a regular manner.
Xu Shiyan chatted with them for a while, and learned that the two young men are both locals and can drive.
"It's good to know how to drive, so I will leave the van outside for you to use.
Just trouble you two and take them around.
You are all locals, you know where the fun is, don't care about the money, as long as you have fun. "
Xu Shiyan took out a wad of money and handed it to the other party, so that they don't have to save, and they can spend as much as they like, as long as the children have fun.
Just like that, the two young men drove away happily with their five children.
Xu Shiyan drove Su Anying's car, together with Ji Tongzhong and Li Zongliang, back to the health care product factory.
As soon as Xu Shiyan arrived at the health care product factory, he first got off the workshop and walked around.
Pay special attention to every link, and if there is something unreasonable, it will be pointed out unceremoniously.
Dai Lijun and others all knew Xu Shiyan, and when they heard that Xu Shiyan was coming, they rushed over to talk to Xu Shiyan.
The other section leaders, team leaders, etc. were a little confused, not knowing what the newcomer was doing.
The general manager and the deputy factory manager accompanied him, and the factory manager also greeted him with a smile. This style is enough.
"Hey, do you know who that person was just now? I looked at that man with a lot of style, is he a major customer of our factory?"
When Xu Shiyan and his party left the workshop here, the workers murmured softly.
"I don't know, it doesn't look like a customer, but a leader.
Cough, let’s take care of that, as long as we understand the work at hand, it doesn’t matter if it’s the client or the leader, it’s out of our control anyway. "
Some people don't care, just stare at the machine in front of them, work with peace of mind, and avoid mistakes.
Xu Shiyan walked around all the workshops, and then went to the quality inspection department to check, and he was sure that there was nothing wrong with the operating procedures, so he was relieved.
"Well, I'm here for a few days, so I won't interfere with other things.
I will help you manage the quality inspection and shipment, and you are responsible for other things. "
Quality is the key to the survival of an enterprise. No matter how loud the advertisement is, the quality of the product is not good, and sooner or later it will be rejected by consumers and eliminated by the market.
Therefore, keeping the quality control is the most important thing.
There will be another chapter in a while.

chapters.title: Chapter 765: Demon King
chapters.content:
Chapter 765 Confused Demon King
Xu Shiyan stayed in the factory to be in charge of quality inspection and shipment. Su Anying immediately asked the workshop director, section chief, and team leader to come over for a meeting.
Then, the whole workshop knew about it. It turned out that the big boss came to guide the work in person.
All departments of the factory cheered up and worked hard, and no one dared to fool around.
With the help of Xu Shiyan, Su Anying can relax a lot.
The last batch of orders before the year was urgent and the quantity was huge. The whole factory was very busy.
Fortunately, the treatment in the factory is good, the wages are quite high, and the overtime pay is double.
So the factory is so busy, and no one complains. For ordinary people, it doesn’t matter to work overtime, as long as they can earn more money.
Xu Shiyan and his wife are busy with the factory, while Xu Haiyuan leads his younger brothers and sisters to play everywhere.
Baiyun Mountain, Pearl River, Yuexiu Mountain, Huanghuagang, Chen Clan Ancestral Hall, Botanical Garden, Lianhua Mountain, Huangpu Military Academy, Shamian, Xiguan, etc.
Anyway, there are cars and money, as long as it is a place that the locals think is good, these children will go around.
As long as the restaurants recommended by the locals, these children also ran to taste them.
For Xu Haiqing, the attractiveness of all the scenic spots is average, and what makes him most happy is that he can eat all kinds of food.
Especially all kinds of fresh seafood that can’t be eaten in the Northeast, this time you can eat whatever you want, it’s really not too happy.
Su Anying knocked in advance, coupled with the strict supervision of Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, and the temptation of various delicacies.
Xu Haiqing didn't do anything wrong, and happily followed everyone to play and eat every day.
Xu Haiyuan took the camera at home and never forgot to take pictures of his younger brothers and sisters wherever he went. The film alone took a lot of time.
Seven or eight days passed in a blink of an eye, and the children's playfulness was greatly reduced, and they no longer had the initial enthusiasm.
Xu Haiyuan saw this, and finally took his younger brothers and sisters to Sun Yat-sen University for a tour, and then went to the medical school to meet Qin Shaoping.
Brought a lot of things to Uncle Qin and his senior brothers, it was considered as a little sympathy.
When Qin Shaoping met Xu Haiyuan, he naturally liked it in various ways, so he insisted on keeping Xu Haiyuan and the others for a meal.
Xu Haiyuan did not refuse, and stayed with his younger brothers and sisters, and had a meal with Uncle Qin and several senior brothers.
After getting along these days, those two students of Qin Shaoping dare not underestimate the Xu family's children.
Especially Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, brother and sister, are simply amazing.
One has amazing talent and knowledge in medicine, those of them who have studied in medical school for five or six years may not be able to catch up with others.
The other one is about astronomy, geography, and folk customs, and he just opened his mouth.
No matter which scenic spot you go to, the little girl can speak clearly and clearly, knowing more than the locals like them.
This means that the adults are not worried about the children going out to play by themselves, and besides, the children are young and no one can drive.
But if Xu Haiyuan is older and can take the driver's license test, he probably doesn't need to find a tour guide driver at all. This matter will not trouble the brother and sister at all.
To be honest, the two boys have been hit hard these days.
These people have good grades in the college entrance examination, and they can barely be regarded as high school students, but in front of others, they can't show it at all.
We only played for seven or eight days thanks to the loss. If we get along for a few more days, they will all doubt themselves.
How did you get into college? In the past few years in medical school, what have you learned?
Brother and sister Xu Haiyuan had a meal with Qin Shaoping and others, and then returned to Zhencaotang.
"Okay, let's stop for a few days and take a good rest.
Waiting for our parents to be free, let them take us to Shenzhen City to play, or to Hong Kong City. "
After arriving home, the children slumped on the sofa. Xu Haiyuan immediately said that the tour around Yangcheng had come to an end.
"Oh, got it."
Xu Haiqing no longer had the energy to jump up and down before, and just lay on the sofa and replied lazily.
Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui also agreed feebly, and then no one spoke, and they all slumped on the sofa and didn't want to move.
But at this moment, the phone on the table rang.
"Hello? Dad." Xu Haiyuan stretched out his arms and grabbed the phone.
You don’t even need to guess, there are only a few people who can call the backyard of Zhencaotang.
"We just came back, and we are all lying on the sofa to rest. What's the matter? Is there something to order?"
With his parents not in front of him, Xu Haiyuan was so tired that he couldn't care about his image anymore. He leaned on the sofa with the phone in his hand, and chatted with Xu Shiyan hummingly.
"Son, your sister-in-law and uncle came from Guangshui, and they should arrive in Yangcheng tomorrow.
Your uncle's job has been transferred to Yangcheng. He must have been very busy when he first arrived here. Your sister-in-law still has to clean up the house and take care of the factory. Both of them can't take care of the children.
So tomorrow, let’s clean up the house, and then the cousins ​​will live with you first and help take care of them for a few days. "
Xu Shiyan explained the matter on the other end of the phone.
Han Liwei has been in Guangshui for three and a half years. He has made many meritorious deeds and led his soldiers to complete the tasks assigned by his superiors several times.
So this time, in the promotion of cadres, Han Liwei was promoted to another level, and was transferred to Yangcheng.
When Han Liwei first arrived in Yangcheng, he must have been very busy with the handover of work.
There is a new home here, the house has to be tidied up, and things for daily life have to be bought. Xu Shiqin must be very busy.
That's why Xu Shiyan said, send the two young ones from the Han family over first, and ask Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping to help them look after them for a few days.
"Oh, I see. Don't worry, Dad, we will take good care of our cousins."
Xu Haiyuan heard his father say that, what else could they do?
Xu Haiyuan chatted with his father for a few more words before hanging up the phone.
As soon as he looked up, he saw his younger brothers and sisters looking at him curiously.
"What are you looking at me for? My sister-in-law and uncle are going to bring Zhenlin and Xiao Yuer over here.
Our dad said, sister-in-law and uncle are busy, let us help coax the children for a few days. "Xu Haiyuan stated calmly with no expression on his face.
"Huh? Zhenlin and Xiao Yuer are coming over? We want to coax the children? Isn't it."
Xu Haiqing wailed immediately when he heard it.
"Xiao Yu'er is okay, Zhenlin that skinny monkey, he's here, is there still time for this family to calm down?"
Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin had only one pair of twins, Han Zhenlin and Han Yu.
The two children may be because they grew up in the compound, they are very skinny, and they are all kinds of tricks.
They came back last Chinese New Year, good guy, they tossed a few old dogs at home.
Thanks to Pi Gui's cleverness, every year during Chinese New Year when there are many people in the family, Pi Gui will hide out, at least he has not been murdered by Han Zhenlin.
However, although the rascal escaped, none of the toys at home could escape.
Xu Haiyuan thought about it many times, but he didn't dare to dismantle the tin frog. In the end, Han Zhenlin broke it and couldn't move it anymore.
Xu Jinping's favorite doll when she was a child, and the one Xu Jinhui has always cherished since she was a child, was stunned by Han Zhenlin who turned her head off.
There are also some things of Xu Haiqing, which were also brutally murdered, and did not end well.
The key point is that Han Zhenlin is still young and not sensible at all.
Hitting him is not worth it. If I don’t hit him, I feel really suffocated and uncomfortable.
So, when Xu Haiqing heard that Han Zhenlin brothers and sisters were coming here, he immediately shouted.
"Otherwise, I'll give you a call, and you go tell our dad and my sister-in-law not to send the child here?"
Xu Haiyuan glanced at his younger brother, sent the phone to his younger brother, and asked lightly.
"No, no, I don't dare." Xu Haiqing waved his hands with a sullen face.
Are you kidding? He really thinks he is so courageous that he still dares to question his father's decision?
If he dares to say it, he doesn't have to wait until the next year to return to the Northeast, his dad can come back now and break his dog legs.
"Then what are you talking about?
My sister-in-law and my uncle are here, this year our family can get together to celebrate the New Year, how nice?
Isn’t it Zhenlin and Xiao Yuer? There are five of us, but we still can't coax two babies?
With you here, Zhenlin likes you, what are you afraid of? "
Xu Haiyuan looked at his younger brother, twitched the corners of his mouth, and smiled lightly.
Strange to say, Han Zhenlin's favorite is Xu Haiqing.
When he returned to Northeast China last year, Han Zhenlin followed Xu Haiqing all day long.
Let Xu Haiqing feed you when you are hungry, ask Xu Haiqing to pour water when you are thirsty, and let Xu Haiqing hug you when you are tired.
No one knew what was going on, anyway, he was most proud of Xu Haiqing, and rarely looked for Xu Haiyuan.
"Don't, he can't pester me all day, let me tell him stories."
Xu Haiqing wailed, with a look of lovelessness on his face.
I regretted it to death. He shouldn't have gone crazy for a while, and had to show his little cousin a grandson monkey playing a golden cudgel to make trouble in heaven.
As a result, the little cousin fell in love with him, and followed him all day long, calling brother monkey.
"I hope this fart kid will forget about me a long time ago when he goes back for a year. What are you talking about this time, I won't play a monkey for him anymore."
Xu Haiqing lay paralyzed on the sofa, clasped his hands together, and made a wish.
When the other people saw Xu Haiqing's appearance, they couldn't help laughing.
Seriously, who told him to jump up and down like a monkey all day? Is it still necessary to act? Just like that.
