The next morning, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin brought their children to Yangcheng.
Han Liwei went directly to the station, Xu Shiqin brought the two children to Zhencaotang, handed the two children to Xu Haiyuan and the others, and then hurried to work.
No way, just arrived here, there must be a place to live, right?
The house is allocated by the organization, but there is nothing in it, so you can't buy it? Shouldn't it be arranged properly?
They just came here, and they haven't found a nanny yet, so they have to do it all by themselves. How can they work with the two children?
I can only trouble my nephews and nieces to help watch.
Fortunately, the children Han Zhenlin and Han Yu have long been used to their parents not being around often. Seeing Xu Shiqin leave, the two children did not cry or make trouble, and obediently followed their cousin.
Originally thought that Han Zhenlin and Han Yu would not know their siblings after a year of absence.
Unexpectedly, as soon as Han Zhenlin saw Xu Haiqing, he immediately climbed onto his lap and put his arms around Xu Haiqing's neck.
"Brother, Sun Monkey."
Okay, this kid has a pretty good memory. I haven't seen him for a year, and I haven't forgotten his brother's grandson Monkey.
Xu Haiyuan and the others laughed when they heard this, "It's over, in Zhenlin's eyes, you are Sun Monkey."
Xu Haiqing didn't know whether to laugh or cry, "Zhenlin, I'm your brother, not Sun Houzi.
Your brother is so tired now that he can't jump up and down, so let's forget about Sun Houzi. "
I only hate that I was young at the time, I was too unsteady, why did I pretend to be a monkey grandson?
It’s been a year now, my little cousin still remembers it.
"No, no, just Sun Monkey, Sun Monkey."
Han Zhenlin made a mistake, no matter what Xu Haiqing said, he was thinking about Sun Houzi.
"Come on, be obedient, brother will tell you a story, today brother will tell you a piece of Yue Fei's biography, okay?
Which passage are you talking about? Let’s talk about the eight big hammers gathering at Niutoushan, and the young general Yue Yun’s hammer shook the golden cicadas, how about it? "
The children have been playing like crazy for the past few days. After taking a break last night, they felt that they were too lazy to panic.
Still acting as a monkey? He wants to play the wood most now, and it would be better to just lie there and not move.
But the little cousin asked him to coax him. If he didn't coax him well, the devil in the world would cry after a while, which would be even more troublesome.
So Xu Haiqing had no choice but to take another approach, which was to tell stories to his little cousin.
He dared not tell about Journey to the West, for fear that his little cousin would be happy to hear it and let him play the monkey again. It would be safer to change the story.
Han Zhenlin was very face-saving, and nodded when he heard about the story. "Well, listen to the story."
There are no monkeys, so listening to stories is fine, anyway, my cousin can tell a lot of stories.
Just like that, Xu Haiqing used his housekeeping skills to give everyone a biography of Yue Fei.
Not to mention, this kid speaks really well, and his vivid voice is particularly vivid.
Even Han Zhenlin, a four-year-old boy, was attracted, nestled in his brother's arms, and slapped his hands happily.
People say that naughty children don't like to cry, this is true, just cause trouble, how can there be time to cry?
Han Zhenlin and Han Yu are just like this, although they are small, naughty is not small.
Following the brothers and sisters, either teasing the dog or catching the cat, or running to the fish in the big tank in the yard.
Anyway, these little things in the small courtyard have suffered disasters, and the children have suffered a lot.
The two babies follow their brothers and sisters to play around all day long. They are active and hungry quickly, so their appetite is naturally large.
Xu Jinping was very patient and cooked food for them alone.
The two babies are not picky eaters at all, and the food is delicious.
At night, Han Yu slept with Xu Jinping and her sisters, and Han Zhenlin slept with Xu Haiqing. He was tired from playing during the day and slept soundly at night.
Three days later, Xu Shiqin and his wife came to pick up the child.
As a result, the two children refused to leave. They wanted to be with their elder brothers and sisters. It was fun here.
"Sister-in-law, or let Zhenlin and Xiao Yuer live here.
Today’s new year, my parents probably should be back, just now Pingping went to buy meat and vegetables, let’s make dumplings later. "
Xu Haiyuan saw that his cousin was hiding behind Xu Haiqing, so he refused to leave, so he had to help him talk.
In many places in the south, it is the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth lunar month.
Xu Haiyuan and the others don’t know, they still follow the customs of the Northeast.
So I went to buy meat and vegetables in the morning, and I was going to wait for my parents to come back and celebrate the new year together.
It happened that Xu Shiqin and his wife came over, so why can't they be allowed to leave, so they stayed together to have fun.
The child refused to leave, and so did Xu Shiqin.
"Is there something going on at your unit? Otherwise, shall we stay here with the children today?"
Xu Shiqin turned to ask Han Liwei for his opinion.
"There is nothing wrong with the unit, everything that needs to be arranged has been arranged." Han Liwei shook his head.
He just arrived here, the leader specially granted him a vacation and asked him to settle down first.
Just like that, Xu Shiqin and his wife also stayed here. Everyone worked together, cooked several dishes, and made a lot of dumplings.
In addition to dumplings with cabbage and pork, there are also dumplings with mushrooms, beef, leeks, eggs and shrimps.
Actually, in Yangcheng, dumplings are served as snacks, not as a staple food, and people don’t eat dumplings during the New Year’s Eve.
But Xu Jinping and the others don't care about these things. Wherever they go, the Northeast people's habit of eating dumplings can't be lost.
For the new year, it must be dumplings.
Well, this is not called Jiageng, it’s just that I wrote a little more with great difficulty, so I can post it directly. I don't cough now, but I have no energy or energy. I feel like my brain is not working all day long, and I am confused.
By the way, let’s recommend a book, Seedlings, which is also the content of this mountain run.

chapters.title: Chapter 766: Chinese New Year in a foreign land
chapters.content:
Chapter 766 New Year in a foreign land
In the evening, Xu Shiyan, his wife and Ji Tongzhong drove back, and the family set off firecrackers and ate dumplings lively, celebrating the new year together.
In the south, most people celebrate the New Year on the 24th of the twelfth lunar month, so Su Anying directly gave the workers a day off.
From the 25th day of the twelfth lunar month, the factory no longer needs to work overtime.
Workers can rest in shifts, and the factory only needs to keep running.
On the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month, the factory takes inventory and settles accounts,
This year's total sales reached 70 million yuan. During the period of the previous year alone, the factory shipped tens of millions of goods.
There is a long queue of transportation vehicles at the gate of the factory, and the queue can go as far as possible.
Health care products have high profits, with sales of more than 70 million yuan, which is a lot of money.
And the most powerful thing is that the payment for the goods has not been pressed for a penny, and it has been settled.
This is also normal. Now Jishengyuan's products are selling very well in the market, and consumers are queuing up to buy them.
Dealers are eager to order with cash, for fear that if they bring less money, they will not be able to get too many goods, and they will not be able to sell enough when they go back.
What is the payment for the goods, and the first settlement after the sale? That doesn't exist at all.
All the pre-payments are paid in advance, and the final payment will be settled immediately as soon as the goods are shipped.
In the first year of the new factory, various investments were also huge.
So don't look at the high sales and huge profits, but there are many places to spend money everywhere.
So most of the funds were kept on the books and reserved for next year's development. The two companies each shared 3 million.
After the inventory was finished and the accounts were settled, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying returned to Yangcheng to spend the New Year with their children.
On the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth lunar month, the factory is on holiday. Except for the guards and fire departments who are on duty, the rest of the workers go home to celebrate the new year.
The holiday is from the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth lunar month to the fifth day of the first lunar month, and the production officially starts on the sixth day.
Zhencaotang is only closed in the afternoon of New Year’s Eve during the Spring Festival, and it opens at 10 am from the first day to the sixth day of the new year.
During the Chinese New Year, visiting relatives and friends, who visits the house without bringing some gifts.
What is the best thing to bring now? That is naturally Jishengyuan's health care products.
The purpose of opening a shop is to make money, Su Anfen is not a fool, it is impossible to miss such a good opportunity.
Of course, you can’t let all the shop assistants come for the New Year’s Eve.
So from the first day to the sixth day of junior high school, the clerks work one day and take two days off, and all come back to work from the seventh day of junior high school.
Everyone else can have a holiday, but Su Anfen definitely doesn't.
Fortunately, Ji Tongzhong is fine if he doesn’t go to work, and Ji Hongliang is also here. The whole family lives in the backyard of Zhencaotang, so that’s all.
Xu Shiqin's garment factory is on holiday right after the Spring Festival.
Han Liwei's work unit is not particularly busy for the New Year. Everyone has made an appointment to come to Zhencaotang on New Year's Eve and spend it together.
So on the 30th day, Zhencaotang is very lively.
The man led the boys, and decorated a lot of string lights of various shapes and colors on the windows of the shop, on the door, and on the shelves in the backyard.
Even the two trees in the yard were wrapped with colorful string lights, and hung with small lanterns made of colored ribbons and colored paper.
There are couplets and door gods pasted on the gate, couplets and blessings on the door of the house, and window grilles on all the windows.
The entire yard is decorated with festive lights and festive atmosphere.
Women are doing all kinds of work in the kitchen, frying and frying to make delicious food.
Compared with the Northeast, the supplies here are obviously more abundant.
There are all kinds of fresh vegetables, as well as various live fish, live shrimp, crabs, etc., which were unimaginable in the Northeast before.
It’s rare for everyone to celebrate the New Year here, so you must prepare more generously, and prepare everything that you can’t eat normally this time.
Don’t care if the method is authentic or not, as long as you like it.
Everyone was busy until three o'clock in the afternoon, and a sumptuous reunion dinner was served on the table, and everyone sat down.
"Wait a minute, wait a minute, I have to take a picture, and I will show my grandpa and grandma when I get back."
Xu Haiyuan set up the camera, let everyone sit down, then set up time-lapse shooting, and took a picture with everyone.
Then, I took another photo of the food on the table.
"I figured it out. You didn't learn anything else. Your dad loves to play with cameras. You learned it very quickly."
Su Anying looked at her son playing with the camera, couldn't help but shook her head with a smile.
"Okay, sit down and eat quickly, I've been busy for a long time, and I'm hungry."
Seeing that her son hadn't sat down yet, Su Anying hurriedly greeted him.
"Wait a minute, I'll call my grandfather."
Xu Haiyuan didn't sit down to eat in a hurry, but picked up the phone.
"Grandpa, it's me, Yuanyuan, have you eaten? What did you eat today?"
After a while, the phone was connected. When Xu Haiyuan heard Xu Chenghou's voice over there, he chatted with Xu Chenghou.
"Yo, it's my eldest grandson.
The meal is ready, I haven’t eaten yet, your grandma and your aunts and aunts have cooked a lot of food.
There are chicken, duck, fish and everything, and there is a big table full. Grandson, have you eaten yet? "
Xu Chenghou was very happy when he heard about his grandson.
"No, the dishes are all on the table, let's eat right away.
I miss grandpa, so I will call him. "
At this time, Xu Jinping, Xu Jinhui, and Xu Haiqing all came together, shouting grandpa.
On the other end of the phone, when Zhou Guilan heard that the grandchildren were calling, she quickly grabbed the phone and chatted with the grandchildren.
"You guys have fun over there, don't worry about home.
Your uncle, second uncle, fourth uncle, and fifth uncle are all back to celebrate the New Year. As for the whole family, don’t worry about me and your grandfather.
Well, today is the Chinese New Year, you should eat more for the reunion dinner, and eat well.
Do you want to make dumplings at night? Tell your mother, you must remember to put money in the dumplings. Let's see who eats more money. "
The children have never left their grandparents since they were young, and they call back every night after they come here.
The three old people in the family are also thinking about it all day long, talking about it all the time, and looking forward to their grandchildren calling back every day.
The two ends of the phone are connected to a family of young and old. It is so far apart that we cannot see each other, so it is good to be able to hear the movement.
"Grandpa, grandma, master, the food is ready, let's eat first, or it will all be cold.
In the evening, I will call you again to say New Year greetings. "
The children chatted with their grandparents and saw that the dishes on the table were getting cold, so they hung up the phone and sat down to eat.
Xu Shiyan and the others didn't move their chopsticks until the children sat down, and then greeted the children to eat.
It’s New Year’s Eve. Even though I didn’t celebrate the New Year in my hometown this year, but traveled thousands of miles away, it must be a lively one.
Men drink, women and children drink.
Everyone filled their cups, toasted and clinked together to celebrate the New Year together.
Even the two little guys, Han Zhenlin and Han Yu, clumsily held the cups and bumped them with everyone.
Fortunately, they poured less drink into their cups, so they didn't spill it.
The two babies were so happy that they couldn't close their mouths, "Happy New Year, cheers."
Han Yu didn't know who he learned from, so while clinking glasses, he said this.
"Yes, Happy New Year, cheers." Everyone laughed.
Xu Shiyan deliberately bumped into Han Yu again before taking a sip of his wine.
Han Yu looked at it, brought the cup to his mouth, and took a big gulp.
A group of Northeast people celebrate the New Year in the south. It is impossible for them to go to the countryside to do as the Romans do. It is still how to celebrate the New Year at home, and it is the same here.
Among other things, the dumplings must be made.
So after the reunion dinner, the women started chopping meat, vegetables, and kneading noodles.
At six o'clock, all the string lights inside and outside the courtyard were plugged in, and the colorful lights made the small courtyard dreamlike and beautiful.
The cartoons are over, the party has not started yet, and there are no interesting programs.
The children don't have many friends here, unlike in their hometown, they all ran out in groups at this time.
Staying bored in the house, the children simply took firecrackers to the yard and lit them. The jingling firecrackers conveyed the joy and blessings of the New Year.
The small courtyard originally raised two dogs and several cats.
These days, especially after Han Zhenlin and Han Yu came, the dog and the cat were suffering.
Nowadays, as long as the children are playing in the yard, the dog will just shrink into the den and never come out.
The same goes for the cats, who have been hiding for a long time, never giving the children a chance to see them.
The two dogs were puppies back then, and they had little knowledge. When the firecrackers rang out, the dogs were so frightened that they hid in the den and couldn't come out.
This movement is too scary, I dare not go out.
At eight o'clock, the party started on time, and the children who were screaming outside all went back to the house and sat down to watch TV obediently.
As for Xu Shiqin, Su Anying and the others, they had already moved the table and panels to the living room, and stood by the table rolling out skins to make dumplings.
While bagging, Su Anying was still muttering.
"Let me just say, it's inconvenient in the south, not even a kang.
If it was at our house, sitting on the hot kang, making dumplings and watching TV at the same time, how exciting would it be? "
Northeast people are used to working on the kang, and they find it inconvenient when they come out.
"Well, what's the matter? Anyway, I've been here for so long, and I'm not used to it.
There is a kang in the northeast of our country, which is really comfortable. When Su Anfen heard this, she nodded quickly.
No way, as a Northeast person, those customs are engraved in the bones, and it is really inconvenient to come out.
The living habits of the north and the south are different, and the food culture is very different. This cannot be changed in a short time.
Northern people are not used to coming to the south, and southerners are also not used to going to the north.
People, it’s not for the sake of making a living, who wants to leave their hometown and go all the way?
However, with the development and changes of the times, the north also began to live in buildings, and the kang gradually became the warmth in people's memory.
Su Anying and the others chatted while making dumplings.
These people have different identities now, they are no longer the housewives they used to be.
The topic of discussion has also changed from family short stories to business matters.
Xu Shiqin's clothing factory here is doing well, and the accounts have just been settled a few days ago.
When the clothing factory was first built, Xu Shiyan and his wife invested part of the money, accounting for 30% of the shares. This time, the dividends were about 500,000.
In the past few months since the opening of Yangcheng Zhencaotang, the turnover of the store has been very good, including wholesale and retail, with a turnover of tens of thousands a day.
Since acting as an agent of Jishengyuan's health products, the income has doubled.
As the store manager, Su Anfen has 10% of the dry stock, so this year's harvest is also great.
Of course, Su Anying made the most money.
The profits of various factories, stores, and companies are added together, and Su Anying will be several million this year.
This is still the start-up stage of the health care product factory and Zhencaotang, and the investment is relatively large. They are waiting for the stable development next year and more profits.
"Thinking about the past, Xiaoji and I were busy working in the fields all year round, that is to say, eating and using for the whole year.
Who would have thought that there would still be a time to earn so much money?
Second sister, thanks to the help of you and second brother-in-law, otherwise, even if we work hard all our lives, we still wouldn’t be able to earn this year’s money. "
Su Anfen sighed while working.
"Cough, what are you talking about?
We are sisters, so my stall is too big and there is no one to help me, how can I find outsiders? I can't trust outsiders either.
My family doesn’t need to talk about this, as long as you two work hard, the days of earning money are still to come.
You save some money and train Liangliang well.
In the future, if he gets into a good university, finds a good job, and marries a wife, won’t his mission in this life be completed? "
Su Anying kept making dumplings, but just smiled.
Which family has a good life without bringing along brothers and sisters?
Besides, this is not free money. No matter Ji Tongzhong or Nan Zhendong, they have made great efforts and helped a lot, and it is only natural to give corresponding rewards.
What? Can you still give money to outsiders? Probably need to give more.
No matter how much you give, it can't match the kindness of your own family.
"No matter what you say, we all followed the second sister and the second brother-in-law."
Su Anfen has long understood that the sisters, even the Su family, are all following the second sister and second brother-in-law.
The third sister and her family, if not for the help of the second brother-in-law, could they come out of the countryside, and now one is in Yangcheng and the other is in the capital? Dreaming.
Without the help of the second brother-in-law, would her father be able to find a job at such an old age?
Look at the front door, the wind and rain are not wrong, and you can still be free, and you get a lot of salary every month. When you don’t want to work, you can retire and get a pension. How good?
There are also the fifth and the sixth. Both of them are section chiefs now, and their wages are not low.
The fifth brother-in-law is the deputy director of the health care product factory, and the sixth brother-in-law is the manager of the sales department of the ginseng company, with a bright future.
If it weren't for the help of the second sister and the second brother-in-law, it is estimated that the fifth and sixth children would just find someone to marry randomly, and they would never be where they are today.
"Sigh, it's a trivial matter whether you get rich or not.
I was thinking, you are in Yangcheng, the third child is in the capital, and the fifth child will come with his fifth brother-in-law after the next year.
We sisters, now there are everywhere in the world.
At the beginning, I thought about getting you all to Donggang. Our sisters are all by our parents, so we can take good care of them.
It's a good thing now, our parents stayed in Donggang and we all came out. What will happen to the old couple in the future? "
As Su Anying was talking, she felt uncomfortable, so she stopped making dumplings.
"Oh, yes, my parents are getting older, and there is no one to take care of them, so I don't feel at ease after all."
Su Anfen was also taken aback when she heard the words, and sighed.
Maybe this is the benefit of raising a son. The elderly must be with their children and grandchildren when they are old.
Don't care about the good or bad life, there are always people around to take care of you.
"Otherwise, when you have a chance in the future, discuss with your parents and take them over?"
Su Anfen thought about it, and it seems that this method is okay.
"I'm here, and the fifth child will come over next year, and the second sister will probably have to come over for a few months a year.
If Mom and Dad are willing, I live here close to Lao Wu, so I can take care of him a bit. "
Su Anying raised her head and looked out the window, "Wait until you go back, and ask your parents what they mean."
When Sister Su Anying was talking about her parents, thousands of miles away in the northeast, Su Weizhong and his wife were sitting on the kang, making dumplings and talking about it.
"In normal years, Yuanyuan and the others would come over a few times on the 30th night, it's quite interesting to make noise.
This year, the children are all going to the south for the New Year, why do they feel so deserted? "
Han Caie muttered while kneading the dough.
"Yeah, there is no movement of a child in this house, just the two of us, why don't we panic?"
Su Weizhong stopped rolling the skin and sighed.
"Look at the in-laws. They have many sons. Shi Yan's family has gone to the south, and there are four other sons.
It’s good for us, six daughters, which of the six girls should not spend the New Year at her in-law’s house?
Why don't we just look at me and I look at you? "
What Su Weizhong looks forward to most in his life is to have a son, but unfortunately, he just doesn't have this life.
It’s fine in normal times, but every year and festivals here, it’s really deserted.
"Come on, don't talk about those useless things, who told us that we don't have that life.
Let’s work, make dumplings quickly, distribute papers early, and go to bed early if there is nothing else to do. "
Compared to the deserted Su family with only an old couple, the Xu family is bustling.
The four brothers of the Xu family all came back with their wives and children for the New Year. The people in this room were full of laughter and laughter.
However, Xu Chenghou is still not used to it.
I always feel that the children of the third family are missing, especially Xu Haiqing, a treasure. Without him in front of Baba, I feel like something is missing.
"I don't know, what happened to the third child's family in Yangcheng.
At this time, do you also make dumplings? "
Xu Chenghou sat on the kang, watched the TV, couldn't help but put a bag of cigarettes in his hand, and started smoking.
"It must be making dumplings, we Northeast people, we can't forget dumplings wherever we go.
A few skinny children, don't know if they can adapt there. "
Chu Xuanhuai, who was sitting opposite Xu Chenghou, couldn't help but sigh.
Compared to Xu Chenghou, Chu Xuanhuai misses Xu Haiyuan and the others more.
Chu Xuanhuai loves Xu Haiyuan and the others as if they were his own grandchildren. The children of the Xu family are also very good, but they don't have much affection after all.
When the family is reunited, without the children in sight, I feel empty in my heart.
The two old men looked at each other, shook their heads and smiled wryly.
When Xu Shiyan discussed with them, they were too troublesome and refused to follow them to the south.
At this moment, to be honest, the two old men felt a little regretful.
"They can't stay in the south for a few days, and they have to go back on the seventh day of the new year at most.
The children have to go back to school, and the third child has to go back to work. "
Xu Chenghou finished smoking a bag of cigarettes, knocked on the pot of the cigarette bag, and came back to say this.
I don't know whether to comfort Chu Xuanhuai or to comfort myself.
On New Year’s Eve, thousands of houses are lit up, whether in the south or the north, every household celebrates the New Year with laughter and laughter.
At nine o'clock, Su Anying and the others finished making the dumplings.
This is not in the Northeast. You can't take the dumplings outside to freeze, so you can only send them to the kitchen for storage.
Let’s discuss it, it’s better to boil the water and prepare the dumplings quickly, and don’t wait until eleven o’clock.
When you are in a foreign land, you can’t be as particular about it as when you were at home.
Especially when the three families get together to celebrate the New Year, the procedures of distributing papers and worshiping ancestors are also saved.
It’s better to cook the dumplings earlier and eat them. If the children are willing to play, they can play for a while, and if they are sleepy, they can go to bed earlier.
Besides, Han Liwei still has something to do tonight, he has to go down to the company to condolence to the soldiers.
At around 9:40, the kitchen started cooking dumplings, and Xu Shiyan and the others led the children out to set off firecrackers.
Three years ago, the three families all bought fireworks and firecrackers. I was afraid that the children would not have enough things to play with, so I took them all out to have a look. Good guy, there are a lot of them on the ground.
I bought everything, so let’s put it away, so I put it on the ground and lit it one by one.
Now the yard is lively, colorful fireworks take off and explode in mid-air.
There are also various firecrackers, clanging.
Han Zhenlin took a nap in the afternoon and was not sleepy at the moment, so he went out to watch the cannon shooting.
This kid is very courageous, he is not afraid of such a big firecracker, watching those fireworks, he clapped his hands happily.
It was the two dogs, who were frightened by the sound of firecrackers in the yard, hid in their dens and shivered, wishing they could curl up into a ball.
Such a big pile of fireworks and firecrackers, it's time to finish the fireworks.
It was only halfway here, and there was a shout from the house, calling them to come in and eat dumplings.
"Okay, let's put these first, and let's come out and put them after we finish eating the dumplings later."
Han Liwei picked up Han Zhenlin, who was still full of emotions, and coaxed him back to the house to eat dumplings.
"Your mother and your aunt put money in the dumplings, let's see how much money you can eat tonight.
Our family Zhenlin is the most capable, and he will definitely be able to eat several. "
Sure enough, when he heard that there was still money in the dumplings, Han Zhenlin showed his strength, and immediately pulled his finger and made a gesture of three.
"Three, I want to eat three." What he meant was to eat three coins.
"Well, three, our family Zhenlin is the most powerful, we will definitely be able to eat three."
Han Liwei carried his son into the house, let him sit on a chair, and waited to eat dumplings.
There are several kinds of fillings for the dumplings on New Year’s Eve, each of which is different, such as lace, wheat ears, and ingots.
Each of them contains money, jujubes, sugar and other things, just to coax the children to eat more.
Xu Haiyuan and the others are all grown up, this trick can no longer fool them.
However, as the child grows up, he also eats a lot. After eating at three o'clock in the afternoon, he will be hungry by this time.
So they all ate a lot of dumplings, and they also got a lot of money, dates and the like.
It was Han Zhenlin who was clamoring for three dollars to eat. He didn't eat any of the five dumplings, and he wanted to eat more if he was in a hurry.
Seeing this, Su Anying was afraid that her nephew would be full, so she hurriedly found some money and secretly stuffed it into the dumplings.
"Come here, look at the dumplings my aunt found for you, there must be money in them."
Su Anying put the dumplings stuffed with money in front of Han Zhenlin.
Hearing this, Han Zhenlin immediately grabbed the dumpling and bit it, and sure enough, he bit something hard.
"Money, money." Children don't know anything else, but they do know money.
This time, Han Zhenlin was so happy that his eyes widened, he didn't care about the half of the dumplings left, and continued to look for dumplings with money.
Su Anying gave Xu Shiyan a wink, and Xu Shiyan quickly gave him another wink.
"Come on, let's try to see if there is any money in this third uncle."
Han Zhenlin took it and bit it, and sure enough, there was one too, so he was very happy now.
Over there, Han Liwei also picked one up for his son, and Han Zhenlin sure enough got another one.
This little guy only knows three numbers, and he can't count if there are too many.
Seeing that there are three coins, the little guy is satisfied. Anyway, his stomach is full, so he stopped clamoring for dumplings and went to play by himself.
Xu Shiqin drew a gourd in the same way again, and coaxed his daughter to eat two dumplings with money.
Xiao Yuer was also full now, happily got down from the table, and went to play with her brother.

chapters.title: Chapter 767: visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 767 Yushenfang
After eating the dumplings, it was not yet half past ten, the children clamored to set off firecrackers, and Xu Shiyan and Ji Tongzhong went out to play with them.
Someone drove over from the other end, picked up Han Liwei and left.
Han Zhenlin and Han Yu are still young after all, they can't stay up too late, and they fall asleep after eating.
Xu Shiqin and Su Anying went upstairs to put the child to sleep.
Xu Haiyuan and the others set off fireworks outside for another half an hour. They didn't come back to the house satisfied until they had finished setting off all the fireworks, and continued to watch TV.
After half past eleven, Xu Haiyuan felt that it was time to finish eating dumplings at home, so he picked up the phone and called.
"Grandpa and grandma, Happy New Year." The phone was connected, and the four children greeted the New Year in unison on the phone.
"Hey, good, good, all good."
On the other end of the phone, the old couple Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were holding the phone, smiling so hard that their teeth could not see their eyes.
"Have you eaten the dumplings? What kind of stuffing did you make tonight? How much did you pay for the meal?"
Zhou Guilan had to ask the children what they had for dinner, for fear that their children and grandchildren would be fooling around in other places.
"I ate it. There are cabbage and radish stuffing, as well as horseshoe pork stuffing and leek fish stuffing.
Grandma, let me tell you, the dumplings stuffed with leeks and fish are delicious. "
Fresh sea fish is minced, add a little fat, and add some leeks, the dumplings made out are extremely delicious.
"Oh, oh, that's good.
Let your mother make whatever you want to eat, and when you come back, there is no such condition. "
When Zhou Guilan heard what the children said, she felt relieved this time.
So I told the children to eat more and pay attention to safety.
While talking, Xu Haibo and others also came to the phone, insisting on paying New Year's greetings to the third uncle and aunt, so they hurriedly passed the phone to Xu Shiyan and his wife.
Nowadays, the South China Sea and the North are thousands of miles apart, and there is only one telephone line to connect with family.
Xu Shixian and his brothers had to come over to join in the fun, and finally Xu Haiyuan paid New Year greetings to the master alone.
This call lasted more than ten minutes.
It's a good thing that life is good now and there is no shortage of money. If it's an ordinary family, it's really distressing.
Hung up the phone, Xu Haiyuan called the Su family again.
Su Weizhong and his wife had just cleaned up the dumplings after eating, and the old couple just sat on the kang dryly.
As soon as the phone rang, the old couple hurried over to answer the phone.
As soon as they heard that it was the grandson inside, the old couple let go of their joy and chatted with the children for a long time.
That night, the phone calls didn't stop.
The other end just hung up the phone after chatting, when Yang Haoyu called again, wishing his godfather and godmother New Year greetings.
Then, Xu Haiyuan called Guo Shouye's home again.
That's his godfather and godmother. He's not at home this year. He can't go to pay New Year's greetings to Guo Shouye and his wife on the first day of the new year. Why don't they make a phone call?
Waiting for Xu Haiyuan to finish calling Guo Shouye, Xu Shiyan had to call Han Wenzhong, Guan Enxue, Lin Qiyue, Chang Hongfa and others to wish New Year.
For those who celebrate Chinese New Year, even if they are not in their hometown, the necessary procedures cannot be omitted.
After that, Dai Chunrong, Li Bingzhuo and others also called one after another to exchange New Year wishes.
Until one o'clock, the phone finally quieted down, and the children were too sleepy, so they went upstairs to sleep.
If it is the previous year, I will definitely visit relatives and friends to celebrate the New Year on the first day of the new year.
Now they are in the south, and there are few acquaintances here. Where can they go?
On the first day of the new year, Xu Shiyan took his wife and children to visit Qin Shaoping's place. Qin Shaoping happened to be resting, so he insisted on keeping his family for a meal.
The children have already played around Yangcheng before, so wandering around is meaningless.
So on the second day of the first lunar month, all three families flew to Sanya for vacation except for Han Liwei.
Fortunately, Sanya has only been developed for a few years, and there are not so many people who come to travel for the New Year.
The scenery here is good, the climate is pleasant, and there are not so many tourists.
Coconut groves, sea breeze, and beach sunshine are completely different from the Northeast scenery, making children linger and forget to return.
I lived in Sanya for four days, and then reluctantly left.
In a blink of an eye, it was already the seventh day of the first lunar month, and Xu Shiyan's family also had to end their trip to the south and set off on their way home.
This year’s New Year’s Eve is late this year, the Spring Festival falls on February 15th, and school will start in a few days after the new year.
Besides, Xu Shiyan still has a job, so he can't play outside all the time.
This time, Su Anying went back with her husband and children.
Health care products factory will not be so busy after the new year, as long as it develops steadily, it will be fine if Dai Lijun and Li Zongliang are watching.
Su Anying has been away from home for so long, she should go back to rest and spend more time with her family.
After two and a half days of tossing and turning by plane and train on the road, I finally returned to Donggang on the afternoon of the ninth day of the ninth day.
At home, Xu Shixian, Xu Shide and others left in the third year of junior high school. They each have jobs, so it is impossible to live with their parents all the time.
It was Xu Shian, Li Chengrong, Han Limin, Zhou Qingguo, Guo Shouye and others who received the call in advance and knew that Xu Shiyan and the others were coming back.
Specially prepared food and drink, waiting at Xu's house.
When everyone met, it was a joy again. The big guys gathered together, eating, drinking, talking and laughing, which was very lively.
Xu Shiyan didn't have time to rest when he came back, so he went back to work the next day.
He has been away for so long, although Dai Chunrong and others are taking care of the company, so nothing can go wrong, but he can't just ask about everything, and he has to be busy for a while.
Su Anying is the same, the company still has a lot of things to do.
Come back and reconcile accounts with Ji Yufeng and others, and plan the development direction for this year.
Anyway, when the couple came back, they were both very busy. At most, they would go home at night to spend time with their parents.
On the fourteenth day of the first lunar month, that is, on the twenty-eighth day of February, both junior high schools and primary schools returned to school.
The happy winter vacation is over, and the new semester officially begins.
As soon as school starts, teachers of various subjects in junior high school begin to select people to participate in this summer's subject competition.
Xu Haiyuan won an award last year, so he must not be able to escape.
There are many physics classes in the second year of junior high school, and Xu Haiyuan's physics grades are also very good, so the physics teacher wants him to train.
Other teachers also hoped that Xu Haiyuan would participate, and now, they started robbing people again.
Finally, the teachers of Mathematics, Physics, Biology, and English won, and Xu Haiyuan started his life of getting up early and going late every day to attend training.
Xu Jinping is in the sixth grade, and this year she is promoted to junior high school.
Due to special reasons, I didn’t make up classes during the winter vacation. When the school starts, the teachers are also crazy, leaving homework in various ways.
Thanks to Xu Jinping being smart enough to study well, she finished all the courses ahead of time during the holidays, so no matter how the teacher kept up with the schedule, she could handle it with ease.
Not only that, Xu Jinping was also selected by the teacher to enter the competition group, preparing to participate in this year's one-minute quiz competition.
This is nothing to Xu Jinping.
She has read the materials of Xu Haiyuan's competition a long time ago, and those things can't help her at all.
Yang Haoyu, Jiang Chunhong and others were selected into the competition group together.
This year, the school decided to keep nine people to participate, and one group will replace the village primary school, so that the chances of winning the prize will be higher.
As for Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui, they are only in the second grade. There is no pressure, just go to school happily every day.
On Saturday and Sunday afternoons, they have to follow Teacher Yu to learn singing and dancing, broadcasting and hosting, etc. Anyway, the lives of the children are quite exciting.
Busy and busy, time flies, as if yesterday was still covered in ice and snow, and the flowers bloomed in the blink of an eye.
Participants began to get busy, building sheds, plastic sheeting, and ponds.
The Xu family still planted a hundred feet of sticks every year, and scattered thirty feet of ginseng seeds. Counting the three years together, it was four to five hundred feet.
Fortunately, they are all contracted out to hire people to work now, so there is no need for Su Anying to work in the fields.
At the health care product factory, the sales after the year are not as hot as before, but they are not as deserted as everyone expected.
The things produced by Jishengyuan Health Products Factory are genuine and effective.
Those who received gifts during the Chinese New Year and used it themselves have become live advertisements for JSY products, and many people spare no effort to recommend them to relatives and friends.
In this regard, Jishengyuan's products have realized the transformation from advertising to word-of-mouth praise.
Don’t underestimate the opinions of the masses. In many cases, advertisements are just to deceive people for a while, and only things that are recognized by the masses can survive in the long run.
So, after the year, there will still be a steady stream of product orders, and everyone in the factory is very happy about this.
The workers are full of motivation, and the management is even more conscientious, not daring to be negligent.
In mid-April, the Spring Fair, which all export companies across the country have been looking forward to, started again.
This year, the province has assigned tasks to enterprises in all counties and cities, and formulated tasks for earning foreign exchange.
If any county or city cannot be completed, the relevant responsible persons will be suspended for reflection and replaced by capable ones.
Now, Guan Enxue and Chang Hongfa are both top leaders in the county and city, and they certainly cannot lead a team to Yangcheng.
Jiang Yunfeng and Zhou Qingguo were arranged in the county, and Lin Qiyue and a deputy mayor were arranged in the city.
That's right, Zhou Qingguo was transferred to the county after the year, from the mayor of the town to the director of the county's commercial bureau.
The original Li Jingming was transferred elsewhere.
From the mayor to the director, it should be regarded as a smooth transition, but this is usually a transition.
As soon as Zhou Qingguo arrived at the Bureau of Commerce, he was arranged to participate in the Spring Fair. This is obviously the leadership's reuse.
It is estimated that in less than two years, he will be able to be promoted.
At Shenye Company, Xu Shiyan was busy with other things, so he arranged for Li Chengrong to take a few young people from the sales department to Yangcheng with the products.
At present, the development of participating companies has been on the right track and getting better and better.
In the spring of this year, orders from regular foreign customers have already reached nearly 40 million US dollars.
On the pharmaceutical factory alone, there are nearly 10 million orders for Jiuxindan, Tongluodan, Jiangtangling and other medicines.
These special medicines produced by Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory have remarkable curative effects.
Although it has not yet obtained the drug certification in Europe and the United States, it can only be sold in health care products in the European and American markets, but the effect has been affirmed by many patients.
In Dongyi, South Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore and other places, these drugs have been widely recognized, and have obtained drug certification from relevant institutions, and can be directly used in hospital pharmacies.
In addition to these medicines from the pharmaceutical factory, there are also many orders for various products from the health care product factory.
Now there is no need to wait until the Spring Fair. Many customers call directly to ask if there are any new products this year.
If there is, just place an order and arrange production and delivery.
It happened that a few young people came up with this year's publicity idea. Xu Shiyan thought it was very good, so he arranged for Li Chengrong to take a few young people from the sales department to practice.
Anyway, with the foundation laid over the years, Xu Shiyan can accept how much foreign exchange he earns at the Spring Fair.
Regarding Xu Shiyan's decision, quite a few people don't understand it, and think that Xu Shiyan's achievements are gone.
Some people had always disliked Xu Shiyan, but this time they discussed it secretly, waiting for the participation company to fail to complete the task of earning foreign exchange, and waiting for Xu Shiyan to lose face.
There are also people who put eye drops in front of the leader, and speak ill of Xu Shiyan and Shenye Company openly and secretly.
However, contrary to everyone's expectations, just half a day after the opening of the third phase of the Spring Fair on May 1, the orders of participating companies exceeded 10 million.
In addition to medicines and health care products, the most outstanding product this year is actually the skin care products from the daily chemical factory.
It turns out that Xu Shiyan has been planning since last winter.
First apply for various certifications abroad through Gangcheng Company, and wait for the certificates to be obtained, then use those old customers to find ways to promote in many places abroad.
In addition to presenting gift sets and free experience, it also makes use of newly emerging TV shopping channels abroad to accurately recommend them to housewives.
Before the Spring Fair, various publicity methods have been pushed.
Many people are very interested in this ancient secret recipe and precious skin care products from the oriental country that were used by the imperial court in the past.
In addition to Li Chengrong and others, they invited actors from a certain art troupe in Yangcheng to pretend to be noble concubines and princesses in the court.
On the day of the Spring Festival Fair, a group of beautiful and slim girls performed swayingly in front of the booth, which immediately attracted the attention of countless foreigners.
Then, the royal ginseng skin care products produced by Changbai Mountain Daily Chemical Factory became an instant hit, with an order of five or six million dollars on the first day of opening.
"Shiyan, I can see it, you boy, you have the most eyes.
Not only do you have a lot of insight, but all the people under your command have been taught by you to be very smart and capable.
Lin Qiyue called me to announce the good news, saying that those foreigners looked straight at the time. "
On the evening of the 1st, Guan Enxue called Xu Shiyan, laughing on the phone, not to mention how happy he was.
"Secretary Guan, why do I listen, don't you seem to be praising me?"
Xu Shiyan had received a call from Li Chengrong a long time ago, and knew everything about the situation there.
Yushenfang's skin care products can stand out at the Spring Fair. In fact, the company's sales team has done a lot of preparatory work.
At that time, everyone thought about it. If the promotion abroad cannot be opened, then they can only be transferred to China.
At that time, the old trick will be repeated, and the method of bombing the advertisements of the health care product factory will be played again. No matter what the situation is, the product can be launched.
Now it seems that their promotion methods are still effective.
Winning orders at the Spring Fair is only the first step, and the next step is to increase promotion efforts.
Strive to make Yushenfang the number one brand of domestic skin care products, and let everyone know that domestic products are no worse than those big foreign brands.
"You heard it wrong, I just praised you. Hahaha." Guan Enxue laughed on the phone.
They have known each other for many years, they are old friends, and they don't have so many scruples when getting along, and no one will care if they just make a joke.
Actually, this time Xu Shiyan didn’t lead the team to Yangcheng. There were a lot of rumors in the province, and some people in the city were waiting to see the joke.
Guan Enxue naturally believed in Xu Shiyan and the ability of Shenye Company, but he couldn't help but sweat in his heart.
It wasn't until Lin Qiyue called back at night that Guan Enxue finally breathed a sigh of relief, and then he was in the mood to joke with Xu Shiyan.
"Shi Yan, please work hard and strive to maximize the ginseng industry.
Don't worry, no matter what difficulties you encounter, the city and the province will definitely support you.
Let’s work together from top to bottom to revitalize the ginseng industry, bring ginseng farmers, and live a good life. "
Guan Enxue has high hopes for Xu Shiyan and Shenye Company. This is also an affirmation of Xu Shiyan.

chapters.title: Chapter 768: Maple Wood
chapters.content:
Chapter 768 Fenglin Wood Industry
With all the attention, the Spring Fair ended.
Oriental Ginseng Company once again broke the record with the data of 43 million foreign exchange earnings.
Among them, the daily chemical factory launched a series of skin care products from Yushenfang, which directly signed an order of more than 10 million US dollars.
Many people feel that it is better to earn money from women.
This spring fair, in addition to the excellent performance of Yushenfang's skin care products, there is another product that did not show much beforehand, but it became a blockbuster and earned tens of millions of foreign exchange.
It is the three-layer solid wood composite floor produced by Fenglin Wood Industry, which is jointly established by Shenye Company and Songjianghe Forestry Bureau.
Three-layer solid wood composite flooring, generally use oak, oak, colored wood, beech, catalpa, willow and other hardwoods as the surface board, basswood or poplar as the core board and back board, and the three-layer wood board is pressed into one with a special structure .
Has the same texture and pattern as pure solid wood veneer, but the quality is stable.
Compared with pure solid wood veneer, it is less prone to deformation, warping, cracking and other problems.
Moreover, the three-layer solid wood composite floor is more convenient to install. It does not need to lay the ground keel, and only needs simple leveling.
The three-layer solid wood composite floor produced by Fenglin Wood Industry has a complete range, including ordinary plain board, painted board, oiled board and so on.
Not only retains the texture of various hardwoods on the surface board, but also makes the floor durable and easy to care for.
When the flooring factory started work in autumn and winter last year, some foreign merchants tentatively ordered some goods.
Unexpectedly, the market response was good, and orders continued to increase after the year.
Coming to the Spring Fair is also a test for Fenglin Wood Industry.
Before, the quality of flooring in Northeast China was not high, and the market sales were mediocre, so most people in the county didn’t pay much attention to it at first.
Everyone has no hope for the solid wood composite flooring of Fenglin Wood Industry. Some people even oppose a new factory to participate in the Spring Fair.
Thanks to Chang Hongfa, Zhou Qingguo and others who fully supported Fenglin Wood Industry.
Helped to win the quota for the second phase of the Spring Fair, so that Fenglin Wood Industry can shine in the Spring Fair.
"Old Chang, your county has done well this year. The beverage factory and flooring factory alone have earned more than 20 million dollars in foreign exchange."
Guan Enxue was very happy and called Chang Hongfa.
It is only a county, and it has earned more than 20 million yuan, which is really remarkable.
"Don't, Secretary Guan, don't say that. Listening to your words, I feel a little frightened."
Chang Hongfa was on the phone, half-truthful.
"It's not easy in our county. The ginseng market has not been good in the past few years, and the county's income has also declined. Now it's just pointing at these two factories."
Chang Hong's implication in his speech was that he was worried that the city would be jealous, and then these two factories would also be transferred to the city.
Back then, Yi Shen was snatched away by the city in this way.
Nowadays, there are not many companies that can be sold in the county. If these two factories are taken away again, what will the county's finances point to?
"Hey look at you, you are so stingy, what are you doing? Guarding against thieves?"
On the other end of the phone, Guan Enxue said something in embarrassment.
Chang Hongfa's guess is correct, there are indeed many people who presuppose in front of Guan Enxue that Fenglin Wood Industry should be classified as a city.
Although Fenglin Wood Industry is a new factory, the product is wooden flooring, but the profit in it is really not small.
Currently, the factory's flooring export price is more than one hundred dollars per square meter.
The main specifications of the factory are 1.83 meters long and 18.9 centimeters wide. Three floors are one square meter.
That is to say, a floor can be sold for thirty or forty dollars, which is equivalent to more than one hundred yuan in RMB.
what is this? Is this the floor? Is this really paving the ground with banknotes? It's time to grab money.
In the past, the products of the Forestry Bureau, such as plywood and composite board, only sold for how much for a large sheet?
At present, the pure solid wood veneer floor, which is more popular in China, cannot even be sold at half the price.
Now, who isn't looking at Fenglin Wood with envy?
Guan Enxue is more self-aware, he sees clearly.
Behind Fenglin Wood Industry is Dongfang Ginseng Company and Songjianghe Forestry Bureau.
Moreover, this is the first solid wood composite flooring factory in China, which can be said to have created a precedent for solid wood composite flooring.
Judging from the current point of view, Fenglin Wood Industry has a bright future, and it is estimated that even the city will not be able to make money. In the future, it may become an enterprise directly under the province.
So Guan Enxue didn't make any plans. Someone raised it with him, but he didn't respond.
But being directly pointed out by Chang Hongfa, Guan Enxue was still a little embarrassed.
"No, Secretary Guan, I didn't say anything.
Secretary Guan has taken good care of our county over the years, and everyone remembers it. "
Chang Hongfa also noticed that what he said outright just now was a bit poignant, so he hurried to make amends.
"Come on, I understand how you feel, so there's no need to explain that.
Don't worry about what you say, this year our city can be regarded as elated, and you all have contributed. "
Guan Enxue smiled, he has known Chang Hongfa for so many years, how can he not know who Chang Hongfa is? Naturally, I don't care about these.
Regardless of whether the beverage factory and the flooring factory belong to the county or the city, anyway, the amount of foreign exchange earned by the city this year ranks first in the province.
This is enough, don't worry too much about the others.
"Thank you, Secretary Guan, for your encouragement. We will definitely continue to work hard."
Don't worry about it, the leader's praise is still very pleasing, and Chang Hongfa also laughed.
The two chatted on the phone for a while, then hung up the phone, each busy with their own work.
Of course, compared to Guan Enxue and Chang Hongfa, the happiest people should be the leaders of the Forestry Bureau and Guo Shouye.
"Brother, you don't know. When I passed by the province, the leader of our Provincial Forest Industry Bureau met me. It was a kind of enthusiasm.
I was stunned to stay in the province for several days, and I almost got drunk just drinking. "
Guo Shouye finally came back from the province, so he hurriedly called Xu Shiyan.
"As soon as I come back, let alone, the phone in the office has never stopped, ringing from morning to night.
The leaders of the bureau and people from other local forestry bureaus all called me to inquire about the flooring factory.
I heard that meaning, it seems that I have moved my mind, I want to come to study, and I will also plan the whole factory later. "
Guo Shouye's main purpose of calling Xu Shiyan was actually to ask Xu Shiyan for advice on what to do in the current situation.
"Brother, this matter is not easy." Xu Shiyan sighed and hesitated on the phone.
"We can't apply for a patent for parquet technology, so we really can't prevent others from following suit."
Composite flooring is actually a combination of many technologies, which are not original to Fenglin Wood Industry, they just made comprehensive use of them.
So there is no way to apply for a technical patent, and it is impossible to prevent others from following suit.
"At present, we can only respond to the superiors first, and it is not the time to promote technology."
Doing business in China is afraid of this. Whenever a project makes money, a bunch of people will follow suit.
The final result is that the market has overcapacity, and related companies lower prices with each other, and in the end no one makes money.
To be honest, the composite floor production technology is not that difficult, and they just seized the opportunity.
If we really let go at this time and allow others to come and learn, I am afraid that within three years, many factories will pop up in the province.
This market has not yet been developed, and it is not appropriate for too many factories to participate, otherwise no one will be able to make money.
Xu Shiyan remembered that the earliest flooring factory in Songjianghe in his previous life was Jinlong Wood Industry.
When it was first established in 1996, it made plywood, and it was only in 1998 that it started to make composite flooring.
The flooring factory has achieved good benefits. It has grown from one workshop to three main workshops, and then expanded the Qianqiu and Jinqiu factories locally.
Later, branch factories were established in Dalian, Nanxun and Russia.
Around 2005, there were many large and small factories such as Yunlong Wood Industry, Jinqiao Wood Industry, and Huasong Wood Industry. There are also several flooring factories in the county.
It is said that at that time, there were more than 1,700 factories producing solid wood composite flooring in the country.
There is an industrial zone in Nanxun, and the factories inside are all for flooring.
People who have been there say that the industrial zone is bigger than the entire county of Fusong.
At that time, domestic solid wood composite flooring had already fully opened up in the international market.
It should be said that more than 90% of solid wood composite flooring is exported from China.
The market has opened up. Although the profit margins are not as large as before, all companies can still develop.
But right now, Fenglin Wood Industry has just started and has not yet gained a firm foothold.
At this time, if other factories get involved, it is likely to have a big impact on Fenglin Wood Industry.
They have to be left with some room for development. At least after they grow stronger, others can follow up with the technology.
After all, in this life, Fenglin Wood Industry is the first to eat crabs.
If technological innovation cannot be protected, but is followed by others as soon as it achieves some achievements, then it will follow suit in the future. Who will think of ways to innovate technology?
Without technological innovation, no industry can go far.
After discussing with Guo Shouye, Xu Shiyan decided to make a small request to the superior.
is the technology of Fenglin Wood Industry, which is kept secret for the time being.
At the very least, they have to be given three years of development time. We will talk about the follow-up.
Of course, the words cannot be so straightforward.
According to the report, the current international market has not yet been opened, and the risk is relatively high.
Since Fenglin Wood Industry has taken this step, there is no way out, so it can only go forward.
I hope that the leaders can give some support and relax the policy so that Fenglin Wood Industry can develop steadily without being affected by other factors.
Fenglin Wood Industry is an enterprise jointly established by Canye Company and Songjianghe Forestry Bureau.
With the influence of participating companies in the province and the strength of the leaders of the Provincial Forest Industry Bureau to protect the calf, this matter is still very easy to do.
Not long after the report was handed in, the higher-ups responded.
Fenglin Wood Industry is directly under the leadership of the Provincial Forestry Department and the Provincial Forest Industry Bureau, and other departments have no right to interfere. The relevant forestry departments of the whole province must fully cooperate with the various development needs of Fenglin Wood Industry.
Any company that wants to learn technology needs to report to the province first, and the province agrees.
As for the report, whether the province agrees or not, that's another matter.
Anyway, with such an extra layer of protection, Fenglin Wood Industry has no worries for the time being. Others just want to learn technology, and Guo Shouye has an excuse to evade it.
As for technology leaks, it’s not that easy.
In the factory, the team leader goes up, section chief, workshop director, quality inspector, etc., most of them are transferred from plywood factory, fiberboard factory and other places.
These people have the establishment of regular employees, and then they are asked to sign confidentiality contracts and non-compete contracts.
We are not afraid that these people will quit and take their technology with them.
Unless someone comes to the factory, all the sections from the beginning to the end are rotated, and every section is mixed with the team leader or above, in order to learn all the skills.
It is estimated that even if someone really does this, it will take at least seven or eight years.
By that time, Fenglin Wood Industry has already established a firm foothold, so it is not afraid of others to follow suit and set up factories.
The Spring Fair has won so many orders, of course each factory has to go all out in production to ensure that the orders can be delivered on time with high quality and quantity.
Daily Chemical Factory has a lot of orders this time, but Xu Shiyan is still not satisfied. If he wants to develop the brand of Yushenfang, he cannot give up the domestic market.
To open up the domestic market, various means of publicity must be arranged. TV commercials are such a good way of publicity, how can it be left behind?
The daily chemical factory has foreign trade orders, and is backed by a ginseng company. It has a lot of money, and its publicity is not like that of a health care product factory.
This time, the advertisement was filmed directly, and it was broadcast on CCTV during the prime time.
In addition, we have also done publicity and promotion in shopping malls, stations and other crowded places in major cities, and the effect is really good.
"General manager, this month the daily chemical factory has received about 3 million domestic orders. At present, department stores in hundreds of large and medium-sized cities in China have counters selling Yushenfang skin care products.
Stores and supply and marketing cooperatives in other places also distribute some products.
According to market feedback, our products have obvious effects and few allergic reactions, and are very popular among consumers. "
The person in charge of the daily chemical factory, holding a large stack of reports, happily came to announce the good news to Xu Shiyan.
"In addition, foreign customers placed an additional order of 2 million this month, and the other party hoped that we could deliver the goods within three months.
Currently, the daily chemical factory is fully engaged in production, and strives to complete the order on time.
However, judging from the current development situation, it is necessary to expand the scale, increase production lines and workers, in order to be able to meet the subsequent order demand. "
Anyway, it’s better to earn money from women.
This skin care product is consumable. A set of skin care products can only be used for two months at most, and you have to buy it again when you run out.
Women generally look for which product is good, and they will continue to use it.
Moreover, Yushenfang’s skin care products are divided into several series, which can adapt to the skin needs of different groups of people and different age groups, so the market prospect is very good.
With the improvement of national awareness, the skin care products of Yushenfang will further occupy the domestic market.
The foreign high-end market is gradually opening up.
According to the current order volume and foreign market feedback, it is speculated that there will be large orders in the second half of the year.
So the daily chemical factory is worried that if it does not prepare in advance, the production of the factory may not be able to supply in the second half of the year or next year.
"Well, I know this. I have asked Secretary Chang and others to recruit workers from various towns."
Xu Shiyan nodded while flipping through the report.
When choosing the site to build the factory, Xu Shiyan had considered relevant aspects, so the area occupied by the daily chemical factory is not small.
In addition to the existing several workshops, there is still a large open space, which can be expanded.
Currently, the existing workshops and production lines are no problem to complete the order production, but there are not enough workers, so they can only work on day shifts.
So Xu Shiyan has already greeted Chang Hongfa, hoping that the county can find a way to support it.
If the county cannot recruit enough people, Xu Shiyan plans to recruit workers in several neighboring counties.

chapters.title: Chapter 769: This time my daughter is going to the game
chapters.content:
Chapter 769 This time the daughter went to the competition
When Xu Shiyan came to participate, there were less than a thousand employees in total.
After years of development, various new factories have been built, and the number of employees has also doubled.
Currently speaking, all participating employees and their families, who have not yet reached the retirement age and are in good health, have all recruited to work, and there is no one idle.
In addition, the participation company also recruited a lot of people in Donggang, Songjianghe and surrounding villages and towns.
You should know that Donggang Town itself is an agricultural town, and most people make a living by growing ginseng.
Around 1985, the entire Erdonggang Township was counted, and there were only 14,000 to 5,000 people.
Up to now, the entire Erdonggang Town has a population of 16,000 to 7,000.
As for Songjianghe Town, which has the largest population in the county, the town, together with the Forestry Bureau and various forest farms, has a population of 59,000.
A large part of them are employees and family members of the Forestry Bureau.
A few years ago, there were quite a few unemployed young people in the Forestry Bureau.
But since the establishment of Bingshan Beverage Factory and Fenglin Wood Industry, many batches of workers have been recruited one after another. At present, there are not many unemployed people in Songjianghe.
So if the daily chemical factory wants to recruit workers, it is a bit difficult to recruit from the local area, and it has to recruit from other towns.
Fusong County currently has a total population of 290,000. The three towns of Songjianghe, Quanyang, and Lushuihe are the top three in terms of population because they are all related to the Forestry Bureau.
Needless to say, Songjianghe, Fenglin Wood Industry currently does not have enough workers.
Quanyang and Lushui are close, and Bingshan Beverage Factory has been booming in recent years, and many people have been recruited from these two places.
Although ginseng companies are not under the jurisdiction of the county, there are many local factories and the rise of industry, which has driven a considerable economy and related industries.
So Xu Shiyan made a request, and the county actively cooperated, and put up job advertisements in other townships.
The wages at the daily chemical factory are the same as those of other factories under the participation company, and they are among the best in the whole county and even the whole city.
The ginseng industry has been sluggish in the past few years. Many people feel that farming and growing ginseng is not as good as finding a factory to work in.
Young people, especially some girls, don't want to make great efforts. When they learned that the daily chemical factory was recruiting workers, many people signed up one after another.
There is a special person in charge of recruiting workers, so naturally Xu Shiyan doesn't need to worry about it.
Xu Shiyan now only needs to control the general direction, and doesn't need to do everything by himself.
"Okay, that's all for today, send the file, and take a good look at it later."
After meeting all afternoon, Xu Shiyan himself was so tired that his back hurt and he felt drowsy.
No way, state-owned enterprises are like this, learning from various meetings.
This is why Xu Shiyan specially streamlined many unnecessary meetings. Otherwise, he would not have to do anything else for a day and just go to the meeting.
"It's time, let's get off work."
Xu Shiyan stood up, looked at his watch, it was almost five o'clock, and he couldn't pick up his children from school today.
"Well, does Mr. Xu have any plans for the evening? How about we find a place to drink?"
The meeting was over, everyone relaxed, Han Limin asked with a smile while packing his things.
"No, I have to go home.
My eldest daughter is going to participate in a competition in the county tomorrow, and she has to go home tonight, so she can take care of her. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head and smiled.
"Your family Yuanyuan and Pingping, this is really amazing in terms of study.
What competition is Pingping participating in this time? Painting, calligraphy or composition? "
Han Limin knew that Xu Jinping followed Chu Xuanhuai to learn calligraphy and painting. In the past two years, he participated in many competitions and won many awards. He thought it would be similar this time.
"No, this is a one-minute quiz for primary school students.
It is the one our family Yuanyuan participated in two years ago, and this time it is Pingping's turn to participate. "
Xu Shiyan didn't use his secretary to do anything, he packed up all the documents himself, and then came out of the meeting room with Han Limin and others, talking while walking.
"This time it's not just Pingping, but also Haoyu.
I originally said that I would send them to the county, but they were not happy, saying that they didn't want to be special.
My dad has spoken, cook something delicious tonight, and call Haoyu's parents over to have a meal together, which is to cheer and encourage the children. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head while talking, the old people in the family put their children too seriously.
Just to participate in a small competition, okay, in the eyes of the old man, it is the same as going to Beijing to catch the exam.
Han Limin and the others were also happy when they heard it, "The child is uplifting, and if he can go out to compete, he must pay attention to it.
That’s your home, it’s no longer a big deal to win prizes in regular competitions.
If those **** from my family can participate in some kind of competition, my parents will be so happy? "Han Limin said while shaking his head and sighing.
There are three sons in his family, the second and the second are average in their studies.
His family’s boss, Han Zhenwen, did not pass the high school entrance examination last year.
Thanks to the agreement between Shenye Company and Donggang High School, I managed to go to high school.
It is estimated that it is mixed with a high school diploma, waiting to graduate from high school, or sent to the army, or directly into a factory to work.
"Don't say that, studying well is not the only way out.
Didn’t your family Zhenwen Kaichun still participate in the county sports meeting and win prizes? Children have their own strengths, which cannot be compared. "
Although the children of the Han family are a little weaker in studies, they are good in other aspects, especially good at sports.
Han Zhenwen participated in the county middle school sports meeting in spring, and won several awards. It is said that he even broke records.
Besides, with the conditions of the Han family, even if you don't get into college in the future, you can still arrange it, so what are you afraid of.
Everyone chatted a few words and left separately.
Xu Shiyan didn't use the driver to take him, so he drove back to his parents.
It is hot in summer, and the windows are all open, so as soon as you enter the door, you can hear many people talking in the room.
Needless to say, all three members of Yang Junxian's family must have come here.
Sure enough, as soon as Xu Shiyan stepped into the room, he saw Yang Junxian, Ji Yufeng, and Yang Haoyu sitting in the east room.
I don't know what they are talking about, but they are very happy anyway.
"Oh, the third brother is back." Seeing Xu Shiyan enter the door, Yang Junxian and his wife stood up quickly.
"Dad." "Dad." Yang Haoyu, Xu Jinping, Xu Jinhui, and Xu Haiqing said in unison.
"Sit down and talk, this is a family, why are you polite?"
Xu Shiyan smiled and waved his hands, signaling Yang Junxian and his wife to sit down, and he himself sat on the edge of the kang.
"How are you doing recently? Is the factory busy?" Xu Shiyan chatted with Yang Junxian.
"Busy, is the factory still busy?
The order came like a snowflake. Our factory is not large enough, and the workers are working overtime to produce more.
The new factory is under construction, and it is coming soon. It is estimated that it will be put into operation in August. "Yang Junxian laughed as soon as he heard it.
"This is what my uncle and aunt are talking about. No matter how busy Yufeng and I are, we have to come over to have fun."
Qingfeng microbial compound fertilizer is specially developed for ginseng, and it is only suitable for the growth of ginseng, so everyone didn't think about other things at first.
It was originally planned that the annual output of the factory could meet the ginseng production needs of various townships in Fusong, and it was not planned to be too large.
The factory is located at the foot of Nanshan Mountain in Donggang, and it actually occupies a large area.
But no one thought that the compound HF market is average, but the foliar fertilizer is popular. It can be applied to many crops, and the effect is particularly good.
Now not only the three northeastern provinces are ordering, but also all other provinces are ordering.
The fertilizer factory is jointly established by Donggang Township, Yishenchang, and Baishan Shenye Comprehensive Company.
After everyone's discussion, it was decided to expand a part near the original factory site and produce microbial compound fertilizer with the original factory.
In addition, a new factory will be built in the north of the railway station, which is to the east of Fenglin Wood Industry.
and other new factories are built to specialize in the production of foliar fertilizers. The orders for foliar fertilizers are large, so it is more convenient to transport them by rail.
The construction of factory buildings is not the same as before. Nowadays, steel structures are mostly used, which is much faster than the brick and tile buildings in the past.
That's why Yang Junxian said that the new factory will probably be completed and put into operation last autumn.
"Well, that's good, anyway, the factory is under your control now, so you can figure it out."
Although Yishenchang also has shares in the fertilizer factory, it is now operating independently. Xu Shiyan can only provide appropriate technical support here and does not participate in business decision-making.
Yang Junxian is very capable, and the fertilizer factory is running very well in his hands, so no one else needs to worry about it.
Yang Junxian and his wife actually entered the house one step earlier than Xu Shiyan. At this moment, Xu Shiyan came back and just chatted with Yang Junxian.
Over there, Ji Yufeng went to the kitchen to help Su Anying and Zhou Guilan with their work.
The two families are relatives and partners. Su Anying and Ji Yufeng get along like sisters, and don't treat Ji Yufeng as an outsider.
So no one is polite, everyone will start cooking together.
The weather is already hot in June, and the cooking and cooking are extremely hot, which is very painful.
The family is just looking for an opportunity to get together and have fun, so they didn't prepare too many complicated dishes.
There are a few cooked foods, just stir-fry a few dishes and mix them with two cold dishes.
"It's hot, I'm afraid those who get some big fish and meat won't have much appetite, so let's eat lighter tonight."
Su Anying smiled as she served dishes into the room.
"Sister-in-law, I was just about to say, oh, I don't have much appetite in this hot weather, it would be best to have some cold dishes or something." Yang Junxian laughed as soon as he heard it.
"These are not outsiders. Even if the third brother and I dip foreign nails in soy sauce, we can serve them as food and drink."
Yang Junxian said that, of course he was joking, and everyone laughed when he heard it.
"Okay, then I'll give you two a whole plate of foreign nails, and pour some soy sauce, I'll save trouble."
Su Anying also deliberately joked, put the food on the table, turned around and went out again.
Said it was a simple way to get something to eat, and finally served eight dishes and one soup, and two bottles of good wine.
It just so happened that the food here was served and ready, and Xu Haiyuan also came back from school.
So there were seven adults at the table, Xu Jingyi, Yang Haoyu and the four children of Xu's family at the table, and they all sat down and were ready to eat.
"Well, Haoyu, Pingping, you two are going to participate in the competition tomorrow.
This meal tonight is mainly for the two of you.
