Among other things, I wish you both success in the competition and both of you can win prizes. "Xu Chenghou spoke first, sending blessings to the two children.
Over there, Xu Jinping looked embarrassed.
This is just going to the county to participate in a small competition, and grandparents are too grand, as if it is a big deal.
Of course, Xu Jinping was quite moved by the kindness of the elders.
It's hard to say anything else at this time, so I can only nod my head.
"Grandpa, grandma, master, don't worry, Hao Yu and I will definitely perform well and strive to win prizes."
"Hey, yes, this is what I want. Grandpa believes that you two will definitely win the prize."
Xu Chenghou was very happy, and nodded while looking at the two children.
"Eat, eat. Eat something good tonight, don't read when you look back, take a good rest, and get enough energy to go to the game."
In the eyes of others, it’s just the two children going to the county to compete. There is no need to make such a show, it’s too flamboyant and too ostentatious.
But for Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan, they have experienced everything in their life, and now they can say that they can get what they want, and enjoy all the blessings they deserve.
Satisfaction, no regrets, the only hope is that the younger generation will have a future.
If the child has the ability and can go to the competition after studying well, in the eyes of Xu Chenghou and his wife, it is great.
They were happy, so they wanted to make something delicious to reward their children, what's wrong? Is anyone in the way?
Anyway, the old couple are confident and confident, and they don't think they are exaggerating at all.
Over there, Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian looked at each other and smiled helplessly.
This old man has a temper like that of a child. You can't argue with them, just coax them to be happy.
Anyway, the two families haven’t been together for a long time, so it’s good to take the opportunity to have a lively time together, there’s no need to fuss so much with the old man.
"Yes, yes, my dad is right.
Haoyu, Pingping, you two should behave well this time, don't disappoint your grandfather and grandma. "Xu Shiyan nodded with a smile.
Xu Shiyan's words made Xu Chenghou smile very happily.
He is almost seventy now, and it is not easy to drink anymore, so he drank soup with Chu Xuanhuai.
This really echoes the sentence, as long as you have the heart, you can drink anything.
It is rare for the two families to get together, and the chatting and laughing is particularly lively.
After dinner, Yang Junxian and his family sat in Xu's house for a while, until it was almost nine o'clock, and then they got up and left.
"Well, you really don't need to send it home tomorrow? Otherwise, I'll drive you two to the county."
Yang Junxian asked Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu again, and always felt that it would be too much trouble for the children to go to the county in a bus.
"That's right, otherwise I will arrange a car for you, and even the teacher and the students will take you there directly."
Here, Xu Shiyan also said.
"No, no, the school and the teacher have already made arrangements, and we will take the big passenger with the teacher."
When the two children heard it, their heads shook like rattles.
Are you kidding me? They are conspicuous enough in school, if they are so high-profile, they really don't have many friends.
The children have long had a tacit understanding, that is, try to keep a low profile in school, and don't show that they are too special than others.
Academic performance is a talent, but in other respects, try to be consistent with your classmates.
Both children said so, Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian couldn't say anything else.
"Well, since you insist, let's forget it. Bring more money when you go out, and buy whatever you want."
Well, when Xu Haiyuan went out to compete, it seemed that his family said the same thing.
The three members of the Yang family left, and Xu Shiyan and his wife also took their children back home.
In the evening, Xu Jinping really didn't read the book and recite the questions. She just washed up and went to sleep under the covers.
Friday, June 21st, Xu Jinping woke up early in the morning, cleaned up, had breakfast, grabbed her bag and was about to set off.
But suddenly felt that the bag seemed to be much heavier than when she packed it up last night.
Open it and see, good guy, there are several sets of clothes stuffed inside, and there are money and food.
Xu Jinping shook her head, took out the extra things and put them aside, and put on her bag again.
Taking advantage of my parents not paying attention, I ran out of the house in a flash.
Recently, I don’t know what’s wrong, I’m just lack of energy, I feel top-heavy and dizzy after eating in the morning. Had to get a good night's sleep to feel better. I started coding in the afternoon, and when I sat in front of the computer, I felt like I didn’t know what I wanted to write, and my mind was blank. Sometimes I wrote a long paragraph and thought it was not good, so I deleted and rewritten it all. It takes a lot of effort to finish writing and uploading the deletions, deletions, and changes.
At the same time, I used to be able to write 8,000 words, but now I struggle to write 4,000 words. I don’t know what’s wrong. I feel like I'm going to be demented, alas.

chapters.title: Chapter 770: game storm
chapters.content:
Chapter 770 Competition disturbance
Originally, Xu Shiyan planned to drive his daughter to the bus station.
Unexpectedly, his daughter was silent, and ran away while the couple were talking in the kitchen.
When Xu Shiyan looked at the time and went back to the house to look for his daughter, the child had long since disappeared.
Su Anying also saw the things and money on the kang.
"Look at this child, I brought a few more sets of clothes for her, just in case the weather would change.
Besides, she is a girl, so it is convenient to bring a few more sets of clothes.
This brat, the older he gets, the more positive his ideas become, and it's hard to manage. "Su Anying muttered angrily.
The child ran away long ago, what else can the couple have?
Apart from smiling wryly and sighing, there is nothing else to do.
On the other side, Xu Jinping walked through the small alley, took a shortcut and went straight to the passenger terminal in the backyard of the town government.
When I got there, I happened to meet Yang Haoyu. Within a few minutes, the leader of the team, Mr. Jiang, also arrived.
This one-minute quiz competition has been held for several years, and it has always been tutored by Teacher Jiang. She must have led the team to the county.
The teacher was familiar with the road, took the children into the car, and went all the way to the county training school.
This time, Donggang Central Primary School selected nine students to participate in the competition, divided into three groups.
Among them, the two groups with the best performance on weekdays represent the small center.
A group with slightly worse results simply represented the village competition.
Among the students who came back to participate in the competition, there are many girls, and there are only two boys among the nine students.
As a result, accommodation is not very easy to arrange.
"I remember that there is a big room on the third floor? It seems that there are more than ten beds in it?
Otherwise, give us that room, so the children can review together. "
Mr. Jiang thought for a while, and mentioned it to the teacher in charge of board and lodging.
"Huh? We live together?"
The students were also in front of them, their eyes widened and their faces were full of surprise when they heard this. It's not good, is it?
"A bunch of little kids, what's the big deal? I live with you too."
Mr. Jiang didn't care about that and just made a decision.
Nine students, she is a teacher, if they live in several houses, she really can't see it.
It's better to put them all in one room, under her nose, so you can rest assured.
In the sixth grade of elementary school, most of them are thirteen or fourteen years old.
Children these days are quite simple and don’t have much other thoughts.
Since the teacher said to live together, let’s live together.
Just like that, Teacher Jiang took the children to live in the big room at the top of the third floor.
Not to mention, this room is really nice, with a total of eighteen beds in it, which is very spacious.
Because it is a house in Bashan, there are windows on three sides, and the light is good.
The children liked it very much, so they each chose a bed.
The beds are two beds next to each other, so the two boys, Yang Haoyu and a man named Li Qiang, chose the two westernmost beds.
The other girls all chose the beds on the east side.
Everyone put away their things and go down to eat.
The game is still divided into two games, the preliminary round on Saturday and the final on Sunday.
Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu, and a girl from Class 3, Wang Jingjing, formed a group of three.
Jiang Chunhong, Li Shuyan from Class 2, and Fang Xiaoping from Class 3 are in a group of three.
These two groups represent the center’s primary schools.
Li Qiang, Wang Chunxiu from Class 4, and Huang Xiaoxia from Class 1 represented the village primary school in a team of three.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu both heard Xu Haiyuan talk about the rules of this competition, especially they are very familiar with the rules of the questions.
These two kids have never seen any big scenes before, and they are not nervous at all when they are on stage.
The two of them took Wang Jingjing along and went all the way to the finals, winning the first place.
As for Jiang Chunhong's group, they failed to pass the preliminary round because the players were too nervous to perform properly.
The group from the village primary school, because the questions were relatively simple, also reached the finals and won the ranking.
The competition ended on Sunday morning. After the awards were presented, Mr. Jiang led the children to take pictures.
Nine students plus one teacher, standing in a row is not pretty, so the two boys squatting on the ground with their certificates count as the first row.
Mr. Jiang was sitting on a chair, and Xu Jinping and Wang Jingjing were standing next to Mr. Jiang.
The other five girls stood on the steps.
Behind Xu Jinping was Jiang Chunhong.
Just when the camera teacher shouted, "Three, two, one." The last one just exited and was about to press the shutter.
Xu Jinping felt someone push her from behind, making her body shake.
Just as she swayed, the flash light was turned on at the same time, and the teacher over there pressed the shutter.
Xu Jinping was annoyed all of a sudden, and turned her head to stare at Jiang Chunhong.
"Why are you pushing me? Are you sick? Didn't you just fail to win the prize? As for using these methods?
how? This photo is badly taken, and if it makes me ugly, it will show me, right? "
When they came to the stage to accept the award, Jiang Chunhong was sneering from below.
Said that Xu Jinping was lucky, the questions she encountered were easy, but the questions her group got were difficult, so what.
The meaning inside and outside the words is that he is very unconvinced.
Xu Jinping and Jiang Chunhong are both in the first class, and Xu Jinping has performed very well in all aspects of the school.
Not only good academic performance, calligraphy, painting, paper-cutting, composition, singing and dancing, everything is excellent.
He has been the squad leader since the first grade, and was elected as the head of the school radio station in the third grade. After Xu Haiyuan graduated, he succeeded her brother as the captain of the Young Pioneers.
Xu Jinping is the monitor, Yang Haoyu is the deputy monitor, and Jiang Chunhong is the school committee member.
Jiang Chunhong is very good at studying. His father is the director of the food department, and his mother also has a job. His family is good.
The little girl is also very proud, she is competitive everywhere, and she refuses to accept anyone.
However, Jiang Chunhong and Xu Jinping are in the same class, no matter how hard Jiang Chunhong tries, they are still a little worse than Xu Jinping.
Unable to study hard, and her family background is not as good. After a long time, Jiang Chunhong feels unbalanced and always loves to target Xu Jinping.
People before and after said that Xu Jinping relied on her parents' background.
If the Xu family hadn't donated so much money to the school, the school wouldn't have made Xu Jinping the captain.
Xu Jinping has heard of these words, but she just doesn't bother to answer them.
When Jiang Chunhong sneered just now, Xu Jinping pretended not to hear.
It's just the jealousy of a brat, it's too cheap to be as knowledgeable as her.
I really didn't expect that Jiang Chunhong would be so stupid to trip up Xu Jinping on this occasion.
If Xu Jinping's fiery temper can be tolerated, it would be a strange thing.
It may be that Xu Jinping didn't care much about Jiang Chunhong in the past, but now she suddenly accused Jiang Chunhong loudly, which shocked Jiang Chunhong.
"I didn't, it's obvious that you didn't stand firm, why are you relying on me?"
Jiang Chunhong cried a while ago because she failed to win the award, but now her eyes are still red.
At this moment, she looked like she was about to cry, which added a bit of tenderness.
"Teacher Jiang, Xu Jinping has falsely accused me, it's obvious that she didn't stand up for herself."
Xu Jinping sneered, "Hehe, some people have been crying for a long time, and their brains have been ruined by crying, right?
I stand on flat ground and you stand on steps.
If you say that you are not standing firmly, and one accidentally pushed me, the big guys can still believe you.
You said that I didn't stand firm and falsely accused you? "
Xu Jinping glanced up and down at Jiang Chunhong with disdain.
"You can't even lie, how can you play tricks like this?"
Xu Jinping's fiery temper didn't give Jiang Chunhong any face at all, and mercilessly exposed Xiaobai Lianhua's trick of pretending to be weak and pitiful.
Jiang Chunhong is just a thirteen or fourteen-year-old girl, so how can she have so much scheming?
Just now, it was just a moment of jealousy, and it was a little tricky behind the scenes.
Being exposed by Xu Jinping face to face at this moment, Jiang Chunhong's face turned pale in an instant, and she muttered and couldn't speak.
"I, I..." This anxiety made the tears flow even more fiercely.
"What are you? If you don't agree with my second sister, you can say so.
Face the drum and face the gong and beat the gong, it's a big deal to compare the eight classics.
What kind of skill are you doing behind the scenes? Do you still have the face to cry? "
At this time, Yang Haoyu was also impatient, he put the certificate in his hand into the hand of the boy next to him, and took two steps to walk in front of Xu Jinping.
He stretched out his hand and dragged Xu Jinping behind him, raised his head and glared angrily at Jiang Chunhong who was on the steps.
Jiang Chunhong couldn't even handle Xu Jinping, let alone add Yang Haoyu.
Distraught, Jiang Chunhong cried even harder.
At this moment, both Teacher Jiang and the teacher who took the photo came back to their senses.
The two hurried forward and dragged Yang Haoyu and Xu Jinping aside.
"Look, isn't it just that a photo wasn't taken well? What else is there?
Come on, come on, let's take another photo.
Jinping, don’t be angry, come on, stand over here, let’s take another photo. "
This is in the county, and teachers and students from so many schools around are watching.
No matter who is right or who is wrong, they can't quarrel at this time and make people laugh.
So Teacher Jiang immediately pulled Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu over and comforted them softly.
Teacher Jiang said so, but Jiang Chunhong was still crying, so Xu Jinping couldn't care less.
So he gave Jiang Chunhong a blank look, and stood in another place.
Mr. Jiang coaxed Xu Jinping, then turned to coax Jiang Chunhong.
"Hurry up, wipe away the tears, the little girl is crying into a big face.
Teacher knows you didn't mean it, so don't cry. "
Mr. Jiang said this cleverly. She said that Jiang Chunhong didn't do it on purpose, and she actually agreed with Jiang Chunhong's push.
Jiang Chunhong, how could a little girl understand the meaning of these words?
The teacher came to coax her, so she went along with the flow, wiped away her tears, stood on the steps sobbing, and took a new photo with the big guys.
After taking the photo, Teacher Jiang led the children to the cafeteria for lunch, then packed up and left the training school.
There were so many students this time, Teacher Jiang didn't dare to let the children go shopping in the department store again, so he took the students straight to the bus station.
They came early, and the bus took more than an hour to leave.
One o'clock in the afternoon is hot, and there is no wind in this bus station, so it is hot and stuffy.
Teacher Jiang saw it, and hurried to buy popsicles for the children, one for each of them, and sat there eating popsicles to cool off.
Yang Haoyu was clever. Seeing that there was still a long time to go before the departure, he simply went to buy two poker cards and came back to play poker with his classmates on the benches in the waiting room.
After finally waiting for the ticket check and departure, these children quickly collected their poker, followed Mr. Jiang to line up for ticket check, got on the bus and sat down.
A group of people returned to Donggang by car. Needless to say, the Xu family prepared dumplings again.
Knowing that both Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu had won the award, Xu Chenghou and his wife were very happy, and kept persuading the two children to eat more during dinner.
The next day is Monday, and the children are all back to school.
As usual, when the national flag was hoisted on Monday, the principal commended several students who participated in the competition and won prizes.
But the strange thing is that Jiang Chunhong didn't come to school for class. According to the teacher, she seemed to be sick and asked for sick leave.
"Second Sister, she is afraid that you will investigate, so she deliberately asked for leave to hide?"
Yang Haoyu approached Xu Jinping and asked in a low voice.
"Who knows what happened to her? Maybe it was too hot yesterday?
Why do you care so much? I didn't expect you to love gossip so much. "Xu Jinping glared at Yang Haoyu and said indifferently.
"Review well, we have an exam this weekend.
Small promotion is very important. If you do poorly in the exam, see how I beat you. "
Xu Jinping treated Yang Haoyu like Xu Haiqing, and was never polite.
Yang Haoyu scratched his head, "Sister, you still don't believe me? In the exam, I'm just worse than you.
Then how about we compare this time to see who gets the higher score? "
The math scores of the two are similar, but Yang Haoyu's Chinese is not as good as Xu Jinping's, and he loses more points in composition, so he always fails Xu Jinping in the exam.
"Okay, let's compare, let's see who has the higher grade this time?"
Xu Jinping became interested, so she made an appointment with Yang Haoyu, and Xiao Shengchu's results were revealed.
Jiang Chunhong took two days off and did not come back to class until the day the class photo was taken.
No one in the class mentioned the competition, and Xu Jinping even ignored Jiang Chunhong, which made Jiang Chunhong heave a sigh of relief.
This year's junior promotion is scheduled for June 29th, which happens to be Saturday.
The two subjects were easily passed, and the children relaxed and prepared for the party happily.
The children sang and danced together all morning on Sunday. At the end of the party, the head teacher told the children that they would come to school to listen to their grades in a few days.
And told the children to help the family with more work during the holidays, and not to go to Dapaozi and Hetao to avoid danger.
This is a lesson of blood and tears. Now every summer vacation, the teachers will give thousands of instructions to prevent the children from going to dangerous places.
As for whether these brats will listen or not, I don’t know.
Anyway, the teacher has done his best, if this happens again, it is purely because the child is disobedient.
"Second Sister, what are you going to do after the holiday?" Yang Haoyu asked excitedly after leaving school with Xu Jinping.
"No matter where you go this time, you don't want to leave me.
Last year, you went to the south for the Chinese New Year, but you didn’t pick me up. "
Yang Haoyu has been used to being with Xu's children these years, and stays at Xu's house every holiday, not even going back to his own home.
Last year during the Chinese New Year, Xu Shiyan's family was in Yangcheng, but Yang Haoyu was in a hurry. It was too boring for him to be at home alone.
So this time, without waiting for anything, Yang Haoyu made it clear that he should not be left behind this year.
"I don't know, I haven't heard from my parents." Xu Jinping shook her head, she didn't know where to go.
"Let me ask later, we have nothing to do this holiday, we don't even have a holiday homework, we should go out and have fun."
After being asked by Yang Haoyu, Xu Jinping also became interested.
Yeah, the vacation is so long and there is no homework, why don't you take the opportunity to go out and play?
In the evening, after everyone had finished their dinner, Xu Jinping remembered Yang Haoyu's question and asked her parents.
"Where are we going to play? Hey, I haven't thought about this before."
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard what his daughter said. The couple really didn't think about it.
"That year when your brother was promoted to junior high school, we went back to our hometown. This time you are promoted to junior high school, you should go out and have fun."
Xu Shiyan thought about it, and it really made sense.
It is rare for the children to have no homework during the holidays, so they can relax. It is time to take the children out for a walk and learn a lot.
Recommend this new book, Deyun Sociological Crosstalk.

chapters.title: Chapter 771: go to the capital
chapters.content:
Chapter 771 Go to the capital
"In two days, I will go out to the capital and the Shanghai stock market, or you will come with me?"
Su Anying thought of something and asked her daughter.
The branches of Zhencaotang in the capital and Shanghai have been open for more than half a year, and Su Anying has never had a chance to visit them.
A few days ago, Su Anying was discussing with Xu Shiyan, and wanted to find some time in the near future to take a look around.
First, I came to see how Zhencaotang's business is doing, and whether it needs to adjust its business direction.
These things can't be explained clearly on the phone, so Su Anying has to go over and have a look in person.
Another one, his family has several houses and shops in the capital, which were previously entrusted to look after or rented out.
It’s been several years, why don’t you have to go and have a look.
I am not busy in summer, so I have time to go out for a walk.
After last autumn, there will be a lot of things. The family needs to start making ginseng, the processing factory has to start work, the customer needs to place an order, and the health care product factory needs to stock up on raw materials.
Although Su Anying doesn't need to do these things by herself, how can she not worry about them?
"Hey, this is fine.
In a few days, Yuanyuan and the third and fourth children will also have final exams. After they finish the exams, we will leave directly. "
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan felt that the proposal was acceptable.
He also really wants to go to the capital to have a look and buy two more houses or something.
Taking advantage of the fact that there are not too many restrictions on buying a house in the capital, hurry up and buy it. It may not be so convenient in a few years.
Shanghai stock market is the same. If there is a suitable place, buy two sets and keep them.
What about the four children in the family, who knows where they will all go in the future?
Prepared in advance, even if the children don’t live in the future, or rent it out or sell it, there will be no loss.
"Oh, at this time, the capital and Shanghai stock market are very hot, it's actually a bit of a pain to go out to play."
Xu Shiyan calculated in his mind that after the children finished their final exams, it would be July 10th.
At that time, no matter the capital or the Shanghai stock market, the temperature was quite high, and it was a bit difficult to go out to play.
Although this year is not as hot as later generations, the summer in the capital is definitely enough for a person to drink a pot, and sauna days are no joke.
The children are used to the coolness of the Northeast, so they may not be able to withstand the heat of the capital.
"Otherwise, you take your daughter and Haoyu to the Shanghai stock market first, and finish everything that needs to be done.
Waiting for those three to finish the exam, I took the others to the capital.
Let’s meet up in the capital, and then let’s go to places like QHD Beidaihe and Chengde. "
It is reasonable to travel north in summer and south in winter.
But the development of tourism in Northeast China is so poor that there is nowhere to go.
Besides, they are near Changbai Mountain. It is really nothing new to see the mountains in the northeast, so they can only go elsewhere.
Traveling is actually enough to see where you live, and go to see where others live.
As a native of Northeast China, where can I go out to play? Then you can only go south.
"Go out and play, I'm my age, I won't mix with you."
When Chu Xuanhuai heard this, he quickly waved his hands.
He has traveled all over his life, and has been to foreign countries, let alone the capital, how many times he has been there.
For a person in his eighties, staying at home honestly is better than anything else, so don’t join in the fun.
"Yes, yes, we won't go either. You take the children out for a stroll. It's good to learn a lot."
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan also quickly waved their hands. They are old and have no interest in young people for a long time, so stay at home with peace of mind.
The year before last, they were going back to their hometown to worship their ancestors, otherwise, they wouldn't want to go all the way.
Xu Shiyan and his wife persuaded him repeatedly, but Chu Xuanhuai and the others just refused to go out.
Then there is no other way, we can only discuss taking the children out to play for a while.
"Oh, that's great, I can go to the capital. I'm going to see the national flag raising and the Forbidden City."
Xu Haiqing jumped up happily when he heard that his parents were going to take them out to play.
"You don't want to be beautiful there. If you don't do well in the final exam this time, I won't take you anywhere. You can take care of your grandparents at home."
Xu Shiyan looked at his younger son, snorted, and deliberately poured cold water on him.
"Huh?" Xu Haiqing's face collapsed when he heard such words.
"Don't, Dad, you see I work very hard. It's not that I don't study, but I can't compare with my elder brother and second sister.
Dad, please, take me with you. "Xu Haiqing almost cried on the spot and showed it to his father.
It’s okay to talk about other things, but when it comes to academic performance, eight of them are tied together, and they can’t keep up with their brothers and sisters.
Xu Haiqing's appearance made the whole family laugh, "Okay, okay, don't scare my grandson."
Zhou Guilan hurriedly hugged her little grandson and patted the child on the back.
"Take you, definitely take you. As long as you study hard and take the exam well, grandma will tell your dad for you."
"Grandma, I must study hard. You see, I just finished my homework when I got home recently, without delay."
After all, I am still young, and I am anxious to go out with my parents to play.
Xu Haiqing blushed anxiously, nodded repeatedly, and assured Zhou Guilan that he would definitely study hard.
"Well, yes, this milk can testify that you have been active in your homework recently.
Third child, do you hear me? Haiqing has promised, you also give him a chance, take him this time. "
Zhou Guilan winked at her son and daughter-in-law.
"That's fine, since your grandma interceded, we will take you with you.
But you have to study hard these few days, do you hear me? "Xu Shiyan held back his smile and said with a straight face.
Actually teasing children is very interesting. The two eldest in the family have been shrewd since they were young. Xu Shiyan can't scare them at all. To be honest, he has no sense of accomplishment.
It’s better to be the youngest son, it’s interesting to be fooled every time.
"Huihui, you have to work hard, and strive to come back first in the final exam."
After scaring his younger son, Xu Shiyan turned his head and touched the top of the little girl's head, and said softly.
"Oh, I see, Dad." The little girl smiled sweetly and nodded obediently.
Different from her elder brother and sister who are extremely intelligent, and also not as mischievous as her younger brother, Xu Jinhui has been a well-behaved, quiet and obedient child since she was a child.
I do whatever my parents tell me to do, and I don’t do it if I don’t want to.
Fortunately, the Xu family has good conditions, and there is no shortage of children
If this were an ordinary family, this child would be the one who was ignored or even mistreated by his parents.
Because she is too obedient and obedient, she has no sense of existence if she is not noisy.
Xu Shiyan looked at his well-behaved little daughter, and couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
Everyone loves a well-behaved daughter, but with such a personality, it is easy to suffer when she grows up and goes out of society.
He would rather the little girl be more aggressive, and it doesn't matter if she is sharp or strong. A strong girl will not suffer in the future.
Ke Ren's personality is innate, and it is difficult to change.
The child is still young, let's wait and see in a few years, at worst, the husband and wife work hard, and they can always give the daughter a future and protect her.
"Okay, let's all watch TV, wait for the news broadcast to end, and then go home."
Xu Shiyan waved his hand, signaling to the children what to do.
Su Anying's time is relatively free, and she doesn't need to ask for leave to arrange work or anything, she can leave as she pleases.
On July 3rd, Su Anying took Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu to the Shanghai Stock Market first, and stayed at the Zhencaotang in the Shanghai Stock Market for a few days.
Learn about the operating conditions of the store here, and discuss the next development direction with Su Anyu.
After that, Su Anying followed Xu Shiyan's wishes and asked for help, and bought two houses in the Shanghai stock market with a good location and a good environment.
After all, it is an international metropolis, and the housing prices here are not low.
However, considering the Xu family's current wealth, it is quite easy to buy two houses.
Buy the house, find someone to go through the formalities, and entrust Su Anyu to help with the follow-up matters.
On July 12th, Su Anying took the two children and set off for the capital.
On the other side, Xu Shiyan took advantage of the time when the children hadn't taken the exam, arranged all the work in the unit and asked for leave.
On July 10th, Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinhui, and Xu Haiqing had their final exams.
Xu Jinhui and the others were in elementary school, and they only took math and Chinese, and they finished it in one day.
Xu Haiyuan is in the second year of junior high school, and at the end of the term, he has to take eight subjects of mathematics, language, history and land administration, biology, and physics, so the exam will take three days.
By the time Xu Haiyuan finished the exam, the papers had already been graded by the participating primary school.
As soon as the results came out, Xu Haiqing's class teacher, Teacher Ye, called Xu Shiyan directly.
"President Xu, the final grades of Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing are out.
I heard from Haiqing that he wants to hang out with you and has no time to come to school to listen to grades and take homework. Then I will tell you about your child's grades. "
"Oh, oh, thank you, Teacher Ye.
These two children have troubled you, and you usually take care of them, so you made a special call here. "
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan quickly thanked him.
"You're welcome, you're welcome, this is what it should be.
Xu Jinhui has 100 in mathematics and 98 in Chinese, ranking first in our class.
Xu Haiqing is 96 in mathematics and 97 in Chinese. His grades are also very good, ranking fifth in our class. "
Shanchangzidi Primary School does not have as many students as Donggang. There are only two classes in the second grade, and each class has less than 40 students.
Xu Haiqing was able to take fifth place in the exam, which is not bad.
Of course, there are not many courses in the second grade, and the knowledge is not difficult. Most of the children can get a score of 90 or so.
The real diversion starts from the third grade. Many children have good grades in the first and second grades, but after the third grade, they get worse and worse.
Xu Haiqing has been studying hard these days in order to go out with his parents.
This kid tried his best to finish his homework in school, and quickly reviewed it after returning home. No need to ask anyone, he found the problems by himself.
So it is quite normal for him to be able to take this test.
"Thank you for your hard work, Mr. Ye, our family Xu Haiqing is too naughty and caused a lot of trouble for the teacher."
Xu Shiyan was quite satisfied with the result of the child's test, so he had a few words of courtesy with the teacher, and then hung up the phone.
Xu Haiyuan finished the exam, and the two younger ones also came out with results.
On the morning of the 13th, Xu Shiyan took the three children and got on the train to Tonghua.
From here to the capital, you can take a car to Tonghua first, and then reverse from Tonghua to the capital.
Probably set off the day before, and arrive at the capital at noon the next day.
There is another way, which is to take the train to Shenyang, and then fly to the capital from Shenyang.
To be honest, this kind of work is a bit strenuous, maybe it's too late to arrive in the capital.
I bought sleeper berths on the train from Tonghua to the capital. The children slept at night, and the next day they woke up and played for a while.
In comparison, it is more economical and comfortable.
At noon on the 14th, the train arrived at the Capital Station. When Xu Shiyan got off the train with his three children, he felt the enthusiasm of the capital, and the heat wave hit his face.
The heat is different from that of the dog days in the Northeast. This kind of heat is stuffy. No wonder people call it a sauna day.
Nan Zhendong drove over to pick him up at the station. The two brothers-in-law hadn’t seen each other for more than half a year, and this meeting was also very close.
"Second brother-in-law, hurry up and get in the car, let's go home."
It was a hot day, and no one was in the mood to chat outside. Nan Zhendong stepped forward to take the luggage of Xu Shiyan and others, put it in the trunk, and then greeted everyone to get in the car.
After Xu Haiyuan and the others greeted Nan Zhendong, they hurried into the car.
Then Nan Zhendong drove the four of them to a yard bought by Xu Shiyan's family in the capital.
At the beginning, Su Anying bought two shops and a small courtyard in the capital, opened one of the two shops and rented out the other, and asked someone to help take care of the small courtyard.
Last year, Su Anzhen and his wife came to the capital to open a shop. When they first came here, they had nowhere to stay, so they lived in the courtyard for a while.
A while ago, Nan Zhendong and his wife bought a house here and moved out of the small courtyard.
It happened that Su Anying and the others came over, they didn't need to stay in a hotel, but lived in their own home, which was comfortable and safe.
This small courtyard is a typical quadrangle courtyard pattern. Once entered, the courtyard is not too big, covering an area of ​​more than 300 square meters.
There are three main rooms with two side rooms, three east and west wing rooms, and three inverted rooms.
Although the place is not too big, it is well organized.
When Nan Zhendong and the others came over last year, they found someone to repair it, and everything was well maintained.
Xu Shiyan and others got out of the car and walked into the yard. Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu, who were playing in the shade of the yard, heard the movement and ran out quickly.
"Dad." "Godfather." The two children hurried forward to help carry the luggage.
"Brother, how did the fourth child do in the exam?"
As Xu Jinping walked in, she didn't forget to inquire about Xu Haiqing's exam results.
Although Xu Haiqing also came with him, he was afraid that this brat would not do well in the exam, and his father would settle the score with him later.
Xu Jinping is such a worry-loving character.
Don't look at her not showing good looks to Xu Haiqing on weekdays, and having to slap her brother twice at every turn. In fact, she is the one who cares about him the most.
"It's not bad, so-so. Mathematics 96, Chinese 97, their class is fifth."
Xu Haiyuan curled his lips. In his eyes, this grade is no different from failing.
I think back then, when he was in the second grade, he got full marks in mathematics and Chinese.
Xu Jinping was the same at that time, she scored double hundred in the final exam.
For some people, the perfect score is because they can only get 100 points on the test.
But for some evildoers, they got full marks in the test because they only got 100 points on the paper.
Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping are such monsters, so Xu Haiyuan can only say that Xu Haiqing's results are so-so.
"Well, it's average.
All right, as far as he is virtuous, at least he got fifth in the exam. " Xu Jinping also sighed.
Xu Haiqing can't be too demanding. If he can maintain his current state, it will be very good.
"Well, anyway, they are all in charge of junior high school, and they can go to junior high school no matter what they take the exam." Xu Haiyuan nodded.
The brothers and sisters do not have high demands on the fourth child, as long as Xu Haiqing can finish high school smoothly.
After all, not everyone can compare with these two.
When Xu Haiyuan was promoted to primary school, he had 100 in mathematics and 98 in Chinese.
Two days ago, Xu Jinping and the others got their primary grades. Xu Jinping got 100 in Mathematics and 99.5 in Chinese.
The 0.5 point was deducted from the composition because the teacher really couldn't find a place to deduct points, and felt that the 100 points in Xiaoshengchu's Chinese test were too exaggerated.

chapters.title: Chapter 772: I want to buy a bigger one
chapters.content:
Chapter 772 I still want to buy a bigger one
The two brothers and sisters muttered as they walked, their voices were not too loud.
Xu Shiyan in front of him heard it so clearly that he could only shake his head and sigh.
To be honest, if anyone becomes brothers and sisters with these two, the pressure is really great.
You know, the feeling that no matter how hard you try to catch up is futile, and you will even be left farther and farther away, it can really drive a person crazy.
There are these two evildoers in the family, Xu Shiyan never dared to tell the two younger ones, see how your brother and sister are doing, learn from your brother and sister, such things.
I was really afraid of hitting the two younger ones, afraid that they would be unbalanced, and afraid that something would happen to them in the future.
In fact, in Xu Shiyan's view, a child like Xu Haiqing is normal.
What kind of things do you do at any age, you should be naughty and play as you please.
Of course, you can't say this in front of Xu Haiqing, or that brat will be cocky again.
So, raising children is difficult, especially with a few wonderful children in the family.
Xu Shiyan was thinking about it, when Su Anying and Su Anzhen just came out of the kitchen.
As soon as she saw Master Xu Shiyan, Su Anzhen laughed.
"Second sister-in-law, it's been a hard journey, so hurry up and take the child into the house to rest, while my second sister and I are cooking.
It's too hot, so we won't go out to eat at noon.
I learned how to make fried noodles with other people. Let's eat this at noon. "
"Then it's hard for the third sister, it's better to eat at home, it's comfortable and at ease."
The weather is so hot, I really don’t want to go out, it’s better to eat at home comfortably.
Xu Haiyuan brothers also hurriedly greeted Su Anzhen.
Over there, Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang came over, and the children got together, chatting and laughing, not to mention how lively it was.
Nan Zhendong helped Xu Shiyan put his luggage and other things into the back room, Xu Jinping made a pot of tea and brought it up, and the two sisters-in-law sat in the living room chatting.
Since Nan Zhendong and his wife came to the capital to manage the store last fall, the two brothers-in-law haven't seen each other again.
During the Chinese New Year, Nan Zhendong and his wife went back to the Northeast, but Xu Shiyan and his family were in Yangcheng at that time.
When Xu Shiyan and the others returned home, Nan Zhendong and his wife took their children back to the capital.
It's rare for the brother-in-law to meet, so naturally they have a lot to talk about.
Nan Zhendong had to ask about the situation at home, inquire about how his father-in-law and mother-in-law are doing, and care about Xu Chenghou and his wife.
Then ask the other brothers-in-law, especially Ji Tongzhong, if they are doing well.
Also, how is the ginseng market at home this year, how is the mallet in the field, and whether the weather is good or not.
Mainly, Nan Zhendong has been here for a short time, and he doesn't have many acquaintances.
He is not like Ji Tongzhong, he can get acquainted with everyone quickly.
So Nan Zhendong is really quite boring here. Apart from looking after the store and taking care of the business, he doesn't have many friends and buddies to chat with each other.
The unexpected brother-in-law is here, so why don't Nan Zhendong just start chattering? To rest in peace, how can he be such a broken-mouthed person.
Xu Shiyan can understand, and besides, he also has a lot to say to Nan Zhendong, so the two chatted very warmly.
While talking, Su Anying came in with a large bowl of noodles soaked in cold water.
Su Anzhen was holding a square plate with several bowls and plates on it.
Among them is a large bowl of fried sauce, and the aroma of the sauce can be smelled from a long distance.
In the other plates, there are vegetables such as shredded cucumber, shredded carrot, and blanched bean sprouts.
"It's time to eat, come and taste the noodles I made." Su Anzhen greeted everyone with a smile, and they all came to eat.
Xu Shiyan and the others took a nap on the train in the morning. It was past twelve o'clock, and Xu Haiyuan and the others were already so hungry that they howled.
As soon as he heard about the meal, Xu Haiqing was the first to rush over, and hurriedly sat at the table, staring at the sauce and noodles on the table.
Especially that bowl of golden-brown, oily, and fragrant sauce made Xu Haiqing's saliva drool.
"You don't need to eat it, just use this sauce, the noodles at noon today must be delicious."
Xu Haiqing's mouth made Su Anzhen feel elated.
Hastily brought over the empty bowl, first gave Xu Haiqing a bowl of noodles.
"Here, here you are, try San Aunt's craftsmanship." Su Anzhen put the bowl in front of Xu Haiqing with a smile.
"It's good to eat, your mother and I made a lot of noodles today, it doesn't matter if you open your mouth and eat."
As Su Anzhen spoke, she served noodles for everyone, and then told everyone how to eat the noodles.
Put the dish codes in the noodle bowl, then scoop up a spoonful of fragrant and oily sauce, and mix like this.
It tastes cold, chewy and smooth, the diced pork belly in the sauce is salty and delicious, and all kinds of vegetables are refreshing and crisp, mixed with a rich sauce.
Come to such a bowl of noodles in summer, it is definitely a good product to cool off the heat.
"Well, it has to be my third aunt's craftsmanship. It's amazing, it's so delicious."
Everyone sat down and moved their chopsticks, and Xu Haiqing took a big mouthful.
While eating, she gave Su Anzhen a thumbs up, praising Su Anzhen's cooking.
"Well, the third aunt is very good at cooking, and any food is delicious."
Over there, the three brothers and sisters Yang Haoyu and Xu Haiyuan also nodded in praise.
"Well, if it tastes good, eat more. What do you want to eat, tell the third aunt, and the third aunt will make it for you."
Su Anzhen was so coaxed that she couldn't close her mouth.
"You two, you only know how to eat, and you don't have a good word.
I cook for you all day long, and I haven't seen you boasting. Why don't you know how to learn more from your cousin? "
Su Anzhen turned her head and saw her two sons eating noodles in silence.
Su Anzhen became angry all of a sudden, and when she caught her son, she punished her.
Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang were dumbfounded. Didn't they say to talk less while eating?
The two of them ate honestly and didn't say a word of nonsense. Why is my mother so angry? Who are they provoking?
"Look at you, what are you doing?
Xiaoming and Xiaoliang are used to eating your cooking all day long, so you can’t praise them every day, right? "
Nan Zhendong saw it, and hurriedly rescued his son.
"You two too, you just know how to eat. Your mother has been busy all afternoon, so you two should talk to each other anyway."
It's not easy for a man. He has to protect the child and also take into account the feelings of his wife. Once the balance is not grasped, the wife will be fried.
Anyway, Su Anzhen didn't fry the pot today, but just gave her son a double stare.
"I can see that, serving you all day long is not a good thing."
Nan Xiaoming quickly put some vegetables in the mother's bowl, and added some sauce.
"Mom, the main reason is that the noodles are so delicious, we both patronized to eat, and we didn't have time to talk about it."
At any rate, this baby is not stupid, so he reacted quickly, so he quickly coaxed her.
Nan Xiaoliang's reaction was a bit slow over there, and at this moment, he also recalled it.
"Yes, yes, the noodles are delicious, mom has worked hard."
Husband and son coaxed her. It would be embarrassing for Su Anzhen to get angry again, so she pursed her lips and nodded.
"Okay, eat quickly, take a break after eating, don't go out to play when the weather is too hot.
Waiting for the evening to cool down a bit, you two take your cousins ​​and the others to play around for a while. "
"Not to mention, you guys came this year at a good time.
I heard people say that the temperature in June of previous years is quite high, sometimes 35-6 degrees or higher.
Up to now, the temperature has not reached the highest level yet. The local old people say that the weather this year is considered comfortable. "
Su Anzhen chatted with Su Anying while eating.
"Tomorrow morning, you and your brother-in-law will take the children to the square to see the national flag being raised, and then go to the Forbidden City in the morning.
Don’t care if you can finish shopping, just come back at noon.
It’s good to take a nap at home in the afternoon, and go out for a walk in the evening.
Anyway, just go out early in the morning and late at night, don't rush outside at noon. "
After all, Su Anzhen has lived here for more than half a year, so she knows a little about the climate of the capital, so she gives advice to Su Anying and the others.
It’s rare to come back to the capital. Among other things, raising the national flag, visiting the Forbidden City, and climbing the Great Wall are a must.
"Well, fine, I'll listen to you." The younger sister's kindness, Su Anying naturally appreciates it.
The family chatted and laughed and finished their meal, Su Anzhen was worried about the store, so she wanted to go back and have a look.
Once Xu Shiyan and his wife thought about it, they should go and have a look.
So I kept the children at home, told them not to run around everywhere, and took a rest at home, and waited until the evening when the heat was not so hot before going out.
Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang also stayed here, and the children either watched TV in the house, or went to play in the shade of the yard.
This yard is small, and there are not many trees planted in the yard.
What children can play is to draw grids on the ground, or play yo, or catch tiles and so on.
Xu Haiyuan didn't like this kind of activities, but Xu Haiqing and Nan's two brothers had a good time.
The shop in Zhencaotang is located on the outskirts of the DC area. In terms of geographical location, it is not as good as Xu's small courtyard.
Of course, for Xu Shiyan, being able to manage several properties within the second ring road of the capital is already very satisfying.
If this is put aside for thirty years, it may not be possible to buy it no matter how much money is spent.
Xu Shiyan and his wife stayed at the shop for a long time.
It's summer, I thought that many people would not like to come out, I guess the business of the shop is mediocre.
Unexpectedly, the shop made a lot of money in one afternoon.
Of course, Jishengyuan’s health care products account for the majority, and other Northeast specialties are less.
Jishengyuan's health products are now well-known all over the country and have won unanimous approval from consumers.
The sales of health care products in summer are not as hot as in winter, even so, the turnover of the store is not low.
Nan Zhendong and his wife are in the capital. The store here is not small, and it also has a warehouse. There is enough space.
So the agent of Jishengyuan health care products in the capital area is naturally Nan Zhendong and his wife.
On this item alone, Nan Zhendong and his wife earned hundreds of thousands last year, not to mention the profit sharing of other goods in the store.
These two couples can buy a house so quickly, settle down in the capital, transfer schools for the two children and settle down, can they do it without money?
"Brother-in-law, if I say too much gratitude, it will be too empty.
No matter what happens in the future, as long as my brother-in-law asks, even if our husband and wife go through fire and water, we have to let my brother-in-law do it. "
Nan Zhendong is not as eloquent as Ji Tongzhong. It is very rare for him to be able to say these words, and they definitely come from the heart.
"It's not necessary to go through fire and water.
If you two know anyone, please help me find out, is there anyone selling houses in this east and west city?
I plan to buy another house in the capital, preferably a bigger courtyard house. "Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it.
Now is the age of peace, so why not go through fire and water?
"Buying a house? Oh, it's easy. Brother-in-law, do you know what's most popular in the capital now?"
Over there, Su Anzhen was overjoyed when she heard it, and deliberately asked Xu Shiyan to guess the question.
"What's popular? I don't live here, so I don't know."
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, he stayed in the Northeast all day long, how could he know what was popular in the capital?
"Second sister and second brother-in-law, the most popular thing in the capital now is to go abroad.
It’s not the kind of government-sponsored going abroad, or you can find a way to go abroad by yourself.
Think about it, how expensive is it to go abroad at your own expense? Can ordinary people get the money?
Many people in the capital are planning to sell their house and go abroad with the money to earn money. "
Su Anzhen shook her head while talking, she didn't really understand those people.
It is so good abroad, so the moon in foreign countries is rounder than domestic ones? Going outside can make a lot of money and get ahead? I don't understand.
"Didn't we buy a house at the beginning of spring? Not to mention, I really inquired a lot and knew a lot of middlemen.
Zhendong, the second brother-in-law may not live here for a few days.
How about you take the second sister and the second brother-in-law to go around and find someone you know to inquire about.
If there is a suitable one, and both of them happen to be here, they will buy the house after looking at it. "
Su Anzhen was quick to handle things and never dragged her feet, so she immediately told her husband to ask Nan Zhendong to lead Xu Shiyan and the others to find those middlemen.
"Okay, then let's go." Nan Zhendong just told him to do whatever he wanted, so naturally he didn't refuse now.
So he drove Xu Shiyan and Su Anying out, and found the middleman who bought the house before him to help him, and asked if there were any houses for sale in Dongxi City.
"In a place as big as the capital, there are plenty of houses, and there must be houses like the one you mentioned.
But the price is hard to say, it is too expensive. "
Nan Zhendong took Xu Shiyan and his wife to find a man named Jin Liu.
After hearing Xu Shiyan's request, Jin Liu said so.
The courtyard house that Xu Shiyan wants to buy is definitely not the kind where more than a dozen households live in one courtyard.
It is a single-family house, and it is slightly larger. This kind of house is hard to find, and the price will definitely not be low.
"How much can it cost? I heard Mr. Jin mean that there should be such a house.
You might as well tell me about the price. I heard that if you think there is room for accounting, then let’s go and have a look. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, no matter how expensive the house is today, how expensive can it be? With the net worth of the couple, they can't afford it.
"Well, according to the request Mr. Xu said, there is really a suitable place.
In Dongcheng, the three courtyards are very neat.
The original owner was a nice family in the past, but there was a lot of trouble in those years, so the house belonged to the government, and later returned to his children and grandchildren.
The eldest grandson of his family is anxious to go abroad recently, so he plans to sell the house passed down from his ancestors and go abroad with the money.
So, his asking price for this house is not low, calling for 200,000 yuan. "
Jin Liu looked at Xu Shiyan. The person in front of him seemed to be a worker, and he didn't look like someone who could spend 200,000 yuan.
"Huh? Two hundred thousand? Is it too much?" Nan Zhendong exclaimed when he heard it.
The small courtyard that his family bought at the beginning of spring cost only tens of thousands of dollars.
Nowadays, most people are rushing to build buildings. The bungalows in this alley are not very valuable in the eyes of ordinary people.
A set of yards costs 200,000 yuan, which is definitely a lion's mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 773: it doesn't work that way
chapters.content:
Chapter 773 No way of doing things
The price of 200,000 yuan not only frightened Nan Zhendong, but to be honest, even Xu Shiyan trembled.
Siheyuan in the capital is extremely valuable. A set of courtyards can sell for tens of millions or even hundreds of millions. When did this news come out?
Probably after a certain Ms. Wendi divorced that media tycoon and got a courtyard house in the capital.
There was a lot of trouble at the time, and various media clamored for analysis.
Not only outsiders know that co-authored courtyard houses in the capital are so valuable.
Even some local people in the capital realized at that time that this courtyard house was worth so much money.
Of course, that courtyard is no ordinary courtyard.
It is in front of the Forbidden City, with a second floor and a yard with an underground parking lot.
From there, it popped up from time to time, how much and how much a house in a certain alley in the capital cost.
There will still be people on the Internet who don’t know if it’s true or a joke.
It is said that in the early 1990s, someone sold his courtyard house for 200,000 yuan, and then took the money to go abroad to work hard.
When he returned to China twenty years later with tens of millions of assets, he found that the house he sold was worth tens of millions.
It is the various publicity of the media that makes people realize the value of courtyard houses in the capital.
Even Xu Shiyan, an old farmer who doesn't know anything, has such an impression.
Now that Xu Shiyan wants to buy a house, he must leave it for his children.
The couple of them have money in their hands, and seeing that the money is getting worse and worse, they must invest something.
Convert the money into fixed assets and leave it to the children in the future.
If you want to leave it to your children, it is best to keep it forever and not be demolished.
If it is demolition, it is not worthwhile.
But Xu Shiyan has been to Changchun the farthest in his previous life. He has never been to the capital. Does he know where it will be demolished in the future? Where will not be dismantled?
Come to buy a house, that is to say, take a risk and try your luck.
Xu Shiyan probably has such a frame in his heart, along the old city wall of the capital, if there is a suitable one inside, he can probably buy it.
The ones that go outside, forget it, and they will be demolished after a few years if they are not in order.
It is not cost-effective to demolish houses in the city. It seems that not only the area is considered, but also the population.
Haven’t you heard of that before? Knowing that the family is about to be demolished, I hurriedly got married and got a daughter-in-law and came back, and the more people I lived, the more houses I got.
The Xu family doesn't live here, so it would be too embarrassing to catch up with the demolition.
Of course, the frame Xu Shiyan drew in his mind is just his own guess.
He doesn't know exactly where to dismantle and where not to dismantle.
If it costs tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands, it will be demolished in the future, and I don’t think it’s a pity, as long as you can get back your money, don’t lose money.
But if it costs 200,000 yuan to buy it, and then it will be demolished in three to five years, it is definitely not worthwhile.
So when Jin Liu said that the house cost 200,000 yuan, Xu Shiyan felt a little nervous.
"Mr. Jin, is there anything else?"
"There are others, but they are not as good as this one. The house is really well cleaned up, everything is as good as new."
Jin Liu's eyes flashed, and he muttered.
Actually, there are many houses for sale at this time, but the asking price is high, and Jin Liu can get a lot of benefits in it.
"Daughter-in-law, why don't we go and have a look?"
Jin Liu’s words touched Xu Shiyan quite a lot. He bought the house because he wanted to keep it, so the newer and more complete the house must be, the better.
If the price is expensive, it will be expensive. After reading it over there, I will calculate it.
This stuff, ask for a lot of money and pay back the money on the spot, and you can’t say that he will give you as much as you want.
"Let's take a look, the house is not cake and bread, we can't break a piece and go home after watching it, what are we afraid of?"
Su Anying nodded, "Look, don't you have to look more when buying a house?"
"If you really like it, then buy it, anyway, you have the final say."
Su Anying came out with Xu Shiyan, it was purely for watching, and Xu Shiyan was in charge of everything.
Xu Shiyan said to go and see, she followed, Xu Shiyan said to buy, and she found a way to withdraw money to pay, it's as simple as that.
The couple agree that since they want to buy a house, it is necessary to visit more.
Jin Liuyi heard the tone of the couple, as if he could really afford it.
Besides, he is familiar with Nan Zhendong, Jin Liu knows what Nan Zhendong is doing.
It is definitely not an ordinary person who can make Nan Zhendong abandon his business and accompany him to find a house. Maybe, people can really afford it.
Just like that, Nan Zhendong drove, Jin Liu led the way, and the group went straight to the house Jin Liu mentioned.
Looking over there, the house is really good, with three courtyards and a standard courtyard layout, the place is very spacious and very orderly.
The owner of the house looked to be only twenty-seven or eight years old, with a look of arrogance on his face. Seeing Jin Liu leading Xu Shiyan and his party to see the house, he talked about their ancestors.
Why their ancestors were imperial merchants, and there were a few officials who were officials, how awesome was his great-grandfather, and his grandfather was also very powerful back then, etc.
Xu Shiyan was listening on the opposite side, humming coldly in his heart.
I thought to myself that your ancestors were so awesome, how did you end up selling your house?
Your ancestors are underground. If you know that you are an unworthy descendant, you plan to sell the house passed down by your ancestors and go abroad after going through the formalities.
I wonder if they can crawl out of the ground and strangle you?
"I have almost completed the formalities here, and I just sold the house and went abroad.
Let me tell you, you won’t lose money if you buy this house.
Our family had a feng shui master to show it to us. In this yard, the layout of each house, brick by brick, was all guided by an expert.
To live in this house, one must have good luck and rise up step by step. "The young man was eloquent, boasting about his house.
"How much do you want to sell this house for?"
Xu Shiyan was impatient to listen to his vernacular, so he interrupted the other party.
The young man surnamed Guan was stunned for a moment, and glanced at Jin Liu.
"Jin Liuye, you didn't tell him that my house is 200,000 yuan?"
"I said it, I said it." Jin Liu smiled and nodded.
"That's it, my house is priced at 200,000 yuan, no bargaining. Buy it if you can afford it, and forget it if you can't afford it."
The young man surnamed Guan squinted at Xu Shiyan and his wife. No matter how you look at it, these two people don't seem to be able to spend 200,000 yuan.
Outsiders, old hats, are you here to pick up a bargain?
"I'm not that big courtyard. I'm a serious single family. The location is good. I can't sell it without 200,000 yuan."
The young man was proud, with his arms folded in his hands, his nostrils facing the sky, and he snorted.
"Mr. Jin, if this is the case, there is really no need to talk about it.
Business, what is important is that there is a selling price and a buying price, and there is a coming and going.
Mr. Guan came up with a price of 200,000 yuan, and no one was allowed to negotiate the price. No matter how good the house is, I can't take it. "
Xu Shiyan cupped his hands at Jin Liugong, "I'm bothering Mr. Jin, I asked you to follow Bai for a while, sorry."
Jin Liu also got a little angry at this time, "Xiaoguan, you are not honest in doing things like this.
When you asked me to help sell the house, you didn't say a buyout price of 200,000 yuan.
You wanted to say that at the time, but I couldn’t lead people all the way to look at the house. "
As Xu Shiyan said, this is not how business is done.
If the house surnamed Guan is not sold for less than 200,000 yuan, it should be called 210,000 or 220,000 yuan at that time, leaving room for bargaining.
People probably knew the price as soon as they heard the price. This is for 200,000 yuan.
But at the beginning, the surname Guan told Jin Liu 200,000. Generally speaking, the figure of 200,000 must be broken.
Basically, the transaction price should be around 170,000 to 100,000 to 190,000, depending on whether the buyer is really optimistic about the house.
But like the one with the surname Guan, there is really no such thing as a direct price without bargaining.
Jin Liu is a well-known middleman in Dongcheng, and those who are familiar with him will respectfully call him Jin Liuye.
This person is not ordinary, he knows things about Sijiucheng.
And he is not only a middleman for house sales, but anyone who has a business of buying and selling can find him.
The middleman is responsible for communicating between the buyer and the seller, and earns the same amount of money.
If the transaction is successful, he will get benefits from both sides, but if the transaction fails, then he will get nothing.
A young man surnamed Guan came with a price of 200,000 yuan. When Xu Shiyan heard this, he simply shook his hand and left without buying.
Jin Liu took a look at it, and he co-authored his trip today for nothing, and he couldn't get anything.
I was not very happy at the moment, and I was not very polite when I spoke to the young man surnamed Guan.
The young man surnamed Guan saw that Jin Liu was angry, and hurriedly dragged him aside.
"Jin Liuye, let me tell you the truth, now that the cost of going abroad has risen again, I can't help it.
I just pointed at this house, and I don't have any extra money. "
Don't look at how capable he is bragging in front of Xu Shiyan, but he can't brag like that in front of Jin Liu.
Jin Liu shook his head, "You, why don't you stay in the capital and do something, why do you have to go abroad?
Besides, if you want to increase the price, tell me in advance, I know it well, I let you do this, alas. "
"I don't think they are people who can afford it. I don't know where they come from."
The surname Guan looked at Xu Shiyan and the others, and snorted disdainfully.
"You are still young.
A person cannot be judged by his appearance, and sea water cannot be measured. Don’t you know this?
I don’t know about other things. Do you know who the **** guy next to him is?
Now the hottest Naji Shengyuan health care product, he is the general agent of our capital area.
Don’t you know how popular Ji Shengyuan is now? How much money do you have to earn that month? "
Jin Liu sighed, this kid really has bad eyesight and brain.
An ordinary person, can he get it here? It's a waste of time in this hot weather, what if he is free?
"Hey, Liu Ye, look at my poor eyesight. Otherwise, Liu Ye will help you make peace?"
When the young man surnamed Guan heard this, he regretted it, so he quickly put on a smile and asked Jin Liu to make peace again.
After all, these days, there are really not many people who can afford a house worth 200,000 yuan.
Jin Liu shook his head and sighed, but he had no choice but to walk back to Xu Shiyan and the others.
"Mr. Xu, I just talked to Guan Xiaozi, and he is willing to talk again."
Xu Shiyan shook his head, "Mr. Jin, it's not that I didn't give you face, but he didn't behave properly in today's matter.
Everything he said just now, for the sake of your Mr. Jin's face, I can discuss it with him. Now, let's not talk about it. "
Xu Shiyan could see clearly the eyes of that Guan just now, he didn't think highly of them at all.
Since this is the case, regardless of whether the house sells for 200,000 or 150,000, Xu Shiyan is not going to talk about it.
At the very least, you have to respect each other when doing business. People have made it clear that they look down on him and take him for a fool.
It's not that Xu Shiyan has money and can't spend it, why does he have to buy this house?
The capital is so big, there is no other place besides his house?
"It's really embarrassing for Mr. Labor Jin to run on a hot day.
How about I treat Mr. Jin to dinner, how about we have a good chat? "
Xu Shiyan raised his hand to see that it was four o'clock, and there was still some time before dinner.
At this time, go to a restaurant, sit down and chat while waiting for the food, anyway.
Since you want to buy a house in the capital, a middleman like Jin Liu who is familiar with the local conditions still needs to maintain it.
Otherwise, Xu Shiyan has just arrived, his eyes are darkened, where is he going to find a house?
Besides, he didn't buy one set this time, if he could, he would at least buy three more sets.
What about the four children in the family, so why can't each of them have a set? Parents can't be partial, can they?
Don’t care about whether the children will not be successful in the future, whether they are relying on their parents to live their lives, but they are parents, and they must do their best.
If you want to buy so many houses, you really can't do without a middleman, so you have to build a good relationship with Jin Liu.
No way, Xu Shiyan is not a local.
"Hey, don't, don't, how can I do it? If the matter is not done, I don't have the face to ask Mr. Xu to treat me to dinner."
Jin Liu hurriedly waved his hands. There are rules in every line of work. If the business fails, he is embarrassed to take advantage of others.
"It's okay, there is no righteousness in buying and selling, don't care whether the house is bought or not, we are all friends."
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it. People from Northeast China do this everywhere they go, making friends.
Don’t care if it’s the first time we meet, whether you’re familiar or not, after a meal and a drink, isn’t it already familiar?
"Lao Jin, let's go, let's go, we are all real people, and we won't play with you with those vain things.
My brother-in-law sincerely treats you to dinner, let's go, let's find a restaurant to sit down and chat. "
Nan Zhendong also spoke at this time, and dragged Jin Liu out of the courtyard of the Guan family.
The young man surnamed Guan over there was still waiting for Jin Liu to make peace. Seeing that Jin Liu followed Xu Shiyan and the others out, the young man hurried out to follow.
"Mr. Xu, right? If you really like this house, we can talk about it."
He saw that he was really going to leave, so he was in a hurry.
This house has been calling for takeout since the Chinese New Year, and it hasn't been sold yet. Can he not be in a hurry?
Just now, I just saw that Xu Shiyan and the others were from other places, and they didn't like him, so I wanted to pretend for a while.
But who would have imagined it? If you pretend to be big, you will walk away.
Xu Shiyan looked back at the young man surnamed Guan, and smiled.
"No need, I'm afraid I can't afford Mr. Guan's house.
It’s the best. If you find a foreigner to buy it, they can pay you directly with US dollars, and save you from having to change the US dollars yourself. How convenient it is. "
Xu Shiyan's words were actually satirizing the other party.
Since he wants to sell the house and go abroad, he might as well sell the house to a foreigner. It is estimated that the coffin of his ancestors will really be overwhelmed.
The young man surnamed Guan didn't recognize it, but his eyes lit up, "Huh? That's right, why didn't I think of it."
Being so happy, he doesn't care whether Xu Shiyan buys a house or not.
Jin Liu shook his head, "Hey, these people all followed like demons, foreign countries are so good?"
I don’t understand, I really don’t understand.
“In the eyes of some people, the moons in foreign countries are rounder than domestic ones.
This kind of person, let him go out and suffer a little, and you will know what's going on. " Xu Shiyan snorted.
I dare not say anything else. Those who sold their houses and ran away will definitely have regrets in the future.
"Zhendong, do you know where a good restaurant is?
Let's find a place quickly, sit down with Mr. Jin and rest for a while, and we can talk after we have something to eat and drink. "Xu Shiyan turned his head and asked Nan Zhendong.
If you want to invite Jin Liu to dinner, it's not easy to ask Jin Liu where he is going.
Xu Shiyan is not familiar with this place, so he can only ask Nan Zhendong. After all, he has been here for so long, and he should know about the same.
"Don't, don't, Mr. Xu, you don't get paid for nothing. If I go to dinner with you like this, I will feel very sorry.
In this way, I also know many places where houses are sold out.
Although it’s not as good as Guan’s, the price is not that expensive, so I’ll take you there. "
Jin Liu also saw that Xu Shiyan really wanted to buy a house, and he was not short of money.
Jin Liu knows that there are too many houses to go, and the Guan family's house is not for sale, and there are other people's houses.
Don't care about whose house, as long as the work is done, Jin Liu can earn benefits from it. If he has money to earn, who can push it out?

chapters.title: Chapter 774: , Xu Haiyuan is going to see the house
chapters.content:
Xu Shiyan wanted to invite Jin Liu to dinner, but Jin Liu felt that he hadn't done anything for him, so he was embarrassed to have this meal.
So he took Xu Shiyan and the three of them to look at several houses from east to west.
There is a small courtyard with two entrances, which is similar to the current one of the Xu family.
There is also a house with three entrances, which is quite similar to that of the Guan family.
There is also a courtyard with four entrances, five main rooms and side rooms, covering a very large and spacious area.
However, these houses also have their own shortcomings, some of which are in average locations, and some of which are slightly older.
Especially the four-entry courtyard, which is a little dilapidated. If it is obtained, it is estimated that it will cost a lot of money to repair it.
Of course, this house is old, and the price is also low. The owner’s main price is only a few hundred thousand, which is much cheaper than the Guan family’s house.
Xu Shiyan and his wife have seen so many, and they are a bit dazzled. They don't know which one to choose.
The main reason is that Xu Shiyan has scruples in his heart, and he is worried that he will have to dismantle it after two years after buying it.
As for demolition, the sooner the demolition, the less cost-effective it is. In the early days, it was calculated according to the population, or even the original household registration.
None of them have registered permanent residence in the capital, so it would definitely not be cost-effective to demolish them in the past few years.
Besides, they bought it and didn't rush to dismantle it. It's better to keep it.
"Mr. Jin, that's it, we saw this today, it's getting late, let's find a place to eat first.
Looking back, our family has a good discussion. Tomorrow afternoon, let's go to see the house and discuss the price. What do you think? "
With such a delay, it will be six o'clock.
Xu Shiyan, can he let others continue to lead them to look around the house? Find a place to eat quickly.
Jin Liu saw that Xu Shiyan sincerely wanted to invite him to dinner, so it was hard to refuse.
Xu Shiyan didn't know where to eat in this capital, so he remembered those places that are more famous in later generations.
It is estimated that at this time, it will not become a place for bluffing like in later generations.
Taking advantage of the opportunity, I happened to bring my family over to have a meal, and it was not a waste of a visit to the capital.
Jin Liu laughed when he heard what Xu Shiyan said.
"No, no, Mr. Xu doesn't need to be too troublesome, just find a restaurant nearby."
As he spoke, he pointed forward casually, "There is a restaurant not far ahead, and the food there is quite authentic."
Jin Liu said so, Xu Shiyan couldn't insist anymore, so everyone went to the place Jin Liu pointed out.
This restaurant is neither big nor small, and the inside is quite clean. It is a restaurant, and there are many customers in the restaurant.
Jin Liu should be quite familiar with the owner of the store. After entering the door and greeting him, the other party arranged a good seat for them to sit down.
"Brother-in-law, this place is not far from our house.
It’s about this time, do you want to pick up the children, or order food for them to send back.
Anzhen didn't get off work until after eight in the evening, and no one went back to cook for the children. "
As soon as he sat down, before ordering food, Nan Zhendong asked.
"Then take it, talk to the shop owner later, and leave us a table, then let the children eat alone at the table."
Xu Shiyan took a look, this is a little bit, and it is true, I don’t know what those children are doing at home.
If they were at home, the two daughters would have to cook.
Now in other places, the children don’t even know where the vegetable market is, so it’s hard to arrange dinner.
He just took it, and it's easy to eat together.
"Okay, then I'll go back and pick up the kids."
Nan Zhendong nodded towards Jin Liu, "Old Jin, that, I'll go back to pick up the kids first, let's have a few drinks later."
After speaking, Nan Zhendong hurried out and drove home to pick up the children.
He doesn't drive a car, but a van, which is convenient for carrying goods.
It’s just right, there are seven children in the family, and they can sit and drive.
This side belongs to the West City, and it is quite close to the small courtyard of Xu's family. Nan Zhendong took all seven children here by driving back and forth in less than half an hour.
When the children arrived, the dishes started to be served one after another.
Su Anying saw the children coming, so she moved to the children's table.
She doesn't drink, so it would be more convenient for Xu Shiyan, Nan Zhendong, and Jin Liu to sit at the same table.
When the food was ready, Xu Shiyan poured wine for Jin Liu, and the three people over there pushed and changed glasses, chatting while drinking, mostly talking about the house.
Jin Liu helped analyze the advantages and disadvantages of each of the houses I saw today.
"Mom, you and my dad still want to buy a house in the capital?"
Xu Haiyuan listened twice, and probably understood that he and his parents planned to buy a few more houses.
"Well, your dad said, after all, this is the capital, a big city, and the house will definitely be worth a lot in the future.
What he meant was to buy a few more sets and leave one set for each of you.
In the future, if you can be admitted to a university in the capital and come to study and work, it will be more convenient for us to have a house of our own. "
Su Anying nodded, and told her husband's rhetoric to her children.
"Oh, that would be fine."
Xu Haiyuan nodded, thinking that his father is pretty reliable, he has a good eye and knows how to buy a house in the capital.
"Mom, what houses have you all looked at? Tell me about it?" Xu Haiyuan asked tentatively.
There is nothing to hide, so Su Anying told her son the details of the houses they looked at this afternoon.
Xu Haiyuan is fourteen years old this year. Anyway, Xu Shiyan and his wife never treated him as a child.
He never avoids important family matters, and sometimes he even asks his elder son for advice.
Xu Haiyuan listened patiently to his mother's narration, pondered for a moment, and then spoke.
"Mom, the house was bought for the four of us, right? Can I choose?"
Su Anying froze for a moment, then laughed.
"Are you interested in buying a house again?
It’s okay, then when we go to see the house tomorrow, you will follow? "
Xu Haiyuan is the eldest son of Xu, and Xu Shiyan and his wife also have high hopes for their eldest son.
