Judging from the current situation, everything in the Xu family will probably have to be handed over to the eldest son in the future, and the other three seem to be enough.
Since you have to turn over shifts sooner or later, it is better to exercise earlier.
Waiting for Xu Haiyuan to graduate from university, the couple can let go and enjoy the happiness.
"Well, okay, then I'll go and have a look with you tomorrow." Xu Haiyuan nodded seriously.
Buying a house in the capital is a big deal. The knowledge here is getting bigger, so it’s better to look at it yourself and rest assured.
The mother and son were talking about buying a house while eating, but Xu Haiqing and the others on the other side didn’t seem to hear it. They didn’t care about what they should eat or drink.
Su Anying and the others don't drink alcohol, and there are many children, so of course they eat quickly.
Half an hour later, the children were full and sat lazily on their chairs.
Seeing this, Su Anying went to talk to Xu Shiyan, and she took the children home first.
"Do you know how to go back? Don't go astray." Xu Shiyan asked uneasy.
"I know, Xiaoming and Xiaoliang know the way.
Besides, there is still a mouth under the nose, and I can’t find it. Can’t I ask someone about it?
I still remember where my home is. "
Su Anying smiled, and just led the children out of the restaurant, walking all the way back.
The children looked around on the road, and they were surprised by everything they saw.
Thanks to Xu Haiyuan being in charge, Xu Haiqing was crazy and ran around.
With Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang leading the way, the group finally returned to Xu's small courtyard smoothly.
Nan Zhendong's house is not too far from Xu's courtyard.
But Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang refused to go back to sleep at home. They had to stay here and live with Xu Haiqing and the others.
Fortunately, after Su Anying came over, she went to buy a lot of bedding, luggage and other things, which was enough.
So, Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang followed Xu Haiqing to live in the south room of the east wing, and Xu Haiyuan and Yang Haoyu lived in the north room of the east wing.
As for sister Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui, she lives in the main house with her parents.
Girls and children, they are timid, and their parents are worried, so they must live nearby and take care of them.
Because he made an appointment to go to the square to watch the national flag raising the next day, so Xu Shiyan came back without drinking too late.
Early in the morning on the 15th, it was still dark outside, and the children were dug out from the bed by Su Anying.
After a little freshening up and tidying up, the whole family headed towards Tiananmen Square.
Thanks to the good location of Xu's courtyard, it's not too far away.
The children walked without any fear at all, jogging and jogging all the way, and they arrived at the place without feeling anything.
There were a lot of people watching the flag raising in the morning. Xu Shiyan's family followed in the footsteps of the crowd, came to the square, found a suitable place, and waited for the flag raising.
"Wow, this place is so big, there are so many people."
Xu Haiqing felt that his eyes were not good enough, and he felt so novel when he looked at everything around him.
"Big Brother, Second Sister, is that Tiananmen Square to the east? Wow, I saw Tiananmen Square."
Xu Jinhui looked at the buildings in the distance with excitement.
However, this little girl doesn't have a good sense of direction, and now she has turned a little bit, and she doesn't know where Tiananmen Square is.
Xu Haiqing covered his face helplessly, "Fourth sister, that's north.
Even if I haven’t been to the capital, I know that Tiananmen Square faces south. This is your first time in a big city. Have you turned around? "
It may be innate. Generally speaking, girls have a poorer sense of direction than boys.
Although Xu Haiqing doesn’t have much of a regular life, he has an excellent sense of direction. He can tell the direction even when he is in a strange place, and he can remember the road after walking it once.
Xu Jinhui couldn't do it anymore. When she was walking back last night, she was a little confused and didn't know where to go.
"Oh, yes, why did I forget. I just looked at Xiangdong over there."
Xu Jinhui smiled embarrassedly, and told her instinctively that it was Dong over there, who knew it was wrong.
While the children were talking, the flag raiser had already walked over holding the bright five-star red flag, and the scene was instantly silent.
Facing the rising sun, accompanied by the majestic and majestic national anthem, the five-star red flag rose slowly under the attention of everyone.
Everyone raised their heads and stared at the red flag. Their eyes followed the rise of the red flag, and they sang the national anthem unconsciously.
The children all looked solemn and serious, with firm eyes.
Even Xu Haiqing, who was joking and not serious on weekdays, seemed to have been completely reborn at this moment, and his whole person was different.
Watching the national flag raising in Tiananmen Square, and raising the national flag with children at school are definitely two different experiences.
The spiritual shock is more direct and the feeling is deeper.
So, when the flag-raising ceremony was over, Xu Shiyan felt that the eyes of the children seemed to have a different feeling.
After watching the flag raising, I led the children to find a place to have breakfast nearby.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan took the children to walk around here and take a few more photos.
Wait until the Forbidden City starts selling tickets, just buy a ticket to visit.
Although it is only the early 1990s, the tourism industry may not have risen in other places, but there are indeed a lot of tourists in the capital.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying took seven children and walked in with the crowd, and told the children not to run around, but to follow the adults closely.
There are majestic and majestic halls in front of you, solemn and solemn. It is the first time for the children to see this kind of building, and they seem to be a little cautious while being novel.
"Second sister, is this the place where the emperor used to live?"
Yang Haoyu followed closely beside Xu Jinping, dragging Xu Jinping, for fear that his second sister would be squeezed out.
Arriving at the Forbidden City, Xu Jinping came to her senses and began to tell her brothers and sisters about the three halls of the Forbidden City, the East and West Six Palaces, and some stories about the emperors of the Ming and Qing Dynasties.
At the beginning, the Xu family members were listening.
Going to the back, maybe the tourists who came in together, after hearing what the little girl said, they all followed, listening as they walked.
Many people around listened to Xu Jinping's explanation with their ears pricked up. Xu Jinping was not stage-frightened, and talked about it wherever she went.
Xu Shiyan followed behind, shaking his head as he walked.
Some people may have such a talent.
In her previous life, the eldest daughter went to take the test for a tour guide certificate to become a tour guide in order to make a living. She led a group all day long and talked about it wherever she went.
I didn't expect that I would have this potential in my teens in this life.
I have to say that the two elders in the family have a wide range of knowledge.
To be honest, Xu Shiyan didn't understand most of what the eldest daughter said, and he didn't know where the child saw it.
People can not only remember it after seeing it, but also tell it, which is quite convincing.
Xu Jinping walked and talked, and Xu Shiyan took a camera and took pictures of his wife and children.
After taking a few photos, Xu Haiyuan took the camera over.
"Dad, you stand with my mother, come, I will take a picture for you two."
The son kindly wanted to take pictures of his parents, Xu Shiyan, why not hurry?
So he gave the camera to his son, and the couple found the scenery they liked, or Xu Shiyan hugged Su Anying's shoulder, or Su Anying held Xu Shiyan's arm, and the two took several photos together.
After that, Xu Shiyan never touched the camera again, and Xu Haiyuan took pictures of everyone throughout the whole process.
The Forbidden City is too big, even if it is only partially open now, Xu Shiyan and the others can't go shopping much in the morning, they just took a look at some of the main palaces.
Even so, by noon, everyone was very tired.
Coming out of the Forbidden City, everyone was tired and hungry.
At this time, don’t think about going home to cook and eat. It’s serious to find a place to eat and fill your stomach quickly.
Originally Xu Shiyan wanted to take the children to eat roast duck, but at this time, everyone was so hungry that their eyes turned green.
If you have to wait for a seat there, how can the children bear it?
Anyway, they will stay in the capital for a few more days, so they can eat at any time.
Just like that, the group casually inquired about a nearby place to eat, and went straight there.
Finally found a restaurant with few people, so I quickly ordered food.
After lunch, the couple sent the children back to the small courtyard to rest, and then they planned to go to Jin Liu again and continue to look at the house.
"Dad, I'll go with you, I told my mother last night." Xu Haiyuan said hastily.
Xu Shiyan fell asleep when he came back last night, and Su Anying didn't have time to mention it to him.
Woke up early this morning, watching the flag raising, and visiting the Forbidden City, Su Anying forgot about this.
When Xu Haiyuan mentioned it, Su Anying suddenly remembered. Yes, I promised my son last night.
"Yes, yes, yesterday my son told me that he would accompany us to see the house."
Xu Shiyan glanced at Da'er, "Okay, if you're not tired, then come together."

chapters.title: Chapter 775: Four yards
chapters.content:
Nan Zhendong is busy, and Xu Shiyan can't always let him accompany him to watch the house.
So he drove the car by himself, took Jin Liu and Su Anying's mother and son, and looked at houses in various places in the east and west cities.
This time, with Xu Haiyuan by his side, the process of looking at the house became easier.
Some rooms, Xu Haiyuan just shook his head when he took a look.
Xu Shiyan couldn't figure out the reason, but he respected the child's wishes.
Since Xu Haiyuan feels bad, then don't do it, what's the big deal?
In the end, Xu Haiyuan took a fancy to three or four houses, including the courtyard that Xu Shiyan had seen before.
"Mr. Xu, Mr. Ling is amazing, it's nothing to say that he chose these yards.
Even if I were asked to pick, I might not be able to pick so well. "
In the evening, after seeing most of the courtyards, Xu Haiyuan told Jin Liu about the place he had chosen.
After listening to Jin Liuyi, he gave Xu Haiyuan a thumbs up, which was repeated praise.
"Look, the places selected by Mr. Ling are either inside the old imperial city, or the inner city outside the old imperial city.
Around here, Beihai Park and Jingshan Park are not too far from the Forbidden City. The scenery is good and the location is good.
This house is well chosen, with a good eye. "
Jin Liu couldn't help but look at Xu Haiyuan a few more times. This kid is not very old, but he is stable enough.
And the memory is not bad, he said those place names once, and the child remembered them all.
Such a smart child is rare.
Xu Shiyan was also proud when he heard Jin Liu praise Xu Haiyuan.
"Children, I guess, he is mainly greedy for fun.
As you said, there are quite a lot of parks here, and it’s not too far from the Forbidden City. It’s for the convenience of future visits. "
To be honest, Xu Shiyan really doesn't know what's good and what's not. In his opinion, any courtyard in the capital is good.
But if the eldest son is elected, the father must support it.
"That's it, please trouble Jin Liuye to tell the owners of these places, and I will come over tomorrow morning to discuss in detail.
I can buy as many as I can negotiate, and it would be best if all of them can be negotiated, so I will buy them all. "
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying planned it when they were at home. This time they came to the capital mainly to buy a house.
So when they left home, they brought some money with them.
The fourth set of renminbi has been issued for several years. After the 100-yuan bill came out, carrying cash is not as troublesome as it used to be.
But Su Anying bought a house in Shanghai and spent a lot of money, so the part she brought didn't have much left.
What Xu Shiyan brought is not enough to pay for the three houses, but it is no problem to pay a deposit to book the house first.
When I go back tonight, I will call quickly and ask my family to transfer money, and when the money arrives, I will pay the balance directly and go through the formalities, which is just right.
Xu Shiyan said it casually, but when Jin Liu heard it, he was dumbfounded.
He thought it would be good for Xu Shiyan to buy at most one set, but he didn't expect him to be optimistic about three or four sets at once.
And from that point of view, as long as the price is reasonable, people plan to buy them all.
God, who did he meet? Where did the big boss come from?
Now, Jin Liu was very happy. He patted his chest and assured Xu Shiyan that these houses are all kept, and they will discuss in detail when Xu Shiyan goes over.
Not to mention buying all three or four houses, even if he buys two, Jin Liu can earn a lot of money.
No matter what year you are, if you have money, you are a grandpa, so you must provide proper service.
Xu Shiyan was very satisfied with Jin Liu's attitude, so he took out two boxes of good cigarettes and stuffed them into Jin Liu's hands.
"Then please trouble Mr. Jin Liu. When the house is bought, your benefits will definitely be indispensable."
Money is not a problem, and remittance is much more convenient than before.
If it doesn’t work, you can borrow it from Zhencaotang and return it later.
Of course, this is actually not very formal, but fortunately, in this day and age, the inspection is not so strict.
As long as the money is remitted over there to make up for it, it will be fine.
"Hey, don't call me a lord. Mr. Xu can call me Jin Liu, otherwise, call me Lao Jin."
Jin Liu dares to show off again.
The person in front of me is obviously the God of Wealth, that's not a joke, no one can offend the God of Wealth.
Thinking of this, Jin Liu couldn't help but feel sorry for the kid surnamed Guan from before.
If the kid knew, he missed a big God of Wealth, and I don't know how he would feel.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan drove Jin Liu home, and then returned to his home with Su Anying and Xu Haiyuan.
As soon as I entered the house, I smelled the aroma of food.
Then Xu Haiqing and Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang, who were playing in the yard, ran towards each other.
"Dad, Mom, why did you go and come back?
We are all hungry, there is no way for the second sister and the third brother to go out to buy food, and they are cooking in the kitchen right now. "
The third brother Xu Haiqing mentioned was naturally Yang Haoyu.
Yang Haoyu is the cadre of Xu Shiyan and his wife's official reception, and he is going to be ranked with Xu Haiyuan and his brother and sister.
So Xu Haiqing would call Yang Haoyu the third brother, and Xu Jinhui the fourth sister.
This is based on the five children of Xu Shiyan's family, not the ranking of the Xu family.
If the Xu family is a big family, Yang Haoyu cannot be counted.
Moreover, the ranking should be divided into men and women.
For example, Xu Haibo is the boss, Xu Haitao is the second child, Xu Haibin is the third child, Xu Haiyuan is the fourth child, Xu Haiyang is the fifth child, and Xu Haiqing is the sixth child.
On the girls side, Xu Jinfeng is the eldest, Xu Jinxiu is the second child, Xu Jinping is the third child, Xu Jingyi is the fourth child, Xu Jingwen is the fifth child, and Xu Jinhui is the sixth child.
Actually, it is only the eldest and the second. The big guys are called the eldest brother and the second brother, the eldest sister and the second sister, and most of the latter are called by their names.
For example, Xu Haibin, most of the younger ones behind him call him Brother Dabin.
If they are called Xu Haiyuan, most of them will be Brother Yuanyuan.
The young ones are called Xu Jinping, and most of them are not called Sanjie, but Sister Ping.
The main reason is that the society has changed now, and brothers are separated from each other and never stay together.
Usually there are only one or two children in the family, and we only get together a few times throughout the year. Many times, I don’t bother to think about who the other party is, so it’s better to bring peace of mind by name.
It’s different from before. In the past, big families lived together. This ranking must be clarified, and it cannot be messed up.
"Huh? Are your second sister and your third brother cooking?" Su Anying hurried to the kitchen when she heard this.
As a result, before Su Anying entered the kitchen, Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui happened to be walking out with food, and the mother and daughter happened to meet up.
"Mom, are you back? Just right, let's wash our hands and eat."
In the afternoon, I saw that you didn't come back, so I went out to buy vegetables with Xiaoyu. "Xu Jinping explained with a smile.
"Do you know where the vegetable market is?" Su Anying asked curiously.
These children are brave enough to go out to buy groceries, and they are not afraid of getting lost.
"I know, when I came back last night, didn't Xiaoming and Xiaoliang chatter all the way?
The two of them mentioned where the vegetable market is, and Xiaoyu and I found it easily. "
Xu Jinping didn't think much of it. The two of them wandered around in the afternoon and found many good places.
"Dad, Mom, don't you know that there is a street near here, where many people sell the Four Treasures of the Study, ancient books, calligraphy and paintings.
There are still many people setting up stalls on the side of the road, selling all kinds of old things.
I have time some other day, I have to go shopping, buy a few dollars of good rice paper, and buy some good ink. "
Xu Jinping is not very interested in old objects, but she likes painting and calligraphy.
While passing by today, I saw many shops selling the Four Treasures of the Study, and these were her favorites.
Donggang is a small place, and there are not many good things. It is rare to come to the capital, so you must choose some good rice paper and good ink to take back.
"Do you know what the name of that place is? It's the Liulichang we watched Qing Dynasty dramas on TV."
Xu Haiyuan explained to his sister.
"Oh, so it's Liulichang, I got it."
After being reminded by her brother, Xu Jinping understood.
When Su Anying came to the capital, Mao Menger bought the house.
She didn't know what was good and what was bad, so she chose randomly, so she chose a small courtyard very close to Liulichang Street.
"When I'm free, I'll take you to shop for old things. Maybe you can find treasures."
Xu Haiyuan smiled and took the plate from Xu Jinhui's hand, and put it on the table.
"Okay, idle is idle anyway."
Xu Jinping is not very interested in any old things, but Xu Haiyuan's last sentence, maybe she can find treasures, which makes her quite curious, what treasures can there be?
Behind, Xu Shiyan heard the conversation between his daughter and son, and could only look up at the sky speechlessly.
"Both of you, give me a break, the water is deep in this line, just take a look, don't think about finding leaks."
Finally, he still couldn't hold back, and warned the children.
"Dad, don't worry, we're just going around and having fun."
Xu Haiyuan didn't argue with his father this time, and nodded obediently.
Xu Shiyan was very happy that his son was so well-behaved. He went to wash his hands, came to sit down, and ate with the children.
Xu Jinping's cooking skills are good, everyone is hungry after a busy afternoon, and the dinner is delicious.
After dinner, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying went into the back room and muttered for a long time, then Su Anying picked up the phone and called Ji Yufeng.
Tell Ji Yufeng to send some money here, and she wants to buy a house in the capital.
When Ji Yufeng heard that the Xu family was going to buy a house in the capital, she quickly called her man over.
The two discussed for a while, and then Ji Yufeng told Su Anying to ask Su Anying to buy a set for their family as well.
Ji Yufeng doesn't know about other things, but she knows very well that following Xu Shiyan and his wife will definitely make money.
The Xu family already has two shops and one house in the capital, and if they want to buy it, it must be beneficial.
"Sister-in-law, the remittance is too slow and inconvenient.
Otherwise, tomorrow I will go to the bank to withdraw money, and then I will go to the capital with Junxian and send the money there directly. "
The remittance can take four to five days at the earliest. The husband and wife brought cash and it took only two days, which is much more convenient.
"Yufeng, that won't work, right? It's too dangerous. I'm not in a hurry here, just send money.
If you two want to come, you can come here by car, but don't bring too much cash, it's not a joke. "
Su Anying was terrified when she heard that.
Before she went out with cash, thanks to the Shanghai stock market by plane, the road was relatively safe.
If you come to the capital from home and take the train all the way, who knows what will happen on the way?
Don’t dare to let Ji Yufeng and the others come here with hundreds of thousands of cash. If there is an accident, they can’t bear the responsibility.
When Ji Yufeng heard it, it seemed to make sense. "That's fine, then I'll send the money tomorrow."
Hearing what Ji Yufeng said, Su Anying finally breathed a sigh of relief, and the two chatted for a few more words before hanging up the phone.
Looking back, Su Anying told Xu Shiyan that Yang Junxian and his wife also planned to buy a house in the capital.
"Okay, it just so happened that Yuanyuan chose four places today, didn't he? Then try to discuss as much as possible and leave one place for the Yang family.
No need to guess, the couple must have bought it for Haoyu. "
The Yang family has only one child, who else can give it to Yang Haoyu?
When he originally said he wanted to buy a house, Xu Shiyan thought about buying one for Yang Haoyu.
But think about it carefully, Yang Haoyu's parents are all there, and it's not that he can't afford it.
It always feels a bit too much for him to buy a suite for his children without discussing with others.
After all, Xu Shiyan and his wife are just Yang Haoyu's godfather and godmother.
Whether they lend a hand to help take care of the children, or take the children out to play, or in the future, if the children go to school, get married, or have children, they say they will give them some money, which should be shared.
But it is not suitable to buy a house for children beyond the parents and mothers.
Fortunately, Yang Junxian and his wife are also smart enough to know what to do when they hear the sound. Aren't they going to buy a house now? That's fine.
With Yang Haoyu's grades, if he can't guarantee that he can really come to the capital to study in the future, buy a house and keep it, wouldn't it come in handy?
It was agreed that I would talk about the house the next day, so I didn't arrange the itinerary.
After breakfast, Xu Shiyan and his wife took their remaining less than 200,000 yuan, drove to find Jin Liu, and went door-to-door to discuss the price of the house.
As for Xu Haiyuan, he is only responsible for choosing a house, and he is not in charge of bargaining.
As soon as their parents left, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping took their younger siblings and went out for a stroll.
Xu Shiyan and his wife had to bargain and grind with others.
The location of this house is different, the size of the yard is different, and the old and new are also different, so the price must be different.
The expensive ones are 130,000 to 40,000, the cheap ones are 70,000 to 80,000, and some are just over 100,000. Anyway, they were all negotiated in the end.
Xu Shiyan and his wife saw the relevant procedures and confirmed the ownership of the house, so they were relieved.
Then it’s time to pay the deposit, and it’s time to write the contract.
At the same time, I made an agreement with others, at least one week, at most ten days, and when the money arrives here, I will come to pay the balance and go through the formalities.
It’s just right, during the middle period, I also allow time for others to vacate the house.
In these houses, there are not only homeowners, but also tenants.
As for the house being sold, what should the tenant do? That is the landlord's business, and it has nothing to do with Xu Shiyan. Xu Shiyan doesn't care about that.
Anyway, when he comes to pay the balance, the house will have to be vacated.
This contract was not written casually. Neighbors from all over the world were invited to testify, and Jin Liu was the middleman.
Both parties sign and press their fingerprints on the housing sales contract, that’s all.
"Neighbors, our husband and wife still have some things to do today.
In this way, when we come to pay the final payment and collect the house in a few days, we must invite everyone to drink. "
After the contract was written and the deposit was paid, Xu Shiyan took out cigarettes and candies, distributed them to the neighbors who were witnesses, and explained to them.
Xu Shiyan was polite, and his shots were generous, all of them were good cigarettes.
The neighbors are also quite friendly, everyone chatted a few words and dispersed, each busy with their own business.
Xu Shiyan and his wife had a lot of busy work this afternoon, and at least they talked about all four families.
When the last family also finished writing the contract, Xu Shiyan finally breathed a sigh of relief.
When everyone came out of that courtyard, Xu Shiyan gave Jin Liu 10,000 yuan directly.
"Old Jin, it's hard work for keeping you busy these days.
Look at me, I don’t understand the rules of your industry, don’t think this ten thousand yuan is too little.
When I come to pay the final payment in a few days, I have to trouble you to run after you are tired, and your benefits will be indispensable at that time. "
At this time, there are no more formal housing agency companies, and there are no relevant regulations stipulating how much the agency fee should be.
The total price of the four houses is less than 400,000 yuan, so the 10,000 yuan benefit fee Xu Shiyan gave should be a lot more.
Jin Liu looked at the brand new bundle of hundred-yuan old man tickets, and was so happy that he couldn't close his mouth from ear to ear.
"Mr. Xu, no matter when you come to pay the final payment, just call me.
There is no need to give any benefits, the money is already enough. "
In these years, no matter how small the money is, 10,000 yuan is not a small sum.
It's only been a few days, and Jin Liu can't wait to get up to 10,000.

chapters.title: Chapter 776: too famous
chapters.content:
Chapter 776 is too famous
Xu Shiyan and his wife worked all morning, and when they returned to the small courtyard with the contract, the children who had been out for a whole morning had already returned to cook.
After lunch, Xu Haiyuan smiled and took out the things they bought this morning, like offering treasures.
"Dad, let me declare first, it didn't cost too much money, it was the pocket money you usually gave, which was used by us."
Xu Haiyuan was afraid that Xu Shiyan would scold him, so he made a statement before his father could speak.
Xu Shiyan took a look, okay, there are a lot of things on the table.
Most of them are disgraced, unable to see their original appearance. "Are you picking up trash?"
Xu Shiyan flipped through those things casually and shook his head. To be honest, he couldn't tell the truth anyway.
Now it’s not the past few years. Those who say they are old objects are actually imitations and artificially made old.
"It's okay to play once in a while, but don't always go out of your way.
These things are bottomless pits, and your pocket money can just go in, no more. "
If there is one thing on this table that is real, even if these children have not wasted their work all afternoon.
If you are afraid, you are afraid, there is really nothing, and the pocket money is useless.
Xu Haiyuan looked at his father helplessly and sighed.
"Dad, is that why you can't trust me?"
"It's not that I can't trust you, I just can't trust those people outside.
Now these people can use any means to make money. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head. Without decades of research, he probably wouldn't be able to see through these things.
Anyway, Xu Shiyan thought he didn't have that much ability, so he didn't bother to bother.
He has money to invest in houses and shops, but he is not willing to invest money in these things.
Xu Haiyuan sighed, and asked Xu Jinping to fetch a basin of water, and then brought two soft cloths, and began to clean up the things on the table that were covered with plaster.
After lunch, there is nothing left and right.
Xu Shiyan and his wife were watching from the side, but they wanted to see what his eldest son had found.
There are a few stone-like things that show their true colors after scrubbing.
Two of the rectangular stones are brightly colored, like chicken blood.
The other two fist-sized stones are dark khaki, and one of them has a gray-black stone skin on the outside, and the exposed part is delicate, moist and shiny.
Two small plates, not too big, a bit bigger than the small plate that Xu's family eats dumplings.
The top is a blue-blue lotus pattern, and the bottom is a few seal characters.
These are nothing more than that, after a little cleaning, the original colors can be seen, but there is one thing that Xu Shiyan can't see what kind of material it is.
Look at it, it looks like an incense burner, the whole body is cinnabar, and the bottom of the three feet reveals the essence of white.
"What the **** is this?"
Xu Shiyan couldn't hold back, he took the incense burner and looked through it carefully, "What material is it made of?"
"The inside is white jade, and the outside is coated with a layer of cinnabar by a special method.
Over time, the color of cinnabar permeated into the white jade, forming the present appearance.
The bottom is due to friction, and the cinnabar is worn off before it forms a ooze.
This thing is at least three to five hundred years old. "Xu Haiyuan can only explain it to his father.
When Xu Shiyan heard this, he quickly put the things on the table, "How much did you pay for this thing?"
If it is true what the son said, this thing must be worth at least three to five hundred years.
I just don’t know how much the eldest son spent to buy it.
There shouldn’t be much pocket money for a few children, right?
"Dad, Dad, I know this, and I will tell you."
Xu Haiqing regained his energy when he heard this, and quickly described the scene to his parents.
"The old man who sold this thing said that he wanted it for five hundred yuan. Guess what my elder brother said?"
Xu Haiqing beamed with joy and began to speak in vernacular.
"My elder brother actually said, five hundred yuan is too famous.
Hahaha, it's so famous, I don't even know what my brother thinks, it seems that being famous can't be used for this, right? "
When Xu Haiqing said this, Xu Shiyan and his wife were also stunned.
"Famous? Is this word used in bargaining prices? Yuanyuan, what do you think?" Xu Shiyan couldn't help laughing.
Based on the intelligence of his eldest son, he was able to say such a sentence at that time, probably because he was too excited to see something good.
"Dad, don't worry about what my elder brother thinks, anyway, in the end, my elder brother bought this thing for 200 yuan.
Those two small plates were used as extras and did not cost any money.
Anyway, I don’t know what this is all about, but I heard from my elder brother that those two small dishes seem to be quite valuable. "
Xu Haiqing rushed to talk before he was addicted.
"The few stones cost a total of eighty yuan.
Yes, and I don’t know what else it is, it looks rusty to me, and my elder brother spent a hundred yuan on it. "
Xu Haiqing pointed to a three-legged, two-eared, big-bellied thing that was covered in green and rust, with a puzzled expression on his face.
This thing feels like it's about to rot, and I don't know what his elder brother is buying it for.
"There are a few things I don't know about. Anyway, the pocket money of the elder brother and the second sister are all gone, and mine is also going to be bought by the elder brother."
The Chase mentioned above is actually foreshadowing the last sentence.
Xu Haiqing just wanted to tell his parents that his pocket money was gone.
"Those stones include the seal material of Changhua chicken blood, and Tianhuang stone.
The two small dishes should be blue and white from the Kangxi period, and they are still well preserved. They should be worth a few dollars in a few years.
The tripod with three legs and two ears is a bronze tripod. There is no need to clean up that thing, just keep it well. "
Xu Haiyuan rolled his eyes at his younger brother, as if no one could see it with his little intelligence.
"The rest, there is an agate handle, the carving is good, and it is quite old.
There is also a small box, which should be made of red sandalwood. The carving is very good. Looking at the pattern carving, it seems to be an object during the Kangxi period. "
Xu Haiyuan introduced all the items on this table to his parents.
"I spent a total of five hundred yuan today. Anyway, Pingping, Xiaoyu, and Xu Haiqing's pocket money were all spent by me.
These things are not as good as the things my dad brought back that time, but they are still good. Put them away properly, and they will be worth some money in the future. "
Xu Haiyuan shook his head while talking.
It took him a lot of work this morning to find these things.
Those who set up the stalls shouted that they were all old objects, but in fact, as Xu Shiyan said, most of them were imitations of old ones.
If you want to pick something real out of it, you really need eyesight.
What the son said was right, and Xu Shiyan couldn't believe it. Anyway, it's five hundred yuan, so you can spend it if you spend it.
Not to mention anything else, just that cinnabar and white jade incense burner can be multiplied many times with one.
The remaining ones, it doesn’t matter if they are real or not, just spend 500 yuan to let the children go out to play.
"Yuanyuan, let's say yes, if you spend this money today, you will buy it, but there will be no next time.
I still say the same thing, the water here is too muddy, so don't fall into it. "Xu Shiyan did not forget to tell his son.
"Dad, I know, today is just taking them to play, just to open their eyes.
We won’t go there in the future, there are indeed a lot of fake ones. "
Xu Haiyuan didn't argue with his father, he was kind, and immediately nodded in agreement.
Xu Shiyan couldn't tell whether these things were true or not, but just asked Su Anying to put them away so that they would not be damaged.
There was nothing to do at noon, and it was really tiring to work on the house for the past two days, so the couple went back to the house to take a nap.
As for the children, they were very energetic and not too hot, and they all played wild in the yard.
"Tell me, can these things our son Taodeng be real?"
Lying on the bed, Su Anying couldn't fall asleep for a while, so she asked her man.
"Yuanyuan said so firmly, it should be true, right?
Anyway, I don’t know about other things, but that cinnabar and white jade incense burner looks quite similar.
The cinnabar color cannot be made in a short period of time.
There is also the bronze tripod, judging by the distribution of the rust, it does not look like a fake. " Xu Shiyan pondered for a moment, then replied.
"Hey, I'm just wondering, where did Yuanyuan learn this? Master Chu taught it?"
Su Anying felt strange, no one in the Xu family understood this, where did Xu Haiyuan learn it?
"Not sure, anyway, the eldest son of our family is fascinated.
That's fine, don't think too much about it, maybe it was taught by the master, or you can't know from the book.
He read those books, how can we understand. "
Xu Shiyan was a little sleepy, closed his eyes and stared in a daze, and hugged his daughter-in-law, and the two of them squinted.
Originally, Xu Shiyan planned to take his wife and children to Chengde or Beidaihe to play.
But the children said that they like to be in the capital, and there are still many places here that they haven’t been to.
Furthermore, Yang Junxian and his wife are coming, so they cannot leave.
So on the morning of the 17th, Xu Shiyan and his wife took their children and went for a walk around the Summer Palace again.
At noon, the children were sent to the roast duck restaurant to occupy seats, and Xu Shiyan and his wife went to the train station to pick up Yang Junxian and his wife.
Yang Junxian and Ji Yufeng went to the bank to remit the money early the next morning after receiving the call.
The two of them took another hundred thousand in cash to bring with them, and hurried all the way to the capital.
When the four met, they were naturally overjoyed.
But there is no time to chat with each other at this time, the children are still waiting at the roast duck restaurant. The four hurried into the car and went to find the children.
The two families happily ate roast duck, and the children were very happy to eat it.
Especially Xu Haiqing, who finally ate the roast duck he had been longing for, and came back to the capital this time, and his wish was fulfilled.
In the days that followed, the two families took Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang to wander around the capital.
On the 21st, the remittance arrived. Ji Yufeng and Su Anying went to withdraw the money together, and then went to find Jin Liu to pay the balance in those houses.
There are four courtyards in total, Yang Junxian and his wife chose three to enter, and the Xu family kept the other three.
To pay the final payment, a formal deed must be written, and neighbors and middlemen should be invited to testify.
Xu Shiyan pays the money, and the landlord hands over the house book and other relevant documents to Xu Shiyan.
Both parties signed and pledged on the written deed, and neighbors and middlemen also signed and stamped their fingerprints on it.
At this point, the house belongs to Xu Shiyan and the others, and we will go to the relevant units later, just transfer the house.
These houses were not too far away, so Xu Shiyan simply went from house to house to get down to business.
Looking back, I found a restaurant, gathered all the owners and neighbors of these houses, and treated everyone to a meal.
It was only then that the homeowners realized that they had bought several houses at once.
Yo ho, how much money does this have, can you afford such an expense?
Of course, people in big places are good at this, and don’t ask around.
Money is yours, no matter how much money you have, I don’t envy you, as long as I live my life well.
Of course, everyone is very polite to Xu Shiyan, Yang Junxian and others.
The big guys ate, drank, chatted and chatted together. The atmosphere was very good and they got along very well.
After getting the house, I gave those families two more days to move and make room.
Here Xu Shiyan entrusts Jin Liu to help transfer the ownership of the house as soon as possible.
Jin Liu is most familiar with these tasks. He does this and has acquaintances in relevant departments.
Find someone to talk to, give some cigarettes and alcohol or something, just transfer to an account, isn't it easy to handle?
The house was bought for the children, so when going through the formalities, they simply wrote the children's names.
Originally, Xu Shiyan planned to leave the four-entry courtyard to Xu Haiyuan, the two three-entry courtyards to the two girls, and the one-entry courtyard to Xu Haiqing.
Unexpectedly, Xu Haiyuan disagreed, and gave the big yard to his younger brother, and he wanted the smaller one.
Xu Haiqing doesn't understand anything, anyway, he wants whichever set his brother gives him, and he doesn't care if he doesn't give it to him.
He is still young, and his family property is too far away for him. As long as he has food, drink and a place to live, he doesn't care about the rest.
However, the children were interested in a few houses.
So taking advantage of the few days between completing the formalities and waiting to receive the new house book, Xu Shiyan took the children to collect the house, clean it up, and check out the door.
Anyway, you have to know where your house is, right?
"This yard is still bigger, much more spacious than the one we live in.
Xu Haiqing, this is my brother letting you go, you have a little count.
In the future, if you dare to fight with my brother for something, I won’t beat you to death. "
As soon as she entered the courtyard, Xu Jinping felt emotional. This courtyard is extraordinarily spacious.
This is a courtyard with four entrances, the second entrance has five main rooms, and one side room on the left and right.
There are three main rooms in the third entrance courtyard, with two side rooms on the left and right sides.
There are three wing rooms in the east and west of the second entrance courtyard, the wing rooms with side rooms in the third entrance courtyard, and a row of back rooms at the end.
Between the rooms, there are corridors connecting them.
Roughly estimated, this yard occupies at least a thousand square meters. Isn’t that larger than the one I live in now?
It’s not easy to catch up with three times the size, of course it’s different.
"Second sister, I don't seem to have said anything?" Xu Haiqing scratched her head with an innocent face.
The elder brother gave him the house, of course he appreciates it.
Besides, he doesn't have the skills of his elder brother, so why should he compete with his elder brother?
"It's okay, just tell me what you like in the future."
Xu Haiyuan reached out and rubbed his brother's head.
This kid has a big heart, and he doesn't take everything to heart. In the future, I am afraid that his brothers and sisters will have to worry about him.
Anyway, it's an old pimple in the family, so it's right to enjoy the blessings.
Yang Junxian and his wife took Yang Haoyu to collect the house.
Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang have been wandering around for the past few days, and they haven't written a few words for their summer homework. Su Anzhen took her to the shop and watched them do their homework.
So today, there are only six members of the Xu family, who come to the new house to collect and clean.
The children ran in first, and Xu Shiyan and Su Anying came in last. When they heard what the daughter and son said, the couple followed suit.
"Hai Qing, good luck, he has two older brothers and sisters who can take care of him, so he doesn't have to worry about anything.
He, just eat and drink all day long, waiting to enjoy the blessing. "Xu Shiyan looked at his youngest son and couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
"Well, thanks to Yuanyuan who was born first, if Haiqing came out first, we wouldn't have to worry about death?"
Su Anying heard it and laughed too.
When Su Anying said this, Xu Shiyan and the children froze for a moment, and then laughed too.
"So, God loves us both, let Yuanyuan and Pingping come out first, with these two, we can save a lot of worry."

chapters.title: Chapter 777: sandwich wall
chapters.content:
Chapter 777 Sandwich Wall
The four-entry courtyard, the serious deep house compound, is absolutely different from the place where ordinary people live.
It is said that this was the residence of some high-ranking officials in the Qing Dynasty, and wealthy businessmen lived in the Republic of China.
Later, this place was taken over and turned into some kind of office, and it was returned to the descendants of this family only a few years ago.
The house has gone through many twists and turns, and the damage is serious but no one maintains it.
The original owner’s family was withered, and the descendants were useless, so they couldn’t spend money to repair it.
Seeing that the house was declining day by day, I thought about selling it.
Just in time for Xu Shiyan to buy a house, the deal was concluded in two clicks. Since then, such a large courtyard has been named Xu.
"Oh, this yard is big, but it's just too dilapidated.
It seems that a lot of money needs to be spent on repairs, otherwise it will not be possible to live. "Su Anying walked around in the yard, sighing regretfully.
The house has been in disrepair for a long time, the carved window lattices are already broken, and the cornices and brackets are also incomplete.
There are several pomegranate trees and jujube trees in the yard, most of which are dead due to neglect.
The two trees that are still alive seem to be broken by naughty children, and most of the branches are bald, which is really a pity.
"Daughter-in-law, you should think this way, if it weren't for the dilapidated house, we wouldn't be able to buy such a large yard for hundreds of thousands.
Xiu, I told Jin Liu about this and asked him to help find someone to repair it. When the time comes, Zhendong will come over from time to time to check on the progress. "
Such a large courtyard cost more than a hundred thousand yuan. Xu Shiyan thought it was a good deal.
If this house is repaired and renovated, it will cost at least tens of millions after thirty years? If it's not good, it can reach hundreds of millions.
It only costs a few dollars to repair the house, it’s just a drizzle.
"Yuanyuan, with his younger brothers and sisters, opened the doors and windows of all the houses to let in the air.
Then look for a broom or something, sweep all the houses, and tidy up the yard. "
Xu Shiyan directed the children to work.
The house has gone through a lot of twists and turns, and every part of it is not built like it should be.
Now that the house belongs to the Xu family, they have to tidy it up anyway, and check everywhere to determine where it needs to be repaired.
"Hey, I see." Xu Haiyuan replied very simply, and then led his younger siblings to work.
Several children opened all the doors and windows from front to back to let the air circulate.
There are so many houses, most of which are unoccupied and in disrepair, with a musty smell inside.
At the beginning, the children were serious about cleaning up, and gradually they started playing.
There are so many houses, dozens of main rooms, wing rooms and side rooms, the place is huge.
The children can be regarded as catching up, so why not be so excited?
Xu Haiqing played hide and seek with Xu Jinhui, looking for places to hide.
Just play and play, anyway, there is nothing to do today, so take a day to clean up slowly.
Unexpected, after a while, I heard Xu Jinhui's cry.
"Father, mother, eldest brother, second sister, come quickly, Haiqing is gone."
Xu Shiyan, his wife, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping quickly ran towards the source of the sound.
"Huihui, where are you?"
With such a big yard, is it not easy to hide a child?
It would be troublesome to find one by one, so Xu Shiyan shouted while running.
"Dad, I'm here.
Just now Haiqing and I were hiding cats here, I heard him ah, and then he disappeared. "
Xu Jinhui came out from the main room in the second courtyard, and raised her hand to wipe the tears off her face.
There is a lot of dust in this room, I don't know where she touched it just now, anyway, there are dust on her hands.
Such a smear, okay, the pretty little face directly becomes a cat.
"Where is it? Let's go and have a look." Xu Haiyuan hurriedly dragged his sister into the house after hearing this.
The second entrance courtyard has five main rooms with side rooms, and the east and west each have three side rooms, which are generally used for hospitality and entertainment, while the third entrance courtyard is the back house.
Xu Jinhui pointed to the ear room on the east side, "Just now I was outside and Hai Qing was inside, so I heard him yell, and I couldn't find him when I went into the room."
The little girl is still crying, she is in a hurry, her brother is gone, can she not be in a hurry?
As soon as Xu Haiyuan heard this, he rushed to the ear room and shouted loudly, "Xu Haiqing, Xu Haiqing." No one answered.
At this time, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying also came over, "Are you sure he disappeared here? Did he go to the backyard?"
A good child, how could he disappear?
"Dad, Mom, I went to the backyard to call just now, but there was no movement." Xu Jinping also ran in panting.
She didn't come directly just now, but yelled around in other places in the backyard, but there was no response from Xu Haiqing.
"Where can this child go?" Su Anying was anxious.
What a good child, he disappeared in a blink of an eye, which sounds impossible no matter what.
"There is something in this house, right?" Su Anying couldn't help but think about the bad side.
"Mom, don't think about it, this house should have a sandwich wall.
In order to avoid disasters and other things in the deep house compound, there are sandwich walls when building the house. Wait, I'll look for it. "
Xu Haiyuan didn't know whether to laugh or cry, but my mother could really think about it, what else could she think of.
What can there be? In this big capital, what dares to make trouble here?
As Xu Haiyuan said, he carefully observed the room, especially the footprints on the ground.
The house has not been cleaned for a long time, and there is a layer of dust on the ground, and Xu Haiqing's footprints can be seen.
Xu Haiyuan identified it carefully, and followed the footprints to the wall between the side room and the main room.
Xu Haiyuan raised his hand and tapped on the wall, but it really sounded wrong.
"It's empty inside, there must be a sandwich wall. Wait, I'll find the switch."
As soon as he finished speaking, Xu Haiyuan noticed a brick protruding slightly at the base of the wall.
So he stepped on it hard, and the wall in front of him suddenly cracked a hole about two feet wide.
Sure enough, this is a sandwich wall with an empty interlayer in the middle.
Then, everyone found that Xu Haiqing was leaning against the wall.
This mezzanine is not wide enough to allow one person to pass through.
Just now the secret door was not opened, Xu Haiqing was standing inside, now the door opened, Xu Haiqing slipped down along the wall, his body softened, and he half fell to the ground.
"What, what's the matter?" Both Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were terrified, and hurried forward to support their son.
These two couples are behind Xu Haiyuan, so naturally they are not as fast as Xu Haiyuan.
I saw Xu Haiyuan scooped up his younger brother, raised his hand to touch the back of Xu Haiqing's head, and sure enough, he found a big bag.
"It's okay, he probably stepped on the mechanism by accident just now, touched the secret door, and fell into the interlayer wall.
Coincidentally, a bump was touched on the back of his head, and he should have passed out temporarily. "
While talking, Xu Haiyuan held his younger brother in his arms, squatted down, and pinched Xu Haiqing's waist with his right thumb.
Not long after, Xu Haiqing snorted and opened his eyes. "What's the matter? I seem to have stepped on the ground just now."
Xu Haiqing frowned, feeling something was wrong, the back of his head hurt, and the top of his lips also hurt.
"You're really good at hiding a cat, and you can fall into the sandwiched wall. You hit the back of your head and passed out.
Thanks to Huihui being with you, otherwise, you would be suffocated inside, and we would not be able to find you. "
Xu Haiyuan rolled his eyes angrily, and helped his brother up.
"Huh? The sandwich wall? Let me see if there is any treasure hidden inside."
Xu Haiqing suddenly became energetic when he heard about the sandwich wall, and asked with widened eyes.
When Xu Haiqing shouted, Xu Shiyan and his wife also cheered up.
Generally speaking, a large family builds a wall, either for hiding people or for hiding things.
Just now, I was just focusing on saving Xu Haiqing, but I didn't check to see if there was anything in the sandwich wall.
The couple hurried forward, looking into the interlocking wall with their probes.
The inside of the sandwich wall is only as high as one person, and there is a gap of about 40 to 50 centimeters in the middle, and the two sides should be single-layer bricks.
Looking in from the outside, the space on the left hand side is small and there is nothing.
There seems to be a lot of space on the right hand side, and there are indeed some unknown things in it.
"Oh, there is really something inside." Su Anying exclaimed.
"Yuanyuan, you are waiting outside, I will go in and have a look."
Xu Shiyan was worried about any accident, so he went in by himself and moved the things inside out.
In the mezzanine, there are several wooden boxes that are not too big.
The box is rectangular, about forty centimeters long, thirty centimeters wide, and only twenty centimeters high.
Although the box is not too big, it is quite heavy and heavy.
"Oops, it's not very brisk, I don't know what's inside."
Xu Shiyan carefully moved the box out and placed it on the ground outside.
There are four boxes in total, all of the same size. Xu Shiyan took a bit of effort, and at least he moved all the boxes out.
The inside of the sandwich wall was quite dry, but it was dusty. After a while, Xu Shiyan's head and body were all covered with dust.
However, the box was well preserved, and it was not damaged by moisture.
"Hey? There is a lock on it. We don't have a key. How can we do this?"
Xu Haiqing also ignored the pain in the back of his head, wandering around those boxes, looking at them curiously.
"Pingping, lend me one of the clips on your head."
Xu Haiyuan glanced at the lock, it was an old copper lock, not too big, small and exquisite.
So turning around, Guan Xu Jinping wanted to issue a card.
Xu Jinping's ponytail, the little girl's hair is broken, and she will use a few black hair clips to pin the broken hair.
As soon as she heard that her brother was going to issue cards, Xu Jinping quickly took off two and handed them to her brother.
Xu Haiyuan took one end of the hairpin and put the other end into the lock.
I saw his wrist twist slightly, three or two times, and then heard a sound, and the lock unexpectedly popped open.
"Brother, when did you practice this hand, isn't it too good?"
Xu Haiqing and the others were all dumbfounded, the lock was opened so easily? Impossible?
It wasn't just Xu Haiqing and the others who were taken aback, even Xu Shiyan and his wife were dumbfounded.
The eldest son played this trick beautifully, did he open the lock easily?
After this, do I need to go somewhere to prepare a case?
"Those students in our class learn not to lock their heads all day long.
Paper clips, pins, hairpins, they use whatever they can find. The locks in my class have to be changed three or four times a semester, and they are all broken. "
Xu Haiyuan smiled, explained something casually, then took off the lock and opened the box.
Inside the box was a layer of red silk. When I opened the red silk, everyone in the room was dumbfounded.
Inside turned out to be golden ingots.
Looking at the appearance, it should be old-made five-two-one ingots. There are three layers in the box, with a layer of more than ten ingots. It seems that there are almost fifty ingots in this box.
If calculated according to the current measurement standard, it would be about fifteen or six catties, which is really heavy.
"Dad, is this gold?" Xu Haiqing was also dumbfounded, and murmured.
"Xu Haiqing, you have to make a promise to me now, you are not allowed to tell anyone what happened today, did you hear me?"
Xu Shiyan glanced at his youngest son and said solemnly.
Although only one of the four boxes in front of me has been opened, the others can guess that there must be valuable things hidden inside.
This house was bought by the Xu family, so no matter what is in it, it should belong to them.
But if it gets out, I am afraid that the original owner of the house will have to come back to fight, and the relevant departments will have to come if there is trouble.
The children in the family, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping, ghosts and ghosts, understand the severity, and Xu Jinhui is honest and stable, and never talks too much.
Only Xu Haiqing's mouth has no door. He can speak out from all over the world, from the first five hundred years to the next five hundred years.
Usually those parents are just short-sighted, but today's matter is very important. If Xu Haiqing goes out to mess around, it will definitely cause trouble.
That's why Xu Shiyan stared at the youngest son, and made the youngest son promise not to go out and talk nonsense.
Xu Haiqing saw his father's face, and knew that something was going to happen. He fell into trouble.
"Dad, I promise, I will never tell when I go out, and I won't tell anyone, even the third brother and the others."
Although Xu Haiqing likes to play and make trouble, he still understands what is right and wrong.
"Okay, your promise today, Dad believed it.
But in the future, if you go out and talk nonsense, you will cause trouble. Be careful I can really kill you, you hear me? "
At this time, the youngest son must be frightened so that he has a memory.
Sure enough, Xu Haiqing turned pale with fright and nodded repeatedly.
He is too clear, don't look at his father not beating them easily, but if he really annoys his father, his father will be ruthless, and he will peel off his skin if he doesn't die.
"I know, Dad, I definitely won't tell." The child was frightened and almost cried.
Xu Shiyan frightened Xu Haiqing, but Su Anying, Xu Haiyuan and others remained silent, and no one made love to Xu Haiqing.
Xu Haiqing must remember this matter, knowing that the consequences will be serious.
Xu Haiqing repeatedly assured, Xu Shiyan nodded.
Over there, Xu Haiyuan opened the other three boxes in turn.
In the second box, there is still gold, but it is gold bars, not gold ingots.
It is said that antiques in prosperous times and gold in troubled times, one can tell at a glance that the owner of this house is quite smart.
The third and fourth boxes contained all kinds of jewelry.
Hairpins, hairpins, necklaces, bracelets, bead strings, jade pendants, pendants, gold, silver, pearls and jade, all kinds of materials, Xu Shiyan can't name them.
Those jewelry are not only beautifully made, most of them are also inlaid with various precious gemstones.
These things are well preserved, and have not become old and dim because of the age, they are still bright and shining.
"The value of these two boxes is more valuable than those two boxes of gold." Xu Haiyuan glanced at it and said.
This, without Xu Haiyuan saying it, Xu Shiyan is also very clear.
In the past, the amount of gold mined was small, so it was very precious, and it was a precious metal that preserved its value.
But as mining technology becomes more and more advanced, gold reserves are increasing.
Regardless of the fact that the price of gold is rising all the way, in fact, if calculated according to purchasing power, gold is depreciating.
But those jewelry are old and considered antiques.
Especially those jade bracelets, jade pendants, gemstone bead strings and other things, any one of them is worth a lot.
It is estimated that these things have been in the interlayer wall for many years, and the incompleteness is left by that senior official and his descendants.
For some unknown reason, the secret of the hidden treasure was not passed on, and in the end no one discovered it, and Xu Haiyuan stomped it out.
"What should we do with these things?" Xu Shiyan looked at the four small boxes in front of him, feeling a little embarrassed for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 778: cellar
chapters.content:
Chapter 778 Cellar
What Xu Shiyan said about how to deal with it did not refer to the removal or retention of these things, nor did he mean to hand them over to the state.
It's not that he is greedy for money, the key is trouble.
If this is really handed in, will the original homeowner come back to make trouble after knowing the news?
Can those so-called experts say that there are probably still things hidden in this house, and it is best to dig them out?
Can other people be jealous and come sneaking to hunt for treasure?
It should be said that these are not possibilities, but will definitely happen.
The Xu family doesn't live here. If the disturbance continues like this, will the house still be there when they come next time?
If the house is not in order, the house can be demolished secretly, even the foundation is gone.
In order to avoid trouble, don't even think about handing over things like this.
Besides, the house he bought with money, everything in the house belongs to him.
Regardless of whether it is a sandwich wall or a cellar, as long as there is something, it belongs to the Xu family.
Xu Shiyan meant to say, what are they going to do with these four boxes now.
Should I move it back to the sandwich wall, or take it back to the small courtyard at night, and wait to find a way to transport it back to the northeast?
"Dad, it's better to move away, you can't stay here.
This house needs to be refurbished. If the workers find the sandwich wall while working, can they still keep it? "
Xu Haiyuan guessed what Xu Shiyan was thinking, and proposed.
"Well, I also think it's better to move away.
But moving to the small courtyard is not a long-term solution. We don’t live in the small courtyard. We can come here once or twice a year. Who can guarantee that it will be safe in the small courtyard? "
Xu Shiyan sighed, this guy turned out to be a hot potato, and he was quite difficult to deal with.
"Dad, those are things for later, there is still something to do right now."
Xu Haiyuan didn't think it was too difficult. In his opinion, this thing is easy to deal with.
"What's the matter?" Xu Shiyan was taken aback, not understanding what the eldest son wanted to say.
"Dad, you said that this house is so big, it is said that a high official once lived there.
Maybe there is something hidden here? Will there be any sandwich walls, or cellars, secret rooms and the like? "
Xu Haiyuan looked thoughtful.
"The point is, our house needs major repairs. If something is discovered by the workers during the repair of the house, it will be a big trouble."
Xu Shiyan glanced at his eldest son, smiled and shook his head, "Impossible, I'm just thinking about it all day.
How big an official must be? These are hidden in the sandwich wall, where else can they be hidden?
The descendants of his family can still be ignorant?
It’s a lot to be able to hide these things. I guess something must have happened at the time, so I didn’t have time to tell future generations. "
It is very lucky to find these things.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to think that there are treasures hidden in this house, it's impossible.
"Dad, never mind that it might be impossible, we have to look for it first, what if?"
Xu Haiyuan still insisted on his own ideas.
In his opinion, this kind of high-ranking official family must have left a lot of behind-the-scenes, and it is impossible to have only one sandwich wall.
The eldest son persisted, and besides, there was indeed some truth to it.
Don't care if there are any treasures, you really should look around and look for them. Don't be afraid of ten thousand, just in case.
"Okay, then let's wander around and look around, don't care if there are any, just look for it and give up."
Xu Shiyan glanced at Su Anying, thinking he was playing with the children.
When Xu Haiqing heard this, he couldn't care less about the pain in the back of his head, so he raised his legs and ran outside.
It was Xu Jinping who glanced at the wall behind her, "How do you close the sandwich wall?"
The wall can’t always be open, can it? It was closed when they were looking for Xu Haiqing just now, which means there must be an agency.
Xu Haiyuan came to the base of the wall, stepped on the raised brick again, and the sandwich wall closed again.
"There should be a mechanism in there, which can be closed. I guess Xu Haiqing fell into it and directly touched it." Xu Haiyuan explained to his sister.
The sandwich wall was closed, and the four boxes were temporarily placed in this room, and then Xu Shiyan waved his hand, motioning for the children to play.
"Okay, let's all go around, maybe we can find some hidden treasures."
Treasure hunting, this is the children's favorite.
Xu Haiqing was the first to jump out, found a stick outside, and started beating on the walls of every room.
Xu Haiyuan is not that stupid, so he doesn't knock on every wall.
The interlining wall must be much thicker than ordinary walls for the purpose of hiding people’s things. This can be seen through careful observation.
Going back and forth into the courtyard, the children searched dozens of houses one by one, but finally found no sandwich walls.
But found a cellar in the yard, and a dry well in the backyard.
The cellar may be the former vegetable cellar. In front of the kitchen door of the third courtyard, there was a square opening covered with stone slabs.
Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan and his son worked together to lift the stone slab away, revealing the entrance below.
Xu Haiqing looked at the entrance and wanted to get down anxiously, but was grabbed by Xu Haiyuan.
"What are you in a hurry for?
This cellar has been untouched for a long time, and we don’t know what’s in it.
What if there are no vents and no oxygen inside? It's too dangerous to venture down. "
Xu Haiqing was taken aback for a moment, scratched his head, and laughed.
"I'm too anxious, I just want to see what's below. What if there is still a baby?"
Xu Shiyan raised his hand and tapped his youngest son on the forehead.
"Stupid, this is a vegetable cellar. It is used to store radishes and cabbage in winter. What treasures can there be in it?"
"Dad, not all cabbages are stored here."
Xu Haiyuan glanced at his father and younger brother, and explained something awkward.
“In the past, ordinary people couldn’t afford to dig cellars, they had to be rich and have their own yards to dig cellars.
Some cellars are very large, more than ten square meters, and people can live in them.
In times of chaos, you can hide in the cellar.
There are also some rich people who specialize in digging cellars to store wine. "
Xu Haiyuan was afraid that if he explained too much, his father would feel uncomfortable, but if he didn't explain, he would panic again.
"Oh, there is still so much to learn about co-authoring.
I thought it was similar to Caijiaozi in Northeast China. "
Xu Shiyan didn't think it was embarrassing or anything. His eldest son felt very normal when he knew this, and there was nothing surprising about it.
"Then when shall we go down? Just open the lid like this, let's chat here?"
Xu Haiqing couldn't bear his temper, and eagerly wanted to go down and have a look.
"Well, you and the second sister, go to the surrounding shops and find out if there is a blower.
If there is one, buy one, and then buy a long length of wire and a socket.
Let's use a blower to blow the inside, so that the ventilation can be faster. "
Currently I don't know the situation below, so I really dare not go down rashly.
You must know that carbon dioxide is heavier than air, and the lower you go, the more dangerous it is.
This is not a joke. People die in the cellar every winter, so be careful.
Blowers are available in the Northeast. Nowadays, some people burn sawdust and need to use blowers.
I don’t know if there are any in the capital, so I can only inquire.
The most important thing is to pay Xu Haiqing to save this kid from always worrying and nagging, which is too annoying.
Xu Haiqing didn't know that his brother thought he was annoying, so he sent him away on purpose.
As soon as I heard that I was going to buy a blower, I followed the two sisters away.
The younger siblings were sent away, Xu Haiyuan asked Su Anying to watch from above, he and Xu Shiyan were going to go into the cellar.
"No, didn't you just say that the cellar is dangerous and you won't let it go down?"
Su Anying saw something was wrong, so she hurriedly stopped the father and son.
"Mom, I was fooling Xu Haiqing.
The cellars of this kind of rich family have ventilation holes at the bottom. Don't believe me? "
While talking, Xu Haiyuan took out a box of matches, lit one and probed into the cellar, but the match did not go out.
"My dad and I walked down while lighting a match.
If there is something wrong with the match, we will return immediately. "
It would be better if there was a candle, but unfortunately, they just came here, and there is nothing here.
That match was Xu Haiyuan's pocket at some point.
Just like that, the two struck a match, and under Su Anying's worried gaze, they walked step by step into the cellar.
After walking two steps, Xu Haiyuan lit a match, bent down to test it, and if the match didn't go out, it meant there was oxygen below.
"Dad, did you see that? The flame of this match is biased.
This means that the bottom is ventilated, and once the cellar door is opened, the air can circulate. "
Xu Haiyuan's observation ability is naturally extraordinary, Xu Haiyuan told his father while the two were walking.
Just like that, the father and father carefully descended to the bottom of the cellar.
Based on the light coming from above, you can roughly see that this is a very square cellar.
It should be less than two meters high, and the surrounding area should be made of strips of stone, which are neat and clean. There are probably large stone slabs on the top of the head, and there are also stone slabs underneath.
The cellar is not too big, and it feels about seven or eight flat, very regular.
It's just a mess on the ground, covered with pieces of paper and broken porcelain.
Xu Shiyan bent down to pick up a piece of broken porcelain, and took two steps outside before glancing at it.
"Unfortunately, this should be a fragment of porcelain."
Seeing these fragments, what else do you not understand?
Twenty years ago, the owner of the house should have hidden some porcelain, calligraphy and paintings in the cellar.
It's a pity that this cellar is too conspicuous to be discovered.
Then someone came down and found those things. It was probably destroyed after a meal, and it became the scene in front of us.
"It's useless, if these things are kept until now, I am afraid that any of them will be worth a lot of money."
In those years, too many good things were really ruined.
"Go, let's go up, even if there used to be anything in here, it has been destroyed, it's a pity."
Xu Shiyan shook his head and sighed, then turned to leave.
"Dad, wait a minute." Xu Haiyuan didn't rush up, but looked around.
"It stands to reason that the cellar shouldn't be so small."
Xu Haiyuan groped and tapped on the wall while talking.
Sure enough, the sound of knocking on one of the walls was wrong.
"Dad, I think there should be another room here. Wait a minute, I'll look for the agency."
As soon as the words fell, and Xu Haiyuan didn't know what happened to him, he heard a creaking sound.
The wall in front of Xu Haiyuan unexpectedly cracked a hole more than two feet wide.
Xu Shiyan was dumbfounded, isn't this too evil? Did his eldest son really hit the mark?
"Well, there really is another room here."
How do you feel, today's experience is just like the one in the story, so bizarre? How can there be such a coincidence?
Xu Haiyuan didn't care how surprised his father was, and stepped into the inner compartment.
There was no light in here, it was very dark, and the Xu family father and son didn't bring any lighting things in, so they had no choice but to light another match.
With the faint light of the match, it can be seen that this secret room is about ten square meters, and it is as neat and clean as the outside room.
There are several boxes on the ground, and I don't know what is inside.
Xu Haiyuan just wanted to go over to have a look, but the match went out, so he hastily struck another one to illuminate it and move forward.
But how long can the match last? After just two steps, it went out again.
"Dad, go and move those four boxes over here, it will be fine to hide them here.
Tonight or sometime, the two of us will prepare a flashlight before coming here, otherwise it will be pitch black and we won’t be able to see anything clearly. "
Xu Haiyuan could only sigh, because he didn't have a suitable lighting tool in his hand, it was impossible.
When Xu Haiyuan was lighting a match just now, Xu Shiyan also saw the box on the ground.
Needless to say, it must be something hidden by the homeowner.
It is very possible that the family knew that something was going to happen, so they put the worthless things outside to attract attention, and put all the valuable things inside.
At that time, those people came to search and saw a pile of porcelain, calligraphy and paintings outside, and smashed them directly, thinking that it was all there.
So I didn't search carefully, and I didn't find that there was another room in the cellar, and I didn't know that the house still had a sandwich wall.
"Okay, then I'll move the boxes."
Nowhere is the safest place than this place, as long as they don't mention it, it will be very difficult for outsiders to find this place.
Very good, there is such a place, but it solves a big problem.
It was said before that it was going to move the box to the small courtyard, but where can it be hidden? There are so many people over there, no matter where you hide, you can't hide it from them.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan went up from the cellar and talked to Su Anying.
Then the couple moved the box down and hid it in the inner room.
After that, the three of them came out from the inner room, Xu Haiyuan touched the mechanism and restored the wall.
"The people in the past were really amazing. They were able to build such a place under the ground with a mechanism. It's really amazing." Xu Shiyan couldn't help but sigh with emotion.
Not long after the three of them came out of the cellar, sisters Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping came back.
It's just that the hands of the three are empty. Obviously, they didn't buy a blower.
"Brother, we have inquired in several places, and they all said that there is no blower." Xu Haiqing said with a mournful face.
"If you don't have it, then you don't have it. After such a long time, it is estimated that the ventilation at the bottom is almost the same.
Do you want to go down with me to have a look? "Xu Haiyuan asked his younger brother pretending.
"Okay, okay, let's go down together."
Xu Haiqing immediately became interested when he heard this, and came to the entrance of the cellar happily.
"Come on, let's go down and have a look."
The little kid was very curious about what was going on underneath, so he thought, what if there were a lot of treasures hidden underneath like that sandwiched wall?
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying looked at each other, both holding back their smiles.
This silly boy, thanks to the fact that Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiyuan are brothers, otherwise, wouldn't Xu Haiyuan play around?
"Dad, Mom, why don't you go down and have a look?"
Xu Haiqing followed his brother down a few steps, then suddenly turned around and asked Xu Shiyan and his wife.
"No, what's there to see in a broken vegetable cellar? You two are just curious, I'm not interested at all.
You two go down, if there is any treasure under there, remember to call me, I will go down to join in the fun. "
Xu Shiyan held back a smile and said solemnly.
"Oh, okay, then I will go down with my elder brother. If there are treasures down there, I will call you." Xu Haiqing nodded.
Okay, then the two brothers can only go down to explore.
"Second Sister, Fourth Sister, let's forget about you two, it's dark down here, it's not good for you two to be afraid when you go down."
Xu Haiqing waved at Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui, then turned around and followed Xu Haiyuan to the cellar.
Not long after, I heard Xu Haiqing's voice from below.
"These prodigal sons, why are they smashing good things? It's a pity."

chapters.title: Chapter 779: a bit strange
chapters.content:
Chapter 779 is a bit strange
Xu Haiqing saw those fragments in the cellar, and felt very distressed.
These are treasures, it’s a pity that they were damaged like this.
But no matter how distressed he was, it was useless, he could only come up from the cellar muttering.
The family came over in the morning, and it was delayed for a long time. It was already past one thirty and nearly two o'clock.
Since I have seen the yard before and after, and there is nothing in the cellar, Xu Shiyan said, let's go back to the courtyard first.
So Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan worked together to lift the stone slab back to its original position, firmly covering the cellar entrance.
"Okay, let's go, go home first, come back when you have time."
Xu Shiyan straightened up, patted the ashes on his hands, and said to his wife and children.
The children were hungry for a long time. When they heard that they were home, they were all happy, and they followed their parents and went out.
"Dad, where are those boxes? Don't you need to move them?"
Xu Jinping looked around, but she didn't seem to see where the boxes were put. She couldn't help but feel a little strange, so she asked.
"Oh, when you went out to buy a blower just now, I discussed with your mother, let's put it in the sandwich wall first.
Moving things out in broad daylight is too conspicuous, so your brother and I will come back at night. "
Xu Shiyan could only make up a reason and fool around.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui didn't feel anything, they ran in front of them bouncing around.
Xu Jinping, who was at the back, came to her brother, reached out and tugged at Xu Haiyuan's sleeve.
"Brother, when we went to buy a blower just now, did you find something in the cellar?"
The little girl felt very keenly that her parents and brother were acting a little strangely.
Xu Haiyuan laughed when he heard this, and raised his hand to rub the top of his sister's head.
"What's in this head? It's full of random thoughts every day.
If there is something under there, why not tell you? "
Hehe, there is really something under there, but I can’t tell you.
Especially about Xu Haiqing's loudspeaker, it's better to know less about it.
Xu Jinping pushed away her brother's mischievous hand, and raised her eyes to glance at him.
"Hehe, are you pretending again? You think I'm that idiot Xu Haiqing, and I just let you fool me?
Not to mention falling down, I don't even know it. " Xu Jinping snorted.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying walked at the back.
Hearing the conversation between the siblings, the husband and wife looked at each other, smiled wryly and shook their heads helplessly.
These two monsters are smarter than the other. Xu Jinping is a girl, her thoughts are more delicate, and she is also more difficult to deal with.
Xu Haiyuan didn't respond to his sister's words, and then Xu Shiyan and his wife didn't say a word.
A group of people left the yard like this, went outside and locked the gate, and returned to the small courtyard.
