After the family returned to the small courtyard, they found that the three of Yang Junxian hadn't come back yet, probably they were still cleaning up the house there.
The kids are hungry and go in and out of the kitchen to find something to eat.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying didn't plan to eat anymore, they went directly to move half a watermelon, and they dug with spoons to eat.
"If there is nothing to do here, we have to hurry up and go home.
I feel that these days are getting hotter and hotter. I can't guarantee that the highest temperature will come one day.
It’s too hot here, and I suffer, so I’d better go back to the Northeast for comfort. "Su Anying muttered while eating.
"Well, there's nothing else to do, just waiting to get the house book.
Otherwise, we will take the children to climb the Great Wall tomorrow, and find a place to wander around the day after tomorrow.
I guess it's only a few days, Fang Ben'er should be almost done. "
Xu Shiyan sent a lot of things over there, and he promised that the house would be available within three or four days at most.
"Okay, then do as you said, wait for Fang Bener to arrive, and then we will go back quickly.
It won’t work if I’m out for a long time, I still have a lot of things to do at home, and I have to go to Yangcheng after a while. "
The couple are very busy people, it is already very good to be able to take a break from their busy schedule to play with the children these days.
"In the future, every winter and summer vacation, let's take the children out to play, so that they can learn a lot."
Xu Shiyan sat on the chair, looking at the children bouncing and playing in the small courtyard, he felt in a particularly good mood.
People, what is the purpose of busying your whole life? Isn't it just a child?
As long as these little guys are happy, it doesn't matter if parents are busy or tired.
"If there is an opportunity in the future, we can also take them abroad to see the scenery around the world."
"Okay, they can go anywhere as long as they like."
Su Anying dug a mouthful of watermelon and brought it to Xu Shiyan's mouth for him to eat. Then she turned to look at the children and said with a smile.
Around four o'clock in the afternoon, Yang Junxian's family of three came back.
From the way they looked, it was clear that the three of them had indeed gone to clean up, and they were still very tired.
"How is it? How much repairs are needed in the house over there?"
Xu Shiyan waved at Yang Junxian and asked with a smile.
"The house has always been lived in, and the dilapidation is not that serious.
But there were many tenants living there before, and some people built it privately, but some sheds had to be demolished.
Also, these people moved away, leaving behind a lot of rubbish. The three of us worked hard all day, so we managed to clean it up.
I'm exhausted, I feel like I haven't done so much work for a long time, and my back hurts. "
Yang Junxian thumped his back and sat on the chair.
In the past few years, the family's ginseng has been hired by others. One of Yang Junxian and his wife is busy with the fertilizer factory, and the other is traveling with Su Anying on business.
Busy is busy, but I seldom do those strenuous tasks anymore.
Xu Shiyan smiled and handed a piece of watermelon to Yang Junxian.
"You just have to find someone to do these jobs, but the three of you really do it yourself."
Yang Junxian was not too polite, and just gnawed on the watermelon.
"The main thing is to look in the past, the yard is full of mess.
Your brother and sister love to be clean, so they can't stand the mess. We have no choice but to clean it up. "
Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian sat chatting at the door of the main room, while Su Anying and Ji Yufeng went into the kitchen to cook.
After dinner, everyone watched TV for a while and chatted for a while.
Yang Junxian's family of three were very tired, and they lay down early to sleep.
At nine o'clock, Xu Shiyan and Xu Haiyuan, father and son, went out and drove straight to the courtyard with the flashlights of household appliances prepared in advance.
The two parked the car at the entrance of the alley, walked into the alley, and came to the gate of their own house. The key unlocked and entered the courtyard.
Entering the courtyard, Xu Shiyan carefully inserted the gate from the inside, and the father and father went straight to the third courtyard with flashlights.
Arrived outside the kitchen door of the Sanjinyuan, lifted the stone slab again, and the two of them went down to the cellar with flashlights.
This time it is much more convenient to have a flashlight. The father and father touched the mechanism with ease, opened the secret room in the cellar, and walked in.
Two flashlights are much brighter than a match.
At this moment, the father and father finally understood that the room inside was bigger than the outside, and it was also very neat, surrounded by stones.
It is estimated that there is a vent somewhere, anyway, it is quite dry inside, not as damp as expected.
On the ground, besides the four small boxes that Xu Shiyan and the others put in, there were several boxes of different sizes.
Xu Haiyuan stepped forward with a flashlight and saw that all the boxes were locked with locks.
This was hard for him, and he easily opened the lock.
Xu Shiyan stepped forward, and the father and father worked together to open the box.
"My God, here is Datou Yuan."
Inside the first box are rolls of things wrapped in red paper.
Xu Shiyan opened a bag and found that it was full of silver dollars, which is what people often call Yuan Datou.
That roll should contain one hundred silver dollars. This box is not small. It is conservatively estimated that there are tens of thousands of silver dollars.
Xu Shiyan was a little excited, and Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiyuan opened the other boxes one by one.
Among them, two large boxes are filled with fabrics.
All kinds of silk and satin, silk embroidered, wrapped in something unknown, but there is a faint fragrance.
The fabrics are all in good condition, not faded or damp and moldy, they are still as bright as new.
But Xu Shiyan didn't do much research on these things, and didn't know what it was all about, so he just rewrapped it as it was, and covered the box.
There is also a big box, which contains a lot of books, calligraphy and paintings.
Because of the good preservation, those calligraphy, paintings and books are very complete, without damp and moths.
I don't know if it was an illusion, but Xu Shiyan felt that there was a faint fragrance of medicine in the box.
It is estimated that the person who put these things in the first place put some spices in it to prevent moths.
Xu Haiyuan reached out and took out a few books to read.
Xu Shiyan glanced at it, and found that it seemed to be something like a medical prescription. "Yuanyuan, what is that? A medical book?"
"Well, it should be a famous doctor's medical practice handbook and family secret recipes. It is quite old, and I see that the writing in it is quite interesting."
Xu Haiyuan flipped through a few pages, nodded, closed the book, and put it back in the box.
"Then do you want to take these books back?"
Xu Shiyan immediately became interested when he heard that it was a medical handbook and a secret recipe.
For him, no amount of gold, silver and jewelry can compare to these prescriptions, which are the most precious things left by his ancestors.
With these things in hand, it will be a big deal in the future.
"Well, I'll pick one later, just take a few back with me, and come pick up the rest when I have a chance."
Xu Haiyuan nodded, since there are secret recipes in medical books, he must take them away.
"Take too much, Pingping will definitely find out."
The younger sister of his family is not easy to fool. Right now, it is not appropriate to let too many people know that there is a secret room in the cellar.
"Okay, then you pick it, and I'll see what's in the other boxes."
Xu Shiyan nodded, went over by himself, and opened the remaining two boxes to check.
One of the big boxes contains boxes of all sizes.
Xu Shiyan took out one and opened it. Inside was a white jade biscuit with intricate patterns carved on it.
Find a bigger box and open it, inside is a pair of porcelain vases.
Needless to say, there should be all kinds of utensils and ornaments.
Those who can be placed in this secret room must be very precious and valuable.
There is also a small box, which contains some gold and silverware, all of which are very beautifully made, with gems on them.
Xu Shiyan looked at the boxes in front of him, and felt that his brain was not enough.
How much are these things worth?
Not to mention anything else, just for Yuan Datou, after twenty years, maybe one piece will cost a hundred and ten yuan, right?
There are tens of thousands of pieces in that box, how much is that?
And those Yuan Datou should be the most worthless things here.
Those porcelain ornaments, gold, silver and jade wares, you may take out any one at random, and the minimum cost is 1.8 million.
God, is he dreaming? Is this really what happened? Why does it feel so unreal?
Didn't even dare to think like this in my dreams, but it really happened before my eyes?
How old is this house? At least one or two hundred years, right?
Experienced so much turmoil, I don’t know how many owners have changed, and how many people have lived there.
No one found this place? No one found these things? Impossible?
Then, the first day their family came here, they found them all?
Why does it feel so weird? Is it too weird?
"Yuanyuan, tell me, isn't what happened today a little weird?
How could it be such a coincidence that we discovered these things? "Xu Shiyan couldn't hold back, and muttered.
Xu Haiyuan's eyes flashed, and his face seemed a little uncomfortable.
It's just that it's very dark inside, and it's hard to see clearly with only two flashlights.
Xu Shiyan was only thinking about his own thoughts and didn't notice.
"Father, didn't they say that those who are blessed don't need to be busy? Perhaps, our family has this blessing?
This kind of thing, who can say it well, maybe it's just a coincidence. "
Xu Haiyuan smiled, and hugged the four books he just picked out in his arms.
"Dad, it's getting late, let's go back first, these things are placed here for the time being, it should be quite safe.
When we have a chance in the future, let's transport it away again. "
The cellar is still some distance away from the ground, unless it is demolished and rebuilt here, it can be found when digging the ground.
Otherwise, it would not be easy to be found.
There is no solution to this kind of thing, how could Xu Shiyan figure it out? Anyway, everything is in front of you, you have to believe it if you don’t believe it.
"Okay, I'll listen to you, let's go."
After finishing speaking, the father and father came out of the secret room inside, Xu Haiyuan touched the mechanism and closed the door.
The two of them went up the steps, put the stone slabs back in place, and then left the yard all the way back to Xu's small courtyard.
When they returned home, it was past eleven o'clock, and there was no movement in the courtyard.
The two fathers entered the door lightly, Xu Shiyan returned to the main house's east room, and Xu Haiyuan returned to the east wing.
Yang Haoyu was sleeping soundly on the bed, and he didn't notice at all that Xu Haiyuan, who was in the same room with him, went out and came back again.
At the landlord's house, Su Anying stayed up all this time, waiting for Xu Shiyan and his son to come back.
Seeing that Xu Shiyan returned safely, Su Anying was relieved, "How is it? What's in the cellar?"
It would be a lie to say that Su Anying was not curious. Now that she saw Xu Shiyan, she hurriedly asked.
Xu Shiyan took off his clothes and got into bed, and at the same time told Su Anying about the things hidden in the cellar.
When Xu Shiyan finished speaking, Su Anying was dumbfounded.
"My God, there are so many things in it? Isn't this catching up with a treasure house?
God, can this good thing happen to our family? We bought a house here, and we still brought so many things? "
Su Anying was a little excited and exclaimed.
"Keep your voice down, Pingping lives in the Westinghouse, don't wake her up.
That girl is smart and clever, so it's not easy to fool her.
Yuanyuan said that for the time being, those few should not know that there are many things hidden in the cellar. "
When they found the sandwich wall, they didn't realize it, and they should have thrown the children out at that time.
How many things are hidden in the sandwich wall, there are so many in the cellar, let alone the children know.
Su Anying let out a long breath, and turned to look at Xu Shiyan in the darkness.
"Why do I feel that this is so mysterious today? I have lived there for many years, but I haven't found a cellar or anything.
Didn’t you also say that someone must have gone down and searched before then? No one found out?
In the end, we just bought a house and cleaned it, and we found it all in less than a day? "
Su Anying also had the same doubts as Xu Shiyan.
This is really unbelievable. Their family is so lucky?
If this is the case, what kind of company do you work for?
Simply, come to the capital to buy a house, buy a house and dig three feet to find treasures.
You don’t need to find so many, just one-tenth of what you have today.
There is still a house. Buy it now and sell it in the future. I think you can earn a fortune. This deal is too good.
Xu Shiyan almost laughed out loud when he heard his wife's remarks.
"Don't do it, you have to be content to be a human being.
It's considered a lucky encounter for us, keep these things well, they will be useful in the future.
Don't be greedy and think about finding another treasure. "It's impossible to say that Xu Shiyan is not tempted.
Buying a house in the capital is earning money. If you really find some treasures somewhere else, you will make a lot of money.
But these are partial wealth, not the right way, so let's go to work and work in a down-to-earth manner, don't be whimsical.
Here, the couple kept talking about it for half the night without falling asleep, thinking about what happened today.
At this time, in the east wing, Xu Haiyuan was lying contentedly under the blanket, thinking about the day's events.
Yes, those treasures did not fall into the hands of outsiders.
Thanks to his father's knowledge, he knew that he came to the capital to buy a house, otherwise, who would get those things.
That brat Xu Haiqing was really lucky.
The hidden place between the walls was unexpectedly discovered by him by accident.
Sure enough, that sentence was answered, those who are blessed don’t need to be busy.

chapters.title: Chapter 780: Xu Shide's promotion
chapters.content:
Chapter 780 Xu Shide's promotion
On July 24th, Xu Shiyan and the others took their children to climb the Great Wall.
When I came back in the afternoon, the children were so tired that they lay on the bed and didn't want to move.
"I just said, it's better to stay at home?" Xu Haiqing complained while shouting tired.
"It's better to clean up the house. I didn't go to look at the two yards of our house."
This kid, he is still thinking about treasure hunting.
In his heart, he thought that those two courtyards might also hide treasures in the corners.
Rather than climbing the Great Wall to death, it is more interesting to go treasure hunting.
"Cousin, don't people say that if you don't go to the Great Wall, you are not a good man?
Look, we have finished climbing the Great Wall, so we are a serious man.
Climbing the Great Wall is tiring. It's interesting. Cleaning up the house is purely tiring. I don't know what you think. "
Nan Xiaoliang is one year younger than Xu Haiqing, he can't understand what his cousin is thinking, can tidying up the house be more fun than the Great Wall?
Xu Haiqing rolled his eyes, thinking you know what a fart, there are good things hidden in our house, which is much more interesting than the Great Wall.
But he can't say this outside, he can only hold it in his heart.
In the evening, Jin Liu came over and told Xu Shiyan that the other side notified that the house book was almost ready, and asked Xu Shiyan to go to the real estate department to pick up the house book tomorrow.
Xu Shiyan was naturally very happy when he heard this, so he thanked Jin Liu and gave Jin Liu two boxes of good cigarettes.
Jin Liu helped Xu Shiyan buy a house, running errands back and forth, and the benefits are true.
Just from Xu Shiyan’s side, he was given a total of more than 10,000 yuan, and there were also a lot of things like tobacco and alcohol.
Otherwise, can Jin Liu do his best to help run forward and backward?
"Mr. Xu, no matter what you have in the future, just ask me.
As long as I Jinliu can do it, there is absolutely nothing wrong with it. Even if I can't do it, I will find a way to ask someone to do it for you. "
Jin Liu took the cigarette and said it very sincerely.
"Okay, I will have to trouble Brother Jin in the future. As time goes on, let's get along slowly." Xu Shiyan nodded with a smile.
Jin Liu is good at work, reliable and righteous. Of course, it was also Xu Shiyan who gave the money in place.
When climbing the Great Wall during the day, Xu Shiyan discussed with Xu Haiyuan that they would have to come back again during the winter vacation and try to find a way to buy a few more shops.
The gold in the cellar is not worth saving to wait for the appreciation, and it is also meaningless to directly convert it into money.
The best way is to use the gold to buy some real estate and shops.
Especially in the capital and the Shanghai stock market, you can buy as much as you can.
Nowadays, many people go abroad. Gold and American knives are in short supply, and they are very easy to sell.
If you want to buy a house or shop in the capital, you must have a middleman. Jin Liu must maintain it.
Jin Liu chatted with Xu Shiyan for a while before leaving.
Xu Shiyan sent Jin Liu away, and just returned to the house, just in time for the weather forecast to be broadcast on TV.
I heard the announcer saying that tomorrow is likely to usher in the highest temperature of the year.
"Huh? Isn't this the highest temperature? It's hot enough these days, and it's going to be hotter?"
When the weather forecast was over, Su Anying couldn't help complaining there.
"It's okay, Jun Xian and I will go get the house book tomorrow morning. As long as we get the house book, we can pack up and go back."
It’s not too long since I’ve been out, and I still have a lot of work at home, so I can’t delay too long.
Anyway, I climbed the Great Wall, saw the flag raising, visited the Forbidden City, ate roast duck, and bought a house. This trip to the capital has gained a lot, and it’s time to go home.
"How many of you are there? Where else do you want to go? Let's take a look when we go back?"
Xu Shiyan turned to look at the children, asking for their opinions.
After all, it was agreed when I came here that I would take them to places like Chengde and Beidaihe.
In the end, in order to buy a house, I didn’t go anywhere, so I stayed in the capital.
"Dad, we don't want to go anywhere, we want to go home." Xu Jinping said with her mouth pursed.
"It's hot here, I can't stand it, it's better to go home.
Besides, we have been out for too long, I miss my grandparents, grandma and grandpa. "
"Well, I don't want to play anymore, I want to go home." Xu Jinhui also said.
Girls are more emotional and love home. They have been out for so long, even though they are accompanied by their parents, they always feel that it is not their own home.
One more thing, it’s really too hot here, the girl’s hair is long, and when she sweats, the hair sticks to her face and neck, making her uncomfortable.
Xu Haiyuan, Xu Haiqing, these stinky boys are different. They shave their short crew cuts in summer, which is cool and comfortable.
"Well, godfather and godmother, I want to go home too."
Yang Haoyu always followed what Xu Jinping said, and when Xu Jinping said he wanted to go home, Yang Haoyu didn't even look at his parents, he nodded quickly and said he wanted to go.
Three of the five children said they wanted to go home, leaving two Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing, what can they say? What dare to say?
Xu Haiqing was afraid of his sister, like a mouse seeing a cat, his sister stared, Xu Haiqing nodded immediately.
"Well, we want to go home too."
As for Xu Haiyuan, he loves his sister the most, so what else can he say?
"Let's go home, I'm going to be in the third year of middle school in autumn, go back and read books, preview new lessons."
Just like that, on the morning of the 25th, Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian went to the real estate department to get the house book.
Stop by the train station and buy a No. 26 ticket.
Su Anying and Ji Yufeng hurriedly went shopping while the morning was still not so hot.
It's hard to come back to the capital, so I have to bring something to relatives and friends.
Everything that needs to be packed has been packed, and Nan Zhendong and his wife are called in the evening, and the big guys go to have a meal together.
During the dinner, Xu Shiyan told Nan Zhendong to help him find a professional maintenance worker to repair those houses as much as possible.
Especially for the courtyard with four entrances, the main body remains unchanged, and the original appearance is restored as much as possible.
This matter was quite simple for Nan Zhendong. He knew a lot of people here, so he readily agreed.
Nan Xiaoming and Nan Xiaoliang knew that their cousin was leaving, so they were reluctant.
These seven children are playing together all day long, which is very lively. When Xu Haiyuan and the others leave, there will be only two brothers left.
But there is nothing I can do if I can't bear it, I can only make an appointment, and we will get together again during the winter vacation.
On the morning of the 26th, a group of people rushed to the train station and got on the train from the capital to Tonghua.
This time I bought a soft berth. Xu Haiyuan and Yang Junxian were together with the family of three, and Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui squeezed together in the lower berth.
The soft sleeper is more spacious than the hard sleeper, and the two girls can pass without a squeeze.
On the morning of the 27th, the train arrived in Tonghua, and the group had a quick meal before boarding the train from Tonghua to Songjianghe.
Anyway, there are not many people here in summer, and the car is not crowded, and it is very spacious.
In addition, the temperature here is not so high, so I finally feel a lot more comfortable.
After one o'clock in the afternoon, the train arrived at Songjianghe. The family received the news in advance and arranged a car to pick up the station.
Xu Shiyan went out for the past few days, and it was not too late this afternoon, so he didn't go back to work, but went home with Su Anying and the others.
"You guys are back. How is the journey going? I read the weather forecast and said that the capital has been extremely hot in recent days?"
Zhou Guilan and Xu Chenghou were very happy to see San'er's family back, and hurriedly asked.
"Well, the temperature was quite high on the 25th. As soon as we heard about the highest temperature, didn't we immediately pack up and come back?"
Xu Shiyan and his wife just laughed, they were simply driven back by the high temperature.
Otherwise, the children would definitely not come back so early, they still want to go to those two yards to find treasures.
"Father, Mom, how is your family doing?"
Although I often call back outside, how can I say much in three or five sentences on the phone?
When I came home, I naturally had to ask in detail if there was any major event at home recently.
"At home, it's okay, everything is fine."
When Zhou Guilan opened his mouth to say something, Xu Chenghou coughed.
Zhou Guilan swallowed what was on her lips, and only said that everything in the house is fine.
"There is nothing wrong at home, and Jinfeng finished the college entrance examination.
That day your elder brother called and said that Jinfeng's grades were probably not satisfactory.
Ask if you can think of a way, Toto relationship or something, to find a school for Jinfeng to study? "
Xu Chenghou coughed twice to clear his throat, and mentioned Xu Jinfeng's exam.
"Oh, that's fine. Let's wait for the results to come out. If it doesn't work, just think of a way." Xu Shiyan didn't say anything else.
In her previous life, Xu Jinfeng's college entrance examination results were not very good.
Later, a friend of Xue Xiulin found a way to send her to Changchun Bank University to study. She studied a junior college and was assigned a job after graduation.
Later, Xu Jinxiu did not pass the college entrance examination, and did not get good grades after two years of repeated studies.
At that time, Xu Jinfeng fell in love with someone and had some contacts, so Xu Jinxiu was also sent to study at the Banking University.
From the bottom of his heart, Xu Shiyan doesn't really want to interfere with his niece's college studies.
The most important thing is that the object of the eldest niece is also from the Bank University.
The two got along very well in school. They got married half a year after graduation, and their relationship has always been very good after marriage.
Although Xu Jinfeng married far away, she has a very high status in her husband's family.
Besides, the niece and son-in-law are all good in terms of family background, character, and appearance. After working, they went to graduate school and have a good future.
When Xu Shiyan was reborn, he seemed to have become the vice president of a listed bank.
If you want to send your niece to college, Xu Shiyan naturally has connections.
Shenye Company cooperates with several schools such as Shenyang Pharmaceutical Sciences, Changchun Agricultural University, Changchun Chemical Industry, etc., and there are places for targeted training every year.
Xu Jinfeng is her niece, so it's not a big deal to occupy a spot.
In these schools, Xu Shiyan can easily send his niece to these schools just by saying a word.
But in this way, wouldn't it ruin the niece's marriage?
It would be fine if Xu Jinfeng had a bad life in his previous life, but he is living a very good life, very happy.
If one of them fails and breaks up the two people who were supposed to be together, Xu Shiyan's crime will be aggravated.
"Well, it's not urgent, I just want to tell you.
Your sister-in-law said that her elder sister with the same surname has connections. If it can't be done over there, you can just find a way. "
Xu Chenghou couldn't hold back, he still filled a bag of cigarettes, lit it, and smoked it.
"One more thing, the fourth child took the cadre selection test before and passed.
I called yesterday and said that I was going to be transferred to Beigang as the mayor.
In autumn, Jingyi doesn’t need to study here, but goes to Beigang to study. "
Xu Chenghou remembered another thing and told Xu Shiyan about it.
Xu Shiyan was taken aback for a moment, this was quite unexpected.
In his previous life, the fifth child took part in the cadre selection examination, and was transferred from the director of Xinglong Township Finance Office to Yushu Township as the deputy head.
The fourth child worked as an accountant at the Xigang Township Finance Office until retirement.
In this life, the fifth child was transferred to the county finance bureau, and now he is the deputy director. Unexpectedly, the fourth child was transferred to Beigang Town instead.
"Beigang Town? Why was it transferred there?" Xu Shiyan asked casually.
"Cough, you don't know, on the 19th, Beigang town organized government officials and their families to travel to the north **** of Changbai Mountain.
As a result, the bus they were in fell off the cliff on the way down from the top of the mountain. There were 53 people on board, 51 of them died and 2 were seriously injured. "
Zhou Guilan brought two bowls of cold noodles from the kitchen and put them on the table, just in time to hear what her husband and son were saying, so she said something.
When Zhou Guilan said this, Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered that someone seemed to have mentioned this in his previous life.
But at that time, he was working on the mountain all day long, and it was a long time before he heard people talk about it, and he didn't quite know when it happened.
In the past few years after being reborn, the memory of her previous life is not so clear.
Except for some important events and things that happened around him, he really couldn't remember anything unless someone else mentioned it.
"The fourth child is going to go, and this job is not easy to do. Okay, let me say hello to the other side when the time comes."
Xu Shiyan still has a lot of contacts in the county, so it's okay to say hello and take care of the fourth child.
"Well, if you know that side well, you can just say hello.
After all, the fourth child has just arrived here, and he is not familiar with the place where he lives, and something happened there again, so the work is not easy to carry out.
It is always more convenient for someone to take care of you. Zhou Guilan nodded, turned around and walked out again.
Su Anying took a look, how could the mother-in-law be busy serving them both inside and outside? So he went to the kitchen.
Not long after, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law brought a few bowls of cold noodles, calling Xu Haiyuan and the others to eat.
In late July, Donggang is not cool here, and it is especially hot at one or two o'clock.
It would be so comfortable to eat a bowl of cold and delicious cold noodles at this time.
The children don't care about that anymore, they just eat when they are bored.
"Oh, I miss my grandma's cooking the most when I'm outside.
It’s hot there, and we often eat water noodles, cold noodles, etc., but it’s not as comfortable as the cold noodles made by my grandma. "
Xu Haiqing kept his mouth still while eating noodles.
Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping and the others all curled their lips when they heard this.
Xu Haiqing, that brat, has a good mouth and is the best at speaking.
When he was in the capital, he praised the delicious noodles made by his third aunt, and when he came back, he praised his grandma for the cold noodles, and said that he missed the rice cooked by grandma the most.
Actually? When he was in the capital, every time he went out to eat out, he ate more than anyone else.
Forget it, this guy has no other strengths, this is the only strength left, let him keep it quickly, don't expose it.
The brother and sister on the other end looked at each other and reached an agreement. Neither of them hesitated to care about Xu Haiqing, and they were too lazy to expose his old background.
In this way, Xu Haiqing was not exposed by his brother and sister, but instead coaxed Zhou Guilan into a smile and a happy heart.
Zhou Guilan watched her little grandson eat quickly, and went back to serve another bowl.
"Eat slowly, why are you in a hurry? You have made a lot of milk, just keep full."
Seeing her grandson's voracious eating, Zhou Guilan couldn't help but feel distressed. Did the child not have enough to eat in the capital?

chapters.title: Chapter : A New Year's letter to book friends
chapters.content:
A letter to book friends in the New Year
Hello, dear readers!
This is the platform's New Year's event. The author publishes a single chapter with the title "A Letter to Book Friends in the New Year", which will automatically trigger the easter egg chapter. Readers who participate in the comment interaction can draw prizes.
I’ve been too busy recently, and I haven’t had time to write a single chapter. At this time, I’ll take a break from my busy schedule to write a little bit, and take the opportunity to chat with everyone casually.
This book has been serialized at the starting point since June, and it has been more than half a year now. Thanks to all the readers who support this book. Without your support, I might not really have the confidence to write it down.
Everyone who joined the group knows that the author is a woman, and this is the first time I have written a book on a male channel. I have always wanted to write a male video, but I never dared to do it.
The main reason is that I am worried that my writing skills are not good enough, that I cannot write the story in my heart, and I cannot satisfy the readers. After hesitating for more than half a year, I finally gritted my teeth, submitted a manuscript to the editor, and opened a new book at the starting point.
At the beginning, I thought about practicing pens, and it would be great if I could get full attendance or something. Unexpectedly, the new book will be liked by so many readers, which gave me the courage to continue writing.
Looking back on the past half a year, there are hardships and difficulties, but most of them are moved.
I will carefully read the comments and comments of all readers, so as to review my own shortcomings, and hope to write works that will satisfy you.
Currently, this book has more than 10,000 subscription points, and has already obtained the 10,000 subscription badge.
It should be said that this is the best work I have ever written. I sincerely thank you for your support and encouragement.
The new year is coming soon, here I wish all readers a happy new year, everything will be successful, happy and happy, free from worries. May we all go smoothly, prosperous and healthy next year!
In addition, I would like to take this opportunity to say that this book is expected to be completed with more than two million words. I want to write about the 1998 or 2000 years, when the state-owned enterprises are restructured, the plot is basically the same.
As for the development of the children, I may write something extra. If you have any extras you want to watch, you can leave a message.
Also, what kind of books do you want to read?
Currently, I have two ideas, one is what I said about Kanto Shenwang, and I want to write some stories about breaking through the Kanto. It should involve logging by gangs, rowing gangs, and digging ginseng by gangs. There will be more folk customs in Northeast China.
The other one is the story of a lumberjack. I want to write about some experiences and stories of the old forestry workers in the early days of the Forestry Bureau. Which one do you like, you can also leave a message.
Well, that's it, and finally I wish all readers a happy new year with family reunion and happiness!

chapters.title: Chapter 781: Domineering Granny Zhou
chapters.content:
Chapter 781 Domineering Granny Zhou
After dinner, Xu Haiyuan went to find Elder Chu, while Xu Shiyan and his wife accompanied Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan to chat and talk about their return to the capital.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were obviously very happy.
Especially when he learned that his third son had bought a few more houses in the capital, Xu Chenghou nodded repeatedly, praising Xu Shiyan and his wife for their brains.
"That's right, the money has been getting worse and worse in recent years, you can't just keep it in the bank, you have to take it out and do something.
Yingzi's side is a company, a store, and the entire factory. It looks like it's booming, but it's also busy.
It’s better to buy a house and land. When the time comes, this can’t be a loss. "
Xu Chenghou is still a bit old-fashioned in his bones.
Isn’t that what the elders were like back then? If you live frugally and save some money, buy a house and land quickly.
Especially the land, what is that? That is a cornucopia. Only when there is land can there be harvest, and only when there is harvest can there be money.
Although it is a new society now, there are no more landlords, and land is not allowed to be bought and sold, but houses are allowed, and it is absolutely fine to invest in them.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan behaved quite normally, they talked and laughed, and chatted with their son and daughter-in-law very warmly.
But Xu Shiyan felt that his parents seemed to be hiding something.
What's the matter? Can not guess.
Xu Shiyan wanted to ask a few times, but just as he opened his mouth, Xu Chenghou cut him off.
The more this happened, the more Xu Shiyan suspected that there must be something wrong at home while they were away.
I just don’t understand why my parents kept it from him.
The old couple refused to talk, and no one gave Xu Shiyan any doubts, so he thought about asking Chu Xuanhuai in the evening.
In the evening, Zhao Jianshe and others came to join in the fun when they heard the news of Xu Shiyan's return.
Then, Zhao Jianshe's casual words solved Xu Shiyan's doubts all afternoon.
"Third brother and third sister-in-law, you came back late, and you didn't see my aunt's posture of fighting with others.
I have known my aunt for many years, but I have never seen her so powerful. "
The matter was quite troublesome, Zhao Jianshe thought that when Xu Shiyan came back, the old couple Xu Chenghou would definitely be able to talk.
So Zhao Jianshe yelled out in a moment of quick talk.
Xu Shiyan's face immediately changed when he heard it, "Father, what's going on, who did my mother fight with?"
It is definitely not a trivial matter to make Zhou Guilan anxious to fight with others.
Now in Donggang, who else dares to provoke the Xu family? Who is this?
As soon as Xu Shiyan said this, Zhao Jianshe and others realized that Xu Shiyan didn't even know before the old couple said it.
"Oh, look at my mouth, I owe you so much. Uncle Xu, I didn't know you didn't mention this to my third brother."
Zhao Jianshe slapped himself directly, what a shame.
Xu Chenghou glanced at Zhao Jianshe and couldn't help but sigh.
"It's nothing, my mother beat him up and smashed him up.
She didn't suffer, so I didn't mention it when you came back, lest you make trouble. "
The son and daughter-in-law just came home, and the family is very happy.
Xu Chenghou meant, don't mention those unhappy things.
It’s been a few days since Zhou Guilan didn’t suffer, so there’s no need to bring it up again, and it will make everyone unhappy.
Unexpectedly, Zhao Jianshe spoke quickly, but he said it out.
"What's going on? Dad, Mom, tell me quickly."
When Dad said that, Xu Shiyan became even more anxious, and asked again.
"What's going on?
Someone looks at our family’s prosperity and sees our children’s success. They are jealous and want to pour dirty water on the children.
Then can I let it? Say I can, dare to say my child, I can't beat her to death. "
Over there, Zhou Guilan didn't hide it anymore, and told Xu Shiyan and his wife what happened.
It turned out that as soon as Xu Shiyan and the others left, some rumors that were unfavorable to Xu Jinping spread from the neighbors in this neighborhood.
Rumors said that Xu Jinping had a bad life style at a young age, and when she went out to compete in the county, she actually lived with a boy.
Some people also said that why Xu Jinping and a boy are together all day long, the two have a close relationship, and they live together when they go to the competition.
Anyway, the rumors were spread with nose and eyes, as if they all saw it with their own eyes.
Xu Jinping went to the county to compete. It was the teacher who took nine students to live in the big house. After returning, Xu Jinping told her family about it.
The family members also felt that they were all teenagers, and there were more than ten people in a room, and there was a teacher in front of them. What is this?
The Northeast sleeps on a kang, and people sleep on a kang during the New Year and holidays.
The Xu family didn't care at all, and never thought that such rumors would spread.
So, when Zhou Guilan heard people talking about this, she was very angry.
These people are too wicked, his granddaughter is only a child, how can he ruin the child's reputation like this?
Actually, not many people really believe this rumor.
The character of the Xu family's children is obvious to all, who doesn't know?
Moreover, everyone can guess who the boy in the rumors is, it must be Yang Haoyu, the son of the Xu family.
Those two children slept in the same room, they ate in the same bowl and slept in the same kang.
Those are siblings who grew up together, and they are not outsiders at all.
The old men and women around persuaded Xu Chenghou and his wife, saying that no one believed this matter at all, so they should not care about it.
But Xu Chenghou's violent temper, how could he swallow it? At that time, I was furious.
Even Zhou Guilan was very angry, and immediately asked who sent these words.
They are all from the same town, and the Xu family is very popular. Everyone is looking for the Xu family. It is not easy to find out who is spreading rumors?
It didn't take much effort for Zhou Guilan to find out that it was none other than the mother-in-law of the Qin family who spread the rumors, and everyone listened to her.
Zhou Guilan found out the source of the rumor, and without a word, she went to find Mrs. Qin to settle the score.
When he arrived at Qin's house, he beat up Mrs. Qin's head and face, and smashed the glass and water tanks of Qin's house.
After finishing all this, Zhou Guilan stood in the courtyard of the Qin family, pointing at Mrs. Qin's nose and cursing.
Zhou Guilan went to Qin's house to fight with Mrs. Qin, causing quite a commotion, and there were many spectators around.
Taking advantage of the opportunity of scolding and confronting Mrs. Qin, Zhou Guilan also explained to everyone that her granddaughter went to the competition.
When everyone heard it, it turned out that the teacher led the children to live in a big house, not Xu Jinping living alone with the boys.
Now, the big guy pointed at Mrs. Qin and cursed.
They all said that she was not a thing, confounding black and white and making up nonsense, which was intended to harm people.
If the little girl hears about this and can't think about it, then Mrs. Qin will do a big crime.
Then Mrs. Qin couldn't stand being scolded by the big guys, so she could only shout that she also heard what others said.
Under Zhou Guilan's questioning, Mrs. Qin said that she heard about it from the Jiang family.
It turns out that Mrs. Qin has a granddaughter named Qin Lina, who is in the same class as Xu Jinping and Jiang Chunhong.
The Xu family was a little unhappy with the Qin family, so Qin Lina always followed Jiang Chunhong, flattering her ass.
Jiang Chunhong's family conditions are good, but the Qin family's life is poor. Sometimes Jiang Chunhong will give Qin Lina clothes she doesn't wear, or used stationery and schoolbags.
That day, Qin Lina went to Jiang's house to play and didn't come home for dinner. Mrs. Qin went to look for her.
Just in time, I heard Jiang Chunhong's mother, and the daughter-in-law of the Wu family next door to Jiang's, chatting across the garden stick.
It happened to be about the children going to the competition.
Jiang Chunhong's mother's words were inconsequential, but her daughter was unlucky and didn't get the easy questions.
By the way, let me just say that the children of some families look very well-behaved, they study well, and they are some kind of captain.
Private life is chaotic, not clear with boys, they live together when they go out to compete, etc.
Then Mrs. Qin had a feud with Xu's family, she tried several times to make plans with Xu's family but failed, and she was very angry.
As soon as she heard this, Mrs. Qin regained her spirits.
She doesn't care whether those words are true or not, and she starts spreading rumors when she turns around, telling everyone she meets.
Actually, most people don't believe it, and many people refute Mrs. Qin face to face, telling her not to talk nonsense.
Be careful that the Xu family finds out, and they will not be as good as her.
Of course, there are also some people who are jealous when they see the prosperity of the Xu family.
These people don't care whether it's true or not, as long as they can discredit the Xu family, they are willing to spread it.
Just like that, the rumors spread more and more fiercely, reaching the old couple of the Xu family.
Actually, there is no need to think about this matter. It must have something to do with the children who went to the competition together.
But the biggest spreader of rumors is Mrs. Qin, so Zhou Guilan came to find Mrs. Qin first.
She planned to go back to the school and the teacher, and check from house to house, to get justice for her granddaughter.
As a result, Mrs. Qin couldn't bear it, so she spoke directly to the Jiang family.
Now, Zhou Guilan quit, and went to Jiang's house with a stick.
Coincidentally, at this time, Han Caie also came to hear the news at home, as well as Zhou Guilan's niece Zhou Lirong.
So a group of people went to Jiang's house again, caught Jiang's daughter-in-law and cleaned it up, almost tore Jiang's daughter-in-law.
In this way, Zhou Guilan became famous in the first battle. No one expected that a person who is usually so gentle would be so frightening when he gets angry.
After hearing this, Xu Shiyan and his wife were also very angry.
Xu Shiyan slapped the table, got up and was about to go out.
"Third brother, why are you going?" Huang Shengli and the others saw it and hurried forward to stop him.
"I'm going to find Jiang Hongsheng, his wife and daughter are heartbroken and spread rumors about my daughter.
I am a big man and can't argue with women and children, so I will settle accounts with him. "
Xu Shiyan is on fire, needless to say with this posture, he is going to beat someone up.
"Third brother, sit down, it's not that the brothers stop you, the key is that you can't find anyone."
Huang Shengli dragged Xu Shiyan back.
"Ah? What do you mean?" Xu Shiyan froze for a moment, not understanding why Huang Shengli said that.
"His family has moved. My aunt took people to Jiang's house to make trouble the next day. Someone saw them and they moved away."
Huang Shengli shook his head and sighed.
"It must be that Jiang Hongsheng knew that his wife and children were in trouble, and he was afraid that you would trouble him, so he quickly moved away."
"This kid is also a bachelor. He knew that the third brother couldn't be provoked. He probably was afraid that you would come back for revenge, so he hurriedly moved away."
On the other end, Zhao Jianshe also explained.
"If the monk can run away but can't run away from the temple, then I will go to his unit. Isn't he from the grain office? Then I will go to the grain office."
Xu Shiyan was still angry, and still wanted to trouble Jiang Hongsheng.
"Third brother, you said that if we could find him, our brothers would have vented this anger for you a long time ago?
The kid seems to have been transferred and left. We tried to find him, but we couldn't find him. "
Huang Shengli shook his head. This Jiang Hongsheng has two brushes. He moves very quickly when he moves house and job.
Before others could react, their family disappeared, and they couldn't find anyone to trouble him.
"Fuck, what a ghost this kid is, he slips away pretty fast." Xu Shiyan couldn't hold back, and cursed.
What the **** is this called? Want to beat someone up, why did you run away early?
"Does he dare to be unhappy? If he doesn't run quickly, when the third brother and third sister-in-law come back, there will be good fruit for him?" Zhao Jianshe snorted.
This is the truth. With Xu Shiyan's current ability, it really doesn't take much effort to clean up the director of a food station.
He doesn't even need to show up himself, just make a phone call and move his mouth.
"Run? Let me see where he can go?" Xu Shiyan snorted coldly.
Unless Jiang Hongsheng doesn't want his job, otherwise, as long as he is still within the county, it is not difficult to find him.
Since Jiang Hongsheng can't even manage his wife and daughter well, he must not be able to do his job well, so why not go home and discipline his wife and children well.
"Father, Mom, you don't need to hide these things from us in the future, and you don't have to face them in person at my mother's age, just wait for us to come back and deal with them.
I've been with Yingzi until now, if I can't even protect my family, it would be a waste. "
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying sat next to their parents to comfort them.
"You two are old, don't get angry because of this shit.
We have everything, just leave it to us. "
"It's okay, your mother and I are still tough, and it doesn't take much effort to clean up a few people." Zhou Guilan waved her hand nonchalantly.
"It doesn't matter if these people mess with me, I don't want to get angry with them, but it's absolutely not okay to mess with my grandchildren."
The old lady is the most protective of children in her life, and the older she gets, the worse she becomes.
These grandchildren, she sees more closely than her eyeballs, dare to arrange her granddaughter? That's okay?
If she didn't tear up those people with her own hands, how could she come out like this?
Xu Shiyan and his wife were amused by what their mother said, and laughed, "Yes, my mother is mighty and domineering, the most powerful."
Xu Shiyan's words made everyone in the room laugh, and the depression and suffocation they had before disappeared with the laughter.
Seeing that it was getting late, Huang Shengli didn't stay long, so he got up and said goodbye to go home.
Xu Shiyan and his wife wanted to keep them at home for dinner, but they all waved their hands and declined.
In desperation, Xu Shiyan went out with him, gave Huang Shengli a few, and everyone chatted at the door before leaving.
Xu Shiyan and his wife both had a lot of work to do, so they didn't get much rest after returning home, and went to their own business the next day.
Xu Shiyan returned to work, first arranged work matters, and then called the County Grain Bureau to inquire about Jiang Hongsheng's whereabouts.
Then I learned that Jiang Hongsheng entrusted someone to work at the Lushuihe Grain Depot.
Xu Shiyan didn't say anything else, just mentioned something to the other end of the phone.
This man surnamed Jiang hastily transferred his job. Is there a problem with his original position, and he is afraid that people will check him?
How many idiots are there who can work in government agencies? As soon as people heard this voice, they knew something was wrong.
So I hung up the phone and immediately arranged a working group to investigate Jiang Hongsheng's original workplace.
Jiang Hongsheng transferred work in a hurry and left, and there were many things he didn't hand over clearly.
This investigation is not important, but many things were found out.
The accounts at the Grain Office are chaotic, and the grain in stock does not match the amount, and the gap is very large.
Needless to say? That must be something wrong with Jiang Hongsheng.
Therefore, the superior department immediately took measures against Jiang Hongsheng, and then found out that Jiang Hongsheng had many problems.
You know, before the mid-1990s, the grain port was definitely a good unit, with a lot of oil and water.
Jiang Hongsheng has been the director for many years, so how can the benefits be less?
Just like that, Jiang Hongsheng not only lost his job, but also got in.

chapters.title: Chapter 782: I feel so bad
chapters.content:
Chapter 782 Distressed, so big
Xu Shiyan could only shake his head when he learned that Jiang Hongsheng had gone in.
If you don't work, you won't die. It should be about the situation of the Jiang family, right?
It stands to reason that this was originally a small conflict between the two children, and it should not be raised to the parents, let alone punish people with dead hands.
But the couple of the Jiang family acted too unethically, so don't blame Xu Shiyan for being cruel.
Obviously the teacher lived with the nine children, but the daughter-in-law of the Jiang family spread rumors that Xu Jinping lived alone with the boy because the daughter didn't win the prize. This was really sinister.
So Zhou Guilan knew the source of the rumor, and went to Jiang's house to find someone to settle the accounts, no problem at all.
When encountering such a thing, you must not swallow your anger. You must let the rumor maker know how serious it is, so that you will not dare to do it again in the future.
As long as Jiang Hongsheng is sensible and able to handle things, he should bring his wife and daughter to Xu's house to apologize after learning the truth.
Youdao means that killing people is nothing more than nodding, and the Jiang family apologized sincerely. With the behavior of Xu Shiyan and his wife, can we still argue with them?
The two families talk about the matter, and this article is considered to be over.
But what did Jiang Hongsheng do? He moved away directly with his family, and even transferred his job in a short period of time.
Why?
Zhao Jianshe said that day that Jiang Hongsheng learned that his wife and daughter had caused trouble, and was afraid that Xu Shiyan would settle accounts with them, so he ran away with his family.
Xu Shiyan felt that this might not be the case.
Then Jiang Hongsheng probably didn't feel that his wife and daughter did something wrong, so he didn't want to lower his head at all.
He moved away because he probably felt that Zhou Guilan made such a fuss and lost face.
Originally, it would be embarrassing for the family to be disturbed by Zhou Guilan once. If he went to the Xu family to apologize again, wouldn't he be ashamed?
How will you hold your head up in front of your neighbors in the future? How do you still work in the unit?
Jiang Hongsheng has been able to work as the director of the Grain Institute for many years, and he must have a background and backing.
So this kid gritted his teeth and simply transferred his job and moved away.
There is no need to bow to the Xu family, and avoid embarrassment among neighbors and colleagues in the future.
It's a pity that Xu Shiyan is a man who can be serious, and also a slave to his daughter, who loves his daughter to the bone.
The Jiang family ruined Xu Jinping's reputation so much, and they refused to apologize when they were clearly wrong. How could Xu Shiyan be willing to let it go?
Want to escape after changing jobs or moving house? How can it be so easy?
It’s great to have a background and a backer? Then try breaking your wrists.
Xu Shiyan doesn't care about what will happen to Jiang Hongsheng and his family in the future. Anyway, he just needs to avenge his daughter.
The rest is all up to the Jiang family.
Xu Shiyan is busy, so he has no time to pay attention to other things.
It’s August, and there’s not much time left before this year to participate in the production.
The busiest season of the year is coming, and the whole company has to work hard to prepare in advance, and must complete the autumn production and processing tasks on time and on time.
As soon as Xu Shiyan came back, the provincial government called him to ask Xu Shiyan to give lectures in the provincial training class.
The province held a training class to help farmers to impart knowledge on rural diversification, development of aquaculture, and deep processing of products.
In this regard, Xu Shiyan has many years of practical work experience. It can be said that he is an expert in this field, much better than those experts who talk on paper.
So the province hoped that Xu Shiyan could go over and give lectures for a few days.
The leader has spoken, can Xu Shiyan go?
I happened to go to the province to meet with the leader, chat, report on work, and get in touch with each other.
Especially regarding the matter of the health care products factory, you should also have a good chat with the leader and explain a few words by the way.
After all, the health care product factory was led by Xu Shiyan, and in the name of the company, it was jointly established with Su Anying's company.
This matter sounds like a public-private partnership, seeking a way out for Changbai Mountain ginseng sales.
To put it bluntly, this is the husband-and-wife shop opened by Xu Shiyan and his wife.
As long as someone's mouth is crooked, Xu Shiyan will be given the name of using public interest for personal gain, and it will be light to do work.
Xu Shiyan didn't think much about it before, but after Jiang Hongsheng's incident this time, Xu Shiyan also became vigilant.
Some things should be on guard, there are more people with background and background than him, what if someone doesn't like him?
It's not that he has to be reluctant to be the general manager of the participating company, but there are some things that will take a lot of work without the title of the general manager of the state-owned company.
Of course, Xu Shiyan can also choose to lie flat.
With their current wealth, even if they don’t do anything, they can live a leisurely life wherever they go.
But people live a lifetime, there must be some pursuit.
Xu Shiyan came back from rebirth, and always wanted to make a difference in the ginseng industry.
Now it can be said that he has seen most of the completion, so why is he willing to stop here and waste all his efforts?
Xu Shiyan was invited to give lectures in the province, and stopped by the Agricultural University to visit several experts and professors, and went to the Medical University to meet many people.
After going back and forth, more than half a month passed. When Xu Shiyan came back, the primary and junior high schools just started.
Xu Shide was transferred to Beigang for work, and his wife and children must follow him. Xu Jingyi transferred from Donggang Central Primary School to Beigang Central Primary School.
In the past few years, Xu Jingyi has been in Donggang with her brothers and sisters. She has good study habits and good grades, so changing schools will not affect her too much.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui are still studying in Canchang Primary School. These two children have good grades, and the teacher already likes them.
In addition to Xu Shiyan's face, the whole school took extra care of them, and no one dared to mess with them.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu are already the first-year students of Donggang Middle School.
After entering junior high school, the two of them were finally not in the same class. Xu Jinping was in class one, and Yang Haoyu was in class two. The two classes were next to each other.
Both of them had very good grades in junior high school, and were appreciated and loved by the class teacher.
Because the two were always class leaders during elementary school, and they were no exception in junior high school, this time they both became class leaders.
As soon as school started, Xu Jinping showed extraordinary abilities.
Take the girls in the class, arrange the learning garden and the cultural wall, and decorate the class with a new look, which is full of cultural atmosphere.
Next, at the school art festival in September, several calligraphy and painting works were exhibited and won several awards.
Xu Jinping's award-winning works were directly selected by the school and sent to the county to participate in the ginseng festival art exhibition held in the county.
Speaking of the Ginseng Festival, the county has stopped holding the Ginseng Festival with great fanfare since it caused trouble in 1989.
Now only enterprises and institutions in the county participate, and domestic and foreign businessmen are no longer invited, and it is not as grand as before. It has become a festival among the people of the county.
There will be no foreign businessmen participating, no Shenwang Auction, and no agricultural products fair.
The ginseng festival, which was originally warm and grand and generated hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue, has since declined.
The glorious scene of that year only exists in people's memory.
Xu Jinping's work won an award at the Ginseng Festival, and was later selected to be sent to the city and province, winning successive awards.
Winning honor for the school also made Xu Jinping the most dazzling and outstanding student in Donggang Middle School after Xu Haiyuan.
Of course, Xu Haiyuan, who is already in the third year of junior high school, is not overshadowed by his younger sister's light.
As soon as the third year of junior high school started, the teachers of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry almost got into a fight in order to get Xu Haiyuan to participate in the subject competition.
This year, there are national competitions for the three subjects of mathematics, physics and chemistry in junior high school.
If you get the ranking in the national competition, you can get extra points in the senior high school entrance examination, and you can even be recommended to a technical secondary school.
The subject competitions in the first and second grades of junior high school are just small fights, mainly for the purpose of selecting students for key training, and the real chapter will be seen in the third grade of junior high school.
How should I say it?
Donggang Middle School is, after all, a middle school in the town, with limited teaching staff and poor qualifications. It is incomparable to those teachers in big cities.
The usual teaching tasks are simple, and they are competent, but in terms of competition coaching, these teachers are a little lacking in ability.
Over the years, Donggang Middle School has not achieved much results in mathematics, physics and chemistry competitions.
It is very good to get a ranking in the city.
In the second semester of the second year of junior high school, Xu Haiyuan participated in the competitions of mathematics, physics, biology and English.
Among them, mathematics and English won the second prize in the county, biology and physics won the first prize in the county, and the second prize in the city.
This is considered to be a relatively good result of Donggang Middle School participating in the competition over the years, and Xu Haiyuan has also become a favorite in the eyes of the teachers.
Mathematics and physics teachers are robbing people, and the chemistry teacher who just started the third year of junior high school also anxiously joined the ranks of robbing people.
Competition tutoring is free, but if students win prizes, tutors get bonuses and can also be judged on professional titles.
After finally meeting a good seedling, which teacher is not jealous?
In this way, the teachers of the three subjects refused to give in to each other, and the head teacher had no choice but to seek Xu Haiyuan's opinion.
Xu Haiyuan didn't care about these things, he just said that he would listen to whatever the teacher arranged for him, and he would go to whichever subject he was asked to go.
Finally, the teachers of the three subjects discussed and decided to split the time.
Two self-study classes in the afternoon, two evening classes, and an extra hour after evening class.
In this case, Xu Haiyuan can participate in competition training in three subjects.
When the time comes, it doesn’t matter which subject wins the prize, it will still be the honor of the school.
Xu Haiyuan and the others at this time had six subjects in the senior high school entrance examination: mathematics, Chinese, English, politics, physics, and chemistry.
Geography and biology are finished in the second year of junior high school, and history is not finished, but they do not take the senior high school entrance examination.
Originally, the third grade of junior high school has a lot of homework. As soon as the school starts, the teachers of all subjects want to pass on all the knowledge of the third grade of junior high school to the children.
They stared at the timetable staring at each other, whether it was sports or self-study, they all relied on their ability to grab classes.
If you can grab a session, it counts as a session, if you can talk a little bit more, you can keep more homework.
Other children participating in the competition is a subject, even if it is self-study or evening class for training, it will not delay other courses.
But Xu Haiyuan took three subjects at once, and had no time to go back to class since the afternoon self-study, and could not leave school until nine o'clock in the evening to go home.
After I got home, I had to do the homework for the competition class and the homework left by the teachers of each subject.
Even if Xu Haiyuan did the questions quickly, he would not be able to sleep until after ten o'clock every day.
"Son, do you need me to talk to your school?
How could a student be so attractive? Why is it that no one else from your school can participate in the competition? Why is this still trying to squeeze a sheep?
You don’t go to bed until ten o’clock every day, and you wake up at five o’clock in the morning to read again.
伱How old are you? It’s time to grow your body, and you can’t sleep enough. "
September and October are the busiest time for the Xu family.
Su Anying wants to bring ginseng to make goods, and also go to the ginseng market to grab the goods for processing, not only to supply the three stores of Zhencaotang, but also to foreign merchants.
Not to mention Xu Shiyan, with so many clubs participating in the field, he had to come back to make goods, process them, and experiment with new products.
The whole company was busy with their feet, and Xu Shiyan often came home very late.
Every time Xu Shiyan came back, he would see the light on in the eldest son's room. He went in and saw that his son was doing a problem.
Xu Shiyan didn't care at first, but after a long time, he felt distressed.
"If it doesn't work, you can quit two subjects and keep one you like, and you won't be tired."
This guy is a competition question and homework, which kid can stand it?
"Dad, you don't need to look for a school, I think it's okay."
Xu Haiyuan shook his head, but he didn't feel that it was too hard. For him, this was also a challenge.
"I can still handle it now. I try to finish as much homework as possible at school, and when I get home, I just pick up some competition questions."
When his son said so, Xu Shiyan didn't recruit him.
"Then are you hungry? Dad, go and make you something to eat. It's easy to get hungry when you study at night. Eat something before you learn."
Xu Shiyan felt sorry for his eldest son, because he was afraid that his son would study hard and his nutrition would not keep up, which would ruin his body.
"Your mother and I are busy these days, and it's true that I can't take care of you.
Otherwise, I will buy you some snacks or something, and you will eat when you come home hungry. "
When a child of this age is able to eat, his stomach is like a bottomless pit, almost like carrying a hungry bag. You must be hungry after learning so late.
"Dad, you can do whatever you need to do, there are Pingping and my grandma.
In the afternoon, my grandma cooked the meal and asked Pingping to give it to me. When I went home in the evening, Pingping made me something to eat. "
There is an evening class in the third day of junior high school. There is a 40-minute break between the two self-study sessions and the evening class in the afternoon.
Children who are close to home go home to eat, and children who are far away can only eat at school.
There is no cafeteria in junior high school, but there is a steamed stuffed bun seller at the door, and they come every afternoon.
But there are few steamed buns, and there are many people buying food, so I can’t grab them if I go late.
Many people can only go to the store, buy a twist or bread for a bite, and wait for the evening class at 7:30 to go home for dinner.
Xu Haiyuan still has to attend training after evening class, and he won't be home until after nine o'clock, so he can't just deal with it and eat.
Every day, Zhou Guilan carefully prepared meals and put them in lunch boxes. Xu Jinping ran home after school, and then gave the meals to her brother to the class.
Xu Haiyuan was eating while doing his homeworkreciting questions and so on.
In the evening, Xu Jinping guessed that it was about the same time, so she made something to eat in advance.
As soon as my brother came in, the hot food was served, and he just finished eating before going to study.
"Thanks to your grandma and your sister."
Xu Shiyan sighed, and sometimes felt that the husband and wife were working so hard, and they didn't know whether it was right or wrong.
Xu Shiyan chatted with his son for a few words, seeing his son chatting and writing questions at the same time, it is not good to delay the child any longer.
Only told his son to go to bed early, and left.
In the blink of an eye, it's November, and the ginseng fields have been planted, and the processing plant is almost busy.
Su Anying bought a ticket and set off for the south.
It's the New Year soon, and the peak season of the health care products market is coming, and agents from all over the world are ordering in large quantities.
Su Anying was worried about the factory, she had to go over and watch it herself.
In mid-November, the trials for the junior high school Olympic competition also started.
The school arranged teachers to take the students to the county to participate in the competition.
The competition is scheduled to be held on Sunday, with mathematics on November 17th, physics on the 24th, and chemistry on December 1st.
Xu Haiyuan had to take part in all three subjects, so he went to the county by car every Saturday.
The examination room for the competition was at the County Continuing School, where Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping went to participate in the one-minute quiz.
The selection competition is basically a written test, which takes two hours on Sunday morning, and returns by car in the afternoon after the test.
Sorry for posting so late. During the day, people come to the house, and they are cooking, cooking and entertaining. At least in the evening, they stare at each other and wake up before they can write.

chapters.title: Chapter 783: Selected to the second round
chapters.content:
Chapter 783 selected for the second round
The results of the trials will come out about ten days later.
After the results came out, each county and city would select a few representatives and go to the provincial capital to participate in the second round of selection.
The winner can represent the provincial team and go to the capital to participate in the national competition.
Xu Haiyuan just came back from the chemistry competition. On Monday morning, he went to self-study. The homeroom teacher and math teacher entered the fast class beaming.
"Congratulations to Xu Haiyuan, you won the first prize in the county and the second prize in the city in this math competition."
There was thunderous applause in the class, and the students all applauded vigorously to congratulate Xu Haiyuan.
"Congratulations to the monitor, our monitor is amazing, awesome."
The boys shouted happily, and some even whistled.
Xu Hai has been king of kids since elementary school.
No matter where she goes, she can subdue the boys in her class, and she is very loved by her classmates.
So when the students learned that Xu Haiyuan had achieved good grades, they were sincerely happy for him.
The first monthly exam after the beginning of the third year of junior high school will be divided into classes according to the results of the monthly exam.
One express class, one back-reading class, one intermediate class, and the rest are parallel classes, that is, slow classes.
After   , every monthly exam and preliminary exam will be adjusted according to the results.
That is to say, the last few in the fast class may be transferred to the middle class, and the first few in the middle class may also be transferred to the fast class.
Xu Haiyuan's grades have not dropped since the day he was in school, and he is not under the pressure of being divided into classes.
However, after entering the third year of junior high school, Xu Haiyuan was unable to take care of various affairs in the class due to competition training.
So the teacher chose a steady girl as the class monitor, and Xu Haiyuan was the deputy monitor.
After the students had a good time, the class became quiet.
After that, the math teacher called Xu Haiyuan out of the class.
"This time, our county selected two students to go to the province to participate in the second round of the competition. You happened to be ranked third, so you were not selected."
The math teacher felt very sorry, Xu Haiyuan's math scores were already the best in Donggang Middle School in years, and even he was not selected, and it is estimated that someone will go to the province to participate in the competition in the future.
This is the gap in the strength of teachers.
In many cases, it is not that the students are not good enough and do not work hard, but the level of the teacher determines the students' achievements.
"Well, thank you teacher, I understand." Xu Haiyuan nodded, accepting the reality calmly.
Competitions are different from studying for exams. Xu Haiyuan knows that his ability is limited, so he is not disappointed.
"Okay, go back and study hard. There are still two subjects that have not yet come out. Maybe there will be surprises in those two subjects."
The math teacher patted Xu Haiyuan on the shoulder, sighed, and let Xu Haiyuan go back to class.
Xu Haiyuan is in a good state of mind and has not been affected in any way. He goes to class, leaves school, and reviews step by step every day.
The three subjects are over, so he doesn't have to stay up late every day like before.
Basically, I go home after school in the evening, and I can rest after doing a little homework.
A few days later, the results of the physics competition came out.
Compared to mathematics, Xu Haiyuan's physics scores are a little better, the county's first prize, the city's first prize, and was successfully selected for the second round.
Now, several teachers in the physics group jumped up with joy. This is the first time someone from Donggang Middle School has been selected to participate in the provincial competition.
What was even more unexpected was that a few days later, the results of the chemistry competition came out. Xu Haiyuan was also selected for the second round.
The venue for the second round of competition is the Provincial Education College, and the competition will start on December 15th.
Mathematics first, followed by physics and chemistry. Each subject takes two days, with a one-day break in between, and then the next subject.
That is to say, mathematics is taken on the 15th and 16th days, physics is taken on the 18th and 19th days, and chemistry is taken on the 21st and 22nd days.
The second round of the competition is to select students from various counties and cities. A county will only select two students, and the number of places in the city will be a little more. About a prefecture-level city can select a dozen students to go to the province.
The city sent a competition notice to every student participating in the second round of the competition, which clearly stated the competition time, place and other related matters.
And explain that the city will arrange two teachers to accompany them.
Each participating school can arrange for a teacher or parent to accompany it, but the board and lodging expenses are at their own expense.
It was the first time that a student from Donggang Middle School went to the provincial capital to participate in a competition, and they were all alone in physics and chemistry.
The school leaders made a decision immediately, and arranged for the two teachers to follow. All the expenses were given by the school, and Xu Haiyuan's safety and health must be guaranteed.
"Dad, I'm going to the provincial capital to participate in the competition in two days. I will leave on the 16th and come back after the 24th."
After he didn't need to participate in the competition training, Xu Haiyuan left school at around 7:30 and went directly back to his grandparents.
Xu Shiyan has not been so busy recently. Every day after get off work, he goes to his parents first, and then chats with his parents for a while after dinner.
Wait for Xu Haiyuan to come back to have a bite, and then I will go home together.
So when Xu Haiyuan said that he was going to the provincial capital to participate in a competition, the Xu family immediately became lively.
The three old people Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan, and Chu Xuanhuai were surprised at first, and then became happy, and the grinning was called happiness.
"Okay, okay, great, our family is very good, not only going to the county to compete, but also to compete in the provincial capital."
The three of them nodded and said hello to each other.
On the other end, Xu Haiqing and the others who were watching TV were jumping for joy when they heard it.
"Wow, my eldest brother is amazing, and he is going to compete in the province.
Brother, you must play well and come back with an award. "
Xu Haiqing jumped to his brother's side, and said with excitement and envy.
"Brother, if you get a place in the provincial competition, can you still participate in the national competition?"
Xu Jinping is in the first year of junior high school, and she usually hears it from the teacher, so she knows more, so she asked.
"Well, yes, those with excellent results will be selected for the provincial team and participate in the national competition. But how many can be selected in our province, I don't know."
Donggang Middle School didn’t even participate in the provincial competition before, let alone the national competition, so the teacher didn’t know.
"Brother, then I wish you smooth sailing in this competition and a title on the gold list.
Strive to enter the provincial team in the first few exams and represent our province to participate in the national competition. "
Xu Jinping raised her right hand, high-fived her brother, and sent blessings.
"Okay, with my sister's auspicious words, I will definitely perform well this time, try to get a good grade in the exam, and bring glory to our family."
Xu Haiyuan also raised his hands, high-fived his sister, and said with a smile.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui saw that they quit, and rushed over to give their brother a high-five and send their most sincere blessings to him.
Xu Shiyan was also full of joy when he saw the children laughing and making trouble, but at the same time, he also had regrets in his heart.
To be honest, what the couple did was really not qualified.
Didn't provide much help for children's studies, and even failed to take good care of them in life.
Thanks to the sensible children in the family, especially the two older ones, it is really super worry-free. Not only do they study well, but they also take care of their younger siblings.
If this was changed to another family, the parents would let go, and the children would not know how many troubles they caused.
It is true that most people are like this these days.
There is no parent who pays special attention to their children's study, and no parent who accompanies their children to do homework every day.
Children learn independently. If they learn well, they will continue to study. If they do not learn well, they will come down to work in the fields.
The era has created people's concepts. People in this era are used to it, and no one thinks it is bad.
But Xu Shiyan is different after all. From the bottom of his heart, he always feels that he owes the child.
"Third brother, are you busy at work recently?"
