Xu Chenghou happily filled a bag of cigarettes and just lit it when he suddenly remembered something and hurriedly asked his son.
"It's been okay recently, not as busy as September and October."
The company is on the right track, with a clear division of labor, and Xu Shiyan doesn't need to do everything himself, which is much easier than before.
"Then take a few days off and accompany Yuanyuan to the provincial capital for the competition.
This is a big deal. I don't feel at ease if the child is handed over to someone else. "
Xu Chenghou lit the pipe, took a puff, and then said.
"Yes, yes, your father is right, we Yuanyuan are going to compete in the provincial capital this time, which is different from going to the county before.
You can’t let your child go alone on such a long road, so don’t worry if you follow us. "
Over there, Chu Xuanhuai nodded in agreement when he heard it.
Zhou Guilan is the same, very much agree with Xu Chenghou's proposal.
"Grandpa, grandma, master, I just went to the provincial capital to participate in a competition.
The school arranged for two teachers to accompany them, and I heard that the city will also arrange teachers to lead the team, so I don’t need my dad to accompany me?
This whole thing seems so grand, it makes people laugh. "Xu Haiyuan immediately objected.
As for it? He just went to the provincial capital to participate in a competition. This guy's school arranged for two teachers, and his father followed him. What's the trouble?
Make others laugh out loud when they see it?
"It's okay, just happened to have some things recently, I need to go to the province, and I will accompany you to the competition along the way."
Xu Shiyan felt guilty just now, but now he finally has the opportunity to make up for his eldest son, so he must follow him to the provincial capital.
"That's fine."
Xu Haiyuan saw that his grandparents, grandparents, teachers, and father were all looking at him with expectant eyes.
How do you say this rejection? Come on, anyway, the family is not short of the money for food and lodging, so let's go together.
As soon as he heard his son agreed, hey, Xu Shiyan was so happy.
"Then it's settled, I'll go back to work tomorrow to arrange work.
Mom, you will pack two more sets of clothes for Yuanyuan tomorrow, and you will go out in the cold weather. It will be six or seven days.
The weather is cold at this time, so bring some warm clothes. "
From mid-to-late December to around the Gregorian calendar, the weather is the coldest. It will be a pain to go out and take a car, so you must bring more clothes.
"Okay, okay, don't worry about this matter, leave it to me. You just need to take care of my eldest grandson."
The old lady was so happy that she couldn't close her mouth from ear to ear, she agreed without saying a word.
"Yuanyuan, remember to tell your teacher tomorrow, you don't need to worry about train tickets, I will buy them for you."
Nowadays, to go to the provincial capital, you can take a train or a bus.
Songjianghe has a direct bus to the provincial capital. It departs at six o'clock in the morning and arrives at the provincial capital in the afternoon, which is more convenient than the train.
Of course, with Xu Shiyan's status, it's no problem to get a better car and drive to the provincial capital.
But Xu Haiyuan is going to participate in a competition, and it is not suitable to take a bus or bring his own car.
One is safety issues. The roads are slippery in winter, and various conditions on the roads are unpredictable.
Once something goes wrong and the game is delayed, it would be a pity.
Another, Xu Haiyuan and the others will go to the Hunjiang River, join other people, be led by the team leader teacher, and set off together, so the train is the most suitable.
Although the train is slow, you can take a sleeper, which is relatively more comfortable.
"Uh, well, then I'll tell the teacher."
Xu Haiyuan was speechless for a while, is his father overly happy?
This guy doesn't even need the school to manage the train tickets, so he is in charge?
It's just a game, so why make it so exciting?
But looking at the excited faces of his father and grandparents, the words of refusal circled around his mouth several times, but he couldn't say it.
Forget it, let’s coax the family to be happy. After all, it’s only one chance for three years in junior high school.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan went back to work the next day to arrange work and asked for leave.
Zhou Guilan packed clothes and other things for her son and grandson at home.
On the morning of December 16, the company arranged a car to pick up Xu Shiyan and his son, and then went to pick up the school's physics and chemistry teachers.
A group of people went straight to the train station, got on the train and went straight to the Hunjiang River.
When I arrived at Hunjiang Railway Station, as soon as I got out of the station, I found someone holding a sign outside to meet the station. The physics teacher hurried forward to contact him.
Xu Haiyuan and the others came to Hunjiang by the express train in the morning, and it was around two o'clock in the afternoon when they arrived at Hunjiang.
The train to the provincial capital was nearly nine o'clock in the evening, and there were still six or seven hours in the middle, so we couldn't stay at the station.
So the relevant person in charge of the city arranged for them to go to the guest house to rest.
Wait for all the contestants to arrive, have a meal together in the evening, and then set off together.
In the Northeast of this year, the winter is quite cold. Everyone wears a lot of clothes and covers them tightly.
So the person in charge of reception did not recognize Xu Shiyan standing beside Xu Haiyuan.
Waiting for everyone to arrive at the guest house, when the staff registered, Xu Shiyan happened to take off his hat and scarf, and was recognized by others.
"Excuse me, are you Mr. Xu of the participating company?"
You must know that Dongfang Ginseng Company is definitely one of the best large companies in the city and is very famous.
Xu Shiyan has been on TV several times, not to mention ordinary newspapers and magazines, there are always several interviews a year.
The person in the guest house just now looked at Xu Shiyan's familiar face, and didn't remember it for a while.
Isn’t this the name of the registered guest? As soon as Xu Shiyan said what his name was, people immediately thought of who it was.
"Ah, yes." Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, but he didn't expect to be recognized at a glance in the city.
Anyway, there is nothing to hide, since you recognize it, then admit it openly.
"So it's really Mr. Xu.
I saw that you looked familiar just now, so I took the liberty to ask, but I didn't expect it to be you. "
The staff of the guest house were so excited that their writing hands trembled slightly. He wrote the word and it flew away.
"Well, this time I'm going out with the child, please excuse me." Xu Shiyan nodded with a smile.
Beside   , the two staff in charge of the reception in the city were dumbfounded.
Is this Mr. Xu? Why didn't they recognize each other at all just now?
"Oh, Mr. Xu, I'm sorry, we didn't even recognize you.
What about that, how about I give you another place to rest? "
"No need, just a few hours, don't be so troublesome.
Originally, the child would not let me follow this time. If you make it too grand, I will never want to go out with the child again in the future. "
Xu Shiyan accompanied his son to the competition, and he wasn't the protagonist, so how could he steal his son's limelight?
Besides, it’s just a few hours of rest, what’s not working, why is it mobilizing teachers and mobilizing people, everyone knows about it?
"It's fine here, please everyone, I will take the child to rest first."
Xu Shiyan nodded with a smile, then carried his luggage and walked to the room with his son.
Here, Xu Shiyan and his father had just entered the room to rest, and the staff responsible for the reception quickly picked up the phone at the front desk and reported the situation to their leaders.
"Director Li, that one has something to report to you.
Just now we received Mr. Xu from Dongfang Ginseng Company. He said that he accompanied his son to participate in the competition. "
The receptionist was from the Education Bureau. Their leader knew that Guan Enxue had a good relationship with Xu Shiyan, so he hung up the phone and hurriedly reported to Guan Enxue.
Then, Guan Enxue found out that Xu Shiyan accompanied his son in the competition.
"Okay, this stinky boy, taking his son to compete, doesn't even say hello to me when he passes by the city."
Guan Enxue hung up the phone, first complained to the secretary, then picked up the phone, and called Chen Jianzhang and Lin Qiyue.
"Lin, do you have time? That little Xu came to the city and said that he was passing by to accompany his son to the provincial capital for a competition.
Hurry up and make arrangements, we will find him later, and we have to arrange a meal at night. "
Guan Enxue's temper, it's fine if he doesn't know Xu Shiyan is here, since he knows, he must arrange a meal.
Today’s update is here. I don’t think there will be a regular update in the past few days. When will it be written and posted. It should be fine in two days, I try to write more.

chapters.title: Chapter 784: Li Kui and Li Gui
chapters.content:
Chapter 784 Li Kui and Li Gui
Xu Shiyan accompanied his son out to the competition, and in order to let the child have a good rest, he specially asked for a room for two.
Of course, the two teachers together also arranged a room for two.
Xu Shiyan is not short of this little money, no matter where he goes, he has to make arrangements.
The father and father had just entered the room to rest for a while, Xu Shiyan was lying on the bed staring in a daze, when suddenly he heard someone knock on the door.
Get up and open the door to see, good guy, Xu Shiyan was taken aback.
"Secretary Guan? Chen Bureau, Forest Bureau? Why are you here?"
Xu Shiyan didn't react for a while, so he asked. In fact, he recalled the truth as soon as he said it. It must be that the reception staff reported it to the higher authorities.
"Secretary Guan, quickly enter the room.
I am just accompanying my child to the provincial capital for a competition. I pass by the city and think about it for a few hours, so I don’t want to disturb you. "
Xu Shiyan stepped aside quickly, and invited Guan Enxue and others to enter the room.
Guan Enxue and the others came over as soon as they received the news. Seeing Xu Shiyan at this moment, Guan Enxue put on a tiger face on purpose and gave Xu Shiyan a blank look.
"I think you are just alienating us.
Don’t worry about how many hours you are here, even if you are just backing up at the station, just let us know in advance and we can arrange it for you. "
"Yes, yes, I was thinking too much, and I always felt that such a trivial matter should not bother the secretary.
After all, it’s almost the end of the year, and you’re busy with work. "
What can Xu Shiyan say? If Guan En learns to talk, then he will listen.
"Come into the house, come in and sit down."
"No, let's not go in and delay the child's rest. Come on, let's find a place to sit and chat for a while.
I asked someone to arrange a restaurant. Later, we will pick up Yuanyuan and go have dinner together. "
As soon as Guan Enxue arrived here, he told the people in the guest house to arrange a separate room for them so that they could sit down and chat for a while.
The main reason is that the conditions of this guest house are average. The downstairs is just a simple bar and a restaurant, which is not suitable for chatting.
Xu Shiyan turned his head and looked at his eldest son. The train was rattling and rattling, but it was quite a tossing. Let the eldest son take a good rest.
"Okay, listen to the secretary's arrangement.
Yuanyuan, let me chat with you Grandpa Guan and Uncle Chen for a while, you rest here. "
Xu Shiyan is not yet forty, and Guan Enxue is twenty years older than him. This age difference must be an elder, so Xu Shiyan said so.
As for Chen Jianzhang and Lin Qiyue, they were both in their early fifties, not much different from Guo Shouye.
Usually, they and Xu Shiyan are called brothers and sisters, so Xu Haiyuan has to be called uncle?
Xu Haiyuan stood behind Xu Shiyan, obediently calling out, "Grandpa Guan, Uncle Chen, and Uncle Lin."
"Hey, good, good, this child is smart at first glance, what a rare person."
Guan Enxue looked at Xu Haiyuan with a smile on his face, with a loving face.
"Well, you should rest first, and get enough energy to go to the competition. Let's chat with your dad, and wait for grandpa to take you to dinner."
Just like that, Xu Shiyan followed Guan En and went to the room opposite to sit down.
The person in charge of the guest house heard that Secretary Guan was coming, so he hurriedly brought tea or something.
Xu Shiyan chatted with Guan Enxue in this room, mainly talking about the health care product factory.
"Xiao Xu, I heard that your daughter-in-law's Jishengyuan health care product is very popular now, with annual sales of several hundred million?
Well, let's see if we can build another factory in our city?
Now the economy here is in a recession, and the benefits are not very good. Many factories have stopped working and production, and the workers have nothing to do at home.
Among other things, the pharmaceutical factory in your county is half dead.
Old often told me several times, asking me to help you find a way, just happened to meet you today, so I thought about asking you to give me an idea. "
Guan Enxue and Xu Shiyan have known each other for many years, and they have a very good relationship, so they didn't beat around the bush and said straight to the point.
Jishengyuan Health Products Factory is really popular this year. Su Anying called back that day and said that by the beginning of December, the sales had reached 600 to 700 million.
Now there are agents and distributors in all regions, which can be said to be in full bloom and a thriving scene.
It is expected that there will be another wave of sales peaks during the Spring Festival this year.
Currently, people working overtime in the factory are rushing for orders. The workers work in three shifts, and the machines don’t stop.
Thanks to the fact that Xu Shiyan reminded them in the summer that all kinds of raw materials are fully prepared when autumn comes, and there will be no shortage of raw materials.
However, behind the prosperity, there are also some hidden dangers.
Ji Tongzhong visited the market for a while and found that similar health products began to appear in some places.
What Gushengyuan, Jiyingyuan, etc., use the shape of the word to beat the edge and imitate the packaging.
Ordinary people will easily be fooled if they don’t distinguish carefully.
Not only these imitation products, but also some independent brands and trademarks, but the formula composition is similar to Jishengyuan's products.
The main functions are also those, regardless of whether it is really the same, anyway, it is written on the outer packaging.
At present, there are not many such situations, but this is a bad sign. If no measures are taken to deal with it, it may affect the reputation of Jishengyuan.
However, Xu Shiyan can't come up with a good plan for how to deal with it.
The main reason is that the country currently doesn’t pay much attention to trademarks and patents. Even if they want to go through formal channels, the relevant departments may not be willing to take care of them.
Furthermore, many of the counterfeit ones are small workshops, black factories and the like, without formal procedures, and they probably don't even have a factory building.
When they heard the wind, they ran away, and the wind continued. Even if they were caught, they didn't have much to pay. At most, they went in and squatted for a few days, which was useless.
"Secretary Guan, the health care product factory is indeed booming at present, but there are also many difficulties.
I'm still going to report to the leader, and ask the leader to give me an idea. "
Xu Shiyan accompanied his son to the provincial capital this time, and he also had this consideration in mind.
Although finding a leader may not be able to solve any problems, as the main person in charge of the company, he must learn to complain to the leader.
Let the superiors understand that the enterprise is not easy.
Guan Enxue was dumbfounded when they heard what Xu Shiyan said. Where did they experience such a thing?
"Well, how can such a thing happen? These people are too shameless, isn't this clearly sucking our blood?"
After listening to Guan Enxue, he became angry all of a sudden.
Although the Jishengyuan health care product factory is located in the south, the employment, profits and taxes, and driving the economy have nothing to do with it.
But don’t forget, there are many medicinal materials in the raw materials, especially ginseng, which are all purchased from Fusong.
This is equivalent to indirectly driving the local economy and finding a way out for participating farmers.
Jishengyuan Health Products Factory has annual sales of several hundred million yuan, and the raw materials it needs are also quite a lot.
The ginseng market has stabilized this year, which is due to health products factories purchasing raw materials, and the sales are smoother than before.
If Jishengyuan Health Products Factory is affected by those imitation and counterfeit products, and sales decline, it will not only affect the profit of the factory, but also the raw material suppliers.
"Xiao Xu, what do you think about this matter?
You take out a charter, and I will bring it up to the province, and the province will never sit idly by. "
Guan Enxue is impatient, is this okay? Lawless.
"Secretary Guan, to be honest, I don't have a good idea."
This is the truth, not to mention now, even twenty years later, such counterfeit things will emerge in endlessly.
Six Nuclear Bombs, Leibi, Kang Shuaifu, Maijie, Nutrition Line, Wangzi, Zhouzhupai, Rimao, Taijie, etc.
These are all using similar characters and similar packaging to attract people's attention. Consumers are easy to be fooled if they don't distinguish carefully and cannot recognize Li Kui and Li Gui.
Waiting for something to happen, and pouring dirty water on the authentic products, this kind of thing is simply not too much.
“For the products exported by our company, we not only applied for formula patents, but also applied for patents for trademarks and outer packaging.
Foreign countries attach great importance to these things, so this aspect is less affected, but you know, Secretary Guan, that we do not pay attention to these things in China now.
Our companies have spent a lot of time and energy, and spent a lot of money on research and development, but in the end they were easily plagiarized.
To be honest, this is really a big loss for the enterprise, and it can even be said to be a disaster. "
These things cannot be solved by Xu Shiyan.
It is necessary to find superior leaders and find ways to attract the attention of relevant departments, so that the industrial and commercial departments can standardize the management of the market as much as possible, and promote the implementation of legislation and related punishment regulations.
Regardless of whether these are useful or not, they can deter some people.
For the rest, various publicity may be needed to keep the brand that the company has worked so hard to create.
The three of Guan Enxue were silent for a long time after hearing this.
"Okay, Xiao Xu, I'll make a note of this matter.
I will call the provincial government when I turn back. When you arrive in the provincial capital, you should also go to the relevant leaders and report the situation. "
Guan Enxue finally sighed and said.
"Originally, I wanted to discuss with you whether I could revitalize your county's pharmaceutical factory. I didn't expect that you would encounter many difficulties."
Xu Shiyan didn't expect these things to be resolved quickly.
He mentioned this, on the one hand, he hoped that the leaders could contribute, and on the other hand, he deliberately complained, letting the higher-ups know their difficulties.
Don’t think how easy it is to build a factory and create a brand. It requires countless people to work hard and invest a lot of money and energy to achieve it.
Don't blame him for everything, he's not a junkie.
The county pharmaceutical factory is now lingering on its last breath, hanging on at one breath.
Xu Shiyan is not interested in investing a lot of money and energy to take over a company that is on the verge of bankruptcy.
Guan Enxue chatted with Xu Shiyan for a while, when the staff came over and said that the hotel has been arranged.
"That's it, take Yuanyuan, let's go to the restaurant together, let's chat while eating."
Xu Shiyan looked at it, and it was less than five o'clock from four o'clock to five o'clock, and the train was almost nine o'clock in the evening, so there was still plenty of time.
Since Guan Enxue has spoken, it's not good to refuse, so let's go to dinner together.
"Okay, then I'll call Yuanyuan. By the way, Yuanyuan's two teachers are also in the guest house. Can we go together?"
Four of them go out together, so it’s not easy to leave the two, Xu Shiyan and his son went to eat.
"Okay, what else is there?" Guan Enxue is a very straightforward person, so naturally he doesn't mind having two teachers together.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan went back to call Xu Haiyuan, and went to invite the two teachers next door.
When the two teachers heard that Secretary Guan arranged for a meal, they quickly waved their hands. What are their identities, they dare not go.
The two teachers insisted not to go, and Xu Shiyan had no choice but to take Xu Haiyuan to eat together.
Before leaving the house, Xu Shiyan told the people in the guest house to cook some good dishes for the two teachers upstairs, and Xu Shiyan will be responsible for it.
Guan Enxue treats guests, it must be the best restaurant.
Now the conditions are better, the hotel is decorated with resplendent and magnificent decoration, which looks very high-end.
When ordinary people come to such a place, it is inevitable to look around and be curious about everything.
But Xu Haiyuan, this child, is watching his eyes, his nose, his nose and his heart, unmoved in the slightest, sitting in his own seat in a well-behaved manner, not saying a word, well-behaved and generous.
"Hey, Xiao Xu, my eldest grandson is amazing. He is calm and composed at such a young age, and he has the air of a general."
Guan Enxue looked at Xu Haiyuan, liked it very much, and praised him again and again.
"Good boy, it's no wonder people say that famous teachers give rise to great apprentices, and the children cultivated by Mr. Chu himself are really different.
It's amazing to be selected to compete in the province. This kid is doing well in his studies. "
When people praise their children, Xu Shiyan has to be humble.
"Secretary Guan is overwhelmed by the award, mainly because Mr. Chu and the school teachers are good at teaching."
"No matter how well others teach, the child has to live up to it.
Donggang Middle School has two or three hundred students in one grade, why did you choose Yuanyuan alone to participate in the competition? Isn't the child still excellent?
You don't need to be humble in front of us.
Train up the child well, and in the future, this little guy will still be able to participate in world competitions.
If there is a day, let alone the glory of your family and your county, it will also be the glory of our city and province. "
Anyway, Guan Enxue just likes Xu Haiyuan more the more he looks at him.
"Thank you, Grandpa Guan, for your compliment. I will work hard and live up to Grandpa Guan's expectations."
Xu Haiyuan responded to Guan Enxue's praise with a well-behaved smile at the right time.
"That's right, a young man must have the spirit of a young man.
Go to the competition well, Grandpa Guan is waiting for your good news. "Guan Enxue nodded in satisfaction.
The restaurant made reservations in advance, so after everyone sat down and chatted for a while, the food and drinks were served.
Xu Shiyan chatted with Guan Enxue and others while drinking, while Xu Haiyuan ate quietly, listening to the conversation between his father and several leaders.
Guan Enxue is old enough to drink too much alcohol, and Xu Shiyan has to take the train to the provincial capital at night.
So they didn't drink much, they mainly talked and chatted.
The content of the conversation was mostly about how to develop the local economy, how to revitalize the ginseng industry, and the endless phenomenon of counterfeit products that I just talked about.
Everyone ate, drank, and chatted until past 7:30. Guan Enxue saw that it was not early, so he announced that today was over.
"Well, Xiao Xu has to go to the provincial capital by car later, let's stop here today, and we will have a chance another day, so we can get together.
I have arranged for the train tickets for the few of you to go to the provincial capital. They are all soft sleepers, so you can have a good rest at night.
Take good care of my eldest grandson on the way, I am still waiting for good news. "
Originally, for Xu Shiyan and the others to go to the provincial capital, each school reported the number of people and paid for the tickets, and the tickets were booked here.
But Guan Enxue had already arranged a soft bed, and Xu Shiyan couldn't refuse.
"Then thank you Secretary Guan, it's getting late, let's go back to the guest house to pack our things.
Wait for Yuanyuan to come back from the game, and then visit Secretary Guan when I have time. "
So Guan Enxue arranged a car to take Xu Shiyan and his son back to the guest house.
It was still early, and the father and son went back upstairs to pack their luggage. While tidying up, Xu Haiyuan chatted with his father.
"Dad, have you and my mother considered dividing the family?
I'm not talking about you two, it's the health care product factory.
Originally, this joint venture between state-owned enterprises and private enterprises has great hidden dangers. I think you might as well take the opportunity to separate. "
Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard his son's words, "Ah? Separation? How can the family be separated?
At the beginning, I thought that your mother and your uncles were inexperienced and not strong enough, so I thought about taking them.
Now that the factory has developed, and this year's revenue is also very impressive, is there a separation at this time? Wouldn't the factory be destroyed? "

chapters.title: Chapter 785: Xu Haiyuan's advice
chapters.content:
Chapter 785 Xu Haiyuan's move
"You don't understand these things, it is not easy to build a factory or create a brand.
Your mother and I have spent so much effort and invested so much capital, and Jishengyuan's health care products have finally gained a foothold in the market.
Separate at this time? Isn't that suicide? No, absolutely not. "
Xu Shiyan hurriedly waved his hand to signal his son not to meddle.
"Dad, don't worry, listen to me and tell you carefully."
Xu Haiyuan didn't stop because of his father's objection, but explained to Xu Shiyan with a smile.
"During the meal just now, I listened to Grandpa Guan's intention. He wanted you and my mother to have the entire health care product factory here.
This can increase employment.
Nowadays, many enterprises have stopped working and production, and workers have no work to do.
If there is a factory with good prospects, it can also help solve part of the surplus labor force. Right? "
“I think this is an opportunity. Once it comes, the higher-ups will definitely give a lot of preferential policies and strong support.
Secondly, the factory is now in the great south, which is not very friendly to the northern market, and the transportation cost is too high.
It is better to have a branch factory in the northeast, and the two sides just cooperate with each other from the south to the north. "
Xu Haiyuan took no time to rush, and explained to his father bit by bit.
"As far as the current situation is concerned, even if you don't set up a factory in the Northeast, someone will build a factory.
Produce the same type of products and compete for the market and consumers with my mother.
Since this is the case, why can’t we build our own factory to produce it?
At present, factories in the south have already started up, and the factories in the north will also be developed by taking the opportunity.
North-South alliance, with the advantage, can other small factories outperform you two? "
"When the two factories are developed, there will definitely be conflicts in resources, markets and other aspects.
Even if there is not, you two can find a chance to let it have, and then take the opportunity to separate.
In this way, state-owned enterprises and private enterprises are separated, so as not to lay mines behind.
Separated into two factories, when the time comes to compete for the market and word of mouth, we must step up publicity.
If the two of you are more ruthless, you can also file a lawsuit or something to fight for some trademark rights, formula rights and so on.
The more noisy you are, the more famous you are, and the more you can attract public attention.
This kind of thing is more useful than advertising. "
“In a business war, fighting is the best way to increase exposure and focus on the brand.
It will continue to strengthen consumers' awareness of both brands, thereby guiding consumers' purchasing habits.
One more thing, fighting is the core competitiveness.
In order to win over each other, both parties will improve their strength in terms of quality, price, marketing, etc.
In this way, the product will become better and better, and the competitiveness will become stronger and stronger.
So, in many cases, it seems that the boss and the second child are fighting on the surface. Isn’t this not cleaning up the battlefield and redefining the market order? "
"If you two factories are making such a fuss, the ones who suffer are those small factories that also want to follow behind and take a share.
At that time, it will not only seize the market, increase brand awareness, but also solve hidden dangers, isn't it good? "
Xu Haiyuan still smiled, his tone was very calm, but there was an inexplicable light in his eyes, revealing the dark nature of this kid.
Xu Shiyan was dumbfounded. He never knew that marketing could still use this method.
"You, who did you learn this from?" Xu Shiyan looked at his eldest son with a puzzled expression.
My son is so smart that he is almost a monster, and his husband and wife have recognized this for a long time.
But, this is too mysterious, right? A junior high school student who knows so much?
"I read it in the book, didn't I go to the bookstore and buy a lot of books when I went to the capital?
When I have time, I will look through it. "Xu Haiyuan shrugged his shoulders with a calm face.
"Dad, I will give you another suggestion, you and my mother need to go to school to study.
Especially my mother, she never went to school, and now all this knowledge is self-taught.
If it is left in the past, the whole small company will be fine.
Now the health care product factory has sales of hundreds of millions a year, and it is estimated that it will increase next year. My mother may struggle to manage it. "
“The founder of an enterprise may not have a high culture, but if he wants to manage a mature enterprise well, he must have a certain amount of cultural accumulation and a keen sense of business.
How about an old saying? People without thought, he must worry about.
You both should go to school, find a business school or something to study, it will be beneficial. "
Xu Haiyuan gave advice to his father with a serious face.
Xu Shiyan was stunned, and forgot to pack the things in his hands. "Yes, your mother should go to school."
He still has a graduate certificate from the Agricultural University, and he works in a state-owned enterprise.
But Su Anying is different. Right now, the two parties are cooperating, and he is behind it.
In the future, if the family is really separated as the eldest son said, Su Anying doesn't know what difficulties they will encounter.
It’s not that it’s 100% useful after going to school, but at least it can broaden your horizons and improve your understanding of the market.
All in all, there are benefits.
After all, his eldest son is still young, he is only in the third year of junior high school, and there are still many years before he graduates from university to take over.
During this period, the couple had to maintain the business anyway, and Ji Shengyuan could not continue to operate before their son graduated.
"Well, I will discuss this matter with your mother during the Chinese New Year."
Since you want to study, you have to read something good, and you need to plan carefully.
"Let's go, it's getting late, let's go down to gather, and we have to tell the team leader that we have booked a soft sleeper."
Xu Shiyan glanced at his watch, it was getting late, so he ended his conversation with his son.
It happened that the luggage was packed, and the two of them went downstairs with the suitcases to meet other people.
Xu Shiyan met the teacher who led the team, told him about the ticket, and expressed his apology.
The teacher who led the team already knew the identity of Xu Shiyan, and then heard that it was the ticket given by the management secretary. What can they say?
Hastily said that it doesn’t matter, just go to the station later and refund the original ticket.
After all the participants of the competition arrived, the team leader took everyone on a specially prepared bus and went straight to the train station.
When I arrived at the place, I went to refund four tickets first, and then distributed the tickets to everyone.
A group of people boarded the train with their luggage checked, Xu Shiyan led his son and the two teachers, and went straight to the soft-sleeper compartment, while the others went to the hard-seat compartment.
It takes less than ten hours from Hunjiang to Changchun, and there are not so many people taking the bus at night, so there will be many empty seats, so just find a place to lie down at that time.
Xu Shiyan and the four of them happen to share a soft sleeper, which is quite spacious.
Xu Haiyuan slept on the upper bunk, Xu Shiyan slept on the lower bunk, and the two teachers slept on the other side.
Once the door is closed, it is a small room, isolated from the noise outside, and relatively safer.
The ones at night didn't have the time to talk and laugh, so they packed up and lay down, and fell asleep after a while.
Waiting to wake up, the outside is faintly white, and it is almost dawn.
So I went to wash my face and tidy up. I took out ham sausage, instant noodles, tea eggs and a lunch box from my bag, and got some hot water to make a bowl of noodles. Breakfast was easy.
When six o'clock in the morning came, there were more people on the bus, and many people from around the provincial capital took this bus to work in the city.
It was less than seven o'clock when the train arrived at the station. Xu Shiyan and others got off the train and joined together, leaving the station together.
The competition is held in the Institute of Education, and all students who come to participate and their accompanying personnel should also live there.
As soon as he left the station, he saw someone holding a sign with Xu Shiyan's name written on it.
Needless to say? Guan Enxue must have called the province, and the province arranged for someone to pick him up.
Xu Shiyan talked to the teacher who led the team, and then led Xu Haiyuan and the two teachers towards the receptionist holding the placard.
After the other party confirmed Xu Shiyan's identity, he was very polite.
"Mr. Xu, the leader knows that you are coming, and specially arranged a hotel. Please come with us."
Just like that, Xu Shiyan and his party got into the car and went straight to the Provincial Hotel.
Provincial Hotel is located in the most prosperous area of ​​the provincial city center. It was built in 1958 and covers an area of ​​nearly 50,000 square meters. There are nearly 300 rooms of various types and more than 20 large and small meeting rooms.
This place is not for ordinary people to live in. Currently, it is only for entertainment.
The environment here is elegant, the facilities are complete, and the transportation is convenient.
Besides, it is on the same street as the Institute of Education, and the distance is not too far. It is very convenient for Xu Haiyuan to go to the competition.
The two teachers who followed Xu Shiyan and his father were dumbfounded.
Where did they stay in such a nice hotel? Usually when I go out, I live in a guest house.
How much does this place cost for one night?
"Mr. Xu, isn't it suitable for us to live here? Otherwise, the two of us will go to live with the Institute of Education, so we won't bother Mr. Xu."
Both of them felt that it was not very good. The room was arranged for Xu Shiyan, and they rubbed against each other, which seemed inappropriate.
"The leader knew that Xu always accompanied his son to the competition, and there were two teachers accompanying him, so he specially reserved two rooms.
Mr. Xu, the leader said that you should take a good rest today, and there will be a meeting that requires you to attend tomorrow, and there will be meeting arrangements for the next few days.
So I have to trouble these two teachers for accompanying Young Master Ling in the competition. "
Before Xu Shiyan could speak, the reception staff over there spoke first.
When the two teachers heard this, they no longer struggled.
Originally, the two of them were supposed to accompany Xu Haiyuan in the competition, this was their duty.
They are naturally happy to be able to follow Xu Shiyan to take advantage of the food and lodging along the way, and to stay in such a good hotel.
"President Xu, don't worry, leave Haiyuan's participation in the competition to us."
There are two rooms arranged here, and Xu Shiyan and his father live in a double suite, which is quite spacious and has good conditions.
The two of them put their luggage away, took a short rest, and then Xu Shiyan took Xu Haiyuan to visit Chi Hao and others.
The first day in the provincial capital was spent visiting relatives and friends.
The next morning, someone came to pick up Xu Shiyan for a meeting, and at the same time arranged a car to send Xu Haiyuan to the competition.
The Provincial Physics Olympiad for Junior High School Students was held in the Provincial College of Education.
This competition itself is to select seedlings in advance for high schools to participate in the national and world competitions, so as to facilitate training with a clear purpose, so the competition system is also modeled on the high school competition system.
Generally, it is divided into two days. The first day is the theoretical part. The exam is three hours and the full score is 160 points.
The next day is the experimental part, the exam is three hours, and the full score is 40 points.
The students entered the examination room with stationery for the examination, and the accompanying teacher waited anxiously in the rest area.
Those who can come to participate in the provincial competition are the top students from various schools and even various counties and cities, and the teachers' favorites.
Those teachers were even more nervous than the parents, and they all prayed silently in their hearts, hoping that their students would perform exceptionally well and get good grades in the exam.
The children in the examination room were writing vigorously, and the teachers outside the examination room were anxiously walking back and forth rubbing their hands, and each of them was still muttering.
Three hours is a torment for teachers, children and students.
On the other side, before the meeting, Xu Shiyan went to meet with several main provincial leaders.
It is estimated that the leader heard some things from Guan Enxue, so after seeing Xu Shiyan, they all asked about some things about the health care product factory.
In particular, the phenomenon of counterfeiting and plagiarism in the market was discussed, trying to find a solution.
Inspired by his son, Xu Shiyan also figured out a little way, so he talked a lot with the leader.
And revealed that they want to build another branch factory in the northeast.
Sure enough, as Xu Haiyuan expected, the leader was very happy when he heard it, and promised many favorable conditions.
"Okay, that's it, the specific plan, after you discuss with the old manager, write a detailed plan.
Don't worry, the province will definitely give the greatest support and discounts. "
At the end of the conversation, the leader patted Xu Shiyan on the shoulder and said with a smile.
"Thank you for the leadership's care. I will take care of this matter when I get back. I will do it as soon as possible. It must be done well and beautifully." Xu Shiyan nodded quickly in promise.
Just in time, the secretary came in to inform that it was time for the meeting. So everyone moved into the conference room together for a meeting.
At the end of the year, there are already many meetings, and various work summaries and reports.
Originally, Xu Shiyan didn't need to participate in these, but didn't he come to the province? The leader asked him to participate by name, what can he do?
Fortunately, he does not need to speak on stage, as long as he listens from the bottom, so let’s listen.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan held meetings every day, while Xu Haiyuan went to competitions.
During the 18th and 19th days, the physics theory and experiments were all over, and the other participating teachers and students left for their return journey.
Xu Haiyuan can also take a break, find two teachers to accompany him, and go out together.
Xu Haiyuan's favorite place to go out is the bookstore.
As long as he finds a book that he doesn’t have at home, he will carefully read and select it, and buy it when he thinks it is good.
On the 21st, the chemistry competition started. It was still in the College of Education, and it was still a two-day competition.
The results of the provincial competition did not come out immediately, and they had to go back to wait for the results, so after two days of competition, Xu Haiyuan and the others could return.
Xu Shiyan held meetings for several days, his head was about to explode.
Fortunately, this trip to the provincial capital has yielded pretty good results. Several leaders have promised many preferential policies.
At the same time, the leader also revealed to Xu Shiyan that he intends to convert the participating company into a provincial enterprise.
After all, the current ginseng companies have ginseng factories, ginseng factories, beverage factories, mineral water factories, pharmaceutical factories, health care products factories, and daily chemical factories under their subsidiaries.
At the same time, there are also fertilizer factories, floor factories, Bingshan beverage factories, and Jishengyuan health care products factories in which it holds shares.
Moreover, the scale of each factory is not small, and the annual profit is very considerable.
It should be said that the current Dongfang Ginseng Company is also one of the top enterprises in the province.
The ability to earn foreign exchange through export is unparalleled, and the annual profits and taxes are among the best.
Now it is still under the jurisdiction of the city, which is a bit unreasonable.
So the meaning above is to change the municipal Dongfang Ginseng Company into a provincial Dongfang Ginseng Group, with Xu Shiyan as the general manager of the group company.
From municipal to provincial, the level of the enterprise has increased, and the level of Xu Shiyan, the general manager, has also risen accordingly.
This is a good thing, of course Xu Shiyan has no reason to object, he can't wait for it.
Xu Shiyan reckoned that the city would not let it go easily, but since the provincial leaders brought this up, it was possible.
Anyway, wrangling is a matter for the city and the province, and has nothing to do with Xu Shiyan. Whether it is a municipal or a provincial one, he just needs to manage the company with peace of mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 786: Provincial first prize
chapters.content:
Chapter 786 Provincial First Prize
Xu Haiyuan finished the competition, and Xu Shiyan also finished the meeting, so he could finally breathe a sigh of relief.
Originally, Xu Shiyan thought that after Xu Haiyuan finished his exam on the 22nd, they would buy tickets for the afternoon bus and leave quickly.
Anyway, he always comes to the provincial capital, and there is nothing new, so it is better to go home quickly.
But after thinking about it, he always comes, doesn't mean the two teachers always come too.
It is rare for him to come to the provincial capital, and he has been nervous to accompany his children in the competition a few days ago.
This is finally over, why don't people go around?
Just like that, Xu Shiyan told the two teachers to stay in the provincial capital for one more day and leave on the afternoon of the 23rd.
The two teachers are naturally very happy.
During this trip, Xu Shiyan paid for all kinds of expenses, such as eating well and living well.
Now they have specially stayed for an extra day, so they can just go around and buy something for their family.
On the afternoon of the 22nd, Xu Shiyan and his son went to the Bank University to find Xu Jinfeng, and called Xu Haibo, who was studying at the Agricultural University, to call the children together.
Xu Shiyan was the host, treated the children to a good meal, and gave a lot of money to his nephew and niece.
Let them study with peace of mind and prepare for the final exam.
On the morning of the 23rd, the four of them went shopping around the provincial capital together.
The two teachers also bought a lot of things.
It’s rare to come here, there are so many good things in the provincial capital, and besides, it’s not too far away from the New Year, so why don’t you bring something home for your parents, wife and children?
After finishing their work in the morning, the four of them rushed to the train station in the afternoon and returned by train.
Originally, the leader wanted to send a car to take Xu Shiyan and the others home, but Xu Shiyan refused.
Nowadays, it takes six or seven hours to drive from the provincial capital to Songjianghe in summer when the road conditions are good.
If you add a meal and rest halfway, the time will be longer.
In winter, the snowy roads are slippery, and long-distance driving is actually quite dangerous.
At noon on the 24th, the group returned to Songjiang River.
Someone picked up the station here, first sent the two teachers back to school, and sent Xu Haiyuan home, and then Xu Shiyan went straight to the company.
As soon as he returned to the company, Xu Shiyan immediately called all the management of each factory over for a meeting, and mentioned that he wanted to open another branch factory.
Naturally, Li Bingzhuo, Dai Chunrong, Han Limin and others did not object to this matter.
Jishengyuan Health Products Factory has sales of hundreds of millions this year. Outsiders don’t know. Can these people in the management still not know?
To be honest, everyone is very envious. If the factory is local, wouldn’t their company be even better?
Now that I heard that a branch factory is going to be built here, what are you talking about? Must fully support ah.
But what about this branch? Whether to re-locate and build a factory, or take over an old factory and renovate it, everyone has their own opinions.
Some people think that the county pharmaceutical factory is half dead. Since the superior leader promised to give preferential treatment, it is better to take it over.
The factory buildings, machines, and workers are all ready-made, and they can be produced after taking over, and the profits are quick.
But there are also objections.
It's a mess over there, the products can't be sold, the workers haven't been paid for several months, and they owe a lot of debts outside.
It is very troublesome to take over, and it is really not worthwhile.
It’s better to start spring next year, choose a good place to build a factory, and if you speed up the progress, it can be put into production in autumn.
Both sides stick to their own opinions, and Xu Shiyan can't make a hasty decision. This matter really needs careful consideration.
At the same time, it is also necessary to seek the opinions of the superiors.
After all, they are state-owned enterprises, not private enterprises, and they cannot do whatever they want.
So Xu Shiyan opened his mouth to quell the debate, and brought up matters related to this year's year-end summary meeting.
The Chinese New Year in 1992 was on February 4th. According to Xu Shiyan, the company's profits are very good this year, and the year-end summary meeting can be held earlier.
Distribute bonuses and benefits in advance, so that workers can have a happy and prosperous year.
"This year's welfare, each person has half a pork belly, a box of fish and shrimp, a bag of rice, a bag of noodles, a barrel of oil, a box of apples, and a box of pears.
I have already ordered the fish and shrimp with Dandong. There are more types in it, including Spanish mackerel, saury, partial mouth, and big yellow flower, and a few catties of prawns.
Anyway, it is to let the workers eat everything they want, so they don’t have to worry about finding new year’s goods. "
The company still has a lot of orders this year, and the profit is not small, so the workers' benefits must be raised to a higher level.
It cannot be said that the workers are working hard in the workshop, but the company is stingy and doesn't give them anything.
It should be said that under the current economic situation, the participating companies can develop so well, in addition to factors such as business direction and timing, it is also the credit of all workers.
The Chinese New Year is coming, the benefits must keep up, and workers must be able to live a stable and prosperous year.
"Oh, according to the general manager, that's amazing.
Many people in our company are dual-employees, and some of their children also work in the factory.
Each worker sends out so many years of goods, so they can't eat them with a flutter or roll? "
Han Limin immediately laughed when he heard this.
Others also laughed and echoed, "Isn't that right?
When I think about it, I feel that this year has been a good one, and I am getting old. "
Xu Shiyan also laughed, "That's right.
What are we working hard every day for? Isn't it for the family to live a good life?
Whenever everyone in our company can live in a good house, have a car when they go out, and have money in their pockets, then I will be satisfied. "
No worries about food and drink, wife and children are hot on the bed, these are the best days.
Xu Haiyuan arrived home on the 24th, and there are only two days left before the final exam.
Xu Haiyuan can represent the county to participate in the competition in the province, and his own strength is very strong.
County No. 1 Middle School and Donggang High School both offered him olive branches, expressing that Xu Haiyuan could be admitted without examination.
That is to say, if Xu Haiyuan doesn't plan to take the technical secondary school entrance examination, he can skip the high school entrance examination next year and be recommended to high school.
However, Xu Haiyuan did not feel complacent and complacent because of this, and stopped moving forward.
On the morning of the 25th, I still returned to school and went to class as usual. On the 26th, I took the final exam with my classmates.
On the 26th, all junior high schools and elementary schools in this county have final exams.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui needless to say, only take math and Chinese, and they will be done in one day.
But there are many subjects in junior high school, and they need to go to the exam room, so Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping and the others have to take the exam for three days.
After the exam in three days, there is no such thing as a party. You can go directly to the holiday on the first day of junior high school, and just go back to school in a few days to listen to the results and collect the homework.
As for the third year of junior high school, because the high school entrance examination will be held next year, the school attaches great importance to it, so there are classes during the winter vacation.
After the final exam, the exam is on holiday, and after New Year's Day, I will go back to school and go to class until the junior year.
On the 29th, all the junior high school exams are over and the holiday is off.
It happened that Zhou Guilan made glutinous rice in advance, and went to the mill on the 30th to push her face and control her all night.
On the morning of the 31st, prepare a pot of small bean stuffing and start wrapping it with a fire spoon.
On New Year's Day on the 1st, the company will have a day off and go home for a reunion.
On the Xu family's side, Xu Shixian and the others only had one day off, and those who were not worth the hassle of going back didn't come back.
It was Xu Shian, who led Wei Mingrong and Xu Haitao back, and spent the holiday with his parents.
Su Anying is still in the south and hasn't come back yet. At home, Zhou Guilan leads sisters Wei Mingrong and Xu Jinping to cook and make dumplings.
In the evening, they prepared six dishes, plus dumplings stuffed with sauerkraut. Xu Shiyan and his brothers accompanied Xu Chenghou to drink a few glasses of wine, coaxing the old man into a good mood.
On January 3rd, Xu Haiyuan went back to school for class, and Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu and others went back to school to listen to their grades.
Xu Jinping is undoubtedly the first in the grade, and Yang Haoyu is the second in the grade by a few points.
Sun Yu, Huang Shuyun, Su Lijuan and others who were in the same grade as them had their own grades, but most of them had decent grades anyway.
After listening to the grades and receiving the homework for the holiday, the winter vacation has officially begun.
For Xu Jinping, the winter vacation homework is drizzle, and it can be completed in two or three days.
In the rest of the time, she took her brother's textbooks to preview the new lessons for the next semester.
After the holiday, Yang Haoyu still ran to Xu's house all day long, doing homework with Xu Jinping, previewing new lessons, and watching the two children study along the way.
On January 5th, the results of the provincial competition came out.
Xu Haiyuan won the provincial first prize in two subjects of physical chemistry.
However, the experimental part of physics scored slightly lower, ranking sixth in the total score, and was not selected for the national competition.
Chemistry score is good, the total score is the first in the province, and won the place to participate in the final.
You must know that the province only selects five students with excellent grades to participate in the national competition, and Xu Haiyuan can be among them, which means that he is absolutely strong.
This is the best result Donggang Middle School has achieved in the subject competition in the past few years, and the whole school is boiling with excitement.
It is a pity that now the first and second grade students are on vacation, and only the third grade students are in school, so there is no way for the whole school to celebrate.
Even so, the school leaders still decided to hold a commendation meeting for Xu Haiyuan, and all teachers and students in the third year of junior high school will participate.
At the commendation meeting, the principal personally presented certificates and prizes to Xu Haiyuan, encouraging Xu Haiyuan to make persistent efforts and strive for good results in the national competition.
Xu Shiyan was at work and also received calls from the county and city.
Guan Enxue, Chang Hongfa and others all called to congratulate Xu Shiyan.
Especially Chang Hongfa, he was as happy as his grandson winning the award.
How should I put it, after all, this is also the county's best result over the years, and Xu Haiyuan has won the county's honor this time.
"Well, the county is going to hold a celebration party for Yuanyuan. You must bring Yuanyuan the next morning." Chang Hongfa said so on the phone.
"Secretary Chang, why don't you skip the celebration party?
Yuanyuan is just a child, but he studies better and occasionally wins an award or something. There is no need to mobilize teachers and people to celebrate his achievements. "
Xu Shiyan actually doesn't like these forms.
No matter which aspect has achieved some results, there must be a celebration party or the like, which is a waste of money and money, and is flashy.
"The child is young and lacks concentration. I'm afraid he won't be able to stand it.
If you become proud and complacent because of this, and stop moving forward, it is not good.
How about this, when Yuanyuan returns from participating in the national competition, if he still wins an award or something, it’s not too late to celebrate him. "
Xu Shiyan hasn't had time to contact the school yet. He doesn't know when and where the National Chemistry Competition will be held.
It’s January 5th, and February 3rd is the Chinese New Year. It’s okay to go to the competition after the next year, because there is plenty of time.
If it was a competition a year ago, it is estimated that they should be ready to start in the next few days. How can there be time to hold some celebration parties?
Chang Hongfa has known Xu Shiyan for many years, how can he not know Xu Shiyan's temper? Immediately he could only sigh.
"Okay, let the child have a good rest and prepare to participate in the national competition.
I will arrange for someone to deliver the children's prizes and bonuses. "
Xu Haiyuan achieved such a good result and gave the county face, so he had to show it.
Xu Shiyan has already rejected the celebration party, so he can no longer refuse the prize, so he can only thank Chang Hongfa.
The two chatted a few more words on the phone, and Chang Hongfa hung up the phone.
The phone here just hung up, and within two minutes, it rang again.
This time it was the principal of No. 1 Middle School who called. As soon as the call was connected, the principal of No. 1 Middle School said that Xu Haiyuan was welcome to study in No. 1 Middle School.
One should be free of tuition and miscellaneous fees, arrange the best teacher, if you have any other requirements, just ask.
What can Xu Shiyan say? He can only explain to others that he hasn't seen his son yet, so he doesn't know what his son is thinking.
Where to study, still have to follow the child's opinion.
Don't worry now, wait for Xu Haiyuan to come back from the national competition before making a decision.
Where is the principal of No. 1 Middle School willing to give up so easily?
If Xu Haiyuan goes to participate in the national competition and gets good results, it is estimated that many schools will have to follow him, and it will be the turn of the county No. 1 middle school?
But no matter what he said, Xu Shiyan insisted on letting the children choose by themselves, and the principal of the No. 1 Middle School did not agree, so he had to hang up the phone in the end.
Xu Shiyan finally heaved a sigh of relief, and then called the principal of Donggang Middle School to ask Xu Haiyuan about participating in the national competition.
Donggang is a small place after all, and Donggang Middle School is a rural junior high school in a remote mountainous area.
It was the first time to participate in a provincial competition, let alone a national competition. I didn't even dare to think about it before, so everyone didn't know much about the rules of the competition.
Thanks to the fact that the rules and regulations of the competition were sent along with the certificate, so I have a rough idea.
This year's National Junior High School Chemistry League will be held at Capital University from January 18th to January 23rd.
Opening ceremony on January 18th, first exam on the 19th, rest on the 20th, second exam on the 21st, rest on the 22nd, closing ceremony and awards ceremony on the 23rd.
The province selected five students with excellent grades to go to the capital to compete.
Participating students who are close to the provincial capital can gather in the provincial capital and start together, and those who are far away can also set off on their own and gather in the capital.
The other four are top students from middle schools in the provincial capital, only Xu Haiyuan is in the remote mountain village of Donggang.
The time required to go from Donggang to Changchun and from Donggang to the capital is not much different, but they are two diametrically opposite directions, one south and one north.
If Xu Haiyuan went to the provincial capital to gather, and then went to the capital, it would be a big detour, and it would be a waste of time.
After discussing with the principal of the middle school, Xu Shiyan decided to go directly to the capital from home.
"Then trouble Principal Wang, contact the province and explain the situation. We will not go to the province and go directly to the capital to gather."
For these matters, it is more convenient for the school to come forward, so I can only ask Principal Wang to help contact and confirm the itinerary.
"No trouble, no trouble, this is what schools and teachers should do.
Mr. Xu can rest assured that the school will arrange everything.
Student Xu Haiyuan doesn’t have to come to school for these few days, so he can adjust his state with peace of mind and strive for a good ranking in the national competition. "
Xu Haiyuan can win the provincial first prize in physics and chemistry, and at least forty points will be added to the senior high school entrance examination.
If he does not take the technical secondary school, he will be recommended in high school.
So it’s okay to delay the class during the holidays.
At present, the game is the biggest thing, and everything else can be compromised.
After discussing with Principal Wang, Xu Shiyan called Su Anying to announce the good news to his wife.
The couple agreed that Xu Shiyan would accompany his son to the capital, and Su Anying would also try to arrive in the capital before January 18th.
In this way, the couple accompanied their son to the game, and when the game was over, the family of three walked back, just in time to go home for the New Year, without any delay.

chapters.title: Chapter 787: award
chapters.content:
Chapter 787 Awarded
My son has achieved such good grades, how can Xu Shiyan sit still?
After communicating with Principal Wang, he rushed out immediately, bought a big bag of candy, and gave out candy when he met someone in the company building.
Everyone was happy for Xu Shiyan when they learned that Xu Haiyuan had won the provincial first prize and was going to the capital to participate in the national competition.
Many people shouted, asking Xu Shiyan to treat him or something.
"Well, treats are a must, but we have to put it aside and wait for the children to come back from the game, together.
I have to go home first and tell my family the good news.
If you have anything to do with the company, just call me at home. "
Ordinarily, that big brother came out early.
With the strength of Xu Shiyan and his wife, there is no pressure to buy them.
But Xu Shiyan thought it was heavy and clumsy, the signal was not good, the battery was not durable, and it didn't make much sense to hold it, so he didn't buy it.
After a few years of waiting, the mobile phone comes out. At least buy a lighter one to hold it and use it, so that it won’t look so stupid.
Xu Shiyan finished distributing the candy, talked to the others, and hurried to his parents.
As a result, as soon as he entered the door, he heard Zhou Guilan's movement in the east room.
"Oh my god, old Xu's family is really smoking from the ancestral grave.
No, I have to buy meat quickly, let’s make dumplings tonight. "
Needless to say, the family must know the news that Xu Haiyuan won the award.
Xu Shiyan opened the door and entered the east room, only to see Zhou Guilan putting on his shoes and going out.
On the kang, Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai were also smiling.
The one who smiled had his eyes narrowed, and the wrinkles on his face were deep.
Looking again, Xu Haiyuan was sitting on the edge of the Kang, with Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu beside him.
Then there is no need to think about it? It must be that the school gave Xu Haiyuan a holiday and asked him to go home and report the good news.
Seeing Xu Shiyan enter the door, Xu Chenghou and the others had a clear look on their faces.
"Have you received the news? The county must have called you, right?
Come, take a look at our family's award-winning certificates, and the school even gave out prizes. "
Xu Chenghou beckoned and asked his son to come to him.
"This certificate, I have to find someone to make a photo frame and hang it on the wall of our house.
My eldest grandson won the first prize in the provincial competition. The old Xu family has never had such an honor.
If we were not too far away from our hometown, I would have planned to go back to worship our ancestors. "
Xu Chenghou looked at the certificate with a wide smile, and gently stroked the gold letters on the certificate with his big dry and rough hands.
Xu Shiyan laughed as soon as he heard it, "Father, don't we have enough certificates in our family? You can see that the wall is full of them."
In recent years, Xu Shiyan and his wife have been appraised as advanced and awarded, plus Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping have won various awards, three good students and so on.
Not only are there certificates of merit on the wall of the east room here, but also in the east room of Xu Shiyan's house.
"Can it be the same? My eldest grandson won the provincial award this time, which is more expensive than the previous ones."
Xu Chenghou shook his head. Although they are all awards, they have different weights. This is so rare.
"That is, the first prize in the province, and the first prize in both physics and chemistry, such results are too few.
If Yuanyuan went to the capital to compete and came back with an award, it would be complete. "
On the other end, Chu Xuanhuai also praised with a smile on his face.
"Master, this is not called Consummation.
When Yuanyuan is in high school, if he can still win an award, then it will be considered complete. "
Xu Shiyan looked at his eldest son and said so on purpose.
Xu Haiyuan aspires to study medicine. For the sake of long-term development, he must not be admitted to a technical secondary school, but must go to a high school to enter a university.
Based on Xu Haiyuan's foundation, it is estimated that he will be selected to participate in the competition when he enters high school. If the high school can participate in the national competition, there will be too many benefits.
Chu Xuanhuai was right when he heard it, "Then Yuanyuan has to work hard, and strive to come back with an award in high school."
Chu Xuanhuai also had high hopes for this disciple and grandson.
"Master, don't worry, I will definitely work hard." Xu Haiyuan smiled and nodded, assuring everyone.
Zhou Guilan went to buy meat and chopped stuffing, while Xu Jinping kneaded the noodles.
As for Xu Chenghou, he picked up the phone and called his four sons one by one.
For such a big happy event, the child's uncles and uncles must know about it.
Xu Shixian and others were very happy when they learned that Xu Haiyuan had won the provincial competition and would go to the capital to participate in the national competition.
At the same time, they all felt that the old Xu family was really promising in this generation.
Xu Shiyan wanted to accompany his son to the capital for the competition, so the company had to arrange everything properly.
There are no major issues recently, the most important thing is the year-end report and commendation meeting, as well as dividends and benefits.
The game starts on the 18th, and the capital will be won on the 17th at the latest.
Depart on the 15th, allow enough time in advance, in case something happens along the way, it will not delay the children's competition.
So Xu Shiyan decided that on January 11th, the company will hold a year-end summary and commendation meeting, and distribute the New Year's benefits to everyone along the way.
The company is making good profits this year, and the participating workers can receive almost 8,000 yuan per person, including the quota production plus excess rewards.
This includes wages and year-end rewards. You must know that this is the net surplus you get, and all production costs are borne by the participants.
In today's market conditions, it is already very good.
Workers in other factories can get six to seven hundred to thousands of yuan depending on the benefits of each factory.
At this time, the monthly salary of ordinary workers is only one or two hundred yuan.
Participating companies are state-owned enterprises, and the basic salary has a fixed standard, which cannot be exceeded too much.
However, various subsidies are high, and workers can get three to four hundred yuan a month.
The year-end bonus is almost two or three months' salary, which is pretty good.
Besides, there are not only bonuses, but also Chinese New Year benefits.
Rice, noodles, oil, fish, meat, fruits, most of the things needed for the New Year do not need to be bought separately, and the company sends them directly. How exciting is that?
Currently, most of the companies are dual-career families, and now they can receive a small two thousand for the year-end bonus alone.
Plus the double New Year benefits, what kind of day is that?
It's just like what Han Limin said, if you open up food, drink and flowers, there is still a lot left.
There are also those couples who both go to work, and the son and daughter also recruit to work when they grow up. Not to mention the life at home, the beauty is bubbling.
So, nowadays, young guys and big girls in participating companies are always in demand, and I don’t know how many people are thinking about proposing to them.
"Well, let me say a few words off topic.
It's the end of the year again, and there are a lot of married people and blind dates in each family.
For the long-term development of our company, I hope that those boys and girls who have not yet found a partner will not be too narrow-minded.
Don't just stare at the inside of our company, but develop outward.
Try your best, find more from outside, and add some new force to our company, right?
After we get married, if the conditions are similar, we can recruit workers.
When the time comes, the couple will both go to work. What a beautiful day this is. "
After the year-end report, Xu Shiyan stood on the stage, chatting with everyone with a smile.
"You can marry at ease, marry at ease, and you don't have to worry about having children.
In the coming year, our company will build a large-scale nursery school, so I am not afraid that no one will take care of you after giving birth.
You can work with peace of mind. Our company takes care of everything from nursery to high school. "
This is normal. Large state-owned enterprises generally have their own schools, ranging from kindergarten to high school.
In the past, the number of participants was small, and it was not cost-effective to run junior and senior high schools by ourselves, so we jointly organized it with Donggang.
In the future, the company's population will increase, and it is completely possible to run a school by itself.
Factories and schools can reduce and exempt a lot of taxes, which is what many factories in the south do.
So that in a few years, many excellent teachers in Donggang High School will be poached by schools run by companies in the south.
The benefits they give are good, the salary is high, and housing is allocated, isn't it much better than in this broken town?
Xu Shiyan's words caused everyone in the audience to burst into laughter. This smile was a happy smile, and a happy smile.
"Don't worry, the general manager. We will tell the children at home to look for those who need to find someone quickly, and try to look for them from the outside." Someone even yelled loudly on purpose.
After the summary meeting was over, Xu Shiyan lost his mind.
On the morning of January 15th, the chemistry teacher accompanied Xu Shiyan and his father to the competition.
Take a train from Songjianghe to Tonghua, and then take a car from Tonghua to the capital. Everything goes well on the road, and we arrive at the capital at noon on the 16th.
Nan Zhendong, Su Anzhen, and Su Anying, who had arrived in the capital ahead of schedule, were waiting at the exit.
After receiving someone, everyone had lunch together, and then drove Xu Haiyuan to Capital University in the afternoon.
The chemistry teacher had the competition instructions issued by the province, so he found the league organizing committee smoothly and went through the relevant procedures.
According to the requirements, the participating students must live collectively in Capital University, with one person accompanying them all the way, and the others living separately.
Xu Shiyan discussed with the teacher, he doesn't understand the competition, so he won't be here to accompany Xu Haiyuan, just let the chemistry teacher accompany Xu Haiyuan.
Just like that, the chemistry teacher stayed with Xu Haiyuan, while Xu Shiyan and his wife lived with Nan Zhendong.
On the 17th, Xu Shiyan and his wife went to the courtyard on Liulichang Street.
Here, Nan Zhendong specially hired someone to take care of him. Everything is well maintained, the windows are bright and clean, and he looks very comfortable.
There is a heater in the house, and it is turned on every night, so it is not too cold and cold to be unbearable.
The couple decided to live in the small courtyard, so that they can get some food by themselves without worry.
In the afternoon, the two went to the other yards for a walk.
It’s okay, except for the four-entry yard, which is slow to repair and is expected to be completed next year, the other two places have been tidied up.
On the 18th, the opening ceremony of the National Junior High School Biochemistry League.
On the morning of the 19th, the first exam, which is the written part.
The difference between the national competition and the provincial competition is that the results of the national competition are directly issued. After answering the papers in the morning, the referees of the organizing committee will start to mark the papers in the afternoon.
On the 20th, the students rested, and everyone organized a sorority.
Student elites from all over the world exchange learning experiences together. Give each other small gifts, keep in touch with each other, and so on.
No. 21, the second game, the experimental part.
On the 22nd, the organizing committee arranged for all participating students to watch the flag-raising ceremony, visit the Forbidden City and other places.
It is important to know that these students are from all over the country. If it were not for participating in the competition, it is very likely that they would not have the opportunity to come to the capital.
The competition is over, no matter how good or bad the test is, everyone has passed, everyone is relaxed, and there is no burden.
So these children were all very excited, and they had a great time playing this day.
On the 23rd, the closing ceremony and awards ceremony of the league was held in a certain auditorium.
After obtaining permission, Xu Shiyan and his wife also came to the scene to watch the ceremony.
At the closing ceremony, relevant leaders, professors and experts delivered speeches respectively.
I made some explanations on the development prospects of the subject of chemistry, and put forward suggestions and expectations for the participating students.
After that, the venue for the next league will be announced, and there will be a small handover ceremony.
Of course, the most important part of the closing ceremony is the announcement of the results and the presentation of awards.
After everyone was looking forward to it, it finally came to this stage.
There are more than 200 people participating in the league this time. After deliberation and discussion by the committee, according to the league regulations, the number of winners will be determined with a certain percentage.
Fifty first prizes and 80 second prizes.
Competitors whose total score does not reach 25% of the full score will not have an award certificate, only a participation certificate.
Deduct this part, and the rest is the third prize.
The winners were announced on the stage, and the winners came to the stage to receive their certificates and take a group photo.
"Why isn't our name Yuanyuan here yet? This is the list of the second prize."
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying sat below, holding back their anxiety and listening carefully to the host reading the list, for fear of missing the name of their eldest son.
But after reading this a lot, and still not hearing Xu Haiyuan's name, Su Anying couldn't help feeling anxious.
Can't you? Didn't her eldest son win an award?
"Don't worry, wait, this award is announced backwards.
Just now the third prize, this is the second prize, maybe we can get the first prize one after another? "
Xu Shiyan was also anxious, he felt his heart beating in his throat right now.
But it's useless to be anxious, I can only wait patiently. This is really a torment, too anxious.
After the list of the second prizes was announced, there was no name of Xu Haiyuan. The couple was in a hurry, and they were eager to announce the list of the first prizes.
But there were awards and group photos on the stage. After a long time of effort, these people finally went down.
Next, the list of the first prizes was announced, Xu Shiyan and his wife were already very nervous.
Su Anying held Xu Shiyan's hand, exerting force unconsciously, Xu Shiyan's hand hurt from being held, and he didn't dare to say anything.
The two of them just listened to the names being read on stage in such a frightened manner, one was not Xu Haiyuan, and the other was not.
Xu Shiyan is still counting in his heart, the first prize is 50, he will count down from the bottom.
"Thirty-six, thirty-five, thirty-four..."
Xu Shiyan had already counted to ten, and he hadn't heard his eldest son's name yet, so the couple were a little dumbfounded.
It’s broken, so it’s not true that my son didn’t win the prize, right?
"Ten, nine, eight, seven..." Counting down to five, there is still no Xu Haiyuan's name, Xu Shiyan's heart is also more than half cold.
Xu Shiyan and his wife were not the only ones who were nervous. The chemistry teacher who was with Xu Haiyuan in front of him was sweating in his palms and back.
At this time, there is no Xu Haiyuan's name, only two possibilities.
One is that Xu Haiyuan's grades are not good and he didn't win an award, and the other is that Xu Haiyuan's grades are super good and he entered the top five.
"Next, we are going to announce the top three students.
