I believe that many people are like me, and now they are eager to know who the top three classmates are. "
Unexpectedly, when the last three people were left, the host stopped on purpose and smiled at the crowd below.
These people below probably want to rush up and beat him up.
The host made a not-so-humorous joke, and no one echoed him, and no one applauded.
The host smiled awkwardly, and began to announce the scores, schools, and names of the top three students.
"The champion of this chemistry league is Xu Haiyuan from Fusong and Donggang Junior Middle Schools in Kyrgyzstan."
When this sentence was uploaded from the stage, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying were immediately dumbfounded.
"Daughter-in-law, what did he say just now? Who is the champion? Is it from our family?"
Xu Shiyan has always known that his eldest son is very good, like a monster.
But he never expected that the eldest son would be able to win the first place in the national competition.
Is this true? Isn't he dreaming?
"No, daughter-in-law, you pinch us, why do I feel like I'm dreaming? Isn't this incredible?"
Can't you? No matter how evil the eldest son is, the qualifications of the school teachers are limited.
As for the teachers of Donggang Junior High School, can they teach the best in the country? Are you kidding me?
Su Anying also seemed to be in a dream, so she pinched Xu Shiyan hard, making Xu Shiyan grin in pain.
"It's not a dream, it's real.
Daughter-in-law, our son really won an award, and it’s still the first prize. Look, isn’t that all on stage? "
Xu Shiyan pointed to Xu Haiyuan who was walking on the stage, and said.
The winners of the first prize came to the stage, and the experts and professors invited by the league organizing committee presented the awards to the winners, and then took photos as a souvenir.
At this time, the top three have shown their advantages.
Many people took photos with them, and some remembered that they came here for interviews.
Xu Haiyuan stepped off the stage holding the award certificate, came to Xu Shiyan and Su Anying, and handed the certificate to his parents.
"Dad, Mom, here is my award certificate.
Thanks to my parents for giving me life, and thank you for your meticulous care and cultivation over the past fourteen years.
The son's grades are half the credit of his parents. "
Su Anying was crying badly at this moment, and Xu Shiyan also burst into tears with excitement.
The couple, one didn't finish junior high school, the other didn't go to school at all, they didn't expect to give birth to a national champion, who wouldn't be excited?
"Good boy, this is all the result of your own hard work. Your mother and I have always felt ashamed of you and failed to take good care of you."
Xu Shiyan hugged his crying wife with his left hand, and wrapped his arms around his son with the other.
"No, Mom and Dad are doing well.
Since I was a child, you have given me enough space to play. No matter what I do outrageous things, you never interfere with me.
No matter how many books I want to buy, you will support me without hesitation.
Without your support and understanding, how could I have won the award? "
Xu Haiyuan is slightly taller than Xu Shiyan, but he leans contentedly in his father's arms.
The picture of a family of three cuddling together is really warm and touching.
The family of three hugged each other excitedly. Over there, for some unknown reason, some well-dressed people, most of them wearing glasses, surrounded several students excitedly.
Then, I heard arguing from over there.
"What are you doing over there?" The three of Xu Shiyan calmed down a little, and they also noticed the abnormality next to them.
"They are teachers from some key high schools in the capital, and they are robbing people."
Someone beside him explained Xu Shiyan's doubts.
Every year, the junior high school league in mathematics, physics and chemistry is a good opportunity for key high schools in various provinces to compete for talent.
Especially the top high schools in the capital will take advantage of the opportunity to **** high-quality students.
These students were admitted in the past, and they were all focused on training.
In the first year of senior high school, I completed the entire high school curriculum, in the second year of high school, I focused on training the knowledge points of competitions, and in the third year of high school, I participated in the national league.
Even some students with particularly good grades will participate in the national competition in the second year of high school.
If you perform well in the national competition and win awards, you can get recommended places for universities such as Qingbei Fujiao.
When the winners were announced just now, these people actually understood that Xu Haiyuan is not from the capital.
I don’t have a registered permanent residence in the capital, so I can only borrow to go to school here, which is very troublesome. In the future, I have to go back to the province for the college entrance examination.
So, even though Xu Haiyuan is the league champion, they really didn't come to fight for him.
After all, there are many outstanding children. Xu Haiyuan is the champion right now. Who can guarantee that he will win in high school?
Xu Shiyan felt very regretful when he heard it. How good would it be if Xu Haiyuan could have a permanent residence in the capital? Can't he study in the capital?
The quality of teaching in the capital is much better than that in Fusong.
Fusong No. 1 Middle School is considered the best school in the county. Compared with these key high schools in the capital, it is really not worthy of carrying shoes.
If Xu Haiyuan can study in a key high school in the capital, with his intelligence and hard work, he will definitely not be bad in the future.
It's a pity, without a permanent residence in the capital, you can't get a student status here. Even if you ask someone to help you, you can only borrow it.
If you borrow to read, you will have to go back to the province for the college entrance examination in the future.
In fact, this is very cost-effective. After all, the teaching quality here is high. If the child studies here for three years, if he goes back to the college entrance examination, his grades will definitely not be bad.
This is also normal, because the quality of teaching in Northeast China is generally poor, and the results of the college entrance examination are also average.
Many students are borrowed in Shandong and come back for the exam in the last six months.
Nowadays, the control is not so strict at this time, this kind of thing is common, wait for a few years, and it will not be allowed.
Thinking of this, Xu Shiyan felt a little moved.
This matter is waiting to be discussed with his son. If Xu Haiyuan agrees, no matter what he thinks of, he has to send the child to study.
Of course, this is not the time to ponder these things, Xu Shiyan dragged his wife to sit down, and Xu Haiyuan followed the team leader teacher to sit in front.
After the award ceremony, the short-term confusion gradually subsided, followed by some simple ceremonies, and then the closing ceremony ended.
Participating teams from various provinces have left one after another. Some will return home this afternoon, and some will leave tomorrow.
Especially in those remote areas, it is rare to come to the capital once, so why not take a good look around?
Ji Province's results in this league are not bad. In addition to Xu Haiyuan's first prize, there is also a second prize and a third prize.
No way, the quality of teaching in Northeast China is not as good as Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shanghai and other major college entrance examination provinces. It is very good to get such a result.
"Mr. Xu, it's like this. In this competition, student Xu has achieved excellent results.
We had already called back just now, and the leader said, please come back to classmate Xu’s family with us, go back to the provincial capital first, and celebrate the achievements of classmate Xu. "
The leading teacher in the province hurried to Xu Shiyan and told Xu Shiyan.
Although it is still an update, it is 6,000 words, and only three chapters have not been disassembled. The main reason is that the average subscription has finally exceeded 10,000, and there are many updated chapters, which will drop down, so it is combined into one chapter.

chapters.title: Chapter 788: Pig Killing Celebration (6,000 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 788 Pig Killing Celebration (6,000 words)
"Gee, how bad is this?
Yuanyuan is just a child, and occasionally won a prize in a competition, so it’s not good to have a celebration party, right? "
Xu Shiyan can understand the feelings of the team leader and the province.
But it will be Chinese New Year soon, if I go back to the provincial capital to hold a celebration party, and go all the way home, I am afraid that it will be Chinese New Year when I get home.
"Don't, don't, Mr. Xu, this is what the leader means.
Please Mr. Xu, don't refuse, and go back with us. "The team leader said pleadingly.
"Student Xu Haiyuan won the league championship this time. This is our honor. It is a great contribution."
This is the truth. Over the years, Kyrgyzstan has often won first prizes in competitions, regardless of junior and senior high schools.
But the national championship, this really has never happened.
Everyone has said that, what else can Xu Shiyan say? Then I can only agree.
So I discussed with the team leader teacher, and everyone will return tomorrow.
Just like that, the leading teacher took the students back to pack up their things, and took everyone for a stroll in the afternoon.
Xu Shiyan reserved a table in Donglaishun, and invited the children and teachers from this province to have a meal in the evening.
On the afternoon of the 24th, a group of people boarded the return train, returned to Changchun from the capital, and arrived at the provincial capital on the morning of the 25th.
Thanks to Xu Shiyan calling the leader in advance, everything in winter should be kept simple and not too grand.
At any rate, he didn't wear red and hang colors like Xu Shiyan did a few times before, and he didn't arrange too many people to meet the station outside the station.
Xu Shiyan finally breathed a sigh of relief when he saw this.
It’s the twelfth lunar month of winter, if a group of students wait outside the station for an hour, won’t they all freeze to death?
The four of them stayed in the provincial capital for two and a half days, and it was really a celebration of all kinds.
Many leaders of relevant departments attended, anyway, I don't know whether it is for Xu Haiyuan or Xu Shiyan.
In short, no matter who met Xu Haiyuan, they would all praise him, and then praise Xu Shiyan and his wife for raising a good son and so on.
The principals and directors of several key high schools in the province came to win over Xu Haiyuan, wanting Xu Haiyuan to study in their schools.
The conditions are always good, and all fees are free.
If the high school participates in the competition and wins the ranking, the minimum bonus is 10,000, and there is no upper limit. There are rewards for excellent grades in the college entrance examination.
In a word, as long as Xu Haiyuan goes to study, they will agree to any conditions.
Now, Xu Shiyan didn't know what to do.
He really wanted to send Xu Haiyuan to the capital to study, even if he borrowed it.
In Xu Shiyan's heart, it is the capital after all, the place with the most concentrated resources in the country, and it is incomparable to other places.
The educational resources in the capital are still very good. The teachers are there. Even if Xu Haiyuan borrowed to study in the past, he would not suffer a disadvantage.
But when these people in the province said it, Xu Shiyan was shaken again.
The provincial key high school should not be much worse than the capital, right?
The main reason is that there are many benefits to studying in the province, not to mention the exemption of tuition and miscellaneous fees, scholarships and the like.
The key is that when Xu Haiyuan comes here, he can directly obtain a student status, and he can directly take the college entrance examination in the provincial capital, which is much more convenient than the capital.
Xu Shiyan couldn't make a decision after much deliberation, so he simply told others that he would contact them after discussing with the child and the child's grandparents.
Anyway, there is still half a year before the admission to the high school entrance examination, so hurry up.
The principals and directors also understood that so many people came to fight for it, and they definitely couldn't directly agree.
Otherwise, it would be embarrassing for other schools in front of everyone.
After discussing it later, just contact in private, everyone looks good.
By the morning of the 28th, Xu Shiyan couldn't live anymore, so he hurriedly talked to the leader and planned to go back.
"Okay, Chinese New Year is coming soon, go home and reunite with your family."
The leader waved his hand with a smile, indicating that Xu Shiyan could leave.
"One more thing, after the year you have to go to the capital for a one and a half month training.
This is recommended by the province, and most people don't have this opportunity to learn. We must seize the opportunity and not be lazy. "
The leader looked at Xu Shiyan with a smile, and said an address.
When Xu Shiyan heard it, hey, it's amazing.
That is probably the best school in the country, the place that all cadres who are eager to make progress yearn for most.
To go there for advanced studies, at least the county level must be recommended by the province, which is a very rare opportunity.
Those who have studied and trained there will not have a bad future in the future.
"Leader, don't worry, I will definitely study hard, and I will definitely live up to the expectations of the leader." Xu Shiyan promised with a serious face.
"Well, I know you are reliable, so let's do it.
Go back and bring your parents a good one. The Chinese New Year is coming soon, even if I wish the second elder a new year in advance. "The leader waved his hand and let Xu Shiyan go.
Just like that, the four got on the train and walked back.
When I arrived at Hunjiang, it was four or five o'clock in the morning on the 29th.
Xu Shiyan thought there was nothing to do, just have breakfast later, and then take the car back to Songjianghe.
As a result, as soon as I got off the train, I was escorted away by the train staff at the station before I even got out of the train station.
Guan Enxue had already arranged someone to wait at the station, just because he was afraid that Xu Shiyan would sneak away with his wife and children.
I had no choice but to stay in the city for another day.
The city also prepared a very grand celebration and commendation meeting, and gave Xu Haiyuan prizes and bonuses.
In the evening, a celebration banquet was prepared, and even Guan Enxue and others attended.
"Boy, if I don't arrange someone in advance to stop you at the station, you will definitely run away with your wife and son."
When Guan Enxue saw Xu Shiyan, he complained.
"It's still Guan Shuji's ability to predict things like a god.
The main reason is that the Chinese New Year is coming soon, and I feel like returning home, so I want to go home early. "
What can Xu Shiyan say? Said that he was afraid that the laborers in the city would mobilize the public to organize those celebrations? How could you talk like that?
I can only pretend to be homesick and go over with a haha.
"Well, it's understandable that I feel homesick now that Chinese New Year is here.
I won't keep you here any longer. The celebration banquet will end tonight, and I will arrange for someone to take you home tomorrow morning. "
Guan Enxue nodded. It took another half a month to go out to the capital to compete, and it was normal to be homesick.
"No, no, the road is slippery in winter, and driving is more troublesome. We can just take the train tomorrow morning, and we will be home by one o'clock in the afternoon."
Xu Shiyan quickly waved his hands, and walked from Hunjiang to Songjianghe, and the driving route was basically the same as that of the train.
If you can’t run fast in winter, it’s better to take the train to be safer.
Xu Shiyan insisted that Guan Enxue didn't argue with him, and other people just came to say hello, so he changed the topic.
Many leaders of the city attended the celebration banquet, and the most educated ones came.
Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to discuss the high school with the leaders of the Education Bureau.
"Oh, Mr. Xu is an amateur at first glance.
In terms of grades, our key high schools in the three eastern provinces are no worse than those in the capital.
If you want me to tell you, Mr. Xu, don’t bother. It’s not worthwhile to go all the way to the capital to study, or to borrow it. "
Unexpectedly, when the bureau chief heard this, he laughed.
"The High School Affiliated to Northeast Normal University in our provincial capital is a well-known good school.
If you listen to me, let your child study there, and keep it right.
Besides, this place is close to home, and the student status is directly transferred, so convenient. "
Xu Shiyan hasn’t studied for a few years in total, and Donggang is a remote place, so he can’t usually get in touch with it. How can he know these things?
Originally, Xu Shiyan also planned to find someone who understands him later, ask him carefully, and make a decision after inquiring clearly.
Hearing what the director said at this moment, Xu Shiyan finally understood.
After making a fuss for a long time, he almost sent his son to the capital.
"Hey, thank you Feng Ju for pointing the maze, you say I don't know anything about these things, that's really for nothing.
Thanks to meeting Feng Ju today, thank you very much, come, let me toast Feng Ju. "
This can be regarded as a great help, Xu Shiyan of course wants to express his gratitude, and hasten to toast.
The celebration banquet was very lively, and it didn't end until after nine o'clock.
Xu Shiyan and others lived in the hotel, had a good night's rest, got up early the next morning, had a casual meal and went straight to the train station.
When the train arrived at Songjianghe Station, it was already January 30th, the 26th of the twelfth lunar month in the afternoon.
"My God, this trip took longer than last time.
If there is any delay in this, we will be thirty years old when we come back. "
When the train arrived at the station, Xu Shiyan said with emotion while walking down with his luggage.
Su Anying and Xu Haiyuan who were behind them both laughed, and the chemistry teacher over there couldn't help laughing either.
A group of people got out of the car just like that, walked out along the crowd, and went straight to the exit.
Before the results came out, they heard someone calling them.
Take a closer look, good guys, Xu Haibo, Xu Haitao, Xu Jinfeng, Xu Jinxiu, the nephews and nieces at home are all dressed thickly, waving from outside the station.
Looking behind the children, Xu Shian and Xu Shixiang are also there.
"Yo, second brother, fifth brother, why are you all here at the station? Did you come here to pick us up?"
Xu Shiyan felt warm when he saw his brothers and nephews coming to pick him up at the station.
"That's necessary, isn't this here to welcome our champion?
Let me tell you, ever since our father knew that Yuanyuan had won the award, he didn't know why he was so happy.
Call us a few times, let us all come back, we must hold a welcome ceremony for Yuanyuan. "
Xu Shian stepped forward with a smile, and hugged Xu Haiyuan up.
"It has to be my eldest nephew, really powerful and promising, the second uncle is the rarest of you."
Although Xu Haiyuan is not short, but in front of Xu Shian who is more than 1.8 meters tall and has great strength, he is still not enough to look good, and he was picked up easily.
Xu Haiyuan will soon be fifteen years old, yet being hugged by someone, this feeling is actually quite scary.
"Second uncle, let me down first."
There were a lot of people outside the station, Xu Haiyuan was embarrassed, and he couldn't shout loudly, so he could only speak weakly.
"Hahaha, my eldest nephew is still embarrassed. Okay, let you down."
Xu Shian laughed heartily, then put Xu Haiyuan down, and patted his nephew on the shoulder.
"Good boy, I don't know who to follow with this cleverness. In the old Xu family's life, they really pointed at you.
Let's go, get in the car and let's go home, your grandpa and grandma are waiting at home.
To celebrate your award, a pig was killed at home today. "
When Xu Shiyan and the others were walking back from the capital, they called their family and told them that they would be home by the 29th or 30th at the latest.
After Xu Chenghou received the call, he called Xu Shixian and the others to discuss, asking his sons to come back and celebrate together.
There is no pig at home, so Xu Chenghou specially bought a pig from someone, and made a plan to slaughter the pig today.
Regardless of whether Xu Shiyan and the others come back on the 29th or 30th, the pigs have to be killed.
Brothers Xu Shixian discussed with each other, and they each asked for leave, and came back yesterday afternoon.
Early this morning, that big fat pig was **** and sent to the guillotine.
At this moment, it has become the delicious stew, blood sausage, and big bones in the pot.
"My God, my father can really do it."
Xu Shiyan couldn't help shaking his head when he heard this. The older the old man, the more he can make troubles.
"Let's go, third brother, let's get in the car first, and we'll talk when we get home." Xu Shixiang greeted the big guys with a smile, and they all got into the car quickly.
Xu Shixiang drives the car of his unit, Xu Shian drives the farm, and Xu Haibo drives the car that Su Anying is at home.
Just like that, the three cars left the train station and went straight to Donggang.
When they arrived at the tomb of the martyrs, Xu Shiyan and others got out of the car. They wanted to drag the chemistry teacher to the house to have fun together.
Where is the chemistry teacher willing? This is a reunion of the Xu family, and he is embarrassed to participate as an outsider.
Having no other choice, Xu Shiyan asked Xu Haibo to drive and take the chemistry teacher home.
also said that waiting for busy work, to visit people, must thank the teacher.
Everyone carried their luggage and entered the gate talking and laughing.
As soon as I entered the yard, I saw the big iron pot in the middle of the yard.
At this moment, there is still a fire under the iron pot, and there is steam in the pot, and the smell of stewed meat wafts out with the heat.
This taste is so gluttonous.
"Oh, the third uncle and three aunts are back. Grandpa, grandma, my third uncle and three aunts, and Yuanyuan are back."
Xu Haibin is leading Xu Haiyang and Xu Haiqing to play in the yard.
Seeing Xu Shiyan and others enter the door, Xu Haibin ran into the house, shouting as he ran.
As soon as the people in the room heard the movement, a large crowd came out.
Xu Shixian, Xu Shide, Xue Xiulin, Wei Mingrong, Su Anfang, Li Zongliang, Su Anhua and others all came out of the house and greeted them with smiles on their faces.
"Oh, my eldest nephew is back, this kid is really promising, so rare.
Hurry up, hurry into the house, your grandpa and grandma are nagging all day long. "
Xue Xiulin stepped forward, grabbed Xu Haiyuan's hand, and other people also gathered around, just like this, Xu Haiyuan entered the house.
Xu Chenghou, Zhou Guilan, Chu Xuanhuai, Su Weizhong, Han Cai'e, five old people are sitting on the kang in the east room.
To be honest, they couldn't sit still because of Xu Haibin's voice just now, they were looking out of the room with their heads stretched out.
Seeing Xu Haiyuan coming in accompanied by his aunt and aunt, these old men and women were also very happy, and they all laughed, not to mention how happy they were.
"Grandpa, grandma, master, grandpa, grandma." Xu Haiyuan smiled and came forward to greet the five elders.
"Hey, hey. Hurry up and sit on the kang, it's quite cold outside, have you froze after taking the train all the way back? Get on the kang to be warm."
Zhou Guilan hurriedly moved into the kang, made room for her grandson, and beckoned for Xu Haiyuan to sit beside her.
"Hurry up, take off your shoes and get on the kang, it's getting warmer on the kang."
"Grandma, it's okay today, it's not too cold, and it's almost done on the train."
How could Xu Haiyuan really take off his shoes and get on the kang? So she sat next to Zhou Guilan on the edge of the Kang.
As Xu Haiyuan said, he took out the award certificate from his backpack.
"Grandpa, grandma, master, grandpa, grandma, this is my award certificate."
The certificate of the national competition must be different from that of the provincial competition. Whether it is printed or produced, it is more exquisite.
The certificate case of big red flannel, with a few big characters in gold stamping on it, looks festive and majestic.
Xu Chenghou took turns holding the certificate to look at it, the joy is beyond words.
"Good boy, the old Xu family has eight generations of ancestors, and there has never been a child as promising as you.
If this is put in the past, is it considered a champion or something? Can you be an official? "
Holding the certificate, Xu Chenghou couldn't put it down, looking at it over and over again, and muttering.
"Father, it seems that it can't be counted that way.
Yuanyuan This is a prize in a chemistry competition. If it was in the Qing Dynasty, it should be an eight-legged essay.
However, our Yuanyuan level is really high. I feel that if we put it in ancient times, it would be quite powerful.
Definitely be able to win the Jinshi, if you don’t have enough guarantees, you can still be named a marquis and worship the prime minister, then you will really honor your ancestors. "
Xu Shide was beside him, pondered for a while, and explained to his father.
"I don't care if it's eight-part or nine-part essay, I just know that it's enough for our family to be promising."
Xu Chenghou waved his hand, so he didn't bother to care about the text.
Anyway, he knows one thing, that in the old Xu's family, there are children who are promising.
Brothers Xu Shiyan looked at each other and smiled at each other. At this time, stop arguing with the old man and say what you like.
"Yes, Dad is right, the children of our younger generation are all very promising.
You can see that Xiaobo is at Agricultural University, Jinfeng is at Banking University, followed by Xiaotao and Xiuxiu, and I think they are all good.
Pingping, Jingwen, and Jingyi, who are further down, are also studying very well. In the future, there will definitely be several college students coming out of our family. "
Xu Shiyan sat on the edge of the kang, looked at the nephews and nieces in the room, and said happily.
"Well, that's good. Your mother and I don't look forward to anything else in this life, but we hope that our old Xu's family will be prosperous and future generations will be prosperous."
Xu Chenghou glanced over the children and grandchildren, and nodded in relief.
"Okay, old man, stop talking nonsense here.
The third child and the others have just arrived home, so they must be hungry. Let's eat quickly, and chat after we finish eating. "
Seeing that her daughter-in-law and granddaughters had already packed up the food, Zhou Guilan quickly greeted everyone for dinner.
Xu Shiyan and the others had dinner in Hunjiang in the morning.
The car is too crowded at this time, it would be nice to have a seat, where is there time to eat?
It's already two o'clock, aren't you hungry?
Especially the smell of pork stewed sauerkraut all over the room, I feel even more hungry.
In order to celebrate Xu Haiyuan winning the award, today the family slaughtered a big fat pig weighing nearly 300 catties.
So this meal must be an authentic pig-killing dish.
Sauerkraut and white meat blood sausage, big bones in sauce, boneless meat, pork heart, liver and tongue platter, fried meatballs, sweet and sour pork ribs, pig ears mixed with cucumber, square meat dipped in garlic sauce.
Although there are only these few dishes, the servings are not small, and several of them are served directly on the basin.
Especially the square meat, all of which are streaky and three-layered skin-on loin meat.
Palm-sized square meat, cooked in a pot and let cool, then cut into slices with a knife.
Mash the garlic cloves and put some soy sauce in it, which is the garlic sauce that people in Northeast China often call.
The large slices of cooked meat are trembling, dipped in a little garlic sauce, the meat is not greasy or greasy, and the meat is full of fragrance. It is safe to eat and still want to eat, and it is impossible to stop.
Su Weizhong and his wife, Su Anfang, Su Anhua and others all came, and the three tables were full.
The five old people are all at this table on the kang, Xu Haiyuan is the protagonist today, so of course he is also on the kang.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying, both of whom had a good time with their son, were also at this table on the kang.
The children of Su Anfang and Su Anhua's family were young, and it happened that Su Weizhong and Han Cai'e hugged each other and coaxed them to eat.
The twenty-sixth day of the twelfth lunar month is only a few days away from the Chinese New Year.
Xu Shixian and the others all came back from a long vacation and planned to spend the new year here before going back.
In the spring of this year, both Xu Shixian and Xu Shixiang bought buildings in the county.
This building is much more convenient than a bungalow. You can just lock the door, and you don't have to worry about burning the fire all day long.
Xu Shide's family lives in the public house of the Beigang Township Government, so there is no need to worry about someone taking care of them anyway.
Brothers have discussed with each other, and they will all stay and celebrate the new year with their parents.
After all, Xu Chenghou and his wife are getting older, so spend more time with the elderly during the holidays, so as not to leave any regrets in the future.
The children and grandchildren stayed to celebrate the New Year, and the happiest couple was Xu Chenghou and his wife.
I killed a pig during the Chinese New Year this year, plus the benefits from Xu Shiyan's work unit, Guo Shouye, Yang Junxian, Huang Shengli and other things sent by brothers and buddies, the family has everything.
From the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth lunar month, the old lady led her daughter-in-law and granddaughters to prepare things for the New Year.
Pork in a big pot, pork knuckles in sauce, stewed skin jelly.
In the morning, two large pots of noodles are served, and at noon, steamed jujube steamed buns, hair cakes, steamed buns and rolls with sugar triangles.
Zhou Guilan knows how to make good pasta, jujube steamed buns can be made in various designs, and can also make various steamed buns such as goldfish, hedgehog, and bunny.
In the sugar triangle, white sugar is mixed with walnut kernels, peanut kernels, and sesame seeds. One bite is delicious and sweet.
Fat cake is fermented with rice flour and white flour, and sprinkled with chopped dates, honey beans, raisins, etc.
The steamed hair cake is soft and sweet, not to mention how delicious it is.
Not only these, Zhou Guilan also brought out the prepared glutinous rice, zong leaves, candied dates, etc., and led the daughters-in-law to make zongzi.
Pronounced in Northeast dialect, zongzi is actually called earning son. Zhou Guilan put money and dates in the zongzi, which is called early earning money, which has a very good meaning.
Finish the staple food, and fry some snacks.
Put a large spoon on the stove, croquettes, dried fruits, crispy twists, collars, mushrooms, eggplant boxes, meat segments, etc.
Anyway, the smell in the kitchen has never been broken, causing the children to stand outside the kitchen one by one, staring at the delicious food inside.
On the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth lunar month, Su Anfen and Ji Tongzhong, who were far away in Yangcheng, and Su Anzhen and Nan Zhendong, who were in the capital, all rushed back.
No one expected that on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth lunar month, Han Liwei and Xu Shiqin would also come back with their children.
The couple spent the New Year in Yangcheng last year, so they plan to come back this year.
But Han Liwei was delayed for a few days due to some impromptu business, and he didn't arrive home until the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth lunar month.
On New Year's Eve, the Xu family's side is not to mention how lively it is.
Waking up early in the morning, Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao led his younger brothers to erect lantern poles, hang strings of lights, and paste couplets with the word "God God" outside.
The boys were mischievous, they were doing their work, and from time to time they lit a firecracker and threw it away.
The firecrackers exploded, and a few little ones clapped their hands happily and jumped up and down.
The girls were not idle either. They put up window grilles in the house and helped with cooking.
There was a reunion dinner at three o'clock in the afternoon. There were more than 20 people in a large family. The scene was not to mention how lively it was. Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were laughing from morning till night, unable to close their mouths.
In the evening, the women make dumplings, the men get together to laugh and chat, and the children spend a lot of time playing.
Xu Haibo led his younger brothers to find out the glass canned bottle, wrapped the mouth of the bottle with wire, made a handle on it, and lifted it with a small stick.
Then nail the small wooden block, the candle sits on the small wooden block, and put it in the bottom of the jar, which becomes a simple lantern.
A few young people held a lantern, and then they dressed neatly, covered themselves tightly, and went out to play with the lanterns.
It’s still a 6,000-word update, I’ll take it easy and write more.

chapters.title: Chapter 789: The Liveliest Year (6,000 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 789 The Liveliest Year (6,000 words)
There is a big red lantern hanging in the courtyard of Xu's house, and a 60-watt light bulb is pulled inside the lantern.
Plastic sheds, garden poles, and string lights of various colors.
It’s Chinese New Year, what we want is this atmosphere.
Life is better now, the electricity bill is not bad these days, and the good day of family reunion is naturally as lively as it is.
With so many lights, the yard is very bright, even if the children don’t play lanterns, it’s fine.
But these children can't stay idle, so how could they just obediently play in the yard?
The children from the neighbors in the neighborhood came over and yelled, and these children went out in a large area, jumping all over the street, playing slippery.
Xu Haiyuan led his younger siblings and ran to Su's house for a tour.
Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui are going to help grandma and grandpa make dumplings for a while.
Anyway, there are many people in the family, so they are not short of the two of them. When I have time, I just come to accompany my grandparents, so as to save them from loneliness.
When the old couple of the Su family saw their grandson and granddaughter coming, they were very happy. They brought out all the delicious food at home, and let the children eat whatever they wanted.
It's Chinese New Year, and every household has food, let alone the Xu family.
Bought by the old couple, shared by Xu Shiyan, gifted by relatives and friends, and brought back by Xu Shixian, there are many.
Apples, oranges, pears, etc. are directly placed in baskets and boxes in the outhouse, and the children can get what they want to eat by themselves.
But the children are still very face-saving, grab a handful of pine nuts, or eat a frozen pear with a bit of ice.
Su Weizhong grabbed several handfuls of candy and stuffed them into Xu Haiqing's coat pocket.
"Take it home and eat slowly. If your mother dislikes you, you can tell her that I gave it to you."
Xu Haiqing secretly glanced at his brothers and sisters, then nodded to his grandfather with a smile, and patted his coat pocket contentedly.
I was thinking in my heart, I will hide the candy when I get home, so that my mother can't find it.
Xu Jinping had already seen her younger brother's little tricks, but she just didn't bother to argue with him during Chinese New Year.
"Grandma, let me help you make dumplings."
The two girls took off their coats, scarves and hats, went directly to wash their hands, and sat on the edge of the kang to help make dumplings.
Xu Jinping can roll out skins and make dumplings, but the work is so fast.
I saw her rolling pin in one hand and dough in the other, but she didn't see how to roll it out, and the dumpling skins came out.
Not long after, there was a pile of dumpling wrappers in front of her. So I stopped the rolling pin and started making dumplings.
Northeast people like to make dumplings with bone spoons, which are usually ground from beef ribs. The front end is round, which is more convenient to use than chopsticks.
Seeing that Xu Jinping had a dumpling wrapper spread out on her left hand, she used a bone spoon to dig a lump of meat stuffing into the dumpling wrapper with her right hand, and then grabbed and squeezed it with both hands, and the dumpling came out.
In the time Xu Haiqing ate a frozen pear, his sister had already rolled out the leather and bags and made half of the curtain.
Although Xu Jinhui is not as quick as her sister, she is not bad. The dumplings she made are small and delicate, and they are also pretty.
"Our Pingping's job is really amazing. Among these girls, they are also top-notch."
Han Cai'e looked at the two granddaughters and smiled happily.
"Huihui is also very good. She is so big. She can cook and do everything. The dumplings are so beautiful."
With the help of Xu Jinping and sisters, the dumplings were naturally made much faster. After a while, the two curtains were full.
"Grandma, grandpa, let's go home first. After eating the dumplings later, we will be the first to come over to say New Year greetings to grandma and grandpa."
It's almost ten o'clock, and the children are thinking about cooking dumplings and setting off firecrackers at home.
Anyway, the dumplings are almost done, so tell Su Weizhong and his wife quickly, and run home after dressing.
The Su family is only a mile away from the Xu family. For these children, it took no effort at all, they slid all the way, and they arrived home in a few minutes.
When I got home, I saw that the dumplings here had just been made and were being cleaned up.
The wrapped dumplings were placed in the shed outside, curtain by curtain, and the plates, pots, and kitchen knives were also taken away.
Then Zhou Guilan took a feather duster and swept off the white flour on the kang.
"Don't say it, this Kang leather is just good. Look how slippery it is? It's easy to sweep things.
Otherwise, the conditions are getting better and better now.
In the past, there were kang mats all over the house, which were a bit dusty and dusty, and they were all hidden in the cracks of the kang mats.
The kang mat rubbed the clothes, good clothes, the buttocks were worn first.
Later, I used that fibreboard to paint. It was okay when it was new, but when the paint peeled off when it was old, it was irritating. "
Zhou Guilan chanted while sweeping the kang.
Kang leather is a new item used by people in the Northeast to lay kang after kang mats and fiberboards.
They are sold in stores, most of them are 1.8 meters wide, and there are large rolls standing there, and they are sold by the meter.
Depending on the quality and thickness, it ranges from more than a dozen yuan to more than 30 yuan per meter.
This thing is better than kang mats and fiberboards, with a smooth surface and various patterns on it, with bright colors and exquisite patterns.
It should be said that apart from being expensive, there are no other problems.
Not long after this thing became popular, Zhou Guilan heard people say that the kang leather was good a few years ago, so she went to the store and bought several pieces, and replaced all the fiberboards on the kang at home.
"Well, it's pretty good, there are still dige in the county.
Some people spread a piece of cement on the concrete floor at home, and change into slippers when they enter the door, which is also very good. "
Chen Chunling just took out the dumplings, and when she went back to the house, she heard what her mother-in-law said, and laughed.
"How do you say this? It's called the progress of the times.
Today’s life is really getting better every day. When we were young, how could we have imagined that we could live such a good life? "
Probably because of the Chinese New Year, Zhou Guilan was particularly emotional.
After the dumplings are made, the house is cleaned up.
Everyone was either sitting on the kang or on the stool, staring at the TV and watching the sketch cross talk, and from time to time they were amused by the baggage that the actors shook out.
At half past ten, Su Anying went to light the fire. Before eleven o'clock, the water in the east and west large pots boiled.
Zhou Guilan yelled, and the daughters-in-law rushed to the kitchen to cook dumplings.
On the other side, Xu Shixian led his four younger brothers and the children of the family out to set up tables, distribute papers, and set off cannons.
The yard suddenly became lively, with all kinds of movements.
The crackling of firecrackers, the sound of fireworks exploding in the air, and the exclamation of children from time to time.
Xu Chenghou and Chu Xuanhuai didn't go out, they sat on the kang and drank tea.
Listening to various sounds outside and watching the fireworks flying outside the window, the two old men laughed at the same time.
"It's great, this is how you live your life. There are many people in the family, and it's fun."
Chu Xuanhuai couldn't help but sighed.
"Yes, what do people want in their life? Isn't it just about future generations?
Seeing that all the children and grandchildren are living a prosperous life, I have no more thoughts. "
Set off firecrackers, cook dumplings, and celebrate the New Year with the whole family.
Steaming hot, fragrant dumplings are placed on the table, and there are happy smiles on the faces of men, women and children in the family.
Everyone gathered together like this, eating dumplings happily.
The children are gearing up, secretly hiding their small thoughts, hoping to earn a few more money.
Whoever eats it will definitely shout, "Money, money."
Don't mention that snarky energy, I can't wait to dance eight times in place.
Others looked at the person who paid the money with envious eyes, and then lowered their heads to eat hard, hoping to get some money from eating.
The children ate a plate without knowing it.
My lord saw it, no, what if I get full? Hurry up and persuade me not to let me eat any more.
After eating the dumplings, pack up, and the time is almost up.
When the twelve o'clock bell rang, Xu Haibo led his younger brothers and sisters. The twelve children knelt on the ground in a large area, and kowtowed to their grandparents for the new year.
"Happy New Year, grandparents, I wish grandparents a long life, peace and prosperity."
Xu Chenghou and his wife were so happy that they quickly took out a large stack of red envelopes from their pockets and gave them one by one.
The children thanked their grandparents in unison, then got up from the ground, happily received the red envelopes, and ran to the side.
Xu Haiyuan led his younger siblings, knelt down again, and kowtowed to Chu Xuanhuai.
"Happy New Year, Shigong, I wish you good health, peace and happiness."
Chu Xuanhuai was so happy that he couldn't close his mouth from ear to ear, he hurriedly called the children to get up, and gave out big red envelopes to all four children.
Over there, starting from Xu Shixian, the five brothers also took turns to distribute red envelopes to the children.
Now that life is better, there are only a few children in the family, and each of them gives a red envelope of five or ten yuan to coax the children to have fun.
This is the happiest time for the children, and they all want to jump to the sky.
When you get the red envelopes, put them in your arms quickly, it's rare.
Xu Haiyuan led his younger siblings out and went straight to Su Weizhong to pay New Year greetings to his grandma and grandpa.
On the TV, the finale program of the Spring Festival Gala is over, and there is nothing exciting about it.
Xu Haibo and the others shouted, who wants to play poker.
The bear kids were very excited for Chinese New Year, and after taking a nap in the afternoon, they were all energetic now, so they went to the Westinghouse to play with poker.
Xu Shixian and the others didn't feel sleepy, so they just moved out mahjong. Men and women sit at a table, so it's good to play a few rounds of mahjong.
"Father, do you want to play two games?" Xu Shixiang deliberately greeted Xu Chenghou on the kang.
"Come on, play with yourself, I haven't touched these things for many years."
Xu Chenghou waved his hand, since he moved from Kuandian to Fusong, he quit gambling.
In recent years, no matter whether it is mahjong, poker, poker, or Pai Gow, they have not played at all.
"Well, when your father played cards, he didn't have any of you.
Regardless of your father’s age, if he really plays with you, it won’t be enough to tie the five of you together. "
Zhou Guilan said with a smile over there.
"When our family was still in Kuandian, your father would go out to make money in winter, and sometimes he wouldn't come back for a month or two.
It’s almost the end of the year, and there’s nothing at home. When your father comes back, I’ll lose my temper with him.
He was not angry either, and left with a smile.
Back in three to five days, there are fish and meat, eggs, cloth, and a lot of them to carry home. The New Year's goods are all there, and he won them all. "
Zhou Guilan couldn't hold back, and talked about the things in the early years.
Xu Chenghou loved to play when he was young, and he was really gambling like his life. He often went out for a long time, and he would go home when he ran out of money.
It was the same in Kuandian that year. Every winter, there were bureaus in various places, and whoever set up the bureau had to draw a lot of money, and these money-seekers ate and drank.
Needless to say, if you lose, you will rarely get home money if you win.
Generally, people pay for good wine and meat, and they will be gone after a meal.
There is no one who makes a fortune playing with money, but if Xu Chenghou wants to win some money, it is really not difficult to buy New Year's goods for his family.
Speaking of which, Xu Chenghou also has some skills.
Even after the Xu family fell, he sold bristles, opened powder workshops, and opened weaving workshops. He did a lot of business and made some money.
But it's useless to make more money, because you can't stand the money-making ghosts around you.
Those people saw that Xu Chenghou was rich, so they tried to get Xu Chenghou out of his circle. After a few months, the money was gone.
At any rate, I moved to Fusong, where there is no such environment around, nor the influence of those money-playing ghosts.
Coupled with the fact that he is getting older and has many children at home, Xu Chenghou also knows that he should live a good life.
Only then did he stop playing with money, and live according to his duties.
"Look, how many years have passed, why are you still mentioning it now?
Thanks to the fact that all the grandchildren have gone to the Westinghouse, otherwise where would I put my old face? "
Xu Chenghou was not annoyed when he heard what the old wife said, he just smiled and said slowly.
Xu Shixian and the others burst out laughing upon hearing this, and this article will be considered over.
The old couple were too old to stay up too late, so they went to the east room to rest.
Chu Xuanhuai couldn't stay up all night, so Xu Shiyan and his wife didn't play mahjong, but helped Chu Xuanhuai go home.
Chu Xuanhuai was settled, and a lot of coal was added to the boiler, and several kangs were fired again, and then checked for any abnormalities everywhere.
Everyone knows that his family stays with his parents every New Year's Eve, afraid that someone will come in and walk in.
Lai Pigui is not at home every Chinese New Year, and goes to the deep mountains and old forests to stay.
The main reason is that there are too many people in the family, especially the firecrackers are too loud on New Year's Eve.
The little guy likes to be quiet, and he finds it too noisy, so he hides out when the Chinese New Year comes, and comes back after a while.
At one o'clock, Xu Haiyuan came back first, followed by Xu Haibo and others.
The big guys don't need to take off their clothes, just sleep in a whole body.
After sleeping until dawn, I quickly got up and went to Xu Chenghou's place for breakfast.
On the morning of the first day of the new year, I must still eat dumplings.
After dinner, first the neighbors went around to pay New Year's greetings, then went to Han's house, and then Xu Haiyuan led his younger siblings to Guo Shouye's place.
The performance of the participating company was very good last year. The workers have been busy for a year, so it is time to relax.
On the morning of the first day of the Lunar New Year, the people participating in the Yangko team performed Yangko performances in the company compound, high school, elementary school and other places.
Now that life is better, every household has a TV, and not many people watch this movie, so this year I didn't book a movie theater.
But this twisting Yangko, only once a year.
So at the side of the participating company, no matter men, women, old or young, they all came out of their homes and went to the street to watch Yangko twisting.
Even on this side of Donggang Town, many people went to join in the fun, not to mention the scene, the crowds were so spectacular.
In addition to twisting Yangko, Shenye Company has made ice and snow sculptures in the open space to the east of Shenchang Primary School, in front of the company building, and at the entrance of the health care product factory.
Especially in the large open space at the east end of the elementary school, there are dozens of ice and snow sculptures of various colors.
There are a lot of lights in this area. From the 30th to the 15th night of the first lunar month, the lights are on, and they are very beautiful. You don’t need to go to Songjiang River to see the ice lanterns.
There is also a large open space in the north of Sanchang Elementary School, and the Great Snow Wall is built on the other end, with steps at one end and a long **** at the other end.
The **** is the best place for children to play.
Get a small sledge, and slide down from the top at once, and can go a long way.
Some children don’t have a sledge, so they can simply find a piece of plastic sheeting or a paper shell to pad it, and they can slide down, and they still have fun playing.
As for the elementary school playground, an ice skating rink has been set up since the beginning of the winter vacation.
Physical education teacher of Canchang Primary School, teaching children to skate during the winter vacation.
Xu Haiqing has been busy this winter, going skating in the morning and learning to sing and dance in the afternoon.
During the Chinese New Year, the teacher stopped teaching the students, the skating rink was open, and the children around could be regarded as fishing. Wearing homemade skates, it was a joy to play.
On the night of the first day of the new year, fireworks were set off on the side of the company building.
The surrounding residents and factory workers all gathered around, looking up at the fireworks.
There are also some people who are too lazy to squeeze in, so they just watch in their own yard.
These fireworks are not the ones set off by each family on the thirty night.
These are all specially customized in a place. The fireworks fly high, and when they explode, they will show various patterns, which are very beautiful.
In the evening, Xu Shiyan and others also came to watch the fireworks.
Looking at the colorful, bright and beautiful fireworks exploding in the sky, exclamations burst out from around.
"The fireworks that last half an hour will cost a lot of money, right?"
Su Anying stood beside Xu Shiyan, looked up at the beautiful fireworks exploding in the sky, and asked Xu Shiyan casually.
"Well, it's more than a hundred thousand. For Chinese New Year, just have fun.
Everyone has been busy talking about this year, and something new makes them all relax. "
Xu Shiyan smiled, and stretched out his arms to hug his daughter-in-law. The two leaned together, looking up at the fireworks.
"Let's make money, we need to calculate how to earn more.
You don’t need to spend money, you can spend it as you feel comfortable, as long as the big guys are happy, the money is worth it. "
The first day of junior high school passed in such a lively manner, and the second year of junior high school, Han Liwei brought Xu Shiqin and two children back.
The whole family gathered together, taking family portraits, roasting whole lamb, and shabu-shabu, it was another day full of excitement.
When it came to the third day of junior high school, Xu Shixian and others had to accompany his daughter-in-law back to her natal home. The whole family had been reunited for six or seven days, so they should do their own things.
Xu Chenghou's old couple prepared a lot of things for their sons, pork, chicken, big goose, radish and cabbage, fried snacks for the New Year, skin jelly, etc., and each family was not young or old.
"Oh, Dad, Mom, we also have them in our family.
Let’s save these for the second elder to eat, there is really no need for us. "
Xu Shi first took a look, is this okay? Mom and Dad are planning to vacate the house, right? That's not okay.
"You two live in the building, and the fourth child lives in the public housing of the unit, without a vegetable garden.
Don’t think I don’t know, you have to buy every bite.
These radishes and cabbages were all grown by your father. They were specially picked out of the cellar years ago, and the selected ones are left to you.
Eat these first when you go back. Those dried beans, dried eggplants, bracken, monkey legs and so on can be put away, and they can be taken out when there is no food in the spring. "
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan couldn't help but stuff things into the trunk of the car of Xu Shixian, Xu Shide, and Xu Shixiang.
When they came, the trunk was filled with a lot of things for parents, and when they went back, parents filled the trunk for them.
In this, what is carried is by no means as simple as food, but the care and love of the elderly for their children and grandchildren.
"Father, Mom, let's go then, take care, the elders, and call later if you have anything to do.
We all have cars now, so it’s convenient to come back. "
These brothers have all been promoted. They are high enough to be equipped with cars. Nowadays, the management is not strict, and it’s okay to drive back.
"Third brother, my brothers have been in touch frequently, what's the matter with you, remember to call us.
Mom and Dad will have to take care of you and your wife. We are far away and can't take care of them. "
Xu Shixian turned his head and said a few words to Xu Shiyan.
"Well, don't worry, big brother. My father and mother are in good health, and nothing is wrong. Yingzi and I will take good care of them." Xu Shiyan nodded to his brothers.
Just like that, the brothers of the Xu family drove away, and Xu Shiyan and Su Anying also led the children to the Su family.
Last year when both Su Anying and Su Anfen lived in Yangcheng, the Su family could not get together.
Happy this year, all six sisters of the family are back, and the Su family is reunited.
Su Weizhong and his wife looked at the people in the room, and they were happy from ear to ear.
The brothers-in-law got together, drinking, playing cards, and bragging. Anyway, they were very happy.
From the fourth day to the sixth day of the first month, the participating companies joined hands with Donggang Township to hold a performance to welcome the new year.
The performance is held in a movie theater, how can anyone watch a movie nowadays? The cinema has long been vacant, and most of the seats are broken and unusable.
The movie theater is not profitable, and no one repairs it, so it is just left there and no one cares about it.
The movie theater in Donggang Township is very large and can accommodate many people, so it is used as a venue for performances.
Donggang Town’s subordinate villages, units and schools in the town, as well as factories and units of participating companies, all sent representatives to participate in the performance.
Shenchang Elementary School also selected a program, and Xu Haiqing, the leader of the participating elementary school team, performed several programs.
This kid, partnered with a teacher from their school, and performed a cross talk.
Don't look at others as small, but they are not afraid at all when they are on stage, teasing and teasing with the teacher, making the people below laugh and laugh.
Later, they sang in a chorus with their classmates, and Xu Haiqing was the one who led the singing.
In the end, the kid came up again and gave another section of the allegro, which aroused the applause of the whole house.
"Third brother, I think you should send Haiqing out to study folk art.
This child was born to eat this bowl of rice. Whoops, why do you think he is so funny. "
Yang Junxian, Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others were all sitting in the front row of seats.
Watching Xu Haiqing perform on stage, Yang Junxian couldn't help sighing.
"Well, there is no rush, let's finish reading the book first.
Our family’s conditions, to put it a bit crazy, even if Haiqing doesn’t do anything in the future, he can still eat and drink for a lifetime.
It's good for children to have interests, but they can't point to their interests to eat.
Look at those folk art actors who are very good on stage, but also suffer a lot down there. "
Xu Shiyan had already thought about this matter.
In his opinion, even if Xu Haiqing is such a material, he can't send him away to study right now. He doesn't want his child to suffer.
The child is still young, so it is important to study.
In the future, if Xu Haiqing is really interested in literature and art, that's easy, and it's not difficult to get into an art school or something.
It doesn’t work right now, it can only be cultivated as an interest, and the main energy still has to be on learning.

chapters.title: Chapter 790: Provincial Group Company
chapters.content:
Chapter 790 Provincial Group Companies
Xu Shiyan went to see the performance on the first day of the three-day performance.
He is busy, how can he have time to go to the show every day?
On the fifth day of the first lunar month, the management of participating companies and relevant leaders of the Forestry Bureau had dinner together to discuss the cooperation between the two parties this year.
On the sixth day of the first lunar month, Xu's family entertained guests with wine.
Greeted Yang Junxian, Zhou Qingguo, Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Chunming and others, together with their brothers, Ji Tongzhong, Nan Zhendong and others.
The big guys got together, chatted and laughed, and set a goal for the new year.
On the seventh day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan arranged a dozen or so tables in the company's cafeteria, inviting colleagues from the unit to eat.
When Xu Haiyuan got his results in the provincial competition, Xu Shiyan promised to treat everyone to dinner.
It’s the Chinese New Year after returning from the national competition, and this meal has been delayed until the new year. If you don’t invite others, you should say that he is reluctant to have a meal.
On the eighth day of the first lunar month, junior high school started.
Although Xu Shiyan had negotiated with the High School Attached to Northeast Normal University, Xu Haiyuan was exempted from the entrance examination and enrolled in the High School Attached to Normal University.
But Xu Haiyuan got up early in the morning to pack up and go to school.
At the same time, Ji Tongzhong and Nan Zhendong also set off.
But this time, the two families took the elderly with them, and picked up their parents to enjoy the blessings.
After all, the elderly in the family are old, and they can come back once a year. They are not with their parents and cannot take care of them. They feel ashamed.
Nan Zhendong has a small courtyard house in the capital. There are quite a few houses, even if his parents live together, it is enough.
As for Ji Tongzhong, the couple bought a property in Yangcheng.
In addition, there is still such a big space in the backyard of Zhencaotang, so there will be no place for the old couple to pass by.
In the morning, they drove the two families to the train station, and then Xu Shiyan and his wife went to the county with relevant personnel and materials to discuss matters related to the bankruptcy and reorganization of the county pharmaceutical factory with the county leaders.
Originally, Xu Shiyan didn't really want to take it. He meant to find a place to build a factory in Donggang or Songjianghe.
But the leaders of the county and the city couldn't stand it, and they promised a lot of discounts.
No way, Xu Shiyan called the company's people together for several meetings, and finally decided to take over the county pharmaceutical factory.
Although Shenye Company has taken over the pharmaceutical factory, the form of ownership has changed, and there are many things to deal with in various aspects.
The new factory is the northern branch of Jishengyuan Health Products Factory. Li Zongliang was sent by Xu Shiyan to be the factory manager, and Li Chengrong also went to help temporarily.
Waiting for the factory to be rectified, Li Chengrong will come back to the company.
Taking over an old factory is actually no more worry-free than building a new factory, and we can only take it slowly.
But Xu Shiyan didn't have time to take care of it, he had to go to the capital for training.
On the sixteenth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan embarked on a journey to study in the capital, and came to a certain school located on Line 4 of the Capital Metro.
Don't worry about your previous status as a bully, you have to obediently obey the organization's arrangements like a primary school student here.
After more than 40 days of training, the whole person is as if reborn, and the spiritual realm is different.
After Xu Shiyan finished his training and returned home, the documents from his superiors were officially issued.
Hunjiang Dongfang Ginseng Company was renamed Jilin Dongfang Ginseng Group Company, with Xu Shiyan as the general manager and secretary of the group company.
From a city-owned enterprise to a provincial-owned enterprise, this step is not a small one. The whole company rejoices and congratulates.
Xu Chenghou and his wife were very happy when they heard the news.
Especially Xu Chenghou, specifically asked Chu Xuanhuai, what level is this general manager of a provincial enterprise?
When he learned that Xu Shiyan should now be equivalent to a bureau-level cadre, he slapped Xu Chenghou on the thigh for joy, and had to shout to go back to his hometown to worship his ancestors.
"Okay, please calm down for me, don't be so loud all day long.
With the current status of the third child, he has to pay attention to every move he makes, so that no one can catch him wrong.
Less fuss, live a stable life, better than anything else. "
This time it was Zhou Guilan who stayed awake and poured cold water on her old man.
To save him from being overly happy and talking about it, it will be too late to cause trouble.
"Don't even look at it, what are our sons doing now?
Except for the second child, they are all members of the public family. Seeing that they all have a good future, don't drag them down by talking and talking. "
Zhou Guilan rolled Xu Chenghou's eyes. The older this old guy is, the more unstable he becomes.
"Besides, how can there be that kind of work? Do you think this is just a few years ago?
Now the third child is busy with the company, and Yingzi is busy with the southern factory.
Yuanyuan is going to study in the provincial capital soon, and Pingping is also a competition counselor from morning to night, who has time to accompany you back to your hometown? "
After the second semester of the third year of junior high school started, Xu Haiyuan felt very boring.
He already got the recommendation quota, and he doesn't need to take the senior high school entrance examination. It's a waste of time to stay in school all day.
But if you don’t go to school, it’s useless to be in the clinic all day long.
Chu Xuanhuai sees ten patients a day. In his free time, Xu Haiyuan can only study the secret recipes of medical books brought back from the capital.
Xu Haiyuan felt that he couldn't waste time like this, so he simply proposed to Su Anying that he wanted to go to high school earlier, get familiar with the environment, and learn more things.
The son knows how to make progress, so as a mother, he must support him.
So Su Anying contacted the High School Affiliated to Normal University and told Xu Haiyuan's thoughts.
A few days ago, news came from the high school attached to the Normal University, saying that they wanted to enroll the recommended students who were exempted from the entrance exam this year.
These children are all good seedlings selected from the mathematics, physics and chemistry competition in the third year of junior high school.
The attached high school will open a science intensive class, so that children can enter school early and directly study high school courses.
Try to finish all the three-year courses during the first year of high school.
Start to prepare for the competition in the summer of the first year of high school, and strive to participate in the national league in the fall of the second year of high school.
That’s fine, anyway, they’ve already got the recommended places, so they don’t need to take the senior high school entrance examination.
Still taking junior high school classes is pure waste, it is better to start high school classes as soon as possible.
Being teased by Zhou Guilan, Xu Chenghou didn't have any temper at all, so he could only chuckle.
"Look, am I not happy?"
Xu Chenghou thinks about it carefully, that's the same thing in his hometown, the relatives are gone, and it's the same for those who don't go back.
Besides, the future of the sons is important, so stop tossing.
The old couple on one side were discussing the matter of worshiping the ancestors, while on the other side, Chu Xuanhuai was discussing with Xu Shiyan to go back to the provincial capital.
"Shiyan, I plan to go back to the provincial capital and open a clinic.
Let Yuanyuan find a house near their school, which is closer and can take care of Yuanyuan.
By the way, I have to go back and report to Yuan Yuan for the TCM exam this fall.
Yuanyuan’s level is higher than yours, so it’s useful to let him pass the exam earlier. "
Chu Xuanhuai came to live in Donggang just for Xu Haiyuan, now that Xu Haiyuan is going to study in the provincial capital, why is Chu Xuanhuai still staying here?
He has to go back to pave the way for Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Shiyan understood what Chu Xuanhuai meant when he heard it.
"Master, if you are like this, Yuanyuan and I will not be able to repay your kindness in this lifetime."
"Cough, why not be kind? You are my apprentice, and Yuanyuan is my grandson. Isn't that what you should do?" The old man smiled.
In the past few years in the Xu family, life has been very comfortable.
The Xu family didn't treat him as an outsider, and he also regarded this place as his own home.
Xu Haiyuan is his own grandson. Shouldn’t the grandfather pave the way for his grandson?
Chu Xuanhuai said so, what else can Xu Shiyan say?
"Well, let's send Yuanyuan to school first.
Go back and think about it within the scope that Master said, let's just buy a store or something. At that time, I will hire two nannies to take care of Master's daily life. "
On April 10th, Xu Shiyan and his wife sent Xu Haiyuan to the High School Attached to Northeast Normal University in the provincial capital to meet the principal and teachers of the attached high school.
There are less than 30 students in the intensive science class, most of them are top students selected from junior high schools in the provincial capital, and a few are students from other places.
The school arranged accommodation here, and the conditions are pretty good.
Xu Haiyuan went to school smoothly. With his ability, Xu Shiyan and his wife were not worried at all, so they concentrated on finding a house in the surrounding area.
Chu Xuanhuai intends to open a medical clinic here, but in fact, he intends to accompany Xu Haiyuan in the provincial capital.
After three years of high school, I still don't know where Xu Haiyuan will go to college.
So the couple discussed it, and bought it if they could, or rented it first if they couldn’t, and we’ll talk about it later.
How easy is it to find a house?
Although I always come to this provincial capital, I don’t live here after all, so I’m not familiar with it.
The couple found a lot of people to help, and finally found a place that was more suitable for them not too far from the High School Attached to Normal University.
It is the largest one in a series of stores, with a total of more than 200 square meters upstairs and downstairs.
The house looks like it was newly built for a few years, and the small ones on the side have been rented out.
Only this area is large, probably due to the high rent, so it was left unused and not rented out.
Xu Shiyan and his wife are quite satisfied with this place, which is quite spacious inside.
The size of the first floor is just right for opening a medical clinic, and the second floor needs to be tidied up a bit and a few partitions made.
The Chaoyang in the south is reserved for Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Haiyuan as bedrooms, and the study, living room, and kitchen are separated from the north, which is completely sufficient.
The owner of the house only rents it and does not sell it. There is no way, Xu Shiyan directly signed a three-year contract with the other party, and paid the rent in one lump sum.
Then I found someone and started to tidy up and decorate.
After all, it is a rented house, and I didn’t buy it myself, so I definitely can’t pretend it very well, so I just need to tidy it up and make it passable.
The construction team came to work on the renovation, Su Anying was watching, and Xu Shiyan took the opportunity to meet the provincial leaders.
He tried to find a way to rely on the relationship, found the vice principal of the business school, and offered Su Anying a self-funded junior college place.
Xu Shiyan felt that what his eldest son said was quite reasonable, and the loss for the couple was due to their lack of culture.
Especially Su Anying, who didn't go to school for a day and relied on self-study.
Nowadays, the health care product factory is booming, and the business is getting bigger and bigger, so Su Anying has to go to further training, learn some professional knowledge and so on.
It happened that Xu Haiyuan was going to study in the provincial capital, and Chu Xuanhuai was going to open a medical clinic, so he sent Su Anying to the provincial capital to study for two years and get a college diploma.
I don't think that diploma is of much use, the main thing is to learn something.
Both of them were busy, and they didn't have time to watch in the provincial capital. After finishing the business here, the two of them went back.
As for the decoration of the store, clarify the requirements with the leader of the construction team, and then ask Xu Haiyuan to go and have a look when he is free, and that's the way it is.
Three years later, when Xu Haiyuan was admitted to another place, the rent of this house was withdrawn.
The people who will take over later don’t know what to do, and they will definitely have to reinstall.
When Xu Shiyan and his wife finished their work in the provincial capital and returned home, the annual Spring Fair began again.
Now there is no need for Xu Shiyan to go there in person, the company's sales department can send a few people over there.
Most of the sales department are young people who dare to think and do, and Xu Shiyan gives pointers from time to time. Anyway, this idea is also let them play.
The Spring Fair has achieved a lot, and the new factories in the county have also been reorganized and officially put into operation.
Jishengyuan's health care products can be said to be popular all over the country, with sales of more than 500 million in the first quarter.
The second quarter is not over yet, and the current sales are 300 million, and the orders are even scheduled for autumn.
The factory in the south has already been working on three shifts and is still busy. It just so happens that the new factory is put into production, and the products are directly released to the sales outlets in the north.
The same formula is used on both sides, and the raw materials are also purchased from the same place.
Xu Shiyan also specially transferred several technicians and quality inspectors from the southern factory to ensure that the products from the two factories are consistent in all aspects.
With the new factory to share, the pressure is finally not so great.
It happens that the two factories, one in the south and the other in the north, echo each other, and each supply goods nearby, which also saves a lot of transportation costs than before.
The original Jishengyuan health care products factory was upgraded to a health care products company, with two branches in the north and south, and thousands of sales outlets all over the country.
While stabilizing the original market, Su Anying also obtained the authorization from Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Haiyuan, and began to develop new products.
The domestic health care product industry has been booming in recent years, and various brands have sprung up like mushrooms after rain.
Ji Shengyuan took the lead in gaining a firm foothold, and by virtue of its hard power and public reputation, ushered in a prosperous era.
But behind this prosperity, there is also a crisis hidden, and various counterfeit and counterfeit brands are also emerging.
As a last resort, Jishengyuan Health Products Company can only advertise on major TV stations and newspapers, making a solemn statement.
Remind consumers to be careful not to be confused by some similar counterfeit products, and must go to regular sales channels to buy goods.
At the same time, the company is also focusing on developing the rural market, arranging people to go to the countryside to give lectures, posting posters, slogans, etc. in various places.
In 1992, the annual sales of Jishengyuan health care products were nearly 3 billion.
In the first half of 1993, sales had reached more than 2.5 billion, making it the leader in the domestic health care products industry.
Xu Shiyan built a new factory in Donggang, which became the third branch of Jishengyuan. At the same time, he also planned to build another factory in Luohu.
However, at this time, the province received a report.
It is said that Xu Shiyan, the general manager of Dongfang Ginseng Group, took his own daughter-in-law to open a husband and wife shop for personal gain.
Through the health care products company, a large amount of property was allocated to the couple's pockets.
"Fuck, what kind of **** is this?
Jishengyuan has billions of billions of sales a year, what is the profit? How much profit and tax?
We managed to have such a profitable enterprise, who is this, making trouble with us? "
Chang Hongfa, who was about to retire soon, was so angry when he heard the news that he swears directly on the phone.
Although when the pharmaceutical factory was handed over to the ginseng company to take over, both the county and the city gave great discounts, and the profits and taxes were reduced a lot.
But don’t forget, the factory is gone after changing hands.
The original hundreds of workers were not unemployed, and many people were recruited later, which indirectly drove the local economy.
Furthermore, the main raw material ginseng required by the health care products factory is also purchased locally, which solves the problem of difficult sales of most ginseng farmers.
Don't care about how much tax you pay, there are many hidden benefits behind it.
In the past two years, many local enterprises have faced many difficulties.
In such a predicament, the health care product factory broke out and became a new local enterprise and a pillar industry of the county.
Now that someone wants to touch this golden mountain, can Chang Hongfa be happy?
"Old Chang, calm down, don't worry." It was Guan Enxue on the other end of the phone.
"Xiao Xu reported this matter to me from the very beginning, and later reported it to the province.
The province agrees with me, regardless of whether it is a state-owned enterprise or a private enterprise, let's make money first.
Now there must be someone who is jealous and wants to stab us behind the scenes. It is best to take the opportunity to drag Xiao Xu and his wife down.
At this time, we can't panic, just find a way to help the couple. "
Guan Enxue has outstanding achievements in economic development. Originally, he should retire after he was 60 years old, but his superiors refused to let him, so he was transferred to the province as a deputy.
In the past few years, Xu Shiyan and his wife have been in the limelight, and everyone respects them on the surface.
But behind the scenes, there are indeed quite a few people who dislike them.
So when the incident happened this time, many people really fell into trouble and shouted at Xu Shiyan and his wife.
Xu Shiyan will be suspended from his job, severely punished, all the property of Xu Shiyan and his wife will be confiscated, the health care company will be taken back, and so on.
After a lot of stirring up by interested people, the province is also non-stop, and there are quarrels everywhere, wanting to deal with Xu Shiyan and his wife.
Although Guan Enxue, as well as forestry department and organizational leaders stepped forward to speak for Xu Shiyan.
But those people can't stand it, they can be noisy and noisy, all kinds of dirty water are poured up, and it's too noisy for a while.
"Xiao Xu, don't worry about things like this.
The province still trusts you very much. At present, some people are yelling, don’t listen to them, and work as you want. "
Guan Enxue called Xu Shiyan himself to comfort Xu Shiyan, fearing that Xu Shiyan had never experienced such a thing, and he couldn't think about it for a while.
A person in charge of a company that earns hundreds of millions of dollars in foreign exchange every year and sells billions of dollars in China, no matter which province he is in, is also the treasure of the superior leader. Can you not care?
"Thank you for your concern, I'm fine.
