At the beginning, it was indeed because I didn’t think so thoroughly, so I left a pigtail.
How about this, the leader arranged two groups of people to go to my side and my wife's side respectively.
Check as much as you want, and don't leave people with words. "
Xu Shiyan doesn't care, check it out, he's not afraid of ghosts knocking on the door if he hasn't done anything wrong.
Although the two parties to the cooperation are a state-owned enterprise and a private enterprise, and the other end of the private enterprise is his wife, all cooperation between the two parties follows the rules and follows the formal process.
The formula of the health care product factory was developed by Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Haiyuan, and the patent is also registered in their names.
Therefore, there is no situation where Xu Shiyan used the formula of Shenye Company privately to make profits for his daughter-in-law.
As for the financial accounts, both parties pay special attention to it, and all work in accordance with the rules and regulations.
Unless someone really wants to punish him to death, otherwise, this matter will really not be difficult.
The big deal is that he quit as the general manager, what's the matter.
He happened to go home to watch over his wife and children, and to be with his parents. His life was more comfortable than now.
"Are you kidding me? Your company's annual financial statements are on it. Why do you check?
Besides, you reported this matter at the beginning, didn't we allow it?
If you really say that, then even we can check it. "Guan Enxue laughed on the other end of the phone.
"No, leader, I'm really not joking about this.
Since there are people making trouble, there must be a process to stop those people's mouths.
I will investigate when it is necessary. I will suspend my job and reflect on it. I will wait for the investigation and let the leader handle it. "
Xu Shiyan is very serious, this matter is a pustule, and it will have to be pierced sooner or later.
Since there has already been trouble, let's take the opportunity to pierce the pustules, so that we can continue.
Hearing the other end of the phone, Xu Shiyan really didn't seem to be fooling around. After thinking about it, he really couldn't avoid the problem all the time.
"Okay then, I'll listen to you, I'll give you half a month off, go home and spend time with your parents."
Just like that, Xu Shiyan returned home on vacation, and before leaving, he held a special meeting to appease the aggrieved management.
Let Han Limin, Li Chengrong and others cooperate with their superiors' inspections as much as possible, and at the same time, they must not delay the production everywhere.
"It's about to start making ginseng and making goods. At this time, no one can be picky and playful.
You need to know that this is not you and me, but this is a group company, and tens of thousands of employees have to live.
I don't care, but the workers below can't. "
Han Liming and the others were very angry at first, and they were planning to complain to their superiors.
After Xu Shiyan said this, he could only silence the drums.
"These are not things that people beat up. If you want me to know who stabbed the knife in the back, I will tear him up."
Han Limin slapped the table angrily, and the teacups in front of him jumped up.
"It's okay, this might be our chance.
You all work with peace of mind. After this incident is over, as long as I am the general manager, our brothers will still work together to develop our company. "
Xu Shiyan walked up to Han Limin, patted Han Limin on the shoulder, and smiled.
The people arranged by the superior arrived soon, and checked here for a few days, but found nothing.
Not only can't find anything here, but also can't find anything wrong with Bao'an.
Those malicious people still don't give up. If they catch this mistake, they must drag Xu Shiyan down.
I don’t know why this matter has alarmed the capital, and then the relevant documents have reached the desk of the provincial leaders.
The document only expresses one meaning, regardless of whether it is a state-owned enterprise, a private enterprise, or a public-private partnership, as long as it can develop the economy and improve people's livelihood, it is a good enterprise.
If the country and society want to develop, they cannot lack good comrades who are willing to use their brains and love to study.
With this document, what else is there to say?
The provincial government directly called Xu Shiyan and told Xu Shiyan to come back to work as soon as possible after the vacation.
Just like that, Xu Shiyan returned to the company and continued to be his general manager.
Then, the first thing Xu Shiyan did when he returned to the company was to notify the legal department, prepare the documents, and Jishengyuan Health Products Company split up.
Xu Shiyan remembered what his son said. Private companies and state-owned companies have been mixed for a long time, and there must be problems.
It's just that Ji Shengyuan has developed very well in the past two years, but Xu Shiyan has never been able to find a chance.
What happened this time happened to be an opportunity. Didn’t those people call Ji Shengyuan the couple’s husband and wife shop? Then it's just a matter of breaking up the partners and doing their own things.
Of course, separating the family is not that easy, there are many things to be resolved in various aspects.
Jishengyuan health care products have been in the limelight in recent years. As the general manager of Jishengyuan company, Su Anying has been rated as an outstanding female entrepreneur one after another, which can be said to have attracted much attention.
The turmoil that occurred this time has been widely reported in the media, not to mention that everyone knows about it.
Originally thought that the matter had calmed down, but unexpectedly, Ji Shengyuan split up.
Now, another wave of higher attention has been aroused. Everyone wants to know what the final result of the separation will be.
I want to know more about the future of the two companies after the separation.
After more than two months of negotiations, the separation of the family was finally settled.
The economic environment in the south is more suitable for the development of private enterprises, so the factories and markets there are left to Su Anying's company.
The factory in Fusong is close to here, and together with the northern market, it is given to participating companies.
Ji Shengyuan's current formula can be used by both parties, and the follow-up will depend on their own abilities.
The brand of Jishengyuan was founded by the South Factory and left to the other side.
The factory in Fusong was renamed Jixingyuan, and the outer packaging of the product was also changed to Jixingyuan.
The current sales outlets are bounded by the Yangtze River, with Jixingyuan in the north and Shengyuan in the south.
As for how to develop in the future, it is still the same sentence, each according to its ability, whoever has the ability will grab the other's market.
It is still a 6,000-word update.

chapters.title: Chapter 791: Pave the way for Xu Haiyuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 791 Paves the way for Xu Haiyuan
The turmoil of family separation finally settled in early November.
With such a fuss, it goes without saying that there is a lot of attention.
Furthermore, the factories on both sides intensified their publicity efforts. Now, the eyes of the people all over the country are focused on the twin brands.
So don’t look at the fact that the division has made a lot of noise, but it didn’t affect product sales at all, but instead increased sales by a large margin.
Su Anying took the opportunity to launch a new product and advertised it on major TV stations.
At the same time, in order to seize the market, Su Anying shelved the original plan to build a factory in Luohu.
Instead, they arranged for people to buy land and build factories in the Shanghai stock market and around the capital.
This is the difference between a state-owned enterprise and a private enterprise. If a state-owned enterprise wants to do something, it must ask for instructions and report to the leader for approval.
Private companies are different, especially those like Su Anying who own more than half of the company's shares. Her decision is equivalent to the company's decision, so she can seize the opportunity one step ahead of others.
Of course, Xu Shiyan has a strong foundation after all, with a network of connections all over the place.
So Ji Xingyuan was not left behind, and sales increased instead of falling.
Moreover, some foreign customers are also optimistic about several products of Jixingyuan and intend to purchase them.
That is to say, when everything is on the bright side, the path becomes wider.
Xu Shiyan couldn't help but admire his eldest son, this kid is really capable.
It seems that this division is really the right one.
Xu Shiyan misses his eldest son, but at this moment, Xu Haiyuan is training intensively.
Work hard for the National High School Chemistry Competition held at Hebei University in January next year.
In September of this year, Xu Haiyuan, who was just a sophomore in high school, participated in the preliminaries of the National Chemistry League, that is, the selection of the provincial competition area, and won the provincial first prize.
Selected into the provincial team and qualified to participate in the National Chemistry Competition.
Qualified for the national competition in the second year of high school and became one of the only two players in the provincial team. Which teacher doesn't love such a student?
Teachers of all subjects treat Xu Haiyuan like an eyeball, and the chemistry teacher doesn't treat Xu Haiyuan well to his own son.
As for the physics and mathematics teachers, they secretly hid some small thoughts, and planned to let Xu Haiyuan participate in the competitions of other subjects next year.
They failed to win the chemistry teacher this year, and Xu Haiyuan is really good in chemistry.
For the sake of safety, let Xu Haiyuan concentrate on winning the chemistry competition first.
Next year, the chemistry teacher will not be able to compete with them again. At that time, he will definitely persuade Xu Haiyuan to participate in another subject competition.
Xu Haiyuan didn't know what the mathematics and physics teachers were thinking. He was now wholeheartedly preparing for the national competition, which is the chemistry winter camp.
At the same time, Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu, who are already in the third grade of junior high school, are also training from dawn to dusk to prepare for the junior high school subject competition to be held in mid-November.
County and city trials for the three subjects of mathematics, physics and chemistry are held in the county.
Mathematics on November 14th, Physics on the 21st, and Chemistry on the 28th, which happens to be every Sunday.
"Girl, why don't I accompany you to the county?
If you suffer in a big bus in cold weather, your father will drive you, which will definitely not delay your exam. "
Xu Shiyan came home from get off work and was told by his daughter that she was going to compete in the county.
Xu Shiyan, a slave to his daughter, felt sorry for his daughter going out in the cold, so he had to accompany her to the exam.
"Dad, no need, there are six of us in total, the teacher will take us there, and Xiaoyu will be with us."
Xu Jinping felt quite speechless. When her brother went to the county to compete, he never heard from his father that he wanted to accompany him.
When her brother participated in the provincial competition, her father followed.
Why is it her turn, the county is so close, and she has to drive to deliver it herself?
"Didn't Dad love you? You are a girl, how can you compare with your brother? Your brother has rough skin and thick flesh and is not afraid of cold."
Xu Shiyan chuckled and found a reason.
"Dad, my brother didn't hear what you said. If he heard it, he would be sad." Xu Jinping was teased by her father and couldn't stop laughing.
"To be honest, Dad, you don't need to send us off, the county exam is really nothing.
Xiaoyu was also with him, and he also participated in all three subjects of mathematics, physics and chemistry. "
"If I can pass the selection like my brother, when I go to the provincial competition, I will definitely let you accompany me to the provincial capital.
Just right, I haven’t seen my mother for a long time, and I miss her. "
Su Anying is still studying in the provincial capital. It is not easy for her to balance the company and her studies. She has not returned home since she left in September.
The children haven't seen their mother for a long time, and they are panicking.
My daughter insisted, but Xu Shiyan had no choice but to shelve the proposal to accompany her to the county.
In this way, Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu, as well as other students from the three subjects, went to the county every Saturday, and returned by car after the competition on Sunday.
Not long after, the results of the trials came out one after another.
Xu Jinping is a girl, and the physical circuit is a short board, so her grades are slightly lower, and she was not selected for the provincial competition.
But she ranked first in the county in mathematics and chemistry, and both were selected for the provincial competition.
Yang Haoyu is the first in the county in physics and the second in the county in chemistry, and he was also selected for the provincial competition.
As soon as the results came out, Donggang Junior High School was in a good position.
Ever since Xu Haiyuan won the first place in the Junior High School National Competition two years ago, Donggang Junior High School has been steadily rising in the county's school rankings.
But the results of the subject competition last year were not satisfactory. Only one student participated in the provincial competition and won the third place in the province.
I didn't expect that this year's grades were so good. Two students were able to participate in the three provincial competitions. The junior high school principal and teachers were so happy that they almost couldn't find the north.
The provincial competition starts on December 8th, mathematics on the 8th, mathematics on the 11th, physics on the 11th, and chemistry on the 14th and 15th.
Xu Jinping wants to take part in mathematics and chemistry, and she will get the provincial capital before the 7th.
It stands to reason that Yang Haoyu's physics competition is a few days late, so he doesn't have to start so early.
But what can he do? When his second sister left, he had to leave too.
Both the school and Yang Junxian had nothing to do with this kid, so they could only follow his wishes and set off with Xu Jinping.
The school arranged three teachers to accompany them, and at the same time, Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian also accompanied them.
In this way, on December 5th, the large army set off in a mighty manner, and arrived at the provincial capital on the morning of the 6th.
Knowing that her husband and daughter were coming to the provincial capital, Su Anying also asked for leave to pick up the station.
The family met outside the station, Xu Jinping hugged her mother and refused to let go.
"Mom, I miss you so much, you call home less now. How are you and my brother in the provincial capital? Okay?"
"Very good, isn't mom studying all the time? She's also quite busy.
Sometimes I have a busy day and forget to call when I get home. "
Su Anying hugged her daughter, but looked towards Xu Shiyan.
Actually, it’s not that she calls back less, but mainly because she talks more with her husband.
There was so much quarrel a while ago, and then the family separated and so on. The couple kept in touch, but they didn't call home less.
"Let's go, let's find a place to settle down in this cold weather. Well, where do you plan to let the children live?"
Su Anying asked Xu Shiyan the last sentence.
The children came to the competition, and they were accompanied by three teachers, so they definitely couldn't live in the house rented by Xu's family.
One reason is that it is a bit far away from the Institute of Education, and the other reason is that there is not enough space.
"The provincial hotel, where else can I go? Uncle Guan knew that I was coming to the province, so he had already arranged for it."
The Uncle Guan Xu Shiyan was talking about was naturally Guan Enxue.
The two have known each other for many years, and Guan Enxue has always been very kind to Xu Shiyan, so in private, Xu Shiyan is called his uncle.
Xu Shiyan came to the provincial capital this time, and accompanying his daughter in the competition can only be regarded as a side effect. In fact, he came for a meeting and a report on work.
Before, there was so much quarreling, inspection and separation.
Now that everything has calmed down, Xu Shiyan must come to the provincial capital to meet with the leaders and report on the company's recent situation.
So when Guan Enxue heard the news, he directly arranged a place for him.
A group of people left the station in this way, and went straight to the provincial hotel by car.
After settling down, Xu Shiyan took his wife and daughter, as well as Yang Junxian and his son, to visit Elder Chu.
In April last year, Xu Shiyan and his wife came to rent the house, and it took less than two months to tidy up and decorate it.
Then Chu Xuanhuai moved here and opened a medical clinic called Zhongcaotang.
In fact, in recent years, many medical schools in the province want to invite Mr. Chu to give lectures.
It's just that Mr. Chu wanted to stay in Donggang to train Xu Haiyuan, so he was pushed back.
As Mr. Chu, he will definitely not be able to hide it when he returns to the provincial capital.
So soon after he came back, Mr. Chu was invited to be a visiting professor at the Provincial College of Traditional Chinese Medicine, where he taught a few classes to the students every month.
Chu Xuanhuai picked out a few seedlings that looked good by the way, and asked them to come and learn from the teacher whenever there was no class.
Western medicine emphasizes education, while traditional Chinese medicine emphasizes inheritance.
It doesn’t matter if you don’t take the postgraduate entrance examination for Chinese medicine, the key is to have the teacher lead you out. ,
With Elder Chu's status in the medical field, if he spread the word and wants to recruit apprentices, I don't know how many people want to be apprentices.
It's just that Mr. Chu has a high vision, and he doesn't accept those who are not spiritual.
After all, not all medical students are as intelligent as Xu Haiyuan, and it is not bad to be able to pick a few out of a class of students.
After all, the medical clinic is different from a small clinic in the countryside. A few people are specially hired here to be responsible for reception and dispensing of medicines.
With the addition of a few students studying with the teacher and patients who came to see the doctor, it is quite lively inside.
Xu Shiyan was in front, Su Anying was behind, and a group of people entered the door.
The little girl in charge of the reception knew Xu Shiyan, and hurriedly nodded to say hello when she saw Xu Shiyan.
"Mr. Xu, Mr. Chu is treating people, and there are still four patients in line."
"Okay, you are busy, let's go upstairs and wait for a while."
Chu Xuanhuai is seeing a doctor, and he is also taking care of students. Xu Shiyan and the others are too many to disturb.
So I went up from the side stairs and sat on the second floor for a while.
The place on the second floor is not small, and Chu Xuanhuai, Su Anying, and Xu Haiyuan currently live there.
Su Anying is busy, and doesn't have much time to take care of the diet and daily life of the grandparents and grandchildren.
So here I hired an aunt who cooks and cleans, and everything is cleaned up.
"Sit down for a while, after your teacher is busy, it happens that your brother should be out of school, so let's go out to eat at noon."
Xu Shiyan looked at his watch, there was still an hour before Xu Haiyuan finished school at noon.
There are so many of them here, it is not easy to keep the aunt who cooks busy, it is better to go out to eat, and it is more convenient.
Su Anying went over and told the aunt who was cooking, to go out to eat at noon, there is no need to prepare the meals for Mr. Chu and Xu Haiyuan, just cook her own.
As for the staff in the medical center, they all have food allowances. There are many restaurants and snack bars around here, so they don’t need aunts to cook for them.
"Dad, shall we pick up my brother from school later? I want to surprise my brother."
Xu Jinping hasn't seen her brother for a long time.
In order to prepare for the competition, Xu Haiyuan did not go home this summer, and has been training at school.
So calculated in this way, the two brothers have not seen each other for more than half a year.
"Your brother already knew that you were coming to the provincial capital, and he was pleasantly surprised."
Su Anying helped her daughter tidy her hair, tucked it behind her ears, and said with a smile.
"He knew I was coming, so he definitely wouldn't have guessed that I would pick him up.
No, I have to go and see my brother's school, maybe next year I can study here too. "
Xu Jinping shook Su Anying's arm.
Don't care how old the girl is, she still has to act like a baby when she meets her own mother.
What's more, Xu Jinping hasn't seen her mother for a long time, why don't she take the opportunity to act like a baby?
"Okay, okay, you can pick it up if you want, but don't shake it, my brain has made you confused."
Su Anying is also in her forties, how can she bear the shaking of her daughter? Surrender directly.
"Oh, that's great, Xiaoyu, let's pick up my elder brother from school later, and take a look at his school along the way.
We both strive to get a good result in the competition, and we will walk over like our brother.
Otherwise, let my dad find a way to send the two of us next year. "
Ever since Xu Haiyuan was sent to a provincial key high school without examination, Xu Jinping made up his mind to study in the provincial capital, like his brother.
"Well, second sister, I'll listen to you." For Yang Haoyu, everything his second sister said was right.
Xu Shiyan snorted over there and shook his head.
"Xiaoyu, please be more considerate. Don't worry about what your second sister says. Be careful that one day she sells you, and you count the money for her."
This child is too obedient, no, it should be said that he obeys his second sister too much.
His second sister said to go east, but he would never go west. How will the future be?
Yang Haoyu just laughed and scratched his head when he heard it, but didn't speak.
Yang Jun over there smiled when he saw it, "If it's sold, let's sell it, as long as someone wants it.
I'm afraid that no one will ask for the money if it's the wrong way, and it will end up in my hands. "
As soon as these words came out, everyone laughed.
Everyone chatted and laughed for a while, it was getting late, so they went downstairs together.
It happened that the patients were gone at this moment, Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian stayed to talk with Mr. Chu, Su Anying took Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu to the school to pick up Xu Haiyuan.
"Master, how are you doing? Are you in good health?"
When Xu Shiyan saw Chu Xuanhuai, he was most concerned about Chu Xuanhuai's body.
"It's pretty good, Yingzi and Yuanyuan are taking care of me, and they care about me everywhere, how can it be worse?" Chu Xuanhuai laughed when he heard it.
The elderly are hale and hearty, with a rosy face. You don’t need to ask to know that your health must be fine.
"I can still eat a big bowl of rice for a meal now, you may not be able to eat me better, it's okay."
"I heard from Yingzi that you will bring Pingping and Xiaoyu to the competition.
It’s pretty good, the children are up to the challenge, and they study well. "Mr. Chu was naturally very happy to see Xu Shiyan.
He is too old now, he is not willing to go out easily, and only during the Chinese New Year, he accompanied Xu Haiyuan back to Donggang for a year.
Master and apprentice haven't seen each other for more than half a year, so they are naturally very close.
Chu Xuanhuai waved and called those students over.
"This is the apprentice I took in before, and he is also Yuanyuan's father. Now the well-known general manager of Dongfang Ginseng Group in the province is him."
Apprentices are not the same as students, there is a difference between closeness and closeness.
These students all came to study with the teacher last fall, and the time is not short.
But Chu Xuanhuai only taught them medical skills and never talked about private matters.
So they didn't know the relationship between Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Shiyan, let alone the talented boy Xu Haiyuan in their eyes, turned out to be the child of the general manager of the provincial Oriental Ginseng Group.
"Hello Mr. Xu, I have admired Mr. Xu's name for a long time, and I don't want to be lucky enough to meet a real person today."
Several students were very excited, and hurried forward to salute and say hello.
Xu Shiyan chatted with those young people for a few words. It was getting late, so Chu Xuanhuai said let them go to eat, and go back to school if they have classes in the afternoon.
Traditional Chinese medicine sees a doctor, mostly in the morning, and few people come to see a doctor in the afternoon.
The same is true for the medical center, which is not so busy in the afternoon.
Several students bid farewell and left, and the staff of the medical center also went to buy food. Finally, Chu Xuanhuai was able to chat with Xu Shiyan quietly for a while.
"These students are not bad, not as good as our Yuanyuan, who has a spiritual foundation, but they are considered top-notch in the medical school.
I thought about bringing them along, and if Yuanyuan wanted to do something, these would be his helpers. "
Why is Chu Xuanhuai still taking students with him at such an old age? It wasn't for Xu Haiyuan's paving the way that he didn't bother to move.
He has a pension, not to mention the patents authorized to pharmaceutical factories and health care products factories over the years, which is already a considerable amount.
The old man is not short of money at all, he just wants to train a few outstanding students, who will be Xu Haiyuan's right-hand man in the future.
"Master, thank you for making such a plan for Yuanyuan."
Xu Shiyan knew that Chu Xuanhuai returned to the provincial capital to pave the way for Xu Haiyuan, but he didn't expect that the old man could think so far, so he was naturally very moved.
The luckiest thing in my life is probably to find Mr. Chu again.
Without the help of Mr. Chu, even if he was working in the field, he would definitely not be able to achieve what he is today.
"Well, don't talk about those useless things.
If I want to thank you, I won't do these things. Isn't it good for me to stop and take care of the elderly? "
Chu Xuanhuai waved his hand. It would be too boring to say thank you for their master and apprentice getting along with each other all these years.
Here Xu Shiyan was chatting with the master, and on the other end Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu followed Su Anying to the main entrance of the High School Attached to Normal University to pick up Xu Haiyuan from school.
The bell rang for the end of get out of class, and the hungry children quickly packed up their things and rushed out of the classroom.
The dormitory student ran to the cafeteria quickly, for fear that he would not be able to grab a meal if he was late.
The day students also quickened their pace and hurried home to eat.
Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu, and Su Anying stood outside the school gate, looking inside the school with their heads stretched out.
I want to find Xu Haiyuan among these groups of people.
Thanks to the great winter, the students wear all kinds of winter clothes, unlike school uniforms when the weather is warm, they can be recognized anyway.
"Brother, this way, this way."
I saw a tall, thin boy from a distance, wearing a beige long down jacket and a scarf of the same color, walking out with three or two students.
Xu Jinping had sharp eyes and recognized it immediately. It was his brother.
Xu Haiyuan was walking out with a few classmates when he suddenly heard a very familiar voice.
Looking up towards the school gate, I saw two figures, one tall and one short, beside my mother.
That figure is too familiar, it is clearly his eldest sister and her follower Yang Haoyu.
"Excuse me, my sister is here to pick me up."
Xu Haiyuan, who was usually calm and stable, suddenly changed his face, smiling happily.
After talking to the people around him, he ran out of the school at a trot.
"It's cold, how come you pick me up at the school gate?"
Xu Haiyuan hasn't seen his younger siblings for a long time, how could he not want to panic? Just looking at my sister's cold and red face, I couldn't help complaining.
Xu Jinping didn't care about that, and rushed towards her brother.
"Brother, I finally met you. You don't know, I miss you so much."
Seeing this, Xu Haiyuan quickly opened his hands and gave his sister a big bear hug.
Ordinarily speaking, Xu Jinping, who is 1.69 meters tall, is not considered short, but in front of Xu Haiyuan, who is 1.85 meters tall, she is still a bit short.
Xu Haiyuan smiled and patted his sister on the back, then stretched out his hand to compare with Xu Jinping's head, and couldn't help but sigh.
"I feel like you didn't grow any taller this year. After all, you're only this tall." Xu Haiyuan deliberately teased his eldest sister.
Xu Jinping couldn't help but rolled her eyes, and pushed his brother away angrily.
"Brother, I'm a girl, you still want me to be 1.8 meters tall?"
She is quite tall now, okay? Among the female students in the same class, she is considered tall.
Xu Haiyuan originally intended to tease his younger sister, but when he saw his younger sister was angry, he smiled and hurriedly coaxed her.
At this time, Yang Haoyu and Su Anying also came closer.
"Brother." Yang Haoyu greeted Xu Haiyuan politely.
Xu Haiyuan looked at Yang Haoyu, and let out a hmm from his nose.
This follower has been like this since she was a child, wherever Pingping goes, he will follow.
Don't believe that they will be able to go to the same university in the future? What will he do then?
Yang Haoyu seemed to sense that his elder brother's attitude towards him was a bit wrong, but he didn't know why, so he could only smile at Xu Haiyuan.
Su Anying over there didn't notice anything at all, she just looked at the three children in front of her with a smile.
A mature and stable eldest son, a quirky daughter, and a seemingly dull, but actually smart and sensible godson.
The three children are all very good-looking, and they really like it when they stand together.
"Go, go back quickly, your dad is still waiting in the store, he said he will take you out for dinner."
Su Anying took her daughter's arms, the mother and daughter walked in front, Xu Haiyuan and Yang Haoyu followed behind, and walked all the way back to the Chinese Herbal Hall.
"Dad, Uncle Yang, Master, I'm out of school." Xu Haiyuan entered the door and greeted Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian.
"Hey, I haven't seen Yuanyuan for a long time, has this kid grown up again?
Third brother, your family is much taller than yours. This big man is rare everywhere he goes. "
When Yang Junxian saw Xu Haiyuan, he couldn't help but praise him.
"Xiaoyu won't be short anymore, don't worry."
Xu Haiyuan glanced at Yang Haoyu. This kid has just passed his fourteenth birthday, and he has already jumped to 1.78 meters.
Boys are still tall in high school, and they will be at least 1.8 meters in the future.
"Well, they are all children of our family, so there is no need to exaggerate.
Let's go, go out to eat, Yuanyuan has class at 1:30 in the afternoon, and he has to get to school early, so don't delay. "
Su Anying couldn't help laughing at her husband and family praising each other's children, and hurriedly called everyone out for dinner.
"Yes, yes, let's go to eat."
Xu Shiyan and the others all dressed properly, supported Chu Xuanhuai, and walked out of the Chinese Herbal Medicine Hall together.
I found a decent restaurant nearby, ordered six dishes, and each asked for four taels of rice.
The dishes in Northeast China are quite large. It is said that seven people can order four dishes.
But when Xu Haiyuan and the others are all growing, they can eat, and a little more will not be enough, at worst, pack the rest back home.
Among the six dishes, there was a braised octopus, which happened to be placed in front of Yang Haoyu.
Yang Haoyu didn't eat it himself, so he picked up a few pieces of good meat in the middle and put them in Xu Jinping's bowl.

chapters.title: Chapter 792: dispute
chapters.content:
Chapter 792 Controversy
On the 8th and 9th, Xu Jinping went to participate in the math competition.
On the 11th and 12th days, Yang Haoyu participated in the physics competition. On the 14th and 15th, the two children went to participate in the chemistry competition together.
Xu Shiyan has been very busy since he arrived in the provincial capital, holding meetings and meeting leaders.
Just in time for this period, the county-level cadre training class was going on in the province. Xu Shiyan was called over again and gave several lectures.
From the deep processing of agricultural products, it talks about how to develop thinking, how to develop the economy in the current economic environment, and so on.
Xu Shiyan is busy, Su Anying still has to go to class, and the couple don't have time to accompany their children to compete.
Fortunately, there are Yang Junxian and three teachers, and a special car is arranged here, so there is no need to worry.
On the morning of the 15th, the chemistry competition ended, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
On the afternoon of the 16th, Xu Shiyan and his party finished their trip to the provincial capital and returned by car.
After Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu returned home, they went to class as usual.
On December 22nd, the results of the provincial competition were announced. Xu Jinping ranked first in the province in mathematics and was successfully selected for the provincial team.
Next, on January 12th, I will go to Fudan University in Shanghai to participate in this year's National Beginner Competition for Junior High School Students.
And her chemistry score was a bit poor. Although she also won the first prize, she was ranked outside the top ten and missed the provincial team.
Yang Haoyu's physics scores are very good, ranking second in the province in terms of total scores, and his chemistry scores are not bad, ranking sixth in the province.
Of course, chemistry missed the national competition.
He is going to participate in the National Junior High School Physics Competition held in the ancient city of Chang'an on January 20.
Now, the two are finally separated and cannot go out together.
Because of this matter, Yang Haoyu was depressed for several days, always nagging in front of Xu Jinping.
Furious, Xu Jinping was dragged over to give Yang Haoyu a thump.
Regardless of Yang Haoyu's size, no one would dare to provoke him in school.
But facing his sister, even if I lend him eight guts, he dare not resist.
After being beaten like this, he stopped nagging and obediently prepared to go to the competition.
The results had just been announced, and Donggang Junior High School hadn't had time to call Xu Shiyan yet.
Xu Shiyan received a call from the principal of the High School Affiliated to Normal University.
The other party didn't mean anything else when they called. On the one hand, it was to announce the good news, and on the other hand, they wanted to win over the two good seedlings Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu.
Xu Shiyan was quite surprised when he received the call. He didn't understand how the High School Affiliated to Normal University knew that these two were children of Xu's family?
After asking, I found out that as soon as the results were announced, the principal of the High School Attached to Normal University took the list of winners and started to recruit people.
When he saw the words of Fusong Donggang Junior High School, he asked Xu Haiyuan if he recognized the two students.
Xu Haiyuan saw it and told the principal that one of them was his own sister and the other was his godbrother.
They are all his children, just call his dad directly.
Just like that, the principal of the High School Affiliated to Normal University called Xu Shiyan directly, trying to get the two children to study in the High School Affiliated to Normal University.
Anyway, Xu Haiyuan is there, so it’s not too late, and it’s convenient to have an older brother to take care of him.
If these two children study in the attached middle school, all the conditions are the same as Xu Haiyuan.
What else can Xu Shiyan say? The eldest daughter of his family has long made up her mind to go to the provincial capital to study high school.
Now that the principal of the attached high school is personally calling to poach people, how can he still refuse? As for Yang Haoyu, do you still need to ask?
"Principal Liang, it's like this, please allow me a moment.
I have to communicate with the Yang family anyway, and ask their parents what they mean.
Haoyu is right because I did it, but for such a big matter, I can't go overboard and just agree to it, right? "
Even if they knew that Yang Junxian and his wife would have no objections, they had to go through the process.
"Yes, yes, Mr. Xu has considered everything thoroughly. That's fine. Mr. Xu will give me a call back after discussing with Yang's parents."
Principal Liang's attitude was excellent, he quickly agreed, and then hung up the phone.
Xu Shiyan quickly called Yang Junxian, and explained to Yang Junxian about Principal Liang looking for him.
Yang Junxian heaved a sigh of relief when he heard that.
Thanks to my son's good grades, he was also spotted by the middle school attached to the Normal University.
If the son's grades are poor and he fails to go to the provincial capital to study, he still doesn't know how that bear thing will make a fuss.
"Third brother, I agree with this matter, you should contact Principal Liang."
So, Yang Junxian did not hesitate at all, and agreed directly.
"Brother, don't you need to discuss with your siblings?
You two are just one child. He went to the provincial capital to study, and after three years of absence, he will only be able to come back during the Chinese New Year. Brothers and sisters don’t want to cry? "Xu Shiyan laughed on the phone.
Yang Junxian and his wife put their children first. No matter what Yang Haoyu asked, they would try their best to satisfy.
It is also thanks to Yang Haoyu who is sensible and never causes trouble. If he were to be replaced by an ordinary child, he would probably have to raise a devil king.
"It's okay, brother, those two children will go to school for the first year, just let them stay with Yuanyuan.
Later, we will see where Yuanyuan went to the university. If it is still in the provincial capital, then we will go to the provincial capital to buy a house.
At that time, hire a reliable nanny for them, even the elderly and children will be taken care of together.
If Yuanyuan goes to another city to study, let Yufeng go to take care of her and accompany her. Anyway, it will only be two or three years, so it doesn't matter. "
Yang Junxian planned it in his heart just now.
When Xu Shiyan heard it, what else did he say?
People go to high places, since the children want to go to the provincial capital to study, and they take the initiative to solicit, such a good thing, then agree.
In this way, Xu and Yang negotiated properly and agreed that the children should go to the provincial capital to study.
Xu Shiyan immediately replied to Principal Liang, and then Principal Liang asked someone to contact Donggang Junior High School immediately.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu were directly recommended by the High School Affiliated to Northeast Normal University.
The National Mathematics Contest for Junior High School Students will be held in Shanghai from January 12th to January 16th.
Xu Haiyuan's National High School Chemistry Winter Camp will be held at Hebei University from January 21st to 25th.
Just in time, Su Anying is going to the Shanghai stock market to see the construction of the branch factory.
So she discussed with Xu Shiyan that she would accompany her daughter to the Shanghai stock market, and let Xu Shiyan accompany her son to Baoding.
After Xu Jinping's competition was over, their mother and daughter rushed to Baoding to meet up with the father and son, and then go home to celebrate the New Year together.
"Father, Mom, Yingzi and I have to accompany the children to the competition, and we can't take care of the family anymore."
Xu Shiyan went home and told his parents apologetically.
"Look, what's the point of this? Others envy you, but you can't come here.
Which child do you think can be as successful as ours? One competes in high school and one competes in junior high.
We don't even need to say whether we can get a ranking in the competition, and if we can participate in it, it's one in a million.
Is there anything that your mother and I are not satisfied with? That's the way it is during the Chinese New Year, the children are important.
As long as you two take care of the children, it will be a great achievement. "Xu Chenghou waved his hand nonchalantly.
On January 8th, Donggang Junior High School arranged for a female teacher to accompany Xu Jinping to the provincial capital.
After the two arrived in the provincial capital on the morning of the 9th, Su Anying made a special trip to pick up the station and arranged for the two to stay.
On the 10th, Su Anying took the two teachers and students by plane to the Shanghai stock market.
It’s so convenient. If you go with the provincial team, you have to take the train, and the road will be rattled for a long time, which is too annoying.
On the 11th, the female math teacher accompanied Xu Jinping to join the rest of the provincial team and went to Fudan University to go through the relevant formalities for the competition.
Su Anying also took the opportunity to quickly call a meeting of the branch staff.
Learn about the construction of the branch here and the recent sales of various sales outlets in East China.
After that, accompanied by the person in charge of the branch, I went to the construction site to see the progress of the construction.
Meet with the construction party and talk about the next construction period.
On the 12th, the opening ceremony of the National Mathematics Contest for Junior High School Students.
There were two consecutive exams on the 13th and 14th, and an academic report was arranged on the morning of the 15th.
The country's well-known mathematics experts will explain the current mathematical cutting-edge technology, development direction and other knowledge.
In the afternoon, arrange the participating students and teachers to visit the surrounding areas.
On the 16th, the closing ceremony and award ceremony will be held. The process is similar to Xu Haiyuan's participation in a chemistry competition.
Su Anying didn't go to accompany the competition before, but it's the final awards ceremony, so she must be there.
Those procedures were still in the front, and the awards were presented later. Xu Jinping lived up to expectations and won the first prize.
When Xu Jinping stepped down with the certificate and walked up to Su Anying, Su Anying hugged her daughter excitedly.
God knows how excited Su Anying is at this moment. She, a person who has never even attended elementary school, has raised two national champions.
Su Anying couldn't hold back, and shed tears on the spot again, hugging and crying with her daughter.
The math teacher and the provincial team leader teacher saw it, and they all looked at the mother and daughter with tears in their eyes and a smile on their faces.
Fortunately, Su Anying quickly restrained her emotions, and the mother and daughter turned to thank the math teacher.
The other teachers and students of the provincial team came to congratulate Su Anying and her daughter.
This time the province's results were good, and four of the five students won awards.
The game on the Shanghai stock market is over, and the math teacher returns with the rest of the provincial team.
Su Anying's mother and daughter stayed here for another two days, and after handling the affairs of the branch company properly, the two boarded the plane and headed to the capital.
Jishengyuan Company bought a large piece of land in Daxing area, and the third phase of the project will be carried out here.
The first phase is the construction of Jishengyuan Health Products Factory, and the largest factory will be built here.
The second phase is the headquarters building of Jishengyuan Health Products Company. After all, this is the closest to the capital, so it is more convenient to move the headquarters here.
The third phase is Xu Haiyuan's idea to build a pharmaceutical factory and a hospital here.
Now Su Anying and his wife obey their son's words. Since Xu Haiyuan said it, they must obey it.
Of course, you can’t rush these things, you have to do it step by step.
Su Anying's mother and daughter arrived in the capital first, and Xu Shiyan and his father, along with the rest of the provincial team, also arrived.
Xu Haiyuan is old enough to not need to be accompanied by his parents all the time, so he went to Baoding alone with his teachers and classmates from the provincial team.
Xu Shiyan and his wife led Xu Jinping to stay in the capital.
Xu Shiyan had to visit the school leaders he knew when he came to the training, and Su Anying called a meeting with the people from the branch company to ask about the specific situation of the land acquisition and construction of the health care product factory.
Thanks to the fact that land prices are not so expensive these days, the Daxing area is still considered a rural area, and related development matters are going very smoothly.
Just wait for the beginning of spring, and the first phase of the project can start.
At the beginning, Jishengyuan separated, and the original sales outlets north of the Yangtze River were assigned to Jixingyuan.
After these days, the new sales channel has been preliminarily established.
Su Anying will definitely take the opportunity to meet the agents in the counties and cities around the capital, hold a meeting to chat, and talk about the company's future plans.
One more thing, Jishengyuan wants to increase its advertising efforts, and it is necessary to discuss with CCTV this year's advertising space, advertising fees and other matters.
After being so busy, it will be the 24th in a blink of an eye, and Xu Haiyuan's game is coming to an end.
So the family of three rushed to Hebei University to attend the closing ceremony on the 25th.
A total of 65 students from 30 provinces and cities participated in this chemistry winter camp.
According to the regulations of the competition, 23 first prizes, 27 second prizes, and 15 third prizes were finally selected.
Xu Haiyuan was first in theory and also in experimental operation, so in addition to the first prize, he also won two sub-awards.
When the host on stage announced Xu Haiyuan's name, there was warm applause from below, and Su Anying also hugged Xu Shiyan.
The couple were excited and didn't know what to do.
"Daughter-in-law, did you hear that? It's our family Yuanyuan, our family Yuanyuan won the award."
When Xu Shiyan was speaking, he accidentally bit his own tongue.
But he didn't care about the pain at all, and went to be happy.
"My God, this is the high school chemistry league.
Our son’s grades, if he had studied in our county, would have been recorded in the county annals. "
During the National Mathematics League in 1991, the students of Lushuihe No. 1 Middle School won the third prize in the country, and it was included in the compilation of the county annals later.
That is, from that time on, Lushuihe High School surpassed County No. 1 Middle School and became the first among the five high schools in the county.
"Why do you care about the county annals or not? We call it Double Happiness.
My daughter won the junior high school competition, and my son won the high school competition. For the rest of our lives, even if we don’t do anything, it’s worth it. "
Su Anying was also so excited that her hands were shaking.
Xu Shiyan was right when he thought about it. The county annals or not are all second. The key is that the daughters and sons are all promising.
What is the purpose of their parents all their lives, isn't it for their children to be promising?
At this time, Xu Haiyuan had already received the award and left the stage, and came in front of his parents.
Xu Shiyan and his wife stepped forward and hugged their son. "Good job, this time it really brought honor to our family."
The team leader explained just now that the top 20 will go to the capital for training in April.
After layers of selection, students who are outstanding in all aspects are selected to participate in the International Olympic Chemistry Competition held in Norway in July.
The team leader teacher also said that with Xu Haiyuan's performance, it shouldn't be a big problem to be selected for the national team.
If this can really make it into the national team, it will be really amazing.
While speaking, a group of reporters gathered around to interview Xu Haiyuan's family.
"Student Xu, your chemistry score is so good, how about other subjects?
Also, you won the first prize in the league this time, and you have already been able to get recommended places for many key universities.
I don’t know where student Xu wants to go to university? "
Although the chemistry competition ranks behind mathematics and physics, winning the first prize in the national competition definitely proves the strength of the students.
So most of the first prize students will be taken by Qingbei.
After all, it is the highest institution of higher education in the country, and it is the place that countless students yearn for the most.
When all the teachers and reporters around were waiting for Xu Haiyuan to tell the name of Qingbei School, Xu Haiyuan smiled indifferently.
"Sorry, I personally like medicine, so I will apply for relevant medical schools."
Xu Haiyuan said something with a calm face and a peaceful tone, but the people around him dropped their jaws in shock.
You must know that Beijing Medical University is not yet called Peking University School of Medicine, and Peking Union Medical College has not yet co-organized with Tsinghua University.
There are naturally top medical schools, but they are obviously not at the same level as Qingbei.
Someone actually abandons the best university in the country to study medicine? This is too unexpected.
Many people shook their heads secretly, thinking that this boy was young and frivolous, too ignorant.
How wonderful Qingbei is. The top domestic universities have concentrated educational resources, and there will be a lot of opportunities to study abroad in the future.
How could someone want to study medicine instead of Qingbei?
"Excuse me, are you the parent of student Xu?
Just now classmate Xu said that he wants to go to medical school. As a parent, what do you think? "
The clever reporter immediately sent the microphone to Xu Shiyan, wanting to interview him.
In their hearts, parents will definitely not let their children mess around.
"I don't have any opinion. Studying medicine is very good. Children have their own interests and hobbies. Parents should support them."
Unexpectedly, Xu Shiyan smiled lightly and said something that surprised them even more.
"Going to college is not just for fame and fortune, right? The most important thing is to choose what suits you and what you like.
If everyone thinks Qingbei is good and medical school is bad, then who will be a doctor? "
In this day and age, there is no such sentence as urging people to study medicine and lightning strikes from the sky.
More often, doctors are a profession worthy of respect in people's hearts.
Xu Shiyan never thought of interfering with his son's future. Whether Xu Haiyuan chooses to study medicine or not, it is his freedom.
Anyway, with Xu Haiyuan's ability, no matter what he learns, he can do very well, which is the pride of his parents, and that's enough.
For the rest, don't interfere too much.
Children are independent individuals, not appendages of their parents.
Parents have no right to decide the future of their children, everything depends on the wishes of the children.
Just like Xu Shiyan often told his wife that Xu Haiyuan will take care of the family business in the future.
This is what Xu Shiyan said after seeing that Xu Haiyuan was really interested in this line of work and indeed had the ability in this field.
If Xu Haiyuan wants to be a scholar in the future and doesn't want to take over the family business, then it doesn't matter, there are three children in the family.
Even if these four children don't like to take over the family business, it doesn't matter if they find professional people to manage it in the future.
Xu Shiyan's answer directly left everyone present speechless.
Many people are probably thinking in their hearts, where did these two dudes come from?
Of course, as news media people, they prefer controversial topics.
Many reporters already had a draft in their minds, and they wrote an article "Is it right or wrong for the champion of the competition to give up key universities in Qingbei, but want to study medicine?" 》The articles are kept with topicality.
Here, the four members of the Xu family ignored all kinds of comments from the people around them, and sat there calmly, waiting for the closing ceremony to be completed.
The chemistry competition is over, and the family of four returns to the capital.
According to the agreement in advance, I met the Yang family father and son who had just participated in the junior high school physics competition and rushed over from Chang'an.
"Third brother, how is the Yuanyuan competition? Did you win any prizes?" Yang Junxian asked as soon as they met.
Xu Shiyan thought that kind of big brother was too heavy and stupid, so he didn't buy it.
But haven’t Bp machines become popular in the past two years? Many people use it.
Xu Shiyan and the others were almost alone, and if something happened, they called the pager.
Then find a public phone or use the hotel phone, and you can call back according to the phone number, which is more convenient than before.
So after Xu Jinping won the award, Yang Junxian and Xu Shiyan knew about it.
After Yang Haoyu participated in the competition two days ago, Yang Junxian immediately called Xu Shiyan to tell him that Yang Haoyu had won the prize.
Yang Haoyu went to participate in the National Junior High School Physics Competition held in the ancient city of Chang'an, and won the first prize and the best operation award.
This time it came out, it can be said to be a grand slam, with a lot of gains.
"I won the award, the first prize, in April next year, right? I will go to the capital for training.
If you perform well during the training camp and are selected, you will go abroad to compete in July. "
When Xu Haiyuan's results came out, Yang Junxian and his son were on their way to the capital, so Xu Shiyan didn't call Yang Junxian.
"Really? Oh, that's great. Yuanyuan, come on, let uncle give you a hug. This kid has such a long face."
Yang Junxian was so happy when he heard this, he had to give Xu Haiyuan a hug.
"Then we have to perform well during the training camp, and strive for us to go abroad for competitions."
Yang Junxian patted Xu Haiyuan on the back happily. These are all children who grew up with him. They are no different from his own children. Of course, he hopes that the children will get better and better.
This year is February 9th, the 29th New Year’s Eve of the twelfth lunar month, and it’s already January 25th. How many days are there before the New Year’s Eve?
If Xu Shiyan followed what he wanted, then don’t go anywhere, just go home by car.
Those who are celebrating or not, stand aside. It is important to go home and spend the New Year with your parents.
He thinks so, but what can others do?
As soon as Yang Junxian and his son met here, the pager started a series of life-threatening calls.
The number was obvious at a glance, it was from the province.
No way, Xu Shiyan could only follow the above prompts, call back, and then was asked by the provincial leaders to return to the provincial capital first.
"Okay, don't try to calm down again." Xu Shiyan sighed and said helplessly.
Just like that, on the morning of the 26th, a group of people flew from the capital to Changchun.
While they were still flying in the sky, major media and newspapers in the capital reported the results of the National High School Chemistry League.
At the same time, the fact that the champion of this competition does not want to study in Qingbei, but wants to study in a medical school was also broadcast on several TV stations, and related articles were published in newspapers.
For a while, people who saw the news were talking about it, saying everything.
Some people say that Xu Shiyan, father and son, are pure idiots. They have to study medicine even though they have a better school.
Some people think that this is a good boy with ideals and aspirations, not for fame and fortune, but only for his own ideals.
Anyway, there is everything to say, and many people even write letters to newspapers, explaining their views and so on.
For a while, it became a hot topic whether to study Qingbei or to study one's ideal major.
Such a lively event, those leaders of the medical school in the capital, still don't know?
Immediately, the leaders of many colleges and universities directly asked people to contact Ji Province, stating that as long as Xu Haiyuan is willing to come, he must be admitted without examination.
It was so lively outside, Xu Shiyan and others who were still flying in the sky didn't know it.
It wasn't until they landed and met the leaders of relevant departments in the province that they learned the news.
For a while, Xu Shiyan was also speechless, what was all this fuss about?

chapters.title: Chapter 793: Study Chinese Medicine or Western Medicine
chapters.content:
Chapter 793 Study Chinese Medicine or Western Medicine
It’s only a few days away from the New Year’s Eve, and the provincial leaders also understand Xu Shiyan’s desire to go home quickly.
So this time the celebration will not be so long-winded.
On the 27th, a commendation meeting was held at the Provincial Hotel, and all the participating students and teachers were invited.
At the meeting, the leaders praised the award-winning students and distributed prizes and bonuses.
Students who did not win the competition were also given souvenirs to encourage them.
Reporters from major news media in the province were also present, and some even interviewed Xu Haiyuan.
Especially dig deep into what Xu Haiyuan wants to study medicine.
Not only interviewed Xu Haiyuan and Xu Shiyan, but also interviewed the principal of the High School Attached to Normal University and Xu Haiyuan’s teacher, hoping that they would also express their opinions.
Regarding this, the principal and teachers of the High School Attached to Normal University agreed that they fully supported Xu Haiyuan's decision.
No matter what major Xu Haiyuan wants to study in the future, that is the child's freedom.
Schools only have the responsibility of teaching and educating people and cultivating children to become talents, and have no right to interfere with children's ideals and future.
At the same time, Xu Haiyuan's teacher also told reporters that Xu Haiyuan has been studying medicine with famous teachers since he was nine years old.
Before the first year of high school, I passed the TCM qualification examination and obtained the qualification certificate, so it is normal for others to study medicine.
The media in the provincial capital itself is very familiar with Xu Shiyan, knowing that the Oriental Ginseng Group has health care products factories and pharmaceutical factories.
At present, the largest Jishengyuan health care product company in China is run by Su Anying.
So it is quite normal for the Xu family to train a medical student.
Especially when they learned that Xu Haiyuan's master is Chu Xuanhuai, what else do they say?
He is a famous teacher who produces a talented student. If such a child does not study medicine, it would be a waste.
Of course, there are also people with ulterior motives who want to create a topic, so they deliberately ask Xu Haiyuan whether he plans to study Chinese medicine or Western medicine.
"My master has learned ancestral medical skills since he was a child. When he became an adult, he went abroad to study Western medicine, and then returned to China to train medical talents for the country.
Now that he is old, he still does not forget to save lives, and devotes himself to researching medical skills.
I have been taught by my teacher for many years, and I have never had any prejudice against Chinese medicine and Western medicine.
In my opinion, regardless of Chinese medicine or western medicine, a good doctor is one who can cure diseases and save people.
Chinese medicine does not represent backwardness, nor does Western medicine represent advancement. It is best if they can complement each other.
It cannot and does not need to discriminate against either party. "
Facing the reporter's sharp questions, Xu Haiyuan was neither humble nor overbearing, with a calm and natural attitude, expounding his own views.
Xu Haiyuan's answer won the praise of everyone, and there was intense applause at the scene.
Xu Shiyan looked at his calm and calm son on the stage, feeling extremely proud in his heart.
But at the same time, he also reminded himself that he needed to talk to his master and plan for Xu Haiyuan how to go next.
After all, you can only choose one university, Chinese medicine or Western medicine, you have to make a decision.
The commendation meeting is over, and there will be a celebration banquet in the evening.
Taking advantage of the opportunity, Xu Shiyan brought Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu to Principal Liang.
Principal Liang was very satisfied with the two children, and told them that they would come directly to the provincial capital to study when school starts on March 1st.
Since Xu Haiyuan set up an intensive class in that class, the effect has been very remarkable.
The school decided to continue this form. All students recommended for admission will enter the school to study in advance to prepare for the next three major high school subject competitions.
On the 28th, Xu Shiyan and his party picked up Chu Xuanhuai and went home for the New Year.
Xu Shiyan called his family before, and discussed with Xu Chenghou, this time it should not be so grand.
After all, Xu Shixian and others are very busy at work, so it's not good to toss them back every time.
Killing pigs and sheep, let’s wait until the 27th and 8th of the twelfth lunar month. When is it different to celebrate?
When Xu Shiyan called, he thought that Xu Chenghou would be unhappy, but he didn't expect the old man to agree very happily.
Xu Shiyan felt a little psychedelic in his heart, and felt that something was wrong, but he couldn't say it.
When the group arrived home on the afternoon of the 29th, there was no pig slaughter to celebrate, but Zhou Guilan made some dumplings.
Seeing their parents and older brothers and sisters coming back, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing jumped up happily, stepped forward and hugged their older brothers and sisters, refusing to let go.
Over there, Xu Chenghou and his wife also smiled, but there seemed to be something different in that smile.
Especially Zhou Guilan, the smile on his face seemed a bit forced.
Xu Shiyan felt strange, so he asked Xu Chenghou while Zhou Guilan and Su Anying were cooking dumplings.
"Father, did something happen at home? Why don't I look very happy to see you and my mother?"
Xu Chenghou let out a long sigh when he heard the words.
"Oh, don't mention it, didn't our Feng'er go on winter vacation a while ago? He brought the object back.
Her partner has nothing to choose in terms of looks, and he is okay, but his home is too far away.
In Baicheng, a place called Zhenlai. "
When Xu Chenghou said this, Xu Shiyan immediately understood.
Xu Jinfeng fell in love with a girl at school, surnamed Lu, named Lu Wensong. My home is on the Zhenlai side, very close to the grassland.
Although they belong to Kyrgyzstan Province, it will take a lot of effort to pass here.
You have to take a train from Songjianghe to Baishan, reverse from Baishan to the provincial capital, then take a bus from the provincial capital to Baicheng, and then take a bus from Baicheng to get there.
After a few years, the expressway will be repaired, and it will be better. Now, going there is really troublesome.
In the previous life, when Xu Jinfeng came back with his partner, Xu Chenghou was already gone.
Xu Shixian didn’t have any job at that time, he just sold ginseng in Yangcheng, so he was still in the bungalow on the street of Songjiang River and Baishan.
Knowing that the girl her daughter is looking for is far away, Xu Shixian starts acting as a demon.
That guy was crying, standing in the yard chopping firewood, crying while chopping.
I think the place my daughter is looking for is too far away. If something happens at home in the future, my daughter will not be able to come back.
Not only Xu Shixian acted as a demon, Zhou Guilan also acted not lightly at that time, sitting on the kang and crying all day long.
Xu Jinfeng is the first child of the Xu family, and can be said to be the most favored one.
The uncles and aunts in the family are all in pain, not to mention grandparents.
Since she was weaned, she followed Zhou Guilan and slept with Zhou Guilan's arms all the time.
So when she learned that her granddaughter had found someone so far away, Zhou Guilan murmured, what if she couldn't even see her eldest granddaughter for the last time when she couldn't catch her breath in the future?
At that time, Xu Shixian held back all his energy and wanted to mess up the girl.
But Xu Jinfeng's temper was very twisted, no one said it was easy to handle, but he didn't stir up pornography.
After Xu Jinfeng graduated, Lu Wensong's father came to propose marriage with a gift.
Assure the Xu family that as long as the Xu family agrees to marry off their daughter, their family will definitely not treat Xu Jinfeng badly.
Things have come to this point, and the Xu family really has no recruiters, so they finally agreed to the marriage.
Xu Jinfeng graduated in summer and arranged a job, and married to Zhenlai in winter.
The Lu family also kept their promise and never treated their daughter-in-law badly.
Later, the couple paid back the money and bought a house for Xu Shixian and his wife. They will come back no matter how far away they are during the holidays.
When Zhou Guilan passed away, Xu Jinfeng and Lu Wensong drove back from such a long distance to see the old lady off for the last time.
"Father, what is my elder brother's attitude? What about you and my mother? What do you think?"
Xu Shiyan guessed in his heart that Xu Shixian must still be a demon.
His elder brother is narrow-minded, and he has cried so many times these days.
"What can you think? Brother and sister-in-law, just say that it's too far away, poorer, worse than us here.
Although Xiao Lu’s family conditions are not bad, your eldest brother always feels that he is still not worthy of our family.
As for your mother, she feels that the granddaughter she brought up with her own hands will marry so far away all at once.
In the future, I won't come back once a year, so I panic.
If one day we close our eyes, Xiao Fenger may not be able to rush back to see us for the last time. "
Xu Chenghou sighed, and knocked the pipe and pot under the edge of the kang.
Xu Shiyan heard it, and sure enough, these girls are still acting like demons in their previous lives.
Lu Wensong's father is the principal of Zhenlai Technical School, and he is considered a person of some status there, and his family conditions are not bad.
In his previous life, Xu Shixian just took advantage of some money, but he was not as good as others in terms of status.
In this life, Xu Shixian has a job, and his position is not low, plus the brothers Xu Shixiang, Xu Shide, and Xu Shiyan, it is indeed much stronger than the Lu family.
"Father, what about you, what do you think?" Xu Shiyan asked again.
"I don't think so, the child is promising, and it's normal to be far away from home.
You can just talk about our family, didn’t Yuanyuan go to the provincial capital to study for two years? Does Pingping have to go to the provincial capital next?
In the future, they will be admitted to university, so I guess they must be in the provincial capital at least?
Baoqi will go further in the future, and if there is a bad situation, he will go abroad.
Then what, can we still stop it? As long as it is good for the children, no matter how far away, we have to support it. "
Xu Chenghou is indeed not simple, most of the time he has a long-term vision.
Xu Shiyan nodded, his father is still reliable.
That's right, how can an elder interfere in a child's marriage?
In the previous life, Lu Wensong and Xu Jinfeng were married for so many years, and their relationship has always been very good.
Xu Jinfeng said whatever he said, so he really told people to go east and never go west.
If this is really messed up, where can I find such a good uncle?
"Well, my father still sees things in the long run.
Since our Feng'er and Xiao Lu have such a good relationship, this matter cannot be messed up inside.
You said that if something gets messed up, what will happen to Feng'er in the future, or you don't want to find a partner? "
Xu Shiyan's words are not alarmist.
In his previous life, his second niece Xu Jinxiu also went to Bank University.
I met a girl in school, from Jingyu's side, not too far away.
As a result, Xu Shixian found out, and there was another fuss.
Xu Jinxiu didn't have the courage of her eldest sister, and if the family refused to let her, she really broke up with them.
After she came back, she refused to find a partner, so she waited until she was twenty-eight, and then met someone on a blind date and married.
The man who looked at Xu Jinxiu at that time was okay, he was tall and gentle.
But whoever wants to drink some wine is not him, he is a completely changed person, he is a **** who beats his father and scolds his mother.
If it’s just like this, that’s all. The key is that the young man has familial diabetes, and his health is not very good when he is only in his thirties. He has had several operations on his eyes.
Xu Jinxiu's son was also affected.
When I was three or two years old, I had a vision problem, glaucoma, and I became severely myopic within a few years after going to school.
No one in the family dared to give the child candy, for fear of inducing some kind of disease.
Secretly, these relatives in the family also felt sorry for Xu Jinxiu.
If the object hadn't been separated at the beginning, maybe it would have been a different scene.
"Yes, you are right.
If you have time, call your elder brother and persuade him not to mess around.
Children’s marriages are destined, since our Feng’er is optimistic about the distance, as long as Xiao Lu treats her well. "
Xu Chenghou nodded. Hearing what the third son said could make him feel more at ease.
"Your elder brother listens to you the most now. If you tell him, he can listen."
"Success, I'll call my elder brother after dinner."
Xu Shiyan simply nodded and agreed. This matter really needs to be discussed carefully, so that Xu Shi can change his mind first and stop being a monster.
Just finished talking here, the dumplings were cooked and served on the table, Zhou Guilan greeted Chu Xuanhuai and Xu Shiyan's family to eat quickly.
Everyone is hungry. How can I care about the delicious dumplings in front of me? Just eat it quickly.
"Grandma, is this stuffed with Daye Qin?" Xu Haiyuan took a bite of the dumpling and tasted it, it was clearly Daye Qin's.
"There are not only celery, but also shepherd's purse and soursop.
You haven’t come back since you left after the Chinese New Year, I guess you can miss this one.
In the spring, people sent a lot of them, I picked them all up and boiled them, and put them in the freezer, waiting for you to come back and eat them. "
Speaking of which, no one loves the child as much as Zhou Guilan, but everything she can think of is prepared for the child.
"Eat quickly. When you come back, you can tell grandma what you want to eat, and grandma will make it for you."
While talking, Zhou Guilan picked out a few more dumplings with other fillings from the plate.
She has packed several tricks, you can tell.
The family ate happily, and as soon as they put down their chopsticks, Xu Shiyan went to call Xu Shixian.
The two brothers chatted on the phone for half an hour. In the end, Xu Shixian agreed not to interfere in his daughter's marriage anymore, and agreed that Xu Jinfeng and Lu Wensong would be together.
Xu Shiyan is not finished yet, he must ask his elder brother to promise not to interfere in Xu Jinxiu's marriage in the future.
You must know that Xu Jinxiu will take the college entrance examination next year, and he will probably go to the bank school to study like in his previous life.
Xu Shiyan was worried about his second niece, because he was afraid that Xu Shi would act as a demon first and delay his second niece's life.
What can Xu Shixian do? Can he not agree?
Now Xu Shiyan is the one who counts the words in the Xu family. Even if Xu Shixian is the eldest brother, he has to give his third brother face.
After finishing the eldest brother's work, Xu Shiyan chatted with his mother for a long time, and finally persuaded the old lady not to interfere in it.
The New Year is approaching, and the work at home is busy, so Xu Shiyan went back to the company to work the next day.
Zhou Guilan and Su Anying led the children to clean up at home and prepare for the New Year.
Originally, Xu Chenghou wanted to kill another pig for the New Year.
But the family doesn’t raise pigs, and Xu Shiyan’s unit has distributed a lot of pork this year.
In addition to what Guo Shouye and others sent, there are so many people in the warehouse that they can't finish eating, so why kill pigs? Xu Chenghou had no choice but to give up.
This year is the 29th New Year's Eve of the twelfth lunar month, and the 27th of the twelfth lunar month. Brothers Xu Shixian, Xu Shixiang, and Xu Shide all came back with their families.
"Father, Mom, well, I've been transferred, and I'm going to be a deputy in the city's Finance Bureau after the next year."
As soon as he entered, Xu Shixiang hurriedly told his parents the good news.
"Yo, fifth child, you're amazing, and now you're promoted again? Congratulations."
Hearing this, Xu Shiyan smiled and congratulated his younger brother. From the Deputy Bureau of the County Finance Bureau to the city, this is another step forward.
"Third brother, have you heard? Recently, many cadres in the province have been transferred, and several people from the city have moved to the province."
Xu Shixiang moved closer to Xu Shiyan and asked in a low voice.
"Well, I heard that some people made mistakes in their work and suffered serious dereliction of duty, so some were directly dismissed, and some were transferred from their posts."
Of course Xu Shiyan knew about it. Guan Enxue had already mentioned it when he accompanied his daughter to the provincial capital.
The list of all transfers, he knew in advance.
This kind of thing is actually very common, nothing unusual.
Those people were so happy back then, they had to have the perception of being liquidated after failure.
No one is a soft persimmon. I didn't have an attack at the time, not because I was afraid, but because I didn't want others to see the signs.
Some things are well known to everyone, and they are just tacit.
Personnel transfer, if there is a drop, there must be a promotion.
Lin Qiyue was transferred to the province, and Chen Jianzhang became the second in command in the city.
Chang Hong, who has reached the retirement age, retires and goes home to provide for the elderly.
What was more unexpected was Zhou Qingguo, who succeeded Chang Hongfa.
Being the top leader in the county at the age of forty is definitely a bright future.
Xu Shixiang is not bad either, he became the deputy of the Municipal Finance Bureau at only thirty-six.
As long as he works hard and doesn't stretch his hands too far, the road ahead will be smooth.
So Xu Shiyan looked for an opportunity and talked with his younger brother once. I don’t know if it will be useful, but the older brother has already done his best.
Xu Shixian has not been transferred this time. He is still the deputy director of the county propaganda department and concurrently serves as the chairman of the Federation of Literary and Art Circles.
Xu Shixian has a strong pen and writes well, but his character is really not suitable for going elsewhere. It's better to be honest and publicity, don't mess around.
Xu Shide has been transferred to Beigang Town for two and a half years, and he has done a good job and is expected to be the top leader.
However, his academic qualifications are not good, so it is hard to say where he will go in the future.
Some people have been at the department level all their lives, and some people have a smooth journey all the way to the top. This is really hard to predict.
Right now, only the second child, Xu Shian, is not in the system, but he is not bad.
The scale of the farm has been expanded again and again. In addition to the original four-kilometer farm, other farms have been built in Kaifeng, Funan, Baixi, Xilinhe, Shuguang and other places.
At present, there are tens of thousands of sika deer and nearly 10,000 forest musk deer.
Musk, deer antler and other products are directly supplied to pharmaceutical factories and health care product factories, so there is no need to worry about sales.
Xu Shi'an now holds 30% of the stock of the farm, and he earns a lot of money a year.
He bought buildings in Songjianghe and the county, and kept them for Xu Haibo and his brothers to marry their wives in the future.
Xu Shiyan brothers are developing well now, and the younger generation seems to be doing well now.
Xu Jinfeng is graduating from college soon, and he is still assigned by the package. No matter which bank he is in, he has a good job.
Xu Haibo has already graduated from Agricultural University, and was arranged by Xu Shiyan to work at the Jixingyuan Health Products Factory in Fusong.
Xu Jinxiu will take the college entrance examination next year. If the development trajectory of his previous life is followed, it should be Lu Wensong who helped get Xu Jinxiu to study at a banking university, and assign work after graduation.
