Xu Haitao is in the same year as Xu Jinxiu, and he should take the college entrance examination next year, but his academic performance is poor, and he basically has no hope for the college entrance examination.
It happened that he was recruited some time ago, and his family sent him to serve as a soldier.
So this year's Chinese New Year, this kid is not at home.
Xu Haibin, a child who has been shopping since he was a child, is especially good at making troubles, and his academic performance is average.
Xu Shi first asked someone to trust him before he got him into the county No. 1 middle school. It is estimated that after high school, he would get a diploma and be a soldier.
Xu Haiyuan needless to say, no one needs to rely on, this child will definitely have high achievements in the future, not to mention Su Anying is still waiting for him to take over.
Judging from the current development situation of Ji Shengyuan, there is no problem at all for Xu Haiyuan to succeed after graduating from university.
Xu Haiyang is the same age as Xu Haiyuan, two months younger than Xu Haiyuan.
He entered school at a normal age, so he is in the same class as Xu Jinping, and will take the senior high school entrance examination next year.
At the beginning, Xu Shide and his wife wanted to send Xu Haiyang here to study with Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping.
But Xu Haiyang is stubborn, but he just refuses.
The quality of teaching at Xigang is mediocre, and the kid doesn’t work too hard in his studies, so his grades are mediocre. I don’t know what he will do in the next year’s exam.
Anyway, with these uncles around, no matter if it is high school or technical secondary school, I can go to one of them anyway, and I can always arrange a way out in the future.
Needless to say, Xu Jinping will go to the provincial capital to study high school in the next year. She has a young birthday and is only fourteen years old.
With Xu Jinping's intelligence, as long as she studies hard for three years in high school, she should be able to get into a good university.
The three girls behind, Xu Jingyi, Xu Jingwen, and Xu Jinhui, can all study. Although they are not as enchanting as Xu Jinping, they are still very good.
As for Xu Haiqing, in the final exam of the first semester of the fifth grade, he was ranked eighth in the class, so he can be considered as an upper-middle class.
This kid is really fond of literature and art. He hosts all school activities, and the school also chooses him to participate in any literary competitions in the county.
Even the company's art troupe has taken a fancy to this kid. Whenever there is a competition or performance, Xu Haiqing is sent to make a show.
In this case, Xu Haiqing can still take the top ten in the class, Xu Shiyan and his wife are already very satisfied.
The whole family except Xu Haitao is here, and the whole family is busy celebrating the New Year.
The old couple looked at their son, daughter-in-law, grandson and daughter-in-law, happy and satisfied.
At their age, they don’t want to do anything else, they just want their children and grandchildren to prosper and their families to be reunited.
After a brief reunion, the brothers left with their wives and children, and Xu Shiyan and Su Anying also had their own affairs to attend to.
The Spring Festival in 1994 was relatively late, so I felt very busy after the year.
Just after the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, Su Anying, Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu, Chu Xuanhuai and his party headed for the provincial capital.
Su Anying will graduate in half a year, and Xu Haiyuan will go to the capital for training in April, so he has to practice quickly.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu will enter the intensive class of the High School Attached to Normal University on March 1st to lay the foundation for three years of high school life.
Chu Xuanhuai needless to say, after the Chinese New Year, the clinic has to continue.
As soon as Su Anying and others left, the house was mostly empty.
Although Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan didn't say anything in front of Xu Shiyan, they always talked about it in private.
But there is no way, this is all for the future of the children, you can't tie the children by your side just to take care of the mood of the old couple, right? How about that?
Fortunately, there are two children, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing, by their side. The old couple are busy taking care of the two children, and gradually get used to it.
In April, Xu Haiyuan went to Beijing to participate in a training camp.
The training time is about a month, and the players have to go through multiple examinations and selections.
Finally, the students with the best grades will be selected to represent the country in international competitions.
The training camp is closed and does not need to be accompanied by parents.
Su Anying just sent the child to the capital, and after dealing with some matters in the capital branch, she went back to school.
Xu Shiyan's side was even busier, and he couldn't spare time to go to Beijing to accompany his son.
"This is a document just issued by the province. The tourism route plan for the west **** of Changbai Mountain has been officially approved and established.
I have a suggestion. Our company donated 30 million yuan to build the gate and related facilities on the west **** of Changbai Mountain. "
At the company management meeting, Xu Shiyan introduced to everyone.
"General manager, why do we have to donate money to repair the scenic spot? Isn't it good for us to cooperate directly with the province to develop the scenic spot?"
Some people are puzzled, donating money to build scenic spots, what kind of operation is this?
"Because there is no money in the province." Xu Shiyan sighed.
"The most important thing is that there is currently a consortium in South Korea that is negotiating with our province to donate money to build the gate on the west **** of Changbai Mountain and related facilities."
In my previous life, the Xipo Mountain Gate was built with donations from South Korea.
Xu Shiyan felt awkward when he heard his daughter recite the guide words. Our own scenic spot had to be donated to build it.
Xu Shiyan didn't intend to compete with anyone, but he felt that this matter was a bit embarrassing.
Now, they have the ability to build it themselves, so they can no longer ask the little stick to donate money to repair it.

chapters.title: Chapter 794: future vision
chapters.content:
Chapter 794 Future Vision
"Fuck, our own mountain, who is so rare to use them to donate money?
Don't say 30 million, let's pay 50 million. "
As soon as Xu Shiyan finished speaking, the conference room was buzzing, and many people slapped the table directly, bearded and staring.
In recent years, ginseng companies have developed rapidly, and ginseng products are exported overseas.
While earning a lot of foreign exchange, there have also been several confrontations with South Korea.
Before, the ginseng industry in South Korea was always very advanced, and many high-end ginseng products from abroad came from South Korea.
But since Xu Shiyan led the ginseng field to conduct research and development, after these years of development, the high-end ginseng products of the ginseng company have seized most of the foreign market.
South Korea saw its market share being robbed, its profits fell sharply, and all kinds of loss tactics emerged in an endless stream.
For a while, they said that the products of Oriental Ginseng Company are plagiarizing their formula.
After a while, he said that the craft of Changbai Mountain red ginseng originated from the craft of Korean ginseng.
Later, the ginseng company developed black ginseng. They also said that it was a craft handed down from their ancestors and was plagiarized.
Especially in the cosmetics industry, there are several cosmetics in South Korea that also use ginseng as the main raw material, but they are not as good as the products of Yushenfang in terms of formula, process, and product richness.
If there is no fair competition, then they start to play dirty tricks.
bribed some consumers, insisting that they were allergic to the products of Yushenfang, their faces were rotten, and so on.
Daily chemical products are the most vulnerable to attacks.
Once a crisis of consumer trust is caused, the reputation of the product will be damaged, and it will be difficult to sell it later.
The cosmetics of Yushenfang first appeared in the Spring Fair and went abroad after obtaining the quality certification of various countries.
Moreover, sellers are very serious about collecting customer feedback and paying great attention to after-sales service.
Once there is an allergy or other situation, it will be reported back in time.
The active ingredients of Yushenfang's cosmetics are all extracted from natural Chinese herbal medicines, with mild and stable quality.
In order to adapt to the skin of Westerners, we also made minor adjustments.
So over the years, the customer feedback has been great.
South Korea wanted to use this aspect to attack Yushenfang. As a result, it directly threw out several thick customer feedback records, as well as quality certification documents from various countries.
Not only that, the company has also widely publicized in the media of various countries, maintaining the reputation of Yushenfang.
Last year, a South Korean consortium came over and said they wanted to cooperate with participating companies in joint ventures.
Invest tens of millions to jointly create internationally renowned ginseng products.
It should be said that the leaders at the top have also experienced it in the past few years, and their vision has improved a lot.
If this is left in the past, it is estimated that many people will be jealous and wish to immediately promote cooperation.
But nowadays, hehe, sorry, the investment of tens of millions is really ignored.
In this way, the South Korean consortium came back in a defeat, and the beams became deeper and deeper.
So when the managers, factory directors, and directors of the ginseng company heard that Xiao Bangzi wanted to donate money to build the mountain gate, they all felt angry.
Go to his grandma, we have money, we don’t need their courtesies.
Xu Shiyan didn't find it ridiculous to respond to the big guy's reaction, but felt a little proud.
How to put it, this is the self-confidence brought to people after the economic development.
In the past, they were all foreigners, and they couldn't afford to offend them.
Now, I dare not say elsewhere, but in Shenye Company, the big guys really don’t pay attention to the little stick.
With money in your pocket, your waist will be strong, and you don't have to please anyone anymore.
"The reason why I proposed to donate money to build the mountain gate is not only because they are not pleasing to the eye, but also because I want to develop the economy from the other side."
Xu Shiyan raised his hand to signal, and the venue became quiet again.
"Our company is still mainly engaged in ginseng planting and processing. At present, we can see that the company is developing well and booming.
But everyone should know that the available forest resources are decreasing.
After waiting for the 33-year planned forest land to be used up, have you ever thought about what development we are pointing at? "
Xu Shiyan raised a very sharp question.
In his previous life, Yishang did not develop to such a brilliant level as it is now.
In 1997, industrial adjustment and enterprise restructuring began, and after two thousand years, it began to decline.
In 2003 or so, all the participating woodlands were used up, and in the end it just turned yellow.
In this life, although so many factories have developed, they are all making money now.
But if there is no forest land, there will be no land to grow ginseng.
These factories are all based on artificial labor. If there is a problem with the supply of raw materials, I am afraid that the development of these factories will also be affected.
Of course, companies can buy ginseng from the market.
However, the quality is difficult to control, the output is even more difficult to guarantee, and the market price fluctuates greatly, which will affect the company's development.
So next, while developing the ginseng industry, new industries must also be developed.
Tourism is a very good emerging industry with good development potential, so it must be laid out in advance.
“Now that the domestic economy is recovering and people’s living standards are gradually improving, the rise of tourism is an inevitable trend.
Our company is located at the foot of Changbai Mountain. With such good conditions, it would be a pity not to take the opportunity to develop. "
Xu Shiyan saw that everyone turned pale from his words, and then smiled, and changed the subject to tourism.
"No, general manager, if we want to develop tourism, we might as well cooperate with the province to develop it.
Why do you have to donate money? With so much money, wouldn't it be nice to save it to improve the lives of employees? "
Some people also raised different opinions, thinking that it is a bit unfair to donate so much money.
Xu Shiyan smiled and leaned back on the back of the chair.
"The mountain belongs to the state, even if it is developed, it is still a state-owned unit, and the level of security is higher than ours.
To tell you the truth, I never set my sights on the spot on the mountain.
How much can you earn a year by selling tickets for scenic spots? What we want to do is to use the name of Changbai Mountain to develop tourism-related industries.
For example, hotels, catering, shopping, and various entertainment projects, this is the big head. "
How much is the ticket for the scenic spot? Tickets for the Changbai Mountain West Slope Scenic Spot rose from 85 at the beginning to 215 later.
When a person comes back, isn’t he just buying a ticket?
Even later, the scenic spot introduced a policy that one ticket can visit the two scenic spots in the west and north within three days.
How much can you earn after deducting various operating expenses of the scenic spot?
But this person's board and lodging, what about other entertainment items? How much does it cost? What is the profit?
So the development of the tourism industry is not just as simple as a scenic spot. The more complete the surrounding supporting facilities, the more money you can make.
Why can’t tourism develop in many places?
There is only one scenic spot, and there is nothing to eat or play around. Why do tourists come here? Just look at the landscape?
The early development of the Changbai Mountain Scenic Area and the West Slope tourism industry can greatly stimulate the surrounding economy.
As the nearest town to the west **** of Changbai Mountain, it will benefit more than 30 million in the future.
Moreover, donations helped the leaders solve major problems, and as long as the resources are slightly diverted in the future, there will be many benefits.
"I have a plan and planning map here, you can take a look at it, but you can't spread it outside.
If the plan can be implemented, then we can form an economic form that perfectly combines planting, processing, and tourism, which will be more conducive to future development.
Of course, this requires a lot of resources, and it must be completed with the strong support of the superior. "
Xu Shiyan flipped through the folder at hand, and took out a stack of documents and drawings from it, and asked the secretary to pass it on to everyone.
"This is just a preliminary idea, and it's still very rough. Just take a look, and don't take it too seriously."
The plan includes the construction of ski resorts, golf courses, resorts, industrial parks, museums, large shopping malls, drift picking gardens and other small scenic spots, catering and accommodation, etc.
However, these can only be gradually implemented after the official development and establishment of the scenic spot on the west **** of Changbai Mountain.
At present, everything is still on paper. How it will develop in the future depends on how strong the support from above is.
The documents and drawings were circulated by everyone, and then everyone fell silent.
No one who can hold a meeting here is stupid.
If everything is realized as stated in the plan, the local economy will be booming.
However, this is definitely not something that participating companies can do alone. It must have policies and strong support from above.
"We listen to the general manager for everything, isn't it 30 million? We can afford it.
To put it bluntly, donating this money can not only give us a good reputation, but also be tax-free, and there will be benefits in the future, which is a good deal. "
Dai Chunrong slapped the table and said.
Everyone was right when they heard it, so they nodded in agreement.
"Manager Dai is right, we all support Mr. Xu, this matter can be done."
"Then thank you for your support and trust, let's work together to make the company run better.
It also allows employees and their families to live a good life. "
Xu Shiyan smiled and nodded towards everyone, took the circulated documents and put them back in the folder.
This document is just a framework. After he slowly refines it, it will take another year or two.
After the Xipo Scenic Spot is officially in operation, he will pass it to the provincial government. As for whether the provincial government will pay attention to it, I don't know.
The company's internal meeting ended, and Xu Shiyan's proposal was supported by everyone.
So the next day, the participation company contacted the province.
It is proposed that the participation company donate 30 million yuan to help the province build the gate and related facilities on the west **** of Changbai Mountain as soon as possible.
Hope to make a little contribution to the development of tourism in this province.
The province was of course very happy to hear the news.
Whoever can afford this amount of money, who is willing to accept funding from outsiders?
In this regard, the development project on the west **** of Changbai Mountain is on the agenda.
The province requested that the road from Songjiang River to Changbai Mountain Scenic Area be repaired as soon as possible, together with the mountain gate, and strive to realize the operation of the scenic area within two years.
Xu Shiyan also began to plan in detail how to use Donggang's geographical advantages to build a tourist town.
Although the scenic spot has not yet been established, there are some things that must be planned this morning.
Plan out in advance, and then build factories, houses, etc., you have to arrange according to the new plan.
Avoid future demolition and reconstruction, wasting resources.
In May, participating companies participated in the Spring Fair and set a new record, with a turnover of more than 300 million US dollars.
Calculated according to the current exchange rate, that is more than two billion RMB.
Among them, cosmetics and high-end health products accounted for the majority, while medicines, simple ginseng products, drinks, etc. accounted for a small proportion.
At the same time, the sales of Jixingyuan health care products are also good.
The sales in the first quarter were more than 500 million yuan, and the second quarter has not yet ended, and there are also 300 million yuan.
This proves that the potential of the domestic market is still very large.
However, compared with Jishengyuan, this sales volume is still a bit worse.
Jishengyuan’s sales in the first quarter exceeded one billion yuan, and the sales in the second quarter also exceeded 700 million yuan.
According to the current situation, the annual sales should exceed 4 billion.
Of course, Jishengyuan's sales are so large, which is also related to their investment in advertising.
Su Anying spent a lot of effort on advertising and publicity on major TV stations. The advertising fee alone is not a small expense for a year.
Moreover, Jishengyuan built two more branch factories and a headquarters building.
So in general, Ji Shengyuan is still in the stage of spending money.
Unlike Ji Xingyuan, who is backed by participating companies, and is walking steadily step by step. Although the sales are not that exaggerated, the actual profit is not a lot at all.
Jishengyuan and Jixingyuan were originally a pair of twin brands born from the same root, but they became incompatible because of the separation incident.
The competition between the two parties is very fierce, and they have invested a lot of effort in publicity and promotion and brand development.
Originally, there were still some small health care product manufacturers in the market.
But less than half a year later, people discovered that those sporadic health care products disappeared at some point and disappeared.
On the market, there are only two major brands, Jishengyuan and Jixingyuan, which are not giving in to each other and vying for each other.
"Okay, you two played beautifully, and now almost all the market has been taken by you."
Guo Shouye called Xu Shiyan to discuss the expansion of the flooring factory, and mentioned something along the way.
The flooring factory has also developed very well in recent years, and sales have been rising year after year. This year's Spring Fair's orders exceeded 100 million.
The original one main workshop has been expanded to three main workshops, which is still not enough at present.
So Guo Shouye discussed with Xu Shiyan that it is better to build another branch factory and expand the production scale.
Xu Shiyan has no opinion on this.
At present, there are very few domestic factories that can produce three-layer solid wood composite flooring. It should be said that the market potential is huge, and we should seize the opportunity to develop and grow quickly.
If you want to build a branch factory, you can build it. Let alone another branch factory, even if you come to three or five, there will be no problem at all.
"Oh, there's no other way, we don't do this, and when those people get up later, what's the matter with us?" Xu Shiyan laughed.
"By the way, where is my eldest son? Is he still training in the capital? Was he selected?"
The two chatted on the phone for a while, and Guo Shouye suddenly remembered that he didn't know how Xu Haiyuan went to the training camp.
"I was selected. I called yesterday and said that the training camp is over. He was successfully selected for the national team and will go abroad to compete in July."
Xu Shiyan slapped his forehead. He was so busy every day that he even forgot about his eldest son going abroad.
"This day, I'm so busy that I can't remember anything.
Brother, wait for Yuanyuan to come back from the competition. I'll treat you. Let's have a good drink. "
Guo Shouye naturally agreed cheerfully, and the two chatted for a while before hanging up the phone.
Xu Shiyan processed the documents for a while, and it was not early, so he went home from get off work.
Had dinner with my parents, and chatted with the old man and the old lady.
While talking happily, Xu Haiqing suddenly ran in from the outside.
"Dad, come out and see, why is the sky in the north so red?"
May 20th, at 7:30 p.m., it was supposed to be dark outside.
But Xu Shiyan walked out of the house and looked to the north, only to see that the sky in the north was really red.
Vaguely, it seems that black smoke rises above the red light.
"Oh, it's broken, there's water on the corner building."
As the old saying goes, when you encounter a fire, you can’t say it’s a fire, you have to say it’s water.
Otherwise, the fire will be ignited all at once through the words of people.
Of course, this is just a legend. No one knows if there is any truth to it. Anyway, it has been passed down as some old rules.
According to the location where the flames rose, Xu Shiyan made a little calculation and guessed that the residential building on the corner building should be on fire.
The buildings over there are old, and they still burn firewood and coal for heating, not collective heating.
Behind each building, there are special firewood stacks and coal sheds.
Xu Shiyan remembered that some firewood piles were particularly large. If a fire was caused by those firewood piles, it would definitely be difficult to save.
Now, I don't know how much I will lose.
"Hurry up and go back to the house, don't go out and run around."
Xu Shiyan hurriedly dragged Xu Haiqing, who was still looking north with his feet up, home, then picked up the phone, and called the company's fire brigade.
Let them gather immediately and prepare for rescue.
Hung up the phone, Xu Shiyan hurriedly called the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau to ask about the specific situation and whether he needed assistance.
Then I was told that the fire in the residential building in the corner building is currently extremely large, and the forestry firefighting manpower is insufficient. I hope that the brother units will help.
"Notify everyone, dispatch quickly, rush to the corner building, assist forestry firefighting, and put out the fire." Xu Shiyan called back to the company.
Then he hung up the phone, and he turned around in a hurry and was about to run out.
"No, what are you doing?
You are not a firefighter. In the past, you were useless and caused trouble for others. "
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan saw it, is this okay? Xu Chenghou had quick eyes and quick hands, and grabbed his son in one go.
"Father, Brother Guo's house is in the bungalow behind the corner building. I have to go and see if there is anything wrong with his house."
Xu Shiyan still doesn't know how much he weighs? He wasn't going to fight the fire.
For such a big fire, after the firefighting, it is estimated that the fire will be controlled and not spread. As for the building where the fire broke out, it is basically hopeless.
Xu Shiyan just wanted to take a look. He wondered if the fire had reached Guo Shouye's house.
"Oh, then I'll be with you."
Xu Chenghou did not stop his son, but he asked to go with him.
With him going over to watch, if this bear thing wants to approach the fire scene, at least he can stop it.
Xu Shiyan was stunned for a moment, and when he understood, he couldn't laugh or cry.
He is in his forties, how can he be so reckless?
"Okay, since Dad wants to go, let's go together."
Just like that, the father and father went out, and Xu Shiyan drove to Songjiang River from the road in Lengchang to the west.
Now the corner building should be completely blocked, and the car probably won’t be able to drive through. It’s better to take a detour, but it’s safe.
Go north along the road of Donggang Forest Farm, the further you go, the more clearly the fire can be seen.
The head of the fire jumped up high, dancing and jumping with the wind, wherever the tongue of fire blows, it will follow and burn.
"Oh, what is this thing on fire? Such a big fire.
Yes, these buildings are definitely hopeless, but I don’t know if anyone is inside. "Xu Chenghou sighed when he saw the fire.
The buildings on fire were concentrated in the southeast. Xu Shiyan drove around on the west road and parked his car in the courtyard of the Forestry Bureau Hospital.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to go any further, but that the streets ahead were crowded with people, making it impossible to drive past.
The two got out of the car and walked, passing through the crowd and walking forward, Xu Shiyan finally let go of his hanging heart.
The fire started at the southeast corner of the corner building, a little distance away from Guo Shouye's bungalow.
However, the residents of this piece of bungalows also came out of their homes, each with a bucket or a basin in his hand, and they were waiting in line.
Once there are sparks floating over, put them out quickly.
"Brother, how are you? Are you okay at home?"
Xu Shiyan walked through the alley, managed to squeeze through the crowd, and came to the gate of Guo's house.
Just in time to see Guo Shouye and his wife standing outside carrying buckets and basins.
"Brother, why are you here?" When Guo Shouye saw Xu Shiyan, he quickly put the bucket in his hand on the ground.
"Oh my god, why did this alarm my uncle?"
Looking up again, he saw Xu Chenghou following behind, Guo Shouye felt so sorry.
"We saw the fire was very high in the north at home, so we guessed that something happened on the corner building.
I'm afraid that your side is also involved, so don't worry about coming over to have a look.
It’s lucky that nothing happened, just stay on guard, the people from my company will be here soon, hoping to control the fire. "
Xu Shiyan stood next to Guo Shouye, looking up at the fire in the south.
Over there, Peng Yucui hurried into the room and moved a stool for Xu Chenghou.
This is also a person in his seventies, how can he stand up all the time?
Not long after Xu Shiyan arrived at Guo's house, the fire engines and firefighters from Shenye Company also arrived.
All the firefighters of Shenye Company were dispatched to assist forestry firefighting. After fighting for half the night, they finally brought the fire under control.
Xu Shiyan and Xu Chenghou also stayed at Guo's side until midnight. Seeing that the fire was under control and they were sure that it would not spread to the north, they were relieved.
"Brother, I think there is nothing wrong here, you and sister-in-law go home and rest, we will go back too."
"Brother, what are you going back to do at this hour? Why don't you just sleep here, and it will dawn in a few hours."
Guo Shouye felt sorry, so he wanted to keep the Xu family and his father here.
"No need, brother, we are still waiting at home. If we don't go back, the old lady will definitely stay up all night."
Xu Shiyan shook his head and smiled, said goodbye to Guo Shouye, and then led Xu Chenghou out of the alley.
Guo Shouye followed behind, until he reached the entrance of the alley, and then turned back.
Mr Xu Chenghou and his wife came out of the alley when they heard crying and howling on the street.
Yeah, whoever spreads such a thing will have a hard time living, can you not cry?
The father and father drove back to Donggang, Zhou Guilan did not sleep, she just sat and waited on the kang.
Seeing her husband and son come back, the old lady finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"Hurry up and pack up and go to sleep, Huihui and Haiqing are sleeping in the Westinghouse."
It was past twelve o'clock, and Xu Shiyan was too lazy to go back home, so he took off his clothes and went to the kang, and took the time to sleep.
The fire incident in the corner building, after the investigation, it was found that the fire started from the large piles of firewood that Xu Shiyan thought.
The pile of firewood was accidentally ignited. The fire was too powerful and went straight to the residential buildings. In the end, nine buildings burned down, causing very large losses.
Fortunately, the floors in this year are short, basically three floors, and some are only two floors.
And when the fire broke out, everyone was awake, and they all ran out when they heard something was wrong, and there were no casualties.
The corner building is the family building of the employees of the Forestry Bureau. Now that it has been burned down, the bureau must be responsible for the follow-up resettlement and reconstruction work.
In the past two years, the Forestry Bureau has been in a downturn. Logging has decreased year by year, and timber production has been low. Lumber mills and plywood factories have been in a state of semi-stop production.
Now that there is such a fire again, for many people, it is tantamount to worsening the situation.
Finally, it was negotiated that the bureau should take part, and the individual should take part, to re-plan and build the residential area of ​​the corner building.
Ban the original separate fire for heating, and change to centralized heating to avoid danger from happening again.
Of course, these have nothing to do with Xu Shiyan. The brother company can reach out to rescue, but it has no obligation to help rebuild.

chapters.title: Chapter 795: Celebrate
chapters.content:
Chapter 795 A banquet to celebrate
From July 3rd to 11th, the International Chemistry Olympiad will be held in Norway.
Xu Haiyuan accompanied the team leader and other students to go abroad to participate in the competition. After several days of competition, Xu Haiyuan finally won the gold medal with a perfect score in theory and the highest score in operation.
The news spread back to the country, and everyone was crazy with joy.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying received countless congratulatory calls, and many people shouted for Xu Shiyan to treat guests with a banquet.
Xu Shiyan and his wife are naturally very happy that their son has achieved such outstanding results.
What is a banquet? Who is short of the banquet money?
Xu Shiyan agreed very readily, and when Xu Haiyuan came back, he would definitely invite everyone to drink.
On July 23rd, Xu Haiyuan, who had been celebrating and commending all the way, finally returned to Donggang.
Donggang also held the most solemn welcome ceremony, with gongs and drums and lanterns and festoons to welcome Xu Haiyuan home.
"Good boy, you've given Donggang a face this time.
World Gold Award, let alone our small town, even in our county or city, I have never heard of it. "
The secretary of Donggang town and the principal of Donggang junior high school came forward in person, one brought flowers to Xu Haiyuan, and the other put a ribbon on it.
Especially the principal of the junior high school, so happy that he couldn't close his mouth.
Xu Haiyuan used to be a student of Donggang Junior High School.
Such a middle school in a remote town not only produced several national champions, but also a world champion. Any principal would jump for joy.
Xu Haiyuan has never stopped these welcoming ceremonies since he set foot on the domestic land, he is used to it.
"Thank you principal, thank you Uncle Song." Xu Haiyuan calmly bowed to the two to show his gratitude.
The welcome ceremony was quite normal up to here, but in the next second, Xu Haiyuan's junior high school and elementary school classmates rushed over with a lot of hula.
Everyone immediately lifted Xu Haiyuan up, then threw it into the sky and caught it, then threw it and caught it again.
The crowd burst into enthusiastic cheers, and everyone applauded and laughed.
Xu Haiyuan was really confused now.
There are so many celebration and commendation meetings along the way, all of them are gentle, how can you imagine that after returning home, the big guys will do this for him?
This feeling of being thrown in the air and then caught is really not good.
"Okay, okay, please forgive me, this thing is too scary."
Xu Haiyuan hurriedly begged for mercy, he didn't want to be thrown over and over again like a ball.
"Stop, put it down."
Huang Shuqing was the leader of this group of people. He said stop, and the big guys stopped throwing Xu Haiyuan hard, but gently put him on the ground.
Then, the students came forward and hugged Xu Haiyuan one by one.
"It's awesome, we are proud to have a classmate like you."
"Squad leader, if you become prosperous in the future, you must always think about us, we will all go to you in the future."
"Yes, yes, we can rely on you. You were our squad leader before, and we will still be our leader in the future.
Whatever you tell us to do, we will listen to you. You can do whatever you want. "
Everyone was chattering and saying everything, but everyone's admiration and blessings to Xu Haiyuan were sincere.
These young people who are only seventeen or eighteen years old, less than twenty, clear and innocent, everyone regards Xu Haiyuan as their idol, the person they admire the most.
Xu Haiyuan only felt that his eyes were a bit uncomfortable at the moment, sour and astringent.
Xu Haiyuan has always been calm and composed, with a maturity and wisdom far beyond those of his peers, and the celebrations all the way back have not moved him.
However, at this moment, Xu Haiyuan only felt that his throat was a little congested, his heart was full, and an inexplicable emotion was rolling in his heart.
"Good brothers, good classmates, I am proud to have you."
Xu Haiyuan patted the opponent's back with his backhand, and blinked hard to make himself more comfortable.
"Come on, let me show you our celebration banquet today."
Huang Shuqing, Yang Jianguo, Sun Yu and other friends who grew up together came forward, surrounded Xu Haiyuan, and walked towards the gate of the market.
Xu Haiyuan still finds it strange, shouldn't he be asked to go home and visit his grandparents first? Why did you come to the market?
As a result, Xu Haiyuan was stunned by the scene inside as soon as he entered the city compound.
On the open space of the Canshi compound, a large row of sheds, pots and stoves, and chopping boards were set up on the south side.
A dozen cooks in white coats and hats were busy cooking.
From the shed to the north, the entire open space in the courtyard is filled with tables, chairs and benches of all kinds.
Not only are round and square people standing aside at home, there are even school desks.
Wooden desks for two people, two or three desks can be put together to form a large desk.
Don't ask, it must be because the dining table is not enough, and I don't know who came up with the idea to use the desk as a dining table.
Looking around, the huge open space is full of tables, and it is estimated that there must be at least a hundred tables.
Xu Haiyuan couldn't help being speechless, hey boy, isn't this a bit too grand and extravagant?
Is this good? His father won't be reported or something because of this, right?
"What are you doing in a daze? Come here, Grandpa Xu and Grandma Xu are waiting for you over there."
Huang Shuqing and others dragged Xu Haiyuan to the middle table in front.
Sitting here are Xu Chenghou, Su Weizhong, Chu Xuanhuai, Han Wenzhong, Su Weicheng, Zhou Anping, Zhou Anfu, Zhao Dahai, Yu Shouguang and others.
Chu Xuanhuai came back with Su Anying, Xu Jinping, Yang Haoyu and the others.
Su Anying's studies in the business school have ended, and she does not need an internship to find a job, so she has one year less than ordinary junior college students.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu are studying in the High School Attached to Normal University in the provincial capital. This semester, they have completed all the courses for the whole school year.
Knowing that my brother won the award, how can the two of them stay together? Just come back with Su Anying and accompany Chu Xuanhuai to celebrate Xu Haiyuan.
"Grandpa, grandpa, master, grandpa, grandpa Han, uncle, uncle."
This table was full of old men, and Xu Haiyuan called people one by one.
"Oh, good boy, come and sit next to Grandpa."
When Xu Chenghou saw his eldest grandson approaching, he immediately waved to the grandson with a smile on his face, and asked the child to sit in front of him.
"It's been half a year since I left, why do I feel like I've grown again? It seems like I've lost weight.
Is it bad to eat when going abroad? Do you have the habit of eating foreign food? "
Xu Chenghou was very rare when he saw his grandson. He never saw fat or thin people, but this time he could see that his grandson had lost weight.
Xu Haiyuan sat down next to his grandfather as promised, looked around, and asked in a low voice.
"Master, how many tables have been set up today? My dad is so busy, doesn't he violate any discipline?"
Xu Haiyuan was a little worried, his father shouldn't fall into it because of this.
"It's okay, we don't accept gifts, we just hold a few tables of banquets to be lively."
Xu Chenghou waved his hand. He had heard what his son and daughter-in-law had said. It seemed that Xu Shiyan had asked the leader for instructions and his superiors allowed it.
Xu Haiyuan was relieved when he heard this.
So obediently sat between grandpa and master, chatting with a group of old men.
Anyway, Xu Haiyuan answered whatever people asked, and he was very obedient.
"Have you decided which school to go to? Are you really determined to study medicine?" Chu Xuanhuai looked at his grandson proudly.
"Actually, there is no need to be too persistent in studying medicine, you have already obtained the qualification certificate.
Based on your current medical skills, it is much better than the students who graduated from the medical school.
Otherwise, it would be good to study chemistry in Qingbei. Even if you want to take over the family business in the future, there will be no conflict. "
Chu Xuanhuai was actually quite conflicted.
On the one hand, I hope that Xu Haiyuan can inherit his mantle and pass on the Chu family's medical skills.
But on the other hand, seeing Xu Haiyuan showing amazing talent in chemistry, he felt that it was a pity that only Xu Haiyuan was allowed to study medicine.
"Master, my ambition since childhood was to study medicine, and this has never changed." Xu Haiyuan laughed when he heard it.
“Whether it is chemistry or physics, it is a student experience.
To put it in a less pleasant way, being able to win an award can only mean that I can do the questions.
It does not mean that I will have much creation or achievement in the field of chemistry in the future. "
"I won the award, and I will study medicine in the future, there is no causal relationship between them.
After returning to China this time, many universities in the capital have contacted me, and my attitude has never changed, to study medicine. "
Xu Haiyuan already has a clear plan for the future, and will not make changes just because of winning an award.
"Okay, you can control your own life." Chu Xuanhuai nodded.
No matter what Xu Haiyuan studies, he can accept it, and studying medicine is naturally the best.
"Do you want to learn Chinese medicine or Western medicine?"
"Well, I've made up my mind, I'll go to study Western medicine first, and get my clinical practice certificate."
Xu Haiyuan has already passed the examination for the TCM qualification certificate. Just like what Chu Xuanhuai said, Xu Haiyuan's current medical skills are not a little bit better than those medical school graduates.
Now if I go to school to learn Chinese medicine, I always feel like a waste of time.
To put it bluntly, Chu Xuanhuai can teach what can be taught in school, and Chu Xuanhuai can teach what cannot be taught in school.
With the teachings of Chu Xuanhuai, and the secret medical books in the cellar back then, as long as Xu Haiyuan can master all of these, it will be absolutely amazing.
If he wants to continue learning in the future, he can also find a master of traditional Chinese medicine to learn from a teacher. Following a teacher is the most effective way to learn.
"Well, since you have chosen it, no matter which subject, study hard. Master believes in you, you can do it."
Chu Xuanhuai himself also learned both Chinese and Western medicine, so he will not be too persistent about these things, no matter what he studies, as long as he learns something.
The grandfather and grandson had just chatted a few words, when a group of young people came over and dragged Xu Haiyuan away again.
The old men couldn't help but feel emotional when they saw it, "This one is getting bigger.
The appearance of running all over the street wearing crotch pants is still in front of my eyes, but I didn't expect that in a blink of an eye, I became a young man. "
"Yeah, the child has grown up in a blink of an eye, and we are also old.
These young people really caught up with the good times, the good days when the country is peaceful and the people are safe, and the food and clothing are affluent, unlike ours at that time. "
A group of old men, looking at the children who are jumping and jumping and playing happily not far away, are full of joy and endless emotion.
In order to celebrate Xu Haiyuan's award, Xu Shiyan and his wife arranged hundreds of banquets in Canshi to entertain relatives and friends.
With so many tables, it will definitely test the skill of the chef.
Under the row of sheds to the south, dozens of people are busy with spoons, piers, plates, and helpers.
The case was covered with pots, pans and pans of all kinds, and the deep-fried meat and meatballs in the big basin were piled up like hills.
There are more than a dozen strong young men at the other end, holding large square plates in their hands, and are responsible for serving the dishes.
At four o'clock in the afternoon, the dishes are ready and the guests are all seated.
"Thank you, everyone, for taking time out of your busy schedule to come to classmate Xu Haiyuan's celebration banquet together."
Donggang Town Secretary Song Fansheng stood in front with a microphone in his hand and delivered an opening speech.
"I never thought that a small place like Donggang would have a world champion one day.
Student Xu Haiyuan this time, for this remote town at the foot of Changbai Mountain, he has really gained face and won pride.
This kid is so promising. "
Song Fansheng's face flushed with joy and excitement, and his voice rose several degrees involuntarily.
"Next, let's invite classmate Xu Haiyuan to tell you a few words?"
As soon as these words came out, there was thunderous applause at the scene, and some people shouted for Xu Haiyuan to say a few words.
Seeing this, Xu Haiyuan knew that he couldn't hide, so he stepped forward and took the microphone.
“Thank you to all relatives, friends and neighbors for your kindness.
I really didn't expect that I just came back from a competition, and everyone was shocked. This summer came over to congratulate me and celebrate.
Xu Haiyuan was born here and grew up here, and has been taken care of by the elders since he was a child. Here, thank you in advance. "
As he spoke, Xu Haiyuan bowed directly to the people in front of him.
“I am still young, so I dare not say that I will achieve something in the future.
But the affection of the elders of the folks, I will definitely remember it in my heart, and I will never forget it. "Xu Haiyuan said, and bowed again.
"Finally, I would also like to thank my parents, grandparents and grandparents who gave birth to me and raised me, as well as my teachers who devoted themselves to teaching me medical skills.
And all the teachers from elementary school to middle school, all the teachers who have taught me and guided me on the road of life.
Without you, there would be no Xu Haiyuan today. "Speaking of this, Xu Haiyuan seemed to be a little choked up, so he bowed again.
There was another burst of applause at the scene, and then Song Fansheng took over the microphone, said a few words, and invited Xu Shiyan and his wife to speak.
What can Xu Shiyan and his wife say? How to raise children on this occasion? This is not what people want to hear.
So simply thank those who were present and those who were not present, and thank everyone for their kindness.
"In order to thank you for your kindness, our husband and wife prepare some bolognese and vegetarian dishes to entertain relatives and friends.
For today’s meal, everyone eats and drinks openly, and they will not return if they are not drunk. "
The atmosphere is here, just say a few words, and the training will be over.
Everyone roared with laughter, and then the table started directly.
Today's banquet is very sumptuous, with twelve dishes, chicken, fish, knuckle, shrimp and various hard dishes, as well as beer, red wine and white wine.
Everyone has been busy since the morning, and quite a few of them haven’t eaten at noon, so they still care about that and start eating.
Such a happy day, the group of old men couldn't bear it anymore, each poured some wine, and drank a few gleefully.
"Oh, this thing is not as good as white wine."
Zhao Dahai took a sip and tapped his mouth, feeling unpleasant.
But there is no trick, they are all old, and the children have clearly stipulated that if they want to drink, this is the only thing they want, and they don’t even think about liquor.
That's all, don't worry about the red and white, as long as you can make sense of it, just be happy.
Xu Haiyuan is still young, the big guys can't drink him, and Xu Shiyan and his wife can't run away.
"Congratulations to Mr. Xu and Mr. Su. With such an outstanding son, this child will definitely have a bright future in the future.
Mr. Xu and Mr. Su are blessed and enviable. Come, let's offer a toast to both of you. "
The leaders of the Forestry Bureau, the managers and factory directors of the ginseng companies, and the leaders of Donggang Town, these people took turns to toast.
My son is promising, and it's all for face when he can come to congratulate him, so why not drink a toast?
After going back and forth, Xu Shiyan and his wife drank a lot.
By the end of the banquet, Xu Shiyan was already so drunk that he was walking staggeringly, and was helped home by Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haibo.
Xu Haiyuan saw that his father was so drunk, so he hurriedly boiled a bowl of hangover soup and fed it to his father.
Xu Shiyan can still drink, but he is not a young man at this age, not as good as before.
After tossing and going out, I vomited for a while, and when I came back to drink sober soup, I felt much more comfortable.
"Dad, drink less alcohol in the future, it's important for your health."
Xu Haiyuan supported his father to sit on the edge of the kang, and couldn't help nagging.
"Well, age is not forgiving. If we wait for the past, we won't be like this if we drink a little more."
Xu Shiyan leaned on the kangqin and sat firmly, looking at his eldest son and laughing.
"I'm happy today, I really didn't drink less, it won't happen in the future, don't worry.
My eldest son is promising, and he won a gold medal in a competition abroad. Your dad is happy today, always happy, really. "
This is the truth. At the beginning, Xu Shiyan only wanted to keep his eldest son, but he never imagined that his eldest son would be so promising.
Xu Haiyuan heard it, um, it’s okay, his dad probably didn’t drink too much. Drunk people never say they are drunk, they are stubborn.
I haven't been able to sleep well in the past two days, and I have a headache. Let's update the four thousand today.
This book is estimated to be finished within this month.

chapters.title: Chapter 796: Nine-year-old ginseng
chapters.content:
Chapter 796 Nine-year-grown ginseng
Xu Haiyuan was only a sophomore in high school, and he participated in the International Olympic Chemistry Competition and won the gold medal, which caused quite a stir for a while.
Many well-known universities extended olive branches to him. In the end, Xu Haiyuan chose the clinical medicine major of Bethune University of Medical Sciences.
In this day and age, Peking Union Medical College is not that famous yet.
Speaking of it, the capitals of the three northeastern provinces all have good medical universities, all of which are more famous than Xiehe.
For example, Bethune Medical University in Kyrgyzstan Province, China Medical University in Liao Province, and Harbin Medical University in Heilongjiang Province.
Those are medical schools with a red tradition, very famous.
Bethune University of Medical Sciences, a medical school that has come out of the war-torn era and experienced the baptism of war.
At this time, it can be ranked among the top three schools in the country with a large number of talents.
Xu Haiyuan chose Bethune University of Medical Sciences because of Chu Xuanhuai.
After all, Chu Xuanhuai has been the principal of the University of Medical Sciences for so many years, but now his disciples are going to study in other schools, which is a bit unreasonable.
Xu Haiyuan studied in the provincial capital for the past two years, and had a lot of contact with Feng Qiyu, the principal of Bethune Medical University, Yuan Jincheng, Chi Hao and others from the Medical University Hospital.
Feng Qiyu admired Xu Haiyuan very much, and always said that Xu Haiyuan should apply for their school.
Another one is for Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu.
These two will study in the provincial capital for three years in high school, Xu Haiyuan is not at ease, he has to watch here.
So Xu Haiyuan rejected the invitations from several medical schools in the capital and chose Bethune University of Medicine and Science.
Xu Shiyan and his wife have never interfered too much in the choice of their children, Xu Haiyuan can choose wherever he wants.
It doesn't matter whether it is the capital or the provincial capital.
Although Xu Haiyuan has obtained the admission qualification of the University of Medical Sciences, he is still a sophomore in high school.
I haven’t finished my third year of senior high school, and I still have to take the exam for several subjects, so I have to study in the attached middle school for another year.
So after the celebration banquet, Xu Haiyuan stayed at home for a few days to accompany his grandparents.
At the end of July, Su Anying and Ji Yufeng accompanied Chu Xuanhuai and their three children back to the provincial capital.
The two families have discussed that they will buy a house in the provincial capital for the children to live in.
Xu Haiyuan has to study seven years of undergraduate and master's clinical studies, plus the third year of high school, that is, he must stay in the provincial capital for at least eight years.
If you want to study for a doctorate or stay in school in the future, you will basically settle in the provincial capital.
So it is very necessary to buy a house in advance, and buy early to save worry.
But it is not so easy to buy a house in a hurry. Either it is far away from the school, or the house is not good.
In the end, the patient who came to Zhongcaotang said that his family had two houses that he wanted to sell, and they were not far away.
As soon as Su Anying heard this, she quickly followed him to see the house.
The residential area is right between the attached middle school and the University of Medical Sciences. There are two houses on the third and fourth floors.
The area is not bad, about 80 square meters, quite spacious.
The owner has two sons at home. Originally, he thought that one person would have a set for married couples, and it would be convenient to live upstairs and downstairs.
As a result, neither of the two sons stayed in the province, one went abroad, and the other went to the south.
The youngest son is working hard to start a company in the south, and the money in his hand is not enough.
The old couple intends to move there to live with their youngest son, so they want to sell the house for the youngest son to start a company.
Su Anying and Ji Yufeng went to look at the house carefully. It doesn't matter the location or the type of room. The house is quite new and has been renovated and no one lives there.
The two sides negotiated a good price, found someone to write the contract, and went to the real estate department to handle the transfer.
The third floor is reserved for Chu Xuanhuai, Xu Haiyuan, and Xu Jinping, and the fourth floor is reserved for Yang Haoyu.
Here, we hire a nanny for cleaning and cooking. In addition, Ji Yufeng plans to study accounting in the provincial capital, just to accompany the children.
I bought a house, bought bedding, luggage, pots and pans.
Everything was settled properly, and Ji Yufeng also went through the admission procedures at the business school.
"Siblings and sisters, I will leave the children to you. Please trouble your siblings for the past two years."
Su Anying still has a lot of things to do over there, and she really doesn't have time to stay for a long time. After she settles down here, she has to leave.
"Sister-in-law see what you said, is there any trouble? If our two families say that, it would be too estranged.
It’s okay, don’t worry if I’m with my third brother and sister-in-law, I’ll take good care of them. "
Ji Yufeng laughed when he heard it. His son lived and ate in the Xu family all these years, and the Xu family never regarded Yang Haoyu as an outsider.
Now that the children are all studying abroad, she will naturally take good care of them when she comes to accompany them.
Just like that, Su Anying made arrangements to leave the provincial capital properly.
On August 20th, the attached high school officially started, and Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu also became freshmen in the first year of the attached high school.
These two have actually been studying in the attached high school for a semester, and they have basically finished the courses in the first year of high school.
During the final exam, both of them got very good grades.
The teachers of all subjects like them very much, and they really take care of them like their own children.
Xu Haiyuan is also a senior high school student, but compared to other senior high school students who are busy with reviewing and preparing for the college entrance examination, Xu Haiyuan is much more relaxed.
Before, Xu Haiyuan's mathematics and physics teachers always hoped that Xu Haiyuan could choose another subject to participate in the competition.
But Xu Haiyuan has already won the gold medal in chemistry, and he doesn't want to practice hard to solve the problems in the next days.
Furthermore, Xu Haiyuan knew his mathematics and physics. Even if he participated, he would not be able to reach the level of chemistry. There is no need to hold up the quota to delay others' performance.
In the last year of high school, it’s better to take it easy, just learn the relevant courses well, and there is no need to compete for others to win the limelight.
If you have the time to participate in competition training, why not follow Chu Xuanhuai and learn more.
The school also expressed its understanding of this, and the math teacher and physics teacher could only give up and pick other students to train.
The three older ones all stay in the provincial capital to study. There are Chu Xuanhuai and Ji Yufeng here, and they also hire someone to cook and clean up. The children don’t need to spend much time in daily life.
Xu Jinping was already independent and sensible. Although Yang Haoyu was a bit childish, but with his eldest brother and second sister in charge, he couldn't make trouble.
In addition, the intensive class the two of them are in has a heavy learning task, and the students are all elite students, and the competition is fierce.
So Yang Haoyu was submerged in the sea of ​​questions all day long, and had no chance to be a demon.
Donggang, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing are also in the sixth grade in autumn.
The grades of the two children are not bad, and the participating elementary school is promoted to the junior high school by all means, so the two have no pressure to go to school.
Xu Haiqing is a little naughty kid, he didn't dare to be too embarrassing when his older brother and second sister watched him before.
Now that her brother and sister are not at home, Xu Jinhui is too gentle to control him at all.
This kid started to **** his tail as soon as school started, and he would follow a group of boys in the class to be mischievous, skipping class and sneaking out to roller-skate and play billiards.
Once or twice, Xu Jinhui didn't hesitate to argue with her younger brother, only typing a few words behind her back.
But Xu Haiqing is not afraid of his fourth sister, who has been restless for two days.
As a result, one day this kid ran out again, and was caught by Xu Jinhui, who swung the broom for sweeping the floor in the class, and whipped Xu Haiqing.
It was only then that Xu Haiqing realized that there was no one in their family to mess with.
Even the fourth sister, who has always been gentle and gentle, is quite scary when she is ruthless.
From September 1st to 5th, Fusong held the 8th Ginseng Festival.
Since the ginseng festival failed in 1989, the ginseng festival has changed from open to small-scale closed, with cultural and sports activities for self-entertainment as the content.
In the autumn of 1993, with the improvement of the situation, it changed from closed to open.
The Ginseng Festival in 1994 took "Openness, Friendship, and Endeavor" as its theme.
In line with the principle of mass participation and self-entertainment, carry out all-round and multi-level cultural, artistic and cultural and sports activities.
Shenchang Primary School also selected a program to participate in the performance of the Ginseng Festival. Xu Haiqing performed well in the art performance and won an award.
At the ginseng festival celebration meeting, twelve model collectives and 105 model workers in the county were commended.
During the ginseng festival, a seminar on ginseng culture theory was also held.
Xu Shiyan was invited to participate in the seminar, discussed the history and culture of Fusong ginseng with a group of experts and guests, and put forward some valuable suggestions and opinions.
During the Ginseng Festival, located in Donggang Ginseng Company, the first domestic ginseng museum - Fusong Changbaishan Ginseng Museum officially opened.
The museum uses a combination of indoor and outdoor exhibitions to display the cultivation and processing of ginseng in detail.
At the same time, it also shows people the history of ginseng cultivation and development in Fusong area, especially the evolution of various cultivation methods.
It plays a very important role in the study of ginseng culture in Fusong area.
This year's Ginseng Festival, economic and trade activities have also achieved certain results.
More than 100 merchants from Dongyi, South Korea, Italy and all over the country conducted economic and trade negotiations, with a turnover of tens of millions of yuan.
Although it is not as good as the previous record, it is a turning point and a good start.
During the Ginseng Festival, there was another big event. The Wanliang Ginseng Market Trading Building was completed, and a grand inauguration ceremony was held.
Compared to Xu Shiyan's previous life, Wanliang's ginseng market is exactly two years behind in this life.
Regarding the construction of the Wanliang Ginseng Market, many people had speculated a lot before that, and they all thought that Xu Shiyan might be secretly trying to prevent the construction.
After all, there is already a ginseng market in Donggang, and the annual market transaction volume is very large.
The stores around Canshi make a lot of money, and the hotels and restaurants in Canshi make a lot of money.
In this case, if there is another ginseng market in Fusong, it will definitely divert a lot of passenger traffic, and Donggang will not make so much money in the future.
But contrary to everyone's expectations, Xu Shiyan didn't react at all to this, so he didn't do such things that hurt others and benefit himself.
Through everyone's hard work in the past few years, Fusong ginseng has basically come out of the trough.
Although the price is at most half of what it was in the prosperous period, at least there is no need to worry about sales.
Many ginseng farmers regained their enthusiasm for planting and began to develop ginseng.
In this case, one more ginseng market can better improve the popularity of Fusong ginseng.
After years of development, Donggang Sanshi has already stabilized its position.
In addition, there are still many pharmaceutical factories and health care product factories coming to grab goods. Even if Wanliang Ginseng Market is completed, it will not be able to shake the position of Donggang Ginseng Market in the short term.
In the future, the respective development of the two parties will further promote the market exchange of ginseng, which is a good thing in itself.
In the past few years, Xu Shiyan and his family have not stopped planting ginseng.
Anyway, there are not many, and it is still a hundred feet a year, all of which are hired people to work.
In autumn, the mallets are played, and the big and good-looking ginseng are packed in white foam boxes and shipped to the capital, Shanghai stock market, and Yangcheng to sell fresh ginseng.
The rest are sent to the processing factory, and after processing, they will be shipped and sold.
In 1989, Xu Shiyan's family planted a hundred feet of ginseng, using the same seeds from the ginseng field in Liumaohe, and the big seeds that took root in four years went to the ground.
Logically, this should have been a product since 1992, but the market was mediocre at that time.
Xu Shiyan told Su Anying that it would be unacceptable for those who left fifty-foot-long seeds to go to the ground, and the others would be used as ginseng to make goods.
The fifty feet did not rise last year, and it will be five years this year.
Although I have been topdressing and paying special attention to field management in the past two years, the power of the soil has come to an end, and it is also particularly susceptible to infection by miscellaneous bacteria that cause rot.
At the beginning, ten or eight trees fell to the ground per centimeter, but this year there are only five or six trees left per centimeter.
The person who watched the ginseng sent a letter to Xu Shiyan, saying that if he couldn't afford it again, he might all be rotten next year, so let's get up.
Xu Shiyan thinks about it too. If you count the period of Shen Zaizi, the club will be nine years old.
It’s true that it’s time, so let’s get up.
So on a Sunday, Xu Shiyan and his wife led Xu Haiqing, Xu Jinhui, and some helpers, and drove up the mountain to participate in the pilgrimage.
In the past years, Xu Shiyan usually did not come to participate in the family. Most of them were Xu Shian and hired people to work.
Isn’t this year special? Xu Shiyan wanted to know what the nine-year-old stick would look like, so he followed him up the mountain.
One more thing, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui had a good time driving, and they hardly went to the mountains to do work.
Xu Shiyan also wanted to find an opportunity to let the two children have a try, knowing that it is not easy to make money.
Especially Xu Haiqing, the child is the youngest in the family, and the most troublesome, with a clever mouth, he is especially good at coaxing people, and he is especially favored.
Xu Shiyan was worried that this kid grew up in a honey jar, and he didn't know what it was to suffer.
In the future, relying on a good mouth to fool around, it will not be a good life.
So Xu Shiyan brought all the children up the mountain to let them try what it's like to work, which can be regarded as experiencing life.
Since Ji Shengyuan separated, Huang Shengli and others have all gone to the south, and the family workers are Huang Shengkai, Feng Yue, Zhao Jianguo and others.
Knowing that Xu Shiyan's family played a club today, these people are very curious and must come up to help.
"Third brother, the sticks in your house are quite strange, why are there several straws growing on each tree?
There must be several reed heads underneath to do this. It's a bit weird, how did it grow out? "
As soon as the ginseng shed was withdrawn, the big guys noticed something was wrong.
Xu Shiyan smiled when he heard the words. This is a small coup he has thought up over the years to increase production, but he has never promoted it.
Every year at the end of July and the beginning of August, ginseng begins to bulge the next year's reed heads underground.
While the bulging reed heads are not as big as rice grains, directly push the soil away, and pick off the bulging reed heads with your hands.
In this way, the ginseng will bulge the reed head again, and under normal circumstances, two reed heads will bulge out.
If there are two reed heads, two ginseng stalks will grow, so that the ginseng leaves will double.
The more ginseng leaves, the stronger the photosynthesis, the sufficient material accumulation, and the natural increase in production.
This is very effective, but it is too labor-intensive, requiring manual picking of reed heads one by one.
Xu Shiyan only did experiments in his own 50-foot-tall land, and he didn't have the heart to do so at all.
"Let's get started first, and see what this nine-year-old mallet looks like."
Xu Shiyan smiled, and didn't explain directly to everyone. Let's get out of the stick and see the production volume.
Everyone didn't ask much, and quickly took the tools and started to participate.
In the beginning, the ginseng was planted with big seeds. After five years of growing, it is estimated that the ginseng will not grow too small.
Xu Shiyan didn't dare to be careless, he swung his three teeth, carefully dug it down, and then came out with a big lump of soil.
Through the back of the three teeth, he shook his hand vigorously, and then most of the loose soil was shaken off, revealing the ginseng buried in the soil.
"My god, third brother, isn't your stick too big?"
Everyone's eyes were fixed on the ginseng tree protruding from the soil, and at this moment they collectively exclaimed.
"The big radish is not as big as your stick? How heavy is this one?"
At this time, Su Anying had squatted on the ground, picked up the ginseng tree, and shook the soil on it again.
Everyone saw the ginseng tree, which was thicker than a human forearm.
Such a big ginseng has no shape at all, and all the five-legged and eight-pointed ginseng are all legs and beards.
The beard on the ginseng's neck is as thick as a man's thumb.
"This tree weighs about three catties." Su Anying weighed the mallet in her hand and estimated.
"I'll go, a three-pound mallet, this is really an eye-opener.
It's a pity that there are no ginseng auctions now. If this was put on the ginseng festival before, this one would not sell at least 20,000 yuan? "
At the Ginseng King Auction, Su Anying took a six-and-a-half ginseng tree and auctioned it for 2,000 yuan.
This tree is much bigger than that one. This is not the king of Shen, but the ancestor of Shen.
If you put it away, the price of 20,000 yuan is easy.
"There is no auction on the Ginseng Festival, but that doesn't mean we can't hold one ourselves." Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard that.
"Go back tonight and tell your sister-in-law to call those customers quickly, saying that we are going to hold an auction of the king of ginseng in Donggang Canshi.
Believe it or not, many people can come? "
Xu Shiyan is an expert at this, if he wants to do something, isn't it easy?
"Yes, yes, sister-in-law, this can be done.
You call to contact customers, we advertise in Canshi, and we will hold an event in Donggang Canshi.
It just so happens that we can take the opportunity to promote our Donggang Sanshi. "Everyone thought it was feasible when they heard it, so they encouraged Su Anying.
"Don't worry, let's get out the mallet first, and see how much big stuff we can get out of these two strings of ginseng.
If this is too little, it is not worth calling someone. "
You can’t call those customers all the way for the sake of three or five sticks, right? Anyway, it should be worth the air ticket money.
"Yes, yes, my sister-in-law is right. Come on, let's go to work."
Everyone cheered up and hurried to work with the three-toothed child.
Everyone knew that there was a lot of goods in the field, so no one dared to be careless. One by one, they picked up the three teeth and planed carefully.
If it doesn’t work after a try, try again and dig deeper.
Then he picked up all the huge clods of soil, kicked the three teeth lightly with his feet, and shook the soil down.
"Oh, this tree is not small, third brother and third sister-in-law, you posted it this time." Over there, Huang Shengkai yelled loudly.
Next, this piece of land will not stop, and the big guys will exclaim one after another.
The sticks are growing, and each tree is bigger than the other. It's really a big carrot, and it may not be as big as the Xu family's stick.
The four-year-old seeds were planted in the ground, and they grew in the ground for another five years.
In the past five years, they have been carefully tended and cared for. They have used foliar fertilizers and compound bacterial fertilizers. They have also specially picked out the reed heads. At least four or five ginseng stalks grow on each ginseng tree.
So many methods have been used, so can the mallet grow badly?
When it was first planted, it was one foot and twelve centimeters, and eight to ten trees per centimeter were planted in the ground.
After these five years, some of them have rotted, and now there are still five or six sticks left per centimeter, and more than sixty mallets can be grown out of one tenth of a foot.
Don’t underestimate the sixty or so trees. The lowest one weighs more than one catty, the slightly better ones weigh more than two catties, and the three catties are not unusual.
Someone even came up with a bigger one, estimated to weigh four catties.
How can this be ginseng? This is better than pulling radishes from the radish field.
The big guy said while working, the extra two years are really not in vain, and he has made a lot of money.
Before coming, Xu Shiyan reckoned that he would be able to produce a large amount of goods, so he didn't bring a gunny bag, but put a plastic film inside the cardboard box.
Although the pretense is less, it is safe and will not crush the mallet.
With such a big mallet, even if it loses a beard, it still hurts.
The big guy on this side got up carefully, and someone on the other side simply picked the stick and packed it into the box.
The main thing is to pick out whether there are any rotten scars or damage. As long as there are no obvious flaws, put them all in the box.
The cardboard box is covered with plastic film, fill a box, first arrange the plastic film, make sure to completely wrap the ginseng inside.
Then use tape to seal the cardboard boxes and pile them on the ground.
Xu Jinhui followed a few aunts to pick goods and pack boxes. This girl worked carefully and was very upright, and everyone who worked with her praised her.
Xu Haiqing worked with Feng Yue and the others.
It is impossible for Xu Haiqing to pick up the ginseng with the three teeth. One is afraid that he will hurt himself, and the other is that he will damage the mallet if he does not plan well.
So Xu Haiqing squatted on the ground, picking up the club.
Don’t underestimate picking up sticks, this job is not easy. After squatting for a long time, your legs are numb, so you can only kneel on the ground.
But kneeling on the ground is useless, and I have to get up after a while, holding the mallet and sending it to pick and pack the goods.
Kneeling and tossing together, it was tiring after a long time.
After the day's work is over, those two legs are sore and sore as if they have been filled with lead.
It’s fifty feet in total. If ordinary people start participating, a dozen or so people will finish it in half a day.
The Xu family’s ginseng is special. Don’t think there are many people, there are nearly twenty people. But who dares to dig out the rough and rough?
Every tree has to be carefully handled, and the work will naturally not be done quickly, until it is past five o'clock, and the fifty feet are finally finished.
During this time, people were arranged to go down the mountain, and they bought a lot of cardboard boxes and plastic films to come up.
Otherwise, those brought up the mountain in the morning are not enough.
Everyone carried all the boxes to the car, covered the outside tightly with a tarpaulin, and tied them firmly with thick ropes before driving back.
Two large trucks in the front and a few light trucks in the back, the convoy drove back to Donggang in a mighty manner.
With so many big mallets, I didn’t dare to keep them at home, so I sent them directly to the large underground warehouse in Canshi for storage.
In the past two years, the big warehouse in the city has undergone several upgrades and renovations, and all available anti-theft methods have been used.
In addition to high-tech means such as burglar alarms, there is no shortage of traditional housekeeping artifacts such as dogs. At night, six or seven big wolf dogs are tied around Daku.
The city guard room also arranged for four people to be on duty, with two shifts at night.
Uncle Li, who was guarding Canshi at the beginning, passed away two years ago.
Aunt Li passed away in her sleep just a few months after her wife left.
The old couple had no children, and Xu Shiyan took care of the funeral, and buried the old couple together on Paotai Mountain in the south.
Chanshi has settled down properly, and told the people in the guard room to be more careful at night, so everyone left in peace.
"Let's go, let's go to the restaurant, I have reserved a table over there."
Dear friends, Happy Lantern Festival.

chapters.title: Chapter 797: Ginseng King
chapters.content:
Chapter 797 Ginseng King
Xu Shiyan and his wife arranged two tables at the Canshi Restaurant and invited all the helpers to eat.
Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui ran home and invited their grandparents to join them.
The two children supported their grandparents and walked, Xu Haiqing's mouth was not idle.
Tell grandparents about the situation of ginseng starting today, and tell how big the ginseng is.
The old couple were a little dumbfounded when they heard it. They have been dealing with sticks all their lives, and they have never heard of them. There are sticks that weigh several catties.
Is that still called a mallet? That's a mallet, right?
After dinner, Xu Chenghou asked his son about it.
"San'er, I heard from Haiqing that our family's club is not small this year?"
"Well, it's not small, the biggest one can weigh more than four catties.
Father, you haven't seen what that club looks like, you're a rare person. "Xu Shiyan nodded and said with a smile.
It can be said that this year's stick has gained too much, it is fifty feet tall, and almost none of the sticks weighs less than a catty.
"The ginseng land at the Liumao River is really good, with long sticks, and Yingzi took care of it meticulously. I think it can be sold for a good price this year."
A mallet that weighs one catty, according to the current market price, will cost at least 2,000 yuan per tree in the market.
Besides, there are also big ones inside, and the proportion is not small. It is conservatively estimated that the fifty-foot ginseng land can be sold for less than one million.
Of course, the cost is quite high.
The big seeds that were put into the ground at the beginning almost sank by one or two, and the cost of planting twelve to three catties in the ground was more than three hundred.
In the past five years, I have taken good care of it, and in the first two years, I have to find someone to watch it alone. The admission fee for a year just costs 20,000 yuan.
This is the best ginseng field in Liumaohe, with less bacteria and sufficient soil fertility. The club can last five years in the field and grow so big.
If it is replaced with ordinary ginseng soil, let alone grow so big, I don’t know how many trees will be left if they rot.
So, this is purely a bet on luck, Xu Shiyan is lucky, and he made the right bet.
If you lose the bet, you will lose everything and nothing.
The routine operation of planting ginseng is still the three-three system. Even if you really want to cultivate large-scale products, it is best to spend nine years like three-three-three.
"It's good to be fifty feet long? Then if you want to send it to the market for sale, what year and month will you have to sell it?"
Xu Chenghou took two puffs of his cigarette and suddenly felt a little worried.
Ordinary people can’t afford such a big mallet, so the big boss has to buy it back or eat it, or keep the wine.
Some people specially get a big glass bottle to soak in a big mallet, and it looks good and impressive when placed there.
