But how many buyers are there?
If you get ten or eight trees to squat in the market and sell them slowly, you can always sell them.
But these 50 feet are almost all big goods, so how much can they afford? How can there be so many big bosses in the city?
"Well, I discussed it with Eiko.
Tomorrow, she will call those clients in the south and tell them that there will be a ginseng auction in No. 20, Donggang Canshi.
Sheng Kai and the others will hurry up to contact farmers from all over the county tomorrow, and they will be in the market then, and they will hold an event or something, and I estimate that more than half of them will be sold.
The rest are packed in moss and foam boxes, and shipped directly to the capital, Shanghai stock market, and Yangcheng.
Don’t our family have shops over there? If this thing is kept in the freezer, it can be stored for a period of time, and it should be able to sell. "
Xu Shiyan had already figured out how to operate on the mountain, so he wouldn't be able to hold all these sticks in his hands.
This is Xu Shiyan and his wife, who have many channels to sell goods.
Switching to someone else, to put it bluntly, don’t look at the mallet growing well and harvesting well, if it’s not going well, it won’t be sold.
In the ginseng market, a hundred or eighty plants can be sold slowly, but if there are too many, it is really difficult to sell.
Xu Chenghou nodded after hearing what his son said, "Well, as long as the two of you know what you think. But don't let your hands fail to sell."
The old man is worried about this, what do you think if you can’t sell it? Isn't that a waste of money?
"Father, it won't happen, if it doesn't work, we can wash the soaked wine and make fresh-keeping ginseng.
The thing is not afraid of aging when soaked in wine, so stay in Shanhuozhuang and sell it slowly. "
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard this. I really don't have to worry about dealing with this little thing.
The father and father chatted for a while, and Xu Shiyan and the others were tired enough to go up the mountain, so they took the child home to rest.
On the next Monday, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui went back to school, while Su Anying took the time to contact the merchants.
All the people she can contact, all call to inform.
On September 23rd, a Ginseng King Auction will be held in Donggang Ginseng City. At that time, garden ginseng weighing one catty or two catties will be auctioned.
Not to mention, many people are very interested in this, and agreed to come and take a look.
At this time, it is already September 12th, and it is very close to the scheduled time, so there are many things that need to be prepared.
Thanks to the right manpower here, everyone started to prepare together, while arranging people to publicize, while setting up a stage to prepare the venue.
Su Anying had to bring someone to pick all the ginseng again and weigh them one by one.
Tie each ginseng tree with red silk, hang a lot underneath, and write the weight on it.
Order another batch of white foam boxes, use moss and damp soil, carefully pack each ginseng, and store it in the refrigerator.
All the sticks have been sorted, weighed and packaged. Among them, there are two biggest ones, both of which weigh more than four catties. They are veritable ginseng kings.
Under Xu Shiyan's guidance, Su Anying picked the heavy tree, and picked a lot of ones that weighed about a catty, and led the people to drive to the province with ginseng.
The biggest one was given directly to the province. This is not for any leader, but for the province.
In 1982, the Second Brigade unearthed a ginseng tree weighing half a catty.
Yu Shouguang sent it to the town, the town sent it to the county, and finally sent it to the province.
At that time, everyone thought that half a catty of ginseng was very rare, and it could be called the king of ginseng.
At the Ginseng Festival in 1988, Su Anying took out a six-and-a-half ginseng tree and was named the king of garden ginseng.
How long has it been? Six years later, a four-jin ginseng appeared.
I have to say that this is definitely a milestone in the history of garden ginseng cultivation in Jilin Province. It is estimated that no one will be able to break through in the short term.
As soon as Shen Wang was delivered to the province, the entire provincial capital was really a sensation, and various news media reported on it one after another.
Fusong ginseng farmers had a good harvest, and a new ginseng king appeared, weighing 2,106 grams.
The huge headline was printed on the front page of the provincial newspaper.
The provincial TV station also broadcast the news on the news that night, and gave the ginseng a big close-up.
Immediately afterwards, the provincial leaders rushed to report to the capital, and then the ginseng tree was sent to the capital again.
Finally, after processing and processing, the ginseng tree was sent to the Jilin Hall of the Great Hall for storage and display.
Su Anying also won the title of "Ginseng King" this time, not only with a certificate, but also with a golden plaque.
The news of a four-jin ginseng tree appeared in Kyrgyzstan, and it spread quickly, and the public was very interested in it.
Immediately afterwards, news came that there would be an auction of ginseng kings at the Donggang Ginseng Market on September 23rd.
At the moment, there are many people who are excited, and quickly book tickets to go to Fusong, Kyrgyzstan Province, to participate in this auction.
September 23rd, the autumn air is crisp and the wind is light and the clouds are light.
Donggang Ginseng Market is full of colorful flags flying, gongs and drums blaring, banners are hanging above the gate of the market, and red silk and balloons are tied on both sides.
Su Anying invited people from Donggang Elementary School, Canchang Elementary School, Canchang Art Troupe, Forestry Bureau Art Troupe, and Fusongshanli Red Opera Troupe to give a grand singing and dancing performance first.
After the performance, the Can Wang Auction will officially begin.
The middle and late September is the day when ginseng farmers start ginseng and make goods.
After the previous campaign, participants all know that there will be an auction on the 23rd.
Many people picked out the big ones from their own ginseng and came to participate in the selection and auction.
Even if it is not rated as the king of ginseng, the price of ginseng in this kind of event is also very high, which is much more cost-effective than usual sales.
At the same time, there are also those mountain hunters who have been running the mountains all year round, bringing the ginseng they dug.
In the past few years, domestic wild ginseng resources have gradually decreased, and it is difficult to see large quantities.
However, this is not a problem for those who dare to take risks. In the past two years, some people have obtained relevant documents and went directly north to neighboring Russia to dig ginseng in the Far East.
According to legend, when the Soviet Union was first established, Lao Maozi once used an airplane to sow a large number of ginseng seeds in the Far East.
No one knows whether this is true or not, but the environment in the Far East is harsh, the land is sparsely populated, and the old man doesn't know how to dig ginseng from the mountains.
It is true that wild ginseng resources are very rich there.
So many people went through the relevant procedures, ventured into the Far East, and searched for treasures in the mountains.
Many people from Donggang went there together, and there were still people looking for Huang Shengkai and the others.
But Huang Shengkai helped Su Anying do things, and earned a lot of money for a year. No one wanted to run out and risk his life to earn that money.
At this auction, there are really many good items.
One of the wild ginseng seedlings weighs more than 300 grams, and its shape is very beautiful, which can be called the best.
Before the auction, there was an exhibition where all the exhibited ginsengs were placed on a table for anyone to watch and evaluate.
Every exhibit has a label, and the merchants will write down the one they are looking at.
Wait for the auction to start, each bids, and the one with the highest bid wins.
Su Anying brought the ginseng tree that was just beginning to weigh four catties, and also brought a few three-jin and two-jin ginseng trees.
It's true that she organized the event, but you can't bring everything in the family, so how can others sell the goods?
So Su Anying only brought these, and the others will be traded privately with those merchants, and will not take up the auction quota.
In the end, the ginseng tree weighing four catties was auctioned off by a Hong Kong businessman for 52,000 yuan, and the rest were also sold at very high prices.
The wild ginseng over there was finally sold for 1.3 million, which is considered the highest price of wild ginseng in China.
During the two-day auction, the turnover was more than 10 million.
The main reason is that the wild ginseng market is good and the price is high, which played a vital role in the turnover of this auction.
The success of the auction has greatly benefited Donggang City, Donggang Town, and even the county.
Although Xu Shiyan's family has a lot of ginseng, there are also many merchants who can't stand it this time.
Many people did not buy anything at the auction, and contacted Su Anying and Xu Shiyan in private to see the goods and discuss the price.
Some Hong Kong businessmen bought hundreds of trees at once, and the price was not low.
Originally, Xu Shiyan also said that the rest would be shipped to the capital or Yangcheng, but in the end, there was nothing left.
Thanks to Su Anying, she set aside some in advance, and those who should be given away have already been sent away.
The relationship network of Xu Shiyan and his wife has grown quite large over the years, and they have to move around when they should.
Ginseng that weighs more than a catty is extremely rare, and it is definitely a treasure if it is used as a gift to get favors. Anyone who sees it will like it.
Deducting the one given to the province, the part that was given away as a gift, and the family left for Xu Chenghou, Su Weizhong, Chu Xuanhuai, Han Wenzhong and other elders, the remaining ginseng was sold for nearly a million.
The special product tax of ginseng is collected according to the number of feet when the ginseng is purchased, and it is stipulated how much a foot is.
Participants who participated in the auction also paid 10% of the handling fee according to the rules.
So there is no problem in this, even if others want to find fault, they can't find it.
The fifty feet of ginseng is sold out, and there are still one hundred feet of ordinary six-year-old ginseng in the field.
There is no need to worry about these, just hire people to go up the mountain and come back, send them to the processing factory for processing, and then ship them in grades and sell them.
Su Anying discussed with Xu Shiyan that starting from this year, the family will no longer grow ginseng.
I really don’t have the time to take care of it. Even if I hire someone to do the whole process, I still need someone to take care of it, right?
Ji Shengyuan is developing better and better now, how can Su Anying have time to take care of the land?
Xu Shian's side is the same, the farm is getting more and more busy, his family doesn't grow ginseng anymore, and he doesn't have time to help Xu Shiyan take care of it.
In fact, not only Xu Shiyan's family, but also Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe and others have decided not to plant ginseng at home in the future.
It's not that they don't like planting ginseng to earn that little money, the key is that they follow Su Anying to work on the Jishengyuan company, and they really can't take care of it.
But Huang Shengkai, Zhao Jianguo, Feng Yue and others did not join Jishengyuan Company, they were only in charge of the periphery.
Helping in the purchase of various medicinal materials and wild vegetables every year, earns a lot of money a year.
Plant some sticks to guarantee the bottom line, and life will be prosperous.
There will be no ginseng planting this year, so after the batch of goods has been processed, Su Anying hurriedly set off for the capital and other places.
Although there are reliable people in the management of Jishengyuan Branch, Su Anying can't let go and ignore everything, she has to go to the headquarters to sit in charge.
In 1994, Jishengyuan Health Products Company achieved an astonishing annual sales of over five billion.
It has developed dozens of types of products. In addition to the main products, the sales volume of other products is also very impressive.
Jishengyuan has branches in Shenzhen, the capital, and Shanghai, and more than 2,000 sales stores in cities across the country. There are also cooperative sales points in rural areas.
It can be said that the sales channels of Jishengyuan have been fully rolled out. In terms of volume and sales, Jishengyuan is already the leader of domestic health care products.
In the blink of an eye, 1994 passed, and 1995 came.
On April 6, 1995, the National Specialty Township Naming Conference was held in the capital.
Fusong was officially named the "Hometown of Ginseng" by the Specialty Township Organizing Committee, ranking first among the 100 famous specialty towns.
When the news came, the whole county rejoiced and held colorful celebrations.
At the same time, the county held a publicity and ideological work conference, and the "Best Citizen" commendation meeting, and Su Anying's name was impressively listed.
At the beginning of the second semester of the third year of senior high school, the students all entered a state of mental tension.
Various preliminary examinations, various rankings, followed by physical examinations and volunteer applications.
This year’s college entrance examination fills in the volunteers or first registers for the volunteers and then takes the exam.
Students can only estimate their approximate scores based on their daily grades and college entrance examination review status, and then fill in their volunteers.
This way of volunteering has certain drawbacks.
Some children usually get good grades in exams, and they report as usual, but the exam performance is abnormal.
Such a child is easy to report high.
There are also children who usually have mediocre grades, but they perform supernormally on the day of the exam.
As soon as the results came out, they were several points higher than usual.
Such children are easy to underestimate.
Compared to his classmates who struggled with grades and aspirations all day long, Xu Haiyuan was much more relaxed.
He has already received the admission notice from the University of Medical Sciences, and he is only waiting for the fall semester to report and attend classes without any burden.
So every day he goes to school as usual, and he doesn’t have to worry about reporting volunteers, test scores, etc.
In the blink of an eye, it is July, the weather is getting hotter and hotter, and the college entrance examination is coming.
It stands to reason that people like Xu Haiyuan who have been recommended for admission do not need to take the college entrance examination.
But Xu Haiyuan was bored, so he told the school that he wanted to take the college entrance examination to experience it.
The school did not object, and registered Xu Haiyuan and recorded the admission ticket according to the normal procedures.
Nowadays, it is not popular for parents to accompany children to take the college entrance examination.
Besides, Xu Haiyuan has already been escorted, and Xu Shiyan and his wife are both busy, so they didn't plan to come to the provincial capital to accompany them.
July 7th, 8th, and 9th, Xu Haiyuan and his classmates sweated and struggled with the test papers in the sweltering examination room.
The college entrance examination is over, both the child and the parents are relieved.
The next step is to wait for the results of the college entrance examination, and then wait for the admission notice.
"Dad, the results of the college entrance examination are out, and my brother's grades are very good.
The total score is 710, and my brother got 692. "
On this day, a big list was posted on the school's publicity gallery, on which were the students' college entrance examination results.
Xu Jinping happened to see it, and quickly called back to announce the good news to her family.
Science total score is 710 points, Xu Haiyuan took the test with 692 points, ranking first in science.
This score is really enough for the Qingbei exam.
When the results came out, many people shook their heads when they saw it, but they couldn't understand why such an outstanding child had to study medicine?
"Well, it's good, your brother followed your mother to the capital, and I'm waiting for a call to tell him.
Girl, how are you doing at school? Tired of homework?
If you are too tired, let's not participate in any competitions, okay?
You just study obediently, just like other girls, play for a while when you want, and go shopping when you want to go shopping.
At that time, we will take the college entrance examination, and we will count as many points as we can. "
Xu Shiyan actually doesn't care much about his son's college entrance examination results.
It is useless to take more exams. Anyway, my son has been admitted to the medical university, so he can go to class in the fall.
It’s my daughter. She hasn’t been home for a long time since she went back to school after the new year, so she panicked.
Xu Shiyan felt a pain in his heart when he thought that his daughter had kicked out all three years of high school courses in the first year of high school in order to prepare for the competition.
Which daughter is not holding hands like pearls and treasures, and it hurts in the heart, but his daughter is desperately competing with those books.
"Dad, what are you talking about? I came to the provincial capital to study and not to play."
Xu Jinping was speechless on the other end of the phone, what is there to do in that street? Going shopping on a hot day, is she out of her mind?
With that time, she might as well do a few sets of questions.
"Dad, I don't feel tired. Really, I like math and do problems. You don't have to worry about me."
"Okay, then you usually remember to eat well, pay attention to combining work and rest, and don't do problems all day long, be careful that it is not good for your health."
Xu Shiyan had no choice but to chatter with his daughter and tell her to pay more attention.
"Oh, oh, I see, Dad. Well, I hung up the phone, and my aunt called me to eat."
Xu Jinping couldn't stand her father's nagging, so she quickly hung up the phone and ran upstairs to eat.
On Xu Shiyan's side, after hanging up the phone, he sat on a chair and stared out the window in a daze.
The weather today is not very good. It has been a little cloudy since I woke up in the morning, and the sky is very cloudy at this moment.
A bunch of dark clouds are extremely low, and it feels like it will rain at any time.
Suddenly, a bright light flashed across, and the sky flashed.
Then, the rumbling thunder sounded loudly.
The first flash of lightning seemed to turn on some switch, followed by a burst of lightning and thunder, accompanied by heavy rain.
Xu Shiyan's heart jumped suddenly, and he quickly grabbed the phone, "Qingguo, is the county ready for flood control?"
"Third uncle, what are you talking about? Flood prevention? It shouldn't be possible at this time, right?" On the other end of the phone, Zhou Qingguo looked confused.
Generally speaking, the local area is in the rainy season in late June, and the more it rains during the days of the senior high school entrance examination.
It hasn’t rained in July this year, and the ground is completely dry. Today’s rain is just in time. Why do you think of flood prevention?
"Don't ask why, just make arrangements."
When the lightning flashed just now, Xu Shiyan suddenly remembered that in his previous life, at the end of July and the beginning of August in 1995, the Songhua River flooded.
The water of the Xijiang River overflowed the embankment, and all the low-lying places in the county were flooded.
At that time, Xu Shixiang lived in the county. I heard from him later that the situation at that time was very difficult, and there were things floating all over the street.
Some people’s refrigerators and washing machines were washed away by the flood.
Zhou Qingguo suddenly remembered that when Xu Shiyan first moved to Donggang, he could always warn in advance to avoid losses to the Second Brigade and the commune.
"Understood, third uncle, I'll let someone arrange it."
Zhou Qingguo's heart trembled. The past few years have been better, but he forgot about it.
If others don't believe it, you must believe his third uncle's words.
Therefore, Zhou Qingguo hung up the phone and immediately organized a staff meeting.
"Secretary Zhou, this can't work, right?
Although the weather forecast said that there will be heavy rain, it hasn’t rained for a long time. You can see that the water level of the Xijiang River has dropped a lot.
Even if the rain is a bit heavier, it shouldn't cause water. "
"Don't worry about whether you have it or not. It's time to prepare first. What if something happens?"
Zhou Qingguo firmly believed that Xu Shiyan's reminder must have a basis, so he insisted on making preparations in advance to be prepared.
Zhou Qingguo's behavior style is very similar to Guan Enxue's.
Regardless of his young age, these people in the county really dare not underestimate him.
Since Zhou Qingguo insisted so much, other people can't object, so they can only follow Zhou Qingguo's wishes.
Immediately notify the villages along the Songhua River, pay attention to the rainfall at any time, stay vigilant, and be ready to move to a higher place at all times.
On the other hand, the county along the river is also monitored at any time, and flood control materials are prepared, so that if there is a problem, rescue can be done at any time.

chapters.title: Chapter 798: season finale
chapters.content:
The rain started at noon on July 28th and has not stopped.
Before there was no rain for nearly a month and the temperature was high, the soil in many places was relatively dry and loose.
This heavy rain kept pouring, and the soil sand and gravel in some places were directly washed down by the rain, causing landslides and mudslides.
On July 30th, the water level of the Xijiang River had already risen, and it was about to overflow the embankment.
Because of the preparation in advance, the villages along the coast were evacuated to higher ground in advance, and the county seat also urgently arranged manpower to rescue on the embankment.
Fortunately, on the evening of the 30th, the rain gradually stopped, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
As long as the rain stops and the water level slowly drops, everything will be fine.
But no one expected that after a few days of rain stopped, it would start to rain again, and it was even bigger than before.
The water level of the Songhua River rose sharply, and the flood was about to rush to the county.
Manpower was organized throughout the county to fight the flood, and other villages and towns also arranged manpower to support them. At least they survived the biggest flood peak on August 6th.
After the 6th, the rain stopped, the water level slowly dropped, and the county was finally safe and sound.
After the rare flood in July 30th, the county took early warning and took timely measures.
The residents along the coast evacuated early, and there was no casualty, which can be regarded as a miracle.
In late August, provincial leaders came down to inspect in person.
Affirmed the achievements of Fusong's flood fighting this time, and highly praised the relevant county cadres headed by Zhou Qingguo.
Xu Shiyan didn't like to show off, and he specifically asked Zhou Qingguo not to say anything to the outside world, so no one knew that Xu Shiyan was the first person to warn.
The outside world only thought that Zhou Qingguo was far-sighted, thoughtful and profitable, so the superiors admired Zhou Qingguo very much.
But Zhou Qingguo is indeed too young at this age, and he has just been promoted not long ago, so it is not suitable for him to be transferred.
It's better to be his secretary safely, and let's talk about it after a few years of hard training.
Next, the county will carry out related work such as reclamation of water-damaged cultivated land and restoration of water-damaged projects.
Businesses and people affected by the flood have been properly resettled.
Because of the high terrain, Donggang and Songjianghe were not seriously affected by the disaster.
Shenye Company and relevant departments of Songjianghe Forestry Bureau jointly donated cement, steel, wood, rice, bedding, medicine, drinking water and other related materials to the severely affected areas, totaling more than 2 million yuan.
At the same time, young and strong laborers were also dispatched to help the severely affected people build houses.
Xu Shiyan, Guo Shouye and others, along with Zhou Qingguo, personally went to the severely affected areas to check the progress of the post-disaster reconstruction.
"Shiyan, quickly arrange someone to find Shuqing, the child is missing."
Before Xu Shiyan could go back, he suddenly received a call from Su Anying.
"What the hell? That kid Huang Shuqing is gone?" Xu Shiyan was stunned when he heard that, and then laughed.
"Didn't you go out to play? That **** is already twenty, and no one else can abduct him. What are you afraid of?"
Huang Shuqing is two years older than Xu Haiyuan, but the two of them went to school together and just finished the college entrance examination this year.
Huang Shuqing didn't study very well, his grades in the senior high school entrance examination were mediocre, and he didn't even pass the high school admission score.
Still using Xu Shiyan's name, he found the principal of the high school, and spent the sponsorship fee to send the high school year's book.
Originally, I thought, no matter how good or bad my high school studies were, I would get a diploma.
Now the junior high school diploma is no longer enough, and I have to go to high school anyway.
If Huang Shuqing studied hard in high school for three years, his family would be happy to send him to study even if he took some majors.
It’s okay if you don’t pass the exam. It’s just that the family is short of staff, so you can do whatever you want.
In a few years, marry a daughter-in-law and have a child. With the current wealth of the Huang family, they are not doing badly.
So Xu Shiyan didn't take his wife's words seriously.
He is a young man in his twenties, he might go to someone’s house to play, and he didn’t tell his family, so what’s the fuss about?
"No, Li Hua quarreled with Shu Qing a few days ago, and then that **** Shu Qing left a letter and ran away."
Su Anying said eagerly on the phone.
"Shengli is still on a business trip in Yunnan and Guizhou, and he won't be back in a while, so you hurry up and arrange someone to look for him everywhere.
I have also been going back for the past two days to send my son back. School is about to start. "
As soon as Xu Haiyuan's college entrance examination ended, the couple went to the capital. They have been there recently and haven't come back yet.
"Fuck, this **** thing.
All right, daughter-in-law, don't worry, I'll go back and see what's going on. "
Xu Shiyan was quite speechless when he heard it. Huang Shuqing, a bastard, is still in his twenties and still not in shape.
Day-to-day, I really can't finish messing with these little bastards.
"Qingguo, that son of the Shengli family has run away, I'll go back and see what's going on."
Xu Shiyan hung up the phone and turned to talk to Zhou Qingguo.
Zhou Qingguo is very familiar with Huang Shengli and others, and he also watched Huang Shuqing grow up.
Hearing this, Zhou Qingguo was speechless.
"None of these little **** can rest easy. Third Uncle, then go back and have a look, and let me know if you have any news."
Just like that, Xu Shiyan hurried back in the car, and went straight to Huang Shengli's house in Donggang.
Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe, Yang Jianguo, Feng Chao, Sun Xiaofeng and others have always followed Su Anying and Xu Shiyan.
From the original Baishan Ginseng Company to today's Jishengyuan Health Products Company, they have participated.
Of course, their shareholding in Jishengyuan is not too much, a few people account for more than 30% of the shares in total.
Ji Shengyuan is so popular now, even with 30% shares, these few people can earn a lot of money every year.
Although Huang Shengli and others work in various branches, they don't know much about management, so most of them are responsible for the procurement of medicinal materials.
The health care product factory now has no less than dozens of products. In addition to the bulk raw material ginseng, the demand for other medicinal materials is also particularly large.
Now there are dedicated cooperative planting bases all over the country.
Huang Shengli and others traveled around most of the time, so their daughter-in-law and children did not follow, and they were still in Donggang.
Huang Shengli's family has three children. The eldest Huang Shuqing just graduated from high school, the second Huang Shuyun is in the second year of high school, and the third Huang Shuping is taking the senior high school entrance examination this year.
When Xu Shiyan arrived at Huang's house, he saw a roomful of people in the family, including the daughters-in-law of several brothers in the Huang family, Zhao Jianshe and Feng Chao's daughters-in-law.
Huang Shengli's daughter-in-law, Yu Lihua, sat on the edge of the Kang and kept wiping her tears, while the people next to her tried to persuade her.
"Sister and brother, what's going on? Why is Shu Qing still running away?"
Xu Shiyan entered the door, and didn't bother to say hello to these people, so he asked directly.
"Third brother, why are you here?" When Yu Lihua saw Xu Shiyan, she hurriedly stood up and handed a letter in her hand to Xu Shiyan.
"I don't know what's going on, I just quarreled with him that day.
As a result, I woke him up the next morning, and he was gone, with such a letter pressed under the pillow. "
When Yu Lihua said that, she couldn't help but shed tears again.
Xu Shiyan took the letter and looked at it, there were a few words scribbled on it.
"Mom, I'm leaving and going out to make a living. Believe me, I can make a name for myself without relying on my dad."
Just these two sentences, and the inscription below is Huang Shuqing.
"Hey, this bastard, what's happening to him?"
When Xu Shiyan saw this message, his blood pressure went up with anger.
What a bastard, the family can't let him go, right? Still running outside, going out to make a living?
The **** graduated from high school, why can't he be arranged?
If Jishengyuan Company is too far away, there are places like fertilizer factory, processing factory, Quanyang Beverage Factory, Fenglin Flooring Factory, etc., where he can find a place.
If it doesn’t work, you can still send it out to study a junior college for a few years, and then arrange it with the participating company when you come back.
With Xu Shiyan around, how could he be able to take advantage of his nephew who had been raised since he was a child?
After hearing what Xu Shiyan said, Yu Lihua regretted it even more.
"Blame me, it's all my fault, I shouldn't have quarreled with him."
It turns out that high schools have started to receive notices one after another in the past few days.
Some people's children study well and are admitted to a good university, and they all make arrangements to treat guests to dinner or something.
Yu Lihua saw it, and started talking to Huang Shuqing when she got home. She thought Huang Shuqing was not good at studying, so she only scored about 200 points in the college entrance examination.
The major colleges and universities haven’t expanded their enrollment in this year, and they don’t even think about colleges for more than 200 points.
There were no private schools, so Huang Shuqing failed the ranking.
And with this score, there is no need to repeat it.
How many parents do not expect their children to be successful? Especially in the Northeast region, it is generally more important for children to learn.
Although the Huang family is rich now, in the hearts of Huang Shengli and his wife, no matter how rich they are, they can’t catch up with getting into a good university, finding a good job, and having a solid job.
When Yu Lihua got angry, she yelled at her son and scolded her earlier.
Later, he told Huang Shuqing to simply follow his uncle and others, and catch goods in the ginseng market in autumn.
Otherwise, go to help Huang Shengli, marry a wife and have a child in a few years.
Huang Shuqing was already a little short-tempered. Ever since his college entrance examination results came out, his mother had been nagging like this all day long. This kid was already annoyed.
So he talked back to his mother, and the two of them started arguing.
Can you have good words when you quarrel? Yu Lihua scolded her son for being worthless, and she relied on Lao Tzu all her life.
As soon as Huang Shuqing got angry, he yelled at his mother, saying that he could make a name for himself without relying on his parents.
Then the next morning, Yu Lihua discovered that her son had disappeared, leaving only this letter.
"He took all the clothes, and the money he praised over the years.
Why do you think I'm so talkative? What's the use of me talking about that with him? "
Yu Lihua regretted it to death. If she knew her son would run away from home, she couldn't talk nonsense.
"Brothers and sisters, stop crying too.
Shu Qingdu is in his twenties. If this is not the case, he should marry a wife and have children.
It doesn't matter if he goes out to make a living, this kid is a bit aggressive, if he doesn't make sure he can really make a name for you.
If you really do not do well, you can also know a little bit about the world, know the dangers of the world, and come back to work safely and steadily, and you will be the same in this life. "
In Xu Shiyan's view, Huang Shuqing's running out may not necessarily be a bad thing.
These children were born at a good time. They haven’t suffered much. They don’t know that life is difficult. It’s good to let them go out and experience it.
Besides, a twenty-year-old guy is strong and strong, and he can still have some punches.
As long as he doesn't follow crooked ways, the chance of danger is not high.
There is no pyramid scheme in this year, and there is no such thing as organ trafficking. There is chaos outside, and at most it is stolen or robbed.
That kid Huang Shuqing is not stupid, but smart. The key is that he is not focused on studying.
Go out to see and see, know a little bit of danger in the world, suffer setbacks and so on, and come back.
"Sister-in-law, Sheng Kai and the others have gone out to look for it, so don't worry.
Maybe Shuqing was found before he went far? "The sisters-in-law of the Huang family also persuaded each other.
After some persuasion by the crowd, Yu Lihua stopped crying at least.
In the evening, Huang Shengkai and others who ran out to find someone came back, but there was no news at all.
No one has seen Huang Shuqing at the train station or bus station.
I've searched and looked for this, and cried and cried, what else can I do?
A few days later, Huang Shengli came back from other places. Seeing the situation at home, he could only comfort his wife and beat the two at home.
Let them study hard, and if anyone dares to go to college with the old man, Huang Shengli will break their legs.
After Huang Shuqing left, there was no news. It has been a long time, and others just shook their heads when they mentioned it occasionally.
Only the Huang family, who sighed every time they mentioned it, and Yu Lihua was even more worried day and night, thinking about her son who was wandering outside.
But Huang Shuqing, a bastard, just didn't come back and there was no news.
In mid-September, Xu Haiyuan went to the University of Medical Sciences to report, and then went to military training and classes.
Xu Hai has been taught by famous teachers since he was a child, and he has read all the medical books at home. He is also very smart and has a solid foundation in mathematics, physics and chemistry.
So life in medical school is not stressful at all for him.
Originally, Xu Haiyuan wanted to work hard to skip a level, but was stopped by Chu Xuanhuai.
Chu Xuanhuai told Xu Haiyuan that there is no shortcut to study medicine.
The seven-year school system itself is already very full of course schedules, and the pressure is great, so don't think about shortening the school system.
That will only take care of one thing and lose another, and it will not be good for the future.
To study medicine, you still need to be down-to-earth and lay a solid foundation.
Solid basic skills, whether it is clinical or academic, will be the biggest reliance in the future.
Xu Haiyuan listened to Chu Xuanhuai's words the most, so he gave up the idea.
But he didn't stop. In his spare time, he studied the secret recipes in medical books, helped Chu Xuanhuai organize medical records, and worked with the seniors from the School of Traditional Chinese Medicine to study medicine for illnesses.
Regarding this, Chu Xuanhuai didn't say anything.
In Chu Xuanhuai's heart, he very much hoped that Xu Haiyuan would become a truly famous doctor who concentrated on the mastery of Western medicine in the future.
This wish may be difficult to realize in others.
Medical medicine is like a vast sea of ​​stars, and it is difficult to master a single subject, not to mention that Chinese and Western medicine are two completely different theories.
Fortunately, Xu Hai came from elementary school medicine, and was taught by a famous doctor like Chu Xuanhuai himself.
In Xu Haiyuan, Chu Xuanhuai saw hope.
University life is rich and colorful, and Xu Haiyuan enjoys it.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu, who are already in the second year of high school, are preparing for the next subject competition.
In the three-subject competition of mathematics, physics and chemistry, most of the participating students are high school seniors.
Basically finish the courses in the first year of senior high school, study the content of the competition wholeheartedly in the second year of high school, participate in the county-level selection in the second semester of the second year of high school, and participate in the preliminaries of the national competition as soon as the third year of high school begins.
Then the provincial department will select the students with excellent preliminaries to participate in the national finals.
Like Xu Haiyuan, there are very few students who can participate in competitions in the second year of high school, go all the way from provincial competitions, national competitions to world competitions, and still win gold medals.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu are the two students who are most likely to win prizes in the second year of high school after Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Jinping focuses on mathematics, and Yang Haoyu focuses on physics. The two participated in the regional qualifiers in the first semester of high school.
Not long after the start of the second year of high school, I participated in the preliminary round of the national competition, which is the provincial competition.
Among a group of senior high school students participating in the competition, two broke through and both won the first prize.
Yang Haoyu ranked second in the province in physics and was qualified to participate in the national competition. He went to Taiyuan to participate in the 12th National High School Physics League in October.
The league was held from October 8th to 11th. Yang Haoyu won the first prize and was qualified to enter the national training team.
When the news came back to Donggang, both Yang and Xu were extremely excited.
"Xiaoyu is really promising." Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan laughed happily.
After all, they were children who grew up watching him grow up. The old couple treated Yang Haoyu as their own grandson. Could they be unhappy that his grandson won an award?
"Yeah, with Xiaoyu's grades, I guess it's no problem to recommend him to a key university.
It will be even more remarkable if they do well in the training camp next year and are selected to represent the country in the world competition.
It doesn't matter even if he didn't pass the final selection, he is only a sophomore in high school, and he can participate again next fall. "
Xu Shiyan is also very happy. It is very gratifying that the child who was thin and small, always sick and almost unable to support himself can reach this point today.
"Now, let's look at Pingping's results in the national competition in January.
I hope she can perform well and come back with an award. "
Xu Haiyuan Chemistry, Yang Haoyu Physics, if Xu Jinping comes back with another prize in mathematics, their family will cover all three major subject competitions.
The elders in the family were celebrating happily, but Xu Haiqing was hiding in a corner trembling at this time, not daring to say a word.
I was afraid that if he opened his mouth, his father would stare at him.
Fourteen-year-old Xu Haiqing is already in junior high school.
However, instead of studying in Donggang Junior High School, he went to Forestry Bureau No. 1 Middle School.
If this matter is mentioned, it has something to do with Guo Shouye.
At the beginning of July, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui took the entrance exam.
Shenchang elementary school is promoted to junior high school. No matter the grades are good or bad, you can get in. Because of this, there is no pressure from teachers to students.
If there is no pressure, there will be no motivation, so the students' grades must not be as good as Donggang Primary School.
Xu Haiqing usually ranks seven or eight in the class, but in junior high school he has to rank outside the hundred.
Xu Jinhui was a bit better, but she didn't make the top ten either.
After Guo Shouye found out, he told Xu Shiyan that the two children should not be allowed to study in Donggang Junior High School.
Actually, the teaching quality of Donggang Junior High School is not very good. Xu Haiyuan, Xu Jinping, and Yang Haoyu are able to come out, and a large part of the reason is that the children themselves are excellent.
However, with the three in front of them, if Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui were still studying in Donggang Junior High School, they would be under a lot of pressure.
Guo Shouye meant that it would be better for the two children to go to the No. 1 Middle School of the Forestry Bureau. After leaving the environment of Donggang Junior High School, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui could play freely.
Never mind how good or bad their studies are, at least no one compares them with their older brothers and sisters, and no one points them out.
Xu Shiyan was worried for several days, thinking about it all the time.
In elementary school, in order to avoid this situation, the two children were sent to Shenchang Primary School.
This is junior high school, do I need to change it again? Does this really work? Is it good or bad for children?
But after thinking about it, the two younger ones are ordinary children themselves, not as evil as their elder brothers and sisters.
In fact, it is the same wherever they study, and it may be better to change the environment.
As Guo Shouye said, at least teachers and classmates will not always compare them with their older brothers and sisters, which is better for children’s psychological growth.
Otherwise, what if these two are weak psychologically and can't stand the pressure at that time, and they also run away from home like Huang Shuqing?
Then the couple should not regret it to death?
In this way, Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui were transferred directly to No. 1 Middle School of the Forestry Bureau when school started in the fall.
Forestry Bureau No. 1 Middle School is a school for the children of Forestry Bureau employees, and generally does not accept local students.
But with Guo Shouye around, these are not problems.
Guo Shouye did not mention to the school that this is the child of Xu Shiyan's family, but only said that it is the child of his relatives.
Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing themselves are not as famous as their elder brothers and sisters. Besides, there are many students in the No. 1 Middle School of the Forestry Bureau. There are twelve classes in the first grade, with more than 500 students.
The two children are not in the same class, and there are no familiar people around them, so they don't stand out.
Although Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui were twins born together, they have completely different personalities.
Xu Jinhui has a quiet and gentle temperament, well-behaved and sensible, so teachers and classmates like her very much, and many people in the class protect her.
Xu Haiqing is lively and playful, and she has become acquainted with her classmates after only a few days of school.
This kid has a pleasing personality, and he can coax people to death with one mouth, so he is especially good at school.
Xu Shiyan saw that the two children had gotten used to it in No. 1 Middle School of the Forestry Bureau, so he let go of his suspense.
Xu Shiyan and his wife didn't have too many demands on the two young children in the family.
It is best if you can finish your studies safely and get admitted to university. If you fail the exam, your family can help arrange it.
As long as they don't go out to cause trouble, and don't eat, drink, whore, gamble and smoke money in the future, it's fine to live an ordinary life.
After all, not every child is talented and suitable for learning. In fact, most of the children are like Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing, ordinary and ordinary.
As a parent, you must accept the ordinaryness of your child, which is also a blessing for your child.
"Xu Haiqing, what are you doing? Your third brother won the award, why am I not happy seeing you?"
Xu Shiyan had actually seen his youngest son's virtue a long time ago, and he was really helpless and funny in his heart.
Xu Shiyan is not happy with anyone who says that this kid is not smart.
Look, how clever this is. As soon as he heard that his brother had won an award, he quickly got up, for fear that the adults would turn around and scold him.
"No, no, I'm quite happy."
Xu Haiqing thought that he would be fine if he hid in a corner, but he was called by his father in a blink of an eye.
Xu Haiqing was so frightened that his little heart trembled wildly, for fear that his father would say the next sentence, look at how promising your third brother is, why can't you learn from him?
"Hehe." Xu Shiyan sneered twice.
"Well, on New Year's Day, the company has a program, and I heard that there seems to be a cultural performance in the county.
Leader Jiang asked you to participate by name. You should remember to rehearse with Leader Jiang on Saturdays and Sundays. Study hard and don't embarrass me. "
Dear son, don’t scare him to death, just make sense.
Xu Shiyan coughed deliberately and said.
"Oh, I see, Dad, I will study hard and act hard, and I will never embarrass you."
Xu Haiqing became happy when he heard it. He loves to perform on stage, so that’s no problem.
In October 1995, Dongfang Ginseng Company invested 500,000 yuan to introduce a set of ginseng pesticide residue detection equipment "gas chromatograph" produced by Dongyi Shimadzu.
Since then, Fusong Changbai Mountain Ginseng Testing Center was formally established in Donggang.
In fact, Xu Shiyan has long proposed about the production of low-residue ginseng, but it is limited to the domestic technical level, and there is no way to accurately detect it.
After the introduction of machines, relevant industry regulations followed up immediately.
For ginseng that has been identified by the testing center and issued a low-residue ginseng identification report, the price of fresh ginseng is ten yuan per catty higher than that of ordinary ginseng.
Not to mention dry goods, the price is much higher.
This initiative has stimulated the enthusiasm of ginseng farmers to grow ginseng with low pesticide residues.
The county also issued documents to encourage ginseng farmers to minimize the use of pesticides containing phosphorus, chlorine, arsenic and other ingredients, improve the quality of ginseng, and develop a green and ecological ginseng industry.
At the same time, South Korean businessmen came to China to purchase a large number of ginseng, and pharmaceutical factories and health care products factories purchased ginseng and other raw materials, and the ginseng market rose accordingly.
Although it is still not as good as the price in 198687, it is much better than before.
Fusong ginseng experienced a six-year low period and began to develop steadily.
In the blink of an eye, 1995 passed, and 1996 came.
In January, Xu Jinping went to Hefei to participate in the 10th National Mathematics Competition for High School Students and the National Mathematics Winter Camp for High School Students.
The winter camp lasts for five days. The second and third days are the exams. There are three big questions every day, each question worth 21 points. The exam time is four and a half hours.
The difficulty of the topic is similar to that of the international Olympic competition, and the thinking is very strong.
The fourth day is academic report or visit, and the fifth day is the closing ceremony and award ceremony.
Xu Jinping won the gold medal with a full score and was also qualified to enter the training team.
In April 1996, Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu entered the National Training Team for Physics and Mathematics respectively.
Passed through multiple selection tests and was finally selected for the national team.
From June 30th to July 7th, the 27th International Physics Olympiad was held in Norway. Yang Haoyu and another player from the national team both won gold medals.
From July 5th to 17th, Xu Jinping participated in the International Mathematical Olympiad held in Mumbai and won the gold medal with a perfect score.
When the news came back, the phone calls of Xu Shiyan and Su Anying almost exploded, and it was all from Hexi.
Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian's family once again hosted a banquet to celebrate their sons and daughters.
In August 1996, the scenic spot on the west **** of Changbai Mountain was completed and officially operated.
Compared to Xu Shiyan's previous life, it was exactly two years earlier.
The mountain gate of the West Scenic Area adopts the design of the traditional Manchu horse house, and the old man's autographed inscription is written on the mountain gate.
The mountain gate of the scenic spot is grand and magnificent, with unique regional customs and characteristics.
On the day of official operation, the scenic spot held a very grand celebration ceremony.
Xu Shiyan, as the representative of donating money to build the scenic spot, was naturally invited, and together with the provincial leaders, cut the ribbon for the completion and operation of the west scenic spot.
After the official operation of the scenic spot, Xu Shiyan submitted a tourism development plan for the west **** of Changbai Mountain that he had planned and completed a long time ago to his superiors.
This planning document contains a complete development and construction plan, as well as the planning and design drawings of Donggang Town.
"Xiao Xu, I didn't realize that you are not only very smart in developing the ginseng industry, but also very forward-looking in developing the tourism economy.
This plan and planning design drawing are very important, and the province attaches great importance to them.
Many experts and professors have been convened to discuss many matters concerning the development of tourism economy on the west **** of Changbai Mountain. "
After receiving the plan and design drawings, the provincial leaders were very happy and praised and praised Xu Shiyan.
"The leader has won the award. This is my own immature idea. There are still many omissions in it. I sincerely ask the leaders and experts to criticize and correct me."
Xu Shiyan has never been the kind of character who takes credit and pride. He is still very calm about the leader's praise, without much emotional ups and downs.
The leader praised Xu Shiyan again, and then hung up the phone.
Xu Shiyan's plan indeed attracted great attention from the province. Several seminars were held in succession and reported to the capital.
However, how can such a major event that costs tens or even tens of billions be easily approved?
Meetings were held one after another, and discussions were discussed again and again, but seriously, where did the money come from?
Xu Shiyan had anticipated this situation, so a few months after the proposal was handed in, he submitted another application.
Shenye Company wants to spend money to buy Guosong Mountain, six kilometers southeast of Donggang, and develop a resort project.
The province is worrying about running out of money. At this time, the participation company actively asks for funding for development and construction, so why not readily agree?
So after a meeting and discussion, all the relevant procedures were given a green light, and the project was quickly approved.
In front of Guosong Mountain, there is a small village called Guosong Village, which was also called Gaoli Baozi in the past.
Guosong Village has more than 130 households with seven to eight hundred people.
If you want to develop and invest in a resort project, the people in the village will have to relocate.
The participating company will arrange for someone to come and talk to them. As long as they agree to relocate, in addition to paying a certain amount of compensation, they can also recruit workers to the participating company.
Employees are allocated to regular workers, units are assigned housing, and children are directly arranged to study in participating primary schools.
In 1996, most people could not refuse this condition, so the relocation was negotiated very quickly.
In the spring of the second year, the Changbai Mountain Pearl International Resort project was officially launched.
Dongfang Ginseng Co., Ltd., in conjunction with a number of local enterprises, will invest in the construction of a large-scale tourist resort integrating leisure, tourism and vacation in Guosong Mountain.
Including golf courses, ski resorts, multiple resort hotels, hot spring resorts, water parks, Northeast characteristic towns, Changbai Mountain specialty street and a series of projects.
This is only the first step in the tourism development of the west **** of Changbai Mountain, and more projects will be developed in succession.
In July 1997, Xu Jinping set off again with four other team members to participate in the International Mathematical Olympiad held in Argentina.
In this competition, Xu Jinping also won the gold medal with a perfect score.
The little girl who aspired to be admitted to Tsinghua University, failed in the end and was recommended to the Department of Mathematics of Peking University.
Yang Haoyu, who was going to take the Tsinghua exam with his sister, actually went to Tsinghua to study.
At the end of 1997, Songjianghe Forestry Bureau changed its name to Songjianghe Forestry Co., Ltd. after the first batch of pilot projects of modern enterprise system in Jilin Province ended.
With the support of Xu Shiyan, Guo Shouye independently contracted Fenglin Wood Industry, and Guo Fenghua contracted Bingshan Beverage Factory and Quanyang Beverage Factory.
Afterwards, these two enterprises were directly assigned to the province.
Yunfeng Compound Fertilizer Factory, which was originally jointly established with Donggang Township, also passed relevant reforms and was independently contracted by Yang Junxian.
In the spring of 1998, the provincial Dongfang Shenye Group Company carried out shareholding reform.
Among them, the legal person shares accounted for 68%, and the individual shares accounted for 32%. It was renamed Dongfang Shenye Group Co., Ltd., and Xu Shiyan became the chairman of the group company.
In the autumn of 1998, the superiors issued an order that the army and other organizations withdraw from the local industry. The original Changbaishan Pharmaceutical Factory was completely owned by Shenye Company.
The glorious era of state-owned enterprises is over, and a new chapter has begun.
The story that should be explained is almost done, the main part is over, and there will be related extra chapters in the follow-up, so as to explain the follow-up of the characters clearly.
By the way, I recommend a book. "The Great Detective"
Reborn in the Jiajing year, a book boy in Prince Yu's Mansion.
Jingshi Soybean Oil Case, Jurong Taoism Case, Yunnan Gu Chong Case, Bozhou Chieftain Case...
Da Ming lost an ordinary person Liu Xie, and gained a detective Liu Xie!
(Li Chengliang is the thug)

chapters.title: Chapter 799: Extra Story by Xu Haiyuan (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 799 Extra Story by Xu Haiyuan (Part 1)
People often say a word, "If you persuade people to study medicine, you will be struck by lightning."
Although it sounds a bit ugly, it does reflect the difficulty of medical students.
Especially in clinical medicine, there are so many subjects to learn, and it is not like other majors that have any emphasis or non-emphasis.
Because it is impossible for patients to get sick according to the key points in the book, there are all kinds of strange diseases of patients in the world, some of which are in the book, and those that are not in the book have to be.
So most people are in a state of sprinting for the college entrance examination every day from the day they study medicine.
You have to use the strength of the cantilever and awl to stab your buttocks to read through the medical professional book that is as tall as a person.
Moreover, when studying medicine, you have to face countless exams and quizzes. It is really a learning experience.
Xu Haiyuan loved reading his father's medical books since he was a child, and later studied with Chu Xuanhuai.
Before Xu Haiyuan went to high school, Xu Haiyuan went through all the medical books in Chu Xuanhuai's room.
In addition, he has excellent grades in all subjects in high school, and his foundation is very good.
So others study medicine hard hahaha, but Xu Haiyuan easily makes people envy and hate, and his grades make everyone pale in comparison.
If you have enough energy to study, you will naturally have a lot of time to do other things.
On Saturdays and Sundays, Xu Haiyuan will study with Mr. Chu at the Zhongcaotang, and discuss case medicine with his seniors.
Winter and summer vacation is to actively participate in various social practices.
Internships in township hospitals, free clinics in the countryside with tutors, etc., performed extremely well, and were loved by tutors and professors.
"Brother, you are finally back."
When the summer vacation of his freshman year was coming to an end, Xu Haiyuan finally came back from the countryside.
As soon as Xu Haiyuan stepped into the Chinese Herb Hall, Xu Jinping happily ran to him, and immediately began to dislike him.
"Oh, look at you, what have you made of yourself, dark and thin.
What you know is that you went to the countryside to study for free clinics, but those who didn’t know thought you went to a coal mine to dig coal.
Why don’t I know how to pay attention to protection? Look at how tan you are. "
"What protection do I, a big man, do?
In summer, patients are lining up under the sun, we young men have the nerve to cover them tightly?
Besides, what are we going to do? Just go to work, you treat me as a blessing? "
Xu Haiyuan laughed as soon as he heard it, and raised his hand to rub the top of his sister's head.
Ever since Xu Jinping entered high school, her original long hair has been cut into neat short hair.
The main reason is that there is a lot of homework, and it is too troublesome to take care of long hair.
In this regard, the men of the Xu family, including but not limited to Xu Shiyan, Xu Haiyuan, Xu Haiqing, Yang Haoyu and others, felt that it was a pity and panicked.
Xu Jinping's hair quality is particularly good, the original long hair was left to the waist, it is a pity to cut it off.
But Xu Jinping herself didn't care. She wore a neat short hair all day long, looking like a tomboy, but she thought it was fine.
However, no matter how neat the short hair is, it can become a bird's nest if Xu Haiyuan rubs it like this.
Xu Jinping rolled her eyes directly, and slapped off her brother's annoying paw.
"It's annoying, there are my friends here."
As Xu Jinping spoke, she straightened her hair with her hands, then turned her head and waved towards the distance behind her.
"Tiantian, come on, let me introduce you. This is my brother. The former student union president of our school."
In fact, children who study well are also very capable in most other aspects, and there are very few nerds who really study hard.
The same is true for the brothers and sisters of the Xu family. They have good academic performance, and they are also excellent in sports and literature and art.
Xu Haiyuan was the squad leader and team leader in elementary school, and the deputy squad leader and league secretary in junior high school.
When I was in high school, I ran for the vice-chairman of the student union when I was a freshman, and became the chairman of the student union when I was a sophomore.
Xu Jinping is no worse than her brother. She is excellent in painting, calligraphy, singing, dancing, and sports.
"This is our elementary school girl, Jiang Xintian, who is a year younger than me.
is also a member of the student union, we all call her Britney. "
Xu Jinping smiled and pulled the girl behind her over, and introduced her brother and the girl to each other.
"Tiantian is two years younger than me, and he is also a well-known genius in our school.
Mathematics, physics and chemistry are all super good, and I am going to participate in the chemistry competition this fall. "
The girl in front of me is about 1.6 meters tall, which is considered short.
But standing next to Xu Jinping who is nearly 1.7 meters tall, she looks small and exquisite.
The girl has a small round face, short hair cut with bangs, and a pair of deer eyes that are innocent and clear.
With her upturned nose, small mouth, and milky white skin, she looks as cute and sweet as that porcelain doll. No wonder everyone calls her Little Sweet.
"Xu, hello senior." Jiang Xintian probably wanted to call Brother Xu, but as soon as he uttered a word, he felt that it was not very good, so he changed his name to senior.
Then, the little girl smiled embarrassedly.
The little girl is very cute if she doesn’t smile. With this smile, the innocent deer’s eyes become two crescent moons, and the two deep dimples on her cheeks are really sweet to people’s hearts.
Xu Haiyuan cleared his throat, and nodded towards the little girl opposite, "Hi Jiang Xuemei."
When two strangers met, they had nothing to say, and the scene was a bit deserted for a while.
"Brother, hurry home and take a shower and change your clothes.
I'll send Tiantian back to school, and I'll find out your notes on the training camp in the capital another day, Tiantian needs to use it. "
Xu Jinping didn't seem to notice anything, so she waved to her brother, and then walked out of the Chinese Herbal Hall arm in arm with Jiang Xintian.
"Wait a minute." Xu Haiyuan hurriedly turned around and greeted.
The two girls stopped and looked back at Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan's face suddenly became hot, thanks to his tan this summer, nothing abnormal could be seen.
"Wait a minute, I'll go find something."
As he spoke, Xu Haiyuan ran up to the second floor of the Chinese Herb Hall, and found a small white porcelain pot that wasn't too big from the shelf.
"Pingping, come here." Xu Haiyuan waved to his sister.
After Xu Jinping came over, Xu Haiyuan handed the small white porcelain jar to her sister.
"Tell your friend, take a spoonful of this and drink it with warm water. If you find it bitter, add some brown sugar."
Speaking of this, Xu Haiyuan paused again, thought for a while and added something.
"Let her eat less cold food and soak her feet in hot water at night."
"Wow, brother, you are amazing." Xu Jinping's eyes lit up, and she looked at her brother with admiration.
"How did you see it? You don't need to feel the pulse?"
Jiang Xintian was not feeling well today, Xu Jinping dragged her to the Chinese Herb Hall, and wanted Chu Xuanhuai to show Jiang Xintian a look, and get some medicine to recuperate.
It turned out that there was a roomful of patients, Jiang Xintian, a little girl who couldn't get rid of it, and was about to leave.
Unexpectedly, I met Xu Haiyuan head-on.
Xu Haiyuan coughed lightly, "Don't talk nonsense, hurry up and give the things to others."
Traditional Chinese medicine pays attention to looking, smelling and asking, and pulse diagnosis is the last place.
Many people deify pulse diagnosis, as if they have to take the pulse to diagnose any problem.
In fact, experienced doctors can learn a lot from the patient's complexion and breath.
"Oh, got it."
Xu Jinping waved to her brother, and quickly went to find Jiang Xintian with her things. The two girls gathered together and muttered a few words.
Then, Jiang Xintian looked back at Xu Haiyuan.
The girl's face was red, maybe she wanted to say something, but she didn't have the nerve to say it. She just nodded and smiled at Xu Haiyuan, then hurriedly turned around, and dragged Xu Jinping away.
Xu Haiyuan stood at the stairs, staring at the backs of the two girls, stunned for a while.
"Hey? Haiyuan is back? Why are you standing here?"
Coincidentally, at this time, a student studying in the medical center saw Xu Haiyuan and came to say hello, Xu Haiyuan came back to his senses.
"Well, when I just came back, I saw that Shigong was busy, so I didn't go in to disturb you."
Xu Haiyuan nodded, descended from the last step of the stairs, turned around and walked inside, looking for Chu Xuanhuai.
After the sophomore year, the curriculum has undergone new changes, with fewer basic courses and more medical professional courses.
Some very professional medical vocabulary is actually quite difficult to remember.
However, for Xu Haiyuan, the new course is not difficult, and he can easily handle it.
Xu Haiyuan's achievements are not only outstanding in this year, but also in previous years.
In college, boys with good grades, good looks, love of sports, and outstanding abilities are very attractive to girls.
Even in medical schools, boys like Xu Haiyuan are very popular.
However, Xu Haiyuan doesn't seem to be very interested in these.
Other people go to some fellowships, parties, etc. after studying, and chase after the girls they meet, but Xu Haiyuan never participates.
He never paid attention to girls who gave him gifts or love letters.
Especially because he doesn't live on campus, he goes to school on a day-to-day basis, spends most of his time alone, and has little contact with other people.
So in the eyes of others, Xu Haiyuan is the kind of super-study, but very mysterious existence, which arouses the curiosity of many people.
However, Xu Haiyuan doesn't care what others think, he still maintains his own pace of life.
Go to class, go to the library to look up information, be called by the instructor to help, and go back to Chinese Herbal Medicine to study in my spare time.
In the summer of 1997, Xu Jinping was successfully sent to Peking University, and Yang Haoyu was sent to Tsinghua University. The two graduated from high school and packed their things to go home.
Chu Xuanhuai is old, and most of the time he directly lives in the Chinese Herbal Hall.
In order to take care of his master, Xu Haiyuan simply moved back to the Zhongcaotang.
In the blink of an eye, it is another year, and the second semester of junior year is coming to an end.
Seven-year clinical medicine, three years of general basic and basic medical education, and four years of clinical medical education.
That is to say, starting from the senior year, clinical special topic orientation practice, under the leadership of the tutor, complete the master's thesis.
Xu Haiyuan's academic performance has always been very good, and his basic medical knowledge is very solid, which is appreciated by his tutors.
Chi Hao, who is already the vice president of the First Clinical Hospital, called for Xu Haiyuan to study after the final exam, and he wanted to take Xu Haiyuan himself.
"Student Xu Haiyuan, you are awesome, you even rejected the department flower of our department?
Our medical school is not a temple for monks, why do I think you are here to practice?
Take advantage of the good times, hurry up and find a partner.
I heard from the seniors that after we graduate and work, we are so busy that we can’t even eat, how can we have time to date? "
Xu Haiyuan had just rejected a girl's confession, when he turned around, he was caught by several boys in the same class.
The big guys surrounded Xu Haiyuan and teased him.
"I think you have less homework, and you still have the time to care about other people's dating?
The day after tomorrow is the end of the term, you all have reviewed this, right? "
Xu Haiyuan didn't want to discuss those unnutritious topics with these naive ghosts.
Sure enough, when Xu Haiyuan said this, everyone immediately wailed.
"Damn, Xu Haiyuan, you are so unkind, why do you have to remind us?"
Xu Haiyuan twitched the corners of his mouth, shook his head, walked out of the howling crowd, went to the carport to find his car, and rode it out of school.
Zhongcaotang is not very far from the University of Medical Sciences. It is troublesome to take a car. It is more convenient to ride a bicycle.
"Senior Xu." As soon as he arrived at the entrance of the Chinese Herb Hall, before Xu Haiyuan parked his car, he heard someone calling him.
Xu Haiyuan held the car with one hand and looked back to where the sound came from.
"Jiang Xuemei, why are you here? You came back from the competition?" Seeing Jiang Xintian, Xu Haiyuan was somewhat surprised.
Jiang Xintian participated in the National High School Chemistry Competition in his sophomore year of high school. Although he won the first prize, he was not selected for the training team.
In the third year of high school, Jiang Xintian participated in the selection competition again, and then successfully entered the training team.
After going through layers of selection, he was selected into the national team. A while ago, he went abroad to Australia to participate in international competitions.
Ever since Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu went to college last year, Xu Haiyuan didn't pay much attention to these games.
About the chemistry competition, I heard it occasionally, but I didn't pay much attention to it.
So when Jiang Xintian appeared in front of Xu Haiyuan at this moment, Xu Haiyuan remembered it belatedly, as if the game was over.
"Well, the competition is over, I didn't perform well, and I only came back with a silver medal. It's not as good as seniors and senior sister Pingping."
When Jiang Xintian said this, annoyance flashed in those big clear eyes.
Her aptitude is still too ordinary, incomparable to the one in front of her.
"Senior Xu, these are the notes you lent me back then. I have finished participating in the competition and I will return the original. Thank you, Senior Xu."
Jiang Xintian held a large thick notebook in both hands, raised his hand and brought it to Xu Haiyuan, but his eyes were still fixed on the notebook, with a slightly nervous look on his face.
"I'm already in college. It's useless for me to keep this thing. You don't need to return it to me."
Xu Haiyuan was stunned for a moment, then smiled.
These things are for the competition, and they are really not needed for the rest of the time, so there is no need to send them back in person.
"How can I do it? If you borrow something, you must return it in its original form."
Jiang Xintian said this a little eagerly, and then he probably realized it, and quickly put the notebook in Xu Haiyuan's hand, turned around and ran away.
"Senior Xu, I'm going to the capital to study in the fall. I'm studying chemistry at Peking University. I can see Senior Pingping then."
Xu Haiyuan looked at Jiang Xintian's figure running away, and for the first time understood what it meant to move like a rabbit, this girl ran quite fast.
Xu Haiyuan shook his head, holding the notebook in one hand, and holding the car steady with the other.
Coincidentally, he was holding the back of the notebook, and the pages were slightly spread upwards, revealing something pink inside.
Xu Haiyuan was stunned for a moment, set up the car, and opened his notebook casually.
Only then did I realize that there was a heart folded from pink letter paper in the notebook.
Xu Haiyuan shook his head, instead of opening the heart immediately, he walked into the Chinese herbal hall instead.
After greeting everyone, he went upstairs with his notebook.
Come upstairs, Xu Haiyuan sat at the desk, carefully unfolding the pink origami heart.
The letter paper is fully unfolded, and the beautiful fonts on it also come into view.
"Senior Xu, I like you very much." Just that simple sentence, there is nothing else.
Xu Haiyuan couldn't help shaking his head and laughing. This girl, knowing that she was going to study in the capital, didn't even leave a contact information.
Thanks to her going to Peking University, she was able to meet Xu Jinping. If this is changed to another place, how can I still contact her in the future?
Do you still like it? If you like it, you just return the things without saying a word, and then run away?
Xu Haiyuan sighed, and wanted to fold the letter back into the shape of a heart, but found that he was so stupid that he couldn't figure it out.
Okay, forget it, don’t bother, just fold it in half, clip it back into the notebook, and put it on the bookshelf.
Xu Haiyuan has to study with Chi Hao during the holidays, so naturally he has no time to go home, but fortunately, everyone at home understands.
Following Chi Hao for a vacation, I really learned a lot. Chi Hao also praised Xu Haiyuan very much.
Not long after the start of senior year, Xu Haiyuan received a letter from his younger sister Xu Jinping, which mentioned Jiang Xintian's study at Peking University.
Xu Haiyuan inquired about Jiang Xintian's mailing address seemingly inadvertently in his reply, and then wrote a letter to Jiang Xintian.
The two of them exchanged letters for a semester.
During the winter vacation, when Jiang Xintian came back from the capital, Xu Haiyuan had already inquired about Jiang Xintian's itinerary with Xu Jinping, and asked for leave to pick him up at the station.
"Tiantian, this way." Xu Haiyuan looked at the girl dragging her luggage and hurriedly running towards the exit, and waved to her with a smile.
Jiang Xintian’s family is from Jiutai. When he comes back from the capital, he has to take a train to the provincial capital, and then go home by car.
Jiang Xintian was thinking about Xu Haiyuan in his heart, so he thought of spending a day in the provincial capital to meet Xu Haiyuan before going home.
Jiang Xintian didn't tell anyone about this, so when she dragged her luggage out of the station and heard Xu Haiyuan calling her, Jiang Xintian was almost stupid at the time.
Here, what's going on? How did Xu Haiyuan know that she came back by this bus today? Moreover, why would he come to pick up the station?
Although the two had communicated for half a year, neither of them pierced the window paper.
So Jiang Xintian is a little confused at the moment, not understanding what is going on.
"Why did you come?" Jiang Xintian dragged her luggage out of the station, came to Xu Haiyuan, and asked him.
Xu Haiyuan didn't say a word, and directly reached out to hug the girl in his arms.
"Little fool, I'm here to pick up my girlfriend home."
"Huh? Your girlfriend?"
Being embraced by Xu Haiyuan, Jiang Xintian's brain crashed immediately, and he could only repeat Xu Haiyuan's words, even forgetting to think.
"Yeah, someone wrote to me and told me she liked me, but didn't even leave a mailing address.
Then, I have to work hard to find it. Thanks to my smartness, otherwise, wouldn't my girlfriend just fly away? "
Xu Haiyuan lowered his head, held Jiang Xintian's small face, and smiled happily.
Jiang Xintian finally understood at this time, and blushed a lot.
"Oh, I didn't promise to be your girlfriend."
How can there be such a thing, without even a confession, and let someone be his girlfriend in a daze?
Jiang Xintian was ashamed and annoyed, her face flushed, and she quickly pushed Xu Haiyuan away.
But seeing Xu Haiyuan conjured a bouquet of roses out of nowhere and sent them to Jiang Xintian.
"Tiantian, I like you, would you like to be my girlfriend?"
At the exit of the station, there are many people coming and going.
It's freezing cold in the middle of this month, so why don't you go home and get warm?
However, at this moment, many people really stopped to watch the excitement here.
It's been 1999, and people's ideas are not as old as before.
At this moment, when I saw the exit of the train station, two young people, a man and a woman, stood facing each other, and the man touched a bouquet of flowers in his hand.
What else do you not understand? This is a man who wants to confess.
Not to mention, these two people stand together, the man is tall and handsome, and the woman is cute and cute, they are really a good match.
These people who watched the excitement suddenly became energetic, and they didn't know which one spoke first.
"Promise him, together."
This is great, as if some kind of magic spell has been cast, a group of people around shouted.
"Together with."
"Tiantian, I really like you, be my girlfriend, I will hold you in the palm of my hand and it will hurt."
Xu Haiyuan looked at Jiang Xintian with a smile, waiting for her response.
Jiang Xintian pursed her lips, unable to hide the smile on her face no matter what.
She has actually liked Xu Haiyuan for a long time, but she never dared to say it.
In the past six months, the two of them have often corresponded. She actually wanted to ask Xu Haiyuan, did you see the letter in the notebook?
But I'm afraid that if I really ask, if Xu Haiyuan doesn't mean anything to her, the two of them may even have to cut off communication.
Jiang Xintian was still struggling on the way back, not knowing what to say when he met Xu Haiyuan.
Unexpectedly, Xu Haiyuan gave her such a big surprise as soon as she got out of the station.
In this world, there should be nothing more beautiful than the person you like and yourself, right?
At this moment, Jiang Xintian felt that there was something called happiness fermenting in the bottom of his heart, bubbling upwards.
You are beautiful in your heart, how can you hide it on your face?
"Then can you promise that you will always be nice to me in the future?"
Jiang Xintian looked up at Xu Haiyuan. In those clear deer eyes, there were joy, happiness, longing and confusion about the future.
"I swear, I will always be good to you, very good."
