Xu Haiyuan looked at the cute little girl in front of him, and the corners of his lips couldn't help but rise.
Such a girl, if you are with her, life must be so sweet every day, right?
"Then, I'm looking at this cold day, so many people are standing in the cold wind watching us. Then I agree?"
Jiang Xintian deliberately looked around, pursed his lips, and smiled with crooked eyes.
Xu Haiyuan held the girl in his arms again, "If you promise, you are not allowed to go back on your word. From today onwards, you will be my girlfriend."
There was a burst of applause from around, making Jiang Xintian flushed and embarrassed.
Xu Haiyuan stuffed the flower into Jiang Xintian's hand, turned his head and cupped his hands towards everyone.
"Thank you for your help, thank you, thank you."
"Young man, treat this little girl well in the future.
Look, what a perfect match, they are a match made in heaven. It's nice to be young, I wish you happiness. "
A not-so-young aunt gave her blessings with a smile, and then took the man next to her by the arm, and the two left quickly.
Many people smiled and sent blessings, and then left in a hurry.
Xu Haiyuan, holding Jiang Xintian's luggage with one hand, held his newly appointed girlfriend in his arms with the other, shielding her from the wind and snow, and the two walked out together.
"Come on, get in the car." Coming to a parking lot not far away, Xu Haiyuan quickly opened the door and let Jiang Xintian get in the car.
"Where did you get the car?" Jiang Xintian was confused, what's going on?
Isn't her boyfriend a student of the Medical University? How come there is still a car?
"Borrow it from a friend, it's convenient to pick up the station." Xu Haiyuan said casually.
In fact, he bought the car himself. Xu Haiyuan has saved a lot of money over the years, and the patent transfer fee for the health care product factory and the pharmaceutical factory alone is a lot of money.
It's not intentional to hide this from Jiang Xintian, it's just that this girl is still young, so telling her the truth may scare her.
Forget it, let’s wait two years until the girl is older.
"Oh, then drive slowly." Jiang Xintian just asked casually, she didn't care how the car got here.
"Where are you going now? Do I just drive you home, or do you have other plans?"
Xu Haiyuan started the car, drove away from the parking lot, and asked by the way.
"I, I told my family that I will arrive home by tomorrow's train."
Jiang Xintian rubbed the corner of his clothes, lowered his head and said in embarrassment.
Growing up so big, the first time I lied to my family was to go and see the boy I liked.
In front of Xu Haiyuan, Jiang Xintian felt that he couldn't get rid of it.
The little girl's thoughts are all written on her face, how can Xu Haiyuan not understand with her shrewdness?
"Well, I'll find you a hotel to settle down. You stay in the provincial capital for a day, and I'll take you home tomorrow."
This girl is really capable, she dares to spend a day in the provincial capital, and she is not afraid of being abducted.
"Oh, good." Jiang Xintian was worrying about where she should settle down, and when she heard Xu Haiyuan's words, she immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
But then, it seemed a little lost again.
Xu Haiyuan drove Jiang Xinyi with him, found a hotel with good conditions, and directly opened two rooms.
Xu Haiyuan doesn't worry about his little girlfriend living outside by herself, so she must accompany her all the way today.
After settling down, Xu Haiyuan took his new girlfriend out to eat, go shopping, and the two of them went to see a movie.
I played until after eight o'clock in the evening before returning to the hotel.
"Take a good rest, I will drive you home tomorrow, don't get up too early."
Xu Haiyuan sent Jiang Xintian to the door of the room, then lowered his head and kissed his new girlfriend on the forehead. "Good night."
"Good night."
Jiang Xintian blushed, looked up at Xu Haiyuan, smiled sweetly at him, then opened the door and entered the room, turned around and waved at Xu Haiyuan.
"Go to bed early, come to me if you need something, I'm next door."
Xu Haiyuan nodded towards Jiang Xintian, watched Jiang Xintian close the door, and then went back to his room.
This night, the young people who had tasted the sweetness of love for the first time were tossing and turning sleeplessly across a wall.
The next morning, Xu Haiyuan took Jiang Xintian to dinner, and then drove her home.
It is not too far from Changchun to Jiutai. I dare not drive too fast in winter. In about an hour, I arrived near Jiang Xintian's house.
Xu Haiyuan helped Jiang Xintian take down the suitcase, and then tidied her hat and scarf.
"Okay, I'll send it here, and you go home by yourself.
Call me if you have anything to do, either on Zhongcaotang or my mobile phone. "
Jiang Xintian stood in front of Xu Haiyuan and asked hesitantly, "Aren't you going to let me in?"
The two just confessed to being together yesterday, and they are going to separate today, how can they be willing?
"I guess if I send you in, your parents can beat me out with a big stick." Xu Haiyuan sighed.
He wanted to meet Jiang's family, but he couldn't do it right now.
This girl is only eighteen, she is too young, and the cabbage is too tender to eat.
If Jiang's father knew that his family's fresh and fresh cabbages were going to be raped by pigs, he would definitely be furious, and what kind of violence might be caused by then.
Jiang Xintian is only in his freshman year, and Xu Haiyuan is only in his senior year, and Xu Haiyuan is still studying medicine, and he doesn't know how many years he will study in the future.
It is obviously not a wise move to rush to the door at this time.
Let's wait until the two of them are about to graduate, when the time comes, they can show their sincerity by going to the door to propose marriage.
Even if the Jiang family is unhappy, the daughter can't stay at home forever when she grows up.
Jiang Xintian was amused by Xu Haiyuan's words, "Okay, I'll take you home again when I have a chance. You should drive slowly when you go back. It's cold and slippery now, so be careful."
Jiang's father is the principal of a junior high school, and Jiang's mother is a primary school teacher.
Jiang Xintian is the only daughter in the family, and the jewel in the palm of her parents' eyes. She has been smart and sensible since she was a child, and she is good at studying.
Especially Jiang Xintian's father, if he knew that his daughter had a boyfriend long ago, he would be really mad.
Thinking of this, how dare Jiang Xintian let Xu Haiyuan go home with her?
Hastily told Xu Haiyuan a few words, and then dragged his luggage to his home.
While walking, he turned his head and waved towards Xu Haiyuan.
Xu Haiyuan saw Jiang Xintian walk into the alley, then returned to the car and sat down.
After a while, the phone in his pocket rang. Xu Haiyuan answered the phone, it was really Jiang Xintian calling.
"I'm home." Probably because he was afraid that his parents would find out that something was wrong, so he didn't dare to say more.
"Well, take a good rest and call when you have time." Xu Haiyuan didn't talk nonsense, just replied.
Then the two hung up the phone at the same time, and Xu Haiyuan drove back to the provincial capital.
The Spring Festival in 1999 was on February 16th. Although Xu Haiyuan had a holiday in mid-January, he was actually busy in the provincial capital until the end of January.
It just so happened that Su Anying also came back from the capital, took a detour to the provincial capital, and picked up Xu Haiyuan and Chu Xuanhuai to go home for the New Year.
Chu Xuanhuai is getting older now, and his mental and physical strength is not as good as before.
Xu Shiyan and his wife wanted to let the old man come back to enjoy his old age.
At the medical center, it happened that several students under Chu Xuanhuai's school had already graduated and graduated from the school. They were basically the ones who saw the doctor in the past two years, and Chu Xuanhuai was just giving pointers.
With the foundation laid by Chu Xuanhuai, the operation of the medical center is not bad, so it is no problem to hand it over to them.
Now there is a direct train from the provincial capital to Songjianghe. Get on the train from Changchun around 3:00 in the afternoon and arrive at Songjianghe around 3:00 in the morning.
Xu Shiyan waited at the train station in advance, picked up Chu Xuanhuai and others, and went home together for the New Year.
Arrange a little sweet girl for Hao Daer, hahaha.

chapters.title: Chapter 800: Extra Story by Xu Haiyuan (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 800 Extra Story by Xu Haiyuan (Part 2)
One of Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian is in the capital and the other is in the provincial capital. On weekdays, they can only pass letters or talk on the phone.
Xu Haiyuan is busy, usually only Jiang Xintian comes back from vacation, and the two can get together.
Long-distance relationships are actually very difficult. If one of the two parties cannot persist, the relationship will fall through.
Fortunately, Xu Haiyuan has a tough heart, while Jiang Xintian is young, naive and persistent.
The two stayed silently until Jiang Xintian's junior summer vacation, when Xu Haiyuan looked for an opportunity and took Jiang Xintian back to Donggang to meet his family.
Jiang Xintian's appearance is not that beautiful.
The beauties from the Xu family, whether it is Xu Jinping's heroic appearance or Xu Jinhui's gentleness and demureness, are actually better than Jiang Xintian.
But the girl looks sweet and cute, and she is very lovable. She is the type that elders like at first sight.
Not only Xu Chenghou and his wife fell in love, but even Chu Xuanhuai, Su Weizhong and others said that this girl and Xu Haiyuan, who was usually serious and deserted, were a natural match.
Jiang Xintian successfully passed the Xu family's test in this way.
The Xu family used the highest hospitality etiquette to entertain Jiang Xintian.
Jiang Xintian lived in Xu's house for four or five days. Before leaving, Zhou Guilan took off the gold bracelet on her wrist and put it on Jiang Xintian's wrist.
As for Su Anying, in addition to giving Jiang Xintian a big thick red envelope, he also gave a Cartier diamond-encrusted watch.
Scared Jiang Xintian so much that he didn't know what to do, and he was dumbfounded while holding the things.
"What should I do? The things my grandma and aunt gave are too expensive."
Before coming here, Jiang Xintian really didn't think about the Xu family.
In the past few years she has been with Xu Haiyuan, she has never asked about these things.
The person she likes, Xu Haiyuan, is not from Xu Haiyuan's family.
After coming here, I saw that Xu's family lived in a small town. Although the house looked quite big and well decorated, Jiang Xintian didn't take it too seriously.
The Xu family is definitely not poor if they can send their children to the provincial capital to study, and they don't live in school.
But Jiang Xintian couldn't imagine that the Xu family is not just poor.
In the past few days, all kinds of delicious treats have led her to play everywhere, especially the resort area, which most people can't afford.
That's all, how could I ever think that before I left, someone would give me such an expensive gift?
Jiang Xintian is able to study in a university in the capital, and she still has some experience.
Among other things, she knows that watch, and it is quite a famous brand. A watch costs a lot of money.
"Our family likes you very much, this is a gift for you.
The rules in our family are like this, no matter whoever leads the object back, he must give a meeting gift. "
Xu Haiyuan's words are not bluffing.
When Xu Haibo brought his partner back, Zhou Guilan also gave him a meeting gift.
"If you give it to you, you will keep it. This is their recognition of you, and it means that we will be a family in the future."
Xu Haiyuan raised his hand and rubbed Jiang Xintian's face and brows.
"Okay, don't frown, a good face will make you wrinkle into a bitter melon.
how? Could it be that you have a bad impression of our family? Or, you don't want to go with me? "Xu Haiyuan deliberately frightened Jiang Xintian.
"No, no, of course I want to be with you forever." The innocent girl was bluffed by Xu Haiyuan just like that.
"That's it, we will be a family in the future, why are we so clearly divided?
Just put it away properly, wear the watch as you like, I think you should put the gold bracelet away, as a souvenir or something.
This style is not suitable for you to wear, I will buy you a suitable one later. "Xu Haiyuan smiled and put the watch on Jiang Xintian's wrist.
"My mother still does things according to the old rules. The watch I prepared for you is not bad. This brand looks good on you."
Table, also has the meaning of marking.
If this is the old society, the man and the woman look at each other, and if the elders of the man are satisfied with the woman, they will put a golden hairpin on the girl's head as a mark.
In the new society, wearing hairpins is no longer popular, so I replaced them with watches.
When Su Anying and Xu Shiyan saw each other, Zhou Guilan did the same, and gave Su Anying a watch directly.
However, there were not so many styles of watches at that time, and they were not as beautiful as today’s watches.
During the summer vacation, Jiang Xintian met Xu's family. During the winter vacation of senior year, Xu Haiyuan made an agreement with Jiang Xintian in advance that he would visit Jiang's family.
Jiang Xintian studied early, went to elementary school at the age of six, and was only 21 years old when she was a senior.
Before, Jiang’s father had been telling his daughter not to be too eager to find a partner, and it would not be too late to find a partner after work.
As a result, Jiang Xintian directly guaranteed his postgraduate studies in this school, and he will study for another three years.
Papa Jiang was a little anxious this time.
If you wait until your daughter finishes her graduate studies, she will be twenty-five. Wouldn't it be too late to find a partner by then?
And just when Jiang's father was anxious, Jiang Xintian suddenly called back and discussed with her parents, saying that she had a crush and wanted to bring it back for her parents to see.
After Jiang's father and Jiang mother learned that their daughter had a partner, although they felt very uncomfortable, they still accepted this reality.
My daughter is grown up, how can she stay at home for a lifetime? Sooner or later you have to get married.
It would be nice if you could find one in college, after all, college students are very pure and don't have so much scheming.
Just like that, Jiang's father nodded and agreed that the daughter would bring the man back, and the couple would check to see if the boy was reliable or not.
Jiang Xintian was very happy to get permission from his parents, and went straight to the provincial capital after the winter vacation.
After meeting Xu Haiyuan, the two bought a lot of gifts and drove to Jiang's house.
I have to say that this young man Xu Haiyuan wants to have a head and a good appearance.
And he is a medical student, which is a very good occupation in the eyes of his parents' generation. He has a stable job and earns a lot of money.
These are all bonus points.
Jiang Xintian's father Jiang Chengzhe and mother Tao Min saw Xu Haiyuan for the first time and thought it was okay.
The Jiang family is a family of intellectuals, and they are gentle and polite.
Actually, Jiang Chengzhe still has some grudges about his daughter bringing back a partner at a young age.
But seeing Xu Haiyuan's prudent, thoughtful and decent way of doing things, and his good conversation, he also loved Jiang Xintian very much, and the Jiang family's parents had a better impression of Xu Haiyuan.
After all, Jiang Xintian is their baby who has been loved since childhood. They don't want the man's family to be rich and rich, but they must treat their daughter well, know pain and heat, and take good care of Jiang Xintian.
In this regard, Xu Haiyuan is still qualified.
He is three years older than Jiang Xintian, calm and capable, and takes care of Jiang Xintian meticulously.
In general, the Jiang family's parents had a good impression of Xu Haiyuan, and then asked Xu Haiyuan what plans he had next.
Jiang Xintian wanted to stay in Peking University to study for graduate school, while Xu Haiyuan was studying in Changchun.
Regarding this point, Xu Haiyuan has already arranged it long ago. Next, he will go to the Capital Union Medical University to study for a Ph.D.
Xu Haiyuan studied a seven-year clinical program and graduated with a master's degree.
In the past few years, during his study with Chi Hao, he has published many papers of great academic value as the first author in many top international and domestic journals, and has been recognized by many domestic and foreign medical experts.
Originally, the school wanted to keep Xu Haiyuan, whether it was continuing to study for a doctorate or working in a clinical hospital.
After careful consideration, Xu Haiyuan decided to go to the capital to study for a Ph.D.
The first one, the headquarters of Jishengyuan is in the capital.
With the company's development and expansion year by year, as well as market changes, Jishengyuan urgently needs to transform and move closer to pharmaceutical companies.
In this regard, Su Anying and Xu Shiyan's abilities are not as good as Xu Haiyuan's.
Needless to say, the second one is for Jiang Xintian.
The two of them have been away from each other for such a long time, and Jiang Xintian will study in graduate school for three years, so they can't stay in different places forever.
Two people love each other, and if they want to have a result, there must be one person who moves closer to each other, so as to end this state of being in a different place.
In comparison, it is naturally more reasonable for Xu Haiyuan to go to the capital. This is an inevitable choice.
After Jiang's parents heard Xu Haiyuan's plan, their impression of Xu Haiyuan became a little better.
This young man is very responsible despite his young age, which is really good.
It was the first time for a girl to bring a partner home, and there was absolutely no reason to stay overnight. Even the Jiang family's parents had a good impression of Xu Haiyuan, so that was not acceptable.
Xu Haiyuan knew the rules well, so after eating at Jiang's house at noon, he chatted with Jiang's father and mother for a while, and then left.
Xu Haiyuan acted decently, advanced and retreated with restraint, which made Jiang's parents fall in love with him after meeting him for the first time.
Jiutai is not far from the provincial capital, and during the winter vacation, Jiang's parents often invite Xu Haiyuan to visit their home, and also allow Jiang Xintian to go to the provincial capital to find Xu Haiyuan.
Waiting until the sixth day of the new year, Xu Shiyan and his wife accompanied their son to Jiang's house with gifts. The parents of both sides met to discuss the children's marriage.
Xu Shiyan and his wife are in Kyrgyzstan, they are also very famous people, and I don’t know how many times they have been interviewed by the media.
When the two sides met, Jiang Chengzhe and his wife recognized each other immediately.
At this time, Jiang Chengzhe and his wife realized Xu Haiyuan's identity.
The husband and wife expressed their feelings again. Xu Haiyuan's family is so wealthy, but he knows the rules and behaves in a gentle and polite manner. He is not at all arrogant and domineering.
Jiang Chengzhe and his wife were already very satisfied with Xu Haiyuan, so what's the point now?
When the parents of both sides meet, it is naturally harmonious, warm and enjoyable.
Jiang Xintian wants to study for graduate school, and Xu Haiyuan wants to study for Ph.D. Both of them happen to be studying for three years.
That's why Xu Shiyan and his wife proposed to get engaged to them after they graduated this summer, and hold the wedding after graduation three years later.
Su Anying also directly stated that Jiang Xintian would look for a job if she wanted to find a job after graduation.
If you don’t want to find a job yourself, you can directly enter the R&D department of Jishengyuan Company. Now the company is short of such high-tech talents.
Anyway, the company will be handed over to Xu Haiyuan in the future, and any arrangements for his own company are reasonable.
As for houses and cars, let alone.
In the past few years, Su Anying has bought a lot of real estate in several big cities such as the capital, Shanghai stock market, Shenzhen stock market, and Yangcheng.
Especially in the capital, in those years Su Anying used the gold found in the cellar to buy a street in the capital.
Now Jishengyuan Company is developing that street, intending to build it into a top shopping area integrating international brand flagship stores, top brand clubs, and high-end shopping centers.
With this condition, what kind of house does Jiang Xintian want?
The Xu family really liked the girl Jiang Xintian, so they showed their utmost sincerity.
The Jiang family is a family of intellectuals.
The Jiang family's husband and wife have only one purpose, as long as Xu Haiyuan treats Jiang Xintian well, the rest are external things, just icing on the cake, and they can't play a decisive role.
In this way, the parents of both parties reached an agreement, and the marriage of the two children was finalized.
Of course, the Xu family didn't hide it, and directly told the Jiang family that the first child of Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian would be named Chu in the future.
As for how many children the young couple will have in the future, it all depends on Jiang Xintian's wishes. If they only want one, that's fine.
After listening to the reason, the Jiang family could understand this point and had no opinion.
Whether or not to have children, how many children, it is all up to the young couple, they can do whatever they want.
Anyway, with the conditions of the Xu family, several children can be afforded.
In late August 2002, Xu Shiyan and his wife invited Jiang Chengzhe's family to the capital, where they held a grand engagement ceremony for Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian.
After the engagement, Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian stayed in the capital to continue their studies.
During his Ph.D. study, Xu Haiyuan managed his own company while studying advanced treatment technologies with his supervisor, and published many academic papers in internationally renowned medical journals.
Some of the content mentioned in the paper has attracted the attention of foreign medical experts.
Xu Haiyuan was therefore invited by a very well-known foreign medical research institute to go abroad for research and study, and participated in some research and experiments on cutting-edge medical technologies.
During the one-and-a-half-year study visit, Xu Haiyuan and the research institute team have overcome medical problems and achieved outstanding academic results.
Xu Haiyuan was favored by many medical research institutions, and offered a high salary to keep him.
Xu Haiyuan rejected the high-paying employment of foreign institutions, and returned to China with the most advanced treatment technology. After completing his doctoral studies, he directly stayed at the school to teach.
At the same time, Jiang Xintian also finished his postgraduate studies, and directly entered the product research and development department of Jishengyuan Company after graduation.
Together with Xu Haiyuan, they will focus on developing new products and lead Jishengyuan to transform into a high-tech pharmaceutical enterprise.
The two have accomplished a lot in their studies, and they are not too young. The parents of both parties are anxious, so they decided to hold the wedding in January of 2006.
Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian's classmates, colleagues, and network of contacts are all in the capital, while most of Xu's relatives and friends are in Kyrgyzstan and their hometown.
To hold a wedding, neither party can be left behind. After discussing with his parents, Xu Haiyuan decided to hold two weddings.
On January 6, 2006, a meeting was held in the capital. Most of the guests were classmates and friends of Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian, the management of Jishengyuan head office, and some connections in the capital and surrounding areas.
Both the Xu family and the Jiang family arranged for representatives of some relatives to attend, but not all of them came.
The wedding in the capital was completed, and the follow-up matters were properly handled. The family returned to Donggang from the capital.
On January 21st, which is the 22nd lunar month, another wedding will be held in Donggang.
The wedding ceremony was held in the Pearl Changbaishan Resort.
After years of development and construction, the humble Guosong Mountain has been built into a domestic first-class tourist and leisure resort.
The resort has a domestic first-class mountain golf course, a natural powder snow ski resort that can hold skiing events, a group of high-end resort hotels, a northeast style folk street, a hot spring swimming and leisure club, and the first super-large water amusement park in China. A leisure and resort center integrating live and play.
In the hearts of Xu Chenghou and other old people, the wedding in the capital is not counted, and this is a serious wedding ceremony at home.
So, this wedding was still held according to the old rules.
It’s just that Jiang’s family is far away, and it’s impossible to go to Jiutai to pick up their relatives on the wedding day, so Jiang’s family arranged them in a five-star hotel in the resort.
On the day of the wedding, the entire resort was festively decorated and lively, with lights and festoons everywhere.
At 8 o'clock in the morning, Xu Haiyuan, accompanied by the groomsmen, set off from the holiday villa on the mountain to pick up the bride at the hotel according to the local wedding rules.
At the hotel, the people from the Jiang family also follow the rules, they should block the door, and they should ask for red envelopes.
Xu Haiyuan led a group of children, passed five trials and defeated six generals, and finally came to the luxury suite where the bride lived.
But at this time, the door of the room could not be closed tightly, Xu Haiyuan was pushed forward by the crowd and shouted loudly.
"Daughter-in-law, open the door, I'm here to pick you up."
"If you don't have a red envelope, you can't open it. If the red envelope is not big enough, you can't open it." Inside the door, several girls from the Jiang family who sent off their relatives laughed and said loudly.
"You don't even open the door, how can we pass the red envelope in?"
Outside the door, Xu Haiyang, Xu Haiqing and others who accompanied the wedding were yelling, trying to trick the people inside to open the door.
"Shove it in from under the door." It's a pity that the person inside was not fooled, and even said to stuff it in through the gap under the door.
"No way, the bottom of the door is too narrow, and the red envelopes are too thick to fit in." Xu Haiqing continued to fool around outside with a smirk on his face.
"How about this, you open the door a crack, how about we stuff the red envelopes in?"
The people inside discussed it and decided to open the door a little so that the red envelope could be stuffed in smoothly.
Unexpectedly, as soon as the door opened, Xu Haiqing pushed the door open with force, protecting his brother and breaking in.
A few girls inside were very upset and were about to explode, Xu Haiqing directly stuffed red envelopes, everyone had one, and inside was 1,000 yuan.
When the girls saw the red envelope, they naturally didn't want to embarrass the groom, so they stepped aside, allowing Xu Haiyuan to come to the bride smoothly.
The wedding dress in the capital was a wedding dress, and I didn’t wear the wedding dress for the second time, so when I came back here, Jiang Xintian wore the traditional dragon and phoenix gown.
Don't underestimate this dress, it was specially made by Su Anying in Suzhou, it is extremely gorgeous and very beautiful.
Of course, Xu Haiyuan is also wearing a Chinese-style dress, a red dress embroidered with gold thread, which makes Xu Haiyuan handsome and extraordinary.
Xu Haiyuan knelt on the ground with one knee, handed the flowers in front of Jiang Xintian, and said loudly, "Daughter-in-law, I'm here to pick you up, come with me."
Jiang Xintian smiled like a flower, and happily stretched out his hands to receive the bouquet. Xu Haiyuan also stood up, leaned over and kissed Jiang Xintian on the lips.
Then the two sat on the bed, and Aunt Jiang brought a bowl of lasagna with poached eggs.
The two of them took a bite of the egg, and then ate the noodles, meaning it, and then took the noodles away.
After that, Xu Jinhui came forward and put on shoes for her sister-in-law, saying auspicious words while putting them on.
Xu Haiqing, as his brother-in-law, came forward to give him a symbolic tug, while still muttering words.
The Jiang family stuffed the red envelopes prepared in advance to the two of them, and they stepped aside.
Xu Haiyuan stepped forward, picked up Jiang Xintian and walked out.
Xu Haiyuan carried his daughter-in-law down the stairs, out of the hotel, and into the car, and all the people who greeted and saw off her relatives got into the car.
Then the convoy circled the resort for a full circle and returned to the Xu family's holiday villa.
As soon as the car stopped, the two hanging firecrackers hanging at the door were lit, and the couple got out of the car with crackling sound.
Su Anying came forward surrounded by everyone, and took the cornucopia from Jiang Xintian's hand.
Jiang Xintian took out a red flower from the basin, put it on Su Anying's head, and called mother affectionately.
"Hey, good, good." Su Anying was very happy, and hurriedly took out a big red envelope from her pocket, and stuffed it into Jiang Xintian's hand.
There are more than 20 such holiday villas in the resort area, and the others have been sold long ago.
This building was specially reserved by Xu Shiyan, just for taking his parents and master to live on the mountain for vacation in summer.
The two-story building covers an area of ​​about 400 square meters. There are many rooms upstairs and downstairs. It is very spacious and well-decorated inside.
The bride and groom enter the door surrounded by everyone, and after meeting with the elders, they go to the new house on the second floor to sit for blessings.
The children of Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao's family rolled around on the bed in the new house, then happily accepted the red envelopes and ran to play.
In the past, the newlyweds just sat there, and relatives and friends came to take pictures together.
But the rules are different now, this has become an early bridal chamber.
The person who videotaped the wedding, together with Xu Haiyuan and his group of friends, made various tricks to tease the bride and groom.
For example, let Xu Haiyuan swallow a shelled melon seed and feed it to Jiang Xintian, then let Jiang Xintian crack open the melon seeds, and then feed the melon seeds to Xu Haiyuan.
What else do I have to say? If you give me money today, I will pay you back next year.
Another example is a couple who use their mouths to peel off the candy wrappers and eat candies together. Anyway, that group of people has a lot of tricks.
Jiang Xintian was already thin-skinned, but his face was even redder when he was teased by these people.
At the other end, a group of young men are still booing, what else are they going to do.
Xu Jinping saw it, and it's not okay to go on like this. Her sister-in-law's face was as red as a red cloth.
"Sun Ning, Huang Shuping, you don't need to keep making noises. You two are going to get married in a few days. When you see, I will make trouble with you two."
It is said that there is no big or small for three days of newlyweds, and you can make troubles as you like, but you can't go too far.
"Also, Brother Shuqing, you are married and have a child as old as you are, so you are also fooling around, right?
Be careful, I will complain to sister-in-law Alina, and let sister-in-law punish you later. "
Xu Jinping and Jiang Xintian used to be best friends, but now they are sister-in-law, so can she not protect Jiang Xintian?
So he stood up and rescued his brother and sister-in-law.
Huang Shuqing left a letter and ran away from home, and did not come back for three years.
At that time, everyone thought that this kid might have encountered some accident outside.
But no one expected that three years later, Huang Shuqing would come back with tens of millions of property and a beautiful Russian girl.
After making trouble for a long time, Huang Shuqing actually thought of a way to leave the country, went to the Far East to dig wild ginseng, and went to the Far East to dig wild ginseng.
This kid is also a little bit capable. He tossed there for three years, earned tens of millions of dollars, and brought back a daughter-in-law.
Now, Huang Shengli and Lihua were so happy that they hurriedly held a wedding for their son.
After the new year, Alina gave birth to a very beautiful mixed-race little boy, who is now seven or eight years old.
Xu Jinping is notoriously pungent, and all these little friends who grew up together know that those boys actually fear her from the bottom of their hearts.
So when Xu Jinping showed his power, the boys who were still booing there just now dared not say a word.
Just in time, someone greeted me at this time, saying that the time is almost up, and the hotel will be open for a while, so I have to hurry over.
Just like that, everyone went downstairs, went out to take the car together, and returned to the hotel.
Xu Shiyan and his wife have been in business for so many years, and they have made countless friends.
Today is the big day for Xu's eldest son to get married. Anyone who knows the news must come.
The banquet hall was full of people, and Xu Shiyan and his wife smiled and chatted with the guests who came to congratulate them.
At 11:18, the ceremony officially began.
With the blessings of the guests, a newlywed couple entered the marriage hall, and they became husband and wife ever since.
After the wedding, Xu Haiyuan and his wife spent the new year at home, and returned to the capital after the year to start their new life.
On October 16th, 2006, the 25th day of the eighth lunar month, Jiang Xintian gave birth to a son in the capital.
According to the original agreement with Chu Xuanhuai, the child was named Chu Sihan.
After Chu Sihan turned one year old, Jiang Xintian returned to the company and also took the Ph.D.
So while studying, he was in charge of the company's R&D department. Together with Xu Haiyuan, he established Jixing Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and devoted himself to the development of various new and special drugs.
At the same time, Jixing Hospital was also officially in operation. Xu Haiyuan served as the president, leading a group of excellent doctors to perform their duties of treating diseases and saving lives.
Xu Haiyuan is also in the process of treating diseases and saving lives, exploring the real method of integrating traditional Chinese and Western medicine to treat diseases, so that more patients can receive the best treatment.
In May 2010, Jiang Xintian became pregnant again, this time the reaction was particularly serious, and later a checkup found that she was pregnant with triplets.
At this time, Jiang Xintian was already thirty, and Xu Haiyuan was so frightened that he sent his daughter-in-law to go home to recuperate and take good care of her.
On February 21, 11, the 19th day of the first lunar month, Jiang Xintian successfully gave birth to two sons and a daughter, named Xu Siyun, Xu Sizhao, and Xu Yixuan.
Since then, Xu Haiyuan has both sons and daughters, and his life is complete.

chapters.title: Chapter 801: Extra Story by Xu Jinping (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 801 Extra Story by Xu Jinping (Part 1)
Xu Jinping was recommended to Peking University because of her excellent performance in the competition.
In 1997, Peking University did not have Yuanpei College, nor did it have science experimental classes. Xu Jinping liked mathematics, so she chose the Department of Mathematics.
It is said that you don’t know until you go to university. What you learned before is not called mathematics, but arithmetic.
And if you choose the Department of Mathematics in a university, it basically turns on the **** mode, and the IQ and brain capacity of ordinary people simply cannot play well.
Xu Jinping can stand out in international competitions and win gold medals with full marks twice in a row. Her strength should not be underestimated.
No matter how difficult the mathematics department is, she can handle it with ease.
This girl was taught by Chu Xuanhuai and Han Wenzhong since she was a child. She is proficient in piano, chess, calligraphy, painting, and boxing.
How can there be a perfect person in this world?
God gave Xu Jinping a super high IQ, but in some aspects, she is so slow that people sigh.
"Hey, fourth child, what do you think of Senior Qin?"
Xu Jinping went to school a year earlier, and her birthday was still young, so she ranked fourth among the four girls in the dormitory, and everyone called her the fourth.
Xu Jinping, who was reading a book, was stunned when she heard the words, "Senior Qin? Which Senior Qin?"
Who? Does she know? Why ask her this question? Xu Jinping was dumbfounded.
The other girls howled when they saw Xu Jinping's expression.
"It's the vice president of your calligraphy and painting club, that Qin Yijing, who is tall and handsome. He is very good at calligraphy and painting, and the one who plays basketball is also very handsome."
"Oh, him, what's the matter?" Xu Jinping tilted her head and thought for a while, before realizing that there was indeed such a person.
"No, people are so kind to you, they always come looking for you, you have to think about who it is?"
The girls were speechless, but anyone with eyes can tell that Senior Qin is interested in their fourth child, okay?
"Our school is so big, and there are quite a few people surnamed Qin. You only say that you are Senior Qin, so I have to think about it?"
Xu Jinping rolled her eyes, obviously they didn't make it clear, okay?
"Also, I haven't been with him often, except for club activities, I met him occasionally.
nice to me? Always come to me? How can I not remember? "
Xu Jinping looked puzzled, why are these crazy women so crazy today?
The girls wailed again, how could there be such a dull girl in the world?
Still meet occasionally? It's obvious that they were waiting on purpose, okay?
"No way, you are too heartless, people have been asking you about your health for so long, and they are very caring.
Bring you breakfast in the morning, bring you an umbrella when it rains, and fetch hot water for you, and take up a place for you in the cafeteria and library, isn’t it good for you? "
The more people talked about it, the more confused Xu Jinping became, "What? Didn't we all meet by chance?
Besides, I can afford breakfast myself, why should he bring it? I have my own umbrella, why should I ask him to give it to me? I can make hot water by myself, I don't need help from others.
Library, cafeteria, those are all accidental encounters. Didn’t he call us to go there? We're all friends, so these seem to be nothing, right? "
Xu Jinping and the others have played with a large group of people since they were young. She has a straightforward personality, just like a tomboy, and she gets along with Sun Ning and Huang Shuping like buddies.
So I really don’t think there is any problem with these.
Xu Jinping thought about it carefully, it seems that there were so many times when she met Qin Yijing in the morning, and he was carrying a meal.
Said it was to bring meals for the students in the dormitory, and bought a copy for Xu Jinping as well.
It seemed that it rained a few times. Indeed, as soon as I got out of the teaching building, I saw Qin Yijing, saying that she happened to be passing by, and asked her if she wanted an umbrella.
Yes, I went to fetch water a few times, and somehow I ran into Qin Yijing, and he had to fight to help fetch water.
But she has never confiscated Qin Yijing's breakfast, and she usually pays attention to the weather, and always has an umbrella in her bag.
As for fetching water, there is usually no one to help. Isn’t she fetching water as well?
And what she refused at that time was that Qin Yijing had to rush over to help fetch water.
"Oh, my Miss Xu, have you ever thought about how far our dormitory building is from them?
Why do you meet each other every time? Isn't that because he deliberately came here to wait for you?
People are chasing you, you really don't know at all, do you? "
This is really the emperor not in a hurry, the **** is in a hurry, how can there be such a girl who is not enlightened? Can't even see the little thoughtfulness of boys?
Xu Jinping shook her head, "I don't know, I didn't feel it."
Actually, Xu Jinping is not to blame for being so slow.
The key point is that she has the kind of sassy and wild temperament, except for her brother Xu Haiyuan in a group of children, she counts what she says.
To put it bluntly, she is a bit of a big sister. The group of boys around her have listened to her since elementary school, not to mention Yang Haoyu's obedient little follower.
She herself went to school early, and her mind was all on her studies.
Other girls are in high school and they are in love for the first time. They like this one, they are optimistic about that one, or they are chasing stars or something.
Xu Jinping is busy training for competitions and participating in competitions everywhere.
And during the most sensitive years of adolescence, the girl was always accompanied by Yang Haoyu, her own brother.
So she is not interested in the attraction between boys and girls at all, and she is very nervous.
Hearing what her roommate said at this moment, Xu Jinping was in disbelief.
It turns out that these mean that boys want to chase girls, well, she has no experience.
"Then what do you mean by that? He's fine? Should I accept it?"
"Nonsense, he has a handsome parent, good grades, outstanding abilities in all aspects, and it is said that his family background is also very good.
You don’t accept this, what else do you want? "
The other three girls wanted to rush up and strangle Xu Jinping to death. Such a good boy didn't know how to cherish it.
Xu Jinping curled her lips and snorted.
Handsome? Can he be more handsome than those three in her family?
Not to mention elder brother Xu Haiyuan and third younger brother Yang Haoyu, even Xu Haiqing, the youngest in her family, can beat Qin Yijing three blocks away.
good grades? No matter how good he can be better than his elder brother? Can it compare to Yang Haoyu? Still can compare to her?
On family background? hehe.
What are you looking for? Xu Jinping racked her brains and couldn't think of this question.
It seems that if you don't compare yourself with these few in your own family, the one surnamed Qin is just fine.
"Come on, don't discuss these nonsense issues.
Let's get serious, what do you want to do this summer?
It just so happens that I don’t have any competitions this year, or else follow me back to the Northeast, and I’ll take you to climb Changbai Mountain.
My house is very comfortable in summer, suitable for escaping the heat. I can also take you rafting, soaking in hot springs and so on, it's all fun.
There are many delicious foods over there, I guarantee you will like it. "
This kind of thing is more troublesome than math problems, let's put it aside, she is too lazy to deal with it.
After Xu Jinping went to college, she often participated in math competitions for college students and won many awards.
At present, she has received an invitation letter from a well-known university in the beautiful country, inviting her to go to graduate school.
So this summer, Xu Jinping wanted to be lazy, instead of participating in any competitions, why not go home and have a good rest, and spend time with her grandparents.
Sure enough, when Xu Jinping said this, the three girls immediately forgot whether Qin Yijing was Qin Jingyi.
With a cry of surprise, they all rushed to Xu Jinping's side and hugged him directly.
"Fourth brother, you are the best.
Oh, whoever is diligent and lazy, let's go, such a good girl Xu, let us leave it. "
"Don't, I'm afraid your boyfriend will be unhappy." Xu Jinping laughed.
"You can bring your family members with you, so that you don't worry about being afraid that I will sell you."
There are four people in the dormitory, only Xu Jinping has no match.
That's it, everyone agreed to go to the Northeast for the summer vacation.
That Qin Yijing got the news somehow, so he had to follow along.
Xu Jinping didn't say anything, and just followed if she wanted to. There are so many people, and his pair of chopsticks are not bad.
The holiday time of each college is not too different, and it happens that Yang Haoyu is also on holiday after the final exam.
So a large group of people set off from the capital to Changbai Mountain.
At home, Xu Shiyan received a call from his daughter, saying that she wanted to bring some classmates back to play.
Xu Shiyan didn't care too much, just play, young people have nothing to do, it's normal to make friends.
So according to my daughter's wishes, I asked someone to reserve a few rooms in the hotel.
In the past few years, Xu Shiyan has not only developed the Pearl Resort on Guosong Mountain, but also redeveloped the scope of the participating companies, building a lot of hotels, shopping malls, leisure places and so on.
At present, only a small part has been developed. In the future, they may cooperate with Guo Shouye and others to develop both Songjiang River and Donggang.
Relying on the tourism advantages of Changbai Mountain, create a tourism industry with regional characteristics.
At first, Xu Shiyan really didn't think much about it, but after his daughter came back with her classmates, Xu Shiyan realized that something was wrong.
"Daughter-in-law, have you noticed that kid surnamed Qin? Why does he always hang around our daughter?
I looked at him as if he had no good intentions. Did he have an interest in our daughter and wanted to chase her? "
Xu Shiyan was in a hurry now, and couldn't sleep at night, so he would make pancakes on the kang.
"Oh, I said, are you annoying? How old is our daughter?
She is twenty-one this year, and she will be in her junior year in the fall, and she will graduate in the summer of the following year.
Then why don't you want someone to date you? "
Su Anying was so tossed back and forth by Xu Shiyan that she lost sleepiness, so she sat up and turned on the light, glaring at the people around her.
"What's the rush when you're only 21? My daughter, even if I don't find a partner for the rest of my life, I can afford it.
What is that Qin thing? How come I didn't see him being a playful, hippie-smiling face all day long?
What kind of eyes does our daughter have, how can she look like this? "
Xu Shiyan became anxious when he heard this, so he sat up and said loudly.
In Xu Shiyan's eyes, anyone who covets his daughter is not a good person.
He cultivated it meticulously for more than 20 years, and managed to grow a pot of precious orchids. As a result, a shriveled calf appeared out of nowhere, and he wanted to remove the pot and the flowers.
How can this work? He didn't break the shriveled calf's leg, so he was considered a man of grace.
"What's the use of being anxious with me?
How is Xiao Qin, is it useful for us to talk? Isn't it because our daughter is optimistic about it? "
Su Anying actually didn't like Qin Yijing either. From a woman's intuition, this kid doesn't seem so reliable.
With a word from the daughter-in-law, Xu Shiyan immediately put out the fire.
Yeah, what kind of partner to find, that is the girl's freedom, parents can express their opinions, but they cannot interfere.
Back when Xu Jinfeng led his partner home, Xu Shixian and Zhou Guilan acted like demons, but Xu Shiyan persuaded him like that.
Now it's my turn, so what I can't say doesn't count, right?
"No, find a time, we have to talk to our daughter.
I'm not optimistic about that surnamed Qin. I always feel that he is unreliable, and I can't find someone like that when looking for a partner. "
Xu Shiyan sat there thinking for a long time, and finally muttered this sentence.
Xu Chenghou also had the same idea as Xu Shiyan.
The old man couldn't sleep at night, and he was also muttering to Zhou Guilan there.
"Our Pingping brought back those classmates this time, and I saw that they were all one-on-one.
Only the kid surnamed Qin seems to be interested in our Pingping no matter how you look at it.
When you have time, you can ask Yingzi, is our Pingping dating that kid?
Why do I think that kid doesn't look like a good person? We, Pingping, don't be fooled. "
"Well, I think so too, that kid must have no good intentions.
But I saw that Pingping didn't seem to have that kind of interest in him, maybe she was chasing our granddaughter. No, I don't like that kid. "
On this point, Zhou Guilan and Xu Chenghou agreed.
That is to say, before Qin Yijing officially confessed his love to Xu Jinping, he was already kicked out by the elders of the Xu family.
Xu Jinping's classmates played here for five or six days.
As the head of the Xu family, Yang Haoyu naturally wants to do his best as a landlord and accompany him throughout the journey as a matter of course.
I dare not say anything else. In Changbai Mountain, Xu Shiyan's words are still useful.
Regardless of the west **** or the north slope, you can directly enter the scenic spot, with a special car with a guide, and VIP treatment throughout the journey.
Not to mention rafting and hot springs, they are all owned by the family, so you can play however you want.
Arrange the best hotel, eat all kinds of delicacies, and arrange a bonfire party and roast whole lamb in the villa at night.
Xu Shiyan doesn't like Qin Yijing, and doesn't like him always coming to his daughter's side.
So people specially called Huang Shuyun, Huang Shuping, Zhao Lili, Zhao Yanyan, Yang Lihua, Sun Yu, Sun Ning, Feng Bin, Feng Tao, Han Zhenan, Han Zhenyuan, Han Zhenhong and other young people to play together.
Xu Shiyan was still not at ease, so he simply called Huang Shengli, Zhao Jianshe, Han Limin, Han Lixin, Li Chengrong and other old brothers over, and they joined a table to drink.
With the elders in front of them, these children were a little reluctant to let go at first.
But after drinking some wine in the back, everyone was having a good time.
Xu Shiyan and his wife found an opportunity, so they called their daughter away, and the three of them talked and chatted in a box in the villa.
"Girl, you have been with your classmates these few days, and your parents haven't had a chance to chat with you.
I heard they are leaving tomorrow? Dad wants to ask you something. "Xu Shiyan coughed twice and opened his mouth.
Xu Jinping froze for a moment, "Dad, just ask if you have anything to say, I'm your daughter, what else can I say?"
"Well, let me ask you, what does that kid surnamed Qin have to do with you? Are you two dating?"
Xu Shiyan still couldn't hold back and asked.
Xu Jinping pondered for a moment before speaking, "Dad, I heard from three people in our dormitory that Qin Yijing was chasing me.
I didn’t feel anything. Anyway, this person is okay, and the conditions are all justified.
It happens that you and my mother are checking him out. If you think he is okay, then I will give him a chance to try everything. "
Maybe it's because I didn't get the hang of it? Xu Jinping felt that it didn't matter whether she was in love or not, and she never expected anything from it.
In those TV novels, the hero and heroine love each other to the death, isn’t that actually the case? It's just two suitable people living together.
Where are there so many romances in real life? Where is the love that will never change until death?
Most people just scrape together to live together.
However, Xu Shiyan obviously didn't hear what the girl meant.
In Xu Shiyan's opinion, the daughter should also have taken a fancy to the kid surnamed Qin.
It's just that his daughter is sensible and obedient, and respects her parents' opinions, so she brought it back first for the family to see.
"It's okay, it's okay, just that kid, he can't even compare to my daughter's hair.
The toad wants to eat swan meat, but he still wants to chase after my daughter? He is beautiful. "
Xu Shiyan's voice was raised several degrees, and he said angrily.
"No, girl, this kid is really not good, he is too far behind you.
If you choose him, you might not be as good as Xiaoyu, Xiaoyu is a hundred times stronger than him. "
Xu Shiyan didn't think much about the latter words, he just wanted to find a reference for comparison, and then he said Yang Haoyu was here.
But when he said this, Xu Shiyan's eyes lit up first, yes, why did he ignore Yang Haoyu?
This child grew up in front of their husband and wife. He is familiar with his temper, temperament and living habits.
The Yang family and the Xu family are close friends, it can be said that they have a family friendship.
Yang Junxian and Ji Yufeng knew all about their tempers, and Xu Jinping was crazy about those two.
If Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu can succeed, and the son-in-law becomes the son-in-law, how wonderful it will be?
"Daughter-in-law, do you think this makes sense?
Xiaoyu is a hundred times better than the kid surnamed Qin regardless of his character, appearance, knowledge, and family background. I looked at it, he was the best. "
In order not to let his daughter be with the boy surnamed Qin, Xu Shiyan also went all out, preferring to make his daughter and Qianer a pair.
Su Anying was taken aback by her husband's words, but after thinking about it, there was really no one more suitable than Yang Haoyu.
Before Su Anying could speak, Xu Jinping rushed to speak.
"Dad, you are getting old, are you confused?
Xiaoyu is our family, he is the third child of our family, and he entered our ranking. "
Xu Jinping stared wide-eyed and looked at his father in surprise.
Can this be fooled around? She has always regarded Yang Haoyu as her younger brother, how can she bring her sister and younger brother together? Playing the piano randomly, isn't it?
"What? Those are the rules of the old society, and now the new society doesn't care about the old etiquette.
You two are not related by blood, you can get married legally. "
Xu Shiyan also went all out to prevent his daughter from being with Qin Yijing.
If this is the adoptive son who was placed in the ranking before, it would be similar to parent-child, and it is true that they cannot be married.
At this time, if you live in some clan villages in the south, you still value those old rules.
But in the Northeast, most people really don't care about that.
There is no blood relationship, and legally it is not a close relative marriage, so there is no problem.
If there was no such thing as Qin Yijing, Xu Shiyan would never have thought of Yang Haoyu. He always regarded Yang Haoyu as his own child.
But as soon as this idea came up, Xu Shiyan felt that there was no one in this world more suitable to be the uncle of the Xu family than Yang Haoyu.
"Dad, I think you are crazy about my uncle."
Xu Jinping rolled her eyes speechlessly, feeling that her father was in trouble.
"Xiaoyu has been in our house since he was a child. I regard him as my younger brother, and I have protected him since he was a child.
Do you remember what he was like when he was a child? Thin and weak, soft-tempered, and often bullied, it was me and my brother who stood up for him.
For him, I fought with those brats all day long in Yuhong Class.
That little follower, clingy, loves to follow me since he was a child. If I didn’t kick him to Tsinghua University, he would still follow me.
You let me follow him? What are you kidding?
I'm looking for a husband, someone who I can rely on and give me a sense of security, not a younger brother for myself, but I have to protect him. "
Xu Jinping shook her head while talking.
Be Yang Haoyu's older sister, his wife? It always feels weird, so forget it, I can’t stand it.
"You also said, it was when Xiaoyu was a child.
Look at him now, he is a big man of 1.85 meters, tall and strong, isn't that more than enough to protect you?
I think you two are quite suitable, much better than that kid surnamed Qin. "Xu Shiyan glanced at his daughter, and sat there muttering.
"Okay, I won't talk nonsense with you.
Since you guys are not optimistic about Qin Yijing, forget it, I didn't say it was him.
But I can say yes, don't give me a moth, mess up the mandarin ducks.
Don’t say anything to Xiaoyu, and don’t let Uncle Yang and Aunt Yang know. "
Xu Jinping got angry with her father, so she simply stopped talking with her parents, got up and went out.
As a result, Xu Jinping just stretched out her hand and opened the door of the box when she saw Yang Haoyu standing outside the door.
"Xiaoyu, when did you come?"
Damn, Xiaoyu won't hear what you said just now, right?
Don't, she was just angry with her parents just now, she definitely didn't mean to slander or belittle anyone.
"Just arrived, they were drunk and said they were going to dance. But when they turned their heads and couldn't see you, I came to look for you.
What's wrong with you? Did you drink too much? If you don't feel well, I'll send you to rest. "
Yang Haoyu said while raising his hand to touch Xu Jinping's forehead.
Most of them in this generation are like this, they will touch their foreheads when they ask if they are comfortable or not.
In fact, there are many problems. I don’t have a fever, and I can’t feel anything when I touch my forehead.
"It's okay, let's go, let's play."
Xu Jinping was a little guilty, so she dragged Yang Haoyu and hurried outside.
At this moment, in the open space outside the villa, most of the bonfire has been burned, leaving only red charcoal fire.
The aroma of roasted whole lamb still lingers in the air, and the young people over there who drank a lot of wine are singing and dancing happily.
Qin Yijing came here, always wanting to show himself well.
So he didn't drink much tonight, and he didn't sing and dance and shout and shout like everyone else, but just sat there quietly, sipping drinks and watching other people play.
Qin Yijing raised his head abruptly, just in time to see Xu Jinping dragging Yang Haoyu out of the room together.
The scene in front of him made his eyes darken, and his face turned cold.
Originally, I wanted to finish writing in one go, but I found out that it was too late, and I couldn’t write so much.

chapters.title: Chapter 802: Extra Story by Xu Jinping (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 802 Extra Story by Xu Jinping (Part 2)
Qin Yijing had heard it mentioned before, and knew of Yang Haoyu's existence.
That is the godson of the Xu family, who grew up with Xu Jinping since he was a child. It is said that Xu Jinping regards him as his own younger brother.
But after getting in touch these days, Qin Yijing always felt something was wrong.
There is an indescribable feeling between Xu Jinping and her younger brother.
Xu Jinping took special care of her younger brother, and never allowed anyone to say a bad word, and especially doted on him.
As for that Yang Haoyu, he was obedient and considerate to Xu Jinping.
What Xu Jinping wanted, she didn't even need to say a word, she didn't even need to look in the eyes, she could understand it and deliver it accurately.
In Qin Yijing's view, this is simply unbelievable, and the twins' telepathy is not so powerful.
These two people give people the feeling that no one can disassemble them or insert them.
This feeling was too bad, so Qin Yijing felt an eyesore when looking at Yang Haoyu, and hated him very much.
"Jinping, where did you go just now? We were looking for you to dance with."
Qin Yijing stood up, walked towards Xu Jinping quickly, and raised his hand to grab Xu Jinping's hand.
Yang Haoyu exerted a little force on his side, and pulled Xu Jinping to his side, avoiding Qin Yijing's hand just in time.
"Come on, sister, let's go play."
Yang Haoyu ignored Qin Yijing, dragged Xu Jinping directly and ran into the crowd, and the big guys gathered around the campfire hand in hand.
Qin Yijing just wanted to chase after him, but was stopped by Xu Haiqing and Han Zhenyuan who dragged him to the other side.
"Brother Qin, there are few people here, come here, let's go together."
Xu Shiyan secretly assigned a task to his youngest son, which was to try to prevent Qin Yijing from contacting Xu Jinping.
Xu Haiqing, a ghostly kid, can't see what's going on?
In his eyes, Qin Yijing is not even a fart, how dare he miss his eldest sister? What spring and autumn dreams are you doing?
Therefore, Xu Haiqing performed the task very seriously, but whenever he saw Qin Yijing, he wanted to go to his sister's side and keep the past to make trouble.
So, this night, Qin Yijing couldn't even touch Xu Jinping's side, which made Qin Yijing very depressed.
Others don't know Qin Yijing's depression, everyone is having fun.
Everyone sang and danced together until the bonfire went out and the night deepened.
After playing for a day, I was also tired, so those who should go back to the hotel should go back to the hotel, and those who should go home should go home.
I had so much fun this day, everyone was tired, and after drinking a little wine, I slept soundly at night.
Only Qin Yijing tossed and turned all night unable to fall asleep.
The boy who happened to be in the same room with him snored while sleeping.
Wait until the next day, everyone else woke up full of energy, but Qin Yijing was the only one with dark circles under his eyes, as haggard as he could be.
This group of people has been playing in Donggang for five or six days, which is enough, so why not leave?
Everyone discussed and decided to leave tomorrow. At
I went to the station to buy tickets together in the morning, and planned to do nothing in the afternoon, take a good rest and leave tomorrow.
Qin Yijing actually didn't want to leave so early, he came this time just to take the opportunity to get in touch with Xu Jinping more, and to confess his love to her.
Nothing has been done now, where are you willing to go? But the big guys came together, and they all have to leave, how could he have the nerve to say stay?
In the afternoon, while others were resting, Qin Yijing called Xu Jinping and wanted to ask her out, and the two of them had a chat.
As a result, it was Xu Haiqing who answered the phone, and Qin Yijing was told that Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu had something to go out.
Qin Yijing just hung up the phone and went back to the room, not long after, the hotel waiter came over and said that someone was looking for him.
Qin Yijing thought it was Xu Jinping who had come, and happily ran to the hotel lobby, but he didn't see Xu Jinping at all.
"Mr. Qin, right? Mr. Xu asked me to pick you up."
A man in a white shirt and trousers came over and asked politely.
Mr. Xu, of course we are talking about Xu Shiyan.
After coming here, Qin Yijing knew the background and strength of the Xu family.
In the beginning, Qin Yijing was interested in Xu Jinping because of her good figure, good looks, and both talents and looks.
If you have such a girlfriend, how much face will you bring out.
The flower of Peking University School of Mathematics, the absolute elite of academic masters, I don’t know how many people envy her.
Waiting to get here, Qin Yijing is determined to win Xu Jinping.
The daughter of the Dongfang Ginseng Group Company in Kyrgyzstan Province, if she is married, she will be married to a golden mountain. She will save 30 years of struggle, and a fool will let go.
At the moment Qin Yijing learned that Xu Shiyan was looking for him, he was ecstatic and nodded quickly.
"Yes, I am. I don't know where Mr. Xu is?"
Is this the future father-in-law who wants to see him? Qin Yijing hurriedly lowered his head to look at his body, it seemed that it was not very formal.
"Uh, do I need to go back and change?"
"No need, Mr. Xu is very busy, he is in the office."
The visitor glanced at Qin Yijing, and spoke in a lukewarm manner. "Please come with me."
Just like that, Qin Yijing followed the other party to the outside of the hotel, got in the car, went straight to the headquarters building of Shenye Company, and came to the chairman and general manager's office.
"President Xu, the person you want to meet has arrived."
"Oh, let him in." Xu Shiyan didn't even raise his head, but only responded.
The staff led Qin Yijing into the office, and Xu Shiyan looked up.
"Sit down, I'll deal with the documents in my hand. Xiao Zhou, make a pot of tea."
The secretary directed Qin Yijing to sit in the reception area over there, and then boiled water and made tea.
The three of them didn't speak, except for the sound of boiling water, there was only the sound of Xu Shiyan flipping through the documents.
Sitting there, Qin Yijing suddenly felt very stuffy, a little out of breath.
Xu Shiyan is the leader of a provincial enterprise after all. Although he always says that he is an old farmer, in fact, the change of status and contact circle will change the temperament of the person himself.
Qin Yijing is just a student in an ivory tower, from a well-to-do family, how did he go through such a situation?
It's normal to feel hairy and depressed.
The water was boiled to make tea, and the secretary withdrew.
Xu Shiyan flipped through the documents for a few more minutes, then put down the things in his hands, got up and walked to the reception area, and sat face to face with Qin Yijing.
"I'm sorry, I have some things to deal with at the moment, and I wasted your time."
"No, no, Uncle Xu, you are busy, I know." Qin Yijing said hurriedly with his heart skipping a beat.
Xu Shiyan didn't look at Qin Yijing, but just lowered his head and played with the teacup in front of him.
"Student Xiao Qin, I think you should be able to guess why I brought you here today?"
Qin Yijing suddenly felt his heart jumping into his throat.
"Uncle Xu, I, I really like Jinping. Please give me a chance."
Xu Shiyan raised his head, glanced at Qin Yijing, and smiled.
"Really? What do you like about her?
Do you like her good-looking, outstanding talent, or do you like me as a father behind her? "
Qin Yijing almost jumped up in fright, "No, it's not, Uncle Xu.
Jinping is gentle, kind, and innocent. I like her. "
"Hehe, gentle, kind, innocent? Are you talking about my daughter?
When she was four or five years old, she dared to fight with boys, biting them until she cried.
In junior high school, gangsters blocked the girl in her class from doing things. She was able to go up with a stick and beat them away.
You say she is hot, sharp, and capable, and I believe it, but you say she is gentle?
Young man, it seems that you have never really understood her, and you still say that you really like her? "
Xu Shiyan shook his head, his eldest daughter is indeed excellent, but she definitely has nothing to do with gentleness.
You can tell just by looking at Xu Haiqing, never daring to jump in front of his sister, that is a painful lesson.
Qin Yijing's face turned pale, and he didn't know how to answer.
"No, I really like her. Jinping is definitely not like what you said at school."
"I don't care if you really like him or not, but I can tell you clearly that you are not within our family's consideration.
Not only me, but our whole family, no one recognizes you.
So, I hope you will take the initiative to stay away from my daughter, and stop appearing in front of her and disturbing her life. "
Xu Shiyan is too lazy to continue talking with Qin Yijing. A superficial boy who only looks at his face is not good enough for his daughter.
Roll as far as you can, so you don’t have to worry about watching it.
"Uncle Xu, you can't do this, Jinping can invite me because she also likes me.
I just haven't had time to confess to her, you have no right to stop others from liking her, let alone destroy her love and happiness. "
Qin Yijing was in a hurry, stood up abruptly, and said angrily.
"Young man, don't say those high-sounding words that even you don't believe.
How did you get here? Did my niece invite you? That's obviously the one who followed you with a brazen face. "
Xu Shiyan chuckled, leaned back on the back of the sofa, and looked at Qin Yijing leisurely.
"Leave obediently, don't pester her anymore, and each of you will be safe in the future.
If you still insist on saying you like her and refuse to let go, keep pestering her.
Hehe, you may not be able to accept the consequences.
Don’t say it’s in Kyrgyzstan, even if it’s the capital, if I want you to disappear, you won’t even be able to make a splash, do you believe it? "
I really thought he was a fool all these years, even if the participating company is no longer a state-owned enterprise, his words are still easy to use.
Qin Yijing's face turned pale from fright, and cold sweat broke out on his back.
He believes that the energy behind the boss of a provincial enterprise is immeasurable.
This kind of person can enjoy himself in any aspect. Dealing with a student like him who has no background is really easier than crushing an ant to death.
"Young man, think carefully and don't make trouble for yourself."
Xu Shiyan got up, returned to his desk, and shouted, "Xiao Zhou, see off the guests."
Secretary Xiao Zhou came in from the outside and made a gesture of invitation.
Seeing that Qin Yijing was still standing there, he pushed Qin Yijing away halfway.
Qin Yijing was sent back to the hotel in a daze, and the group left the next morning.
The Xu family prepared a lot of special products for everyone, and arranged a car to take them to the train station.
After seeing off the classmates, Xu Jinping was accompanying her grandparents and teacher, watching her younger siblings study.
Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing are about to enter their third year of high school. Xu Jinhui is okay with good grades, but Xu Haiqing's grades can only be described in one word, which is bad.
Xu Jinping acted like a elder sister, cleaned up Xu Haiqing, and then stared at him every day to study and do papers.
Time passed by in a hurry, and in the blink of an eye the summer vacation passed, Xu Jinping had to go back to school and start her junior year.
After returning to school, Qin Yijing really didn't show up again, and Xu Jinping didn't care, it's best if no one bothers you.
University life has returned to calm, and Xu Jinping can study at ease again.
But to everyone's surprise, Yang Haoyu actually signed up to be a soldier in the winter of his junior year.
Before leaving, Yang Haoyu only said this to Xu Jinping.
"Sister, from now on, let me protect you."
As soon as Xu Jinping heard this, she realized that Yang Haoyu must have heard her words in the villa that day.
Xu Jinping regretted it to death. If she hadn't said that at the time, Yang Haoyu wouldn't have dropped his studies and gone to the army.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu have been together since childhood, almost inseparable.
Although the university is not in the same school, we can meet each other on weekends.
However, Yang Haoyu has been away for two years and cannot contact his family at will, let alone go home to visit relatives. Xu Jinping feels empty and uncomfortable.
At this time, Xu Jinping finally understood, as if Yang Haoyu held a very important place in her heart.
In July 2001, Xu Jinping graduated from university and went to the beautiful country to study for a doctorate.
Yang Haoyu performed well in the army. In 2002, he retired from the army and returned to school with two second-class merits and two third-class merits.
In 2003, Yang Haoyu completed his undergraduate studies and went directly to the National University of Defense Technology.
At the beginning of January 2006, Xu Jinping completed her credits ahead of schedule, got her Ph.D., and won a Young Mathematician Award.
She rejected the employment of many foreign companies and institutions, accepted the letter of employment from Peking University, and returned to China.
"Sister, this way."
At the airport pick-up gate, Xu Jinhui, Xu Haiqing, Yang Haoyu and others all looked inside anxiously.
After finally seeing a familiar figure, everyone hurriedly waved their hands.
The bulky luggage had already been mailed back to China, and Xu Jinping only carried a suitcase and a bag on her back.
Seeing her younger brothers and sisters, Xu Jinping trotted to the front of the crowd, dropped the suitcase, and hugged them one by one.
"Oh, I'm finally back, these past few years have really missed me.
After five years of walking, Huihui hasn't changed much, she's still the same. "
Xu Jinping was the first to hug Xu Jinhui. The two sisters hugged each other and almost cried.
Seeing the 25-year-old soon, slim and outstandingly beautiful younger sister, Xu Jinping was also full of joy.
"Stinky boy, why do I feel that you are taller than when I left? In the past few years, you have cultivated a lot more calmly."
Xu Jinping stood in front of Xu Haiqing, who was 1.86 meters tall, looking at her younger brother who was much calmer in front of her, full of joy.
"Sister, you still think of me as a child. I will be twenty-five after Chinese New Year, can I still be as naughty as I was when I was a child?"
Xu Haiqing reached out and gave her sister a big bear hug.
"Sister, this is the third brother, can you still recognize him?"
Xu Haiqing hugged her sister, then let go immediately, and stepped aside, pointing at Yang Haoyu and said.
Xu Jinping glanced at the person in front of her and smiled, "I know the person who grew up with him even if he turns into ashes."
Saying this on the lips, but there are all kinds of sighs in my heart.
After six years of separation, if we say that the person who has changed the most is Yang Haoyu.
The facial features are still the same, and the stature is still so tall, but the feeling is completely different.
Two years in the army and two and a half years in the military academy, Yang Haoyu's temperament has undergone earth-shaking changes.
Standing upright like a pine, with firm eyes, just standing there gives people an infinite sense of security.
Yang Haoyu is now a graduate student and assigned to an information technology engineering unit.
To pick up the airport today, he didn't wear a uniform, but casual clothes.
Beige gray cashmere coat with a beige sweater.
If you wear it on someone else, it will be a literary fan Xiaoqing.
But when worn on Yang Haoyu's body, it has a distinctive calmness and ability, giving people a sense of reliability.
Yang Haoyu was also looking at Xu Jinping at this time.
I haven't seen her in six years. The girl who was heroic and not inferior to a man at the beginning, restrained the sharpness between her brows, grew her long hair again, and her whole body became warm and moist.
He is 1.7 meters tall, wearing a pair of half-heeled leather shoes, and an off-white long, slim-fitting coat.
Even more slender, intellectual and elegant, a typical urban beauty and elite in the workplace.
"Sister, welcome back to China." Yang Haoyu stretched out his arms, took two steps forward, and hugged the person he had been thinking about for six years.
"Thank you, it's rare that you are so busy and still find time to pick me up."
Xu Jinping reached out, hugged Yang Haoyu as well, and patted him on the back.
"Let's go, the car is parked outside, brother has a wedding the day after tomorrow, and there are many things to be busy."
Over there, Xu Haiqing was carrying her sister's suitcase, Xu Jinhui came over and held her sister's arm, and the group went straight to the parking lot.
Xu Haiqing drove his brothers and sisters back to his house in the capital.
On January 6th, Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian will hold a wedding in the capital.
Xu Shiyan, his wife, Nan Zhendong and others are all busy in Xu Haiqing's big courtyard.
"Dad, Mom, I'm back." Xu Jinping started shouting as soon as she entered the second door, all the way to the backyard.
Xu Shiyan and Su Anying hurried out of the room when they heard their daughter's movement.
Su Anying stepped forward and hugged her daughter.
"My good girl, I'm finally back. You said you've been away for four and a half years, and everyone at home misses you."
As Su Anying spoke, tears fell.
In the past, whether my daughter was in the provincial capital or the capital city, she could go home for winter and summer vacations, and they could go and have a look when they were free.
It was a good time this time. I ran to the other side of the ocean and didn't come back for several years.
The couple are burdened with heavy burdens and have no time to go abroad to see their daughter. They have been relying on the phone for the past four and a half years.
On the other end, Xu Shiyan, who was in his fifties, also had tears in his eyes.
"Look at you, how wonderful it is for my daughter to come back, why are you crying?"
Xu Shiyan tried to persuade his daughter-in-law, but couldn't help but raise his hand to wipe away the tears from the corners of his eyes.
"It's good to come back, I won't leave this time, right?"
Xu Jinping accepted the letter of appointment from Peking University, the family already knew about it, but Xu Shiyan couldn't help but ask.
"Well, I'm not leaving, I will settle down in the capital from now on." Xu Jinping wiped away the tears on her face, and smiled at her father.
"Dad, you are so old, you have gray hair."
After leaving for many years, my parents have already stained their temples with frost, and the years make people old. In the future, it is time to spend more time with my parents.
"Okay, it's fine if you don't leave. Second sister, second brother-in-law, let's go into the room to talk. It's cold, and the child is not used to it when he just came back."
Nan Zhendong and his wife were over there, with tears in their eyes, and hurriedly called everyone into the house.
The courtyard houses bought by the Xu family have been remodeled a long time ago. There is heating in winter, so the house is warm.
Everyone entered the room, sat down and chatted, Xu Shiyan and his wife asked here and there, asking what was going on with their daughter outside.
The most important thing is whether the daughter has a partner outside.
During the past few years when my daughter went abroad, Xu Shiyan was most worried about one thing, what if the daughter brought back a foreign son-in-law?
Back then, he was able to scare the kid surnamed Qin away because the girl didn't have such a person in her heart.
But this time is different, my daughter is out alone, in case she gets lonely and wants to find someone to accompany her, she will meet a handsome blond and blue-eyed guy.
The two saw each other right away, so what's the matter?
Xu Shiyan has been in fear for several years, but now he is finally looking forward to the return of his daughter, and she comes back alone.
I let go of more than half of this hanging heart.
Of course, what should be inquired has to be inquired. Xiaoyu has been waiting here. Will these two children get together?
