"Girl, you have been doing well outside these few years? Are you used to it? Are you not alone?"
Xu Shiyan inquired carefully, beating around the bush. While asking, his gaze was still drifting towards Yang Haoyu.
"Dad, if you want to ask me if I have a partner, if I have found you a foreign son-in-law, you can just ask."
Xu Jinping couldn't laugh or cry. With his father's narrow-mindedness, could he still hide it from her?
You don’t need to be so cautious, just ask directly.
"Hey, it has to be my daughter, she knows me best."
Xu Shiyan, relying on his old face and thick skin, laughed when he was exposed by his daughter.
"I'm not thinking about it, we have plenty of good guys in China, why do we have to look outside, right?"
Xu Shiyan said while winking at Yang Haoyu, who is a good guy, needless to say.
"I didn't find it, your daughter and I are traditional Chinese, and I don't like those blonde foreigners.
Furthermore, I'm busy, how can I care about dating? "
Doing a PhD abroad is based on the credit system. In order to come back sooner, Xu Jinping repeatedly compressed the time.
Most people take five or six years to get a doctoral degree, but she got it in four and a half years.
She is doing research, working on projects, publishing papers, and awarding awards over there. She can't wait to spend all the time eating and sleeping, so how can she have someone to spend time with?
Xu Shiyan was very happy when he heard this, "Ahem, there are some people, you need to hold on tighter."
These words are clearly aimed at Yang Haoyu.
Before Xu Jinping came back, Xu Shiyan had a private conversation with Yang Haoyu.
The content of the conversation between the two fathers is unknown to others, but Xu Shiyan's attitude towards Yang Haoyu is more cordial anyway.
Xu Jinping came back from abroad, so of course it was time to celebrate.
It happened that Jiang's family was also in the capital, and everyone ignored the old rules, so they arranged two tables in the high-end restaurant run by the family to celebrate Xu Jinping's return from school together.
On the 6th, Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian held a wedding ceremony in the capital. After finishing the ceremony here, the whole family hurried back to the northeast.
Xu Chenghou and his wife, Su Weizhong and his wife, as well as Chu Xuanhuai and others, were also very happy to see Xu Jinping come back.
The relatives at home are all back, and it is very lively.
On January 21st, Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian held an extremely grand wedding in the resort area of ​​their hometown.
At the wedding banquet, the group of boys started to toasting noisyly again, shouting that they must get Xu Haiyuan drunk to prevent him from entering the bridal chamber.
Xu Haiyuan is a doctor and a cardiothoracic surgeon.
It may be in the impression of others that surgeons can drink alcohol, and drink a lot, but in fact most doctors rarely drink alcohol.
Occasionally, it’s fine to drink a little on special occasions. What if they really make them drink so hard that it hurts Xu Haiyuan’s brain?
So, Xu Haiyang, Xu Haiqing, Yang Haoyu, Nan Xiaoming, Ji Hongliang and other unmarried buddies all dispatched to block the wine for Xu Haiyuan.
As Xu Haiyuan's younger brother, Yang Haoyu was also a soldier. He is the one who holds the best drink, and he has really blocked Xu Haiyuan a lot.
In order to prevent these people from making trouble in the bridal chamber at night, Xu Jinping gave an idea to go directly down the mountain to Songjiang River and hire a KTV to sing.
Those young people who yelled that they were going to have a bridal chamber at night, they sang at the top of their voices when they went to the karaoke hall, howling wolves while drinking, and temporarily forgot about the bridal chamber.
Xu Haiyuan's elementary school classmates share a room, middle school classmates share a room, and everyone else shares a room. The big guys are separated.
Xu Haiyuan and Jiang Xintian sat in each box and sang a song or two.
Then Xu Jinping asked Xu Haiqing and the others to stay and play with them. She and Yang Haoyu covered up her brother and sister-in-law's escape, and drove her brother and sister-in-law back to the holiday villa on the mountain.
In order not to disturb the newlyweds, the villa on the mountain was used as their new house.
"Brother and sister-in-law, you two should rest early, we are going down the mountain and going home."
The car drove to the door, but Xu Jinping didn't get out of the car, but only waved at her brother and sister-in-law.
The newlyweds are like glue, so they shouldn't be light bulbs.
"Well, you two should be careful when you go down the mountain. Xiaoyu didn't drink less today, so don't let him drive." Xu Haiyuan was not at ease, and specially instructed.
"Understood, don't worry." Xu Jinping agreed and drove down the mountain.
"Xiaoyu, where are you going to stay tonight? Are you going back to your house? Or, let's go back to the karaoke hall together?"
Xu Jinping asked Yang Haoyu while driving.
"Sister, can we find a place to sit down and chat for a while? I've been busy these days, and I haven't had a chance to have a good chat with you."
Yang Haoyu leaned on the back of the chair, turned his head to look at Xu Jinping, and asked tentatively.
"Okay, how about this, let's go to Songjianghe, find a skewer shop and go.
It just so happens that I haven't eaten much today, so I'm hungry. "
Xu Jinping actually had something to say to Yang Haoyu, and the two agreed.
Xu Jinping called Xu Haiqing to find out which chain store in Songjianghe was better and where it was located.
Not at home for several years, Donggang Songjianghe has changed too much, and it took a lot of effort to finally find a place.
The two found a small table, sat down facing each other, ordered a bunch of skewers, two bottles of beer, and chatted while eating.
"Sister, we will be twenty-eight after the Chinese New Year, haven't you considered lifelong events?"
Yang Haoyu drank a glass of beer and mustered up his courage to ask.
"In these years, haven't you met someone who can make you fall in love?"
Xu Jinping took a sip of wine and looked at the person opposite.
With the tacit understanding that the two grew up together, she could tell at a glance the anxiety and uneasiness behind Yang Haoyu's pretending to be calm.
"Xiaoyu, when I said those words to my dad in the villa, there was no other meaning. I'm sorry, I hurt your heart."
This was a lump in her heart. Back then, Yang Haoyu left without listening to her explanation, and the two of them never met again.
Today, she had to say it.
"No, I'm not sad, really." Yang Haoyu didn't expect Xu Jinping to mention this matter, and was stunned for a while.
“At that time, I was actually quite confused, and I didn’t know what to do next.
Others think that I can go to Tsinghua University to study, which is the best future, but I am not very happy, and I can't find the direction of life.
You also know that in the first twenty years of my life, I almost followed you.
You are going to the provincial capital to study, so I will follow you to the provincial capital.
You want to go to Peking University, I originally wanted to go to Peking University, but you said that Tsinghua University is more suitable for me, so I went to Tsinghua University. "
Yang Haoyu smiled wryly. Back then, he never thought about anything else, he just wanted to be with the second sister and stay with the second sister all the time.
But he never thought about whether people would let him follow.
"I went to find you that day, and just overheard the conversation between you and godfather, and I suddenly came to my senses.
I have been under your protection for so many years, it is time to grow up independently.
I should be that towering tree, protecting you from wind and rain.
So, I chose to serve as a soldier, to train myself well in the army, so that I can grow into a real man. "
"Later, I found that I liked this kind of life very much, so after I retired from the army and went back to study, I submitted an application again, and I was admitted to the National University of Science and Technology of China.
Sister, I never blamed you. If it weren't for what you said that day, I might not be able to find the direction of my life. "
When Yang Haoyu was speaking, Xu Jinping kept looking at him, seeing joy and love in his eyes.
Xu Jinping knew that what Yang Haoyu said was true, not to comfort her.
"Then do I count it as a mistake? On the contrary, I have fulfilled you?"
Xu Jinping smiled with relief. This matter has been in her heart for many years, and now she is finally relieved.
"Of course, my sister has always been the noble person in my life, the light that I want to chase after."
Yang Haoyu looked at Xu Jinping, against the backdrop of the lights, his dark eyes were full of tender affection.
"Sister, you haven't said anything yet, what do you want to do next? Have you really not considered lifelong events?"
When Yang Haoyu said this, although Yang Haoyu was smiling, there was a trace of tension in his voice.
"Just now, you asked me, have you met someone who has fascinated me in these years, right?"
Xu Jinping suddenly smiled, very free and easy with a hint of determination.
"But all these years, I have been living alone in my heart, so how can I be tempted by others?
Although that person is stupid, stupid, clingy and follower, I still have him in my heart.
My heart is so big, I can’t live in others, what should I do? "
Xu Jinping has such a character, she doesn't beat around the bush, and just speaks up when she has something to say.
In her view, there is no such thing as girls having to wait for others to confess.
"Sister, are you telling the truth? Didn't you coax me?"
Yang Haoyu stood up suddenly, he didn't know whether he was happy or excited, his face was red, and he didn't know where to put his hands and feet.
"Pinch me quickly, I want to make sure I'm not dreaming, sister, I'm not dreaming."
This guy's voice was raised several degrees, causing people on the table next to him to look at him.
At this time, Yang Haoyu didn't have the time to care whether others looked at him or not.
He held Xu Jinping's hand excitedly, and looked at her.
"Sister, is that what I think? You have me in your heart, right?"
"Why don't I say you're stupid? With your IQ, I really wonder why you went to school."
Xu Jinping smiled, making fun of Yang Haoyu on purpose.
"Sit down, everyone is watching you."
Yang Haoyu didn't care about that, he grabbed Xu Jinping's hand and refused to let go.
"Whoever likes to stare at me, let's go. Those who look at us must have no girlfriends. They envy me."
"I didn't agree to be your girlfriend, don't be too happy."
Xu Jinping thought this guy was too funny, so she said that on purpose to tease him.
No, Yang Haoyu knelt down in front of Xu Jinping on one knee, and took out something from the inside pocket of his coat.
"Sister, I picked this ring when I knew you came back, and I don't know if there is a chance to give it to you.
Fortunately, God has mercy on me and really gave me a chance. Sister, would you like to be my girlfriend? "
Now, it was Xu Jinping's turn to be dumbfounded. How could she have imagined that this silly boy had prepared the ring in advance.
Those people around who were eating skewers, they all stood up and stretched their necks to look this way.
Seeing someone holding a ring, as if proposing marriage, some people booed and shouted yes to him.
It doesn't matter if you shout, all the customers in the shop followed suit, even the waiter stopped working, clapped their hands and shouted together.
Xu Jinping is not that hypocritical, so she simply nodded, "Okay, I promise you."
Yang Haoyu put the ring on Xu Jinping's hand, then stood up and embraced Xu Jinping in his arms.
"Sister, I finally waited until this day."
There was warm applause from all around, and everyone watching the excitement smiled and sent blessings.
At this point, how can I care about what skewers to eat? Yang Haoyu is eager to share his joy with the whole world immediately.
"Go, sister, let's go home. I have to tell my parents the good news."
After finishing speaking, Yang Haoyu dragged Xu Jinping out.
Fortunately, he went to pay the bill just now, so the waiter would not chase them out to stop them.
Both of them were drinking, and neither of them was driving. They stopped a taxi and told the driver the address.
Because of Donggang’s tourism development, Yang Junxian’s family had moved to the large group area where they originally lived.
Xu Shiyan built several small two-story buildings at the location of the original oil depot.
Several managers of Shenye Company each kept a set, and both Xu Shiyan and Yang Junxian also kept a set, and Yang and Xu were next to each other.
The taxi drove all the way to the place according to the address Yang Haoyu said.
At this time, the Xu family's side is brightly lit, and relatives and friends are chatting and joking here.
Yang Haoyu dragged Xu Jinping out of the car, and the two of them just entered the courtyard hand in hand, and opened the door to enter the house.
Sure enough, a whole room of people from the Xu family, even Yang Junxian and his wife, were here.
The big guys were all joking and chatting. When they heard someone coming in, they turned their heads and glanced at the door. Then, everyone was stunned.
"What are you two?"
Xu Shiyan watched his daughter and Qianer walk in the door holding hands, and felt mixed feelings for a while, ranging from joy to sadness.
The cabbage in his family was overwhelmed by the pigs he raised since he was a child.
Over there, Yang Junxian and his wife are also stupid. What's going on? "Xiaoyu, what's the matter?"
When the two children were young, they held hands all the time, but now that they are older, they will be twenty-eight. If they enter the door holding hands like this, the meaning is different.
"Father, mother, godfather, godmother, I announce one thing. Starting today, my sister will be my girlfriend."
Yang Haoyu held Xu Jinping's hand tightly and announced loudly to everyone in the room.
"Oh my god, our Pingping finally got the hang of it.
I was still thinking, when will she realize that she has the best young man by her side. "
On the other end, Xu Chenghou, who was in his eighties, glanced at his wife and smiled contentedly.
Although the old man is so old, he is not deaf and blind, he is good everywhere.
"Isn't it? I've said all these years that this kid is stupid.
Xiaoyu is so nice, why didn't she know how to drag her home. "
Zhou Guilan was also having fun there. The old lady is also in good health, not deaf or deaf, and has a particularly good spirit.
Since Qin Yijing came to Donggang that year, the old couple had chatted with Xu Shiyan and his wife.
They picked up all the boys they knew, and they all thought that Yang Haoyu and Xu Jinping were the best match.
At that time, they were still thinking about finding a way to match the two during the Chinese New Year, but before the Chinese New Year, Yang Haoyu joined the army.
In these years, everyone is worried. On the one hand, they are afraid that Yang Haoyu will meet the girl he likes at UCAS, and on the other hand, they are worried that Xu Jinping will find a foreign son-in-law abroad.
Seeing the two of them together now makes them really happy, and I don't know what to do.
Yang Junxian and his wife, let alone Xu Jinping.
I also said in private that if Xu Jinping could be the daughter-in-law of the Yang family, how great would it be?
Now that the dream has come true, Yang Junxian and his wife are so happy that they can't even close their mouths.
Just like that, Yang Haoyu and Xu Jinping officially appeared in front of everyone as boyfriend and girlfriend.
When Xu Haiqing and Xu Jinhui came back after having enough fun in the middle of the night, they realized that they just accompanied those people to the karaoke hall for half the night, and the second sister and the third brother became partners.
And that Xu Haiyuan, who was sweet with his wife in the resort, returned home three days later, only to find out that he was just married, and his sister was abducted by that brat Yang Haoyu.
So, Xu Haiyuan and Xu Haiqing directly pushed Yang Haoyu out and had a very "friendly" discussion.
It's a pity that the Yang Haoyu of today is not what he used to be. The fists of the two brothers of the Xu family are not worth mentioning in front of him.
Of course, Yang Haoyu didn't dare to offend his uncle and brother-in-law. In the end, he was beaten twice, and the two brothers gave up.
He only asked Yang Haoyu to promise that he would treat Xu Jinping well for the rest of his life.
Xu Jinping returned to the country, Xu Haiyuan got married, this year can be said to be a real reunion for the Xu family.
On the sixth day of the new year, Yang Haoyu set off to return to the army, and the four brothers and sisters of the Xu family returned to the capital.
After that, Xu Jinping went to Peking University to go through the relevant procedures and teach in the School of Mathematics.
Yang Haoyu's unit is not too far from the capital.
Xu Jinping can go to see him on holidays, and when Yang Haoyu has vacations, he can also come to the capital to see Xu Jinping, and the relationship between the two has grown stronger as they get along.
In the summer of 2006, the parents of Yang and Xu took advantage of the time when Xu Jinping was on vacation and Yang Haoyu was on vacation, and they got engaged.
In January 2007, the two held a collective wedding in Yang Haoyu's army, and then returned to the Northeast to hold a grand wedding according to their elders' request.
At the end of 2007, Xu Jinping gave birth to a boy in the capital, named Yang Xihang.
Due to the work of both parties, the couple can only have this one child.
But no one expected that in the winter of 15 years, Xu Jinping got pregnant unexpectedly, and the couple gritted their teeth and decided to have this child.
It happened to be released in 2016, and the child landed safely in the autumn. It was a very beautiful little girl named Yang Xiran.
Since then, Yang Xihang has a younger sister who is nine years younger than him.
It may have disappointed many readers. Yang Haoyu and Xu Jinping are official partners, which was fixed from the beginning and cannot be changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 803: Extra Story by Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing
chapters.content:
The Xu family has four children, the two older ones never have to worry about it at home, but the two younger ones make Xu Shiyan and his wife very worried.
Xu Jinhui has been gentle and well-behaved since she was a child. She does whatever her parents say, and she does whatever her brothers and sisters arrange.
Xu Shiyan was worried, the little girl is too submissive and has no temper at all, what if she is bullied in the future?
Elementary school is attending, everyone knows whose family Xu Jinhui is from, and no one dares to mess with her, but what about junior high school?
Those years were chaotic, Songjianghe's children were wild, and fighting and so on were commonplace.
My daughter is so honest, she won't tell me if she gets bullied, what can I do?
As for the youngest son, let alone, he can get into any mischief in a day.
Apart from that good mouth, I really can't find any advantages.
For him, Xu Shiyan really put in a lot of thought. The primary school was arranged to go to the Canchang Children's School, and the junior high school was assigned to Songlin No. 1 Middle School.
Songlin No. 1 Middle School is a school for the children of the Forestry Bureau. The Forestry Bureau was prosperous in those years, and the forestry children were also proud. In fact, they were very xenophobic.
However, Xu Haiqing passed by. Not only was he not excluded, but he also gathered a large group of students who were not very good at learning.
In that year, the Songjiang River was chaotic and there were many bastards.
Xu Haiqing led the students to support the scene to avoid being bullied.
It may be precisely because of this reason that everyone knows that Xu Jinhui has a twin brother who cannot be messed with.
She is very powerful, she is considered a leader in the middle school, so no one dares to bully Xu Jinhui.
In elementary school, Xu Haiqing was disobedient and taunted, but Xu Jinhui was still able to control her and beat her up with a broom.
When he arrived in middle school, Xu Haiqing jumped up, a head taller than Xu Jinhui.
The big long legs, his sister's expression was wrong, the brat ran away, and ran away without a trace.
Xu Jinhui couldn't control it at all, so she had no choice but to go home and sue.
Xu Shiyan has always been strict with his youngest son, but the more this is the case, the more rebellious the child will be.
In the past, when he got angry, he would beat him up. Later, Xu Haiqing's head was much taller than Xu Shiyan's, so it was no longer easy to beat.
No way, Xu Shiyan found his son and had a peaceful talk with him.
"What's your plan? Just thinking about messing around like this?
how? Are you taking charge of the school now, and you will be the boss in society in the future? "
Xu Shiyan didn't plan to talk to his son at home, so the father and son found a small restaurant, ordered four small dishes, and a few bottles of beer, and chatted while eating.
To save the child from being rebellious and quarreling before finishing a few sentences.
"Dad, I don't think this is okay now.
Anyway, I was not as good as my eldest brother and second sister in my studies, and my family didn't expect me to pass the university entrance examination.
I can do whatever I want, isn’t it just to get a diploma when I come to school? "
Xu Haiqing looked indifferent, it would be nice to have three promising people in the family, not bad for him.
Xu Shiyan poured a glass of wine and put it in front of his son.
"I know, you are actually under a lot of pressure.
Your eldest brother and second sister in our family are all very promising. Their aura is too great, and it is easy to overwhelm you. "
There is an old saying that in a family, it takes almost all the luck of the entire family to raise a child as amazing and talented as Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping.
In the next few years, there may only be some mediocre people.
Although this statement is a bit superstitious, it actually makes sense.
Because the brilliance of this genius is too dazzling, it makes everyone else dim.
Invisibly, it puts too much pressure on other people, and most people can't get out of the shadows at all.
The Xu family is fine. Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping came out earlier, and they didn't affect Xu Jinhui too much.
Although Xu Jinhui is not as evil as her elder brother and sister, she can still stay in the top ten of her grade.
Only this Xu Haiqing, a child who is a little bit broken, obviously very smart, just refuses to study hard.
"Your mother and I have been trying our best to avoid this problem.
We have never dared to say things like see how your brother and sister are doing in front of you.
You can't deny that, can you? Did we say that in front of both of you? "
Xu Shiyan poured himself a glass of wine, touched his son with the glass, and took a sip.
Xu Haiqing also took a sip, then nodded.
"Dad, I know, you are all for my own good.
But I just can't get up the energy to study. When I see books and things, my brain is buzzing. "
Xu Shiyan laughed when he heard it, "You are just like your second uncle back then.
When your second uncle was studying, he refused to study anyway.
But your second uncle was able to farm and work without studying.
Later, didn’t your second uncle also regret it, and went to the Agricultural University to study again?
You don’t study now, can you plant ginseng and dig the soil? "
"With our family's conditions, even if you really don't want to go to school, with me and your mother around, how can you keep you from worrying about food and drink for the rest of your life.
But son, have you ever thought about it, if you go down the current path, where will you go? "
Xu Shiyan looked up and looked at his youngest son.
"If you really want to go this way, your dad can't help you.
With me here, within three years, let alone Song Jianghe, I can make you the boss of the whole county.
But have you thought about it, what can you do afterwards? "The expression on Xu Shiyan's face gradually became serious, and there was no smile at all.
How old is Xu Haiqing, a child of sixteen or seventeen, who is just trying to have fun for a while, how does he know this?
"I don't know." He shook his head honestly.
"It's very simple, when the time comes, you will either go in and eat peanuts, or you will be hacked to death.
Really, there is no other way. When Xu Shiyan said this, he sighed.
"Do you remember your Uncle Cao? It's Cao Libin from Songjianghe. Do you know what happened to him in the end? He was hacked to death."
Back then, Xu Shiyan had some friendship with Cao Libin, and he kept persuading him to follow the right path, so that he would not be arrested at that time.
Cao Libin agreed at the time, and was planning to lead those under his command to change careers.
As a result, one day he was negligent, and was blocked by people looking for revenge. There were many people on the other side. Cao Libin was surrounded by seven or eight people and hacked to death.
Although the other group of people did not run away later, the dead cannot be brought back to life.
"With your Uncle Cao's ability, you still can't avoid such a fate, do you think you are better than him?"
Xu Haiqing was overwhelmed by his father's words, and stood there for a long time.
"Dad, I know, I'm going back to school to study, and I won't mess around anymore."
Just like that, Xu Haiqing went back to school obediently, and never skipped class or went out to fight.
But at that time, he was in the third year of junior high school, and the senior high school entrance examination was about to take place. Even if Xu Haiqing put his heart into studying, his grades would not be too good.
Thanks to the fact that I went to Pine Forest No. 1 Middle School, even if my grades were not good, I could still go to Pine Forest High School.
Songlin High School is a high school run by the Songjianghe Forestry Bureau. It is a place for forestry children to study.
Back then the Forestry Bureau was rich, and teachers’ salaries were much better than those in local governments.
In order to encourage teachers and students, the Forestry Bureau also spends money in real money.
When I was admitted to Tsinghua University and Peking University, the Forestry Bureau gave me tens of thousands of cash rewards.
There were five high schools in the county at that time, Lulin (Lushuihe Forestry Bureau High School), Songlin (Songjianghe Forestry Bureau High School), Quanlin (Quanyang Forestry Bureau High School), Fusong No. 1 Middle School, Fusong No. 4 Middle School (Donggang High School) .
Among the five high schools, Lulin ranked first.
Xu Shiyan mentioned that the student who entered the county annals belonged to Lu Lin. In 1991, he participated in the National Mathematics League and won the third prize in the country.
Since then, Lu Lin can be said to have become famous and became the boss of the five high schools.
Songlin can be ranked second, and the county No. 1 middle school and No. 4 middle school compete for the third and fourth place.
But in 1997, Donggang High School, also known as the No. 4 Middle School, was poached from a large number of good teachers.
So it was not as good as No. 1 Middle School, and sometimes even Tranlin couldn't do it.
After Xu Jinhui arrived in high school, her grades have been very stable, probably in the top ten.
The first semester of high school is divided into arts and sciences. Xu Shiyan doesn't know much about these, so he can only ask others whether it is better to study literature or theory.
Because Xu Jinfeng and Xu Jinxiu did not get good grades when they studied literature.
Xu Shixian and his wife said, don’t study literature, because the way to study literature is narrow, it is better to study theory.
Both Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping have learned theories, and they also think that the theories are good, and they will have a wide range of employment opportunities in the future.
Actually, this high school is divided into arts and sciences, so it’s really not that students can learn whatever they want.
It doesn’t matter if you have good grades, you can go anywhere. If your grades are slightly worse, the teacher does not recommend studying Chinese, because the exam is too difficult.
Pinewood High School itself is good at science, and there are few liberal arts classes. If you want to enter a liberal arts class, you have to get pretty good grades.
Xu Jinhui is good at the three main subjects, and the other subjects are almost the same, and both arts and sciences are good, so she chose science.
As for Xu Haiqing, he just went to junior high school and didn't have a good foundation. There is actually no difference in studying literature and science.
The daughter is easy to handle, but the son is too worried.
Xu Shiyan asked people in various ways, and consulted about the children's division of arts and sciences, and the college entrance examination.
The leader of the Municipal Education Bureau told Xu Shiyan that if Xu Haiqing's grades can be maintained, and now that he has caught up with the expansion of enrollment, he can almost take a junior college exam, and maybe he can even take a private course.
The private capital costs a lot of money, and the employment prospects are hard to say.
Since Xu Haiqing is quite talented in art, why not let him study literature and pass the art test.
If you can really perform well, you can go to a school of military art or Chinese opera, which is much better than a junior college.
Xu Shiyan got excited when he heard this. Yes, he took the art test, and the requirements for cultural courses were not that high.
If Xu Jinhui kept an eye on her, she would really be able to pass the exam. Give it a try, what can you do for the sake of your child's future?
That's it, Xu Haiqing studies literature.
Xu Shiyan asked someone to find a relationship, and let Xu Haiqing go to the art academy in the provincial capital to study for a period of time every year to prepare for the art exam.
Not to mention, Xu Haiqing is indeed talented in this area.
The teacher of the art college said that as long as the child is not too bad in culture, he will definitely pass the exam.
With the encouragement of the teacher, and Xu Haiqing also really realized the importance of learning and changed his attitude.
So not only did he do well in professional courses, but he also made progress in cultural courses.
In fact, Xu Haiqing is not stupid. I know it too. There are four children in the family, and all three of them have high IQs. How could Xu Haiqing be really stupid?
He just didn't want to study before, but now that he realizes this aspect and is willing to work hard, it must be no problem.
At the end of two thousand years, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying accompanied their son to take the professional examination for art colleges that can recruit students in Kyrgyzstan.
In the end, Xu Haiqing passed five tests and defeated six generals, and obtained a military art certificate. As long as he passed the cultural class, he could be admitted to military art.
In June 2001, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing took the college entrance examination.
This is their second year in Kyrgyzstan. In other words, in addition to the three main subjects of science, they also need to take a comprehensive test of physics, chemistry and biology, and the liberal arts is a comprehensive history and land administration.
Xu Jinhui's Chinese and English are particularly good, with 135 points in Chinese, 138 points in English, and a little bit worse in mathematics, and she passed 120 points in the test.
Girls, most physics and chemistry students are a little bit worse, and Xu Jinhui is also like this, but he can't stand the fact that his family has three good people.
Xu Haiyuan is busy, and few come back from winter and summer vacations, but he can collect question banks for his younger siblings.
Xu Jinping and Yang Haoyu came back from the winter and summer vacations to make up homework for their younger siblings.
So Xu Jinhui's comprehensive science is passable, and she can usually get two hundred and twenty points in the test.
This is the first time that the family has a student taking the college entrance examination, not to mention Xu Shiyan and his wife, even Xu Haiyuan and Xu Jinping who are studying outside are very attentive.
The two of them collected a lot of questions for their younger siblings. Xu Haiyuan also found the college entrance examination questions from Kyrgyzstan over the years to study.
Not to mention, the bet was really right, Xu Jinhui scored 277 in the comprehensive science test.
Now, the total score is six hundred and seven. With this score, you can enter some majors in Qingbei.
Xu Jinhui and the others are different at this time. After the test results are obtained, they report their volunteers according to the results.
The two elders in the family have never applied for volunteering, and Xu Shiyan and his wife don't understand these things, so they can only listen to the teachers and children.
As for Xu Jinhui, at that time, she considered that the participating companies were mainly engaged in exports and had a lot of dealings with foreigners.
She wanted to help a family, so she simply enrolled in a foreign language school, whether it was to learn a foreign language or international economics and trade, these were fine.
According to Xu Jinhui's college entrance examination results, plus the admission scores in the past few years, the teacher recommended, saying that BFSU and China Foreign Affairs University are both very good, and Xu Jinhui's grades must be no problem.
Beiwai was the first batch of admissions, and the China Foreign Affairs University was approved in advance. Xu Jinhui didn't think much about it at the time, so they all applied.
Hit the grass and beat the rabbit, these two are very good schools, and you can get into either of them well.
Then, Xu Jinhui was successfully admitted to China Foreign Affairs University.
Xu Haiqing also studied desperately in the last few months. He was in good condition during the exam, and he performed exceptionally well.
I got 128 in Chinese, 113 in English, 95 points in mathematics, and 212 in liberal arts.
The total score of the test was more than 540, and the first line of Guoji Province was 40 points.
As soon as the score came out, Xu Shiyan's nose was almost crooked.
If he had known that Xiong'er could get such a high score in the test, he couldn't sleep because of worry all day long. Was he begging for help and relying on relationships for him?
It’s enough to take the exam honestly, so why bother to go to the art academy to study, it’s an art exam again?
But the exams are over, and the volunteer application is over, so why talk so much nonsense? It is better to pass the exam than not to pass the exam.
Military skills are very good, just like Xu Haiqing, if he goes there to study hard and exercise, he can also correct his bad habits.
Just like that, Xu Jinhui and Xu Haiqing also went to study in the capital.
Xu Jinhui has excellent undergraduate grades in four years and is directly guaranteed to study in this school.
During the postgraduate study, he still performed very well. After graduation, he was directly recommended to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as a translator.
Xu Jinhui is beautiful and has an excellent personality. During her studies, many people pursued her, but Xu Jinhui devoted herself to studying and rejected everyone.
After the job became stable, under the care of parents and leaders, and through the introduction of his brother Xu Haiyuan, he got acquainted with Gu Tingzhou, a doctor in Xiehe.
To be favored by Xu Haiyuan is definitely not an ordinary person.
Gu Tingzhou was born in a medical family. He was admitted to Peking Union Medical College as a clinical medicine major with excellent grades. After graduation, he stayed in Union Medical College Hospital.
Moreover, Gu Tingzhou is also very good-looking, humble, courteous and gentle.
Xu Jinhui and Gu Tingzhou lived together for about a year, met their parents, got engaged, and entered the marriage hall in early February 2010.
At the end of the same year, Xu Jinhui gave birth to a pair of twins, who perfectly inherited the Xu family's genes.
Xu Haiqing's undergraduate study was acting. When he was a sophomore and a junior, he played a small supporting role in some TV shows.
Graduated from senior year, assigned to a song and dance troupe in the army.
Xu Haiqing has an outstanding appearance, coupled with a background in military art, has an excellent image and temperament, and has participated in many TV shows.
From the supporting role to the leading role, acting all the way, not only honed the acting skills, but also accumulated the audience's attention, which was very recognized by the audience.
During the period, he was also invited to participate in the Spring Festival Gala, and acted in skits and cross talks with others. He was praised as a versatile and talented actor.
Later, Xu Haiqing accepted an invitation from a TV station to be the host of a column, and happened to be acquainted with a female host.
The two had a good impression of each other, and after two years of love, they finally achieved a positive result.
In 13 years, when Xu Haiqing was thirty-two years old, he finally embraced the beauty.
This is the end of the character episode, and tomorrow I will post an afterword in the free chapter, and then explain the last thing clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 807: : Postscript past and present
chapters.content:
: Postscript past and present
Postscript Past and Present
On February 20, 2018, the fifth day of the first lunar month, Xu Shiyan celebrated his sixty-sixth birthday.
Actually, Xu Shiyan's birthday is not at this time, he is on the eighth day of the tenth lunar month.
But everyone was busy at that time, and no one could ask for leave to come back to celebrate his birthday.
In addition, Su Anying asked someone to check, saying that Xu Shiyan can't live a normal life at 66, and it's better to advance.
The couple discussed it with the children, so lets forget about the date of the first month.
The relatives and friends are all at home, and it happens to be lively and lively together.
In fact, in the past few years, most of Xu Shiyan and his wife have been away in winter and returned in summer.
In the autumn of 2007, the ninety-eight-year-old Chu Xuanhuai passed away in his sleep.
Chu Xuanhuai's two sons were sentenced to life in the first place. They performed well in it, and their sentences were commuted for meritorious service. In the end, the sentence was reduced to 20 years, so they failed to send Elder Chu on his last journey.
It was the younger generations of the Chu family who later learned from the principal of the high school that it was Xu Shiyan who sponsored them to go to college.
Chu Junyu called Xu Shiyan to express his gratitude, but Xu Shiyan only said that this was what Chu Xuanhuai meant.
If the younger generations still have a little conscience, just come and see the old man often.
After Chu Junyu and others found out, they rushed to the northeast to visit Chu Xuanhuai. The old man was very happy to finally see his grandchildren.
After that, the children came to visit the old man every year, and Chu Xuanhuai had no regrets.
Old Chu passed away suddenly, Xu Shiyan called to inform the Chu family, Chu Junyu and others rushed over, and at least gave Chu Xuanhuai a ride.
Logically, in Chu Xuanhuai's capacity, he should be sent to the capital after his death for a farewell party, and his ashes should be sent to the Revolutionary Cemetery.
But Chu Xuanhuai didn't want to go through too much trouble, and made a will long ago. After he left, he only had to follow the normal procedures for the funeral.
Burn as soon as possible, don't hold any farewell or memorial service.
Xu Shiyan specially chose a cemetery with excellent Fengshui for the old man according to his last wish.
On the way from Donggang to Southwest Chadajiang, there is a natural pine forest with beautiful mountains and clear waters and a very good environment, where Elder Chu was buried.
With the consent of the Chu family, the bones of Mrs. Chu's wife were moved from the provincial capital and buried with Mrs. Chu.
At the end of 2008, the 86-year-old Xu Chenghou also fell asleep without illness or pain. In 2009, Zhou Guilan also left.
In the previous life, Xu Chenghou died suddenly due to encephalopathy caused by high blood pressure. Zhou Guilan passed away in the autumn of 2008 due to space-occupying lesions of the bile duct, which caused liver cirrhosis, ascites, and gastrointestinal bleeding.
In this life, Xu Shiyan pays special attention to the physical condition of his parents, and treats him as soon as he feels a little uncomfortable.
Especially Zhou Guilan's liver and gallbladder problem, Xu Shiyan pays special attention to it and keeps an eye on it.
In addition, Zhou Guilan lived a smooth life in her later years, unlike her previous life, where she had a lot of troubles and suffered hardships.
So the old lady basically has no major problems, and her physique has always been good.
Its just that Im getting old, and my wife passed away suddenly. In the vernacular, its a flash, so not long after Xu Chenghou passed away, the old lady also left.
Xu Chenghou and Zhou Guilan were buried together. According to their requirements, the cemetery is very close to the cemetery of Chu Xuanhuai and his wife.
Su Weizhong and Han Cai'e also passed away in those few years.
Old people, as they get older, it is inevitable that this day will come.
As a child, I cant accept it for a while, but how can ordinary people decide life, old age, sickness and death?
After finishing the funeral of the elders, Xu Shiyan and his wife were taken to the capital by their children to relax.
Shenye Company has in-depth cooperation with Shenyang College of Pharmaceutical Sciences, which later became the University of Pharmaceutical Sciences. Xu Shiyan is a professor of the University of Pharmaceutical Sciences.
The University of Pharmaceutical Sciences has a special experimental base and research institute in Changbai Mountain, specializing in the protection, development and utilization of various medicinal plants.
So in spring, summer and autumn, Xu Shiyan went back to Donggang to lead students to conduct experiments and research, and manage the company.
In winter, he and Su Anying went to the capital, Shenzhen stock market, Shanghai stock market and other places to investigate.
After so many years of hard work, Xu Shiyan is already the director of the Changbai Mountain Resources Institute and the Soil Research Institute of Jilin Agricultural University, the vice chairman of the Specialty Products Society of the Chinese Agricultural Society, the chairman of the Jilin Ginseng Technology Development Board, and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.
It can be said that Xu Shiyan has achieved the ultimate in ginseng production, processing, utilization and protection in his life.
With Xu Shiyan's current status and the strength of Xu's descendants, Xu Shiyan is going to celebrate his sixty-sixth birthday. Can the battle be too small?
Xu Shiyan's brothers, the Xu family's nephews, all the relatives of the Zhou family and the Su family, the children and relatives of Xu Shiyan and his wife, all came.
Zhao Jianshe, Huang Shengli, Guo Shouye and others, those who should retire now, and those who should retire.
Just taking advantage of the opportunity, they all got together to have fun.
With so many people celebrating birthdays, the birthday banquet must be held in a hotel.
After years of development and construction, the original venue has long since changed its appearance, and all industrial plants have been moved to the industrial concentration area on the outer ring of Songjiang River.
The original participating area has become a prosperous resort integrating accommodation, catering, entertainment, shopping and leisure.
The birthday banquet was arranged in a five-star hotel, and Hershey's guests filled the huge banquet hall.
"Third Uncle, what do you think it would be if the participation company was reformed a few years later?
If that's the case, I guess with your strong support, Sanjiang City can be established, otherwise, Changbaishan Development Zone will be fine. "
Zhou Qingguo, who is one year younger than Xu Shiyan, retired from the province last winter, and rushed back when he learned that Xu Shiyan had passed his birthday.
Bringing up the events of that year, Zhou Qingguo also had various emotions.
In 1996, Changbai Mountain West Scenic Area was established and operated. After that, Shenye Company, under the leadership of Xu Shiyan, began to focus on developing the tourism business on the west **** of Changbai Mountain.
With the success of the Pearl Resort, the people above also saw the huge impact of tourism development on economic development.
Since 2002, the upper management has been thinking about how to develop tourism in Changbai Mountain.
The original idea was to merge Fusong, Antu, and Changbai into one city under the name of Sanjiang.
Unified integration of resources and unified development just happen to manage the three scenic spots in the north, west and south of Changbai Mountain in a unified manner.
As a result, the Hunjiang River, which was later Baishan, and the other end of Yanbian, disagreed, and it became a mess.
Afterwards, the higher-ups thought about dividing Fusong City, Songjianghe, and Donggang separately, and setting up a development zone directly under the province, located in Songjianghe.
As a result, the people in the county disagreed, and they were confused again.
Later it was said that combining Songjianghe and Donggang would not work, and the county refused to let go.
In the end, in 2005, only Donggang was drawn out, and Chixi District of Changbaishan Development Zone was established.
"Impossible, I can at most just propose a plan, I'm not capable of anything else." Xu Shiyan smiled and shook his head when he heard that.
In fact, he also heard some rumors at the beginning, and the higher-ups did have this meaning.
But at that time, the participation company had completed the joint-stock reform and was no longer a state-owned enterprise. Xu Shiyan was not the secretary of a state-owned enterprise, so it was impossible to be transferred to the system again.
Xu Shiyan has been running the company for so many years, and finally managed to grow the company. Could he leave the company and go to the city or the development zone?
At that time, he was fifty years old, why bother to come and worry about those leisurely things?
Besides, Xu Shiyan is too clear about some people's urination, and it is very difficult to deal with the interests of all parties.
He might as well guard the company safely and live his happy life.
"Oh, it's a pity. If a city or district was really established in the first place, it would be even more serious here." Zhou Qinguo still felt it was a pity.
At that time, he had just been transferred from the county to the city, and he hadn't established a firm foothold yet, and he didn't have enough voice to intervene.
Now, I can only sigh.
"It's pretty good now, you can see that ginseng companies have grown and grown, and tourism development is also booming.
We have built roads everywhere here, most of Donggang has been relocated, and the big guys have all lived in high-rise buildings. Arent they all living a good life? "
Xu Shiyan didn't think it was a pity or a pity, he couldn't worry about those things.
He is only responsible for the development and construction of the participation area, and he has no control over other aspects.
In recent years, Changbai Mountain has developed really well.
Changbaishan Airport opened to traffic in 2008, the expressway was also opened to traffic a few years ago, and the high-speed rail is also under construction. It is said that it will be opened to traffic in two or three years.
Chixi District is also actively attracting investment. First, roads were built, and then many hotels were built.
The mountain gate on the west **** was also moved down as a whole, and the Changbai Mountain Tourism Distribution Center was established to drive the development of local tourism economy.
The three villages of Dongcan, Donggang, and Xican were mostly demolished and rebuilt, and the people lived in buildings.
However, compared to the participants here, the construction is still not enough.
In Xu Shiyan's previous life, he stopped participating in the venue in 2003. Later, Chixi District was set up as part of the venue.
In this life, although the ginseng soil planned in the 33rd year is gone, the ginseng field is still there, and the ginseng company is still developing very well.
The main reason is that Xu Shiyan made a plan in advance and directly negotiated cooperation with the Black Province to establish a large-scale ginseng production base there.
Fusong is the most famous hometown of ginseng in the country. After so many years of development, there are very few woodlands where ginseng can be cultivated, only sporadic small plots and second stubble soil.
Second stubble soil refers to the ginseng soil that has been planted with a crop of ginseng.
The fertility of this kind of soil is not much, and there are many bacteria. Even after more than ten years of recuperation, it is difficult to recover.
So when ginseng is replanted in this kind of soil, the fertility is poor and the growth is not good, and it is particularly easy to rot.
Although Yunfeng Ginseng Compound Fertilizer Factory, after years of research, has successfully developed a fertilizer that can improve soil, sterilize and disinfect, and is suitable for second-crop land.
But this cost is not low, and it is not as worry-free as the first stubble.
With the lack of ginseng soil in Fusong area in recent years, ginseng farmers are also looking for other ways out.
At the beginning, they bought ginseng soil and planted ginseng in nearby Antu, Jingyu, Changbai and other places, and later developed to Huadian, Dunhua, Wangqing, Hunchun and other places.
In the end, they basically went out of the province and went straight to Hei Province.
Hei Province is too far away, and it is inconvenient for ordinary resident households to take care of them. In order to maximize profits, most of them adopt the method of on-demand four-year direct rooting, which has poor potency and low price.
Participating companies are different. It is equivalent to relocating the participating companies as a whole, so we still insist on the minimum six-year development method.
The output of ginseng is not low, and the quality can be perfectly controlled.
There is direct supply from the place of origin, and some high-quality ginseng is purchased from the market. These years, the ginseng companies have not only not declined, but have developed even better.
Xu Shiyan has already thought about it. If the development of the Black Province is not good in a few years, he might as well go abroad to Russia to build a field.
There is wild ginseng over there, and it can also develop garden ginseng.
With the participation company as the backer, the subordinate Changbaishan Tourism Development Company will definitely develop well.
What you want to build here does not need to be approved layer by layer, and you don't need to wait for the appropriation from the superior.
The management of the head office has passed the approval, and handed over the formalities, and then what to do.
In last year's year-end report, the tourism development company affiliated to the participating company had an annual revenue of nearly 500 million yuan and a net profit of more than 100 million yuan attributable to the parent.
The surrounding economic growth driven by various projects of tourism companies is not included.
"That's because third uncle is capable. If it were someone else, who would be able to develop the company?" Zhou Qingguo shook his head.
At the beginning, there were so many state-run participants in the county, where did they go in the end?
Three ginseng, three ginseng, and four ginseng have been in recession since 2,000 years ago, and went bankrupt in 2003.
The same is the participation, those are all yellow, only the first participation in the past, and now the participation company is booming, who has the most credit for it?
And if Xu Shiyan could really be transferred to take charge of the overall situation at the beginning, I believe that the development of Changbai Mountain is not limited to this, it should be much more brilliant than it is now.
"Qingguo, we are all old, why worry about those anymore? It's good to live our little life in peace.
Look, the four in our family are all successful, married and harmonious, and have both children.
Let me tell you, no matter how ambitious you are, you cant catch up with your grandchildren and grandchildren who come and call you grandpa, and grandchildren and granddaughters call you grandpa.
I dont think about anything now, its serious to be with the children. "
Xu Shiyan shook his head and looked at the children playing not far away. That was the greatest achievement in his life.
"That's right, what the third brother said is reasonable, what's the use of caring so much? Let's live our own life well.
In these years, we have also been **** and stormy, overcoming obstacles all the way.
It's not easy to be stable, don't think about anything, just enjoy peace of mind. "Huang Shengli echoed in unison.
The development of domestic ginseng processing industry, especially the development and growth of Dongfang Ginseng Industry Company, has attracted the attention of foreign capital.
Those foreign capital initially wanted to win over through cooperation, and later wanted to use capital power to acquire.
After all kinds of methods were useless, these people repeated their tricks and joined forces to suppress the price of domestic ginseng.
In the autumn of 2008, the domestic ginseng market fell again, and it was even worse than that in 1990. The price of a one-stop water ginseng was even as low as six yuan a catty.
Everyone said that it was cheaper than a big turnip.
The price of raw materials has been reduced, and the price of ginseng products has also been reduced across the board.
Dongfang Ginseng Company is the largest processing and exporting enterprise of ginseng products in China. If this wave of blows fails, it will really lose everything.
At that time, it will inevitably end up being acquired by foreign capital.
Especially at this time, participating companies are no longer state-owned enterprises and are facing the most difficult situation.
At that time, Xu Shiyan and Su Anying used all the funds of the two companies, and even mortgaged all the real estate and real estate in the capital, Shenzhen stock market, Shanghai stock market, and Yangcheng.
Even the antiques and luminous pearls that Xu Shiyan got back then were all auctioned off by him.
Xu Shiqin, Xu Shian, Guo Shouye, Guo Fenghua, Yang Junxian, Huang Shengli and others also tried their best to help.
Coupled with the assistance of the provincial leaders, they provided a large amount of interest-free loans and used all their strength to help.
Xu Shiyan took advantage of the low price of ginseng, bought all the ginseng on the market, and hoarded it without selling it.
At that time, everyone had one idea, fought hard, and fought with their backs.
They came from such a poor life back then, and at worst they would return to the old days.
The poorest is begging for food, and if you don't die, you will eventually come out. With a burst of spirit, he gritted his teeth and survived.
The 2008 year was not over, and the ginseng market rose in a straight line. By 2009, the ginseng market had risen several times.
Especially with the promulgation of relevant policies to restrict land use for deforestation, the planting area of ginseng has been reduced again and again, and the market of ginseng has been rising all the way.
Although there have been some fluctuations in recent years, the overall impact is not significant, and it is still showing an upward trend.
The ginseng company also directly made a lot of money because of this one-handed operation, and everyone who gave up their wealth to help at the beginning also made a lot of money.
Now Huang Shengli and others are old and don't have the energy to do anything else, so they don't mix anything, just pay dividends for the elderly with peace of mind.
As for the children of each family, the promising ones go out to study, or enter the reference company to work.
Those who have no skills can do business and farm at home. With the background laid down by their parents, coupled with the development of Chixi, they can live well no matter what they do.
Zhou Qingguo was right when he thought about it, "It's because I'm short-sighted, it's better for you, follow the three uncles and three aunts, and each one earns a lot, with a net worth of tens of millions."
Zhou Qingguo looked at Huang Shengli and the others and said with emotion.
"Hey, this is not the same, each has its own future.
We are local rich people, you are a great leader, dont you think you are doing well now? "Everyone laughed.
Sixty-sixth birthday, the traditional item that must be kept is dumplings.
My daughter paid for it, and bought six taels of meat and six taels of noodles, and made sixty-eight dumplings.
This work must be done by Xu Jinping and Xu Jinhui. The two of them prepared it in advance and asked the hotel to set aside a separate pot for cooking dumplings.
In addition, Xu Haiyuan and the others prepared a three-tiered cake with candles on it.
Chu Sihan took his younger brothers and sisters, together with Xu Haibo and Xu Haitao's children, a total of twenty or so, sang birthday songs together, and then followed Xu Shiyan to blow out candles and share the cake.
The dumplings happened to be cooked over there, one for heaven and one for earth, and Xu Shiyan ate two more symbolically.
That's all, save the rest and eat slowly at home.
Before the banquet officially started, Xu Haibo, Xu Haiyuan and others ranked according to age, stood upright and saluted, and paid homage to Xu Shiyan's birthday.
"I wish the third uncle, the third uncle, father, and grandpa, be as blessed as Donghai Shoubi Nanshan."
Xu Shiyan was beautiful, with a smile all over his face, "Okay, okay, let me borrow your good words."
Five-star hotel banquets naturally have no specifications, and all kinds of high-end ingredients are made with good taste.
Its been a long time since everyone got together to have fun. It doesnt matter to eat. The main thing is to take the opportunity to chat and connect with each other.
"Brother, try this fish, it's very good, and it doesn't have any spines."
Sitting on Xu Shiyan's left was Guo Shouye, and the two brothers hadn't seen each other for some time.
Guo Shouye is a bit older than Xu Shiyan, and is now in his seventies, but he is in good health and spirit.
Fenglin Flooring Factory was originally co-organized by Shenchang and the Forestry Bureau. When the first batch of enterprises in the Forestry Bureau were transformed, Guo Shouye contracted the flooring factory with Xu Shiyan's support.
In recent years, Fenglin Flooring Factory has branch factories in Songjianghe, counties, Dalian, Nanxun, and Russia. Although it has experienced many setbacks and troubles, it is generally not bad.
Now, the floor factory is in the hands of Guo Shouye's two daughters, especially the youngest daughter, Guo Fengxia, who is as smart and capable as her brother.
Xu Shiyan has 30% of the shares in the flooring factory, but he does not participate in the management and only pays dividends every year.
Quanyang Mineral Water Beverage Factory and Bingshan Mineral Water Factory were originally contracted by Guo Fenghua, and they are developing well now.
Like the flooring factory, Xu Shiyan also holds 30% of the shares, and only receives dividends every year and does not interfere with the management and operation of the factory.
"Well, it's pretty good, but it's still not as delicious as the thin scales you gave me back then."
The fish on the table is golden trout, which is also a famous cold-water fish, artificially raised.
The tourism company has a special cold-water fish base that breeds all kinds of cold-water fish. The golden trout used in today's banquet was transported from the cold-water fish base.
Mentioning the thin scale fish, I remembered how the two met in the first place.
Xu Shiyan laughed, "Yeah, I also think that no fish is as delicious as the wild fine scales in the big river.
It's a pity, when the Xijiang Power Station was built, the river ran out of water, and the fish disappeared. "
Lepidopteris is already a second-class protected animal in the country, and there are very few wild ones, so fishing is prohibited.
This kind of fish breeding technology is very difficult, and the fry are not easy to find. The cold-water fish base has just introduced some, and it has not been cultivated yet.
"Brother, in a blink of an eye, we have known each other for more than forty years."
Guo Shouye, who I met in 1977, only wanted to contact a regular client. Who would have thought that the two would become close friends, and Guo Shouye was also Xu Haiyuan's godfather.
"Yes, we were all young back then, but now we are all old men." Guo Shouye also expressed various emotions.
"Brother, you are my elder brother's nobleman, without you, my elder brother will at most be retired as a director in this life, how can I have a good life today?
Fenghua and the others, if it weren't for you to take care of them, they would definitely not have the future they are today. "
When people get old, they always like to think about the past, and Guo Shouye is no exception.
Every time I think about the past, I feel lucky that I went to the market on a whim and got to know Xu Shiyan.
"Look at what you said, brother is my noble man. I might not have been able to move out of Jiangyan'er's big house without my brother's help back then."
Xu Shiyan laughed and clinked glasses with Guo Shouye. The glass was not wine, but blueberry juice from a beverage factory.
Xu Shiyan celebrated his birthday, everyone took turns to toast and chat with Xu Shiyan for a while.
So the time for this banquet was not short, and when it finally ended, it was almost three o'clock.
The banquet was over, the outsiders took their leave and left, only the Xu family was left, and they all went back to the second floor of Xu Shiyan's house.
This small building occupies a large area. The first floor is a quite large living room, and there is a yard outside.
